title: She's a really good friend.
translation: 她是個很好的朋友。
name: 形容詞片語放在名詞前
sentences: I have a very important meeting at ten.
It was a very old house with a big garden.
My grandfather was a very kind man.
We had a very long day at the airport.
That's a very good question, Ken.
She lives in a very small village in the mountains.
She's a really good friend. She always listens.
We watched a really funny movie last night.
My uncle still drives a really old car to work.
It was a really hot afternoon, so we stayed inside.
Ann made a really nice cake for my birthday.
That was a really difficult test.
We were tired after an extremely long flight from London.
She's an extremely talented singer.
That's an extremely expensive watch.
Thanks for inviting us. It was a pretty good party.
He's a pretty fast runner.
We stayed in a pretty cheap hotel near the station.
My really old laptop finally stopped working.
The very tall man at the back is my uncle.
This really comfortable chair was only twenty dollars.
Their very noisy neighbors moved out last week.
I lost my really nice sunglasses at the beach.
The extremely heavy rain closed the roads.
They sell very fresh fish at that market.
We had really bad weather on our trip.
These are very useful tips for new students.
My neighbors are really friendly people.
The kids need very warm coats for the snow.
This shop sells really cheap clothes.

examples.heading: ① a + very + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: I have a very important meeting at ten.
items.zh: 我十點有一個很重要的會議。

items.en: It was a very old house with a big garden.
items.zh: 那是一棟很老的房子，有個大花園。

items.en: My grandfather was a very kind man.
items.zh: 我爺爺是個很和善的人。

items.en: We had a very long day at the airport.
items.zh: 我們在機場待了很漫長的一天。

items.en: That's a very good question, Ken.
items.zh: Ken，這個問題問得很好。

items.en: She lives in a very small village in the mountains.
items.zh: 她住在山裡一個很小的村子。

examples.heading: ② a + really + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: She's a really good friend. She always listens.
items.zh: 她是個很好的朋友，總是會聽我說。

items.en: We watched a really funny movie last night.
items.zh: 我們昨天晚上看了一部很好笑的電影。

items.en: My uncle still drives a really old car to work.
items.zh: 我叔叔還是開一輛很舊的車去上班。

items.en: It was a really hot afternoon, so we stayed inside.
items.zh: 那天下午很熱，所以我們待在室內。

items.en: Ann made a really nice cake for my birthday.
items.zh: Ann 為我的生日做了一個很棒的蛋糕。

items.en: That was a really difficult test.
items.zh: 那次考試很難。

examples.heading: ③ an + extremely / a + pretty + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: We were tired after an extremely long flight from London.
items.zh: 從倫敦飛來的航程非常長，我們都累了。

items.en: She's an extremely talented singer.
items.zh: 她是個非常有天分的歌手。

items.en: That's an extremely expensive watch.
items.zh: 那是一支非常貴的手錶。

items.en: Thanks for inviting us. It was a pretty good party.
items.zh: 謝謝你邀請我們，派對還不錯。

items.en: He's a pretty fast runner.
items.zh: 他跑得滿快的。

items.en: We stayed in a pretty cheap hotel near the station.
items.zh: 我們住在車站附近一家滿便宜的旅館。

examples.heading: ④ the / my / this + 程度副詞 + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: My really old laptop finally stopped working.
items.zh: 我那台很舊的筆電終於壞了。

items.en: The very tall man at the back is my uncle.
items.zh: 後面那個很高的男人是我叔叔。

items.en: This really comfortable chair was only twenty dollars.
items.zh: 這張很舒服的椅子只要二十塊。

items.en: Their very noisy neighbors moved out last week.
items.zh: 他們那些很吵的鄰居上禮拜搬走了。

items.en: I lost my really nice sunglasses at the beach.
items.zh: 我在海邊弄丟了我那副很好看的太陽眼鏡。

items.en: The extremely heavy rain closed the roads.
items.zh: 那場非常大的雨讓道路封閉了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 程度副詞 + 形容詞 + 複數 / 不可數名詞

items.en: They sell very fresh fish at that market.
items.zh: 那個市場賣的魚很新鮮。

items.en: We had really bad weather on our trip.
items.zh: 我們旅行的時候天氣很差。

items.en: These are very useful tips for new students.
items.zh: 這些對新生來說是很有用的建議。

items.en: My neighbors are really friendly people.
items.zh: 我的鄰居都是很友善的人。

items.en: The kids need very warm coats for the snow.
items.zh: 孩子們需要很保暖的外套才能去雪地。

items.en: This shop sells really cheap clothes.
items.zh: 這家店賣很便宜的衣服。

title: I was very nervous because I was alone at the bus station.
translation: 我一個人在公車站，所以很緊張。
name: a- 開頭的形容詞只當補語
sentences: Be quiet. The baby is asleep.
I was almost asleep when the doorbell rang.
He fell asleep in front of the TV.
The kids were fast asleep by nine.
Is Grandpa still asleep?
I fell asleep on the train and missed my stop.
Are you awake? I need to talk to you.
I was awake all night because of the noise.
Drink some coffee to stay awake.
The baby is awake now. Can you pick her up?
I lay awake thinking about the exam.
I was so happy that my father was still alive.
Is the lobster in the tank still alive?
The old tree is still alive after the storm.
Keep the plants alive while I'm away.
We found the bird alive under the car.
I was alone in the office on Friday night.
My grandmother is alone during the day.
Don't leave the dog alone all day.
I like to be alone when I study.
She was alone on the trip, but she made friends.
I'm often alone, but I'm not lonely.
Don't be afraid to ask questions in class.
My son is afraid of the dark.
The cat looked afraid of the noise.
Were you afraid during the storm?
Grandpa felt alone in the big house.
The kids fell asleep in the back of the car.
Nobody was afraid of the new teacher.
After the long flight, I could hardly stay awake.

examples.heading: ① asleep

items.en: Be quiet. The baby is asleep.
items.zh: 小聲一點，寶寶睡著了。

items.en: I was almost asleep when the doorbell rang.
items.zh: 我快睡著的時候，門鈴響了。

items.en: He fell asleep in front of the TV.
items.zh: 他在電視前面睡著了。

items.en: The kids were fast asleep by nine.
items.zh: 孩子們九點就睡熟了。

items.en: Is Grandpa still asleep?
items.zh: 爺爺還在睡嗎？

items.en: I fell asleep on the train and missed my stop.
items.zh: 我在火車上睡著，坐過站了。

examples.heading: ② awake

items.en: Are you awake? I need to talk to you.
items.zh: 你醒著嗎？我需要跟你說話。

items.en: I was awake all night because of the noise.
items.zh: 因為太吵，我整晚都沒睡。

items.en: Drink some coffee to stay awake.
items.zh: 喝點咖啡保持清醒。

items.en: The baby is awake now. Can you pick her up?
items.zh: 寶寶醒了，你可以把她抱起來嗎？

items.en: I lay awake thinking about the exam.
items.zh: 我躺著睡不著，一直想著考試。

examples.heading: ③ alive

items.en: I was so happy that my father was still alive.
items.zh: 我很高興我爸爸還活著。

items.en: Is the lobster in the tank still alive?
items.zh: 水箱裡那隻龍蝦還活著嗎？

items.en: The old tree is still alive after the storm.
items.zh: 暴風雨過後，那棵老樹還活著。

items.en: Keep the plants alive while I'm away.
items.zh: 我不在的時候，別讓這些植物死掉。

items.en: We found the bird alive under the car.
items.zh: 我們在車子底下找到那隻鳥，牠還活著。

examples.heading: ④ alone

items.en: I was alone in the office on Friday night.
items.zh: 星期五晚上我一個人在辦公室。

items.en: My grandmother is alone during the day.
items.zh: 我奶奶白天一個人在家。

items.en: Don't leave the dog alone all day.
items.zh: 別把狗整天丟著不管。

items.en: I like to be alone when I study.
items.zh: 我讀書的時候喜歡一個人。

items.en: She was alone on the trip, but she made friends.
items.zh: 她這趟旅行是一個人，不過交到了朋友。

items.en: I'm often alone, but I'm not lonely.
items.zh: 我常常一個人，但是我不寂寞。

examples.heading: ⑤ afraid 和連綴動詞

items.en: Don't be afraid to ask questions in class.
items.zh: 上課別害怕發問。

items.en: My son is afraid of the dark.
items.zh: 我兒子怕黑。

items.en: The cat looked afraid of the noise.
items.zh: 那隻貓看起來被聲音嚇到了。

items.en: Were you afraid during the storm?
items.zh: 暴風雨的時候你害怕嗎？

items.en: Grandpa felt alone in the big house.
items.zh: 爺爺在大房子裡覺得孤單。

items.en: The kids fell asleep in the back of the car.
items.zh: 孩子們在車子後座睡著了。

items.en: Nobody was afraid of the new teacher.
items.zh: 沒有人怕新老師。

items.en: After the long flight, I could hardly stay awake.
items.zh: 長途飛行後，我幾乎沒辦法保持清醒。

title: I think we are all very concerned about the present situation.
translation: 我想我們都很擔心現在的情況。
name: 只放名詞前的時間形容詞
sentences: Orders have dropped by half this year. The present situation at the factory is not good.
The old library burned down in 1985. The present building was finished in 1990.
My grandparents sold that house long ago. Who is the present owner of the house?
I'm sorry, sir. At the present time, we have no free rooms.
Why change the way we book holidays? The present system works well.
We've hired five new people this year. Our present office is too small.
Ken talked about his future plans at dinner.
Thank you for the talk about your new book. We'd like to hear about your future projects.
This is my future husband, Tom.
Don't spend all your first salary. Save some money for future needs.
The company wants to open shops in Japan. It is thinking about its future growth.
Let's plant trees along the river. Future generations will thank us.
Mrs. Lin is a former colleague of my father's.
The guide showed us the big room upstairs. In former times, people held dances in this hall.
Our hotel has classrooms for bedrooms. It's in a former school.
Guess who I saw this morning? I met my former boss at the station.
My friends moved out of the village in 2015. Their former house is now a café.
Our university opened a new hall on Monday. The former president gave a speech.
Mr Brown retired two years ago. The present head teacher started last year.
Nobody was ill this morning. Everyone in the class was present today.
The director's name isn't in the notes. Was she present at the meeting?
Let's wait until the sales to buy a sofa. The present prices are too high.
The trains were late that morning. Only ten people were present when the meeting started.
Anna got married again last year. Do you know her former husband?
I've changed jobs. Please send future emails to my new address.
They stopped making cars in our town in 2000. The former factory is now a museum.
The house is cheap, but the roof is old. We need to think about future costs.
You didn't like your last job at the bank. Is your present job interesting?
I've got three wedding invitations this month. My former classmates are getting married.
My sister and her fiancé are building a house. Their future home will be near the sea.

examples.heading: ① present + 名詞

items.en: Orders have dropped by half this year. The present situation at the factory is not good.
items.zh: 今年的訂單少了一半。工廠目前的情況不太好。

items.en: The old library burned down in 1985. The present building was finished in 1990.
items.zh: 舊的圖書館在 1985 年燒掉了。現在的建築是 1990 年完工的。

items.en: My grandparents sold that house long ago. Who is the present owner of the house?
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶很久以前就賣掉那棟房子了。這棟房子現在的屋主是誰？

items.en: I'm sorry, sir. At the present time, we have no free rooms.
items.zh: 先生，很抱歉。目前我們沒有空房。

items.en: Why change the way we book holidays? The present system works well.
items.zh: 為什麼要改我們排休假的方式？目前的制度運作得很好。

items.en: We've hired five new people this year. Our present office is too small.
items.zh: 我們今年請了五個新人。我們現在的辦公室太小了。

examples.heading: ② future + 名詞

items.en: Ken talked about his future plans at dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐時 Ken 聊到他未來的計畫。

items.en: Thank you for the talk about your new book. We'd like to hear about your future projects.
items.zh: 謝謝你介紹你的新書。我們想聽聽你未來的計畫。

items.en: This is my future husband, Tom.
items.zh: 這是我未來的老公，Tom。

items.en: Don't spend all your first salary. Save some money for future needs.
items.zh: 別把第一份薪水全部花掉。存點錢以備將來之需。

items.en: The company wants to open shops in Japan. It is thinking about its future growth.
items.zh: 公司想在日本開店。它在考慮未來的發展。

items.en: Let's plant trees along the river. Future generations will thank us.
items.zh: 我們沿著河邊種樹吧。後代會感謝我們。

examples.heading: ③ former + 名詞

items.en: Mrs. Lin is a former colleague of my father's.
items.zh: 林太太是我爸爸以前的同事。

items.en: The guide showed us the big room upstairs. In former times, people held dances in this hall.
items.zh: 導遊帶我們看樓上的大房間。以前人們會在這個大廳辦舞會。

items.en: Our hotel has classrooms for bedrooms. It's in a former school.
items.zh: 我們的飯店用教室當臥室。它開在一所以前的學校裡。

items.en: Guess who I saw this morning? I met my former boss at the station.
items.zh: 猜猜我今天早上看到誰？我在車站遇到我以前的老闆。

items.en: My friends moved out of the village in 2015. Their former house is now a café.
items.zh: 我朋友們 2015 年搬出那個村子。他們以前住的房子現在是一家咖啡店。

items.en: Our university opened a new hall on Monday. The former president gave a speech.
items.zh: 我們大學星期一啟用了一棟新大樓。前任總統發表了演說。

examples.heading: ④ the present + 名詞 和 be present

items.en: Mr Brown retired two years ago. The present head teacher started last year.
items.zh: 布朗先生兩年前退休了。現任校長是去年上任的。

items.en: Nobody was ill this morning. Everyone in the class was present today.
items.zh: 今天早上沒有人生病。今天班上每個人都到了。

items.en: The director's name isn't in the notes. Was she present at the meeting?
items.zh: 筆記裡沒有主任的名字。她有出席會議嗎？

items.en: Let's wait until the sales to buy a sofa. The present prices are too high.
items.zh: 我們等到打折再買沙發吧。現在的價格太高了。

items.en: The trains were late that morning. Only ten people were present when the meeting started.
items.zh: 那天早上火車誤點。會議開始的時候，只有十個人在場。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: Anna got married again last year. Do you know her former husband?
items.zh: 安娜去年又結婚了。你認識她的前夫嗎？

items.en: I've changed jobs. Please send future emails to my new address.
items.zh: 我換工作了。以後的電子郵件請寄到我的新地址。

items.en: They stopped making cars in our town in 2000. The former factory is now a museum.
items.zh: 我們鎮上 2000 年就不再生產汽車了。以前的工廠現在是博物館。

items.en: The house is cheap, but the roof is old. We need to think about future costs.
items.zh: 那棟房子很便宜，可是屋頂很舊。我們要考慮將來的費用。

items.en: You didn't like your last job at the bank. Is your present job interesting?
items.zh: 你不喜歡你上一份在銀行的工作。你現在的工作有趣嗎？

items.en: I've got three wedding invitations this month. My former classmates are getting married.
items.zh: 我這個月收到三張喜帖。我以前的同學都要結婚了。

items.en: My sister and her fiancé are building a house. Their future home will be near the sea.
items.zh: 我姊姊和她的未婚夫在蓋房子。他們未來的家會在海邊。

title: We have a big garden and a small swimming pool.
translation: 我們有一個大花園和一個小游泳池。

examples.heading: ① a / an + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: I have a small dog. His name is Max.
items.zh: 我有一隻小狗，牠叫 Max。

items.en: My uncle has a big farm with cows.
items.zh: 我叔叔有一座養牛的大農場。

items.en: She has an old bike.
items.zh: 她有一台舊腳踏車。

items.en: It's a nice day. Let's go out.
items.zh: 今天天氣很好，我們出去吧。

items.en: This is my new phone.

examples.heading: ③ 形容詞 + 複數名詞

items.en: They sell nice cakes.
items.zh: 他們賣很好吃的蛋糕。

items.zh: 我們樓上有兩間大房間。

items.en: Tall trees grow along the river.

items.en: My grandparents have three black cats.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶養了三隻黑貓。

items.en: I need new shoes.
items.zh: 我需要新鞋子。

examples.heading: ④ 兩個名詞片語

items.en: Our flat has a big kitchen and a small bathroom.
items.zh: 我們的公寓有一間大廚房和一間小浴室。

items.en: I have a white cat and a brown dog.
items.zh: 我有一隻白貓和一隻棕色的狗。

items.zh: 我想要一杯冷飲和一份熱騰騰的餐點。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和否定句

items.en: Do you have a big family? I have four brothers.
items.zh: 你家人口多嗎？我有四個兄弟。

items.en: Is there a good restaurant near here?
items.zh: 這附近有好吃的餐廳嗎？

items.zh: 我們的廚房不大。

items.zh: 我不喜歡炎熱的天氣。

Your boss and your best friend both need you on Saturday. You're in a complicated situation.

He told us an amusing story about his first job.
My grandmother wears traditional clothes at New Year.
My uncle runs a small bakery in Tainan.
This market sells delicious fresh fruit.
Busy people often skip breakfast.
It's going to snow in the mountains. We need warm clothes for the trip.
The town has narrow streets and old houses.

The hotel has friendly staff and clean rooms.
My new teacher has curly red hair.

items.zh: 我們昨天開了十個小時的車。我們度過了漫長又累人的一天。

items.zh: 我奶奶善良、有智慧、堅強，而且總是很開朗。

items.en: The trip was long, hot, tiring and wonderful.
items.zh: 這趟旅行很長、很熱、很累，可是很棒。

items.en: Our team was fast, strong, smart and lucky.
items.zh: 我們隊速度快、體力好、腦筋靈活，運氣也好。

items.en: The kitchen is small, old, dark and dirty.
items.zh: 廚房又小又舊，又暗又髒。

items.en: Ann is honest, hardworking, polite and very generous.
items.zh: Ann 誠實、勤奮、有禮貌，而且非常大方。

items.en: The café is warm, cozy, friendly and not expensive.
items.zh: 那家咖啡館溫暖、舒適、親切，而且不貴。

examples.heading: ③ and 前面加逗號

items.en: The museum was big, modern, and very interesting.
items.zh: 那間博物館很大、很現代，而且非常有趣。

items.en: My brother is loud, messy, and always hungry.
items.zh: 我弟弟很吵、很亂，而且老是肚子餓。

items.en: The roads were wet, icy, and dangerous.
items.zh: 路面濕滑、結冰，而且很危險。

items.en: The new phone is light, fast, and easy to use.
items.zh: 新手機很輕、很快，而且很好用。

items.en: The lesson was short, clear, and useful.
items.zh: 那堂課很短、很清楚，也很有用。

examples.heading: ④ 不同的時態

items.en: The children will be tired, hungry and dirty after the game.
items.zh: 比賽完以後，孩子們會又累又餓又髒。

items.en: The house was old, cold and empty.
items.zh: 那棟房子又舊又冷，空蕩蕩的。

items.en: My neighbors are quiet, tidy and polite.
items.zh: 我的鄰居很安靜、很愛乾淨，也很有禮貌。

items.en: My first car was small, slow and very cheap.
items.zh: 我的第一輛車又小又慢，而且非常便宜。

items.en: The questions were strange, hard and a little unfair.
items.zh: 那些題目很奇怪、很難，而且有點不公平。

title: We live in an increasingly materialistic, greedy and shallow society.
translation: 我們生活在一個越來越物質、貪婪又膚淺的社會。
name: 多個形容詞，最後兩個用 and 連接

examples.heading: ① 三個以上的形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: He told a long, strange and sad story.
items.zh: 他講了一個又長又奇怪又悲傷的故事。

items.en: They live in a small, dark and noisy flat.
items.zh: 他們住在一間又小又暗又吵的公寓。

items.zh: 我們過著安靜、簡單又快樂的生活。

items.en: It was a hot, dry and dusty afternoon.
items.zh: 那是一個又熱又乾又多灰塵的下午。

items.zh: 一個膽小、害羞、緊張又孤單的男孩坐在角落。

items.en: They wanted a fast, safe, cheap and reliable car.
items.zh: 他們想要一輛快速、安全、便宜又可靠的車。

examples.heading: ② 副詞 + 形容詞

items.en: It is an increasingly busy and crowded city.
items.zh: 那是一座越來越忙碌、越來越擁擠的城市。

items.en: She wrote a deeply moving, honest and beautiful letter.
items.zh: 她寫了一封非常感人、真誠又優美的信。

items.zh: 他做了一場出乎意料簡短、清楚又有用的演講。

items.en: It was a terribly long, boring and pointless meeting.
items.zh: 那是一場非常冗長、無聊又沒有意義的會議。

items.en: We stayed in a beautifully quiet, clean and friendly village.
items.zh: 我們待在一個非常安靜、乾淨又友善的村子。

items.en: They face an extremely difficult, slow and expensive process.
items.zh: 他們面對的是一個極困難、緩慢又昂貴的過程。

examples.heading: ③ 複合形容詞

items.en: A shy, self-conscious and sensitive boy joined our class.
items.zh: 一個害羞、在意別人眼光又敏感的男孩加入了我們班。

items.en: She is an open-minded, hard-working and patient manager.
items.zh: 她是一位心胸開放、勤奮又有耐心的經理。

items.en: She is a cheerful, easy-going and good-natured nurse.
items.zh: 她是一位開朗、隨和又脾氣好的護理師。

items.en: He is a self-assured, confident and even bossy leader.
items.zh: 他是一個很有把握、有自信，甚至有點霸道的領導者。

examples.heading: ④ 放在 be 後面

items.en: He was tired, hungry and very angry.
items.zh: 他又累又餓，而且非常生氣。

items.en: The streets were dark, empty, wet and silent.
items.zh: 街道又暗又空，又濕又安靜。

items.en: The film is long, slow and rather confusing.
items.zh: 那部電影又長又慢，而且相當難懂。

items.en: Our new neighbors are loud, rude and completely careless.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居又吵又沒禮貌，而且完全不在乎。

items.en: The water was clear, cold and surprisingly deep.
items.zh: 水很清澈、很冷，而且出乎意料地深。

items.en: My grandmother was strict, fair and deeply kind.
items.zh: 我奶奶很嚴格、很公平，而且非常善良。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句子

items.en: What a long, hot and tiring day!
items.zh: 多麼漫長、炎熱又累人的一天！

items.en: Was it a cheap, fast and easy trip?
items.zh: 那是一趟便宜、快速又輕鬆的旅行嗎？

items.en: Don't be so rude, lazy and selfish.
items.zh: 不要那麼沒禮貌、懶惰又自私。

items.en: I prefer warm, sunny and quiet places.
items.zh: 我比較喜歡溫暖、晴朗又安靜的地方。

items.en: They built a modern, bright and very expensive school.
items.zh: 他們蓋了一所現代、明亮又非常昂貴的學校。

items.en: She has a calm, low and gentle voice.
items.zh: 她的聲音冷靜、低沉又溫柔。

title: Nowadays, television is getting worse and worse.
translation: 現在的電視越來越難看了。
name: 用 and 連接同一個比較級形容詞
sentences: In autumn, the nights get longer and longer.
The room became hotter and hotter.
The line got longer and longer.
My little brother is getting taller and taller.
The noise grew louder and louder.
The sky became darker and darker.
The bags felt heavier and heavier.
The plane became smaller and smaller in the sky.
Her voice got quieter and quieter.
The roads are getting busier and busier.
Rent is getting more and more expensive.
The story became more and more exciting.
Phones are getting more and more popular with children.
I felt more and more nervous before the test.
The questions got more and more difficult.
Our town is becoming more and more crowded.
The weather is getting more and more unusual.
The meeting became more and more tense.
His English is getting better and better.
The bus service is getting worse and worse.
My cough is getting worse and worse.
Your cooking gets better and better.
The traffic got worse and worse during the day.
Ann's grades are getting better and better.
Is the water getting colder and colder?
Prices will get higher and higher.
The fire grew bigger and bigger.
Life in the city has become faster and faster.
Don't let the problem get bigger and bigger.
Over the years, Ken became more and more confident.
The waves were getting higher and higher.

examples.heading: ① -er + and + -er

items.en: In autumn, the nights get longer and longer.
items.zh: 到了秋天，夜晚越來越長。

items.en: The room became hotter and hotter.
items.zh: 房間越來越熱。

items.en: The line got longer and longer.
items.zh: 隊伍越排越長。

items.en: My little brother is getting taller and taller.
items.zh: 我弟弟越長越高。

items.en: The noise grew louder and louder.
items.zh: 噪音越來越大聲。

items.en: The sky became darker and darker.
items.zh: 天色越來越暗。

items.en: The bags felt heavier and heavier.
items.zh: 那些袋子提起來越來越重。

items.en: The plane became smaller and smaller in the sky.
items.zh: 飛機在天空中變得越來越小。

items.en: Her voice got quieter and quieter.
items.zh: 她的聲音越來越小。

items.en: The roads are getting busier and busier.
items.zh: 路上的車越來越多。

examples.heading: ② more and more + 形容詞

items.en: Rent is getting more and more expensive.
items.zh: 房租越來越貴。

items.en: The story became more and more exciting.
items.zh: 故事越來越精彩。

items.en: Phones are getting more and more popular with children.
items.zh: 手機在小孩之間越來越普遍。

items.en: I felt more and more nervous before the test.
items.zh: 考試前我越來越緊張。

items.en: The questions got more and more difficult.
items.zh: 題目越來越難。

items.en: Our town is becoming more and more crowded.
items.zh: 我們的小鎮越來越擠。

items.en: The weather is getting more and more unusual.
items.zh: 天氣越來越反常。

items.en: The meeting became more and more tense.
items.zh: 會議的氣氛越來越緊張。

examples.heading: ③ 不規則比較級

items.zh: 他的英文越來越好。

items.en: The bus service is getting worse and worse.
items.zh: 公車的服務越來越差。

items.en: My cough is getting worse and worse.
items.zh: 我咳嗽咳得越來越嚴重。

items.en: Your cooking gets better and better.
items.zh: 你的廚藝越來越好。

items.en: The traffic got worse and worse during the day.
items.zh: 白天交通越來越糟。

items.en: Ann's grades are getting better and better.
items.zh: Ann 的成績越來越好。

examples.heading: ④ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: Is the water getting colder and colder?
items.zh: 水是不是越來越冷了？

items.en: Prices will get higher and higher.
items.zh: 物價會越來越高。

items.en: The fire grew bigger and bigger.
items.zh: 火越燒越大。

items.en: Life in the city has become faster and faster.
items.zh: 城市的生活步調越來越快。

items.en: Don't let the problem get bigger and bigger.
items.zh: 別讓問題越變越大。

items.en: Over the years, Ken became more and more confident.
items.zh: 這些年來，Ken 越來越有自信。

items.en: The waves were getting higher and higher.
items.zh: 浪越來越高。

title: The teachers are very nice and friendly.

items.zh: 那是漫長又辛苦的一天。

items.zh: 她的笑容溫暖又親切。

items.en: Ann looked surprised and pleased.
items.zh: Ann 看起來又驚訝又開心。

examples.heading: ④ very / really + 形容詞 + and + 形容詞

items.zh: 這裡的人真的很好，也很樂於幫忙。

items.zh: 那片海灘非常乾淨又漂亮。

items.en: My new phone is really small and fast.
items.zh: 我的新手機真的又小又快。

items.zh: 孩子們很安靜，也很有禮貌。

items.zh: 那間博物館真的很大，也很有趣。

title: The weather was cloudy but fine.

It was too good a chance to miss.
This is too important a decision to make alone.
Ten pounds is too high a price for a sandwich.
It's too nice a day to stay inside.
That was too difficult a question for a beginner.
He's too good a friend to lose over money.

examples.heading: ① as + 形容詞 + a + 名詞 + as（肯定句）

items.en: She is as good a player as her brother.
items.zh: 她跟她哥哥一樣是個好球員。

items.en: This was as cold a winter as last year's.
items.zh: 這個冬天跟去年冬天一樣冷。

items.en: He is as kind a man as you will ever meet.
items.zh: 他是你這輩子會遇到最好心的人。

items.en: This is as good a time as any to start.
items.zh: 現在就是開始的好時機。

items.en: Paris is as expensive a city as London.
items.zh: 巴黎跟倫敦一樣是物價很高的城市。

items.en: It was as long a meeting as last month's.
items.zh: 這次會議跟上個月的一樣長。

examples.heading: ② not as + 形容詞 + a + 名詞 + as（否定句）

items.en: The evening class doesn't attract as large a group as the morning one.
items.zh: 晚上的課吸引的人沒有早上的多。

items.en: It wasn't as good a game as last week's.
items.zh: 這場比賽沒有上禮拜那場好看。

items.en: He isn't as fast a runner as he used to be.
items.zh: 他跑得沒有以前那麼快了。

items.en: The new hotel isn't as big a building as the old one.
items.zh: 新飯店的建築沒有舊的那麼大。

items.en: It wasn't as difficult a test as I expected.
items.zh: 那次考試沒有我想的那麼難。

items.en: This isn't as serious a problem as it looks.
items.zh: 這個問題沒有看起來那麼嚴重。

examples.heading: ③ so + 形容詞 + a + 名詞 + that

items.en: It was so hot a day that the roads melted.
items.zh: 那天熱到路面都融化了。

items.en: He had so strong a shock that he couldn't speak.
items.zh: 他受到的驚嚇大到說不出話來。

items.en: It was so good a film that I watched it twice.
items.zh: 那部電影好看到我看了兩次。

items.en: She gave so clear an answer that nobody asked again.
items.zh: 她回答得清楚到沒有人再問。

items.en: It was so long a journey that we slept on the train.
items.zh: 那趟旅程長到我們在火車上睡著了。

items.en: He is so honest a man that everyone trusts him.
items.zh: 他為人誠實到每個人都信任他。

examples.heading: ④ so + 形容詞 + a + 名詞（沒有 that 子句）

items.en: I've never seen so beautiful a garden.
items.zh: 我從來沒看過這麼漂亮的花園。

items.en: How could so small a mistake cause so much trouble?
items.zh: 這麼小的錯誤怎麼會造成這麼多麻煩？

items.en: Few people have so happy a childhood.
items.zh: 很少人有這麼快樂的童年。

items.en: It's rare to find so quiet a beach in summer.
items.zh: 夏天很難找到這麼安靜的海灘。

examples.heading: ⑤ too + 形容詞 + a + 名詞

items.en: It's too big a risk to take.
items.zh: 這個風險太大了，不能冒。

items.en: That's too long a walk for the kids.
items.zh: 那段路對孩子們來說太遠了。

items.en: It was too good a chance to miss.
items.zh: 那個機會太好了，不能錯過。

items.en: This is too important a decision to make alone.
items.zh: 這個決定太重要了，不能一個人做。

items.en: Ten pounds is too high a price for a sandwich.
items.zh: 一個三明治十英鎊太貴了。

items.en: It's too nice a day to stay inside.
items.zh: 天氣這麼好，不該待在室內。

items.en: That was too difficult a question for a beginner.
items.zh: 那個問題對初學者來說太難了。

items.en: He's too good a friend to lose over money.
items.zh: 他是很好的朋友，不值得為了錢失去他。

title: You can come by bus. It's easier.
translation: 你可以搭公車來，比較方便。

Call me tomorrow. Tomorrow is better.

items.en: The soup was saltier than usual.
items.zh: 湯比平常鹹。

items.en: Use the stairs. They're closer.
items.zh: 走樓梯吧，比較近。

items.en: Sit here. This side is warmer.
items.zh: 坐這裡，這一邊比較溫暖。

items.en: Is the second floor quieter?

examples.heading: ② be + more + 形容詞

items.zh: 穿短褲吧，你會比較舒服。

items.zh: 第二本書比較精彩。

items.en: Online shopping is more convenient.
items.zh: 網路購物比較方便。

items.en: Was the museum more interesting than the zoo?
items.zh: 博物館比動物園有趣嗎？

items.en: The new rules are more difficult to follow.

examples.heading: ③ be + better / worse

items.zh: 明天打給我，明天比較好。

items.zh: 她今天感冒比較嚴重。

items.en: My English is better than last year.
items.zh: 我的英文比去年好。

items.en: The weather was worse in the mountains.
items.zh: 山上的天氣比較糟。

items.en: Is this one better?
items.zh: 這個比較好嗎？

items.en: The traffic is worse on Fridays.
items.zh: 星期五交通比較糟。

examples.heading: ④ It would be better

items.zh: 你五點以後來會比較好。

items.en: It would be better to leave early.
items.zh: 早點出發會比較好。

items.en: It would be better if we met at the station.
items.zh: 我們在車站見面會比較好。

items.en: Wouldn't it be better to wait?
items.zh: 等一下不是比較好嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態

items.zh: 下個月票會比較便宜。

items.en: The beach was cleaner last summer.
items.zh: 去年夏天海灘比較乾淨。

items.en: Ann's new job is easier than her old one.
items.zh: Ann 的新工作比舊的輕鬆。

title: She's my best friend.
translation: 她是我最好的朋友。
name: 最高級 best 用在 my best friend
sentences: This is Ann. She's my best friend from school.

This is a photo of my best friend and me.

Who is your best friend in this class?

My daughter wants a dog too. Her best friend has a dog.
You and Ken are always together. Is he your best friend?
My son sings in a band. His best friend plays the guitar.
I met Sam at the party. Your best friend told me a funny story about you.

My parents asked a friend about my school. Their best friend is a teacher.

Mia and Zoe are my best friends from the dance class.
Kate and I tell each other everything. We are best friends.

You always sit next to Ann. Are you and Ann best friends?
I'm inviting two people to the cinema. My best friends are Lucy and Mary.
Jo and I sat together on the first day at secondary school. We became best friends in the first year.
Look, it's Emma in this old photo. She was my best friend at school.

My best friend moved to Canada, and I miss her a lot.

My grandfather says his old dog is his best friend.
I was crying at the school gate, and a girl gave me a sweet. I met my best friend on the first day of school.

items.zh: 我不搭公車上學。我最好的朋友住在隔壁，我們一起走路去。

items.en: On Saturdays, I play tennis with my best friend.
items.zh: 星期六我都跟我最好的朋友打網球。

items.en: I love Mondays at school. My best friend is in my class this year.
items.zh: 我喜歡星期一上學。我最好的朋友今年跟我同班。

items.zh: 這是我和我最好的朋友的照片。

items.zh: 我在新的城鎮有很多朋友。我最好的朋友叫 Lucy。

items.zh: 我媽說我的電話費太高了。我每天都打電話給我最好的朋友。

items.zh: 你在這個班上最好的朋友是誰？

items.zh: 我哥哥在學日文。他最好的朋友是日本人。

items.zh: 我女兒也想養狗。她最好的朋友養了一隻狗。

items.zh: 我兒子在樂團裡唱歌。他最好的朋友彈吉他。

items.zh: 我在派對上遇到山姆。你最好的朋友跟我講了一件你的趣事。

items.zh: 我爸媽問了一個朋友我學校的事。他們最好的朋友是老師。

items.zh: Bob 常常在我們家。Tom 最好的朋友是 Bob。

items.zh: 我姊姊最好的朋友十六歲，所以她還不能開車。

items.zh: 凱特和我什麼都跟對方說。我們是最好的朋友。

items.zh: 我爸爸和吉姆叔叔每年夏天都去釣魚。他們從學生時代就是最好的朋友。

items.en: You always sit next to Ann. Are you and Ann best friends?
items.zh: 你總是坐在 Ann 旁邊。你和 Ann 是最好的朋友嗎？

items.zh: 我要邀兩個人去看電影。我最好的朋友是 Lucy 和 Mary。

items.zh: 我最好的朋友搬到加拿大了，我很想她。

items.zh: 爺爺，跟我說你小時候的事。你小學時最好的朋友是誰？

items.zh: 我在校門口哭，一個女孩給了我一顆糖。我在開學第一天認識了我最好的朋友。

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + involved

items.en: Thank you for coming to the interview. We'll pay all the travel costs involved.
items.zh: 謝謝你來面試。我們會負擔所有相關的交通費用。

items.en: Everyone involved in the accident spoke to the police.
items.zh: 事故相關的每個人都跟警方談過了。

items.en: The rafting trip was really dangerous. Nobody told us about the risks involved.
items.zh: 泛舟那趟真的很危險。沒人告訴我們其中的風險。

items.en: The school concert raised £2,000. Thanks to everyone involved.
items.zh: 學校音樂會募到兩千英鎊。謝謝所有參與的人。

items.en: We painted the whole house ourselves. The work involved was more than we expected.
items.zh: 我們自己把整間房子漆好。需要做的工作比我們預期的多。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + required / needed

items.en: Our hotel meets all the safety standards required.
items.zh: 我們的飯店符合所有要求的安全標準。

items.en: You need a visa for this trip. Fill in all the forms required.
items.zh: 這趟旅行你需要簽證。請填好所有要求的表格。

items.en: Our old car keeps breaking down, but we don't have the money needed for a new one.
items.zh: 我們的舊車一直壞，可是我們沒有買新車需要的錢。

items.en: We have to be in Leeds by noon. Can you check the time needed for the trip?
items.zh: 我們中午以前要到里茲。你可以查一下這趟路需要的時間嗎？

items.en: We are looking for a new receptionist. The skills required are listed below.
items.zh: 我們在找一位新的櫃台人員。需要的技能列在下面。

items.en: My sister phoned the bank about her loan. She had all the information needed.
items.zh: 我姊姊打電話給銀行問她的貸款。她有所有需要的資料。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + shown / mentioned / given

items.en: The dates shown in red are holidays.
items.zh: 用紅色標示的日期是假日。

items.en: You won't pay more at the till. The prices shown include tax.
items.zh: 你在收銀台不會多付錢。標示的價格含稅。

items.en: The problems mentioned in your letter are now fixed.
items.zh: 你信裡提到的問題現在已經解決了。

items.en: Here's how to set up your new printer. Follow the steps given on this page.
items.zh: 這是你的新印表機的安裝方法。照這一頁給的步驟做。

items.en: Our guidebook is five years old. The hotel mentioned in it is closed now.
items.zh: 我們的旅遊指南是五年前的。裡面提到的那家飯店現在關了。

items.en: Our office has moved. Please use the address given below.
items.zh: 我們的辦公室搬家了。請使用下面提供的地址。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞 + used / chosen / paid

items.en: My son is only seven, but he can read this story alone. The words used in it are easy.
items.zh: 我兒子才七歲，可是他可以自己讀這個故事。裡面用的字很簡單。

items.en: The scientists cleaned the river in a year. The method used was very simple.
items.zh: 科學家一年就把那條河清乾淨了。用的方法很簡單。

items.en: The school picked six students for the science prize. The students chosen will travel to London.
items.zh: 學校挑了六個學生參加科學獎。被選上的學生會去倫敦。

items.en: We painted the baby's room last week. The colors chosen for it are calm.
items.zh: 我們上星期粉刷了寶寶的房間。房間挑的顏色很柔和。

items.en: The school disco has finished. Please count the money collected at the door.
items.zh: 學校的舞會結束了。請點一下在門口收到的錢。

items.en: We spent £500 on my son's birthday. The money spent on the party was too much.
items.zh: 我們為我兒子的生日花了五百英鎊。花在派對上的錢太多了。

examples.heading: ⑤ the people concerned 和其他

items.en: The school bus will not run next week. The families concerned have all been told.
items.zh: 校車下星期停駛。相關的家庭都已經被通知了。

items.en: Some exam papers went missing. The head teacher spoke to the teachers concerned.
items.zh: 有一些考卷不見了。校長跟相關的老師談過了。

items.en: We asked our neighbours about a street party. Most of the people asked said yes.
items.zh: 我們問鄰居要不要辦街頭派對。被問到的人大多說好。

items.en: We cooked too much for the wedding. The food left after the party went to a shelter.
items.zh: 我們為婚禮煮了太多菜。派對剩下的食物送到了收容所。

items.en: Welcome to the hotel. The rooms booked for the conference are on the second floor.
items.zh: 歡迎來到本飯店。為會議訂的房間在二樓。

items.en: The shop is busier now. The changes made last year helped a lot.
items.zh: 那家店現在客人比較多了。去年做的改變幫助很大。

items.en: We had too much cake at the launch. Ten of the people invited didn't come.
items.zh: 發表會的蛋糕太多了。受邀的人有十個沒來。

title: We could travel by boat to a small island full of exotic species of birds.
translation: 我們可以搭船去一座小島，島上到處是珍奇的鳥類。
name: 形容詞片語修飾名詞
sentences: We found a box full of old photos.
He carried a bag full of books.
She gave me a basket full of apples.
It was a room full of noisy children.
They have a garden full of flowers.
I got an email full of mistakes.
We walked along a street full of shops.
Kyoto is a city famous for its old temples.
Students interested in art can join the club.
Spinach is a vegetable rich in iron.
A teacher proud of her students wrote this letter.
We need a person good at math.
I bought a coat similar to yours.
People afraid of dogs should stay inside.
Taiwan is an island famous for its night markets.
It is a town popular with tourists.
Parents worried about their children called the school.
This is a job suitable for students.
They sell shoes good for long walks.
She married a man ten years older than her.
She asked a question difficult to answer.
He wrote a book easy to understand.
We found a house cheap enough to buy.
It was a mistake impossible to fix.
They built a bridge strong enough to carry trucks.
Is there a restaurant open after midnight?
Anyone late for class must wait outside.
Ken has a desk covered with papers.
I want a room big enough for five people.
Find a word similar in meaning to happy.

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + full of + 名詞

items.en: We found a box full of old photos.
items.zh: 我們找到一個裝滿舊照片的盒子。

items.en: He carried a bag full of books.
items.zh: 他提著一個裝滿書的袋子。

items.en: She gave me a basket full of apples.
items.zh: 她給了我一籃滿滿的蘋果。

items.en: It was a room full of noisy children.
items.zh: 那是一個擠滿吵鬧小孩的房間。

items.en: They have a garden full of flowers.
items.zh: 他們有一個開滿花的花園。

items.en: I got an email full of mistakes.
items.zh: 我收到一封錯誤百出的電子郵件。

items.en: We walked along a street full of shops.
items.zh: 我們沿著一條商店林立的街走。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + 其他形容詞 + 介系詞片語

items.en: Kyoto is a city famous for its old temples.
items.zh: 京都是一座以古老寺廟出名的城市。

items.en: Students interested in art can join the club.
items.zh: 對美術有興趣的學生可以加入社團。

items.en: Spinach is a vegetable rich in iron.
items.zh: 菠菜是一種富含鐵質的蔬菜。

items.en: A teacher proud of her students wrote this letter.
items.zh: 一位以學生為榮的老師寫了這封信。

items.en: We need a person good at math.
items.zh: 我們需要一個數學很好的人。

items.en: I bought a coat similar to yours.
items.zh: 我買了一件跟你的很像的外套。

items.en: People afraid of dogs should stay inside.
items.zh: 怕狗的人應該待在裡面。

items.en: Taiwan is an island famous for its night markets.
items.zh: 台灣是一座以夜市出名的島。

items.en: It is a town popular with tourists.
items.zh: 那是一個很受觀光客歡迎的小鎮。

items.en: Parents worried about their children called the school.
items.zh: 擔心孩子的家長打電話到學校。

items.en: This is a job suitable for students.
items.zh: 這是一份適合學生的工作。

items.en: They sell shoes good for long walks.
items.zh: 他們賣適合走遠路的鞋子。

items.en: She married a man ten years older than her.
items.zh: 她嫁給了一個比她大十歲的男人。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + 形容詞 + to 不定詞

items.en: She asked a question difficult to answer.
items.zh: 她問了一個很難回答的問題。

items.en: He wrote a book easy to understand.
items.zh: 他寫了一本很好懂的書。

items.en: We found a house cheap enough to buy.
items.zh: 我們找到一間便宜到買得起的房子。

items.en: It was a mistake impossible to fix.
items.zh: 那是一個沒辦法彌補的錯誤。

items.en: They built a bridge strong enough to carry trucks.
items.zh: 他們蓋了一座夠堅固、能讓卡車通過的橋。

examples.heading: ④ 不同的句子

items.en: Is there a restaurant open after midnight?
items.zh: 有沒有半夜以後還開著的餐廳？

items.en: Anyone late for class must wait outside.
items.zh: 上課遲到的人必須在外面等。

items.en: Ken has a desk covered with papers.
items.zh: Ken 有一張堆滿文件的桌子。

items.en: I want a room big enough for five people.
items.zh: 我想要一間夠住五個人的房間。

items.en: Find a word similar in meaning to happy.
items.zh: 找一個意思跟 happy 相近的字。

title: This place is lovely.
translation: 這個地方很漂亮。
name: 形容詞放在 be 動詞後（少數形容詞）
sentences: Come in! My flat is small, but it's warm.
I like my home because my bedroom is big.
Look at the sea from this window. This place is beautiful.
Your new kitchen is lovely. Did you paint it yourself?
Ann's bike is new. She got it for her birthday.
My grandfather is old, but he walks every day.
Wait a minute. The pizza is very hot.
I'm hungry. What's for dinner, Mom?
My parents are happy with my new school.
The kids are quiet today. Are they sick?
We're ready. Let's go to the station.
Your hands are cold. Put on your gloves.
These bananas are still green, so don't eat them yet.
The concert was loud, and my ears hurt.
Our holiday was great. The weather was sunny every day.
The hotel rooms were small but clean.
I was tired after the long walk.
The questions on the test were easy for me.
Don't worry. The dog isn't dangerous.
My room isn't big, but it has a nice view.
These shoes aren't new. They're my sister's old ones.
I'm not sleepy yet. Can I watch TV?
The bus wasn't late today, for once.
The museum isn't open on Mondays.
Is your new room big?
You didn't eat lunch. Are you hungry now?
Is the coffee still hot?
Was the party fun last night?
Are the people at your new job friendly?
Is the station far from your hotel?

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + is + 形容詞

items.en: Come in! My flat is small, but it's warm.
items.zh: 進來吧！我的公寓很小，不過很暖和。

items.en: I like my home because my bedroom is big.
items.zh: 我喜歡我家，因為我的臥室很大。

items.en: Look at the sea from this window. This place is beautiful.
items.zh: 從這扇窗看海，這個地方好美。

items.en: Your new kitchen is lovely. Did you paint it yourself?
items.zh: 你的新廚房好漂亮，是你自己漆的嗎？

items.en: Ann's bike is new. She got it for her birthday.
items.zh: Ann 的腳踏車是新的，是她的生日禮物。

items.en: My grandfather is old, but he walks every day.
items.zh: 我爺爺年紀大了，但是他每天都去散步。

items.en: Wait a minute. The pizza is very hot.
items.zh: 等一下，披薩很燙。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + am / are + 形容詞

items.en: I'm hungry. What's for dinner, Mom?
items.zh: 媽，我餓了，晚餐吃什麼？

items.en: My parents are happy with my new school.
items.zh: 我爸媽很滿意我的新學校。

items.en: The kids are quiet today. Are they sick?
items.zh: 孩子們今天很安靜，他們生病了嗎？

items.en: We're ready. Let's go to the station.
items.zh: 我們準備好了，去車站吧。

items.en: Your hands are cold. Put on your gloves.
items.zh: 你的手好冰，戴上手套吧。

items.en: These bananas are still green, so don't eat them yet.
items.zh: 這些香蕉還是綠的，先不要吃。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + was / were + 形容詞

items.en: The concert was loud, and my ears hurt.
items.zh: 演唱會很吵，我耳朵好痛。

items.en: Our holiday was great. The weather was sunny every day.
items.zh: 我們的假期很棒，每天都出太陽。

items.en: The hotel rooms were small but clean.
items.zh: 飯店的房間很小，但是很乾淨。

items.en: I was tired after the long walk.
items.zh: 走了一大段路以後，我很累。

items.en: The questions on the test were easy for me.
items.zh: 考試的題目對我來說很簡單。

examples.heading: ④ 否定

items.en: Don't worry. The dog isn't dangerous.
items.zh: 別擔心，那隻狗不兇。

items.en: My room isn't big, but it has a nice view.
items.zh: 我的房間不大，不過景色很好。

items.en: These shoes aren't new. They're my sister's old ones.
items.zh: 這雙鞋不是新的，是我姊姊的舊鞋。

items.en: I'm not sleepy yet. Can I watch TV?
items.zh: 我還不睏，可以看電視嗎？

items.en: The bus wasn't late today, for once.
items.zh: 公車今天難得沒有誤點。

items.en: The museum isn't open on Mondays.
items.zh: 博物館星期一不開放。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句

items.en: Is your new room big?
items.zh: 你的新房間大嗎？

items.en: You didn't eat lunch. Are you hungry now?
items.zh: 你沒吃午餐，現在餓了嗎？

items.en: Is the coffee still hot?
items.zh: 咖啡還是熱的嗎？

items.en: Was the party fun last night?
items.zh: 昨晚的派對好玩嗎？

items.en: Are the people at your new job friendly?
items.zh: 你新工作的同事友善嗎？

items.en: Is the station far from your hotel?
items.zh: 車站離你的飯店遠嗎？

title: I am free Monday morning.
translation: 我星期一早上有空。
name: 形容詞放在 be 動詞後（較多種形容詞）
sentences: I'm free on Monday morning. Can we meet then?
Please call back later. I'm busy right now.
I need to pay this bill. Is the bank open on Saturday?
Dinner is ready! Come and eat.
The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
The fridge is empty. Let's go shopping.
Don't go to the library tomorrow. It's closed on public holidays.
Don't be scared. The spider is tiny.
My brother hasn't phoned home for a week. My mother is worried about him.
The kids couldn't sleep the night before the zoo trip. They were too excited.
I'm sorry. I forgot your birthday.
My sister got married without telling anyone. We were all surprised.
Are you bored? We can play a game.
Everyone at school likes Lucy because she is so friendly.
My uncle is funny. He always makes us laugh.
The nurse was kind and gave my son a sticker.
Ken is shy, so he doesn't talk much in class.
My cousin is clever. She can do math in her head.
The bus drivers here always say good morning. The people in this town are very polite.
You should read this book about space. It's interesting.
The museum was boring, so we left early.
A good night's sleep is important for growing kids.
The driving test was difficult, but I passed on my first try.
There's no lifeguard on this beach. Is it dangerous to swim here?
Let's go back to the new restaurant on Friday. The food there is excellent.
I'm not hungry. I had a big lunch.
The maths test starts in ten minutes. Are you ready?
The shop isn't open yet. It opens at ten.
Congratulations on the new job! Were you nervous before the interview?
You missed the first five minutes, but they weren't important.

examples.heading: ① 狀態

items.en: I'm free on Monday morning. Can we meet then?
items.zh: 我星期一早上有空，我們那時候見面好嗎？

items.en: Please call back later. I'm busy right now.
items.zh: 請晚點再打來，我現在很忙。

items.en: I need to pay this bill. Is the bank open on Saturday?
items.zh: 我要繳這張帳單。銀行星期六有開嗎？

items.en: Dinner is ready! Come and eat.
items.zh: 晚餐好了！來吃吧。

items.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
items.zh: 公車滿了，所以我們等下一班。

items.en: The fridge is empty. Let's go shopping.
items.zh: 冰箱空了，我們去買東西吧。

items.en: Don't go to the library tomorrow. It's closed on public holidays.
items.zh: 明天別去圖書館。國定假日不開放。

examples.heading: ② 感覺

items.en: Don't be scared. The spider is tiny.
items.zh: 別怕，那隻蜘蛛很小。

items.en: My brother hasn't phoned home for a week. My mother is worried about him.
items.zh: 我哥哥一個星期沒打電話回家了。我媽媽很擔心他。

items.en: The kids couldn't sleep the night before the zoo trip. They were too excited.
items.zh: 去動物園的前一晚，孩子們睡不著。他們太興奮了。

items.en: I'm sorry. I forgot your birthday.
items.zh: 對不起，我忘了你的生日。

items.en: My sister got married without telling anyone. We were all surprised.
items.zh: 我姊姊沒告訴任何人就結婚了。我們都嚇了一跳。

items.en: Are you bored? We can play a game.
items.zh: 你覺得無聊嗎？我們可以玩遊戲。

examples.heading: ③ 個性

items.en: Everyone at school likes Lucy because she is so friendly.
items.zh: 學校裡大家都喜歡 Lucy，因為她很友善。

items.en: My uncle is funny. He always makes us laugh.
items.zh: 我叔叔很好笑，他總是逗我們笑。

items.en: The nurse was kind and gave my son a sticker.
items.zh: 護理師人很好，給了我兒子一張貼紙。

items.en: Ken is shy, so he doesn't talk much in class.
items.zh: Ken 很害羞，所以他上課不太說話。

items.en: My cousin is clever. She can do math in her head.
items.zh: 我表姊很聰明，她可以心算。

items.en: The bus drivers here always say good morning. The people in this town are very polite.
items.zh: 這裡的公車司機都會說早安。這個小鎮的人都很有禮貌。

examples.heading: ④ 評價

items.en: You should read this book about space. It's interesting.
items.zh: 你應該看看這本講太空的書，很有趣。

items.en: The museum was boring, so we left early.
items.zh: 博物館很無聊，所以我們提早離開了。

items.en: A good night's sleep is important for growing kids.
items.zh: 睡飽對成長中的孩子很重要。

items.en: The driving test was difficult, but I passed on my first try.
items.zh: 駕照考試很難，不過我第一次就過了。

items.en: There's no lifeguard on this beach. Is it dangerous to swim here?
items.zh: 這個海灘沒有救生員。在這裡游泳危險嗎？

items.en: Let's go back to the new restaurant on Friday. The food there is excellent.
items.zh: 我們星期五再去那家新餐廳吧。那裡的菜很棒。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定和問句

items.en: I'm not hungry. I had a big lunch.
items.zh: 我不餓，我午餐吃很多。

items.en: The maths test starts in ten minutes. Are you ready?
items.zh: 數學考試再十分鐘就開始了。你準備好了嗎？

items.en: The shop isn't open yet. It opens at ten.
items.zh: 那家店還沒開，十點才開。

items.en: Congratulations on the new job! Were you nervous before the interview?
items.zh: 恭喜你找到新工作！面試前你緊張嗎？

items.en: You missed the first five minutes, but they weren't important.
items.zh: 你錯過了前五分鐘，不過那段不重要。

title: It is black and it looks perfect.
translation: 它是黑色的，看起來很完美。
name: 形容詞放在 look、feel 後
sentences: You look cheerful today. Did you get some good news?
Your mom is fifty? She looks young for her age.
You look great in that green jacket.
Look at these holiday photos. The kids look happy at the beach.
Ken looked worried before the test.
You haven't said a word all evening. Why do you look so sad?
The new curtains look perfect in the living room.
Thanks for baking for my birthday. The cake looks delicious.
Thanks for showing me round. Your new flat looks great.
The sky looks dark. It might rain.

examples.heading: ① look + 形容詞（人）

items.en: You look cheerful today. Did you get some good news?
items.zh: 你今天看起來很開心，有什麼好消息嗎？

items.en: Your mom is fifty? She looks young for her age.
items.zh: 你媽媽五十歲了？她看起來比實際年齡年輕。

items.en: You look great in that green jacket.
items.zh: 你穿那件綠色夾克很好看。

items.en: Look at these holiday photos. The kids look happy at the beach.
items.zh: 你看這些度假的照片。孩子們在海邊看起來很開心。

items.en: Ken looked worried before the test.
items.zh: 考試前 Ken 看起來很擔心。

items.en: You haven't said a word all evening. Why do you look so sad?
items.zh: 你整個晚上一句話也沒說。你為什麼看起來這麼難過？

examples.heading: ② look + 形容詞（東西）

items.en: The new curtains look perfect in the living room.
items.zh: 新窗簾掛在客廳看起來很完美。

items.en: Thanks for baking for my birthday. The cake looks delicious.
items.zh: 謝謝你為我的生日烤蛋糕。蛋糕看起來很好吃。

items.en: Thanks for showing me round. Your new flat looks great.
items.zh: 謝謝你帶我參觀。你的新公寓看起來很棒。

items.en: The sky looks dark. It might rain.
items.zh: 天空看起來很暗，可能會下雨。

items.en: Those running shoes in the window look light.
items.zh: 櫥窗裡那雙跑鞋看起來很輕。

items.en: Let's not walk across there. The old bridge looks dangerous.
items.zh: 我們別從那裡走過去。那座舊橋看起來很危險。

examples.heading: ③ feel + 形容詞（人的感覺）

items.en: I always wear these clothes on long flights. I feel comfortable in them.
items.zh: 我搭長途飛機總是穿這些衣服。我穿起來覺得很舒服。

items.en: I feel dizzy. I need to sit down.
items.zh: 我覺得頭暈，我得坐下來。

items.en: She felt nervous before her first day at work.
items.zh: 她第一天上班前覺得很緊張。

items.en: Do you feel cold? I can close the window.
items.zh: 你會冷嗎？我可以關窗。

items.en: We felt sad when our cat died.
items.zh: 我們的貓死掉的時候，我們很難過。

items.en: After a hot shower, I felt warm again.
items.zh: 洗完熱水澡以後，我又覺得暖和了。

examples.heading: ④ feel + 形容詞（摸起來）

items.zh: 寶寶的頭髮摸起來好軟。

items.zh: 下來跟我們一起游泳。水摸起來很溫暖。

items.en: Your forehead feels hot. Do you have a fever?
items.zh: 你的額頭摸起來很燙，你發燒了嗎？

items.en: The bed felt hard, so I didn't sleep well.
items.zh: 床睡起來很硬，所以我沒睡好。

items.en: The towels feel wet. Did someone use them?
items.zh: 毛巾摸起來濕濕的，有人用過嗎？

items.en: Put your slippers on. The floor feels cold in the morning.
items.zh: 穿上你的拖鞋。早上地板踩起來很冰。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定和問句

items.zh: 你看起來不太舒服，你還好嗎？

items.en: Does this shirt look nice with these trousers?
items.zh: 這件襯衫配這條褲子好看嗎？

items.en: Let's have dinner later. I don't feel hungry yet.
items.zh: 我們晚一點再吃晚餐吧。我還不覺得餓。

items.en: Do you feel better after your nap?
items.zh: 你睡完午覺覺得好一點了嗎？

items.en: The hotel room didn't look clean, so we asked for another one.
items.zh: 飯店房間看起來不乾淨，所以我們要求換一間。

items.en: I bought this loaf on Monday. Does it still feel fresh?
items.zh: 這條麵包是我星期一買的。它摸起來還新鮮嗎？

title: Summer is the best time to visit Poland.

examples.heading: ① the best time to

items.en: Spring is the best time to visit Kyoto.
items.zh: 春天是去京都最好的時節。

items.zh: 清晨是去跑步最好的時間。

items.en: When's the best time to call you?
items.zh: 什麼時候打給你最好？

items.en: Now is the best time to buy a new phone.
items.zh: 現在是買新手機最好的時機。

items.en: Winter is the best time to see the northern lights.
items.zh: 冬天是看北極光最好的季節。

examples.heading: ② the best place to

items.en: This is the best place to buy fresh fruit.
items.zh: 這是買新鮮水果最好的地方。

items.en: The roof is the best place to watch the fireworks.
items.zh: 屋頂是看煙火最好的地方。

items.en: Where's the best place to eat around here?
items.zh: 這附近哪裡最適合吃飯？

items.en: The library is the best place to study.
items.zh: 圖書館是讀書最好的地方。

items.en: That beach is the best place to learn to surf.
items.zh: 那片海灘是學衝浪最好的地方。

items.zh: 旅行的事找誰談最好？

items.en: He's the best person to lead the team.
items.zh: 他是最適合帶領這個團隊的人。

items.en: Your doctor is the best person to give you advice.
items.zh: 你的醫生是最適合給你建議的人。

examples.heading: ⑤ the best thing to 和不同的句型

items.en: The best thing to do is wait.
items.zh: 最好的做法是等。

items.en: What's the best thing to eat for breakfast?
items.zh: 早餐吃什麼最好？

items.en: Is this the best road to take?
items.zh: 走這條路最好嗎？

items.en: This is the best book to read on a long flight.

items.en: Sunscreen is the best thing to take to the beach.

items.en: That's the best hotel to stay at near the station.

title: They were the happiest days of my life.
translation: 那些日子是我這輩子最快樂的時光。
name: 最高級加介系詞片語
sentences: We took the kids to see the pandas. Ueno has the oldest zoo in Japan.
More than thirty million people live in and around Tokyo. It's the largest city in Japan.
The guide stopped outside a small stone church. This is the oldest building in the city.
Here's the last question in the quiz. What's the longest river in the world?
Taipei 101 was once the tallest building in the world.
You can't visit Madrid without seeing the Prado. It's the most famous museum in the country.
Mia is the shortest girl in our team.
We had a party for Grandma's ninety-fifth birthday. She's the oldest person in our family.
Put Lily in the last race. She's the fastest swimmer in our club.
Ken is only four. He's the youngest student in the school.
You play basketball every weekend. Who is the best player in your team?
The waiter took us to a corner by the window. This is the quietest table in the restaurant.
Those summers at the beach were the best times of my childhood.
For us, Christmas Day is the happiest day of the year.
We sell lots of toys before Christmas. December is the busiest month of the year.
Our car broke down in the snow, and we slept in it. That was the worst night of my life.
I have six classes and a piano lesson on Fridays. Friday is the longest day of the week for me.
Our goalkeeper saved a penalty in the last minute. It was the most exciting moment of the game.
The shop assistant showed me five phones. This is the cheapest of all the phones.
Mrs Lee always helped me after class. She was the kindest of all my teachers.
Ann can reach the top shelf. She's the tallest of the three sisters.
There are three ways to the station. This road is the shortest of the three.
I failed the chemistry exam. It was the hardest of all the tests.
Invite Jack to the party. He's the funniest of my friends.
We have one day to see the temples. Which is the oldest temple in Tainan?
We've walked for an hour and we're still in the park. Is this the biggest park in Taipei?
My cousin got married by a lake in June. It was the most beautiful wedding of the summer.
I want to read a book from Korea. Who's the most popular writer in your country right now?
All the shops in our village close on Sundays. Sunday is the quietest day of the week here.
Sit here, Grandpa. This is the most comfortable chair in the house.

examples.heading: ① 最高級 + 名詞 + in the world / country / city

items.en: We took the kids to see the pandas. Ueno has the oldest zoo in Japan.
items.zh: 我們帶孩子們去看貓熊。上野有日本最古老的動物園。

items.en: More than thirty million people live in and around Tokyo. It's the largest city in Japan.
items.zh: 東京和周邊住了超過三千萬人。它是日本最大的城市。

items.en: The guide stopped outside a small stone church. This is the oldest building in the city.
items.zh: 導遊在一間石頭砌的小教堂外面停下來。這是這座城市裡最老的建築。

items.en: Here's the last question in the quiz. What's the longest river in the world?
items.zh: 這是問答比賽的最後一題。世界上最長的河是哪一條？

items.en: Taipei 101 was once the tallest building in the world.
items.zh: 台北 101 曾經是世界上最高的大樓。

items.en: You can't visit Madrid without seeing the Prado. It's the most famous museum in the country.
items.zh: 你去馬德里一定要去普拉多。那是這個國家最有名的博物館。

examples.heading: ② 最高級 + 名詞 + in my class / family / team

items.en: Mia is the shortest girl in our team.
items.zh: Mia 是我們隊上最矮的女生。

items.en: We had a party for Grandma's ninety-fifth birthday. She's the oldest person in our family.
items.zh: 我們為奶奶九十五歲生日辦了派對。她是我們家年紀最大的人。

items.en: Put Lily in the last race. She's the fastest swimmer in our club.
items.zh: 讓莉莉游最後一棒。她是我們俱樂部裡游得最快的人。

items.en: Ken is only four. He's the youngest student in the school.
items.zh: Ken 才四歲。他是學校裡年紀最小的學生。

items.en: You play basketball every weekend. Who is the best player in your team?
items.zh: 你每個週末都打籃球。你們隊上最厲害的球員是誰？

items.en: The waiter took us to a corner by the window. This is the quietest table in the restaurant.
items.zh: 服務生帶我們到窗邊的角落。這是餐廳裡最安靜的桌子。

examples.heading: ③ 最高級 + 名詞 + of my life / of the year

items.en: Those summers at the beach were the best times of my childhood.
items.zh: 在海邊度過的那些夏天是我童年最美好的時光。

items.en: For us, Christmas Day is the happiest day of the year.
items.zh: 對我們來說，聖誕節是一年當中最快樂的一天。

items.en: We sell lots of toys before Christmas. December is the busiest month of the year.
items.zh: 聖誕節前我們賣很多玩具。十二月是一年當中最忙的月份。

items.en: Our car broke down in the snow, and we slept in it. That was the worst night of my life.
items.zh: 我們的車在雪地裡拋錨，我們就睡在車上。那是我這輩子最糟的一晚。

items.en: I have six classes and a piano lesson on Fridays. Friday is the longest day of the week for me.
items.zh: 我星期五有六堂課和一堂鋼琴課。對我來說，星期五是一週裡最漫長的一天。

items.en: Our goalkeeper saved a penalty in the last minute. It was the most exciting moment of the game.
items.zh: 我們的守門員在最後一分鐘擋下了一記十二碼罰球。那是比賽中最刺激的一刻。

examples.heading: ④ 最高級 + 名詞 + of all / of the three

items.en: The shop assistant showed me five phones. This is the cheapest of all the phones.
items.zh: 店員給我看了五支手機。這是所有手機裡最便宜的。

items.en: Mrs Lee always helped me after class. She was the kindest of all my teachers.
items.zh: 李老師總是在下課後幫我。她是我所有老師裡最和善的。

items.en: Ann can reach the top shelf. She's the tallest of the three sisters.
items.zh: Ann 搆得到最上面那一層。她是三姊妹裡最高的。

items.en: There are three ways to the station. This road is the shortest of the three.
items.zh: 去車站有三條路。這條路是三條裡最短的。

items.en: I failed the chemistry exam. It was the hardest of all the tests.
items.zh: 我化學考試不及格。那是所有考試裡最難的。

items.en: Invite Jack to the party. He's the funniest of my friends.
items.zh: 邀傑克來派對吧。他是我朋友裡最好笑的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和不同的句型

items.en: We have one day to see the temples. Which is the oldest temple in Tainan?
items.zh: 我們只有一天可以看廟。台南最古老的廟是哪一間？

items.en: We've walked for an hour and we're still in the park. Is this the biggest park in Taipei?
items.zh: 我們走了一個小時，還在公園裡。這是台北最大的公園嗎？

items.en: My cousin got married by a lake in June. It was the most beautiful wedding of the summer.
items.zh: 我表姊六月在湖邊結婚。那是那個夏天最美的婚禮。

items.en: I want to read a book from Korea. Who's the most popular writer in your country right now?
items.zh: 我想讀一本韓國的書。你們國家現在最受歡迎的作家是誰？

items.en: All the shops in our village close on Sundays. Sunday is the quietest day of the week here.
items.zh: 我們村子裡的店星期天都關門。這裡一週最安靜的是星期天。

items.en: Sit here, Grandpa. This is the most comfortable chair in the house.
items.zh: 爺爺，坐這裡。這是家裡最舒服的椅子。

The fish is the most expensive dish on the menu.

This is the best seat on the plane.
He was the oldest man at the meeting.
Venice is one of the most beautiful cities in Europe.
He's one of the best players on the team.
It's one of the most popular shows on TV.
This is one of the oldest buildings in Taipei.
She's one of the kindest people I know.
Rice is one of the most important foods in Asia.
What's the most interesting place in your city?

examples.heading: ① the + 最高級 + 名詞 + of my life / of the year

items.zh: 畢業典禮那天是我爸媽這輩子最驕傲的時刻。

items.zh: 離家是我這輩子最難的決定。

items.zh: 那是這個世紀最冷的冬天。

items.en: Seeing my son walk for the first time made it the best day of my year.
items.zh: 看到我兒子第一次走路，那天成了我今年最棒的一天。

items.en: The typhoon last week brought the heaviest rain of the year.
items.zh: 上禮拜的颱風帶來今年最大的雨。

examples.heading: ② the + 最高級 + 名詞 + in our lives / in history

items.en: Exercise is the most important thing in our lives.
items.zh: 運動是我們生活中最重要的事。

items.en: It was the worst earthquake in the country's history.
items.zh: 那是這個國家史上最嚴重的地震。

items.en: Family is the most precious thing in my life.
items.zh: 家人是我生命中最珍貴的。

items.en: She was the youngest winner in the history of the prize.
items.zh: 她是這個獎項史上最年輕的得主。

items.en: Some people say Bologna has the oldest university in the world.
items.zh: 有人說波隆那有世界上最古老的大學。

examples.heading: ③ the + 最高級 + 名詞 + for / on / at

items.en: Sleep is the best medicine for a cold.
items.zh: 睡覺是治感冒最好的藥。

items.en: Vegetables are the healthiest food for children.
items.zh: 蔬菜是對小孩最健康的食物。

items.en: The fish is the most expensive dish on the menu.
items.zh: 魚是菜單上最貴的菜。

items.en: She was the most beautiful woman at the party.
items.zh: 她是派對上最美的女人。

items.en: This is the best seat on the plane.
items.zh: 這是飛機上最好的位子。

items.en: He was the oldest man at the meeting.
items.zh: 他是會議上年紀最大的人。

examples.heading: ④ one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞

items.zh: 威尼斯是歐洲最美的城市之一。

items.zh: 他是隊上最好的球員之一。

items.en: It's one of the most popular shows on TV.
items.zh: 那是電視上最受歡迎的節目之一。

items.en: This is one of the oldest buildings in Taipei.
items.zh: 這是台北最古老的建築之一。

items.en: She's one of the kindest people I know.
items.zh: 她是我認識最好心的人之一。

items.en: Rice is one of the most important foods in Asia.
items.zh: 米是亞洲最重要的食物之一。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和不同的句型

items.en: What's the most interesting place in your city?
items.zh: 你們城市裡最有趣的地方是哪裡？

items.en: Who was the best teacher at your school?
items.zh: 你學校裡最好的老師是誰？

items.en: What's the most useful app on your phone?
items.zh: 你手機上最有用的 app 是什麼？

items.en: One of the oldest trees in the park fell down last night.
items.zh: 公園裡最老的樹之一昨晚倒了。

items.en: Is this the cheapest flight on the website?
items.zh: 這是網站上最便宜的機票嗎？

items.en: What was the best thing about your holiday in Japan?
items.zh: 你在日本的假期中最棒的是什麼？

items.en: Is Mount Everest the highest mountain on Earth?
items.zh: 聖母峰是地球上最高的山嗎？

items.en: We stood in the longest line at the airport for two hours.
items.zh: 我們在機場最長的隊伍裡站了兩個小時。

title: Suddenly the lights went out, and I found myself standing in complete darkness.
translation: 燈突然熄了，我發現自己站在一片漆黑之中。
name: 名詞前的程度形容詞
sentences: Noise from the bar next door is a real problem for us.
Making friends is easy, but finding a real friend is hard.
There used to be an empty car park here. The new park is a real improvement.
Thanks for cooking while I was sick. You've been a real help this week.
It's a real pity your brother missed the wedding.
The traffic in the morning is a real nightmare.
When the results were read out, there was absolute silence.
It rained every day, so the camping trip was an absolute disaster.
Tom says cats can't swim. That's absolute nonsense.
The climb takes three hours, but the view from the top is an absolute joy.
I've seen the same doctor for twenty years. I have absolute trust in her.
Our school play was an absolute hit with the parents.
During the power cut, the street was in complete darkness.
The news was a complete surprise to everyone.
That man keeps waving at me, but he's a complete stranger to me.
We talked for two hours and decided nothing. The meeting was a complete waste of time.
I've worked every weekend since March. I need a few days of complete rest.
The kitchen was in complete chaos after the party.
Grandma is coming in an hour, and your bedroom is a total mess!
The cake fell on the floor, and the oven broke. My first dinner party was a total disaster.
I waved at a woman. She wasn't my sister. I felt like a total fool.
We lost the game ten to nil. It was a total embarrassment.
He's a total stranger. I've never seen him before.
The head teacher said the school was going to close. There was total silence after the announcement.
You called the fire brigade about a cat in a tree? Is this a real emergency?
It broke down three times in a month. Buying that car was a complete mistake.
I didn't know you lived in Rome. What a total surprise to see you here!
The tickets are still on sale. It would be a real pity to miss the show.
We didn't finish the app, but we learned a lot. The project was not a complete failure.
You fed my cat for a whole week? Thank you. You're an absolute star.

examples.heading: ① real + 名詞

items.en: Noise from the bar next door is a real problem for us.
items.zh: 隔壁酒吧的噪音對我們來說是個大問題。

items.en: Making friends is easy, but finding a real friend is hard.
items.zh: 交朋友很容易，但是要找到真正的朋友很難。

items.en: There used to be an empty car park here. The new park is a real improvement.
items.zh: 這裡以前是一個空的停車場。新的公園真的改善了很多。

items.en: Thanks for cooking while I was sick. You've been a real help this week.
items.zh: 謝謝你在我生病的時候煮飯。你這個禮拜真的幫了大忙。

items.en: It's a real pity your brother missed the wedding.
items.zh: 你哥哥錯過了婚禮，真的很可惜。

items.en: The traffic in the morning is a real nightmare.
items.zh: 早上的交通真是一場惡夢。

examples.heading: ② absolute + 名詞

items.en: When the results were read out, there was absolute silence.
items.zh: 宣讀結果的時候，全場鴉雀無聲。

items.en: It rained every day, so the camping trip was an absolute disaster.
items.zh: 每天都下雨，所以那次露營完全是一場災難。

items.en: Tom says cats can't swim. That's absolute nonsense.
items.zh: 湯姆說貓不會游泳。那完全是胡說八道。

items.en: The climb takes three hours, but the view from the top is an absolute joy.
items.zh: 爬上去要三個小時，可是從山頂看出去的景色讓人無比開心。

items.en: I've seen the same doctor for twenty years. I have absolute trust in her.
items.zh: 我看同一位醫生看了二十年。我完全信任她。

items.en: Our school play was an absolute hit with the parents.
items.zh: 我們學校的話劇大受家長歡迎。

examples.heading: ③ complete + 名詞

items.en: During the power cut, the street was in complete darkness.
items.zh: 停電的時候，整條街一片漆黑。

items.en: The news was a complete surprise to everyone.
items.zh: 這個消息讓大家完全意想不到。

items.en: That man keeps waving at me, but he's a complete stranger to me.
items.zh: 那個男人一直跟我揮手，可是他對我來說完全是個陌生人。

items.en: We talked for two hours and decided nothing. The meeting was a complete waste of time.
items.zh: 我們談了兩個小時，什麼都沒決定。那個會議完全是浪費時間。

items.en: I've worked every weekend since March. I need a few days of complete rest.
items.zh: 我從三月開始每個週末都在工作。我需要完全休息幾天。

items.en: The kitchen was in complete chaos after the party.
items.zh: 派對後廚房一片混亂。

examples.heading: ④ total + 名詞

items.en: Grandma is coming in an hour, and your bedroom is a total mess!
items.zh: 奶奶一個小時後就到了，你的臥室還亂七八糟！

items.en: The cake fell on the floor, and the oven broke. My first dinner party was a total disaster.
items.zh: 蛋糕掉到地上，烤箱也壞了。我第一次辦的晚餐派對完全是一場災難。

items.en: I waved at a woman. She wasn't my sister. I felt like a total fool.
items.zh: 我跟一個女人揮手。她不是我姊姊。我覺得自己像個大笨蛋。

items.en: We lost the game ten to nil. It was a total embarrassment.
items.zh: 我們零比十輸了比賽。真是丟臉極了。

items.en: He's a total stranger. I've never seen him before.
items.zh: 他是個完全不認識的人，我以前從沒見過他。

items.en: The head teacher said the school was going to close. There was total silence after the announcement.
items.zh: 校長說學校要關閉了。宣布完之後，全場一片寂靜。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: You called the fire brigade about a cat in a tree? Is this a real emergency?
items.zh: 你為了樹上的一隻貓打電話給消防隊？這是真正的緊急狀況嗎？

items.en: It broke down three times in a month. Buying that car was a complete mistake.
items.zh: 它一個月壞了三次。買那輛車完全是個錯誤。

items.en: I didn't know you lived in Rome. What a total surprise to see you here!
items.zh: 我不知道你住在羅馬。在這裡見到你，真是太意外了！

items.en: The tickets are still on sale. It would be a real pity to miss the show.
items.zh: 票還在賣。錯過這場表演真的很可惜。

items.en: We didn't finish the app, but we learned a lot. The project was not a complete failure.
items.zh: 我們沒有做完那個應用程式，可是我們學到很多。這個專案並沒有完全失敗。

items.en: You fed my cat for a whole week? Thank you. You're an absolute star.
items.zh: 你幫我餵了一整個星期的貓？謝謝你，你真是太棒了。

title: It is located in the very center of Pisa.
translation: 它就在比薩的正中心。
name: 名詞前表示程度的形容詞（較多種）
sentences: Bring good shoes for the walk. The café sits at the very top of the hill.
We bought the tickets late. Our seats were in the very last row.
We waited for my aunt for an hour. She arrived at the very moment we were leaving.
So the gardener stole the money? I knew it from the very beginning.
Don't look yet. The answer to the puzzle is at the very end of the book.
The hotel lift was broken, and our room was at the very top of the building.
My grandmother told me a sad story about her father. He died on the very day his son was born.
The questions aren't hard. The major problem with the exam is the time limit.
Sorry we're late. There was a major accident on the highway.
In my family, we eat rice twice a day. It's a major part of our diet.
Ten million people visit Kyoto every year. The city is a major center for tourism.
The doctor told my uncle to stop smoking. Smoking is a major cause of illness.
The other team was much better than us. We won by sheer luck.
The idea that cats hate music is utter rubbish.
My new business partner and I sat next to each other on a train. I met her by pure chance.
We told the kids about the trip to Disneyland. They screamed with sheer joy.
We lost our bags, and then I broke my leg. The trip was an utter disaster.
A tree fell onto the bus stop. It was pure luck that nobody was hurt.
Can I get his autograph? I'm a huge fan of his music.
Buy my mum a black-and-white DVD. She's a big fan of old movies.
My little sister is a big talker at dinner.
She's a big reader. She finishes a book every week.
My dad never misses a match on TV. He's a huge football fan.
We were lucky to wake up. The fire started in the very room where we slept.
The streets in Venice all look the same. Getting lost was a major problem on our first day.
My aunt worked in her shop seven days a week. Her success came from sheer hard work.
Stay here tonight. It's utter madness to drive in this snow.
There's a new show at the museum. Is your son a big fan of dinosaurs?
My boyfriend wants to move to Canada, and I don't. We had a major argument last night.
We ran to the stop, but the bus drove away. That was the very last bus of the night.

examples.heading: ① the very + 名詞

items.en: Bring good shoes for the walk. The café sits at the very top of the hill.
items.zh: 走路要穿好一點的鞋子。那家咖啡店就在山的最頂端。

items.en: We bought the tickets late. Our seats were in the very last row.
items.zh: 我們很晚才買票。我們的位子在最後一排。

items.en: We waited for my aunt for an hour. She arrived at the very moment we were leaving.
items.zh: 我們等我阿姨等了一個小時。她就在我們要走的那一刻到了。

items.en: So the gardener stole the money? I knew it from the very beginning.
items.zh: 所以是園丁偷了錢？我從一開始就知道了。

items.en: Don't look yet. The answer to the puzzle is at the very end of the book.
items.zh: 先別看。謎題的答案在書的最後面。

items.en: The hotel lift was broken, and our room was at the very top of the building.
items.zh: 飯店的電梯壞了，我們的房間又在大樓的最頂樓。

items.en: My grandmother told me a sad story about her father. He died on the very day his son was born.
items.zh: 我奶奶跟我說了她爸爸的一個悲傷的故事。他就在他兒子出生的那一天過世。

examples.heading: ② major + 名詞

items.en: The questions aren't hard. The major problem with the exam is the time limit.
items.zh: 題目不難。這個考試最大的問題是時間限制。

items.en: Sorry we're late. There was a major accident on the highway.
items.zh: 抱歉我們遲到了。高速公路上發生了重大車禍。

items.en: In my family, we eat rice twice a day. It's a major part of our diet.
items.zh: 我們家一天吃兩次米飯。它是我們飲食的主要部分。

items.en: Ten million people visit Kyoto every year. The city is a major center for tourism.
items.zh: 每年有一千萬人去京都。這座城市是主要的觀光中心。

items.en: The doctor told my uncle to stop smoking. Smoking is a major cause of illness.
items.zh: 醫生叫我叔叔戒菸。抽菸是疾病的主要原因。

examples.heading: ③ sheer / utter / pure + 名詞

items.en: The other team was much better than us. We won by sheer luck.
items.zh: 另一隊比我們強多了。我們純粹是靠運氣贏的。

items.en: The idea that cats hate music is utter rubbish.
items.zh: 貓討厭音樂的說法完全是胡扯。

items.en: My new business partner and I sat next to each other on a train. I met her by pure chance.
items.zh: 我的新事業夥伴和我在火車上坐在隔壁。我跟她完全是偶然遇見的。

items.en: We told the kids about the trip to Disneyland. They screamed with sheer joy.
items.zh: 我們跟孩子們說要去迪士尼樂園。他們開心得尖叫。

items.en: We lost our bags, and then I broke my leg. The trip was an utter disaster.
items.zh: 我們弄丟了行李，然後我又摔斷了腿。那趟旅行徹底失敗。

items.en: A tree fell onto the bus stop. It was pure luck that nobody was hurt.
items.zh: 一棵樹倒在公車站上。沒有人受傷純粹是運氣好。

examples.heading: ④ huge / big + 名詞（說人）

items.en: Can I get his autograph? I'm a huge fan of his music.
items.zh: 我可以請他簽名嗎？我超喜歡他的音樂。

items.en: Buy my mum a black-and-white DVD. She's a big fan of old movies.
items.zh: 買一張黑白片的 DVD 給我媽。她很喜歡老電影。

items.en: My little sister is a big talker at dinner.
items.zh: 我妹妹吃晚餐時話很多。

items.en: She's a big reader. She finishes a book every week.
items.zh: 她很愛看書，每個禮拜看完一本。

items.en: My dad never misses a match on TV. He's a huge football fan.
items.zh: 電視上的球賽我爸爸一場都不錯過。他超愛足球。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: We were lucky to wake up. The fire started in the very room where we slept.
items.zh: 我們很幸運有醒來。火就是從我們睡覺的那個房間燒起來的。

items.en: The streets in Venice all look the same. Getting lost was a major problem on our first day.
items.zh: 威尼斯的街道看起來都一樣。第一天迷路是個大問題。

items.en: My aunt worked in her shop seven days a week. Her success came from sheer hard work.
items.zh: 我阿姨一個星期七天都在店裡工作。她的成功完全來自努力。

items.en: Stay here tonight. It's utter madness to drive in this snow.
items.zh: 今天晚上住這裡吧。在這種雪天開車簡直瘋了。

items.en: There's a new show at the museum. Is your son a big fan of dinosaurs?
items.zh: 博物館有一個新展覽。你兒子很喜歡恐龍嗎？

items.en: My boyfriend wants to move to Canada, and I don't. We had a major argument last night.
items.zh: 我男朋友想搬去加拿大，我不想。我們昨晚大吵了一架。

items.en: We ran to the stop, but the bus drove away. That was the very last bus of the night.
items.zh: 我們跑到公車站，可是公車開走了。那是當晚最後一班公車。

title: The only thing that I didn't like was the weather.
translation: 我唯一不喜歡的就是天氣。
name: 限制名詞的形容詞 main、only
sentences: The main reason I'm learning English is my job.
Turn left at the main road.
The main problem with this flat is the noise.
Meet me at the main entrance at six.
What's the main idea of this story?
The main dish was chicken with rice.
Rice is the main food in many Asian countries.
My main goal this year is to get fit.
Our main office is in Taipei.
Swimming is my main hobby.
His main worry is money.
Their main concern was the children's safety.
She was the only person at the bus stop.
This is the only key to the house.
Is this the only bus to the airport?
Ken was the only student in the class with a car.
The only way to the beach is down these stairs.
It was the only free table in the café.
The only thing I forgot was my toothbrush.
You're the only one who knows the password.
The only time I'm free is Sunday morning.
The only problem we had was the weather.
That's the only shop that sells fresh bread here.
The only word I understood was "hello."
I'm an only child.
She's their only daughter.
This is my only coat, so I can't lose it.
My only question is the price.
His only brother is a doctor in Tainan.
Their only son lives in Canada.

examples.heading: ① the main + 名詞

items.en: The main reason I'm learning English is my job.
items.zh: 我學英文最主要的原因是工作。

items.en: Turn left at the main road.
items.zh: 在大馬路左轉。

items.en: The main problem with this flat is the noise.
items.zh: 這間公寓最主要的問題是太吵。

items.en: Meet me at the main entrance at six.
items.zh: 六點在大門口跟我碰面。

items.en: What's the main idea of this story?
items.zh: 這個故事的主旨是什麼？

items.en: The main dish was chicken with rice.
items.zh: 主菜是雞肉飯。

items.en: Rice is the main food in many Asian countries.
items.zh: 在很多亞洲國家，米飯是主食。

examples.heading: ② my / our + main + 名詞

items.en: My main goal this year is to get fit.
items.zh: 我今年最主要的目標是把身體練好。

items.en: Our main office is in Taipei.
items.zh: 我們的總公司在台北。

items.en: Swimming is my main hobby.
items.zh: 游泳是我最主要的嗜好。

items.en: His main worry is money.
items.zh: 他最擔心的是錢。

items.en: Their main concern was the children's safety.
items.zh: 他們最在意的是孩子們的安全。

examples.heading: ③ the only + 名詞

items.en: She was the only person at the bus stop.
items.zh: 她是公車站唯一的人。

items.en: This is the only key to the house.
items.zh: 這是房子唯一的鑰匙。

items.en: Is this the only bus to the airport?
items.zh: 這是唯一一班到機場的公車嗎？

items.en: Ken was the only student in the class with a car.
items.zh: Ken 是班上唯一有車的學生。

items.en: The only way to the beach is down these stairs.
items.zh: 到海邊唯一的路是走下這些樓梯。

items.en: It was the only free table in the café.
items.zh: 那是咖啡店裡唯一空著的桌子。

examples.heading: ④ the only + 名詞 + 子句

items.en: The only thing I forgot was my toothbrush.
items.zh: 我唯一忘了帶的是牙刷。

items.en: You're the only one who knows the password.
items.zh: 你是唯一知道密碼的人。

items.en: The only time I'm free is Sunday morning.
items.zh: 我唯一有空的時間是星期天早上。

items.en: The only problem we had was the weather.
items.zh: 我們唯一遇到的問題是天氣。

items.en: That's the only shop that sells fresh bread here.
items.zh: 那是這裡唯一賣新鮮麵包的店。

items.en: The only word I understood was "hello."
items.zh: 我唯一聽得懂的字是 hello。

examples.heading: ⑤ my / their / an + only + 名詞

items.en: I'm an only child.
items.zh: 我是獨生子女。

items.en: She's their only daughter.
items.zh: 她是他們唯一的女兒。

items.en: This is my only coat, so I can't lose it.
items.zh: 這是我唯一的外套，所以我不能弄丟。

items.en: My only question is the price.
items.zh: 我唯一的問題是價格。

items.en: His only brother is a doctor in Tainan.
items.zh: 他唯一的兄弟在台南當醫生。

items.en: Their only son lives in Canada.
items.zh: 他們唯一的兒子住在加拿大。

title: I don't have the faintest idea.
translation: 我一點頭緒都沒有。
name: the slightest、the faintest 表示最少量
sentences: I spoke for ten minutes in the meeting. The boss didn't pay the slightest attention to my idea.
My sister checked the map three times. I don't have the slightest doubt that she's right.
Pizza or pasta? It doesn't make the slightest difference to me.
The tourists never showed the slightest interest in the local culture.
We knocked and looked through the windows. There wasn't the slightest sign of life in the old house.
We slept well for the first time in weeks. The baby didn't make the slightest noise all night.
My flatmate packed his bags last night. He left without the slightest explanation.
My grandmother set up her new phone by herself. She did it without the slightest problem.
My favourite bookshop is empty now. The shop closed without the slightest warning.
The trainer held up a biscuit. The dog sat still without the slightest movement.
When the judge asked, she told the truth without the slightest hesitation.
Ask Tom. I don't have the faintest idea about engines.
I've looked in every pocket. I haven't the faintest idea where my keys are.
Water was coming through the ceiling, and my sister was alone. She didn't have the faintest clue what to do.
Our village team played against the national champions. They didn't have the faintest hope of winning.
My brother eats out every night. He hasn't the faintest idea how to cook.
Sorry, can you say that again? I haven't the slightest idea what you mean.
The sky was blue when we left the house. We didn't have the slightest idea it would rain.
Someone stole a painting from the museum. The police don't have the slightest clue who did it.
We planned the surprise for weeks. Mum hadn't the slightest idea about the party.
The manager spoke to the new delivery staff. If there's the slightest delay, tell the customer.
The doctors say the new treatment might help Dad. If there's the slightest chance, we should try.
You said you'd be home by ten. Do you have the slightest idea how late it is?
Your knee is still weak after the operation. If you feel the slightest pain, stop running.
My son says he's leaving university. Is there the slightest chance he'll change his mind?
Close the window, please. The slightest breeze makes the candle go out.
Be careful what you say to my aunt. She gets angry at the slightest thing.
Our best teacher resigned today. Did you have the faintest idea she was leaving?
Read the contract slowly. If you have the slightest doubt, don't sign it.
Don't let my brother fix the car. He panics at the slightest problem.

examples.heading: ① not the slightest + 名詞

items.en: I spoke for ten minutes in the meeting. The boss didn't pay the slightest attention to my idea.
items.zh: 我在會議上講了十分鐘。老闆對我的點子一點都不在意。

items.en: My sister checked the map three times. I don't have the slightest doubt that she's right.
items.zh: 我姊姊看了三次地圖。我完全不懷疑她是對的。

items.en: Pizza or pasta? It doesn't make the slightest difference to me.
items.zh: 披薩還是義大利麵？這對我來說一點差別都沒有。

items.en: The tourists never showed the slightest interest in the local culture.
items.zh: 那些觀光客從來沒有對當地文化表現出一點興趣。

items.en: We knocked and looked through the windows. There wasn't the slightest sign of life in the old house.
items.zh: 我們敲了門，又從窗戶往裡看。那間老房子裡一點生氣都沒有。

items.en: We slept well for the first time in weeks. The baby didn't make the slightest noise all night.
items.zh: 我們幾個星期以來第一次睡好。寶寶整晚一點聲音都沒有。

examples.heading: ② without the slightest + 名詞

items.en: My flatmate packed his bags last night. He left without the slightest explanation.
items.zh: 我室友昨天晚上收拾了行李。他一句解釋都沒有就走了。

items.en: My grandmother set up her new phone by herself. She did it without the slightest problem.
items.zh: 我奶奶自己設定好她的新手機。她一點問題都沒有就做好了。

items.en: My favourite bookshop is empty now. The shop closed without the slightest warning.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的書店現在空了。那家店一點預告都沒有就關了。

items.en: The trainer held up a biscuit. The dog sat still without the slightest movement.
items.zh: 訓練師拿起一塊餅乾。那隻狗坐著一動也不動。

items.en: When the judge asked, she told the truth without the slightest hesitation.
items.zh: 法官問的時候，她毫不猶豫地說出實話。

examples.heading: ③ not the faintest + 名詞

items.en: Ask Tom. I don't have the faintest idea about engines.
items.zh: 去問 Tom，引擎的事我一竅不通。

items.en: I've looked in every pocket. I haven't the faintest idea where my keys are.
items.zh: 我每個口袋都找過了。我完全不知道我的鑰匙在哪裡。

items.en: Water was coming through the ceiling, and my sister was alone. She didn't have the faintest clue what to do.
items.zh: 水從天花板流下來，我姊姊又一個人在家。她完全不知道該怎麼辦。

items.en: Our village team played against the national champions. They didn't have the faintest hope of winning.
items.zh: 我們村子的球隊跟全國冠軍比賽。他們一點贏的希望都沒有。

items.en: My brother eats out every night. He hasn't the faintest idea how to cook.
items.zh: 我哥哥每天晚上都在外面吃。他完全不會煮飯。

examples.heading: ④ not the slightest idea / clue
