items.en: Sorry, can you say that again? I haven't the slightest idea what you mean.
items.zh: 抱歉，你可以再說一次嗎？我完全不懂你的意思。

items.en: The sky was blue when we left the house. We didn't have the slightest idea it would rain.
items.zh: 我們出門的時候天空是藍的。我們完全沒想到會下雨。

items.en: Someone stole a painting from the museum. The police don't have the slightest clue who did it.
items.zh: 有人從博物館偷了一幅畫。警方完全不知道是誰做的。

items.en: We planned the surprise for weeks. Mum hadn't the slightest idea about the party.
items.zh: 我們計畫這個驚喜計畫了好幾個星期。媽媽完全不知道派對的事。

examples.heading: ⑤ if 子句、問句和其他句型

items.en: The manager spoke to the new delivery staff. If there's the slightest delay, tell the customer.
items.zh: 經理跟新的送貨員說話。只要有一點延誤，就告訴客人。

items.en: The doctors say the new treatment might help Dad. If there's the slightest chance, we should try.
items.zh: 醫生說新的療法可能對爸爸有幫助。只要有一點機會，我們就該試試。

items.en: You said you'd be home by ten. Do you have the slightest idea how late it is?
items.zh: 你說你十點前會回家。你知道現在多晚了嗎？

items.en: Your knee is still weak after the operation. If you feel the slightest pain, stop running.
items.zh: 你的膝蓋開完刀還很弱。只要覺得有一點痛，就停下來別跑了。

items.en: My son says he's leaving university. Is there the slightest chance he'll change his mind?
items.zh: 我兒子說他要從大學退學。他有可能改變心意嗎？

items.en: Close the window, please. The slightest breeze makes the candle go out.
items.zh: 請關窗。一點點風就會把蠟燭吹熄。

items.en: Be careful what you say to my aunt. She gets angry at the slightest thing.
items.zh: 跟我阿姨說話要小心。她為了一點小事就生氣。

items.en: Our best teacher resigned today. Did you have the faintest idea she was leaving?
items.zh: 我們最好的老師今天辭職了。你有想到她要走嗎？

items.en: Read the contract slowly. If you have the slightest doubt, don't sign it.
items.zh: 合約慢慢讀。只要有一點懷疑，就別簽。

items.en: Don't let my brother fix the car. He panics at the slightest problem.
items.zh: 別讓我哥哥修車。一點小問題就讓他慌張。

title: It was the best birthday present I have ever had.
translation: 那是我收過最棒的生日禮物。
name: the best 加名詞加現在完成式
sentences: Can I have another slice? This is the best pizza I've ever eaten.
Thanks to Grandma's recipe, this is the best soup I've ever made.
Thanks for lending me that novel. It's the best story I've ever read.
You've helped me so much. You're the best friend I've ever had.
The beans come from Ethiopia. It's the best coffee I've ever tasted.
The band played for three hours. It was the best concert I've ever been to.
Ms. Lee is the best teacher our class has ever had.
Everyone agrees that it's the best goal he has ever scored.
My parents say it's the best hotel they've ever stayed in.
Print this one. It's the best photo you've ever taken of the kids.
Dad's roast chicken was the best meal he has ever cooked for us.
We walked out after twenty minutes. It was the worst movie we've ever seen.
The plane shook for an hour. It was the worst flight I've ever taken.
I stayed in bed for a week. It was the worst cold I've ever had.
My sister cried when she saw the mirror. It was the worst haircut she's ever had.
Santorini is the most beautiful island I've ever visited.
My new roommate is the funniest guy I've ever lived with.
Look at this! It's the biggest crab we've ever caught at this beach.
The driving test was the hardest exam I've ever taken.
Climbing that hill was the longest hike our kids have ever done.
Which is the best city you've ever lived in?
Is this the best wine you've ever had?
Who's the best singer you've ever heard live?
Thanks for the party! It's the best surprise I've ever had.
That was the best holiday our family has ever had.
What's the best advice anyone has ever given you?
Moving here was the smartest choice we've ever made.
This must be the best view we've ever had from a hotel room.
Was it the best party you've ever been to?
That's the best news I've heard all week.

examples.heading: ① the best + 名詞 + I've ever + 過去分詞

items.en: Can I have another slice? This is the best pizza I've ever eaten.
items.zh: 可以再給我一片嗎？這是我吃過最好吃的披薩。

items.en: Thanks to Grandma's recipe, this is the best soup I've ever made.
items.zh: 多虧奶奶的食譜，這是我煮過最好喝的湯。

items.en: Thanks for lending me that novel. It's the best story I've ever read.
items.zh: 謝謝你借我那本小說，那是我看過最好看的故事。

items.en: You've helped me so much. You're the best friend I've ever had.
items.zh: 你幫了我好多，你是我交過最好的朋友。

items.en: The beans come from Ethiopia. It's the best coffee I've ever tasted.
items.zh: 這些咖啡豆來自衣索比亞，這是我喝過最好喝的咖啡。

items.en: The band played for three hours. It was the best concert I've ever been to.
items.zh: 樂團演奏了三個小時，那是我去過最棒的演唱會。

examples.heading: ② the best + 名詞 + 其他主詞 + have ever + 過去分詞

items.en: Ms. Lee is the best teacher our class has ever had.
items.zh: 李老師是我們班遇過最好的老師。

items.en: Everyone agrees that it's the best goal he has ever scored.
items.zh: 大家都同意那是他進過最漂亮的一球。

items.en: My parents say it's the best hotel they've ever stayed in.
items.zh: 我爸媽說那是他們住過最好的飯店。

items.en: Print this one. It's the best photo you've ever taken of the kids.
items.zh: 把這張印出來，這是你幫孩子們拍過最好的照片。

items.en: Dad's roast chicken was the best meal he has ever cooked for us.
items.zh: 爸爸的烤雞是他為我們煮過最好吃的一餐。

examples.heading: ③ the worst + 名詞 + have ever + 過去分詞

items.en: We walked out after twenty minutes. It was the worst movie we've ever seen.
items.zh: 我們二十分鐘就離場了，那是我們看過最爛的電影。

items.en: The plane shook for an hour. It was the worst flight I've ever taken.
items.zh: 飛機晃了一個小時，那是我搭過最糟的一班飛機。

items.en: I stayed in bed for a week. It was the worst cold I've ever had.
items.zh: 我在床上躺了一個禮拜，那是我得過最嚴重的感冒。

items.en: My sister cried when she saw the mirror. It was the worst haircut she's ever had.
items.zh: 我姊姊照鏡子的時候哭了，那是她剪過最糟的髮型。

examples.heading: ④ 其他最高級 + 名詞 + have ever + 過去分詞

items.en: Santorini is the most beautiful island I've ever visited.
items.zh: 聖托里尼是我去過最美的島。

items.en: My new roommate is the funniest guy I've ever lived with.
items.zh: 我的新室友是我一起住過最好笑的人。

items.en: Look at this! It's the biggest crab we've ever caught at this beach.
items.zh: 你看！這是我們在這片海灘抓過最大的螃蟹。

items.en: The driving test was the hardest exam I've ever taken.
items.zh: 駕照考試是我考過最難的考試。

items.en: Climbing that hill was the longest hike our kids have ever done.
items.zh: 爬那座山是我們孩子走過最長的一段健行。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和不同的句型

items.en: Which is the best city you've ever lived in?
items.zh: 你住過最好的城市是哪一個？

items.en: Is this the best wine you've ever had?
items.zh: 這是你喝過最好喝的酒嗎？

items.en: Who's the best singer you've ever heard live?
items.zh: 你聽過現場唱得最好的歌手是誰？

items.en: Thanks for the party! It's the best surprise I've ever had.
items.zh: 謝謝你們辦的派對！這是我收過最棒的驚喜。

items.en: That was the best holiday our family has ever had.
items.zh: 那是我們家度過最棒的假期。

items.en: What's the best advice anyone has ever given you?
items.zh: 別人給過你最好的建議是什麼？

items.en: Moving here was the smartest choice we've ever made.
items.zh: 搬來這裡是我們做過最聰明的選擇。

items.en: This must be the best view we've ever had from a hotel room.
items.zh: 這一定是我們在飯店房間看過最美的景色。

items.en: Was it the best party you've ever been to?
items.zh: 那是你參加過最棒的派對嗎？

items.en: That's the best news I've heard all week.
items.zh: 那是我這整個禮拜聽到最好的消息。

title: She's a little bit older than me.
translation: 她比我大一點。
name: a (little) bit 修飾比較級形容詞
sentences: This jacket is a bit cheaper than that one.
He's a bit shorter than his brother.
The second lesson was a bit longer.
Is the blue bag a bit lighter?
The water was a bit colder than yesterday.
My new office is a bit quieter.
Their garden is a bit smaller than ours.
My friend is a little bit younger than me.
The soup is a little bit saltier today.
The music is a little bit louder in this room.
My hair is a little bit darker now.
The new chairs are a little bit higher.
The test was a little bit easier than last time.
The hotel was a bit more expensive than we planned.
Could you be a bit more careful with the plates?
The second movie was a bit more exciting.
Ken is a little bit more reticent than his sister.
This road is a bit more dangerous at night.
The second room was a little larger.
Prices are a little higher this year.
The new design is a little simpler.
The river was a little deeper than we thought.
Our flight was a little later than planned.
I feel a bit better after some sleep.
You look a bit thinner than last year.
It's getting a bit warmer now.
Ann looks a little bit taller in those shoes.
The baby feels a bit hotter than usual.
The roads got a bit busier after eight.
My English is getting a little better.

examples.heading: ① a bit + 形容詞-er

items.en: This jacket is a bit cheaper than that one.
items.zh: 這件外套比那件便宜一點。

items.en: He's a bit shorter than his brother.
items.zh: 他比他哥哥矮一點。

items.en: The second lesson was a bit longer.
items.zh: 第二堂課長一點。

items.en: Is the blue bag a bit lighter?
items.zh: 藍色那個包包有比較輕一點嗎？

items.en: The water was a bit colder than yesterday.
items.zh: 水比昨天冷一點。

items.en: My new office is a bit quieter.
items.zh: 我的新辦公室安靜一點。

items.en: Their garden is a bit smaller than ours.
items.zh: 他們的花園比我們的小一點。

examples.heading: ② a little bit + 比較級

items.en: My friend is a little bit younger than me.
items.zh: 我朋友比我小一點。

items.en: The soup is a little bit saltier today.
items.zh: 今天的湯鹹一點。

items.en: The music is a little bit louder in this room.
items.zh: 這個房間的音樂大聲一點。

items.en: My hair is a little bit darker now.
items.zh: 我的頭髮現在深一點了。

items.en: The new chairs are a little bit higher.
items.zh: 新的椅子高一點。

items.en: The test was a little bit easier than last time.
items.zh: 這次考試比上次簡單一點。

examples.heading: ③ a bit + more + 形容詞

items.en: The hotel was a bit more expensive than we planned.
items.zh: 旅館比我們預計的貴一點。

items.en: Could you be a bit more careful with the plates?
items.zh: 你拿盤子可以小心一點嗎？

items.en: The second movie was a bit more exciting.
items.zh: 第二部電影刺激一點。

items.en: Ken is a little bit more reticent than his sister.
items.zh: Ken 比他姊姊話少一點。

items.en: This road is a bit more dangerous at night.
items.zh: 這條路晚上危險一點。

examples.heading: ④ a little + 比較級

items.en: The second room was a little larger.
items.zh: 第二個房間大一點。

items.en: Prices are a little higher this year.
items.zh: 今年的價格高一點。

items.en: The new design is a little simpler.
items.zh: 新的設計簡單一點。

items.en: The river was a little deeper than we thought.
items.zh: 河比我們想的深一點。

items.en: Our flight was a little later than planned.
items.zh: 我們的班機比原本晚一點。

examples.heading: ⑤ look / feel / get 後面

items.en: I feel a bit better after some sleep.
items.zh: 睡了一下之後，我覺得好一點了。

items.en: You look a bit thinner than last year.
items.zh: 你看起來比去年瘦一點。

items.en: It's getting a bit warmer now.
items.zh: 現在變得暖和一點了。

items.en: Ann looks a little bit taller in those shoes.
items.zh: Ann 穿那雙鞋看起來高一點。

items.en: The baby feels a bit hotter than usual.
items.zh: 寶寶摸起來比平常燙一點。

items.en: The roads got a bit busier after eight.
items.zh: 八點以後路上車多了一點。

items.en: My English is getting a little better.
items.zh: 我的英文進步了一點。

title: A bike, even a good one, is a lot cheaper than a car.
translation: 腳踏車就算是好的，也比汽車便宜很多。
name: a lot 修飾敘述用法的比較級形容詞
sentences: Taking the train is a lot faster than driving at rush hour.
Online tickets are a lot cheaper than tickets at the door.
The new library is a lot bigger than the old one on Main Street.
My grandmother is a lot calmer since she moved to the countryside.
Our new puppy is a lot quieter than our last dog.
With the window open, the room is a lot cooler.
Is the lake a lot deeper on the other side?
Hiring a guide was a lot more expensive than we planned.
His second speech was a lot more relaxed than the first.
The exam was a lot more difficult than the practice test.
Working from home is a lot more comfortable for me.
Our new manager is a lot more placid than the old one.
Shopping online is a lot more convenient with two small kids.
Your cough sounds a lot better today.
The second half of the match was a lot better.
The traffic on the bridge was a lot worse than usual this morning.
My Spanish is a lot better after six months in Madrid.
The hotel food was a lot worse than the photos.
Don't you think it would be a lot easier to finish college first?
It would be a lot cheaper to book the flights now.
The trip would be a lot shorter by plane.
A bigger table would be a lot more useful in this kitchen.
It would be a lot safer to wait until the rain stops.
You look a lot happier since you changed jobs.
I feel a lot stronger after two weeks of rest.
The kids seem a lot calmer after their nap.
It gets a lot colder here after sunset.
The pain got a lot worse after I carried those boxes.
Ken's handwriting has got a lot neater this year.
The streets get a lot busier at the weekend.

examples.heading: ① a lot + 形容詞-er

items.en: Taking the train is a lot faster than driving at rush hour.
items.zh: 尖峰時間搭火車比開車快很多。

items.en: Online tickets are a lot cheaper than tickets at the door.
items.zh: 網路上買的票比現場買的便宜很多。

items.en: The new library is a lot bigger than the old one on Main Street.
items.zh: 新的圖書館比大街上那間舊的大很多。

items.en: My grandmother is a lot calmer since she moved to the countryside.
items.zh: 我奶奶搬到鄉下以後平靜很多。

items.en: Our new puppy is a lot quieter than our last dog.
items.zh: 我們的新小狗比之前那隻狗安靜很多。

items.en: With the window open, the room is a lot cooler.
items.zh: 窗戶打開以後，房間涼很多。

items.en: Is the lake a lot deeper on the other side?
items.zh: 湖的另一邊深很多嗎？

examples.heading: ② a lot + more + 形容詞

items.en: Hiring a guide was a lot more expensive than we planned.
items.zh: 請導遊比我們預計的貴很多。

items.en: His second speech was a lot more relaxed than the first.
items.zh: 他第二次演講比第一次放鬆很多。

items.en: The exam was a lot more difficult than the practice test.
items.zh: 正式考試比模擬考難很多。

items.en: Working from home is a lot more comfortable for me.
items.zh: 對我來說，在家工作舒服很多。

items.en: Our new manager is a lot more placid than the old one.
items.zh: 我們的新經理比原本那個平和很多。

items.en: Shopping online is a lot more convenient with two small kids.
items.zh: 帶著兩個小孩，在網路上買東西方便很多。

examples.heading: ③ a lot better / a lot worse

items.en: Your cough sounds a lot better today.
items.zh: 你今天咳嗽的聲音好很多了。

items.en: The second half of the match was a lot better.
items.zh: 比賽的下半場精彩很多。

items.en: The traffic on the bridge was a lot worse than usual this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上橋上的交通比平常糟很多。

items.en: My Spanish is a lot better after six months in Madrid.
items.zh: 在馬德里待了六個月以後，我的西班牙文好很多。

items.en: The hotel food was a lot worse than the photos.
items.zh: 飯店的菜比照片上差很多。

examples.heading: ④ would be a lot + 比較級

items.en: Don't you think it would be a lot easier to finish college first?
items.zh: 你不覺得先把大學念完會容易很多嗎？

items.en: It would be a lot cheaper to book the flights now.
items.zh: 現在訂機票會便宜很多。

items.en: The trip would be a lot shorter by plane.
items.zh: 搭飛機的話，這趟路會短很多。

items.en: A bigger table would be a lot more useful in this kitchen.
items.zh: 這個廚房放一張大一點的桌子會好用很多。

items.en: It would be a lot safer to wait until the rain stops.
items.zh: 等雨停再走會安全很多。

examples.heading: ⑤ look / feel / seem / get 後面

items.en: You look a lot happier since you changed jobs.
items.zh: 你換工作以後看起來開心很多。

items.en: I feel a lot stronger after two weeks of rest.
items.zh: 休息了兩個禮拜以後，我覺得身體好很多。

items.en: The kids seem a lot calmer after their nap.
items.zh: 孩子們睡完午覺以後，看起來平靜很多。

items.en: It gets a lot colder here after sunset.
items.zh: 這裡太陽下山以後會冷很多。

items.en: The pain got a lot worse after I carried those boxes.
items.zh: 我搬了那些箱子以後，痛得厲害很多。

items.en: Ken's handwriting has got a lot neater this year.
items.zh: Ken 的字今年整齊很多。

items.en: The streets get a lot busier at the weekend.
items.zh: 週末街上熱鬧很多。

title: I saw everything become smaller and smaller.
translation: 我看到所有東西變得越來越小。
name: 比較級 and 比較級表示逐漸變化
sentences: The nights are getting shorter and shorter.
The tea in my cup got cooler and cooler.
Our garden is getting smaller and smaller.
The baby's crying got louder and louder.
The line at the bank got longer and longer.
Tom's puppy is getting bigger and bigger.
Is it getting darker and darker outside?
The river got wider and wider near the sea.
Summer is coming. Days become longer and longer.
My little brother's school bag became heavier and heavier each year.
The old photos grew paler and paler over the years.
The cat grew fatter and fatter.
The village became quieter and quieter.
The trains are becoming more and more crowded.
Eating out in this city is getting more and more expensive.
The football match got more and more exciting in the second half.
Ann grew more and more nervous during the interview.
The old man grew more and more reticent.
Life is becoming more and more stressful.
The math questions were getting more and more difficult.
The view got better and better as we climbed.
The weather got worse and worse.
The service at that restaurant has got worse and worse.
Her piano playing is getting better and better.
My knee felt worse and worse after the run.
The puddles on the road have got deeper and deeper.
I saw the plane become smaller and smaller.
Why is the traffic getting heavier and heavier?
The road will get narrower and narrower.
The kids were getting more and more tired.

examples.heading: ① get + 形容詞-er + and + 形容詞-er

items.en: The nights are getting shorter and shorter.
items.zh: 晚上越來越短。

items.en: The tea in my cup got cooler and cooler.
items.zh: 我杯子裡的茶越來越涼。

items.en: Our garden is getting smaller and smaller.
items.zh: 我們的花園越來越小。

items.en: The baby's crying got louder and louder.
items.zh: 寶寶越哭越大聲。

items.en: The line at the bank got longer and longer.
items.zh: 銀行的隊伍越排越長。

items.en: Tom's puppy is getting bigger and bigger.
items.zh: Tom 的小狗越來越大。

items.en: Is it getting darker and darker outside?
items.zh: 外面是不是越來越暗了？

items.en: The river got wider and wider near the sea.
items.zh: 河越靠近海越寬。

examples.heading: ② become / grow + 形容詞-er + and + 形容詞-er

items.en: Summer is coming. Days become longer and longer.
items.zh: 夏天要來了，白天越來越長。

items.en: My little brother's school bag became heavier and heavier each year.
items.zh: 我弟弟的書包一年比一年重。

items.en: The old photos grew paler and paler over the years.
items.zh: 這些舊照片一年比一年淡。

items.en: The cat grew fatter and fatter.
items.zh: 那隻貓越來越胖。

items.en: The village became quieter and quieter.
items.zh: 村子越來越安靜。

examples.heading: ③ more and more + 形容詞

items.en: The trains are becoming more and more crowded.
items.zh: 火車越來越擠。

items.en: Eating out in this city is getting more and more expensive.
items.zh: 在這座城市外食越來越貴。

items.en: The football match got more and more exciting in the second half.
items.zh: 足球比賽到了下半場越來越精彩。

items.en: Ann grew more and more nervous during the interview.
items.zh: 面試的時候，Ann 越來越緊張。

items.en: The old man grew more and more reticent.
items.zh: 那個老人話越來越少。

items.en: Life is becoming more and more stressful.
items.zh: 生活壓力越來越大。

items.en: The math questions were getting more and more difficult.
items.zh: 數學題目越來越難。

examples.heading: ④ better and better、worse and worse

items.en: The view got better and better as we climbed.
items.zh: 我們越爬，風景越好。

items.en: The weather got worse and worse.
items.zh: 天氣越來越糟。

items.en: The service at that restaurant has got worse and worse.
items.zh: 那家餐廳的服務越來越差。

items.en: Her piano playing is getting better and better.
items.zh: 她的鋼琴越彈越好。

items.en: My knee felt worse and worse after the run.
items.zh: 跑完步以後，我的膝蓋越來越痛。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: The puddles on the road have got deeper and deeper.
items.zh: 路上的水坑越來越深。

items.en: I saw the plane become smaller and smaller.
items.zh: 我看著飛機變得越來越小。

items.en: Why is the traffic getting heavier and heavier?
items.zh: 交通為什麼越來越塞？

items.en: The road will get narrower and narrower.
items.zh: 這條路會越來越窄。

items.en: The kids were getting more and more tired.
items.zh: 孩子們越來越累。

title: When I was a child, Christmas morning was by far the most exciting moment of the year.
translation: 我小時候，聖誕節早上絕對是一年裡最興奮的時刻。
name: by far 加強最高級形容詞
sentences: We've tried every noodle shop on this street, and this one is by far the best.
Ken is by far the tallest in the class.
Nobody finished the chemistry exam. It was by far the hardest one this term.
The train is by far the fastest way to get there.
August is by far the hottest month here.
It was by far the longest meeting of the week.
For our kids, the first day of the holidays is by far the most exciting.
Of all the forests I've visited, this one is by far the most beautiful.
Health is by far the most important thing.
That restaurant is by far the most expensive in the area.
She's by far the most talented singer in the group.
This was by far the most difficult decision of my life.
She's the fastest runner by far.
This is the cheapest option by far.
It was the best day of the holiday by far.
He's the oldest player on the team by far.
That's the most popular dish on the menu by far.
Her second album is by far the best.
That was by far the worst hotel we stayed in.
Walking is by far the best way to see the old town.
Monday was by far the worst day of the week.
Your idea is by far the best one.
Isn't this by far the nicest beach on the island?
Which is by far the most popular sport in your country?
For me, summer is by far the best season.
It's by far the quickest route, so let's take it.
The red one is by far the prettiest of the three.
Last year was by far the busiest year for the shop.
This exercise is by far the easiest in the book.
That was by far the funniest film I've seen this year.

examples.heading: ① by far the + 形容詞-est

items.en: We've tried every noodle shop on this street, and this one is by far the best.
items.zh: 這條街上每家麵店我們都吃過了，這家絕對是最好吃的。

items.en: Ken is by far the tallest in the class.
items.zh: Ken 是班上最高的，比其他人高很多。

items.en: Nobody finished the chemistry exam. It was by far the hardest one this term.
items.zh: 沒有人寫完化學考試，那絕對是這學期最難的一次。

items.en: The train is by far the fastest way to get there.
items.zh: 搭火車絕對是去那裡最快的方法。

items.en: August is by far the hottest month here.
items.zh: 八月絕對是這裡最熱的月份。

items.en: It was by far the longest meeting of the week.
items.zh: 那絕對是這週最長的會議。

examples.heading: ② by far the most + 形容詞

items.en: For our kids, the first day of the holidays is by far the most exciting.
items.zh: 對我們的孩子來說，放假第一天絕對是最興奮的。

items.en: Of all the forests I've visited, this one is by far the most beautiful.
items.zh: 我去過的森林裡，這座絕對是最美的。

items.en: Health is by far the most important thing.
items.zh: 健康絕對是最重要的事。

items.en: That restaurant is by far the most expensive in the area.
items.zh: 那家餐廳絕對是這一帶最貴的。

items.en: She's by far the most talented singer in the group.
items.zh: 她絕對是團體裡最有天分的歌手。

items.en: This was by far the most difficult decision of my life.
items.zh: 這絕對是我這輩子最難的決定。

examples.heading: ③ the + 最高級 + 名詞 + by far

items.en: She's the fastest runner by far.
items.zh: 她是跑得最快的，其他人差遠了。

items.en: This is the cheapest option by far.
items.zh: 這絕對是最便宜的選擇。

items.en: It was the best day of the holiday by far.
items.zh: 那絕對是假期中最棒的一天。

items.en: He's the oldest player on the team by far.
items.zh: 他是隊上年紀最大的球員，比其他人大很多。

items.en: That's the most popular dish on the menu by far.
items.zh: 那絕對是菜單上最受歡迎的菜。

examples.heading: ④ by far the best / worst

items.en: Her second album is by far the best.
items.zh: 她的第二張專輯絕對是最好的。

items.en: That was by far the worst hotel we stayed in.
items.zh: 那絕對是我們住過最糟的飯店。

items.en: Walking is by far the best way to see the old town.
items.zh: 走路絕對是看舊城區最好的方式。

items.en: Monday was by far the worst day of the week.
items.zh: 星期一絕對是這週最糟的一天。

items.en: Your idea is by far the best one.
items.zh: 你的點子絕對是最好的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和不同的句型

items.en: Isn't this by far the nicest beach on the island?
items.zh: 這不就是島上最漂亮的海灘嗎？

items.en: Which is by far the most popular sport in your country?
items.zh: 在你們國家，哪一種運動遠比其他的受歡迎？

items.en: For me, summer is by far the best season.
items.zh: 對我來說，夏天絕對是最好的季節。

items.en: It's by far the quickest route, so let's take it.
items.zh: 這絕對是最快的路線，我們走這條吧。

items.en: The red one is by far the prettiest of the three.
items.zh: 三個裡面，紅色的絕對是最漂亮的。

items.en: Last year was by far the busiest year for the shop.
items.zh: 去年絕對是這家店最忙的一年。

items.en: This exercise is by far the easiest in the book.
items.zh: 這個練習絕對是書裡最簡單的。

items.en: That was by far the funniest film I've seen this year.
items.zh: 那絕對是我今年看過最好笑的電影。

title: I'm sure you've seen part one already, but part two was even better!
translation: 我相信你已經看過第一集了，不過第二集更好看！
name: even 修飾比較級形容詞
sentences: The first hotel was nice, but the second one was even nicer.
My brother is tall, but my sister is even taller.
The new stadium is even bigger than the old one.
Tokyo was busy, but Osaka was even busier.
The second box is even heavier.
Her new flat is even smaller than her old one.
Is the beach even quieter in winter?
The ending of the film was even more exciting.
The view from the top was even more beautiful.
This phone is even more expensive than mine.
My grandfather is quiet, but my grandmother is even more reticent.
Is the final exam even more difficult?
Your idea is even more interesting than his.
The sequel was even better than the original.
The food was good, and the service was even better.
The traffic is bad today, but tomorrow will be even worse.
Her second song was even better than her first.
That would be even worse.
The rain got even heavier in the afternoon.
Her smile got even bigger when she saw the cake.
The roads will get even busier at five.
Ann's English got even better after a year in London.
The room got even colder at night.
The questions got even harder after lunch.
Next week will be even hotter.
Ken looks even happier than before.
The second day of the trip felt even longer.
Why is this bag even more expensive?
I feel even more tired now.
The second floor seems even quieter.

examples.heading: ① be + even + 形容詞-er

items.en: The first hotel was nice, but the second one was even nicer.
items.zh: 第一家旅館很好，第二家更好。

items.en: My brother is tall, but my sister is even taller.
items.zh: 我哥哥很高，但是我姊姊更高。

items.en: The new stadium is even bigger than the old one.
items.zh: 新的體育館比舊的還要大。

items.en: Tokyo was busy, but Osaka was even busier.
items.zh: 東京很熱鬧，大阪更熱鬧。

items.en: The second box is even heavier.
items.zh: 第二個箱子更重。

items.en: Her new flat is even smaller than her old one.
items.zh: 她的新公寓比舊的還要小。

items.en: Is the beach even quieter in winter?
items.zh: 海灘冬天更安靜嗎？

examples.heading: ② be + even + more + 形容詞

items.en: The ending of the film was even more exciting.
items.zh: 電影的結局更刺激。

items.en: The view from the top was even more beautiful.
items.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色更美。

items.en: This phone is even more expensive than mine.
items.zh: 這支手機比我的還要貴。

items.en: My grandfather is quiet, but my grandmother is even more reticent.
items.zh: 我爺爺很安靜，我奶奶話更少。

items.en: Is the final exam even more difficult?
items.zh: 期末考更難嗎？

items.en: Your idea is even more interesting than his.
items.zh: 你的點子比他的還要有趣。

examples.heading: ③ even better / even worse

items.en: The sequel was even better than the original.
items.zh: 續集比第一集還要好看。

items.en: The food was good, and the service was even better.
items.zh: 食物很好吃，服務更好。

items.en: The traffic is bad today, but tomorrow will be even worse.
items.zh: 今天交通很糟，明天會更糟。

items.en: Her second song was even better than her first.
items.zh: 她的第二首歌比第一首還要好聽。

items.en: That would be even worse.
items.zh: 那樣會更糟。

examples.heading: ④ get even + 比較級

items.en: The rain got even heavier in the afternoon.
items.zh: 到了下午，雨下得更大了。

items.en: Her smile got even bigger when she saw the cake.
items.zh: 她看到蛋糕，笑得更開了。

items.en: The roads will get even busier at five.
items.zh: 五點的時候路上會更塞。

items.en: Ann's English got even better after a year in London.
items.zh: 在倫敦待了一年以後，Ann 的英文變得更好了。

items.en: The room got even colder at night.
items.zh: 到了晚上，房間變得更冷。

items.en: The questions got even harder after lunch.
items.zh: 午餐後題目變得更難。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: Next week will be even hotter.
items.zh: 下禮拜會更熱。

items.en: Ken looks even happier than before.
items.zh: Ken 看起來比以前更開心。

items.en: The second day of the trip felt even longer.
items.zh: 旅行的第二天感覺更長。

items.en: Why is this bag even more expensive?
items.zh: 為什麼這個包包更貴？

items.en: I feel even more tired now.
items.zh: 我現在覺得更累了。

items.en: The second floor seems even quieter.
items.zh: 二樓好像更安靜。

title: It's the biggest room in the house.
translation: 這是整間房子最大的房間。
name: 最高級後接 in 加地點
sentences: My bedroom is the smallest room in the house.
In winter we all sit by the stove. The kitchen is the warmest place in the house.
Don't take Dad's armchair. That's the most comfortable seat in the room.
We live on the twentieth floor. Our flat is the highest one in the building.
Everyone wants to sit by the window. It's the brightest spot in the office.
The guide showed us the oldest painting in the museum.
I chose these jeans because they were the cheapest ones in the shop.
It's our first time here. What's the most popular dish in this restaurant?
The hotel was nearly empty, so we got the biggest room in the hotel.
Don't touch that one. This is the most expensive watch in the store.
My son always asks for the chocolate cake. It's the sweetest thing in the bakery.
Elm Road is the widest street in our neighborhood.
People queue outside my cousins' shop every morning. Their bakery sells the best bread in the city.
Our neighbours have roses all over the front wall. Their house is the prettiest one in the street.
Let's open the new shop near the station. It's the busiest place in town.
I eat my lunch here on sunny days. This park is the greenest area in the city center.
You can see the whole harbour from our room. This hotel has the best view in Kaohsiung.
Jade Mountain is the highest mountain in Taiwan.
Is it Toronto or Montreal? Which is the biggest city in Canada?
Look at the gold walls in the photo. This is the most famous temple in Kyoto.
We went up the Tokyo Skytree on our trip. It's the tallest tower in Japan.
Go south for your summer holiday. Kenting has the best beaches in Taiwan.
We only have fifty dollars a night. Is this the cheapest hotel in the area?
Excuse me, I need some cash. Where's the nearest bank in this neighborhood?
My mother needs an operation on her heart. Who's the best doctor in the hospital?
I sat behind a big pillar all night. That was the worst seat in the theater.
Leo always remembers my order. He's the friendliest waiter in the café.
I study there before exams. The library is the quietest building in the school.
Line 2 goes through the centre. It's the most crowded underground line in the city.
Nobody wants to sleep in the back bedroom. It's the coldest room in the flat.

examples.heading: ① in the house / room / building

items.en: My bedroom is the smallest room in the house.
items.zh: 我的臥室是家裡最小的房間。

items.en: In winter we all sit by the stove. The kitchen is the warmest place in the house.
items.zh: 冬天我們都坐在爐子旁邊。廚房是家裡最溫暖的地方。

items.en: Don't take Dad's armchair. That's the most comfortable seat in the room.
items.zh: 別坐爸爸的扶手椅。那是房間裡最舒服的位子。

items.en: We live on the twentieth floor. Our flat is the highest one in the building.
items.zh: 我們住在二十樓。我們家是這棟樓裡最高的一戶。

items.en: Everyone wants to sit by the window. It's the brightest spot in the office.
items.zh: 大家都想坐在窗邊。那是辦公室裡最亮的地方。

items.en: The guide showed us the oldest painting in the museum.
items.zh: 導覽員帶我們看博物館裡最古老的畫。

examples.heading: ② in the shop / restaurant / hotel

items.en: I chose these jeans because they were the cheapest ones in the shop.
items.zh: 我選了這條牛仔褲，因為它是店裡最便宜的。

items.en: It's our first time here. What's the most popular dish in this restaurant?
items.zh: 我們第一次來這裡。這家餐廳最受歡迎的菜是什麼？

items.en: The hotel was nearly empty, so we got the biggest room in the hotel.
items.zh: 飯店幾乎沒有客人，所以我們拿到飯店裡最大的房間。

items.en: Don't touch that one. This is the most expensive watch in the store.
items.zh: 別碰那支。這是店裡最貴的手錶。

items.en: My son always asks for the chocolate cake. It's the sweetest thing in the bakery.
items.zh: 我兒子每次都要巧克力蛋糕。那是麵包店裡最甜的東西。

examples.heading: ③ in the city / town / street

items.en: Elm Road is the widest street in our neighborhood.
items.zh: Elm Road 是我們這一區最寬的街。

items.en: People queue outside my cousins' shop every morning. Their bakery sells the best bread in the city.
items.zh: 每天早上都有人在我表親的店外面排隊。他們的麵包店賣全城最好吃的麵包。

items.en: Our neighbours have roses all over the front wall. Their house is the prettiest one in the street.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居前面整面牆都是玫瑰。他們家是這條街上最漂亮的房子。

items.en: Let's open the new shop near the station. It's the busiest place in town.
items.zh: 我們把新店開在車站附近吧。那是鎮上最熱鬧的地方。

items.en: I eat my lunch here on sunny days. This park is the greenest area in the city center.
items.zh: 天氣好的時候我在這裡吃午餐。這座公園是市中心綠地最多的地方。

examples.heading: ④ in + 地名

items.en: You can see the whole harbour from our room. This hotel has the best view in Kaohsiung.
items.zh: 從我們的房間可以看到整個港口。這家飯店有高雄最棒的景觀。

items.en: Jade Mountain is the highest mountain in Taiwan.
items.zh: 玉山是台灣最高的山。

items.en: Is it Toronto or Montreal? Which is the biggest city in Canada?
items.zh: 是多倫多還是蒙特婁？加拿大最大的城市是哪一個？

items.en: Look at the gold walls in the photo. This is the most famous temple in Kyoto.
items.zh: 你看照片裡金色的牆。這是京都最有名的寺廟。

items.en: We went up the Tokyo Skytree on our trip. It's the tallest tower in Japan.
items.zh: 我們旅行的時候上了東京晴空塔。它是日本最高的塔。

items.en: Go south for your summer holiday. Kenting has the best beaches in Taiwan.
items.zh: 暑假往南部去。墾丁有台灣最好的海灘。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和不同的句型

items.en: We only have fifty dollars a night. Is this the cheapest hotel in the area?
items.zh: 我們一個晚上只有五十塊。這是這一帶最便宜的旅館嗎？

items.en: Excuse me, I need some cash. Where's the nearest bank in this neighborhood?
items.zh: 不好意思，我需要一些現金。這附近最近的銀行在哪裡？

items.en: My mother needs an operation on her heart. Who's the best doctor in the hospital?
items.zh: 我媽媽心臟需要開刀。醫院裡最好的醫生是誰？

items.en: I sat behind a big pillar all night. That was the worst seat in the theater.
items.zh: 我整個晚上坐在一根大柱子後面。那是劇院裡最差的位子。

items.en: Leo always remembers my order. He's the friendliest waiter in the café.
items.zh: 里歐總是記得我點什麼。他是咖啡店裡最友善的服務生。

items.en: I study there before exams. The library is the quietest building in the school.
items.zh: 考試前我都在那裡讀書。圖書館是學校裡最安靜的建築。

items.en: Line 2 goes through the centre. It's the most crowded underground line in the city.
items.zh: 二號線經過市中心。它是城裡最擠的地鐵線。

items.en: Nobody wants to sleep in the back bedroom. It's the coldest room in the flat.
items.zh: 沒有人想睡後面那間臥室。那是公寓裡最冷的房間。

title: What about a much cheaper hotel?
translation: 那住便宜很多的飯店怎麼樣？
name: much 修飾名詞前的比較級形容詞
sentences: We need a much bigger car for the trip.
What about a much cheaper hotel near the station?
She found a much better job in Taichung.
The second computer was a much better investment.
We moved into a much smaller flat after the kids left home.
He bought a much older car to save money.
Is there a much shorter way to the beach?
I'd like a much more comfortable chair for my office.
She chose a much more expensive dress for the wedding.
Let's find a much more interesting topic for the project.
The school hired a much more experienced teacher this year.
They built a much more modern station in the city center.
Bring much warmer clothes for the mountains.
The new phones have much bigger screens.
Children today have much busier lives.
We found much cheaper flights on another website.
The shop down the road sells much fresher eggs.
Older students usually ask much harder questions.
Our grandparents had much fresher vegetables.
The south has much warmer weather in winter.
This shop sells much better coffee than the one at work.
You'll get much faster service at the other counter.
We need much stronger evidence before we tell the police.
My new job pays much higher wages.
We asked for the much larger room on the top floor.
I took my much younger brother to the zoo.
My much older sister taught me to swim.
They sold their much bigger house in the city.
The much cheaper ticket doesn't include lunch.
Our much bigger kitchen is the best thing about the new house.

examples.heading: ① a + much + 比較級 + 可數名詞

items.en: We need a much bigger car for the trip.
items.zh: 這趟旅行我們需要一輛大很多的車。

items.en: What about a much cheaper hotel near the station?
items.zh: 那住車站附近便宜很多的飯店怎麼樣？

items.en: She found a much better job in Taichung.
items.zh: 她在台中找到一份好很多的工作。

items.en: The second computer was a much better investment.
items.zh: 第二台電腦是好很多的投資。

items.en: We moved into a much smaller flat after the kids left home.
items.zh: 孩子們離家以後，我們搬到一間小很多的公寓。

items.en: He bought a much older car to save money.
items.zh: 他為了省錢，買了一輛舊很多的車。

items.en: Is there a much shorter way to the beach?
items.zh: 有沒有到海邊近很多的路？

examples.heading: ② a + much + more + 形容詞 + 可數名詞

items.en: I'd like a much more comfortable chair for my office.
items.zh: 我辦公室想要一張舒服很多的椅子。

items.en: She chose a much more expensive dress for the wedding.
items.zh: 她為了婚禮挑了一件貴很多的洋裝。

items.en: Let's find a much more interesting topic for the project.
items.zh: 我們幫這個專案找一個有趣很多的題目吧。

items.en: The school hired a much more experienced teacher this year.
items.zh: 學校今年請了一位經驗豐富很多的老師。

items.en: They built a much more modern station in the city center.
items.zh: 他們在市中心蓋了一座現代化很多的車站。

examples.heading: ③ much + 比較級 + 複數名詞

items.en: Bring much warmer clothes for the mountains.
items.zh: 去山上要帶暖和很多的衣服。

items.en: The new phones have much bigger screens.
items.zh: 新的手機螢幕大很多。

items.en: Children today have much busier lives.
items.zh: 現在的小孩生活忙很多。

items.en: We found much cheaper flights on another website.
items.zh: 我們在另一個網站找到便宜很多的機票。

items.en: The shop down the road sells much fresher eggs.
items.zh: 路那頭的店賣的蛋新鮮很多。

items.en: Older students usually ask much harder questions.
items.zh: 年紀大一點的學生通常問難很多的問題。

examples.heading: ④ much + 比較級 + 不可數名詞

items.en: Our grandparents had much fresher vegetables.
items.zh: 我們的祖父母那時候吃的蔬菜新鮮很多。

items.en: The south has much warmer weather in winter.
items.zh: 南部冬天的天氣暖和很多。

items.en: This shop sells much better coffee than the one at work.
items.zh: 這家店賣的咖啡比公司那家好喝很多。

items.en: You'll get much faster service at the other counter.
items.zh: 另一個櫃台的服務會快很多。

items.en: We need much stronger evidence before we tell the police.
items.zh: 我們要有有力很多的證據，才能報警。

items.en: My new job pays much higher wages.
items.zh: 我的新工作薪水高很多。

examples.heading: ⑤ the / my / our + much + 比較級 + 名詞

items.en: We asked for the much larger room on the top floor.
items.zh: 我們要了頂樓那間大很多的房間。

items.en: I took my much younger brother to the zoo.
items.zh: 我帶比我小很多的弟弟去動物園。

items.en: My much older sister taught me to swim.
items.zh: 比我大很多的姊姊教我游泳。

items.en: They sold their much bigger house in the city.
items.zh: 他們把城裡那棟大很多的房子賣了。

items.en: The much cheaper ticket doesn't include lunch.
items.zh: 便宜很多的那種票不含午餐。

items.en: Our much bigger kitchen is the best thing about the new house.
items.zh: 我們新房子最棒的是大很多的廚房。

title: We are not any happier than you were.
translation: 我們一點也沒有比你們當時快樂。
name: no、not any 修飾比較級形容詞
sentences: The new phone isn't any faster than my old one.
The kids aren't any happier with the new teacher.
The hotel by the beach isn't any cheaper.
The second test wasn't any easier than the first.
My brother isn't any taller than me now.
These shoes aren't any more comfortable than my old ones.
The traffic wasn't any lighter on Sunday.
Taking a taxi at rush hour is no faster than walking.
The bus is no cheaper than the train.
His second book is no better than his first.
Living in the city is no more expensive than living here.
The new road is no safer than the old one.
Our house is no bigger than theirs.
The water was no higher than my knees.
The room is no bigger than a cupboard.
The kitten was no bigger than my hand.
The path was no wider than a bicycle.
The shop is no further than the end of this street.
The scratch is no longer than a centimeter.
My cold is no better today.
The weather isn't any better in the north.
His English is no worse than mine.
The food here isn't any worse than at home.
The pain isn't any better after the medicine.
The prices won't be any lower next month.
The second movie was no more exciting than the first.
Her new job isn't any more interesting.
The streets were no quieter at midnight.
I'm not any older than you, so don't tell me what to do.
The trip home was no shorter than the trip there.

examples.heading: ① be not any + 比較級

items.en: The new phone isn't any faster than my old one.
items.zh: 新手機一點也沒有比我的舊手機快。

items.en: The kids aren't any happier with the new teacher.
items.zh: 孩子們換了新老師，一點也沒有比較開心。

items.en: The hotel by the beach isn't any cheaper.
items.zh: 海邊那家旅館一點也沒有比較便宜。

items.en: The second test wasn't any easier than the first.
items.zh: 第二次考試一點也沒有比第一次簡單。

items.en: My brother isn't any taller than me now.
items.zh: 我弟弟現在一點也沒有比我高。

items.en: These shoes aren't any more comfortable than my old ones.
items.zh: 這雙鞋一點也沒有比我的舊鞋舒服。

items.en: The traffic wasn't any lighter on Sunday.
items.zh: 星期天交通一點也沒有比較順。

examples.heading: ② be no + 比較級

items.en: Taking a taxi at rush hour is no faster than walking.
items.zh: 尖峰時間搭計程車沒有比走路快。

items.en: The bus is no cheaper than the train.
items.zh: 公車沒有比火車便宜。

items.en: His second book is no better than his first.
items.zh: 他的第二本書沒有比第一本好。

items.en: Living in the city is no more expensive than living here.
items.zh: 住在城裡沒有比住在這裡貴。

items.en: The new road is no safer than the old one.
items.zh: 新的路沒有比舊的安全。

items.en: Our house is no bigger than theirs.
items.zh: 我們的房子沒有比他們的大。

examples.heading: ③ no + 比較級 + than 表示最多只有

items.en: The water was no higher than my knees.
items.zh: 水最多只到我的膝蓋。

items.en: The room is no bigger than a cupboard.
items.zh: 那個房間差不多只有櫥櫃那麼大。

items.en: The kitten was no bigger than my hand.
items.zh: 那隻小貓頂多只有我的手那麼大。

items.en: The path was no wider than a bicycle.
items.zh: 那條小路頂多只有一台腳踏車寬。

items.en: The shop is no further than the end of this street.
items.zh: 那家店最遠就在這條街的盡頭。

items.en: The scratch is no longer than a centimeter.
items.zh: 這道刮痕頂多一公分長。

examples.heading: ④ no better / not any better

items.en: My cold is no better today.
items.zh: 我的感冒今天沒有好一點。

items.en: The weather isn't any better in the north.
items.zh: 北部的天氣一點也沒有比較好。

items.en: His English is no worse than mine.
items.zh: 他的英文沒有比我的差。

items.en: The food here isn't any worse than at home.
items.zh: 這裡的食物一點也沒有比家裡的差。

items.en: The pain isn't any better after the medicine.
items.zh: 吃了藥以後，痛一點也沒有好。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: The prices won't be any lower next month.
items.zh: 下個月價格一點也不會比較低。

items.en: The second movie was no more exciting than the first.
items.zh: 第二部電影沒有比第一部刺激。

items.en: Her new job isn't any more interesting.
items.zh: 她的新工作一點也沒有比較有趣。

items.en: The streets were no quieter at midnight.
items.zh: 到了半夜，街上也沒有比較安靜。

items.en: I'm not any older than you, so don't tell me what to do.
items.zh: 我又沒有比你大，別管我。

items.en: The trip home was no shorter than the trip there.
items.zh: 回家的路沒有比去的路短。

title: She is not that much older than I am.
translation: 她沒有比我大多少。
name: not that much 修飾比較級形容詞
sentences: The new flat isn't that much bigger than our old one.
My sister is not that much younger than me.
Don't worry, the test isn't that much harder than last time.
The express train wasn't that much faster.
Their garden isn't that much smaller than ours.
The water wasn't that much colder in the morning.
The blue one isn't that much cheaper, is it?
The bigger size isn't that much more expensive.
The second part of the course wasn't that much more difficult.
Flying isn't that much more expensive than the train these days.
Her new job isn't that much more interesting than her old one.
The new sofa isn't that much more comfortable.
The city center is not that much more crowded on weekdays.
The second hotel wasn't that much better.
My Japanese isn't that much better than yours.
The traffic today isn't that much worse than usual.
The new version of the app isn't that much better.
His cold wasn't that much worse this morning.
A: Your brother is so tall! B: He isn't that much taller than me.
A: Isn't the hotel too expensive? B: It's not that much more expensive than the hostel.
A: Is she a lot older than you? B: No, she's not that much older.
A: Isn't it far to walk? B: It's not that much further than the bus stop.
A: Should we wait for the sale? B: It won't be that much cheaper.
You don't look that much older than your students.
I don't feel that much better after the medicine.
The new teacher doesn't seem that much stricter.
It didn't get that much warmer in the afternoon.
The roads didn't get that much busier after the holiday.
The kitchen doesn't look that much bigger after the changes.
The room doesn't feel that much quieter with the new windows.

examples.heading: ① not that much + 形容詞-er

items.en: The new flat isn't that much bigger than our old one.
items.zh: 新公寓沒有比我們以前那間大多少。

items.en: My sister is not that much younger than me.
items.zh: 我妹妹沒有比我小多少。

items.en: Don't worry, the test isn't that much harder than last time.
items.zh: 別擔心，這次考試沒有比上次難多少。

items.en: The express train wasn't that much faster.
items.zh: 快車沒有快多少。

items.en: Their garden isn't that much smaller than ours.
items.zh: 他們的花園沒有比我們的小多少。

items.en: The water wasn't that much colder in the morning.
items.zh: 早上的水沒有冷多少。

items.en: The blue one isn't that much cheaper, is it?
items.zh: 藍色那個沒有便宜多少吧？

examples.heading: ② not that much + more + 形容詞

items.en: The bigger size isn't that much more expensive.
items.zh: 大一點的尺寸沒有貴多少。

items.en: The second part of the course wasn't that much more difficult.
items.zh: 課程的第二部分沒有難多少。

items.en: Flying isn't that much more expensive than the train these days.
items.zh: 現在搭飛機沒有比搭火車貴多少。

items.en: Her new job isn't that much more interesting than her old one.
items.zh: 她的新工作沒有比舊的有趣多少。

items.en: The new sofa isn't that much more comfortable.
items.zh: 新沙發沒有舒服多少。

items.en: The city center is not that much more crowded on weekdays.
items.zh: 平日市中心沒有擠多少。

examples.heading: ③ not that much better / worse

items.en: The second hotel wasn't that much better.
items.zh: 第二家旅館沒有好多少。

items.en: My Japanese isn't that much better than yours.
items.zh: 我的日文沒有比你的好多少。

items.en: The traffic today isn't that much worse than usual.
items.zh: 今天的交通沒有比平常糟多少。

items.en: The new version of the app isn't that much better.
items.zh: 新版的 app 沒有好多少。

items.en: His cold wasn't that much worse this morning.
items.zh: 他的感冒今天早上沒有嚴重多少。

examples.heading: ④ 回答對方

items.en: A: Your brother is so tall! B: He isn't that much taller than me.
items.zh: A：你哥哥好高！B：他沒有比我高多少。

items.en: A: Isn't the hotel too expensive? B: It's not that much more expensive than the hostel.
items.zh: A：那家飯店不會太貴嗎？B：它沒有比青年旅館貴多少。

items.en: A: Is she a lot older than you? B: No, she's not that much older.
items.zh: A：她比你大很多嗎？B：沒有，她沒有大多少。

items.en: A: Isn't it far to walk? B: It's not that much further than the bus stop.
items.zh: A：走路去不會很遠嗎？B：沒有比到公車站遠多少。

items.en: A: Should we wait for the sale? B: It won't be that much cheaper.
items.zh: A：我們要不要等特價？B：不會便宜多少。

examples.heading: ⑤ look / feel / seem / get 後面

items.en: You don't look that much older than your students.
items.zh: 你看起來沒有比你的學生大多少。

items.en: I don't feel that much better after the medicine.
items.zh: 吃了藥以後，我沒有覺得好多少。

items.en: The new teacher doesn't seem that much stricter.
items.zh: 新老師看起來沒有嚴格多少。

items.en: It didn't get that much warmer in the afternoon.
items.zh: 下午沒有變暖多少。

items.en: The roads didn't get that much busier after the holiday.
items.zh: 放假結束以後，路上的車沒有多多少。

items.en: The kitchen doesn't look that much bigger after the changes.
items.zh: 改裝以後，廚房看起來沒有大多少。

items.en: The room doesn't feel that much quieter with the new windows.
items.zh: 換了新窗戶，房間感覺沒有安靜多少。

title: It is not the shortest possible route, but it is the easiest for people with luggage.
translation: 這不是最短的路線，但對帶著行李的人來說是最輕鬆的。
name: 最高級加 possible 再接名詞
sentences: Most of our clients work near the river. Central London is the best possible location for the office.
My parents are selling their house this spring. They want the best possible price for it.
My grandmother was in hospital for a month. The doctors gave her the best possible care.
I'm sorry your order arrived late. We'll find the best possible solution.
The final is on Sunday. Our team wants to get the best possible result.
The manager spoke about next year's plans. We want to raise sales to the highest possible level.
We'll repair the roof in three stages. This isn't the quickest possible plan, but it's the cheapest.
All our staff are busy right now. We'll call you back at the earliest possible moment.
The client moved the deadline to Friday. We need to finish in the shortest possible time.
The theatre wanted students to come. They sold the tickets at the lowest possible price.
The salesman said the car was very safe. It was built with the strongest possible steel.
My dad paid extra for a bed seat. This is the most comfortable possible seat on the plane.
We didn't want to change planes with a baby. We chose the most direct possible flight.
My grandmother doesn't understand computers. Explain it in the most basic possible terms.
The interviewer asked about her weaknesses. She gave the most honest possible answer.
The old bridge might fall down. The engineers took the most careful possible approach.
My car broke down on the way to my wedding. It happened at the worst possible time.
We were halfway up the mountain. The rain came at the worst possible moment.
Dad has a problem with his heart. Use the smallest possible amount of salt.
The neighbours have a new baby. We kept the noise to the lowest possible level.
The airline charges for big suitcases. We packed the smallest possible bags for the flight.
The client wants to sign the contract soon. What's the earliest possible date for the meeting?
Three hundred pounds for a phone repair? Is this the cheapest possible option?
Your new passport is ready. We'll send it by the fastest possible route.
I got a new job on 2 January. That was the best possible start to the year.
Our host family met us at the airport with flowers. They gave us the warmest possible welcome.
The party will be boring at the start. Let's leave at the latest possible time.
My sister met her boyfriend's parents last week. She tried to make the best possible impression.
We wanted to talk about the plans. We asked for the quietest possible table in the café.
There are six of us, with the grandparents. We booked the largest possible room for the family.

examples.heading: ① the best possible + 名詞

items.en: Most of our clients work near the river. Central London is the best possible location for the office.
items.zh: 我們大部分的客戶都在河邊附近工作。倫敦市中心是辦公室最理想的地點。

items.en: My parents are selling their house this spring. They want the best possible price for it.
items.zh: 我爸媽今年春天要賣房子。他們想用最好的價格賣掉。

items.en: My grandmother was in hospital for a month. The doctors gave her the best possible care.
items.zh: 我奶奶住院住了一個月。醫生給了她最好的照顧。

items.en: I'm sorry your order arrived late. We'll find the best possible solution.
items.zh: 很抱歉你的訂單晚到了。我們會找出最好的解決辦法。

items.en: The final is on Sunday. Our team wants to get the best possible result.
items.zh: 決賽在星期天。我們隊想拿到最好的成績。

examples.heading: ② the + 形容詞-est + possible + 名詞

items.en: The manager spoke about next year's plans. We want to raise sales to the highest possible level.
items.zh: 經理談到明年的計畫。我們想把銷售量提高到最高的水準。

items.en: We'll repair the roof in three stages. This isn't the quickest possible plan, but it's the cheapest.
items.zh: 我們會分三個階段修屋頂。這不是最快的計畫，不過是最便宜的。

items.en: All our staff are busy right now. We'll call you back at the earliest possible moment.
items.zh: 我們所有的員工現在都在忙。我們會盡快回電給你。

items.en: The client moved the deadline to Friday. We need to finish in the shortest possible time.
items.zh: 客戶把截止日改到星期五。我們要在最短的時間內完成。

items.en: The theatre wanted students to come. They sold the tickets at the lowest possible price.
items.zh: 劇院希望學生來看。他們用最低的價格賣票。

items.en: The salesman said the car was very safe. It was built with the strongest possible steel.
items.zh: 業務員說這輛車很安全。它是用最堅固的鋼材打造的。

examples.heading: ③ the most + 形容詞 + possible + 名詞

items.en: My dad paid extra for a bed seat. This is the most comfortable possible seat on the plane.
items.zh: 我爸爸多付錢買了可以躺平的座位。這是飛機上最舒服的座位。

items.en: We didn't want to change planes with a baby. We chose the most direct possible flight.
items.zh: 我們不想帶著寶寶轉機。我們選了最直接的航班。

items.en: My grandmother doesn't understand computers. Explain it in the most basic possible terms.
items.zh: 我奶奶不懂電腦。用最基本的說法解釋。

items.en: The interviewer asked about her weaknesses. She gave the most honest possible answer.
items.zh: 面試官問她的缺點。她給了最誠實的回答。

items.en: The old bridge might fall down. The engineers took the most careful possible approach.
items.zh: 那座舊橋可能會倒。工程師採取了最謹慎的做法。

examples.heading: ④ the worst / smallest / lowest + possible + 名詞

items.en: My car broke down on the way to my wedding. It happened at the worst possible time.
items.zh: 我的車在去婚禮的路上拋錨了。這件事發生在最糟的時候。

items.en: We were halfway up the mountain. The rain came at the worst possible moment.
items.zh: 我們爬到半山腰。雨在最不巧的時候下了。

items.en: Dad has a problem with his heart. Use the smallest possible amount of salt.
items.zh: 爸爸心臟有問題。鹽盡量少放。

items.en: The neighbours have a new baby. We kept the noise to the lowest possible level.
items.zh: 鄰居剛生了寶寶。我們盡量把噪音降到最低。

items.en: The airline charges for big suitcases. We packed the smallest possible bags for the flight.
items.zh: 航空公司對大行李箱收費。我們為了搭飛機，帶了最小的行李。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: The client wants to sign the contract soon. What's the earliest possible date for the meeting?
items.zh: 客戶想盡快簽約。會議最早可以排在哪一天？

items.en: Three hundred pounds for a phone repair? Is this the cheapest possible option?
items.zh: 修手機要三百英鎊？這是最便宜的選擇嗎？

items.en: Your new passport is ready. We'll send it by the fastest possible route.
items.zh: 你的新護照好了。我們會用最快的路線寄出。

items.en: I got a new job on 2 January. That was the best possible start to the year.
items.zh: 我一月二日找到新工作。那是今年最好的開始。

items.en: Our host family met us at the airport with flowers. They gave us the warmest possible welcome.
items.zh: 我們的寄宿家庭帶著花到機場接我們。他們給了我們最熱情的歡迎。

items.en: The party will be boring at the start. Let's leave at the latest possible time.
items.zh: 派對一開始會很無聊。我們盡量晚一點出發。

items.en: My sister met her boyfriend's parents last week. She tried to make the best possible impression.
items.zh: 我姊姊上星期見了她男朋友的爸媽。她努力留下最好的印象。

items.en: We wanted to talk about the plans. We asked for the quietest possible table in the café.
items.zh: 我們想談那些計畫。我們在咖啡店要了最安靜的位子。

items.en: There are six of us, with the grandparents. We booked the largest possible room for the family.
items.zh: 加上爺爺奶奶我們有六個人。我們幫全家訂了最大的房間。

title: You will miss the best party of the year!
translation: 你會錯過今年最棒的派對！
name: 最高級後接 of 片語表示範圍
sentences: Ann threw the best party of the year last Saturday.
Friday is the busiest evening of the week at our café.
We went to the beach on the hottest day of the summer.
Don't go to school hungry. Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
The pipes froze in our kitchen on 3 January. That was the coldest night of the winter.
Everything in the shop is half price today. This is the biggest sale of the season.
The boat ride was the most relaxing part of our holiday.
The story was good until the last ten minutes. The ending was the worst part of the film.
You've been a nurse for twenty years. What's the hardest part of your job?
The speeches were long, but the food was the best part of the wedding.
I take two buses to work. Waiting at the bus stop is the most boring part of the day.
I was lucky that I had time left at the end. The last question was the easiest part of the exam.
Everyone agreed her cake was the best one of all.
I'll take the blue bag. It's the cheapest of the three.
Ann still goes to primary school. She's the youngest of the four kids.
I need something for my sister's wedding. Which is the nicest of these dresses?
Look at my nephew in the team photo. He's the tallest of them all.
Everyone laughed at the story about the goat. That was the funniest of all his jokes.
Holding my baby for the first time was the happiest moment of my life.
Getting lost in the mountains was the scariest experience of my life.
Moving to the countryside was the best decision of my life.
I studied art and worked in a theatre. The year in London was the most exciting time of my life.
Waiting for the test results felt like the longest week of my life.
I missed the match on TV last night. What was the best moment of the game?
I hear this everywhere I go. Is this the most popular song of the summer?
I only have time to read one chapter before class. Which is the most interesting chapter of the book?
Why did you go out for popcorn then? You missed the funniest scene of the movie.
I didn't know anyone, and the teacher spoke very fast. The first day was the most difficult day of the course.
We paid two hundred euros for fish in Venice. That was the most expensive meal of the whole trip.
All the children were away at camp. That was the quietest week of the month.

examples.heading: ① of the year / week / day

items.en: Ann threw the best party of the year last Saturday.
items.zh: Ann 上週六辦了今年最棒的派對。

items.en: Friday is the busiest evening of the week at our café.
items.zh: 星期五晚上是我們咖啡店一週裡最忙的時候。

items.en: We went to the beach on the hottest day of the summer.
items.zh: 我們在夏天最熱的那一天去了海邊。

items.en: Don't go to school hungry. Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
items.zh: 別餓著肚子去上學。早餐是一天當中最重要的一餐。

items.en: The pipes froze in our kitchen on 3 January. That was the coldest night of the winter.
items.zh: 一月三日我們廚房的水管結冰了。那是那年冬天最冷的一晚。

items.en: Everything in the shop is half price today. This is the biggest sale of the season.
items.zh: 店裡所有東西今天都半價。這是這一季最大的特賣。

examples.heading: ② the best / worst part of + 名詞

items.en: The boat ride was the most relaxing part of our holiday.
items.zh: 搭船是我們假期裡最放鬆的部分。

items.en: The story was good until the last ten minutes. The ending was the worst part of the film.
items.zh: 故事到最後十分鐘以前都很好。結局是這部電影最差的部分。

items.en: You've been a nurse for twenty years. What's the hardest part of your job?
items.zh: 你當了二十年的護理師。你的工作最難的部分是什麼？

items.en: The speeches were long, but the food was the best part of the wedding.
items.zh: 致詞很長，可是食物是婚禮最棒的部分。

items.en: I take two buses to work. Waiting at the bus stop is the most boring part of the day.
items.zh: 我上班要搭兩班公車。在公車站等車是一天中最無聊的部分。

items.en: I was lucky that I had time left at the end. The last question was the easiest part of the exam.
items.zh: 我很幸運最後還有時間。最後一題是考試最簡單的部分。

examples.heading: ③ of all / of the three / of them

items.en: Everyone agreed her cake was the best one of all.
items.zh: 大家都同意她的蛋糕是所有蛋糕裡最好吃的。

items.en: I'll take the blue bag. It's the cheapest of the three.
items.zh: 我要藍色那個包包，它是三個裡面最便宜的。

items.en: Ann still goes to primary school. She's the youngest of the four kids.
items.zh: Ann 還在讀小學。她是四個孩子裡最小的。

items.en: I need something for my sister's wedding. Which is the nicest of these dresses?
items.zh: 我需要一件衣服去參加我姊姊的婚禮。這幾件洋裝裡哪一件最好看？

items.en: Look at my nephew in the team photo. He's the tallest of them all.
items.zh: 你看團體照裡我的姪子。他是他們之中最高的。

items.en: Everyone laughed at the story about the goat. That was the funniest of all his jokes.
items.zh: 大家聽到那個山羊的故事都笑了。那是他所有笑話裡最好笑的。

examples.heading: ④ of my life

items.en: Holding my baby for the first time was the happiest moment of my life.
items.zh: 第一次抱我的寶寶是我這輩子最快樂的時刻。

items.en: Getting lost in the mountains was the scariest experience of my life.
items.zh: 在山裡迷路是我這輩子最可怕的經歷。

items.en: Moving to the countryside was the best decision of my life.
items.zh: 搬到鄉下是我這輩子做過最好的決定。

items.en: I studied art and worked in a theatre. The year in London was the most exciting time of my life.
items.zh: 我讀藝術，又在劇院工作。在倫敦的那一年是我這輩子最刺激的時光。

items.en: Waiting for the test results felt like the longest week of my life.
items.zh: 等檢查結果的那一週，感覺是我這輩子最漫長的一週。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和不同的句型

items.en: I missed the match on TV last night. What was the best moment of the game?
items.zh: 我昨晚沒看到電視上的比賽。比賽最精彩的時刻是哪一刻？

items.en: I hear this everywhere I go. Is this the most popular song of the summer?
items.zh: 我到哪裡都聽到這首。這是今年夏天最紅的歌嗎？

items.en: I only have time to read one chapter before class. Which is the most interesting chapter of the book?
items.zh: 上課前我只有時間讀一章。這本書哪一章最有趣？

items.en: Why did you go out for popcorn then? You missed the funniest scene of the movie.
items.zh: 你為什麼那時候出去買爆米花？你錯過了電影最好笑的一幕。

items.en: I didn't know anyone, and the teacher spoke very fast. The first day was the most difficult day of the course.
items.zh: 我誰都不認識，老師又講得很快。第一天是整個課程裡最難的一天。

items.en: We paid two hundred euros for fish in Venice. That was the most expensive meal of the whole trip.
items.zh: 我們在威尼斯吃魚付了兩百歐元。那是整趟旅行最貴的一餐。

items.en: All the children were away at camp. That was the quietest week of the month.
items.zh: 孩子們都去參加營隊了。那是這個月最安靜的一週。

title: We want to present ourselves in the best way possible.
translation: 我們想用最好的方式呈現自己。
name: 最高級加名詞再接 possible、ever
sentences: The art students are planning their end-of-year show. They want to show their work in the best way possible.
This cream heals small cuts in the shortest time possible.
The concert usually sells out in a week. Book your tickets at the earliest date possible.
The builder looked at our kitchen. He said, "We'll do it at the lowest cost possible."
The band put posters all over town. They want the biggest audience possible.
The children are only six. Please answer in the simplest words possible.
The summer of 2023 was the wettest summer ever here.
Dad says it's the tastiest pizza ever!
We've moved two kilometres in an hour. This is the worst traffic ever.
We talked for five hours. It was the longest phone call ever.
My daughter gave her teacher a card on the last day. It said, "You're the best teacher ever!"
Everything is seventy per cent off. It's the biggest sale ever at this shop.
Many fans say it was her greatest show ever.
A hotel wants ten thousand towels from our factory. This is our biggest order ever.
I lost my phone and missed my train. Yesterday was my worst day ever.
Our town's football club won twenty games last year. It was the team's best season ever.
My brother swam across the lake last Sunday. That was his longest swim ever.
The ambulance drivers had no time to lose. They took the most direct road possible to the hospital.
The final ended five to four after extra time. It was the most exciting game ever.
We drive across the desert every summer. We need the most reliable car possible.
The kids said the museum tour was the most boring trip ever.
This letter has my bank details in it. Please send it in the most secure way possible.
In our chess club, Lucy is the strongest player by far.
I looked at ten hotels near the station. The Green Inn is the cheapest hotel by far.
It can go at four hundred kilometres an hour. Is this the fastest car ever made?
The cat opened the fridge by itself? That's the strangest thing ever.
My son hates waiting at airports. We'll get there at the latest time possible.
Hundreds of trees fell down last night. Was that the biggest storm ever in this area?
Her skin gets red very easily. Give the baby the softest blanket possible.
With the kids away, we had the quietest Christmas ever.

examples.heading: ① the + 最高級 + 名詞 + possible

items.en: The art students are planning their end-of-year show. They want to show their work in the best way possible.
items.zh: 美術系的學生在準備期末展。他們想用最好的方式展示他們的作品。

items.en: This cream heals small cuts in the shortest time possible.
items.zh: 這款藥膏能在最短時間內讓小傷口癒合。

items.en: The concert usually sells out in a week. Book your tickets at the earliest date possible.
items.zh: 這場音樂會通常一個星期就賣完。請盡早訂票。

items.en: The builder looked at our kitchen. He said, "We'll do it at the lowest cost possible."
items.zh: 建築工人看了我們的廚房。他說：我們會用最低的成本完成。

items.en: The band put posters all over town. They want the biggest audience possible.
items.zh: 樂團在全鎮貼滿了海報。他們想要越多觀眾越好。

items.en: The children are only six. Please answer in the simplest words possible.
items.zh: 孩子們才六歲。請用最簡單的字回答。

examples.heading: ② the + 最高級 + 名詞 + ever

items.en: The summer of 2023 was the wettest summer ever here.
items.zh: 2023 年的夏天是這裡有史以來最多雨的夏天。

items.en: Dad says it's the tastiest pizza ever!
items.zh: 爸爸說那是有史以來最好吃的披薩！

items.en: We've moved two kilometres in an hour. This is the worst traffic ever.
items.zh: 我們一個小時才前進兩公里。這是有史以來最糟的交通。

items.en: We talked for five hours. It was the longest phone call ever.
items.zh: 我們講了五個小時，那是有史以來最長的一通電話。

items.en: My daughter gave her teacher a card on the last day. It said, "You're the best teacher ever!"
items.zh: 我女兒最後一天給老師一張卡片。上面寫：你是全世界最好的老師！

items.en: Everything is seventy per cent off. It's the biggest sale ever at this shop.
items.zh: 所有東西都打三折。這是這家店有史以來最大的特賣。

examples.heading: ③ 所有格 + 最高級 + 名詞 + ever

items.en: Many fans say it was her greatest show ever.
items.zh: 很多粉絲說那是她有史以來最精彩的演出。

items.en: A hotel wants ten thousand towels from our factory. This is our biggest order ever.
items.zh: 一家飯店向我們工廠訂了一萬條毛巾。這是我們有史以來最大的一筆訂單。

items.en: I lost my phone and missed my train. Yesterday was my worst day ever.
items.zh: 我弄丟了手機，又錯過了火車。昨天是我最倒楣的一天。

items.en: Our town's football club won twenty games last year. It was the team's best season ever.
items.zh: 我們鎮上的足球隊去年贏了二十場。那是這支球隊有史以來最好的一季。

items.en: My brother swam across the lake last Sunday. That was his longest swim ever.
items.zh: 我哥哥上星期天游過了那座湖。那是他游過最長的一次。

examples.heading: ④ the most + 形容詞 + 名詞 + possible / ever

items.en: The ambulance drivers had no time to lose. They took the most direct road possible to the hospital.
items.zh: 救護車司機沒有時間可以浪費。他們走了最直接的路去醫院。

items.en: The final ended five to four after extra time. It was the most exciting game ever.
items.zh: 決賽延長賽後以五比四結束。那是有史以來最刺激的比賽。

items.en: We drive across the desert every summer. We need the most reliable car possible.
items.zh: 我們每年夏天都開車穿越沙漠。我們需要最可靠的車。

items.en: The kids said the museum tour was the most boring trip ever.
items.zh: 孩子們說那次博物館導覽是有史以來最無聊的出遊。

items.en: This letter has my bank details in it. Please send it in the most secure way possible.
items.zh: 這封信裡有我的銀行資料。請用最安全的方式寄出。

examples.heading: ⑤ the + 最高級 + 名詞 + by far 和不同的句型

items.en: In our chess club, Lucy is the strongest player by far.
items.zh: 在我們的西洋棋社，Lucy 是最強的棋手，其他人差遠了。

items.en: I looked at ten hotels near the station. The Green Inn is the cheapest hotel by far.
items.zh: 我看了車站附近十家飯店。綠旅館絕對是最便宜的。

items.en: It can go at four hundred kilometres an hour. Is this the fastest car ever made?
items.zh: 它時速可以到四百公里。這是有史以來最快的車嗎？

items.en: The cat opened the fridge by itself? That's the strangest thing ever.
items.zh: 貓自己打開冰箱？那是最奇怪的事。

items.en: My son hates waiting at airports. We'll get there at the latest time possible.
items.zh: 我兒子討厭在機場等。我們會盡量晚一點到。

items.en: Hundreds of trees fell down last night. Was that the biggest storm ever in this area?
items.zh: 昨天晚上倒了好幾百棵樹。那是這一帶有史以來最大的暴風雨嗎？

items.en: Her skin gets red very easily. Give the baby the softest blanket possible.
items.zh: 她的皮膚很容易發紅。給寶寶最柔軟的毯子。

items.en: With the kids away, we had the quietest Christmas ever.
items.zh: 孩子們不在，我們過了有史以來最安靜的聖誕節。

title: The food at restaurant A is slightly better than at restaurant B.
translation: A 餐廳的菜比 B 餐廳的稍微好一點。
name: slightly 修飾比較級形容詞
sentences: The blue jacket is slightly cheaper than the black one.
This year's rent is slightly higher than last year's.
The train was slightly later than usual this morning.
The second test was slightly easier for most students.
My new desk is slightly wider than the old one.
The water in the lake was slightly warmer in the afternoon.
Is the bottom shelf slightly lower than the others?
The hotel by the sea is slightly more expensive.
The second plan seems slightly more practical.
Sales were slightly more successful in the spring.
The old version of the app was slightly more reliable.
The new chairs are slightly more comfortable than the old ones.
Our second meeting with the client was slightly more relaxed.
The food at the first restaurant was slightly better.
His exam results were slightly better than last term.
The traffic was slightly worse because of the rain.
I think the second photo is slightly better.
Her cough sounded slightly worse this morning.
Could I have a slightly bigger room?
We took a slightly longer route to avoid the traffic.
She wants a slightly cheaper phone for her son.
The shop has slightly smaller sizes in the back.
Let's meet at a slightly earlier time on Friday.
He ordered a slightly larger coffee.
You look slightly taller in those boots.
The room feels slightly colder with the window open.
Prices seem slightly lower at the market.
The patient is getting slightly stronger every day.
The second coat of paint looked slightly darker.
It got slightly warmer after lunch.

examples.heading: ① slightly + 形容詞-er

items.en: The blue jacket is slightly cheaper than the black one.
items.zh: 藍色那件外套比黑色那件便宜一點。

items.en: This year's rent is slightly higher than last year's.
items.zh: 今年的房租比去年高一點。

items.en: The train was slightly later than usual this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上火車比平常晚一點。

items.en: The second test was slightly easier for most students.
items.zh: 對大部分的學生來說，第二次考試簡單一點。

items.en: My new desk is slightly wider than the old one.
items.zh: 我的新書桌比舊的寬一點。

items.en: The water in the lake was slightly warmer in the afternoon.
items.zh: 下午湖水暖一點。

items.en: Is the bottom shelf slightly lower than the others?
items.zh: 最下面那層架子是不是比其他的低一點？

examples.heading: ② slightly + more + 形容詞

items.en: The hotel by the sea is slightly more expensive.
items.zh: 海邊那家旅館貴一點。

items.en: The second plan seems slightly more practical.
items.zh: 第二個計畫看起來實際一點。

items.en: Sales were slightly more successful in the spring.
items.zh: 春天的銷售成績好一點。

items.en: The old version of the app was slightly more reliable.
items.zh: 舊版的 app 穩定一點。

items.en: The new chairs are slightly more comfortable than the old ones.
items.zh: 新的椅子比舊的舒服一點。

items.en: Our second meeting with the client was slightly more relaxed.
items.zh: 我們第二次和客戶開會時，氣氛輕鬆一點。

examples.heading: ③ slightly better / slightly worse

items.en: The food at the first restaurant was slightly better.
items.zh: 第一家餐廳的菜好一點。

items.en: His exam results were slightly better than last term.
items.zh: 他的考試成績比上學期好一點。

items.en: The traffic was slightly worse because of the rain.
items.zh: 因為下雨，交通糟了一點。

items.en: I think the second photo is slightly better.
items.zh: 我覺得第二張照片好一點。

items.en: Her cough sounded slightly worse this morning.
items.zh: 她今天早上咳嗽的聲音聽起來嚴重了一點。

examples.heading: ④ slightly + 比較級 + 名詞

items.en: Could I have a slightly bigger room?
items.zh: 我可以換一間大一點的房間嗎？

items.en: We took a slightly longer route to avoid the traffic.
items.zh: 為了避開車潮，我們走了一條遠一點的路。

items.en: She wants a slightly cheaper phone for her son.
items.zh: 她想幫兒子買一支便宜一點的手機。

items.en: The shop has slightly smaller sizes in the back.
items.zh: 店裡後面有小一點的尺寸。

items.en: Let's meet at a slightly earlier time on Friday.
items.zh: 我們星期五早一點的時間見面吧。

items.en: He ordered a slightly larger coffee.
items.zh: 他點了一杯大一點的咖啡。

examples.heading: ⑤ look / feel / seem / get 後面

items.en: You look slightly taller in those boots.
items.zh: 你穿那雙靴子看起來高一點。

items.en: The room feels slightly colder with the window open.
items.zh: 窗戶開著，房間感覺冷一點。

items.en: Prices seem slightly lower at the market.
items.zh: 市場的價格好像低一點。

items.en: The patient is getting slightly stronger every day.
items.zh: 病人每天都強壯一點。

items.en: The second coat of paint looked slightly darker.
items.zh: 第二層油漆看起來深一點。

items.en: It got slightly warmer after lunch.
items.zh: 午餐後天氣暖了一點。

title: I think the teacher in the new class is much better than the last one.
translation: 我覺得新班的老師比上一個好很多。
name: (so) much 修飾比較級形容詞
sentences: This flat is much bigger than our old one.
The express train is much faster than the local one.
My sister is much older than her husband.
The lake was much colder than we expected.
Our new neighbors are much quieter.
Her second book was much shorter than her first.
Is the hotel much cheaper on weekdays?
The shy girl in my class is much braver now.
The museum was much more interesting than I thought.
Flying is much more expensive than taking the train.
Our new manager is much more reticent than the old one.
The second test was much more difficult.
This chair is much more comfortable than the sofa.
Life in the city is much more stressful.
The weather today is much better than yesterday.
Your English is much better than mine.
The traffic was much worse this morning.
Is your grandmother much better now?
The food here is much better than at the old place.
The house is beautiful, and so much bigger than the previous one.
This new laptop is so much lighter.
Ann's cooking is so much better than mine.
The beach was so much cleaner this year.
Walking to work is so much cheaper than driving.
The children look much happier in the new school.
It's getting much colder at night.
I feel much calmer after a long walk.
The new boss seems much friendlier.
The streets got much busier after the new mall opened.
My grandfather feels so much healthier these days.

examples.heading: ① much + 形容詞-er

items.en: This flat is much bigger than our old one.
items.zh: 這間公寓比我們以前那間大很多。

items.en: The express train is much faster than the local one.
items.zh: 快車比區間車快很多。

items.en: My sister is much older than her husband.
items.zh: 我姊姊比她先生大很多。

items.en: The lake was much colder than we expected.
items.zh: 湖水比我們想的冷很多。

items.en: Our new neighbors are much quieter.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居安靜多了。

items.en: Her second book was much shorter than her first.
items.zh: 她的第二本書比第一本短很多。

items.en: Is the hotel much cheaper on weekdays?
items.zh: 那家旅館平日便宜很多嗎？

items.en: The shy girl in my class is much braver now.
items.zh: 我們班上那個害羞的女生現在勇敢多了。

examples.heading: ② much + more + 形容詞

items.en: The museum was much more interesting than I thought.
items.zh: 博物館比我想的有趣很多。

items.en: Flying is much more expensive than taking the train.
items.zh: 搭飛機比搭火車貴很多。

items.en: Our new manager is much more reticent than the old one.
items.zh: 我們的新經理比原本那個話少很多。

items.en: The second test was much more difficult.
items.zh: 第二次考試難很多。

items.en: This chair is much more comfortable than the sofa.
items.zh: 這張椅子比沙發舒服很多。

items.en: Life in the city is much more stressful.
items.zh: 在城市生活壓力大很多。

examples.heading: ③ much better / much worse

items.en: The weather today is much better than yesterday.
items.zh: 今天的天氣比昨天好很多。

items.en: Your English is much better than mine.
items.zh: 你的英文比我的好很多。

items.en: The traffic was much worse this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上的交通糟很多。

items.en: Is your grandmother much better now?
items.zh: 你奶奶現在好多了嗎？

items.en: The food here is much better than at the old place.
items.zh: 這裡的食物比以前那家好吃很多。

examples.heading: ④ so much + 比較級

items.en: The house is beautiful, and so much bigger than the previous one.
items.zh: 這間房子很漂亮，而且比之前那間大太多了。

items.en: This new laptop is so much lighter.
items.zh: 這台新的筆電輕太多了。

items.en: Ann's cooking is so much better than mine.
items.zh: Ann 的廚藝比我的好太多了。

items.en: The beach was so much cleaner this year.
items.zh: 今年的海灘乾淨太多了。

items.en: Walking to work is so much cheaper than driving.
items.zh: 走路上班比開車省太多了。

examples.heading: ⑤ look / feel / seem / get 後面

items.en: The children look much happier in the new school.
items.zh: 孩子們在新學校看起來開心多了。

items.en: It's getting much colder at night.
items.zh: 晚上變得冷多了。

items.en: I feel much calmer after a long walk.
items.zh: 走了一大段路以後，我覺得平靜多了。

items.en: The new boss seems much friendlier.
items.zh: 新老闆看起來友善多了。

items.en: The streets got much busier after the new mall opened.
items.zh: 新的購物中心開幕以後，街上熱鬧多了。

items.en: My grandfather feels so much healthier these days.
items.zh: 我爺爺最近覺得身體好太多了。

title: It was sunny and really hot every day!
translation: 每天都出大太陽，真的好熱！
name: really、so、quite 修飾形容詞
sentences: Don't jump in yet. The pool is really cold.
Your new haircut looks really good.
The math homework was really hard tonight.
Thanks for the help. You're really kind.
The bus was really crowded this morning.
Is the hotel really expensive in July?
We had a really nice dinner at the new restaurant.
I'm so happy we can have a party for my birthday!
Thank you for the flowers. They're so beautiful.
I'm so tired. I'm going to bed.
Look at that puppy in the window! It's so cute!
I almost fell asleep. The movie was so boring.
I said sorry. Why are you still so upset?
Turn on the fan. The kitchen is so hot.
The jeans are quite expensive, but they're good quality.
The town is quite small, so we walked everywhere.
The people in my new office are quite friendly.
The exam was quite easy for most of us.
It's quite cold today. Take a jacket.
Her English is quite good for a beginner.
Take the bus. It's quite a long walk to the museum.
They live in quite a big house near the park.
Ken asked quite a strange question in class.
We had quite a good time at the beach.
She's quite a fast runner.
The rooms were bright and really warm in winter.
The room was clean and really quiet.
The teacher was so patient and so kind.
The shop is small but quite busy.
The cake looked so pretty and tasted really good.

examples.heading: ① really + 形容詞

items.en: Don't jump in yet. The pool is really cold.
items.zh: 先別跳下去，游泳池的水真的很冰。

items.en: Your new haircut looks really good.
items.zh: 你的新髮型真的很好看。

items.en: The math homework was really hard tonight.
items.zh: 今天晚上的數學作業真的很難。

items.en: Thanks for the help. You're really kind.
items.zh: 謝謝你幫忙，你人真的很好。

items.en: The bus was really crowded this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上公車真的很擠。

items.en: Is the hotel really expensive in July?
items.zh: 那家旅館七月真的很貴嗎？

items.en: We had a really nice dinner at the new restaurant.
items.zh: 我們在那家新餐廳吃了一頓很棒的晚餐。

examples.heading: ② so + 形容詞

items.en: I'm so happy we can have a party for my birthday!
items.zh: 我好開心我們可以一起幫我辦生日派對！

items.en: Thank you for the flowers. They're so beautiful.
items.zh: 謝謝你送的花，好漂亮。

items.en: I'm so tired. I'm going to bed.
items.zh: 我好累，我要去睡了。

items.en: Look at that puppy in the window! It's so cute!
items.zh: 你看櫥窗裡那隻小狗！好可愛！

items.en: I almost fell asleep. The movie was so boring.
items.zh: 我差點睡著，那部電影好無聊。

items.en: I said sorry. Why are you still so upset?
items.zh: 我已經道歉了，你為什麼還那麼不高興？

items.en: Turn on the fan. The kitchen is so hot.
items.zh: 開電扇吧，廚房好熱。

examples.heading: ③ quite + 形容詞

items.en: The jeans are quite expensive, but they're good quality.
items.zh: 這條牛仔褲相當貴，不過品質很好。

items.en: The town is quite small, so we walked everywhere.
items.zh: 那個小鎮不大，所以我們到哪裡都用走的。

items.en: The people in my new office are quite friendly.
items.zh: 我新辦公室的同事還算友善。

items.en: The exam was quite easy for most of us.
items.zh: 這次考試對我們大部分的人來說還算簡單。

items.en: It's quite cold today. Take a jacket.
items.zh: 今天滿冷的，帶件外套吧。

items.en: Her English is quite good for a beginner.
items.zh: 以初學者來說，她的英文算很好了。

examples.heading: ④ quite a + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: Take the bus. It's quite a long walk to the museum.
items.zh: 搭公車吧，走到博物館滿遠的。

items.en: They live in quite a big house near the park.
items.zh: 他們住在公園附近一棟相當大的房子。

items.en: Ken asked quite a strange question in class.
items.zh: Ken 在課堂上問了一個滿奇怪的問題。

items.en: We had quite a good time at the beach.
items.zh: 我們在海邊玩得滿開心的。

items.en: She's quite a fast runner.
items.zh: 她跑得滿快的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 兩個形容詞

items.en: The rooms were bright and really warm in winter.
items.zh: 冬天房間很亮，而且真的很暖和。

items.en: The room was clean and really quiet.
items.zh: 房間很乾淨，而且真的很安靜。

items.en: The teacher was so patient and so kind.
items.zh: 老師好有耐心，人又好。

items.en: The shop is small but quite busy.
items.zh: 那家店很小，但是客人還算多。

items.en: The cake looked so pretty and tasted really good.
items.zh: 蛋糕看起來好漂亮，吃起來也真的很好吃。

title: Tomorrow I'm expecting a delivery of our latest catalogs.
translation: 我明天要收一批我們最新的型錄。
name: 限定詞加最高級形容詞
sentences: We're sending our latest catalogs to all our customers.
People wear their best clothes to the festival.
Our biggest customer is a hotel chain.
Their youngest child just started school.
Our newest store opens next month.
Their cheapest room was still too expensive for us.
He showed me his latest paintings.
Her greatest fear is flying.
Bring your strongest bag for the books.
My earliest memory is of my grandmother's garden.
His fastest time was under ten seconds.
The company sold its oldest factory.
The team played its best game of the season.
