items.en: It's too dark in the garden now. Bring a torch.
items.zh: 花園裡現在太暗了，帶支手電筒吧。

items.en: It gets too hot in the car in summer.
items.zh: 夏天車子裡會太熱。

items.en: The beach is too noisy at night.
items.zh: 海灘晚上太吵了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: Most of my old clothes are too small for me now.
items.zh: 我大部分的舊衣服現在都太小，穿不下了。

items.en: Are these boots too big for you?
items.zh: 這雙靴子你穿會太大嗎？

items.en: I think this book is too easy for my class.
items.zh: 我覺得這本書對我班上的學生來說太簡單了。

items.en: The flat was too expensive for a student.
items.zh: 那間公寓對學生來說太貴了。

items.en: Don't buy that sofa. It's too big for our living room.
items.zh: 別買那張沙發，它放我們的客廳太大了。

title: He always told me that he was too busy to write a letter to me.
translation: 他總是跟我說他太忙了，沒空寫信給我。
name: too 修飾形容詞再接不定詞
sentences: I was too tired to cook last night.
He was always too busy to call his mother.
My son is too young to go to school.
She was too nervous to speak in front of the class.
We were too late to see the start of the movie.
Are you too sick to come to work today?
I'm too full to eat dessert.
It's too cold to go swimming today.
It was too dark to see the path.
This printer is too old to work properly.
It's too late to change the plan now.
The river was too deep to cross on foot.
The weather was too bad to fly.
This tea is too hot to drink.
The box is too heavy to carry upstairs.
The instructions were too difficult to understand.
That shelf is too high to reach.
The fish was too salty to eat.
Her handwriting is too small to read.
The suitcase was too heavy for me to lift.
The questions were too hard for the kids to answer.
The music was too loud for us to talk.
It's too far for Grandma to walk.
The shoes were too expensive for her to buy.
The water is too cold for the baby to swim in.
Is it too early to call Ken?
You're never too old to learn a new language.
Don't be too proud to ask for help.
The road will be too icy to drive on tonight.
I was too surprised to say anything.

examples.heading: ① too + 形容詞 + to 不定詞（主詞是人）

items.en: I was too tired to cook last night.
items.zh: 我昨天晚上太累了，沒辦法煮飯。

items.en: He was always too busy to call his mother.
items.zh: 他總是忙到沒空打電話給他媽媽。

items.en: My son is too young to go to school.
items.zh: 我兒子還太小，不能上學。

items.en: She was too nervous to speak in front of the class.
items.zh: 她太緊張了，沒辦法在全班面前說話。

items.en: We were too late to see the start of the movie.
items.zh: 我們太晚到，沒看到電影的開頭。

items.en: Are you too sick to come to work today?
items.zh: 你今天病到不能來上班嗎？

items.en: I'm too full to eat dessert.
items.zh: 我太飽了，吃不下甜點。

examples.heading: ② too + 形容詞 + to 不定詞（主詞是東西或情況）

items.en: It's too cold to go swimming today.
items.zh: 今天太冷了，不能去游泳。

items.en: It was too dark to see the path.
items.zh: 天太暗了，看不到路。

items.en: This printer is too old to work properly.
items.zh: 這台印表機太舊了，沒辦法好好運作。

items.en: It's too late to change the plan now.
items.zh: 現在要改計畫太晚了。

items.en: The river was too deep to cross on foot.
items.zh: 河太深了，沒辦法走過去。

items.en: The weather was too bad to fly.
items.zh: 天氣太差，飛機不能飛。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞是不定詞的受詞

items.en: This tea is too hot to drink.
items.zh: 這茶太燙了，沒辦法喝。

items.en: The box is too heavy to carry upstairs.
items.zh: 箱子太重了，沒辦法搬上樓。

items.en: The instructions were too difficult to understand.
items.zh: 說明書太難了，看不懂。

items.en: That shelf is too high to reach.
items.zh: 那層架子太高了，搆不到。

items.en: The fish was too salty to eat.
items.zh: 那條魚太鹹了，沒辦法吃。

items.en: Her handwriting is too small to read.
items.zh: 她的字太小了，看不清楚。

examples.heading: ④ too + 形容詞 + for + 人 + to 不定詞

items.en: The suitcase was too heavy for me to lift.
items.zh: 這個行李箱太重了，我提不起來。

items.en: The questions were too hard for the kids to answer.
items.zh: 這些問題太難了，孩子們答不出來。

items.en: The music was too loud for us to talk.
items.zh: 音樂太大聲了，我們沒辦法講話。

items.en: It's too far for Grandma to walk.
items.zh: 這段路太遠，奶奶走不到。

items.en: The shoes were too expensive for her to buy.
items.zh: 那雙鞋太貴了，她買不起。

items.en: The water is too cold for the baby to swim in.
items.zh: 水太冰了，寶寶不能下去游。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: Is it too early to call Ken?
items.zh: 現在打給 Ken 會太早嗎？

items.en: You're never too old to learn a new language.
items.zh: 學新語言永遠不嫌老。

items.en: Don't be too proud to ask for help.
items.zh: 別因為太愛面子而不求助。

items.en: The road will be too icy to drive on tonight.
items.zh: 今晚路面會結冰，沒辦法開車。

items.en: I was too surprised to say anything.
items.zh: 我驚訝到說不出話來。

title: My neighbors are very friendly.
translation: 我的鄰居都很友善。
name: very 修飾形容詞（少數常用形容詞）
sentences: The hotel staff were very nice to us.
My new teacher is very kind.
Your little brother is very funny.
Dad is very tired after his long flight.
The children were very happy at the party.
Grandma is very busy in the garden this week.
Are you very hungry? Dinner is almost ready.
My bedroom is very small, but I like it.
The beach was very beautiful this morning.
This soup is very hot, so be careful.
The dog next door is very big, but it's friendly.
The museum is very quiet on Monday mornings.
These shoes are very comfortable.
The park near my school is very clean.
It's very cold outside today.
It was very hot in Tainan last summer.
The mornings are very dark in December.
It's very late, and the last bus leaves at eleven.
The weather was very nice on our trip.
The first lesson was very easy for me.
This game is very good for kids.
The movie was very long, so I fell asleep.
Learning to swim is very important.
My job is very interesting.
I like my town because it's very quiet and very nice.
The food was very cheap and very good.
My grandparents are very old and very sweet.
The new shop is very small but very busy.
Our teacher is very strict but very fair.
The hotel room was very clean and very quiet.

examples.heading: ① 人

items.en: The hotel staff were very nice to us.
items.zh: 飯店的員工對我們很好。

items.en: My new teacher is very kind.
items.zh: 我的新老師人很好。

items.en: Your little brother is very funny.
items.zh: 你弟弟很好笑。

items.en: Dad is very tired after his long flight.
items.zh: 爸爸坐了很久的飛機，很累。

items.en: The children were very happy at the party.
items.zh: 孩子們在派對上很開心。

items.en: Grandma is very busy in the garden this week.
items.zh: 奶奶這個禮拜在花園裡很忙。

items.en: Are you very hungry? Dinner is almost ready.
items.zh: 你很餓嗎？晚餐快好了。

examples.heading: ② 東西和地方

items.en: My bedroom is very small, but I like it.
items.zh: 我的臥室很小，但是我很喜歡。

items.en: The beach was very beautiful this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上的海灘很漂亮。

items.en: This soup is very hot, so be careful.
items.zh: 這碗湯很燙，小心一點。

items.en: The dog next door is very big, but it's friendly.
items.zh: 隔壁的狗很大，但是很友善。

items.en: The museum is very quiet on Monday mornings.
items.zh: 博物館星期一早上很安靜。

items.en: These shoes are very comfortable.
items.zh: 這雙鞋很舒服。

items.en: The park near my school is very clean.
items.zh: 我學校附近的公園很乾淨。

examples.heading: ③ 天氣和時間

items.en: It's very cold outside today.
items.zh: 今天外面很冷。

items.en: It was very hot in Tainan last summer.
items.zh: 去年夏天台南很熱。

items.en: The mornings are very dark in December.
items.zh: 十二月的早上天色很暗。

items.en: It's very late, and the last bus leaves at eleven.
items.zh: 很晚了，最後一班公車十一點開。

items.en: The weather was very nice on our trip.
items.zh: 我們旅行的時候天氣很好。

examples.heading: ④ 事情和活動

items.en: The first lesson was very easy for me.
items.zh: 第一堂課對我來說很簡單。

items.en: This game is very good for kids.
items.zh: 這個遊戲很適合小孩。

items.en: The movie was very long, so I fell asleep.
items.zh: 那部電影很長，所以我睡著了。

items.en: Learning to swim is very important.
items.zh: 學游泳很重要。

items.en: My job is very interesting.
items.zh: 我的工作很有趣。

examples.heading: ⑤ 兩個 very

items.en: I like my town because it's very quiet and very nice.
items.zh: 我喜歡我住的小鎮，因為那裡很安靜，也很好。

items.en: The food was very cheap and very good.
items.zh: 那裡的食物很便宜，也很好吃。

items.en: My grandparents are very old and very sweet.
items.zh: 我的祖父母年紀很大，人也很好。

items.en: The new shop is very small but very busy.
items.zh: 新開的店很小，但是客人很多。

items.en: Our teacher is very strict but very fair.
items.zh: 我們老師很嚴格，但是很公平。

items.en: The hotel room was very clean and very quiet.
items.zh: 飯店房間很乾淨，也很安靜。

title: Imaginative, good-humored, friendly, he was respected and liked by his fellow students.
translation: 他富有想像力、幽默又友善，同學都很尊敬他、喜歡他。
name: 多個形容詞構成的省略子句（強調）
sentences: Tired and hungry, we finally reached the hotel.
Calm and patient, she answered every question.
Cold, wet and miserable, the children walked home.
Young, rich and famous, he seemed to have everything.
Nervous but excited, Ann walked onto the stage.
Quiet, polite, hard-working, she was every teacher's favorite.
Kind and generous, my grandfather helped everyone in the village.
Small, cheap and fast, the new car sold very well.
Hot, dusty and crowded, the market was full of noise.
Brave and honest, the young reporter told the truth.
Angry and confused, he left the room without a word.
Funny, clever and kind, Ken soon made many friends.
Old and tired, the dog slept all day.
Clean, bright and modern, the new library is popular with students.
Sad and lonely, she wrote to her old friends.
Shy and nervous, the boy said nothing at first.
The old man – tired, cold and hungry – sat down by the fire.
The room – dark, small and dirty – smelled terrible.
Our teacher – strict but fair – was loved by everyone.
The road – narrow, steep and icy – was very dangerous.
The puppy – small, soft and sleepy – lay in my arms.
The hotel – cheap, clean and quiet – was perfect for us.
My brother – tall, thin and pale – looked very ill.
The city – busy, loud and exciting – never sleeps.
Happy and relaxed, they will enjoy the holiday.
Wet and cold, I couldn't wait to get home.
Excited, nervous, a little scared, the students waited for the results.
Proud and happy, the parents watched their son graduate.
The test – long and difficult – took three hours.
Simple, fresh and cheap, the food at the stall is always popular.

examples.heading: ① 一串形容詞放在句首

items.en: Tired and hungry, we finally reached the hotel.
items.zh: 又累又餓的我們終於到了旅館。

items.en: Calm and patient, she answered every question.
items.zh: 她冷靜又有耐心，回答了每一個問題。

items.en: Cold, wet and miserable, the children walked home.
items.zh: 孩子們又冷又濕又難受，走路回家。

items.en: Young, rich and famous, he seemed to have everything.
items.zh: 他年輕、有錢又有名，好像什麼都有了。

items.en: Nervous but excited, Ann walked onto the stage.
items.zh: Ann 緊張又興奮地走上舞台。

items.en: Quiet, polite, hard-working, she was every teacher's favorite.
items.zh: 她安靜、有禮貌又勤奮，是每個老師最喜歡的學生。

items.en: Kind and generous, my grandfather helped everyone in the village.
items.zh: 我爺爺善良又大方，幫助村裡的每一個人。

items.en: Small, cheap and fast, the new car sold very well.
items.zh: 新車小巧、便宜又快，賣得很好。

items.en: Hot, dusty and crowded, the market was full of noise.
items.zh: 市場又熱、灰塵又多、人又擠，到處都很吵。

items.en: Brave and honest, the young reporter told the truth.
items.zh: 那個年輕記者勇敢又誠實，說出了真相。

items.en: Angry and confused, he left the room without a word.
items.zh: 他又生氣又困惑，一句話也沒說就離開了房間。

items.en: Funny, clever and kind, Ken soon made many friends.
items.zh: Ken 風趣、聰明又善良，很快就交了很多朋友。

items.en: Old and tired, the dog slept all day.
items.zh: 那隻狗又老又累，整天都在睡覺。

items.en: Clean, bright and modern, the new library is popular with students.
items.zh: 新的圖書館乾淨、明亮又現代，很受學生歡迎。

items.en: Sad and lonely, she wrote to her old friends.
items.zh: 她又難過又寂寞，寫信給她的老朋友。

items.en: Shy and nervous, the boy said nothing at first.
items.zh: 那個男孩又害羞又緊張，一開始什麼話也沒說。

examples.heading: ② 一串形容詞放在名詞後面

items.en: The old man – tired, cold and hungry – sat down by the fire.
items.zh: 那個老人又累又冷又餓，在火爐旁坐了下來。

items.en: The room – dark, small and dirty – smelled terrible.
items.zh: 那個房間又暗又小又髒，聞起來很可怕。

items.en: Our teacher – strict but fair – was loved by everyone.
items.zh: 我們老師很嚴格，但是很公平，大家都很喜歡她。

items.en: The road – narrow, steep and icy – was very dangerous.
items.zh: 那條路又窄又陡又結冰，非常危險。

items.en: The puppy – small, soft and sleepy – lay in my arms.
items.zh: 那隻小狗又小又軟，睡眼惺忪，躺在我懷裡。

items.en: The hotel – cheap, clean and quiet – was perfect for us.
items.zh: 那家旅館便宜、乾淨又安靜，對我們來說剛剛好。

items.en: My brother – tall, thin and pale – looked very ill.
items.zh: 我哥哥又高又瘦，臉色蒼白，看起來病得很重。

items.en: The city – busy, loud and exciting – never sleeps.
items.zh: 這座城市忙碌、喧鬧又刺激，從來不睡覺。

examples.heading: ③ 不同的形式

items.en: Happy and relaxed, they will enjoy the holiday.
items.zh: 他們開心又放鬆，會好好享受假期。

items.en: Wet and cold, I couldn't wait to get home.
items.zh: 我又濕又冷，等不及要回家。

items.en: Excited, nervous, a little scared, the students waited for the results.
items.zh: 學生們興奮、緊張，還有點害怕，等著結果。

items.en: Proud and happy, the parents watched their son graduate.
items.zh: 父母又驕傲又開心，看著兒子畢業。

items.en: The test – long and difficult – took three hours.
items.zh: 那次考試又長又難，花了三個小時。

items.en: Simple, fresh and cheap, the food at the stall is always popular.
items.zh: 那個攤子的食物簡單、新鮮又便宜，一直都很受歡迎。

title: I hope to fix the problem very quickly.
translation: 我希望能很快就把問題解決。
name: 副詞修飾副詞
sentences: My grandfather drives very slowly.
Our son is doing really well at his new school.
The kids ate their lunch very quickly and ran outside.
The guide spoke really clearly, so everyone understood her.
Please speak very quietly in the library.
Our team played really badly yesterday.
Your daughter plays the piano so beautifully!
He talks too fast. I can't understand him.
The time went so quickly on holiday.
You're walking too slowly. We'll miss the bus.
The old dog climbed the stairs so carefully.
The number 9 bus comes really often in the morning.
My husband and I don't argue very often.
You came home too late last night.
The new shopping centre will open really soon.
We got to the station too early and had to wait.
Thank you so much for driving all this way to see us.
Grandma appreciated your visit very much.
We miss our old school so much.
My dad loves football so much.
Did you like the museum very much?
I can't talk right now. I'm driving.
Leave your bags right here by the door.
The doctor will see you right away.
Please answer my email right away.
It's raining right now, so let's wait.
The bus stop is right there, next to the bank.
He doesn't speak French very well.
Did the time pass really slowly in hospital?
Why did the meeting finish so early today?
Our new printer doesn't work very well with my laptop.

examples.heading: ① very、really + 情狀副詞

items.en: My grandfather drives very slowly.
items.zh: 我爺爺開車開得很慢。

items.en: Our son is doing really well at his new school.
items.zh: 我們兒子在新學校表現得很好。

items.en: The kids ate their lunch very quickly and ran outside.
items.zh: 孩子們很快吃完午餐就跑出去了。

items.en: The guide spoke really clearly, so everyone understood her.
items.zh: 導遊講得很清楚，所以大家都聽得懂。

items.en: Please speak very quietly in the library.
items.zh: 在圖書館請小聲說話。

items.en: Our team played really badly yesterday.
items.zh: 我們隊昨天打得很差。

examples.heading: ② so、too + 情狀副詞

items.en: Your daughter plays the piano so beautifully!
items.zh: 你女兒鋼琴彈得好美！

items.en: He talks too fast. I can't understand him.
items.zh: 他說話太快了，我聽不懂。

items.en: The time went so quickly on holiday.
items.zh: 度假的時候時間過得好快。

items.en: You're walking too slowly. We'll miss the bus.
items.zh: 你走太慢了，我們會趕不上公車。

items.en: The old dog climbed the stairs so carefully.
items.zh: 那隻老狗好小心地爬上樓梯。

examples.heading: ③ very、really、too + 時間副詞

items.en: The number 9 bus comes really often in the morning.
items.zh: 9 號公車早上班次很密。

items.en: My husband and I don't argue very often.
items.zh: 我和我先生不常吵架。

items.en: You came home too late last night.
items.zh: 你昨晚太晚回家了。

items.en: The new shopping centre will open really soon.
items.zh: 新的購物中心很快就要開幕了。

items.en: We got to the station too early and had to wait.
items.zh: 我們太早到車站，只好等。

examples.heading: ④ so much、very much

items.en: Thank you so much for driving all this way to see us.
items.zh: 非常謝謝你大老遠開車來看我們。

items.en: Grandma appreciated your visit very much.
items.zh: 奶奶很感謝你來看她。

items.en: We miss our old school so much.
items.zh: 我們好想念以前的學校。

items.en: My dad loves football so much.
items.zh: 我爸超愛足球。

items.en: Did you like the museum very much?
items.zh: 你很喜歡那間博物館嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ right now、right here、right away

items.en: I can't talk right now. I'm driving.
items.zh: 我現在不能講電話，我在開車。

items.en: Leave your bags right here by the door.
items.zh: 把你的包包放在門邊這裡就好。

items.en: The doctor will see you right away.
items.zh: 醫生馬上就會幫你看診。

items.en: Please answer my email right away.
items.zh: 請馬上回我的電子郵件。

items.en: It's raining right now, so let's wait.
items.zh: 現在正在下雨，我們等一下吧。

items.en: The bus stop is right there, next to the bank.
items.zh: 公車站就在那裡，銀行旁邊。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句和疑問句

items.en: He doesn't speak French very well.
items.zh: 他法語說得不太好。

items.en: Did the time pass really slowly in hospital?
items.zh: 在醫院的時候，時間過得很慢嗎？

items.en: Why did the meeting finish so early today?
items.zh: 今天的會議為什麼這麼早就結束了？

items.en: Our new printer doesn't work very well with my laptop.
items.zh: 我們的新印表機跟我的筆電配合得不太好。

title: We get along quite well.
translation: 我們處得滿好的。
name: 副詞修飾副詞（較多種）
sentences: My brother cooks pretty well for a student.
The interview went quite well, I think.
She learns new languages fairly quickly.
The kids behaved pretty badly at the restaurant.
We finished the job fairly easily.
Our new manager speaks pretty quickly in meetings.
My dad almost always falls asleep in front of the TV.
It nearly always rains on my birthday.
We almost never go out on weeknights.
The trains are nearly always on time here.
My cat almost never comes when I call her.
I nearly always forget my umbrella.
This coffee is just too sweet for me.
The kids played just so nicely together today.
You worry just too much about little things.
The hotel was just too far from the beach.
We moved into this flat just yesterday, so it's still a mess.
Your mum called just now.
The new library opened just last week.
I finished the book just this morning.
The music is far too loud. Can you turn it down?
He spends much too long on his phone.
We arrived far too early for the party.
You eat much too quickly. Slow down.
The bus goes far too slowly in the city centre.
Does it nearly always snow here in January?
Do you almost always walk to school?
Isn't this soup just too salty?
Isn't the TV much too loud?
Did your son do fairly well in his exams?

examples.heading: ① quite、pretty、fairly + 情狀副詞

items.en: My brother cooks pretty well for a student.
items.zh: 以學生來說，我哥煮飯煮得滿好的。

items.en: The interview went quite well, I think.
items.zh: 我覺得面試進行得還算順利。

items.en: She learns new languages fairly quickly.
items.zh: 她學新語言學得還算快。

items.en: The kids behaved pretty badly at the restaurant.
items.zh: 孩子們在餐廳表現得滿糟的。

items.en: We finished the job fairly easily.
items.zh: 我們還算輕鬆地完成了工作。

items.en: Our new manager speaks pretty quickly in meetings.
items.zh: 我們的新經理開會時講話滿快的。

examples.heading: ② almost、nearly + always、never

items.en: My dad almost always falls asleep in front of the TV.
items.zh: 我爸幾乎都會在電視前睡著。

items.en: It nearly always rains on my birthday.
items.zh: 我生日那天幾乎都會下雨。

items.en: We almost never go out on weeknights.
items.zh: 我們平日晚上幾乎從不出門。

items.en: The trains are nearly always on time here.
items.zh: 這裡的火車幾乎都準時。

items.en: My cat almost never comes when I call her.
items.zh: 我叫我的貓，她幾乎從來不過來。

items.en: I nearly always forget my umbrella.
items.zh: 我幾乎每次都忘了帶傘。

examples.heading: ③ just + too、so

items.en: This coffee is just too sweet for me.
items.zh: 這杯咖啡對我來說真的太甜了。

items.en: The kids played just so nicely together today.
items.zh: 孩子們今天一起玩得真的好乖。

items.en: You worry just too much about little things.
items.zh: 你真的太在意小事了。

items.en: The hotel was just too far from the beach.
items.zh: 那間旅館離海灘真的太遠了。

examples.heading: ④ just + 時間副詞

items.en: We moved into this flat just yesterday, so it's still a mess.
items.zh: 我們昨天才剛搬進這間公寓，所以還很亂。

items.en: Your mum called just now.
items.zh: 你媽剛剛打電話來。

items.en: The new library opened just last week.
items.zh: 新的圖書館上禮拜才剛開。

items.en: I finished the book just this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上才剛把書看完。

examples.heading: ⑤ much、far + too + 副詞

items.en: The music is far too loud. Can you turn it down?
items.zh: 音樂實在太大聲了，你可以轉小聲嗎？

items.en: He spends much too long on his phone.
items.zh: 他花在手機上的時間實在太長了。

items.en: We arrived far too early for the party.
items.zh: 我們到派對的時間實在太早了。

items.en: You eat much too quickly. Slow down.
items.zh: 你吃得實在太快了，慢一點。

items.en: The bus goes far too slowly in the city centre.
items.zh: 公車在市中心開得實在太慢了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句

items.en: Does it nearly always snow here in January?
items.zh: 這裡一月幾乎都會下雪嗎？

items.en: Do you almost always walk to school?
items.zh: 你幾乎都走路上學嗎？

items.en: Isn't this soup just too salty?
items.zh: 這碗湯不會真的太鹹了嗎？

items.en: Isn't the TV much too loud?
items.zh: 電視不會太大聲了嗎？

items.en: Did your son do fairly well in his exams?
items.zh: 你兒子考試考得還算好嗎？

title: The value of this game will drop extremely rapidly.
translation: 這款遊戲的價值會跌得非常快。
name: 副詞修飾副詞（較多種副詞）
sentences: The new phone sold extremely well in its first week.
The orchestra played exceptionally beautifully last night.
Prices in the area have risen extremely sharply.
She handled the difficult customer exceptionally calmly.
The disease spreads extremely easily in crowded places.
The new software can be installed relatively easily.
The team recovered comparatively quickly after the defeat.
Most of the students did relatively well in the exam.
Small companies can change direction comparatively easily.
The patient is breathing relatively normally now.
He left the company in May and died shortly afterwards.
We arrived at the hotel shortly after midnight.
The couple got engaged in June and married soon afterwards.
The fire started shortly before six o'clock.
She found a new job soon after she moved to Leeds.
The old cinema closed long ago.
I'd finished my homework long before my sister got home.
People talked about the match long after it ended.
The village was abandoned long ago.
Please let us know well in advance if you can't come.
We got to the airport well before our flight.
The tickets sold out well before the concert.
You need to apply for a visa well in advance.
I'll come straight back after I drop off the kids.
Keep going straight ahead until you see the church.
The manager answered my complaint right away.
The dog ran straight back to its owner.
My best friend now lives far away in Australia.
Our team finished far ahead of the others.
The youngest runner fell far behind after the first lap.

examples.heading: ① extremely、exceptionally + 情狀副詞

items.en: The new phone sold extremely well in its first week.
items.zh: 那支新手機第一週賣得非常好。

items.en: The orchestra played exceptionally beautifully last night.
items.zh: 樂團昨晚演奏得格外動聽。

items.en: Prices in the area have risen extremely sharply.
items.zh: 那一區的價格漲得非常兇。

items.en: She handled the difficult customer exceptionally calmly.
items.zh: 她格外冷靜地應付那位難搞的客人。

items.en: The disease spreads extremely easily in crowded places.
items.zh: 這種病在擁擠的地方非常容易傳染。

examples.heading: ② relatively、comparatively + 情狀副詞

items.en: The new software can be installed relatively easily.
items.zh: 新軟體裝起來還算容易。

items.en: The team recovered comparatively quickly after the defeat.
items.zh: 比起其他隊，這支隊伍輸球後恢復得算快。

items.en: Most of the students did relatively well in the exam.
items.zh: 大部分學生考得還算好。

items.en: Small companies can change direction comparatively easily.
items.zh: 小公司轉換方向比較容易。

items.en: The patient is breathing relatively normally now.
items.zh: 病人現在呼吸還算正常。

examples.heading: ③ shortly、soon + afterwards、after

items.en: He left the company in May and died shortly afterwards.
items.zh: 他五月離開公司，不久後就過世了。

items.en: We arrived at the hotel shortly after midnight.
items.zh: 我們半夜過後不久到了旅館。

items.en: The couple got engaged in June and married soon afterwards.
items.zh: 那對情侶六月訂婚，不久之後就結婚了。

items.en: The fire started shortly before six o'clock.
items.zh: 火是在六點前不久燒起來的。

items.en: She found a new job soon after she moved to Leeds.
items.zh: 她搬到里茲後不久就找到了新工作。

examples.heading: ④ long + ago、before、after

items.en: The old cinema closed long ago.
items.zh: 那間老電影院很久以前就關了。

items.en: I'd finished my homework long before my sister got home.
items.zh: 我姊姊回家前很久，我就寫完作業了。

items.en: People talked about the match long after it ended.
items.zh: 比賽結束後很久，大家還在談論它。

items.en: The village was abandoned long ago.
items.zh: 那個村子很久以前就沒人住了。

examples.heading: ⑤ well + in advance、before

items.en: Please let us know well in advance if you can't come.
items.zh: 如果你不能來，請提早通知我們。

items.en: We got to the airport well before our flight.
items.zh: 我們在班機起飛前很久就到機場了。

items.en: The tickets sold out well before the concert.
items.zh: 音樂會前很久票就賣光了。

items.en: You need to apply for a visa well in advance.
items.zh: 你要提早很久申請簽證。

examples.heading: ⑥ straight、right + home、back、ahead、away

items.en: I'll come straight back after I drop off the kids.
items.zh: 我送完孩子就直接回來。

items.en: Keep going straight ahead until you see the church.
items.zh: 一直往前走，直到看到教堂。

items.en: The manager answered my complaint right away.
items.zh: 經理馬上就回覆了我的投訴。

items.en: The dog ran straight back to its owner.
items.zh: 那隻狗直接跑回主人身邊。

examples.heading: ⑦ far + away、ahead、behind

items.en: My best friend now lives far away in Australia.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友現在住在遙遠的澳洲。

items.en: Our team finished far ahead of the others.
items.zh: 我們隊遠遠領先其他隊伍完成。

items.en: The youngest runner fell far behind after the first lap.
items.zh: 最年輕的跑者第一圈後就遠遠落後了。

title: You have to repair your car much more often than your bicycle.
translation: 汽車要修的次數比腳踏車多得多。
name: 副詞的比較級
sentences: My brother runs faster than anyone in his class.
The bus arrived later than usual this morning.
You speak English more fluently than you think.
She works harder than all her colleagues.
I got up earlier than my parents today.
Electric cars run more quietly than petrol cars.
You can get to work much more quickly by train.
My grandmother walks a lot more slowly since her operation.
Prices are rising far more rapidly than wages.
Our new boss explains things much more clearly.
The second team played far better in the final.
The team trained even harder after losing the match.
The storm hit the coast even more violently than expected.
He apologised, which made her cry even more.
My new laptop starts up even faster than my old one.
The new dishwasher runs a little more quietly than the old one.
The plane landed slightly earlier than planned.
Try to hold the brush a bit more gently.
Sales grew slightly more steadily in the second half of the year.
My son reads much better since he got his glasses.
The company did worse this year than last year.
We walked further than we planned and got lost.
You should drink more and eat less in hot weather.
Our team played much worse in the second half.
I watch TV less often than I used to.
People drive less carefully when they're tired.
My son eats far less healthily at university.
The project took much longer than we expected.
House prices rose even more sharply than economists had predicted.
She can swim faster now than she could last summer.
We can search for information far more easily than before.

examples.heading: ① 比較級副詞 + than

items.en: My brother runs faster than anyone in his class.
items.zh: 我弟弟跑得比他班上任何人都快。

items.en: The bus arrived later than usual this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上公車比平常晚到。

items.en: You speak English more fluently than you think.
items.zh: 你英文說得比你以為的流利。

items.en: She works harder than all her colleagues.
items.zh: 她比所有同事都認真工作。

items.en: I got up earlier than my parents today.
items.zh: 我今天比我爸媽早起。

items.en: Electric cars run more quietly than petrol cars.
items.zh: 電動車開起來比汽油車安靜。

examples.heading: ② much、far、a lot + 比較級副詞

items.en: You can get to work much more quickly by train.
items.zh: 搭火車上班快得多。

items.en: My grandmother walks a lot more slowly since her operation.
items.zh: 我奶奶開刀以後走路慢多了。

items.en: Prices are rising far more rapidly than wages.
items.zh: 物價上漲的速度比薪水快得多。

items.en: Our new boss explains things much more clearly.
items.zh: 我們的新老闆講解事情清楚多了。

items.en: The second team played far better in the final.
items.zh: 第二隊在決賽打得好多了。

examples.heading: ③ even + 比較級副詞

items.en: The team trained even harder after losing the match.
items.zh: 球隊輸了比賽以後練得更拚了。

items.en: The storm hit the coast even more violently than expected.
items.zh: 暴風雨襲擊海岸的強度比預期的還要猛。

items.en: He apologised, which made her cry even more.
items.zh: 他道了歉，結果她哭得更厲害了。

items.en: My new laptop starts up even faster than my old one.
items.zh: 我的新筆電開機比舊的還要快。

examples.heading: ④ slightly、a bit、a little + 比較級副詞

items.en: The new dishwasher runs a little more quietly than the old one.
items.zh: 新的洗碗機運轉起來比舊的安靜一點。

items.en: The plane landed slightly earlier than planned.
items.zh: 飛機比預定的時間稍早降落。

items.en: Try to hold the brush a bit more gently.
items.zh: 試著把刷子拿得再輕一點。

items.en: Sales grew slightly more steadily in the second half of the year.
items.zh: 下半年的銷售成長得比較穩定一點。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不規則的比較級副詞

items.en: My son reads much better since he got his glasses.
items.zh: 我兒子配了眼鏡以後，閱讀好多了。

items.en: The company did worse this year than last year.
items.zh: 公司今年的表現比去年差。

items.en: We walked further than we planned and got lost.
items.zh: 我們走得比計畫的遠，結果迷路了。

items.en: You should drink more and eat less in hot weather.
items.zh: 天氣熱的時候應該多喝水、少吃東西。

items.en: Our team played much worse in the second half.
items.zh: 我們隊下半場打得差多了。

examples.heading: ⑥ less + 副詞

items.en: I watch TV less often than I used to.
items.zh: 我看電視的次數沒有以前多。

items.en: People drive less carefully when they're tired.
items.zh: 人累的時候開車會比較不小心。

items.en: My son eats far less healthily at university.
items.zh: 我兒子上大學以後吃得不健康多了。

examples.heading: ⑦ than + 子句或時間副詞

items.en: The project took much longer than we expected.
items.zh: 這個專案花的時間比我們預期的長得多。

items.en: House prices rose even more sharply than economists had predicted.
items.zh: 房價漲得比經濟學家預測的還要兇。

items.en: She can swim faster now than she could last summer.
items.zh: 她現在游得比去年夏天快。

items.en: We can search for information far more easily than before.
items.zh: 我們找資料比以前容易多了。

title: I really like Japanese music.
translation: 我真的很喜歡日本音樂。
name: 程度副詞和時間副詞修飾動詞
sentences: I really love the smell of fresh bread.
We really enjoyed the trip.
My daughter really wants to learn the piano.
They really need some help.
Do you really believe his story about the lost wallet?
Our teacher really likes our class project.
Thanks, I really appreciate your help.
My kids love their grandmother very much.
My parents enjoyed their holiday in Greece very much.
My grandmother loved her garden very much.
He doesn't like his new job very much.
I miss my old friends very much.
My dad always reads the newspaper at breakfast.
We always visit my grandparents at Christmas.
She always wears a hat in the sun.
Do you always take the same bus to work?
I sometimes play tennis with my brother.
We sometimes have pizza on Friday nights.
My neighbour sometimes leaves his car in front of my house.
Sometimes we eat dinner in the garden.
My mum never drinks coffee.
He never forgets my birthday.
We never watch TV in the morning.
They never answer the phone.
I never take sugar in my tea.
The children are always hungry after school.
I'm sometimes tired in the afternoon.
You can always ask me.
I don't really know my new neighbours yet.
We've never been to Japan.
My little brother doesn't really eat vegetables.

examples.heading: ① really + 一般動詞

items.en: I really love the smell of fresh bread.
items.zh: 我真的很愛剛出爐麵包的味道。

items.en: We really enjoyed the trip.
items.zh: 我們真的很享受這趟旅行。

items.en: My daughter really wants to learn the piano.
items.zh: 我女兒真的很想學鋼琴。

items.en: They really need some help.
items.zh: 他們真的需要幫忙。

items.en: Do you really believe his story about the lost wallet?
items.zh: 你真的相信他說掉了錢包的事嗎？

items.en: Our teacher really likes our class project.
items.zh: 我們老師真的很喜歡我們班的專題。

items.en: Thanks, I really appreciate your help.
items.zh: 謝謝，我真的很感激你的幫忙。

examples.heading: ② 受詞 + very much

items.en: My kids love their grandmother very much.
items.zh: 我的孩子很愛他們的奶奶。

items.en: My parents enjoyed their holiday in Greece very much.
items.zh: 我爸媽很喜歡他們在希臘的假期。

items.en: My grandmother loved her garden very much.
items.zh: 我奶奶很愛她的花園。

items.en: He doesn't like his new job very much.
items.zh: 他不太喜歡他的新工作。

items.en: I miss my old friends very much.
items.zh: 我很想念我的老朋友。

examples.heading: ③ always + 一般動詞

items.en: My dad always reads the newspaper at breakfast.
items.zh: 我爸爸總是在吃早餐的時候看報紙。

items.en: We always visit my grandparents at Christmas.
items.zh: 我們聖誕節都會去看我祖父母。

items.en: She always wears a hat in the sun.
items.zh: 她在太陽底下都會戴帽子。

items.en: Do you always take the same bus to work?
items.zh: 你上班都搭同一班公車嗎？

examples.heading: ④ sometimes + 一般動詞

items.en: I sometimes play tennis with my brother.
items.zh: 我有時候會跟我哥哥打網球。

items.en: We sometimes have pizza on Friday nights.
items.zh: 我們星期五晚上有時候會吃披薩。

items.en: My neighbour sometimes leaves his car in front of my house.
items.zh: 我的鄰居有時候會把車停在我家門口。

items.en: Sometimes we eat dinner in the garden.
items.zh: 我們有時候在院子裡吃晚餐。

examples.heading: ⑤ never + 一般動詞

items.en: My mum never drinks coffee.
items.zh: 我媽媽從不喝咖啡。

items.en: He never forgets my birthday.
items.zh: 他從來不會忘記我的生日。

items.en: We never watch TV in the morning.
items.zh: 我們早上從來不看電視。

items.en: They never answer the phone.
items.zh: 他們從來不接電話。

items.en: I never take sugar in my tea.
items.zh: 我喝茶從來不加糖。

examples.heading: ⑥ be 或助動詞 + 副詞

items.en: The children are always hungry after school.
items.zh: 孩子們放學後總是很餓。

items.en: I'm sometimes tired in the afternoon.
items.zh: 我下午有時候會很累。

items.en: You can always ask me.
items.zh: 你隨時都可以問我。

items.en: I don't really know my new neighbours yet.
items.zh: 我跟新鄰居還不太熟。

items.en: We've never been to Japan.
items.zh: 我們從來沒去過日本。

items.en: My little brother doesn't really eat vegetables.
items.zh: 我弟弟不太吃蔬菜。

title: I have a really good friend.
translation: 我有一個很要好的朋友。
name: 程度副詞放在形容詞前（少數副詞）
sentences: The bedrooms in our new flat are very small.
The children were very tired after the long walk home.
Thank you for the flowers, that's very kind of you.
The roads are very icy this morning, so drive slowly.
Our neighbours on the third floor are very quiet.
The noodles at that little shop are really cheap.
I skipped lunch, so I'm really hungry now.
My sister's new boyfriend is really funny.
Your little boy is really tall for his age.
The view from the top of the hill is really beautiful.
My uncle drives a very old red truck.
We had a very long meeting on Monday afternoon.
Dr Lee is a very patient dentist.
They booked a very nice room near the beach.
Taipei is a very crowded place at New Year.
I had a really strange dream about my old school.
Mum bought me a really warm coat for the winter.
My grandmother keeps a really big dog in her garden.
Thanks for a really lovely evening.
Lisa is a really clever student.
They sell very cheap shoes at the Sunday market.
We had really sunny weather on our trip to Rome.
My parents grow very sweet tomatoes.
Those shops only sell really expensive watches.
My dad drinks very strong black coffee every morning.
The bus station isn't very far from my house.
Is the lake very deep in the middle?
I'm not really sure about the answer to question five.
Were the questions in the test very hard?
The coffee in the office kitchen isn't very good.
Is your teacher really strict about homework?

examples.heading: ① be + very + 形容詞

items.en: The bedrooms in our new flat are very small.
items.zh: 我們新公寓的臥室很小。

items.en: The children were very tired after the long walk home.
items.zh: 孩子們走了一大段路回家，累壞了。

items.en: Thank you for the flowers, that's very kind of you.
items.zh: 謝謝你送的花，你人真好。

items.en: The roads are very icy this morning, so drive slowly.
items.zh: 今天早上路面很滑，開慢一點。

items.en: Our neighbours on the third floor are very quiet.
items.zh: 我們三樓的鄰居很安靜。

examples.heading: ② be + really + 形容詞

items.en: The noodles at that little shop are really cheap.
items.zh: 那家小店的麵很便宜。

items.en: I skipped lunch, so I'm really hungry now.
items.zh: 我沒吃午餐，現在好餓。

items.en: My sister's new boyfriend is really funny.
items.zh: 我姊姊的新男朋友很好笑。

items.en: Your little boy is really tall for his age.
items.zh: 以他的年紀來說，你兒子長得很高。

items.en: The view from the top of the hill is really beautiful.
items.zh: 從山頂看出去的風景真的很美。

examples.heading: ③ a + very + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: My uncle drives a very old red truck.
items.zh: 我叔叔開一台很舊的紅色卡車。

items.en: We had a very long meeting on Monday afternoon.
items.zh: 我們星期一下午開了一個很長的會。

items.en: Dr Lee is a very patient dentist.
items.zh: 李醫師是一位很有耐心的牙醫。

items.en: They booked a very nice room near the beach.
items.zh: 他們訂了一間在海灘附近、很不錯的房間。

items.en: Taipei is a very crowded place at New Year.
items.zh: 台北過年的時候人很多。

examples.heading: ④ a + really + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: I had a really strange dream about my old school.
items.zh: 我做了一個很奇怪的夢，夢到我以前的學校。

items.en: Mum bought me a really warm coat for the winter.
items.zh: 媽媽買了一件很保暖的外套給我過冬。

items.en: My grandmother keeps a really big dog in her garden.
items.zh: 我奶奶在院子裡養了一隻很大的狗。

items.en: Thanks for a really lovely evening.
items.zh: 謝謝你讓我們度過一個很愉快的晚上。

items.en: Lisa is a really clever student.
items.zh: Lisa 是個很聰明的學生。

examples.heading: ⑤ very / really + 形容詞 + 複數名詞或不可數名詞

items.en: They sell very cheap shoes at the Sunday market.
items.zh: 星期天的市集賣的鞋子很便宜。

items.en: We had really sunny weather on our trip to Rome.
items.zh: 我們去羅馬玩的時候天氣很晴朗。

items.en: My parents grow very sweet tomatoes.
items.zh: 我爸媽種的番茄很甜。

items.en: Those shops only sell really expensive watches.
items.zh: 那些店只賣很貴的手錶。

items.en: My dad drinks very strong black coffee every morning.
items.zh: 我爸每天早上都喝很濃的黑咖啡。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句和疑問句

items.en: The bus station isn't very far from my house.
items.zh: 公車站離我家不太遠。

items.en: Is the lake very deep in the middle?
items.zh: 湖的中間很深嗎？

items.en: I'm not really sure about the answer to question five.
items.zh: 第五題的答案我不太確定。

items.en: Were the questions in the test very hard?
items.zh: 考試的題目很難嗎？

items.en: The coffee in the office kitchen isn't very good.
items.zh: 辦公室茶水間的咖啡不太好喝。

items.en: Is your teacher really strict about homework?
items.zh: 你的老師對作業真的很嚴格嗎？

title: I'm so glad you're coming.
translation: 你要來，我真的好高興。
name: 程度副詞放在形容詞前（較多種副詞）

The baby is so cute when she laughs.

My feet are so cold after walking in the snow.
You're so kind to help me with my bags.
The film was so boring that I left early.
The soup was so hot that I burnt my tongue.
She was so nervous she couldn't eat breakfast.
The music next door was so loud that we couldn't sleep.
The swimming pool near my office is quite big.
The exam was quite difficult, but I think I passed.
It's quite warm today, so you don't need a coat.
My son's cooking is quite good for a ten-year-old.
We had quite a nice holiday in spite of the weather.
It's quite an old house, so it needs a lot of work.
Can you open the window? The classroom is too hot.
That restaurant is too expensive for students.
The bed in the hotel was too soft.
Turn the TV down. It's too loud!
You're too late. The shop has just closed.
My little sister is too short to reach the light switch.
I was too tired to finish my homework last night.
The river is too dangerous to swim in.
It's too early to call Grandma.
I'm a bit tired. Can we stop for a coffee?
The jeans are a little long, but I like them.
It's a bit cold in here. Can I close the window?
The first lesson was a little confusing.
Dad was a bit angry when I came home late.
The hotel room wasn't too small, and it was clean.
Is the water too cold for swimming?
My grandmother's village isn't so far from here by train.
Are you a bit hungry? I can make you a sandwich.

examples.heading: ① so + 形容詞

items.en: I love your garden in spring. The roses are so beautiful!
items.zh: 我好喜歡你家春天的花園，玫瑰好漂亮！

items.en: The baby is so cute when she laughs.
items.zh: 那個小寶寶笑起來好可愛。

items.en: I'm so sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible.
items.zh: 真的很抱歉我遲到了，路上塞得好嚴重。

items.en: My feet are so cold after walking in the snow.
items.zh: 在雪地裡走完路，我的腳好冰。

items.en: You're so kind to help me with my bags.
items.zh: 你人真好，幫我提包包。

examples.heading: ② so + 形容詞 + that 子句

items.en: The film was so boring that I left early.
items.zh: 那部電影無聊到我提早離場。

items.en: The soup was so hot that I burnt my tongue.
items.zh: 湯燙到我舌頭都燙傷了。

items.en: She was so nervous she couldn't eat breakfast.
items.zh: 她緊張到吃不下早餐。

items.en: The music next door was so loud that we couldn't sleep.
items.zh: 隔壁的音樂吵到我們睡不著。

examples.heading: ③ quite + 形容詞

items.en: The swimming pool near my office is quite big.
items.zh: 我辦公室附近的游泳池滿大的。

items.en: The exam was quite difficult, but I think I passed.
items.zh: 考試滿難的，不過我想我有過。

items.en: It's quite warm today, so you don't need a coat.
items.zh: 今天滿暖的，你不用穿外套。

items.en: My son's cooking is quite good for a ten-year-old.
items.zh: 以十歲的孩子來說，我兒子的廚藝滿好的。

items.en: We had quite a nice holiday in spite of the weather.
items.zh: 雖然天氣不好，我們的假期還算不錯。

items.en: It's quite an old house, so it needs a lot of work.
items.zh: 那是一間滿舊的房子，所以要修的地方很多。

examples.heading: ④ too + 形容詞

items.en: Can you open the window? The classroom is too hot.
items.zh: 你可以開窗嗎？教室太熱了。

items.en: That restaurant is too expensive for students.
items.zh: 那家餐廳對學生來說太貴了。

items.en: The bed in the hotel was too soft.
items.zh: 飯店的床太軟了。

items.en: Turn the TV down. It's too loud!
items.zh: 把電視轉小聲，太吵了！

items.en: You're too late. The shop has just closed.
items.zh: 你太晚了，店剛關門。

examples.heading: ⑤ too + 形容詞 + to + 動詞原形

items.en: My little sister is too short to reach the light switch.
items.zh: 我妹妹太矮了，搆不到電燈開關。

items.en: I was too tired to finish my homework last night.
items.zh: 我昨晚太累了，作業寫不完。

items.en: The river is too dangerous to swim in.
items.zh: 那條河太危險了，不能下去游泳。

items.en: It's too early to call Grandma.
items.zh: 現在打給奶奶太早了。

examples.heading: ⑥ a bit、a little + 形容詞

items.en: I'm a bit tired. Can we stop for a coffee?
items.zh: 我有點累，我們可以停下來喝杯咖啡嗎？

items.en: The jeans are a little long, but I like them.
items.zh: 這條牛仔褲有點長，不過我很喜歡。

items.en: It's a bit cold in here. Can I close the window?
items.zh: 這裡有點冷，我可以把窗戶關起來嗎？

items.en: The first lesson was a little confusing.
items.zh: 第一堂課有點讓人搞不清楚。

items.en: Dad was a bit angry when I came home late.
items.zh: 我晚回家，爸爸有點生氣。

examples.heading: ⑦ 否定句和疑問句

items.en: The hotel room wasn't too small, and it was clean.
items.zh: 飯店房間沒有太小，而且很乾淨。

items.en: Is the water too cold for swimming?
items.zh: 水太冷不能游泳嗎？

items.en: My grandmother's village isn't so far from here by train.
items.zh: 搭火車的話，我奶奶住的村子離這裡沒有那麼遠。

items.en: Are you a bit hungry? I can make you a sandwich.
items.zh: 你有點餓嗎？我可以幫你做個三明治。

title: I miss you a lot.
translation: 我很想你。
name: 程度副詞放在句尾
sentences: It rains a lot in Scotland.
My little brother talks a lot at dinner.
I travelled a lot when I was younger.
My cousins and I argued a lot when we were children.
My parents help me a lot with my homework.
Thank you very much for looking after our cat in August.
She likes her new teacher very much.
I enjoyed your party a lot.
The whole class respected Mr Hill very much.
My daughter loves her swimming lessons so much!
Thanks so much for driving me to the airport.
The kids missed their dad so much while he was away.
My knee hurt so much that I couldn't walk.
I ate too much at lunch, and now I feel sick.
Our neighbour's dog barks too much at night.
My son plays computer games too much.
Don't think about it too much.
Can you move your chair a bit? I can't see.
Let's rest a little before we walk up the hill.
I think you should cut your fringe a bit before the photo.
I only know her a little.
Could you turn the radio down a bit, please?
My grandmother doesn't like cats at all.
It didn't snow at all last winter.
I can't hear you at all. Can you speak up?
We weren't tired at all after the walk.
He hasn't changed at all since school.
Do you speak any Italian at all?
Has the new medicine helped your back at all?
Is there any milk left at all?
Can you help me at all this weekend?

examples.heading: ① 動詞 + a lot

items.en: It rains a lot in Scotland.
items.zh: 蘇格蘭常下雨。

items.en: My little brother talks a lot at dinner.
items.zh: 我弟弟吃晚餐時話很多。

items.en: I travelled a lot when I was younger.
items.zh: 我年輕的時候常常旅行。

items.en: My cousins and I argued a lot when we were children.
items.zh: 我和表兄弟姊妹小時候常吵架。

examples.heading: ② 動詞 + 受詞 + a lot、very much

items.en: My parents help me a lot with my homework.
items.zh: 我爸媽幫我做功課幫很多。

items.en: Thank you very much for looking after our cat in August.
items.zh: 非常謝謝你八月幫我們照顧貓。

items.en: She likes her new teacher very much.
items.zh: 她很喜歡她的新老師。

items.en: I enjoyed your party a lot.
items.zh: 我在你的派對上玩得很開心。

items.en: The whole class respected Mr Hill very much.
items.zh: 全班都很敬重 Hill 老師。

examples.heading: ③ so much

items.en: My daughter loves her swimming lessons so much!
items.zh: 我女兒好愛她的游泳課！

items.en: Thanks so much for driving me to the airport.
items.zh: 非常感謝你開車送我去機場。

items.en: The kids missed their dad so much while he was away.
items.zh: 爸爸不在的時候，孩子們好想他。

items.en: My knee hurt so much that I couldn't walk.
items.zh: 我的膝蓋痛到不能走路。

examples.heading: ④ too much

items.en: I ate too much at lunch, and now I feel sick.
items.zh: 我午餐吃太多了，現在覺得不舒服。

items.en: Our neighbour's dog barks too much at night.
items.zh: 鄰居的狗晚上叫得太兇了。

items.en: My son plays computer games too much.
items.zh: 我兒子打電動打太多了。

items.en: Don't think about it too much.
items.zh: 別想太多。

examples.heading: ⑤ a bit、a little

items.en: Can you move your chair a bit? I can't see.
items.zh: 你可以把椅子挪一點嗎？我看不到。

items.en: Let's rest a little before we walk up the hill.
items.zh: 我們爬山坡之前先休息一下吧。

items.en: I think you should cut your fringe a bit before the photo.
items.zh: 我覺得你拍照前應該把瀏海剪短一點。

items.en: I only know her a little.
items.zh: 我跟她只是有一點認識。

items.en: Could you turn the radio down a bit, please?
items.zh: 可以請你把收音機轉小聲一點嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句 + at all

items.en: My grandmother doesn't like cats at all.
items.zh: 我奶奶一點都不喜歡貓。

items.en: It didn't snow at all last winter.
items.zh: 去年冬天完全沒下雪。

items.en: I can't hear you at all. Can you speak up?
items.zh: 我完全聽不到你，你可以大聲一點嗎？

items.en: We weren't tired at all after the walk.
items.zh: 走完路以後我們一點也不累。

items.en: He hasn't changed at all since school.
items.zh: 他從畢業以後一點都沒變。

examples.heading: ⑦ 疑問句 + at all

items.en: Do you speak any Italian at all?
items.zh: 你到底會不會說一點義大利文？

items.en: Has the new medicine helped your back at all?
items.zh: 新的藥到底對你的背有沒有幫助？

items.en: Is there any milk left at all?
items.zh: 到底還有沒有牛奶？

items.en: Can you help me at all this weekend?
items.zh: 你這個週末有辦法幫我一下嗎？

title: I'm so happy because you can come!
translation: 你可以來，我真的好開心！
name: 程度副詞修飾形容詞
sentences: The chicken at that market is really good.
My new boss is really nice.
The roads were really icy this morning.
You look really tired. Go to bed.
We had a really good time at the wedding.
That's a really interesting idea.
It was an extremely long journey.
My brother is a pretty good swimmer.
The new phones are extremely expensive.
The teacher was extremely patient with us.
It's extremely important to drink enough water.
The path up the hill is extremely narrow.
I'm so sorry I'm late.
Your little girl is so clever.
Why is the house so cold?
We were so excited about the trip.
The bus driver was pretty friendly to the tourists.
I'm pretty sure he's at home.
Her French is pretty good.
The match was pretty boring.
I'm a bit hungry. Let's eat.
This coat is a bit small for me.
The film was a bit long.
He seemed a bit sad on the phone.
I feel a little sick.
The instructions are a little confusing.
My grandmother is a little deaf.
The water was a little cold, but we swam anyway.
The towels in the bathroom weren't really clean.
Are you a bit nervous about the exam?
Were the tickets extremely expensive?
Is the museum really far from here?

examples.heading: ① really + 形容詞

items.en: The chicken at that market is really good.
items.zh: 那個市場的雞肉真的很好吃。

items.en: My new boss is really nice.
items.zh: 我的新老闆人真的很好。

items.en: The roads were really icy this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上路面結冰結得很厲害。

items.en: You look really tired. Go to bed.
items.zh: 你看起來真的很累。去睡覺吧。

examples.heading: ② a + really / extremely / pretty + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: We had a really good time at the wedding.
items.zh: 我們在婚禮上玩得很開心。

items.en: That's a really interesting idea.
items.zh: 那是個很有意思的想法。

items.en: It was an extremely long journey.
items.zh: 那是一趟非常漫長的旅程。

items.en: My brother is a pretty good swimmer.
items.zh: 我哥哥游泳游得滿好的。

examples.heading: ③ extremely + 形容詞

items.en: The new phones are extremely expensive.
items.zh: 新的手機貴得要命。

items.en: The teacher was extremely patient with us.
items.zh: 老師對我們非常有耐心。

items.en: It's extremely important to drink enough water.
items.zh: 喝足夠的水非常重要。

items.en: The path up the hill is extremely narrow.
items.zh: 上山的小路非常窄。

examples.heading: ④ so + 形容詞

items.en: I'm so sorry I'm late.
items.zh: 真的很抱歉我遲到了。

items.en: Your little girl is so clever.
items.zh: 你的小女兒好聰明。

items.en: Why is the house so cold?
items.zh: 房子怎麼這麼冷？

items.en: We were so excited about the trip.
items.zh: 我們對這趟旅行好興奮。

examples.heading: ⑤ pretty + 形容詞

items.en: The bus driver was pretty friendly to the tourists.
items.zh: 公車司機對觀光客還滿友善的。

items.en: I'm pretty sure he's at home.
items.zh: 我滿確定他在家。

items.en: Her French is pretty good.
items.zh: 她的法文滿好的。

items.en: The match was pretty boring.
items.zh: 那場比賽滿無聊的。

examples.heading: ⑥ a bit + 形容詞

items.en: I'm a bit hungry. Let's eat.
items.zh: 我有點餓。我們吃飯吧。

items.en: This coat is a bit small for me.
items.zh: 這件外套我穿有點小。

items.en: The film was a bit long.
items.zh: 那部電影有點長。

items.en: He seemed a bit sad on the phone.
items.zh: 他在電話裡聽起來有點難過。

examples.heading: ⑦ a little + 形容詞

items.en: I feel a little sick.
items.zh: 我覺得有點不舒服。

items.en: The instructions are a little confusing.
items.zh: 說明有點難懂。

items.en: My grandmother is a little deaf.
items.zh: 我奶奶耳朵有點背。

items.en: The water was a little cold, but we swam anyway.
items.zh: 水有點冷，可是我們還是下去游了。

examples.heading: ⑧ 否定句和疑問句

items.en: The towels in the bathroom weren't really clean.
items.zh: 浴室裡的毛巾不太乾淨。

items.en: Are you a bit nervous about the exam?
items.zh: 你對考試有點緊張嗎？

items.en: Were the tickets extremely expensive?
items.zh: 票是不是貴得要命？

items.en: Is the museum really far from here?
items.zh: 博物館離這裡真的很遠嗎？

title: We left really early on a Friday morning.
translation: 我們在一個星期五的早上很早就出發了。
name: 程度副詞修飾副詞
sentences: My niece reads very well for her age.
The nurse spoke very softly.
He finished the race very slowly.
You did that very nicely.

She types really fast.
We waited really patiently.
I got home really late on Friday.
The team played extremely badly.
The prices went up extremely quickly.
He listened extremely carefully to the instructions.
My sister sings extremely well.
Thank you for coming so quickly.
The old lift goes up so slowly.
The children were playing so happily.
You speak English so well!
The teacher talks too fast.
Don't eat too quickly.
We arrived too late for the first bus.
He works too hard.
Our football team did quite well this season.
The queue moved quite slowly at the post office.
He runs pretty fast for a big guy.
I usually get up pretty early.
The bus came a bit early today.
The meeting started a little late because of the rain.
She walks a bit slowly after the operation.
You're driving a little fast.
I don't swim very well.

examples.heading: ① very + 副詞

items.en: My niece reads very well for her age.
items.zh: 以她的年紀來說，我姪女書讀得很好。

items.en: The nurse spoke very softly.
items.zh: 護士說話很輕聲。

items.en: He finished the race very slowly.
items.zh: 他很慢才跑完比賽。

items.en: You did that very nicely.
items.zh: 你做得很好。

examples.heading: ② really + 副詞

items.en: The kids behaved really well at the party.
items.zh: 孩子們在派對上很乖。

items.en: She types really fast.
items.zh: 她打字打得很快。

items.en: We waited really patiently.
items.zh: 我們很有耐心地等。

items.en: I got home really late on Friday.
items.zh: 我星期五很晚才回家。

examples.heading: ③ extremely + 副詞

items.en: The team played extremely badly.
items.zh: 那支球隊打得爛透了。

items.en: The prices went up extremely quickly.
items.zh: 價格漲得非常快。

items.en: He listened extremely carefully to the instructions.
items.zh: 他非常仔細地聽指示。

items.en: My sister sings extremely well.
items.zh: 我姊姊唱歌唱得非常好。

examples.heading: ④ so + 副詞

items.en: Thank you for coming so quickly.
items.zh: 謝謝你這麼快就趕來。

items.en: The old lift goes up so slowly.
items.zh: 那台舊電梯上升得好慢。

items.en: The children were playing so happily.
items.zh: 孩子們玩得好開心。

items.en: You speak English so well!
items.zh: 你英文說得好好！

examples.heading: ⑤ too + 副詞

items.en: The teacher talks too fast.
items.zh: 老師講得太快了。

items.en: Don't eat too quickly.
items.zh: 別吃得太快。

items.en: We arrived too late for the first bus.
items.zh: 我們到得太晚，趕不上第一班公車。

items.en: He works too hard.
items.zh: 他工作太拚了。

examples.heading: ⑥ quite、pretty + 副詞

items.en: Our football team did quite well this season.
items.zh: 我們的足球隊這一季表現得還不錯。

items.en: The queue moved quite slowly at the post office.
items.zh: 郵局的隊伍前進得滿慢的。

items.en: He runs pretty fast for a big guy.
items.zh: 以他的塊頭來說，他跑得滿快的。

items.en: I usually get up pretty early.
items.zh: 我通常起得滿早的。

examples.heading: ⑦ a bit、a little + 副詞

items.en: The bus came a bit early today.
items.zh: 公車今天早到了一點。

items.en: The meeting started a little late because of the rain.
items.zh: 因為下雨，會議晚了一點才開始。

items.en: She walks a bit slowly after the operation.
items.zh: 她手術後走路有點慢。

items.en: You're driving a little fast.
items.zh: 你開得有點快。

examples.heading: ⑧ 否定句和疑問句

items.en: I don't swim very well.
items.zh: 我不太會游泳。

items.en: Did they play really badly?
items.zh: 他們打得真的很爛嗎？

items.en: He didn't answer very politely.
items.zh: 他回答得不太有禮貌。

items.en: Do you get up really early on weekdays?
items.zh: 你平日都起得很早嗎？

title: The mobile market is growing incredibly fast in Britain.
translation: 英國的手機市場成長得快得驚人。
name: 程度副詞修飾各類副詞
sentences: The new staff learned the system remarkably quickly.
Your daughter plays the violin incredibly well.
That shrewd old farmer bargains extraordinarily hard.
The meeting went surprisingly smoothly.
Rents have risen incredibly sharply this year.
Our fund-raising day went reasonably well.
He speaks Japanese fairly fluently.
The software runs relatively smoothly on older laptops.
I thought you handled the complaint reasonably calmly.
We played fairly badly in the first half.
Moreover, I use those negotiation techniques quite frequently.
We eat out fairly often these days.
My uncle visits us relatively rarely.
Our neighbours complain about the dog remarkably seldom.
The trains here break down surprisingly often.
She arrived unusually early this morning.
We'll know the results fairly soon.
That bakery opened relatively recently.
The builders finished the job remarkably early.
I only found out about it quite recently.
The snow had nearly completely melted by noon.
My grandfather is virtually always in the garden.
She almost never offends anyone.
I agree with you almost entirely.
We've almost always paid the rent on time.
He has virtually never missed a match.
She didn't explain the rules clearly enough.
Are we leaving early enough to catch the train?
He ran fast enough to win a medal.
Our stingy landlord never fixes anything quickly enough.
Could you speak slowly enough for the children to follow?

examples.heading: ① incredibly、remarkably、extraordinarily、surprisingly + 情狀副詞

items.en: The new staff learned the system remarkably quickly.
items.zh: 新來的員工學這套系統學得出奇地快。

items.en: Your daughter plays the violin incredibly well.
items.zh: 你女兒小提琴拉得好得不得了。

items.en: That shrewd old farmer bargains extraordinarily hard.
items.zh: 那個精明的老農夫殺價殺得非常兇。

items.en: The meeting went surprisingly smoothly.
items.zh: 會議進行得出乎意料地順利。

items.en: Rents have risen incredibly sharply this year.
items.zh: 今年房租漲得非常兇。

examples.heading: ② reasonably、fairly、relatively + 情狀副詞

items.en: Our fund-raising day went reasonably well.
items.zh: 我們的募款日辦得還算順利。

items.en: He speaks Japanese fairly fluently.
items.zh: 他日文說得相當流利。

items.en: The software runs relatively smoothly on older laptops.
items.zh: 這個軟體在舊筆電上跑得還算順。

items.en: I thought you handled the complaint reasonably calmly.
items.zh: 我覺得你處理那件客訴還算冷靜。

items.en: We played fairly badly in the first half.
items.zh: 我們上半場打得滿差的。

examples.heading: ③ 程度副詞 + 頻率副詞

items.en: Moreover, I use those negotiation techniques quite frequently.
items.zh: 而且，那些談判技巧我還滿常用的。

items.en: We eat out fairly often these days.
items.zh: 我們最近滿常外食的。

items.en: My uncle visits us relatively rarely.
items.zh: 我叔叔比較少來看我們。

items.en: Our neighbours complain about the dog remarkably seldom.
items.zh: 鄰居抱怨我們家狗的次數少得出奇。

items.en: The trains here break down surprisingly often.
items.zh: 這裡的火車故障得出奇頻繁。

examples.heading: ④ 程度副詞 + 時間副詞

items.en: She arrived unusually early this morning.
items.zh: 她今天早上比平常早到。

items.en: We'll know the results fairly soon.
items.zh: 我們很快就會知道結果了。

items.en: That bakery opened relatively recently.
items.zh: 那家麵包店是最近才開的。

items.en: The builders finished the job remarkably early.
items.zh: 工人們提早很多就把工程做完了。

items.en: I only found out about it quite recently.
items.zh: 我也是最近才知道這件事的。

examples.heading: ⑤ almost、nearly、virtually + 表示全部的副詞

items.en: The snow had nearly completely melted by noon.
items.zh: 到了中午，雪幾乎全融了。

items.en: My grandfather is virtually always in the garden.
items.zh: 我爺爺幾乎都待在花園裡。

items.en: She almost never offends anyone.
items.zh: 她幾乎從不得罪人。

items.en: I agree with you almost entirely.
items.zh: 我幾乎完全同意你的看法。

items.en: We've almost always paid the rent on time.
items.zh: 我們幾乎每次都準時付房租。

items.en: He has virtually never missed a match.
items.zh: 他幾乎一場比賽都沒錯過。

examples.heading: ⑥ 副詞 + enough

items.en: She didn't explain the rules clearly enough.
items.zh: 她規則解釋得不夠清楚。

items.en: Are we leaving early enough to catch the train?
items.zh: 我們這時候出門，趕得上火車嗎？

items.en: He ran fast enough to win a medal.
items.zh: 他跑得夠快，拿到了獎牌。

items.en: Our stingy landlord never fixes anything quickly enough.
items.zh: 我們那個小氣的房東修東西從來都不夠快。

items.en: Could you speak slowly enough for the children to follow?
items.zh: 你可以說得慢一點，讓孩子們跟得上嗎？

title: It will be a bit more expensive than the bus, but it's safer and quicker.
translation: 這會比搭公車貴一點，不過比較安全，也比較快。
name: 程度副詞修飾比較級
sentences: The bus is a bit slower, but it's cheaper.
The second photo is a little clearer than the first.
Profits were slightly higher than last year.
I'd prefer a slightly smaller table.
The second interview was a little less stressful.
Our new neighbours seem a bit more tolerant of noise.
The hotel was much nicer than the photos suggested.
The city centre is far busier at weekends.
This route is a lot shorter.
She's much less shy than she used to be.
Living in the countryside is far cheaper than living in London.
You'll feel a lot more relaxed after a holiday.
The new model is considerably lighter than the old one.
Prices in the north are significantly lower.
The second edition is considerably longer than the first.
Patients who exercise recover significantly faster.
The film was good, but the book is even better.
It was cold yesterday, and today it's even colder.
Clearing the garage turned out to be an even bigger chore than cleaning the kitchen.
If you add salt, the soup will taste even worse.
Can you walk a bit faster? We're late.
He drives much more carefully since the accident.
The children behaved a lot better at their grandmother's.
This printer works slightly more quietly than the old one.
My mother cooks far better than I do.
Please answer a little more slowly so I can write it down.
I feel so much better after that sleep.
The house looks so much bigger without all that furniture.
Travelling by train is so much more comfortable.
Life got so much easier once we moved closer to work.

examples.heading: ① slightly、a bit、a little + 比較級

items.en: The bus is a bit slower, but it's cheaper.
items.zh: 公車慢一點，可是比較便宜。

items.en: The second photo is a little clearer than the first.
items.zh: 第二張照片比第一張清楚一點。

items.en: Profits were slightly higher than last year.
items.zh: 利潤比去年高了一點。

items.en: I'd prefer a slightly smaller table.
items.zh: 我比較想要一張小一點的桌子。

items.en: The second interview was a little less stressful.
items.zh: 第二次面試的壓力小了一點。

items.en: Our new neighbours seem a bit more tolerant of noise.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居對噪音好像比較能容忍一點。

examples.heading: ② much、far、a lot + 比較級

items.en: The hotel was much nicer than the photos suggested.
items.zh: 那間飯店比照片上看起來好得多。

items.en: The city centre is far busier at weekends.
items.zh: 市中心週末的時候熱鬧得多。

items.en: This route is a lot shorter.
items.zh: 走這條路近很多。

items.en: She's much less shy than she used to be.
items.zh: 她現在遠不像以前那麼害羞了。

items.en: Living in the countryside is far cheaper than living in London.
items.zh: 住鄉下比住倫敦便宜得多。

items.en: You'll feel a lot more relaxed after a holiday.
items.zh: 放個假之後你會輕鬆很多。

examples.heading: ③ considerably、significantly + 比較級

items.en: The new model is considerably lighter than the old one.
items.zh: 新款比舊款輕了不少。

items.en: Prices in the north are significantly lower.
items.zh: 北部的物價低了很多。

items.en: The second edition is considerably longer than the first.
items.zh: 第二版比第一版長了不少。

items.en: Patients who exercise recover significantly faster.
items.zh: 有運動的病人復原得快很多。

examples.heading: ④ even + 比較級

items.en: The film was good, but the book is even better.
items.zh: 電影不錯，可是書更好看。

items.en: It was cold yesterday, and today it's even colder.
items.zh: 昨天很冷，今天更冷。

items.en: Clearing the garage turned out to be an even bigger chore than cleaning the kitchen.
items.zh: 清車庫結果比打掃廚房還要累人。

items.en: If you add salt, the soup will taste even worse.
items.zh: 你再加鹽，湯會更難喝。

examples.heading: ⑤ 程度副詞 + 比較級副詞

items.en: Can you walk a bit faster? We're late.
items.zh: 你可以走快一點嗎？我們遲到了。

items.en: He drives much more carefully since the accident.
items.zh: 出了那次車禍以後，他開車小心多了。

items.en: The children behaved a lot better at their grandmother's.
items.zh: 孩子們在奶奶家乖多了。

items.en: This printer works slightly more quietly than the old one.
items.zh: 這台印表機運作的聲音比舊的那台小一點。

items.en: My mother cooks far better than I do.
items.zh: 我媽煮菜比我好得多。

items.en: Please answer a little more slowly so I can write it down.
items.zh: 請你回答得慢一點，我好記下來。

examples.heading: ⑥ so much + 比較級

items.en: I feel so much better after that sleep.
items.zh: 睡了那一覺，我覺得好多了。

items.en: The house looks so much bigger without all that furniture.
items.zh: 沒有那些家具，房子看起來大好多。

items.en: Travelling by train is so much more comfortable.
items.zh: 搭火車舒服太多了。

items.en: Life got so much easier once we moved closer to work.
items.zh: 我們搬到離公司近一點的地方以後，日子輕鬆多了。

title: There are probably very few of us who have never been to a zoo.
translation: 我們之中大概很少人沒去過動物園。
name: 程度副詞修飾限定詞
sentences: Very few students came to the talk.
We've got very little bread left.
Very few shops open on Christmas Day.
My dad shows very little interest in football.
There are too many cars in the city centre.
You put too much sugar in my tea.
I've never seen so many people in one place.
I've got so much homework this weekend.
We spent so much money on the holiday.
He asks too many questions.
Almost all my friends live in London.
Nearly every room in the hotel has a sea view.
She goes swimming almost every day.
Nearly all the tickets have been sold.
Almost every child in the street has a bike.
The shop is open nearly all the time.
Quite a few people complained about the food.
We've had quite a lot of rain this month.
She's read quite a few of his books.
There were quite a lot of mistakes in the report.
Very few of my classmates have a car.
Almost all of the guests had left by midnight.
Too many of the questions were about history.
Very little of the money went to charity.
Nearly all of us agreed with the plan.
So many of my friends have moved away.
Why are there so few buses on Sundays?
Did almost all the students pass?
There isn't very much milk in the fridge.
We don't have too many options.
Does nearly every flat have a balcony?
Not very many people know about this beach.

examples.heading: ① very + few、little

items.en: Very few students came to the talk.
items.zh: 來聽演講的學生很少。

items.en: We've got very little bread left.
items.zh: 我們的麵包剩很少了。

items.en: Very few shops open on Christmas Day.
items.zh: 聖誕節那天開門的店很少。

items.en: My dad shows very little interest in football.
items.zh: 我爸對足球沒什麼興趣。

examples.heading: ② too、so + many、much

items.en: There are too many cars in the city centre.
items.zh: 市中心的車太多了。

items.en: You put too much sugar in my tea.
items.zh: 你在我茶裡加太多糖了。

items.en: I've never seen so many people in one place.
items.zh: 我從來沒看過一個地方有那麼多人。

items.en: I've got so much homework this weekend.
items.zh: 這個週末我有好多功課。

items.en: We spent so much money on the holiday.
items.zh: 我們度假花了好多錢。

items.en: He asks too many questions.
items.zh: 他問太多問題了。

examples.heading: ③ almost、nearly + all、every

items.en: Almost all my friends live in London.
items.zh: 我的朋友幾乎都住在倫敦。

items.en: Nearly every room in the hotel has a sea view.
items.zh: 飯店裡幾乎每間房都看得到海。

items.en: She goes swimming almost every day.
items.zh: 她幾乎每天都去游泳。

items.en: Nearly all the tickets have been sold.
items.zh: 票幾乎都賣完了。

items.en: Almost every child in the street has a bike.
items.zh: 這條街上幾乎每個小孩都有腳踏車。

items.en: The shop is open nearly all the time.
items.zh: 那家店幾乎一直都開著。

examples.heading: ④ quite + a few、a lot of

items.en: Quite a few people complained about the food.
items.zh: 有不少人抱怨那些菜。

items.en: We've had quite a lot of rain this month.
items.zh: 這個月下了不少雨。

items.en: She's read quite a few of his books.
items.zh: 他的書她讀過不少。

items.en: There were quite a lot of mistakes in the report.
items.zh: 報告裡有不少錯。

examples.heading: ⑤ 程度副詞 + 限定詞 + of

items.en: Very few of my classmates have a car.
items.zh: 我的同學很少有人有車。

items.en: Almost all of the guests had left by midnight.
items.zh: 到了半夜，客人幾乎都走了。

items.en: Too many of the questions were about history.
items.zh: 太多題目都跟歷史有關。

items.en: Very little of the money went to charity.
items.zh: 那筆錢很少捐給慈善機構。

items.en: Nearly all of us agreed with the plan.
items.zh: 我們幾乎每個人都同意這個計畫。

items.en: So many of my friends have moved away.
items.zh: 我好多朋友都搬走了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Why are there so few buses on Sundays?
items.zh: 星期天的公車為什麼那麼少？

items.en: Did almost all the students pass?
items.zh: 學生幾乎都考過了嗎？

items.en: There isn't very much milk in the fridge.
items.zh: 冰箱裡的牛奶不多了。

items.en: We don't have too many options.
items.zh: 我們的選擇不多。

items.en: Does nearly every flat have a balcony?
items.zh: 幾乎每一間公寓都有陽台嗎？

items.en: Not very many people know about this beach.
items.zh: 知道這片海灘的人不多。

title: It would be quite a formal meeting.
translation: 那會是一場相當正式的會議。
name: 程度副詞修飾名詞片語
sentences: That was quite a difficult exam.
My aunt runs quite a successful bakery.
We had quite a long wait at the airport.
It's quite a big house for two people.
Winning the prize was quite a surprise.
Your little boy is quite a character.
Moving abroad was quite a challenge for us.
There was quite a crowd outside the shop.
It was rather a strange question.
The plumber left rather a big mess in the kitchen.
We had rather a cold summer this year.
That's rather an expensive restaurant.
She gave a rather short speech.
It was a rather boring party.
My uncle drives a rather old car.
The bride wore a rather simple dress.
I waited almost an hour for the bus.
The baby is nearly a year old now.
My grandad was almost a professional footballer.
We've been friends for nearly a decade.
He drank almost a whole bottle of wine.
The flight was nearly an hour late.
Our dog is almost a member of the family.
The repairs cost nearly a month's salary.
Isn't it rather a long way to walk?
Wasn't that quite a risk?
Has it been almost a year since we last met?
Isn't that rather a high price for a used bike?
Was it quite a big wedding?
Did the job take almost a week?
Wasn't it quite a shock to see him again?
Isn't your son almost a teenager now?

examples.heading: ① quite + a + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: That was quite a difficult exam.
items.zh: 那次考試相當難。

items.en: My aunt runs quite a successful bakery.
items.zh: 我阿姨開了一家相當成功的麵包店。

items.en: We had quite a long wait at the airport.
items.zh: 我們在機場等了滿久。

items.en: It's quite a big house for two people.
items.zh: 兩個人住，那間房子算滿大的。

examples.heading: ② quite + a + 名詞

items.en: Winning the prize was quite a surprise.
items.zh: 得獎真是一大驚喜。

items.en: Your little boy is quite a character.
items.zh: 你家小男孩真是個有個性的孩子。

items.en: Moving abroad was quite a challenge for us.
items.zh: 搬到國外對我們來說是不小的挑戰。

items.en: There was quite a crowd outside the shop.
items.zh: 那家店外面圍了一大群人。

examples.heading: ③ rather + a + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: It was rather a strange question.
items.zh: 那是個滿奇怪的問題。

items.en: The plumber left rather a big mess in the kitchen.
items.zh: 水電工在廚房留下一大堆髒亂。

items.en: We had rather a cold summer this year.
items.zh: 今年夏天滿冷的。

items.en: That's rather an expensive restaurant.
items.zh: 那家餐廳滿貴的。

examples.heading: ④ a + rather + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: She gave a rather short speech.
items.zh: 她的致詞滿短的。

items.en: It was a rather boring party.
items.zh: 那個派對滿無聊的。

items.en: My uncle drives a rather old car.
items.zh: 我叔叔開一輛滿舊的車。

items.en: The bride wore a rather simple dress.
items.zh: 新娘穿了一件滿簡單的禮服。

examples.heading: ⑤ almost、nearly + 名詞片語

items.en: I waited almost an hour for the bus.
items.zh: 我等公車等了快一個小時。

items.en: The baby is nearly a year old now.
items.zh: 寶寶現在快一歲了。

items.en: My grandad was almost a professional footballer.
items.zh: 我爺爺差一點就成了職業足球員。

items.en: We've been friends for nearly a decade.
items.zh: 我們當朋友快十年了。

items.en: He drank almost a whole bottle of wine.
items.zh: 他差不多喝了一整瓶紅酒。

items.en: The flight was nearly an hour late.
items.zh: 班機晚了快一個小時。

items.en: Our dog is almost a member of the family.
items.zh: 我們的狗差不多就是家裡的一份子。

items.en: The repairs cost nearly a month's salary.
items.zh: 修理費差不多是一個月的薪水。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句

items.en: Isn't it rather a long way to walk?
items.zh: 走路去不會滿遠的嗎？

items.en: Wasn't that quite a risk?
items.zh: 那樣不是滿冒險的嗎？

items.en: Has it been almost a year since we last met?
items.zh: 我們上次見面已經快一年了嗎？

items.en: Isn't that rather a high price for a used bike?
items.zh: 一台二手腳踏車賣這個價錢不會太高嗎？

items.en: Was it quite a big wedding?
items.zh: 婚禮辦得滿盛大的嗎？

items.en: Did the job take almost a week?
items.zh: 那份工作花了快一個星期嗎？

items.en: Wasn't it quite a shock to see him again?
items.zh: 再見到他不是滿震驚的嗎？

items.en: Isn't your son almost a teenager now?
items.zh: 你兒子不是快十三歲了嗎？

title: You can eat very well and pay almost nothing.
translation: 你可以吃得很好，又幾乎不用花錢。
name: 程度副詞修飾代名詞
sentences: Almost everyone in my class has a phone.
There was almost nothing in the fridge.
Almost nobody uses that old printer.
She remembers almost everything about her childhood.
Nearly everybody voted for the new plan.
The storm destroyed nearly everything in the garden.
Nearly everyone at the wedding was in tears.
He knows nearly everybody in the village.
That old sofa cost practically nothing.
Practically everyone was late because of the snow.
My little cousin believes practically anything you tell him.
Practically nobody came to the meeting.
You can ask me absolutely anything.
The thieves took absolutely everything.
Absolutely nobody believed his story.
There's absolutely nothing to do in this town.
She'd do absolutely anything for her kids.
Absolutely everyone needs a good night's sleep.
There's hardly anybody on the beach today.
We had hardly anything to eat on the trip.
Hardly anyone reads the local paper now.
He said hardly anything at dinner.
Almost everybody in the office takes the train.
My little brother is scared of almost everything.
The new manager changed nearly everything.
I found absolutely nothing wrong with the car.
Almost anything can happen in a final.
We charge almost nothing for delivery.
Did almost everyone pass the test?
Is there absolutely nothing we can do?
Was nearly everything sold by noon?
Can you really eat practically anything?

examples.heading: ① almost + 不定代名詞

items.en: Almost everyone in my class has a phone.
items.zh: 我們班上幾乎每個人都有手機。

items.en: There was almost nothing in the fridge.
items.zh: 冰箱裡幾乎什麼都沒有。

items.en: Almost nobody uses that old printer.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有人用那台舊印表機。

items.en: She remembers almost everything about her childhood.
items.zh: 她小時候的事她幾乎都記得。

examples.heading: ② nearly + 不定代名詞

items.en: Nearly everybody voted for the new plan.
items.zh: 幾乎每個人都投票支持新方案。

items.en: The storm destroyed nearly everything in the garden.
items.zh: 暴風雨把花園裡的東西幾乎都毀了。

items.en: Nearly everyone at the wedding was in tears.
items.zh: 婚禮上幾乎每個人都哭了。

items.en: He knows nearly everybody in the village.
items.zh: 村子裡的人他幾乎都認識。

examples.heading: ③ practically + 不定代名詞

items.en: That old sofa cost practically nothing.
items.zh: 那張舊沙發幾乎沒花錢。

items.en: Practically everyone was late because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，幾乎每個人都遲到了。

items.en: My little cousin believes practically anything you tell him.
items.zh: 你跟我小表弟說什麼，他幾乎都相信。

items.en: Practically nobody came to the meeting.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有人來開會。

examples.heading: ④ absolutely + 不定代名詞

items.en: You can ask me absolutely anything.
items.zh: 你什麼都可以問我。

items.en: The thieves took absolutely everything.
items.zh: 小偷把東西全都拿走了。

items.en: Absolutely nobody believed his story.
items.zh: 完全沒有人相信他的說法。

items.en: There's absolutely nothing to do in this town.
items.zh: 這個小鎮完全沒什麼事可做。

items.en: She'd do absolutely anything for her kids.
items.zh: 為了孩子，她什麼事都願意做。

items.en: Absolutely everyone needs a good night's sleep.
items.zh: 每個人都需要好好睡一覺。

examples.heading: ⑤ hardly + 不定代名詞

items.en: There's hardly anybody on the beach today.
items.zh: 今天海灘上幾乎沒人。

items.en: We had hardly anything to eat on the trip.
items.zh: 我們旅途中幾乎沒東西吃。

items.en: Hardly anyone reads the local paper now.
items.zh: 現在幾乎沒有人看地方報紙了。

items.en: He said hardly anything at dinner.
items.zh: 他吃晚飯的時候幾乎沒說話。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的不定代名詞

items.en: Almost everybody in the office takes the train.
items.zh: 辦公室裡幾乎每個人都搭火車上班。

items.en: My little brother is scared of almost everything.
items.zh: 我弟弟幾乎什麼都怕。

items.en: The new manager changed nearly everything.
items.zh: 新經理幾乎什麼都改了。

items.en: I found absolutely nothing wrong with the car.
items.zh: 我完全沒發現車子有什麼問題。

items.en: Almost anything can happen in a final.
items.zh: 決賽什麼事都可能發生。

items.en: We charge almost nothing for delivery.
items.zh: 我們的運費幾乎不收錢。

examples.heading: ⑦ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Did almost everyone pass the test?
items.zh: 幾乎每個人都考過了嗎？

items.en: Is there absolutely nothing we can do?
items.zh: 我們真的完全沒辦法了嗎？

items.en: Was nearly everything sold by noon?
items.zh: 中午以前東西幾乎都賣完了嗎？

items.en: Can you really eat practically anything?
items.zh: 你真的幾乎什麼都能吃嗎？

title: My house is opposite the train station, so you can find it easily.
translation: 我家就在火車站對面，所以你很容易就能找到。
name: 情狀副詞放在句尾
