My dad snores loudly every night.
The old train moves slowly through the mountains.
Everyone worked hard before the exams.
Speak quietly, please. Grandma is resting.
Please put the glasses down gently on the shelf.
Our guide answered all our questions patiently.
My grandmother makes soup really well.
He opened the present slowly.
Hold the cup carefully. It's very hot.
We finished the project quickly.
You can find the hotel easily from the station.
I can't read your writing clearly.
You should check your answers carefully.
Could you explain the homework slowly, please?
The children played happily in the park all afternoon.
He drove carefully through the town.
We waited patiently at the bus stop for an hour.
She swam well in the race yesterday.
My cousin did really well at school last year.
The doctor spoke very kindly to my son.
You did that exercise really quickly.
Our team played quite badly on Saturday.
My sister dances so beautifully.
The old man walked very slowly up the hill.
This pizza smells delicious.
You sound tired. Are you OK?
The milk tastes a bit strange. Is it old?
The new sofa looks comfortable.
Did the new waiter treat you politely at dinner?
He doesn't drive very carefully.
Can you write your name clearly at the top, please?

examples.heading: ① 動詞 + 情狀副詞

items.en: Please walk slowly. My feet hurt.
items.zh: 請走慢一點，我的腳好痛。

items.en: My dad snores loudly every night.
items.zh: 我爸每天晚上打鼾都很大聲。

items.en: The old train moves slowly through the mountains.
items.zh: 那列老火車慢慢地穿過山區。

items.en: Everyone worked hard before the exams.
items.zh: 考試前大家都很用功。

items.en: Speak quietly, please. Grandma is resting.
items.zh: 說話小聲一點，奶奶在休息。

examples.heading: ② 動詞 + 受詞 + 情狀副詞

items.en: Please put the glasses down gently on the shelf.
items.zh: 請把杯子輕輕放在架子上。

items.en: Our guide answered all our questions patiently.
items.zh: 我們的導遊很有耐心地回答了我們所有的問題。

items.en: My grandmother makes soup really well.
items.zh: 我奶奶湯煮得很好。

items.en: He opened the present slowly.
items.zh: 他慢慢地打開禮物。

items.en: Hold the cup carefully. It's very hot.
items.zh: 小心拿杯子，很燙。

items.en: We finished the project quickly.
items.zh: 我們很快就做完了那個專題。

examples.heading: ③ 助動詞 + 動詞 + 受詞 + 情狀副詞

items.en: You can find the hotel easily from the station.
items.zh: 你從車站很容易就能找到那間旅館。

items.en: I can't read your writing clearly.
items.zh: 我看不清楚你寫的字。

items.en: You should check your answers carefully.
items.zh: 你應該仔細檢查你的答案。

items.en: Could you explain the homework slowly, please?
items.zh: 可以請你慢慢講解作業嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 情狀副詞 + 地點 + 時間

items.en: The children played happily in the park all afternoon.
items.zh: 孩子們整個下午在公園玩得很開心。

items.en: He drove carefully through the town.
items.zh: 他小心地開車穿過市區。

items.en: We waited patiently at the bus stop for an hour.
items.zh: 我們在公車站耐心地等了一個小時。

items.en: She swam well in the race yesterday.
items.zh: 她昨天比賽游得很好。

items.en: My cousin did really well at school last year.
items.zh: 我表弟去年在學校表現很好。

examples.heading: ⑤ 程度副詞 + 情狀副詞

items.en: The doctor spoke very kindly to my son.
items.zh: 醫生對我兒子說話很溫柔。

items.en: You did that exercise really quickly.
items.zh: 你那個練習做得真快。

items.en: Our team played quite badly on Saturday.
items.zh: 我們隊星期六打得滿差的。

items.en: My sister dances so beautifully.
items.zh: 我姊姊跳舞跳得好美。

items.en: The old man walked very slowly up the hill.
items.zh: 那位老先生很慢地走上山坡。

examples.heading: ⑥ 連綴動詞 + 形容詞

items.en: This pizza smells delicious.
items.zh: 這個披薩聞起來好香。

items.en: You sound tired. Are you OK?
items.zh: 你聽起來很累，你還好嗎？

items.en: The milk tastes a bit strange. Is it old?
items.zh: 牛奶喝起來怪怪的，是放太久了嗎？

items.en: The new sofa looks comfortable.
items.zh: 新沙發看起來很舒服。

examples.heading: ⑦ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Did the new waiter treat you politely at dinner?
items.zh: 晚餐時那個新來的服務生對你們有禮貌嗎？

items.en: He doesn't drive very carefully.
items.zh: 他開車不太小心。

items.en: Can you write your name clearly at the top, please?
items.zh: 可以請你在最上面把名字寫清楚嗎？

title: She sometimes goes to the cinema.
translation: 她有時候會去看電影。
name: 頻率副詞放在主詞和動詞之間
sentences: My father always walks the dog before work.
We usually have dinner at seven o'clock.
Ken often plays football with his cousins on Sundays.
I sometimes forget my umbrella on the train.
My little sister never eats vegetables.
Our teacher usually gives us homework on Fridays.
My grandmother never uses her mobile phone.
Jack sometimes stays up very late.
The trains are often late in winter.
My boss is never angry with us.
The swimming pool is usually empty in the morning.
I'm sometimes late for my piano lesson.
Mr Brown is always polite to his customers.
You can always borrow my bike on weekdays.
I will never forget my first day at school.
She has often visited her aunt in Canada.
My brother can sometimes be very lazy.
We have always lived in this town.
After school, I usually do my homework and play computer games.
On Saturdays my mum often goes shopping and cooks a big lunch.
My friends and I sometimes go to the park and ride our bikes.
Do your children always go to bed early?
Does Anna often come to your house?
Are you usually at home on Monday evenings?
Do you often drink tea in the afternoon?
My husband doesn't usually work at weekends.
I don't often watch the news on TV.
Teenagers don't always listen to their parents.
The bus doesn't usually stop here.
Sometimes we walk to the beach after dinner.
Sometimes my dad picks me up from school.
Sometimes the corner shop closes early on Sundays.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + 頻率副詞 + 動詞

items.en: My father always walks the dog before work.
items.zh: 我爸爸上班前都會去遛狗。

items.en: We usually have dinner at seven o'clock.
items.zh: 我們通常七點吃晚餐。

items.en: Ken often plays football with his cousins on Sundays.
items.zh: Ken 星期天常常和他的表兄弟踢足球。

items.en: I sometimes forget my umbrella on the train.
items.zh: 我有時候會把雨傘忘在火車上。

items.en: My little sister never eats vegetables.
items.zh: 我妹妹從來不吃青菜。

items.en: Our teacher usually gives us homework on Fridays.
items.zh: 我們老師通常星期五會出作業。

items.en: My grandmother never uses her mobile phone.
items.zh: 我奶奶從來不用手機。

items.en: Jack sometimes stays up very late.
items.zh: Jack 有時候很晚才睡。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + 頻率副詞

items.en: The trains are often late in winter.
items.zh: 冬天火車常常誤點。

items.en: My boss is never angry with us.
items.zh: 我老闆從來不對我們生氣。

items.en: The swimming pool is usually empty in the morning.
items.zh: 游泳池早上通常沒什麼人。

items.en: I'm sometimes late for my piano lesson.
items.zh: 我上鋼琴課有時候會遲到。

items.en: Mr Brown is always polite to his customers.
items.zh: Brown 先生對客人總是很有禮貌。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 助動詞 + 頻率副詞 + 動詞

items.en: You can always borrow my bike on weekdays.
items.zh: 平日你隨時都可以借我的腳踏車。

items.en: I will never forget my first day at school.
items.zh: 我永遠不會忘記第一天上學的情景。

items.en: She has often visited her aunt in Canada.
items.zh: 她常常去加拿大看她阿姨。

items.en: My brother can sometimes be very lazy.
items.zh: 我哥哥有時候很懶。

items.en: We have always lived in this town.
items.zh: 我們一直都住在這個小鎮。

examples.heading: ④ 一個頻率副詞修飾幾個動詞

items.en: After school, I usually do my homework and play computer games.
items.zh: 放學以後，我通常寫作業、玩電腦遊戲。

items.en: On Saturdays my mum often goes shopping and cooks a big lunch.
items.zh: 星期六我媽常常去買東西，再煮一頓豐盛的午餐。

items.en: My friends and I sometimes go to the park and ride our bikes.
items.zh: 我和朋友有時候會去公園騎腳踏車。

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問句

items.en: Do your children always go to bed early?
items.zh: 你的孩子都很早睡嗎？

items.en: Does Anna often come to your house?
items.zh: Anna 常常來你家嗎？

items.en: Are you usually at home on Monday evenings?
items.zh: 你星期一晚上通常在家嗎？

items.en: Do you often drink tea in the afternoon?
items.zh: 你下午常喝茶嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句

items.en: My husband doesn't usually work at weekends.
items.zh: 我先生週末通常不上班。

items.en: I don't often watch the news on TV.
items.zh: 我不常看電視新聞。

items.en: Teenagers don't always listen to their parents.
items.zh: 青少年不一定都聽父母的話。

items.en: The bus doesn't usually stop here.
items.zh: 公車通常不停這一站。

examples.heading: ⑦ sometimes 放在句首

items.en: Sometimes we walk to the beach after dinner.
items.zh: 我們有時候吃完晚餐會走路去海邊。

items.en: Sometimes my dad picks me up from school.
items.zh: 我爸爸有時候會來學校接我。

items.en: Sometimes the corner shop closes early on Sundays.
items.zh: 轉角那家店星期天有時候會提早關門。

title: Sometimes I go to the beach.
translation: 有時候我會去海邊。
name: 副詞放在句首（少數副詞）
sentences: Sometimes my brother helps me with my maths homework.
Sometimes our teacher plays songs in class.
Sometimes the bus doesn't come at all.
I like singing, but sometimes I'm too shy.
Sometimes, the lift in our building stops working.
Sometimes it rains for a whole week here.
Maybe Dad can drive us to the station.
Maybe she's still at the office.
Maybe your phone is in your other bag.
Maybe, I'll see you at the party.
Maybe the shop opens at ten.
Maybe they don't know the way to our new house.
Today I'm wearing my new shoes.
Yesterday we went to my grandma's house.
Tomorrow my cousin is coming to stay with us.
Today, the museum is free for children.
Yesterday I lost my favourite pen.
Tomorrow there's a test in English class.
Now I live in a small flat near the river.
Now you can take the cake out of the oven.
Now it's your turn to choose a game.
Now, please sit down and listen.
Now my sister works in a bank.
I have a shower. Then I make breakfast.
We visited the castle. Then we had lunch in a café.
Open the box. Then take out the instructions.
She finished her homework. Then she called her friend.
Turn left at the bank. Then walk straight on for two minutes.
Today the café isn't open because of the holiday.
Now I don't need my glasses for reading.
Yesterday the children didn't go to school because of the snow.

examples.heading: ① sometimes 放在句首

items.en: Sometimes my brother helps me with my maths homework.
items.zh: 有時候我哥哥會教我數學作業。

items.en: Sometimes our teacher plays songs in class.
items.zh: 有時候我們老師會在課堂上放歌。

items.en: Sometimes the bus doesn't come at all.
items.zh: 有時候公車根本不來。

items.en: I like singing, but sometimes I'm too shy.
items.zh: 我喜歡唱歌，可是有時候我太害羞了。

items.en: Sometimes, the lift in our building stops working.
items.zh: 有時候我們大樓的電梯會故障。

items.en: Sometimes it rains for a whole week here.
items.zh: 這裡有時候會連下一整個禮拜的雨。

examples.heading: ② maybe 放在句首

items.en: Maybe Dad can drive us to the station.
items.zh: 也許爸爸可以載我們去車站。

items.en: Maybe she's still at the office.
items.zh: 她說不定還在辦公室。

items.en: Maybe your phone is in your other bag.
items.zh: 你的手機說不定在你另一個包包裡。

items.en: Maybe, I'll see you at the party.
items.zh: 也許我會在派對上見到你。

items.en: Maybe the shop opens at ten.
items.zh: 那家店說不定十點才開。

items.en: Maybe they don't know the way to our new house.
items.zh: 也許他們不知道怎麼去我們的新家。

examples.heading: ③ today、yesterday、tomorrow 放在句首

items.en: Today I'm wearing my new shoes.
items.zh: 今天我穿了新鞋子。

items.en: Yesterday we went to my grandma's house.
items.zh: 昨天我們去了我奶奶家。

items.en: Tomorrow my cousin is coming to stay with us.
items.zh: 明天我表姊要來我們家住。

items.en: Today, the museum is free for children.
items.zh: 今天博物館兒童免費。

items.en: Yesterday I lost my favourite pen.
items.zh: 昨天我把我最喜歡的筆弄丟了。

items.en: Tomorrow there's a test in English class.
items.zh: 明天英文課有考試。

examples.heading: ④ now 放在句首

items.en: Now I live in a small flat near the river.
items.zh: 現在我住在河邊的一間小公寓。

items.en: Now you can take the cake out of the oven.
items.zh: 現在你可以把蛋糕從烤箱拿出來了。

items.en: Now it's your turn to choose a game.
items.zh: 現在輪到你選遊戲了。

items.en: Now, please sit down and listen.
items.zh: 現在請坐下來聽好。

items.en: Now my sister works in a bank.
items.zh: 我姊姊現在在銀行上班。

examples.heading: ⑤ then 放在句首

items.en: I have a shower. Then I make breakfast.
items.zh: 我先洗澡，然後做早餐。

items.en: We visited the castle. Then we had lunch in a café.
items.zh: 我們參觀了城堡，然後去咖啡店吃午餐。

items.en: Open the box. Then take out the instructions.
items.zh: 把盒子打開，然後把說明書拿出來。

items.en: She finished her homework. Then she called her friend.
items.zh: 她寫完作業，接著打電話給朋友。

items.en: Turn left at the bank. Then walk straight on for two minutes.
items.zh: 在銀行那裡左轉，然後直走兩分鐘。

examples.heading: ⑥ 句首的副詞後面接否定句

items.en: Today the café isn't open because of the holiday.
items.zh: 今天放假，咖啡店沒開。

items.en: Now I don't need my glasses for reading.
items.zh: 現在我看書不用戴眼鏡了。

items.en: Yesterday the children didn't go to school because of the snow.
items.zh: 昨天孩子們因為下雪沒去上學。

title: Perhaps I left it in your living room.
translation: 也許我把它忘在你家客廳了。
name: 副詞放在句首（較多種副詞）
sentences: Perhaps the bakery on the corner sells birthday cakes.
Perhaps we should take a taxi. It's getting late.
Perhaps you can ask your teacher for help.
Perhaps the train is late because of the snow.
Perhaps, your sister would like to come with us to the lake.
The flat is very small. However, it's close to the city centre.
I wanted to go to the concert. However, all the tickets were sold.
My brother is good at maths. However, he hates science.
The food at the hotel was great. However, the rooms were dirty.
We planned to have a picnic. However, it rained all day.
Suddenly someone knocked on the door.
We were watching TV. Suddenly the screen went black.
Suddenly I remembered my keys were in the car.
I was walking home. Suddenly it started to rain very hard.
Suddenly, a cat jumped onto the table.
I missed the bus. Luckily, my friend gave me a lift.
Luckily, the weather was perfect for the wedding.
I dropped my phone. Luckily it didn't break.
Luckily, there was a chemist's near the hotel.
Luckily, my mum found my passport in the kitchen.
Usually I walk to work, but today I drove.
Often we eat dinner in front of the TV.
Usually, the library is quiet in the mornings.
Often my grandad tells us stories about the war.
Usually the post arrives before lunch.
Perhaps they don't know about the party.
Luckily, we didn't miss the start of the film.
The car is old. However, it doesn't use much petrol.
Usually my cat doesn't go outside at night.
Suddenly I couldn't remember the name of my own street.
Often I don't have time for breakfast.

examples.heading: ① perhaps

items.en: Perhaps the bakery on the corner sells birthday cakes.
items.zh: 轉角那家麵包店也許有賣生日蛋糕。

items.en: Perhaps we should take a taxi. It's getting late.
items.zh: 也許我們該搭計程車，時間不早了。

items.en: Perhaps you can ask your teacher for help.
items.zh: 也許你可以請老師幫忙。

items.en: Perhaps the train is late because of the snow.
items.zh: 火車也許是因為下雪才誤點。

items.en: Perhaps, your sister would like to come with us to the lake.
items.zh: 也許你妹妹會想跟我們一起去湖邊。

examples.heading: ② however

items.en: The flat is very small. However, it's close to the city centre.
items.zh: 那間公寓很小，不過離市中心很近。

items.en: I wanted to go to the concert. However, all the tickets were sold.
items.zh: 我本來想去那場音樂會，不過票全賣光了。

items.en: My brother is good at maths. However, he hates science.
items.zh: 我弟弟數學很好，不過他很討厭自然科學。

items.en: The food at the hotel was great. However, the rooms were dirty.
items.zh: 那間旅館的餐點很好，不過房間很髒。

items.en: We planned to have a picnic. However, it rained all day.
items.zh: 我們本來打算去野餐，不過下了一整天的雨。

examples.heading: ③ suddenly

items.en: Suddenly someone knocked on the door.
items.zh: 突然有人敲門。

items.en: We were watching TV. Suddenly the screen went black.
items.zh: 我們正在看電視，螢幕突然黑掉了。

items.en: Suddenly I remembered my keys were in the car.
items.zh: 我突然想起鑰匙在車上。

items.en: I was walking home. Suddenly it started to rain very hard.
items.zh: 我在走路回家，突然下起了大雨。

items.en: Suddenly, a cat jumped onto the table.
items.zh: 一隻貓突然跳上了桌子。

examples.heading: ④ luckily

items.en: I missed the bus. Luckily, my friend gave me a lift.
items.zh: 我錯過了公車，幸好我朋友載了我一程。

items.en: Luckily, the weather was perfect for the wedding.
items.zh: 幸好婚禮那天天氣好極了。

items.en: I dropped my phone. Luckily it didn't break.
items.zh: 我把手機摔到地上，幸好沒摔壞。

items.en: Luckily, there was a chemist's near the hotel.
items.zh: 幸好旅館附近有一家藥局。

items.en: Luckily, my mum found my passport in the kitchen.
items.zh: 幸好我媽在廚房找到了我的護照。

examples.heading: ⑤ usually、often

items.en: Usually I walk to work, but today I drove.
items.zh: 我通常走路上班，不過今天開車。

items.en: Often we eat dinner in front of the TV.
items.zh: 我們常常邊看電視邊吃晚餐。

items.en: Usually, the library is quiet in the mornings.
items.zh: 圖書館早上通常很安靜。

items.en: Often my grandad tells us stories about the war.
items.zh: 我爺爺常常跟我們講戰爭時的故事。

items.en: Usually the post arrives before lunch.
items.zh: 郵件通常午餐前就送到了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 句首的副詞 + 否定句

items.en: Perhaps they don't know about the party.
items.zh: 也許他們不知道有派對。

items.en: Luckily, we didn't miss the start of the film.
items.zh: 幸好我們沒錯過電影的開頭。

items.en: The car is old. However, it doesn't use much petrol.
items.zh: 那輛車很舊，不過不太耗油。

items.en: Usually my cat doesn't go outside at night.
items.zh: 我的貓晚上通常不出門。

items.en: Suddenly I couldn't remember the name of my own street.
items.zh: 我突然想不起自己住的那條街叫什麼。

items.en: Often I don't have time for breakfast.
items.zh: 我常常沒時間吃早餐。

title: I learned to use my phone very quickly and easily.
translation: 我很快、很輕鬆就學會用我的手機了。

Put the plates down gently.
She explained the rules simply.

The cat jumped nimbly onto the wall.
The doors open automatically.
He spoke enthusiastically about his new job.
The lights turn off automatically at midnight.
My grandmother crosses the road very carefully.
The ice cream melted very quickly in the sun.
She plays the guitar very nicely.
He talks very loudly on the phone.
Read the questions slowly and carefully.
They worked quickly and quietly.
She answered calmly and politely.
The team played well and fairly.
He fixed my bike quickly and cheaply.

examples.heading: ① 一般形容詞 + -ly

items.en: The old man walked slowly to the bus stop.
items.zh: 那個老先生慢慢走到公車站。

items.en: The students left the library quietly.
items.zh: 學生們安靜地離開圖書館。

items.en: She checked her answers carefully.
items.zh: 她仔細檢查了她的答案。

items.en: The baby is sleeping peacefully.
items.zh: 寶寶睡得很安穩。

items.en: The receptionist greeted every guest politely.
items.zh: 櫃檯人員很有禮貌地招呼每位客人。

examples.heading: ② 子音 + y 結尾 → -ily

items.en: We found the hotel easily.
items.zh: 我們很輕鬆就找到飯店了。

items.en: The kids laughed happily.
items.zh: 孩子們開心地笑了。

items.en: She shouted angrily at the driver.
items.zh: 她生氣地對司機大吼。

items.en: He got dressed hurriedly and ran out.
items.zh: 他匆匆忙忙穿好衣服就跑出去了。

items.en: The dog wagged its tail lazily.
items.zh: 那隻狗懶洋洋地搖著尾巴。

examples.heading: ③ 子音 + le 結尾 → -ly

items.en: Put the plates down gently.
items.zh: 把盤子輕輕放下。

items.en: She explained the rules simply.
items.zh: 她簡單地說明了規則。

items.en: I played terribly in the last game.
items.zh: 我上一場打得很爛。

items.en: The cat jumped nimbly onto the wall.
items.zh: 那隻貓輕巧地跳上牆。

examples.heading: ④ ic 結尾 → -ally

items.en: The doors open automatically.
items.zh: 門會自動打開。

items.en: He spoke enthusiastically about his new job.
items.zh: 他熱情地談起他的新工作。

items.en: The lights turn off automatically at midnight.
items.zh: 燈到午夜會自動關掉。

examples.heading: ⑤ very + 情狀副詞

items.en: My grandmother crosses the road very carefully.
items.zh: 我奶奶過馬路很小心。

items.en: The ice cream melted very quickly in the sun.
items.zh: 冰淇淋在太陽底下融化得很快。

items.en: She plays the guitar very nicely.
items.zh: 她吉他彈得很好聽。

items.en: He talks very loudly on the phone.
items.zh: 他講電話很大聲。

examples.heading: ⑥ 情狀副詞 + and + 情狀副詞

items.en: Read the questions slowly and carefully.
items.zh: 慢慢地、仔細地讀題目。

items.en: They worked quickly and quietly.
items.zh: 他們做得又快又安靜。

items.en: She answered calmly and politely.
items.zh: 她冷靜又有禮貌地回答。

items.en: The team played well and fairly.
items.zh: 這支球隊打得好，也打得公平。

items.en: He fixed my bike quickly and cheaply.
items.zh: 他很快就修好我的腳踏車，也收得很便宜。

examples.heading: ⑦ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Did you sleep peacefully last night?
items.zh: 你昨晚睡得安穩嗎？

items.en: He didn't explain it very clearly.
items.zh: 他沒有解釋得很清楚。

items.en: Can you write a bit more neatly?
items.zh: 你可以寫整齊一點嗎？

items.en: Why did she leave so suddenly?
items.zh: 她為什麼突然就走了？

items.en: They didn't treat us fairly.
items.zh: 他們對我們不公平。

examples.heading: ⑧ in a friendly way

items.en: The waiter talked to us in a friendly way.
items.zh: 服務生很友善地跟我們說話。

items.en: The nurse spoke to my mum in a kind and friendly way.
items.zh: 護士親切又友善地跟我媽媽說話。

title: My smile slowly disappeared as I finished reading.
translation: 讀完的時候，我臉上的笑容慢慢消失了。

examples.heading: ① 情狀副詞 + 動詞

items.en: The old man slowly opened the letter.
items.zh: 老先生慢慢打開那封信。

items.en: The noise gradually got louder.
items.zh: 噪音漸漸變大了。

items.en: She quietly closed the bedroom door.
items.zh: 她輕輕地關上臥室的門。

items.en: The lights suddenly went out.
items.zh: 燈突然熄了。

items.en: He carefully wrapped the glasses in newspaper.
items.zh: 他用報紙小心地把玻璃杯包好。

items.en: The children patiently waited for their turn.
items.zh: 孩子們很有耐心地等著輪到自己。

items.en: My grandfather proudly showed us his medal.
items.zh: 我爺爺很驕傲地把他的獎章拿給我們看。

items.en: The cat silently jumped onto the table.
items.zh: 貓悄悄跳上了桌子。

examples.heading: ② 助動詞 + 情狀副詞 + 動詞

items.en: The weather will gradually improve this week.
items.zh: 這個星期天氣會漸漸好轉。

items.en: You should seriously think about the job offer.
items.zh: 你應該認真考慮那份工作邀約。

items.en: The pilot had safely landed the plane.
items.zh: 機長已經把飛機安全降落了。

items.en: She has politely refused the invitation.
items.zh: 她已經客氣地婉拒了邀請。

examples.heading: ③ 動詞 + 情狀副詞

items.en: Please drive carefully. The road is icy.
items.zh: 請小心開車，路上結冰了。

items.en: Grandma is resting comfortably in her room.
items.zh: 奶奶在房間裡舒服地休息。

items.en: She smiled nervously before her speech.
items.zh: 她演講前緊張地笑了笑。

items.en: The audience clapped loudly at the end.
items.zh: 最後觀眾大聲鼓掌。

items.en: The old dog walked slowly to the door.
items.zh: 老狗慢慢走到門邊。

items.en: The kids laughed happily at the clown.
items.zh: 孩子們看著小丑開心地笑。

examples.heading: ④ 動詞 + 受詞 + 情狀副詞

items.en: The doctor explained the results clearly.
items.zh: 醫生把檢查結果解釋得很清楚。

items.en: Read the instructions carefully before you start.
items.zh: 開始之前，先仔細讀說明。

items.en: He treats his staff fairly.
items.zh: 他對待員工很公平。

items.en: My mum spends money frugally.
items.zh: 我媽花錢很節省。

items.en: She held the puppy gently in her arms.
items.zh: 她把小狗輕輕抱在懷裡。

items.en: The waiter served the soup quickly.
items.zh: 服務生很快就把湯端上來了。

examples.heading: ⑤ fast、hard、well、late

items.en: Our new puppy learns fast.
items.zh: 我們新養的小狗學得很快。

items.en: My dad worked hard all his life.
items.zh: 我爸辛苦工作了一輩子。

items.en: The new nurse handled the situation well.
items.zh: 新來的護士把狀況處理得很好。

items.en: I got up late on Sunday.
items.zh: 我星期天很晚才起床。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句和疑問句

items.en: He didn't answer the question honestly.
items.zh: 他沒有老實回答那個問題。

items.en: Did you lock the back door properly?
items.zh: 你後門有鎖好嗎？

items.en: She didn't take my advice seriously.
items.zh: 她沒有把我的勸告當一回事。

items.en: Did the patient breathe normally after the operation?
items.zh: 病人手術後呼吸正常嗎？

title: I have finally bought a mobile phone.
translation: 我終於買手機了。
name: 副詞放在句中（含助動詞和 be 之後）
sentences: My brother plays the guitar. He also sings in a band.
The hotel has a pool. It also has a small gym.
I also need some milk from the shop.
Our teacher also gave us a reading test.
Lisa is my classmate. She's also my neighbour.
The museum is free, and it's also open on Mondays.
The weather was cold. It was also very windy.
You can also pay by card.
We should also buy some water for the trip.
My parents will also be at the party.
I only have five euros in my wallet.
The bakery only opens in the morning.
We can only stay for one night.
My son only eats pasta with cheese.
The swimming lesson was only half an hour long.
The bus finally arrived after forty minutes.
We have finally found a flat near the park.
My little brother can finally ride a bike.
She finally passed her driving test.
After three hours, the rain finally stopped.
My grandparents still live in the same village.
Are you still hungry?
It's ten o'clock and Tom is still in bed.
My old laptop still works, so I don't need a new one.
I've already sent the invitations for the barbecue.
The children are already asleep.
My daughter already speaks a little Spanish.
We have already booked the hotel for July.
Ben can't swim, and his sister can't swim either.
I didn't go to the party. My friends didn't go either.
The first hotel wasn't cheap, and the second one wasn't cheap either.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + also + 主要動詞

items.en: My brother plays the guitar. He also sings in a band.
items.zh: 我哥會彈吉他，他也在樂團唱歌。

items.en: The hotel has a pool. It also has a small gym.
items.zh: 那間旅館有游泳池，也有一間小健身房。

items.en: I also need some milk from the shop.
items.zh: 我也需要從店裡買點牛奶。

items.en: Our teacher also gave us a reading test.
items.zh: 我們老師也給我們考了閱讀測驗。

examples.heading: ② be + also

items.en: Lisa is my classmate. She's also my neighbour.
items.zh: Lisa 是我的同學，也是我的鄰居。

items.en: The museum is free, and it's also open on Mondays.
items.zh: 那間博物館免費，而且星期一也有開。

items.en: The weather was cold. It was also very windy.
items.zh: 天氣很冷，風也很大。

examples.heading: ③ 助動詞 + also

items.en: You can also pay by card.
items.zh: 你也可以刷卡。

items.en: We should also buy some water for the trip.
items.zh: 我們也該買些水帶去旅行。

items.en: My parents will also be at the party.
items.zh: 我爸媽也會去派對。

examples.heading: ④ only

items.en: I only have five euros in my wallet.
items.zh: 我錢包裡只有五歐元。

items.en: The bakery only opens in the morning.
items.zh: 那家麵包店只有早上開。

items.en: We can only stay for one night.
items.zh: 我們只能住一個晚上。

items.en: My son only eats pasta with cheese.
items.zh: 我兒子只吃加起司的義大利麵。

items.en: The swimming lesson was only half an hour long.
items.zh: 游泳課只有半小時。

examples.heading: ⑤ finally

items.en: The bus finally arrived after forty minutes.
items.zh: 公車等了四十分鐘終於來了。

items.en: We have finally found a flat near the park.
items.zh: 我們終於在公園附近找到一間公寓。

items.en: My little brother can finally ride a bike.
items.zh: 我弟弟終於會騎腳踏車了。

items.en: She finally passed her driving test.
items.zh: 她終於考過駕照了。

items.en: After three hours, the rain finally stopped.
items.zh: 三個小時後，雨終於停了。

examples.heading: ⑥ still

items.en: My grandparents still live in the same village.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶還住在同一個村子。

items.en: Are you still hungry?
items.zh: 你還會餓嗎？

items.en: It's ten o'clock and Tom is still in bed.
items.zh: 已經十點了，Tom 還在床上。

items.en: My old laptop still works, so I don't need a new one.
items.zh: 我的舊筆電還能用，所以不需要買新的。

examples.heading: ⑦ already

items.en: I've already sent the invitations for the barbecue.
items.zh: 烤肉的邀請我已經寄出去了。

items.en: The children are already asleep.
items.zh: 孩子們已經睡著了。

items.en: My daughter already speaks a little Spanish.
items.zh: 我女兒已經會說一點西班牙文了。

items.en: We have already booked the hotel for July.
items.zh: 我們已經訂好七月的旅館了。

examples.heading: ⑧ 否定句的 either

items.en: Ben can't swim, and his sister can't swim either.
items.zh: Ben 不會游泳，他妹妹也不會。

items.en: I didn't go to the party. My friends didn't go either.
items.zh: 我沒去派對，我朋友也沒去。

items.en: The first hotel wasn't cheap, and the second one wasn't cheap either.
items.zh: 第一間旅館不便宜，第二間也不便宜。

title: I hope you will be there.

items.zh: 水電工午餐後會到。

items.zh: 你昨晚在這裡嗎？

examples.heading: ② be + there

items.en: Will your sister be there tomorrow?
items.zh: 你姊姊明天會去嗎？

items.en: Sorry, I can't be there on Saturday.
items.zh: 抱歉，我星期六不能去。

items.en: The key was there this morning.
items.zh: 鑰匙今天早上還在那裡。

items.zh: 我到的時候他不在。

examples.heading: ③ go、come + here、there

items.en: Please come here and sit down.
items.zh: 請過來坐下。

items.en: I went there with my cousins.
items.zh: 我跟我表哥他們一起去了那裡。

items.en: Why don't you come here for Christmas this year?
items.zh: 你今年何不來這裡過聖誕節？

items.zh: 晚上別一個人去那裡。

examples.heading: ④ get + here、there

items.zh: 去那裡要多久？

items.en: We got here early.
items.zh: 我們很早就到了。

items.en: Send me a message as soon as you get there.
items.zh: 你一到那裡就傳訊息給我。

items.zh: 他們幾點到的？

examples.heading: ⑤ walk、drive、run + here、there

items.zh: 我們可以從車站走過去嗎？

items.en: The kids ran there as fast as they could.
items.zh: 孩子們拚命跑過去。

items.en: I walked here this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上是走路來的。

examples.heading: ⑥ live、stay、work、sit + here、there

items.zh: 你祖父母還住在那裡嗎？

items.zh: 我最好的朋友在那裡工作。

items.en: You can sit here next to me.
items.zh: 你可以坐在我旁邊。

items.en: We stayed there for three nights.
items.zh: 我們在那裡住了三個晚上。

items.en: Wait here while I buy the tickets.
items.zh: 我去買票，你在這裡等。

items.en: How long have you worked here?
items.zh: 你在這裡工作多久了？

items.en: She used to live there with her grandmother.
items.zh: 她以前跟她奶奶住在那裡。

title: I like this place because my parents live there.
