items.en: Our accountant is highly organised and never misses a deadline.
items.zh: 我們的會計很有條理，從來不錯過期限。

items.en: The company has been highly successful.
items.zh: 那家公司一直很成功。

examples.heading: ③ deeply

items.en: We are deeply grateful for your support.
items.zh: 我們非常感謝你們的支持。

items.en: Her speech at the wedding was deeply moving.
items.zh: 她在婚禮上的致詞非常感人。

items.en: His parents were deeply worried about him.
items.zh: 他的父母非常擔心他。

items.en: I'm deeply sorry about what happened.
items.zh: 對於發生的事，我深感抱歉。

examples.heading: ④ completely、totally、entirely

items.en: The two sisters are completely different.
items.zh: 那兩姊妹完全不一樣。

items.en: The map on the website is totally wrong about the bus times.
items.zh: 網站上的地圖把公車時間寫得完全錯了。

items.en: I'm not entirely sure what he meant.
items.zh: 我不完全確定他的意思。

items.en: The building looks completely new.
items.zh: 那棟建築看起來全新的。

items.en: That kind of behaviour is totally unacceptable.
items.zh: 那種行為完全不能接受。

items.en: The decision is entirely yours.
items.zh: 這個決定完全由你做。

examples.heading: ⑤ absolutely + 極端的形容詞

items.en: My grandmother's apple pie was absolutely delicious.
items.zh: 我奶奶做的蘋果派好吃極了。

items.en: The nurses were absolutely exhausted after the night shift.
items.zh: 護士們上完夜班累壞了。

items.en: The weather on our holiday was absolutely terrible.
items.zh: 我們度假時天氣糟透了。

items.en: It's absolutely impossible to finish by Monday.
items.zh: 星期一前完成是絕對不可能的。

items.en: Your garden looks absolutely gorgeous.
items.zh: 你的花園看起來美極了。

examples.heading: ⑥ really + 兩組形容詞

items.en: The water in the lake was really cold.
items.zh: 湖裡的水真的很冷。

items.en: It's really freezing in here.
items.zh: 這裡真的冷死了。

items.en: I'm really tired after work.
items.zh: 下班後我真的很累。

items.en: I'm really exhausted after the trip.
items.zh: 旅行回來我真的累壞了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 否定句

items.en: The new rules aren't completely fair.
items.zh: 新規定不是完全公平。

items.en: I'm not completely happy with the result.
items.zh: 我對結果不是完全滿意。

items.en: The plan isn't entirely clear to me.
items.zh: 這個計畫我還不完全清楚。

title: I like my garden very much.
translation: 我很喜歡我的花園。
name: really、very much 加強 like、love
sentences: We like our new neighbours very much.
My son loves trains very much.
I liked the film very much.
She loves her grandmother very much.
They enjoyed the concert very much.
I want to see you very much.
Does he like his job very much?
I really like your shoes.
We really love this beach.
My sister really likes cooking.
I really enjoyed the party last night.
He really wants a dog.
The kids really loved the zoo.
I really hate waiting for the bus.
You'll really like this book.
I don't really like spicy food.
She doesn't really enjoy parties.
We didn't really like the hotel.
My dad doesn't really want a new phone.
I don't like rainy days very much.
He didn't enjoy the trip very much.
They don't like their new teacher very much.
My cat doesn't like the vet very much.
Do you really like it?
Does she really love him?
Did you really enjoy the meal?
Do they really want to move?
I like my new school a lot.
She loves her bike a lot.
We enjoyed the holiday a lot.
My parents like this café a lot.

examples.heading: ① like / love + 受詞 + very much

items.en: We like our new neighbours very much.
items.zh: 我們很喜歡新鄰居。

items.en: My son loves trains very much.
items.zh: 我兒子非常喜歡火車。

items.en: I liked the film very much.
items.zh: 我很喜歡那部電影。

items.en: She loves her grandmother very much.
items.zh: 她非常愛她奶奶。

items.en: They enjoyed the concert very much.
items.zh: 他們很喜歡那場音樂會。

items.en: I want to see you very much.
items.zh: 我非常想見你。

items.en: Does he like his job very much?
items.zh: 他很喜歡他的工作嗎？

examples.heading: ② really + like / love + 受詞

items.en: I really like your shoes.
items.zh: 我真的很喜歡你的鞋子。

items.en: We really love this beach.
items.zh: 我們真的很愛這個海灘。

items.en: My sister really likes cooking.
items.zh: 我姊姊真的很喜歡做菜。

items.en: I really enjoyed the party last night.
items.zh: 昨晚的派對我玩得很開心。

items.en: He really wants a dog.
items.zh: 他真的很想養狗。

items.en: The kids really loved the zoo.
items.zh: 孩子們真的很喜歡動物園。

items.en: I really hate waiting for the bus.
items.zh: 我真的很討厭等公車。

items.en: You'll really like this book.
items.zh: 你一定會很喜歡這本書。

examples.heading: ③ don't really + like / love

items.en: I don't really like spicy food.
items.zh: 我不太喜歡吃辣。

items.en: She doesn't really enjoy parties.
items.zh: 她不太喜歡參加派對。

items.en: We didn't really like the hotel.
items.zh: 我們不太喜歡那家旅館。

items.en: My dad doesn't really want a new phone.
items.zh: 我爸不太想要新手機。

examples.heading: ④ don't like + 受詞 + very much

items.en: I don't like rainy days very much.
items.zh: 我不太喜歡下雨天。

items.en: He didn't enjoy the trip very much.
items.zh: 那趟旅行他玩得不太開心。

items.en: They don't like their new teacher very much.
items.zh: 他們不太喜歡新老師。

items.en: My cat doesn't like the vet very much.
items.zh: 我的貓不太喜歡獸醫。

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問句裡的 really

items.en: Do you really like it?
items.zh: 你真的喜歡嗎？

items.en: Does she really love him?
items.zh: 她真的愛他嗎？

items.en: Did you really enjoy the meal?
items.zh: 你真的覺得那頓飯好吃嗎？

items.en: Do they really want to move?
items.zh: 他們真的想搬家嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ like / love + 受詞 + a lot

items.en: I like my new school a lot.
items.zh: 我很喜歡我的新學校。

items.en: She loves her bike a lot.
items.zh: 她很愛她的腳踏車。

items.en: We enjoyed the holiday a lot.
items.zh: 我們假期玩得很開心。

items.en: My parents like this café a lot.
items.zh: 我爸媽很喜歡這家咖啡店。

title: We listened to music, and we danced a lot too.
translation: 我們聽了音樂，也跳了很多舞。
name: so much、a lot 修飾動詞表示程度
sentences: My brother travels a lot for work.
It rained a lot last week.
We laughed a lot at the party.
You've changed a lot!
Does he talk a lot in class?
I walk a lot because I don't have a car.
The kids swam a lot on holiday.
My kids watch cartoons a lot.
My mum helps me a lot.
We use this app a lot.
My grandfather tells us stories about his childhood a lot.
They visited their grandparents a lot that summer.
I don't go out a lot these days.
He didn't sleep a lot last night.
Do you cook a lot?
Did it snow a lot in Canada?
I miss you so much.
We laughed so much that my face hurt.
The baby cried so much last night.
My knee hurts so much.
She has grown so much since last year.
Thank you so much for the present!
I love this song so much.
We enjoyed the trip so much.
He loves his dog so much.
I'm looking forward to the holiday so much!
My parents liked the restaurant so much.
We listened to music, and we sang a lot too.
I ate a lot, and I drank a lot too.
She studies a lot, and she reads a lot too.

examples.heading: ① 動詞 + a lot

items.en: My brother travels a lot for work.
items.zh: 我哥哥常因為工作出差。

items.en: It rained a lot last week.
items.zh: 上星期下了很多雨。

items.en: We laughed a lot at the party.
items.zh: 我們在派對上笑得很開心。

items.en: You've changed a lot!
items.zh: 你變了好多！

items.en: Does he talk a lot in class?
items.zh: 他上課時話很多嗎？

items.en: I walk a lot because I don't have a car.
items.zh: 我常走路，因為我沒有車。

items.en: The kids swam a lot on holiday.
items.zh: 孩子們度假時游了很多次泳。

examples.heading: ② 動詞 + 受詞 + a lot

items.en: My kids watch cartoons a lot.
items.zh: 我的孩子很常看卡通。

items.en: My mum helps me a lot.
items.zh: 我媽幫了我很多忙。

items.en: We use this app a lot.
items.zh: 我們很常用這個 app。

items.en: My grandfather tells us stories about his childhood a lot.
items.zh: 我爺爺很常跟我們講他小時候的故事。

items.en: They visited their grandparents a lot that summer.
items.zh: 那年夏天他們常去看爺爺奶奶。

examples.heading: ③ 否定句和疑問句的 a lot

items.en: I don't go out a lot these days.
items.zh: 我最近不太常出門。

items.en: He didn't sleep a lot last night.
items.zh: 他昨晚沒睡多少。

items.en: Do you cook a lot?
items.zh: 你常煮飯嗎？

items.en: Did it snow a lot in Canada?
items.zh: 在加拿大雪下得多嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 動詞 + so much

items.en: I miss you so much.
items.zh: 我好想你。

items.en: We laughed so much that my face hurt.
items.zh: 我們笑到臉都痛了。

items.en: The baby cried so much last night.
items.zh: 寶寶昨晚哭得好厲害。

items.en: My knee hurts so much.
items.zh: 我的膝蓋好痛。

items.en: She has grown so much since last year.
items.zh: 她從去年到現在長大了好多。

examples.heading: ⑤ 動詞 + 受詞 + so much

items.en: Thank you so much for the present!
items.zh: 非常謝謝你的禮物！

items.en: I love this song so much.
items.zh: 我好喜歡這首歌。

items.en: We enjoyed the trip so much.
items.zh: 我們那趟旅行玩得好開心。

items.en: He loves his dog so much.
items.zh: 他好愛他的狗。

items.en: I'm looking forward to the holiday so much!
items.zh: 我好期待這次假期！

items.en: My parents liked the restaurant so much.
items.zh: 我爸媽好喜歡那家餐廳。

examples.heading: ⑥ a lot 和 too

items.en: We listened to music, and we sang a lot too.
items.zh: 我們聽了音樂，也唱了很多歌。

items.en: I ate a lot, and I drank a lot too.
items.zh: 我吃了很多，也喝了很多。

items.en: She studies a lot, and she reads a lot too.
items.zh: 她很用功，也讀很多書。

title: I don't speak very well, but I can understand and speak a little.
translation: 我講得不太好，不過我聽得懂，也會講一點。
name: 程度副詞修飾動詞（a little、a bit）
sentences: The baby cried a little and then fell asleep.
I only know how to cook a little.
Her hand shook a little as she signed the letter.
The prices went up a little last year.
My back still aches a little.
Can you move up a bit?
I'm going to lie down a bit.
Let's wait a bit before we decide.
Things have changed a bit since last year.
We chatted a bit after class.
Turn the music down a little, please.
Can you open the window a bit?
I practised the piano a little last night.
She pushed the door a bit, and it opened.
Move the picture a little to the left.
I read just a little bit every night.
"Did it hurt?" "Just a little."
Can I rest just a little bit longer?
He studied just a little before the test.
Sit down and rest a bit.
Let's stop and talk a little.
I need to think about it a bit.
We walked around the town a little after dinner.
"Do you speak Chinese?" "Yes, a little."
Did you sleep a bit on the plane?
Didn't you study a bit last weekend?
Could you slow down a bit?
Has the pain gone down a little?
I ate very little at lunch because I felt sick.
She sleeps very little before exams.
He talks very little in meetings.

examples.heading: ① 動詞 + a little

items.en: The baby cried a little and then fell asleep.
items.zh: 寶寶哭了一下，然後就睡著了。

items.en: I only know how to cook a little.
items.zh: 我只會煮一點點菜。

items.en: Her hand shook a little as she signed the letter.
items.zh: 她簽信的時候手有點抖。

items.en: The prices went up a little last year.
items.zh: 價格去年漲了一點。

items.en: My back still aches a little.
items.zh: 我的背還有點痠。

examples.heading: ② 動詞 + a bit

items.en: Can you move up a bit?
items.zh: 你可以往裡面挪一下嗎？

items.en: I'm going to lie down a bit.
items.zh: 我要去躺一下。

items.en: Let's wait a bit before we decide.
items.zh: 我們等一下再決定。

items.en: Things have changed a bit since last year.
items.zh: 從去年到現在，事情有了一點變化。

items.en: We chatted a bit after class.
items.zh: 我們下課後聊了一下。

examples.heading: ③ 動詞 + 受詞 + a little / a bit

items.en: Turn the music down a little, please.
items.zh: 請把音樂關小聲一點。

items.en: Can you open the window a bit?
items.zh: 你可以把窗戶打開一點嗎？

items.en: I practised the piano a little last night.
items.zh: 我昨晚練了一下鋼琴。

items.en: She pushed the door a bit, and it opened.
items.zh: 她推了一下門，門就開了。

items.en: Move the picture a little to the left.
items.zh: 把畫往左移一點。

examples.heading: ④ just a little、just a little bit

items.en: I read just a little bit every night.
items.zh: 我每天晚上只看一點點書。

items.en: "Did it hurt?" "Just a little."
items.zh: 會痛嗎？一點點而已。

items.en: Can I rest just a little bit longer?
items.zh: 我可以再多休息一下下嗎？

items.en: He studied just a little before the test.
items.zh: 他考試前只讀了一點點。

examples.heading: ⑤ 表示時間不長

items.en: Sit down and rest a bit.
items.zh: 坐下來休息一下。

items.en: Let's stop and talk a little.
items.zh: 我們停下來聊一下吧。

items.en: I need to think about it a bit.
items.zh: 我需要想一下。

items.en: We walked around the town a little after dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐後我們在鎮上走了一下。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: "Do you speak Chinese?" "Yes, a little."
items.zh: 你會說中文嗎？會，一點點。

items.en: Did you sleep a bit on the plane?
items.zh: 你在飛機上有睡一下嗎？

items.en: Didn't you study a bit last weekend?
items.zh: 你上週末都沒讀一下書嗎？

items.en: Could you slow down a bit?
items.zh: 你可以慢一點嗎？

items.en: Has the pain gone down a little?
items.zh: 痛有減輕一點嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 和 very little 對比

items.en: I ate very little at lunch because I felt sick.
items.zh: 我午餐幾乎沒吃，因為我不舒服。

items.en: She sleeps very little before exams.
items.zh: 她考試前幾乎不睡。

items.en: He talks very little in meetings.
items.zh: 他開會時很少說話。

title: The author of the letter apparently has no experience of being a parent in our times.
translation: 寫這封信的人看來不知道在我們這個時代當父母是什麼樣子。
name: 子句中插入副詞表示保留態度
sentences: The new manager apparently used to work in a bank.
They have apparently decided to sell the house.
The swimming pool apparently opens again in May.
Our neighbours apparently didn't hear the alarm.
The two brothers, apparently, haven't spoken for years.
This cream supposedly makes you look younger.
The castle is supposedly haunted.
He is supposedly an expert, but he made a lot of mistakes.
The train was supposedly on time, but we waited an hour.
It's the best restaurant in town, supposedly.
The man allegedly stole three cars.
The company allegedly hid the problem from its customers.
She allegedly lied to the police.
The player allegedly took money to lose the match.
The singer is reportedly planning a world tour.
The minister will reportedly resign next week.
The storm reportedly destroyed hundreds of homes.
The fire reportedly started in the kitchen.
The company has reportedly lost millions this year.
The problem seemingly has no solution.
He was seemingly calm, but his hands were shaking.
The road went on seemingly forever.
She answered every question with seemingly no effort.
The film, supposedly a comedy, didn't make anyone laugh.
His uncle, apparently, was a famous singer.
The painting, allegedly a fake, sold for a million pounds.
The meeting, reportedly, lasted six hours.
The suspect allegedly entered the building at midnight.
The factory will reportedly close by the end of the year.
The two leaders apparently disagreed on several points.

examples.heading: ① apparently

items.en: The new manager apparently used to work in a bank.
items.zh: 新經理聽說以前在銀行工作。

items.en: They have apparently decided to sell the house.
items.zh: 他們看來決定要賣房子了。

items.en: The swimming pool apparently opens again in May.
items.zh: 游泳池聽說五月會重新開放。

items.en: Our neighbours apparently didn't hear the alarm.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居好像沒聽到警報聲。

items.en: The two brothers, apparently, haven't spoken for years.
items.zh: 那兩兄弟聽說好幾年沒說過話了。

examples.heading: ② supposedly

items.en: This cream supposedly makes you look younger.
items.zh: 這種乳霜據說會讓你看起來比較年輕。

items.en: The castle is supposedly haunted.
items.zh: 據說那座城堡鬧鬼。

items.en: He is supposedly an expert, but he made a lot of mistakes.
items.zh: 他據說是專家，可是他犯了很多錯。

items.en: The train was supposedly on time, but we waited an hour.
items.zh: 火車據說準時，可是我們等了一個小時。

items.en: It's the best restaurant in town, supposedly.
items.zh: 那是城裡最好的餐廳，至少大家是這麼說的。

examples.heading: ③ allegedly

items.en: The man allegedly stole three cars.
items.zh: 那名男子據稱偷了三輛車。

items.en: The company allegedly hid the problem from its customers.
items.zh: 那家公司據稱向顧客隱瞞了這個問題。

items.en: She allegedly lied to the police.
items.zh: 她據稱對警方說了謊。

items.en: The player allegedly took money to lose the match.
items.zh: 那名球員據稱收錢打假球。

examples.heading: ④ reportedly

items.en: The singer is reportedly planning a world tour.
items.zh: 據報導，那位歌手正在計畫世界巡迴演出。

items.en: The minister will reportedly resign next week.
items.zh: 據報導，部長下週會辭職。

items.en: The storm reportedly destroyed hundreds of homes.
items.zh: 據報導，暴風雨摧毀了數百間房屋。

items.en: The fire reportedly started in the kitchen.
items.zh: 據報導，火是從廚房燒起來的。

items.en: The company has reportedly lost millions this year.
items.zh: 據報導，那家公司今年虧損了數百萬。

examples.heading: ⑤ seemingly

items.en: The problem seemingly has no solution.
items.zh: 這個問題看起來沒有解決辦法。

items.en: He was seemingly calm, but his hands were shaking.
items.zh: 他表面上很冷靜，可是他的手在發抖。

items.en: The road went on seemingly forever.
items.zh: 那條路看起來好像永遠走不完。

items.en: She answered every question with seemingly no effort.
items.zh: 她回答每個問題都好像毫不費力。

examples.heading: ⑥ 插入句中的保留態度副詞

items.en: The film, supposedly a comedy, didn't make anyone laugh.
items.zh: 那部電影據說是喜劇，可是沒有人笑。

items.en: His uncle, apparently, was a famous singer.
items.zh: 他叔叔聽說是一位有名的歌手。

items.en: The painting, allegedly a fake, sold for a million pounds.
items.zh: 那幅畫據稱是假的，卻賣了一百萬英鎊。

items.en: The meeting, reportedly, lasted six hours.
items.zh: 那場會議據報導開了六個小時。

examples.heading: ⑦ 新聞和報告裡

items.en: The suspect allegedly entered the building at midnight.
items.zh: 嫌犯據稱在午夜進入大樓。

items.en: The factory will reportedly close by the end of the year.
items.zh: 據報導，那間工廠年底前會關閉。

items.en: The two leaders apparently disagreed on several points.
items.zh: 兩位領導人看來在幾點上意見不同。

title: I usually read in my free time, particularly in the evenings before I go to bed.
translation: 我有空的時候通常會看書，特別是晚上睡覺前。
name: 焦點副詞（particularly、especially）
sentences: I like all kinds of music, especially jazz.
The children loved the zoo, especially the monkeys.
Everyone was friendly, especially the old lady next door.
Drink lots of water, especially in summer.
I miss my family, especially my little brother.
The roads are dangerous, particularly at night.
I enjoyed the whole trip, particularly the day in the mountains.
Many people, particularly young people, use this app.
The town is busy, particularly on market days.
She likes Asian food, particularly Thai food.
I particularly liked the ending of the film.
We especially want to thank our teachers.
She particularly enjoys cooking for her friends.
He especially loves the beach in the morning.
The weather was especially cold this winter.
The last part of the exam was particularly difficult.
The new teacher is especially patient with young children.
The sunset was particularly beautiful last night.
I feel tired, especially when I don't sleep well.
Be careful, particularly if you're driving at night.
I like this café, especially because it's quiet.
Take a jacket, especially if you're going to the mountains.
It's hard to find a flat, particularly when you don't have much money.
I'm not particularly worried about the interview.
The restaurant near the station wasn't especially cheap.
My brother doesn't particularly enjoy long car journeys.
"Do you want to go out tonight?" "Not particularly."
Thank you for the party. I especially enjoyed the music.
Please check your homework, particularly the spelling.
All students, especially new students, must come to the meeting.

examples.heading: ① especially + 名詞片語

items.en: I like all kinds of music, especially jazz.
items.zh: 我喜歡各種音樂，尤其是爵士樂。

items.en: The children loved the zoo, especially the monkeys.
items.zh: 孩子們很喜歡動物園，尤其是猴子。

items.en: Everyone was friendly, especially the old lady next door.
items.zh: 大家都很友善，尤其是隔壁的老太太。

items.en: Drink lots of water, especially in summer.
items.zh: 多喝水，尤其是在夏天。

items.en: I miss my family, especially my little brother.
items.zh: 我想念我的家人，尤其是我弟弟。

examples.heading: ② particularly + 名詞片語或介系詞片語

items.en: The roads are dangerous, particularly at night.
items.zh: 路上很危險，特別是晚上。

items.en: I enjoyed the whole trip, particularly the day in the mountains.
items.zh: 我整趟旅行都很開心，特別是在山上的那一天。

items.en: Many people, particularly young people, use this app.
items.zh: 很多人用這個應用程式，特別是年輕人。

items.en: The town is busy, particularly on market days.
items.zh: 鎮上很熱鬧，特別是有市集的日子。

items.en: She likes Asian food, particularly Thai food.
items.zh: 她喜歡亞洲菜，特別是泰國菜。

examples.heading: ③ especially / particularly + 一般動詞

items.en: I particularly liked the ending of the film.
items.zh: 我特別喜歡那部電影的結局。

items.en: We especially want to thank our teachers.
items.zh: 我們特別要感謝我們的老師。

items.en: She particularly enjoys cooking for her friends.
items.zh: 她特別喜歡煮飯給朋友吃。

items.en: He especially loves the beach in the morning.
items.zh: 他特別愛早上的海灘。

examples.heading: ④ especially / particularly + 形容詞

items.en: The weather was especially cold this winter.
items.zh: 今年冬天天氣特別冷。

items.en: The last part of the exam was particularly difficult.
items.zh: 考試的最後一部分特別難。

items.en: The new teacher is especially patient with young children.
items.zh: 新老師對年紀小的孩子特別有耐心。

items.en: The sunset was particularly beautiful last night.
items.zh: 昨晚的夕陽特別美。

examples.heading: ⑤ especially / particularly + 子句

items.en: I feel tired, especially when I don't sleep well.
items.zh: 我覺得很累，尤其是沒睡好的時候。

items.en: Be careful, particularly if you're driving at night.
items.zh: 要小心，特別是晚上開車的話。

items.en: I like this café, especially because it's quiet.
items.zh: 我喜歡這家咖啡館，特別是因為它很安靜。

items.en: Take a jacket, especially if you're going to the mountains.
items.zh: 帶件外套，尤其是你要上山的話。

items.en: It's hard to find a flat, particularly when you don't have much money.
items.zh: 找公寓很難，特別是錢不多的時候。

examples.heading: ⑥ not particularly、not especially

items.en: I'm not particularly worried about the interview.
items.zh: 我對面試沒有特別擔心。

items.en: The restaurant near the station wasn't especially cheap.
items.zh: 車站附近那家餐廳沒有特別便宜。

items.en: My brother doesn't particularly enjoy long car journeys.
items.zh: 我弟弟沒有特別喜歡坐長途車。

items.en: "Do you want to go out tonight?" "Not particularly."
items.zh: 你今晚想出去嗎？不怎麼想。

examples.heading: ⑦ 在書信和訊息裡

items.en: Thank you for the party. I especially enjoyed the music.
items.zh: 謝謝你的派對。我特別喜歡那些音樂。

items.en: Please check your homework, particularly the spelling.
items.zh: 請檢查你的功課，特別是拼字。

items.en: All students, especially new students, must come to the meeting.
items.zh: 所有學生都要來開會，尤其是新生。

title: They are always very friendly and polite.
translation: 他們總是很友善、很有禮貌。
name: always、sometimes 表示頻率
sentences: The trains are always late on Mondays.
My mother is always busy in the morning.
He was always kind to me.
Is the museum always this crowded?
The shop is always closed on Sundays.
I always text my mum when I get home.
We always have rice for dinner.
My dad always reads the news on his phone.
She always says hello to the neighbours.
Do you always get up so early?
They always went to the same café after school.
I always forget his name.
The road is sometimes closed in winter.
My little brother is sometimes difficult.
The tests were sometimes very hard.
Work is sometimes boring, but I like my team.
I sometimes cook for my friends.
We sometimes eat outside when it's warm.
My cat sometimes sleeps on my bed.
He sometimes works from home.
Do you sometimes feel tired after lunch?
She sometimes didn't answer my messages.
Sometimes I go to the beach with my sister.
Sometimes we play cards after dinner.
Sometimes it snows here in March.
Sometimes my parents visit me at the weekend.
I take the bus to work sometimes.
We meet for coffee sometimes.
My boss gets angry sometimes.
It gets very hot here sometimes.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + always

items.en: The trains are always late on Mondays.
items.zh: 星期一火車總是誤點。

items.en: My mother is always busy in the morning.
items.zh: 我媽早上總是很忙。

items.en: He was always kind to me.
items.zh: 他以前一直對我很好。

items.en: Is the museum always this crowded?
items.zh: 博物館一直都這麼多人嗎？

items.en: The shop is always closed on Sundays.
items.zh: 這家店星期天都不開。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + always + 動詞

items.en: I always text my mum when I get home.
items.zh: 我到家都會傳訊息給我媽。

items.en: We always have rice for dinner.
items.zh: 我們晚餐都吃飯。

items.en: My dad always reads the news on his phone.
items.zh: 我爸都用手機看新聞。

items.en: She always says hello to the neighbours.
items.zh: 她總是跟鄰居打招呼。

items.en: Do you always get up so early?
items.zh: 你都這麼早起床嗎？

items.en: They always went to the same café after school.
items.zh: 他們以前放學後都去同一家咖啡店。

items.en: I always forget his name.
items.zh: 我老是忘記他的名字。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + sometimes

items.en: The road is sometimes closed in winter.
items.zh: 這條路冬天有時候會封閉。

items.en: My little brother is sometimes difficult.
items.zh: 我弟弟有時候很難搞。

items.en: The tests were sometimes very hard.
items.zh: 考試有時候很難。

items.en: Work is sometimes boring, but I like my team.
items.zh: 工作有時候很無聊，可是我喜歡我的團隊。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + sometimes + 動詞

items.en: I sometimes cook for my friends.
items.zh: 我有時候會煮飯給朋友吃。

items.en: We sometimes eat outside when it's warm.
items.zh: 天氣暖和的時候，我們有時候會在外面吃飯。

items.en: My cat sometimes sleeps on my bed.
items.zh: 我的貓有時候會睡在我床上。

items.en: He sometimes works from home.
items.zh: 他有時候在家工作。

items.en: Do you sometimes feel tired after lunch?
items.zh: 你吃完午餐有時候會覺得累嗎？

items.en: She sometimes didn't answer my messages.
items.zh: 她以前有時候不回我訊息。

examples.heading: ⑤ sometimes 放在句首

items.en: Sometimes I go to the beach with my sister.
items.zh: 我有時候會跟我妹妹去海邊。

items.en: Sometimes we play cards after dinner.
items.zh: 我們晚餐後有時候會玩牌。

items.en: Sometimes it snows here in March.
items.zh: 這裡三月有時候會下雪。

items.en: Sometimes my parents visit me at the weekend.
items.zh: 我爸媽有時候週末會來看我。

examples.heading: ⑥ sometimes 放在句尾

items.en: I take the bus to work sometimes.
items.zh: 我有時候搭公車上班。

items.en: We meet for coffee sometimes.
items.zh: 我們有時候會見面喝咖啡。

items.en: My boss gets angry sometimes.
items.zh: 我老闆有時候會生氣。

items.en: It gets very hot here sometimes.
items.zh: 這裡有時候會變得很熱。

title: You never remember anything!
translation: 你老是什麼都不記得！
name: usually、often、never 表示頻率
sentences: People usually eat breakfast between seven and nine.
I usually take the train to work.
My grandmother usually goes to bed at ten.
Do you usually cook at home?
We usually didn't have much homework on Fridays.
Usually I walk the dog after dinner.
The library is usually quiet in the morning.
My brother is usually late for dinner.
Are the shops usually open on Sundays?
I often go to the history museum on Saturdays.
We often play football in the park.
My parents often call me on Sundays.
Does it often snow here?
She often forgets her keys.
I don't often watch TV.
The trains are often full in the morning.
He is often tired after work.
The weather is often windy here.
I never drink coffee at night.
My dad never says sorry.
We never went abroad when I was a child.
You never listen to me!
She never eats breakfast.
The bus is never on time.
I can never find a parking space here.
He is never at home in the evening.
I will never forget this day.
Do I have to pay weekly or monthly?
The magazine comes out weekly.
We meet weekly to talk about the project.
Take this medicine daily.
We pay the rent monthly.

examples.heading: ① usually + 動詞

items.en: People usually eat breakfast between seven and nine.
items.zh: 大家通常七點到九點吃早餐。

items.en: I usually take the train to work.
items.zh: 我通常搭火車上班。

items.en: My grandmother usually goes to bed at ten.
items.zh: 我奶奶通常十點睡覺。

items.en: Do you usually cook at home?
items.zh: 你通常在家煮飯嗎？

items.en: We usually didn't have much homework on Fridays.
items.zh: 我們以前星期五通常沒什麼功課。

items.en: Usually I walk the dog after dinner.
items.zh: 我通常晚餐後遛狗。

examples.heading: ② be + usually

items.en: The library is usually quiet in the morning.
items.zh: 圖書館早上通常很安靜。

items.en: My brother is usually late for dinner.
items.zh: 我哥哥吃晚餐通常會遲到。

items.en: Are the shops usually open on Sundays?
items.zh: 商店星期天通常有開嗎？

examples.heading: ③ often + 動詞

items.en: I often go to the history museum on Saturdays.
items.zh: 我星期六常去歷史博物館。

items.en: We often play football in the park.
items.zh: 我們常在公園踢足球。

items.en: My parents often call me on Sundays.
items.zh: 我爸媽常在星期天打電話給我。

items.en: Does it often snow here?
items.zh: 這裡常下雪嗎？

items.en: She often forgets her keys.
items.zh: 她常忘記帶鑰匙。

items.en: I don't often watch TV.
items.zh: 我不常看電視。

examples.heading: ④ be + often

items.en: The trains are often full in the morning.
items.zh: 早上的火車常常客滿。

items.en: He is often tired after work.
items.zh: 他下班後常常很累。

items.en: The weather is often windy here.
items.zh: 這裡常常颳風。

examples.heading: ⑤ never + 動詞

items.en: I never drink coffee at night.
items.zh: 我晚上從不喝咖啡。

items.en: My dad never says sorry.
items.zh: 我爸從來不道歉。

items.en: We never went abroad when I was a child.
items.zh: 我小時候我們從沒出過國。

items.en: You never listen to me!
items.zh: 你從來都不聽我說！

items.en: She never eats breakfast.
items.zh: 她從不吃早餐。

examples.heading: ⑥ be + never、助動詞 + never

items.en: The bus is never on time.
items.zh: 公車從來不準時。

items.en: I can never find a parking space here.
items.zh: 我在這裡從來都找不到停車位。

items.en: He is never at home in the evening.
items.zh: 他晚上從來不在家。

items.en: I will never forget this day.
items.zh: 我永遠不會忘記這一天。

examples.heading: ⑦ weekly、monthly、daily 放在句尾

items.en: Do I have to pay weekly or monthly?
items.zh: 我要每週付還是每月付？

items.en: The magazine comes out weekly.
items.zh: 這本雜誌每週出刊。

items.en: We meet weekly to talk about the project.
items.zh: 我們每週開會討論這個專案。

items.en: Take this medicine daily.
items.zh: 這個藥每天吃。

items.en: We pay the rent monthly.
items.zh: 我們每個月付一次房租。

title: I don't like green, so I decided to use blue.
translation: 我不喜歡綠色，所以我決定用藍色。
name: also、so、however 連接子句
sentences: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.
It's late, so let's go home.
My phone was dead, so I couldn't call you.
The shop was closed, so we went to the market.
She's ill, so she can't come to the party.
We missed the bus, so we took a taxi.
The film was boring, so I fell asleep.
I don't have much money, so I usually cook at home.
The clothes were cheap. However, they were good quality.
My flat is small. However, it's very close to work.
We wanted to go to the beach. However, it rained all day.
The food was great. However, the service was slow.
He studied hard. However, he didn't pass the test.
I like my job. However, I want to try something new.
Tickets usually cost forty pounds. However, students pay twenty.
I also bought a new pair of jeans.
She plays the piano. She also sings.
We visited the castle, and we also went to the museum.
My dad also works on Saturdays.
They also want to come with us.
I also need some milk.
My mother is a nurse. My aunt is also a nurse.
The hotel is cheap. It's also near the station.
I can also speak a little Spanish.
You should also bring a coat.
We were also very tired.
The train was late, so I missed the meeting. I also missed lunch.
The flat is small. However, it's cheap, so I'm going to take it.
I don't like coffee, so I usually drink tea. However, I sometimes have a latte.
It was sunny. However, it was also windy, so we didn't go sailing.

examples.heading: ① 子句 + , so + 子句

items.en: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.
items.zh: 我餓了，所以做了一個三明治。

items.en: It's late, so let's go home.
items.zh: 很晚了，我們回家吧。

items.en: My phone was dead, so I couldn't call you.
items.zh: 我的手機沒電了，所以沒辦法打給你。

items.en: The shop was closed, so we went to the market.
items.zh: 那家店沒開，所以我們去了市場。

items.en: She's ill, so she can't come to the party.
items.zh: 她生病了，所以不能來派對。

items.en: We missed the bus, so we took a taxi.
items.zh: 我們錯過了公車，所以搭了計程車。

items.en: The film was boring, so I fell asleep.
items.zh: 電影很無聊，所以我睡著了。

items.en: I don't have much money, so I usually cook at home.
items.zh: 我錢不多，所以通常在家煮飯。

examples.heading: ② 句子。However, + 句子。

items.en: The clothes were cheap. However, they were good quality.
items.zh: 那些衣服很便宜。不過品質很好。

items.en: My flat is small. However, it's very close to work.
items.zh: 我的公寓很小。不過離公司很近。

items.en: We wanted to go to the beach. However, it rained all day.
items.zh: 我們本來想去海邊。不過下了一整天的雨。

items.en: The food was great. However, the service was slow.
items.zh: 食物很好吃。不過服務很慢。

items.en: He studied hard. However, he didn't pass the test.
items.zh: 他很用功。不過考試沒過。

items.en: I like my job. However, I want to try something new.
items.zh: 我喜歡我的工作。不過我想嘗試新的東西。

items.en: Tickets usually cost forty pounds. However, students pay twenty.
items.zh: 票通常要四十英鎊。不過學生付二十英鎊就好。

examples.heading: ③ also + 一般動詞

items.en: I also bought a new pair of jeans.
items.zh: 我也買了一條新的牛仔褲。

items.en: She plays the piano. She also sings.
items.zh: 她會彈鋼琴。她也會唱歌。

items.en: We visited the castle, and we also went to the museum.
items.zh: 我們參觀了城堡，也去了博物館。

items.en: My dad also works on Saturdays.
items.zh: 我爸星期六也要上班。

items.en: They also want to come with us.
items.zh: 他們也想跟我們一起去。

items.en: I also need some milk.
items.zh: 我也需要一些牛奶。

examples.heading: ④ be + also、助動詞 + also

items.en: My mother is a nurse. My aunt is also a nurse.
items.zh: 我媽是護士。我阿姨也是護士。

items.en: The hotel is cheap. It's also near the station.
items.zh: 那家旅館很便宜。它也在車站附近。

items.en: I can also speak a little Spanish.
items.zh: 我也會說一點西班牙文。

items.en: You should also bring a coat.
items.zh: 你也應該帶件外套。

items.en: We were also very tired.
items.zh: 我們也很累。

examples.heading: ⑤ so、however、also 在同一段話裡

items.en: The train was late, so I missed the meeting. I also missed lunch.
items.zh: 火車誤點了，所以我錯過了會議。我也錯過了午餐。

items.en: The flat is small. However, it's cheap, so I'm going to take it.
items.zh: 那間公寓很小。不過很便宜，所以我要租下來。

items.en: I don't like coffee, so I usually drink tea. However, I sometimes have a latte.
items.zh: 我不喜歡咖啡，所以我通常喝茶。不過我有時候會喝拿鐵。

items.en: It was sunny. However, it was also windy, so we didn't go sailing.
items.zh: 天氣晴朗。不過風也很大，所以我們沒去開帆船。

title: Please let me know if you can collect it. Otherwise, I will ask my other friend.
translation: 請跟我說你能不能來拿。不然我就去拜託我另一個朋友。
name: 連接副詞（therefore、otherwise）
sentences: Write it down. Otherwise, you'll forget it.
We need to leave now. Otherwise, we'll be late.
Call me before you come. Otherwise, I might be out.
Put the milk in the fridge, otherwise it'll go off.
I'm glad you reminded me. Otherwise, I would have forgotten.
Book the tickets soon. Otherwise, there won't be any left.
The bridge is closed. Therefore, all traffic must use the main road.
He was ill. Therefore, he couldn't take the exam.
The airline cancelled our flight. Therefore, we stayed one more night.
Many of our staff are ill. Therefore, the shop will close early today.
It is therefore important to arrive on time.
She had no experience. She therefore found the job difficult at first.
The flat is in a quiet street. Furthermore, it has a big garden.
I enjoy my job. Furthermore, my colleagues are very kind.
The museum is free. Furthermore, it's open every day.
You will improve your English. Furthermore, you will meet people from many countries.
This phone is light. Furthermore, the battery lasts for two days.
Our town needs a new library. Furthermore, it needs more parks.
Dear Sir, I am writing to complain about my order. Furthermore, I would like a refund.
Please reply by Friday. Otherwise, I will give the room to another guest.
I have three years of experience. Therefore, I believe I am right for this job.
The course starts in May. Furthermore, it includes a trip to London.
The heating doesn't work. Therefore, I would like to change rooms.
Be careful, otherwise you'll fall.
Turn the music down, otherwise the neighbours will complain.
Eat something now, otherwise you'll be hungry later.
Let's take a taxi, otherwise we'll never get there.
I didn't have my keys. Therefore, I couldn't get in.
Don't forget your passport. Otherwise, they won't let you on the plane.
The tickets aren't expensive. Furthermore, children don't pay.

examples.heading: ① otherwise

items.en: Write it down. Otherwise, you'll forget it.
items.zh: 寫下來。不然你會忘記。

items.en: We need to leave now. Otherwise, we'll be late.
items.zh: 我們現在得出發了。不然會遲到。

items.en: Call me before you come. Otherwise, I might be out.
items.zh: 來之前先打給我。不然我可能不在家。

items.en: Put the milk in the fridge, otherwise it'll go off.
items.zh: 把牛奶放進冰箱，不然會壞掉。

items.en: I'm glad you reminded me. Otherwise, I would have forgotten.
items.zh: 還好你提醒我。不然我就忘了。

items.en: Book the tickets soon. Otherwise, there won't be any left.
items.zh: 早點訂票。不然會賣光。

examples.heading: ② therefore

items.en: The bridge is closed. Therefore, all traffic must use the main road.
items.zh: 橋封閉了。所以所有車輛都必須走主要道路。

items.en: He was ill. Therefore, he couldn't take the exam.
items.zh: 他生病了。因此沒辦法參加考試。

items.en: The airline cancelled our flight. Therefore, we stayed one more night.
items.zh: 航空公司取消了我們的班機。所以我們多住了一晚。

items.en: Many of our staff are ill. Therefore, the shop will close early today.
items.zh: 我們很多員工生病了。因此店今天會提早關門。

items.en: It is therefore important to arrive on time.
items.zh: 因此，準時抵達很重要。

items.en: She had no experience. She therefore found the job difficult at first.
items.zh: 她沒有經驗。所以一開始覺得那份工作很難。

examples.heading: ③ furthermore

items.en: The flat is in a quiet street. Furthermore, it has a big garden.
items.zh: 那間公寓在一條安靜的街上。而且有一個大花園。

items.en: I enjoy my job. Furthermore, my colleagues are very kind.
items.zh: 我喜歡我的工作。而且我的同事人都很好。

items.en: The museum is free. Furthermore, it's open every day.
items.zh: 博物館免費。而且每天開放。

items.en: You will improve your English. Furthermore, you will meet people from many countries.
items.zh: 你的英文會進步。而且你會認識很多國家的人。

items.en: This phone is light. Furthermore, the battery lasts for two days.
items.zh: 這支手機很輕。而且電池可以撐兩天。

items.en: Our town needs a new library. Furthermore, it needs more parks.
items.zh: 我們鎮需要一間新的圖書館。而且需要更多公園。

examples.heading: ④ 在書信裡

items.en: Dear Sir, I am writing to complain about my order. Furthermore, I would like a refund.
items.zh: 敬啟者，我寫信來投訴我的訂單。此外，我希望能退款。

items.en: Please reply by Friday. Otherwise, I will give the room to another guest.
items.zh: 請在星期五前回覆。不然我會把房間給另一位客人。

items.en: I have three years of experience. Therefore, I believe I am right for this job.
items.zh: 我有三年的經驗。因此我相信我適合這份工作。

items.en: The course starts in May. Furthermore, it includes a trip to London.
items.zh: 課程五月開始。此外還包括一趟倫敦之旅。

items.en: The heating doesn't work. Therefore, I would like to change rooms.
items.zh: 暖氣壞了。因此我想換房間。

examples.heading: ⑤ 在說話裡用 otherwise

items.en: Be careful, otherwise you'll fall.
items.zh: 小心點，不然你會跌倒。

items.en: Turn the music down, otherwise the neighbours will complain.
items.zh: 把音樂關小聲，不然鄰居會抱怨。

items.en: Eat something now, otherwise you'll be hungry later.
items.zh: 現在吃點東西，不然你等一下會餓。

items.en: Let's take a taxi, otherwise we'll never get there.
items.zh: 我們搭計程車吧，不然永遠到不了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句

items.en: I didn't have my keys. Therefore, I couldn't get in.
items.zh: 我沒帶鑰匙。所以進不去。

items.en: Don't forget your passport. Otherwise, they won't let you on the plane.
items.zh: 別忘了帶護照。不然他們不會讓你上飛機。

items.en: The tickets aren't expensive. Furthermore, children don't pay.
items.zh: 票不貴。而且兒童免費。

title: Both the players played well.
translation: 兩位選手都打得很好。
name: 情狀副詞片語表示方式
sentences: You did well in the exam.
Did you sleep well?
The team didn't play well yesterday.
My grandmother can't hear very well.
Everything went well at the interview.
She speaks French very well.
He knows the city well.
I don't remember the trip very well.
You explained the problem well.
My little sister can swim very fast.
Don't drive so fast!
My brother works hard every day.
It rained hard all night.
Go straight, then turn left at the bank.
Walk straight down this road.
The dog ran fast across the field.
The nurse cleaned the cut on my arm quickly.
Please speak slowly.
She closed the door quietly.
Read the instructions carefully.
The children waited patiently for the bus.
He answered the question correctly.
We walked home slowly.
The old man smiled kindly at us.
You sing very well.
The time went very quickly.
She drives very carefully.
He ate very slowly.
Can you run fast?
I didn't sleep very well last night.
Does your son behave nicely at school?
They don't play the piano well.

examples.heading: ① 動詞 + well

items.en: You did well in the exam.
items.zh: 你考試考得很好。

items.en: Did you sleep well?
items.zh: 你睡得好嗎？

items.en: The team didn't play well yesterday.
items.zh: 球隊昨天打得不好。

items.en: My grandmother can't hear very well.
items.zh: 我奶奶聽力不太好。

items.en: Everything went well at the interview.
items.zh: 面試一切都很順利。

examples.heading: ② 動詞 + 受詞 + well

items.en: She speaks French very well.
items.zh: 她法文說得很好。

items.en: He knows the city well.
items.zh: 他對這座城市很熟。

items.en: I don't remember the trip very well.
items.zh: 那趟旅行我記得不太清楚。

items.en: You explained the problem well.
items.zh: 你把問題解釋得很清楚。

examples.heading: ③ fast、hard、straight

items.en: My little sister can swim very fast.
items.zh: 我妹妹游得很快。

items.en: Don't drive so fast!
items.zh: 別開那麼快！

items.en: My brother works hard every day.
items.zh: 我哥哥每天都很努力工作。

items.en: It rained hard all night.
items.zh: 雨下了一整夜，下得很大。

items.en: Go straight, then turn left at the bank.
items.zh: 直走，然後在銀行那裡左轉。

items.en: Walk straight down this road.
items.zh: 沿著這條路直走。

items.en: The dog ran fast across the field.
items.zh: 那隻狗飛快地跑過田野。

examples.heading: ④ 形容詞 + -ly

items.en: The nurse cleaned the cut on my arm quickly.
items.zh: 護士很快地清理了我手臂上的傷口。

items.en: Please speak slowly.
items.zh: 請說慢一點。

items.en: She closed the door quietly.
items.zh: 她輕輕地關上門。

items.en: Read the instructions carefully.
items.zh: 仔細看說明。

items.en: The children waited patiently for the bus.
items.zh: 孩子們耐心地等公車。

items.en: He answered the question correctly.
items.zh: 他答對了那個問題。

items.en: We walked home slowly.
items.zh: 我們慢慢走回家。

items.en: The old man smiled kindly at us.
items.zh: 那個老先生親切地對我們微笑。

examples.heading: ⑤ very + 情狀副詞

items.en: You sing very well.
items.zh: 你唱歌唱得很好。

items.en: The time went very quickly.
items.zh: 時間過得很快。

items.en: She drives very carefully.
items.zh: 她開車很小心。

items.en: He ate very slowly.
items.zh: 他吃得很慢。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句和否定句裡的情狀副詞

items.en: Can you run fast?
items.zh: 你跑得快嗎？

items.en: I didn't sleep very well last night.
items.zh: 我昨晚睡得不太好。

items.en: Does your son behave nicely at school?
items.zh: 你兒子在學校乖嗎？

items.en: They don't play the piano well.
items.zh: 他們鋼琴彈得不好。

title: She realizes that he is a very dangerous man and that she should take his warning seriously.
translation: 她發現他是個非常危險的人，她應該認真看待他的警告。
name: 情狀副詞（多種）
sentences: The police took the problem seriously.
My brother is seriously thinking about leaving his job.
You need to think seriously about your future.
She doesn't take anything seriously.
We urgently need more nurses.
I need to speak to you urgently.
The hospital is asking urgently for blood donors.
The roof needs repairing urgently.
He parked his car illegally outside the bank.
They entered the country illegally.
Someone has been using our parking space illegally.
The factory illegally poured waste into the river.
She deliberately ignored my message.
I didn't do it deliberately!
He accidentally locked himself out of the house.
I accidentally sent the email to my boss.
Did you break it accidentally?
Shut the fridge door properly, or the food will go off.
I haven't slept properly for days.
Make sure you cook the chicken properly.
My laptop isn't working properly.
The teacher marks our tests fairly.
The company pays its workers fairly.
Please share the sweets fairly.
She smiled politely and said nothing.
The children listened silently.
He spoke confidently in the interview.
We waited anxiously for the results.
The players celebrated wildly after the goal.
The firefighters got everyone out of the building safely.

examples.heading: ① seriously

items.en: The police took the problem seriously.
items.zh: 警察認真看待這個問題。

items.en: My brother is seriously thinking about leaving his job.
items.zh: 我哥哥在認真考慮辭職。

items.en: You need to think seriously about your future.
items.zh: 你需要認真考慮你的未來。

items.en: She doesn't take anything seriously.
items.zh: 她什麼事都不認真。

examples.heading: ② urgently

items.en: We urgently need more nurses.
items.zh: 我們急需更多護士。

items.en: I need to speak to you urgently.
items.zh: 我有急事要跟你說。

items.en: The hospital is asking urgently for blood donors.
items.zh: 醫院正在緊急徵求捐血者。

items.en: The roof needs repairing urgently.
items.zh: 屋頂急需修理。

examples.heading: ③ illegally

items.en: He parked his car illegally outside the bank.
items.zh: 他把車違規停在銀行外面。

items.en: They entered the country illegally.
items.zh: 他們非法入境那個國家。

items.en: Someone has been using our parking space illegally.
items.zh: 有人一直違規使用我們的停車位。

items.en: The factory illegally poured waste into the river.
items.zh: 那間工廠非法把廢水排進河裡。

examples.heading: ④ deliberately、accidentally

items.en: She deliberately ignored my message.
items.zh: 她故意不理我的訊息。

items.en: I didn't do it deliberately!
items.zh: 我不是故意的！

items.en: He accidentally locked himself out of the house.
items.zh: 他不小心把自己鎖在門外。

items.en: I accidentally sent the email to my boss.
items.zh: 我不小心把電子郵件寄給了我的老闆。

items.en: Did you break it accidentally?
items.zh: 你是不小心弄壞的嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ properly

items.en: Shut the fridge door properly, or the food will go off.
items.zh: 把冰箱門關好，不然食物會壞掉。

items.en: I haven't slept properly for days.
items.zh: 我好幾天沒睡好了。

items.en: Make sure you cook the chicken properly.
items.zh: 雞肉一定要煮熟。

items.en: My laptop isn't working properly.
items.zh: 我的筆電運作不太正常。

examples.heading: ⑥ fairly

items.en: The teacher marks our tests fairly.
items.zh: 老師公平地批改我們的考卷。

items.en: The company pays its workers fairly.
items.zh: 這家公司付給員工合理的薪水。

items.en: Please share the sweets fairly.
items.zh: 糖果請公平分配。

examples.heading: ⑦ 其他情狀副詞

items.en: She smiled politely and said nothing.
items.zh: 她禮貌地笑了笑，什麼也沒說。

items.en: The children listened silently.
items.zh: 孩子們靜靜地聽著。

items.en: He spoke confidently in the interview.
items.zh: 他在面試時說話很有自信。

items.en: We waited anxiously for the results.
items.zh: 我們焦急地等待結果。

items.en: The players celebrated wildly after the goal.
items.zh: 進球後球員們瘋狂慶祝。

items.en: The firefighters got everyone out of the building safely.
items.zh: 消防員把所有人都安全地救出大樓。

title: We go everywhere together.
translation: 我們去哪裡都在一起。
name: 情狀副詞和副詞片語（較多種）
sentences: My brother and I walk to school together.
Let's do the washing up together.
The whole family had dinner together.
My grandfather lives alone now.
She travelled alone across Asia.
He makes friends easily.
You can get there easily by train.
The nurse put the bandage on my knee carefully.
I opened the parcel carefully and slowly.
My mum knits all our jumpers by hand.
We went to the airport by taxi.
Most people pay for their shopping by card now.
Please send it to me by post.
My grandmother still washes her clothes by hand.
He smiled at me in a strange way.
She explained it in a simple way.
Sorry, I can't talk. I'm in a hurry.
They packed their bags in a hurry.
Please handle this box with care.
She opened the door with a smile.
He listened to the news with interest.
The children waited with excitement.
She sings like a bird.
He was shaking like a leaf.
Hold the pen like this.
Don't talk to me like that!
You fold the paper like this, then like this.
Did your daughter go to the cinema alone?
Do you usually go to work by bus?
I can't do it like that.
Why did you leave in such a hurry?

examples.heading: ① together、alone

items.en: My brother and I walk to school together.
items.zh: 我和我哥哥一起走路上學。

items.en: Let's do the washing up together.
items.zh: 我們一起洗碗吧。

items.en: The whole family had dinner together.
items.zh: 全家人一起吃晚餐。

items.en: My grandfather lives alone now.
items.zh: 我爺爺現在一個人住。

items.en: She travelled alone across Asia.
items.zh: 她一個人在亞洲各地旅行。

examples.heading: ② easily、carefully

items.en: He makes friends easily.
items.zh: 他很容易交到朋友。

items.en: You can get there easily by train.
items.zh: 你搭火車很容易就能到那裡。

items.en: The nurse put the bandage on my knee carefully.
items.zh: 護士小心地幫我的膝蓋包上繃帶。

items.en: I opened the parcel carefully and slowly.
items.zh: 我小心又慢慢地拆開包裹。

examples.heading: ③ by + 名詞

items.en: My mum knits all our jumpers by hand.
items.zh: 我媽媽親手織我們所有的毛衣。

items.en: We went to the airport by taxi.
items.zh: 我們搭計程車去機場。

items.en: Most people pay for their shopping by card now.
items.zh: 現在大部分人買東西都刷卡。

items.en: Please send it to me by post.
items.zh: 請用郵寄把它寄給我。

items.en: My grandmother still washes her clothes by hand.
items.zh: 我奶奶還是用手洗衣服。

examples.heading: ④ in a + 形容詞 + way、in a hurry

items.en: He smiled at me in a strange way.
items.zh: 他用奇怪的樣子對我笑。

items.en: She explained it in a simple way.
items.zh: 她用簡單的方式解釋。

items.en: Sorry, I can't talk. I'm in a hurry.
items.zh: 抱歉，我不能聊。我在趕時間。

items.en: They packed their bags in a hurry.
items.zh: 他們匆匆忙忙地收拾行李。

examples.heading: ⑤ with + 名詞

items.en: Please handle this box with care.
items.zh: 請小心搬這個箱子。

items.en: She opened the door with a smile.
items.zh: 她笑著開了門。

items.en: He listened to the news with interest.
items.zh: 他很感興趣地聽新聞。

items.en: The children waited with excitement.
items.zh: 孩子們興奮地等著。

examples.heading: ⑥ like + 名詞、like this

items.en: She sings like a bird.
items.zh: 她唱歌像小鳥一樣好聽。

items.en: He was shaking like a leaf.
items.zh: 他抖得像片葉子一樣。

items.en: Hold the pen like this.
items.zh: 筆要這樣拿。

items.en: Don't talk to me like that!
items.zh: 別用那種口氣跟我說話！

items.en: You fold the paper like this, then like this.
items.zh: 你把紙這樣折，然後再這樣折。

examples.heading: ⑦ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Did your daughter go to the cinema alone?
items.zh: 你女兒是一個人去看電影的嗎？

items.en: Do you usually go to work by bus?
items.zh: 你通常搭公車上班嗎？

items.en: I can't do it like that.
items.zh: 我沒辦法那樣做。

items.en: Why did you leave in such a hurry?
items.zh: 你為什麼走得那麼匆忙？

title: Firstly, I advise you to visit both schools.
translation: 首先，我建議你兩間學校都去看看。
name: 當言談標記的副詞（firstly）
sentences: Firstly, the classes are too big.
Firstly, thank you for your letter.
Firstly, the hotel is too far from the centre.
There are two reasons. Firstly, I don't have time.
Firstly, make a list of what you need.
Secondly, we need better books.
Secondly, the rooms were dirty.
Secondly, it's too expensive for students.
Thirdly, the staff were not very helpful.
Thirdly, you should practise every day.
Finally, I think the speaker did an excellent job.
Finally, the trip will cost less than last year.
Finally, I would like to ask about the price.
Finally, don't forget to switch off the lights.
The café has great coffee. What's more, it's cheap.
He's late every day. What's more, he never says sorry.
The course is online. What's more, you can start any time.
It's a lovely town. What's more, the people are very friendly.
The bike is light. What's more, it folds up.
My boss will talk about selling abroad. Actually, our company wants to open a shop in Spain.
I said Tuesday, but actually the meeting is on Wednesday.
You think I'm angry, but actually I'm just tired.
We thought it was a holiday. Actually, the school was open.
There are three things to remember. Firstly, be on time. Secondly, bring a pen. Finally, switch off your phone.
I chose this school for two reasons. Firstly, it's near my home. Secondly, the teachers are excellent.
Firstly, I want to say sorry. Secondly, I want to explain.
First, open the app. Second, choose your seat. Finally, pay.
The plan has two problems. Firstly, it costs too much. Secondly, it takes too long.
Firstly, the food was cold. What's more, the waiter was rude.
Finally, I'd like to thank my family.

examples.heading: ① firstly

items.en: Firstly, the classes are too big.
items.zh: 首先，班級人數太多了。

items.en: Firstly, thank you for your letter.
items.zh: 首先，謝謝你的來信。

items.en: Firstly, the hotel is too far from the centre.
items.zh: 首先，飯店離市中心太遠了。

items.en: There are two reasons. Firstly, I don't have time.
items.zh: 有兩個原因。第一，我沒有時間。

items.en: Firstly, make a list of what you need.
items.zh: 首先，把你需要的東西列出來。

examples.heading: ② secondly、thirdly

items.en: Secondly, we need better books.
items.zh: 第二，我們需要更好的課本。

items.en: Secondly, the rooms were dirty.
items.zh: 第二，房間很髒。

items.en: Secondly, it's too expensive for students.
items.zh: 第二，這對學生來說太貴了。

items.en: Thirdly, the staff were not very helpful.
items.zh: 第三，員工不太幫得上忙。

items.en: Thirdly, you should practise every day.
items.zh: 第三，你應該每天練習。

examples.heading: ③ finally

items.en: Finally, I think the speaker did an excellent job.
items.zh: 最後，我覺得講者講得很好。

items.en: Finally, the trip will cost less than last year.
items.zh: 最後，這次旅行的費用會比去年少。

items.en: Finally, I would like to ask about the price.
items.zh: 最後，我想問一下價錢。

items.en: Finally, don't forget to switch off the lights.
items.zh: 最後，別忘了關燈。

examples.heading: ④ what's more

items.en: The café has great coffee. What's more, it's cheap.
items.zh: 那家咖啡館的咖啡很好喝。而且很便宜。

items.en: He's late every day. What's more, he never says sorry.
items.zh: 他每天都遲到。而且從來不道歉。

items.en: The course is online. What's more, you can start any time.
items.zh: 這門課在線上。而且隨時都可以開始。

items.en: It's a lovely town. What's more, the people are very friendly.
items.zh: 那是個很可愛的小鎮。而且人都很友善。

items.en: The bike is light. What's more, it folds up.
items.zh: 這台腳踏車很輕。而且可以折起來。

examples.heading: ⑤ actually

items.en: My boss will talk about selling abroad. Actually, our company wants to open a shop in Spain.
items.zh: 我老闆會談到海外銷售。其實我們公司想在西班牙開店。

items.en: I said Tuesday, but actually the meeting is on Wednesday.
items.zh: 我說星期二，不過會議其實是星期三。

items.en: You think I'm angry, but actually I'm just tired.
items.zh: 你以為我在生氣，可是我其實只是累了。

items.en: We thought it was a holiday. Actually, the school was open.
items.zh: 我們以為那天放假。其實學校有上課。

examples.heading: ⑥ 在一段話裡列點

items.en: There are three things to remember. Firstly, be on time. Secondly, bring a pen. Finally, switch off your phone.
items.zh: 有三件事要記住。第一，準時。第二，帶筆。最後，手機關機。

items.en: I chose this school for two reasons. Firstly, it's near my home. Secondly, the teachers are excellent.
items.zh: 我選這間學校有兩個原因。第一，離我家近。第二，老師很棒。

items.en: Firstly, I want to say sorry. Secondly, I want to explain.
items.zh: 首先，我想道歉。第二，我想解釋一下。

items.en: First, open the app. Second, choose your seat. Finally, pay.
items.zh: 首先，打開應用程式。第二，選座位。最後，付款。

items.en: The plan has two problems. Firstly, it costs too much. Secondly, it takes too long.
items.zh: 這個計畫有兩個問題。第一，花費太高。第二，時間太長。

items.en: Firstly, the food was cold. What's more, the waiter was rude.
items.zh: 首先，食物是冷的。而且服務生很沒禮貌。

items.en: Finally, I'd like to thank my family.
items.zh: 最後，我想謝謝我的家人。

title: My girlfriend is here with me.
translation: 我女朋友跟我一起在這裡。
name: here、there 表示地點
sentences: Your coffee is here on the table.
Is your brother here today?
We're here for the job interview.
The bus stop isn't here anymore.
I've been here since nine o'clock.
Come here and look at this.
My family has lived here for ten years.
Can I park here?
Wait here. I'll get the car.
Do you come here often?
I left my umbrella here yesterday.
Is Lisa there? Can I talk to her?
The museum was closed when we were there.
Don't worry. I'll be there at six.
The old cinema isn't there now.
My keys were there a minute ago.
I was born in Kyoto, and I lived there for twenty years.
We go there every summer.
Put the box there, please.
My uncle works at the hospital, and he met my aunt there.
Have you ever been to Paris? I want to go there.
Stay there. I'm coming.
We walked there because it was close.
Your shoes are over there by the door.
Can you see that tall building over there?
Bring the chairs over here.
We're over here, by the window!
It's cold here, but it's warm there.
I don't like it here. Let's go there instead.
Is it raining there? It's sunny here.
We're here now, but our bags are still there.
The food here is really good.
The shops there close at five.
My friends there don't speak English.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + here

items.en: Your coffee is here on the table.
items.zh: 你的咖啡在這裡，在桌上。

items.en: Is your brother here today?
items.zh: 你哥哥今天在這裡嗎？

items.en: We're here for the job interview.
items.zh: 我們是來參加面試的。

items.en: The bus stop isn't here anymore.
items.zh: 公車站已經不在這裡了。

items.en: I've been here since nine o'clock.
items.zh: 我從九點就在這裡了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 動詞 + here

items.en: Come here and look at this.
items.zh: 過來看一下這個。

items.en: My family has lived here for ten years.
items.zh: 我們家在這裡住了十年。

items.en: Can I park here?
items.zh: 我可以在這裡停車嗎？

items.en: Wait here. I'll get the car.
items.zh: 在這裡等。我去開車。

items.en: Do you come here often?
items.zh: 你常來這裡嗎？

items.en: I left my umbrella here yesterday.
items.zh: 我昨天把雨傘忘在這裡了。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + there

items.en: Is Lisa there? Can I talk to her?
items.zh: Lisa 在嗎？我可以跟她說話嗎？

items.en: The museum was closed when we were there.
items.zh: 我們去的時候博物館沒開。

items.en: Don't worry. I'll be there at six.
items.zh: 別擔心。我六點會到。

items.en: The old cinema isn't there now.
items.zh: 那家老戲院現在已經不在那裡了。

items.en: My keys were there a minute ago.
items.zh: 我的鑰匙一分鐘前還在那裡。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + 動詞 + there

items.en: I was born in Kyoto, and I lived there for twenty years.
items.zh: 我在京都出生，在那裡住了二十年。

items.en: We go there every summer.
items.zh: 我們每年夏天都去那裡。

items.en: Put the box there, please.
items.zh: 請把箱子放在那裡。

items.en: My uncle works at the hospital, and he met my aunt there.
items.zh: 我叔叔在醫院工作，他在那裡認識了我嬸嬸。

items.en: Have you ever been to Paris? I want to go there.
items.zh: 你去過巴黎嗎？我想去那裡。

items.en: Stay there. I'm coming.
items.zh: 待在那裡別動。我就來。

items.en: We walked there because it was close.
items.zh: 那裡很近，所以我們走路過去。

examples.heading: ⑤ over here / over there

items.en: Your shoes are over there by the door.
items.zh: 你的鞋子在那邊門旁邊。

items.en: Can you see that tall building over there?
items.zh: 你看得到那邊那棟高樓嗎？

items.en: Bring the chairs over here.
items.zh: 把椅子搬到這邊來。

items.en: We're over here, by the window!
items.zh: 我們在這邊，窗戶旁邊！

examples.heading: ⑥ here 和 there 在同一句

items.en: It's cold here, but it's warm there.
items.zh: 這裡很冷，可是那裡很暖和。

items.en: I don't like it here. Let's go there instead.
items.zh: 我不喜歡這裡。我們改去那裡吧。

items.en: Is it raining there? It's sunny here.
items.zh: 你那邊在下雨嗎？這裡天氣很晴朗。

items.en: We're here now, but our bags are still there.
items.zh: 我們已經到這裡了，可是行李還在那裡。

examples.heading: ⑦ 名詞 + here / there

items.en: The food here is really good.
items.zh: 這裡的東西很好吃。

items.en: The shops there close at five.
items.zh: 那裡的商店五點就關門了。

items.en: My friends there don't speak English.
items.zh: 我在那裡的朋友不會說英文。

title: He went downstairs.
translation: 他下樓去了。
name: 地點副詞（near、upstairs）
sentences: I'll go upstairs and get my jacket.
The kids are playing upstairs.
The people upstairs play loud music every night.
Can you carry this box upstairs?
The hotel guests have breakfast downstairs.
I heard a noise downstairs.
Come downstairs, dinner's ready!
She left her phone downstairs.
Is there a bank nearby?
My cousins live nearby.
We parked the car nearby and walked to the beach.
A nearby hotel had some free rooms.
Don't come near, the dog bites.
Come a bit nearer so I can see you.
The sound of the music got nearer and nearer.
My best friend moved far away.
The mountains look blue from far away.
Don't go too far away from the car.
Is the airport far away?
My brother works abroad.
Have you ever lived abroad?
We usually travel abroad in August.
Many students want to study abroad.
The cat stays inside all winter.
Wait outside, please.
Let's eat outside. It's a lovely evening.
It's warmer inside.
Take your shoes off before you go inside.
We didn't go abroad this year.
Is your office upstairs or downstairs?
I don't want to live far away from my parents.

examples.heading: ① upstairs

items.en: I'll go upstairs and get my jacket.
items.zh: 我上樓拿我的外套。

items.en: The kids are playing upstairs.
items.zh: 孩子們在樓上玩。

items.en: The people upstairs play loud music every night.
items.zh: 樓上的人每天晚上都放很大聲的音樂。

items.en: Can you carry this box upstairs?
items.zh: 你可以把這個箱子搬上樓嗎？

examples.heading: ② downstairs

items.en: The hotel guests have breakfast downstairs.
items.zh: 飯店的客人在樓下吃早餐。

items.en: I heard a noise downstairs.
items.zh: 我聽到樓下有聲音。

items.en: Come downstairs, dinner's ready!
items.zh: 下樓來，晚餐好了！

items.en: She left her phone downstairs.
items.zh: 她把手機留在樓下了。

examples.heading: ③ nearby

items.en: Is there a bank nearby?
items.zh: 附近有銀行嗎？

items.en: My cousins live nearby.
items.zh: 我的表兄弟住在附近。

items.en: We parked the car nearby and walked to the beach.
items.zh: 我們把車停在附近，然後走路去海邊。

items.en: A nearby hotel had some free rooms.
items.zh: 附近一家飯店還有空房。

examples.heading: ④ near

items.en: Don't come near, the dog bites.
items.zh: 別靠近，那隻狗會咬人。

items.en: Come a bit nearer so I can see you.
items.zh: 再靠近一點，讓我看看你。

items.en: The sound of the music got nearer and nearer.
items.zh: 音樂聲越來越近了。

examples.heading: ⑤ far away

items.en: My best friend moved far away.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友搬到很遠的地方去了。

items.en: The mountains look blue from far away.
items.zh: 從遠處看，山是藍色的。

items.en: Don't go too far away from the car.
items.zh: 別離車子太遠。

items.en: Is the airport far away?
items.zh: 機場很遠嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ abroad

items.en: My brother works abroad.
items.zh: 我哥哥在國外工作。

items.en: Have you ever lived abroad?
items.zh: 你住過國外嗎？

items.en: We usually travel abroad in August.
items.zh: 我們通常八月出國旅行。

items.en: Many students want to study abroad.
items.zh: 很多學生想出國念書。

examples.heading: ⑦ outside、inside

items.en: The cat stays inside all winter.
items.zh: 那隻貓整個冬天都待在屋裡。

items.en: Wait outside, please.
items.zh: 請在外面等。

items.en: Let's eat outside. It's a lovely evening.
items.zh: 我們在外面吃吧。今晚天氣很好。

items.en: It's warmer inside.
items.zh: 裡面比較暖和。

items.en: Take your shoes off before you go inside.
items.zh: 進去之前把鞋子脫掉。

examples.heading: ⑧ 否定句和疑問句

items.en: We didn't go abroad this year.
items.zh: 我們今年沒出國。

items.en: Is your office upstairs or downstairs?
items.zh: 你的辦公室在樓上還是樓下？

items.en: I don't want to live far away from my parents.
items.zh: 我不想住得離爸媽太遠。

title: First we had dinner in a very expensive restaurant, and then we went to a disco.
translation: 我們先在一家很貴的餐廳吃晚餐，然後去了一家迪斯可舞廳。
name: first、then、after that 表示順序
sentences: First I had a shower, and then I got dressed.
First we'll go to the bank, and then we'll go to the post office.
First she called her mum, and then she called the police.
First you turn on the computer, and then you type your password.
We had a picnic in the park, then we went home.
He opened the letter and then smiled.
Let's eat first, then we can talk about the plan.
Wait for the green light, then cross the road.
Have a rest, and then we'll start again.
We visited the castle. After that, we went for a walk by the river.
I worked in a hotel for two years. After that, I moved to London.
The teacher checked our homework. After that, we played a game.
We'll have dinner at seven. After that, we can watch a film.
My dad didn't say anything. After that, he never mentioned it again.
Next, put the eggs in the bowl.
What should we do next?
First, fill in this form. Next, sign your name at the bottom.
Finally, close the lid and press the green button.
We went to three shops, and finally we found the right shoes.
First, they had a meeting. Then they had lunch. Finally, they went back to the office.
Finally, I want to thank my parents.
First, boil some water.
Then put the tea bag in the cup.
First, take the old battery out. Then put the new one in.
Turn left at the corner, then go straight on.
Mix the flour and the butter first. After that, add the milk.
In the morning we went to the beach. Then we had lunch at a little café.
We played football for an hour. After that, we were very tired.
First the lights went out, and then the music stopped.
She finished her exams, and then she went on holiday.
They got married in June, and after that they moved to Spain.
First we waited for an hour, then the doctor saw us.

examples.heading: ① First ..., and then ...

items.en: First I had a shower, and then I got dressed.
items.zh: 我先洗了個澡，然後換好衣服。

items.en: First we'll go to the bank, and then we'll go to the post office.
items.zh: 我們先去銀行，再去郵局。

items.en: First she called her mum, and then she called the police.
items.zh: 她先打電話給她媽媽，然後才報警。

items.en: First you turn on the computer, and then you type your password.
items.zh: 你先開電腦，然後輸入密碼。

examples.heading: ② then 接下一件事

items.en: We had a picnic in the park, then we went home.
items.zh: 我們在公園野餐，然後就回家了。

items.en: He opened the letter and then smiled.
items.zh: 他打開信，然後笑了。

items.en: Let's eat first, then we can talk about the plan.
items.zh: 我們先吃飯，然後再談計畫。

items.en: Wait for the green light, then cross the road.
items.zh: 等綠燈亮了再過馬路。

items.en: Have a rest, and then we'll start again.
items.zh: 休息一下，然後我們再開始。

examples.heading: ③ After that, ...

items.en: We visited the castle. After that, we went for a walk by the river.
items.zh: 我們參觀了城堡。之後去河邊散步。

items.en: I worked in a hotel for two years. After that, I moved to London.
items.zh: 我在一家飯店工作了兩年。之後搬到倫敦。

items.en: The teacher checked our homework. After that, we played a game.
items.zh: 老師檢查了我們的作業。之後我們玩了一個遊戲。

items.en: We'll have dinner at seven. After that, we can watch a film.
items.zh: 我們七點吃晚餐。之後可以看部電影。

items.en: My dad didn't say anything. After that, he never mentioned it again.
items.zh: 我爸爸什麼都沒說。之後他再也沒提過這件事。

examples.heading: ④ next 接下一步

items.en: Next, put the eggs in the bowl.
items.zh: 接下來把蛋放進碗裡。

items.en: What should we do next?
items.zh: 我們接下來要做什麼？

items.en: First, fill in this form. Next, sign your name at the bottom.
items.zh: 先填這張表。接下來在下面簽名。

examples.heading: ⑤ finally 接最後一步

items.en: Finally, close the lid and press the green button.
items.zh: 最後蓋上蓋子，按下綠色的按鈕。

items.en: We went to three shops, and finally we found the right shoes.
items.zh: 我們去了三家店，最後找到了合適的鞋子。

items.en: First, they had a meeting. Then they had lunch. Finally, they went back to the office.
items.zh: 他們先開了個會。然後吃午餐。最後回到辦公室。

items.en: Finally, I want to thank my parents.
items.zh: 最後，我想謝謝我的父母。

examples.heading: ⑥ 排步驟的祈使句

items.en: First, boil some water.
items.zh: 先燒一些水。

items.en: Then put the tea bag in the cup.
items.zh: 然後把茶包放進杯子裡。

items.en: First, take the old battery out. Then put the new one in.
items.zh: 先把舊電池拿出來。然後把新的放進去。

items.en: Turn left at the corner, then go straight on.
items.zh: 在轉角左轉，然後直走。

items.en: Mix the flour and the butter first. After that, add the milk.
items.zh: 先把麵粉和奶油拌在一起。之後加牛奶。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說一天裡發生的事

items.en: In the morning we went to the beach. Then we had lunch at a little café.
items.zh: 早上我們去了海邊。然後在一家小咖啡館吃午餐。

items.en: We played football for an hour. After that, we were very tired.
items.zh: 我們踢了一個小時的足球。之後大家都很累。

items.en: First the lights went out, and then the music stopped.
items.zh: 先是燈熄了，然後音樂停了。

items.en: She finished her exams, and then she went on holiday.
items.zh: 她考完試，然後就去度假了。

items.en: They got married in June, and after that they moved to Spain.
items.zh: 他們在六月結婚，之後搬到西班牙。

items.en: First we waited for an hour, then the doctor saw us.
items.zh: 我們先等了一個小時，然後醫生才幫我們看診。

title: Unfortunately, my team lost.
translation: 可惜我們隊輸了。
name: actually、unfortunately 表示態度
sentences: Unfortunately, it rained all weekend.
Unfortunately, I can't come to your party.
Unfortunately, the tickets were sold out.
We wanted to see the castle, but unfortunately it was closed.
My grandfather is unfortunately not very well.
Unfortunately, she didn't get the job.
Actually, I don't like chocolate very much.
He looks young, but he's actually forty.
I actually enjoyed the film.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
The new teacher was actually really friendly.
"Is this your car?" "Actually, it's my sister's."
Did you actually see the accident?
Of course, I'll help you with your homework.
Of course, everyone wants to win.
"Do you remember me?" "Of course I do!"
"Can I sit here?" "Yes, of course."
We'll invite your parents, of course.
Of course it's cold. It's January!
"Is the museum free?" "Of course not."
The hotel was actually very nice.
I can't actually remember her name.
She actually lives next door to my aunt.
We have unfortunately lost the key.
They will of course need a map.
Actually, we met last year.
Unfortunately, the bus didn't come.
Of course, you can bring your dog.
Actually, I've never been to Paris.
Unfortunately, my brother broke his leg.
Of course, the food was delicious.

examples.heading: ① unfortunately

items.en: Unfortunately, it rained all weekend.
items.zh: 可惜整個週末都在下雨。

items.en: Unfortunately, I can't come to your party.
items.zh: 很可惜，我不能去你的派對。

items.en: Unfortunately, the tickets were sold out.
items.zh: 很可惜，票都賣完了。

items.en: We wanted to see the castle, but unfortunately it was closed.
items.zh: 我們想看那座城堡，可惜它沒開。

items.en: My grandfather is unfortunately not very well.
items.zh: 可惜我爺爺身體不太好。

items.en: Unfortunately, she didn't get the job.
items.zh: 可惜她沒得到那份工作。

examples.heading: ② actually

items.en: Actually, I don't like chocolate very much.
items.zh: 其實我不太喜歡巧克力。

items.en: He looks young, but he's actually forty.
items.zh: 他看起來很年輕，其實已經四十歲了。

items.en: I actually enjoyed the film.
items.zh: 其實我挺喜歡那部電影的。

items.en: Actually, I've changed my mind.
items.zh: 其實我改變主意了。

items.en: The new teacher was actually really friendly.
items.zh: 新老師其實很友善。

items.en: "Is this your car?" "Actually, it's my sister's."
items.zh: 這是你的車嗎？其實是我姊姊的。

items.en: Did you actually see the accident?
items.zh: 你真的看到那場意外了嗎？

examples.heading: ③ of course

items.en: Of course, I'll help you with your homework.
items.zh: 我當然會幫你寫功課。

items.en: Of course, everyone wants to win.
items.zh: 當然，每個人都想贏。

items.en: "Do you remember me?" "Of course I do!"
items.zh: 你記得我嗎？當然記得！

items.en: "Can I sit here?" "Yes, of course."
items.zh: 我可以坐這裡嗎？當然可以。

items.en: We'll invite your parents, of course.
items.zh: 我們當然會邀請你爸媽。

items.en: Of course it's cold. It's January!
items.zh: 當然冷啊。現在是一月！

items.en: "Is the museum free?" "Of course not."
items.zh: 博物館免費嗎？當然不是。

examples.heading: ④ 放在 be、助動詞後面或一般動詞前面

items.en: The hotel was actually very nice.
items.zh: 那家飯店其實很不錯。

items.en: I can't actually remember her name.
items.zh: 我其實想不起她的名字。

items.en: She actually lives next door to my aunt.
items.zh: 她其實就住在我阿姨家隔壁。

items.en: We have unfortunately lost the key.
items.zh: 很可惜，我們把鑰匙弄丟了。

items.en: They will of course need a map.
items.zh: 他們當然需要一張地圖。

examples.heading: ⑤ 放在句首

items.en: Actually, we met last year.
items.zh: 其實我們去年見過面。

items.en: Unfortunately, the bus didn't come.
items.zh: 可惜公車沒來。

items.en: Of course, you can bring your dog.
items.zh: 你當然可以帶你的狗來。

items.en: Actually, I've never been to Paris.
items.zh: 其實我從來沒去過巴黎。

items.en: Unfortunately, my brother broke his leg.
items.zh: 很不幸，我哥哥摔斷了腿。

items.en: Of course, the food was delicious.
items.zh: 當然，食物很好吃。

title: I am completely sure.
translation: 我完全確定。
name: 態度副詞（較多種）
sentences: The car hit a tree, but luckily nobody inside was hurt.
We missed the bus. Luckily, my dad was driving past.
Luckily, I had an umbrella with me.
I left my phone on the train, but luckily a kind woman handed it in.
Sadly, the old cinema closed last year.
I don't watch much TV. Sadly, I don't have time.
Sadly, our dog died last month.
Our holiday in Greece was sadly too short.
Hopefully, I'll get the job.
The parcel will hopefully arrive tomorrow.
Hopefully, we'll see you again soon.
Hopefully, the rain will stop before the match.
Obviously, you need a passport to travel abroad.
He was obviously very tired.
The baker clearly enjoys talking to his customers.
Clearly, the school needs a bigger car park.
The driver clearly didn't see the red light.
Honestly, I didn't enjoy the second half of the film.
I honestly don't know where he is.
Basically, the job is answering the phone.
Basically, the club is for anyone who likes walking.
It's basically a small hotel with a restaurant.
Surely you remember her!
Surely the shops are open on Saturday.
Surely they won't charge us for water.
You're not leaving already, surely?
I completely forgot about the meeting.
The room was completely empty.
I'm completely lost. Can you help me?
My grandmother's cake recipe is completely different from mine.

examples.heading: ① luckily

items.en: The car hit a tree, but luckily nobody inside was hurt.
items.zh: 車子撞到樹，不過幸好車裡沒有人受傷。

items.en: We missed the bus. Luckily, my dad was driving past.
items.zh: 我們錯過了公車。幸好我爸爸剛好開車經過。

items.en: Luckily, I had an umbrella with me.
items.zh: 幸好我身上帶了傘。

items.en: I left my phone on the train, but luckily a kind woman handed it in.
items.zh: 我把手機忘在火車上，不過幸好一位好心的女士把它交了出來。

examples.heading: ② sadly

items.en: Sadly, the old cinema closed last year.
items.zh: 很可惜，那家老電影院去年關了。

items.en: I don't watch much TV. Sadly, I don't have time.
items.zh: 我不常看電視。可惜我沒時間。

items.en: Sadly, our dog died last month.
items.zh: 很難過，我們的狗上個月死了。

items.en: Our holiday in Greece was sadly too short.
items.zh: 很可惜，我們在希臘的假期太短了。

examples.heading: ③ hopefully

items.en: Hopefully, I'll get the job.
items.zh: 希望我能得到那份工作。

items.en: The parcel will hopefully arrive tomorrow.
items.zh: 包裹希望明天會到。

items.en: Hopefully, we'll see you again soon.
items.zh: 希望我們很快能再見到你。

items.en: Hopefully, the rain will stop before the match.
items.zh: 希望比賽前雨會停。

examples.heading: ④ obviously、clearly

items.en: Obviously, you need a passport to travel abroad.
items.zh: 出國當然需要護照。

items.en: He was obviously very tired.
items.zh: 他顯然很累了。

items.en: The baker clearly enjoys talking to his customers.
items.zh: 那個麵包師傅顯然很喜歡跟顧客聊天。

items.en: Clearly, the school needs a bigger car park.
items.zh: 很明顯，學校需要一個更大的停車場。

items.en: The driver clearly didn't see the red light.
items.zh: 司機顯然沒看到紅燈。

examples.heading: ⑤ honestly、basically

items.en: Honestly, I didn't enjoy the second half of the film.
items.zh: 老實說，我不喜歡那部電影的下半段。

items.en: I honestly don't know where he is.
items.zh: 我真的不知道他在哪裡。

items.en: Basically, the job is answering the phone.
items.zh: 基本上，這份工作就是接電話。

items.en: Basically, the club is for anyone who likes walking.
items.zh: 簡單地說，這個社團是給喜歡健行的人參加的。

items.en: It's basically a small hotel with a restaurant.
items.zh: 那基本上就是一家附設餐廳的小旅館。

examples.heading: ⑥ surely

items.en: Surely you remember her!
items.zh: 你總不會不記得她吧！

items.en: Surely the shops are open on Saturday.
items.zh: 商店星期六應該有開吧。

items.en: Surely they won't charge us for water.
items.zh: 他們總不會連水都跟我們收錢吧。

items.en: You're not leaving already, surely?
items.zh: 你不會現在就要走了吧？

examples.heading: ⑦ completely

items.en: I completely forgot about the meeting.
items.zh: 我完全忘了開會的事。

items.en: The room was completely empty.
items.zh: 房間完全是空的。

items.en: I'm completely lost. Can you help me?
items.zh: 我完全迷路了。你可以幫我嗎？

items.en: My grandmother's cake recipe is completely different from mine.
items.zh: 我奶奶的蛋糕食譜跟我的完全不一樣。

title: Obviously, everybody has the right to go on strike.
translation: 顯然，每個人都有罷工的權利。
name: 態度副詞表示態度（較多種）
sentences: Apparently, the restaurant is closing next month.
Apparently, he's moving to Australia.
She was apparently very angry about the decision.
Apparently, it's going to snow tomorrow.
Naturally, I chose the second option.
Naturally, my parents were worried when I didn't call.
She was naturally upset about losing her job.
Surprisingly, nobody complained about the price.
Surprisingly, my grandfather enjoyed the rock concert.
The old car was surprisingly fast.
Frankly, I don't care what he thinks.
Frankly, the food was terrible.
Quite frankly, you should apologise.
Admittedly, I made a few mistakes, but I learned a lot.
Admittedly, the flat is small, but it's in a great location.
The plan is admittedly risky, but it's our best chance.
Inevitably, the price of petrol went up again.
Inevitably, there were some problems at the start.
Young children inevitably make a mess when they eat.
Wisely, she saved some money for emergencies.
He wisely decided not to argue.
I simply don't have enough time.
It's simply too expensive for us.
I truly believe you can do it.
It was a truly amazing concert.
Luckily for me, I stayed with a very kind family.
Fortunately for us, the rain stopped before the match.
Unfortunately for him, the shop had already closed.
Luckily for the passengers, nobody was injured.
Sadly for the team, their best player was ill.

examples.heading: ① apparently

items.en: Apparently, the restaurant is closing next month.
items.zh: 聽說那家餐廳下個月要關了。

items.en: Apparently, he's moving to Australia.
items.zh: 聽說他要搬去澳洲。

items.en: She was apparently very angry about the decision.
items.zh: 她看起來對那個決定很生氣。

items.en: Apparently, it's going to snow tomorrow.
items.zh: 聽說明天會下雪。

examples.heading: ② naturally

items.en: Naturally, I chose the second option.
items.zh: 我當然選了第二個選項。

items.en: Naturally, my parents were worried when I didn't call.
items.zh: 我沒打電話，我爸媽當然很擔心。

items.en: She was naturally upset about losing her job.
items.zh: 她丟了工作，當然很難過。

examples.heading: ③ surprisingly

items.en: Surprisingly, nobody complained about the price.
items.zh: 出乎意料地，沒有人抱怨價格。

items.en: Surprisingly, my grandfather enjoyed the rock concert.
items.zh: 沒想到我爺爺很喜歡那場搖滾演唱會。

items.en: The old car was surprisingly fast.
items.zh: 那輛舊車快得出乎意料。

examples.heading: ④ frankly

items.en: Frankly, I don't care what he thinks.
items.zh: 坦白說，我不在乎他怎麼想。

items.en: Frankly, the food was terrible.
items.zh: 坦白說，食物糟透了。

items.en: Quite frankly, you should apologise.
items.zh: 坦白說，你應該道歉。

examples.heading: ⑤ admittedly

items.en: Admittedly, I made a few mistakes, but I learned a lot.
items.zh: 我承認我犯了一些錯，不過我學到很多。

items.en: Admittedly, the flat is small, but it's in a great location.
items.zh: 不可否認，公寓很小，不過地點很好。

items.en: The plan is admittedly risky, but it's our best chance.
items.zh: 這個計畫確實有風險，不過這是我們最好的機會。

examples.heading: ⑥ inevitably

items.en: Inevitably, the price of petrol went up again.
items.zh: 不可避免地，油價又漲了。

items.en: Inevitably, there were some problems at the start.
items.zh: 一開始不可避免地出現了一些問題。

items.en: Young children inevitably make a mess when they eat.
items.zh: 小小孩吃東西難免會弄得亂七八糟。

examples.heading: ⑦ wisely、simply、truly

items.en: Wisely, she saved some money for emergencies.
items.zh: 她很明智地存了一些錢以備不時之需。

items.en: He wisely decided not to argue.
items.zh: 他很明智地決定不爭吵。

items.en: I simply don't have enough time.
items.zh: 我就是沒有足夠的時間。

items.en: It's simply too expensive for us.
items.zh: 那對我們來說根本太貴了。

items.en: I truly believe you can do it.
items.zh: 我真心相信你做得到。

items.en: It was a truly amazing concert.
items.zh: 那是一場真正精彩的演唱會。

examples.heading: ⑧ 態度副詞 + for + 受詞

items.en: Luckily for me, I stayed with a very kind family.
items.zh: 我很幸運，住在一個很親切的家庭裡。

items.en: Fortunately for us, the rain stopped before the match.
items.zh: 我們很幸運，比賽前雨停了。

items.en: Unfortunately for him, the shop had already closed.
items.zh: 他運氣不好，店已經關了。

items.en: Luckily for the passengers, nobody was injured.
items.zh: 乘客們很幸運，沒有人受傷。

items.en: Sadly for the team, their best player was ill.
items.zh: 對那支隊伍來說很不幸，他們最好的球員生病了。

title: See you soon.
translation: 回頭見。
name: soon 用在 See you soon 等結尾語
sentences: Thanks for coming. See you soon.
Bye, Mum! See you soon!
Have a safe trip home. See you soon.
Say hi to your parents. See you soon.
It was great to catch up. See you soon.
The party starts at eight. See you soon!
I'll be there in ten minutes. See you soon.
Good luck with the move, and see you soon.
I'll see you soon, OK?
It was nice to meet you. See you again soon.
We had a lovely time. See you again soon!
Don't cry. I'll see you again soon.
Only two more days! See you very soon.
The tickets are booked. See you very soon!
I heard you broke your arm. Get well soon!
Get well soon, Grandpa.
Sorry to hear about your flu. Get well soon.
Stay in bed and get well soon.
We all miss you at work. Get well soon!
Rest up and get well soon.
I have to go now. Talk to you soon.
Thanks for the call. Talk to you soon.
I'll send you the details tonight. Speak to you soon.
Let me check with my boss. Speak to you soon.
OK, talk to you soon. Bye!
Thanks again for dinner. Hope to see you soon.
Everyone here says hello. Hope to see you soon!
We hope to see you soon.
I miss you a lot. Write soon!
Tell me all about your new school. Write soon.
Please write soon and send some photos.

examples.heading: ① See you soon.

items.en: Thanks for coming. See you soon.
items.zh: 謝謝你來。回頭見。

items.en: Bye, Mum! See you soon!
items.zh: 媽，再見！回頭見！

items.en: Have a safe trip home. See you soon.
items.zh: 回家路上小心。回頭見。

items.en: Say hi to your parents. See you soon.
items.zh: 幫我跟你爸媽問好。回頭見。

items.en: It was great to catch up. See you soon.
items.zh: 很高興跟你聊近況。回頭見。

items.en: The party starts at eight. See you soon!
items.zh: 派對八點開始。待會見！

items.en: I'll be there in ten minutes. See you soon.
items.zh: 我十分鐘後到。待會見。

items.en: Good luck with the move, and see you soon.
items.zh: 搬家順利，回頭見。

items.en: I'll see you soon, OK?
items.zh: 我們很快就會見面，好嗎？

examples.heading: ② See you again soon. / See you very soon.

items.en: It was nice to meet you. See you again soon.
items.zh: 很高興認識你。希望很快再見。

items.en: We had a lovely time. See you again soon!
items.zh: 我們玩得很開心。下次再見！

items.en: Don't cry. I'll see you again soon.
items.zh: 別哭。我很快就會再來看你。
