items.en: Only two more days! See you very soon.
items.zh: 只剩兩天了！很快就見面了。

items.en: The tickets are booked. See you very soon!
items.zh: 票訂好了。很快就見面了！

examples.heading: ③ Get well soon.

items.en: I heard you broke your arm. Get well soon!
items.zh: 聽說你手臂骨折了。早日康復！

items.en: Get well soon, Grandpa.
items.zh: 爺爺，祝你早日康復。

items.en: Sorry to hear about your flu. Get well soon.
items.zh: 聽說你得了流感，真遺憾。早日康復。

items.en: Stay in bed and get well soon.
items.zh: 好好躺在床上休息，早日康復。

items.en: We all miss you at work. Get well soon!
items.zh: 公司的大家都很想你。早日康復！

items.en: Rest up and get well soon.
items.zh: 好好休息，早日康復。

examples.heading: ④ Talk to you soon. / Speak to you soon.

items.en: I have to go now. Talk to you soon.
items.zh: 我得掛了。再聊。

items.en: Thanks for the call. Talk to you soon.
items.zh: 謝謝你打來。再聊。

items.en: I'll send you the details tonight. Speak to you soon.
items.zh: 我今晚把細節寄給你。再聯絡。

items.en: Let me check with my boss. Speak to you soon.
items.zh: 我問一下我老闆。再聯絡。

items.en: OK, talk to you soon. Bye!
items.zh: 好，再聊。拜拜！

examples.heading: ⑤ Hope to see you soon.

items.en: Thanks again for dinner. Hope to see you soon.
items.zh: 再次謝謝你的晚餐。希望很快能再見到你。

items.en: Everyone here says hello. Hope to see you soon!
items.zh: 這裡大家都向你問好。希望很快見到你！

items.en: We hope to see you soon.
items.zh: 我們希望很快見到你。

examples.heading: ⑥ Write soon.

items.en: I miss you a lot. Write soon!
items.zh: 我很想你。快點回信！

items.en: Tell me all about your new school. Write soon.
items.zh: 跟我說說你新學校的事。快點回信。

items.en: Please write soon and send some photos.
items.zh: 請快點回信，再寄幾張照片來。

title: The bus will arrive shortly.
translation: 公車馬上就到了。
name: 時間副詞（多種）
sentences: Mr Brown will be with you shortly.
We'll be landing shortly.
She left shortly after midnight.
I'll reply to your email shortly.
He fell asleep instantly.
I instantly liked her.
The medicine works almost instantly.
The photos appear instantly on your phone.
She previously worked as a teacher.
I had previously met him in Paris.
The building was previously a school.
As I previously mentioned, the price includes breakfast.
Let me know beforehand if you can't come.
I always check the weather beforehand.
We had a drink beforehand and then went to the theatre.
If you need help, please call us beforehand.
Thanks in advance for your help with the move.
We booked our tickets two months in advance.
You need to pay for the course in advance.
Please tell us in advance if you need a vegetarian meal.
They moved to Canada permanently.
The accident damaged his eyes permanently.
This road is temporarily closed because of the floods.
I'm temporarily living with my parents.
Will you live here permanently, or only for a year?
The two phones rang simultaneously.
It's hard to listen and write simultaneously.
The film opens simultaneously in London and New York.
Everyone started talking simultaneously.
You can't watch two programmes simultaneously.

examples.heading: ① shortly

items.en: Mr Brown will be with you shortly.
items.zh: 布朗先生很快就會來招呼你。

items.en: We'll be landing shortly.
items.zh: 我們很快就要降落了。

items.en: She left shortly after midnight.
items.zh: 她午夜過後不久就離開了。

items.en: I'll reply to your email shortly.
items.zh: 我會盡快回覆你的電子郵件。

examples.heading: ② instantly

items.en: He fell asleep instantly.
items.zh: 他一下子就睡著了。

items.en: I instantly liked her.
items.zh: 我一見到她就喜歡她了。

items.en: The medicine works almost instantly.
items.zh: 這個藥幾乎馬上就見效。

items.en: The photos appear instantly on your phone.
items.zh: 照片馬上就會出現在你的手機上。

examples.heading: ③ previously

items.en: She previously worked as a teacher.
items.zh: 她以前當過老師。

items.en: I had previously met him in Paris.
items.zh: 我之前在巴黎見過他。

items.en: The building was previously a school.
items.zh: 這棟建築以前是一所學校。

items.en: As I previously mentioned, the price includes breakfast.
items.zh: 如同我之前提過的，價格含早餐。

examples.heading: ④ beforehand

items.en: Let me know beforehand if you can't come.
items.zh: 你如果不能來，先跟我說一聲。

items.en: I always check the weather beforehand.
items.zh: 我總是事先查天氣。

items.en: We had a drink beforehand and then went to the theatre.
items.zh: 我們先喝了一杯，然後去看戲。

items.en: If you need help, please call us beforehand.
items.zh: 如果你需要協助，請事先打電話給我們。

examples.heading: ⑤ in advance

items.en: Thanks in advance for your help with the move.
items.zh: 搬家的事先謝謝你幫忙。

items.en: We booked our tickets two months in advance.
items.zh: 我們提前兩個月訂了票。

items.en: You need to pay for the course in advance.
items.zh: 這門課要預先付費。

items.en: Please tell us in advance if you need a vegetarian meal.
items.zh: 如果你需要素食餐，請提前告訴我們。

examples.heading: ⑥ permanently、temporarily

items.en: They moved to Canada permanently.
items.zh: 他們永久移居加拿大了。

items.en: The accident damaged his eyes permanently.
items.zh: 那場意外讓他的眼睛受到永久的傷害。

items.en: This road is temporarily closed because of the floods.
items.zh: 這條路因為淹水暫時封閉。

items.en: I'm temporarily living with my parents.
items.zh: 我暫時跟我爸媽住。

items.en: Will you live here permanently, or only for a year?
items.zh: 你會一直住在這裡，還是只住一年？

examples.heading: ⑦ simultaneously

items.en: The two phones rang simultaneously.
items.zh: 兩支電話同時響了。

items.en: It's hard to listen and write simultaneously.
items.zh: 同時聽和寫很難。

items.en: The film opens simultaneously in London and New York.
items.zh: 那部電影在倫敦和紐約同時上映。

items.en: Everyone started talking simultaneously.
items.zh: 大家同時開始講話。

items.en: You can't watch two programmes simultaneously.
items.zh: 你不能同時看兩個節目。

title: I immediately called her to see if everything was OK.
translation: 我馬上打給她，看看是不是一切都好。
name: 時間副詞（較多種）
sentences: My sister got married recently.
I've recently started a new job.
Have you seen Peter recently?
The shop on the corner closed recently.
We recently moved to a quieter area.
I haven't slept well lately.
Have you been to the gym lately?
She's been very busy lately.
It's rained a lot lately.
The doctor came immediately.
Please reply to this email immediately.
When the alarm rang, we immediately left the building.
He recognised me immediately.
Call me immediately if you hear anything.
I'm busy now. I'll read your report later this afternoon.
I'll finish the washing up later.
Two days later, the parcel arrived.
The rain stopped, and later the sun came out.
We went to the concert and had a drink afterwards.
Afterwards, I felt much better.
The film was long, and afterwards everyone was tired.
I'm going to the dentist at three. I'll meet you afterwards.
We waited for an hour, and eventually the bus came.
He eventually found his keys in his coat pocket.
After many tries, she eventually passed her driving test.
The two countries eventually signed the agreement.
Nowadays, many people work from home.
Kids nowadays spend a lot of time online.
Nowadays I hardly ever watch TV.
Food is much more expensive nowadays.

examples.heading: ① recently

items.en: My sister got married recently.
items.zh: 我姊姊最近結婚了。

items.en: I've recently started a new job.
items.zh: 我最近開始做新工作。

items.en: Have you seen Peter recently?
items.zh: 你最近有見到彼得嗎？

items.en: The shop on the corner closed recently.
items.zh: 轉角那家店最近關了。

items.en: We recently moved to a quieter area.
items.zh: 我們最近搬到一個比較安靜的地方。

examples.heading: ② lately

items.en: I haven't slept well lately.
items.zh: 我最近睡得不好。

items.en: Have you been to the gym lately?
items.zh: 你最近有去健身房嗎？

items.en: She's been very busy lately.
items.zh: 她最近很忙。

items.en: It's rained a lot lately.
items.zh: 最近常下雨。

examples.heading: ③ immediately

items.en: The doctor came immediately.
items.zh: 醫生馬上就來了。

items.en: Please reply to this email immediately.
items.zh: 請馬上回覆這封電子郵件。

items.en: When the alarm rang, we immediately left the building.
items.zh: 警報一響，我們馬上就離開大樓。

items.en: He recognised me immediately.
items.zh: 他一眼就認出我了。

items.en: Call me immediately if you hear anything.
items.zh: 你一聽到消息就馬上打給我。

examples.heading: ④ later

items.en: I'm busy now. I'll read your report later this afternoon.
items.zh: 我現在很忙。今天下午晚一點再看你的報告。

items.en: I'll finish the washing up later.
items.zh: 我晚一點再洗碗。

items.en: Two days later, the parcel arrived.
items.zh: 兩天後，包裹到了。

items.en: The rain stopped, and later the sun came out.
items.zh: 雨停了，後來太陽出來了。

examples.heading: ⑤ afterwards

items.en: We went to the concert and had a drink afterwards.
items.zh: 我們去聽演唱會，之後去喝了一杯。

items.en: Afterwards, I felt much better.
items.zh: 後來我覺得好多了。

items.en: The film was long, and afterwards everyone was tired.
items.zh: 電影很長，看完之後大家都累了。

items.en: I'm going to the dentist at three. I'll meet you afterwards.
items.zh: 我三點要去看牙醫。看完再跟你碰面。

examples.heading: ⑥ eventually

items.en: We waited for an hour, and eventually the bus came.
items.zh: 我們等了一個小時，公車終於來了。

items.en: He eventually found his keys in his coat pocket.
items.zh: 他最後在外套口袋裡找到了鑰匙。

items.en: After many tries, she eventually passed her driving test.
items.zh: 試了很多次之後，她終於考過駕照了。

items.en: The two countries eventually signed the agreement.
items.zh: 兩國最後簽了協議。

examples.heading: ⑦ nowadays

items.en: Nowadays, many people work from home.
items.zh: 現在很多人在家工作。

items.en: Kids nowadays spend a lot of time online.
items.zh: 現在的小孩花很多時間上網。

items.en: Nowadays I hardly ever watch TV.
items.zh: 現在我幾乎不看電視。

items.en: Food is much more expensive nowadays.
items.zh: 現在的食物貴多了。

title: He's a very good man.
translation: 他是個很好的人。
name: very 加強形容詞的語氣
sentences: She's a very good cook.
Monday was a very long day for me.
We stayed in a very old hotel.
That's a very nice jacket.
He has a very small car.
This is a very useful app.
I'm very hungry.
The test was very easy.
My grandparents are very kind.
Is the water very cold?
The streets were very quiet last night.
Your English is very good.
This chair isn't very comfortable.
The shop is very busy at weekends.
You look very happy today.
I feel very cold.
The new teacher seems very nice.
The house looked very empty without the furniture.
She felt very nervous before the interview.
The roads seem very busy today.
They have very big dogs.
We had very good weather in Spain.
These are very expensive shoes.
My aunt makes very sweet tea.
He gives very clear answers.
There are very tall trees in the park.
The room wasn't very clean.
I'm not very good at maths.
The museum isn't very far from here.
It's not a very big town.
My brother isn't very tall.

examples.heading: ① a / an + very + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: She's a very good cook.
items.zh: 她很會做菜。

items.en: Monday was a very long day for me.
items.zh: 星期一對我來說是很漫長的一天。

items.en: We stayed in a very old hotel.
items.zh: 我們住在一家很老的旅館。

items.en: That's a very nice jacket.
items.zh: 那件夾克很好看。

items.en: He has a very small car.
items.zh: 他有一台很小的車。

items.en: This is a very useful app.
items.zh: 這是一個很好用的 app。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + very + 形容詞

items.en: I'm very hungry.
items.zh: 我很餓。

items.en: The test was very easy.
items.zh: 那次考試很簡單。

items.en: My grandparents are very kind.
items.zh: 我的爺爺奶奶人很好。

items.en: Is the water very cold?
items.zh: 水很冷嗎？

items.en: The streets were very quiet last night.
items.zh: 昨晚街上很安靜。

items.en: Your English is very good.
items.zh: 你的英文很好。

items.en: This chair isn't very comfortable.
items.zh: 這張椅子不太舒服。

items.en: The shop is very busy at weekends.
items.zh: 這家店週末很忙。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + look / feel / seem + very + 形容詞

items.en: You look very happy today.
items.zh: 你今天看起來很開心。

items.en: I feel very cold.
items.zh: 我覺得很冷。

items.en: The new teacher seems very nice.
items.zh: 新老師看起來人很好。

items.en: The house looked very empty without the furniture.
items.zh: 沒有家具，房子看起來很空。

items.en: She felt very nervous before the interview.
items.zh: 她面試前很緊張。

items.en: The roads seem very busy today.
items.zh: 今天路上車好像很多。

examples.heading: ④ very + 形容詞 + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: They have very big dogs.
items.zh: 他們養了很大的狗。

items.en: We had very good weather in Spain.
items.zh: 我們在西班牙遇到很好的天氣。

items.en: These are very expensive shoes.
items.zh: 這是很貴的鞋子。

items.en: My aunt makes very sweet tea.
items.zh: 我阿姨泡的茶很甜。

items.en: He gives very clear answers.
items.zh: 他的回答很清楚。

items.en: There are very tall trees in the park.
items.zh: 公園裡有很高的樹。

examples.heading: ⑤ not very + 形容詞

items.en: The room wasn't very clean.
items.zh: 房間不怎麼乾淨。

items.en: I'm not very good at maths.
items.zh: 我數學不太好。

items.en: The museum isn't very far from here.
items.zh: 博物館離這裡不太遠。

items.en: It's not a very big town.
items.zh: 那不是一個很大的鎮。

items.en: My brother isn't very tall.
items.zh: 我哥哥不太高。

title: I'm very happy that you want to see me.
translation: 我很高興你想見我。
name: 受格代名詞當動詞受詞
sentences: Thanks for your letter. I'm very happy that you want to see me.
My dog follows me everywhere.
My teacher always helps me with my writing.
Can you hear me? The line is bad.
Thank you for the flowers. Can I kiss you?
Goodnight, sweetheart. Mummy and Daddy love you.
Don't worry. I'll help you with your bags.
My friend Anna is busy this week, but I can see her on Saturday at 8 pm.
I phoned my brother, but he didn't answer. I'll call him again later.
Do you know Mr Lee? I met him at the party.
My grandma lives alone, so we visit her every week.
We love our umbrella. It protects us from rain, wind and sun.
Our neighbours invited us to dinner.
Can you take us to the airport tomorrow?
You will find a lot of different shops in my town. I hope you'll like them.
I've got two cats. I feed them every morning.
My cousins live in Spain. I don't see them very often.
"Do you know Sarah?" "Yes, I see her at the gym."
"Do you like these earrings?" "Yes, I love them."
"Can you help us?" "Of course. What do you need?"

examples.heading: ① me

items.en: Thanks for your letter. I'm very happy that you want to see me.
items.zh: 謝謝你的信。我很高興你想見我。

items.en: My dog follows me everywhere.
items.zh: 我的狗走到哪都跟著我。

items.en: My teacher always helps me with my writing.
items.zh: 我的老師常常幫我改作文。

items.en: Can you hear me? The line is bad.
items.zh: 你聽得到我嗎？訊號不好。

examples.heading: ② you

items.en: Thank you for the flowers. Can I kiss you?
items.zh: 謝謝你的花。我可以親你一下嗎？

items.en: Goodnight, sweetheart. Mummy and Daddy love you.
items.zh: 晚安，寶貝。爸爸媽媽愛你。

items.en: Don't worry. I'll help you with your bags.
items.zh: 別擔心。我幫你拿行李。

examples.heading: ③ him / her

items.en: My friend Anna is busy this week, but I can see her on Saturday at 8 pm.
items.zh: 我朋友 Anna 這星期很忙，可是我星期六晚上八點可以見她。

items.en: I phoned my brother, but he didn't answer. I'll call him again later.
items.zh: 我打給我哥哥，可是他沒接。我等一下再打給他。

items.en: Do you know Mr Lee? I met him at the party.
items.zh: 你認識 Lee 先生嗎？我在派對上認識他的。

items.en: My grandma lives alone, so we visit her every week.
items.zh: 我奶奶自己住，所以我們每個星期都去看她。

examples.heading: ④ us

items.en: We love our umbrella. It protects us from rain, wind and sun.
items.zh: 我們很喜歡我們的大傘。它幫我們擋雨、擋風、擋太陽。

items.en: Our neighbours invited us to dinner.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居請我們吃晚餐。

items.en: Can you take us to the airport tomorrow?
items.zh: 你明天可以載我們去機場嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ them

items.en: You will find a lot of different shops in my town. I hope you'll like them.
items.zh: 你會在我住的鎮上看到很多不同的商店。希望你會喜歡。

items.en: I've got two cats. I feed them every morning.
items.zh: 我養了兩隻貓。我每天早上餵牠們。

items.en: My cousins live in Spain. I don't see them very often.
items.zh: 我的表兄弟姊妹住在西班牙。我不常見到他們。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Do you know Sarah?" "Yes, I see her at the gym."
items.zh: 你認識 Sarah 嗎？認識，我在健身房會看到她。

items.en: "Do you like these earrings?" "Yes, I love them."
items.zh: 你喜歡這副耳環嗎？喜歡，我好愛。

items.en: "Can you help us?" "Of course. What do you need?"
items.zh: 你可以幫我們嗎？當然。你們需要什麼？

title: He prefers chess.
translation: 他比較喜歡下西洋棋。
name: 主格代名詞當直述句的主詞
sentences: I get up at six because I start work early.
If you want, you can go inside.
I live in a small flat with my sister.
You always know the right thing to say.
My little brother doesn't like football. He prefers chess.
My friend's name is Julissa. She is from Ecuador, and she lives near my home.
My dad is a doctor. He works at the city hospital.
My grandma is eighty, but she still rides a bike.
I like my home because it is a beautiful home. It has a big garden and a good sitting room.
I like my front garden because it's very nice and warm.
I love this café. It makes the best coffee in town.
My neighbours help me a lot. They're nice people.
My family and I love the sea. We go to the beach every summer.
My cousins live in Canada. They have a big dog.
We start school at eight o'clock.
This is my sister, Maria. She is nineteen.
I have two cats. They sleep on my bed.
Our school is small. It has only two hundred students.
"Where's Tom?" "He's in the kitchen."
"Do you like the new teacher?" "Yes, she's really funny."
"Where are the kids?" "They're at the park."

examples.heading: ① I / you

items.en: I get up at six because I start work early.
items.zh: 我六點起床，因為我很早就要上班。

items.en: If you want, you can go inside.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以進去。

items.en: I live in a small flat with my sister.
items.zh: 我和姊姊住在一間小公寓。

items.en: You always know the right thing to say.
items.zh: 你總是知道該說什麼。

examples.heading: ② he / she

items.en: My little brother doesn't like football. He prefers chess.
items.zh: 我弟弟不喜歡足球。他比較喜歡下西洋棋。

items.en: My friend's name is Julissa. She is from Ecuador, and she lives near my home.
items.zh: 我朋友叫 Julissa。她來自厄瓜多，住在我家附近。

items.en: My dad is a doctor. He works at the city hospital.
items.zh: 我爸爸是醫生。他在市立醫院上班。

items.en: My grandma is eighty, but she still rides a bike.
items.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了，可是她還在騎腳踏車。

examples.heading: ③ it

items.en: I like my home because it is a beautiful home. It has a big garden and a good sitting room.
items.zh: 我喜歡我家，因為它是一個漂亮的家。它有一個大花園和一間舒服的客廳。

items.en: I like my front garden because it's very nice and warm.
items.zh: 我喜歡我家前院，因為那裡很舒服又溫暖。

items.en: I love this café. It makes the best coffee in town.
items.zh: 我很喜歡這家咖啡店。它的咖啡是鎮上最好喝的。

examples.heading: ④ we / they

items.en: My neighbours help me a lot. They're nice people.
items.zh: 我的鄰居常常幫我。他們人很好。

items.en: My family and I love the sea. We go to the beach every summer.
items.zh: 我和家人很喜歡海。我們每年夏天都去海邊。

items.en: My cousins live in Canada. They have a big dog.
items.zh: 我的表兄弟姊妹住在加拿大。他們養了一隻大狗。

items.en: We start school at eight o'clock.
items.zh: 我們八點開始上課。

examples.heading: ⑤ 介紹自己和家人

items.en: This is my sister, Maria. She is nineteen.
items.zh: 這是我姊姊 Maria。她十九歲。

items.en: I have two cats. They sleep on my bed.
items.zh: 我養了兩隻貓。牠們睡在我床上。

items.en: Our school is small. It has only two hundred students.
items.zh: 我們學校很小。只有兩百個學生。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Where's Tom?" "He's in the kitchen."
items.zh: Tom 在哪裡？他在廚房。

items.en: "Do you like the new teacher?" "Yes, she's really funny."
items.zh: 你喜歡新老師嗎？喜歡，她很好笑。

items.en: "Where are the kids?" "They're at the park."
items.zh: 孩子們在哪裡？他們在公園。

title: I think I am responsible enough to handle this job.
translation: 我覺得我夠負責，能勝任這份工作。
name: 形容詞加 enough 加不定詞的句型
sentences: You're away next week, Mrs Hill. I think I'm responsible enough to look after your dog.
Ben has worked in our shop for ten years. He's experienced enough to train new staff.
My brother only has a first degree. He isn't qualified enough to teach at the university.
The wedding has two hundred guests. Are you confident enough to speak in front of everyone?
She worked in a big hospital for five years. Our new nurse is skilled enough to work alone.
At sixteen, I wasn't mature enough to live on my own.
The school is only three stops away. Is your son old enough to take the bus by himself?
Tell your daughter why we're moving. She's mature enough to understand the problem.
My twin sisters were seventeen then. They weren't old enough to vote in the last election.
My son has a job now. He's grown up enough to pay his own bills.
The doctor checked his heart last week. Grandpa is healthy enough to travel again.
I can only run five kilometres. I'm not fit enough to run a marathon.
The nurse wants to take Mr Lee to the garden. Is the patient strong enough to walk?
After a week, she felt well enough to go back to work.
The river washed part of the bridge away. The bridge isn't safe enough to cross.
We don't need two cars for the trip. Dad's van is big enough for all six of us to fit in.
Read this book to your class. The story is simple enough for young children to understand.
It's only three hundred pounds a month. The flat is cheap enough for students to rent.
My aunt uses a wheelchair. Are the doors at the station wide enough for her to get through?
The back bedroom faces the garden. It's quiet enough for the baby to sleep.
The boss asked us all to work on Sunday. Nobody was brave enough to say no to him.
Your team entered the city's green plan competition. Was the plan good enough to win the prize?
The concert sold out in ten minutes. We weren't quick enough to get tickets.
You want to start your own café? If you're serious enough to try, I'll help you.
I passed my IELTS test last month. My English is good enough for me to work abroad now.
We've invited ten people for dinner. Is the table big enough to seat everyone?
Sales doubled last year. The company was rich enough to buy a second building.
The police asked me about the car's colour. I wasn't sure enough to give an answer.
It's the end of September. Are the apples ripe enough to pick?
The boy held the door for an old lady. She was polite enough to say thank you.

examples.heading: ① 能力和資格

items.en: You're away next week, Mrs Hill. I think I'm responsible enough to look after your dog.
items.zh: 希爾太太，你下星期不在。我覺得我夠負責，可以幫你照顧狗。

items.en: Ben has worked in our shop for ten years. He's experienced enough to train new staff.
items.zh: Ben 在我們店裡工作了十年。他的經驗夠，可以訓練新員工。

items.en: My brother only has a first degree. He isn't qualified enough to teach at the university.
items.zh: 我哥哥只有學士學位。他的資格不夠，不能在大學教書。

items.en: The wedding has two hundred guests. Are you confident enough to speak in front of everyone?
items.zh: 婚禮有兩百位客人。你有足夠的自信在大家面前說話嗎？

items.en: She worked in a big hospital for five years. Our new nurse is skilled enough to work alone.
items.zh: 她在一家大醫院工作了五年。我們的新護理師技術夠好，可以單獨作業。

examples.heading: ② 年紀和成熟度

items.en: At sixteen, I wasn't mature enough to live on my own.
items.zh: 十六歲的時候，我還不夠成熟，不能自己住。

items.en: The school is only three stops away. Is your son old enough to take the bus by himself?
items.zh: 學校只有三站遠。你兒子大到可以自己搭公車了嗎？

items.en: Tell your daughter why we're moving. She's mature enough to understand the problem.
items.zh: 跟你女兒說我們為什麼要搬家。她夠成熟，能理解這個問題。

items.en: My twin sisters were seventeen then. They weren't old enough to vote in the last election.
items.zh: 我的雙胞胎妹妹那時候十七歲。上次選舉時，她們還沒到投票年齡。

items.en: My son has a job now. He's grown up enough to pay his own bills.
items.zh: 我兒子現在有工作了。他已經長大到可以自己付帳單了。

examples.heading: ③ 身體和狀態

items.en: The doctor checked his heart last week. Grandpa is healthy enough to travel again.
items.zh: 醫生上星期檢查了他的心臟。爺爺身體好到可以再去旅行了。

items.en: I can only run five kilometres. I'm not fit enough to run a marathon.
items.zh: 我只能跑五公里。我體能不夠，跑不了馬拉松。

items.en: The nurse wants to take Mr Lee to the garden. Is the patient strong enough to walk?
items.zh: 護理師想帶李先生去花園。病人有力氣走路了嗎？

items.en: After a week, she felt well enough to go back to work.
items.zh: 一個禮拜後，她覺得身體好到可以回去上班了。

items.en: The river washed part of the bridge away. The bridge isn't safe enough to cross.
items.zh: 河水沖走了橋的一部分。那座橋不夠安全，不能過。

examples.heading: ④ for + 人 + to 不定詞

items.en: We don't need two cars for the trip. Dad's van is big enough for all six of us to fit in.
items.zh: 這趟旅行我們不需要兩輛車。爸爸的廂型車夠大，我們六個人都坐得下。

items.en: Read this book to your class. The story is simple enough for young children to understand.
items.zh: 把這本書唸給你班上聽。那個故事夠簡單，小小孩也聽得懂。

items.en: It's only three hundred pounds a month. The flat is cheap enough for students to rent.
items.zh: 一個月只要三百英鎊。那間公寓夠便宜，學生租得起。

items.en: My aunt uses a wheelchair. Are the doors at the station wide enough for her to get through?
items.zh: 我阿姨坐輪椅。車站的門夠寬，她過得去嗎？

items.en: The back bedroom faces the garden. It's quiet enough for the baby to sleep.
items.zh: 後面那間臥室面對花園。房間夠安靜，寶寶可以睡覺。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: The boss asked us all to work on Sunday. Nobody was brave enough to say no to him.
items.zh: 老闆要我們全部星期天上班。沒有人有勇氣對他說不。

items.en: Your team entered the city's green plan competition. Was the plan good enough to win the prize?
items.zh: 你們隊參加了市政府的綠色計畫比賽。那個計畫好到能得獎嗎？

items.en: The concert sold out in ten minutes. We weren't quick enough to get tickets.
items.zh: 音樂會十分鐘就賣完了。我們動作不夠快，沒買到票。

items.en: You want to start your own café? If you're serious enough to try, I'll help you.
items.zh: 你想自己開咖啡館？如果你夠認真想試，我會幫你。

items.en: I passed my IELTS test last month. My English is good enough for me to work abroad now.
items.zh: 我上個月考過了雅思。我的英文現在好到我可以在國外工作了。

items.en: We've invited ten people for dinner. Is the table big enough to seat everyone?
items.zh: 我們邀了十個人來吃晚餐。桌子夠大，坐得下每個人嗎？

items.en: Sales doubled last year. The company was rich enough to buy a second building.
items.zh: 去年銷售量翻倍。那家公司有錢到可以買第二棟大樓。

items.en: The police asked me about the car's colour. I wasn't sure enough to give an answer.
items.zh: 警察問我那輛車的顏色。我不夠確定，沒辦法給答案。

items.en: It's the end of September. Are the apples ripe enough to pick?
items.zh: 已經九月底了。蘋果熟到可以摘了嗎？

items.en: The boy held the door for an old lady. She was polite enough to say thank you.
items.zh: 那個男孩幫一位老太太扶著門。她很有禮貌地說了謝謝。

title: Come to my house at six.
translation: 六點來我家。
name: 肯定祈使句
sentences: Come round for dinner on Friday. I'll make curry.
Bring sandwiches and a bottle of water for the hike.
The film starts at eight. Meet me in front of the cinema.
There's lots of food at the barbecue. Bring a friend if you like.
Wear something warm. It's cold tonight.
See you next week. Email me soon.
Text me when you get home.
Thanks for a lovely evening. Say hello to your parents.
I've never been to Iceland. Send me some photos of your trip.
You leave for Spain tomorrow? Have a great holiday!
Please take a seat. The doctor will see you soon.
Please wait by the gate until we call your name.
Shut the gate behind you, please. The dog might run out.
Welcome to our home. Please help yourself to some cake.
The film is starting. Switch your phones to silent, please.
I need the contract for the meeting. Pass me that blue folder on your desk.
Open the window. It's hot in here.
I found Grandma's old album. Look at this photo!
Listen to this song. It reminds me of you.
You've been playing in the garden all afternoon. Wash your hands before dinner.
Hurry up! We're late.
Try the chocolate cake. It's great.
The forecast says rain this afternoon. Take an umbrella with you.
Here are your two pizzas. Enjoy your meal!
My friend got into the taxi to the airport. I called after her, "Take care!"
You've had a long week. Get some rest.
You got front-row tickets? Enjoy the concert tonight!
The doctor says you have a cold. Drink lots of water.
If the homework is too hard, ask your big sister.
Here's twenty dollars for the ride. Keep the change.

examples.heading: ① 邀請和安排

items.en: Come round for dinner on Friday. I'll make curry.
items.zh: 星期五來我家吃晚餐，我會煮咖哩。

items.en: Bring sandwiches and a bottle of water for the hike.
items.zh: 健行要帶三明治和一瓶水。

items.en: The film starts at eight. Meet me in front of the cinema.
items.zh: 電影八點開始。在電影院門口跟我碰面。

items.en: There's lots of food at the barbecue. Bring a friend if you like.
items.zh: 烤肉有很多食物。想帶朋友來也可以。

items.en: Wear something warm. It's cold tonight.
items.zh: 穿暖一點，今晚很冷。

examples.heading: ② 書信和電話的結尾

items.en: See you next week. Email me soon.
items.zh: 下禮拜見，記得快點寄信給我。

items.en: Text me when you get home.
items.zh: 到家的時候傳簡訊給我。

items.en: Thanks for a lovely evening. Say hello to your parents.
items.zh: 謝謝你讓我度過愉快的晚上。幫我跟你爸媽問好。

items.en: I've never been to Iceland. Send me some photos of your trip.
items.zh: 我從來沒去過冰島。傳幾張你旅行的照片給我。

items.en: You leave for Spain tomorrow? Have a great holiday!
items.zh: 你明天去西班牙？祝你假期愉快！

examples.heading: ③ please + 原形動詞

items.en: Please take a seat. The doctor will see you soon.
items.zh: 請坐，醫生很快就會幫你看診。

items.en: Please wait by the gate until we call your name.
items.zh: 請在登機門旁邊等，我們叫到你的名字再過來。

items.en: Shut the gate behind you, please. The dog might run out.
items.zh: 請隨手關上大門，狗可能會跑出去。

items.en: Welcome to our home. Please help yourself to some cake.
items.zh: 歡迎來我們家。請自己拿蛋糕吃。

items.en: The film is starting. Switch your phones to silent, please.
items.zh: 電影要開始了，請把手機調成靜音。

examples.heading: ④ 日常的請求

items.en: I need the contract for the meeting. Pass me that blue folder on your desk.
items.zh: 我開會需要那份合約。把你桌上那個藍色資料夾遞給我。

items.en: Open the window. It's hot in here.
items.zh: 把窗戶打開，這裡好熱。

items.en: I found Grandma's old album. Look at this photo!
items.zh: 我找到奶奶的舊相簿。你看這張照片！

items.en: Listen to this song. It reminds me of you.
items.zh: 聽聽這首歌，它讓我想起你。

items.en: You've been playing in the garden all afternoon. Wash your hands before dinner.
items.zh: 你整個下午都在花園玩。吃晚餐前去洗手。

items.en: Hurry up! We're late.
items.zh: 快一點！我們遲到了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 建議和祝福

items.en: Try the chocolate cake. It's great.
items.zh: 試試巧克力蛋糕，很好吃。

items.en: The forecast says rain this afternoon. Take an umbrella with you.
items.zh: 氣象預報說今天下午會下雨。帶把傘去。

items.en: Here are your two pizzas. Enjoy your meal!
items.zh: 這是你們的兩份披薩。用餐愉快！

items.en: My friend got into the taxi to the airport. I called after her, "Take care!"
items.zh: 我朋友上了去機場的計程車。我在後面喊：保重！

items.en: You've had a long week. Get some rest.
items.zh: 你忙了一整個星期。休息一下吧。

items.en: You got front-row tickets? Enjoy the concert tonight!
items.zh: 你拿到第一排的票？今晚的演唱會好好享受！

items.en: The doctor says you have a cold. Drink lots of water.
items.zh: 醫生說你感冒了。多喝水。

items.en: If the homework is too hard, ask your big sister.
items.zh: 如果作業太難，就問你姊姊。

items.en: Here's twenty dollars for the ride. Keep the change.
items.zh: 這是二十塊車資。零錢不用找了。

title: My friend is a nurse.
translation: 我朋友是護士。
name: 肯定直述句
sentences: The woman in the red coat is our new manager.
That's Ken in the garden next door. Ken is my neighbor.
We have rice fields in the country. Both of my grandparents are farmers.
Mr Lee retired in June. Mrs. Wang is our new English teacher.
Can I borrow books from this library? I'm a student at the university.
My mother works at the hospital. She is a doctor.
My cousin is very funny, but sometimes he is a little loud.
We eat out a lot. The noodle shop on our street is very cheap.
My uncle is flying to Tokyo today. He is at the airport now.
Let's go to the beach. The sky is clear and blue this morning.
I always drink coffee at two. I'm sleepy after lunch every day.
Mum, where are the car keys? The keys are on the table.
My sister isn't at home this year. She studies law in Taichung.
I ride my bike to my best friend's house. She lives near the river.
My brother is never home on weekends. He plays football every Saturday.
Our flat is never quiet. We have two cats.
My aunt and uncle are nurses. They work in a hospital.
We never eat out on weekdays. My mother cooks dinner every night.
My parents are working in Dubai. I'm living with my aunt this year.
Don't call Lucy tonight. She's studying for a test.
Water came through the ceiling last night. My dad is fixing the roof today.
It's a sunny Sunday. Dad is washing the car in front of the house.
Go to the night market for souvenirs. The market is very cheap and you can find everything there.
I've worked at the bakery for a year. I like my job and my boss is nice.
Only three thousand people live here. My town is small, but it has a big park.
I'm at work all day. You can call me after six.
My school starts at nine. I leave home at half past eight.
We don't need the lights on in the day. Our classroom has big windows.
Ken's mother is French, and his father is Japanese. Ken speaks four languages.
We can't go in yet. The museum opens at nine.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + 名詞

items.en: The woman in the red coat is our new manager.
items.zh: 穿紅外套的那位女士是我們的新經理。

items.en: That's Ken in the garden next door. Ken is my neighbor.
items.zh: 隔壁花園裡那個是 Ken。Ken 是我的鄰居。

items.en: We have rice fields in the country. Both of my grandparents are farmers.
items.zh: 我們在鄉下有稻田。我的爺爺奶奶都是農夫。

items.en: Mr Lee retired in June. Mrs. Wang is our new English teacher.
items.zh: 李老師六月退休了。王老師是我們的新英文老師。

items.en: Can I borrow books from this library? I'm a student at the university.
items.zh: 我可以向這間圖書館借書嗎？我是那所大學的學生。

items.en: My mother works at the hospital. She is a doctor.
items.zh: 我媽媽在醫院工作。她是醫生。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + 形容詞 / 地方

items.en: My cousin is very funny, but sometimes he is a little loud.
items.zh: 我表哥很好笑，但有時候有點吵。

items.en: We eat out a lot. The noodle shop on our street is very cheap.
items.zh: 我們常常在外面吃。我們這條街上的麵店很便宜。

items.en: My uncle is flying to Tokyo today. He is at the airport now.
items.zh: 我叔叔今天要飛去東京。他現在在機場。

items.en: Let's go to the beach. The sky is clear and blue this morning.
items.zh: 我們去海邊吧。今天早上天空又藍又晴朗。

items.en: I always drink coffee at two. I'm sleepy after lunch every day.
items.zh: 我總是兩點喝咖啡。我每天吃完午餐都很睏。

items.en: Mum, where are the car keys? The keys are on the table.
items.zh: 媽，車鑰匙在哪裡？鑰匙在桌上。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 一般動詞

items.en: My sister isn't at home this year. She studies law in Taichung.
items.zh: 我姊姊今年不在家。她在台中讀法律。

items.en: I ride my bike to my best friend's house. She lives near the river.
items.zh: 我騎腳踏車去我最好的朋友家。她住在河邊。

items.en: My brother is never home on weekends. He plays football every Saturday.
items.zh: 我哥哥週末從來不在家。他每個星期六踢足球。

items.en: Our flat is never quiet. We have two cats.
items.zh: 我們的公寓從來不安靜。我們養了兩隻貓。

items.en: My aunt and uncle are nurses. They work in a hospital.
items.zh: 我阿姨和姨丈是護理師。他們在醫院工作。

items.en: We never eat out on weekdays. My mother cooks dinner every night.
items.zh: 我們平日從來不在外面吃。我媽媽每天晚上煮晚餐。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + be + 動詞-ing

items.en: My parents are working in Dubai. I'm living with my aunt this year.
items.zh: 我爸媽在杜拜工作。我今年住在我阿姨家。

items.en: Don't call Lucy tonight. She's studying for a test.
items.zh: 今天晚上別打給露西。她在準備考試。

items.en: Water came through the ceiling last night. My dad is fixing the roof today.
items.zh: 昨天晚上水從天花板滴下來。我爸爸今天在修屋頂。

items.en: It's a sunny Sunday. Dad is washing the car in front of the house.
items.zh: 今天是晴朗的星期天。爸爸正在家門口洗車。

examples.heading: ⑤ 兩個子句和不同的句型

items.en: Go to the night market for souvenirs. The market is very cheap and you can find everything there.
items.zh: 去夜市買紀念品吧。那個市場很便宜，什麼都買得到。

items.en: I've worked at the bakery for a year. I like my job and my boss is nice.
items.zh: 我在麵包店工作一年了。我喜歡我的工作，我的老闆人也很好。

items.en: Only three thousand people live here. My town is small, but it has a big park.
items.zh: 這裡只住了三千人。我住的小鎮很小，但是有一座大公園。

items.en: I'm at work all day. You can call me after six.
items.zh: 我整天都在上班。你可以在六點以後打給我。

items.en: My school starts at nine. I leave home at half past eight.
items.zh: 我的學校九點上課。我八點半出門。

items.en: We don't need the lights on in the day. Our classroom has big windows.
items.zh: 我們白天不用開燈。我們的教室有大窗戶。

items.en: Ken's mother is French, and his father is Japanese. Ken speaks four languages.
items.zh: Ken 的媽媽是法國人，爸爸是日本人。Ken 會說四種語言。

items.en: We can't go in yet. The museum opens at nine.
items.zh: 我們還不能進去。博物館九點開門。

title: I will visit you soon.
translation: 我很快就會去看你。
name: 有情態動詞的肯定直述句
sentences: I'm free on Friday afternoon, so I can help you move.
My mom is busy, but I can get the kids after school.
At five years old, my nephew can already swim across the pool.
My train gets in at a quarter to six. We can meet in front of the station at six.
My daughter started lessons in May. She can play three songs on the guitar now.
Your phone is dead? You can borrow my charger.
I'm in a meeting now, Mum. I'll call you tonight after dinner.
We'll visit our grandparents in Hualien next week.
There's an announcement at the station. The next train will leave from platform two.
You're making the salads? Good. I'll bring some cake to the party.
The forecast says it will be windy on the coast tomorrow.
Don't book a taxi for Saturday. My cousin will pick us up at the airport.
The police stopped my brother yesterday. You must wear a helmet on a motorbike.
I can't come out this weekend. I must finish this report before Monday.
Your tooth still hurts? You should call the dentist today.
Everyone drives to the coast on holidays. We should leave early to miss the traffic.
In hot weather, children should drink a lot of water.
Take an umbrella. There may be showers after lunch.
The highway is closed, so you could take the old road instead.
I'm checking in for my flight to Rome. I would like a window seat, please.
Her light is on, so she may be at home.
If it's sunny, we could hire bikes and ride along the river.
Call my uncle about the broken door. He can fix almost anything in the house.
Please get the classrooms ready. The new students will arrive on Monday morning.
Lock the back door at night. My dog can open it by himself.
Because of the holiday, the post office will close at noon.
Ask Mrs. Chen to help the tourists. She can speak Japanese and Korean.
It's ten o'clock. The children should be in bed.
The school trip goes to France this year. Everyone on the trip must bring a passport.
Take my big blue case on your trip. This suitcase can hold clothes for two weeks.

examples.heading: ① can + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm free on Friday afternoon, so I can help you move.
items.zh: 我星期五下午有空，所以可以幫你搬家。

items.en: My mom is busy, but I can get the kids after school.
items.zh: 我媽媽很忙，不過我可以放學後去接孩子。

items.en: At five years old, my nephew can already swim across the pool.
items.zh: 我外甥才五歲，就已經能游過整個游泳池了。

items.en: My train gets in at a quarter to six. We can meet in front of the station at six.
items.zh: 我的火車五點四十五分到。我們可以六點在車站前面碰面。

items.en: My daughter started lessons in May. She can play three songs on the guitar now.
items.zh: 我女兒五月開始上課。她現在會用吉他彈三首歌了。

items.en: Your phone is dead? You can borrow my charger.
items.zh: 你的手機沒電了？你可以借我的充電器。

examples.heading: ② will + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm in a meeting now, Mum. I'll call you tonight after dinner.
items.zh: 媽，我現在在開會。我今晚吃完飯會打給你。

items.en: We'll visit our grandparents in Hualien next week.
items.zh: 我們下禮拜會去花蓮看爺爺奶奶。

items.en: There's an announcement at the station. The next train will leave from platform two.
items.zh: 車站有廣播。下一班火車會從第二月台出發。

items.en: You're making the salads? Good. I'll bring some cake to the party.
items.zh: 你要做沙拉？很好。我會帶蛋糕去派對。

items.en: The forecast says it will be windy on the coast tomorrow.
items.zh: 氣象預報說明天海邊風會很大。

items.en: Don't book a taxi for Saturday. My cousin will pick us up at the airport.
items.zh: 星期六別叫計程車。我表姊會去機場接我們。

examples.heading: ③ must / should + 原形動詞

items.en: The police stopped my brother yesterday. You must wear a helmet on a motorbike.
items.zh: 警察昨天攔下我哥哥。騎機車一定要戴安全帽。

items.en: I can't come out this weekend. I must finish this report before Monday.
items.zh: 我這個週末不能出去。我一定要在星期一之前寫完這份報告。

items.en: Your tooth still hurts? You should call the dentist today.
items.zh: 你的牙還在痛？你今天應該打給牙醫。

items.en: Everyone drives to the coast on holidays. We should leave early to miss the traffic.
items.zh: 放假的時候大家都開車去海邊。我們應該早點出發，避開車潮。

items.en: In hot weather, children should drink a lot of water.
items.zh: 天氣熱的時候，小孩應該多喝水。

examples.heading: ④ may / could / would + 原形動詞

items.en: Take an umbrella. There may be showers after lunch.
items.zh: 帶把傘吧，午餐後可能會下陣雨。

items.en: The highway is closed, so you could take the old road instead.
items.zh: 高速公路封閉了，所以你可以改走舊路。

items.en: I'm checking in for my flight to Rome. I would like a window seat, please.
items.zh: 我在辦去羅馬班機的報到。我想要靠窗的位子，謝謝。

items.en: Her light is on, so she may be at home.
items.zh: 她家燈亮著，所以她可能在家。

items.en: If it's sunny, we could hire bikes and ride along the river.
items.zh: 如果天氣好，我們可以租腳踏車沿著河騎。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的主詞

items.en: Call my uncle about the broken door. He can fix almost anything in the house.
items.zh: 門壞了就打給我叔叔。家裡幾乎什麼東西他都會修。

items.en: Please get the classrooms ready. The new students will arrive on Monday morning.
items.zh: 請把教室準備好。新生星期一早上會到。

items.en: Lock the back door at night. My dog can open it by himself.
items.zh: 晚上要鎖後門。我的狗會自己打開它。

items.en: Because of the holiday, the post office will close at noon.
items.zh: 因為放假，郵局中午就會關門。

items.en: Ask Mrs. Chen to help the tourists. She can speak Japanese and Korean.
items.zh: 請陳太太幫那些觀光客。她會說日文和韓文。

items.en: It's ten o'clock. The children should be in bed.
items.zh: 十點了，孩子們應該上床睡覺了。

items.en: The school trip goes to France this year. Everyone on the trip must bring a passport.
items.zh: 今年的校外旅行去法國。參加旅行的每個人都一定要帶護照。

items.en: Take my big blue case on your trip. This suitcase can hold clothes for two weeks.
items.zh: 旅行帶我那個藍色的大箱子。這個行李箱可以裝兩個禮拜的衣服。

title: Do you remember Julie?
translation: 你還記得 Julie 嗎？
name: 助動詞 do 的是非疑問句
sentences: I found an old class photo. Do you remember our first teacher?
Your fridge is always full. Do you cook at home most nights?
Excuse me, we're new in town. Do you know the way to the stadium?
My tooth has hurt for a week. Do you know a good dentist?
You look very fit. Do you play any sports?
You're carrying a lot. Do you need help with that box?
I need some advice about my mum's medicine. Does your sister still work at the hospital?
Your new flatmate lived in Osaka for a year. Does she speak Japanese?
Excuse me, driver. Does this bus go to the airport?
My son wants to pat your dog. Does it bite?
I need some paint for the weekend. Does the shop open on Sundays?
You're having fifty people at the house. Do your parents know about the party?
We can go after lunch. Do we need tickets for the museum?
I want to post this card today. Do they sell stamps at the supermarket?
The twins go to different schools now. Do they take the same bus?
They're a bit tight on my toes. Do these shoes come in a bigger size?
Your old one was very slow. Did you buy a new laptop for college?
You arrived in Vienna this morning. Did you sleep well on the night train?
Lisa said she'd tell you the news. Did she call you last night?
Did your parents enjoy the boat trip around the island?
There was a storm in Kaohsiung. Did it rain in Tainan yesterday?
We're halfway to the airport. Did you turn off the gas before we left?
A: There's a concert in the park. Do you like jazz? B: Yes, I do.
A: Ken took his driving test today. Did he pass? B: No, he didn't.
Your cup is empty. Do you want some more tea?
I'm driving to your work tomorrow. Does your office have a car park?
Our town was on TV. Did you see the news this morning?
I'm making coffee for everyone. Do you take milk in your coffee?
We're booking a room for our trip to Bath. Does the hotel have a lift?
You didn't come at ten. Did you get my text about the meeting?

examples.heading: ① Do you + 原形動詞?

items.en: I found an old class photo. Do you remember our first teacher?
items.zh: 我找到一張舊的班級照片。你記得我們的第一個老師嗎？

items.en: Your fridge is always full. Do you cook at home most nights?
items.zh: 你的冰箱總是滿的。你大多數晚上都在家煮飯嗎？

items.en: Excuse me, we're new in town. Do you know the way to the stadium?
items.zh: 不好意思，我們剛來這個鎮。你知道去體育場的路嗎？

items.en: My tooth has hurt for a week. Do you know a good dentist?
items.zh: 我的牙痛了一個星期。你知道哪裡有好的牙醫嗎？

items.en: You look very fit. Do you play any sports?
items.zh: 你看起來身材很好。你有做什麼運動嗎？

items.en: You're carrying a lot. Do you need help with that box?
items.zh: 你拿了好多東西。那個箱子你需要幫忙嗎？

examples.heading: ② Does he / she / it + 原形動詞?

items.en: I need some advice about my mum's medicine. Does your sister still work at the hospital?
items.zh: 我需要問一下我媽媽吃藥的事。你姊姊還在醫院上班嗎？

items.en: Your new flatmate lived in Osaka for a year. Does she speak Japanese?
items.zh: 你的新室友在大阪住過一年。她會說日文嗎？

items.en: Excuse me, driver. Does this bus go to the airport?
items.zh: 不好意思，司機。這班公車有到機場嗎？

items.en: My son wants to pat your dog. Does it bite?
items.zh: 我兒子想摸你的狗。牠會咬人嗎？

items.en: I need some paint for the weekend. Does the shop open on Sundays?
items.zh: 我週末需要一些油漆。那家店星期天有開嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Do they / we + 原形動詞?

items.en: You're having fifty people at the house. Do your parents know about the party?
items.zh: 你要請五十個人來家裡。你爸媽知道派對的事嗎？

items.en: We can go after lunch. Do we need tickets for the museum?
items.zh: 我們午餐後可以去。博物館需要門票嗎？

items.en: I want to post this card today. Do they sell stamps at the supermarket?
items.zh: 我今天想寄這張卡片。超市有賣郵票嗎？

items.en: The twins go to different schools now. Do they take the same bus?
items.zh: 那對雙胞胎現在讀不同的學校。她們搭同一班公車嗎？

items.en: They're a bit tight on my toes. Do these shoes come in a bigger size?
items.zh: 它們在我的腳趾有點緊。這雙鞋有大一號的嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Did + 主詞 + 原形動詞?

items.en: Your old one was very slow. Did you buy a new laptop for college?
items.zh: 你的舊筆電很慢。你為了上大學買了新筆電嗎？

items.en: You arrived in Vienna this morning. Did you sleep well on the night train?
items.zh: 你今天早上到維也納。你在夜車上睡得好嗎？

items.en: Lisa said she'd tell you the news. Did she call you last night?
items.zh: 麗莎說她會告訴你那個消息。她昨晚有打給你嗎？

items.en: Did your parents enjoy the boat trip around the island?
items.zh: 你爸媽喜歡環島的乘船之旅嗎？

items.en: There was a storm in Kaohsiung. Did it rain in Tainan yesterday?
items.zh: 高雄有暴風雨。台南昨天有下雨嗎？

items.en: We're halfway to the airport. Did you turn off the gas before we left?
items.zh: 我們已經在去機場的半路上了。我們出門前你有關瓦斯嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 簡短回答和不同的句型

items.en: A: There's a concert in the park. Do you like jazz? B: Yes, I do.
items.zh: A：公園有一場音樂會。你喜歡爵士樂嗎？B：喜歡。

items.en: A: Ken took his driving test today. Did he pass? B: No, he didn't.
items.zh: A：Ken 今天考駕照。他過了嗎？B：沒有。

items.en: Your cup is empty. Do you want some more tea?
items.zh: 你的杯子空了。你要再喝點茶嗎？

items.en: I'm driving to your work tomorrow. Does your office have a car park?
items.zh: 我明天要開車去你上班的地方。你們辦公室有停車場嗎？

items.en: Our town was on TV. Did you see the news this morning?
items.zh: 我們鎮上了電視。你今天早上有看新聞嗎？

items.en: I'm making coffee for everyone. Do you take milk in your coffee?
items.zh: 我在幫大家泡咖啡。你的咖啡要加牛奶嗎？

items.en: We're booking a room for our trip to Bath. Does the hotel have a lift?
items.zh: 我們在訂去巴斯旅行的房間。那家飯店有電梯嗎？

items.en: You didn't come at ten. Did you get my text about the meeting?
items.zh: 你十點沒來。你有收到我傳的開會簡訊嗎？

title: Are you going to the new art class?
translation: 你要去上新的美術課嗎？
name: 助動詞 be、have 的是非疑問句
sentences: The school has a list for after-school clubs. Are you going to the swimming lessons this term?
Your knee looks better now. Are you playing in the match on Saturday?
I haven't seen you for years. Are you still working at the bank?
Are you listening to the radio, or can I turn it off?
Your parents are going abroad in July. Are you staying with your aunt this summer?
We want to go skiing next week. Is it snowing in the mountains yet?
I see him training every morning. Is your brother running in the city marathon this year?
There are cans of green paint by the gate. Are your neighbors going to paint their fence green?
Your sister got a letter from a British university. Is she going to study in London?
I can hear cartoons from the living room. Are the kids watching TV again?
She needs an answer about the trip today. Have you replied to Ann's email yet?
We're planning our honeymoon in the Maldives. Have you ever stayed in a hotel on the water?
Has the plumber called you back about the leak?
They moved to the city in August. Have your cousins found a school for their son?
She sent it last Monday. Has the parcel from Grandma arrived?
The football starts in five minutes. Have you seen the remote control anywhere?
The show is on Friday night. Have you got a costume for the school play?
I need to sign this form. Have you got a pen I can borrow?
I want to grow tomatoes. Has your flat got a balcony?
Your dog keeps running next door. Have your neighbors got a garden?
Lisa is good with computers. Has she got time to help us?
A: Is your sister coming too? B: No, she isn't.
A: Has your hotel got a pool? B: Yes, it has.
Sorry, you sounded busy last night. Were you having dinner when I phoned?
Your sister's husband seems very nice. Had you met him before the wedding?
I need to print my report. Is anybody using this printer at the moment?
You've hardly eaten your dinner. Are you feeling nervous about tomorrow's interview?
You love fresh bread. Have you heard about the new bakery on Elm Street?
The police asked me about the visitor. Was the man at the door wearing a uniform?
Has the baby stopped crying, or should I go up?

examples.heading: ① Are you + 動詞-ing?

items.en: The school has a list for after-school clubs. Are you going to the swimming lessons this term?
items.zh: 學校有一張課後社團的名單。你這學期要去上游泳課嗎？

items.en: Your knee looks better now. Are you playing in the match on Saturday?
items.zh: 你的膝蓋看起來好多了。你星期六要上場比賽嗎？

items.en: I haven't seen you for years. Are you still working at the bank?
items.zh: 我好幾年沒見到你了。你還在銀行上班嗎？

items.en: Are you listening to the radio, or can I turn it off?
items.zh: 你在聽收音機嗎？還是我可以關掉？

items.en: Your parents are going abroad in July. Are you staying with your aunt this summer?
items.zh: 你爸媽七月要出國。你今年夏天要住在你阿姨家嗎？

examples.heading: ② Is / Are + 主詞 + 動詞-ing / going to

items.en: We want to go skiing next week. Is it snowing in the mountains yet?
items.zh: 我們下星期想去滑雪。山上開始下雪了嗎？

items.en: I see him training every morning. Is your brother running in the city marathon this year?
items.zh: 我每天早上都看到他在練跑。你哥哥今年要跑城市馬拉松嗎？

items.en: There are cans of green paint by the gate. Are your neighbors going to paint their fence green?
items.zh: 大門旁邊有幾罐綠色油漆。你鄰居打算把籬笆漆成綠色嗎？

items.en: Your sister got a letter from a British university. Is she going to study in London?
items.zh: 你姊姊收到一所英國大學的信。她打算去倫敦讀書嗎？

items.en: I can hear cartoons from the living room. Are the kids watching TV again?
items.zh: 我聽到客廳傳來卡通的聲音。孩子們又在看電視了嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Have / Has + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: She needs an answer about the trip today. Have you replied to Ann's email yet?
items.zh: 她今天就需要旅行的答覆。你回 Ann 的電子郵件了嗎？

items.en: We're planning our honeymoon in the Maldives. Have you ever stayed in a hotel on the water?
items.zh: 我們在計畫去馬爾地夫度蜜月。你住過蓋在水上的飯店嗎？

items.en: Has the plumber called you back about the leak?
items.zh: 水電工有回你電話說漏水的事嗎？

items.en: They moved to the city in August. Have your cousins found a school for their son?
items.zh: 他們八月搬到城裡。你表哥他們幫兒子找到學校了嗎？

items.en: She sent it last Monday. Has the parcel from Grandma arrived?
items.zh: 她上星期一寄的。奶奶寄的包裹到了嗎？

items.en: The football starts in five minutes. Have you seen the remote control anywhere?
items.zh: 足球賽五分鐘後開始。你有看到遙控器嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Have / Has + 主詞 + got

items.en: The show is on Friday night. Have you got a costume for the school play?
items.zh: 表演在星期五晚上。你有學校話劇要穿的戲服嗎？

items.en: I need to sign this form. Have you got a pen I can borrow?
items.zh: 我要簽這張表格。你有筆可以借我嗎？

items.en: I want to grow tomatoes. Has your flat got a balcony?
items.zh: 我想種番茄。你的公寓有陽台嗎？

items.en: Your dog keeps running next door. Have your neighbors got a garden?
items.zh: 你的狗一直跑去隔壁。你的鄰居有花園嗎？

items.en: Lisa is good with computers. Has she got time to help us?
items.zh: 麗莎很會用電腦。她有時間幫我們嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 簡短回答和不同的句型

items.en: A: Is your sister coming too? B: No, she isn't.
items.zh: A：你姊姊也要來嗎？B：不來。

items.en: A: Has your hotel got a pool? B: Yes, it has.
items.zh: A：你們飯店有游泳池嗎？B：有。

items.en: Sorry, you sounded busy last night. Were you having dinner when I phoned?
items.zh: 抱歉，你昨天晚上聽起來很忙。我打電話的時候你在吃晚餐嗎？

items.en: Your sister's husband seems very nice. Had you met him before the wedding?
items.zh: 你姊姊的先生看起來人很好。婚禮以前你見過他嗎？

items.en: I need to print my report. Is anybody using this printer at the moment?
items.zh: 我要印我的報告。現在有人在用這台印表機嗎？

items.en: You've hardly eaten your dinner. Are you feeling nervous about tomorrow's interview?
items.zh: 你晚餐幾乎都沒吃。你對明天的面試感到緊張嗎？

items.en: You love fresh bread. Have you heard about the new bakery on Elm Street?
items.zh: 你很愛新鮮麵包。你聽說榆樹街上那家新開的麵包店了嗎？

items.en: The police asked me about the visitor. Was the man at the door wearing a uniform?
items.zh: 警察問我那個訪客的事。門口那個男人當時穿著制服嗎？

items.en: Has the baby stopped crying, or should I go up?
items.zh: 寶寶不哭了嗎？還是我該上樓去看看？

title: How are you?
translation: 你好嗎？
name: be 動詞的疑問句
sentences: You've been very quiet all day. Are you all right?
Are you cold? I can turn the heating up.
Are you nervous about your driving test on Friday?
I haven't seen you here before. Are you the new nurse on this floor?
Are you busy after lunch, or can we talk then?
Your accent is lovely. Are you from Scotland?
Is your sister at home, or is she still at work?
Monday is a holiday. Is the swimming pool open on public holidays?
Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?
You changed jobs last month. Is your new boss easy to work with?
I asked the receptionist about the walk. Is it far from the hotel to the old town?
You and Ken look so alike. Is he your brother or your cousin?
You said they might move to Taipei. Are your grandparents still in Hualien?
Are we late? The film started at seven.
I'm going hiking in Scotland. Are these boots waterproof?
It's very quiet upstairs. Are the kids asleep yet?
Who are those girls waving at you? Are they your friends from the swimming club?
I haven't seen them since your wedding. How are your parents these days?
How is your grandmother after her operation?
I asked the waiter at the café. Where are the toilets, please?
I need to send an email from the hotel. What is the password for the Wi-Fi?
He's been watching us all evening. Who is that man by the door?
I need to book a day off. When is your sister's wedding?
You went out for dinner last night. Was the food good at the new Thai place?
Were you at Lisa's party on Friday night?
How was your holiday in Greece?
Where were you when the lights went out?
Am I too early? The door was open.
Was the maths exam as hard as last year's?
Excuse me, I'm not sure about my train. Is this the right platform for Kaohsiung?

examples.heading: ① Are you ...?

items.en: You've been very quiet all day. Are you all right?
items.zh: 你一整天都好安靜，你還好嗎？

items.en: Are you cold? I can turn the heating up.
items.zh: 你會冷嗎？我可以把暖氣開大一點。

items.en: Are you nervous about your driving test on Friday?
items.zh: 你對星期五的駕照考試緊張嗎？

items.en: I haven't seen you here before. Are you the new nurse on this floor?
items.zh: 我以前沒在這裡見過你。你是這層樓新來的護理師嗎？

items.en: Are you busy after lunch, or can we talk then?
items.zh: 你午餐後忙嗎？還是我們那時候可以談談？

items.en: Your accent is lovely. Are you from Scotland?
items.zh: 你的口音很好聽，你是蘇格蘭人嗎？

examples.heading: ② Is he / she / it ...?

items.en: Is your sister at home, or is she still at work?
items.zh: 你姊姊在家嗎？還是她還在上班？

items.en: Monday is a holiday. Is the swimming pool open on public holidays?
items.zh: 星期一放假。游泳池國定假日有開嗎？

items.en: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?
items.zh: 不好意思，這裡有人坐嗎？

items.en: You changed jobs last month. Is your new boss easy to work with?
items.zh: 你上個月換了工作。你的新老闆好相處嗎？

items.en: I asked the receptionist about the walk. Is it far from the hotel to the old town?
items.zh: 我問櫃台人員走路要多久。從飯店到舊城區遠嗎？

items.en: You and Ken look so alike. Is he your brother or your cousin?
items.zh: 你和 Ken 長得好像。他是你哥哥還是你表哥？

examples.heading: ③ Are they / we ...?

items.en: You said they might move to Taipei. Are your grandparents still in Hualien?
items.zh: 你說他們可能會搬到台北。你爺爺奶奶還在花蓮嗎？

items.en: Are we late? The film started at seven.
items.zh: 我們遲到了嗎？電影七點就開始了。

items.en: I'm going hiking in Scotland. Are these boots waterproof?
items.zh: 我要去蘇格蘭健行。這雙靴子防水嗎？

items.en: It's very quiet upstairs. Are the kids asleep yet?
items.zh: 樓上好安靜。孩子們睡了嗎？

items.en: Who are those girls waving at you? Are they your friends from the swimming club?
items.zh: 那些跟你揮手的女生是誰？她們是你游泳社的朋友嗎？

examples.heading: ④ How / Where / What + be

items.en: I haven't seen them since your wedding. How are your parents these days?
items.zh: 你婚禮以後我就沒見過他們。你爸媽最近好嗎？

items.en: How is your grandmother after her operation?
items.zh: 你奶奶開完刀後還好嗎？

items.en: I asked the waiter at the café. Where are the toilets, please?
items.zh: 我問咖啡館的服務生。請問廁所在哪裡？

items.en: I need to send an email from the hotel. What is the password for the Wi-Fi?
items.zh: 我要從飯店寄一封電子郵件。Wi-Fi 的密碼是什麼？

items.en: He's been watching us all evening. Who is that man by the door?
items.zh: 他整個晚上都在看我們。門邊那個男人是誰？

items.en: I need to book a day off. When is your sister's wedding?
items.zh: 我要請一天假。你姊姊的婚禮是什麼時候？

examples.heading: ⑤ Was / Were 和不同的句型

items.en: You went out for dinner last night. Was the food good at the new Thai place?
items.zh: 你昨天晚上出去吃飯。那家新開的泰國餐廳東西好吃嗎？

items.en: Were you at Lisa's party on Friday night?
items.zh: 你星期五晚上有去 Lisa 的派對嗎？

items.en: How was your holiday in Greece?
items.zh: 你在希臘的假期過得怎麼樣？

items.en: Where were you when the lights went out?
items.zh: 燈熄的時候你在哪裡？

items.en: Am I too early? The door was open.
items.zh: 我太早到了嗎？門開著。

items.en: Was the maths exam as hard as last year's?
items.zh: 數學考試跟去年一樣難嗎？

items.en: Excuse me, I'm not sure about my train. Is this the right platform for Kaohsiung?
items.zh: 不好意思，我不太確定我的火車。這是往高雄的月台嗎？

title: Would you like to come with me?
translation: 你要不要跟我一起去？
name: 情態動詞的是非疑問句
sentences: I'll look after your flat while you're away. Can I drop by on Thursday to pick up the keys?
My hands are full. Can you get the door for me?
It's stuffy in here. Could you open a window, please?
We're going cycling by the river on Sunday. Can your little sister ride a bike yet?
It's starting to rain. Could I borrow your umbrella?
Our room isn't ready yet. Can we leave our bags at reception until three?
We're going to the beach. Would you like to come along?
Your train isn't until four. Would you like another cup of coffee before you go?
The waiter took our empty plates. Would you like to see the dessert menu?
It's a long walk. Would you like a ride home?
We're cooking a big roast this weekend. Would your parents like to join us for dinner on Sunday?
The film starts at eight. Shall we meet outside the cinema at half past seven?
That bag looks heavy. Shall I carry it for you?
Nobody wants to cook. Shall we get some noodles?
It's cold in here. Shall I turn on the heater?
We're late. Shall we take a taxi instead of the bus?
I hate needles. Will you hold my hand at the clinic?
We need milk for the weekend. Will the shops be open on New Year's Day?
I need to find my ticket. Would you mind holding my coffee for a second?
He hasn't answered. Should I try his office number?
They're building the new library next to the park. Will it have a café inside?
My phone battery is dead. May I use your phone to call a taxi?
I'm a new teacher here. May I sit in on your class tomorrow?
Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
I don't have any cash with me. Can I pay for the tickets by card?
Something came up. Could we meet next week instead?
Thanks for the invitation. Should we bring anything to the barbecue?
I know it's late, but will you marry me?
There's a tall man in front of you. Can you see the stage from where you're sitting?
You don't know when the last train leaves? Would you like me to check the timetable for you?

examples.heading: ① Can / Could + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: I'll look after your flat while you're away. Can I drop by on Thursday to pick up the keys?
items.zh: 你不在的時候我會幫你看公寓。我可以星期四過去拿鑰匙嗎？

items.en: My hands are full. Can you get the door for me?
items.zh: 我手上都是東西，你可以幫我開門嗎？

items.en: It's stuffy in here. Could you open a window, please?
items.zh: 這裡好悶，可以請你開一扇窗嗎？

items.en: We're going cycling by the river on Sunday. Can your little sister ride a bike yet?
items.zh: 我們星期天要去河邊騎腳踏車。你妹妹會騎腳踏車了嗎？

items.en: It's starting to rain. Could I borrow your umbrella?
items.zh: 開始下雨了，我可以借你的傘嗎？

items.en: Our room isn't ready yet. Can we leave our bags at reception until three?
items.zh: 我們的房間還沒準備好。我們可以把行李寄放在櫃台到三點嗎？

examples.heading: ② Would you like ...?

items.en: We're going to the beach. Would you like to come along?
items.zh: 我們要去海邊，你要一起來嗎？

items.en: Your train isn't until four. Would you like another cup of coffee before you go?
items.zh: 你的火車四點才開。你走之前要不要再喝一杯咖啡？

items.en: The waiter took our empty plates. Would you like to see the dessert menu?
items.zh: 服務生收走了我們的空盤子。你要看甜點菜單嗎？

items.en: It's a long walk. Would you like a ride home?
items.zh: 走路很遠，你要我載你回家嗎？

items.en: We're cooking a big roast this weekend. Would your parents like to join us for dinner on Sunday?
items.zh: 我們這個週末要煮一大份烤肉。你爸媽星期天想跟我們一起吃晚餐嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Shall I / Shall we ...?

items.en: The film starts at eight. Shall we meet outside the cinema at half past seven?
items.zh: 電影八點開始。我們七點半在電影院外面見好嗎？

items.en: That bag looks heavy. Shall I carry it for you?
items.zh: 那個袋子看起來好重，要我幫你提嗎？

items.en: Nobody wants to cook. Shall we get some noodles?
items.zh: 沒人想煮飯，我們去吃麵好嗎？

items.en: It's cold in here. Shall I turn on the heater?
items.zh: 這裡好冷，要我開暖氣嗎？

items.en: We're late. Shall we take a taxi instead of the bus?
items.zh: 我們遲到了，我們改搭計程車好嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Will / Would / Should + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: I hate needles. Will you hold my hand at the clinic?
items.zh: 我很怕打針，在診所你會握著我的手嗎？

items.en: We need milk for the weekend. Will the shops be open on New Year's Day?
items.zh: 我們週末需要牛奶。元旦商店會開嗎？

items.en: I need to find my ticket. Would you mind holding my coffee for a second?
items.zh: 我要找我的票。你介意幫我拿一下咖啡嗎？

items.en: He hasn't answered. Should I try his office number?
items.zh: 他沒接，我應該打他辦公室的電話嗎？

items.en: They're building the new library next to the park. Will it have a café inside?
items.zh: 他們在公園旁邊蓋新圖書館。它裡面會有咖啡廳嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ May / Could 和不同的句型

items.en: My phone battery is dead. May I use your phone to call a taxi?
items.zh: 我的手機沒電了。我可以用你的電話叫計程車嗎？

items.en: I'm a new teacher here. May I sit in on your class tomorrow?
items.zh: 我是這裡的新老師。我明天可以去旁聽你的課嗎？

items.en: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
items.zh: 抱歉，可以請你再慢慢說一次嗎？

items.en: I don't have any cash with me. Can I pay for the tickets by card?
items.zh: 我身上沒有現金。票可以刷卡付嗎？

items.en: Something came up. Could we meet next week instead?
items.zh: 臨時有事，我們可以改成下禮拜見面嗎？

items.en: Thanks for the invitation. Should we bring anything to the barbecue?
items.zh: 謝謝你的邀請。烤肉我們應該帶什麼東西嗎？

items.en: I know it's late, but will you marry me?
items.zh: 我知道已經很晚了，可是你願意嫁給我嗎？

items.en: There's a tall man in front of you. Can you see the stage from where you're sitting?
items.zh: 你前面有一個高個子。你從你坐的位子看得到舞台嗎？

items.en: You don't know when the last train leaves? Would you like me to check the timetable for you?
items.zh: 你不知道最後一班火車幾點開？你要我幫你查時刻表嗎？

title: What have you bought?
translation: 你買了什麼？
name: wh- 詞當受詞的 wh- 疑問句
sentences: You've been shopping all morning. What have you bought for your mother's birthday?
Christmas is in two weeks. What does your daughter want this year?
I signed up for the cooking course yesterday. What must I bring to the first class?
You took Max to the clinic this morning. What did the vet say about his leg?
You always have a book in your bag. What are you reading at the moment?
Eight people are coming to dinner. What will you cook for the guests on Saturday?
Your story won first prize. Where did you get the idea for it?
We're new in the area. Where do your kids go to school?
The kids will be home soon. Where have you hidden the birthday presents?
My flight is delayed, and my battery is low. Where can I recharge my phone in the airport?
School finishes next week. Where are you spending the summer holidays?
I miss you already. When are you coming back from Japan?
The client wants a plan by Friday. When can we meet to talk about the project?
Your English is excellent. When did you start learning it?
I want to swim before breakfast on Saturday. When does the pool open on weekends?
You finished your last exam today. When will you know your results?
You had a high fever yesterday. How do you feel today?
There's glass all over the floor. How did the kids break the kitchen window?
I asked the man at reception for directions. How can I get to the museum from the hotel?
I'm booking the table for you. How do you spell your surname?
Your husband was away on business. How have you managed with the baby this week?
The tickets were all for different seats. Who did you sit next to at the concert?
You're at the post office again. Who are you sending that parcel to?
You loved playing music. Why did you sell your old piano?
The interviewer smiled and asked the first question. Why do you want this job?
The station is very big. Which platform should we wait on for the Tainan train?
You went to the cinema last night. Which film did you watch?
You're away for two weeks. Who will you ask to look after your cat?
I'll drive you to the station. What time does the train leave?
It looks very expensive. How much did you pay for that jacket?

examples.heading: ① What + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞

items.en: You've been shopping all morning. What have you bought for your mother's birthday?
items.zh: 你逛了一整個早上。你買了什麼給你媽媽當生日禮物？

items.en: Christmas is in two weeks. What does your daughter want this year?
items.zh: 再兩個星期就是聖誕節。你女兒今年想要什麼？

items.en: I signed up for the cooking course yesterday. What must I bring to the first class?
items.zh: 我昨天報名了烹飪課。第一堂課我得帶什麼？

items.en: You took Max to the clinic this morning. What did the vet say about his leg?
items.zh: 你今天早上帶小麥去診所。獸醫怎麼說牠的腿？

items.en: You always have a book in your bag. What are you reading at the moment?
items.zh: 你包包裡總是有一本書。你最近在看什麼書？

items.en: Eight people are coming to dinner. What will you cook for the guests on Saturday?
items.zh: 有八個人要來吃晚餐。星期六你要煮什麼給客人吃？

examples.heading: ② Where + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞

items.en: Your story won first prize. Where did you get the idea for it?
items.zh: 你的故事得了第一名。你故事的點子是從哪裡來的？

items.en: We're new in the area. Where do your kids go to school?
items.zh: 我們剛搬來這一區。你的孩子在哪裡上學？

items.en: The kids will be home soon. Where have you hidden the birthday presents?
items.zh: 孩子們快回家了。你把生日禮物藏到哪裡去了？

items.en: My flight is delayed, and my battery is low. Where can I recharge my phone in the airport?
items.zh: 我的班機誤點，手機又快沒電了。機場裡哪裡可以幫手機充電？

items.en: School finishes next week. Where are you spending the summer holidays?
items.zh: 學校下星期就放假了。你暑假要去哪裡過？

examples.heading: ③ When + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞

items.en: I miss you already. When are you coming back from Japan?
items.zh: 我已經在想你了。你什麼時候從日本回來？

items.en: The client wants a plan by Friday. When can we meet to talk about the project?
items.zh: 客戶星期五前要一份計畫。我們什麼時候可以見面討論專案？

items.en: Your English is excellent. When did you start learning it?
items.zh: 你的英文很棒。你什麼時候開始學的？

items.en: I want to swim before breakfast on Saturday. When does the pool open on weekends?
items.zh: 我星期六想在早餐前游泳。游泳池週末幾點開？

items.en: You finished your last exam today. When will you know your results?
items.zh: 你今天考完最後一科。你什麼時候會知道成績？

examples.heading: ④ How + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞

items.en: You had a high fever yesterday. How do you feel today?
items.zh: 你昨天發高燒。你今天覺得怎麼樣？

items.en: There's glass all over the floor. How did the kids break the kitchen window?
items.zh: 地板上到處都是玻璃。孩子們是怎麼把廚房窗戶打破的？

items.en: I asked the man at reception for directions. How can I get to the museum from the hotel?
items.zh: 我問櫃台的人怎麼走。我要怎麼從飯店去博物館？

items.en: I'm booking the table for you. How do you spell your surname?
items.zh: 我在幫你訂位。你的姓怎麼拼？

items.en: Your husband was away on business. How have you managed with the baby this week?
items.zh: 你先生出差了。這個禮拜你帶寶寶還應付得來嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Who / Why / Which + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞

items.en: The tickets were all for different seats. Who did you sit next to at the concert?
items.zh: 票都是不同的位子。你在演唱會上坐在誰旁邊？

items.en: You're at the post office again. Who are you sending that parcel to?
items.zh: 你又在郵局了。你那個包裹要寄給誰？

items.en: You loved playing music. Why did you sell your old piano?
items.zh: 你很愛彈琴。你為什麼把舊鋼琴賣了？

items.en: The interviewer smiled and asked the first question. Why do you want this job?
items.zh: 面試官笑著問了第一個問題。你為什麼想要這份工作？

items.en: The station is very big. Which platform should we wait on for the Tainan train?
items.zh: 車站很大。我們應該在哪個月台等去台南的火車？

items.en: You went to the cinema last night. Which film did you watch?
items.zh: 你昨天晚上去看電影。你看了哪一部電影？

items.en: You're away for two weeks. Who will you ask to look after your cat?
items.zh: 你要出門兩個星期。你會找誰幫你照顧貓？

items.en: I'll drive you to the station. What time does the train leave?
items.zh: 我開車送你去車站。火車幾點開？

items.en: It looks very expensive. How much did you pay for that jacket?
items.zh: 它看起來很貴。那件夾克你付了多少錢？

title: She closed her eyes as if to push those thoughts away.
translation: 她閉上眼睛，好像想把那些念頭推開。
name: as if 加非限定子句
sentences: The baby next to us on the plane was screaming. My mother shut her eyes as if to block out the noise.
I stood at the top of the climbing frame. Dad held out his arms as if to catch me.
I asked the shy new girl to sit with us. She nodded as if to say yes.
My brother looked at me across the dinner table. He opened his mouth as if to say something, then stopped.
I bent down to say hello to my friend's dog. It lifted its paw as if to shake hands.
My friend read the letter from her father. She turned away as if to hide her tears.
The striker stepped up to take the penalty. The goalkeeper spread his arms as if to fill the whole goal.
We were still chatting at the end of the test. The teacher looked at the clock as if to remind us of the time.
I came home after two years abroad. Grandpa hugged me tightly, as if to make sure I was real.
The chairman stood at the front of the noisy room. He coughed loudly as if to get our attention.
I was very nervous before my speech. My teacher smiled at me as if to say, "Don't worry."
It was our son's first winter. He reached out as if to touch the snow.
I walked into the dark house alone. My stomach was turning over, as if trying to warn me.
We watched a deer in the forest. It froze as if hearing a noise.
My father came home after a long day at the factory. He walked slowly, as if carrying something heavy.
I saw a woman at the station entrance. She stood very still, as if waiting for someone.
I told the farmer that the summer was too dry. The old man nodded as if agreeing with me.
We couldn't sleep during the storm. The wind was howling, as if trying to break the windows.
Dad shouted at us in the morning. In the evening he cooked our favorite meal, as if trying to say sorry.
I told the salesman I didn't want the car. He kept talking, as if hoping to change my mind.
My flatmate stopped at the door before work. She looked around the room as if searching for her keys.
The head teacher walked towards them. The boy hid behind his mother, as if expecting trouble.
I waved at Lisa in the canteen. Why did she turn her face away, as if to avoid me?
The baby had just fallen asleep. My wife put her finger to her lips as if to say, "Be quiet."
The pianist finished the last piece. He bowed deeply, as if to thank the whole audience.
We sat down to eat our sandwiches. The puppy wagged its tail as if begging for food.
We lay on the grass on a windy afternoon. The clouds moved fast, as if racing each other.
My sister looked down from the top of the tower. She laughed as if to hide her fear.
My friend didn't eat his dinner. He looked at his phone as if expecting a call.
The lights in the cave went out. The children went quiet, as if sensing danger.

examples.heading: ① as if + to 不定詞

items.en: The baby next to us on the plane was screaming. My mother shut her eyes as if to block out the noise.
items.zh: 飛機上坐我們旁邊的寶寶在尖叫。我媽媽閉上眼睛，好像想隔絕噪音。

items.en: I stood at the top of the climbing frame. Dad held out his arms as if to catch me.
items.zh: 我站在攀爬架的最上面。爸爸張開雙臂，好像要接住我。

items.en: I asked the shy new girl to sit with us. She nodded as if to say yes.
items.zh: 我請那個害羞的新來女孩跟我們坐。她點點頭，好像在說好。

items.en: My brother looked at me across the dinner table. He opened his mouth as if to say something, then stopped.
items.zh: 我哥哥在餐桌另一頭看著我。他張開嘴，好像要說什麼，接著又停了。

items.en: I bent down to say hello to my friend's dog. It lifted its paw as if to shake hands.
items.zh: 我彎下腰跟我朋友的狗打招呼。牠抬起腳掌，好像要握手。

items.en: My friend read the letter from her father. She turned away as if to hide her tears.
items.zh: 我朋友讀了她爸爸的信。她轉過身，好像要藏住眼淚。

items.en: The striker stepped up to take the penalty. The goalkeeper spread his arms as if to fill the whole goal.
items.zh: 前鋒走上前踢十二碼罰球。守門員張開雙臂，好像要把整個球門擋住。

examples.heading: ② as if + to 不定詞，表示猜測的目的

items.en: We were still chatting at the end of the test. The teacher looked at the clock as if to remind us of the time.
items.zh: 考試快結束了我們還在聊天。老師看了看時鐘，好像在提醒我們時間。

items.en: I came home after two years abroad. Grandpa hugged me tightly, as if to make sure I was real.
items.zh: 我在國外兩年後回家。爺爺緊緊抱住我，好像要確定我是真的。

items.en: The chairman stood at the front of the noisy room. He coughed loudly as if to get our attention.
items.zh: 主席站在吵鬧的房間前面。他大聲咳嗽，好像想引起我們注意。

items.en: I was very nervous before my speech. My teacher smiled at me as if to say, "Don't worry."
items.zh: 我演講前很緊張。老師對我笑了笑，好像在說別擔心。

items.en: It was our son's first winter. He reached out as if to touch the snow.
items.zh: 那是我們兒子的第一個冬天。他伸出手，好像想摸雪。

examples.heading: ③ as if + 動詞-ing

items.en: I walked into the dark house alone. My stomach was turning over, as if trying to warn me.
items.zh: 我一個人走進黑漆漆的房子。我的胃在翻攪，好像想警告我什麼。

items.en: We watched a deer in the forest. It froze as if hearing a noise.
items.zh: 我們在森林裡看一隻鹿。牠突然不動，好像聽到了什麼聲音。

items.en: My father came home after a long day at the factory. He walked slowly, as if carrying something heavy.
items.zh: 我爸爸在工廠忙了一整天才回家。他走得很慢，好像扛著很重的東西。

items.en: I saw a woman at the station entrance. She stood very still, as if waiting for someone.
items.zh: 我在車站入口看到一個女人。她站著一動也不動，好像在等人。

items.en: I told the farmer that the summer was too dry. The old man nodded as if agreeing with me.
items.zh: 我跟農夫說夏天太乾了。那個老人點點頭，好像同意我的話。

items.en: We couldn't sleep during the storm. The wind was howling, as if trying to break the windows.
items.zh: 暴風雨的時候我們睡不著。風在呼嘯，好像想把窗戶吹破。

examples.heading: ④ as if + 動詞-ing，表示猜測的原因

items.en: Dad shouted at us in the morning. In the evening he cooked our favorite meal, as if trying to say sorry.
items.zh: 爸爸早上對我們大吼。晚上他煮了我們最愛吃的菜，好像想道歉。

items.en: I told the salesman I didn't want the car. He kept talking, as if hoping to change my mind.
items.zh: 我跟業務員說我不要那輛車。他一直說，好像希望我改變主意。

items.en: My flatmate stopped at the door before work. She looked around the room as if searching for her keys.
items.zh: 我室友上班前在門口停下來。她環顧房間，好像在找鑰匙。

items.en: The head teacher walked towards them. The boy hid behind his mother, as if expecting trouble.
items.zh: 校長朝他們走過去。那個男孩躲在他媽媽身後，好像預料會有麻煩。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: I waved at Lisa in the canteen. Why did she turn her face away, as if to avoid me?
items.zh: 我在餐廳跟麗莎揮手。她為什麼把臉轉開，好像在躲我？

items.en: The baby had just fallen asleep. My wife put her finger to her lips as if to say, "Be quiet."
items.zh: 寶寶剛睡著。我太太把手指放在嘴唇上，好像在說安靜。

items.en: The pianist finished the last piece. He bowed deeply, as if to thank the whole audience.
items.zh: 鋼琴家彈完最後一首曲子。他深深一鞠躬，好像在感謝全場觀眾。

items.en: We sat down to eat our sandwiches. The puppy wagged its tail as if begging for food.
items.zh: 我們坐下來吃三明治。小狗搖著尾巴，好像在討東西吃。

items.en: We lay on the grass on a windy afternoon. The clouds moved fast, as if racing each other.
items.zh: 我們在一個風很大的下午躺在草地上。雲移動得很快，好像在互相比賽。

items.en: My sister looked down from the top of the tower. She laughed as if to hide her fear.
items.zh: 我姊姊從塔頂往下看。她笑了，好像想掩飾她的恐懼。

items.en: My friend didn't eat his dinner. He looked at his phone as if expecting a call.
items.zh: 我朋友沒吃他的晚餐。他看著手機，好像在等電話。

items.en: The lights in the cave went out. The children went quiet, as if sensing danger.
items.zh: 洞穴裡的燈熄了。孩子們安靜下來，好像察覺到危險。

title: Everything was so familiar, as though he had never left the place.
translation: 一切都那麼熟悉，好像他從來沒離開過這個地方。
name: as if、as though 子句
sentences: I found my brother under the bed, as if he was hiding from someone.
I watched a man walk through the dark car park. He kept turning around, as if someone was following him.
My sister carried Grandma's old plates to the car. She held the box carefully, as if it was full of eggs.
We were watching TV at midnight. The dog barked at the door, as if someone was outside.
My date didn't listen to me at dinner. He kept looking at his watch, as if he was late for something.
The house felt warm and familiar, as though we had lived there for years.
We had a big fight on Friday. On Monday she smiled at me, as though nothing had happened.
My brother came home from his exams. He was very tired, as if he hadn't slept for days.
The kids made pancakes while I was out. The kitchen was a mess, as though a storm had passed through it.
I met my boyfriend's parents for the first time. They greeted me warmly, as if they had known me for years.
I waited outside the exam room. My heart was beating so hard, as if it was going to jump out.
I only climbed the stairs to the fifth floor. My legs were shaking, as if I had run a marathon.
The coach shouted at the boy in front of the team. His face went red, as though he was about to cry.
I stood up too fast after the blood test. My head was spinning, as if I was on a boat.
Our neighbour tells everyone where to park. He talks about the town as if he were the mayor.
My cousin earns very little, but he spends money as if he were a millionaire.
I'm twenty-five, but my parents still check my homework. They treat me as though I were a child.
My grandmother loves the village parties. She dances as if nobody were watching.
The new manager has only been here a week. He talks as if he knows everything.
My sister is wearing new shoes today. She walks as though her feet hurt.
Look at him in his cot. The baby is laughing as if someone is tickling him.
I just want to sell the car and buy a boat. Don't look at me as if I'm crazy.
The new boy puts his feet on the desks. He behaves as though he owns the place.
We've been inside for three days. It's raining as if it will never stop.
I'm sitting right next to you. Why are you shouting as if I can't hear you?
Our neighbours packed the car at midnight. They left in a hurry, as if they were afraid of something.
Every evening I saw him on the harbour wall. The old man stared at the sea, as though he was waiting for someone.
My daughter left for university last week. She packed all her bags, as if she would never come back.
We arrived at three in the afternoon on a Sunday. The town was silent, as though everyone had gone away.
The teacher asked the hardest question in the test. He answered calmly, as if the question was easy.

examples.heading: ① 動作 + as if + 過去進行式

items.en: I found my brother under the bed, as if he was hiding from someone.
items.zh: 我發現我弟弟躲在床底下，好像在躲什麼人。

items.en: I watched a man walk through the dark car park. He kept turning around, as if someone was following him.
items.zh: 我看著一個男人走過黑暗的停車場。他一直回頭，好像有人在跟蹤他。

items.en: My sister carried Grandma's old plates to the car. She held the box carefully, as if it was full of eggs.
items.zh: 我姊姊把奶奶的舊盤子搬到車上。她小心地拿著那個箱子，好像裡面裝滿了蛋。

items.en: We were watching TV at midnight. The dog barked at the door, as if someone was outside.
items.zh: 我們半夜在看電視。狗對著門叫，好像外面有人。

items.en: My date didn't listen to me at dinner. He kept looking at his watch, as if he was late for something.
items.zh: 我的約會對象晚餐時都沒在聽我說話。他一直看手錶，好像有什麼事要遲到了。

examples.heading: ② 狀態 + as though + 過去完成式

items.en: The house felt warm and familiar, as though we had lived there for years.
items.zh: 那間房子感覺溫暖又熟悉，好像我們在那裡住了好多年。

items.en: We had a big fight on Friday. On Monday she smiled at me, as though nothing had happened.
items.zh: 我們星期五大吵一架。星期一她對我笑，好像什麼事都沒發生過。

items.en: My brother came home from his exams. He was very tired, as if he hadn't slept for days.
items.zh: 我哥哥考完試回家。他非常累，好像好幾天沒睡了。

items.en: The kids made pancakes while I was out. The kitchen was a mess, as though a storm had passed through it.
items.zh: 我出門的時候孩子們做了鬆餅。廚房一團亂，好像被暴風吹過一樣。

items.en: I met my boyfriend's parents for the first time. They greeted me warmly, as if they had known me for years.
items.zh: 我第一次見我男朋友的爸媽。他們熱情地跟我打招呼，好像認識我好幾年了。

examples.heading: ③ 心跳和身體的感覺

items.en: I waited outside the exam room. My heart was beating so hard, as if it was going to jump out.
items.zh: 我在考場外面等。我的心跳得好用力，好像要跳出來了。

items.en: I only climbed the stairs to the fifth floor. My legs were shaking, as if I had run a marathon.
items.zh: 我只是爬樓梯到五樓。我的腿在發抖，好像跑了一場馬拉松。

items.en: The coach shouted at the boy in front of the team. His face went red, as though he was about to cry.
items.zh: 教練在全隊面前對那個男孩大吼。他的臉紅了，好像快哭了。
