items.en: I stood up too fast after the blood test. My head was spinning, as if I was on a boat.
items.zh: 抽完血我站起來太快。我的頭在轉，好像在船上一樣。

examples.heading: ④ as if + were

items.en: Our neighbour tells everyone where to park. He talks about the town as if he were the mayor.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居告訴每個人要停在哪裡。他說起這個鎮，好像他是鎮長一樣。

items.en: My cousin earns very little, but he spends money as if he were a millionaire.
items.zh: 我表哥賺得很少，可是他花錢好像他是百萬富翁一樣。

items.en: I'm twenty-five, but my parents still check my homework. They treat me as though I were a child.
items.zh: 我二十五歲了，可是我爸媽還在檢查我的作業。他們把我當小孩看。

items.en: My grandmother loves the village parties. She dances as if nobody were watching.
items.zh: 我奶奶很愛村子裡的派對。她跳舞好像沒人在看一樣。

examples.heading: ⑤ 現在式和不同的句型

items.en: The new manager has only been here a week. He talks as if he knows everything.
items.zh: 新經理才來一個星期。他說話好像什麼都懂。

items.en: My sister is wearing new shoes today. She walks as though her feet hurt.
items.zh: 我姊姊今天穿新鞋。她走路好像腳在痛。

items.en: Look at him in his cot. The baby is laughing as if someone is tickling him.
items.zh: 你看嬰兒床裡的他。寶寶在笑，好像有人在搔他癢。

items.en: I just want to sell the car and buy a boat. Don't look at me as if I'm crazy.
items.zh: 我只是想賣掉車子買一艘船。別用好像我瘋了的眼神看我。

items.en: The new boy puts his feet on the desks. He behaves as though he owns the place.
items.zh: 那個新來的男生把腳放在桌上。他的舉止好像這裡是他的。

items.en: We've been inside for three days. It's raining as if it will never stop.
items.zh: 我們已經在室內待了三天。雨下得好像永遠不會停。

items.en: I'm sitting right next to you. Why are you shouting as if I can't hear you?
items.zh: 我就坐在你旁邊。你為什麼在吼，好像我聽不到一樣？

items.en: Our neighbours packed the car at midnight. They left in a hurry, as if they were afraid of something.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居半夜把東西裝上車。他們匆匆離開，好像在怕什麼。

items.en: Every evening I saw him on the harbour wall. The old man stared at the sea, as though he was waiting for someone.
items.zh: 每天傍晚我都看到他在港口的堤上。那個老人望著海，好像在等人。

items.en: My daughter left for university last week. She packed all her bags, as if she would never come back.
items.zh: 我女兒上星期去上大學。她打包了所有的行李，好像再也不會回來了。

items.en: We arrived at three in the afternoon on a Sunday. The town was silent, as though everyone had gone away.
items.zh: 我們星期天下午三點到。小鎮一片寂靜，好像大家都離開了。

items.en: The teacher asked the hardest question in the test. He answered calmly, as if the question was easy.
items.zh: 老師問了考試裡最難的問題。他冷靜地回答，好像這個問題很簡單。

title: She likes to listen to music and watch TV.
translation: 她喜歡聽音樂和看電視。
name: 對等子句省略第二個主詞
sentences: Every morning I walk the dog and buy a newspaper.
We have a short break at ten. After the break, we go back to class and study.
My mornings are busy. I get up at seven and take a shower.
My mum works late on Mondays. My dad comes home and cooks dinner.
My grandmother doesn't like supermarkets. She goes to the market and buys fresh fruit.
I'm free on Saturday afternoons. Sometimes I meet my friends and play tennis.
My daughter is very quiet. She likes to read and draw.
We've walked for three hours. I want to rest and eat something.
My cousins always start the party. They like to sing and dance.
Grandma is coming tomorrow. We need to clean the kitchen and wash the car.
My brother finished school last month. He wants to travel and see the world.
I cooked yesterday, so it's your turn. You can cook or wash up tonight.
The meeting is over. You can stay here or go home.
Here's the plan for Saturday. We'll have lunch and go to the museum.
She's only four, but my little sister can read and write her name.
My plane lands at nine. I'll call you or send a text.
Last Sunday was sunny. We drove to the coast and walked along the cliffs.
We sat down at the restaurant. The waiter brought our drinks and took our order.
I was very tired last night. I finished my homework and went to bed.
My parents went south for the weekend. They visited Tainan and ate a lot of food.
My sister got the job. She called her mother and told her the news.
Coffee keeps me awake. I like coffee but don't drink it at night.
My son ran in the school race. He tried hard but didn't win.
The party is getting boring. Do you want to stay or go?
Please turn the music down. I'm tired and want to sleep.
My aunt takes the train every day. She lives in Taipei but works in Taoyuan.
We stayed home on Saturday night. We cooked dinner, watched a film and went to bed.
I can't sleep well these days. My cat sleeps all day and plays all night.
My grandfather is ninety and very healthy. He doesn't smoke or drink.
Ann is always in a hurry in the morning. She reads the news and has breakfast at the same time.

examples.heading: ① 現在式 + and + 動詞

items.en: Every morning I walk the dog and buy a newspaper.
items.zh: 我每天早上遛狗，然後買份報紙。

items.en: We have a short break at ten. After the break, we go back to class and study.
items.zh: 我們十點有一段短短的下課時間。下課後，我們回教室讀書。

items.en: My mornings are busy. I get up at seven and take a shower.
items.zh: 我的早上很忙。我七點起床，然後洗澡。

items.en: My mum works late on Mondays. My dad comes home and cooks dinner.
items.zh: 我媽媽星期一工作到很晚。我爸爸回家煮晚餐。

items.en: My grandmother doesn't like supermarkets. She goes to the market and buys fresh fruit.
items.zh: 我奶奶不喜歡超市。她去市場買新鮮水果。

items.en: I'm free on Saturday afternoons. Sometimes I meet my friends and play tennis.
items.zh: 我星期六下午有空。有時候我跟朋友見面打網球。

examples.heading: ② to + 動詞 + and + 動詞

items.en: My daughter is very quiet. She likes to read and draw.
items.zh: 我女兒很安靜。她喜歡看書和畫畫。

items.en: We've walked for three hours. I want to rest and eat something.
items.zh: 我們走了三個小時。我想休息一下，吃點東西。

items.en: My cousins always start the party. They like to sing and dance.
items.zh: 我的表親們總是帶動派對。他們喜歡唱歌跳舞。

items.en: Grandma is coming tomorrow. We need to clean the kitchen and wash the car.
items.zh: 奶奶明天要來。我們要打掃廚房，還要洗車。

items.en: My brother finished school last month. He wants to travel and see the world.
items.zh: 我哥哥上個月畢業了。他想去旅行，看看這個世界。

examples.heading: ③ can / will + 動詞 + or / and + 動詞

items.en: I cooked yesterday, so it's your turn. You can cook or wash up tonight.
items.zh: 我昨天煮飯了，所以換你。今晚你可以煮飯或洗碗。

items.en: The meeting is over. You can stay here or go home.
items.zh: 會議結束了。你可以待在這裡，或是回家。

items.en: Here's the plan for Saturday. We'll have lunch and go to the museum.
items.zh: 這是星期六的計畫。我們會吃午餐，然後去博物館。

items.en: She's only four, but my little sister can read and write her name.
items.zh: 她才四歲，可是我妹妹會讀，也會寫自己的名字。

items.en: My plane lands at nine. I'll call you or send a text.
items.zh: 我的飛機九點降落。我會打給你，或是傳簡訊。

examples.heading: ④ 過去式 + and + 過去式

items.en: Last Sunday was sunny. We drove to the coast and walked along the cliffs.
items.zh: 上星期天天氣很好。我們開車去海邊，沿著懸崖散步。

items.en: We sat down at the restaurant. The waiter brought our drinks and took our order.
items.zh: 我們在餐廳坐下來。服務生送來飲料，幫我們點菜。

items.en: I was very tired last night. I finished my homework and went to bed.
items.zh: 我昨天晚上很累。我寫完作業就去睡了。

items.en: My parents went south for the weekend. They visited Tainan and ate a lot of food.
items.zh: 我爸媽週末去南部。他們去台南吃了很多東西。

items.en: My sister got the job. She called her mother and told her the news.
items.zh: 我姊姊得到那份工作了。她打給她媽媽，告訴她這個消息。

examples.heading: ⑤ but / 否定和不同的句型

items.en: Coffee keeps me awake. I like coffee but don't drink it at night.
items.zh: 咖啡會讓我睡不著。我喜歡咖啡，但是晚上不喝。

items.en: My son ran in the school race. He tried hard but didn't win.
items.zh: 我兒子參加了學校的賽跑。他很努力，但是沒贏。

items.en: The party is getting boring. Do you want to stay or go?
items.zh: 派對越來越無聊了。你想留下還是走？

items.en: Please turn the music down. I'm tired and want to sleep.
items.zh: 請把音樂關小聲。我很累，想睡覺。

items.en: My aunt takes the train every day. She lives in Taipei but works in Taoyuan.
items.zh: 我阿姨每天搭火車。她住在台北，但在桃園上班。

items.en: We stayed home on Saturday night. We cooked dinner, watched a film and went to bed.
items.zh: 我們星期六晚上待在家。我們煮了晚餐，看了電影，然後去睡覺。

items.en: I can't sleep well these days. My cat sleeps all day and plays all night.
items.zh: 我最近睡不好。我的貓整天睡覺，整晚玩。

items.en: My grandfather is ninety and very healthy. He doesn't smoke or drink.
items.zh: 我爺爺九十歲了，身體很好。他不抽菸，也不喝酒。

items.en: Ann is always in a hurry in the morning. She reads the news and has breakfast at the same time.
items.zh: Ann 早上總是很趕。她一邊看新聞一邊吃早餐。

title: They chose our school because it's very modern and there are a lot of students.
translation: 他們選了我們學校，因為學校很現代化，而且學生很多。
name: 連接詞連接同類子句
sentences: My friend asked why I don't go to the new sports centre. I go to that gym because it's cheap and the trainers are friendly.
We're travelling with three children. We chose this hotel because it's near the beach and the rooms are big.
My sister worked at the restaurant for a year. She left her job because the pay was low and the hours were long.
I've lived in Hualien for ten years. I love this town because the people are kind and the food is great.
Tom missed the start of the meeting. He was late because the bus broke down and his phone died.
You spend too much on takeaways. If you want to save money and eat well, cook at home.
I'll pick you up from the hotel. When you arrive and you're ready, call me.
The wedding starts at two. If it rains or the bus is late, we'll take a taxi.
The hike is long, so listen to your body. If you're hungry or you feel tired, take a break.
My evenings start late. When the kids are asleep and the house is quiet, I read.
We can't afford a hotel this year. This summer we're visiting Japan and staying with friends.
My parents are visiting on Monday. I spent the weekend cleaning the house and washing the car.
My grandmother has lots of free time now. She enjoys painting and playing the piano.
We live in the city centre now. We're thinking of selling the car and buying a bike.
Ask my uncle about your broken bike. He's good at fixing things and solving problems.
I've been working abroad for a year. This Christmas I want to rest and see my family.
My cousin finishes university in June. She hopes to travel and learn new languages.
It was raining hard on Saturday night. We decided to stay home and watch a film.
My brother and his wife got married last spring. They plan to buy a house and start a family.
You could spend the summer either working in a café or helping on your uncle's farm.
A company in Singapore offered me a job. I can't decide whether to take the job or to stay here.
My wife fell asleep on the sofa. She was tired because she'd worked all day and hadn't eaten.
We didn't go out on New Year's Eve. We stayed in because it was cold and we had no money.
My dad goes to the countryside every summer. He likes walking in the hills and swimming in the lake.
The manager spoke to the new waiter. If you finish early and nobody needs you, go home.
We're asking students about their habits. Do you prefer to cook or to eat out?
The other students asked why I moved to London. I came here to study and to make new friends.
My sister always listens. When I'm sad or I feel lonely, I call her.
We left the big city last year. We moved here because the schools are good and the air is clean.
My great-aunt doesn't have a TV. She spends her evenings reading books or writing letters.

examples.heading: ① because + 子句 + and + 子句

items.en: My friend asked why I don't go to the new sports centre. I go to that gym because it's cheap and the trainers are friendly.
items.zh: 我朋友問我為什麼不去新的運動中心。我去那家健身房，因為很便宜，而且教練很友善。

items.en: We're travelling with three children. We chose this hotel because it's near the beach and the rooms are big.
items.zh: 我們帶著三個孩子旅行。我們選了這家飯店，因為離海灘近，而且房間很大。

items.en: My sister worked at the restaurant for a year. She left her job because the pay was low and the hours were long.
items.zh: 我姊姊在那家餐廳工作了一年。她辭掉工作，因為薪水低，而且工時長。

items.en: I've lived in Hualien for ten years. I love this town because the people are kind and the food is great.
items.zh: 我在花蓮住了十年。我很喜歡這個小鎮，因為這裡的人很親切，而且食物很好吃。

items.en: Tom missed the start of the meeting. He was late because the bus broke down and his phone died.
items.zh: 湯姆錯過了會議的開頭。他遲到了，因為公車拋錨，而且他的手機沒電了。

examples.heading: ② if / when + 子句 + and / or + 子句

items.en: You spend too much on takeaways. If you want to save money and eat well, cook at home.
items.zh: 你花太多錢買外帶了。如果你想省錢又想吃得好，就在家煮飯。

items.en: I'll pick you up from the hotel. When you arrive and you're ready, call me.
items.zh: 我會去飯店接你。你到了而且準備好的時候，打給我。

items.en: The wedding starts at two. If it rains or the bus is late, we'll take a taxi.
items.zh: 婚禮兩點開始。如果下雨或是公車誤點，我們就搭計程車。

items.en: The hike is long, so listen to your body. If you're hungry or you feel tired, take a break.
items.zh: 這段健行很長，所以要注意身體的感覺。如果你餓了或是覺得累，就休息一下。

items.en: My evenings start late. When the kids are asleep and the house is quiet, I read.
items.zh: 我的晚上很晚才開始。孩子們睡了、家裡安靜的時候，我會看書。

examples.heading: ③ 動詞-ing + and + 動詞-ing

items.en: We can't afford a hotel this year. This summer we're visiting Japan and staying with friends.
items.zh: 我們今年住不起飯店。今年夏天我們要去日本，住在朋友家。

items.en: My parents are visiting on Monday. I spent the weekend cleaning the house and washing the car.
items.zh: 我爸媽星期一要來。我週末都在打掃房子和洗車。

items.en: My grandmother has lots of free time now. She enjoys painting and playing the piano.
items.zh: 我奶奶現在有很多空閒時間。她喜歡畫畫和彈鋼琴。

items.en: We live in the city centre now. We're thinking of selling the car and buying a bike.
items.zh: 我們現在住在市中心。我們在考慮把車賣掉，買一台腳踏車。

items.en: Ask my uncle about your broken bike. He's good at fixing things and solving problems.
items.zh: 你的腳踏車壞了就問我叔叔。他很會修東西和解決問題。

examples.heading: ④ to 不定詞 + and + 不定詞

items.en: I've been working abroad for a year. This Christmas I want to rest and see my family.
items.zh: 我在國外工作了一年。今年聖誕節我想休息，也想見我的家人。

items.en: My cousin finishes university in June. She hopes to travel and learn new languages.
items.zh: 我表姊六月大學畢業。她希望能去旅行，學新的語言。

items.en: It was raining hard on Saturday night. We decided to stay home and watch a film.
items.zh: 星期六晚上雨下得很大。我們決定待在家看電影。

items.en: My brother and his wife got married last spring. They plan to buy a house and start a family.
items.zh: 我哥哥和他太太去年春天結婚。他們打算買房子，成家生小孩。

examples.heading: ⑤ either ... or 和不同的句型

items.en: You could spend the summer either working in a café or helping on your uncle's farm.
items.zh: 你暑假可以去咖啡店打工，或是去你叔叔的農場幫忙。

items.en: A company in Singapore offered me a job. I can't decide whether to take the job or to stay here.
items.zh: 新加坡一家公司給了我一份工作。我沒辦法決定要接那份工作，還是留在這裡。

items.en: My wife fell asleep on the sofa. She was tired because she'd worked all day and hadn't eaten.
items.zh: 我太太在沙發上睡著了。她很累，因為她工作了一整天，而且還沒吃東西。

items.en: We didn't go out on New Year's Eve. We stayed in because it was cold and we had no money.
items.zh: 我們跨年夜沒出門。我們待在家裡，因為很冷，而且我們沒錢。

items.en: My dad goes to the countryside every summer. He likes walking in the hills and swimming in the lake.
items.zh: 我爸爸每年夏天都去鄉下。他喜歡在山裡散步和在湖裡游泳。

items.en: The manager spoke to the new waiter. If you finish early and nobody needs you, go home.
items.zh: 經理跟新來的服務生說話。如果你提早做完而且沒人需要你，就回家吧。

items.en: We're asking students about their habits. Do you prefer to cook or to eat out?
items.zh: 我們在調查學生的習慣。你比較喜歡自己煮，還是外食？

items.en: The other students asked why I moved to London. I came here to study and to make new friends.
items.zh: 其他學生問我為什麼搬來倫敦。我來這裡是為了讀書和交新朋友。

items.en: My sister always listens. When I'm sad or I feel lonely, I call her.
items.zh: 我姊姊總是會聽我說。當我難過或是覺得孤單的時候，我就打給她。

items.en: We left the big city last year. We moved here because the schools are good and the air is clean.
items.zh: 我們去年離開了大城市。我們搬來這裡，因為學校很好，而且空氣乾淨。

items.en: My great-aunt doesn't have a TV. She spends her evenings reading books or writing letters.
items.zh: 我的姑婆沒有電視。她晚上都在看書或寫信。

title: It is much easier to be single than to have a partner.
translation: 單身比有伴侶輕鬆多了。
name: 比較級形容詞加 than 加非限定子句
sentences: For some people, it's easier to work alone than to work in a team.
The next bus is in forty minutes. It's quicker to walk than to wait for the bus.
Don't sign the form if you don't understand it. It's better to ask than to guess.
Come to Thailand with us next summer. It's more fun to travel with friends than to go alone.
The streets near the station are dark. It's safer to take a taxi than to walk home at night.
You and your neighbour are angry about the fence. It's more appropriate to talk first than to go to court.
All my friends from this job have gone. I'd find it harder to stay than to leave.
My grandfather always told us this. Nothing is more important than to be honest.
My sister wants a new laptop, but the sales start next month. She thinks it's wiser to wait than to buy now.
We need an answer from the hotel today. It's quicker to call than to write an email.
My boss asked me to work on Saturday. It was easier to say yes than to explain.
We need more staff at weekends. The new café is busier than expected.
We used the heater every day in January. Our electricity bill was higher than expected.
The builders found more problems with the roof. The repairs were more expensive than planned.
Everyone agreed quickly. The meeting finished earlier than planned.
There was a strong wind against us. The flight took longer than expected.
It rained every weekend of the festival. Ticket sales were lower than expected this year.
There's a football match in town. The roads are busier than usual today.
Your new job really suits you. You look happier than ever.
The air in the basement is bad. Don't stay longer than necessary.
I'm wearing my winter coat today. It's colder than usual for May.
We waited outside the bakery until ten. The shop opened later than usual.
You look worried about the bill. Was the hotel more expensive than expected?
My aunt still won't speak to her brother. It's often harder to forgive than to forget.
Two of our engineers are ill. The project will take longer than planned.
We all slept until seven. The baby was quieter than usual last night.
Leave home at seven for your interview. It's better to arrive early than to be late.
We didn't need our jackets on the walk. The weather was warmer than forecast.
The shop is only ten minutes away. For short distances, it's healthier to walk than to drive.
We're thinking of moving to Lisbon. Is it cheaper to rent than to buy there?

examples.heading: ① It + be + 比較級 + to 不定詞 + than + to 不定詞

items.en: For some people, it's easier to work alone than to work in a team.
items.zh: 對有些人來說，自己工作比團隊合作容易。

items.en: The next bus is in forty minutes. It's quicker to walk than to wait for the bus.
items.zh: 下一班公車要四十分鐘後才來。走路比等公車快。

items.en: Don't sign the form if you don't understand it. It's better to ask than to guess.
items.zh: 看不懂表格就別簽。問清楚比用猜的好。

items.en: Come to Thailand with us next summer. It's more fun to travel with friends than to go alone.
items.zh: 明年夏天跟我們一起去泰國吧。跟朋友旅行比自己去好玩。

items.en: The streets near the station are dark. It's safer to take a taxi than to walk home at night.
items.zh: 車站附近的街道很暗。晚上搭計程車比走路回家安全。

items.en: You and your neighbour are angry about the fence. It's more appropriate to talk first than to go to court.
items.zh: 你和你的鄰居為了圍籬在生氣。先談談比上法院恰當。

examples.heading: ② 比較級 + than + to 不定詞（其他句型）

items.en: All my friends from this job have gone. I'd find it harder to stay than to leave.
items.zh: 我在這份工作的朋友都走了。我覺得留下來比離開難。

items.en: My grandfather always told us this. Nothing is more important than to be honest.
items.zh: 我爺爺總是跟我們說這句話。沒有什麼比誠實更重要。

items.en: My sister wants a new laptop, but the sales start next month. She thinks it's wiser to wait than to buy now.
items.zh: 我姊姊想買新筆電，可是特價下個月才開始。她覺得等一等比現在買明智。

items.en: We need an answer from the hotel today. It's quicker to call than to write an email.
items.zh: 我們今天就需要飯店的回覆。打電話比寫電子郵件快。

items.en: My boss asked me to work on Saturday. It was easier to say yes than to explain.
items.zh: 我老闆要我星期六上班。說好比解釋容易。

examples.heading: ③ 比較級 + than expected / planned

items.en: We need more staff at weekends. The new café is busier than expected.
items.zh: 我們週末需要更多人手。新咖啡店比預期的熱鬧。

items.en: We used the heater every day in January. Our electricity bill was higher than expected.
items.zh: 我們一月每天都開暖氣。我們的電費比預期的高。

items.en: The builders found more problems with the roof. The repairs were more expensive than planned.
items.zh: 工人發現屋頂有更多問題。修理費比計畫的貴。

items.en: Everyone agreed quickly. The meeting finished earlier than planned.
items.zh: 大家很快就同意了。會議比計畫的早結束。

items.en: There was a strong wind against us. The flight took longer than expected.
items.zh: 我們遇到很強的逆風。飛行時間比預期的長。

items.en: It rained every weekend of the festival. Ticket sales were lower than expected this year.
items.zh: 音樂節每個週末都在下雨。今年的票房比預期的低。

examples.heading: ④ 比較級 + than usual / ever / necessary

items.en: There's a football match in town. The roads are busier than usual today.
items.zh: 鎮上有一場足球賽。今天路上的車比平常多。

items.en: Your new job really suits you. You look happier than ever.
items.zh: 你的新工作真的很適合你。你看起來比以前都開心。

items.en: The air in the basement is bad. Don't stay longer than necessary.
items.zh: 地下室的空氣不好。不要待得比需要的久。

items.en: I'm wearing my winter coat today. It's colder than usual for May.
items.zh: 我今天穿冬天的大衣。以五月來說，今天比平常冷。

items.en: We waited outside the bakery until ten. The shop opened later than usual.
items.zh: 我們在麵包店外面等到十點。那家店比平常晚開門。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: You look worried about the bill. Was the hotel more expensive than expected?
items.zh: 你看起來在擔心帳單。那家飯店比預期的貴嗎？

items.en: My aunt still won't speak to her brother. It's often harder to forgive than to forget.
items.zh: 我阿姨還是不肯跟她哥哥說話。原諒常常比忘記難。

items.en: Two of our engineers are ill. The project will take longer than planned.
items.zh: 我們有兩個工程師生病了。這個專案會比計畫的久。

items.en: We all slept until seven. The baby was quieter than usual last night.
items.zh: 我們都睡到七點。寶寶昨晚比平常安靜。

items.en: Leave home at seven for your interview. It's better to arrive early than to be late.
items.zh: 面試那天七點就出門。早到總比遲到好。

items.en: We didn't need our jackets on the walk. The weather was warmer than forecast.
items.zh: 我們散步的時候不需要外套。天氣比預報的暖和。

items.en: The shop is only ten minutes away. For short distances, it's healthier to walk than to drive.
items.zh: 那家店只要十分鐘。短距離走路比開車健康。

items.en: We're thinking of moving to Lisbon. Is it cheaper to rent than to buy there?
items.zh: 我們在考慮搬到里斯本。在那裡租房子比買房子便宜嗎？

title: I bought some clothes that I will need for my trip to Greece.
translation: 我買了一些去希臘旅行會用到的衣服。

examples.heading: ① the + 東西 + that + 主詞 + 動詞

items.zh: 你為派對做的檸檬派很好吃。

items.en: The team that I like is called The Lions.
items.zh: 我喜歡的那支隊伍叫獅子隊。

items.en: The book that I'm reading is very funny.
items.zh: 我正在看的那本書很好笑。

items.en: The boots that I ordered online are too small.

items.en: The film that we saw last night was great.
items.zh: 我們昨晚看的那部電影很好看。

items.en: The song that she sang made everyone cry.
items.zh: 她唱的那首歌讓大家都哭了。

examples.heading: ② some / a + 東西 + that ...

items.en: I bought some snacks that we can eat on the train.
items.zh: 我買了一些可以在火車上吃的零食。

items.en: Use an old sheet that you can throw away later.
items.zh: 用一條之後可以丟掉的舊床單。

items.en: He found a wallet that someone had lost.
items.zh: 他撿到一個別人掉的皮夾。

items.en: She made a cake that everyone loved.
items.zh: 她做了一個大家都愛的蛋糕。

items.en: I need a pen that I can write with.
items.zh: 我需要一支可以寫字的筆。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + that + 主詞 + 動詞 + 其他

items.en: The hotel that we booked is near the beach.
items.zh: 我們訂的飯店靠近海邊。

items.en: The present that my aunt sent arrived today.
items.zh: 我阿姨寄的禮物今天到了。

items.en: The bus that I usually take was late.
items.zh: 我平常搭的那班公車誤點了。

items.en: Is this the jacket that you lost?
items.zh: 這是你弄丟的那件夾克嗎？

items.en: The photos that you took are beautiful.
items.zh: 你拍的照片好漂亮。

examples.heading: ④ everything / something / all + that ...

items.en: Thank you for everything that you've done.
items.zh: 謝謝你為我做的一切。

items.en: Is there any job in the kitchen that I can do for you?
items.zh: 廚房裡有什麼我能幫你做的事嗎？

items.en: That's all that I know.
items.zh: 我知道的就只有這些。

items.en: Tell me something that you remember about her.
items.zh: 跟我說一件你記得的關於她的事。

items.en: The only thing that I want is some sleep.
items.zh: 我唯一想要的就是睡一下。

examples.heading: ⑤ that 指人和不同的句型

items.en: The man that we met at the party is a pilot.
items.zh: 我們在派對上認識的那個男人是機師。

items.en: The teacher that I liked most was Mr. Lee.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的老師是李老師。

items.en: Who's the girl that you were talking to?
items.zh: 剛剛跟你說話的那個女孩是誰？

items.en: The doctor that I saw was very kind.
items.zh: 幫我看病的那位醫生人很好。

items.en: The friends that I made at school are still close.
items.zh: 我在學校交的朋友現在還是很要好。

items.en: The restaurant that you recommended was full.
items.zh: 你推薦的那家餐廳客滿了。

items.en: The money that I saved is for the trip.
items.zh: 我存的錢是要拿去旅行的。

items.en: The pizza that we ordered hasn't come yet.
items.zh: 我們點的披薩還沒來。

items.en: This is the house that my grandfather built.
items.zh: 這是我爺爺蓋的房子。

title: The coffee cup which my good friend gave me is pretty.
translation: 我好朋友送我的那個咖啡杯很漂亮。

sentences: The soup which my mother makes on cold days is the best.

The present which you chose for Dad was perfect.
The emails which our boss sends at midnight are really annoying.
The color which I like best is dark green.
I can't find the earrings which my sister lent me.
Have you read the article which I shared yesterday?
She still has the teddy bear which her grandfather won at the fair.
We finally fixed the window which the storm damaged.
Please return the books which you borrowed from the library.
I'll never forget the trip which we took to Hualien.
The key which I was looking for was in my coat pocket.
Is this the course which you applied for?
The hotel which we stayed at had a lovely pool.
That's the problem which I was talking about.
The concert which we paid for got cancelled.
The movie that we saw on Friday was too long.
Where's the cheese that I bought this morning?

The bike that my uncle gave me is too small now.
The cookies which you're baking smell wonderful.

The language which I'd most like to learn is Japanese.

The photos which you've posted are amazing.
The wry comment which she made in the meeting made everyone laugh.
Can I see the dress which you're wearing to the party?
The medicine which the doctor gave me makes me sleepy.

examples.heading: ① 子句在主詞後面

items.en: The soup which my mother makes on cold days is the best.
items.zh: 我媽媽冷天煮的湯最好喝。

items.en: The shoes which I wore to the wedding hurt my feet.
items.zh: 我穿去婚禮的那雙鞋讓我腳很痛。

items.en: The car which they rented broke down on the highway.
items.zh: 他們租的那輛車在高速公路上拋錨了。

items.en: The present which you chose for Dad was perfect.
items.zh: 你幫爸爸挑的禮物太完美了。

items.en: The emails which our boss sends at midnight are really annoying.
items.zh: 我們老闆半夜寄的那些電子郵件真的很煩。

items.en: The color which I like best is dark green.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是深綠色。

examples.heading: ② 子句在句尾

items.en: I can't find the earrings which my sister lent me.
items.zh: 我找不到我姊姊借我的那對耳環。

items.en: Have you read the article which I shared yesterday?
items.zh: 你看了我昨天分享的那篇文章嗎？

items.en: She still has the teddy bear which her grandfather won at the fair.
items.zh: 她還留著她爺爺在園遊會贏來的那隻泰迪熊。

items.en: We finally fixed the window which the storm damaged.
items.zh: 我們終於修好了被暴風雨弄壞的那扇窗。

items.en: Please return the books which you borrowed from the library.
items.zh: 請把你跟圖書館借的書還回去。

items.en: I'll never forget the trip which we took to Hualien.
items.zh: 我永遠不會忘記我們去花蓮的那趟旅行。

examples.heading: ③ 子句動詞後面接介系詞

items.en: The key which I was looking for was in my coat pocket.
items.zh: 我在找的那把鑰匙在我外套口袋裡。

items.en: Is this the course which you applied for?
items.zh: 這是你申請的那門課嗎？

items.en: The hotel which we stayed at had a lovely pool.
items.zh: 我們住的那家飯店有一座很棒的游泳池。

items.en: That's the problem which I was talking about.
items.zh: 那就是我剛剛說的問題。

items.en: The concert which we paid for got cancelled.
items.zh: 我們付了錢的那場演唱會取消了。

examples.heading: ④ which 換成 that

items.en: The movie that we saw on Friday was too long.
items.zh: 我們星期五看的那部電影太長了。

items.en: Where's the cheese that I bought this morning?
items.zh: 我今天早上買的起司在哪裡？

items.en: The plan that the team suggested sounds good.
items.zh: 團隊提出的計畫聽起來不錯。

items.en: The bike that my uncle gave me is too small now.
items.zh: 我叔叔送我的腳踏車現在太小了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和情境

items.en: The cookies which you're baking smell wonderful.
items.zh: 你在烤的餅乾聞起來好香。

items.en: The exam which I failed last spring is on Monday again.
items.zh: 我去年春天沒過的那個考試星期一又要考了。

items.en: The house which they're building next door will have three floors.
items.zh: 他們在隔壁蓋的房子會有三層樓。

items.en: The language which I'd most like to learn is Japanese.
items.zh: 我最想學的語言是日文。

items.en: The jokes which he told at dinner weren't funny at all.
items.zh: 他晚餐時講的笑話一點都不好笑。

items.en: The photos which you've posted are amazing.
items.zh: 你貼的照片好漂亮。

items.en: The wry comment which she made in the meeting made everyone laugh.
items.zh: 她在會議上說的那句挖苦話讓大家都笑了。

items.en: Can I see the dress which you're wearing to the party?
items.zh: 我可以看你要穿去派對的那件洋裝嗎？

items.en: The medicine which the doctor gave me makes me sleepy.
items.zh: 醫生開給我的藥讓我想睡覺。

title: My friends are the people who I love most.
translation: 我的朋友就是我最愛的人。

items.zh: 他是那種大家都有點怕的老闆。

items.zh: 我喜歡會讓我笑的電影。

items.en: They sell vegetables which come from local farms.
items.zh: 他們賣的蔬菜來自當地的農場。

items.en: Buy shoes which are comfortable for walking.
items.zh: 買走路很舒服的鞋子。

items.en: Avoid food which has a lot of sugar.
items.zh: 避免吃含糖量高的食物。

examples.heading: ③ the + 東西 + which ...

items.en: The bus which goes to the airport leaves at six.
items.zh: 開往機場的公車六點開。

items.en: The shoes which are on the left are mine.
items.zh: 左邊那雙鞋是我的。

items.en: The road which goes to the beach is closed.
items.zh: 通往海邊的那條路封閉了。

items.en: Where's the book which was on my desk?
items.zh: 本來在我桌上的那本書在哪裡？

items.en: The train which arrives at ten is always late.
items.zh: 十點到的那班火車總是誤點。

examples.heading: ④ that 代替 which

items.en: I want a car that uses less petrol.
items.zh: 我想要一輛比較省油的車。

items.en: This is the key that opens the back door.
items.zh: 這是開後門的鑰匙。

items.en: Is there a bus that stops near the museum?
items.zh: 有停在博物館附近的公車嗎？

items.en: They have a dog that barks all night.
items.zh: 他們養了一隻整晚都在叫的狗。

items.en: I need an app that tells me the train times.
items.zh: 我需要一個會告訴我火車時刻的 app。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: The storm which hit the town last night broke many windows.
items.zh: 昨晚襲擊小鎮的暴風雨打破了很多窗戶。

items.en: It's a machine which makes coffee and tea.
items.zh: 那是一台可以煮咖啡和泡茶的機器。

items.en: The plants which grow in the shade need less water.
items.zh: 長在陰涼處的植物需要比較少的水。

items.en: Is this the bus which goes to the zoo?
items.zh: 這是去動物園的公車嗎？

items.en: The house which stood here was very old.
items.zh: 以前在這裡的那棟房子很老。

items.en: A song which always makes me smile is on the radio.
items.zh: 收音機正在播一首總是讓我微笑的歌。

items.en: The shop which sold cheap books has closed.
items.zh: 那家賣便宜書的店關了。

items.en: Food which is fresh tastes better.
items.zh: 新鮮的食物比較好吃。

items.en: The email which arrived this morning was from my boss.
items.zh: 今天早上收到的那封電子郵件是我老闆寄的。

title: I'd like a pen friend who really likes music and reading.
translation: 我想找一個很喜歡音樂和閱讀的筆友。
name: who 當主詞的限定關係子句
sentences: We want a babysitter who loves animals.
I know a girl who speaks five languages.
We need someone who can drive.
She's a teacher who really cares about her students.
It's a film about a man who sailed around the world alone.
I have a friend who lives in Spain.
I agree with people who think the park should stay free.
People who smoke get ill more often.
I don't like people who talk during films.
People who live in the city often work long hours.
There are many people who help at the festival.
The man who lives above us plays the piano every night.
The woman who called you is my aunt.
The boy who won the race is only ten.
Do you know the girl who sits next to Ken?
The students who handed in their projects late lost points.
Anyone who wants a free ticket should email me today.
Is there someone who can help me?
Everyone who came to the party had fun.
I don't know anyone who likes this song.
Someone who works here found my wallet.
The nurse who looked after me was very kind.
He's the player who scored the goal.
Who's the man who is talking to your mother?
I'm looking for someone who has seen my cat.
The people who were on the bus were all tourists.
Children who read a lot usually write well.
The driver who hit my car said sorry.
She's the one who told me about the job.
A friend who helps you is a real friend.

examples.heading: ① a / an + 人 + who ...

items.en: We want a babysitter who loves animals.
items.zh: 我們想找一個喜歡動物的保母。

items.en: I know a girl who speaks five languages.
items.zh: 我認識一個會說五種語言的女孩。

items.en: We need someone who can drive.
items.zh: 我們需要一個會開車的人。

items.en: She's a teacher who really cares about her students.
items.zh: 她是個真心關心學生的老師。

items.en: It's a film about a man who sailed around the world alone.
items.zh: 那是一部關於一個人獨自環遊世界的電影。

items.en: I have a friend who lives in Spain.
items.zh: 我有一個住在西班牙的朋友。

examples.heading: ② people + who ...

items.en: I agree with people who think the park should stay free.
items.zh: 我同意那些認為公園應該繼續免費的人。

items.en: People who smoke get ill more often.
items.zh: 抽菸的人比較常生病。

items.en: I don't like people who talk during films.
items.zh: 我不喜歡看電影時講話的人。

items.en: People who live in the city often work long hours.
items.zh: 住在城市裡的人常常工作很長的時間。

items.en: There are many people who help at the festival.
items.zh: 有很多人在節慶上幫忙。

examples.heading: ③ the + 人 + who ...

items.en: The man who lives above us plays the piano every night.
items.zh: 住在我們樓上的那個男人每天晚上都彈鋼琴。

items.en: The woman who called you is my aunt.
items.zh: 打電話給你的那個女人是我阿姨。

items.en: The boy who won the race is only ten.
items.zh: 贏得比賽的那個男孩才十歲。

items.en: Do you know the girl who sits next to Ken?
items.zh: 你認識坐在 Ken 旁邊的那個女孩嗎？

items.en: The students who handed in their projects late lost points.
items.zh: 專題遲交的學生被扣分了。

examples.heading: ④ anyone / someone / everyone + who ...

items.en: Anyone who wants a free ticket should email me today.
items.zh: 想要免費門票的人，今天寄電子郵件給我。

items.en: Is there someone who can help me?
items.zh: 有人可以幫我嗎？

items.en: Everyone who came to the party had fun.
items.zh: 來派對的每個人都玩得很開心。

items.en: I don't know anyone who likes this song.
items.zh: 我不認識喜歡這首歌的人。

items.en: Someone who works here found my wallet.
items.zh: 在這裡工作的人找到了我的皮夾。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: The nurse who looked after me was very kind.
items.zh: 照顧我的那位護理師人很好。

items.en: He's the player who scored the goal.
items.zh: 他就是進球的那個球員。

items.en: Who's the man who is talking to your mother?
items.zh: 正在跟你媽媽說話的那個男人是誰？

items.en: I'm looking for someone who has seen my cat.
items.zh: 我在找有看到我的貓的人。

items.en: The people who were on the bus were all tourists.
items.zh: 公車上的人都是觀光客。

items.en: Children who read a lot usually write well.
items.zh: 常讀書的小孩通常寫作都不錯。

items.en: The driver who hit my car said sorry.
items.zh: 撞到我車子的那個司機道了歉。

items.en: She's the one who told me about the job.
items.zh: 就是她跟我說那份工作的事。

items.en: A friend who helps you is a real friend.
items.zh: 會幫你的朋友才是真正的朋友。

title: Either I talk to her now or I won't ever be able to talk to her.
translation: 我要嘛現在就跟她談，要嘛就永遠沒辦法跟她談了。
name: either … or 連接兩個主要子句
sentences: The concert tickets are twenty pounds. Either you pay now or you pay at the door.
It's ten past eight, and nobody is at the stop. Either the bus is late or I've missed it.
My brother isn't answering his phone. Either he's at work or he's asleep.
Mum needs to know about the broken window. Either you tell her the truth or I will.
The bakery's windows are empty. Either the shop is closed or it's moved.
Our friends said they'd meet us at the gate. Either they're late or we're at the wrong station.
Let's talk about the plan on Saturday. We can either meet at the café or come to your house.
The doctor says you need more exercise. You can either take a yoga class or swim twice a week.
Nobody wants to cook tonight. We could either eat out or order a pizza.
The hotel receptionist gave me two choices. You can either pay now or pay later.
The doctor is very busy today. The patients can either wait here or come back tomorrow.
She sent you a birthday present. You should either call your aunt or write her a card.
You made your sister cry. You should either apologize to her or keep quiet.
It's been in the garage for a year. We should either fix the car or sell it.
The new manager cancelled the trip without a reason. She should either change her mind or explain.
My weekends are quiet. On Sundays I either read or go for a walk.
My husband is never home before nine. He either works late or plays football after work.
My daughter never walks. She either takes the bus or rides her bike to school.
My cat is very lazy. She either sleeps or eats all day.
We don't travel much. We either stay at home or visit my grandparents at the weekend.
Your phone was on this table an hour ago. Either you lost it or someone took it.
Take your boots on the trip. Either it'll rain or it'll snow tomorrow.
Try this blue cheese. You'll either love it or hate it.
I won't go to the party without you. Either we go together or we don't go at all.
Don't worry about your results. The doctor will either call you tonight or send a text.
Anna isn't here yet. Either she missed the bus or she forgot about the meeting.
We haven't booked our trip yet. We'll either fly or take the train to Kaohsiung.
The map shows a bridge here, but I can only see water. Either I'm wrong or this map is wrong.
Your homework is full of mistakes. You either do it properly or you don't do it.
The screen won't turn on. Either the battery is dead or the phone is broken.

examples.heading: ① Either + 主要子句 + or + 主要子句

items.en: The concert tickets are twenty pounds. Either you pay now or you pay at the door.
items.zh: 音樂會的票二十英鎊。你要嘛現在付，要嘛在門口付。

items.en: It's ten past eight, and nobody is at the stop. Either the bus is late or I've missed it.
items.zh: 已經八點十分了，公車站一個人都沒有。不是公車誤點，就是我錯過了。

items.en: My brother isn't answering his phone. Either he's at work or he's asleep.
items.zh: 我哥哥不接電話。他不是在上班，就是在睡覺。

items.en: Mum needs to know about the broken window. Either you tell her the truth or I will.
items.zh: 媽媽需要知道窗戶破掉的事。你要嘛告訴她實話，要嘛就由我來說。

items.en: The bakery's windows are empty. Either the shop is closed or it's moved.
items.zh: 麵包店的櫥窗是空的。那家店不是關了，就是搬走了。

items.en: Our friends said they'd meet us at the gate. Either they're late or we're at the wrong station.
items.zh: 我們的朋友說會在閘門跟我們碰面。不是他們遲到了，就是我們走錯車站了。

examples.heading: ② can / could + either + 動詞 + or + 動詞

items.en: Let's talk about the plan on Saturday. We can either meet at the café or come to your house.
items.zh: 我們星期六談計畫吧。我們可以在咖啡店碰面，或是去你家。

items.en: The doctor says you need more exercise. You can either take a yoga class or swim twice a week.
items.zh: 醫生說你需要多運動。你可以上瑜伽課，或是一週游泳兩次。

items.en: Nobody wants to cook tonight. We could either eat out or order a pizza.
items.zh: 今晚沒有人想煮飯。我們可以出去吃，或是叫披薩。

items.en: The hotel receptionist gave me two choices. You can either pay now or pay later.
items.zh: 飯店的櫃台人員給我兩個選擇。你可以現在付，或是晚點付。

items.en: The doctor is very busy today. The patients can either wait here or come back tomorrow.
items.zh: 醫生今天很忙。病人可以在這裡等，或是明天再來。

examples.heading: ③ should + either + 動詞 + or + 動詞

items.en: She sent you a birthday present. You should either call your aunt or write her a card.
items.zh: 她送了你生日禮物。你應該打給你阿姨，或是寫張卡片給她。

items.en: You made your sister cry. You should either apologize to her or keep quiet.
items.zh: 你把你妹妹弄哭了。你應該跟她道歉，不然就別說話。

items.en: It's been in the garage for a year. We should either fix the car or sell it.
items.zh: 它已經在車庫裡放了一年。我們應該把車修好，或是賣掉。

items.en: The new manager cancelled the trip without a reason. She should either change her mind or explain.
items.zh: 新經理沒有理由就取消了旅行。她應該改變主意，或是解釋清楚。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + either + 動詞 + or + 動詞

items.en: My weekends are quiet. On Sundays I either read or go for a walk.
items.zh: 我的週末很安靜。星期天我不是看書，就是去散步。

items.en: My husband is never home before nine. He either works late or plays football after work.
items.zh: 我先生從來不會九點前回家。他下班後不是加班，就是去踢足球。

items.en: My daughter never walks. She either takes the bus or rides her bike to school.
items.zh: 我女兒從來不走路。她不是搭公車，就是騎腳踏車上學。

items.en: My cat is very lazy. She either sleeps or eats all day.
items.zh: 我的貓很懶。她整天不是睡覺就是吃東西。

items.en: We don't travel much. We either stay at home or visit my grandparents at the weekend.
items.zh: 我們不常旅行。週末我們不是待在家，就是去看我爺爺奶奶。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: Your phone was on this table an hour ago. Either you lost it or someone took it.
items.zh: 你的手機一個小時前還在這張桌上。不是你弄丟了，就是有人拿走了。

items.en: Take your boots on the trip. Either it'll rain or it'll snow tomorrow.
items.zh: 旅行帶你的靴子。明天不是下雨就是下雪。

items.en: Try this blue cheese. You'll either love it or hate it.
items.zh: 吃吃看這個藍紋起司。你要嘛超愛，要嘛超討厭。

items.en: I won't go to the party without you. Either we go together or we don't go at all.
items.zh: 沒有你我不去派對。我們要嘛一起去，要嘛都不去。

items.en: Don't worry about your results. The doctor will either call you tonight or send a text.
items.zh: 別擔心你的檢查結果。醫生今晚會打給你，或是傳簡訊。

items.en: Anna isn't here yet. Either she missed the bus or she forgot about the meeting.
items.zh: 安娜還沒到。她不是錯過了公車，就是忘了開會的事。

items.en: We haven't booked our trip yet. We'll either fly or take the train to Kaohsiung.
items.zh: 我們還沒訂行程。我們會搭飛機或是搭火車去高雄。

items.en: The map shows a bridge here, but I can only see water. Either I'm wrong or this map is wrong.
items.zh: 地圖上這裡有一座橋，可是我只看到水。不是我錯了，就是這張地圖錯了。

items.en: Your homework is full of mistakes. You either do it properly or you don't do it.
items.zh: 你的作業錯一堆。你要嘛就好好做，要嘛就別做。

items.en: The screen won't turn on. Either the battery is dead or the phone is broken.
items.zh: 螢幕打不開。不是電池沒電了，就是手機壞了。

title: Meals are served, if requested, three times a day.
translation: 如有需要，每天可供應三餐。
name: if 加過去分詞的省略條件子句
sentences: If kept in a cool, dry place, the coffee stays fresh for months.
If swallowed, this liquid is injurious to health.
If left untreated, the infection could degenerate into something serious.
If asked about the accident, just tell the truth.
If cooked slowly, the beef becomes very tender.
If accepted, you will start the course in September.
If resolved quickly, the dispute won't affect the sale.
The tickets, if bought online, cost ten pounds less.
This dress, if washed carefully, will last for years.
The plan, if approved, will create two hundred jobs.
The old contract, if annulled, would no longer bind either company.
Your comments, if given honestly, will help us a lot.
A testimonial, if written by a former boss, carries a lot of weight.
I can work on Saturday if needed.
The doctor will call you back if required.
Children can join the tour if accompanied by an adult.
The medicine works better if taken with food.
Peppers taste great if stuffed with rice and cheese.
The fabric loses its iridescent shine if exposed to strong sunlight.
She always answers with great candor if asked about her past.
If not stored properly, the vaccine becomes useless.
If not paid by Friday, the bill will double.
The seeds won't grow if not watered every day.
If not booked in advance, the tour is often full.
The offer, if not accepted within a week, will be withdrawn.
If damaged during delivery, the item can be returned free of charge.
Refunds, if requested, are paid within five working days.
If used as directed, the spray is safe for children.
If divided equally, the money comes to two thousand pounds each.
I'd love to go to the wedding if invited.
These cookies are delicious if dipped in hot chocolate.
If caught, the kids will be in serious trouble.

examples.heading: ① 放在句首

items.en: If kept in a cool, dry place, the coffee stays fresh for months.
items.zh: 如果放在陰涼乾燥的地方，咖啡可以新鮮好幾個月。

items.en: If swallowed, this liquid is injurious to health.
items.zh: 如果吞下去，這種液體會傷害健康。

items.en: If left untreated, the infection could degenerate into something serious.
items.zh: 如果不治療，感染可能惡化成嚴重的病。

items.en: If asked about the accident, just tell the truth.
items.zh: 如果被問到那場意外，就照實說。

items.en: If cooked slowly, the beef becomes very tender.
items.zh: 如果用小火慢慢煮，牛肉會變得很嫩。

items.en: If accepted, you will start the course in September.
items.zh: 如果被錄取，你九月開始上課。

items.en: If resolved quickly, the dispute won't affect the sale.
items.zh: 如果很快解決，這場糾紛不會影響這筆買賣。

examples.heading: ② 放在句中

items.en: The tickets, if bought online, cost ten pounds less.
items.zh: 這些票如果在網路上買，便宜十英鎊。

items.en: This dress, if washed carefully, will last for years.
items.zh: 這件洋裝如果小心洗，可以穿好幾年。

items.en: The plan, if approved, will create two hundred jobs.
items.zh: 這個計畫如果通過，會創造兩百個工作機會。

items.en: The old contract, if annulled, would no longer bind either company.
items.zh: 舊合約如果撤銷，就不再約束兩家公司。

items.en: Your comments, if given honestly, will help us a lot.
items.zh: 你的意見如果坦白說出來，對我們幫助很大。

items.en: A testimonial, if written by a former boss, carries a lot of weight.
items.zh: 推薦信如果是前上司寫的，很有份量。

examples.heading: ③ 放在句尾

items.en: I can work on Saturday if needed.
items.zh: 需要的話，我星期六可以上班。

items.en: The doctor will call you back if required.
items.zh: 必要的話，醫生會回電給你。

items.en: Children can join the tour if accompanied by an adult.
items.zh: 如果有大人陪同，兒童可以參加導覽。

items.en: The medicine works better if taken with food.
items.zh: 這種藥如果跟食物一起服用，效果比較好。

items.en: Peppers taste great if stuffed with rice and cheese.
items.zh: 甜椒如果塞進米飯和起司，非常好吃。

items.en: The fabric loses its iridescent shine if exposed to strong sunlight.
items.zh: 這種布料如果曬到強烈的陽光，就會失去彩虹般的光澤。

items.en: She always answers with great candor if asked about her past.
items.zh: 如果被問到過去，她總是很坦白地回答。

examples.heading: ④ if not

items.en: If not stored properly, the vaccine becomes useless.
items.zh: 如果保存不當，疫苗就沒用了。

items.en: If not paid by Friday, the bill will double.
items.zh: 如果星期五前沒付，帳單金額會變兩倍。

items.en: The seeds won't grow if not watered every day.
items.zh: 種子如果沒有每天澆水，就不會長。

items.en: If not booked in advance, the tour is often full.
items.zh: 如果沒有提前預訂，導覽常常已經額滿。

items.en: The offer, if not accepted within a week, will be withdrawn.
items.zh: 這個提議如果一週內沒有接受，就會撤回。（被動）

examples.heading: ⑤ 說明書和公告

items.en: If damaged during delivery, the item can be returned free of charge.
items.zh: 如果在運送時損壞，商品可以免費退回。（被動）

items.en: Refunds, if requested, are paid within five working days.
items.zh: 如有要求，退款會在五個工作天內付清。（被動）

items.en: If used as directed, the spray is safe for children.
items.zh: 如果照指示使用，這種噴霧對兒童是安全的。

items.en: If divided equally, the money comes to two thousand pounds each.
items.zh: 如果平分，這筆錢每人可以分到兩千英鎊。

examples.heading: ⑥ 日常對話

items.en: I'd love to go to the wedding if invited.
items.zh: 如果受到邀請，我很想去參加婚禮。

items.en: These cookies are delicious if dipped in hot chocolate.
items.zh: 這些餅乾如果沾熱巧克力吃，非常好吃。

items.en: If caught, the kids will be in serious trouble.
items.zh: 如果被抓到，這些孩子會有大麻煩。

title: He is almost 60 years old, but he's faster than you can imagine.
translation: 他快 60 歲了，可是他比你想像的還快。
name: than 後接限定子句
sentences: I failed my driving test twice. Learning to drive was harder than I expected.
They charged us for the minibar and parking. The hotel bill was bigger than we expected.
We got lost twice in the mountains. The trip took longer than we planned.
Don't be shy at the interview. Your English is better than you think.
The beach near our hotel was cleaner than the photos suggested.
The council spent three times its budget. The new bridge cost more than anyone could imagine.
Many classrooms have no heating in winter. I wish our schools could be better than they are.
There are new shops and a cinema now. The town is busier than it was ten years ago.
The mirrors on the wall help. The room looks bigger than it really is.
A coffee costs five dollars now. Prices are higher than they used to be.
The factory stopped putting waste in the water. The river is cleaner than it was last year.
He's eighty, but Grandpa still walks faster than we do.
Let Anna order for us in Paris. She speaks French better than Tom does.
Our cousins took the fast train. They arrived earlier than we did.
My sister and I had a race to the island. I can swim farther than she can.
You're still at your desk at nine every night. You work harder than I do.
My sister is only twelve, but she's taller than I am.
Our neighbours have a new oven and a big fridge. Their kitchen is more modern than ours is.
Can you help Grandma with her new phone? You're more patient than I am.
I can hardly feel it in my pocket. The new phones are lighter than the old ones were.
They always say hello and bring us cake. Our neighbors are friendlier than we are.
We didn't get home until midnight. The film was longer than I had expected.
Wear your thick coat. It's colder today than it was yesterday.
You'll work nights and weekends at the hospital. The job will be harder than you think.
You look tired after your first piano lesson. Was it more difficult than you expected?
Rent takes half my salary. Life in the city is more expensive than people realize.
The restaurant looked very smart. But the meal cost less than we had feared.
Our youngest son starts university this year. The kids grew up faster than we wanted.
My niece is quiet in class, but she's smarter than most people think.
We've already finished the first stage. The project is going better than anyone hoped.

examples.heading: ① than I thought / than we expected

items.en: I failed my driving test twice. Learning to drive was harder than I expected.
items.zh: 我駕照考了兩次都沒過。學開車比我預期的難。

items.en: They charged us for the minibar and parking. The hotel bill was bigger than we expected.
items.zh: 他們跟我們收了小冰箱和停車的錢。飯店的帳單比我們預期的多。

items.en: We got lost twice in the mountains. The trip took longer than we planned.
items.zh: 我們在山裡迷路了兩次。這趟旅行花的時間比我們計畫的長。

items.en: Don't be shy at the interview. Your English is better than you think.
items.zh: 面試的時候別害羞。你的英文比你以為的好。

items.en: The beach near our hotel was cleaner than the photos suggested.
items.zh: 我們飯店附近的海灘比照片看起來的還乾淨。

items.en: The council spent three times its budget. The new bridge cost more than anyone could imagine.
items.zh: 市議會花了三倍的預算。新橋的造價比任何人想像的都高。

examples.heading: ② than it was / than they are

items.en: Many classrooms have no heating in winter. I wish our schools could be better than they are.
items.zh: 很多教室冬天沒有暖氣。我希望我們的學校能比現在更好。

items.en: There are new shops and a cinema now. The town is busier than it was ten years ago.
items.zh: 現在有新的商店和一家電影院。這個小鎮比十年前熱鬧。

items.en: The mirrors on the wall help. The room looks bigger than it really is.
items.zh: 牆上的鏡子有幫助。這個房間看起來比實際上大。

items.en: A coffee costs five dollars now. Prices are higher than they used to be.
items.zh: 一杯咖啡現在要五塊。物價比以前高。

items.en: The factory stopped putting waste in the water. The river is cleaner than it was last year.
items.zh: 工廠不再把廢水排進水裡。這條河比去年乾淨。

examples.heading: ③ than + 主詞 + 助動詞

items.zh: 他八十歲了，可是爺爺走得還是比我們快。

items.en: Let Anna order for us in Paris. She speaks French better than Tom does.
items.zh: 在巴黎讓安娜幫我們點菜。她的法文說得比湯姆好。

items.en: Our cousins took the fast train. They arrived earlier than we did.
items.zh: 我們的表親搭快車。他們比我們早到。

items.en: My sister and I had a race to the island. I can swim farther than she can.
items.zh: 我和我妹妹比賽游到小島。我可以游得比她遠。

items.en: You're still at your desk at nine every night. You work harder than I do.

examples.heading: ④ than + 主詞 + be

items.zh: 我妹妹才十二歲，可是她比我高。

items.zh: 我們的鄰居有新烤箱和大冰箱。他們的廚房比我們的新式。

items.en: Can you help Grandma with her new phone? You're more patient than I am.
items.zh: 你可以幫奶奶弄她的新手機嗎？你比我有耐心。

items.en: I can hardly feel it in my pocket. The new phones are lighter than the old ones were.
items.zh: 我放在口袋裡幾乎感覺不到。新手機比舊的輕。

items.en: They always say hello and bring us cake. Our neighbors are friendlier than we are.
items.zh: 他們總是打招呼，還拿蛋糕給我們。我們的鄰居比我們友善。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: We didn't get home until midnight. The film was longer than I had expected.
items.zh: 我們半夜才到家。那部電影比我原本預期的長。

items.en: Wear your thick coat. It's colder today than it was yesterday.

items.en: You look tired after your first piano lesson. Was it more difficult than you expected?
items.zh: 你上完第一堂鋼琴課看起來很累。它比你預期的難嗎？

items.en: Rent takes half my salary. Life in the city is more expensive than people realize.
items.zh: 房租花掉我一半的薪水。城市生活比大家以為的還貴。

items.en: The restaurant looked very smart. But the meal cost less than we had feared.
items.zh: 那家餐廳看起來很高級。可是那頓飯花的錢比我們擔心的少。

items.en: Our youngest son starts university this year. The kids grew up faster than we wanted.
items.zh: 我們最小的兒子今年上大學。孩子們長大得比我們希望的快。

items.en: My niece is quiet in class, but she's smarter than most people think.
items.zh: 我姪女在課堂上很安靜，可是她比大部分人以為的聰明。

items.en: We've already finished the first stage. The project is going better than anyone hoped.
items.zh: 我們已經完成第一階段了。這個專案進行得比大家希望的還順利。
