items.en: The prize went to Ann, who worked really hard.
items.zh: 獎頒給了 Ann，她真的很努力。

items.en: I spoke to the manager, who said sorry.
items.zh: 我跟經理談了，經理道了歉。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: My grandfather, who died last year, loved gardening.
items.zh: 我爺爺去年過世了，他生前很喜歡園藝。

items.en: I'll ask my cousin, who knows a lot about cars.
items.zh: 我會問我表哥，他很懂車子。

items.en: My friends, who had never been to Taipei, loved the night market.
items.zh: 我的朋友們從來沒去過台北，他們很喜歡夜市。

items.en: The children, who were tired, fell asleep in the car.
items.zh: 孩子們很累，在車上睡著了。

items.en: I'm meeting Tom, who just got back from Spain.
items.zh: 我要跟 Tom 見面，他剛從西班牙回來。

items.en: My mother, who can't swim, stayed on the beach.
items.zh: 我媽媽不會游泳，她待在沙灘上。

items.en: We thanked the driver, who had waited for us.
items.zh: 我們謝謝司機，他一直在等我們。

items.en: Ann's husband, who is a chef, cooked dinner for us.
items.zh: Ann 的先生是廚師，他為我們煮了晚餐。

items.en: I wrote to my old teacher, who still remembers me.
items.zh: 我寫信給我以前的老師，老師還記得我。

title: At the concert, I met a friend of mine, whose job is to organize shows like that.
translation: 我在演唱會上遇到一個朋友，他的工作就是籌辦那類的演出。
name: whose 引導的非限定關係子句
sentences: I had coffee with Jenny, whose husband works in my office.
We had dinner with the Wangs, whose garden is the best on the street.
I sat next to an old man, whose stories kept me awake all the way to Tainan.
She's dating Leo, whose parents own the bakery on the corner.
I borrowed a dress from Mia, whose taste in clothes is excellent.
We talked to the farmer, whose family has grown tea here for a hundred years.
My cousin, whose wedding I missed, still hasn't forgiven me.
Mr. Okada, whose English is perfect, will translate for us.
The old library, whose roof leaks every winter, needs repairs.
Our teacher, whose patience seemed endless, never raised her voice.
My best friend, whose parents are both doctors, wants to be an artist.
The restaurant, whose chef trained in France, is always full.
I finally met Professor Hall, whose books I studied at university.
We went to see Amy, whose new baby we hadn't met yet.
That's Mr. Chou, whose car I accidentally scratched.
I'm reading a novel by Kazuo Ishiguro, whose work I really admire.
Our neighbors, whose cat we feed when they're away, have gone to Japan.
We drove through Tainan, whose temples are famous across Taiwan.
I bought this phone, whose battery lasts two whole days.
They live in a cottage, whose windows look out over the sea.
The museum, whose collection includes over ten thousand paintings, opens at nine.
We hiked up Hehuan Mountain, whose peak was covered in snow.
I'll introduce you to Kevin, whose company is looking for designers.
She thanked her neighbor, whose quick thinking had saved the house.
We hired Sara, whose experience in marketing is impressive.
I'm worried about Tom, whose exams start tomorrow.
My grandmother, whose memory is getting worse, still remembers every song from her childhood.
The singer, whose voice everyone recognizes, rarely gives interviews.
I asked my uncle, whose advice is always practical, what I should do.
We stayed with Ken, whose love of hiking got us up at five every morning.

examples.heading: ① 子句在句尾：whose + 名詞當主詞

items.en: I had coffee with Jenny, whose husband works in my office.
items.zh: 我跟 Jenny 喝了咖啡，她先生在我辦公室上班。

items.en: We had dinner with the Wangs, whose garden is the best on the street.
items.zh: 我們跟王家吃了晚餐，他們的花園是這條街上最漂亮的。

items.en: I sat next to an old man, whose stories kept me awake all the way to Tainan.
items.zh: 我坐在一位老先生旁邊，他講的故事讓我一路清醒到台南。

items.en: She's dating Leo, whose parents own the bakery on the corner.
items.zh: 她在跟 Leo 交往，他的爸媽開了轉角那家麵包店。

items.en: I borrowed a dress from Mia, whose taste in clothes is excellent.
items.zh: 我跟 Mia 借了一件洋裝，她對衣服很有品味。

items.en: We talked to the farmer, whose family has grown tea here for a hundred years.
items.zh: 我們跟那位農夫聊天，他家在這裡種茶種了一百年。

examples.heading: ② 子句在句子中間

items.en: My cousin, whose wedding I missed, still hasn't forgiven me.
items.zh: 我錯過了我表姊的婚禮，她到現在還不原諒我。

items.en: Mr. Okada, whose English is perfect, will translate for us.
items.zh: 岡田先生會幫我們翻譯，他的英文很好。

items.en: The old library, whose roof leaks every winter, needs repairs.
items.zh: 那間老圖書館需要整修，它的屋頂每年冬天都漏水。

items.en: Our teacher, whose patience seemed endless, never raised her voice.
items.zh: 我們的老師好像有用不完的耐心，從來不大聲說話。

items.en: My best friend, whose parents are both doctors, wants to be an artist.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友想當藝術家，他的爸媽都是醫生。

items.en: The restaurant, whose chef trained in France, is always full.
items.zh: 那家餐廳總是客滿，它的主廚在法國受過訓練。

examples.heading: ③ whose + 名詞當受詞

items.en: I finally met Professor Hall, whose books I studied at university.
items.zh: 我終於見到了 Hall 教授，我大學時讀過他的書。

items.en: We went to see Amy, whose new baby we hadn't met yet.
items.zh: 我們去看 Amy，我們還沒見過她剛出生的寶寶。

items.en: That's Mr. Chou, whose car I accidentally scratched.
items.zh: 那位是周先生，我不小心刮到他的車。

items.en: I'm reading a novel by Kazuo Ishiguro, whose work I really admire.
items.zh: 我在讀石黑一雄的小說，我很欣賞他的作品。

items.en: Our neighbors, whose cat we feed when they're away, have gone to Japan.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居去日本了，他們不在的時候我們幫他們餵貓。

examples.heading: ④ 指東西和地方

items.en: We drove through Tainan, whose temples are famous across Taiwan.
items.zh: 我們開車經過台南，那裡的廟在全台灣都很有名。

items.en: I bought this phone, whose battery lasts two whole days.
items.zh: 我買了這支手機，它的電池可以撐兩整天。

items.en: They live in a cottage, whose windows look out over the sea.
items.zh: 他們住在一間小屋，窗戶看出去就是海。

items.en: The museum, whose collection includes over ten thousand paintings, opens at nine.
items.zh: 那間博物館九點開門，館藏有一萬多幅畫。

items.en: We hiked up Hehuan Mountain, whose peak was covered in snow.
items.zh: 我們爬了合歡山，山頂覆蓋著雪。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和情境

items.en: I'll introduce you to Kevin, whose company is looking for designers.
items.zh: 我會介紹你認識 Kevin，他的公司在找設計師。

items.en: She thanked her neighbor, whose quick thinking had saved the house.
items.zh: 她向鄰居道謝，鄰居反應很快，救了那棟房子。

items.en: We hired Sara, whose experience in marketing is impressive.
items.zh: 我們雇用了 Sara，她的行銷經驗很豐富。

items.en: I'm worried about Tom, whose exams start tomorrow.
items.zh: 我很擔心 Tom，他明天開始考試。

items.en: My grandmother, whose memory is getting worse, still remembers every song from her childhood.
items.zh: 我奶奶的記性越來越差，但還記得小時候的每一首歌。

items.en: The singer, whose voice everyone recognizes, rarely gives interviews.
items.zh: 那位歌手很少接受訪問，大家都認得她的聲音。

items.en: I asked my uncle, whose advice is always practical, what I should do.
items.zh: 我問了我叔叔該怎麼做，他的建議總是很實際。

items.en: We stayed with Ken, whose love of hiking got us up at five every morning.
items.zh: 我們住在 Ken 家，他超愛爬山，每天早上五點就把我們叫起來。

title: Please do not hesitate to ask for further assistance if needed.
translation: 如果需要進一步的協助，請儘管提出。
name: if 後接非限定子句
sentences: You can call me at home if needed.
Extra blankets are available if required.
We can change the date if necessary.
If needed, I can stay late tomorrow.
Bring an umbrella, and a warm jacket if necessary.
Wear gloves if required by the instructions.
If asked, say that you're a friend of mine.
Most people, if asked, would say they want to be happy.
She'll help with the cooking if asked.
If asked about the price, tell them it's not decided yet.
Rent here is low if compared with rent in Taipei.
If compared to last year, sales have doubled.
Our flat seems tiny if compared with my parents' house.
The results are disappointing if compared to what we expected.
These pills work best if taken with food.
This cream can damage your skin if used too often.
Milk goes bad quickly if left out of the fridge.
The suggestions, if accepted, will make the streets safer.
This dish tastes better if eaten hot.
The plan, if followed carefully, should work.
Bread stays fresh longer if kept in a cool place.
If done properly, the job takes about two hours.
Please specify a delivery time if preferred.
If washed in hot water, this sweater will shrink.
These measures, if introduced now, could prevent another flood.
Late homework is fine if accompanied by a note from your parents.
If stored correctly, the rice will keep for a year.
Leftover paint lasts for years if sealed tightly.
Spoken English, if practiced daily, improves surprisingly fast.
The bike can carry a child seat if fitted correctly.

examples.heading: ① if needed / if required / if necessary

items.en: You can call me at home if needed.
items.zh: 如果需要，你可以打到我家。

items.en: Extra blankets are available if required.
items.zh: 如果需要，有額外的毯子可以用。

items.en: We can change the date if necessary.
items.zh: 如果有必要，我們可以改日期。

items.en: If needed, I can stay late tomorrow.
items.zh: 如果需要的話，我明天可以留晚一點。

items.en: Bring an umbrella, and a warm jacket if necessary.
items.zh: 帶把傘，必要的話也帶件保暖的外套。

items.en: Wear gloves if required by the instructions.
items.zh: 如果說明書要求，就戴上手套。

examples.heading: ② if asked

items.en: If asked, say that you're a friend of mine.
items.zh: 如果有人問，就說你是我的朋友。

items.en: Most people, if asked, would say they want to be happy.
items.zh: 如果被問到，大部分的人都會說他們想要快樂。

items.en: She'll help with the cooking if asked.
items.zh: 如果有人請她，她會幫忙煮飯。

items.en: If asked about the price, tell them it's not decided yet.
items.zh: 如果被問到價錢，就說還沒決定。

examples.heading: ③ if compared with / to

items.en: Rent here is low if compared with rent in Taipei.
items.zh: 跟台北的房租比起來，這裡的房租很低。

items.en: If compared to last year, sales have doubled.
items.zh: 跟去年比起來，銷售量翻倍了。

items.en: Our flat seems tiny if compared with my parents' house.
items.zh: 跟我爸媽的房子比起來，我們的公寓好像很小。

items.en: The results are disappointing if compared to what we expected.
items.zh: 跟我們預期的比起來，結果很令人失望。

examples.heading: ④ if taken / if used / if left

items.en: These pills work best if taken with food.
items.zh: 這些藥配著食物吃效果最好。

items.en: This cream can damage your skin if used too often.
items.zh: 這種乳霜用得太頻繁可能會傷皮膚。

items.en: Milk goes bad quickly if left out of the fridge.
items.zh: 牛奶放在冰箱外面很快就會壞掉。

items.en: The suggestions, if accepted, will make the streets safer.
items.zh: 這些建議如果被採納，會讓街道更安全。

items.en: This dish tastes better if eaten hot.
items.zh: 這道菜趁熱吃比較好吃。

items.en: The plan, if followed carefully, should work.
items.zh: 這個計畫如果仔細照著做，應該會成功。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Bread stays fresh longer if kept in a cool place.
items.zh: 麵包放在陰涼的地方可以保存比較久。

items.en: If done properly, the job takes about two hours.
items.zh: 如果做得對，這份工作大概要兩個小時。

items.en: Please specify a delivery time if preferred.
items.zh: 如果有偏好，請指定送貨時間。

items.en: If washed in hot water, this sweater will shrink.
items.zh: 這件毛衣用熱水洗會縮水。

items.en: These measures, if introduced now, could prevent another flood.
items.zh: 這些措施如果現在實施，可以防止再次淹水。

items.en: Late homework is fine if accompanied by a note from your parents.
items.zh: 如果附上家長的字條，遲交的作業沒關係。

items.en: If stored correctly, the rice will keep for a year.
items.zh: 如果保存得當，這些米可以放一年。

items.en: Leftover paint lasts for years if sealed tightly.
items.zh: 剩下的油漆如果封緊，可以放好幾年。

items.en: Spoken English, if practiced daily, improves surprisingly fast.
items.zh: 英語口說如果每天練習，進步得出乎意料地快。

items.en: The bike can carry a child seat if fitted correctly.
items.zh: 這台腳踏車如果裝得正確，可以加裝兒童座椅。

title: If you find it, call me.
translation: 如果你找到它，就打電話給我。
name: 現在簡單式 if 子句加祈使句
sentences: If you see Emma at the gym, give her this book.
If you get lost, ask someone for directions.
If you're hungry, help yourself to some bread.
If the dog looks thirsty, give him some water.
If you go to the supermarket, buy some eggs.
If it starts to rain, bring the washing in.
If you finish before five, go home.
If you feel sick, don't go to school.
If the water is too cold, don't swim.
If someone calls, don't tell them I'm here.
If you borrow my car, don't leave it in the sun.
If the light is red, don't cross the road.
If you don't know the answer, don't guess.
If you get home late, don't wake your brother.
If you want to join us, just tell me.
If you have any problems, please let me know.
If you need a towel, just ask.
If you arrive early, please wait in the hall.
If you can't come, please send me a message.
If the printer jams, just switch it off and on again.
If you don't feel well, stay in bed.
If you don't like the soup, leave it.
If it doesn't fit, take it back to the shop.
If you can't find the hotel, phone me from the station.
If they don't answer, try again later.
If the bus doesn't come, take a taxi.
Call me if you need a lift.
Wear a coat if it's cold outside.
Take an umbrella if it looks like rain.
Ask the teacher if you don't understand.
Don't open the door if you don't know who it is.
Send me a postcard if you go to Greece.

examples.heading: ① 叫對方做的事

items.en: If you see Emma at the gym, give her this book.
items.zh: 如果你在健身房見到 Emma，把這本書給她。

items.en: If you get lost, ask someone for directions.
items.zh: 如果你迷路了，就找人問路。

items.en: If you're hungry, help yourself to some bread.
items.zh: 如果你餓了，自己拿麵包吃。

items.en: If the dog looks thirsty, give him some water.
items.zh: 如果狗看起來很渴，給牠一點水。

items.en: If you go to the supermarket, buy some eggs.
items.zh: 如果你去超市，買些蛋。

items.en: If it starts to rain, bring the washing in.
items.zh: 如果開始下雨，就把衣服收進來。

items.en: If you finish before five, go home.
items.zh: 如果你五點前做完，就回家吧。

examples.heading: ② don't 開頭的祈使句

items.en: If you feel sick, don't go to school.
items.zh: 如果你覺得不舒服，就別去上學。

items.en: If the water is too cold, don't swim.
items.zh: 如果水太冷，就別游泳。

items.en: If someone calls, don't tell them I'm here.
items.zh: 如果有人打電話來，別說我在這裡。

items.en: If you borrow my car, don't leave it in the sun.
items.zh: 如果你借我的車，別把它停在大太陽下。

items.en: If the light is red, don't cross the road.
items.zh: 如果是紅燈，就別過馬路。

items.en: If you don't know the answer, don't guess.
items.zh: 如果你不知道答案，就別亂猜。

items.en: If you get home late, don't wake your brother.
items.zh: 如果你晚回家，別吵醒你弟弟。

examples.heading: ③ please 和 just

items.en: If you want to join us, just tell me.
items.zh: 如果你想加入我們，跟我說一聲就好。

items.en: If you have any problems, please let me know.
items.zh: 如果你有任何問題，請讓我知道。

items.en: If you need a towel, just ask.
items.zh: 如果你需要毛巾，開口就好。

items.en: If you arrive early, please wait in the hall.
items.zh: 如果你早到，請在大廳等。

items.en: If you can't come, please send me a message.
items.zh: 如果你不能來，請傳訊息給我。

items.en: If the printer jams, just switch it off and on again.
items.zh: 如果印表機卡紙，關掉再開就好。

examples.heading: ④ don't、doesn't、can't 的條件

items.en: If you don't feel well, stay in bed.
items.zh: 如果你覺得不舒服，就待在床上。

items.en: If you don't like the soup, leave it.
items.zh: 如果你不喜歡這湯，就別喝了。

items.en: If it doesn't fit, take it back to the shop.
items.zh: 如果不合身，就拿回店裡。

items.en: If you can't find the hotel, phone me from the station.
items.zh: 如果你找不到飯店，就在車站打給我。

items.en: If they don't answer, try again later.
items.zh: 如果他們沒接，晚點再打。

items.en: If the bus doesn't come, take a taxi.
items.zh: 如果公車沒來，就搭計程車。

examples.heading: ⑤ 條件放在後面

items.en: Call me if you need a lift.
items.zh: 如果你需要人載，打給我。

items.en: Wear a coat if it's cold outside.
items.zh: 外面冷的話，就穿外套。

items.en: Take an umbrella if it looks like rain.
items.zh: 看起來要下雨的話，就帶把傘。

items.en: Ask the teacher if you don't understand.
items.zh: 如果你不懂，就問老師。

items.en: Don't open the door if you don't know who it is.
items.zh: 如果你不知道是誰，就別開門。

items.en: Send me a postcard if you go to Greece.
items.zh: 如果你去希臘，寄張明信片給我。

title: They have three wonderful children who I love to play with.
translation: 他們有三個很棒的孩子，我很喜歡跟他們一起玩。
name: 介系詞放在句尾的關係子句
sentences: She's the colleague who I always have lunch with.
The chair that you're sitting on belonged to my great-grandfather.
The topic that we argued about all night was politics.
Is that the guy who you went to the concert with?
The box that I keep my letters in is under the bed.
He's a friend who I can talk to about anything.
The pen I'm writing with is running out of ink.
The town she comes from is famous for its tea.
These are the people I grew up with.
Is this the bag you were asking about?
The thing I'm most worried about is the cost.
The company he works for is opening a branch in Taichung.
I've taken up painting, which I'm actually quite good at.
We visited Mr. Liu, who my father used to work with.
They gave us a long report, which nobody could make sense of.
My aunt, who I stayed with last summer, has a farm.
The new policy, which many staff complained about, ends next month.
Her latest book, which I'm really looking forward to, comes out in May.
Chemistry is the subject that I'm most interested in.
Spiders are the only thing I'm really afraid of.
This is a result which we can all be proud of.
The dog, which my sister is allergic to, has to stay outside.
He showed me the scar that he's so embarrassed about.
The manager to whom I addressed my complaint never answered.
The hotel in which the conference took place was very modern.
Mr. Huang, with whom I worked for ten years, is retiring.
The project on which we spent two years finally ended last week.
The charity to which she gave her savings helps children in need.
The colleagues with whom she shared an office threw her a farewell party.
The principles on which the founders built the school still matter today.

examples.heading: ① 限定：who / that + ... + 介系詞

items.en: She's the colleague who I always have lunch with.
items.zh: 她是我都會一起吃午餐的同事。

items.en: The chair that you're sitting on belonged to my great-grandfather.
items.zh: 你坐的那張椅子是我曾祖父的。

items.en: The topic that we argued about all night was politics.
items.zh: 我們吵了一整晚的話題是政治。

items.en: Is that the guy who you went to the concert with?
items.zh: 那就是跟你一起去演唱會的人嗎？

items.en: The box that I keep my letters in is under the bed.
items.zh: 我放信的盒子在床底下。

items.en: He's a friend who I can talk to about anything.
items.zh: 他是我什麼都可以聊的朋友。

examples.heading: ② 限定：省略關係代名詞

items.en: The pen I'm writing with is running out of ink.
items.zh: 我正在用的筆快沒水了。

items.en: The town she comes from is famous for its tea.
items.zh: 她的家鄉以茶聞名。

items.en: These are the people I grew up with.
items.zh: 這些是跟我一起長大的人。

items.en: Is this the bag you were asking about?
items.zh: 這是你剛剛問的那個包包嗎？

items.en: The thing I'm most worried about is the cost.
items.zh: 我最擔心的是費用。

items.en: The company he works for is opening a branch in Taichung.
items.zh: 他工作的公司要在台中開分公司。

examples.heading: ③ 非限定：, which / who ... + 介系詞

items.en: I've taken up painting, which I'm actually quite good at.
items.zh: 我開始畫畫了，其實我畫得還不錯。

items.en: We visited Mr. Liu, who my father used to work with.
items.zh: 我們去看劉先生，我爸爸以前跟他一起工作。

items.en: They gave us a long report, which nobody could make sense of.
items.zh: 他們給我們一份很長的報告，沒人看得懂。

items.en: My aunt, who I stayed with last summer, has a farm.
items.zh: 我阿姨有一座農場，我去年夏天住在她家。

items.en: The new policy, which many staff complained about, ends next month.
items.zh: 很多員工抱怨的新政策下個月結束。

items.en: Her latest book, which I'm really looking forward to, comes out in May.
items.zh: 她的新書五月出版，我真的很期待。

examples.heading: ④ 形容詞 + 介系詞

items.en: Chemistry is the subject that I'm most interested in.
items.zh: 化學是我最有興趣的科目。

items.en: Spiders are the only thing I'm really afraid of.
items.zh: 蜘蛛是我唯一真的很怕的東西。

items.en: This is a result which we can all be proud of.
items.zh: 這是我們都可以感到驕傲的成果。

items.en: The dog, which my sister is allergic to, has to stay outside.
items.zh: 那隻狗要待在外面，我姊姊對牠過敏。

items.en: He showed me the scar that he's so embarrassed about.
items.zh: 他給我看他很不好意思的那道疤。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式的寫法：介系詞 + whom / which

items.en: The manager to whom I addressed my complaint never answered.
items.zh: 我寄申訴的那位經理一直沒回覆。

items.en: The hotel in which the conference took place was very modern.
items.zh: 舉辦研討會的飯店很現代。

items.en: Mr. Huang, with whom I worked for ten years, is retiring.
items.zh: 黃先生要退休了，我跟他共事了十年。

items.en: The project on which we spent two years finally ended last week.
items.zh: 我們花了兩年的那個計畫上禮拜終於結束了。

items.en: The charity to which she gave her savings helps children in need.
items.zh: 她把積蓄捐給的那個慈善機構幫助有需要的孩子。

items.en: The colleagues with whom she shared an office threw her a farewell party.
items.zh: 跟她共用辦公室的同事幫她辦了歡送會。

items.en: The principles on which the founders built the school still matter today.
items.zh: 創辦人建校的理念到今天還是很重要。

title: I would prefer to sleep in tents rather than stay in rooms.
translation: 我寧可睡帳篷，也不要住房間。
name: rather than 加非限定子句
sentences: I've had a long week at work. I'd prefer to stay in rather than go to the party.
The babysitter cancelled at the last minute. We decided to cook dinner at home rather than go out.
My cousin's parents are both lawyers. She chose to study medicine rather than become a lawyer.
This is about your job, Tom. I'd like to talk to you in person rather than send an email.
My brother and his wife may move abroad next year. They want to rent a flat rather than buy one.
My classmate never brings a laptop to lectures. She likes to take notes by hand rather than type them.
It only needs new brakes. Why not fix your old bike rather than buy a new one?
We've spent too much this month. Let's eat in rather than go to a restaurant.
The code for the door is long. Write it down rather than try to remember it.
You still have a high temperature. You should rest rather than go to work today.
Parking in the city costs a lot. We could take the train rather than drive.
He makes dinner for us every Friday. My son is keen on cooking rather than eating out.
My sister has a long trip to work. She prefers working from home rather than going to the office.
He's outside with his roses all day. My grandfather enjoys gardening rather than watching TV.
My boss didn't send any emails. I spent the weekend relaxing rather than working.
My friend just finished his PhD. He's interested in teaching rather than doing research.
It was a lovely evening after work. Rather than go straight home, we stopped at the beach.
The manager spoke to the angry staff. Rather than complain, try to fix the problem.
My mum wanted to save money. Rather than buying new clothes, she fixed her old ones.
My son was too shy to speak to the girl. Rather than calling, he sent a text.
The hotels in the park were full. Rather than staying in a hotel, we camped by the lake.
Look at this rain. Should we watch a film at home rather than walk to the cinema?
The bank hasn't answered my question for a week. I'd prefer to call rather than wait for an email.
The students couldn't finish the project alone. They asked for help rather than give up.
My son broke the neighbour's window with his ball. He decided to tell the truth rather than lie.
Our city has new bike lanes everywhere. Many people choose to cycle rather than drive to work.
The doctor talked to parents about health. Kids should play outside rather than sit in front of screens.
The new manager changed my sister's hours. She decided to quit rather than work every weekend.
The film cut half the story. I prefer reading the book rather than watching the film.
My uncle got lost because he didn't use the map. He laughed rather than admit he was wrong.

examples.heading: ① to 不定詞 + rather than + 原形動詞

items.en: I've had a long week at work. I'd prefer to stay in rather than go to the party.
items.zh: 我這個星期工作很累。我寧可待在家，也不要去派對。

items.en: The babysitter cancelled at the last minute. We decided to cook dinner at home rather than go out.
items.zh: 保母在最後一刻取消了。我們決定在家煮晚餐，不出門了。

items.en: My cousin's parents are both lawyers. She chose to study medicine rather than become a lawyer.
items.zh: 我表姊的爸媽都是律師。她選擇讀醫，不當律師。

items.en: This is about your job, Tom. I'd like to talk to you in person rather than send an email.
items.zh: 湯姆，這是關於你工作的事。我想當面跟你談，不想寄電子郵件。

items.en: My brother and his wife may move abroad next year. They want to rent a flat rather than buy one.
items.zh: 我哥哥和他太太明年可能會搬到國外。他們想租公寓，不想買。

items.en: My classmate never brings a laptop to lectures. She likes to take notes by hand rather than type them.
items.zh: 我同學上課從來不帶筆電。她喜歡手寫筆記，不用打字。

examples.heading: ② 原形動詞 + rather than + 原形動詞

items.en: It only needs new brakes. Why not fix your old bike rather than buy a new one?
items.zh: 它只需要換新的煞車。為什麼不修你的舊腳踏車，而要買新的？

items.en: We've spent too much this month. Let's eat in rather than go to a restaurant.
items.zh: 我們這個月花太多錢了。我們在家吃吧，不要上館子。

items.en: The code for the door is long. Write it down rather than try to remember it.
items.zh: 門的密碼很長。把它寫下來，不要試著記在腦子裡。

items.en: You still have a high temperature. You should rest rather than go to work today.
items.zh: 你還在發高燒。你今天應該休息，不要去上班。

items.en: Parking in the city costs a lot. We could take the train rather than drive.
items.zh: 在市區停車很貴。我們可以搭火車，不要開車。

examples.heading: ③ 動詞-ing + rather than + 動詞-ing

items.en: He makes dinner for us every Friday. My son is keen on cooking rather than eating out.
items.zh: 他每個星期五都煮晚餐給我們吃。我兒子喜歡下廚，不喜歡外食。

items.en: My sister has a long trip to work. She prefers working from home rather than going to the office.
items.zh: 我姊姊上班要通勤很久。她比較喜歡在家工作，不喜歡進辦公室。

items.en: He's outside with his roses all day. My grandfather enjoys gardening rather than watching TV.
items.zh: 他整天都在外面照顧他的玫瑰。我爺爺喜歡園藝，不喜歡看電視。

items.en: My boss didn't send any emails. I spent the weekend relaxing rather than working.
items.zh: 我老闆沒寄任何電子郵件。我週末都在放鬆，沒有工作。

items.en: My friend just finished his PhD. He's interested in teaching rather than doing research.
items.zh: 我朋友剛讀完博士。他對教書有興趣，對做研究沒興趣。

examples.heading: ④ Rather than 放在句首

items.en: It was a lovely evening after work. Rather than go straight home, we stopped at the beach.
items.zh: 那天下班後的傍晚很美。我們沒有直接回家，而是在海邊停了一下。

items.en: The manager spoke to the angry staff. Rather than complain, try to fix the problem.
items.zh: 經理跟生氣的員工說話。與其抱怨，不如試著解決問題。

items.en: My mum wanted to save money. Rather than buying new clothes, she fixed her old ones.
items.zh: 我媽媽想省錢。她沒有買新衣服，而是把舊衣服修好。

items.en: My son was too shy to speak to the girl. Rather than calling, he sent a text.
items.zh: 我兒子太害羞，不敢跟那個女孩說話。他沒有打電話，而是傳了簡訊。

items.en: The hotels in the park were full. Rather than staying in a hotel, we camped by the lake.
items.zh: 公園裡的飯店都滿了。我們沒住飯店，而是在湖邊露營。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: Look at this rain. Should we watch a film at home rather than walk to the cinema?
items.zh: 你看這場雨。我們要不要在家看電影，不要走去電影院？

items.en: The bank hasn't answered my question for a week. I'd prefer to call rather than wait for an email.
items.zh: 銀行一個星期都沒回答我的問題。我寧可打電話，也不要等電子郵件。

items.en: The students couldn't finish the project alone. They asked for help rather than give up.
items.zh: 學生們沒辦法自己完成專題。他們尋求幫助，而不是放棄。

items.en: My son broke the neighbour's window with his ball. He decided to tell the truth rather than lie.
items.zh: 我兒子的球打破了鄰居的窗戶。他決定說實話，不說謊。

items.en: Our city has new bike lanes everywhere. Many people choose to cycle rather than drive to work.
items.zh: 我們城市到處都有新的自行車道。很多人選擇騎腳踏車上班，不開車。

items.en: The doctor talked to parents about health. Kids should play outside rather than sit in front of screens.
items.zh: 醫生跟家長談健康。孩子應該去外面玩，不要坐在螢幕前面。

items.en: The new manager changed my sister's hours. She decided to quit rather than work every weekend.
items.zh: 新經理改了我姊姊的工時。她決定辭職，不要每個週末都上班。

items.en: The film cut half the story. I prefer reading the book rather than watching the film.
items.zh: 電影刪掉了一半的故事。我比較喜歡看書，而不是看電影。

items.en: My uncle got lost because he didn't use the map. He laughed rather than admit he was wrong.
items.zh: 我叔叔沒看地圖，結果迷路了。他笑了笑，不肯承認自己錯了。

title: I think I will have to buy an umbrella because it looks as if it'll rain.
translation: 看起來好像要下雨了，我想我得去買把傘。
name: 感官動詞加 as if 或 as though
sentences: The windows are empty, and there's a sign on the door. It looks as if the shop has closed for good.
It's two in the afternoon, and you're still in your pyjamas. You look as if you've just woken up.
From your email, it looks as if you need some help.
The garden is full of weeds, and the curtains are always closed. The house looks as though nobody lives there.
That man keeps checking his pockets. He looks as if he's lost something.
Listen to all that laughing in the garden. The kids look as though they're having fun.
On the swing, I felt as if I was flying.
When you walk into the café, you feel as if you're in Paris.
The old street made me feel as though I was back in the past.
We only met last week, but I feel as if I've known you for years.
My sister walked into the party alone. She felt as though everyone was looking at her.
We climbed for six hours today. My legs feel as if they're made of stone.
You danced until three in the morning? It sounds as if the party was a lot of fun.
Your voice is very different on the phone today. You sound as if you have a cold.
Turn the TV down for a minute. That sounds as though someone is at the door.
Listen to that loud noise. The car sounds as if it needs a new engine.
My friend called me late last night. She sounded as though she was crying.
There are thousands of people at the summer fair. It seems as if the whole town is here.
It rained every day of our holiday in Wales. It seemed as though the rain would never stop.
The delivery man didn't even say hello. He seems as if he's in a hurry.
Their car isn't outside, and the lights are off. It seems as though they've already left.
We got lost in the forest. It seemed as if we'd walked for hours.
I'm driving to the mountains tomorrow. Does it look as if it'll snow?
It's nine o'clock, and our guests haven't called. It doesn't look as if they're coming.
I came home from school and opened the door. The kitchen smelled as if someone had been baking.
Quick, check the toaster! The bread smells as if it's burning.
Check the date on the bottle. This milk tastes as though it's gone bad.
It's cold and very bitter. This coffee tastes as if it's been sitting there all day.
Your face is white. Why do you look as if you've seen a ghost?
The kids had a pillow fight while we were out. The room looked as if a storm had passed through it.

examples.heading: ① look as if / as though

items.en: The windows are empty, and there's a sign on the door. It looks as if the shop has closed for good.
items.zh: 櫥窗是空的，門上還貼了一張告示。那家店看起來好像永遠關門了。

items.en: It's two in the afternoon, and you're still in your pyjamas. You look as if you've just woken up.
items.zh: 現在下午兩點了，你還穿著睡衣。你看起來好像剛睡醒。

items.en: From your email, it looks as if you need some help.
items.zh: 從你的電子郵件看來，你好像需要幫忙。

items.en: The garden is full of weeds, and the curtains are always closed. The house looks as though nobody lives there.
items.zh: 花園長滿了雜草，窗簾總是拉著。那棟房子看起來好像沒人住。

items.en: That man keeps checking his pockets. He looks as if he's lost something.
items.zh: 那個男人一直摸他的口袋。他看起來好像丟了什麼東西。

items.en: Listen to all that laughing in the garden. The kids look as though they're having fun.
items.zh: 你聽花園裡那些笑聲。孩子們看起來好像玩得很開心。

examples.heading: ② feel as if / as though

items.en: On the swing, I felt as if I was flying.
items.zh: 盪鞦韆的時候，我感覺自己好像在飛。

items.en: When you walk into the café, you feel as if you're in Paris.
items.zh: 一走進那家咖啡店，你會感覺好像到了巴黎。

items.en: The old street made me feel as though I was back in the past.
items.zh: 那條老街讓我感覺好像回到了過去。

items.en: We only met last week, but I feel as if I've known you for years.
items.zh: 我們上星期才認識，可是我感覺好像認識你好多年了。

items.en: My sister walked into the party alone. She felt as though everyone was looking at her.
items.zh: 我姊姊一個人走進派對。她覺得好像每個人都在看她。

items.en: We climbed for six hours today. My legs feel as if they're made of stone.
items.zh: 我們今天爬了六個小時。我的腿感覺好像是石頭做的。

examples.heading: ③ sound as if / as though

items.en: You danced until three in the morning? It sounds as if the party was a lot of fun.
items.zh: 你跳舞跳到凌晨三點？聽起來派對好像很好玩。

items.en: Your voice is very different on the phone today. You sound as if you have a cold.
items.zh: 你今天在電話裡聲音很不一樣。你聽起來好像感冒了。

items.en: Turn the TV down for a minute. That sounds as though someone is at the door.
items.zh: 把電視關小聲一下。聽起來好像有人在門口。

items.en: Listen to that loud noise. The car sounds as if it needs a new engine.
items.zh: 你聽那個很大的聲音。這輛車聽起來好像需要換引擎了。

items.en: My friend called me late last night. She sounded as though she was crying.
items.zh: 我朋友昨天深夜打給我。她聽起來好像在哭。

examples.heading: ④ seem as if / as though

items.en: There are thousands of people at the summer fair. It seems as if the whole town is here.
items.zh: 夏季市集有好幾千人。好像整個鎮的人都在這裡。

items.en: It rained every day of our holiday in Wales. It seemed as though the rain would never stop.
items.zh: 我們在威爾斯度假的每一天都在下雨。雨好像永遠不會停。

items.en: The delivery man didn't even say hello. He seems as if he's in a hurry.
items.zh: 送貨員連招呼都沒打。他好像在趕時間。

items.en: Their car isn't outside, and the lights are off. It seems as though they've already left.
items.zh: 他們的車不在外面，燈也關了。他們好像已經走了。

items.en: We got lost in the forest. It seemed as if we'd walked for hours.
items.zh: 我們在森林裡迷路了。我們好像走了好幾個小時。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: I'm driving to the mountains tomorrow. Does it look as if it'll snow?
items.zh: 我明天要開車去山上。看起來會下雪嗎？

items.en: It's nine o'clock, and our guests haven't called. It doesn't look as if they're coming.
items.zh: 已經九點了，我們的客人都沒打電話來。看起來他們好像不會來了。

items.en: I came home from school and opened the door. The kitchen smelled as if someone had been baking.
items.zh: 我放學回家打開門。廚房聞起來好像有人在烤東西。

items.en: Quick, check the toaster! The bread smells as if it's burning.
items.zh: 快，看一下烤麵包機！麵包聞起來好像在燒焦了。

items.en: Check the date on the bottle. This milk tastes as though it's gone bad.
items.zh: 看一下瓶子上的日期。這牛奶喝起來好像壞了。

items.en: It's cold and very bitter. This coffee tastes as if it's been sitting there all day.
items.zh: 它又冷又很苦。這咖啡喝起來好像放了一整天。

items.en: Your face is white. Why do you look as if you've seen a ghost?
items.zh: 你的臉好白。你為什麼一副見到鬼的樣子？

items.en: The kids had a pillow fight while we were out. The room looked as if a storm had passed through it.
items.zh: 我們出門的時候，孩子們在玩枕頭大戰。房間看起來好像被暴風吹過一樣。

title: I was so tired that I didn't have the strength to stand up.
translation: 我累到連站起來的力氣都沒有。
name: so 加形容詞加 that 子句
sentences: Dad worked a double shift on Friday. He was so tired that he fell asleep in front of the TV.
I tried the Turkish coffee at the market. It was so strong that my hands shook.
We wanted to see the new dinosaur show at the museum, but the queue was so long that we gave up.
We walked around Seville in July. It was so hot that the chocolate melted in my bag.
Our teacher was surprised by the results. The test was so easy that everyone passed.
My grandmother sent us her old books. The box was so heavy that we needed three people.
I met my favourite actor at a café. I was so nervous that I couldn't speak.
We tried to talk at the club. The music was so loud that we couldn't hear each other.
My sister had six meetings on Monday. She was so busy that she didn't eat lunch.
The lights went off at the hotel. The room was so dark that I couldn't see anything.
Someone scratched my uncle's new car. He was so angry that he didn't say a word.
The doctor said our son was fine. We were so relieved that we hugged each other.
My daughter's first school trip was the next day. She was so excited that she couldn't sleep.
We heard a strange noise in the woods. We were so scared that we ran home.
I called my teacher "Mum" in front of the class. I was so embarrassed that my face went red.
My dad heard that he won the lottery. He was so surprised that he dropped his cup.
I moved house yesterday. I was so tired I went to bed at eight.
My aunt baked bread for our picnic. The bread was so good we ate it all.
I walked home in the storm last night. It was so windy I couldn't open my umbrella.
My nephews were drawing in the back room. The kids were so quiet I forgot they were there.
We went to buy a new TV on Saturday. The shop was so busy we left.
My wife had worked all night at the hospital. She looked so tired that I offered to drive.
Mum took the cake out of the oven. It smelled so good that we ate it warm.
I had a fever on Monday morning. I felt so sick that I stayed home.
It snowed all night in our village. The road became so icy that the school closed.
You came back from your holiday three days early. Was the hotel so bad that you left?
Tom told us a joke about his dog. The joke was so funny that I couldn't stop laughing.
I wore new shoes to the wedding. My feet were so sore that I couldn't walk.
The theatre had a sale on Monday. The tickets were so cheap that we bought four.
We went snorkelling in Thailand. The water was so clear that we could see the fish.

examples.heading: ① so + 形容詞 + that + 結果

items.en: Dad worked a double shift on Friday. He was so tired that he fell asleep in front of the TV.
items.zh: 爸爸星期五連上了兩班。他累到在電視前面睡著了。

items.en: I tried the Turkish coffee at the market. It was so strong that my hands shook.
items.zh: 我在市場喝了土耳其咖啡。咖啡濃到我的手都在抖。

items.en: We wanted to see the new dinosaur show at the museum, but the queue was so long that we gave up.
items.zh: 我們想看博物館新的恐龍展，可是隊伍長到我們放棄了。

items.en: We walked around Seville in July. It was so hot that the chocolate melted in my bag.
items.zh: 我們七月在塞維亞到處走。熱到巧克力在我的包包裡融化了。

items.en: Our teacher was surprised by the results. The test was so easy that everyone passed.
items.zh: 老師對成績很驚訝。考試簡單到每個人都及格了。

items.en: My grandmother sent us her old books. The box was so heavy that we needed three people.
items.zh: 我奶奶把她的舊書寄給我們。箱子重到我們需要三個人來搬。

examples.heading: ② so + 形容詞 + that + 否定的結果

items.en: I met my favourite actor at a café. I was so nervous that I couldn't speak.
items.zh: 我在一家咖啡館遇到我最喜歡的演員。我緊張到說不出話。

items.en: We tried to talk at the club. The music was so loud that we couldn't hear each other.
items.zh: 我們想在夜店聊天。音樂大聲到我們聽不到彼此說話。

items.en: My sister had six meetings on Monday. She was so busy that she didn't eat lunch.
items.zh: 我姊姊星期一有六個會議。她忙到沒吃午餐。

items.en: The lights went off at the hotel. The room was so dark that I couldn't see anything.
items.zh: 飯店停電了。房間暗到我什麼都看不到。

items.en: Someone scratched my uncle's new car. He was so angry that he didn't say a word.
items.zh: 有人刮傷了我叔叔的新車。他氣到一句話都沒說。

examples.heading: ③ 感覺 + so + 形容詞 + that

items.en: The doctor said our son was fine. We were so relieved that we hugged each other.
items.zh: 醫生說我們的兒子沒事。我們鬆了一口氣，高興得抱在一起。

items.en: My daughter's first school trip was the next day. She was so excited that she couldn't sleep.
items.zh: 我女兒隔天要第一次校外教學。她興奮到睡不著。

items.en: We heard a strange noise in the woods. We were so scared that we ran home.
items.zh: 我們在樹林裡聽到奇怪的聲音。我們嚇到跑回家。

items.en: I called my teacher "Mum" in front of the class. I was so embarrassed that my face went red.
items.zh: 我在全班面前叫老師媽。我尷尬到臉都紅了。

items.en: My dad heard that he won the lottery. He was so surprised that he dropped his cup.
items.zh: 我爸爸聽到他中了樂透。他驚訝到杯子都掉了。

examples.heading: ④ 省略 that

items.en: I moved house yesterday. I was so tired I went to bed at eight.
items.zh: 我昨天搬家。我累到八點就上床睡覺了。

items.en: My aunt baked bread for our picnic. The bread was so good we ate it all.
items.zh: 我阿姨為我們的野餐烤了麵包。麵包好吃到我們全吃光了。

items.en: I walked home in the storm last night. It was so windy I couldn't open my umbrella.
items.zh: 我昨天晚上在暴風雨中走路回家。風大到我打不開傘。

items.en: My nephews were drawing in the back room. The kids were so quiet I forgot they were there.
items.zh: 我的姪子們在後面的房間畫畫。孩子們安靜到我都忘了他們在那裡。

items.en: We went to buy a new TV on Saturday. The shop was so busy we left.
items.zh: 我們星期六去買新電視。店裡人多到我們就走了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的動詞和句型

items.en: My wife had worked all night at the hospital. She looked so tired that I offered to drive.
items.zh: 我太太在醫院工作了一整夜。她看起來累到我主動說要開車。

items.en: Mum took the cake out of the oven. It smelled so good that we ate it warm.
items.zh: 媽媽把蛋糕從烤箱拿出來。蛋糕香到我們趁熱就吃了。

items.en: I had a fever on Monday morning. I felt so sick that I stayed home.
items.zh: 我星期一早上發燒。我不舒服到待在家裡。

items.en: It snowed all night in our village. The road became so icy that the school closed.
items.zh: 我們村子下了一整夜的雪。路面結冰結到學校停課了。

items.en: You came back from your holiday three days early. Was the hotel so bad that you left?
items.zh: 你度假提早三天回來。那家飯店糟到你們離開了嗎？

items.en: Tom told us a joke about his dog. The joke was so funny that I couldn't stop laughing.
items.zh: 湯姆跟我們講了一個他的狗的笑話。那個笑話好笑到我停不下來。

items.en: I wore new shoes to the wedding. My feet were so sore that I couldn't walk.
items.zh: 我穿新鞋去參加婚禮。我的腳痛到不能走路。

items.en: The theatre had a sale on Monday. The tickets were so cheap that we bought four.
items.zh: 劇院星期一特價。票便宜到我們買了四張。

items.en: We went snorkelling in Thailand. The water was so clear that we could see the fish.
items.zh: 我們在泰國浮潛。水清澈到我們看得到魚。

title: On Thursday, I did the best I could.
translation: 星期四那天，我已經盡力了。
name: the best 加主詞和省略的 can/could
sentences: The report is due at five, and it's already two. I'll do the best I can with the time I have.
Your driving test is tomorrow. Don't worry. Just do the best you can.
Your flight was cancelled, madam? We'll do the best we can to help you.
Your father is still in the operating room. The doctors are doing the best they can.
My husband never complains about long hours. He always does the best he can at work.
The coach spoke to the runners before the race. Do the best you can and don't give up.
Last night I did the best I could, but the cake still burned.
My mother raised four children alone. She did the best she could with very little money.
The other team had much taller players. We did the best we could, but we lost the game.
The storm broke the biggest branch. The gardeners did the best they could to save the old tree.
Don't be angry with Tom about the late delivery. He did the best he could, and that's all we can ask.
My dad isn't good at drawing, but he tries the best he can.
My little brother annoys me every day. I try the best I can to stay calm.
Grandpa was asleep on the sofa. The kids tried the best they could to keep quiet.
My cousin works in his family's shop after school. He tries the best he can to help his parents.
Our small team offers the best it can on a tight budget.
Our café is small, but we bake everything fresh. We give our customers the best we can.
All the big rooms were taken. The hotel gave us the best it could on such a busy night.
Our school has very old books and computers. The teachers give their students the best they can.
You failed the test, but that's OK. Did you do the best you could?
You can't control the judges' scores. All you can do is the best you can.
Anna came second in the swimming race. I'm sure she did the best she could.
Can you promise me you'll do the best you can on Monday?
My son had only ten minutes for the essay. He wrote the best he could in such a short time.
We painted the fence the best we could before the rain.
Don't use a dictionary in the test. Answer the questions the best you can.
The pitch was wet and muddy. The team played the best they could in the rain.
I fixed the bike the best I could, but it's still noisy.
My little sister asked me about the stars. I explained it the best I could.
My grandparents live far from the shops. They managed the best they could without a car.

examples.heading: ① do the best + 主詞 + can

items.en: The report is due at five, and it's already two. I'll do the best I can with the time I have.
items.zh: 報告五點要交，現在已經兩點了。我會在有限的時間內盡力。

items.en: Your driving test is tomorrow. Don't worry. Just do the best you can.
items.zh: 你明天考駕照。別擔心，盡力就好。

items.en: Your flight was cancelled, madam? We'll do the best we can to help you.
items.zh: 女士，你的班機取消了嗎？我們會盡力幫你。

items.en: Your father is still in the operating room. The doctors are doing the best they can.
items.zh: 你爸爸還在手術室。醫生們正在盡力。

items.en: My husband never complains about long hours. He always does the best he can at work.
items.zh: 我先生從來不抱怨工時長。他工作總是盡全力。

items.en: The coach spoke to the runners before the race. Do the best you can and don't give up.
items.zh: 教練在比賽前跟跑者說話。盡你所能，不要放棄。

examples.heading: ② did the best + 主詞 + could

items.en: Last night I did the best I could, but the cake still burned.
items.zh: 我昨晚盡力了，但蛋糕還是烤焦了。

items.en: My mother raised four children alone. She did the best she could with very little money.
items.zh: 我媽媽獨自養大四個孩子。她用很少的錢盡力做到最好。

items.en: The other team had much taller players. We did the best we could, but we lost the game.
items.zh: 另一隊的球員高很多。我們盡力了，但還是輸了比賽。

items.en: The storm broke the biggest branch. The gardeners did the best they could to save the old tree.
items.zh: 暴風雨把最大的樹枝打斷了。園丁們盡力想救那棵老樹。

items.en: Don't be angry with Tom about the late delivery. He did the best he could, and that's all we can ask.
items.zh: 別為了晚送貨的事生湯姆的氣。他盡力了，我們也只能要求這麼多。

examples.heading: ③ try the best + 主詞 + can

items.en: My dad isn't good at drawing, but he tries the best he can.
items.zh: 我爸爸不太會畫畫，但他很盡力。

items.en: My little brother annoys me every day. I try the best I can to stay calm.
items.zh: 我弟弟每天都惹我生氣。我盡量保持冷靜。

items.en: Grandpa was asleep on the sofa. The kids tried the best they could to keep quiet.
items.zh: 爺爺在沙發上睡著了。孩子們盡量保持安靜。

items.en: My cousin works in his family's shop after school. He tries the best he can to help his parents.
items.zh: 我表弟放學後在家裡的店工作。他盡力幫他爸媽的忙。

examples.heading: ④ offer / give the best + 主詞 + can

items.en: Our small team offers the best it can on a tight budget.
items.zh: 我們這個小團隊在有限的預算下盡力提供最好的。

items.en: Our café is small, but we bake everything fresh. We give our customers the best we can.
items.zh: 我們的咖啡館很小，可是每樣東西都是現烤的。我們盡力給顧客最好的。

items.en: All the big rooms were taken. The hotel gave us the best it could on such a busy night.
items.zh: 大房間都被訂走了。在那麼忙的晚上，飯店盡力給了我們最好的安排。

items.en: Our school has very old books and computers. The teachers give their students the best they can.
items.zh: 我們學校的書和電腦都很舊。老師們盡力給學生最好的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: You failed the test, but that's OK. Did you do the best you could?
items.zh: 你考試沒過，不過沒關係。你盡力了嗎？

items.en: You can't control the judges' scores. All you can do is the best you can.
items.zh: 你沒辦法控制評審的分數。你能做的就是盡力而已。

items.en: Anna came second in the swimming race. I'm sure she did the best she could.
items.zh: 安娜游泳比賽拿第二名。我相信她已經盡力了。

items.en: Can you promise me you'll do the best you can on Monday?
items.zh: 你能答應我星期一會盡力嗎？

items.en: My son had only ten minutes for the essay. He wrote the best he could in such a short time.
items.zh: 我兒子只有十分鐘寫作文。在那麼短的時間內，他盡力寫了。

items.en: We painted the fence the best we could before the rain.
items.zh: 下雨前，我們盡力把籬笆漆好了。

items.en: Don't use a dictionary in the test. Answer the questions the best you can.
items.zh: 考試不能用字典。盡你所能回答這些問題。

items.en: The pitch was wet and muddy. The team played the best they could in the rain.
items.zh: 球場又濕又泥濘。隊員們在雨中盡力比賽。

items.en: I fixed the bike the best I could, but it's still noisy.
items.zh: 我盡力修了腳踏車，不過它還是很吵。

items.en: My little sister asked me about the stars. I explained it the best I could.
items.zh: 我妹妹問我星星的事。我盡力解釋了。

items.en: My grandparents live far from the shops. They managed the best they could without a car.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶住得離商店很遠。他們在沒有車的情況下盡力應付。

title: Some people say that friendship today is not the same as it used to be.
translation: 有些人說，現在的友誼跟以前不一樣了。
name: the same as 加子句
sentences: Your grandmother's cakes are always perfect. Bake yours the same way as she does.
You loved the fish curry here. I ordered the same dish as you did last time.
My sister also forgot to sign the form. She made the same mistake as I did.
Little Sam copies everything his brother does. He wears the same clothes as his brother does.
We left home at seven this morning. We took the same train as we always do.
The other team also said the answer was Rome. They gave the same answer as we did.
Most people buy everything online now. Shopping isn't the same as it used to be.
There are big new houses where the fields were. The village isn't the same as it was in my childhood.
I still answer the phone and file reports. My job is the same as it was five years ago.
You went back to our old school last week. Is it still the same as it was?
The storm destroyed the harbour and half the shops. Nothing is the same as it was before.
I visited Grandma after ten years. Her kitchen was exactly the same as I remembered it.
I read lots of reviews before the trip. The hotel was the same as I expected.
The same cat was asleep on the counter. The old bookshop was the same as I remembered it from my student days.
The chef at this café is from Naples. The food tasted the same as it did in Italy.
Nobody had been in the flat during our holiday. Everything was the same as we left it.
We loved the pool at the Sea View. We stayed in the same hotel as we did last year.
My uncle never buys new things. He has the same car as he had at university.
I'd like to book again for May. I want the same room as I had last time.
My aunt has never moved. She still lives in the same house as she did as a child.
The band hasn't written anything new. They play the same songs as they played ten years ago.
I'd like to renew my gym membership. Is it the same price as it was last year?
The doctor checked my temperature again. Do you feel the same as you did yesterday?
Our team will miss you when you move to Berlin. It won't be the same as it was without you.
She never uses a recipe book. My grandmother cooks the same way as her mother did.
It rained all afternoon. The weather was the same as the forecast said.
I'm sorry, but I can't agree with your plan. I don't see things the same way as you do.
Read the new handbook before the exam. The rules aren't the same as they were last year.
I saw my old teacher at the station. He looks the same as he did twenty years ago.
I got full marks easily. The test had the same questions as the one we did last week.

examples.heading: ① the same + 名詞 + as + 主詞 + did / do

items.en: Your grandmother's cakes are always perfect. Bake yours the same way as she does.
items.zh: 你奶奶的蛋糕總是很完美。照她的方式烤你的蛋糕。

items.en: You loved the fish curry here. I ordered the same dish as you did last time.
items.zh: 你很喜歡這裡的咖哩魚。我點了跟你上次一樣的菜。

items.en: My sister also forgot to sign the form. She made the same mistake as I did.
items.zh: 我姊姊也忘了在表格上簽名。她犯了跟我一樣的錯。

items.en: Little Sam copies everything his brother does. He wears the same clothes as his brother does.
items.zh: 小山姆什麼都學他哥哥。他穿得跟他哥哥一樣。

items.en: We left home at seven this morning. We took the same train as we always do.
items.zh: 我們今天早上七點出門。我們搭了跟平常一樣的火車。

items.en: The other team also said the answer was Rome. They gave the same answer as we did.
items.zh: 另一隊也說答案是羅馬。他們給了跟我們一樣的答案。

examples.heading: ② the same as + it used to be / it was

items.en: Most people buy everything online now. Shopping isn't the same as it used to be.
items.zh: 現在大部分的人什麼都在網路上買。購物跟以前不一樣了。

items.en: There are big new houses where the fields were. The village isn't the same as it was in my childhood.
items.zh: 以前的田地蓋了新的大房子。這個村子跟我小時候不一樣了。

items.en: I still answer the phone and file reports. My job is the same as it was five years ago.
items.zh: 我還是接電話、整理報告。我的工作跟五年前一樣。

items.en: You went back to our old school last week. Is it still the same as it was?
items.zh: 你上星期回了我們以前的學校。它還跟以前一樣嗎？

items.en: The storm destroyed the harbour and half the shops. Nothing is the same as it was before.
items.zh: 暴風雨毀了港口和一半的商店。一切都跟以前不一樣了。

examples.heading: ③ the same as + I remembered / I expected

items.en: I visited Grandma after ten years. Her kitchen was exactly the same as I remembered it.
items.zh: 隔了十年我去看奶奶。她的廚房跟我記憶中的一模一樣。

items.en: I read lots of reviews before the trip. The hotel was the same as I expected.
items.zh: 我出發前看了很多評論。那家飯店跟我預期的一樣。

items.en: The same cat was asleep on the counter. The old bookshop was the same as I remembered it from my student days.
items.zh: 同一隻貓睡在櫃台上。那家老書店跟我學生時代記得的一樣。

items.en: The chef at this café is from Naples. The food tasted the same as it did in Italy.
items.zh: 這家咖啡館的主廚來自拿坡里。那些菜吃起來跟在義大利時一樣。

items.en: Nobody had been in the flat during our holiday. Everything was the same as we left it.
items.zh: 我們度假的時候沒有人進過公寓。一切都跟我們離開時一樣。

examples.heading: ④ the same + 名詞 + as + 其他子句

items.en: We loved the pool at the Sea View. We stayed in the same hotel as we did last year.
items.zh: 我們很喜歡海景飯店的游泳池。我們住了跟去年一樣的飯店。

items.en: My uncle never buys new things. He has the same car as he had at university.
items.zh: 我叔叔從來不買新東西。他開的車跟他大學時開的一樣。

items.en: I'd like to book again for May. I want the same room as I had last time.
items.zh: 我想再訂五月的房間。我想要跟上次一樣的房間。

items.en: My aunt has never moved. She still lives in the same house as she did as a child.
items.zh: 我阿姨從來沒搬過家。她還住在跟小時候同一棟房子裡。

items.en: The band hasn't written anything new. They play the same songs as they played ten years ago.
items.zh: 那個樂團沒有寫新歌。他們唱的歌跟十年前一樣。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和不同的句型

items.en: I'd like to renew my gym membership. Is it the same price as it was last year?
items.zh: 我想續約健身房的會員。價錢跟去年一樣嗎？

items.en: The doctor checked my temperature again. Do you feel the same as you did yesterday?
items.zh: 醫生又量了我的體溫。你覺得跟昨天一樣嗎？

items.en: Our team will miss you when you move to Berlin. It won't be the same as it was without you.
items.zh: 你搬去柏林以後，我們團隊會想念你。沒有你，一切都不會跟以前一樣了。

items.en: She never uses a recipe book. My grandmother cooks the same way as her mother did.
items.zh: 她從來不看食譜。我奶奶煮菜的方式跟她媽媽一樣。

items.en: It rained all afternoon. The weather was the same as the forecast said.
items.zh: 下了一整個下午的雨。天氣跟預報說的一樣。

items.en: I'm sorry, but I can't agree with your plan. I don't see things the same way as you do.
items.zh: 抱歉，我不能同意你的計畫。我看事情的方式跟你不一樣。

items.en: Read the new handbook before the exam. The rules aren't the same as they were last year.
items.zh: 考試前讀一下新的手冊。規定跟去年不一樣了。

items.en: I saw my old teacher at the station. He looks the same as he did twenty years ago.
items.zh: 我在車站看到我以前的老師。他看起來跟二十年前一樣。

items.en: I got full marks easily. The test had the same questions as the one we did last week.
items.zh: 我輕鬆拿了滿分。這次考試的題目跟上禮拜那次一樣。

title: It's better to be with people who are the same age as you.
translation: 跟和你同年紀的人在一起比較好。
name: the same (名詞) as
sentences: My son is the same height as his teacher now.
Ken and my brother were born in the same month. Ken is the same age as my brother.
I don't need to try them on. These shoes are the same size as my old ones.
Our neighbours have three bedrooms too. Their house is the same size as ours.
My son is starting school in September. Is your son the same age as mine?
I've grown a lot this year. I'm almost the same weight as my father.
Look at the man in the green tie. His tie is the same color as the walls.
I know Mia from netball. She's in the same team as my daughter.
We both passed Grade 5 this year. My cousin is at the same level as me in piano.
Look, we both drive a blue Honda. My car is the same model as yours.
They take the bus together every morning. Ann goes to the same school as my daughter.
My son is called Henry. He has the same name as his grandfather.
He always wants the latest football game. My little brother likes the same games as his friends.
Your laptop won't start? I had the same problem as you last year.
My sister couldn't decide what to eat. She ordered the same dish as me.
We did the science experiment twice. We got the same results as the other team.
I see the Browns every time I visit home. They live on the same street as my parents.
Look at Lily and her mother. Her new haircut is the same as her mum's.
I got eighty-one, and you got eighty-two. My exam score was almost the same as yours.
Why did you pay so much for the new model? This phone looks the same as the old one.
Lucy says the answer to question five is twelve. Is your answer the same as hers?
It's raining again. The weather today is the same as yesterday.
The new table is round. It isn't the same shape as the old one.
The shops in our village close at five. Life here isn't the same as in the city.
The sofa arrived today, but it's not the same color as the photo.
You're in Year 4 now. Do you have the same teacher as last year?
Kids learn faster with classmates at the same level as them.
My son showed the barber a photo. "I want the same haircut as my friend."
They changed the ending. The film wasn't the same as the book.
We ran to the stop and didn't have to wait. We arrived at the same time as the bus.

examples.heading: ① the same age / height / size + as

items.en: My son is the same height as his teacher now.
items.zh: 我兒子現在跟他的老師一樣高。

items.en: Ken and my brother were born in the same month. Ken is the same age as my brother.
items.zh: Ken 和我哥哥在同一個月出生。Ken 跟我哥哥同年。

items.en: I don't need to try them on. These shoes are the same size as my old ones.
items.zh: 我不用試穿。這雙鞋跟我的舊鞋一樣大。

items.en: Our neighbours have three bedrooms too. Their house is the same size as ours.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居也有三個臥室。他們的房子跟我們的一樣大。

items.en: My son is starting school in September. Is your son the same age as mine?
items.zh: 我兒子九月要上學了。你兒子跟我兒子同年嗎？

items.en: I've grown a lot this year. I'm almost the same weight as my father.
items.zh: 我今年長大很多。我的體重跟我爸爸差不多。

examples.heading: ② the same color / class / level + as

items.en: Look at the man in the green tie. His tie is the same color as the walls.
items.zh: 你看那個打綠領帶的男人。他的領帶跟牆壁同一個顏色。

items.en: I know Mia from netball. She's in the same team as my daughter.
items.zh: 我是在籃網球認識 Mia 的。她跟我女兒在同一隊。

items.en: We both passed Grade 5 this year. My cousin is at the same level as me in piano.
items.zh: 我們今年都考過了五級。我表弟的鋼琴程度跟我一樣。

items.en: Look, we both drive a blue Honda. My car is the same model as yours.
items.zh: 你看，我們都開藍色的本田。我的車跟你的同款。

items.en: They take the bus together every morning. Ann goes to the same school as my daughter.
items.zh: 她們每天早上一起搭公車。Ann 跟我女兒讀同一所學校。

items.en: My son is called Henry. He has the same name as his grandfather.
items.zh: 我兒子叫亨利。他跟他爺爺同名。

examples.heading: ③ the same things / problem + as

items.en: He always wants the latest football game. My little brother likes the same games as his friends.
items.zh: 他總是要最新的足球遊戲。我弟弟喜歡的遊戲跟他朋友一樣。

items.en: Your laptop won't start? I had the same problem as you last year.
items.zh: 你的筆電開不了機？我去年也遇到跟你一樣的問題。

items.en: My sister couldn't decide what to eat. She ordered the same dish as me.
items.zh: 我姊姊不知道要吃什麼。她點了跟我一樣的菜。

items.en: We did the science experiment twice. We got the same results as the other team.
items.zh: 我們做了兩次科學實驗。我們得到的結果跟另一組一樣。

items.en: I see the Browns every time I visit home. They live on the same street as my parents.
items.zh: 我每次回家都會看到布朗一家。他們跟我爸媽住在同一條街。

examples.heading: ④ the same as + 代名詞 / 名詞

items.en: Look at Lily and her mother. Her new haircut is the same as her mum's.
items.zh: 你看莉莉和她媽媽。她的新髮型跟她媽媽的一樣。

items.en: I got eighty-one, and you got eighty-two. My exam score was almost the same as yours.
items.zh: 我考八十一分，你考八十二分。我的考試分數跟你的幾乎一樣。

items.en: Why did you pay so much for the new model? This phone looks the same as the old one.
items.zh: 你為什麼花那麼多錢買新款？這支手機看起來跟舊的一樣。

items.en: Lucy says the answer to question five is twelve. Is your answer the same as hers?
items.zh: 露西說第五題的答案是十二。你的答案跟她的一樣嗎？

items.en: It's raining again. The weather today is the same as yesterday.
items.zh: 又在下雨了。今天的天氣跟昨天一樣。

examples.heading: ⑤ not the same / 不同的句型

items.en: The new table is round. It isn't the same shape as the old one.
items.zh: 新桌子是圓的。它的形狀跟舊的不一樣。

items.en: The shops in our village close at five. Life here isn't the same as in the city.
items.zh: 我們村子的店五點就關門了。這裡的生活跟城市不一樣。

items.en: The sofa arrived today, but it's not the same color as the photo.
items.zh: 沙發今天送到了，可是它的顏色跟照片上的不一樣。

items.en: You're in Year 4 now. Do you have the same teacher as last year?
items.zh: 你現在四年級了。你的老師跟去年一樣嗎？

items.en: Kids learn faster with classmates at the same level as them.
items.zh: 孩子跟程度一樣的同學在一起學得比較快。

items.en: My son showed the barber a photo. "I want the same haircut as my friend."
items.zh: 我兒子給理髮師看了一張照片。我想剪跟我朋友一樣的髮型。

items.en: They changed the ending. The film wasn't the same as the book.
items.zh: 他們改了結局。電影跟書不一樣。

items.en: We ran to the stop and didn't have to wait. We arrived at the same time as the bus.
items.zh: 我們跑到公車站，不用等。我們跟公車同時到。

title: I think you are too young to go on holiday by yourself.
translation: 我覺得你年紀太小，還不能自己一個人去度假。
name: too … to 不定詞句型
sentences: I think your son is too young to stay home alone.
My aunt has just opened a new shop. She's too busy to visit us this month.
Dad was always too busy to come to my football games.
Ann saw her favourite singer at the airport, but she was too shy to say hello.
We were flying to Disneyland the next morning. The kids were too excited to sleep.
I didn't have lunch today. I'm too hungry to wait until dinner.
I loved the red coat in the window, but it was too expensive to buy.
I'll leave the dictionary at home. This book is too heavy to carry around.
My cousin is two metres tall. The bed in our spare room was too small for him to sleep in.
Leave the car at the station. The street is too narrow to park in.
We bought a new TV, but the box was too big to fit in the car.
The shops are closed. It's too late to buy milk now.
The hotel is six kilometres away. It's too far to walk from here.
We went to the courts on Sunday, but it was too windy to play tennis.
The election is still three months away. It's too early to say who will win.
My grandmother started piano lessons at seventy. It's never too late to learn.
You've worked for twelve hours. I think you're too tired to finish this tonight.
Mum has been awake since five. I think she's too sleepy to drive home.
The water is only twelve degrees. I think it's too cold to swim today.
Don't tell Sam about Grandpa's illness yet. I think he's too young to understand.
You want to climb the mountain in winter? Don't you think it's too risky to go alone?
My sister only drank some water that morning. She was too nervous to eat before the exam.
You've had a long day at work. Are you too tired to come to the party?
The manager has meetings all day. He'll be too busy to see you tomorrow.
I opened the fridge after our holiday. The milk was too old to drink.
The concert finished at midnight. We were too late to catch the last train.
The dog dies at the end. The story was too sad to read to the kids.
After the storm, the beach was too dirty to walk on.
The heating in the classroom was broken. My hands were too cold to write.
I was cooking during the news. The TV was too quiet to hear from the kitchen.

examples.heading: ① 人 + too + 形容詞 + to 不定詞

items.en: I think your son is too young to stay home alone.
items.zh: 我覺得你兒子年紀太小，不能一個人待在家。

items.en: My aunt has just opened a new shop. She's too busy to visit us this month.
items.zh: 我阿姨剛開了一家新店。她這個月太忙了，沒空來看我們。

items.en: Dad was always too busy to come to my football games.
items.zh: 爸爸總是忙到沒空來看我的足球賽。

items.en: Ann saw her favourite singer at the airport, but she was too shy to say hello.
items.zh: Ann 在機場看到她最喜歡的歌手，可是她太害羞了，不敢打招呼。

items.en: We were flying to Disneyland the next morning. The kids were too excited to sleep.
items.zh: 我們隔天早上要飛去迪士尼樂園。孩子們太興奮了，睡不著。

items.en: I didn't have lunch today. I'm too hungry to wait until dinner.
items.zh: 我今天沒吃午餐。我太餓了，等不到晚餐。

examples.heading: ② 東西 + too + 形容詞 + to 不定詞

items.en: I loved the red coat in the window, but it was too expensive to buy.
items.zh: 我很喜歡櫥窗裡那件紅大衣，可是它太貴了，買不下手。

items.en: I'll leave the dictionary at home. This book is too heavy to carry around.
items.zh: 我把字典留在家裡。這本書太重了，不方便帶著走。

items.en: My cousin is two metres tall. The bed in our spare room was too small for him to sleep in.
items.zh: 我表哥有兩公尺高。我們客房的床太小了，他沒辦法睡。

items.en: Leave the car at the station. The street is too narrow to park in.
items.zh: 把車停在車站。那條街太窄了，不能停車。

items.en: We bought a new TV, but the box was too big to fit in the car.
items.zh: 我們買了一台新電視，可是箱子太大了，塞不進車裡。

examples.heading: ③ it + be + too + 形容詞 + to 不定詞

items.en: The shops are closed. It's too late to buy milk now.
items.zh: 店都關了，現在太晚，買不到牛奶了。

items.en: The hotel is six kilometres away. It's too far to walk from here.
items.zh: 飯店在六公里外。從這裡走路太遠了。

items.en: We went to the courts on Sunday, but it was too windy to play tennis.
items.zh: 我們星期天去了球場，可是風太大了，不能打網球。

items.en: The election is still three months away. It's too early to say who will win.
items.zh: 選舉還有三個月。現在說誰會贏還太早。

items.en: My grandmother started piano lessons at seventy. It's never too late to learn.
items.zh: 我奶奶七十歲開始學鋼琴。學習永遠不嫌晚。

examples.heading: ④ I think you're too ... to

items.en: You've worked for twelve hours. I think you're too tired to finish this tonight.
items.zh: 你已經工作十二個小時了。我覺得你太累了，今晚做不完這個。

items.en: Mum has been awake since five. I think she's too sleepy to drive home.
items.zh: 媽媽五點就起床了。我覺得她太睏了，不能開車回家。

items.en: The water is only twelve degrees. I think it's too cold to swim today.
items.zh: 水溫只有十二度。我覺得今天太冷，不能游泳。

items.en: Don't tell Sam about Grandpa's illness yet. I think he's too young to understand.
items.zh: 先別跟山姆說爺爺生病的事。我覺得他年紀太小，還不懂。

items.en: You want to climb the mountain in winter? Don't you think it's too risky to go alone?
items.zh: 你想在冬天爬那座山？你不覺得一個人去太冒險了嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: My sister only drank some water that morning. She was too nervous to eat before the exam.
items.zh: 我姊姊那天早上只喝了一點水。考試前她太緊張了，吃不下東西。

items.en: You've had a long day at work. Are you too tired to come to the party?
items.zh: 你上了一整天的班。你累到不能來派對嗎？

items.en: The manager has meetings all day. He'll be too busy to see you tomorrow.
items.zh: 經理一整天都在開會。他明天會太忙，沒空見你。

items.en: I opened the fridge after our holiday. The milk was too old to drink.
items.zh: 度假回來我打開冰箱。牛奶放太久了，不能喝。

items.en: The concert finished at midnight. We were too late to catch the last train.
items.zh: 音樂會半夜才結束。我們太晚了，沒趕上最後一班火車。

items.en: The dog dies at the end. The story was too sad to read to the kids.
items.zh: 最後狗死了。那個故事太悲傷了，不適合唸給孩子聽。

items.en: After the storm, the beach was too dirty to walk on.
items.zh: 暴風雨過後，海灘髒到不能走。

items.en: The heating in the classroom was broken. My hands were too cold to write.
items.zh: 教室的暖氣壞了。我的手太冰了，沒辦法寫字。

items.en: I was cooking during the news. The TV was too quiet to hear from the kitchen.
items.zh: 新聞播出的時候我在煮飯。電視太小聲了，在廚房聽不到。

title: I don't like trousers as much as you do.
translation: 我沒有像你那麼喜歡長褲。
name: (not) as … as
sentences: We finally found a place with three bedrooms. The flat is as big as we wanted.
I finally saw the new Bond film. It was as good as everyone said.
I went back to Crete after twenty years. The beach was as beautiful as I remembered.
You started at the bank last week. Is the new job as hard as you thought?
We sat on it for an hour last night. The new sofa is as comfortable as we hoped.
I swam for half an hour in Scotland. The sea was not as cold as I expected.
The managers smiled and asked easy questions. The interview wasn't as scary as I feared.
Our room is dark and small. The hotel isn't as nice as it looks online.
My uncle has two grandchildren. He's not as young as he looks.
The factory closed, and many families left. The town isn't as busy as it used to be.
Tom doesn't enjoy shopping as much as his wife does.
They play outside after school now. My kids don't watch TV as much as they did last year.
My niece came second in the race. She can't swim as fast as her brother can.
Dad made dinner tonight, but he doesn't cook as well as Mum does.
We're always tired these days. We don't go out as much as we did before the baby.
I lived in Paris twenty years ago. I can't speak French as well as I could then.
I'll practice as often as I can before the concert.
Your father has fallen in the garden. Please come as soon as you can.
I'll answer your emails as quickly as I can while you're away.
There's lots of food left from the party. Eat as much as you want.
The bus is leaving! Run as fast as you can!
My daughter got sick, so we came home early. The trip wasn't as long as we had planned.
The advert says you can learn Spanish in a month. Is it as easy as it sounds?
She goes to the market on foot every day. My grandmother still walks as much as she did ten years ago.
It was on sale for half price. The new phone wasn't as expensive as I feared.
Come on, only one more kilometre. You're not as tired as you think you are.
He's eighty-five now. My grandfather doesn't drive as fast as he used to.
We agreed on everything quickly. The meeting didn't last as long as we expected.
Our children live abroad now. They don't visit us as often as they did.
You waited a year for the new comedy. Was the film as funny as you'd hoped?

examples.heading: ① as + 形容詞 + as + 子句

items.en: We finally found a place with three bedrooms. The flat is as big as we wanted.
items.zh: 我們終於找到一間有三個臥室的地方。那間公寓跟我們想要的一樣大。

items.en: I finally saw the new Bond film. It was as good as everyone said.
items.zh: 我終於看了新的 007 電影。它跟大家說的一樣好看。

items.en: I went back to Crete after twenty years. The beach was as beautiful as I remembered.
items.zh: 我隔了二十年又回到克里特島。那片海灘跟我記憶中的一樣美。

items.en: You started at the bank last week. Is the new job as hard as you thought?
items.zh: 你上星期開始在銀行上班。新工作跟你想的一樣難嗎？

items.en: We sat on it for an hour last night. The new sofa is as comfortable as we hoped.
items.zh: 我們昨天晚上在上面坐了一個小時。新沙發跟我們希望的一樣舒服。

examples.heading: ② not as + 形容詞 + as + 子句

items.en: I swam for half an hour in Scotland. The sea was not as cold as I expected.
items.zh: 我在蘇格蘭游了半個小時。海水沒有我預期的那麼冷。

items.en: The managers smiled and asked easy questions. The interview wasn't as scary as I feared.
items.zh: 經理們面帶微笑，問了簡單的問題。面試沒有我擔心的那麼可怕。

items.en: Our room is dark and small. The hotel isn't as nice as it looks online.
items.zh: 我們的房間又暗又小。那家飯店沒有網路上看起來那麼好。

items.en: My uncle has two grandchildren. He's not as young as he looks.
items.zh: 我叔叔有兩個孫子了。他沒有看起來那麼年輕。

items.en: The factory closed, and many families left. The town isn't as busy as it used to be.
items.zh: 工廠關了，很多家庭都搬走了。這個小鎮沒有以前那麼熱鬧了。

examples.heading: ③ as + 副詞 + as + 主詞 + 助動詞

items.en: Tom doesn't enjoy shopping as much as his wife does.
items.zh: Tom 沒有他太太那麼喜歡逛街。

items.en: They play outside after school now. My kids don't watch TV as much as they did last year.
items.zh: 他們現在放學後都在外面玩。我的孩子沒有像去年那麼常看電視了。

items.en: My niece came second in the race. She can't swim as fast as her brother can.
items.zh: 我姪女比賽拿第二名。她游得沒有她哥哥那麼快。

items.en: Dad made dinner tonight, but he doesn't cook as well as Mum does.
items.zh: 爸爸今天晚上煮晚餐，可是他煮得沒有媽媽好。

items.en: We're always tired these days. We don't go out as much as we did before the baby.
items.zh: 我們最近總是很累。有了寶寶以後，我們沒有像以前那麼常出門。

items.en: I lived in Paris twenty years ago. I can't speak French as well as I could then.
items.zh: 我二十年前住在巴黎。我的法文沒有那時候說得那麼好了。

examples.heading: ④ as much as I can / as soon as you can

items.en: I'll practice as often as I can before the concert.
items.zh: 演唱會前我會盡量多練習。

items.en: Your father has fallen in the garden. Please come as soon as you can.
items.zh: 你爸爸在花園裡跌倒了。請盡快過來。

items.en: I'll answer your emails as quickly as I can while you're away.
items.zh: 你不在的時候，我會盡快幫你回電子郵件。

items.en: There's lots of food left from the party. Eat as much as you want.
items.zh: 派對剩了很多食物。想吃多少就吃多少。

items.en: The bus is leaving! Run as fast as you can!
items.zh: 公車要開了！盡你所能地快跑！

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: My daughter got sick, so we came home early. The trip wasn't as long as we had planned.
items.zh: 我女兒生病了，所以我們提早回家。這趟旅行沒有我們原本計畫的那麼長。

items.en: The advert says you can learn Spanish in a month. Is it as easy as it sounds?
items.zh: 廣告說一個月就可以學會西班牙文。它有聽起來那麼容易嗎？

items.en: She goes to the market on foot every day. My grandmother still walks as much as she did ten years ago.
items.zh: 她每天走路去市場。我奶奶現在走的路跟十年前一樣多。

items.en: It was on sale for half price. The new phone wasn't as expensive as I feared.
items.zh: 它在打對折。新手機沒有我擔心的那麼貴。

items.en: Come on, only one more kilometre. You're not as tired as you think you are.
items.zh: 加油，只剩一公里了。你沒有你以為的那麼累。

items.en: He's eighty-five now. My grandfather doesn't drive as fast as he used to.
items.zh: 他現在八十五歲了。我爺爺開車沒有以前那麼快了。

items.en: We agreed on everything quickly. The meeting didn't last as long as we expected.
items.zh: 我們很快就什麼都同意了。會議沒有我們預期的那麼久。

items.en: Our children live abroad now. They don't visit us as often as they did.
items.zh: 我們的孩子現在住在國外。他們沒有像以前那麼常來看我們了。

items.en: You waited a year for the new comedy. Was the film as funny as you'd hoped?
items.zh: 你等了一年那部新喜劇。那部電影有你希望的那麼好笑嗎？

title: I do miss you.
translation: 我真的很想你。
name: 肯定直述句中表示強調的助動詞 do
sentences: My new school is fine, but I do miss my old school.
We stopped in front of a picture of the sea at the gallery. I do love the colors in this painting.
With three kids, we do need a bigger car.
Yes, I do have a dog. He's at my parents' house.
The new cleaners start at six every morning. They do work hard, and they never complain.
I do hope the rain stops before the wedding.
She does like chocolate, but she's on a diet.
Our new waiter is slow, but he does try his best.
Maybe we should go home. The sky over the hills does look dark.
Mum says he's lazy, but my brother does help at home sometimes.
Who made this? This soup does taste good.
Don't say you're busy on Saturday. You did promise to help me move.
I did call you, but you didn't answer.
Thanks for dinner. We did enjoy the fish.
Grandpa did take his pills this morning. I watched him.
I missed Tom's party last week. He did tell me, but I forgot.
A: You never cook. B: I do cook! I made pasta last night.
A: Did you lock the door? B: Yes, I did lock it.
A: Ken never reads. B: He does read. He reads comics.
A: You didn't study. B: I did study, but the test was hard.
Thank you for your email of 3 May. I do apologize for the late reply.
Grandma's funeral was very sad. We do appreciate all the flowers you sent.
I lost my job last year too. I do understand how you feel.
Let's eat out on Friday. I do want to try that new Thai place.
Your sister is still upset about the party. I do think you should talk to her.
Listen to my cousin in the choir. She does sing beautifully.
Everyone said our idea was crazy. The plan did work in the end.
That man waved at me in the shop. I do remember his face, but not his name.
The final ended two to one. Our team did win the cup, but only just.
You do look pale today. Did you skip breakfast?

examples.heading: ① do + 原形動詞

items.en: My new school is fine, but I do miss my old school.
items.zh: 我的新學校還不錯，可是我真的很想念我以前的學校。

items.en: We stopped in front of a picture of the sea at the gallery. I do love the colors in this painting.
items.zh: 我們在美術館一幅海的畫前面停下來。我真的很喜歡這幅畫的顏色。

items.en: With three kids, we do need a bigger car.
items.zh: 有三個孩子，我們真的需要一輛大一點的車。

items.en: Yes, I do have a dog. He's at my parents' house.
items.zh: 對，我確實有養狗，牠在我爸媽家。

items.en: The new cleaners start at six every morning. They do work hard, and they never complain.
items.zh: 新的清潔人員每天早上六點就開始工作。他們真的很努力，而且從不抱怨。

items.en: I do hope the rain stops before the wedding.
items.zh: 我真的希望婚禮前雨會停。

examples.heading: ② does + 原形動詞

items.en: She does like chocolate, but she's on a diet.
items.zh: 她確實喜歡巧克力，只是在節食。

items.en: Our new waiter is slow, but he does try his best.
items.zh: 我們的新服務生動作很慢，不過他真的很盡力。

items.en: Maybe we should go home. The sky over the hills does look dark.
items.zh: 也許我們應該回家了。山那邊的天空看起來真的很暗。

items.en: Mum says he's lazy, but my brother does help at home sometimes.
items.zh: 媽媽說他很懶，可是我弟弟有時候確實會在家幫忙。

items.en: Who made this? This soup does taste good.
items.zh: 這是誰做的？這湯真的很好喝。

examples.heading: ③ did + 原形動詞

items.en: Don't say you're busy on Saturday. You did promise to help me move.
items.zh: 別說你星期六很忙。你確實答應過要幫我搬家。

items.en: I did call you, but you didn't answer.
items.zh: 我真的有打給你，可是你沒接。

items.en: Thanks for dinner. We did enjoy the fish.
items.zh: 謝謝你的晚餐，我們真的很喜歡那道魚。

items.en: Grandpa did take his pills this morning. I watched him.
items.zh: 爺爺今天早上確實吃了藥，我親眼看到的。

items.en: I missed Tom's party last week. He did tell me, but I forgot.
items.zh: 我錯過了湯姆上星期的派對。他確實告訴過我，可是我忘了。

examples.heading: ④ 回應別人的懷疑

items.en: A: You never cook. B: I do cook! I made pasta last night.
items.zh: A：你從來不煮飯。B：我有煮啊！我昨晚才煮了義大利麵。

items.en: A: Did you lock the door? B: Yes, I did lock it.
items.zh: A：你有鎖門嗎？B：有，我真的鎖了。

items.en: A: Ken never reads. B: He does read. He reads comics.
items.zh: A：Ken 從來不看書。B：他有看啊，他看漫畫。

items.en: A: You didn't study. B: I did study, but the test was hard.
items.zh: A：你沒讀書。B：我真的有讀，只是考試很難。

examples.heading: ⑤ 客氣地道歉、感謝和不同的句型

items.en: Thank you for your email of 3 May. I do apologize for the late reply.
items.zh: 謝謝你五月三日的來信。我真的很抱歉這麼晚才回覆。

items.en: Grandma's funeral was very sad. We do appreciate all the flowers you sent.
items.zh: 奶奶的葬禮很令人難過。我們真的很感謝你送來的花。

items.en: I lost my job last year too. I do understand how you feel.
items.zh: 我去年也丟了工作。我真的懂你的感受。

items.en: Let's eat out on Friday. I do want to try that new Thai place.
items.zh: 我們星期五出去吃吧。我真的很想去試那家新的泰國餐廳。

items.en: Your sister is still upset about the party. I do think you should talk to her.
items.zh: 你姊姊還在為派對的事難過。我真的覺得你應該跟她談談。

items.en: Listen to my cousin in the choir. She does sing beautifully.
items.zh: 你聽合唱團裡我表妹的聲音。她唱歌真的很好聽。

items.en: Everyone said our idea was crazy. The plan did work in the end.
items.zh: 大家都說我們的想法很瘋狂。那個計畫最後確實成功了。

items.en: That man waved at me in the shop. I do remember his face, but not his name.
items.zh: 那個男人在店裡跟我揮手。我確實記得他的臉，可是不記得他的名字。

items.en: The final ended two to one. Our team did win the cup, but only just.
items.zh: 決賽以二比一結束。我們的隊伍確實贏了獎盃，只是險勝。

items.en: You do look pale today. Did you skip breakfast?
items.zh: 你今天看起來臉色真的很蒼白，你沒吃早餐嗎？

title: I love her because she is friendly.
translation: 我愛她，因為她很友善。
name: because 子句放在主要子句後說明原因
sentences: I like my new flat because it has a big balcony.
My son loves his teacher because she tells funny stories.
I don't like winter because it gets dark so early.
We like this beach because the water is so clear.
She doesn't like coffee because it's too bitter.
I love Sundays because I can sleep late.
I'm wearing a jacket because it's windy outside.
We took a taxi because we were late.
He's studying hard because he has an exam on Friday.
I called my mom because I missed her.
They're saving money because they want to buy a house.
I went to bed early because I was very sleepy.
My sister is happy because she passed her driving test.
The baby is crying because he's hungry.
I'm nervous because I have a job interview today.
The kids are excited because it's snowing.
My feet hurt because these shoes are new.
A: Why are you late? B: Because my bus didn't come.
A: Why is the shop closed? B: Because it's a holiday.
A: Why do you want to learn Korean? B: Because I love K-pop.
A: Why are you smiling? B: Because I got the job!
A: Why didn't you eat lunch? B: Because I wasn't hungry.
I can't come to the party because I have to work.
Please be quiet because the baby is sleeping.
We didn't buy the sofa because it didn't fit through the door.
He's very thrifty because he grew up with very little money.
I'm learning to cook because I want to eat more healthily.
Our team won because everyone played well.
Turn on the light because I can't see anything.
I bought two cakes because my brother is coming too.

examples.heading: ① 說明喜歡或不喜歡

items.en: I like my new flat because it has a big balcony.
items.zh: 我喜歡我的新公寓，因為它有一個大陽台。

items.en: My son loves his teacher because she tells funny stories.
items.zh: 我兒子很喜歡他的老師，因為她會講好笑的故事。

items.en: I don't like winter because it gets dark so early.
items.zh: 我不喜歡冬天，因為天黑得好早。

items.en: We like this beach because the water is so clear.
items.zh: 我們喜歡這片海灘，因為水好清澈。

items.en: She doesn't like coffee because it's too bitter.
items.zh: 她不喜歡咖啡，因為太苦了。

items.en: I love Sundays because I can sleep late.
items.zh: 我很愛星期天，因為我可以睡晚一點。

examples.heading: ② 說明做一件事的原因

items.en: I'm wearing a jacket because it's windy outside.
items.zh: 我穿了外套，因為外面風很大。

items.en: We took a taxi because we were late.
items.zh: 我們搭了計程車，因為我們遲到了。

items.en: He's studying hard because he has an exam on Friday.
items.zh: 他很用功，因為他星期五有考試。

items.en: I called my mom because I missed her.
items.zh: 我打給我媽，因為我想她。

items.en: They're saving money because they want to buy a house.
items.zh: 他們在存錢，因為他們想買房子。

items.en: I went to bed early because I was very sleepy.
items.zh: 我很早就睡了，因為我很睏。

examples.heading: ③ 說明感覺和狀態

items.en: My sister is happy because she passed her driving test.
items.zh: 我姊姊很開心，因為她考過駕照了。

items.en: The baby is crying because he's hungry.
items.zh: 寶寶在哭，因為他餓了。

items.en: I'm nervous because I have a job interview today.
items.zh: 我很緊張，因為我今天有工作面試。

items.en: The kids are excited because it's snowing.
items.zh: 孩子們很興奮，因為在下雪。
