items.en: My feet hurt because these shoes are new.
items.zh: 我的腳好痛，因為這雙鞋是新的。

examples.heading: ④ 回答 Why 的問題

items.en: A: Why are you late? B: Because my bus didn't come.
items.zh: A：你為什麼遲到？B：因為我的公車沒來。

items.en: A: Why is the shop closed? B: Because it's a holiday.
items.zh: A：那家店為什麼沒開？B：因為今天放假。

items.en: A: Why do you want to learn Korean? B: Because I love K-pop.
items.zh: A：你為什麼想學韓文？B：因為我很愛韓國流行音樂。

items.en: A: Why are you smiling? B: Because I got the job!
items.zh: A：你為什麼在笑？B：因為我得到那份工作了！

items.en: A: Why didn't you eat lunch? B: Because I wasn't hungry.
items.zh: A：你為什麼沒吃午餐？B：因為我不餓。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: I can't come to the party because I have to work.
items.zh: 我不能去派對，因為我要上班。

items.en: Please be quiet because the baby is sleeping.
items.zh: 請安靜一點，因為寶寶在睡覺。

items.en: We didn't buy the sofa because it didn't fit through the door.
items.zh: 我們沒買那張沙發，因為它搬不進門。

items.en: He's very thrifty because he grew up with very little money.
items.zh: 他很節儉，因為他從小家裡就沒什麼錢。

items.en: I'm learning to cook because I want to eat more healthily.
items.zh: 我在學做菜，因為我想吃得健康一點。

items.en: Our team won because everyone played well.
items.zh: 我們隊贏了，因為每個人都打得很好。

items.en: Turn on the light because I can't see anything.
items.zh: 把燈打開，因為我什麼都看不到。

items.en: I bought two cakes because my brother is coming too.
items.zh: 我買了兩個蛋糕，因為我弟弟也要來。

title: Provided the weather is fine, you could go swimming or take a tour of our beautiful town.
translation: 只要天氣好，你可以去游泳，或是參觀一下我們美麗的小鎮。
name: 表示條件的從屬子句
sentences: We'll have the barbecue on Sunday unless the forecast changes.
Don't call me unless it's an emergency.
The plants will die unless someone waters them.
Unless the bank opens on Saturday, I'll have to go on Monday.
She never drinks coffee unless she's really tired.
The ferry is the quickest way to the island unless the sea is rough.
Provided that you finish your work, you can leave early.
I'll come to the party provided I can bring a friend.
Provided the price is right, we'll buy the house.
The trip will go ahead provided that enough people sign up.
You can use the kitchen provided you clean up afterwards.
Providing the train is on time, I'll be there by ten.
We'll play tennis providing that it doesn't rain.
You can have a dog providing you take it for walks.
Providing that everyone agrees, we'll start on Monday.
I'm happy to help providing it doesn't take too long.
You can borrow my bike as long as you lock it.
As long as you're honest, I won't be angry.
You can bring your dog as long as it stays on a lead.
I'll cook dinner as long as you do the dishes.
As long as we have each other, we'll be fine.
Unless you hurry, all the good seats will be gone.
The airline will change your ticket provided you call before Friday.
I don't mind which hotel we stay at, as long as it has a pool.
You won't lose weight unless you change your diet.
The concert will be outdoors providing the weather is good.
Unless I hear from you, I'll see you at eight.
You can stay up late tonight as long as you're not tired tomorrow.
I'll lend you the money provided you pay me back next month.
Nothing will change unless people start to care.

examples.heading: ① unless

items.en: We'll have the barbecue on Sunday unless the forecast changes.
items.zh: 除非天氣預報有變，不然我們星期天烤肉。

items.en: Don't call me unless it's an emergency.
items.zh: 除非有急事，不然別打給我。

items.en: The plants will die unless someone waters them.
items.zh: 除非有人澆水，不然植物會死掉。

items.en: Unless the bank opens on Saturday, I'll have to go on Monday.
items.zh: 除非銀行星期六有開，不然我得星期一去。

items.en: She never drinks coffee unless she's really tired.
items.zh: 除非她真的很累，不然她從來不喝咖啡。

items.en: The ferry is the quickest way to the island unless the sea is rough.
items.zh: 搭渡輪是去那座島最快的方法，除非海上風浪很大。

examples.heading: ② provided / provided that

items.en: Provided that you finish your work, you can leave early.
items.zh: 只要你做完工作，就可以提早走。

items.en: I'll come to the party provided I can bring a friend.
items.zh: 只要我可以帶朋友，我就會去派對。

items.en: Provided the price is right, we'll buy the house.
items.zh: 只要價錢合理，我們就會買那間房子。

items.en: The trip will go ahead provided that enough people sign up.
items.zh: 只要有足夠的人報名，旅行就會照常舉行。

items.en: You can use the kitchen provided you clean up afterwards.
items.zh: 只要你用完會清理，就可以用廚房。

examples.heading: ③ providing / providing that

items.en: Providing the train is on time, I'll be there by ten.
items.zh: 只要火車準時，我十點前會到。

items.en: We'll play tennis providing that it doesn't rain.
items.zh: 只要沒下雨，我們就會去打網球。

items.en: You can have a dog providing you take it for walks.
items.zh: 只要你會帶牠去散步，就可以養狗。

items.en: Providing that everyone agrees, we'll start on Monday.
items.zh: 只要大家都同意，我們星期一就開始。

items.en: I'm happy to help providing it doesn't take too long.
items.zh: 只要不會花太久，我很樂意幫忙。

examples.heading: ④ as long as

items.en: You can borrow my bike as long as you lock it.
items.zh: 只要你有上鎖，就可以借我的腳踏車。

items.en: As long as you're honest, I won't be angry.
items.zh: 只要你說實話，我就不會生氣。

items.en: You can bring your dog as long as it stays on a lead.
items.zh: 只要你的狗繫著牽繩，就可以帶牠來。

items.en: I'll cook dinner as long as you do the dishes.
items.zh: 只要你洗碗，我就煮晚餐。

items.en: As long as we have each other, we'll be fine.
items.zh: 只要我們有彼此，就沒問題。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Unless you hurry, all the good seats will be gone.
items.zh: 除非你快一點，不然好位子都會被搶光。

items.en: The airline will change your ticket provided you call before Friday.
items.zh: 只要你在星期五前打電話，航空公司就會幫你改票。

items.en: I don't mind which hotel we stay at, as long as it has a pool.
items.zh: 只要有游泳池，我不在乎住哪家飯店。

items.en: You won't lose weight unless you change your diet.
items.zh: 除非你改變飲食，不然不會瘦下來。

items.en: The concert will be outdoors providing the weather is good.
items.zh: 只要天氣好，演唱會就會在戶外舉行。

items.en: Unless I hear from you, I'll see you at eight.
items.zh: 除非你有通知我，不然我們八點見。

items.en: You can stay up late tonight as long as you're not tired tomorrow.
items.zh: 只要你明天不會累，今晚可以晚點睡。

items.en: I'll lend you the money provided you pay me back next month.
items.zh: 只要你下個月還我，我就借你錢。

items.en: Nothing will change unless people start to care.
items.zh: 除非大家開始在乎，不然什麼都不會改變。

title: Although he was famous, I didn't like him.
translation: 雖然他很有名，我還是不喜歡他。
name: although、even though 引導的讓步副詞子句
sentences: Although the restaurant was full, they found us a table.
Although I studied hard, I didn't pass the test.
Although she's only twelve, she speaks three languages.
Although the film was long, nobody got bored.
Although we live in the same street, we rarely see each other.
Although the flat is small, it's very bright.
I bought the jacket, although it was quite expensive.
He came to work, although he had a bad cold.
I enjoyed the book, although the ending was sad.
We had a great time, although the weather was terrible.
She said yes, although she didn't really want to go.
The plan worked, although nobody expected it to.
Though my cousin lives in Canada, we talk every week.
Though the shop is small, it sells everything.
I'll come to the party, though I can't stay long.
Though he's rich, he lives very simply.
The soup was nice, though it was a bit salty.
Even though I was tired, I couldn't fall asleep.
He kept running even though his leg hurt.
Even though it was my birthday, I had to work.
She didn't call me even though she promised.
Even though the tickets were expensive, the show sold out.
My dad still drives to work, even though the office is a short walk away.
Although my grandmother is ninety, she still goes swimming.
I couldn't reconcile with him, although I tried many times.
Although the bus was late, we arrived on time.
He's very gregarious, even though his brother is quite shy.
Though the exam was hard, most students passed.
We went to the beach even though it was cloudy.
Although I've lived here for years, I still get lost.

examples.heading: ① Although + 子句放在前面

items.en: Although the restaurant was full, they found us a table.
items.zh: 雖然餐廳客滿了，他們還是幫我們找到一張桌子。

items.en: Although I studied hard, I didn't pass the test.
items.zh: 雖然我很用功，還是沒考過。

items.en: Although she's only twelve, she speaks three languages.
items.zh: 雖然她只有十二歲，她會說三種語言。

items.en: Although the film was long, nobody got bored.
items.zh: 雖然電影很長，沒有人覺得無聊。

items.en: Although we live in the same street, we rarely see each other.
items.zh: 雖然我們住在同一條街，我們很少見面。

items.en: Although the flat is small, it's very bright.
items.zh: 雖然公寓很小，採光很好。

examples.heading: ② although + 子句放在後面

items.en: I bought the jacket, although it was quite expensive.
items.zh: 我買了那件夾克，雖然它滿貴的。

items.en: He came to work, although he had a bad cold.
items.zh: 他來上班了，雖然他感冒得很嚴重。

items.en: I enjoyed the book, although the ending was sad.
items.zh: 我很喜歡那本書，雖然結局很悲傷。

items.en: We had a great time, although the weather was terrible.
items.zh: 我們玩得很開心，雖然天氣很糟。

items.en: She said yes, although she didn't really want to go.
items.zh: 她答應了，雖然她其實不太想去。

items.en: The plan worked, although nobody expected it to.
items.zh: 計畫成功了，雖然沒人料到。

examples.heading: ③ though

items.en: Though my cousin lives in Canada, we talk every week.
items.zh: 雖然我表哥住在加拿大，我們每個禮拜都會聊天。

items.en: Though the shop is small, it sells everything.
items.zh: 雖然那家店很小，卻什麼都賣。

items.en: I'll come to the party, though I can't stay long.
items.zh: 我會去派對，不過我不能待太久。

items.en: Though he's rich, he lives very simply.
items.zh: 雖然他很有錢，生活卻很簡樸。

items.en: The soup was nice, though it was a bit salty.
items.zh: 湯很好喝，不過有點鹹。

examples.heading: ④ even though

items.en: Even though I was tired, I couldn't fall asleep.
items.zh: 雖然我很累，還是睡不著。

items.en: He kept running even though his leg hurt.
items.zh: 雖然他的腳很痛，他還是一直跑。

items.en: Even though it was my birthday, I had to work.
items.zh: 雖然那天是我生日，我還是得上班。

items.en: She didn't call me even though she promised.
items.zh: 她答應過，卻沒有打給我。

items.en: Even though the tickets were expensive, the show sold out.
items.zh: 雖然票很貴，那場表演還是賣完了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: My dad still drives to work, even though the office is a short walk away.
items.zh: 我爸爸還是開車上班，雖然公司走路一下就到。

items.en: Although my grandmother is ninety, she still goes swimming.
items.zh: 雖然我奶奶九十歲了，她還是會去游泳。

items.en: I couldn't reconcile with him, although I tried many times.
items.zh: 雖然我試了很多次，還是沒辦法跟他和好。

items.en: Although the bus was late, we arrived on time.
items.zh: 雖然公車誤點，我們還是準時到了。

items.en: He's very gregarious, even though his brother is quite shy.
items.zh: 他很愛交朋友，雖然他哥哥滿害羞的。

items.en: Though the exam was hard, most students passed.
items.zh: 雖然考試很難，大部分的學生都過了。

items.en: We went to the beach even though it was cloudy.
items.zh: 雖然是陰天，我們還是去了海邊。

items.en: Although I've lived here for years, I still get lost.
items.zh: 雖然我在這裡住了好幾年，還是會迷路。

title: I had the opportunity to teach Vietnamese children whose parents had immigrated to Australia.
translation: 我有機會教一些越南孩子，他們的父母之前移民到了澳洲。
name: whose 引導的限定關係子句
sentences: Children whose parents read to them often learn to read early.
I sat next to a man whose daughter had just won a gold medal.
We need a babysitter whose kids are already grown up.
There's a girl in my class whose twin brother goes to another school.
Families whose homes the flood damaged can apply for help.
I know a couple whose wedding lasted three days.
I spoke to a nurse whose patients all love her.
He's a manager whose team always finishes on time.
We're looking for a designer whose ideas are fresh.
She works for a man whose company makes bicycles.
Employees whose contracts end in June must speak to HR.
I have a friend whose boss lets her work from home.
I want a car whose seats fold down flat.
Choose a password whose letters are hard to guess.
They live in a building whose lift is always broken.
We stayed at a hotel whose owner cooked breakfast for us every morning.
It's a country whose history goes back thousands of years.
He's the singer whose songs my mother sings in the shower.
Is she the student whose essay you read out in class?
That's the neighbor whose dog we walk on weekends.
I finally met the man whose house we're renting.
He's an artist whose paintings I've seen in Paris.
Anyone whose ticket has a red star wins a prize.
People whose jobs involve a lot of travel often feel tired.
Is there anyone here whose phone isn't switched off?
The boy whose bike you borrowed is waiting outside.
Mary was an orphan whose only relative was an old aunt.
I met a writer whose wry sense of humor made everyone laugh.
Patients whose blood pressure is high should avoid salt.
She's one of those people whose smile makes you feel welcome.

examples.heading: ① 家人的關係

items.en: Children whose parents read to them often learn to read early.
items.zh: 父母常唸書給他們聽的孩子通常很早就學會閱讀。

items.en: I sat next to a man whose daughter had just won a gold medal.
items.zh: 我坐在一位男士旁邊，他女兒剛拿下金牌。

items.en: We need a babysitter whose kids are already grown up.
items.zh: 我們需要一位孩子已經長大的保母。

items.en: There's a girl in my class whose twin brother goes to another school.
items.zh: 我們班有個女生，她的雙胞胎哥哥讀別的學校。

items.en: Families whose homes the flood damaged can apply for help.
items.zh: 房子在水災中受損的家庭可以申請補助。

items.en: I know a couple whose wedding lasted three days.
items.zh: 我認識一對夫妻，他們的婚禮辦了三天。

examples.heading: ② 工作和朋友的關係

items.en: I spoke to a nurse whose patients all love her.
items.zh: 我跟一位護理師聊過，她的病人都很喜歡她。

items.en: He's a manager whose team always finishes on time.
items.zh: 他是一位經理，他帶的團隊總是準時完成工作。

items.en: We're looking for a designer whose ideas are fresh.
items.zh: 我們在找想法新穎的設計師。

items.en: She works for a man whose company makes bicycles.
items.zh: 她在一個開腳踏車公司的人手下工作。

items.en: Employees whose contracts end in June must speak to HR.
items.zh: 合約六月到期的員工要去找人資談。

items.en: I have a friend whose boss lets her work from home.
items.zh: 我有個朋友，她老闆讓她在家工作。

examples.heading: ③ 東西和地方

items.en: I want a car whose seats fold down flat.
items.zh: 我想要一輛座椅可以完全放平的車。

items.en: Choose a password whose letters are hard to guess.
items.zh: 選一組字母很難被猜到的密碼。

items.en: They live in a building whose lift is always broken.
items.zh: 他們住在一棟電梯老是壞掉的大樓。

items.en: We stayed at a hotel whose owner cooked breakfast for us every morning.
items.zh: 我們住在一家飯店，老闆每天早上幫我們做早餐。

items.en: It's a country whose history goes back thousands of years.
items.zh: 那是一個歷史有好幾千年的國家。

examples.heading: ④ whose + 名詞當受詞

items.en: He's the singer whose songs my mother sings in the shower.
items.zh: 他就是唱那些我媽媽洗澡時會哼的歌的歌手。

items.en: Is she the student whose essay you read out in class?
items.zh: 她就是你在課堂上唸出作文的那個學生嗎？

items.en: That's the neighbor whose dog we walk on weekends.
items.zh: 那就是我們週末幫忙遛狗的鄰居。

items.en: I finally met the man whose house we're renting.
items.zh: 我終於見到我們租的那間房子的屋主了。

items.en: He's an artist whose paintings I've seen in Paris.
items.zh: 他是一位藝術家，我在巴黎看過他的畫。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Anyone whose ticket has a red star wins a prize.
items.zh: 票上有紅色星星的人可以得獎。

items.en: People whose jobs involve a lot of travel often feel tired.
items.zh: 工作要常出差的人常覺得累。

items.en: Is there anyone here whose phone isn't switched off?
items.zh: 這裡有誰的手機還沒關嗎？

items.en: The boy whose bike you borrowed is waiting outside.
items.zh: 你跟他借腳踏車的那個男孩在外面等。

items.en: Mary was an orphan whose only relative was an old aunt.
items.zh: Mary 是個孤兒，她唯一的親人是一位年老的阿姨。

items.en: I met a writer whose wry sense of humor made everyone laugh.
items.zh: 我認識了一位作家，他冷面的幽默感讓大家都笑了。

items.en: Patients whose blood pressure is high should avoid salt.
items.zh: 血壓高的病人應該少吃鹽。

items.en: She's one of those people whose smile makes you feel welcome.
items.zh: 她是那種笑容讓人覺得很受歡迎的人。

title: Do let me know your views on this.
translation: 請一定要讓我知道你對這件事的看法。
name: 祈使句前加 do 表示強調
sentences: Do come and see the garden while the roses are out.
Welcome to our home. Do help yourself to the fruit on the table.
Do take a seat. The manager will be with you soon.
Do stay the night. The last train has gone.
Grandma waved goodbye at the door. Do come again soon!
We loved having you for dinner. Do bring your sister next time.
You start in Tokyo next week. Do write and tell me about your new job.
The new timetable is attached. Do give us your opinion before Friday.
Do ring us once you've landed in Sydney.
Congratulations on your little girl! Do send me some photos of the baby.
It was lovely to meet you on the course. Do keep in touch.
This bread is tricky. Do follow the recipe exactly the first time.
The landlord wants your answer today. Do read the contract before you sign it.
The roads are busy in the city. Do wear a helmet on your bike.
There are two streets with that name. Do check the address before you leave.
There were two break-ins on our street last month. Do lock the door at night.
The path to the bus stop is frozen. Do be careful on the ice.
Do be quiet in the library this week. Students have exams.
Do be patient with him. He's new.
Do be gentle with the kitten. She's only two weeks old.
The bank sent me a letter about my new card. Do contact us if you have any questions.
The receptionist gave me my room key. Do enjoy your stay at our hotel.
Do try the fish. It's delicious.
Call me tonight. Do tell me how the job interview went.
Edinburgh has a lot to see. Do visit the castle if you have time.
Our chef has changed the dishes for spring. Do have a look at the new menu.
Do remember to water my plants while I'm away.
Our wedding is on 12 June. Do let us know if you can come.
It's your first week here. Do feel free to ask for help.
I've been in hospital for two weeks. Do forgive me for the late reply.

examples.heading: ① 邀請和歡迎

items.en: Do come and see the garden while the roses are out.
items.zh: 趁玫瑰開著，一定要來看看花園。

items.en: Welcome to our home. Do help yourself to the fruit on the table.
items.zh: 歡迎來我們家。桌上的水果請自己拿。

items.en: Do take a seat. The manager will be with you soon.
items.zh: 請坐，經理馬上就來。

items.en: Do stay the night. The last train has gone.
items.zh: 留下來過夜吧，最後一班火車已經開走了。

items.en: Grandma waved goodbye at the door. Do come again soon!
items.zh: 奶奶在門口揮手說再見。一定要再來喔！

items.en: We loved having you for dinner. Do bring your sister next time.
items.zh: 很高興你來吃晚餐。下次一定要帶你妹妹來。

examples.heading: ② 請對方聯絡

items.en: You start in Tokyo next week. Do write and tell me about your new job.
items.zh: 你下星期在東京開始上班。一定要寫信告訴我你新工作的事。

items.en: The new timetable is attached. Do give us your opinion before Friday.
items.zh: 新的時間表在附件裡。請一定要在星期五前告訴我們你的意見。

items.en: Do ring us once you've landed in Sydney.
items.zh: 你在雪梨降落後，一定要打電話給我們。

items.en: Congratulations on your little girl! Do send me some photos of the baby.
items.zh: 恭喜你生了女兒！一定要傳幾張寶寶的照片給我。

items.en: It was lovely to meet you on the course. Do keep in touch.
items.zh: 很高興在課程上認識你。一定要保持聯絡。

examples.heading: ③ 強調指示

items.en: This bread is tricky. Do follow the recipe exactly the first time.
items.zh: 這種麵包很難做。第一次一定要完全照著食譜做。

items.en: The landlord wants your answer today. Do read the contract before you sign it.
items.zh: 房東今天要你的答覆。簽約前一定要先讀合約。

items.en: The roads are busy in the city. Do wear a helmet on your bike.
items.zh: 市區的路車很多。騎腳踏車一定要戴安全帽。

items.en: There are two streets with that name. Do check the address before you leave.
items.zh: 有兩條街是那個名字。出發前一定要確認地址。

items.en: There were two break-ins on our street last month. Do lock the door at night.
items.zh: 上個月我們這條街有兩起闖空門。晚上一定要鎖門。

examples.heading: ④ Do be + 形容詞

items.en: The path to the bus stop is frozen. Do be careful on the ice.
items.zh: 去公車站的路結冰了。在冰上一定要小心。

items.en: Do be quiet in the library this week. Students have exams.
items.zh: 這個禮拜在圖書館一定要安靜，學生在考試。

items.en: Do be patient with him. He's new.
items.zh: 對他一定要有耐心，他是新來的。

items.en: Do be gentle with the kitten. She's only two weeks old.
items.zh: 對小貓一定要溫柔，牠才兩個禮拜大。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式的信件和不同的句型

items.en: The bank sent me a letter about my new card. Do contact us if you have any questions.
items.zh: 銀行寄給我一封關於新卡的信。如有任何問題，請務必與我們聯絡。

items.en: The receptionist gave me my room key. Do enjoy your stay at our hotel.
items.zh: 櫃台人員給了我房間鑰匙。祝您在本飯店住得愉快。

items.en: Do try the fish. It's delicious.
items.zh: 一定要嚐嚐這道魚，很好吃。

items.en: Call me tonight. Do tell me how the job interview went.
items.zh: 今晚打給我。一定要告訴我面試的結果。

items.en: Edinburgh has a lot to see. Do visit the castle if you have time.
items.zh: 愛丁堡有很多東西可以看。如果有時間，一定要去參觀那座城堡。

items.en: Our chef has changed the dishes for spring. Do have a look at the new menu.
items.zh: 我們的主廚換了春季的菜。請一定要看看新的菜單。

items.en: Do remember to water my plants while I'm away.
items.zh: 我不在的時候，一定要記得幫我澆花。

items.en: Our wedding is on 12 June. Do let us know if you can come.
items.zh: 我們的婚禮在六月十二日。請一定要告訴我們你能不能來。

items.en: It's your first week here. Do feel free to ask for help.
items.zh: 這是你在這裡的第一個星期。有需要請儘管開口。

items.en: I've been in hospital for two weeks. Do forgive me for the late reply.
items.zh: 我住院了兩個星期。請一定原諒我這麼晚才回覆。

title: Do not hesitate to contact me should you need further information.
translation: 如果您需要更多資訊，請儘管與我聯絡，不必客氣。
name: 不縮寫的 do not 祈使句
sentences: The teacher sent a letter to all new students. Do not hesitate to email me with any questions about the course.
The form is attached to this email. Do not hesitate to ask if anything is unclear.
The welcome sign at the entrance says this. Do not hesitate to ask our staff for a map of the museum.
The bank's message ended with a note. Do not reply to this email.
The school sent all students their new login. Do not share your password with anyone.
There's a sign outside the school gate. Do not leave your car engine running.
A guard stood by the door of the room. Do not touch the paintings in this gallery.
The street cleaners come every week. Do not park on the left side of the street on Tuesdays.
The sign at the temple gate was in three languages. Do not feed the monkeys. They can bite.
The sign next to the petrol pumps is very clear. Do not smoke in this area.
There's a notice on every floor of the hotel. In case of fire, do not use the lifts. Take the stairs.
I read the instructions for my new scooter. Do not charge the battery overnight.
The label on the medicine box says this. Do not take more than two tablets a day.
There's a note on the machine in the launderette. Do not open the washing machine until the light goes off.
Look at the label inside the collar. Do not wash this shirt in hot water.
The visa form has a section for the office. Do not write in the boxes below.
You've worked through lunch every day this week. Do not forget to take a break at lunchtime.
My cousin tells great stories about his travels. Do not believe everything he says.
Take a taxi home after the wedding. Do not drive if you've been drinking.
My father gave me some advice before I rented my first flat. Do not sign anything until you've read it.
My grandmother wrote in my graduation card. Do not give up on your dream.
I hung a sign on my hotel door. Please do not disturb.
Our English teacher wants us to speak more in class. Do not be afraid to make mistakes.
The park has new signs by the lawn. Do not walk on the grass.
The vet put a poster in the waiting room. Do not leave pets inside parked cars in summer.
The police gave out leaflets on the road. Do not use your phone while driving.
There's a sign on the bridge in our town. Do not throw rubbish into the river.
The sign is at the entrance to the concert hall. Do not enter without a ticket.
The lifeguard pointed to the sign. Do not dive into the shallow end of the pool.
The cliff path has a fence and a warning. Do not stand too close to the edge.

examples.heading: ① 正式的信件

items.en: The teacher sent a letter to all new students. Do not hesitate to email me with any questions about the course.
items.zh: 老師寄了一封信給所有新生。對課程有任何問題，請儘管寄電子郵件給我。

items.en: The form is attached to this email. Do not hesitate to ask if anything is unclear.
items.zh: 表格附在這封電子郵件裡。有任何不清楚的地方，請儘管問。

items.en: The welcome sign at the entrance says this. Do not hesitate to ask our staff for a map of the museum.
items.zh: 入口的歡迎牌上這樣寫。需要博物館地圖，請儘管向工作人員索取。

items.en: The bank's message ended with a note. Do not reply to this email.
items.zh: 銀行的訊息最後有一行附註。請勿回覆這封電子郵件。

items.en: The school sent all students their new login. Do not share your password with anyone.
items.zh: 學校把新的登入帳號寄給所有學生。請勿將密碼告訴任何人。

examples.heading: ② 告示和公告

items.en: There's a sign outside the school gate. Do not leave your car engine running.
items.zh: 校門外面有一個告示牌。請勿讓汽車引擎空轉。

items.en: A guard stood by the door of the room. Do not touch the paintings in this gallery.
items.zh: 一個警衛站在展廳門口。請勿觸摸這個展廳裡的畫。

items.en: The street cleaners come every week. Do not park on the left side of the street on Tuesdays.
items.zh: 掃街車每個星期都會來。星期二請勿在街道左側停車。

items.en: The sign at the temple gate was in three languages. Do not feed the monkeys. They can bite.
items.zh: 寺廟門口的告示牌有三種語言。請勿餵食猴子，牠們會咬人。

items.en: The sign next to the petrol pumps is very clear. Do not smoke in this area.
items.zh: 加油機旁邊的告示牌寫得很清楚。本區禁止吸菸。

items.en: There's a notice on every floor of the hotel. In case of fire, do not use the lifts. Take the stairs.
items.zh: 飯店每一層樓都有告示。發生火災時請勿搭乘電梯，請走樓梯。

examples.heading: ③ 說明書和指示

items.en: I read the instructions for my new scooter. Do not charge the battery overnight.
items.zh: 我讀了新電動滑板車的說明書。請勿整晚為電池充電。

items.en: The label on the medicine box says this. Do not take more than two tablets a day.
items.zh: 藥盒上的標籤這樣寫。每天服用請勿超過兩顆。

items.en: There's a note on the machine in the launderette. Do not open the washing machine until the light goes off.
items.zh: 自助洗衣店的機器上貼了一張紙條。燈熄滅之前請勿打開洗衣機。

items.en: Look at the label inside the collar. Do not wash this shirt in hot water.
items.zh: 你看領子裡面的標籤。這件襯衫請勿用熱水洗。

items.en: The visa form has a section for the office. Do not write in the boxes below.
items.zh: 簽證表格有一欄是給辦公室填的。請勿在下面的方格內書寫。

examples.heading: ④ 強調的勸告

items.en: You've worked through lunch every day this week. Do not forget to take a break at lunchtime.
items.zh: 你這個星期每天都沒吃午餐在工作。千萬別忘了午餐時間要休息一下。

items.en: My cousin tells great stories about his travels. Do not believe everything he says.
items.zh: 我表哥很會講他旅行的故事。千萬別相信他說的每一句話。

items.en: Take a taxi home after the wedding. Do not drive if you've been drinking.
items.zh: 婚禮結束後搭計程車回家。喝了酒千萬不要開車。

items.en: My father gave me some advice before I rented my first flat. Do not sign anything until you've read it.
items.zh: 我租第一間公寓前，我爸爸給了我一個建議。沒讀過之前，千萬不要簽任何東西。

items.en: My grandmother wrote in my graduation card. Do not give up on your dream.
items.zh: 我奶奶在我的畢業卡片上寫字。千萬不要放棄你的夢想。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: I hung a sign on my hotel door. Please do not disturb.
items.zh: 我在飯店房門上掛了一個牌子。請勿打擾。

items.en: Our English teacher wants us to speak more in class. Do not be afraid to make mistakes.
items.zh: 我們的英文老師希望我們上課多說話。不要怕犯錯。

items.en: The park has new signs by the lawn. Do not walk on the grass.
items.zh: 公園的草坪旁邊有新的告示牌。請勿踐踏草坪。

items.en: The vet put a poster in the waiting room. Do not leave pets inside parked cars in summer.
items.zh: 獸醫在候診室貼了一張海報。夏天請勿將寵物留在停著的車內。

items.en: The police gave out leaflets on the road. Do not use your phone while driving.
items.zh: 警察在路上發傳單。開車時請勿使用手機。

items.en: There's a sign on the bridge in our town. Do not throw rubbish into the river.
items.zh: 我們鎮上的橋上有一個告示牌。請勿將垃圾丟進河裡。

items.en: The sign is at the entrance to the concert hall. Do not enter without a ticket.
items.zh: 告示牌在音樂廳的入口。沒有票請勿進入。

items.en: The lifeguard pointed to the sign. Do not dive into the shallow end of the pool.
items.zh: 救生員指著告示牌。請勿在游泳池的淺水區跳水。

items.en: The cliff path has a fence and a warning. Do not stand too close to the edge.
items.zh: 懸崖步道有圍欄和警告標示。請勿站得離邊緣太近。

title: Don't let them spend all their free time in front of the TV.
translation: 別讓他們把所有空閒時間都花在電視前面。
name: don't let 加代名詞表示不允許
sentences: Don't let him walk to school alone yet. He's only six.
Don't let him drive. He's had a beer.
I baked these for the school sale, and your brother is in the kitchen. Don't let him eat all the cookies.
My brother wants you to lend him money again. Don't let him talk you into it.
The new driver is collecting his keys. Don't let him leave before he signs the form.
Watch the baby while I cook. Don't let her crawl into the kitchen.
The park is very dark after ten. Don't let her walk home alone at night.
Grandma has a bad back. Don't let her carry that heavy box.
Hide it in your wardrobe. Don't let her see the present before Sunday.
Your mother has enough problems. Don't let her worry about money.
Don't let them play video games before their homework is done.
Thanks for babysitting tonight. Don't let them go to bed after nine.
The cars go very fast here. Don't let them play near the road.
The kids won't sleep with all that sugar. Don't let them drink cola at dinner.
Those boys always push to the front. Don't let them take your seat on the bus.
The manager spoke to the man at the door. Don't let them come in without a ticket.
We just bought new sheets. Don't let the dog sleep on the bed.
I'll be back in an hour. Don't let the kids open the door to strangers.
Keep the heat low under the pan. Don't let the milk burn.
It'll be very hot while we're away. Don't let the plants dry out.
There are foxes in the garden. Don't let the cat go out at night.
My ex-boyfriend is at the party too. Please don't let him know I'm here.
My daughter says she's not hungry. Don't let her go to bed without dinner.
The clients are already in the meeting room. Don't let them wait too long.
I lost money on that car. Don't let your son make the same mistake.
Don't let the noise from the street keep you awake. Use earplugs.
It has some very violent scenes. Don't let the children watch that film.
Your sister paid last time and the time before. Don't let her pay for dinner again.
The kids leave at eight. Don't let them forget their homework.
Take the baby for a walk, but put his hat on. Don't let him get too cold.

examples.heading: ① Don't let him + 原形動詞

items.en: Don't let him walk to school alone yet. He's only six.
items.zh: 先別讓他自己走路上學，他才六歲。

items.en: Don't let him drive. He's had a beer.
items.zh: 別讓他開車，他喝了一杯啤酒。

items.en: I baked these for the school sale, and your brother is in the kitchen. Don't let him eat all the cookies.
items.zh: 這些是我為學校義賣烤的，你弟弟在廚房裡。別讓他把餅乾全吃光。

items.en: My brother wants you to lend him money again. Don't let him talk you into it.
items.zh: 我哥哥又想跟你借錢。別讓他說服你。

items.en: The new driver is collecting his keys. Don't let him leave before he signs the form.
items.zh: 新司機在領鑰匙。他簽表格之前別讓他走。

examples.heading: ② Don't let her + 原形動詞

items.en: Watch the baby while I cook. Don't let her crawl into the kitchen.
items.zh: 我煮飯的時候幫忙看著寶寶。別讓她爬進廚房。

items.en: The park is very dark after ten. Don't let her walk home alone at night.
items.zh: 十點以後公園很暗。別讓她晚上一個人走路回家。

items.en: Grandma has a bad back. Don't let her carry that heavy box.
items.zh: 奶奶的背不好。別讓她搬那個很重的箱子。

items.en: Hide it in your wardrobe. Don't let her see the present before Sunday.
items.zh: 把它藏在你的衣櫃裡。星期天之前別讓她看到禮物。

items.en: Your mother has enough problems. Don't let her worry about money.
items.zh: 你媽媽的煩惱已經夠多了。別讓她為錢擔心。

examples.heading: ③ Don't let them + 原形動詞

items.en: Don't let them play video games before their homework is done.
items.zh: 寫完作業之前別讓他們打電玩。

items.en: Thanks for babysitting tonight. Don't let them go to bed after nine.
items.zh: 謝謝你今晚幫忙帶孩子。別讓他們九點以後才睡。

items.en: The cars go very fast here. Don't let them play near the road.
items.zh: 這裡的車開得很快。別讓他們在馬路附近玩。

items.en: The kids won't sleep with all that sugar. Don't let them drink cola at dinner.
items.zh: 孩子們喝那麼多糖會睡不著。晚餐別讓他們喝可樂。

items.en: Those boys always push to the front. Don't let them take your seat on the bus.
items.zh: 那些男生總是擠到前面。公車上別讓他們搶你的位子。

items.en: The manager spoke to the man at the door. Don't let them come in without a ticket.
items.zh: 經理跟門口的人說話。沒有票別讓他們進來。

examples.heading: ④ Don't let + 名詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: We just bought new sheets. Don't let the dog sleep on the bed.
items.zh: 我們剛買了新床單。別讓狗睡在床上。

items.en: I'll be back in an hour. Don't let the kids open the door to strangers.
items.zh: 我一個小時後回來。別讓孩子們幫陌生人開門。

items.en: Keep the heat low under the pan. Don't let the milk burn.
items.zh: 鍋子下面的火保持小火。別讓牛奶燒焦。

items.en: It'll be very hot while we're away. Don't let the plants dry out.
items.zh: 我們不在的時候會很熱。別讓植物乾掉。

items.en: There are foxes in the garden. Don't let the cat go out at night.
items.zh: 花園裡有狐狸。晚上別讓貓出去。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: My ex-boyfriend is at the party too. Please don't let him know I'm here.
items.zh: 我前男友也在派對上。拜託別讓他知道我在這裡。

items.en: My daughter says she's not hungry. Don't let her go to bed without dinner.
items.zh: 我女兒說她不餓。別讓她沒吃晚餐就去睡。

items.en: The clients are already in the meeting room. Don't let them wait too long.
items.zh: 客戶已經在會議室了。別讓他們等太久。

items.en: I lost money on that car. Don't let your son make the same mistake.
items.zh: 我在那輛車上賠了錢。別讓你兒子犯同樣的錯。

items.en: Don't let the noise from the street keep you awake. Use earplugs.
items.zh: 別讓街上的噪音吵得你睡不著，用耳塞吧。

items.en: It has some very violent scenes. Don't let the children watch that film.
items.zh: 它有一些很暴力的場面。別讓孩子們看那部電影。

items.en: Your sister paid last time and the time before. Don't let her pay for dinner again.
items.zh: 你姊姊上次和上上次都付了。別再讓她付晚餐錢了。

items.en: The kids leave at eight. Don't let them forget their homework.
items.zh: 孩子們八點出門。別讓他們忘了帶作業。

items.en: Take the baby for a walk, but put his hat on. Don't let him get too cold.
items.zh: 帶寶寶去散步，不過要幫他戴帽子。別讓他著涼了。

title: Don't you dare forget me!
translation: 你敢忘了我試試看！
name: Don't you 加強命令語氣
sentences: A car nearly hit my son as he chased his ball. Don't you ever run into the road like that again!
My daughter came home at one in the morning. Don't you ever walk home alone at night again!
Your grandmother was only trying to help. Don't you ever shout at her again!
I found the baby crying in the bath. Don't you ever leave her alone!
Ask me first next time. Don't you ever borrow my car without telling me!
Here's your pocket money for the school trip. Don't you dare spend all your money on the first day!
Those are my chips. Don't you dare open the bag!
The party is a secret, so don't you dare say anything to Ann!
I'm saving that for Dad. Don't you dare eat the last piece of cake!
I know my hat looks silly. Don't you dare laugh!
Our flight leaves at six in the morning. Don't you dare be late tomorrow!
A: I'll eat your chocolate. B: Don't you dare!
A: I might read your diary. B: Don't you dare!
A: Can I wear your new dress? B: Don't you dare!
A: I'll post this photo online. B: Don't you dare!
Grandma waved from the hospital bed. Don't you worry about me. I'll be fine.
It's her birthday today. Don't you forget to call your grandmother!
Wait here by the car, kids. Don't you go anywhere. I'll be right back.
You're only one kilometre from the finish. Don't you give up now!
Nobody knows I'm leaving the company yet. Don't you say a word about this.
Don't you dare miss my wedding. I'm saving you a seat!
You hid behind the door and jumped out! Don't you ever scare me like that again!
Now, don't you cry. Everything's OK.
I spent all morning on the icing. Don't you touch that cake until the guests arrive!
Your sister's birthday present is in my room. Don't you dare open that door!
My father said this before I left for the city. Don't you ever forget where you came from.
You want to drive in this snow? Fine. Don't you dare say I didn't warn you.
I'm your teacher. Don't you use that tone with me!
My grandmother held my hand on my graduation day. Don't you ever give up on your dreams.
I saw you had two beers at the party. Don't you dare drive after drinking!

examples.heading: ① Don't you ever + 原形動詞

items.en: A car nearly hit my son as he chased his ball. Don't you ever run into the road like that again!
items.zh: 我兒子追球的時候差點被車撞到。你再也不准那樣衝到馬路上！

items.en: My daughter came home at one in the morning. Don't you ever walk home alone at night again!
items.zh: 我女兒凌晨一點才回家。你再也不准晚上一個人走路回家！

items.en: Your grandmother was only trying to help. Don't you ever shout at her again!
items.zh: 你奶奶只是想幫忙，你再也不准對她大吼！

items.en: I found the baby crying in the bath. Don't you ever leave her alone!
items.zh: 我發現寶寶在浴缸裡哭。你絕對不准把她一個人留下！

items.en: Ask me first next time. Don't you ever borrow my car without telling me!
items.zh: 下次先問我，你再也不准沒說一聲就借我的車！

examples.heading: ② Don't you dare + 原形動詞

items.en: Here's your pocket money for the school trip. Don't you dare spend all your money on the first day!
items.zh: 這是你校外旅行的零用錢。你敢第一天就把錢花光試試看！

items.en: Those are my chips. Don't you dare open the bag!
items.zh: 那是我的洋芋片，你敢打開袋子試試看！

items.en: The party is a secret, so don't you dare say anything to Ann!
items.zh: 派對是祕密，你敢跟 Ann 說試試看！

items.en: I'm saving that for Dad. Don't you dare eat the last piece of cake!
items.zh: 那是我留給爸爸的。你敢把最後一塊蛋糕吃掉試試看！

items.en: I know my hat looks silly. Don't you dare laugh!
items.zh: 我知道我的帽子看起來很蠢，你敢笑試試看！

items.en: Our flight leaves at six in the morning. Don't you dare be late tomorrow!
items.zh: 我們的班機早上六點起飛。你明天敢遲到試試看！

examples.heading: ③ Don't you dare!（單獨使用）

items.en: A: I'll eat your chocolate. B: Don't you dare!
items.zh: A：我要吃你的巧克力。B：你敢！

items.en: A: I might read your diary. B: Don't you dare!
items.zh: A：我可能會偷看你的日記。B：你敢！

items.en: A: Can I wear your new dress? B: Don't you dare!
items.zh: A：我可以穿你的新洋裝嗎？B：想都別想！

items.en: A: I'll post this photo online. B: Don't you dare!
items.zh: A：我要把這張照片傳到網路上。B：你敢！

examples.heading: ④ Don't you + 原形動詞（強烈的要求）

items.en: Grandma waved from the hospital bed. Don't you worry about me. I'll be fine.
items.zh: 奶奶在病床上揮手。你不用擔心我，我會沒事的。

items.en: It's her birthday today. Don't you forget to call your grandmother!
items.zh: 今天是她生日。你可別忘了打給你奶奶！

items.en: Wait here by the car, kids. Don't you go anywhere. I'll be right back.
items.zh: 孩子們，在車子旁邊等。你們哪裡都別去，我馬上回來。

items.en: You're only one kilometre from the finish. Don't you give up now!
items.zh: 你離終點只剩一公里。你現在可不准放棄！

items.en: Nobody knows I'm leaving the company yet. Don't you say a word about this.
items.zh: 還沒有人知道我要離開公司。這件事你一個字都不准說。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: Don't you dare miss my wedding. I'm saving you a seat!
items.zh: 你敢錯過我的婚禮試試看，我幫你留了位子！

items.en: You hid behind the door and jumped out! Don't you ever scare me like that again!
items.zh: 你躲在門後跳出來！你再也不准那樣嚇我！

items.en: Now, don't you cry. Everything's OK.
items.zh: 好了，別哭，沒事了。

items.en: I spent all morning on the icing. Don't you touch that cake until the guests arrive!
items.zh: 我花了整個早上做糖霜。客人到之前你不准碰那個蛋糕！

items.en: Your sister's birthday present is in my room. Don't you dare open that door!
items.zh: 你姊姊的生日禮物在我房間。你敢開那扇門試試看！

items.en: My father said this before I left for the city. Don't you ever forget where you came from.
items.zh: 我去城裡之前，我爸爸這樣說。永遠別忘了你從哪裡來。

items.en: You want to drive in this snow? Fine. Don't you dare say I didn't warn you.
items.zh: 你想在這種雪天開車？好啊。你可別說我沒警告過你。

items.en: I'm your teacher. Don't you use that tone with me!
items.zh: 我是你的老師，你不准用那種語氣跟我說話！

items.en: My grandmother held my hand on my graduation day. Don't you ever give up on your dreams.
items.zh: 我畢業那天，奶奶握著我的手。永遠別放棄你的夢想。

items.en: I saw you had two beers at the party. Don't you dare drive after drinking!
items.zh: 我看到你在派對上喝了兩杯啤酒。你敢喝了酒還開車試試看！

title: Is the hotel OK for you? If not, call me as soon as possible.
translation: 這家飯店你覺得可以嗎？如果不行，請盡快打給我。
name: if not 表示另一個選擇
sentences: Are you warm enough? If not, I'll turn the heating up.
Do you have your own towel? If not, you can borrow one from reception.
Can you make it to the meeting? If not, send me your notes.
Is Tuesday convenient? If not, we could meet on Thursday.
Did you bring an umbrella? If not, take mine.
Have you eaten yet? If not, there's some soup in the fridge.
Does your phone have a signal? If not, use the landline.
Are the kids asleep? If not, tell them to turn off the light.
Let me know whether you can come. If not, I'll give the ticket to Anna.
Check whether the shop delivers. If not, we'll pick the sofa up ourselves.
I'm not sure whether the restaurant takes bookings. If not, we'll have to get there early.
Ask your teacher if you can hand it in late. If not, you'll have to finish it tonight.
I wonder whether the bridge is open again. If not, we'll have to drive round the lake.
Please confirm whether the price includes breakfast. If not, we'll eat at the café next door.
I think the museum opens at ten. If not, we'll have a coffee first.
I assume you've already got a visa. If not, apply for one now.
Hopefully the rain will stop soon. If not, we'll cancel the picnic.
I hope this time suits you. If not, please suggest another.
The bus should be here in five minutes. If not, we'll get a taxi.
I expect the report will be ready by Friday. If not, I'll let you know.
You probably know the way already. If not, follow the signs for the castle.
Find out whether the hall is free on Saturday and, if not, when it will be.
Ask the hotel whether the pool is open and, if not, when it reopens.
The nurse will check whether the wound is healing and, if not, what treatment you need.
We asked whether the flight was on time and, if not, how long the delay would be.
Tell me whether the plan works for you and, if not, what you would change.
Did you receive your tickets? If not, please contact our booking office.
Is your order correct? If not, return it within fourteen days.
I hope everything is clear. If not, don't hesitate to ask.
Are you registered with a doctor? If not, ask at the front desk for a list.
Has your address changed? If not, you don't need to fill in this section.
Do you agree with the terms? If not, please do not sign the contract.

examples.heading: ① 直接問句 + If not

items.en: Are you warm enough? If not, I'll turn the heating up.
items.zh: 你夠暖嗎？如果不夠，我把暖氣開大一點。

items.en: Do you have your own towel? If not, you can borrow one from reception.
items.zh: 你有自己的毛巾嗎？如果沒有，可以跟櫃台借。

items.en: Can you make it to the meeting? If not, send me your notes.
items.zh: 你能來開會嗎？如果不能，把你的筆記寄給我。

items.en: Is Tuesday convenient? If not, we could meet on Thursday.
items.zh: 星期二方便嗎？如果不方便，我們可以星期四見。

items.en: Did you bring an umbrella? If not, take mine.
items.zh: 你有帶傘嗎？如果沒有，拿我的去。

items.en: Have you eaten yet? If not, there's some soup in the fridge.
items.zh: 你吃過了嗎？如果還沒，冰箱裡有湯。

items.en: Does your phone have a signal? If not, use the landline.
items.zh: 你的手機有訊號嗎？如果沒有，用市話。

items.en: Are the kids asleep? If not, tell them to turn off the light.
items.zh: 孩子們睡了嗎？如果還沒，叫他們關燈。

examples.heading: ② 間接問句 + If not

items.en: Let me know whether you can come. If not, I'll give the ticket to Anna.
items.zh: 告訴我你能不能來。如果不能，我就把票給 Anna。

items.en: Check whether the shop delivers. If not, we'll pick the sofa up ourselves.
items.zh: 查一下那家店有沒有送貨。如果沒有，我們就自己去載沙發。

items.en: I'm not sure whether the restaurant takes bookings. If not, we'll have to get there early.
items.zh: 我不確定那家餐廳收不收訂位。如果不收，我們就得早點到。

items.en: Ask your teacher if you can hand it in late. If not, you'll have to finish it tonight.
items.zh: 問問老師可不可以晚點交。如果不行，你今晚就得寫完。

items.en: I wonder whether the bridge is open again. If not, we'll have to drive round the lake.
items.zh: 不知道那座橋重新開放了沒。如果還沒，我們就得繞湖開。

items.en: Please confirm whether the price includes breakfast. If not, we'll eat at the café next door.
items.zh: 請確認價格有沒有含早餐。如果沒有，我們就去隔壁的咖啡館吃。

examples.heading: ③ 期望或猜測 + If not

items.en: I think the museum opens at ten. If not, we'll have a coffee first.
items.zh: 我想博物館是十點開門。如果不是，我們就先喝杯咖啡。

items.en: I assume you've already got a visa. If not, apply for one now.
items.zh: 我想你已經拿到簽證了。如果還沒，現在就去申請。

items.en: Hopefully the rain will stop soon. If not, we'll cancel the picnic.
items.zh: 希望雨很快就停。如果不停，我們就取消野餐。

items.en: I hope this time suits you. If not, please suggest another.
items.zh: 希望這個時間您方便。如果不方便，請提出另一個時間。

items.en: The bus should be here in five minutes. If not, we'll get a taxi.
items.zh: 公車應該五分鐘內會到。如果沒到，我們就搭計程車。

items.en: I expect the report will be ready by Friday. If not, I'll let you know.
items.zh: 我預計報告星期五前會好。如果沒好，我會通知你。

items.en: You probably know the way already. If not, follow the signs for the castle.
items.zh: 你大概已經知道怎麼走了。如果不知道，就跟著往城堡的指標走。

examples.heading: ④ and, if not,

items.en: Find out whether the hall is free on Saturday and, if not, when it will be.
items.zh: 查一下禮堂星期六有沒有空，如果沒有，什麼時候會空。

items.en: Ask the hotel whether the pool is open and, if not, when it reopens.
items.zh: 問問飯店游泳池有沒有開，如果沒有，什麼時候重新開放。

items.en: The nurse will check whether the wound is healing and, if not, what treatment you need.
items.zh: 護理師會檢查傷口有沒有在癒合，如果沒有，你需要什麼治療。

items.en: We asked whether the flight was on time and, if not, how long the delay would be.
items.zh: 我們問了班機是否準時，如果沒有，會延誤多久。

items.en: Tell me whether the plan works for you and, if not, what you would change.
items.zh: 告訴我這個計畫你覺得可不可行，如果不行，你會改哪裡。

examples.heading: ⑤ 信件和公告

items.en: Did you receive your tickets? If not, please contact our booking office.
items.zh: 您收到票了嗎？如果沒有，請聯絡我們的訂票處。

items.en: Is your order correct? If not, return it within fourteen days.
items.zh: 您的訂單正確嗎？如果不正確，請在十四天內退回。

items.en: I hope everything is clear. If not, don't hesitate to ask.
items.zh: 希望一切都清楚了。如果有不清楚的地方，請儘管問。

items.en: Are you registered with a doctor? If not, ask at the front desk for a list.
items.zh: 您有登記家庭醫生嗎？如果沒有，請到櫃台索取名單。

items.en: Has your address changed? If not, you don't need to fill in this section.
items.zh: 您的地址有變更嗎？如果沒有，就不用填這一欄。

items.en: Do you agree with the terms? If not, please do not sign the contract.
items.zh: 您同意這些條款嗎？如果不同意，請不要簽合約。

title: Is it possible to pay by credit card? If so, which ones do you take?
translation: 可以刷信用卡嗎？如果可以，你們收哪幾種卡？
name: if so 承接肯定的回答

examples.heading: ① 直接問句 + If so

items.en: Do you like Italian food? If so, you'll love this restaurant.
items.zh: 你喜歡義大利菜嗎？如果喜歡，你一定會愛這家餐廳。

items.en: Are you feeling tired? If so, go to bed early tonight.
items.zh: 你覺得累嗎？如果累，今晚就早點睡。

items.en: Is the printer working again? If so, I'll print the tickets now.
items.zh: 印表機又可以用了嗎？如果可以，我現在就印票。

items.en: Have you finished with the ladder? If so, I'll put it back in the garage.
items.zh: 梯子你用完了嗎？如果用完了，我就把它放回車庫。

items.en: Did the parcel arrive this morning? If so, please put it in my office.
items.zh: 包裹今天早上到了嗎？如果到了，請放在我的辦公室。

items.en: Is your brother still looking for a job? If so, he should call my uncle.
items.zh: 你哥哥還在找工作嗎？如果是，他應該打電話給我叔叔。

items.en: Was the film any good? If so, I might watch it this weekend.
items.zh: 那部電影好看嗎？如果好看，我這個週末可能會去看。

items.en: Is it your birthday today? If so, the dessert is free.
items.zh: 今天是你的生日嗎？如果是，甜點免費。

examples.heading: ② 間接問句 + If so

items.en: I'm not sure whether the shop is open today. If so, I'll buy some bread.
items.zh: 我不確定那家店今天有沒有開。如果有開，我會去買些麵包。

items.en: Please let me know if you need a hotel room. If so, I'll book one for you.
items.zh: 請告訴我你需不需要飯店房間。如果需要，我會幫你訂一間。

items.en: I wonder whether Tom has heard the news. If so, he must be very upset.
items.zh: 不知道 Tom 聽到消息了沒。如果聽到了，他一定很難過。

items.en: Check whether the milk has gone off. If so, throw it away.
items.zh: 看看牛奶是不是壞了。如果壞了，就丟掉。

items.en: Find out if the train is delayed. If so, we'll take a taxi.
items.zh: 查一下火車有沒有誤點。如果有，我們就搭計程車。

items.en: The doctor will ask whether you're taking any medicine. If so, bring the boxes with you.
items.zh: 醫生會問你有沒有在吃藥。如果有，把藥盒帶去。

items.en: I'd like to know whether the job includes travel. If so, I'm very interested.
items.zh: 我想知道這份工作需不需要出差。如果需要，我很有興趣。

examples.heading: ③ If so + 問句

items.en: Do you play any instruments? If so, which ones do you play?
items.zh: 你會演奏樂器嗎？如果會，你會哪些？

items.en: Are you coming to the meeting? If so, could you bring the report?
items.zh: 你會來開會嗎？如果會，可以帶報告來嗎？

items.en: Have you finished with the newspaper? If so, can I have it?
items.zh: 報紙你看完了嗎？如果看完了，可以給我嗎？

items.en: Is there a car park near the stadium? If so, how much does it cost?
items.zh: 體育場附近有停車場嗎？如果有，要多少錢？

items.en: Did anyone see the accident? If so, why didn't they call the police?
items.zh: 有人看到那場意外嗎？如果有，為什麼沒人報警？

items.en: Is the museum free on Sundays? If so, what time does it open?
items.zh: 博物館星期天免費嗎？如果是，幾點開門？

items.en: Do you have any brothers or sisters? If so, are they older than you?
items.zh: 你有兄弟姊妹嗎？如果有，他們比你大嗎？

examples.heading: ④ and, if so,

items.en: Ask the guests whether they have any allergies and, if so, what they can't eat.
items.zh: 問問客人有沒有過敏，如果有，有什麼不能吃。

items.en: I'd like to know whether the flight is full and, if so, when the next one leaves.
items.zh: 我想知道這班飛機是不是客滿了，如果是，下一班什麼時候起飛。

items.en: The survey asks whether people own a car and, if so, how often they use it.
items.zh: 這份調查問大家有沒有車，如果有，多久用一次。

items.en: Please tell us whether you will attend and, if so, how many guests you'll bring.
items.zh: 請告訴我們您是否會出席，如果會，會帶幾位客人來。

items.en: The police want to know whether the man was armed and, if so, what kind of weapon he had.
items.zh: 警方想知道那個男人有沒有帶武器，如果有，是哪一種武器。

examples.heading: ⑤ 信件和公告

items.en: Are you over sixty-five? If so, you can travel free on local buses.
items.zh: 您年滿六十五歲了嗎？如果是，您可以免費搭乘本地公車。

items.en: Have you changed your address recently? If so, please update your details online.
items.zh: 您最近換了地址嗎？如果是，請上網更新您的資料。

items.en: Do you suffer from lethargy in the afternoons? If so, try a short walk after lunch.
items.zh: 您下午常常昏昏欲睡嗎？如果是，午餐後試著散步一下。

items.en: Did you find our staff obliging? If so, please leave us a review.
items.zh: 您覺得我們的員工親切熱心嗎？如果是，請給我們留個評論。

items.en: Is your child's school closed tomorrow? If so, the library offers free activities for children.
items.zh: 您孩子的學校明天停課嗎？如果是，圖書館有提供兒童免費活動。

title: I will come see you on Friday if it's OK with you.
translation: 如果你方便的話，我星期五會去看你。
name: 放在主要子句前後的 if 子句
sentences: You can borrow my bike if you need it.
I'll make some tea if you're staying a bit longer.
We'll miss the train if we don't leave now.
Call the doctor if your fever gets worse.
My dad gets angry if I come home late.
I'd love to join you if there's room in the car.
If you like spicy food, you'll love this restaurant.
If the shop is closed, try the one across the street.
If the printer jams again, unplug it for a minute.
If I have time this weekend, I'll paint the kitchen.
If the baby wakes up, give her some milk.
If you're cold, close the window.
If you study every day, you'll pass easily.
If we hurry, we can catch the last bus.
If anyone calls, tell them I'm in a meeting.
If you heat ice, it melts.
If you're free on Saturday, come to my party.
Let me know if you have any questions.
Take another cookie if you want.
I can help you move if you like.
Sit down if you're tired.
Please send me the photos if you remember.
If the meeting finishes early, let's have lunch together.
The plants will die if you don't water them.
If you specify the size, we can order it for you.
If you're ever in Kaohsiung, give me a call.
If there's a problem with the room, call reception.
You won't get a seat if you arrive after seven.
If my sister can't come, I'll go on my own.
The dog barks if someone rings the doorbell.

examples.heading: ① if 子句放在後面

items.en: You can borrow my bike if you need it.
items.zh: 如果你需要，可以借我的腳踏車。

items.en: I'll make some tea if you're staying a bit longer.
items.zh: 如果你要多待一下，我就泡點茶。

items.en: We'll miss the train if we don't leave now.
items.zh: 如果我們不現在出發，就會趕不上火車。

items.en: Call the doctor if your fever gets worse.
items.zh: 如果你發燒更嚴重，就打給醫生。

items.en: My dad gets angry if I come home late.
items.zh: 如果我晚回家，我爸就會生氣。

items.en: I'd love to join you if there's room in the car.
items.zh: 如果車上還有位子，我很想跟你們一起去。

examples.heading: ② if 子句放在前面

items.en: If you like spicy food, you'll love this restaurant.
items.zh: 如果你喜歡吃辣，你一定會愛這家餐廳。

items.en: If the shop is closed, try the one across the street.
items.zh: 如果那家店沒開，就去對面那家看看。

items.en: If the printer jams again, unplug it for a minute.
items.zh: 如果印表機又卡紙，就把插頭拔掉一分鐘。

items.en: If I have time this weekend, I'll paint the kitchen.
items.zh: 如果我這個週末有空，我就來漆廚房。

items.en: If the baby wakes up, give her some milk.
items.zh: 如果寶寶醒了，就餵她喝點奶。

items.en: If you're cold, close the window.
items.zh: 如果你冷，就把窗戶關起來。

examples.heading: ③ if 子句 + will / can / 祈使句

items.en: If you study every day, you'll pass easily.
items.zh: 如果你每天念書，就能輕鬆考過。

items.en: If we hurry, we can catch the last bus.
items.zh: 如果我們快一點，就能搭上最後一班公車。

items.en: If anyone calls, tell them I'm in a meeting.
items.zh: 如果有人打來，就說我在開會。

items.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
items.zh: 冰加熱就會融化。

items.en: If you're free on Saturday, come to my party.
items.zh: 如果你星期六有空，就來我的派對。

examples.heading: ④ 回應和請求

items.en: Let me know if you have any questions.
items.zh: 如果你有任何問題，跟我說。

items.en: Take another cookie if you want.
items.zh: 如果你想吃，再拿一塊餅乾。

items.en: I can help you move if you like.
items.zh: 如果你需要，我可以幫你搬家。

items.en: Sit down if you're tired.
items.zh: 如果你累了，就坐下來。

items.en: Please send me the photos if you remember.
items.zh: 如果你記得的話，請把照片寄給我。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.zh: 如果會議提早結束，我們一起吃午餐吧。

items.zh: 如果你不澆水，植物會死掉。

items.zh: 如果你說明尺寸，我們可以幫你訂。

items.zh: 如果你有來高雄，打給我。

items.zh: 如果房間有問題，打給櫃台。

items.en: You won't get a seat if you arrive after seven.
items.zh: 如果你七點以後才到，就不會有位子。

items.en: If my sister can't come, I'll go on my own.
items.zh: 如果我姊姊不能來，我就自己去。

items.en: The dog barks if someone rings the doorbell.
items.zh: 如果有人按門鈴，狗就會叫。

items.zh: 如果我是你，我會把音樂關小聲一點。
