items.zh: 如果我是你，我不會跟你爸媽提價錢。

examples.heading: ⑤ 替對方做選擇

items.en: If I were you, I'd choose the cheaper flat near the station.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會選車站附近比較便宜的公寓。

items.en: If I were you, I would study medicine because you love science.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會讀醫學，因為你喜歡科學。

items.en: If I were you, I'd go to the beach in June, when it's quieter.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會六月去海邊，那時候人比較少。

items.en: If I were you, I'd stay with your aunt rather than in a hotel.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會住在你阿姨家，不住飯店。

items.en: If I were you, I'd pick the red dress for the wedding.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會選紅色那件洋裝去參加婚禮。

items.en: If I were you, I'd do both and see which one you enjoy more.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我兩個都會試試，看哪一個比較喜歡。

title: If it weren't for that boy, I would have failed the exams.
translation: 要不是那個男生，我考試就不及格了。
name: if it were not for 加名詞片語
sentences: If it weren't for my sister, I would be completely lost in this city.
If it weren't for the noise, this would be the perfect flat.
If it weren't for the internet, I would hardly ever speak to my cousins in Canada.
If it weren't for his pompous manner, people would like him a lot more.
If it weren't for coffee, I wouldn't get through the morning.
If it weren't for the vicissitudes of the market, the business would be easy to run.
If it weren't for his determination, he would have resigned long ago.
If it weren't for Ms Lee, I would have dropped out of school.
If it weren't for my candid friends, I would have made some terrible decisions.
If it weren't for her calm nature, she would have shouted at the irate customer.
If it weren't for his years of training, he would have panicked in the storm.
I would have given up long ago if it weren't for you.
The village would be completely empty if it weren't for the tourists.
Our team would be top of the league if it weren't for injuries.
The meal would be perfect if it weren't for the unpalatable sauce.
If it weren't for the language barrier, I could work abroad.
If it weren't for the cost, we might move to the coast.
If it weren't for my bad back, I could go hiking with you.
If it weren't for the fog, you could see the mountains from here.
If it were not for the generosity of our donors, the shelter would have to close.
If it were not for philanthropic foundations, many museums would not survive.
If it were not for the efforts of volunteers, the festival would not take place.
If it were not for the new regulations, the company would have expanded further.
If it were not for prescriptive rules, the language would change even faster.
If it were not for the river, the town would never have grown into a city.
"How do you manage with three kids?" "If it weren't for my mum, I wouldn't."
"You look tired." "I'd be fine if it weren't for the neighbours' dog."
"Do you like your new job?" "I'd love it if it weren't for the long commute."
"Why do you still live here?" "If it weren't for my parents, I'd have moved years ago."
"Thank you so much. If it weren't for you, I'd still be waiting at the station."
"How's the new flat?" "Great. If it weren't for the stairs, it would be perfect."
"Can you finish the report today?" "If it weren't for all these meetings, I could."

examples.heading: ① 說現在的結果

items.en: If it weren't for my sister, I would be completely lost in this city.
items.zh: 要不是有我姊姊，我在這個城市會完全不知道方向。

items.en: If it weren't for the noise, this would be the perfect flat.
items.zh: 要不是有噪音，這間公寓就完美了。

items.en: If it weren't for the internet, I would hardly ever speak to my cousins in Canada.
items.zh: 要不是有網路，我幾乎不會跟加拿大的表親說話。

items.en: If it weren't for his pompous manner, people would like him a lot more.
items.zh: 要不是他那副自大的樣子，大家會更喜歡他。

items.en: If it weren't for coffee, I wouldn't get through the morning.
items.zh: 要不是有咖啡，我撐不過早上。

items.en: If it weren't for the vicissitudes of the market, the business would be easy to run.
items.zh: 要不是市場變化無常，這門生意很好做。

examples.heading: ② 說過去的結果

items.en: If it weren't for his determination, he would have resigned long ago.
items.zh: 要不是他意志堅定，他早就辭職了。

items.en: If it weren't for Ms Lee, I would have dropped out of school.
items.zh: 要不是有李老師，我早就輟學了。

items.en: If it weren't for my candid friends, I would have made some terrible decisions.
items.zh: 要不是有那些說話直率的朋友，我早就做了一些很糟的決定。

items.en: If it weren't for her calm nature, she would have shouted at the irate customer.
items.zh: 要不是她個性冷靜，她早就對那個氣沖沖的客人大吼了。

items.en: If it weren't for his years of training, he would have panicked in the storm.
items.zh: 要不是他受過多年訓練，他在暴風雨中早就慌了。

examples.heading: ③ 主要子句在前面

items.en: I would have given up long ago if it weren't for you.
items.zh: 要不是有你，我早就放棄了。

items.en: The village would be completely empty if it weren't for the tourists.
items.zh: 要不是有觀光客，這個村子就完全沒有人了。

items.en: Our team would be top of the league if it weren't for injuries.
items.zh: 要不是有人受傷，我們隊會是聯賽第一。

items.en: The meal would be perfect if it weren't for the unpalatable sauce.
items.zh: 要不是醬汁難吃，這頓飯就完美了。

examples.heading: ④ could 和 might 說可能的結果

items.en: If it weren't for the language barrier, I could work abroad.
items.zh: 要不是有語言障礙，我可以去國外工作。

items.en: If it weren't for the cost, we might move to the coast.
items.zh: 要不是費用的問題，我們可能會搬到海邊。

items.en: If it weren't for my bad back, I could go hiking with you.
items.zh: 要不是背有毛病，我可以跟你去爬山。

items.en: If it weren't for the fog, you could see the mountains from here.
items.zh: 要不是有霧，從這裡可以看到山。

examples.heading: ⑤ were not 用在正式的書面文字

items.en: If it were not for the generosity of our donors, the shelter would have to close.
items.zh: 要不是捐款人的慷慨，收容所就得關門。

items.en: If it were not for philanthropic foundations, many museums would not survive.
items.zh: 要不是有慈善基金會，很多博物館撐不下去。

items.en: If it were not for the efforts of volunteers, the festival would not take place.
items.zh: 要不是志工的努力，這個節慶就辦不成。

items.en: If it were not for the new regulations, the company would have expanded further.
items.zh: 要不是有新法規，公司早就擴張得更大了。

items.en: If it were not for prescriptive rules, the language would change even faster.
items.zh: 要不是有規範性的規則，語言會變得更快。

items.en: If it were not for the river, the town would never have grown into a city.
items.zh: 要不是有這條河，這個小鎮絕不會發展成城市。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "How do you manage with three kids?" "If it weren't for my mum, I wouldn't."
items.zh: 你怎麼顧得來三個小孩？要不是有我媽，我顧不來。

items.en: "You look tired." "I'd be fine if it weren't for the neighbours' dog."
items.zh: 你看起來很累。要不是鄰居家的狗，我會好好的。

items.en: "Do you like your new job?" "I'd love it if it weren't for the long commute."
items.zh: 你喜歡新工作嗎？要不是通勤時間太長，我會很喜歡。

items.en: "Why do you still live here?" "If it weren't for my parents, I'd have moved years ago."
items.zh: 你為什麼還住在這裡？要不是因為我爸媽，我好幾年前就搬走了。

items.en: "Thank you so much. If it weren't for you, I'd still be waiting at the station."
items.zh: 真的很謝謝你。要不是有你，我現在還在車站等。

items.en: "How's the new flat?" "Great. If it weren't for the stairs, it would be perfect."
items.zh: 新公寓怎麼樣？很好。要不是要爬樓梯，就完美了。

items.en: "Can you finish the report today?" "If it weren't for all these meetings, I could."
items.zh: 你今天能把報告寫完嗎？要不是有這麼多會議，我可以寫完。

title: If it were to be published, the first issue would include a short introduction.
translation: 如果真的出版的話，第一期會有一篇簡短的介紹。
name: if it were 加 to 不定詞的條件句
sentences: The bridge is over a hundred years old. If it were to collapse, the town would lose its only link to the city.
The merger is still under discussion. If it were to happen, around two hundred jobs would disappear.
Many staff find the new policy arbitrary. If it were to continue, morale would fall even further.
The volcano has been quiet for decades. If it were to erupt, thousands of people would have to leave their homes.
The scheme has helped indigent families for years. If it were to end, many of them would struggle to pay the rent.
The strike has lasted two weeks. If it were to spread to other ports, exports would come to a halt.
The old theatre still has a loyal audience. If it were to be revived, it would attract tourists again.
The proposal is controversial. If it were to be approved, residents would pay higher taxes.
The clause is not in the contract yet. If it were to be included, the tenant would receive full reimbursement for repairs.
Nuclear power has many critics. If it were to be abandoned, countries would need other sources of clean energy.
The company would lose its best customers if it were to raise prices again.
The government would antagonize farmers if it were to cut the subsidies.
The museum would have to close for a year if it were to be renovated.
The team would need two more engineers if it were to finish the work by March.
The storm is moving north. If it were to reach the coast, it might cause severe flooding.
The law is unpopular. If it were to pass, it could precipitate a crisis in the coalition.
The deal is not final. If it were to fall through, we might have to look for another investor.
Your idea is clever. If it were to work, we could finish a week early.
We appreciate your offer. If it were to remain open until June, we would be pleased to discuss it further.
We have agreed a fixed price. If it were to change, both parties would need to sign a new agreement.
Your application is incomplete. If it were to reach the committee in this form, the committee would almost certainly reject it.
Our current system is outdated. If it were to fail during the audit, we could not produce the records on time.
The hall is booked for the conference. If it were to become unavailable, we would inform all delegates immediately.
Your contract ends in May. If it were to be renewed, your salary would rise by five per cent.
Space tourism remains expensive. If it were to become affordable, it would change the way people think about travel.
The plan for a new airport is controversial. If it were to go ahead, it would destroy a large area of forest.
A four-day working week sounds appealing. If it were to become the norm, it might stimulate the leisure industry.
The idea of a world government may seem chimerical. If it were to succeed, however, it would end many conflicts.
The tax on sugary drinks is modest. If it were to double, consumption would probably fall sharply.
The reform aims to redress past injustices. If it were to fail, public trust in the courts would decline further.
Online voting is still at the trial stage. If it were to replace polling stations, more young people might vote.
The magazine has no funding yet. If it were to find a sponsor, the first issue could appear next spring.

examples.heading: ① 前面提到的東西出事

items.en: The bridge is over a hundred years old. If it were to collapse, the town would lose its only link to the city.
items.zh: 這座橋已經一百多年了。萬一它倒塌，鎮上就會失去唯一通往城市的路。

items.en: The merger is still under discussion. If it were to happen, around two hundred jobs would disappear.
items.zh: 合併案還在討論。如果真的合併，大約兩百個職位會消失。

items.en: Many staff find the new policy arbitrary. If it were to continue, morale would fall even further.
items.zh: 很多員工覺得新政策很武斷。如果繼續實施，士氣會更低落。

items.en: The volcano has been quiet for decades. If it were to erupt, thousands of people would have to leave their homes.
items.zh: 這座火山已經幾十年沒動靜了。萬一它噴發，成千上萬的人得離開家園。

items.en: The scheme has helped indigent families for years. If it were to end, many of them would struggle to pay the rent.
items.zh: 這個方案多年來幫助貧困家庭。如果方案結束，很多家庭會付不出房租。

items.en: The strike has lasted two weeks. If it were to spread to other ports, exports would come to a halt.
items.zh: 罷工已經持續兩週。萬一擴散到其他港口，出口就會停擺。

examples.heading: ② 被動的條件子句

items.en: The old theatre still has a loyal audience. If it were to be revived, it would attract tourists again.
items.zh: 這間老戲院還有一群忠實觀眾。如果重新開張，它會再吸引觀光客。（被動）

items.en: The proposal is controversial. If it were to be approved, residents would pay higher taxes.
items.zh: 這項提案很有爭議。如果通過，居民要繳更多稅。（被動）

items.en: The clause is not in the contract yet. If it were to be included, the tenant would receive full reimbursement for repairs.
items.zh: 這個條款還沒寫進合約。如果寫進去，房客的修繕費可以全額報銷。（被動）

items.en: Nuclear power has many critics. If it were to be abandoned, countries would need other sources of clean energy.
items.zh: 核能有很多反對者。如果放棄核能，各國會需要其他乾淨能源。（被動）

examples.heading: ③ 主要子句在前面

items.en: The company would lose its best customers if it were to raise prices again.
items.zh: 如果這家公司再漲價，就會失去最好的客戶。

items.en: The government would antagonize farmers if it were to cut the subsidies.
items.zh: 如果政府削減補貼，就會激怒農民。

items.en: The museum would have to close for a year if it were to be renovated.
items.zh: 如果博物館要整修，就得關閉一年。（被動）

items.en: The team would need two more engineers if it were to finish the work by March.
items.zh: 這個團隊要在三月前完成工作的話，還需要兩名工程師。

examples.heading: ④ could 和 might 說可能的結果

items.en: The storm is moving north. If it were to reach the coast, it might cause severe flooding.
items.zh: 暴風雨正往北移動。萬一到了海岸，可能會造成嚴重的水災。

items.en: The law is unpopular. If it were to pass, it could precipitate a crisis in the coalition.
items.zh: 這條法律不受歡迎。萬一通過，可能會引發聯合政府的危機。

items.en: The deal is not final. If it were to fall through, we might have to look for another investor.
items.zh: 這筆交易還沒定案。萬一破局，我們可能得另外找投資人。

items.en: Your idea is clever. If it were to work, we could finish a week early.
items.zh: 你的點子很聰明。如果行得通，我們可以提早一個星期完成。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式信件和通知

items.en: We appreciate your offer. If it were to remain open until June, we would be pleased to discuss it further.
items.zh: 我們很感謝您的提議。如果提議能保留到六月，我們很樂意進一步討論。

items.en: We have agreed a fixed price. If it were to change, both parties would need to sign a new agreement.
items.zh: 我們已經講定固定價格。如果價格要變動，雙方都得簽新的協議。

items.en: Your application is incomplete. If it were to reach the committee in this form, the committee would almost certainly reject it.
items.zh: 您的申請不完整。如果用這個樣子送到委員會，委員會幾乎一定會駁回。

items.en: Our current system is outdated. If it were to fail during the audit, we could not produce the records on time.
items.zh: 我們現在的系統很舊。萬一稽核期間當機，我們就沒辦法準時拿出紀錄。

items.en: The hall is booked for the conference. If it were to become unavailable, we would inform all delegates immediately.
items.zh: 會議廳已經訂好了。萬一不能用，我們會馬上通知所有與會代表。

items.en: Your contract ends in May. If it were to be renewed, your salary would rise by five per cent.
items.zh: 您的合約五月到期。如果續約，您的薪水會調高百分之五。（被動）

examples.heading: ⑥ 論說文和報告

items.en: Space tourism remains expensive. If it were to become affordable, it would change the way people think about travel.
items.zh: 太空旅遊還是很貴。如果變得負擔得起，會改變人們對旅行的看法。

items.en: The plan for a new airport is controversial. If it were to go ahead, it would destroy a large area of forest.
items.zh: 新機場的計畫很有爭議。如果照常進行，會毀掉一大片森林。

items.en: A four-day working week sounds appealing. If it were to become the norm, it might stimulate the leisure industry.
items.zh: 一週工作四天聽起來很吸引人。如果變成常態，可能會帶動休閒產業。

items.en: The idea of a world government may seem chimerical. If it were to succeed, however, it would end many conflicts.
items.zh: 世界政府的想法也許顯得不切實際。不過如果真的成功，就能結束很多衝突。

items.en: The tax on sugary drinks is modest. If it were to double, consumption would probably fall sharply.
items.zh: 含糖飲料稅不高。如果加倍，消費量大概會大幅下降。

items.en: The reform aims to redress past injustices. If it were to fail, public trust in the courts would decline further.
items.zh: 這項改革的目的是糾正過去的不公。如果改革失敗，民眾對法院的信任會更低。

items.en: Online voting is still at the trial stage. If it were to replace polling stations, more young people might vote.
items.zh: 網路投票還在試辦階段。如果取代投票所，可能會有更多年輕人去投票。

items.en: The magazine has no funding yet. If it were to find a sponsor, the first issue could appear next spring.
items.zh: 這本雜誌還沒有經費。如果找到贊助者，第一期明年春天就可以出刊。

title: All this could have been avoided if the plan had been more flexible.
translation: 如果計畫更有彈性一點，這一切本來都可以避免。
name: if 加過去完成式配情態動詞加 have
sentences: If you had told me earlier, I could have changed my plans.
If we had brought a map, we could have found the hotel easily.
If he had trained harder, he could have won the gold medal.
If I had spoken with more candor, we could have avoided the argument.
She could have become a doctor if she had stayed at university.
I could have helped you with the move if you had asked.
If the shop had been open, we could have got some milk.
If they had saved more, they could have bought a bigger flat.
If I had gone to a different school, I might have chosen another career.
If the weather had been better, more people might have come.
If she had apologised, he might have forgiven her.
If you had read the contract carefully, you might have noticed the problem.
He might have accepted the job if they had offered more money.
If we had stayed until dawn, we might have seen the fishing boats come in.
If the critics had been more dispassionate, the film might have done better.
The accident could have been prevented if the road had been lit.
If the warning had been heard, the town might have been evacuated in time.
Much of the damage could have been avoided if the river had been cleaned.
If the letter had been posted on Monday, it could have been delivered by Friday.
If the report had been checked, the mistakes might have been noticed.
The contract could have been annulled if the lawyer had acted sooner.
If I hadn't missed the bus, I could have met you for lunch.
If she hadn't been so capricious, they might not have broken up.
We couldn't have finished the project if you hadn't helped us.
If he hadn't lied, his colleagues might have trusted him.
If I had checked the weather, I might not have got so wet.
The team couldn't have won if she hadn't scored in the final minute.
If I had been more careful, I could have avoided the crash.
I might have passed the interview if I hadn't been so nervous.
If we had invested in that company, we could have made a fortune.
If I had complained to the manager, I might have got a refund.
If my grandfather had kept the farm, it could have been a fine legacy for us.

examples.heading: ① could have

items.en: If you had told me earlier, I could have changed my plans.
items.zh: 如果你早點告訴我，我本來可以改變計畫。

items.en: If we had brought a map, we could have found the hotel easily.
items.zh: 如果我們有帶地圖，本來可以輕鬆找到飯店。

items.en: If he had trained harder, he could have won the gold medal.
items.zh: 如果他練得更勤，本來可以拿到金牌。

items.en: If I had spoken with more candor, we could have avoided the argument.
items.zh: 如果我說話更坦白一點，我們本來可以避免那場爭吵。

items.en: She could have become a doctor if she had stayed at university.
items.zh: 如果她當年繼續讀大學，本來可以當醫生。

items.en: I could have helped you with the move if you had asked.
items.zh: 如果你有開口，我本來可以幫你搬家。

items.en: If the shop had been open, we could have got some milk.
items.zh: 如果那家店有開，我們本來可以買點牛奶。

items.en: If they had saved more, they could have bought a bigger flat.
items.zh: 如果他們存多一點錢，本來可以買大一點的公寓。

examples.heading: ② might have

items.en: If I had gone to a different school, I might have chosen another career.
items.zh: 如果我讀了另一所學校，也許會選別的職業。

items.en: If the weather had been better, more people might have come.
items.zh: 如果天氣好一點，也許會有更多人來。

items.en: If she had apologised, he might have forgiven her.
items.zh: 如果她道了歉，他也許會原諒她。

items.en: If you had read the contract carefully, you might have noticed the problem.
items.zh: 如果你仔細讀過合約，也許會發現那個問題。

items.en: He might have accepted the job if they had offered more money.
items.zh: 如果他們出更多錢，他也許會接受那份工作。

items.en: If we had stayed until dawn, we might have seen the fishing boats come in.
items.zh: 如果我們待到天亮，也許會看到漁船進港。

items.en: If the critics had been more dispassionate, the film might have done better.
items.zh: 如果影評人更冷靜客觀一點，這部電影也許會賣得更好。

examples.heading: ③ 被動

items.en: The accident could have been prevented if the road had been lit.
items.zh: 如果那條路有路燈，這場意外本來可以避免。（被動）

items.en: If the warning had been heard, the town might have been evacuated in time.
items.zh: 如果有人聽到警告，鎮上的人也許能及時撤離。（被動）

items.en: Much of the damage could have been avoided if the river had been cleaned.
items.zh: 如果河道有清理，很多損害本來可以避免。（被動）

items.en: If the letter had been posted on Monday, it could have been delivered by Friday.
items.zh: 如果信星期一就寄出，本來星期五前就能送到。（被動）

items.en: If the report had been checked, the mistakes might have been noticed.
items.zh: 如果報告有人檢查，那些錯誤也許會被發現。（被動）

items.en: The contract could have been annulled if the lawyer had acted sooner.
items.zh: 如果律師早點行動，那份合約本來可以撤銷。（被動）

examples.heading: ④ 否定

items.en: If I hadn't missed the bus, I could have met you for lunch.
items.zh: 如果我沒錯過公車，本來可以跟你吃午餐。

items.en: If she hadn't been so capricious, they might not have broken up.
items.zh: 如果她不是那麼善變，他們也許不會分手。

items.en: We couldn't have finished the project if you hadn't helped us.
items.zh: 如果你沒有幫我們，我們不可能完成這個專案。

items.en: If he hadn't lied, his colleagues might have trusted him.
items.zh: 如果他沒有說謊，同事也許會信任他。

items.en: If I had checked the weather, I might not have got so wet.
items.zh: 如果我先看了天氣預報，也許不會淋得這麼濕。

items.en: The team couldn't have won if she hadn't scored in the final minute.
items.zh: 如果她沒在最後一分鐘得分，球隊不可能贏。

examples.heading: ⑤ 後悔和遺憾

items.en: If I had been more careful, I could have avoided the crash.
items.zh: 如果我小心一點，本來可以避開那場車禍。

items.en: I might have passed the interview if I hadn't been so nervous.
items.zh: 如果我沒那麼緊張，也許能通過面試。

items.en: If we had invested in that company, we could have made a fortune.
items.zh: 如果我們當初投資那家公司，本來可以賺一大筆錢。

items.en: If I had complained to the manager, I might have got a refund.
items.zh: 如果我跟經理投訴，也許能拿到退款。

items.en: If my grandfather had kept the farm, it could have been a fine legacy for us.
items.zh: 如果爺爺把農場留下來，那本來可以是留給我們的一份好遺產。

title: If they had not been there, I would have been very lonely.
translation: 如果他們當時不在那裡，我會非常寂寞。
name: 第三條件句（if 過去完成式加 would have）
sentences: If I had set off earlier, I would have arrived before the rain.
If I had saved my work, I wouldn't have lost the whole essay.
If I had listened to my mother, I would have taken a warmer jacket.
If we had checked the tyres, we wouldn't have had a puncture on the motorway.
If I had read the instructions, I wouldn't have broken the printer.
If I hadn't been so heedless, I would have noticed the wet paint.
If I had practised more, I wouldn't have forgotten my lines on stage.
If we had bought the tickets online, we wouldn't have queued for an hour.
If the neighbours hadn't smelled the smoke, the fire would have spread.
If I hadn't gone to that party, I would never have met my wife.
If the doctor hadn't acted so fast, I would have lost my leg.
If you hadn't lent me your notes, I would have failed the test.
If the pilot hadn't stayed calm, the plane would have crashed.
If my teacher hadn't encouraged me, I wouldn't have applied to university.
If you had locked the car, nobody would have stolen your bag.
If he had driven more slowly, the police wouldn't have stopped him.
If she had sent the form in time, she would have got a place on the course.
If the team had scored one more goal, they would have reached the final.
If you had told us about your allergy, the chef would have changed the dish.
If the council had cleared the drains, the street wouldn't have flooded.
We would have caught the ferry if the car hadn't broken down.
She wouldn't have missed the flight if her taxi had arrived on time.
I wouldn't have bought this sofa if I had measured the door first.
They would have enjoyed the trip more if the guide had been more affable.
You would have loved the concert if you had come with us.
The cake wouldn't have burned if I had set the timer.
If you had been there, you would have been proud of her.
If the hotel had had a pool, the children would have been ecstatic.
If we hadn't moved house, I would have been at the same school as my cousin.
If the tickets had cost less, the trip would have been worth it.
If the rescue team hadn't found them, the climbers would have been in serious danger.
If my parents hadn't helped me, the first year would have been much harder.

examples.heading: ① 說後悔

items.en: If I had set off earlier, I would have arrived before the rain.
items.zh: 如果我早點出發，就會在下雨前到了。

items.en: If I had saved my work, I wouldn't have lost the whole essay.
items.zh: 如果我有存檔，就不會把整篇作文弄丟了。

items.en: If I had listened to my mother, I would have taken a warmer jacket.
items.zh: 如果我有聽我媽的話，就會帶一件比較暖的外套。

items.en: If we had checked the tyres, we wouldn't have had a puncture on the motorway.
items.zh: 如果我們有檢查輪胎，就不會在高速公路上爆胎了。

items.en: If I had read the instructions, I wouldn't have broken the printer.
items.zh: 如果我有看說明書，就不會把印表機弄壞了。

items.en: If I hadn't been so heedless, I would have noticed the wet paint.
items.zh: 如果我當時沒那麼粗心，就會注意到油漆還沒乾。

items.en: If I had practised more, I wouldn't have forgotten my lines on stage.
items.zh: 如果我多練習一點，就不會在台上忘詞了。

items.en: If we had bought the tickets online, we wouldn't have queued for an hour.
items.zh: 如果我們在網路上買票，就不用排一個小時的隊了。

examples.heading: ② 說幸好

items.en: If the neighbours hadn't smelled the smoke, the fire would have spread.
items.zh: 如果鄰居沒聞到煙味，火就會蔓延開來。

items.en: If I hadn't gone to that party, I would never have met my wife.
items.zh: 如果我沒去那個派對，就永遠不會遇到我太太。

items.en: If the doctor hadn't acted so fast, I would have lost my leg.
items.zh: 如果醫生沒有那麼快處理，我就會失去一條腿。

items.en: If you hadn't lent me your notes, I would have failed the test.
items.zh: 如果你沒借我筆記，我考試就會不及格。

items.en: If the pilot hadn't stayed calm, the plane would have crashed.
items.zh: 如果機長沒有保持冷靜，飛機就會墜毀。

items.en: If my teacher hadn't encouraged me, I wouldn't have applied to university.
items.zh: 如果老師沒有鼓勵我，我就不會申請大學。

examples.heading: ③ 說別人的錯或可惜的事

items.en: If you had locked the car, nobody would have stolen your bag.
items.zh: 如果你有鎖車，就不會有人偷走你的包包。

items.en: If he had driven more slowly, the police wouldn't have stopped him.
items.zh: 如果他開慢一點，警察就不會攔他。

items.en: If she had sent the form in time, she would have got a place on the course.
items.zh: 如果她及時寄出表格，就會拿到課程的名額。

items.en: If the team had scored one more goal, they would have reached the final.
items.zh: 如果球隊多進一球，就會打進決賽。

items.en: If you had told us about your allergy, the chef would have changed the dish.
items.zh: 如果你有告訴我們你會過敏，主廚就會換掉那道菜。

items.en: If the council had cleared the drains, the street wouldn't have flooded.
items.zh: 如果市政府有清理排水溝，街道就不會淹水。

examples.heading: ④ if 子句在後面

items.en: We would have caught the ferry if the car hadn't broken down.
items.zh: 如果車子沒拋錨，我們就會趕上渡輪了。

items.en: She wouldn't have missed the flight if her taxi had arrived on time.
items.zh: 如果她的計程車準時到，她就不會錯過班機。

items.en: I wouldn't have bought this sofa if I had measured the door first.
items.zh: 如果我先量了門的寬度，就不會買這張沙發了。

items.en: They would have enjoyed the trip more if the guide had been more affable.
items.zh: 如果導遊親切一點，他們會更喜歡這趟旅行。

items.en: You would have loved the concert if you had come with us.
items.zh: 如果你跟我們一起來，你一定會很喜歡那場音樂會。

items.en: The cake wouldn't have burned if I had set the timer.
items.zh: 如果我有設計時器，蛋糕就不會烤焦了。

examples.heading: ⑤ would have been

items.en: If you had been there, you would have been proud of her.
items.zh: 如果你當時在場，你會為她感到驕傲。

items.en: If the hotel had had a pool, the children would have been ecstatic.
items.zh: 如果飯店有游泳池，孩子們一定會樂翻了。

items.en: If we hadn't moved house, I would have been at the same school as my cousin.
items.zh: 如果我們沒搬家，我就會和我表哥讀同一所學校。

items.en: If the tickets had cost less, the trip would have been worth it.
items.zh: 如果票便宜一點，這趟旅行就值得了。

items.en: If the rescue team hadn't found them, the climbers would have been in serious danger.
items.zh: 如果救難隊沒找到他們，那些登山客就會非常危險。

items.en: If my parents hadn't helped me, the first year would have been much harder.
items.zh: 如果我爸媽沒幫我，第一年會辛苦得多。

title: If you wanted to do some outdoor activities, we could go fishing.
translation: 如果你想做一些戶外活動，我們可以去釣魚。
name: if 過去簡單式加 could 的條件句
sentences: If you liked, we could meet at the café near the station.
If it stopped raining, we could take the dog for a walk.
If you were interested, we could visit the castle on Sunday.
If you got here early, we could have breakfast together.
If the children got bored, we could take them to the zoo.
If you wanted something quieter, we could stay at a farmhouse.
If we hired a boat, we could explore the islands.
If you didn't mind the cold, we could swim in the lake.
If you gave me your address, I could send you the photos.
If you needed a lift, I could pick you up at the station.
If your laptop broke again, I could lend you mine.
If you were too busy, I could do the shopping.
If you told me the date, I could book the restaurant.
If you felt nervous, I could practise the speech with you.
If I lived nearer, I could walk to work.
If I knew his number, I could call him.
If we had a bigger kitchen, we could invite more friends for dinner.
If she played the piano, she could join the band.
If I earned more money, I could travel every summer.
If they built a bridge, people could cross the river in minutes.
If the bakery closed, we couldn't buy fresh bread in the village.
If I lost my glasses, I couldn't read anything.
If the internet went down, we couldn't send the orders.
If you moved to Canada, we couldn't see each other very often.
If the road flooded, the bus couldn't reach the school.
If he broke his leg, he couldn't play in the final.
If you arrived on Friday evening, we could show you around the town.
If you stayed for a week, we could take a trip to the coast.
If your parents agreed, you could stay with us in July.
If you preferred, we could meet at the airport instead.
If you let us know your arrival time, our driver could meet you.
If you brought your bike, we could cycle along the canal.

examples.heading: ① 主詞是 we 的建議

items.en: If you liked, we could meet at the café near the station.
items.zh: 如果你願意，我們可以在車站附近的咖啡館見面。

items.en: If it stopped raining, we could take the dog for a walk.
items.zh: 如果雨停了，我們可以帶狗去散步。

items.en: If you were interested, we could visit the castle on Sunday.
items.zh: 如果你有興趣，我們星期天可以去參觀城堡。

items.en: If you got here early, we could have breakfast together.
items.zh: 如果你早點到，我們可以一起吃早餐。

items.en: If the children got bored, we could take them to the zoo.
items.zh: 如果孩子們覺得無聊，我們可以帶他們去動物園。

items.en: If you wanted something quieter, we could stay at a farmhouse.
items.zh: 如果你想要安靜一點的地方，我們可以住在農舍。

items.en: If we hired a boat, we could explore the islands.
items.zh: 如果我們租一艘船，就可以去探索那些島。

items.en: If you didn't mind the cold, we could swim in the lake.
items.zh: 如果你不怕冷，我們可以在湖裡游泳。

examples.heading: ② 主詞是 I 的提議

items.en: If you gave me your address, I could send you the photos.
items.zh: 如果你給我你的地址，我可以把照片寄給你。

items.en: If you needed a lift, I could pick you up at the station.
items.zh: 如果你需要人載，我可以去車站接你。

items.en: If your laptop broke again, I could lend you mine.
items.zh: 如果你的筆電又壞了，我可以借你我的。

items.en: If you were too busy, I could do the shopping.
items.zh: 如果你太忙，我可以去買東西。

items.en: If you told me the date, I could book the restaurant.
items.zh: 如果你告訴我日期，我可以訂餐廳。

items.en: If you felt nervous, I could practise the speech with you.
items.zh: 如果你覺得緊張，我可以陪你練習演講。

examples.heading: ③ 能力

items.en: If I lived nearer, I could walk to work.
items.zh: 如果我住近一點，就可以走路上班。

items.en: If I knew his number, I could call him.
items.zh: 如果我知道他的電話號碼，就可以打給他。

items.en: If we had a bigger kitchen, we could invite more friends for dinner.
items.zh: 如果我們的廚房大一點，就可以請更多朋友來吃晚餐。

items.en: If she played the piano, she could join the band.
items.zh: 如果她會彈鋼琴，就可以加入樂團。

items.en: If I earned more money, I could travel every summer.
items.zh: 如果我賺更多錢，每年夏天就可以去旅行。

items.en: If they built a bridge, people could cross the river in minutes.
items.zh: 如果他們蓋一座橋，大家幾分鐘就可以過河。

examples.heading: ④ couldn't

items.en: If the bakery closed, we couldn't buy fresh bread in the village.
items.zh: 如果那家麵包店關門，我們在村子裡就買不到新鮮麵包了。

items.en: If I lost my glasses, I couldn't read anything.
items.zh: 如果我弄丟眼鏡，就什麼都沒辦法讀了。

items.en: If the internet went down, we couldn't send the orders.
items.zh: 如果網路斷線，我們就沒辦法送出訂單。

items.en: If you moved to Canada, we couldn't see each other very often.
items.zh: 如果你搬去加拿大，我們就不能常常見面了。

items.en: If the road flooded, the bus couldn't reach the school.
items.zh: 如果道路淹水，公車就沒辦法開到學校。

items.en: If he broke his leg, he couldn't play in the final.
items.zh: 如果他摔斷腿，就不能參加決賽了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 信件和邀請

items.en: If you arrived on Friday evening, we could show you around the town.
items.zh: 如果你星期五晚上到，我們可以帶你逛逛小鎮。

items.en: If you stayed for a week, we could take a trip to the coast.
items.zh: 如果你待一週，我們可以去海邊玩一趟。

items.en: If your parents agreed, you could stay with us in July.
items.zh: 如果你爸媽同意，你七月可以來我們家住。

items.en: If you preferred, we could meet at the airport instead.
items.zh: 如果你比較想這樣，我們可以改在機場見面。

items.en: If you let us know your arrival time, our driver could meet you.
items.zh: 如果你告訴我們你抵達的時間，我們的司機可以去接你。

items.en: If you brought your bike, we could cycle along the canal.
items.zh: 如果你帶腳踏車來，我們可以沿著運河騎車。

title: If you went on holiday with your friends, where would you go?
translation: 如果你跟朋友去度假，你會去哪裡？
name: 第二條件句（if 過去簡單式加 would）
sentences: If I had wings, I would fly over the mountains.
If my sister lived nearer, I would see her every weekend.
If we owned a boat, we would spend the summer at sea.
If I knew how to sew, I would make my own clothes.
If the weekend lasted three days, people would be much happier.
If he practised every day, he would get better at chess.
If our school had a pool, I would swim every morning.
If you won a free trip, where would you go?
If you met the president, what would you say?
If you lost your phone, what would you do first?
If your boss offered you a job abroad, would you take it?
If you didn't have to work, how would you spend your days?
If you had to choose one food forever, which one would it be?
If a friend asked you for money, would you lend it?
Your room would look bigger if you painted the walls white.
If you went to bed earlier, you would feel less tired.
The trip would be cheaper if you booked it in advance.
If you spoke to her directly, she would understand.
You would save money if you cooked at home.
If you took a map, you would find the lake easily.
If you asked the teacher, she would explain it again.
If I didn't have a car, I would cycle everywhere.
If the shop wasn't so far away, we would go there more often.
If he didn't talk so fast, people would understand him better.
If it wasn't so expensive, I would buy the leather jacket.
I wouldn't go out in this weather if I didn't have to.
We wouldn't need a bigger flat if we didn't have so many books.
If I moved, I would like to live near the coast.
If I had a choice, I would like to work from home.
If we had more time, we would like to visit the old town.
If I went back to university, I'd like to study history.
If she earned more, she'd like to buy a flat of her own.

examples.heading: ① 想像的情況

items.en: If I had wings, I would fly over the mountains.
items.zh: 如果我有翅膀，我會飛越群山。

items.en: If my sister lived nearer, I would see her every weekend.
items.zh: 如果我姊姊住近一點，我每個週末都會去看她。

items.en: If we owned a boat, we would spend the summer at sea.
items.zh: 如果我們有一艘船，就會在海上度過夏天。

items.en: If I knew how to sew, I would make my own clothes.
items.zh: 如果我會縫紉，我會自己做衣服。

items.en: If the weekend lasted three days, people would be much happier.
items.zh: 如果週末有三天，大家會快樂得多。

items.en: If he practised every day, he would get better at chess.
items.zh: 如果他每天練習，他的西洋棋會進步。

items.en: If our school had a pool, I would swim every morning.
items.zh: 如果我們學校有游泳池，我每天早上都會去游泳。

examples.heading: ② 問對方的想法

items.en: If you won a free trip, where would you go?
items.zh: 如果你贏得一趟免費旅行，你會去哪裡？

items.en: If you met the president, what would you say?
items.zh: 如果你見到總統，你會說什麼？

items.en: If you lost your phone, what would you do first?
items.zh: 如果你弄丟手機，你第一件事會做什麼？

items.en: If your boss offered you a job abroad, would you take it?
items.zh: 如果你老闆給你一份國外的工作，你會接受嗎？

items.en: If you didn't have to work, how would you spend your days?
items.zh: 如果你不用工作，你會怎麼過日子？

items.en: If you had to choose one food forever, which one would it be?
items.zh: 如果你一輩子只能吃一種食物，你會選哪一種？

items.en: If a friend asked you for money, would you lend it?
items.zh: 如果朋友跟你借錢，你會借嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 給建議

items.en: Your room would look bigger if you painted the walls white.
items.zh: 如果你把牆刷成白色，房間看起來會比較大。

items.en: If you went to bed earlier, you would feel less tired.
items.zh: 如果你早點睡，就不會那麼累。

items.en: The trip would be cheaper if you booked it in advance.
items.zh: 如果你提早訂，這趟旅行會比較便宜。

items.en: If you spoke to her directly, she would understand.
items.zh: 如果你直接跟她說，她會理解的。

items.en: You would save money if you cooked at home.
items.zh: 如果你在家煮飯，就會省錢。

items.en: If you took a map, you would find the lake easily.
items.zh: 如果你帶張地圖，就會很容易找到那座湖。

items.en: If you asked the teacher, she would explain it again.
items.zh: 如果你去問老師，她會再解釋一次。

examples.heading: ④ didn't 和 wouldn't

items.en: If I didn't have a car, I would cycle everywhere.
items.zh: 如果我沒有車，我會到哪都騎腳踏車。

items.en: If the shop wasn't so far away, we would go there more often.
items.zh: 如果那家店沒那麼遠，我們會比較常去。

items.en: If he didn't talk so fast, people would understand him better.
items.zh: 如果他講話沒那麼快，大家會比較聽得懂。

items.en: If it wasn't so expensive, I would buy the leather jacket.
items.zh: 如果沒那麼貴，我會買那件皮夾克。

items.en: I wouldn't go out in this weather if I didn't have to.
items.zh: 如果不是非出門不可，我不會在這種天氣出去。

items.en: We wouldn't need a bigger flat if we didn't have so many books.
items.zh: 如果我們的書沒那麼多，就不需要大一點的公寓。

examples.heading: ⑤ would like to

items.en: If I moved, I would like to live near the coast.
items.zh: 如果我搬家，我想住在海邊附近。

items.en: If I had a choice, I would like to work from home.
items.zh: 如果我可以選，我想在家工作。

items.en: If we had more time, we would like to visit the old town.
items.zh: 如果我們有更多時間，我們想去參觀舊城區。

items.en: If I went back to university, I'd like to study history.
items.zh: 如果我回大學讀書，我想讀歷史。

items.en: If she earned more, she'd like to buy a flat of her own.
items.zh: 如果她賺得多一點，她想買一間自己的公寓。

title: See one of them and you'll want to see them all.
translation: 只要看過其中一個，你就會想把它們全部看完。
name: 祈使句加 and 表示條件和結果
sentences: Read one of her books and you'll want to read them all.
The doctor visited my sick grandfather. Eat well and you'll feel better soon.
You don't need hours for English. Read for ten minutes a day and you'll learn a lot.
My aunt makes the best pasta. Taste this sauce and you'll want the recipe.
The main road is full of traffic. Take this road and you'll get there in ten minutes.
Ken knows all the bus times. Ask him and he'll tell you.
You're nearly there. Turn left at the bank and you'll see the hotel.
The new waiter is slow, but he learns fast. Give him a chance and he'll surprise you.
My grandmother often said this to us. Smile and the world smiles with you.
The door to our building is locked at night. Push the button and the door will open.
The man at the flower shop gave me some advice. Water the plant once a week and it'll grow fast.
Spend a week in Kyoto and you'll never want to leave.
The soup is a bit boring. Add a little salt and it'll taste much better.
You don't need expensive toys at the beach. Give the kids a ball and they'll play for hours.
Everyone loves this little island. Visit once and you'll come back every year.
It's too hot to sleep in here. Leave the window open and the room will cool down.
Your brother is about to swim. Run, or you'll miss the start of the race.
Your flight is at seven in the morning. Set an alarm or you'll oversleep.
It's very windy today. Wear a coat or you'll catch a cold.
Hold the rail on these stairs or you'll slip.
We're eating outside today. Cover the cake or the flies will get to it.
Don't call my sister fat. Say that again and I'll be very angry.
The teacher saw the boy kick the door. Do that once more and you'll be in trouble.
The bakery has an offer on cakes this week. Buy two and you'll get one free.
The radio advert for the new gym says this. Call before ten and you'll get a discount.
The guards at the stadium check everyone. Show your ticket and they'll let you in.
We're in the middle of the forest now. Listen carefully and you'll hear the birds.
The project ends in March. Work hard now and you'll have more time later.
The hospital is a big building. Follow the signs and you won't get lost.
Happy birthday, darling! Open the box and you'll find a surprise.

examples.heading: ① 祈使句 + and + you'll

items.en: Read one of her books and you'll want to read them all.
items.zh: 只要讀過她的一本書，你就會想把全部都讀完。

items.en: The doctor visited my sick grandfather. Eat well and you'll feel better soon.
items.zh: 醫生來看我生病的爺爺。好好吃飯，你很快就會好起來。

items.en: You don't need hours for English. Read for ten minutes a day and you'll learn a lot.
items.zh: 學英文不需要花好幾個小時。每天讀十分鐘，你就會學到很多。

items.en: My aunt makes the best pasta. Taste this sauce and you'll want the recipe.
items.zh: 我阿姨做的義大利麵最好吃。嚐嚐這個醬汁，你一定會想要食譜。

items.en: The main road is full of traffic. Take this road and you'll get there in ten minutes.
items.zh: 大馬路塞滿了車。走這條路，你十分鐘就會到。

items.en: Ken knows all the bus times. Ask him and he'll tell you.
items.zh: Ken 知道所有公車的時間。問他，他就會告訴你。

examples.heading: ② 祈使句 + and + 其他結果

items.en: You're nearly there. Turn left at the bank and you'll see the hotel.
items.zh: 你快到了。在銀行左轉，你就會看到飯店。

items.en: The new waiter is slow, but he learns fast. Give him a chance and he'll surprise you.
items.zh: 新服務生動作很慢，可是他學得很快。給他一個機會，他會讓你驚訝的。

items.en: My grandmother often said this to us. Smile and the world smiles with you.
items.zh: 我奶奶常常跟我們說這句話。你笑，全世界都會跟著你笑。

items.en: The door to our building is locked at night. Push the button and the door will open.
items.zh: 我們大樓的門晚上會鎖。按這個按鈕，門就會開。

items.en: The man at the flower shop gave me some advice. Water the plant once a week and it'll grow fast.
items.zh: 花店的老闆給了我一些建議。這盆植物一週澆一次水，就會長得很快。

examples.heading: ③ Spend / Give / Add ... and ...

items.en: Spend a week in Kyoto and you'll never want to leave.
items.zh: 在京都待一個禮拜，你就會再也不想走了。

items.en: The soup is a bit boring. Add a little salt and it'll taste much better.
items.zh: 這湯有點淡。加一點鹽，它就會好喝很多。

items.en: You don't need expensive toys at the beach. Give the kids a ball and they'll play for hours.
items.zh: 去海邊不需要貴的玩具。給孩子們一顆球，他們就能玩好幾個小時。

items.en: Everyone loves this little island. Visit once and you'll come back every year.
items.zh: 大家都愛這座小島。去過一次，你就會每年都想回去。

items.en: It's too hot to sleep in here. Leave the window open and the room will cool down.
items.zh: 這裡熱到睡不著。把窗戶開著，房間就會涼下來。

examples.heading: ④ 祈使句 + or + 結果

items.en: Your brother is about to swim. Run, or you'll miss the start of the race.
items.zh: 你哥哥要游了。快跑，不然你會錯過比賽開始。

items.en: Your flight is at seven in the morning. Set an alarm or you'll oversleep.
items.zh: 你的班機早上七點起飛。設個鬧鐘，不然你會睡過頭。

items.en: It's very windy today. Wear a coat or you'll catch a cold.
items.zh: 今天風很大。穿件外套，不然你會感冒。

items.en: Hold the rail on these stairs or you'll slip.
items.zh: 走這些樓梯要扶著欄杆，不然你會滑倒。

items.en: We're eating outside today. Cover the cake or the flies will get to it.
items.zh: 我們今天在外面吃。把蛋糕蓋起來，不然蒼蠅會飛上去。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: Don't call my sister fat. Say that again and I'll be very angry.
items.zh: 別說我妹妹胖。你再說一次，我就要生氣了。

items.en: The teacher saw the boy kick the door. Do that once more and you'll be in trouble.
items.zh: 老師看到那個男孩踢門。你再那樣做一次，就麻煩了。

items.en: The bakery has an offer on cakes this week. Buy two and you'll get one free.
items.zh: 麵包店這星期蛋糕有優惠。買兩個，就送一個。

items.en: The radio advert for the new gym says this. Call before ten and you'll get a discount.
items.zh: 新健身房的電台廣告這樣說。十點以前打電話，就能打折。

items.en: The guards at the stadium check everyone. Show your ticket and they'll let you in.
items.zh: 體育場的警衛會檢查每個人。出示你的票，他們就會讓你進去。

items.en: We're in the middle of the forest now. Listen carefully and you'll hear the birds.
items.zh: 我們現在在森林中間。仔細聽，你就會聽到鳥叫聲。

items.en: The project ends in March. Work hard now and you'll have more time later.
items.zh: 這個專案三月結束。現在努力工作，以後你就會有更多時間。

items.en: The hospital is a big building. Follow the signs and you won't get lost.
items.zh: 醫院是一棟很大的建築。跟著指標走，你就不會迷路。

items.en: Happy birthday, darling! Open the box and you'll find a surprise.
items.zh: 親愛的，生日快樂！打開盒子，你會看到一個驚喜。

title: Using his best smile, Paul asked her if he could sit beside her.
translation: Paul 擺出他最迷人的笑容，問她能不能坐在她旁邊。
name: 句首的動詞-ing 子句
sentences: Smiling at the children, the teacher opened the book.
Carrying two heavy bags, he climbed the stairs slowly.
Looking out of the window, she saw her old car drive past.
Singing loudly, the kids ran into the garden.
Waving goodbye, my grandparents got on the train.
Sitting by the fire, we told each other stories.
Feeling a bit sick, I stayed home from work.
Not wanting to wake the baby, we spoke in whispers.
Having no money left, they had to walk home.
Being the oldest, my sister always looked after us.
Not knowing anyone at the party, I left early.
Wanting to impress his boss, he arrived an hour early.
Using an old recipe, my mother baked the perfect cake.
Following the signs, we found the car park easily.
Working day and night, they finished the house in a month.
Speaking slowly, she explained the rules to the new students.
Saving a little every week, he bought his first guitar.
Having lost my keys, I had to call a locksmith.
Having studied the data, we decided to change our plan.
Having lived in Spain for years, she speaks Spanish fluently.
Having eaten too much, I felt sleepy all afternoon.
Having heard the news, they rushed to the hospital.
Having no choice, I paid the fine.
Taking a deep breath, he walked onto the stage.
Turning the corner, we saw the sea for the first time.
Being gregarious, Ken made friends on his first day.
Hoping to save time, we took a shortcut through the park.
Opening the letter, she started to cry.
Remembering her promise, she called her mother that night.
Having missed the bus, I decided to cycle instead.

examples.heading: ① 同時發生

items.en: Smiling at the children, the teacher opened the book.
items.zh: 老師對孩子們笑了笑，打開了書。

items.en: Carrying two heavy bags, he climbed the stairs slowly.
items.zh: 他提著兩個很重的袋子，慢慢地爬上樓梯。

items.en: Looking out of the window, she saw her old car drive past.
items.zh: 她往窗外看，看到她的舊車開過去。

items.en: Singing loudly, the kids ran into the garden.
items.zh: 孩子們一邊大聲唱歌，一邊跑進花園。

items.en: Waving goodbye, my grandparents got on the train.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶揮手道別，上了火車。

items.en: Sitting by the fire, we told each other stories.
items.zh: 我們坐在爐火邊，互相講故事。

examples.heading: ② 原因

items.en: Feeling a bit sick, I stayed home from work.
items.zh: 我覺得有點不舒服，所以請假在家。

items.en: Not wanting to wake the baby, we spoke in whispers.
items.zh: 我們不想吵醒寶寶，所以小聲說話。

items.en: Having no money left, they had to walk home.
items.zh: 他們身上沒錢了，只好走路回家。

items.en: Being the oldest, my sister always looked after us.
items.zh: 我姊姊是老大，所以總是照顧我們。

items.en: Not knowing anyone at the party, I left early.
items.zh: 我在派對上誰都不認識，所以提早走了。

items.en: Wanting to impress his boss, he arrived an hour early.
items.zh: 他想讓老闆留下好印象，所以早到了一個小時。

examples.heading: ③ 方法

items.en: Using an old recipe, my mother baked the perfect cake.
items.zh: 我媽媽用一個老食譜烤出了完美的蛋糕。

items.en: Following the signs, we found the car park easily.
items.zh: 我們跟著指標走，很容易就找到了停車場。

items.en: Working day and night, they finished the house in a month.
items.zh: 他們日以繼夜地工作，一個月就把房子蓋好了。

items.en: Speaking slowly, she explained the rules to the new students.
items.zh: 她慢慢地說，向新同學解釋規則。

items.en: Saving a little every week, he bought his first guitar.
items.zh: 他每週存一點錢，買了他的第一把吉他。

examples.heading: ④ Having + 過去分詞

items.en: Having lost my keys, I had to call a locksmith.
items.zh: 我把鑰匙弄丟了，只好叫鎖匠。

items.en: Having studied the data, we decided to change our plan.
items.zh: 研究過數據之後，我們決定改變計畫。

items.en: Having lived in Spain for years, she speaks Spanish fluently.
items.zh: 她在西班牙住了好幾年，西班牙文說得很流利。

items.en: Having eaten too much, I felt sleepy all afternoon.
items.zh: 我吃太多了，整個下午都很想睡。

items.en: Having heard the news, they rushed to the hospital.
items.zh: 他們聽到消息後，趕到了醫院。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Having no choice, I paid the fine.
items.zh: 我別無選擇，只好付了罰款。

items.en: Taking a deep breath, he walked onto the stage.
items.zh: 他深吸一口氣，走上了舞台。

items.en: Turning the corner, we saw the sea for the first time.
items.zh: 我們一轉過街角，第一次看到了海。

items.en: Being gregarious, Ken made friends on his first day.
items.zh: Ken 很愛交朋友，第一天就交到了朋友。

items.en: Hoping to save time, we took a shortcut through the park.
items.zh: 我們想省時間，所以抄近路穿過公園。

items.en: Opening the letter, she started to cry.
items.zh: 她打開信，開始哭了起來。

items.en: Remembering her promise, she called her mother that night.
items.zh: 她想起了她的承諾，那天晚上打給了她媽媽。

items.en: Having missed the bus, I decided to cycle instead.
items.zh: 我錯過了公車，所以決定改騎腳踏車。

title: Had we known that before, we could have taken more money with us.
translation: 要是我們早點知道那件事，就可以多帶點錢了。
name: should、had、were 倒裝的從屬子句
sentences: Should you arrive before noon, you can leave your bags at reception.
Should your plans change, just send us an email.
Should anyone call, tell them I'll be back at three.
Should you wish to cancel, please let us know 24 hours in advance.
Should the weather change, the event will move indoors.
Should you lose your card, call the bank immediately.
Had I known you were coming, I would have cooked something special.
Had they left on time, they wouldn't have missed the ferry.
Had she taken the job in Singapore, she would be earning twice as much now.
Had we booked earlier, we would have got a cheaper room.
Had you told me the truth, I would have understood.
Had the doctor arrived sooner, things might have been different.
Were I able to speak Japanese, I would apply for the Tokyo job.
Were she here now, she would know what to do.
Were the company to close, hundreds of people would lose their jobs.
Were I a little younger, I would join you on the hike.
Were you to accept the job, when could you start?
Had it not been for the rain, we would have won the match.
Had I not checked the date, I would have missed the exam.
Were it not for my parents, I couldn't afford university.
Should you not receive the parcel by Friday, please contact us.
Had she not called, I would still be asleep.
Should you require parking, please reserve a space when you book.
Had we received your letter earlier, we would have replied sooner.
Should the problem continue, please contact our technical team.
Were the price lower, we would order a larger quantity.
Should you be interested, I would be happy to send you more details.
Had the meeting gone well, we would be celebrating now.
Should you specify a delivery date, we will do our best to meet it.
Were I to see him again, I wouldn't know what to say.

examples.heading: ① Should + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Should you arrive before noon, you can leave your bags at reception.
items.zh: 如果您中午前抵達，可以把行李寄放在櫃台。

items.en: Should your plans change, just send us an email.
items.zh: 如果您的計畫有變，寄封電子郵件給我們就好。

items.en: Should anyone call, tell them I'll be back at three.
items.zh: 如果有人打來，就說我三點會回來。

items.en: Should you wish to cancel, please let us know 24 hours in advance.
items.zh: 如果您想取消，請在二十四小時前通知我們。

items.en: Should the weather change, the event will move indoors.
items.zh: 如果天氣變了，活動會移到室內。

items.en: Should you lose your card, call the bank immediately.
items.zh: 如果您遺失卡片，請立刻打電話給銀行。

examples.heading: ② Had + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: Had I known you were coming, I would have cooked something special.
items.zh: 要是我知道你要來，我就會煮點特別的。

items.en: Had they left on time, they wouldn't have missed the ferry.
items.zh: 要是他們準時出發，就不會錯過渡輪了。

items.en: Had she taken the job in Singapore, she would be earning twice as much now.
items.zh: 要是她接了新加坡那份工作，她現在的薪水會是兩倍。

items.en: Had we booked earlier, we would have got a cheaper room.
items.zh: 要是我們早點訂，就能拿到比較便宜的房間了。

items.en: Had you told me the truth, I would have understood.
items.zh: 要是你跟我說實話，我會理解的。

items.en: Had the doctor arrived sooner, things might have been different.
items.zh: 要是醫生早點到，情況可能會不一樣。

examples.heading: ③ Were + 主詞

items.en: Were I able to speak Japanese, I would apply for the Tokyo job.
items.zh: 要是我會說日文，我就會去應徵東京那份工作。

items.en: Were she here now, she would know what to do.
items.zh: 要是她現在在這裡，她會知道該怎麼辦。

items.en: Were the company to close, hundreds of people would lose their jobs.
items.zh: 要是那家公司關門，好幾百人會失業。

items.en: Were I a little younger, I would join you on the hike.
items.zh: 要是我年輕一點，我就會跟你們一起去健行。

items.en: Were you to accept the job, when could you start?
items.zh: 如果你接受這份工作，什麼時候可以開始？

examples.heading: ④ 否定：Had ... not / Were ... not / Should ... not

items.en: Had it not been for the rain, we would have won the match.
items.zh: 要不是下雨，我們就贏了那場比賽。

items.en: Had I not checked the date, I would have missed the exam.
items.zh: 要不是我有確認日期，我就錯過考試了。

items.en: Were it not for my parents, I couldn't afford university.
items.zh: 要不是有我爸媽，我根本付不起大學的學費。

items.en: Should you not receive the parcel by Friday, please contact us.
items.zh: 如果您星期五前還沒收到包裹，請與我們聯絡。

items.en: Had she not called, I would still be asleep.
items.zh: 要不是她打來，我現在還在睡。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式的信件和情境

items.en: Should you require parking, please reserve a space when you book.
items.zh: 如果您需要停車位，請在訂房時預約。

items.en: Had we received your letter earlier, we would have replied sooner.
items.zh: 要是我們早點收到您的信，就會早點回覆了。

items.en: Should the problem continue, please contact our technical team.
items.zh: 如果問題持續，請聯絡我們的技術團隊。

items.en: Were the price lower, we would order a larger quantity.
items.zh: 要是價格低一點，我們會訂更多。

items.en: Should you be interested, I would be happy to send you more details.
items.zh: 如果您有興趣，我很樂意寄給您更多細節。

items.en: Had the meeting gone well, we would be celebrating now.
items.zh: 要是會議進行順利，我們現在就在慶祝了。

items.en: Should you specify a delivery date, we will do our best to meet it.
items.zh: 如果您指定送貨日期，我們會盡力配合。

items.en: Were I to see him again, I wouldn't know what to say.
items.zh: 要是我再見到他，我會不知道該說什麼。

title: Had public transportation been an option, I would have chosen that instead of my car.
translation: 要是當時有大眾運輸可以搭，我就會選那個，不開車了。
name: had 倒裝條件句（主要子句用情態動詞完成式）
sentences: Had I known you were in town, I would have invited you to dinner.
Had we left five minutes earlier, we would have caught the ferry.
Had she listened to her lawyer, she would have avoided the fine.
Had the referee seen the foul, he would have sent the player off.
Had they checked the weather, they would have stayed at home.
Had you told me about the contretemps, I would have tried to placate the client.
Had the hotel been cheaper, we would have stayed another week.
Had I been in your position, I would have done the same.
Had the instructions been clearer, nobody would have got lost.
Had she been a little older, she would have understood.
Had the task been less laborious, we would have finished by lunch.
Had we not booked a table, we would have waited for an hour.
Had he not apologized, I would never have spoken to him again.
Had the firefighters not arrived so quickly, the whole building would have burned down.
Had I not missed the bus, I would never have met my wife.
Had the company not cut costs, it would have gone bankrupt.
Had I studied harder, I could have got into medical school.
Had the road been less icy, the accident might never have happened.
Had you asked me, I could have lent you the money.
Had the letter arrived on time, things might have turned out differently.
Had we invested in that company, we might have made a fortune.
Had I taken that job in Paris, I would be living in France now.
Had she finished her degree, she would have a better job today.
Had we bought a house ten years ago, we wouldn't be paying rent now.
Had he not lost his passport, he would be in Tokyo by now.
Had the government acted sooner, it could have saved thousands of lives.
Had the bank's managers been less venal, the crisis would never have happened.
Had the council listened to residents, it would have kept the library open.
Had the researchers repeated the experiment, they might have got different results.
Had the regime been less draconian, fewer people would have left the country.
Had the inspectors done more than a perfunctory check, they would have found the cracks.
Had early doctors understood germs, millions of patients would have survived.

examples.heading: ① Had + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: Had I known you were in town, I would have invited you to dinner.
items.zh: 要是我知道你在城裡，就會請你吃晚餐了。

items.en: Had we left five minutes earlier, we would have caught the ferry.
items.zh: 要是我們早五分鐘出發，就趕上渡輪了。

items.en: Had she listened to her lawyer, she would have avoided the fine.
items.zh: 要是她聽律師的話，就不會被罰款了。

items.en: Had the referee seen the foul, he would have sent the player off.
items.zh: 要是裁判看到那次犯規，他早就把那名球員罰下場了。

items.en: Had they checked the weather, they would have stayed at home.
items.zh: 要是他們有看天氣預報，就會待在家裡了。

items.en: Had you told me about the contretemps, I would have tried to placate the client.
items.zh: 要是你跟我說了那場小風波，我就會想辦法安撫客戶。

examples.heading: ② Had + 主詞 + been + 形容詞或名詞

items.en: Had the hotel been cheaper, we would have stayed another week.
items.zh: 要是飯店便宜一點，我們就多住一個星期了。

items.en: Had I been in your position, I would have done the same.
items.zh: 要是我是你，我也會這麼做。

items.en: Had the instructions been clearer, nobody would have got lost.
items.zh: 要是說明清楚一點，就不會有人迷路了。

items.en: Had she been a little older, she would have understood.
items.zh: 要是她大一點，她就會懂了。

items.en: Had the task been less laborious, we would have finished by lunch.
items.zh: 要是那份工作不那麼費力，我們中午前就做完了。

examples.heading: ③ 否定

items.en: Had we not booked a table, we would have waited for an hour.
items.zh: 要是我們沒有訂位，就得等一個小時了。

items.en: Had he not apologized, I would never have spoken to him again.
items.zh: 要是他沒道歉，我就再也不跟他說話了。

items.en: Had the firefighters not arrived so quickly, the whole building would have burned down.
items.zh: 要是消防員沒有那麼快趕到，整棟大樓早就燒光了。

items.en: Had I not missed the bus, I would never have met my wife.
items.zh: 要是我沒錯過那班公車，就不會認識我太太了。

items.en: Had the company not cut costs, it would have gone bankrupt.
items.zh: 要是公司沒有削減成本，早就破產了。

examples.heading: ④ could have 和 might have

items.en: Had I studied harder, I could have got into medical school.
items.zh: 要是我當時更用功，就能進醫學院了。

items.en: Had the road been less icy, the accident might never have happened.
items.zh: 要是路面沒那麼滑，那場意外可能就不會發生。

items.en: Had you asked me, I could have lent you the money.
items.zh: 要是你開口，我就可以借你錢了。

items.en: Had the letter arrived on time, things might have turned out differently.
items.zh: 要是那封信準時到，事情的結果可能就不一樣了。

items.en: Had we invested in that company, we might have made a fortune.
items.zh: 要是我們投資了那家公司，可能已經賺了一大筆錢。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主要子句說現在的結果

items.en: Had I taken that job in Paris, I would be living in France now.
items.zh: 要是我接了巴黎那份工作，現在就住在法國了。

items.en: Had she finished her degree, she would have a better job today.
items.zh: 要是她把學位念完，今天會有更好的工作。

items.en: Had we bought a house ten years ago, we wouldn't be paying rent now.
items.zh: 要是我們十年前買了房子，現在就不用付房租了。

items.en: Had he not lost his passport, he would be in Tokyo by now.
items.zh: 要是他沒弄丟護照，現在已經在東京了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 報告和論說文

items.en: Had the government acted sooner, it could have saved thousands of lives.
items.zh: 要是政府早點行動，就能救成千上萬條人命。

items.en: Had the bank's managers been less venal, the crisis would never have happened.
items.zh: 要是銀行經理們沒那麼貪財，那場危機根本不會發生。

items.en: Had the council listened to residents, it would have kept the library open.
items.zh: 要是市議會聽了居民的意見，就會讓圖書館繼續開放。

items.en: Had the researchers repeated the experiment, they might have got different results.
items.zh: 要是研究人員重做那個實驗，可能會得到不同的結果。

items.en: Had the regime been less draconian, fewer people would have left the country.
items.zh: 要是那個政權沒那麼嚴苛，離開那個國家的人會少一點。

items.en: Had the inspectors done more than a perfunctory check, they would have found the cracks.
items.zh: 要是檢查員不只是草草看一下，就會發現那些裂縫。

items.en: Had early doctors understood germs, millions of patients would have survived.
items.zh: 要是早期的醫生了解細菌，幾百萬個病人就能活下來。

title: Were this suggestion to be put into practice, our town would change completely.
translation: 如果這個建議真的付諸實行，我們的城鎮會徹底改變。
name: were 倒裝加 to 不定詞的條件句（各種主詞）
sentences: Were I to lose my job, I would move back to my parents' house.
Were we to cancel the trip now, we would lose our deposit.
Were I to choose again, I would study medicine.
Were we to accept their offer, we would have to move to Berlin.
Were I to extol every feature of this hotel, I would need several pages.
Were you to visit Kyoto in spring, you would see the cherry blossoms.
Were you to ask my opinion, I would advise against it.
Were you to read the report carefully, you would find several mistakes.
Were you to accept this position, you would report directly to the director.
Were you to compare the two plans, you would see that ours is cheaper.
Were the government to raise taxes, many small businesses would close.
Were the president to resign, the vice president would take over.
Were someone to find the wallet, they would probably take it to the police.
Were the river to flood, the whole village would be under water.
Were a cataclysm of that size to happen today, few cities would survive.
Were the company to precipitate a price war, its rivals would suffer most.
Were the old factory to be demolished, the town would gain a large park.
Were the results to be published, the public would demand answers.
Were his book to be abridged, more students would read it.
Were the museum to be closed, the city would lose its main attraction.
Were this rule to be applied strictly, half the staff would be breaking it.
Were they not to agree, we would look for another partner.
Were the rain not to stop, the organizers would postpone the match.
Were I not to tell you the truth, you would find out anyway.
Were the doctors not to operate, the patient would die within weeks.
Were we to hire two more nurses, the clinic could open on Sundays.
Were the price of electric cars to fall, more families could afford one.
Were you to speak to him directly, he might listen.
Were the volcano to erupt, the ash might reach the capital.
Were schools to ban mobile phones, students might concentrate better.
Were politicians to show more humility, voters would trust them more.
Were cities to build more cycle lanes, fewer people would drive to work.

examples.heading: ① 主詞是 I 或 we

items.en: Were I to lose my job, I would move back to my parents' house.
items.zh: 如果我丟了工作，我會搬回爸媽家。

items.en: Were we to cancel the trip now, we would lose our deposit.
items.zh: 如果我們現在取消旅行，訂金就拿不回來了。

items.en: Were I to choose again, I would study medicine.
items.zh: 如果讓我再選一次，我會讀醫學。

items.en: Were we to accept their offer, we would have to move to Berlin.
items.zh: 如果我們接受他們的條件，就得搬到柏林。

items.en: Were I to extol every feature of this hotel, I would need several pages.
items.zh: 如果我要把這家飯店的每個優點都誇一遍，會需要好幾頁。

examples.heading: ② 主詞是 you

items.en: Were you to visit Kyoto in spring, you would see the cherry blossoms.
items.zh: 如果你春天去京都，就會看到櫻花。

items.en: Were you to ask my opinion, I would advise against it.
items.zh: 如果你問我的意見，我會勸你不要。

items.en: Were you to read the report carefully, you would find several mistakes.
items.zh: 如果你仔細讀這份報告，會發現好幾個錯誤。

items.en: Were you to accept this position, you would report directly to the director.
items.zh: 如果您接受這個職位，您會直接向主任報告。

items.en: Were you to compare the two plans, you would see that ours is cheaper.
items.zh: 如果您比較這兩個方案，會發現我們的比較便宜。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞是第三人稱

items.en: Were the government to raise taxes, many small businesses would close.
items.zh: 如果政府加稅，很多小公司會倒閉。

items.en: Were the president to resign, the vice president would take over.
items.zh: 如果總統辭職，副總統會接任。

items.en: Were someone to find the wallet, they would probably take it to the police.
items.zh: 如果有人撿到錢包，那個人大概會交給警察。

items.en: Were the river to flood, the whole village would be under water.
items.zh: 如果河水氾濫，整個村子都會泡在水裡。

items.en: Were a cataclysm of that size to happen today, few cities would survive.
items.zh: 如果今天發生那麼大的災難，很少城市能撐過去。

items.en: Were the company to precipitate a price war, its rivals would suffer most.
items.zh: 如果這家公司掀起價格戰，受害最深的會是它的對手。

examples.heading: ④ 被動

items.en: Were the old factory to be demolished, the town would gain a large park.
items.zh: 如果舊工廠拆掉，鎮上就會多一座大公園。（被動）

items.en: Were the results to be published, the public would demand answers.
items.zh: 如果結果公布出來，大眾會要求解釋。（被動）

items.en: Were his book to be abridged, more students would read it.
items.zh: 如果他的書出刪節版，會有更多學生讀。（被動）

items.en: Were the museum to be closed, the city would lose its main attraction.
items.zh: 如果博物館關閉，這座城市就少了最主要的景點。（被動）

items.en: Were this rule to be applied strictly, half the staff would be breaking it.
items.zh: 如果嚴格執行這條規定，一半的員工都會違規。（被動）

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定

items.en: Were they not to agree, we would look for another partner.
items.zh: 如果他們不同意，我們會另外找合作對象。

items.en: Were the rain not to stop, the organizers would postpone the match.
items.zh: 如果雨不停，主辦單位會把比賽延期。

items.en: Were I not to tell you the truth, you would find out anyway.
items.zh: 如果我不跟你說實話，你也會自己發現。

items.en: Were the doctors not to operate, the patient would die within weeks.
items.zh: 如果醫生不開刀，病人幾週內就會死。

examples.heading: ⑥ could 和 might 說可能的結果

items.en: Were we to hire two more nurses, the clinic could open on Sundays.
items.zh: 如果我們再請兩個護理師，診所星期天就能開。

items.en: Were the price of electric cars to fall, more families could afford one.
items.zh: 如果電動車的價格下跌，更多家庭買得起。

items.en: Were you to speak to him directly, he might listen.
items.zh: 如果你直接跟他談，他可能會聽。

items.en: Were the volcano to erupt, the ash might reach the capital.
items.zh: 如果火山爆發，火山灰可能會飄到首都。

examples.heading: ⑦ 論說文

items.en: Were schools to ban mobile phones, students might concentrate better.
items.zh: 如果學校禁止手機，學生可能會比較專心。

items.en: Were politicians to show more humility, voters would trust them more.
items.zh: 如果政治人物謙虛一點，選民會更信任他們。

items.en: Were cities to build more cycle lanes, fewer people would drive to work.
items.zh: 如果城市多蓋一些自行車道，開車上班的人會變少。

title: Let me tell you my story.
translation: 我來跟你說說我的故事。
name: let me 開頭的祈使句
sentences: Sit down, you won't believe this. Let me tell you what happened last night.
The coach gathered the team after training. Let me explain the plan for tomorrow.
Not everyone knows this card game. Let me explain the rules before we play.
You're nervous about Monday? Let me tell you a funny thing about my first day at work.
I'm sorry, everyone. Let me explain why I was late.
I got back last night. Let me tell you about my trip to Japan.
I'm on my phone on the train now. Let me answer your email properly tomorrow.
The speaker talked about saving money. Let me give you an example from my own life.
I've worked at that company for five years. Let me give you a piece of advice about the interview.
You asked about the price and the date. Let me answer that one first.
Call me if you need help with the move. Let me give you my phone number.
Welcome to the office on your first day. Let me show you where the kitchen and the meeting rooms are.
The new coffee machine is a bit tricky. Let me show you how to use the machine.
The manager opened the meeting. Let me start with the good news.
The bride stood up to speak at the wedding. Let me start by saying thank you.
You couldn't come in June, so let me show you the photos from our wedding.
You want me to move to Paris with you? Let me think about it.
The receptionist looked at her computer. Let me see. Your room is on the third floor.
Lunch next week? Let me check my calendar.
When did you last see your keys? Let me think. Was it Monday or Tuesday?
I'd love a day off on Friday. Let me check with my boss first.
This is my first time bringing family to the office party. Let me introduce my sister, Ann.
The meeting is nearly over. Let me say a few words about the project.
You keep stopping me in the middle. Let me finish, please.
The teacher looked at the class. Let me be clear about one thing. No phones in the exam.
You look confused. Let me put it another way.
I'm thinking of taking the flat. Let me ask you a quick question about the rent.
You've got three bags and an umbrella. Let me help you with that bag.
You haven't seen any photos yet. Let me describe the house to you first.
You want to buy a present after work? Let me remind you that the shop closes at six.

examples.heading: ① Let me tell / explain

items.en: Sit down, you won't believe this. Let me tell you what happened last night.
items.zh: 坐下，你一定不會相信。我來告訴你昨晚發生了什麼事。

items.en: The coach gathered the team after training. Let me explain the plan for tomorrow.
items.zh: 教練在練習後把隊員集合起來。我來說明明天的計畫。

items.en: Not everyone knows this card game. Let me explain the rules before we play.
items.zh: 不是每個人都會玩這個紙牌遊戲。玩之前我先解釋規則。

items.en: You're nervous about Monday? Let me tell you a funny thing about my first day at work.
items.zh: 你為了星期一緊張？我跟你說一件我上班第一天的趣事。

items.en: I'm sorry, everyone. Let me explain why I was late.
items.zh: 各位，對不起。我來解釋我為什麼遲到。

items.en: I got back last night. Let me tell you about my trip to Japan.
items.zh: 我昨天晚上回來的。我來跟你說說我的日本之旅。

examples.heading: ② Let me answer / give

items.en: I'm on my phone on the train now. Let me answer your email properly tomorrow.
items.zh: 我現在在火車上用手機。我明天再好好回覆你的電子郵件。

items.en: The speaker talked about saving money. Let me give you an example from my own life.
items.zh: 講者談到存錢。我舉一個我自己生活中的例子。

items.en: I've worked at that company for five years. Let me give you a piece of advice about the interview.
items.zh: 我在那家公司工作了五年。關於面試，我給你一個建議。

items.en: You asked about the price and the date. Let me answer that one first.
items.zh: 你問了價錢和日期。我先回答那個問題。

items.en: Call me if you need help with the move. Let me give you my phone number.
items.zh: 搬家需要幫忙就打給我。我給你我的電話號碼。

examples.heading: ③ Let me show / start

items.en: Welcome to the office on your first day. Let me show you where the kitchen and the meeting rooms are.
items.zh: 歡迎你第一天來上班。我帶你看廚房和會議室在哪裡。

items.en: The new coffee machine is a bit tricky. Let me show you how to use the machine.
items.zh: 新的咖啡機有點難用。我示範給你看這台機器怎麼用。

items.en: The manager opened the meeting. Let me start with the good news.
items.zh: 經理開始開會。我先說好消息。

items.en: The bride stood up to speak at the wedding. Let me start by saying thank you.
items.zh: 新娘在婚禮上站起來致詞。首先我要說聲謝謝。

items.en: You couldn't come in June, so let me show you the photos from our wedding.
items.zh: 你六月沒辦法來，所以我給你看看我們婚禮的照片。

examples.heading: ④ Let me think / see / check

items.en: You want me to move to Paris with you? Let me think about it.
items.zh: 你要我跟你搬去巴黎？讓我想一想。

items.en: The receptionist looked at her computer. Let me see. Your room is on the third floor.
items.zh: 櫃台人員看了看電腦。我看看，你的房間在三樓。

items.en: Lunch next week? Let me check my calendar.
items.zh: 下星期一起吃午餐？我查一下我的行事曆。

items.en: When did you last see your keys? Let me think. Was it Monday or Tuesday?
items.zh: 你最後一次看到你的鑰匙是什麼時候？我想想，是星期一還是星期二？

items.en: I'd love a day off on Friday. Let me check with my boss first.
items.zh: 我很想星期五請一天假。我先問一下我的老闆。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: This is my first time bringing family to the office party. Let me introduce my sister, Ann.
items.zh: 這是我第一次帶家人來公司派對。我來介紹我妹妹 Ann。

items.en: The meeting is nearly over. Let me say a few words about the project.
items.zh: 會議快結束了。我來說幾句關於這個專案的話。

items.en: You keep stopping me in the middle. Let me finish, please.
items.zh: 你一直在我說到一半的時候打斷我。請讓我把話說完。

items.en: The teacher looked at the class. Let me be clear about one thing. No phones in the exam.
items.zh: 老師看著全班。有一件事我要說清楚。考試不能用手機。

items.en: You look confused. Let me put it another way.
items.zh: 你看起來很困惑。我換個方式說。

items.en: I'm thinking of taking the flat. Let me ask you a quick question about the rent.
items.zh: 我在考慮租這間公寓。我問你一個關於房租的問題。

items.en: You've got three bags and an umbrella. Let me help you with that bag.
items.zh: 你拿了三個袋子和一把傘。我幫你提那個袋子。

items.en: You haven't seen any photos yet. Let me describe the house to you first.
items.zh: 你還沒看過照片。我先跟你描述一下那間房子。

items.en: You want to buy a present after work? Let me remind you that the shop closes at six.
items.zh: 你想下班後去買禮物？提醒你，那家店六點關門。

title: Let's not lose track of each other again!
translation: 我們別再失去聯絡了！
name: let's not 表示建議
sentences: It's a holiday. Let's not check our work emails.
It's half past eight, and the food is getting cold. Let's not wait for the others. They're not coming.
Look at the queue outside that café. Let's not go there. It's too crowded.
I worked ten hours today. Let's not eat out tonight. I'm tired.
The radio says the traffic is stopped. Let's not take the highway. There's an accident.
We might move to Spain next year. Let's not tell our parents until it's certain.
It was great to see you. Let's not wait ten years next time!
Last year we booked too late. Let's not do that again.
We only got the last two tickets for the show. Let's not leave it so late next time.
We fought about money all last week. Let's not have another argument.
We need to clean the spare room. Let's not forget that Grandma is coming on Friday.
Our daughter wants to go to the festival alone. Let's not forget that she's only sixteen.
Don't blame Tom for missing the start. Let's not forget that the bus was late too.
Our shop is doing well now. Let's not forget who helped us when we started.
The charity run was a big success. Let's not forget to thank the volunteers.
The plan is already hard to follow. Let's not make things more complicated.
The bank hasn't said yes to the loan. Let's not get too excited yet.
Dad only broke one plate. Let's not make a big deal of it.
We're sharing a flat for a whole year. Let's not get angry about small things.
We're both too tired to think clearly. Let's not make any decisions tonight.
A: Tom is late again. Shall we call him? B: No, let's not.
It's your birthday. Let's not open any bills today.
The exam results come out in August. Let's not worry about that now.
We're saving for a new car. Let's not spend too much on the party.
The kids have school tomorrow, so let's not watch the late film.
We've talked about the colour for an hour. Let's not waste any more time.
The train leaves at noon. Let's not rush. We have plenty of time.
People say the new boy started the fight. Let's not judge him before we hear his side.
It's getting late, and there are no lights up there. Let's not take the mountain road in the dark.
We both know the business is in trouble. Let's not pretend everything is fine.

examples.heading: ① Let's not + 原形動詞（日常建議）

items.en: It's a holiday. Let's not check our work emails.
items.zh: 今天放假，我們別看工作的電子郵件了。

items.en: It's half past eight, and the food is getting cold. Let's not wait for the others. They're not coming.
items.zh: 已經八點半了，菜都快涼了。我們別等其他人了，他們不會來了。

items.en: Look at the queue outside that café. Let's not go there. It's too crowded.
items.zh: 你看那家咖啡館外面的隊伍。我們別去那裡了，人太多。

items.en: I worked ten hours today. Let's not eat out tonight. I'm tired.
items.zh: 我今天工作了十個小時。今晚我們別出去吃了，我很累。

items.en: The radio says the traffic is stopped. Let's not take the highway. There's an accident.
items.zh: 廣播說車流停住了。我們別走高速公路，那裡有車禍。

items.en: We might move to Spain next year. Let's not tell our parents until it's certain.
items.zh: 我們明年可能會搬到西班牙。在確定之前，我們先別告訴我們的爸媽。

examples.heading: ② Let's not ... again / next time

items.en: It was great to see you. Let's not wait ten years next time!
items.zh: 很高興見到你，下次我們別再等十年了！

items.en: Last year we booked too late. Let's not do that again.
items.zh: 去年我們太晚訂了，別再那樣了。

items.en: We only got the last two tickets for the show. Let's not leave it so late next time.
items.zh: 我們只買到那場表演的最後兩張票。下次我們別拖到那麼晚。

items.en: We fought about money all last week. Let's not have another argument.
items.zh: 我們上星期整個星期都在為錢吵。我們別再吵架了。

examples.heading: ③ Let's not forget that ...

items.en: We need to clean the spare room. Let's not forget that Grandma is coming on Friday.
items.zh: 我們要打掃客房。我們別忘了，奶奶星期五要來。

items.en: Our daughter wants to go to the festival alone. Let's not forget that she's only sixteen.
items.zh: 我們的女兒想自己去音樂節。我們別忘了，她才十六歲。

items.en: Don't blame Tom for missing the start. Let's not forget that the bus was late too.
items.zh: 別怪湯姆錯過開頭。我們別忘了，公車也誤點了。

items.en: Our shop is doing well now. Let's not forget who helped us when we started.
items.zh: 我們的店現在生意很好。我們別忘了，我們剛起步時是誰幫了我們。

items.en: The charity run was a big success. Let's not forget to thank the volunteers.
items.zh: 慈善路跑很成功。我們別忘了感謝志工們。

examples.heading: ④ Let's not make ... / Let's not get ...

items.en: The plan is already hard to follow. Let's not make things more complicated.
items.zh: 這個計畫已經很難懂了。我們別把事情弄得更複雜。

items.en: The bank hasn't said yes to the loan. Let's not get too excited yet.
items.zh: 銀行還沒同意貸款。我們先別太興奮。

items.en: Dad only broke one plate. Let's not make a big deal of it.
items.zh: 爸爸只打破了一個盤子。我們別把這件事搞得太嚴重。

items.en: We're sharing a flat for a whole year. Let's not get angry about small things.
items.zh: 我們要合租一整年。我們別為了小事生氣。

items.en: We're both too tired to think clearly. Let's not make any decisions tonight.
items.zh: 我們兩個都累到沒辦法好好想。今晚我們先別做任何決定。

examples.heading: ⑤ 回應和不同的句型

items.en: A: Tom is late again. Shall we call him? B: No, let's not.
items.zh: A：湯姆又遲到了。我們要打給他嗎？B：不，別打了。

items.en: It's your birthday. Let's not open any bills today.
items.zh: 今天是你生日。我們今天別拆任何帳單。

items.en: The exam results come out in August. Let's not worry about that now.
items.zh: 考試成績八月才公布。我們現在先別擔心那件事。

items.en: We're saving for a new car. Let's not spend too much on the party.
items.zh: 我們在存錢買新車。派對我們別花太多錢。

items.en: The kids have school tomorrow, so let's not watch the late film.
items.zh: 孩子們明天要上學，所以我們別看晚場電影。

items.en: We've talked about the colour for an hour. Let's not waste any more time.
items.zh: 我們已經討論顏色討論了一個小時。我們別再浪費時間了。

items.en: The train leaves at noon. Let's not rush. We have plenty of time.
items.zh: 火車中午才開。我們別急，時間還很多。

items.en: People say the new boy started the fight. Let's not judge him before we hear his side.
items.zh: 大家說是那個新來的男生先打架的。在聽他的說法之前，我們別急著評斷他。

items.en: It's getting late, and there are no lights up there. Let's not take the mountain road in the dark.
items.zh: 時間晚了，山上又沒有路燈。天黑了，我們別走山路。

items.en: We both know the business is in trouble. Let's not pretend everything is fine.
items.zh: 我們兩個都知道生意出問題了。我們別假裝一切都沒事。

title: Let's meet at half past four.
translation: 我們四點半見吧。

It's our anniversary. Let's not talk about work tonight.

A: Let's go for a walk after dinner. B: Good idea!

Let's sit at the back so we can leave early.

examples.heading: ① Let's + 原形動詞（活動）

items.en: The shops open at ten tomorrow. Let's meet outside the bank at ten.
items.zh: 商店明天十點開門。我們十點在銀行外面碰面吧。

items.zh: 節慶星期五開始，我們去吧！

items.en: We have one free afternoon in Prague. Let's go to the old town. It's really pretty.
items.zh: 我們在布拉格有一個空閒的下午。我們去舊城區吧，那裡很漂亮。

items.en: The weather will be sunny this weekend. Let's have a picnic by the lake on Saturday.
items.zh: 這個週末天氣會很好。星期六我們去湖邊野餐吧。

items.en: It's the first day of the holidays, kids. Let's make pancakes for breakfast tomorrow.
items.zh: 孩子們，明天是放假第一天。我們明天早餐做鬆餅吧。

items.en: I've booked a court at the sports centre. Let's play tennis on Sunday.
items.zh: 我在運動中心訂了一個場地。我們星期天去打網球吧。

examples.heading: ② Let's + 原形動詞（安排和計畫）

items.en: Let's take the train. It's faster.
items.zh: 我們搭火車吧，比較快。

items.zh: 團隊每個人都會來吃晚餐。我們訂一張八人桌吧。

items.en: Ann loves the mountains. Let's ask her to come too.
items.zh: Ann 很愛山。我們也找她一起來吧。

items.en: Everyone is here, and it's ten o'clock. Let's start the meeting now.
items.zh: 大家都到了，已經十點了。我們現在開始開會吧。

items.en: Mum already has lots of books. Let's buy her flowers for her birthday.
items.zh: 媽媽已經有很多書了。我們買花送她當生日禮物吧。

examples.heading: ③ Let's + 原形動詞（解決問題）

items.en: It's pouring outside. Let's play a board game instead.
items.zh: 外面下大雨，我們改玩桌遊吧。

items.en: I'm hungry. Let's get something to eat.
items.zh: 我餓了，我們去買點東西吃吧。

items.en: We're lost. Let's ask someone.
items.zh: 我們迷路了，找個人問問吧。

items.en: The bus is late. Let's walk.
items.zh: 公車誤點了，我們用走的吧。

items.en: It's too hot. Let's go for a swim.
items.zh: 太熱了，我們去游泳吧。

examples.heading: ④ Let's not + 原形動詞
