items.zh: 我們別開車了，這個時間塞車很嚴重。

items.en: We have to get up early tomorrow. Let's not stay too long.
items.zh: 我們明天要早起。我們別待太久。

items.en: It's our anniversary. Let's not talk about work tonight.
items.zh: 今天是我們的紀念日。今晚我們別談工作了。

items.en: They'll be too excited to sleep. Let's not tell the kids about the trip yet.
items.zh: 他們會興奮到睡不著。我們先別跟孩子們說旅行的事。

items.en: It's only a film. Let's not argue about it.
items.zh: 那只是一部電影。我們別為這件事吵了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 回應和不同的句型

items.en: A: Let's go for a walk after dinner. B: Good idea!
items.zh: A：我們晚餐後去散步吧。B：好主意！

items.en: A: Let's order pizza. B: Yes, let's.
items.zh: A：我們叫披薩吧。B：好啊。

items.en: It's getting late. Let's head back to the hotel, shall we?
items.zh: 時間晚了，我們回飯店吧，好嗎？

items.en: We're too tired to go out. Let's see what's on TV.
items.zh: 我們累到不想出門。我們看看電視上在演什麼吧。

items.en: I'm bored of our usual place. Let's try the new café on the corner.
items.zh: 我吃膩了我們常去的那家。我們去試試轉角那家新咖啡店吧。

items.en: The doctor will have the results on Friday. Let's wait and see.
items.zh: 醫生星期五會拿到結果。我們等著看吧。

items.en: We didn't finish the plan today. Let's meet again next week.
items.zh: 我們今天沒做完計畫。我們下禮拜再見面吧。

items.en: Let's sit at the back so we can leave early.
items.zh: 我們坐後面吧，這樣可以早點走。

items.en: We've painted three rooms, and it's getting dark. Let's call it a day.
items.zh: 我們漆了三個房間，天快黑了。今天就到這裡吧。

title: Let them find their own food.
translation: 讓他們自己去找吃的。
name: let 加 him、her、them 把事情交給別人
sentences: They're old enough. Let them cook their own dinner.
The boys made all the mess. Let them clean the kitchen after the party.
The neighbours' kids kicked their ball through our glass. Let them pay for the broken window.
The twins are fighting about the TV again. Let them be. They'll stop arguing soon.
The new team can't agree on a plan. Let them work it out on their own.
They left without us at midnight. Let them find their own way home.
He lost the tickets, so let him find them.
He won't take advice. Let him find out for himself.
My brother spilt paint all over the floor. Let him clean up his own mess.
If he wants a new phone, let him buy it with his own money.
Tom sent the wrong file to the client. Let him explain it to the boss.
She doesn't want our help. Let her live alone if she wants.
It's her money, so let her spend it how she likes.
It's my sister's car, and it's her parking ticket. Let her deal with it.
Don't tell her the ending. Let her watch it and see.
She's twenty now. Let her plan her own holidays.
Don't give them the answer. Let the kids solve the puzzle on their own.
I've got forty tests to mark. Let the students check their own answers.
The customer is shouting at the till. Let the manager handle it.
We can't agree about the old bridge. Let the experts decide.
You walked the dog every day this week. Let your brother do it today.
Don't help him. Let him try first.
The builders know what they're doing. Just let them get on with it.
She packed too much. Let her carry the suitcase up the stairs.
The salesmen came without an appointment. Let them wait. We're busy.
The broken car is your dad's problem, not yours. Let him worry about that.
Don't tell the new students about the hard teacher. Let them find out for themselves.
Let him pay the parking fine. He parked there.
Don't feed her so much. Let the cat catch its own mice.
Your daughter chose the wrong course. Let her learn from her own mistakes.

examples.heading: ① Let them + 原形動詞

items.en: They're old enough. Let them cook their own dinner.
items.zh: 他們夠大了，讓他們自己煮晚餐。

items.en: The boys made all the mess. Let them clean the kitchen after the party.
items.zh: 那些男生弄得一團亂。派對後讓他們自己清廚房。

items.en: The neighbours' kids kicked their ball through our glass. Let them pay for the broken window.
items.zh: 鄰居的小孩把球踢破了我們的玻璃。讓他們賠那扇破掉的窗戶。

items.en: The twins are fighting about the TV again. Let them be. They'll stop arguing soon.
items.zh: 雙胞胎又在為電視吵架了。別管他們，他們很快就不吵了。

items.en: The new team can't agree on a plan. Let them work it out on their own.
items.zh: 新團隊對計畫意見不一。讓他們自己想辦法解決。

items.en: They left without us at midnight. Let them find their own way home.
items.zh: 他們半夜丟下我們就走了。讓他們自己找路回家。

examples.heading: ② Let him + 原形動詞

items.en: He lost the tickets, so let him find them.
items.zh: 票是他弄丟的，所以讓他自己去找。

items.en: He won't take advice. Let him find out for himself.
items.zh: 他不聽勸，就讓他自己去發現吧。

items.en: My brother spilt paint all over the floor. Let him clean up his own mess.
items.zh: 我弟弟把油漆灑得滿地都是。讓他自己收拾他的爛攤子。

items.en: If he wants a new phone, let him buy it with his own money.
items.zh: 如果他想要新手機，就讓他用自己的錢買。

items.en: Tom sent the wrong file to the client. Let him explain it to the boss.
items.zh: 湯姆把錯的檔案寄給客戶。讓他自己去跟老闆解釋。

examples.heading: ③ Let her + 原形動詞

items.en: She doesn't want our help. Let her live alone if she wants.
items.zh: 她不要我們幫忙，她想一個人住就讓她住吧。

items.en: It's her money, so let her spend it how she likes.
items.zh: 那是她的錢，讓她想怎麼花就怎麼花。

items.en: It's my sister's car, and it's her parking ticket. Let her deal with it.
items.zh: 那是我姊姊的車，也是她的停車罰單。讓她自己處理。

items.en: Don't tell her the ending. Let her watch it and see.
items.zh: 別告訴她結局，讓她自己看了就知道。

items.en: She's twenty now. Let her plan her own holidays.
items.zh: 她現在二十歲了，讓她自己安排假期。

examples.heading: ④ Let + 名詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Don't give them the answer. Let the kids solve the puzzle on their own.
items.zh: 別告訴他們答案。讓孩子們自己解謎題。

items.en: I've got forty tests to mark. Let the students check their own answers.
items.zh: 我有四十份考卷要改。讓學生自己對答案。

items.en: The customer is shouting at the till. Let the manager handle it.
items.zh: 那個客人在收銀台大吼。讓經理處理吧。

items.en: We can't agree about the old bridge. Let the experts decide.
items.zh: 我們對那座舊橋的事意見不一。讓專家決定吧。

items.en: You walked the dog every day this week. Let your brother do it today.
items.zh: 你這個星期每天都去遛狗。今天讓你哥哥去。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: Don't help him. Let him try first.
items.zh: 別幫他，讓他先試試看。

items.en: The builders know what they're doing. Just let them get on with it.
items.zh: 工人知道自己在做什麼。就讓他們自己做下去吧。

items.en: She packed too much. Let her carry the suitcase up the stairs.
items.zh: 她帶太多東西了，讓她自己把行李箱提上樓。

items.en: The salesmen came without an appointment. Let them wait. We're busy.
items.zh: 那些業務員沒有預約就來了。讓他們等吧，我們很忙。

items.en: The broken car is your dad's problem, not yours. Let him worry about that.
items.zh: 車子壞了是你爸爸的問題，不是你的。那件事讓他去擔心吧。

items.en: Don't tell the new students about the hard teacher. Let them find out for themselves.
items.zh: 別跟新生說那位嚴格老師的事。讓他們自己去發現。

items.en: Let him pay the parking fine. He parked there.
items.zh: 停車罰單讓他付，是他停在那裡的。

items.en: Don't feed her so much. Let the cat catch its own mice.
items.zh: 別餵牠那麼多。讓貓自己抓老鼠。

items.en: Your daughter chose the wrong course. Let her learn from her own mistakes.
items.zh: 你女兒選錯了課程。讓她從自己的錯誤中學習。

title: If she wants to study away from home, please let her go.
translation: 如果她想離家去外地讀書，就請讓她去吧。
name: let 加 him/her/them 表示允許
sentences: When you play cards with Grandpa, let him win now and then.
He's tired. Let him sleep.
Don't stop Grandpa in the middle. Let him finish his story.
If he wants to sing, let him sing.
Your son is twelve now. Let him choose his own clothes.
My nephew wants to ride the horse. Let him try it once.
If your daughter wants to join the band, let her join.
Your daughter is twenty and knows what she wants. Let her decide for herself.
She's hungry. Let her have the last piece.
Everyone is talking at once in the meeting. Let her speak.
Your niece found a puppy in the park. She loves animals, so let her keep it.
The students worked hard all week, so let them leave early today.
The kids are too noisy in the house. Let them play in the garden.
Let them stay up late tonight. It's New Year's Eve.
Your children are adults now. Let them make their own mistakes.
The guests are early, and they're waiting at the door. Let them come in. It's raining.
It's Friday, and there's no school tomorrow. Let the kids watch one more episode.
There's a storm, and he's scared. Let the dog sleep on the sofa tonight.
The project will be more fun that way. Let the students choose a topic.
It's just come off the stove. Let the soup cool down before you eat it.
You've played games for two hours. Let your sister use the computer.
My friend's daughter loves the zoo. Please let her come with us.
Your son is good at maths. Why don't you let him help you with the bills?
The cats are fighting again, but they'll stop soon. Just let them be.
Your brother's bike is broken. Let him borrow yours for the weekend.
Your mother just came home from hospital. Let her rest for a few days.
The new staff are still learning the system. Let them take their time.
Wait, children. Let the guests sit down first.
You paid for dinner last week. Let him pay this time.
The tourists want to see the old map. Let them have a look.

items.zh: 會議上大家同時在講話。讓她說話。

items.en: Your niece found a puppy in the park. She loves animals, so let her keep it.
items.zh: 你姪女在公園撿到一隻小狗。她喜歡動物，就讓她養吧。

examples.heading: ③ Let them + 原形動詞

items.en: The students worked hard all week, so let them leave early today.

items.zh: 這樣專題會比較有趣。讓學生自己選題目。

items.zh: 你已經打了兩個小時的電動。讓你妹妹用電腦。

items.zh: 我朋友的女兒很愛動物園。請讓她跟我們一起去。

items.zh: 你哥哥的腳踏車壞了。週末讓他借你的。

items.zh: 你媽媽剛出院回家。讓她休息幾天。

items.zh: 那些觀光客想看那張舊地圖。讓他們看一下。

title: You start at your house, go straight ahead, then turn right.
translation: 你從你家出發，一直往前走，然後右轉。
name: 表示先後順序的多個主要子句
sentences: The receptionist told us how to find the beach. Leave the hotel, walk down to the harbor, then follow the coast path.
Come to my party after school. Walk to the end of the street, turn right, and my house is on the left.
A tourist asked me for the post office. Take the third street, go straight, then turn left at the bakery.
My grandmother lives by the river. Get off the bus at the school, walk back a little, then cross the bridge.
Let's meet at Rosa's Café at three. Go past the park, take the second left, and the café is next to the post office.
The new dentist is easy to find. Turn right at the lights, go up the hill, then look for the red door.
The wedding is at the old hall. You leave the car park, go past the church, then take the first right.
A guard at the airport helped me find the trains. You go down these stairs, follow the signs, then take the exit.
My uncle explained the way to his farm. You leave the highway, drive for two kilometers, then stop at the gas station.
Here's how to get to my school from the airport. You get on the train, change at Taipei, then get off at the third stop.
Making these noodles is easy. Boil the water, add the noodles, then cook for three minutes.
Mum left me a note about dinner. Wash the rice, put it in the pot, and turn on the rice cooker.
Can you make the sandwiches for the picnic? Cut the bread, add some butter, then put the cheese on top.
The new bookshelf arrived today. Open the box, take out the parts, then read the instructions.
The IT man answered my call about the frozen screen. Turn off the computer, wait ten seconds, then turn it on again.
The receptionist at the clinic gave me a form. First fill in the form, then sign it, and then give it to the nurse.
Lunch is ready, children. First wash your hands, then take a plate, and then help yourself.
My son is taking the train alone for the first time. First buy a ticket, then go through the gate, and then wait on the platform.
The bank sent me an email about my account. First log in, then click on "Settings", and then change your password.
The sports centre is near my house. When you reach the school, turn left, then go up the hill.
Many people get lost on the way to our flat. Don't turn at the first corner, go to the second one, then turn right.
Welcome to our home! Come in, take off your shoes and sit down.
You can call the front desk from your room. Pick up the phone, press 1, then wait for an answer.
The taxi is here. Put on your coat, get your bag, and meet me at the door.
The art teacher showed the class how to make a snowflake. Fold the paper in half, cut along the line, then open it.
The hotel is near the station. Walk for five minutes, cross the river, and you'll see it.
Grandma taught me her pancake recipe. Mix the flour and eggs, add milk, then stir well.
You're the last one in the office tonight. Close the windows, lock the door, then switch off the lights.
The picnic is by the lake. Take this road, drive past the farm, then park near the water.
The teacher gave advice before the exam. Read the question, think for a moment, then write your answer.

examples.heading: ① 指路

items.en: The receptionist told us how to find the beach. Leave the hotel, walk down to the harbor, then follow the coast path.
items.zh: 櫃台人員告訴我們怎麼去海灘。離開飯店，走到港口，然後沿著海岸步道走。

items.en: Come to my party after school. Walk to the end of the street, turn right, and my house is on the left.
items.zh: 放學後來我的派對。走到街底，右轉，我家就在左邊。

items.en: A tourist asked me for the post office. Take the third street, go straight, then turn left at the bakery.
items.zh: 一個觀光客問我郵局在哪裡。走第三條街，直走，然後在麵包店左轉。

items.en: My grandmother lives by the river. Get off the bus at the school, walk back a little, then cross the bridge.
items.zh: 我奶奶住在河邊。在學校那站下公車，往回走一點，然後過橋。

items.en: Let's meet at Rosa's Café at three. Go past the park, take the second left, and the café is next to the post office.
items.zh: 我們三點在羅莎咖啡館見。經過公園，第二個路口左轉，咖啡店就在郵局旁邊。

items.en: The new dentist is easy to find. Turn right at the lights, go up the hill, then look for the red door.
items.zh: 新的牙醫診所很好找。在紅綠燈右轉，上坡，然後找紅色的門。

examples.heading: ② You + 動詞, + 動詞, + then + 動詞

items.en: The wedding is at the old hall. You leave the car park, go past the church, then take the first right.
items.zh: 婚禮在舊的禮堂。你出停車場，經過教堂，然後在第一個路口右轉。

items.en: A guard at the airport helped me find the trains. You go down these stairs, follow the signs, then take the exit.
items.zh: 機場的警衛幫我找火車。你走下這些樓梯，跟著指標走，然後從出口出去。

items.en: My uncle explained the way to his farm. You leave the highway, drive for two kilometers, then stop at the gas station.
items.zh: 我叔叔說明去他農場的路。你下高速公路，開兩公里，然後在加油站停下來。

items.en: Here's how to get to my school from the airport. You get on the train, change at Taipei, then get off at the third stop.
items.zh: 這是從機場到我學校的方法。你上火車，在台北轉車，然後在第三站下車。

examples.heading: ③ 做菜和做事的步驟

items.en: Making these noodles is easy. Boil the water, add the noodles, then cook for three minutes.
items.zh: 煮這種麵很簡單。把水煮滾，放入麵條，然後煮三分鐘。

items.en: Mum left me a note about dinner. Wash the rice, put it in the pot, and turn on the rice cooker.
items.zh: 媽媽留了一張晚餐的紙條給我。洗米，放進鍋子，然後打開電鍋。

items.en: Can you make the sandwiches for the picnic? Cut the bread, add some butter, then put the cheese on top.
items.zh: 你可以做野餐的三明治嗎？切麵包，抹點奶油，然後把起司放上去。

items.en: The new bookshelf arrived today. Open the box, take out the parts, then read the instructions.
items.zh: 新書架今天送到了。打開箱子，拿出零件，然後看說明書。

items.en: The IT man answered my call about the frozen screen. Turn off the computer, wait ten seconds, then turn it on again.
items.zh: 電腦人員接了我打去問當機的電話。關掉電腦，等十秒，然後再打開。

examples.heading: ④ first ... then ... and then

items.en: The receptionist at the clinic gave me a form. First fill in the form, then sign it, and then give it to the nurse.
items.zh: 診所的櫃台人員給我一張表格。先填表格，然後簽名，再交給護理師。

items.en: Lunch is ready, children. First wash your hands, then take a plate, and then help yourself.
items.zh: 孩子們，午餐好了。先洗手，然後拿盤子，再自己取用。

items.en: My son is taking the train alone for the first time. First buy a ticket, then go through the gate, and then wait on the platform.
items.zh: 我兒子第一次自己搭火車。先買票，然後過閘門，再到月台等。

items.en: The bank sent me an email about my account. First log in, then click on "Settings", and then change your password.
items.zh: 銀行寄了一封關於我帳戶的電子郵件。先登入，然後點設定，再改密碼。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: The sports centre is near my house. When you reach the school, turn left, then go up the hill.
items.zh: 運動中心在我家附近。到學校的時候左轉，然後上坡。

items.en: Many people get lost on the way to our flat. Don't turn at the first corner, go to the second one, then turn right.
items.zh: 很多人來我們公寓的路上會迷路。第一個轉角不要轉，走到第二個，然後右轉。

items.en: Welcome to our home! Come in, take off your shoes and sit down.
items.zh: 歡迎來我們家！進來，脫鞋，坐下。

items.en: You can call the front desk from your room. Pick up the phone, press 1, then wait for an answer.
items.zh: 你可以從房間打電話到櫃台。拿起電話，按 1，然後等人接聽。

items.en: The taxi is here. Put on your coat, get your bag, and meet me at the door.
items.zh: 計程車到了。穿上外套，拿好包包，到門口跟我會合。

items.en: The art teacher showed the class how to make a snowflake. Fold the paper in half, cut along the line, then open it.
items.zh: 美術老師教全班怎麼做雪花。把紙對折，沿著線剪，然後打開。

items.en: The hotel is near the station. Walk for five minutes, cross the river, and you'll see it.
items.zh: 飯店在車站附近。走五分鐘，過河，你就會看到它了。

items.en: Grandma taught me her pancake recipe. Mix the flour and eggs, add milk, then stir well.
items.zh: 奶奶教我做她的鬆餅。把麵粉和蛋混在一起，加牛奶，然後攪拌均勻。

items.en: You're the last one in the office tonight. Close the windows, lock the door, then switch off the lights.
items.zh: 你今天晚上是辦公室最後一個人。關窗，鎖門，然後關燈。

items.en: The picnic is by the lake. Take this road, drive past the farm, then park near the water.
items.zh: 野餐在湖邊。走這條路，開過農場，然後把車停在水邊。

items.en: The teacher gave advice before the exam. Read the question, think for a moment, then write your answer.
items.zh: 老師在考試前給了建議。讀題目，想一下，然後寫答案。

title: Larry decided to tell his mother the truth, but then she showed him his suitcase.
translation: Larry 決定把實話告訴他媽媽，可是接著她把他的行李箱拿給他看。
name: 敘事中連接多個主要子句
sentences: We checked into the hotel, and then we had a swim.
I was alone in the house that night. The phone rang, and then the lights went out.
He finished his work, turned off the lights, and then he went home.
My uncle stood up to give a speech at the wedding. He knocked over his glass, and everyone started to laugh.
My friends came over on Friday. We had dinner, and then we watched a film.
The lift was broken, so we took the stairs, and then we were out of breath.
Monday was a bad day. My alarm didn't go off, so I missed my first class.
The keys were still missing, so Dad decided to call a locksmith.
I was hungry, so I made a sandwich, and then I felt better.
It was the hottest day of the summer. The pool was full, so the kids played in the park instead.
The printer broke, so I wrote it by hand, but nobody could read it.
It was snowing on the night of my birthday. I made dinner for six, but only two friends came.
My brother woke up and ran to the bathroom. He thought he was late, but then he saw the clock. It was only five.
I tried on a blue dress in the shop. I wanted to buy the dress, but then I saw the price.
We scored in the first five minutes. The game started well, but then it began to snow.
You look tired, but it's your choice. Go to the concert, or stay home and rest.
The next bus is in forty minutes. We can wait here, or we can take a taxi.
I need your answer about the trip. Call me tonight, or send me a message tomorrow.
I don't know that word either. You could ask your teacher, or you could look it up online.
My phone died, so I couldn't call anyone, and then I got lost.
We got to the airport early, but the flight was late, so we had lunch.
It started to rain, so we ran into a café, and there we met an old friend.
Ann made a cake, but she forgot the sugar, so nobody ate it.
I studied all night, but I was so tired that I fell asleep in the exam.
The car broke down, so we called for help, and then we waited for two hours.
The postman had a parcel for us. He knocked on the door, but nobody answered, so he left a note.
We got lost, so we asked a farmer, but he didn't speak English.
Someone left the gate open. The dog ran into the garden, and then it dug a big hole.
My sister wanted to cancel lunch. She called her friend, but the line was busy, so she sent a text.
We found the hotel, but our room wasn't ready, so we went for a walk.

examples.heading: ① and / and then

items.en: We checked into the hotel, and then we had a swim.
items.zh: 我們辦好飯店入住，接著去游了泳。

items.en: I was alone in the house that night. The phone rang, and then the lights went out.
items.zh: 那天晚上我一個人在家。電話響了，接著燈就熄了。

items.en: He finished his work, turned off the lights, and then he went home.
items.zh: 他做完工作，關了燈，接著回家了。

items.en: My uncle stood up to give a speech at the wedding. He knocked over his glass, and everyone started to laugh.
items.zh: 我叔叔在婚禮上站起來致詞。他打翻了他的杯子，大家都笑了起來。

items.en: My friends came over on Friday. We had dinner, and then we watched a film.
items.zh: 我的朋友們星期五來我家。我們吃了晚餐，接著看了一部電影。

examples.heading: ② so

items.en: The lift was broken, so we took the stairs, and then we were out of breath.
items.zh: 電梯壞了，所以我們走樓梯，結果喘不過氣來。

items.en: Monday was a bad day. My alarm didn't go off, so I missed my first class.
items.zh: 星期一很倒楣。我的鬧鐘沒響，所以我錯過了第一堂課。

items.en: The keys were still missing, so Dad decided to call a locksmith.
items.zh: 鑰匙還是找不到，所以爸爸決定叫鎖匠。

items.en: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich, and then I felt better.
items.zh: 我餓了，所以做了一個三明治，吃完就覺得好多了。

items.en: It was the hottest day of the summer. The pool was full, so the kids played in the park instead.
items.zh: 那是夏天最熱的一天。游泳池人滿了，所以孩子們改去公園玩。

examples.heading: ③ but / but then

items.en: The printer broke, so I wrote it by hand, but nobody could read it.
items.zh: 印表機壞了，所以我用手寫，可是沒人看得懂。

items.en: It was snowing on the night of my birthday. I made dinner for six, but only two friends came.
items.zh: 我生日那天晚上在下雪。我做了六人份的晚餐，可是只來了兩個朋友。

items.en: My brother woke up and ran to the bathroom. He thought he was late, but then he saw the clock. It was only five.
items.zh: 我哥哥醒來就衝進浴室。他以為自己遲到了，可是接著他看到了時鐘。才五點而已。

items.en: I tried on a blue dress in the shop. I wanted to buy the dress, but then I saw the price.
items.zh: 我在店裡試穿了一件藍色洋裝。我想買那件洋裝，可是接著我看到了價錢。

items.en: We scored in the first five minutes. The game started well, but then it began to snow.
items.zh: 我們在前五分鐘就進球了。比賽開始時很順利，可是接著開始下雪了。

examples.heading: ④ or

items.en: You look tired, but it's your choice. Go to the concert, or stay home and rest.
items.zh: 你看起來很累，不過你自己決定。去聽演唱會，或是待在家休息。

items.en: The next bus is in forty minutes. We can wait here, or we can take a taxi.
items.zh: 下一班公車還要四十分鐘。我們可以在這裡等，或是搭計程車。

items.en: I need your answer about the trip. Call me tonight, or send me a message tomorrow.
items.zh: 我需要你回覆旅行的事。今晚打給我，或是明天傳訊息給我。

items.en: I don't know that word either. You could ask your teacher, or you could look it up online.
items.zh: 我也不知道那個字。你可以問老師，或是上網查。

examples.heading: ⑤ 長一點的敘述

items.en: My phone died, so I couldn't call anyone, and then I got lost.
items.zh: 我的手機沒電了，所以沒辦法打給任何人，接著我就迷路了。

items.en: We got to the airport early, but the flight was late, so we had lunch.
items.zh: 我們很早到機場，可是班機誤點，所以我們吃了午餐。

items.en: It started to rain, so we ran into a café, and there we met an old friend.
items.zh: 開始下雨了，所以我們跑進一家咖啡店，在那裡遇到一個老朋友。

items.en: Ann made a cake, but she forgot the sugar, so nobody ate it.
items.zh: Ann 做了蛋糕，可是忘了加糖，所以沒人吃。

items.en: I studied all night, but I was so tired that I fell asleep in the exam.
items.zh: 我熬夜讀書，可是太累了，考試時睡著了。

items.en: The car broke down, so we called for help, and then we waited for two hours.
items.zh: 車子拋錨了，所以我們打電話求救，接著等了兩個小時。

items.en: The postman had a parcel for us. He knocked on the door, but nobody answered, so he left a note.
items.zh: 郵差有一個我們的包裹。他敲了門，可是沒人應，所以他留了一張紙條。

items.en: We got lost, so we asked a farmer, but he didn't speak English.
items.zh: 我們迷路了，所以問了一個農夫，可是他不會說英文。

items.en: Someone left the gate open. The dog ran into the garden, and then it dug a big hole.
items.zh: 有人沒關大門。那隻狗跑進花園，接著挖了一個大洞。

items.en: My sister wanted to cancel lunch. She called her friend, but the line was busy, so she sent a text.
items.zh: 我姊姊想取消午餐。她打給朋友，可是電話忙線，所以她傳了簡訊。

items.en: We found the hotel, but our room wasn't ready, so we went for a walk.
items.zh: 我們找到了飯店，可是房間還沒準備好，所以我們去散步。

title: Don't tell Lucy, please.
translation: 拜託不要跟 Lucy 說。
name: 表示勸告、指示和命令的否定祈使句
sentences: Don't worry about the bill. I'll pay.
Your maths exam is at nine tomorrow. Don't stay up too late before the exam.
Don't buy that phone. It breaks easily.
Have a light lunch today. Don't eat too much before you swim.
Stop at the next service station for a coffee. Don't drive when you're sleepy.
Don't trust every review you see on that website.
Don't tell Mom about the broken vase, please.
The guard spoke to two boys on the train. Please don't put your feet on the seats.
I want to hear about your first day. Don't forget to call me tonight.
I know you have an early flight. Please don't leave without saying goodbye.
Grandma is cooking tonight, so don't come home late.
Here's a present from Grandma. Don't open the box until your birthday.
The tomatoes are already sweet. Don't add sugar to the sauce.
The bank needs a clear copy. Don't use a pencil on the form.
That's the emergency stop for the lift. Don't press the red button.
Don't turn left here. Go straight.
Don't touch the iron. I've just used it.
The floor is wet, children. Don't run in the hall.
Don't swim here. The water is deep.
Bread makes ducks ill. Don't feed the ducks bread.
We heard an announcement on the platform. Do not leave bags unattended in the station.
Don't be shy. Come and say hello.
Don't be sad. You'll see her again soon.
Don't be nervous. The interviewer is very friendly.
Don't be cross with your sister. She didn't break it on purpose.
Don't panic! I've got the tickets.
Don't give up. You're nearly there.
I asked for a little off the top, but look at it. Don't laugh at my new haircut!
Don't wait for me. Start eating.
Don't make so much noise. The baby's asleep.

examples.heading: ① 勸告

items.en: Don't worry about the bill. I'll pay.
items.zh: 帳單別擔心，我來付。

items.en: Your maths exam is at nine tomorrow. Don't stay up too late before the exam.
items.zh: 你的數學考試明天九點。考試前別熬夜熬太晚。

items.en: Don't buy that phone. It breaks easily.
items.zh: 別買那支手機，很容易壞。

items.en: Have a light lunch today. Don't eat too much before you swim.
items.zh: 今天午餐吃清淡一點。游泳前別吃太多。

items.en: Stop at the next service station for a coffee. Don't drive when you're sleepy.
items.zh: 在下一個休息站停下來喝杯咖啡。想睡的時候別開車。

items.en: Don't trust every review you see on that website.
items.zh: 別相信那個網站上的每一則評論。

examples.heading: ② 拜託和請求

items.en: Don't tell Mom about the broken vase, please.
items.zh: 拜託別跟媽媽說花瓶破了的事。

items.en: The guard spoke to two boys on the train. Please don't put your feet on the seats.
items.zh: 列車員跟火車上兩個男孩說話。請不要把腳放在座位上。

items.en: I want to hear about your first day. Don't forget to call me tonight.
items.zh: 我想聽聽你第一天的情況。別忘了今晚打給我。

items.en: I know you have an early flight. Please don't leave without saying goodbye.
items.zh: 我知道你要搭早班飛機。請不要沒說再見就走。

items.en: Grandma is cooking tonight, so don't come home late.
items.zh: 奶奶今晚要煮飯，所以別太晚回家。

examples.heading: ③ 指示

items.en: Here's a present from Grandma. Don't open the box until your birthday.
items.zh: 這是奶奶送的禮物。生日以前別打開這個盒子。

items.en: The tomatoes are already sweet. Don't add sugar to the sauce.
items.zh: 番茄已經很甜了。醬汁裡別加糖。

items.en: The bank needs a clear copy. Don't use a pencil on the form.
items.zh: 銀行需要清楚的副本。填表格時別用鉛筆。

items.en: That's the emergency stop for the lift. Don't press the red button.
items.zh: 那是電梯的緊急停止按鈕。別按紅色的按鈕。

items.en: Don't turn left here. Go straight.
items.zh: 這裡別左轉，直走。

examples.heading: ④ 禁止和警告

items.en: Don't touch the iron. I've just used it.
items.zh: 別碰熨斗，我剛用過。

items.en: The floor is wet, children. Don't run in the hall.
items.zh: 孩子們，地板是濕的。走廊上不要跑。

items.en: Don't swim here. The water is deep.
items.zh: 別在這裡游泳，水很深。

items.en: Bread makes ducks ill. Don't feed the ducks bread.
items.zh: 麵包會讓鴨子生病。別餵鴨子吃麵包。

items.en: We heard an announcement on the platform. Do not leave bags unattended in the station.
items.zh: 我們在月台上聽到廣播。請勿在車站內放置無人看管的行李。

examples.heading: ⑤ Don't be + 形容詞 和不同的句型

items.en: Don't be shy. Come and say hello.
items.zh: 別害羞，過來打招呼。

items.en: Don't be sad. You'll see her again soon.
items.zh: 別難過，你很快就會再見到她。

items.en: Don't be nervous. The interviewer is very friendly.
items.zh: 別緊張，面試官人很好。

items.en: Don't be cross with your sister. She didn't break it on purpose.
items.zh: 別對你妹妹生氣，她不是故意弄壞的。

items.en: Don't panic! I've got the tickets.
items.zh: 別慌！票在我這裡。

items.en: Don't give up. You're nearly there.
items.zh: 別放棄，你快成功了。

items.en: I asked for a little off the top, but look at it. Don't laugh at my new haircut!
items.zh: 我只說頭頂剪一點，可是你看。別笑我的新髮型！

items.en: Don't wait for me. Start eating.
items.zh: 別等我，你們先吃。

items.en: Don't make so much noise. The baby's asleep.
items.zh: 別那麼吵，寶寶睡著了。

title: That night Kevin did not sleep; nor did Kristin.
translation: 那天晚上 Kevin 沒睡，Kristin 也沒睡。
name: 否定子句後接 nor 倒裝子句
sentences: On the last night of the trip, I didn't sleep well; nor did my roommate.
The police asked us about the crash at the corner. I didn't see the accident, nor did my friend.
Don't make an omelette for breakfast. My brother doesn't eat eggs, nor does my dad.
A visitor asked a hard question about the old castle. The teacher didn't know the answer, nor did the students.
I'm the first in my family with a degree. My parents never went to university, nor did my grandparents.
I complained to the waiter. The coffee wasn't hot, nor was the soup.
It was a holiday, but we didn't know. The shop wasn't open, nor was the bank.
We had a big lunch at Grandma's. I'm not hungry, nor is Ann.
My driving lessons were hard. The first test wasn't easy, nor was the second.
Take a taxi home after the concert. The road isn't safe at night, nor is the park.
We live next to the station. We don't have a car, nor do we need one.
Can I have some juice, please? I don't drink tea, nor do I like coffee.
My daughter was out until two. She didn't text, nor did she email.
Someone called me at midnight. I didn't know the caller, nor did I recognize the number.
My grandmother lives alone at ninety. She never complains, nor does she ask for help.
He only started school last month. My son can't read yet, nor can he write.
The company closed our factory without warning. We won't forget, nor will we forgive.
My neighbour broke my window a month ago. He hasn't paid, nor has he said sorry.
The hotel has strict rules. Guests can't bring pets, nor can they smoke in the rooms.
Our guests were due at seven. They haven't arrived yet, nor have they called.
The council wants a new bridge over the river. The plan isn't cheap, nor is it easy.
We'd love to see Kyoto one day. I have never been to Japan, nor has my brother.
The landlord didn't fix the heater, nor did he answer our emails.
I didn't know the meeting was moved. Nobody told me, nor did I ask.
We left the cinema early. The film wasn't funny, nor was it exciting.
Our cousins had a big wedding. We didn't get an invitation, nor did we want one.
We stayed in the tent all weekend. The rain didn't stop, nor did the wind.
The nurse worked a double shift. She hadn't eaten all day, nor had she slept.
You want to close the library on Saturdays? I don't agree with you, nor does anyone else here.
My aunt sent me a birthday letter and a parcel from Canada. The letter never arrived, nor did the parcel.

examples.heading: ① nor + 助動詞 + 不同的主詞

items.en: On the last night of the trip, I didn't sleep well; nor did my roommate.
items.zh: 旅行最後一晚我沒睡好，我室友也沒有。

items.en: The police asked us about the crash at the corner. I didn't see the accident, nor did my friend.
items.zh: 警察問我們轉角那場車禍的事。我沒看到那場車禍，我朋友也沒看到。

items.en: Don't make an omelette for breakfast. My brother doesn't eat eggs, nor does my dad.
items.zh: 早餐別做歐姆蛋。我哥哥不吃蛋，我爸爸也不吃。

items.en: A visitor asked a hard question about the old castle. The teacher didn't know the answer, nor did the students.
items.zh: 一個訪客問了一個關於古堡的難題。老師不知道答案，學生也不知道。

items.en: I'm the first in my family with a degree. My parents never went to university, nor did my grandparents.
items.zh: 我是家裡第一個有學位的人。我爸媽沒讀過大學，我爺爺奶奶也沒有。

examples.heading: ② nor + be + 主詞

items.en: I complained to the waiter. The coffee wasn't hot, nor was the soup.
items.zh: 我跟服務生抱怨。咖啡不熱，湯也不熱。

items.en: It was a holiday, but we didn't know. The shop wasn't open, nor was the bank.
items.zh: 那天是假日，可是我們不知道。那家店沒開，銀行也沒開。

items.en: We had a big lunch at Grandma's. I'm not hungry, nor is Ann.
items.zh: 我們在奶奶家吃了很豐盛的午餐。我不餓，Ann 也不餓。

items.en: My driving lessons were hard. The first test wasn't easy, nor was the second.
items.zh: 我的開車課很難。第一次考試不簡單，第二次也不簡單。

items.en: Take a taxi home after the concert. The road isn't safe at night, nor is the park.
items.zh: 音樂會結束後搭計程車回家。那條路晚上不安全，公園也不安全。

examples.heading: ③ nor + 助動詞 + 同一個主詞 + 不同的動作

items.en: We live next to the station. We don't have a car, nor do we need one.
items.zh: 我們住在車站旁邊。我們沒有車，也不需要。

items.en: Can I have some juice, please? I don't drink tea, nor do I like coffee.
items.zh: 可以給我一點果汁嗎？我不喝茶，也不喜歡咖啡。

items.en: My daughter was out until two. She didn't text, nor did she email.
items.zh: 我女兒在外面待到兩點。她沒傳簡訊，也沒寄電子郵件。

items.en: Someone called me at midnight. I didn't know the caller, nor did I recognize the number.
items.zh: 半夜有人打給我。我不認識打來的人，也不認得那個號碼。

items.en: My grandmother lives alone at ninety. She never complains, nor does she ask for help.
items.zh: 我奶奶九十歲了還一個人住。她從不抱怨，也從不求助。

examples.heading: ④ nor + can / will / have + 主詞

items.en: He only started school last month. My son can't read yet, nor can he write.
items.zh: 他上個月才開始上學。我兒子還不會讀，也不會寫。

items.en: The company closed our factory without warning. We won't forget, nor will we forgive.
items.zh: 公司沒有預告就關了我們的工廠。我們不會忘記，也不會原諒。

items.en: My neighbour broke my window a month ago. He hasn't paid, nor has he said sorry.
items.zh: 我的鄰居一個月前打破了我的窗戶。他沒付錢，也沒道歉。

items.en: The hotel has strict rules. Guests can't bring pets, nor can they smoke in the rooms.
items.zh: 那家飯店的規定很嚴格。客人不能帶寵物，也不能在房間抽菸。

items.en: Our guests were due at seven. They haven't arrived yet, nor have they called.
items.zh: 我們的客人七點應該要到。他們還沒到，也沒打電話來。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: The council wants a new bridge over the river. The plan isn't cheap, nor is it easy.
items.zh: 市議會想在河上蓋一座新橋。這個計畫不便宜，也不容易。

items.en: We'd love to see Kyoto one day. I have never been to Japan, nor has my brother.
items.zh: 我們希望有一天能去京都看看。我沒去過日本，我哥哥也沒去過。

items.en: The landlord didn't fix the heater, nor did he answer our emails.
items.zh: 房東沒修暖氣，也沒回我們的電子郵件。

items.en: I didn't know the meeting was moved. Nobody told me, nor did I ask.
items.zh: 我不知道會議改時間了。沒人告訴我，我也沒問。

items.en: We left the cinema early. The film wasn't funny, nor was it exciting.
items.zh: 我們提早離開電影院。那部電影不好笑，也不刺激。

items.en: Our cousins had a big wedding. We didn't get an invitation, nor did we want one.
items.zh: 我們的表親辦了盛大的婚禮。我們沒收到邀請，也不想要。

items.en: We stayed in the tent all weekend. The rain didn't stop, nor did the wind.
items.zh: 我們整個週末都待在帳篷裡。雨沒停，風也沒停。

items.en: The nurse worked a double shift. She hadn't eaten all day, nor had she slept.
items.zh: 那位護理師連上了兩班。她一整天沒吃東西，也沒睡覺。

items.en: You want to close the library on Saturdays? I don't agree with you, nor does anyone else here.
items.zh: 你想讓圖書館星期六關門？我不同意你，這裡也沒有別人同意。

items.en: My aunt sent me a birthday letter and a parcel from Canada. The letter never arrived, nor did the parcel.
items.zh: 我阿姨從加拿大寄了生日信和包裹給我。那封信一直沒到，包裹也沒到。

title: Wouldn't it be wonderful!
translation: 那該有多好啊！
name: 否定疑問句表示驚訝或熱切
sentences: Wouldn't it be wonderful to live by the sea!
Wouldn't it be nice to have a whole week off!
Wouldn't it be great if we all went together!
Wouldn't it be fun to learn to dance!
Wouldn't it be lovely to see the northern lights!
Look at the view! Isn't it beautiful!
Isn't that amazing! She's only six.
Isn't this cake delicious!
Blue sky and no wind. Isn't it a perfect day for sailing!
Aren't they cute!
A weekend in the mountains? Doesn't that sound perfect?
Doesn't she look happy!
Doesn't this smell good!
Doesn't the garden look lovely in spring!
Don't you just love this song!
Didn't we have a great time in Paris!
Wasn't that a fantastic concert!
Wasn't the seafood at that little harbor restaurant amazing!
Didn't the choir sound wonderful at the wedding!
Weren't the kids good today!
Wouldn't you love to visit Japan!
Isn't it strange how quiet the town is today!
Hasn't she grown!
Won't it be nice to see everyone again!
Isn't it lucky the shop was still open!
Doesn't time fly!
Top of the class! Haven't you worked hard this year!
Isn't it a shame they can't come!
Wouldn't it be amazing to see the band play live!
Don't you look smart in your new uniform!

examples.heading: ① Wouldn't it be + 形容詞

items.en: Wouldn't it be wonderful to live by the sea!
items.zh: 住在海邊該有多好啊！

items.en: Wouldn't it be nice to have a whole week off!
items.zh: 能放一整個禮拜的假該有多好！

items.en: Wouldn't it be great if we all went together!
items.zh: 如果我們大家一起去，那該有多棒！

items.en: Wouldn't it be fun to learn to dance!
items.zh: 學跳舞該有多好玩！

items.en: Wouldn't it be lovely to see the northern lights!
items.zh: 能看到北極光該有多好！

examples.heading: ② Isn't it / Isn't that + 形容詞

items.en: Look at the view! Isn't it beautiful!
items.zh: 你看那景色！真美啊！

items.en: Isn't that amazing! She's only six.
items.zh: 太厲害了吧！她才六歲。

items.en: Isn't this cake delicious!
items.zh: 這蛋糕真好吃！

items.en: Blue sky and no wind. Isn't it a perfect day for sailing!
items.zh: 藍天又沒風，今天真適合出海！

items.en: Aren't they cute!
items.zh: 他們好可愛啊！

examples.heading: ③ Doesn't that sound / look ...?

items.en: A weekend in the mountains? Doesn't that sound perfect?
items.zh: 去山上過週末？你不覺得聽起來很完美嗎？

items.en: Doesn't she look happy!
items.zh: 她看起來好開心啊！

items.en: Doesn't this smell good!
items.zh: 這聞起來好香啊！

items.en: Doesn't the garden look lovely in spring!
items.zh: 花園春天看起來好漂亮啊！

items.en: Don't you just love this song!
items.zh: 你不覺得這首歌超棒嗎！

examples.heading: ④ Didn't we / Wasn't it ...!

items.en: Didn't we have a great time in Paris!
items.zh: 我們在巴黎玩得真開心啊！

items.en: Wasn't that a fantastic concert!
items.zh: 那場演唱會真是太精彩了！

items.en: Wasn't the seafood at that little harbor restaurant amazing!
items.zh: 港口那家小餐廳的海鮮真是太好吃了！

items.en: Didn't the choir sound wonderful at the wedding!
items.zh: 婚禮上的合唱團唱得真好聽啊！

items.en: Weren't the kids good today!
items.zh: 孩子們今天真乖啊！

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: Wouldn't you love to visit Japan!
items.zh: 你不會很想去日本嗎！

items.en: Isn't it strange how quiet the town is today!
items.zh: 今天鎮上這麼安靜，好奇怪啊！

items.en: Hasn't she grown!
items.zh: 她長這麼大了！

items.en: Won't it be nice to see everyone again!
items.zh: 能再見到大家該有多好！

items.en: Isn't it lucky the shop was still open!
items.zh: 還好那家店還開著！

items.en: Doesn't time fly!
items.zh: 時間過得真快啊！

items.en: Top of the class! Haven't you worked hard this year!
items.zh: 全班第一！你今年真的好用功！

items.en: Isn't it a shame they can't come!
items.zh: 他們不能來，真可惜！

items.en: Wouldn't it be amazing to see the band play live!
items.zh: 能看那個樂團現場演出該有多棒！

items.en: Don't you look smart in your new uniform!
items.zh: 你穿新制服真帥氣！

title: They neither got married nor had children.
translation: 他們既沒有結婚，也沒有生小孩。
name: neither … nor 連接子句
sentences: My uncle left home at fifteen. He neither finished school nor learned a trade.
My birthday was last week. My cousin neither phoned nor sent a card.
The nurse gave my son two injections. He neither cried nor complained.
The police asked about the robbery next door. We neither saw nor heard anything.
I returned the broken lamp a month ago. The shop neither replied to my email nor sent the money back.
The road to the mountains was very bumpy. We neither slept nor rested on the night bus.
We take the bus everywhere. We neither own a car nor ride bikes.
He's ninety and still walks every day. My grandfather neither smokes nor drinks.
My flatmate leaves everything to me. She neither cooks nor cleans at home.
I'm taking it back to the shop. The new phone neither looks good nor works well.
My brother doesn't know about the election. He neither reads the news nor watches TV.
The school nurse gave the parents some advice. Children should neither skip breakfast nor eat too many sweets.
A police officer knocked on my car window. You can neither park nor stop here.
I saw a bear on the path in front of me. I could neither move nor speak.
The builders damaged our wall. They will neither pay nor apologize.
Our son is only nine months old. He can neither walk nor talk yet.
My old boss offered me a part-time job. I neither wanted the job nor needed the money.
We stayed there for five nights. The hotel neither cleaned our room nor changed the towels.
I went to my sister's flat after work. She neither answered the door nor picked up the phone.
I had a bad cough for two weeks. The doctor neither gave me medicine nor told me to rest.
Our guests never came to dinner. Neither did they call, nor did they send a message.
Our neighbours' tree fell on our car. Neither did they help, nor did they say sorry.
I asked my boss for a pay rise. She neither agreed nor said no.
The new teacher had a hard first day. The children neither listened nor sat still.
My ex-boyfriend left town last month. I neither know nor care where he went.
The manager wants to change the delivery routes. But the plan neither saves time nor cuts costs.
A reporter asked the actor about his secret wedding. He neither confirmed nor denied the story.
The score was two all at the end. We neither won nor lost; it was a draw.
I posted a letter to my aunt in Peru in May. The letter neither arrived nor came back.
My old friends moved to Spain ten years ago. They neither visited us nor invited us to their wedding.

examples.heading: ① 過去式

items.en: My uncle left home at fifteen. He neither finished school nor learned a trade.
items.zh: 我叔叔十五歲就離家了。他既沒讀完書，也沒學一技之長。

items.en: My birthday was last week. My cousin neither phoned nor sent a card.
items.zh: 我的生日在上星期。我表哥既沒打電話，也沒寄卡片。

items.en: The nurse gave my son two injections. He neither cried nor complained.
items.zh: 護理師幫我兒子打了兩針。他既沒哭，也沒抱怨。

items.en: The police asked about the robbery next door. We neither saw nor heard anything.
items.zh: 警察問隔壁搶案的事。我們什麼都沒看到，也沒聽到。

items.en: I returned the broken lamp a month ago. The shop neither replied to my email nor sent the money back.
items.zh: 我一個月前退回那盞壞掉的燈。那家店既沒回我的電子郵件，也沒退錢。

items.en: The road to the mountains was very bumpy. We neither slept nor rested on the night bus.
items.zh: 去山上的路很顛簸。在夜車上我們既沒睡，也沒休息。

examples.heading: ② 現在式

items.en: We take the bus everywhere. We neither own a car nor ride bikes.
items.zh: 我們去哪裡都搭公車。我們既沒有車，也不騎腳踏車。

items.en: He's ninety and still walks every day. My grandfather neither smokes nor drinks.
items.zh: 他九十歲了，還每天走路。我爺爺既不抽菸，也不喝酒。

items.en: My flatmate leaves everything to me. She neither cooks nor cleans at home.
items.zh: 我室友什麼都丟給我。她在家既不煮飯，也不打掃。

items.en: I'm taking it back to the shop. The new phone neither looks good nor works well.
items.zh: 我要把它拿回店裡。那支新手機既不好看，也不好用。

items.en: My brother doesn't know about the election. He neither reads the news nor watches TV.
items.zh: 我哥哥不知道選舉的事。他既不看新聞，也不看電視。

examples.heading: ③ 助動詞 + neither + 動詞 + nor + 動詞

items.en: The school nurse gave the parents some advice. Children should neither skip breakfast nor eat too many sweets.
items.zh: 學校護理師給家長一些建議。小孩既不該不吃早餐，也不該吃太多甜食。

items.en: A police officer knocked on my car window. You can neither park nor stop here.
items.zh: 一個警察敲了我的車窗。這裡既不能停車，也不能暫停。

items.en: I saw a bear on the path in front of me. I could neither move nor speak.
items.zh: 我看到前面的小路上有一隻熊。我既動不了，也說不出話。

items.en: The builders damaged our wall. They will neither pay nor apologize.
items.zh: 工人弄壞了我們的牆。他們既不會付錢，也不會道歉。

items.en: Our son is only nine months old. He can neither walk nor talk yet.
items.zh: 我們的兒子才九個月大。他還不會走路，也不會說話。

examples.heading: ④ neither + 動詞 + 受詞 + nor + 動詞 + 受詞

items.en: My old boss offered me a part-time job. I neither wanted the job nor needed the money.
items.zh: 我以前的老闆給我一份兼職工作。我既不想要那份工作，也不需要那筆錢。

items.en: We stayed there for five nights. The hotel neither cleaned our room nor changed the towels.
items.zh: 我們在那裡住了五晚。飯店既沒打掃我們的房間，也沒換毛巾。

items.en: I went to my sister's flat after work. She neither answered the door nor picked up the phone.
items.zh: 我下班後去我姊姊的公寓。她既沒應門，也沒接電話。

items.en: I had a bad cough for two weeks. The doctor neither gave me medicine nor told me to rest.
items.zh: 我咳得很嚴重，咳了兩個星期。醫生既沒開藥給我，也沒叫我休息。

examples.heading: ⑤ Neither + 倒裝 和不同的句型

items.en: Our guests never came to dinner. Neither did they call, nor did they send a message.
items.zh: 我們的客人一直沒來吃晚餐。他們既沒打電話，也沒傳訊息。

items.en: Our neighbours' tree fell on our car. Neither did they help, nor did they say sorry.
items.zh: 我們鄰居的樹倒在我們的車上。他們既沒幫忙，也沒道歉。

items.en: I asked my boss for a pay rise. She neither agreed nor said no.
items.zh: 我跟我老闆要求加薪。她既沒同意，也沒拒絕。

items.en: The new teacher had a hard first day. The children neither listened nor sat still.
items.zh: 新老師的第一天很辛苦。孩子們既沒聽話，也沒坐好。

items.en: My ex-boyfriend left town last month. I neither know nor care where he went.
items.zh: 我前男友上個月離開了這個鎮。我不知道，也不在乎他去了哪裡。

items.en: The manager wants to change the delivery routes. But the plan neither saves time nor cuts costs.
items.zh: 經理想改送貨路線。可是這個計畫既省不了時間，也降不了成本。

items.en: A reporter asked the actor about his secret wedding. He neither confirmed nor denied the story.
items.zh: 一個記者問那個演員他秘密結婚的事。他對那件事既沒承認，也沒否認。

items.en: The score was two all at the end. We neither won nor lost; it was a draw.
items.zh: 最後比數是二比二。我們既沒贏也沒輸，是平手。

items.en: I posted a letter to my aunt in Peru in May. The letter neither arrived nor came back.
items.zh: 我五月寄了一封信給我在秘魯的阿姨。那封信既沒寄到，也沒退回來。

items.en: My old friends moved to Spain ten years ago. They neither visited us nor invited us to their wedding.
items.zh: 我的老朋友十年前搬去西班牙。他們既沒來看我們，也沒邀請我們參加婚禮。

title: Jack, though disappointed, respects the result.
translation: Jack 雖然很失望，還是尊重這個結果。
name: although、though 加非限定子句
sentences: Although small, the flat has everything we need.
Although nervous, she answered every question clearly.
Although expensive, the course was worth every penny.
Although busy with her own work, she always helps her colleagues.
Although popular with tourists, the island is still very quiet.
Although useful, the app uses a lot of battery.
Although married, they live in different cities.
Although committed to his studies, he plays football every weekend.
Although injured, the player finished the match.
Although surprised by the news, he stayed calm.
Although trained as a lawyer, she works as a chef.
The hotel, though old, was very comfortable.
My brother, though annoyed, agreed to help.
The film, though long, never got boring.
Her answer, though short, was very clear.
The town, though tiny, has three good restaurants.
The kids, though exhausted, didn't want to go to bed.
Although living in the city, she grows her own vegetables.
Though working full-time, he still finds time to paint.
Although in pain, the runner kept going.
Though knowing the risks, they decided to go ahead.
Although under pressure, the team stayed calm.
Though thrifty, my aunt always buys good shoes.
Although tired after the flight, we went straight to the beach.
The plan, though simple, worked perfectly.
Although unsure of the way, he refused to ask for directions.
The room, though tidy, smelled of smoke.
Although retired, my father still goes to the office twice a week.
Though hungry, she waited for everyone to sit down.
Although disappointed with the result, the coach praised his players.

examples.heading: ① Although + 形容詞

items.en: Although small, the flat has everything we need.
items.zh: 這間公寓雖然小，卻有我們需要的一切。

items.en: Although nervous, she answered every question clearly.
items.zh: 雖然很緊張，她每個問題都回答得很清楚。

items.en: Although expensive, the course was worth every penny.
items.zh: 這門課雖然很貴，但每一分錢都花得值得。

items.en: Although busy with her own work, she always helps her colleagues.
items.zh: 雖然自己的工作很忙，她總是會幫同事。

items.en: Although popular with tourists, the island is still very quiet.
items.zh: 這座島雖然很受觀光客歡迎，還是很安靜。

items.en: Although useful, the app uses a lot of battery.
items.zh: 這個應用程式雖然好用，卻很耗電。

examples.heading: ② Although + 過去分詞

items.en: Although married, they live in different cities.
items.zh: 雖然結婚了，他們住在不同的城市。

items.en: Although committed to his studies, he plays football every weekend.
items.zh: 他雖然很專心念書，每個週末還是會去踢足球。

items.en: Although injured, the player finished the match.
items.zh: 雖然受了傷，那位球員還是打完了比賽。

items.en: Although surprised by the news, he stayed calm.
items.zh: 雖然對那個消息很驚訝，他還是保持冷靜。

items.en: Although trained as a lawyer, she works as a chef.
items.zh: 她雖然受過律師的訓練，卻在當廚師。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞, + though + 形容詞 / 過去分詞

items.en: The hotel, though old, was very comfortable.
items.zh: 那家飯店雖然舊，卻很舒服。

items.en: My brother, though annoyed, agreed to help.
items.zh: 我哥哥雖然很不爽，還是答應幫忙。

items.en: The film, though long, never got boring.
items.zh: 那部電影雖然很長，卻從不無聊。

items.en: Her answer, though short, was very clear.
items.zh: 她的回答雖然很短，卻很清楚。

items.en: The town, though tiny, has three good restaurants.
items.zh: 那個小鎮雖然很小，卻有三家好餐廳。

items.en: The kids, though exhausted, didn't want to go to bed.
items.zh: 孩子們雖然累壞了，卻不想上床睡覺。

examples.heading: ④ although / though + 動詞-ing 或介系詞片語

items.en: Although living in the city, she grows her own vegetables.
items.zh: 雖然住在城市，她自己種菜。

items.en: Though working full-time, he still finds time to paint.
items.zh: 雖然全職工作，他還是有時間畫畫。

items.en: Although in pain, the runner kept going.
items.zh: 雖然很痛，那位跑者還是繼續跑。

items.en: Though knowing the risks, they decided to go ahead.
items.zh: 雖然知道風險，他們還是決定繼續。

items.en: Although under pressure, the team stayed calm.
items.zh: 雖然壓力很大，團隊還是保持冷靜。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Though thrifty, my aunt always buys good shoes.
items.zh: 我阿姨雖然節儉，卻總是買好鞋子。

items.en: Although tired after the flight, we went straight to the beach.
items.zh: 雖然搭完飛機很累，我們還是直接去了海邊。

items.en: The plan, though simple, worked perfectly.
items.zh: 那個計畫雖然簡單，卻非常成功。

items.en: Although unsure of the way, he refused to ask for directions.
items.zh: 雖然不確定怎麼走，他還是不肯問路。

items.en: The room, though tidy, smelled of smoke.
items.zh: 那個房間雖然很整齊，卻有菸味。

items.en: Although retired, my father still goes to the office twice a week.
items.zh: 雖然退休了，我爸爸每個禮拜還是會去辦公室兩次。

items.en: Though hungry, she waited for everyone to sit down.
items.zh: 雖然很餓，她還是等大家都坐下才吃。

items.en: Although disappointed with the result, the coach praised his players.
items.zh: 雖然對結果很失望，教練還是稱讚了他的球員。

title: Going away with friends will be more fun than sitting at home.
translation: 跟朋友出去玩會比坐在家裡有趣。
name: than 後接動詞-ing 非限定子句
sentences: Parking at the airport costs twenty pounds a day. Sharing a taxi is cheaper than paying for parking.
You've had three cups already. Taking a nap is better than drinking more coffee.
The trainer said this to the new gym members. Stretching is more important than lifting heavy weights.
Put the tablet away and go to the park. Playing outside is healthier than sitting at a screen.
The roads are always full at rush hour. Taking the train is faster than driving in the city.
I get nervous on the phone. Writing an email is easier than calling.
Camping with friends will be more fun than staying in a hotel.
My son is seventeen now. He says traveling with friends is more interesting than spending the holiday with parents.
Turn off the TV and come to the park. Playing football is more fun than watching it.
Our science teacher lets us do experiments. Learning by doing is more interesting than reading about it.
You find small cafés and markets that way. Visiting a city on foot is more fun than taking a tour bus.
Every teacher knows your name there. Going to a small school is less complicated than going to a large one.
I can read or sleep on the way to work. Taking the bus is less tiring than driving.
My company lets me stay home on Fridays. Working from home is less stressful than commuting every day.
My sister likes to try clothes on. For her, buying online is less fun than going to the shops.
My mum is in the operating room. For me, waiting quietly is less painful than worrying about everything.
Our flat is on the tenth floor. Walking up the stairs is harder than taking the lift.
Your sister is upset with you. Talking to her is better than sending a text.
Don't carry the sofa by yourself. Asking for help is smarter than trying to do it alone.
The mechanic gave us the price. Fixing the old car is more expensive than buying a new one.
I always miss my morning run. Getting up early is harder than going to bed early.
You went to Rome by plane. Was flying cheaper than taking the train?
It took us four weekends. Painting the room ourselves was harder than paying someone.
I don't want to visit museums on holiday. Nothing is better than lying on the beach.
For me, studying in the morning works better than studying at night.
The trucks drive very close to the edge. Riding a bike is more dangerous than walking in this traffic.
You forgot the milk again. Making a list is quicker than trying to remember everything.
It's Saturday night, and you're in your pyjamas. Is staying home really better than going out?
Our band only plays other people's music. Learning a song is easier than writing one.
Rent in the city is very high. Sharing a flat will be cheaper than living alone.

examples.heading: ① 動詞-ing + 比較級 + than + 動詞-ing

items.en: Parking at the airport costs twenty pounds a day. Sharing a taxi is cheaper than paying for parking.
items.zh: 機場停車一天要二十英鎊。共乘計程車比付停車費便宜。

items.en: You've had three cups already. Taking a nap is better than drinking more coffee.
items.zh: 你已經喝了三杯了。睡個午覺比再喝咖啡好。

items.en: The trainer said this to the new gym members. Stretching is more important than lifting heavy weights.
items.zh: 教練跟健身房的新會員這樣說。伸展比舉重更重要。

items.en: Put the tablet away and go to the park. Playing outside is healthier than sitting at a screen.
items.zh: 把平板收起來，去公園吧。在外面玩比坐在螢幕前健康。

items.en: The roads are always full at rush hour. Taking the train is faster than driving in the city.
items.zh: 尖峰時間路上總是很塞。在市區搭火車比開車快。

items.en: I get nervous on the phone. Writing an email is easier than calling.
items.zh: 我講電話會緊張。寫電子郵件比打電話容易。

examples.heading: ② more fun / more interesting + than + 動詞-ing

items.en: Camping with friends will be more fun than staying in a hotel.
items.zh: 跟朋友去露營會比住飯店好玩。

items.en: My son is seventeen now. He says traveling with friends is more interesting than spending the holiday with parents.
items.zh: 我兒子現在十七歲。他說跟朋友旅行比跟爸媽一起過假期有趣。

items.en: Turn off the TV and come to the park. Playing football is more fun than watching it.
items.zh: 關掉電視，來公園吧。踢足球比看足球好玩。

items.en: Our science teacher lets us do experiments. Learning by doing is more interesting than reading about it.
items.zh: 我們的自然老師讓我們做實驗。從做中學比讀書本有趣。

items.en: You find small cafés and markets that way. Visiting a city on foot is more fun than taking a tour bus.
items.zh: 那樣你會找到小咖啡館和市場。走路逛城市比搭觀光巴士好玩。

examples.heading: ③ less + 形容詞 + than + 動詞-ing

items.en: Every teacher knows your name there. Going to a small school is less complicated than going to a large one.
items.zh: 那裡每個老師都知道你的名字。讀規模小的學校比讀大的學校單純。

items.en: I can read or sleep on the way to work. Taking the bus is less tiring than driving.
items.zh: 我上班路上可以看書或睡覺。搭公車比開車不累。

items.en: My company lets me stay home on Fridays. Working from home is less stressful than commuting every day.
items.zh: 我的公司讓我星期五待在家。在家工作比每天通勤壓力小。

items.en: My sister likes to try clothes on. For her, buying online is less fun than going to the shops.
items.zh: 我姊姊喜歡試穿衣服。對她來說，網購沒有去逛街好玩。

items.en: My mum is in the operating room. For me, waiting quietly is less painful than worrying about everything.
items.zh: 我媽媽在手術室。對我來說，安靜地等沒有什麼都擔心那麼痛苦。

examples.heading: ④ better / harder / more expensive + than + 動詞-ing

items.en: Our flat is on the tenth floor. Walking up the stairs is harder than taking the lift.
items.zh: 我們的公寓在十樓。走樓梯比搭電梯辛苦。

items.en: Your sister is upset with you. Talking to her is better than sending a text.
items.zh: 你姊姊在生你的氣。跟她談比傳簡訊好。

items.en: Don't carry the sofa by yourself. Asking for help is smarter than trying to do it alone.
items.zh: 別自己搬沙發。尋求幫助比試著自己做聰明。

items.en: The mechanic gave us the price. Fixing the old car is more expensive than buying a new one.
items.zh: 修車師傅給了我們價錢。修舊車比買新車貴。

items.en: I always miss my morning run. Getting up early is harder than going to bed early.
items.zh: 我總是錯過早上的跑步。早起比早睡難。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: You went to Rome by plane. Was flying cheaper than taking the train?
items.zh: 你搭飛機去羅馬。搭飛機比搭火車便宜嗎？

items.en: It took us four weekends. Painting the room ourselves was harder than paying someone.
items.zh: 我們花了四個週末。自己漆房間比請人漆難。

items.en: I don't want to visit museums on holiday. Nothing is better than lying on the beach.
items.zh: 我度假不想逛博物館。沒有什麼比躺在海灘上更好的了。

items.en: For me, studying in the morning works better than studying at night.
items.zh: 對我來說，早上讀書比晚上讀書有效。

items.en: The trucks drive very close to the edge. Riding a bike is more dangerous than walking in this traffic.
items.zh: 卡車開得很靠路邊。在這種交通狀況下，騎腳踏車比走路危險。

items.en: You forgot the milk again. Making a list is quicker than trying to remember everything.
items.zh: 你又忘了買牛奶。列清單比試著記住每件事快。

items.en: It's Saturday night, and you're in your pyjamas. Is staying home really better than going out?
items.zh: 今天是星期六晚上，你穿著睡衣。待在家真的比出門好嗎？

items.en: Our band only plays other people's music. Learning a song is easier than writing one.
items.zh: 我們樂團只演奏別人的歌。學一首歌比寫一首歌容易。

items.en: Rent in the city is very high. Sharing a flat will be cheaper than living alone.
items.zh: 城市的房租很高。跟人合租公寓會比一個人住便宜。

title: After having worked for many hours, you'll probably be tired.
translation: 工作了好幾個小時之後，你大概會很累。
name: after having/being 加過去分詞
sentences: After having spent all morning in the sun, we were very thirsty.
After having read the contract carefully, I decided not to sign it.
After having lived abroad for years, he found his hometown very small.
After having missed the last bus, we had to walk home.
After having argued for an hour, they finally agreed.
After having tried every shop in town, I gave up.
After having finished this course, you'll be able to build a website.
After having paid, take your receipt to the counter.
After having walked all day, most visitors are ready for a rest.
After having eaten that much, you won't want dessert.
After having signed up, you'll receive an email from us.
After having passed the test, you can drive on your own.
After being given a map, the new students explored the campus.
After being rescued, the hikers thanked the volunteers.
After being told off by the teacher, the boy was very quiet.
After being invited to speak, she prepared for weeks.
After being chosen for the team, he trained every day.
After having cleaned the house, we sat down with a cup of tea.
After cleaning the kitchen, we watched a film.
After having heard both sides, the judge made a decision.
After hearing the joke, everyone laughed.
After having left Taipei, we drove down the east coast.
After having checked every page, the client approved the design.
After having spoken to the manager, I felt much calmer.
After having waited two hours, we finally saw a doctor.
After having visited twenty countries, she wrote a book about her travels.
After being warned twice, the driver finally slowed down.
After having saved for three years, they bought their first flat.
After having apologized, he left the room.
After having seen the film, I wanted to read the book.

examples.heading: ① After having + 過去分詞（過去的事）

items.en: After having spent all morning in the sun, we were very thirsty.
items.zh: 在太陽底下待了一整個早上之後，我們都很渴。

items.en: After having read the contract carefully, I decided not to sign it.
items.zh: 仔細讀過合約之後，我決定不簽。

items.en: After having lived abroad for years, he found his hometown very small.
items.zh: 在國外住了好幾年之後，他覺得家鄉很小。

items.en: After having missed the last bus, we had to walk home.
items.zh: 錯過了最後一班公車之後，我們只好走路回家。

items.en: After having argued for an hour, they finally agreed.
items.zh: 吵了一個小時之後，他們終於達成共識。

items.en: After having tried every shop in town, I gave up.
items.zh: 找遍了鎮上的每一家店之後，我放棄了。

examples.heading: ② After having + 過去分詞（現在和未來）

items.en: After having finished this course, you'll be able to build a website.
items.zh: 上完這門課之後，你就能自己架網站。

items.en: After having paid, take your receipt to the counter.
items.zh: 付完錢之後，把收據拿到櫃台。

items.en: After having walked all day, most visitors are ready for a rest.
items.zh: 走了一整天之後，大部分的遊客都想休息了。

items.en: After having eaten that much, you won't want dessert.
items.zh: 吃了那麼多之後，你不會想吃甜點了。

items.en: After having signed up, you'll receive an email from us.
items.zh: 註冊之後，你會收到我們寄的電子郵件。

items.en: After having passed the test, you can drive on your own.
items.zh: 考過之後，你就可以自己開車了。

examples.heading: ③ After being + 過去分詞（被動）

items.en: After being given a map, the new students explored the campus.
items.zh: 拿到地圖之後，新生們去逛了校園。（being given 是被動）

items.en: After being rescued, the hikers thanked the volunteers.
items.zh: 獲救之後，登山客向志工道謝。（being rescued 是被動）

items.en: After being told off by the teacher, the boy was very quiet.
items.zh: 被老師罵了之後，那個男孩變得很安靜。（being told off 是被動）

items.en: After being invited to speak, she prepared for weeks.
items.zh: 受邀演講之後，她準備了好幾個禮拜。（being invited 是被動）

items.en: After being chosen for the team, he trained every day.
items.zh: 被選進隊伍之後，他每天都在練習。（being chosen 是被動）

examples.heading: ④ after having 和 after + 動詞-ing 的比較

items.en: After having cleaned the house, we sat down with a cup of tea.
items.zh: 把房子打掃完之後，我們坐下來喝了杯茶。

items.en: After cleaning the kitchen, we watched a film.
items.zh: 清理完廚房之後，我們看了一部電影。

items.en: After having heard both sides, the judge made a decision.
items.zh: 聽完雙方的說法之後，法官做出了決定。

items.en: After hearing the joke, everyone laughed.
items.zh: 聽了那個笑話之後，大家都笑了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: After having left Taipei, we drove down the east coast.
items.zh: 離開台北之後，我們沿著東海岸往南開。

items.en: After having checked every page, the client approved the design.
items.zh: 客戶檢查過每一頁之後，批准了設計。

items.en: After having spoken to the manager, I felt much calmer.
items.zh: 跟經理談過之後，我覺得冷靜多了。

items.en: After having waited two hours, we finally saw a doctor.
items.zh: 等了兩個小時之後，我們終於看到醫生了。

items.en: After having visited twenty countries, she wrote a book about her travels.
items.zh: 去過二十個國家之後，她寫了一本關於旅行的書。

items.en: After being warned twice, the driver finally slowed down.
items.zh: 被警告了兩次之後，那個司機終於放慢速度。（being warned 是被動）

items.en: After having saved for three years, they bought their first flat.
items.zh: 存了三年的錢之後，他們買了第一間公寓。

items.en: After having apologized, he left the room.
items.zh: 道歉之後，他就離開了房間。

items.en: After having seen the film, I wanted to read the book.
items.zh: 看了那部電影之後，我想去讀原著。

title: Not knowing North London very well, I took quite a long time to get there.
translation: 我對北倫敦不太熟，所以花了好一段時間才到那裡。
name: not 開頭的動詞-ing 子句
sentences: Not knowing anyone in the city, I felt very lonely at first.
Not knowing the rules, he made a lot of mistakes.
Not knowing what to say, she just smiled.
Not knowing the language, we used a translation app.
Not knowing how long the meeting would last, I cancelled my dinner plans.
Not knowing his phone number, I sent him an email.
Not wanting to wake my parents, I took off my shoes at the door.
Not wanting to waste food, she took the leftovers home.
Not wanting to seem rude, he ate everything on his plate.
Not wanting to miss the start, we ran all the way to the cinema.
Not wanting any trouble, the shop owner gave him a refund.
Not being a morning person, I always set three alarms.
Not understanding the question, he asked the teacher again.
Not being very tall, she sat in the front row.
Not understanding the instructions, we built the shelf upside down.
Not being able to drive, my grandmother takes the bus everywhere.
Not having slept well, I found it hard to concentrate.
Not having read the book, I couldn't join the discussion.
Not having seen her for years, I didn't recognize her.
Not having booked a table, we had to wait an hour.
Not having heard the alarm, she missed her first class.
Not having any cash, I paid by card.
Not liking crowds, we went to the museum on a weekday.
Not feeling well, he left the party early.
Not expecting visitors, I was still in my pajamas.
Not trusting the weather, she packed an umbrella.
Not needing the car that day, I lent it to my neighbor.
Not being gregarious by nature, he found parties exhausting.
Not realizing the time, we talked until midnight.
Not wishing to disturb you, I left a note on your desk.

examples.heading: ① Not knowing

items.en: Not knowing anyone in the city, I felt very lonely at first.
items.zh: 我在這個城市誰都不認識，一開始覺得很孤單。

items.en: Not knowing the rules, he made a lot of mistakes.
items.zh: 他不懂規則，所以犯了很多錯。

items.en: Not knowing what to say, she just smiled.
items.zh: 她不知道該說什麼，就只是笑了笑。

items.en: Not knowing the language, we used a translation app.
items.zh: 我們不會說當地的語言，就用翻譯應用程式。

items.en: Not knowing how long the meeting would last, I cancelled my dinner plans.
items.zh: 我不知道會議會開多久，就取消了晚餐的計畫。

items.en: Not knowing his phone number, I sent him an email.
items.zh: 我不知道他的電話，就寄了電子郵件給他。

examples.heading: ② Not wanting

items.en: Not wanting to wake my parents, I took off my shoes at the door.
items.zh: 我不想吵醒我爸媽，就在門口脫了鞋。

items.en: Not wanting to waste food, she took the leftovers home.
items.zh: 她不想浪費食物，就把剩菜帶回家。

items.en: Not wanting to seem rude, he ate everything on his plate.
items.zh: 他不想顯得沒禮貌，就把盤子裡的東西全吃了。

items.en: Not wanting to miss the start, we ran all the way to the cinema.
items.zh: 我們不想錯過開頭，就一路跑到電影院。

items.en: Not wanting any trouble, the shop owner gave him a refund.
items.zh: 店老闆不想惹麻煩，就退錢給他了。

examples.heading: ③ Not being / Not understanding

items.en: Not being a morning person, I always set three alarms.
items.zh: 我不是早起的人，所以都會設三個鬧鐘。

items.en: Not understanding the question, he asked the teacher again.
items.zh: 他聽不懂問題，又問了老師一次。

items.en: Not being very tall, she sat in the front row.
items.zh: 她個子不高，所以坐在第一排。

items.en: Not understanding the instructions, we built the shelf upside down.
items.zh: 我們看不懂說明，把架子裝反了。

items.en: Not being able to drive, my grandmother takes the bus everywhere.
items.zh: 我奶奶不會開車，到哪裡都搭公車。

examples.heading: ④ Not having + 過去分詞

items.en: Not having slept well, I found it hard to concentrate.
items.zh: 我沒睡好，很難專心。

items.en: Not having read the book, I couldn't join the discussion.
items.zh: 我沒讀過那本書，沒辦法加入討論。

items.en: Not having seen her for years, I didn't recognize her.
items.zh: 我好幾年沒見到她，認不出她來。

items.en: Not having booked a table, we had to wait an hour.
items.zh: 我們沒訂位，只好等了一個小時。

items.en: Not having heard the alarm, she missed her first class.
items.zh: 她沒聽到鬧鐘，錯過了第一堂課。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Not having any cash, I paid by card.
items.zh: 我身上沒現金，就刷卡付了。

items.en: Not liking crowds, we went to the museum on a weekday.
items.zh: 我們不喜歡人多，就挑平日去博物館。

items.en: Not feeling well, he left the party early.
items.zh: 他不太舒服，就提早離開了派對。

items.en: Not expecting visitors, I was still in my pajamas.
items.zh: 我沒料到會有客人，還穿著睡衣。

items.en: Not trusting the weather, she packed an umbrella.
items.zh: 她不太相信天氣會好，就帶了一把傘。

items.en: Not needing the car that day, I lent it to my neighbor.
items.zh: 我那天不需要車，就借給了鄰居。

items.en: Not being gregarious by nature, he found parties exhausting.
items.zh: 他天生不愛交際，覺得參加派對很累。

items.en: Not realizing the time, we talked until midnight.
items.zh: 我們沒注意到時間，聊到了半夜。

items.en: Not wishing to disturb you, I left a note on your desk.
items.zh: 我不想打擾你，就在你桌上留了張字條。

title: I really like it, not only because it is nice and colorful but also because I spent most of my childhood summers there.
translation: 我真的很喜歡那裡，不只是因為那裡漂亮又多彩多姿，也因為我童年大部分的暑假都是在那裡過的。
name: not only … but also 的強調
sentences: Look at the garden behind the restaurant. The chef not only cooks but also grows his own herbs.
My brother has a small workshop in the garage. He not only repairs bikes but also builds them.
I order my groceries with this app now. It not only saves time but also saves money.
My grandmother is very busy for her age. She not only volunteers at the library but also teaches swimming.
The builders did more than we asked. They not only fixed the roof but also painted the house.
She gave us all a day off after the busy month. My new boss is not only fair but also generous.
We were lucky in Rome. The hotel was not only cheap but also clean.
Nobody finished the chemistry paper. The test was not only long but also difficult.
Have you been inside the new library? It's not only big but also beautiful.
My brother spoke at his best friend's wedding. His speech was not only funny but very moving.
My aunt worked in Asia for twenty years. She speaks not only Thai but also Vietnamese.
I spend hours at the bookshop on the corner. The shop sells not only books but also coffee.
Our garden party was very big. We invited not only our friends but also our neighbors.
A pan caught fire while we were out. The fire damaged not only the kitchen but also the living room.
My sister had a terrible day at the airport. She lost not only her bag but also her passport.
Tom's birthday was on Saturday. The party was fun, not only because the music was good but also because everyone danced.
We found a café near the museum. It was nice, not only because it was quiet but also because the staff were friendly.
My friend asked why I became a nurse. I chose this job not only because the pay is good but also because I love the work.
We left the city last year. We moved here not only because it's cheap but because it's near my parents.
Tom missed the start of his exam. He was late not only because the traffic was bad but also because he overslept.
The city is giving free bus passes to students. The plan will help not only students but also their families.
We ate noodles at a street stall in Bangkok. It was not only the best meal of the trip but also the cheapest.
Go for a run after work. Exercise not only keeps you fit but also helps you sleep.
You're going to India next month? You need not only a passport but also a visa.
The cinemas were full every weekend. The film was popular not only with kids but also with adults.
We stayed home for two days last week. The storm not only closed the roads but also cut the power.
My mum started English classes at fifty. Learning English is useful not only for work but also for travel.
My sister was worried about her maths exam. She not only passed the exam but got the highest score.
Take the kids to the science museum. It's not only interesting but also free.
I'm very angry with my boyfriend. He not only forgot my birthday but also forgot our dinner.

examples.heading: ① not only + 動詞 + but also + 動詞

items.en: Look at the garden behind the restaurant. The chef not only cooks but also grows his own herbs.
items.zh: 你看餐廳後面的花園。那個廚師不只會做菜，還自己種香草。

items.en: My brother has a small workshop in the garage. He not only repairs bikes but also builds them.
items.zh: 我哥哥在車庫有一間小工作室。他不只會修腳踏車，還會自己組裝。

items.en: I order my groceries with this app now. It not only saves time but also saves money.
items.zh: 我現在用這個 app 訂日用品。它不只省時間，還省錢。

items.en: My grandmother is very busy for her age. She not only volunteers at the library but also teaches swimming.
items.zh: 以她的年紀來說，我奶奶很忙。她不只在圖書館當志工，還教游泳。

items.en: The builders did more than we asked. They not only fixed the roof but also painted the house.
items.zh: 工人做的比我們要求的還多。他們不只修好了屋頂，還粉刷了房子。

examples.heading: ② not only + 形容詞 + but also + 形容詞

items.en: She gave us all a day off after the busy month. My new boss is not only fair but also generous.
items.zh: 忙了一個月以後她讓我們每個人都放一天假。我的新老闆不只公正，還很大方。

items.en: We were lucky in Rome. The hotel was not only cheap but also clean.
items.zh: 我們在羅馬運氣很好。那家飯店不只便宜，還很乾淨。

items.en: Nobody finished the chemistry paper. The test was not only long but also difficult.
items.zh: 沒有人寫完化學考卷。考試不只很長，還很難。

items.en: Have you been inside the new library? It's not only big but also beautiful.
items.zh: 你進過新圖書館嗎？它不只大，還很漂亮。

items.en: My brother spoke at his best friend's wedding. His speech was not only funny but very moving.
items.zh: 我哥哥在他最好朋友的婚禮上致詞。他的演講不只好笑，還很感人。

examples.heading: ③ not only + 名詞 + but also + 名詞

items.en: My aunt worked in Asia for twenty years. She speaks not only Thai but also Vietnamese.
items.zh: 我阿姨在亞洲工作了二十年。她不只會說泰文，還會說越南文。

items.en: I spend hours at the bookshop on the corner. The shop sells not only books but also coffee.
items.zh: 我在轉角那家書店一待就是好幾個小時。那家店不只賣書，還賣咖啡。

items.en: Our garden party was very big. We invited not only our friends but also our neighbors.
items.zh: 我們的花園派對很盛大。我們不只邀請了朋友，還邀請了鄰居。

items.en: A pan caught fire while we were out. The fire damaged not only the kitchen but also the living room.
items.zh: 我們出門的時候一個鍋子起火了。那場火不只燒壞了廚房，還燒壞了客廳。

items.en: My sister had a terrible day at the airport. She lost not only her bag but also her passport.
items.zh: 我姊姊在機場過了很糟的一天。她不只弄丟了包包，連護照也弄丟了。

examples.heading: ④ not only because ... but also because ...

items.en: Tom's birthday was on Saturday. The party was fun, not only because the music was good but also because everyone danced.
items.zh: 湯姆的生日在星期六。派對很好玩，不只是因為音樂好，也因為大家都在跳舞。

items.en: We found a café near the museum. It was nice, not only because it was quiet but also because the staff were friendly.
items.zh: 我們在博物館附近找到一家咖啡店。那家咖啡店很好，不只是因為安靜，也因為員工很友善。

items.en: My friend asked why I became a nurse. I chose this job not only because the pay is good but also because I love the work.
items.zh: 我朋友問我為什麼當護理師。我選這份工作，不只是因為薪水好，也因為我喜歡這個工作。

items.en: We left the city last year. We moved here not only because it's cheap but because it's near my parents.
items.zh: 我們去年離開了城市。我們搬來這裡，不只是因為便宜，也因為離我爸媽很近。

items.en: Tom missed the start of his exam. He was late not only because the traffic was bad but also because he overslept.
items.zh: 湯姆錯過了考試的開頭。他遲到不只是因為塞車，也因為他睡過頭了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: The city is giving free bus passes to students. The plan will help not only students but also their families.
items.zh: 市政府要發免費公車卡給學生。這個計畫不只會幫助學生，還會幫助他們的家人。

items.en: We ate noodles at a street stall in Bangkok. It was not only the best meal of the trip but also the cheapest.
items.zh: 我們在曼谷的路邊攤吃麵。那不只是這趟旅行最好吃的一餐，也是最便宜的一餐。

items.en: Go for a run after work. Exercise not only keeps you fit but also helps you sleep.
items.zh: 下班後去跑步吧。運動不只讓你保持健康，還能幫助睡眠。

items.en: You're going to India next month? You need not only a passport but also a visa.
items.zh: 你下個月要去印度？你不只需要護照，還需要簽證。

items.en: The cinemas were full every weekend. The film was popular not only with kids but also with adults.
items.zh: 電影院每個週末都客滿。那部電影不只受小孩歡迎，也受大人歡迎。

items.en: We stayed home for two days last week. The storm not only closed the roads but also cut the power.
items.zh: 我們上星期在家待了兩天。暴風雨不只讓道路封閉，還造成停電。

items.en: My mum started English classes at fifty. Learning English is useful not only for work but also for travel.
items.zh: 我媽媽五十歲開始上英文課。學英文不只對工作有用，對旅行也有用。

items.en: My sister was worried about her maths exam. She not only passed the exam but got the highest score.
items.zh: 我姊姊很擔心她的數學考試。她不只考試及格，還拿到最高分。

items.en: Take the kids to the science museum. It's not only interesting but also free.
items.zh: 帶孩子們去科學博物館吧。那間博物館不只有趣，還免費。

items.en: I'm very angry with my boyfriend. He not only forgot my birthday but also forgot our dinner.
items.zh: 我很生我男朋友的氣。他不只忘了我的生日，還忘了我們的晚餐約會。

title: If you are looking for fun and excitement, I would go for the city.
translation: 如果你想找樂子和刺激，我會選城市。
name: if 現在進行式的條件句表示勸告
sentences: If you're flying to Rome on Friday, you should check in online.
If you're staying with us, you can use the spare room.
If you're coming to the wedding, please reply by Monday.
If you're cooking dinner tonight, don't forget the bread.
If they're arriving late, we can leave the key with the neighbour.
If you're moving house next month, you should tell the bank.
If you're meeting Sam tomorrow, give him this book.
If you're taking the children to the beach, bring plenty of sun cream.
If you're looking for a cheap lunch, the market has great stalls.
If you're thinking of learning Italian, I'd start with an evening class.
If you're hoping to see the northern lights, go in winter.
If you're planning a picnic, the park by the lake is lovely.
If you're looking for adventure, you could try rock climbing.
If you're considering a new phone, you should wait for the sales.
If you're trying to lose weight, you should cut down on sugar.
If you're going to study abroad, you should start saving now.
If you're going to drive all night, take a break every two hours.
If we're going to finish on time, we must start now.
If you're going to buy a dog, think about who will walk it.
If she's going to run the marathon, she needs to train every day.
If you're going to be late, please call me.
If you're going to live in a big city, you should choose a flat near the underground.
If you're looking for peace and quiet, I'd choose the village.
If you're planning to stay a month, I'd rent a flat instead of a hotel room.
If you're starting a new job on Monday, I'd get an early night on Sunday.
If you're buying a used car, I would take a mechanic with you.
If you're visiting Scotland, I'd take a waterproof jacket.
If you're travelling with friends, choose them carefully.
If you're applying for that job, ask your teacher for a reference.
If you're having a party, remember to tell the neighbours.
If you're choosing a new school, visit a few of them first.
If you're going camping, don't forget a torch.

examples.heading: ① 計畫好的事

items.en: If you're flying to Rome on Friday, you should check in online.
items.zh: 如果你星期五要飛羅馬，應該先線上報到。

items.en: If you're staying with us, you can use the spare room.
items.zh: 如果你要住我們家，可以用客房。

items.en: If you're coming to the wedding, please reply by Monday.
items.zh: 如果你要來參加婚禮，請在星期一前回覆。

items.en: If you're cooking dinner tonight, don't forget the bread.
items.zh: 如果你今晚要煮晚餐，別忘了麵包。

items.en: If they're arriving late, we can leave the key with the neighbour.
items.zh: 如果他們會晚到，我們可以把鑰匙留給鄰居。

items.en: If you're moving house next month, you should tell the bank.
items.zh: 如果你下個月要搬家，應該通知銀行。

items.en: If you're meeting Sam tomorrow, give him this book.
items.zh: 如果你明天要跟 Sam 見面，把這本書給他。

items.en: If you're taking the children to the beach, bring plenty of sun cream.
items.zh: 如果你要帶孩子去海邊，多帶點防曬乳。

examples.heading: ② 正在找或考慮的事

items.en: If you're looking for a cheap lunch, the market has great stalls.
items.zh: 如果你在找便宜的午餐，市場有很棒的攤位。

items.en: If you're thinking of learning Italian, I'd start with an evening class.
items.zh: 如果你在考慮學義大利文，我會從夜間課程開始。

items.en: If you're hoping to see the northern lights, go in winter.
items.zh: 如果你希望看到北極光，就冬天去。

items.en: If you're planning a picnic, the park by the lake is lovely.
items.zh: 如果你在計畫野餐，湖邊的公園很棒。

items.en: If you're looking for adventure, you could try rock climbing.
items.zh: 如果你在找刺激的活動，可以試試攀岩。

items.en: If you're considering a new phone, you should wait for the sales.
items.zh: 如果你在考慮買新手機，應該等特價。

items.en: If you're trying to lose weight, you should cut down on sugar.
items.zh: 如果你想減重，應該少吃糖。

examples.heading: ③ If + be going to

items.en: If you're going to study abroad, you should start saving now.
items.zh: 如果你打算出國讀書，現在就應該開始存錢。

items.en: If you're going to drive all night, take a break every two hours.
items.zh: 如果你打算開整晚的車，每兩個小時休息一次。

items.en: If we're going to finish on time, we must start now.
items.zh: 如果我們想準時完成，現在就得開始。

items.en: If you're going to buy a dog, think about who will walk it.
items.zh: 如果你打算買狗，先想想誰要遛牠。

items.en: If she's going to run the marathon, she needs to train every day.
items.zh: 如果她打算跑馬拉松，就得每天訓練。

items.en: If you're going to be late, please call me.
items.zh: 如果你會遲到，請打電話給我。

items.en: If you're going to live in a big city, you should choose a flat near the underground.
items.zh: 如果你打算住在大城市，應該選地鐵站附近的公寓。

examples.heading: ④ I'd 或 I would

items.en: If you're looking for peace and quiet, I'd choose the village.
items.zh: 如果你在找寧靜，我會選那個村子。

items.en: If you're planning to stay a month, I'd rent a flat instead of a hotel room.
items.zh: 如果你打算待一個月，我會租公寓，不住飯店。

items.en: If you're starting a new job on Monday, I'd get an early night on Sunday.
items.zh: 如果你星期一要開始新工作，換作是我，星期天會早點睡。

items.en: If you're buying a used car, I would take a mechanic with you.
