items.zh: 如果你要買二手車，我會帶個技師一起去。

items.en: If you're visiting Scotland, I'd take a waterproof jacket.
items.zh: 如果你要去蘇格蘭，我會帶一件防水外套。

examples.heading: ⑤ 祈使句

items.en: If you're travelling with friends, choose them carefully.
items.zh: 如果你要和朋友去旅行，要小心挑選旅伴。

items.en: If you're applying for that job, ask your teacher for a reference.
items.zh: 如果你要應徵那份工作，請老師幫你寫推薦信。

items.en: If you're having a party, remember to tell the neighbours.
items.zh: 如果你要辦派對，記得跟鄰居說一聲。

items.en: If you're choosing a new school, visit a few of them first.
items.zh: 如果你在挑新學校，先去幾間看看。

items.en: If you're going camping, don't forget a torch.
items.zh: 如果你要去露營，別忘了帶手電筒。

title: If you come to Brazil, you can stay at my home.
translation: 如果你來巴西，可以住我家。
name: if 現在簡單式加情態動詞的條件句
sentences: If you're free on Thursday, you can join us for dinner.
If it stops raining, the kids can play in the garden.
If you pass your driving test, you can borrow my car.
If we get there early, we can find good seats.
If he needs a lift, he can come with us.
If you don't like fish, you can have the chicken instead.
If the hotel is full, we can try the campsite.
If the traffic is heavy, we might be a bit late.
If you ask nicely, she may lend you her camera.
If it's sunny tomorrow, we might go to the beach.
If they don't hurry, they may miss the last bus.
If I finish my homework, I might watch a film later.
If the price goes down, more people may buy it.
If you leave the window open, the cat might get out.
If we leave at six, we could be there by lunch.
If you don't wear a coat, you could catch a cold.
If the weather stays fine, we could have a barbecue.
If you're bored, you could help me in the kitchen.
If she gets the scholarship, she could study in Japan.
If the meeting ends early, we could go for a coffee.
If you go to Paris, you should visit the Louvre.
If your tooth still hurts tomorrow, you should see a dentist.
If you borrow my bike, you must bring it back by Friday.
If the alarm goes off, everyone must leave the building.
If you want a good seat, you should book early.
If he wants to join the team, he must come to training.
If you see Anna, you should tell her the news.
You can borrow my laptop if yours breaks.
We might go swimming if the pool is open.
You should take an umbrella if the sky looks grey.
I could pick you up if your train arrives late.
The children may get bored if the film is too long.

examples.heading: ① 主要子句用 can

items.en: If you're free on Thursday, you can join us for dinner.
items.zh: 如果你星期四有空，可以跟我們一起吃晚餐。

items.en: If it stops raining, the kids can play in the garden.
items.zh: 如果雨停了，孩子們可以在花園玩。

items.en: If you pass your driving test, you can borrow my car.
items.zh: 如果你考過駕照，可以借我的車。

items.en: If we get there early, we can find good seats.
items.zh: 如果我們早點到，就能找到好位子。

items.en: If he needs a lift, he can come with us.
items.zh: 如果他需要搭便車，可以跟我們一起走。

items.en: If you don't like fish, you can have the chicken instead.
items.zh: 如果你不喜歡魚，可以改點雞肉。

items.en: If the hotel is full, we can try the campsite.
items.zh: 如果飯店客滿，我們可以試試露營區。

examples.heading: ② 主要子句用 may 或 might

items.en: If the traffic is heavy, we might be a bit late.
items.zh: 如果車很多，我們可能會晚一點到。

items.en: If you ask nicely, she may lend you her camera.
items.zh: 如果你好好拜託，她可能會借你相機。

items.en: If it's sunny tomorrow, we might go to the beach.
items.zh: 如果明天出太陽，我們可能會去海邊。

items.en: If they don't hurry, they may miss the last bus.
items.zh: 如果他們不快一點，可能會錯過末班公車。

items.en: If I finish my homework, I might watch a film later.
items.zh: 如果我寫完作業，晚點可能會看部電影。

items.en: If the price goes down, more people may buy it.
items.zh: 如果降價，可能會有更多人買。

items.en: If you leave the window open, the cat might get out.
items.zh: 如果你讓窗戶開著，貓可能會跑出去。

examples.heading: ③ 主要子句用 could

items.en: If we leave at six, we could be there by lunch.
items.zh: 如果我們六點出發，中午前可能就到了。

items.en: If you don't wear a coat, you could catch a cold.
items.zh: 如果你不穿外套，可能會感冒。

items.en: If the weather stays fine, we could have a barbecue.
items.zh: 如果天氣一直很好，我們可以烤肉。

items.en: If you're bored, you could help me in the kitchen.
items.zh: 如果你很無聊，可以來廚房幫我。

items.en: If she gets the scholarship, she could study in Japan.
items.zh: 如果她拿到獎學金，就可以去日本讀書。

items.en: If the meeting ends early, we could go for a coffee.
items.zh: 如果會議提早結束，我們可以去喝杯咖啡。

examples.heading: ④ 主要子句用 should 或 must

items.en: If you go to Paris, you should visit the Louvre.
items.zh: 如果你去巴黎，應該去羅浮宮看看。

items.en: If your tooth still hurts tomorrow, you should see a dentist.
items.zh: 如果你的牙明天還痛，應該去看牙醫。

items.en: If you borrow my bike, you must bring it back by Friday.
items.zh: 如果你借我的腳踏車，星期五前一定要還。

items.en: If the alarm goes off, everyone must leave the building.
items.zh: 如果警報響了，每個人都必須離開大樓。

items.en: If you want a good seat, you should book early.
items.zh: 如果你想要好位子，應該早點訂。

items.en: If he wants to join the team, he must come to training.
items.zh: 如果他想加入球隊，就必須來練習。

items.en: If you see Anna, you should tell her the news.
items.zh: 如果你見到 Anna，應該把這個消息告訴她。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主要子句在前面

items.en: You can borrow my laptop if yours breaks.
items.zh: 如果你的筆電壞了，可以借我的。

items.en: We might go swimming if the pool is open.
items.zh: 如果游泳池有開，我們可能會去游泳。

items.en: You should take an umbrella if the sky looks grey.
items.zh: 如果天色看起來很灰，你應該帶把傘。

items.en: I could pick you up if your train arrives late.
items.zh: 如果你的火車晚到，我可以去接你。

items.en: The children may get bored if the film is too long.
items.zh: 如果電影太長，孩子們可能會覺得無聊。

title: If I have spare time, I always read a book.
translation: 只要有空，我都會看書。
name: 表示真實條件的 if 子句
sentences: If my train is late, I usually get a coffee at the station.
If it's sunny, we often have lunch on the balcony.
If Tom can't sleep, he listens to the radio.
If I eat too late, I sleep badly.
If the baby cries at night, my husband usually gets up.
If we go to the cinema, we always buy popcorn.
If my grandma visits, she brings a cake.
If you have a library card, you can borrow six books.
If you're over sixty, you can travel free on the bus.
If it's not too windy, the children can play on the beach.
If you book online, you can choose your seat.
If the door is locked, you can use the back entrance.
If you live near the school, you can walk there.
If you don't understand a word, you can look it up.
If you need to contact me, just call my mobile.
If you're cold, put on a jumper.
If the phone rings, don't answer it.
If you see smoke, leave the building at once.
If you have any questions, ask Maria.
If the milk smells bad, throw it away.
If you need some help, I'm here.
If you want the keys, they're on the kitchen table.
If you need a pen, there's one in my bag.
If you like Italian food, there's a great restaurant round the corner.
If you're hungry, there are some sandwiches on the table.
If you want a quiet place to study, the library is open until nine.
You can get to the stadium if you take the number 35 bus.
My dog barks if someone knocks on the door.
I always take the stairs if the lift is busy.
Call reception if you need anything.
My parents worry if I come home late.
Students can leave early if they finish the test.

examples.heading: ① 習慣和每次都會發生的事

items.en: If my train is late, I usually get a coffee at the station.
items.zh: 如果火車誤點，我通常會在車站買杯咖啡。

items.en: If it's sunny, we often have lunch on the balcony.
items.zh: 天氣好的話，我們常在陽台吃午餐。

items.en: If Tom can't sleep, he listens to the radio.
items.zh: Tom 睡不著的時候，會聽收音機。

items.en: If I eat too late, I sleep badly.
items.zh: 如果我太晚吃東西，就會睡不好。

items.en: If the baby cries at night, my husband usually gets up.
items.zh: 寶寶晚上哭的話，通常是我先生起來。

items.en: If we go to the cinema, we always buy popcorn.
items.zh: 我們去看電影的話，都會買爆米花。

items.en: If my grandma visits, she brings a cake.
items.zh: 奶奶來的話，都會帶蛋糕。

examples.heading: ② can 說可以做的事

items.en: If you have a library card, you can borrow six books.
items.zh: 如果你有借書證，可以借六本書。

items.en: If you're over sixty, you can travel free on the bus.
items.zh: 如果你超過六十歲，可以免費搭公車。

items.en: If it's not too windy, the children can play on the beach.
items.zh: 如果風不太大，孩子們可以在海灘玩。

items.en: If you book online, you can choose your seat.
items.zh: 如果你在網路上訂，可以自己選位子。

items.en: If the door is locked, you can use the back entrance.
items.zh: 如果門鎖著，你可以走後門。

items.en: If you live near the school, you can walk there.
items.zh: 如果你住在學校附近，可以走路去。

items.en: If you don't understand a word, you can look it up.
items.zh: 如果你看不懂某個字，可以查一查。

examples.heading: ③ 祈使句

items.en: If you need to contact me, just call my mobile.
items.zh: 如果你需要聯絡我，打我手機就好。

items.en: If you're cold, put on a jumper.
items.zh: 如果你冷，就穿件毛衣。

items.en: If the phone rings, don't answer it.
items.zh: 如果電話響了，別接。

items.en: If you see smoke, leave the building at once.
items.zh: 如果你看到煙，馬上離開大樓。

items.en: If you have any questions, ask Maria.
items.zh: 如果你有任何問題，問 Maria。

items.en: If the milk smells bad, throw it away.
items.zh: 如果牛奶聞起來壞了，就丟掉。

examples.heading: ④ 告訴對方去哪裡找

items.en: If you need some help, I'm here.
items.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，我在這裡。

items.en: If you want the keys, they're on the kitchen table.
items.zh: 如果你要鑰匙，就在廚房桌上。

items.en: If you need a pen, there's one in my bag.
items.zh: 如果你需要筆，我包包裡有一支。

items.en: If you like Italian food, there's a great restaurant round the corner.
items.zh: 如果你喜歡義大利菜，轉角有家很棒的餐廳。

items.en: If you're hungry, there are some sandwiches on the table.
items.zh: 如果你餓了，桌上有三明治。

items.en: If you want a quiet place to study, the library is open until nine.
items.zh: 如果你想找安靜的地方讀書，圖書館開到九點。

examples.heading: ⑤ 條件放在後面

items.en: You can get to the stadium if you take the number 35 bus.
items.zh: 你搭三十五號公車就可以到體育場。

items.en: My dog barks if someone knocks on the door.
items.zh: 有人敲門的話，我的狗就會叫。

items.en: I always take the stairs if the lift is busy.
items.zh: 電梯人多的話，我都走樓梯。

items.en: Call reception if you need anything.
items.zh: 你需要什麼的話，就打給櫃台。

items.en: My parents worry if I come home late.
items.zh: 我晚回家的話，我爸媽會擔心。

items.en: Students can leave early if they finish the test.
items.zh: 學生考完的話，可以提早離開。

title: I'm sure your parents will be happy if you go with them.
translation: 我相信如果你跟你爸媽一起去，他們會很高興。
name: 第一條件句（if 現在簡單式加 will）
sentences: If you tell them your reasons, they'll understand.
If Mark gets the job, he'll buy a new car.
If we miss this train, we'll have to wait an hour.
If you live in the countryside, you'll see a lot of wildlife.
If the shop has my size, I'll buy those boots.
If she practises every day, she'll be ready for the concert.
If you leave the milk out, it'll go off.
I'll send you the photos if you give me your email.
Grandma will be pleased if you phone her on her birthday.
We'll have the party in the garden if the weather is good.
The plants will grow faster if you put them by the window.
He'll be tired tomorrow if he stays up late.
I'll make some soup if you're hungry.
If you don't take a map, you'll get lost.
If it doesn't rain soon, the river will dry up.
If we don't book now, there won't be any seats left.
If you eat all those sweets, you won't want your dinner.
She won't come if you don't invite her.
If he doesn't apologise, I won't speak to him again.
If they don't fix the heating, the office will be freezing tomorrow.
What will you do if you don't get a place at university?
Will you call me if you hear any news?
If it rains on Saturday, where will we have the picnic?
Who will look after the dog if you go away?
If the trains are on strike, how will you get to work?
Will they be angry if we're late?
I'm sure you'll love Rome if you go in the spring.
I think the teacher will let you leave early if you ask.
I'm sure she'll help you if you explain the problem.
I think we'll be late if we wait for Tom.
The team will probably win if Sara plays.
I'm sure your boss will understand if you need a day off.

examples.heading: ① 條件在前面

items.en: If you tell them your reasons, they'll understand.
items.zh: 如果你跟他們說你的理由，他們會理解的。

items.en: If Mark gets the job, he'll buy a new car.
items.zh: 如果 Mark 得到那份工作，他會買一輛新車。

items.en: If we miss this train, we'll have to wait an hour.
items.zh: 如果我們錯過這班火車，就得等一個小時。

items.en: If you live in the countryside, you'll see a lot of wildlife.
items.zh: 如果你住在鄉下，會看到很多野生動物。

items.en: If the shop has my size, I'll buy those boots.
items.zh: 如果那家店有我的尺寸，我會買那雙靴子。

items.en: If she practises every day, she'll be ready for the concert.
items.zh: 如果她每天練習，就能準備好參加音樂會。

items.en: If you leave the milk out, it'll go off.
items.zh: 如果你把牛奶放在外面，它會壞掉。

examples.heading: ② 條件在後面

items.en: I'll send you the photos if you give me your email.
items.zh: 如果你給我電子郵件，我會把照片傳給你。

items.en: Grandma will be pleased if you phone her on her birthday.
items.zh: 如果你在奶奶生日那天打電話給她，她會很高興。

items.en: We'll have the party in the garden if the weather is good.
items.zh: 如果天氣好，我們會在花園辦派對。

items.en: The plants will grow faster if you put them by the window.
items.zh: 如果你把植物放在窗邊，它們會長得比較快。

items.en: He'll be tired tomorrow if he stays up late.
items.zh: 如果他熬夜，明天會很累。

items.en: I'll make some soup if you're hungry.
items.zh: 如果你餓了，我會煮點湯。

examples.heading: ③ don't 和 won't

items.en: If you don't take a map, you'll get lost.
items.zh: 如果你不帶地圖，會迷路。

items.en: If it doesn't rain soon, the river will dry up.
items.zh: 如果不快點下雨，河會乾掉。

items.en: If we don't book now, there won't be any seats left.
items.zh: 如果我們現在不訂，就沒有位子了。

items.en: If you eat all those sweets, you won't want your dinner.
items.zh: 如果你把那些糖果都吃掉，就會不想吃晚餐。

items.en: She won't come if you don't invite her.
items.zh: 如果你不邀請她，她不會來。

items.en: If he doesn't apologise, I won't speak to him again.
items.zh: 如果他不道歉，我就再也不跟他說話。

items.en: If they don't fix the heating, the office will be freezing tomorrow.
items.zh: 如果他們不修暖氣，明天辦公室會冷得要命。

examples.heading: ④ 問會怎麼樣

items.en: What will you do if you don't get a place at university?
items.zh: 如果你沒申請到大學，你會怎麼辦？

items.en: Will you call me if you hear any news?
items.zh: 如果你聽到任何消息，會打給我嗎？

items.en: If it rains on Saturday, where will we have the picnic?
items.zh: 如果星期六下雨，我們要在哪裡野餐？

items.en: Who will look after the dog if you go away?
items.zh: 如果你出遠門，誰會照顧狗？

items.en: If the trains are on strike, how will you get to work?
items.zh: 如果火車罷工，你要怎麼去上班？

items.en: Will they be angry if we're late?
items.zh: 如果我們遲到，他們會生氣嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ I'm sure、I think、probably

items.en: I'm sure you'll love Rome if you go in the spring.
items.zh: 我相信如果你春天去，一定會愛上羅馬。

items.en: I think the teacher will let you leave early if you ask.
items.zh: 我想如果你去問，老師會讓你早點走。

items.en: I'm sure she'll help you if you explain the problem.
items.zh: 我相信如果你把問題說清楚，她會幫你。

items.en: I think we'll be late if we wait for Tom.
items.zh: 我想如果我們等 Tom，會遲到。

items.en: The team will probably win if Sara plays.
items.zh: 如果 Sara 上場，球隊可能會贏。

items.en: I'm sure your boss will understand if you need a day off.
items.zh: 我相信如果你需要請一天假，你老闆會諒解的。

title: To contact me, you can call me on my mobile phone.
translation: 要聯絡我的話，你可以打我的手機。
name: 表示目的的不定詞子句
sentences: To reach the museum, take the number 12 bus.
To find our office, look for the blue door next to the bakery.
To book a table, call us after ten.
To get a discount, show your student card.
To open the box, pull the red tab.
To turn on the heater, press this button twice.
To save money, we cook at home every night.
To stay healthy, my grandmother walks every morning.
To improve my English, I watch films without subtitles.
To catch the first train, I had to get up at five.
To make the cake softer, add a little more milk.
I called the hotel to change my booking.
She's going to Japan to visit her cousin.
We stopped at a café to have a rest.
He opened the window to let some air in.
I use this app to learn new words.
They moved to the countryside to have a quieter life.
A: Why did you go to the post office? B: To send a parcel.
A: Why are you learning Spanish? B: To talk to my wife's family.
A: Why did he call? B: To say thank you.
A: Why do you get up so early? B: To go running before work.
A: Why are you at the bank? B: To open an account.
To join the club, fill in this form.
I set two alarms to make sure I wake up.
To specify a delivery time, choose it at checkout.
My dad works two jobs to pay for my studies.
To get good seats, we arrived an hour early.
I'm writing to ask about the job in your shop.
To keep the milk fresh, put it in the fridge.
She turned off her phone to concentrate on her homework.

examples.heading: ① To + 原形動詞放在前面：指路和方法

items.en: To reach the museum, take the number 12 bus.
items.zh: 要去博物館的話，搭 12 號公車。

items.en: To find our office, look for the blue door next to the bakery.
items.zh: 要找我們辦公室的話，就找麵包店旁邊的藍色門。

items.en: To book a table, call us after ten.
items.zh: 要訂位的話，十點以後打給我們。

items.en: To get a discount, show your student card.
items.zh: 要打折的話，出示你的學生證。

items.en: To open the box, pull the red tab.
items.zh: 要打開盒子，就拉那個紅色的拉片。

items.en: To turn on the heater, press this button twice.
items.zh: 要開暖氣的話，按這個按鈕兩下。

examples.heading: ② To + 原形動詞放在前面：其他目的

items.en: To save money, we cook at home every night.
items.zh: 為了省錢，我們每天晚上都在家煮。

items.en: To stay healthy, my grandmother walks every morning.
items.zh: 為了保持健康，我奶奶每天早上都去散步。

items.en: To improve my English, I watch films without subtitles.
items.zh: 為了加強英文，我看電影不看字幕。

items.en: To catch the first train, I had to get up at five.
items.zh: 為了趕上第一班火車，我五點就得起床。

items.en: To make the cake softer, add a little more milk.
items.zh: 要讓蛋糕軟一點，就多加一點牛奶。

examples.heading: ③ 主要子句 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: I called the hotel to change my booking.
items.zh: 我打電話給飯店改訂房。

items.en: She's going to Japan to visit her cousin.
items.zh: 她要去日本看她的表妹。

items.en: We stopped at a café to have a rest.
items.zh: 我們在一家咖啡店停下來休息。

items.en: He opened the window to let some air in.
items.zh: 他打開窗戶讓空氣進來。

items.en: I use this app to learn new words.
items.zh: 我用這個應用程式學新單字。

items.en: They moved to the countryside to have a quieter life.
items.zh: 他們搬到鄉下去過比較安靜的生活。

examples.heading: ④ 回答 Why 的問題

items.en: A: Why did you go to the post office? B: To send a parcel.
items.zh: A：你為什麼去郵局？B：去寄包裹。

items.en: A: Why are you learning Spanish? B: To talk to my wife's family.
items.zh: A：你為什麼在學西班牙文？B：為了跟我太太的家人說話。

items.en: A: Why did he call? B: To say thank you.
items.zh: A：他為什麼打來？B：為了說聲謝謝。

items.en: A: Why do you get up so early? B: To go running before work.
items.zh: A：你為什麼那麼早起？B：為了上班前去跑步。

items.en: A: Why are you at the bank? B: To open an account.
items.zh: A：你為什麼在銀行？B：來開戶。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: To join the club, fill in this form.
items.zh: 要加入社團的話，填這張表。

items.en: I set two alarms to make sure I wake up.
items.zh: 我設了兩個鬧鐘，確保我會醒來。

items.en: To specify a delivery time, choose it at checkout.
items.zh: 要指定送貨時間的話，結帳時選擇。

items.en: My dad works two jobs to pay for my studies.
items.zh: 我爸爸做兩份工作來付我的學費。

items.en: To get good seats, we arrived an hour early.
items.zh: 為了搶到好位子，我們提早一個小時到。

items.en: I'm writing to ask about the job in your shop.
items.zh: 我寫信來是想詢問貴店的工作。

items.en: To keep the milk fresh, put it in the fridge.
items.zh: 要讓牛奶保持新鮮，就放進冰箱。

items.en: She turned off her phone to concentrate on her homework.
items.zh: 她把手機關掉，好專心寫功課。

title: Could you please give me some extra exercises so that I can cover the work I missed?
translation: 可以請你多給我一些練習，讓我把缺的進度補上嗎？
name: so that 和 in order that 引導的目的副詞子句
sentences: Move the plant to the window so that it gets more sun.
I'll give you my number so that you can call me.
Leave the door open so that the cat can come in.
I'm taking notes so that I'll remember everything.
Put the milk in the fridge so that it stays fresh.
Let's start early so that we can finish by lunch.
We moved closer to the city so that the kids could walk to school.
He whispered so that nobody else would hear.
I set two alarms so that I wouldn't oversleep.
She saved for months so that she could visit her family.
They booked early so that they would get a room with a view.
I left the light on so that you could find your way.
Text me when you arrive so I know you're safe.
Write it down so you don't forget.
Can you move your bag so I can sit down?
Tell me your size so I can order the right shirt.
Charge your phone tonight so it's full for the trip.
Please arrive early in order that we can start on time.
The museum opens late on Fridays in order that people can visit after work.
Staff must wear name badges in order that visitors can identify them.
We have simplified the form in order that customers can complete it quickly.
The teacher spoke slowly in order that the new students would understand.
I'm learning Spanish so that I can talk to my in-laws.
Turn off your phone so that it doesn't ring during the film.
She specified the delivery date so that the cake would arrive on time.
We painted the room white so that it would look bigger.
I'm cooking extra rice so that we'll have lunch tomorrow.
He wore a hat so that nobody would recognize him.
Could you send me the slides so that I can review them tonight?
Lock the gate so that the dog can't get out.

examples.heading: ① so that + can / will

items.en: Move the plant to the window so that it gets more sun.
items.zh: 把盆栽移到窗邊，讓它多曬點太陽。

items.en: I'll give you my number so that you can call me.
items.zh: 我給你我的電話，你就可以打給我。

items.en: Leave the door open so that the cat can come in.
items.zh: 門開著，讓貓可以進來。

items.en: I'm taking notes so that I'll remember everything.
items.zh: 我在做筆記，才會記得所有的事。

items.en: Put the milk in the fridge so that it stays fresh.
items.zh: 把牛奶放進冰箱，才能保持新鮮。

items.en: Let's start early so that we can finish by lunch.
items.zh: 我們早點開始，才能在午餐前做完。

examples.heading: ② so that + could / would（過去）

items.en: We moved closer to the city so that the kids could walk to school.
items.zh: 我們搬到離市區近一點的地方，讓孩子可以走路上學。

items.en: He whispered so that nobody else would hear.
items.zh: 他小聲說話，免得別人聽到。

items.en: I set two alarms so that I wouldn't oversleep.
items.zh: 我設了兩個鬧鐘，免得睡過頭。

items.en: She saved for months so that she could visit her family.
items.zh: 她存了好幾個月的錢，才能去看她的家人。

items.en: They booked early so that they would get a room with a view.
items.zh: 他們很早就訂了，才能拿到有景觀的房間。

items.en: I left the light on so that you could find your way.
items.zh: 我把燈開著，讓你可以找到路。

examples.heading: ③ 口語的 so

items.en: Text me when you arrive so I know you're safe.
items.zh: 你到了傳訊息給我，我才知道你平安。

items.en: Write it down so you don't forget.
items.zh: 把它寫下來，你才不會忘記。

items.en: Can you move your bag so I can sit down?
items.zh: 你可以把包包移開讓我坐下嗎？

items.en: Tell me your size so I can order the right shirt.
items.zh: 跟我說你的尺寸，我才能訂對的襯衫。

items.en: Charge your phone tonight so it's full for the trip.
items.zh: 今晚把手機充電，出門的時候才會是滿的。

examples.heading: ④ in order that（正式）

items.en: Please arrive early in order that we can start on time.
items.zh: 請提早到，好讓我們準時開始。

items.en: The museum opens late on Fridays in order that people can visit after work.
items.zh: 博物館星期五開到很晚，好讓大家下班後可以去參觀。

items.en: Staff must wear name badges in order that visitors can identify them.
items.zh: 員工必須配戴名牌，好讓訪客認得出他們。

items.en: We have simplified the form in order that customers can complete it quickly.
items.zh: 我們簡化了表格，好讓客戶可以很快填完。

items.en: The teacher spoke slowly in order that the new students would understand.
items.zh: 老師說得很慢，好讓新同學聽得懂。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: I'm learning Spanish so that I can talk to my in-laws.
items.zh: 我在學西班牙文，才能跟我的姻親說話。

items.en: Turn off your phone so that it doesn't ring during the film.
items.zh: 把手機關掉，免得電影播放時響起來。

items.en: She specified the delivery date so that the cake would arrive on time.
items.zh: 她指定了送貨日期，好讓蛋糕準時送到。

items.en: We painted the room white so that it would look bigger.
items.zh: 我們把房間漆成白色，讓它看起來大一點。

items.en: I'm cooking extra rice so that we'll have lunch tomorrow.
items.zh: 我多煮了一些飯，明天的午餐就有了。

items.en: He wore a hat so that nobody would recognize him.
items.zh: 他戴了帽子，免得被人認出來。

items.en: Could you send me the slides so that I can review them tonight?
items.zh: 你可以把投影片寄給我，讓我今晚看一下嗎？

items.en: Lock the gate so that the dog can't get out.
items.zh: 把大門鎖上，免得狗跑出去。

title: Eat healthy foods rather than fatty foods.
translation: 要吃健康的食物，不要吃油膩的食物。
name: rather than 加名詞片語或介系詞片語
sentences: The school nurse talked to the parents about lunch boxes. Choose healthy snacks rather than chips.
I ate here last week. Order the soup rather than the salad.
Petrol is very expensive now. Use your bike rather than the car for short trips.
We wanted to be near the lake. We booked a cabin rather than a hotel room.
The dentist looked at my son's teeth. Drink water rather than soda with your meals, she said.
My sister wanted to save money. She bought a used car rather than a new one.
Big schools have more clubs and sports. Some parents think it's better to go to a large school rather than a small one.
Coffee keeps me awake at night. I'd prefer tea rather than coffee, thanks.
My parents are going to Bali for a rest. They want a quiet hotel rather than a big one.
It's a lovely sunny day. Let's have a picnic rather than a restaurant meal.
My girlfriend is on a diet. On Valentine's Day I gave her flowers rather than chocolates.
The room is small. Put the sofa against the wall rather than in the middle.
The station is always crowded on Fridays. Let's meet at the café rather than at the station.
It's too hot inside today. We'll eat in the garden rather than in the kitchen.
The cat keeps eating the leaves. Put the plant on the table rather than on the floor.
My grandparents keep chickens and grow vegetables. They live in the country rather than in the city.
I go to bed at nine these days. Call me in the morning rather than at night.
The taxi driver has no change. Pay by card rather than in cash.
Japan is very hot in August. Go in spring rather than in summer.
The form must arrive by Friday. Send it by email rather than by post.
Your homework will take an hour. Do it now rather than later.
The airport bus is only five dollars. Why not take the bus rather than a taxi?
We can finish the new kitchen in a week. The problem is the cost rather than the time.
I'll be fine after the flood, but I'm worried about my mother rather than myself.
The children tell Miss Wu all their secrets. She's a friend rather than a teacher to them.
Everything is low and you can touch it all. The museum is for children rather than adults.
The subway is closed for repairs today. Should we take the bus rather than the tram?
Our Chinese partners joined the call. Everyone spoke English rather than Spanish at the meeting.
I usually read the news online rather than in the paper.
You can't sleep after your evening run. Try running in the morning rather than in the evening.

examples.heading: ① 名詞片語 + rather than + 名詞片語

items.en: The school nurse talked to the parents about lunch boxes. Choose healthy snacks rather than chips.
items.zh: 學校護理師跟家長談午餐盒的事。選健康的點心，不要選洋芋片。

items.en: I ate here last week. Order the soup rather than the salad.
items.zh: 我上星期在這裡吃過。點湯，別點沙拉。

items.en: Petrol is very expensive now. Use your bike rather than the car for short trips.
items.zh: 現在汽油很貴。短程就騎腳踏車，不要開車。

items.en: We wanted to be near the lake. We booked a cabin rather than a hotel room.
items.zh: 我們想住在湖邊。我們訂了小木屋，沒訂飯店房間。

items.en: The dentist looked at my son's teeth. Drink water rather than soda with your meals, she said.
items.zh: 牙醫看了我兒子的牙齒。她說：吃飯配水，不要配汽水。

items.en: My sister wanted to save money. She bought a used car rather than a new one.
items.zh: 我姊姊想省錢。她買了中古車，沒買新車。

examples.heading: ② 說喜好和選擇

items.en: Big schools have more clubs and sports. Some parents think it's better to go to a large school rather than a small one.
items.zh: 大學校有比較多社團和運動。有些家長認為讀規模大的學校比讀小的學校好。

items.en: Coffee keeps me awake at night. I'd prefer tea rather than coffee, thanks.
items.zh: 咖啡會讓我晚上睡不著。我想喝茶，不喝咖啡，謝謝。

items.en: My parents are going to Bali for a rest. They want a quiet hotel rather than a big one.
items.zh: 我爸媽要去峇里島休息。他們想要安靜的飯店，不要大飯店。

items.en: It's a lovely sunny day. Let's have a picnic rather than a restaurant meal.
items.zh: 今天天氣很好。我們去野餐吧，不要上館子。

items.en: My girlfriend is on a diet. On Valentine's Day I gave her flowers rather than chocolates.
items.zh: 我女朋友在節食。情人節我送她花，沒送巧克力。

examples.heading: ③ 介系詞片語 + rather than + 介系詞片語

items.en: The room is small. Put the sofa against the wall rather than in the middle.
items.zh: 房間很小。把沙發靠牆放，不要放在中間。

items.en: The station is always crowded on Fridays. Let's meet at the café rather than at the station.
items.zh: 車站星期五總是很擠。我們在咖啡店碰面，不要在車站。

items.en: It's too hot inside today. We'll eat in the garden rather than in the kitchen.
items.zh: 今天屋子裡太熱了。我們在花園吃，不在廚房吃。

items.en: The cat keeps eating the leaves. Put the plant on the table rather than on the floor.
items.zh: 貓一直吃葉子。把植物放在桌上，不要放在地上。

items.en: My grandparents keep chickens and grow vegetables. They live in the country rather than in the city.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶養雞，也種菜。他們住在鄉下，不住城市。

examples.heading: ④ 時間和方式

items.en: I go to bed at nine these days. Call me in the morning rather than at night.
items.zh: 我最近九點就睡了。早上打給我，不要晚上打。

items.en: The taxi driver has no change. Pay by card rather than in cash.
items.zh: 計程車司機沒有零錢。用卡付，不要付現金。

items.en: Japan is very hot in August. Go in spring rather than in summer.
items.zh: 日本八月很熱。春天去，不要夏天去。

items.en: The form must arrive by Friday. Send it by email rather than by post.
items.zh: 表格星期五前要送到。用電子郵件寄，不要用郵寄。

items.en: Your homework will take an hour. Do it now rather than later.
items.zh: 你的作業要花一個小時。現在就做，不要等以後。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: The airport bus is only five dollars. Why not take the bus rather than a taxi?
items.zh: 機場巴士只要五塊。何不搭公車，別搭計程車？

items.en: We can finish the new kitchen in a week. The problem is the cost rather than the time.
items.zh: 我們一個星期就可以做好新廚房。問題在於費用，而不是時間。

items.en: I'll be fine after the flood, but I'm worried about my mother rather than myself.
items.zh: 淹水以後我會沒事，可是我擔心的是我媽媽，而不是我自己。

items.en: The children tell Miss Wu all their secrets. She's a friend rather than a teacher to them.
items.zh: 孩子們把所有秘密都告訴吳老師。對他們來說，她比較像朋友，而不是老師。

items.en: Everything is low and you can touch it all. The museum is for children rather than adults.
items.zh: 每樣東西都放得很低，全部都可以摸。那間博物館是給小孩的，不是給大人的。

items.en: The subway is closed for repairs today. Should we take the bus rather than the tram?
items.zh: 地鐵今天停駛維修。我們要搭公車，不搭電車嗎？

items.en: Our Chinese partners joined the call. Everyone spoke English rather than Spanish at the meeting.
items.zh: 我們的中國合作夥伴也加入了通話。大家在會議上說英文，不說西班牙文。

items.en: I usually read the news online rather than in the paper.
items.zh: 我通常在網路上看新聞，不看報紙。

items.en: You can't sleep after your evening run. Try running in the morning rather than in the evening.
items.zh: 你晚上跑完步就睡不著。試試早上跑步，不要晚上跑。

title: I am going to be absent from my English class next week, as I am traveling to Italy.
translation: 我下週英文課會請假，因為我要去義大利。
name: 放在主要子句後的原因副詞子句
sentences: I'll be working from home tomorrow, as the office is closed.
Please reply by Friday, as we need to book the hotel.
She didn't eat much, as she wasn't feeling well.
I'd like to change my appointment, as I have to work that day.
We stayed inside, as it was too hot to go out.
I'm writing to you, as I saw your advertisement in the newspaper.
I can't lend you the car, since I need it this weekend.
We ordered pizza, since nobody wanted to cook.
Let's take the stairs, since the lift is out of order.
I won't be at the class on Monday, since I have a dentist appointment.
You should ask Tom, since he knows the city well.
They're selling their car, since they hardly ever use it.
I'm afraid I can't attend the party, as I'll be abroad.
Please send the documents again, as the file didn't open.
I would like a refund, since the product arrived damaged.
We need a new printer for the office, since the old one keeps breaking down.
I'd prefer to meet on Thursday, as I'm busy on Wednesday.
He was late for work, as he missed his train.
I'll take a jacket, since it gets cold in the evening.
We've decided to stay home this summer, as flights are so expensive.
She had to leave early, as her son was sick.
I haven't called her yet, since I don't know her number.
Speak slowly, as my English isn't very good.
We chose this hotel, since it's close to the beach.
I'll do the shopping, as you did it last week.
He's very thrifty, since he's saving for a house.
The kids went to bed early, as they were exhausted.
Bring some cash, since the market doesn't take cards.
I couldn't finish the report, as my computer crashed.
Let's walk to the restaurant, since it's only ten minutes away.

examples.heading: ① as

items.en: I'll be working from home tomorrow, as the office is closed.
items.zh: 我明天會在家工作，因為辦公室不開。

items.en: Please reply by Friday, as we need to book the hotel.
items.zh: 請在星期五前回覆，因為我們要訂飯店。

items.en: She didn't eat much, as she wasn't feeling well.
items.zh: 她沒吃多少，因為她不太舒服。

items.en: I'd like to change my appointment, as I have to work that day.
items.zh: 我想改我的預約時間，因為我那天要上班。

items.en: We stayed inside, as it was too hot to go out.
items.zh: 我們待在室內，因為外面太熱了。

items.en: I'm writing to you, as I saw your advertisement in the newspaper.
items.zh: 我寫信給你，因為我在報紙上看到你們的廣告。

examples.heading: ② since

items.en: I can't lend you the car, since I need it this weekend.
items.zh: 我不能借你車，因為我這個週末要用。

items.en: We ordered pizza, since nobody wanted to cook.
items.zh: 我們叫了披薩，因為沒人想煮飯。

items.en: Let's take the stairs, since the lift is out of order.
items.zh: 我們走樓梯吧，因為電梯故障了。

items.en: I won't be at the class on Monday, since I have a dentist appointment.
items.zh: 我星期一不會去上課，因為我要看牙醫。

items.en: You should ask Tom, since he knows the city well.
items.zh: 你應該問 Tom，因為他對這個城市很熟。

items.en: They're selling their car, since they hardly ever use it.
items.zh: 他們要賣車，因為他們幾乎不開。

examples.heading: ③ 信件和電子郵件

items.en: I'm afraid I can't attend the party, as I'll be abroad.
items.zh: 恐怕我不能參加派對，因為我會在國外。

items.en: Please send the documents again, as the file didn't open.
items.zh: 請再寄一次文件，因為檔案打不開。

items.en: I would like a refund, since the product arrived damaged.
items.zh: 我想要退款，因為產品送到時已經壞了。

items.en: We need a new printer for the office, since the old one keeps breaking down.
items.zh: 辦公室需要一台新的印表機，因為舊的一直壞。

items.en: I'd prefer to meet on Thursday, as I'm busy on Wednesday.
items.zh: 我比較想約星期四，因為我星期三很忙。

examples.heading: ④ 不同的時態

items.en: He was late for work, as he missed his train.
items.zh: 他上班遲到，因為他沒趕上火車。

items.en: I'll take a jacket, since it gets cold in the evening.
items.zh: 我會帶件外套，因為晚上會變冷。

items.en: We've decided to stay home this summer, as flights are so expensive.
items.zh: 我們決定今年夏天待在家，因為機票太貴了。

items.en: She had to leave early, as her son was sick.
items.zh: 她得提早走，因為她兒子生病了。

items.en: I haven't called her yet, since I don't know her number.
items.zh: 我還沒打給她，因為我不知道她的電話。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Speak slowly, as my English isn't very good.
items.zh: 說慢一點，因為我的英文不太好。

items.en: We chose this hotel, since it's close to the beach.
items.zh: 我們選這家飯店，因為它離海灘很近。

items.en: I'll do the shopping, as you did it last week.
items.zh: 我去買東西，因為上禮拜是你去的。

items.en: He's very thrifty, since he's saving for a house.
items.zh: 他很節儉，因為他在存錢買房子。

items.en: The kids went to bed early, as they were exhausted.
items.zh: 孩子們很早就睡了，因為他們累壞了。

items.en: Bring some cash, since the market doesn't take cards.
items.zh: 帶點現金，因為市場不收卡。

items.en: I couldn't finish the report, as my computer crashed.
items.zh: 我沒辦法完成報告，因為我的電腦當機了。

items.en: Let's walk to the restaurant, since it's only ten minutes away.
items.zh: 我們走路去餐廳吧，因為只要十分鐘。

title: It is now possible to send a letter and receive an answer within ten minutes, which is a good thing.
translation: 現在寄出一封信，十分鐘內就能收到回覆，這是件好事。
name: 修飾整句的關係子句（表示評價）
sentences: The museum is free on Sundays, which is great for families.
He didn't even say goodbye, which was rude.
My neighbors are moving away, which is sad.
The tickets sold out in five minutes, which was incredible.
They gave us a free upgrade, which was very generous.
She speaks four languages, which is impressive.
We finished the project early, which was a big relief.
The shop has started selling local fruit, which is a great idea.
I forgot my umbrella, which was a mistake.
The kids cleaned their room without anyone asking them, which was a nice surprise.
Prices keep going up, which is a real problem for students.
He apologized in front of everyone, which was a brave thing to do.
Our flight leaves at 6 a.m., which means getting up at three.
She's been working twelve-hour days, which explains why she looks so tired.
The heating is broken, which makes the office freezing.
The café opens at seven, which means I can have breakfast before work.
He's lived in Spain for ten years, which explains his accent.
Nobody came to the meeting, which surprised the manager.
My brother lent me his car, which helped a lot.
They changed the timetable again, which confused everyone.
She laughed at my idea, which hurt my feelings.
The baby slept through the night, which made us very happy.
You can return the shoes within thirty days, which is useful if they don't fit.
The boss specified every detail of the report, which saved us a lot of time.
My parents finally reconciled, which I never expected.
Zoos help us learn about animals, which is important for protecting them.
The concert was outdoors, which was perfect on such a warm night.
He agreed to help us, which I thought was very kind.
The library now stays open until midnight, which suits students perfectly.
I got the last seat on the bus, which was lucky.

examples.heading: ① which is / was + 形容詞

items.en: The museum is free on Sundays, which is great for families.
items.zh: 博物館星期天免費，對家庭來說很棒。

items.en: He didn't even say goodbye, which was rude.
items.zh: 他連再見都沒說，真沒禮貌。

items.en: My neighbors are moving away, which is sad.
items.zh: 我的鄰居要搬走了，好難過。

items.en: The tickets sold out in five minutes, which was incredible.
items.zh: 票五分鐘就賣完了，太誇張了。

items.en: They gave us a free upgrade, which was very generous.
items.zh: 他們幫我們免費升等，真大方。

items.en: She speaks four languages, which is impressive.
items.zh: 她會說四種語言，真厲害。

examples.heading: ② which is / was + 名詞片語

items.en: We finished the project early, which was a big relief.
items.zh: 我們提早完成了計畫，總算鬆了一口氣。

items.en: The shop has started selling local fruit, which is a great idea.
items.zh: 那家店開始賣本地水果了，這個主意很好。

items.en: I forgot my umbrella, which was a mistake.
items.zh: 我忘了帶傘，真是失策。

items.en: The kids cleaned their room without anyone asking them, which was a nice surprise.
items.zh: 孩子們沒人叫就自己整理了房間，真是驚喜。

items.en: Prices keep going up, which is a real problem for students.
items.zh: 物價一直漲，對學生來說是個大問題。

items.en: He apologized in front of everyone, which was a brave thing to do.
items.zh: 他當著大家的面道歉，這需要勇氣。

examples.heading: ③ which means / makes / explains

items.en: Our flight leaves at 6 a.m., which means getting up at three.
items.zh: 我們的班機早上六點起飛，也就是說要三點起床。

items.en: She's been working twelve-hour days, which explains why she looks so tired.
items.zh: 她每天工作十二個小時，難怪她看起來那麼累。

items.en: The heating is broken, which makes the office freezing.
items.zh: 暖氣壞了，辦公室冷得要命。

items.en: The café opens at seven, which means I can have breakfast before work.
items.zh: 那家咖啡店七點開，所以我上班前可以吃早餐。

items.en: He's lived in Spain for ten years, which explains his accent.
items.zh: 他在西班牙住了十年，難怪他有那種口音。

examples.heading: ④ which + 其他動詞

items.en: Nobody came to the meeting, which surprised the manager.
items.zh: 沒有人來開會，讓經理很驚訝。

items.en: My brother lent me his car, which helped a lot.
items.zh: 我哥哥借我他的車，幫了我很大的忙。

items.en: They changed the timetable again, which confused everyone.
items.zh: 他們又改了時刻表，讓大家都搞不清楚。

items.en: She laughed at my idea, which hurt my feelings.
items.zh: 她笑我的點子，讓我很受傷。

items.en: The baby slept through the night, which made us very happy.
items.zh: 寶寶一覺睡到天亮，讓我們很開心。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: You can return the shoes within thirty days, which is useful if they don't fit.
items.zh: 鞋子三十天內可以退，不合腳的話很方便。

items.en: The boss specified every detail of the report, which saved us a lot of time.
items.zh: 老闆把報告的每個細節都說清楚了，替我們省了很多時間。

items.en: My parents finally reconciled, which I never expected.
items.zh: 我爸媽終於和好了，我從來沒想到會這樣。

items.en: Zoos help us learn about animals, which is important for protecting them.
items.zh: 動物園幫助我們了解動物，這對保護牠們很重要。

items.en: The concert was outdoors, which was perfect on such a warm night.
items.zh: 演唱會在戶外，在那麼溫暖的夜晚真是再好不過了。

items.en: He agreed to help us, which I thought was very kind.
items.zh: 他答應幫我們，我覺得他人很好。

items.en: The library now stays open until midnight, which suits students perfectly.
items.zh: 圖書館現在開到半夜，對學生來說再適合不過了。

items.en: I got the last seat on the bus, which was lucky.
items.zh: 我搶到公車上最後一個位子，運氣真好。

title: Travelers should not be so ignorant as to think they can understand other nationalities after staying in one of their hotels.
translation: 旅客不該無知到以為在某個國家的飯店住過，就能了解那個國家的人。
name: so 加形容詞加 as to 不定詞
sentences: The current is very strong after the rain. Surely nobody would be so foolish as to swim in that river.
The salesman wanted my signature at once. I'm not so stupid as to sign a contract without reading it.
It promised I'd lose ten kilos in a week. I wasn't so foolish as to believe the advert.
Our new boss listens to everyone in the team. A good manager isn't so proud as to ignore advice.
The police asked if my husband forgot to lock up. He was not so careless as to leave the door open.
It was below zero last night. How could you be so cruel as to leave the dog outside?
My old neighbour asked me to drive her to the doctor. I couldn't be so cruel as to refuse.
You have no other offer yet. Don't be so foolish as to quit your job.
Your cousin left the party at nine? Was he really so rude as to leave without saying goodbye?
The mountain road is covered in ice. Nobody would be so silly as to drive up it tonight.
The old gentleman at the dinner party turned to me. Would you be so kind as to pass me the salt?
I wrote to the hotel's front desk about a lost bag. Would you be so kind as to forward this letter to the manager?
The doctor is on the phone. Would you be so good as to wait a moment?
An old lady stopped me at the top of the stairs. Could you be so kind as to help me with this bag?
This is a non-smoking restaurant. Sir, would you be so kind as to put out your cigarette?
We were away for two weeks. Our neighbor was so kind as to feed our cat.
My aunt got a new job last month. She was so generous as to pay for everyone's dinner.
We met a young couple on the train to Prague. They were so helpful as to show us around the city.
It was very hot while I was in hospital. My neighbor was so thoughtful as to water my plants.
The student wrote this in her application. Should I be so fortunate as to win the scholarship, I'll study abroad.
My favourite actor is at the film festival this week. Should you be so lucky as to meet him, ask for a photo.
I applied to a bank in Japan. If I were so lucky as to get the job, I'd move to Tokyo.
The wedding lunch is on Saturday. Should we be so fortunate as to have good weather, we'll eat outside.
You can see the northern lights then. If you are ever so lucky as to visit Iceland, go in winter.
I sent my CV to five companies. Should I be so fortunate as to get an interview, I'll prepare well.
My sister lost her wedding ring on the beach. If she were so lucky as to find it, she'd cry with joy.
I put a notice on the station wall. Should anyone be so kind as to return my wallet, I'll give a reward.
He tried to climb the cliff without a rope. Should he be so foolish as to try again, he'll fail.
The boat trip leaves at nine. If we're so lucky as to see a whale, we'll take photos.
The travel guide gives this advice. Should you be so unlucky as to lose your passport, call the embassy.

examples.heading: ① not so + 形容詞 + as to

items.en: The current is very strong after the rain. Surely nobody would be so foolish as to swim in that river.
items.zh: 下過雨以後水流很急。應該沒有人會笨到在那條河裡游泳吧。

items.en: The salesman wanted my signature at once. I'm not so stupid as to sign a contract without reading it.
items.zh: 業務員要我馬上簽名。我沒有笨到不看合約就簽名。

items.en: It promised I'd lose ten kilos in a week. I wasn't so foolish as to believe the advert.
items.zh: 它保證我一個星期會瘦十公斤。我沒有傻到相信那則廣告。

items.en: Our new boss listens to everyone in the team. A good manager isn't so proud as to ignore advice.
items.zh: 我們的新老闆會聽團隊裡每個人的意見。好的經理不會自負到不聽建議。

items.en: The police asked if my husband forgot to lock up. He was not so careless as to leave the door open.
items.zh: 警察問我先生是不是忘了鎖門。他沒有粗心到讓門開著。

examples.heading: ② so + 形容詞 + as to（批評）

items.en: It was below zero last night. How could you be so cruel as to leave the dog outside?
items.zh: 昨天晚上零度以下。你怎麼能狠心到把狗留在外面？

items.en: My old neighbour asked me to drive her to the doctor. I couldn't be so cruel as to refuse.
items.zh: 我的老鄰居請我開車載她去看醫生。我沒辦法狠心到拒絕。

items.en: You have no other offer yet. Don't be so foolish as to quit your job.
items.zh: 你還沒有別的工作機會。別傻到把工作辭掉。

items.en: Your cousin left the party at nine? Was he really so rude as to leave without saying goodbye?
items.zh: 你表哥九點就離開派對了？他真的沒禮貌到不說再見就走了嗎？

items.en: The mountain road is covered in ice. Nobody would be so silly as to drive up it tonight.
items.zh: 山路上都是冰。沒有人會傻到今天晚上開車上去。

examples.heading: ③ Would you be so kind as to ...?

items.en: The old gentleman at the dinner party turned to me. Would you be so kind as to pass me the salt?
items.zh: 晚宴上那位老先生轉向我。可以麻煩你把鹽遞給我嗎？

items.en: I wrote to the hotel's front desk about a lost bag. Would you be so kind as to forward this letter to the manager?
items.zh: 我寫信給飯店櫃台，說我掉了一個包包。可以麻煩您把這封信轉給經理嗎？

items.en: The doctor is on the phone. Would you be so good as to wait a moment?
items.zh: 醫生在講電話。可以麻煩你稍等一下嗎？

items.en: An old lady stopped me at the top of the stairs. Could you be so kind as to help me with this bag?
items.zh: 一位老太太在樓梯頂端叫住我。可以麻煩你幫我提這個袋子嗎？

items.en: This is a non-smoking restaurant. Sir, would you be so kind as to put out your cigarette?
items.zh: 這是禁菸餐廳。先生，可以麻煩您把菸熄掉嗎？

examples.heading: ④ so + 形容詞 + as to（稱讚和感謝）

items.en: We were away for two weeks. Our neighbor was so kind as to feed our cat.
items.zh: 我們出門了兩個星期。我們的鄰居好心幫我們餵貓。

items.en: My aunt got a new job last month. She was so generous as to pay for everyone's dinner.
items.zh: 我阿姨上個月找到新工作。她大方到請大家吃晚餐。

items.en: We met a young couple on the train to Prague. They were so helpful as to show us around the city.
items.zh: 我們在去布拉格的火車上遇到一對年輕夫妻。他們熱心到帶我們參觀整個城市。

items.en: It was very hot while I was in hospital. My neighbor was so thoughtful as to water my plants.
items.zh: 我住院的時候天氣很熱。我鄰居很貼心，幫我澆了花。

examples.heading: ⑤ Should ... / If ... + so + 形容詞 + as to

items.en: The student wrote this in her application. Should I be so fortunate as to win the scholarship, I'll study abroad.
items.zh: 那個學生在申請書上這樣寫。如果我有幸拿到獎學金，我會出國讀書。

items.en: My favourite actor is at the film festival this week. Should you be so lucky as to meet him, ask for a photo.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的演員這個星期在電影節。如果你有幸見到他，跟他要張合照。

items.en: I applied to a bank in Japan. If I were so lucky as to get the job, I'd move to Tokyo.
items.zh: 我應徵了日本的一家銀行。如果我有幸得到那份工作，我會搬到東京。

items.en: The wedding lunch is on Saturday. Should we be so fortunate as to have good weather, we'll eat outside.
items.zh: 婚宴午餐在星期六。如果我們運氣好遇到好天氣，我們就在外面吃。

items.en: You can see the northern lights then. If you are ever so lucky as to visit Iceland, go in winter.
items.zh: 那時候可以看到北極光。如果你有幸去冰島，冬天去。

items.en: I sent my CV to five companies. Should I be so fortunate as to get an interview, I'll prepare well.
items.zh: 我把履歷寄給五家公司。如果我有幸得到面試機會，我會好好準備。

items.en: My sister lost her wedding ring on the beach. If she were so lucky as to find it, she'd cry with joy.
items.zh: 我姊姊在海灘上弄丟了她的婚戒。如果她有幸找到它，她會高興得哭出來。

items.en: I put a notice on the station wall. Should anyone be so kind as to return my wallet, I'll give a reward.
items.zh: 我在車站的牆上貼了一張告示。如果有人好心把錢包還給我，我會給謝禮。

items.en: He tried to climb the cliff without a rope. Should he be so foolish as to try again, he'll fail.
items.zh: 他想不用繩子爬那座懸崖。如果他笨到再試一次，他會失敗。

items.en: The boat trip leaves at nine. If we're so lucky as to see a whale, we'll take photos.
items.zh: 遊船九點出發。如果我們有幸看到鯨魚，我們會拍照。

items.en: The travel guide gives this advice. Should you be so unlucky as to lose your passport, call the embassy.
items.zh: 旅遊指南給了這個建議。如果你不幸弄丟護照，打電話給大使館。

title: As long as it involves children, I'd be delighted to work for you during the summer.
translation: 只要工作跟小孩有關，我很樂意夏天替你工作。
name: as long as 等連接詞的條件子句
sentences: As long as the weather stays fine, we'll have the party in the garden.
You can go out to play as long as you're back before dark.
As long as we leave before seven, we'll miss the traffic.
I'll hold the ladder as long as you don't climb too high.
The meeting will finish early as long as nobody raises a new topic.
As long as your answers aren't ambiguous, the examiner will give you full marks.
Mum won't scold you as long as you tell her the truth.
"Can I borrow your bike?" "Sure, as long as you lock it up."
Provided that the flight is domestic, you won't need your passport.
You can keep the kitten provided you look after it yourself.
Provided the sellers accept our offer, we'll move in May.
Provided that the board concurs, the new policy will start in January.
I'll lend you my notes provided you give them back tomorrow.
Provided that nobody objects, we'll close the office early on Friday.
Visitors may take photos provided that they don't use a flash.
Providing that the train isn't delayed, I'll be home by six.
You can come with us providing you pay for your own ticket.
Providing we make these changes, sales will rise next year.
Providing it doesn't rain, the farmers will finish the harvest this week.
Your plan should work providing that everyone does their part.
Providing the doctor agrees, Grandpa can come home on Monday.
As long as you're living under my roof, you'll follow my rules.
Provided that you're travelling with a child, you can board first.
As long as you're driving tomorrow, I'll leave my car at home.
Providing we're meeting at the station, I'll bring the tickets.
You can use my desk tomorrow as long as I'm not working from home.
As long as it's not too far, I'd be happy to drive you to the airport.
Provided the price is right, we'd be interested in ordering two hundred units.
I'd gladly join the project providing it doesn't take up my weekends.
I'd be glad to help as long as you don't mind waiting until Friday.
As long as you're careful, borrow whatever you need.
Provided it isn't after midnight, call me when you land.

examples.heading: ① as long as

items.en: As long as the weather stays fine, we'll have the party in the garden.
items.zh: 只要天氣一直很好，我們就在花園辦派對。

items.en: You can go out to play as long as you're back before dark.
items.zh: 只要天黑前回來，你就可以出去玩。

items.en: As long as we leave before seven, we'll miss the traffic.
items.zh: 只要我們七點前出發，就能避開車潮。

items.en: I'll hold the ladder as long as you don't climb too high.
items.zh: 只要你不爬太高，我就幫你扶梯子。

items.en: The meeting will finish early as long as nobody raises a new topic.
items.zh: 只要沒有人提出新的話題，會議會提早結束。

items.en: As long as your answers aren't ambiguous, the examiner will give you full marks.
items.zh: 只要你的答案不模稜兩可，考官就會給你滿分。

items.en: Mum won't scold you as long as you tell her the truth.
items.zh: 只要你跟媽媽說實話，她不會罵你。

items.en: "Can I borrow your bike?" "Sure, as long as you lock it up."
items.zh: 可以借你的腳踏車嗎？可以啊，只要你有上鎖。

examples.heading: ② provided (that)

items.en: Provided that the flight is domestic, you won't need your passport.
items.zh: 只要是國內航班，你就不需要護照。

items.en: You can keep the kitten provided you look after it yourself.
items.zh: 只要你自己照顧，就可以養這隻小貓。

items.en: Provided the sellers accept our offer, we'll move in May.
items.zh: 只要賣方接受我們的出價，我們五月就會搬家。

items.en: Provided that the board concurs, the new policy will start in January.
items.zh: 只要董事會同意，新政策會在一月開始實施。

items.en: I'll lend you my notes provided you give them back tomorrow.
items.zh: 只要你明天還我，我就借你我的筆記。

items.en: Provided that nobody objects, we'll close the office early on Friday.
items.zh: 只要沒有人反對，我們星期五會提早關辦公室。

items.en: Visitors may take photos provided that they don't use a flash.
items.zh: 只要不用閃光燈，參觀者可以拍照。

examples.heading: ③ providing (that)

items.en: Providing that the train isn't delayed, I'll be home by six.
items.zh: 只要火車沒誤點，我六點前會到家。

items.en: You can come with us providing you pay for your own ticket.
items.zh: 只要你自己出票錢，就可以跟我們去。

items.en: Providing we make these changes, sales will rise next year.
items.zh: 只要我們做出這些改變，明年的銷售額會成長。

items.en: Providing it doesn't rain, the farmers will finish the harvest this week.
items.zh: 只要不下雨，農夫們這週會完成收割。

items.en: Your plan should work providing that everyone does their part.
items.zh: 只要每個人都做好自己的部分，你的計畫應該行得通。

items.en: Providing the doctor agrees, Grandpa can come home on Monday.
items.zh: 只要醫生同意，爺爺星期一就可以回家。

examples.heading: ④ 現在進行式

items.en: As long as you're living under my roof, you'll follow my rules.
items.zh: 只要你還住在我家，就要守我的規矩。

items.en: Provided that you're travelling with a child, you can board first.
items.zh: 只要你帶著小孩同行，就可以先登機。

items.en: As long as you're driving tomorrow, I'll leave my car at home.
items.zh: 只要你明天會開車，我就把我的車留在家。

items.en: Providing we're meeting at the station, I'll bring the tickets.
items.zh: 只要我們是在車站碰面，我就帶車票去。

items.en: You can use my desk tomorrow as long as I'm not working from home.
items.zh: 只要我明天不在家工作，你就可以用我的書桌。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主要子句用 would 或祈使句

items.en: As long as it's not too far, I'd be happy to drive you to the airport.
items.zh: 只要不會太遠，我很樂意開車送你去機場。

items.en: Provided the price is right, we'd be interested in ordering two hundred units.
items.zh: 只要價格合理，我們有興趣訂兩百件。

items.en: I'd gladly join the project providing it doesn't take up my weekends.
items.zh: 只要不佔用我的週末，我很樂意加入這個專案。

items.en: I'd be glad to help as long as you don't mind waiting until Friday.
items.zh: 只要你不介意等到星期五，我很樂意幫忙。

items.en: As long as you're careful, borrow whatever you need.
items.zh: 只要你小心一點，需要什麼就拿去用。

items.en: Provided it isn't after midnight, call me when you land.
items.zh: 只要還沒過半夜，你落地後就打給我。

title: I was allowed to go out with my friends on condition that my parents knew where I was.
translation: 只要我爸媽知道我在哪裡，我就可以跟朋友出去。
name: so long as、on condition that 等條件連接詞
sentences: You can borrow my car so long as you bring it back by Sunday.
So long as the weather holds, we'll finish the roof tomorrow.
I don't mind the music so long as it stops by midnight.
So long as you don't contradict him in public, he'll listen to your ideas.
The old sofa will do so long as nobody sits on the left arm.
"Can I come too?" "So long as you're ready by eight."
Children are happy so long as they have space to play.
My grandfather eats anything so long as it isn't spicy.
So long as a coat is impermeable, I don't care how it looks.
The landlord doesn't care who lives here so long as the rent arrives on time.
I'll lend you the money on condition that you pay it back next month.
The bank will approve the loan on condition that you provide a guarantor.
They'll let us use the hall on condition that we leave it clean.
You can join the club on condition that you attend at least two meetings a month.
The company will drop the case on condition that we apologize publicly.
In the event that the lift breaks down, please use the stairs.
In the event that you lose your card, call the bank immediately.
In the event that the river becomes turbid, the town stops taking water from it.
We'll refund the full price in the event that the band cancels the concert.
In the event that it snows, the wedding will take place in the hotel.
In the event that the parcel arrives damaged, keep the box and contact us.
My father lent me the car on condition that I filled up the tank.
She agreed to the interview on condition that the paper didn't print her name.
My parents let me keep the puppy so long as I walked it every day.
The judge released him on condition that he reported to the police every week.
We could stay out late so long as we came home together.
The museum lent us the painting on condition that we kept it in a locked room.
Tenants may keep pets on condition that they obtain written permission from the landlord.
In the event that the buyer fails to pay, the seller may cancel the contract.
Staff may work from home so long as their manager approves.
In the event that a fire alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest exit.
Students keep the scholarship on condition that they maintain an average of B or above.

examples.heading: ① so long as 說未來的事

items.en: You can borrow my car so long as you bring it back by Sunday.
items.zh: 只要你星期天前還回來，就可以借我的車。

items.en: So long as the weather holds, we'll finish the roof tomorrow.
items.zh: 只要天氣一直這麼好，我們明天就能把屋頂做完。

items.en: I don't mind the music so long as it stops by midnight.
items.zh: 只要半夜前停下來，我不介意那些音樂。

items.en: So long as you don't contradict him in public, he'll listen to your ideas.
items.zh: 只要你不在大家面前反駁他，他就會聽你的想法。

items.en: The old sofa will do so long as nobody sits on the left arm.
items.zh: 只要沒有人坐左邊的扶手，這張舊沙發還能用。

items.en: "Can I come too?" "So long as you're ready by eight."
items.zh: 我也可以去嗎？只要你八點前準備好。

examples.heading: ② so long as 說一般的事實

items.en: Children are happy so long as they have space to play.
items.zh: 只要有空間玩，孩子就很開心。

items.en: My grandfather eats anything so long as it isn't spicy.
items.zh: 只要不辣，我爺爺什麼都吃。

items.en: So long as a coat is impermeable, I don't care how it looks.
items.zh: 只要外套不透水，我不在乎它好不好看。

items.en: The landlord doesn't care who lives here so long as the rent arrives on time.
items.zh: 只要房租準時到，房東不在乎誰住在這裡。

examples.heading: ③ on condition that 說未來的事

items.en: I'll lend you the money on condition that you pay it back next month.
items.zh: 我會借你錢，條件是你下個月要還我。

items.en: The bank will approve the loan on condition that you provide a guarantor.
items.zh: 銀行會核准貸款，條件是你要提供保證人。

items.en: They'll let us use the hall on condition that we leave it clean.
items.zh: 他們會讓我們用禮堂，條件是我們要把它打掃乾淨。

items.en: You can join the club on condition that you attend at least two meetings a month.
items.zh: 你可以加入社團，條件是每個月至少要參加兩次聚會。

items.en: The company will drop the case on condition that we apologize publicly.
items.zh: 公司會撤告，條件是我們要公開道歉。

examples.heading: ④ in the event that 說可能發生的事

items.en: In the event that the lift breaks down, please use the stairs.
items.zh: 萬一電梯故障，請走樓梯。

items.en: In the event that you lose your card, call the bank immediately.
items.zh: 萬一卡片遺失，請馬上打電話給銀行。

items.en: In the event that the river becomes turbid, the town stops taking water from it.
items.zh: 萬一河水變混濁，鎮上就不從河裡取水。

items.en: We'll refund the full price in the event that the band cancels the concert.
items.zh: 萬一樂團取消音樂會，我們會全額退款。

items.en: In the event that it snows, the wedding will take place in the hotel.
items.zh: 萬一下雪，婚禮會在飯店裡舉行。

items.en: In the event that the parcel arrives damaged, keep the box and contact us.
items.zh: 萬一包裹送到時有損壞，請留著箱子並跟我們聯絡。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說過去的事

items.en: My father lent me the car on condition that I filled up the tank.
items.zh: 我爸把車借給我，條件是我要把油加滿。

items.en: She agreed to the interview on condition that the paper didn't print her name.
items.zh: 她答應接受採訪，條件是報紙不能登出她的名字。

items.en: My parents let me keep the puppy so long as I walked it every day.
items.zh: 我爸媽讓我養那隻小狗，條件是我每天要遛牠。

items.en: The judge released him on condition that he reported to the police every week.
items.zh: 法官放了他，條件是他每週要向警方報到。

items.en: We could stay out late so long as we came home together.
items.zh: 只要我們一起回家，就可以在外面待到很晚。

items.en: The museum lent us the painting on condition that we kept it in a locked room.
items.zh: 博物館把那幅畫借給我們，條件是我們要把它放在上鎖的房間。

examples.heading: ⑥ 合約、規定和公告

items.en: Tenants may keep pets on condition that they obtain written permission from the landlord.
items.zh: 房客可以養寵物，條件是要取得房東的書面同意。

items.en: In the event that the buyer fails to pay, the seller may cancel the contract.
items.zh: 萬一買方沒有付款，賣方可以取消合約。

items.en: Staff may work from home so long as their manager approves.
items.zh: 只要主管同意，員工可以在家工作。

items.en: In the event that a fire alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest exit.
items.zh: 萬一火警警報響起，請從最近的出口離開大樓。

items.en: Students keep the scholarship on condition that they maintain an average of B or above.
items.zh: 學生可以保有獎學金，條件是平均成績要維持在 B 以上。

title: In my opinion, this is the worst thing that can ever happen.
translation: 我覺得這是可能發生的事情裡最糟的一件。
name: 最高級形容詞加 that 子句
sentences: Losing my passport was the worst thing that could happen on the trip.
Every student danced or sang on stage. That was the best show that the school could put on.
He carried me on his shoulders at the zoo. That's the earliest thing I can remember about my grandfather.
It leaves at six in the morning, but it's the cheapest flight we can find.
They asked me why I left my last job. That was the hardest question they could ask.
Visit your grandma in hospital this week. It's the kindest thing you could do for her.
It weighs less than a kilo. This is the lightest laptop that exists right now.
Mr Evans has to bend down at every door. He's the tallest man that lives in our village.
Look at the big oak by the lake. It's the oldest tree that grows in this park.
Try Page One for your textbooks. It's the biggest shop that sells books in town.
My cousin started at the bank when she was eighteen. She's the youngest person that works there.
My uncle joked about his first car at dinner. That was the funniest thing he said all night.
We walked twenty kilometres along the coast. It was the longest walk we did on the trip.
A farmer's wife cooked pasta for us in her kitchen. That was the best meal I had in Italy.
It was minus twenty on our last day in Oslo. It was the coldest day we spent there.
Look at this photo from 1998. That was the biggest fish my father caught that year.
Go back to university and study nursing. It's the best decision you will ever make.
Study hard for the final. This is the most important exam you'll take this year.
My best friend moved to Australia when I was ten. It was the hardest goodbye I would ever say.
The chef showed me how to use a knife safely. That's the most useful thing you'll learn here, he said.
We're telling travel stories tonight. What's the worst thing that has ever happened to you?
These shoes are still too big for my daughter. Is this the smallest size that they make?
Your card is the sweetest thing that I've received this year.
Ann teaches my son maths every week. She's the most patient person I know.
A man was walking a pig on the high street. That's the strangest thing I've seen today.
The kitchen pipe is leaking. Tell me the earliest time you can come.
Listen, they always play it at the end. This is the most beautiful song that the band plays.
The whole village came out to meet us. It was the warmest welcome that we could hope for.
Room 12 faces the garden. It's the quietest room that the hotel has.
Tell the interviewer you love working with people. That's the best answer you can give.

examples.heading: ① 最高級 + 名詞 + that + can / could

items.en: Losing my passport was the worst thing that could happen on the trip.
items.zh: 弄丟護照是這趟旅行可能遇到最糟的事。

items.en: Every student danced or sang on stage. That was the best show that the school could put on.
items.zh: 每個學生都上台跳舞或唱歌。那是學校能辦出最好的表演。

items.en: He carried me on his shoulders at the zoo. That's the earliest thing I can remember about my grandfather.
items.zh: 他在動物園讓我騎在他肩膀上。那是我對爺爺最早的記憶。

items.en: It leaves at six in the morning, but it's the cheapest flight we can find.
items.zh: 它早上六點起飛，可是這是我們能找到最便宜的班機。

items.en: They asked me why I left my last job. That was the hardest question they could ask.
items.zh: 他們問我為什麼離開上一份工作。那是他們能問的最難的問題。

items.en: Visit your grandma in hospital this week. It's the kindest thing you could do for her.
items.zh: 這個星期去醫院看你奶奶。那是你能為她做最貼心的事。

examples.heading: ② 最高級 + that + 現在式（that 當主詞）

items.en: It weighs less than a kilo. This is the lightest laptop that exists right now.
items.zh: 它不到一公斤。這是目前最輕的筆電。

items.en: Mr Evans has to bend down at every door. He's the tallest man that lives in our village.
items.zh: 伊凡斯先生每扇門都要彎腰才能過。他是我們村子裡最高的人。

items.en: Look at the big oak by the lake. It's the oldest tree that grows in this park.
items.zh: 你看湖邊那棵大橡樹。那是這座公園裡最老的樹。

items.en: Try Page One for your textbooks. It's the biggest shop that sells books in town.
items.zh: 你的課本去佩吉萬書店找。那是鎮上賣書的店裡最大的一家。

items.en: My cousin started at the bank when she was eighteen. She's the youngest person that works there.
items.zh: 我表姊十八歲就在那家銀行工作。她是那家銀行最年輕的員工。

examples.heading: ③ 最高級 + 名詞 + 過去式子句

items.en: My uncle joked about his first car at dinner. That was the funniest thing he said all night.
items.zh: 我叔叔晚餐時拿他的第一台車開玩笑。那是他整晚說過最好笑的話。

items.en: We walked twenty kilometres along the coast. It was the longest walk we did on the trip.
items.zh: 我們沿著海岸走了二十公里。那是我們這趟旅行走過最長的路。

items.en: A farmer's wife cooked pasta for us in her kitchen. That was the best meal I had in Italy.
items.zh: 一個農夫的太太在她的廚房為我們煮義大利麵。那是我在義大利吃過最好吃的一餐。

items.en: It was minus twenty on our last day in Oslo. It was the coldest day we spent there.
items.zh: 我們在奧斯陸的最後一天是零下二十度。那是我們在那裡度過最冷的一天。

items.en: Look at this photo from 1998. That was the biggest fish my father caught that year.
items.zh: 你看這張 1998 年的照片。那是我爸爸那年釣到最大的魚。

examples.heading: ④ 最高級 + 名詞 + will / would

items.en: Go back to university and study nursing. It's the best decision you will ever make.
items.zh: 回大學讀護理吧。那會是你做過最好的決定。

items.en: Study hard for the final. This is the most important exam you'll take this year.
items.zh: 期末考要認真準備。這是你今年要考的最重要的考試。

items.en: My best friend moved to Australia when I was ten. It was the hardest goodbye I would ever say.
items.zh: 我十歲的時候，我最好的朋友搬去澳洲。那是我說過最難的一次再見。

items.en: The chef showed me how to use a knife safely. That's the most useful thing you'll learn here, he said.
items.zh: 主廚教我怎麼安全地用刀。他說：那是你在這裡會學到最有用的東西。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: We're telling travel stories tonight. What's the worst thing that has ever happened to you?
items.zh: 我們今天晚上在講旅行的故事。你遇過最糟的事是什麼？

items.en: These shoes are still too big for my daughter. Is this the smallest size that they make?
items.zh: 這雙鞋對我女兒來說還是太大。這是他們做的最小尺寸嗎？

items.en: Your card is the sweetest thing that I've received this year.
items.zh: 你的卡片是我今年收到最貼心的東西。

items.en: Ann teaches my son maths every week. She's the most patient person I know.
items.zh: Ann 每個星期教我兒子數學。她是我認識最有耐心的人。

items.en: A man was walking a pig on the high street. That's the strangest thing I've seen today.
items.zh: 有個男人在大街上遛一隻豬。那是我今天看過最奇怪的事。

items.en: The kitchen pipe is leaking. Tell me the earliest time you can come.
items.zh: 廚房的水管在漏水。告訴我你最早什麼時候能來。

items.en: Listen, they always play it at the end. This is the most beautiful song that the band plays.
items.zh: 你聽，他們總是在最後演奏這首。這是那個樂團演奏的最美的歌。

items.en: The whole village came out to meet us. It was the warmest welcome that we could hope for.
items.zh: 全村的人都出來接我們。那是我們所能期望最熱情的歡迎。

items.en: Room 12 faces the garden. It's the quietest room that the hotel has.
items.zh: 十二號房面對花園。那是飯店裡最安靜的房間。

items.en: Tell the interviewer you love working with people. That's the best answer you can give.
items.zh: 跟面試官說你很喜歡跟人一起工作。那是你能給出最好的答案。

title: It's the best place that I have ever seen.
translation: 這是我看過最棒的地方。
name: the best (that) 加現在完成式子句
sentences: Going to France for a year was the best decision that I've ever made.
We've been to Japan four times. Kyoto is the best city that we have ever visited.
My dad told me to save a little every month. This is the best advice that anyone has ever given me.
Ms Lopez always listens to our ideas. She's the best boss that I've ever worked for.
We spent three days at a farm in the hills. It was the best trip that our class has ever taken.
My brother took this at my graduation. That's the best photo that he's ever taken of me.
These are the best cookies my mum has ever baked.
We won the league in her first year. She's the best coach our team has ever had.
The sand is white, and the water is clear. This is the best beach we've ever been to.
My son scored three goals on Saturday. It was the best match he's ever played.
That was the best speech I've ever heard at a wedding.
They make their own bread and cakes. It's the best café that has ever opened near our office.
The fans built a statue of him outside the stadium. He's the best player that has ever played for the club.
It won five awards this year. It's the best film that has ever come out of this studio.
Lisa wants to sell our cakes online. This is the best idea that has ever come from our team.
The wind took the roof off the school. It was the worst storm that we've ever had here.
Dr Kim answered all my questions for half an hour. He's the most patient doctor that I've ever met.
I was flying over my school on a bicycle. That was the strangest dream that I've ever had.
My aunt paid two thousand dollars for it. It's the most expensive watch that she has ever bought.
The roller coaster went upside down three times. That was the scariest ride that the kids have ever been on.
My present for Dad is a watch again. What's the best gift that you've ever received?
We're writing about school memories in class. Who's the best teacher you've ever had?
We finally reached the top of the mountain. Is this the best view that you've ever seen?
We swam in the lake every day in 2015. That was the best summer that I can remember.
Grandpa's operation went well. It's the best news that we've had all year.
You've travelled to so many countries. Tell me about the best holiday you've ever had.
I can't stop laughing. That's the best joke that I've heard in a long time.
They played for three hours in the rain. It was the best concert that the band has ever given.
Your family moved a lot when you were young. Which was the best school that you've ever studied at?
The teacher smiled at Tom. That's the best answer that anyone has given so far.

examples.heading: ① the best + 名詞 + that + have ever

items.en: Going to France for a year was the best decision that I've ever made.
items.zh: 去法國待一年是我做過最好的決定。

items.en: We've been to Japan four times. Kyoto is the best city that we have ever visited.
items.zh: 我們去過日本四次。京都是我們去過最棒的城市。

items.en: My dad told me to save a little every month. This is the best advice that anyone has ever given me.
items.zh: 我爸爸叫我每個月存一點錢。這是別人給過我最好的建議。

items.en: Ms Lopez always listens to our ideas. She's the best boss that I've ever worked for.
items.zh: 羅培茲女士總是聽我們的想法。她是我遇過最好的老闆。

items.en: We spent three days at a farm in the hills. It was the best trip that our class has ever taken.
items.zh: 我們在山上的農場待了三天。那是我們班參加過最棒的一次旅行。

items.en: My brother took this at my graduation. That's the best photo that he's ever taken of me.
items.zh: 我哥哥在我畢業典禮上拍了這張。那是他幫我拍過最好看的照片。

examples.heading: ② the best + 名詞 + have ever（省略 that）

items.en: These are the best cookies my mum has ever baked.
items.zh: 這是我媽媽烤過最好吃的餅乾。

items.en: We won the league in her first year. She's the best coach our team has ever had.
items.zh: 她來的第一年我們就贏了聯賽。她是我們隊有過最好的教練。

items.en: The sand is white, and the water is clear. This is the best beach we've ever been to.
items.zh: 沙子是白的，海水很清澈。這是我們去過最棒的海灘。

items.en: My son scored three goals on Saturday. It was the best match he's ever played.
items.zh: 我兒子星期六進了三球。那是他打過最好的一場比賽。

items.en: That was the best speech I've ever heard at a wedding.
items.zh: 那是我在婚禮上聽過最精彩的致詞。

examples.heading: ③ the best + 名詞 + that + has ever

items.en: They make their own bread and cakes. It's the best café that has ever opened near our office.
items.zh: 他們自己做麵包和蛋糕。那是我們辦公室附近開過最好的咖啡店。

items.en: The fans built a statue of him outside the stadium. He's the best player that has ever played for the club.
items.zh: 球迷在球場外面為他立了一座雕像。他是這個俱樂部有過最好的球員。

items.en: It won five awards this year. It's the best film that has ever come out of this studio.
items.zh: 它今年得了五個獎。那是這家製片廠拍過最好的電影。

items.en: Lisa wants to sell our cakes online. This is the best idea that has ever come from our team.
items.zh: 麗莎想在網路上賣我們的蛋糕。這是我們團隊想過最好的點子。

examples.heading: ④ the worst / the most + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that

items.en: The wind took the roof off the school. It was the worst storm that we've ever had here.
items.zh: 風把學校的屋頂吹走了。那是我們這裡遇過最嚴重的暴風雨。

items.en: Dr Kim answered all my questions for half an hour. He's the most patient doctor that I've ever met.
items.zh: 金醫生花了半個小時回答我所有的問題。他是我遇過最有耐心的醫生。

items.en: I was flying over my school on a bicycle. That was the strangest dream that I've ever had.
items.zh: 我騎著腳踏車飛過我的學校。那是我做過最奇怪的夢。

items.en: My aunt paid two thousand dollars for it. It's the most expensive watch that she has ever bought.
items.zh: 我阿姨花了兩千塊買的。那是她買過最貴的手錶。

items.en: The roller coaster went upside down three times. That was the scariest ride that the kids have ever been on.
items.zh: 雲霄飛車倒轉了三次。那是孩子們坐過最可怕的遊樂設施。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和不同的句型

items.en: My present for Dad is a watch again. What's the best gift that you've ever received?
items.zh: 我送爸爸的禮物又是手錶。你收過最好的禮物是什麼？

items.en: We're writing about school memories in class. Who's the best teacher you've ever had?
items.zh: 我們在課堂上寫學校的回憶。你遇過最好的老師是誰？

items.en: We finally reached the top of the mountain. Is this the best view that you've ever seen?
items.zh: 我們終於到了山頂。這是你看過最美的景色嗎？

items.en: We swam in the lake every day in 2015. That was the best summer that I can remember.
items.zh: 2015 年我們每天都在湖裡游泳。那是我記得最棒的夏天。

items.en: Grandpa's operation went well. It's the best news that we've had all year.
items.zh: 爺爺的手術很順利。這是我們今年聽到最好的消息。

items.en: You've travelled to so many countries. Tell me about the best holiday you've ever had.
items.zh: 你去過那麼多國家。跟我說說你度過最棒的假期。

items.en: I can't stop laughing. That's the best joke that I've heard in a long time.
items.zh: 我笑得停不下來。那是我很久以來聽過最好笑的笑話。

items.en: They played for three hours in the rain. It was the best concert that the band has ever given.
items.zh: 他們在雨中演奏了三個小時。那是那個樂團辦過最好的演唱會。

items.en: Your family moved a lot when you were young. Which was the best school that you've ever studied at?
items.zh: 你小時候常常搬家。你讀過最好的學校是哪一所？

items.en: The teacher smiled at Tom. That's the best answer that anyone has given so far.
items.zh: 老師對湯姆笑了笑。那是目前為止最好的答案。

title: The thing that I love most is going to the shops.
translation: 我最喜歡的事就是去逛街。
name: the person who、the thing that 的強調用法
sentences: The thing that I miss most about home is my mother's cooking.
The thing that annoys me most is people talking in the cinema.
The thing that I liked best about the hotel was the breakfast.
The thing that impressed everyone was her calm voice.
The thing that I don't understand is why he lied.
The thing that makes this city special is its night markets.
The person who taught me to cook was my grandfather.
The person who sits behind me in class is my best friend.
The person who found my wallet was a young student.
The person that I admire most is my grandfather.
The person who should apologize is you, not me.
The one who broke the window was the boy next door.
The one that I want is the blue one.
The one who always makes us laugh is Uncle Joe.
The one that tasted best was the chocolate cake.
The one who suffers most is the dog.
He's the only one who remembers where we parked.
This is the only one that still works.
I was the only one who laughed at his joke.
She's the only person who can make my dad laugh.
That's the only thing that matters to me.
The thing that I hate most is getting up early.
The thing that you need to do is to call her now.
The thing that surprised us was that the shop was still open.
The person who annoyed me most was the man with the loud phone.
The thing that helped me most was a good night's sleep.
The one thing that I can't stand is rudeness.
The person who deserves the prize is Mrs. Chen.
The thing that worried my parents was that I was always alone.
The thing that I'd like to do this weekend is nothing at all.

examples.heading: ① The thing that ... is ...

items.en: The thing that I miss most about home is my mother's cooking.
items.zh: 我最想念家裡的是我媽媽煮的菜。

items.en: The thing that annoys me most is people talking in the cinema.
items.zh: 最讓我煩的是有人在電影院講話。

items.en: The thing that I liked best about the hotel was the breakfast.
items.zh: 那家飯店我最喜歡的是早餐。

items.en: The thing that impressed everyone was her calm voice.
items.zh: 讓大家印象深刻的是她冷靜的聲音。

items.en: The thing that I don't understand is why he lied.
items.zh: 我不懂的是他為什麼說謊。

items.en: The thing that makes this city special is its night markets.
items.zh: 讓這個城市特別的是它的夜市。

examples.heading: ② The person who ... is ...

items.en: The person who taught me to cook was my grandfather.
items.zh: 教我做菜的人是我爺爺。

items.en: The person who sits behind me in class is my best friend.
items.zh: 上課坐我後面的那個人是我最好的朋友。

items.en: The person who found my wallet was a young student.
items.zh: 撿到我皮夾的人是一個年輕學生。

items.en: The person that I admire most is my grandfather.
items.zh: 我最欣賞的人是我爺爺。

items.en: The person who should apologize is you, not me.
items.zh: 該道歉的是你，不是我。

examples.heading: ③ The one who / that ... is ...

items.en: The one who broke the window was the boy next door.
items.zh: 打破窗戶的是隔壁的男孩。

items.en: The one that I want is the blue one.
items.zh: 我要的是藍色那個。

items.en: The one who always makes us laugh is Uncle Joe.
items.zh: 總是逗我們笑的是 Joe 叔叔。

items.en: The one that tasted best was the chocolate cake.
items.zh: 最好吃的是巧克力蛋糕。

items.en: The one who suffers most is the dog.
items.zh: 最可憐的是那隻狗。

examples.heading: ④ the only one who / that

items.en: He's the only one who remembers where we parked.
items.zh: 他是唯一記得我們車停在哪裡的人。

items.en: This is the only one that still works.
items.zh: 這是唯一還能用的一個。

items.en: I was the only one who laughed at his joke.
items.zh: 只有我笑了他的笑話。

items.en: She's the only person who can make my dad laugh.
items.zh: 她是唯一能讓我爸笑的人。

items.en: That's the only thing that matters to me.
items.zh: 那是我唯一在乎的事。

examples.heading: ⑤ 重點的不同形式

items.en: The thing that I hate most is getting up early.
items.zh: 我最討厭的是早起。

items.en: The thing that you need to do is to call her now.
items.zh: 你要做的是現在就打給她。

items.en: The thing that surprised us was that the shop was still open.
items.zh: 讓我們驚訝的是那家店還開著。

items.en: The person who annoyed me most was the man with the loud phone.
items.zh: 最讓我煩的人是那個手機很吵的男人。

items.en: The thing that helped me most was a good night's sleep.
items.zh: 對我最有幫助的是好好睡一覺。

items.en: The one thing that I can't stand is rudeness.
items.zh: 我唯一受不了的是沒禮貌。

items.en: The person who deserves the prize is Mrs. Chen.
items.zh: 該得獎的是陳太太。

items.en: The thing that worried my parents was that I was always alone.
items.zh: 讓我爸媽擔心的是我總是一個人。

items.en: The thing that I'd like to do this weekend is nothing at all.
items.zh: 這個週末我想做的就是什麼都不做。

title: This is the reason why we are changing our working hours.
translation: 這就是我們要調整工作時間的原因。
name: the reason why 引導的關係子句
sentences: Nobody told us the reason why the meeting was cancelled.
Do you know the reason why the shop closed early today?
I finally understood the reason why he was so quiet.
The doctor explained the reason why I was feeling so tired.
Can you specify the reason why you want to change your flight?
There's no reason why we can't finish today.
The reason why I love this café is that it's never crowded.
The reason why she moved to Hualien is that she wanted a quieter life.
The reason why we're selling the car is that we hardly ever drive.
The reason why I didn't call you was that my phone was dead.
The reason why he gets up so early is his long commute.
The reason why the film is so popular is the music.
The main reason why I chose this job was the people.
One reason why I like living here is the food.
The only reason why I went to the party was to see you.
Money isn't the only reason why people change jobs.
That's one of the reasons why I never take taxis.
It rained all week. That's the reason why the grass is so green.
He's very thrifty. That's the reason why he never eats out.
This is the reason why we need more volunteers.
Traffic was terrible. That's the reason why we missed the start.
The heater broke last night. That's the reason why it's so cold in here.
The reason I'm texting is to remind you about the dentist.
Nobody knows the reason she left the band.
