Is that the reason you didn't come yesterday?
The reason that I'm learning Korean is my love of K-dramas.
The reason we chose this hotel is that it has a pool.
Tell me the real reason you're leaving.
The reason that the bus is late is the snow on the mountain road.
That isn't the reason I'm angry.

examples.heading: ① the reason why + 子句

items.en: Nobody told us the reason why the meeting was cancelled.
items.zh: 沒人告訴我們會議為什麼取消。

items.en: Do you know the reason why the shop closed early today?
items.zh: 你知道那家店今天為什麼提早關門嗎？

items.en: I finally understood the reason why he was so quiet.
items.zh: 我終於懂他為什麼那麼安靜了。

items.en: The doctor explained the reason why I was feeling so tired.
items.zh: 醫生解釋了我為什麼一直覺得很累。

items.en: Can you specify the reason why you want to change your flight?
items.zh: 你可以說明你為什麼要改班機嗎？

items.en: There's no reason why we can't finish today.
items.zh: 我們沒有理由今天做不完。

examples.heading: ② The reason why ... is that ...（強調原因）

items.en: The reason why I love this café is that it's never crowded.
items.zh: 我喜歡這家咖啡店是因為這裡從來都不擠。

items.en: The reason why she moved to Hualien is that she wanted a quieter life.
items.zh: 她搬到花蓮是因為她想過比較安靜的生活。

items.en: The reason why we're selling the car is that we hardly ever drive.
items.zh: 我們要賣車是因為我們幾乎不開車。

items.en: The reason why I didn't call you was that my phone was dead.
items.zh: 我沒打給你是因為我手機沒電了。

items.en: The reason why he gets up so early is his long commute.
items.zh: 他那麼早起是因為他通勤時間很長。

items.en: The reason why the film is so popular is the music.
items.zh: 那部電影那麼受歡迎是因為它的音樂。

examples.heading: ③ the main / only / one reason why

items.en: The main reason why I chose this job was the people.
items.zh: 我選這份工作的主要原因是這裡的人。

items.en: One reason why I like living here is the food.
items.zh: 我喜歡住這裡的其中一個原因是這裡的食物。

items.en: The only reason why I went to the party was to see you.
items.zh: 我去那個派對唯一的原因是要見你。

items.en: Money isn't the only reason why people change jobs.
items.zh: 錢不是人們換工作唯一的原因。

items.en: That's one of the reasons why I never take taxis.
items.zh: 這是我從來不搭計程車的原因之一。

examples.heading: ④ This is / That's the reason why

items.en: It rained all week. That's the reason why the grass is so green.
items.zh: 下了一整個禮拜的雨，所以草才這麼綠。

items.en: He's very thrifty. That's the reason why he never eats out.
items.zh: 他很節儉，所以他從來不在外面吃。

items.en: This is the reason why we need more volunteers.
items.zh: 這就是我們需要更多志工的原因。

items.en: Traffic was terrible. That's the reason why we missed the start.
items.zh: 交通很糟，所以我們錯過了開頭。

items.en: The heater broke last night. That's the reason why it's so cold in here.
items.zh: 暖氣昨晚壞了，所以這裡才這麼冷。

examples.heading: ⑤ 省略 why 或換成 that

items.en: The reason I'm texting is to remind you about the dentist.
items.zh: 我傳訊息是要提醒你看牙醫的事。

items.en: Nobody knows the reason she left the band.
items.zh: 沒人知道她為什麼離開樂團。

items.en: Is that the reason you didn't come yesterday?
items.zh: 那就是你昨天沒來的原因嗎？

items.en: The reason that I'm learning Korean is my love of K-dramas.
items.zh: 我學韓文是因為我很愛韓劇。

items.en: The reason we chose this hotel is that it has a pool.
items.zh: 我們選這家飯店是因為這裡有游泳池。

items.en: Tell me the real reason you're leaving.
items.zh: 告訴我你要走的真正原因。

items.en: The reason that the bus is late is the snow on the mountain road.
items.zh: 公車誤點是因為山路上有積雪。

items.en: That isn't the reason I'm angry.
items.zh: 我生氣不是因為這個。

title: I feel comfortable when I am wearing these clothes.
translation: 我穿這些衣服的時候覺得很舒服。
name: 時間連接詞引導的從屬子句
sentences: When I opened the door, the cat ran out.
My grandfather was a sailor when he was young.
When it's sunny, we eat lunch in the garden.
I was cutting onions when my mother called.
When I lived in Tainan, I cycled everywhere.
I always feel sleepy when I eat a big lunch.
While we were walking home, it started to rain.
The power went out while I was drying my hair.
I listen to podcasts while I'm running.
While my parents were away, I looked after the dog.
My brother and I played cards while we were waiting for our flight.
Brush your teeth before you go to bed.
Before I started this job, I was a waiter.
After the guests left, we washed all the dishes.
She felt much better after she had a nap.
Check the address before you leave the house.
Stay in bed until your fever goes down.
The kids played in the park until it got dark.
As soon as I saw her, I knew something was wrong.
As soon as the bakery opens, there's a queue outside.
Don't open your presents until everyone arrives.
When I finish university, I'm going to travel for a year.
I'll make dinner after I get back from the gym.
Before you sign the contract, read it carefully.
We'll start the meeting as soon as the boss gets here.
I'll look after your plants while you're on holiday.
Can you wait until I've finished this email?
When the bell rings, put your pens down.
Keep stirring the sauce until it gets thick.
When my sister gets her driving licence, she's going to buy a car.

examples.heading: ① when

items.en: When I opened the door, the cat ran out.
items.zh: 我一開門，貓就跑出去了。

items.en: My grandfather was a sailor when he was young.
items.zh: 我爺爺年輕的時候是水手。

items.en: When it's sunny, we eat lunch in the garden.
items.zh: 天氣好的時候，我們在花園吃午餐。

items.en: I was cutting onions when my mother called.
items.zh: 我在切洋蔥的時候，我媽媽打電話來。

items.en: When I lived in Tainan, I cycled everywhere.
items.zh: 我住在台南的時候，到哪裡都騎腳踏車。

items.en: I always feel sleepy when I eat a big lunch.
items.zh: 我午餐吃很多的時候都會想睡覺。

examples.heading: ② while

items.en: While we were walking home, it started to rain.
items.zh: 我們走路回家的時候，開始下雨了。

items.en: The power went out while I was drying my hair.
items.zh: 我在吹頭髮的時候停電了。

items.en: I listen to podcasts while I'm running.
items.zh: 我跑步的時候會聽 podcast。

items.en: While my parents were away, I looked after the dog.
items.zh: 我爸媽不在的時候，我照顧那隻狗。

items.en: My brother and I played cards while we were waiting for our flight.
items.zh: 我跟我哥哥等班機的時候在玩牌。

examples.heading: ③ before / after

items.en: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.
items.zh: 睡覺前要刷牙。

items.en: Before I started this job, I was a waiter.
items.zh: 在做這份工作之前，我是服務生。

items.en: After the guests left, we washed all the dishes.
items.zh: 客人走了以後，我們把碗盤全洗了。

items.en: She felt much better after she had a nap.
items.zh: 她睡了午覺之後覺得好多了。

items.en: Check the address before you leave the house.
items.zh: 出門前先確認地址。

examples.heading: ④ until / as soon as

items.en: Stay in bed until your fever goes down.
items.zh: 在床上躺著，直到你退燒為止。

items.en: The kids played in the park until it got dark.
items.zh: 孩子們在公園玩到天黑。

items.en: As soon as I saw her, I knew something was wrong.
items.zh: 我一看到她，就知道出事了。

items.en: As soon as the bakery opens, there's a queue outside.
items.zh: 那家麵包店一開門，外面就排起隊來。

items.en: Don't open your presents until everyone arrives.
items.zh: 等大家都到了再拆禮物。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說未來的時間

items.en: When I finish university, I'm going to travel for a year.
items.zh: 我大學畢業後要去旅行一年。

items.en: I'll make dinner after I get back from the gym.
items.zh: 我從健身房回來後會煮晚餐。

items.en: Before you sign the contract, read it carefully.
items.zh: 簽約之前要仔細讀過。

items.en: We'll start the meeting as soon as the boss gets here.
items.zh: 老闆一到我們就開始開會。

items.en: I'll look after your plants while you're on holiday.
items.zh: 你去度假的時候，我會幫你照顧植物。

items.en: Can you wait until I've finished this email?
items.zh: 你可以等我寫完這封電子郵件嗎？

items.en: When the bell rings, put your pens down.
items.zh: 鈴聲響的時候，把筆放下。

items.en: Keep stirring the sauce until it gets thick.
items.zh: 一直攪拌醬汁，直到變濃稠為止。

items.en: When my sister gets her driving licence, she's going to buy a car.
items.zh: 我姊姊拿到駕照以後要買車。

title: I think I am going to pay in cash, unless you accept credit cards.
translation: 我想我會付現金，除非你們收信用卡。
name: unless 表示例外
sentences: I always take the stairs unless I'm carrying something heavy.
My father reads the paper at breakfast unless he's in a hurry.
We eat dinner at seven unless someone has a late class.
The office closes at five unless there's a meeting.
She doesn't wear make-up unless she's going somewhere special.
Our cat sleeps on the sofa unless the dog gets there first.
I don't usually drink coffee after lunch unless I have a long drive.
We're going to have the party in the garden unless it's too windy.
I'll finish the painting tomorrow unless my brother needs my help.
The match will start at three unless the pitch is too wet.
I'm going to buy the blue one unless they have it in green.
We'll stay at home this weekend unless our friends invite us out.
I'm going to apply for the job unless the salary is too low.
The museum will reopen in May unless the repairs take longer.
Let's meet at the cinema, unless you want to eat first.
I'll make pasta tonight, unless you're tired of it.
Take my umbrella, unless you have your own.
I think I'll walk, unless you're driving past the station.
The answer is no, unless your parents agree.
We'll order a pizza, unless anyone has a better idea.
I'll send the letter today, unless there's anything you want to add.
Unless the shop has my size, I'll order the shoes online.
Unless you show your student card, you pay the full price.
Unless the doctor says otherwise, I'll go back to work on Monday.
Unless it's very cold, the children play outside after lunch.
Unless you water these herbs every day, they'll dry out.
Unless the technician fixes the printer soon, we won't have the leaflets ready.
If I were you, I'd take the train, unless the tickets are too expensive.
Passengers must stay in their seats unless the crew tells them otherwise.
Students may not use phones in class unless the teacher allows it.
You should rest for a week unless the pain goes away sooner.
Unless you exercise regularly, you'll find the hike very hard.

examples.heading: ① 現在的習慣

items.en: I always take the stairs unless I'm carrying something heavy.
items.zh: 我都走樓梯，除非我拿著很重的東西。

items.en: My father reads the paper at breakfast unless he's in a hurry.
items.zh: 我爸早餐時都會看報紙，除非他趕時間。

items.en: We eat dinner at seven unless someone has a late class.
items.zh: 我們七點吃晚餐，除非有人晚上有課。

items.en: The office closes at five unless there's a meeting.
items.zh: 辦公室五點關門，除非有會議。

items.en: She doesn't wear make-up unless she's going somewhere special.
items.zh: 她不化妝，除非她要去特別的場合。

items.en: Our cat sleeps on the sofa unless the dog gets there first.
items.zh: 我們的貓睡在沙發上，除非狗先佔了位子。

items.en: I don't usually drink coffee after lunch unless I have a long drive.
items.zh: 我午餐後通常不喝咖啡，除非要開很久的車。

examples.heading: ② 未來的計畫

items.en: We're going to have the party in the garden unless it's too windy.
items.zh: 我們打算在花園辦派對，除非風太大。

items.en: I'll finish the painting tomorrow unless my brother needs my help.
items.zh: 我明天會把油漆刷完，除非我弟弟需要我幫忙。

items.en: The match will start at three unless the pitch is too wet.
items.zh: 比賽三點開始，除非場地太濕。

items.en: I'm going to buy the blue one unless they have it in green.
items.zh: 我打算買藍色的，除非他們有綠色的。

items.en: We'll stay at home this weekend unless our friends invite us out.
items.zh: 這個週末我們會待在家，除非朋友約我們出去。

items.en: I'm going to apply for the job unless the salary is too low.
items.zh: 我打算應徵這份工作，除非薪水太低。

items.en: The museum will reopen in May unless the repairs take longer.
items.zh: 博物館五月會重新開放，除非修繕拖得更久。

examples.heading: ③ 逗號 + unless

items.en: Let's meet at the cinema, unless you want to eat first.
items.zh: 我們在電影院見，除非你想先吃東西。

items.en: I'll make pasta tonight, unless you're tired of it.
items.zh: 我今晚煮義大利麵，除非你吃膩了。

items.en: Take my umbrella, unless you have your own.
items.zh: 拿我的傘去，除非你自己有帶。

items.en: I think I'll walk, unless you're driving past the station.
items.zh: 我想我用走的，除非你會開車經過車站。

items.en: The answer is no, unless your parents agree.
items.zh: 答案是不行，除非你爸媽同意。

items.en: We'll order a pizza, unless anyone has a better idea.
items.zh: 我們叫披薩吧，除非有人有更好的主意。

items.en: I'll send the letter today, unless there's anything you want to add.
items.zh: 我今天會寄出這封信，除非你有想補充的東西。

examples.heading: ④ Unless 在句首

items.en: Unless the shop has my size, I'll order the shoes online.
items.zh: 除非店裡有我的尺寸，不然我就在網路上訂那雙鞋。

items.en: Unless you show your student card, you pay the full price.
items.zh: 除非你出示學生證，不然要付全額。

items.en: Unless the doctor says otherwise, I'll go back to work on Monday.
items.zh: 除非醫生另有指示，不然我星期一會回去上班。

items.en: Unless it's very cold, the children play outside after lunch.
items.zh: 除非天氣很冷，不然孩子們午餐後都在外面玩。

items.en: Unless you water these herbs every day, they'll dry out.
items.zh: 除非你每天幫這些香草澆水，不然它們會乾掉。

items.en: Unless the technician fixes the printer soon, we won't have the leaflets ready.
items.zh: 除非技術人員很快把印表機修好，不然我們沒辦法把傳單準備好。

examples.heading: ⑤ 建議和規定

items.en: If I were you, I'd take the train, unless the tickets are too expensive.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會搭火車，除非票太貴。

items.en: Passengers must stay in their seats unless the crew tells them otherwise.
items.zh: 乘客必須留在座位上，除非機組人員另有指示。

items.en: Students may not use phones in class unless the teacher allows it.
items.zh: 學生上課不能用手機，除非老師允許。

items.en: You should rest for a week unless the pain goes away sooner.
items.zh: 你應該休息一週，除非疼痛提早消失。

items.en: Unless you exercise regularly, you'll find the hike very hard.
items.zh: 除非你規律運動，不然你會覺得這趟健行很辛苦。

title: Were it not for that kind of toy, children would gain more team spirit, creativity and self-confidence.
translation: 要是沒有那種玩具，孩子會更有團隊精神、創造力和自信。
name: were it not for 加名詞片語
sentences: Were it not for tourism, the island would have very few jobs.
Were it not for the river, the valley would be completely desiccated.
Were it not for the music, the film would be rather banal.
Were it not for his ostentatious lifestyle, few people would notice him.
Were it not for public apathy, the government would face much more pressure.
Were it not for the new trains, commuters would spend two hours a day on the road.
Were it not for her courage, the truth would never have come out.
Were it not for his ambition, he would have stayed in his home town.
Were it not for the support of my family, I would have left university in the first year.
Were it not for their peaceable nature, the two groups would have fought long ago.
Were it not for the army's loyalty, the rebels would have overthrown the king.
Many small theatres would close were it not for government grants.
The city would be unbearable in summer were it not for its parks.
I would give up this course immediately were it not for my scholarship.
The report would be quite jejune were it not for the final chapter.
Were it not for the language barrier, the two companies could work together easily.
Were it not for the high rents, young artists might stay in the city centre.
Were it not for the murky water, divers could see the wreck clearly.
Were it not for the strict rules, the event might become rather frivolous.
Were it not for advertising, children would want fewer expensive toys.
Were it not for social media, many people would spend more time outdoors.
Were it not for the beneficence of a few rich families, the arts would struggle to survive.
Were it not for strict laws, companies would infringe workers' rights far more often.
Were it not for modern medicine, life expectancy would be much lower.
Were it not for computer games, teenagers would be less unsociable.
Were it not for vaccines, millions of children would die every year.
Were it not for your generous donation, this project would not exist.
Were it not for the hard work of our staff, we would not be celebrating today.
Were it not for a prior engagement, I would gladly accept your invitation.
Were it not for your letter, I would not have known about the problem.
Were it not for Professor Hall's monograph, this research would have taken twice as long.
Were it not for your patience, the negotiations would have failed.

examples.heading: ① 說現在的結果

items.en: Were it not for tourism, the island would have very few jobs.
items.zh: 要不是有觀光業，這座島的工作機會會非常少。

items.en: Were it not for the river, the valley would be completely desiccated.
items.zh: 要不是有這條河，這座山谷會完全乾涸。

items.en: Were it not for the music, the film would be rather banal.
items.zh: 要不是有配樂，這部電影會相當平淡。

items.en: Were it not for his ostentatious lifestyle, few people would notice him.
items.zh: 要不是他生活奢華招搖，很少人會注意到他。

items.en: Were it not for public apathy, the government would face much more pressure.
items.zh: 要不是民眾冷漠，政府會面臨大得多的壓力。

items.en: Were it not for the new trains, commuters would spend two hours a day on the road.
items.zh: 要不是有新的火車，通勤族每天會在路上花兩個小時。

examples.heading: ② 說過去的結果

items.en: Were it not for her courage, the truth would never have come out.
items.zh: 要不是她有勇氣，真相永遠不會曝光。

items.en: Were it not for his ambition, he would have stayed in his home town.
items.zh: 要不是他有企圖心，他當初就會留在家鄉了。

items.en: Were it not for the support of my family, I would have left university in the first year.
items.zh: 要不是家人支持，我大一就離開大學了。

items.en: Were it not for their peaceable nature, the two groups would have fought long ago.
items.zh: 要不是兩邊的人個性溫和，兩群人早就打起來了。

items.en: Were it not for the army's loyalty, the rebels would have overthrown the king.
items.zh: 要不是軍隊忠誠，叛軍早就推翻國王了。

examples.heading: ③ were it not for 放在句尾

items.en: Many small theatres would close were it not for government grants.
items.zh: 要不是有政府補助，很多小劇場會關門。

items.en: The city would be unbearable in summer were it not for its parks.
items.zh: 要不是有公園，這座城市夏天會讓人受不了。

items.en: I would give up this course immediately were it not for my scholarship.
items.zh: 要不是有獎學金，我會馬上放棄這門課。

items.en: The report would be quite jejune were it not for the final chapter.
items.zh: 要不是有最後一章，這份報告會相當空洞。

examples.heading: ④ could 和 might 說可能的結果

items.en: Were it not for the language barrier, the two companies could work together easily.
items.zh: 要不是有語言障礙，兩家公司可以輕鬆合作。

items.en: Were it not for the high rents, young artists might stay in the city centre.
items.zh: 要不是房租高，年輕藝術家可能會留在市中心。

items.en: Were it not for the murky water, divers could see the wreck clearly.
items.zh: 要不是水很混濁，潛水員可以清楚看到沉船。

items.en: Were it not for the strict rules, the event might become rather frivolous.
items.zh: 要不是規定嚴格，這個活動可能會變得相當輕浮。

examples.heading: ⑤ 論說文

items.en: Were it not for advertising, children would want fewer expensive toys.
items.zh: 要不是有廣告，孩子不會想要那麼多昂貴的玩具。

items.en: Were it not for social media, many people would spend more time outdoors.
items.zh: 要不是有社群媒體，很多人會花更多時間在戶外。

items.en: Were it not for the beneficence of a few rich families, the arts would struggle to survive.
items.zh: 要不是有幾個富有家族的善舉，藝術會很難生存。

items.en: Were it not for strict laws, companies would infringe workers' rights far more often.
items.zh: 要不是有嚴格的法律，公司會更常侵犯勞工的權利。

items.en: Were it not for modern medicine, life expectancy would be much lower.
items.zh: 要不是有現代醫學，平均壽命會低得多。

items.en: Were it not for computer games, teenagers would be less unsociable.
items.zh: 要不是有電腦遊戲，青少年不會那麼不愛交際。

items.en: Were it not for vaccines, millions of children would die every year.
items.zh: 要不是有疫苗，每年會有幾百萬個孩子死亡。

examples.heading: ⑥ 正式信件和演講

items.en: Were it not for your generous donation, this project would not exist.
items.zh: 要不是您慷慨捐款，這個計畫就不會存在。

items.en: Were it not for the hard work of our staff, we would not be celebrating today.
items.zh: 要不是員工努力工作，我們今天就不會在這裡慶祝。

items.en: Were it not for a prior engagement, I would gladly accept your invitation.
items.zh: 要不是之前已經有約，我會很樂意接受您的邀請。

items.en: Were it not for your letter, I would not have known about the problem.
items.zh: 要不是您的來信，我不會知道這個問題。

items.en: Were it not for Professor Hall's monograph, this research would have taken twice as long.
items.zh: 要不是有 Hall 教授的專論，這項研究會多花一倍的時間。

items.en: Were it not for your patience, the negotiations would have failed.
items.zh: 要不是您有耐心，談判早就破局了。

title: Were I to choose one of them, I would select the last one.
translation: 如果要我從中選一個，我會選最後那個。
name: were 加代名詞加 to 不定詞的條件句
sentences: Were I to retire early, I would open a small bookshop.
Were I to live anywhere in the world, I would choose New Zealand.
Were I to tell you the truth, you wouldn't believe me.
Were I to win the prize, I would give the money to charity.
Were I to meet the president, I would ask about the new law.
Were you to have any problems with the order, please contact our support team.
Were you to change your mind, please let us know by May.
Were you to walk to the station, it would take about forty minutes.
Were you to ask my mother, she would say the same thing.
Were you to accept our offer, we could start next week.
Were you to cancel now, you would lose your deposit.
Were she to apply, she would certainly get the job.
Were he to resign, who would replace him?
Were it to rain on the day, the wedding would move indoors.
Were she to find out, she would be furious.
Were it to snow tonight, the roads would be dangerous.
Were we to hire more nurses, patients would wait less.
Were they to raise the price again, we would find another supplier.
Were we to leave at six, we would avoid the traffic.
Were they to offer me more money, I might stay.
Were we to sell the house, where would we live?
Were they to close the factory, the town would suffer.
Were we not to act now, the problem would only get worse.
Were you not to return the form, your application could not proceed.
Were I to need a lawyer, I would call my cousin first.
Were she not to come, the meeting would be pointless.
Were it to happen again, we would call the police immediately.
Were they to specify a budget, we could prepare a proposal.
Were you to reconcile with your brother, your parents would be delighted.
Were I to lose my phone, I wouldn't remember a single number.

examples.heading: ① Were I to

items.en: Were I to retire early, I would open a small bookshop.
items.zh: 要是我提早退休，我會開一家小書店。

items.en: Were I to live anywhere in the world, I would choose New Zealand.
items.zh: 要是我可以住在世界上任何地方，我會選紐西蘭。

items.en: Were I to tell you the truth, you wouldn't believe me.
items.zh: 要是我跟你說實話，你也不會相信我。

items.en: Were I to win the prize, I would give the money to charity.
items.zh: 要是我得獎，我會把錢捐給慈善機構。

items.en: Were I to meet the president, I would ask about the new law.
items.zh: 要是我見到總統，我會問新法律的事。

examples.heading: ② Were you to

items.en: Were you to have any problems with the order, please contact our support team.
items.zh: 如果您的訂單有任何問題，請聯絡我們的客服團隊。

items.en: Were you to change your mind, please let us know by May.
items.zh: 如果您改變主意，請在五月前告訴我們。

items.en: Were you to walk to the station, it would take about forty minutes.
items.zh: 要是你走路去車站，大概要四十分鐘。

items.en: Were you to ask my mother, she would say the same thing.
items.zh: 要是你去問我媽媽，她也會說一樣的話。

items.en: Were you to accept our offer, we could start next week.
items.zh: 如果您接受我們的提議，我們下週就可以開始。

items.en: Were you to cancel now, you would lose your deposit.
items.zh: 要是您現在取消，就會失去訂金。

examples.heading: ③ Were he / she / it to

items.en: Were she to apply, she would certainly get the job.
items.zh: 要是她去應徵，一定會得到那份工作。

items.en: Were he to resign, who would replace him?
items.zh: 要是他辭職，誰會接替他？

items.en: Were it to rain on the day, the wedding would move indoors.
items.zh: 要是那天下雨，婚禮會改在室內舉行。

items.en: Were she to find out, she would be furious.
items.zh: 要是她發現了，她會氣炸。

items.en: Were it to snow tonight, the roads would be dangerous.
items.zh: 要是今晚下雪，路會很危險。

examples.heading: ④ Were we / they to

items.en: Were we to hire more nurses, patients would wait less.
items.zh: 要是我們多雇一些護理師，病人就不用等那麼久。

items.en: Were they to raise the price again, we would find another supplier.
items.zh: 要是他們再漲價，我們就會找別的供應商。

items.en: Were we to leave at six, we would avoid the traffic.
items.zh: 要是我們六點出發，就會避開塞車。

items.en: Were they to offer me more money, I might stay.
items.zh: 要是他們給我更多錢，我可能會留下來。

items.en: Were we to sell the house, where would we live?
items.zh: 要是我們把房子賣了，我們要住哪裡？

items.en: Were they to close the factory, the town would suffer.
items.zh: 要是他們關掉工廠，這個小鎮會受到很大的影響。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定和不同的情境

items.en: Were we not to act now, the problem would only get worse.
items.zh: 要是我們現在不採取行動，問題只會更嚴重。

items.en: Were you not to return the form, your application could not proceed.
items.zh: 如果您不交回表格，您的申請就無法進行。

items.en: Were I to need a lawyer, I would call my cousin first.
items.zh: 要是我需要律師，我會先打給我表哥。

items.en: Were she not to come, the meeting would be pointless.
items.zh: 要是她不來，這場會議就沒有意義了。

items.en: Were it to happen again, we would call the police immediately.
items.zh: 要是這種事再發生，我們會立刻報警。

items.en: Were they to specify a budget, we could prepare a proposal.
items.zh: 要是他們說明預算，我們就能準備提案。

items.en: Were you to reconcile with your brother, your parents would be delighted.
items.zh: 要是你跟你哥哥和好，你爸媽會很高興。

items.en: Were I to lose my phone, I wouldn't remember a single number.
items.zh: 要是我把手機弄丟了，我一個電話號碼都記不得。

title: I remember the day when I lost my suitcase at the airport.
translation: 我記得我在機場弄丟行李箱的那一天。
name: when 引導表示時間的限定關係子句
sentences: I still remember the afternoon when we first met.
She'll never forget the moment when she heard the news.
I miss the time when we lived by the sea.
Do you remember the summer when the pool was closed for repairs?
My grandmother often talks about the days when there were no cars in her village.
I'm looking forward to the day when I can retire.
The week when we moved house was exhausting.
The day when my son started school was very emotional for me.
The winter when the river froze was the coldest anyone could remember.
The evening when they announced the results was very tense.
The year when I lived in Paris changed my life.
The month when the festival happens is always busy.
There was a time when I didn't like vegetables.
That was the moment when everything changed.
There are times when I just want to be alone.
It was a period when nobody had much money.
Do you ever have days when nothing goes right?
That was the night we saw the shooting star.
Monday is the day I go to the gym.
Do you remember the last time we went dancing?
Christmas is the time that families get together.
Sunday is the day that my parents come for lunch.
Saturday is the only day when the market opens early.
I can't wait for the weekend when we finally go camping.
The hour when the sun sets is the best time to take photos.
Spring is the season when I feel most alive.
They got married in the year when the old bridge collapsed.
Ten o'clock is the time when the library closes.
I remember a holiday when it rained every single day.
That was a time when I went out every night.

examples.heading: ① 時間名詞在受詞的位置

items.en: I still remember the afternoon when we first met.
items.zh: 我還記得我們第一次見面的那個下午。

items.en: She'll never forget the moment when she heard the news.
items.zh: 她永遠不會忘記她聽到那個消息的那一刻。

items.en: I miss the time when we lived by the sea.
items.zh: 我懷念我們住在海邊的那段時光。

items.en: Do you remember the summer when the pool was closed for repairs?
items.zh: 你記得游泳池整修沒開的那個夏天嗎？

items.en: My grandmother often talks about the days when there were no cars in her village.
items.zh: 我奶奶常常說起她的村子還沒有車的那些日子。

items.en: I'm looking forward to the day when I can retire.
items.zh: 我很期待可以退休的那一天。

examples.heading: ② 時間名詞在主詞的位置

items.en: The week when we moved house was exhausting.
items.zh: 我們搬家的那個禮拜累死人了。

items.en: The day when my son started school was very emotional for me.
items.zh: 我兒子開始上學的那一天讓我很激動。

items.en: The winter when the river froze was the coldest anyone could remember.
items.zh: 河結冰的那個冬天是大家印象中最冷的。

items.en: The evening when they announced the results was very tense.
items.zh: 他們公布結果的那個晚上很緊張。

items.en: The year when I lived in Paris changed my life.
items.zh: 我住在巴黎的那一年改變了我的人生。

items.en: The month when the festival happens is always busy.
items.zh: 舉辦節慶的那個月總是很忙。

examples.heading: ③ a time / the moment / the period + when

items.en: There was a time when I didn't like vegetables.
items.zh: 我以前有一段時間不喜歡吃蔬菜。

items.en: That was the moment when everything changed.
items.zh: 那就是一切改變的那一刻。

items.en: There are times when I just want to be alone.
items.zh: 有時候我只想一個人待著。

items.en: It was a period when nobody had much money.
items.zh: 那是一個大家都沒什麼錢的時期。

items.en: Do you ever have days when nothing goes right?
items.zh: 你有沒有過做什麼都不順的日子？

examples.heading: ④ 省略 when 或換成 that

items.en: That was the night we saw the shooting star.
items.zh: 那是我們看到流星的那一晚。

items.en: Monday is the day I go to the gym.
items.zh: 星期一是我去健身房的日子。

items.en: Do you remember the last time we went dancing?
items.zh: 你記得我們上次去跳舞是什麼時候嗎？

items.en: Christmas is the time that families get together.
items.zh: 聖誕節是家人團聚的時候。

items.en: Sunday is the day that my parents come for lunch.
items.zh: 星期天是我爸媽來吃午餐的日子。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Saturday is the only day when the market opens early.
items.zh: 星期六是市場唯一提早開的日子。

items.en: I can't wait for the weekend when we finally go camping.
items.zh: 我等不及我們終於要去露營的那個週末了。

items.en: The hour when the sun sets is the best time to take photos.
items.zh: 太陽下山的那個時候最適合拍照。

items.en: Spring is the season when I feel most alive.
items.zh: 春天是我最有活力的季節。

items.en: They got married in the year when the old bridge collapsed.
items.zh: 他們在舊橋倒塌的那一年結婚。

items.en: Ten o'clock is the time when the library closes.
items.zh: 十點是圖書館關門的時間。

items.en: I remember a holiday when it rained every single day.
items.zh: 我記得有一次度假每天都在下雨。

items.en: That was a time when I went out every night.
items.zh: 那段時間我每天晚上都出去。

title: Whether or not it is better to educate boys and girls in separate schools has been a widely discussed issue in recent years.
translation: 男女分校是不是比較好，是近年來大家廣泛討論的問題。
name: whether or not 引導條件（正式）
sentences: Whether or not you agree with the decision, you must respect it.
Whether or not the board concurs, we will publish the results next month.
Whether or not it is profitable, the project will continue until 2030.
Whether or not they receive approbation from their peers, scientists must report their findings honestly.
Whether or not the evidence is equivocal, the court must reach a decision.
Whether or not the trend continues, the industry will need to adapt.
Whether or not one agrees with the author, the book raises important questions.
Employees must attend the training whether or not they have worked here before.
The hotel charges the full fee whether or not guests use the facilities.
The government must act whether or not the public supports the plan.
Every citizen has the right to vote whether or not they own property.
Many people disparage modern art whether or not they understand it.
Guests may use the pool whether or not they are staying at the hotel.
Parents should praise their children's efforts whether or not the children win.
Whether the plan succeeds or not, we will have learned a great deal.
The flight will leave on time whether the passengers are ready or not.
Whether she was right or not, her remarks caused grave offence.
Whether the delay was unforeseen or not, the company should have informed its customers.
Whether or not children should have homework is a frequently debated topic.
Whether or not the company knew about the risks is still a mystery.
Whether or not tourists should follow local customs is a debatable issue.
Nobody knows yet whether or not the new policy will work.
The minister refused to say whether or not she knew about the problem.
Researchers are investigating whether or not the drug has any side effects.
The report does not say whether or not the costs were excessive.
Scientists still disagree about whether or not screen time harms young children.
Students can decide for themselves whether or not they go to university.
Whether or not you have booked in advance, please report to reception on arrival.
Please inform us whether or not you wish to renew your membership.
We will consider all applications whether or not they include a photograph.
Whether or not the strike goes ahead, the office will remain open.
We would be grateful if you could confirm whether or not the room is still available.

examples.heading: ① 條件子句放在主要子句前面

items.en: Whether or not you agree with the decision, you must respect it.
items.zh: 不管你同不同意這個決定，你都必須尊重它。

items.en: Whether or not the board concurs, we will publish the results next month.
items.zh: 不管董事會同不同意，我們下個月都會公布結果。

items.en: Whether or not it is profitable, the project will continue until 2030.
items.zh: 不管有沒有獲利，這個計畫都會持續到 2030 年。

items.en: Whether or not they receive approbation from their peers, scientists must report their findings honestly.
items.zh: 不管有沒有得到同行的認可，科學家都必須誠實報告研究結果。

items.en: Whether or not the evidence is equivocal, the court must reach a decision.
items.zh: 不管證據是不是模稜兩可，法院都必須做出判決。

items.en: Whether or not the trend continues, the industry will need to adapt.
items.zh: 不管這個趨勢會不會持續，這個產業都得調整。

items.en: Whether or not one agrees with the author, the book raises important questions.
items.zh: 不管是否同意作者的看法，這本書都提出了重要的問題。

examples.heading: ② 條件子句放在主要子句後面

items.en: Employees must attend the training whether or not they have worked here before.
items.zh: 不管以前有沒有在這裡工作過，員工都必須參加訓練。

items.en: The hotel charges the full fee whether or not guests use the facilities.
items.zh: 不管房客有沒有使用設施，飯店都收全額費用。

items.en: The government must act whether or not the public supports the plan.
items.zh: 不管民眾支不支持這個計畫，政府都必須採取行動。

items.en: Every citizen has the right to vote whether or not they own property.
items.zh: 不管有沒有財產，每個公民都有投票權。

items.en: Many people disparage modern art whether or not they understand it.
items.zh: 很多人不管看不看得懂現代藝術，都會貶低它。

items.en: Guests may use the pool whether or not they are staying at the hotel.
items.zh: 不管有沒有住在飯店，客人都可以使用游泳池。

items.en: Parents should praise their children's efforts whether or not the children win.
items.zh: 不管孩子有沒有贏，父母都應該稱讚他們的努力。

examples.heading: ③ or not 放在條件子句後面

items.en: Whether the plan succeeds or not, we will have learned a great deal.
items.zh: 不管計畫成不成功，我們都會學到很多。

items.en: The flight will leave on time whether the passengers are ready or not.
items.zh: 不管乘客準備好了沒有，班機都會準時起飛。

items.en: Whether she was right or not, her remarks caused grave offence.
items.zh: 不管她說得對不對，她的話都嚴重冒犯了別人。

items.en: Whether the delay was unforeseen or not, the company should have informed its customers.
items.zh: 不管這次延誤是不是無法預見，公司都應該通知顧客。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞子句當主詞

items.en: Whether or not children should have homework is a frequently debated topic.
items.zh: 孩子該不該有回家功課，是常被討論的話題。

items.en: Whether or not the company knew about the risks is still a mystery.
items.zh: 這家公司是否知道這些風險，到現在還是個謎。

items.en: Whether or not tourists should follow local customs is a debatable issue.
items.zh: 觀光客是否應該遵守當地習俗，是一個有爭議的問題。

examples.heading: ⑤ 名詞子句當受詞

items.en: Nobody knows yet whether or not the new policy will work.
items.zh: 還沒有人知道新政策是否有效。

items.en: The minister refused to say whether or not she knew about the problem.
items.zh: 部長拒絕說明她是否知道這個問題。

items.en: Researchers are investigating whether or not the drug has any side effects.
items.zh: 研究人員正在調查這種藥是否有副作用。

items.en: The report does not say whether or not the costs were excessive.
items.zh: 報告沒有說明這些費用是否過高。

items.en: Scientists still disagree about whether or not screen time harms young children.
items.zh: 科學家對於使用螢幕的時間是否傷害幼童，看法仍然不一致。

items.en: Students can decide for themselves whether or not they go to university.
items.zh: 要不要上大學，學生可以自己決定。

examples.heading: ⑥ 正式信件和通知

items.en: Whether or not you have booked in advance, please report to reception on arrival.
items.zh: 不管您有沒有事先預約，抵達時請先到櫃台報到。

items.en: Please inform us whether or not you wish to renew your membership.
items.zh: 請告知我們您是否要續約會員資格。

items.en: We will consider all applications whether or not they include a photograph.
items.zh: 不管有沒有附照片，我們都會審核所有的申請。

items.en: Whether or not the strike goes ahead, the office will remain open.
items.zh: 不管罷工會不會照常進行，辦公室都會照常開放。

items.en: We would be grateful if you could confirm whether or not the room is still available.
items.zh: 如果您能確認那個房間是否還有空，我們會很感謝。

title: What happened?
translation: 發生什麼事了？
name: wh- 疑問詞當主詞的疑問句
sentences: You're limping. What happened to your knee?
You hated cats. What made you get one?
There's glass everywhere. What smashed the kitchen window?
My new coffee machine has a red button. What happens if I press this button?
I can hear a strange buzz in the kitchen. What's making that noise?
The firefighters are still there this morning. What started the fire at the old factory?
Your phone rang at midnight. Who called you so late?
There are always nice cars outside. Who owns that big house on the hill?
There's one piece left. Who wants more cake?
You've got an interview on Monday? Who told you about the job at the library?
I missed the end of the football. Who won the match?
It looks great, and you did it in one day. Who helped you paint the bedroom?
There are three buses at this stop. Which bus goes to the airport?
I arrived at half-time. Which team scored first?
There are four bakeries on this street. Which shop sells the best bread?
We're at a crossroads, and there's no sign. Which road leads to the beach?
The test results are on the wall. Which student got the highest mark?
A: Will it rain tomorrow? B: Who knows?
A: Your shirt is on inside out. B: Who cares?
Don't plan too far ahead. Who knows what will happen next year?
It's just a game. Who cares who wins?
I need to set the table. Who's coming to dinner tonight?
The screen is black. What has happened to my laptop?
We're all going to Spain for two weeks. Who will take care of the dog?
The cake didn't rise. What went wrong this time?
The teacher wrote a hard sum on the board. Who can answer this question?
The electricity bill is huge this month. Who's been leaving the lights on all night?
The taxi is stuck in traffic. What will happen if we miss the train?
It isn't my birthday. Who left these flowers on my desk?
My glasses were on the sofa, and now they're bent. Which of you broke them?

examples.heading: ① What + 動詞

items.en: You're limping. What happened to your knee?
items.zh: 你走路一跛一跛的，你的膝蓋怎麼了？

items.en: You hated cats. What made you get one?
items.zh: 你以前很討厭貓，是什麼讓你決定養一隻？

items.en: There's glass everywhere. What smashed the kitchen window?
items.zh: 到處都是玻璃，是什麼打破了廚房的窗戶？

items.en: My new coffee machine has a red button. What happens if I press this button?
items.zh: 我的新咖啡機有一個紅色按鈕。如果我按這個按鈕會怎麼樣？

items.en: I can hear a strange buzz in the kitchen. What's making that noise?
items.zh: 我聽到廚房裡有奇怪的嗡嗡聲。是什麼在發出那個聲音？

items.en: The firefighters are still there this morning. What started the fire at the old factory?
items.zh: 消防員今天早上還在那裡。老工廠的火是什麼引起的？

examples.heading: ② Who + 動詞

items.en: Your phone rang at midnight. Who called you so late?
items.zh: 你的手機半夜響了。誰那麼晚打給你？

items.en: There are always nice cars outside. Who owns that big house on the hill?
items.zh: 外面總是停著好車。山上那棟大房子是誰的？

items.en: There's one piece left. Who wants more cake?
items.zh: 還剩一塊。誰還要蛋糕？

items.en: You've got an interview on Monday? Who told you about the job at the library?
items.zh: 你星期一有面試？誰跟你說圖書館那份工作的事？

items.en: I missed the end of the football. Who won the match?
items.zh: 我錯過了足球賽的最後一段。誰贏了比賽？

items.en: It looks great, and you did it in one day. Who helped you paint the bedroom?
items.zh: 看起來很棒，而且你一天就做完了。誰幫你油漆臥室的？

examples.heading: ③ Which + 名詞 + 動詞

items.en: There are three buses at this stop. Which bus goes to the airport?
items.zh: 這個站有三班公車。哪一班公車到機場？

items.en: I arrived at half-time. Which team scored first?
items.zh: 我中場休息才到。哪一隊先得分？

items.en: There are four bakeries on this street. Which shop sells the best bread?
items.zh: 這條街有四家麵包店。哪一家店賣的麵包最好吃？

items.en: We're at a crossroads, and there's no sign. Which road leads to the beach?
items.zh: 我們在十字路口，可是沒有路標。哪一條路通往海邊？

items.en: The test results are on the wall. Which student got the highest mark?
items.zh: 考試成績貼在牆上。哪個學生拿最高分？

examples.heading: ④ Who knows? / Who cares?

items.en: A: Will it rain tomorrow? B: Who knows?
items.zh: A：明天會下雨嗎？B：誰知道呢？

items.en: A: Your shirt is on inside out. B: Who cares?
items.zh: A：你的襯衫穿反了。B：誰在乎？

items.en: Don't plan too far ahead. Who knows what will happen next year?
items.zh: 別計畫得太遠。誰知道明年會發生什麼事？

items.en: It's just a game. Who cares who wins?
items.zh: 只是遊戲而已，誰在乎誰贏？

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: I need to set the table. Who's coming to dinner tonight?
items.zh: 我要擺餐桌。今晚誰要來吃晚餐？

items.en: The screen is black. What has happened to my laptop?
items.zh: 螢幕全黑了，我的筆電怎麼了？

items.en: We're all going to Spain for two weeks. Who will take care of the dog?
items.zh: 我們全家要去西班牙兩個星期。誰會照顧那隻狗？

items.en: The cake didn't rise. What went wrong this time?
items.zh: 蛋糕沒發起來，這次是哪裡出錯了？

items.en: The teacher wrote a hard sum on the board. Who can answer this question?
items.zh: 老師在黑板上寫了一題很難的算術。誰能回答這個問題？

items.en: The electricity bill is huge this month. Who's been leaving the lights on all night?
items.zh: 這個月的電費好高。是誰一直整晚開著燈？

items.en: The taxi is stuck in traffic. What will happen if we miss the train?
items.zh: 計程車塞在車陣裡。如果我們錯過火車會怎麼樣？

items.en: It isn't my birthday. Who left these flowers on my desk?
items.zh: 今天不是我生日。誰把這些花放在我桌上的？

items.en: My glasses were on the sofa, and now they're bent. Which of you broke them?
items.zh: 我的眼鏡放在沙發上，現在彎掉了。你們之中誰弄壞的？

title: What a great afternoon I had yesterday!
translation: 我昨天下午過得真開心！
name: what a 加名詞片語的感嘆句
sentences: You booked the tickets and the hotel already? What a brilliant plan!
Look at the mountains from this window. What a beautiful view!
You made that dress yourself? What a lovely piece of work!
Three meetings and two flights. What a long day it's been!
Is that your new puppy? What a cute little thing!
Why do you want to know my shoe size? What a strange question!
We saw dolphins and a rainbow. What an amazing trip!
Your grandfather sailed around the world? What an interesting life!
Three hundred dollars for a T-shirt? What an expensive shop!
Close the fridge. What an awful smell!
Everyone got full marks. What an easy quiz that was!
Toys everywhere and paint on the wall. What a mess!
You came all the way from Canada? What a surprise!
The concert is sold out? What a pity!
I missed the bus and lost my wallet. What a day!
The test results are fine? What a relief!
What a nice room they gave us!
What a great time we had at the lake!
What a beautiful house you live in!
What a good friend you are!
What a terrible mistake I made at work today!
What a lucky boy he is!
Thank you for the roses. What lovely flowers they are!
Rain again, and it's July. What terrible weather we're having!
What beautiful eyes your daughter has!
Your mother cooked all this? What delicious food!
They helped us carry everything. What kind people they are!
A flat tire on the way to the airport? What bad luck!
What nice shoes you're wearing!
What strange ideas he has!

examples.heading: ① What a + 形容詞 + 名詞!

items.en: You booked the tickets and the hotel already? What a brilliant plan!
items.zh: 你已經訂好票跟飯店了？好棒的計畫！

items.en: Look at the mountains from this window. What a beautiful view!
items.zh: 從這扇窗看那些山，好美的景色！

items.en: You made that dress yourself? What a lovely piece of work!
items.zh: 那件洋裝是你自己做的？做得真好！

items.en: Three meetings and two flights. What a long day it's been!
items.zh: 三場會議加兩趟飛機，今天真漫長！

items.en: Is that your new puppy? What a cute little thing!
items.zh: 那是你的新小狗嗎？好可愛的小傢伙！

items.en: Why do you want to know my shoe size? What a strange question!
items.zh: 你為什麼想知道我穿幾號鞋？好奇怪的問題！

examples.heading: ② What an + 形容詞 + 名詞!

items.en: We saw dolphins and a rainbow. What an amazing trip!
items.zh: 我們看到海豚和彩虹，這趟旅行太棒了！

items.en: Your grandfather sailed around the world? What an interesting life!
items.zh: 你爺爺航行過全世界？他的人生真有趣！

items.en: Three hundred dollars for a T-shirt? What an expensive shop!
items.zh: 一件 T 恤三百塊？這家店好貴！

items.en: Close the fridge. What an awful smell!
items.zh: 把冰箱關上，好難聞的味道！

items.en: Everyone got full marks. What an easy quiz that was!
items.zh: 每個人都滿分，那次小考真簡單！

examples.heading: ③ What a + 名詞!（沒有形容詞）

items.en: Toys everywhere and paint on the wall. What a mess!
items.zh: 到處都是玩具，牆上還有顏料，好亂！

items.en: You came all the way from Canada? What a surprise!
items.zh: 你大老遠從加拿大過來？真是驚喜！

items.en: The concert is sold out? What a pity!
items.zh: 演唱會賣完了？真可惜！

items.en: I missed the bus and lost my wallet. What a day!
items.zh: 我錯過公車又弄丟皮夾，真是倒楣的一天！

items.en: The test results are fine? What a relief!
items.zh: 檢查結果沒問題？總算鬆了一口氣！

examples.heading: ④ What a + 名詞片語 + 子句!

items.en: What a nice room they gave us!
items.zh: 他們給我們的房間真好！

items.en: What a great time we had at the lake!
items.zh: 我們在湖邊玩得真開心！

items.en: What a beautiful house you live in!
items.zh: 你住的房子真漂亮！

items.en: What a good friend you are!
items.zh: 你真是個好朋友！

items.en: What a terrible mistake I made at work today!
items.zh: 我今天在工作上犯了好嚴重的錯！

items.en: What a lucky boy he is!
items.zh: 他真是個幸運的男孩！

examples.heading: ⑤ What + 複數 / 不可數名詞!

items.en: Thank you for the roses. What lovely flowers they are!
items.zh: 謝謝你送的玫瑰，這些花好漂亮！

items.en: Rain again, and it's July. What terrible weather we're having!
items.zh: 又下雨了，現在可是七月，天氣真糟！

items.en: What beautiful eyes your daughter has!
items.zh: 你女兒的眼睛真漂亮！

items.en: Your mother cooked all this? What delicious food!
items.zh: 這些都是你媽媽煮的？好好吃！

items.en: They helped us carry everything. What kind people they are!
items.zh: 他們幫我們搬了所有東西，他們真是好心的人！

items.en: A flat tire on the way to the airport? What bad luck!
items.zh: 去機場的路上爆胎？運氣真差！

items.en: What nice shoes you're wearing!
items.zh: 你穿的鞋真好看！

items.en: What strange ideas he has!
items.zh: 他的想法真奇怪！

title: What a pity that you didn't come.
translation: 你沒來真是太可惜了。
name: what a pity 加 that 子句
sentences: What a pity that you missed the party. It was great.
What a pity that it rained on your wedding day.
What a pity that the museum was closed.
What a pity that we missed the train.
What a pity that your brother couldn't join us.
What a pity that they cancelled the concert.
What a pity you lost the map of the old town.
What a pity you left your camera at home.
What a pity you didn't tell me earlier.
What a pity we live so far apart.
What a pity she didn't get the job.
What a pity that you can't stay longer.
What a pity the beach is so crowded today.
What a pity that he won't be here for my birthday.
What a pity you have to work this weekend.
What a pity the weather isn't better.
What a shame the shop has closed.
What a shame that you can't come to the wedding.
What a shame we didn't take more photos.
What a shame that the holiday is over.
What a shame he forgot his lines in the play.
What a pity! I really wanted to see you.
It's a pity that the library closes so early.
What a pity that nobody told us about the sale.
What a pity the cake didn't turn out well.
What a pity that they're pulling down the old cinema.
What a pity we only have one day in Rome.
What a pity that your parents can't meet her.
What a pity you weren't there to see it.
What a shame that the restaurant is full tonight.

examples.heading: ① What a pity that + 過去式

items.en: What a pity that you missed the party. It was great.
items.zh: 你錯過了派對真可惜，派對很好玩。

items.en: What a pity that it rained on your wedding day.
items.zh: 你結婚那天下雨，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity that the museum was closed.
items.zh: 博物館沒開，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity that we missed the train.
items.zh: 我們錯過了火車，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity that your brother couldn't join us.
items.zh: 你哥哥不能跟我們一起來，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity that they cancelled the concert.
items.zh: 他們取消了演唱會，真可惜。

examples.heading: ② What a pity + 子句（省略 that）

items.en: What a pity you lost the map of the old town.
items.zh: 你把舊城區的地圖弄丟了，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity you left your camera at home.
items.zh: 你把相機忘在家裡，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity you didn't tell me earlier.
items.zh: 你沒早點告訴我，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity we live so far apart.
items.zh: 我們住得那麼遠，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity she didn't get the job.
items.zh: 她沒得到那份工作，真可惜。

examples.heading: ③ What a pity + 現在式 / can't / won't

items.en: What a pity that you can't stay longer.
items.zh: 你不能多待一陣子，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity the beach is so crowded today.
items.zh: 今天海邊人這麼多，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity that he won't be here for my birthday.
items.zh: 他不能來參加我的生日，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity you have to work this weekend.
items.zh: 你這個週末要上班，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity the weather isn't better.
items.zh: 天氣不好一點，真可惜。

examples.heading: ④ What a shame (that) ...

items.en: What a shame the shop has closed.
items.zh: 那家店關了，真可惜。

items.en: What a shame that you can't come to the wedding.
items.zh: 你不能來婚禮，真可惜。

items.en: What a shame we didn't take more photos.
items.zh: 我們沒多拍一些照片，真可惜。

items.en: What a shame that the holiday is over.
items.zh: 假期結束了，真可惜。

items.en: What a shame he forgot his lines in the play.
items.zh: 他在話劇裡忘詞了，真可惜。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: What a pity! I really wanted to see you.
items.zh: 真可惜！我很想見你。

items.en: It's a pity that the library closes so early.
items.zh: 圖書館這麼早關門，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity that nobody told us about the sale.
items.zh: 沒人跟我們說特賣的事，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity the cake didn't turn out well.
items.zh: 蛋糕沒做好，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity that they're pulling down the old cinema.
items.zh: 他們要拆掉那間老電影院，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity we only have one day in Rome.
items.zh: 我們在羅馬只有一天，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity that your parents can't meet her.
items.zh: 你爸媽不能見她，真可惜。

items.en: What a pity you weren't there to see it.
items.zh: 你不在那裡看到，真可惜。

items.en: What a shame that the restaurant is full tonight.
items.zh: 那家餐廳今晚客滿了，真可惜。

title: Which coat is yours, and whose is this one?
translation: 哪件外套是你的？這件又是誰的？
name: which 和 whose 開頭的疑問句
sentences: There are two buses at the stop. Which bus goes to the hospital?
We have twenty minutes to get to school. Which path is quicker, the one by the river or through the park?
I fell asleep before the end of the match. Which team won?
The campsite is full of tents. Which tent is ours, the green one or the orange one?
The café is very busy. Which table is free for four people?
We're painting your bedroom next week. Which colour would you like?
I'll pick you up at the airport. Which flight are you taking?
There are three schools in our town. Which school does your son go to?
I have a blue tie and a red one. Which tie should I wear to the interview?
Your photos of Venice are lovely. Which hotel did you stay at?
There are five coats on the chair. Which of these coats is yours?
The cookie jar is empty, kids. Which of you ate the last cookie?
There's chocolate, lemon and carrot. Which of the three would you like?
You got offers from the bank and the school. Which of the two jobs will you take?
I'm going south next week. Which of your sisters lives in Tainan?
Please turn off your phones in the cinema. Whose phone is that?
A red sports car is in front of our gate. Whose car is it?
I washed up last night. Whose turn is it to wash the dishes?
We're camping in the rain with no tent. Whose idea was this?
Someone left muddy boots in the hall. Whose shoes are these by the door?
Is the party at Ann's or Ken's? Whose house are we going to tonight?
A blue scarf was left in the classroom. Whose is this scarf?
I found them on the kitchen table. Whose are these keys?
Someone left this umbrella here. Whose is it?
Which towel is Ann's, and which is Ken's?
We're lost in the old town. Which way is the beach?
I'm at your building now. Which floor do you live on?
There's a cake in the office kitchen. Whose birthday is it today?
I can't decide between these two bags. Which is better, the red one or the blue one?
I couldn't sleep at all. Whose dog is barking all night?

examples.heading: ① Which + 名詞 + 動詞

items.en: There are two buses at the stop. Which bus goes to the hospital?
items.zh: 公車站有兩班公車。哪一班公車到醫院？

items.en: We have twenty minutes to get to school. Which path is quicker, the one by the river or through the park?
items.zh: 我們有二十分鐘到學校。哪一條路比較快，河邊那條還是穿過公園那條？

items.en: I fell asleep before the end of the match. Which team won?
items.zh: 比賽結束前我就睡著了。哪一隊贏了？

items.en: The campsite is full of tents. Which tent is ours, the green one or the orange one?
items.zh: 營地裡滿是帳篷。哪一頂帳篷是我們的，綠色那頂還是橘色那頂？

items.en: The café is very busy. Which table is free for four people?
items.zh: 咖啡館很擠。哪一張桌子可以坐四個人？

examples.heading: ② Which + 名詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞

items.en: We're painting your bedroom next week. Which colour would you like?
items.zh: 我們下星期要油漆你的臥室。你想要哪個顏色？

items.en: I'll pick you up at the airport. Which flight are you taking?
items.zh: 我會去機場接你。你要搭哪一班飛機？

items.en: There are three schools in our town. Which school does your son go to?
items.zh: 我們鎮上有三所學校。你兒子讀哪一所學校？

items.en: I have a blue tie and a red one. Which tie should I wear to the interview?
items.zh: 我有一條藍領帶和一條紅領帶。面試我應該打哪條領帶？

items.en: Your photos of Venice are lovely. Which hotel did you stay at?
items.zh: 你拍的威尼斯照片很美。你住哪一家飯店？

examples.heading: ③ Which of ...?

items.en: There are five coats on the chair. Which of these coats is yours?
items.zh: 椅子上有五件外套。這些外套裡哪一件是你的？

items.en: The cookie jar is empty, kids. Which of you ate the last cookie?
items.zh: 孩子們，餅乾罐空了。你們之中誰吃了最後一塊餅乾？

items.en: There's chocolate, lemon and carrot. Which of the three would you like?
items.zh: 有巧克力、檸檬和紅蘿蔔口味。三個裡面你想要哪一個？

items.en: You got offers from the bank and the school. Which of the two jobs will you take?
items.zh: 銀行和學校都給你工作機會。這兩份工作你會選哪一份？

items.en: I'm going south next week. Which of your sisters lives in Tainan?
items.zh: 我下星期要去南部。你哪一個姊妹住在台南？

examples.heading: ④ Whose + 名詞 ...?

items.en: Please turn off your phones in the cinema. Whose phone is that?
items.zh: 電影院裡請把手機關掉。那是誰的手機？

items.en: A red sports car is in front of our gate. Whose car is it?
items.zh: 一輛紅色跑車停在我們大門前面。那是誰的車？

items.en: I washed up last night. Whose turn is it to wash the dishes?
items.zh: 我昨天晚上洗了碗。輪到誰洗碗了？

items.en: We're camping in the rain with no tent. Whose idea was this?
items.zh: 我們在雨中露營，又沒有帳篷。這是誰的主意？

items.en: Someone left muddy boots in the hall. Whose shoes are these by the door?
items.zh: 有人把沾泥的靴子留在玄關。門邊這雙鞋是誰的？

items.en: Is the party at Ann's or Ken's? Whose house are we going to tonight?
items.zh: 派對是在 Ann 家還是 Ken 家？我們今晚要去誰家？

examples.heading: ⑤ Whose is ...? 和不同的句型

items.en: A blue scarf was left in the classroom. Whose is this scarf?
items.zh: 有一條藍色圍巾留在教室裡。這條圍巾是誰的？

items.en: I found them on the kitchen table. Whose are these keys?
items.zh: 我在廚房桌上找到的。這些鑰匙是誰的？

items.en: Someone left this umbrella here. Whose is it?
items.zh: 有人把這把傘留在這裡，是誰的？

items.en: Which towel is Ann's, and which is Ken's?
items.zh: 哪條毛巾是 Ann 的？哪條是 Ken 的？

items.en: We're lost in the old town. Which way is the beach?
items.zh: 我們在舊城區迷路了。海邊往哪個方向？

items.en: I'm at your building now. Which floor do you live on?
items.zh: 我現在在你的大樓。你住幾樓？

items.en: There's a cake in the office kitchen. Whose birthday is it today?
items.zh: 辦公室的廚房有一個蛋糕。今天是誰的生日？

items.en: I can't decide between these two bags. Which is better, the red one or the blue one?
items.zh: 我沒辦法在這兩個包包之間做決定。紅色的跟藍色的，哪一個比較好？

items.en: I couldn't sleep at all. Whose dog is barking all night?
items.zh: 我完全睡不著。是誰家的狗整晚在叫？

title: The city where I live is very nice and extremely charming.
translation: 我住的城市很棒，而且非常迷人。
name: where 引導表示地點的限定關係子句
sentences: The beach where we spent our honeymoon is now a resort.
The office where my mother works is on the tenth floor.
The school where I teach has only two hundred students.
The restaurant where they got engaged doesn't exist anymore.
The street where we parked the car was really dark.
The village where my grandmother grew up has no supermarket.
We're looking for a hotel where we can bring our dog.
I remember the room where I used to do my homework.
Let's go to a place where nobody knows us.
Can you show me the spot where you found the wallet?
They moved to a town where houses are much cheaper.
I need a quiet corner where I can study.
This is the place where the accident happened.
Is there somewhere where we can sit down?
Home is the place where I feel most relaxed.
I'd like to live somewhere where it never snows.
We couldn't find anywhere where they sold batteries.
That's the corner where I'll be waiting for you.
This is the park where I learned to ride a bike.
The airport where we've just landed is tiny.
The gym where I was training last year has closed.
Do you know the bakery where they make those huge croissants?
Taitung is the city where I feel most at home.
I've booked a table at the restaurant where we had our first date.
Is this the shop where you bought your glasses?
The temple where we stayed had a beautiful garden.
Show me the drawer where you keep the spare keys.
The island where they filmed that movie is full of tourists now.
That's the bridge where my father proposed to my mother.
We visited the factory where they make the chocolate.

examples.heading: ① 地點名詞在主詞的位置

items.en: The beach where we spent our honeymoon is now a resort.
items.zh: 我們度蜜月的海灘現在變成度假村了。

items.en: The office where my mother works is on the tenth floor.
items.zh: 我媽媽上班的辦公室在十樓。

items.en: The school where I teach has only two hundred students.
items.zh: 我教書的學校只有兩百個學生。

items.en: The restaurant where they got engaged doesn't exist anymore.
items.zh: 他們訂婚的那家餐廳已經不在了。

items.en: The street where we parked the car was really dark.
items.zh: 我們停車的那條街好暗。

items.en: The village where my grandmother grew up has no supermarket.
items.zh: 我奶奶長大的那個村子沒有超市。

examples.heading: ② 地點名詞在受詞的位置

items.en: We're looking for a hotel where we can bring our dog.
items.zh: 我們在找一間可以帶狗入住的飯店。

items.en: I remember the room where I used to do my homework.
items.zh: 我記得我以前寫功課的那個房間。

items.en: Let's go to a place where nobody knows us.
items.zh: 我們去一個沒人認識我們的地方吧。

items.en: Can you show me the spot where you found the wallet?
items.zh: 你可以給我看你撿到皮夾的地方嗎？

items.en: They moved to a town where houses are much cheaper.
items.zh: 他們搬到一個房子便宜很多的小鎮。

items.en: I need a quiet corner where I can study.
items.zh: 我需要一個安靜的角落念書。

examples.heading: ③ the place / somewhere / anywhere + where

items.en: This is the place where the accident happened.
items.zh: 這就是事故發生的地方。

items.en: Is there somewhere where we can sit down?
items.zh: 有沒有什麼地方我們可以坐下來？

items.en: Home is the place where I feel most relaxed.
items.zh: 家是我覺得最放鬆的地方。

items.en: I'd like to live somewhere where it never snows.
items.zh: 我想住在一個從來不下雪的地方。

items.en: We couldn't find anywhere where they sold batteries.
items.zh: 我們找不到有賣電池的地方。

examples.heading: ④ 不同的時態

items.en: That's the corner where I'll be waiting for you.
items.zh: 那就是我會等你的那個轉角。

items.en: This is the park where I learned to ride a bike.
items.zh: 這是我學會騎腳踏車的公園。

items.en: The airport where we've just landed is tiny.
items.zh: 我們剛降落的機場好小。

items.en: The gym where I was training last year has closed.
items.zh: 我去年訓練的那家健身房關了。

items.en: Do you know the bakery where they make those huge croissants?
items.zh: 你知道做那種超大可頌的麵包店嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Taitung is the city where I feel most at home.
items.zh: 台東是讓我最有家的感覺的城市。

items.en: I've booked a table at the restaurant where we had our first date.
items.zh: 我在我們第一次約會的那家餐廳訂了位子。

items.en: Is this the shop where you bought your glasses?
items.zh: 這是你買眼鏡的店嗎？

items.en: The temple where we stayed had a beautiful garden.
items.zh: 我們住過的那間寺廟有一座很美的花園。

items.en: Show me the drawer where you keep the spare keys.
items.zh: 給我看你放備用鑰匙的抽屜。

items.en: The island where they filmed that movie is full of tourists now.
items.zh: 他們拍那部電影的那座島現在到處都是觀光客。

items.en: That's the bridge where my father proposed to my mother.
items.zh: 那就是我爸爸跟我媽媽求婚的那座橋。

items.en: We visited the factory where they make the chocolate.
items.zh: 我們參觀了製作那種巧克力的工廠。

title: We have a new employee whose name is Mary Watts.
translation: 我們有一位新員工，名字叫 Mary Watts。
name: whose name 引導的關係子句
sentences: There's a girl in my class whose name is exactly the same as mine.
She has a cat whose name is Mr. Whiskers.
They hired a designer whose name was on every magazine cover that year.
I'm reading a book by a writer whose name is hard to pronounce.
We stayed in a village whose name means "white river."
There's a restaurant on the corner whose name I really like.
My grandfather, whose name was Henry, was a fisherman.
I spoke to the manager, whose name is Paul Ross.
Our new puppy, whose name is Biscuit, chews everything.
We met her husband, whose name I've already forgotten.
Our dentist, whose name is on the door, is very gentle.
The hotel, whose name I didn't catch, was right next to the beach.
There was a man at the party whose name nobody knew.
She's an actress whose name I can never spell.
I bought a wine whose name I couldn't pronounce.
He's a player whose name every football fan recognizes.
That's the band whose name we saw on the poster.
The company whose name sounded familiar turned out to be a scam.
The man whose name appears on the cheque must sign it.
I called the student whose name came first on the list.
They're looking for the owner whose name is written inside the bag.
She's the scientist whose name is going to be on the new building.
Do you know anyone whose name starts with Z?
There's a street in Paris whose name changed five times.
I have a cousin whose name is the same as a famous singer's.
Anyone whose name isn't on the list can't come in.
Our neighbor, whose name is Mrs. Yang, cleans the park every morning.
The guide, whose name was Ahmed, spoke five languages.
Is there someone here whose name is Kim?
I finally found the song whose name I'd been trying to remember for weeks.

examples.heading: ① 限定：whose name + is / was

items.en: There's a girl in my class whose name is exactly the same as mine.
items.zh: 我們班有一個女生跟我同名同姓。

items.en: She has a cat whose name is Mr. Whiskers.
items.zh: 她養了一隻名叫鬍子先生的貓。

items.en: They hired a designer whose name was on every magazine cover that year.
items.zh: 他們請了一位設計師，他的名字那一年出現在每一本雜誌封面上。

items.en: I'm reading a book by a writer whose name is hard to pronounce.
items.zh: 我在看一本書，作者的名字很難唸。

items.en: We stayed in a village whose name means "white river."
items.zh: 我們住在一個名字意思是白色的河的村子。

items.en: There's a restaurant on the corner whose name I really like.
items.zh: 轉角有一家餐廳，我很喜歡它的名字。

examples.heading: ② 非限定：, whose name ...

items.en: My grandfather, whose name was Henry, was a fisherman.
items.zh: 我爺爺叫 Henry，他是漁夫。

items.en: I spoke to the manager, whose name is Paul Ross.
items.zh: 我跟經理談過了，他叫 Paul Ross。

items.en: Our new puppy, whose name is Biscuit, chews everything.
items.zh: 我們的新小狗叫餅乾，什麼都咬。

items.en: We met her husband, whose name I've already forgotten.
items.zh: 我們見過她先生，他的名字我已經忘了。

items.en: Our dentist, whose name is on the door, is very gentle.
items.zh: 我們的牙醫很溫柔，他的名字就寫在門上。

items.en: The hotel, whose name I didn't catch, was right next to the beach.
items.zh: 那家飯店就在海灘旁邊，我沒聽清楚它的名字。

examples.heading: ③ whose name 當受詞

items.en: There was a man at the party whose name nobody knew.
items.zh: 派對上有一個沒人知道名字的男人。

items.en: She's an actress whose name I can never spell.
items.zh: 她是一個我總是拼不出名字的女演員。

items.en: I bought a wine whose name I couldn't pronounce.
items.zh: 我買了一瓶我唸不出名字的酒。

items.en: He's a player whose name every football fan recognizes.
items.zh: 他是一位每個足球迷都認得名字的球員。

items.en: That's the band whose name we saw on the poster.
items.zh: 那就是我們在海報上看到名字的那個樂團。

examples.heading: ④ whose name 後面接其他動詞

items.en: The company whose name sounded familiar turned out to be a scam.
items.zh: 那家名字聽起來很耳熟的公司結果是詐騙。

items.en: The man whose name appears on the cheque must sign it.
items.zh: 支票上寫的那個人要在支票上簽名。

items.en: I called the student whose name came first on the list.
items.zh: 我叫了名單上排第一個的學生。

items.en: They're looking for the owner whose name is written inside the bag.
items.zh: 他們在找名字寫在包包裡面的那個主人。

items.en: She's the scientist whose name is going to be on the new building.
items.zh: 她就是那位名字會放在新大樓上的科學家。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Do you know anyone whose name starts with Z?
items.zh: 你認識名字是 Z 開頭的人嗎？

items.en: There's a street in Paris whose name changed five times.
items.zh: 巴黎有一條街，名字改了五次。

items.en: I have a cousin whose name is the same as a famous singer's.
items.zh: 我有一個表哥跟一位知名歌手同名。

items.en: Anyone whose name isn't on the list can't come in.
items.zh: 名字不在名單上的人不能進來。

items.en: Our neighbor, whose name is Mrs. Yang, cleans the park every morning.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居楊太太每天早上都去打掃公園。

items.en: The guide, whose name was Ahmed, spoke five languages.
items.zh: 導遊叫 Ahmed，他會說五種語言。

items.en: Is there someone here whose name is Kim?
items.zh: 這裡有叫 Kim 的人嗎？

items.en: I finally found the song whose name I'd been trying to remember for weeks.
items.zh: 我終於找到那首歌了，我想它的名字想了好幾個禮拜。

title: Write to me soon.
translation: 要早點寫信給我喔。
name: 書信結尾和道別的祈使句
sentences: Write to me when you're settled in.
You're flying to Canada tomorrow? Email or phone me when you get there.
I'm in meetings all morning. Call me tomorrow after lunch, OK?
It was great to meet you. Keep in touch!
Have a great time on your trip! Send me a postcard from Paris.
Good luck on Monday. Let me know how the interview goes.
Come soon. We miss you.
Our new house has a spare room. Come and see us next summer.
We live near the old fort. Visit us when you're in Tainan.
We'll miss you at work. Come back soon!
We live just round the corner now. Drop by anytime.
Bye, Grandma. Look after yourself until we visit again.
Have a safe flight home, and text me when you land.
Enjoy your week in Bali, and don't forget the sunscreen.
Rest as much as you can, and get better soon.
Your bags are already in the car? Have a lovely weekend at the lake.
Good night, kids. Sleep well and sweet dreams.
Say hello to your family for me, and see you in May.
I heard she's back from hospital. Give my love to your mother.
You're seeing Ken at the party tonight? Say hi to him for me.
Thank you for the lovely visit. Give my best wishes to your grandparents.
I haven't seen Ann since school. Tell her I said hello.
I know you're busy with exams. Write back when you can. Take care.
Enjoy the camping trip, kids. See you next week. Have fun!
My train is coming. Bye for now. Call me later.
Good luck tomorrow. Let me know how it goes.
That's all my news for now. Write back when you have time.
Thanks again. Look after yourself.
Hope to see you soon. Give my love to everyone.
I have to go now. Give the baby a hug from me.

examples.heading: ① 請對方聯絡

items.en: Write to me when you're settled in.
items.zh: 你安頓好以後寫信給我。

items.en: You're flying to Canada tomorrow? Email or phone me when you get there.
items.zh: 你明天要飛去加拿大？你到了以後寄電子郵件或打電話給我。

items.en: I'm in meetings all morning. Call me tomorrow after lunch, OK?
items.zh: 我整個早上都在開會。明天午餐後打給我，好嗎？

items.en: It was great to meet you. Keep in touch!
items.zh: 很高興認識你，保持聯絡！

items.en: Have a great time on your trip! Send me a postcard from Paris.
items.zh: 旅行玩得開心！從巴黎寄張明信片給我。

items.en: Good luck on Monday. Let me know how the interview goes.
items.zh: 星期一祝你好運。讓我知道面試的結果。

examples.heading: ② 請對方來

items.en: Come soon. We miss you.
items.zh: 早點來喔，我們很想你。

items.en: Our new house has a spare room. Come and see us next summer.
items.zh: 我們的新家有一間客房。明年夏天來看我們。

items.en: We live near the old fort. Visit us when you're in Tainan.
items.zh: 我們住在古堡附近。你來台南的時候來找我們。

items.en: We'll miss you at work. Come back soon!
items.zh: 公司的大家會想你的，早點回來喔！

items.en: We live just round the corner now. Drop by anytime.
items.zh: 我們現在就住在轉角。隨時過來坐坐。

examples.heading: ③ 關心和祝福

items.en: Bye, Grandma. Look after yourself until we visit again.
items.zh: 奶奶再見，好好照顧自己，等我們再來看你。

items.en: Have a safe flight home, and text me when you land.
items.zh: 回程一路平安，降落後傳簡訊給我。

items.en: Enjoy your week in Bali, and don't forget the sunscreen.
items.zh: 在峇里島的這個禮拜玩得開心，別忘了擦防曬。

items.en: Rest as much as you can, and get better soon.
items.zh: 盡量多休息，早點好起來。

items.en: Your bags are already in the car? Have a lovely weekend at the lake.
items.zh: 你的行李已經在車上了？在湖邊週末愉快。

items.en: Good night, kids. Sleep well and sweet dreams.
items.zh: 晚安，孩子們，好好睡，做個好夢。

examples.heading: ④ 轉達問候

items.en: Say hello to your family for me, and see you in May.
items.zh: 幫我跟你的家人問好，五月見。

items.en: I heard she's back from hospital. Give my love to your mother.
items.zh: 我聽說她出院了。代我向你媽媽問好。

items.en: You're seeing Ken at the party tonight? Say hi to him for me.
items.zh: 你今天晚上會在派對上見到 Ken？幫我跟他打聲招呼。

items.en: Thank you for the lovely visit. Give my best wishes to your grandparents.
items.zh: 謝謝你們熱情招待。代我向你爺爺奶奶問候。

items.en: I haven't seen Ann since school. Tell her I said hello.
items.zh: 我畢業以後就沒見過 Ann 了。跟她說我向她問好。

examples.heading: ⑤ 結合在一起的結尾

items.en: I know you're busy with exams. Write back when you can. Take care.
items.zh: 我知道你在忙考試。有空就回信。保重。

items.en: Enjoy the camping trip, kids. See you next week. Have fun!
items.zh: 孩子們，露營玩得開心。下禮拜見，玩得開心！

items.en: My train is coming. Bye for now. Call me later.
items.zh: 我的火車來了。先這樣，晚點打給我。

items.en: Good luck tomorrow. Let me know how it goes.
items.zh: 明天祝你好運，結果如何要告訴我。

items.en: That's all my news for now. Write back when you have time.
items.zh: 我的近況就先寫到這裡，有空再回信喔。

items.en: Thanks again. Look after yourself.
items.zh: 再次謝謝你，好好照顧自己。

items.en: Hope to see you soon. Give my love to everyone.
items.zh: 希望很快見到你，代我向大家問好。

items.en: I have to go now. Give the baby a hug from me.
items.zh: 我得走了，幫我抱抱寶寶。

title: We'll meet at my house at 3 o'clock. Don't be late!
translation: 我們 3 點在我家碰面。不要遲到！
name: 接在指示後加強語氣的否定祈使句
sentences: The film starts at seven. Don't be late!
Class begins at 8:30 sharp. Don't be late.
The bus leaves at noon. Don't be late, or it'll go without you.
Dinner is at six tonight. Don't be late again!
We'll pick you up at nine. Don't be late.
The café is behind the bank, near the bus stop. Don't forget.
You have PE first thing tomorrow. Pack your gym shoes tonight. Don't forget!
It's her eightieth birthday today. Call your grandmother tonight. Don't forget.
The Wi-Fi password is sunny123. Don't forget it.
The doctor gave me pills for my ear. Take your medicine after lunch. Don't forget!
Here's the key to the flat. Don't lose it.
You need it to get out of the station. Keep your ticket. Don't lose it!
The last train is at midnight. Don't miss it.
The sale ends on Sunday. Don't miss it!
My phone is new, and you don't have the number. Write down my number. Don't lose it.
The party is a surprise. Don't tell Ann!
I'm getting married in May. Don't tell anyone yet.
The paint is still wet. Don't touch it.
The cake is for tomorrow. Don't eat it!
This is my sister's laptop. Don't open it.
I'll meet you at the station. Don't worry.
Thanks for feeding the cat this weekend. Lock the door when you leave. Don't leave it open.
It's snowing outside. Wear a warm coat. Don't catch a cold.
The road to the hotel has many sharp bends. Drive slowly on the mountain road. Don't rush.
Turn off the oven at four. Don't let the cake burn.
The museum is very big. Wait for me by the gate. Don't go in alone.
You know the job well. Speak slowly in the interview. Don't panic.
We'll be away for two weeks in August. Water the plants every day. Don't let them dry out.
The road by the school is busy. Hold my hand when we cross. Don't run.
The teacher handed out the test. Answer all the questions. Don't leave any blank.

examples.heading: ① ... Don't be late!

items.en: The film starts at seven. Don't be late!
items.zh: 電影七點開始，不要遲到！

items.en: Class begins at 8:30 sharp. Don't be late.
items.zh: 八點半準時上課，不要遲到。

items.en: The bus leaves at noon. Don't be late, or it'll go without you.
items.zh: 公車中午開，別遲到，不然它不會等你。

items.en: Dinner is at six tonight. Don't be late again!
items.zh: 今晚六點吃晚餐，別再遲到了！

items.en: We'll pick you up at nine. Don't be late.
items.zh: 我們九點去接你，不要遲到。

examples.heading: ② ... Don't forget.

items.en: The café is behind the bank, near the bus stop. Don't forget.
items.zh: 咖啡店在銀行後面，公車站附近，別忘了。

items.en: You have PE first thing tomorrow. Pack your gym shoes tonight. Don't forget!
items.zh: 你明天第一堂是體育課。今晚把運動鞋收進包包，別忘了！

items.en: It's her eightieth birthday today. Call your grandmother tonight. Don't forget.
items.zh: 今天是她八十歲生日。今晚打給你奶奶，別忘了。

items.en: The Wi-Fi password is sunny123. Don't forget it.
items.zh: 無線網路的密碼是 sunny123，別忘了。

items.en: The doctor gave me pills for my ear. Take your medicine after lunch. Don't forget!
items.zh: 醫生開了治耳朵的藥給我。午餐後吃藥，別忘了！

examples.heading: ③ ... Don't lose / Don't miss

items.en: Here's the key to the flat. Don't lose it.
items.zh: 這是公寓的鑰匙，別弄丟了。

items.en: You need it to get out of the station. Keep your ticket. Don't lose it!
items.zh: 出站要用它。車票收好，別弄丟了！

items.en: The last train is at midnight. Don't miss it.
items.zh: 最後一班火車在午夜，別錯過了。

items.en: The sale ends on Sunday. Don't miss it!
items.zh: 特賣星期天結束，別錯過了！

items.en: My phone is new, and you don't have the number. Write down my number. Don't lose it.
items.zh: 我的手機是新的，你沒有號碼。把我的號碼記下來，別弄丟了。

examples.heading: ④ ... Don't tell / Don't touch

items.en: The party is a surprise. Don't tell Ann!
items.zh: 那個派對是驚喜，別告訴 Ann！

items.en: I'm getting married in May. Don't tell anyone yet.
items.zh: 我五月要結婚了，先別告訴任何人。

items.en: The paint is still wet. Don't touch it.
items.zh: 油漆還沒乾，別碰。

items.en: The cake is for tomorrow. Don't eat it!
items.zh: 蛋糕是明天要吃的，別吃！

items.en: This is my sister's laptop. Don't open it.
items.zh: 這是我姊姊的筆電，別打開。

examples.heading: ⑤ ... Don't worry. 和其他提醒

items.en: I'll meet you at the station. Don't worry.
items.zh: 我會去車站接你，別擔心。

items.en: Thanks for feeding the cat this weekend. Lock the door when you leave. Don't leave it open.
items.zh: 謝謝你這個週末幫忙餵貓。離開時把門鎖上，別開著。

items.en: It's snowing outside. Wear a warm coat. Don't catch a cold.
items.zh: 外面在下雪。穿件保暖的外套，別感冒了。

items.en: The road to the hotel has many sharp bends. Drive slowly on the mountain road. Don't rush.
items.zh: 去飯店的路有很多急彎。山路上開慢一點，別急。

items.en: Turn off the oven at four. Don't let the cake burn.
items.zh: 四點把烤箱關掉，別讓蛋糕烤焦。

items.en: The museum is very big. Wait for me by the gate. Don't go in alone.
items.zh: 博物館很大。在門口等我，別自己進去。

items.en: You know the job well. Speak slowly in the interview. Don't panic.
items.zh: 你很懂這份工作。面試時說慢一點，別慌。

items.en: We'll be away for two weeks in August. Water the plants every day. Don't let them dry out.
items.zh: 我們八月要出門兩個星期。每天澆花，別讓它們乾掉。

items.en: The road by the school is busy. Hold my hand when we cross. Don't run.
items.zh: 學校旁邊的路車很多。過馬路時牽著我的手，別跑。

items.en: The teacher handed out the test. Answer all the questions. Don't leave any blank.
items.zh: 老師發了考卷。每一題都要回答，別空著。

title: Call me if you like.
translation: 你想的話，可以打電話給我。
name: 表示委婉的 if 子句
sentences: Bring some board games if you want.
Stay for dinner if you like.
Have a nap if you want.
Use my phone if you like.
Sit by the window if you want.
Come round on Sunday if you like.
Take some flowers home if you want.
I can drive you to the station if you like.
I'll help you with the cooking if you want.
I can show you around the town if you like.
I'll wait here if you want.
I can check your essay if you like.
My brother can fix your bike if you want.
I'll lend you a jumper if you like.
You could bring some music if you like.
You could stay the night if you want.
We could go to the beach if you like.
You could ask Ben to join us if you want.
We could have lunch in the park if you like.
You could try the blue one if you like.
We can go by bus, or in my car if you prefer.
Wear a skirt, or shorts if you prefer.
You can pay now, or later if you prefer.
We can eat inside, or on the terrace if you prefer.
Send me an email, or call me if you prefer.
I can make tea, or coffee if you prefer.
If you want, I can help you with the decorations.
If you like, you could bring your guitar.
If you prefer, we can meet at the café instead.
If you want, I'll pick you up at eight.
If you like, we can watch the match at my house.
If you want, take the afternoon off.

examples.heading: ① 祈使句加 if you like 或 if you want

items.en: Bring some board games if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，帶幾個桌遊來。

items.en: Stay for dinner if you like.
items.zh: 你想的話，留下來吃晚餐吧。

items.en: Have a nap if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，睡個午覺吧。

items.en: Use my phone if you like.
items.zh: 你想用的話，就用我的手機。

items.en: Sit by the window if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以坐窗邊。

items.en: Come round on Sunday if you like.
items.zh: 你想的話，星期天過來坐坐。

items.en: Take some flowers home if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，帶些花回家。

examples.heading: ② 提議幫忙

items.en: I can drive you to the station if you like.
items.zh: 你想要的話，我可以載你去車站。

items.en: I'll help you with the cooking if you want.
items.zh: 你需要的話，我幫你煮飯。

items.en: I can show you around the town if you like.
items.zh: 你想的話，我可以帶你在城裡逛逛。

items.en: I'll wait here if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，我在這裡等。

items.en: I can check your essay if you like.
items.zh: 你想要的話，我可以幫你看看作文。

items.en: My brother can fix your bike if you want.
items.zh: 你需要的話，我哥哥可以幫你修腳踏車。

items.en: I'll lend you a jumper if you like.
items.zh: 你想要的話，我借你一件毛衣。

examples.heading: ③ could 的建議

items.en: You could bring some music if you like.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以帶些音樂來。

items.en: You could stay the night if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以住一晚。

items.en: We could go to the beach if you like.
items.zh: 你想的話，我們可以去海邊。

items.en: You could ask Ben to join us if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以找 Ben 一起來。

items.en: We could have lunch in the park if you like.
items.zh: 你想的話，我們可以在公園吃午餐。

items.en: You could try the blue one if you like.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以試試藍色那件。

examples.heading: ④ or ... if you prefer

items.en: We can go by bus, or in my car if you prefer.
items.zh: 我們可以搭公車，你比較想的話也可以坐我的車。

items.en: Wear a skirt, or shorts if you prefer.
items.zh: 穿裙子，你比較想的話穿短褲也行。

items.en: You can pay now, or later if you prefer.
items.zh: 你可以現在付，想晚點付也行。

items.en: We can eat inside, or on the terrace if you prefer.
items.zh: 我們可以在裡面吃，你比較想的話也可以在露台吃。

items.en: Send me an email, or call me if you prefer.
items.zh: 寄電子郵件給我，你比較想的話打電話也行。

items.en: I can make tea, or coffee if you prefer.
items.zh: 我可以泡茶，你比較想喝咖啡的話也可以。

examples.heading: ⑤ If you want、If you like 開頭

items.en: If you want, I can help you with the decorations.
items.zh: 你想的話，我可以幫你佈置。

items.en: If you like, you could bring your guitar.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以帶你的吉他來。

items.en: If you prefer, we can meet at the café instead.
items.zh: 你比較想的話，我們可以改在咖啡館見。

items.en: If you want, I'll pick you up at eight.
items.zh: 你想的話，我八點去接你。

items.en: If you like, we can watch the match at my house.
items.zh: 你想的話，我們可以在我家看比賽。

items.en: If you want, take the afternoon off.
items.zh: 你想的話，下午就請假吧。

title: Wear an apron over your clothes.
translation: 在衣服外面穿上圍裙。
name: 表示指示的祈使句
sentences: I'll pick you up after your class. Take the bus to the library, then call me.
The museum is easy to reach by underground. Take the yellow line to the river.
The bus driver will tell you when we arrive. Get off at the third stop.
Our farm is hard to find. Turn right after the petrol station.
You're nearly there. Walk a little farther, and you'll see the school.
Here's how to get to work on your first day. Take the green bus outside the bank at 7:15.
The bus ride to the zoo takes three hours. Bring some fruit and a drink.
It's going to rain on the school trip. Don't forget your raincoat and boots.
The school kitchen is closed for repairs. Bring your own lunch on Friday.
Take a jacket. It gets cold at night.
We'll be on the beach all day. Pack sunscreen and a hat.
Put on an apron before you start cooking.
This cleaner is very strong. Wear rubber gloves when you use it.
The chef showed us how to make the sauce. Cut the onions into small pieces.
The receptionist handed me a form. Fill in your name and address here.
This is the new coffee machine. Press the green button to start the machine.
The pharmacist gave me some advice. Keep the medicine in a cool place.
Good morning, class. Open your books at page 20.
Pencil is not allowed in the exam. Write your answers in pen.
Find a partner. Work in pairs for this exercise.
The teacher gave us homework for the weekend. Email me your answers by Monday.
You have five minutes left. Check your spelling before you hand in the test.
Thanks for looking after our flat. Remember to water the plants on Sunday.
The steps are wet after the rain. Hold the handrail on the stairs.
You're the last one in the classroom. Turn off the lights when you leave.
Children cross the road at three o'clock. Drive slowly near the school.
Storms come quickly in the mountains. Check the weather before you go hiking.
These apples came from the market. Wash the fruit before you eat it.
Don't cross the road yet. Wait for the green light.
