The inspector may check it on the train. Keep your ticket until the end of the trip.

examples.heading: ① 交通和指路

items.en: I'll pick you up after your class. Take the bus to the library, then call me.
items.zh: 你下課後我去接你。搭公車到圖書館，然後打給我。

items.en: The museum is easy to reach by underground. Take the yellow line to the river.
items.zh: 搭地鐵去博物館很方便。搭黃線到河邊。

items.en: The bus driver will tell you when we arrive. Get off at the third stop.
items.zh: 公車司機到了會告訴你。在第三站下車。

items.en: Our farm is hard to find. Turn right after the petrol station.
items.zh: 我們的農場很難找。過了加油站右轉。

items.en: You're nearly there. Walk a little farther, and you'll see the school.
items.zh: 你快到了。再往前走一點，你就會看到學校。

items.en: Here's how to get to work on your first day. Take the green bus outside the bank at 7:15.
items.zh: 這是你第一天上班的交通方式。七點十五分在銀行外面搭綠色公車。

examples.heading: ② 要帶的東西

items.en: The bus ride to the zoo takes three hours. Bring some fruit and a drink.
items.zh: 搭巴士去動物園要三個小時。帶些水果和飲料。

items.en: It's going to rain on the school trip. Don't forget your raincoat and boots.
items.zh: 校外教學那天會下雨。別忘了帶雨衣和雨靴。

items.en: The school kitchen is closed for repairs. Bring your own lunch on Friday.
items.zh: 學校廚房在維修。星期五自己帶午餐。

items.en: Take a jacket. It gets cold at night.
items.zh: 帶件夾克，晚上會變冷。

items.en: We'll be on the beach all day. Pack sunscreen and a hat.
items.zh: 我們整天都會在海灘上。帶防曬乳和帽子。

examples.heading: ③ 做事的方法

items.en: Put on an apron before you start cooking.
items.zh: 開始煮飯前先穿上圍裙。

items.en: This cleaner is very strong. Wear rubber gloves when you use it.
items.zh: 這個清潔劑很強。用的時候要戴橡膠手套。

items.en: The chef showed us how to make the sauce. Cut the onions into small pieces.
items.zh: 主廚教我們怎麼做醬汁。把洋蔥切成小塊。

items.en: The receptionist handed me a form. Fill in your name and address here.
items.zh: 櫃台人員給了我一張表格。在這裡填你的姓名和地址。

items.en: This is the new coffee machine. Press the green button to start the machine.
items.zh: 這是新的咖啡機。按綠色的按鈕啟動機器。

items.en: The pharmacist gave me some advice. Keep the medicine in a cool place.
items.zh: 藥劑師給了我一些建議。把藥放在陰涼的地方。

examples.heading: ④ 學校和工作的指示

items.en: Good morning, class. Open your books at page 20.
items.zh: 同學們早安。把書翻到第 20 頁。

items.en: Pencil is not allowed in the exam. Write your answers in pen.
items.zh: 考試不能用鉛筆。用原子筆寫答案。

items.en: Find a partner. Work in pairs for this exercise.
items.zh: 找一個夥伴。這個練習兩人一組。

items.en: The teacher gave us homework for the weekend. Email me your answers by Monday.
items.zh: 老師給我們週末的作業。星期一之前把答案寄給我。

items.en: You have five minutes left. Check your spelling before you hand in the test.
items.zh: 你們還有五分鐘。交考卷之前檢查拼字。

examples.heading: ⑤ 提醒和安全

items.en: Thanks for looking after our flat. Remember to water the plants on Sunday.
items.zh: 謝謝你幫我們看公寓。星期天記得澆花。

items.en: The steps are wet after the rain. Hold the handrail on the stairs.
items.zh: 下過雨後台階是濕的。走樓梯時扶著扶手。

items.en: You're the last one in the classroom. Turn off the lights when you leave.
items.zh: 你是教室裡最後一個人。離開時把燈關掉。

items.en: Children cross the road at three o'clock. Drive slowly near the school.
items.zh: 孩子們三點過馬路。在學校附近開慢一點。

items.en: Storms come quickly in the mountains. Check the weather before you go hiking.
items.zh: 山上的暴風雨來得很快。去健行之前先查天氣。

items.en: These apples came from the market. Wash the fruit before you eat it.
items.zh: 這些蘋果是市場買的。吃水果之前先洗乾淨。

items.en: Don't cross the road yet. Wait for the green light.
items.zh: 先別過馬路。等綠燈。

items.en: The inspector may check it on the train. Keep your ticket until the end of the trip.
items.zh: 查票員可能會在火車上查票。車票留到旅程結束。

title: Should you fail to do so, we would have no choice but to take further action.
translation: 如果您沒有這麼做，我們將不得不採取進一步的行動。
name: should 倒裝的條件句（未來可能的結果）
sentences: Should you wish to cancel your booking, we would need written notice.
Should you decide to accept our offer, we would arrange a start date in June.
Should you require a larger room, we would be happy to upgrade you.
Should you visit London next month, I would gladly show you around.
Should you find any errors in the report, we would correct them at once.
Should you need a reference, I would write one for you.
Should you have time next week, I would like to discuss the budget with you.
Should the item be out of stock, we would be grateful if you could tell us.
Should our proposal interest you, we would welcome a meeting.
Should the board approve the plan, we would like to start building in spring.
Should you join us for dinner, my wife and I would be delighted.
Should the medicine not work, the doctor would try a different treatment.
Should you not receive the parcel within a week, we would send a replacement.
Should the tenants not leave by the end of the month, the landlord would take legal action.
Should the weather not improve, we would hold the wedding indoors.
Should the supplier not deliver on time, we would look for another one.
Should the documents be lost, we would have to start again.
Should your application be rejected, you would have the right to appeal.
Should the road be closed, the bus would take a different route.
Should the match be postponed, ticket holders would get a full refund.
Should the data be stolen, the bank would inform all its customers.
Should prices keep rising, many families might struggle to pay their bills.
Should you change your plans, we could still reserve a seat for you.
Should the storm reach the coast, thousands of people might lose power.
Should the company expand, it could open an office in Singapore.
Should the river rise any higher, the bridge might collapse.
Should any employee conceal a mistake, the company would take disciplinary action.
Should the article contain defamation, the newspaper would face a lawsuit.
Should the contract stipulate a later date, we would follow that date.
Should you fail to pay the fine, the court would issue a warrant.
Should the guests behave badly, the hotel would ask them to leave.
Should the club break the rules again, the league would deduct points.

examples.heading: ① 正式信件

items.en: Should you wish to cancel your booking, we would need written notice.
items.zh: 如果您想取消預訂，我們需要書面通知。

items.en: Should you decide to accept our offer, we would arrange a start date in June.
items.zh: 如果您決定接受我們的條件，我們會把到職日安排在六月。

items.en: Should you require a larger room, we would be happy to upgrade you.
items.zh: 如果您需要大一點的房間，我們很樂意幫您升等。

items.en: Should you visit London next month, I would gladly show you around.
items.zh: 如果您下個月來倫敦，我很樂意帶您四處看看。

items.en: Should you find any errors in the report, we would correct them at once.
items.zh: 如果您在報告裡發現任何錯誤，我們會馬上改正。

items.en: Should you need a reference, I would write one for you.
items.zh: 如果您需要推薦信，我會幫您寫一封。

examples.heading: ② would like 和 would be grateful

items.en: Should you have time next week, I would like to discuss the budget with you.
items.zh: 如果您下週有空，我想跟您討論預算。

items.en: Should the item be out of stock, we would be grateful if you could tell us.
items.zh: 如果那件商品缺貨，麻煩您通知我們。

items.en: Should our proposal interest you, we would welcome a meeting.
items.zh: 如果您對我們的提案有興趣，我們歡迎約時間見面。

items.en: Should the board approve the plan, we would like to start building in spring.
items.zh: 如果董事會核准這個計畫，我們想在春天開工。

items.en: Should you join us for dinner, my wife and I would be delighted.
items.zh: 如果您來跟我們吃晚餐，我和我太太會很高興。

examples.heading: ③ 否定

items.en: Should the medicine not work, the doctor would try a different treatment.
items.zh: 如果這種藥沒效，醫生會改用別的療法。

items.en: Should you not receive the parcel within a week, we would send a replacement.
items.zh: 如果您一週內沒收到包裹，我們會寄一個新的給您。

items.en: Should the tenants not leave by the end of the month, the landlord would take legal action.
items.zh: 如果房客月底前沒搬走，房東會採取法律行動。

items.en: Should the weather not improve, we would hold the wedding indoors.
items.zh: 如果天氣沒有好轉，我們會在室內辦婚禮。

items.en: Should the supplier not deliver on time, we would look for another one.
items.zh: 如果供應商沒有準時交貨，我們會另外找一家。

examples.heading: ④ 被動

items.en: Should the documents be lost, we would have to start again.
items.zh: 如果文件弄丟了，我們就得從頭來過。（被動）

items.en: Should your application be rejected, you would have the right to appeal.
items.zh: 如果您的申請被駁回，您有權提出上訴。（被動）

items.en: Should the road be closed, the bus would take a different route.
items.zh: 如果道路封閉，公車會改走別的路線。（被動）

items.en: Should the match be postponed, ticket holders would get a full refund.
items.zh: 如果比賽延期，持票人會拿到全額退款。（被動）

items.en: Should the data be stolen, the bank would inform all its customers.
items.zh: 如果資料被偷，銀行會通知所有的客戶。（被動）

examples.heading: ⑤ could 和 might

items.en: Should prices keep rising, many families might struggle to pay their bills.
items.zh: 如果物價繼續上漲，很多家庭可能付不出帳單。

items.en: Should you change your plans, we could still reserve a seat for you.
items.zh: 如果您改變計畫，我們還是可以幫您保留一個位子。

items.en: Should the storm reach the coast, thousands of people might lose power.
items.zh: 如果暴風雨到達海岸，成千上萬的人可能會停電。

items.en: Should the company expand, it could open an office in Singapore.
items.zh: 如果公司擴張，它可以在新加坡開一間辦公室。

items.en: Should the river rise any higher, the bridge might collapse.
items.zh: 如果河水再漲高，那座橋可能會垮。

examples.heading: ⑥ 警告和規定

items.en: Should any employee conceal a mistake, the company would take disciplinary action.
items.zh: 如果有員工隱瞞錯誤，公司會採取懲處行動。

items.en: Should the article contain defamation, the newspaper would face a lawsuit.
items.zh: 如果那篇文章有誹謗的內容，報社會面臨訴訟。

items.en: Should the contract stipulate a later date, we would follow that date.
items.zh: 如果合約規定更晚的日期，我們會照那個日期做。

items.en: Should you fail to pay the fine, the court would issue a warrant.
items.zh: 如果您沒繳罰款，法院會發出拘票。

items.en: Should the guests behave badly, the hotel would ask them to leave.
items.zh: 如果客人行為不當，飯店會請他們離開。

items.en: Should the club break the rules again, the league would deduct points.
items.zh: 如果那個俱樂部再違規，聯盟會扣分。

title: Come and stay with us this weekend!
translation: 這個週末來我們家住吧！
name: 用祈使句提出邀請
sentences: Come and visit us in the spring. The garden will be beautiful.
Our dog had five babies last night. Come and look at the puppies!
You need a holiday after all that work. Come and stay at our cabin in the mountains.
We're at the bar across the street. Come and have a drink with us.
You're wet from the rain. Come and sit by the fire.
We have a big new TV. Come and watch the game at our place.
I'm cooking my grandmother's lamb stew. Come over for dinner on Friday.
There's a spare seat in the car. Come with us to the beach!
We're home all weekend. Come over anytime.
I'm turning thirty! Come to my birthday party next Saturday.
Come along! It'll be fun.
The whole team is going to the Thai place. Join us for lunch tomorrow.
We need one more player. Join our team on Thursday!
Don't go yet, the kettle is on. Stay for a coffee.
Stay the night. It's too late to drive.
Stay with us until your flat is ready.
Your cup is empty. Have some more tea.
Have a piece of cake. I made it this morning.
Take a seat. I'll get you a drink.
I'll be in the garden with the kids. Help yourself to the snacks in the kitchen.
The baker gave out new cookies at the door. Take one. They're free.
We finally moved into the new flat. Please come to our housewarming party next Sunday.
Do come and see us when you're in Taipei.
We're having a barbecue on Sunday. Bring your family too!
Put your bag down and take off your coat. Make yourself at home.
Come in, come in! It's cold outside.
There's lots left, and you look hungry. Have another slice of pizza.
We're having a dinner on 5 May. Please join us for our tenth anniversary.
She makes the best dumplings in town. Come and try my mother's cooking.
We're out all day tomorrow. Feel free to use the pool.

examples.heading: ① Come and + 原形動詞

items.en: Come and visit us in the spring. The garden will be beautiful.
items.zh: 春天來看我們，花園會很漂亮。

items.en: Our dog had five babies last night. Come and look at the puppies!
items.zh: 我們的狗昨天晚上生了五隻。來看看小狗！

items.en: You need a holiday after all that work. Come and stay at our cabin in the mountains.
items.zh: 你工作那麼累，需要休假。來我們山上的小屋住吧。

items.en: We're at the bar across the street. Come and have a drink with us.
items.zh: 我們在對街的酒吧。來跟我們喝一杯。

items.en: You're wet from the rain. Come and sit by the fire.
items.zh: 你被雨淋濕了。來火爐邊坐。

items.en: We have a big new TV. Come and watch the game at our place.
items.zh: 我們有一台新的大電視。來我們家看比賽。

examples.heading: ② Come over / Come with + 人

items.en: I'm cooking my grandmother's lamb stew. Come over for dinner on Friday.
items.zh: 我要煮我奶奶的燉羊肉。星期五來我家吃晚餐。

items.en: There's a spare seat in the car. Come with us to the beach!
items.zh: 車上還有一個空位。跟我們一起去海邊吧！

items.en: We're home all weekend. Come over anytime.
items.zh: 我們整個週末都在家，隨時過來玩。

items.en: I'm turning thirty! Come to my birthday party next Saturday.
items.zh: 我要三十歲了！下個星期六來參加我的生日派對。

items.en: Come along! It'll be fun.
items.zh: 一起來吧！會很好玩的。

examples.heading: ③ Join / Stay

items.en: The whole team is going to the Thai place. Join us for lunch tomorrow.
items.zh: 整個團隊都要去那家泰國餐廳。明天跟我們一起吃午餐。

items.en: We need one more player. Join our team on Thursday!
items.zh: 我們還缺一個人，星期四加入我們這隊吧！

items.en: Don't go yet, the kettle is on. Stay for a coffee.
items.zh: 先別走，水在燒了。留下來喝杯咖啡吧。

items.en: Stay the night. It's too late to drive.
items.zh: 留下來過夜吧，太晚了不好開車。

items.en: Stay with us until your flat is ready.
items.zh: 你的公寓弄好之前就住我們家吧。

examples.heading: ④ Have / Take / Help yourself（提供東西）

items.en: Your cup is empty. Have some more tea.
items.zh: 你的杯子空了。再喝點茶吧。

items.en: Have a piece of cake. I made it this morning.
items.zh: 吃塊蛋糕吧，我今天早上做的。

items.en: Take a seat. I'll get you a drink.
items.zh: 請坐，我去幫你拿喝的。

items.en: I'll be in the garden with the kids. Help yourself to the snacks in the kitchen.
items.zh: 我會跟孩子們在花園裡。廚房裡的零食自己拿吧。

items.en: The baker gave out new cookies at the door. Take one. They're free.
items.zh: 麵包師傅在門口發新口味的餅乾。拿一個吧，免費的。

examples.heading: ⑤ please 和不同的句型

items.en: We finally moved into the new flat. Please come to our housewarming party next Sunday.
items.zh: 我們終於搬進新公寓了。下個星期天請來參加我們的喬遷派對。

items.en: Do come and see us when you're in Taipei.
items.zh: 你來台北的時候一定要來看我們。

items.en: We're having a barbecue on Sunday. Bring your family too!
items.zh: 我們星期天要烤肉。也帶你的家人來吧！

items.en: Put your bag down and take off your coat. Make yourself at home.
items.zh: 把包包放下，把外套脫了。就當自己家。

items.en: Come in, come in! It's cold outside.
items.zh: 進來，進來！外面很冷。

items.en: There's lots left, and you look hungry. Have another slice of pizza.
items.zh: 還剩很多，你看起來很餓。再吃一片披薩吧。

items.en: We're having a dinner on 5 May. Please join us for our tenth anniversary.
items.zh: 我們五月五日要辦晚宴。請來參加我們的十週年紀念。

items.en: She makes the best dumplings in town. Come and try my mother's cooking.
items.zh: 她做的餃子是鎮上最好吃的。來嚐嚐我媽媽的手藝。

items.en: We're out all day tomorrow. Feel free to use the pool.
items.zh: 我們明天整天都不在。游泳池請隨意使用。

title: See the enclosed brochure.
translation: 請參閱隨附的簡介手冊。
name: 祈使句指向文件或附件（正式）
sentences: The museum sent a letter to our school. See the enclosed leaflet for opening times.
The training course runs for three weeks in June. See the attached schedule for the dates.
The company's travel guide covers business trips. See page 10 for a list of approved hotels.
The festival newsletter came this morning. See below for the full list of events.
Our report explains how we asked 500 students. See Appendix A for the survey questions.
The wedding is at a farm outside the town. See the map on the back of this letter.
The scientist showed a slide about our region. Look at the graph of rainfall from 2010 to 2020.
The manager went through the report. Look at Table 2. Sales went up in March.
Look at the pie chart, which shows how we spend our budget.
The budget for the trip is too high. Look at the costs listed under "Travel" in the second column.
The brochure shows our new hotel. Look at the photo on page 4.
New staff often ask about holidays. Please refer to page 12 of the handbook.
The new printer arrived in a big box. Refer to the user guide before you start.
The client asked when to pay us. Refer to the contract for the payment terms.
You asked about the meeting time again. Please refer to my previous email.
Read the lab manual before your first class. Refer to section 3 for the safety rules.
The letter from the visa office ends with a reminder. Note that the office is closed on Fridays.
The library sent an email to all members. Please note the new opening hours.
The train company's website lists the ticket prices. Note that children under five travel free.
Room 2 is being painted this week. Please note that the meeting has moved to Room 5.
The professor sent a message to the class. Note the new date for the final report.
The advert for the summer camp was short. For more details, see our website.
The textbook asks about city and village life. Compare the two graphs on page 6.
Many people fill in the tax form wrongly. Read the instructions on the back of the form.
The conference office emailed all speakers. Check the attached list and confirm your name.
I wrote to the university about the course. Please find enclosed my application form.
The quiz is in the middle of the magazine. Turn to page 20 for the answers.
Some of the old words in the story are hard. See the notes at the end of the chapter.
