examples.heading: ① See + 文件的某個部分

items.en: The museum sent a letter to our school. See the enclosed leaflet for opening times.
items.zh: 博物館寄了一封信給我們學校。開放時間請參閱隨附的傳單。

items.en: The training course runs for three weeks in June. See the attached schedule for the dates.
items.zh: 訓練課程六月上三個星期。日期請見附件的行程表。

items.en: The company's travel guide covers business trips. See page 10 for a list of approved hotels.
items.zh: 公司的出差手冊說明出差的規定。核可的飯店名單請見第 10 頁。

items.en: The festival newsletter came this morning. See below for the full list of events.
items.zh: 音樂節的通訊今天早上寄來了。完整的活動清單請見下方。

items.en: Our report explains how we asked 500 students. See Appendix A for the survey questions.
items.zh: 我們的報告說明我們怎麼問了五百個學生。問卷題目請見附錄 A。

items.en: The wedding is at a farm outside the town. See the map on the back of this letter.
items.zh: 婚禮在鎮外的一座農場。請看這封信背面的地圖。

examples.heading: ② Look at + 圖表

items.en: The scientist showed a slide about our region. Look at the graph of rainfall from 2010 to 2020.
items.zh: 那位科學家放了一張關於我們地區的投影片。請看 2010 到 2020 年降雨量的圖表。

items.en: The manager went through the report. Look at Table 2. Sales went up in March.
items.zh: 經理逐項說明報告。請看表二，三月的業績上升了。

items.en: Look at the pie chart, which shows how we spend our budget.
items.zh: 請看圓餅圖，它顯示了我們預算的用法。

items.en: The budget for the trip is too high. Look at the costs listed under "Travel" in the second column.
items.zh: 這趟出差的預算太高了。請看第二欄交通下面列的費用。

items.en: The brochure shows our new hotel. Look at the photo on page 4.
items.zh: 這本簡介介紹了我們的新飯店。請看第 4 頁的照片。

examples.heading: ③ Refer to + 文件

items.en: New staff often ask about holidays. Please refer to page 12 of the handbook.
items.zh: 新員工常問休假的事。請參考手冊第 12 頁。

items.en: The new printer arrived in a big box. Refer to the user guide before you start.
items.zh: 新印表機裝在一個大箱子裡送來。開始之前請參考使用指南。

items.en: The client asked when to pay us. Refer to the contract for the payment terms.
items.zh: 客戶問什麼時候付款給我們。付款條件請參考合約。

items.en: You asked about the meeting time again. Please refer to my previous email.
items.zh: 你又問了會議時間。請參考我上一封電子郵件。

items.en: Read the lab manual before your first class. Refer to section 3 for the safety rules.
items.zh: 第一堂課前先讀實驗手冊。安全規定請參考第 3 節。

examples.heading: ④ Note + that 子句 / 名詞

items.en: The letter from the visa office ends with a reminder. Note that the office is closed on Fridays.
items.zh: 簽證辦公室的信最後有一個提醒。請注意，辦公室星期五不上班。

items.en: The library sent an email to all members. Please note the new opening hours.
items.zh: 圖書館寄電子郵件給所有會員。請注意新的營業時間。

items.en: The train company's website lists the ticket prices. Note that children under five travel free.
items.zh: 火車公司的網站列出票價。請注意，五歲以下兒童免費搭乘。

items.en: Room 2 is being painted this week. Please note that the meeting has moved to Room 5.
items.zh: 二號會議室這個星期在油漆。請注意，會議改到五號會議室。

items.en: The professor sent a message to the class. Note the new date for the final report.
items.zh: 教授傳了一則訊息給全班。請注意期末報告的新日期。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: The advert for the summer camp was short. For more details, see our website.
items.zh: 夏令營的廣告很短。更多細節請見我們的網站。

items.en: The textbook asks about city and village life. Compare the two graphs on page 6.
items.zh: 課本問到城市和鄉村生活。請比較第 6 頁的兩張圖表。

items.en: Many people fill in the tax form wrongly. Read the instructions on the back of the form.
items.zh: 很多人填錯稅務表格。請閱讀表格背面的說明。

items.en: The conference office emailed all speakers. Check the attached list and confirm your name.
items.zh: 會議辦公室寄電子郵件給所有講者。請確認附件裡的名單，核對你的名字。

items.en: I wrote to the university about the course. Please find enclosed my application form.
items.zh: 我寫信給大學詢問這門課程。隨信附上我的申請表。

items.en: The quiz is in the middle of the magazine. Turn to page 20 for the answers.
items.zh: 小測驗在雜誌中間。答案請翻到第 20 頁。

items.en: Some of the old words in the story are hard. See the notes at the end of the chapter.
items.zh: 故事裡有些古老的字很難。請見本章最後的註解。

items.en: The students tested three kinds of soil. Look at Figure 3, which shows the results.
items.zh: 學生們測試了三種土壤。請看圖三，那張圖顯示了結果。

items.en: The school wants to know about your child's lunch. Fill in the enclosed form and return it by May 1.
items.zh: 學校想了解你孩子的午餐需求。請填寫隨附的表格，並在五月一日前寄回。

title: I want a big garden because I have children.
translation: 我想要一個大花園，因為我有小孩。
name: because 當從屬連接詞
sentences: I want a new phone because my old one is broken.
She wants a dog because she lives alone.
We want a bigger flat because we have a baby now.
My son wants a bike because his friends all have one.
I want to live near the sea because I love swimming.
I like my English class because the teacher is funny.
Tom likes Saturdays because he doesn't go to school.
We like this restaurant because the food is cheap and good.
My mother likes her job because she helps people.
I love summer because I can go to the beach.
I don't like winter because it is cold and dark.
She doesn't drink coffee because it keeps her awake.
My brother hates Mondays because he starts work at six.
We don't go to that café because it is always full.
I'm learning English because I want to travel.
She walks to work because she doesn't have a car.
We eat at home on weekdays because we are busy.
He goes to bed early because he gets up at five.
I take the bus because it is faster than the train.
I was late because I missed the bus.
We stayed at home because it was raining.
She was happy because her friends visited her.
They went to bed early because they were tired.
I called my mum because it was her birthday.
"Why are you happy?" "Because it's Friday."
"Why is she crying?" "Because she lost her cat."
"Why do you get up so early?" "Because I go running before work."
"Why are the shops closed?" "Because it's a holiday."
I live in the city centre because it is near my office.
My favourite colour is green because I love nature.
I have two jobs because I am saving money for a car.
I play the guitar because my father taught me.

examples.heading: ① 說出想要的原因

items.en: I want a new phone because my old one is broken.
items.zh: 我想要一支新手機，因為我的舊手機壞了。

items.en: She wants a dog because she lives alone.
items.zh: 她想養狗，因為她一個人住。

items.en: We want a bigger flat because we have a baby now.
items.zh: 我們想要大一點的公寓，因為我們現在有小寶寶了。

items.en: My son wants a bike because his friends all have one.
items.zh: 我兒子想要一台腳踏車，因為他的朋友都有。

items.en: I want to live near the sea because I love swimming.
items.zh: 我想住在海邊，因為我很愛游泳。

examples.heading: ② 說出喜歡的原因

items.en: I like my English class because the teacher is funny.
items.zh: 我喜歡我的英文課，因為老師很風趣。

items.en: Tom likes Saturdays because he doesn't go to school.
items.zh: Tom 喜歡星期六，因為他不用上學。

items.en: We like this restaurant because the food is cheap and good.
items.zh: 我們喜歡這家餐廳，因為東西便宜又好吃。

items.en: My mother likes her job because she helps people.
items.zh: 我媽媽喜歡她的工作，因為她可以幫助別人。

items.en: I love summer because I can go to the beach.
items.zh: 我很愛夏天，因為我可以去海邊。

examples.heading: ③ 說出不喜歡的原因

items.en: I don't like winter because it is cold and dark.
items.zh: 我不喜歡冬天，因為又冷又暗。

items.en: She doesn't drink coffee because it keeps her awake.
items.zh: 她不喝咖啡，因為喝了會睡不著。

items.en: My brother hates Mondays because he starts work at six.
items.zh: 我哥很討厭星期一，因為他六點就要上班。

items.en: We don't go to that café because it is always full.
items.zh: 我們不去那家咖啡館，因為那裡總是客滿。

examples.heading: ④ 說出做一件事的原因

items.en: I'm learning English because I want to travel.
items.zh: 我在學英文，因為我想去旅行。

items.en: She walks to work because she doesn't have a car.
items.zh: 她走路上班，因為她沒有車。

items.en: We eat at home on weekdays because we are busy.
items.zh: 我們平日在家吃飯，因為我們很忙。

items.en: He goes to bed early because he gets up at five.
items.zh: 他很早睡，因為他五點就起床。

items.en: I take the bus because it is faster than the train.
items.zh: 我搭公車，因為公車比火車快。

examples.heading: ⑤ 過去發生的事

items.en: I was late because I missed the bus.
items.zh: 我遲到了，因為我沒趕上公車。

items.en: We stayed at home because it was raining.
items.zh: 我們待在家裡，因為下雨了。

items.en: She was happy because her friends visited her.
items.zh: 她很高興，因為朋友來看她。

items.en: They went to bed early because they were tired.
items.zh: 他們很早就睡了，因為他們很累。

items.en: I called my mum because it was her birthday.
items.zh: 我打電話給我媽，因為那天是她生日。

examples.heading: ⑥ 回答 why 的問題

items.en: "Why are you happy?" "Because it's Friday."
items.zh: 你為什麼這麼高興？因為今天是星期五。

items.en: "Why is she crying?" "Because she lost her cat."
items.zh: 她為什麼在哭？因為她的貓不見了。

items.en: "Why do you get up so early?" "Because I go running before work."
items.zh: 你為什麼這麼早起？因為我上班前會去跑步。

items.en: "Why are the shops closed?" "Because it's a holiday."
items.zh: 店為什麼都關了？因為今天是假日。

examples.heading: ⑦ 介紹自己時說出原因

items.en: I live in the city centre because it is near my office.
items.zh: 我住在市中心，因為那裡離我的辦公室很近。

items.en: My favourite colour is green because I love nature.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是綠色，因為我很愛大自然。

items.en: I have two jobs because I am saving money for a car.
items.zh: 我做兩份工作，因為我在存錢買車。

items.en: I play the guitar because my father taught me.
items.zh: 我會彈吉他，因為我爸爸教過我。

title: I have visited a lot of places, but the best place is Thailand.
translation: 我去過很多地方，但最棒的是泰國。
name: 對等連接詞連接子句
sentences: He is a journalist and he likes everything about cinema.
I have a big family and I love them all.
We moved here last year and we really like the area.
She speaks French and she is learning Spanish now.
My dad cooks dinner and my mum washes the dishes.
There are lots of shops in the town and the station is very close.
The sun was shining and the children were playing outside.
I play the piano and my brother plays the drums.
The food was great and the waiters were very friendly.
I have tried many hobbies, but my favourite is painting.
I like my job, but I don't like my boss.
We waited for an hour, but the bus didn't come.
My flat is small, but it has a lovely view.
Maria can read English well, but she can't speak it.
I asked my teacher, but she didn't know the answer.
We went to the museum, but it wasn't open.
I phoned the hotel, but nobody answered.
Ben wanted to come, but he wasn't feeling well.
You can wear the blue shirt, or you can borrow mine.
You can call me tonight, or you can send me an email.
Is he at work, or is he still at home?
We can eat out tonight, or I can make pasta.
Should I bring a cake, or will your mum make one?
He gets up at six and goes to the gym.
My sister works in a bank but wants to be a teacher.
I opened the door and saw my old friend.
You can sit down or wait outside.
I went to the shop, I bought some milk and then I came home.
The room is clean, the bed is comfortable and the price is good.
My mum is a nurse, my dad is a driver and I am a student.
We had lunch, we went for a walk, but then it started to rain.

examples.heading: ① 子句 + and + 子句（主詞相同）

items.en: He is a journalist and he likes everything about cinema.
items.zh: 他是記者，而且他喜歡電影的一切。

items.en: I have a big family and I love them all.
items.zh: 我家人很多，我每一個都愛。

items.en: We moved here last year and we really like the area.
items.zh: 我們去年搬來這裡，我們很喜歡這一帶。

items.en: She speaks French and she is learning Spanish now.
items.zh: 她會說法語，現在還在學西班牙語。

examples.heading: ② 子句 + and + 子句（主詞不同）

items.en: My dad cooks dinner and my mum washes the dishes.
items.zh: 我爸煮晚餐，我媽洗碗。

items.en: There are lots of shops in the town and the station is very close.
items.zh: 鎮上有很多店，車站也很近。

items.en: The sun was shining and the children were playing outside.
items.zh: 太陽很大，孩子們在外面玩。

items.en: I play the piano and my brother plays the drums.
items.zh: 我彈鋼琴，我弟弟打鼓。

items.en: The food was great and the waiters were very friendly.
items.zh: 菜很好吃，服務生也很親切。

examples.heading: ③ 子句 + , but + 子句

items.en: I have tried many hobbies, but my favourite is painting.
items.zh: 我試過很多嗜好，但我最喜歡的是畫畫。

items.en: I like my job, but I don't like my boss.
items.zh: 我喜歡我的工作，但是不喜歡我老闆。

items.en: We waited for an hour, but the bus didn't come.
items.zh: 我們等了一個小時，但是公車沒來。

items.en: My flat is small, but it has a lovely view.
items.zh: 我的公寓很小，但是景觀很棒。

items.en: Maria can read English well, but she can't speak it.
items.zh: Maria 英文讀得很好，但是不會說。

examples.heading: ④ 子句 + , but + 否定子句

items.en: I asked my teacher, but she didn't know the answer.
items.zh: 我問了老師，但是她也不知道答案。

items.en: We went to the museum, but it wasn't open.
items.zh: 我們去了博物館，但是它沒開。

items.en: I phoned the hotel, but nobody answered.
items.zh: 我打電話到飯店，但是沒人接。

items.en: Ben wanted to come, but he wasn't feeling well.
items.zh: Ben 想來，但是他身體不舒服。

examples.heading: ⑤ 子句 + , or + 子句

items.en: You can wear the blue shirt, or you can borrow mine.
items.zh: 你可以穿那件藍襯衫，或者借我的穿。

items.en: You can call me tonight, or you can send me an email.
items.zh: 你今晚可以打給我，或者寄電子郵件給我。

items.en: Is he at work, or is he still at home?
items.zh: 他在上班，還是還在家？

items.en: We can eat out tonight, or I can make pasta.
items.zh: 我們今晚可以去外面吃，或者我煮義大利麵。

items.en: Should I bring a cake, or will your mum make one?
items.zh: 我要帶蛋糕去嗎，還是你媽媽會做一個？

examples.heading: ⑥ 主詞相同時省略第二個主詞

items.en: He gets up at six and goes to the gym.
items.zh: 他六點起床，然後去健身房。

items.en: My sister works in a bank but wants to be a teacher.
items.zh: 我姊姊在銀行上班，但是想當老師。

items.en: I opened the door and saw my old friend.
items.zh: 我打開門，看到我的老朋友。

items.en: You can sit down or wait outside.
items.zh: 你可以坐下，或在外面等。

examples.heading: ⑦ 三個子句

items.en: I went to the shop, I bought some milk and then I came home.
items.zh: 我去了商店，買了一些牛奶，然後就回家了。

items.en: The room is clean, the bed is comfortable and the price is good.
items.zh: 房間很乾淨，床很舒服，價錢也不錯。

items.en: My mum is a nurse, my dad is a driver and I am a student.
items.zh: 我媽是護士，我爸是司機，我是學生。

items.en: We had lunch, we went for a walk, but then it started to rain.
items.zh: 我們吃了午餐，去散了步，但是後來開始下雨。

title: I decided to go to Paris as soon as I finished university.
translation: 我決定大學一畢業就去巴黎。
name: 複合從屬連接詞（as long as 等）
sentences: Text me as soon as your train leaves the station.
As soon as the film ended, everyone stood up and left.
My sister started looking for a job as soon as she left school.
I'll send you the report as soon as it is ready.
As soon as the baby fell asleep, we sat down to watch TV.
You can borrow my bike as long as you bring it back tomorrow.
I don't mind where we eat as long as the food is good.
As long as you study regularly, you'll pass the exam.
The children can play outside as long as they stay in the garden.
Take a rest in your hotel in order that you can be ready for the busy schedule.
The meeting was moved to Friday in order that everyone could attend.
We sent the documents early in order that the bank would have time to check them.
The teacher spoke slowly in order that all the students could follow.
The festival was a success despite the fact that the sound system was poor.
Despite the fact that he was tired, he finished the race.
She got the job despite the fact that she had no experience.
Despite the fact that the hotel was expensive, it was always full.
Due to the fact that cars pollute our cities, more people are using public transport.
The match was postponed due to the fact that the pitch was flooded.
Due to the fact that sales have fallen, the company is closing two shops.
The trains were delayed due to the fact that there was ice on the tracks.
He looked at me as if I had said something terrible.
Everything was so familiar, as though he had never left the town.
She talks about Paris as if she lived there.
The sky is so dark. It looks as though a storm is coming.
The old man walked slowly, as though every step hurt him.
As far as I'm concerned, zoos are acceptable as long as the animals are well looked after.
To sum up, most people enjoyed the event despite the fact that the weather was bad.
The service was suspended due to the fact that the system needed repairs.
We will contact you as soon as your order has been sent.
Please read the instructions carefully in order that you can use the machine safely.

examples.heading: ① as soon as

items.en: Text me as soon as your train leaves the station.
items.zh: 你的火車一開出車站就傳訊息給我。

items.en: As soon as the film ended, everyone stood up and left.
items.zh: 電影一結束，大家就站起來走了。

items.en: My sister started looking for a job as soon as she left school.
items.zh: 我姊姊一畢業就開始找工作。

items.en: I'll send you the report as soon as it is ready.
items.zh: 報告一好，我就寄給你。

items.en: As soon as the baby fell asleep, we sat down to watch TV.
items.zh: 寶寶一睡著，我們就坐下來看電視。

examples.heading: ② as long as

items.en: You can borrow my bike as long as you bring it back tomorrow.
items.zh: 只要明天還我，你就可以借我的腳踏車。

items.en: I don't mind where we eat as long as the food is good.
items.zh: 只要東西好吃，在哪裡吃我都不在意。

items.en: As long as you study regularly, you'll pass the exam.
items.zh: 只要你規律地讀書，就會通過考試。

items.en: The children can play outside as long as they stay in the garden.
items.zh: 只要待在花園裡，孩子們就可以在外面玩。

examples.heading: ③ in order that

items.en: Take a rest in your hotel in order that you can be ready for the busy schedule.
items.zh: 在飯店休息一下，好應付接下來緊湊的行程。

items.en: The meeting was moved to Friday in order that everyone could attend.
items.zh: 會議改到星期五，好讓每個人都能參加。

items.en: We sent the documents early in order that the bank would have time to check them.
items.zh: 我們提早把文件寄出去，好讓銀行有時間審核。

items.en: The teacher spoke slowly in order that all the students could follow.
items.zh: 老師講得很慢，好讓所有學生都跟得上。

examples.heading: ④ despite the fact that

items.en: The festival was a success despite the fact that the sound system was poor.
items.zh: 儘管音響很差，這個節慶還是很成功。

items.en: Despite the fact that he was tired, he finished the race.
items.zh: 儘管很累，他還是跑完了比賽。

items.en: She got the job despite the fact that she had no experience.
items.zh: 儘管沒有經驗，她還是得到了那份工作。

items.en: Despite the fact that the hotel was expensive, it was always full.
items.zh: 儘管那家飯店很貴，還是天天客滿。

examples.heading: ⑤ due to the fact that

items.en: Due to the fact that cars pollute our cities, more people are using public transport.
items.zh: 因為汽車汙染城市，越來越多人搭大眾運輸。

items.en: The match was postponed due to the fact that the pitch was flooded.
items.zh: 因為球場淹水，比賽延期了。

items.en: Due to the fact that sales have fallen, the company is closing two shops.
items.zh: 因為銷售量下滑，公司要關掉兩家店。

items.en: The trains were delayed due to the fact that there was ice on the tracks.
items.zh: 因為軌道結冰，火車誤點了。

examples.heading: ⑥ as if、as though

items.en: He looked at me as if I had said something terrible.
items.zh: 他看著我，好像我說了什麼很糟的話。

items.en: Everything was so familiar, as though he had never left the town.
items.zh: 一切都那麼熟悉，好像他從來沒離開過這個小鎮。

items.en: She talks about Paris as if she lived there.
items.zh: 她講起巴黎的樣子，好像她住在那裡一樣。

items.en: The sky is so dark. It looks as though a storm is coming.
items.zh: 天色好暗，看起來好像暴風雨要來了。

items.en: The old man walked slowly, as though every step hurt him.
items.zh: 那位老先生走得很慢，好像每一步都很痛。

examples.heading: ⑦ 作文和報告裡的句子

items.en: As far as I'm concerned, zoos are acceptable as long as the animals are well looked after.
items.zh: 就我來說，只要動物受到好好的照顧，動物園是可以接受的。

items.en: To sum up, most people enjoyed the event despite the fact that the weather was bad.
items.zh: 總結來說，儘管天氣很差，大多數人還是很喜歡這次活動。

items.en: The service was suspended due to the fact that the system needed repairs.
items.zh: 因為系統需要維修，這項服務暫停了。

items.en: We will contact you as soon as your order has been sent.
items.zh: 您的訂單一寄出，我們就會跟您聯絡。

items.en: Please read the instructions carefully in order that you can use the machine safely.
items.zh: 請仔細閱讀說明，以便安全地使用這台機器。

title: I was scared and closed the window, but I couldn't sleep, so I opened it again.
translation: 我很害怕，就把窗戶關上了，可是我睡不著，所以又把它打開。
name: 用對等連接詞連接多個子句
sentences: I was cold and put on a jumper, but I was still shivering, so I made some tea.
I called Sam and left a message, but he didn't call back, so I went to his house.
We got up early and drove to the beach, but it was raining, so we went to a café.
Maria saw the dress and loved it, but it was too expensive, so she didn't buy it.
The bus was late and the traffic was terrible, but we got there in time.
I finished my homework and then I watched a film.
We had dinner at a little restaurant and then we walked along the river.
She opened the letter, read it twice and then started to cry.
We visited my grandparents and then drove home late at night.
We went to his studio, then he started singing, and I joined in.
I heard a strange noise, then the lights went out, and everyone screamed.
I woke up, then I looked at the clock, and it was already ten.
The plane landed, then we waited for our bags, and finally we took a taxi.
I wanted to go to the concert, but I had no money, so I stayed at home.
The tickets were sold out, but my friend had two, so we went together.
It was a long walk, but the weather was lovely, so we didn't mind.
I forgot my keys, but my neighbour had a spare one, so I got in.
It started to snow and the roads were icy, so we stayed in the hotel.
I was hungry and there was nothing in the fridge, so I ordered a pizza.
The baby was crying and nobody could sleep, so Dad took her for a drive.
The film was boring and very long, so we left early.
You can take the train or the bus, but the train is faster, so I'd take that.
We could stay in or go out, but I'm tired, so let's stay in.
You can pay now or later, but the price goes up next week.
Should we call a taxi, or should we walk? It's not raining, so let's walk.
I looked out of the window and saw two men in the garden, but when I called my dad, they were gone.
We arrived at the hotel, but our room wasn't ready, so we left our bags and went for lunch.
I heard a strange voice, I woke up, and there was my mum next to my bed.
My phone died, so I borrowed a stranger's phone, and then I called my sister.
The dog ran out of the house, then it crossed the road, and a kind lady caught it.

examples.heading: ① and + but + so

items.en: I was cold and put on a jumper, but I was still shivering, so I made some tea.
items.zh: 我覺得冷，就穿上毛衣，可是還是一直發抖，所以泡了一杯茶。

items.en: I called Sam and left a message, but he didn't call back, so I went to his house.
items.zh: 我打給 Sam 並留了言，可是他沒回電，所以我去他家找他。

items.en: We got up early and drove to the beach, but it was raining, so we went to a café.
items.zh: 我們很早起床開車去海邊，可是在下雨，所以我們去了一家咖啡館。

items.en: Maria saw the dress and loved it, but it was too expensive, so she didn't buy it.
items.zh: Maria 看到那件洋裝很喜歡，可是太貴了，所以她沒買。

items.en: The bus was late and the traffic was terrible, but we got there in time.
items.zh: 公車誤點，交通又很糟，可是我們還是準時到了。

examples.heading: ② and then

items.en: I finished my homework and then I watched a film.
items.zh: 我寫完功課，然後看了一部電影。

items.en: We had dinner at a little restaurant and then we walked along the river.
items.zh: 我們在一家小餐廳吃晚餐，然後沿著河邊散步。

items.en: She opened the letter, read it twice and then started to cry.
items.zh: 她打開信讀了兩遍，然後就哭了。

items.en: We visited my grandparents and then drove home late at night.
items.zh: 我們去看了爺爺奶奶，然後深夜才開車回家。

examples.heading: ③ then + and

items.en: We went to his studio, then he started singing, and I joined in.
items.zh: 我們去了他的錄音室，接著他開始唱歌，我也跟著唱。

items.en: I heard a strange noise, then the lights went out, and everyone screamed.
items.zh: 我聽到一個奇怪的聲音，接著燈熄了，大家都尖叫起來。

items.en: I woke up, then I looked at the clock, and it was already ten.
items.zh: 我醒來，接著看了一下時鐘，已經十點了。

items.en: The plane landed, then we waited for our bags, and finally we took a taxi.
items.zh: 飛機降落，接著我們等行李，最後搭計程車。

examples.heading: ④ but + so

items.en: I wanted to go to the concert, but I had no money, so I stayed at home.
items.zh: 我想去聽演唱會，可是沒錢，所以待在家。

items.en: The tickets were sold out, but my friend had two, so we went together.
items.zh: 票賣完了，可是我朋友有兩張，所以我們一起去了。

items.en: It was a long walk, but the weather was lovely, so we didn't mind.
items.zh: 路很遠，可是天氣很好，所以我們不介意。

items.en: I forgot my keys, but my neighbour had a spare one, so I got in.
items.zh: 我忘了帶鑰匙，可是鄰居有備用的，所以我進得了門。

examples.heading: ⑤ and + so

items.en: It started to snow and the roads were icy, so we stayed in the hotel.
items.zh: 開始下雪，路面又結冰，所以我們待在飯店。

items.en: I was hungry and there was nothing in the fridge, so I ordered a pizza.
items.zh: 我很餓，冰箱裡又什麼都沒有，所以我叫了披薩。

items.en: The baby was crying and nobody could sleep, so Dad took her for a drive.
items.zh: 寶寶一直哭，大家都睡不著，所以爸爸開車載她出去兜風。

items.en: The film was boring and very long, so we left early.
items.zh: 那部電影很無聊又很長，所以我們提早離開了。

examples.heading: ⑥ or + so

items.en: You can take the train or the bus, but the train is faster, so I'd take that.
items.zh: 你可以搭火車或公車，可是火車比較快，所以我會搭火車。

items.en: We could stay in or go out, but I'm tired, so let's stay in.
items.zh: 我們可以待在家或出去，可是我很累，所以我們待在家吧。

items.en: You can pay now or later, but the price goes up next week.
items.zh: 你可以現在付或之後付，可是下週價錢會漲。

items.en: Should we call a taxi, or should we walk? It's not raining, so let's walk.
items.zh: 我們要叫計程車，還是走路？沒在下雨，所以我們走路吧。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說故事的長句

items.en: I looked out of the window and saw two men in the garden, but when I called my dad, they were gone.
items.zh: 我往窗外看，看到花園裡有兩個男人，可是等我叫爸爸過來，他們已經不見了。

items.en: We arrived at the hotel, but our room wasn't ready, so we left our bags and went for lunch.
items.zh: 我們到了飯店，可是房間還沒準備好，所以我們放下行李去吃午餐。

items.en: I heard a strange voice, I woke up, and there was my mum next to my bed.
items.zh: 我聽到一個奇怪的聲音，醒了過來，發現我媽就在我床邊。

items.en: My phone died, so I borrowed a stranger's phone, and then I called my sister.
items.zh: 我的手機沒電了，所以我跟一位陌生人借手機，然後打給我姊姊。

items.en: The dog ran out of the house, then it crossed the road, and a kind lady caught it.
items.zh: 狗跑出家門，接著穿過馬路，有一位好心的女士抓住了牠。

title: I'll either write or phone you soon.
translation: 我很快就會寫信或打電話給你。
name: 對等連接詞 either … or
sentences: I'll either text or email you the address.
On Sundays we either cook at home or eat at my aunt's.
You can either sit here or stand at the back.
After dinner, Dad either reads or watches the news.
We'll either rent a car or take the train.
You can have either chicken or fish for the main course.
Bring either a sandwich or some fruit for lunch.
We'll buy either a sofa or two armchairs.
My brother wants to be either a pilot or a doctor.
The men wear suits, either white or black.
In this town, the weather is either very hot or very cold.
The answer is either right or wrong.
You can get the T-shirt either blue or green.
We can go either to the beach or to the countryside.
You can pay either in cash or by card.
The keys are either in my bag or on the kitchen table.
I usually study either in my room or at the library.
You can either go to the gym or take a yoga class.
For your birthday, we can either have a party or go out for dinner.
To get there, you can either take the bus or walk through the park.
You can either call the hotel or book online.
Either you come with me, or you stay here alone.
Either the shop is closed, or the lights are broken.
Either you tidy your room, or you can't go out tonight.
Either he forgot, or he didn't get my message.
Either my sister or my parents are coming.
Either my parents or my sister is coming.
Either Tom or Lisa has the key.
Either the teacher or the students have made a mistake.
Either Mum or Dad picks me up from school.

examples.heading: ① either + 動詞 + or + 動詞

items.en: I'll either text or email you the address.
items.zh: 我會傳簡訊或寄電子郵件把地址給你。

items.en: On Sundays we either cook at home or eat at my aunt's.
items.zh: 星期天我們不是在家煮，就是去我阿姨家吃。

items.en: You can either sit here or stand at the back.
items.zh: 你可以坐這裡，或站在後面。

items.en: After dinner, Dad either reads or watches the news.
items.zh: 晚餐後，爸爸不是看書就是看新聞。

items.en: We'll either rent a car or take the train.
items.zh: 我們會租車或搭火車。

examples.heading: ② either + 名詞 + or + 名詞

items.en: You can have either chicken or fish for the main course.
items.zh: 主菜你可以選雞肉或魚。

items.en: Bring either a sandwich or some fruit for lunch.
items.zh: 午餐帶一個三明治或一些水果。

items.en: We'll buy either a sofa or two armchairs.
items.zh: 我們會買一張沙發，或兩張扶手椅。

items.en: My brother wants to be either a pilot or a doctor.
items.zh: 我弟弟想當飛行員或醫生。

examples.heading: ③ either + 形容詞 + or + 形容詞

items.en: The men wear suits, either white or black.
items.zh: 男士穿西裝，不是白色就是黑色。

items.en: In this town, the weather is either very hot or very cold.
items.zh: 這個鎮的天氣不是很熱就是很冷。

items.en: The answer is either right or wrong.
items.zh: 答案不是對就是錯。

items.en: You can get the T-shirt either blue or green.
items.zh: 這件 T 恤你可以買藍色或綠色的。

examples.heading: ④ either + 介系詞片語 + or + 介系詞片語

items.en: We can go either to the beach or to the countryside.
items.zh: 我們可以去海邊或去鄉下。

items.en: You can pay either in cash or by card.
items.zh: 你可以付現金或刷卡。

items.en: The keys are either in my bag or on the kitchen table.
items.zh: 鑰匙不是在我包包裡，就是在廚房桌上。

items.en: I usually study either in my room or at the library.
items.zh: 我通常在房間或圖書館念書。

examples.heading: ⑤ either + 動詞片語（建議和選擇）

items.en: You can either go to the gym or take a yoga class.
items.zh: 你可以去健身房，或去上瑜伽課。

items.en: For your birthday, we can either have a party or go out for dinner.
items.zh: 你生日的時候，我們可以辦派對，或出去吃晚餐。

items.en: To get there, you can either take the bus or walk through the park.
items.zh: 要去那裡，你可以搭公車，或走路穿過公園。

items.en: You can either call the hotel or book online.
items.zh: 你可以打電話給飯店，或上網訂房。

examples.heading: ⑥ Either + 子句 + or + 子句

items.en: Either you come with me, or you stay here alone.
items.zh: 要嘛你跟我走，要嘛你自己待在這裡。

items.en: Either the shop is closed, or the lights are broken.
items.zh: 不是店關了，就是燈壞了。

items.en: Either you tidy your room, or you can't go out tonight.
items.zh: 你要嘛整理好房間，要嘛今晚就不能出去。

items.en: Either he forgot, or he didn't get my message.
items.zh: 他不是忘了，就是沒收到我的訊息。

examples.heading: ⑦ either A or B + 動詞

items.en: Either my sister or my parents are coming.
items.zh: 我姊姊或我爸媽會來。

items.en: Either my parents or my sister is coming.
items.zh: 我爸媽或我姊姊會來。

items.en: Either Tom or Lisa has the key.
items.zh: 鑰匙不是在 Tom 那裡，就是在 Lisa 那裡。

items.en: Either the teacher or the students have made a mistake.
items.zh: 不是老師就是學生弄錯了。

items.en: Either Mum or Dad picks me up from school.
items.zh: 不是媽媽就是爸爸來學校接我。

title: Either you get something from your country, or I get something from their wedding list.
translation: 要嘛你從你們國家帶點東西來，要嘛我從他們的結婚禮物清單上買一樣。
name: either … or 連接較複雜的子句
sentences: Either you finish the report tonight, or you explain to the manager why it is late.
Either the meeting starts on time, or we postpone it until next week.
Either she has forgotten our appointment, or her train is delayed.
Either we fix the roof this summer, or we will have serious problems in the winter.
Either the shop has sold out, or they never had the book in stock.
You have two choices: either you accept the offer, or you look for another job.
There are only two possibilities: either the letter got lost, or someone took it by mistake.
We have two options for the party: either we book a restaurant, or we cook at home.
The plan is simple: either the government lowers taxes, or businesses move abroad.
Here is the deal: either you clean your room, or you stay home this weekend.
Either we take the coast road, which is longer but more beautiful, or we use the motorway.
Either you stay in the city centre, which is expensive, or you find a room near the university.
Either we buy the blue sofa, which matches the curtains, or we keep the old one for another year.
Either the company opens a new branch, which would create jobs, or it closes the old factory.
Either he missed the bus because he always leaves late, or he is ill again.
Either they cancelled the concert because of the storm, or the website is wrong.
Either you give her flowers because she loves gardening, or you take her out for dinner.
Either we leave the car at home because parking is difficult, or we arrive very early.
Either you send me the files today, or I come to your office and copy them myself.
Either we rent a van and move everything ourselves, or we pay a removal company.
Either you call the landlord and complain, or I write to him and ask for a meeting.
Either we book the flights now and save money, or we wait and hope for a last-minute deal.
Either the committee approves the budget at the next meeting, or the project will be delayed by at least six months.
Either you come to the airport, which I would really appreciate, or I take a taxi and meet you at the hotel.
Either the school buys new computers this year, or the students continue to share the old ones in the library.
Either we reduce our energy use at home, or we accept much higher bills next winter.
Either the airline refunds the full price, or I will take the matter to a lawyer.
Either your brother picks up the children, or I leave work early.
Either the guests bring their own drinks, or we order some from the shop.
Either the teacher explains the task again, or the students ask their classmates for help.
Either my parents visit us in June, or we fly to see them at Christmas.

examples.heading: ① Either + 子句 + , or + 子句

items.en: Either you finish the report tonight, or you explain to the manager why it is late.
items.zh: 要嘛你今晚寫完報告，要嘛你跟經理解釋為什麼遲交。

items.en: Either the meeting starts on time, or we postpone it until next week.
items.zh: 要嘛會議準時開始，要嘛我們延到下星期。

items.en: Either she has forgotten our appointment, or her train is delayed.
items.zh: 不是她忘了我們的約，就是她的火車誤點了。

items.en: Either we fix the roof this summer, or we will have serious problems in the winter.
items.zh: 要嘛我們今年夏天修屋頂，要嘛冬天會有大麻煩。

items.en: Either the shop has sold out, or they never had the book in stock.
items.zh: 不是書店賣完了，就是他們根本沒進那本書。

examples.heading: ② 用冒號帶出兩個選項

items.en: You have two choices: either you accept the offer, or you look for another job.
items.zh: 你有兩個選擇：要嘛接受這個工作，要嘛另外找工作。

items.en: There are only two possibilities: either the letter got lost, or someone took it by mistake.
items.zh: 只有兩個可能：不是信寄丟了，就是有人拿錯了。

items.en: We have two options for the party: either we book a restaurant, or we cook at home.
items.zh: 派對我們有兩個選擇：要嘛訂餐廳，要嘛在家裡煮。

items.en: The plan is simple: either the government lowers taxes, or businesses move abroad.
items.zh: 道理很簡單：要嘛政府降稅，要嘛企業搬到國外。

items.en: Here is the deal: either you clean your room, or you stay home this weekend.
items.zh: 就這樣說定：要嘛你把房間整理乾淨，要嘛這個週末待在家。

examples.heading: ③ 選項後面接 which 子句

items.en: Either we take the coast road, which is longer but more beautiful, or we use the motorway.
items.zh: 要嘛我們走海岸公路，那條比較遠但風景比較美，要嘛走高速公路。

items.en: Either you stay in the city centre, which is expensive, or you find a room near the university.
items.zh: 要嘛你住市中心，那裡很貴，要嘛在大學附近找個房間。

items.en: Either we buy the blue sofa, which matches the curtains, or we keep the old one for another year.
items.zh: 要嘛我們買那張藍色沙發，它和窗簾很配，要嘛舊的再用一年。

items.en: Either the company opens a new branch, which would create jobs, or it closes the old factory.
items.zh: 要嘛公司開一家新分店，這樣會創造工作機會，要嘛關掉舊工廠。

examples.heading: ④ 選項後面接 because 子句

items.en: Either he missed the bus because he always leaves late, or he is ill again.
items.zh: 不是他沒趕上公車，因為他每次都很晚出門，就是他又生病了。

items.en: Either they cancelled the concert because of the storm, or the website is wrong.
items.zh: 不是他們因為暴風雨取消了音樂會，就是網站寫錯了。

items.en: Either you give her flowers because she loves gardening, or you take her out for dinner.
items.zh: 要嘛你送她花，因為她很愛園藝，要嘛你帶她出去吃晚餐。

items.en: Either we leave the car at home because parking is difficult, or we arrive very early.
items.zh: 要嘛我們把車留在家裡，因為停車很難，要嘛我們很早就到。

examples.heading: ⑤ 選項裡面用 and 接下一步

items.en: Either you send me the files today, or I come to your office and copy them myself.
items.zh: 要嘛你今天把檔案寄給我，要嘛我去你辦公室自己複製。

items.en: Either we rent a van and move everything ourselves, or we pay a removal company.
items.zh: 要嘛我們租一輛廂型車自己搬，要嘛付錢請搬家公司。

items.en: Either you call the landlord and complain, or I write to him and ask for a meeting.
items.zh: 要嘛你打給房東抱怨，要嘛我寫信給他，約他見個面。

items.en: Either we book the flights now and save money, or we wait and hope for a last-minute deal.
items.zh: 要嘛我們現在訂機票省點錢，要嘛等等看有沒有最後一刻的特價。

examples.heading: ⑥ 書信和報告裡的長句

items.en: Either the committee approves the budget at the next meeting, or the project will be delayed by at least six months.
items.zh: 要嘛委員會在下次會議通過預算，要嘛這個計畫至少延後六個月。

items.en: Either you come to the airport, which I would really appreciate, or I take a taxi and meet you at the hotel.
items.zh: 要嘛你來機場接我，我會很感謝，要嘛我搭計程車到飯店跟你碰面。

items.en: Either the school buys new computers this year, or the students continue to share the old ones in the library.
items.zh: 要嘛學校今年買新電腦，要嘛學生繼續在圖書館共用舊的。

items.en: Either we reduce our energy use at home, or we accept much higher bills next winter.
items.zh: 要嘛我們在家少用點電，要嘛明年冬天接受貴很多的帳單。

items.en: Either the airline refunds the full price, or I will take the matter to a lawyer.
items.zh: 要嘛航空公司全額退費，要嘛我會找律師處理這件事。

examples.heading: ⑦ 兩個選項的主詞不同

items.en: Either your brother picks up the children, or I leave work early.
items.zh: 要嘛你哥去接孩子，要嘛我提早下班。

items.en: Either the guests bring their own drinks, or we order some from the shop.
items.zh: 要嘛客人自己帶飲料，要嘛我們跟店家訂一些。

items.en: Either the teacher explains the task again, or the students ask their classmates for help.
items.zh: 要嘛老師再講一次作業怎麼做，要嘛學生問同學。

items.en: Either my parents visit us in June, or we fly to see them at Christmas.
items.zh: 要嘛我爸媽六月來看我們，要嘛我們聖誕節飛回去看他們。

title: She likes to go to the cinema or to the theater.
translation: 她喜歡去電影院或劇院。
name: 對等連接詞連接片語
sentences: I live with my mother and her boyfriend.
Our flat has a small kitchen and a big balcony.
For dinner we had grilled fish and fresh vegetables.
My best friend and her little sister came to my party.
The hotel has a swimming pool and a nice restaurant.
My home is very light and very comfortable.
The new teacher is really friendly and very patient.
The village was very old and really beautiful.
Today the sea is very calm and quite warm.
Their garden is tiny but very pretty.
The exam was long but quite easy.
The shoes are very cheap but really strong.
Our new neighbour is a bit quiet but very kind.
The weather was very cold but really sunny.
Would you like a glass of water or a cup of coffee?
You can take the red bus or the green train.
For my birthday I want a new bike or a big cake.
Do you want the small room or the big one?
My aunt likes to swim in the pool or in the sea.
On Sundays we eat at home or at my grandma's house.
You can leave your bag on the chair or under the table.
My brother studies in his room or in the library.
In summer we go to the beach or to the mountains.
There are flowers in the garden and on the balcony.
The museum is open in the morning but not in the evening.
The cat sleeps on my bed and under my desk.
We put our photos on the wall and in a big album.
After school I do my homework and watch TV.
On Saturday mornings my dad cleans the car and cooks lunch.
In the evening we play cards or listen to music.
You can stay at home or come with us.
My sister gets up early and goes for a run.

examples.heading: ① 名詞片語 + and + 名詞片語

items.en: I live with my mother and her boyfriend.
items.zh: 我和我媽媽還有她男朋友住在一起。

items.en: Our flat has a small kitchen and a big balcony.
items.zh: 我們的公寓有一間小廚房和一個大陽台。

items.en: For dinner we had grilled fish and fresh vegetables.
items.zh: 晚餐我們吃了烤魚和新鮮蔬菜。

items.en: My best friend and her little sister came to my party.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友和她妹妹來參加我的派對。

items.en: The hotel has a swimming pool and a nice restaurant.
items.zh: 這家飯店有游泳池，還有一間不錯的餐廳。

examples.heading: ② 形容詞片語 + and + 形容詞片語

items.en: My home is very light and very comfortable.
items.zh: 我家採光很好，也很舒服。

items.en: The new teacher is really friendly and very patient.
items.zh: 新老師人很親切，也很有耐心。

items.en: The village was very old and really beautiful.
items.zh: 那個村子很古老，也很漂亮。

items.en: Today the sea is very calm and quite warm.
items.zh: 今天海面很平靜，海水也滿溫暖的。

examples.heading: ③ 形容詞片語 + but + 形容詞片語

items.en: Their garden is tiny but very pretty.
items.zh: 他們的花園很小，但是很漂亮。

items.en: The exam was long but quite easy.
items.zh: 考試很長，但是滿簡單的。

items.en: The shoes are very cheap but really strong.
items.zh: 這雙鞋很便宜，但是很耐穿。

items.en: Our new neighbour is a bit quiet but very kind.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居有點安靜，但是人很好。

items.en: The weather was very cold but really sunny.
items.zh: 天氣很冷，但是陽光很好。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞片語 + or + 名詞片語

items.en: Would you like a glass of water or a cup of coffee?
items.zh: 你要一杯水還是一杯咖啡？

items.en: You can take the red bus or the green train.
items.zh: 你可以搭紅色的公車或綠色的火車。

items.en: For my birthday I want a new bike or a big cake.
items.zh: 我生日想要一台新腳踏車或一個大蛋糕。

items.en: Do you want the small room or the big one?
items.zh: 你要小房間還是大房間？

examples.heading: ⑤ 介系詞片語 + or + 介系詞片語

items.en: My aunt likes to swim in the pool or in the sea.
items.zh: 我阿姨喜歡在游泳池或海裡游泳。

items.en: On Sundays we eat at home or at my grandma's house.
items.zh: 星期天我們在家吃，或是去我奶奶家吃。

items.en: You can leave your bag on the chair or under the table.
items.zh: 你可以把包包放在椅子上或桌子底下。

items.en: My brother studies in his room or in the library.
items.zh: 我弟弟在他房間或圖書館念書。

items.en: In summer we go to the beach or to the mountains.
items.zh: 夏天我們去海邊或去山上。

examples.heading: ⑥ 介系詞片語 + and、but + 介系詞片語

items.en: There are flowers in the garden and on the balcony.
items.zh: 花園裡和陽台上都有花。

items.en: The museum is open in the morning but not in the evening.
items.zh: 博物館早上開，但是晚上不開。

items.en: The cat sleeps on my bed and under my desk.
items.zh: 貓會睡在我床上，也會睡在我書桌底下。

items.en: We put our photos on the wall and in a big album.
items.zh: 我們把照片貼在牆上，也放進一本大相簿。

examples.heading: ⑦ 動詞片語 + and、or + 動詞片語

items.en: After school I do my homework and watch TV.
items.zh: 放學後我寫功課，然後看電視。

items.en: On Saturday mornings my dad cleans the car and cooks lunch.
items.zh: 星期六早上我爸洗車，再煮午餐。

items.en: In the evening we play cards or listen to music.
items.zh: 晚上我們玩牌或聽音樂。

items.en: You can stay at home or come with us.
items.zh: 你可以待在家，或跟我們一起去。

items.en: My sister gets up early and goes for a run.
items.zh: 我姊姊很早起床，然後去跑步。

title: At the moment, I pay 550 pounds monthly plus bills.
translation: 我目前每個月付 550 英鎊，另外還要付水電費。
name: plus 連接名詞
sentences: Our rent is 1,200 dollars a month plus water.
It cost me £2,500 plus the taxes.
The flat is £900 a month plus electricity.
The concert tickets are £45 plus a booking fee.
The repair cost 300 dollars plus parts.
You pay ten euros for the tour plus two euros for the map.
The job pays £28,000 a year plus a company car.
I get a good salary plus six weeks' holiday.
She earns 2,000 euros a month plus tips.
Waiters get a basic wage plus free meals.
In my house we are six people plus my two cats.
There were twenty students plus two teachers on the bus.
We need a table for four adults plus a baby.
The team has eleven players plus three reserves.
My uncle has three sons plus a daughter.
The kit includes a tent plus two sleeping bags.
You get a burger and chips plus a free drink.
Bring your passport plus two photos.
The room has a double bed plus a sofa bed.
The course includes ten lessons plus a final exam.
The flight takes six hours plus a two-hour stop in Dubai.
I work forty hours a week plus some weekends.
The training lasts three days plus one day of tests.
It takes an hour by train plus ten minutes on foot.
Two plus three is five.
Ten plus ten equals twenty.
What is seven plus eight?
My share of the rent is £700 plus half the bills.
The winner gets £1,000 plus a trip to Paris.
The price includes the flight plus three nights in a hotel.

examples.heading: ① 價錢 + plus + 費用

items.en: Our rent is 1,200 dollars a month plus water.
items.zh: 我們的房租一個月 1,200 美元，水費另計。

items.en: It cost me £2,500 plus the taxes.
items.zh: 它花了我 2,500 英鎊，另外還要加稅。

items.en: The flat is £900 a month plus electricity.
items.zh: 這間公寓一個月 900 英鎊，電費另計。

items.en: The concert tickets are £45 plus a booking fee.
items.zh: 演唱會的票是 45 英鎊，另外還有訂票手續費。

items.en: The repair cost 300 dollars plus parts.
items.zh: 修理費 300 美元，零件另計。

items.en: You pay ten euros for the tour plus two euros for the map.
items.zh: 導覽要付十歐元，地圖另外兩歐元。

examples.heading: ② 薪水和好處

items.en: The job pays £28,000 a year plus a company car.
items.zh: 這份工作年薪 28,000 英鎊，另外配一台公司車。

items.en: I get a good salary plus six weeks' holiday.
items.zh: 我的薪水不錯，另外還有六個星期的假。

items.en: She earns 2,000 euros a month plus tips.
items.zh: 她一個月賺 2,000 歐元，另外還有小費。

items.en: Waiters get a basic wage plus free meals.
items.zh: 服務生有基本工資，另外還供餐。

examples.heading: ③ 人數 + plus + 人或動物

items.en: In my house we are six people plus my two cats.
items.zh: 我家有六個人，另外還有我的兩隻貓。

items.en: There were twenty students plus two teachers on the bus.
items.zh: 公車上有二十個學生，另外還有兩位老師。

items.en: We need a table for four adults plus a baby.
items.zh: 我們需要一張四個大人的桌子，另外還有一個寶寶。

items.en: The team has eleven players plus three reserves.
items.zh: 這個隊伍有十一個球員，另外還有三個替補。

items.en: My uncle has three sons plus a daughter.
items.zh: 我叔叔有三個兒子，另外還有一個女兒。

examples.heading: ④ 東西 + plus + 東西

items.en: The kit includes a tent plus two sleeping bags.
items.zh: 這組裝備有一頂帳篷，另外還有兩個睡袋。

items.en: You get a burger and chips plus a free drink.
items.zh: 你會拿到漢堡和薯條，另外還送一杯飲料。

items.en: Bring your passport plus two photos.
items.zh: 帶你的護照，另外再帶兩張照片。

items.en: The room has a double bed plus a sofa bed.
items.zh: 房間有一張雙人床，另外還有一張沙發床。

items.en: The course includes ten lessons plus a final exam.
items.zh: 這門課有十堂課，另外還有一次期末考。

examples.heading: ⑤ 時間 + plus + 時間

items.en: The flight takes six hours plus a two-hour stop in Dubai.
items.zh: 飛行時間六小時，另外在杜拜轉機停兩個小時。

items.en: I work forty hours a week plus some weekends.
items.zh: 我一週工作四十小時，有時候週末也要上班。

items.en: The training lasts three days plus one day of tests.
items.zh: 訓練為期三天，另外還有一天考試。

items.en: It takes an hour by train plus ten minutes on foot.
items.zh: 搭火車要一個小時，另外還要走路十分鐘。

examples.heading: ⑥ 算術

items.en: Two plus three is five.
items.zh: 二加三等於五。

items.en: Ten plus ten equals twenty.
items.zh: 十加十等於二十。

items.en: What is seven plus eight?
items.zh: 七加八是多少？

examples.heading: ⑦ 獎品和優惠 + plus + 另外的東西

items.en: My share of the rent is £700 plus half the bills.
items.zh: 我分攤的房租是 700 英鎊，另外還要付一半的水電費。

items.en: The winner gets £1,000 plus a trip to Paris.
items.zh: 得獎的人可以拿到 1,000 英鎊，另外還有一趟巴黎之旅。

items.en: The price includes the flight plus three nights in a hotel.
items.zh: 這個價錢包括機票，另外還有三晚的飯店住宿。

title: I go shopping on Ladypool Road. Or sometimes I go to my local shop.
translation: 我會去 Ladypool Road 買東西。或者有時候我會去家附近的店。
name: 對等連接詞放在句首連接句子
sentences: I like my town because it is quiet. And I like my flat because it is big.
The park near my house is beautiful. And it is free.
My new school is very big. And the teachers are really nice.
We had a lovely dinner. And then we went for a walk by the river.
My grandmother is eighty. And she still rides her bike every day.
I work in a café. And on Saturdays I help my uncle in his shop.
I am from Estonia. But now I live in Dorchester.
I like football. But I don't like watching it on TV.
Our holiday was very short. But we had a great time.
My phone is quite old. But it still works well.
I wanted to buy the jacket. But it was too expensive.
Lisa studied English at school. But she forgot most of it.
I buy my bread at the market. Or sometimes I bake it myself.
On Sundays I visit my parents. Or they come to my house.
We usually watch a film in the evening. Or we play cards.
You can come by train. Or you can take the bus from the airport.
I often have soup for lunch. Or sometimes I just eat a sandwich.
I lived in Paris for five years. But now I live in London.
I didn't like fish as a child. But now I eat it every week.
The morning was sunny. But then it started to rain.
We were lost for an hour. But then a kind man helped us.
I clean the kitchen every morning. And then I make breakfast.
I finished work at five. And then I met my friends for coffee.
The kids opened their presents. And then they played in the snow.
First, wash your hands. And then cut the vegetables.
Do you want to go out tonight? Or are you too tired?
Shall we eat here? Or would you like to go somewhere else?
Is the meeting today? Or is it tomorrow?
"This dress is lovely." "But it's very expensive."
"Let's go to the beach." "Or we could go to the pool."
"I've finished my homework." "And have you cleaned your room?"

examples.heading: ① 句子。 + And + 句子。

items.en: I like my town because it is quiet. And I like my flat because it is big.
items.zh: 我喜歡我住的鎮，因為很安靜。而且我喜歡我的公寓，因為很大。

items.en: The park near my house is beautiful. And it is free.
items.zh: 我家附近的公園很漂亮。而且是免費的。

items.en: My new school is very big. And the teachers are really nice.
items.zh: 我的新學校很大。而且老師人都很好。

items.en: We had a lovely dinner. And then we went for a walk by the river.
items.zh: 我們吃了一頓很棒的晚餐。然後我們去河邊散步。

items.en: My grandmother is eighty. And she still rides her bike every day.
items.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了。而且她每天還在騎腳踏車。

items.en: I work in a café. And on Saturdays I help my uncle in his shop.
items.zh: 我在一家咖啡館上班。星期六我還會去我叔叔的店幫忙。

examples.heading: ② 句子。 + But + 句子。

items.en: I am from Estonia. But now I live in Dorchester.
items.zh: 我來自愛沙尼亞。但是我現在住在多徹斯特。

items.en: I like football. But I don't like watching it on TV.
items.zh: 我喜歡足球。但是我不喜歡看電視轉播。

items.en: Our holiday was very short. But we had a great time.
items.zh: 我們的假期很短。但是我們玩得很開心。

items.en: My phone is quite old. But it still works well.
items.zh: 我的手機滿舊的。但是還很好用。

items.en: I wanted to buy the jacket. But it was too expensive.
items.zh: 我想買那件夾克。但是太貴了。

items.en: Lisa studied English at school. But she forgot most of it.
items.zh: Lisa 在學校學過英文。但是她大部分都忘了。

examples.heading: ③ 句子。 + Or + 句子。

items.en: I buy my bread at the market. Or sometimes I bake it myself.
items.zh: 我在市場買麵包。或者有時候我自己烤。

items.en: On Sundays I visit my parents. Or they come to my house.
items.zh: 星期天我去看我爸媽。或者他們來我家。

items.en: We usually watch a film in the evening. Or we play cards.
items.zh: 我們晚上通常看電影。或者玩牌。

items.en: You can come by train. Or you can take the bus from the airport.
items.zh: 你可以搭火車來。或者從機場搭公車。

items.en: I often have soup for lunch. Or sometimes I just eat a sandwich.
items.zh: 我午餐常喝湯。或者有時候只吃一個三明治。

examples.heading: ④ 句子。 + But now、But then + 句子。

items.en: I lived in Paris for five years. But now I live in London.
items.zh: 我在巴黎住了五年。但是現在我住在倫敦。

items.en: I didn't like fish as a child. But now I eat it every week.
items.zh: 我小時候不喜歡吃魚。但是現在我每個星期都吃。

items.en: The morning was sunny. But then it started to rain.
items.zh: 早上天氣很好。但是後來開始下雨了。

items.en: We were lost for an hour. But then a kind man helped us.
items.zh: 我們迷路了一個小時。但是後來有一位好心的先生幫了我們。

examples.heading: ⑤ 句子。 + And then + 句子。

items.en: I clean the kitchen every morning. And then I make breakfast.
items.zh: 我每天早上打掃廚房。然後做早餐。

items.en: I finished work at five. And then I met my friends for coffee.
items.zh: 我五點下班。然後去和朋友喝咖啡。

items.en: The kids opened their presents. And then they played in the snow.
items.zh: 孩子們拆了禮物。然後他們去雪地裡玩。

items.en: First, wash your hands. And then cut the vegetables.
items.zh: 先洗手。然後切菜。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問句。 + Or + 問句。

items.en: Do you want to go out tonight? Or are you too tired?
items.zh: 你今晚想出去嗎？還是你太累了？

items.en: Shall we eat here? Or would you like to go somewhere else?
items.zh: 我們在這裡吃嗎？還是你想去別的地方？

items.en: Is the meeting today? Or is it tomorrow?
items.zh: 會議是今天嗎？還是明天？

examples.heading: ⑦ 回答對方的話

items.en: "This dress is lovely." "But it's very expensive."
items.zh: 這件洋裝很好看。可是很貴。

items.en: "Let's go to the beach." "Or we could go to the pool."
items.zh: 我們去海邊吧。或者我們可以去游泳池。

items.en: "I've finished my homework." "And have you cleaned your room?"
items.zh: 我寫完功課了。那你房間打掃了嗎？

title: All of us were dancing while my father sang my favorite song.
translation: 我爸爸在唱我最喜歡的歌，我們大家都在跳舞。
name: 從屬連接詞 if、when、so、while
sentences: If you don't take your car, you can rent a bike in the park.
If I have time this weekend, I'll visit my grandparents.
If you are cold, you can wear my jacket.
If the shop is closed, we can go to the supermarket.
We'll go to the beach if the weather is nice.
When I was a child, I lived in a small village.
My little brother laughed when he saw the clown.
When you arrive at the station, call me.
When my brother gets home, he always plays computer games.
We had lunch in the garden when the sun came out.
I read a book while I was waiting for the bus.
My dad washed the car while my mum was shopping.
Someone stole my bag while I was sleeping on the train.
The children played in the garden while we cooked dinner.
I always sing while I take a shower.
I didn't like green, so I chose blue.
It was raining, so we took a taxi.
The tickets were expensive, so we watched the match at home.
The bakery was closed, so I bought bread at the supermarket.
The museum was free, so we went in.
If you need help, ask your teacher.
When the teacher came in, everyone stopped talking.
While I was cooking, the phone rang.
If you buy two coffees, you get a free cake.
I'll lend you my umbrella if you need it.
My grandmother smiled when she opened the present.
We sang songs while we were walking home.
I left early, so I didn't see the end of the party.
I was so happy when I saw my exam results.
If you come to my city, I will show you the old town.
My friends danced while the band played our favorite song.
The hotel was full, so we stayed with my cousin.

examples.heading: ① if：說出條件

items.en: If you don't take your car, you can rent a bike in the park.
items.zh: 如果你不開車去，可以在公園裡租腳踏車。

items.en: If I have time this weekend, I'll visit my grandparents.
items.zh: 如果這個週末有空，我會去看我爺爺奶奶。

items.en: If you are cold, you can wear my jacket.
items.zh: 如果你覺得冷，可以穿我的外套。

items.en: If the shop is closed, we can go to the supermarket.
items.zh: 如果那家店沒開，我們可以去超市。

items.en: We'll go to the beach if the weather is nice.
items.zh: 如果天氣好，我們就去海邊。

examples.heading: ② when：說出時間

items.en: When I was a child, I lived in a small village.
items.zh: 我小時候住在一個小村子裡。

items.en: My little brother laughed when he saw the clown.
items.zh: 我弟弟看到小丑就笑了。

items.en: When you arrive at the station, call me.
items.zh: 你到車站的時候打電話給我。

items.en: When my brother gets home, he always plays computer games.
items.zh: 我弟弟一回到家就打電動。

items.en: We had lunch in the garden when the sun came out.
items.zh: 太陽出來的時候，我們在花園裡吃午餐。

examples.heading: ③ while：說出同時進行的事

items.en: I read a book while I was waiting for the bus.
items.zh: 我等公車的時候在看書。

items.en: My dad washed the car while my mum was shopping.
items.zh: 我媽媽去買東西的時候，我爸爸在洗車。

items.en: Someone stole my bag while I was sleeping on the train.
items.zh: 我在火車上睡覺的時候，有人偷了我的包包。

items.en: The children played in the garden while we cooked dinner.
items.zh: 我們煮晚餐的時候，孩子們在花園裡玩。

items.en: I always sing while I take a shower.
items.zh: 我洗澡的時候總是會唱歌。

examples.heading: ④ so：說出結果

items.en: I didn't like green, so I chose blue.
items.zh: 我不喜歡綠色，所以我選了藍色。

items.en: It was raining, so we took a taxi.
items.zh: 那時在下雨，所以我們搭了計程車。

items.en: The tickets were expensive, so we watched the match at home.
items.zh: 票很貴，所以我們在家看比賽。

items.en: The bakery was closed, so I bought bread at the supermarket.
items.zh: 麵包店關了，所以我在超市買了麵包。

items.en: The museum was free, so we went in.
items.zh: 博物館不用錢，所以我們就進去了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 子句放在句首

items.en: If you need help, ask your teacher.
items.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，就問老師。

items.en: When the teacher came in, everyone stopped talking.
items.zh: 老師走進來的時候，大家都不說話了。

items.en: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
items.zh: 我在煮飯的時候，電話響了。

items.en: If you buy two coffees, you get a free cake.
items.zh: 如果你買兩杯咖啡，就送一塊蛋糕。

examples.heading: ⑥ 子句放在句尾

items.en: I'll lend you my umbrella if you need it.
items.zh: 如果你需要，我可以借你雨傘。

items.en: My grandmother smiled when she opened the present.
items.zh: 我奶奶打開禮物的時候笑了。

items.en: We sang songs while we were walking home.
items.zh: 我們走路回家的時候一路唱歌。

items.en: I left early, so I didn't see the end of the party.
items.zh: 我很早就走了，所以沒看到派對的結尾。

examples.heading: ⑦ 信件和日記裡的句子

items.en: I was so happy when I saw my exam results.
items.zh: 我看到考試成績的時候好開心。

items.en: If you come to my city, I will show you the old town.
items.zh: 如果你來我住的城市，我會帶你去看舊城區。

items.en: My friends danced while the band played our favorite song.
items.zh: 樂團演奏我們最喜歡的歌時，我的朋友們都在跳舞。

items.en: The hotel was full, so we stayed with my cousin.
items.zh: 飯店客滿了，所以我們住在我表哥家。

title: I haven't seen him since we were at school.
translation: 我們學生時代之後，我就再也沒見過他了。
name: 引導副詞子句的從屬連接詞（較多種）
sentences: The kids went straight to bed after they got home from the party.
Please turn off the lights before you leave the office.
After I finished university, I moved to London.
She always checks her emails before she goes to bed.
Before we went out, we ate something at a café near the station.
My grandparents have lived in this house since they got married.
I've wanted to visit Japan since I was a little girl.
We waited at the bus stop until the rain stopped.
Don't open the box until your father gets home.
He didn't notice his wallet was missing until he got to the shop.
As it was my sister's birthday, we went to a nice restaurant.
I'm sorry I can't come to the meeting, since I'll be in China that week.
As the shop was closed, we went home.
Since you're here, can you help me move this table?
Although the hotel was small, it was very comfortable.
My parents want me to go on holiday with them, although I want to stay with my friends.
Though it was late, the streets were still busy.
We enjoyed the concert, though the tickets were expensive.
Although he is only twelve, he plays the piano very well.
I wrote the address down so that I wouldn't forget it.
She saved money so that she could buy a new laptop.
Speak louder so that everyone can hear you.
We left early so that we would get good seats.
I don't know whether the museum is open on Sundays.
She asked me whether I wanted tea or coffee.
We haven't decided whether we will go by train or by car.
Can you check whether the tickets are still available?
I'm writing to you because I need some advice before I start my new job.
Although the trip was fantastic, we missed you a lot.
Call me after you arrive at the airport.
I'll keep the photos until you come back from holiday.

examples.heading: ① after、before

items.en: The kids went straight to bed after they got home from the party.
items.zh: 孩子們從派對回到家後就直接上床睡覺了。

items.en: Please turn off the lights before you leave the office.
items.zh: 離開辦公室前，請把燈關掉。

items.en: After I finished university, I moved to London.
items.zh: 我大學畢業後搬到了倫敦。

items.en: She always checks her emails before she goes to bed.
items.zh: 她睡覺前都會看一下電子郵件。

items.en: Before we went out, we ate something at a café near the station.
items.zh: 出門前，我們在車站附近的咖啡館吃了點東西。

examples.heading: ② since、until

items.en: My grandparents have lived in this house since they got married.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶從結婚後就一直住在這棟房子裡。

items.en: I've wanted to visit Japan since I was a little girl.
items.zh: 我從小時候就一直想去日本。

items.en: We waited at the bus stop until the rain stopped.
items.zh: 我們在公車站等到雨停。

items.en: Don't open the box until your father gets home.
items.zh: 等你爸爸回家再打開盒子。

items.en: He didn't notice his wallet was missing until he got to the shop.
items.zh: 他到了店裡才發現錢包不見了。

examples.heading: ③ as、since 表示原因

items.en: As it was my sister's birthday, we went to a nice restaurant.
items.zh: 因為那天是我姊姊生日，我們去了一家不錯的餐廳。

items.en: I'm sorry I can't come to the meeting, since I'll be in China that week.
items.zh: 很抱歉我不能參加會議，因為那個星期我人在中國。

items.en: As the shop was closed, we went home.
items.zh: 因為店關了，我們就回家了。

items.en: Since you're here, can you help me move this table?
items.zh: 既然你在這裡，可以幫我搬這張桌子嗎？

examples.heading: ④ although、though

items.en: Although the hotel was small, it was very comfortable.
items.zh: 那家旅館雖然小，但很舒服。

items.en: My parents want me to go on holiday with them, although I want to stay with my friends.
items.zh: 我爸媽要我跟他們去度假，雖然我想跟朋友待在一起。

items.en: Though it was late, the streets were still busy.
items.zh: 雖然很晚了，街上還是很熱鬧。

items.en: We enjoyed the concert, though the tickets were expensive.
items.zh: 雖然票很貴，我們還是很喜歡那場音樂會。

items.en: Although he is only twelve, he plays the piano very well.
items.zh: 他雖然才十二歲，鋼琴卻彈得很好。

examples.heading: ⑤ so that 表示目的

items.en: I wrote the address down so that I wouldn't forget it.
items.zh: 我把地址寫下來，免得忘記。

items.en: She saved money so that she could buy a new laptop.
items.zh: 她存錢好買一台新筆電。

items.en: Speak louder so that everyone can hear you.
items.zh: 大聲一點，讓大家都聽得到你說話。

items.en: We left early so that we would get good seats.
items.zh: 我們提早出門，好佔到好位子。

examples.heading: ⑥ whether 表示是否

items.en: I don't know whether the museum is open on Sundays.
items.zh: 我不知道博物館星期天有沒有開。

items.en: She asked me whether I wanted tea or coffee.
items.zh: 她問我要喝茶還是咖啡。

items.en: We haven't decided whether we will go by train or by car.
items.zh: 我們還沒決定要搭火車還是開車去。

items.en: Can you check whether the tickets are still available?
items.zh: 你可以查一下票還有沒有嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 信件裡的句子

items.en: I'm writing to you because I need some advice before I start my new job.
items.zh: 我寫信給你，是因為開始新工作前需要一些建議。

items.en: Although the trip was fantastic, we missed you a lot.
items.zh: 雖然這趟旅行很棒，我們還是很想你。

items.en: Call me after you arrive at the airport.
items.zh: 你到機場後打電話給我。

items.en: I'll keep the photos until you come back from holiday.
items.zh: 我會把照片留著，等你度假回來。

title: Believe me, once you have tried it, you'll never give it up.
translation: 相信我，你只要試過一次，就再也不會想放棄了。
name: 單字從屬連接詞（once、whereas 等）
sentences: Once you have finished the test, you can leave the room.
Once the guests arrive, we'll start serving dinner.
Riding a bike is easy once you've learned how to do it.
Once I get my first salary, I'll buy my parents a nice dinner.
Once the snow melts, the mountain roads will open again.
Whenever I visit my grandmother, she makes me a big lunch.
My dog gets excited whenever he hears the doorbell.
Whenever it rains, the road outside our house floods.
Feel free to drop by whenever you're in the area.
You can't enter the building unless you have a pass.
Unless we hurry, we'll miss the start of the film.
I usually walk to work unless it's raining.
The tickets won't be refunded unless the concert is cancelled.
Don't call me at night unless it's urgent.
You can borrow my camera provided that you take good care of it.
Provided the weather is good, we'll have the party in the garden.
Students get free entry provided they show their student card.
I'll help you with the project provided that you do your part.
My brother loves sport, whereas I prefer reading.
The north of the country is cold and wet, whereas the south is warm and dry.
Some people find the new system useful, whereas others find it confusing.
Whereas the old phone was heavy, the new one weighs only 150 grams.
The holiday was perfect, except that it rained on the last day.
I know nothing about him except that he works in a bank.
The two jackets are the same, except that one has a hood.
Everything went well, except that the taxi was late.
Once you become a member, you'll receive our monthly newsletter.
Driving to work is comfortable, and faster unless you are caught in a traffic jam.
I can't say I've changed much, except that I now wear glasses.
We will continue to work with you provided that the prices stay the same.
Young people often shop online, whereas older people prefer to go to the shops.

examples.heading: ① once

items.en: Once you have finished the test, you can leave the room.
items.zh: 考完試就可以離開教室。

items.en: Once the guests arrive, we'll start serving dinner.
items.zh: 客人一到，我們就開始上菜。

items.en: Riding a bike is easy once you've learned how to do it.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車只要學會了就很簡單。

items.en: Once I get my first salary, I'll buy my parents a nice dinner.
items.zh: 一拿到第一份薪水，我就要請我爸媽吃一頓好的。

items.en: Once the snow melts, the mountain roads will open again.
items.zh: 雪一融化，山路就會重新開放。

examples.heading: ② whenever

items.en: Whenever I visit my grandmother, she makes me a big lunch.
items.zh: 每次我去看奶奶，她都會幫我煮一頓豐盛的午餐。

items.en: My dog gets excited whenever he hears the doorbell.
items.zh: 我的狗每次聽到門鈴聲都很興奮。

items.en: Whenever it rains, the road outside our house floods.
items.zh: 每次下雨，我家外面的路就會淹水。

items.en: Feel free to drop by whenever you're in the area.
items.zh: 你到附近的時候，隨時可以過來坐坐。

examples.heading: ③ unless

items.en: You can't enter the building unless you have a pass.
items.zh: 沒有通行證就不能進大樓。

items.en: Unless we hurry, we'll miss the start of the film.
items.zh: 除非我們動作快，否則會錯過電影的開頭。

items.en: I usually walk to work unless it's raining.
items.zh: 除非下雨，我通常走路上班。

items.en: The tickets won't be refunded unless the concert is cancelled.
items.zh: 除非音樂會取消，否則門票不退。

items.en: Don't call me at night unless it's urgent.
items.zh: 除非有急事，晚上不要打電話給我。

examples.heading: ④ provided (that)

items.en: You can borrow my camera provided that you take good care of it.
items.zh: 只要你好好愛惜，就可以借我的相機。

items.en: Provided the weather is good, we'll have the party in the garden.
items.zh: 只要天氣好，我們就在花園裡辦派對。

items.en: Students get free entry provided they show their student card.
items.zh: 學生只要出示學生證就可以免費入場。

items.en: I'll help you with the project provided that you do your part.
items.zh: 只要你做好你的部分，我就幫你做這個專題。

examples.heading: ⑤ whereas

items.en: My brother loves sport, whereas I prefer reading.
items.zh: 我哥很愛運動，而我比較喜歡看書。

items.en: The north of the country is cold and wet, whereas the south is warm and dry.
items.zh: 這個國家的北部又冷又濕，南部則溫暖乾燥。

items.en: Some people find the new system useful, whereas others find it confusing.
items.zh: 有些人覺得新系統很好用，有些人卻覺得很難懂。

items.en: Whereas the old phone was heavy, the new one weighs only 150 grams.
items.zh: 舊手機很重，新手機卻只有一百五十公克。

examples.heading: ⑥ except (that)

items.en: The holiday was perfect, except that it rained on the last day.
items.zh: 這次度假很完美，只是最後一天下雨了。

items.en: I know nothing about him except that he works in a bank.
items.zh: 我對他一無所知，只知道他在銀行上班。

items.en: The two jackets are the same, except that one has a hood.
items.zh: 這兩件外套一樣，只是其中一件有帽子。

items.en: Everything went well, except that the taxi was late.
items.zh: 一切都很順利，只是計程車遲到了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 討論和信件裡的句子

items.en: Once you become a member, you'll receive our monthly newsletter.
items.zh: 你一成為會員，就會收到我們的每月通訊。

items.en: Driving to work is comfortable, and faster unless you are caught in a traffic jam.
items.zh: 開車上班很舒服，而且比較快，除非遇到塞車。

items.en: I can't say I've changed much, except that I now wear glasses.
items.zh: 我不能說自己變了很多，只是現在戴眼鏡了。

items.en: We will continue to work with you provided that the prices stay the same.
items.zh: 只要價格不變，我們會繼續跟你們合作。

items.en: Young people often shop online, whereas older people prefer to go to the shops.
items.zh: 年輕人常在網路上購物，年紀大的人則比較喜歡去店裡買。

title: I was sure I would get the sack. And yet the manager forgave me.
translation: 我以為我一定會被炒魷魚。可是經理原諒了我。
name: and yet 表示讓步轉折
sentences: I felt very embarrassed and I was sure I would lose my job. And yet the manager forgave me and I stayed.
The road was icy and the car was old. And yet we arrived without any problems.
Nobody in the class expected her to pass. And yet she got the top mark.
The restaurant had terrible reviews online. And yet the food was delicious.
He had never played the piano in public before. And yet he gave a perfect performance.
The job is stressful and the hours are long. And yet I wouldn't change it for anything.
Living in a big city is expensive. And yet I can't imagine living anywhere else.
Learning Chinese takes years. And yet it is one of the most rewarding things I have done.
I know he has made many mistakes. And yet I still trust him.
The town is small and quiet. And yet there is always something to do.
I would probably make the same mistakes as my own parents did. And yet, I think I would be a loving father.
The evidence against him seemed very strong. And yet, the jury found him not guilty.
We had planned everything carefully. And yet, something still went wrong on the day.
The two sisters look almost the same. And yet, their personalities are completely different.
I waited at the station for two hours. And yet she never came.
The house was empty for years. And yet the garden was full of flowers.
We had argued all evening. And yet, when he left, I missed him immediately.
The letter was short and simple. And yet it made me cry.
I had walked past that shop every day. And yet I had never noticed its name.
The country has rich natural resources. And yet most of its people remain poor.
Doctors have warned about the dangers of smoking for decades. And yet millions of people still smoke.
The project received large amounts of public money. And yet very little has been achieved.
Technology has made communication easier than ever. And yet many people feel lonely.
The government promised to build new homes. And yet house prices continue to rise.
"You said you hated camping." "I know. And yet here I am in a tent."
"He's so rude to everyone." "And yet everyone seems to like him."
"The film got bad reviews." "And yet it made millions at the box office."
"She's only sixteen." "And yet she speaks four languages."
The hotel was expensive. But the rooms were nice.
The hotel was cheap and far from the centre. And yet it was the best part of our trip.
The exam was hard. Yet everyone in the class passed.

examples.heading: ① 說出出乎意料的結果

items.en: I felt very embarrassed and I was sure I would lose my job. And yet the manager forgave me and I stayed.
items.zh: 我覺得很丟臉，也以為自己一定會丟掉工作。可是經理原諒了我，我就留了下來。

items.en: The road was icy and the car was old. And yet we arrived without any problems.
items.zh: 路上結冰，車子又舊。可是我們一路平安到了。

items.en: Nobody in the class expected her to pass. And yet she got the top mark.
items.zh: 班上沒有人以為她會及格。可是她拿了最高分。

items.en: The restaurant had terrible reviews online. And yet the food was delicious.
items.zh: 那家餐廳網路上的評價很差。可是東西很好吃。

items.en: He had never played the piano in public before. And yet he gave a perfect performance.
items.zh: 他以前從來沒在大家面前彈過鋼琴。可是他的演出很完美。

examples.heading: ② 說出相反的看法

items.en: The job is stressful and the hours are long. And yet I wouldn't change it for anything.
items.zh: 這份工作壓力大，工時又長。可是我說什麼都不會換。

items.en: Living in a big city is expensive. And yet I can't imagine living anywhere else.
items.zh: 住在大城市很花錢。可是我想不出要住在別的地方。

items.en: Learning Chinese takes years. And yet it is one of the most rewarding things I have done.
items.zh: 學中文要花好幾年。可是這是我做過最有收穫的事之一。

items.en: I know he has made many mistakes. And yet I still trust him.
items.zh: 我知道他犯過很多錯。可是我還是相信他。

items.en: The town is small and quiet. And yet there is always something to do.
items.zh: 這個小鎮又小又安靜。可是總是有事情可以做。

examples.heading: ③ And yet, + 句子

items.en: I would probably make the same mistakes as my own parents did. And yet, I think I would be a loving father.
items.zh: 我大概會犯和我爸媽一樣的錯。可是我想，我會是個有愛心的爸爸。

items.en: The evidence against him seemed very strong. And yet, the jury found him not guilty.
items.zh: 對他不利的證據看起來很有力。然而，陪審團判他無罪。

items.en: We had planned everything carefully. And yet, something still went wrong on the day.
items.zh: 我們什麼都仔細計畫好了。可是，當天還是出了差錯。

items.en: The two sisters look almost the same. And yet, their personalities are completely different.
items.zh: 這兩姊妹長得幾乎一樣。可是，她們的個性完全不同。

examples.heading: ④ 故事和日記裡的句子

items.en: I waited at the station for two hours. And yet she never came.
items.zh: 我在車站等了兩個小時。可是她始終沒來。

items.en: The house was empty for years. And yet the garden was full of flowers.
items.zh: 那棟房子空了好幾年。可是花園裡開滿了花。

items.en: We had argued all evening. And yet, when he left, I missed him immediately.
items.zh: 我們吵了一整個晚上。可是他一走，我馬上就想他了。

items.en: The letter was short and simple. And yet it made me cry.
items.zh: 那封信又短又簡單。可是它讓我哭了。

items.en: I had walked past that shop every day. And yet I had never noticed its name.
items.zh: 我每天都走過那家店。可是我從來沒注意過它的店名。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式文章裡的句子

items.en: The country has rich natural resources. And yet most of its people remain poor.
items.zh: 這個國家有豐富的天然資源。然而大部分的人民仍然很窮。

items.en: Doctors have warned about the dangers of smoking for decades. And yet millions of people still smoke.
items.zh: 醫生警告吸菸的危險已經幾十年了。然而還是有幾百萬人吸菸。

items.en: The project received large amounts of public money. And yet very little has been achieved.
items.zh: 這個計畫拿了大筆的公帑。然而成果很少。

items.en: Technology has made communication easier than ever. And yet many people feel lonely.
items.zh: 科技讓溝通變得前所未有地容易。然而很多人覺得孤單。

items.en: The government promised to build new homes. And yet house prices continue to rise.
items.zh: 政府答應要蓋新房子。然而房價還在上漲。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話裡的句子

items.en: "You said you hated camping." "I know. And yet here I am in a tent."
items.zh: 你說過你很討厭露營。我知道。可是我現在就在帳篷裡。

items.en: "He's so rude to everyone." "And yet everyone seems to like him."
items.zh: 他對每個人都很沒禮貌。可是大家好像都很喜歡他。

items.en: "The film got bad reviews." "And yet it made millions at the box office."
items.zh: 那部電影評價很差。可是票房賺了幾百萬。

items.en: "She's only sixteen." "And yet she speaks four languages."
items.zh: 她才十六歲。可是她會說四種語言。

examples.heading: ⑦ And yet 和 But 的比較

items.en: The hotel was expensive. But the rooms were nice.
items.zh: 那家飯店很貴。不過房間很好。

items.en: The hotel was cheap and far from the centre. And yet it was the best part of our trip.
items.zh: 那家飯店很便宜，又離市中心很遠。可是它是我們這趟旅行最棒的部分。

items.en: The exam was hard. Yet everyone in the class passed.
items.zh: 考試很難。然而全班都及格了。

title: Both friends and family are very important.
translation: 朋友和家人都很重要。

I speak both English and Japanese at work.
You need both a passport and a visa for this country.
We invited both our neighbours and their children.
The hotel offers both breakfast and dinner.
This film is popular with both children and adults.
The shop sells clothes for both men and women.
The rules are the same for both players and coaches.
I'm interested in both history and art.
The city has both old churches and modern buildings.
Our school has both a big library and a new sports hall.
The menu includes both hot dishes and cold salads.
We need both strong players and a good coach.
Both Anna and Tom passed the exam.
Both Sam and his wife are doctors.
I called both Maria and her sister.
Both Ben and Lucy speak three languages.
I love both the sea and the mountains, so it's hard to choose.
This job gives you both money and experience.
Good food needs both time and love.
The museum has both paintings and sculptures from that period.
They have homes in both Spain and France.
The singer is famous in both Europe and Asia.
It snowed in both the north and the south.
You can buy this phone in both shops and supermarkets.

examples.heading: ① Both + 名詞 + and + 名詞 + 動詞

items.en: Both health and happiness matter more than money.
items.zh: 健康和快樂都比錢重要。

items.en: Both my parents and my grandparents live in this street.
items.zh: 我爸媽和我爺爺奶奶都住在這條街上。

items.en: Both the teachers and the students enjoyed the trip.
items.zh: 老師和學生都很喜歡這次旅行。

items.en: Both our market share and our staff numbers are growing.
items.zh: 我們的市場占有率和員工人數都在增加。

examples.heading: ② 動詞 + both + 名詞 + and + 名詞

items.en: Argentina has both wonderful landscapes and excellent towns.
items.zh: 阿根廷既有美麗的風景，也有很棒的城鎮。

items.en: I speak both English and Japanese at work.
items.zh: 我上班時英語和日語都會說。

examples.heading: ③ 介系詞 + both + 名詞 + and + 名詞

items.en: This film is popular with both children and adults.

examples.heading: ④ both + 形容詞 + 名詞 + and + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.zh: 菜單上有熱菜，也有冷的沙拉。

items.en: We need both strong players and a good coach.
items.zh: 我們需要很強的球員，也需要一位好教練。

examples.heading: ⑤ both + 人名 + and + 人名

items.en: Both Anna and Tom passed the exam.
items.zh: Anna 和 Tom 都通過了考試。

items.en: Both Sam and his wife are doctors.
items.zh: Sam 和他太太都是醫生。

items.en: I called both Maria and her sister.
items.zh: 我打給了 Maria，也打給了她姊姊。

items.en: Both Ben and Lucy speak three languages.
items.zh: Ben 和 Lucy 都會說三種語言。

examples.heading: ⑥ both … and 強調兩個都有

items.en: I love both the sea and the mountains, so it's hard to choose.
items.zh: 海和山我都很愛，所以很難選。

items.en: This job gives you both money and experience.
items.zh: 這份工作讓你有錢賺，也有經驗。

items.en: Good food needs both time and love.
items.zh: 好的食物需要時間，也需要用心。

items.en: The museum has both paintings and sculptures from that period.
items.zh: 博物館有那個時期的畫，也有雕塑。

examples.heading: ⑦ both … and + 地點

items.en: They have homes in both Spain and France.
items.zh: 他們在西班牙和法國都有房子。

items.zh: 這位歌手在歐洲和亞洲都很有名。

items.en: It snowed in both the north and the south.
items.zh: 北部和南部都下雪了。

items.en: You can buy this phone in both shops and supermarkets.
items.zh: 這支手機在一般商店和超市都買得到。

title: A lot of people think that television can both entertain and educate.
translation: 很多人認為電視既能娛樂，也能教育。
name: both … and 連接片語和子句
sentences: Music can both relax and inspire people.
A good teacher can both explain and listen.
This machine can both wash and dry your clothes.
Exercise can both prevent and cure many problems.
Children should both play and learn at school.
I could both get some enjoyment and make some money.
She both works full-time and studies at night.
The app lets you both book a table and pay the bill.
My uncle both grows vegetables and sells them at the market.
We want to both see the city and relax by the sea.
We have won a high reputation both at home and abroad.
The singer is popular both in Asia and in Europe.
I use my laptop both at work and at home.
You can see the castle both from the bridge and from the hill.
This road is busy both in the morning and in the evening.
This job is both well paid and interesting.
The old market is both noisy and colourful.
My new neighbour is both kind and funny.
The soup was both hot and delicious.
Learning a language is both hard and rewarding.
The house was both painted and cleaned before we moved in.
The report has been both checked and signed.
The building was both designed and built by local workers.
Her new book is both praised and criticised.
I was both tired and hungry after the trip.
He both cooked dinner and washed the dishes.
My grandmother both knits and sews her own clothes.
Anna both sings and plays the guitar in the band.
I came to London both to work and to improve my English.
We need the money both to pay the rent and to buy food.

examples.heading: ① 情態動詞 + both + 動詞 + and + 動詞

items.en: Music can both relax and inspire people.
items.zh: 音樂既能讓人放鬆，也能啟發人。

items.en: A good teacher can both explain and listen.
items.zh: 好老師既會講解，也會傾聽。

items.en: This machine can both wash and dry your clothes.
items.zh: 這台機器既能洗衣服，也能烘衣服。

items.en: Exercise can both prevent and cure many problems.
items.zh: 運動既能預防，也能治好很多毛病。

items.en: Children should both play and learn at school.
items.zh: 孩子在學校應該又玩又學。

examples.heading: ② both + 動詞片語 + and + 動詞片語

items.en: I could both get some enjoyment and make some money.
items.zh: 我既能玩得開心，又能賺點錢。

items.en: She both works full-time and studies at night.
items.zh: 她白天全職上班，晚上還念書。

items.en: The app lets you both book a table and pay the bill.
items.zh: 這個應用程式既能訂位，也能付帳。

items.en: My uncle both grows vegetables and sells them at the market.
items.zh: 我叔叔既種菜，又在市場賣菜。

items.en: We want to both see the city and relax by the sea.
items.zh: 我們既想逛逛城市，也想在海邊放鬆。

examples.heading: ③ both + 介系詞片語 + and + 介系詞片語

items.en: We have won a high reputation both at home and abroad.
items.zh: 我們在國內外都贏得了很高的聲譽。

items.en: The singer is popular both in Asia and in Europe.
items.zh: 這位歌手在亞洲和歐洲都很受歡迎。

items.en: I use my laptop both at work and at home.
items.zh: 我上班和在家都用筆電。

items.en: You can see the castle both from the bridge and from the hill.

items.en: This road is busy both in the morning and in the evening.
items.zh: 這條路早上和晚上都很塞。

examples.heading: ④ be + both + 形容詞 + and + 形容詞

items.en: This job is both well paid and interesting.
items.zh: 這份工作薪水好，也很有趣。

items.en: The old market is both noisy and colourful.
items.zh: 舊市場很吵，也很繽紛。

items.en: My new neighbour is both kind and funny.
items.zh: 我的新鄰居人很好，也很風趣。

items.en: The soup was both hot and delicious.
items.zh: 湯很熱，也很好喝。

items.en: Learning a language is both hard and rewarding.
items.zh: 學一種語言很難，可是收穫也很多。

examples.heading: ⑤ both + 過去分詞 + and + 過去分詞

examples.heading: ⑥ 主詞相同時用 both … and 連接後半部

items.en: He both cooked dinner and washed the dishes.
items.zh: 他煮了晚餐，也洗了碗。

items.en: My grandmother both knits and sews her own clothes.
items.zh: 我奶奶自己織毛衣，也自己縫衣服。

items.en: Anna both sings and plays the guitar in the band.
items.zh: Anna 在樂團裡既唱歌，也彈吉他。

examples.heading: ⑦ both + to 不定詞 + and + to 不定詞
