items.zh: 我來倫敦，既是為了工作，也是為了把英文練好。

items.en: We need the money both to pay the rent and to buy food.
items.zh: 我們需要這筆錢付房租，也要買食物。

title: Wherever you go, you find shops, hotels and pubs which are full of tourists.
translation: 不管你走到哪裡，都會看到擠滿觀光客的商店、旅館和酒吧。
name: whatever、wherever 等引導句首子句
sentences: Whatever you decide, your parents will support you.
Whatever happens tomorrow, stay calm.
Whatever she cooks, it always tastes good.
Whatever you buy, keep the receipt.
Whatever the problem is, we can talk about it.
Wherever I travel, I always try the local food.
Wherever you sit, you'll have a good view of the stage.
Wherever we went in the city, there were crowds of tourists.
Wherever she lives, she makes friends quickly.
Whoever wins the election, taxes will probably go up.
Whoever we choose, they will need training.
Whoever finishes first, please wait for the others outside.
Whoever made this cake, it's delicious.
Whenever you're ready, we can start the meeting.
Whenever I hear this song, I think of my first holiday abroad.
Whenever he visits, he brings flowers for my mother.
Whenever the phone rings at night, I get worried.
However hard the exam is, don't give up.
However late you get home, send me a message.
However much money he earns, he never seems happy.
However carefully I explain it, she still doesn't understand.
However cold it is, my grandfather swims in the sea every morning.
Whatever the cause of the problem, we will fix it this week.
Whatever the weather, the race will go ahead.
Whatever the result, I'm proud of you.
Whatever your age, it's never too late to learn a language.
Whatever the reason for the poor service, we recommend that you take action immediately.
Whoever we appoint, he or she should be well qualified and flexible.
Wherever you look in the old town, you see beautiful buildings.
However difficult the situation becomes, we will continue to help our customers.
Whenever you have a question, please contact our office.

examples.heading: ① whatever

items.en: Whatever you decide, your parents will support you.
items.zh: 不管你怎麼決定，你爸媽都會支持你。

items.en: Whatever happens tomorrow, stay calm.
items.zh: 不管明天發生什麼事，都要保持冷靜。

items.en: Whatever she cooks, it always tastes good.
items.zh: 不管她煮什麼，都很好吃。

items.en: Whatever you buy, keep the receipt.
items.zh: 不管買什麼，都要留著收據。

items.en: Whatever the problem is, we can talk about it.
items.zh: 不管有什麼問題，我們都可以談。

examples.heading: ② wherever

items.en: Wherever I travel, I always try the local food.
items.zh: 不管我去哪裡旅行，都會嘗試當地的食物。

items.en: Wherever you sit, you'll have a good view of the stage.
items.zh: 不管你坐哪裡，都看得清楚舞台。

items.en: Wherever we went in the city, there were crowds of tourists.
items.zh: 我們在城裡不管走到哪裡，都是一群群的觀光客。

items.en: Wherever she lives, she makes friends quickly.
items.zh: 不管她住在哪裡，都很快交到朋友。

examples.heading: ③ whoever

items.zh: 不管誰贏得選舉，稅大概都會漲。

items.zh: 不管我們選誰，他們都需要受訓。

items.zh: 不管誰先寫完，都請在外面等其他人。

items.zh: 不管這個蛋糕是誰做的，都很好吃。

examples.heading: ④ whenever

items.en: Whenever you're ready, we can start the meeting.
items.zh: 你什麼時候準備好，我們就什麼時候開會。

items.en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of my first holiday abroad.
items.zh: 每次聽到這首歌，我都會想起第一次出國度假。

items.en: Whenever he visits, he brings flowers for my mother.
items.zh: 他每次來，都會帶花給我媽媽。

items.en: Whenever the phone rings at night, I get worried.
items.zh: 每次晚上電話響，我都會擔心。

examples.heading: ⑤ however + 形容詞或副詞

items.en: However hard the exam is, don't give up.
items.zh: 不管考試多難，都不要放棄。

items.en: However late you get home, send me a message.
items.zh: 不管你多晚回到家，都傳個訊息給我。

items.en: However much money he earns, he never seems happy.
items.zh: 不管他賺多少錢，他好像都不快樂。

items.en: However carefully I explain it, she still doesn't understand.
items.zh: 不管我解釋得多仔細，她還是聽不懂。

items.en: However cold it is, my grandfather swims in the sea every morning.
items.zh: 不管天氣多冷，我爺爺每天早上都去海裡游泳。

examples.heading: ⑥ whatever + 名詞

items.en: Whatever the cause of the problem, we will fix it this week.
items.zh: 不管問題的原因是什麼，我們這星期都會修好。

items.en: Whatever the weather, the race will go ahead.
items.zh: 不管天氣如何，比賽都會照常舉行。

items.en: Whatever the result, I'm proud of you.
items.zh: 不管結果如何，我都以你為榮。

items.en: Whatever your age, it's never too late to learn a language.
items.zh: 不管你幾歲，學語言都不嫌晚。

examples.heading: ⑦ 正式信件和作文裡的句子

items.en: Whatever the reason for the poor service, we recommend that you take action immediately.
items.zh: 不管服務不好的原因是什麼，我們建議你們馬上採取行動。

items.en: Whoever we appoint, he or she should be well qualified and flexible.
items.zh: 不管我們聘用誰，那個人都應該條件好、能變通。

items.en: Wherever you look in the old town, you see beautiful buildings.
items.zh: 在舊城區不管往哪裡看，都看得到漂亮的建築。

items.en: However difficult the situation becomes, we will continue to help our customers.
items.zh: 不管情況變得多困難，我們都會繼續幫助顧客。

items.en: Whenever you have a question, please contact our office.
items.zh: 你有任何問題，隨時都可以聯絡我們辦公室。

title: Professional sports are damaging to people's health in that they involve grueling training sessions.
translation: 職業運動對人的健康有害，因為要做非常累人的訓練。
name: in that 當從屬連接詞說明原因
sentences: Social media can be harmful in that it encourages people to compare themselves with others.
The policy is unfair in that it punishes people on low incomes.
Fast fashion is wasteful in that most clothes are thrown away after a few months.
Night shifts are dangerous in that they disturb the body's natural rhythm.
The report was misleading in that it left out several key figures.
Learning a second language is valuable in that it improves memory.
The new system is an improvement in that patients no longer wait for hours.
Working from home is convenient in that you save time on commuting.
The scheme was a success in that over a thousand young people found jobs.
I was lucky in that my manager let me take the whole summer off.
The two novels are similar in that both are set in post-war Berlin.
This museum is unique in that visitors are allowed to touch the exhibits.
My approach differs from yours in that I focus on long-term results.
Humans are unusual in that they cook their food.
The two cities are alike in that both depend heavily on tourism.
You are right in that we need more staff, but we can't afford them yet.
The critics have a point in that the ending feels rushed.
His claim is true in that prices have risen, but wages have risen too.
The film is historical in that it is based on real events, but many details are invented.
The study is limited in that it only included adults over the age of sixty.
These results are significant in that they challenge earlier theories.
The method is efficient in that it requires very little equipment.
The survey was flawed in that most of the participants were students.
This species is important in that it controls the number of insects in the forest.
The election was historic in that a woman won the presidency for the first time.
The budget has been criticised, in that it does little for small businesses.
The merger is controversial in that thousands of workers could lose their jobs.
The match was memorable in that the home team came back from three goals down.
Moving abroad changed me in that I became much more independent.
My first job was useful in that it taught me how to deal with difficult customers.
The course was disappointing in that we hardly practised speaking.
Our trip was a failure in that it rained every single day.

examples.heading: ① 說明哪一方面有害

items.en: Social media can be harmful in that it encourages people to compare themselves with others.
items.zh: 社群媒體可能有害，因為它讓人拿自己跟別人比較。

items.en: The policy is unfair in that it punishes people on low incomes.
items.zh: 這項政策不公平，因為它懲罰低收入的人。

items.en: Fast fashion is wasteful in that most clothes are thrown away after a few months.
items.zh: 快時尚很浪費，因為大部分衣服穿幾個月就被丟掉。

items.en: Night shifts are dangerous in that they disturb the body's natural rhythm.
items.zh: 夜班很危險，因為它打亂身體的自然節奏。

items.en: The report was misleading in that it left out several key figures.
items.zh: 這份報告會誤導人，因為它漏掉幾個重要的數字。

examples.heading: ② 說明哪一方面有好處

items.en: Learning a second language is valuable in that it improves memory.
items.zh: 學第二種語言很有價值，因為它能增強記憶力。

items.en: The new system is an improvement in that patients no longer wait for hours.
items.zh: 新制度是一種進步，因為病人不用再等好幾個小時。

items.en: Working from home is convenient in that you save time on commuting.
items.zh: 在家工作很方便，因為可以省下通勤的時間。

items.en: The scheme was a success in that over a thousand young people found jobs.
items.zh: 這個計畫算是成功，因為有超過一千個年輕人找到工作。

items.en: I was lucky in that my manager let me take the whole summer off.
items.zh: 我很幸運，因為主管讓我整個夏天都休假。

examples.heading: ③ 說明相同或不同的地方

items.en: The two novels are similar in that both are set in post-war Berlin.
items.zh: 這兩本小說很像，因為故事都發生在戰後的柏林。

items.en: This museum is unique in that visitors are allowed to touch the exhibits.
items.zh: 這間博物館很特別，因為參觀的人可以摸展品。

items.en: My approach differs from yours in that I focus on long-term results.
items.zh: 我的做法和你的不同，因為我重視長期的成果。

items.en: Humans are unusual in that they cook their food.
items.zh: 人類很特別，因為人會把食物煮熟再吃。

items.en: The two cities are alike in that both depend heavily on tourism.
items.zh: 這兩座城市很像，因為兩座都很依賴觀光業。

examples.heading: ④ 說明說法對的部分

items.en: You are right in that we need more staff, but we can't afford them yet.
items.zh: 你說我們需要更多人手，這點沒錯，可是我們還請不起。

items.en: The critics have a point in that the ending feels rushed.
items.zh: 評論家說得有道理，因為結局確實寫得太倉促。

items.en: His claim is true in that prices have risen, but wages have risen too.
items.zh: 他說的在物價上漲這一點是對的，可是薪水也漲了。

items.en: The film is historical in that it is based on real events, but many details are invented.
items.zh: 這部電影算是歷史片，因為它根據真實事件改編，可是很多細節是虛構的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 用在論文和報告

items.en: The study is limited in that it only included adults over the age of sixty.
items.zh: 這項研究有限制，因為它只納入六十歲以上的成人。

items.en: These results are significant in that they challenge earlier theories.
items.zh: 這些結果很重要，因為它們挑戰了先前的理論。

items.en: The method is efficient in that it requires very little equipment.
items.zh: 這個方法很有效率，因為它只需要很少的器材。

items.en: The survey was flawed in that most of the participants were students.
items.zh: 這份調查有缺陷，因為大部分受訪者是學生。

items.en: This species is important in that it controls the number of insects in the forest.
items.zh: 這個物種很重要，因為牠控制森林裡昆蟲的數量。

examples.heading: ⑥ 用在新聞和評論

items.en: The election was historic in that a woman won the presidency for the first time.
items.zh: 這次選舉具有歷史意義，因為第一次有女性當選總統。

items.en: The budget has been criticised, in that it does little for small businesses.
items.zh: 這份預算受到批評，因為它對小企業幫助很少。

items.en: The merger is controversial in that thousands of workers could lose their jobs.
items.zh: 這次合併有爭議，因為可能有幾千名員工會失業。

items.en: The match was memorable in that the home team came back from three goals down.
items.zh: 這場比賽讓人難忘，因為主隊落後三球還追回來。

examples.heading: ⑦ 用在個人的看法

items.en: Moving abroad changed me in that I became much more independent.
items.zh: 搬到國外改變了我，因為我變得獨立很多。

items.en: My first job was useful in that it taught me how to deal with difficult customers.
items.zh: 我的第一份工作很有用，因為它教我怎麼應付難搞的客人。

items.en: The course was disappointing in that we hardly practised speaking.
items.zh: 這門課讓人失望，因為我們幾乎沒有練口說。

items.en: Our trip was a failure in that it rained every single day.
items.zh: 我們的旅行很失敗，因為每天都下雨。

title: At first, I didn't pay attention to the magazines she subscribed to. Neither did I oppose her need to get new clothes every month.
translation: 一開始，我沒注意她訂了哪些雜誌。她每個月都要買新衣服，我也沒反對。
name: neither、nor 加倒裝助動詞追加否定
sentences: I have no memory of leaving my diary on the train. Neither do I remember losing it on the platform.
The manager didn't explain the decision. Neither did he answer our questions.
We didn't book a hotel in advance. Neither did we check the train times.
My parents never complained about the cost. Neither did they ask me to pay them back.
The police didn't find any fingerprints. Neither did they find a witness.
He has not recovered from the accident. Nor does his future look any more promising.
The new law does not protect small businesses. Nor does it help people on low incomes.
Most visitors don't know about the old castle. Nor do they know about the caves below it.
The company doesn't pay for overtime. Nor does it allow staff to work from home.
Young people rarely read newspapers. Nor do they watch the evening news.
It is not possible to talk on the veranda without shouting. Nor is it possible to watch television peacefully.
The room wasn't very clean. Nor was it as big as the photos suggested.
The plan is not cheap. Nor is it likely to succeed.
The instructions were not clear. Nor were they translated into English.
The museum isn't open on Mondays. Nor is the café next to it.
The council has not repaired the road. Nor has it replied to our letters.
The workers haven't received their wages. Nor have they been told when they will be paid.
I haven't heard from Anna for months. Nor has anyone else in the family.
The airline has not apologised. Nor has it offered us any compensation.
I cannot accept your explanation. Nor can I agree to your request for more time.
The children won't eat vegetables. Neither will they try any new food.
We could not see the stage from our seats. Nor could we hear the actors clearly.
The shop would not give me a refund. Neither would it exchange the faulty camera.
There was no hot water in the bathroom. Nor was there any heating in the bedroom.
She never mentioned her plans to leave. Neither did she say goodbye to her colleagues.
No one told us about the delay. Nor did anyone offer us a drink while we waited.
I had no money for a taxi. Neither did I have a phone to call a friend.
I don't like horror films, and neither does my sister.
The lecture wasn't useful, nor was it short.
Tom doesn't eat meat, and neither does his wife.
The government did not reduce taxes, nor did it create new jobs.

examples.heading: ① Neither + did + 主詞

items.en: I have no memory of leaving my diary on the train. Neither do I remember losing it on the platform.
items.zh: 我不記得把日記留在火車上，也不記得在月台上弄丟了它。

items.en: The manager didn't explain the decision. Neither did he answer our questions.
items.zh: 經理沒有解釋這個決定，也沒有回答我們的問題。

items.en: We didn't book a hotel in advance. Neither did we check the train times.
items.zh: 我們沒有事先訂飯店，也沒查火車的時刻。

items.en: My parents never complained about the cost. Neither did they ask me to pay them back.
items.zh: 我爸媽從來沒抱怨過花費，也沒叫我還錢。

items.en: The police didn't find any fingerprints. Neither did they find a witness.
items.zh: 警方沒找到任何指紋，也沒找到目擊者。

examples.heading: ② Nor + does / do + 主詞

items.en: He has not recovered from the accident. Nor does his future look any more promising.
items.zh: 他還沒從意外中恢復，他的未來看起來也沒有比較樂觀。

items.en: The new law does not protect small businesses. Nor does it help people on low incomes.
items.zh: 新法律沒有保護小型企業，也沒有幫助低收入的人。

items.en: Most visitors don't know about the old castle. Nor do they know about the caves below it.
items.zh: 大多數遊客不知道那座古堡，也不知道古堡下面的洞穴。

items.en: The company doesn't pay for overtime. Nor does it allow staff to work from home.
items.zh: 公司不付加班費，也不讓員工在家工作。

items.en: Young people rarely read newspapers. Nor do they watch the evening news.
items.zh: 年輕人很少看報紙，也不看晚間新聞。

examples.heading: ③ Nor + is / was + 主詞

items.en: It is not possible to talk on the veranda without shouting. Nor is it possible to watch television peacefully.
items.zh: 在陽台上不大聲喊就沒辦法講話，也沒辦法安靜地看電視。

items.en: The room wasn't very clean. Nor was it as big as the photos suggested.
items.zh: 房間不太乾淨，也沒有照片看起來那麼大。

items.en: The plan is not cheap. Nor is it likely to succeed.
items.zh: 這個計畫不便宜，也不太可能成功。

items.en: The instructions were not clear. Nor were they translated into English.
items.zh: 說明寫得不清楚，也沒有翻成英文。

items.en: The museum isn't open on Mondays. Nor is the café next to it.
items.zh: 博物館星期一不開，旁邊的咖啡館也不開。

examples.heading: ④ Nor + has / have + 主詞

items.en: The council has not repaired the road. Nor has it replied to our letters.
items.zh: 市議會沒有修路，也沒有回覆我們的信。

items.en: The workers haven't received their wages. Nor have they been told when they will be paid.
items.zh: 工人還沒拿到薪水，也沒人告訴他們什麼時候會發。

items.en: I haven't heard from Anna for months. Nor has anyone else in the family.
items.zh: 我好幾個月沒有 Anna 的消息，家裡其他人也沒有。

items.en: The airline has not apologised. Nor has it offered us any compensation.
items.zh: 航空公司沒有道歉，也沒有給我們任何補償。

examples.heading: ⑤ Neither / Nor + can / will / would + 主詞

items.en: I cannot accept your explanation. Nor can I agree to your request for more time.
items.zh: 我不能接受你的解釋，也不能答應你延期的要求。

items.en: The children won't eat vegetables. Neither will they try any new food.
items.zh: 孩子們不吃蔬菜，也不肯嘗試任何新的食物。

items.en: We could not see the stage from our seats. Nor could we hear the actors clearly.
items.zh: 從我們的座位看不到舞台，也聽不清楚演員說話。

items.en: The shop would not give me a refund. Neither would it exchange the faulty camera.
items.zh: 那家店不肯退錢給我，也不肯換那台壞掉的相機。

examples.heading: ⑥ 前一句有 no、never

items.en: There was no hot water in the bathroom. Nor was there any heating in the bedroom.
items.zh: 浴室沒有熱水，臥室也沒有暖氣。

items.en: She never mentioned her plans to leave. Neither did she say goodbye to her colleagues.
items.zh: 她從沒提過要離職，也沒跟同事道別。

items.en: No one told us about the delay. Nor did anyone offer us a drink while we waited.
items.zh: 沒有人告訴我們班機延誤，等的時候也沒人給我們一杯飲料。

items.en: I had no money for a taxi. Neither did I have a phone to call a friend.
items.zh: 我沒錢搭計程車，也沒有手機可以打給朋友。

examples.heading: ⑦ and neither、, nor

items.en: I don't like horror films, and neither does my sister.
items.zh: 我不喜歡恐怖片，我妹也不喜歡。

items.en: The lecture wasn't useful, nor was it short.
items.zh: 那堂課沒什麼用，也不短。

items.en: Tom doesn't eat meat, and neither does his wife.
items.zh: Tom 不吃肉，他太太也不吃。

items.en: The government did not reduce taxes, nor did it create new jobs.
items.zh: 政府沒有減稅，也沒有創造新的工作機會。

title: We can neither eat nor drink during the lessons.
translation: 上課時我們不能吃東西，也不能喝東西。
name: neither … nor 連接兩個成分
sentences: Visitors can neither touch nor photograph the paintings.
My grandfather can neither read nor write.
The baby neither slept nor ate all day.
You can neither smoke nor use your phone on the plane.
He neither called nor sent a message.
I have neither climbed nor surfed before.
She has neither seen nor heard from him since May.
We have neither finished nor started the second part.
They have neither paid nor answered our emails.
Neither you nor I would like that.
Neither Tom nor Lisa came to the meeting.
Neither my phone nor my laptop works.
Neither my sister nor my cousin eats meat.
I like neither tea nor coffee.
The hotel had neither a pool nor a gym.
He speaks neither French nor German.
We saw neither lions nor elephants on the trip.
The room was neither clean nor comfortable.
The film was neither funny nor exciting.
The weather is neither hot nor cold today.
His answer was neither right nor wrong.
The cat was neither under the bed nor behind the sofa.
We found him neither at home nor at work.
The book is available neither in shops nor online.
She was happy neither in London nor in Paris.
Neither my brother nor my parents are at home.
Neither my parents nor my brother is at home.
Neither the teacher nor the students were ready.
Neither the manager nor his staff knows the answer.
Neither the shops nor the bank opens on Sundays.

examples.heading: ① neither + 動詞 + nor + 動詞

items.en: Visitors can neither touch nor photograph the paintings.
items.zh: 參觀的人不能摸這些畫，也不能拍照。

items.en: My grandfather can neither read nor write.
items.zh: 我爺爺不識字，也不會寫字。

items.en: The baby neither slept nor ate all day.
items.zh: 寶寶一整天沒睡覺，也沒吃東西。

items.en: You can neither smoke nor use your phone on the plane.
items.zh: 在飛機上你不能抽菸，也不能用手機。

items.en: He neither called nor sent a message.
items.zh: 他沒打電話，也沒傳訊息。

examples.heading: ② neither + 過去分詞 + nor + 過去分詞

items.en: I have neither climbed nor surfed before.
items.zh: 我以前沒攀岩過，也沒衝浪過。

items.en: She has neither seen nor heard from him since May.
items.zh: 她五月以後就沒見過他，也沒有他的消息。

items.en: We have neither finished nor started the second part.
items.zh: 第二部分我們沒做完，其實也還沒開始。

items.en: They have neither paid nor answered our emails.
items.zh: 他們沒付錢，也沒回我們的電子郵件。

examples.heading: ③ Neither + 名詞 + nor + 名詞 + 動詞

items.en: Neither you nor I would like that.
items.zh: 你和我都不會喜歡那樣。

items.en: Neither Tom nor Lisa came to the meeting.
items.zh: Tom 和 Lisa 都沒來開會。

items.en: Neither my phone nor my laptop works.
items.zh: 我的手機和筆電都不能用。

items.en: Neither my sister nor my cousin eats meat.
items.zh: 我姊姊和我表妹都不吃肉。

examples.heading: ④ 動詞 + neither + 名詞 + nor + 名詞

items.en: I like neither tea nor coffee.
items.zh: 茶和咖啡我都不喜歡。

items.en: The hotel had neither a pool nor a gym.
items.zh: 那家飯店沒有游泳池，也沒有健身房。

items.en: He speaks neither French nor German.
items.zh: 他不會說法語，也不會說德語。

items.en: We saw neither lions nor elephants on the trip.
items.zh: 這趟旅行我們沒看到獅子，也沒看到大象。

examples.heading: ⑤ be + neither + 形容詞 + nor + 形容詞

items.en: The room was neither clean nor comfortable.
items.zh: 房間不乾淨，也不舒服。

items.en: The film was neither funny nor exciting.
items.zh: 那部電影不好笑，也不刺激。

items.en: The weather is neither hot nor cold today.
items.zh: 今天天氣不熱也不冷。

items.en: His answer was neither right nor wrong.
items.zh: 他的答案不算對，也不算錯。

examples.heading: ⑥ neither + 介系詞片語 + nor + 介系詞片語

items.en: The cat was neither under the bed nor behind the sofa.
items.zh: 貓不在床底下，也不在沙發後面。

items.en: We found him neither at home nor at work.
items.zh: 我們在他家和公司都找不到他。

items.en: The book is available neither in shops nor online.
items.zh: 這本書在書店和網路上都買不到。

items.en: She was happy neither in London nor in Paris.
items.zh: 她在倫敦不快樂，在巴黎也不快樂。

examples.heading: ⑦ Neither A nor B + 動詞

items.en: Neither my brother nor my parents are at home.
items.zh: 我哥和我爸媽都不在家。

items.en: Neither my parents nor my brother is at home.
items.zh: 我爸媽和我哥都不在家。

items.en: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready.
items.zh: 老師和學生都還沒準備好。

items.en: Neither the manager nor his staff knows the answer.
items.zh: 經理和他的員工都不知道答案。

items.en: Neither the shops nor the bank opens on Sundays.
items.zh: 商店和銀行星期天都不開。

title: This book is not only a guide to the history of music but also a compendium of theory.
translation: 這本書不只是一本音樂史指南，也是一本樂理大全。
name: not only … but also 連接片語和子句
sentences: The festival is not only a celebration of local food but also a chance to meet the farmers.
Our new manager is not only an experienced engineer but also a patient teacher.
The report covers not only the costs of the project but also its effects on the community.
The city offers not only good jobs but also excellent public transport.
What surprised me was not only the size of the building but also its age.
The programme will not only train new staff but also support them in their first year.
Regular exercise can not only improve your health but also reduce stress.
The volunteers not only cleaned the beach but also planted trees along the road.
The new law will not only protect workers but also encourage companies to hire more people.
He not only repaired my bike but also refused to take any money.
The instructions were not only confusing but also incomplete.
Her latest novel is not only entertaining but also deeply moving.
The journey was not only long but also extremely uncomfortable.
The software is not only expensive but also difficult to install.
The song became popular not only in Britain but also in Japan and Brazil.
You can use the card not only in the canteen but also at the campus bookshop.
The problem affects people not only in cities but also in rural areas.
She is respected not only by her students but also by other teachers.
The hotel not only gave us a free upgrade, but it also paid for our taxi.
My grandfather not only built the house, but he also designed the garden.
The storm not only damaged the roof, but it also flooded the basement.
The company not only lost money last year, but it also lost several key clients.
The difference between the two phones is not only the price but the battery life.
The meal was not only cheap but delicious.
The change will affect not only students but their parents too.
If we move to the new premises, we can not only solve the problem of space, but also offer customers free parking.
The project aims not only to reduce traffic in the city centre but also to make the streets safer for cyclists.
The research shows not only that sleep affects memory, but also that a short nap can improve it.
Online courses give learners not only more flexibility but also access to teachers from around the world.
The museum's new wing provides not only more space for exhibitions but also a café and a children's area.

examples.heading: ① not only + 名詞片語 + but also + 名詞片語

items.en: The festival is not only a celebration of local food but also a chance to meet the farmers.
items.zh: 這個節慶不只是在地美食的慶典，也是和農夫見面的機會。

items.en: Our new manager is not only an experienced engineer but also a patient teacher.
items.zh: 我們的新經理不只是經驗豐富的工程師，也是有耐心的老師。

items.en: The report covers not only the costs of the project but also its effects on the community.
items.zh: 這份報告不只談計畫的成本，也談它對社區的影響。

items.en: The city offers not only good jobs but also excellent public transport.
items.zh: 這座城市不只有好工作，大眾運輸也很好。

items.en: What surprised me was not only the size of the building but also its age.
items.zh: 讓我驚訝的不只是那棟建築的大小，還有它的年代。

examples.heading: ② not only + 動詞片語 + but also + 動詞片語

items.en: The programme will not only train new staff but also support them in their first year.
items.zh: 這個計畫不只會訓練新員工，也會在他們第一年給予協助。

items.en: Regular exercise can not only improve your health but also reduce stress.
items.zh: 規律運動不只能改善健康，也能減輕壓力。

items.en: The volunteers not only cleaned the beach but also planted trees along the road.
items.zh: 志工不只清理了海灘，還在路邊種了樹。

items.en: The new law will not only protect workers but also encourage companies to hire more people.
items.zh: 新法律不只會保護勞工，也會鼓勵公司多僱人。

items.en: He not only repaired my bike but also refused to take any money.
items.zh: 他不只幫我修好了腳踏車，還不肯收錢。

examples.heading: ③ not only + 形容詞 + but also + 形容詞

items.en: The instructions were not only confusing but also incomplete.
items.zh: 說明不只讓人看不懂，也不完整。

items.en: Her latest novel is not only entertaining but also deeply moving.
items.zh: 她最新的小說不只好看，也非常感人。

items.en: The journey was not only long but also extremely uncomfortable.
items.zh: 那趟路程不只很長，也非常不舒服。

items.en: The software is not only expensive but also difficult to install.
items.zh: 這套軟體不只很貴，安裝也很麻煩。

examples.heading: ④ not only + 介系詞片語 + but also + 介系詞片語

items.en: The song became popular not only in Britain but also in Japan and Brazil.
items.zh: 這首歌不只在英國走紅，在日本和巴西也很紅。

items.en: You can use the card not only in the canteen but also at the campus bookshop.
items.zh: 這張卡不只能在餐廳用，也能在校園書店用。

items.en: The problem affects people not only in cities but also in rural areas.
items.zh: 這個問題不只影響城市的人，也影響鄉下的人。

items.en: She is respected not only by her students but also by other teachers.
items.zh: 她不只受學生尊敬，其他老師也尊敬她。

examples.heading: ⑤ but + 主詞 + also + 動詞

items.en: The hotel not only gave us a free upgrade, but it also paid for our taxi.
items.zh: 飯店不只免費幫我們升等，還幫我們付了計程車錢。

items.en: My grandfather not only built the house, but he also designed the garden.
items.zh: 我爺爺不只蓋了這棟房子，還設計了花園。

items.en: The storm not only damaged the roof, but it also flooded the basement.
items.zh: 暴風雨不只弄壞了屋頂，還淹了地下室。

items.en: The company not only lost money last year, but it also lost several key clients.
items.zh: 公司去年不只虧錢，還流失了好幾個重要客戶。

examples.heading: ⑥ 省略 also

items.en: The difference between the two phones is not only the price but the battery life.
items.zh: 兩支手機的差別不只是價錢，還有電池續航力。

items.en: The meal was not only cheap but delicious.
items.zh: 這頓飯不只便宜，還很好吃。

items.en: The change will affect not only students but their parents too.
items.zh: 這項改變不只影響學生，也會影響他們的家長。

examples.heading: ⑦ 正式書面語裡的長句

items.en: If we move to the new premises, we can not only solve the problem of space, but also offer customers free parking.
items.zh: 如果搬到新的辦公地點，我們不只能解決空間的問題，還能提供客人免費停車。

items.en: The project aims not only to reduce traffic in the city centre but also to make the streets safer for cyclists.
items.zh: 這個計畫不只要減少市中心的車流，也要讓街道對騎腳踏車的人更安全。

items.en: The research shows not only that sleep affects memory, but also that a short nap can improve it.
items.zh: 這項研究不只顯示睡眠會影響記憶，也顯示短暫的午睡能增強記憶。

items.en: Online courses give learners not only more flexibility but also access to teachers from around the world.
items.zh: 線上課程不只讓學習者更有彈性，也讓他們能接觸到世界各地的老師。

items.en: The museum's new wing provides not only more space for exhibitions but also a café and a children's area.
items.zh: 博物館的新館不只提供更多展覽空間，還有咖啡館和兒童區。

title: I would be more than pleased to have you at my home, plus you won't have to pay a thing!
translation: 我非常樂意讓你來我家，而且你一毛錢都不用花！
name: plus 連接子句
sentences: You should come and stay with us, plus you'll save money on hotels.
You can stay in our spare room, plus my mum will cook for you.
Join our team, plus you'll get a free T-shirt!
You can borrow my car, plus I'll fill it up for you.
It's around 200 pesos, so it's pretty cheap for a good game. Plus, it's really addictive!
The café has great coffee. Plus, the cakes are homemade.
This phone has a brilliant camera. Plus, the battery lasts two days.
You should try the yoga class. Plus, the first lesson is free.
It will be fun because everyone is going to be there. Plus, the park is the best place for a picnic.
I don't want to go out tonight. I'm really tired. Plus, it's raining.
Let's take the train. It's faster than the bus. Plus, we can read on the way.
I love living here. My job is close. Plus, I've made lots of friends.
The hotel is right on the beach, plus breakfast is included.
My new job pays well, plus I can work from home on Fridays.
The course is short, plus you get a certificate at the end.
The bike is light, plus it folds up small.
I can't stand my flat. It's too small. Plus, the neighbours are noisy.
I didn't enjoy the trip. The weather was awful. Plus, I lost my camera.
We left the restaurant early. The food was cold. Plus, the music was too loud.
I don't want that job. The hours are long. Plus, it's a long way from home.
You should go to bed early. You have an exam tomorrow. Plus, you look tired.
Don't buy a new laptop yet. Yours still works. Plus, prices will drop next month.
Take an umbrella. It's cloudy. Plus, the forecast says rain later.
Walk to work. It's good exercise. Plus, you won't have to find a parking space.
Thanks for the lovely present! Plus, the card made me laugh.
Can't wait to see you! Plus, I've got some big news to tell you.
The weather here is amazing. Plus, the food is incredible.
Sorry I missed your call. I was driving. Plus, my phone was on silent.
The kids loved the zoo, plus they slept all the way home.
We found a great flat, plus it's only five minutes from the station.

examples.heading: ① 邀請 + plus + 好處

items.en: You should come and stay with us, plus you'll save money on hotels.
items.zh: 你應該來我們家住，而且可以省下住飯店的錢。

items.en: You can stay in our spare room, plus my mum will cook for you.
items.zh: 你可以住我們的客房，而且我媽會煮飯給你吃。

items.en: Join our team, plus you'll get a free T-shirt!
items.zh: 加入我們的隊伍，而且還會送你一件 T 恤！

items.en: You can borrow my car, plus I'll fill it up for you.
items.zh: 你可以借我的車，而且我會幫你把油加滿。

examples.heading: ② 推薦 + Plus, + 另一個好處

items.en: It's around 200 pesos, so it's pretty cheap for a good game. Plus, it's really addictive!
items.zh: 它大概 200 披索，以一款好遊戲來說滿便宜的。而且真的很容易上癮！

items.en: The café has great coffee. Plus, the cakes are homemade.
items.zh: 那家咖啡館的咖啡很好喝。而且蛋糕都是自己做的。

items.en: This phone has a brilliant camera. Plus, the battery lasts two days.
items.zh: 這支手機的相機很棒。而且電池可以撐兩天。

items.en: You should try the yoga class. Plus, the first lesson is free.
items.zh: 你應該去上那堂瑜伽課。而且第一堂課免費。

examples.heading: ③ 理由 + Plus, + 另一個理由

items.en: It will be fun because everyone is going to be there. Plus, the park is the best place for a picnic.
items.zh: 會很好玩，因為大家都會去。而且公園是野餐最好的地方。

items.en: I don't want to go out tonight. I'm really tired. Plus, it's raining.
items.zh: 我今晚不想出去。我很累。而且外面在下雨。

items.en: Let's take the train. It's faster than the bus. Plus, we can read on the way.
items.zh: 我們搭火車吧。火車比公車快。而且路上可以看書。

items.en: I love living here. My job is close. Plus, I've made lots of friends.
items.zh: 我很喜歡住在這裡。我上班的地方很近。而且我交了很多朋友。

examples.heading: ④ 子句 + , plus + 子句

items.en: The hotel is right on the beach, plus breakfast is included.
items.zh: 飯店就在海灘上，而且有附早餐。

items.en: My new job pays well, plus I can work from home on Fridays.
items.zh: 我的新工作薪水不錯，而且星期五可以在家上班。

items.en: The course is short, plus you get a certificate at the end.
items.zh: 這門課很短，而且結束時會拿到證書。

items.en: The bike is light, plus it folds up small.
items.zh: 這台腳踏車很輕，而且可以折得很小。

examples.heading: ⑤ 抱怨 + Plus, + 另一個缺點

items.en: I can't stand my flat. It's too small. Plus, the neighbours are noisy.
items.zh: 我受不了我的公寓。太小了。而且鄰居很吵。

items.en: I didn't enjoy the trip. The weather was awful. Plus, I lost my camera.
items.zh: 我這趟旅行玩得不開心。天氣很糟。而且我把相機弄丟了。

items.en: We left the restaurant early. The food was cold. Plus, the music was too loud.
items.zh: 我們提早離開餐廳。菜是冷的。而且音樂太大聲。

items.en: I don't want that job. The hours are long. Plus, it's a long way from home.
items.zh: 我不想要那份工作。工時很長。而且離家很遠。

examples.heading: ⑥ 勸說 + Plus, + 補充

items.en: You should go to bed early. You have an exam tomorrow. Plus, you look tired.
items.zh: 你應該早點睡。你明天要考試。而且你看起來很累。

items.en: Don't buy a new laptop yet. Yours still works. Plus, prices will drop next month.
items.zh: 先別買新筆電。你的還能用。而且下個月會降價。

items.en: Take an umbrella. It's cloudy. Plus, the forecast says rain later.
items.zh: 帶把傘吧。天氣陰陰的。而且氣象預報說等一下會下雨。

items.en: Walk to work. It's good exercise. Plus, you won't have to find a parking space.
items.zh: 走路去上班吧。這是很好的運動。而且你不用找停車位。

examples.heading: ⑦ 訊息和電子郵件裡的 plus

items.en: Thanks for the lovely present! Plus, the card made me laugh.
items.zh: 謝謝你送的禮物，我好喜歡！而且那張卡片讓我笑了。

items.en: Can't wait to see you! Plus, I've got some big news to tell you.
items.zh: 好期待見到你！而且我有個大消息要告訴你。

items.en: The weather here is amazing. Plus, the food is incredible.
items.zh: 這裡天氣超好。而且東西超好吃。

items.en: Sorry I missed your call. I was driving. Plus, my phone was on silent.
items.zh: 抱歉沒接到你的電話。我在開車。而且我的手機調成靜音了。

items.en: The kids loved the zoo, plus they slept all the way home.
items.zh: 孩子們很喜歡動物園，而且回家的路上全程都在睡。

items.en: We found a great flat, plus it's only five minutes from the station.
items.zh: 我們找到一間很棒的公寓，而且離車站只要五分鐘。

title: This college is famous for its art teachers and very skilled students, and yet it does not have its own gallery.
translation: 這所學院以美術老師和技術高超的學生出名，但它卻沒有自己的展覽館。
name: 連接詞 yet 表示讓步
sentences: The host family was carefully selected, yet it was four miles away from school.
She had studied for weeks, yet she still felt nervous before the interview.
The restaurant looks expensive from outside, yet the prices are quite reasonable.
We left home two hours early, yet we nearly missed the flight.
The report was carefully checked, yet it still contained several errors.
He grew up by the sea, yet he never learned to swim.
Our team trained every day, and yet we lost the final match.
The town has two big hotels, and yet tourists often cannot find a room in summer.
I explained the rules twice, and yet some players still got them wrong.
The company made a large profit last year, and yet it cut staff salaries.
She lives only a few minutes from the office, and yet she is late almost every day.
The film had a huge budget, and yet the special effects looked cheap.
The lecture was long yet never boring.
It was a small yet very friendly hotel near the station.
Her speech was funny yet moving.
The new phone is light yet strong.
The old castle looked dark yet beautiful in the evening light.
He gave a polite yet firm answer.
The doctor spoke slowly yet confidently.
The plan worked well in theory yet badly in practice.
He drove carefully yet quickly through the busy streets.
The changes were introduced gradually yet steadily.
The exam looked easy, yet only half the class passed.
Nobody expected him to win, yet he came first.
The shop was in a quiet street, yet it was always full of customers.
The house was very old, and yet everything in it worked perfectly.
The hotel was beautiful. Yet the service was disappointing.
Most people said the project would fail. Yet it was a great success.
The museum is free. Yet very few local people visit it.
Our garden is narrow but full of flowers.
The flat is small yet surprisingly comfortable.
The bag isn't black but dark blue.
He is rich, yet he lives in a tiny flat.

examples.heading: ① 子句 + , yet + 子句

items.en: The host family was carefully selected, yet it was four miles away from school.
items.zh: 寄宿家庭是仔細挑過的，卻離學校四英里遠。

items.en: She had studied for weeks, yet she still felt nervous before the interview.
items.zh: 她準備了好幾個星期，面試前還是很緊張。

items.en: The restaurant looks expensive from outside, yet the prices are quite reasonable.
items.zh: 這家餐廳從外面看很貴，價錢卻很合理。

items.en: We left home two hours early, yet we nearly missed the flight.
items.zh: 我們提早兩個小時出門，卻差點趕不上飛機。

items.en: The report was carefully checked, yet it still contained several errors.
items.zh: 報告仔細檢查過了，卻還是有好幾個錯誤。

items.en: He grew up by the sea, yet he never learned to swim.
items.zh: 他在海邊長大，卻一直沒學會游泳。

examples.heading: ② 子句 + , and yet + 子句

items.en: Our team trained every day, and yet we lost the final match.
items.zh: 我們隊每天訓練，最後的決賽卻輸了。

items.en: The town has two big hotels, and yet tourists often cannot find a room in summer.
items.zh: 鎮上有兩家大飯店，夏天觀光客卻常常訂不到房間。

items.en: I explained the rules twice, and yet some players still got them wrong.
items.zh: 規則我講了兩次，還是有些選手搞錯。

items.en: The company made a large profit last year, and yet it cut staff salaries.
items.zh: 公司去年賺了很多錢，卻還是減了員工的薪水。

items.en: She lives only a few minutes from the office, and yet she is late almost every day.
items.zh: 她住的地方離辦公室只要幾分鐘，卻幾乎每天遲到。

items.en: The film had a huge budget, and yet the special effects looked cheap.
items.zh: 那部電影預算很高，特效看起來卻很廉價。

examples.heading: ③ 形容詞 + yet + 形容詞

items.en: The lecture was long yet never boring.
items.zh: 那堂課很長，卻一點也不無聊。

items.en: It was a small yet very friendly hotel near the station.
items.zh: 那是車站附近一家小而很親切的旅館。

items.en: Her speech was funny yet moving.
items.zh: 她的演講很好笑，卻也讓人感動。

items.en: The new phone is light yet strong.
items.zh: 新手機很輕，卻很堅固。

items.en: The old castle looked dark yet beautiful in the evening light.
items.zh: 傍晚的光線裡，古堡看起來陰暗卻美麗。

items.en: He gave a polite yet firm answer.
items.zh: 他給了一個客氣卻堅定的回答。

examples.heading: ④ 副詞或片語 + yet + 副詞或片語

items.en: The doctor spoke slowly yet confidently.
items.zh: 醫生說話很慢，卻很有把握。

items.en: The plan worked well in theory yet badly in practice.
items.zh: 這個計畫在理論上可行，實際做起來卻很糟。

items.en: He drove carefully yet quickly through the busy streets.
items.zh: 他在熱鬧的街上開得小心卻很快。

items.en: The changes were introduced gradually yet steadily.
items.zh: 這些改變是慢慢地、卻穩定地推行的。

examples.heading: ⑤ yet 帶出出乎意料的結果

items.en: The exam looked easy, yet only half the class passed.
items.zh: 考試看起來很簡單，卻只有半班的人及格。

items.en: Nobody expected him to win, yet he came first.
items.zh: 沒有人覺得他會贏，他卻得了第一名。

items.en: The shop was in a quiet street, yet it was always full of customers.
items.zh: 那家店在一條安靜的街上，卻總是擠滿了客人。

items.en: The house was very old, and yet everything in it worked perfectly.
items.zh: 那棟房子很舊，裡面的東西卻都很好用。

examples.heading: ⑥ yet 放在句首

items.en: The hotel was beautiful. Yet the service was disappointing.
items.zh: 飯店很漂亮，服務卻令人失望。

items.en: Most people said the project would fail. Yet it was a great success.
items.zh: 大多數人說這個計畫會失敗，結果卻很成功。

items.en: The museum is free. Yet very few local people visit it.
items.zh: 博物館不收門票，卻很少有當地人去參觀。

examples.heading: ⑦ yet 和 but 的比較

items.en: Our garden is narrow but full of flowers.
items.zh: 我們的花園很窄，但種滿了花。

items.en: The flat is small yet surprisingly comfortable.
items.zh: 這間公寓很小，卻出乎意料地舒服。

items.en: The bag isn't black but dark blue.
items.zh: 這個包包不是黑色的，是深藍色的。

items.en: He is rich, yet he lives in a tiny flat.
items.zh: 他很有錢，卻住在一間很小的公寓。

title: I like chicken and rice.
translation: 我喜歡雞肉和米飯。
name: 對等連接詞連接單字
sentences: For breakfast I usually have toast and jam.
My mum and dad work at the same hospital.
We need some paper and a pen for the test.
On Monday and Wednesday I have English and maths.
Tom and his brother play football every Saturday afternoon.
In the garden there are roses and tulips.
The beach was clean and quiet this morning.
My grandmother is kind and funny.
The soup is hot and spicy, so be careful.
The puppy next door is small and noisy at night.
After the long walk, I was tired and hungry.
The flat is small but cheap.
The hike up the hill was steep but short.
My laptop is heavy but fast, so I still use it for work.
The museum was interesting but very crowded.
Our car is slow but comfortable, so we take it on long trips.
Would you like orange juice or apple juice?
We can meet on Saturday or Sunday.
Do you want a sandwich or a salad for lunch?
You can pay by cash or card at the front desk.
My sister wants a cat or a rabbit for her birthday.
Do you like your tea hot or cold?
Is the new film good or bad?
I don't know if the answer is right or wrong.
Are the shoes too big or too small?
I don't eat meat or fish.
My brother doesn't like milk or cheese.
There isn't any sugar or salt in this cake.
I like to eat soup, eggs, meat and salad.
Our flag is red, white and blue.
You can choose pizza, pasta or a burger.
The room was bright, warm and clean.

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + and + 名詞

items.en: For breakfast I usually have toast and jam.
items.zh: 我早餐通常吃吐司配果醬。

items.en: My mum and dad work at the same hospital.
items.zh: 我爸媽在同一家醫院上班。

items.en: We need some paper and a pen for the test.
items.zh: 考試要帶紙和一支筆。

items.en: On Monday and Wednesday I have English and maths.
items.zh: 星期一和星期三我有英文課和數學課。

items.en: Tom and his brother play football every Saturday afternoon.
items.zh: Tom 和他弟弟每個星期六下午都去踢足球。

items.en: In the garden there are roses and tulips.
items.zh: 花園裡有玫瑰和鬱金香。

examples.heading: ② 形容詞 + and + 形容詞

items.en: The beach was clean and quiet this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上海灘又乾淨又安靜。

items.en: My grandmother is kind and funny.
items.zh: 我奶奶人很好，又很風趣。

items.en: The soup is hot and spicy, so be careful.
items.zh: 湯又燙又辣，喝的時候小心。

items.en: The puppy next door is small and noisy at night.
items.zh: 隔壁的小狗個子小，晚上又很吵。

items.en: After the long walk, I was tired and hungry.
items.zh: 走了一大段路之後，我又累又餓。

examples.heading: ③ 形容詞 + but + 形容詞

items.en: The flat is small but cheap.
items.zh: 這間公寓很小，但是很便宜。

items.en: The hike up the hill was steep but short.
items.zh: 上山的路很陡，但是不長。

items.en: My laptop is heavy but fast, so I still use it for work.
items.zh: 我的筆電很重，但是跑得很快，所以我還拿它來工作。

items.en: The museum was interesting but very crowded.
items.zh: 博物館很有趣，但是人很多。

items.en: Our car is slow but comfortable, so we take it on long trips.
items.zh: 我們的車開不快，但是坐起來很舒服，所以長途旅行都開它。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞 + or + 名詞

items.en: Would you like orange juice or apple juice?
items.zh: 你要柳橙汁還是蘋果汁？

items.en: We can meet on Saturday or Sunday.
items.zh: 我們可以星期六或星期天見面。

items.en: Do you want a sandwich or a salad for lunch?
items.zh: 你午餐要吃三明治還是沙拉？

items.en: You can pay by cash or card at the front desk.
items.zh: 你可以在櫃台付現金或刷卡。

items.en: My sister wants a cat or a rabbit for her birthday.
items.zh: 我妹妹生日想要一隻貓或一隻兔子。

examples.heading: ⑤ 形容詞 + or + 形容詞

items.en: Do you like your tea hot or cold?
items.zh: 你的茶要熱的還是冰的？

items.en: Is the new film good or bad?
items.zh: 那部新電影好看還是不好看？

items.en: I don't know if the answer is right or wrong.
items.zh: 我不知道答案是對是錯。

items.en: Are the shoes too big or too small?
items.zh: 這雙鞋太大還是太小？

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句 + or

items.en: I don't eat meat or fish.
items.zh: 我不吃肉，也不吃魚。

items.en: My brother doesn't like milk or cheese.
items.zh: 我哥不喜歡牛奶，也不喜歡起司。

items.en: There isn't any sugar or salt in this cake.
items.zh: 這個蛋糕裡沒有放糖，也沒有放鹽。

examples.heading: ⑦ 連接兩個以上的字

items.en: I like to eat soup, eggs, meat and salad.
items.zh: 我喜歡吃湯、蛋、肉和沙拉。

items.en: Our flag is red, white and blue.
items.zh: 我們的國旗是紅、白、藍三色。

items.en: You can choose pizza, pasta or a burger.
items.zh: 你可以選披薩、義大利麵或漢堡。

items.en: The room was bright, warm and clean.
items.zh: 房間明亮、溫暖又乾淨。

title: It is very small, but it is very easy to clean.
translation: 它很小，但打掃起來很容易。
name: but 表示出乎意料的對比
sentences: I really like my home. It is very small, but it is very easy to clean.
The village is far from the city, but the air is really clean.
The kitchen is tiny, but we cook big meals in it every weekend.
The old bike is heavy, but it never breaks down.
Our flat has no garden, but the park is just across the road.
The restaurant is very popular, but the food is not very good.
The new phone looks great, but the battery doesn't last long.
My neighbours are friendly, but they are very noisy at night.
The city is beautiful, but it is very expensive to live there.
My home is small but so comfortable.
The test was short but really difficult.
My grandfather is old but very active.
The path was narrow but safe.
I studied all night, but I still failed the exam.
We ran to the station, but we missed the train.
She looked everywhere, but she couldn't find her keys.
I followed the recipe carefully, but the cake didn't rise.
It was very cold, but the children played outside all day.
He was very tired, but he finished his homework.
The tickets were expensive, but we bought them anyway.
My brother hates vegetables, but he ate all his salad.
He is very rich, but he is not happy.
My aunt is a chef, but she never cooks at home.
Tom lives next to the sea, but he can't swim.
My cousin is only twelve, but he speaks four languages.
The hotel was cheap, but it was still very clean.
I've lived here for ten years, but I still get lost.
The town is quiet, but it also has some good bars.
The exercise looks easy, but it is actually quite hard.
My car is twenty years old, but it still runs perfectly.

examples.heading: ① 缺點 + but + 優點

items.en: I really like my home. It is very small, but it is very easy to clean.
items.zh: 我真的很喜歡我家。它很小，但打掃起來很容易。

items.en: The village is far from the city, but the air is really clean.
items.zh: 那個村子離城市很遠，但是空氣很乾淨。

items.en: The kitchen is tiny, but we cook big meals in it every weekend.
items.zh: 廚房很小，但是我們每個週末都在裡面煮一大桌菜。

items.en: The old bike is heavy, but it never breaks down.
items.zh: 那台舊腳踏車很重，但是從來沒壞過。

items.en: Our flat has no garden, but the park is just across the road.
items.zh: 我們的公寓沒有花園，但是公園就在對面。

examples.heading: ② 優點 + but + 缺點

items.en: The restaurant is very popular, but the food is not very good.
items.zh: 那家餐廳很受歡迎，但是東西不太好吃。

items.en: The new phone looks great, but the battery doesn't last long.
items.zh: 新手機看起來很棒，但是電池不耐用。

items.en: My neighbours are friendly, but they are very noisy at night.
items.zh: 我的鄰居很友善，但是晚上很吵。

items.en: The city is beautiful, but it is very expensive to live there.
items.zh: 那個城市很漂亮，但是住在那裡很貴。

examples.heading: ③ 形容詞 + but + 形容詞

items.en: My home is small but so comfortable.
items.zh: 我家很小，但是非常舒服。

items.en: The test was short but really difficult.
items.zh: 考試很短，但是很難。

items.en: My grandfather is old but very active.
items.zh: 我爺爺年紀大了，但是很有活力。

items.en: The path was narrow but safe.
items.zh: 那條小路很窄，但是很安全。

examples.heading: ④ 努力 + but + 沒有預期的結果

items.en: I studied all night, but I still failed the exam.
items.zh: 我念了一整晚，但是考試還是沒過。

items.en: We ran to the station, but we missed the train.
items.zh: 我們跑去車站，但是還是錯過了火車。

items.en: She looked everywhere, but she couldn't find her keys.
items.zh: 她到處都找了，但是找不到鑰匙。

items.en: I followed the recipe carefully, but the cake didn't rise.
items.zh: 我很仔細地照著食譜做，但是蛋糕沒有發起來。

examples.heading: ⑤ 情況 + but + 相反的行動

items.en: It was very cold, but the children played outside all day.
items.zh: 天氣很冷，但是孩子們在外面玩了一整天。

items.en: He was very tired, but he finished his homework.
items.zh: 他很累，但是他還是寫完了功課。

items.en: The tickets were expensive, but we bought them anyway.
items.zh: 票很貴，但是我們還是買了。

items.en: My brother hates vegetables, but he ate all his salad.
items.zh: 我弟弟討厭蔬菜，但是他把沙拉全吃完了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 身分 + but + 出乎意料的事

items.en: He is very rich, but he is not happy.
items.zh: 他很有錢，但是不快樂。

items.en: My aunt is a chef, but she never cooks at home.
items.zh: 我阿姨是廚師，但是她在家從來不煮飯。

items.en: Tom lives next to the sea, but he can't swim.
items.zh: Tom 住在海邊，但是他不會游泳。

items.en: My cousin is only twelve, but he speaks four languages.
items.zh: 我表弟才十二歲，但是他會說四種語言。

examples.heading: ⑦ but + still、also

items.en: The hotel was cheap, but it was still very clean.
items.zh: 飯店很便宜，但是還是很乾淨。

items.en: I've lived here for ten years, but I still get lost.
items.zh: 我住在這裡十年了，但是還是會迷路。

items.en: The town is quiet, but it also has some good bars.
items.zh: 那個小鎮很安靜，但是也有幾家不錯的酒吧。

items.en: The exercise looks easy, but it is actually quite hard.
items.zh: 這個運動看起來很簡單，但是其實滿難的。

items.en: My car is twenty years old, but it still runs perfectly.
items.zh: 我的車二十年了，但是還是跑得很好。

title: I like to eat chicken, mushrooms and some vegetables.
translation: 我喜歡吃雞肉、蘑菇和一些蔬菜。
name: and、or 放在列舉的最後一項前

You can choose chocolate, vanilla or strawberry ice cream.
We can meet on Monday, Wednesday or Friday.
Bring a jacket, a coat or a warm jumper.
I go to college every Tuesday, Thursday and Friday morning.
The museum is open on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.
We have English in June, July and August.
My sister swims on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays.
My new neighbours are young, friendly and very helpful.
The weather was cold, wet and windy all week.
Her flat is small, bright and very clean.

You can read a book, draw a picture or play outside.
I have three rooms: a kitchen, a living room and a bathroom.
I speak four languages: English, French, German and Spanish.
We need three things: eggs, flour and sugar.
You can pay in three ways: by cash, by card or by phone.
I don't like carrots, onions or peppers.
There is no bread, milk or butter in the fridge.
My little brother can't read, write or count yet.

She never eats sweets, cakes or biscuits.

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + and

items.en: In my bag I have a book, a pen and an apple.
items.zh: 我的包包裡有一本書、一支筆和一顆蘋果。

items.en: I really like the students from Italy, Portugal, China and India.
items.zh: 我很喜歡那些從義大利、葡萄牙、中國和印度來的同學。

items.en: For the picnic we need sandwiches, fruit, juice and a blanket.
items.zh: 野餐要帶三明治、水果、果汁和一條毯子。

items.en: My aunt has two dogs, three cats and a parrot.
items.zh: 我阿姨養了兩隻狗、三隻貓和一隻鸚鵡。

items.en: We visited Rome, Florence and Venice on our holiday.
items.zh: 我們度假時去了羅馬、佛羅倫斯和威尼斯。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + or

items.en: I like to eat steak, vegetables, potatoes or rice.
items.zh: 我喜歡吃牛排、蔬菜、馬鈴薯或米飯。

items.en: You can choose chocolate, vanilla or strawberry ice cream.
items.zh: 你可以選巧克力、香草或草莓冰淇淋。

items.en: We can meet on Monday, Wednesday or Friday.
items.zh: 我們可以星期一、星期三或星期五見面。

items.en: Bring a jacket, a coat or a warm jumper.
items.zh: 帶一件夾克、一件大衣或一件保暖的毛衣。

examples.heading: ③ 時間 + and

items.en: I go to college every Tuesday, Thursday and Friday morning.
items.zh: 我每個星期二、星期四和星期五早上去學院上課。

items.en: The museum is open on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.
items.zh: 博物館星期六、星期天和國定假日有開。

items.en: We have English in June, July and August.
items.zh: 我們六月、七月和八月有英文課。

items.en: My sister swims on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays.
items.zh: 我妹妹每個星期一、星期三和星期六游泳。

examples.heading: ④ 形容詞 + and

items.en: My new neighbours are young, friendly and very helpful.
items.zh: 我的新鄰居年輕、友善，而且很熱心。

items.en: The weather was cold, wet and windy all week.
items.zh: 整個星期天氣又冷又濕又颳風。

items.en: Her flat is small, bright and very clean.
items.zh: 她的公寓小小的，很明亮，也很乾淨。

items.en: The film was long, slow and a bit boring.
items.zh: 那部電影很長、節奏很慢，還有點無聊。

examples.heading: ⑤ 動詞片語 + and、or

items.en: In the evening I cook dinner, wash the dishes and watch TV.
items.zh: 晚上我煮晚餐、洗碗，然後看電視。

items.en: At the weekend we go swimming, play tennis or visit friends.
items.zh: 週末我們去游泳、打網球或去拜訪朋友。

items.en: Every morning she gets up, has a shower and drinks a coffee.
items.zh: 她每天早上起床、洗澡，然後喝一杯咖啡。

items.en: You can read a book, draw a picture or play outside.
items.zh: 你可以看書、畫畫或去外面玩。

examples.heading: ⑥ 冒號 + 列舉

items.en: I have three rooms: a kitchen, a living room and a bathroom.
items.zh: 我有三個房間：廚房、客廳和浴室。

items.en: I speak four languages: English, French, German and Spanish.
items.zh: 我會說四種語言：英語、法語、德語和西班牙語。

items.en: We need three things: eggs, flour and sugar.
items.zh: 我們需要三樣東西：蛋、麵粉和糖。

items.en: You can pay in three ways: by cash, by card or by phone.
items.zh: 你可以用三種方式付款：付現、刷卡或用手機。

examples.heading: ⑦ 否定句 + or

items.en: I don't like carrots, onions or peppers.
items.zh: 我不喜歡胡蘿蔔、洋蔥，也不喜歡甜椒。

items.en: There is no bread, milk or butter in the fridge.
items.zh: 冰箱裡沒有麵包、牛奶，也沒有奶油。

items.en: My little brother can't read, write or count yet.
items.zh: 我弟弟還不會讀、不會寫，也不會數數。

items.en: We didn't see any lions, tigers or elephants at the zoo.
items.zh: 我們在動物園沒看到獅子、老虎，也沒看到大象。

items.en: She never eats sweets, cakes or biscuits.
items.zh: 她從來不吃糖果、蛋糕或餅乾。

title: All my friends gave me a present, but the one I liked best was John's.
translation: 我的朋友每個人都送了我禮物，不過我最喜歡的是 John 送的那份。
name: 省略關係代名詞的限定關係子句

Is this the bus you were waiting for?

I lost the notebook I wrote all my passwords in.
The people we stayed with in Kyoto were really kind.
This isn't the one I ordered.
You can have everything you want from the fridge.
Is there anything you'd like me to pick up from the supermarket?
That's all the cash I have on me right now.

examples.heading: ① 子句在主詞後面

items.en: The film we saw last night was really scary.
items.zh: 我們昨晚看的電影好恐怖。

items.en: The sandals I ordered from that website fell apart in a week.
items.zh: 我跟那個網站訂的涼鞋一個禮拜就壞了。

items.en: The teacher everyone loved retired last year.
items.zh: 大家都喜歡的那位老師去年退休了。

items.en: The bread my grandmother bakes is better than anything in the shops.
items.zh: 我奶奶烤的麵包比店裡賣的都好吃。

items.en: The questions they asked in the interview were very difficult.
items.zh: 他們面試時問的問題很難。

items.en: The hotel we booked for our honeymoon had a view of the sea.
items.zh: 我們蜜月訂的飯店看得到海。

examples.heading: ② 子句在句尾

items.en: Did you get the message I sent you?
items.zh: 你收到我傳給你的訊息了嗎？

items.en: I can't remember the name of the song you played.
items.zh: 我記不得你放的那首歌的名字。

items.en: She married a man she met on holiday in Greece.
items.zh: 她嫁給了她在希臘度假時認識的男人。

items.en: We finally found the restaurant my cousin recommended.
items.zh: 我們終於找到我表姊推薦的那家餐廳了。

items.en: Here's the money I owe you.
items.zh: 這是我欠你的錢。

items.en: Let's watch the documentary your brother told us about.
items.zh: 我們來看你哥哥跟我們說的那部紀錄片吧。

examples.heading: ③ 子句動詞後面接介系詞

items.en: Is this the bus you were waiting for?
items.zh: 這是你在等的公車嗎？

items.en: The flat we're living in has no heating.
items.zh: 我們住的公寓沒有暖氣。

items.en: That's the student I was telling you about.
items.zh: 那就是我跟你說過的那個學生。

items.en: I lost the notebook I wrote all my passwords in.
items.zh: 我把寫了所有密碼的筆記本弄丟了。

items.en: The people we stayed with in Kyoto were really kind.
items.zh: 我們在京都借住的那家人很親切。

examples.heading: ④ the one / everything / something + 子句

items.en: This isn't the one I ordered.
items.zh: 這不是我點的那個。

items.en: You can have everything you want from the fridge.
items.zh: 冰箱裡你想吃什麼都可以拿。

items.en: Is there anything you'd like me to pick up from the supermarket?
items.zh: 你有什麼要我從超市順便帶回來的嗎？

items.en: That's all the cash I have on me right now.
items.zh: 我身上現在就只有這些現金。

items.en: Tell me something you've never told anyone.
items.zh: 告訴我一件你從來沒跟別人說過的事。

items.en: The thing I miss most about Tainan is the street food.
items.zh: 我最懷念台南的是那裡的小吃。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: The jacket you lent me kept me warm all evening.
items.zh: 你借我的外套讓我整晚都很暖和。

items.en: Everyone liked the cake you made for Ben's party.
items.zh: 大家都喜歡你為 Ben 的派對做的蛋糕。

items.en: The best advice my father ever gave me was to save money.
items.zh: 我爸爸給過我最好的建議是存錢。

items.en: He's the most gregarious person I've ever worked with.
items.zh: 他是我共事過最愛交朋友的人。

items.en: The emails you sent last week never arrived.
items.zh: 你上個禮拜寄的電子郵件一直都沒到。

items.en: The language I find hardest is German.
items.zh: 我覺得最難的語言是德文。

items.en: Where are the photos you took at the beach?
items.zh: 你在海邊拍的照片在哪裡？

title: I like it because it is an interesting place.
translation: 我喜歡那裡，因為那是一個很有意思的地方。

examples.heading: ② an + 形容詞 + 名詞：家和房間

items.en: It's an old house, about fifty years old.
items.zh: 那是一棟老房子，大概五十年了。

items.en: We have an empty room upstairs.
items.zh: 我們樓上有一間空房間。

items.en: My grandmother has an amazing garden.
items.zh: 我奶奶有一座很棒的花園。

items.en: He lives in an ugly building next to the station.

examples.heading: ③ 介紹人

items.zh: Sam 讀小學時是個很害羞的孩子。

items.en: The man next door is a friendly neighbour.
items.zh: 隔壁那位先生是個很友善的鄰居。

items.en: She is an excellent cook.
items.zh: 她很會做菜。

items.en: He is an honest man.
items.zh: 他是個誠實的人。

items.en: My dad is a busy doctor.
items.zh: 我爸爸是個很忙的醫生。

examples.heading: ④ 說吃的東西

items.zh: 放學後我通常會很快吃個點心。

items.en: I had a big breakfast this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早餐吃很多。

items.en: She ordered an ice cream with chocolate sauce.
items.zh: 她點了一份淋巧克力醬的冰淇淋。

items.en: We had a delicious lunch at the new restaurant.

items.en: This is an easy recipe for soup.
items.zh: 這是一個很簡單的湯的食譜。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說地方

items.en: In Kyoto we visited a famous temple.
items.zh: 我們在京都參觀了一間有名的寺廟。

items.en: We went to an old castle on Sunday.
items.zh: 我們星期天去了一座古堡。

items.en: It's a popular beach in summer.
items.zh: 那是夏天很熱門的海灘。

items.en: There's an Italian café near my office.
items.zh: 我公司附近有一家義大利咖啡館。

items.en: They live in a small village in the mountains.
items.zh: 他們住在山裡的一個小村莊。

examples.heading: ⑥ 說東西

items.en: I want a red bike for my birthday.
items.zh: 我生日想要一台紅色的腳踏車。

items.en: He has an expensive watch.
items.zh: 他有一支很貴的手錶。

items.en: This is a useful book for beginners.
items.zh: 這是一本適合初學者的實用書。

items.en: My aunt sent me an orange scarf from Spain.
items.zh: 我阿姨從西班牙寄給我一條橘色圍巾。

items.en: Dad keeps a sharp knife in the top drawer.
items.zh: 爸爸把一把很利的刀放在最上面的抽屜。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說時間和活動

items.zh: 昨天對我們隊來說是很糟的一天。

items.zh: 今天上班的時間好長。

items.zh: 明天我們得搭一早的火車去里茲。
