items.zh: 我姪女六歲時就是個很聰明的女孩。

items.en: For a beginner like me, Mr Wong is a very patient piano teacher.
items.zh: 對我這種初學者來說，黃老師是一位很有耐心的鋼琴老師。

examples.heading: ② 說地方

items.en: The lake behind our cottage is a very beautiful place for a walk.
items.zh: 我們小屋後面的湖是一個很適合散步的美麗地方。

items.en: On Friday nights the old harbour becomes a very lively area.
items.zh: 每個星期五晚上，舊港區會變得很熱鬧。

items.en: We stayed in a very small hotel by the lake.
items.zh: 我們住在湖邊一家很小的旅館。

items.en: This is a very busy road in the morning.
items.zh: 這條路早上車很多。

items.en: They live in a very quiet area.
items.zh: 他們住在很安靜的地區。

examples.heading: ③ a very + 母音開頭的形容詞

items.en: It's a very old church, from the twelfth century.
items.zh: 那是一座很古老的教堂，十二世紀蓋的。

items.en: Our guide gave a very interesting talk about the castle.
items.zh: 導遊介紹城堡，講得很有意思。

items.en: At the campfire Ben shared a very exciting story about bears.
items.zh: 在營火旁，Ben 講了一個關於熊的很刺激的故事。

items.en: Number five on the test was a very easy question.
items.zh: 考卷上的第五題很簡單。

items.en: She has a very unusual name.
items.zh: 她的名字很特別。

examples.heading: ④ 說東西

items.en: The guest room has a very comfortable bed and a desk.
items.zh: 客房有一張很舒服的床和一張書桌。

items.en: My cousin bought a very fast motorbike last month.
items.zh: 我表哥上個月買了一台很快的機車。

items.en: My boss carries a very expensive phone in a leather case.
items.zh: 我老闆把一支很貴的手機放在皮套裡。

items.en: My sister gave me a very pretty necklace.
items.zh: 我姊姊送我一條很漂亮的項鍊。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說吃的東西

items.en: We had a very good dinner at Maria's house.
items.zh: 我們在 Maria 家吃了一頓很棒的晚餐。

items.en: Be careful. Raj has made a very hot curry tonight.
items.zh: 小心，Raj 今晚煮了很辣的咖哩。

items.en: I'd like a very small piece of cake, please.
items.zh: 請給我很小一塊蛋糕就好。

items.en: Jake baked a very sweet cake for the picnic.
items.zh: Jake 為野餐烤了一個很甜的蛋糕。

examples.heading: ⑥ 說時間和經驗

items.en: From Lisbon to Moscow by train would be a very long journey.
items.zh: 從里斯本搭火車到莫斯科會是一趟很長的路程。

items.en: We had a very nice holiday in Greece.
items.zh: 我們在希臘度了一個很愉快的假期。

items.en: Today was a very cold day.
items.zh: 今天很冷。

items.en: The manager called a very important meeting for Monday morning.
items.zh: 經理在星期一早上召開一場很重要的會議。

items.en: Last term we sat a very difficult exam in chemistry.
items.zh: 上學期我們考了一場很難的化學考試。

examples.heading: ⑦ 寫信和明信片

items.en: Thank you for a very lovely present.
items.zh: 謝謝你送我這麼可愛的禮物。

items.en: Our hotel has a very big swimming pool.
items.zh: 我們的飯店有一座很大的游泳池。

items.en: We are having a very relaxing week here.
items.zh: 我們在這裡度過很放鬆的一星期。

items.en: There's a very nice restaurant near our hotel.
items.zh: 我們飯店附近有一家很不錯的餐廳。

title: Every five minutes, he makes another great joke.
translation: 他每隔五分鐘就又講一個很好笑的笑話。
name: another 加單數名詞
sentences: Help yourself to another slice of pizza.
I'm still hungry. I'll order another sandwich.
Could we have another bottle of water, please?
He drank another coffee to stay awake.
We stayed for another week because we loved the island.
Wait another ten minutes, and the cake will be ready.
The shop will be closed for another month.
Let's try again another day.
There was another accident on the motorway this morning.
Oh no, another email from my boss!
Our team scored another goal in the second half.
It's another rainy day in London.
This room is too noisy. Can we have another room?
My phone is broken, so I need another one.
Let's go to another restaurant. This one is full.
Can you show me this shirt in another colour?
The author is writing another long novel about the war.
We had another lovely evening with the Browns.
The company opened another big office in Berlin.
That was another excellent meal, thank you.
Don't cry over one bad mark. There's another test next month.
You can always take the exam another time.
Give it another try. You can do it.
Everyone deserves another chance.
We missed the train, so we waited for another train.
After Paris, we took a bus to another city.
The hotel was full, so we looked for another hotel nearby.
I'd like to stay another night, please.
Next summer we want to visit another country in Asia.
Our flight was cancelled, so the airline put us on another plane.

examples.heading: ① 再一個：吃喝

items.en: Help yourself to another slice of pizza.
items.zh: 披薩再拿一片吧，別客氣。

items.en: I'm still hungry. I'll order another sandwich.
items.zh: 我還是很餓。我要再點一份三明治。

items.en: Could we have another bottle of water, please?
items.zh: 可以再給我們一瓶水嗎？

items.en: He drank another coffee to stay awake.
items.zh: 他又喝了一杯咖啡來保持清醒。

examples.heading: ② 再一個：時間

items.en: We stayed for another week because we loved the island.
items.zh: 我們很喜歡那座島，所以多待了一星期。

items.en: Wait another ten minutes, and the cake will be ready.
items.zh: 再等十分鐘，蛋糕就好了。

items.en: The shop will be closed for another month.
items.zh: 那家店還要再關一個月。

items.en: Let's try again another day.
items.zh: 我們改天再試一次吧。

examples.heading: ③ 再一個：事情又發生

items.en: There was another accident on the motorway this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上高速公路上又出了一起車禍。

items.en: Oh no, another email from my boss!
items.zh: 糟了，老闆又寄信來了！

items.en: Our team scored another goal in the second half.
items.zh: 我們隊下半場又進了一球。

items.en: It's another rainy day in London.
items.zh: 倫敦又是下雨天。

examples.heading: ④ 另一個：換一個

items.en: This room is too noisy. Can we have another room?
items.zh: 這間房間太吵了。可以換一間嗎？

items.en: My phone is broken, so I need another one.
items.zh: 我的手機壞了，所以我要換一支。

items.en: Let's go to another restaurant. This one is full.
items.zh: 我們去別家餐廳吧。這家客滿了。

items.en: Can you show me this shirt in another colour?
items.zh: 這件襯衫可以給我看別的顏色嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ another + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: The author is writing another long novel about the war.
items.zh: 那位作家又在寫一本關於戰爭的長篇小說。

items.en: We had another lovely evening with the Browns.
items.zh: 我們跟 Brown 一家又度過一個愉快的晚上。

items.en: The company opened another big office in Berlin.
items.zh: 那家公司在柏林又開了一間大辦公室。

items.en: That was another excellent meal, thank you.
items.zh: 這又是很棒的一餐，謝謝你。

examples.heading: ⑥ 說鼓勵和安慰的話

items.en: Don't cry over one bad mark. There's another test next month.
items.zh: 別為一次考不好哭。下個月還有一次考試。

items.en: You can always take the exam another time.
items.zh: 你隨時可以下次再考。

items.en: Give it another try. You can do it.
items.zh: 再試一次。你做得到的。

items.en: Everyone deserves another chance.
items.zh: 每個人都應該有第二次機會。

examples.heading: ⑦ 旅行

items.en: We missed the train, so we waited for another train.
items.zh: 我們沒趕上火車，所以等了下一班。

items.en: After Paris, we took a bus to another city.
items.zh: 離開巴黎以後，我們搭巴士去另一個城市。

items.en: The hotel was full, so we looked for another hotel nearby.
items.zh: 那家飯店客滿了，所以我們在附近找了另一家。

items.en: I'd like to stay another night, please.
items.zh: 我想再住一晚。

items.en: Next summer we want to visit another country in Asia.
items.zh: 明年夏天我們想去亞洲的另一個國家。

items.en: Our flight was cancelled, so the airline put us on another plane.
items.zh: 我們的班機取消了，所以航空公司讓我們改搭另一架飛機。

title: The competition was very tough because both of the teams were good.
translation: 這場比賽很激烈，因為兩隊都很強。
name: 數量限定詞加 of 加限定詞
sentences: I went shopping in town yesterday. I spent all of my money!
All of our neighbours came to the street party.
Did you eat all of the biscuits?
I've lost all of my photos from the holiday.
It was my birthday last week. Some of my friends gave me books.
Some of the food at the party was too spicy for me.
Some of our teachers are very young.
I've already done some of my homework.
It was a great final. The competition was very tough because both of the teams were good.
Both of my parents work in a hospital.
I like both of these jackets. Which one should I buy?
Both of my brothers play the guitar.
It was my grandmother's ninetieth birthday. Many of my relatives and friends had come.
Many of the shops in the old town sell souvenirs.
Many of my classmates are going to university next year.
Without a library card you can't take any of the books with you.
Have you seen any of his films?
I didn't know any of the people at the party.
Can any of your friends speak Japanese?
I enjoyed the party. I had invited five of my friends and my family.
Two of our cats are black and one is white.
Three of the students in my class come from Brazil.
At the end of the race, each of the players gets a medal.
Each of my sisters has her own bedroom.
The teacher spoke to each of the parents after the show.
"Which T-shirt do you want?" "Both of them, please!"
"Did you finish the cake?" "Yes, all of it. It was delicious."
"Do you know any of the girls in that photo?" "Yes, two of them are my cousins."

examples.heading: ① all of

items.en: I went shopping in town yesterday. I spent all of my money!
items.zh: 我昨天去鎮上買東西。我把錢全花光了！

items.en: All of our neighbours came to the street party.
items.zh: 我們所有鄰居都來參加街坊派對。

items.en: Did you eat all of the biscuits?
items.zh: 你把餅乾全吃光了嗎？

items.en: I've lost all of my photos from the holiday.
items.zh: 我度假拍的照片全不見了。

examples.heading: ② some of

items.en: It was my birthday last week. Some of my friends gave me books.
items.zh: 上星期是我的生日。我有些朋友送我書。

items.en: Some of the food at the party was too spicy for me.
items.zh: 派對上有些食物對我來說太辣了。

items.en: Some of our teachers are very young.
items.zh: 我們有些老師很年輕。

items.en: I've already done some of my homework.
items.zh: 我的功課已經寫了一部分。

examples.heading: ③ both of

items.en: It was a great final. The competition was very tough because both of the teams were good.
items.zh: 這場決賽很精彩。比賽很激烈，因為兩隊都很強。

items.en: Both of my parents work in a hospital.
items.zh: 我爸媽都在醫院工作。

items.en: I like both of these jackets. Which one should I buy?
items.zh: 這兩件外套我都喜歡。我該買哪一件？

items.en: Both of my brothers play the guitar.
items.zh: 我兩個哥哥都會彈吉他。

examples.heading: ④ many of

items.en: It was my grandmother's ninetieth birthday. Many of my relatives and friends had come.
items.zh: 那天是我奶奶的九十歲生日。我很多親戚和朋友都來了。

items.en: Many of the shops in the old town sell souvenirs.
items.zh: 老城區很多商店都賣紀念品。

items.en: Many of my classmates are going to university next year.
items.zh: 我很多同學明年要上大學。

examples.heading: ⑤ any of

items.en: Without a library card you can't take any of the books with you.
items.zh: 沒有借書證，你不能把任何一本書帶走。

items.en: Have you seen any of his films?
items.zh: 他的電影你看過哪一部嗎？

items.en: I didn't know any of the people at the party.
items.zh: 派對上的人我一個都不認識。

items.en: Can any of your friends speak Japanese?
items.zh: 你的朋友有誰會說日文嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 數字 + of

items.en: I enjoyed the party. I had invited five of my friends and my family.
items.zh: 派對很好玩。我請了五個朋友和家人。

items.en: Two of our cats are black and one is white.
items.zh: 我們的貓有兩隻是黑的，一隻是白的。

items.en: Three of the students in my class come from Brazil.
items.zh: 我們班有三個學生來自巴西。

examples.heading: ⑦ each of

items.en: At the end of the race, each of the players gets a medal.
items.zh: 比賽結束的時候，每個球員都拿到一面獎牌。

items.en: Each of my sisters has her own bedroom.
items.zh: 我的姊妹每個人都有自己的房間。

items.en: The teacher spoke to each of the parents after the show.
items.zh: 表演結束後，老師跟每位家長都談了話。

examples.heading: ⑧ 對話

items.en: "Which T-shirt do you want?" "Both of them, please!"
items.zh: 你要哪一件 T 恤？兩件都要，謝謝！

items.en: "Did you finish the cake?" "Yes, all of it. It was delicious."
items.zh: 蛋糕吃完了嗎？吃完了，全部吃光。很好吃。

items.en: "Do you know any of the girls in that photo?" "Yes, two of them are my cousins."
items.zh: 那張照片裡的女生你認識哪一個嗎？認識，其中兩個是我表姊妹。

title: Although I knew what kind of dress I wanted, none of the stores had it.
translation: 雖然我知道自己想要什麼樣的洋裝，但每家店都沒有。
name: 數量限定詞加 of 加限定詞（half of、none of）
sentences: I knew exactly what kind of dress I wanted, but none of the stores had it.
I asked everyone, but none of my friends could help me move.
None of the photos from the party came out well.
We tried three restaurants, but none of them had a free table.
None of this money is mine. It belongs to the club.
You should spend half of your holiday with your parents and the other half with your friends.
Half of my class went on the school trip.
I only ate half of the pizza. Do you want the rest?
We're selling cakes at school on Friday. Half of the money goes to the hospital.
Anyway, that's enough of my news! How are you?
I've had enough of your excuses. Do your homework now.
Have you had enough of the soup, or would you like some more?
We've seen enough of this town. Let's drive to the coast.
Most of my friends live in the same street as me.
I spent most of the weekend in bed with a cold.
Some of these books are very old. Be careful with them.
Some of my classmates are coming to the beach with us.
Our teacher was so proud. All of the students in my class passed the exam.
You'll like the hotel. Each of the rooms has its own bathroom.
One of my teachers is from Canada.
Each of the children got a small present.
The teacher asked a hard question. None of us knew the answer.
We invited all the parents, but half of them didn't come to the meeting.
Thank you, everyone. Most of you have already paid for the trip.
The play was too long, but some of it was very funny.
I love these shoes, but none of the shops have my size.
Most of the snow has melted, so we can drive now.
Half of the cake was gone before the guests arrived!
"Did you like the films?" "Some of them. Not all of them."
"Have you met my cousins?" "Only one of them."
"Is there any cake left?" "No, none of it. Sorry!"

examples.heading: ① none of

items.en: I knew exactly what kind of dress I wanted, but none of the stores had it.
items.zh: 我很清楚自己想要什麼樣的洋裝，可是每家店都沒有。

items.en: I asked everyone, but none of my friends could help me move.
items.zh: 我問了每個人，可是我的朋友沒有一個能幫我搬家。

items.en: None of the photos from the party came out well.
items.zh: 派對拍的照片沒有一張拍得好。

items.en: We tried three restaurants, but none of them had a free table.
items.zh: 我們試了三家餐廳，可是沒有一家有空桌。

items.en: None of this money is mine. It belongs to the club.
items.zh: 這些錢沒有一分是我的。是社團的。

examples.heading: ② half of

items.en: You should spend half of your holiday with your parents and the other half with your friends.
items.zh: 你應該把一半的假期拿來陪爸媽，另一半陪朋友。

items.en: Half of my class went on the school trip.
items.zh: 我們班有一半的人去了校外教學。

items.en: I only ate half of the pizza. Do you want the rest?
items.zh: 披薩我只吃了一半。剩下的你要嗎？

items.en: We're selling cakes at school on Friday. Half of the money goes to the hospital.
items.zh: 我們星期五在學校賣蛋糕。一半的錢捐給醫院。

examples.heading: ③ enough of

items.en: Anyway, that's enough of my news! How are you?
items.zh: 好了，我的近況就說到這裡！你好嗎？

items.en: I've had enough of your excuses. Do your homework now.
items.zh: 你的藉口我聽夠了。現在去寫功課。

items.en: Have you had enough of the soup, or would you like some more?
items.zh: 湯喝夠了嗎，還是要再來一點？

items.en: We've seen enough of this town. Let's drive to the coast.
items.zh: 這個小鎮我們看夠了。開車去海邊吧。

examples.heading: ④ most of / some of

items.en: Most of my friends live in the same street as me.
items.zh: 我大部分的朋友都跟我住在同一條街。

items.en: I spent most of the weekend in bed with a cold.
items.zh: 我感冒了，週末大部分時間都躺在床上。

items.en: Some of these books are very old. Be careful with them.
items.zh: 這些書有些很舊了。小心點。

items.en: Some of my classmates are coming to the beach with us.
items.zh: 我有些同學要跟我們一起去海邊。

examples.heading: ⑤ all of / each of / one of

items.en: Our teacher was so proud. All of the students in my class passed the exam.
items.zh: 我們老師好驕傲。我們班所有學生都通過了考試。

items.en: You'll like the hotel. Each of the rooms has its own bathroom.
items.zh: 你會喜歡那間旅館。每個房間都有自己的浴室。

items.en: One of my teachers is from Canada.
items.zh: 我的一個老師是加拿大人。

items.en: Each of the children got a small present.
items.zh: 每個孩子都拿到一份小禮物。

examples.heading: ⑥ 代名詞前面

items.en: The teacher asked a hard question. None of us knew the answer.
items.zh: 老師問了一個很難的問題。我們沒有一個人知道答案。

items.en: We invited all the parents, but half of them didn't come to the meeting.
items.zh: 我們邀請了所有家長，可是他們有一半的人沒來開會。

items.en: Thank you, everyone. Most of you have already paid for the trip.
items.zh: 謝謝大家。你們大部分人已經付了旅行的錢。

items.en: The play was too long, but some of it was very funny.
items.zh: 那齣戲太長了，可是有些部分很好笑。

examples.heading: ⑦ 不同的情境

items.en: I love these shoes, but none of the shops have my size.
items.zh: 我很喜歡這雙鞋，可是每家店都沒有我的尺寸。

items.en: Most of the snow has melted, so we can drive now.
items.zh: 大部分的雪都融了，所以我們現在可以開車了。

items.en: Half of the cake was gone before the guests arrived!
items.zh: 客人還沒到，蛋糕就沒了一半！

examples.heading: ⑧ 對話

items.en: "Did you like the films?" "Some of them. Not all of them."
items.zh: 你喜歡那些電影嗎？有一些。不是全部。

items.en: "Have you met my cousins?" "Only one of them."
items.zh: 你見過我的表兄弟姊妹嗎？只見過其中一個。

items.en: "Is there any cake left?" "No, none of it. Sorry!"
items.zh: 還有蛋糕嗎？沒了，一點都不剩。抱歉！

title: Of course, if you are not at all interested in sports, neither of these games will be of any interest to you.
translation: 當然，如果你對運動完全沒興趣，這兩場比賽你都不會感興趣。
name: either、neither of 加複數名詞片語
sentences: There's a football match and a tennis match on Saturday. Of course, if you are not at all interested in sports, neither of these games will be of any interest to you.
We visited two schools for our son, but neither of the schools had a swimming pool.
I'm the first in my family to study at university. Neither of my parents went.
We looked at two flats, but neither of the flats had a garden.
Neither of the answers you gave is correct. Try again.
You can take either of the two roads. They both go to the village.
Either of the measures is recommended, and both will help the company.
I don't mind which film we see. Either of those films is fine with me.
Have either of your brothers been to Japan?
If either of the children feels ill, call me straight away.
You forgot to say that neither of us could predict the rise in the price of wheat.
Neither of us wanted to cook, so we ordered a pizza.
I've met your two cousins, but I don't remember either of them.
"Which of you broke the window?" "Neither of us!"
Neither of them said a word during the whole trip.
Don't book a taxi. Either of us can drive you to the airport tomorrow.
Is either of you free on Friday evening?
I've got two spare tickets. Would either of you like them?
If either of them calls, tell them I'm in a meeting.
Sorry, Tom. I don't agree with either of your ideas.
She didn't answer either of my emails.
We couldn't find either of the keys, so we called a locksmith.
Everyone's talking about that writer, but I haven't read either of his books.
Both hotels are expensive, and neither of them is near the beach.
The two phones look the same. Neither of the shops could tell me the difference.
We need a bigger car. Neither of our cars has room for five people.
Look at the board, everyone. Choose either of the two topics for your essay.
The meeting ended without a decision. Neither of the proposals was accepted by the committee.
Please let us know if either of these dates is suitable.
Neither of the candidates has enough experience for the job.
We regret that neither of the rooms you asked for is available.

examples.heading: ① neither of + 限定詞 + 複數名詞

items.en: There's a football match and a tennis match on Saturday. Of course, if you are not at all interested in sports, neither of these games will be of any interest to you.
items.zh: 星期六有一場足球賽和一場網球賽。當然，如果你對運動完全沒興趣，這兩場比賽你都不會感興趣。

items.en: We visited two schools for our son, but neither of the schools had a swimming pool.
items.zh: 我們幫兒子看了兩間學校，可是兩間都沒有游泳池。

items.en: I'm the first in my family to study at university. Neither of my parents went.
items.zh: 我是家裡第一個上大學的。我爸媽兩個都沒上過。

items.en: We looked at two flats, but neither of the flats had a garden.
items.zh: 我們看了兩間公寓，可是兩間都沒有花園。

items.en: Neither of the answers you gave is correct. Try again.
items.zh: 你給的兩個答案都不對。再試一次。

examples.heading: ② either of + 限定詞 + 複數名詞

items.en: You can take either of the two roads. They both go to the village.
items.zh: 兩條路你走哪一條都可以。它們都通到村子。

items.en: Either of the measures is recommended, and both will help the company.
items.zh: 兩個措施採用哪一個都好，兩個都會對公司有幫助。

items.en: I don't mind which film we see. Either of those films is fine with me.
items.zh: 我不在乎看哪一部電影。那兩部我都可以。

items.en: Have either of your brothers been to Japan?
items.zh: 你兩個哥哥有誰去過日本嗎？

items.en: If either of the children feels ill, call me straight away.
items.zh: 兩個孩子如果有誰不舒服，馬上打給我。

examples.heading: ③ neither of us / you / them

items.en: You forgot to say that neither of us could predict the rise in the price of wheat.
items.zh: 你忘了說，我們雙方都沒辦法預料小麥價格會上漲。

items.en: Neither of us wanted to cook, so we ordered a pizza.
items.zh: 我們兩個都不想煮飯，所以叫了披薩。

items.en: I've met your two cousins, but I don't remember either of them.
items.zh: 我見過你兩個表哥，可是兩個我都不記得了。

items.en: "Which of you broke the window?" "Neither of us!"
items.zh: 你們兩個誰打破窗戶的？我們兩個都沒有！

items.en: Neither of them said a word during the whole trip.
items.zh: 整趟旅行他們兩個都沒說一句話。

examples.heading: ④ either of us / you / them

items.en: Don't book a taxi. Either of us can drive you to the airport tomorrow.
items.zh: 別叫計程車。我們兩個誰都可以明天載你去機場。

items.en: Is either of you free on Friday evening?
items.zh: 你們兩個有誰星期五晚上有空嗎？

items.en: I've got two spare tickets. Would either of you like them?
items.zh: 我多了兩張票。你們兩個有誰想要嗎？

items.en: If either of them calls, tell them I'm in a meeting.
items.zh: 他們兩個如果有誰打來，跟他們說我在開會。

examples.heading: ⑤ not ... either of

items.en: Sorry, Tom. I don't agree with either of your ideas.
items.zh: Tom，抱歉。你的兩個點子我都不同意。

items.en: She didn't answer either of my emails.
items.zh: 我寄的兩封電子郵件她都沒回。

items.en: We couldn't find either of the keys, so we called a locksmith.
items.zh: 兩把鑰匙我們都找不到，所以叫了鎖匠。

items.en: Everyone's talking about that writer, but I haven't read either of his books.
items.zh: 大家都在談那個作家，可是他的兩本書我都還沒讀過。

examples.heading: ⑥ 比較和選擇

items.en: Both hotels are expensive, and neither of them is near the beach.
items.zh: 兩間旅館都很貴，而且兩間都不在海灘附近。

items.en: The two phones look the same. Neither of the shops could tell me the difference.
items.zh: 兩支手機看起來一樣。兩家店都說不出差別在哪。

items.en: We need a bigger car. Neither of our cars has room for five people.
items.zh: 我們需要一台大一點的車。我們的兩台車都坐不下五個人。

items.en: Look at the board, everyone. Choose either of the two topics for your essay.
items.zh: 大家看黑板。你們的作文從兩個題目裡任選一個。

examples.heading: ⑦ 正式的信和報告

items.en: The meeting ended without a decision. Neither of the proposals was accepted by the committee.
items.zh: 會議沒有做出決定就結束了。委員會兩個提案都沒有接受。

items.en: Please let us know if either of these dates is suitable.
items.zh: 如果這兩個日期有一個合適，請告訴我們。

items.en: Neither of the candidates has enough experience for the job.
items.zh: 兩位應徵者的經驗都不足以勝任這份工作。

items.en: We regret that neither of the rooms you asked for is available.
items.zh: 很抱歉，您要的兩間房間都沒有空。

title: This way, the toilet can be accessed easily from either floor.
translation: 這樣一來，不管從哪一層樓都能輕鬆到廁所。
name: either、neither 加單數名詞
sentences: If we put the toilet between the two floors, it can be accessed easily from either floor.
You can pay by cash or card. Either way is fine.
In my country, people can say it in two ways, and either way is correct.
"Tea or coffee?" "Either one. I don't mind."
There are two buses to the city centre. Either bus will get you there in twenty minutes.
We have two free rooms. You can stay in either room.
You'll like the high street. There are shops on either side of it.
You can't miss the bridge. It has a tower at either end.
She was carrying a heavy bag in either hand.
Two policemen stood on either side of the door.
The river has fields on either bank.
We would like to point out that neither party could foresee the rise in the price of wheat.
I tried two keys, but neither key opened the door.
Neither answer is correct. Read the question again.
We looked at two houses. Neither house had enough bedrooms.
I've got two brothers, but neither brother lives near me.
The two teams played well, but neither team scored.
Neither plan is perfect, but the second one is cheaper.
There are two bakeries in our village, but neither shop sells the kind of bread I like.
We can stay at home or go to your mum's. Honestly, neither option sounds good to me.
You can get off at either stop. They're both close to the museum.
I don't agree with either side in this argument.
Don't worry about parking at the zoo. There's a car park at either entrance.
You can start from either end of the trail.
The contract can be ended by either party with one month's notice.
The two companies are planning to join together. Neither company would comment on the news.
Neither candidate has any experience in teaching.
The town has two railway stations. The museum can be reached from either station.
"Which shirt should I wear?" "Either shirt looks good on you."
"Do you prefer the red one or the blue one?" "Neither colour, really."
"Did you speak to Tom or Anna?" "Neither one. They were both out."

examples.heading: ① either + 單數名詞：任何一個

items.en: If we put the toilet between the two floors, it can be accessed easily from either floor.
items.zh: 如果把廁所放在兩層樓中間，不管從哪一層樓都能輕鬆到廁所。

items.en: You can pay by cash or card. Either way is fine.
items.zh: 你可以付現或刷卡。哪一種方式都可以。

items.en: In my country, people can say it in two ways, and either way is correct.
items.zh: 在我的國家，這句話有兩種說法，兩種說法都對。

items.en: "Tea or coffee?" "Either one. I don't mind."
items.zh: 茶還是咖啡？哪一個都好。我不介意。

items.en: There are two buses to the city centre. Either bus will get you there in twenty minutes.
items.zh: 有兩班公車到市中心。哪一班都能讓你在二十分鐘內到。

items.en: We have two free rooms. You can stay in either room.
items.zh: 我們有兩間空房。你住哪一間都可以。

examples.heading: ② either side / end / hand：兩邊都

items.en: You'll like the high street. There are shops on either side of it.
items.zh: 你會喜歡那條商店街。街的兩邊都有商店。

items.en: You can't miss the bridge. It has a tower at either end.
items.zh: 你不會錯過那座橋。橋的兩端都有一座塔。

items.en: She was carrying a heavy bag in either hand.
items.zh: 她兩手各提著一個很重的袋子。

items.en: Two policemen stood on either side of the door.
items.zh: 兩個警察站在門的兩邊。

items.en: The river has fields on either bank.
items.zh: 這條河的兩岸都是田。

examples.heading: ③ neither + 單數名詞

items.en: We would like to point out that neither party could foresee the rise in the price of wheat.
items.zh: 我們想指出，雙方都無法預料小麥價格的上漲。

items.en: I tried two keys, but neither key opened the door.
items.zh: 我試了兩把鑰匙，可是兩把都打不開門。

items.en: Neither answer is correct. Read the question again.
items.zh: 兩個答案都不對。再讀一次題目。

items.en: We looked at two houses. Neither house had enough bedrooms.
items.zh: 我們看了兩間房子。兩間的臥室都不夠。

items.en: I've got two brothers, but neither brother lives near me.
items.zh: 我有兩個哥哥，可是兩個都沒住在我附近。

examples.heading: ④ neither + 單數名詞當主詞

items.en: The two teams played well, but neither team scored.
items.zh: 兩隊都踢得很好，可是兩隊都沒進球。

items.en: Neither plan is perfect, but the second one is cheaper.
items.zh: 兩個計畫都不完美，可是第二個比較便宜。

items.en: There are two bakeries in our village, but neither shop sells the kind of bread I like.
items.zh: 我們村子有兩家麵包店，可是兩家都沒賣我喜歡的那種麵包。

items.en: We can stay at home or go to your mum's. Honestly, neither option sounds good to me.
items.zh: 我們可以待在家，或去你媽媽家。老實說，兩個選項我都覺得不好。

examples.heading: ⑤ 在介系詞後面

items.en: You can get off at either stop. They're both close to the museum.
items.zh: 你在哪一站下車都可以。兩站都離博物館很近。

items.en: I don't agree with either side in this argument.
items.zh: 這場爭論兩邊我都不同意。

items.en: Don't worry about parking at the zoo. There's a car park at either entrance.
items.zh: 別擔心動物園停車的問題。兩個入口都有停車場。

items.en: You can start from either end of the trail.
items.zh: 這條步道你從哪一頭開始走都可以。

examples.heading: ⑥ 正式的文字

items.en: The contract can be ended by either party with one month's notice.
items.zh: 雙方任何一方提前一個月通知，就可以終止合約。

items.en: The two companies are planning to join together. Neither company would comment on the news.
items.zh: 那兩家公司打算合併。兩家公司都不願意評論這則新聞。

items.en: Neither candidate has any experience in teaching.
items.zh: 兩位應徵者都沒有任何教學經驗。

items.en: The town has two railway stations. The museum can be reached from either station.
items.zh: 這個鎮有兩個火車站。從兩個車站都可以到博物館。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Which shirt should I wear?" "Either shirt looks good on you."
items.zh: 我該穿哪件襯衫？兩件你穿都好看。

items.en: "Do you prefer the red one or the blue one?" "Neither colour, really."
items.zh: 你比較喜歡紅的還是藍的？其實兩個顏色我都不喜歡。

items.en: "Did you speak to Tom or Anna?" "Neither one. They were both out."
items.zh: 你有跟 Tom 還是 Anna 講到話嗎？兩個都沒有。他們都出去了。

title: I like wearing clothes that attract people's attention.
translation: 我喜歡穿能吸引別人目光的衣服。
name: 不規則複數名詞加 's
sentences: When I go out with my friends, I like wearing clothes that attract people's attention.
You should listen to other people's ideas.
It's rude to read other people's letters.
The museum tells the story of people's lives in the past.
Don't worry about other people's opinions.
I don't like the flat. The second reason is that it's too far from the children's school, and I haven't got a car.
My mother writes children's books.
We need to buy new children's clothes for the winter.
There's a children's playground in the park.
The men's toilets are on the left.
Women's football is becoming very popular.
I'm looking for the men's shoe department.
She won the women's hundred metres.
The mice's nest was behind the cupboard.
The geese's feathers were white and grey.
The sheep's wool keeps them warm in winter.
The doctor asked about the children's health.
People's habits have changed a lot because of smartphones.
The women's team trains on Tuesdays.
"Where are the kids' coats?" "In the children's room."
"Is this the men's changing room?" "Yes, the women's is upstairs."
"Why did you become a teacher?" "I wanted to change people's lives."

examples.heading: ① people's + 名詞

items.en: When I go out with my friends, I like wearing clothes that attract people's attention.
items.zh: 我跟朋友出去的時候，喜歡穿能吸引別人目光的衣服。

items.en: You should listen to other people's ideas.
items.zh: 你應該聽聽別人的想法。

items.en: It's rude to read other people's letters.
items.zh: 看別人的信很沒禮貌。

items.en: The museum tells the story of people's lives in the past.
items.zh: 那間博物館講述過去人們的生活。

items.en: Don't worry about other people's opinions.
items.zh: 別在意別人的看法。

examples.heading: ② children's + 名詞

items.en: I don't like the flat. The second reason is that it's too far from the children's school, and I haven't got a car.
items.zh: 我不喜歡那間公寓。第二個原因是離孩子們的學校太遠，我又沒有車。

items.en: My mother writes children's books.
items.zh: 我媽媽寫童書。

items.en: We need to buy new children's clothes for the winter.
items.zh: 我們得幫孩子們買冬天的新衣服。

items.en: There's a children's playground in the park.
items.zh: 公園裡有一個兒童遊樂場。

examples.heading: ③ men's / women's + 名詞

items.en: The men's toilets are on the left.
items.zh: 男廁在左邊。

items.en: Women's football is becoming very popular.
items.zh: 女子足球越來越受歡迎。

items.en: I'm looking for the men's shoe department.
items.zh: 我在找男鞋部。

items.en: She won the women's hundred metres.
items.zh: 她贏了女子一百公尺。

examples.heading: ④ 其他不規則的複數

items.en: The mice's nest was behind the cupboard.
items.zh: 老鼠窩在櫃子後面。

items.en: The geese's feathers were white and grey.
items.zh: 那些鵝的羽毛是白色和灰色的。

items.en: The sheep's wool keeps them warm in winter.
items.zh: 羊毛讓羊在冬天保暖。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: The doctor asked about the children's health.
items.zh: 醫生問了孩子們的健康狀況。

items.en: People's habits have changed a lot because of smartphones.
items.zh: 因為智慧型手機，人們的習慣改變了很多。

items.en: The women's team trains on Tuesdays.
items.zh: 女子隊每個星期二練習。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Where are the kids' coats?" "In the children's room."
items.zh: 孩子們的外套在哪裡？在孩子們的房間。

items.en: "Is this the men's changing room?" "Yes, the women's is upstairs."
items.zh: 這是男生更衣室嗎？對，女生的在樓上。

items.en: "Why did you become a teacher?" "I wanted to change people's lives."
items.zh: 你為什麼當老師？我想改變別人的生活。

title: They've chosen my school because of its size.
translation: 他們選了我們學校，是因為學校的規模。
name: 所有格限定詞 its
sentences: A TV company is making a programme about schools. They've chosen my school because of its size.
I love this phone. Its camera takes beautiful photos.
The car is old, but its engine is still good.
The book is famous for its surprise ending.
The table is lovely, but one of its legs is broken.
It was the biggest TV in the bazaar, with its huge black screen.
The journey was quite long, but Verona is a great city, with its buildings and churches.
The hotel, with its big garden and pool, is perfect for families.
Paris, with its cafés and museums, is my favourite city.
The cat is sleeping in its basket.
The bird built its nest in our garden.
The dog hurt its leg when it jumped over the wall.
A snake can open its mouth very wide.
The company has opened its first shop in Asia.
The team won its last five games.
The school is celebrating its hundredth birthday this year.
The town is known for its beautiful old bridge.
Every country has its own traditions.
The plant needs water. Its leaves are turning brown.
"Why did you buy that laptop?" "Because of its battery. It lasts all day."
"What do you like about the city?" "Its parks. There are so many."
"Is the restaurant good?" "Yes, it's famous for its fish."

examples.heading: ① its + 名詞：東西

items.en: A TV company is making a programme about schools. They've chosen my school because of its size.
items.zh: 有一家電視公司在拍一個關於學校的節目。他們選了我們學校，是因為學校的規模。

items.en: I love this phone. Its camera takes beautiful photos.
items.zh: 我很喜歡這支手機。它的相機拍照很漂亮。

items.en: The car is old, but its engine is still good.
items.zh: 那輛車很舊，可是引擎還很好。

items.en: The book is famous for its surprise ending.
items.zh: 那本書以出人意料的結局出名。

items.en: The table is lovely, but one of its legs is broken.
items.zh: 那張桌子很漂亮，可是有一隻腳斷了。

examples.heading: ② with its + 名詞

items.en: It was the biggest TV in the bazaar, with its huge black screen.
items.zh: 那是市集裡最大的電視，有一個巨大的黑色螢幕。

items.en: The journey was quite long, but Verona is a great city, with its buildings and churches.
items.zh: 路程很長，可是維洛那是一座很棒的城市，有很多建築和教堂。

items.en: The hotel, with its big garden and pool, is perfect for families.
items.zh: 那間旅館有大花園和游泳池，很適合全家一起去。

items.en: Paris, with its cafés and museums, is my favourite city.
items.zh: 巴黎有很多咖啡店和博物館，是我最喜歡的城市。

examples.heading: ③ its + 名詞：動物

items.en: The cat is sleeping in its basket.
items.zh: 貓在牠的籃子裡睡覺。

items.en: The bird built its nest in our garden.
items.zh: 那隻鳥在我們的花園裡築巢。

items.en: The dog hurt its leg when it jumped over the wall.
items.zh: 那隻狗跳過牆的時候弄傷了腿。

items.en: A snake can open its mouth very wide.
items.zh: 蛇可以把嘴巴張得很大。

examples.heading: ④ its + 名詞：公司和團體

items.en: The company has opened its first shop in Asia.
items.zh: 那家公司在亞洲開了第一家店。

items.en: The team won its last five games.
items.zh: 那支球隊贏了最後五場比賽。

items.en: The school is celebrating its hundredth birthday this year.
items.zh: 那所學校今年慶祝一百週年。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: The town is known for its beautiful old bridge.
items.zh: 那個小鎮以一座美麗的古橋出名。

items.en: Every country has its own traditions.
items.zh: 每個國家都有自己的傳統。

items.en: The plant needs water. Its leaves are turning brown.
items.zh: 那株植物需要水。它的葉子開始枯了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Why did you buy that laptop?" "Because of its battery. It lasts all day."
items.zh: 你為什麼買那台筆電？因為它的電池。可以撐一整天。

items.en: "What do you like about the city?" "Its parks. There are so many."
items.zh: 你喜歡那個城市的什麼？它的公園。公園好多。

items.en: "Is the restaurant good?" "Yes, it's famous for its fish."
items.zh: 那家餐廳好吃嗎？好吃，那裡的魚很有名。

title: We are sick of working hard for so little money.
translation: 我們受夠了拚命工作卻只拿這麼一點錢。
name: 修飾語加 little 或 few 表示不足
sentences: We work ten hours a day. We are sick of working hard for so little money.
I can't believe you finished it in so little time.
There's so little space in our flat that we keep our bikes in the kitchen.
The old man had so little food that the neighbours brought him meals.
There are so few pandas left that we must try to help them.
So few people came to the meeting that we had to cancel it.
I was surprised that so few students asked questions.
The village has so few shops that we drive to town every week.
I spend very little time outside, and I know I'm not very fit.
My grandmother eats very little meat these days.
There's very little information about the hotel online.
He speaks very little English, so I translated for him.
Very few people know about this beach, so it's always quiet.
We get very few visitors in winter.
Most of my classmates live on takeaways. Very few teenagers can cook a proper meal these days.
There were very few cars on the road this morning.
The plan failed because we had too little money.
Too few people voted, so the result isn't clear.
You're getting too little sleep. Go to bed earlier.
There are too few buses after ten o'clock.
Relatively few tourists visit this part of the island.
Run when you land! There's extremely little time between the two flights.
Surprisingly few people turned up for the free concert.
My grandma says remarkably few houses in the village have changed since the 1950s.
Our school gives us so little homework that we get bored at weekends.
The council does very little for young people in this town.
There are so few jobs here that young people move to the city.
We have too little time with our children during the week.
"How much milk is left?" "Very little. Can you buy some?"
"Did many people come?" "No, very few. It was raining."
"Why are you so tired?" "I've had so little sleep this week."

examples.heading: ① so little + 不可數名詞

items.en: We work ten hours a day. We are sick of working hard for so little money.
items.zh: 我們一天工作十個小時。我們受夠了拚命工作卻只拿這麼一點錢。

items.en: I can't believe you finished it in so little time.
items.zh: 我不敢相信你這麼短的時間就做完了。

items.en: There's so little space in our flat that we keep our bikes in the kitchen.
items.zh: 我們公寓的空間小到腳踏車只能放在廚房。

items.en: The old man had so little food that the neighbours brought him meals.
items.zh: 那個老人沒什麼東西吃，所以鄰居送飯給他。

examples.heading: ② so few + 可數名詞

items.en: There are so few pandas left that we must try to help them.
items.zh: 剩下的熊貓這麼少，我們一定要想辦法幫牠們。

items.en: So few people came to the meeting that we had to cancel it.
items.zh: 來開會的人太少，所以我們只好取消。

items.en: I was surprised that so few students asked questions.
items.zh: 我很驚訝問問題的學生這麼少。

items.en: The village has so few shops that we drive to town every week.
items.zh: 這個村子的商店少到我們每個星期都要開車去鎮上。

examples.heading: ③ very little + 不可數名詞

items.en: I spend very little time outside, and I know I'm not very fit.
items.zh: 我很少待在戶外，我知道自己體力不太好。

items.en: My grandmother eats very little meat these days.
items.zh: 我奶奶現在很少吃肉。

items.en: There's very little information about the hotel online.
items.zh: 網路上關於這間旅館的資料很少。

items.en: He speaks very little English, so I translated for him.
items.zh: 他英文會說的很少，所以我幫他翻譯。

examples.heading: ④ very few + 可數名詞

items.en: Very few people know about this beach, so it's always quiet.
items.zh: 很少人知道這個海灘，所以它一直都很安靜。

items.en: We get very few visitors in winter.
items.zh: 我們冬天很少有訪客。

items.en: Most of my classmates live on takeaways. Very few teenagers can cook a proper meal these days.
items.zh: 我大部分的同學都靠外賣過活。現在很少青少年會煮一頓像樣的飯。

items.en: There were very few cars on the road this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上路上的車很少。

examples.heading: ⑤ too little / too few

items.en: The plan failed because we had too little money.
items.zh: 計畫失敗了，因為我們的錢太少。

items.en: Too few people voted, so the result isn't clear.
items.zh: 投票的人太少，所以結果不明確。

items.en: You're getting too little sleep. Go to bed earlier.
items.zh: 你睡得太少了。早點去睡。

items.en: There are too few buses after ten o'clock.
items.zh: 十點以後的公車太少了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 其他修飾語

items.en: Relatively few tourists visit this part of the island.
items.zh: 來島上這一帶的觀光客相對很少。

items.en: Run when you land! There's extremely little time between the two flights.
items.zh: 一落地就要跑！兩班飛機之間的時間極少。

items.en: Surprisingly few people turned up for the free concert.
items.zh: 免費音樂會來的人少得出奇。

items.en: My grandma says remarkably few houses in the village have changed since the 1950s.
items.zh: 我奶奶說，自從 1950 年代以來，村子裡改變的房子少得驚人。

examples.heading: ⑦ 抱怨和批評

items.en: Our school gives us so little homework that we get bored at weekends.
items.zh: 我們學校出的功課太少了，週末都很無聊。

items.en: The council does very little for young people in this town.
items.zh: 市議會為這個鎮上的年輕人做的事很少。

items.en: There are so few jobs here that young people move to the city.
items.zh: 這裡工作機會太少，所以年輕人都搬到城市去了。

items.en: We have too little time with our children during the week.
items.zh: 我們平日陪孩子的時間太少了。

examples.heading: ⑧ 對話

items.en: "How much milk is left?" "Very little. Can you buy some?"
items.zh: 還剩多少牛奶？很少了。你可以去買一些嗎？

items.en: "Did many people come?" "No, very few. It was raining."
items.zh: 很多人來嗎？沒有，很少。那時在下雨。

items.en: "Why are you so tired?" "I've had so little sleep this week."
items.zh: 你怎麼這麼累？我這個星期睡得太少了。

title: Have you got many friends in England?
translation: 你在英格蘭有很多朋友嗎？
name: 疑問句中 many 加複數名詞
sentences: I hope you're happy at your new school. Have you got many friends in England?
You read so well, Lucy. Do you have many books in English at home?
Have you got many plans for the summer?
Let's meet after school. Do you have many lessons on Friday?
Do your grandparents have many visitors?
How was the concert? Were there many people there?
Did you take many photos on holiday?
Sorry I missed the talk. Did many parents turn up?
Were there many mistakes in my essay?
I'm thinking of moving to the UK. How many channels are there on British TV?
I need to buy drinks. How many people are coming to your party?
Your house is so big! How many bedrooms has it got?
How many hours do you sleep every night?
How many languages can your teacher speak?
You travel so much! How many countries did you visit last year?
How many goals did your team score on Saturday?
How many times did you call me? I didn't hear the phone.
Can you tell me how many tickets are left?
I don't know how many people live in this town.
We usually shop in town. There aren't many shops in my village.
It was too hot. We didn't see many animals at the zoo.
Are there many good restaurants near your hotel?
I heard your school is very international. Are there many students from other countries?
My flight lands at midnight. Are there many buses to the city at that time?
You look tired. Have you had many late nights this week?
I'm going to the market. Do we need many eggs for the cake?
You can't sleep? How many cups of coffee have you had today?
"Have you got many friends at work?" "A few. Most people are friendly."
"How many sweets did you eat?" "Only three, Mum!"
"Do you get many emails?" "Yes, about a hundred a day."
"How many people work in your office?" "About twenty."

examples.heading: ① Have you got / Do you have many ...?

items.en: I hope you're happy at your new school. Have you got many friends in England?
items.zh: 希望你在新學校過得開心。你在英格蘭有很多朋友嗎？

items.en: You read so well, Lucy. Do you have many books in English at home?
items.zh: Lucy，你讀得很好。你家裡有很多英文書嗎？

items.en: Have you got many plans for the summer?
items.zh: 你暑假有很多計畫嗎？

items.en: Let's meet after school. Do you have many lessons on Friday?
items.zh: 我們放學後見吧。你星期五課很多嗎？

items.en: Do your grandparents have many visitors?
items.zh: 你爺爺奶奶常有很多人去看他們嗎？

examples.heading: ② Did / Were there many ...?

items.en: How was the concert? Were there many people there?
items.zh: 演唱會怎麼樣？人很多嗎？

items.en: Did you take many photos on holiday?
items.zh: 你度假時拍了很多照片嗎？

items.en: Sorry I missed the talk. Did many parents turn up?
items.zh: 抱歉我錯過了演講。很多家長去了嗎？

items.en: Were there many mistakes in my essay?
items.zh: 我的作文錯很多嗎？

examples.heading: ③ How many + 複數名詞

items.en: I'm thinking of moving to the UK. How many channels are there on British TV?
items.zh: 我在考慮搬去英國。英國電視有幾個頻道？

items.en: I need to buy drinks. How many people are coming to your party?
items.zh: 我要去買飲料。你的派對有幾個人要來？

items.en: Your house is so big! How many bedrooms has it got?
items.zh: 你家好大！有幾間臥室？

items.en: How many hours do you sleep every night?
items.zh: 你每天晚上睡幾個小時？

items.en: How many languages can your teacher speak?
items.zh: 你的老師會說幾種語言？

examples.heading: ④ How many ... + 過去式

items.en: You travel so much! How many countries did you visit last year?
items.zh: 你好常旅行！你去年去了幾個國家？

items.en: How many goals did your team score on Saturday?
items.zh: 你們隊星期六進了幾球？

items.en: How many times did you call me? I didn't hear the phone.
items.zh: 你打了幾次電話給我？我沒聽到電話響。

examples.heading: ⑤ 間接問句和否定句

items.en: Can you tell me how many tickets are left?
items.zh: 你可以告訴我還剩幾張票嗎？

items.en: I don't know how many people live in this town.
items.zh: 我不知道這個鎮住了多少人。

items.en: We usually shop in town. There aren't many shops in my village.
items.zh: 我們通常去鎮上買東西。我們村子沒有很多商店。

items.en: It was too hot. We didn't see many animals at the zoo.
items.zh: 天氣太熱了。我們在動物園沒看到很多動物。

examples.heading: ⑥ Are there many ...?

items.en: Are there many good restaurants near your hotel?
items.zh: 你的旅館附近有很多好餐廳嗎？

items.en: I heard your school is very international. Are there many students from other countries?
items.zh: 聽說你們學校很國際化。有很多外國學生嗎？

items.en: My flight lands at midnight. Are there many buses to the city at that time?
items.zh: 我的班機半夜到。那個時間有很多班公車去市區嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 不同的情境

items.en: You look tired. Have you had many late nights this week?
items.zh: 你看起來很累。你這星期熬了很多次夜嗎？

items.en: I'm going to the market. Do we need many eggs for the cake?
items.zh: 我要去市場。做蛋糕需要很多蛋嗎？

items.en: You can't sleep? How many cups of coffee have you had today?
items.zh: 你睡不著？你今天喝了幾杯咖啡？

examples.heading: ⑧ 對話

items.en: "Have you got many friends at work?" "A few. Most people are friendly."
items.zh: 你在公司有很多朋友嗎？有幾個。大部分人都很友善。

items.en: "How many sweets did you eat?" "Only three, Mum!"
items.zh: 你吃了幾顆糖？只有三顆，媽！

items.en: "Do you get many emails?" "Yes, about a hundred a day."
items.zh: 你收到很多電子郵件嗎？對，一天大概一百封。

items.en: "How many people work in your office?" "About twenty."
items.zh: 你們辦公室有多少人？大約二十個。

title: There aren't many tickets.
translation: 票沒有很多。
name: 否定句的 many 加複數名詞
sentences: Let's buy them today. There aren't many tickets for the concert.
There aren't many cafés near my office, so I bring my lunch.
There aren't many trees in the city centre.
Come early. There aren't many seats in the hall.
It was raining, so there weren't many people at the beach.
There weren't many cars on the road on Christmas morning.
The test was easy. There weren't many difficult questions.
There weren't many children at the park because of the cold.
I bought two jumpers because I haven't got many winter clothes.
We've just moved here, so we don't have many friends yet.
I don't have many books in English. Can I borrow one?
Our village hasn't got many buses at the weekend.
The weather was bad, so we didn't take many photos.
I didn't buy many presents this year. I made cards instead.
He didn't make many mistakes in his essay.
We didn't have many lessons on Friday because of the sports day.
Not many students came to the meeting.
I don't eat many sweets. They're bad for my teeth.
The new film is very long. Not many viewers stayed until the end.
My grandma doesn't send many emails. She prefers to call.
"Are there any good shops in your town?" "Not many. It's very small."
"Did many people come to your party?" "No, not many. About ten."
"Have you got any eggs?" "Not many. Only two."

examples.heading: ① There aren't many + 複數名詞

items.en: Let's buy them today. There aren't many tickets for the concert.
items.zh: 我們今天就買吧。演唱會的票沒有很多。

items.en: There aren't many cafés near my office, so I bring my lunch.
items.zh: 我公司附近咖啡店不多，所以我自己帶午餐。

items.en: There aren't many trees in the city centre.
items.zh: 市中心的樹不多。

items.en: Come early. There aren't many seats in the hall.
items.zh: 早點來。禮堂的座位不多。

examples.heading: ② There weren't many + 複數名詞

items.en: It was raining, so there weren't many people at the beach.
items.zh: 那天下雨，所以海邊人不多。

items.en: There weren't many cars on the road on Christmas morning.
items.zh: 聖誕節早上路上車不多。

items.en: The test was easy. There weren't many difficult questions.
items.zh: 考試很簡單。難題不多。

items.en: There weren't many children at the park because of the cold.
items.zh: 天氣太冷，公園裡小孩不多。

examples.heading: ③ haven't got / don't have many + 複數名詞

items.en: I bought two jumpers because I haven't got many winter clothes.
items.zh: 我買了兩件毛衣，因為我的冬天衣服不多。

items.en: We've just moved here, so we don't have many friends yet.
items.zh: 我們剛搬來，所以還沒有很多朋友。

items.en: I don't have many books in English. Can I borrow one?
items.zh: 我的英文書不多。可以借我一本嗎？

items.en: Our village hasn't got many buses at the weekend.
items.zh: 我們村子週末的公車不多。

examples.heading: ④ didn't + 動詞 + many + 複數名詞

items.en: The weather was bad, so we didn't take many photos.
items.zh: 天氣不好，所以我們沒拍很多照片。

items.en: I didn't buy many presents this year. I made cards instead.
items.zh: 我今年沒買很多禮物。我改成自己做卡片。

items.en: He didn't make many mistakes in his essay.
items.zh: 他的作文沒犯什麼錯。

items.en: We didn't have many lessons on Friday because of the sports day.
items.zh: 因為運動會，我們星期五的課不多。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Not many students came to the meeting.
items.zh: 來開會的學生不多。

items.en: I don't eat many sweets. They're bad for my teeth.
items.zh: 我不常吃糖果。對牙齒不好。

items.en: The new film is very long. Not many viewers stayed until the end.
items.zh: 那部新電影很長。看到最後的觀眾不多。

items.en: My grandma doesn't send many emails. She prefers to call.
items.zh: 我奶奶不常寄電子郵件。她比較喜歡打電話。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Are there any good shops in your town?" "Not many. It's very small."
items.zh: 你們鎮上有好的商店嗎？不多。鎮很小。

items.en: "Did many people come to your party?" "No, not many. About ten."
items.zh: 很多人來你的派對嗎？沒有，不多。大概十個。

items.en: "Have you got any eggs?" "Not many. Only two."
items.zh: 你有蛋嗎？不多。只有兩顆。

title: Since we were little kids, we've spent nearly every day together.
translation: 我們從小到大幾乎每天都待在一起。
name: 副詞修飾限定詞
sentences: My best friend is called Richard. Since we were little kids, we've spent nearly every day together.
I love this café. I come here almost every morning.
Nearly every house in our street has a garden.
Almost every student in my class has a part-time job.
It rained nearly every day of our holiday.
I don't watch TV any more, because almost all of the programmes are stupid.
Nearly all my friends live in the city now.
Almost all the food was gone by nine o'clock.
We've sold nearly all the tickets for Saturday's show.
Read to your son every night. Almost all children love stories.
Not every hotel has free Wi-Fi, so check before you book.
Not all my teachers are strict. Some are really friendly.
Not every child enjoys sport, and that's OK.
The exam wasn't too bad. Not all the questions were difficult.
There's hardly any milk left. Can you buy some?
Hardly any people came to the meeting because of the snow.
I've got hardly any money until payday.
We saw hardly any animals on the safari. It was too hot.
The office is very quiet this week. Quite a few people at work have the flu.
I've read quite a lot of books this summer.
My teacher wasn't happy. There were quite a few mistakes in my essay.
She's got quite a lot of friends in London.
The test was too long. Only a few students finished it on time.
There's only a little coffee left, so let's share it.
It was a surprise for Mum. Just a few people knew about the party.
Only some of the rooms have a sea view.
My grandma calls me almost every Sunday.
Do your shopping early. Nearly all the shops close at six here.
Hardly any of my friends have a car.
"Do you go to the gym often?" "Almost every day."
"Did everyone like the film?" "Not everyone. Quite a few people left early."

examples.heading: ① nearly / almost every

items.en: My best friend is called Richard. Since we were little kids, we've spent nearly every day together.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友叫 Richard。我們從小到大幾乎每天都待在一起。

items.en: I love this café. I come here almost every morning.
items.zh: 我很喜歡這家咖啡店。我幾乎每天早上都來。

items.en: Nearly every house in our street has a garden.
items.zh: 我們這條街幾乎每一間房子都有花園。

items.en: Almost every student in my class has a part-time job.
items.zh: 我們班幾乎每個學生都有打工。

items.en: It rained nearly every day of our holiday.
items.zh: 我們度假的時候幾乎每天都下雨。

examples.heading: ② nearly / almost all

items.en: I don't watch TV any more, because almost all of the programmes are stupid.
items.zh: 我不再看電視了，因為幾乎所有節目都很蠢。

items.en: Nearly all my friends live in the city now.
items.zh: 我幾乎所有朋友現在都住在城市裡。

items.en: Almost all the food was gone by nine o'clock.
items.zh: 九點的時候，食物幾乎都沒了。

items.en: We've sold nearly all the tickets for Saturday's show.
items.zh: 星期六演出的票我們幾乎都賣完了。

items.en: Read to your son every night. Almost all children love stories.
items.zh: 每天晚上唸書給你兒子聽。幾乎所有孩子都喜歡聽故事。

examples.heading: ③ not every / not all

items.en: Not every hotel has free Wi-Fi, so check before you book.
items.zh: 不是每間旅館都有免費 Wi-Fi，所以訂房前要查一下。

items.en: Not all my teachers are strict. Some are really friendly.
items.zh: 不是所有老師都很嚴格。有些很友善。

items.en: Not every child enjoys sport, and that's OK.
items.zh: 不是每個孩子都喜歡運動，這沒關係。

items.en: The exam wasn't too bad. Not all the questions were difficult.
items.zh: 考試沒那麼糟。不是所有題目都很難。

examples.heading: ④ hardly any

items.en: There's hardly any milk left. Can you buy some?
items.zh: 牛奶幾乎沒了。你可以去買一些嗎？

items.en: Hardly any people came to the meeting because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，幾乎沒人來開會。

items.en: I've got hardly any money until payday.
items.zh: 發薪日之前我幾乎沒錢了。

items.en: We saw hardly any animals on the safari. It was too hot.
items.zh: 我們去野生動物園幾乎沒看到動物。天氣太熱了。

examples.heading: ⑤ quite a few / quite a lot of

items.en: The office is very quiet this week. Quite a few people at work have the flu.
items.zh: 這星期辦公室很安靜。公司裡不少人得了流感。

items.en: I've read quite a lot of books this summer.
items.zh: 這個夏天我讀了不少書。

items.en: My teacher wasn't happy. There were quite a few mistakes in my essay.
items.zh: 老師不太滿意。我的作文裡有不少錯誤。

items.en: She's got quite a lot of friends in London.
items.zh: 她在倫敦有不少朋友。

examples.heading: ⑥ only / just + 限定詞

items.en: The test was too long. Only a few students finished it on time.
items.zh: 考試太長了。只有幾個學生準時寫完。

items.en: There's only a little coffee left, so let's share it.
items.zh: 咖啡只剩一點點，我們分著喝吧。

items.en: It was a surprise for Mum. Just a few people knew about the party.
items.zh: 那是給媽媽的驚喜。只有幾個人知道派對的事。

items.en: Only some of the rooms have a sea view.
items.zh: 只有一部分房間看得到海。

examples.heading: ⑦ 不同的情境

items.en: My grandma calls me almost every Sunday.
items.zh: 我奶奶幾乎每個星期天都打給我。

items.en: Do your shopping early. Nearly all the shops close at six here.
items.zh: 早點去買東西。這裡幾乎所有商店六點就關門。

items.en: Hardly any of my friends have a car.
items.zh: 我的朋友幾乎都沒有車。

examples.heading: ⑧ 對話

items.en: "Do you go to the gym often?" "Almost every day."
items.zh: 你常去健身房嗎？幾乎每天。

items.en: "Did everyone like the film?" "Not everyone. Quite a few people left early."
items.zh: 每個人都喜歡那部電影嗎？不是每個人。不少人提早走了。

title: How much television do you watch?
translation: 你平常電視看多少？
name: 疑問句中 much 加不可數名詞
sentences: We're doing a survey about teenagers. How much television do you watch?
I'm going to the bank. How much money do you need?
You look tired. How much sleep do you get at night?
How much homework do you have this weekend?
How much time do you spend on the internet every day?
How much rain did you have on holiday?
How much water have you had today? Drink some more.
How much luggage are you taking on the plane?
How much bread did you buy? We need some for tomorrow.
Do you watch much TV in the evenings?
Do you get much free time at your new job?
You were in Scotland at Christmas. Did you see much snow there?
Does your dog need much exercise?
Is there much traffic in the city centre in the morning?
Was there much food left after the party?
Is there much milk in the fridge, or should I buy some?
Was there much noise from the building work?
Have you got much work to do before the holiday?
Have you got much experience with children?
Have we got much time before the train leaves?
Can you tell me how much sugar I need for this cake?
I don't know how much money we spent on holiday.

examples.heading: ① How much + 不可數名詞 + do you ...?

items.zh: 我要去銀行。你需要多少錢？

items.zh: 你看起來很累。你晚上睡多少？

items.zh: 你這個週末有多少功課？

examples.heading: ② How much + 不可數名詞 + did / have ...?

items.zh: 你們度假的時候雨下得多嗎？

items.zh: 你今天喝了多少水？再多喝一點。

items.en: How much bread did you buy? We need some for tomorrow.

examples.heading: ③ Do you ... much + 不可數名詞？

items.zh: 你的狗需要很多運動嗎？

items.zh: 你跟小孩相處的經驗多嗎？

items.en: Have we got much time before the train leaves?
items.zh: 火車開之前我們還有很多時間嗎？

items.zh: 你一天喝多少咖啡？太多了！大概五杯。

title: I want to sell the television because I haven't got much time to watch it.
translation: 我想把電視賣掉，因為我沒什麼時間看。
name: 否定句的 much 加不可數名詞

There isn't much space in my bedroom for a desk.
There wasn't much news in the paper today.
Don't buy that phone. It doesn't have much memory.
I don't drink much coffee. It keeps me awake.
The film didn't get much attention, but I loved it.
We haven't had much rain this summer, so the garden is very dry.
Sorry I didn't write sooner. I haven't had much free time with all my exams.
The hotel is nice, but there isn't much choice of food in the restaurant.
I'm learning to cook, but I don't have much experience yet.
"Is there any bread?" "Not much. Just two slices."
"Did you do much work today?" "No, not much. I was tired."
"How was the party?" "Boring. There wasn't much music."

items.zh: 我哥哥對小孩子沒什麼耐心。

title: They can give us a small discount because the owner is a friend of my father's.

title: Living in Greece, I have had a chance to realize how much tourism can affect one's life.
translation: 住在希臘讓我有機會了解到，觀光對一個人的生活影響有多大。
name: one's 泛指一般人的所有格
sentences: Living in Greece, I have had a chance to realize how much tourism can affect one's life.
In my opinion, learning a language depends on one's ability to communicate in other ways, apart from one's mother tongue.
Moving to a new country can change one's view of the world.
Regular exercise is good for one's health and mood.
Travel broadens one's mind.
After one has spent enough time away from one's parents, it is possible to move back in with them.
It is natural to want to make one's parents proud.
One's family can be one's greatest support in difficult times.
Once one has a personality of one's own, living with one's parents is less difficult.
As a teenager, one longs for a room of one's own.
It takes time to develop a style of one's own.
One should never judge others by one's own standards.
One must always try to do one's best.
It is important to know one's own limits.
One should keep one's opinions to oneself at a job interview.
Losing one's job can be a very stressful experience.
One's freedom should never be taken for granted.
One's first year at university is often the hardest.
Reading widely improves one's writing.
It's not easy to change one's mind once a decision is made.
One needs to have a little faith in one's own abilities.
Sometimes it is wise to hold one's tongue.

examples.heading: ① 論說文：一般人的生活

items.en: Living in Greece, I have had a chance to realize how much tourism can affect one's life.
items.zh: 住在希臘讓我有機會了解到，觀光對一個人的生活影響有多大。

items.en: In my opinion, learning a language depends on one's ability to communicate in other ways, apart from one's mother tongue.
items.zh: 我認為學語言要看一個人能不能用母語以外的方式溝通。

items.en: Moving to a new country can change one's view of the world.
items.zh: 搬到一個新國家，可能改變一個人的世界觀。

items.en: Regular exercise is good for one's health and mood.
items.zh: 規律運動對一個人的健康和心情都有好處。

items.en: Travel broadens one's mind.
items.zh: 旅行讓人眼界開闊。

examples.heading: ② one's + 家人

items.en: After one has spent enough time away from one's parents, it is possible to move back in with them.
items.zh: 一個人離開父母夠久以後，再搬回去和他們住是可能的。

items.en: It is natural to want to make one's parents proud.
items.zh: 想讓父母感到驕傲是很自然的。

items.en: One's family can be one's greatest support in difficult times.
items.zh: 在困難的時候，家人可能是一個人最大的支柱。

examples.heading: ③ of one's own

items.zh: 一個人有了自己的個性以後，和父母同住就沒那麼難。

items.en: As a teenager, one longs for a room of one's own.
items.zh: 青少年時期，一個人會渴望有自己的房間。

items.en: It takes time to develop a style of one's own.
items.zh: 發展出自己的風格需要時間。

examples.heading: ④ 建議和規則

items.en: One should never judge others by one's own standards.
items.zh: 一個人不該用自己的標準評斷別人。

items.en: One must always try to do one's best.
items.zh: 一個人應該永遠盡力而為。

items.en: It is important to know one's own limits.
items.zh: 了解自己的極限很重要。

items.en: One should keep one's opinions to oneself at a job interview.

examples.heading: ⑤ 演講和正式的寫作

items.zh: 失業可能是一段壓力很大的經驗。

items.en: One's freedom should never be taken for granted.
items.zh: 一個人的自由永遠不該被視為理所當然。

items.en: One's first year at university is often the hardest.
items.zh: 一個人上大學的第一年往往最辛苦。

items.en: Reading widely improves one's writing.
items.zh: 廣泛閱讀能讓一個人的寫作進步。

items.zh: 我下個月有兩天假。
