items.zh: 那間旅館走路到海邊要十分鐘。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的情境

items.en: Most of my friends' parents work in the city.
items.zh: 我大部分朋友的爸媽都在城裡上班。

items.en: The neighbours' dog barked all night.
items.zh: 鄰居家的狗叫了一整晚。

items.en: The workers' new contract starts in January.
items.zh: 工人的新合約一月開始。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Whose coats are these?" "They're the guests'. Put them in the bedroom."
items.zh: 這些是誰的外套？是客人的。放到臥室去。

items.en: "Where did you stay?" "At my cousins' flat in London."
items.zh: 你住在哪裡？住在我表兄弟姊妹在倫敦的公寓。

items.en: "Is this the boys' bathroom?" "No, it's the next one."
items.zh: 這是男生廁所嗎？不是，是隔壁那間。

title: I go to college every day.
translation: 我每天都去學校。
name: 介系詞後不加冠詞的固定說法
sentences: My little brother started going to school last year.
She goes to college in the evening after work.
My daughter is at school until three.
I want to go to university in Canada.
My mum is at work until six.
I usually walk to work in the summer.
Dad gets home from work at seven.
Please don't phone me at work.
I stay at home on rainy days.
Is your sister at home now?
After the party we went home in a taxi.
My grandfather works from home three days a week.
Ana left home at eighteen.
The children go to bed at eight.
I was ill and stayed in bed all day.
Mia reads in bed every night before she sleeps.
What time did you go to bed last night?
I go to the city centre by bus.
We travelled from London to Rome by plane.
It takes two hours by train.
My uncle goes everywhere by bike.
We can get there by taxi in ten minutes.
The beach is ten minutes from here on foot.
We explored the old town on foot.
Most students come to school on foot.
Mum went to the school to pick up my lunch box.
Please put the clean sheets on the bed.
I sat on the bed and opened the letter.
Dad went to the college to see the new library.
There's a big tree behind the school.

examples.heading: ① to school、to college

items.en: My little brother started going to school last year.
items.zh: 我弟弟去年開始上學。

items.en: She goes to college in the evening after work.
items.zh: 她下班後晚上去上課。

items.en: My daughter is at school until three.
items.zh: 我女兒在學校上課到三點。

items.en: I want to go to university in Canada.
items.zh: 我想去加拿大讀大學。

examples.heading: ② at work、to work

items.en: My mum is at work until six.
items.zh: 我媽媽上班到六點。

items.en: I usually walk to work in the summer.
items.zh: 我夏天通常走路上班。

items.en: Dad gets home from work at seven.
items.zh: 爸爸七點下班回到家。

items.en: Please don't phone me at work.
items.zh: 請不要在我上班時打電話給我。

examples.heading: ③ at home、go home

items.en: I stay at home on rainy days.
items.zh: 下雨天我都待在家裡。

items.en: Is your sister at home now?
items.zh: 你姊姊現在在家嗎？

items.en: After the party we went home in a taxi.
items.zh: 派對結束後我們搭計程車回家。

items.en: My grandfather works from home three days a week.
items.zh: 我爺爺一星期有三天在家工作。

items.en: Ana left home at eighteen.
items.zh: Ana 十八歲就離家了。

examples.heading: ④ to bed、in bed

items.en: The children go to bed at eight.
items.zh: 孩子們八點上床睡覺。

items.en: I was ill and stayed in bed all day.
items.zh: 我生病了，整天躺在床上。

items.en: Mia reads in bed every night before she sleeps.
items.zh: Mia 每天晚上睡前在床上看書。

items.en: What time did you go to bed last night?
items.zh: 你昨晚幾點睡？

examples.heading: ⑤ by + 交通工具

items.en: I go to the city centre by bus.
items.zh: 我搭公車去市中心。

items.en: We travelled from London to Rome by plane.
items.zh: 我們從倫敦搭飛機到羅馬。

items.en: It takes two hours by train.
items.zh: 搭火車要兩個小時。

items.en: My uncle goes everywhere by bike.
items.zh: 我叔叔去哪裡都騎腳踏車。

items.en: We can get there by taxi in ten minutes.
items.zh: 搭計程車十分鐘就到了。

examples.heading: ⑥ on foot

items.en: The beach is ten minutes from here on foot.
items.zh: 從這裡走路到海灘要十分鐘。

items.en: We explored the old town on foot.
items.zh: 我們走路逛老城區。

items.en: Most students come to school on foot.
items.zh: 大部分學生走路上學。

examples.heading: ⑦ 加 the 時意思不同

items.en: Mum went to the school to pick up my lunch box.
items.zh: 媽媽去學校拿我的便當盒。

items.en: Please put the clean sheets on the bed.
items.zh: 請把乾淨的床單鋪在床上。

items.en: I sat on the bed and opened the letter.
items.zh: 我坐在床上，打開那封信。

items.en: Dad went to the college to see the new library.
items.zh: 爸爸去那所學院看新的圖書館。

items.en: There's a big tree behind the school.
items.zh: 學校後面有一棵大樹。

title: This program will be shown on television next Friday.
translation: 這個節目下週五會在電視上播出。
name: 介系詞後不加冠詞的固定說法（較多種名詞）
sentences: The match will be on television tonight at eight.
I watched an interesting documentary on TV last night.
Her father appears on television every Sunday.
There's nothing good on TV this evening.
In the desert, it's hot during the day but freezing at night.
My uncle spent six months at sea on a fishing boat.
At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
Owls hunt at night.
The Johnsons are on holiday in Greece this week.
Please try to be on time for the meeting.
I met my husband while I was on holiday in Italy.
Our flight left on time for once.
My grandmother has been in hospital for a week.
He spent ten years in prison.
I'd like to thank you in person.
Is it OK to eat in public here?
You can contact us by email or by phone.
All the pots in this shop are made by hand.
My aunt still writes her letters by hand.
We booked the hotel by phone.
I took your umbrella by mistake. Sorry!
We met by chance at the airport.
He didn't break the window on purpose.
I deleted the photos by mistake.
We arrived just in time to see the start of the show.
Rosa has never handed in her homework on time.
Will the repairs be finished in time for Christmas?
The concert started on time at half past seven.
I heard the news on the radio this morning.
My favourite song was on the radio in the car.

examples.heading: ① on television、on TV

items.en: The match will be on television tonight at eight.
items.zh: 那場比賽今晚八點會在電視上轉播。

items.en: I watched an interesting documentary on TV last night.
items.zh: 我昨晚在電視上看了一部很有意思的紀錄片。

items.en: Her father appears on television every Sunday.
items.zh: 她爸爸每個星期天都上電視。

items.en: There's nothing good on TV this evening.
items.zh: 今晚電視沒什麼好看的。

examples.heading: ② at night、at sea、at first

items.en: In the desert, it's hot during the day but freezing at night.
items.zh: 沙漠白天很熱，晚上卻冷得要命。

items.en: My uncle spent six months at sea on a fishing boat.
items.zh: 我叔叔在一艘漁船上出海了六個月。

items.en: At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
items.zh: 一開始我不喜歡這座城市，可是現在很愛。

items.en: Owls hunt at night.
items.zh: 貓頭鷹晚上捕獵。

examples.heading: ③ on holiday、on time

items.en: The Johnsons are on holiday in Greece this week.
items.zh: Johnson 一家這星期在希臘度假。

items.en: Please try to be on time for the meeting.
items.zh: 開會請盡量準時。

items.en: I met my husband while I was on holiday in Italy.
items.zh: 我在義大利度假時認識我先生。

items.en: Our flight left on time for once.
items.zh: 我們的班機難得準時起飛。

examples.heading: ④ in hospital、in prison、in person

items.en: My grandmother has been in hospital for a week.
items.zh: 我奶奶已經住院一星期了。

items.en: He spent ten years in prison.
items.zh: 他坐了十年牢。

items.en: I'd like to thank you in person.
items.zh: 我想當面謝謝你。

items.en: Is it OK to eat in public here?
items.zh: 在這裡公開吃東西可以嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ by email、by phone、by hand

items.en: You can contact us by email or by phone.
items.zh: 你可以用電子郵件或電話聯絡我們。

items.en: All the pots in this shop are made by hand.
items.zh: 這家店所有的陶壺都是手工做的。

items.en: My aunt still writes her letters by hand.
items.zh: 我阿姨還是用手寫信。

items.en: We booked the hotel by phone.
items.zh: 我們打電話訂了飯店。

examples.heading: ⑥ by mistake、by chance、on purpose

items.en: I took your umbrella by mistake. Sorry!
items.zh: 我不小心拿錯你的傘了。對不起！

items.en: We met by chance at the airport.
items.zh: 我們在機場偶然碰到。

items.en: He didn't break the window on purpose.
items.zh: 他不是故意打破窗戶的。

items.en: I deleted the photos by mistake.
items.zh: 我不小心把照片刪了。

examples.heading: ⑦ in time、on time 和 on the radio

items.en: We arrived just in time to see the start of the show.
items.zh: 我們剛好及時趕上表演開場。

items.en: Rosa has never handed in her homework on time.
items.zh: Rosa 從來沒有準時交過作業。

items.en: Will the repairs be finished in time for Christmas?
items.zh: 修理會在聖誕節前完成嗎？

items.en: The concert started on time at half past seven.
items.zh: 音樂會在七點半準時開始。

items.en: I heard the news on the radio this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上在收音機上聽到這個消息。

items.en: My favourite song was on the radio in the car.
items.zh: 車上的收音機正在播我最喜歡的歌。

title: I work on the weekend.
translation: 我週末要上班。
name: the 用在表示時間的介系詞片語
sentences: I usually go running in the morning.
Our first lesson starts at half past eight in the morning.
My dad reads the newspaper in the morning.
I feel tired in the morning before breakfast.
We have art and music in the afternoon.
My baby sister sleeps for two hours in the afternoon.
The museum is quiet in the afternoon.
Can we play tennis in the afternoon?
I do my homework in the evening.
My parents watch the news in the evening.
The park is beautiful in the evening.
Grandma phones us every Sunday in the evening.
I'm very busy from Monday to Friday, but I'm free on the weekend.
We often visit my grandparents at the weekend.
The shopping centre is very crowded on the weekend.
Do you and Sara ever go hiking at the weekend?
My brother plays basketball with his friends on the weekend.
It's very hot here in the summer.
We go skiing in the winter.
The days are long in the summer.
I wear a hat and gloves in the winter.
I have swimming lessons on Tuesday.
The owls in the forest are awake at night.
Mum goes to her yoga class on Wednesday.
It gets very cold in the desert at night.
Our piano teacher doesn't work on Thursday.
My driving test is on Tuesday in the afternoon.
We have a meeting on Monday morning.
Let's go to the beach on Saturday afternoon.
My friends come round on Thursday evening.
I clean the house on Sunday morning.

examples.heading: ① in the morning

items.en: I usually go running in the morning.
items.zh: 我通常早上去跑步。

items.en: Our first lesson starts at half past eight in the morning.
items.zh: 我們第一堂課早上八點半開始。

items.en: My dad reads the newspaper in the morning.
items.zh: 我爸爸早上看報紙。

items.en: I feel tired in the morning before breakfast.
items.zh: 吃早餐前，我早上都覺得很累。

examples.heading: ② in the afternoon

items.en: We have art and music in the afternoon.
items.zh: 我們下午有美術課和音樂課。

items.en: My baby sister sleeps for two hours in the afternoon.
items.zh: 我妹妹下午會睡兩個小時。

items.en: The museum is quiet in the afternoon.
items.zh: 博物館下午人很少。

items.en: Can we play tennis in the afternoon?
items.zh: 我們下午可以打網球嗎？

examples.heading: ③ in the evening

items.en: I do my homework in the evening.
items.zh: 我晚上寫作業。

items.en: My parents watch the news in the evening.
items.zh: 我爸媽晚上看新聞。

items.en: The park is beautiful in the evening.
items.zh: 公園傍晚很美。

items.en: Grandma phones us every Sunday in the evening.
items.zh: 奶奶每個星期天晚上打電話給我們。

examples.heading: ④ on the weekend、at the weekend

items.en: I'm very busy from Monday to Friday, but I'm free on the weekend.
items.zh: 我星期一到星期五很忙，可是週末有空。

items.en: We often visit my grandparents at the weekend.
items.zh: 我們週末常去看爺爺奶奶。

items.en: The shopping centre is very crowded on the weekend.
items.zh: 購物中心週末人很多。

items.en: Do you and Sara ever go hiking at the weekend?
items.zh: 你和 Sara 週末會去爬山嗎？

items.en: My brother plays basketball with his friends on the weekend.
items.zh: 我哥哥週末會跟朋友打籃球。

examples.heading: ⑤ in the summer、in the winter

items.en: It's very hot here in the summer.
items.zh: 這裡夏天很熱。

items.en: We go skiing in the winter.
items.zh: 我們冬天去滑雪。

items.en: The days are long in the summer.
items.zh: 夏天的白天很長。

items.en: I wear a hat and gloves in the winter.
items.zh: 我冬天會戴帽子和手套。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不加 the：星期幾和 night

items.en: I have swimming lessons on Tuesday.
items.zh: 我星期二有游泳課。

items.en: The owls in the forest are awake at night.
items.zh: 森林裡的貓頭鷹晚上醒著。

items.en: Mum goes to her yoga class on Wednesday.
items.zh: 媽媽星期三去上瑜伽課。

items.en: It gets very cold in the desert at night.
items.zh: 沙漠晚上變得很冷。

items.en: Our piano teacher doesn't work on Thursday.
items.zh: 我們的鋼琴老師星期四不上班。

examples.heading: ⑦ 星期幾 + 時段

items.en: My driving test is on Tuesday in the afternoon.
items.zh: 我的路考在星期二下午。

items.en: We have a meeting on Monday morning.
items.zh: 我們星期一早上有會議。

items.en: Let's go to the beach on Saturday afternoon.
items.zh: 我們星期六下午去海邊吧。

items.en: My friends come round on Thursday evening.
items.zh: 我朋友星期四晚上會來我家。

items.en: I clean the house on Sunday morning.
items.zh: 我星期天早上打掃家裡。

title: They spent two weeks together at Emily's grandmother's house.
translation: 他們在 Emily 的奶奶家一起待了兩個星期。
name: 一個名詞片語中連用兩個所有格 's
sentences: After fourteen months of dating, they spent two weeks together at Emily's grandmother's house.
We had the party at my best friend's parents' flat.
The wedding was in Tom's uncle's garden.
I spent the summer at my cousin's aunt's farm in Wales.
Nobody knew what he looked like. There were no photographs of him in Ann's mother's albums.
I found my grandfather's father's watch in an old box.
She wore her mother's mother's wedding ring.
The story is based on the writer's father's diaries.
I borrowed my sister's friend's car for the weekend.
The police found the thief in his neighbour's son's garage.
Have you read my brother's girlfriend's novel? It's really good.
The plan was my manager's boss's idea, not hers.
The detective noticed that the letter was written in the victim's brother's handwriting.
The child had been living at his mother's partner's house for a year.
The singer's late husband's paintings were sold for millions.
We're invited to my colleague's daughter's christening.
The dog in the photo is my friend's grandmother's.
Jack's wife's family live in Canada.
"Whose bike is this?" "It's my flatmate's brother's. He left it here."
"Where did you meet him?" "At Sarah's sister's birthday party."
"Is that your coat?" "No, it's my husband's father's."

examples.heading: ① 名詞 's + 家人 's + 地方

items.en: After fourteen months of dating, they spent two weeks together at Emily's grandmother's house.
items.zh: 交往了十四個月以後，他們在 Emily 的奶奶家一起待了兩個星期。

items.en: We had the party at my best friend's parents' flat.
items.zh: 我們在我最好朋友的爸媽家辦派對。

items.en: The wedding was in Tom's uncle's garden.
items.zh: 婚禮在 Tom 的叔叔家的花園舉行。

items.en: I spent the summer at my cousin's aunt's farm in Wales.
items.zh: 我那年夏天在威爾斯，住在我表哥的阿姨的農場。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 's + 家人 's + 東西

items.en: Nobody knew what he looked like. There were no photographs of him in Ann's mother's albums.
items.zh: 沒人知道他長什麼樣子。Ann 她媽媽的相簿裡沒有一張他的照片。

items.en: I found my grandfather's father's watch in an old box.
items.zh: 我在一個舊箱子裡找到我曾祖父的手錶。

items.en: She wore her mother's mother's wedding ring.
items.zh: 她戴著她外婆的結婚戒指。

items.en: The story is based on the writer's father's diaries.
items.zh: 這個故事是根據作者父親的日記寫的。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 's + 朋友或同事 's + 東西

items.en: I borrowed my sister's friend's car for the weekend.
items.zh: 我週末借了我姊姊的朋友的車。

items.en: The police found the thief in his neighbour's son's garage.
items.zh: 警察在他鄰居兒子的車庫裡找到那個小偷。

items.en: Have you read my brother's girlfriend's novel? It's really good.
items.zh: 你讀過我哥哥女朋友寫的小說嗎？寫得很好。

items.en: The plan was my manager's boss's idea, not hers.
items.zh: 這個計畫是我主管的上司想的，不是她想的。

examples.heading: ④ 小說和報導

items.en: The detective noticed that the letter was written in the victim's brother's handwriting.
items.zh: 偵探發現那封信是被害人的哥哥的筆跡。

items.en: The child had been living at his mother's partner's house for a year.
items.zh: 那個孩子在他媽媽的伴侶家住了一年。

items.en: The singer's late husband's paintings were sold for millions.
items.zh: 那位歌手已故丈夫的畫賣了好幾百萬。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: We're invited to my colleague's daughter's christening.
items.zh: 我們受邀去參加我同事女兒的受洗典禮。

items.en: The dog in the photo is my friend's grandmother's.
items.zh: 照片裡的狗是我朋友的奶奶養的。

items.en: Jack's wife's family live in Canada.
items.zh: Jack 太太的家人住在加拿大。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Whose bike is this?" "It's my flatmate's brother's. He left it here."
items.zh: 這是誰的腳踏車？是我室友的哥哥的。他放在這裡。

items.en: "Where did you meet him?" "At Sarah's sister's birthday party."
items.zh: 你在哪裡認識他的？在 Sarah 她姊姊的生日派對上。

items.en: "Is that your coat?" "No, it's my husband's father's."
items.zh: 那是你的外套嗎？不是，是我公公的。

title: I heard a familiar voice; it was my father's.
translation: 我聽到一個熟悉的聲音，是我爸爸的。
name: 所有格 's 後省略名詞（已提過或可推知）
sentences: Someone was shaking me, and then I heard a familiar voice; it was my father's.
After two weeks I realised that my bank account was empty, and so was my friend's.
The story is told by a narrator. Olivia's experiences are probably the narrator's.
My essay was good, but Maria's was even better.
Your car is much bigger than my parents'.
My phone is older than my sister's, but it works better.
Their garden is smaller than the Browns'.
Tom's idea was better than his manager's.
His handwriting is easier to read than the doctor's.
We're having dinner at my grandmother's on Sunday.
I stayed at a friend's last night because I missed the last train.
The party is at Lucy's, so bring something to drink.
My tooth hurts. I'm going to the dentist's after work.
She went to the hairdresser's before the wedding.
Can you pick up some meat from the butcher's?
I had to wait an hour at the doctor's this morning.
The police found two sets of footprints. One was the thief's, but whose was the other?
The bag on the train wasn't the victim's. It belonged to a passenger.
The decision wasn't the government's. It was the court's.
"Is this your umbrella?" "No, I think it's Sam's."
"Whose coat is this?" "It's the teacher's. She left it in the classroom."
"Where were you last night?" "At my cousin's. We watched a film."

examples.heading: ① 前面提過的名詞

items.en: Someone was shaking me, and then I heard a familiar voice; it was my father's.
items.zh: 有人在搖我，接著我聽到一個熟悉的聲音，是我爸爸的。

items.en: After two weeks I realised that my bank account was empty, and so was my friend's.
items.zh: 兩個星期後，我發現我的銀行帳戶空了，我朋友的也是。

items.en: The story is told by a narrator. Olivia's experiences are probably the narrator's.
items.zh: 這個故事由一個敘事者來講。Olivia 的經歷大概就是敘事者的經歷。

items.en: My essay was good, but Maria's was even better.
items.zh: 我的作文寫得不錯，可是 Maria 的更好。

items.en: Your car is much bigger than my parents'.
items.zh: 你的車比我爸媽的大很多。

examples.heading: ② 比較兩樣東西

items.en: My phone is older than my sister's, but it works better.
items.zh: 我的手機比我妹妹的舊，可是比較好用。

items.en: Their garden is smaller than the Browns'.
items.zh: 他們家的花園比 Brown 家的小。

items.en: Tom's idea was better than his manager's.
items.zh: Tom 的點子比他主管的好。

items.en: His handwriting is easier to read than the doctor's.
items.zh: 他的字比醫生的好認。

examples.heading: ③ 某人的家

items.en: We're having dinner at my grandmother's on Sunday.
items.zh: 我們星期天在奶奶家吃晚餐。

items.en: I stayed at a friend's last night because I missed the last train.
items.zh: 我昨晚住朋友家，因為我錯過了最後一班火車。

items.en: The party is at Lucy's, so bring something to drink.
items.zh: 派對在 Lucy 家，帶點喝的來。

examples.heading: ④ 店和診所

items.en: My tooth hurts. I'm going to the dentist's after work.
items.zh: 我牙齒痛。下班後要去看牙醫。

items.en: She went to the hairdresser's before the wedding.
items.zh: 她在婚禮前去了美髮店。

items.en: Can you pick up some meat from the butcher's?
items.zh: 你可以去肉店買點肉嗎？

items.en: I had to wait an hour at the doctor's this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上在診所等了一個小時。

examples.heading: ⑤ 故事和報導

items.en: The police found two sets of footprints. One was the thief's, but whose was the other?
items.zh: 警察找到兩組腳印。一組是小偷的，可是另一組是誰的？

items.en: The bag on the train wasn't the victim's. It belonged to a passenger.
items.zh: 火車上那個包包不是被害人的。是一位乘客的。

items.en: The decision wasn't the government's. It was the court's.
items.zh: 這個決定不是政府做的。是法院做的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Is this your umbrella?" "No, I think it's Sam's."
items.zh: 這是你的傘嗎？不是，我想是 Sam 的。

items.en: "Whose coat is this?" "It's the teacher's. She left it in the classroom."
items.zh: 這是誰的外套？是老師的。她忘在教室了。

items.en: "Where were you last night?" "At my cousin's. We watched a film."
items.zh: 你昨晚在哪裡？在我表姊家。我們看了一部電影。

title: To maintain its popularity, the program should keep some of the series' aspects the same.

name: 字尾是 s 的單數名詞加撇號
sentences: To maintain its popularity, the program should keep some of the series' aspects the same, but change others.
The series' final episode will be shown on Friday.
Scientists are studying the species' behavior in the wild.
The species' numbers have fallen sharply in the last ten years.
Many fans were unhappy with the series' new director.
We stayed at James's house for the weekend.
Charles's new book comes out next month.
Have you seen Chris's photos from Japan?
Mrs Jones's class is going on a trip to the museum.
Dickens' novels describe life in nineteenth-century London.
The exhibition shows Degas' early paintings.
Many tourists visit Achilles' statue in the park.
In my view, the series' success comes from its strong characters.
The species' survival depends on clean rivers.
The series' writers have promised a surprise ending.
Our class's project won first prize.
The bus's engine broke down on the motorway.
The princess's dress was designed in Paris.
"Which season did you like best?" "The series' second season. It was brilliant."
"Whose jacket is this?" "It's Thomas's. He forgot it."
"Where's the party?" "At Lewis's flat."

examples.heading: ① 字尾是 s 的單數名詞 + '

items.en: To maintain its popularity, the program should keep some of the series' aspects the same, but change others.
items.zh: 為了維持人氣，這個節目應該保留這個系列的一些特色，再改掉其他部分。

items.en: The series' final episode will be shown on Friday.
items.zh: 這個影集的最後一集星期五播出。

items.en: Scientists are studying the species' behavior in the wild.
items.zh: 科學家在研究這個物種在野外的行為。

items.en: The species' numbers have fallen sharply in the last ten years.
items.zh: 這個物種的數量在過去十年大幅下降。

items.en: Many fans were unhappy with the series' new director.
items.zh: 很多影迷不喜歡這個影集的新導演。

examples.heading: ② 人名 + 's

items.en: We stayed at James's house for the weekend.
items.zh: 我們週末住在 James 家。

items.zh: Charles 的新書下個月出版。

items.en: Have you seen Chris's photos from Japan?
items.zh: 你看過 Chris 在日本拍的照片嗎？

items.en: Mrs Jones's class is going on a trip to the museum.
items.zh: Jones 老師的班要去博物館校外教學。

examples.heading: ③ 人名 + '

items.en: Dickens' novels describe life in nineteenth-century London.
items.zh: 狄更斯的小說描寫十九世紀倫敦的生活。

items.en: The exhibition shows Degas' early paintings.
items.zh: 這個展覽展出竇加早期的畫作。

items.en: Many tourists visit Achilles' statue in the park.
items.zh: 很多觀光客去公園看阿基里斯的雕像。

examples.heading: ④ 評論和報告

items.en: In my view, the series' success comes from its strong characters.
items.zh: 我認為這個影集成功的原因是角色寫得好。

items.en: The species' survival depends on clean rivers.
items.zh: 這個物種能不能存活，要看河水乾不乾淨。

items.en: The series' writers have promised a surprise ending.
items.zh: 這個影集的編劇保證結局會出人意料。

examples.heading: ⑤ 其他字尾是 s 的單數名詞 + 's

items.en: Our class's project won first prize.
items.zh: 我們班的作品得了第一名。

items.en: The bus's engine broke down on the motorway.
items.zh: 公車的引擎在高速公路上壞了。

items.en: The princess's dress was designed in Paris.
items.zh: 公主的禮服是在巴黎設計的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Which season did you like best?" "The series' second season. It was brilliant."
items.zh: 你最喜歡哪一季？這個影集的第二季。超好看。

items.en: "Whose jacket is this?" "It's Thomas's. He forgot it."
items.zh: 這是誰的夾克？是 Thomas 的。他忘了拿。

items.en: "Where's the party?" "At Lewis's flat."
items.zh: 派對在哪裡？在 Lewis 的公寓。

title: It's very important to me because it's my sister's jacket.
translation: 它對我來說很重要，因為那是我姊姊的外套。
name: 單數名詞和專有名詞加 's 表示所有
sentences: Please help me find it. It's very important to me because it's my sister's jacket.
I'm wearing my brother's football shirt.
My mum's birthday is in May.
We stayed at my uncle's house for a week.
My grandfather's garden has lots of apple trees.
I bought some new shoes. I'll wear them at Linda's party.
Somebody took Tom's lunch from the fridge.
We're going to Anna's house after school.
Mr Brown's class is in Room 12.
Don't sit there. That's the teacher's chair.
The dog's bed is in the kitchen.
My friend's flat is very small.
The shop's windows are full of Christmas lights.
I'm writing this on my cousin's laptop.
I went to my best friend's wedding last Saturday.
I'm staying at my grandma's house this weekend.
My aunt's dog is bigger than me!
The cat's food is in the cupboard.
I found my neighbour's keys in the street.
"Whose phone is this?" "It's Sam's phone."
"Can I use your computer?" "It's not mine. It's my brother's computer."
"Is that your bag?" "No, it's my mum's bag."

examples.heading: ① 家人 + 's

items.en: Please help me find it. It's very important to me because it's my sister's jacket.
items.zh: 請幫我找。它對我來說很重要，因為那是我姊姊的外套。

items.en: I'm wearing my brother's football shirt.
items.zh: 我穿著我哥哥的足球衣。

items.en: My mum's birthday is in May.
items.zh: 我媽媽的生日在五月。

items.en: We stayed at my uncle's house for a week.
items.zh: 我們在我叔叔家住了一個星期。

items.en: My grandfather's garden has lots of apple trees.
items.zh: 我爺爺的花園有很多蘋果樹。

examples.heading: ② 人名 + 's

items.en: I bought some new shoes. I'll wear them at Linda's party.
items.zh: 我買了新鞋。我要穿去 Linda 的派對。

items.en: Somebody took Tom's lunch from the fridge.
items.zh: 有人從冰箱拿走了 Tom 的午餐。

items.en: We're going to Anna's house after school.
items.zh: 我們放學後要去 Anna 家。

items.en: Mr Brown's class is in Room 12.
items.zh: Brown 老師的班在十二號教室。

examples.heading: ③ 其他單數名詞 + 's

items.en: Don't sit there. That's the teacher's chair.
items.zh: 別坐那裡。那是老師的椅子。

items.en: The dog's bed is in the kitchen.
items.zh: 狗的床在廚房。

items.en: My friend's flat is very small.
items.zh: 我朋友的公寓很小。

items.en: The shop's windows are full of Christmas lights.
items.zh: 那家店的櫥窗掛滿了聖誕燈。

examples.heading: ④ 寫給朋友的信

items.en: I'm writing this on my cousin's laptop.
items.zh: 我在用我表姊的筆電寫這封信。

items.en: I went to my best friend's wedding last Saturday.
items.zh: 我上星期六去了我最好朋友的婚禮。

items.en: I'm staying at my grandma's house this weekend.
items.zh: 我這個週末住在奶奶家。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: My aunt's dog is bigger than me!
items.zh: 我阿姨的狗比我還大！

items.en: The cat's food is in the cupboard.
items.zh: 貓的食物在櫃子裡。

items.en: I found my neighbour's keys in the street.
items.zh: 我在街上撿到我鄰居的鑰匙。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Whose phone is this?" "It's Sam's phone."
items.zh: 這是誰的手機？是 Sam 的手機。

items.en: "Can I use your computer?" "It's not mine. It's my brother's computer."
items.zh: 我可以用你的電腦嗎？那不是我的。是我哥哥的電腦。

items.en: "Is that your bag?" "No, it's my mum's bag."
items.zh: 那是你的包包嗎？不是，是我媽媽的包包。

title: I know, I bought too many things, but I liked all of them.
translation: 我知道，我買了太多東西，可是每一樣我都很喜歡。
name: so many 和 too many 加複數名詞
sentences: The party was great fun. We played so many games, like dog and bone and four corners.
We visited so many places in Rome, mostly monuments. The weather was perfect.
Thank you for all your help. You've done so many nice things for me.
There are so many good films on at the cinema this month.
I've got so many photos from the trip. I'll show you tomorrow.
I know, I bought too many things, but I liked all of them.
I can't walk here. There are too many cars in the city centre.
You've put too many eggs in the cake. It's very heavy.
Our teacher gives us too many tests.
There were too many people on the bus, so I waited for the next one.
There were so many people at the concert that we couldn't see the stage.
He made so many mistakes that he had to write the letter again.
She has so many books that she needs another shelf.
My little brother eats too many sweets. His teeth are bad.
The office has too many meetings. We never finish our work.
There are too many tourists in the old town in August.
I've had so many emails this week.
We'll have too many guests if we invite your cousins too.
They were selling so many things at the market.
"Are you coming to the party?" "No, I've got too many things to do."
"How was New York?" "Amazing! There are so many tall buildings."
"Why are you so tired?" "Too many late nights, I think."
"Do you like the new shopping centre?" "Yes, it has so many shops."

examples.heading: ① so many + 複數名詞

items.en: The party was great fun. We played so many games, like dog and bone and four corners.
items.zh: 派對好好玩。我們玩了好多遊戲，像搶手帕和四個角落。

items.en: We visited so many places in Rome, mostly monuments. The weather was perfect.
items.zh: 我們在羅馬去了好多地方，大部分是古蹟。天氣好極了。

items.en: Thank you for all your help. You've done so many nice things for me.
items.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙。你為我做了好多好事。

items.en: There are so many good films on at the cinema this month.
items.zh: 這個月電影院上映好多好電影。

items.en: I've got so many photos from the trip. I'll show you tomorrow.
items.zh: 我這趟旅行拍了好多照片。明天給你看。

examples.heading: ② too many + 複數名詞

items.en: I know, I bought too many things, but I liked all of them.
items.zh: 我知道，我買了太多東西，可是每一樣我都很喜歡。

items.en: I can't walk here. There are too many cars in the city centre.
items.zh: 這裡沒辦法走路。市中心的車太多了。

items.en: You've put too many eggs in the cake. It's very heavy.
items.zh: 你蛋糕裡放了太多蛋。蛋糕好紮實。

items.en: Our teacher gives us too many tests.
items.zh: 我們老師考太多試了。

items.en: There were too many people on the bus, so I waited for the next one.
items.zh: 公車上人太多，所以我等下一班。

examples.heading: ③ so many ... that

items.en: There were so many people at the concert that we couldn't see the stage.
items.zh: 演唱會的人多到我們看不到舞台。

items.en: He made so many mistakes that he had to write the letter again.
items.zh: 他錯太多了，只好重寫那封信。

items.en: She has so many books that she needs another shelf.
items.zh: 她的書多到需要再買一個書架。

examples.heading: ④ too many：抱怨

items.en: My little brother eats too many sweets. His teeth are bad.
items.zh: 我弟弟吃太多糖果了。他的牙齒不好。

items.en: The office has too many meetings. We never finish our work.
items.zh: 公司的會開太多了。我們的工作從來做不完。

items.en: There are too many tourists in the old town in August.
items.zh: 八月的時候老城區的觀光客太多了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態

items.en: I've had so many emails this week.
items.zh: 我這星期收到好多電子郵件。

items.en: We'll have too many guests if we invite your cousins too.
items.zh: 如果你的表兄弟姊妹也請，客人就太多了。

items.en: They were selling so many things at the market.
items.zh: 市集上在賣好多東西。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Are you coming to the party?" "No, I've got too many things to do."
items.zh: 你要來派對嗎？不行，我要做的事太多了。

items.en: "How was New York?" "Amazing! There are so many tall buildings."
items.zh: 紐約怎麼樣？很棒！高樓好多。

items.en: "Why are you so tired?" "Too many late nights, I think."
items.zh: 你怎麼這麼累？我想是熬太多夜了。

items.en: "Do you like the new shopping centre?" "Yes, it has so many shops."
items.zh: 你喜歡那個新的購物中心嗎？喜歡，那裡店好多。

title: My neighbors are making too much noise.
translation: 我的鄰居實在太吵了。
name: so much 和 too much 加不可數名詞
sentences: I can't sleep. My neighbors are making too much noise.
Grandpa has to be careful with his heart. Don't put too much salt in the soup.
Put it down and go outside! You spend too much time on your phone.
I can't eat this. There's too much sugar in it.
We left early because there was too much traffic.
The teacher gave us too much homework this weekend.
Hello Marina. Unfortunately, I have so much work at the moment that I can't help you.
Thank you so much for the present. I had so much fun at your party!
There's so much food left. Take some home with you.
She has so much energy. She never sits down.
I've learned so much English this year.
There was so much snow that the school closed for two days.
He drank so much coffee that he couldn't sleep.
We had so much rain last month that the river flooded.
There was so much smoke that we couldn't see the road.
The new phone costs too much money for a student.
There's too much rubbish on the beach. Someone should clean it up.
No wonder he has bad teeth. My brother eats too much chocolate.
This juice tastes of nothing. You've added too much water to it.
I had too much homework yesterday, so I didn't call you.
We'll have so much time when the exams are over.
There has been too much talk and not enough action.
They were making so much noise that the police came.
I have so much work this week that I can't come to the party.
They have exams and extra classes every week. Students today are under too much pressure.
There's so much information online that it's hard to know what's true.
"Do you want more cake?" "No, thanks. I've had too much cake already."
"Why are you late?" "There was so much traffic on the bridge."
"Is the music OK?" "It's a bit loud. It's making too much noise for the baby."
"How was your holiday?" "Great! We had so much fun."
"Can you help me move on Saturday?" "Sorry, I've got so much homework."

examples.heading: ① too much + 不可數名詞

items.en: I can't sleep. My neighbors are making too much noise.
items.zh: 我睡不著。我的鄰居實在太吵了。

items.en: Grandpa has to be careful with his heart. Don't put too much salt in the soup.
items.zh: 爺爺的心臟要小心。湯裡不要放太多鹽。

items.en: Put it down and go outside! You spend too much time on your phone.
items.zh: 放下來去外面走走！你花太多時間在手機上了。

items.en: I can't eat this. There's too much sugar in it.
items.zh: 我不能吃這個。裡面糖太多了。

items.en: We left early because there was too much traffic.
items.zh: 我們提早出門，因為車太多了。

items.en: The teacher gave us too much homework this weekend.
items.zh: 老師這個週末出了太多功課。

examples.heading: ② so much + 不可數名詞

items.en: Hello Marina. Unfortunately, I have so much work at the moment that I can't help you.
items.zh: 嗨，Marina。很抱歉，我現在工作多到沒辦法幫你。

items.en: Thank you so much for the present. I had so much fun at your party!
items.zh: 謝謝你的禮物。你的派對我玩得好開心！

items.en: There's so much food left. Take some home with you.
items.zh: 剩下好多食物。帶一些回家吧。

items.en: She has so much energy. She never sits down.
items.zh: 她精力好旺盛。她從來不坐下來。

items.en: I've learned so much English this year.
items.zh: 我今年學了好多英文。

examples.heading: ③ so much ... that

items.en: There was so much snow that the school closed for two days.
items.zh: 雪多到學校停課兩天。

items.en: He drank so much coffee that he couldn't sleep.
items.zh: 他喝了太多咖啡，結果睡不著。

items.en: We had so much rain last month that the river flooded.
items.zh: 上個月雨下得太多，河水氾濫了。

items.en: There was so much smoke that we couldn't see the road.
items.zh: 煙多到我們看不到路。

examples.heading: ④ too much：抱怨

items.en: The new phone costs too much money for a student.
items.zh: 這支新手機對學生來說太貴了。

items.en: There's too much rubbish on the beach. Someone should clean it up.
items.zh: 海灘上垃圾太多了。應該有人來清。

items.en: No wonder he has bad teeth. My brother eats too much chocolate.
items.zh: 難怪他牙齒不好。我弟弟吃太多巧克力了。

items.en: This juice tastes of nothing. You've added too much water to it.
items.zh: 這果汁一點味道都沒有。你在裡面加太多水了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態

items.en: I had too much homework yesterday, so I didn't call you.
items.zh: 我昨天功課太多，所以沒打給你。

items.en: We'll have so much time when the exams are over.
items.zh: 考完試以後我們會有好多時間。

items.en: There has been too much talk and not enough action.
items.zh: 說得太多，做得太少。

items.en: They were making so much noise that the police came.
items.zh: 他們吵到警察都來了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 工作和學校

items.en: I have so much work this week that I can't come to the party.
items.zh: 我這星期工作多到不能去派對。

items.en: They have exams and extra classes every week. Students today are under too much pressure.
items.zh: 他們每個星期都有考試和補習。現在的學生壓力太大了。

items.en: There's so much information online that it's hard to know what's true.
items.zh: 網路上的資訊多到很難知道什麼是真的。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Do you want more cake?" "No, thanks. I've had too much cake already."
items.zh: 還要蛋糕嗎？不用了，謝謝。我已經吃太多蛋糕了。

items.en: "Why are you late?" "There was so much traffic on the bridge."
items.zh: 你怎麼遲到了？橋上車好多。

items.en: "Is the music OK?" "It's a bit loud. It's making too much noise for the baby."
items.zh: 音樂可以嗎？有點大聲。對寶寶來說太吵了。

items.en: "How was your holiday?" "Great! We had so much fun."
items.zh: 你的假期怎麼樣？很棒！我們玩得好開心。

items.en: "Can you help me move on Saturday?" "Sorry, I've got so much homework."
items.zh: 你星期六可以幫我搬家嗎？抱歉，我有好多功課。

examples.heading: ① 想做的事

items.en: I want to read that book too.
items.zh: 我也想讀那本書。

items.en: We'd like to try that new restaurant.
items.zh: 我們想去吃吃看那家新餐廳。

items.en: My son really wants that toy car.
items.zh: 我兒子很想要那台玩具車。

items.en: That museum has a famous painting by Van Gogh.
items.zh: 那間博物館有一幅梵谷的名畫。

items.en: She wants to go to that concert on Friday.
items.zh: 她想去星期五的那場演唱會。

examples.heading: ② 遠的人和東西

items.en: That woman in the red coat is my aunt.
items.zh: 穿紅外套的那個女人是我阿姨。

items.en: Can you pass me that cup, please?
items.zh: 可以請你把那個杯子遞給我嗎？

items.en: That building over there is the hospital.
items.zh: 那邊那棟大樓是醫院。

items.en: Look at that car! It's beautiful.
items.zh: 你看那台車！好漂亮。

items.en: Is that bus going to the city centre?
items.zh: 那班公車是去市中心的嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 店裡和餐廳裡

items.en: How much is that hat in the window?
items.zh: 櫥窗裡那頂帽子多少錢？

items.en: I'll have that cake with the strawberries.
items.zh: 我要那個有草莓的蛋糕。

items.en: Can I try on that ring with the blue stone?
items.zh: 我可以試戴那個有藍色寶石的戒指嗎？

items.en: That table by the window is free.
items.zh: 窗邊那張桌子沒人坐。

examples.heading: ④ 雙方都知道的東西

items.en: Do you still have that red bike?
items.zh: 你還有那台紅色的腳踏車嗎？

items.en: I loved that song you sang at the party.
items.zh: 我很愛你在派對上唱的那首歌。

items.en: Where did you put that letter from the bank?
items.zh: 你把銀行寄來的那封信放到哪裡了？

items.en: That teacher was really kind to me.
items.zh: 那位老師以前對我很好。

items.en: Remember that holiday in Spain?
items.zh: 還記得在西班牙的那次度假嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 學校和課程

items.en: That course is only for second-year students.
items.zh: 那門課只給二年級的學生上。

items.en: That class starts at nine.
items.zh: 那堂課九點開始。

items.en: My brother studied at that university.
items.zh: 我哥哥讀過那所大學。

items.en: Is that exam very difficult?
items.zh: 那個考試很難嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 回應對方說的東西

items.en: "I bought a new phone." "Is that phone expensive?"
items.zh: 我買了一支新手機。那支手機很貴嗎？

items.en: "We stayed at the Hotel Rex." "I know that hotel."
items.zh: 我們住在 Rex 飯店。我知道那家飯店。

items.en: "Have you seen the new Batman film?" "No, but my sister says that film is great."
items.zh: 你看過新的蝙蝠俠電影嗎？還沒，但是我姊姊說那部電影很好看。

items.en: "There's a new café on Park Road." "Let's try that café tomorrow."
items.zh: Park 路上開了一家新咖啡館。我們明天去那家咖啡館試試看吧。

examples.heading: ⑦ 那一天、那一年

items.en: I was very tired that day.
items.zh: 那天我很累。

items.en: We stayed in a tent all that week.
items.zh: 那個星期我們都住在帳篷裡。

items.en: That summer we went to the beach every day.
items.zh: 那年夏天我們每天都去海邊。

items.en: I started school that year.
items.zh: 我那一年開始上學。

items.en: I met my wife that evening.
items.zh: 我就是那天晚上認識我太太的。

title: It was the most expensive mobile phone in the shop.
translation: 那是店裡最貴的手機。
name: the 加最高級形容詞

Mrs Patel gave the best speech at the wedding.

My uncle makes the best pancakes.
Our dog is the laziest animal on the farm.
Question one is the easiest question on the test.
July is the busiest month for hotels by the sea.
Our kitchen is the sunniest room in the flat.

Anna is the tallest girl in my class.

Today is the hottest day of the year.

examples.heading: ① the + -est + 名詞

items.en: This is the cheapest hotel in the city centre.
items.zh: 這是市中心最便宜的飯店。

items.en: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
items.zh: 聖母峰是世界最高的山。

items.en: At sixteen, Ben became the youngest member of the orchestra.
items.zh: Ben 十六歲就成為樂團裡年紀最小的團員。

items.en: We always choose the shortest way to the airport.
items.zh: 我們都選去機場最短的路。

items.en: Pluto was once the smallest planet in our solar system.
items.zh: 冥王星曾經是太陽系裡最小的行星。

examples.heading: ② the + most + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: It was the most beautiful sunset I've ever seen.
items.zh: 那是我看過最美的夕陽。

items.en: Learning the verbs was the most difficult part of the course.
items.zh: 背動詞是這門課最難的部分。

items.en: That was the most boring film of the year.
items.zh: 那是今年最無聊的電影。

items.en: She bought the most comfortable sofa in the shop.
items.zh: 她買了店裡最舒服的沙發。

items.en: This is the most popular café near the station.
items.zh: 這是車站附近最受歡迎的咖啡館。

examples.heading: ③ the best、the worst

items.en: In my opinion, autumn is the best season for walking in Kyoto.
items.zh: 我覺得秋天是在京都散步最好的季節。

items.en: Monday was the worst day of the holiday because it rained.
items.zh: 星期一是假期裡最糟的一天，因為下雨了。

items.en: Mrs Patel gave the best speech at the wedding.
items.zh: Patel 太太在婚禮上的致詞講得最好。

items.en: This is the worst traffic jam I've seen in years.
items.zh: 這是我這幾年來看過最嚴重的塞車。

items.en: My uncle makes the best pancakes.
items.zh: 我叔叔做的鬆餅最好吃。

examples.heading: ④ 字尾是 y 的形容詞

items.en: Our dog is the laziest animal on the farm.
items.zh: 我們的狗是農場上最懶的動物。

items.en: Question one is the easiest question on the test.
items.zh: 第一題是考卷上最簡單的題目。

items.en: July is the busiest month for hotels by the sea.
items.zh: 七月是海邊飯店最忙的月份。

items.en: Our kitchen is the sunniest room in the flat.
items.zh: 我們的廚房是公寓裡陽光最充足的房間。

examples.heading: ⑤ 範圍用 in

items.en: It's the biggest shopping centre in the country.
items.zh: 這是全國最大的購物中心。

items.en: Anna is the tallest girl in my class.
items.zh: Anna 是我們班上最高的女生。

items.en: They have the fastest internet in town.
items.zh: 他們有鎮上最快的網路。

items.en: Kate lives on the quietest street in the neighbourhood.
items.zh: Kate 住在這一區最安靜的街上。

examples.heading: ⑥ 範圍用 of

items.en: Today is the hottest day of the year.
items.zh: 今天是今年最熱的一天。

items.en: This is the coldest winter of the last ten years.
items.zh: 這是過去十年來最冷的冬天。

items.en: We chose the cheapest flight of all the options.
items.zh: 我們選了所有選項裡最便宜的班機。

items.en: Lisa got the highest mark of all the students.
items.zh: Lisa 拿到所有學生裡最高的分數。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說新東西

items.en: This car has the latest safety system.
items.zh: 這台車有最新的安全系統。

items.en: My phone has the newest camera.
items.zh: 我的手機有最新型的相機。

items.en: Did you read the latest news about the storm?
items.zh: 你看了關於暴風雨的最新消息嗎？

items.en: They sell the most modern furniture in town.
items.zh: 他們賣鎮上最現代的家具。

title: I couldn't see their faces.
translation: 我看不到他們的臉。
name: 所有格限定詞 their
sentences: Two men ran past my window. It was dark, so I couldn't see their faces.
My grandparents sold their house and moved to a flat.
The students are doing their homework in the library.
My neighbours are on holiday, so I'm feeding their cat.
They were having the time of their lives at the zoo, but when they returned to their car, they saw that someone was stealing Paul's suitcase.
The two girls packed their bags and left before breakfast.
The children ran to their mother when they saw the dog.
The TV crew visited the old town. They filmed the artists and their work.
The fans waited for hours to see their favourite band.
Workers at the factory are worried about their jobs.
The birds left their nests in the autumn.
The trees lose their leaves in winter.
The horses were eating their dinner in the field.
My friends invited me to their wedding.
The players raised their arms to celebrate the goal.
Parents should know their children's friends.
"Are those your bags?" "No, they're my parents'. Their car is outside."
"Do you know the Smiths?" "Yes, I go to school with their son."
"Where are the kids?" "In their room. They're watching a film."

examples.heading: ① their + 名詞：人

items.en: Two men ran past my window. It was dark, so I couldn't see their faces.
items.zh: 兩個男人從我窗前跑過去。天很黑，所以我看不到他們的臉。

items.en: My grandparents sold their house and moved to a flat.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶把房子賣了，搬到一間公寓。

items.en: The students are doing their homework in the library.
items.zh: 學生們在圖書館寫功課。

items.en: My neighbours are on holiday, so I'm feeding their cat.
items.zh: 我的鄰居去度假了，所以我在餵他們的貓。

examples.heading: ② 故事裡的 their

items.en: They were having the time of their lives at the zoo, but when they returned to their car, they saw that someone was stealing Paul's suitcase.
items.zh: 他們在動物園玩得超開心，可是回到車上的時候，發現有人在偷 Paul 的行李箱。

items.en: The two girls packed their bags and left before breakfast.
items.zh: 那兩個女孩收拾好行李，在早餐前就走了。

items.en: The children ran to their mother when they saw the dog.
items.zh: 孩子們看到那隻狗，就跑到媽媽身邊。

examples.heading: ③ 報導裡的 their

items.en: The TV crew visited the old town. They filmed the artists and their work.
items.zh: 電視台的工作人員去了老城區。他們拍了那些藝術家和他們的作品。

items.en: The fans waited for hours to see their favourite band.
items.zh: 歌迷等了好幾個小時，要看他們最喜歡的樂團。

items.en: Workers at the factory are worried about their jobs.
items.zh: 工廠的工人在擔心他們的工作。

examples.heading: ④ their + 名詞：動物和東西

items.en: The birds left their nests in the autumn.
items.zh: 那些鳥秋天離開了牠們的巢。

items.en: The trees lose their leaves in winter.
items.zh: 這些樹冬天會掉葉子。

items.en: The horses were eating their dinner in the field.
items.zh: 那些馬在草地上吃晚餐。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: My friends invited me to their wedding.
items.zh: 我的朋友邀請我參加他們的婚禮。

items.en: The players raised their arms to celebrate the goal.
items.zh: 球員們舉起手臂慶祝進球。

items.en: Parents should know their children's friends.
items.zh: 父母應該認識孩子的朋友。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Are those your bags?" "No, they're my parents'. Their car is outside."
items.zh: 那些是你的包包嗎？不是，是我爸媽的。他們的車在外面。

items.en: "Do you know the Smiths?" "Yes, I go to school with their son."
items.zh: 你認識 Smith 一家人嗎？認識，我跟他們的兒子同校。

items.en: "Where are the kids?" "In their room. They're watching a film."
items.zh: 孩子們在哪裡？在他們房間。他們在看電影。

title: I bought these clothes because they weren't expensive.
translation: 我買這些衣服是因為它們不貴。
name: these 加複數名詞
sentences: I bought these trainers in the sales.
These oranges are from my uncle's farm.
These earrings were a real bargain.
Do these trousers come in black?
I'm going to take these books back to the shop.
These boots are perfect for the snow.
Can I wear these jeans to the party?
These socks have holes in them.
My grandmother knitted these gloves.
These cookies taste of cinnamon.
Wash these tomatoes before you cut them.
These eggs come from our own chickens.
Don't eat these mushrooms. They might be dangerous.
Where should I put these plates?
We bought these chairs in a second-hand shop.
These plants need more water.
I need a taxi for all these bags.
Look at these photos of my holiday.
My grandfather wrote these letters during the war.
These pictures were painted by my students.
I found these old postcards in a drawer.
These children are learning to swim.
These puppies are only six weeks old.
These students come from Korea.
Can I ride one of these horses?
I have to finish these reports by Friday.
These exercises are easy.
Follow these steps to make the cake.
These glasses help me read small letters.
These keys open the garage and the back door.

examples.heading: ① 買東西

items.en: I bought these trainers in the sales.
items.zh: 這雙運動鞋是我在特價時買的。

items.en: These oranges are from my uncle's farm.
items.zh: 這些柳橙是我叔叔農場種的。

items.en: These earrings were a real bargain.
items.zh: 這副耳環買得真划算。

items.en: Do these trousers come in black?
items.zh: 這條長褲有黑色的嗎？

items.en: I'm going to take these books back to the shop.
items.zh: 我要把這些書拿回店裡退。

examples.heading: ② 衣服和鞋子

items.en: These boots are perfect for the snow.
items.zh: 這雙靴子很適合下雪天穿。

items.en: Can I wear these jeans to the party?
items.zh: 我可以穿這條牛仔褲去派對嗎？

items.en: These socks have holes in them.
items.zh: 這幾雙襪子都破洞了。

items.en: My grandmother knitted these gloves.
items.zh: 這雙手套是我奶奶織的。

examples.heading: ③ 吃的東西

items.en: These cookies taste of cinnamon.
items.zh: 這些餅乾有肉桂的味道。

items.en: Wash these tomatoes before you cut them.
items.zh: 這些番茄要先洗再切。

items.en: These eggs come from our own chickens.
items.zh: 這些蛋是我們自己養的雞生的。

items.en: Don't eat these mushrooms. They might be dangerous.
items.zh: 不要吃這些蘑菇。它們可能有毒。

examples.heading: ④ 家裡的東西

items.en: Where should I put these plates?
items.zh: 這些盤子要放在哪裡？

items.en: We bought these chairs in a second-hand shop.
items.zh: 這些椅子是我們在二手店買的。

items.en: These plants need more water.
items.zh: 這些植物需要多澆點水。

items.en: I need a taxi for all these bags.
items.zh: 這麼多袋子我得叫一台計程車。

examples.heading: ⑤ 照片和信

items.en: Look at these photos of my holiday.
items.zh: 你看這些我度假的照片。

items.en: My grandfather wrote these letters during the war.
items.zh: 這些信是我爺爺在戰爭時寫的。

items.en: These pictures were painted by my students.
items.zh: 這些圖是我的學生畫的。

items.en: I found these old postcards in a drawer.
items.zh: 我在抽屜裡找到這些舊明信片。

examples.heading: ⑥ 人和動物

items.en: These children are learning to swim.
items.zh: 這些小孩正在學游泳。

items.en: These puppies are only six weeks old.
items.zh: 這些小狗才六個星期大。

items.en: These students come from Korea.
items.zh: 這些學生是從韓國來的。

items.en: Can I ride one of these horses?
items.zh: 我可以騎這些馬的其中一匹嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 工作和學習

items.en: I have to finish these reports by Friday.
items.zh: 我星期五之前要做完這些報告。

items.en: These exercises are easy.
items.zh: 這些練習很簡單。

items.en: Follow these steps to make the cake.
items.zh: 照這些步驟做蛋糕。

items.en: These glasses help me read small letters.
items.zh: 這副眼鏡讓我看得清小字。

items.en: These keys open the garage and the back door.
items.zh: 這串鑰匙可以開車庫和後門。

title: If you like, we can go this Saturday.
translation: 你願意的話，我們可以這個星期六去。

items.en: This phone is new. I bought it last week.
items.zh: 這支手機是新的。我上星期買的。

items.en: My kids sing this song in the car every day.
items.zh: 我的小孩每天在車上唱這首歌。

items.en: How much does this lamp cost?
items.zh: 這盞燈多少錢？

examples.heading: ② 地方

items.en: This town has a good market.
items.zh: 這個小鎮有一個很好的市場。

items.zh: 這個房間兩個人住太小了。

items.en: We often eat at this restaurant.
items.zh: 我們常來這家餐廳吃飯。

items.en: Is this the right bus stop for the museum?
items.zh: 去博物館是在這個公車站等車嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 人和動物

items.en: This man is my teacher.
items.zh: 這位先生是我的老師。

items.en: This dog belongs to my neighbour.
items.zh: 這隻狗是我鄰居的。

items.en: Who is this girl in the photo?
items.zh: 照片裡的這個女生是誰？

items.en: This cat sleeps all day.
items.zh: 這隻貓整天都在睡覺。

examples.heading: ④ 今天的一段時間

items.en: I'm cooking fish this evening.
items.zh: 我今天晚上要煮魚。

items.en: I missed the train this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上沒趕上火車。

items.en: Are you free this afternoon?
items.zh: 你今天下午有空嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 這個星期、這個月、今年

items.zh: 那家店這個星期沒開。

items.zh: 我兒子今年開始上學。

items.en: This city is beautiful. You must visit me here!
items.zh: 這個城市很漂亮。你一定要來這裡找我！

items.en: I started this job in May and I like it a lot.
items.zh: 我五月開始做這份工作，我很喜歡。

items.en: This weekend we are going to the mountains.
items.zh: 這個週末我們要去山上。

title: My mother told me that this food is healthy and good for me.
translation: 我媽媽跟我說，這種食物很健康，對我很好。
name: this 加不可數名詞
sentences: This bread is still warm.
This cheese smells strong but tastes great.
This rice comes from Chishang.
My kids don't like this soup.
Who ate all this chocolate?
This coffee tastes a bit bitter.
Can I drink this water?
This juice is made from fresh oranges.
My grandfather grows this tea in his garden.
This information is on page three.
This news made everyone happy.
I got this information from the tourist office.
Please keep this information secret.
Where did you hear this news?
Thanks for this advice. It really helped me.
This advice comes from my doctor.
We couldn't finish without this help.
This paper is too thin for painting.
This wood comes from an old tree.
You can wash this cotton in hot water.
Is this glass strong enough?
This furniture belonged to my grandmother.
This money is for your school trip.
All this luggage won't fit in the car.
We borrowed this equipment from the sports club.
I hate this weather!
This rain is good for the farmers.
This music always makes me want to dance.
My uncle wrote this music for my wedding.
This snow will melt by tomorrow.
My dad listens to this music every morning.

examples.heading: ① 吃的東西

items.en: This bread is still warm.
items.zh: 這個麵包還是熱的。

items.en: This cheese smells strong but tastes great.
items.zh: 這個起司味道很重，但是很好吃。

items.en: This rice comes from Chishang.
items.zh: 這個米是池上產的。

items.en: My kids don't like this soup.
items.zh: 我的小孩不喜歡這個湯。

items.en: Who ate all this chocolate?
items.zh: 這些巧克力是誰吃光的？

examples.heading: ② 喝的東西

items.en: This coffee tastes a bit bitter.
items.zh: 這個咖啡喝起來有點苦。

items.en: Can I drink this water?
items.zh: 這個水可以喝嗎？

items.en: This juice is made from fresh oranges.
items.zh: 這個果汁是新鮮柳橙做的。

items.en: My grandfather grows this tea in his garden.
items.zh: 這個茶是我爺爺在他的園子裡種的。

examples.heading: ③ 消息和資料

items.en: This information is on page three.
items.zh: 這個資料在第三頁。

items.en: This news made everyone happy.
items.zh: 這個消息讓大家都很高興。

items.en: I got this information from the tourist office.
items.zh: 這個資料是我從遊客中心拿到的。

items.en: Please keep this information secret.
items.zh: 這個資料請保密。

items.en: Where did you hear this news?
items.zh: 這個消息你是在哪裡聽到的？

examples.heading: ④ 建議和幫忙

items.en: Thanks for this advice. It really helped me.
items.zh: 謝謝你給我這個建議。真的幫了我很多。

items.en: This advice comes from my doctor.
items.zh: 這個建議是我的醫生給的。

items.en: We couldn't finish without this help.
items.zh: 沒有這些幫忙，我們沒辦法做完。

examples.heading: ⑤ 東西的材料

items.en: This paper is too thin for painting.
items.zh: 這種紙太薄了，不能用來畫畫。

items.en: This wood comes from an old tree.
items.zh: 這塊木頭是從一棵老樹來的。

items.en: You can wash this cotton in hot water.
items.zh: 這種棉可以用熱水洗。

items.en: Is this glass strong enough?
items.zh: 這種玻璃夠堅固嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 家裡的東西和錢

items.en: This furniture belonged to my grandmother.
items.zh: 這些家具以前是我奶奶的。

items.en: This money is for your school trip.
items.zh: 這些錢是給你校外教學用的。

items.en: All this luggage won't fit in the car.
items.zh: 這些行李放不進車裡。

items.en: We borrowed this equipment from the sports club.
items.zh: 這些器材是我們跟運動俱樂部借的。

examples.heading: ⑦ 天氣和音樂

items.en: I hate this weather!
items.zh: 我好討厭這種天氣！

items.en: This rain is good for the farmers.
items.zh: 這場雨對農夫很好。

items.en: This music always makes me want to dance.
items.zh: 這種音樂總是讓我想跳舞。

items.en: My uncle wrote this music for my wedding.
items.zh: 這首曲子是我叔叔為我的婚禮寫的。

items.en: This snow will melt by tomorrow.
items.zh: 這些雪明天就會融化了。

items.en: My dad listens to this music every morning.
items.zh: 我爸爸每天早上都聽這種音樂。

title: I love to play those instruments.
translation: 我很喜歡演奏那些樂器。
name: those 加複數名詞
sentences: I can play the guitar and the piano. I love to play those instruments.
Can you put those plates in the cupboard, please?
I don't want those biscuits. They're too sweet.
Did you buy those trainers online?
I've never seen those photos before.
Those shoes are really nice. Where did you get them?
Those tomatoes come from my grandfather's garden.
Those exercises were very easy.
Those apples look delicious.
I bought a new coat and two dresses. The cost of those clothes was £300.
The colour of those curtains is lovely.
I'll have one of those sandwiches, please.
How much are those sunglasses?
Have you got those jeans in a smaller size?
I'd like to try on those boots in the window.
Who gave you those flowers?
Those students in the corner are from Korea.
I loved those holidays at my aunt's farm.
"Are those your glasses?" "Yes, thanks. I was looking for them."
"Do you want those magazines?" "No, you can throw them away."
"Those cakes look amazing." "My mum made them."

examples.heading: ① those + 複數名詞：受詞

items.en: I can play the guitar and the piano. I love to play those instruments.
items.zh: 我會彈吉他和鋼琴。我很喜歡演奏那些樂器。

items.en: Can you put those plates in the cupboard, please?
items.zh: 你可以把那些盤子放進櫃子裡嗎？

items.en: I don't want those biscuits. They're too sweet.
items.zh: 我不要那些餅乾。太甜了。

items.en: Did you buy those trainers online?
items.zh: 那雙運動鞋你是網購的嗎？

items.en: I've never seen those photos before.
items.zh: 那些照片我以前從沒看過。

examples.heading: ② those + 複數名詞：主詞

items.en: Those shoes are really nice. Where did you get them?
items.zh: 那雙鞋很好看。你在哪裡買的？

items.en: Those tomatoes come from my grandfather's garden.
items.zh: 那些番茄是我爺爺的花園種的。

items.en: Those exercises were very easy.
items.zh: 那些練習題很簡單。

items.en: Those apples look delicious.
items.zh: 那些蘋果看起來很好吃。

examples.heading: ③ of those + 複數名詞

items.en: I bought a new coat and two dresses. The cost of those clothes was £300.
items.zh: 我買了一件新大衣和兩件洋裝。那些衣服花了三百英鎊。

items.en: The colour of those curtains is lovely.
items.zh: 那些窗簾的顏色很漂亮。

items.en: I'll have one of those sandwiches, please.
items.zh: 請給我一個那種三明治。

examples.heading: ④ 購物

items.en: How much are those sunglasses?
items.zh: 那副太陽眼鏡多少錢？

items.en: Have you got those jeans in a smaller size?
items.zh: 那件牛仔褲有小一號的嗎？

items.en: I'd like to try on those boots in the window.
items.zh: 我想試穿櫥窗裡那雙靴子。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Who gave you those flowers?
items.zh: 那些花是誰送你的？

items.en: Those students in the corner are from Korea.
items.zh: 角落那些學生來自韓國。

items.en: I loved those holidays at my aunt's farm.
items.zh: 我很喜歡在阿姨的農場度過的那些假期。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Are those your glasses?" "Yes, thanks. I was looking for them."
items.zh: 那是你的眼鏡嗎？對，謝謝。我剛在找。

items.en: "Do you want those magazines?" "No, you can throw them away."
items.zh: 你還要那些雜誌嗎？不要了，你可以丟掉。

items.en: "Those cakes look amazing." "My mum made them."
items.zh: 那些蛋糕看起來好好吃。是我媽做的。

title: We have come a long way and climbed many a mountain.
translation: 我們走了很長的路，爬過很多座山。
name: many a 加單數名詞
sentences: Look how far we've come. We have come a long way and climbed many a mountain.
My grandfather was a sailor. He crossed many a sea in his long life.
This old house has seen many a family come and go.
The coach has trained many a champion over the years.
She has written many a letter to the council, but nothing has changed.
The final maths exam is famous at our school. Many a student has stayed up all night before it.
Many a parent has made the same mistake.
Many a tourist has got lost in these narrow streets.
Always keep a notebook with you. Many a good idea has been lost because nobody wrote it down.
Many a famous writer was born in this small town.
Your article has raised many an issue which I would like to comment on.
I spent many an hour in that library when I was a student.
You'll recognise this view. Many an artist has painted this bridge.
The old tree has survived many an autumn storm.
Her father's shop was often broken into, and she was threatened many a time on her way home.
I've told you many a time to lock the door!
We sat by this river many a time when we were children.
My dad has fixed that old car many a time.
Many a night I lay awake, worrying about the exam.
Many a year has passed since we last met.
I spent many a day walking in these hills.
She waited many a long week for his letter.
Ladies and gentlemen, many a speaker has stood here before me.
Many a company has failed because it ignored its customers.
Why do we dream? This question has puzzled many a scientist.
History shows that many a war has started over a small argument.
"Have you been here before?" "Oh yes, many a time."
My grandma has told many a story about her school days.
Many a summer we went camping by the lake.
That old song brings back many a happy memory.
Don't throw that old sofa away! Many a friend has slept on it.

examples.heading: ① many a + 單數名詞當受詞

items.en: Look how far we've come. We have come a long way and climbed many a mountain.
items.zh: 看看我們走了多遠。我們走了很長的路，爬過很多座山。

items.en: My grandfather was a sailor. He crossed many a sea in his long life.
items.zh: 我爺爺是水手。他一生中航行過很多片海。

items.en: This old house has seen many a family come and go.
items.zh: 這間老房子看過很多家庭來來去去。

items.en: The coach has trained many a champion over the years.
items.zh: 這位教練這些年訓練過很多冠軍。

items.en: She has written many a letter to the council, but nothing has changed.
items.zh: 她寫過很多封信給市議會，可是什麼都沒改變。

examples.heading: ② many a + 單數名詞當主詞

items.en: The final maths exam is famous at our school. Many a student has stayed up all night before it.
items.zh: 期末數學考試在我們學校很出名。很多學生在考前熬了一整夜。

items.en: Many a parent has made the same mistake.
items.zh: 很多父母都犯過同樣的錯。

items.en: Many a tourist has got lost in these narrow streets.
items.zh: 很多觀光客在這些窄巷裡迷過路。

items.en: Always keep a notebook with you. Many a good idea has been lost because nobody wrote it down.
items.zh: 隨身帶一本筆記本。很多好點子因為沒人寫下來就不見了。

items.en: Many a famous writer was born in this small town.
items.zh: 很多有名的作家在這個小鎮出生。

examples.heading: ③ many an + 母音開頭的名詞

items.en: Your article has raised many an issue which I would like to comment on.
items.zh: 您的文章提出了很多我想評論的問題。

items.en: I spent many an hour in that library when I was a student.
items.zh: 我當學生的時候，在那間圖書館待過很多個小時。

items.en: You'll recognise this view. Many an artist has painted this bridge.
items.zh: 你會認得這個景色。很多畫家都畫過這座橋。

items.en: The old tree has survived many an autumn storm.
items.zh: 這棵老樹撐過了很多場秋天的暴風雨。

examples.heading: ④ many a time

items.en: Her father's shop was often broken into, and she was threatened many a time on her way home.
items.zh: 她爸爸的店常被闖空門，她回家的路上也被威脅過很多次。

items.en: I've told you many a time to lock the door!
items.zh: 我已經跟你說過很多次要鎖門了！

items.en: We sat by this river many a time when we were children.
items.zh: 我們小時候常常坐在這條河邊。

items.en: My dad has fixed that old car many a time.
items.zh: 我爸爸修過那台舊車很多次。

examples.heading: ⑤ many a day / night / year

items.en: Many a night I lay awake, worrying about the exam.
items.zh: 很多個晚上我都睡不著，擔心考試。

items.en: Many a year has passed since we last met.
items.zh: 自從我們上次見面，已經過了很多年。

items.en: I spent many a day walking in these hills.
items.zh: 我花了很多天在這些山丘上散步。

items.en: She waited many a long week for his letter.
items.zh: 她等他的信等了好幾個漫長的星期。

examples.heading: ⑥ 演講和正式的文章

items.en: Ladies and gentlemen, many a speaker has stood here before me.
items.zh: 各位先生女士，在我之前已經有很多人站在這裡演講過。

items.en: Many a company has failed because it ignored its customers.
items.zh: 很多公司因為忽視客戶而倒閉。

items.en: Why do we dream? This question has puzzled many a scientist.
items.zh: 我們為什麼會做夢？這個問題難倒了很多科學家。

items.en: History shows that many a war has started over a small argument.
items.zh: 歷史告訴我們，很多戰爭是從一場小爭執開始的。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說故事和回憶

items.en: "Have you been here before?" "Oh yes, many a time."
items.zh: 你以前來過這裡嗎？喔，來過很多次了。

items.en: My grandma has told many a story about her school days.
items.zh: 我奶奶講過很多她上學時的故事。

items.en: Many a summer we went camping by the lake.
items.zh: 很多個夏天我們都去湖邊露營。

items.en: That old song brings back many a happy memory.
items.zh: 那首老歌讓我想起很多快樂的回憶。

items.en: Don't throw that old sofa away! Many a friend has slept on it.
items.zh: 別把那張舊沙發丟掉！很多朋友都在上面睡過。

title: I like rice and sweet dishes.
translation: 我喜歡米飯和甜食。
name: 泛指時不加冠詞
sentences: My little brother refuses to drink orange juice.
Children need sleep to grow.
Our baker uses butter instead of oil.
Fresh fruit is good for you.
Money isn't everything.
My sister is afraid of spiders.
Nurses often work at night and at the weekend.
Uncle Joe has collected stamps since 1990.
Carrots are cheap at this market.
Tourists often get lost in these narrow streets.
On Wednesdays the girls play volleyball in the park.
My dad watches golf on Sundays.
Grandpa taught me chess when I was seven.
The twins learned tennis from their uncle.
I usually have breakfast at seven.
What's for dinner tonight?
Let's have lunch together on Friday.
I never eat breakfast on school days.
She speaks Spanish and French.
At university Leo studied biology and chemistry.
My cousin teaches science at a secondary school.
Since last spring Tina has been studying Korean online.
In my free time I usually stay at home. I watch TV and read books.
My mum listens to music while she cooks.
I love films about animals.
On rainy days we play computer games.
Kevin can't stand cheese, but he eats yoghurt every morning.
My son hates vegetables.
Few people in my office enjoy jazz.
I enjoy cooking Chinese food.

examples.heading: ① 不可數名詞

items.en: My little brother refuses to drink orange juice.
items.zh: 我弟弟不肯喝柳橙汁。

items.en: Children need sleep to grow.
items.zh: 小孩要睡飽才會長大。

items.en: Our baker uses butter instead of oil.
items.zh: 我們的麵包師傅用奶油，不用油。

items.en: Fresh fruit is good for you.
items.zh: 新鮮水果對身體好。

items.en: Money isn't everything.
items.zh: 錢不是一切。

examples.heading: ② 複數名詞

items.en: My sister is afraid of spiders.
items.zh: 我妹妹怕蜘蛛。

items.en: Nurses often work at night and at the weekend.
items.zh: 護理師常要在晚上和週末上班。

items.en: Uncle Joe has collected stamps since 1990.
items.zh: 喬叔叔從一九九〇年開始收集郵票。

items.en: Carrots are cheap at this market.
items.zh: 這個市場的紅蘿蔔很便宜。

items.en: Tourists often get lost in these narrow streets.
items.zh: 觀光客常在這些小巷裡迷路。

examples.heading: ③ 運動和遊戲

items.en: On Wednesdays the girls play volleyball in the park.
items.zh: 星期三女孩們在公園打排球。

items.en: My dad watches golf on Sundays.
items.zh: 我爸爸星期天看高爾夫球賽。

items.en: Grandpa taught me chess when I was seven.
items.zh: 我七歲時爺爺教我下西洋棋。

items.en: The twins learned tennis from their uncle.
items.zh: 這對雙胞胎跟他們的叔叔學網球。

examples.heading: ④ 三餐

items.en: I usually have breakfast at seven.
items.zh: 我通常七點吃早餐。

items.en: What's for dinner tonight?
items.zh: 今晚吃什麼？

items.en: Let's have lunch together on Friday.
items.zh: 我們星期五一起吃午餐吧。

items.en: I never eat breakfast on school days.
items.zh: 上學日我都不吃早餐。

examples.heading: ⑤ 語言和學科

items.en: She speaks Spanish and French.
items.zh: 她會說西班牙語和法語。

items.en: At university Leo studied biology and chemistry.
items.zh: Leo 大學讀生物和化學。

items.en: My cousin teaches science at a secondary school.
items.zh: 我表姊在一所中學教自然科學。

items.en: Since last spring Tina has been studying Korean online.
items.zh: Tina 從去年春天開始在網路上學韓文。

examples.heading: ⑥ 空閒時間的活動

items.en: In my free time I usually stay at home. I watch TV and read books.
items.zh: 我有空時通常待在家裡，看電視、看書。

items.en: My mum listens to music while she cooks.
items.zh: 我媽媽煮飯時會聽音樂。

items.en: I love films about animals.
items.zh: 我很喜歡關於動物的電影。

items.en: On rainy days we play computer games.
items.zh: 下雨天我們打電腦遊戲。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說喜好

items.en: Kevin can't stand cheese, but he eats yoghurt every morning.
items.zh: Kevin 受不了起司，可是每天早上都吃優格。

items.en: My son hates vegetables.
items.zh: 我兒子討厭青菜。

items.en: Few people in my office enjoy jazz.
items.zh: 我辦公室裡很少人喜歡爵士樂。

items.en: I enjoy cooking Chinese food.
items.zh: 我喜歡煮中國菜。

title: Friends are very important in life.
translation: 朋友在人生中非常重要。
name: 泛指時不加冠詞（較多種名詞）
sentences: Children learn languages more easily than adults.
Farmers depend on the weather.
Grandparents often spoil their grandchildren.
Teenagers need more sleep than they get.
Computers have changed the way we work.
Smartphones can be bad for your eyes.
Cars cause a lot of pollution in big cities.
Books make wonderful presents.
Life is too short to stay angry.
Love makes people do strange things.
Happiness comes from small things.
True friendship lasts for ever.
Education should be free for everyone.
Good health matters more to me now that I'm older.
Poverty is still a big problem in many countries.
Technology makes our lives easier.
Nature can help people feel calm.
Online shopping saves a lot of time.
Smoking is not allowed in this building.
Travelling teaches you about other cultures.
Gardening keeps my grandparents busy and fit.
Remember that hard work always pays off in the end.
Patience is important when you learn a language.
Exercise is good for both body and mind.
Money can't buy happiness.
History is my best subject. The history of China is especially interesting.
Music helps me relax. The music in this café is too loud, though.
Coffee keeps me awake. The coffee at work is terrible.
Art is for everyone. The art in this museum is free to see.
Life in a big city is exciting, but the life of a farmer is peaceful.

examples.heading: ① 複數名詞泛指一類人

items.en: Children learn languages more easily than adults.
items.zh: 小孩學語言比大人容易。

items.en: Farmers depend on the weather.
items.zh: 農夫要看天氣吃飯。

items.en: Grandparents often spoil their grandchildren.
items.zh: 爺爺奶奶常常寵孫子。

items.en: Teenagers need more sleep than they get.
items.zh: 青少年需要的睡眠比他們實際睡的多。

examples.heading: ② 複數名詞泛指一類東西

items.en: Computers have changed the way we work.
items.zh: 電腦改變了我們工作的方式。

items.en: Smartphones can be bad for your eyes.
items.zh: 智慧型手機可能對眼睛不好。

items.en: Cars cause a lot of pollution in big cities.
items.zh: 汽車在大城市造成很多污染。

items.en: Books make wonderful presents.
items.zh: 書是很棒的禮物。

examples.heading: ③ 人生和感情

items.en: Life is too short to stay angry.
items.zh: 人生太短，不值得一直生氣。

items.en: Love makes people do strange things.
items.zh: 愛會讓人做出奇怪的事。

items.en: Happiness comes from small things.
items.zh: 快樂來自小事。

items.en: True friendship lasts for ever.
items.zh: 真正的友誼會持續一輩子。

examples.heading: ④ 社會

items.en: Education should be free for everyone.
items.zh: 教育應該對每個人都免費。

items.en: Good health matters more to me now that I'm older.
items.zh: 年紀大了，我更在乎身體健康。

items.en: Poverty is still a big problem in many countries.
items.zh: 貧窮在很多國家還是很大的問題。

items.en: Technology makes our lives easier.
items.zh: 科技讓我們的生活更方便。

items.en: Nature can help people feel calm.
items.zh: 大自然能讓人平靜下來。

examples.heading: ⑤ 動名詞泛指活動

items.en: Online shopping saves a lot of time.
items.zh: 網路購物省下很多時間。

items.en: Smoking is not allowed in this building.
items.zh: 這棟大樓禁止吸菸。

items.en: Travelling teaches you about other cultures.
items.zh: 旅行讓你認識別的文化。

items.en: Gardening keeps my grandparents busy and fit.
items.zh: 園藝讓我爺爺奶奶既忙碌又健康。

examples.heading: ⑥ 給建議

items.en: Remember that hard work always pays off in the end.
items.zh: 記住，努力最後一定會有回報。

items.en: Patience is important when you learn a language.
items.zh: 學語言的時候，耐心很重要。

items.en: Exercise is good for both body and mind.
items.zh: 運動對身心都好。

items.en: Money can't buy happiness.
items.zh: 錢買不到快樂。

examples.heading: ⑦ 泛指和特指對照

items.en: History is my best subject. The history of China is especially interesting.
items.zh: 歷史是我最拿手的科目。中國的歷史特別有意思。

items.en: Music helps me relax. The music in this café is too loud, though.
items.zh: 音樂讓我放鬆。不過這家咖啡館的音樂太大聲了。

items.en: Coffee keeps me awake. The coffee at work is terrible.
items.zh: 咖啡讓我保持清醒。公司的咖啡很難喝。

items.en: Art is for everyone. The art in this museum is free to see.
items.zh: 藝術屬於每個人。這間博物館的藝術品可以免費參觀。

items.en: Life in a big city is exciting, but the life of a farmer is peaceful.
items.zh: 大城市的生活很刺激，可是農夫的生活很平靜。

title: I want to buy the red dress.
translation: 我想買那件紅色洋裝。
name: 表示特指的 the 加形容詞
sentences: The red sofa came from my grandmother's house.
The black cat in the garden belongs to our neighbour.
Can I try on the green jacket, please?
Take the yellow bus to the beach.
Please put the white towels in the bathroom.
Dad still drives the old van to work.
We walked across the old bridge into town.
The new library opens next Monday.
I prefer the old version of this game.
The big box is for your brother, and the small one is for you.
Lily sleeps in the small bedroom.
Let's sit at the large table near the window.
The heavy suitcase belongs to Mr Brown.
The cups are on the top shelf.
Turn into the first street on the left.
My name is on the last page.
The left window doesn't open.
How much is the blue shirt?
Is the striped scarf on sale too?
Can I see the silver watch in the window?
Does the brown belt come in a larger size?
For the first class you need to bring coloured pens and paper.
The new students are in Room 4.
Please read the short text on page ten.
The difficult questions are at the end of the test.
Can you get the clean plates out of the dishwasher?
The dirty clothes go in the basket.
The old sofa is in the garage now.
Turn off the big light, please.
Put the hot pan on the wooden board.

examples.heading: ① 顏色

items.en: The red sofa came from my grandmother's house.
items.zh: 那張紅色沙發是從我奶奶家搬來的。

items.en: The black cat in the garden belongs to our neighbour.
items.zh: 花園裡那隻黑貓是我們鄰居的。

items.en: Can I try on the green jacket, please?
items.zh: 我可以試穿那件綠色外套嗎？

items.en: Take the yellow bus to the beach.
items.zh: 搭那班黃色公車去海邊。

items.en: Please put the white towels in the bathroom.
items.zh: 請把那些白色毛巾放進浴室。

examples.heading: ② 新和舊

items.en: Dad still drives the old van to work.
items.zh: 爸爸還是開那台舊廂型車上班。

items.en: We walked across the old bridge into town.
items.zh: 我們走過那座舊橋進城。

items.en: The new library opens next Monday.
items.zh: 那間新圖書館下星期一開幕。

items.en: I prefer the old version of this game.
items.zh: 我比較喜歡這個遊戲的舊版本。

examples.heading: ③ 大小

items.en: The big box is for your brother, and the small one is for you.
items.zh: 那個大箱子是給你哥哥的，小的是給你的。

items.en: Lily sleeps in the small bedroom.
items.zh: Lily 睡在那間小臥室。

items.en: Let's sit at the large table near the window.
items.zh: 我們坐在窗邊那張大桌子吧。

items.en: The heavy suitcase belongs to Mr Brown.
items.zh: 那個很重的行李箱是 Brown 先生的。

examples.heading: ④ 位置

items.en: The cups are on the top shelf.
items.zh: 杯子在最上面那層架子。

items.en: Turn into the first street on the left.
items.zh: 在左邊第一條街轉進去。

items.en: My name is on the last page.
items.zh: 我的名字在最後一頁。

items.en: The left window doesn't open.
items.zh: 左邊那扇窗戶打不開。

examples.heading: ⑤ 在店裡

items.en: How much is the blue shirt?
items.zh: 那件藍色襯衫多少錢？

items.en: Is the striped scarf on sale too?
items.zh: 那條條紋圍巾也在特價嗎？

items.en: Can I see the silver watch in the window?
items.zh: 我可以看櫥窗裡那支銀色手錶嗎？

items.en: Does the brown belt come in a larger size?
items.zh: 那條咖啡色皮帶有大一點的尺寸嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 在學校

items.en: For the first class you need to bring coloured pens and paper.
items.zh: 第一堂課要帶彩色筆和紙。

items.en: The new students are in Room 4.
items.zh: 新生在四號教室。

items.en: Please read the short text on page ten.
items.zh: 請讀第十頁那篇短文。

items.en: The difficult questions are at the end of the test.
items.zh: 難的題目在考卷最後面。

examples.heading: ⑦ 在家裡

items.en: Can you get the clean plates out of the dishwasher?
items.zh: 你可以把洗碗機裡的乾淨盤子拿出來嗎？

items.en: The dirty clothes go in the basket.
items.zh: 髒衣服放進籃子裡。

items.en: The old sofa is in the garage now.
items.zh: 那張舊沙發現在放在車庫。

items.en: Turn off the big light, please.
items.zh: 請把大燈關掉。

items.en: Put the hot pan on the wooden board.
items.zh: 把那個熱鍋子放在木板上。

title: The better the education you have, the better the opportunities you can get.
translation: 你受的教育越好，能得到的機會就越好。
name: the more …, the more … 比較句
sentences: The more I learn about space, the more I want to know.
The more you smile, the more people smile back.
The more books you read, the more ideas you get.
The more he talked, the more bored she became.
The more I sleep, the less energy I seem to have.
The more you eat late at night, the less you sleep.
The more you worry, the less you can enjoy life.
The more time I spend on my phone, the less I study.
The better you know a city, the better you can enjoy it.
The better the weather, the busier the beach.
The better your English is, the better job you can find.
The older my grandfather gets, the happier he seems.
The bigger the house, the higher the rent.
The faster you drive, the more dangerous it is.
The longer we waited, the angrier the customers got.
The cheaper the ticket, the earlier you have to book.
The more difficult the question, the more interesting the answer.
The more expensive the hotel, the more comfortable the beds.
The more popular the restaurant, the longer you wait for a table.
You can watch one or two hours a day, but the more you watch, the worse you become.
The later you go to bed, the worse you feel in the morning.
The worse the traffic, the later we arrive.
The less you exercise, the worse your back gets.
"When do you need the report?" "The sooner, the better."
"How many people can come to the party?" "The more, the merrier!"
"How big should the cake be?" "The bigger, the better."
"Should I add more salt?" "The less, the better."
"How spicy do you want it?" "The hotter, the better!"
Book your flights early. The earlier, the better.
Fresh bread tastes great. The fresher, the better.

examples.heading: ① the more ..., the more ...

items.en: The more I learn about space, the more I want to know.
items.zh: 我對太空知道得越多，就越想知道更多。

items.en: The more you smile, the more people smile back.
items.zh: 你笑得越多，別人就越常對你笑。

items.en: The more books you read, the more ideas you get.
items.zh: 你讀的書越多，得到的想法就越多。

items.en: The more he talked, the more bored she became.
items.zh: 他講得越多，她就越覺得無聊。

examples.heading: ② the more ..., the less ...

items.en: The more I sleep, the less energy I seem to have.
items.zh: 我睡得越多，好像越沒精神。

items.en: The more you eat late at night, the less you sleep.
items.zh: 你越常深夜吃東西，就睡得越少。

items.en: The more you worry, the less you can enjoy life.
items.zh: 你越擔心，就越不能享受生活。

items.en: The more time I spend on my phone, the less I study.
items.zh: 我花在手機上的時間越多，讀書的時間就越少。

examples.heading: ③ the better ..., the better ...

items.en: The better you know a city, the better you can enjoy it.
items.zh: 你越了解一座城市，就越能好好享受它。

items.en: The better the weather, the busier the beach.
items.zh: 天氣越好，海灘就越擠。

items.en: The better your English is, the better job you can find.
items.zh: 你的英文越好，就越能找到好工作。

examples.heading: ④ the + 形容詞 -er

items.en: The older my grandfather gets, the happier he seems.
items.zh: 我爺爺年紀越大，看起來越快樂。

items.en: The bigger the house, the higher the rent.
items.zh: 房子越大，房租就越高。

items.en: The faster you drive, the more dangerous it is.
items.zh: 你開得越快就越危險。

items.en: The longer we waited, the angrier the customers got.
items.zh: 我們等得越久，客人就越生氣。

items.en: The cheaper the ticket, the earlier you have to book.
items.zh: 票越便宜，就越要早點訂。

examples.heading: ⑤ the more + 長的形容詞

items.en: The more difficult the question, the more interesting the answer.
items.zh: 問題越難，答案就越有意思。

items.en: The more expensive the hotel, the more comfortable the beds.
items.zh: 飯店越貴，床就越舒服。

items.en: The more popular the restaurant, the longer you wait for a table.
items.zh: 餐廳越受歡迎，等位子的時間就越長。

examples.heading: ⑥ the worse ...

items.en: You can watch one or two hours a day, but the more you watch, the worse you become.
items.zh: 你一天可以看一兩個小時，可是看得越多，就變得越糟。

items.en: The later you go to bed, the worse you feel in the morning.
items.zh: 你越晚睡，早上就越不舒服。

items.en: The worse the traffic, the later we arrive.
items.zh: 交通越糟，我們就越晚到。

items.en: The less you exercise, the worse your back gets.
items.zh: 你越少運動，背就越不好。

examples.heading: ⑦ 短句

items.en: "When do you need the report?" "The sooner, the better."
items.zh: 你什麼時候要這份報告？越快越好。

items.en: "How many people can come to the party?" "The more, the merrier!"
items.zh: 派對可以來多少人？人越多越熱鬧！

items.en: "How big should the cake be?" "The bigger, the better."
items.zh: 蛋糕要多大？越大越好。

items.en: "Should I add more salt?" "The less, the better."
items.zh: 要多加點鹽嗎？越少越好。

items.en: "How spicy do you want it?" "The hotter, the better!"
items.zh: 你要多辣？越辣越好！

items.en: Book your flights early. The earlier, the better.
items.zh: 早點訂機票。越早越好。

items.en: Fresh bread tastes great. The fresher, the better.
items.zh: 新鮮的麵包很好吃。越新鮮越好。

title: She saw his blue jacket in a shop on the other side of the street.
translation: 她在對街的一家店裡看到了他那件藍色夾克。
name: the other 加名詞
sentences: The bank is on the other side of the road.
My grandparents live on the other side of town.
Please write your answer on the other side of the paper.
I could hear music from the other side of the wall.
I have two cars. One is red, and the other one is black.
My left ear is fine, but the other ear hurts.
One twin likes football. The other twin prefers music.
The lift is broken, so use the other lift.
I moved to this house because the other house was very small, and my brother and I had to share a bedroom.
This job pays better than the other job did.
I like this teacher more than the other teacher.
In the first lesson we did some games in English, so I met all the other people in the class.
We need a new delivery company, because the other companies are very expensive.
Anna finished first, and the other runners came in a few minutes later.
Where are the other plates? I can only find three.
Two of the windows are open. Please close the other windows too.
The city is exciting. On the other hand, it's very expensive.
The flat is small. On the other hand, it's close to my office.
I'd like to go out. On the other hand, I'm really tired.
I saw your brother in the supermarket the other day.
The other day I found an old photo of my parents.
We had a lovely dinner at that new restaurant the other day.
It's not my fault, it's the other way round.
You put the battery in the other way round.
I thought he was older than her, but it's the other way round.
One of my shoes is under the bed, but where is the other shoe?
Lucy is here, but where are the other girls?
Two students passed, and the other students failed.
One road goes to the beach, and the other road goes to the hills.
I'll carry this bag. You take the other bag.

examples.heading: ① the other side
