items.en: The bank is on the other side of the road.
items.zh: 銀行在馬路對面。

items.en: My grandparents live on the other side of town.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶住在鎮的另一頭。

items.en: Please write your answer on the other side of the paper.
items.zh: 請把答案寫在紙的背面。

items.en: I could hear music from the other side of the wall.
items.zh: 我聽得到牆另一邊傳來的音樂。

examples.heading: ② 兩個裡面的另一個

items.en: I have two cars. One is red, and the other one is black.
items.zh: 我有兩台車。一台紅的，另一台黑的。

items.en: My left ear is fine, but the other ear hurts.
items.zh: 我的左耳沒事，可是另一隻耳朵很痛。

items.en: One twin likes football. The other twin prefers music.
items.zh: 雙胞胎一個喜歡足球，另一個比較喜歡音樂。

items.en: The lift is broken, so use the other lift.
items.zh: 這台電梯壞了，所以用另一台。

examples.heading: ③ 之前的那一個

items.en: I moved to this house because the other house was very small, and my brother and I had to share a bedroom.
items.zh: 我搬到這間房子，因為之前那間太小，我和我哥哥得共用一間臥室。

items.en: This job pays better than the other job did.
items.zh: 這份工作的薪水比之前那份好。

items.en: I like this teacher more than the other teacher.
items.zh: 比起之前那位老師，我比較喜歡這位。

examples.heading: ④ the other + 複數名詞

items.en: In the first lesson we did some games in English, so I met all the other people in the class.
items.zh: 第一堂課我們玩了一些英文遊戲，所以我認識了班上其他所有的人。

items.en: We need a new delivery company, because the other companies are very expensive.
items.zh: 我們需要一家新的送貨公司，因為其他公司都很貴。

items.en: Anna finished first, and the other runners came in a few minutes later.
items.zh: Anna 第一個跑完，其他跑者幾分鐘後才到。

items.en: Where are the other plates? I can only find three.
items.zh: 其他盤子在哪裡？我只找到三個。

items.en: Two of the windows are open. Please close the other windows too.
items.zh: 有兩扇窗戶開著。請把其他窗戶也關上。

examples.heading: ⑤ on the other hand

items.en: The city is exciting. On the other hand, it's very expensive.
items.zh: 城市很刺激。另一方面，生活費很貴。

items.en: The flat is small. On the other hand, it's close to my office.
items.zh: 公寓很小。不過另一方面，離我公司很近。

items.en: I'd like to go out. On the other hand, I'm really tired.
items.zh: 我想出去。可是另一方面，我真的很累。

examples.heading: ⑥ the other day、the other way round

items.en: I saw your brother in the supermarket the other day.
items.zh: 我前幾天在超市看到你哥哥。

items.en: The other day I found an old photo of my parents.
items.zh: 前幾天我找到一張我爸媽的舊照片。

items.en: We had a lovely dinner at that new restaurant the other day.
items.zh: 前幾天我們在那家新餐廳吃了一頓很棒的晚餐。

items.en: It's not my fault, it's the other way round.
items.zh: 不是我的錯，正好相反。

items.en: You put the battery in the other way round.
items.zh: 你把電池裝反了。

items.en: I thought he was older than her, but it's the other way round.
items.zh: 我以為他比她大，可是正好相反。

examples.heading: ⑦ 和 one 對照

items.en: One of my shoes is under the bed, but where is the other shoe?
items.zh: 我有一隻鞋在床底下，可是另一隻鞋在哪？

items.en: Lucy is here, but where are the other girls?
items.zh: Lucy 在這裡，可是其他女生呢？

items.en: Two students passed, and the other students failed.
items.zh: 兩個學生通過，其他學生都沒過。

items.en: One road goes to the beach, and the other road goes to the hills.
items.zh: 一條路通往海邊，另一條路通往山丘。

items.en: I'll carry this bag. You take the other bag.
items.zh: 我提這個袋子。你拿另一個袋子。

title: This characteristic of his is shown in every situation in his life.
translation: 他的這個特點表現在他生活中的每一個場合。
name: this … of 加所有格代名詞（強調）
sentences: My grandfather never gets angry. This characteristic of his is shown in every situation in his life.
She always remembers people's names. This gift of hers makes everyone feel welcome.
He gives away half of his salary. This generosity of his is well known in the town.
This sense of humour of hers helped her through difficult times.
Our athletes are amazing. Not only is this rare talent of theirs used for public pleasure, but also for international sports success, which makes us all proud.
The team never gives up. This fighting spirit of theirs wins them a lot of games.
My parents believe in hard work. This attitude of theirs has influenced me a lot.
These ideas of yours are very interesting. Can you write them down?
These paintings of hers are the best in the exhibition.
These stories of his always make the children laugh.
This dream of mine finally came true when I visited Japan.
This plan of ours will save the company a lot of money.
This bad habit of yours has to stop. You're always late.
Mandela forgave the people who put him in prison. This quality of his inspired the whole world.
The writer describes ordinary life in great detail. This skill of hers makes her books feel real.
My best friend always tells the truth. This honesty of hers is why I trust her.
"He's been helping his neighbours every weekend." "That's typical. This kindness of his is rare these days."
"I've got another idea for the party." "Not another one! These ideas of yours always cost too much."

examples.heading: ① this + 名詞 + of his / hers

items.en: My grandfather never gets angry. This characteristic of his is shown in every situation in his life.
items.zh: 我爺爺從來不生氣。他的這個特點表現在他生活中的每一個場合。

items.en: She always remembers people's names. This gift of hers makes everyone feel welcome.
items.zh: 她總是記得別人的名字。她的這個本事讓每個人都覺得受歡迎。

items.en: He gives away half of his salary. This generosity of his is well known in the town.
items.zh: 他把一半的薪水捐出去。他的這份慷慨在鎮上很有名。

items.en: This sense of humour of hers helped her through difficult times.
items.zh: 她的這種幽默感幫她度過了困難的時候。

examples.heading: ② this + 名詞 + of theirs

items.en: Our athletes are amazing. Not only is this rare talent of theirs used for public pleasure, but also for international sports success, which makes us all proud.
items.zh: 我們的運動員很了不起。他們這種難得的天分不只帶給大眾樂趣，也在國際體壇上爭光，讓我們都感到驕傲。

items.en: The team never gives up. This fighting spirit of theirs wins them a lot of games.
items.zh: 那支球隊從不放棄。他們的這種鬥志讓他們贏了很多比賽。

items.en: My parents believe in hard work. This attitude of theirs has influenced me a lot.
items.zh: 我爸媽相信努力。他們的這種態度對我影響很大。

examples.heading: ③ these + 複數名詞 + of + 所有格代名詞

items.en: These ideas of yours are very interesting. Can you write them down?
items.zh: 你的這些想法很有意思。你可以寫下來嗎？

items.en: These paintings of hers are the best in the exhibition.
items.zh: 她的這些畫是展覽裡最好的。

items.en: These stories of his always make the children laugh.
items.zh: 他的這些故事總是逗得孩子們哈哈大笑。

examples.heading: ④ this + 名詞 + of mine / yours / ours

items.en: This dream of mine finally came true when I visited Japan.
items.zh: 我去了日本，我的這個夢想終於實現了。

items.en: This plan of ours will save the company a lot of money.
items.zh: 我們的這個計畫會幫公司省下很多錢。

items.en: This bad habit of yours has to stop. You're always late.
items.zh: 你這個壞習慣一定要改。你老是遲到。

examples.heading: ⑤ 論說文和人物介紹

items.en: Mandela forgave the people who put him in prison. This quality of his inspired the whole world.
items.zh: 曼德拉原諒了把他關進監獄的人。他的這種品格鼓舞了全世界。

items.en: The writer describes ordinary life in great detail. This skill of hers makes her books feel real.
items.zh: 那位作家把平凡的生活寫得很細膩。她的這個技巧讓她的書讀起來很真實。

items.en: My best friend always tells the truth. This honesty of hers is why I trust her.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友總是說實話。她的這份誠實就是我信任她的原因。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "He's been helping his neighbours every weekend." "That's typical. This kindness of his is rare these days."
items.zh: 他每個週末都去幫鄰居。他就是這樣。他的這種善良現在很少見了。

items.en: "I've got another idea for the party." "Not another one! These ideas of yours always cost too much."
items.zh: 派對我又想到一個點子。又來了！你的這些點子總是太花錢。

title: I had a bit of free time, so I took the bus to my friend's house.
translation: 我有一點空閒時間，所以搭公車去朋友家。
name: 數量限定詞加不可數名詞（a little、a bit of）
sentences: I went to the cinema with my friends so we could spend a little time together.
Add a little salt to the water before you cook the pasta.
The soup is too thick. Put a little water in it.
I only speak a little Spanish, but I can order food.
You'll pass the test. You just need a little practice.
On Saturday I had a bit of free time, so I took the bus to my friend's house.
Could you give me a bit of help with these boxes?
I've got a bit of money left. Let's get an ice cream.
Good luck in the race tomorrow! You'll need a bit of luck with the weather.
There was a bit of rain in the morning, but the afternoon was sunny.
I just watch a little bit of TV when I come home from school.
Can I have a little bit of cake? I'm not very hungry.
There's a little bit of coffee on your shirt.
I'm doing a little bit of exercise every morning now.
Would you like a little sugar in your coffee?
Can you lend me a bit of money until Friday?
Could I have a little bit of quiet, please? I'm trying to study.
Do you want a bit of advice? Take an umbrella.
I'm having a great time here. I've even learned a bit of French.
After the exams, I want a little bit of peace before the summer job starts.
Bring a little food for the journey. The train has no café.
The plant looks dry. Give it a little water every day.
My phone has only a bit of battery left.
There's a little bit of snow on the mountains this morning.
With a bit of hard work, you can finish it by Monday.
"Do you want milk?" "Just a little, please."
"Are you busy?" "A bit. I've got a little bit of work to finish."
"How was the beach?" "Lovely. We had a bit of sun in the afternoon."
"Can you play the piano?" "A little. I had a bit of practice as a child."

examples.heading: ① a little + 不可數名詞

items.en: I went to the cinema with my friends so we could spend a little time together.
items.zh: 我跟朋友去看電影，這樣我們可以一起待一下。

items.en: Add a little salt to the water before you cook the pasta.
items.zh: 煮義大利麵之前，在水裡加一點鹽。

items.en: The soup is too thick. Put a little water in it.
items.zh: 湯太濃了。加一點水進去。

items.en: I only speak a little Spanish, but I can order food.
items.zh: 我只會說一點西班牙文，可是我會點菜。

items.en: You'll pass the test. You just need a little practice.
items.zh: 你會通過考試的。你只需要多練習一點。

examples.heading: ② a bit of + 不可數名詞

items.en: On Saturday I had a bit of free time, so I took the bus to my friend's house.
items.zh: 星期六我有一點空閒時間，所以搭公車去朋友家。

items.en: Could you give me a bit of help with these boxes?
items.zh: 你可以幫我搬一下這些箱子嗎？

items.en: I've got a bit of money left. Let's get an ice cream.
items.zh: 我還剩一點錢。我們去買冰淇淋吧。

items.en: Good luck in the race tomorrow! You'll need a bit of luck with the weather.
items.zh: 祝你明天比賽順利！天氣方面你需要一點運氣。

items.en: There was a bit of rain in the morning, but the afternoon was sunny.
items.zh: 早上下了一點雨，可是下午出太陽。

examples.heading: ③ a little bit of + 不可數名詞

items.en: I just watch a little bit of TV when I come home from school.
items.zh: 我放學回家只看一點點電視。

items.en: Can I have a little bit of cake? I'm not very hungry.
items.zh: 我可以吃一點點蛋糕嗎？我不太餓。

items.en: There's a little bit of coffee on your shirt.
items.zh: 你的襯衫上沾到一點咖啡。

items.en: I'm doing a little bit of exercise every morning now.
items.zh: 我現在每天早上做一點點運動。

examples.heading: ④ 問句和請求

items.en: Would you like a little sugar in your coffee?
items.zh: 你的咖啡要加一點糖嗎？

items.en: Can you lend me a bit of money until Friday?
items.zh: 你可以借我一點錢到星期五嗎？

items.en: Could I have a little bit of quiet, please? I'm trying to study.
items.zh: 可以安靜一點嗎？我在讀書。

items.en: Do you want a bit of advice? Take an umbrella.
items.zh: 要不要聽我一句建議？帶把傘。

examples.heading: ⑤ 寫給朋友的信

items.en: I'm having a great time here. I've even learned a bit of French.
items.zh: 我在這裡玩得很開心。我甚至學了一點法文。

items.en: After the exams, I want a little bit of peace before the summer job starts.
items.zh: 考完試以後，暑期打工開始之前，我想清靜一下。

items.en: Bring a little food for the journey. The train has no café.
items.zh: 帶一點吃的在路上吃。火車上沒有餐車。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的情境

items.en: The plant looks dry. Give it a little water every day.
items.zh: 這株植物看起來很乾。每天給它澆一點水。

items.en: My phone has only a bit of battery left.
items.zh: 我的手機只剩一點電了。

items.en: There's a little bit of snow on the mountains this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上山上有一點雪。

items.en: With a bit of hard work, you can finish it by Monday.
items.zh: 多努力一點，你星期一之前就能做完。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Do you want milk?" "Just a little, please."
items.zh: 你要牛奶嗎？一點就好，謝謝。

items.en: "Are you busy?" "A bit. I've got a little bit of work to finish."
items.zh: 你在忙嗎？有一點。我還有一點工作要做完。

items.en: "How was the beach?" "Lovely. We had a bit of sun in the afternoon."
items.zh: 海邊怎麼樣？很好。下午出了一點太陽。

items.en: "Can you play the piano?" "A little. I had a bit of practice as a child."
items.zh: 你會彈鋼琴嗎？會一點。我小時候練過一點。

title: She lives in a small flat in the town.
translation: 她住在鎮上的一間小公寓。
name: 冠詞 the、a、an 放在名詞前
sentences: I have a sister and a brother.
Her uncle is a bus driver in Manchester.
There is a bank near my house.
There is a supermarket opposite the school.
We have a cat at home.
I eat an orange every morning.
My cousin works as an artist in Paris.
He waited for an hour at the bus stop.
I need an envelope for this letter.
She has an older brother in London.
The sun is very hot today.
Look at the moon. It's beautiful tonight.
The sky is blue and clear.
My office is on the top floor.
Let's meet at the station at six.
Mum is in the kitchen.
I go to the gym after work.
The bathroom is upstairs on the left.
The shops in the town close at seven.
I saw a film last night. The film was very funny.
We stayed in a hotel. The hotel had a big pool.
My friend gave me a book. The book is about China.
There's a café on my street. The coffee there is great.
Put the milk in the fridge.
He works in a big office in the city centre.
The children are playing in the garden.
I live in a house with a red door.
I found my phone behind the sofa.
I live in a small village near the sea.
My brother has an old car.
My grandparents live in a flat in the city.
I have an English class on Monday.

examples.heading: ① a + 名詞

items.en: I have a sister and a brother.
items.zh: 我有一個姊姊和一個弟弟。

items.en: Her uncle is a bus driver in Manchester.
items.zh: 她叔叔在曼徹斯特當公車司機。

items.en: There is a bank near my house.
items.zh: 我家附近有一家銀行。

items.en: There is a supermarket opposite the school.
items.zh: 學校對面有一家超市。

items.en: We have a cat at home.
items.zh: 我們家有養一隻貓。

examples.heading: ② an + 名詞

items.en: I eat an orange every morning.
items.zh: 我每天早上吃一顆柳橙。

items.en: My cousin works as an artist in Paris.
items.zh: 我表哥在巴黎當藝術家。

items.en: He waited for an hour at the bus stop.
items.zh: 他在公車站等了一個小時。

items.en: I need an envelope for this letter.
items.zh: 這封信我需要一個信封。

items.en: She has an older brother in London.
items.zh: 她有一個哥哥住在倫敦。

examples.heading: ③ the + 名詞：只有一個的東西

items.en: The sun is very hot today.
items.zh: 今天太陽很大。

items.en: Look at the moon. It's beautiful tonight.
items.zh: 你看月亮。今晚好美。

items.en: The sky is blue and clear.
items.zh: 天空又藍又清。

items.en: My office is on the top floor.
items.zh: 我的辦公室在頂樓。

examples.heading: ④ the + 名詞：大家知道的地方

items.en: Let's meet at the station at six.
items.zh: 我們六點在車站碰面。

items.en: Mum is in the kitchen.
items.zh: 媽媽在廚房。

items.en: I go to the gym after work.
items.zh: 我下班後去健身房。

items.en: The bathroom is upstairs on the left.
items.zh: 浴室在樓上左手邊。

items.en: The shops in the town close at seven.
items.zh: 鎮上的商店七點關門。

examples.heading: ⑤ 先用 a，再用 the

items.en: I saw a film last night. The film was very funny.
items.zh: 我昨晚看了一部電影。那部電影很好笑。

items.en: We stayed in a hotel. The hotel had a big pool.
items.zh: 我們住在一家飯店。那家飯店有一個大游泳池。

items.en: My friend gave me a book. The book is about China.
items.zh: 朋友送我一本書。那本書在講中國。

items.en: There's a café on my street. The coffee there is great.
items.zh: 我住的街上有一家咖啡館。那裡的咖啡很棒。

examples.heading: ⑥ 介系詞 + 冠詞 + 名詞

items.en: Put the milk in the fridge.
items.zh: 把牛奶放進冰箱。

items.en: He works in a big office in the city centre.
items.zh: 他在市中心的一間大辦公室上班。

items.en: The children are playing in the garden.
items.zh: 小孩在花園裡玩。

items.en: I live in a house with a red door.
items.zh: 我住在一棟紅色大門的房子。

items.en: I found my phone behind the sofa.
items.zh: 我在沙發後面找到我的手機。

examples.heading: ⑦ 介紹自己和家人

items.en: I live in a small village near the sea.
items.zh: 我住在海邊附近的一個小村莊。

items.en: My brother has an old car.
items.zh: 我哥哥有一輛舊車。

items.en: My grandparents live in a flat in the city.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶住在市區的一間公寓。

items.en: I have an English class on Monday.
items.zh: 我星期一有英文課。

title: I live with my mother and her boyfriend.
translation: 我跟我媽和她男朋友住在一起。
name: 所有格限定詞放在名詞前
sentences: I live with my family. My home is a flat.
My neighbours are very nice and helpful.
I like my teachers. They're very friendly.
I keep my bike in the garden shed.
My parents are divorced. I live with my mother and her boyfriend.
My sister is in her room.
Maria walks to school with her friends.
My grandma loves her garden.
My brother plays football with his friends on Saturdays.
My dad drives his car to work.
Paul lives with his grandparents.
Peter can't find his keys.
Our house has four rooms, one bathroom and one toilet.
Our English teacher gives us a test every Friday.
We love our dog. His name is Max.
Our school has a big field, so we play sports every day.
Hello! Welcome to the class. Can you tell us your name?
Don't forget your umbrella. It's raining.
Please write your address on this form.
Is your mum a doctor? I saw her at the hospital.
"Where do you live?" "In a flat with my parents."
"Who's that girl?" "That's Lucy. Her dad is my teacher."
"Do you like your new school?" "Yes, our classroom is really big."

examples.heading: ① my + 名詞

items.en: I live with my family. My home is a flat.
items.zh: 我跟家人住。我家是一間公寓。

items.en: My neighbours are very nice and helpful.
items.zh: 我的鄰居很好，也很樂於幫忙。

items.en: I like my teachers. They're very friendly.
items.zh: 我喜歡我的老師。他們很友善。

items.en: I keep my bike in the garden shed.
items.zh: 我把腳踏車放在花園的小屋裡。

examples.heading: ② her + 名詞

items.en: My parents are divorced. I live with my mother and her boyfriend.
items.zh: 我爸媽離婚了。我跟我媽和她男朋友住在一起。

items.en: My sister is in her room.
items.zh: 我姊姊在她的房間。

items.en: Maria walks to school with her friends.
items.zh: Maria 跟她的朋友一起走路上學。

items.en: My grandma loves her garden.
items.zh: 我奶奶很愛她的花園。

examples.heading: ③ his + 名詞

items.en: My brother plays football with his friends on Saturdays.
items.zh: 我哥哥星期六跟他的朋友踢足球。

items.en: My dad drives his car to work.
items.zh: 我爸爸開車上班。

items.en: Paul lives with his grandparents.
items.zh: Paul 跟他的爺爺奶奶住。

items.en: Peter can't find his keys.
items.zh: Peter 找不到他的鑰匙。

examples.heading: ④ our + 名詞

items.en: Our house has four rooms, one bathroom and one toilet.
items.zh: 我們家有四個房間、一間浴室和一間廁所。

items.en: Our English teacher gives us a test every Friday.
items.zh: 我們的英文老師每個星期五都給我們考試。

items.en: We love our dog. His name is Max.
items.zh: 我們很愛我們的狗。牠叫 Max。

items.en: Our school has a big field, so we play sports every day.
items.zh: 我們學校有一個大操場，所以我們每天都運動。

examples.heading: ⑤ your + 名詞

items.en: Hello! Welcome to the class. Can you tell us your name?
items.zh: 哈囉！歡迎來上課。你可以告訴我們你的名字嗎？

items.en: Don't forget your umbrella. It's raining.
items.zh: 別忘了帶你的傘。外面在下雨。

items.en: Please write your address on this form.
items.zh: 請在這張表格上寫你的地址。

items.en: Is your mum a doctor? I saw her at the hospital.
items.zh: 你媽媽是醫生嗎？我在醫院看到她。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Where do you live?" "In a flat with my parents."
items.zh: 你住在哪裡？跟我爸媽住在一間公寓。

items.en: "Who's that girl?" "That's Lucy. Her dad is my teacher."
items.zh: 那個女孩是誰？那是 Lucy。她爸爸是我的老師。

items.en: "Do you like your new school?" "Yes, our classroom is really big."
items.zh: 你喜歡你的新學校嗎？喜歡，我們的教室很大。

title: I think we should bring some water to drink.
translation: 我覺得我們應該帶點水來喝。
name: 數量限定詞加複數名詞和不可數名詞
sentences: There are no shops on the mountain. I think we should bring some water to drink.
We're out of fruit. Could you get some bananas at the market?
I've made some sandwiches for the journey.
Some friends from school are coming for dinner.
I bought these shorts because I don't have any clothes for the summer, and I need them!
Have you got any brothers or sisters?
Sorry, I can't pay for the coffee. I haven't got any cash.
Are there any good films on TV tonight?
The weather was great on Saturday. There were no clouds.
I want to see that film, but I have no time today because I have more work at home.
The village is very quiet. There are no cars in the main street.
My grandparents have no internet at their house.
If you want more details about the course, you can call this number.
We will meet at my house at 10.15, so we will have more time in the club.
We need more chairs. Ten people are coming.
Can I have more milk in my tea, please?
It was a great birthday. We danced, played games and had lots of fun.
There are a lot of tourists in the town in summer.
She drinks a lot of tea, about six cups a day.
I've got lots of friends in my new class.
The children have no school on Monday. It's a holiday.
Did you make any mistakes in the test?
Let's buy some flowers for Grandma.
You'll get more information at the tourist office.
"Have we got any eggs?" "No, we've got no eggs. I'll get some."
"Would you like more cake?" "Yes, please. It's lovely."
"How was the beach?" "Great. There were lots of people, but we found a nice place."

examples.heading: ① some + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: There are no shops on the mountain. I think we should bring some water to drink.
items.zh: 山上沒有商店。我覺得我們應該帶點水來喝。

items.en: We're out of fruit. Could you get some bananas at the market?
items.zh: 水果吃完了。你可以去市場買些香蕉嗎？

items.en: I've made some sandwiches for the journey.
items.zh: 我做了一些三明治在路上吃。

items.en: Some friends from school are coming for dinner.
items.zh: 幾個學校的朋友要來吃晚餐。

examples.heading: ② any + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: I bought these shorts because I don't have any clothes for the summer, and I need them!
items.zh: 我買了這幾件短褲，因為我沒有夏天穿的衣服，我需要！

items.en: Have you got any brothers or sisters?
items.zh: 你有兄弟姊妹嗎？

items.en: Sorry, I can't pay for the coffee. I haven't got any cash.
items.zh: 抱歉，我沒辦法付咖啡錢。我身上沒有現金。

items.en: Are there any good films on TV tonight?
items.zh: 今晚電視有好看的電影嗎？

examples.heading: ③ no + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: The weather was great on Saturday. There were no clouds.
items.zh: 星期六天氣很好。天上一朵雲也沒有。

items.en: I want to see that film, but I have no time today because I have more work at home.
items.zh: 我想看那部電影，可是我今天沒時間，因為我家裡還有更多工作。

items.en: The village is very quiet. There are no cars in the main street.
items.zh: 那個村子很安靜。大街上一輛車也沒有。

items.en: My grandparents have no internet at their house.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶家沒有網路。

examples.heading: ④ more + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: If you want more details about the course, you can call this number.
items.zh: 想知道這門課更多的細節，可以打這個號碼。

items.en: We will meet at my house at 10.15, so we will have more time in the club.
items.zh: 我們十點十五分在我家集合，這樣在俱樂部就有更多時間。

items.en: We need more chairs. Ten people are coming.
items.zh: 我們需要更多椅子。有十個人要來。

items.en: Can I have more milk in my tea, please?
items.zh: 我的茶可以再多加點牛奶嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ a lot of / lots of + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: It was a great birthday. We danced, played games and had lots of fun.
items.zh: 那是一個很棒的生日。我們跳舞、玩遊戲，玩得很開心。

items.en: There are a lot of tourists in the town in summer.
items.zh: 夏天鎮上有很多觀光客。

items.en: She drinks a lot of tea, about six cups a day.
items.zh: 她喝很多茶，一天大概六杯。

items.en: I've got lots of friends in my new class.
items.zh: 我在新班級有很多朋友。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的情境

items.en: The children have no school on Monday. It's a holiday.
items.zh: 孩子們星期一不用上學。那天放假。

items.en: Did you make any mistakes in the test?
items.zh: 你考試有寫錯嗎？

items.en: Let's buy some flowers for Grandma.
items.zh: 我們買些花給奶奶吧。

items.en: You'll get more information at the tourist office.
items.zh: 你在旅客服務中心可以拿到更多資訊。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Have we got any eggs?" "No, we've got no eggs. I'll get some."
items.zh: 我們有蛋嗎？沒有，一顆都沒有。我去買一些。

items.en: "Would you like more cake?" "Yes, please. It's lovely."
items.zh: 還要再來點蛋糕嗎？好，謝謝。很好吃。

items.en: "How was the beach?" "Great. There were lots of people, but we found a nice place."
items.zh: 海邊怎麼樣？很棒。人很多，可是我們找到一個好位置。

title: I'm convinced that most people watch too much TV these days.
translation: 我確信現在大多數人電視都看太多了。
name: 數量限定詞加複數和不可數名詞（most、enough）
sentences: I'm writing about TV for my essay. I'm convinced that most people watch too much TV these days.
Most shops in the village close on Sunday afternoons.
Most children in my class walk to school.
Most fruit is good for you, but don't eat too much at night.
I usually cook at home. Most fast food is too salty for me.
If you haven't got enough credit on your phone, we can meet at 11 am at the bookshop.
We can't play the game. There aren't enough players.
Have you got enough money for the bus?
There weren't enough seats on the train, so we stood all the way.
Drink enough water when it's hot.
I think if we meet at 8 pm, we'll have plenty of time to buy the tickets and some drinks.
Don't worry about food. There's plenty of pizza for everyone.
The town has plenty of cafés, so we can sit down anywhere.
You'll find plenty of good books in the school library.
We have plenty of chairs. Invite as many people as you like.
The trip was great. We went to loads of beautiful places.
I've got loads of homework this week.
She's got loads of friends at her new school.
There was loads of food at the wedding.
There isn't enough milk for breakfast. Can you get some?
Are there enough cups for everyone?
Most people didn't like the new timetable.
Have we got enough petrol to get home?
Take the big bag. It has plenty of space for your clothes.
Most students in my school learn two languages.
We spent loads of money on the holiday, but it was worth it.
The room is dark. There isn't enough light to read.
"Should we take a taxi?" "No, we've got plenty of time. Let's walk."
"Did you take any photos?" "Loads of photos! I'll send them to you."
"Is there enough cake for ten people?" "I think so."
"Do people here speak English?" "Yes, most people speak a little."

examples.heading: ① most + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: I'm writing about TV for my essay. I'm convinced that most people watch too much TV these days.
items.zh: 我在寫一篇關於電視的作文。我確信現在大多數人電視都看太多了。

items.en: Most shops in the village close on Sunday afternoons.
items.zh: 村子裡大部分商店星期天下午都關門。

items.en: Most children in my class walk to school.
items.zh: 我們班大部分小孩都走路上學。

items.en: Most fruit is good for you, but don't eat too much at night.
items.zh: 大部分水果對你都好，可是晚上別吃太多。

items.en: I usually cook at home. Most fast food is too salty for me.
items.zh: 我通常在家煮。大部分速食對我來說太鹹了。

examples.heading: ② enough + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: If you haven't got enough credit on your phone, we can meet at 11 am at the bookshop.
items.zh: 如果你手機的通話費不夠，我們就十一點在書店見。

items.en: We can't play the game. There aren't enough players.
items.zh: 我們沒辦法玩這個遊戲。人數不夠。

items.en: Have you got enough money for the bus?
items.zh: 你搭公車的錢夠嗎？

items.en: There weren't enough seats on the train, so we stood all the way.
items.zh: 火車上的座位不夠，所以我們一路站著。

items.en: Drink enough water when it's hot.
items.zh: 天氣熱的時候要喝夠水。

examples.heading: ③ plenty of + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: I think if we meet at 8 pm, we'll have plenty of time to buy the tickets and some drinks.
items.zh: 我想如果我們八點見，就有很多時間買票和飲料。

items.en: Don't worry about food. There's plenty of pizza for everyone.
items.zh: 食物不用擔心。披薩很多，每個人都夠吃。

items.en: The town has plenty of cafés, so we can sit down anywhere.
items.zh: 那個小鎮咖啡店很多，所以我們隨處都能坐下來。

items.en: You'll find plenty of good books in the school library.
items.zh: 學校圖書館裡有很多好書。

items.en: We have plenty of chairs. Invite as many people as you like.
items.zh: 我們的椅子很多。想請多少人就請多少人。

examples.heading: ④ loads of + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞

items.en: The trip was great. We went to loads of beautiful places.
items.zh: 這趟旅行很棒。我們去了好多漂亮的地方。

items.en: I've got loads of homework this week.
items.zh: 我這星期有好多功課。

items.en: She's got loads of friends at her new school.
items.zh: 她在新學校交了好多朋友。

items.en: There was loads of food at the wedding.
items.zh: 婚禮上的食物好多。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定句和問句

items.en: There isn't enough milk for breakfast. Can you get some?
items.zh: 牛奶不夠早餐喝。你可以去買一些嗎？

items.en: Are there enough cups for everyone?
items.zh: 杯子夠每個人用嗎？

items.en: Most people didn't like the new timetable.
items.zh: 大部分人不喜歡新的時刻表。

items.en: Have we got enough petrol to get home?
items.zh: 我們的油夠開回家嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的情境

items.en: Take the big bag. It has plenty of space for your clothes.
items.zh: 帶那個大包包。它有很多空間放你的衣服。

items.en: Most students in my school learn two languages.
items.zh: 我們學校大部分學生都學兩種語言。

items.en: We spent loads of money on the holiday, but it was worth it.
items.zh: 我們這次度假花了好多錢，可是很值得。

items.en: The room is dark. There isn't enough light to read.
items.zh: 房間很暗。光線不夠看書。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Should we take a taxi?" "No, we've got plenty of time. Let's walk."
items.zh: 我們要搭計程車嗎？不用，時間還很多。走路吧。

items.en: "Did you take any photos?" "Loads of photos! I'll send them to you."
items.zh: 你有拍照嗎？拍了好多！我傳給你。

items.en: "Is there enough cake for ten people?" "I think so."
items.zh: 蛋糕夠十個人吃嗎？應該夠。

items.en: "Do people here speak English?" "Yes, most people speak a little."
items.zh: 這裡的人會說英文嗎？會，大部分人會說一點。

title: Near my home there are some shops.
translation: 我家附近有一些商店。
name: 數量限定詞加複數名詞
sentences: I live in a small town. Near my home there are some shops.
I've got some books for you.
My aunt sent me some postcards from Italy.
I need some stamps for these letters.
Some girls in my class play football.
My house is small. My house has got three rooms.
The bus to the city takes forty minutes.
Our school has two hundred students and fifteen teachers.
My cat has four kittens.
I drink two glasses of milk every morning.
I lived here when I was a child. I had a lot of friends in this town.
There are a lot of cars on the road today.
My grandma has a lot of plants in her garden.
We saw a lot of animals at the farm.
School is hard this year. For homework we have to write lots of things.
There are lots of people in the park on Sundays.
She has lots of DVDs.
My town has lots of restaurants.
My flat is near the station. It has two bedrooms.
In my street there are some old houses and a lot of trees.
There are lots of children in my building.
"Have you got any pets?" "Yes, two dogs."
"What did you buy?" "Some T-shirts and a lot of socks."
"Are there any good cafés here?" "Yes, lots of cafés."

examples.heading: ① some + 複數名詞

items.en: I live in a small town. Near my home there are some shops.
items.zh: 我住在一個小鎮。我家附近有一些商店。

items.en: I've got some books for you.
items.zh: 我有幾本書要給你。

items.en: My aunt sent me some postcards from Italy.
items.zh: 我阿姨從義大利寄了幾張明信片給我。

items.en: I need some stamps for these letters.
items.zh: 這些信我需要幾張郵票。

items.en: Some girls in my class play football.
items.zh: 我們班有幾個女生踢足球。

examples.heading: ② 數字 + 複數名詞

items.en: My house is small. My house has got three rooms.
items.zh: 我家很小。我家有三個房間。

items.en: The bus to the city takes forty minutes.
items.zh: 搭公車到市區要四十分鐘。

items.en: Our school has two hundred students and fifteen teachers.
items.zh: 我們學校有兩百個學生和十五位老師。

items.en: My cat has four kittens.
items.zh: 我的貓生了四隻小貓。

items.en: I drink two glasses of milk every morning.
items.zh: 我每天早上喝兩杯牛奶。

examples.heading: ③ a lot of + 複數名詞

items.en: I lived here when I was a child. I had a lot of friends in this town.
items.zh: 我小時候住在這裡。我在這個鎮上有很多朋友。

items.en: There are a lot of cars on the road today.
items.zh: 今天路上車很多。

items.en: My grandma has a lot of plants in her garden.
items.zh: 我奶奶的花園裡有很多植物。

items.en: We saw a lot of animals at the farm.
items.zh: 我們在農場看到很多動物。

examples.heading: ④ lots of + 複數名詞

items.en: School is hard this year. For homework we have to write lots of things.
items.zh: 今年的課業很重。我們的功課要寫很多東西。

items.en: There are lots of people in the park on Sundays.
items.zh: 星期天公園裡人很多。

items.en: She has lots of DVDs.
items.zh: 她有很多 DVD。

items.en: My town has lots of restaurants.
items.zh: 我住的鎮有很多餐廳。

examples.heading: ⑤ 介紹自己住的地方

items.en: My flat is near the station. It has two bedrooms.
items.zh: 我的公寓在車站附近。有兩間臥室。

items.en: In my street there are some old houses and a lot of trees.
items.zh: 我住的街上有一些老房子和很多樹。

items.en: There are lots of children in my building.
items.zh: 我住的大樓裡有很多小孩。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Have you got any pets?" "Yes, two dogs."
items.zh: 你有養寵物嗎？有，兩隻狗。

items.en: "What did you buy?" "Some T-shirts and a lot of socks."
items.zh: 你買了什麼？幾件 T 恤和很多襪子。

items.en: "Are there any good cafés here?" "Yes, lots of cafés."
items.zh: 這裡有好的咖啡店嗎？有，很多。

title: It was exciting, as both teams played well, but India won the match.
translation: 比賽很刺激，因為兩隊都打得很好，不過最後是印度贏了。
name: 數量限定詞加複數名詞（all、both、a few）
sentences: This notice is for all students: we are going to have a concert at school.
All students in Year 9 need to bring a packed lunch on Friday.
All rooms have free Wi-Fi.
All drivers in the race got a cup at the end.
I like all kinds of music, from rock to jazz.
It was exciting, as both teams played well, but India won the match.
Hold the cup with both hands. It's hot.
There are shops on both sides of the street.
Both girls want to be doctors.
I've read both books, and I prefer the first one.
Hi Tom! I'm just writing to say hello, and to tell you a few things.
We're staying at the beach for a few days.
I'll be ready in a few minutes.
A few people were waiting outside the shop.
I've got a few questions about the homework.
All the guests left before midnight.
We stayed in a small hotel for a few nights.
Both players were tired at the end of the game.
All flights to Paris are cancelled because of the snow.
A few students stayed after class to talk to the teacher.
Both my grandmothers live in the country.
"Which one do you like?" "I like both colours."
"Have you got any stamps?" "Yes, a few stamps. How many do you need?"
"Can everyone come to the meeting?" "Yes, all teachers will be there."

examples.heading: ① all + 複數名詞

items.en: This notice is for all students: we are going to have a concert at school.
items.zh: 這份通知是給全體學生的：學校要辦一場音樂會。

items.en: All students in Year 9 need to bring a packed lunch on Friday.
items.zh: 九年級所有學生星期五都要帶便當。

items.en: All rooms have free Wi-Fi.
items.zh: 所有房間都有免費 Wi-Fi。

items.en: All drivers in the race got a cup at the end.
items.zh: 參加比賽的所有車手最後都拿到一個獎盃。

items.en: I like all kinds of music, from rock to jazz.
items.zh: 我各種音樂都喜歡，從搖滾到爵士。

examples.heading: ② both + 複數名詞

items.en: It was exciting, as both teams played well, but India won the match.
items.zh: 比賽很刺激，因為兩隊都打得很好，不過最後是印度贏了。

items.en: Hold the cup with both hands. It's hot.
items.zh: 兩隻手捧著杯子。很燙。

items.en: There are shops on both sides of the street.
items.zh: 街道兩邊都有商店。

items.en: Both girls want to be doctors.
items.zh: 兩個女孩都想當醫生。

items.en: I've read both books, and I prefer the first one.
items.zh: 兩本書我都讀過，我比較喜歡第一本。

examples.heading: ③ a few + 複數名詞

items.en: Hi Tom! I'm just writing to say hello, and to tell you a few things.
items.zh: 嗨，Tom！我只是寫信打個招呼，順便跟你說幾件事。

items.en: We're staying at the beach for a few days.
items.zh: 我們要在海邊待幾天。

items.en: I'll be ready in a few minutes.
items.zh: 我再幾分鐘就好了。

items.en: A few people were waiting outside the shop.
items.zh: 有幾個人在店外面等。

items.en: I've got a few questions about the homework.
items.zh: 我對功課有幾個問題。

examples.heading: ④ 過去的事

items.en: All the guests left before midnight.
items.zh: 所有客人都在半夜以前走了。

items.en: We stayed in a small hotel for a few nights.
items.zh: 我們在一間小旅館住了幾晚。

items.en: Both players were tired at the end of the game.
items.zh: 比賽結束的時候，兩個選手都很累。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: All flights to Paris are cancelled because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，所有飛往巴黎的班機都取消了。

items.en: A few students stayed after class to talk to the teacher.
items.zh: 有幾個學生下課後留下來跟老師說話。

items.en: Both my grandmothers live in the country.
items.zh: 我外婆和奶奶都住在鄉下。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Which one do you like?" "I like both colours."
items.zh: 你喜歡哪一個？兩種顏色我都喜歡。

items.en: "Have you got any stamps?" "Yes, a few stamps. How many do you need?"
items.zh: 你有郵票嗎？有，有幾張。你要幾張？

items.en: "Can everyone come to the meeting?" "Yes, all teachers will be there."
items.zh: 大家都能來開會嗎？能，所有老師都會到。

title: Several days ago, we received a complaint.
translation: 幾天前，我們接到一件投訴。
name: 數量限定詞加複數名詞（several、a few of）
sentences: Dear staff, several days ago we received a complaint about noise on the third floor.
I've called him several times, but he doesn't answer.
Several students in my class are ill this week.
We stayed in Rome for several weeks last summer.
There are several good restaurants near the station.
I found an old lottery ticket. I took it and wished to have millions of dollars.
Millions of people watched the World Cup final on TV.
Thousands of fans waited outside the hotel to see the band.
There are hundreds of books in my grandfather's house.
Thousands of birds fly south in the autumn.
The local TV came to our school. They interviewed a few of the students, the teachers and the headmistress.
A few of my friends are coming over to watch the match.
I've read a few of his books. They're very funny.
A few of the questions in the test were really hard.
Several people saw the accident and called the police.
I lost a few of my photos when my phone broke.
Hundreds of people came to the opening of the new library.
Did several people complain about the food?
Could a few of the older students stay after class? I need help with the chairs.
The text had several new words, so I used a dictionary.
The museum has thousands of old coins from all over the world.
We need several chairs for the meeting room.
Millions of trees are cut down every year.
A few of the shops in town are open on Sunday.
"How long did you wait?" "Several hours! The plane was late."
"Did you invite the whole class?" "No, just a few of my friends."
"How many people use this app?" "Millions of people. It's very popular."
"Have you been to London?" "Yes, several times."

examples.heading: ① several + 複數名詞

items.en: Dear staff, several days ago we received a complaint about noise on the third floor.
items.zh: 各位同仁：幾天前我們接到一件投訴，說三樓很吵。

items.en: I've called him several times, but he doesn't answer.
items.zh: 我打給他好幾次了，可是他都沒接。

items.en: Several students in my class are ill this week.
items.zh: 我們班這星期有好幾個學生生病。

items.en: We stayed in Rome for several weeks last summer.
items.zh: 去年夏天我們在羅馬待了好幾個星期。

items.en: There are several good restaurants near the station.
items.zh: 車站附近有好幾家好餐廳。

examples.heading: ② millions of / thousands of + 複數名詞

items.en: I found an old lottery ticket. I took it and wished to have millions of dollars.
items.zh: 我找到一張舊彩券。我拿起來，希望自己有好幾百萬美元。

items.en: Millions of people watched the World Cup final on TV.
items.zh: 有好幾百萬人在電視上看世界盃決賽。

items.en: Thousands of fans waited outside the hotel to see the band.
items.zh: 好幾千個歌迷在飯店外面等著看那個樂團。

items.en: There are hundreds of books in my grandfather's house.
items.zh: 我爺爺家有好幾百本書。

items.en: Thousands of birds fly south in the autumn.
items.zh: 秋天有好幾千隻鳥飛到南方。

examples.heading: ③ a few of + 限定詞 + 複數名詞

items.en: The local TV came to our school. They interviewed a few of the students, the teachers and the headmistress.
items.zh: 地方電視台來我們學校。他們訪問了幾個學生、老師和校長。

items.en: A few of my friends are coming over to watch the match.
items.zh: 我有幾個朋友要過來看比賽。

items.en: I've read a few of his books. They're very funny.
items.zh: 他的書我讀過幾本。很好笑。

items.en: A few of the questions in the test were really hard.
items.zh: 考試有幾題真的很難。

examples.heading: ④ 過去的事

items.en: Several people saw the accident and called the police.
items.zh: 好幾個人看到車禍，報了警。

items.en: I lost a few of my photos when my phone broke.
items.zh: 我的手機壞了，我掉了幾張照片。

items.en: Hundreds of people came to the opening of the new library.
items.zh: 新圖書館開幕的時候來了好幾百人。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句和否定句

items.en: Did several people complain about the food?
items.zh: 有好幾個人抱怨食物嗎？

items.en: Could a few of the older students stay after class? I need help with the chairs.
items.zh: 可以請幾個高年級的學生下課後留下來嗎？我需要人幫忙搬椅子。

items.en: The text had several new words, so I used a dictionary.
items.zh: 這篇文章有好幾個生字，所以我查了字典。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的情境

items.en: The museum has thousands of old coins from all over the world.
items.zh: 那間博物館有好幾千枚來自世界各地的古錢幣。

items.en: We need several chairs for the meeting room.
items.zh: 會議室需要好幾張椅子。

items.en: Millions of trees are cut down every year.
items.zh: 每年都有好幾百萬棵樹被砍掉。

items.en: A few of the shops in town are open on Sunday.
items.zh: 鎮上有幾家店星期天有開。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "How long did you wait?" "Several hours! The plane was late."
items.zh: 你等了多久？好幾個小時！飛機誤點。

items.en: "Did you invite the whole class?" "No, just a few of my friends."
items.zh: 你請了全班嗎？沒有，只請了我幾個朋友。

items.en: "How many people use this app?" "Millions of people. It's very popular."
items.zh: 有多少人用這個 app？好幾百萬人。它很紅。

items.en: "Have you been to London?" "Yes, several times."
items.zh: 你去過倫敦嗎？去過，好幾次了。

title: All of my friends were there.
translation: 我的朋友全都在場。
name: 數量限定詞加 of 加所有格限定詞
sentences: It was a great party. All of my friends were there.
I spent a long time opening presents. All of my family were here.
I went shopping, but after that I saw that I'd spent all of my money!
She gave all of her old toys to her little cousin.
We've invited all of our neighbours to the barbecue.
I bought some T-shirts and jeans, because some of my clothes are too small for me.
Come to my house on Saturday. Bring some of your DVDs.
Some of his songs are really sad.
Some of their furniture is very old.
I've lent some of my books to my cousin.
Most of my classmates live near the school.
Many of her friends are from Spain.
Most of our lessons are in the morning.
Many of his photos are on the internet.
A lot of my free time goes on football.
A lot of their customers come from abroad.
I keep a lot of my old letters in a box.
I'm sending you some of my holiday photos.
All of our cousins came to my grandma's birthday.
Most of my new school is very modern.
"Did your family come to the show?" "Yes, all of my family came."
"Can I borrow some of your pens?" "Sure. Take two."
"Do you still have your old games?" "Some of my games. I sold the rest."

examples.heading: ① all of + 所有格 + 名詞

items.en: It was a great party. All of my friends were there.
items.zh: 那是一場很棒的派對。我的朋友全都在場。

items.en: I spent a long time opening presents. All of my family were here.
items.zh: 我花了好久時間拆禮物。我全家人都在。

items.en: I went shopping, but after that I saw that I'd spent all of my money!
items.zh: 我去買東西，可是後來發現我把錢全花光了！

items.en: She gave all of her old toys to her little cousin.
items.zh: 她把所有舊玩具都送給了她的小表妹。

items.en: We've invited all of our neighbours to the barbecue.
items.zh: 我們邀請了所有鄰居來烤肉。

examples.heading: ② some of + 所有格 + 名詞

items.en: I bought some T-shirts and jeans, because some of my clothes are too small for me.
items.zh: 我買了一些 T 恤和牛仔褲，因為我有些衣服太小了。

items.en: Come to my house on Saturday. Bring some of your DVDs.
items.zh: 星期六來我家。帶幾片你的 DVD 來。

items.en: Some of his songs are really sad.
items.zh: 他有些歌很悲傷。

items.en: Some of their furniture is very old.
items.zh: 他們有些家具很舊。

items.en: I've lent some of my books to my cousin.
items.zh: 我借了幾本書給我表弟。

examples.heading: ③ most of / many of + 所有格 + 名詞

items.en: Most of my classmates live near the school.
items.zh: 我大部分的同學都住在學校附近。

items.en: Many of her friends are from Spain.
items.zh: 她很多朋友來自西班牙。

items.en: Most of our lessons are in the morning.
items.zh: 我們大部分的課在早上。

items.en: Many of his photos are on the internet.
items.zh: 他很多照片都在網路上。

examples.heading: ④ a lot of + 所有格 + 名詞

items.en: A lot of my free time goes on football.
items.zh: 我很多空閒時間都花在足球上。

items.en: A lot of their customers come from abroad.
items.zh: 他們很多客人來自國外。

items.en: I keep a lot of my old letters in a box.
items.zh: 我把很多舊信放在一個盒子裡。

examples.heading: ⑤ 寫給朋友的信

items.en: I'm sending you some of my holiday photos.
items.zh: 我寄幾張我度假的照片給你。

items.en: All of our cousins came to my grandma's birthday.
items.zh: 我們所有的表兄弟姊妹都來參加奶奶的生日。

items.en: Most of my new school is very modern.
items.zh: 我的新學校大部分都很現代化。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Did your family come to the show?" "Yes, all of my family came."
items.zh: 你家人有來看表演嗎？有，我全家人都來了。

items.en: "Can I borrow some of your pens?" "Sure. Take two."
items.zh: 可以借我幾支你的筆嗎？好啊。拿兩支。

items.en: "Do you still have your old games?" "Some of my games. I sold the rest."
items.zh: 你還留著你的舊遊戲嗎？留了一部分。其他的賣掉了。

title: I go to India every year to see my friends and family.
translation: 我每年都會去印度看我的朋友和家人。
name: 數量限定詞 a、every 加單數名詞
sentences: In my home there are three bedrooms. I have a big kitchen and a small toilet.
The first floor has two bedrooms and a big bathroom with a bath.
My brother has a dog and a cat.
Our school has a swimming pool and a library.
I live in a small flat in the city centre.
I go to India every year to see my friends and family.
My mum phones her sister every evening.
We have English lessons every Tuesday.
My dad goes swimming every morning.
My cousins come to stay with us every summer.
Every student has a locker.
Every room in our house has a window.
The teacher knows every child's name.
Every shop in the street was closed.
Hi! My name is Paulo. I have a sister and a brother.
I'm from Brazil, and I go to a language school every afternoon.
I have a part-time job in a café.
Can I have a sandwich and a cup of tea, please?
I wash my dad's car every weekend for some pocket money.
There's a bus to the airport every hour.
"How often do you play tennis?" "Every Sunday."
"Have you got a pet?" "Yes, a rabbit."
"Do you walk to school?" "Yes, every day."

examples.heading: ① a + 單數名詞

items.en: In my home there are three bedrooms. I have a big kitchen and a small toilet.
items.zh: 我家有三間臥室。有一間大廚房和一間小廁所。

items.en: The first floor has two bedrooms and a big bathroom with a bath.
items.zh: 二樓有兩間臥室和一間有浴缸的大浴室。

items.en: My brother has a dog and a cat.
items.zh: 我哥哥養了一隻狗和一隻貓。

items.en: Our school has a swimming pool and a library.
items.zh: 我們學校有一座游泳池和一間圖書館。

items.en: I live in a small flat in the city centre.
items.zh: 我住在市中心的一間小公寓。

examples.heading: ② every + 時間

items.en: I go to India every year to see my friends and family.
items.zh: 我每年都會去印度看我的朋友和家人。

items.en: My mum phones her sister every evening.
items.zh: 我媽媽每天晚上都打電話給她姊姊。

items.en: We have English lessons every Tuesday.
items.zh: 我們每個星期二都有英文課。

items.en: My dad goes swimming every morning.
items.zh: 我爸爸每天早上都去游泳。

items.en: My cousins come to stay with us every summer.
items.zh: 我的表兄弟姊妹每年夏天都來我們家住。

examples.heading: ③ every + 人或東西

items.en: Every student has a locker.
items.zh: 每個學生都有一個置物櫃。

items.en: Every room in our house has a window.
items.zh: 我們家每個房間都有窗戶。

items.en: The teacher knows every child's name.
items.zh: 老師知道每個孩子的名字。

items.en: Every shop in the street was closed.
items.zh: 那條街上每家店都關門了。

examples.heading: ④ 介紹自己

items.en: Hi! My name is Paulo. I have a sister and a brother.
items.zh: 嗨！我叫 Paulo。我有一個姊姊和一個弟弟。

items.en: I'm from Brazil, and I go to a language school every afternoon.
items.zh: 我來自巴西，每天下午都去語言學校。

items.en: I have a part-time job in a café.
items.zh: 我在一家咖啡店打工。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Can I have a sandwich and a cup of tea, please?
items.zh: 請給我一份三明治和一杯茶。

items.en: I wash my dad's car every weekend for some pocket money.
items.zh: 我每個週末幫爸爸洗車，賺點零用錢。

items.en: There's a bus to the airport every hour.
items.zh: 每個小時有一班公車到機場。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "How often do you play tennis?" "Every Sunday."
items.zh: 你多久打一次網球？每個星期天。

items.en: "Have you got a pet?" "Yes, a rabbit."
items.zh: 你有養寵物嗎？有，一隻兔子。

items.en: "Do you walk to school?" "Yes, every day."
items.zh: 你走路上學嗎？對，每天都走。

title: The new art class starts next Monday, and each class is about one hour long.
translation: 新的美術課下星期一開始，每堂課大約一個小時。
name: 數量限定詞加單數名詞（each、one、數字）
sentences: The new art class starts next Monday, and each class is about one hour long.
Each room in the hotel has a view of the sea.
The teacher gave each child a small present at the end of the year.
Each ticket costs five pounds.
Read each question carefully before you answer.
My sister can't come to the concert. We have an extra ticket and we want you to come.
The train was late, so I waited for an hour.
I had an egg and some toast for breakfast.
She works in an office in the city centre.
Yesterday I bought three T-shirts: one blue T-shirt, one pink T-shirt and one yellow T-shirt.
We only have one bathroom, so we take turns in the morning.
I've got one brother and two sisters.
Wait one minute. I'll get my coat.
The course lasts for six weeks.
I've been learning the guitar for four years.
My grandmother has eight grandchildren.
The museum is open five days a week.
Each player in the team has a number on their shirt.
It's only an hour by train to London.
Can I have one cheese sandwich and two coffees, please?
Each lesson starts with a short test.
"How many tickets do you need?" "Just one ticket, please."
"Do we all get a prize?" "Yes, each person gets a medal."
"Have you got a pen?" "I've got an old one. Is that OK?"

examples.heading: ① each + 單數名詞

items.en: The new art class starts next Monday, and each class is about one hour long.
items.zh: 新的美術課下星期一開始，每堂課大約一個小時。

items.en: Each room in the hotel has a view of the sea.
items.zh: 旅館的每個房間都看得到海。

items.en: The teacher gave each child a small present at the end of the year.
items.zh: 學期結束的時候，老師給每個孩子一份小禮物。

items.en: Each ticket costs five pounds.
items.zh: 每張票五英鎊。

items.en: Read each question carefully before you answer.
items.zh: 回答之前，每一題都要仔細讀。

examples.heading: ② an + 單數名詞

items.en: My sister can't come to the concert. We have an extra ticket and we want you to come.
items.zh: 我妹妹不能去演唱會。我們多一張票，想請你來。

items.en: The train was late, so I waited for an hour.
items.zh: 火車誤點，所以我等了一個小時。

items.en: I had an egg and some toast for breakfast.
items.zh: 我早餐吃了一顆蛋和一些吐司。

items.en: She works in an office in the city centre.
items.zh: 她在市中心的一間辦公室上班。

examples.heading: ③ one + 單數名詞

items.en: Yesterday I bought three T-shirts: one blue T-shirt, one pink T-shirt and one yellow T-shirt.
items.zh: 我昨天買了三件 T 恤：一件藍色、一件粉紅色、一件黃色。

items.en: We only have one bathroom, so we take turns in the morning.
items.zh: 我們只有一間浴室，所以早上要輪流用。

items.en: I've got one brother and two sisters.
items.zh: 我有一個哥哥和兩個姊姊。

items.en: Wait one minute. I'll get my coat.
items.zh: 等一分鐘。我去拿外套。

examples.heading: ④ 數字 + 複數名詞

items.en: The course lasts for six weeks.
items.zh: 這門課上六個星期。

items.en: I've been learning the guitar for four years.
items.zh: 我學吉他學了四年。

items.en: My grandmother has eight grandchildren.
items.zh: 我奶奶有八個孫子孫女。

items.en: The museum is open five days a week.
items.zh: 博物館一星期開五天。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Each player in the team has a number on their shirt.
items.zh: 隊上每個球員的球衣上都有號碼。

items.en: It's only an hour by train to London.
items.zh: 搭火車到倫敦只要一個小時。

items.en: Can I have one cheese sandwich and two coffees, please?
items.zh: 請給我一份起司三明治和兩杯咖啡。

items.en: Each lesson starts with a short test.
items.zh: 每堂課都從一個小考開始。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "How many tickets do you need?" "Just one ticket, please."
items.zh: 你要幾張票？一張就好，謝謝。

items.en: "Do we all get a prize?" "Yes, each person gets a medal."
items.zh: 我們每個人都有獎嗎？有，每個人都拿到一面獎牌。

items.en: "Have you got a pen?" "I've got an old one. Is that OK?"
items.zh: 你有筆嗎？我有一支舊的。可以嗎？

title: I think it is better to stay at another hotel.
translation: 我覺得住別家飯店比較好。
name: another 表示另一個不同的
sentences: This café is too crowded. Let's find another café.
Personally, I think it's better to stay at another hotel, such as a Holiday Inn.
The family moved to another city for the father's job.
If the bank is closed, try another branch.
I'm busy now. Can we meet another day?
Thanks, but I'm full. Maybe another time.
I'll miss class tomorrow, but I can come another day to make up the work.
The match was cancelled because of the rain. They'll play it another weekend.
This printer doesn't work. Use another one.
The shoes were too small, so I asked for another size.
My pen ran out of ink. Can I borrow another pen?
Please choose another password. This one is too short.
If this doesn't work, we'll try another way.
There must be another solution to the problem.
The bridge is closed, so the bus is taking another route.
We need to find another way to save money.
If Mr Ross is busy, can I speak to another teacher?
She left her husband for another man.
The doctor is on holiday, so you'll see another doctor today.
I'm sorry, you'll have to ask another person.
It's exciting to live in another country.
Learning another language opens many doors.
In another life, I would like to be a musician.
They come from another part of the world.
Winning one game is easy, but winning the whole season is another challenge.
That's another story. I'll tell you later.
Talking about a plan is one thing, but doing it is another thing.
Whether he will agree is another question.
The price is fine, but the size is another problem.
That's another matter. Let's discuss it next week.

examples.heading: ① 換一個地方

items.en: This café is too crowded. Let's find another café.
items.zh: 這家咖啡館人太多了。我們找別家咖啡館吧。

items.en: Personally, I think it's better to stay at another hotel, such as a Holiday Inn.
items.zh: 我個人覺得住別家飯店比較好，像假日飯店。

items.en: The family moved to another city for the father's job.
items.zh: 那一家人因為爸爸的工作搬到別的城市。

items.en: If the bank is closed, try another branch.
items.zh: 如果這家銀行關了，去別家分行試試。

examples.heading: ② 改天、下次

items.en: I'm busy now. Can we meet another day?
items.zh: 我現在很忙。我們可以改天見面嗎？

items.en: Thanks, but I'm full. Maybe another time.
items.zh: 謝謝，可是我吃飽了。下次吧。

items.en: I'll miss class tomorrow, but I can come another day to make up the work.
items.zh: 我明天會缺課，可是我可以改天來補。

items.en: The match was cancelled because of the rain. They'll play it another weekend.
items.zh: 比賽因為下雨取消了。他們會改到別的週末比。

examples.heading: ③ 換一個東西

items.en: This printer doesn't work. Use another one.
items.zh: 這台印表機壞了。用別台。

items.en: The shoes were too small, so I asked for another size.
items.zh: 鞋子太小了，所以我要了別的尺寸。

items.en: My pen ran out of ink. Can I borrow another pen?
items.zh: 我的筆沒水了。我可以跟你借別支筆嗎？

items.en: Please choose another password. This one is too short.
items.zh: 請換一個密碼。這個太短了。

examples.heading: ④ 換一個方法

items.en: If this doesn't work, we'll try another way.
items.zh: 如果這樣不行，我們就試別的方法。

items.en: There must be another solution to the problem.
items.zh: 這個問題一定有別的解決辦法。

items.en: The bridge is closed, so the bus is taking another route.
items.zh: 橋封了，所以公車改走別的路線。

items.en: We need to find another way to save money.
items.zh: 我們得找別的方法省錢。

examples.heading: ⑤ 換一個人

items.en: If Mr Ross is busy, can I speak to another teacher?
items.zh: 如果 Ross 老師在忙，我可以跟別的老師談嗎？

items.en: She left her husband for another man.
items.zh: 她為了別的男人離開了她先生。

items.en: The doctor is on holiday, so you'll see another doctor today.
items.zh: 那位醫生在休假，所以你今天會看別的醫生。

items.en: I'm sorry, you'll have to ask another person.
items.zh: 抱歉，你得問別人。

examples.heading: ⑥ 另一個國家、另一種語言

items.en: It's exciting to live in another country.
items.zh: 住在別的國家很刺激。

items.en: Learning another language opens many doors.
items.zh: 學另一種語言會帶來很多機會。

items.en: In another life, I would like to be a musician.
items.zh: 如果有來生，我想當音樂家。

items.en: They come from another part of the world.
items.zh: 他們來自世界的另一個地方。

examples.heading: ⑦ 那是另一回事

items.en: Winning one game is easy, but winning the whole season is another challenge.
items.zh: 贏一場比賽很容易，可是贏下整個球季又是另一個挑戰。

items.en: That's another story. I'll tell you later.
items.zh: 那是另一回事。我晚點再告訴你。

items.en: Talking about a plan is one thing, but doing it is another thing.
items.zh: 說一個計畫是一回事，做起來又是另一回事。

items.en: Whether he will agree is another question.
items.zh: 他會不會同意又是另一個問題。

items.en: The price is fine, but the size is another problem.
items.zh: 價錢沒問題，可是尺寸又是另一個問題。

items.en: That's another matter. Let's discuss it next week.
items.zh: 那是另一件事。我們下星期再討論。

title: If I had been in her shoes, I would not have put up with that sort of behavior.
translation: 如果我是她，我才不會忍受那種行為。
name: that、those 表示不贊同
sentences: I told her that if I had been in her shoes, I would not have put up with that sort of behavior.
I'm not going to listen to that kind of nonsense.
We don't allow that sort of language at the dinner table.
My parents never let me watch that kind of program when I was young.
You can't speak to customers with that kind of attitude.
I'm surprised she married that man. He's so rude.
Turn off that awful music! I'm trying to sleep.
I never want to see that dog in my garden again.
Why do you still wear that old jumper? It's full of holes.
Celebrities are often worshipped by crowds of fans who can't see through the mask that those so-called heroes wear.
I'm sick of those people who park in front of my garage.
Don't believe those adverts. The product doesn't work.
Those politicians only care about winning the next election.
Those so-called experts on TV know nothing about real life.
I've read those so-called health websites, and most of them are wrong.
Those so-called friends of hers never help her.
Young people copy the stars they see on TV, and that kind of influence worries many parents.
Those reality shows teach children that fame is more important than hard work.
Schools should not accept that sort of bullying.
"He shouted at the waiter." "I can't stand that kind of person."
"My boss wants me to work on Sunday again." "Don't accept that sort of treatment."
"Have you heard what those boys said about her?" "Yes. It was horrible."

examples.heading: ① that sort of / that kind of + 名詞

items.en: I told her that if I had been in her shoes, I would not have put up with that sort of behavior.
items.zh: 我跟她說，如果我是她，我才不會忍受那種行為。

items.en: I'm not going to listen to that kind of nonsense.
items.zh: 我才不要聽那種廢話。

items.en: We don't allow that sort of language at the dinner table.
items.zh: 我們家吃飯的時候不准講那種話。

items.en: My parents never let me watch that kind of program when I was young.
items.zh: 我小時候，爸媽從來不讓我看那種節目。

items.en: You can't speak to customers with that kind of attitude.
items.zh: 你不能用那種態度跟客人說話。

examples.heading: ② that + 名詞

items.en: I'm surprised she married that man. He's so rude.
items.zh: 我很驚訝她嫁給了那個男人。他好沒禮貌。

items.en: Turn off that awful music! I'm trying to sleep.
items.zh: 把那難聽的音樂關掉！我要睡覺。

items.en: I never want to see that dog in my garden again.
items.zh: 我再也不想看到那隻狗跑進我的花園。

items.en: Why do you still wear that old jumper? It's full of holes.
items.zh: 你為什麼還穿那件舊毛衣？上面都是洞。

examples.heading: ③ those + 複數名詞

items.en: Celebrities are often worshipped by crowds of fans who can't see through the mask that those so-called heroes wear.
items.zh: 名人常被一群群的粉絲崇拜，這些粉絲看不穿那些所謂英雄戴的面具。

items.en: I'm sick of those people who park in front of my garage.
items.zh: 那些把車停在我車庫前面的人讓我很受不了。

items.en: Don't believe those adverts. The product doesn't work.
items.zh: 別相信那些廣告。那個產品沒效。

items.en: Those politicians only care about winning the next election.
items.zh: 那些政客只在乎贏下一次選舉。

examples.heading: ④ those so-called + 複數名詞

items.en: Those so-called experts on TV know nothing about real life.
items.zh: 電視上那些所謂的專家對真實生活一無所知。

items.en: I've read those so-called health websites, and most of them are wrong.
items.zh: 我看過那些所謂的健康網站，大部分都是錯的。

items.en: Those so-called friends of hers never help her.
items.zh: 她那些所謂的朋友從來不幫她。

examples.heading: ⑤ 論說文和評論

items.en: Young people copy the stars they see on TV, and that kind of influence worries many parents.
items.zh: 年輕人模仿電視上的明星，那種影響讓很多家長擔心。

items.en: Those reality shows teach children that fame is more important than hard work.
items.zh: 那些實境節目教小孩成名比努力更重要。

items.en: Schools should not accept that sort of bullying.
items.zh: 學校不應該容忍那種霸凌。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "He shouted at the waiter." "I can't stand that kind of person."
items.zh: 他對服務生大吼。我受不了那種人。

items.en: "My boss wants me to work on Sunday again." "Don't accept that sort of treatment."
items.zh: 我老闆又要我星期天上班。別接受那種待遇。

items.en: "Have you heard what those boys said about her?" "Yes. It was horrible."
items.zh: 你聽到那些男生說她什麼了嗎？聽到了。好過分。

title: Everyone has their own opinion.
translation: 每個人都有自己的看法。
name: 泛指的 their
sentences: People like different kinds of music, and everyone has their preference for one or another.
Everyone has their own opinion about the new law.
Everybody brought their own food to the picnic.
Everyone in the office has their own desk and computer.
Someone left their phone in the classroom.
If anyone loses their ticket, they have to buy a new one.
No one wants to lose their job.
Somebody has parked their car in front of my garage.
Each child has to bring their own lunch on the trip.
Every student should check their answers before the end of the exam.
A good teacher knows all their students' names.
When a customer complains, listen to their problem carefully.
IBM is a very important customer for us, and they ordered 10,000 colour copies which show their new product.
The band played all their old songs at the concert.
The company has moved their head office to Manchester.
The government has changed their plans again.
Each passenger may take one bag with them, and they must keep their ticket until the end of the journey.
Anyone who wants to join the club should write their name on the list.
Every member must show their card at the door.
"Whose bag is this?" "I don't know. Someone forgot their bag."
"Is the test hard?" "It depends. Everyone has their strong subjects."
"Can we sit anywhere?" "No, each guest has their name on a card."

examples.heading: ① everyone / everybody + their

items.en: People like different kinds of music, and everyone has their preference for one or another.
items.zh: 大家喜歡的音樂不一樣，每個人都有自己偏好的類型。

items.en: Everyone has their own opinion about the new law.
items.zh: 對新法律，每個人都有自己的看法。

items.en: Everybody brought their own food to the picnic.
items.zh: 每個人都自己帶食物去野餐。

items.en: Everyone in the office has their own desk and computer.
items.zh: 辦公室裡每個人都有自己的桌子和電腦。

examples.heading: ② someone / anyone / no one + their

items.en: Someone left their phone in the classroom.
items.zh: 有人把手機忘在教室了。

items.en: If anyone loses their ticket, they have to buy a new one.
items.zh: 如果有人把票弄丟了，就得再買一張。

items.en: No one wants to lose their job.
items.zh: 沒有人想丟掉工作。

items.en: Somebody has parked their car in front of my garage.
items.zh: 有人把車停在我車庫前面。

examples.heading: ③ each / every / a + 單數名詞 + their

items.en: Each child has to bring their own lunch on the trip.
items.zh: 每個孩子校外教學都要自己帶午餐。

items.en: Every student should check their answers before the end of the exam.
items.zh: 每個學生考試結束前都應該檢查答案。

items.en: A good teacher knows all their students' names.
items.zh: 好老師知道每個學生的名字。

items.en: When a customer complains, listen to their problem carefully.
items.zh: 客人抱怨的時候，要仔細聽他們的問題。

examples.heading: ④ 公司和團體 + their

items.en: IBM is a very important customer for us, and they ordered 10,000 colour copies which show their new product.
items.zh: IBM 是我們很重要的客戶，他們訂了一萬份彩色影本，介紹他們的新產品。

items.en: The band played all their old songs at the concert.
items.zh: 那個樂團在演唱會上唱了他們所有的老歌。

items.en: The company has moved their head office to Manchester.
items.zh: 那家公司把總部搬到曼徹斯特了。

items.en: The government has changed their plans again.
items.zh: 政府又改了他們的計畫。

examples.heading: ⑤ 規則和通知

items.en: Each passenger may take one bag with them, and they must keep their ticket until the end of the journey.
items.zh: 每位乘客可以帶一個包包，而且要保留車票到旅程結束。

items.en: Anyone who wants to join the club should write their name on the list.
items.zh: 想加入社團的人，請在名單上寫下名字。

items.en: Every member must show their card at the door.
items.zh: 每位會員在門口都要出示會員卡。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Whose bag is this?" "I don't know. Someone forgot their bag."
items.zh: 這是誰的包包？不知道。有人忘了拿包包。

items.en: "Is the test hard?" "It depends. Everyone has their strong subjects."
items.zh: 考試難嗎？要看人。每個人都有自己擅長的科目。

items.en: "Can we sit anywhere?" "No, each guest has their name on a card."
items.zh: 我們可以隨便坐嗎？不行，每位客人都有寫名字的座位卡。

title: I'm going to make loads of cookies this year and give them to my family and friends.
translation: 我今年要做一大堆餅乾，送給家人和朋友。
name: 表示誇大數量的限定詞（loads of 等）
sentences: Christmas is coming! I'm going to make loads of cookies this year and give them to my family and friends.
Don't rush. We've got loads of time before the train leaves.
The party was great. There were loads of people I didn't know.
You should try the café on the corner. They've got loads of different cakes.
I took loads of photos on holiday. Do you want to see them?
When I was a kid, I got tons of plastic ducks every birthday.
Sorry, I can't play football on Saturday. My teacher gave us tons of homework.
Don't buy any more food. There's heaps of pasta in the cupboard.
She's got tons of energy. She runs every morning before work.
We've got heaps of chairs in the garage if you need some.
My kitchen is tiny, but I managed to fit in a table and millions of cookbooks.
I've told you hundreds of times to take your shoes off!
There were thousands of people at the station this morning.
My sister has millions of friends online, but she never goes out.
I've been to that shop hundreds of times, and I've never seen it so busy.
Sorry I forgot to call. I've had a million things to do today.
The kids asked me a million questions about the trip.
I never use most of them, but my phone has a million apps on it.
I've got a million ideas for the party.
Take your time. There's loads of food left.
My grandparents have tons of money, but they never spend it.
Be careful, there's heaps of snow on the road.
You need loads of patience to teach young children.
I've asked the landlord hundreds of times to fix the light, and nothing happens.
There are tons of mistakes in this report. Who wrote it?
My inbox has thousands of emails I haven't read.
I've spent loads of money on this car, and it still doesn't work.
"Do you need help with the shopping?" "No, thanks. I've got loads of bags."
"Have you got any books about Spain?" "Tons! Come and look."
"Was the concert busy?" "Yes, there were thousands of people."
"How many times have you seen this film?" "Hundreds of times!"

examples.heading: ① loads of

items.en: Christmas is coming! I'm going to make loads of cookies this year and give them to my family and friends.
items.zh: 聖誕節快到了！我今年要做一大堆餅乾，送給家人和朋友。

items.en: Don't rush. We've got loads of time before the train leaves.
items.zh: 別急。火車開之前我們還有很多時間。

items.en: The party was great. There were loads of people I didn't know.
items.zh: 派對很棒。有好多我不認識的人。

items.en: You should try the café on the corner. They've got loads of different cakes.
items.zh: 你應該去轉角那家咖啡店。他們有好多種蛋糕。

items.en: I took loads of photos on holiday. Do you want to see them?
items.zh: 我度假時拍了一大堆照片。你要看嗎？

examples.heading: ② tons of / heaps of

items.en: When I was a kid, I got tons of plastic ducks every birthday.
items.zh: 我小時候每次生日都收到一大堆塑膠鴨子。

items.en: Sorry, I can't play football on Saturday. My teacher gave us tons of homework.
items.zh: 抱歉，我星期六不能踢足球。老師出了一大堆功課。

items.en: Don't buy any more food. There's heaps of pasta in the cupboard.
items.zh: 別再買吃的了。櫃子裡有一大堆義大利麵。

items.en: She's got tons of energy. She runs every morning before work.
items.zh: 她精力超多。她每天上班前都去跑步。

items.en: We've got heaps of chairs in the garage if you need some.
items.zh: 如果你需要，我們車庫裡有一大堆椅子。

examples.heading: ③ millions of / thousands of / hundreds of

items.en: My kitchen is tiny, but I managed to fit in a table and millions of cookbooks.
items.zh: 我的廚房很小，可是我還是塞進了一張桌子和數不清的食譜。

items.en: I've told you hundreds of times to take your shoes off!
items.zh: 我跟你說過幾百次要脫鞋了！

items.en: There were thousands of people at the station this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上車站有好幾千人。

items.en: My sister has millions of friends online, but she never goes out.
items.zh: 我姊姊網路上有一大堆朋友，可是她從來不出門。

items.en: I've been to that shop hundreds of times, and I've never seen it so busy.
items.zh: 我去過那家店幾百次了，從來沒看過它這麼忙。

examples.heading: ④ a million

items.en: Sorry I forgot to call. I've had a million things to do today.
items.zh: 抱歉我忘了打電話。我今天有一百萬件事要做。

items.en: The kids asked me a million questions about the trip.
items.zh: 孩子們問了我一大堆關於旅行的問題。

items.en: I never use most of them, but my phone has a million apps on it.
items.zh: 大部分我都沒在用，可是我的手機裡有一百萬個應用程式。

items.en: I've got a million ideas for the party.
items.zh: 我對派對有一大堆點子。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不可數名詞

items.en: Take your time. There's loads of food left.
items.zh: 慢慢來。還剩很多食物。

items.en: My grandparents have tons of money, but they never spend it.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶有很多錢，可是從來不花。

items.en: Be careful, there's heaps of snow on the road.
items.zh: 小心，路上有一大堆雪。

items.en: You need loads of patience to teach young children.
items.zh: 教小小孩需要很多耐心。

examples.heading: ⑥ 抱怨

items.en: I've asked the landlord hundreds of times to fix the light, and nothing happens.
items.zh: 我已經請房東修燈修了幾百次了，什麼都沒發生。

items.en: There are tons of mistakes in this report. Who wrote it?
items.zh: 這份報告有一大堆錯誤。是誰寫的？

items.en: My inbox has thousands of emails I haven't read.
items.zh: 我的收件匣有好幾千封還沒讀的信。

items.en: I've spent loads of money on this car, and it still doesn't work.
items.zh: 我在這台車上花了好多錢，它還是不能動。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Do you need help with the shopping?" "No, thanks. I've got loads of bags."
items.zh: 買東西要幫忙嗎？不用，謝謝。我有很多袋子。

items.en: "Have you got any books about Spain?" "Tons! Come and look."
items.zh: 你有講西班牙的書嗎？一大堆！來看。

items.en: "Was the concert busy?" "Yes, there were thousands of people."
items.zh: 演唱會人多嗎？多，有好幾千人。

items.en: "How many times have you seen this film?" "Hundreds of times!"
items.zh: 這部電影你看過幾次？幾百次了！

title: I spent a week in Dubai, and I am going to spend another week in Al Ain.
translation: 我在杜拜待了一個星期，接下來還要在艾因再待一個星期。
name: another 表示再一個
sentences: The doctor told me to stay in bed for another day.
We loved Lisbon so much that we stayed another night.
I'll give you another week to finish the report.
Can we wait another five minutes for Sam?
The road is closed for another three months.
We need another two players for the team.
It's another twenty kilometres to the next town.
The ticket costs another fifteen euros if you buy it on the train.
Could I have another cup of coffee, please?
The waiter brought us another plate of chips.
My son asked for another bowl of soup.
Have another piece of chocolate. There's plenty.
Another reason I moved here was the good schools.
Here's another example of the problem.
Another thing I don't understand is the price.
Good food is another reason why people visit Italy.
Dear Mary, I spent a week in Dubai, and now I'm spending another week in Oman.
I'm attaching another photo of the flat.
Please let me know if you need another copy of the form.
I have another question about the course.
The manager hired another assistant last month.
You can take the test another time if you fail.
We need another meeting to make a decision.
The teacher gave us another chance to hand in our homework.
One more question, and then we'll finish.
Just one more game, Mum, please!
We need one more person for the trip.
I'll wait for one more day and then call him.
Can I stay up for one more hour tonight?
Add one more spoonful of sugar to the sauce.

examples.heading: ① 再一段時間

items.en: The doctor told me to stay in bed for another day.
items.zh: 醫生要我在床上多躺一天。

items.en: We loved Lisbon so much that we stayed another night.
items.zh: 我們太喜歡里斯本了，所以多住了一晚。

items.en: I'll give you another week to finish the report.
items.zh: 我再給你一星期把報告寫完。

items.en: Can we wait another five minutes for Sam?
items.zh: 我們可以再等 Sam 五分鐘嗎？

examples.heading: ② another + 數字 + 複數名詞

items.en: The road is closed for another three months.
items.zh: 那條路還要再封三個月。

items.en: We need another two players for the team.
items.zh: 我們隊上還需要兩名球員。

items.en: It's another twenty kilometres to the next town.
items.zh: 到下一個鎮還有二十公里。

items.en: The ticket costs another fifteen euros if you buy it on the train.
items.zh: 如果在車上買票，要再多付十五歐元。

examples.heading: ③ 再一份吃的喝的

items.en: Could I have another cup of coffee, please?
items.zh: 可以再給我一杯咖啡嗎？

items.en: The waiter brought us another plate of chips.
items.zh: 服務生又給我們送來一盤薯條。

items.en: My son asked for another bowl of soup.
items.zh: 我兒子又要了一碗湯。

items.en: Have another piece of chocolate. There's plenty.
items.zh: 再吃一塊巧克力吧。還有很多。

examples.heading: ④ another reason、another thing

items.en: Another reason I moved here was the good schools.
items.zh: 我搬來這裡的另一個原因是學校好。

items.en: Here's another example of the problem.
items.zh: 這是這個問題的另一個例子。

items.en: Another thing I don't understand is the price.
items.zh: 我不懂的另一件事是價錢。

items.en: Good food is another reason why people visit Italy.
items.zh: 美食是人們去義大利的另一個原因。

examples.heading: ⑤ 寫信和電子郵件

items.en: Dear Mary, I spent a week in Dubai, and now I'm spending another week in Oman.
items.zh: 親愛的 Mary：我在杜拜待了一個星期，現在在阿曼再待一個星期。

items.en: I'm attaching another photo of the flat.
items.zh: 我再附上一張公寓的照片。

items.en: Please let me know if you need another copy of the form.
items.zh: 如果你還需要一份表格，請告訴我。

items.en: I have another question about the course.
items.zh: 關於這門課，我還有一個問題。

examples.heading: ⑥ 在工作和學校

items.en: The manager hired another assistant last month.
items.zh: 經理上個月又請了一位助理。

items.en: You can take the test another time if you fail.
items.zh: 如果沒考過，你可以再考一次。

items.en: We need another meeting to make a decision.
items.zh: 我們還要再開一次會才能做決定。

items.en: The teacher gave us another chance to hand in our homework.
items.zh: 老師又給我們一次交作業的機會。

examples.heading: ⑦ 用 one more 說同樣的意思

items.en: One more question, and then we'll finish.
items.zh: 再一個問題，然後我們就結束。

items.en: Just one more game, Mum, please!
items.zh: 媽，再玩一局就好，拜託！

items.en: We need one more person for the trip.
items.zh: 這趟旅行我們還需要一個人。

items.en: I'll wait for one more day and then call him.
items.zh: 我再等一天，然後打給他。

items.en: Can I stay up for one more hour tonight?
items.zh: 我今晚可以再晚一個小時睡嗎？

items.en: Add one more spoonful of sugar to the sauce.
items.zh: 醬汁裡再加一匙糖。

title: The colour is blue, and I like that colour because it's my favourite.
translation: 顏色是藍色的。我喜歡那個顏色，因為那是我最喜歡的顏色。
name: that 指前面提過的事物
sentences: I bought a jacket in the sales. That jacket was only £20.
My dad had an old car when I was a child. We drove all over Europe in that car.
I got a guitar for my tenth birthday. I still play that guitar.
She found a lovely lamp at the market. That lamp is now in her bedroom.
There's a great Thai restaurant near the station. You should try that restaurant.
We went to a beautiful beach last summer. That beach is in the south of Spain.
I stayed at a small hotel in Kyoto. I'd love to go back to that hotel.
My aunt took me to a museum in Paris. That museum has lots of paintings by Monet.
My new bedroom is green. I don't really like that colour.
Have you heard the new song by Adele? I love that song.
We had fish soup for lunch. My brother didn't like that soup at all.
My mum often wears a red scarf. That scarf looks great on her.
I want to learn Japanese. That language is useful for my job.
There's a cooking class on Tuesday evenings. I want to join that class.
My sister studied at Oxford. She loved her time at that university.
I took a history course last year. That course was really hard.
"I met a woman called Sarah at the party." "I think I know that woman."
"We watched a film about penguins." "Was that film good?"
"I'm going to a new dentist." "Is that dentist expensive?"
"My cousin works for a big bank." "How long has he worked at that bank?"
When I was ten, I had a teacher called Mr Lee. That teacher changed my life.
A kind man helped me with my bags at the station. I never saw that man again.
I shared a flat with a girl from Brazil. That girl is still my best friend.
My grandmother had a neighbour called Rosa. That neighbour made the best cakes in the village.
I had a piano teacher who was very strict. I was afraid of that teacher.
We had a big storm last week. That storm broke three windows in our street.
I had a bad cold in March. I missed two weeks of school because of that cold.
There was a party at Tom's house on Friday. Everyone danced at that party.
We had a big argument about money. After that argument, we didn't speak for a week.
My brother entered a singing competition. He won that competition!

examples.heading: ① 說過去買的東西

items.en: I bought a jacket in the sales. That jacket was only £20.
items.zh: 我在特價時買了一件夾克。那件夾克才二十英鎊。

items.en: My dad had an old car when I was a child. We drove all over Europe in that car.
items.zh: 我小時候我爸爸有一台舊車。我們開那台車跑遍了歐洲。

items.en: I got a guitar for my tenth birthday. I still play that guitar.
items.zh: 我十歲生日收到一把吉他。我現在還在彈那把吉他。

items.en: She found a lovely lamp at the market. That lamp is now in her bedroom.
items.zh: 她在市場找到一盞很漂亮的燈。那盞燈現在在她的臥室裡。

examples.heading: ② 推薦地方

items.en: There's a great Thai restaurant near the station. You should try that restaurant.
items.zh: 車站附近有一家很棒的泰國餐廳。你應該去吃吃看那家餐廳。

items.en: We went to a beautiful beach last summer. That beach is in the south of Spain.
items.zh: 我們去年夏天去了一個很漂亮的海灘。那個海灘在西班牙南部。

items.en: I stayed at a small hotel in Kyoto. I'd love to go back to that hotel.
items.zh: 我在京都住過一間小旅館。我很想再去住那間旅館。

items.en: My aunt took me to a museum in Paris. That museum has lots of paintings by Monet.
items.zh: 我阿姨帶我去巴黎的一間博物館。那間博物館有很多莫內的畫。

examples.heading: ③ 說喜歡和不喜歡

items.en: My new bedroom is green. I don't really like that colour.
items.zh: 我的新房間是綠色的。我不太喜歡那個顏色。

items.en: Have you heard the new song by Adele? I love that song.
items.zh: 你聽過 Adele 的新歌嗎？我好愛那首歌。

items.en: We had fish soup for lunch. My brother didn't like that soup at all.
items.zh: 我們午餐喝魚湯。我弟弟一點也不喜歡那個湯。

items.en: My mum often wears a red scarf. That scarf looks great on her.
items.zh: 我媽媽常圍一條紅色圍巾。那條圍巾她圍起來很好看。

examples.heading: ④ 說學校和課程

items.en: I want to learn Japanese. That language is useful for my job.
items.zh: 我想學日文。那個語言對我的工作很有用。

items.en: There's a cooking class on Tuesday evenings. I want to join that class.
items.zh: 星期二晚上有一堂烹飪課。我想參加那堂課。

items.en: My sister studied at Oxford. She loved her time at that university.
items.zh: 我姊姊在牛津讀書。她很喜歡在那所大學的日子。

items.en: I took a history course last year. That course was really hard.
items.zh: 我去年修了一門歷史課。那門課真的很難。

examples.heading: ⑤ 回應對方說的東西

items.en: "I met a woman called Sarah at the party." "I think I know that woman."
items.zh: 我在派對上認識了一個叫 Sarah 的女人。我好像認識那個女人。

items.en: "We watched a film about penguins." "Was that film good?"
items.zh: 我們看了一部講企鵝的電影。那部電影好看嗎？

items.en: "I'm going to a new dentist." "Is that dentist expensive?"
items.zh: 我要去看一個新的牙醫。那個牙醫很貴嗎？

items.en: "My cousin works for a big bank." "How long has he worked at that bank?"
items.zh: 我表哥在一家大銀行上班。他在那家銀行上班多久了？

examples.heading: ⑥ 說過去的人

items.en: When I was ten, I had a teacher called Mr Lee. That teacher changed my life.
items.zh: 我十歲的時候，有一位老師叫李老師。那位老師改變了我的人生。

items.en: A kind man helped me with my bags at the station. I never saw that man again.
items.zh: 在車站有一個好心的人幫我提行李。我再也沒見過那個人。

items.en: I shared a flat with a girl from Brazil. That girl is still my best friend.
items.zh: 我以前跟一個巴西女生合租公寓。那個女生現在還是我最好的朋友。

items.en: My grandmother had a neighbour called Rosa. That neighbour made the best cakes in the village.
items.zh: 我奶奶以前有一個鄰居叫 Rosa。那個鄰居做的蛋糕是村子裡最好吃的。

items.en: I had a piano teacher who was very strict. I was afraid of that teacher.
items.zh: 我以前有一個很嚴格的鋼琴老師。我很怕那位老師。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說過去的一件事

items.en: We had a big storm last week. That storm broke three windows in our street.
items.zh: 我們上星期有一場很大的暴風雨。那場暴風雨打破了我們這條街上三扇窗戶。

items.en: I had a bad cold in March. I missed two weeks of school because of that cold.
items.zh: 我三月得了重感冒。因為那場感冒，我有兩個星期沒去上學。

items.en: There was a party at Tom's house on Friday. Everyone danced at that party.
items.zh: 星期五 Tom 家有一個派對。那個派對上大家都在跳舞。

items.en: We had a big argument about money. After that argument, we didn't speak for a week.
items.zh: 我們為了錢大吵了一架。那次吵完以後，我們一個星期都沒講話。

items.en: My brother entered a singing competition. He won that competition!
items.zh: 我哥哥參加了一個歌唱比賽。他贏了那個比賽！

title: Look at that bird on the roof!
translation: 你看屋頂上那隻鳥！
name: that 指時間或空間較遠的事物
sentences: Look at that plane! It's flying very low.
What's that bright star called?
Two cats are fighting on that wall.
Can you see that kite above the trees?
That man across the street is waving at us.
Is that taxi free?
That girl on the bike is my cousin.
Let's ask that police officer for help.
Whose is that red car?
That door at the end of the hall is the toilet.
Put your coat on that chair by the window.
