That clock on the wall is ten minutes fast.
That light above the stairs doesn't work.
I'd like to try that dress in the window.
Can you get that box from the top shelf?
How old is that piano in the corner?
That sofa looks really comfortable.
What's that smell? Is something burning?
That music is too loud. Can you ask them to turn it down?
Can you hear that dog? It barks all night.
That noise is coming from the kitchen.
It snowed that night, so we stayed at home.
We got engaged that day.
We were so happy that evening.
Do you remember that morning at the beach?
That summer was the hottest in years.
We lived in Canada that year.
My grandmother learned to swim that spring.
That winter my father lost his job.
Everything changed that month.

examples.heading: ① 天上和高處的東西

items.en: Look at that plane! It's flying very low.
items.zh: 你看那架飛機！飛得好低。

items.en: What's that bright star called?
items.zh: 那顆很亮的星星叫什麼名字？

items.en: Two cats are fighting on that wall.
items.zh: 那面牆上有兩隻貓在打架。

items.en: Can you see that kite above the trees?
items.zh: 你看得到樹上面那個風箏嗎？

examples.heading: ② 街上的人和車

items.en: That man across the street is waving at us.
items.zh: 街對面那個男人在跟我們揮手。

items.en: Is that taxi free?
items.zh: 那台計程車有載客嗎？

items.en: That girl on the bike is my cousin.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車的那個女生是我表妹。

items.en: Let's ask that police officer for help.
items.zh: 我們去問那位警察吧。

items.en: Whose is that red car?
items.zh: 那台紅色的車是誰的？

examples.heading: ③ 房間另一邊的東西

items.en: That door at the end of the hall is the toilet.
items.zh: 走廊盡頭那扇門是廁所。

items.en: Put your coat on that chair by the window.
items.zh: 把你的外套放在窗邊那張椅子上。

items.en: That clock on the wall is ten minutes fast.
items.zh: 牆上那個時鐘快了十分鐘。

items.en: That light above the stairs doesn't work.
items.zh: 樓梯上面那盞燈壞了。

examples.heading: ④ 店裡遠處的東西

items.en: I'd like to try that dress in the window.
items.zh: 我想試穿櫥窗裡那件洋裝。

items.en: Can you get that box from the top shelf?
items.zh: 你可以幫我拿最上層那個箱子嗎？

items.en: How old is that piano in the corner?
items.zh: 角落那台鋼琴有多老了？

items.en: That sofa looks really comfortable.
items.zh: 那張沙發看起來很舒服。

examples.heading: ⑤ 聽到和聞到的東西

items.en: What's that smell? Is something burning?
items.zh: 那是什麼味道？有東西燒焦了嗎？

items.en: That music is too loud. Can you ask them to turn it down?
items.zh: 那個音樂太大聲了。你可以請他們關小聲一點嗎？

items.en: Can you hear that dog? It barks all night.
items.zh: 你聽得到那隻狗嗎？牠整晚都在叫。

items.en: That noise is coming from the kitchen.
items.zh: 那個聲音是從廚房傳來的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 過去的一天或一個晚上

items.en: It snowed that night, so we stayed at home.
items.zh: 那天晚上下雪，所以我們待在家裡。

items.en: We got engaged that day.
items.zh: 我們那天訂婚了。

items.en: We were so happy that evening.
items.zh: 那天晚上我們好開心。

items.en: Do you remember that morning at the beach?
items.zh: 你還記得在海邊的那個早上嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 過去的一年或一個季節

items.en: That summer was the hottest in years.
items.zh: 那年夏天是好幾年來最熱的。

items.en: We lived in Canada that year.
items.zh: 那一年我們住在加拿大。

items.en: My grandmother learned to swim that spring.
items.zh: 我奶奶那年春天學會了游泳。

items.en: That winter my father lost his job.
items.zh: 那年冬天我爸爸丟了工作。

items.en: Everything changed that month.
items.zh: 那個月一切都變了。

title: I bought a swimsuit, shorts, T-shirts and sunglasses. I'll need these things because it's summertime.
translation: 我買了泳衣、短褲、T 恤和太陽眼鏡。我會需要這些東西，因為現在是夏天。
name: 限定詞 these 指前面提過的事物
sentences: I bought a swimsuit, shorts, T-shirts and sunglasses. I'll need these things because it's summertime.
I've packed my passport, my tickets and some money. I can't travel without these things.
My mum gave me two jumpers and a scarf. I'm wearing these clothes today.
You need flour, eggs and sugar. Mix these ingredients in a bowl.
In the town you can visit the Old Museum, the Green Park, the old bridge and the old church. These places are very old.
We'll see the castle, the market and the cathedral today. These places are all in the old town.
I've marked three cafés on the map. These places have free Wi-Fi.
The first jeans I wanted were cheaper, but too small. These jeans are better, and they fit me well.
The old chairs were very uncomfortable. These chairs are much better.
My last headphones broke easily. I hope these headphones last longer.
I'd like you to meet Anna and Lucy. These girls are in my class.
Three new teachers started today. These teachers will help with the exams.
Two boys found my wallet and gave it back. These boys were so honest.
Read pages ten to twenty. These pages will be in the test.
Press the red and green buttons. These buttons turn the machine on.
Here are the rules for the trip. Please follow these rules.
"Do you like the photos from the wedding?" "Yes, these pictures are lovely."
"I've made some sandwiches and a salad." "These sandwiches look great."
"We need apples, bananas and grapes." "These fruits are all on sale today."

examples.heading: ① these + things / clothes

items.en: I bought a swimsuit, shorts, T-shirts and sunglasses. I'll need these things because it's summertime.
items.zh: 我買了泳衣、短褲、T 恤和太陽眼鏡。我會需要這些東西，因為現在是夏天。

items.en: I've packed my passport, my tickets and some money. I can't travel without these things.
items.zh: 我帶了護照、機票和一些錢。沒有這些東西我沒辦法旅行。

items.en: My mum gave me two jumpers and a scarf. I'm wearing these clothes today.
items.zh: 我媽給了我兩件毛衣和一條圍巾。我今天就穿著這些衣服。

items.en: You need flour, eggs and sugar. Mix these ingredients in a bowl.
items.zh: 你需要麵粉、蛋和糖。把這些材料放進碗裡攪拌。

examples.heading: ② these + places

items.en: In the town you can visit the Old Museum, the Green Park, the old bridge and the old church. These places are very old.
items.zh: 在鎮上你可以去老博物館、綠園、古橋和老教堂。這些地方都很古老。

items.en: We'll see the castle, the market and the cathedral today. These places are all in the old town.
items.zh: 我們今天會去城堡、市集和大教堂。這些地方都在老城區。

items.en: I've marked three cafés on the map. These places have free Wi-Fi.
items.zh: 我在地圖上標了三家咖啡店。這些地方有免費 Wi-Fi。

examples.heading: ③ 比較：these + 名詞

items.en: The first jeans I wanted were cheaper, but too small. These jeans are better, and they fit me well.
items.zh: 我一開始想要的牛仔褲比較便宜，可是太小了。這件牛仔褲比較好，很合身。

items.en: The old chairs were very uncomfortable. These chairs are much better.
items.zh: 舊椅子很不舒服。這些椅子好多了。

items.en: My last headphones broke easily. I hope these headphones last longer.
items.zh: 我之前的耳機很容易壞。希望這副耳機可以用久一點。

examples.heading: ④ these + 人

items.en: I'd like you to meet Anna and Lucy. These girls are in my class.
items.zh: 我想介紹 Anna 和 Lucy 給你認識。這兩個女孩是我班上的同學。

items.en: Three new teachers started today. These teachers will help with the exams.
items.zh: 今天來了三位新老師。這幾位老師會幫忙考試的事。

items.en: Two boys found my wallet and gave it back. These boys were so honest.
items.zh: 兩個男生撿到我的錢包還給我。這兩個男生好誠實。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說明和指示

items.en: Read pages ten to twenty. These pages will be in the test.
items.zh: 讀第十頁到第二十頁。考試會考這幾頁。

items.en: Press the red and green buttons. These buttons turn the machine on.
items.zh: 按紅色和綠色的按鈕。這兩個按鈕會打開機器。

items.en: Here are the rules for the trip. Please follow these rules.
items.zh: 這是校外教學的規則。請遵守這些規則。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Do you like the photos from the wedding?" "Yes, these pictures are lovely."
items.zh: 你喜歡婚禮的照片嗎？喜歡，這些照片好漂亮。

items.en: "I've made some sandwiches and a salad." "These sandwiches look great."
items.zh: 我做了一些三明治和一份沙拉。這些三明治看起來很棒。

items.en: "We need apples, bananas and grapes." "These fruits are all on sale today."
items.zh: 我們需要蘋果、香蕉和葡萄。這些水果今天都特價。

title: Are these keys yours?
translation: 這些鑰匙是你的嗎？
name: these 從說話者的位置指稱地方和事物
sentences: I'm carrying these boxes to the car.
I picked these flowers in the garden.
These cups are still wet.
Have some of these grapes from my garden.
These sunglasses belong to my sister.
These seats are for older people.
These cushions are so soft.
Somebody left these umbrellas by the door.
These lights turn on by themselves at night.
Excuse me, do you have these shoes in a size 38?
These candles smell of vanilla.
I'd like three of these postcards, please.
These T-shirts are buy one, get one free.
I hope you like these pictures of the baby.
I'm sending you these documents for the meeting.
Please fill in these forms and return them by Monday.
These tickets are for you and your wife.
These photos are from my children's school play.
My uncle brought me these stamps from Africa.
These medals are from my swimming competitions.
I made these cards for my friends.
The people in these mountains are very friendly.
These streets are busy at night.
These islands are famous for their beaches.
There are lots of wild birds in these woods.
Please open your books and look at these sentences.
Can you answer these questions in English?
These words are new for most of the class.
Learn these verbs for the test.
These pictures show life in the 1950s.

examples.heading: ① 手上拿的東西

items.en: I'm carrying these boxes to the car.
items.zh: 我要把這些箱子搬到車上。

items.en: I picked these flowers in the garden.
items.zh: 這些花是我在花園摘的。

items.en: These cups are still wet.
items.zh: 這些杯子還是濕的。

items.en: Have some of these grapes from my garden.
items.zh: 吃一點我園子種的這些葡萄吧。

items.en: These sunglasses belong to my sister.
items.zh: 這副太陽眼鏡是我姊姊的。

examples.heading: ② 身邊的東西

items.en: These seats are for older people.
items.zh: 這幾個位子是給老人坐的。

items.en: These cushions are so soft.
items.zh: 這些靠墊好軟。

items.en: Somebody left these umbrellas by the door.
items.zh: 有人把這幾把傘放在門邊。

items.en: These lights turn on by themselves at night.
items.zh: 這幾盞燈晚上會自己亮。

examples.heading: ③ 店裡的東西

items.en: Excuse me, do you have these shoes in a size 38?
items.zh: 不好意思，這雙鞋有 38 號的嗎？

items.en: These candles smell of vanilla.
items.zh: 這些蠟燭有香草的味道。

items.en: I'd like three of these postcards, please.
items.zh: 這些明信片我要三張。

items.en: These T-shirts are buy one, get one free.
items.zh: 這些 T 恤買一送一。

examples.heading: ④ 寄給別人看的東西

items.en: I hope you like these pictures of the baby.
items.zh: 希望你喜歡這些寶寶的照片。

items.en: I'm sending you these documents for the meeting.
items.zh: 我寄這些開會用的文件給你。

items.en: Please fill in these forms and return them by Monday.
items.zh: 請填好這些表格，星期一之前交回。

items.en: These tickets are for you and your wife.
items.zh: 這幾張票是給你和你太太的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 給別人看自己的東西

items.en: These photos are from my children's school play.
items.zh: 這些照片是我小孩在學校演戲時拍的。

items.en: My uncle brought me these stamps from Africa.
items.zh: 這些郵票是我叔叔從非洲帶給我的。

items.en: These medals are from my swimming competitions.
items.zh: 這些獎牌是我參加游泳比賽得的。

items.en: I made these cards for my friends.
items.zh: 這些卡片是我做給朋友的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 自己所在的地方

items.en: The people in these mountains are very friendly.
items.zh: 這一帶山區的人都很友善。

items.en: These streets are busy at night.
items.zh: 這幾條街晚上很熱鬧。

items.en: These islands are famous for their beaches.
items.zh: 這些島的海灘很有名。

items.en: There are lots of wild birds in these woods.
items.zh: 這片樹林裡有很多野鳥。

examples.heading: ⑦ 課堂上

items.en: Please open your books and look at these sentences.
items.zh: 請打開課本，看這幾個句子。

items.en: Can you answer these questions in English?
items.zh: 你可以用英文回答這些問題嗎？

items.en: These words are new for most of the class.
items.zh: 這些單字對班上大部分的人來說都是新的。

items.en: Learn these verbs for the test.
items.zh: 考試要背這些動詞。

items.en: These pictures show life in the 1950s.
items.zh: 這些照片呈現了 1950 年代的生活。

title: If you are interested in this house, please call me on my mobile phone.
translation: 如果您對這間房子有興趣，請打我的手機。
name: this 指前面提過的事物
sentences: We have a flat for rent near the station. This flat has two bedrooms.
I'm selling my old bike. This bike is only two years old.
Our school offers a summer course in art. This course is for children aged 8 to 12.
The museum has a new show about dinosaurs. This show ends in May.
We are looking for a waiter for our café. This job is from Monday to Friday.
The lift in our building doesn't work. This problem started last week.
My new phone keeps turning off. Can you do something about this problem?
The shower in my room is always cold. Please fix this shower as soon as possible.
The internet in the hotel is very slow. I am not happy with this service.
Many people gave me presents. My aunt gave me a watch. This watch is my favourite present.
My brother sent me a book from London. This book is about the history of the city.
I got a camera for my birthday. I take this camera everywhere.
My friends gave me a plant. I keep this plant on my desk.
Last summer we stayed at a small hotel by the sea. This hotel had a lovely garden.
There is a new café on my street. The cakes in this café are delicious.
We visited a village in the mountains. People in this village make cheese.
I go to a gym near my office. This gym opens at six in the morning.
Let's have a picnic on Saturday. What do you think of this plan?
Maybe we can share a taxi to the airport. This idea will save us money.
Tom wants to cycle across Europe. I think this plan is a bit crazy.
We could meet at the library to study. Do you like this idea?
My sister is going to have a baby. This news made my parents very happy.
Our teacher is leaving the school. We were sad to hear this news.
The concert is cancelled because of the rain. Lots of fans are angry about this decision.
They are building a new road behind my house. I don't like this news at all.
My boss wants me to work every weekend. I can't accept this situation.
There are no buses after ten at night. This problem makes it hard for me to get home.
Two of my classmates are always late. The teacher is angry about this situation.
The prices in the supermarket go up every month. Many people are worried about this problem.
Our flight is delayed by five hours. Who can we talk to about this delay?

examples.heading: ① 廣告

items.en: We have a flat for rent near the station. This flat has two bedrooms.
items.zh: 我們有一間公寓要出租，在車站附近。這間公寓有兩間臥室。

items.en: I'm selling my old bike. This bike is only two years old.
items.zh: 我要賣我的舊腳踏車。這台腳踏車才騎兩年。

items.en: Our school offers a summer course in art. This course is for children aged 8 to 12.
items.zh: 我們學校開了一門暑期美術課。這門課給八到十二歲的小孩上。

items.en: The museum has a new show about dinosaurs. This show ends in May.
items.zh: 博物館有一個新的恐龍展。這個展覽五月結束。

items.en: We are looking for a waiter for our café. This job is from Monday to Friday.
items.zh: 我們咖啡館在找一個服務生。這份工作是星期一到星期五。

examples.heading: ② 寫信抱怨問題

items.en: The lift in our building doesn't work. This problem started last week.
items.zh: 我們大樓的電梯壞了。這個問題上星期就開始了。

items.en: My new phone keeps turning off. Can you do something about this problem?
items.zh: 我的新手機一直自己關機。你們可以處理一下這個問題嗎？

items.en: The shower in my room is always cold. Please fix this shower as soon as possible.
items.zh: 我房間的淋浴一直都是冷水。請盡快修好這個淋浴。

items.en: The internet in the hotel is very slow. I am not happy with this service.
items.zh: 旅館的網路很慢。我對這個服務很不滿意。

examples.heading: ③ 介紹禮物

items.en: Many people gave me presents. My aunt gave me a watch. This watch is my favourite present.
items.zh: 很多人送我禮物。我阿姨送我一支手錶。這支手錶是我最喜歡的禮物。

items.en: My brother sent me a book from London. This book is about the history of the city.
items.zh: 我哥哥從倫敦寄了一本書給我。這本書講的是那個城市的歷史。

items.en: I got a camera for my birthday. I take this camera everywhere.
items.zh: 我生日收到一台相機。我去哪裡都帶著這台相機。

items.en: My friends gave me a plant. I keep this plant on my desk.
items.zh: 朋友送我一盆植物。我把這盆植物放在書桌上。

examples.heading: ④ 介紹地方

items.en: Last summer we stayed at a small hotel by the sea. This hotel had a lovely garden.
items.zh: 去年夏天我們住在海邊的一間小旅館。這間旅館有一個很漂亮的花園。

items.en: There is a new café on my street. The cakes in this café are delicious.
items.zh: 我住的街上開了一家新咖啡館。這家咖啡館的蛋糕很好吃。

items.en: We visited a village in the mountains. People in this village make cheese.
items.zh: 我們去了山上的一個村子。這個村子的人做起司。

items.en: I go to a gym near my office. This gym opens at six in the morning.
items.zh: 我去辦公室附近的一家健身房。這家健身房早上六點開門。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說一個主意或計畫

items.en: Let's have a picnic on Saturday. What do you think of this plan?
items.zh: 我們星期六去野餐吧。你覺得這個計畫怎麼樣？

items.en: Maybe we can share a taxi to the airport. This idea will save us money.
items.zh: 也許我們可以一起搭計程車去機場。這個主意可以幫我們省錢。

items.en: Tom wants to cycle across Europe. I think this plan is a bit crazy.
items.zh: Tom 想騎腳踏車橫越歐洲。我覺得這個計畫有點瘋狂。

items.en: We could meet at the library to study. Do you like this idea?
items.zh: 我們可以約在圖書館讀書。你喜歡這個主意嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 說一個消息

items.en: My sister is going to have a baby. This news made my parents very happy.
items.zh: 我姊姊要生小孩了。這個消息讓我爸媽很高興。

items.en: Our teacher is leaving the school. We were sad to hear this news.
items.zh: 我們的老師要離開學校了。我們聽到這個消息很難過。

items.en: The concert is cancelled because of the rain. Lots of fans are angry about this decision.
items.zh: 演唱會因為下雨取消了。很多歌迷對這個決定很生氣。

items.en: They are building a new road behind my house. I don't like this news at all.
items.zh: 他們要在我家後面蓋一條新的路。我一點也不喜歡這個消息。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說一個情況

items.en: My boss wants me to work every weekend. I can't accept this situation.
items.zh: 我老闆要我每個週末都上班。我沒辦法接受這個情況。

items.en: There are no buses after ten at night. This problem makes it hard for me to get home.
items.zh: 晚上十點以後就沒有公車了。這個問題讓我很難回家。

items.en: Two of my classmates are always late. The teacher is angry about this situation.
items.zh: 我有兩個同學總是遲到。老師對這個情況很生氣。

items.en: The prices in the supermarket go up every month. Many people are worried about this problem.
items.zh: 超市的價格每個月都在漲。很多人都很擔心這個問題。

items.en: Our flight is delayed by five hours. Who can we talk to about this delay?
items.zh: 我們的班機延誤了五個小時。這次延誤我們可以找誰說？

title: I'll call you this evening.
translation: 我今天晚上打電話給你。
name: this 加時間詞指即將到來的時間
sentences: I'll text you this afternoon.
We're having pizza this evening.
My parents are coming for dinner this evening.
