items.en: I am writing this letter to tell you about my new school.
items.zh: 我寫這封信，是要跟你說我的新學校。

items.en: I'm sending this email from the airport.
items.zh: 我在機場寄這封電子郵件。

items.en: Please answer this message soon.
items.zh: 請快點回這則訊息。

items.en: I am writing this note because you were out.
items.zh: 你不在，所以我寫了這張字條。

items.en: I hope you like this postcard from Paris.
items.zh: 希望你喜歡這張從巴黎寄來的明信片。

examples.heading: ⑤ 信的結尾

items.en: I hope this information is useful.
items.zh: 希望這個資料對你有用。

items.en: Read this letter when you feel sad.
items.zh: 你難過的時候就讀讀這封信。

items.en: Thank you for reading this email.
items.zh: 謝謝你讀這封電子郵件。

items.en: Write back and tell me what you think of this idea.
items.zh: 回信告訴我你覺得這個主意怎麼樣。

examples.heading: ⑥ 給號碼和地址

items.en: You can contact me by calling me on this number.
items.zh: 你可以打這個號碼聯絡我。

items.en: Please send the parcel to this address.
items.zh: 請把包裹寄到這個地址。

items.en: My new email is on this card.
items.zh: 我的新電子郵件地址寫在這張卡片上。

items.en: Click on this link to see the photos.
items.zh: 點這個連結就可以看照片。

examples.heading: ⑦ 介紹禮物和自己的東西

items.en: My aunt gave me this bracelet for my birthday.
items.zh: 我阿姨送我這個手環當生日禮物。

items.en: This laptop was my favourite birthday present.
items.zh: 這台筆電是我最喜歡的生日禮物。

items.en: My grandmother knitted this scarf for me.
items.zh: 這條圍巾是我奶奶織給我的。

items.en: My best friend sent me this hat from Peru.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友從秘魯寄這頂帽子給我。

items.en: My grandfather wore this watch every day.
items.zh: 我爺爺以前每天都戴這支手錶。

title: It's black and pink, and I like those colors very much.
translation: 它是黑色和粉紅色的，我非常喜歡那兩種顏色。
name: 限定詞 those 指前面提過的事物
sentences: My new bag is black and pink, and I like those colours very much.
I went shopping yesterday and bought some jumpers and trousers. I bought those clothes because I'm going to Japan next Friday, and the weather is cold there.
My grandmother gave me some old coins. I still keep those coins in a box.
We ordered pizza and chips. Those dishes are always popular with the kids.
I met two Italian students at the language school. Those girls are now my best friends.
Some fans waited outside the hotel all night. Those people really love the band.
Two men asked me for money in the street. I didn't trust those men.
Last year I visited Paris and Rome. Those cities are full of history.
We stayed in two small villages in the mountains. Those places were very quiet.
My uncle lived in Brazil and Mexico. He loved those countries.
I had exams in May and June. I studied hard during those months.
My parents told me about their first dates. I love those stories.
We sang some songs from the 1980s. Those songs remind me of my childhood.
I've sent you some photos of the beach. I took those pictures on my new phone.
You asked about the books I read. I read those books for my English class.
My aunt made two cakes for my birthday. Those cakes were delicious.
"I loved the red shoes and the blue boots." "Why didn't you buy those shoes?"
"Tom and Jack are coming tonight." "Oh no, those boys are so noisy!"
"We went to the museum and the old castle." "I've never been to those places."

examples.heading: ① 前一句 + those + 名詞：東西

items.en: My new bag is black and pink, and I like those colours very much.
items.zh: 我的新書包是黑色和粉紅色的，我非常喜歡那兩種顏色。

items.en: I went shopping yesterday and bought some jumpers and trousers. I bought those clothes because I'm going to Japan next Friday, and the weather is cold there.
items.zh: 我昨天去買衣服，買了一些毛衣和長褲。我買那些衣服是因為下星期五要去日本，那裡天氣很冷。

items.en: My grandmother gave me some old coins. I still keep those coins in a box.
items.zh: 我奶奶給了我一些舊硬幣。我還把那些硬幣放在一個盒子裡。

items.en: We ordered pizza and chips. Those dishes are always popular with the kids.
items.zh: 我們點了披薩和薯條。孩子們總是很喜歡那些菜。

examples.heading: ② 前一句 + those + 名詞：人

items.en: I met two Italian students at the language school. Those girls are now my best friends.
items.zh: 我在語言學校認識了兩個義大利學生。那兩個女孩現在是我最好的朋友。

items.en: Some fans waited outside the hotel all night. Those people really love the band.
items.zh: 有些歌迷在飯店外面等了一整晚。那些人真的很愛那個樂團。

items.en: Two men asked me for money in the street. I didn't trust those men.
items.zh: 街上有兩個男人跟我要錢。我不相信那兩個人。

examples.heading: ③ 前一句 + those + 名詞：地方

items.en: Last year I visited Paris and Rome. Those cities are full of history.
items.zh: 去年我去了巴黎和羅馬。那兩座城市充滿了歷史。

items.en: We stayed in two small villages in the mountains. Those places were very quiet.
items.zh: 我們在山上兩個小村子住過。那些地方很安靜。

items.en: My uncle lived in Brazil and Mexico. He loved those countries.
items.zh: 我叔叔住過巴西和墨西哥。他很喜歡那兩個國家。

examples.heading: ④ 前一句 + those + 名詞：時間和事情

items.en: I had exams in May and June. I studied hard during those months.
items.zh: 我五月和六月有考試。那兩個月我很用功。

items.en: My parents told me about their first dates. I love those stories.
items.zh: 我爸媽跟我講他們第一次約會的事。我很喜歡那些故事。

items.en: We sang some songs from the 1980s. Those songs remind me of my childhood.
items.zh: 我們唱了幾首八〇年代的歌。那些歌讓我想起我的童年。

examples.heading: ⑤ 寫給朋友的信

items.en: I've sent you some photos of the beach. I took those pictures on my new phone.
items.zh: 我寄了幾張海邊的照片給你。那些照片是用我的新手機拍的。

items.en: You asked about the books I read. I read those books for my English class.
items.zh: 你問到我讀的那幾本書。那些書是我英文課要讀的。

items.en: My aunt made two cakes for my birthday. Those cakes were delicious.
items.zh: 我阿姨幫我做了兩個生日蛋糕。那兩個蛋糕很好吃。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "I loved the red shoes and the blue boots." "Why didn't you buy those shoes?"
items.zh: 我很喜歡那雙紅鞋和那雙藍靴子。你為什麼沒買那雙鞋？

items.en: "Tom and Jack are coming tonight." "Oh no, those boys are so noisy!"
items.zh: Tom 和 Jack 今晚要來。不會吧，那兩個男生好吵！

items.en: "We went to the museum and the old castle." "I've never been to those places."
items.zh: 我們去了博物館和那座古堡。那些地方我都沒去過。

title: Who are those people across the street?
translation: 對街那些人是誰？
name: those 指時間或空間較遠的事物
sentences: There's a film crew outside. Who are those people across the street?
Do you know those boys at the bus stop?
Those children over there are in my sister's class.
Can you see those men on the roof? They're fixing it.
Excuse me, how much are those bags in the window?
Look at those balloons in the sky! There are hundreds of them.
Can you pass me those books on the top shelf?
Those mountains are covered in snow all year.
I'd like two of those cakes, please.
My grandmother grew up on a farm. In those days, there was no electricity.
I remember those summers at the beach with my cousins.
Life was simpler in those days.
We were students then. Those years were the best of my life.
I don't like these shoes. Can I try those ones?
Those flowers by the door are for you.
Are those your keys on the table?
Those houses on the hill have a beautiful view.
Don't eat those berries. They might be poisonous.
Can you hear those birds? They sing every morning.
"Whose are those coats?" "They're ours. We'll take them."
"Are those your parents?" "Yes, the ones by the car."
"Which glasses do you want?" "Those ones on the left, please."

examples.heading: ① those + 複數名詞：遠處的人

items.en: There's a film crew outside. Who are those people across the street?
items.zh: 外面有一組拍片的人。對街那些人是誰？

items.en: Do you know those boys at the bus stop?
items.zh: 你認識公車站那幾個男生嗎？

items.en: Those children over there are in my sister's class.
items.zh: 那邊那幾個小孩是我妹妹班上的。

items.en: Can you see those men on the roof? They're fixing it.
items.zh: 你看得到屋頂上那幾個男人嗎？他們在修屋頂。

examples.heading: ② those + 複數名詞：遠處的東西

items.en: Excuse me, how much are those bags in the window?
items.zh: 請問櫥窗裡那些包包多少錢？

items.en: Look at those balloons in the sky! There are hundreds of them.
items.zh: 你看天上那些氣球！有好幾百個。

items.en: Can you pass me those books on the top shelf?
items.zh: 你可以把書架最上面那幾本書拿給我嗎？

items.en: Those mountains are covered in snow all year.
items.zh: 那些山一整年都積著雪。

items.en: I'd like two of those cakes, please.
items.zh: 請給我兩個那種蛋糕。

examples.heading: ③ those days / those years：過去的時間

items.en: My grandmother grew up on a farm. In those days, there was no electricity.
items.zh: 我奶奶在農場長大。那個時候沒有電。

items.en: I remember those summers at the beach with my cousins.
items.zh: 我記得那幾個夏天跟表兄弟姊妹在海邊度過。

items.en: Life was simpler in those days.
items.zh: 那個時候生活比較簡單。

items.en: We were students then. Those years were the best of my life.
items.zh: 那時候我們是學生。那幾年是我人生中最好的時光。

examples.heading: ④ 購物和指東西

items.en: I don't like these shoes. Can I try those ones?
items.zh: 我不喜歡這雙鞋。我可以試穿那雙嗎？

items.en: Those flowers by the door are for you.
items.zh: 門邊那些花是給你的。

items.en: Are those your keys on the table?
items.zh: 桌上那串是你的鑰匙嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Those houses on the hill have a beautiful view.
items.zh: 山坡上那些房子的景色很美。

items.en: Don't eat those berries. They might be poisonous.
items.zh: 別吃那些莓果。可能有毒。

items.en: Can you hear those birds? They sing every morning.
items.zh: 你聽得到那些鳥叫嗎？牠們每天早上都在唱歌。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Whose are those coats?" "They're ours. We'll take them."
items.zh: 那些外套是誰的？是我們的。我們會拿走。

items.en: "Are those your parents?" "Yes, the ones by the car."
items.zh: 那兩個是你爸媽嗎？對，車子旁邊那兩個。

items.en: "Which glasses do you want?" "Those ones on the left, please."
items.zh: 你要哪副眼鏡？左邊那副，謝謝。

title: Surprisingly, the suitcase was Lucy's.
translation: 沒想到那個行李箱是 Lucy 的。
name: 表示態度的副詞當言談標記
sentences: Unfortunately, we're in a fix: we've lost the car keys.
Fortunately, the tumour turned out to be benign.
Fortunately, the storm passed without much damage.
Luckily, my neighbour lent me his lawnmower.
Sadly, the old cinema will close next month.
Surprisingly, the survey found that most teenagers prefer paper books.
Obviously, you can't drive if you've been drinking.
Obviously, the team was downcast after the defeat.
Clearly, someone painted the graffiti last night. The paint is still wet.
Apparently, the band is going to play here in May.
Actually, I don't mind working at weekends.
Actually, the meeting is at three, not at two.
Honestly, it was a trifling mistake.
Personally, I find his jokes obnoxious.
Personally, I think superstition is harmless.
Frankly, the evidence for this theory is tenuous.
Frankly, some of his friends are a bit unsavoury.
We actually finished the project a week early.
The bus was luckily on time for once.
He has clearly been working too hard.
You will obviously need a visa for this trip.
My brother obviously knows more about cars than I do.
Prices are apparently going up again in January.
I quite like living alone, actually.
They're getting married next year, apparently.
We lost the final, sadly.
The tickets had sold out, unfortunately.
Unfortunately, the hotel cannot offer refunds for late cancellations.
Clearly, the city needs more buses at night.
Surprisingly, sales rose during the winter months.
Luckily, the fire alarm worked and everyone left the building safely.
Sadly, the writer died before the book came out.
Honestly, I expected more from a five-star hotel.

examples.heading: ① 表示感受

items.en: Unfortunately, we're in a fix: we've lost the car keys.
items.zh: 糟糕的是，我們遇到麻煩了：車鑰匙弄丟了。

items.en: Fortunately, the tumour turned out to be benign.
items.zh: 幸好那顆腫瘤是良性的。

items.en: Fortunately, the storm passed without much damage.
items.zh: 幸好暴風雨過去了，沒造成多少損害。

items.en: Luckily, my neighbour lent me his lawnmower.
items.zh: 還好鄰居把割草機借給我。

items.en: Sadly, the old cinema will close next month.
items.zh: 很遺憾，那家老電影院下個月就要關了。

items.en: Surprisingly, the survey found that most teenagers prefer paper books.
items.zh: 令人意外的是，這份調查發現大部分青少年比較喜歡紙本書。

examples.heading: ② 表示確定程度

items.en: Obviously, you can't drive if you've been drinking.
items.zh: 喝了酒當然不能開車。

items.en: Obviously, the team was downcast after the defeat.
items.zh: 很明顯，輸球之後全隊都很沮喪。

items.en: Clearly, someone painted the graffiti last night. The paint is still wet.
items.zh: 顯然有人昨晚畫了這些塗鴉。油漆還沒乾。

items.en: Apparently, the band is going to play here in May.
items.zh: 聽說那個樂團五月會來這裡表演。

examples.heading: ③ 表示說話態度

items.en: Actually, I don't mind working at weekends.
items.zh: 其實我不介意週末上班。

items.en: Actually, the meeting is at three, not at two.
items.zh: 其實會議是三點，不是兩點。

items.en: Honestly, it was a trifling mistake.
items.zh: 說真的，那只是個小錯。

items.en: Personally, I find his jokes obnoxious.
items.zh: 我個人覺得他的笑話很討人厭。

items.en: Personally, I think superstition is harmless.
items.zh: 我個人認為迷信沒什麼害處。

items.en: Frankly, the evidence for this theory is tenuous.
items.zh: 坦白說，支持這個理論的證據很薄弱。

items.en: Frankly, some of his friends are a bit unsavoury.
items.zh: 坦白說，他有些朋友不太正派。

examples.heading: ④ 放在句中

items.en: We actually finished the project a week early.
items.zh: 我們其實提早一個星期完成了這個案子。

items.en: The bus was luckily on time for once.
items.zh: 幸好公車難得準時一次。

items.en: He has clearly been working too hard.
items.zh: 他顯然工作得太累了。

items.en: You will obviously need a visa for this trip.
items.zh: 這趟旅行你當然需要簽證。

items.en: My brother obviously knows more about cars than I do.
items.zh: 我哥哥對車子顯然比我懂得多。

items.en: Prices are apparently going up again in January.
items.zh: 聽說一月又要漲價了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 放在句尾

items.en: I quite like living alone, actually.
items.zh: 其實我還滿喜歡一個人住的。

items.en: They're getting married next year, apparently.
items.zh: 聽說他們明年要結婚。

items.en: We lost the final, sadly.
items.zh: 很可惜，我們輸了決賽。

items.en: The tickets had sold out, unfortunately.
items.zh: 可惜票已經賣完了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 書面文字

items.en: Unfortunately, the hotel cannot offer refunds for late cancellations.
items.zh: 很遺憾，飯店無法為太晚取消的訂房退款。

items.en: Clearly, the city needs more buses at night.
items.zh: 很明顯，這個城市晚上需要更多公車。

items.en: Surprisingly, sales rose during the winter months.
items.zh: 出乎意料的是，冬季那幾個月的銷售量上升了。

items.en: Luckily, the fire alarm worked and everyone left the building safely.
items.zh: 幸好火災警報器有響，大家都安全離開了大樓。

items.en: Sadly, the writer died before the book came out.
items.zh: 很遺憾，作者在書出版前就過世了。

items.en: Honestly, I expected more from a five-star hotel.
items.zh: 老實說，我對一家五星級飯店原本期待更多。

title: As you know, my parents are leaving home tomorrow night to go to Spain.
translation: 你也知道，我爸媽明天晚上要出門去西班牙。
name: 言談標記 as you know
sentences: As you know, Tom and I have been friends since primary school.
As you know, Grandma isn't very well at the moment.
As you know, our flat isn't very capacious, so you'll have to sleep on the sofa.
As you know, the deadline for the report is Friday.
As you know, I've been in a bit of a predicament since I lost my job.
We'd love to visit, but, as you know, our car broke down last month.
The village is very quiet and, as you know, there's nothing to do in the evenings.
Our neighbour, as you know, is a doctor.
I'm not driving tonight because, as you know, my eyes are bad in the dark.
The rain was relentless all week, as you know.
Life in a small town can be a bit humdrum, as you know.
I can't stand pungent cheese, as you know.
As you may know, our prices will go up in January.
As you may know, Mr Green is leaving the company at the end of the month.
As you may know, the new rules will expedite the whole process.
As you all know, the exam starts at nine sharp.
As you all know, we've had an excessive number of complaints this year.
Thanks for the invitation. As you know, I love weddings, so I'll definitely be there.
As you know, my parents are away next week, so I'll have the house to myself.
As you know, I've never been abroad before, so I'm a bit nervous about the trip.
I'm sorry I can't help with the move. As you know, I'm working every weekend this month.
As you know, Sam had an unforeseen problem with his visa, so he can't come.
I passed my driving test! As you know, I failed it twice last year.
As you know, the meeting has been moved to Thursday.
As you know, the library closes early during the holidays.
As you know, the main road will be closed for repairs next week.
As you know, I have worked in this department for ten years.
"Can you lend me your car?" "Sorry. As you know, I sold it last month."
"Are you coming to the match?" "I can't. As you know, I work on Saturdays."
"Why don't you ask Dad?" "Because, as you know, he never lends anyone money."
"Shall we eat at the Italian place?" "It's closed on Sundays, as you know."
"Is Anna coming tonight?" "No. As you know, she's still in hospital."

examples.heading: ① 放在句首

items.en: As you know, Tom and I have been friends since primary school.
items.zh: 你也知道，我和 Tom 從小學就是朋友了。

items.en: As you know, Grandma isn't very well at the moment.
items.zh: 你也知道，奶奶最近身體不太好。

items.en: As you know, our flat isn't very capacious, so you'll have to sleep on the sofa.
items.zh: 你也知道，我們的公寓不大，所以你得睡沙發。

items.en: As you know, the deadline for the report is Friday.
items.zh: 你也知道，報告的截止日是星期五。

items.en: As you know, I've been in a bit of a predicament since I lost my job.
items.zh: 你也知道，我丟了工作以後就有點進退兩難。

examples.heading: ② 放在句中

items.en: We'd love to visit, but, as you know, our car broke down last month.
items.zh: 我們很想去看你們，可是你也知道，我們的車上個月壞了。

items.en: The village is very quiet and, as you know, there's nothing to do in the evenings.
items.zh: 那個村子很安靜，而且你也知道，晚上沒什麼事可做。

items.en: Our neighbour, as you know, is a doctor.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居是醫生，你也知道的。

items.en: I'm not driving tonight because, as you know, my eyes are bad in the dark.
items.zh: 我今晚不開車，因為你也知道，我在暗的地方看不清楚。

examples.heading: ③ 放在句尾

items.en: The rain was relentless all week, as you know.
items.zh: 雨整個星期下個不停，你也知道的。

items.en: Life in a small town can be a bit humdrum, as you know.
items.zh: 小鎮的生活有時候有點單調，你也知道的。

items.en: I can't stand pungent cheese, as you know.
items.zh: 我受不了味道很重的起司，你也知道的。

examples.heading: ④ as you may know

items.en: As you may know, our prices will go up in January.
items.zh: 您可能已經知道，我們的價格一月起會調漲。

items.en: As you may know, Mr Green is leaving the company at the end of the month.
items.zh: 各位可能已經知道，Green 先生月底要離開公司。

items.en: As you may know, the new rules will expedite the whole process.
items.zh: 您可能已經知道，新規定會加快整個流程。

examples.heading: ⑤ as you all know

items.en: As you all know, the exam starts at nine sharp.
items.zh: 大家都知道，考試九點整開始。

items.en: As you all know, we've had an excessive number of complaints this year.
items.zh: 大家都知道，我們今年收到的投訴多得不尋常。

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫給朋友的信

items.en: Thanks for the invitation. As you know, I love weddings, so I'll definitely be there.
items.zh: 謝謝你的邀請。你也知道我很愛參加婚禮，所以我一定會去。

items.en: As you know, my parents are away next week, so I'll have the house to myself.
items.zh: 你也知道，我爸媽下星期不在家，所以整間房子都是我的。

items.en: As you know, I've never been abroad before, so I'm a bit nervous about the trip.
items.zh: 你也知道，我以前從來沒出過國，所以對這趟旅行有點緊張。

items.en: I'm sorry I can't help with the move. As you know, I'm working every weekend this month.
items.zh: 很抱歉沒辦法幫你搬家。你也知道，我這個月每個週末都要上班。

items.en: As you know, Sam had an unforeseen problem with his visa, so he can't come.
items.zh: 你也知道，Sam 的簽證出了意料之外的問題，所以他不能來。

items.en: I passed my driving test! As you know, I failed it twice last year.
items.zh: 我考過駕照了！你也知道，我去年考了兩次都沒過。

examples.heading: ⑦ 正式信件和通知

items.en: As you know, the meeting has been moved to Thursday.
items.zh: 如您所知，會議改到星期四。

items.en: As you know, the library closes early during the holidays.
items.zh: 如各位所知，圖書館假期期間提早關門。

items.en: As you know, the main road will be closed for repairs next week.
items.zh: 如各位所知，大馬路下星期要封路維修。

items.en: As you know, I have worked in this department for ten years.
items.zh: 如您所知，我在這個部門工作了十年。

examples.heading: ⑧ 對話

items.en: "Can you lend me your car?" "Sorry. As you know, I sold it last month."
items.zh: 你可以借我車嗎？抱歉。你也知道，我上個月把車賣了。

items.en: "Are you coming to the match?" "I can't. As you know, I work on Saturdays."
items.zh: 你要來看比賽嗎？我不行。你也知道，我星期六要上班。

items.en: "Why don't you ask Dad?" "Because, as you know, he never lends anyone money."
items.zh: 你為什麼不問爸？因為你也知道，他從來不借錢給任何人。

items.en: "Shall we eat at the Italian place?" "It's closed on Sundays, as you know."
items.zh: 我們要不要去那家義大利餐廳吃？它星期天公休，你也知道的。

items.en: "Is Anna coming tonight?" "No. As you know, she's still in hospital."
items.zh: Anna 今晚會來嗎？不會。你也知道，她還在住院。

title: When you read a letter, you can almost feel the writer's emotions. In the same way, when you read a book, you can feel the author's emotions.
translation: 讀信的時候，你幾乎能感受到寫信人的情緒。同樣地，讀書的時候，你也能感受到作者的情緒。
name: 表示比較的言談標記
sentences: The company assigned Tom to the sales team. Similarly, it moved Anna to marketing.
Most teachers concur that homework helps students. Similarly, many parents think it is useful.
The old factory is now defunct. Similarly, the mine near the river closed years ago.
You need a passport to enter the country. Similarly, you need one to leave.
I don't eat meat. Similarly, my wife avoids fish and eggs.
The number of farmers fell in the 1990s; similarly, fewer people worked in factories.
In Nepal, New Year comes in April. Likewise, Thailand celebrates New Year in April.
The nurses were very compassionate. Likewise, the doctor took time to talk to us.
Children must wear helmets on bikes. Likewise, adults should wear them on scooters.
My brother advocates cycling to work. Likewise, his friends all ride bikes.
The first chapter is quite discursive; likewise, the second chapter moves slowly.
Visitors must not touch the paintings. Likewise, they may not use flash cameras.
Exercise keeps your body strong. In the same way, reading keeps your mind active.
You wouldn't go into someone's house without asking. In the same way, you shouldn't read their messages without asking.
A tyrant controls people with fear. In the same way, a bad boss can control the staff.
Music can make a long drive feel shorter. In the same way, a good book makes a flight pass quickly.
We learn our first language by listening. In the same way, we can learn a second one.
Bees work together to build a hive. In a similar way, ants build their nests as a team.
The first film was a big success. In a similar way, the second one sold out in many cinemas.
Some people relax by cooking. In a similar way, I relax by working in the garden.
The lake was frozen. The river was similarly covered in ice.
The first plan failed. The second plan will likewise fail without more money.
Our team lost last week. We have similarly lost two games this month.
The manager condemned the decision. The staff likewise refused to accept it.
Older people use the internet more than before. Young children are similarly spending more time online.
The kitchen needs a new floor; similarly, the bathroom needs new tiles.
Students can borrow ten books; likewise, teachers can borrow ten.
The fans rallied outside the stadium; in the same way, people gathered in the town square.
The old system often crashed; in a similar way, the new one stops working twice a week.
The number of workers is expected to fall by 2050. Similarly, the share of children is likely to drop to 11.5%.
Vietnam celebrates New Year according to the lunar calendar. Likewise, Korea uses the lunar calendar for its New Year.
A good teacher listens to students. In the same way, a good manager listens to the staff.

examples.heading: ① similarly

items.en: The company assigned Tom to the sales team. Similarly, it moved Anna to marketing.
items.zh: 公司把 Tom 派到業務組。同樣地，公司把 Anna 調到行銷部。

items.en: Most teachers concur that homework helps students. Similarly, many parents think it is useful.
items.zh: 大部分老師都同意功課對學生有幫助。同樣地，很多家長也認為功課有用。

items.en: The old factory is now defunct. Similarly, the mine near the river closed years ago.
items.zh: 那座舊工廠現在已經停業了。同樣地，河邊那座礦場好幾年前就關了。

items.en: You need a passport to enter the country. Similarly, you need one to leave.
items.zh: 入境這個國家要護照。同樣地，出境也要護照。

items.en: I don't eat meat. Similarly, my wife avoids fish and eggs.
items.zh: 我不吃肉。同樣地，我太太也不吃魚和蛋。

items.en: The number of farmers fell in the 1990s; similarly, fewer people worked in factories.
items.zh: 1990 年代農民人數減少了；同樣地，在工廠工作的人也變少了。

examples.heading: ② likewise

items.en: In Nepal, New Year comes in April. Likewise, Thailand celebrates New Year in April.
items.zh: 尼泊爾的新年在四月。同樣地，泰國也在四月過新年。

items.en: The nurses were very compassionate. Likewise, the doctor took time to talk to us.
items.zh: 護理師都很有同情心。同樣地，醫生也花時間跟我們說明。

items.en: Children must wear helmets on bikes. Likewise, adults should wear them on scooters.
items.zh: 孩子騎腳踏車必須戴安全帽。同樣地，大人騎機車也應該戴。

items.en: My brother advocates cycling to work. Likewise, his friends all ride bikes.
items.zh: 我哥哥主張騎腳踏車上班。同樣地，他的朋友也都騎腳踏車。

items.en: The first chapter is quite discursive; likewise, the second chapter moves slowly.
items.zh: 第一章寫得相當散漫；同樣地，第二章的步調也很慢。

items.en: Visitors must not touch the paintings. Likewise, they may not use flash cameras.
items.zh: 參觀者不可以觸摸畫作。同樣地，也不可以用閃光燈拍照。

examples.heading: ③ in the same way

items.en: Exercise keeps your body strong. In the same way, reading keeps your mind active.
items.zh: 運動讓身體強壯。同樣地，閱讀讓頭腦保持活躍。

items.en: You wouldn't go into someone's house without asking. In the same way, you shouldn't read their messages without asking.
items.zh: 你不會沒問過就走進別人家。同樣地，你也不應該沒問過就看別人的訊息。

items.en: A tyrant controls people with fear. In the same way, a bad boss can control the staff.
items.zh: 暴君用恐懼控制人民。同樣地，糟糕的老闆也可能用恐懼控制員工。

items.en: Music can make a long drive feel shorter. In the same way, a good book makes a flight pass quickly.
items.zh: 音樂可以讓長途開車感覺短一點。同樣地，一本好書能讓飛行時間過得很快。

items.en: We learn our first language by listening. In the same way, we can learn a second one.
items.zh: 我們靠聽來學母語。同樣地，我們也可以這樣學第二語言。

examples.heading: ④ in a similar way

items.en: Bees work together to build a hive. In a similar way, ants build their nests as a team.
items.zh: 蜜蜂合力建蜂巢。同樣地，螞蟻也一起築巢。

items.en: The first film was a big success. In a similar way, the second one sold out in many cinemas.
items.zh: 第一部電影很成功。同樣地，第二部在很多電影院都賣光了票。

items.en: Some people relax by cooking. In a similar way, I relax by working in the garden.
items.zh: 有些人靠做菜放鬆。同樣地，我靠整理花園放鬆。

examples.heading: ⑤ 放在句中

items.en: The lake was frozen. The river was similarly covered in ice.
items.zh: 湖結冰了。河面同樣也結了一層冰。

items.en: The first plan failed. The second plan will likewise fail without more money.
items.zh: 第一個計畫失敗了。沒有更多經費的話，第二個計畫同樣會失敗。

items.en: Our team lost last week. We have similarly lost two games this month.
items.zh: 我們隊上週輸了。這個月我們同樣也輸了兩場。

items.en: The manager condemned the decision. The staff likewise refused to accept it.
items.zh: 經理譴責這個決定。員工同樣拒絕接受。

items.en: Older people use the internet more than before. Young children are similarly spending more time online.
items.zh: 老年人比以前更常上網。小孩子同樣也花更多時間上網。

examples.heading: ⑥ 分號後面

items.en: The kitchen needs a new floor; similarly, the bathroom needs new tiles.
items.zh: 廚房需要換新地板；同樣地，浴室也需要換新磁磚。

items.en: Students can borrow ten books; likewise, teachers can borrow ten.
items.zh: 學生可以借十本書；同樣地，老師也可以借十本。

items.en: The fans rallied outside the stadium; in the same way, people gathered in the town square.
items.zh: 球迷聚集在球場外；同樣地，民眾也聚集在鎮上的廣場。

items.en: The old system often crashed; in a similar way, the new one stops working twice a week.
items.zh: 舊系統常常當機；同樣地，新系統一個星期也會停擺兩次。

examples.heading: ⑦ 論說文和報告

items.en: The number of workers is expected to fall by 2050. Similarly, the share of children is likely to drop to 11.5%.
items.zh: 到 2050 年，勞動人口預計會減少。同樣地，兒童的比例可能會降到 11.5%。

items.en: Vietnam celebrates New Year according to the lunar calendar. Likewise, Korea uses the lunar calendar for its New Year.
items.zh: 越南依照農曆過新年。同樣地，韓國也依照農曆過新年。

items.en: A good teacher listens to students. In the same way, a good manager listens to the staff.
items.zh: 好老師會傾聽學生的話。同樣地，好主管也會傾聽員工的話。

title: Besides, you're 18 years old, and you aren't a baby.
translation: 再說，你都 18 歲了，又不是小嬰兒。
name: 表示補充的言談標記
sentences: The new law is arbitrary. Moreover, it will be hard to enforce.
Exercise improves your mood. Moreover, it helps you sleep better.
The evidence is tenuous. Moreover, the main witness has changed her story twice.
The company failed to pay its staff; moreover, it lied to the bank.
Online banking is fast. Furthermore, you can use it at any time of day.
The town needs a new hospital. Furthermore, the old one is too far from the centre.
The report is superficial. Furthermore, it contains several mistakes.
We have enough money for the project; furthermore, the council has offered to help.
The course is cheap. In addition, the teachers are very experienced.
You will need a passport. In addition, you must bring two photos.
The hotel offers free breakfast. In addition, guests can use the gym.
Our new manager is friendly. In addition, she's very good at facilitating meetings.
I don't want to see that film. Besides, I've got work to do.
We can't afford a new car. Besides, the old one still works.
Don't worry about the test. Besides, it's only a practice one.
I'm not lending him money again. Besides, he never paid me back last time.
It's too late to call her now. Besides, she's probably asleep.
The food was delicious. What is more, the prices were very reasonable.
She speaks four languages. What is more, she learned them all as an adult.
The tent is easy to put up. What's more, it only weighs two kilos.
He was late again. What's more, he didn't even say sorry.
The flat is in the centre; what's more, it's quite cheap.
The new plan is quicker. It is, moreover, much cheaper than the old one.
The office is on the fifth floor. The building, furthermore, has no lift.
The new drug works quickly. It is, furthermore, safe for children.
Life there is easy for older people. The village, moreover, has its own doctor.
Public transport reduces traffic. Moreover, it is better for the environment.
I have five years of experience in sales. In addition, I speak fluent Spanish.
Many students cannot afford the fees. Furthermore, there are not enough places at the university.
The library is too small. In addition, it closes too early for working people.
Volunteering helps others. What is more, it teaches young people new skills.
Children who read every day write better. Furthermore, they tend to do better at school.

examples.heading: ① moreover

items.en: The new law is arbitrary. Moreover, it will be hard to enforce.
items.zh: 這條新法律很武斷。而且很難執行。

items.en: Exercise improves your mood. Moreover, it helps you sleep better.
items.zh: 運動能改善心情。而且能幫助你睡得更好。

items.en: The evidence is tenuous. Moreover, the main witness has changed her story twice.
items.zh: 證據很薄弱。而且主要證人已經改了兩次說法。

items.en: The company failed to pay its staff; moreover, it lied to the bank.
items.zh: 那家公司沒付員工薪水；而且還對銀行說謊。

examples.heading: ② furthermore

items.en: Online banking is fast. Furthermore, you can use it at any time of day.
items.zh: 網路銀行很快。此外，一天當中任何時間都能用。

items.en: The town needs a new hospital. Furthermore, the old one is too far from the centre.
items.zh: 這個鎮需要一間新醫院。此外，舊醫院離市中心太遠了。

items.en: The report is superficial. Furthermore, it contains several mistakes.
items.zh: 這份報告很膚淺。此外，裡面還有好幾個錯誤。

items.en: We have enough money for the project; furthermore, the council has offered to help.
items.zh: 我們有足夠的經費做這個計畫；此外，市議會也表示願意幫忙。

examples.heading: ③ in addition

items.en: The course is cheap. In addition, the teachers are very experienced.
items.zh: 這門課很便宜。此外，老師都很有經驗。

items.en: You will need a passport. In addition, you must bring two photos.
items.zh: 你需要護照。此外，你還必須帶兩張照片。

items.en: The hotel offers free breakfast. In addition, guests can use the gym.
items.zh: 飯店提供免費早餐。此外，房客還可以用健身房。

items.en: Our new manager is friendly. In addition, she's very good at facilitating meetings.
items.zh: 我們的新經理很友善。此外，她很會主持會議。

examples.heading: ④ besides

items.en: I don't want to see that film. Besides, I've got work to do.
items.zh: 我不想看那部電影。再說，我還有工作要做。

items.en: We can't afford a new car. Besides, the old one still works.
items.zh: 我們買不起新車。再說，舊的還能開。

items.en: Don't worry about the test. Besides, it's only a practice one.
items.zh: 別擔心考試。再說，那只是練習考。

items.en: I'm not lending him money again. Besides, he never paid me back last time.
items.zh: 我不會再借他錢了。再說，他上次也沒還我。

items.en: It's too late to call her now. Besides, she's probably asleep.
items.zh: 現在打給她太晚了。再說，她大概已經睡了。

examples.heading: ⑤ what is more 和 what's more

items.en: The food was delicious. What is more, the prices were very reasonable.
items.zh: 菜很好吃。而且，價格很合理。

items.en: She speaks four languages. What is more, she learned them all as an adult.
items.zh: 她會說四種語言。而且，她全都是長大以後才學的。

items.en: The tent is easy to put up. What's more, it only weighs two kilos.
items.zh: 這頂帳篷很好搭。而且，只有兩公斤重。

items.en: He was late again. What's more, he didn't even say sorry.
items.zh: 他又遲到了。而且，他連對不起都沒說。

items.en: The flat is in the centre; what's more, it's quite cheap.
items.zh: 那間公寓在市中心；而且還滿便宜的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 放在句中

items.en: The new plan is quicker. It is, moreover, much cheaper than the old one.
items.zh: 新計畫比較快。而且，它比舊的便宜得多。

items.en: The office is on the fifth floor. The building, furthermore, has no lift.
items.zh: 辦公室在五樓。此外，那棟大樓沒有電梯。

items.en: The new drug works quickly. It is, furthermore, safe for children.
items.zh: 這種新藥見效很快。此外，它對兒童也很安全。

items.en: Life there is easy for older people. The village, moreover, has its own doctor.
items.zh: 那裡的生活對老人家很方便。而且，那個村子有自己的醫生。

examples.heading: ⑦ 論說文和正式信件

items.en: Public transport reduces traffic. Moreover, it is better for the environment.
items.zh: 大眾運輸能減少車流。而且對環境比較好。

items.en: I have five years of experience in sales. In addition, I speak fluent Spanish.
items.zh: 我有五年的業務經驗。此外，我的西班牙語很流利。

items.en: Many students cannot afford the fees. Furthermore, there are not enough places at the university.
items.zh: 很多學生付不起學費。此外，大學的名額也不夠。

items.en: The library is too small. In addition, it closes too early for working people.
items.zh: 圖書館太小了。此外，它關門的時間太早，上班的人來不及去。

items.en: Volunteering helps others. What is more, it teaches young people new skills.
items.zh: 當志工能幫助別人。而且，能讓年輕人學到新技能。

items.en: Children who read every day write better. Furthermore, they tend to do better at school.
items.zh: 每天閱讀的孩子寫作比較好。此外，他們在學校的表現往往也比較好。

title: On the one hand, going to a large school is better for making friends, but on the other hand, I think you can learn better in a small school.
translation: 一方面，念大型學校比較容易交到朋友；但另一方面，我覺得在小型學校可以學得更好。
name: 表示對比的言談標記
sentences: On the one hand, I'd like a bigger house, but on the other hand, I don't want a longer commute.
On the one hand, social media keeps us in touch. On the other hand, it wastes a lot of time.
On the one hand, the course was useful, but on the other hand, it was far too short.
On the one hand, living alone gives you freedom. On the other hand, it can be lonely.
The salary is a pittance. On the other hand, the work is interesting.
Trains are faster. On the other hand, buses are much cheaper.
He can be impulsive. On the other hand, he's always honest with us.
I could take the job in London. On the other hand, I could stay here and finish my degree.
The plan sounds good. However, it isn't relevant to our problem.
We waited for an hour. However, nobody came.
Most owls are nocturnal. However, some hunt during the day.
I'd love to help. However, I'm busy all weekend.
My parents liked the film. My friends, however, thought it was crummy.
The first chapter is slow. The rest of the book, however, is excellent.
She agreed to come. She didn't stay long, however.
The room was small. It was very clean, however.
Summers here are hot. In contrast, the winters are mild.
The old phone was heavy. In contrast, the new model weighs only 150 grams.
Sales rose in Asia. By contrast, they fell sharply in Europe.
My father is an inveterate talker. My mother, by contrast, rarely says a word.
The exam wasn't easy. On the contrary, it was the hardest one this year.
She isn't covetous. On the contrary, she gives away most of her money.
"Did you hate the trip?" "On the contrary, we had a wonderful time."
"I suppose the news upset you." "On the contrary, I was jubilant."
"Should we buy the bigger car?" "On the one hand, it's safer. On the other hand, it's hard to park."
"Is the new manager strict?" "On the contrary, she's very easy-going."
"Was the hotel nice?" "Yes. The beach was quite dirty, however."
"Shall we eat out tonight?" "I'd love to. On the other hand, we've spent a lot this week."
Online courses are flexible. However, students often miss face-to-face contact.
On the one hand, tourism brings money to the region. On the other hand, it damages the environment.
In 2010, most people read the news in print. In contrast, most people today read it online.
Private schools have small classes. By contrast, many state schools have over thirty students per class.

examples.heading: ① on the one hand 和 on the other hand

items.en: On the one hand, I'd like a bigger house, but on the other hand, I don't want a longer commute.
items.zh: 一方面，我想要大一點的房子；但另一方面，我不想通勤更久。

items.en: On the one hand, social media keeps us in touch. On the other hand, it wastes a lot of time.
items.zh: 一方面，社群媒體讓我們保持聯絡。另一方面，它很浪費時間。

items.en: On the one hand, the course was useful, but on the other hand, it was far too short.
items.zh: 一方面，這門課很有用；但另一方面，它實在太短了。

items.en: On the one hand, living alone gives you freedom. On the other hand, it can be lonely.
items.zh: 一方面，一個人住很自由。另一方面，可能會很寂寞。

examples.heading: ② on the other hand 單獨用

items.en: The salary is a pittance. On the other hand, the work is interesting.
items.zh: 薪水少得可憐。可是話說回來，工作很有意思。

items.en: Trains are faster. On the other hand, buses are much cheaper.
items.zh: 火車比較快。可是另一方面，公車便宜多了。

items.en: He can be impulsive. On the other hand, he's always honest with us.
items.zh: 他有時候很衝動。可是另一方面，他對我們一向很誠實。

items.en: I could take the job in London. On the other hand, I could stay here and finish my degree.
items.zh: 我可以接倫敦的工作。不過話說回來，我也可以留在這裡念完學位。

examples.heading: ③ however 放在句首

items.en: The plan sounds good. However, it isn't relevant to our problem.
items.zh: 這個計畫聽起來不錯。不過，它跟我們的問題無關。

items.en: We waited for an hour. However, nobody came.
items.zh: 我們等了一個小時。不過，沒有人來。

items.en: Most owls are nocturnal. However, some hunt during the day.
items.zh: 大部分的貓頭鷹在夜間活動。不過，有些在白天獵食。

items.en: I'd love to help. However, I'm busy all weekend.
items.zh: 我很想幫忙。不過，我整個週末都很忙。

examples.heading: ④ however 放在句中或句尾

items.en: My parents liked the film. My friends, however, thought it was crummy.
items.zh: 我爸媽喜歡那部電影。不過我朋友覺得它很爛。

items.en: The first chapter is slow. The rest of the book, however, is excellent.
items.zh: 第一章節奏很慢。不過這本書其他的部分很精彩。

items.en: She agreed to come. She didn't stay long, however.
items.zh: 她答應來了。不過她沒待多久。

items.en: The room was small. It was very clean, however.
items.zh: 房間很小。不過很乾淨。

examples.heading: ⑤ in contrast 和 by contrast

items.en: Summers here are hot. In contrast, the winters are mild.
items.zh: 這裡的夏天很熱。相較之下，冬天很溫和。

items.en: The old phone was heavy. In contrast, the new model weighs only 150 grams.
items.zh: 舊手機很重。相較之下，新機型只有一百五十公克。

items.en: Sales rose in Asia. By contrast, they fell sharply in Europe.
items.zh: 亞洲的銷售額上升了。相較之下，歐洲的銷售額大幅下滑。

items.en: My father is an inveterate talker. My mother, by contrast, rarely says a word.
items.zh: 我爸爸是個改不了的話匣子。相較之下，我媽媽很少說話。

examples.heading: ⑥ on the contrary

items.en: The exam wasn't easy. On the contrary, it was the hardest one this year.
items.zh: 這次考試不簡單。正好相反，它是今年最難的一次。

items.en: She isn't covetous. On the contrary, she gives away most of her money.
items.zh: 她不貪心。正好相反，她把大部分的錢都送人了。

items.en: "Did you hate the trip?" "On the contrary, we had a wonderful time."
items.zh: 你們不喜歡那趟旅行嗎？才不呢，我們玩得很開心。

items.en: "I suppose the news upset you." "On the contrary, I was jubilant."
items.zh: 我想這個消息讓你很難過吧。才不呢，我高興得不得了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Should we buy the bigger car?" "On the one hand, it's safer. On the other hand, it's hard to park."
items.zh: 我們要買大一點的車嗎？一方面，它比較安全。另一方面，它很難停車。

items.en: "Is the new manager strict?" "On the contrary, she's very easy-going."
items.zh: 新經理很嚴格嗎？才不呢，她很隨和。

items.en: "Was the hotel nice?" "Yes. The beach was quite dirty, however."
items.zh: 飯店好嗎？好。不過海灘蠻髒的。

items.en: "Shall we eat out tonight?" "I'd love to. On the other hand, we've spent a lot this week."
items.zh: 我們今晚要出去吃嗎？我很想。不過話說回來，我們這星期花了不少錢。

examples.heading: ⑧ 論說文和報告

items.en: Online courses are flexible. However, students often miss face-to-face contact.
items.zh: 線上課程很有彈性。不過，學生常常想念面對面的互動。

items.en: On the one hand, tourism brings money to the region. On the other hand, it damages the environment.
items.zh: 一方面，觀光替這個地區帶來收入。另一方面，它破壞環境。

items.en: In 2010, most people read the news in print. In contrast, most people today read it online.
items.zh: 二〇一〇年，大部分的人看紙本新聞。相較之下，現在大部分的人在網路上看新聞。

items.en: Private schools have small classes. By contrast, many state schools have over thirty students per class.
items.zh: 私立學校的班級人數少。相較之下，很多公立學校一班超過三十個學生。

title: The thing is, if I could move, I'd go to the countryside.
translation: 其實，如果我能搬家，我會搬到鄉下去。
name: you see 和 the thing is 引出新資訊
sentences: I'm nervous about renting a car in London. You see, I've never driven on the left before.
You see, my boss is a bit of a martinet.
You see, the floor was slippery, so I fell.
You see, he isn't lazy. He just finds reading laborious.
You see, tickets are cheaper online, so I booked them last night.
We had to leave early. The baby was tired, you see.
I don't drink booze any more. Doctor's orders, you see.
Don't let her carry the glasses. She's a bit clumsy, you see.
Sorry, I don't know the area. We've only just moved here, you see.
The thing is, I don't have the nerve to ask her out.
The thing is, we can't afford a bigger flat.
I don't want to sell you my car. The thing is, it makes a strange noise every morning.
I know it's a good deal. The thing is, I don't really need a new phone.
Talking to Ben won't help. The thing is, he never listens to anyone.
The thing is that I'm in a bit of a quandary about the job offer.
I can't pick up the cake after work. The thing is that the shop closes at six.
Please don't tell anyone about my new job. The thing is that my parents don't know about it yet.
We drove around for an hour. The thing was, nobody knew the way to the hotel.
I liked the flat. The thing was, it was too far from work.
I went back for my bag, but the classroom was locked. The thing was that the teacher had already left.
"Why are you so late?" "You see, the bus broke down halfway."
"Why don't you want the job?" "The thing is, I'd have to move to another city."
"Can you lend me some money?" "The thing is, I'm a bit short myself this month."
"Why didn't you say yes?" "You see, I'd already promised to help Mum."
"Are you coming to the party?" "I'd like to. The thing is, I don't know anyone there."
"Why is the garden such a mess?" "You see, we've been away for a month."
"Shall we eat outside?" "The thing is, it's going to rain any minute."
"Why didn't you call me back?" "My phone died, you see."
"Why's your sister so quiet?" "She's a bit shy with new people, you see."
Sorry I didn't reply sooner. You see, I've been away all week.
I'd love to visit you in July. The thing is, I don't get much holiday this year.
We didn't go to the beach in the end. The thing was, the weather was awful.

examples.heading: ① you see 放在句首

items.en: I'm nervous about renting a car in London. You see, I've never driven on the left before.
items.zh: 在倫敦租車讓我很緊張。是這樣的，我以前從來沒在左邊開過車。

items.en: You see, my boss is a bit of a martinet.
items.zh: 你要知道，我老闆管得很嚴。

items.en: You see, the floor was slippery, so I fell.
items.zh: 是這樣的，地板很滑，所以我跌倒了。

items.en: You see, he isn't lazy. He just finds reading laborious.
items.zh: 你要知道，他不是懶。他只是覺得讀書很吃力。

items.en: You see, tickets are cheaper online, so I booked them last night.
items.zh: 是這樣的，網路上的票比較便宜，所以我昨晚就訂了。

examples.heading: ② you see 放在句尾

items.en: We had to leave early. The baby was tired, you see.
items.zh: 我們得提早走。寶寶累了嘛。

items.en: I don't drink booze any more. Doctor's orders, you see.
items.zh: 我現在不喝酒了。醫生交代的嘛。

items.en: Don't let her carry the glasses. She's a bit clumsy, you see.
items.zh: 別讓她拿杯子。她有點笨手笨腳的，你知道的。

items.en: Sorry, I don't know the area. We've only just moved here, you see.
items.zh: 抱歉，我對這一帶不熟。我們才剛搬來，你知道的。

examples.heading: ③ the thing is

items.en: The thing is, I don't have the nerve to ask her out.
items.zh: 問題是，我沒膽約她出去。

items.en: The thing is, we can't afford a bigger flat.
items.zh: 問題是，我們租不起大一點的公寓。

items.en: I don't want to sell you my car. The thing is, it makes a strange noise every morning.
items.zh: 我不想把車賣給你。問題是，它每天早上都會發出怪聲。

items.en: I know it's a good deal. The thing is, I don't really need a new phone.
items.zh: 我知道這很划算。問題是，我其實不需要新手機。

items.en: Talking to Ben won't help. The thing is, he never listens to anyone.
items.zh: 跟 Ben 談沒有用。問題是，他從來不聽任何人的話。

examples.heading: ④ the thing is that

items.en: The thing is that I'm in a bit of a quandary about the job offer.
items.zh: 問題是，那份工作的邀約讓我很為難。

items.en: I can't pick up the cake after work. The thing is that the shop closes at six.
items.zh: 我下班後沒辦法去拿蛋糕。問題是那家店六點就關了。

items.en: Please don't tell anyone about my new job. The thing is that my parents don't know about it yet.
items.zh: 請別跟任何人說我換新工作的事。問題是我爸媽還不知道。

examples.heading: ⑤ the thing was

items.en: We drove around for an hour. The thing was, nobody knew the way to the hotel.
items.zh: 我們開車繞了一個小時。問題是，沒人知道去飯店的路。

items.en: I liked the flat. The thing was, it was too far from work.
items.zh: 我喜歡那間公寓。問題是，它離公司太遠了。

items.en: I went back for my bag, but the classroom was locked. The thing was that the teacher had already left.
items.zh: 我回去拿包包，可是教室鎖住了。問題是老師已經走了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Why are you so late?" "You see, the bus broke down halfway."
items.zh: 你怎麼這麼晚？是這樣的，公車半路拋錨了。

items.en: "Why don't you want the job?" "The thing is, I'd have to move to another city."
items.zh: 你為什麼不想要那份工作？問題是，我得搬到別的城市。

items.en: "Can you lend me some money?" "The thing is, I'm a bit short myself this month."
items.zh: 你可以借我一點錢嗎？問題是，我這個月自己也有點缺錢。

items.en: "Why didn't you say yes?" "You see, I'd already promised to help Mum."
items.zh: 你為什麼沒答應？是這樣的，我已經答應要幫我媽了。

items.en: "Are you coming to the party?" "I'd like to. The thing is, I don't know anyone there."
items.zh: 你要來派對嗎？我很想去。問題是，我在那裡誰都不認識。

items.en: "Why is the garden such a mess?" "You see, we've been away for a month."
items.zh: 花園怎麼這麼亂？是這樣的，我們出門一個月了。

items.en: "Shall we eat outside?" "The thing is, it's going to rain any minute."
items.zh: 我們要不要在外面吃？問題是，隨時都會下雨。

items.en: "Why didn't you call me back?" "My phone died, you see."
items.zh: 你怎麼沒回我電話？我手機沒電了嘛。

items.en: "Why's your sister so quiet?" "She's a bit shy with new people, you see."
items.zh: 你妹妹怎麼這麼安靜？她跟不熟的人在一起會有點害羞，你知道的。

examples.heading: ⑦ 寫給朋友的信

items.en: Sorry I didn't reply sooner. You see, I've been away all week.
items.zh: 抱歉沒早點回信。是這樣的，我整個星期都不在家。

items.en: I'd love to visit you in July. The thing is, I don't get much holiday this year.
items.zh: 我很想七月去找你。問題是，我今年假不多。

items.en: We didn't go to the beach in the end. The thing was, the weather was awful.
items.zh: 我們最後沒去海邊。問題是，天氣太糟了。

title: To begin with, I want to ensure that you are going to have a great time with us.
translation: 首先，我想確保您跟我們在一起會過得很愉快。
name: 開頭和結尾的言談標記（正式）
sentences: To begin with, let me tell you a little about our company.
To begin with, I must say that I enjoyed the course very much.
The town should build a new library. To begin with, it would give students a quiet place to study.
To begin with, we need to agree on a date for the party.
To begin with, I would like to explain why I am writing to you.
I wouldn't like to live in the city. For a start, there are far too many cars.
I don't want to move there. For a start, I don't speak the language.
We were not happy with the hotel. For a start, the room was much smaller than the photos showed.
You shouldn't buy that car. For a start, it uses too much petrol.
Let's take the kids to the museum. For a start, it's free on Sundays.
In conclusion, I think both cities are good places to live.
In conclusion, there are more advantages than disadvantages to working from home.
In conclusion, I would like to thank everyone who helped with the event.
In conclusion, the survey shows that most people want more parks.
In conclusion, schools should teach children how to cook.
To sum up, the trip was tiring but very interesting.
To sum up, we need more staff, more space and more time.
To sum up, I think you should take the job in London.
To sum up, the club has had a very good year.
To sum up, whether you take a car or a bike depends on where you live.
In summary, the new system saves time and money.
In summary, most of the students are willing to help clean the school.
In summary, the results of the test were better than we expected.
In summary, sport is good for both the body and the mind.
In summary, our customers are happy with the service but not with the prices.
To conclude, I strongly believe that zoos should stay open.
To conclude, I would like to thank our teachers for their help.
To conclude, the company should open a second shop next year.
To conclude, I hope this report helps you choose the right course.
To conclude, the council should spend the money on buses, not on new roads.
To conclude, I'd say the film is worth seeing, but the book is better.

examples.heading: ① to begin with

items.en: To begin with, let me tell you a little about our company.
items.zh: 首先，讓我向各位簡單介紹一下我們公司。

items.en: To begin with, I must say that I enjoyed the course very much.
items.zh: 首先，我必須說我非常喜歡這門課。

items.en: The town should build a new library. To begin with, it would give students a quiet place to study.
items.zh: 鎮上應該蓋一座新圖書館。首先，它能給學生一個安靜的讀書地方。

items.en: To begin with, we need to agree on a date for the party.
items.zh: 首先，我們得先決定派對的日期。

items.en: To begin with, I would like to explain why I am writing to you.
items.zh: 首先，我想說明我寫信給您的原因。

examples.heading: ② for a start

items.en: I wouldn't like to live in the city. For a start, there are far too many cars.
items.zh: 我不想住在城市。首先，那裡的車子實在太多了。

items.en: I don't want to move there. For a start, I don't speak the language.
items.zh: 我不想搬去那裡。首先，我不會說那裡的語言。

items.en: We were not happy with the hotel. For a start, the room was much smaller than the photos showed.
items.zh: 我們對那家飯店不滿意。首先，房間比照片上看起來小得多。

items.en: You shouldn't buy that car. For a start, it uses too much petrol.
items.zh: 你不應該買那台車。首先，它太耗油了。

items.en: Let's take the kids to the museum. For a start, it's free on Sundays.
items.zh: 我們帶孩子去博物館吧。首先，那裡星期天免費。

examples.heading: ③ in conclusion

items.en: In conclusion, I think both cities are good places to live.
items.zh: 總而言之，我認為這兩個城市都是適合居住的地方。

items.en: In conclusion, there are more advantages than disadvantages to working from home.
items.zh: 總而言之，在家工作的優點比缺點多。

items.en: In conclusion, I would like to thank everyone who helped with the event.
items.zh: 最後，我想感謝每一位幫忙這次活動的人。

items.en: In conclusion, the survey shows that most people want more parks.
items.zh: 總而言之，這份調查顯示大多數人想要更多公園。

items.en: In conclusion, schools should teach children how to cook.
items.zh: 總而言之，學校應該教孩子做飯。

examples.heading: ④ to sum up

items.en: To sum up, the trip was tiring but very interesting.
items.zh: 總結來說，這趟旅行很累，但非常有趣。

items.en: To sum up, we need more staff, more space and more time.
items.zh: 總結來說，我們需要更多人手、更多空間和更多時間。

items.en: To sum up, I think you should take the job in London.
items.zh: 總結來說，我認為你應該接受倫敦那份工作。

items.en: To sum up, the club has had a very good year.
items.zh: 總結來說，社團今年過得非常好。

items.en: To sum up, whether you take a car or a bike depends on where you live.
items.zh: 總結來說，開車還是騎腳踏車，要看你住在哪裡。

examples.heading: ⑤ in summary

items.en: In summary, the new system saves time and money.
items.zh: 總之，新系統省時又省錢。

items.en: In summary, most of the students are willing to help clean the school.
items.zh: 總之，大部分學生都願意幫忙打掃學校。

items.en: In summary, the results of the test were better than we expected.
items.zh: 總之，測試結果比我們預期的好。

items.en: In summary, sport is good for both the body and the mind.
items.zh: 總之，運動對身體和心理都有好處。

items.en: In summary, our customers are happy with the service but not with the prices.
items.zh: 總之，我們的顧客對服務滿意，但對價格不滿意。

examples.heading: ⑥ to conclude

items.en: To conclude, I strongly believe that zoos should stay open.
items.zh: 最後，我深信動物園應該繼續開放。

items.en: To conclude, I would like to thank our teachers for their help.
items.zh: 最後，我想感謝老師們的幫忙。

items.en: To conclude, the company should open a second shop next year.
items.zh: 最後，公司明年應該開第二家店。

items.en: To conclude, I hope this report helps you choose the right course.
items.zh: 最後，希望這份報告能幫助你選到合適的課程。

items.en: To conclude, the council should spend the money on buses, not on new roads.
items.zh: 最後，市議會應該把錢花在公車上，而不是花在新道路上。

items.en: To conclude, I'd say the film is worth seeing, but the book is better.
items.zh: 最後，我會說這部電影值得一看，不過原著更好看。

title: First of all, I must tell you that it always depends on how badly you want to do something.
translation: 首先，我必須告訴你，這始終要看你有多想做一件事。
name: 表示順序的言談標記
sentences: First of all, I must apologise for my late reply.
First of all, let's look at the costs.
We had an awful holiday. First of all, the hotel was fetid and dirty.
First of all, you need to decide what you really want.
Firstly, the plan isn't plausible. Secondly, it would cost too much.
I'm sending the bookshelf back. Firstly, the instructions weren't intelligible. Secondly, two parts were missing.
Firstly, cars cause pollution. Secondly, they make cities noisy. Thirdly, they're expensive to run.
Firstly, I'd like to know the price. Secondly, could you tell me when the course starts?
First, open the box carefully. Next, take out the batteries.
First, we drove to the coast. Then we took a boat to the island.
Mix the flour and sugar. Next, add the milk.
We had lunch in the square. After that, we visited the castle.
Fill in the form. After that, take it to the front desk.
She checked her email. Then she called the client.
Finally, I would like to thank everyone who helped.
Pour the mixture into a tin. Finally, put the cake in the oven for 40 minutes.
Turn off all the lights. Lastly, remember to lock the door when you leave.
Lastly, I want to assert that nobody here acted dishonestly.
First of all, thanks for the lovely present.
Firstly, try to get more sleep. Secondly, eat more vegetables.
Our trip to Italy was perfect. First of all, the weather was great. Secondly, the food was amazing.
Eat well and get some exercise. And lastly, please believe in yourself.
I am writing to complain about my order. Firstly, it arrived two weeks late.
Firstly, there is no evidence. Secondly, the witness's testimony is deceptive.
Finally, I would be grateful if you could arrange a car from the airport.
Firstly, homework helps students review. Secondly, it teaches them to work alone. Thirdly, it shows teachers who needs help.
First, switch off the power. Next, remove the cover.
First of all, read the questions carefully. Then write your answers.
Boil the water. Then pour it over the tea leaves.
Download the app. After that, create an account.
First, we checked into the hotel. After that, we went for a walk.
He packed his bags. Next, he called a taxi. Finally, he locked the house.

examples.heading: ① first of all

items.en: First of all, I must apologise for my late reply.
items.zh: 首先，我必須為這麼晚回信道歉。

items.en: First of all, let's look at the costs.
items.zh: 首先，我們來看看成本。

items.en: We had an awful holiday. First of all, the hotel was fetid and dirty.
items.zh: 我們的假期糟透了。首先，那家飯店又臭又髒。

items.en: First of all, you need to decide what you really want.
items.zh: 首先，你得決定你真正想要什麼。

examples.heading: ② firstly、secondly 和 thirdly

items.en: Firstly, the plan isn't plausible. Secondly, it would cost too much.
items.zh: 第一，這個計畫不可信。第二，它花費太大。

items.en: I'm sending the bookshelf back. Firstly, the instructions weren't intelligible. Secondly, two parts were missing.
items.zh: 我要把書架退回去。第一，說明書看不懂。第二，少了兩個零件。

items.en: Firstly, cars cause pollution. Secondly, they make cities noisy. Thirdly, they're expensive to run.
items.zh: 第一，汽車造成污染。第二，它們讓城市變吵。第三，養車很貴。

items.en: Firstly, I'd like to know the price. Secondly, could you tell me when the course starts?
items.zh: 第一，我想知道價格。第二，可以告訴我課程什麼時候開始嗎？

examples.heading: ③ first、next、then 和 after that

items.en: First, open the box carefully. Next, take out the batteries.
items.zh: 首先，小心打開盒子。接著，取出電池。

items.en: First, we drove to the coast. Then we took a boat to the island.
items.zh: 首先，我們開車到海邊。然後我們搭船去島上。

items.en: Mix the flour and sugar. Next, add the milk.
items.zh: 把麵粉和糖拌在一起。接著，加入牛奶。

items.en: We had lunch in the square. After that, we visited the castle.
items.zh: 我們在廣場吃午餐。之後，我們去參觀城堡。

items.en: Fill in the form. After that, take it to the front desk.
items.zh: 填好表格。之後，把它拿到櫃台。

items.en: She checked her email. Then she called the client.
items.zh: 她看了電子郵件。然後打電話給客戶。

examples.heading: ④ finally 和 lastly

items.en: Finally, I would like to thank everyone who helped.
items.zh: 最後，我要謝謝每一位幫忙的人。

items.en: Pour the mixture into a tin. Finally, put the cake in the oven for 40 minutes.
items.zh: 把麵糊倒進烤模。最後，把蛋糕放進烤箱烤四十分鐘。

items.en: Turn off all the lights. Lastly, remember to lock the door when you leave.
items.zh: 把燈全部關掉。最後，離開時記得鎖門。

items.en: Lastly, I want to assert that nobody here acted dishonestly.
items.zh: 最後，我要明確表示，這裡沒有人做出不誠實的事。

examples.heading: ⑤ 寫給朋友的信

items.en: First of all, thanks for the lovely present.
items.zh: 首先，謝謝你送的可愛禮物。

items.en: Firstly, try to get more sleep. Secondly, eat more vegetables.
items.zh: 第一，盡量多睡一點。第二，多吃蔬菜。

items.en: Our trip to Italy was perfect. First of all, the weather was great. Secondly, the food was amazing.
items.zh: 我們的義大利之旅很完美。首先，天氣很好。第二，食物很棒。

items.en: Eat well and get some exercise. And lastly, please believe in yourself.
items.zh: 吃好一點，多運動。最後，請相信自己。

examples.heading: ⑥ 正式信件和論說文

items.en: I am writing to complain about my order. Firstly, it arrived two weeks late.
items.zh: 我寫信是要投訴我的訂單。第一，它晚了兩個星期才送到。

items.en: Firstly, there is no evidence. Secondly, the witness's testimony is deceptive.
items.zh: 第一，沒有證據。第二，那位證人的證詞有誤導性。

items.en: Finally, I would be grateful if you could arrange a car from the airport.
items.zh: 最後，如果您能安排一輛車從機場接我，我會很感激。

items.en: Firstly, homework helps students review. Secondly, it teaches them to work alone. Thirdly, it shows teachers who needs help.
items.zh: 第一，作業幫助學生複習。第二，它教學生自己做事。第三，它讓老師知道誰需要幫忙。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說明和指示

items.en: First, switch off the power. Next, remove the cover.
items.zh: 首先，關掉電源。接著，拆下外殼。

items.en: First of all, read the questions carefully. Then write your answers.
items.zh: 首先，仔細讀題目。然後寫下你的答案。

items.en: Boil the water. Then pour it over the tea leaves.
items.zh: 把水煮開。然後把水倒在茶葉上。

items.en: Download the app. After that, create an account.
items.zh: 下載這個應用程式。之後，建立一個帳號。

examples.heading: ⑧ 說過去的事

items.en: First, we checked into the hotel. After that, we went for a walk.
items.zh: 首先，我們辦了飯店入住。之後，我們去散步。

items.en: He packed his bags. Next, he called a taxi. Finally, he locked the house.
items.zh: 他收拾好行李。接著，他叫了計程車。最後，他把房子鎖上。

title: So, what do you think?
translation: 那，你覺得怎麼樣？
name: 言談標記 so 表示總結
sentences: My mum can drive us there. So, we don't need to book a taxi.
The shop closes at eight, and I finish work at seven. So, I'll buy the cake on my way home.
The tickets are twenty pounds each, and there are four of us. So, that's eighty pounds altogether.
We don't use the old printer any more. So, we can give it away.
My parents are away this weekend. So, you can stay at our house.
We had an interminable meeting, and then the trains were late. So, that's why I'm late.
The weather was awful and the hotel was dirty. So, it wasn't a great holiday.
Tom is very frugal. So, don't expect an expensive present from him.
Her reply was rather flippant. So, I don't think she's taking the problem seriously.
He spent all his savings on a new car last month. So, he couldn't come on holiday with us.
I've been ill all week. So, I'm sorry I couldn't come to your party.
I forgot to check the opening times, and the museum was already closed. So, I'm afraid we'll have to go tomorrow.
That's everything about our trip to Scotland. So, now it's your turn to write.
That's my idea for Anna's party. So, what do you think of it?
You've seen both flats now. So, which one do you like best?
The film starts at eight. So, shall we have dinner first?
You've been learning Spanish for a year. So, how is it going?
I've got a dentist's appointment on Friday morning. So, can we meet in the afternoon?
The plan sounds a bit ludicrous to me. So, why do you want to do it?
"I can't find my keys anywhere." "So, how did you get in?"
"I've finished all my exams." "So, you're free all summer!"
"My sister is moving to Canada." "So, you won't see her very often."
"The last bus left ten minutes ago." "So, we'll have to walk."
"I've decided to leave my job." "So, what are you going to do next?"
I finish school at four tomorrow. So, I'll be at the café by half past four.
I'm going to Italy in July. So, I can't come to your wedding, I'm afraid.
I've never been to a concert before. So, I'm really excited about Saturday.
We're having a barbecue by the pool on Sunday. So, bring your swimsuit.
I don't know many people in this town yet. So, write to me soon!
It's a surprise party for Anna. So, please be discreet.
I've lived a fairly solitary life since I moved here. So, I'm really glad you're coming to visit.
You said you've just got back from Greece. So, how was your holiday?

examples.heading: ① 總結安排

items.en: My mum can drive us there. So, we don't need to book a taxi.
items.zh: 我媽可以載我們去。所以，我們不用叫計程車。

items.en: The shop closes at eight, and I finish work at seven. So, I'll buy the cake on my way home.
items.zh: 店八點關，我七點下班。所以，我下班回家順路買蛋糕。

items.en: The tickets are twenty pounds each, and there are four of us. So, that's eighty pounds altogether.
items.zh: 票一張二十英鎊，我們有四個人。所以，總共八十英鎊。

items.en: We don't use the old printer any more. So, we can give it away.
items.zh: 我們不再用那台舊印表機了。所以，可以把它送人。

items.en: My parents are away this weekend. So, you can stay at our house.
items.zh: 我爸媽這個週末不在家。所以，你可以住我們家。

examples.heading: ② 總結原因或結果

items.en: We had an interminable meeting, and then the trains were late. So, that's why I'm late.
items.zh: 我們開了一場開不完的會，然後火車又誤點。所以我才遲到。

items.en: The weather was awful and the hotel was dirty. So, it wasn't a great holiday.
items.zh: 天氣很糟，飯店又髒。所以，那不算是一趟好的假期。

items.en: Tom is very frugal. So, don't expect an expensive present from him.
items.zh: Tom 很節儉。所以，別指望他送你很貴的禮物。

items.en: Her reply was rather flippant. So, I don't think she's taking the problem seriously.
items.zh: 她的回答很輕率。所以，我不覺得她把這個問題當一回事。

items.en: He spent all his savings on a new car last month. So, he couldn't come on holiday with us.
items.zh: 他上個月把存款都花在一台新車上。所以，他沒辦法跟我們去度假。

examples.heading: ③ 說完經過後道歉或收尾

items.en: I've been ill all week. So, I'm sorry I couldn't come to your party.
items.zh: 我整個星期都在生病。所以，很抱歉沒能去你的派對。

items.en: I forgot to check the opening times, and the museum was already closed. So, I'm afraid we'll have to go tomorrow.
items.zh: 我忘了查開放時間，到的時候博物館已經關了。所以，恐怕我們得明天再去。

items.en: That's everything about our trip to Scotland. So, now it's your turn to write.
items.zh: 我們去蘇格蘭的事就是這些了。那，現在換你寫信給我了。

examples.heading: ④ 引出問題

items.en: That's my idea for Anna's party. So, what do you think of it?
items.zh: 這是我對 Anna 派對的想法。那，你覺得怎麼樣？

items.en: You've seen both flats now. So, which one do you like best?
items.zh: 兩間公寓你都看過了。那，你最喜歡哪一間？

items.en: The film starts at eight. So, shall we have dinner first?
items.zh: 電影八點開始。那，我們要不要先吃晚飯？

items.en: You've been learning Spanish for a year. So, how is it going?
items.zh: 你學西班牙文一年了。那，學得怎麼樣？

items.en: I've got a dentist's appointment on Friday morning. So, can we meet in the afternoon?
items.zh: 我星期五早上要看牙醫。所以，我們可以下午見嗎？

items.en: The plan sounds a bit ludicrous to me. So, why do you want to do it?
items.zh: 這個計畫我聽起來有點荒唐。那，你為什麼想做？

examples.heading: ⑤ 對話

items.en: "I can't find my keys anywhere." "So, how did you get in?"
items.zh: 我到處都找不到鑰匙。那你是怎麼進來的？

items.en: "I've finished all my exams." "So, you're free all summer!"
items.zh: 我考完所有的試了。所以你整個暑假都有空了！

items.en: "My sister is moving to Canada." "So, you won't see her very often."
items.zh: 我姊姊要搬去加拿大。那你就不常見到她了。

items.en: "The last bus left ten minutes ago." "So, we'll have to walk."
items.zh: 最後一班公車十分鐘前就開走了。那我們只好走路了。

items.en: "I've decided to leave my job." "So, what are you going to do next?"
items.zh: 我決定辭職了。那你接下來打算做什麼？

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫給朋友的信和訊息

items.en: I finish school at four tomorrow. So, I'll be at the café by half past four.
items.zh: 我明天四點放學。所以，我四點半前會到咖啡店。

items.en: I'm going to Italy in July. So, I can't come to your wedding, I'm afraid.
items.zh: 我七月要去義大利。所以，恐怕我沒辦法去你的婚禮。

items.en: I've never been to a concert before. So, I'm really excited about Saturday.
items.zh: 我以前從來沒去過演唱會。所以，我很期待星期六。

items.en: We're having a barbecue by the pool on Sunday. So, bring your swimsuit.
items.zh: 我們星期天要在泳池邊烤肉。所以，帶你的泳衣來。

items.en: I don't know many people in this town yet. So, write to me soon!
items.zh: 我在這個鎮上還不認識幾個人。所以，快點寫信給我！

items.en: It's a surprise party for Anna. So, please be discreet.
items.zh: 這是給 Anna 的驚喜派對。所以，請別說出去。

items.en: I've lived a fairly solitary life since I moved here. So, I'm really glad you're coming to visit.
items.zh: 我搬來這裡以後過得滿孤單的。所以，我很高興你要來看我。

items.en: You said you've just got back from Greece. So, how was your holiday?
items.zh: 你說你剛從希臘回來。那，你的假期過得怎麼樣？

title: Consequently, visiting zoos can help people learn about nature.
translation: 因此，參觀動物園可以幫助人們認識大自然。
name: 表示總結的言談標記（正式）
sentences: The bridge is closed for repairs. Therefore, all buses will use the north road.
You have missed three classes. Therefore, you cannot take the final exam.
Our flight leaves at six. Therefore, we should be at the airport by four.
The second plan costs less and takes less time. I therefore recommend it.
The data was collected in only one city; therefore, the results may not apply to the whole country.
The new machines work faster. Thus, the factory can produce more cars each day.
Few people replied to the survey. The findings are thus limited.
The volunteers cleaned the beach every weekend. Thus, the town saved a lot of money.
Students who read every day learn new words quickly; thus, reading helps them write better.
Our main supplier went out of business. Consequently, we had to find a new one.
He did not read the instructions. Consequently, he broke the printer.
The heating broke down in January; consequently, the school closed for a week.
Many young people move to the cities. The villages are consequently getting smaller.
The museum has no lift. Consequently, visitors in wheelchairs cannot reach the top floor.
The hotel is far from the station. Hence, most guests come by taxi.
The old system was slow. Hence, the company decided to replace it.
Fresh fruit is expensive in winter; hence, many families buy frozen fruit.
The film is three hours long, hence the break in the middle.
My sister has a new job in Tokyo, hence her move to Japan.
The town grew up around a market, hence its name, Market Hill.
The company cut its prices. As a result, sales went up by 30%.
I trained every morning for six months. As a result, I finished the marathon in under four hours.
The river flooded last spring. As a result, many farmers lost their crops.
The café started selling breakfast; as a result, it now opens at seven.
The report, therefore, needs more examples.
We have therefore decided to move the meeting to Friday.
The two schools are very different, and parents should thus visit both before they choose.
The rent is high. Most students, consequently, share a flat.
Our team had less time than the others and was therefore unable to finish the project.
The roads were icy, and the police therefore asked drivers to stay at home.
Cars cause most of the pollution in the city. The council should therefore improve public transport.

examples.heading: ① therefore

items.en: The bridge is closed for repairs. Therefore, all buses will use the north road.
items.zh: 橋在整修，不能通行。因此，所有公車都會改走北邊的路。

items.en: You have missed three classes. Therefore, you cannot take the final exam.
items.zh: 你缺了三堂課。因此，你不能參加期末考。

items.en: Our flight leaves at six. Therefore, we should be at the airport by four.
items.zh: 我們的班機六點起飛。因此，我們四點前應該到機場。

items.en: The second plan costs less and takes less time. I therefore recommend it.
items.zh: 第二個方案花費比較少，時間也比較短。因此，我建議採用這個方案。

items.en: The data was collected in only one city; therefore, the results may not apply to the whole country.
items.zh: 資料只在一個城市收集；因此，這個結果不一定適用於全國。

examples.heading: ② thus

items.en: The new machines work faster. Thus, the factory can produce more cars each day.
items.zh: 新機器運作得比較快。因此，工廠每天可以生產更多車子。

items.en: Few people replied to the survey. The findings are thus limited.
items.zh: 回覆問卷的人很少。因此，這些研究結果有限。

items.en: The volunteers cleaned the beach every weekend. Thus, the town saved a lot of money.
items.zh: 志工每個週末都去清理海灘。因此，鎮上省下了很多錢。

items.en: Students who read every day learn new words quickly; thus, reading helps them write better.
items.zh: 每天閱讀的學生學新單字學得很快；因此，閱讀能幫助他們寫得更好。

examples.heading: ③ consequently

items.en: Our main supplier went out of business. Consequently, we had to find a new one.
items.zh: 我們的主要供應商倒閉了。因此，我們必須另外找一家。

items.en: He did not read the instructions. Consequently, he broke the printer.
items.zh: 他沒有看說明書。結果，他把印表機弄壞了。

items.en: The heating broke down in January; consequently, the school closed for a week.
items.zh: 暖氣在一月壞掉了；因此，學校停課一週。

items.en: Many young people move to the cities. The villages are consequently getting smaller.
items.zh: 很多年輕人搬到城市。因此，村子越來越小。

items.en: The museum has no lift. Consequently, visitors in wheelchairs cannot reach the top floor.
items.zh: 博物館沒有電梯。因此，坐輪椅的參觀者到不了頂樓。

examples.heading: ④ hence

items.en: The hotel is far from the station. Hence, most guests come by taxi.
items.zh: 飯店離車站很遠。因此，大部分客人都搭計程車來。

items.en: The old system was slow. Hence, the company decided to replace it.
items.zh: 舊系統很慢。因此，公司決定換掉它。

items.en: Fresh fruit is expensive in winter; hence, many families buy frozen fruit.
items.zh: 冬天新鮮水果很貴；因此，很多家庭買冷凍水果。

examples.heading: ⑤ hence + 名詞片語

items.en: The film is three hours long, hence the break in the middle.
items.zh: 這部電影長達三小時，所以中間才有休息時間。

items.en: My sister has a new job in Tokyo, hence her move to Japan.
items.zh: 我姊姊在東京找到了新工作，所以她才搬去日本。

items.en: The town grew up around a market, hence its name, Market Hill.
items.zh: 這個城鎮是在市場周圍發展起來的，所以才叫 Market Hill。

examples.heading: ⑥ as a result

items.en: The company cut its prices. As a result, sales went up by 30%.
items.zh: 公司降價了。結果，銷售額增加了百分之三十。

items.en: I trained every morning for six months. As a result, I finished the marathon in under four hours.
items.zh: 我每天早上訓練，練了六個月。結果，我四小時內就跑完了馬拉松。

items.en: The river flooded last spring. As a result, many farmers lost their crops.
items.zh: 那條河去年春天氾濫。結果，很多農民的作物都沒了。

items.en: The café started selling breakfast; as a result, it now opens at seven.
items.zh: 那家咖啡廳開始賣早餐；因此，現在七點就開門。

examples.heading: ⑦ 放在句中

items.en: The report, therefore, needs more examples.
items.zh: 因此，這份報告需要更多例子。

items.en: We have therefore decided to move the meeting to Friday.
items.zh: 因此，我們決定把會議改到星期五。

items.en: The two schools are very different, and parents should thus visit both before they choose.
items.zh: 這兩間學校很不一樣，因此家長在選擇之前應該兩間都去看看。

items.en: The rent is high. Most students, consequently, share a flat.
items.zh: 房租很高。因此，大部分學生都跟別人合租公寓。

items.en: Our team had less time than the others and was therefore unable to finish the project.
items.zh: 我們這組的時間比其他組少，因此沒辦法完成這個專題。

items.en: The roads were icy, and the police therefore asked drivers to stay at home.
items.zh: 路面結冰，因此警方要駕駛人待在家裡。

items.en: Cars cause most of the pollution in the city. The council should therefore improve public transport.
items.zh: 城裡大部分的污染來自汽車。因此，市議會應該改善大眾運輸。

title: As mentioned above, it might be possible to negotiate better contracts for your company.
translation: 如上所述，或許可以替貴公司談到更好的合約。
name: 指向文中其他部分的言談標記
sentences: As mentioned above, the hotel has free parking for guests.
As mentioned earlier, the meeting room has moved to the third floor.
As stated above, members must pay the club fee by the end of March.
As noted earlier, the new software will save each team about two hours a week.
As discussed above, the main problem with the old bus route is the traffic in the city centre.
As explained earlier, our refund policy does not cover sale items.
As mentioned previously, the library will close for repairs in August.
As shown above, most students prefer to study in the evening.
As stated previously, the company does not share customer details with anyone.
As noted above, the figures in this report are not final yet.
As shown below, the number of visitors doubled between 2019 and 2023.
As explained below, you can pay online or at the front desk.
As described below, each room has a small kitchen and a balcony.
As discussed later in this report, the café could open on Sundays too.
As explained later in this guide, you can change your password at any time.
As explained in Section 3, the survey took place over two weeks.
As shown in the table, women spent more on books than men did.
As noted in my last email, I can only start work in September.
As mentioned in the introduction, this essay compares life in the city and in the countryside.
As stated in the contract, you must clean the flat before you move out.
The opening hours are as follows: Monday to Friday, 9 to 6, and Saturday, 10 to 4.
My reasons for leaving the team are as follows: I have less free time, and I want to focus on my exams.
The prizes for the competition are as follows: first prize, a bike; second prize, a camera.
Please answer the following questions before the interview.
The following students have not handed in their homework yet.
The following is a list of the books you will need for the course.
The following is a summary of what we agreed with the landlord yesterday.
For the full price list, see below.
The training is on 12 June (see above for the address).
Parking is free for guests, but the car park closes at midnight (see below).
If you have any questions about the above, please call me.
I hope the above explains why we cancelled the trip.
Taking the points above into account, I recommend the smaller hotel.
Please check the dates above before you book your flight.
We will discuss all of the above at the next staff meeting.

examples.heading: ① as + 過去分詞 + above、earlier、previously

items.en: As mentioned above, the hotel has free parking for guests.
items.zh: 如上所述，這家飯店替住客提供免費停車。

items.en: As mentioned earlier, the meeting room has moved to the third floor.
items.zh: 如前所述，會議室已經搬到三樓。

items.en: As stated above, members must pay the club fee by the end of March.
items.zh: 如上所述，會員必須在三月底前繳清社費。

items.en: As noted earlier, the new software will save each team about two hours a week.
items.zh: 如前所述，新軟體每週能替每個團隊省下大約兩小時。

items.en: As discussed above, the main problem with the old bus route is the traffic in the city centre.
items.zh: 如上所討論，舊公車路線的主要問題是市中心的交通。

items.en: As explained earlier, our refund policy does not cover sale items.
items.zh: 如前所說明，我們的退款規定不包括特價商品。

items.en: As mentioned previously, the library will close for repairs in August.
items.zh: 如先前所提，圖書館八月會關閉整修。

items.en: As shown above, most students prefer to study in the evening.
items.zh: 如上所示，大部分學生比較喜歡晚上讀書。

items.en: As stated previously, the company does not share customer details with anyone.
items.zh: 如先前所述，本公司不會把顧客資料提供給任何人。

items.en: As noted above, the figures in this report are not final yet.
items.zh: 如上所述，這份報告裡的數字還不是最終的。

examples.heading: ② as + 過去分詞 + below、later

items.en: As shown below, the number of visitors doubled between 2019 and 2023.
items.zh: 如下所示，參觀人數在 2019 到 2023 年之間增加了一倍。

items.en: As explained below, you can pay online or at the front desk.
items.zh: 如下所說明，您可以線上付款，也可以在櫃檯付款。

items.en: As described below, each room has a small kitchen and a balcony.
items.zh: 如下所述，每個房間都有一個小廚房和一個陽台。

items.en: As discussed later in this report, the café could open on Sundays too.
items.zh: 如本報告後面所討論，咖啡廳星期天也可以營業。

items.en: As explained later in this guide, you can change your password at any time.
items.zh: 如本指南後面所說明，您隨時可以更改密碼。

examples.heading: ③ as + 過去分詞 + in + 文件的部分

items.en: As explained in Section 3, the survey took place over two weeks.
items.zh: 如第三節所說明，這份調查進行了兩週。

items.en: As shown in the table, women spent more on books than men did.
items.zh: 如表格所示，女性花在書上的錢比男性多。

items.en: As noted in my last email, I can only start work in September.
items.zh: 如我上一封信所提，我九月才能開始上班。

items.en: As mentioned in the introduction, this essay compares life in the city and in the countryside.
items.zh: 如導言所提，這篇文章比較城市和鄉下的生活。

items.en: As stated in the contract, you must clean the flat before you move out.
items.zh: 如合約所載明，你搬走之前必須把公寓打掃乾淨。

examples.heading: ④ as follows 和 the following

items.en: The opening hours are as follows: Monday to Friday, 9 to 6, and Saturday, 10 to 4.
items.zh: 營業時間如下：星期一到星期五九點到六點，星期六十點到四點。

items.en: My reasons for leaving the team are as follows: I have less free time, and I want to focus on my exams.
items.zh: 我退出團隊的理由如下：我的空閒時間變少了，而且我想專心準備考試。

items.en: The prizes for the competition are as follows: first prize, a bike; second prize, a camera.
items.zh: 比賽的獎品如下：第一名是一台腳踏車，第二名是一台相機。

items.en: Please answer the following questions before the interview.
items.zh: 面試前請回答以下問題。

items.en: The following students have not handed in their homework yet.
items.zh: 以下這幾位同學還沒交作業。

items.en: The following is a list of the books you will need for the course.
items.zh: 以下是這門課需要的書單。

items.en: The following is a summary of what we agreed with the landlord yesterday.
items.zh: 以下是我們昨天跟房東談定的事項摘要。

examples.heading: ⑤ see above 和 see below

items.en: For the full price list, see below.
items.zh: 完整的價目表請見下方。

items.en: The training is on 12 June (see above for the address).
items.zh: 訓練在六月十二日（地址請見上方）。

items.en: Parking is free for guests, but the car park closes at midnight (see below).
items.zh: 住客停車免費，但停車場半夜十二點關閉（請見下方）。

examples.heading: ⑥ the above 和 the points above

items.en: If you have any questions about the above, please call me.
items.zh: 如果您對以上內容有任何疑問，請打電話給我。

items.en: I hope the above explains why we cancelled the trip.
items.zh: 希望以上內容說明了我們為什麼取消這趟旅行。

items.en: Taking the points above into account, I recommend the smaller hotel.
items.zh: 考慮到以上幾點，我推薦那家比較小的飯店。

items.en: Please check the dates above before you book your flight.
items.zh: 訂機票之前，請先確認上面的日期。

items.en: We will discuss all of the above at the next staff meeting.
items.zh: 以上所有內容，我們會在下次員工會議上討論。
