examples.heading: ① opposite / between / behind

items.en: You can't miss it. The bus stop is opposite the hospital.
items.zh: 你一定找得到。公車站在醫院對面。

items.en: I sat between my mother and my aunt at dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐時我坐在我媽媽和我阿姨中間。

items.en: The cat is scared of the vacuum cleaner. She's hiding behind the sofa.
items.zh: 貓怕吸塵器。她躲在沙發後面。

items.en: The kids can play outside. There's a small garden behind our building.
items.zh: 孩子們可以到外面玩。我們大樓後面有一個小花園。

items.en: Are you watching the baseball tonight? The match is between Taiwan and Japan.
items.zh: 你今晚要看棒球嗎？這場比賽是台灣對日本。

items.en: We loved the view from our room. Our hotel was opposite a beautiful old church.
items.zh: 我們很喜歡房間看出去的景色。我們的飯店在一座漂亮的老教堂對面。

examples.heading: ② near / above / along / across

items.en: We go swimming every day in summer. My grandparents' house is near the beach.
items.zh: 我們夏天每天都去游泳。我爺爺奶奶家在海灘附近。

items.en: You don't need your phone to check the time. There's a clock above the door.
items.zh: 你不用看手機看時間。門上方有一個時鐘。

items.en: The weather was lovely, so we walked along the river for an hour.
items.zh: 天氣很好，所以我們沿著河邊走了一個小時。

items.en: When the bell rang, the children ran across the playground.
items.zh: 鐘聲一響，孩子們就跑過操場。

items.en: Take the lift to the fourth floor. My office is on the floor above the gym.
items.zh: 搭電梯到四樓。我的辦公室在健身房上面那一層。

examples.heading: ③ during / before / after

items.en: Please turn off your phone during the concert.
items.zh: 演唱會期間請把手機關掉。

items.en: I don't know how it ended. I fell asleep during the second half of the film.
items.zh: 我不知道結局。我在電影的下半場睡著了。

items.en: Mum said we have to get home before midnight.
items.zh: 媽媽說我們得在半夜以前到家。

items.en: Let's go shopping now. The shops get very busy after five o'clock.
items.zh: 我們現在去買東西吧。五點以後店裡會變得很擠。

items.en: The garden is all wet. It rained heavily during the night.
items.zh: 院子全濕了。夜裡下了很大的雨。

examples.heading: ④ until / by

items.en: We still have time to go in. The museum is open until six.
items.zh: 我們還有時間進去。博物館開到六點。

items.en: Please return the book by next Monday.
items.zh: 請在下星期一以前還書。

items.en: Take the other road to work. The roadworks will continue until the end of March.
items.zh: 走另一條路上班吧。道路施工會持續到三月底。

items.en: The manager needs it for the meeting. The report must be ready by Thursday.
items.zh: 經理開會要用。報告星期四以前要好。

items.en: It was a perfect day. We stayed at the beach until sunset.
items.zh: 那天很完美。我們在海邊待到日落。

examples.heading: ⑤ like / without / about

items.en: Have you met the new girl? Her eyes are green like the sea.
items.zh: 你見過那個新來的女生嗎？她的眼睛像海一樣綠。

items.en: I always pack it when I travel. I can't sleep without my pillow.
items.zh: 我旅行都會帶著它。沒有我的枕頭我睡不著。

items.en: The kids loved TV last night. We watched a programme about elephants.
items.zh: 孩子們昨晚很愛看電視。我們看了一個關於大象的節目。

items.en: Did you make this? This cake tastes like my mother's.
items.zh: 這是你做的嗎？這個蛋糕吃起來像我媽媽做的。

items.en: No milk for me, thanks. I drink my tea without milk.
items.zh: 我不用牛奶，謝謝。我喝茶不加牛奶。

items.en: It's good to see you! Tell me about your new job.
items.zh: 真高興見到你！跟我說說你的新工作。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的情境

items.en: Is there a hotel near the station? I arrive late at night.
items.zh: 車站附近有飯店嗎？我很晚才會到。

items.en: Our neighbours live below us, so please don't jump on the floor.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居住在我們樓下，所以請不要在地板上跳。

items.en: Look, you can see fish swimming below the surface of the water.
items.zh: 你看，可以看到魚在水面下游。

items.en: In summer, there are flowers along the road to the village.
items.zh: 夏天的時候，往村子的路上沿路都是花。

items.en: I always check my email before breakfast.
items.zh: 我都在早餐前看電子郵件。

items.en: We can go for a walk after lunch. The rain will stop by then.
items.zh: 我們午餐後可以去散步。那時候雨就會停了。

title: I will be free at 4 p.m., and we can meet in front of our tennis club.
translation: 我下午 4 點有空，我們可以在我們網球俱樂部前面碰面。
name: 複合介系詞（常用）
sentences: The film starts at half past seven. Let's meet in front of the cinema at seven.
You'll find it easily. There's a big tree in front of my school.
My little sister always wants to sit next to Grandpa.
Can you buy some bread when you post the letter? The bakery is next to the post office.
Did you hear that noise? A taxi stopped in front of our house at midnight.
I like my new room. My desk is next to the window.
Our flat is small, but we live close to the station.
I'm going for a run at lunch. Is your office near to the river?
Bring your swimsuit. The campsite is close to a waterfall.
My grandparents live near to us, so they often pick up the kids from school.
I'm tired of the long drive. I want a flat close to my work.
I hate the gym. I like outdoor sports such as hiking and cycling.
You can buy snacks such as chips and cookies at the counter.

The doctor told me to eat more vegetables such as carrots and spinach.
On our trip to Japan, we visited big cities such as Tokyo and Osaka.

We have to go the long way. The road is closed because of a fallen tree.
I'm trying to drink less sugar. Can I have water instead of soda?
It's a lovely day. Let's walk instead of taking the bus.

When I opened the door, the cat jumped out of the box.
He took his phone out of his pocket and showed me the photo.
You don't need a taxi. There's a bus stop right in front of the hotel.
Guess what? I sat next to a famous actor on the plane.
I can't take him for a walk. My dog won't go out because of the thunder.
I had steak for lunch, so I'll have fish instead of meat tonight.
The park is close to my house, so I go there every day.
Our guide was very late. We waited in front of the museum for an hour.
You'll enjoy it here. Our school offers clubs such as chess and drama.

examples.heading: ① in front of / next to

items.en: The film starts at half past seven. Let's meet in front of the cinema at seven.
items.zh: 電影七點半開始。我們七點在電影院前面碰面吧。

items.en: You'll find it easily. There's a big tree in front of my school.
items.zh: 你很容易找到。我學校前面有一棵大樹。

items.en: My little sister always wants to sit next to Grandpa.
items.zh: 我妹妹總是想坐在爺爺旁邊。

items.en: Can you buy some bread when you post the letter? The bakery is next to the post office.
items.zh: 你寄信的時候可以順便買麵包嗎？麵包店在郵局旁邊。

items.en: Did you hear that noise? A taxi stopped in front of our house at midnight.
items.zh: 你有聽到那個聲音嗎？半夜有一輛計程車停在我們家前面。

items.en: I like my new room. My desk is next to the window.
items.zh: 我喜歡我的新房間。我的書桌在窗戶旁邊。

examples.heading: ② near to / close to

items.en: Our flat is small, but we live close to the station.
items.zh: 我們的公寓很小，但是住得離車站很近。

items.en: I'm going for a run at lunch. Is your office near to the river?
items.zh: 我午餐時間要去跑步。你的辦公室在河邊附近嗎？

items.en: Bring your swimsuit. The campsite is close to a waterfall.
items.zh: 帶你的泳衣。營地離一座瀑布很近。

items.en: My grandparents live near to us, so they often pick up the kids from school.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶住在我們家附近，所以他們常去學校接孩子。

items.en: I'm tired of the long drive. I want a flat close to my work.
items.zh: 我受夠了每天開那麼久的車。我想要一間離公司近的公寓。

examples.heading: ③ such as

items.en: I hate the gym. I like outdoor sports such as hiking and cycling.
items.zh: 我討厭健身房。我喜歡戶外運動，像是健行和騎腳踏車。

items.en: You can buy snacks such as chips and cookies at the counter.
items.zh: 你可以在櫃台買零食，像是洋芋片和餅乾。

items.en: Our new guide is great. She speaks several languages, such as French and Japanese.
items.zh: 我們的新導遊很棒。她會說好幾種語言，像是法文和日文。

items.en: The doctor told me to eat more vegetables such as carrots and spinach.
items.zh: 醫生叫我多吃一點蔬菜，像是紅蘿蔔和菠菜。

items.en: On our trip to Japan, we visited big cities such as Tokyo and Osaka.
items.zh: 我們去日本旅行的時候，去了一些大城市，像是東京和大阪。

examples.heading: ④ because of / instead of

items.en: Grandma will arrive after lunch. The flight is late because of the fog.
items.zh: 奶奶午餐後才會到。班機因為起霧誤點了。

items.en: We have to go the long way. The road is closed because of a fallen tree.
items.zh: 我們得繞遠路。那條路因為有一棵樹倒了而封閉。

items.en: I'm trying to drink less sugar. Can I have water instead of soda?
items.zh: 我想少喝一點糖。我可以喝水，不要汽水嗎？

items.en: It's a lovely day. Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
items.zh: 天氣很好。我們走路吧，不要搭公車。

items.en: Sorry we missed the start of the meeting. Because of the traffic, we arrived late.
items.zh: 抱歉我們錯過了會議的開頭。因為塞車，我們遲到了。

examples.heading: ⑤ out of 和不同的情境

items.en: When I opened the door, the cat jumped out of the box.
items.zh: 我一開門，貓就從箱子裡跳出來。

items.en: He took his phone out of his pocket and showed me the photo.
items.zh: 他從口袋裡拿出手機，給我看那張照片。

items.en: You don't need a taxi. There's a bus stop right in front of the hotel.
items.zh: 你不用搭計程車。飯店前面就有一個公車站。

items.en: Guess what? I sat next to a famous actor on the plane.
items.zh: 你猜怎麼樣？我在飛機上坐在一位有名的演員旁邊。

items.en: I can't take him for a walk. My dog won't go out because of the thunder.
items.zh: 我沒辦法帶牠去散步。我的狗因為打雷不肯出門。

items.en: I had steak for lunch, so I'll have fish instead of meat tonight.
items.zh: 我午餐吃了牛排，所以今晚要吃魚，不吃肉。

items.en: The park is close to my house, so I go there every day.
items.zh: 公園離我家很近，所以我每天都去。

items.en: Our guide was very late. We waited in front of the museum for an hour.
items.zh: 我們的導遊遲到很久。我們在博物館前面等了一個小時。

items.en: You'll enjoy it here. Our school offers clubs such as chess and drama.
items.zh: 你會喜歡這裡的。我們學校有一些社團，像是西洋棋社和戲劇社。

title: Compared to the campsite job, this one has its advantages.
translation: 跟營地的工作比起來，這份工作有它的好處。
name: 主要子句前的過去分詞子句
sentences: Compared to my old flat, this one is huge.
Compared with last summer, this year has been quite cool.
Compared to the city, life in the village is very slow.
Compared with other students, she learns very quickly.
Compared to driving, the train is much more relaxing.
Compared with the first film, the sequel was disappointing.
Based on the reviews, this restaurant is worth a visit.
Based on my experience, I'd recommend booking early.
Based on the test results, the doctor changed my medicine.
Based on what you've told me, I think you should accept.
Based on the weather forecast, we'll go hiking on Sunday.
Given the traffic, we should leave now.
Given his age, he's in very good health.
Given the circumstances, I think we did quite well.
Given the cost, most people take the bus.
Given the bad weather, the match went ahead surprisingly smoothly.
Located near the station, the café is popular with commuters.
Based in Taipei, the company has offices across Asia.
Built in the 1920s, the bridge still carries heavy traffic.
Designed for small kitchens, the oven fits on any counter.
Made from local wood, the furniture lasts for decades.
Compared to last month, our electricity bill is lower.
Based on last year's sales, we're hiring two more staff.
Given the delays, we expect some compensation.
Surrounded by mountains, the town gets very little wind.
Painted bright yellow, the house is easy to find.
Compared with my brother, I'm quite thrifty.
Founded in 1950, the school has a long history.
Given more time, I could have done a better job.
Set in the 1960s, the film follows a young singer in London.

examples.heading: ① Compared to / with

items.en: Compared to my old flat, this one is huge.
items.zh: 跟我以前的公寓比起來，這間好大。

items.en: Compared with last summer, this year has been quite cool.
items.zh: 跟去年夏天比起來，今年滿涼的。

items.en: Compared to the city, life in the village is very slow.
items.zh: 跟城市比起來，村子裡的生活步調很慢。

items.en: Compared with other students, she learns very quickly.
items.zh: 跟其他學生比起來，她學得很快。

items.en: Compared to driving, the train is much more relaxing.
items.zh: 跟開車比起來，搭火車輕鬆多了。

items.en: Compared with the first film, the sequel was disappointing.
items.zh: 跟第一集比起來，續集令人失望。

examples.heading: ② Based on

items.en: Based on the reviews, this restaurant is worth a visit.
items.zh: 根據評價，這家餐廳值得一去。

items.en: Based on my experience, I'd recommend booking early.
items.zh: 根據我的經驗，我建議早點訂。

items.en: Based on the test results, the doctor changed my medicine.
items.zh: 根據檢查結果，醫生換了我的藥。

items.en: Based on what you've told me, I think you should accept.
items.zh: 根據你跟我說的，我覺得你應該接受。

items.en: Based on the weather forecast, we'll go hiking on Sunday.
items.zh: 根據天氣預報，我們星期天去健行。

examples.heading: ③ Given

items.en: Given the traffic, we should leave now.
items.zh: 考慮到交通狀況，我們應該現在就出發。

items.en: Given his age, he's in very good health.
items.zh: 以他的年紀來說，他身體很好。

items.en: Given the circumstances, I think we did quite well.
items.zh: 在那種情況下，我覺得我們做得還不錯。

items.en: Given the cost, most people take the bus.
items.zh: 考慮到費用，大部分的人都搭公車。

items.en: Given the bad weather, the match went ahead surprisingly smoothly.
items.zh: 考慮到天氣很差，比賽進行得出奇順利。

examples.heading: ④ Located / Based / Built + 地點或時間

items.en: Located near the station, the café is popular with commuters.
items.zh: 那家咖啡店位在車站附近，很受通勤族歡迎。

items.en: Based in Taipei, the company has offices across Asia.
items.zh: 那家公司總部在台北，在全亞洲都有辦公室。

items.en: Built in the 1920s, the bridge still carries heavy traffic.
items.zh: 那座橋建於一九二〇年代，到現在還承載很大的車流量。

items.en: Designed for small kitchens, the oven fits on any counter.
items.zh: 這台烤箱專為小廚房設計，任何流理台都放得下。

items.en: Made from local wood, the furniture lasts for decades.
items.zh: 這些家具用本地的木材做成，可以用好幾十年。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Compared to last month, our electricity bill is lower.
items.zh: 跟上個月比起來，我們的電費比較低。

items.en: Based on last year's sales, we're hiring two more staff.
items.zh: 根據去年的銷售量，我們要再雇兩個員工。

items.en: Given the delays, we expect some compensation.
items.zh: 考慮到延誤，我們希望得到一些補償。

items.en: Surrounded by mountains, the town gets very little wind.
items.zh: 這個小鎮四面環山，很少颳風。

items.en: Painted bright yellow, the house is easy to find.
items.zh: 那棟房子漆成亮黃色，很好找。

items.en: Compared with my brother, I'm quite thrifty.
items.zh: 跟我哥哥比起來，我滿節儉的。

items.en: Founded in 1950, the school has a long history.
items.zh: 那所學校創立於一九五〇年，歷史很悠久。

items.en: Given more time, I could have done a better job.
items.zh: 要是有更多時間，我可以做得更好。

items.en: Set in the 1960s, the film follows a young singer in London.
items.zh: 那部電影的背景設在一九六〇年代，講一位年輕歌手在倫敦的故事。

title: At the end of the day, everything is up to you.
translation: 說到底，一切都由你決定。
name: 固定說法放在句首表示強調
sentences: All in all, the activity week was a great experience.
All things considered, the trip went quite well.

In short, we need more money and more time.
All in all, it was a day to remember.
All things considered, I think we did the right thing.
At the end of the day, we all want the same thing.
At the end of the day, the customer is always right.
When it comes down to it, family is what matters most.
When all is said and done, he's still my brother.
At the end of the day, you have to make your own choices.
When it comes down to it, nobody wants to pay more tax.
Having said that, the food was excellent.
Even so, I'm glad we went.
That said, the price is a bit high for students.
Having said that, I wouldn't go back there.
Even so, we should thank them for their help.
When you think about it, a car costs a lot to run.
Come to think of it, I haven't seen Mark all week.
When you think about it, the old system was simpler.
Come to think of it, she did look a bit tired.
At the end of the day, what else could we do?
When it comes down to it, who really needs a second car?
When you think about it, can we really afford a flat in London?
All things considered, isn't this the best option?
To be honest, I didn't enjoy the film.
As a matter of fact, I've already booked the tickets.
By the way, your package arrived this morning.
In other words, the plan has failed.
Believe it or not, the shop has been open for a hundred years.
On second thoughts, I'll have the fish.

examples.heading: ① 總結

items.en: All in all, the activity week was a great experience.
items.zh: 整體來說，這次的活動週是很棒的經驗。

items.en: All things considered, the trip went quite well.
items.zh: 全面考量之後，這趟旅行還算順利。

items.en: On the whole, the students were happy with the course.
items.zh: 大致上，學生對這門課很滿意。

items.en: In short, we need more money and more time.
items.zh: 總之，我們需要更多錢和更多時間。

items.en: All in all, it was a day to remember.
items.zh: 整體來說，那是值得紀念的一天。

items.en: All things considered, I think we did the right thing.
items.zh: 全面考量之後，我覺得我們做得對。

examples.heading: ② 說出真正的重點

items.en: At the end of the day, we all want the same thing.
items.zh: 說到底，我們要的都一樣。

items.en: At the end of the day, the customer is always right.
items.zh: 說到底，顧客永遠是對的。

items.en: When it comes down to it, family is what matters most.
items.zh: 說穿了，家人才是最重要的。

items.en: When all is said and done, he's still my brother.
items.zh: 不管怎麼說，他還是我哥哥。

items.en: At the end of the day, you have to make your own choices.
items.zh: 說到底，你得自己做決定。

items.en: When it comes down to it, nobody wants to pay more tax.
items.zh: 說穿了，沒有人想多繳稅。

examples.heading: ③ 讓步

items.en: Having said that, the food was excellent.
items.zh: 話雖如此，食物非常好吃。

items.en: Even so, I'm glad we went.
items.zh: 即使如此，我還是很高興我們去了。

items.en: That said, the price is a bit high for students.
items.zh: 話是這麼說，可是這個價錢對學生來說有點高。

items.en: Having said that, I wouldn't go back there.
items.zh: 話雖如此，我不會再去那裡了。

items.en: Even so, we should thank them for their help.
items.zh: 即使如此，我們還是應該謝謝他們的幫忙。

examples.heading: ④ 請對方想一想

items.en: When you think about it, a car costs a lot to run.
items.zh: 你想想看，養一輛車要花很多錢。

items.en: Come to think of it, I haven't seen Mark all week.
items.zh: 這麼說來，我整個星期都沒看到 Mark。

items.en: When you think about it, the old system was simpler.
items.zh: 你想想看，舊的制度比較簡單。

items.en: Come to think of it, she did look a bit tired.
items.zh: 這麼說來，她看起來確實有點累。

examples.heading: ⑤ 後面接問句

items.en: At the end of the day, what else could we do?
items.zh: 說到底，我們還能怎麼辦？

items.en: When it comes down to it, who really needs a second car?
items.zh: 說穿了，誰真的需要第二輛車？

items.en: When you think about it, can we really afford a flat in London?
items.zh: 你想想看，我們真的買得起倫敦的公寓嗎？

items.en: All things considered, isn't this the best option?
items.zh: 全面考量之後，這不就是最好的選擇嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 其他固定說法

items.en: To be honest, I didn't enjoy the film.
items.zh: 老實說，我不喜歡那部電影。

items.en: As a matter of fact, I've already booked the tickets.
items.zh: 事實上，我已經訂好票了。

items.en: By the way, your package arrived this morning.
items.zh: 對了，你的包裹今天早上到了。

items.en: In other words, the plan has failed.
items.zh: 換句話說，這個計畫失敗了。

items.en: Believe it or not, the shop has been open for a hundred years.
items.zh: 信不信由你，這家店已經開了一百年。

items.en: On second thoughts, I'll have the fish.
items.zh: 我再想想，還是點魚好了。

title: Suddenly, the door opened.
translation: 突然，門開了。
name: 副詞放在句首表示強調
sentences: Suddenly, all the lights went out.
Then we heard a loud noise from the kitchen.
Later, I found my wallet under the sofa.
Finally, the rain stopped.
Yesterday I met an old friend at the station.
Now you can open your eyes.
Outside, the street was empty.
Here we can talk without being disturbed.
Upstairs, someone was playing the piano.
Nearby, there's a small park where you can sit.
Downstairs, the kids were watching TV.
Quickly, he wrote down the number.
Slowly, the old man stood up.
Carefully, she lifted the cake out of the box.
Quietly, we closed the door behind us.
Gently, he put the baby down in the bed.
Sometimes I forget to lock the door.
Usually we eat dinner at seven.
Often she works until midnight.
Occasionally, the trains are late.
We looked everywhere. Eventually, we found the cat on the roof.
I knocked twice. Then the door opened.
He read the letter. Suddenly he started to laugh.
It was a long day. Finally, we got home.
She waited by the window. Soon a car stopped outside.
Tomorrow I've got a dentist appointment.
Today I'm working from home.
Next week the shop will be closed.
Soon you'll be able to swim on your own.
Here you can buy fresh bread every morning.
Afterwards we cleaned up the kitchen together.

examples.heading: ① 時間

items.en: Suddenly, all the lights went out.
items.zh: 突然，所有的燈都熄了。

items.en: Then we heard a loud noise from the kitchen.
items.zh: 接著我們聽到廚房傳來一聲巨響。

items.en: Later, I found my wallet under the sofa.
items.zh: 後來，我在沙發底下找到了錢包。

items.en: Finally, the rain stopped.
items.zh: 雨終於停了。

items.en: Yesterday I met an old friend at the station.
items.zh: 昨天我在車站遇到一個老朋友。

items.en: Now you can open your eyes.
items.zh: 現在你可以張開眼睛了。

examples.heading: ② 地點

items.en: Outside, the street was empty.
items.zh: 外面街上空無一人。

items.en: Here we can talk without being disturbed.
items.zh: 在這裡我們可以好好談，不會被打擾。

items.en: Upstairs, someone was playing the piano.
items.zh: 樓上有人在彈鋼琴。

items.en: Nearby, there's a small park where you can sit.
items.zh: 附近有個小公園可以坐坐。

items.en: Downstairs, the kids were watching TV.
items.zh: 樓下，孩子們在看電視。

examples.heading: ③ 方式

items.en: Quickly, he wrote down the number.
items.zh: 他很快地把號碼寫下來。

items.en: Slowly, the old man stood up.
items.zh: 老先生慢慢地站了起來。

items.en: Carefully, she lifted the cake out of the box.
items.zh: 她小心翼翼地把蛋糕從盒子裡拿出來。

items.en: Quietly, we closed the door behind us.
items.zh: 我們輕輕地把身後的門關上。

items.en: Gently, he put the baby down in the bed.
items.zh: 他輕輕地把寶寶放到床上。

examples.heading: ④ 頻率

items.en: Sometimes I forget to lock the door.
items.zh: 有時候我會忘記鎖門。

items.en: Usually we eat dinner at seven.
items.zh: 我們通常七點吃晚餐。

items.en: Often she works until midnight.
items.zh: 她常常工作到半夜。

items.en: Occasionally, the trains are late.
items.zh: 火車偶爾會誤點。

examples.heading: ⑤ 故事裡帶出下一件事

items.en: We looked everywhere. Eventually, we found the cat on the roof.
items.zh: 我們到處找。最後在屋頂上找到了貓。

items.en: I knocked twice. Then the door opened.
items.zh: 我敲了兩下門。接著門就開了。

items.en: He read the letter. Suddenly he started to laugh.
items.zh: 他讀了那封信。突然他笑了起來。

items.en: It was a long day. Finally, we got home.
items.zh: 那天真漫長。我們終於回到家了。

items.en: She waited by the window. Soon a car stopped outside.
items.zh: 她在窗邊等著。不久，一輛車停在外面。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不加逗號

items.en: Tomorrow I've got a dentist appointment.
items.zh: 我明天要去看牙醫。

items.en: Today I'm working from home.
items.zh: 今天我在家工作。

items.en: Next week the shop will be closed.
items.zh: 下週那家店不開。

items.en: Soon you'll be able to swim on your own.
items.zh: 很快你就能自己游泳了。

items.en: Here you can buy fresh bread every morning.
items.zh: 在這裡每天早上都買得到新鮮麵包。

items.en: Afterwards we cleaned up the kitchen together.
items.zh: 之後我們一起把廚房收拾乾淨。

It's a bit sad that the village school has no pupils now.

It's terrible that people throw rubbish in the river.

It's true that I don't call my grandmother enough.

examples.heading: ① 感受：好事

items.en: It's great that you can come to the party.
items.zh: 你能來參加派對，太好了。

items.en: It's nice that your parents live so close.
items.zh: 你爸媽住得這麼近，真好。

items.en: It's wonderful that the whole family was there.
items.zh: 全家人都到了，真是太好了。

items.en: It was lucky that we found a taxi so quickly.
items.zh: 幸好我們那麼快就叫到計程車。

items.en: It's good that you told me before the meeting.
items.zh: 還好你在開會前就跟我說了。

examples.heading: ② 感受：壞事或奇怪的事

items.en: It's a bit sad that the village school has no pupils now.
items.zh: 村裡的小學現在一個學生都沒有，有點令人難過。

items.en: It's strange that she hasn't replied yet.
items.zh: 她到現在還沒回，真奇怪。

items.en: It's terrible that people throw rubbish in the river.
items.zh: 大家把垃圾丟進河裡，真是太糟了。

items.en: It was surprising that so few people came.
items.zh: 來的人那麼少，真令人意外。

items.en: It's annoying that the shop is closed on Mondays.
items.zh: 那家店星期一不開，真討厭。

examples.heading: ③ 真假

items.zh: 很明顯，他沒看那封信。

items.en: It's vital that the doctor knows about your allergy.
items.zh: 醫生一定要知道你會過敏。

examples.heading: ⑥ 省略 that

items.zh: 你好多了，太好了。

items.zh: 沒人跟我們說，真令人難過。

items.zh: 你提到這件事，真巧。

items.en: It's lucky we brought umbrellas.
items.zh: 幸好我們有帶傘。

items.en: It's obvious he likes her.
items.zh: 很明顯他喜歡她。

items.en: It's strange nobody noticed the mistake.
items.zh: 奇怪，竟然沒有人發現那個錯誤。

To begin with, as far as I know, the museum is closed on Mondays.
First and foremost, from my point of view, the town needs a hospital.
To start with, in my experience, online classes are hard to follow.
As a result, sooner or later, the shop will have to close.
In the end, after all that, we missed the last train home.
As it turned out, in the end, the noise was just the wind.
In the end, to our surprise, the shy boy won the speech contest.

examples.heading: ① 突然發生

items.en: All of a sudden, out of nowhere, a dog ran into the road in front of my car.
items.zh: 突然間，不知道從哪裡冒出一隻狗，衝到我車子前面的馬路上。

items.en: All of a sudden, out of the blue, my old roommate called me last night.
items.zh: 昨晚我以前的室友突然打電話給我，完全沒有預兆。

items.en: Late at night, out of nowhere, we heard a loud bang from the kitchen.
items.zh: 深夜時，我們突然聽到廚房傳來一聲巨響。

items.en: All of a sudden, without any warning, the power went off during the exam.
items.zh: 考試考到一半，突然毫無預警地停電了。

items.en: Just then, out of the corner of my eye, I saw someone pick up my bag.
items.zh: 就在那時，我用眼角餘光看到有人拿起我的包包。

items.en: All of a sudden, for no reason at all, the baby started laughing.
items.zh: 寶寶突然無緣無故笑了起來。

examples.heading: ② 總結

items.en: All in all, taking everything into account, I'd say the festival went well.
items.zh: 整體來說，把所有事情都考慮進去，我覺得這次的音樂祭辦得不錯。

items.en: In short, all things considered, the new library is worth the money.
items.zh: 總之，全面考量之後，新的圖書館值得花這筆錢。

items.en: All in all, at the end of the day, a sports centre would help the most people in town.
items.zh: 整體來說，說到底，運動中心能幫到鎮上最多的人。

items.en: On the whole, taking everything into account, the students enjoyed the course.
items.zh: 大致上，把所有事情都考慮進去，學生都很喜歡這門課。

items.en: In the end, all things considered, we decided to stay in our old flat.
items.zh: 最後，全面考量之後，我們決定繼續住在原來的公寓。

items.en: All in all, when all is said and done, it was a good year for the company.
items.zh: 整體來說，歸根究柢，今年對公司來說是不錯的一年。

examples.heading: ③ 補充

items.en: What is more, from my point of view, the bus fares are far too high.
items.zh: 而且，就我看來，公車票價實在太貴了。

items.en: On top of that, to be honest, I don't really like the food there.
items.zh: 再說，老實講，我不太喜歡那裡的食物。

items.en: What's more, in my opinion, the hotel staff were rude.
items.zh: 而且，我覺得那家飯店的員工很沒禮貌。

items.en: Besides, if you ask me, the film was far too long.
items.zh: 再說，要我說的話，那部電影實在太長了。

items.en: In addition, as far as I'm concerned, the park needs more lights at night.
items.zh: 另外，就我來說，公園晚上需要更多路燈。

items.en: On top of that, believe it or not, he forgot his passport again.
items.zh: 更扯的是，信不信由你，他又忘了帶護照。

examples.heading: ④ 轉折

items.en: Having said that, in my opinion, the old system worked better.
items.zh: 話雖如此，我覺得舊的制度比較好用。

items.en: Even so, to be fair, the manager did try to help us.
items.zh: 即使如此，說句公道話，經理確實有試著幫我們。

items.en: On the other hand, to be honest, the city centre is very noisy.
items.zh: 另一方面，老實說，市中心很吵。

items.en: That said, in all honesty, I enjoyed the evening.
items.zh: 話是這麼說，可是老實講，我那晚玩得很開心。

items.en: Still, at the same time, we can't ignore the cost of the project.
items.zh: 不過，同時我們也不能不管這個計畫的花費。

items.en: However, to be fair, the weather was terrible that week.
items.zh: 不過說句公道話，那個星期的天氣真的很糟。

examples.heading: ⑤ 提出第一點

items.en: First of all, in my view, students need more time to rest.
items.zh: 首先，我認為學生需要更多休息的時間。

items.en: To begin with, as far as I know, the museum is closed on Mondays.
items.zh: 首先，就我所知，博物館星期一休館。

items.en: First and foremost, from my point of view, the town needs a hospital.
items.zh: 最重要的是，就我看來，這個鎮需要一家醫院。

items.en: To start with, in my experience, online classes are hard to follow.
items.zh: 首先，照我的經驗，線上課程很難跟上。

examples.heading: ⑥ 結果

items.en: As a result, sooner or later, the shop will have to close.
items.zh: 所以，這家店遲早得關門。

items.en: In the end, after all that, we missed the last train home.
items.zh: 最後，折騰了那麼久，我們還是錯過了回家的末班車。

items.en: As it turned out, in the end, the noise was just the wind.
items.zh: 結果到頭來，那個聲音只是風聲。

items.en: In the end, to our surprise, the shy boy won the speech contest.
items.zh: 最後，出乎我們意料，那個害羞的男孩贏了演講比賽。

title: Outlined below are some essential reasons which justify my choice.
translation: 以下列出幾個支持我這個選擇的重要理由。
name: 過去分詞子句放在句首表示強調（正式）
sentences: Listed below are the dates of this year's meetings.
Shown above is the plan for the new office.
Included below is a list of useful phone numbers.
Outlined in this report are three ways to cut costs.
Printed on the back is a map of the campus.
Hidden under the floor was a box of old letters.
Listed on the next page are the names of all the winners.
Attached is my CV for your consideration.
Enclosed is a cheque for the full amount.
Attached are the minutes of yesterday's meeting.
Enclosed are the tickets you ordered.
Attached is the invoice for March.
Compared with other cities, rent here is quite cheap.
Compared to last year, fewer students applied this term.
Compared with my old job, this one is far less stressful.
Compared to the first book, the sequel was a disappointment.
Based on the feedback, we have changed the menu.
Based on her experience, she was offered the manager's job.
Given the weather, the match will probably be postponed.
Given his age, he did remarkably well in the race.
Given the circumstances, I think we made the right decision.
Built in the 1960s, the bridge now needs major repairs.
Asked to wait outside, the visitors sat down on the steps.
Written in simple English, the book is ideal for beginners.
Shocked by the news, she sat down and said nothing.
Surrounded by mountains, the village is hard to reach in winter.
Made from recycled paper, these bags are good for the environment.
Founded in 1985, the company now employs over 500 people.
Left alone in the house, the dog chewed the sofa.
Exhausted after the long flight, we went straight to bed.
Delighted with the results, the board approved the project.

examples.heading: ① 過去分詞 + 地點 + be + 主詞

items.en: Listed below are the dates of this year's meetings.
items.zh: 以下列出今年的會議日期。

items.en: Shown above is the plan for the new office.
items.zh: 上面是新辦公室的平面圖。

items.en: Included below is a list of useful phone numbers.
items.zh: 下面附上一份常用電話號碼表。

items.en: Outlined in this report are three ways to cut costs.
items.zh: 這份報告列出三種降低成本的方法。

items.en: Printed on the back is a map of the campus.
items.zh: 背面印著一張校園地圖。

items.en: Hidden under the floor was a box of old letters.
items.zh: 地板底下藏著一盒舊信。

items.en: Listed on the next page are the names of all the winners.
items.zh: 下一頁列出所有得獎者的名字。

examples.heading: ② Attached / Enclosed + be + 主詞

items.en: Attached is my CV for your consideration.
items.zh: 隨信附上我的履歷，請您參考。

items.en: Enclosed is a cheque for the full amount.
items.zh: 隨信附上全額的支票。

items.en: Attached are the minutes of yesterday's meeting.
items.zh: 附件是昨天的會議記錄。

items.en: Enclosed are the tickets you ordered.
items.zh: 隨信附上您訂的票。

items.en: Attached is the invoice for March.
items.zh: 附件是三月的發票。

examples.heading: ③ Compared with / to + 主要子句

items.en: Compared with other cities, rent here is quite cheap.
items.zh: 跟其他城市比起來，這裡的房租相當便宜。

items.en: Compared to last year, fewer students applied this term.
items.zh: 跟去年比起來，這學期申請的學生比較少。

items.en: Compared with my old job, this one is far less stressful.
items.zh: 跟我以前的工作比起來，這份工作的壓力小很多。

items.en: Compared to the first book, the sequel was a disappointment.
items.zh: 跟第一本書比起來，續集讓人失望。

examples.heading: ④ Based on / Given + 主要子句

items.en: Based on the feedback, we have changed the menu.
items.zh: 根據顧客的意見，我們改了菜單。

items.en: Based on her experience, she was offered the manager's job.
items.zh: 根據她的經歷，公司請她當經理。

items.en: Given the weather, the match will probably be postponed.
items.zh: 考慮到天氣，比賽可能會延期。

items.en: Given his age, he did remarkably well in the race.
items.zh: 以他的年紀來說，他在比賽中的表現非常好。

items.en: Given the circumstances, I think we made the right decision.
items.zh: 考慮到當時的情況，我覺得我們的決定是對的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 一般動詞的過去分詞 + 主要子句

items.en: Built in the 1960s, the bridge now needs major repairs.
items.zh: 這座橋建於 1960 年代，現在需要大修。

items.en: Asked to wait outside, the visitors sat down on the steps.
items.zh: 訪客被請到外面等，就在台階上坐了下來。

items.en: Written in simple English, the book is ideal for beginners.
items.zh: 這本書用簡單的英文寫成，很適合初學者。

items.en: Shocked by the news, she sat down and said nothing.
items.zh: 聽到這個消息，她嚇得坐下來，一句話都沒說。

items.en: Surrounded by mountains, the village is hard to reach in winter.
items.zh: 那個村子被群山環繞，冬天很難到達。

items.en: Made from recycled paper, these bags are good for the environment.
items.zh: 這些袋子用回收紙做成，對環境很好。

items.en: Founded in 1985, the company now employs over 500 people.
items.zh: 這家公司成立於 1985 年，現在有五百多名員工。

items.en: Left alone in the house, the dog chewed the sofa.
items.zh: 被單獨留在家裡，那隻狗咬壞了沙發。

items.en: Exhausted after the long flight, we went straight to bed.
items.zh: 長途飛行後我們累壞了，一到就直接上床睡覺。

items.en: Delighted with the results, the board approved the project.
items.zh: 董事會對結果很滿意，批准了這個計畫。

title: Not a word was spoken by anyone throughout the journey.
translation: 整趟旅程中，沒有任何人說過一句話。
name: not a 加名詞放在句首（被動語態或倒裝）
sentences: Not a word was spoken during the whole meal.
Not a single seat was left in the theatre.
Not a penny was wasted on the new building.
Not a single mistake was found in her report.
Not a drop of rain had been recorded by the end of July.
Not a shot was fired during the protest.
Not a single question was asked at the end of the talk.
Not a thing was stolen from the house.
Not a sound came from the baby's room.
Not a single car passed us on the mountain road.
Not a soul knew where she had gone.
Not a cloud appeared in the sky all day.
Not a day has passed without him calling me.
Not a word did he say to me all evening.
Not a single penny did they pay back.
Not a single tear did she shed at the funeral.
Not a moment did we waste once the doors opened.
Not a single photo did I take on the whole trip.
Not a scrap of remorse do they show.
Not a single email does he answer on time.
Not a minute do I get to myself these days.
Not a single thing does she throw away.
Not a single complaint have we received this year.
Not a word has she written since the accident.
Not a single word have they changed in the contract.
Not a single book have I finished this month.
Not a cent will I give him.
Not a single word would she listen to.
Not a single drink will I have tonight.
Not a word would he tell us about the plan.
Not a single ticket was sold before the show was cancelled.
Not a single student was absent on the day of the test.

examples.heading: ① Not a + 名詞 + 被動動詞

items.en: Not a word was spoken during the whole meal.
items.zh: 整頓飯吃下來，沒有人說一句話。

items.en: Not a single seat was left in the theatre.
items.zh: 劇院裡連一個空位都沒有。

items.en: Not a penny was wasted on the new building.
items.zh: 新大樓的工程沒有浪費一毛錢。

items.en: Not a single mistake was found in her report.
items.zh: 她的報告裡找不到一個錯誤。

items.en: Not a drop of rain had been recorded by the end of July.
items.zh: 到七月底，連一滴雨都沒有記錄到。

items.en: Not a shot was fired during the protest.
items.zh: 抗議期間，一槍也沒開。

items.en: Not a single question was asked at the end of the talk.
items.zh: 演講結束時，連一個問題都沒人問。

items.en: Not a thing was stolen from the house.
items.zh: 房子裡什麼都沒被偷。

examples.heading: ② Not a + 名詞 + 主動動詞

items.en: Not a sound came from the baby's room.
items.zh: 寶寶的房間裡一點聲音都沒有。

items.en: Not a single car passed us on the mountain road.
items.zh: 山路上連一輛車都沒有從我們旁邊經過。

items.en: Not a soul knew where she had gone.
items.zh: 沒有一個人知道她去了哪裡。

items.en: Not a cloud appeared in the sky all day.
items.zh: 一整天天上都沒有出現一朵雲。

items.en: Not a day has passed without him calling me.
items.zh: 他沒有一天不打電話給我。

examples.heading: ③ Not a + 名詞 + did + 主詞

items.en: Not a word did he say to me all evening.
items.zh: 他整晚沒跟我說一句話。

items.en: Not a single penny did they pay back.
items.zh: 他們連一毛錢都沒還。

items.en: Not a single tear did she shed at the funeral.
items.zh: 她在葬禮上一滴眼淚都沒掉。

items.en: Not a moment did we waste once the doors opened.
items.zh: 門一開，我們一刻都沒浪費。

items.en: Not a single photo did I take on the whole trip.
items.zh: 整趟旅行我一張照片都沒拍。

examples.heading: ④ Not a + 名詞 + do / does + 主詞

items.en: Not a scrap of remorse do they show.
items.zh: 他們一點悔意都沒有。

items.en: Not a single email does he answer on time.
items.zh: 他沒有一封電子郵件是準時回覆的。

items.en: Not a minute do I get to myself these days.
items.zh: 我最近連一分鐘自己的時間都沒有。

items.en: Not a single thing does she throw away.
items.zh: 她什麼東西都不丟。

examples.heading: ⑤ Not a + 名詞 + have / has + 主詞

items.en: Not a single complaint have we received this year.
items.zh: 今年我們連一件客訴都沒收到。

items.en: Not a word has she written since the accident.
items.zh: 意外發生以後，她一個字都沒寫過。

items.en: Not a single word have they changed in the contract.
items.zh: 合約他們一個字都沒改。

items.en: Not a single book have I finished this month.
items.zh: 這個月我一本書都沒讀完。

examples.heading: ⑥ Not a + 名詞 + will / would + 主詞

items.en: Not a cent will I give him.
items.zh: 我一分錢都不會給他。

items.en: Not a single word would she listen to.
items.zh: 她一個字都聽不進去。

items.en: Not a single drink will I have tonight.
items.zh: 今晚我一杯酒都不會喝。

items.en: Not a word would he tell us about the plan.
items.zh: 那個計畫他什麼都不肯告訴我們。

examples.heading: ⑦ Not a single + 名詞 + 被動動詞

items.en: Not a single ticket was sold before the show was cancelled.
items.zh: 演出取消前，連一張票都沒賣出去。

items.en: Not a single student was absent on the day of the test.
items.zh: 考試那天，沒有一個學生缺席。

title: In the morning, I go to the beach.
translation: 早上我會去海邊。
name: 介系詞片語放在句首表示強調
sentences: In the evening, my grandparents sit in the garden.
On Saturdays, I play football with my brother.
After dinner, my dad always washes the dishes.
At the weekend, the city centre is very busy.
In 2019, my sister started university.
During the holidays, I worked in a café.
In my town, there are two cinemas.
At school, we have to wear a uniform.
On the left, you can see the old church.
In the kitchen, there's a big table by the window.
At the party, I met a lot of interesting people.
In Japan, people take off their shoes at home.
From your house, take the first turning on the left.
From the airport, it's about an hour by train.
From my window, I can see the sea.
From here, the road goes up the hill.
In my opinion, the book is better than the film.
For me, the best part was the music.
In my experience, small hotels are friendlier.
For most people, the price is too high.
In the summer, it's hot. In the winter, it snows.
On weekdays, I get up at six. On Sundays, I sleep until ten.
In the city, life is fast. In the country, it's much slower.
At home, I speak Spanish. At work, I speak English.
Before the trip, I was nervous. After it, I felt great.
In April we're going to visit my aunt.
At night the streets are very quiet.
On Mondays I have a piano lesson.
After the film we went for a pizza.
In this photo you can see my grandparents.
Near the station there's a good bakery.

examples.heading: ① 時間

items.en: In the evening, my grandparents sit in the garden.
items.zh: 晚上我祖父母會坐在花園裡。

items.en: On Saturdays, I play football with my brother.
items.zh: 每個星期六我都跟我哥哥踢足球。

items.en: After dinner, my dad always washes the dishes.
items.zh: 吃完晚餐，我爸都會洗碗。

items.en: At the weekend, the city centre is very busy.
items.zh: 週末時市中心人很多。

items.en: In 2019, my sister started university.
items.zh: 2019 年，我姊姊上了大學。

items.en: During the holidays, I worked in a café.
items.zh: 放假期間，我在一家咖啡館打工。

examples.heading: ② 地點

items.en: In my town, there are two cinemas.
items.zh: 我住的鎮上有兩家電影院。

items.en: At school, we have to wear a uniform.
items.zh: 在學校我們得穿制服。

items.en: On the left, you can see the old church.
items.zh: 左邊可以看到那座老教堂。

items.en: In the kitchen, there's a big table by the window.
items.zh: 廚房裡窗邊有一張大桌子。

items.en: At the party, I met a lot of interesting people.
items.zh: 在派對上，我認識了很多有趣的人。

items.en: In Japan, people take off their shoes at home.
items.zh: 在日本，大家在家裡會脫鞋。

examples.heading: ③ 起點

items.en: From your house, take the first turning on the left.
items.zh: 從你家出來，在第一個路口左轉。

items.en: From the airport, it's about an hour by train.
items.zh: 從機場搭火車大約一個小時。

items.en: From my window, I can see the sea.
items.zh: 從我的窗戶可以看到海。

items.en: From here, the road goes up the hill.
items.zh: 從這裡開始，路就往山上去。

examples.heading: ④ 看法的來源

items.en: In my opinion, the book is better than the film.
items.zh: 我覺得書比電影好看。

items.en: For me, the best part was the music.
items.zh: 對我來說，最棒的是音樂。

items.en: In my experience, small hotels are friendlier.
items.zh: 就我的經驗，小旅館比較親切。

items.en: For most people, the price is too high.
items.zh: 對大部分的人來說，價格太高了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 比較兩個時間或地點

items.en: In the summer, it's hot. In the winter, it snows.
items.zh: 夏天很熱。冬天會下雪。

items.en: On weekdays, I get up at six. On Sundays, I sleep until ten.
items.zh: 平日我六點起床。星期天我睡到十點。

items.en: In the city, life is fast. In the country, it's much slower.
items.zh: 城市的生活步調很快。鄉下慢多了。

items.en: At home, I speak Spanish. At work, I speak English.
items.zh: 在家我說西班牙文。上班時我說英文。

items.en: Before the trip, I was nervous. After it, I felt great.
items.zh: 出發前我很緊張。回來後我覺得很棒。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不加逗號

items.en: In April we're going to visit my aunt.
items.zh: 四月我們要去看我阿姨。

items.en: At night the streets are very quiet.
items.zh: 晚上街上很安靜。

items.en: On Mondays I have a piano lesson.
items.zh: 每個星期一我都有鋼琴課。

items.en: After the film we went for a pizza.
items.zh: 看完電影我們去吃了披薩。

items.en: In this photo you can see my grandparents.
items.zh: 這張照片裡可以看到我的祖父母。

items.en: Near the station there's a good bakery.
items.zh: 車站附近有一家不錯的麵包店。

title: The only problem is that they are a little too noisy at night.
translation: 唯一的問題是，他們晚上有點太吵了。
name: the 加修飾語加 thing、fact 加 is that

items.en: Where our products are made.

title: We will be waiting for you at the River's Cafe at 6:30.
translation: 我們 6:30 會在 River's Cafe 等你。
name: 未來進行式的肯定句（will、shall）

The minister will be visiting the school next Tuesday.

The board will be discussing the new budget all afternoon.
Your teacher will be marking the essays over the weekend.
The museum will be closing early on Christmas Eve.
Two professors will be reviewing your dissertation.
The trains will be running every ten minutes during the festival.
Our staff will be wearing green shirts, so you can find them easily.

The doctors will be operating on him for about three hours.

The builders will be furnishing the flats with new kitchens.
The company will be launching its new app in the autumn.
I shall be attending class the day after tomorrow.
We shall be travelling through France in May.
I shall be thinking of you all on Friday.
We shall be leaving at dawn, so pack your bags tonight.
I shall be working at home for the rest of the week.

I shall be speaking to your parents this evening.
We shall be celebrating our fiftieth anniversary in July.
We'll be landing in about twenty minutes.
She'll be studying abroad next year.
They'll be playing at home on Saturday.
I'll be keeping an eye on the kids while you're out.
He'll be joining us later for dessert.
You'll be hearing from our lawyer soon.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will be + 動詞-ing

items.en: Our guide will be meeting you at the hotel entrance.
items.zh: 我們的導遊會在飯店門口和你會合。

items.en: The minister will be visiting the school next Tuesday.
items.zh: 部長下星期二會來參觀學校。

items.en: Passengers will be boarding through gate twelve.
items.zh: 乘客會從十二號登機門登機。

items.en: The board will be discussing the new budget all afternoon.
items.zh: 董事會整個下午都會在討論新的預算。

items.en: Your teacher will be marking the essays over the weekend.
items.zh: 你們老師週末會在改作文。

items.en: The museum will be closing early on Christmas Eve.
items.zh: 博物館平安夜會提早關門。

items.en: Two professors will be reviewing your dissertation.
items.zh: 兩位教授會審查你的論文。

items.en: The trains will be running every ten minutes during the festival.
items.zh: 節慶期間火車每十分鐘一班。

items.en: Our staff will be wearing green shirts, so you can find them easily.
items.zh: 我們的工作人員會穿綠色上衣，所以你很容易找到他們。

items.en: The new manager will be starting on the first of June.
items.zh: 新經理六月一日會開始上班。

items.en: Ann will be giving the opening speech.
items.zh: Ann 會發表開幕致詞。

items.en: The doctors will be operating on him for about three hours.
items.zh: 醫生會替他動大約三個小時的手術。

items.en: You will be sharing a room with two other students.
items.zh: 你會和另外兩個學生共住一間房。

items.en: The builders will be furnishing the flats with new kitchens.
items.zh: 建商會替這些公寓裝上新廚房。

items.en: The company will be launching its new app in the autumn.
items.zh: 公司秋天會推出新的應用程式。

examples.heading: ② I / we + shall be + 動詞-ing

items.en: I shall be attending class the day after tomorrow.
items.zh: 我後天會去上課。

items.en: We shall be travelling through France in May.
items.zh: 我們五月會在法國各地旅行。

items.en: I shall be thinking of you all on Friday.
items.zh: 星期五我會想著你們大家。

items.en: We shall be leaving at dawn, so pack your bags tonight.
items.zh: 我們天一亮就要出發，所以今晚把行李收好。

items.en: I shall be working at home for the rest of the week.
items.zh: 這星期剩下的幾天我都會在家工作。

items.en: We shall be holding the meeting in the main hall.
items.zh: 我們會在大禮堂開會。

items.en: I shall be writing to the director about this.
items.zh: 這件事我會寫信給主任。

items.en: We shall be staying in Edinburgh until the end of August.
items.zh: 我們會在 Edinburgh 待到八月底。

items.en: I shall be speaking to your parents this evening.
items.zh: 今天晚上我會跟你父母談一談。

items.en: We shall be celebrating our fiftieth anniversary in July.
items.zh: 我們七月要慶祝結婚五十週年。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 'll be + 動詞-ing

items.en: We'll be landing in about twenty minutes.
items.zh: 我們大約二十分鐘後會降落。

items.en: She'll be studying abroad next year.
items.zh: 她明年會出國念書。

items.en: They'll be playing at home on Saturday.
items.zh: 他們星期六會在主場比賽。

items.en: I'll be keeping an eye on the kids while you're out.
items.zh: 你出去的時候，我會幫你看著孩子。

items.en: He'll be joining us later for dessert.
items.zh: 他晚一點會來跟我們一起吃甜點。

items.en: You'll be hearing from our lawyer soon.
items.zh: 你很快就會收到我們律師的消息。

title: This summer, I will have been working for my company for three years.
translation: 到今年夏天，我在公司就工作滿三年了。
name: 未來完成進行式的肯定句
sentences: By next spring my uncle will have been farming this land for fifty years.
By June the band will have been touring for eight months.
Next month the factory will have been making bikes for half a century.
By the end of the year, she will have been teaching for twenty years.
In May my parents will have been running their bakery for thirty years.
By Friday the workers will have been repairing the road for a month.
By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for two hours.
Next year the shop will have been selling books for a century.
By midnight the doctors will have been operating for ten hours.
In April he will have been writing his dissertation for two years.
By the time the rain stops, it will have been raining for a week.
Soon the team will have been playing without a win for three months.

In October the museum will have been standing on this spot for two hundred years.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will have been + 動詞-ing

items.en: By next spring my uncle will have been farming this land for fifty years.
items.zh: 到明年春天，我叔叔耕種這塊地就滿五十年了。

items.en: By June the band will have been touring for eight months.
items.zh: 到六月，樂團巡演就滿八個月了。

items.en: Next month the factory will have been making bikes for half a century.
items.zh: 到下個月，這間工廠做腳踏車就滿半世紀了。

items.en: By the end of the year, she will have been teaching for twenty years.
items.zh: 到年底，她教書就滿二十年了。

items.zh: 到五月，我爸媽經營麵包店就滿三十年了。

items.zh: 到星期五，工人修這條路就修了一個月了。

items.zh: 等你到的時候，我已經等了兩個小時了。

items.zh: 到明年，這家店賣書就賣了一百年了。

items.en: By midnight the doctors will have been operating for ten hours.
items.zh: 到半夜，醫生就已經動了十個小時的手術。

items.zh: 到四月，他寫論文就寫了兩年了。

items.zh: 等雨停的時候，就已經下了一個星期了。

items.en: Soon the team will have been playing without a win for three months.
items.zh: 球隊很快就要滿三個月沒贏球了。

items.en: By Christmas Tom will have been working on the treatise for a decade.
items.zh: 到聖誕節，Tom 寫這部專論就寫了十年了。

items.en: In October the museum will have been standing on this spot for two hundred years.
items.zh: 到十月，這座博物館矗立在這裡就滿兩百年了。

items.en: By the end of the course the students will have been practising for six months.
items.zh: 到課程結束，學生們就練習了六個月了。

items.en: Next week Ann will have been running the company for five years.
items.zh: 到下星期，Ann 經營這家公司就滿五年了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 'll have been + 動詞-ing

items.en: By noon I'll have been sitting in this office for five hours.
items.zh: 到中午，我就已經在這間辦公室坐了五個小時。

items.en: By the time we land, we'll have been travelling for a whole day.
items.zh: 等我們降落的時候，我們就已經旅行了一整天。

items.zh: 到七月，我們交往就滿一年了。

items.zh: 等他退休的時候，他在這裡就工作四十年了。

items.zh: 到下學期，我學鋼琴就滿三年了。

items.zh: 到午餐時間，他們就已經談了四個小時。

items.en: Soon she'll have been travelling around Asia for half a year.
items.zh: 她在亞洲旅行很快就滿半年了。

items.en: By the time we get there, we'll have been walking all day.
items.zh: 等我們到那裡的時候，我們就已經走了一整天了。

items.en: On Saturday I'll have been training for this race for six months.
items.zh: 到星期六，我為這場比賽就已經訓練了六個月。

items.en: By the summer you'll have been living in Taipei for ten years.
items.zh: 到夏天，你住在台北就滿十年了。

items.en: In March they'll have been building the bridge for two years.
items.zh: 到三月，他們蓋這座橋就蓋了兩年了。

items.en: By the end of today I'll have been answering emails for nine hours.
items.zh: 到今天結束，我就已經回了九個小時的電子郵件。

items.en: Next spring we'll have been running this café for five years.
items.zh: 到明年春天，我們開這家咖啡店就滿五年了。

items.zh: 到今晚，她照顧寶寶就已經十二個小時了。

items.en: In a few minutes he'll have been speaking for an hour.
items.zh: 再過幾分鐘，他就已經講了一個小時了。

title: I'm sure I will have learned today's lesson by the next lesson.

sentences: It seems that the role of clothes as decoration will have disappeared by 2050.

items.zh: 看來到 2050 年，衣服的裝飾作用就已經消失了。

items.zh: 到月底，我們就存夠錢買新沙發了。

items.zh: 到星期五，工人就把屋頂蓋好了。

items.zh: 等你到家的時候，我已經煮好晚餐了。

items.zh: 到明年春天，她就已經搬到倫敦了。

items.zh: 到課程結束，你就已經進步很多了。

items.zh: 到那時候，科學家就已經測試過新藥了。

items.zh: 到我三十歲的時候，我就已經還清學生貸款了。

items.zh: 到夏天，物價就又漲了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + will have + 過去分詞（不規則動詞）

items.zh: 到明年，她就已經寫了三本書。

items.en: The guests will have gone by midnight.
items.zh: 到半夜，客人就都走了。

items.zh: 等電影開始的時候，我們就已經吃過了。

items.zh: 到六月，我在這所學校就教了十年書了。

items.zh: 等我們到山頂的時候，太陽就已經下山了。

items.zh: 到星期一，教授就已經看過你的論文了。

items.zh: 到旅行結束，他們就已經去過十個國家了。

items.zh: 等計程車來的時候，她就已經收好行李了。

items.zh: 明天這個時候，我們就已經到巴黎了。

items.en: They'll have built the new bridge by 2030.
items.zh: 到 2030 年，他們就已經把新橋蓋好了。

items.en: In two hours I'll have driven three hundred kilometres.
items.zh: 再過兩個小時，我就已經開了三百公里。

items.en: You'll have spent all your money by the end of the week.
items.zh: 到週末，你就已經把錢花光了。

items.en: He'll have fixed the car by the time you need it.
items.zh: 等你需要用車的時候，他就已經修好了。

items.en: I am going to visit my grandparents on Sunday.

items.en: My sister is going to study in Canada.
items.zh: 我姊姊要去加拿大念書。

items.en: They are going to paint the kitchen yellow.
items.zh: 他們要把廚房漆成黃色。

items.en: The weather is going to be cold tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天天氣會很冷。

items.en: Our class is going to have a party on Friday.
items.zh: 我們班星期五要辦派對。

items.en: My parents are going to buy a new car.
items.zh: 我爸媽要買新車。

items.en: He is going to cook dinner tonight.
items.zh: 他今晚要煮晚餐。

items.en: The kids are going to play in the garden.
items.zh: 孩子們要在花園裡玩。

items.en: I am going to learn Japanese next year.
items.zh: 我明年要學日文。

items.en: The bus is going to stop at the museum.
items.zh: 公車會停在博物館。

items.en: You are going to love this cake.
items.zh: 你一定會喜歡這個蛋糕。

items.en: Ann is going to sing at the school concert.
items.zh: Ann 要在學校音樂會上唱歌。

items.en: The shop is going to close early today.
items.zh: 那家店今天會提早關門。

examples.heading: ② 縮寫：I'm / he's / she's / it's / we're / you're / they're going to

items.en: I'm going to wear my new jeans on holiday.
items.zh: 我要在度假時穿我的新牛仔褲。

items.en: It's going to snow in the mountains tonight.
items.zh: 今晚山上會下雪。

items.en: We're going to spend the weekend at the beach.
items.zh: 我們週末要去海邊過。

items.en: She's going to call you later.
items.zh: 她晚一點會打給你。

items.en: They're going to move to a new house.
items.zh: 他們要搬新家。

items.en: He's going to be a doctor.
items.zh: 他將來要當醫生。

items.en: I'm going to clean my room after lunch.
items.zh: 我午餐後要打掃房間。

items.en: You're going to need an umbrella.
items.zh: 你會需要一把傘。

items.en: Look at those dark clouds. It's going to rain soon.
items.zh: 你看那些烏雲，很快就要下雨了。

items.en: We're going to watch the football on TV.
items.zh: 我們要看電視轉播的足球賽。

items.en: She's going to have a baby in May.
items.zh: 她五月要生寶寶了。

items.en: I'm going to tell her the truth about the money tonight.
items.zh: 我今晚要跟她說那筆錢的實話。

items.en: They're going to get married next year.
items.zh: 他們明年要結婚。

items.en: He's going to sell his bike.
items.zh: 他要賣掉他的腳踏車。

items.en: We're going to walk to school today.
items.zh: 我們今天要走路去學校。

items.en: I'm going to have a shower.
items.zh: 我要去洗澡。

title: We shall take a bus to the sports center.
translation: 我們會搭公車去運動中心。
name: shall 的肯定句（未來式）
sentences: I shall carry the picnic basket.
I shall wear my blue dress to the dance.
I shall start my new job in October.
I shall see you at the conference on Monday.
I shall stay with my aunt in July.
I shall be twelve in May.
I shall bake a cake for her birthday.
I shall need a new coat for the winter.
I shall tell my parents about it tonight.
I shall be very happy to help.
I shall meet you at the station at six.
I shall read the book on the train.
I shall miss you all very much.
I shall be back before dinner.
I shall phone the doctor in the morning.
We shall drive to the coast on Sunday.
We shall go camping in the hills!
We shall have a party on Saturday.
We shall arrive in London at noon.
We shall play tennis after lunch.
We shall need more chairs for the guests.
We shall visit the castle on the last day.
We shall be in Paris for three days.
We shall eat at the hotel tonight.
We shall send you the tickets by post.
We shall know the results next week.
We shall start the meeting at nine o'clock sharp.
We shall see the new film on Friday.
We shall walk to the beach in the morning.
We shall move to a bigger flat next year.
We shall be sorry to leave this town.

examples.heading: ① I + shall + 原形動詞

items.en: I shall carry the picnic basket.

items.en: I shall wear my blue dress to the dance.
items.zh: 我會穿我的藍色洋裝去舞會。

items.en: I shall start my new job in October.
items.zh: 我十月會開始新工作。

items.en: I shall see you at the conference on Monday.
items.zh: 我們星期一在研討會上見。

items.en: I shall stay with my aunt in July.
items.zh: 我七月會住在我阿姨家。

items.en: I shall be twelve in May.
items.zh: 我五月就十二歲了。

items.en: I shall bake a cake for her birthday.
items.zh: 我會為她的生日烤一個蛋糕。

items.en: I shall need a new coat for the winter.

items.en: I shall tell my parents about it tonight.
items.zh: 我今晚會跟我爸媽說這件事。

items.en: I shall be very happy to help.
items.zh: 我會很樂意幫忙。

items.en: I shall meet you at the station at six.
items.zh: 我六點會在車站跟你會合。

items.en: I shall read the book on the train.
items.zh: 我會在火車上看那本書。

items.en: I shall miss you all very much.
items.zh: 我會很想念你們大家。

items.en: I shall be back before dinner.
items.zh: 我晚餐前會回來。

items.en: I shall phone the doctor in the morning.
items.zh: 我早上會打電話給醫生。

examples.heading: ② We + shall + 原形動詞

items.zh: 我們星期天會開車去海邊。

items.en: We shall go camping in the hills!
items.zh: 我們會去山上露營！

items.en: We shall have a party on Saturday.
items.zh: 我們星期六會辦派對。

items.en: We shall arrive in London at noon.
items.zh: 我們中午會到倫敦。

items.en: We shall play tennis after lunch.
items.zh: 我們午餐後會去打網球。

items.en: We shall need more chairs for the guests.
items.zh: 我們會需要更多椅子給客人坐。

items.en: We shall visit the castle on the last day.
items.zh: 我們最後一天會去參觀城堡。

items.en: We shall be in Paris for three days.
items.zh: 我們會在巴黎待三天。

items.en: We shall eat at the hotel tonight.
items.zh: 我們今晚會在飯店吃飯。

items.en: We shall send you the tickets by post.
items.zh: 我們會把票寄給你。

items.en: We shall know the results next week.
items.zh: 我們下星期就會知道結果。

items.en: We shall start the meeting at nine o'clock sharp.
items.zh: 我們九點整準時開會。

items.en: We shall see the new film on Friday.
items.zh: 我們星期五會去看那部新電影。

items.en: We shall walk to the beach in the morning.
items.zh: 我們早上會走路去海灘。

items.en: We shall move to a bigger flat next year.
items.zh: 我們明年會搬到大一點的公寓。

items.en: We shall be sorry to leave this town.
items.zh: 要離開這個小鎮，我們會很捨不得。

title: I'll come at seven o'clock.
translation: 我七點會到。

The plane will land at six.

My mother will be fifty next month.
The film will start in five minutes.
It will be hot tomorrow.

They'll arrive on Sunday.
It'll rain this afternoon.

We'll walk to the park.

items.zh: 我今天晚上會打電話給你。

items.zh: 那家店明天十點開門。

items.zh: 我媽下個月就五十歲了。

items.en: It will be hot tomorrow.

items.zh: 我們老師星期五會考試。

items.en: The train will arrive at platform two.

items.en: You will love this book.
items.zh: 你一定會喜歡這本書。

items.en: The weather will be nice at the weekend.
items.zh: 週末天氣會很好。

items.en: Dinner will be ready in ten minutes.
items.zh: 晚餐十分鐘後就好了。

items.en: The baby will sleep for two hours.
items.zh: 寶寶會睡兩個小時。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 'll + 原形動詞

items.en: I'll bring some drinks.
items.zh: 我會帶一些飲料來。

items.zh: 我們星期六會去看奶奶。

items.zh: 她很快就到了。

items.zh: 他會幫你寫功課。

items.en: You'll be fine.
items.zh: 你會沒事的。

items.en: I'll wait for you outside.
items.zh: 我在外面等你。

items.en: We'll have lunch at noon.
items.zh: 我們中午吃午餐。

items.en: She'll love the present.
items.zh: 她一定會喜歡這份禮物。

items.en: They'll play football after school.
items.zh: 他們放學後會踢足球。

items.en: I'll be at home all day.
items.zh: 我一整天都會在家。

items.en: He'll be twenty next week.
items.zh: 他下星期就二十歲了。

items.en: It'll get cold in the evening.
items.zh: 傍晚會變冷。

items.en: You'll see her at the party.
items.zh: 你會在派對上見到她。

items.en: We'll walk to the park.
items.zh: 我們會走路去公園。

title: I'll be waiting for you.
translation: 我會等著你。
name: 未來進行式的肯定句
sentences: We will be starting at twelve o'clock this afternoon.
The manager will be waiting for you in the lobby.
My parents will be staying at a hotel near the airport.
The library will be closing in ten minutes.
Professor Lin will be reading our dissertations over the summer.
The workers will be painting the hall all day tomorrow.
Our team will be playing in the final on Sunday.
Tom will be driving through the mountains at that time.
The students will be taking their exam at nine.
The band will be playing until midnight.
Grandpa will be sleeping when you get home.
The shop will be selling the new phone from Friday.
Ms. Chen will be teaching your class next term.

The company will be furnishing the new office next month.
The kids will be swimming in the lake all afternoon.
I'll be sitting near the door, so look for me there.
She'll be working late tonight.
They'll be staying with us next week.
We'll be having dinner when you arrive.
He'll be wearing a blue jacket.
I'll be thinking of you on your big day.
You'll be living in a new city this time next year.

We'll be flying over the ocean at midnight.
I'll be cooking, so just come into the kitchen.
They'll be celebrating all weekend.
You'll be feeling better in a few days.
He'll be travelling around Japan in April.
I'll be working from home on Monday.
Don't call at six. We'll be eating then.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will be + 動詞-ing

items.en: We will be starting at twelve o'clock this afternoon.
items.zh: 我們今天中午十二點開始。

items.en: The manager will be waiting for you in the lobby.
items.zh: 經理會在大廳等你。

items.en: My parents will be staying at a hotel near the airport.
items.zh: 我爸媽會住在機場附近的飯店。

items.en: The library will be closing in ten minutes.
items.zh: 圖書館再十分鐘就要關門了。

items.en: Professor Lin will be reading our dissertations over the summer.
items.zh: Lin 教授暑假會看我們的論文。

items.en: The workers will be painting the hall all day tomorrow.
items.zh: 工人明天一整天都會在油漆大廳。

items.en: Our team will be playing in the final on Sunday.
items.zh: 我們隊星期天會打決賽。

items.en: Tom will be driving through the mountains at that time.
items.zh: 那個時候 Tom 會正在開車穿過山區。

items.en: The students will be taking their exam at nine.
items.zh: 學生九點會在考試。

items.en: The band will be playing until midnight.
items.zh: 樂團會一直演奏到半夜。

items.en: Grandpa will be sleeping when you get home.
items.zh: 你到家的時候爺爺會已經在睡覺了。

items.en: The shop will be selling the new phone from Friday.
items.zh: 這家店星期五開始賣那支新手機。

items.en: Ms. Chen will be teaching your class next term.
items.zh: Chen 老師下學期會教你們班。

items.en: Most people will be watching the game tonight.
items.zh: 今晚大部分的人都會在看比賽。

items.en: The company will be furnishing the new office next month.
items.zh: 公司下個月會替新辦公室添置家具。

items.en: The kids will be swimming in the lake all afternoon.
items.zh: 孩子們整個下午都會在湖裡游泳。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 'll be + 動詞-ing

items.en: I'll be sitting near the door, so look for me there.
items.zh: 我會坐在門邊，你到那裡找我。

items.en: She'll be working late tonight.
items.zh: 她今晚會加班到很晚。

items.en: They'll be staying with us next week.
items.zh: 他們下星期會住在我們家。

items.en: We'll be having dinner when you arrive.
items.zh: 你到的時候我們會正在吃晚餐。

items.en: He'll be wearing a blue jacket.
items.zh: 他會穿一件藍色外套。

items.en: I'll be thinking of you on your big day.
items.zh: 你的大日子那天我會想著你。

items.en: You'll be living in a new city this time next year.
items.zh: 明年這個時候你就住在新的城市了。

items.en: She'll be writing her treatise on the history of tea all winter.
items.zh: 她整個冬天都會在寫那篇關於茶的歷史的專論。

items.en: We'll be flying over the ocean at midnight.
items.zh: 半夜的時候我們會正在飛越海洋。

items.en: I'll be cooking, so just come into the kitchen.
items.zh: 我會在煮飯，你直接進廚房來。

items.en: They'll be celebrating all weekend.
items.zh: 他們整個週末都會在慶祝。

items.en: You'll be feeling better in a few days.
items.zh: 過幾天你就會覺得好一點了。

items.en: He'll be travelling around Japan in April.
items.zh: 他四月會在日本各地旅行。

items.en: I'll be working from home on Monday.
items.zh: 我星期一會在家工作。

items.en: Don't call at six. We'll be eating then.
items.zh: 六點別打來，我們那時候在吃飯。

title: You are not going to believe what I am about to tell you!
translation: 我接下來要跟你說的事，你一定不會相信！
name: 現在式的 be about to
sentences: I'm in a hurry. My class is about to begin.
The train is about to leave, so get on now.
Hurry up! The shop is about to close.
I'm about to go out. Can I call you back?
We're about to have dinner. Do you want to join us?
The plane is about to take off.
Quick, the film is about to start!
She's about to give birth to her second child.
They're about to announce the winner.
Look at those clouds. It's about to rain.
The kettle is about to boil.
I'm about to send the email. Is there anything else to add?
The concert is about to begin. Please take your seats.
My phone is about to die.
The baby is about to fall asleep, so keep your voice down.
We're about to land in Taipei.
He's about to finish his dissertation.
The company is about to launch its new phone.
Listen to what he's about to say.
You won't like what I'm about to show you.
The beauty of the world we are about to destroy is hard to describe.
I know what you're about to ask.
The players who are about to leave the club met the fans.
Think carefully about the decision you're about to make.
I'm not about to give up now.
She's not about to apologize to him.
We're not about to sell the house.
He isn't about to change his mind.
They aren't about to let a child drive the car.
I'm not about to pay that much for a sandwich.
The boss isn't about to give us a day off.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + am / is / are + about to + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm in a hurry. My class is about to begin.
items.zh: 我在趕時間，我的課馬上就要開始了。

items.zh: 火車馬上就要開了，快上車。

items.zh: 快點！店就要關門了。

items.zh: 我正要出門，我等一下回電給你好嗎？

items.en: We're about to have dinner. Do you want to join us?
items.zh: 我們正要吃晚餐，你要一起吃嗎？

items.en: The plane is about to take off.
items.zh: 飛機就要起飛了。

items.en: Quick, the film is about to start!
items.zh: 快點，電影要開始了！

items.en: She's about to give birth to her second child.
items.zh: 她第二個孩子就快生了。

items.en: They're about to announce the winner.
items.zh: 他們馬上就要宣布得獎者了。

items.en: Look at those clouds. It's about to rain.
items.zh: 你看那些雲，馬上就要下雨了。

items.en: The kettle is about to boil.
items.zh: 水壺裡的水就快開了。

items.en: I'm about to send the email. Is there anything else to add?
items.zh: 我正要寄出這封電子郵件，還有什麼要補充的嗎？

items.en: The concert is about to begin. Please take your seats.
items.zh: 音樂會即將開始，請各位就座。

items.en: My phone is about to die.
items.zh: 我的手機快沒電了。

items.en: The baby is about to fall asleep, so keep your voice down.
items.zh: 寶寶快睡著了，說話小聲一點。

items.en: We're about to land in Taipei.
items.zh: 我們即將降落在台北。

items.en: He's about to finish his dissertation.
items.zh: 他的論文快寫完了。

items.en: The company is about to launch its new phone.
items.zh: 這家公司即將推出新手機。

examples.heading: ② 子句裡的 be about to

items.en: Listen to what he's about to say.
items.zh: 聽聽他接下來要說什麼。

items.en: You won't like what I'm about to show you.
items.zh: 你不會喜歡我接下來要給你看的東西。

items.en: The beauty of the world we are about to destroy is hard to describe.
items.zh: 我們即將毀掉的這個世界有多美，很難形容。

items.en: I know what you're about to ask.
items.zh: 我知道你接下來要問什麼。

items.en: The players who are about to leave the club met the fans.
items.zh: 即將離開俱樂部的球員和球迷見了面。

items.en: Think carefully about the decision you're about to make.
items.zh: 你要做的這個決定，好好想清楚。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + am / is / are + not + about to + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm not about to give up now.
items.zh: 我現在絕對不會放棄。

items.en: She's not about to apologize to him.
items.zh: 她才不會跟他道歉。

items.en: We're not about to sell the house.
items.zh: 我們絕對不會賣掉房子。

items.en: He isn't about to change his mind.
items.zh: 他絕對不會改變主意。

items.en: They aren't about to let a child drive the car.
items.zh: 他們絕對不會讓小孩開車。

items.en: I'm not about to pay that much for a sandwich.
items.zh: 我才不會花那麼多錢買一個三明治。

items.en: The boss isn't about to give us a day off.
items.zh: 老闆絕對不會讓我們放一天假。

title: I am due to start work in August.

The next bus is due to leave at half past six.

title: Only when we understand that will we be able to live in better societies.
translation: 只有在我們明白這一點的時候，我們才能生活在更好的社會。
name: only when 子句後的 will 倒裝
sentences: Only when people manage this will they be able to move on with their lives.
Only when something terrible happens will people face reality.
Only when the government listens will things start to change.
Only when you try it yourself will you understand how hard it is.
Only when prices fall will young people be able to buy homes.
Only when both sides agree will the war end.
Only when we lose our health will we realise how important it is.
Only when the results come out will we know who won.
Only when he apologises will she speak to him again.
Only when cities invest in public transport will traffic improve.
Only when the last tree dies will we notice what we have lost.
Only when children feel safe will they learn well.
Only when the factory closes will the town see how much it depended on it.
Only when you leave home will you appreciate your parents.
Only when the economy grows will unemployment fall.
Only when we work together will we solve this problem.
I believe that only when something catastrophic happens will citizens accept that measures must be taken.
I think only when the public complains will the company change its policy.
Many experts believe that only when fuel costs more will people drive less.
She feels that only when women earn the same will society be fair.
I'm convinced that only when he fails will he learn.
We believe that only when schools teach these skills will students be ready for work.
Only when the ice melts can the ships leave the harbour.
Only when you have all the facts should you make a decision.
Only when the patient is stable can the doctors operate.
Only when the bell rings may the students leave the room.
Only when the paint is dry can you put the furniture back.
Only when the contract is signed can we start the project.
Only when you finish your homework can you go out.
Only when the storm passes should the boats go out.
Only when everyone is here can we begin.

examples.heading: ① Only when + 現在簡單式 + will + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Only when people manage this will they be able to move on with their lives.
items.zh: 只有在人們做到這一點的時候，他們才能繼續往前走。

items.en: Only when something terrible happens will people face reality.
items.zh: 只有發生很可怕的事的時候，人們才會面對現實。

items.en: Only when the government listens will things start to change.
items.zh: 只有政府願意傾聽，情況才會開始改變。

items.en: Only when you try it yourself will you understand how hard it is.
items.zh: 只有你自己試過，你才會明白那有多難。

items.en: Only when prices fall will young people be able to buy homes.
items.zh: 只有房價下跌，年輕人才買得起房子。

items.en: Only when both sides agree will the war end.
items.zh: 只有雙方都同意，戰爭才會結束。

items.en: Only when we lose our health will we realise how important it is.
items.zh: 只有失去健康的時候，我們才會明白健康有多重要。

items.en: Only when the results come out will we know who won.
items.zh: 只有結果公布時，我們才會知道誰贏了。

items.en: Only when he apologises will she speak to him again.
items.zh: 只有他道歉，她才會再跟他說話。

items.en: Only when cities invest in public transport will traffic improve.
items.zh: 只有城市投資大眾運輸，交通才會改善。

items.en: Only when the last tree dies will we notice what we have lost.
items.zh: 只有最後一棵樹死了，我們才會發現我們失去了什麼。

items.en: Only when children feel safe will they learn well.
items.zh: 只有孩子覺得安全，他們才會學得好。

items.en: Only when the factory closes will the town see how much it depended on it.
items.zh: 只有工廠關閉時，這個鎮才會發現自己有多依賴它。

items.en: Only when you leave home will you appreciate your parents.
items.zh: 只有離開家的時候，你才會感謝你的父母。

items.en: Only when the economy grows will unemployment fall.
items.zh: 只有經濟成長，失業率才會下降。

items.en: Only when we work together will we solve this problem.
items.zh: 只有我們一起努力，才能解決這個問題。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + think / believe + (that) + only when ... will + 主詞

items.en: I believe that only when something catastrophic happens will citizens accept that measures must be taken.
items.zh: 我相信只有發生災難性的事的時候，市民才會接受必須採取措施。

items.en: I think only when the public complains will the company change its policy.
items.zh: 我認為只有大眾抱怨，公司才會改變政策。

items.en: Many experts believe that only when fuel costs more will people drive less.
items.zh: 很多專家相信，只有燃料變貴，人們才會少開車。

items.en: She feels that only when women earn the same will society be fair.
items.zh: 她覺得只有女性賺得一樣多，社會才會公平。

items.en: I'm convinced that only when he fails will he learn.
items.zh: 我深信只有他失敗了，他才會學到教訓。

items.en: We believe that only when schools teach these skills will students be ready for work.
items.zh: 我們相信只有學校教這些技能，學生才會準備好去工作。

items.zh: 只有病人狀況穩定，醫生才能動手術。

items.zh: 只有鈴響了，學生才可以離開教室。

items.zh: 只有油漆乾了，你才能把家具放回去。

items.en: Only when everyone is here can we begin.
items.zh: 只有大家都到了，我們才能開始。

The new hospital will not have opened by the end of the year.
By the time the meeting starts, the report will not have arrived.
The workers will not have repaired the road by the holiday.
I will not have saved enough money by the summer.
The paint will not have dried by tonight.
By next week, the committee will not have made a decision.
The professor will not have read all the dissertations by Friday.
The company will not have paid the workers by the end of the month.
By the time you land, the storm will not have passed.
The students will not have learned all the words by the test.
By noon the shop will not have sold half its bread.
The doctors will not have received the test results by Monday.
By then, the government will not have changed the law.
The river will not have gone down by morning.
Once we stop for lunch, we won't have done more than forty kilometres.
Don't call at six. I won't have got home yet.
She won't have finished her homework by dinner.
They won't have heard the news by the time we arrive.
By Christmas, we won't have paid off the car.
He won't have woken up by eight.
You won't have seen the film by Saturday, so don't read the review.
I won't have read the book by the next class.
The guests won't have left by eleven.
By then, the kids won't have eaten anything for six hours.
We won't have sold the house by the time the baby comes.
My brother won't have passed his driving test by the summer.
The band won't have recorded the album by the end of the year.
She won't have spent all the money by next week.
By the time the bus comes, I won't have waited long.
You won't have forgotten me by next year, will you?

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will not have + 過去分詞

items.en: The architects will not have finished the plans by the deadline.
items.zh: 到截止日，建築師還沒畫完設計圖。

items.en: The new hospital will not have opened by the end of the year.
items.zh: 到年底，新醫院還不會開幕。

items.en: By the time the meeting starts, the report will not have arrived.
items.zh: 等會議開始的時候，報告還不會送到。

items.en: The workers will not have repaired the road by the holiday.
items.zh: 到假期的時候，工人還沒把路修好。

items.en: I will not have saved enough money by the summer.
items.zh: 到夏天，我還存不夠錢。

items.en: The paint will not have dried by tonight.
items.zh: 到今晚，油漆還不會乾。

items.en: By next week, the committee will not have made a decision.
items.zh: 到下星期，委員會還不會做出決定。

items.en: The professor will not have read all the dissertations by Friday.
items.zh: 到星期五，教授還沒把論文全部看完。

items.en: The company will not have paid the workers by the end of the month.
items.zh: 到月底，公司還不會付工資給工人。

items.en: By the time you land, the storm will not have passed.
items.zh: 等你降落的時候，暴風雨還不會過去。

items.en: The students will not have learned all the words by the test.
items.zh: 到考試的時候，學生們還沒把單字全部學會。

items.en: By noon the shop will not have sold half its bread.
items.zh: 到中午，這家店賣出的麵包還不到一半。

items.en: The doctors will not have received the test results by Monday.
items.zh: 到星期一，醫生還不會收到檢查結果。

items.en: By then, the government will not have changed the law.
items.zh: 到那時候，政府還不會修改法律。

items.en: The river will not have gone down by morning.
items.zh: 到早上，河水還不會退。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + won't have + 過去分詞

items.en: Once we stop for lunch, we won't have done more than forty kilometres.
items.zh: 我們停下來吃午餐的時候，騎的路還不會超過四十公里。

items.en: Don't call at six. I won't have got home yet.
items.zh: 六點別打來，那時候我還沒到家。

items.en: She won't have finished her homework by dinner.
items.zh: 到晚餐時間，她還沒寫完功課。

items.en: They won't have heard the news by the time we arrive.
items.zh: 等我們到的時候，他們還不會聽到這個消息。

items.en: By Christmas, we won't have paid off the car.
items.zh: 到聖誕節，我們還沒付清車貸。

items.en: He won't have woken up by eight.
items.zh: 到八點他還不會醒。

items.en: You won't have seen the film by Saturday, so don't read the review.
items.zh: 到星期六你還沒看那部電影，所以別看影評。

items.en: I won't have read the book by the next class.
items.zh: 到下一堂課，我還沒讀完那本書。

items.en: The guests won't have left by eleven.
items.zh: 到十一點，客人還不會走。

items.en: By then, the kids won't have eaten anything for six hours.
items.zh: 到那時候，孩子們就已經六個小時沒吃東西了。

items.en: We won't have sold the house by the time the baby comes.
items.zh: 等寶寶出生的時候，我們還沒把房子賣掉。

items.en: My brother won't have passed his driving test by the summer.
items.zh: 到夏天，我弟還沒考過駕照。

items.en: The band won't have recorded the album by the end of the year.
items.zh: 到年底，樂團還不會錄完專輯。

items.en: She won't have spent all the money by next week.
items.zh: 到下星期，她還不會把錢花光。

items.en: By the time the bus comes, I won't have waited long.
items.zh: 等公車來的時候，我應該還沒等很久。

items.en: You won't have forgotten me by next year, will you?
items.zh: 到明年你還不會忘了我吧？

title: I am not going to go to school tomorrow.
translation: 我明天不打算去上學。
name: be going to 的否定句

The shop is not going to open on Monday.

It is not going to rain this weekend.

The teacher is not going to give us homework today.
I am not going to eat any more chocolate.
He is not going to finish the report on time.
I'm not going to lend him any more money.
He isn't going to enjoy the long drive to the coast.
They aren't going to win the cup this year.
I'm not going to wait any longer.
She's not going to come to the party.
We aren't going to have enough time.
You're not going to believe this.
The bus isn't going to stop here.
I'm not going to watch TV tonight.
They're not going to move house after all.
It isn't going to be easy.
My brother isn't going to study law.
We're not going to stay long.

There aren't going to be any buses after midnight.
There isn't going to be enough food for everyone.
