examples.heading: ① 主詞 + am / is / are + not + going to + 原形動詞

items.en: I am not going to apply for that job in London.
items.zh: 我不打算應徵倫敦那份工作。

items.en: She is not going to change her mind.
items.zh: 她不打算改變主意。

items.en: We are not going to buy a new car this year.
items.zh: 我們今年不打算買新車。

items.en: The shop is not going to open on Monday.
items.zh: 那家店星期一不會開。

items.en: They are not going to sell the farm.
items.zh: 他們不打算賣掉農場。

items.en: It is not going to rain this weekend.
items.zh: 這個週末不會下雨。

items.en: My parents are not going to let me go to the concert.
items.zh: 我爸媽不會讓我去聽音樂會。

items.en: The teacher is not going to give us homework today.
items.zh: 老師今天不會出功課給我們。

items.en: I am not going to eat any more chocolate.
items.zh: 我不要再吃巧克力了。

items.en: He is not going to finish the report on time.
items.zh: 他沒辦法準時寫完報告。

examples.heading: ② 縮寫：I'm not / isn't / aren't going to

items.en: I'm not going to lend him any more money.
items.zh: 我不打算再借他錢了。

items.en: He isn't going to enjoy the long drive to the coast.
items.zh: 他不會喜歡開那麼長的車去海邊。

items.en: They aren't going to win the cup this year.
items.zh: 他們今年不會贏得獎盃。

items.en: I'm not going to wait any longer.
items.zh: 我不要再等了。

items.en: She's not going to come to the party.
items.zh: 她不會來派對。

items.en: We aren't going to have enough time.
items.zh: 我們不會有足夠的時間。

items.en: You're not going to believe this.
items.zh: 你一定不會相信這件事。

items.en: The bus isn't going to stop here.
items.zh: 公車不會停在這裡。

items.en: I'm not going to watch TV tonight.
items.zh: 我今晚不打算看電視。

items.en: They're not going to move house after all.
items.zh: 他們最後不會搬家了。

items.en: It isn't going to be easy.
items.zh: 這不會很容易。

items.en: My brother isn't going to study law.
items.zh: 我哥不打算念法律。

items.en: We're not going to stay long.
items.zh: 我們不會待很久。

examples.heading: ③ there is not going to be + 名詞

items.en: There is not going to be an adult there to stop you.
items.zh: 那裡不會有大人管你。

items.en: There isn't going to be a school trip in the spring.
items.zh: 春天不會有校外教學。

items.en: There aren't going to be any buses after midnight.
items.zh: 半夜以後不會有公車。

items.en: There isn't going to be enough food for everyone.
items.zh: 食物不會夠所有人吃。

items.en: There's not going to be a test on Friday.
items.zh: 星期五不會考試。

items.en: There aren't going to be many people at the meeting.
items.zh: 會議不會有很多人來。

items.en: There isn't going to be time to see the museum.
items.zh: 不會有時間去參觀博物館。

items.en: There aren't going to be any classes next week.
items.zh: 下星期不會上課。

title: We shall not forget to mention the legal and social consequences of such a merger.
translation: 我們不會忘記提到這種合併在法律和社會上造成的後果。
name: 未來式的 shall not
sentences: We shall not forget to mention the legal side of the plan.
I shall not keep you more than five minutes.
We shall not accept any late applications.
I shall not sign anything before I read it.
We shall not give up until we find the answer.
I shall not be able to attend the meeting on Friday.
We shall not discuss this matter in public.
I shall not make the same mistake again.
We shall not raise our prices this year.
I shall not change my mind.
We shall not send any more students to that school.
I shall not need the car this weekend.
We shall not know the results until June.
I shall not repeat what you told me.
We shall not let you down.
I shan't be late, I promise.
We shan't need the tent after all.
I shan't tell anyone.
We shan't be home for dinner tonight.
I shan't go to the party without you.
We shan't have time to visit the museum.
I shan't be sorry to leave this job.
The tenant shall not paint the walls without permission.
The supplier shall not end the contract early.
Visitors shall not take photographs inside the museum.
The company shall not share your personal data.
Employees shall not accept gifts from suppliers.
The buyer shall not sell the goods to a third party.
Drivers shall not park in front of the gate.
The landlord shall not enter the flat without notice.
Members shall not bring guests on Saturdays.

examples.heading: ① I / we + shall not + 原形動詞

items.en: We shall not forget to mention the legal side of the plan.
items.zh: 我們不會忘記提到這個計畫在法律上的問題。

items.en: I shall not keep you more than five minutes.
items.zh: 我不會耽誤你超過五分鐘。

items.en: We shall not accept any late applications.
items.zh: 我們不會接受任何逾期的申請。

items.en: I shall not sign anything before I read it.
items.zh: 我不會在讀過之前簽任何東西。

items.en: We shall not give up until we find the answer.
items.zh: 找到答案之前，我們不會放棄。

items.en: I shall not be able to attend the meeting on Friday.
items.zh: 我星期五沒辦法出席會議。

items.en: We shall not discuss this matter in public.
items.zh: 我們不會公開討論這件事。

items.en: I shall not make the same mistake again.
items.zh: 我不會再犯同樣的錯。

items.en: We shall not raise our prices this year.
items.zh: 我們今年不會漲價。

items.en: I shall not change my mind.
items.zh: 我不會改變主意。

items.en: We shall not send any more students to that school.
items.zh: 我們不會再送學生去那所學校。

items.en: I shall not need the car this weekend.
items.zh: 我這個週末不會用到車。

items.en: We shall not know the results until June.
items.zh: 我們要到六月才會知道結果。

items.en: I shall not repeat what you told me.
items.zh: 我不會把你告訴我的話說出去。

items.en: We shall not let you down.
items.zh: 我們不會讓你失望。

examples.heading: ② I / we + shan't + 原形動詞

items.en: I shan't be late, I promise.
items.zh: 我不會遲到，我保證。

items.en: We shan't need the tent after all.
items.zh: 我們最後用不到帳篷了。

items.en: I shan't tell anyone.
items.zh: 我不會告訴任何人。

items.en: We shan't be home for dinner tonight.
items.zh: 我們今晚不回家吃晚餐。

items.en: I shan't go to the party without you.
items.zh: 沒有你，我不會去派對。

items.en: We shan't have time to visit the museum.
items.zh: 我們不會有時間去參觀博物館。

items.en: I shan't be sorry to leave this job.
items.zh: 離開這份工作，我不會覺得可惜。

examples.heading: ③ 法律和合約：主詞 + shall not + 原形動詞

items.en: The tenant shall not paint the walls without permission.
items.zh: 房客未經許可不得粉刷牆壁。

items.en: The supplier shall not end the contract early.
items.zh: 供應商不得提前終止合約。

items.en: Visitors shall not take photographs inside the museum.
items.zh: 參觀者不得在博物館內拍照。

items.en: The company shall not share your personal data.
items.zh: 公司不得分享你的個人資料。

items.en: Employees shall not accept gifts from suppliers.
items.zh: 員工不得收受供應商的禮物。

items.en: The buyer shall not sell the goods to a third party.
items.zh: 買方不得將貨品轉售給第三方。

items.en: Drivers shall not park in front of the gate.
items.zh: 駕駛人不得在大門前停車。

items.en: The landlord shall not enter the flat without notice.
items.zh: 房東未經通知不得進入公寓。

items.en: Members shall not bring guests on Saturdays.
items.zh: 會員星期六不得攜帶訪客。

title: Without them, I will not be able to play football.
translation: 少了它們，我就沒辦法踢足球了。
name: will 的否定句（未來式）
sentences: Without my boots, I will not be able to play.
The shop will not open on Sunday.
I will not tell anyone your secret.
We will not have time to see the museum.
The bus will not stop here today.
The sun will not set until nine tonight.
According to the forecast, it will not snow this weekend.
My parents will not let me go.
The train will not leave on time.
I will not forget your help.
They will not be at the meeting.
The doctor will not be in until ten.
You will not be able to park near the stadium.
The pool will not be open in winter.
I will not do that again.
Can you come at seven? I won't be home before then.
She won't be able to come to the party.
Don't worry. It won't hurt.
I won't be long.
He won't like this film.
We won't need our coats today.
They won't know the answer.
You won't believe what happened.
The kids won't have school next Friday.
I won't see you tomorrow.
We won't be able to stay for dinner.
The repairs won't cost much.
She won't be at school on Monday.
We won't go out tonight.
He won't be home for dinner.
You won't find a better price.

items.zh: 我不會跟任何人說你的祕密。

items.en: We will not have time to see the museum.
items.zh: 我們不會有時間去參觀博物館。

items.en: The bus will not stop here today.
items.zh: 公車今天不停這一站。

items.en: The sun will not set until nine tonight.
items.zh: 今晚太陽九點才會下山。

items.en: The train will not leave on time.

items.en: I will not forget your help.

items.en: The doctor will not be in until ten.

items.en: I will not do that again.

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + won't + 原形動詞

items.en: Can you come at seven? I won't be home before then.
items.zh: 你可以七點來嗎？我七點以前不會在家。

items.en: She won't be able to come to the party.
items.zh: 她沒辦法來派對。

items.en: Don't worry. It won't hurt.
items.zh: 別擔心，不會痛的。

items.en: I won't be long.

items.en: You won't believe what happened.
items.zh: 你一定不會相信發生了什麼事。

items.en: The kids won't have school next Friday.
items.zh: 孩子們下星期五不用上學。

items.en: I won't see you tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天不會見到你。

items.en: We won't be able to stay for dinner.
items.zh: 我們沒辦法留下來吃晚餐。

items.en: The repairs won't cost much.
items.zh: 修理費不會很貴。

items.en: She won't be at school on Monday.
items.zh: 她星期一不會去學校。

items.en: We won't go out tonight.
items.zh: 我們今晚不出去。

items.en: He won't be home for dinner.
items.zh: 他不會回家吃晚餐。

items.en: You won't find a better price.
items.zh: 你找不到更便宜的價錢了。

title: I won't be attending your English class next week.
translation: 我下週不會去上你的英文課。
name: 未來進行式的否定句（won't）

Mr. Lee will not be teaching this term.

We will not be accepting any more applications after Friday.
The road will not be reopening before the end of the month.

The shop will not be stocking that brand any longer.
We will not be furnishing the flat, so bring your own bed.
The professor will not be supervising any new dissertations this year.
The ferry will not be running in bad weather.
I won't be coming because my family and I are going to London.
I won't be coming to the party.
She won't be joining us for dinner tonight.
Don't wait up. I won't be getting home until late.

Don't worry, we won't be making any noise.
She won't be using her old laptop anymore.

items.zh: 這家店不會再進那個牌子的貨。

items.en: We will not be furnishing the flat, so bring your own bed.
items.zh: 我們不會替這間公寓配家具，所以自己帶床來。

items.en: The professor will not be supervising any new dissertations this year.
items.zh: 教授今年不會再指導新的論文。

items.en: The ferry will not be running in bad weather.
items.zh: 天氣不好時渡輪不會開。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + won't be + 動詞-ing

items.en: I won't be coming because my family and I are going to London.
items.zh: 我不會去，因為我和家人要去倫敦。

items.en: I won't be coming to the party.
items.zh: 我不會去派對。

items.en: She won't be joining us for dinner tonight.
items.zh: 她今晚不會來跟我們一起吃晚餐。

items.en: Don't wait up. I won't be getting home until late.
items.zh: 不用等我，我會很晚才到家。

items.en: We won't be needing the extra chairs after all.
items.zh: 我們最後用不到那些多的椅子。

items.en: He won't be playing on Saturday because of his knee.
items.zh: 他因為膝蓋的關係，星期六不會上場。

items.en: You won't be seeing much of me this month.
items.zh: 這個月你不太會見到我。

items.en: They won't be staying long, so don't make a big dinner.
items.zh: 他們不會待很久，所以別準備太豐盛的晚餐。

items.en: Sorry, I won't be answering emails while I'm on holiday.
items.zh: 抱歉，我休假期間不會回覆電子郵件。

items.en: The kids won't be going to school tomorrow because of the storm.
items.zh: 因為暴風雨，孩子們明天不會去上學。

items.en: We won't be eating out tonight, because the kids are sick.
items.zh: 我們今晚不會出去吃，因為孩子們生病了。

items.en: Tom won't be driving, so he can have a drink.
items.zh: Tom 不會開車，所以他可以喝一杯。

items.en: I won't be working this weekend for once.
items.zh: 我這個週末難得不用上班。

items.en: My parents won't be travelling abroad this summer.
items.zh: 我爸媽今年夏天不會出國旅行。

items.en: Don't worry, we won't be making any noise.
items.zh: 別擔心，我們不會發出任何噪音。

items.en: She won't be using her old laptop anymore.
items.zh: 她不會再用她的舊筆電了。

title: When we realized it was going to be an extremely hot day, we took water.
translation: 我們發現那天會非常熱，所以帶了水。
name: be going to 的過去式
sentences: We were going to meet at half past eleven, but the bus was late.
I was going to email the photos to Grandma, but the internet stopped working.
He was going to study medicine before he changed his mind.
My parents were going to sell the flat in the city.
The film was going to start at eight.
Everyone knew the match was going to be close.
We could see that the river was going to flood the road.
My sister was going to bake a cake for the wedding.
The children were going to sing a song for their teacher.
I was going to wear my red jacket, but it was too warm.
The company was going to build a hotel on the beach.
You were going to show me your holiday photos.
It was clear that the meeting was going to last for hours.
When I saw the queue, I knew I was going to miss my train.
My grandfather was going to plant apple trees behind the house.
The two teams were going to play again the following week.
I wasn't going to tell anyone about the accident.
We weren't going to stay for dinner, but they asked us to.
She wasn't going to apply for the job at first.
They weren't going to finish the bridge before winter.
The shop wasn't going to give me my money back.
He was not going to let a small injury stop him.
My friends weren't going to wait for me any longer.
It wasn't going to be an easy year for the family.
Were you going to ask your boss for a day off?
Was he going to drive all the way to Scotland?
What were you going to buy with the money?
Where were they going to hold the party?
When was the new library going to open?
How were we going to carry all those boxes?
Who was going to pick up the kids from school?

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was / were + going to + 原形動詞

items.en: We were going to meet at half past eleven, but the bus was late.
items.zh: 我們本來約十一點半見面，可是公車誤點了。

items.en: I was going to email the photos to Grandma, but the internet stopped working.
items.zh: 我本來要把照片寄給奶奶，可是網路斷了。

items.en: He was going to study medicine before he changed his mind.
items.zh: 他改變主意之前，本來要念醫學。

items.en: My parents were going to sell the flat in the city.
items.zh: 我爸媽本來要賣掉城裡的公寓。

items.en: The film was going to start at eight.
items.zh: 電影本來八點開始。

items.en: Everyone knew the match was going to be close.
items.zh: 大家都知道那場比賽會很接近。

items.en: We could see that the river was going to flood the road.
items.zh: 我們看得出來河水會淹到路上。

items.en: My sister was going to bake a cake for the wedding.
items.zh: 我姊本來要為婚禮烤一個蛋糕。

items.en: The children were going to sing a song for their teacher.
items.zh: 孩子們本來要唱一首歌給老師聽。

items.en: I was going to wear my red jacket, but it was too warm.
items.zh: 我本來要穿紅外套，可是天氣太暖了。

items.en: The company was going to build a hotel on the beach.
items.zh: 那家公司本來要在海邊蓋一間飯店。

items.en: You were going to show me your holiday photos.
items.zh: 你本來要給我看你的度假照片。

items.en: It was clear that the meeting was going to last for hours.
items.zh: 很明顯，會議會開好幾個小時。

items.en: When I saw the queue, I knew I was going to miss my train.
items.zh: 我看到排隊的人龍，就知道我會錯過火車。

items.en: My grandfather was going to plant apple trees behind the house.
items.zh: 我爺爺本來要在房子後面種蘋果樹。

items.en: The two teams were going to play again the following week.
items.zh: 兩隊本來下個星期要再比一次。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + wasn't / weren't + going to + 原形動詞

items.en: I wasn't going to tell anyone about the accident.
items.zh: 我本來不打算告訴任何人那場意外。

items.en: We weren't going to stay for dinner, but they asked us to.
items.zh: 我們本來不打算留下來吃晚餐，可是他們要我們留下。

items.en: She wasn't going to apply for the job at first.
items.zh: 她一開始不打算應徵那份工作。

items.en: They weren't going to finish the bridge before winter.
items.zh: 他們在冬天之前不會蓋好那座橋。

items.en: The shop wasn't going to give me my money back.
items.zh: 那家店不打算退錢給我。

items.en: He was not going to let a small injury stop him.
items.zh: 他不打算讓一點小傷阻止他。

items.en: My friends weren't going to wait for me any longer.
items.zh: 我朋友不打算再等我了。

items.en: It wasn't going to be an easy year for the family.
items.zh: 那一年對那家人來說不會好過。

examples.heading: ③ (wh- 疑問詞) + was / were + 主詞 + going to + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Were you going to ask your boss for a day off?
items.zh: 你本來要跟老闆請一天假嗎？

items.en: Was he going to drive all the way to Scotland?
items.zh: 他本來要一路開車到蘇格蘭嗎？

items.en: What were you going to buy with the money?
items.zh: 你本來要拿那筆錢買什麼？

items.en: Where were they going to hold the party?
items.zh: 他們本來要在哪裡辦派對？

items.en: When was the new library going to open?
items.zh: 新圖書館本來什麼時候開幕？

items.en: How were we going to carry all those boxes?
items.zh: 我們本來要怎麼搬那些箱子？

items.en: Who was going to pick up the kids from school?
items.zh: 本來誰要去學校接孩子？

title: Will they be holding any activities at night?

Will we be stopping for a break on the way?
Will your parents be staying for the weekend?
Will the teacher be checking our homework today?
Will you be paying by card or in cash?
Will he be bringing his dog?
Will the professor be reading every dissertation herself?
Will the band be playing any old songs?
What will you be doing in a few years?
Where will you be staying in Rome?
When will the new teacher be starting?
How long will you be waiting there?
What time will the plane be landing?
Which room will we be using for the meeting?
How will you be getting to the airport?
Why will they be closing the road?
What will she be wearing to the wedding?
Where will the kids be sleeping tonight?
How many people will you be inviting?
Who will be driving the van?
Who will be looking after the baby?
Who will be giving the speech at the ceremony?
Who will be taking notes at the meeting?
Won't you be needing a coat?
Won't they be expecting us at six?
Won't she be missing her friends?
Won't you be feeling tired after the flight?
Won't he be finishing work soon?

examples.heading: ① Will + 主詞 + be + 動詞-ing ...?

items.en: Will they be holding any activities at night?
items.zh: 他們晚上會舉辦什麼活動嗎？

items.en: Will you be using the car tomorrow?
items.zh: 你明天會用車嗎？

items.en: Will Ann be joining us for lunch?
items.zh: Ann 會來跟我們一起吃午餐嗎？

items.en: Will the shops be opening on the holiday?
items.zh: 假日那天商店會開嗎？

items.en: Will we be stopping for a break on the way?
items.zh: 我們路上會停下來休息嗎？

items.en: Will your parents be staying for the weekend?
items.zh: 你爸媽週末會留下來嗎？

items.en: Will the teacher be checking our homework today?
items.zh: 老師今天會檢查我們的作業嗎？

items.en: Will you be paying by card or in cash?
items.zh: 你會刷卡還是付現？

items.en: Will he be bringing his dog?
items.zh: 他會帶他的狗來嗎？

items.en: Will the professor be reading every dissertation herself?
items.zh: 教授會親自看每一篇論文嗎？

items.en: Will the band be playing any old songs?
items.zh: 樂團會唱一些老歌嗎？

examples.heading: ② wh- 疑問詞 + will + 主詞 + be + 動詞-ing ...?

items.en: What will you be doing in a few years?
items.zh: 幾年後你會在做什麼？

items.en: Where will you be staying in Rome?
items.zh: 你在羅馬會住在哪裡？

items.en: When will the new teacher be starting?
items.zh: 新老師什麼時候開始上班？

items.en: How long will you be waiting there?
items.zh: 你會在那裡等多久？

items.en: What time will the plane be landing?
items.zh: 飛機幾點會降落？

items.en: Which room will we be using for the meeting?
items.zh: 我們會用哪一間房間開會？

items.en: How will you be getting to the airport?
items.zh: 你要怎麼去機場？

items.en: Why will they be closing the road?
items.zh: 他們為什麼要封路？

items.en: What will she be wearing to the wedding?
items.zh: 她會穿什麼去參加婚禮？

items.en: Where will the kids be sleeping tonight?
items.zh: 孩子們今晚會睡哪裡？

items.en: How many people will you be inviting?
items.zh: 你會邀請多少人？

examples.heading: ③ Who + will be + 動詞-ing ...?

items.en: Who will be driving the van?
items.zh: 誰會開那輛廂型車？

items.en: Who will be looking after the baby?
items.zh: 誰會照顧寶寶？

items.en: Who will be giving the speech at the ceremony?
items.zh: 典禮上誰會致詞？

items.en: Who will be taking notes at the meeting?
items.zh: 會議上誰會做紀錄？

examples.heading: ④ Won't + 主詞 + be + 動詞-ing ...?

items.en: Won't you be needing a coat?
items.zh: 你不會需要外套嗎？

items.en: Won't they be expecting us at six?
items.zh: 他們不是六點等我們嗎？

items.en: Won't she be missing her friends?
items.zh: 她不會想念她的朋友嗎？

items.en: Won't you be feeling tired after the flight?
items.zh: 坐完飛機你不會累嗎？

items.en: Won't he be finishing work soon?
items.zh: 他不是快下班了嗎？

title: Will he have changed?
translation: 他會不會已經變了？
name: 未來完成式疑問句
sentences: Will the kids have grown much by the time we see them again?
Will you have finished the report by Friday?
Will the guests have arrived by the time we get back?
Will they have repaired the road before winter?
Will she have heard the news by then?
Will the shops have closed when the film ends?
Will the bank have approved our loan by Monday?
Will the paint have dried by tomorrow?
Will you have read the book before the next class?
Will the children have eaten when we pick them up?
Will the professor have marked the dissertations by June?
Will the snow have melted by the weekend?
Won't they have left by the time we arrive?
Won't the meeting have finished by four?
Will the town have grown much in ten years?
Will my parcel have arrived before I go on holiday?
How much will you have paid back by next year?
How many books will you have read by the end of the year?
Where will they have moved to by next year?
How long will you have lived here by Christmas?
What will you have done by the time you're thirty?
How far will we have walked by lunchtime?
When will the builders have finished the house?
How many countries will she have visited by the end of the tour?
What will the city have done about the traffic by then?
Who will have scored the most goals by the end of the season?
Who will have won the league by May?
What will have happened to the old house by then?
Who will have taken over the company by next year?
What will have changed in the town when we come back?
Who will have finished first, do you think?

examples.heading: ① Will + 主詞 + have + 過去分詞 ...?

items.en: Will the kids have grown much by the time we see them again?
items.zh: 等我們再見到孩子們的時候，他們會不會已經長大很多？

items.en: Will you have finished the report by Friday?
items.zh: 你星期五前會寫完報告嗎？

items.en: Will the guests have arrived by the time we get back?
items.zh: 等我們回來的時候，客人會已經到了嗎？

items.en: Will they have repaired the road before winter?
items.zh: 冬天以前他們會把路修好嗎？

items.en: Will she have heard the news by then?
items.zh: 到那時候，她會已經聽到消息了嗎？

items.en: Will the shops have closed when the film ends?
items.zh: 電影結束的時候，商店會不會已經關門了？

items.en: Will the bank have approved our loan by Monday?
items.zh: 到星期一，銀行會核准我們的貸款嗎？

items.en: Will the paint have dried by tomorrow?
items.zh: 到明天油漆會乾了嗎？

items.en: Will you have read the book before the next class?
items.zh: 下一堂課以前你會讀完那本書嗎？

items.en: Will the children have eaten when we pick them up?
items.zh: 我們去接孩子的時候，他們會已經吃過飯了嗎？

items.en: Will the professor have marked the dissertations by June?
items.zh: 到六月，教授會改完論文嗎？

items.en: Will the snow have melted by the weekend?
items.zh: 到週末，雪會融化了嗎？

items.en: Won't they have left by the time we arrive?
items.zh: 等我們到的時候，他們不是已經走了嗎？

items.en: Won't the meeting have finished by four?
items.zh: 四點以前會議不是已經結束了嗎？

items.en: Will the town have grown much in ten years?
items.zh: 十年後這個城鎮會不會已經變大很多？

items.en: Will my parcel have arrived before I go on holiday?
items.zh: 我去度假之前，包裹會送到嗎？

examples.heading: ② wh- 疑問詞 + will + 主詞 + have + 過去分詞 ...?

items.en: How much will you have paid back by next year?
items.zh: 到明年，你會還掉多少錢？

items.en: How many books will you have read by the end of the year?
items.zh: 到年底，你會讀完幾本書？

items.en: Where will they have moved to by next year?
items.zh: 到明年，他們會搬到哪裡去？

items.en: How long will you have lived here by Christmas?
items.zh: 到聖誕節，你住在這裡就會滿多久了？

items.en: What will you have done by the time you're thirty?
items.zh: 到三十歲的時候，你會做完哪些事？

items.en: How far will we have walked by lunchtime?
items.zh: 到午餐時間，我們會走了多遠？

items.en: When will the builders have finished the house?
items.zh: 工人什麼時候會蓋好房子？

items.en: How many countries will she have visited by the end of the tour?
items.zh: 到巡迴結束，她會去過幾個國家？

items.en: What will the city have done about the traffic by then?
items.zh: 到那時候，市政府會對交通做了什麼？

examples.heading: ③ Who / What + will have + 過去分詞 ...?

items.en: Who will have scored the most goals by the end of the season?
items.zh: 到球季結束，誰會進最多球？

items.en: Who will have won the league by May?
items.zh: 到五月，誰會已經贏得聯賽冠軍？

items.en: What will have happened to the old house by then?
items.zh: 到那時候，那間老房子會變成什麼樣子？

items.en: Who will have taken over the company by next year?
items.zh: 到明年，誰會已經接手這家公司？

items.en: What will have changed in the town when we come back?
items.zh: 等我們回來的時候，鎮上會有什麼改變？

items.en: Who will have finished first, do you think?
items.zh: 你覺得誰會先完成？

title: What shall I bring to the party?

examples.heading: ① Will + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?

items.zh: 你哥會去參加婚禮嗎？

examples.heading: ② wh- 疑問詞 + will + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?

items.zh: 你放學後要做什麼？

examples.heading: ④ wh- 疑問詞 + shall + I / we + 原形動詞 ...?

items.zh: 晚餐我該煮什麼？

items.en: Where shall we put the Christmas tree?
items.zh: 聖誕樹我們放哪裡好？

items.zh: 我幾點來好？

items.en: What shall we do this weekend?
items.zh: 我們這個週末做什麼好？

items.en: Who shall I ask for help?
items.zh: 我該找誰幫忙？

items.en: How shall we get there?
items.zh: 我們要怎麼去那裡？

title: Sales will possibly have fallen to 5,000 units by the end of the year.
translation: 到年底，銷售量可能已經掉到 5,000 件了。
name: 未來完成式加句中副詞
sentences: By the end of the trip, we will possibly have visited twelve cities.
If you have read his stories, you will surely have discovered why he is famous.
By the time you get this letter, I'll probably have left Japan.
The storm will certainly have passed by the morning.
By next year, prices will definitely have gone up.
The guests will probably have eaten before they come.
By the time we arrive, the film will possibly have started.
By the weekend, the doctor will surely have seen the results.
By the end of the week, the river will probably have risen even more.
By the next election, the voters will probably have changed their minds.
By June we will already have moved to the new flat.
By the time the firefighters arrive, the fire will already have spread.
When you wake up, I'll already have gone to work.
By ten, the shop will already have sold out of bread.
The bus will just have left when we get to the stop.
By the summer, she will already have finished her dissertation.
By the time the guests sit down, I will already have opened the wine.
The meeting will already have begun when the boss arrives.
By the end of the year, I will already have spent my whole holiday allowance.
The train will just have arrived when you get to the platform.
By the time the show ends, the last bus will already have gone.
He probably won't have finished the painting by the exhibition.
The parcel probably won't have arrived by Friday.
They certainly won't have sold the house by June.
The workers probably won't have cleared the roads by the morning.
She definitely won't have heard the news by then.
The kids probably won't have gone to bed when we get home.
The builders certainly won't have finished the roof before the rain.
I probably won't have read the report before the meeting.
The new library possibly won't have opened by the autumn.
We definitely won't have saved enough by the summer.

examples.heading: ① 表示可能性的副詞

items.en: By the end of the trip, we will possibly have visited twelve cities.
items.zh: 到旅行結束，我們可能已經去過十二個城市了。

items.en: If you have read his stories, you will surely have discovered why he is famous.
items.zh: 如果你讀過他的故事，你一定已經發現他為什麼有名。

items.en: By the time you get this letter, I'll probably have left Japan.
items.zh: 等你收到這封信的時候，我大概已經離開日本了。

items.en: The storm will certainly have passed by the morning.
items.zh: 到早上，暴風雨一定已經過去了。

items.en: By next year, prices will definitely have gone up.
items.zh: 到明年，物價一定已經漲了。

items.en: The guests will probably have eaten before they come.
items.zh: 客人來之前大概已經吃過了。

items.en: By the time we arrive, the film will possibly have started.
items.zh: 等我們到的時候，電影可能已經開始了。

items.en: By the weekend, the doctor will surely have seen the results.
items.zh: 到週末，醫生一定已經看到結果了。

items.en: By the end of the week, the river will probably have risen even more.
items.zh: 到週末，河水大概又漲得更高了。

items.en: By the next election, the voters will probably have changed their minds.
items.zh: 到下次選舉，選民大概已經改變主意了。

examples.heading: ② 表示時間的副詞

items.en: By June we will already have moved to the new flat.
items.zh: 到六月，我們就已經搬進新公寓了。

items.en: By the time the firefighters arrive, the fire will already have spread.
items.zh: 等消防員到的時候，火早就蔓延開了。

items.en: When you wake up, I'll already have gone to work.
items.zh: 等你醒來的時候，我已經去上班了。

items.en: By ten, the shop will already have sold out of bread.
items.zh: 到十點，這家店的麵包早就賣光了。

items.en: The bus will just have left when we get to the stop.
items.zh: 我們到站牌的時候，公車應該剛好開走。

items.en: By the summer, she will already have finished her dissertation.
items.zh: 到夏天，她就已經寫完論文了。

items.en: By the time the guests sit down, I will already have opened the wine.
items.zh: 等客人坐下的時候，我就已經把酒開好了。

items.en: The meeting will already have begun when the boss arrives.
items.zh: 老闆到的時候，會議已經開始了。

items.en: By the end of the year, I will already have spent my whole holiday allowance.
items.zh: 到年底，我就已經把年假全部用完了。

items.en: The train will just have arrived when you get to the platform.
items.zh: 你到月台的時候，火車應該剛好進站。

items.en: By the time the show ends, the last bus will already have gone.
items.zh: 等表演結束的時候，最後一班公車早就開走了。

examples.heading: ③ 否定句：副詞 + won't have + 過去分詞

items.en: He probably won't have finished the painting by the exhibition.
items.zh: 到展覽的時候，他大概還沒畫完那幅畫。

items.en: The parcel probably won't have arrived by Friday.
items.zh: 到星期五，包裹大概還不會送到。

items.en: They certainly won't have sold the house by June.
items.zh: 到六月，他們一定還沒把房子賣掉。

items.en: The workers probably won't have cleared the roads by the morning.
items.zh: 到早上，工人大概還沒把道路清理好。

items.en: She definitely won't have heard the news by then.
items.zh: 到那時候，她一定還沒聽到這個消息。

items.en: The kids probably won't have gone to bed when we get home.
items.zh: 等我們到家的時候，孩子們大概還沒上床睡覺。

items.en: The builders certainly won't have finished the roof before the rain.
items.zh: 下雨前，工人一定還沒把屋頂蓋好。

items.en: I probably won't have read the report before the meeting.
items.zh: 開會前我大概還沒讀完報告。

items.en: The new library possibly won't have opened by the autumn.
items.zh: 到秋天，新圖書館可能還沒開放。

items.en: We definitely won't have saved enough by the summer.
items.zh: 到夏天，我們一定還存不夠錢。

title: I know that I'm never going to forget this moment.
translation: 我知道我永遠不會忘記這一刻。
name: be going to 的句中副詞
sentences: I'm never going to speak to him again.
She's never going to believe your story.
This old car is never going to pass the test.
We're never going to find a parking space here.
They are never going to agree with each other.
My little brother is never going to grow up.
We are really going to miss you when you leave.
This is really going to help my English.
I'm definitely going to try that restaurant.
The new road is definitely going to make the journey shorter.
You're really going to love this book.
They're definitely going to win the league this year.
Mum is really going to be angry about the window.
It's probably going to snow tonight.
I'm probably going to stay at home this weekend.
The tickets are probably going to sell out quickly.
He's probably going to call you after lunch.
We're probably going to move to a bigger flat.
She's probably not going to like the colour.
The bus is probably not going to come on time.
I'm just going to check my email.
We're just going to have a quick look around the shop.
Are you still going to drive us to the airport?
She's still going to take the exam in June.
The concert is still going to happen, even in the rain.
My cousins are also going to come to the barbecue.
I'm also going to need a new pair of boots.
I knew I was never going to see her again.
We were definitely going to win until our goalkeeper got hurt.
He was probably going to be late, so we started without him.
The plan was always going to fail.
Moving abroad was always going to be hard for the kids.

examples.heading: ① be + never + going to

items.en: I'm never going to speak to him again.
items.zh: 我再也不要跟他說話了。

items.en: She's never going to believe your story.
items.zh: 她永遠不會相信你的說法。

items.en: This old car is never going to pass the test.
items.zh: 這台老車永遠過不了檢驗。

items.en: We're never going to find a parking space here.
items.zh: 我們在這裡永遠找不到停車位。

items.en: They are never going to agree with each other.
items.zh: 他們永遠不會同意彼此的看法。

items.en: My little brother is never going to grow up.
items.zh: 我弟弟永遠長不大。

examples.heading: ② be + really / definitely + going to

items.en: We are really going to miss you when you leave.
items.zh: 你走了以後，我們真的會很想你。

items.en: This is really going to help my English.
items.zh: 這真的會對我的英文有幫助。

items.en: I'm definitely going to try that restaurant.
items.zh: 我一定要去試試那家餐廳。

items.en: The new road is definitely going to make the journey shorter.
items.zh: 新路一定會讓路程變短。

items.en: You're really going to love this book.
items.zh: 你真的會很喜歡這本書。

items.en: They're definitely going to win the league this year.
items.zh: 他們今年一定會拿到聯賽冠軍。

items.en: Mum is really going to be angry about the window.
items.zh: 媽媽真的會為了那扇窗戶生氣。

examples.heading: ③ be + probably + going to

items.en: It's probably going to snow tonight.
items.zh: 今晚可能會下雪。

items.en: I'm probably going to stay at home this weekend.
items.zh: 我這個週末可能會待在家。

items.en: The tickets are probably going to sell out quickly.
items.zh: 票可能很快就會賣完。

items.en: He's probably going to call you after lunch.
items.zh: 他可能午餐後會打給你。

items.en: We're probably going to move to a bigger flat.
items.zh: 我們可能會搬到大一點的公寓。

items.en: She's probably not going to like the colour.
items.zh: 她可能不會喜歡這個顏色。

items.en: The bus is probably not going to come on time.
items.zh: 公車可能不會準時來。

examples.heading: ④ be + just / still / also + going to

items.en: I'm just going to check my email.
items.zh: 我只是要看一下電子郵件。

items.en: We're just going to have a quick look around the shop.
items.zh: 我們只是要在店裡很快地看一下。

items.en: Are you still going to drive us to the airport?
items.zh: 你還是要開車載我們去機場嗎？

items.en: She's still going to take the exam in June.
items.zh: 她還是要在六月考試。

items.en: The concert is still going to happen, even in the rain.
items.zh: 就算下雨，音樂會還是會照常舉行。

items.en: My cousins are also going to come to the barbecue.
items.zh: 我表哥他們也會來烤肉。

items.en: I'm also going to need a new pair of boots.
items.zh: 我也會需要一雙新靴子。

examples.heading: ⑤ 過去式：was / were + 副詞 + going to

items.en: I knew I was never going to see her again.
items.zh: 我知道我再也見不到她了。

items.en: We were definitely going to win until our goalkeeper got hurt.
items.zh: 我們本來一定會贏，可是後來守門員受傷了。

items.en: He was probably going to be late, so we started without him.
items.zh: 他可能會遲到，所以我們先開始了。

items.en: The plan was always going to fail.
items.zh: 這個計畫本來就註定會失敗。

items.en: Moving abroad was always going to be hard for the kids.
items.zh: 搬到國外對孩子們來說本來就會很辛苦。

title: It is surely going to help us to improve our English skills.
translation: 這一定會幫助我們提升英文能力。
name: be going to 加句中副詞（較多種）
sentences: The new store is undoubtedly going to have a bad effect on our sales.
This course is surely going to improve your chances of finding a job.
The decision is certainly going to upset some customers.
Rising prices are surely going to hit poorer families hardest.
The film is certainly going to win several awards.
Their research is undoubtedly going to change how doctors treat the disease.
Our profits are certainly going to fall this quarter.
The new law is surely going to reduce traffic in the city centre.
A second airport is undoubtedly going to bring more tourists to the region.
Cutting the budget is inevitably going to mean fewer staff.
The building work is inevitably going to cause some noise.
The president is clearly going to lose the next election.
A merger is inevitably going to lead to some job losses.
The team is clearly going to need a new coach.
Online shopping is inevitably going to replace some high street shops.
He is probably going to finish his political career in two or three years.
The project is probably going to take longer than planned.
Interest rates are possibly going to rise again in the spring.
The company is probably going to move its head office to Leeds.
She's possibly going to take over the department next year.
The museum is probably going to need more volunteers.
The repairs are only going to take an hour.
These problems are eventually going to affect the whole industry.
Arguing about it is only going to make things worse.
Raising taxes again is simply going to drive businesses away.
The truth is eventually going to come out.
More rules are only going to confuse people.
The government is certainly not going to change its mind.
A small pay rise is clearly not going to satisfy the workers.
The weather is probably not going to improve before the weekend.
This kind of approach is simply not going to work.

examples.heading: ① be + surely / certainly / undoubtedly + going to

items.en: The new store is undoubtedly going to have a bad effect on our sales.
items.zh: 新的分店毫無疑問會對我們的銷售有不好的影響。

items.en: This course is surely going to improve your chances of finding a job.
items.zh: 這門課一定會增加你找到工作的機會。

items.en: The decision is certainly going to upset some customers.
items.zh: 這個決定肯定會讓一些顧客不高興。

items.en: Rising prices are surely going to hit poorer families hardest.
items.zh: 物價上漲一定對比較窮的家庭影響最大。

items.en: The film is certainly going to win several awards.
items.zh: 這部電影肯定會拿好幾個獎。

items.en: Their research is undoubtedly going to change how doctors treat the disease.
items.zh: 他們的研究毫無疑問會改變醫生治療這種病的方法。

items.en: Our profits are certainly going to fall this quarter.
items.zh: 我們這一季的利潤肯定會下滑。

items.en: The new law is surely going to reduce traffic in the city centre.
items.zh: 新的法律一定會減少市中心的車流量。

items.en: A second airport is undoubtedly going to bring more tourists to the region.
items.zh: 第二座機場毫無疑問會為這個地區帶來更多觀光客。

examples.heading: ② be + inevitably / clearly + going to

items.en: Cutting the budget is inevitably going to mean fewer staff.
items.zh: 刪減預算免不了會讓員工變少。

items.en: The building work is inevitably going to cause some noise.
items.zh: 施工免不了會有一些噪音。

items.en: The president is clearly going to lose the next election.
items.zh: 總統顯然會輸掉下一次選舉。

items.en: A merger is inevitably going to lead to some job losses.
items.zh: 合併免不了會造成一些人失業。

items.en: The team is clearly going to need a new coach.
items.zh: 這支隊伍顯然會需要新教練。

items.en: Online shopping is inevitably going to replace some high street shops.
items.zh: 網購免不了會取代一些大街上的商店。

examples.heading: ③ be + probably / possibly + going to

items.en: He is probably going to finish his political career in two or three years.
items.zh: 他大概兩三年後就會結束他的政治生涯。

items.en: The project is probably going to take longer than planned.
items.zh: 這個專案大概會比計畫的還要久。

items.en: Interest rates are possibly going to rise again in the spring.
items.zh: 利率春天也許會再升。

items.en: The company is probably going to move its head office to Leeds.
items.zh: 這家公司大概會把總部搬到里茲。

items.en: She's possibly going to take over the department next year.
items.zh: 她明年也許會接管這個部門。

items.en: The museum is probably going to need more volunteers.
items.zh: 博物館大概會需要更多志工。

examples.heading: ④ be + eventually / only / simply + going to

items.en: The repairs are only going to take an hour.
items.zh: 修理只會花一個小時。

items.en: These problems are eventually going to affect the whole industry.
items.zh: 這些問題最後會影響整個產業。

items.en: Arguing about it is only going to make things worse.
items.zh: 為這件事吵只會讓情況更糟。

items.en: Raising taxes again is simply going to drive businesses away.
items.zh: 再加稅只會把企業趕走。

items.en: The truth is eventually going to come out.
items.zh: 真相最後會水落石出。

items.en: More rules are only going to confuse people.
items.zh: 更多規定只會讓人更混亂。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定：be + 副詞 + not going to

items.en: The government is certainly not going to change its mind.
items.zh: 政府肯定不會改變主意。

items.en: A small pay rise is clearly not going to satisfy the workers.
items.zh: 小幅加薪顯然沒辦法讓員工滿意。

items.en: The weather is probably not going to improve before the weekend.
items.zh: 週末之前天氣大概不會好轉。

items.en: This kind of approach is simply not going to work.
items.zh: 這種做法根本行不通。

title: Nobody is going to even look at you when your sister is there.
translation: 你姊姊在的時候，根本沒有人會看你一眼。
name: be going to 與主要動詞之間加副詞
sentences: I don't know if I'm going to still live here next year.

They're not going to even try to fix the problem.
Is the shop going to still be open at nine?

First, I'm going to briefly introduce the main activities of the club.
The speaker is going to briefly explain the new rules.
I'm going to quickly check the tyres before we leave.
We're going to briefly look at last year's results.
She's going to quickly change her clothes and then join us.
The guide is going to briefly describe the history of the castle.
This time I'm going to really study for the exam.
Are you going to actually wear that hat to the wedding?
I think he's going to really enjoy the trip.
Is anyone going to actually read this long report?
We're going to really miss the old house.

items.zh: 那幅畫原本預定要拍賣，可是被人偷走了。

items.en: The prisoners were due to be released the next day.
items.zh: 囚犯預定隔天獲釋。

title: We were going to meet two days later in the square next to the center.
translation: 我們本來打算兩天後在市中心旁邊的廣場見面。
name: 用 was going to 的過去未來式
sentences: We were going to meet at the station at noon.
I was going to call you last night, but I fell asleep.
She was going to study medicine, but she changed her mind.
We were going to drive to the coast, so we filled the tank.
He was going to sell his car, but nobody wanted it.
They were going to get married in June.
I was going to tell you, but I didn't get the chance.
My parents were going to buy a new sofa that weekend.
The teacher was going to give us a test, but she was ill.
I was going to make pasta, so I bought some tomatoes.
We were going to stay for a week, but we left after three days.
Ann was going to finish her dissertation by May.
Were you going to say something?
He wasn't going to come, but his friends talked him into it.
I was just going to ring you.
They were going to open a café in the old bank.
Nobody knew who was going to win the election.
I knew it was going to be a long day.
We thought the bus was going to be late.
Everyone was sure the team was going to win.
The sky was dark, and it was going to snow.
The doctor said the operation was going to take two hours.
I had a feeling something bad was going to happen.
They told us the flight was going to be delayed.
We could see the boat was going to sink.
Nobody guessed he was going to become famous.
The forecast said it was going to be sunny all week.
I didn't think the film was going to be so long.
I never imagined I was going to live abroad.
We were sure the shop was going to close soon.
He looked as if he was going to cry.

examples.heading: ① 過去的計畫

items.en: We were going to meet at the station at noon.
items.zh: 我們本來約好中午在車站見面。

items.en: I was going to call you last night, but I fell asleep.
items.zh: 我昨晚本來要打給你，結果睡著了。

items.en: She was going to study medicine, but she changed her mind.
items.zh: 她本來要念醫學，後來改變主意了。

items.en: We were going to drive to the coast, so we filled the tank.
items.zh: 我們打算開車去海邊，所以把油加滿了。

items.en: He was going to sell his car, but nobody wanted it.
items.zh: 他本來要賣車，可是沒人要買。

items.en: They were going to get married in June.
items.zh: 他們本來打算六月結婚。

items.en: I was going to tell you, but I didn't get the chance.
items.zh: 我本來要告訴你，可是一直沒機會。

items.en: My parents were going to buy a new sofa that weekend.
items.zh: 我爸媽那個週末打算買一張新沙發。

items.en: The teacher was going to give us a test, but she was ill.
items.zh: 老師本來要考試，可是她生病了。

items.en: I was going to make pasta, so I bought some tomatoes.
items.zh: 我打算煮義大利麵，所以買了一些番茄。

items.en: We were going to stay for a week, but we left after three days.
items.zh: 我們本來打算待一個星期，結果三天後就走了。

items.en: Ann was going to finish her dissertation by May.
items.zh: Ann 本來打算五月前寫完論文。

items.en: Were you going to say something?
items.zh: 你剛才是要說什麼嗎？

items.en: He wasn't going to come, but his friends talked him into it.
items.zh: 他本來不打算來，可是他朋友說服了他。

items.en: I was just going to ring you.
items.zh: 我正要打電話給你。

items.en: They were going to open a café in the old bank.
items.zh: 他們本來打算在舊銀行裡開一家咖啡店。

examples.heading: ② 過去以為會發生的事

items.en: Nobody knew who was going to win the election.
items.zh: 沒有人知道誰會贏得選舉。

items.en: I knew it was going to be a long day.
items.zh: 我知道那會是漫長的一天。

items.en: We thought the bus was going to be late.
items.zh: 我們以為公車會遲到。

items.en: Everyone was sure the team was going to win.
items.zh: 每個人都確定球隊會贏。

items.en: The sky was dark, and it was going to snow.
items.zh: 天色很暗，快要下雪了。

items.en: The doctor said the operation was going to take two hours.
items.zh: 醫生說手術要花兩個小時。

items.en: I had a feeling something bad was going to happen.
items.zh: 我有種預感，會有不好的事發生。

items.en: They told us the flight was going to be delayed.
items.zh: 他們告訴我們班機會延誤。

items.en: We could see the boat was going to sink.
items.zh: 我們看得出那艘船要沉了。

items.en: Nobody guessed he was going to become famous.
items.zh: 沒有人猜到他會成名。

items.en: The forecast said it was going to be sunny all week.
items.zh: 氣象預報說整個星期都會是晴天。

items.en: I didn't think the film was going to be so long.
items.zh: 我沒想到那部電影會那麼長。

items.en: I never imagined I was going to live abroad.
items.zh: 我從來沒想過自己會住在國外。

items.en: We were sure the shop was going to close soon.
items.zh: 我們確定那家店很快就會關門。

items.en: He looked as if he was going to cry.
items.zh: 他看起來好像要哭了。

title: When I was on the point of leaving the office, the phone rang.
translation: 我正要離開辦公室的時候，電話響了。
name: 過去式的 be on the point of
sentences: I was on the point of going to bed when someone knocked at the door.
Ann was on the point of booking the flight when the airline raised its prices.
The police were on the point of catching him when he escaped.
We were on the point of calling a taxi when Dad arrived.
He was on the point of saying sorry when she walked out.
I was on the point of buying the coat when I saw the price.
They were on the point of cancelling the trip when the weather improved.
The doctor was on the point of sending me home when the results came back.
I was on the point of falling asleep when the alarm went off.
She was on the point of finishing her dissertation when her computer crashed.
We were on the point of leaving the party when the band started playing.
He was on the point of opening the letter when the phone rang.
I was on the point of losing my temper when he finally said sorry.
The company was on the point of closing when a new buyer appeared.
When the shop was on the point of closing, a crowd of tourists came in.
When I was on the point of quitting, my boss offered me a pay rise.
The old bridge was on the point of falling down.
By midnight I was on the point of crying.
The two countries were on the point of going to war.
The team was on the point of winning its first title.
My grandmother was on the point of moving to a smaller flat.
The baby was on the point of waking up, so we spoke quietly.
I was so tired that I was on the point of collapsing.
The talks were on the point of breaking down.
Many shops in the street were on the point of closing for good.
He told us he was on the point of retiring.
The patient was on the point of dying, but the doctors saved him.
We were on the point of giving up hope.
The kids were on the point of fighting over the last cake.
The government was on the point of changing the law.
Our cat was on the point of jumping onto the table.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was / were + on the point of + 動詞-ing + when ...

items.en: I was on the point of going to bed when someone knocked at the door.
items.zh: 我正要上床睡覺的時候，有人敲門。

items.en: Ann was on the point of booking the flight when the airline raised its prices.
items.zh: Ann 正要訂機票的時候，航空公司漲價了。

items.en: The police were on the point of catching him when he escaped.
items.zh: 警察正要抓到他的時候，他逃走了。

items.en: We were on the point of calling a taxi when Dad arrived.
items.zh: 我們正要叫計程車的時候，爸爸到了。

items.en: He was on the point of saying sorry when she walked out.
items.zh: 他正要道歉的時候，她走了出去。

items.en: I was on the point of buying the coat when I saw the price.
items.zh: 我正要買那件外套的時候，看到了價錢。

items.en: They were on the point of cancelling the trip when the weather improved.
items.zh: 他們正要取消旅行的時候，天氣變好了。

items.en: The doctor was on the point of sending me home when the results came back.
items.zh: 醫生正要讓我回家的時候，檢查結果出來了。

items.en: I was on the point of falling asleep when the alarm went off.
items.zh: 我快要睡著的時候，警報響了。

items.en: She was on the point of finishing her dissertation when her computer crashed.
items.zh: 她的論文快寫完的時候，電腦當機了。

items.en: We were on the point of leaving the party when the band started playing.
items.zh: 我們正要離開派對的時候，樂團開始演奏了。

items.en: He was on the point of opening the letter when the phone rang.
items.zh: 他正要拆信的時候，電話響了。

items.en: I was on the point of losing my temper when he finally said sorry.
items.zh: 我快要發脾氣的時候，他終於道歉了。

items.en: The company was on the point of closing when a new buyer appeared.
items.zh: 公司快要倒閉的時候，出現了一位新買家。

items.en: When the shop was on the point of closing, a crowd of tourists came in.
items.zh: 那家店正要打烊的時候，一群觀光客走了進來。

items.en: When I was on the point of quitting, my boss offered me a pay rise.
items.zh: 我正要辭職的時候，老闆給我加薪。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + was / were + on the point of + 動詞-ing

items.en: The old bridge was on the point of falling down.
items.zh: 那座舊橋快要倒塌了。

items.en: By midnight I was on the point of crying.
items.zh: 到了半夜，我已經快哭了。

items.en: The two countries were on the point of going to war.
items.zh: 兩國當時已經快要開戰了。

items.en: The team was on the point of winning its first title.
items.zh: 球隊即將贏得第一座冠軍。

items.en: My grandmother was on the point of moving to a smaller flat.
items.zh: 我奶奶當時正打算搬到小一點的公寓。

items.en: The baby was on the point of waking up, so we spoke quietly.
items.zh: 寶寶快醒了，所以我們小聲說話。

items.en: I was so tired that I was on the point of collapsing.
items.zh: 我累到快要昏倒了。

items.en: The talks were on the point of breaking down.
items.zh: 會談已經快要破裂了。

items.en: Many shops in the street were on the point of closing for good.
items.zh: 這條街上很多店都快要永久歇業了。

items.en: He told us he was on the point of retiring.
items.zh: 他告訴我們他快要退休了。

items.en: The patient was on the point of dying, but the doctors saved him.
items.zh: 病人快要死了，可是醫生救了他。

items.en: We were on the point of giving up hope.
items.zh: 我們已經快要放棄希望了。

items.en: The kids were on the point of fighting over the last cake.
items.zh: 孩子們為了最後一塊蛋糕快要打起來了。

items.en: The government was on the point of changing the law.
items.zh: 政府當時正要修改法律。

items.en: Our cat was on the point of jumping onto the table.
items.zh: 我們家的貓正要跳上桌子。

title: It's no problem if you want to leave at 4:30 p.m., as the match will have finished by that time.
translation: 你想下午 4:30 離開也沒問題，因為那時比賽已經結束了。
name: 未來完成式表示到未來某時已完成
sentences: The concert will have ended by eleven, so you can take the last train.
If you walk every day, you will have lost five kilos by the summer.
The plane will have landed by the time you get to the airport.
Come after eight. We'll have finished dinner by then.
By the time the police arrive, the thief will have escaped.
The tickets will have sold out by Monday, so book now.
By the weekend, the swelling will have gone down.
I'll have finished the report by the time you need it.
In an hour, the cake will have cooled enough to cut.
By the time you read this letter, I'll have started my new job.
The movers will have taken everything out by noon.
By next year, the city will have planted ten thousand trees.
By the time the kids come home, I'll have tidied their room.
The shops will have closed by the time we get there.
In three weeks, she'll have recovered completely.
By the time the guests arrive, the band will have set up.
By the end of the month, you won't have paid anything for parking.
Don't come at nine. I won't have got dressed.
By Friday the parcel won't have arrived.
The paint won't have dried by the time the guests come.
The bakery won't have opened by six.
By the time the film starts, they won't have found a parking space.
We won't have decided on a name by the time the baby is born.
The council won't have fixed the lights by Christmas.
By the deadline, half the class won't have handed in their essays.
The medicine won't have started working by tonight.
She won't have heard about the party by then.
By the end of the day, the workers won't have cleared all the snow.
The new manager won't have met everyone by the end of the week.
By the summer the bridge won't have reopened.
I won't have seen the doctor by the time you call.

examples.heading: ① 預計完成的事

items.en: The concert will have ended by eleven, so you can take the last train.
items.zh: 音樂會十一點前就結束了，所以你趕得上末班車。

items.en: If you walk every day, you will have lost five kilos by the summer.
items.zh: 如果你每天走路，到夏天你就瘦了五公斤。

items.en: The plane will have landed by the time you get to the airport.
items.zh: 等你到機場的時候，飛機已經降落了。

items.en: Come after eight. We'll have finished dinner by then.
items.zh: 八點以後再來，那時候我們就吃完晚餐了。

items.en: By the time the police arrive, the thief will have escaped.
items.zh: 等警察到的時候，小偷已經逃走了。

items.en: The tickets will have sold out by Monday, so book now.
items.zh: 到星期一票就賣光了，所以現在就訂。

items.en: By the weekend, the swelling will have gone down.
items.zh: 到週末，腫就消了。

items.en: I'll have finished the report by the time you need it.
items.zh: 等你需要報告的時候，我就已經寫好了。

items.en: In an hour, the cake will have cooled enough to cut.
items.zh: 再過一個小時，蛋糕就涼到可以切了。

items.en: By the time you read this letter, I'll have started my new job.
items.zh: 等你讀到這封信的時候，我已經開始新工作了。

items.en: The movers will have taken everything out by noon.
items.zh: 到中午，搬家工人就把東西全部搬走了。

items.en: By next year, the city will have planted ten thousand trees.
items.zh: 到明年，這座城市就已經種了一萬棵樹。

items.en: By the time the kids come home, I'll have tidied their room.
items.zh: 等孩子們回家的時候，我就已經整理好他們的房間了。

items.en: The shops will have closed by the time we get there.
items.zh: 等我們到那裡的時候，商店都已經關門了。

items.en: In three weeks, she'll have recovered completely.
items.zh: 再過三個星期，她就完全康復了。

items.en: By the time the guests arrive, the band will have set up.
items.zh: 等客人到的時候，樂團就已經架好設備了。

examples.heading: ② 預計沒完成的事

items.en: By the end of the month, you won't have paid anything for parking.
items.zh: 到月底，你就不會付任何停車費了。

items.en: Don't come at nine. I won't have got dressed.
items.zh: 九點別來，那時候我還沒換好衣服。

items.en: By Friday the parcel won't have arrived.
items.zh: 到星期五，包裹還不會送到。

items.en: The paint won't have dried by the time the guests come.
items.zh: 等客人來的時候，油漆還不會乾。

items.en: The bakery won't have opened by six.
items.zh: 到六點，麵包店還沒開門。

items.en: By the time the film starts, they won't have found a parking space.
items.zh: 等電影開始的時候，他們還沒找到停車位。

items.en: We won't have decided on a name by the time the baby is born.
items.zh: 等寶寶出生的時候，我們還沒決定好名字。

items.en: The council won't have fixed the lights by Christmas.
items.zh: 到聖誕節，市議會還沒把路燈修好。

items.en: By the deadline, half the class won't have handed in their essays.
items.zh: 到截止日，班上有一半的人還沒交作文。

items.en: The medicine won't have started working by tonight.
items.zh: 到今晚，藥效還不會開始發揮。

items.en: She won't have heard about the party by then.
items.zh: 到那時候，她還不會聽說派對的事。

items.en: By the end of the day, the workers won't have cleared all the snow.
items.zh: 到今天結束，工人還沒把雪全部清完。

items.en: The new manager won't have met everyone by the end of the week.
items.zh: 到週末，新經理還沒跟每個人見過面。

items.en: By the summer the bridge won't have reopened.
items.zh: 到夏天，橋還不會重新開放。

items.en: I won't have seen the doctor by the time you call.
items.zh: 等你打來的時候，我還沒看完醫生。

title: Your boss may be calling at 10 p.m. asking you to prepare a report for the next day's meeting.
translation: 你老闆可能會在晚上 10 點打電話來，要你準備隔天開會用的報告。
name: may/might 加未來進行式
sentences: Your boss may be calling at ten asking for that report.
I may be working late tonight, so don't wait for me.
The new products may be coming out in the spring.
They may be selling the house next year.
We may be getting a new manager soon.
Ann may be staying with us for a few days.
The prices may be going up again in July.
I may be travelling a lot for work next year.
You may be hearing from our lawyer.
The band may be playing some new songs tonight.
She may be studying abroad next autumn.
I may not be coming to class tomorrow.
The students may not be taking the exam this year.
We might be moving to Canada next year.
Tom might be joining us for dinner.
I might be changing jobs soon.
They might be closing the factory at the end of the year.
It might be raining when we get there.
She might be giving a talk at the conference.
The kids might be sleeping when you arrive.
He might be writing a book about his travels.
We might be needing some extra help on Saturday.
The team might be playing without their captain.
I might be seeing her at the weekend.
The workers might be striking again next month.
You might be waiting a long time for a bus at this hour.
Some people might be feeling nervous before the interview.
I might not be using the car tomorrow.
They might not be coming back until Sunday.
The museum might not be opening on time.
He might not be playing in the final.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + may be + 動詞-ing

items.en: Your boss may be calling at ten asking for that report.
items.zh: 你老闆可能會在十點打電話來要那份報告。

items.en: I may be working late tonight, so don't wait for me.
items.zh: 我今晚可能要加班，所以別等我。

items.en: The new products may be coming out in the spring.
items.zh: 新產品可能會在春天推出。

items.en: They may be selling the house next year.
items.zh: 他們明年可能會賣掉房子。

items.en: We may be getting a new manager soon.
items.zh: 我們可能很快就會有新經理。

items.en: Ann may be staying with us for a few days.
items.zh: Ann 可能會在我們家住幾天。

items.en: The prices may be going up again in July.
items.zh: 價格七月可能又要漲了。

items.en: I may be travelling a lot for work next year.
items.zh: 我明年可能會常常出差。

items.en: You may be hearing from our lawyer.
items.zh: 你可能會收到我們律師的消息。

items.en: The band may be playing some new songs tonight.
items.zh: 樂團今晚可能會唱一些新歌。

items.en: She may be studying abroad next autumn.
items.zh: 她明年秋天可能會出國念書。

items.en: I may not be coming to class tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天可能不會來上課。

items.en: The students may not be taking the exam this year.
items.zh: 學生今年可能不會參加考試。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + might be + 動詞-ing

items.en: We might be moving to Canada next year.
items.zh: 我們明年可能會搬到加拿大。

items.en: Tom might be joining us for dinner.
items.zh: Tom 也許會來跟我們一起吃晚餐。

items.en: I might be changing jobs soon.
items.zh: 我可能很快就要換工作了。

items.en: They might be closing the factory at the end of the year.
items.zh: 他們年底可能會關閉工廠。

items.en: It might be raining when we get there.
items.zh: 我們到那裡的時候可能正在下雨。

items.en: She might be giving a talk at the conference.
items.zh: 她可能會在研討會上演講。

items.en: The kids might be sleeping when you arrive.
items.zh: 你到的時候孩子們可能已經在睡了。

items.en: He might be writing a book about his travels.
items.zh: 他可能會寫一本關於他旅行的書。

items.en: We might be needing some extra help on Saturday.
items.zh: 我們星期六可能需要多一點人手。

items.en: The team might be playing without their captain.
items.zh: 球隊可能要在沒有隊長的情況下比賽。

items.en: I might be seeing her at the weekend.
items.zh: 我週末可能會見到她。

items.en: The workers might be striking again next month.
items.zh: 工人下個月可能又要罷工了。

items.en: You might be waiting a long time for a bus at this hour.
items.zh: 這個時間你可能要等公車等很久。

items.en: Some people might be feeling nervous before the interview.
items.zh: 有些人在面試前可能會覺得緊張。

items.en: I might not be using the car tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天可能不會用到車。

items.en: They might not be coming back until Sunday.
items.zh: 他們可能要到星期天才會回來。

items.en: The museum might not be opening on time.
items.zh: 博物館可能不會準時開門。

items.en: He might not be playing in the final.
items.zh: 他可能不會上場打決賽。

title: The work will start at 8 a.m. and finish at 2 p.m.
translation: 工作會在早上 8 點開始，下午 2 點結束。
name: 未來式 will 表示排定的計畫
sentences: The bridge will close at midnight and reopen at 5 a.m.
The new timetable will start on 1 June.
The train will leave at 9:15 from platform three.
The meeting will take place on Tuesday at ten.

items.zh: 俱樂部星期四晚上要開年度大會。

items.en: Our town is hosting the regional games this summer.
items.zh: 我們鎮今年夏天要主辦地區運動會。

items.en: I'm joining a gym near the office in January.
items.zh: 我一月要加入辦公室附近的健身房。

items.en: They're throwing a leaving party for their boss on Friday.
items.zh: 他們星期五要幫老闆辦歡送派對。

items.en: The school is holding a concert to raise money for the hospital.
items.zh: 學校要辦一場音樂會，為醫院募款。

items.en: My parents are hosting a dinner for the whole family on Sunday.
items.zh: 我爸媽星期天要請全家吃晚餐。

examples.heading: ② launch / release / publish

items.en: The company is launching its new phone in September.
items.zh: 那家公司九月要推出新手機。

items.en: My favourite singer is releasing a new album next month.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的歌手下個月要出新專輯。

items.en: The magazine is publishing my article in the spring issue.
items.zh: 那本雜誌春季號要刊登我的文章。

items.en: They're launching a campaign to clean up the beach.
items.zh: 他們要發起一個淨灘活動。

items.en: The studio is releasing the film in cinemas on 12th March.
items.zh: 片商三月十二日要在電影院上映這部電影。

examples.heading: ③ sign / interview / hire

items.en: The club is signing a new striker next week.
items.zh: 球隊下星期要簽一位新前鋒。

items.en: We're interviewing three candidates for the job tomorrow.
items.zh: 我們明天要面試三位應徵者。

items.en: The restaurant is hiring two new chefs for the summer.
items.zh: 那家餐廳夏天要僱兩位新廚師。

items.en: I'm signing the contract for the flat on Monday.
items.zh: 我星期一要簽公寓的租約。

items.en: The director is interviewing actors for the new play this week.
items.zh: 導演這週要為新戲面試演員。

examples.heading: ④ perform / present / give

items.en: Our class is performing a play for the parents next Friday.
items.zh: 我們班下星期五要演戲給家長看。

items.en: I'm presenting my project to the board on Tuesday.
items.zh: 我星期二要向董事會報告我的專案。

items.en: The orchestra is performing in the town hall on Saturday.
items.zh: 管弦樂團星期六要在市政廳演出。

items.en: She's giving a speech at her sister's wedding.
items.zh: 她要在她姊的婚禮上致詞。

items.en: Two students are presenting their research at the conference.
items.zh: 有兩位學生要在研討會上發表研究。

examples.heading: ⑤ 其他動詞

items.en: We're redecorating the living room over the holidays.
items.zh: 我們放假時要重新裝潢客廳。

items.en: The council is repairing the bridge in October.
items.zh: 市議會十月要修那座橋。

items.en: I'm volunteering at the animal shelter on Saturday mornings from next week.
items.zh: 從下星期開始，我星期六早上要去動物收容所當志工。

items.en: My brother is competing in a chess tournament next weekend.
items.zh: 我哥下個週末要參加西洋棋比賽。

items.en: The hotel is installing a new swimming pool before the summer.
items.zh: 飯店夏天前要裝一座新游泳池。

items.en: We're collecting the keys to our new house on Wednesday.
items.zh: 我們星期三要去拿新家的鑰匙。

items.en: The museum is lending some paintings to a gallery in Paris.
items.zh: 博物館要把幾幅畫借給巴黎的一家美術館。

items.en: I'm babysitting for my neighbours on Saturday night.
items.zh: 我星期六晚上要幫鄰居顧小孩。

title: She didn't know what was going to happen.
translation: 她不知道接下來會發生什麼事。
name: 過去式 be going to 表示過去的未來
sentences: When I saw the dark clouds, I knew it was going to rain.
Everyone could see that the old tree was going to fall.
From the first page, I knew the hero was going to die at the end.
The sky over the mountains looked like it was going to clear.
By midnight it was clear that our team was going to lose.
The pilot told us the flight was going to be bumpy.
We realised the journey was going to cost more than we thought.
My grandmother always said I was going to be a singer.
Nobody guessed that the shy boy was going to become famous.
The forecast said the storm was going to reach the coast by Friday.
I was going to cook dinner, but we ordered a pizza instead.
They were going to get married in May, but they waited until autumn.
Tom was going to repair the bike himself, but he couldn't find the tools.
We were going to walk to the lake, but it started to snow.
I was going to send her a card, but I forgot her address.
The school was going to close for a week, but the heating came back on.
My dad was going to retire last year, but he loves his job too much.
We were going to camp by the river, but the ground was too wet.
She was going to take the early train, but she overslept.
The band was going to play outside, but they moved the concert indoors.
I didn't know who was going to meet me at the airport.
We had no idea how long the repairs were going to take.
I thought you were going to bring the drinks.
She wondered if her parents were going to be angry.
The players didn't know if the match was going to go ahead.
I wasn't sure what I was going to say to him.
He asked me where I was going to spend the summer.
Nobody told us when the train was going to leave.
I thought the film was going to be funny, but it was really sad.
We wondered how we were going to pay for the repairs.
Did you know that Lucy was going to leave the company?

examples.heading: ① 過去的預料

items.en: When I saw the dark clouds, I knew it was going to rain.
items.zh: 我看到烏雲，就知道會下雨。

items.en: Everyone could see that the old tree was going to fall.
items.zh: 大家都看得出來那棵老樹會倒。

items.en: From the first page, I knew the hero was going to die at the end.
items.zh: 從第一頁開始，我就知道主角最後會死。

items.en: The sky over the mountains looked like it was going to clear.
items.zh: 山上的天空看起來會放晴。

items.en: By midnight it was clear that our team was going to lose.
items.zh: 到了半夜，很明顯我們隊會輸。

items.en: The pilot told us the flight was going to be bumpy.
items.zh: 機長告訴我們飛行途中會有點顛簸。

items.en: We realised the journey was going to cost more than we thought.
items.zh: 我們發現這趟旅程會比我們想的還要花錢。

items.en: My grandmother always said I was going to be a singer.
items.zh: 我奶奶總是說我會當歌手。

items.en: Nobody guessed that the shy boy was going to become famous.
items.zh: 沒有人猜到那個害羞的男孩會出名。

items.en: The forecast said the storm was going to reach the coast by Friday.
items.zh: 預報說暴風雨星期五會到海岸。

examples.heading: ② 過去的計畫沒有實現：was / were going to ..., but ...

items.en: I was going to cook dinner, but we ordered a pizza instead.
items.zh: 我本來要煮晚餐，可是我們改叫了披薩。

items.en: They were going to get married in May, but they waited until autumn.
items.zh: 他們本來五月要結婚，可是等到了秋天。

items.en: Tom was going to repair the bike himself, but he couldn't find the tools.
items.zh: Tom 本來要自己修腳踏車，可是他找不到工具。

items.en: We were going to walk to the lake, but it started to snow.
items.zh: 我們本來要走路去湖邊，可是開始下雪了。

items.en: I was going to send her a card, but I forgot her address.
items.zh: 我本來要寄卡片給她，可是我忘了她的地址。

items.en: The school was going to close for a week, but the heating came back on.
items.zh: 學校本來要停課一週，可是暖氣恢復了。

items.en: My dad was going to retire last year, but he loves his job too much.
items.zh: 我爸去年本來要退休，可是他太愛他的工作了。

items.en: We were going to camp by the river, but the ground was too wet.
items.zh: 我們本來要在河邊露營，可是地上太濕了。

items.en: She was going to take the early train, but she overslept.
items.zh: 她本來要搭早班火車，可是她睡過頭了。

items.en: The band was going to play outside, but they moved the concert indoors.
items.zh: 樂團本來要在戶外表演，可是他們把音樂會移到室內。

examples.heading: ③ know / think / wonder + what / who / if + was / were going to

items.en: I didn't know who was going to meet me at the airport.
items.zh: 我不知道誰會來機場接我。

items.en: We had no idea how long the repairs were going to take.
items.zh: 我們完全不知道修理會花多久。

items.en: I thought you were going to bring the drinks.
items.zh: 我以為你會帶飲料來。

items.en: She wondered if her parents were going to be angry.
items.zh: 她在想她爸媽會不會生氣。

items.en: The players didn't know if the match was going to go ahead.
items.zh: 球員們不知道比賽會不會照常進行。

items.en: I wasn't sure what I was going to say to him.
items.zh: 我不確定我要跟他說什麼。

items.en: He asked me where I was going to spend the summer.
items.zh: 他問我暑假要去哪裡過。

items.en: Nobody told us when the train was going to leave.
items.zh: 沒有人告訴我們火車什麼時候開。

items.en: I thought the film was going to be funny, but it was really sad.
items.zh: 我以為那部電影會很好笑，結果很悲傷。

items.en: We wondered how we were going to pay for the repairs.
items.zh: 我們在想要怎麼付修理費。

items.en: Did you know that Lucy was going to leave the company?
items.zh: 你知道 Lucy 要離開公司嗎？

title: I hope you come to visit me soon.

I hope we win the match on Saturday.
I hope they like my cake.
I hope you get the job.
I hope your parents enjoy the concert.
I hope you find a nice flat.
I hope we see each other again soon.
I hope you have a good journey home.
I hope you all have a lovely Christmas.
I hope my friends remember my birthday.
I hope your brother gets better soon.
I hope she likes her new school.
I hope the weather stays sunny for the wedding.
I hope it snows at Christmas.
I hope the bus comes soon.
I hope my sister passes her driving test.
I hope Grandma enjoys the flowers.
I hope the new teacher is nice.
I hope he remembers to bring the tickets.
I hope it doesn't rain on our picnic day.
I hope you don't miss your train.
I hope the dog doesn't bark all night.
I hope they don't forget about the meeting.
I hope the test isn't too difficult.
I hope we aren't late for the film.
I hope my mum doesn't find out.
I hope that you enjoy your first week at the new school.
I hope that everything goes well tomorrow.
I hope that the hotel has a swimming pool.
I hope that the shop still has my size.

examples.heading: ① I hope + 主詞 + 現在簡單式

items.en: I hope you like the book I sent.
items.zh: 希望你喜歡我寄給你的書。

items.en: I hope you have a great time in Italy.
items.zh: 祝你在義大利玩得開心。

items.en: I hope we win the match on Saturday.
items.zh: 希望我們星期六的比賽會贏。

items.en: I hope they like my cake.
items.zh: 希望他們喜歡我做的蛋糕。

items.en: I hope you get the job.
items.zh: 希望你得到那份工作。

items.en: I hope your parents enjoy the concert.
items.zh: 希望你爸媽喜歡那場音樂會。

items.en: I hope you find a nice flat.
items.zh: 希望你找到一間不錯的公寓。

items.en: I hope we see each other again soon.
items.zh: 希望我們很快再見面。

items.en: I hope you have a good journey home.
items.zh: 祝你回家一路順利。

items.en: I hope you all have a lovely Christmas.
items.zh: 祝你們大家聖誕快樂。

items.en: I hope my friends remember my birthday.
items.zh: 希望我朋友記得我的生日。

examples.heading: ② I hope + he / she / it + 動詞-s

items.en: I hope your brother gets better soon.
items.zh: 希望你哥早日康復。

items.en: I hope she likes her new school.
items.zh: 希望她喜歡她的新學校。

items.en: I hope the weather stays sunny for the wedding.
items.zh: 希望婚禮那天天氣一直晴朗。

items.en: I hope it snows at Christmas.
items.zh: 希望聖誕節會下雪。

items.en: I hope the bus comes soon.
items.zh: 希望公車快點來。

items.en: I hope my sister passes her driving test.
items.zh: 希望我姊通過駕照考試。

items.en: I hope Grandma enjoys the flowers.
items.zh: 希望奶奶喜歡這些花。

items.en: I hope the new teacher is nice.
items.zh: 希望新老師人很好。

items.en: I hope he remembers to bring the tickets.
items.zh: 希望他記得帶票。

examples.heading: ③ I hope + 主詞 + 否定的現在簡單式

items.en: I hope it doesn't rain on our picnic day.
items.zh: 希望我們野餐那天不要下雨。

items.en: I hope you don't miss your train.
items.zh: 希望你不要錯過火車。

items.en: I hope the dog doesn't bark all night.
items.zh: 希望那隻狗不要整晚叫。

items.en: I hope they don't forget about the meeting.
items.zh: 希望他們不要忘了開會。

items.en: I hope the test isn't too difficult.
items.zh: 希望考試不要太難。

items.en: I hope we aren't late for the film.
items.zh: 希望我們看電影不要遲到。

items.en: I hope my mum doesn't find out.
items.zh: 希望我媽不會發現。

examples.heading: ④ I hope that + 主詞 + 現在簡單式

items.en: I hope that you enjoy your first week at the new school.
items.zh: 希望你在新學校的第一個星期過得開心。

items.en: I hope that everything goes well tomorrow.
items.zh: 希望明天一切順利。

items.en: I hope that the hotel has a swimming pool.
items.zh: 希望那家飯店有游泳池。

items.en: I hope that the shop still has my size.
items.zh: 希望那家店還有我的尺寸。

title: We're about to introduce a new identity card system in our company.
translation: 我們即將在公司導入新的識別證系統。
name: be about to 表示即將發生
sentences: Our club is about to elect a new chairman.
The hospital is about to open a new children's ward.
The airline is about to start flights to Vietnam.
Our neighbours are about to have their third child.
The city is about to open its first underground line.
My sister is about to become a doctor.
The government is about to change the tax rules.
The factory is about to close for good.
You're about to meet the most important people in the company.
A new chapter of my life is about to begin.
The professor is about to publish her treatise on Chinese poetry.
Prices are about to go up again.
The two companies are about to join together.
We're about to move into a bigger office.
The winter sales are about to start.
The two sides are about to sign a peace agreement.
We are just about to launch a new snack for children.
I'm just about to start a meeting. Can I text you later?
The doctor is just about to see you.
She's just about to leave for the airport.
We're just about to sit down to dinner.
Hold on, I'm just about to find out.
The show is just about to begin, so turn off your phone.
The kids are just about to go to bed.
I'm just about to finish this chapter.
He's just about to call you back.
The plane is just about to touch down.
The guests are just about to arrive.
I'm just about to lock up the shop.
The runners are just about to cross the finish line.
We're just about to board, so I have to go.

items.zh: 我們社團即將選出新的主席。

items.zh: 醫院即將開設新的兒童病房。

items.zh: 這家航空公司即將開航飛越南的航線。

items.zh: 我們的鄰居快要生第三個孩子了。

items.en: The city is about to open its first underground line.
items.zh: 這座城市即將開通第一條地鐵線。

items.en: My sister is about to become a doctor.
items.zh: 我姊姊快要當上醫生了。

items.en: The government is about to change the tax rules.
items.zh: 政府即將修改稅務規定。

items.en: The factory is about to close for good.
items.zh: 這間工廠即將永久關閉。

items.en: You're about to meet the most important people in the company.
items.zh: 你即將見到公司裡最重要的人。

items.en: A new chapter of my life is about to begin.
items.zh: 我人生的新篇章即將開始。

items.en: The professor is about to publish her treatise on Chinese poetry.
items.zh: 教授即將出版她那部關於中國詩的專論。

items.zh: 物價又要漲了。

items.en: The two companies are about to join together.
items.zh: 這兩家公司即將合併。

items.en: We're about to move into a bigger office.
items.zh: 我們即將搬進更大的辦公室。

items.en: The winter sales are about to start.

items.en: The two sides are about to sign a peace agreement.

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + am / is / are + just about to + 原形動詞

items.zh: 我正要開會，我晚一點傳訊息給你好嗎？

items.zh: 醫生馬上就要幫你看診了。

items.en: She's just about to leave for the airport.
items.zh: 她正要出發去機場。

items.en: We're just about to sit down to dinner.
items.zh: 我們正要坐下來吃晚餐。

items.en: Hold on, I'm just about to find out.
items.zh: 等一下，我馬上就知道了。

items.zh: 節目馬上就要開始了，把手機關掉。

items.en: The kids are just about to go to bed.
items.zh: 孩子們正要上床睡覺。

items.en: I'm just about to finish this chapter.

items.zh: 我正要鎖店門。

items.en: The runners are just about to cross the finish line.
items.zh: 跑者們馬上就要衝過終點線了。

items.zh: 我們正要登機，我得走了。

title: I'm not going to be able to meet you next Tuesday, because I have to go to the dentist.

My brother isn't going to join us for lunch.
We're not going to spend all our savings on a car.
I'm not going to make the same mistake twice.
She's not going to wear a dress to the party.
They're not going to cut down the old oak tree.
I'm not going to argue with you.
Our neighbours aren't going to sell their house after all.
He isn't going to play in Saturday's match.
I'm not going to eat out this week.
I'm not going to be able to finish this report by Friday.
We aren't going to be able to visit you this weekend, because our car has broken down.

examples.heading: ① 不打算做的事：be not going to + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm sure I'm not going to live in this town forever.
items.zh: 我確定我不會一輩子住在這個小鎮。

items.en: I'm not going to watch that film again.
items.zh: 那部電影我不打算再看了。

items.en: She isn't going to leave her job.
items.zh: 她不打算辭職。

items.en: We aren't going to paint the kitchen this summer.
items.zh: 我們今年夏天不打算油漆廚房。

items.en: He's not going to apologise to anyone.
items.zh: 他不打算跟任何人道歉。

items.en: They aren't going to take the kids on holiday this year.
items.zh: 他們今年不打算帶孩子去度假。

items.en: I'm not going to answer that question.
items.zh: 我不打算回答那個問題。

items.en: My brother isn't going to join us for lunch.
items.zh: 我哥不會跟我們一起吃午餐。

items.en: We're not going to spend all our savings on a car.
items.zh: 我們不打算把存款全花在一台車上。

items.zh: 我不會犯同樣的錯兩次。

items.en: He isn't going to play in Saturday's match.
items.zh: 他不打算參加星期六的比賽。

items.en: I'm not going to eat out this week.
items.zh: 我這週不打算在外面吃飯。

items.zh: 我星期五之前沒辦法寫完這份報告。

items.zh: 我們這個週末沒辦法去看你，因為我們的車壞了。

items.en: She isn't going to be able to sing tonight, because she has a sore throat.
items.zh: 她今晚沒辦法唱歌，因為她喉嚨痛。

items.zh: 你沒辦法把車停在醫院外面。

items.en: She's not going to be able to come to the meeting, because her flight is late.
items.zh: 她沒辦法來開會，因為她的班機誤點了。

items.en: I'm not going to be able to help you move house on Sunday.
items.zh: 我星期天沒辦法幫你搬家。

items.en: We aren't going to be able to get tickets for the final.
items.zh: 我們買不到決賽的票。

items.en: My parents aren't going to be able to pick me up after school.
items.zh: 我爸媽放學後沒辦法來接我。

items.zh: 我會永遠留著你的信。

items.zh: 我們會永遠感謝你的幫忙。

items.zh: 我會永遠記住這個教訓。

items.zh: 我們會永遠記得幫助過我們的人。

examples.heading: ② I / we + shall never + 原形動詞

items.en: If I believe in myself, I shall never feel lost.
items.zh: 只要相信自己，我就永遠不會迷失。

items.en: I shall never forget the day we met.
items.zh: 我永遠不會忘記我們見面的那一天。

items.en: We shall never give up on our dream.
items.zh: 我們永遠不會放棄我們的夢想。

items.zh: 我們永遠不會賣掉這間房子。

items.en: We shall never go back to that hotel.
items.zh: 我們再也不會去那間飯店了。

items.en: I shall never stop loving music.

items.zh: 我們不會再送任何應徵者去那裡。

items.en: I shall not work for a company I don't respect.
items.zh: 我不會替我不尊重的公司工作。

items.en: We shall not work with that company again.
items.zh: 我們不會再和那家公司合作。

items.en: I shall not live in a big city.
items.zh: 我不會住在大城市。

items.en: We shall not repeat the mistakes of the past.
items.zh: 我們不會重蹈過去的覆轍。

items.en: I shall not marry for money.
items.zh: 我不會為了錢結婚。

items.en: We shall not buy from that shop again.
items.zh: 我們不會再跟那家店買東西。

items.en: I shall not let anything stop me.
items.zh: 我不會讓任何事情阻止我。

items.en: We shall not move from this village.
items.zh: 我們不會離開這個村子。

I'll have been standing in this queue for an hour soon.

By the end of his shift, the driver will have been working for fourteen hours.
This weekend, we'll have been camping in the hills for a week.
By the end of the trial, the jury will have been listening to witnesses for a month.
Next Christmas, Dad will have been running marathons for twenty years.
By the time the plane lands, the crew will have been flying for fourteen hours.

items.zh: 到明年夏天，我們為這趟旅行就存了三年的錢。

items.zh: 到九月，她在那間醫院當護理師就滿十五年了。

items.zh: 到明年春天，他們為了房子就吵了十年了。

items.zh: 到明年，科學家研究這種病毒就滿十年了。

items.zh: 再過不久，我排這個隊伍就排了一個小時了。

items.zh: 到今年秋天，她通勤到台北就滿十年了。

items.en: Next month, I'll have been volunteering at the shelter for three years.
items.zh: 到下個月，我在收容所當志工就滿三年了。

items.en: By the time the guests arrive, Mum will have been cooking all day.
items.zh: 等客人到的時候，媽媽就已經煮了一整天的菜了。

items.en: By the next election, the party will have been governing for twelve years.
items.zh: 到下次選舉，這個政黨就已經執政十二年了。

items.en: By lunchtime, the kids will have been swimming for three hours.
items.zh: 到午餐時間，孩子們就已經游了三個小時了。

items.en: By the end of his shift, the driver will have been working for fourteen hours.
items.zh: 到他下班的時候，這位司機就已經工作了十四個小時。

items.en: This weekend, we'll have been camping in the hills for a week.
items.zh: 到這個週末，我們在山上露營就滿一個星期了。

items.en: By the end of the trial, the jury will have been listening to witnesses for a month.
items.zh: 到審判結束，陪審團聽證人作證就聽了一個月了。

items.en: Next Christmas, Dad will have been running marathons for twenty years.
items.zh: 到明年聖誕節，爸爸跑馬拉松就滿二十年了。

items.en: By the time the plane lands, the crew will have been flying for fourteen hours.
items.zh: 等飛機降落的時候，機組人員就已經飛了十四個小時。
