items.zh: 他們本來要開車去西班牙，後來改搭火車。

items.en: I was going to learn the guitar, but I never had the time.
items.zh: 我本來要學吉他，可是一直沒有時間。

items.en: We were going to have a barbecue, but the weather turned cold.
items.zh: 我們本來要烤肉，可是天氣變冷了。

items.en: He was going to quit smoking on his birthday, but he didn't.
items.zh: 他本來要在生日那天戒菸，可是沒有戒。

items.en: The club was going to buy a new minibus, but the price went up.
items.zh: 俱樂部本來要買一台新的小巴，可是價格漲了。

items.en: I was going to tidy my room this morning, but my cousins arrived.
items.zh: 我今天早上本來要整理房間，可是我表弟他們來了。

items.en: We were going to invite the whole class, but the room was too small.
items.zh: 我們本來要邀全班，可是場地太小了。

items.en: She was going to become a nurse, but she decided to teach instead.
items.zh: 她本來要當護士，後來決定去教書。

items.en: They were going to knock down the old cinema, but people protested.
items.zh: 他們本來要拆掉老電影院，可是大家抗議。

items.en: I was going to answer your letter, but I lost it.
items.zh: 我本來要回你的信，可是我把信弄丟了。

items.en: The coach was going to take the team to a tournament in Italy, but the club cancelled the trip.
items.zh: 教練本來要帶隊去義大利參加比賽，可是俱樂部取消了行程。

items.en: We were going to paint the fence green, but we chose white in the end.
items.zh: 我們本來要把圍籬漆成綠色，最後選了白色。

items.en: My parents were going to buy a dog, but my sister is allergic to fur.
items.zh: 我爸媽本來要買一隻狗，可是我妹對動物的毛過敏。

items.en: I was going to wash the car, but it started raining.
items.zh: 我本來要洗車，可是開始下雨了。

items.en: He was going to run the marathon, but he hurt his knee in training.
items.zh: 他本來要跑馬拉松，可是練習時傷了膝蓋。

items.en: We were going to have lunch in the park, but all the benches were wet.
items.zh: 我們本來要在公園吃午餐，可是長椅全都是濕的。

items.en: The museum was going to stay open late, but there was a power cut.
items.zh: 博物館本來要開到很晚，可是停電了。

items.en: I was going to sleep early, but the neighbours had a party.
items.zh: 我本來要早點睡，可是鄰居在開派對。

items.en: She was going to fly home on Sunday, but the airport was closed.
items.zh: 她本來星期天要飛回家，可是機場關閉了。

items.en: We were going to keep the old sofa, but it was falling apart.
items.zh: 我們本來要留著舊沙發，可是它快散了。

examples.heading: ② 提醒以前的約定：You / We + were going to ...

items.en: We were going to see a film on Friday, remember?
items.zh: 我們說好星期五要看電影，記得嗎？

items.en: You were going to lend me your camera this weekend.
items.zh: 你說過這個週末要借我相機。

items.en: Weren't you going to call your grandmother today?
items.zh: 你今天不是要打給你奶奶嗎？

items.en: I thought we were going to meet outside the bank.
items.zh: 我以為我們說好在銀行外面見。

items.en: You were going to help me with my maths homework, don't you remember?
items.zh: 你說過要幫我寫數學功課，你不記得了嗎？

items.en: Weren't we going to share the cost of the taxi?
items.zh: 我們不是說好要平分計程車錢嗎？

items.en: Dad, you were going to take us swimming after lunch!
items.zh: 爸，你說過午餐後要帶我們去游泳！

items.en: Will I be teaching the morning classes?

items.en: Will you be staying for dinner?
items.zh: 你會留下來吃晚餐嗎？

items.en: Will you be using the meeting room this afternoon?
items.zh: 你今天下午會用會議室嗎？

items.en: Will you be going home for the holidays?

items.en: Will your husband be joining us tonight?

items.en: Will you be bringing the kids?
items.zh: 你會帶孩子們來嗎？

items.en: Will you be needing a lift to the station?
items.zh: 你會需要人載你去車站嗎？

items.en: Will the director be speaking at the dinner?
items.zh: 主任會在晚宴上致詞嗎？

items.en: Will you be seeing Ann at the weekend?
items.zh: 你週末會見到 Ann 嗎？

items.en: Will you be writing your dissertation in English?
items.zh: 你的論文會用英文寫嗎？

items.en: Will your parents be coming to the graduation?
items.zh: 你父母會來參加畢業典禮嗎？

items.en: Will you be finishing early today?
items.zh: 你今天會早點下班嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 服務人員問客人

items.en: Will you be paying by card?
items.zh: 您會刷卡付款嗎？

items.en: Will you be needing a room for tonight?
items.zh: 請問您今晚需要房間嗎？

items.en: Will you be checking any bags today?
items.zh: 您今天有行李要託運嗎？

items.en: Will you be dining with us this evening?
items.zh: 您今晚會在我們這裡用餐嗎？

items.en: Will you be needing anything else?
items.zh: 您還需要什麼嗎？

items.en: Will you be travelling alone, sir?
items.zh: 先生，您是一個人旅行嗎？

items.en: Will you be ordering a starter?
items.zh: 您要點前菜嗎？

items.en: How will you be paying today?
items.zh: 您今天要怎麼付款？

items.en: How long will you be staying with us?
items.zh: 您會在我們這裡住多久？

items.en: What time will you be arriving at the hotel?
items.zh: 您幾點會到飯店？

items.en: Will anyone be joining you for dinner?
items.zh: 晚餐會有人跟您一起用嗎？

Careful, you're going to drop those plates!
The traffic is going to get worse after five.
I think our team is going to score soon.
I'm not going to sleep tonight because tomorrow is a big day.

items.en: You're going to miss your parents when you move abroad.

items.en: I'm sure the kids are going to love the new playground.
items.zh: 我確定孩子們會很愛新的遊樂場。

items.en: This app is going to change the way we shop.
items.zh: 這個應用程式會改變我們買東西的方式。

items.en: I bet the price of petrol is going to rise again.
items.zh: 我敢說油價又會漲。

items.en: Your sister is going to laugh when she sees this photo.

items.zh: 你站上去的話，那個梯子會斷。

items.zh: 新經理會做很多改變。

items.en: I'm sure this experience is going to teach you a lot.
items.zh: 我確定這次經驗會教你很多東西。

items.en: The flowers are going to die without water.
items.zh: 沒有水，這些花會死。

items.en: Your hard work is going to pay off.

items.en: I think the audience is going to cry at the end of the play.

items.zh: 走長路的話，那雙靴子會讓你腳痛。

items.zh: 小心，你會把那些盤子摔下去！

items.zh: 我覺得我們隊很快就會得分。

items.zh: 我今晚會睡不著，因為明天是很重要的一天。

items.zh: 新手機不會讓你快樂。

items.zh: 你覺得今年冬天河會結冰嗎？

items.en: Do you think our plan is going to work?
items.zh: 你覺得我們的計畫會成功嗎？

items.zh: 別帶孩子們去看那部電影，那對他們來說會太恐怖。

examples.heading: ② be going to be + 名詞

items.en: The school trip to the zoo is going to be great fun for the kids.
items.zh: 去動物園的校外教學對孩子們來說一定會很好玩。

items.en: Saturday is going to be a busy day.
items.zh: 星期六會是忙碌的一天。

items.en: With three essays to write, it's going to be a long night for me.
items.zh: 要寫三篇作文，今晚對我來說會很漫長。

items.en: This is going to be the best party ever.
items.zh: 這會是有史以來最棒的派對。

items.en: The match is going to be a hard one.
items.zh: 這場比賽會很難打。

items.en: Our new neighbour is going to be a problem.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居會是個麻煩。

items.en: She's going to be a great teacher one day.
items.zh: 她有一天會成為很棒的老師。

items.en: Look at the sky, it's going to be a beautiful sunset over the sea.
items.zh: 你看天空，等一下海上會有很美的夕陽。

items.en: The concert is going to be a big success.
items.zh: 音樂會一定會很成功。

items.en: This summer is going to be a hot one.
items.zh: 今年夏天會很熱。

items.en: The new shopping centre is going to be a big help for the town.
items.zh: 新的購物中心對這個鎮會有很大的幫助。

items.en: According to the forecast, tomorrow is going to be the hottest day of the year.
items.zh: 根據氣象預報，明天會是今年最熱的一天。

items.en: Learning to drive is going to be a challenge for him.
items.zh: 學開車對他來說會是一大挑戰。

items.en: The test is going to be a piece of cake.
items.zh: 這次考試會很簡單。

items.en: Next year is going to be an exciting year for us.
items.zh: 明年對我們來說會是令人興奮的一年。

title: I hope we shall meet in November.
translation: 希望我們十一月能見面。
name: 未來式 shall 表示預測（正式）
sentences: I hope we shall see each other again in the spring.
We shall probably have several more years to enjoy our garden.
I think we shall have a hard winter this year.
I'm sure we shall be very happy here.
We shall soon know whether the plan has worked.
I expect I shall be tired after the journey.
If the weather is good, we shall reach the top by noon.
I hope I shall be well enough to travel.
We shall probably arrive after dark.
I dare say we shall find a solution.
At this rate, we shall need a bigger office next year.
I suspect I shall regret this decision.
We shall be glad to see the end of this project.
I think we shall get on very well together.
We shall see a lot of changes in the next ten years.
I hope we shall hear good news soon.
I'm afraid we shall not finish the bridge this year.
I fear I shall not see him again.
We shall not have enough money for a holiday this year.
We shall not get home before midnight, I think.
I'm afraid I shan't be able to come.
We shan't know until the results come out.
I suspect we shall not get the contract.
I shan't be surprised if it rains tomorrow.
We shall not see weather like this again for years.
I shan't need my coat today.
I'm afraid we shan't have time to visit you.
We shall not be ready by Friday, I'm afraid.
I shan't miss this cold weather.
I hope we shall not have to wait long.
We shall not get another chance like this.

examples.heading: ① I / we + shall + 原形動詞

items.en: I hope we shall see each other again in the spring.
items.zh: 希望我們春天能再見面。

items.en: We shall probably have several more years to enjoy our garden.
items.zh: 我們大概還有好幾年可以享受我們的花園。

items.en: I think we shall have a hard winter this year.
items.zh: 我覺得今年冬天會很冷。

items.en: I'm sure we shall be very happy here.
items.zh: 我確定我們在這裡會很快樂。

items.en: We shall soon know whether the plan has worked.
items.zh: 我們很快就會知道計畫有沒有成功。

items.en: I expect I shall be tired after the journey.
items.zh: 我想旅行回來我會很累。

items.en: If the weather is good, we shall reach the top by noon.
items.zh: 如果天氣好，我們中午前就會登頂。

items.en: I hope I shall be well enough to travel.
items.zh: 希望我的身體能好到可以旅行。

items.en: We shall probably arrive after dark.
items.zh: 我們大概會在天黑後抵達。

items.en: I dare say we shall find a solution.
items.zh: 我想我們會找到解決辦法的。

items.en: At this rate, we shall need a bigger office next year.
items.zh: 照這樣下去，我們明年會需要更大的辦公室。

items.en: I suspect I shall regret this decision.
items.zh: 我想我會後悔這個決定。

items.en: We shall be glad to see the end of this project.
items.zh: 這個計畫結束時，我們會很高興。

items.en: I think we shall get on very well together.
items.zh: 我覺得我們會相處得很好。

items.en: We shall see a lot of changes in the next ten years.
items.zh: 接下來十年，我們會看到很多改變。

items.en: I hope we shall hear good news soon.
items.zh: 希望我們很快會聽到好消息。

examples.heading: ② I / we + shall not / shan't + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm afraid we shall not finish the bridge this year.
items.zh: 恐怕我們今年蓋不完這座橋。

items.en: I fear I shall not see him again.
items.zh: 我怕我再也見不到他了。

items.en: We shall not have enough money for a holiday this year.
items.zh: 我們今年不會有足夠的錢去度假。

items.en: We shall not get home before midnight, I think.
items.zh: 我想我們半夜前到不了家。

items.en: I'm afraid I shan't be able to come.
items.zh: 恐怕我沒辦法來。

items.en: We shan't know until the results come out.
items.zh: 結果出來之前我們不會知道。

items.en: I suspect we shall not get the contract.
items.zh: 我想我們拿不到這份合約。

items.en: I shan't be surprised if it rains tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天下雨的話我不會意外。

items.en: We shall not see weather like this again for years.
items.zh: 我們好幾年都不會再看到這樣的天氣了。

items.en: I shan't need my coat today.
items.zh: 我今天用不到外套。

items.en: I'm afraid we shan't have time to visit you.
items.zh: 恐怕我們沒有時間去拜訪你。

items.en: We shall not be ready by Friday, I'm afraid.
items.zh: 恐怕我們星期五前準備不好。

items.en: I shan't miss this cold weather.
items.zh: 我不會懷念這種冷天氣。

items.en: I hope we shall not have to wait long.
items.zh: 希望我們不用等太久。

items.en: We shall not get another chance like this.
items.zh: 我們不會再有這樣的機會了。

title: It will be hotter because of global warming.
translation: 因為全球暖化，天氣會變得更熱。
name: 未來式 will 和 'll 表示預測
sentences: The summers will be hotter because of global warming.
You'll enjoy the trip to the mountains.
I think it'll be sunny on the day of the race.
The train will probably be full on Friday evening.
Prices will go up next year.
People will live longer in the future.
Our team will definitely win on Saturday.
The roads will be busy this weekend.
I'm sure you'll pass the exam.
Robots will do many of our jobs one day.
This medicine will make you feel better.
The new road will be very useful.
In twenty years, most cars will be electric.
The kids will be tired after the trip.
It'll be dark by the time we get home.
I think the shop will close soon.
If you travel with your parents, you will not have money problems.
Your parents will not worry about you too much.
I won't live here in the future.
I don't think it will snow this year.
He probably won't come to the party.
The bus won't be crowded on Sunday.
Don't worry. The test won't be difficult.
People won't use cash much in the future.
The rain won't stop before the evening.
You won't need a coat today.
Prices won't come down this year.
The team won't win without its best player.
I don't think she'll like the present.
It won't take more than ten minutes.
The new library won't be ready until next year.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will / 'll + 原形動詞

items.en: The summers will be hotter because of global warming.
items.zh: 因為全球暖化，夏天會更熱。

items.en: You'll enjoy the trip to the mountains.
items.zh: 你會喜歡這趟山上之旅的。

items.en: I think it'll be sunny on the day of the race.
items.zh: 我覺得比賽那天會是晴天。

items.en: The train will probably be full on Friday evening.
items.zh: 星期五晚上火車大概會客滿。

items.en: Prices will go up next year.
items.zh: 明年物價會上漲。

items.en: People will live longer in the future.
items.zh: 未來人們會活得更久。

items.en: Our team will definitely win on Saturday.
items.zh: 我們隊星期六一定會贏。

items.en: The roads will be busy this weekend.
items.zh: 這個週末路上車會很多。

items.en: I'm sure you'll pass the exam.
items.zh: 我確定你會通過考試。

items.en: Robots will do many of our jobs one day.
items.zh: 有一天機器人會做很多我們現在的工作。

items.en: This medicine will make you feel better.
items.zh: 這個藥會讓你覺得舒服一點。

items.en: The new road will be very useful.
items.zh: 新的道路會很有用。

items.en: In twenty years, most cars will be electric.
items.zh: 二十年後，大部分的車子都會是電動車。

items.en: The kids will be tired after the trip.
items.zh: 孩子們旅行回來會很累。

items.en: It'll be dark by the time we get home.
items.zh: 等我們到家的時候，天就黑了。

items.en: I think the shop will close soon.
items.zh: 我覺得那家店很快就會關門。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + will not / won't + 原形動詞

items.en: If you travel with your parents, you will not have money problems.
items.zh: 如果你跟爸媽一起去旅行，就不會有錢的問題。

items.en: Your parents will not worry about you too much.
items.zh: 你爸媽不會太擔心你。

items.en: I won't live here in the future.
items.zh: 我以後不會住在這裡。

items.en: I don't think it will snow this year.
items.zh: 我覺得今年不會下雪。

items.en: He probably won't come to the party.
items.zh: 他大概不會來派對。

items.en: The bus won't be crowded on Sunday.
items.zh: 星期天公車不會很擠。

items.en: Don't worry. The test won't be difficult.
items.zh: 別擔心，考試不會很難。

items.en: People won't use cash much in the future.
items.zh: 未來人們不太會用現金。

items.en: The rain won't stop before the evening.
items.zh: 雨傍晚以前不會停。

items.en: You won't need a coat today.
items.zh: 你今天不需要外套。

items.en: Prices won't come down this year.
items.zh: 今年物價不會降。

items.en: The team won't win without its best player.
items.zh: 沒有最好的球員，這支隊伍不會贏。

items.en: I don't think she'll like the present.
items.zh: 我覺得她不會喜歡這份禮物。

items.en: It won't take more than ten minutes.
items.zh: 不會超過十分鐘。

items.en: The new library won't be ready until next year.
items.zh: 新圖書館要到明年才會好。

title: When are you coming?

sentences: We've got tickets for the Rolling Stones. Are you coming?
Is your sister coming to the wedding?
Are you going to the gym after work?
Are they staying with you at Christmas?
Is Tom playing in the match tomorrow?
Are we having fish for dinner tonight?
Is the bus leaving soon?
Are you working on Saturday?
Is your dad picking you up after school?
Are you meeting Sam at the café?
Are your parents flying to Spain next week?
Is anyone sitting next to you on the coach?
Where are you going on holiday this year?
What are you doing on Saturday afternoon?
Where are we meeting tomorrow?
What is your brother doing after university?
Where are they staying in Rome?
What are we having for lunch?
Where is Anna going for her birthday dinner?
What are you wearing to the party?
The party starts at six. When are you coming?
What time are you collecting the cake from the bakery?
When is your cousin arriving from Canada?
What time is the train leaving for Glasgow?
When is the plumber coming to look at the boiler?
What time are we having dinner?
When are your friends going back to Japan?
Who are you going to the dance with?
How are you getting home after the concert?
Who is coming to the barbecue on Sunday?
How are they travelling to Scotland?

items.zh: 我們買到滾石樂團的票了，你要來嗎？

items.zh: 你姊要來參加婚禮嗎？

items.zh: 你下班後要去健身房嗎？

items.en: Are they staying with you at Christmas?
items.zh: 他們聖誕節要住你家嗎？

items.en: Is Tom playing in the match tomorrow?
items.zh: Tom 明天要上場比賽嗎？

items.en: Are we having fish for dinner tonight?
items.zh: 我們今晚晚餐吃魚嗎？

items.en: Is the bus leaving soon?
items.zh: 公車快開了嗎？

items.en: Are you working on Saturday?
items.zh: 你星期六要上班嗎？

items.en: Is your dad picking you up after school?
items.zh: 你爸放學後要來接你嗎？

items.en: Are you meeting Sam at the café?
items.zh: 你要在咖啡店跟 Sam 見面嗎？

items.en: Are your parents flying to Spain next week?
items.zh: 你爸媽下星期要飛去西班牙嗎？

items.en: Is anyone sitting next to you on the coach?
items.zh: 遊覽車上有人要坐你旁邊嗎？

examples.heading: ② What / Where + am / is / are + 主詞 + 動詞-ing ...?

items.en: Where are you going on holiday this year?
items.zh: 你今年要去哪裡度假？

items.en: What are you doing on Saturday afternoon?
items.zh: 你星期六下午要做什麼？

items.en: Where are we meeting tomorrow?
items.zh: 我們明天在哪裡見面？

items.en: What is your brother doing after university?
items.zh: 你哥大學畢業後要做什麼？

items.en: Where are they staying in Rome?
items.zh: 他們在羅馬要住哪裡？

items.en: What are we having for lunch?
items.zh: 我們午餐吃什麼？

items.en: Where is Anna going for her birthday dinner?
items.zh: Anna 的生日晚餐要去哪裡吃？

items.en: What are you wearing to the party?
items.zh: 你要穿什麼去派對？

examples.heading: ③ When / What time + am / is / are + 主詞 + 動詞-ing ...?

items.en: The party starts at six. When are you coming?
items.zh: 派對六點開始，你什麼時候來？

items.en: What time are you collecting the cake from the bakery?
items.zh: 你幾點要去麵包店拿蛋糕？

items.en: When is your cousin arriving from Canada?
items.zh: 你表姊什麼時候從加拿大來？

items.en: What time is the train leaving for Glasgow?
items.zh: 往格拉斯哥的火車幾點開？

items.en: When is the plumber coming to look at the boiler?
items.zh: 水電工什麼時候要來看熱水器？

items.en: What time are we having dinner?
items.zh: 我們幾點吃晚餐？

items.en: When are your friends going back to Japan?
items.zh: 你朋友什麼時候回日本？

examples.heading: ④ Who / How + am / is / are + 主詞 + 動詞-ing ...?

items.zh: 你要跟誰去舞會？

items.zh: 演唱會結束後你要怎麼回家？

items.zh: 星期天誰要來烤肉？

items.en: How are they travelling to Scotland?
items.zh: 他們要怎麼去蘇格蘭？

title: Why are you moving to a different area?

items.zh: 考完試你要怎麼慶祝？

items.zh: 你要怎麼在島上移動？

title: When is the festival starting, and when is it finishing?
translation: 這個節慶活動什麼時候開始，什麼時候結束？

items.en: I suggest that we meet again next week.
items.zh: 我建議我們下星期再見面。

examples.heading: ② recommend / propose + that + 主詞 + 現在簡單式

items.en: I recommend that we go to the theatre in Ginza where Miss Saigon is on.
items.zh: 我建議我們去銀座那家正在演《西貢小姐》的劇院。

items.en: We would recommend that every student reads the guide before the trip.
items.zh: 我們建議每個學生在旅行前讀一下手冊。

items.en: The committee proposes that the club opens on Sundays.
items.zh: 委員會提議俱樂部星期天也開放。

items.en: I recommend that you check the timetable before you leave.
items.zh: 我建議你出發前先查時刻表。

items.en: The bank recommends that customers change their passwords regularly.
items.zh: 銀行建議客戶定期更改密碼。

items.en: I propose that we vote on it now.
items.zh: 我提議我們現在就投票。

items.en: The manager recommends that the team takes a short break.
items.zh: 經理建議團隊休息一下。

examples.heading: ③ insist / ask / demand + that + 主詞 + 現在簡單式

items.en: We insist that the agreement between you is legally binding.
items.zh: 我們堅持你們之間的協議要有法律效力。

items.en: My mother insists that I phone her every Sunday.
items.zh: 我媽堅持要我每個星期天打電話給她。

items.en: The landlord asks that tenants keep the stairs clear.
items.zh: 房東要求房客保持樓梯通暢。

items.en: The workers demand that the factory pays them for the extra hours.
items.zh: 工人要求工廠支付加班費。

items.en: She insists that everyone takes their shoes off at the door.
items.zh: 她堅持每個人都要在門口脫鞋。

items.en: The school asks that parents collect their children by four.
items.zh: 學校要求家長四點前接孩子。

items.en: The customers demand that the airline gives them a full refund.
items.zh: 顧客要求航空公司全額退款。

items.en: He insists that his son studies law.
items.zh: 他堅持要他兒子念法律。

examples.heading: ④ 正式的寫法：that + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: The committee recommends that the plan be accepted.
items.zh: 委員會建議接受這個計畫。（被動）

items.en: I suggest that he take a few days off.
items.zh: 我建議他休幾天假。

items.en: The law requires that every driver wear a seat belt.
items.zh: 法律規定每個駕駛都要繫安全帶。

items.en: We propose that the meeting start at nine.
items.zh: 我們提議會議九點開始。

items.en: She insisted that her name be removed from the list.
items.zh: 她堅持要把她的名字從名單上刪掉。（被動）

items.en: The judge ordered that the man pay a fine.
items.zh: 法官命令那個男人繳罰款。

items.en: It is essential that every child have a place at school.
items.zh: 每個孩子都必須有學校可以念。

items.en: The doctor advised that she not eat any sugar.
items.zh: 醫生建議她不要吃糖。

items.en: They demanded that the government act at once.
items.zh: 他們要求政府馬上行動。

title: Shall we go there together?
translation: 我們要不要一起去那裡？
name: shall we 表示建議（未來式）
sentences: Shall we go to my friend's house after school?
Shall we go to the beach this weekend?
Shall we have a picnic in the park?
Shall we watch a film tonight?
Shall we stop for a coffee?
Shall we ask the teacher for help?
Shall we walk home instead of taking the bus?
Shall we invite Tom and Ann for dinner?
Shall we play a board game with the kids?
Shall we meet in front of the cinema?
Shall we try that new Thai restaurant?
Shall we share a pizza?
Shall we sit outside in the garden?
Shall we leave the dishes until tomorrow?
Shall we go cycling along the river on Saturday?
Shall we take a break and finish later?
Shall we get a taxi? It's raining.
Shall we buy Mum a present together?
What time shall we set off for the airport?
Where shall we go for our holiday?
What shall we order for the office party?
When shall we meet next week?
How shall we get to the museum?
Which film shall we see?
Who shall we invite to the barbecue?
Where shall we hang this painting?
What colour shall we paint the kitchen?
How much shall we spend on the present?
What game shall we play next?
Which bus shall we take to the city centre?
What shall we call the new puppy?

examples.heading: ① Shall we + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Shall we go to my friend's house after school?
items.zh: 我們放學後去我朋友家好嗎？

items.en: Shall we go to the beach this weekend?
items.zh: 我們這個週末去海邊好嗎？

items.en: Shall we have a picnic in the park?
items.zh: 我們在公園野餐好嗎？

items.en: Shall we watch a film tonight?
items.zh: 我們今晚看部電影好嗎？

items.en: Shall we stop for a coffee?
items.zh: 我們停下來喝杯咖啡好嗎？

items.en: Shall we ask the teacher for help?
items.zh: 我們去找老師幫忙好嗎？

items.en: Shall we walk home instead of taking the bus?
items.zh: 我們走路回家，不要搭公車，好嗎？

items.en: Shall we invite Tom and Ann for dinner?
items.zh: 我們請 Tom 和 Ann 來吃晚餐好嗎？

items.en: Shall we play a board game with the kids?
items.zh: 我們跟孩子們玩桌遊好嗎？

items.en: Shall we meet in front of the cinema?
items.zh: 我們在電影院前面碰面好嗎？

items.en: Shall we try that new Thai restaurant?
items.zh: 我們去試試那家新開的泰國餐廳好嗎？

items.en: Shall we share a pizza?
items.zh: 我們合吃一個披薩好嗎？

items.en: Shall we sit outside in the garden?
items.zh: 我們坐外面的花園好嗎？

items.en: Shall we leave the dishes until tomorrow?
items.zh: 碗盤我們明天再洗好嗎？

items.en: Shall we go cycling along the river on Saturday?
items.zh: 我們星期六沿著河邊騎腳踏車好嗎？

items.en: Shall we take a break and finish later?
items.zh: 我們休息一下，晚點再做完好嗎？

items.en: Shall we get a taxi? It's raining.
items.zh: 下雨了，我們叫計程車好嗎？

items.en: Shall we buy Mum a present together?
items.zh: 我們一起買個禮物給媽媽好嗎？

examples.heading: ② wh- 疑問詞 + shall we + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: What time shall we set off for the airport?
items.zh: 我們幾點出發去機場好？

items.en: Where shall we go for our holiday?
items.zh: 我們去哪裡度假好？

items.en: What shall we order for the office party?
items.zh: 辦公室派對我們訂什麼好？

items.en: When shall we meet next week?
items.zh: 我們下星期什麼時候碰面好？

items.en: How shall we get to the museum?
items.zh: 我們要怎麼去博物館？

items.en: Which film shall we see?
items.zh: 我們看哪部電影好？

items.en: Who shall we invite to the barbecue?
items.zh: 烤肉我們要邀請誰？

items.en: Where shall we hang this painting?
items.zh: 這幅畫我們掛哪裡好？

items.en: What colour shall we paint the kitchen?
items.zh: 廚房我們要漆什麼顏色？

items.en: How much shall we spend on the present?
items.zh: 禮物我們要花多少錢？

items.en: What game shall we play next?
items.zh: 我們接下來玩什麼遊戲？

items.en: Which bus shall we take to the city centre?
items.zh: 我們要搭哪一班公車去市中心？

items.en: What shall we call the new puppy?
items.zh: 我們幫新來的小狗取什麼名字好？

title: It begins at 8 o'clock in the evening.
translation: 它晚上 8 點開始。
name: 現在簡單式表示未來的時刻表
sentences: The class is on Monday. It starts at 6 pm and finishes at 7 pm.
The play starts at half past seven.
The football match kicks off at three.
The summer holidays start next Friday.
The concert finishes at about eleven.
Our English course ends in June.
The festival begins on the first of August.
The exams start on Tuesday morning.
The meeting finishes at half past four.
The train leaves at 7.15 tomorrow morning.
Our plane arrives in Rome at midnight.
The last bus leaves the station at eleven thirty.
The ferry departs from Dover at nine.
The coach gets to Oxford at noon.
Your flight lands at six in the evening.
The next train to Cambridge leaves from platform 4.
The museum opens at ten on Sundays.
The supermarket closes early on Christmas Eve.
The party is on Saturday at my house.
The new swimming pool opens next month.
The dentist's appointment is at twenty past two.
The library closes at five tomorrow.
My birthday is on a Friday this year.
The school trip is next Wednesday.
What time does the swimming lesson start on Thursday?
When does the next bus come?
What time does the shop open tomorrow?
When do the classes finish this term?
What time does your flight arrive?
When does the art exhibition close?
What time do the gates open for the concert?

examples.heading: ① start / begin / finish / end

items.en: The class is on Monday. It starts at 6 pm and finishes at 7 pm.
items.zh: 課在星期一，下午六點開始，七點結束。

items.en: The play starts at half past seven.
items.zh: 那齣戲七點半開始。

items.en: The football match kicks off at three.
items.zh: 足球賽三點開賽。

items.en: The summer holidays start next Friday.
items.zh: 暑假下星期五開始。

items.en: The concert finishes at about eleven.
items.zh: 演唱會大約十一點結束。

items.en: Our English course ends in June.
items.zh: 我們的英文課六月結束。

items.en: The festival begins on the first of August.
items.zh: 節慶活動八月一日開始。

items.en: The exams start on Tuesday morning.
items.zh: 考試星期二早上開始。

items.en: The meeting finishes at half past four.
items.zh: 會議四點半結束。

examples.heading: ② leave / arrive

items.en: The train leaves at 7.15 tomorrow morning.
items.zh: 火車明天早上七點十五分開。

items.en: Our plane arrives in Rome at midnight.
items.zh: 我們的飛機半夜抵達羅馬。

items.en: The last bus leaves the station at eleven thirty.
items.zh: 最後一班公車十一點半從車站開出。

items.en: The ferry departs from Dover at nine.
items.zh: 渡輪九點從多佛出發。

items.en: The coach gets to Oxford at noon.
items.zh: 遊覽車中午到牛津。

items.en: Your flight lands at six in the evening.
items.zh: 你的班機晚上六點降落。

items.en: The next train to Cambridge leaves from platform 4.
items.zh: 下一班往劍橋的火車從第四月台開出。

examples.heading: ③ open / close / be

items.en: The museum opens at ten on Sundays.
items.zh: 博物館星期天十點開門。

items.en: The supermarket closes early on Christmas Eve.
items.zh: 超市聖誕夜提早關門。

items.en: The party is on Saturday at my house.
items.zh: 派對星期六在我家舉行。

items.en: The new swimming pool opens next month.
items.zh: 新的游泳池下個月開放。

items.en: The dentist's appointment is at twenty past two.
items.zh: 看牙醫的時間是兩點二十分。

items.en: The library closes at five tomorrow.
items.zh: 圖書館明天五點關門。

items.en: My birthday is on a Friday this year.
items.zh: 我的生日今年是星期五。

items.en: The school trip is next Wednesday.
items.zh: 校外教學在下星期三。

examples.heading: ④ What time / When + does / do + 主詞 + 原形動詞?

items.en: What time does the swimming lesson start on Thursday?
items.zh: 星期四的游泳課幾點開始？

items.en: When does the next bus come?
items.zh: 下一班公車什麼時候來？

items.en: What time does the shop open tomorrow?
items.zh: 那家店明天幾點開門？

items.en: When do the classes finish this term?
items.zh: 這學期的課什麼時候結束？

items.en: What time does your flight arrive?
items.zh: 你的班機幾點到？

items.en: When does the art exhibition close?
items.zh: 美術展什麼時候閉幕？

items.en: What time do the gates open for the concert?
items.zh: 演唱會幾點開放入場？

title: My mother will drive us there.
translation: 我媽媽會開車載我們過去。
name: will 表示意願（未來式）
sentences: My aunt will drive you to the airport.
My elder sister will help us too.
Ask Tom. He'll lend you his laptop.
My uncle will fix your bike for free.
Grandma will look after the baby on Saturday.
Our neighbours will feed the cat while we're away.
My friend will show you around the city.
The teacher will explain it again if you ask.
Ann will give you a lift home.
My dad will pay for the tickets.
I'll carry the heavy bags.
I'll lend you some money until Friday.
We'll help you move to the new flat.
My brother will cook dinner tonight.
The hotel staff will call a taxi for you.
If you're lost, a police officer will help you.
Don't worry. Someone will drive you home.
My grandfather won't wear his glasses.
The baby won't drink her milk tonight.
She won't tell me what happened.
My parents won't let me go to the festival with my friends.
He won't answer his phone.
The cat won't come down from the tree.
My car won't start this morning.
The window won't close properly.
The kids won't go to bed.
The shop won't give me my money back.
The lid of this jar won't come off.
Dad won't buy me a new phone.
The dog won't walk in the rain.
My computer won't turn on.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will + 原形動詞（願意）

items.en: My aunt will drive you to the airport.
items.zh: 我阿姨會開車送你去機場。

items.en: My elder sister will help us too.
items.zh: 我姊姊也會幫我們。

items.en: Ask Tom. He'll lend you his laptop.
items.zh: 去問 Tom，他會借你他的筆電。

items.en: My uncle will fix your bike for free.
items.zh: 我叔叔會免費幫你修腳踏車。

items.en: Grandma will look after the baby on Saturday.
items.zh: 奶奶星期六會幫忙照顧寶寶。

items.en: Our neighbours will feed the cat while we're away.
items.zh: 我們不在的時候，鄰居會幫忙餵貓。

items.en: My friend will show you around the city.
items.zh: 我朋友會帶你參觀這座城市。

items.en: The teacher will explain it again if you ask.
items.zh: 你問的話，老師會再解釋一次。

items.en: Ann will give you a lift home.
items.zh: Ann 會載你回家。

items.en: My dad will pay for the tickets.
items.zh: 我爸會付票錢。

items.en: I'll carry the heavy bags.
items.zh: 重的袋子我來提。

items.en: I'll lend you some money until Friday.
items.zh: 我先借你一些錢，你星期五還我。

items.en: We'll help you move to the new flat.
items.zh: 我們會幫你搬到新公寓。

items.en: My brother will cook dinner tonight.
items.zh: 我哥今晚會煮晚餐。

items.en: The hotel staff will call a taxi for you.
items.zh: 飯店人員會幫你叫計程車。

items.en: If you're lost, a police officer will help you.
items.zh: 如果你迷路了，警察會幫你。

items.en: Don't worry. Someone will drive you home.
items.zh: 別擔心，會有人開車送你回家。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + won't + 原形動詞（不願意）

items.en: My grandfather won't wear his glasses.
items.zh: 我爺爺不肯戴眼鏡。

items.en: The baby won't drink her milk tonight.
items.zh: 寶寶今晚不肯喝奶。

items.en: She won't tell me what happened.
items.zh: 她不肯告訴我發生了什麼事。

items.en: My parents won't let me go to the festival with my friends.
items.zh: 我爸媽不准我跟朋友去音樂節。

items.en: He won't answer his phone.
items.zh: 他不肯接電話。

items.en: The cat won't come down from the tree.
items.zh: 貓不肯從樹上下來。

items.en: My car won't start this morning.
items.zh: 我的車今天早上發不動。

items.en: The window won't close properly.
items.zh: 這扇窗戶關不緊。

items.en: The kids won't go to bed.
items.zh: 孩子們不肯去睡覺。

items.en: The shop won't give me my money back.
items.zh: 那家店不肯退錢給我。

items.en: The lid of this jar won't come off.
items.zh: 這個罐子的蓋子打不開。

items.en: Dad won't buy me a new phone.
items.zh: 爸爸不肯買新手機給我。

items.en: The dog won't walk in the rain.
items.zh: 那隻狗不肯在雨中散步。

items.en: My computer won't turn on.
items.zh: 我的電腦開不了機。

title: When I saw them, I thought they would be great for tonight's party.
translation: 我一看到它們，就覺得很適合今晚的派對。
name: 用 would 的過去未來式
sentences: As soon as I saw the advert, I knew it would be a lovely birthday present.
We thought the film would be horrible because of the title.
She said she would call me after the meeting.
I was sure you would like this book.
They hoped the rain would stop before the game.
He promised he would help me move.
I thought the exam would be easy, but it wasn't.
Nobody expected that the old shop would close.
My mum said dinner would be ready at seven.
We knew the journey would take all day.
I guessed you would be hungry, so I made sandwiches.
The teacher told us the results would come out on Friday.
I felt sure that everything would be fine.
She knew her parents would worry about her.
He said the train would leave from platform two.
At that time, I never imagined I would become a teacher.
We hoped our new neighbours would be friendly.
The doctor thought I would need an operation.
I always believed that one day we would meet again.
She told me the treatise would take ten years to write.
Everyone thought the new player would score.
I hoped the weather would be warm for the trip.
I knew the shop wouldn't have my size.
He said he wouldn't be late again.
We thought the shop wouldn't be open on Sunday.
I was afraid the car wouldn't start.
She promised she wouldn't tell anyone.
They thought the bridge wouldn't be finished in time.
I knew my brother wouldn't like the idea.
We were sure it wouldn't snow in April.
He told me the meeting wouldn't last long.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + 過去式的動詞 + 主詞 + would + 原形動詞

items.en: As soon as I saw the advert, I knew it would be a lovely birthday present.
items.zh: 我一看到廣告，就知道那會是很棒的生日禮物。

items.en: We thought the film would be horrible because of the title.
items.zh: 因為片名，我們以為那部電影會很難看。

items.en: She said she would call me after the meeting.
items.zh: 她說開完會會打給我。

items.en: I was sure you would like this book.
items.zh: 我就確定你會喜歡這本書。

items.en: They hoped the rain would stop before the game.
items.zh: 他們希望比賽前雨會停。

items.en: He promised he would help me move.
items.zh: 他答應過會幫我搬家。

items.en: I thought the exam would be easy, but it wasn't.
items.zh: 我以為考試會很簡單，結果並沒有。

items.en: Nobody expected that the old shop would close.
items.zh: 沒有人料到那家老店會關門。

items.en: My mum said dinner would be ready at seven.
items.zh: 我媽說晚餐七點會好。

items.en: We knew the journey would take all day.
items.zh: 我們知道這趟路要花一整天。

items.en: I guessed you would be hungry, so I made sandwiches.
items.zh: 我猜你會餓，所以做了三明治。

items.en: The teacher told us the results would come out on Friday.
items.zh: 老師告訴我們成績星期五會公布。

items.en: I felt sure that everything would be fine.
items.zh: 我很確定一切都會沒事。

items.en: She knew her parents would worry about her.
items.zh: 她知道她爸媽會擔心她。

items.en: He said the train would leave from platform two.
items.zh: 他說火車會從第二月台開。

items.en: At that time, I never imagined I would become a teacher.
items.zh: 那時候，我從來沒想過自己會當老師。

items.en: We hoped our new neighbours would be friendly.
items.zh: 我們希望新鄰居會很友善。

items.en: The doctor thought I would need an operation.
items.zh: 醫生認為我需要動手術。

items.en: I always believed that one day we would meet again.
items.zh: 我一直相信總有一天我們會再見面。

items.en: She told me the treatise would take ten years to write.
items.zh: 她告訴我那部專論要花十年才寫得完。

items.en: Everyone thought the new player would score.
items.zh: 每個人都以為新球員會得分。

items.en: I hoped the weather would be warm for the trip.
items.zh: 我希望旅行時天氣會很暖和。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 過去式的動詞 + 主詞 + wouldn't + 原形動詞

items.en: I knew the shop wouldn't have my size.
items.zh: 我知道那家店不會有我的尺寸。

items.en: He said he wouldn't be late again.
items.zh: 他說他不會再遲到了。

items.en: We thought the shop wouldn't be open on Sunday.
items.zh: 我們以為那家店星期天不會開。

items.en: I was afraid the car wouldn't start.
items.zh: 我怕車子發不動。

items.en: She promised she wouldn't tell anyone.
items.zh: 她答應過不會告訴任何人。

items.en: They thought the bridge wouldn't be finished in time.
items.zh: 他們以為橋不會準時完工。

items.en: I knew my brother wouldn't like the idea.
items.zh: 我知道我哥不會喜歡這個主意。

items.en: We were sure it wouldn't snow in April.
items.zh: 我們很確定四月不會下雪。

items.en: He told me the meeting wouldn't last long.
items.zh: 他告訴我會議不會開很久。

title: If you should get lost, don't hesitate to call us.
translation: 萬一迷路了，請儘管打電話給我們。
name: if you should 的客氣條件句
sentences: If you should have any questions about the course, please email me.
If you should see my brother at the party, give him this book.

title: Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to ask.
translation: 如果您需要任何進一步的資訊，請不要客氣，儘管發問。
name: should 倒裝的條件子句
sentences: Should you need a taxi, ask at the front desk.
Should you lose your key card, contact reception immediately.
Should anyone call while I'm out, take a message.
Should you have any difficulty finding the office, please phone me.
Should the alarm go off, leave the building by the nearest exit.
Should you notice anything unusual, inform the security staff.
Should you wish to bring a guest, please let us know by Monday.
Should you book before May, you will get a ten percent discount.
Should the train arrive late, the hotel will hold your room.
Should it rain on Saturday, the concert will move to the town hall.
Should you choose the premium plan, you get free delivery.
Should the price drop, I will buy two.
Should the pain return, the patient takes another tablet.
Should there be any problems, please call our helpline.
Should there be a fire, the doors will open automatically.
Should there be any changes to the programme, we will post them on our website.
Should there be a lack of trust between partners, the business will fail.
Should there be any seats left, the box office will sell them at the door.
Should you not be satisfied with the product, return it within thirty days.
Should the shop not have your size, the assistant will order it for you.
Should the client not reply by Monday, send a reminder.
Should the bus not come, walk to the station.
Should your luggage be damaged, fill in this form.
Should the event be cancelled, the organizers will refund all tickets.
Should your card be stolen, call the bank at once.
Should the package be returned, we will contact you.
Should you require further details, please consult our website.
Should you glean any useful information, please share it with the team.
Should any noise become obtrusive, please inform the manager.
Should you wish to advocate a different approach, raise it at the meeting.
Should a member of staff be absent, a colleague will cover the shift.
Should you have any further questions, our staff will be happy to help.

items.zh: 如果您需要計程車，請到櫃台詢問。

items.zh: 如果您弄丟房卡，請馬上聯絡櫃台。

items.zh: 如果我出去時有人打電話來，請幫我留言。

items.zh: 如果您找不到辦公室，請打電話給我。

items.en: Should the alarm go off, leave the building by the nearest exit.
items.zh: 如果警報響了，請從最近的出口離開大樓。

items.en: Should you notice anything unusual, inform the security staff.
items.zh: 如果您注意到任何異常，請通知保全人員。

items.en: Should you wish to bring a guest, please let us know by Monday.
items.zh: 如果您想帶客人來，請在星期一前告訴我們。

examples.heading: ② 主要子句用 will 或現在式

items.zh: 如果您五月前預訂，就能打九折。

items.zh: 如果火車晚到，飯店會幫您保留房間。

items.zh: 如果星期六下雨，音樂會會改到市政廳舉行。

items.en: Should you choose the premium plan, you get free delivery.
items.zh: 如果您選高級方案，就享有免運。

items.en: Should the price drop, I will buy two.
items.zh: 如果價格下降，我會買兩個。

items.en: Should the pain return, the patient takes another tablet.
items.zh: 如果疼痛再出現，病人就再吃一顆藥。

items.en: Should there be a fire, the doors will open automatically.

items.zh: 如果節目有任何更動，我們會公布在網站上。

items.en: Should there be any seats left, the box office will sell them at the door.

items.zh: 如果您對產品不滿意，請在三十天內退回。

items.zh: 如果您的行李損壞，請填這張表格。（被動）

items.en: Should you glean any useful information, please share it with the team.
items.zh: 如果您蒐集到任何有用的資訊，請跟團隊分享。

items.zh: 如果有任何噪音干擾到您，請告訴經理。

items.zh: 如果您想主張用不同的做法，請在會議上提出。

items.zh: 如果有員工缺席，會由一位同事代班。

items.en: Should you have any further questions, our staff will be happy to help.
items.zh: 如果您還有任何問題，我們的員工很樂意幫忙。

title: It was Paul who stole the money.
translation: 偷錢的是 Paul。
name: it 分裂句（it be 加名詞加 that 子句）
sentences: It was your mum who phoned, not the school.
It was my grandmother who taught me to swim.
It's the manager who decides, not me.
It was the neighbours who called the police.
Was it your brother who left the door open?
It wasn't Tom who broke the window.
It is the nurses who keep this hospital running.
It was my dad that fixed the bike.
It's the kids that make all the noise.
It was our coach that told us to rest.
It was a stranger that found my wallet.
It's the price that worries me.
It was the smell that woke me up.
It was a small mistake that cost us the game.
It's this song that always makes her cry.
It was his kindness that I remember most.
It isn't the money that matters, it's the time.
It was in 2015 that we bought this house.
It was only last week that I heard the news.
It was after midnight that the guests finally left.
It's on Sundays that the market is busiest.
It was in this café that I met my wife.
It's at the station that you need to change trains.
It was here that the accident happened.
It was because of you that I got the job.
It's because she's tired that she's so quiet.
It was thanks to the doctors that he survived.
It was me who sent you the flowers.
It is I who should apologise, not you.
It was he who first noticed the problem.
It was them that won the prize, not us.

examples.heading: ① 焦點是人，用 who

items.en: It was your mum who phoned, not the school.
items.zh: 打電話來的是你媽，不是學校。

items.en: It was my grandmother who taught me to swim.
items.zh: 教我游泳的是我奶奶。

items.en: It's the manager who decides, not me.
items.zh: 做決定的是經理，不是我。

items.en: It was the neighbours who called the police.
items.zh: 報警的是鄰居。

items.en: Was it your brother who left the door open?
items.zh: 沒關門的是你哥哥嗎？

items.en: It wasn't Tom who broke the window.
items.zh: 打破窗戶的不是 Tom。

items.en: It is the nurses who keep this hospital running.
items.zh: 讓這間醫院撐下去的是護理師。

examples.heading: ② 焦點是人，用 that

items.en: It was my dad that fixed the bike.
items.zh: 修好腳踏車的是我爸。

items.en: It's the kids that make all the noise.
items.zh: 吵鬧的都是那些小孩。

items.en: It was our coach that told us to rest.
items.zh: 叫我們休息的是我們的教練。

items.en: It was a stranger that found my wallet.
items.zh: 撿到我錢包的是一個陌生人。

examples.heading: ③ 焦點是東西

items.en: It's the price that worries me.
items.zh: 讓我擔心的是價錢。

items.en: It was the smell that woke me up.
items.zh: 把我弄醒的是那股味道。

items.en: It was a small mistake that cost us the game.
items.zh: 讓我們輸掉比賽的是一個小失誤。

items.en: It's this song that always makes her cry.
items.zh: 總是讓她哭的是這首歌。

items.en: It was his kindness that I remember most.
items.zh: 我記得最清楚的是他的善良。

items.en: It isn't the money that matters, it's the time.
items.zh: 重要的不是錢，是時間。

examples.heading: ④ 焦點是時間

items.en: It was in 2015 that we bought this house.
items.zh: 我們是 2015 年買下這棟房子的。

items.en: It was only last week that I heard the news.
items.zh: 我上星期才聽到這個消息。

items.en: It was after midnight that the guests finally left.
items.zh: 客人是過了午夜才走的。

items.en: It's on Sundays that the market is busiest.
items.zh: 市場最熱鬧的是星期天。

examples.heading: ⑤ 焦點是地點

items.en: It was in this café that I met my wife.
items.zh: 我是在這家咖啡館認識我太太的。

items.en: It's at the station that you need to change trains.
items.zh: 你是要在車站換車。

items.en: It was here that the accident happened.
items.zh: 意外就是在這裡發生的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 焦點是原因

items.en: It was because of you that I got the job.
items.zh: 我是因為你才得到這份工作的。

items.en: It's because she's tired that she's so quiet.
items.zh: 她那麼安靜是因為她累了。

items.en: It was thanks to the doctors that he survived.
items.zh: 他是多虧了醫生才活下來的。

examples.heading: ⑦ 焦點是代名詞

items.en: It was me who sent you the flowers.
items.zh: 送你花的是我。

items.en: It is I who should apologise, not you.
items.zh: 該道歉的是我，不是你。

items.en: It was he who first noticed the problem.
items.zh: 最先發現這個問題的是他。

items.en: It was them that won the prize, not us.
items.zh: 得獎的是他們，不是我們。

title: I've already seen it.
translation: 我已經看過了。
name: just、already 等副詞表示事件時間
sentences: We've already had lunch.
She has already left for the airport.
Don't tell me the ending. I've already read the book.
They've already sold the house.
The film has already started.
I've already told you twice!
I've just got home.
The bus has just left.
My sister has just had a baby.
We've just moved to a new flat.
I've just read your email.
He has just woken up.
Yesterday I went to the dentist.
It rained all day yesterday.
Did you call your mum yesterday?
I bought this jacket yesterday.
We didn't go to work yesterday.
Yesterday was my birthday.
I'm cooking dinner now.
She lives in Berlin now.
The doctor can see you now.
We're saving money now because we want a car.
It's raining now, so let's stay inside.
My brother is a teacher now.
I just saw your brother at the shop.
She already paid for the tickets.
We just got back from the beach.
He already knew the answer.
Have you already eaten?
Has the mail just arrived?
Isn't she working now?
Why didn't you tell me yesterday?

examples.heading: ① have / has + already + 過去分詞

items.en: We've already had lunch.
items.zh: 我們已經吃過午餐了。

items.en: She has already left for the airport.
items.zh: 她已經出發去機場了。

items.en: Don't tell me the ending. I've already read the book.
items.zh: 別告訴我結局。我已經看過那本書了。

items.en: They've already sold the house.
items.zh: 他們已經把房子賣掉了。

items.en: The film has already started.
items.zh: 電影已經開始了。

items.en: I've already told you twice!
items.zh: 我已經跟你說兩次了！

examples.heading: ② have / has + just + 過去分詞

items.en: I've just got home.
items.zh: 我剛到家。

items.en: The bus has just left.
items.zh: 公車剛開走。

items.en: My sister has just had a baby.
items.zh: 我姊姊剛生了寶寶。

items.en: We've just moved to a new flat.
items.zh: 我們剛搬到新公寓。

items.en: I've just read your email.
items.zh: 我剛看了你的電子郵件。

items.en: He has just woken up.
items.zh: 他剛睡醒。

examples.heading: ③ 過去式 + yesterday

items.en: Yesterday I went to the dentist.
items.zh: 我昨天去看牙醫。

items.en: It rained all day yesterday.
items.zh: 昨天下了一整天的雨。

items.en: Did you call your mum yesterday?
items.zh: 你昨天有打電話給你媽嗎？

items.en: I bought this jacket yesterday.
items.zh: 這件夾克是我昨天買的。

items.en: We didn't go to work yesterday.
items.zh: 我們昨天沒去上班。

items.en: Yesterday was my birthday.
items.zh: 昨天是我的生日。

examples.heading: ④ 現在式、現在進行式 + now

items.en: I'm cooking dinner now.
items.zh: 我現在在煮晚餐。

items.en: She lives in Berlin now.
items.zh: 她現在住在柏林。

items.en: The doctor can see you now.
items.zh: 醫生現在可以看你了。

items.en: We're saving money now because we want a car.
items.zh: 我們現在在存錢，因為我們想買車。

items.en: It's raining now, so let's stay inside.
items.zh: 現在在下雨，我們待在室內吧。

items.en: My brother is a teacher now.
items.zh: 我哥哥現在是老師。

examples.heading: ⑤ just、already + 過去式（美式英文）

items.en: I just saw your brother at the shop.
items.zh: 我剛在商店看到你哥哥。

items.en: She already paid for the tickets.
items.zh: 她已經付了票錢。

items.en: We just got back from the beach.
items.zh: 我們剛從海灘回來。

items.en: He already knew the answer.
items.zh: 他早就知道答案了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句和否定句裡的時間副詞

items.en: Have you already eaten?
items.zh: 你已經吃過了嗎？

items.en: Has the mail just arrived?
items.zh: 信剛到嗎？

items.en: Isn't she working now?
items.zh: 她現在沒在工作嗎？

items.en: Why didn't you tell me yesterday?
items.zh: 你昨天為什麼沒跟我說？

title: It's only two hours.
translation: 才兩個小時而已。
name: 焦點副詞 only、just
sentences: The station is only five minutes away.
The tickets were only ten pounds each.
She's only six, so she can't stay up late.
Don't worry, it's only a small cut.
The button is only a little loose.
Was the film only an hour long?
The jacket was just £20 in the sale.
It's just a short walk to the beach.
We're just friends.
It was just a joke!
Is it just me, or is it cold in here?
It wasn't just the money. I didn't like the job.
I only drink coffee in the morning.
He only reads the news on his phone.
She only speaks a little Japanese.

Can I just ask one question?

examples.heading: ① be + only + 數量或名詞片語

items.en: The station is only five minutes away.
items.zh: 車站只有五分鐘的路程。

items.en: The tickets were only ten pounds each.
items.zh: 票一張才十英鎊。

items.en: She's only six, so she can't stay up late.
items.zh: 她才六歲，所以不能熬夜。

items.en: Don't worry, it's only a small cut.
items.zh: 別擔心，只是個小傷口。

items.en: The button is only a little loose.
items.zh: 釦子只是有點鬆。

items.en: Was the film only an hour long?
items.zh: 那部電影只有一個小時嗎？

examples.heading: ② be + just + 數量或名詞片語

items.zh: 那件夾克特價才二十英鎊。

items.en: It's just a short walk to the beach.
items.zh: 走到海灘只有一小段路。

items.en: We're just friends.
items.zh: 我們只是朋友。

items.en: It was just a joke!
items.zh: 只是開玩笑啦！

items.en: Is it just me, or is it cold in here?
items.zh: 是我的錯覺，還是這裡真的很冷？

items.en: It wasn't just the money. I didn't like the job.
items.zh: 不只是錢的問題。我不喜歡那份工作。

examples.heading: ③ only / just + 一般動詞

items.en: She only speaks a little Japanese.

items.en: It only took ten minutes to mend the chair.

items.en: I just need one more minute.
items.zh: 我只需要再一分鐘。

items.en: They just wanted to help.
items.zh: 他們只是想幫忙。

items.en: I just want a plain T-shirt.
items.zh: 我只想要一件素面的T恤。

examples.heading: ④ 助動詞 + only / just + 一般動詞

items.zh: 我只能待一個小時。

items.en: We could only see a small part of the lake from our room.
items.zh: 從我們的房間只看得到湖的一小部分。

items.en: The shop will only take cash.
items.zh: 這家店只收現金。

items.en: You can just leave the keys on the table.
items.zh: 你把鑰匙放在桌上就好。

items.en: Can I just ask one question?
items.zh: 我問一個問題就好，可以嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ only / just + 主詞

items.en: Only my mother knows the password.
items.zh: 只有我媽媽知道密碼。

items.en: Only two students passed the test.
items.zh: 只有兩個學生考試及格。

items.en: Only children under twelve can play here.
items.zh: 只有十二歲以下的兒童可以在這裡玩。

items.en: Just one person called me back.
items.zh: 只有一個人回我電話。

items.en: Just a few people came to the meeting.
items.zh: 只有幾個人來開會。

examples.heading: ⑥ only / just + 受詞

items.en: I had just one cup of tea.
items.zh: 我只喝了一杯茶。

items.en: He invited only a few friends to his party.
items.zh: 他只請了幾個朋友來他的派對。

items.en: We have only one bathroom.
items.zh: 我們只有一間浴室。

items.en: She packed just one small bag for the trip.
items.zh: 她這趟旅行只帶了一個小包包。

title: I like her because she is like me.
translation: 我喜歡她，因為她跟我很像。
name: be like 加名詞或代名詞
sentences: I get on well with Ann because she's like me.
He has your eyes and your laugh. Your son is just like you.
Ken is like his father. They're both very quiet.
I love sport, and she loves books. My sister isn't like me at all.
I've met both your parents now. Are you like your mother or your father?
Our neighbours have two kids and a dog too. We are like them in many ways.
Take the tram to the castle. It's like a little train that goes up the hill.
This café is like a library. Everyone is reading.
Nobody lived in the house for years. The garden was like a forest.
Mr Chen eats lunch with us and listens to our problems. Our teacher is like a friend to us.
We watched the sun go down from the beach. The sky was like fire at sunset.
She keeps old clocks and maps in every room. My grandmother's house is like a museum.
Look at their baby photos. The baby is just like her big sister.
There's a river and a small market here. This town is a bit like my hometown.
Don't mix them up! Your new phone is just like mine.
I've been in London for a month. The food here isn't like the food at home.
Max reads poems at break time. He's not like the other boys in class.
What's the food like at the new Thai restaurant?
Welcome back from your trip! What was the weather like in Tokyo?
So you moved last week. What's your new flat like?
You've got a new boss. What's she like?
You stayed by the lake last weekend. What was the hotel like?
I've always lived in the city. What's it like to live by the sea?
Now I'm quiet, but when I was young, I was like my brother. I never stopped talking.
My cousin finished the maths test in ten minutes. The test was like a game for him.
We're moving next month. Will the new office be like the old one?
She signed my T-shirt after the concert. Meeting my favorite singer was like a dream.
Try a cup. This tea is a bit like coffee.
My twin cousins both love football and hate fish. Twins are often like each other in many ways.
Look up, Mum! That cloud is like a rabbit!

examples.heading: ① be like + 代名詞

items.en: I get on well with Ann because she's like me.
items.zh: 我跟 Ann 很合得來，因為她跟我很像。

items.en: He has your eyes and your laugh. Your son is just like you.
items.zh: 他有你的眼睛和你的笑聲。你兒子跟你一模一樣。

items.en: Ken is like his father. They're both very quiet.
items.zh: Ken 跟他爸爸很像，兩個人都很安靜。

items.en: I love sport, and she loves books. My sister isn't like me at all.
items.zh: 我愛運動，她愛看書。我姊姊跟我一點都不像。

items.en: I've met both your parents now. Are you like your mother or your father?
items.zh: 我現在見過你爸媽了。你比較像你媽媽還是你爸爸？

items.en: Our neighbours have two kids and a dog too. We are like them in many ways.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居也有兩個孩子和一隻狗。我們在很多方面跟他們很像。

examples.heading: ② be like + 名詞

items.en: Take the tram to the castle. It's like a little train that goes up the hill.
items.zh: 搭電車去城堡。那像一台開上山的小火車。

items.en: This café is like a library. Everyone is reading.
items.zh: 這家咖啡店像圖書館，每個人都在看書。

items.en: Nobody lived in the house for years. The garden was like a forest.
items.zh: 那間房子好幾年沒人住。那座花園像一片森林。

items.en: Mr Chen eats lunch with us and listens to our problems. Our teacher is like a friend to us.
items.zh: 陳老師跟我們一起吃午餐，聽我們說煩惱。我們的老師對我們來說像朋友一樣。

items.en: We watched the sun go down from the beach. The sky was like fire at sunset.
items.zh: 我們在海灘上看太陽下山。夕陽西下時，天空像火一樣。

items.en: She keeps old clocks and maps in every room. My grandmother's house is like a museum.
items.zh: 她每個房間都放了舊時鐘和舊地圖。我奶奶家像一座博物館。

examples.heading: ③ just like / a bit like / not like

items.en: Look at their baby photos. The baby is just like her big sister.
items.zh: 你看她們嬰兒時期的照片。那個小寶寶跟她姊姊一模一樣。

items.en: There's a river and a small market here. This town is a bit like my hometown.
items.zh: 這裡有一條河和一個小市場。這個小鎮有點像我的家鄉。

items.en: Don't mix them up! Your new phone is just like mine.
items.zh: 別拿錯了！你的新手機跟我的一模一樣。

items.en: I've been in London for a month. The food here isn't like the food at home.
items.zh: 我在倫敦一個月了。這裡的食物跟家裡的不一樣。

items.en: Max reads poems at break time. He's not like the other boys in class.
items.zh: 麥克斯下課時間讀詩。他跟班上其他男生不一樣。

examples.heading: ④ What is ... like?

items.en: What's the food like at the new Thai restaurant?
items.zh: 新開的泰國餐廳的菜怎麼樣？

items.en: Welcome back from your trip! What was the weather like in Tokyo?
items.zh: 歡迎旅行回來！東京的天氣怎麼樣？

items.en: So you moved last week. What's your new flat like?
items.zh: 你上禮拜搬家了，新公寓怎麼樣？

items.en: You've got a new boss. What's she like?
items.zh: 你換了新主管，她人怎麼樣？

items.en: You stayed by the lake last weekend. What was the hotel like?
items.zh: 你上個週末住在湖邊。那家飯店怎麼樣？

items.en: I've always lived in the city. What's it like to live by the sea?
items.zh: 我一直住在城市裡。住在海邊是什麼感覺？

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的時態和句型

items.en: Now I'm quiet, but when I was young, I was like my brother. I never stopped talking.
items.zh: 我現在很安靜，可是我小時候跟我哥哥很像。我一直講個不停。

items.en: My cousin finished the maths test in ten minutes. The test was like a game for him.
items.zh: 我表哥十分鐘就寫完數學考試。那次考試對他來說像遊戲一樣。

items.en: We're moving next month. Will the new office be like the old one?
items.zh: 我們下個月要搬。新辦公室會跟舊的一樣嗎？

items.en: She signed my T-shirt after the concert. Meeting my favorite singer was like a dream.
items.zh: 音樂會結束後她在我的 T 恤上簽名。見到我最喜歡的歌手就像一場夢。

items.en: Try a cup. This tea is a bit like coffee.
items.zh: 喝一杯看看。這個茶喝起來有點像咖啡。

items.en: My twin cousins both love football and hate fish. Twins are often like each other in many ways.
items.zh: 我的雙胞胎表弟都愛足球、討厭魚。雙胞胎常常在很多方面很像。

items.en: Look up, Mum! That cloud is like a rabbit!
items.zh: 媽，你看上面！那朵雲像一隻兔子！

title: The price of the watch also contributes to my love of it, however small it may be.
translation: 不管旅行看起來多有用，事實證明，在開闊眼界這方面，旅行根本沒有用。
name: however … may be 的讓步子句
sentences: I still love my old bike, however slow it may be.
However difficult it may be, I'm going to finish the race.
Every vote counts, however small the village may be.
However tired you may be, you should always brush your teeth.
However hard the work may be, she never complains.
Thank everyone who helped, however little they may have done.
However useful travel may seem, it doesn't always broaden the mind.
However strange it may seem, I miss the rainy weather in London.
However easy the job may seem, it needs a lot of care.
However expensive it may seem, the course is good value.
However boring it may seem, the history of the town is worth learning.
However far away the trip may seem, it will soon be here.
The most important thing is that people enjoy what they do, whatever it may be.
Many people want success, in whatever field it may be.
Whatever the reason may be, he's late again.
Whatever the problem may be, we'll solve it together.
I'll support your decision, whatever it may be.
Whatever the weather may be, the festival will go ahead.
Whoever the new manager may be, they'll have a lot of work.
Whoever you may be, you're welcome here.
The winner, whoever it may be, will get a trip to Paris.
Whoever they may be, they shouldn't park in front of my garage.
I want to thank the person who found my bag, whoever it may be.
Whoever the teacher may be, the class will be fun.
People should enjoy their work, wherever it may take place.
Wherever you may go, remember your home.
Whenever it may happen, we'll be ready.
Wherever they may live, children need good schools.
Whenever you may need the car, just ask.
Wherever the meeting may be, I'll be there on time.
Whenever the baby may arrive, her room is ready.

examples.heading: ① however + 形容詞 + it may be

items.en: I still love my old bike, however slow it may be.
items.zh: 不管我的舊腳踏車有多慢，我還是很喜歡它。

items.en: However difficult it may be, I'm going to finish the race.
items.zh: 不管有多難，我都要跑完這場比賽。

items.en: Every vote counts, however small the village may be.
items.zh: 不管村子有多小，每一票都算數。

items.en: However tired you may be, you should always brush your teeth.
items.zh: 不管你有多累，你都應該刷牙。

items.en: However hard the work may be, she never complains.
items.zh: 不管工作有多辛苦，她從來不抱怨。

items.en: Thank everyone who helped, however little they may have done.
items.zh: 不管別人幫了多少，都要謝謝每個幫過你的人。

examples.heading: ② however + 形容詞 + it may seem

items.en: However useful travel may seem, it doesn't always broaden the mind.
items.zh: 不管旅行看起來有多有用，它不一定能開闊心胸。

items.en: However strange it may seem, I miss the rainy weather in London.
items.zh: 不管這看起來有多奇怪，我想念倫敦的下雨天。

items.en: However easy the job may seem, it needs a lot of care.
items.zh: 不管這份工作看起來有多簡單，它需要很仔細。

items.en: However expensive it may seem, the course is good value.
items.zh: 不管這門課看起來有多貴，它很划算。

items.en: However boring it may seem, the history of the town is worth learning.
items.zh: 不管看起來有多無聊，這個鎮的歷史值得學。

items.en: However far away the trip may seem, it will soon be here.
items.zh: 不管那次旅行看起來還有多久，很快就會到了。

examples.heading: ③ whatever + 主詞 + may be

items.en: The most important thing is that people enjoy what they do, whatever it may be.
items.zh: 最重要的是，人們喜歡自己做的事，不管是什麼事。

items.en: Many people want success, in whatever field it may be.
items.zh: 很多人想要成功，不管是在哪一個領域。

items.en: Whatever the reason may be, he's late again.
items.zh: 不管理由是什麼，他又遲到了。

items.en: Whatever the problem may be, we'll solve it together.
items.zh: 不管問題是什麼，我們一起解決。

items.en: I'll support your decision, whatever it may be.
items.zh: 不管你的決定是什麼，我都支持。

items.en: Whatever the weather may be, the festival will go ahead.
items.zh: 不管天氣如何，節慶都會照常舉行。

examples.heading: ④ whoever + 主詞 + may be

items.en: Whoever the new manager may be, they'll have a lot of work.
items.zh: 不管新經理是誰，都會有很多工作。

items.en: Whoever you may be, you're welcome here.
items.zh: 不管你是誰，這裡都歡迎你。

items.en: The winner, whoever it may be, will get a trip to Paris.
items.zh: 不管得獎的是誰，都會得到一趟巴黎之旅。

items.en: Whoever they may be, they shouldn't park in front of my garage.
items.zh: 不管他們是誰，都不應該把車停在我的車庫前面。

items.en: I want to thank the person who found my bag, whoever it may be.
items.zh: 我想謝謝撿到我包包的人，不管那個人是誰。

items.en: Whoever the teacher may be, the class will be fun.
items.zh: 不管老師是誰，這堂課都會很有趣。

examples.heading: ⑤ wherever / whenever + 主詞 + may + 原形動詞

items.en: People should enjoy their work, wherever it may take place.
items.zh: 不管在哪裡工作，人們都應該喜歡自己的工作。

items.en: Wherever you may go, remember your home.
items.zh: 不管你去哪裡，都要記得你的家。

items.en: Whenever it may happen, we'll be ready.
items.zh: 不管什麼時候發生，我們都會準備好。

items.en: Wherever they may live, children need good schools.
items.zh: 不管住在哪裡，孩子都需要好學校。

items.en: Whenever you may need the car, just ask.
items.zh: 不管你什麼時候需要用車，說一聲就好。

items.en: Wherever the meeting may be, I'll be there on time.
items.zh: 不管會議在哪裡開，我都會準時到。

items.en: Whenever the baby may arrive, her room is ready.
items.zh: 不管寶寶什麼時候出生，她的房間都準備好了。

examples.heading: ① I / we / they + can + 原形動詞

items.zh: 晚餐後我可以幫你寫功課。

items.en: We can take the bus to the city centre.
items.zh: 我們可以搭公車去市中心。

items.en: They can stay at our house for the weekend.
items.zh: 他們週末可以住我們家。

items.en: I can lend you my umbrella until tomorrow.
items.zh: 我可以把傘借你到明天。

items.en: We can have a picnic in the garden.
items.zh: 我們可以在花園裡野餐。
