You could call me when you arrive.
We could watch a football match on Sunday.
You could come by train, and I could pick you up.
We could cook dinner, and you could choose the film.
I could buy the drinks, and you could bring the snacks.
You could fly to Madrid, and we could drive to the coast together.
She could wash the dishes, and he could dry them.
My grandmother could knit very quickly.
I could run very fast at school.
She could speak French when she was a child.
We could see the sea from our old house.
He could sing really well.
My cat could open the kitchen door.
They could play the piano and the violin.
That could be the wrong address.
It could be cold in the evening.
The tickets could sell out quickly.
You could be right.
The trip could take four hours.
I could help you with your bags.
He could show you the city.
It could rain tomorrow.
They could meet us at the hotel.
She could lend you a map.

examples.heading: ① 建議：主詞 + could + 原形動詞

items.en: You could take a taxi from the airport.
items.zh: 你可以從機場搭計程車。

items.en: We could visit the royal palace.
items.zh: 我們可以去參觀皇宮。

items.en: You could stay at my flat.
items.zh: 你可以住我家。

items.en: We could have lunch in the old market.
items.zh: 我們可以在舊市場吃午餐。

items.en: You could bring your guitar.
items.zh: 你可以帶你的吉他來。

items.en: We could walk around the park in the afternoon.
items.zh: 我們下午可以在公園裡散步。

items.en: You could call me when you arrive.
items.zh: 你到了可以打給我。

items.en: We could watch a football match on Sunday.
items.zh: 我們星期天可以去看足球賽。

examples.heading: ② 兩個 could，用 and 連起來

items.en: You could come by train, and I could pick you up.
items.zh: 你可以搭火車來，我可以去接你。

items.en: We could cook dinner, and you could choose the film.
items.zh: 我們可以煮晚餐，你可以挑電影。

items.en: I could buy the drinks, and you could bring the snacks.
items.zh: 我可以買飲料，你可以帶零食。

items.en: You could fly to Madrid, and we could drive to the coast together.
items.zh: 你可以飛到馬德里，我們再一起開車去海邊。

items.en: She could wash the dishes, and he could dry them.
items.zh: 她可以洗碗，他可以擦乾。

examples.heading: ③ 過去的能力：主詞 + could + 原形動詞

items.en: My grandmother could knit very quickly.
items.zh: 我奶奶織毛線織得很快。

items.en: I could run very fast at school.
items.zh: 我上學的時候跑得很快。

items.en: She could speak French when she was a child.
items.zh: 她小時候會說法文。

items.en: We could see the sea from our old house.
items.zh: 我們以前的房子看得到海。

items.en: He could sing really well.
items.zh: 他以前唱歌很好聽。

items.en: My cat could open the kitchen door.
items.zh: 我的貓會開廚房的門。

items.en: They could play the piano and the violin.
items.zh: 他們會彈鋼琴，也會拉小提琴。

examples.heading: ④ 可能：主詞 + could + 原形動詞

items.en: That could be the wrong address.
items.zh: 那可能是錯的地址。

items.en: It could be cold in the evening.
items.zh: 晚上可能會冷。

items.en: The tickets could sell out quickly.
items.zh: 票可能很快就會賣完。

items.en: You could be right.
items.zh: 你可能是對的。

items.en: The trip could take four hours.
items.zh: 這趟路可能要四個小時。

examples.heading: ⑤ 所有主詞都用 could

items.en: I could help you with your bags.
items.zh: 我可以幫你拿行李。

items.en: He could show you the city.
items.zh: 他可以帶你逛逛這座城市。

items.en: It could rain tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天可能會下雨。

items.en: They could meet us at the hotel.
items.zh: 他們可以在飯店跟我們碰面。

items.en: She could lend you a map.
items.zh: 她可以借你一張地圖。

title: I can cook if you dare eat it!
translation: 只要你敢吃，我就煮給你吃！
name: dare 加原形動詞
sentences: You can borrow my bike, if you dare ride it down that hill.
I'll show you the photos, if you dare look at them.
Come to the haunted house with us, if you dare go inside.
I'll tell you the truth, if you dare hear it.
Try my grandmother's chilli sauce, if you dare taste it.
I'll take you up the tower, if you dare look down.
Jump into the lake, if you dare swim in cold water.
I'll lend you the horror film, if you dare watch it alone.
Ask the boss for a pay rise, if you dare speak to him.
Dare we ask him for help again?
Dare I say it, the new menu is better than the old one.
Dare we go out in this storm?
Dare I ask how much it cost?
Dare we hope that the war will end soon?
Dare I suggest that we take a short break?
Dare you tell your mother what you did?
Nobody dare say a word when the headteacher is angry.
No one dare touch the old man's car.
Few people dare swim in that river.
Nobody in the office dare argue with her.
No one dare walk through the forest at night.
Hardly anyone dare ask him a question.
Few students dare speak in his class.
She dares to say what everyone else is thinking.
He is the only one who dares to disagree with the manager.
Not many people dare to live alone in the mountains.
My little brother dares to climb the tallest tree in the park.
Only a few journalists dare to write about the problem.
She never dares to sing in front of other people.
Who dares to tell him the bad news?
We finally dared to ask for a bigger flat.

examples.heading: ① if + 主詞 + dare + 原形動詞

items.en: You can borrow my bike, if you dare ride it down that hill.
items.zh: 如果你敢騎它下那個坡，我的腳踏車就借你。

items.en: I'll show you the photos, if you dare look at them.
items.zh: 如果你敢看，我就給你看照片。

items.en: Come to the haunted house with us, if you dare go inside.
items.zh: 如果你敢進去，就跟我們去鬼屋。

items.en: I'll tell you the truth, if you dare hear it.
items.zh: 如果你敢聽，我就告訴你實話。

items.en: Try my grandmother's chilli sauce, if you dare taste it.
items.zh: 如果你敢嚐，就試試我奶奶的辣椒醬。

items.en: I'll take you up the tower, if you dare look down.
items.zh: 如果你敢往下看，我就帶你上塔頂。

items.en: Jump into the lake, if you dare swim in cold water.
items.zh: 如果你敢在冷水裡游泳，就跳進湖裡。

items.en: I'll lend you the horror film, if you dare watch it alone.
items.zh: 如果你敢一個人看，我就把那部恐怖片借你。

items.en: Ask the boss for a pay rise, if you dare speak to him.
items.zh: 如果你敢跟老闆說話，就去跟他要求加薪。

examples.heading: ② Dare + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Dare we ask him for help again?
items.zh: 我們敢再請他幫忙嗎？

items.en: Dare I say it, the new menu is better than the old one.
items.zh: 恕我直言，新菜單比舊菜單好。

items.en: Dare we go out in this storm?
items.zh: 這種暴風雨我們敢出門嗎？

items.en: Dare I ask how much it cost?
items.zh: 我可以冒昧問一下這花了多少錢嗎？

items.en: Dare we hope that the war will end soon?
items.zh: 我們敢希望戰爭很快就會結束嗎？

items.en: Dare I suggest that we take a short break?
items.zh: 我可以冒昧建議我們休息一下嗎？

items.en: Dare you tell your mother what you did?
items.zh: 你敢跟你媽說你做了什麼嗎？

examples.heading: ③ nobody / no one / few people / hardly anyone + dare + 原形動詞

items.en: Nobody dare say a word when the headteacher is angry.
items.zh: 校長生氣的時候，沒有人敢說一句話。

items.en: No one dare touch the old man's car.
items.zh: 沒有人敢碰那個老人的車。

items.en: Few people dare swim in that river.
items.zh: 很少人敢在那條河裡游泳。

items.en: Nobody in the office dare argue with her.
items.zh: 辦公室裡沒有人敢跟她爭論。

items.en: No one dare walk through the forest at night.
items.zh: 沒有人敢在晚上走過那片森林。

items.en: Hardly anyone dare ask him a question.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有人敢問他問題。

items.en: Few students dare speak in his class.
items.zh: 在他的課上，很少學生敢說話。

examples.heading: ④ 一般動詞：主詞 + dare / dares + to + 原形動詞

items.en: She dares to say what everyone else is thinking.
items.zh: 她敢說出別人心裡想的事。

items.en: He is the only one who dares to disagree with the manager.
items.zh: 他是唯一敢跟經理唱反調的人。

items.en: Not many people dare to live alone in the mountains.
items.zh: 敢一個人住在山上的人不多。

items.en: My little brother dares to climb the tallest tree in the park.
items.zh: 我弟敢爬公園裡最高的樹。

items.en: Only a few journalists dare to write about the problem.
items.zh: 只有少數記者敢寫這個問題。

items.en: She never dares to sing in front of other people.
items.zh: 她從來不敢在別人面前唱歌。

items.en: Who dares to tell him the bad news?
items.zh: 誰敢告訴他這個壞消息？

items.en: We finally dared to ask for a bigger flat.
items.zh: 我們終於敢開口要求一間大一點的公寓。

title: This weekend I have to go to a party.
translation: 這個週末我得去參加一個派對。
name: have (got) to 的肯定句
sentences: I have to be at the dentist's at nine tomorrow.
You have to bring your swimming things on Friday.
We have to take our shoes off when we go into the temple.
They have to wear a uniform at their new school.
I have to finish my homework before I can play football.
On Sundays we have to visit my grandparents.
You have to turn left at the bank to find the cafe.
We'll meet at four because my mum has to go to the shopping centre then.
My dad has to get up at five for work.
My little sister has to go to bed at eight.
Our teacher has to mark sixty tests this weekend.
The dog has to go out twice a day.
Tom has to take the bus because his bike is broken.
For the art lessons we've got to bring a rubber, two pencils and some coloured pencils.
It's going to be very sunny, so you've got to bring a cap.
I've got to phone my mum. She's waiting for me.
She's got to practise the piano every evening.
We've got to buy a present for Jack's birthday.
He's got to leave early to catch his train.
They've got to tidy the classroom before they go home.
Yesterday I had to go back home for my keys.
We had to walk home because it was too late for a taxi.
She had to stay in bed for a week when she broke her leg.
Last year my brother had to share a room with me.
We had to leave the beach early because of the rain.
If you want to come camping, you'll have to ask your mum.
We'll have to get up early to see the sunrise.
The shop is closed, so I'll have to buy milk tomorrow.
You'll have to wear warm clothes. It's cold up the mountain.
Next year she'll have to take the train to school.
If it rains, we'll have to stay inside.

examples.heading: ① I / you / we / they + have to + 原形動詞

items.en: I have to be at the dentist's at nine tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天九點必須到牙醫診所。

items.en: You have to bring your swimming things on Friday.
items.zh: 星期五你必須帶游泳用品。

items.en: We have to take our shoes off when we go into the temple.
items.zh: 我們進寺廟的時候必須脫鞋。

items.en: They have to wear a uniform at their new school.
items.zh: 他們在新學校必須穿制服。

items.en: I have to finish my homework before I can play football.
items.zh: 我必須先寫完功課才能去踢足球。

items.en: On Sundays we have to visit my grandparents.
items.zh: 星期天我們必須去看我的祖父母。

items.en: You have to turn left at the bank to find the cafe.
items.zh: 要找那家咖啡館，你必須在銀行左轉。

examples.heading: ② he / she / it + has to + 原形動詞

items.en: We'll meet at four because my mum has to go to the shopping centre then.
items.zh: 我們四點見面，因為我媽媽那時候必須去購物中心。

items.en: My dad has to get up at five for work.
items.zh: 我爸爸為了上班必須五點起床。

items.en: My little sister has to go to bed at eight.
items.zh: 我妹妹必須八點上床睡覺。

items.en: Our teacher has to mark sixty tests this weekend.
items.zh: 我們老師這個週末必須改六十份考卷。

items.en: The dog has to go out twice a day.
items.zh: 那隻狗一天必須出去兩次。

items.en: Tom has to take the bus because his bike is broken.
items.zh: 湯姆必須搭公車，因為他的腳踏車壞了。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + have got to / has got to + 原形動詞

items.en: For the art lessons we've got to bring a rubber, two pencils and some coloured pencils.
items.zh: 上美術課我們必須帶一塊橡皮擦、兩支鉛筆和一些色鉛筆。

items.en: It's going to be very sunny, so you've got to bring a cap.
items.zh: 天氣會很晴朗，所以你必須帶一頂帽子。

items.en: I've got to phone my mum. She's waiting for me.
items.zh: 我必須打電話給我媽媽。她在等我。

items.en: She's got to practise the piano every evening.
items.zh: 她每天晚上必須練鋼琴。

items.en: We've got to buy a present for Jack's birthday.
items.zh: 我們必須幫傑克買生日禮物。

items.en: He's got to leave early to catch his train.
items.zh: 他必須早點走才趕得上火車。

items.en: They've got to tidy the classroom before they go home.
items.zh: 他們回家前必須整理教室。

examples.heading: ④ had to + 原形動詞：過去必須

items.en: Yesterday I had to go back home for my keys.
items.zh: 昨天我必須回家拿鑰匙。

items.en: We had to walk home because it was too late for a taxi.
items.zh: 太晚叫不到計程車，我們只好走路回家。

items.en: She had to stay in bed for a week when she broke her leg.
items.zh: 她摔斷腿的時候必須在床上躺一個星期。

items.en: Last year my brother had to share a room with me.
items.zh: 去年我哥哥必須跟我住同一個房間。

items.en: We had to leave the beach early because of the rain.
items.zh: 因為下雨，我們必須提早離開海灘。

examples.heading: ⑤ will have to + 原形動詞：未來必須

items.en: If you want to come camping, you'll have to ask your mum.
items.zh: 如果你想來露營，你必須問你媽媽。

items.en: We'll have to get up early to see the sunrise.
items.zh: 我們必須早起才看得到日出。

items.en: The shop is closed, so I'll have to buy milk tomorrow.
items.zh: 商店關了，所以我必須明天再買牛奶。

items.en: You'll have to wear warm clothes. It's cold up the mountain.
items.zh: 你必須穿保暖的衣服。山上很冷。

items.en: Next year she'll have to take the train to school.
items.zh: 明年她必須搭火車上學。

items.en: If it rains, we'll have to stay inside.
items.zh: 如果下雨，我們必須待在室內。

title: I think it may be dirty.
translation: 我覺得它可能髒了。
name: may 的肯定句
sentences: Can I take my winter clothes on the trip? I may need them in the mountains.
Bring some money with you. We may need it for the bus.
I may be a little late tonight. The traffic is bad.
We may go to the beach on Sunday if it's sunny.
I may stop at the bakery on my way home.
We may paint the kitchen yellow this spring.
Check the bread first. It may be past its date.
Ask Tom. He may know the answer.
My sister may join us for lunch after her swimming lesson.
Take an umbrella. It may rain later.
The shop may be closed now. It's after six.
My brother may visit us at Christmas.
Try this cake. You may like it.
They may be at home. Let's phone them.
You may find the book in the library.
They may buy a new car this year.
You may need a jacket. It's cold in the evenings.
The children may be hungry after the walk.
That woman may be our new teacher.
The answer may be on page ten.
The film may be too long for the kids.
This may be the best day of the holiday.
He may be tired after the long flight.
The water may be cold in the morning.
I may stay at home tonight because I've got a cold.
We may eat outside because it's such a nice day.
She may take the train because the car is broken.
They may cancel the match because of the snow.
You may get lost, so take a map.
I may buy those shoes because they're on sale.
The baby may wake up, so please be quiet.

examples.heading: ① I / we + may + 原形動詞

items.en: Can I take my winter clothes on the trip? I may need them in the mountains.
items.zh: 我可以帶冬天的衣服去旅行嗎？在山上我可能會需要它們。

items.en: Bring some money with you. We may need it for the bus.
items.zh: 帶一點錢在身上。我們搭公車可能會需要。

items.en: I may be a little late tonight. The traffic is bad.
items.zh: 我今天晚上可能會晚一點到。交通很糟。

items.en: We may go to the beach on Sunday if it's sunny.
items.zh: 如果星期天天氣晴朗，我們可能會去海灘。

items.en: I may stop at the bakery on my way home.
items.zh: 我回家的路上可能會去麵包店。

items.en: We may paint the kitchen yellow this spring.
items.zh: 我們今年春天可能會把廚房漆成黃色。

examples.heading: ② he / she / it + may + 原形動詞

items.en: Check the bread first. It may be past its date.
items.zh: 先看一下麵包，它可能過期了。

items.en: Ask Tom. He may know the answer.
items.zh: 問湯姆。他可能知道答案。

items.en: My sister may join us for lunch after her swimming lesson.
items.zh: 我妹妹上完游泳課可能會來跟我們吃午餐。

items.en: Take an umbrella. It may rain later.
items.zh: 帶把傘。等一下可能會下雨。

items.en: The shop may be closed now. It's after six.
items.zh: 那家店現在可能關了。已經過六點了。

items.en: My brother may visit us at Christmas.
items.zh: 我哥哥聖誕節可能會來看我們。

examples.heading: ③ you / they + may + 原形動詞

items.en: Try this cake. You may like it.
items.zh: 吃吃看這個蛋糕。你可能會喜歡。

items.en: They may be at home. Let's phone them.
items.zh: 他們可能在家。我們打電話給他們吧。

items.en: You may find the book in the library.
items.zh: 你可能會在圖書館找到那本書。

items.en: They may buy a new car this year.
items.zh: 他們今年可能會買新車。

items.en: You may need a jacket. It's cold in the evenings.
items.zh: 你可能會需要外套。傍晚很冷。

items.en: The children may be hungry after the walk.
items.zh: 走完路孩子們可能會餓。

examples.heading: ④ may be + 名詞或形容詞

items.en: That woman may be our new teacher.
items.zh: 那位女士可能是我們的新老師。

items.en: The answer may be on page ten.
items.zh: 答案可能在第十頁。

items.en: The film may be too long for the kids.
items.zh: 這部電影對孩子們來說可能太長了。

items.en: This may be the best day of the holiday.
items.zh: 這可能是假期裡最棒的一天。

items.en: He may be tired after the long flight.
items.zh: 長途飛行後他可能會很累。

items.en: The water may be cold in the morning.
items.zh: 早上水可能會很冷。

examples.heading: ⑤ may + 原形動詞 + 理由

items.en: I may stay at home tonight because I've got a cold.
items.zh: 我今天晚上可能會待在家，因為我感冒了。

items.en: We may eat outside because it's such a nice day.
items.zh: 天氣這麼好，我們可能會在外面吃。

items.en: She may take the train because the car is broken.
items.zh: 車子壞了，她可能會搭火車。

items.en: They may cancel the match because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，他們可能會取消比賽。

items.en: You may get lost, so take a map.
items.zh: 你可能會迷路，所以帶一張地圖。

items.en: I may buy those shoes because they're on sale.
items.zh: 那雙鞋在特價，我可能會買。

items.en: The baby may wake up, so please be quiet.
items.zh: 寶寶可能會醒來，所以請安靜一點。

title: I think it might be in your bedroom.
translation: 我想它可能在你的房間裡。
name: might 的肯定句
sentences: Have you checked the kitchen? Your keys might be by the kettle.
Your jacket might be in the car.
The tickets might be in my other bag.
Ask Dad. The scissors might be in his toolbox.
The remote control might be behind the cushions.
My glasses might be next to the bed.
Pack a hat and sun cream. The weather might be hot and sunny.
Take a sweater. It might be cold in the evening.
The beach might be busy on Sunday.
The soup might be too spicy for the children.
The test might be easier than you think.
The shop might be closed on a holiday.
I might go to the cinema tonight.
We might buy a dog next year.
She might call you later.
They might come to the party on Saturday.
I might learn to play the guitar this summer.
My cousin might stay with us for a week.
I think it might rain this afternoon.
I think she might be at the library.
I think he might like this book.
I think we might be late for the film.
I think they might need some help.
I think this might be the right road.
It might snow, so wear your boots.
The baby might be hungry, so I'll make some milk.
We might get lost, so let's take a map.
The bus might be full, so let's leave early.
You might need some money, so take this.
The film might be scary, so don't watch it alone.
Grandma might feel lonely, so let's visit her on Sunday.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + might + be + 地方：東西可能在哪裡

items.en: Have you checked the kitchen? Your keys might be by the kettle.
items.zh: 你看過廚房了嗎？你的鑰匙可能在水壺旁邊。

items.en: Your jacket might be in the car.
items.zh: 你的外套可能在車上。

items.en: The tickets might be in my other bag.
items.zh: 票可能在我另一個包包裡。

items.en: Ask Dad. The scissors might be in his toolbox.
items.zh: 問爸爸。剪刀可能在他的工具箱裡。

items.en: The remote control might be behind the cushions.
items.zh: 遙控器可能在靠墊後面。

items.en: My glasses might be next to the bed.
items.zh: 我的眼鏡可能在床旁邊。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + might + be + 形容詞：天氣和情況

items.en: Pack a hat and sun cream. The weather might be hot and sunny.
items.zh: 帶帽子和防曬乳。天氣可能會又熱又晴朗。

items.en: Take a sweater. It might be cold in the evening.
items.zh: 帶一件毛衣。傍晚可能會冷。

items.en: The beach might be busy on Sunday.
items.zh: 星期天海灘可能會很多人。

items.en: The soup might be too spicy for the children.
items.zh: 這個湯對孩子們來說可能太辣了。

items.en: The test might be easier than you think.
items.zh: 考試可能比你想的簡單。

items.en: The shop might be closed on a holiday.
items.zh: 放假日那家店可能沒開。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + might + 原形動詞：以後可能做的事

items.en: I might go to the cinema tonight.
items.zh: 我今天晚上可能會去看電影。

items.en: We might buy a dog next year.
items.zh: 我們明年可能會養一隻狗。

items.en: She might call you later.
items.zh: 她晚一點可能會打給你。

items.en: They might come to the party on Saturday.
items.zh: 他們星期六可能會來派對。

items.en: I might learn to play the guitar this summer.
items.zh: 這個夏天我可能會學彈吉他。

items.en: My cousin might stay with us for a week.
items.zh: 我表哥可能會來我們家住一個星期。

examples.heading: ④ I think + 主詞 + might + 原形動詞

items.en: I think it might rain this afternoon.
items.zh: 我想今天下午可能會下雨。

items.en: I think she might be at the library.
items.zh: 我想她可能在圖書館。

items.en: I think he might like this book.
items.zh: 我想他可能會喜歡這本書。

items.en: I think we might be late for the film.
items.zh: 我想我們看電影可能會遲到。

items.en: I think they might need some help.
items.zh: 我想他們可能需要一些幫忙。

items.en: I think this might be the right road.
items.zh: 我想這可能是對的路。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + might + 原形動詞, so + 句子

items.en: It might snow, so wear your boots.
items.zh: 可能會下雪，所以穿你的靴子。

items.en: The baby might be hungry, so I'll make some milk.
items.zh: 寶寶可能餓了，所以我會泡一點奶。

items.en: We might get lost, so let's take a map.
items.zh: 我們可能會迷路，所以帶一張地圖吧。

items.en: The bus might be full, so let's leave early.
items.zh: 公車可能會客滿，所以我們早點出發吧。

items.en: You might need some money, so take this.
items.zh: 你可能會需要一點錢，所以拿著這個。

items.en: The film might be scary, so don't watch it alone.
items.zh: 那部電影可能很可怕，所以不要一個人看。

items.en: Grandma might feel lonely, so let's visit her on Sunday.
items.zh: 奶奶可能會覺得寂寞，所以我們星期天去看她吧。

title: You must wear your sports shoes and you must also bring your racket!
translation: 你一定要穿運動鞋，也一定要帶球拍！
name: must 的肯定句
sentences: We're going hiking on Sunday. You must bring a waterproof jacket!
The pool has new rules this year. You must bring your swimming hat.
You're coming to my house on Friday? You must try my mum's chocolate cake.
The concert hall fills up fast. You must come early to get a good seat.
It's late and the roads are dark. You must call me when you get home.
You're visiting my town next month? You must see the new park. It's beautiful.
My mum is waiting for me. I must be back at a quarter past ten.
Sorry, I can't come to the cinema. I must study for my English test tonight.
My sister turns twelve on Saturday. I must buy a present for her.
My friends are coming at five. I must clean my room before they arrive.
My parents are away this weekend. I must remember to feed the cat.
I can't stay at the party. I must go to bed early. I have a match tomorrow.
It's ten to eight. We must leave now or we'll miss the bus.
Shh, Mum just put the baby down. We must be quiet.
The teacher is coming back after the break. We must tidy the classroom before the bell.
There's no bread left. We must buy some for breakfast tomorrow.
It was so good to see you after all these years. We must meet again soon.
Look at the sky over the sea! We must take some photos of the sunset.
My grandma has a bad chest infection. She must take her medicine three times a day.
My brother can't see small letters well. He must wear glasses for reading.
The football fans are queuing outside the stadium. They must show their tickets at the gate.
My tennis club is very traditional. Players must wear white shirts there.
Our street has no lights. The children must be home before dark.
The school trip is to a farm with no café. Everyone must bring a packed lunch.
I still need milk for the cake. I must hurry because the shop closes at six.
Are you going out to play? You must wear a coat because it's very cold outside.
Look at the garden, it's so dry. We must water the plants because it hasn't rained for weeks.
I'll do my homework later. I must phone my grandma first because it's her birthday.
The match is at midday in July. You must drink lots of water because it's so hot.
My aunt is going to London tomorrow. She must get up early because her train leaves at seven.
Let's have dinner at Rosa's on Friday. We must book a table because it's always full.

examples.heading: ① You must + 原形動詞：提醒朋友

items.en: We're going hiking on Sunday. You must bring a waterproof jacket!
items.zh: 我們星期天要去健行。你一定要帶防水外套！

items.en: The pool has new rules this year. You must bring your swimming hat.
items.zh: 游泳池今年有新規定。你一定要帶泳帽。

items.en: You're coming to my house on Friday? You must try my mum's chocolate cake.
items.zh: 你星期五要來我家？你一定要吃吃看我媽媽做的巧克力蛋糕。

items.en: The concert hall fills up fast. You must come early to get a good seat.
items.zh: 音樂廳很快就會坐滿。你一定要早點來才有好位子。

items.en: It's late and the roads are dark. You must call me when you get home.
items.zh: 很晚了，路上又暗。你到家的時候一定要打電話給我。

items.en: You're visiting my town next month? You must see the new park. It's beautiful.
items.zh: 你下個月要來我住的城市？你一定要去看看新的公園。很漂亮。

examples.heading: ② I must + 原形動詞：自己必須做的事

items.en: My mum is waiting for me. I must be back at a quarter past ten.
items.zh: 我媽媽在等我。我必須十點十五分回到家。

items.en: Sorry, I can't come to the cinema. I must study for my English test tonight.
items.zh: 抱歉，我不能去看電影。我今天晚上必須準備英文考試。

items.en: My sister turns twelve on Saturday. I must buy a present for her.
items.zh: 我妹妹星期六滿十二歲。我必須買禮物給她。

items.en: My friends are coming at five. I must clean my room before they arrive.
items.zh: 我朋友五點會來。他們到之前，我必須打掃房間。

items.en: My parents are away this weekend. I must remember to feed the cat.
items.zh: 我爸媽這個週末不在家。我必須記得餵貓。

items.en: I can't stay at the party. I must go to bed early. I have a match tomorrow.
items.zh: 我不能留在派對。我必須早點睡覺。我明天有比賽。

examples.heading: ③ We must + 原形動詞：大家必須做的事

items.en: It's ten to eight. We must leave now or we'll miss the bus.
items.zh: 七點五十了。我們必須現在走，不然會錯過公車。

items.en: Shh, Mum just put the baby down. We must be quiet.
items.zh: 噓，媽媽剛哄寶寶睡著。我們必須安靜。

items.en: The teacher is coming back after the break. We must tidy the classroom before the bell.
items.zh: 老師下課後會回來。鐘響前我們必須整理教室。

items.en: There's no bread left. We must buy some for breakfast tomorrow.
items.zh: 麵包吃完了。我們必須買一些當明天的早餐。

items.en: It was so good to see you after all these years. We must meet again soon.
items.zh: 這麼多年後見到你真好。我們一定要很快再見面。

items.en: Look at the sky over the sea! We must take some photos of the sunset.
items.zh: 看海上的天空！我們一定要拍幾張夕陽的照片。

examples.heading: ④ He / She / They + must + 原形動詞

items.en: My grandma has a bad chest infection. She must take her medicine three times a day.
items.zh: 我奶奶胸腔感染很嚴重。她一天必須吃三次藥。

items.en: My brother can't see small letters well. He must wear glasses for reading.
items.zh: 我哥哥看不清楚小字。他看書必須戴眼鏡。

items.en: The football fans are queuing outside the stadium. They must show their tickets at the gate.
items.zh: 球迷在體育場外面排隊。他們必須在門口出示門票。

items.en: My tennis club is very traditional. Players must wear white shirts there.
items.zh: 我的網球俱樂部很傳統。球員在那裡必須穿白色上衣。

items.en: Our street has no lights. The children must be home before dark.
items.zh: 我們這條街沒有路燈。孩子們必須在天黑前回家。

items.en: The school trip is to a farm with no café. Everyone must bring a packed lunch.
items.zh: 校外教學去的農場沒有餐廳。每個人都必須帶便當。

examples.heading: ⑤ must + 原形動詞 + because + 子句

items.en: I still need milk for the cake. I must hurry because the shop closes at six.
items.zh: 我做蛋糕還需要牛奶。我必須快一點，因為那家店六點關門。

items.en: Are you going out to play? You must wear a coat because it's very cold outside.
items.zh: 你要出去玩嗎？你必須穿外套，因為外面很冷。

items.en: Look at the garden, it's so dry. We must water the plants because it hasn't rained for weeks.
items.zh: 你看花園好乾。我們必須幫植物澆水，因為好幾個星期沒下雨了。

items.en: I'll do my homework later. I must phone my grandma first because it's her birthday.
items.zh: 我等一下再寫功課。我必須先打電話給我奶奶，因為今天是她的生日。

items.en: The match is at midday in July. You must drink lots of water because it's so hot.
items.zh: 比賽在七月的中午。你必須多喝水，因為天氣很熱。

items.en: My aunt is going to London tomorrow. She must get up early because her train leaves at seven.
items.zh: 我阿姨明天要去倫敦。她必須早起，因為她的火車七點開。

items.en: Let's have dinner at Rosa's on Friday. We must book a table because it's always full.
items.zh: 我們星期五去 Rosa's 吃晚餐吧。我們必須訂位，因為那裡總是客滿。

title: Oh, I'm sorry, my mum's calling and I ought to go.
translation: 我覺得你應該跟他們兩個一起去度假。
name: ought to 的肯定句
sentences: Oh, I'm sorry, my mum's calling me for dinner and I ought to go.
It's nearly midnight, and I have school tomorrow. I ought to go to bed.
I ought to call my grandmother. It's her birthday today.
My maths test is on Friday. I ought to study tonight, but I'm so tired.
I ought to return these library books. They're a week late.
My aunt sent me a lovely sweater for Christmas. I ought to write her a thank-you card.
Your parents are both lonely. I think you ought to go on holiday with both of them.
You ought to wear a coat. It's below zero outside.
This restaurant is famous for its seafood. You ought to try the fish here.
Your back has hurt for weeks. You ought to get it checked.
Some boys in your class keep taking your lunch? You ought to tell your teacher.
You've been at your desk since eight. You ought to take a break.
It's twenty to five. We ought to leave now or we'll miss the train.
Mother's Day is on Sunday. We ought to buy Mum a present.
Grandpa lives alone since Grandma died. We ought to visit him more often.
Mrs Kay next door has a broken arm. We ought to help her with her shopping.
Our bin is full of bottles and paper again. We ought to recycle more of our rubbish.
We ought to book the hotel in Cornwall soon. It gets busy in summer.
Emma said something unkind to Lucy at school. She ought to apologise to her.
My uncle had two accidents this year. He ought to drive more carefully.
Our guests left at six. They ought to be here by now.
My brother left university a year ago and still lives at home. He ought to get a job.
It's after ten on a school night. The children ought to be in bed.
Tom only eats pizza and chips. He ought to eat more vegetables.
You broke Sam's phone. I think you ought to say sorry to him.
We've been lost for an hour. I think we ought to ask for help.
My sister got a job offer in Paris. I think she ought to take it.
The twins want to leave school at sixteen. I think they ought to listen to their parents.
Dad has a bad cold. I think he ought to rest for a few days.
Our old pool closed last year. I think the town ought to build a new one.
The forest path has no lights. I think we ought to go home before it gets dark.

examples.heading: ① I ought to + 原形動詞：自己應該做的事

items.en: Oh, I'm sorry, my mum's calling me for dinner and I ought to go.
items.zh: 噢，抱歉，我媽媽叫我去吃晚飯，我應該走了。

items.en: It's nearly midnight, and I have school tomorrow. I ought to go to bed.
items.zh: 快半夜了，我明天還要上學。我應該去睡覺了。

items.en: I ought to call my grandmother. It's her birthday today.
items.zh: 我應該打電話給我奶奶。今天是她的生日。

items.en: My maths test is on Friday. I ought to study tonight, but I'm so tired.
items.zh: 我的數學考試在星期五。我今天晚上應該讀書，可是我好累。

items.en: I ought to return these library books. They're a week late.
items.zh: 我應該還這些圖書館的書。已經晚了一個星期。

items.en: My aunt sent me a lovely sweater for Christmas. I ought to write her a thank-you card.
items.zh: 我阿姨聖誕節寄給我一件很漂亮的毛衣。我應該寫一張謝卡給她。

examples.heading: ② You ought to + 原形動詞：給建議

items.en: Your parents are both lonely. I think you ought to go on holiday with both of them.
items.zh: 你爸媽都很寂寞。我想你應該跟他們兩個一起去度假。

items.en: You ought to wear a coat. It's below zero outside.
items.zh: 你應該穿外套。外面零度以下。

items.en: This restaurant is famous for its seafood. You ought to try the fish here.
items.zh: 這家餐廳的海鮮很有名。你應該試試這裡的魚。

items.en: Your back has hurt for weeks. You ought to get it checked.
items.zh: 你的背痛了好幾個星期。你應該去檢查一下。

items.en: Some boys in your class keep taking your lunch? You ought to tell your teacher.
items.zh: 班上有些男生一直拿你的午餐？你應該告訴你的老師。

items.en: You've been at your desk since eight. You ought to take a break.
items.zh: 你從八點就坐在桌子前。你應該休息一下。

examples.heading: ③ We ought to + 原形動詞：大家應該做的事

items.en: It's twenty to five. We ought to leave now or we'll miss the train.
items.zh: 四點四十了。我們應該現在走，不然會錯過火車。

items.en: Mother's Day is on Sunday. We ought to buy Mum a present.
items.zh: 母親節在星期天。我們應該買禮物給媽媽。

items.en: Grandpa lives alone since Grandma died. We ought to visit him more often.
items.zh: 奶奶過世後，爺爺一個人住。我們應該更常去看他。

items.en: Mrs Kay next door has a broken arm. We ought to help her with her shopping.
items.zh: 隔壁的 Kay 太太手臂斷了。我們應該幫她買東西。

items.en: Our bin is full of bottles and paper again. We ought to recycle more of our rubbish.
items.zh: 我們的垃圾桶又裝滿了瓶子和紙。我們應該回收更多垃圾。

items.en: We ought to book the hotel in Cornwall soon. It gets busy in summer.
items.zh: 我們應該早點訂 Cornwall 的飯店。夏天很多人。

examples.heading: ④ He / She / They + ought to + 原形動詞

items.en: Emma said something unkind to Lucy at school. She ought to apologise to her.
items.zh: Emma 在學校對 Lucy 說了不好聽的話。她應該跟她道歉。

items.en: My uncle had two accidents this year. He ought to drive more carefully.
items.zh: 我叔叔今年出了兩次車禍。他應該開車小心一點。

items.en: Our guests left at six. They ought to be here by now.
items.zh: 我們的客人六點出發。他們現在應該到了。

items.en: My brother left university a year ago and still lives at home. He ought to get a job.
items.zh: 我哥哥大學畢業一年了，還住在家裡。他應該找一份工作。

items.en: It's after ten on a school night. The children ought to be in bed.
items.zh: 明天要上學，現在已經十點多了。孩子們應該在床上了。

items.en: Tom only eats pizza and chips. He ought to eat more vegetables.
items.zh: Tom 只吃披薩和薯條。他應該多吃蔬菜。

examples.heading: ⑤ I think + 主詞 + ought to + 原形動詞

items.en: You broke Sam's phone. I think you ought to say sorry to him.
items.zh: 你弄壞了 Sam 的手機。我想你應該跟他說對不起。

items.en: We've been lost for an hour. I think we ought to ask for help.
items.zh: 我們迷路一個小時了。我想我們應該請人幫忙。

items.en: My sister got a job offer in Paris. I think she ought to take it.
items.zh: 我姊姊收到巴黎的工作機會。我想她應該接受。

items.en: The twins want to leave school at sixteen. I think they ought to listen to their parents.
items.zh: 那對雙胞胎想十六歲就離開學校。我想他們應該聽他們爸媽的話。

items.en: Dad has a bad cold. I think he ought to rest for a few days.
items.zh: 爸爸重感冒。我想他應該休息幾天。

items.en: Our old pool closed last year. I think the town ought to build a new one.
items.zh: 我們的舊游泳池去年關了。我想這個鎮應該蓋一座新的。

items.en: The forest path has no lights. I think we ought to go home before it gets dark.
items.zh: 森林小路沒有燈。我想我們應該在天黑前回家。

title: I shall be free on Sunday at six o'clock in the evening.
translation: 我星期天晚上 6 點有空。
name: shall 的肯定句（情態動詞）
sentences: Everyone has agreed, so we shall start tomorrow at two o'clock in the library.
Our flight is early, so we shall leave for the airport at five in the morning.
We shall meet the new head teacher at the assembly on Monday.
On the first day of the tour, we shall have lunch in a small fishing village.
If the traffic is light, we shall reach Oxford before the rain starts.
We shall finish the evening course just before the summer holidays.
My Sunday afternoon is busy, but I shall be free on Sunday at six o'clock in the evening.
Ring me on Saturday. I shall be at home sorting out the garden all day.
I shall be eighteen next month, so I can finally learn to drive.
I shall be in Paris for the whole of July, working at my uncle's café.
If you need help with your maths, I shall be glad to sit with you after school.
I shall be away on business until the end of the month.
I shall write to you again as soon as I get my exam results.
I shall phone you from the hotel when we arrive in Madrid.
I shall bring my old camera to your wedding and take lots of photos.
With my birthday money, I shall buy a new saddle for my bike.
I shall think of you all when I'm far away in Canada.
I shall explain everything to my parents when they get home tonight.
If the weather is nice, we shall go swimming in the river after lunch.
This summer we shall rent a little cottage on the Scottish coast.
We shall need plenty of sandwiches for the long walk tomorrow.
We shall take the slow train along the coast so we can see the sea.
On the second day, we shall explore the old streets around the cathedral.
We shall cook sausages on the beach if the wind isn't too strong.
Don't worry about the alarm. I shan't be late for the interview this time.
Dad is taking the car to work, but we shan't need it tomorrow.
You helped me so much last winter. I shan't ever forget it.
The concert finishes late, so we shan't get home until after midnight.
You can trust me with the news. I shan't say a word to your sister.
The trip is very short, so we shan't see much of the countryside.
I've had three slices already, so I shan't have any more cake tonight.

examples.heading: ① We shall + 原形動詞：安排和時間

items.en: Everyone has agreed, so we shall start tomorrow at two o'clock in the library.
items.zh: 大家都同意了，所以我們明天兩點在圖書館開始。

items.en: Our flight is early, so we shall leave for the airport at five in the morning.
items.zh: 我們的班機很早，所以我們早上五點出發去機場。

items.en: We shall meet the new head teacher at the assembly on Monday.
items.zh: 星期一朝會的時候，我們會見到新校長。

items.en: On the first day of the tour, we shall have lunch in a small fishing village.
items.zh: 旅行的第一天，我們會在一個小漁村吃午餐。

items.en: If the traffic is light, we shall reach Oxford before the rain starts.
items.zh: 如果路上車不多，我們會在下雨前到牛津。

items.en: We shall finish the evening course just before the summer holidays.
items.zh: 暑假前我們會上完夜間課程。

examples.heading: ② I shall be + 形容詞或地方：說自己以後的狀態

items.en: My Sunday afternoon is busy, but I shall be free on Sunday at six o'clock in the evening.
items.zh: 我星期天下午很忙，可是我星期天傍晚六點有空。

items.en: Ring me on Saturday. I shall be at home sorting out the garden all day.
items.zh: 星期六打給我。我整天都會在家整理花園。

items.en: I shall be eighteen next month, so I can finally learn to drive.
items.zh: 我下個月就滿十八歲了，所以終於可以學開車了。

items.en: I shall be in Paris for the whole of July, working at my uncle's café.
items.zh: 我整個七月都會在巴黎，在我叔叔的咖啡館工作。

items.en: If you need help with your maths, I shall be glad to sit with you after school.
items.zh: 如果你數學需要幫忙，我放學後很樂意陪你一起做。

items.en: I shall be away on business until the end of the month.
items.zh: 我出差到月底才會回來。

examples.heading: ③ I shall + 原形動詞：以後會做的事

items.en: I shall write to you again as soon as I get my exam results.
items.zh: 我一拿到考試成績就會再寫信給你。

items.en: I shall phone you from the hotel when we arrive in Madrid.
items.zh: 我們到馬德里的時候，我會從飯店打電話給你。

items.en: I shall bring my old camera to your wedding and take lots of photos.
items.zh: 我會帶我的舊相機去你的婚禮，拍很多照片。

items.en: With my birthday money, I shall buy a new saddle for my bike.
items.zh: 我會用我的生日禮金幫腳踏車買一個新坐墊。

items.en: I shall think of you all when I'm far away in Canada.
items.zh: 我在遙遠的加拿大時，會想念你們大家。

items.en: I shall explain everything to my parents when they get home tonight.
items.zh: 我爸媽今晚回家的時候，我會把一切都解釋給他們聽。

examples.heading: ④ We shall + 原形動詞：大家一起的計畫

items.en: If the weather is nice, we shall go swimming in the river after lunch.
items.zh: 如果天氣好，我們午餐後會去河裡游泳。

items.en: This summer we shall rent a little cottage on the Scottish coast.
items.zh: 今年夏天我們會在蘇格蘭海邊租一間小屋。

items.en: We shall need plenty of sandwiches for the long walk tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天要走很長的路，我們會需要很多三明治。

items.en: We shall take the slow train along the coast so we can see the sea.
items.zh: 我們會搭沿著海岸的慢車，這樣就能看到海。

items.en: On the second day, we shall explore the old streets around the cathedral.
items.zh: 第二天，我們會去逛大教堂附近的老街。

items.en: We shall cook sausages on the beach if the wind isn't too strong.
items.zh: 如果風不太大，我們會在海灘上烤香腸。

examples.heading: ⑤ I / We shan't + 原形動詞：不會

items.en: Don't worry about the alarm. I shan't be late for the interview this time.
items.zh: 別擔心鬧鐘的事。這次面試我不會遲到。

items.en: Dad is taking the car to work, but we shan't need it tomorrow.
items.zh: 爸爸要開車去上班，可是我們明天不會需要車子。

items.en: You helped me so much last winter. I shan't ever forget it.
items.zh: 你去年冬天幫了我很多。我永遠不會忘記。

items.en: The concert finishes late, so we shan't get home until after midnight.
items.zh: 音樂會很晚才結束，所以我們半夜以後才會到家。

items.en: You can trust me with the news. I shan't say a word to your sister.
items.zh: 這個消息你可以放心告訴我。我不會跟你妹妹說一個字。

items.en: The trip is very short, so we shan't see much of the countryside.
items.zh: 這趟旅行很短，所以我們看不到多少鄉村風景。

items.en: I've had three slices already, so I shan't have any more cake tonight.
items.zh: 我已經吃了三塊，所以今天晚上不會再吃蛋糕了。

title: You should come at six o'clock.
translation: 改天我們應該一起去那裡。
name: should 的肯定句
sentences: My mum will have dinner ready by then, so you should come at six o'clock.
The museum is very busy after lunch, so you should go in the morning.
Our house is a long walk from the station. You should take the number twelve bus from outside the bank.
The beach is windy, so you should bring a warm jumper.
Our front doorbell is broken. You should ring the bell at the side door.
We have a new white carpet. You should leave your shoes by the door when you come in.
The show is very popular, so we should buy two tickets today.
It's getting dark. We should start walking back to the car.
We should take some water. It's a long walk to the waterfall.
Those computers are new. We should ask the teacher before we use them.
Grandpa is coming home from hospital tonight. We should save some cake for him.
We should get up early to see the sunrise from the hill.
Your photos of Venice are beautiful. Someday we should go there together.
Look how beautiful it is in the snow. One day we should climb that mountain behind the village.
That couple is dancing so well. Someday we should learn to dance the tango.
You love long train journeys. One day we should take the train all the way across Canada.
You make the best cakes, and I love making coffee. Someday we should open our own little café.
One day we should visit your grandparents' farm in Ireland.
My room is a mess. I should tidy it before my aunt arrives.
I should call my grandmother. I haven't spoken to her for weeks.
I should go to bed. I have a test in the morning.
I get headaches every afternoon. I should drink more water during the day.
The test is on chapter five. I should finish this chapter before I watch TV.
Mrs Fox helped me so much this year. I should write a card to thank her.
My brother should practise the piano more if he wants to pass the exam.
My sister rides on a busy road. She should wear a helmet when she rides her bike to school.
They should book a table. The restaurant is always full on Fridays.
They're always tired in the morning. The children should be in bed by eight on school nights.
Ben's machine keeps stopping. He should tell his boss about the problem.
My parents should take a holiday. They work too hard.
We lost our last three games. Our team should train more before the big match.

examples.heading: ① You should + 原形動詞：告訴對方好的時間和做法

items.en: My mum will have dinner ready by then, so you should come at six o'clock.
items.zh: 我媽媽那時候會把晚餐準備好，所以你應該六點來。

items.en: The museum is very busy after lunch, so you should go in the morning.
items.zh: 博物館午餐後人很多，所以你應該早上去。

items.en: Our house is a long walk from the station. You should take the number twelve bus from outside the bank.
items.zh: 我們家離車站要走很久。你應該在銀行外面搭十二號公車。

items.en: The beach is windy, so you should bring a warm jumper.
items.zh: 海灘風很大，所以你應該帶一件保暖的毛衣。

items.en: Our front doorbell is broken. You should ring the bell at the side door.
items.zh: 我們前門的門鈴壞了。你應該按側門的門鈴。

items.en: We have a new white carpet. You should leave your shoes by the door when you come in.
items.zh: 我們有一塊新的白地毯。你進來的時候應該把鞋子放在門邊。

examples.heading: ② We should + 原形動詞：大家應該做的事

items.en: The show is very popular, so we should buy two tickets today.
items.zh: 那場表演很受歡迎，所以我們應該今天就買兩張票。

items.en: It's getting dark. We should start walking back to the car.
items.zh: 天快黑了。我們應該開始走回車子那裡。

items.en: We should take some water. It's a long walk to the waterfall.
items.zh: 我們應該帶點水。走到瀑布要很久。

items.en: Those computers are new. We should ask the teacher before we use them.
items.zh: 那些電腦是新的。我們用之前應該先問老師。

items.en: Grandpa is coming home from hospital tonight. We should save some cake for him.
items.zh: 爺爺今晚從醫院回家。我們應該留一些蛋糕給他。

items.en: We should get up early to see the sunrise from the hill.
items.zh: 我們應該早起，從山丘上看日出。

examples.heading: ③ Someday / One day + we should + 原形動詞：提議以後一起做

items.en: Your photos of Venice are beautiful. Someday we should go there together.
items.zh: 你拍的威尼斯照片好美。有一天我們應該一起去那裡。

items.en: Look how beautiful it is in the snow. One day we should climb that mountain behind the village.
items.zh: 你看它在雪中多美。有一天我們應該去爬村子後面那座山。

items.en: That couple is dancing so well. Someday we should learn to dance the tango.
items.zh: 那對夫妻跳得好棒。有一天我們應該去學跳探戈。

items.en: You love long train journeys. One day we should take the train all the way across Canada.
items.zh: 你很喜歡搭長途火車。有一天我們應該搭火車橫越整個加拿大。

items.en: You make the best cakes, and I love making coffee. Someday we should open our own little café.
items.zh: 你做的蛋糕最好吃，我又很愛煮咖啡。有一天我們應該開一家我們自己的小咖啡館。

items.en: One day we should visit your grandparents' farm in Ireland.
items.zh: 有一天我們應該去你祖父母在愛爾蘭的農場。

examples.heading: ④ I should + 原形動詞：說自己應該做的事

items.en: My room is a mess. I should tidy it before my aunt arrives.
items.zh: 我的房間一團亂。我應該在阿姨來之前整理好。

items.en: I should call my grandmother. I haven't spoken to her for weeks.
items.zh: 我應該打電話給我奶奶。我好幾個星期沒跟她說話了。

items.en: I should go to bed. I have a test in the morning.
items.zh: 我應該去睡了。我早上有考試。

items.en: I get headaches every afternoon. I should drink more water during the day.
items.zh: 我每天下午都頭痛。我白天應該多喝水。

items.en: The test is on chapter five. I should finish this chapter before I watch TV.
items.zh: 考試考第五章。我看電視之前應該先讀完這一章。

items.en: Mrs Fox helped me so much this year. I should write a card to thank her.
items.zh: Fox 老師今年幫了我很多。我應該寫一張卡片謝謝她。

examples.heading: ⑤ He / She / They + should + 原形動詞

items.en: My brother should practise the piano more if he wants to pass the exam.
items.zh: 如果我弟弟想通過考試，他應該多練鋼琴。

items.en: My sister rides on a busy road. She should wear a helmet when she rides her bike to school.
items.zh: 我妹妹騎在車很多的路上。她騎腳踏車上學的時候應該戴安全帽。

items.en: They should book a table. The restaurant is always full on Fridays.
items.zh: 他們應該訂位。那家餐廳星期五總是客滿。

items.en: They're always tired in the morning. The children should be in bed by eight on school nights.
items.zh: 他們早上總是很累。上學日的晚上孩子們應該八點前上床。

items.en: Ben's machine keeps stopping. He should tell his boss about the problem.
items.zh: Ben 的機器一直停下來。他應該把問題告訴他的老闆。

items.en: My parents should take a holiday. They work too hard.
items.zh: 我爸媽應該去度個假。他們工作太辛苦了。

items.en: We lost our last three games. Our team should train more before the big match.
items.zh: 我們輸了前三場比賽。我們隊在大比賽前應該多練習。

title: When I was a little girl, we used to be together all the time.
translation: 我以前跟我哥哥共用一個房間。
name: used to 的肯定句
sentences: My cousin and I lived on the same street. When I was a little girl, we used to be together all the time.
This café used to be a bookshop when I was at school.
My grandfather used to be a fisherman before he retired.
The town used to be very quiet, but now it's full of tourists.
I used to be afraid of the dark when I was small.
There used to be a cinema on the corner of this street.
I used to share my room with my brother, but now I've got my own.
We used to live in a small flat above a bakery.
She used to have a big black dog called Max.
My parents used to own a little shop in the village.
I used to have very long hair, down to my waist.
They used to live next door to a famous singer.
Every summer we used to go camping by the lake.
My dad used to read us a story every night.
I used to walk to school with my best friend.
We used to play football in the street after school.
My grandma used to make pancakes every Sunday morning.
She used to swim in the sea every morning before work.
I used to hate vegetables, but now I love them.
He used to smoke, but now he goes running every day.
We used to write letters, but now we just send messages.
She used to work in a bank, but now she's a teacher.
I used to get up late, but now I'm up at six.
They used to argue a lot, but now they're best friends.
When I was a child, I used to collect stamps.
When my mum was young, she used to dance in a band.
When we lived in Spain, we used to eat dinner at ten.
When he was at university, he used to work in a pub.
When I was a teenager, I used to listen to rock music all day.
When the children were small, we used to go to the zoo every month.
When my grandparents were young, they used to dance every Saturday night.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + used to + be：過去的狀態

items.en: My cousin and I lived on the same street. When I was a little girl, we used to be together all the time.
items.zh: 我表姊和我住在同一條街上。我小時候，我們常常整天都在一起。

items.en: This café used to be a bookshop when I was at school.
items.zh: 我上學的時候，這家咖啡館以前是一家書店。

items.en: My grandfather used to be a fisherman before he retired.
items.zh: 我爺爺退休前是漁夫。

items.en: The town used to be very quiet, but now it's full of tourists.
items.zh: 這個鎮以前很安靜，可是現在都是觀光客。

items.en: I used to be afraid of the dark when I was small.
items.zh: 我小時候很怕黑。

items.en: There used to be a cinema on the corner of this street.
items.zh: 這條街的轉角以前有一家電影院。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + used to + have / live：過去擁有或住過

items.en: I used to share my room with my brother, but now I've got my own.
items.zh: 我以前跟我哥哥住同一個房間，可是現在我有自己的房間了。

items.en: We used to live in a small flat above a bakery.
items.zh: 我們以前住在一家麵包店樓上的小公寓。

items.en: She used to have a big black dog called Max.
items.zh: 她以前養了一隻叫麥克斯的大黑狗。

items.en: My parents used to own a little shop in the village.
items.zh: 我爸媽以前在村子裡開了一家小店。

items.en: I used to have very long hair, down to my waist.
items.zh: 我以前留很長的頭髮，長到腰。

items.en: They used to live next door to a famous singer.
items.zh: 他們以前住在一位有名歌手的隔壁。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + used to + 原形動詞：過去的習慣

items.en: Every summer we used to go camping by the lake.
items.zh: 每年夏天我們都會去湖邊露營。

items.en: My dad used to read us a story every night.
items.zh: 我爸爸以前每天晚上都會唸故事給我們聽。

items.en: I used to walk to school with my best friend.
items.zh: 我以前都跟我最好的朋友一起走路上學。

items.en: We used to play football in the street after school.
items.zh: 我們以前放學後都在街上踢足球。

items.en: My grandma used to make pancakes every Sunday morning.
items.zh: 我奶奶以前每個星期天早上都會做鬆餅。

items.en: She used to swim in the sea every morning before work.
items.zh: 她以前每天早上上班前都會去海裡游泳。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + used to + 原形動詞, but now + 句子

items.en: I used to hate vegetables, but now I love them.
items.zh: 我以前很討厭蔬菜，可是現在很喜歡。

items.en: He used to smoke, but now he goes running every day.
items.zh: 他以前抽菸，可是現在每天都去跑步。

items.en: We used to write letters, but now we just send messages.
items.zh: 我們以前寫信，可是現在只傳訊息。

items.en: She used to work in a bank, but now she's a teacher.
items.zh: 她以前在銀行工作，可是現在是老師。

items.en: I used to get up late, but now I'm up at six.
items.zh: 我以前很晚起床，可是現在六點就起來了。

items.en: They used to argue a lot, but now they're best friends.
items.zh: 他們以前常吵架，可是現在是最好的朋友。

examples.heading: ⑤ When + 主詞 + was …, + 主詞 + used to + 原形動詞

items.en: When I was a child, I used to collect stamps.
items.zh: 我小時候會收集郵票。

items.en: When my mum was young, she used to dance in a band.
items.zh: 我媽媽年輕的時候，以前在一個樂團跳舞。

items.en: When we lived in Spain, we used to eat dinner at ten.
items.zh: 我們住在西班牙的時候，以前十點才吃晚餐。

items.en: When he was at university, he used to work in a pub.
items.zh: 他念大學的時候，以前在一家酒吧打工。

items.en: When I was a teenager, I used to listen to rock music all day.
items.zh: 我十幾歲的時候，以前整天聽搖滾樂。

items.en: When the children were small, we used to go to the zoo every month.
items.zh: 孩子們小的時候，我們以前每個月都去動物園。

items.en: When my grandparents were young, they used to dance every Saturday night.
items.zh: 我祖父母年輕的時候，以前每個星期六晚上都去跳舞。

title: I'll come to see you tomorrow morning.
translation: 我明天早上會去看你。
name: 情態動詞 will 的肯定句
sentences: I will be at your house at half past seven, because I have an appointment before.
The bus will stop outside the museum.
My mother will cook dinner for everyone on Sunday.
The shop will close early on New Year's Eve.
The hotel will provide towels and soap in every room.
The teacher will give back our tests on Monday.
The plumber will come between nine and twelve.
Your order will arrive in three days.
The meeting will start after lunch.
I will keep a seat for you in the front row.
Traffic on the ring road will move slowly until the repairs end.
My uncle will meet us at the harbour.
The children will sing two songs at the end of the show.
Our flight will land at ten past four.
I'll come to see you tomorrow morning, Grandma.
I'll wait for you in front of the bank.
You'll get a letter from the school next week.
He'll be back from Berlin on Friday.
She'll text you the address.
It'll be dark when we get home.
I'll bring the cake, and you bring the candles.
He'll show us around the farm in the afternoon.
You'll find the towels in the bathroom.
I'll see you at the station at ten.
We'll phone you as soon as we land.
They'll arrive by car on Saturday.
We'll have lunch at a café near the river.
They'll paint the classroom during the holidays.
We'll stay at my aunt's flat in the city.
They'll come back to collect the keys later.
We'll pick up the hire car at the airport and drive to the coast.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will + 原形動詞

items.en: I will be at your house at half past seven, because I have an appointment before.
items.zh: 我七點半會到你家，因為之前我有約。

items.en: The bus will stop outside the museum.
items.zh: 公車會停在博物館外面。

items.en: My mother will cook dinner for everyone on Sunday.
items.zh: 我媽星期天會煮晚餐給大家吃。

items.en: The shop will close early on New Year's Eve.
items.zh: 那家店除夕會提早關門。

items.en: The hotel will provide towels and soap in every room.
items.zh: 飯店每個房間都會提供毛巾和肥皂。

items.en: The teacher will give back our tests on Monday.
items.zh: 老師星期一會發回我們的考卷。

items.en: The plumber will come between nine and twelve.
items.zh: 水電工會在九點到十二點之間來。

items.en: Your order will arrive in three days.
items.zh: 你訂的東西三天後會到。

items.en: The meeting will start after lunch.
items.zh: 會議會在午餐後開始。

items.en: I will keep a seat for you in the front row.
items.zh: 我會在第一排幫你留一個位子。

items.en: Traffic on the ring road will move slowly until the repairs end.
items.zh: 環城道路的車流在修完之前都會很慢。

items.en: My uncle will meet us at the harbour.
items.zh: 我叔叔會在港口接我們。

items.en: The children will sing two songs at the end of the show.
items.zh: 孩子們會在表演最後唱兩首歌。

items.en: Our flight will land at ten past four.
items.zh: 我們的班機四點十分會降落。

examples.heading: ② I'll / you'll / he'll / she'll / it'll + 原形動詞

items.en: I'll come to see you tomorrow morning, Grandma.
items.zh: 奶奶，我明天早上會去看你。

items.en: I'll wait for you in front of the bank.
items.zh: 我會在銀行前面等你。

items.en: You'll get a letter from the school next week.
items.zh: 你下星期會收到學校寄來的信。

items.en: He'll be back from Berlin on Friday.
items.zh: 他星期五會從柏林回來。

items.en: She'll text you the address.
items.zh: 她會把地址傳簡訊給你。

items.en: It'll be dark when we get home.
items.zh: 我們到家的時候天會黑了。

items.en: I'll bring the cake, and you bring the candles.
items.zh: 我帶蛋糕，你帶蠟燭。

items.en: He'll show us around the farm in the afternoon.
items.zh: 他下午會帶我們參觀農場。

items.en: You'll find the towels in the bathroom.
items.zh: 毛巾在浴室裡。

items.en: I'll see you at the station at ten.
items.zh: 十點車站見。

examples.heading: ③ we'll / they'll + 原形動詞

items.en: We'll phone you as soon as we land.
items.zh: 我們一降落就會打給你。

items.en: They'll arrive by car on Saturday.
items.zh: 他們星期六會開車來。

items.en: We'll have lunch at a café near the river.
items.zh: 我們會在河邊的咖啡店吃午餐。

items.en: They'll paint the classroom during the holidays.
items.zh: 他們放假時會油漆教室。

items.en: We'll stay at my aunt's flat in the city.
items.zh: 我們會住在我阿姨在城裡的公寓。

items.en: They'll come back to collect the keys later.

items.en: My sister would love to share a flat with her friends.
items.zh: 我姊姊很想跟她的朋友合租一間公寓。

items.en: We'd like to stay one more night at the hotel.

title: It was obvious that I would be late for work.
translation: 很明顯，我上班要遲到了。
name: be 加 sure 等形容詞加 that 子句
sentences: It was obvious that the waiter had made a mistake with the bill.
It was obvious that the old man needed help with his bags.
It is obvious that the children love their new teacher.
It was obvious that nobody had cleaned the kitchen for weeks.
It is obvious that this house needs a new roof.
It was obvious that she had been crying.
It's obvious that the team is tired after the long season.
It is likely that the new café will be busy at weekends.
It was likely that the river would flood after so much rain.
It is likely that we'll need more volunteers next year.
It's likely that the trains will be late because of the snow.
It was likely that the factory would close by the end of the year.
It is likely that most people will agree with the plan.
It is certain that our new screen will sell well.
It was certain that the president would win again.
It is certain that prices will go up in the new year.
It's certain that the museum will need more space.

It isn't certain that the concert will go ahead.
It was not obvious that he was unhappy.
It isn't likely that we'll get a refund.
I'm not sure that the hotel has a car park.
It wasn't obvious that the two women were sisters.
I'm not sure that the bus stops here.

examples.heading: ① It + is / was + obvious + that + 子句

items.zh: 很明顯，服務生把帳單算錯了。

items.en: It was obvious that the old man needed help with his bags.
items.zh: 很明顯，那個老人需要人幫他提袋子。

items.en: It is obvious that the children love their new teacher.
items.zh: 很明顯，孩子們很喜歡他們的新老師。

items.en: It was obvious that nobody had cleaned the kitchen for weeks.
items.zh: 很明顯，已經好幾個星期沒人打掃廚房了。

items.en: It is obvious that this house needs a new roof.
items.zh: 很明顯，這間房子需要新屋頂。

items.en: It was obvious that she had been crying.
items.zh: 很明顯，她剛剛哭過。

items.en: It's obvious that the team is tired after the long season.
items.zh: 很明顯，球隊經過漫長的球季已經累了。

examples.heading: ② It + is / was + likely + that + 子句

items.zh: 新的咖啡店週末很可能會很忙。

items.en: It was likely that the river would flood after so much rain.
items.zh: 下了這麼多雨，河水很可能會氾濫。

items.en: It is likely that we'll need more volunteers next year.
items.zh: 我們明年很可能需要更多志工。

items.en: It's likely that the trains will be late because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，火車很可能會誤點。

items.en: It was likely that the factory would close by the end of the year.
items.zh: 工廠很可能在年底前關閉。

items.en: It is likely that most people will agree with the plan.
items.zh: 大部分的人很可能會同意這個計畫。

examples.heading: ③ It + is / was + certain + that + 子句

items.zh: 我們的新螢幕一定會賣得很好。

items.en: It was certain that the president would win again.
items.zh: 那時很確定總統會再次勝選。

items.en: It is certain that prices will go up in the new year.
items.zh: 新的一年物價一定會上漲。

items.en: It's certain that the museum will need more space.
items.zh: 博物館一定會需要更多空間。

items.en: It was certain that the match would go ahead, rain or shine.
items.zh: 不管晴天還是下雨，比賽那時確定會照常舉行。

items.en: It is almost certain that the road will close for repairs.
items.zh: 那條路幾乎確定會封閉整修。

examples.heading: ④ 人 + am / is / was + sure + that + 子句

items.zh: 那座城堡大約有一千年歷史，所以我確定你會覺得很有意思。

items.en: I was sure that I had locked the door.
items.zh: 我那時確定我鎖了門。

items.en: She is sure that her brother will get the job.
items.zh: 她確定她哥會得到那份工作。

items.zh: 我們那時確定那家店還開著。

items.en: I'm sure that your grandmother will love the scarf.
items.zh: 我確定你奶奶會喜歡那條圍巾。

items.en: The coach is sure that his team can win the cup.
items.zh: 教練確定他的隊伍能贏得獎盃。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定：It is not + 形容詞 + that / I'm not sure + that

items.zh: 演唱會不確定會不會照常舉行。

items.en: It was not obvious that he was unhappy.
items.zh: 他不開心這件事並不明顯。

items.en: It isn't likely that we'll get a refund.
items.zh: 我們不太可能拿到退款。

items.en: I'm not sure that the hotel has a car park.
items.zh: 我不確定那家飯店有沒有停車場。

items.en: It wasn't obvious that the two women were sisters.
items.zh: 看不太出來那兩個女人是姊妹。

items.en: I'm not sure that the bus stops here.
items.zh: 我不確定公車有沒有停這裡。

title: Perhaps you will be allowed to go on holiday with your friends next year.
translation: 也許明年你就可以跟朋友去度假了。
name: be allowed to 等 be 加不定詞的片語
sentences: If you are allowed to leave the building in your break, you should go for a walk.
In a few years, you'll be allowed to choose your own bedtime.
Students aren't allowed to use their phones in class.
We were allowed to stay up late on New Year's Eve.
Are dogs allowed to come into the café?
My little brother isn't allowed to watch horror films.
Next year you'll be allowed to drive on your own.
Visitors were not allowed to take photos inside the palace.
Will we be allowed to bring our own food?
The film is supposed to start at seven, so we'd better meet at half past six.
I was supposed to meet my friend Laura, but she didn't come.
You're supposed to wear a helmet on a bike.
The train was supposed to arrive at ten, but it was late.
What are we supposed to bring to the picnic?
We're supposed to hand in our essays on Monday.
He was supposed to call me last night, but he forgot.
This medicine is supposed to help you sleep.
You weren't supposed to tell anyone!
I'm sorry, but I am not able to meet you next Tuesday.
We were able to choose the songs for the wedding ourselves.
After a month of practice, she was able to swim across the pool.
Are you able to come to the meeting on Friday?
The firefighters were able to get the cat down from the tree.
I wasn't able to sleep because of the noise.
Will you be able to finish the painting before the guests arrive?
My grandmother is able to walk without a stick now.
Were you allowed to bring your phone on the school trip?
We aren't supposed to park here after six.
Was he able to find a parking space?
You won't be allowed to enter without a ticket.
Isn't the shop supposed to open at nine?

items.zh: 再過幾年，你就可以自己決定什麼時候睡覺了。

items.en: Students aren't allowed to use their phones in class.
items.zh: 學生上課時不可以用手機。

items.en: We were allowed to stay up late on New Year's Eve.
items.zh: 除夕那天我們可以晚睡。

items.en: Are dogs allowed to come into the café?
items.zh: 狗可以進咖啡店嗎？

items.en: My little brother isn't allowed to watch horror films.
items.zh: 我弟不可以看恐怖片。

items.en: Next year you'll be allowed to drive on your own.

items.zh: 遊客不可以在宮殿裡拍照。

items.en: Will we be allowed to bring our own food?
items.zh: 我們可以帶自己的食物嗎？

examples.heading: ② be supposed to + 原形動詞

items.zh: 電影應該七點開始，所以我們最好六點半見面。

items.en: I was supposed to meet my friend Laura, but she didn't come.
items.zh: 我本來要跟我朋友 Laura 見面，可是她沒來。

items.en: You're supposed to wear a helmet on a bike.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車應該要戴安全帽。

items.en: The train was supposed to arrive at ten, but it was late.
items.zh: 火車應該十點到，可是誤點了。

items.en: What are we supposed to bring to the picnic?
items.zh: 我們應該帶什麼去野餐？

items.en: We're supposed to hand in our essays on Monday.
items.zh: 我們應該星期一交作文。

items.en: He was supposed to call me last night, but he forgot.
items.zh: 他昨晚應該打給我，可是他忘了。

items.en: This medicine is supposed to help you sleep.
items.zh: 這種藥應該能幫你睡覺。

items.en: You weren't supposed to tell anyone!
items.zh: 你不應該告訴任何人的！

examples.heading: ③ be able to + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm sorry, but I am not able to meet you next Tuesday.
items.zh: 很抱歉，我下星期二沒辦法跟你見面。

items.en: We were able to choose the songs for the wedding ourselves.
items.zh: 婚禮的歌我們可以自己選。

items.en: After a month of practice, she was able to swim across the pool.
items.zh: 練習了一個月，她能游過整個游泳池了。

items.en: Are you able to come to the meeting on Friday?
items.zh: 你星期五能來開會嗎？

items.en: The firefighters were able to get the cat down from the tree.
items.zh: 消防員把貓從樹上救了下來。

items.en: I wasn't able to sleep because of the noise.
items.zh: 因為噪音，我沒辦法睡覺。

items.en: Will you be able to finish the painting before the guests arrive?
items.zh: 客人來之前你能油漆完嗎？

items.en: My grandmother is able to walk without a stick now.
items.zh: 我奶奶現在不用拐杖也能走路了。

examples.heading: ④ 否定句和疑問句

items.en: Were you allowed to bring your phone on the school trip?
items.zh: 校外教學可以帶手機嗎？（被動）

items.en: We aren't supposed to park here after six.
items.zh: 六點以後我們不應該停在這裡。

items.en: Was he able to find a parking space?
items.zh: 他有找到停車位嗎？

items.en: You won't be allowed to enter without a ticket.
items.zh: 沒有票你就不能進去。（被動）

items.en: Isn't the shop supposed to open at nine?
items.zh: 那家店不是應該九點開門嗎？

title: People who read books are likely to be more knowledgeable.
