items.en: It's important that you keep your passport in a safe place.
items.zh: 護照要放在安全的地方，這很重要。

items.en: It's important that you don't forget your medicine.
items.zh: 別忘了吃藥，這很重要。

examples.heading: ② It's important that + 其他主詞 + 動詞

items.en: It's important that children learn to swim.
items.zh: 小孩學游泳很重要。

items.en: It's important that everyone knows the fire exits.
items.zh: 每個人都知道逃生出口在哪裡很重要。

items.en: It's important that we leave before the traffic gets bad.
items.zh: 在交通變糟之前出發很重要。

items.en: It's important that the food is fresh.
items.zh: 食物新鮮很重要。

items.en: It's important that students practise speaking every day.
items.zh: 學生每天練習說話很重要。

items.en: It's important that the team trains together.
items.zh: 團隊一起練習很重要。

items.en: It's important that parents talk to their children.
items.zh: 父母跟孩子聊天很重要。

items.en: It's important that the room is quiet during the test.
items.zh: 考試時教室保持安靜很重要。

items.en: It's important that we recycle our rubbish.
items.zh: 垃圾回收很重要。

items.en: It's important that your boss knows about your plans.
items.zh: 讓你老闆知道你的計畫很重要。

examples.heading: ③ I think it's important that + 子句

items.en: I think it's important that you look at each point before you decide.
items.zh: 我覺得你做決定前把每一點都看過很重要。

items.en: I think it's important that we help our neighbours.
items.zh: 我覺得幫助鄰居很重要。

items.en: I think it's important that young people vote.
items.zh: 我覺得年輕人去投票很重要。

items.en: I think it's important that families eat together.
items.zh: 我覺得家人一起吃飯很重要。

items.en: I think it's important that you enjoy your job.
items.zh: 我覺得喜歡自己的工作很重要。

items.en: My dad thinks it's important that I learn another language.
items.zh: 我爸覺得我學另一種語言很重要。

examples.heading: ④ It was / It is very important that + 子句

items.en: It was important that we found the dog before dark.
items.zh: 天黑前找到那隻狗很重要。

items.en: It is very important that you keep this secret.
items.zh: 你要保守這個祕密，這非常重要。

items.en: It was important that everyone arrived early.
items.zh: 每個人都早點到很重要。

items.en: It is very important that the doors stay closed.
items.zh: 門一直關著非常重要。

items.en: It was really important that she passed that exam.
items.zh: 她通過那次考試真的很重要。

items.en: It is very important that nobody touches these wires.
items.zh: 非常重要的是，誰都不能碰這些電線。

title: It seems clear to me that swimming is good for the whole body.
translation: 在我看來，游泳顯然對全身都有好處。
name: it 加連綴動詞加形容詞加 that 子句
sentences: It is obvious that some people prefer reading books to watching films.
It is possible that we can learn a lot from television.
It is clear that the town needs a new hospital.
It is true that prices have gone up this year.
It is strange that nobody noticed the mistake.
It's surprising that the shop is still open.
It is lucky that you brought an umbrella.
It's sad that the old cinema closed.
It is unlikely that the plan will work.
It seems obvious that it is not necessary.
It seems clear that the team needs a new coach.
It seems likely that the meeting will be cancelled.
It seems strange that he left without saying goodbye.
It seems unfair that only some students get a prize.
It seems possible that the price will fall next year.
It seems odd that the lights are still on.
It appears certain that the company will close the factory.
It looks likely that it will snow tonight.
It became clear that she wasn't coming.
It appears unlikely that they will finish on time.
It soon became obvious that we were lost.
It looks certain that the road will stay closed.
It became apparent that the bridge was not safe.
It seems clear to me that we need more time.
It seems obvious to me that he made a mistake.
It is clear to me that you love your job.
It seems strange to me that nobody complained.
It seems likely to me that prices will rise again.
It's obvious to everyone that they are in love.
It seems unfair to me that the rules changed so late.
It was clear to the doctor that the boy had broken his arm.

examples.heading: ① It is + 形容詞 + that + 子句

items.en: It is obvious that some people prefer reading books to watching films.
items.zh: 很明顯，有些人比較喜歡讀書，不喜歡看電影。

items.en: It is possible that we can learn a lot from television.
items.zh: 我們有可能從電視學到很多東西。

items.en: It is clear that the town needs a new hospital.
items.zh: 很清楚，這個鎮需要一間新醫院。

items.en: It is true that prices have gone up this year.
items.zh: 今年物價確實上漲了。

items.en: It is strange that nobody noticed the mistake.
items.zh: 奇怪的是沒有人發現這個錯誤。

items.en: It's surprising that the shop is still open.
items.zh: 那家店還開著，真令人意外。

items.en: It is lucky that you brought an umbrella.
items.zh: 幸好你帶了傘。

items.en: It's sad that the old cinema closed.
items.zh: 那家老電影院關了，真令人難過。

items.en: It is unlikely that the plan will work.
items.zh: 這個計畫不太可能成功。

examples.heading: ② It seems + 形容詞 + that + 子句

items.en: It seems obvious that it is not necessary.
items.zh: 這件事顯然沒有必要。

items.en: It seems clear that the team needs a new coach.
items.zh: 看起來這支隊伍顯然需要新教練。

items.en: It seems likely that the meeting will be cancelled.
items.zh: 會議看起來很可能會取消。（被動）

items.en: It seems strange that he left without saying goodbye.
items.zh: 他沒說再見就走了，看起來很奇怪。

items.en: It seems unfair that only some students get a prize.
items.zh: 只有部分學生得獎，看起來不太公平。

items.en: It seems possible that the price will fall next year.
items.zh: 價格明年看起來有可能下跌。

items.en: It seems odd that the lights are still on.
items.zh: 燈還亮著，看起來很奇怪。

examples.heading: ③ It appears / looks / becomes + 形容詞 + that + 子句

items.en: It appears certain that the company will close the factory.
items.zh: 那家公司看來一定會關掉工廠。

items.en: It looks likely that it will snow tonight.
items.zh: 今晚看起來很可能會下雪。

items.en: It became clear that she wasn't coming.
items.zh: 後來很清楚，她不會來了。

items.en: It appears unlikely that they will finish on time.
items.zh: 他們看起來不太可能準時完成。

items.en: It soon became obvious that we were lost.
items.zh: 很快就很明顯，我們迷路了。

items.en: It looks certain that the road will stay closed.
items.zh: 那條路看來一定會繼續封閉。

items.en: It became apparent that the bridge was not safe.
items.zh: 後來很明顯，那座橋不安全。

examples.heading: ④ It seems / is + 形容詞 + to me + that + 子句

items.en: It seems clear to me that we need more time.
items.zh: 在我看來，我們顯然需要更多時間。

items.en: It seems obvious to me that he made a mistake.
items.zh: 在我看來，他顯然犯了錯。

items.en: It is clear to me that you love your job.
items.zh: 在我看來，你顯然很愛你的工作。

items.en: It seems strange to me that nobody complained.
items.zh: 在我看來，沒有人抱怨很奇怪。

items.en: It seems likely to me that prices will rise again.
items.zh: 在我看來，物價很可能會再漲。

items.en: It's obvious to everyone that they are in love.
items.zh: 大家都看得出來他們在談戀愛。

items.en: It seems unfair to me that the rules changed so late.
items.zh: 在我看來，規定這麼晚才改並不公平。

items.en: It was clear to the doctor that the boy had broken his arm.
items.zh: 醫生很清楚那個男孩的手臂骨折了。

title: If they only want to have fun, they might as well stay at home.
translation: 如果他們只是想玩，那還不如待在家裡。
name: might as well 提出最合理的做法
sentences: If you only eat burgers on holiday, you might as well stay in your own town.
If you're going to look at your phone all evening, you might as well go home.
If you don't listen to me, I might as well talk to the wall.
If nobody reads the reports, we might as well stop writing them.
If the train costs the same, we might as well fly.
If you're only going to sleep in class, you might as well stay in bed.
If you reach old age in good health, you might as well make the best of these years.
We're stuck here until the morning, so we might as well make the best of it.
The holiday is nearly over, so we might as well make the best of the last day.
You can't change the weather, so you might as well enjoy the rain.
The job isn't perfect, but you might as well learn as much as you can.
We've paid for the course, so we might as well go to every class.
The last ferry has gone. We might as well find a hotel.
It's too late to cook. We might as well order a pizza.
The road is closed, so we might as well turn back.
Nobody's coming to the meeting. We might as well cancel it.
The film has already started. We might as well wait for the next one.
My old phone is broken again. I might as well get a new one.
The shop is on our way, so we might as well stop and buy some milk.
You're already wet, so you might as well go for a swim.
I'm going to the post office anyway, so I might as well send your parcel.
The tickets are free, so we might as well go and see the show.
Since you're here, you might as well stay for lunch.
The oven is hot, so I might as well bake some bread too.
The meeting was so short that I might as well have stayed at home.
I didn't understand a word. I might as well have been listening to Russian.
The food was so bad that we might as well have eaten at home.
He didn't use the gym once. He might as well have kept his money.
The rain didn't stop all week. We might as well have gone somewhere hot.
Nobody read my email. I might as well have saved my time.
The bus took two hours. We might as well have walked.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + might as well + 原形動詞：那還不如

items.en: If you only eat burgers on holiday, you might as well stay in your own town.
items.zh: 如果你度假只吃漢堡，那還不如待在自己的城市。

items.en: If you're going to look at your phone all evening, you might as well go home.
items.zh: 如果你整晚都要看手機，那還不如回家。

items.en: If you don't listen to me, I might as well talk to the wall.
items.zh: 如果你不聽我說，我還不如對牆壁說話。

items.en: If nobody reads the reports, we might as well stop writing them.
items.zh: 如果沒有人讀這些報告，我們不如別寫了。

items.en: If the train costs the same, we might as well fly.
items.zh: 如果火車票價一樣，我們不如搭飛機。

items.en: If you're only going to sleep in class, you might as well stay in bed.
items.zh: 如果你上課只會睡覺，還不如待在床上。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + might as well + 原形動詞：既然這樣，就好好利用

items.en: If you reach old age in good health, you might as well make the best of these years.
items.zh: 如果你健康地活到老，那就不如好好利用這些年。

items.en: We're stuck here until the morning, so we might as well make the best of it.
items.zh: 我們早上前都困在這裡，所以不如好好利用這段時間。

items.en: The holiday is nearly over, so we might as well make the best of the last day.
items.zh: 假期快結束了，所以我們不如好好利用最後一天。

items.en: You can't change the weather, so you might as well enjoy the rain.
items.zh: 你沒辦法改變天氣，所以不如享受下雨。

items.en: The job isn't perfect, but you might as well learn as much as you can.
items.zh: 這份工作不完美，可是你不如盡量多學一點。

items.en: We've paid for the course, so we might as well go to every class.
items.zh: 課程的錢已經付了，所以我們不如每堂課都去上。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + might as well + 原形動詞：沒有更好的選擇

items.en: The last ferry has gone. We might as well find a hotel.
items.zh: 最後一班渡輪開走了。我們不如找一家飯店。

items.en: It's too late to cook. We might as well order a pizza.
items.zh: 太晚了不能煮飯。我們不如叫披薩。

items.en: The road is closed, so we might as well turn back.
items.zh: 路封了，所以我們不如掉頭。

items.en: Nobody's coming to the meeting. We might as well cancel it.
items.zh: 沒有人要來開會。我們不如取消吧。

items.en: The film has already started. We might as well wait for the next one.
items.zh: 電影已經開始了。我們不如等下一場。

items.en: My old phone is broken again. I might as well get a new one.
items.zh: 我的舊手機又壞了。我不如買一支新的。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + might as well + 原形動詞：做了也沒有壞處

items.en: The shop is on our way, so we might as well stop and buy some milk.
items.zh: 那家店就在路上，所以我們不如停下來買點牛奶。

items.en: You're already wet, so you might as well go for a swim.
items.zh: 你都已經濕了，不如去游個泳。

items.en: I'm going to the post office anyway, so I might as well send your parcel.
items.zh: 我反正要去郵局，乾脆幫你寄包裹。

items.en: The tickets are free, so we might as well go and see the show.
items.zh: 票是免費的，所以我們不如去看表演。

items.en: Since you're here, you might as well stay for lunch.
items.zh: 既然你來了，不如留下來吃午餐。

items.en: The oven is hot, so I might as well bake some bread too.
items.zh: 烤箱是熱的，所以我乾脆也烤些麵包。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + might as well + have + 過去分詞：說過去的事沒有意義

items.en: The meeting was so short that I might as well have stayed at home.
items.zh: 會議那麼短，我還不如待在家裡。

items.en: I didn't understand a word. I might as well have been listening to Russian.
items.zh: 我一個字都聽不懂。我還不如在聽俄文。

items.en: The food was so bad that we might as well have eaten at home.
items.zh: 食物那麼難吃，我們還不如在家吃。

items.en: He didn't use the gym once. He might as well have kept his money.
items.zh: 他一次都沒去健身房。他還不如把錢留著。

items.en: The rain didn't stop all week. We might as well have gone somewhere hot.
items.zh: 雨下了一整個星期。我們還不如去熱一點的地方。

items.en: Nobody read my email. I might as well have saved my time.
items.zh: 沒有人讀我的電子郵件。我還不如省下那些時間。

items.en: The bus took two hours. We might as well have walked.
items.zh: 公車花了兩個小時。我們還不如走路。

title: I'd be able to take walks without even worrying about inhaling polluted air.
translation: 我就能出去散步，根本不用擔心會吸到被汙染的空氣。
name: 情態動詞加 be able to
sentences: If we had a garden, the kids would be able to play outside.
If I lived closer to work, I'd be able to cycle every day.
If I had more time, I would be able to learn the piano.
With a bigger kitchen, we'd be able to invite more friends for dinner.
If the library opened on Sundays, students would be able to study there.
If she spoke English, she'd be able to get a better job.
Without the noise from the road, we'd be able to sleep with the windows open.
If you came by train, you'd be able to relax on the way.
After finishing school, you might be able to spend more time with your friends.
You might be able to get a cheaper flight on Tuesday.
I may be able to leave work early on Friday.
The mechanic might be able to fix the car today.
If we ask nicely, they may be able to give us a better room.
Grandpa might be able to come to the concert after all.
We may be able to see the northern lights tonight.
If we could meet in Switzerland, we should be able to finish the project by the 20th of June.
With the new software, you should be able to work much faster.
The bus leaves at six, so we should be able to get home by eight.
A good student should be able to answer this question.
If you follow the map, you should be able to find the house easily.
The new hospital should be able to treat more patients.
After a year in Paris, you should be able to speak good French.
All drivers must be able to read a number plate from twenty metres.
Applicants must be able to speak two languages.
Nurses must be able to work at night.
Children must be able to swim before they join the sailing club.
After the operation, you will be able to see clearly again.
Once you get your licence, you'll be able to drive to work.
Without your help, I wouldn't be able to finish this.
I might not be able to come to the meeting tomorrow.
If it rains, we may not be able to play the match.

examples.heading: ① would / 'd + be able to + 原形動詞：假設的情況

items.en: If we had a garden, the kids would be able to play outside.
items.zh: 如果我們有花園，孩子們就能在外面玩。

items.en: If I lived closer to work, I'd be able to cycle every day.
items.zh: 如果我住得離公司近一點，我就能每天騎腳踏車。

items.en: If I had more time, I would be able to learn the piano.
items.zh: 如果我有更多時間，我就能學鋼琴。

items.en: With a bigger kitchen, we'd be able to invite more friends for dinner.
items.zh: 如果廚房大一點，我們就能請更多朋友來吃晚餐。

items.en: If the library opened on Sundays, students would be able to study there.
items.zh: 如果圖書館星期天開放，學生就能去那裡讀書。

items.en: If she spoke English, she'd be able to get a better job.
items.zh: 如果她會說英文，她就能找到更好的工作。

items.en: Without the noise from the road, we'd be able to sleep with the windows open.
items.zh: 如果沒有馬路上的噪音，我們就能開著窗睡覺。

items.en: If you came by train, you'd be able to relax on the way.
items.zh: 如果你搭火車來，路上就能放鬆一下。

examples.heading: ② might / may + be able to + 原形動詞：也許能夠

items.en: After finishing school, you might be able to spend more time with your friends.
items.zh: 畢業以後，你也許能多花點時間跟朋友在一起。

items.en: You might be able to get a cheaper flight on Tuesday.
items.zh: 星期二你也許能買到比較便宜的機票。

items.en: I may be able to leave work early on Friday.
items.zh: 我星期五也許可以早點下班。

items.en: The mechanic might be able to fix the car today.
items.zh: 技師今天也許能修好車。

items.en: If we ask nicely, they may be able to give us a better room.
items.zh: 如果我們客氣地問，他們也許能給我們一間比較好的房間。

items.en: Grandpa might be able to come to the concert after all.
items.zh: 爺爺最後也許能來聽音樂會。

items.en: We may be able to see the northern lights tonight.
items.zh: 我們今晚也許能看到北極光。

examples.heading: ③ should + be able to + 原形動詞：應該能夠

items.en: If we could meet in Switzerland, we should be able to finish the project by the 20th of June.
items.zh: 如果我們能在瑞士見面，應該能在六月二十日前完成專案。

items.en: With the new software, you should be able to work much faster.
items.zh: 有了新軟體，你應該能做得快很多。

items.en: The bus leaves at six, so we should be able to get home by eight.
items.zh: 公車六點開，所以我們應該能在八點前到家。

items.en: A good student should be able to answer this question.
items.zh: 好學生應該能回答這個問題。

items.en: If you follow the map, you should be able to find the house easily.
items.zh: 如果你照著地圖走，應該很容易就能找到那間房子。

items.en: The new hospital should be able to treat more patients.
items.zh: 新醫院應該能治療更多病人。

items.en: After a year in Paris, you should be able to speak good French.
items.zh: 在巴黎待一年後，你應該能說一口好法文。

examples.heading: ④ must / will + be able to + 原形動詞

items.en: All drivers must be able to read a number plate from twenty metres.
items.zh: 所有駕駛都必須能看清楚二十公尺外的車牌。

items.en: Applicants must be able to speak two languages.
items.zh: 應徵者必須會說兩種語言。

items.en: Nurses must be able to work at night.
items.zh: 護理師必須能上夜班。

items.en: Children must be able to swim before they join the sailing club.
items.zh: 孩子們加入帆船社之前，必須會游泳。

items.en: After the operation, you will be able to see clearly again.
items.zh: 手術後你就能再看清楚了。

items.en: Once you get your licence, you'll be able to drive to work.
items.zh: 等你拿到駕照，你就能開車上班。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定：情態動詞 + not + be able to

items.en: Without your help, I wouldn't be able to finish this.
items.zh: 沒有你的幫忙，我沒辦法完成這件事。

items.en: I might not be able to come to the meeting tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天也許沒辦法來開會。

items.en: If it rains, we may not be able to play the match.
items.zh: 如果下雨，我們也許沒辦法比賽。

title: I cannot come to see you.
translation: 我沒辦法去看你。
name: can 的否定句（cannot、can't）
sentences: I cannot come to your party on Saturday, because I have to work.
We cannot pay for a new car this year.
My grandmother cannot walk very far now.
I cannot answer your question today.
The doctor cannot see you until Thursday.
Students cannot use their phones in the exam.
I cannot hear you very well.
We cannot open the windows in this office.
I'm very nervous and I can't say anything.
I can't find my glasses anywhere.
She can't eat cheese.
We can't stay long, because the baby is tired.
He can't reach the top shelf without a chair.
They can't come to the wedding.
I can't sleep when it's hot.
My little brother can't tie his shoes yet.
I can't see the board from here.
Our cat can't get down from the tree.
I can't understand this letter.
Dad can't fix the computer.
We can't hear the music in the garden.
I can't wait for the holidays!
You can't park in front of the school.
You can't take photos in the museum.
You can't swim here, because the water is too deep.
You can't bring food into the library.
You can't go out until you finish your homework.
You can't smoke in the restaurant.
You can't play football in the house.
You can't wear jeans to work in that office.
Children can't watch this film.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + cannot + 原形動詞

items.en: I cannot come to your party on Saturday, because I have to work.
items.zh: 我星期六沒辦法去你的派對，因為我要上班。

items.en: We cannot pay for a new car this year.
items.zh: 我們今年沒辦法買新車。

items.en: My grandmother cannot walk very far now.
items.zh: 我奶奶現在沒辦法走很遠。

items.en: I cannot answer your question today.
items.zh: 我今天沒辦法回答你的問題。

items.en: The doctor cannot see you until Thursday.
items.zh: 醫生星期四之前沒辦法看你。

items.en: Students cannot use their phones in the exam.
items.zh: 學生考試時不可以用手機。

items.en: I cannot hear you very well.
items.zh: 我聽不太清楚你說話。

items.en: We cannot open the windows in this office.
items.zh: 這間辦公室的窗戶打不開。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + can't + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm very nervous and I can't say anything.
items.zh: 我很緊張，什麼都說不出來。

items.en: I can't find my glasses anywhere.
items.zh: 我到處都找不到我的眼鏡。

items.en: She can't eat cheese.
items.zh: 她不能吃起司。

items.en: We can't stay long, because the baby is tired.
items.zh: 我們不能待太久，因為寶寶累了。

items.en: He can't reach the top shelf without a chair.
items.zh: 沒有椅子，他搆不到最上面的架子。

items.en: They can't come to the wedding.
items.zh: 他們沒辦法來參加婚禮。

items.en: I can't sleep when it's hot.
items.zh: 天氣熱的時候我睡不著。

items.en: My little brother can't tie his shoes yet.
items.zh: 我弟還不會綁鞋帶。

items.en: I can't see the board from here.
items.zh: 我從這裡看不到黑板。

items.en: Our cat can't get down from the tree.
items.zh: 我們的貓從樹上下不來。

items.en: I can't understand this letter.
items.zh: 我看不懂這封信。

items.en: Dad can't fix the computer.
items.zh: 爸爸修不好電腦。

items.en: We can't hear the music in the garden.
items.zh: 在花園裡聽不到音樂。

items.en: I can't wait for the holidays!
items.zh: 我等不及要放假了！

examples.heading: ③ You can't + 原形動詞：不可以

items.en: You can't park in front of the school.
items.zh: 你不可以把車停在學校前面。

items.en: You can't take photos in the museum.
items.zh: 博物館裡不可以拍照。

items.en: You can't swim here, because the water is too deep.
items.zh: 這裡不可以游泳，因為水太深了。

items.en: You can't bring food into the library.
items.zh: 不可以帶食物進圖書館。

items.en: You can't go out until you finish your homework.
items.zh: 寫完功課之前你不可以出去。

items.en: You can't smoke in the restaurant.
items.zh: 餐廳裡不可以抽菸。

items.en: You can't play football in the house.
items.zh: 不可以在家裡踢足球。

items.en: You can't wear jeans to work in that office.
items.zh: 在那間辦公室上班不可以穿牛仔褲。

items.en: Children can't watch this film.
items.zh: 小孩不可以看這部電影。

title: I couldn't close the window.
translation: 我沒辦法把窗戶關上。
name: could 的否定句
sentences: It rained all the way home. I couldn't find my umbrella this morning.
We sat at the back of the hall, so we couldn't hear the music.
The workers lost the key, so they couldn't get into the building.
There were thick clouds last night. You couldn't see the moon at all.
I bought too much at the market. I couldn't carry all the shopping home.
We drove around for twenty minutes. We couldn't find a parking space near the cinema.
The exam was very hard for my classmates. They couldn't answer the last question.
Sorry I'm late, boss. I couldn't wake up this morning.
My brother was scared of bikes. He couldn't ride one until he was eight.
The train was very crowded. She couldn't find a seat.
We found a bird in the garden. It couldn't fly because its wing was hurt.
I told my mum I got full marks. She couldn't believe it.
I called the clinic on Wednesday. The doctor couldn't see me until Monday.
There was ice on the road. Our old car couldn't go up the hill.
My dad told a really funny story at dinner. My little brother couldn't stop laughing.
Mark was ill, so he could not go to the game.
The weather turned bad, and the climbers could not reach the top of the mountain.
The school had strict rules. The students could not use their phones during the test.
When I opened the letter from the university, I could not believe my eyes.
The final was cancelled. The team could not play because of the storm.
The party was great last night. Too bad you couldn't come.
My phone died yesterday. Sorry I couldn't call you.
The hotel was full for the weekend. Too bad we couldn't stay longer.
We don't sell that part in this shop. Sorry we couldn't help you.
Anna had to work late. It's a pity she couldn't join us for dinner.
I couldn't close the door because the wind was too strong.
We went to the beach, but we couldn't swim because the sea was too rough.
The concert was sold out. She couldn't buy a ticket, so she stayed at home.
I asked my son a question, but he couldn't talk because his mouth was full.
Sorry, I couldn't hear you just now. The line was bad.

examples.heading: ① I / you / we / they + couldn't + 原形動詞

items.en: It rained all the way home. I couldn't find my umbrella this morning.
items.zh: 回家一路都在下雨。我今天早上找不到我的傘。

items.en: We sat at the back of the hall, so we couldn't hear the music.
items.zh: 我們坐在大廳的最後面，所以聽不到音樂。

items.en: The workers lost the key, so they couldn't get into the building.
items.zh: 工人弄丟了鑰匙，所以進不了那棟大樓。

items.en: There were thick clouds last night. You couldn't see the moon at all.
items.zh: 昨晚雲很厚。你根本看不到月亮。

items.en: I bought too much at the market. I couldn't carry all the shopping home.
items.zh: 我在市場買太多東西了。我沒辦法把買的東西全部提回家。

items.en: We drove around for twenty minutes. We couldn't find a parking space near the cinema.
items.zh: 我們開車繞了二十分鐘。我們在電影院附近找不到停車位。

items.en: The exam was very hard for my classmates. They couldn't answer the last question.
items.zh: 這次考試對我的同學來說很難。他們答不出最後一題。

items.en: Sorry I'm late, boss. I couldn't wake up this morning.
items.zh: 老闆，抱歉我遲到了。我今天早上起不來。

examples.heading: ② he / she / it + couldn't + 原形動詞

items.en: My brother was scared of bikes. He couldn't ride one until he was eight.
items.zh: 我弟弟以前很怕腳踏車。他到八歲才會騎。

items.en: The train was very crowded. She couldn't find a seat.
items.zh: 火車非常擠。她找不到座位。

items.en: We found a bird in the garden. It couldn't fly because its wing was hurt.
items.zh: 我們在花園裡發現一隻鳥。牠飛不起來，因為翅膀受傷了。

items.en: I told my mum I got full marks. She couldn't believe it.
items.zh: 我跟媽媽說我考了滿分。她不敢相信。

items.en: I called the clinic on Wednesday. The doctor couldn't see me until Monday.
items.zh: 我星期三打電話去診所。醫生要到星期一才能幫我看診。

items.en: There was ice on the road. Our old car couldn't go up the hill.
items.zh: 路上結冰了。我們那輛舊車開不上山坡。

items.en: My dad told a really funny story at dinner. My little brother couldn't stop laughing.
items.zh: 我爸爸晚餐時講了一個很好笑的故事。我弟弟笑個不停。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + could not + 原形動詞

items.en: Mark was ill, so he could not go to the game.
items.zh: 馬克生病了，所以沒辦法去看比賽。

items.en: The weather turned bad, and the climbers could not reach the top of the mountain.
items.zh: 天氣變壞了，登山客沒辦法爬到山頂。

items.en: The school had strict rules. The students could not use their phones during the test.
items.zh: 學校的規定很嚴。學生考試時不能用手機。

items.en: When I opened the letter from the university, I could not believe my eyes.
items.zh: 我打開大學寄來的信時，我不敢相信自己的眼睛。

items.en: The final was cancelled. The team could not play because of the storm.
items.zh: 決賽取消了。因為暴風雨，那支隊伍沒辦法比賽。

examples.heading: ④ Too bad / Sorry + couldn't

items.en: The party was great last night. Too bad you couldn't come.
items.zh: 昨晚的派對很棒。可惜你沒能來。

items.en: My phone died yesterday. Sorry I couldn't call you.
items.zh: 我的手機昨天沒電了。抱歉我沒辦法打給你。

items.en: The hotel was full for the weekend. Too bad we couldn't stay longer.
items.zh: 那間飯店週末都客滿了。可惜我們沒辦法待久一點。

items.en: We don't sell that part in this shop. Sorry we couldn't help you.
items.zh: 我們店裡沒有賣那個零件。抱歉我們沒能幫上你的忙。

items.en: Anna had to work late. It's a pity she couldn't join us for dinner.
items.zh: 安娜得加班。可惜她沒能跟我們一起吃晚餐。

examples.heading: ⑤ couldn't + 原形動詞，加上原因

items.en: I couldn't close the door because the wind was too strong.
items.zh: 風太大了，我關不上門。

items.en: We went to the beach, but we couldn't swim because the sea was too rough.
items.zh: 我們去了海邊，可是海浪太大，我們沒辦法游泳。

items.en: The concert was sold out. She couldn't buy a ticket, so she stayed at home.
items.zh: 演唱會的票賣光了。她買不到票，所以待在家裡。

items.en: I asked my son a question, but he couldn't talk because his mouth was full.
items.zh: 我問我兒子一個問題，可是他嘴裡塞滿了東西，沒辦法說話。

items.en: Sorry, I couldn't hear you just now. The line was bad.
items.zh: 抱歉，我剛剛聽不到你說話。收訊不好。

title: Many local people dare not go to that restaurant because it is too expensive.
translation: 很多當地人都不敢去那家餐廳，因為太貴了。
name: dare not 和 daren't 加原形動詞
sentences: Many students dare not ask questions in front of the whole class.
The children dare not make a noise when their father is sleeping.
I dare not open the letter from the bank.
She dare not tell her boss about the mistake.
We dare not leave the dog alone in the house.
He dare not look at the price tag.
Most people dare not walk in that park after dark.
The villagers dare not cross the river when it floods.
I dare not think about the exam results.
The team dare not lose another match this season.
I daren't look down from the top of the tower.
She daren't ask for another day off.
We daren't be late again. The teacher was furious last time.
He daren't go home without the shopping.
I daren't tell Mum that I broke her favourite cup.
They daren't complain because they need the job.
I daren't eat the mushrooms we picked in the woods.
My brother daren't go near the dentist's chair.
I daren't think what might have happened without the doctor.
I daren't imagine how much the repairs will cost.
I daren't think what my parents will say.
I daren't imagine what the house looks like after the party.
I daren't think how many emails are waiting for me.
I don't dare to ask her what happened.
He didn't dare tell his parents about the accident.
She doesn't dare to drive on the motorway.
We didn't dare go into the old house.
My cat doesn't dare to go near the neighbour's dog.
They didn't dare to disagree with the coach.
I didn't dare look at the screen during the scary part.
My sister didn't dare to open her exam results.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + dare not + 原形動詞

items.en: Many students dare not ask questions in front of the whole class.
items.zh: 很多學生不敢在全班面前問問題。

items.en: The children dare not make a noise when their father is sleeping.
items.zh: 爸爸睡覺的時候，孩子們不敢出聲。

items.en: I dare not open the letter from the bank.
items.zh: 我不敢打開銀行寄來的信。

items.en: She dare not tell her boss about the mistake.
items.zh: 她不敢跟老闆說那個錯誤。

items.en: We dare not leave the dog alone in the house.
items.zh: 我們不敢把狗單獨留在家。

items.en: He dare not look at the price tag.
items.zh: 他不敢看價格標籤。

items.en: Most people dare not walk in that park after dark.
items.zh: 大部分的人天黑後不敢在那個公園散步。

items.en: The villagers dare not cross the river when it floods.
items.zh: 河水氾濫的時候，村民不敢過河。

items.en: I dare not think about the exam results.
items.zh: 我不敢想考試的結果。

items.en: The team dare not lose another match this season.
items.zh: 這支隊伍這一季不敢再輸任何一場比賽。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + daren't + 原形動詞

items.en: I daren't look down from the top of the tower.
items.zh: 我在塔頂上不敢往下看。

items.en: She daren't ask for another day off.
items.zh: 她不敢再請一天假。

items.en: We daren't be late again. The teacher was furious last time.
items.zh: 我們不敢再遲到了，上次老師氣壞了。

items.en: He daren't go home without the shopping.
items.zh: 他沒買東西不敢回家。

items.en: I daren't tell Mum that I broke her favourite cup.
items.zh: 我不敢跟媽媽說我打破了她最喜歡的杯子。

items.en: They daren't complain because they need the job.
items.zh: 他們不敢抱怨，因為他們需要這份工作。

items.en: I daren't eat the mushrooms we picked in the woods.
items.zh: 我不敢吃我們在樹林裡摘的蘑菇。

items.en: My brother daren't go near the dentist's chair.
items.zh: 我哥不敢靠近牙醫的椅子。

examples.heading: ③ I daren't think / imagine + 子句

items.en: I daren't think what might have happened without the doctor.
items.zh: 我不敢想如果沒有醫生，會發生什麼事。

items.en: I daren't imagine how much the repairs will cost.
items.zh: 我不敢想像修理要花多少錢。

items.en: I daren't think what my parents will say.
items.zh: 我不敢想我爸媽會說什麼。

items.en: I daren't imagine what the house looks like after the party.
items.zh: 我不敢想像派對後房子變成什麼樣子。

items.en: I daren't think how many emails are waiting for me.
items.zh: 我不敢想有多少電子郵件在等著我。

examples.heading: ④ 一般動詞：don't / doesn't / didn't dare + (to) + 原形動詞

items.en: I don't dare to ask her what happened.
items.zh: 我不敢問她發生了什麼事。

items.en: He didn't dare tell his parents about the accident.
items.zh: 他不敢跟他爸媽說那場意外。

items.en: She doesn't dare to drive on the motorway.
items.zh: 她不敢在高速公路上開車。

items.en: We didn't dare go into the old house.
items.zh: 我們不敢進那間舊房子。

items.en: My cat doesn't dare to go near the neighbour's dog.
items.zh: 我的貓不敢靠近鄰居的狗。

items.en: They didn't dare to disagree with the coach.
items.zh: 他們不敢跟教練唱反調。

items.en: I didn't dare look at the screen during the scary part.
items.zh: 恐怖的那一段，我不敢看螢幕。

items.en: My sister didn't dare to open her exam results.
items.zh: 我姊不敢打開她的考試成績。

title: The country's population is not likely to increase fast enough.
translation: 你不一定要請他們來家裡。
name: be not 加形容詞加 to 不定詞
sentences: The old factory is not likely to open again.
The rain isn't likely to stop before the evening, so take an umbrella.
My boss is not likely to give me a day off next week. We're too busy.
The new road isn't likely to be ready before the summer.
The doctor says my grandfather is not likely to need an operation.
The team aren't likely to score many goals without their best player.
Our landlord isn't likely to lower the rent, but I'll ask him anyway.
As for tourism, its positive effects are not certain to outweigh the negative ones.
A good degree is not certain to get you a good job these days.
The ferry isn't certain to run if the wind gets stronger.
A famous actor is not certain to make the film a hit.
Cheap flights aren't certain to save you money once you pay for bags.
More police on the streets are not certain to reduce crime.
Your old phone isn't certain to work with the new charger.
You don't get on with your cousins, so you are not obliged to invite them over.
Shoppers are not obliged to give their email address at the till.
You aren't obliged to reply to every message from your manager at night.
Volunteers are not obliged to work every weekend.
Hotel guests aren't obliged to leave their passports at the desk.
As a visitor, you are not obliged to join in the prayers.
Readers aren't obliged to pay for the online version of the paper.
You are not bound to accept the first offer you get.
The company is not bound to give you a refund after thirty days.
Witnesses are not bound to answer questions from reporters.
Tenants aren't bound to stay for the whole year.
The new owner is not bound to keep the old staff.
Higher taxes on cigarettes are not likely to make everyone stop smoking.
New factories are not certain to bring jobs to the local people.
Online classes aren't likely to replace teachers completely.
The ban on plastic bags is not certain to solve the problem of waste.
Small companies are not obliged to publish their accounts every year.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + not + likely + to + 原形動詞：不太可能

items.en: The old factory is not likely to open again.
items.zh: 那間舊工廠不太可能再開工了。

items.en: The rain isn't likely to stop before the evening, so take an umbrella.
items.zh: 雨在傍晚前不太可能停，帶把傘吧。

items.en: My boss is not likely to give me a day off next week. We're too busy.
items.zh: 我老闆下星期不太可能讓我休假。我們太忙了。

items.en: The new road isn't likely to be ready before the summer.
items.zh: 新的道路在夏天前不太可能完工。

items.en: The doctor says my grandfather is not likely to need an operation.
items.zh: 醫生說我爺爺不太可能需要開刀。

items.en: The team aren't likely to score many goals without their best player.
items.zh: 少了最好的球員，球隊不太可能進很多球。

items.en: Our landlord isn't likely to lower the rent, but I'll ask him anyway.
items.zh: 我們的房東不太可能降房租，可是我還是會問他。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + not + certain + to + 原形動詞：不一定會

items.en: As for tourism, its positive effects are not certain to outweigh the negative ones.
items.zh: 說到觀光業，它的正面影響不一定大過負面影響。

items.en: A good degree is not certain to get you a good job these days.
items.zh: 現在有好學歷不一定能找到好工作。

items.en: The ferry isn't certain to run if the wind gets stronger.
items.zh: 風再大一點，渡輪不一定會開。

items.en: A famous actor is not certain to make the film a hit.
items.zh: 有名演員不一定能讓電影賣座。

items.en: Cheap flights aren't certain to save you money once you pay for bags.
items.zh: 付了行李費以後，便宜機票不一定能幫你省錢。

items.en: More police on the streets are not certain to reduce crime.
items.zh: 街上多一點警察不一定能減少犯罪。

items.en: Your old phone isn't certain to work with the new charger.
items.zh: 你的舊手機不一定能用新的充電器。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + not + obliged + to + 原形動詞：沒有義務

items.en: You don't get on with your cousins, so you are not obliged to invite them over.
items.zh: 你跟你的表親處不來，所以你不必邀請他們來家裡。

items.en: Shoppers are not obliged to give their email address at the till.
items.zh: 購物的人在收銀台不必留電子郵件地址。

items.en: You aren't obliged to reply to every message from your manager at night.
items.zh: 晚上你不必回覆經理傳來的每一則訊息。

items.en: Volunteers are not obliged to work every weekend.
items.zh: 志工不必每個週末都來工作。

items.en: Hotel guests aren't obliged to leave their passports at the desk.
items.zh: 飯店的客人不必把護照留在櫃台。

items.en: As a visitor, you are not obliged to join in the prayers.
items.zh: 你是訪客，不必跟著一起禱告。

items.en: Readers aren't obliged to pay for the online version of the paper.
items.zh: 讀者看報紙的網路版不必付錢。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + be + not + bound + to + 原形動詞：沒有義務

items.en: You are not bound to accept the first offer you get.
items.zh: 你不一定要接受第一個報價。

items.en: The company is not bound to give you a refund after thirty days.
items.zh: 三十天後，公司沒有義務退款給你。

items.en: Witnesses are not bound to answer questions from reporters.
items.zh: 證人沒有義務回答記者的問題。

items.en: Tenants aren't bound to stay for the whole year.
items.zh: 房客不必住滿一整年。

items.en: The new owner is not bound to keep the old staff.
items.zh: 新老闆沒有義務留下原來的員工。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + be + not + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞：作文和報告的判斷

items.en: Higher taxes on cigarettes are not likely to make everyone stop smoking.
items.zh: 提高香菸稅不太可能讓每個人都戒菸。

items.en: New factories are not certain to bring jobs to the local people.
items.zh: 新工廠不一定會為當地人帶來工作。

items.en: Online classes aren't likely to replace teachers completely.
items.zh: 線上課程不太可能完全取代老師。

items.en: The ban on plastic bags is not certain to solve the problem of waste.
items.zh: 禁用塑膠袋不一定能解決垃圾問題。

items.en: Small companies are not obliged to publish their accounts every year.
items.zh: 小公司不必每年公布帳目。

title: You don't have to bring many things with you.
translation: 你不用帶很多東西。
name: have (got) to 的否定句
sentences: You don't have to bring food. Lunch is included in the price.
About the transport, you don't have to worry. My dad can drop us at the sports centre.
We don't have to get up early tomorrow. There's no school.
You don't have to pay for the museum. It's free on Sundays.
I don't have to wear a tie at my new job.

items.zh: 我明天開始新工作。我第一天不可以遲到。

items.en: Shh, Dad's asleep. We mustn't make too much noise.
items.zh: 噓，爸爸在睡覺。我們不可以太吵。

items.en: I've already had three bars of chocolate. I mustn't eat any more this week.
items.zh: 我已經吃了三條巧克力。我這個星期不可以再吃了。

items.en: We only have two hundred euros for the holiday. We mustn't spend it all on the first day.
items.zh: 我們這趟旅行只有兩百歐元。我們不可以第一天就花光。

items.en: I have a big exam in the morning. I mustn't stay up late tonight.
items.zh: 我明天早上有一場大考。我今天晚上不可以熬夜。

items.en: There's no phone signal in these mountains. We mustn't lose the map.
items.zh: 這片山區沒有手機訊號。我們不可以把地圖弄丟。

examples.heading: ⑤ mustn't + 原形動詞 + because + 子句

items.en: You mustn't wake the baby because she's only just gone to sleep.
items.zh: 你不可以吵醒寶寶，因為她才剛睡著。

items.en: We mustn't miss the train because it's the last one tonight.
items.zh: 我們不可以錯過那班火車，因為那是今晚最後一班。

items.en: We're camping by the river. You mustn't drink the water because it isn't clean.
items.zh: 我們在河邊露營。你不可以喝河水，因為它不乾淨。

items.en: I mustn't fail this test because I need a good grade for university.
items.zh: 我這次考試不可以不及格，因為我申請大學需要好成績。

items.en: This station is very busy. You mustn't leave your bag here because someone might take it.
items.zh: 這個車站人很多。你不可以把包包留在這裡，因為可能有人會拿走。

items.en: You mustn't sit on that bench because the paint is still wet.
items.zh: 你不可以坐那張長椅，因為油漆還沒乾。

title: You needn't worry about where we can stay.
translation: 你不用擔心我們要住哪裡。
name: need 的否定句 needn't
sentences: My uncle has a cabin by the lake, so you needn't worry about where we can stay.
Come with us to Italy this summer. You needn't worry about the cost. My parents are paying.
Come in, it's all right. You needn't worry about the dog. He's very friendly.
You needn't worry about tomorrow's exam. You've studied hard all term.
Enjoy your evening at the theatre. You needn't worry about the children. Grandma is looking after them.
Our farm is hard to find, but you needn't worry about getting lost. I'll send you a map.
My sister lives in New York, but when I send an email, I need not worry about the time difference.
I need not get up early tomorrow. It's Sunday.
My old coat is still warm and looks fine. I needn't buy a new one this winter.
We moved to a flat near my work, so I need not take the bus any more.
It's my birthday, and Dad has booked a table. I needn't cook tonight.
Every shop in this city takes cards. With this one, I need not carry any cash.
You needn't go jogging this evening because you've already had your exercise today.
Pack light for the trip. You needn't bring a towel because the hotel has them.
It's only half past seven. You needn't hurry because the film starts at nine.
It's late, and it's raining. You needn't call a taxi because I can drive you home.
Your son is five, isn't he? You needn't buy a ticket for him because children under six travel free.
Thanks for dinner. Can I help? No, you needn't wash the dishes because we have a dishwasher.
Tell Sarah the meeting is only about the summer party. She needn't come if she's busy.
The party at the office is very casual. Your husband needn't wear a tie.
The guests at the wedding needn't pay for the drinks. They're free all night.
Monday is a bank holiday. The children needn't go to school.
Your brother needn't bring anything to the barbecue. We've got plenty of food.
The museum website says: "Visitors need not book in advance."
It's only a small party at my flat. You needn't come if you don't want to.
The report is due on Friday. You needn't finish it today if you're tired.
Let me check the board first. We needn't leave the café yet if the train is delayed.
It's just a quiz for fun. You needn't answer if you don't know.
Tell Mia she needn't stay at work if she feels ill.
Your essay is good. You needn't write it all again if there are only small mistakes.
The beach is only a mile away. We needn't take the car if the weather is nice.

examples.heading: ① You needn't worry about + 名詞：讓對方放心

items.en: My uncle has a cabin by the lake, so you needn't worry about where we can stay.
items.zh: 我叔叔在湖邊有一間小木屋，所以你不必擔心我們住哪裡。

items.en: Come with us to Italy this summer. You needn't worry about the cost. My parents are paying.
items.zh: 今年夏天跟我們去義大利吧。你不必擔心費用。我爸媽會付。

items.en: Come in, it's all right. You needn't worry about the dog. He's very friendly.
items.zh: 進來吧，沒關係。你不必擔心那隻狗。牠很友善。

items.en: You needn't worry about tomorrow's exam. You've studied hard all term.
items.zh: 你不必擔心明天的考試。你整個學期都很用功。

items.en: Enjoy your evening at the theatre. You needn't worry about the children. Grandma is looking after them.
items.zh: 好好享受在劇院的晚上。你不必擔心孩子們。奶奶在照顧他們。

items.en: Our farm is hard to find, but you needn't worry about getting lost. I'll send you a map.
items.zh: 我們的農場很難找，可是你不必擔心迷路。我會寄地圖給你。

examples.heading: ② I need not + 原形動詞：說自己不必做的事

items.en: My sister lives in New York, but when I send an email, I need not worry about the time difference.
items.zh: 我姊姊住在紐約，可是我寄電子郵件的時候，不必擔心時差。

items.en: I need not get up early tomorrow. It's Sunday.
items.zh: 我明天不必早起。是星期天。

items.en: My old coat is still warm and looks fine. I needn't buy a new one this winter.
items.zh: 我的舊外套還很保暖，看起來也不錯。今年冬天我不必買新的。

items.en: We moved to a flat near my work, so I need not take the bus any more.
items.zh: 我們搬到離我公司很近的公寓，所以我不必再搭公車了。

items.en: It's my birthday, and Dad has booked a table. I needn't cook tonight.
items.zh: 今天是我生日，爸爸訂了位。我今天晚上不必煮飯。

items.en: Every shop in this city takes cards. With this one, I need not carry any cash.
items.zh: 這個城市每家店都收卡。有了這張卡，我不必帶任何現金。

examples.heading: ③ You needn't + 原形動詞, because + 子句

items.en: You needn't go jogging this evening because you've already had your exercise today.
items.zh: 你今天傍晚不必去慢跑，因為你今天已經運動過了。

items.en: Pack light for the trip. You needn't bring a towel because the hotel has them.
items.zh: 這趟旅行東西帶少一點。你不必帶毛巾，因為飯店有。

items.en: It's only half past seven. You needn't hurry because the film starts at nine.
items.zh: 現在才七點半。你不必趕，因為電影九點才開始。

items.en: It's late, and it's raining. You needn't call a taxi because I can drive you home.
items.zh: 很晚了，又在下雨。你不必叫計程車，因為我可以載你回家。

items.en: Your son is five, isn't he? You needn't buy a ticket for him because children under six travel free.
items.zh: 你兒子五歲，對嗎？你不必幫他買票，因為六歲以下的小孩搭車免費。

items.en: Thanks for dinner. Can I help? No, you needn't wash the dishes because we have a dishwasher.
items.zh: 謝謝你的晚餐。我可以幫忙嗎？不用，你不必洗碗，因為我們有洗碗機。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + needn't + 原形動詞：別人不必做的事

items.en: Tell Sarah the meeting is only about the summer party. She needn't come if she's busy.
items.zh: 跟 Sarah 說那個會只是討論夏日派對。如果她很忙，她不必來。

items.en: The party at the office is very casual. Your husband needn't wear a tie.
items.zh: 公司的派對很隨性。你先生不必打領帶。

items.en: The guests at the wedding needn't pay for the drinks. They're free all night.
items.zh: 婚禮的客人不必付飲料的錢。整晚都是免費的。

items.en: Monday is a bank holiday. The children needn't go to school.
items.zh: 星期一是國定假日。孩子們不必上學。

items.en: Your brother needn't bring anything to the barbecue. We've got plenty of food.
items.zh: 你哥哥不必帶任何東西來烤肉。我們有很多食物。

items.en: The museum website says: "Visitors need not book in advance."
items.zh: 博物館網站上寫著：參觀者不必事先預約。

examples.heading: ⑤ needn't + 原形動詞 + if + 子句

items.en: It's only a small party at my flat. You needn't come if you don't want to.
items.zh: 只是在我公寓的小派對。如果你不想來，你不必來。

items.en: The report is due on Friday. You needn't finish it today if you're tired.
items.zh: 報告星期五才要交。如果你累了，你今天不必做完。

items.en: Let me check the board first. We needn't leave the café yet if the train is delayed.
items.zh: 我先看一下看板。如果火車誤點，我們還不必離開咖啡店。

items.en: It's just a quiz for fun. You needn't answer if you don't know.
items.zh: 這只是好玩的小測驗。如果你不知道，你不必回答。

items.en: Tell Mia she needn't stay at work if she feels ill.
items.zh: 跟 Mia 說，如果她覺得不舒服，她不必留在公司。

items.en: Your essay is good. You needn't write it all again if there are only small mistakes.
items.zh: 你的作文很好。如果只有小錯，你不必全部重寫。

items.en: The beach is only a mile away. We needn't take the car if the weather is nice.
items.zh: 海灘只有一英里遠。如果天氣好，我們不必開車。

title: We ought not to forget that the food industry has increased the number of chemicals in its products.
translation: 不應該有貧富之分。
name: ought not to 否定式
sentences: Food may look safe, but we ought not to forget that the food industry has increased the chemicals in its products.
The mayor spoke at the town's two-hundredth birthday. We ought not to forget the people who built this town.
Summers are getting hotter every year. We ought not to ignore the warnings of scientists.
The new MP hasn't visited our town once. Politicians ought not to forget who voted for them.
Everyone at the council meeting loves the plan. But we ought not to ignore the cost of the new stadium.
Many old people in our town live alone. Young people ought not to forget their grandparents.
In a fair society, there ought not to be such a big division between rich and poor.
Our class cleaned the beach last Saturday. There ought not to be any rubbish on it.
The air in the centre is terrible. There ought not to be so many cars there.
My essay argues that children need time to play. There ought not to be any homework at weekends.
The station asked for fifty pence to use the toilet. There ought not to be a charge for that.
My sister earns less than the men in her team. There ought not to be any difference between men's and women's pay.
In my essay on technology, I argue that children ought not to spend more than two hours a day in front of a screen.
Many shampoos are still tested on rabbits. Companies ought not to test their products on animals.
Families are already struggling to pay for bread and milk. The government ought not to raise taxes on food.
A third of the children in our town are overweight. Schools ought not to sell sugary drinks.
The singer couldn't even go to the shops in peace. Famous people ought not to be followed by photographers everywhere.
Ships full of old plastic leave Europe every week. Rich countries ought not to send their waste to poor countries.
My cousin is a young doctor, and he often works all night. Doctors ought not to work thirty hours without sleep.
The car in front didn't move when the light went green. Drivers ought not to use their phones at red lights.
The hotel lost two hundred towels last summer. Guests ought not to take them home.
Half the essays were the same as a website. Students ought not to copy from the internet.
In my interview, they asked if I planned to have children. Employers ought not to ask about your private life.
I couldn't sleep until three because of the flat upstairs. Neighbours ought not to play loud music after midnight.
Our town had no rain in July. We ought not to waste water, because the lakes are very low.
My mum always asked why I wasn't like my sister. Parents ought not to compare their children, because every child is different.
You always feel weak by eleven. You ought not to skip breakfast, because it gives you energy.
The council wants to build a road through Hill Wood. We ought not to cut down the old forest, because many animals live there.
Most car trips in our town are under a mile. People ought not to drive short distances, because walking is healthier.
The supermarket now opens on Christmas Day. Shops ought not to open on every holiday, because staff need rest too.
The man in the old coat was the company's owner. We ought not to judge people by their clothes, because appearances can be wrong.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + ought not to + forget / ignore：提醒重要的事

items.en: Food may look safe, but we ought not to forget that the food industry has increased the chemicals in its products.
items.zh: 食物看起來可能很安全，可是我們不應該忘記，食品業增加了產品裡的化學物質。

items.en: The mayor spoke at the town's two-hundredth birthday. We ought not to forget the people who built this town.
items.zh: 市長在鎮上兩百週年的慶祝會上致詞。我們不應該忘記建設這個鎮的人。

items.en: Summers are getting hotter every year. We ought not to ignore the warnings of scientists.
items.zh: 夏天一年比一年熱。我們不應該忽視科學家的警告。

items.en: The new MP hasn't visited our town once. Politicians ought not to forget who voted for them.
items.zh: 新的國會議員一次都沒來過我們鎮上。政客不應該忘記是誰投票給他們。

items.en: Everyone at the council meeting loves the plan. But we ought not to ignore the cost of the new stadium.
items.zh: 議會上大家都很喜歡這個計畫。可是我們不應該忽視新體育場的費用。

items.en: Many old people in our town live alone. Young people ought not to forget their grandparents.
items.zh: 我們鎮上很多老人一個人住。年輕人不應該忘記他們的祖父母。

examples.heading: ② There ought not to be + 名詞：不應該存在的情況

items.en: In a fair society, there ought not to be such a big division between rich and poor.
items.zh: 在一個公平的社會裡，貧富之間不應該有這麼大的差距。

items.en: Our class cleaned the beach last Saturday. There ought not to be any rubbish on it.
items.zh: 我們班上星期六去清理海灘。海灘上不應該有任何垃圾。

items.en: The air in the centre is terrible. There ought not to be so many cars there.
items.zh: 市中心的空氣很糟。那裡不應該有這麼多車。

items.en: My essay argues that children need time to play. There ought not to be any homework at weekends.
items.zh: 我的作文主張孩子需要時間玩。週末不應該有任何功課。

items.en: The station asked for fifty pence to use the toilet. There ought not to be a charge for that.
items.zh: 車站上廁所要收五十便士。那不應該收費。

items.en: My sister earns less than the men in her team. There ought not to be any difference between men's and women's pay.
items.zh: 我姊姊賺得比她團隊裡的男生少。男女的薪水不應該有任何差別。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + ought not to + 原形動詞：議論文的意見

items.en: In my essay on technology, I argue that children ought not to spend more than two hours a day in front of a screen.
items.zh: 我在科技的作文裡主張，孩子一天不應該在螢幕前超過兩個小時。

items.en: Many shampoos are still tested on rabbits. Companies ought not to test their products on animals.
items.zh: 很多洗髮精還在用兔子測試。公司不應該用動物測試產品。

items.en: Families are already struggling to pay for bread and milk. The government ought not to raise taxes on food.
items.zh: 家庭已經很難負擔麵包和牛奶了。政府不應該提高食物的稅。

items.en: A third of the children in our town are overweight. Schools ought not to sell sugary drinks.
items.zh: 我們鎮上三分之一的孩子過重。學校不應該賣含糖飲料。

items.en: The singer couldn't even go to the shops in peace. Famous people ought not to be followed by photographers everywhere.
items.zh: 那位歌手連去商店都不得安寧。名人不應該到哪裡都被攝影師跟著。（被動）

items.en: Ships full of old plastic leave Europe every week. Rich countries ought not to send their waste to poor countries.
items.zh: 每週都有載滿舊塑膠的船離開歐洲。富裕的國家不應該把垃圾送到貧窮的國家。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + ought not to + 原形動詞：規範和行為

items.en: My cousin is a young doctor, and he often works all night. Doctors ought not to work thirty hours without sleep.
items.zh: 我表哥是年輕醫生，常常整晚工作。醫生不應該不睡覺連續工作三十個小時。

items.en: The car in front didn't move when the light went green. Drivers ought not to use their phones at red lights.
items.zh: 綠燈亮了，前面那台車都沒動。駕駛停紅燈的時候不應該用手機。

items.en: The hotel lost two hundred towels last summer. Guests ought not to take them home.
items.zh: 飯店去年夏天少了兩百條毛巾。客人不應該把毛巾帶回家。

items.en: Half the essays were the same as a website. Students ought not to copy from the internet.
items.zh: 一半的作文跟某個網站一模一樣。學生不應該從網路上抄東西。

items.en: In my interview, they asked if I planned to have children. Employers ought not to ask about your private life.
items.zh: 面試時他們問我打不打算生小孩。雇主不應該問你的私生活。

items.en: I couldn't sleep until three because of the flat upstairs. Neighbours ought not to play loud music after midnight.
items.zh: 因為樓上的公寓，我到三點都睡不著。鄰居半夜以後不應該放很大聲的音樂。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + ought not to + 原形動詞, because + 子句

items.en: Our town had no rain in July. We ought not to waste water, because the lakes are very low.
items.zh: 我們鎮上七月都沒下雨。我們不應該浪費水，因為湖水很低。

items.en: My mum always asked why I wasn't like my sister. Parents ought not to compare their children, because every child is different.
items.zh: 我媽媽總是問我為什麼不像我姊姊。父母不應該比較孩子，因為每個孩子都不一樣。

items.en: You always feel weak by eleven. You ought not to skip breakfast, because it gives you energy.
items.zh: 你總是到十一點就沒力氣。你不應該不吃早餐，因為早餐給你能量。

items.en: The council wants to build a road through Hill Wood. We ought not to cut down the old forest, because many animals live there.
items.zh: 議會想在 Hill 森林裡蓋一條路。我們不應該砍掉那片老森林，因為很多動物住在那裡。

items.en: Most car trips in our town are under a mile. People ought not to drive short distances, because walking is healthier.
items.zh: 我們鎮上大部分的開車行程都不到一英里。人們不應該開車去近的地方，因為走路比較健康。

items.en: The supermarket now opens on Christmas Day. Shops ought not to open on every holiday, because staff need rest too.
items.zh: 超市現在聖誕節也營業。商店不應該每個假日都開，因為員工也需要休息。

items.en: The man in the old coat was the company's owner. We ought not to judge people by their clothes, because appearances can be wrong.
items.zh: 穿舊外套的那個人是公司的老闆。我們不應該以衣著判斷人，因為外表可能會誤導。

title: This way, students shall not die of boredom or feel that their stay was useless.
translation: 供應商合約不得省略。
name: 情態動詞 shall 的否定式
sentences: With trips every afternoon, students shall not die of boredom or feel that their stay was useless.
If we follow this plan, we shall not lose any more customers.
With the new timetable, we shall not have to wait more than ten minutes for a bus.
If we recycle more, we shall not need a second rubbish dump.
With better lighting in the park, we shall not feel afraid to walk home at night.
With two new teachers, we shall not have to cancel any more classes.
Secondly, supplier contracts shall not be omitted from the report.
The results shall not be shared with anyone outside the company.
This agreement shall not be changed without the consent of both sides.
Personal information shall not be used for advertising.
The deposit shall not be returned if the flat is damaged.
Tickets shall not be sold to anyone under sixteen.
The tenant shall not rent any room in the flat to another person.
Members of the golf club shall not wear jeans in the dining room.
Staff shall not use company cars for private trips at the weekend.
Players shall not leave the field without the referee's permission.
Visitors shall not smoke anywhere on the hospital grounds.
The writer shall not publish the story in any other magazine.
I have a meeting until six, so I shall not be able to pick you up at the airport. My brother will meet you.
Dear Dr Wood, because of my operation, I shall not be able to attend the conference in May.
We shall not be able to deliver the goods before Friday.
I'm afraid I shall not be able to finish the report this week.
Unfortunately, we shall not be able to offer you a place this year.
I shall not be able to reply to emails while I'm abroad.
Don't wait up for me. I shan't be home until midnight.
We shan't need a big car for only three people.
I shan't stay long at the party. I'm very tired.
We shan't go camping if it rains all weekend.
I shan't say anything to Dad about the broken window.
We shan't forget our week in your lovely cottage.
I shan't buy another phone from that shop.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + shall not + 原形動詞：建議書裡說的結果

items.en: With trips every afternoon, students shall not die of boredom or feel that their stay was useless.
items.zh: 每天下午都有參觀活動，學生就不會無聊得要死，也不會覺得這趟留學沒有用。

items.en: If we follow this plan, we shall not lose any more customers.
items.zh: 如果我們照這個計畫做，我們就不會再流失顧客。

items.en: With the new timetable, we shall not have to wait more than ten minutes for a bus.
items.zh: 有了新時刻表，我們等公車就不必等超過十分鐘。

items.en: If we recycle more, we shall not need a second rubbish dump.
items.zh: 如果我們多做回收，就不需要第二個垃圾場。

items.en: With better lighting in the park, we shall not feel afraid to walk home at night.
items.zh: 公園有了更好的照明，我們晚上走路回家就不會害怕。

items.en: With two new teachers, we shall not have to cancel any more classes.
items.zh: 有了兩位新老師，我們就不必再取消任何課程。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + shall not + be + 過去分詞：合約和規定

items.en: Secondly, supplier contracts shall not be omitted from the report.
items.zh: 第二，報告裡不得遺漏供應商合約。（被動）

items.en: The results shall not be shared with anyone outside the company.
items.zh: 結果不得與公司以外的人分享。（被動）

items.en: This agreement shall not be changed without the consent of both sides.
items.zh: 這份協議未經雙方同意不得更改。（被動）

items.en: Personal information shall not be used for advertising.
items.zh: 個人資料不得用於廣告。（被動）

items.en: The deposit shall not be returned if the flat is damaged.
items.zh: 如果公寓有損壞，押金不會退還。（被動）

items.en: Tickets shall not be sold to anyone under sixteen.
items.zh: 門票不得賣給十六歲以下的人。（被動）

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + shall not + 原形動詞：規定不准做的事

items.en: The tenant shall not rent any room in the flat to another person.
items.zh: 房客不得把公寓裡的任何房間租給別人。

items.en: Members of the golf club shall not wear jeans in the dining room.
items.zh: 高爾夫球俱樂部的會員不得在餐廳穿牛仔褲。

items.en: Staff shall not use company cars for private trips at the weekend.
items.zh: 員工週末不得把公司的車用於私人行程。

items.en: Players shall not leave the field without the referee's permission.
items.zh: 沒有裁判允許，球員不得離開球場。

items.en: Visitors shall not smoke anywhere on the hospital grounds.
items.zh: 訪客不得在醫院範圍內的任何地方抽菸。

items.en: The writer shall not publish the story in any other magazine.
items.zh: 作者不得在其他雜誌刊登這篇故事。

examples.heading: ④ I / We + shall not + be able to + 原形動詞：正式地說不能做的事

items.en: I have a meeting until six, so I shall not be able to pick you up at the airport. My brother will meet you.
items.zh: 我開會開到六點，所以將無法去機場接你。我哥哥會去接你。

items.en: Dear Dr Wood, because of my operation, I shall not be able to attend the conference in May.
items.zh: Wood 博士您好，因為我要開刀，我將無法出席五月的研討會。

items.en: We shall not be able to deliver the goods before Friday.
items.zh: 我們星期五前將無法交貨。

items.en: I'm afraid I shall not be able to finish the report this week.
items.zh: 恐怕我這個星期將無法完成報告。

items.en: Unfortunately, we shall not be able to offer you a place this year.
items.zh: 很遺憾，我們今年將無法給你一個名額。

items.en: I shall not be able to reply to emails while I'm abroad.
items.zh: 我在國外的時候將無法回覆電子郵件。

examples.heading: ⑤ I / We + shan't + 原形動詞：口語的不會

items.en: Don't wait up for me. I shan't be home until midnight.
items.zh: 別等我。我半夜才會到家。

items.en: We shan't need a big car for only three people.
items.zh: 只有三個人，我們不需要大車。

items.en: I shan't stay long at the party. I'm very tired.
items.zh: 我不會在派對待很久。我很累。

items.en: We shan't go camping if it rains all weekend.
items.zh: 如果整個週末都下雨，我們不會去露營。

items.en: I shan't say anything to Dad about the broken window.
items.zh: 我不會跟爸爸說窗戶破掉的事。

items.en: We shan't forget our week in your lovely cottage.
items.zh: 我們不會忘記在你那間可愛小屋度過的那一週。

items.en: I shan't buy another phone from that shop.
items.zh: 我不會再從那家店買手機了。

title: It's a new flat, so there shouldn't be any problems.
translation: 這個你不應該錯過。
name: should 的否定句
sentences: We've rented a brand-new flat, so there shouldn't be any problems with the heating.
We booked the tickets weeks ago, so there shouldn't be a problem at the door.
It's a quiet road, so there shouldn't be much traffic in the morning.
The forecast is good, so there shouldn't be any rain on the wedding day.
The office is closed on Sunday, so there shouldn't be anyone there.
We've got plenty of chairs, so there shouldn't be any trouble finding a seat.
It's the best film of the year. You shouldn't miss it.
You shouldn't wear your favourite clothes to the farm because they might get dirty.
You shouldn't leave your bag on the chair in a busy café.
The sea is very rough today. You shouldn't go out in that little boat.
You shouldn't stay up so late before your driving test.
You shouldn't lend your bike to people you don't know.
The bus comes every ten minutes, so we shouldn't have to wait long.
The exam is on things we've practised, so it shouldn't be too difficult.
The repair is quite simple, so it shouldn't cost very much.
The journey is only an hour, so the children shouldn't get bored.
The paint is dry now, so it shouldn't mark your clothes.
My sister knows the way, so she shouldn't get lost.
Hikers should not leave the marked path in foggy weather.
Medicine should not be left where children can reach it.
Drivers should not park in front of the fire station.
Visitors should not feed the animals in the zoo.
Food should not be kept in the fridge for more than three days.
Young children should not walk to school alone.
I don't think you should buy that coat. It's too big for you.
I don't think we should tell Mum about the broken plate yet.
I don't think she should drive in this snow.
I don't think they should build a car park on the football field.
I don't think you should eat that. It smells strange.
I don't think he should leave school at sixteen.
I don't think we should go out in this storm.

examples.heading: ① There shouldn't be + 名詞：應該不會有

items.en: We've rented a brand-new flat, so there shouldn't be any problems with the heating.
items.zh: 我們租了一間全新的公寓，所以暖氣應該不會有任何問題。

items.en: We booked the tickets weeks ago, so there shouldn't be a problem at the door.
items.zh: 我們幾個星期前就訂了票，所以門口應該不會有問題。

items.en: It's a quiet road, so there shouldn't be much traffic in the morning.
items.zh: 那是一條安靜的路，所以早上應該不會有很多車。

items.en: The forecast is good, so there shouldn't be any rain on the wedding day.
items.zh: 天氣預報很好，所以婚禮那天應該不會下雨。

items.en: The office is closed on Sunday, so there shouldn't be anyone there.
items.zh: 辦公室星期天不開，所以那裡應該不會有人。

items.en: We've got plenty of chairs, so there shouldn't be any trouble finding a seat.
items.zh: 我們有很多椅子，所以應該不會找不到位子。

examples.heading: ② You shouldn't + 原形動詞：勸對方不要做

items.en: It's the best film of the year. You shouldn't miss it.
items.zh: 那是今年最好的電影。你不應該錯過。

items.en: You shouldn't wear your favourite clothes to the farm because they might get dirty.
items.zh: 你不應該穿你最喜歡的衣服去農場，因為可能會弄髒。

items.en: You shouldn't leave your bag on the chair in a busy café.
items.zh: 在人很多的咖啡館裡，你不應該把包包放在椅子上。

items.en: The sea is very rough today. You shouldn't go out in that little boat.
items.zh: 今天海浪很大。你不應該坐那艘小船出海。

items.en: You shouldn't stay up so late before your driving test.
items.zh: 考駕照前你不應該熬夜到那麼晚。

items.en: You shouldn't lend your bike to people you don't know.
items.zh: 你不應該把腳踏車借給你不認識的人。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + shouldn't + 原形動詞：應該不會

items.en: The bus comes every ten minutes, so we shouldn't have to wait long.
items.zh: 公車每十分鐘一班，所以我們應該不用等很久。

items.en: The exam is on things we've practised, so it shouldn't be too difficult.
items.zh: 考試考的是我們練習過的東西，所以應該不會太難。

items.en: The repair is quite simple, so it shouldn't cost very much.
items.zh: 修理很簡單，所以應該不會花很多錢。

items.en: The journey is only an hour, so the children shouldn't get bored.
items.zh: 路程只有一個小時，所以孩子們應該不會覺得無聊。

items.en: The paint is dry now, so it shouldn't mark your clothes.
items.zh: 油漆現在乾了，所以應該不會弄髒你的衣服。

items.en: My sister knows the way, so she shouldn't get lost.
items.zh: 我姊姊認得路，所以她應該不會迷路。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + should not + 原形動詞：規定和正式的建議

items.en: Hikers should not leave the marked path in foggy weather.
items.zh: 起霧的時候，健行的人不應該離開標示的步道。

items.en: Medicine should not be left where children can reach it.
items.zh: 藥不應該放在孩子拿得到的地方。（被動）

items.en: Drivers should not park in front of the fire station.
items.zh: 駕駛不應該把車停在消防局前面。

items.en: Visitors should not feed the animals in the zoo.
items.zh: 參觀者不應該餵動物園裡的動物。

items.en: Food should not be kept in the fridge for more than three days.
items.zh: 食物不應該放在冰箱超過三天。（被動）

items.en: Young children should not walk to school alone.
items.zh: 小孩子不應該一個人走路上學。

examples.heading: ⑤ I don't think + 主詞 + should + 原形動詞

items.en: I don't think you should buy that coat. It's too big for you.
items.zh: 我覺得你不應該買那件外套。它對你來說太大了。

items.en: I don't think we should tell Mum about the broken plate yet.
items.zh: 我覺得我們還不應該告訴媽媽盤子破掉的事。

items.en: I don't think she should drive in this snow.
items.zh: 我覺得她不應該在這種雪裡開車。

items.en: I don't think they should build a car park on the football field.
items.zh: 我覺得他們不應該在足球場上蓋停車場。

items.en: I don't think you should eat that. It smells strange.
items.zh: 我覺得你不應該吃那個。它聞起來很怪。

items.en: I don't think he should leave school at sixteen.
items.zh: 我覺得他不應該十六歲就離開學校。

items.en: I don't think we should go out in this storm.
items.zh: 我覺得我們不應該在這種暴風雨裡出門。

title: This year I've met lots of new people that I didn't use to talk to.
translation: 我們以前都不跟彼此講話。
name: used to 的否定句（didn't use to）
sentences: My sister and I fought all the time. We didn't use to talk to each other, but now we're very close.
I didn't use to like coffee, but now I drink three cups a day.
He didn't use to exercise, but now he runs every morning.
We didn't use to have a car, but now we drive everywhere.
She didn't use to wear glasses, but now she needs them to read.
I didn't use to enjoy cooking, but now it's my favourite hobby.
This year I've met lots of new people that I didn't used to talk to, like Monica and Nina.
I didn't used to watch the news, but now I watch it every night.
My brother didn't used to help at home, but he does now.
We didn't used to go abroad for our holidays.
She didn't used to like her neighbours, but now they're friends.
The town didn't used to have a cinema.
There didn't use to be so many cars on this road.
There didn't use to be a supermarket in our village.
There didn't use to be any traffic lights here.
There didn't use to be so much homework at our school.
There didn't use to be a bridge across the river.
There didn't use to be any tourists in this part of town.
I didn't use to be so busy before I started this job.
The beach didn't use to be so crowded in summer.
My dad didn't use to be very patient with us.
Food didn't use to be so expensive.
He didn't use to be interested in politics.
The streets didn't use to be so dirty.
I didn't use to read much until I discovered detective stories.
We didn't use to eat fish until we moved to the coast.
She didn't use to travel alone until she went to university.
I didn't use to sleep well until I stopped drinking tea at night.
He didn't use to speak in class until he joined the debate club.
We didn't use to recycle until the town gave us special bins.
I didn't use to like dogs until my neighbour's puppy followed me home.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + didn't use to + 原形動詞, but now + 句子

items.en: My sister and I fought all the time. We didn't use to talk to each other, but now we're very close.
items.zh: 我妹妹和我以前一直吵架。我們以前不跟對方說話，可是現在我們很親近。

items.en: I didn't use to like coffee, but now I drink three cups a day.
items.zh: 我以前不喜歡咖啡，可是現在一天喝三杯。

items.en: He didn't use to exercise, but now he runs every morning.
items.zh: 他以前不運動，可是現在每天早上都跑步。

items.en: We didn't use to have a car, but now we drive everywhere.
items.zh: 我們以前沒有車，可是現在去哪裡都開車。

items.en: She didn't use to wear glasses, but now she needs them to read.
items.zh: 她以前不戴眼鏡，可是現在讀書需要戴。

items.en: I didn't use to enjoy cooking, but now it's my favourite hobby.
items.zh: 我以前不喜歡煮飯，可是現在那是我最喜歡的嗜好。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + didn't used to + 原形動詞：常見的寫法

items.en: This year I've met lots of new people that I didn't used to talk to, like Monica and Nina.
items.zh: 今年我認識了很多以前不會說話的新朋友，像莫妮卡和妮娜。

items.en: I didn't used to watch the news, but now I watch it every night.
items.zh: 我以前不看新聞，可是現在每天晚上都看。

items.en: My brother didn't used to help at home, but he does now.
items.zh: 我哥哥以前不在家幫忙，可是他現在會了。

items.en: We didn't used to go abroad for our holidays.
items.zh: 我們以前放假不出國。

items.en: She didn't used to like her neighbours, but now they're friends.
items.zh: 她以前不喜歡她的鄰居，可是現在他們是朋友了。

items.en: The town didn't used to have a cinema.
items.zh: 這個鎮以前沒有電影院。

examples.heading: ③ There didn't use to be + 名詞：以前沒有

items.en: There didn't use to be so many cars on this road.
items.zh: 這條路以前沒有這麼多車。

items.en: There didn't use to be a supermarket in our village.
items.zh: 我們村子以前沒有超市。

items.en: There didn't use to be any traffic lights here.
items.zh: 這裡以前沒有紅綠燈。

items.en: There didn't use to be so much homework at our school.
items.zh: 我們學校以前沒有這麼多功課。

items.en: There didn't use to be a bridge across the river.
items.zh: 以前沒有橋可以過河。

items.en: There didn't use to be any tourists in this part of town.
items.zh: 城裡的這一帶以前沒有觀光客。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + didn't use to + be + 形容詞：以前不是這樣

items.en: I didn't use to be so busy before I started this job.
items.zh: 我開始這份工作以前沒有這麼忙。

items.en: The beach didn't use to be so crowded in summer.
items.zh: 夏天海灘以前沒有這麼擠。

items.en: My dad didn't use to be very patient with us.
items.zh: 我爸爸以前對我們沒有很有耐心。

items.en: Food didn't use to be so expensive.
items.zh: 食物以前沒有這麼貴。

items.en: He didn't use to be interested in politics.
items.zh: 他以前對政治沒興趣。

items.en: The streets didn't use to be so dirty.
items.zh: 街道以前沒有這麼髒。

examples.heading: ⑤ I didn't use to + 原形動詞, + until / when + 子句

items.en: I didn't use to read much until I discovered detective stories.
items.zh: 我以前不太讀書，直到我發現偵探小說。

items.en: We didn't use to eat fish until we moved to the coast.
items.zh: 我們以前不吃魚，直到我們搬到海邊。

items.en: She didn't use to travel alone until she went to university.
items.zh: 她以前不會一個人旅行，直到她上大學。

items.en: I didn't use to sleep well until I stopped drinking tea at night.
items.zh: 我以前睡不好，直到我晚上不再喝茶。

items.en: He didn't use to speak in class until he joined the debate club.
items.zh: 他以前上課不發言，直到他加入辯論社。

items.en: We didn't use to recycle until the town gave us special bins.
items.zh: 我們以前不做回收，直到鎮上給了我們專用的垃圾桶。

items.en: I didn't use to like dogs until my neighbour's puppy followed me home.
items.zh: 我以前不喜歡狗，直到鄰居的小狗跟著我回家。

title: Don't worry, you won't need anything apart from some pencils and your art book.
translation: 我希望它不會很無聊！
name: will 的否定句（情態動詞）
sentences: You're coming to the art class? Don't worry, you won't need anything apart from some pencils and your art book.
Don't worry about the dog. He won't bite you.
Don't worry, the injection won't hurt very much.
Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about your new boyfriend.
Don't worry, the meeting won't last more than an hour.
Don't worry, you won't have to speak in front of the class.
It's a long film with no music. I hope it will not be boring!
I hope the train won't be too crowded on Friday evening.
I hope my parents won't be angry about my school report.
I hope the shop won't close before we get there.
I hope the noise won't wake the baby.
I hope it won't rain on our camping trip.
The bus is always late, so it won't be here before ten.
My brother won't like this film. He hates romantic stories.
The shops won't be open on Christmas Day.
This old car won't make it up the mountain.
The ice won't melt for weeks in this cold weather.
The stain on your shirt is tiny. People won't notice it at the party.
I won't be home for dinner tonight. I'm working late.
I won't forget your kindness when I was ill.
I won't eat any more biscuits today. I promise.
I won't be able to come to your party on Saturday.
I won't drive tonight. I'll take a taxi.
I won't stay long. I just want to give you this book.
Because of the repairs, the east wing of the museum will not reopen until May.
Passengers will not be allowed on the plane without a passport.
I will not accept this behaviour in my classroom.
The company will not pay for damage caused by careless drivers.
We will not give up until we find the missing dog.
The library will not lend books to people without a card.
I will not be spoken to like that!

examples.heading: ① Don't worry, + 主詞 + won't + 原形動詞：讓對方放心

items.en: You're coming to the art class? Don't worry, you won't need anything apart from some pencils and your art book.
items.zh: 你要來上美術課？別擔心，你除了幾支鉛筆和你的美術本，什麼都不需要。

items.en: Don't worry about the dog. He won't bite you.
items.zh: 別擔心那隻狗。牠不會咬你。

items.en: Don't worry, the injection won't hurt very much.
items.zh: 別擔心，打針不會很痛。

items.en: Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about your new boyfriend.
items.zh: 別擔心，我不會把你新男友的事告訴任何人。

items.en: Don't worry, the meeting won't last more than an hour.
items.zh: 別擔心，會議不會超過一個小時。

items.en: Don't worry, you won't have to speak in front of the class.
items.zh: 別擔心，你不必在全班面前說話。

examples.heading: ② I hope + 主詞 + will not / won't + 原形動詞

items.en: It's a long film with no music. I hope it will not be boring!
items.zh: 那是一部很長的電影，沒有音樂。我希望它不會很無聊！

items.en: I hope the train won't be too crowded on Friday evening.
items.zh: 我希望星期五傍晚的火車不會太擠。

items.en: I hope my parents won't be angry about my school report.
items.zh: 我希望我爸媽不會因為我的成績單生氣。

items.en: I hope the shop won't close before we get there.
items.zh: 我希望那家店在我們到之前不會關門。

items.en: I hope the noise won't wake the baby.
items.zh: 我希望那個聲音不會吵醒寶寶。

items.en: I hope it won't rain on our camping trip.
items.zh: 我希望我們露營的時候不會下雨。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + won't + 原形動詞：預測不會發生

items.en: The bus is always late, so it won't be here before ten.
items.zh: 公車總是誤點，所以十點前不會到。

items.en: My brother won't like this film. He hates romantic stories.
items.zh: 我哥哥不會喜歡這部電影。他討厭愛情故事。

items.en: The shops won't be open on Christmas Day.
items.zh: 聖誕節當天商店不會開。

items.en: This old car won't make it up the mountain.
items.zh: 這台舊車開不上那座山。

items.en: The ice won't melt for weeks in this cold weather.
items.zh: 在這麼冷的天氣，冰好幾個星期都不會融化。

items.en: The stain on your shirt is tiny. People won't notice it at the party.
items.zh: 你襯衫上的污漬很小。派對上的人不會注意到。

examples.heading: ④ I won't + 原形動詞：說自己不會做的事

items.en: I won't be home for dinner tonight. I'm working late.
items.zh: 我今天晚上不會回家吃晚餐。我要加班。

items.en: I won't forget your kindness when I was ill.
items.zh: 我不會忘記我生病時你對我的好。

items.en: I won't eat any more biscuits today. I promise.
items.zh: 我今天不會再吃餅乾了。我保證。

items.en: I won't be able to come to your party on Saturday.
items.zh: 我星期六不能去你的派對。

items.en: I won't drive tonight. I'll take a taxi.
items.zh: 我今天晚上不開車。我會搭計程車。

items.en: I won't stay long. I just want to give you this book.
items.zh: 我不會待很久。我只是想把這本書給你。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + will not + 原形動詞：正式或強調

items.en: Because of the repairs, the east wing of the museum will not reopen until May.
items.zh: 因為整修，博物館的東側展區要到五月才會重新開放。

items.en: Passengers will not be allowed on the plane without a passport.
items.zh: 沒有護照的乘客不准登機。（被動）

items.en: I will not accept this behaviour in my classroom.
items.zh: 我不會接受在我的教室裡有這種行為。

items.en: The company will not pay for damage caused by careless drivers.
items.zh: 公司不會支付粗心駕駛造成的損壞。

items.en: We will not give up until we find the missing dog.
items.zh: 在找到走失的狗之前，我們不會放棄。

items.en: The library will not lend books to people without a card.
items.zh: 圖書館不會把書借給沒有借書證的人。

items.en: I will not be spoken to like that!
items.zh: 我不能接受被人這樣說話！（被動）

title: You wouldn't believe how much they cost!
translation: 你一定不敢相信它們有多貴！
name: would 的否定句
sentences: We went into that designer shop. You wouldn't believe how much the clothes cost!
You wouldn't believe how big their new house is.
You wouldn't believe what my little brother said to the teacher.
You wouldn't believe how cold it was on the mountain.
You wouldn't believe who I met at the airport!
You wouldn't believe how long we waited for the bus.
We can stay with my aunt and cook our own meals. I think we would not need much money.
I think the children would not enjoy such a long museum visit.
I think my parents would not let me go alone.
I think a small car would not be big enough for all of us.
I think she would not like a surprise party.
I think the shop would not open on a holiday.
I wouldn't eat that fish. It smells strange.
My dog wouldn't hurt anyone. He's very gentle.
I wouldn't wear that hat. It's too big.
She wouldn't leave her children alone at home.
I wouldn't take a small boat out on a windy day like this.
He wouldn't lie to his best friend.
I wouldn't buy that car if I were you. It's too old.
I wouldn't tell her the truth yet, if I were you.
I wouldn't swim there if I were you. The water is dirty.
I wouldn't call him now if I were you. He's very angry.
I wouldn't wear white to the farm if I were you.
I wouldn't spend all your money on the first day if I were you.
The baby wouldn't stop crying all night.
It was so cold that the old van wouldn't start until Dad pushed it.
My brother wouldn't share his sweets with me.
The door wouldn't open because of the snow.
She wouldn't tell me where she had been.
We called and called, but the kitten wouldn't come out from under the shed.
My grandfather wouldn't take any money for the work.

examples.heading: ① You wouldn't believe + 疑問詞 + 子句：強調讓人驚訝的事

items.en: We went into that designer shop. You wouldn't believe how much the clothes cost!
items.zh: 我們走進那家名牌店。你一定不敢相信那些衣服有多貴！

items.en: You wouldn't believe how big their new house is.
items.zh: 你一定不敢相信他們的新房子有多大。

items.en: You wouldn't believe what my little brother said to the teacher.
items.zh: 你一定不敢相信我弟弟跟老師說了什麼。

items.en: You wouldn't believe how cold it was on the mountain.
items.zh: 你一定不敢相信山上有多冷。

items.en: You wouldn't believe who I met at the airport!
items.zh: 你一定不敢相信我在機場遇到誰！

items.en: You wouldn't believe how long we waited for the bus.
items.zh: 你一定不敢相信我們等公車等了多久。

examples.heading: ② I think + 主詞 + would not + 原形動詞：想像的情況

items.en: We can stay with my aunt and cook our own meals. I think we would not need much money.
items.zh: 我們可以住我阿姨家，自己煮飯。我想我們不會需要很多錢。

items.en: I think the children would not enjoy such a long museum visit.
items.zh: 我想孩子們不會喜歡那麼長的博物館參觀。

items.en: I think my parents would not let me go alone.
items.zh: 我想我爸媽不會讓我一個人去。

items.en: I think a small car would not be big enough for all of us.
items.zh: 我想一台小車不夠大，坐不下我們所有人。

items.en: I think she would not like a surprise party.
items.zh: 我想她不會喜歡驚喜派對。

items.en: I think the shop would not open on a holiday.
items.zh: 我想那家店放假不會開。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + wouldn't + 原形動詞：想像中不會做的事

items.en: I wouldn't eat that fish. It smells strange.
items.zh: 我不會吃那條魚。它聞起來很怪。

items.en: My dog wouldn't hurt anyone. He's very gentle.
items.zh: 我的狗不會傷害任何人。牠很溫和。

items.en: I wouldn't wear that hat. It's too big.
items.zh: 我不會戴那頂帽子。它太大了。

items.en: She wouldn't leave her children alone at home.
items.zh: 她不會讓她的孩子單獨在家。

items.en: I wouldn't take a small boat out on a windy day like this.
items.zh: 在今天這種大風天，我不會開小船出海。

items.en: He wouldn't lie to his best friend.
items.zh: 他不會對他最好的朋友說謊。

examples.heading: ④ I wouldn't + 原形動詞, if I were you：給建議

items.en: I wouldn't buy that car if I were you. It's too old.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我不會買那台車。它太舊了。

items.en: I wouldn't tell her the truth yet, if I were you.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我還不會告訴她真相。

items.en: I wouldn't swim there if I were you. The water is dirty.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我不會在那裡游泳。水很髒。

items.en: I wouldn't call him now if I were you. He's very angry.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我現在不會打給他。他很生氣。

items.en: I wouldn't wear white to the farm if I were you.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我不會穿白色的衣服去農場。

items.en: I wouldn't spend all your money on the first day if I were you.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我不會第一天就把錢花光。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + wouldn't + 原形動詞：過去不肯做
