items.en: The baby wouldn't stop crying all night.
items.zh: 寶寶整晚哭個不停。

items.en: It was so cold that the old van wouldn't start until Dad pushed it.
items.zh: 天氣太冷了，那台舊貨車發不動，直到爸爸推了它。

items.en: My brother wouldn't share his sweets with me.
items.zh: 我哥哥不肯跟我分他的糖果。

items.en: The door wouldn't open because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，門打不開。

items.en: She wouldn't tell me where she had been.
items.zh: 她不肯告訴我她去了哪裡。

items.en: We called and called, but the kitten wouldn't come out from under the shed.
items.zh: 我們叫了又叫，可是小貓就是不肯從棚子底下出來。

items.en: My grandfather wouldn't take any money for the work.
items.zh: 我爺爺做了那些工作卻不肯收錢。

title: You can ask your parents what they think you should do, can't you?
translation: 你可以問問你爸媽，他們覺得你該怎麼做，不是嗎？
name: can 的否定疑問句和附加問句
sentences: Can't we leave a bit earlier?
It's late. Can't we finish this tomorrow?
Can't you turn the music down? I'm trying to study.
Can't your brother drive you to the station?
The shop is closed. Can't we buy some bread at the petrol station?
Can't you see I'm busy right now?
Can't they stay at a hotel for one night?
Can't you just say sorry and forget about it?
Can't she ask her teacher for more time?
Why can't she visit them alone so I can relax at the beach?
Why can't you stay for one more day?
Why can't we take the bus instead of a taxi?
Why can't I find my glasses when I need them?
Why can't the children play in the park after school?
What can't you eat? I'll cook something else.
Why can't he tell us the truth?
Why can't we have a dog like everyone else?
You can stay with us next week, can't you?
She can speak three languages, can't she?
We can walk to the beach from the hotel, can't we?
You can come to my house after school, can't you?
Your dad can fix the roof, can't he?
They can bring the drinks, can't they?
I can pay by card here, can't I?
You can't swim, can you?
She can't come tonight, can she?
We can't park here, can we?
Your grandma can't hear very well, can she?
They can't afford a new car, can they?
You can't remember his name, can you?
The baby can't walk yet, can she?

examples.heading: ① Can't + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Can't we leave a bit earlier?
items.zh: 我們不能早一點出發嗎？

items.en: It's late. Can't we finish this tomorrow?
items.zh: 很晚了，我們不能明天再做完嗎？

items.en: Can't you turn the music down? I'm trying to study.
items.zh: 你不能把音樂關小聲一點嗎？我在讀書。

items.en: Can't your brother drive you to the station?
items.zh: 你哥不能開車載你去車站嗎？

items.en: The shop is closed. Can't we buy some bread at the petrol station?
items.zh: 那家店關了，我們不能去加油站買點麵包嗎？

items.en: Can't you see I'm busy right now?
items.zh: 你沒看到我現在很忙嗎？

items.en: Can't they stay at a hotel for one night?
items.zh: 他們不能在飯店住一晚嗎？

items.en: Can't you just say sorry and forget about it?
items.zh: 你不能就道個歉，然後把這件事忘了嗎？

items.en: Can't she ask her teacher for more time?
items.zh: 她不能跟老師要求多一點時間嗎？

examples.heading: ② Why / What + can't + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Why can't she visit them alone so I can relax at the beach?
items.zh: 她為什麼不能自己去看他們，讓我在海邊放鬆一下？

items.en: Why can't you stay for one more day?
items.zh: 你為什麼不能多待一天？

items.en: Why can't we take the bus instead of a taxi?
items.zh: 我們為什麼不能搭公車，不搭計程車？

items.en: Why can't I find my glasses when I need them?
items.zh: 為什麼我要用眼鏡的時候都找不到？

items.en: Why can't the children play in the park after school?
items.zh: 孩子們放學後為什麼不能去公園玩？

items.en: What can't you eat? I'll cook something else.
items.zh: 你有什麼不能吃的？我煮別的。

items.en: Why can't he tell us the truth?
items.zh: 他為什麼不能跟我們說實話？

items.en: Why can't we have a dog like everyone else?
items.zh: 我們為什麼不能像大家一樣養狗？

examples.heading: ③ 肯定句 + can't + 主詞?

items.en: You can stay with us next week, can't you?
items.zh: 你下星期可以來我們家住，對吧？

items.en: She can speak three languages, can't she?
items.zh: 她會說三種語言，不是嗎？

items.en: We can walk to the beach from the hotel, can't we?
items.zh: 我們從飯店可以走路到海邊，對吧？

items.en: You can come to my house after school, can't you?
items.zh: 你放學後可以來我家，對吧？

items.en: Your dad can fix the roof, can't he?
items.zh: 你爸會修屋頂，不是嗎？

items.en: They can bring the drinks, can't they?
items.zh: 他們可以帶飲料來，對吧？

items.en: I can pay by card here, can't I?
items.zh: 我在這裡可以刷卡，對吧？

examples.heading: ④ 否定句 + can + 主詞?

items.en: You can't swim, can you?
items.zh: 你不會游泳，對吧？

items.en: She can't come tonight, can she?
items.zh: 她今晚不能來，對吧？

items.en: We can't park here, can we?
items.zh: 我們不能停在這裡，對吧？

items.en: Your grandma can't hear very well, can she?
items.zh: 你奶奶聽力不太好，對吧？

items.en: They can't afford a new car, can they?
items.zh: 他們買不起新車，對吧？

items.en: You can't remember his name, can you?
items.zh: 你想不起來他的名字，對吧？

items.en: The baby can't walk yet, can she?
items.zh: 寶寶還不會走路，對吧？

title: Taking everything into account, it can be concluded that the current training course is very useful for our company.
translation: 綜合考量各方面，可以得出結論：目前的訓練課程對我們公司非常有用。
name: It can be said that 等 can 的被動語態
sentences: As for marriage, it can be said that women with a job no longer quit after they get married.
It can be said that the internet has changed the way we shop.
It can be said that the town has become much safer in recent years.
In general, it can be said that the students enjoyed the course.
It can be said that the festival was a great success.
It can be said that young people read less than before.
Looking at the figures, it can be argued that the company should leave the heater market.
It can be argued that schools should start later in the morning.
It can be argued that tourism does more harm than good to the island.
It can be argued that the new law is unfair to small shops.
It can be argued that television is a useful tool for learning.
On the other hand, it can be argued that the price is too high.
Taking everything into account, it can be concluded that the move to the new office was the right decision.
From the survey, it can be concluded that most customers are happy with the service.
It can be concluded that the project needs more money.
From these results, it can be concluded that the medicine works.
It can be concluded that the old system should be replaced.
It can be concluded that the new timetable has reduced delays.
From the chart, it can be seen that sales rose sharply in March.
It can be seen that more people now work from home.
It can be seen from the table that prices fell in the summer.
It can be seen that the number of visitors doubled.
It can clearly be seen that the plan has failed.
From the photos, it can be seen that the building is in poor condition.
It can be noted that most complaints came from new customers.
It can be assumed that most readers know the story.
It can be expected that prices will rise next year.
It can be assumed that the weather will be warm in July.
It can be expected that more students will apply this year.
It can be expected that the roads will be busy over the holiday.
It can be noted that the staff worked very hard this year.

examples.heading: ① It can be said that + 子句

items.en: As for marriage, it can be said that women with a job no longer quit after they get married.
items.zh: 說到婚姻，可以說有工作的女性結婚後不再辭職了。

items.en: It can be said that the internet has changed the way we shop.
items.zh: 可以說網路改變了我們買東西的方式。

items.en: It can be said that the town has become much safer in recent years.
items.zh: 可以說這幾年這個鎮變得安全多了。

items.en: In general, it can be said that the students enjoyed the course.
items.zh: 整體來說，可以說學生們喜歡這門課。

items.en: It can be said that the festival was a great success.
items.zh: 可以說這次節慶活動非常成功。

items.en: It can be said that young people read less than before.
items.zh: 可以說年輕人讀的書比以前少。

examples.heading: ② It can be argued that + 子句

items.en: Looking at the figures, it can be argued that the company should leave the heater market.
items.zh: 從數字來看，可以主張公司應該退出暖氣機市場。

items.en: It can be argued that schools should start later in the morning.
items.zh: 可以主張學校早上應該晚一點上課。

items.en: It can be argued that tourism does more harm than good to the island.
items.zh: 可以主張觀光對這座島的害處大於好處。

items.en: It can be argued that the new law is unfair to small shops.
items.zh: 可以主張新法律對小商店不公平。

items.en: It can be argued that television is a useful tool for learning.
items.zh: 可以主張電視是很有用的學習工具。

items.en: On the other hand, it can be argued that the price is too high.
items.zh: 另一方面，可以主張價格太高了。

examples.heading: ③ It can be concluded that + 子句

items.en: Taking everything into account, it can be concluded that the move to the new office was the right decision.
items.zh: 綜合考量各方面，可以得出結論：搬到新辦公室是正確的決定。

items.en: From the survey, it can be concluded that most customers are happy with the service.
items.zh: 從調查可以得出結論：大部分的顧客對服務很滿意。

items.en: It can be concluded that the project needs more money.
items.zh: 可以得出結論：這個專案需要更多經費。

items.en: From these results, it can be concluded that the medicine works.
items.zh: 從這些結果可以得出結論：這種藥有效。

items.en: It can be concluded that the old system should be replaced.
items.zh: 可以得出結論：舊系統應該被取代。

items.en: It can be concluded that the new timetable has reduced delays.
items.zh: 可以得出結論：新的時刻表減少了誤點。

examples.heading: ④ It can be seen that + 子句

items.en: From the chart, it can be seen that sales rose sharply in March.
items.zh: 從圖表可以看出，三月的銷售量大幅上升。

items.en: It can be seen that more people now work from home.
items.zh: 可以看出現在有更多人在家工作。

items.en: It can be seen from the table that prices fell in the summer.
items.zh: 從表格可以看出，夏天的價格下降了。

items.en: It can be seen that the number of visitors doubled.
items.zh: 可以看出訪客人數增加了一倍。

items.en: It can clearly be seen that the plan has failed.
items.zh: 可以清楚看出這個計畫失敗了。

items.en: From the photos, it can be seen that the building is in poor condition.
items.zh: 從照片可以看出這棟建築的狀況很差。

examples.heading: ⑤ It can be assumed / expected / noted that + 子句

items.en: It can be noted that most complaints came from new customers.
items.zh: 值得一提的是，大部分的投訴來自新顧客。

items.en: It can be assumed that most readers know the story.
items.zh: 可以假定大部分的讀者都知道這個故事。

items.en: It can be expected that prices will rise next year.
items.zh: 可以預期明年價格會上漲。

items.en: It can be assumed that the weather will be warm in July.
items.zh: 可以假定七月的天氣會很溫暖。

items.en: It can be expected that more students will apply this year.
items.zh: 可以預期今年會有更多學生申請。

items.en: It can be expected that the roads will be busy over the holiday.
items.zh: 可以預期假期期間路上會很塞。

items.en: It can be noted that the staff worked very hard this year.
items.zh: 值得一提的是，員工今年非常努力。

title: You certainly have to have lived in each place for a long time.
translation: 要看得客觀，你得在每個地方都住過很長一段時間才行。
name: have to have 加過去分詞的形式
sentences: To judge a football match fairly, you have to have played the game yourself.
To give advice about raising children, you have to have brought up children yourself.
To write about the war, you have to have spoken to the people who fought in it.
To understand the problem, you have to have worked in a hospital.
To review a restaurant fairly, you have to have eaten there more than once.
To talk about poverty, you have to have seen it with your own eyes.
To join the advanced class, you have to have passed the first exam.
Applicants have to have worked in sales for at least two years.
To get a driving licence, you have to have taken twenty lessons.
Players have to have played for the club for a full season.
To enter the race, runners have to have finished a marathon before.
Students have to have read the first three chapters before the seminar.
To rent a car, you have to have held a licence for a year.
The tour buses stop at the famous places that you "have to have seen", and everyone jumps out to take photos.
The Eiffel Tower is one of those places that every visitor has to have seen.
My guidebook lists twenty sights that you have to have visited.
There's a list of films that every student has to have watched.
These are the books that every child has to have read.
It's one of those albums that every music fan has to have heard.
By next June, you will have to have finished your thesis.
By the time the guests arrive, we'll have to have cleaned the whole house.
Before you leave, you will have to have returned all the library books.
By Friday, the builders will have to have fixed the roof.
By the end of the year, the company will have to have paid back the loan.
Before the trip, you'll have to have had all your injections.
You don't have to have studied art to enjoy this exhibition.
You don't have to have seen the first film to understand the second one.
Applicants don't have to have worked abroad.
You don't have to have cooked before to join this class.
Members don't have to have played tennis before.
You don't have to have finished school to apply for the job.

examples.heading: ① have to have + 過去分詞：比較或判斷之前的條件

items.en: To judge a football match fairly, you have to have played the game yourself.
items.zh: 要公平地評判一場足球賽，你自己一定要踢過球。

items.en: To give advice about raising children, you have to have brought up children yourself.
items.zh: 要給教養孩子的建議，你自己一定要養過孩子。

items.en: To write about the war, you have to have spoken to the people who fought in it.
items.zh: 要寫那場戰爭，你一定要跟打過仗的人談過。

items.en: To understand the problem, you have to have worked in a hospital.
items.zh: 要了解這個問題，你一定要在醫院工作過。

items.en: To review a restaurant fairly, you have to have eaten there more than once.
items.zh: 要公平地評論一家餐廳，你一定要在那裡吃過不只一次。

items.en: To talk about poverty, you have to have seen it with your own eyes.
items.zh: 要談貧窮，你一定要親眼見過。

examples.heading: ② have to have + 過去分詞：課程和工作的條件

items.en: To join the advanced class, you have to have passed the first exam.
items.zh: 要參加進階班，你必須已經通過第一次考試。

items.en: Applicants have to have worked in sales for at least two years.
items.zh: 申請人必須有至少兩年的銷售經驗。

items.en: To get a driving licence, you have to have taken twenty lessons.
items.zh: 要拿到駕照，你必須已經上過二十堂課。

items.en: Players have to have played for the club for a full season.
items.zh: 球員必須已經為球隊踢滿一整個球季。

items.en: To enter the race, runners have to have finished a marathon before.
items.zh: 要參加這場比賽，跑者必須以前跑完過一場馬拉松。

items.en: Students have to have read the first three chapters before the seminar.
items.zh: 學生必須在研討課之前讀完前三章。

items.en: To rent a car, you have to have held a licence for a year.
items.zh: 要租車，你必須已經持有駕照一年。

examples.heading: ③ the places you have to have seen：必看的景點

items.en: The tour buses stop at the famous places that you "have to have seen", and everyone jumps out to take photos.
items.zh: 遊覽車停在那些必看的有名景點，大家都跳下車拍照。

items.en: The Eiffel Tower is one of those places that every visitor has to have seen.
items.zh: 艾菲爾鐵塔是每個遊客一定要去過的地方之一。

items.en: My guidebook lists twenty sights that you have to have visited.
items.zh: 我的旅遊書列出二十個一定要去過的景點。

items.en: There's a list of films that every student has to have watched.
items.zh: 有一份每個學生一定要看過的電影清單。

items.en: These are the books that every child has to have read.
items.zh: 這些是每個孩子一定要讀過的書。

items.en: It's one of those albums that every music fan has to have heard.
items.zh: 這是每個音樂迷一定要聽過的專輯之一。

examples.heading: ④ will have to have + 過去分詞：未來的時間點之前必須完成

items.en: By next June, you will have to have finished your thesis.
items.zh: 到明年六月，你必須已經寫完論文。

items.en: By the time the guests arrive, we'll have to have cleaned the whole house.
items.zh: 在客人到之前，我們必須已經打掃完整間房子。

items.en: Before you leave, you will have to have returned all the library books.
items.zh: 你離開之前，必須已經把圖書館的書都還了。

items.en: By Friday, the builders will have to have fixed the roof.
items.zh: 到星期五，工人必須已經修好屋頂。

items.en: By the end of the year, the company will have to have paid back the loan.
items.zh: 到年底，公司必須已經還清貸款。

items.en: Before the trip, you'll have to have had all your injections.
items.zh: 出發之前，你必須已經打完所有的預防針。

examples.heading: ⑤ don't have to have + 過去分詞：不必已經

items.en: You don't have to have studied art to enjoy this exhibition.
items.zh: 你不必學過藝術也能欣賞這個展覽。

items.en: You don't have to have seen the first film to understand the second one.
items.zh: 你不必看過第一集也看得懂第二集。

items.en: Applicants don't have to have worked abroad.
items.zh: 申請人不必有國外工作經驗。

items.en: You don't have to have cooked before to join this class.
items.zh: 你不必以前做過菜也能參加這堂課。

items.en: Members don't have to have played tennis before.
items.zh: 會員不必以前打過網球。

items.en: You don't have to have finished school to apply for the job.
items.zh: 你不必念完中學也能應徵這份工作。

title: What could have happened?
translation: 會是出了什麼事呢？
name: could have 加過去分詞
sentences: In fact, it could have been dangerous.
The thief could have climbed in through the kitchen window.
We could have stayed at a cheaper hotel.
She could've called a taxi from the station.
Your umbrella could have fallen behind the sofa.
The game could have ended in a draw.
They could have sold the car for more money.
Our teacher couldn't have picked anyone better to do it.
He couldn't have driven home. His car was at the garage.
I couldn't have asked for a better birthday.
You couldn't have chosen a worse day for a picnic.
The dog couldn't have opened the fridge by itself.
They couldn't have finished the job without a ladder.
What could have woken the baby up?
Who could have left the gate open?
What could have made her so angry?
Who could have written this note?
What could have gone wrong with the plan?
Where could the children have hidden?
What could he have meant by that?
How could she have known my name?
Which train could she have caught?
Where could I have left my glasses?
How could they have missed such a big sign?
Could the battery have died?
Could the shop have closed early?
Could you have done anything differently?
Could she have taken the wrong bus?
Could the parcel have been delivered to our neighbour?
Could anyone have seen the accident?

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + could have + 過去分詞

items.en: In fact, it could have been dangerous.
items.zh: 其實那本來可能很危險。

items.en: The thief could have climbed in through the kitchen window.
items.zh: 小偷可能是從廚房窗戶爬進來的。

items.en: We could have stayed at a cheaper hotel.
items.zh: 我們本來可以住便宜一點的旅館。

items.en: She could've called a taxi from the station.
items.zh: 她本來可以在車站叫計程車的。

items.en: Your umbrella could have fallen behind the sofa.
items.zh: 你的傘可能掉到沙發後面了。

items.en: The game could have ended in a draw.
items.zh: 那場比賽本來可能踢成平手。

items.en: They could have sold the car for more money.
items.zh: 他們本來可以把車賣得貴一點。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + couldn't have + 過去分詞

items.en: Our teacher couldn't have picked anyone better to do it.
items.zh: 我們老師不可能挑到更適合做這件事的人了。

items.en: He couldn't have driven home. His car was at the garage.
items.zh: 他不可能開車回家。他的車在修車廠。

items.en: I couldn't have asked for a better birthday.
items.zh: 這是我過得最好的一次生日。

items.en: You couldn't have chosen a worse day for a picnic.
items.zh: 你挑了一個最不適合野餐的日子。

items.en: The dog couldn't have opened the fridge by itself.
items.zh: 狗不可能自己打開冰箱。

items.en: They couldn't have finished the job without a ladder.
items.zh: 沒有梯子，他們不可能完成那份工作。

examples.heading: ③ 疑問詞當主詞 + could have + 過去分詞？

items.en: What could have woken the baby up?
items.zh: 會是什麼把寶寶吵醒了？

items.en: Who could have left the gate open?
items.zh: 大門會是誰沒關的？

items.en: What could have made her so angry?
items.zh: 是什麼事讓她那麼生氣呢？

items.en: Who could have written this note?
items.zh: 這張紙條會是誰寫的？

items.en: What could have gone wrong with the plan?
items.zh: 那個計畫會是哪裡出了錯呢？

examples.heading: ④ 疑問詞 + could + 主詞 + have + 過去分詞？

items.en: Where could the children have hidden?
items.zh: 孩子們會躲到哪裡去了？

items.en: What could he have meant by that?
items.zh: 他那句話會是什麼意思呢？

items.en: How could she have known my name?
items.zh: 她怎麼會知道我的名字？

items.en: Which train could she have caught?
items.zh: 她會是搭了哪一班火車？

items.en: Where could I have left my glasses?
items.zh: 我會把眼鏡放到哪裡去了？

items.en: How could they have missed such a big sign?
items.zh: 那麼大的牌子，他們怎麼會沒看到？

examples.heading: ⑤ Could + 主詞 + have + 過去分詞？

items.en: Could the battery have died?
items.zh: 會不會是電池沒電了？

items.en: Could the shop have closed early?
items.zh: 那家店會不會提早關門了？

items.en: Could you have done anything differently?
items.zh: 你那時有沒有可能換個做法？

items.en: Could she have taken the wrong bus?
items.zh: 她會不會是搭錯公車了？

items.en: Could the parcel have been delivered to our neighbour?
items.zh: 包裹會不會送到我們鄰居家了？

items.en: Could anyone have seen the accident?
items.zh: 會不會有人看到了那場車禍？

title: It might have been our neighbours' cat.
translation: 他可能看到我們了。
name: might have 加過去分詞
sentences: Something knocked over the bin. It might have been a fox.
Someone left flowers at the door. It might have been your aunt.
I heard a loud bang. It might have been a car tyre.
A man called while you were out. It might have been the plumber.
The light in the sky might have been a plane.
The smell might have been from the bakery next door.
Let's hide behind the tree. He might have seen us.
She's not answering. She might have gone to bed early.
Tom is late. He might have missed the bus.
The kids are very quiet. They might have fallen asleep.
I can't find my wallet. I might have dropped it on the train.
The grass is wet. It might have rained in the morning.
They might have been right, but I don't agree with them.
The test might have been easy for you, but it was hard for me.
The hotel might have been cheap, but it was very dirty.
The trip might have been long, but it was worth it.
The film might have been popular, but I found it boring.
His idea might have been strange, but it worked.
In years past, you might have gone straight from school to your family's farm.
Fifty years ago, you might have walked five miles to school.
In those days, you might have married at eighteen.
Before phones, you might have written letters every week.
In my grandfather's time, you might have worked in the same factory all your life.
A hundred years ago, you might have lived without electricity.
The plant died. I might have given it too much water.
The cake is flat. You might have opened the oven too early.
He looks upset. Someone might have said something unkind.
My phone stopped working. I might have dropped it in the sink.
The milk is sour. It might have been out of the fridge all night.
She failed the exam. She might have studied the wrong chapters.
The car won't start. We might have left the lights on.

examples.heading: ① It might have been + 名詞：猜是誰或是什麼

items.en: Something knocked over the bin. It might have been a fox.
items.zh: 有東西把垃圾桶撞倒了。那可能是一隻狐狸。

items.en: Someone left flowers at the door. It might have been your aunt.
items.zh: 有人在門口留了花。那可能是你阿姨。

items.en: I heard a loud bang. It might have been a car tyre.
items.zh: 我聽到一聲巨響。那可能是汽車輪胎。

items.en: A man called while you were out. It might have been the plumber.
items.zh: 你出去的時候有個男的打電話來。那可能是水電工。

items.en: The light in the sky might have been a plane.
items.zh: 天空中的光可能是一架飛機。

items.en: The smell might have been from the bakery next door.
items.zh: 那個味道可能是從隔壁麵包店來的。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + might have + 過去分詞：猜別人做了什麼

items.en: Let's hide behind the tree. He might have seen us.
items.zh: 我們躲到樹後面。他可能看到我們了。

items.en: She's not answering. She might have gone to bed early.
items.zh: 她沒接電話。她可能早早睡了。

items.en: Tom is late. He might have missed the bus.
items.zh: 湯姆遲到了。他可能錯過了公車。

items.en: The kids are very quiet. They might have fallen asleep.
items.zh: 孩子們很安靜。他們可能睡著了。

items.en: I can't find my wallet. I might have dropped it on the train.
items.zh: 我找不到錢包。我可能掉在火車上了。

items.en: The grass is wet. It might have rained in the morning.
items.zh: 草是濕的。早上可能下過雨。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + might have been + 形容詞, but + 句子

items.en: They might have been right, but I don't agree with them.
items.zh: 他們可能是對的，可是我不同意他們。

items.en: The test might have been easy for you, but it was hard for me.
items.zh: 那次考試對你來說可能很簡單，可是對我來說很難。

items.en: The hotel might have been cheap, but it was very dirty.
items.zh: 那家飯店可能很便宜，可是非常髒。

items.en: The trip might have been long, but it was worth it.
items.zh: 那趟旅程可能很長，可是很值得。

items.en: The film might have been popular, but I found it boring.
items.zh: 那部電影可能很受歡迎，可是我覺得很無聊。

items.en: His idea might have been strange, but it worked.
items.zh: 他的想法可能很奇怪，可是成功了。

examples.heading: ④ In the past, you might have + 過去分詞：以前一般的情況

items.en: In years past, you might have gone straight from school to your family's farm.
items.zh: 在過去，你可能一畢業就直接去家裡的農場工作。

items.en: Fifty years ago, you might have walked five miles to school.
items.zh: 五十年前，你可能要走五英里去上學。

items.en: In those days, you might have married at eighteen.
items.zh: 那個年代，你可能十八歲就結婚了。

items.en: Before phones, you might have written letters every week.
items.zh: 有手機以前，你可能每個星期都寫信。

items.en: In my grandfather's time, you might have worked in the same factory all your life.
items.zh: 在我爺爺那個年代，你可能一輩子都在同一間工廠工作。

items.en: A hundred years ago, you might have lived without electricity.
items.zh: 一百年前，你可能過著沒有電的生活。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + might have + 過去分詞：猜事情的原因

items.en: The plant died. I might have given it too much water.
items.zh: 那盆植物死了。我可能澆太多水了。

items.en: The cake is flat. You might have opened the oven too early.
items.zh: 蛋糕扁了。你可能太早打開烤箱了。

items.en: He looks upset. Someone might have said something unkind.
items.zh: 他看起來很難過。可能有人說了不好聽的話。

items.en: My phone stopped working. I might have dropped it in the sink.
items.zh: 我的手機壞了。我可能把它掉進水槽了。

items.en: The milk is sour. It might have been out of the fridge all night.
items.zh: 牛奶酸了。它可能整晚都放在冰箱外面。

items.en: She failed the exam. She might have studied the wrong chapters.
items.zh: 她考試沒過。她可能讀錯章節了。

items.en: The car won't start. We might have left the lights on.
items.zh: 車子發不動。我們可能沒關車燈。

title: I must have fallen about fifty times.
translation: 我一定摔了五十次左右。
name: must have 加過去分詞
sentences: Skiing was hard at the beginning. I must have fallen about fifty times.
The grass is wet this morning. It must have rained last night.
Anna's coat isn't on the hook. She must have left early.
You look really tired. You must have worked very hard this week.
The back door is open and the cat is outside. Someone must have forgotten to close it.
Tom answered every question about the story. He must have read the book.
He didn't come to the café. When I realised he must have forgotten, I called him up.
My keys weren't in my bag when I got home. I thought I must have left them at work.
When the lights went out, we realised the storm must have damaged the power line.
The bus went past the airport. I realised I must have taken the wrong one.
Her grandson never got her birthday card. She thought it must have got lost in the post.
After twenty minutes we were still on the motorway. We realised we must have missed the turning.
I heard you won the singing competition. You must have been so happy!
A big dog jumped at my little sister in the park. She must have been scared.
You camped at the top of Ben Nevis in March? It must have been cold on the mountain.
My grandparents drove from London to Edinburgh in one day. They must have been tired.
The test must have been difficult. Nobody in the class passed.
You saw the Northern Lights in Norway? It must have been wonderful.
My feet really hurt after the city tour. I must have walked twenty kilometres today.
Look at all those plates in front of Jack. He must have eaten six pieces of cake.
The buses were on strike, and we didn't know. We must have waited two hours at the bus stop.
My daughter knows every line of Harry Potter. She must have read it ten times.
Where were you? I must have called you a hundred times!
The wedding was in a castle, with three hundred guests. They must have spent a lot of money.
I was away for two weeks, and now the plants are dead. You must have forgotten to water them.
My stomach hurts after lunch. I must have eaten something bad.
The car won't start this morning. The battery must have died in the cold.
Mia didn't say a word at dinner. Something must have happened at school.
The town centre is empty this morning. Everyone must have gone to the sale at the new mall.
There's sand all over the back seat. The kids must have been to the beach.
The kitchen floor is wet near the dog's bowl. The dog must have knocked over its water.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + must have + 過去分詞：推論過去一定發生了

items.en: Skiing was hard at the beginning. I must have fallen about fifty times.
items.zh: 一開始滑雪很難。我一定跌了大概五十次。

items.en: The grass is wet this morning. It must have rained last night.
items.zh: 今天早上草是濕的。昨晚一定下過雨。

items.en: Anna's coat isn't on the hook. She must have left early.
items.zh: Anna 的外套不在掛鉤上。她一定提早走了。

items.en: You look really tired. You must have worked very hard this week.
items.zh: 你看起來好累。你這個星期一定工作得很辛苦。

items.en: The back door is open and the cat is outside. Someone must have forgotten to close it.
items.zh: 後門開著，貓跑到外面了。一定有人忘了關門。

items.en: Tom answered every question about the story. He must have read the book.
items.zh: Tom 答出了故事的每一個問題。他一定讀過那本書。

examples.heading: ② I realised / thought + 主詞 + must have + 過去分詞

items.en: He didn't come to the café. When I realised he must have forgotten, I called him up.
items.zh: 他沒來咖啡館。我發現他一定是忘了，就打電話給他。

items.en: My keys weren't in my bag when I got home. I thought I must have left them at work.
items.zh: 我回家時鑰匙不在包包裡。我以為我一定把鑰匙留在公司了。

items.en: When the lights went out, we realised the storm must have damaged the power line.
items.zh: 燈熄的時候，我們發現暴風雨一定弄壞了電線。

items.en: The bus went past the airport. I realised I must have taken the wrong one.
items.zh: 公車開過了機場。我發現我一定搭錯車了。

items.en: Her grandson never got her birthday card. She thought it must have got lost in the post.
items.zh: 她孫子一直沒收到她寄的生日卡。她以為卡片一定是寄丟了。

items.en: After twenty minutes we were still on the motorway. We realised we must have missed the turning.
items.zh: 二十分鐘後我們還在高速公路上。我們發現一定是錯過了那個轉彎。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + must have been + 形容詞：推論過去的感覺

items.en: I heard you won the singing competition. You must have been so happy!
items.zh: 聽說你贏了歌唱比賽。你一定很高興！

items.en: A big dog jumped at my little sister in the park. She must have been scared.
items.zh: 公園裡有一隻大狗撲向我妹妹。她一定很害怕。

items.en: You camped at the top of Ben Nevis in March? It must have been cold on the mountain.
items.zh: 你三月在 Ben Nevis 山頂露營？山上一定很冷。

items.en: My grandparents drove from London to Edinburgh in one day. They must have been tired.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶一天之內從倫敦開車到愛丁堡。他們一定很累。

items.en: The test must have been difficult. Nobody in the class passed.
items.zh: 那次考試一定很難。班上沒有人及格。

items.en: You saw the Northern Lights in Norway? It must have been wonderful.
items.zh: 你在挪威看到了北極光？那一定很美好。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + must have + 過去分詞：推論數量

items.en: My feet really hurt after the city tour. I must have walked twenty kilometres today.
items.zh: 城市導覽之後，我的腳好痛。我今天一定走了二十公里。

items.en: Look at all those plates in front of Jack. He must have eaten six pieces of cake.
items.zh: 你看 Jack 面前那些盤子。他一定吃了六塊蛋糕。

items.en: The buses were on strike, and we didn't know. We must have waited two hours at the bus stop.
items.zh: 公車在罷工，我們卻不知道。我們一定在公車站等了兩個小時。

items.en: My daughter knows every line of Harry Potter. She must have read it ten times.
items.zh: 我女兒會背《哈利波特》的每一句話。她一定讀了十遍。

items.en: Where were you? I must have called you a hundred times!
items.zh: 你去哪裡了？我一定打給你一百次了！

items.en: The wedding was in a castle, with three hundred guests. They must have spent a lot of money.
items.zh: 婚禮在一座城堡裡辦，有三百位客人。他們一定花了很多錢。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + must have + 過去分詞：推論原因

items.en: I was away for two weeks, and now the plants are dead. You must have forgotten to water them.
items.zh: 我出門兩個星期，現在植物都死了。你一定忘了澆水。

items.en: My stomach hurts after lunch. I must have eaten something bad.
items.zh: 午餐後我肚子痛。我一定吃了不乾淨的東西。

items.en: The car won't start this morning. The battery must have died in the cold.
items.zh: 車子今天早上發不動。電瓶一定是在冷天裡沒電了。

items.en: Mia didn't say a word at dinner. Something must have happened at school.
items.zh: Mia 晚餐時一句話都沒說。學校裡一定發生了什麼事。

items.en: The town centre is empty this morning. Everyone must have gone to the sale at the new mall.
items.zh: 今天早上市中心沒有人。大家一定都去新購物中心搶特價了。

items.en: There's sand all over the back seat. The kids must have been to the beach.
items.zh: 後座到處都是沙子。孩子們一定去過海灘。

items.en: The kitchen floor is wet near the dog's bowl. The dog must have knocked over its water.
items.zh: 廚房地板在狗碗旁邊濕了。狗一定打翻了牠的水。

title: I knew I should have written before.
translation: 你當時真該跟我們在一起。
name: should have 加過去分詞
sentences: Sorry I haven't written for three months. I knew I should have written before.
I failed the test. I should have studied harder.
I'm so cold. I should have brought a warmer coat.
I should have listened to my dad. He was right about the car.
The shop is closed now. I should have gone this morning.
I should have checked the time of the last bus.
The concert was amazing. You should have been with us!
You should have been at the beach yesterday. The sea was so warm.
You should have been there when Tom fell in the pool!
The food at the wedding was wonderful. You should have been there.
You should have been at the match. It was the best game of the season.
We had such a laugh last night. You should have been with us.
Why didn't you ask me? You should have told me you needed money.
You should have taken the train. The roads were terrible.
You should have called before you came. I was out.
You should have worn a hat. Your face is all red.
You should have asked for a receipt.
You should have seen a doctor sooner.
We missed the plane. We should have left home earlier.
They should have booked a hotel. Everything was full.
We should have bought more bread. There's none left.
They should have read the instructions before they started.
We should have taken a photo of the sunset.
They should have asked for directions at the station.
The parcel should have arrived by now. Let's call the shop.
It's after seven. Dad should have got home by now.
The cake has been in the oven for an hour. It should have finished baking by now.
They left at noon, so they should have reached the hotel by now.
The results should have come out by now.
The snow should have melted by now. It's April.
My sister should have finished her exams by now.

examples.heading: ① I should have + 過去分詞：自己沒做的事

items.en: Sorry I haven't written for three months. I knew I should have written before.
items.zh: 抱歉我三個月沒寫信。我知道我早就應該寫信了。

items.en: I failed the test. I should have studied harder.
items.zh: 我考試沒過。我應該更用功的。

items.en: I'm so cold. I should have brought a warmer coat.
items.zh: 我好冷。我應該帶一件更暖的外套的。

items.en: I should have listened to my dad. He was right about the car.
items.zh: 我應該聽我爸爸的話。他對那台車的看法是對的。

items.en: The shop is closed now. I should have gone this morning.
items.zh: 那家店現在關了。我應該早上去的。

items.en: I should have checked the time of the last bus.
items.zh: 我應該查一下最後一班公車的時間的。

examples.heading: ② You should have been + with us / there：當時應該在場

items.en: The concert was amazing. You should have been with us!
items.zh: 音樂會太精彩了。你當時應該跟我們一起去的！

items.en: You should have been at the beach yesterday. The sea was so warm.
items.zh: 你昨天應該在海灘的。海水好溫暖。

items.en: You should have been there when Tom fell in the pool!
items.zh: 湯姆掉進游泳池的時候，你應該在場的！

items.en: The food at the wedding was wonderful. You should have been there.
items.zh: 婚禮的食物太棒了。你應該去的。

items.en: You should have been at the match. It was the best game of the season.
items.zh: 你應該去看那場比賽的。那是這一季最好的比賽。

items.en: We had such a laugh last night. You should have been with us.
items.zh: 我們昨晚笑得好開心。你應該跟我們在一起的。

examples.heading: ③ You should have + 過去分詞：說對方當時應該做的事

items.en: Why didn't you ask me? You should have told me you needed money.
items.zh: 你為什麼不問我？你需要錢的時候應該告訴我的。

items.en: You should have taken the train. The roads were terrible.
items.zh: 你應該搭火車的。路況很糟。

items.en: You should have called before you came. I was out.
items.zh: 你來之前應該先打電話的。我那時不在。

items.en: You should have worn a hat. Your face is all red.
items.zh: 你應該戴帽子的。你的臉都紅了。

items.en: You should have asked for a receipt.
items.zh: 你應該要收據的。

items.en: You should have seen a doctor sooner.
items.zh: 你應該早點去看醫生的。

examples.heading: ④ We / They + should have + 過去分詞

items.en: We missed the plane. We should have left home earlier.
items.zh: 我們錯過了飛機。我們應該早點出門的。

items.en: They should have booked a hotel. Everything was full.
items.zh: 他們應該訂飯店的。全都客滿了。

items.en: We should have bought more bread. There's none left.
items.zh: 我們應該多買點麵包的。都沒了。

items.en: They should have read the instructions before they started.
items.zh: 他們開始之前應該先讀說明的。

items.en: We should have taken a photo of the sunset.
items.zh: 我們應該拍一張夕陽的照片的。

items.en: They should have asked for directions at the station.
items.zh: 他們應該在車站問路的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + should have + 過去分詞 + by now：現在應該已經

items.en: The parcel should have arrived by now. Let's call the shop.
items.zh: 包裹現在應該已經到了。我們打電話給那家店吧。

items.en: It's after seven. Dad should have got home by now.
items.zh: 已經七點多了。爸爸現在應該已經到家了。

items.en: The cake has been in the oven for an hour. It should have finished baking by now.
items.zh: 蛋糕在烤箱裡一個小時了。現在應該已經烤好了。

items.en: They left at noon, so they should have reached the hotel by now.
items.zh: 他們中午出發，所以現在應該已經到飯店了。

items.en: The results should have come out by now.
items.zh: 結果現在應該已經出來了。

items.en: The snow should have melted by now. It's April.
items.zh: 雪現在應該已經融化了。都四月了。

items.en: My sister should have finished her exams by now.
items.zh: 我姊姊現在應該已經考完試了。

title: I did not think my friend Janis would have done that.
translation: 那個答案本來會改變我的人生。
name: would have 加過去分詞
sentences: She told everyone my secret. I did not think my friend Janis would have done that.
I didn't think the shop would have closed so early.
We didn't think the journey would have taken so long.
I never thought my brother would have cooked dinner for us.
Nobody thought the old car would have lasted so long.
I didn't think she would have remembered my birthday.
I asked him a question, but he never answered. That answer would have changed my life.
That job would have meant moving to another country.
A bigger car would have been much more comfortable for the trip.
A map would have saved us a lot of time.
The party would have been better with some music.
A warmer coat would have kept me dry in the rain.
If I had known you were ill, I would have visited you.
If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.
If she had studied more, she would have passed the exam.
If it had been sunny, we would have gone to the beach.
If you had asked me, I would have lent you the money.
If they had booked earlier, they would have got cheaper tickets.
I would have called you, but my phone was dead.
We would have come to the wedding, but we were abroad.
She would have helped us, but she was too busy.
I would have bought the shoes, but they didn't have my size.
He would have stayed longer, but he had to catch a flight.
They would have won the match, but their best player was injured.
I'd have come to the party if you'd invited me.
I'd have made more food if I'd known so many people were coming.
We'd have been on time if the bus hadn't broken down.
She'd have enjoyed the film if she hadn't been so tired.
I'd have told you the truth if you'd asked me.
He'd have got the job if he'd worn a suit.
We'd have walked home if it hadn't been raining.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + didn't think + 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞：沒想到

items.en: She told everyone my secret. I did not think my friend Janis would have done that.
items.zh: 她把我的秘密告訴了每個人。我沒想到我的朋友珍妮絲會做那種事。

items.en: I didn't think the shop would have closed so early.
items.zh: 我沒想到那家店會那麼早關門。

items.en: We didn't think the journey would have taken so long.
items.zh: 我們沒想到路程會花那麼久。

items.en: I never thought my brother would have cooked dinner for us.
items.zh: 我從來沒想到我哥哥會為我們煮晚餐。

items.en: Nobody thought the old car would have lasted so long.
items.zh: 沒有人想到那台舊車會用那麼久。

items.en: I didn't think she would have remembered my birthday.
items.zh: 我沒想到她會記得我的生日。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞：想像過去的結果

items.en: I asked him a question, but he never answered. That answer would have changed my life.
items.zh: 我問了他一個問題，可是他一直沒回答。那個答案原本會改變我的人生。

items.en: That job would have meant moving to another country.
items.zh: 那份工作原本意味著要搬到另一個國家。

items.en: A bigger car would have been much more comfortable for the trip.
items.zh: 大一點的車對這趟旅行原本會舒服很多。

items.en: A map would have saved us a lot of time.
items.zh: 一張地圖原本能幫我們省很多時間。

items.en: The party would have been better with some music.
items.zh: 有一些音樂的話，派對原本會更好。

items.en: A warmer coat would have kept me dry in the rain.
items.zh: 一件比較暖的外套原本能讓我在雨中不被淋濕。

examples.heading: ③ If + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞

items.en: If I had known you were ill, I would have visited you.
items.zh: 如果我知道你生病了，我就會去看你了。

items.en: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.
items.zh: 如果我們早點出發，就會趕上火車了。

items.en: If she had studied more, she would have passed the exam.
items.zh: 如果她多讀一點書，她就會通過考試了。

items.en: If it had been sunny, we would have gone to the beach.
items.zh: 如果天氣晴朗，我們就會去海灘了。

items.en: If you had asked me, I would have lent you the money.
items.zh: 如果你有問我，我就會借你錢了。

items.en: If they had booked earlier, they would have got cheaper tickets.
items.zh: 如果他們早點訂，就會買到比較便宜的票了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞 + but + 子句：本來會，可是

items.en: I would have called you, but my phone was dead.
items.zh: 我本來會打給你，可是我的手機沒電了。

items.en: We would have come to the wedding, but we were abroad.
items.zh: 我們本來會去婚禮，可是我們在國外。

items.en: She would have helped us, but she was too busy.
items.zh: 她本來會幫我們，可是她太忙了。

items.en: I would have bought the shoes, but they didn't have my size.
items.zh: 我本來會買那雙鞋，可是他們沒有我的尺寸。

items.en: He would have stayed longer, but he had to catch a flight.
items.zh: 他本來會待久一點，可是他要趕飛機。

items.en: They would have won the match, but their best player was injured.
items.zh: 他們本來會贏那場比賽，可是他們最好的球員受傷了。

examples.heading: ⑤ I'd have + 過去分詞 + if + 子句：口語的縮寫

items.en: I'd have come to the party if you'd invited me.
items.zh: 如果你有邀請我，我就會去派對了。

items.en: I'd have made more food if I'd known so many people were coming.
items.zh: 如果我知道會來這麼多人，我就會做更多食物了。

items.en: We'd have been on time if the bus hadn't broken down.
items.zh: 如果公車沒有拋錨，我們就會準時了。

items.en: She'd have enjoyed the film if she hadn't been so tired.
items.zh: 如果她沒有那麼累，她就會喜歡那部電影了。

items.en: I'd have told you the truth if you'd asked me.
items.zh: 如果你問我，我就會告訴你真相了。

items.en: He'd have got the job if he'd worn a suit.
items.zh: 如果他穿西裝，他就會拿到那份工作了。

items.en: We'd have walked home if it hadn't been raining.
items.zh: 如果沒下雨，我們就會走路回家了。

title: The disappointment you mentioned might not have been as bad as you thought.
translation: 失望的程度也許沒有你想的那麼嚴重。
name: might not have 加過去分詞
sentences: Only ten people complained. The problem might not have been as big as the report said.
The delay might not have been as long as the newspaper said.
The damage might not have been as serious as it looked.
The crowd might not have been as big as the organisers claimed.
The noise might not have been as loud as your neighbour said.
The test might not have been as hard as you feared.
Send it again. She might not have got your email.
He might not have heard the doorbell. He had his headphones on.
They might not have read the notice on the door.
The driver might not have noticed the sign.
You might not have saved the file before you closed it.
The plants might not have had enough sun.
I mightn't have locked the back door. Can you check?
She mightn't have known it was your birthday.
We mightn't have bought enough bread for everyone.
He mightn't have meant to be rude.
They mightn't have understood the joke.
You mightn't have turned the oven on.
The plan might not have worked, but at least we tried.
The teacher might not have liked my essay, but I'm proud of it.
The party might not have started on time, but everyone had fun.
I might not have said it well, but I meant it.
Our team might not have played their best, but they fought hard.
The hotel might not have been perfect, but the staff were kind.
If you hadn't helped me, I might not have finished in time.
We might not have met if I hadn't missed that train.
If it had rained, they might not have come.
She might not have got the job if she hadn't spoken French.
If I had known the price, I might not have ordered it.
If his teacher hadn't stayed late with him, he might not have passed.
If the shop had been open, we might not have driven to the next town.

examples.heading: ① might not have been as + 形容詞 + as：委婉地反駁

items.en: Only ten people complained. The problem might not have been as big as the report said.
items.zh: 只有十個人投訴。問題可能沒有報告說的那麼大。

items.en: The delay might not have been as long as the newspaper said.
items.zh: 延誤的時間可能沒有報紙說的那麼長。

items.en: The damage might not have been as serious as it looked.
items.zh: 損害可能沒有看起來那麼嚴重。

items.en: The crowd might not have been as big as the organisers claimed.
items.zh: 人潮可能沒有主辦單位說的那麼多。

items.en: The noise might not have been as loud as your neighbour said.
items.zh: 噪音可能沒有你鄰居說的那麼大聲。

items.en: The test might not have been as hard as you feared.
items.zh: 考試可能沒有你擔心的那麼難。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + might not have + 過去分詞：猜過去沒發生的事

items.en: Send it again. She might not have got your email.
items.zh: 再寄一次。她可能沒收到你的電子郵件。

items.en: He might not have heard the doorbell. He had his headphones on.
items.zh: 他可能沒聽到門鈴。他戴著耳機。

items.en: They might not have read the notice on the door.
items.zh: 他們可能沒看到門上的告示。

items.en: The driver might not have noticed the sign.
items.zh: 司機可能沒注意到那個標誌。

items.en: You might not have saved the file before you closed it.
items.zh: 你關掉檔案前可能沒存檔。

items.en: The plants might not have had enough sun.
items.zh: 那些植物可能沒曬到足夠的太陽。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + mightn't have + 過去分詞：口語

items.en: I mightn't have locked the back door. Can you check?
items.zh: 我可能沒鎖後門。你可以去看看嗎？

items.en: She mightn't have known it was your birthday.
items.zh: 她可能不知道那天是你的生日。

items.en: We mightn't have bought enough bread for everyone.
items.zh: 我們買的麵包可能不夠大家吃。

items.en: He mightn't have meant to be rude.
items.zh: 他可能不是故意要沒禮貌的。

items.en: They mightn't have understood the joke.
items.zh: 他們可能沒聽懂那個笑話。

items.en: You mightn't have turned the oven on.
items.zh: 你可能沒開烤箱。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + might not have + 過去分詞, but + 句子

items.en: The plan might not have worked, but at least we tried.
items.zh: 這個計畫可能沒成功，可是至少我們試過了。

items.en: The teacher might not have liked my essay, but I'm proud of it.
items.zh: 老師可能不喜歡我的作文，可是我很自豪。

items.en: The party might not have started on time, but everyone had fun.
items.zh: 派對可能沒有準時開始，可是大家都玩得很開心。

items.en: I might not have said it well, but I meant it.
items.zh: 我可能說得不好，可是我是真心的。

items.en: Our team might not have played their best, but they fought hard.
items.zh: 我們隊可能沒有發揮最好的水準，可是他們很拚。

items.en: The hotel might not have been perfect, but the staff were kind.
items.zh: 那家飯店可能不完美，可是員工很親切。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + might not have + 過去分詞 + if + 子句

items.en: If you hadn't helped me, I might not have finished in time.
items.zh: 如果你沒幫我，我可能沒辦法及時完成。

items.en: We might not have met if I hadn't missed that train.
items.zh: 如果我沒錯過那班火車，我們可能就不會認識了。

items.en: If it had rained, they might not have come.
items.zh: 如果下雨了，他們可能就不會來了。

items.en: She might not have got the job if she hadn't spoken French.
items.zh: 如果她不會說法文，她可能就拿不到那份工作。

items.en: If I had known the price, I might not have ordered it.
items.zh: 如果我知道價錢，我可能就不會點了。

items.en: If his teacher hadn't stayed late with him, he might not have passed.
items.zh: 如果老師沒有留下來陪他，他可能考不過。

items.en: If the shop had been open, we might not have driven to the next town.
items.zh: 如果那家店有開，我們可能就不會開車到隔壁鎮。

title: It must not have been easy for him to be a post-war son of a widow.
translation: 這對他來說一定不容易。
name: must not have been 推測過去
sentences: My father grew up after the war with only his mother. It must not have been easy for him to be the son of a widow.
You moved to Australia at eighteen. It must not have been easy for you to leave your family.
My aunt lost her job at the bank and became a nurse. It must not have been easy for her to start a new job at fifty.
Our new neighbours came from Syria last year. It must not have been easy for them to learn a new language.
The family moved house three times in two years. It must not have been easy for the children to change schools so often.
Jack told his parents that he had crashed the car. It must not have been easy for him to tell the truth.
My grandmother married a man with three little children, which must not have been easy for her.
My uncle worked two jobs to pay for college, which must not have been easy.
In the 1960s my grandparents lived in a tiny flat with five kids, which must not have been easy.
Our teacher looked after her sick mother for years, which must not have been easy.
At twenty, my father moved to Japan, where he knew nobody, which must not have been easy.
The Wilsons lost everything in the fire and had to start again, which must not have been easy.
The captain made a second announcement. It mustn't have been more than an hour after the first one.
My grandmother looks very young in this photo with my mum. She mustn't have been more than twenty when she had her first child.
The room was almost empty when I arrived late. There mustn't have been more than ten people at the meeting.
We got to the lake before lunch, and the children weren't tired. The walk mustn't have been more than two miles.
The paint on the shop sign still looks new. The shop mustn't have been open for more than a year.
We got soaked on the way to the bus stop. The shower mustn't have been more than ten minutes long, though.
In 1900 there were robbers on the mountain road. The road must not have been safe in those days.
My grandfather lost ten kilos at the army camp. The food there must not have been very good.
The farmhouse had no heating and thin walls. Life on the farm must not have been comfortable in winter.
Many patients caught infections there in the 1800s. The old hospital must not have been very clean.
My parents drove across Spain in August in their old car. The journey must not have been pleasant without air conditioning.
The cottage had six rooms and only one fire. The house must not have been warm in winter.
I called Sam across the street. He must not have heard me, because he didn't turn round.
Everyone was at Emma's party except Lucy. She must not have known about it.
We wrote to the hotel a month ago, and they still haven't answered. They must not have received our letter.
The police have a clear video of the man's face. The thief must not have seen the camera.
The car door was open when we came back. You must not have locked it.
Most of the soup was left in the bowls. The guests must not have liked it.
I woke up at ten and missed my train. I must not have set my alarm.

examples.heading: ① It must not have been easy for + 人 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: My father grew up after the war with only his mother. It must not have been easy for him to be the son of a widow.
items.zh: 我父親戰後跟他媽媽兩個人長大。當一個寡婦的兒子，對他來說一定很不容易。

items.en: You moved to Australia at eighteen. It must not have been easy for you to leave your family.
items.zh: 你十八歲搬去澳洲。離開你的家人對你來說一定很不容易。

items.en: My aunt lost her job at the bank and became a nurse. It must not have been easy for her to start a new job at fifty.
items.zh: 我阿姨在銀行失業後當了護理師。五十歲開始一份新工作，對她來說一定很不容易。

items.en: Our new neighbours came from Syria last year. It must not have been easy for them to learn a new language.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居去年從敘利亞來。學一種新的語言對他們來說一定很不容易。

items.en: The family moved house three times in two years. It must not have been easy for the children to change schools so often.
items.zh: 那家人兩年搬了三次家。這麼常轉學對孩子們來說一定很不容易。

items.en: Jack told his parents that he had crashed the car. It must not have been easy for him to tell the truth.
items.zh: Jack 告訴爸媽他把車撞壞了。說出真相對他來說一定很不容易。

examples.heading: ② …, which must not have been easy for + 人

items.en: My grandmother married a man with three little children, which must not have been easy for her.
items.zh: 我奶奶嫁給一個有三個小孩的男人，這對她來說一定很不容易。

items.en: My uncle worked two jobs to pay for college, which must not have been easy.
items.zh: 我叔叔做兩份工作付大學學費，這一定很不容易。

items.en: In the 1960s my grandparents lived in a tiny flat with five kids, which must not have been easy.
items.zh: 一九六〇年代，我爺爺奶奶跟五個孩子住在一間很小的公寓，這一定很不容易。

items.en: Our teacher looked after her sick mother for years, which must not have been easy.
items.zh: 我們老師照顧生病的媽媽好幾年，這一定很不容易。

items.en: At twenty, my father moved to Japan, where he knew nobody, which must not have been easy.
items.zh: 我父親二十歲搬去日本，在那裡一個人都不認識，這一定很不容易。

items.en: The Wilsons lost everything in the fire and had to start again, which must not have been easy.
items.zh: Wilson 一家在火災中失去了一切，必須從頭開始，這一定很不容易。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + mustn't have been + more than：推論數量和時間

items.en: The captain made a second announcement. It mustn't have been more than an hour after the first one.
items.zh: 機長又做了一次廣播。離第一次一定不超過一個小時。

items.en: My grandmother looks very young in this photo with my mum. She mustn't have been more than twenty when she had her first child.
items.zh: 這張照片裡我奶奶抱著我媽媽，看起來好年輕。她生第一個孩子的時候，一定不超過二十歲。

items.en: The room was almost empty when I arrived late. There mustn't have been more than ten people at the meeting.
items.zh: 我遲到的時候，房間幾乎是空的。開會的人一定不超過十個。

items.en: We got to the lake before lunch, and the children weren't tired. The walk mustn't have been more than two miles.
items.zh: 我們午餐前就走到湖邊，孩子們也不累。那段路一定不超過兩英里。

items.en: The paint on the shop sign still looks new. The shop mustn't have been open for more than a year.
items.zh: 店招牌的油漆看起來還很新。那家店開業一定不超過一年。

items.en: We got soaked on the way to the bus stop. The shower mustn't have been more than ten minutes long, though.
items.zh: 我們走去公車站時全身濕透了。不過那陣雨一定不超過十分鐘。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + must not have been + 形容詞：推論過去的情況

items.en: In 1900 there were robbers on the mountain road. The road must not have been safe in those days.
items.zh: 一九〇〇年那條山路上有強盜。那個年代那條路一定不安全。

items.en: My grandfather lost ten kilos at the army camp. The food there must not have been very good.
items.zh: 我爺爺在軍營瘦了十公斤。那裡的食物一定不怎麼好。

items.en: The farmhouse had no heating and thin walls. Life on the farm must not have been comfortable in winter.
items.zh: 農舍沒有暖氣，牆又薄。冬天在農場的生活一定不舒服。

items.en: Many patients caught infections there in the 1800s. The old hospital must not have been very clean.
items.zh: 十九世紀很多病人在那裡受到感染。那間老醫院一定不太乾淨。

items.en: My parents drove across Spain in August in their old car. The journey must not have been pleasant without air conditioning.
items.zh: 我爸媽八月開他們的舊車穿越西班牙。沒有冷氣，那趟旅程一定不舒服。

items.en: The cottage had six rooms and only one fire. The house must not have been warm in winter.
items.zh: 那間小屋有六個房間，卻只有一個火爐。那間房子冬天一定不暖和。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + must not have + 過去分詞：推論過去沒發生

items.en: I called Sam across the street. He must not have heard me, because he didn't turn round.
items.zh: 我在街對面叫 Sam。他一定沒聽到我，因為他沒有轉過頭來。

items.en: Everyone was at Emma's party except Lucy. She must not have known about it.
items.zh: 除了 Lucy，大家都去了 Emma 的派對。她一定不知道派對的事。

items.en: We wrote to the hotel a month ago, and they still haven't answered. They must not have received our letter.
items.zh: 我們一個月前寫信給飯店，他們到現在還沒回。他們一定沒收到我們的信。

items.en: The police have a clear video of the man's face. The thief must not have seen the camera.
items.zh: 警察有那個人臉部的清楚影片。小偷一定沒看到攝影機。

items.en: The car door was open when we came back. You must not have locked it.
items.zh: 我們回來的時候車門是開的。你一定沒鎖車。

items.en: Most of the soup was left in the bowls. The guests must not have liked it.
items.zh: 碗裡的湯大部分都剩下來了。客人一定不喜歡那道湯。

items.en: I woke up at ten and missed my train. I must not have set my alarm.
items.zh: 我十點才醒，錯過了火車。我一定沒設鬧鐘。

title: You needn't have bought me anything!
translation: 你其實不用買東西給我的！
name: needn't have 加過去分詞
sentences: Oh, a bracelet! It's beautiful, but you needn't have bought me anything!
Thank you for the lovely dinner. However, you needn't have bothered so much.
Flowers! You needn't have brought anything.
You needn't have cleaned the kitchen. I was going to do it.
You needn't have waited for me. I could have taken a taxi.
I'm only in hospital for one night. You needn't have driven all this way to see me.
I needn't have taken a coat. It was really warm.
We needn't have hurried. The train was late.
I needn't have worried about the exam. It was easy.
We needn't have booked a table. The restaurant was empty.
I needn't have bought so much food. Only four people came.
We needn't have left so early. We arrived an hour before it started.
She needn't have come so early. The meeting started at ten.
He needn't have printed the tickets. They were on his phone.
They needn't have paid for parking. It's free on Sundays.
The children needn't have brought their swimsuits. The pool was closed.
My mum needn't have made a cake. We had one already.
Tom needn't have studied all night. The test was cancelled.
I needn't have taken an umbrella, because it didn't rain.
You needn't have phoned, because I got your email.
We needn't have bought new chairs, because the old ones were fine.
She needn't have apologised, because it wasn't her fault.
I needn't have changed my money, because they took cards everywhere.
He needn't have run, because the bus waited for him.
You needn't have been so nervous. You did really well.
I needn't have been afraid of the dog. It was very gentle.
It was sunny every day of the camping trip. We needn't have been so worried about the weather.
She needn't have felt shy. Everyone was very friendly.
You needn't have panicked. The keys were in your pocket.
I needn't have been so angry. It was only a small mistake.
They needn't have been so careful. The box wasn't fragile.

examples.heading: ① You needn't have + 過去分詞：感謝別人的好意

items.en: Oh, a bracelet! It's beautiful, but you needn't have bought me anything!
items.zh: 噢，一條手鍊！好漂亮，可是你其實不必買東西給我的！

items.en: Thank you for the lovely dinner. However, you needn't have bothered so much.
items.zh: 謝謝你準備這麼棒的晚餐。不過，你其實不必這麼費心的。

items.en: Flowers! You needn't have brought anything.
items.zh: 花！你其實不必帶東西來的。

items.en: You needn't have cleaned the kitchen. I was going to do it.
items.zh: 你其實不必打掃廚房的。我本來要做。

items.en: You needn't have waited for me. I could have taken a taxi.
items.zh: 你其實不必等我的。我可以搭計程車。

items.en: I'm only in hospital for one night. You needn't have driven all this way to see me.
items.zh: 我只住院一個晚上。你其實不必大老遠開車來看我的。

examples.heading: ② I / We needn't have + 過去分詞：自己多做的事

items.en: I needn't have taken a coat. It was really warm.
items.zh: 我其實不必帶外套的。天氣很暖和。

items.en: We needn't have hurried. The train was late.
items.zh: 我們其實不必趕的。火車誤點了。

items.en: I needn't have worried about the exam. It was easy.
items.zh: 我其實不必擔心考試的。很簡單。

items.en: We needn't have booked a table. The restaurant was empty.
items.zh: 我們其實不必訂位的。餐廳都沒人。

items.en: I needn't have bought so much food. Only four people came.
items.zh: 我其實不必買那麼多食物的。只來了四個人。

items.en: We needn't have left so early. We arrived an hour before it started.
items.zh: 我們其實不必那麼早出發的。我們在開始前一個小時就到了。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + needn't have + 過去分詞：別人多做的事

items.en: She needn't have come so early. The meeting started at ten.
items.zh: 她其實不必那麼早來的。會議十點才開始。

items.en: He needn't have printed the tickets. They were on his phone.
items.zh: 他其實不必把票印出來的。票在他的手機裡。

items.en: They needn't have paid for parking. It's free on Sundays.
items.zh: 他們其實不必付停車費的。星期天免費。

items.en: The children needn't have brought their swimsuits. The pool was closed.
items.zh: 孩子們其實不必帶泳衣的。游泳池關了。

items.en: My mum needn't have made a cake. We had one already.
items.zh: 我媽媽其實不必做蛋糕的。我們已經有一個了。

items.en: Tom needn't have studied all night. The test was cancelled.
items.zh: Tom 其實不必熬夜讀書的。考試取消了。

examples.heading: ④ needn't have + 過去分詞, because + 子句

items.en: I needn't have taken an umbrella, because it didn't rain.
items.zh: 我其實不必帶傘的，因為沒下雨。

items.en: You needn't have phoned, because I got your email.
items.zh: 你其實不必打電話的，因為我收到你的電子郵件了。

items.en: We needn't have bought new chairs, because the old ones were fine.
items.zh: 我們其實不必買新椅子的，因為舊的還很好。

items.en: She needn't have apologised, because it wasn't her fault.
items.zh: 她其實不必道歉的，因為那不是她的錯。

items.en: I needn't have changed my money, because they took cards everywhere.
items.zh: 我其實不必換錢的，因為到處都可以刷卡。

items.en: He needn't have run, because the bus waited for him.
items.zh: 他其實不必跑的，因為公車等了他。

examples.heading: ⑤ needn't have + 過去分詞：說擔心是多餘的

items.en: You needn't have been so nervous. You did really well.
items.zh: 你其實不必那麼緊張的。你表現得很好。

items.en: I needn't have been afraid of the dog. It was very gentle.
items.zh: 我其實不必怕那隻狗的。牠很溫和。

items.en: It was sunny every day of the camping trip. We needn't have been so worried about the weather.
items.zh: 露營的每一天都是晴天。我們其實不必那麼擔心天氣的。

items.en: She needn't have felt shy. Everyone was very friendly.
items.zh: 她其實不必害羞的。每個人都很友善。

items.en: You needn't have panicked. The keys were in your pocket.
items.zh: 你其實不必慌的。鑰匙在你的口袋裡。

items.en: I needn't have been so angry. It was only a small mistake.
items.zh: 我其實不必那麼生氣的。只是一個小錯。

items.en: They needn't have been so careful. The box wasn't fragile.
items.zh: 他們其實不必那麼小心的。箱子裡的東西不易碎。

title: I know I shouldn't have made it during school time, but I had no other choice.
translation: 我知道我不該把約排在上課時間，但我也沒有別的辦法。
name: shouldn't have 加過去分詞
sentences: I have a dentist's appointment tomorrow. I know I shouldn't have made it during school time, but I had no other choice.
I know I shouldn't have spent so much, but the shoes were perfect.
I know I shouldn't have left early, but I felt ill.
I know I shouldn't have opened your letter, but I thought it was for me.
I know I shouldn't have taken the car, but the buses were on strike.
I know I shouldn't have stayed up so late, but the book was so good.
I shouldn't have shouted at you this morning. I'm really sorry.
I feel sick. I shouldn't have eaten that third piece of cake.
I shouldn't have told her your secret. It just slipped out.
I shouldn't have believed everything the salesman said.
I shouldn't have lent him my camera. He broke it.
I shouldn't have drunk coffee so late. Now I can't sleep.
You shouldn't have driven so fast in the rain.
You shouldn't have left the door open. The cat got out.
You shouldn't have laughed at him. He was upset.
You shouldn't have walked home alone so late.
You shouldn't have touched the oven. It was still hot.
You shouldn't have paid so much for that old bike.
We shouldn't have come on a Saturday. It's so crowded.
They shouldn't have built the houses so close to the river.
We shouldn't have ordered so much food. We can't finish it.
They shouldn't have cut down the old oak tree.
We shouldn't have stayed in the sun all afternoon.
They shouldn't have started the match in such heavy rain.
He shouldn't have said those things to his mother.
She shouldn't have gone back into the burning house.
He shouldn't have quit his job before finding a new one.
She shouldn't have trusted that website with her card details.
He shouldn't have parked on the double yellow lines.
She shouldn't have carried such a heavy bag with a bad back.
He shouldn't have skipped breakfast before the race.

examples.heading: ① I know I shouldn't have + 過去分詞, but …：解釋原因

items.en: I have a dentist's appointment tomorrow. I know I shouldn't have made it during school time, but I had no other choice.
items.zh: 我明天要看牙醫。我知道我不應該約在上課時間，可是我沒有別的選擇。

items.en: I know I shouldn't have spent so much, but the shoes were perfect.
items.zh: 我知道我不應該花那麼多錢，可是那雙鞋太完美了。

items.en: I know I shouldn't have left early, but I felt ill.
items.zh: 我知道我不應該提早走，可是我覺得不舒服。

items.en: I know I shouldn't have opened your letter, but I thought it was for me.
items.zh: 我知道我不應該拆你的信，可是我以為那是給我的。

items.en: I know I shouldn't have taken the car, but the buses were on strike.
items.zh: 我知道我不應該開車，可是公車在罷工。

items.en: I know I shouldn't have stayed up so late, but the book was so good.
items.zh: 我知道我不應該熬夜到那麼晚，可是那本書太好看了。

examples.heading: ② I shouldn't have + 過去分詞：後悔和道歉

items.en: I shouldn't have shouted at you this morning. I'm really sorry.
items.zh: 我今天早上不應該對你大吼。真的很對不起。

items.en: I feel sick. I shouldn't have eaten that third piece of cake.
items.zh: 我覺得想吐。我不應該吃第三塊蛋糕的。

items.en: I shouldn't have told her your secret. It just slipped out.
items.zh: 我不應該把你的秘密告訴她的。我不小心說出來了。

items.en: I shouldn't have believed everything the salesman said.
items.zh: 我不應該相信那個推銷員說的每一句話。

items.en: I shouldn't have lent him my camera. He broke it.
items.zh: 我不應該把相機借給他的。他弄壞了。

items.en: I shouldn't have drunk coffee so late. Now I can't sleep.
items.zh: 我不應該那麼晚喝咖啡的。現在我睡不著。

examples.heading: ③ You shouldn't have + 過去分詞：批評對方

items.en: You shouldn't have driven so fast in the rain.
items.zh: 你不應該在雨中開那麼快的。

items.en: You shouldn't have left the door open. The cat got out.
items.zh: 你不應該讓門開著的。貓跑出去了。

items.en: You shouldn't have laughed at him. He was upset.
items.zh: 你不應該笑他的。他很難過。

items.en: You shouldn't have walked home alone so late.
items.zh: 你不應該那麼晚一個人走路回家的。

items.en: You shouldn't have touched the oven. It was still hot.
items.zh: 你不應該碰烤箱的。它還很燙。

items.en: You shouldn't have paid so much for that old bike.
items.zh: 你不應該花那麼多錢買那台舊腳踏車的。

examples.heading: ④ We / They + shouldn't have + 過去分詞

items.en: We shouldn't have come on a Saturday. It's so crowded.
items.zh: 我們不應該星期六來的。人好多。

items.en: They shouldn't have built the houses so close to the river.
items.zh: 他們不應該把房子蓋得離河那麼近的。

items.en: We shouldn't have ordered so much food. We can't finish it.
items.zh: 我們不應該點那麼多食物的。我們吃不完。

items.en: They shouldn't have cut down the old oak tree.
items.zh: 他們不應該砍掉那棵老橡樹的。

items.en: We shouldn't have stayed in the sun all afternoon.
items.zh: 我們不應該整個下午都待在太陽底下的。

items.en: They shouldn't have started the match in such heavy rain.
items.zh: 他們不應該在那麼大的雨中開始比賽的。

examples.heading: ⑤ He / She + shouldn't have + 過去分詞

items.en: He shouldn't have said those things to his mother.
items.zh: 他不應該對他媽媽說那些話的。

items.en: She shouldn't have gone back into the burning house.
items.zh: 她不應該回到著火的房子裡的。

items.en: He shouldn't have quit his job before finding a new one.
items.zh: 他不應該在找到新工作之前就辭職的。

items.en: She shouldn't have trusted that website with her card details.
items.zh: 她不應該在那個網站上留她的信用卡資料的。

items.en: He shouldn't have parked on the double yellow lines.
items.zh: 他不應該把車停在雙黃線上的。

items.en: She shouldn't have carried such a heavy bag with a bad back.
items.zh: 她背不好，不應該提那麼重的袋子的。

items.en: He shouldn't have skipped breakfast before the race.
items.zh: 他比賽前不應該不吃早餐的。

title: Without your help, I wouldn't have got this result.
translation: 要不是那一天，她就不會遇到 George 了。
name: wouldn't have 加過去分詞
sentences: You helped me every week for three months. Without your help, I wouldn't have got this result.
Without my parents' support, I wouldn't have gone to university.
Without the map, we wouldn't have found the hotel.
Without your advice, I wouldn't have taken this job.
Without the volunteers, the festival wouldn't have happened.
Without my glasses, I wouldn't have seen the sign.
She missed her train that day. Had it not been for that day, she would not have met George.
Had it not been for the rain, we would not have stayed indoors.
Had it not been for her teacher, she would not have become a writer.
Had it not been for the doctor, he would not have survived.
Had it not been for the strike, the trip would not have been cancelled.
Had it not been for my dog, I would not have woken up during the fire.
If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late for the exam.
If we hadn't taken the wrong road, we wouldn't have got lost.
If she hadn't fallen, she wouldn't have broken her arm.
If you hadn't reminded me, I wouldn't have remembered his birthday.
If they hadn't left the door open, the cat wouldn't have escaped.
If I hadn't eaten so much, I wouldn't have felt sick.
I wouldn't have bought the car if I'd known about the problems.
We wouldn't have gone camping if we'd seen the forecast.
She wouldn't have said that if she'd been less tired.
They wouldn't have won if they hadn't bought a new striker.
I wouldn't have met my best friend if I hadn't moved here.
He wouldn't have passed if he hadn't studied so hard.
I wouldn't have chosen that colour for the kitchen.
My grandmother wouldn't have liked this modern music.
I wouldn't have known what to do without the instructions.
Most drivers wouldn't have seen that small sign in the dark.
Most people wouldn't have waited so long.
I wouldn't have believed it if I hadn't seen it myself.
A careful driver wouldn't have parked there.

examples.heading: ① Without + 名詞, + 主詞 + wouldn't have + 過去分詞：感謝

items.en: You helped me every week for three months. Without your help, I wouldn't have got this result.
items.zh: 您三個月來每個星期都幫我。沒有您的幫忙，我不會得到這個成績。

items.en: Without my parents' support, I wouldn't have gone to university.
items.zh: 沒有我爸媽的支持，我不會去念大學。

items.en: Without the map, we wouldn't have found the hotel.
items.zh: 沒有那張地圖，我們不會找到飯店。

items.en: Without your advice, I wouldn't have taken this job.
items.zh: 沒有你的建議，我不會接受這份工作。

items.en: Without the volunteers, the festival wouldn't have happened.
items.zh: 沒有那些志工，這個節慶不會辦成。

items.en: Without my glasses, I wouldn't have seen the sign.
items.zh: 沒有眼鏡，我不會看到那個標誌。

examples.heading: ② Had it not been for + 名詞, + 主詞 + would not have + 過去分詞

items.en: She missed her train that day. Had it not been for that day, she would not have met George.
items.zh: 那天她錯過了火車。要不是那一天，她不會遇到喬治。

items.en: Had it not been for the rain, we would not have stayed indoors.
items.zh: 要不是下雨，我們不會待在室內。

items.en: Had it not been for her teacher, she would not have become a writer.
items.zh: 要不是她的老師，她不會成為作家。

items.en: Had it not been for the doctor, he would not have survived.
items.zh: 要不是那位醫生，他不會活下來。

items.en: Had it not been for the strike, the trip would not have been cancelled.
items.zh: 要不是罷工，旅行不會取消。（被動）

items.en: Had it not been for my dog, I would not have woken up during the fire.
items.zh: 要不是我的狗，火災時我不會醒過來。

examples.heading: ③ If + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + wouldn't have + 過去分詞

items.en: If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late for the exam.
items.zh: 如果我沒錯過公車，考試就不會遲到了。

items.en: If we hadn't taken the wrong road, we wouldn't have got lost.
items.zh: 如果我們沒走錯路，就不會迷路了。

items.en: If she hadn't fallen, she wouldn't have broken her arm.
items.zh: 如果她沒跌倒，就不會摔斷手臂了。

items.en: If you hadn't reminded me, I wouldn't have remembered his birthday.
items.zh: 如果你沒提醒我，我就不會記得他的生日了。

items.en: If they hadn't left the door open, the cat wouldn't have escaped.
items.zh: 如果他們沒讓門開著，貓就不會跑掉了。

items.en: If I hadn't eaten so much, I wouldn't have felt sick.
items.zh: 如果我沒吃那麼多，就不會覺得不舒服了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + wouldn't have + 過去分詞 + if + 子句：if 子句放在後面

items.en: I wouldn't have bought the car if I'd known about the problems.
items.zh: 如果我知道那些問題，我就不會買那台車了。

items.en: We wouldn't have gone camping if we'd seen the forecast.
items.zh: 如果我們看了天氣預報，就不會去露營了。

items.en: She wouldn't have said that if she'd been less tired.
items.zh: 如果她沒那麼累，她就不會那樣說了。

items.en: They wouldn't have won if they hadn't bought a new striker.
items.zh: 如果他們沒有買一個新前鋒，他們不會贏。

items.en: I wouldn't have met my best friend if I hadn't moved here.
items.zh: 如果我沒搬來這裡，就不會認識我最好的朋友。

items.en: He wouldn't have passed if he hadn't studied so hard.
items.zh: 如果他沒那麼用功，他就不會考過了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + wouldn't have + 過去分詞：說過去不會做的事

items.en: I wouldn't have chosen that colour for the kitchen.
items.zh: 我不會為廚房選那個顏色。

items.en: My grandmother wouldn't have liked this modern music.
items.zh: 我奶奶不會喜歡這種現代音樂。

items.en: I wouldn't have known what to do without the instructions.
items.zh: 沒有說明書，我不會知道要怎麼做。

items.en: Most drivers wouldn't have seen that small sign in the dark.
items.zh: 天黑的時候，大部分的駕駛不會看到那個小標誌。

items.en: Most people wouldn't have waited so long.
items.zh: 大部分的人不會等那麼久。

items.en: I wouldn't have believed it if I hadn't seen it myself.
items.zh: 如果不是我親眼看到，我不會相信。

items.en: A careful driver wouldn't have parked there.
items.zh: 一個小心的駕駛不會把車停在那裡。

title: Can we go to the park on Sunday?
translation: 我們星期天可以去公園嗎？
name: can 的疑問句
sentences: Can we go to the park on the weekend?
Can I open the window? It's very hot in here.
Can we keep the kitten in our bedroom tonight?
Can I borrow your bike this afternoon?
Can we have pizza for dinner tonight?
Can I try on these jeans?
Can we watch one more episode?
Can I leave my bag behind the counter for an hour?
Can I bring my sister to the party?
Can you come for dinner on Monday at six?
Can you help me carry these boxes?
Can you explain this sentence to me in simple words?
Can you send me the photos from the trip?
Can you pick me up from school?
Can you play the guitar?
Can you turn the music down, please?
Can you see the bus from there?
Can your brother take us to the airport in his van?
Can she come to the cinema with us?
Can they stay for lunch?
Can the baby sit up yet?
Can your dog stay in the kitchen while we eat?
Can Tom meet us at the café?
Can the kids play outside after lunch?
Where can I buy stamps?
What time can you come round to help me with the garden?
How can I send money to my son in Australia?
When can we see the new house?
What can I cook for the party?
Who can help me with my maths?
Where can we park the car?

examples.heading: ① Can + I / we + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Can we go to the park on the weekend?
items.zh: 我們週末可以去公園嗎？

items.en: Can I open the window? It's very hot in here.
items.zh: 我可以開窗嗎？這裡好熱。

items.en: Can we keep the kitten in our bedroom tonight?
items.zh: 我們今晚可以讓小貓待在我們的房間嗎？

items.en: Can I borrow your bike this afternoon?
items.zh: 我今天下午可以借你的腳踏車嗎？

items.en: Can we have pizza for dinner tonight?
items.zh: 我們今晚晚餐可以吃披薩嗎？

items.en: Can I try on these jeans?
items.zh: 我可以試穿這條牛仔褲嗎？

items.en: Can we watch one more episode?
items.zh: 我們可以再看一集嗎？

items.en: Can I leave my bag behind the counter for an hour?
items.zh: 我可以把包包放在櫃台後面一個小時嗎？

items.en: Can I bring my sister to the party?
items.zh: 我可以帶我妹來派對嗎？

examples.heading: ② Can + you + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Can you come for dinner on Monday at six?
items.zh: 你星期一六點可以來吃晚餐嗎？

items.en: Can you help me carry these boxes?
items.zh: 你可以幫我搬這些箱子嗎？

items.en: Can you explain this sentence to me in simple words?
items.zh: 你可以用簡單的話跟我解釋這個句子嗎？

items.en: Can you send me the photos from the trip?
items.zh: 你可以把旅行的照片寄給我嗎？

items.en: Can you pick me up from school?
items.zh: 你可以來學校接我嗎？

items.en: Can you play the guitar?
items.zh: 你會彈吉他嗎？

items.en: Can you turn the music down, please?
items.zh: 你可以把音樂關小聲一點嗎？

items.en: Can you see the bus from there?
items.zh: 你從那裡看得到公車嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Can + he / she / it / they + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Can your brother take us to the airport in his van?
items.zh: 你哥可以開他的廂型車載我們去機場嗎？

items.en: Can she come to the cinema with us?
items.zh: 她可以跟我們去看電影嗎？

items.en: Can they stay for lunch?
items.zh: 他們可以留下來吃午餐嗎？

items.en: Can the baby sit up yet?
items.zh: 寶寶會坐了嗎？

items.en: Can your dog stay in the kitchen while we eat?
items.zh: 我們吃飯時你的狗可以待在廚房嗎？

items.en: Can Tom meet us at the café?
items.zh: Tom 可以在咖啡店跟我們見面嗎？

items.en: Can the kids play outside after lunch?
items.zh: 孩子們午餐後可以去外面玩嗎？

examples.heading: ④ wh- 疑問詞 + can + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Where can I buy stamps?
items.zh: 我可以在哪裡買郵票？

items.en: What time can you come round to help me with the garden?
items.zh: 你幾點可以過來幫我整理花園？

items.en: How can I send money to my son in Australia?
items.zh: 我要怎麼寄錢給我在澳洲的兒子？

items.en: When can we see the new house?
items.zh: 我們什麼時候可以看新房子？

items.en: What can I cook for the party?
items.zh: 派對我可以煮什麼？

items.en: Who can help me with my maths?
items.zh: 誰可以幫我做數學？

items.en: Where can we park the car?
items.zh: 我們可以把車停在哪裡？

title: Dare we run the risk of even one child turning to violent crime?
translation: 哪怕只有一個孩子走上暴力犯罪的路，我們敢冒這個險嗎？
name: dare 的疑問句
sentences: Dare we sell our parks to builders?
Dare we ignore the warnings from scientists?
Dare we spend so much money on one project?
Dare we leave such an important decision to chance?
Dare we hope for a better future?
Dare we build more roads when the air is already so dirty?
Dare we close the only hospital in the area?
Dare we trust a company that has lied before?
Dare we cut the budget for schools again?
Dare we let our children grow up without nature?
Dare I ask what you paid for that car?
Dare I suggest that we try a different approach?
Dare I mention that the deadline was yesterday?
Dare I ask who chose this colour?
Dare I hope that you'll come to the wedding?
Dare I point out that the figures don't add up?
Dare I admit that I've never read the book?
Dare she tell her parents the truth?
Dare they go against the wishes of the public?
Dare he ask her out after what happened?
Dare the club sell its best player before the final?
Dare the government admit its mistake?
Dare anyone disagree with the director?
Who dare say no to such a generous offer?
Do you dare to tell her what really happened?
Does he dare to climb the old tower?
Did you dare look inside the box?
Do you dare go back to that restaurant?
Did they dare to complain to the manager?
Do you dare ask your teacher for a higher mark?
Who dare question the captain's decision?

examples.heading: ① Dare we + 原形動詞 ...?：修辭問句

items.en: Dare we sell our parks to builders?
items.zh: 我們敢把公園賣給建商嗎？

items.en: Dare we ignore the warnings from scientists?
items.zh: 我們敢忽視科學家的警告嗎？

items.en: Dare we spend so much money on one project?
items.zh: 我們敢在一個專案上花這麼多錢嗎？

items.en: Dare we leave such an important decision to chance?
items.zh: 我們敢把這麼重要的決定交給運氣嗎？

items.en: Dare we hope for a better future?
items.zh: 我們敢期待更好的未來嗎？

items.en: Dare we build more roads when the air is already so dirty?
items.zh: 空氣已經這麼髒了，我們還敢蓋更多路嗎？

items.en: Dare we close the only hospital in the area?
items.zh: 我們敢關閉這個地區唯一的醫院嗎？

items.en: Dare we trust a company that has lied before?
items.zh: 我們敢相信一家以前說過謊的公司嗎？

items.en: Dare we cut the budget for schools again?
items.zh: 我們敢再刪減學校的預算嗎？

items.en: Dare we let our children grow up without nature?
items.zh: 我們敢讓孩子在沒有大自然的環境下長大嗎？

examples.heading: ② Dare I + 原形動詞 ...?：客氣地提出

items.en: Dare I ask what you paid for that car?
items.zh: 我可以冒昧問一下你那台車花了多少錢嗎？

items.en: Dare I suggest that we try a different approach?
items.zh: 我可以冒昧建議我們試試不同的方法嗎？

items.en: Dare I mention that the deadline was yesterday?
items.zh: 我可以提一下截止日期是昨天嗎？

items.en: Dare I ask who chose this colour?
items.zh: 我可以冒昧問一下這個顏色是誰選的嗎？

items.en: Dare I hope that you'll come to the wedding?
items.zh: 我可以期待你會來參加婚禮嗎？

items.en: Dare I point out that the figures don't add up?
items.zh: 我可以指出這些數字加起來不對嗎？

items.en: Dare I admit that I've never read the book?
items.zh: 我可以承認我從來沒讀過那本書嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Dare + 第三人稱主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Dare she tell her parents the truth?
items.zh: 她敢告訴爸媽實話嗎？

items.en: Dare they go against the wishes of the public?
items.zh: 他們敢違背民意嗎？

items.en: Dare he ask her out after what happened?
items.zh: 發生那件事之後，他敢約她出去嗎？

items.en: Dare the club sell its best player before the final?
items.zh: 球隊敢在決賽前賣掉最好的球員嗎？

items.en: Dare the government admit its mistake?
items.zh: 政府敢承認錯誤嗎？

items.en: Dare anyone disagree with the director?
items.zh: 有人敢跟導演唱反調嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Who + dare + 原形動詞 ...? / Do + 主詞 + dare + (to) ...?

items.en: Who dare say no to such a generous offer?
items.zh: 誰敢拒絕這麼慷慨的提議？

items.en: Do you dare to tell her what really happened?
items.zh: 你敢告訴她真正發生了什麼事嗎？

items.en: Does he dare to climb the old tower?
items.zh: 他敢爬那座舊塔嗎？

items.en: Did you dare look inside the box?
items.zh: 你敢看箱子裡面嗎？

items.en: Do you dare go back to that restaurant?
items.zh: 你敢再回那家餐廳嗎？

items.en: Did they dare to complain to the manager?
items.zh: 他們敢向經理抱怨嗎？

items.en: Do you dare ask your teacher for a higher mark?
items.zh: 你敢跟老師要求更高的分數嗎？

items.en: Who dare question the captain's decision?
items.zh: 誰敢質疑船長的決定？

title: What do we have to bring?
translation: 你一定要穿裙子嗎？
name: have (got) to 的疑問句
sentences: I've never been to a summer camp. Do I have to bring my own sleeping bag?
Do you have to wear a skirt at your school?
Do we have to buy the tickets before we get on the bus?
Do they have to pay to use the swimming pool?
Do you have to work on Christmas Day?
Do I have to show my passport at the hotel?
Do we have to finish the whole book by Monday?
Does your brother have to share a room with you?
Does she have to take a test to join the club?
Does the dog have to stay outside at night?
