Does your dad have to travel a lot for his job?
Does Anna have to leave before the end of the party?
Does the parcel have to go by air?
What do you have to wear for the job interview?
Which bus do we have to take to the beach?
What time does your sister have to be home?
Where do I have to sign?
How long do you have to stay in hospital?
Why does he have to go so early?
How many books do we have to read this term?
For the drawing class, have you got to bring a pencil?
Have we got to wear our football boots for the photo?
Has she got to work this evening?
Have I got to bring a packed lunch on the trip?
Has your mum got to drive you to the station?
What have we got to do for homework?
Did you have to wait long at the doctor's?
Did she have to pay for the broken window?
What did you have to do in the exam?
Did they have to walk all the way home?
How early did you have to get up for the flight?

examples.heading: ① Do + 主詞 + have to + 原形動詞？

items.en: I've never been to a summer camp. Do I have to bring my own sleeping bag?
items.zh: 我從來沒去過夏令營。我必須自己帶睡袋嗎？

items.en: Do you have to wear a skirt at your school?
items.zh: 你們學校必須穿裙子嗎？

items.en: Do we have to buy the tickets before we get on the bus?
items.zh: 我們必須上公車前買票嗎？

items.en: Do they have to pay to use the swimming pool?
items.zh: 他們用游泳池必須付錢嗎？

items.en: Do you have to work on Christmas Day?
items.zh: 你聖誕節當天必須工作嗎？

items.en: Do I have to show my passport at the hotel?
items.zh: 我在飯店必須出示護照嗎？

items.en: Do we have to finish the whole book by Monday?
items.zh: 我們必須在星期一前讀完整本書嗎？

examples.heading: ② Does + 主詞 + have to + 原形動詞？

items.en: Does your brother have to share a room with you?
items.zh: 你弟弟必須跟你住同一個房間嗎？

items.en: Does she have to take a test to join the club?
items.zh: 她必須考試才能加入社團嗎？

items.en: Does the dog have to stay outside at night?
items.zh: 那隻狗晚上必須待在外面嗎？

items.en: Does your dad have to travel a lot for his job?
items.zh: 你爸爸工作必須常常出差嗎？

items.en: Does Anna have to leave before the end of the party?
items.zh: 安娜必須在派對結束前離開嗎？

items.en: Does the parcel have to go by air?
items.zh: 這個包裹必須用空運寄嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 疑問詞 + do / does + 主詞 + have to + 原形動詞？

items.en: What do you have to wear for the job interview?
items.zh: 面試你必須穿什麼？

items.en: Which bus do we have to take to the beach?
items.zh: 去海邊我們必須搭哪一班公車？

items.en: What time does your sister have to be home?
items.zh: 你妹妹必須幾點回家？

items.en: Where do I have to sign?
items.zh: 我必須簽在哪裡？

items.en: How long do you have to stay in hospital?
items.zh: 你必須住院多久？

items.en: Why does he have to go so early?
items.zh: 他為什麼必須這麼早走？

items.en: How many books do we have to read this term?
items.zh: 這學期我們必須讀幾本書？

examples.heading: ④ Have / Has + 主詞 + got to + 原形動詞？

items.en: For the drawing class, have you got to bring a pencil?
items.zh: 上畫畫課，你必須帶鉛筆嗎？

items.en: Have we got to wear our football boots for the photo?
items.zh: 拍照的時候我們必須穿足球鞋嗎？

items.en: Has she got to work this evening?
items.zh: 她今天傍晚必須工作嗎？

items.en: Have I got to bring a packed lunch on the trip?
items.zh: 去校外教學我必須帶便當嗎？

items.en: Has your mum got to drive you to the station?
items.zh: 你媽媽必須開車載你去車站嗎？

items.en: What have we got to do for homework?
items.zh: 我們的功課必須做什麼？

examples.heading: ⑤ Did + 主詞 + have to + 原形動詞？：問過去

items.en: Did you have to wait long at the doctor's?
items.zh: 你在診所必須等很久嗎？

items.en: Did she have to pay for the broken window?
items.zh: 她必須賠那扇破掉的窗戶嗎？

items.en: What did you have to do in the exam?
items.zh: 考試的時候你必須做什麼？

items.en: Did they have to walk all the way home?
items.zh: 他們必須一路走回家嗎？

items.en: How early did you have to get up for the flight?
items.zh: 為了搭飛機，你必須多早起床？

title: Could we meet on Friday afternoon?
translation: 我們可以星期五下午見面嗎？
name: could 的疑問句
sentences: Could I have a cup of tea?
Could I keep this drawing?
Could I talk to you for a minute?
Could I come to your house after school?
Could I sit by the window?
Could you help me?
Could you carry this bag for me?
Could you write the word on the board?
Could you show me your new phone?
Could you meet me at the station?
Could we meet on Friday morning instead?
Could we go to the zoo on Sunday?
Could we have pizza tonight?
Could we sit together?
Could we talk about this later?
Could she come with us?
Could he play the guitar when he was young?
Could they hear us from the garden?
Could your sister give me a lift?
Could the children stay up late tonight?
Where could we park?
What could I bring to the party?
When could you start?
How could I get to the airport?
Who could help me with this?
Which bus could I take to the beach?
Could you swim when you were five? — No, I couldn't.
Could I open the window? — Yes, of course.
Could you read the sign? — Yes, I could.
Could we leave early today? — Sorry, you can't.

examples.heading: ① Could I + 原形動詞？

items.en: Could I have a cup of tea?
items.zh: 我可以喝杯茶嗎？

items.en: Could I keep this drawing?
items.zh: 這張畫我可以留著嗎？

items.en: Could I talk to you for a minute?
items.zh: 我可以跟你談一下嗎？

items.en: Could I come to your house after school?
items.zh: 我放學後可以去你家嗎？

items.en: Could I sit by the window?
items.zh: 我可以坐窗邊嗎？

examples.heading: ② Could you + 原形動詞？

items.en: Could you help me?
items.zh: 你可以幫我嗎？

items.en: Could you carry this bag for me?
items.zh: 你可以幫我提這個袋子嗎？

items.en: Could you write the word on the board?
items.zh: 你可以把那個字寫在白板上嗎？

items.en: Could you show me your new phone?
items.zh: 你可以給我看看你的新手機嗎？

items.en: Could you meet me at the station?
items.zh: 你可以來車站接我嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Could we + 原形動詞？

items.en: Could we meet on Friday morning instead?
items.zh: 我們可以改成星期五早上見面嗎？

items.en: Could we go to the zoo on Sunday?
items.zh: 我們星期天可以去動物園嗎？

items.en: Could we have pizza tonight?
items.zh: 我們今晚可以吃披薩嗎？

items.en: Could we sit together?
items.zh: 我們可以坐在一起嗎？

items.en: Could we talk about this later?
items.zh: 我們可以晚一點再談這件事嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Could + he / she / they + 原形動詞？

items.en: Could she come with us?
items.zh: 她可以跟我們一起去嗎？

items.en: Could he play the guitar when he was young?
items.zh: 他年輕的時候會彈吉他嗎？

items.en: Could they hear us from the garden?
items.zh: 他們在花園裡聽得到我們嗎？

items.en: Could your sister give me a lift?
items.zh: 你姊姊可以載我一程嗎？

items.en: Could the children stay up late tonight?
items.zh: 孩子們今晚可以晚點睡嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問詞 + could + 主詞 + 原形動詞？

items.en: Where could we park?
items.zh: 我們可以把車停在哪裡？

items.en: What could I bring to the party?
items.zh: 我可以帶什麼去派對？

items.en: When could you start?
items.zh: 你什麼時候可以開始？

items.en: How could I get to the airport?
items.zh: 我要怎麼去機場？

items.en: Who could help me with this?
items.zh: 誰可以幫我處理這件事？

items.en: Which bus could I take to the beach?
items.zh: 我可以搭哪一班公車去海邊？

examples.heading: ⑥ Could ...? 和簡答

items.en: Could you swim when you were five? — No, I couldn't.
items.zh: 你五歲的時候會游泳嗎？不會。

items.en: Could I open the window? — Yes, of course.
items.zh: 我可以開窗嗎？當然可以。

items.en: Could you read the sign? — Yes, I could.
items.zh: 你看得清那個標誌嗎？看得清。

items.en: Could we leave early today? — Sorry, you can't.
items.zh: 我們今天可以早點走嗎？抱歉，不行。

title: May I give you a short presentation on 17th December?
translation: 我可以問你一下我住宿的事嗎？
name: may I 開頭的疑問句
sentences: May I arrange a meeting with your sales team next month?
May I call you next week to discuss the details?
May I send you a copy of our new catalogue?
May I visit your office on Monday morning?
May I introduce myself? My name is Anna Clark.
May I make a suggestion about the timetable?
May I change my booking to the following week?
I'm starting the course in September. May I ask you about my accommodation?
May I ask you about the parking at the hotel?
May I ask you about the job you advertised?
May I ask you about the cost of the trip?
May I ask you about your experience in sales?
May I ask you about the meals on the course?
We've ordered from you for many years. May I ask you if our company will receive the usual ten per cent discount?
May I ask if there's a lift in the building?
May I ask whether breakfast is included?
May I ask if you have any rooms free in July?
May I ask you whether the tickets can be changed?
May I ask if students get a cheaper price?
May I ask when the course starts?
May I ask how long the delivery will take?
May I ask who is in charge of the project?
May I ask what time the museum closes?
May I ask why my order hasn't arrived yet?
May I ask where I can leave my luggage?
Good morning. May I speak to Mr Davis, please?

May I see your passport and the letter from your school?
May I have a receipt for the payment?
May I leave a message for the manager?
May I have a copy of the contract before I sign?

examples.heading: ① May I + 原形動詞：正式的請求

items.en: May I arrange a meeting with your sales team next month?
items.zh: 我可以安排下個月跟貴公司的業務團隊開會嗎？

items.en: May I call you next week to discuss the details?
items.zh: 我可以下星期打電話給您討論細節嗎？

items.en: May I send you a copy of our new catalogue?
items.zh: 我可以寄一份我們的新目錄給您嗎？

items.en: May I visit your office on Monday morning?
items.zh: 我可以星期一早上去您的辦公室拜訪嗎？

items.en: May I introduce myself? My name is Anna Clark.
items.zh: 我可以自我介紹嗎？我叫安娜．克拉克。

items.en: May I make a suggestion about the timetable?
items.zh: 我可以對時間表提一個建議嗎？

items.en: May I change my booking to the following week?
items.zh: 我可以把預約改到下一個星期嗎？

examples.heading: ② May I ask you about + 名詞

items.en: I'm starting the course in September. May I ask you about my accommodation?
items.zh: 我九月要開始上課。我可以請問您住宿的事嗎？

items.en: May I ask you about the parking at the hotel?
items.zh: 我可以請問您飯店停車的事嗎？

items.en: May I ask you about the job you advertised?
items.zh: 我可以請問您刊登的那份工作嗎？

items.en: May I ask you about the cost of the trip?
items.zh: 我可以請問您這趟旅行的費用嗎？

items.en: May I ask you about your experience in sales?
items.zh: 我可以請問您在銷售方面的經驗嗎？

items.en: May I ask you about the meals on the course?
items.zh: 我可以請問您課程期間的餐點嗎？

examples.heading: ③ May I ask (you) if / whether + 子句

items.en: We've ordered from you for many years. May I ask you if our company will receive the usual ten per cent discount?
items.zh: 我們跟貴公司訂貨很多年了。請問我們公司還會拿到平常的九折優惠嗎？

items.en: May I ask if there's a lift in the building?
items.zh: 請問大樓裡有電梯嗎？

items.en: May I ask whether breakfast is included?
items.zh: 請問有包含早餐嗎？

items.en: May I ask if you have any rooms free in July?
items.zh: 請問七月有空房嗎？

items.en: May I ask you whether the tickets can be changed?
items.zh: 請問門票可以更改嗎？（被動）

items.en: May I ask if students get a cheaper price?
items.zh: 請問學生有比較便宜的價錢嗎？

examples.heading: ④ May I ask + 疑問詞 + 子句

items.en: May I ask when the course starts?
items.zh: 請問課程什麼時候開始？

items.en: May I ask how long the delivery will take?
items.zh: 請問送貨要多久？

items.en: May I ask who is in charge of the project?
items.zh: 請問誰負責這個專案？

items.en: May I ask what time the museum closes?
items.zh: 請問博物館幾點關門？

items.en: May I ask why my order hasn't arrived yet?
items.zh: 請問為什麼我的訂單還沒到？

items.en: May I ask where I can leave my luggage?
items.zh: 請問我可以把行李放在哪裡？

examples.heading: ⑤ May I + have / see / speak to：電話和櫃台

items.en: Good morning. May I speak to Mr Davis, please?
items.zh: 早安。請問我可以找戴維斯先生嗎？

items.en: May I have your name and the number of your booking, please?
items.zh: 請問您的大名和訂位編號是？

items.en: May I see your passport and the letter from your school?
items.zh: 我可以看一下您的護照和學校的信嗎？

items.en: May I have a receipt for the payment?
items.zh: 我可以拿一張付款的收據嗎？

items.en: May I leave a message for the manager?
items.zh: 我可以留言給經理嗎？

items.en: May I have a copy of the contract before I sign?
items.zh: 簽約前我可以拿一份合約影本嗎？

title: Might it not be a good idea to change the travel company next time?
translation: 你們換一家合作的旅行社，會不會比較好呢？
name: might 的疑問句
sentences: Might it not be safer to travel in a group?
Might it not be better to wait until the spring?
Might it not be cheaper to go by train?
Might it not be wise to ask a lawyer first?
Might it not be easier to meet online?
Might it not be fairer to let everyone vote?
Is it possible that your company sent me the wrong bill, or might it be the bill for the last person who lived in my house?
Was the parcel lost, or might it be at the wrong address?
Is the machine broken, or might it be the plug?
Did I misunderstand, or might there be a mistake in the timetable?
Is the shop closed, or might it have moved?
Was it a mistake, or might someone have changed the figures?
Might the delay have been caused by the weather?
Might there be another way to solve the problem?
Might the price go down before Christmas?
Might the meeting be moved to next week?
Might the hotel have a quieter room for us?
Might the new rules affect our business?
Might I ask how long you have worked for the company?
Might I suggest that the interview takes place in the afternoon instead?
Might I have a few more days to finish the report?
Might I see the room before I pay?
Might I make a small comment on your plan?
Might I borrow your notes from yesterday's lecture?
Might the children not enjoy a day at the farm more?
Might you not regret it later?
Might we not save money by buying in bulk?
Might they not prefer a quieter hotel?
Might the staff not work better with more breaks?
Might a short holiday not help you relax?
Might the students not learn more outside the classroom?

examples.heading: ① Might it not be + 名詞或形容詞？：委婉的建議

items.en: Might it not be safer to travel in a group?
items.zh: 結伴旅行難道不是比較安全嗎？

items.en: Might it not be better to wait until the spring?
items.zh: 等到春天難道不是比較好嗎？

items.en: Might it not be cheaper to go by train?
items.zh: 搭火車難道不是比較便宜嗎？

items.en: Might it not be wise to ask a lawyer first?
items.zh: 先問律師難道不是比較明智嗎？

items.en: Might it not be easier to meet online?
items.zh: 在網路上開會難道不是比較方便嗎？

items.en: Might it not be fairer to let everyone vote?
items.zh: 讓每個人都投票難道不是比較公平嗎？

examples.heading: ② …, or might it be + 名詞？：列出另一個可能

items.en: Is it possible that your company sent me the wrong bill, or might it be the bill for the last person who lived in my house?
items.zh: 有沒有可能是貴公司寄錯帳單給我，還是那可能是上一個住在我家的人的帳單？

items.en: Was the parcel lost, or might it be at the wrong address?
items.zh: 包裹是不是遺失了，還是可能寄到錯的地址？

items.en: Is the machine broken, or might it be the plug?
items.zh: 是機器壞了，還是可能是插頭的問題？

items.en: Did I misunderstand, or might there be a mistake in the timetable?
items.zh: 是我誤會了，還是時刻表可能有錯？

items.en: Is the shop closed, or might it have moved?
items.zh: 那家店是關了，還是可能搬家了？

items.en: Was it a mistake, or might someone have changed the figures?
items.zh: 這是個錯誤，還是可能有人改了數字？

examples.heading: ③ Might + 主詞 + 原形動詞？：正式地問可能性

items.en: Might the delay have been caused by the weather?
items.zh: 延誤有沒有可能是天氣造成的？（被動）

items.en: Might there be another way to solve the problem?
items.zh: 有沒有可能有另一個方法解決這個問題？

items.en: Might the price go down before Christmas?
items.zh: 價格有沒有可能在聖誕節前下降？

items.en: Might the meeting be moved to next week?
items.zh: 會議有沒有可能改到下星期？（被動）

items.en: Might the hotel have a quieter room for us?
items.zh: 飯店有沒有可能給我們一間安靜一點的房間？

items.en: Might the new rules affect our business?
items.zh: 新規定有沒有可能影響我們的生意？

examples.heading: ④ Might I + 原形動詞？：很正式的請求

items.en: Might I ask how long you have worked for the company?
items.zh: 我可以請問您在公司工作多久了嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest that the interview takes place in the afternoon instead?
items.zh: 我可以建議面試改在下午進行嗎？

items.en: Might I have a few more days to finish the report?
items.zh: 我可以多幾天時間完成報告嗎？

items.en: Might I see the room before I pay?
items.zh: 我付錢之前可以先看房間嗎？

items.en: Might I make a small comment on your plan?
items.zh: 我可以對您的計畫提一點小意見嗎？

items.en: Might I borrow your notes from yesterday's lecture?
items.zh: 我可以借您昨天上課的筆記嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Might + 主詞 + not + 原形動詞？：提出另一種看法

items.en: Might the children not enjoy a day at the farm more?
items.zh: 孩子們難道不會比較喜歡在農場玩一天嗎？

items.en: Might you not regret it later?
items.zh: 你以後難道不會後悔嗎？

items.en: Might we not save money by buying in bulk?
items.zh: 我們大量購買難道不能省錢嗎？

items.en: Might they not prefer a quieter hotel?
items.zh: 他們難道不會比較喜歡安靜一點的飯店嗎？

items.en: Might the staff not work better with more breaks?
items.zh: 員工休息多一點，難道不會工作得比較好嗎？

items.en: Might a short holiday not help you relax?
items.zh: 短短的假期難道不能幫你放鬆嗎？

items.en: Might the students not learn more outside the classroom?
items.zh: 學生在教室外面難道不會學到更多嗎？

title: How much money must I bring with me?
translation: 我得帶多少錢去？
name: must 的疑問句
sentences: Finally, how much money must I bring with me on the course?
Thank you for the plane ticket. What time must I be at the airport?
I'd like to apply for the summer job at your hotel. Which form must I fill in?
I'd like to book the room for the first week of July. When must I send the money?
I'm driving from France to Switzerland next week. What documents must I show at the border?
I'm interested in the job at your café. How many hours must I work each week?
I'm ill and can't travel. Is it possible to use the prize next year, or must I cancel my trip to India?
I'd like to buy two tickets for the show. Can I pay by card, or must I pay in cash?
I don't eat meat or fish. Can I bring my own food, or must I eat in the hotel?
I'm afraid of lifts. Can I choose my room, or must I take the one you give me?
I live two hours from your school. Is the course online, or must I come to the school?
I've finished the application. Can I send the form by email, or must I post it?
I'm staying at your hostel in May. Must I bring my own towels, or do you provide them?
I'd like to visit the castle on Saturday. Must I book in advance?
I'm joining the camping trip in August. Must I bring a sleeping bag, or are there beds?
The language course costs eight hundred pounds. Must I pay the whole price now?
I'm a university student. Must I show my student card to get the discount?
I failed the driving test by two points. Must I take the whole test again?
The party has only just started. Must we leave so early?
It's midnight and the baby is asleep. Must you play your music so loud?
Our flat is tiny. Must we invite all your cousins to the dinner?
The film started ten minutes ago. Must you always be late?
I'm so tired, and the report is long. Must we finish it today?
We're having dinner together. Must you check your phone every five minutes?
I only asked about your day. Why must you always argue with me?
I was late for work again today. Why must the trains be late every morning?
Ben and Sara never help in the kitchen. Why must I do all the washing-up?
The forest is full of birds and deer. Why must they build a road through it?
I planned a picnic for Saturday, and it's raining again. Why must it rain every weekend?
I nearly fell over again. Why must you leave your shoes in the hall?
My appointment was at ten, and it's now eleven. Why must we wait so long at the doctor's?

examples.heading: ① 疑問詞 + must I + 原形動詞？：問規定

items.en: Finally, how much money must I bring with me on the course?
items.zh: 最後，上課期間我必須帶多少錢？

items.en: Thank you for the plane ticket. What time must I be at the airport?
items.zh: 謝謝你們的機票。我必須幾點到機場？

items.en: I'd like to apply for the summer job at your hotel. Which form must I fill in?
items.zh: 我想應徵你們飯店的暑期工作。我必須填哪一張表格？

items.en: I'd like to book the room for the first week of July. When must I send the money?
items.zh: 我想訂七月第一週的房間。我必須什麼時候匯錢？

items.en: I'm driving from France to Switzerland next week. What documents must I show at the border?
items.zh: 我下星期要從法國開車去瑞士。在邊境我必須出示什麼證件？

items.en: I'm interested in the job at your café. How many hours must I work each week?
items.zh: 我對你們咖啡店的工作有興趣。我每個星期必須工作幾個小時？

examples.heading: ② …, or must I + 原形動詞？：問另一個選擇

items.en: I'm ill and can't travel. Is it possible to use the prize next year, or must I cancel my trip to India?
items.zh: 我生病了，沒辦法旅行。獎品可以明年用嗎，還是我必須取消去印度的旅行？

items.en: I'd like to buy two tickets for the show. Can I pay by card, or must I pay in cash?
items.zh: 我想買兩張表演的票。我可以刷卡嗎，還是我必須付現金？

items.en: I don't eat meat or fish. Can I bring my own food, or must I eat in the hotel?
items.zh: 我不吃肉也不吃魚。我可以自己帶食物嗎，還是我必須在飯店吃？

items.en: I'm afraid of lifts. Can I choose my room, or must I take the one you give me?
items.zh: 我很怕搭電梯。我可以選房間嗎，還是我必須住你們給我的那間？

items.en: I live two hours from your school. Is the course online, or must I come to the school?
items.zh: 我住的地方離你們學校兩個小時。這門課是線上的嗎，還是我必須去學校？

items.en: I've finished the application. Can I send the form by email, or must I post it?
items.zh: 我填好申請表了。我可以用電子郵件寄表格嗎，還是我必須郵寄？

examples.heading: ③ Must I + 原形動詞？：問是不是必須

items.en: I'm staying at your hostel in May. Must I bring my own towels, or do you provide them?
items.zh: 我五月要住你們的青年旅館。我必須自己帶毛巾嗎，還是你們會提供？

items.en: I'd like to visit the castle on Saturday. Must I book in advance?
items.zh: 我想星期六去參觀城堡。我必須事先預約嗎？

items.en: I'm joining the camping trip in August. Must I bring a sleeping bag, or are there beds?
items.zh: 我八月要參加露營。我必須帶睡袋嗎，還是那裡有床？

items.en: The language course costs eight hundred pounds. Must I pay the whole price now?
items.zh: 語言課程要八百英鎊。我現在必須付全額嗎？

items.en: I'm a university student. Must I show my student card to get the discount?
items.zh: 我是大學生。我必須出示學生證才能拿到折扣嗎？

items.en: I failed the driving test by two points. Must I take the whole test again?
items.zh: 我差兩分沒通過駕照考試。我必須整個重考嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Must we / you + 原形動詞？

items.en: The party has only just started. Must we leave so early?
items.zh: 派對才剛開始。我們一定要這麼早走嗎？

items.en: It's midnight and the baby is asleep. Must you play your music so loud?
items.zh: 現在半夜了，寶寶在睡覺。你一定要把音樂放這麼大聲嗎？

items.en: Our flat is tiny. Must we invite all your cousins to the dinner?
items.zh: 我們的公寓很小。晚餐一定要邀請你所有的表親嗎？

items.en: The film started ten minutes ago. Must you always be late?
items.zh: 電影十分鐘前就開始了。你一定要每次都遲到嗎？

items.en: I'm so tired, and the report is long. Must we finish it today?
items.zh: 我好累，報告又很長。我們一定要今天做完嗎？

items.en: We're having dinner together. Must you check your phone every five minutes?
items.zh: 我們在一起吃晚餐。你一定要每五分鐘就看一次手機嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Why must + 主詞 + 原形動詞？：表示不滿

items.en: I only asked about your day. Why must you always argue with me?
items.zh: 我只是問你今天過得怎樣。你為什麼總是要跟我吵？

items.en: I was late for work again today. Why must the trains be late every morning?
items.zh: 我今天上班又遲到了。為什麼火車每天早上都要誤點？

items.en: Ben and Sara never help in the kitchen. Why must I do all the washing-up?
items.zh: Ben 和 Sara 從來不幫忙廚房的事。為什麼所有的碗都要我洗？

items.en: The forest is full of birds and deer. Why must they build a road through it?
items.zh: 森林裡都是鳥和鹿。為什麼他們一定要在那裡蓋路？

items.en: I planned a picnic for Saturday, and it's raining again. Why must it rain every weekend?
items.zh: 我計畫星期六去野餐，結果又下雨了。為什麼每個週末都要下雨？

items.en: I nearly fell over again. Why must you leave your shoes in the hall?
items.zh: 我又差點跌倒了。你為什麼一定要把鞋子放在走廊？

items.en: My appointment was at ten, and it's now eleven. Why must we wait so long at the doctor's?
items.zh: 我約的是十點，現在已經十一點了。我們在診所為什麼要等這麼久？

title: Need I say more?
translation: 還需要我多說嗎？
name: need 開頭的疑問句
sentences: The floors are dirty, the showers are cold and the bins are always full. Need I say more?
My review of the restaurant is short. The food was cold and the waiter was rude. Need I say more?
Why do I love this bike? It's cheap, it's fast and it never breaks. Need I say more?
Come to Crete with us this summer. Sun, sea and great food. Need I say more?
Dear Sir, I am writing about the airport bus. It was an hour late and then it broke down. Need I say more?
You ask why I want a new assistant. He's late every day and never does his work. Need I say more?
"Do you want to come to the beach?" "Need you ask?"
"Would you like some chocolate cake?" "Need you ask?"
"Are you coming to my party?" "Need you ask? Of course!"
"You've been in Canada for a year. Do you miss your family?" "Need you ask?"
"Shall we order pizza?" "Need you ask?"
"Are you tired after the marathon?" "Need you ask?"
Thank you for inviting me for an interview. Need I bring my passport with me?
I sent you the application form last week. Need I fill it in again?
I've just joined your gym. Need I show my membership card every time I come?
The course costs six hundred pounds. Need I pay the whole amount today?
I live two hours from your office. Need I come in person to sign the papers?
I missed two lessons because of the flu. Need I explain why I was absent?
The trip to Rome is in term time. Need we take the children out of school for it?
Dad would only worry. Need he know about this?
Mia is only a part-time worker. Need she come to every meeting?
We broke the window by accident and paid for it. Need we tell the others?
The builders have worked since seven. Need they finish the wall tonight?
The wedding will cost thirty thousand pounds. Need we really spend so much?
The forecast says light showers in the afternoon. Need we worry about a little rain?
Need you shout? I'm right here.
Need I remind you that the rent is due tomorrow?
We talked about the holiday for two hours last night. Need we discuss it again?
He only brought the wrong drink. Need you be so rude to the waiter?
Your report still isn't on my desk. Need I point out that the deadline was yesterday?
We only have two things to decide. Need the meeting last three hours?

examples.heading: ① Need I say more?：問題已經很清楚

items.en: The floors are dirty, the showers are cold and the bins are always full. Need I say more?
items.zh: 地板很髒，淋浴是冷水，垃圾桶總是滿的。我還需要多說嗎？

items.en: My review of the restaurant is short. The food was cold and the waiter was rude. Need I say more?
items.zh: 我對那家餐廳的評論很短。食物是冷的，服務生很沒禮貌。我還需要多說嗎？

items.en: Why do I love this bike? It's cheap, it's fast and it never breaks. Need I say more?
items.zh: 我為什麼愛這台腳踏車？它很便宜，很快，而且從來不壞。我還需要多說嗎？

items.en: Come to Crete with us this summer. Sun, sea and great food. Need I say more?
items.zh: 今年夏天跟我們去克里特島吧。陽光、海洋和美食。我還需要多說嗎？

items.en: Dear Sir, I am writing about the airport bus. It was an hour late and then it broke down. Need I say more?
items.zh: 先生您好，我寫信是為了機場巴士的事。它晚了一個小時，然後還拋錨。我還需要多說嗎？

items.en: You ask why I want a new assistant. He's late every day and never does his work. Need I say more?
items.zh: 你問我為什麼要換助理。他每天遲到，從來不做事。我還需要多說嗎？

examples.heading: ② Need you ask?：答案很明顯

items.en: "Do you want to come to the beach?" "Need you ask?"
items.zh: 你想去海灘嗎？你還需要問嗎？

items.en: "Would you like some chocolate cake?" "Need you ask?"
items.zh: 你想吃巧克力蛋糕嗎？還用問嗎？

items.en: "Are you coming to my party?" "Need you ask? Of course!"
items.zh: 你會來我的派對嗎？還用問嗎？當然！

items.en: "You've been in Canada for a year. Do you miss your family?" "Need you ask?"
items.zh: 你在加拿大一年了。你想念你的家人嗎？還用問嗎？

items.en: "Shall we order pizza?" "Need you ask?"
items.zh: 我們要叫披薩嗎？還用問嗎？

items.en: "Are you tired after the marathon?" "Need you ask?"
items.zh: 跑完馬拉松你累嗎？還用問嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Need I + 原形動詞？：正式地問是不是必要

items.en: Thank you for inviting me for an interview. Need I bring my passport with me?
items.zh: 謝謝您邀請我面試。我需要帶護照嗎？

items.en: I sent you the application form last week. Need I fill it in again?
items.zh: 我上星期寄了申請表給您。我需要再填一次嗎？

items.en: I've just joined your gym. Need I show my membership card every time I come?
items.zh: 我剛加入你們的健身房。我每次來都需要出示會員卡嗎？

items.en: The course costs six hundred pounds. Need I pay the whole amount today?
items.zh: 課程要六百英鎊。我今天需要付全額嗎？

items.en: I live two hours from your office. Need I come in person to sign the papers?
items.zh: 我住的地方離你們公司兩個小時。我需要親自去簽文件嗎？

items.en: I missed two lessons because of the flu. Need I explain why I was absent?
items.zh: 我因為流感缺了兩堂課。我需要解釋我為什麼缺席嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Need we / he / she + 原形動詞？

items.en: The trip to Rome is in term time. Need we take the children out of school for it?
items.zh: 去羅馬的旅行在學期中。我們需要為了這趟旅行讓孩子們請假嗎？

items.en: Dad would only worry. Need he know about this?
items.zh: 爸爸只會擔心。他需要知道這件事嗎？

items.en: Mia is only a part-time worker. Need she come to every meeting?
items.zh: Mia 只是兼職員工。她需要每次會議都來嗎？

items.en: We broke the window by accident and paid for it. Need we tell the others?
items.zh: 我們不小心打破窗戶，也賠了錢。我們需要告訴其他人嗎？

items.en: The builders have worked since seven. Need they finish the wall tonight?
items.zh: 工人從七點就開始工作了。他們需要今天晚上把牆做完嗎？

items.en: The wedding will cost thirty thousand pounds. Need we really spend so much?
items.zh: 婚禮要花三萬英鎊。我們真的需要花這麼多錢嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Need + 主詞 + 原形動詞 …？：委婉地表示不必

items.en: The forecast says light showers in the afternoon. Need we worry about a little rain?
items.zh: 天氣預報說下午有小陣雨。一點點雨我們需要擔心嗎？

items.en: Need you shout? I'm right here.
items.zh: 你需要大吼嗎？我就在這裡。

items.en: Need I remind you that the rent is due tomorrow?
items.zh: 我需要提醒你明天要交房租嗎？

items.en: We talked about the holiday for two hours last night. Need we discuss it again?
items.zh: 我們昨晚討論假期討論了兩個小時。我們需要再討論一次嗎？

items.en: He only brought the wrong drink. Need you be so rude to the waiter?
items.zh: 他只是送錯飲料。你需要對服務生這麼沒禮貌嗎？

items.en: Your report still isn't on my desk. Need I point out that the deadline was yesterday?
items.zh: 你的報告還沒放在我桌上。我需要指出截止日期是昨天嗎？

items.en: We only have two things to decide. Need the meeting last three hours?
items.zh: 我們只有兩件事要決定。這個會議需要開三個小時嗎？

title: What time shall I come? And what shall I bring to the party?
translation: 我們四點半在我家門口見面好嗎？
name: shall 的疑問句（情態動詞）
sentences: Thanks for the invitation! What time shall I come? And what shall I bring to the party?
It's my first job interview. What shall I wear so that I look serious?
Your train gets in this evening. What time shall I wait for you at the station?
Grandma is coming to stay. What shall I make for her first dinner here?
Your mum will ask where you are. What shall I say to her?
You have an early flight. At what time shall I knock on your door in the morning?
My mum can drive us to the match. Shall we meet at half past four in front of my house?
The film starts at seven. Shall we meet at the station or at the cinema?
It's a lovely day. Shall we cycle to the lake instead of taking the bus?
I haven't seen you for months. Shall we meet for a coffee when you finish work on Friday?
We need plants for the new balcony. Shall we go to the flower market early on Saturday morning?
Shall we meet outside the library at noon and walk to the park together?
There are three cafés near the office. Which one shall we try today?
The taxi comes at six. When shall we start packing the suitcases?
The new bookcase is too tall for the hall. Where shall we put it instead?
The trip is a surprise for Mum. When shall we tell her about it?
We have two weeks off in August. Where shall we spend them?
The last bus has gone. How shall we get back to the hotel?
You look cold. Shall I close the window behind you?
The baby is asleep. Shall I switch off the radio?
It's your birthday on Friday. Shall I book a table at the Italian place?
Your arms are full. Shall I carry the shopping up the stairs for you?
You can't sleep? Shall I make you a cup of warm milk?
I took some great pictures of your dog. Shall I email them to you tonight?
The sun has come out. Let's go for a walk along the river, shall we?
Nobody wants to cook. Let's order a pizza, shall we?
There's a free table by the window. Let's sit there, shall we?
Everyone is here now. Let's begin, shall we?
It's pouring with rain. Let's take a taxi home, shall we?
We've got nothing to do tonight. Let's watch an old film, shall we?
We're completely lost. Let's ask that man for directions, shall we?

examples.heading: ① What / What time + shall I + 原形動詞？：問安排

items.en: Thanks for the invitation! What time shall I come? And what shall I bring to the party?
items.zh: 謝謝你的邀請！我幾點來？我要帶什麼去派對？

items.en: It's my first job interview. What shall I wear so that I look serious?
items.zh: 這是我第一次面試。我要穿什麼才看起來很認真？

items.en: Your train gets in this evening. What time shall I wait for you at the station?
items.zh: 你的火車今天傍晚到。我幾點在車站等你？

items.en: Grandma is coming to stay. What shall I make for her first dinner here?
items.zh: 奶奶要來住。她來的第一頓晚餐我要做什麼？

items.en: Your mum will ask where you are. What shall I say to her?
items.zh: 你媽媽會問你在哪裡。我要跟她說什麼？

items.en: You have an early flight. At what time shall I knock on your door in the morning?
items.zh: 你的班機很早。早上我幾點敲你的門？

examples.heading: ② Shall we + meet / go + …？：約時間和地點

items.en: My mum can drive us to the match. Shall we meet at half past four in front of my house?
items.zh: 我媽媽可以載我們去看比賽。我們四點半在我家門口見好嗎？

items.en: The film starts at seven. Shall we meet at the station or at the cinema?
items.zh: 電影七點開始。我們在車站見還是在電影院見？

items.en: It's a lovely day. Shall we cycle to the lake instead of taking the bus?
items.zh: 天氣很好。我們騎腳踏車去湖邊，不要搭公車，好嗎？

items.en: I haven't seen you for months. Shall we meet for a coffee when you finish work on Friday?
items.zh: 我好幾個月沒見到你了。你星期五下班後，我們見面喝杯咖啡好嗎？

items.en: We need plants for the new balcony. Shall we go to the flower market early on Saturday morning?
items.zh: 我們的新陽台需要植物。我們星期六一大早去花市好嗎？

items.en: Shall we meet outside the library at noon and walk to the park together?
items.zh: 我們中午在圖書館外面見，然後一起走去公園好嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Where / When / How / Which + shall we + 原形動詞？

items.en: There are three cafés near the office. Which one shall we try today?
items.zh: 辦公室附近有三家咖啡館。我們今天試哪一家？

items.en: The taxi comes at six. When shall we start packing the suitcases?
items.zh: 計程車六點來。我們什麼時候開始收行李？

items.en: The new bookcase is too tall for the hall. Where shall we put it instead?
items.zh: 新書櫃放在走廊太高了。我們要改放在哪裡？

items.en: The trip is a surprise for Mum. When shall we tell her about it?
items.zh: 這趟旅行是給媽媽的驚喜。我們什麼時候告訴她？

items.en: We have two weeks off in August. Where shall we spend them?
items.zh: 我們八月有兩個星期假。我們要去哪裡過？

items.en: The last bus has gone. How shall we get back to the hotel?
items.zh: 最後一班公車走了。我們要怎麼回飯店？

examples.heading: ④ Shall I + 原形動詞？：問對方要不要自己做

items.en: You look cold. Shall I close the window behind you?
items.zh: 你看起來很冷。要我關上你後面的窗戶嗎？

items.en: The baby is asleep. Shall I switch off the radio?
items.zh: 寶寶睡著了。要我把收音機關掉嗎？

items.en: It's your birthday on Friday. Shall I book a table at the Italian place?
items.zh: 星期五是你生日。要我在那家義大利餐廳訂位嗎？

items.en: Your arms are full. Shall I carry the shopping up the stairs for you?
items.zh: 你兩手都拿滿了。要我幫你把買的東西提上樓嗎？

items.en: You can't sleep? Shall I make you a cup of warm milk?
items.zh: 你睡不著嗎？要我幫你泡一杯熱牛奶嗎？

items.en: I took some great pictures of your dog. Shall I email them to you tonight?
items.zh: 我拍了你的狗幾張很棒的照片。要我今晚用電子郵件寄給你嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Let's …, shall we?：附加問句

items.en: The sun has come out. Let's go for a walk along the river, shall we?
items.zh: 太陽出來了。我們沿著河邊散步吧，好嗎？

items.en: Nobody wants to cook. Let's order a pizza, shall we?
items.zh: 沒有人想煮飯。我們叫披薩吧，好嗎？

items.en: There's a free table by the window. Let's sit there, shall we?
items.zh: 窗邊有一張空桌子。我們坐那裡吧，好嗎？

items.en: Everyone is here now. Let's begin, shall we?
items.zh: 大家都到了。我們開始吧，好嗎？

items.en: It's pouring with rain. Let's take a taxi home, shall we?
items.zh: 雨下得好大。我們搭計程車回家吧，好嗎？

items.en: We've got nothing to do tonight. Let's watch an old film, shall we?
items.zh: 我們今天晚上沒事做。我們看一部老電影吧，好嗎？

items.en: We're completely lost. Let's ask that man for directions, shall we?
items.zh: 我們完全迷路了。我們問那個男的怎麼走吧，好嗎？

title: It's going to be in São Paulo. Should we go by plane?
translation: 我應該穿特別的衣服嗎？
name: should 的疑問句
sentences: The festival is going to be in São Paulo. Should we go by plane or take the bus?
The film starts at eight. Should we eat before or after it?
It's going to rain all day. Should we cancel the picnic?
The hotel is quite far from the station. Should we book a taxi?
The queue for the castle is huge. Should we come back tomorrow morning?
My brother wants to come too. Should we buy three tickets?
It's a formal dinner. Should I wear special clothes?
The teacher looked angry. Should I say sorry to her after class?
My phone is very old. Should I buy a new one or repair it?
I've got a sore throat. Should I stay at home tomorrow?
My friend hasn't answered my message. Should I call her?
The job pays well but it's far away. Should I take it?
I'm going to an interview tomorrow. What should I say about my last job?
It's Dad's birthday next week. What should we get him?
We're going camping. What should we take with us?
I've burnt the rice. What should I do now?
I don't know anyone at the party. What should I talk about?
My plant has yellow leaves. What should I give it?
We've got three days in Rome. Where should we stay?
The exam is in May. When should I start revising?
I've never cooked fish before. How should I cook it?
The new sofa is very big. Where should we put it?
The party is on Friday. When should we send the invitations?
I want to improve my English. How should I practise?
Do you think I should cut my hair short for the summer?
Do you think we should invite the new neighbours to the barbecue?
Do you think she should tell her parents about the accident?
Do you think I should learn Spanish or Italian first?
Do you think we should paint the kitchen white?
Do you think he should apply for the manager's job?
Do you think they should sell the old car?

examples.heading: ① Should we + 原形動詞？：問交通和安排

items.en: The festival is going to be in São Paulo. Should we go by plane or take the bus?
items.zh: 音樂節在聖保羅。我們應該搭飛機去還是搭巴士？

items.en: The film starts at eight. Should we eat before or after it?
items.zh: 電影八點開始。我們應該在電影之前還是之後吃飯？

items.en: It's going to rain all day. Should we cancel the picnic?
items.zh: 整天都會下雨。我們應該取消野餐嗎？

items.en: The hotel is quite far from the station. Should we book a taxi?
items.zh: 飯店離車站很遠。我們應該叫計程車嗎？

items.en: The queue for the castle is huge. Should we come back tomorrow morning?
items.zh: 排城堡的隊伍好長。我們應該明天早上再來嗎？

items.en: My brother wants to come too. Should we buy three tickets?
items.zh: 我哥哥也想來。我們應該買三張票嗎？

examples.heading: ② Should I + 原形動詞？：問自己應不應該做

items.en: It's a formal dinner. Should I wear special clothes?
items.zh: 那是正式的晚宴。我應該穿特別的衣服嗎？

items.en: The teacher looked angry. Should I say sorry to her after class?
items.zh: 老師看起來很生氣。下課後我應該跟她道歉嗎？

items.en: My phone is very old. Should I buy a new one or repair it?
items.zh: 我的手機很舊了。我應該買新的還是修理？

items.en: I've got a sore throat. Should I stay at home tomorrow?
items.zh: 我喉嚨痛。我明天應該待在家裡嗎？

items.en: My friend hasn't answered my message. Should I call her?
items.zh: 我朋友沒回我的訊息。我應該打給她嗎？

items.en: The job pays well but it's far away. Should I take it?
items.zh: 那份工作薪水很好，可是很遠。我應該接受嗎？

examples.heading: ③ What should I / we + 原形動詞？

items.en: I'm going to an interview tomorrow. What should I say about my last job?
items.zh: 我明天要去面試。關於我上一份工作，我應該說什麼？

items.en: It's Dad's birthday next week. What should we get him?
items.zh: 下星期是爸爸的生日。我們應該送他什麼？

items.en: We're going camping. What should we take with us?
items.zh: 我們要去露營。我們應該帶什麼？

items.en: I've burnt the rice. What should I do now?
items.zh: 我把飯煮焦了。我現在應該怎麼辦？

items.en: I don't know anyone at the party. What should I talk about?
items.zh: 我在派對上一個人都不認識。我應該聊什麼？

items.en: My plant has yellow leaves. What should I give it?
items.zh: 我的植物葉子變黃了。我應該給它什麼？

examples.heading: ④ Where / When / How + should + 主詞 + 原形動詞？

items.en: We've got three days in Rome. Where should we stay?
items.zh: 我們在羅馬有三天。我們應該住哪裡？

items.en: The exam is in May. When should I start revising?
items.zh: 考試在五月。我應該什麼時候開始複習？

items.en: I've never cooked fish before. How should I cook it?
items.zh: 我從來沒煮過魚。我應該怎麼煮？

items.en: The new sofa is very big. Where should we put it?
items.zh: 新沙發很大。我們應該把它放在哪裡？

items.en: The party is on Friday. When should we send the invitations?
items.zh: 派對在星期五。我們應該什麼時候寄邀請函？

items.en: I want to improve my English. How should I practise?
items.zh: 我想讓我的英文進步。我應該怎麼練習？

examples.heading: ⑤ Do you think + 主詞 + should + 原形動詞？：客氣地問意見

items.en: Do you think I should cut my hair short for the summer?
items.zh: 你覺得我夏天應該把頭髮剪短嗎？

items.en: Do you think we should invite the new neighbours to the barbecue?
items.zh: 你覺得我們應該邀請新鄰居來烤肉嗎？

items.en: Do you think she should tell her parents about the accident?
items.zh: 你覺得她應該把那次意外告訴她爸媽嗎？

items.en: Do you think I should learn Spanish or Italian first?
items.zh: 你覺得我應該先學西班牙文還是義大利文？

items.en: Do you think we should paint the kitchen white?
items.zh: 你覺得我們應該把廚房漆成白色嗎？

items.en: Do you think he should apply for the manager's job?
items.zh: 你覺得他應該去應徵經理的工作嗎？

items.en: Do you think they should sell the old car?
items.zh: 你覺得他們應該把那台舊車賣掉嗎？

title: What did we use to eat?
translation: 我們以前都吃些什麼？
name: used to 的疑問句
sentences: Today many families eat frozen food. But what did we use to eat fifty years ago?
What did people use to do in the evenings before television?
What did children use to play with before computers?
What did your grandparents use to do for a living?
What did this building use to be?
What did you use to want to be when you were small?
Did you use to live near the sea when you were a child?
Did you use to play any sports at school?
Did you use to have a pet when you were young?
Did you use to walk to school or take the bus?
Did you use to get on well with your brother?
Did you use to wear a uniform at your school?
Where did you use to go on holiday when you were young?
How did people use to travel before there were cars?
When did you use to do your homework, before or after dinner?
Where did your family use to live before you moved here?
How did you use to get to work before the new road opened?
Where did you use to buy your clothes?
Did this street use to have a market on Saturdays?
Did your father use to work in the factory?
Did the town use to be bigger than it is now?
Did your sister use to sing in the school choir?
Did people use to swim in this river?
Did your teachers use to give you a lot of homework?
Didn't you use to have long hair?
Didn't this café use to be a shoe shop?
Didn't your family use to live next to the church?
Didn't he use to play for our town's football team?
Didn't we use to come here every summer?
Didn't you use to work at the bank on the high street?
Didn't your grandmother use to make her own bread?

examples.heading: ① What did + 主詞 + use to + 原形動詞？：報告和討論

items.en: Today many families eat frozen food. But what did we use to eat fifty years ago?
items.zh: 現在很多家庭吃冷凍食品。可是五十年前我們都吃些什麼？

items.en: What did people use to do in the evenings before television?
items.zh: 有電視以前，人們晚上都做些什麼？

items.en: What did children use to play with before computers?
items.zh: 有電腦以前，孩子們都玩什麼？

items.en: What did your grandparents use to do for a living?
items.zh: 你的祖父母以前做什麼工作？

items.en: What did this building use to be?
items.zh: 這棟建築以前是做什麼的？

items.en: What did you use to want to be when you were small?
items.zh: 你小時候想當什麼？

examples.heading: ② Did you use to + 原形動詞？：問對方的過去

items.en: Did you use to live near the sea when you were a child?
items.zh: 你小時候住在海邊嗎？

items.en: Did you use to play any sports at school?
items.zh: 你以前在學校有玩什麼運動嗎？

items.en: Did you use to have a pet when you were young?
items.zh: 你小時候有養寵物嗎？

items.en: Did you use to walk to school or take the bus?
items.zh: 你以前走路上學還是搭公車？

items.en: Did you use to get on well with your brother?
items.zh: 你以前跟你哥哥處得好嗎？

items.en: Did you use to wear a uniform at your school?
items.zh: 你們學校以前要穿制服嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Where / When / How + did + 主詞 + use to + 原形動詞？

items.en: Where did you use to go on holiday when you were young?
items.zh: 你小時候都去哪裡度假？

items.en: How did people use to travel before there were cars?
items.zh: 有汽車以前，人們怎麼旅行？

items.en: When did you use to do your homework, before or after dinner?
items.zh: 你以前什麼時候寫功課，晚餐前還是晚餐後？

items.en: Where did your family use to live before you moved here?
items.zh: 你們家搬來這裡以前住在哪裡？

items.en: How did you use to get to work before the new road opened?
items.zh: 新路開通以前，你怎麼去上班？

items.en: Where did you use to buy your clothes?
items.zh: 你以前都在哪裡買衣服？

examples.heading: ④ Did + 名詞 + use to + 原形動詞？：問別人或地方的過去

items.en: Did this street use to have a market on Saturdays?
items.zh: 這條街以前星期六有市集嗎？

items.en: Did your father use to work in the factory?
items.zh: 你爸爸以前在那間工廠工作嗎？

items.en: Did the town use to be bigger than it is now?
items.zh: 這個鎮以前比現在大嗎？

items.en: Did your sister use to sing in the school choir?
items.zh: 你姊姊以前在學校合唱團唱歌嗎？

items.en: Did people use to swim in this river?
items.zh: 人們以前會在這條河裡游泳嗎？

items.en: Did your teachers use to give you a lot of homework?
items.zh: 你的老師以前給你很多功課嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Didn't + 主詞 + use to + 原形動詞？：確認過去的事

items.en: Didn't you use to have long hair?
items.zh: 你以前不是留長頭髮嗎？

items.en: Didn't this café use to be a shoe shop?
items.zh: 這家咖啡館以前不是一家鞋店嗎？

items.en: Didn't your family use to live next to the church?
items.zh: 你們家以前不是住在教堂旁邊嗎？

items.en: Didn't he use to play for our town's football team?
items.zh: 他以前不是在我們鎮上的足球隊踢球嗎？

items.en: Didn't we use to come here every summer?
items.zh: 我們以前不是每年夏天都來這裡嗎？

items.en: Didn't you use to work at the bank on the high street?
items.zh: 你以前不是在主要街道上那家銀行工作嗎？

items.en: Didn't your grandmother use to make her own bread?
items.zh: 你奶奶以前不是自己做麵包嗎？

title: I'm happy because I'll see you tomorrow, but what time will you be here?
translation: 你會在家嗎？
name: will 的疑問句（情態動詞）
sentences: My cousin is coming tomorrow. I'm happy because I'll see you soon, but what time will you be here?
What time will your train get in on Saturday?
When will you know the results of your exam?
What time will the party finish? My dad wants to pick me up.
When will you finish painting the kitchen?
What time will the shop open after the holiday?
I'm bringing your parcel round this evening. Will you be at home?
Will you be at the office on Monday morning?
Will you be free for lunch tomorrow?
Will you be warm enough in that thin jacket?
Will you be in town for the festival next week?
Will you be okay on your own tonight?
Will your sister come to the wedding too?
Will the bus stop near the hotel?
Will the weather be good enough for a walk?
Will the teacher give us homework over the holiday?
Will the museum be very busy on Sunday?
Will your parents mind if I stay the night?
There are so many hotels in Rome. Which part of the city will you stay in?
How long will the journey take by car?
How much will the repairs cost?
Where will we meet before the concert?
How long will you be away on holiday?
How many people will come to the barbecue?
"Will you be at the match on Saturday?" "Yes, I will."
"Will it be cold in the mountains?" "Yes, it will."
"Will Tom be there?" "No, he won't. He's ill."
"Will the shop be open late?" "No, it won't."
"Will we need our passports?" "Yes, we will."
"Will your grandparents come for Christmas?" "Yes, they will."
"Will the exam be difficult?" "No, it won't, if you study."

examples.heading: ① What time / When + will you + 原形動詞？：問時間

items.en: My cousin is coming tomorrow. I'm happy because I'll see you soon, but what time will you be here?
items.zh: 我很高興很快就會見到你，可是你幾點會到這裡？

items.en: What time will your train get in on Saturday?
items.zh: 你星期六的火車幾點到？

items.en: When will you know the results of your exam?
items.zh: 你什麼時候會知道考試的結果？

items.en: What time will the party finish? My dad wants to pick me up.
items.zh: 派對幾點會結束？我爸爸要來接我。

items.en: When will you finish painting the kitchen?
items.zh: 你什麼時候會漆完廚房？

items.en: What time will the shop open after the holiday?
items.zh: 放假後那家店幾點會開？

examples.heading: ② Will you be + 地方 / 形容詞？：問以後的狀態

items.en: I'm bringing your parcel round this evening. Will you be at home?
items.zh: 我今天傍晚會把你的包裹拿過去。你會在家嗎？

items.en: Will you be at the office on Monday morning?
items.zh: 你星期一早上會在辦公室嗎？

items.en: Will you be free for lunch tomorrow?
items.zh: 你明天午餐有空嗎？

items.en: Will you be warm enough in that thin jacket?
items.zh: 你穿那件薄外套會夠暖嗎？

items.en: Will you be in town for the festival next week?
items.zh: 下星期的節慶你會在城裡嗎？

items.en: Will you be okay on your own tonight?
items.zh: 你今天晚上一個人會沒事嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Will + 名詞 + 原形動詞？：問別人或事情

items.en: Will your sister come to the wedding too?
items.zh: 你姊姊也會來婚禮嗎？

items.en: Will the bus stop near the hotel?
items.zh: 公車會停在飯店附近嗎？

items.en: Will the weather be good enough for a walk?
items.zh: 天氣會好到可以去散步嗎？

items.en: Will the teacher give us homework over the holiday?
items.zh: 老師放假會給我們功課嗎？

items.en: Will the museum be very busy on Sunday?
items.zh: 博物館星期天會很多人嗎？

items.en: Will your parents mind if I stay the night?
items.zh: 如果我在這裡過夜，你爸媽會介意嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Which / Where / How long / How much + will + 主詞 + 原形動詞？

items.en: There are so many hotels in Rome. Which part of the city will you stay in?
items.zh: 羅馬有好多飯店。你會住在城裡的哪一區？

items.en: How long will the journey take by car?
items.zh: 開車去要多久？

items.en: How much will the repairs cost?
items.zh: 修理要花多少錢？

items.en: Where will we meet before the concert?
items.zh: 演唱會前我們會在哪裡碰面？

items.en: How long will you be away on holiday?
items.zh: 你度假會去多久？

items.en: How many people will come to the barbecue?
items.zh: 會有多少人來烤肉？

examples.heading: ⑤ Will + 主詞 + 原形動詞？："Yes, … will." / "No, … won't."

items.en: "Will you be at the match on Saturday?" "Yes, I will."
items.zh: 你星期六會去看比賽嗎？會，我會去。

items.en: "Will it be cold in the mountains?" "Yes, it will."
items.zh: 山上會冷嗎？會，會冷。

items.en: "Will Tom be there?" "No, he won't. He's ill."
items.zh: 湯姆會在那裡嗎？不會，他不會去。他生病了。

items.en: "Will the shop be open late?" "No, it won't."
items.zh: 那家店會開到很晚嗎？不會。

items.en: "Will we need our passports?" "Yes, we will."
items.zh: 我們會需要護照嗎？會，需要。

items.en: "Will your grandparents come for Christmas?" "Yes, they will."
items.zh: 你的祖父母會來過聖誕節嗎？會，他們會來。

items.en: "Will the exam be difficult?" "No, it won't, if you study."
items.zh: 考試會很難嗎？如果你有讀書，就不會。

title: Would you please do me a favour? Could you go and collect the clothes for me?
translation: 可以告訴我你的想法嗎？
name: would 的疑問句
sentences: I'm stuck abroad for two more days. Would you please do me a favour and collect my dress from the cleaner's?
Would you please close the window? There's a cold wind.
Would you please speak a little more slowly?
Would you please water my plants while I'm on holiday?
Would you please turn your music down after ten?
Would you please sign here and write the date?
I've attached my plan for the party. Would you let me know what you think?
Would you let me know if you can come on Saturday?
Would you let me know when the parcel arrives?
Would you let me know your new address?
Would you let me know how much I owe you?
Would you let me know which day suits you best?
Think of the fun with your friends, playing sports and eating ice cream all day. Wouldn't that be wonderful?
We could have a picnic by the lake. Wouldn't that be lovely?
Imagine living in a house by the sea. Wouldn't that be amazing?
We could all go to the concert together. Wouldn't that be fun?
If the shop gave us a discount, wouldn't that be great?
A whole week without homework. Wouldn't that be nice?
I think a trip to the mountains would be fantastic, wouldn't it?
A party on the roof would be great fun, wouldn't it?
It would be easier to take a taxi, wouldn't it?
It would be cheaper to cook at home, wouldn't it?
A dog would be good company for Grandma, wouldn't it?
It would be nice to see everyone again, wouldn't it?
Would you look after my bag while I go to the toilet?
Would you lend me your umbrella for an hour?
Would you show me how to use this machine?
Would you take our photo in front of the fountain?
Would you carry this box to the car for me?
Would you wait here while I get the tickets?
Would you read my essay before I hand it in?

examples.heading: ① Would you please + 原形動詞？：有禮貌的請求

items.en: I'm stuck abroad for two more days. Would you please do me a favour and collect my dress from the cleaner's?
items.zh: 我在國外還要多待兩天。可以請你幫我一個忙，去乾洗店拿我的洋裝嗎？

items.en: Would you please close the window? There's a cold wind.
items.zh: 可以請你關窗嗎？有冷風。

items.en: Would you please speak a little more slowly?
items.zh: 可以請你說慢一點嗎？

items.en: Would you please water my plants while I'm on holiday?
items.zh: 我度假的時候，可以請你幫我澆花嗎？

items.en: Would you please turn your music down after ten?
items.zh: 十點以後可以請你把音樂關小聲一點嗎？

items.en: Would you please sign here and write the date?
items.zh: 可以請你在這裡簽名，寫上日期嗎？

examples.heading: ② Would you let me know + 名詞 / 子句？：請對方回覆

items.en: I've attached my plan for the party. Would you let me know what you think?
items.zh: 我附上了派對的計畫。可以讓我知道你的想法嗎？

items.en: Would you let me know if you can come on Saturday?
items.zh: 可以讓我知道你星期六能不能來嗎？

items.en: Would you let me know when the parcel arrives?
items.zh: 包裹到的時候可以讓我知道嗎？

items.en: Would you let me know your new address?
items.zh: 可以讓我知道你的新地址嗎？

items.en: Would you let me know how much I owe you?
items.zh: 可以讓我知道我欠你多少錢嗎？

items.en: Would you let me know which day suits you best?
items.zh: 可以讓我知道哪一天你最方便嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Wouldn't that be + 形容詞？：請對方同意

items.en: Think of the fun with your friends, playing sports and eating ice cream all day. Wouldn't that be wonderful?
items.zh: 想想跟你的朋友一起玩，整天運動、吃冰淇淋。那不是很棒嗎？

items.en: We could have a picnic by the lake. Wouldn't that be lovely?
items.zh: 我們可以在湖邊野餐。那不是很好嗎？

items.en: Imagine living in a house by the sea. Wouldn't that be amazing?
items.zh: 想像住在海邊的房子。那不是很棒嗎？

items.en: We could all go to the concert together. Wouldn't that be fun?
items.zh: 我們可以一起去聽演唱會。那不是很好玩嗎？

items.en: If the shop gave us a discount, wouldn't that be great?
items.zh: 如果那家店給我們打折，那不是很好嗎？

items.en: A whole week without homework. Wouldn't that be nice?
items.zh: 整整一個星期沒有功課。那不是很好嗎？

examples.heading: ④ It would be + 形容詞, wouldn't it?：附加問句

items.en: I think a trip to the mountains would be fantastic, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 我想去山上旅行會很棒，對吧？

items.en: A party on the roof would be great fun, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 在屋頂上辦派對會很好玩，對吧？

items.en: It would be easier to take a taxi, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 搭計程車會比較方便，對吧？

items.en: It would be cheaper to cook at home, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 在家煮飯會比較便宜，對吧？

items.en: A dog would be good company for Grandma, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 一隻狗會是奶奶很好的伴，對吧？

items.en: It would be nice to see everyone again, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 再見到大家會很好，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ Would you + 原形動詞？：問對方的意願

items.en: Would you look after my bag while I go to the toilet?
items.zh: 我去廁所的時候，你可以幫我看一下包包嗎？

items.en: Would you lend me your umbrella for an hour?
items.zh: 你可以借我你的雨傘一個小時嗎？

items.en: Would you show me how to use this machine?
items.zh: 你可以教我怎麼用這台機器嗎？

items.en: Would you take our photo in front of the fountain?
items.zh: 你可以幫我們在噴泉前面拍張照嗎？

items.en: Would you carry this box to the car for me?
items.zh: 你可以幫我把這個箱子搬到車上嗎？

items.en: Would you wait here while I get the tickets?
items.zh: 我去拿票的時候，你可以在這裡等嗎？

items.en: Would you read my essay before I hand it in?
items.zh: 我交作文之前，你可以幫我讀一下嗎？

title: Ought we not to learn from the mistakes of the past?
translation: 我們難道不該從過去的錯誤中學習嗎？
name: ought 加主詞加 not to 的疑問句
sentences: The river flooded this area fifty years ago. Ought we not to learn from the mistakes of the past?
Only a few old woods are left in this country. Ought we not to protect the last of our forests?
The storm destroyed two hundred houses on the coast. Ought we not to help the people who have lost their homes?
Thousands of students marched through the city today. Ought we not to listen to what young people are saying?
Our schools have leaking roofs and old books. Ought we not to spend more on schools than on roads?
The new factory would pollute the river for years. Ought we not to think about our children's future?
Many pensioners can't heat their homes this winter. Ought the government not to do more for old people?
The workers only heard about the factory closing on the news. Ought the company not to tell its workers the truth first?
Some countries have plenty of food while others are starving. Ought rich countries not to help poorer ones?
The council has decided to close our park without a meeting. Ought the council not to ask local people first?
Many young people get into debt in their first year of work. Ought schools not to teach children how to manage money?
My father had an operation and nobody told him about the side effects. Ought doctors not to explain the risks to patients?
I saw the man who broke the shop window. Ought I not to tell the police what I saw?
We both said unkind things in the argument. Ought I not to apologise to her first?
The client wants a new deadline from me today. Ought I not to ask my manager before I agree?
My uncle has been in hospital for two weeks. Ought I not to visit him while he's there?
I found a wallet with two hundred pounds in it. Ought I not to return the money?
My editor wants the story by tonight. Ought I not to check the facts before I write the article?
Oughtn't we to leave soon? It's getting dark.
It's Monday morning. Oughtn't you to be at the office by now?
Their train got in at two, and it's now four. Oughtn't they to have arrived by now?
Grandma wants to go back to work next week. Oughtn't she to rest after the operation?
We're going to the lake with Leo. Oughtn't we to tell Mum where we're going?
It's half past nine on a school night. Oughtn't the children to be in bed by now?
If the plan failed before, ought we not to try something new?
If prices keep rising, ought we not to look for a cheaper supplier?
If the bridge is unsafe, ought we not to close it?
If people are unhappy, ought we not to ask them why?
If the climate is changing, ought we not to change our habits?
If nobody uses the old library, ought we not to find a new use for it?
If the children are bored, ought we not to change the lessons?

examples.heading: ① Ought we not to + 原形動詞？：演講和議論文

items.en: The river flooded this area fifty years ago. Ought we not to learn from the mistakes of the past?
items.zh: 這條河五十年前淹過這一區。我們難道不應該從過去的錯誤中學習嗎？

items.en: Only a few old woods are left in this country. Ought we not to protect the last of our forests?
items.zh: 這個國家只剩幾片老樹林了。我們難道不應該保護我們最後的森林嗎？

items.en: The storm destroyed two hundred houses on the coast. Ought we not to help the people who have lost their homes?
items.zh: 暴風雨毀了海邊兩百棟房子。我們難道不應該幫助失去家園的人嗎？

items.en: Thousands of students marched through the city today. Ought we not to listen to what young people are saying?
items.zh: 今天有好幾千名學生在市區遊行。我們難道不應該聽聽年輕人在說什麼嗎？

items.en: Our schools have leaking roofs and old books. Ought we not to spend more on schools than on roads?
items.zh: 我們的學校屋頂漏水，書本又舊。我們難道不應該在學校上比在道路上花更多錢嗎？

items.en: The new factory would pollute the river for years. Ought we not to think about our children's future?
items.zh: 新工廠會污染河流好多年。我們難道不應該想想我們孩子的未來嗎？

examples.heading: ② Ought + 名詞 + not to + 原形動詞？：質疑別人的做法

items.en: Many pensioners can't heat their homes this winter. Ought the government not to do more for old people?
items.zh: 很多領退休金的人這個冬天付不起暖氣。政府難道不應該為老人做更多事嗎？

items.en: The workers only heard about the factory closing on the news. Ought the company not to tell its workers the truth first?
items.zh: 工人是從新聞上才知道工廠要關。公司難道不應該先告訴員工真相嗎？

items.en: Some countries have plenty of food while others are starving. Ought rich countries not to help poorer ones?
items.zh: 有些國家食物很多，有些國家卻在挨餓。富裕的國家難道不應該幫助比較窮的國家嗎？

items.en: The council has decided to close our park without a meeting. Ought the council not to ask local people first?
items.zh: 議會沒開會就決定關閉我們的公園。市議會難道不應該先問當地人嗎？

items.en: Many young people get into debt in their first year of work. Ought schools not to teach children how to manage money?
items.zh: 很多年輕人工作第一年就欠債。學校難道不應該教孩子怎麼管錢嗎？

items.en: My father had an operation and nobody told him about the side effects. Ought doctors not to explain the risks to patients?
items.zh: 我爸爸開了刀，卻沒人告訴他有什麼副作用。醫生難道不應該向病人解釋風險嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Ought I not to + 原形動詞？：很正式地問自己的責任

items.en: I saw the man who broke the shop window. Ought I not to tell the police what I saw?
items.zh: 我看到打破商店櫥窗的人了。我難道不應該把我看到的告訴警察嗎？

items.en: We both said unkind things in the argument. Ought I not to apologise to her first?
items.zh: 我們吵架時都說了難聽的話。我難道不應該先跟她道歉嗎？

items.en: The client wants a new deadline from me today. Ought I not to ask my manager before I agree?
items.zh: 客戶今天要我給新的截止日期。我答應之前，難道不應該先問我的經理嗎？

items.en: My uncle has been in hospital for two weeks. Ought I not to visit him while he's there?
items.zh: 我叔叔住院兩個星期了。他住院的時候，我難道不應該去看他嗎？

items.en: I found a wallet with two hundred pounds in it. Ought I not to return the money?
items.zh: 我撿到一個裝了兩百英鎊的皮夾。我難道不應該把錢還回去嗎？

items.en: My editor wants the story by tonight. Ought I not to check the facts before I write the article?
items.zh: 我的編輯今晚就要稿子。我寫文章之前，難道不應該先查證事實嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Oughtn't + 主詞 + to + 原形動詞？：比較口語

items.en: Oughtn't we to leave soon? It's getting dark.
items.zh: 我們難道不該快點走嗎？天快黑了。

items.en: It's Monday morning. Oughtn't you to be at the office by now?
items.zh: 今天是星期一早上。你現在難道不該在辦公室了嗎？

items.en: Their train got in at two, and it's now four. Oughtn't they to have arrived by now?
items.zh: 他們的火車兩點到站，現在已經四點了。他們現在難道不該已經到了嗎？

items.en: Grandma wants to go back to work next week. Oughtn't she to rest after the operation?
items.zh: 奶奶下星期就想回去上班。她手術後難道不該休息嗎？

items.en: We're going to the lake with Leo. Oughtn't we to tell Mum where we're going?
items.zh: 我們要跟 Leo 去湖邊。我們難道不該告訴媽媽我們要去哪裡嗎？

items.en: It's half past nine on a school night. Oughtn't the children to be in bed by now?
items.zh: 明天要上學，現在已經九點半了。孩子們現在難道不該在床上了嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ If …, ought we not to + 原形動詞？：先說條件，再反問

items.en: If the plan failed before, ought we not to try something new?
items.zh: 如果這個計畫以前失敗過，我們難道不應該試試新的方法嗎？

items.en: If prices keep rising, ought we not to look for a cheaper supplier?
items.zh: 如果價格一直上漲，我們難道不應該找便宜一點的供應商嗎？

items.en: If the bridge is unsafe, ought we not to close it?
items.zh: 如果那座橋不安全，我們難道不應該封閉它嗎？

items.en: If people are unhappy, ought we not to ask them why?
items.zh: 如果大家不快樂，我們難道不應該問問他們為什麼嗎？

items.en: If the climate is changing, ought we not to change our habits?
items.zh: 如果氣候在改變，我們難道不應該改變我們的習慣嗎？

items.en: If nobody uses the old library, ought we not to find a new use for it?
items.zh: 如果沒有人用那間舊圖書館，我們難道不應該為它找新的用途嗎？

items.en: If the children are bored, ought we not to change the lessons?
items.zh: 如果孩子們覺得無聊，我們難道不應該改變課程嗎？

title: I'm going to a concert on Saturday. Would you like to go with me?
translation: Sarah，你今天晚上想打網球嗎？
name: would you like 的疑問句
sentences: I've got two tickets for a concert on Saturday. Would you like to go with me?
I want to watch the new film tonight. Would you like to come with me?
I'm going to the market on Sunday morning. Would you like to come along?
I'm taking the dog to the beach. Would you like to join us?
My family is going camping next month. Would you like to come with us?
I'm going to the new museum on Friday. Would you like to come too?
Sarah, would you like to play tennis this evening?
Tom, would you like to come to my house after school?
Anna, would you like to be in our team for the quiz?
Ben, would you like to help me make the cake?
Lucy, would you like to sit next to me on the bus?
Mark, would you like to borrow my bike this weekend?
You look cold. Would you like a cup of hot chocolate?
Would you like some more cake? There's plenty left.
Would you like a lift to the station?
Would you like a seat? You've been standing for ages.
Would you like some help with your homework?
Would you like a glass of water with your medicine?
Would you like to see the photos from our holiday?
Would you like to try on the blue dress?
Would you like to stay for dinner?
Would you like to leave a message for her?
Would you like to sit by the window?
Would you like to hear my new song?
What would you like to do for your birthday?
Where would you like to go on holiday this year?
When would you like to meet next week?
The café has twenty kinds of tea. Which one would you like to try?
Which film would you like to see tonight?
What would you like to be when you grow up?
Who would you like to invite to the party?

examples.heading: ① Would you like to + 原形動詞 + with me？：邀請一起去

items.en: I've got two tickets for a concert on Saturday. Would you like to go with me?
items.zh: 我有兩張星期六演唱會的票。你想跟我一起去嗎？

items.en: I want to watch the new film tonight. Would you like to come with me?
items.zh: 我今天晚上想看那部新電影。你想跟我一起去嗎？

items.en: I'm going to the market on Sunday morning. Would you like to come along?
items.zh: 我星期天早上要去市場。你想一起來嗎？

items.en: I'm taking the dog to the beach. Would you like to join us?
items.zh: 我要帶狗去海灘。你想跟我們一起去嗎？

items.en: My family is going camping next month. Would you like to come with us?
items.zh: 我們家下個月要去露營。你想跟我們一起去嗎？

items.en: I'm going to the new museum on Friday. Would you like to come too?
items.zh: 我星期五要去新的博物館。你也想一起來嗎？

examples.heading: ② 人名, would you like to + 原形動詞？：邀請一起做

items.en: Sarah, would you like to play tennis this evening?
items.zh: 莎拉，你今天傍晚想打網球嗎？

items.en: Tom, would you like to come to my house after school?
items.zh: 湯姆，你放學後想來我家嗎？

items.en: Anna, would you like to be in our team for the quiz?
items.zh: 安娜，你想加入我們這隊參加問答比賽嗎？

items.en: Ben, would you like to help me make the cake?
items.zh: 班，你想幫我做蛋糕嗎？

items.en: Lucy, would you like to sit next to me on the bus?
items.zh: 露西，你想在巴士上坐我旁邊嗎？

items.en: Mark, would you like to borrow my bike this weekend?
items.zh: 馬克，你這個週末想借我的腳踏車嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Would you like + 名詞？：問對方要不要

items.en: You look cold. Would you like a cup of hot chocolate?
items.zh: 你看起來很冷。你想要一杯熱可可嗎？

items.en: Would you like some more cake? There's plenty left.
items.zh: 你想再吃一些蛋糕嗎？還剩很多。

items.en: Would you like a lift to the station?
items.zh: 你想要我載你去車站嗎？

items.en: Would you like a seat? You've been standing for ages.
items.zh: 你想坐下嗎？你站好久了。

items.en: Would you like some help with your homework?
items.zh: 你寫功課需要幫忙嗎？

items.en: Would you like a glass of water with your medicine?
items.zh: 你吃藥要配一杯水嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Would you like to + 原形動詞？：問對方的意願

items.en: Would you like to see the photos from our holiday?
items.zh: 你想看我們度假的照片嗎？

items.en: Would you like to try on the blue dress?
items.zh: 你想試穿那件藍色洋裝嗎？

items.en: Would you like to stay for dinner?
items.zh: 你想留下來吃晚餐嗎？

items.en: Would you like to leave a message for her?
items.zh: 你想留言給她嗎？

items.en: Would you like to sit by the window?
items.zh: 你想坐在窗邊嗎？

items.en: Would you like to hear my new song?
items.zh: 你想聽我的新歌嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問詞 + would you like to + 原形動詞？

items.en: What would you like to do for your birthday?
items.zh: 你生日想做什麼？

items.en: Where would you like to go on holiday this year?
items.zh: 你今年想去哪裡度假？

items.en: When would you like to meet next week?
items.zh: 你下星期想什麼時候見面？

items.en: The café has twenty kinds of tea. Which one would you like to try?
items.zh: 這家咖啡館有二十種茶。你想試哪一種？

items.en: Which film would you like to see tonight?
items.zh: 你今天晚上想看哪一部電影？

items.en: What would you like to be when you grow up?
items.zh: 你長大想當什麼？

items.en: Who would you like to invite to the party?
items.zh: 你想邀請誰來派對？

title: We should be reading books instead of watching television in our free time.
translation: 空閒時，我們應該看書，而不是看電視。
name: should be 加動詞-ing
sentences: These are the reasons why I believe we should be reading books instead of watching television in our free time.
We should be spending more time outdoors instead of sitting at our computers.
We should be walking to school instead of asking our parents to drive us.
We should be talking to each other at dinner instead of looking at our phones.
We should be growing our own vegetables instead of buying them in plastic.
Young people should be learning practical skills instead of only studying for exams.
It's nearly midnight. You should be sleeping, not playing games!
Your exam is tomorrow. You should be revising now.
It's ten o'clock. You should be sitting at your desk by now.
You should be resting your leg, not walking around the house.
You should be helping your mum in the kitchen.
The bus leaves in five minutes. You should be putting your shoes on.
He has a bad cold. He shouldn't be playing football in the rain.
You shouldn't be using your phone while you're driving.
The children shouldn't be watching that film. It's too scary.
She shouldn't be carrying such heavy bags with her bad back.
They shouldn't be talking during the exam.
You shouldn't be eating sweets before dinner.
You've won the lottery! You should be jumping up and down with joy!
You got the job! You should be dancing in the street!
It's your birthday! You should be smiling, not sitting there looking sad.
Your team won the cup. You should be singing all the way home!
You passed every exam. You should be celebrating tonight!
The sun is shining and it's Friday. We should be having fun!
It's three o'clock. The children should be coming out of school now.
The plumber should be fixing the pipe, not drinking tea.
The waiter should be taking our order by now.
The guards should be watching the door at all times.
The government should be building more homes for young families.
My brother should be studying, but he's asleep on the sofa.
The team should be training harder before the final.

examples.heading: ① we should be + -ing + instead of + -ing：議論文的意見

items.en: These are the reasons why I believe we should be reading books instead of watching television in our free time.
items.zh: 這些就是我認為我們空閒時應該讀書、而不是看電視的理由。

items.en: We should be spending more time outdoors instead of sitting at our computers.
items.zh: 我們應該多花時間在戶外，而不是坐在電腦前。

items.en: We should be walking to school instead of asking our parents to drive us.
items.zh: 我們應該走路上學，而不是叫爸媽開車載我們。

items.en: We should be talking to each other at dinner instead of looking at our phones.
items.zh: 吃晚餐的時候我們應該彼此聊天，而不是看手機。

items.en: We should be growing our own vegetables instead of buying them in plastic.
items.zh: 我們應該自己種蔬菜，而不是買塑膠包裝的。

items.en: Young people should be learning practical skills instead of only studying for exams.
items.zh: 年輕人應該學實用的技能，而不是只為考試讀書。

examples.heading: ② You should be + -ing + now：現在應該正在做

items.en: It's nearly midnight. You should be sleeping, not playing games!
items.zh: 快半夜了。你應該在睡覺，而不是在打電動！

items.en: Your exam is tomorrow. You should be revising now.
items.zh: 你明天要考試。你現在應該在複習。

items.en: It's ten o'clock. You should be sitting at your desk by now.
items.zh: 已經十點了。你現在應該坐在你的座位上了。

items.en: You should be resting your leg, not walking around the house.
items.zh: 你應該讓你的腳休息，不要在家裡走來走去。

items.en: You should be helping your mum in the kitchen.
items.zh: 你應該在廚房幫你媽媽。

items.en: The bus leaves in five minutes. You should be putting your shoes on.
items.zh: 公車五分鐘後開。你應該在穿鞋了。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + shouldn't be + -ing：不應該正在做

items.en: He has a bad cold. He shouldn't be playing football in the rain.
items.zh: 他感冒很嚴重。他不應該在雨中踢足球。

items.en: You shouldn't be using your phone while you're driving.
items.zh: 你開車的時候不應該用手機。

items.en: The children shouldn't be watching that film. It's too scary.
items.zh: 孩子們不應該看那部電影。太可怕了。

items.en: She shouldn't be carrying such heavy bags with her bad back.
items.zh: 她背不好，不應該提那麼重的袋子。

items.en: They shouldn't be talking during the exam.
items.zh: 他們考試的時候不應該說話。

items.en: You shouldn't be eating sweets before dinner.
items.zh: 你晚餐前不應該吃糖果。

examples.heading: ④ You should be + -ing + with joy：開玩笑的誇張說法

items.en: You've won the lottery! You should be jumping up and down with joy!
items.zh: 你中樂透了！你應該高興得跳起來才對！

items.en: You got the job! You should be dancing in the street!
items.zh: 你拿到那份工作了！你應該在街上跳舞才對！

items.en: It's your birthday! You should be smiling, not sitting there looking sad.
items.zh: 今天是你生日！你應該在笑，而不是坐在那裡一臉難過。

items.en: Your team won the cup. You should be singing all the way home!
items.zh: 你們隊贏了獎盃。你應該一路唱歌回家才對！

items.en: You passed every exam. You should be celebrating tonight!
items.zh: 你每一科都考過了。你今天晚上應該在慶祝才對！

items.en: The sun is shining and it's Friday. We should be having fun!
items.zh: 陽光燦爛，又是星期五。我們應該在玩才對！

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + should be + -ing：說別人現在應該在做的事

items.en: It's three o'clock. The children should be coming out of school now.
items.zh: 已經三點了。孩子們現在應該正在放學。

items.en: The plumber should be fixing the pipe, not drinking tea.
items.zh: 水管工人應該在修水管，而不是在喝茶。

items.en: The waiter should be taking our order by now.
items.zh: 服務生現在應該來幫我們點菜了。

items.en: The guards should be watching the door at all times.
items.zh: 警衛應該隨時看著門。

items.en: The government should be building more homes for young families.
items.zh: 政府應該為年輕家庭蓋更多房子。

items.en: My brother should be studying, but he's asleep on the sofa.
items.zh: 我弟弟應該在讀書，可是他在沙發上睡著了。

items.en: The team should be training harder before the final.
items.zh: 決賽前球隊應該更努力訓練。

title: They are unlikely to arrive on Friday.
translation: 他們不太可能星期五到。
name: 主詞加 be 加形容詞加不定詞
sentences: Whenever money is involved, some problems are likely to happen.
The new rules are likely to affect small businesses.
She is likely to be chosen for the national team.
Traffic is likely to be heavy this evening.
House prices are likely to rise again next year.
The match is likely to finish late.
My brother is likely to call while we're out.
These shoes are likely to last for years.
The weather is unlikely to change before the weekend.
He's unlikely to agree with your plan.
The shop is unlikely to have your size.
We're unlikely to finish before midnight.
The government is unlikely to change the law this year.
The old printer is unlikely to work with the new laptop.
She's unlikely to forget your birthday.
We are sure to increase our sales this year.
The film is certain to be a big hit.
You're bound to make a few mistakes at first.
The kids are sure to love the new park.
The roads are bound to be busy on a holiday weekend.
The concert is certain to sell out.
Uncle Dave is sure to tell his fishing stories at dinner.
Something is bound to go wrong.
The fire is likely to have started in the kitchen.
The thief is likely to have left the city by now.
She's unlikely to have finished the book already.
The letter is likely to have arrived this morning.
They're unlikely to have heard the news yet.
He is likely to have missed the last bus.
The guests are unlikely to have noticed the mistake.
Our parcel is likely to have reached the post office.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + likely + to + 原形動詞

items.en: Whenever money is involved, some problems are likely to happen.
items.zh: 只要牽涉到錢，就很可能會出問題。

items.en: The new rules are likely to affect small businesses.
items.zh: 新規定很可能會影響小公司。

items.en: She is likely to be chosen for the national team.
items.zh: 她很可能會被選進國家隊。（被動）

items.en: Traffic is likely to be heavy this evening.
items.zh: 今晚車流量很可能會很大。

items.en: House prices are likely to rise again next year.
items.zh: 明年房價很可能會再漲。

items.en: The match is likely to finish late.
items.zh: 比賽很可能會很晚結束。

items.en: My brother is likely to call while we're out.
items.zh: 我們出門的時候，我哥很可能會打電話來。

items.en: These shoes are likely to last for years.
items.zh: 這雙鞋很可能可以穿好幾年。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + unlikely + to + 原形動詞

items.en: The weather is unlikely to change before the weekend.
items.zh: 週末前天氣不太可能改變。

items.en: He's unlikely to agree with your plan.
items.zh: 他不太可能同意你的計畫。

items.en: The shop is unlikely to have your size.
items.zh: 那家店不太可能有你的尺寸。

items.en: We're unlikely to finish before midnight.
items.zh: 我們不太可能在半夜前做完。

items.en: The government is unlikely to change the law this year.
items.zh: 政府今年不太可能修改法律。

items.en: The old printer is unlikely to work with the new laptop.
items.zh: 舊的印表機不太可能跟新筆電相容。

items.en: She's unlikely to forget your birthday.
items.zh: 她不太可能忘記你的生日。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + sure / certain / bound + to + 原形動詞

items.en: We are sure to increase our sales this year.
items.zh: 我們今年一定會增加銷售量。

items.en: The film is certain to be a big hit.
items.zh: 這部電影一定會大受歡迎。

items.en: You're bound to make a few mistakes at first.
items.zh: 一開始你免不了會犯幾個錯。

items.en: The kids are sure to love the new park.
items.zh: 孩子們一定會喜歡新公園。

items.en: The roads are bound to be busy on a holiday weekend.
items.zh: 連假週末路上免不了會很塞。

items.en: The concert is certain to sell out.
items.zh: 音樂會的票一定會賣完。

items.en: Uncle Dave is sure to tell his fishing stories at dinner.
items.zh: Dave 叔叔晚餐時一定會講他釣魚的故事。

items.en: Something is bound to go wrong.
items.zh: 一定會出點差錯。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + be + likely / unlikely + to have + 過去分詞

items.en: The fire is likely to have started in the kitchen.
items.zh: 火很可能是從廚房燒起來的。

items.en: The thief is likely to have left the city by now.
items.zh: 小偷現在很可能已經離開這個城市了。

items.en: She's unlikely to have finished the book already.
items.zh: 她不太可能已經讀完那本書了。

items.en: The letter is likely to have arrived this morning.
items.zh: 信很可能今天早上已經到了。

items.en: They're unlikely to have heard the news yet.
items.zh: 他們不太可能已經聽說這個消息了。

items.en: He is likely to have missed the last bus.
items.zh: 他很可能已經錯過最後一班公車了。

items.en: The guests are unlikely to have noticed the mistake.
items.zh: 客人不太可能已經注意到那個錯誤。

items.en: Our parcel is likely to have reached the post office.
items.zh: 我們的包裹很可能已經到郵局了。

title: If you should change your mind and prefer to take a taxi, you can call this number.
translation: 萬一出了什麼事，就打當地的緊急電話 112。
name: if 子句中的 should 表示未來可能
sentences: Our shuttle bus is free. If you should change your mind and prefer to take a taxi, you can call 3570 outside the airport.
If you should need anything during the night, please call reception.
If you should lose your key, ask at the front desk.
If you should have any questions, please write to me.
If you should arrive after ten, the side door will be open.
If you should feel unwell on the tour, tell the guide immediately.
You'll be alone in the house this weekend. If something should happen, call 112, the local emergency number.
If anything should go wrong with the car, phone this garage.
If something should happen to me, my sister will look after the dog.
If anything should break, please tell us before you leave.
If something should go wrong during the exam, raise your hand.
If anything should happen to the baby, call the doctor at once.
If the weather should turn bad, we can move the party indoors.
If the train should be late, I'll wait for you at the café.
If the shop should close early, we'll go to the market instead.
If the tickets should sell out, we can watch it online.
If my flight should be cancelled, I'll take the train.
If the speaker should be ill, Mr Lee will give the talk.
If you should see Anna at the party, please give her this card.
If you should meet my brother in London, say hello from me.
If you should hear from Tom, ask him to call me.
If you should find my glasses, put them on my desk.
If you should pass the bakery, could you buy some bread?
If you should speak to the manager, mention my complaint.
If the goods should arrive damaged, we will replace them free of charge.
If you should be unhappy with the course, we will give you your money back.
If the price should go down, we will refund the difference.
If the hotel should be full, we will find you another one nearby.
If the event should be cancelled, all tickets will be refunded.
If your parcel should get lost, we will send another one.
If the machine should stop working, our engineer will come within a day.

examples.heading: ① If you should + 原形動詞, + 祈使句：給客人和顧客的資訊

items.en: Our shuttle bus is free. If you should change your mind and prefer to take a taxi, you can call 3570 outside the airport.
items.zh: 我們的接駁車是免費的。萬一您改變主意，比較想搭計程車，可以在機場外打 3570。

items.en: If you should need anything during the night, please call reception.
items.zh: 萬一您夜裡需要任何東西，請打電話給櫃台。

items.en: If you should lose your key, ask at the front desk.
items.zh: 萬一您弄丟了鑰匙，請到前台詢問。

items.en: If you should have any questions, please write to me.
items.zh: 萬一您有任何問題，請寫信給我。

items.en: If you should arrive after ten, the side door will be open.
items.zh: 萬一您十點以後到，側門會開著。

items.en: If you should feel unwell on the tour, tell the guide immediately.
items.zh: 萬一您在旅途中覺得不舒服，請馬上告訴導遊。

examples.heading: ② If something / anything should happen, + 祈使句：緊急情況

items.en: You'll be alone in the house this weekend. If something should happen, call 112, the local emergency number.
items.zh: 這個週末你會一個人在家。萬一發生什麼事，打 112，這是當地的緊急電話。

items.en: If anything should go wrong with the car, phone this garage.
items.zh: 萬一車子出了什麼問題，打電話給這家修車廠。

items.en: If something should happen to me, my sister will look after the dog.
items.zh: 萬一我出了什麼事，我妹妹會照顧那隻狗。

items.en: If anything should break, please tell us before you leave.
items.zh: 萬一有什麼東西壞了，請在離開前告訴我們。

items.en: If something should go wrong during the exam, raise your hand.
items.zh: 萬一考試時出了什麼問題，請舉手。

items.en: If anything should happen to the baby, call the doctor at once.
items.zh: 萬一寶寶有什麼狀況，馬上打電話給醫生。

examples.heading: ③ If + 主詞 + should + 原形動詞, + 主詞 + can / will：可能的安排
