items.en: If the weather should turn bad, we can move the party indoors.
items.zh: 萬一天氣變壞，我們可以把派對移到室內。

items.en: If the train should be late, I'll wait for you at the café.
items.zh: 萬一火車誤點，我會在咖啡館等你。

items.en: If the shop should close early, we'll go to the market instead.
items.zh: 萬一那家店提早關門，我們就改去市場。

items.en: If the tickets should sell out, we can watch it online.
items.zh: 萬一票賣完了，我們可以在網路上看。

items.en: If my flight should be cancelled, I'll take the train.
items.zh: 萬一我的班機取消，我會搭火車。（被動）

items.en: If the speaker should be ill, Mr Lee will give the talk.
items.zh: 萬一講者生病，李先生會代替他演講。

examples.heading: ④ If you should see / meet + 人, + 祈使句：請對方轉告

items.en: If you should see Anna at the party, please give her this card.
items.zh: 萬一你在派對上見到安娜，請把這張卡片給她。

items.en: If you should meet my brother in London, say hello from me.
items.zh: 萬一你在倫敦遇到我哥哥，幫我跟他打聲招呼。

items.en: If you should hear from Tom, ask him to call me.
items.zh: 萬一你有湯姆的消息，請他打給我。

items.en: If you should find my glasses, put them on my desk.
items.zh: 萬一你找到我的眼鏡，把它們放在我桌上。

items.en: If you should pass the bakery, could you buy some bread?
items.zh: 萬一你經過麵包店，可以買一些麵包嗎？

items.en: If you should speak to the manager, mention my complaint.
items.zh: 萬一你跟經理說話，提一下我的投訴。

examples.heading: ⑤ If + 主詞 + should + 原形動詞, + 主詞 + will：正式的承諾

items.en: If the goods should arrive damaged, we will replace them free of charge.
items.zh: 萬一貨物到的時候有損壞，我們會免費更換。

items.en: If you should be unhappy with the course, we will give you your money back.
items.zh: 萬一您對課程不滿意，我們會退錢給您。

items.en: If the price should go down, we will refund the difference.
items.zh: 萬一價格下降，我們會退還差額。

items.en: If the hotel should be full, we will find you another one nearby.
items.zh: 萬一飯店客滿，我們會幫您在附近找另一家。

items.en: If the event should be cancelled, all tickets will be refunded.
items.zh: 萬一活動取消，所有的票都會退款。（被動）

items.en: If your parcel should get lost, we will send another one.
items.zh: 萬一您的包裹遺失，我們會再寄一個。

items.en: If the machine should stop working, our engineer will come within a day.
items.zh: 萬一機器停止運作，我們的工程師會在一天內到。

title: It's your decision, but if I had the chance, I would go with my friends.
translation: 如果我是你，我就不會一直看電視。
name: if 子句後主要子句的 would
sentences: Your friends have invited you to the beach. It's your decision, but if I had the chance, I would go with my friends.
If I had more time, I would learn to play the piano.
If I had a garden, I would grow my own vegetables.
If I had a lot of money, I would travel around the world.
If I had a dog, I would take it for long walks every day.
If I had a car, I would visit my grandparents more often.
You watch TV for six hours a day. If I were you, I would not watch TV all the time.
If I were you, I would talk to your teacher about it.
If I were you, I would take the job in London.
If I were you, I wouldn't buy such an expensive phone.
If I were you, I would go to bed early tonight.
If I were you, I wouldn't tell anyone about it yet.
If you decided to go to the small country school, you'd probably get more attention as a student.
If you studied a bit every day, you would pass easily.
If you got up earlier, you wouldn't be late every morning.
If you moved closer to work, you would save a lot of time.
If you ate more vegetables, you would feel better.
If you joined the club, you would meet lots of new people.
People ask if I want to move. If I were able to move, I wouldn't, because I think this street is perfect.
If I were able to choose, I would live by the sea.
If I were able to change one thing, I would make school start later.
If I were able to fly, I would visit every country in the world.
If I were able to speak five languages, I would work as a guide.
If I were able to cook like my mum, I would open a restaurant.
I would help you if I knew the answer.
She would come to the party if she didn't have to work.
We would buy that house if it were a bit cheaper.
They would go on holiday more often if they had more money.
My dad would be happier if he worked fewer hours.
I would call her if I had her number.
The town would be nicer if there were fewer cars.

examples.heading: ① If I had + 名詞, I would + 原形動詞：說自己會怎麼做

items.en: Your friends have invited you to the beach. It's your decision, but if I had the chance, I would go with my friends.
items.zh: 你的朋友邀你去海邊。這是你的決定，可是如果我有這個機會，我會跟朋友去。

items.en: If I had more time, I would learn to play the piano.
items.zh: 如果我有更多時間，我會學彈鋼琴。

items.en: If I had a garden, I would grow my own vegetables.
items.zh: 如果我有一座花園，我會自己種蔬菜。

items.en: If I had a lot of money, I would travel around the world.
items.zh: 如果我有很多錢，我會環遊世界。

items.en: If I had a dog, I would take it for long walks every day.
items.zh: 如果我有一隻狗，我每天都會帶牠去散步很久。

items.en: If I had a car, I would visit my grandparents more often.
items.zh: 如果我有車，我會更常去看我的祖父母。

examples.heading: ② If I were you, I would (not) + 原形動詞：給建議

items.en: You watch TV for six hours a day. If I were you, I would not watch TV all the time.
items.zh: 你一天看六個小時電視。如果我是你，我不會一直看電視。

items.en: If I were you, I would talk to your teacher about it.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會跟你的老師談這件事。

items.en: If I were you, I would take the job in London.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會接受倫敦的那份工作。

items.en: If I were you, I wouldn't buy such an expensive phone.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我不會買那麼貴的手機。

items.en: If I were you, I would go to bed early tonight.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我今天晚上會早點睡。

items.en: If I were you, I wouldn't tell anyone about it yet.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我還不會告訴任何人。

examples.heading: ③ If you + 過去式, you would + 原形動詞：說對方可能的結果

items.en: If you decided to go to the small country school, you'd probably get more attention as a student.
items.zh: 如果你決定去那所鄉下的小學校，你當學生可能會得到比較多的照顧。

items.en: If you studied a bit every day, you would pass easily.
items.zh: 如果你每天讀一點書，你會很輕鬆就考過。

items.en: If you got up earlier, you wouldn't be late every morning.
items.zh: 如果你早一點起床，你每天早上就不會遲到。

items.en: If you moved closer to work, you would save a lot of time.
items.zh: 如果你搬到離公司近一點的地方，你會省很多時間。

items.en: If you ate more vegetables, you would feel better.
items.zh: 如果你多吃蔬菜，你會覺得好一點。

items.en: If you joined the club, you would meet lots of new people.
items.zh: 如果你加入那個社團，你會認識很多新朋友。

examples.heading: ④ If I were able to + 原形動詞, I wouldn't + 原形動詞：說自己的意見

items.en: People ask if I want to move. If I were able to move, I wouldn't, because I think this street is perfect.
items.zh: 大家問我想不想搬家。就算我能搬，我也不會搬，因為我覺得這條街很完美。

items.en: If I were able to choose, I would live by the sea.
items.zh: 如果我能選，我會住在海邊。

items.en: If I were able to change one thing, I would make school start later.
items.zh: 如果我能改變一件事，我會讓學校晚一點上課。

items.en: If I were able to fly, I would visit every country in the world.
items.zh: 如果我會飛，我會去世界上每一個國家。

items.en: If I were able to speak five languages, I would work as a guide.
items.zh: 如果我會說五種語言，我會去當導遊。

items.en: If I were able to cook like my mum, I would open a restaurant.
items.zh: 如果我能像我媽媽一樣會煮飯，我會開一家餐廳。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + would + 原形動詞 + if + 主詞 + 過去式：if 子句放在後面

items.en: I would help you if I knew the answer.
items.zh: 如果我知道答案，我會幫你。

items.en: She would come to the party if she didn't have to work.
items.zh: 如果她不用工作，她會來派對。

items.en: We would buy that house if it were a bit cheaper.
items.zh: 如果那間房子便宜一點，我們會買。

items.en: They would go on holiday more often if they had more money.
items.zh: 如果他們有更多錢，他們會更常去度假。

items.en: My dad would be happier if he worked fewer hours.
items.zh: 如果我爸爸工作時間少一點，他會比較快樂。

items.en: I would call her if I had her number.
items.zh: 如果我有她的電話號碼，我會打給她。

items.en: The town would be nicer if there were fewer cars.
items.zh: 如果車子少一點，這個鎮會比較好。

title: If my mum can, she will fetch you from the station.
translation: 如果你能幫我，我會很高興。
name: if 子句後主要子句的 will
sentences: You'll arrive at the station at four. If my mum can, she will fetch you in the car.
If you can help me with my maths, I will be very happy.
If I can find my old tent, I will lend it to you for the trip.
If Dad can leave work early, he will drive us to the match.
If we can get tickets, we will go to the concert together.
If you can come on Friday, I will show you around my school.
I'm not taking my camera. If I need a camera, I will use my mobile phone.
If you need a towel, I will bring one from upstairs.
If we need more chairs, my neighbour will lend us some.
If you need help with your bags, my brother will carry them.
If I need money for the trip, I will ask my grandparents.
If the children need a rest, we will stop at the next café.
If it's sunny on Saturday, we will have a picnic by the river.
If it snows tonight, the school will probably close tomorrow.
If the wind is too strong, the ferry won't leave the harbour.
If it's warm enough, we'll swim in the lake.
If it rains all weekend, I'll finish my book at home.
If the weather is bad, the match will be on Sunday instead.
If you forget her birthday again, she will be very upset.
If the bus is late, we will be late for the film.
If you eat all that cake, you'll be sick.
If we win this match, the coach will be so proud of us.
If you study every day, the exam will be much easier.
If you take the train, the journey will be quicker.
I'll phone you if I hear any news about the job.
We'll wait for you if you're a few minutes late.
The teacher will help you if you ask her after class.
My grandma will make pancakes if we visit on Sunday.
I'll buy you an ice cream if you tidy your room.
The dog will bark if anyone comes near the gate.
You'll catch the train if you leave right now.

examples.heading: ① If + 主詞 + can, + 主詞 + will + 原形動詞

items.en: You'll arrive at the station at four. If my mum can, she will fetch you in the car.
items.zh: 你四點會到車站。如果我媽媽可以，她會開車去接你。

items.en: If you can help me with my maths, I will be very happy.
items.zh: 如果你可以幫我數學，我會很高興。

items.en: If I can find my old tent, I will lend it to you for the trip.
items.zh: 如果我找得到我的舊帳篷，我會借你去旅行。

items.en: If Dad can leave work early, he will drive us to the match.
items.zh: 如果爸爸可以提早下班，他會開車載我們去看比賽。

items.en: If we can get tickets, we will go to the concert together.
items.zh: 如果我們買得到票，我們會一起去聽演唱會。

items.en: If you can come on Friday, I will show you around my school.
items.zh: 如果你星期五可以來，我會帶你參觀我的學校。

examples.heading: ② If + 主詞 + need + 名詞, + 主詞 + will + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm not taking my camera. If I need a camera, I will use my mobile phone.
items.zh: 我不帶相機。如果我需要相機，我會用我的手機。

items.en: If you need a towel, I will bring one from upstairs.
items.zh: 如果你需要毛巾，我會從樓上拿一條。

items.en: If we need more chairs, my neighbour will lend us some.
items.zh: 如果我們需要更多椅子，我的鄰居會借我們一些。

items.en: If you need help with your bags, my brother will carry them.
items.zh: 如果你的行李需要幫忙，我哥哥會幫你提。

items.en: If I need money for the trip, I will ask my grandparents.
items.zh: 如果我旅行需要錢，我會問我的祖父母。

items.en: If the children need a rest, we will stop at the next café.
items.zh: 如果孩子們需要休息，我們會在下一家咖啡館停一下。

examples.heading: ③ If + 天氣, + 主詞 + will + 原形動詞

items.en: If it's sunny on Saturday, we will have a picnic by the river.
items.zh: 如果星期六天氣晴朗，我們會在河邊野餐。

items.en: If it snows tonight, the school will probably close tomorrow.
items.zh: 如果今天晚上下雪，學校明天可能會停課。

items.en: If the wind is too strong, the ferry won't leave the harbour.
items.zh: 如果風太大，渡輪不會離開港口。

items.en: If it's warm enough, we'll swim in the lake.
items.zh: 如果夠暖和，我們會去湖裡游泳。

items.en: If it rains all weekend, I'll finish my book at home.
items.zh: 如果整個週末都下雨，我會在家把書讀完。

items.en: If the weather is bad, the match will be on Sunday instead.
items.zh: 如果天氣不好，比賽會改到星期天。

examples.heading: ④ If + 主詞 + 現在式, + 主詞 + will + be + 形容詞

items.en: If you forget her birthday again, she will be very upset.
items.zh: 如果你又忘了她的生日，她會很難過。

items.en: If the bus is late, we will be late for the film.
items.zh: 如果公車誤點，我們看電影會遲到。

items.en: If you eat all that cake, you'll be sick.
items.zh: 如果你把那些蛋糕都吃掉，你會不舒服。

items.en: If we win this match, the coach will be so proud of us.
items.zh: 如果我們贏了這場比賽，教練會很以我們為榮。

items.en: If you study every day, the exam will be much easier.
items.zh: 如果你每天讀書，考試會容易很多。

items.en: If you take the train, the journey will be quicker.
items.zh: 如果你搭火車，路程會比較快。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + will + 原形動詞 + if + 子句：if 子句放在後面

items.en: I'll phone you if I hear any news about the job.
items.zh: 如果我聽到那份工作的任何消息，我會打給你。

items.en: We'll wait for you if you're a few minutes late.
items.zh: 如果你晚幾分鐘，我們會等你。

items.en: The teacher will help you if you ask her after class.
items.zh: 如果你下課後問老師，她會幫你。

items.en: My grandma will make pancakes if we visit on Sunday.
items.zh: 如果我們星期天去，我奶奶會做鬆餅。

items.en: I'll buy you an ice cream if you tidy your room.
items.zh: 如果你整理好房間，我會買冰淇淋給你。

items.en: The dog will bark if anyone comes near the gate.
items.zh: 如果有人靠近大門，狗會叫。

items.en: You'll catch the train if you leave right now.
items.zh: 如果你現在馬上走，你會趕上火車。

title: Be sure not to miss the alligator steak.
translation: 千萬別錯過鱷魚排。
name: be 加形容詞加 not to 不定詞（強調）
sentences: When you visit my grandmother, be sure not to mention politics.
Be sure not to leave your bag on the beach when you go swimming.
The museum closes at five, so be sure not to arrive too late.
Be sure not to tell Dad about the party. It's a surprise.
When you fill in the form, be sure not to forget your signature.
Be sure not to drink the tap water in that hotel.
Be sure not to park outside the school gate. They give fines.
Be careful not to wake the baby when you come in.
The soup is very hot, so be careful not to burn your mouth.
Be careful not to slip. The floor has just been cleaned.
Be careful not to drop the box. There are glasses in it.
When you cut the cake, be careful not to touch the candles.
Be careful not to say anything about his divorce.
In the exam, be careful not to spend too long on one question.
Whatever way parents choose, they are almost certain not to do a perfect job.
My sister is sure not to like this film. She hates horror.
The shop is certain not to have my size in the sale.
Granny is sure not to remember the new password.
Our neighbours are certain not to agree to a new fence.
The boss is sure not to accept another excuse from me.
The new rules are bound not to please everyone.
Lawyers are bound not to share what their clients tell them.
The kids have had a long day, so they are bound not to stay awake for the film.
Bank staff are bound not to discuss a customer's account with anyone else.
A plan made in such a hurry is bound not to work.
People should be obliged not to have more than a very small number of children.
Players are obliged not to talk to the press before the match.
Staff are obliged not to use their phones on the shop floor.
The two sides are obliged not to attack each other during the talks.
Tenants are obliged not to keep pets in the flats.
Chemists are obliged not to sell this medicine without a prescription.

examples.heading: ① Be sure not to + 原形動詞：一定不要

items.en: When you visit my grandmother, be sure not to mention politics.
items.zh: 去看我奶奶的時候，千萬別提政治。

items.en: Be sure not to leave your bag on the beach when you go swimming.
items.zh: 去游泳的時候，千萬別把包包留在海灘上。

items.en: The museum closes at five, so be sure not to arrive too late.
items.zh: 博物館五點關門，所以千萬別太晚到。

items.en: Be sure not to tell Dad about the party. It's a surprise.
items.zh: 千萬別跟爸爸說派對的事。這是驚喜。

items.en: When you fill in the form, be sure not to forget your signature.
items.zh: 填表格的時候，千萬別忘了簽名。

items.en: Be sure not to drink the tap water in that hotel.
items.zh: 在那家飯店千萬別喝水龍頭的水。

items.en: Be sure not to park outside the school gate. They give fines.
items.zh: 千萬別在校門外停車。他們會開罰單。

examples.heading: ② Be careful not to + 原形動詞：小心不要

items.en: Be careful not to wake the baby when you come in.
items.zh: 你進來的時候小心不要吵醒寶寶。

items.en: The soup is very hot, so be careful not to burn your mouth.
items.zh: 湯很燙，小心不要燙到嘴巴。

items.en: Be careful not to slip. The floor has just been cleaned.
items.zh: 小心不要滑倒。地板剛擦過。（被動）

items.en: Be careful not to drop the box. There are glasses in it.
items.zh: 小心不要摔到箱子。裡面有玻璃杯。

items.en: When you cut the cake, be careful not to touch the candles.
items.zh: 切蛋糕的時候，小心不要碰到蠟燭。

items.en: Be careful not to say anything about his divorce.
items.zh: 小心不要提到他離婚的事。

items.en: In the exam, be careful not to spend too long on one question.
items.zh: 考試的時候，小心不要在一題上花太多時間。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + certain / sure + not + to + 原形動詞：一定不會

items.en: Whatever way parents choose, they are almost certain not to do a perfect job.
items.zh: 不管父母選哪一種方式，他們幾乎一定做不到完美。

items.en: My sister is sure not to like this film. She hates horror.
items.zh: 我妹妹一定不會喜歡這部電影。她討厭恐怖片。

items.en: The shop is certain not to have my size in the sale.
items.zh: 那家店的特價品一定不會有我的尺寸。

items.en: Granny is sure not to remember the new password.
items.zh: 奶奶一定不會記得新的密碼。

items.en: Our neighbours are certain not to agree to a new fence.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居一定不會同意蓋新的圍籬。

items.en: The boss is sure not to accept another excuse from me.
items.zh: 老闆一定不會再接受我的藉口。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + be + bound + not + to + 原形動詞：一定不會、有義務不做

items.en: The new rules are bound not to please everyone.
items.zh: 新規定一定不會讓每個人都滿意。

items.en: Lawyers are bound not to share what their clients tell them.
items.zh: 律師有義務不洩露客戶告訴他們的事。

items.en: The kids have had a long day, so they are bound not to stay awake for the film.
items.zh: 孩子們累了一整天，一定撐不到電影結束。

items.en: Bank staff are bound not to discuss a customer's account with anyone else.
items.zh: 銀行員工有義務不跟別人討論客戶的帳戶。

items.en: A plan made in such a hurry is bound not to work.
items.zh: 這麼匆忙訂的計畫一定行不通。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + be + obliged + not + to + 原形動詞：有義務不做

items.en: People should be obliged not to have more than a very small number of children.
items.zh: 人們應該有義務不生太多孩子。

items.en: Players are obliged not to talk to the press before the match.
items.zh: 球員有義務在比賽前不接受媒體採訪。

items.en: Staff are obliged not to use their phones on the shop floor.
items.zh: 員工在賣場有義務不使用手機。

items.en: The two sides are obliged not to attack each other during the talks.
items.zh: 雙方在談判期間有義務不互相攻擊。

items.en: Tenants are obliged not to keep pets in the flats.
items.zh: 房客有義務不在公寓裡養寵物。

items.en: Chemists are obliged not to sell this medicine without a prescription.
items.zh: 藥師有義務不在沒有處方的情況下賣這種藥。

title: In an accident, one is more likely to be badly injured when riding a bicycle.
translation: 發生意外時，騎腳踏車的人比較容易受重傷。
name: more likely 和 less likely 的比較
sentences: People who live alone are more likely to feel lonely at Christmas.
Students who sleep well are more likely to remember what they learn.
People who exercise are more likely to live longer.
You're more likely to find a job in the city.
Children are more likely to catch colds in winter.
Shoppers are more likely to buy things near the checkout.
Fresh fruit is more likely to go bad in hot weather.
Tired drivers are more likely to make mistakes.
Older people are less likely to use social media.
Well-trained dogs are less likely to bite.
If you book early, you're less likely to pay a high price.
Small classes are less likely to be noisy.
People who eat breakfast are less likely to feel hungry before lunch.
A good lock makes your bike less likely to be stolen.
Cars with winter tyres are less likely to slide on ice.
Young drivers are much more likely to have accidents at night.
Smokers are much more likely to get heart disease.
You're much less likely to get lost if you take a map.
Children who read at home are much more likely to enjoy school.
Houses near the river are much more likely to flood.
Buses are much less likely to be late on Sunday mornings.
They are more likely to have better jobs and much less likely to cause problems for other people.
Happy workers are more likely to stay and less likely to look for new jobs.
Well-rested students are more likely to concentrate and less likely to make mistakes.
Customers who feel welcome are more likely to return and less likely to complain.
Dogs that walk every day are more likely to sleep well and less likely to bark.
People who cook at home are more likely to eat well and less likely to spend too much.
It is more likely that the meeting will be on Thursday.
It's less likely that we'll see snow in the city than in the mountains.
It is much more likely that he forgot than that he lied.
It's more likely that the keys are in your coat.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + more likely + to + 原形動詞

items.en: People who live alone are more likely to feel lonely at Christmas.
items.zh: 獨居的人在聖誕節比較容易覺得寂寞。

items.en: Students who sleep well are more likely to remember what they learn.
items.zh: 睡得好的學生比較能記住學到的東西。

items.en: People who exercise are more likely to live longer.
items.zh: 有運動的人比較可能活得久。

items.en: You're more likely to find a job in the city.
items.zh: 你在城市比較可能找到工作。

items.en: Children are more likely to catch colds in winter.
items.zh: 小孩在冬天比較容易感冒。

items.en: Shoppers are more likely to buy things near the checkout.
items.zh: 購物的人比較可能買結帳區附近的東西。

items.en: Fresh fruit is more likely to go bad in hot weather.
items.zh: 新鮮水果在熱天比較容易壞。

items.en: Tired drivers are more likely to make mistakes.
items.zh: 疲勞的駕駛比較容易犯錯。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + less likely + to + 原形動詞

items.en: Older people are less likely to use social media.
items.zh: 老人家比較少用社群媒體。

items.en: Well-trained dogs are less likely to bite.
items.zh: 受過良好訓練的狗比較不會咬人。

items.en: If you book early, you're less likely to pay a high price.
items.zh: 如果你早點訂，就比較不會付高價。

items.en: Small classes are less likely to be noisy.
items.zh: 小班比較不會吵。

items.en: People who eat breakfast are less likely to feel hungry before lunch.
items.zh: 有吃早餐的人午餐前比較不會覺得餓。

items.en: A good lock makes your bike less likely to be stolen.
items.zh: 好的鎖讓你的腳踏車比較不容易被偷。（被動）

items.en: Cars with winter tyres are less likely to slide on ice.
items.zh: 裝冬季輪胎的車在冰上比較不會打滑。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + much more / much less + likely + to + 原形動詞

items.en: Young drivers are much more likely to have accidents at night.
items.zh: 年輕駕駛晚上發生車禍的可能性高得多。

items.en: Smokers are much more likely to get heart disease.
items.zh: 抽菸的人得心臟病的可能性高得多。

items.en: You're much less likely to get lost if you take a map.
items.zh: 如果你帶地圖，迷路的可能性會低得多。

items.en: Children who read at home are much more likely to enjoy school.
items.zh: 在家讀書的孩子喜歡上學的可能性高得多。

items.en: Houses near the river are much more likely to flood.
items.zh: 河邊的房子淹水的可能性高得多。

items.en: Buses are much less likely to be late on Sunday mornings.
items.zh: 星期天早上公車誤點的可能性低得多。

examples.heading: ④ more likely ... and less likely ...：同時比較

items.en: They are more likely to have better jobs and much less likely to cause problems for other people.
items.zh: 他們比較可能找到好工作，也比較不會給別人造成問題。

items.en: Happy workers are more likely to stay and less likely to look for new jobs.
items.zh: 快樂的員工比較會留下來，也比較不會找新工作。

items.en: Well-rested students are more likely to concentrate and less likely to make mistakes.
items.zh: 睡飽的學生比較能專心，也比較不會犯錯。

items.en: Customers who feel welcome are more likely to return and less likely to complain.
items.zh: 覺得受歡迎的顧客比較會再來，也比較不會抱怨。

items.en: Dogs that walk every day are more likely to sleep well and less likely to bark.
items.zh: 每天散步的狗比較睡得好，也比較不會叫。

items.en: People who cook at home are more likely to eat well and less likely to spend too much.
items.zh: 在家煮飯的人比較吃得健康，也比較不會花太多錢。

examples.heading: ⑤ It is more / less likely that + 子句

items.en: It is more likely that the meeting will be on Thursday.
items.zh: 會議比較可能在星期四。

items.en: It's less likely that we'll see snow in the city than in the mountains.
items.zh: 在城市看到雪的可能性比在山上低。

items.en: It is much more likely that he forgot than that he lied.
items.zh: 他忘了的可能性比他說謊大得多。

items.en: It's more likely that the keys are in your coat.
items.zh: 鑰匙比較可能在你的外套裡。

title: There ought to be a lift, since the rooms were on the fourth floor.
translation: 我覺得應該要有更多的遠足和導覽行程。
name: there ought to be 表示期望的狀態
sentences: The rooms were dirty and there was no room service. There ought to be a lift, since the rooms were on the fourth floor.
There ought to be a sign at the entrance. We couldn't find the reception.
Dear Sir, I travelled on the four-hour train to Leeds yesterday. There ought to be a toilet on the train.
Someone took my camera from our hotel room. There ought to be a safe in every room.
We arrived at the hotel at midnight and waited an hour outside. There ought to be someone at the desk at night.
We paid full price for our two little boys. There ought to be a discount for families.
After the meeting, we came to the conclusion that there ought to be some changes to the club's publicity.
People leave dirty plates in the office kitchen every day. There ought to be some rules about using it.
Parents at the meeting had one complaint. There ought to be some way of contacting the teachers at weekends.
Many first-year students feel lost in the first week. There ought to be some help for them.
The talk went on for two hours without a break. There ought to be some time for questions at the end.
The village hall roof is leaking again. There ought to be some money for repairs.
I enjoyed the course, but I think there ought to be more excursions and guided tours.
I waited fifty minutes for a bus last night. There ought to be more of them after eight.
The park is covered in litter every Sunday. There ought to be more bins.
Half the voters are women, so there ought to be more women in parliament.
Cycling in the city centre is dangerous. There ought to be more cycle paths.
The café only has two kinds of sandwiches. There ought to be more choice on the menu.
My neighbours had a party until four this morning. There ought to be a law against loud music after midnight.
Nobody talked at dinner. They all looked at their screens. There ought to be a rule against using phones at the table.
The shop across from the school sells sweets to children every afternoon. There ought to be a law against it.
I had to push the pram into the road because of a van. There ought to be a rule against parking on the pavement.
They cut down a three-hundred-year-old oak in our street. There ought to be a law against cutting down old trees.
Two people chatted through the whole film last night. There ought to be a rule against talking in the cinema.
The new estate has three hundred homes. There ought to be a playground for the kids who live there.
The school library is noisy at lunchtime. There ought to be a quiet room for students who want to study.
My dad uses a wheelchair, and the car park was full. There ought to be a parking space for disabled drivers.
The wedding menu was all meat and fish. There ought to be a vegetarian dish for guests who don't eat meat.
We stood in the rain for twenty minutes. There ought to be a shelter for people waiting at the bus stop.
The young people in our village have nowhere to go. There ought to be a place for teenagers to meet in the evening.
The quiz night is next Friday. There ought to be a prize for the best team.

examples.heading: ① There ought to be + 名詞：投訴信

items.en: The rooms were dirty and there was no room service. There ought to be a lift, since the rooms were on the fourth floor.
items.zh: 房間很髒，也沒有客房服務。應該要有電梯，因為房間在四樓。

items.en: There ought to be a sign at the entrance. We couldn't find the reception.
items.zh: 入口應該要有指示牌。我們找不到櫃台。

items.en: Dear Sir, I travelled on the four-hour train to Leeds yesterday. There ought to be a toilet on the train.
items.zh: 先生您好，我昨天搭四個小時的火車去 Leeds。火車上應該要有廁所。

items.en: Someone took my camera from our hotel room. There ought to be a safe in every room.
items.zh: 有人從我們飯店房間拿走了我的相機。每個房間都應該要有保險箱。

items.en: We arrived at the hotel at midnight and waited an hour outside. There ought to be someone at the desk at night.
items.zh: 我們半夜到飯店，在外面等了一個小時。晚上櫃台應該要有人。

items.en: We paid full price for our two little boys. There ought to be a discount for families.
items.zh: 我們兩個小兒子都付了全價。應該要有家庭折扣。

examples.heading: ② There ought to be some changes / some + 名詞：會議的結論

items.en: After the meeting, we came to the conclusion that there ought to be some changes to the club's publicity.
items.zh: 開完會以後，我們得出結論：社團的宣傳應該要有一些改變。

items.en: People leave dirty plates in the office kitchen every day. There ought to be some rules about using it.
items.zh: 每天都有人把髒盤子留在公司廚房。使用廚房應該要有一些規定。

items.en: Parents at the meeting had one complaint. There ought to be some way of contacting the teachers at weekends.
items.zh: 家長在會議上有一個意見。週末應該要有聯絡老師的方法。

items.en: Many first-year students feel lost in the first week. There ought to be some help for them.
items.zh: 很多一年級新生第一週都很茫然。應該要給他們一些協助。

items.en: The talk went on for two hours without a break. There ought to be some time for questions at the end.
items.zh: 演講講了兩個小時都沒休息。最後應該要有一些發問的時間。

items.en: The village hall roof is leaking again. There ought to be some money for repairs.
items.zh: 村民會館的屋頂又漏水了。應該要有一些修理的經費。

examples.heading: ③ There ought to be more + 名詞：建議增加

items.en: I enjoyed the course, but I think there ought to be more excursions and guided tours.
items.zh: 我很喜歡這門課，可是我想應該要有更多的校外活動和導覽。

items.en: I waited fifty minutes for a bus last night. There ought to be more of them after eight.
items.zh: 我昨晚等公車等了五十分鐘。八點以後應該要有更多班次。

items.en: The park is covered in litter every Sunday. There ought to be more bins.
items.zh: 公園每個星期天都滿地垃圾。應該要有更多垃圾桶。

items.en: Half the voters are women, so there ought to be more women in parliament.
items.zh: 一半的選民是女性，所以國會裡應該要有更多女性。

items.en: Cycling in the city centre is dangerous. There ought to be more cycle paths.
items.zh: 在市中心騎腳踏車很危險。應該要有更多腳踏車道。

items.en: The café only has two kinds of sandwiches. There ought to be more choice on the menu.
items.zh: 那家咖啡店只有兩種三明治。菜單上應該要有更多選擇。

examples.heading: ④ There ought to be + a law / a rule + against + 名詞

items.en: My neighbours had a party until four this morning. There ought to be a law against loud music after midnight.
items.zh: 我鄰居的派對開到今天早上四點。應該要有法律禁止半夜以後放很大聲的音樂。

items.en: Nobody talked at dinner. They all looked at their screens. There ought to be a rule against using phones at the table.
items.zh: 晚餐時沒有人說話。大家都在看螢幕。應該要有規定禁止在餐桌上用手機。

items.en: The shop across from the school sells sweets to children every afternoon. There ought to be a law against it.
items.zh: 學校對面的店每天下午都賣糖果給孩子。應該要有法律禁止。

items.en: I had to push the pram into the road because of a van. There ought to be a rule against parking on the pavement.
items.zh: 因為一台廂型車，我只好把嬰兒車推到馬路上。應該要有規定禁止在人行道上停車。

items.en: They cut down a three-hundred-year-old oak in our street. There ought to be a law against cutting down old trees.
items.zh: 他們砍了我們街上一棵三百年的橡樹。應該要有法律禁止砍老樹。

items.en: Two people chatted through the whole film last night. There ought to be a rule against talking in the cinema.
items.zh: 昨晚有兩個人整部電影都在聊天。應該要有規定禁止在電影院裡說話。

examples.heading: ⑤ There ought to be + 名詞 + for + 名詞

items.en: The new estate has three hundred homes. There ought to be a playground for the kids who live there.
items.zh: 新社區有三百戶。應該要有給住在那裡的孩子的遊樂場。

items.en: The school library is noisy at lunchtime. There ought to be a quiet room for students who want to study.
items.zh: 學校圖書館午餐時間很吵。應該要有一間安靜的房間給想讀書的學生。

items.en: My dad uses a wheelchair, and the car park was full. There ought to be a parking space for disabled drivers.
items.zh: 我爸爸坐輪椅，停車場又滿了。應該要有給身障駕駛的停車位。

items.en: The wedding menu was all meat and fish. There ought to be a vegetarian dish for guests who don't eat meat.
items.zh: 婚宴的菜單全是肉和魚。應該要有一道素食給不吃肉的客人。

items.en: We stood in the rain for twenty minutes. There ought to be a shelter for people waiting at the bus stop.
items.zh: 我們在雨中站了二十分鐘。公車站應該要有給等車的人的遮雨棚。

items.en: The young people in our village have nowhere to go. There ought to be a place for teenagers to meet in the evening.
items.zh: 我們村子的年輕人沒地方去。應該要有一個地方讓青少年晚上聚會。

items.en: The quiz night is next Friday. There ought to be a prize for the best team.
items.zh: 問答之夜在下星期五。應該要有給最佳隊伍的獎品。

title: For these reasons, I definitely recommend staying in a city.
translation: 我星期五一定會打電話給你。
name: 表示強調的副詞（certainly、definitely）
sentences: Cities have better transport, more jobs and more to do. For these reasons, I definitely recommend staying in a city.
I definitely prefer summer to winter.
I really believe that sport is good for everyone.
I definitely think we should have more holidays.
I really love the old part of the town.
I definitely agree with the writer of this article.
I'm busy all week, but I will certainly ring you on Friday.
I will certainly come to your birthday party.
We will certainly send you the photos after the trip.
I'll certainly tell my parents about your kind offer.
She will certainly remember this holiday for a long time.
They will certainly need more help next year.
If I were you, I'd certainly choose not to go with your parents.
If I were you, I'd definitely accept the offer from the bank in Dublin.
If I were you, I'd certainly talk to your teacher.
If I were you, I'd definitely wear a coat today.
If I were you, I'd certainly ask for a refund.
If I were you, I'd definitely visit the castle.
You sit at a desk all day. With the job you've got, you obviously can't keep fit.
He obviously likes her. He talks about her all the time.
You obviously need a bigger flat.
She obviously didn't read the instructions.
They obviously enjoyed the meal. The plates are empty.
We obviously can't finish all this work today.
You should really visit the lighthouse before the summer crowds arrive.
We must definitely visit the market before we leave.
I can really see why you love this town.
Your old laptop still works well, so you don't really need to replace it.
They have definitely made the right choice.
I would really like to see you again.
My grandmother has certainly seen a lot of changes in this village.

examples.heading: ① I + definitely / really + 動詞：強調自己的意見

items.en: Cities have better transport, more jobs and more to do. For these reasons, I definitely recommend staying in a city.
items.zh: 城市交通比較方便、工作比較多、活動也比較多。因為這些理由，我絕對推薦住在城市。

items.en: I definitely prefer summer to winter.
items.zh: 我絕對比較喜歡夏天，不喜歡冬天。

items.en: I really believe that sport is good for everyone.
items.zh: 我真的相信運動對每個人都好。

items.en: I definitely think we should have more holidays.
items.zh: 我絕對認為我們應該有更多假期。

items.en: I really love the old part of the town.
items.zh: 我真的很愛這個鎮的老城區。

items.en: I definitely agree with the writer of this article.
items.zh: 我絕對同意這篇文章的作者。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + will + certainly + 原形動詞：強調承諾

items.en: I'm busy all week, but I will certainly ring you on Friday.
items.zh: 我整個星期都很忙，可是我星期五一定會打給你。

items.en: I will certainly come to your birthday party.
items.zh: 我一定會去你的生日派對。

items.en: We will certainly send you the photos after the trip.
items.zh: 旅行後我們一定會把照片寄給你。

items.en: I'll certainly tell my parents about your kind offer.
items.zh: 我一定會把你的好意告訴我爸媽。

items.en: She will certainly remember this holiday for a long time.
items.zh: 她一定會記得這次假期很久。

items.en: They will certainly need more help next year.
items.zh: 他們明年一定會需要更多幫忙。

examples.heading: ③ If I were you, I'd + certainly / definitely + 原形動詞

items.en: If I were you, I'd certainly choose not to go with your parents.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我一定會選擇不跟你爸媽去。

items.en: If I were you, I'd definitely accept the offer from the bank in Dublin.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我絕對會接受都柏林那家銀行的工作機會。

items.en: If I were you, I'd certainly talk to your teacher.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我一定會跟你的老師談談。

items.en: If I were you, I'd definitely wear a coat today.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我今天絕對會穿外套。

items.en: If I were you, I'd certainly ask for a refund.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我一定會要求退款。

items.en: If I were you, I'd definitely visit the castle.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我絕對會去參觀城堡。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + obviously + 動詞 / can't + 原形動詞：很明顯的事

items.en: You sit at a desk all day. With the job you've got, you obviously can't keep fit.
items.zh: 你整天坐在桌前。做你那份工作，你顯然沒辦法保持健康。

items.en: He obviously likes her. He talks about her all the time.
items.zh: 他顯然喜歡她。他一直在說她的事。

items.en: You obviously need a bigger flat.
items.zh: 你顯然需要大一點的公寓。

items.en: She obviously didn't read the instructions.
items.zh: 她顯然沒讀說明。

items.en: They obviously enjoyed the meal. The plates are empty.
items.zh: 他們顯然很喜歡這頓飯。盤子都空了。

items.en: We obviously can't finish all this work today.
items.zh: 我們顯然沒辦法今天做完這些工作。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + 助動詞 + really / definitely + 原形動詞

items.en: You should really visit the lighthouse before the summer crowds arrive.
items.zh: 你真的應該在夏天人潮來之前去看那座燈塔。

items.en: We must definitely visit the market before we leave.
items.zh: 我們離開前一定要去逛市場。

items.en: I can really see why you love this town.
items.zh: 我真的看得出你為什麼喜歡這個鎮。

items.en: Your old laptop still works well, so you don't really need to replace it.
items.zh: 你的舊筆電還很好用，所以你其實不太需要換。

items.en: They have definitely made the right choice.
items.zh: 他們絕對做了正確的選擇。

items.en: I would really like to see you again.
items.zh: 我真的很想再見到你。

items.en: My grandmother has certainly seen a lot of changes in this village.
items.zh: 我奶奶一定看過這個村子很多的變化。

title: This is what almost everyone thinks, but we really ought to think a little more about it.
translation: 我們真的應該再多想一想。
name: really ought to 表示強調
sentences: Banning phones is what almost everyone thinks is right, but we really ought to think a little more about it.
Young people will live with our decisions for the longest time. We really ought to listen to them more.
A new survey says that half of all workers hate their jobs. We really ought to ask ourselves why.
Many people say that crime is rising, but the numbers show the opposite. We really ought to look at the facts before we decide.
Families buy more and more things and still feel poor. We really ought to change the way we think about money.
The average teenager looks at a screen for seven hours a day. We really ought to spend less time on our phones.
Before you choose a school, you really ought to ask for details about the timetable, just to be sure it suits you.
You've had toothache for a week. You really ought to see a dentist about it.
Your laptop is ten years old and very slow. You really ought to back up your files.
That hotel looks cheap online. You really ought to read the reviews before you book.
You scratched your dad's car this morning. You really ought to tell your parents about the accident.
You really ought to get some rest. You look exhausted.
When one chooses a present, one really ought to know the interests and wishes of the person who will receive it.
The guidebook says that Venice is like no other city. One really ought to visit it at least once.
Our lawyer always gives the same advice. One really ought to read a contract before signing it.
Travellers abroad are often helped by strangers. One really ought to learn some of the local language.
My grandmother always said that one really ought to thank people who help.
Health is worth more than money, as the old saying goes. One really ought to take care of one's health.
I really ought to go home. It's nearly midnight.
It's eight o'clock, and I haven't opened my school bag. I really ought to start my homework.
Grandma lives alone and loves to chat. I really ought to call her more often.
I can't get the car into the garage any more. I really ought to clean it out this weekend.
I've eaten takeaway five times this week. I really ought to learn to cook.
My wardrobe won't close. I really ought to stop buying so many clothes.
It took me an hour to drive two miles this morning. The government really ought to do something about the traffic.
The children wear their coats in class all winter. The school really ought to fix the heating.
Your brother is thirty and still lives with your parents. He really ought to find a job.
I've written to the phone company three times about my bill. They really ought to answer my emails.
There's only one waiter in the café on Saturdays. They really ought to have more staff on at weekends.
The swings in our park have been broken for months. The council really ought to repair them.
My mum hasn't had a day off all year. She really ought to take a holiday.

examples.heading: ① we really ought to + 原形動詞：議論文的意見

items.en: Banning phones is what almost everyone thinks is right, but we really ought to think a little more about it.
items.zh: 禁用手機幾乎是每個人都認為對的事，可是我們真的應該再多想一想。

items.en: Young people will live with our decisions for the longest time. We really ought to listen to them more.
items.zh: 年輕人要承受我們的決定最久。我們真的應該多聽聽他們的意見。

items.en: A new survey says that half of all workers hate their jobs. We really ought to ask ourselves why.
items.zh: 一份新的調查說，一半的上班族討厭自己的工作。我們真的應該問問自己為什麼。

items.en: Many people say that crime is rising, but the numbers show the opposite. We really ought to look at the facts before we decide.
items.zh: 很多人說犯罪在增加，可是數字顯示的是相反的情況。我們決定之前，真的應該看看事實。

items.en: Families buy more and more things and still feel poor. We really ought to change the way we think about money.
items.zh: 家庭買的東西越來越多，卻還是覺得窮。我們真的應該改變對錢的看法。

items.en: The average teenager looks at a screen for seven hours a day. We really ought to spend less time on our phones.
items.zh: 一般青少年一天看螢幕七個小時。我們真的應該少花一點時間在手機上。

examples.heading: ② you really ought to + 原形動詞：重要的提醒

items.en: Before you choose a school, you really ought to ask for details about the timetable, just to be sure it suits you.
items.zh: 選學校之前，你真的應該問一下時間表的細節，確定它適合你。

items.en: You've had toothache for a week. You really ought to see a dentist about it.
items.zh: 你牙痛一個星期了。你真的應該去看牙醫。

items.en: Your laptop is ten years old and very slow. You really ought to back up your files.
items.zh: 你的筆電用了十年，又很慢。你真的應該備份你的檔案。

items.en: That hotel looks cheap online. You really ought to read the reviews before you book.
items.zh: 那家飯店在網路上看起來很便宜。你訂之前真的應該看看評論。

items.en: You scratched your dad's car this morning. You really ought to tell your parents about the accident.
items.zh: 你今天早上刮傷了你爸爸的車。你真的應該把那次意外告訴你爸媽。

items.en: You really ought to get some rest. You look exhausted.
items.zh: 你真的應該休息一下。你看起來累壞了。

examples.heading: ③ one really ought to + 原形動詞：正式的一般建議

items.en: When one chooses a present, one really ought to know the interests and wishes of the person who will receive it.
items.zh: 選禮物的時候，人真的應該了解收禮的人有什麼興趣和願望。

items.en: The guidebook says that Venice is like no other city. One really ought to visit it at least once.
items.zh: 旅遊書說威尼斯跟其他城市都不一樣。人真的應該至少去一次。

items.en: Our lawyer always gives the same advice. One really ought to read a contract before signing it.
items.zh: 我們的律師總是給同樣的建議。人簽約之前真的應該先讀合約。

items.en: Travellers abroad are often helped by strangers. One really ought to learn some of the local language.
items.zh: 在國外旅行的人常常受到陌生人幫忙。人真的應該學一點當地的語言。

items.en: My grandmother always said that one really ought to thank people who help.
items.zh: 我奶奶總是說，人真的應該謝謝幫忙的人。

items.en: Health is worth more than money, as the old saying goes. One really ought to take care of one's health.
items.zh: 俗話說，健康比錢更有價值。人真的應該照顧自己的健康。

examples.heading: ④ I really ought to + 原形動詞：自己應該做的事

items.en: I really ought to go home. It's nearly midnight.
items.zh: 我真的應該回家了。快半夜了。

items.en: It's eight o'clock, and I haven't opened my school bag. I really ought to start my homework.
items.zh: 已經八點了，我還沒打開書包。我真的應該開始寫功課了。

items.en: Grandma lives alone and loves to chat. I really ought to call her more often.
items.zh: 奶奶一個人住，很喜歡聊天。我真的應該更常打電話給她。

items.en: I can't get the car into the garage any more. I really ought to clean it out this weekend.
items.zh: 我的車已經開不進車庫了。這個週末我真的應該把車庫清乾淨。

items.en: I've eaten takeaway five times this week. I really ought to learn to cook.
items.zh: 我這個星期吃了五次外帶。我真的應該學煮飯。

items.en: My wardrobe won't close. I really ought to stop buying so many clothes.
items.zh: 我的衣櫃關不起來了。我真的應該停止買那麼多衣服。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + really ought to + 原形動詞：說別人或機構

items.en: It took me an hour to drive two miles this morning. The government really ought to do something about the traffic.
items.zh: 我今天早上開兩英里開了一個小時。政府真的應該對交通做點什麼。

items.en: The children wear their coats in class all winter. The school really ought to fix the heating.
items.zh: 孩子們整個冬天都穿著外套上課。學校真的應該修暖氣。

items.en: Your brother is thirty and still lives with your parents. He really ought to find a job.
items.zh: 你哥哥三十歲了，還跟你爸媽住。他真的應該找份工作。

items.en: I've written to the phone company three times about my bill. They really ought to answer my emails.
items.zh: 我為了帳單寫信給電信公司三次了。他們真的應該回覆我的電子郵件。

items.en: There's only one waiter in the café on Saturdays. They really ought to have more staff on at weekends.
items.zh: 那家咖啡店星期六只有一個服務生。他們週末真的應該安排更多員工。

items.en: The swings in our park have been broken for months. The council really ought to repair them.
items.zh: 我們公園的鞦韆壞了好幾個月了。市議會真的應該修理。

items.en: My mum hasn't had a day off all year. She really ought to take a holiday.
items.zh: 我媽媽一整年都沒休過假。她真的應該去度個假。

title: I'm not sure that the council has anticipated everything.
translation: 我不確定議會是不是每件事都預料到了。
name: be not 加形容詞接 that 子句表示委婉
sentences: I'm not sure that the council has thought about parking.
I'm not certain that the people near the dump have got used to the smell.
I'm not sure that this is the best time to buy a house.
I'm not certain that everyone received the email.
I'm not sure that the children will enjoy such a long film.
I'm not certain that the price includes breakfast.
I'm not sure that we have enough chairs for everyone.
I'm not certain that the new rules are fair.
I'm not convinced that the new system is any better.
I'm not convinced that he's telling the truth.
I'm not convinced that more roads will solve the traffic problem.
I'm not convinced that the diet really works.
I'm not convinced that the shop will survive another year.
I'm not convinced that we need a second car.
If you study with the TV on, it's not likely that you'll make much progress.
It's not likely that the train will arrive on time.
It is not certain that the ferry will sail in this wind.
It's not likely that prices will fall soon.
It is not certain that the vote will go our way.
It's not likely that he'll change his mind now.
It is not certain that the bridge is safe.
It is not clear that the plan will save any money.
It's not clear whether the meeting is still on.
It is not clear that the new law has made any difference.
It's not clear who will pay for the damage.
It is not clear that students learn more with tablets.
The new menu is nice, but I'm not sure that the prices are right.
The hotel looks lovely, but I'm not sure that it's near enough to the beach.
Your idea is interesting, but I'm not sure that we have the money.
The course sounds useful, but I'm not certain that I have the time.
The design is beautiful, but I'm not convinced that it's practical.

examples.heading: ① I'm not sure / certain + that + 子句

items.en: I'm not sure that the council has thought about parking.
items.zh: 我不確定議會有沒有想過停車的問題。

items.en: I'm not certain that the people near the dump have got used to the smell.
items.zh: 我不確定住在垃圾場附近的人已經習慣那個味道了。

items.en: I'm not sure that this is the best time to buy a house.
items.zh: 我不確定現在是不是買房子的最好時機。

items.en: I'm not certain that everyone received the email.
items.zh: 我不確定每個人都收到了那封電子郵件。

items.en: I'm not sure that the children will enjoy such a long film.
items.zh: 我不確定孩子們會喜歡這麼長的電影。

items.en: I'm not certain that the price includes breakfast.
items.zh: 我不確定價格有沒有包含早餐。

items.en: I'm not sure that we have enough chairs for everyone.
items.zh: 我不確定我們的椅子夠不夠大家坐。

items.en: I'm not certain that the new rules are fair.
items.zh: 我不確定新規定是不是公平。

examples.heading: ② I'm not convinced + that + 子句

items.en: I'm not convinced that the new system is any better.
items.zh: 我不太相信新系統有比較好。

items.en: I'm not convinced that he's telling the truth.
items.zh: 我不太相信他說的是實話。

items.en: I'm not convinced that more roads will solve the traffic problem.
items.zh: 我不太相信多蓋路就能解決交通問題。

items.en: I'm not convinced that the diet really works.
items.zh: 我不太相信這種飲食法真的有效。

items.en: I'm not convinced that the shop will survive another year.
items.zh: 我不太相信那家店能再撐一年。

items.en: I'm not convinced that we need a second car.
items.zh: 我不太相信我們需要第二台車。

examples.heading: ③ It is not likely / certain + that + 子句

items.en: If you study with the TV on, it's not likely that you'll make much progress.
items.zh: 如果你開著電視讀書，你不太可能進步多少。

items.en: It's not likely that the train will arrive on time.
items.zh: 火車不太可能準時到。

items.en: It is not certain that the ferry will sail in this wind.
items.zh: 風這麼大，渡輪不一定會開。

items.en: It's not likely that prices will fall soon.
items.zh: 物價不太可能很快下跌。

items.en: It is not certain that the vote will go our way.
items.zh: 投票結果不一定對我們有利。

items.en: It's not likely that he'll change his mind now.
items.zh: 他現在不太可能改變主意。

items.en: It is not certain that the bridge is safe.
items.zh: 那座橋不一定安全。

examples.heading: ④ It is not clear + that / whether / wh- 疑問詞 + 子句

items.en: It is not clear that the plan will save any money.
items.zh: 這個計畫會不會省錢並不清楚。

items.en: It's not clear whether the meeting is still on.
items.zh: 會議還開不開並不清楚。

items.en: It is not clear that the new law has made any difference.
items.zh: 新法律有沒有帶來任何改變並不清楚。

items.en: It's not clear who will pay for the damage.
items.zh: 誰會賠償損失並不清楚。

items.en: It is not clear that students learn more with tablets.
items.zh: 學生用平板學得比較多這一點並不清楚。

examples.heading: ⑤ ..., but I'm not sure that + 子句：先贊成，再提出疑問

items.en: The new menu is nice, but I'm not sure that the prices are right.
items.zh: 新菜單不錯，可是我不確定價格是不是合理。

items.en: The hotel looks lovely, but I'm not sure that it's near enough to the beach.
items.zh: 那家飯店看起來很棒，可是我不確定它離海灘夠不夠近。

items.en: Your idea is interesting, but I'm not sure that we have the money.
items.zh: 你的想法很有趣，可是我不確定我們有沒有錢。

items.en: The course sounds useful, but I'm not certain that I have the time.
items.zh: 這門課聽起來很有用，可是我不確定我有沒有時間。

items.en: The design is beautiful, but I'm not convinced that it's practical.
items.zh: 設計很漂亮，可是我不太相信它實用。

title: I dare say that the last option may be the best one.
translation: 我想最後一個選項可能是最好的。
name: I dare say 表示可能是真的
sentences: I dare say the second plan is easier to organise.
I dare say you've heard the news already.
I dare say the shops will be busy on Saturday.
I dare say she'll be a bit late, as usual.
I dare say the price will go up again next year.
I dare say that most people would agree with you.
I dare say the children are hungry after the long walk.
I dare say there will be a few problems at the start.
I dare say that the new rules will take some time to get used to.
I dare say the hotel is more expensive in August.
I dare say you know more about computers than I do.
You're tired after the long flight, I dare say.
The canteen, which I dare say needs improvement, is very popular.
The weather will improve by the weekend, I dare say.
He'll call when he's ready, I dare say.
The library, which I dare say is the oldest in the country, needs a new roof.
There's a simple answer to this, I dare say.
The film will be a success, I dare say.
I dare say you're right, but I still want to try.
I dare say it's cheaper, but the quality isn't as good.
I dare say he means well, but he talks too much.
I dare say the course is useful, but it's very expensive.
I dare say she has her reasons, but she should have told us.
I dare say the city is exciting, but I prefer the countryside.
I dare say we could walk, but it's a long way.
I daresay you'll find the book interesting.
I daresay things will be different next year.
I daresay the student study centre needs more computers.
I daresay he'll get used to his new school.
I daresay there's some truth in what she says.
I daresay we'll meet again one day.

examples.heading: ① I dare say + (that) + 子句

items.en: I dare say the second plan is easier to organise.
items.zh: 我想第二個方案比較容易安排。

items.en: I dare say you've heard the news already.
items.zh: 我想你大概已經聽說這個消息了。

items.en: I dare say the shops will be busy on Saturday.
items.zh: 我想星期六商店大概會很擠。

items.en: I dare say she'll be a bit late, as usual.
items.zh: 我想她大概會晚一點到，跟平常一樣。

items.en: I dare say the price will go up again next year.
items.zh: 我想價格明年大概又會漲。

items.en: I dare say that most people would agree with you.
items.zh: 我想大部分的人大概都會同意你。

items.en: I dare say the children are hungry after the long walk.
items.zh: 我想走了那麼長的路，孩子們大概餓了。

items.en: I dare say there will be a few problems at the start.
items.zh: 我想一開始大概會有一些問題。

items.en: I dare say that the new rules will take some time to get used to.
items.zh: 我想新規定大概需要一點時間才能習慣。

items.en: I dare say the hotel is more expensive in August.
items.zh: 我想那家飯店八月大概比較貴。

items.en: I dare say you know more about computers than I do.
items.zh: 我想你大概比我懂電腦。

examples.heading: ② 子句, I dare say. / 句中的 I dare say

items.en: You're tired after the long flight, I dare say.
items.zh: 長途飛行後你大概累了吧。

items.en: The canteen, which I dare say needs improvement, is very popular.
items.zh: 餐廳很受歡迎，我想它需要改善。

items.en: The weather will improve by the weekend, I dare say.
items.zh: 天氣到週末大概會好轉吧。

items.en: He'll call when he's ready, I dare say.
items.zh: 我想他準備好就會打來。

items.en: The library, which I dare say is the oldest in the country, needs a new roof.
items.zh: 那間圖書館需要新的屋頂，我想它大概是全國最古老的。

items.en: There's a simple answer to this, I dare say.
items.zh: 我想這件事大概有個簡單的答案。

items.en: The film will be a success, I dare say.
items.zh: 我想那部電影大概會成功。

examples.heading: ③ I dare say + 子句, but ...：先承認，再提出不同的看法

items.en: I dare say you're right, but I still want to try.
items.zh: 我想你說得對，可是我還是想試試看。

items.en: I dare say it's cheaper, but the quality isn't as good.
items.zh: 我想那比較便宜，可是品質沒那麼好。

items.en: I dare say he means well, but he talks too much.
items.zh: 我想他是好意，可是他話太多了。

items.en: I dare say the course is useful, but it's very expensive.
items.zh: 我想這門課很有用，可是很貴。

items.en: I dare say she has her reasons, but she should have told us.
items.zh: 我想她有她的理由，可是她應該告訴我們的。

items.en: I dare say the city is exciting, but I prefer the countryside.
items.zh: 我想城市很刺激，可是我比較喜歡鄉下。

items.en: I dare say we could walk, but it's a long way.
items.zh: 我想我們可以走路去，可是路很遠。

examples.heading: ④ I daresay + 子句

items.en: I daresay you'll find the book interesting.
items.zh: 我想你大概會覺得那本書很有趣。

items.en: I daresay things will be different next year.
items.zh: 我想明年情況大概會不一樣。

items.en: I daresay the student study centre needs more computers.
items.zh: 我想學生自習中心大概需要更多電腦。

items.en: I daresay he'll get used to his new school.
items.zh: 我想他大概會習慣新學校。

items.en: I daresay there's some truth in what she says.
items.zh: 我想她說的話大概有幾分道理。

items.en: I daresay we'll meet again one day.
items.zh: 我想我們有一天大概會再見面。

title: I have to admit that it is a very difficult choice.
translation: 我得承認，這是個非常困難的選擇。
name: I have to admit 表示強調
sentences: I have to admit that I watch a lot of TV, especially films and soap operas. I love them.
I have to admit that I eat too much chocolate.
I have to admit that I don't read the news very often.
I have to admit that I spend hours on my phone every night.
I have to admit that I hardly ever cook at home.
I have to admit that I'm not very good at saving money.
I have to admit that choosing a new flat is harder than I expected.
I have to admit that the exam was harder than I thought.
I have to admit that I found the first week at my new job very tiring.
I have to admit that I didn't understand the end of the film.
I have to admit that moving to a new city was frightening.
I have to admit that the instructions were very confusing.
I have to admit I was wrong about your friend. She's really nice.
I have to admit I forgot to post your letter.
I have to admit I didn't do my homework last night.
I have to admit I broke the vase. I'm really sorry.
I have to admit I wasn't listening when you explained it.
I have to admit I lied about my age.
I have to admit, the film was better than I expected.
I have to admit, your cake is better than mine.
I didn't want to go camping, but I have to admit, it was great fun.
I have to admit, the new teacher explains things really well.
I have to admit, the small hotel was more comfortable than the big one.
I have to admit, you were right to bring an umbrella.
I have to admit my mistake. I put the wrong date on the poster.
I have to admit the truth. I've never been to London.
I have to admit my fear of flying.
I have to admit defeat. You're a much better chess player than me.
I have to admit my part in the argument.
I have to admit my ignorance. I've never heard of that singer.
I have to admit one thing. I've lost your book.

examples.heading: ① I have to admit that + 子句：承認自己的習慣

items.en: I have to admit that I watch a lot of TV, especially films and soap operas. I love them.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我看很多電視，特別是電影和肥皂劇。我很喜歡。

items.en: I have to admit that I eat too much chocolate.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我吃太多巧克力了。

items.en: I have to admit that I don't read the news very often.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我不常看新聞。

items.en: I have to admit that I spend hours on my phone every night.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我每天晚上花好幾個小時在手機上。

items.en: I have to admit that I hardly ever cook at home.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我幾乎不在家煮飯。

items.en: I have to admit that I'm not very good at saving money.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我不太會存錢。

examples.heading: ② I have to admit that + 子句：說事情很難

items.en: I have to admit that choosing a new flat is harder than I expected.
items.zh: 我必須承認，挑新公寓比我想的難。

items.en: I have to admit that the exam was harder than I thought.
items.zh: 我必須承認，考試比我想的難。

items.en: I have to admit that I found the first week at my new job very tiring.
items.zh: 我必須承認，新工作的第一個星期我覺得非常累。

items.en: I have to admit that I didn't understand the end of the film.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我看不懂那部電影的結局。

items.en: I have to admit that moving to a new city was frightening.
items.zh: 我必須承認，搬到新的城市很可怕。

items.en: I have to admit that the instructions were very confusing.
items.zh: 我必須承認，那份說明非常難懂。

examples.heading: ③ I have to admit + 子句：承認自己錯了

items.en: I have to admit I was wrong about your friend. She's really nice.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我看錯你的朋友了。她人真的很好。

items.en: I have to admit I forgot to post your letter.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我忘了幫你寄信。

items.en: I have to admit I didn't do my homework last night.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我昨天晚上沒寫功課。

items.en: I have to admit I broke the vase. I'm really sorry.
items.zh: 我必須承認，花瓶是我打破的。真的很抱歉。

items.en: I have to admit I wasn't listening when you explained it.
items.zh: 我必須承認，你解釋的時候我沒在聽。

items.en: I have to admit I lied about my age.
items.zh: 我必須承認，我謊報了年齡。

examples.heading: ④ I have to admit, + 子句：承認別人或事情比想的好

items.en: I have to admit, the film was better than I expected.
items.zh: 我必須承認，那部電影比我想的好看。

items.en: I have to admit, your cake is better than mine.
items.zh: 我必須承認，你的蛋糕比我的好吃。

items.en: I didn't want to go camping, but I have to admit, it was great fun.
items.zh: 我本來不想去露營，可是我必須承認，非常好玩。

items.en: I have to admit, the new teacher explains things really well.
items.zh: 我必須承認，新老師解釋得真的很好。

items.en: I have to admit, the small hotel was more comfortable than the big one.
items.zh: 我必須承認，那家小飯店比大飯店舒服。

items.en: I have to admit, you were right to bring an umbrella.
items.zh: 我必須承認，你帶傘是對的。

examples.heading: ⑤ I have to admit + 名詞

items.en: I have to admit my mistake. I put the wrong date on the poster.
items.zh: 我必須承認我的錯。我在海報上寫錯了日期。

items.en: I have to admit the truth. I've never been to London.
items.zh: 我必須承認事實。我從來沒去過倫敦。

items.en: I have to admit my fear of flying.
items.zh: 我必須承認我怕坐飛機。

items.en: I have to admit defeat. You're a much better chess player than me.
items.zh: 我必須認輸。你下西洋棋比我厲害多了。

items.en: I have to admit my part in the argument.
items.zh: 我必須承認我在那場爭吵裡也有錯。

items.en: I have to admit my ignorance. I've never heard of that singer.
items.zh: 我必須承認我不懂。我從來沒聽過那個歌手。

items.en: I have to admit one thing. I've lost your book.
items.zh: 我必須承認一件事。我弄丟了你的書。

title: If it's possible, could you send the cards to my office in London?
translation: 如果可以的話，能不能請你把卡片寄到我在倫敦的辦公室？
name: if 子句加 possible 表示客氣
sentences: If it is possible, I would like to pay by credit card.
If it's possible, could you change my appointment to Thursday?
If it's possible, I'd like to sit near the front.
If it's possible, could you send me a copy of the contract?
If it is possible, we would like to arrive a day early.
If it's possible, could you call me back after lunch?
If it's possible, I'd like to speak to the manager.
If possible, please deliver the same goods again right now.
If possible, I'd like a table by the window.
If possible, please reply before Friday.
If possible, could we start the meeting a bit later?
If possible, I'd like to bring my dog.
If possible, please send the documents by email.
If possible, we'd prefer a quiet room at the back of the hotel.
If possible, could you lend me your notes from the lecture?
I would prefer the 15th of July, if it is possible.
I'm not free at six, so I'd change it to nine if it's possible.
I'd like to change my seat if it's possible.
Could you fix the heating today, if it's possible?
We'd like to check out at noon, if it's possible.
I'd like to pay in two parts, if it is possible.
Could I leave work an hour early on Friday, if it's possible?
I'd like a vegetarian meal on the flight, if possible.
Please send the parcel to my work address, if possible.
We'd like to visit the factory next week, if possible.
I'd like an appointment in the morning, if possible.
Could you send me the bill by the end of the month, if possible?
Please keep the noise down after ten, if possible.
The opening hours are quite good, but, if possible, I would like the pool to open at half past eight.
We would, if possible, like to meet the new teacher before the term starts.
I would, if possible, prefer to work from home on Mondays.

examples.heading: ① If it is / it's possible, + 請求

items.en: If it is possible, I would like to pay by credit card.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想用信用卡付款。

items.en: If it's possible, could you change my appointment to Thursday?
items.zh: 如果可以的話，能不能把我的預約改到星期四？

items.en: If it's possible, I'd like to sit near the front.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想坐前面一點。

items.en: If it's possible, could you send me a copy of the contract?
items.zh: 如果可以的話，能不能寄一份合約給我？

items.en: If it is possible, we would like to arrive a day early.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我們想早一天到。

items.en: If it's possible, could you call me back after lunch?
items.zh: 如果可以的話，能不能午餐後回電給我？

items.en: If it's possible, I'd like to speak to the manager.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想跟經理說話。

examples.heading: ② If possible, + 請求或要求

items.en: If possible, please deliver the same goods again right now.
items.zh: 可以的話，請馬上重新寄送同樣的貨品。

items.en: If possible, I'd like a table by the window.
items.zh: 可以的話，我想要靠窗的桌子。

items.en: If possible, please reply before Friday.
items.zh: 可以的話，請在星期五前回覆。

items.en: If possible, could we start the meeting a bit later?
items.zh: 可以的話，會議能不能晚一點開始？

items.en: If possible, I'd like to bring my dog.
items.zh: 可以的話，我想帶我的狗去。

items.en: If possible, please send the documents by email.
items.zh: 可以的話，請用電子郵件寄文件。

items.en: If possible, we'd prefer a quiet room at the back of the hotel.
items.zh: 可以的話，我們比較想要飯店後面安靜的房間。

items.en: If possible, could you lend me your notes from the lecture?
items.zh: 可以的話，能不能把上課的筆記借我？

examples.heading: ③ 請求 + if it is / it's possible

items.en: I would prefer the 15th of July, if it is possible.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我比較希望是七月十五日。

items.en: I'm not free at six, so I'd change it to nine if it's possible.
items.zh: 我六點沒空，所以如果可以的話，我想改到九點。

items.en: I'd like to change my seat if it's possible.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想換座位。

items.en: Could you fix the heating today, if it's possible?
items.zh: 如果可以的話，能不能今天修好暖氣？

items.en: We'd like to check out at noon, if it's possible.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我們想中午退房。

items.en: I'd like to pay in two parts, if it is possible.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想分兩次付款。

items.en: Could I leave work an hour early on Friday, if it's possible?
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我星期五能不能早一個小時下班？

examples.heading: ④ 請求 + if possible

items.en: I'd like a vegetarian meal on the flight, if possible.
items.zh: 可以的話，我想在飛機上吃素食餐。

items.en: Please send the parcel to my work address, if possible.
items.zh: 可以的話，請把包裹寄到我公司的地址。

items.en: We'd like to visit the factory next week, if possible.
items.zh: 可以的話，我們想下星期去參觀工廠。

items.en: I'd like an appointment in the morning, if possible.
items.zh: 可以的話，我想約早上的時間。

items.en: Could you send me the bill by the end of the month, if possible?
items.zh: 可以的話，能不能在月底前把帳單寄給我？

items.en: Please keep the noise down after ten, if possible.
items.zh: 可以的話，十點以後請小聲一點。

examples.heading: ⑤ 句子中間的 if possible

items.en: The opening hours are quite good, but, if possible, I would like the pool to open at half past eight.
items.zh: 開放時間還算方便，不過可以的話，我希望游泳池八點半開。

items.en: We would, if possible, like to meet the new teacher before the term starts.
items.zh: 可以的話，我們想在開學前見見新老師。

items.en: I would, if possible, prefer to work from home on Mondays.
items.zh: 可以的話，我比較想星期一在家工作。

title: If you cannot attend, be sure to inform me in advance.
translation: 如果你不能出席，務必事先通知我。
name: 祈使句 be sure to
sentences: Be sure to contact me if you need any further information.
Be sure to bring your passport to the airport.
Be sure to reply before the end of the month.
Be sure to keep your receipt.
Be sure to arrive ten minutes before the exam starts.
Be sure to wear comfortable shoes for the walking tour.
Be sure to read the instructions before you start.
Be sure to switch off all the lights when you leave.
Be sure to write your name on every page.
Be sure to book your tickets early.
If you are going to be late, be sure to phone the school.
If you go to Rome, be sure to visit the Colosseum.
If you feel ill, be sure to tell the teacher.
If you're driving tonight, be sure to take it slowly on the icy roads.
If you see Tom, be sure to say hello from me.
If you change your address, be sure to let the bank know.
If it rains, be sure to bring the washing in.
If you need a lift, be sure to call me.
When you're in Paris, be sure to try the croissants.
Be sure to take an umbrella. It rains a lot here.
Be sure to drink plenty of water in the desert.
Be sure to check the weather before you climb the mountain.
Be sure to visit the night market while you're in Taipei.
Be sure to put on sun cream at the beach.
Be sure to keep your bag close to you on the metro.
Be sure not to leave the oven on.
Be sure not to tell her about the party.
Be sure not to miss the last train.
Be sure not to touch the paintings.
Be sure not to use your phone while you're driving.
Be sure not to lose the key to the flat.

examples.heading: ① Be sure to + 原形動詞：信件和通知

items.en: Be sure to contact me if you need any further information.
items.zh: 如果你需要任何進一步的資料，務必跟我聯絡。

items.en: Be sure to bring your passport to the airport.
items.zh: 務必帶護照去機場。

items.en: Be sure to reply before the end of the month.
items.zh: 務必在月底前回覆。

items.en: Be sure to keep your receipt.
items.zh: 務必保留收據。

items.en: Be sure to arrive ten minutes before the exam starts.
items.zh: 務必在考試開始前十分鐘到。

items.en: Be sure to wear comfortable shoes for the walking tour.
items.zh: 參加徒步導覽務必穿舒服的鞋子。

items.en: Be sure to read the instructions before you start.
items.zh: 開始前務必先讀說明。

items.en: Be sure to switch off all the lights when you leave.
items.zh: 離開時務必把所有的燈關掉。

items.en: Be sure to write your name on every page.
items.zh: 務必在每一頁寫上名字。

items.en: Be sure to book your tickets early.
items.zh: 務必提早訂票。

examples.heading: ② If ..., be sure to + 原形動詞

items.en: If you are going to be late, be sure to phone the school.
items.zh: 如果你會遲到，務必打電話給學校。

items.en: If you go to Rome, be sure to visit the Colosseum.
items.zh: 如果你去羅馬，一定要去看羅馬競技場。

items.en: If you feel ill, be sure to tell the teacher.
items.zh: 如果你覺得不舒服，一定要告訴老師。

items.en: If you're driving tonight, be sure to take it slowly on the icy roads.
items.zh: 如果你今晚要開車，路上結冰一定要慢慢開。

items.en: If you see Tom, be sure to say hello from me.
items.zh: 如果你見到 Tom，一定要幫我跟他打招呼。

items.en: If you change your address, be sure to let the bank know.
items.zh: 如果你換地址，一定要通知銀行。

items.en: If it rains, be sure to bring the washing in.
items.zh: 如果下雨，一定要把衣服收進來。

items.en: If you need a lift, be sure to call me.
items.zh: 如果你需要人載，一定要打給我。

examples.heading: ③ Be sure to + 原形動詞：旅遊和建議

items.en: When you're in Paris, be sure to try the croissants.
items.zh: 你在巴黎的時候，一定要試試可頌。

items.en: Be sure to take an umbrella. It rains a lot here.
items.zh: 一定要帶把傘，這裡常下雨。

items.en: Be sure to drink plenty of water in the desert.
items.zh: 在沙漠裡一定要多喝水。

items.en: Be sure to check the weather before you climb the mountain.
items.zh: 爬山前一定要看天氣。

items.en: Be sure to visit the night market while you're in Taipei.
items.zh: 你在台北的時候，一定要去逛夜市。

items.en: Be sure to put on sun cream at the beach.
items.zh: 在海邊一定要擦防曬乳。

items.en: Be sure to keep your bag close to you on the metro.
items.zh: 搭地鐵時一定要把包包放在身邊。

examples.heading: ④ Be sure not to + 原形動詞：務必不要

items.en: Be sure not to leave the oven on.
items.zh: 務必不要讓烤箱開著。

items.en: Be sure not to tell her about the party.
items.zh: 務必不要告訴她派對的事。

items.en: Be sure not to miss the last train.
items.zh: 務必不要錯過最後一班火車。

items.en: Be sure not to touch the paintings.
items.zh: 務必不要碰那些畫。

items.en: Be sure not to use your phone while you're driving.
items.zh: 開車時務必不要用手機。

items.en: Be sure not to lose the key to the flat.
items.zh: 務必不要弄丟公寓的鑰匙。

title: Should you need any further information, don't hesitate to contact us.
translation: 如需更多資訊，歡迎隨時與我們聯絡。
name: should 倒裝表示可能的情況（正式）
sentences: Thank you for choosing our company. Should you need any further information, don't hesitate to contact us.
Should you have any questions about your order, please call our office.
Should you require a receipt, please ask at the till.
Should you need help with your luggage, our staff will be happy to assist.
Should you have any problems with the room, please call reception.
Should you wish to cancel your booking, please let us know by Friday.
Should you withhold any important information or documents, this could stop any payment to you.
Should you fail to pay by the end of the month, we will charge a fee.
Should you break the rules again, you will be asked to leave the club.
Should you miss more than three classes, you may not pass the course.
Should you lose your card, you must report it at once.
Should you damage the car, you will have to pay for the repairs.
Should the weather be bad, the concert will move to the town hall.
Should the flight be delayed, a driver will wait for you.
Should the goods arrive damaged, we will replace them immediately.
Should the price change, we will tell you before you pay.
Should the speaker be late, we will start with the questions.
Should the course be full, your name will go on a waiting list.
Should you prefer a quieter room, we can move you to the top floor.
Should you wish to bring a guest, you can buy an extra ticket.
Should you want to stay longer, you can extend your booking online.
Should you be interested in the job, you can apply on our website.
Should you need a parking space, we can reserve one for you.
Should you not be able to come, you can send a colleague.
Should you decide to join us, we will send you a welcome pack.
Should the machine stop working, an engineer will visit within a day.
Should you not be satisfied, we will refund your money.
Should there be any changes to the timetable, we will email you.
Should you arrive early, our staff will show you around.
Should the item be out of stock, we will tell you at once.
Should you need to change your plans, we will do our best to help.

examples.heading: ① Should you + need / have + 名詞, + 祈使句：商業信件的結尾

items.en: Thank you for choosing our company. Should you need any further information, don't hesitate to contact us.
items.zh: 謝謝您選擇我們公司。如果您需要任何進一步的資訊，請隨時與我們聯絡。

items.en: Should you have any questions about your order, please call our office.
items.zh: 如果您對訂單有任何問題，請打電話到我們的辦公室。

items.en: Should you require a receipt, please ask at the till.
items.zh: 如果您需要收據，請在收銀台詢問。

items.en: Should you need help with your luggage, our staff will be happy to assist.
items.zh: 如果您的行李需要幫忙，我們的員工很樂意協助。

items.en: Should you have any problems with the room, please call reception.
items.zh: 如果房間有任何問題，請打電話給櫃台。

items.en: Should you wish to cancel your booking, please let us know by Friday.
items.zh: 如果您想取消預約，請在星期五前通知我們。

examples.heading: ② Should you + 原形動詞, + 句子：正式的警告

items.en: Should you withhold any important information or documents, this could stop any payment to you.
items.zh: 如果您隱瞞任何重要的資訊或文件，可能會導致無法付款給您。

items.en: Should you fail to pay by the end of the month, we will charge a fee.
items.zh: 如果您月底前未付款，我們會收取費用。

items.en: Should you break the rules again, you will be asked to leave the club.
items.zh: 如果您再違反規定，您會被要求退出俱樂部。（被動）

items.en: Should you miss more than three classes, you may not pass the course.
items.zh: 如果您缺課超過三堂，您可能無法通過這門課。

items.en: Should you lose your card, you must report it at once.
items.zh: 如果您的卡遺失，您必須馬上報失。

items.en: Should you damage the car, you will have to pay for the repairs.
items.zh: 如果您損壞車子，您必須支付修理費。

examples.heading: ③ Should + 名詞 + 原形動詞, + 句子：可能的情況

items.en: Should the weather be bad, the concert will move to the town hall.
items.zh: 如果天氣不好，音樂會會移到市政廳舉行。

items.en: Should the flight be delayed, a driver will wait for you.
items.zh: 如果班機延誤，司機會等您。（被動）

items.en: Should the goods arrive damaged, we will replace them immediately.
items.zh: 如果貨物到的時候有損壞，我們會馬上更換。

items.en: Should the price change, we will tell you before you pay.
items.zh: 如果價格有變動，我們會在您付款前通知您。

items.en: Should the speaker be late, we will start with the questions.
items.zh: 如果講者遲到，我們會先開始問答。

items.en: Should the course be full, your name will go on a waiting list.
items.zh: 如果課程額滿，您的名字會列入候補名單。

examples.heading: ④ Should + 主詞 + 原形動詞, + 主詞 + can：提供選擇

items.en: Should you prefer a quieter room, we can move you to the top floor.
items.zh: 如果您比較喜歡安靜的房間，我們可以幫您換到頂樓。

items.en: Should you wish to bring a guest, you can buy an extra ticket.
items.zh: 如果您想帶客人，您可以多買一張票。

items.en: Should you want to stay longer, you can extend your booking online.
items.zh: 如果您想多住幾天，您可以在網路上延長預約。

items.en: Should you be interested in the job, you can apply on our website.
items.zh: 如果您對這份工作有興趣，您可以在我們的網站上申請。

items.en: Should you need a parking space, we can reserve one for you.
items.zh: 如果您需要停車位，我們可以幫您保留一個。

items.en: Should you not be able to come, you can send a colleague.
items.zh: 如果您不能來，您可以派一位同事來。

examples.heading: ⑤ Should + 主詞 + 原形動詞, + 主詞 + will：正式的承諾

items.en: Should you decide to join us, we will send you a welcome pack.
items.zh: 如果您決定加入我們，我們會寄給您一份歡迎資料。

items.en: Should the machine stop working, an engineer will visit within a day.
items.zh: 如果機器停止運作，工程師會在一天內來。

items.en: Should you not be satisfied, we will refund your money.
items.zh: 如果您不滿意，我們會退錢給您。

items.en: Should there be any changes to the timetable, we will email you.
items.zh: 如果時間表有任何變動，我們會寄電子郵件給您。

items.en: Should you arrive early, our staff will show you around.
items.zh: 如果您提早到，我們的員工會帶您參觀。

items.en: Should the item be out of stock, we will tell you at once.
items.zh: 如果商品缺貨，我們會馬上通知您。

items.en: Should you need to change your plans, we will do our best to help.
items.zh: 如果您需要改變計畫，我們會盡力幫忙。

title: Sometimes it's essential to do what your parents want you to do.
translation: 有時候你就是得照爸媽希望你做的去做。
name: it is 加形容詞加不定詞（委婉或強調）
sentences: Our sales staff work on many international projects, so it is necessary to improve their language skills.
It's essential to drink plenty of water when you exercise.
It is necessary to show your passport at the gate.
It's vital to check the brakes before a long journey.
It is essential to book early in the summer.
It's necessary to wear a uniform at this school.
It's essential to keep the baby warm.
It is vital to act quickly in an emergency.
In the centre of town it is possible to do more activities after school.
It was impossible to install the system on my old computer.
It's possible to walk to the beach from here.
It was impossible to sleep because of the noise.
Is it possible to change the date of my flight?
It's impossible to find a parking space on Saturdays.
It's possible to see the mountains on a clear day.
It was impossible to get tickets for the final.
It's easy to get lost in the old part of the city.
It's difficult to learn a language without practice.
It was hard to say goodbye to my friends.
It's easy to make mistakes when you're tired.
It's not difficult to cook this dish.
It was hard to understand his accent.
It's easy to see why people love this town.
It might be better to wait until the rain stops.
It may be advisable to take a warm jacket.
It might be a good idea to call before you go.
It may be better to discuss this in private.
It might be wise to save some money first.
It may be difficult to find a hotel at such short notice.
It might be easier to take the train.
It may be necessary to cancel the trip.

examples.heading: ① It is + essential / necessary / vital + to + 原形動詞

items.en: Our sales staff work on many international projects, so it is necessary to improve their language skills.
items.zh: 我們的業務人員參與很多國際專案，所以必須加強他們的語言能力。

items.en: It's essential to drink plenty of water when you exercise.
items.zh: 運動時一定要喝很多水。

items.en: It is necessary to show your passport at the gate.
items.zh: 在登機門必須出示護照。

items.en: It's vital to check the brakes before a long journey.
items.zh: 長途旅行前檢查煞車極為重要。

items.en: It is essential to book early in the summer.
items.zh: 夏天一定要提早訂。

items.en: It's necessary to wear a uniform at this school.
items.zh: 這間學校必須穿制服。

items.en: It's essential to keep the baby warm.
items.zh: 一定要讓寶寶保暖。

items.en: It is vital to act quickly in an emergency.
items.zh: 緊急的時候行動要快，這極為重要。

examples.heading: ② It is + possible / impossible + to + 原形動詞

items.en: In the centre of town it is possible to do more activities after school.
items.zh: 在市中心，放學後可以做更多活動。

items.en: It was impossible to install the system on my old computer.
items.zh: 那個系統沒辦法裝在我的舊電腦上。

items.en: It's possible to walk to the beach from here.
items.zh: 從這裡可以走路到海邊。

items.en: It was impossible to sleep because of the noise.
items.zh: 因為噪音，根本沒辦法睡覺。

items.en: Is it possible to change the date of my flight?
items.zh: 我的班機日期可以改嗎？

items.en: It's impossible to find a parking space on Saturdays.
items.zh: 星期六根本找不到停車位。

items.en: It's possible to see the mountains on a clear day.
items.zh: 天氣晴朗的時候可以看到山。

items.en: It was impossible to get tickets for the final.
items.zh: 決賽的票根本買不到。

examples.heading: ③ It is + easy / difficult / hard + to + 原形動詞

items.en: It's easy to get lost in the old part of the city.
items.zh: 在老城區很容易迷路。

items.en: It's difficult to learn a language without practice.
items.zh: 不練習很難學會一種語言。

items.en: It was hard to say goodbye to my friends.
items.zh: 跟朋友道別很難。

items.en: It's easy to make mistakes when you're tired.
items.zh: 人累的時候很容易犯錯。

items.en: It's not difficult to cook this dish.
items.zh: 這道菜不難做。

items.en: It was hard to understand his accent.
items.zh: 他的口音很難聽懂。

items.en: It's easy to see why people love this town.
items.zh: 很容易看出大家為什麼喜歡這個小鎮。

examples.heading: ④ It might be / may be + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞：委婉

items.en: It might be better to wait until the rain stops.
items.zh: 也許等雨停比較好。

items.en: It may be advisable to take a warm jacket.
items.zh: 也許帶件保暖的外套比較好。

items.en: It might be a good idea to call before you go.
items.zh: 也許去之前先打個電話比較好。

items.en: It may be better to discuss this in private.
items.zh: 這件事也許私下談比較好。

items.en: It might be wise to save some money first.
items.zh: 也許先存點錢比較明智。

items.en: It may be difficult to find a hotel at such short notice.
items.zh: 這麼臨時，也許很難找到飯店。

items.en: It might be easier to take the train.
items.zh: 也許搭火車比較方便。

items.en: It may be necessary to cancel the trip.
items.zh: 也許必須取消這趟旅行。

title: It is likely that by reading books we will learn some new words.
translation: 透過讀書，我們很可能會學到一些新單字。
name: it 加連綴動詞加形容詞表示委婉
sentences: It is likely that regular exercise will improve your sleep.
It is likely that more people will work from home in the future.
It is probable that the price of food will continue to rise.
It's likely that the new law will reduce pollution.
It is likely that most students will choose the easier course.
It is probable that the meeting will run late.
It's likely that she has already heard the news.
It is likely that the team will need more money.
It is possible that the storm will reach the coast tonight.
It is possible that the results are wrong.
It's possible that he forgot about the appointment.
