items.zh: 晚開始就表示晚結束。嗯，不一定。我們可以不休息。

items.en: "Old cars break down all the time." "Well, not necessarily. Mine has never let me down."
items.zh: 舊車常常拋錨。嗯，不一定。我的車從來沒讓我失望過。

title: Do I agree with this statement? Definitely.
translation: 我同意這個說法嗎？當然同意。
name: 表示確定的副詞當簡答
sentences: Should everyone learn a foreign language? Do I agree with this statement? Definitely.
Is the new museum worth a visit? Absolutely. The paintings are wonderful.
Would I go back to that hotel? Definitely. The staff were so kind.
Is it worth paying more for good shoes? Absolutely.
Did the course help me? Definitely. I'm much more confident now.
Should children play outside more? Absolutely.
"Are you coming to the beach on Saturday?" "Definitely! I can't wait."
"Was the concert good?" "Absolutely. The best I've ever seen."
"Shall we order dessert?" "Definitely. I saw a chocolate cake on the menu."
"Do you think she'll win?" "Absolutely. She's the best runner here."
"Would you recommend this book?" "Definitely. I read it twice."
"Are you happy with your new flat?" "Absolutely. It's perfect."
"Could I see the menu, please?" "Certainly, madam. Here you are."
"Can I pay by card?" "Certainly. Just put it in the machine."
"Could you wrap it as a present?" "Certainly. Would you like a bow?"
"May I sit here?" "Certainly. Nobody's using it."
"Could you call me a taxi?" "Certainly, sir. Where would you like to go?"
"Can I try these shoes on?" "Certainly. What size are you?"
"Can I stay out until two?" "Certainly not! Be home by eleven."
"Would you eat a spider for money?" "Definitely not!"
"Are you going to lend him money again?" "Definitely not. He never pays it back."
"Can the children watch that film?" "Certainly not. It's too violent."
"Will you go camping in this weather?" "Definitely not!"
"Is the swimming pool open in winter?" "Certainly not. It's outdoors."
"Will you be at the party tonight?" "Probably. I just need to finish my work."
"Is it going to rain tomorrow?" "Possibly. Take an umbrella just in case."
"Will the shop have my size?" "Maybe. Let's ask."
"Is he going to be late again?" "Probably. He always is."
"Could the plane be delayed?" "Possibly. There's fog at the airport."
"Will your parents let you go?" "Maybe, if I finish my homework."
"Are we going to need more chairs?" "Probably. More people are coming."

examples.heading: ① 問題？ + Definitely. / Absolutely.：寫作的自問自答

items.en: Should everyone learn a foreign language? Do I agree with this statement? Definitely.
items.zh: 每個人都應該學一種外語嗎？我同意這個說法嗎？絕對同意。

items.en: Is the new museum worth a visit? Absolutely. The paintings are wonderful.
items.zh: 新的博物館值得去嗎？絕對值得。那些畫很棒。

items.en: Would I go back to that hotel? Definitely. The staff were so kind.
items.zh: 我會再去那家飯店嗎？一定會。員工都好親切。

items.en: Is it worth paying more for good shoes? Absolutely.
items.zh: 多花錢買好鞋值得嗎？絕對值得。

items.en: Did the course help me? Definitely. I'm much more confident now.
items.zh: 那門課對我有幫助嗎？絕對有。我現在有自信多了。

items.en: Should children play outside more? Absolutely.
items.zh: 孩子應該多在外面玩嗎？當然應該。

examples.heading: ② "…？" "Definitely." / "Absolutely."：熱情地同意

items.en: "Are you coming to the beach on Saturday?" "Definitely! I can't wait."
items.zh: 你星期六會去海灘嗎？一定去！我等不及了。

items.en: "Was the concert good?" "Absolutely. The best I've ever seen."
items.zh: 演唱會好看嗎？太棒了。我看過最好的。

items.en: "Shall we order dessert?" "Definitely. I saw a chocolate cake on the menu."
items.zh: 我們要點甜點嗎？當然要。我在菜單上看到巧克力蛋糕。

items.en: "Do you think she'll win?" "Absolutely. She's the best runner here."
items.zh: 你覺得她會贏嗎？一定會。她是這裡跑得最快的。

items.en: "Would you recommend this book?" "Definitely. I read it twice."
items.zh: 你會推薦這本書嗎？一定會。我讀了兩遍。

items.en: "Are you happy with your new flat?" "Absolutely. It's perfect."
items.zh: 你喜歡你的新公寓嗎？非常喜歡。太完美了。

examples.heading: ③ "Could I …？" "Certainly."：客氣地答應

items.en: "Could I see the menu, please?" "Certainly, madam. Here you are."
items.zh: 請問我可以看菜單嗎？當然，女士。給您。

items.en: "Can I pay by card?" "Certainly. Just put it in the machine."
items.zh: 我可以刷卡嗎？當然。把卡插進機器就好。

items.en: "Could you wrap it as a present?" "Certainly. Would you like a bow?"
items.zh: 你可以包成禮物嗎？當然。您要加一個蝴蝶結嗎？

items.en: "May I sit here?" "Certainly. Nobody's using it."
items.zh: 我可以坐這裡嗎？當然。沒有人坐。

items.en: "Could you call me a taxi?" "Certainly, sir. Where would you like to go?"
items.zh: 你可以幫我叫一輛計程車嗎？當然，先生。您要去哪裡？

items.en: "Can I try these shoes on?" "Certainly. What size are you?"
items.zh: 我可以試穿這雙鞋嗎？當然。您穿幾號？

examples.heading: ④ "…？" "Definitely not." / "Certainly not."：堅決地拒絕

items.en: "Can I stay out until two?" "Certainly not! Be home by eleven."
items.zh: 我可以在外面待到兩點嗎？當然不行！十一點前回家。

items.en: "Would you eat a spider for money?" "Definitely not!"
items.zh: 給你錢你會吃蜘蛛嗎？絕對不會！

items.en: "Are you going to lend him money again?" "Definitely not. He never pays it back."
items.zh: 你又要借他錢嗎？絕對不借。他從來不還。

items.en: "Can the children watch that film?" "Certainly not. It's too violent."
items.zh: 孩子們可以看那部電影嗎？當然不行。太暴力了。

items.en: "Will you go camping in this weather?" "Definitely not!"
items.zh: 這種天氣你會去露營嗎？絕對不會！

items.en: "Is the swimming pool open in winter?" "Certainly not. It's outdoors."
items.zh: 游泳池冬天有開嗎？當然沒有。那是戶外的。

examples.heading: ⑤ "…？" "Probably." / "Possibly." / "Maybe."：不太確定的回答

items.en: "Will you be at the party tonight?" "Probably. I just need to finish my work."
items.zh: 你今天晚上會去派對嗎？大概會。我只要把工作做完。

items.en: "Is it going to rain tomorrow?" "Possibly. Take an umbrella just in case."
items.zh: 明天會下雨嗎？也許。帶把傘以防萬一。

items.en: "Will the shop have my size?" "Maybe. Let's ask."
items.zh: 那家店會有我的尺寸嗎？也許。我們問問看。

items.en: "Is he going to be late again?" "Probably. He always is."
items.zh: 他又會遲到嗎？大概會。他總是這樣。

items.en: "Could the plane be delayed?" "Possibly. There's fog at the airport."
items.zh: 飛機可能會延誤嗎？有可能。機場有霧。

items.en: "Will your parents let you go?" "Maybe, if I finish my homework."
items.zh: 你爸媽會讓你去嗎？也許，如果我寫完功課的話。

items.en: "Are we going to need more chairs?" "Probably. More people are coming."
items.zh: 我們會需要更多椅子嗎？大概會。會來更多人。

title: Will you be able to come this time?
translation: 你這次能來嗎？
name: will be able to 表示可能和能力
sentences: After the course, you will be able to speak basic Spanish.
I'll be able to help you with your homework after dinner.
With the new bridge, we'll be able to drive to the island.
Next year my sister will be able to vote.
When the snow melts, we'll be able to walk to the lake.
If you save enough money, you'll be able to buy a car.
The doctor says I'll be able to play tennis again in a month.
Once the baby is older, we'll be able to travel more.
With this ticket, you'll be able to visit all the museums in the city.
Without my glasses, I will not be able to read the menu.
I won't be able to play the guitar at the party, because I've never learned.
We won't be able to come to the wedding, because we'll be in Canada.
Sorry, I won't be able to meet you at the station.
If you don't hurry, you won't be able to catch the bus.
The shop is closed tomorrow, so we won't be able to buy bread.
She won't be able to drive for six weeks after the operation.
Without the internet, I won't be able to send you the photos.
They won't be able to finish the house before winter.
Without the key, the neighbours won't be able to get in.
Will you be able to lend me your camera next week?
Will you be able to pick me up from the airport?
Will we be able to see the sea from the hotel?
Will your brother be able to fix my bike?
Will I be able to pay by card in the market?
Will your parents be able to join us for the school play?
Will you be able to finish the report by Friday?
When will we be able to move into the new flat?
"Will you be able to help me?" "Yes, I will."
"Will you be able to come on Sunday?" "No, I won't, sorry."
"Will she be able to walk again?" "Yes, she will, but it will take time."
"Will we be able to park near the theatre?" "No, we won't. It's always full."

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will / 'll + be able to + 原形動詞

items.en: After the course, you will be able to speak basic Spanish.
items.zh: 上完這門課，你就能說基本的西班牙文。

items.en: I'll be able to help you with your homework after dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐後我可以幫你寫功課。

items.en: With the new bridge, we'll be able to drive to the island.
items.zh: 有了新橋，我們就能開車到島上。

items.en: Next year my sister will be able to vote.
items.zh: 明年我姊就可以投票了。

items.en: When the snow melts, we'll be able to walk to the lake.
items.zh: 雪融化以後，我們就能走路到湖邊。

items.en: If you save enough money, you'll be able to buy a car.
items.zh: 如果你存夠錢，你就能買車。

items.en: The doctor says I'll be able to play tennis again in a month.
items.zh: 醫生說我一個月後就能再打網球。

items.en: Once the baby is older, we'll be able to travel more.
items.zh: 等寶寶大一點，我們就能多去旅行。

items.en: With this ticket, you'll be able to visit all the museums in the city.
items.zh: 有了這張票，你就能參觀城裡所有的博物館。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + won't / will not + be able to + 原形動詞

items.en: Without my glasses, I will not be able to read the menu.
items.zh: 沒有眼鏡，我就沒辦法看菜單。

items.en: I won't be able to play the guitar at the party, because I've never learned.
items.zh: 我沒辦法在派對上彈吉他，因為我從來沒學過。

items.en: We won't be able to come to the wedding, because we'll be in Canada.
items.zh: 我們沒辦法去參加婚禮，因為我們會在加拿大。

items.en: Sorry, I won't be able to meet you at the station.
items.zh: 抱歉，我沒辦法去車站接你。

items.en: If you don't hurry, you won't be able to catch the bus.
items.zh: 如果你不快一點，就趕不上公車了。

items.en: The shop is closed tomorrow, so we won't be able to buy bread.
items.zh: 那家店明天沒開，所以我們買不到麵包。

items.en: She won't be able to drive for six weeks after the operation.
items.zh: 手術後六個星期她都不能開車。

items.en: Without the internet, I won't be able to send you the photos.
items.zh: 沒有網路，我就沒辦法把照片寄給你。

items.en: They won't be able to finish the house before winter.
items.zh: 他們沒辦法在冬天前蓋好房子。

items.en: Without the key, the neighbours won't be able to get in.
items.zh: 沒有鑰匙，鄰居就進不去。

examples.heading: ③ Will + 主詞 + be able to + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Will you be able to lend me your camera next week?
items.zh: 你下星期能借我相機嗎？

items.en: Will you be able to pick me up from the airport?
items.zh: 你能來機場接我嗎？

items.en: Will we be able to see the sea from the hotel?
items.zh: 我們從飯店看得到海嗎？

items.en: Will your brother be able to fix my bike?
items.zh: 你哥能修好我的腳踏車嗎？

items.en: Will I be able to pay by card in the market?
items.zh: 我在市場可以刷卡嗎？

items.en: Will your parents be able to join us for the school play?
items.zh: 你爸媽能來看學校的話劇嗎？

items.en: Will you be able to finish the report by Friday?
items.zh: 你星期五前能完成報告嗎？

items.en: When will we be able to move into the new flat?
items.zh: 我們什麼時候能搬進新公寓？

examples.heading: ④ 回答：Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

items.en: "Will you be able to help me?" "Yes, I will."
items.zh: 你能幫我嗎？可以。

items.en: "Will you be able to come on Sunday?" "No, I won't, sorry."
items.zh: 你星期天能來嗎？抱歉，沒辦法。

items.en: "Will she be able to walk again?" "Yes, she will, but it will take time."
items.zh: 她還能再走路嗎？可以，可是需要時間。

items.en: "Will we be able to park near the theatre?" "No, we won't. It's always full."
items.zh: 我們能把車停在劇院附近嗎？沒辦法，那裡總是停滿了。

title: She had gone out for a walk in the woods, as she used to do every Sunday.
translation: 她去樹林裡散步了，就像她以前每個星期天都會做的那樣。
name: as 加代名詞加 used to 補充敘事背景
sentences: She had gone out for a walk in the woods, as she used to do every Sunday, with her diary in her hand and a pen in her pocket.
He sat on the bench by the river, as he used to do every evening after work.
She lit a candle by the window, as she used to do on her son's birthday.
The old man fed the pigeons in the square, as he used to do every morning.
They walked along the beach after dinner, as they used to do when they were young.
She read the newspaper in bed, as she used to do on lazy Sunday mornings.
She married a rich man and ended up as a housewife, doing piecework for peanuts, as she used to say.
"Hard work never killed anyone," as my grandfather used to say.
Life was "one long holiday", as my aunt used to say.
The house was "too big for one old woman", as she used to say.
"Every cloud has a silver lining," as my mother used to say.
He was "a man of few words", as his wife used to say.
He divorced his wife, old flabby Nellie as he used to call her, and proposed to his young secretary.
She visited "the old witch", as she used to call her neighbour, every Friday.
He met "the professor", as he used to call his clever brother, at the station.
They went to visit "the castle", as they used to call their grandmother's big house.
She phoned "the boss", as she used to call her older sister.
He wrote to "the little monster", as he used to call his nephew.
She hid the key under the flowerpot, as her mother used to.
He made the tea in the old brown pot, as his father used to.
She wore her hair in a long plait, as she used to at school.
He whistled as he worked, as he used to when he was happy.
They sat in the back row, as they used to in their student days.
She signed the letter with a small heart, as she used to as a girl.
Just as she used to, she waited for the postman at the gate.
Just as he used to, he ordered a coffee and sat by the window.
Just as they used to, the two sisters shared a bed that night.
Just as she used to, she sang to the baby until it fell asleep.
Just as he used to, the old dog waited by the door at six.
Just as we used to, we climbed the hill to watch the sunset.
Just as she used to, my grandmother put an extra plate on the table.

examples.heading: ① 句子, as + 代名詞 + used to do + 時間：人物的習慣

items.en: She had gone out for a walk in the woods, as she used to do every Sunday, with her diary in her hand and a pen in her pocket.
items.zh: 她出去森林散步了，就像她以前每個星期天都會做的那樣，手裡拿著日記本，口袋裡放著一支筆。

items.en: He sat on the bench by the river, as he used to do every evening after work.
items.zh: 他坐在河邊的長椅上，就像他以前每天下班後都會做的那樣。

items.en: She lit a candle by the window, as she used to do on her son's birthday.
items.zh: 她在窗邊點了一根蠟燭，就像她以前在她兒子生日時都會做的那樣。

items.en: The old man fed the pigeons in the square, as he used to do every morning.
items.zh: 老人在廣場上餵鴿子，就像他以前每天早上都會做的那樣。

items.en: They walked along the beach after dinner, as they used to do when they were young.
items.zh: 他們晚餐後沿著海灘散步，就像他們年輕時常做的那樣。

items.en: She read the newspaper in bed, as she used to do on lazy Sunday mornings.
items.zh: 她在床上看報紙，就像她以前在悠閒的星期天早上常做的那樣。

examples.heading: ② …, as + 代名詞 + used to say：引用人物常說的話

items.en: She married a rich man and ended up as a housewife, doing piecework for peanuts, as she used to say.
items.zh: 她嫁給一個有錢人，最後當了家庭主婦，做計件的工作賺一點點錢，她以前常這麼說。

items.en: "Hard work never killed anyone," as my grandfather used to say.
items.zh: 努力工作不會害死人。就像我爺爺以前常說的。

items.en: Life was "one long holiday", as my aunt used to say.
items.zh: 人生是一個很長的假期，就像我阿姨以前常說的。

items.en: The house was "too big for one old woman", as she used to say.
items.zh: 那間房子對一個老太太來說太大了，她以前常這麼說。

items.en: "Every cloud has a silver lining," as my mother used to say.
items.zh: 黑暗中總有一線光明。就像我媽媽以前常說的。

items.en: He was "a man of few words", as his wife used to say.
items.zh: 他是一個話很少的人，就像他太太以前常說的。

examples.heading: ③ …, as + 代名詞 + used to call + 人：人物的稱呼

items.en: He divorced his wife, old flabby Nellie as he used to call her, and proposed to his young secretary.
items.zh: 他跟他太太離了婚，他以前都叫她鬆垮垮的老奈莉，然後向他年輕的秘書求婚。

items.en: She visited "the old witch", as she used to call her neighbour, every Friday.
items.zh: 她每個星期五都去看老巫婆，她以前都這樣叫她的鄰居。

items.en: He met "the professor", as he used to call his clever brother, at the station.
items.zh: 他在車站跟教授碰面，他以前都這樣叫他聰明的哥哥。

items.en: They went to visit "the castle", as they used to call their grandmother's big house.
items.zh: 他們去拜訪城堡，他們以前都這樣叫他們奶奶的大房子。

items.en: She phoned "the boss", as she used to call her older sister.
items.zh: 她打電話給老大，她以前都這樣叫她姊姊。

items.en: He wrote to "the little monster", as he used to call his nephew.
items.zh: 他寫信給小怪獸，他以前都這樣叫他的姪子。

examples.heading: ④ …, as + 代名詞 + used to + 原形動詞：人物以前的做法

items.en: She hid the key under the flowerpot, as her mother used to.
items.zh: 她把鑰匙藏在花盆底下，就像她媽媽以前那樣。

items.en: He made the tea in the old brown pot, as his father used to.
items.zh: 他用那個舊的棕色茶壺泡茶，就像他爸爸以前那樣。

items.en: She wore her hair in a long plait, as she used to at school.
items.zh: 她把頭髮綁成一條長辮子，就像她以前上學時那樣。

items.en: He whistled as he worked, as he used to when he was happy.
items.zh: 他一邊工作一邊吹口哨，就像他以前高興時那樣。

items.en: They sat in the back row, as they used to in their student days.
items.zh: 他們坐在最後一排，就像他們學生時代那樣。

items.en: She signed the letter with a small heart, as she used to as a girl.
items.zh: 她在信的最後畫了一個小愛心，就像她小時候那樣。

examples.heading: ⑤ Just as + 代名詞 + used to, + 句子：放在句首

items.en: Just as she used to, she waited for the postman at the gate.
items.zh: 就像她以前那樣，她在大門口等郵差。

items.en: Just as he used to, he ordered a coffee and sat by the window.
items.zh: 就像他以前那樣，他點了一杯咖啡，坐在窗邊。

items.en: Just as they used to, the two sisters shared a bed that night.
items.zh: 就像她們以前那樣，那天晚上兩姊妹睡同一張床。

items.en: Just as she used to, she sang to the baby until it fell asleep.
items.zh: 就像她以前那樣，她唱歌給寶寶聽，直到寶寶睡著。

items.en: Just as he used to, the old dog waited by the door at six.
items.zh: 就像牠以前那樣，那隻老狗六點在門邊等。

items.en: Just as we used to, we climbed the hill to watch the sunset.
items.zh: 就像我們以前那樣，我們爬上山丘看夕陽。

items.en: Just as she used to, my grandmother put an extra plate on the table.
items.zh: 就像她以前那樣，我奶奶在桌上多放了一個盤子。

title: As a teenager I used not to be very sociable. I had few friends.
translation: 我十幾歲的時候不太愛跟人來往。
name: used not to 否定式
sentences: As a child I used to play until late in the evening. I used not to do my homework, and I did not do well at school.
As a teenager I used not to be very sociable. I had few friends, and none of them felt close.
I used not to enjoy reading until I found the right books.
I used not to speak in meetings, but now I lead them.
I used not to care about my health when I was young.
I used not to believe in luck, but this year changed my mind.
The village used not to be so busy in the summer.
My father used not to be so patient with us.
The roads used not to be so dangerous.
Holidays abroad used not to be so cheap.
She used not to be afraid of flying.
Before the factory opened, the water in the river used not to smell at all.
My grandparents used not to go on holiday at all.
People used not to lock their doors in this village.
We used not to have a television in the house.
He used not to drink coffee, but now he can't live without it.
Children used not to stay at school for lunch.
She used not to wear make-up.
There used not to be so many shops on the high street.
There used not to be any houses on this hill.
There used not to be a bus to the village.
There used not to be so much noise at night.
There used not to be any rules about parking here.
There used not to be a school in our town.
I used not to like spicy food, but now I order the hottest curry.
She used not to travel alone, but last year she went to India by herself.
We used not to recycle, but now we sort all our rubbish.
He used not to cook, but now he makes dinner every night.
They used not to talk to each other, but now they're married.
I used not to get up early, but my new job starts at seven.
The shop used not to open on Sundays, but now it's open every day.

examples.heading: ① I used not to + 原形動詞：自傳裡說過去的自己

items.en: As a child I used to play until late in the evening. I used not to do my homework, and I did not do well at school.
items.zh: 我小時候常常玩到很晚。我以前不寫功課，在學校成績也不好。

items.en: As a teenager I used not to be very sociable. I had few friends, and none of them felt close.
items.zh: 我十幾歲的時候不太喜歡交際。我的朋友很少，也沒有一個覺得很親近。

items.en: I used not to enjoy reading until I found the right books.
items.zh: 在找到對的書以前，我不喜歡讀書。

items.en: I used not to speak in meetings, but now I lead them.
items.zh: 我以前開會不發言，可是現在我主持會議。

items.en: I used not to care about my health when I was young.
items.zh: 我年輕的時候不在乎我的健康。

items.en: I used not to believe in luck, but this year changed my mind.
items.zh: 我以前不相信運氣，可是今年改變了我的想法。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + used not to + be + 形容詞：過去不是這樣

items.en: The village used not to be so busy in the summer.
items.zh: 這個村子以前夏天沒有這麼熱鬧。

items.en: My father used not to be so patient with us.
items.zh: 我爸爸以前對我們沒有這麼有耐心。

items.en: The roads used not to be so dangerous.
items.zh: 這些路以前沒有這麼危險。

items.en: Holidays abroad used not to be so cheap.
items.zh: 出國度假以前沒有這麼便宜。

items.en: She used not to be afraid of flying.
items.zh: 她以前不怕坐飛機。

items.en: Before the factory opened, the water in the river used not to smell at all.
items.zh: 工廠開工以前，河水一點也不臭。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + used not to + 原形動詞：過去的習慣

items.en: My grandparents used not to go on holiday at all.
items.zh: 我的祖父母以前完全不去度假。

items.en: People used not to lock their doors in this village.
items.zh: 這個村子的人以前不鎖門。

items.en: We used not to have a television in the house.
items.zh: 我們家以前沒有電視。

items.en: He used not to drink coffee, but now he can't live without it.
items.zh: 他以前不喝咖啡，可是現在沒有咖啡活不下去。

items.en: Children used not to stay at school for lunch.
items.zh: 孩子們以前不留在學校吃午餐。

items.en: She used not to wear make-up.
items.zh: 她以前不化妝。

examples.heading: ④ There used not to be + 名詞：以前沒有

items.en: There used not to be so many shops on the high street.
items.zh: 主要街道上以前沒有這麼多商店。

items.en: There used not to be any houses on this hill.
items.zh: 這座山丘上以前沒有房子。

items.en: There used not to be a bus to the village.
items.zh: 以前沒有公車到這個村子。

items.en: There used not to be so much noise at night.
items.zh: 晚上以前沒有這麼吵。

items.en: There used not to be any rules about parking here.
items.zh: 這裡以前沒有任何停車的規定。

items.en: There used not to be a school in our town.
items.zh: 我們鎮上以前沒有學校。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + used not to + 原形動詞, but + 句子：說改變

items.en: I used not to like spicy food, but now I order the hottest curry.
items.zh: 我以前不喜歡辣的食物，可是現在我點最辣的咖哩。

items.en: She used not to travel alone, but last year she went to India by herself.
items.zh: 她以前不會一個人旅行，可是去年她自己去了印度。

items.en: We used not to recycle, but now we sort all our rubbish.
items.zh: 我們以前不做回收，可是現在我們把垃圾都分類。

items.en: He used not to cook, but now he makes dinner every night.
items.zh: 他以前不煮飯，可是現在他每天晚上做晚餐。

items.en: They used not to talk to each other, but now they're married.
items.zh: 他們以前不跟對方說話，可是現在他們結婚了。

items.en: I used not to get up early, but my new job starts at seven.
items.zh: 我以前不早起，可是我的新工作七點開始。

items.en: The shop used not to open on Sundays, but now it's open every day.
items.zh: 那家店以前星期天不開，可是現在每天都開。

title: I can't even remember the girl's face.
translation: 我連那個女孩的臉都想不起來。
name: can 的句中副詞（also、even、only）
sentences: If you miss your friends, you can also write them postcards and letters.
At the market you can also buy fresh fish.
If the bus is late, you can always take a taxi.
You can always stay with us when you visit the city.
My sister can also play the violin.
If you don't like the shirt, you can always take it back.
I'm so tired that I can't even remember what I did this morning.
My cousin is ten, and he can't even ride a bike.
It's so noisy here that I can't even hear myself think.
She can't even cook an egg.
Our dog is so clever that he can even open the fridge.
I can't even find my phone in this mess.
I can only tell you what I think, because you have to decide.
You can just put the parcel by the back door if nobody answers.
The car park is full, so we can only stop here for five minutes.
I can just see the mountains from my window.
The children can only watch TV at the weekend.
You can just send me a message when you arrive.
Sorry, I can only lend you ten pounds.
The trouble is that I can't really afford a new car.
I can't really explain it, but I don't like him.
She can really sing! Did you hear her?
We can't really go out in this rain.
You can really see the difference after the new paint.
I can't really remember what she said.
Grandpa is ninety, but he can still ride a bike.
You can still buy tickets at the door.
I can still remember my first day at school.
We can still catch the train if we run.
Even with the windows closed, I can still hear the neighbours' dog.
After all these years, she can still speak perfect Italian.

examples.heading: ① can + also / always

items.en: If you miss your friends, you can also write them postcards and letters.
items.zh: 如果你想念朋友，你也可以寫明信片和信給他們。

items.en: At the market you can also buy fresh fish.
items.zh: 在市場也可以買到新鮮的魚。

items.en: If the bus is late, you can always take a taxi.
items.zh: 如果公車誤點，你隨時可以搭計程車。

items.en: You can always stay with us when you visit the city.
items.zh: 你來這個城市的時候，隨時可以住我們家。

items.en: My sister can also play the violin.
items.zh: 我妹也會拉小提琴。

items.en: If you don't like the shirt, you can always take it back.
items.zh: 如果你不喜歡這件襯衫，隨時可以拿回去退。

examples.heading: ② can / can't + even

items.en: I'm so tired that I can't even remember what I did this morning.
items.zh: 我累到連今天早上做了什麼都不記得。

items.en: My cousin is ten, and he can't even ride a bike.
items.zh: 我表弟十歲了，連腳踏車都不會騎。

items.en: It's so noisy here that I can't even hear myself think.
items.zh: 這裡吵到我連自己在想什麼都聽不到。

items.en: She can't even cook an egg.
items.zh: 她連蛋都不會煮。

items.en: Our dog is so clever that he can even open the fridge.
items.zh: 我們的狗聰明到連冰箱都會開。

items.en: I can't even find my phone in this mess.
items.zh: 這麼亂，我連手機都找不到。

examples.heading: ③ can + just / only

items.en: I can only tell you what I think, because you have to decide.
items.zh: 我只能告訴你我怎麼想，因為要由你決定。

items.en: You can just put the parcel by the back door if nobody answers.
items.zh: 如果沒人應門，你把包裹放在後門旁邊就好。

items.en: The car park is full, so we can only stop here for five minutes.
items.zh: 停車場滿了，所以我們只能在這裡停五分鐘。

items.en: I can just see the mountains from my window.
items.zh: 從我的窗戶剛好看得到山。

items.en: The children can only watch TV at the weekend.
items.zh: 孩子們只有週末才能看電視。

items.en: You can just send me a message when you arrive.
items.zh: 你到了傳個訊息給我就好。

items.en: Sorry, I can only lend you ten pounds.
items.zh: 抱歉，我只能借你十英鎊。

examples.heading: ④ can / can't + really

items.en: The trouble is that I can't really afford a new car.
items.zh: 問題是我不太負擔得起新車。

items.en: I can't really explain it, but I don't like him.
items.zh: 我說不太上來，可是我不喜歡他。

items.en: She can really sing! Did you hear her?
items.zh: 她真的很會唱！你聽到了嗎？

items.en: We can't really go out in this rain.
items.zh: 下這麼大的雨，我們不太能出門。

items.en: You can really see the difference after the new paint.
items.zh: 重新油漆之後，真的看得出差別。

items.en: I can't really remember what she said.
items.zh: 我不太記得她說了什麼。

examples.heading: ⑤ can / can't + still

items.en: Grandpa is ninety, but he can still ride a bike.
items.zh: 爺爺九十歲了，可是他還是會騎腳踏車。

items.en: You can still buy tickets at the door.
items.zh: 你還是可以在門口買票。

items.en: I can still remember my first day at school.
items.zh: 我還記得我上學的第一天。

items.en: We can still catch the train if we run.
items.zh: 如果我們用跑的，還是趕得上火車。

items.en: Even with the windows closed, I can still hear the neighbours' dog.
items.zh: 就算關著窗戶，我還是聽得到鄰居的狗叫。

items.en: After all these years, she can still speak perfect Italian.
items.zh: 過了這麼多年，她還是能說一口完美的義大利文。

title: In case you need them, I can easily provide references.
translation: 萬一您需要推薦信，我可以很輕易地提供。
name: can 與副詞的位置（較多種副詞）
sentences: With the right tools, you can easily repair a bike yourself.
The hall can easily hold three hundred people.
You can easily walk to the station from the hotel.
We can easily fit another chair at the table.
A small mistake like that can easily happen.
My dad can easily lift that box by himself.
You can hardly expect him to remember every name.
It's so noisy in here that I can hardly hear you.
After the long walk, my grandma is so tired that she can hardly stand.
I can hardly believe it's already December.
The writing is so small that I can hardly read it.
We can hardly ask them to pay for everything.
As you read her book, you can probably imagine what kind of person she is.
The mechanic can probably fix the car by Friday.
You can probably get a cheaper ticket online.
She probably can't come to the meeting tomorrow.
We can probably finish the painting this weekend.
He probably can't afford a holiday this year.
With the new bridge, people can now cross the river in five minutes.
The children can sometimes be noisy, but they are very kind.
You can still apply for the course until the end of the month.
Visitors can now buy tickets online.
The bus can sometimes take an hour in heavy traffic.
After the operation, my uncle can still play golf.
I can sometimes see deer from my bedroom window.
We can still catch the last bus if we leave now.
Can you now see why I was so worried?
Can we still get tickets for tonight's show?
Can you easily get to work by public transport?
Can the doctor still see me this afternoon?
Can you sometimes work from home?

examples.heading: ① can + easily

items.en: With the right tools, you can easily repair a bike yourself.
items.zh: 有對的工具，你就能輕鬆自己修腳踏車。

items.en: The hall can easily hold three hundred people.
items.zh: 這個大廳可以輕易容納三百人。

items.en: You can easily walk to the station from the hotel.
items.zh: 從飯店走路到車站很容易。

items.en: We can easily fit another chair at the table.
items.zh: 桌子旁邊很容易再擠一張椅子。

items.en: A small mistake like that can easily happen.
items.zh: 那樣的小錯很容易發生。

items.en: My dad can easily lift that box by himself.
items.zh: 我爸一個人就能輕鬆抬起那個箱子。

examples.heading: ② can + hardly

items.en: You can hardly expect him to remember every name.
items.zh: 你總不能期待他記得每個人的名字。

items.en: It's so noisy in here that I can hardly hear you.
items.zh: 這裡太吵了，我幾乎聽不到你說話。

items.en: After the long walk, my grandma is so tired that she can hardly stand.
items.zh: 走了那麼長的路，奶奶累到幾乎站不起來。

items.en: I can hardly believe it's already December.
items.zh: 我幾乎不敢相信已經十二月了。

items.en: The writing is so small that I can hardly read it.
items.zh: 字太小了，我幾乎看不清楚。

items.en: We can hardly ask them to pay for everything.
items.zh: 我們總不能叫他們全部付錢。

examples.heading: ③ can + probably / probably can't

items.en: As you read her book, you can probably imagine what kind of person she is.
items.zh: 你讀她的書的時候，大概可以想像她是什麼樣的人。

items.en: The mechanic can probably fix the car by Friday.
items.zh: 技師大概星期五前可以修好車。

items.en: You can probably get a cheaper ticket online.
items.zh: 你大概可以在網路上買到比較便宜的票。

items.en: She probably can't come to the meeting tomorrow.
items.zh: 她明天大概沒辦法來開會。

items.en: We can probably finish the painting this weekend.
items.zh: 我們這個週末大概可以油漆完。

items.en: He probably can't afford a holiday this year.
items.zh: 他今年大概負擔不起度假。

examples.heading: ④ can + now / sometimes / still

items.en: With the new bridge, people can now cross the river in five minutes.
items.zh: 有了新橋，大家現在五分鐘就能過河。

items.en: The children can sometimes be noisy, but they are very kind.
items.zh: 孩子們有時候會很吵，可是他們很善良。

items.en: You can still apply for the course until the end of the month.
items.zh: 你在月底前還是可以申請這門課程。

items.en: Visitors can now buy tickets online.
items.zh: 訪客現在可以在網路上買票。

items.en: The bus can sometimes take an hour in heavy traffic.
items.zh: 交通很塞的時候，公車有時候要坐一個小時。

items.en: After the operation, my uncle can still play golf.
items.zh: 手術後，我叔叔還是可以打高爾夫。

items.en: I can sometimes see deer from my bedroom window.
items.zh: 我有時候從臥室的窗戶可以看到鹿。

items.en: We can still catch the last bus if we leave now.
items.zh: 如果我們現在走，還是趕得上最後一班公車。

examples.heading: ⑤ Can + 主詞 + 副詞 + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Can you now see why I was so worried?
items.zh: 你現在明白我為什麼那麼擔心了嗎？

items.en: Can we still get tickets for tonight's show?
items.zh: 我們還買得到今晚表演的票嗎？

items.en: Can you easily get to work by public transport?
items.zh: 你搭大眾運輸上班方便嗎？

items.en: Can the doctor still see me this afternoon?
items.zh: 醫生今天下午還能幫我看診嗎？

items.en: Can you sometimes work from home?
items.zh: 你有時候可以在家工作嗎？

title: I can honestly say that I know her personality fairly well.
translation: 我可以老實說，我相當了解她的個性。
name: can 加句中副詞（較多種）
sentences: I can honestly say that I enjoyed every day of my holiday.
I can honestly say that this is the best meal I've ever had.
I can truly say that he is the kindest person I know.
We can honestly recommend this hotel to anyone.
I can honestly say I've never been so tired in my life.
I can truly understand how hard this year has been for you.
Only people who live with their relatives can fully understand how important family is.
I can fully understand why you're angry.
The new system can completely change how we work.
Doctors can now fully cure this disease.
After the course, you can fully enjoy reading English novels.
I can completely trust my sister with my secrets.
From the top of the hill, you can clearly see the sea.
I can certainly help you with your application.
We can definitely meet next week.
You can clearly hear the difference between the two singers.
The team can certainly win if they play like this.
I can definitely recommend this book to young readers.
My grandmother can no longer live on her own.
We can no longer afford to eat out every week.
I can no longer remember my first teacher's name.
The old bridge can no longer carry heavy lorries.
You can no longer pay by cheque in this shop.
He can no longer play football because of his knee.
You can simply download the form from our website.
I can safely say that our customers are happy.
We can simply wait and see what happens.
You can safely leave your bags at the reception.
I can quickly check the timetable for you.
You can freely walk around the gardens until six.
She can confidently speak in front of large groups.

examples.heading: ① can + honestly / truly

items.en: I can honestly say that I enjoyed every day of my holiday.
items.zh: 我可以老實說，假期的每一天我都過得很開心。

items.en: I can honestly say that this is the best meal I've ever had.
items.zh: 我可以老實說，這是我吃過最好吃的一餐。

items.en: I can truly say that he is the kindest person I know.
items.zh: 我可以真心地說，他是我認識最善良的人。

items.en: We can honestly recommend this hotel to anyone.
items.zh: 我們可以真心推薦這家飯店給任何人。

items.en: I can honestly say I've never been so tired in my life.
items.zh: 我可以老實說，我這輩子從來沒這麼累過。

items.en: I can truly understand how hard this year has been for you.
items.zh: 我真的能理解今年對你來說有多辛苦。

examples.heading: ② can + fully / completely

items.en: Only people who live with their relatives can fully understand how important family is.
items.zh: 只有跟親戚住在一起的人，才能完全理解家人有多重要。

items.en: I can fully understand why you're angry.
items.zh: 我完全可以理解你為什麼生氣。

items.en: The new system can completely change how we work.
items.zh: 新的系統可以完全改變我們工作的方式。

items.en: Doctors can now fully cure this disease.
items.zh: 醫生現在可以完全治好這種病。

items.en: After the course, you can fully enjoy reading English novels.
items.zh: 上完這門課，你就能好好享受讀英文小說。

items.en: I can completely trust my sister with my secrets.
items.zh: 我可以完全相信我姊會守住我的祕密。

examples.heading: ③ can + clearly / certainly / definitely

items.en: From the top of the hill, you can clearly see the sea.
items.zh: 從山頂可以清楚看到海。

items.en: I can certainly help you with your application.
items.zh: 我一定可以幫你寫申請表。

items.en: We can definitely meet next week.
items.zh: 我們下週一定可以見面。

items.en: You can clearly hear the difference between the two singers.
items.zh: 你可以清楚聽出兩位歌手的差別。

items.en: The team can certainly win if they play like this.
items.zh: 如果他們這樣踢，這支隊伍一定能贏。

items.en: I can definitely recommend this book to young readers.
items.zh: 我絕對可以把這本書推薦給年輕讀者。

examples.heading: ④ can + no longer

items.en: My grandmother can no longer live on her own.
items.zh: 我奶奶再也沒辦法一個人住了。

items.en: We can no longer afford to eat out every week.
items.zh: 我們再也負擔不起每週出去吃飯了。

items.en: I can no longer remember my first teacher's name.
items.zh: 我再也想不起我第一個老師的名字。

items.en: The old bridge can no longer carry heavy lorries.
items.zh: 那座舊橋再也撐不住重型卡車了。

items.en: You can no longer pay by cheque in this shop.
items.zh: 這家店再也不能用支票付款了。

items.en: He can no longer play football because of his knee.
items.zh: 因為膝蓋的關係，他再也不能踢足球了。

examples.heading: ⑤ can + simply / safely 和其他副詞

items.en: You can simply download the form from our website.
items.zh: 你只要從我們的網站下載表格就好。

items.en: I can safely say that our customers are happy.
items.zh: 我可以放心地說，我們的顧客很滿意。

items.en: We can simply wait and see what happens.
items.zh: 我們只要等著看會怎樣就好。

items.en: You can safely leave your bags at the reception.
items.zh: 你可以放心把包包放在櫃台。

items.en: I can quickly check the timetable for you.
items.zh: 我可以很快幫你查一下時刻表。

items.en: You can freely walk around the gardens until six.
items.zh: 六點前你可以在花園裡自由走動。

items.en: She can confidently speak in front of large groups.
items.zh: 她可以很有自信地在一大群人面前說話。

title: I may also ask you for another favour.
translation: 我可能還會再請你幫一個忙。
name: may 的句中副詞 also
sentences: I may also stay an extra night if the weather is good.
Why don't you try going to the gym before work? It may also help you relax.
We may also visit my aunt while we're in Spain.
Eating more vegetables may also help you sleep better.
The new road may also bring more tourists to the town.
You may also need a visa for that country.
I may also bring my brother to the party, if that's OK.
If you practise hard, you may even win the competition.
The tickets are so cheap that we may even buy two.
The film was so good that I may even watch it again.
It's very warm. We may even swim in the sea.
She's doing so well at work that she may even become manager.
The storm may even close the airport.
It's late, but the shop may still be open.
There may still be some tickets at the door.
He left an hour ago, but he may still be on the train.
If you hurry, you may still catch the last bus.
The soup may still be hot, so be careful.
They may still have my old photos somewhere.
You may well be right about the weather.
Bus fares may well rise again after the summer.
She may well be the best student in the class.
The trip may well take longer than we think.
My parents may well retire to the coast in a few years.
This may well be our last chance to see him.
If we don't go now, we may never get another chance.
The truth may never be known.
Small children may sometimes feel scared at night.
This medicine may sometimes make you feel sleepy.
We may never find out who sent the flowers.
The trains may sometimes be late in bad weather.

examples.heading: ① may + also + 原形動詞：可能也會

items.en: I may also stay an extra night if the weather is good.
items.zh: 如果天氣好，我可能也會多待一晚。

items.en: Why don't you try going to the gym before work? It may also help you relax.
items.zh: 你何不試試上班前去健身房？它可能也會幫你放鬆。

items.en: We may also visit my aunt while we're in Spain.
items.zh: 我們在西班牙的時候，可能也會去看我阿姨。

items.en: Eating more vegetables may also help you sleep better.
items.zh: 多吃蔬菜可能也會幫你睡得比較好。

items.en: The new road may also bring more tourists to the town.
items.zh: 新的道路可能也會帶更多觀光客到鎮上。

items.en: You may also need a visa for that country.
items.zh: 去那個國家你可能也需要簽證。

items.en: I may also bring my brother to the party, if that's OK.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我可能也會帶我哥哥去派對。

examples.heading: ② may + even + 原形動詞：甚至可能

items.en: If you practise hard, you may even win the competition.
items.zh: 如果你努力練習，你甚至可能贏得比賽。

items.en: The tickets are so cheap that we may even buy two.
items.zh: 票這麼便宜，我們甚至可能買兩張。

items.en: The film was so good that I may even watch it again.
items.zh: 那部電影好看到我甚至可能再看一次。

items.en: It's very warm. We may even swim in the sea.
items.zh: 天氣很暖和。我們甚至可能下海游泳。

items.en: She's doing so well at work that she may even become manager.
items.zh: 她工作表現很好，甚至可能當上經理。

items.en: The storm may even close the airport.
items.zh: 暴風雨甚至可能讓機場關閉。

examples.heading: ③ may + still + 原形動詞：可能還

items.en: It's late, but the shop may still be open.
items.zh: 很晚了，可是那家店可能還開著。

items.en: There may still be some tickets at the door.
items.zh: 門口可能還有一些票。

items.en: He left an hour ago, but he may still be on the train.
items.zh: 他一個小時前走的，可是他可能還在火車上。

items.en: If you hurry, you may still catch the last bus.
items.zh: 如果你快一點，你可能還趕得上最後一班公車。

items.en: The soup may still be hot, so be careful.
items.zh: 湯可能還很燙，所以小心。

items.en: They may still have my old photos somewhere.
items.zh: 他們可能還在哪裡留著我的舊照片。

examples.heading: ④ may + well + 原形動詞：很有可能

items.en: You may well be right about the weather.
items.zh: 你對天氣的看法很可能是對的。

items.en: Bus fares may well rise again after the summer.
items.zh: 夏天過後公車票價很有可能再漲。

items.en: She may well be the best student in the class.
items.zh: 她很可能是班上最好的學生。

items.en: The trip may well take longer than we think.
items.zh: 這趟旅行很可能比我們想的還久。

items.en: My parents may well retire to the coast in a few years.
items.zh: 我爸媽幾年後很有可能退休搬到海邊。

items.en: This may well be our last chance to see him.
items.zh: 這很可能是我們最後一次機會見到他。

examples.heading: ⑤ may + never / sometimes + 原形動詞

items.en: If we don't go now, we may never get another chance.
items.zh: 如果我們現在不去，我們可能永遠沒有另一個機會了。

items.en: The truth may never be known.
items.zh: 真相可能永遠不會被知道。（被動）

items.en: Small children may sometimes feel scared at night.
items.zh: 小孩子晚上有時候可能會害怕。

items.en: This medicine may sometimes make you feel sleepy.
items.zh: 這種藥有時候可能會讓你想睡。

items.en: We may never find out who sent the flowers.
items.zh: 我們可能永遠不會知道花是誰送的。

items.en: The trains may sometimes be late in bad weather.
items.zh: 天氣不好時，火車有時候可能會誤點。

title: Children living in cities may never get the chance to come near any animals at all.
translation: 住在城市的孩子可能根本沒有機會接近任何動物。
name: may 與副詞的位置（較多種副詞）
sentences: Without a passport, she may never be able to visit her family abroad.
If the factory closes, many people here may never work again.
Some old songs may never be heard again.
If you don't ask her now, you may never know the answer.
Some of these birds may never return to the lake.
Without help, poor families may never own a home.
In an old library, you may even find books from the 1600s.
If you keep reading English novels, you may even start to dream in English.
A short walk every day may even help you live longer.
The rain may even stop before lunch.
Learning to cook may even save you money.
The ticket may only cost a few pounds if you book early.
The repair may only take an hour.
We may only stay in Paris for one night.
The festival may only happen once every four years.
Some students may only need a little extra help.
Don't wait for her. She may already be at the restaurant.
Hurry up! The film may already have started.
You may already know some of the people in the group.
He may already have sold the car.
The tickets may already be sold out.
If we leave now, we may just catch the last train.
Keep trying. You may just win next time.
Ask the manager. He may just give you a discount.
Send your CV. They may just call you for an interview.
The weather may just stay dry for the wedding.
Travelling alone may sometimes feel lonely.
Parents may sometimes forget what it's like to be young.
The lift may sometimes stop between floors.
Online reviews may sometimes give the wrong idea.
Even good friends may sometimes disagree.

examples.heading: ① may never + 原形動詞：可能永遠不

items.en: Without a passport, she may never be able to visit her family abroad.
items.zh: 沒有護照，她可能永遠沒辦法去國外看她的家人。

items.en: If the factory closes, many people here may never work again.
items.zh: 如果工廠關了，這裡很多人可能再也找不到工作。

items.en: Some old songs may never be heard again.
items.zh: 有些老歌可能再也不會有人聽到了。（被動）

items.en: If you don't ask her now, you may never know the answer.
items.zh: 如果你現在不問她，你可能永遠不會知道答案。

items.en: Some of these birds may never return to the lake.
items.zh: 這些鳥有一些可能再也不會回到湖邊。

items.en: Without help, poor families may never own a home.
items.zh: 沒有幫助，窮困的家庭可能永遠買不起房子。

examples.heading: ② may even + 原形動詞：甚至可能

items.en: In an old library, you may even find books from the 1600s.
items.zh: 在老圖書館裡，你甚至可能找到十七世紀的書。

items.en: If you keep reading English novels, you may even start to dream in English.
items.zh: 如果你一直讀英文小說，你甚至可能開始用英文做夢。

items.en: A short walk every day may even help you live longer.
items.zh: 每天散一小段步甚至可能讓你活得更久。

items.en: The rain may even stop before lunch.
items.zh: 雨甚至可能在午餐前就停了。

items.en: Learning to cook may even save you money.
items.zh: 學煮飯甚至可能幫你省錢。

examples.heading: ③ may only + 原形動詞：可能只

items.en: The ticket may only cost a few pounds if you book early.
items.zh: 如果你早點訂，票可能只要幾英鎊。

items.en: The repair may only take an hour.
items.zh: 修理可能只要一個小時。

items.en: We may only stay in Paris for one night.
items.zh: 我們可能只在巴黎住一晚。

items.en: The festival may only happen once every four years.
items.zh: 這個節慶可能每四年才辦一次。

items.en: Some students may only need a little extra help.
items.zh: 有些學生可能只需要一點額外的幫助。

examples.heading: ④ may already + 原形動詞：可能已經

items.en: Don't wait for her. She may already be at the restaurant.
items.zh: 別等她了。她可能已經在餐廳了。

items.en: Hurry up! The film may already have started.
items.zh: 快一點！電影可能已經開始了。

items.en: You may already know some of the people in the group.
items.zh: 這個團體裡的一些人你可能已經認識了。

items.en: He may already have sold the car.
items.zh: 他可能已經把車賣掉了。

items.en: The tickets may already be sold out.
items.zh: 票可能已經賣完了。（被動）

examples.heading: ⑤ may just + 原形動詞：說不定

items.en: If we leave now, we may just catch the last train.
items.zh: 如果我們現在走，說不定還趕得上最後一班火車。

items.en: Keep trying. You may just win next time.
items.zh: 繼續努力。說不定你下次會贏。

items.en: Ask the manager. He may just give you a discount.
items.zh: 問問經理。說不定他會給你折扣。

items.en: Send your CV. They may just call you for an interview.
items.zh: 寄你的履歷去。說不定他們會打電話找你面試。

items.en: The weather may just stay dry for the wedding.
items.zh: 說不定婚禮那天不會下雨。

examples.heading: ⑥ may sometimes + 原形動詞：有時候可能

items.en: Travelling alone may sometimes feel lonely.
items.zh: 一個人旅行有時候可能會覺得寂寞。

items.en: Parents may sometimes forget what it's like to be young.
items.zh: 父母有時候可能會忘了年輕是什麼感覺。

items.en: The lift may sometimes stop between floors.
items.zh: 電梯有時候可能會停在兩層樓中間。

items.en: Online reviews may sometimes give the wrong idea.
items.zh: 網路評論有時候可能會讓人誤會。

items.en: Even good friends may sometimes disagree.
items.zh: 就算是好朋友，有時候也可能意見不合。

title: I must also do the practice test because I will have the exam soon.
translation: 首先，你一定要隨時注意自己吃了什麼。
name: must 的句中副詞 also
sentences: I have to tidy my room, and I must also walk the dog.
You must also bring a photo for your student card.
We must also buy some candles for the cake.
Visitors must also leave their bags at the entrance.
I must also thank my parents for their help.
You must also tell the teacher if you're going to be absent.
If you want to lose weight, first you must always watch what you eat.
You must always wear a helmet when you ride your bike.
You must always say thank you when someone helps you.
We must always lock the back door at night.
You must always check the oil before a long drive.
Children must always hold an adult's hand when crossing the road.
You must never swim alone in the sea.
You must never give your password to anyone.
We must never forget the people who helped us.
You must never leave a candle burning in an empty room.
Children must never play near the railway.
You must never touch a wild animal.
Before you start, you must first read the instructions.
You must first fill in this form.
We must first find somewhere to stay.
You must first ask your parents.
Before you cook, you must first wash your hands.
I must first check my diary.
I must really go now. It's late.
You must really try harder at school.
I must just send this email, then I'll help you.
We must really clean the car this weekend.
I must just make a quick phone call.
You must really see a doctor about that cough.
I must just finish this page before dinner.

examples.heading: ① must + also + 原形動詞：也必須

items.en: I have to tidy my room, and I must also walk the dog.
items.zh: 我必須整理房間，還必須去遛狗。

items.en: You must also bring a photo for your student card.
items.zh: 你也必須帶一張照片辦學生證。

items.en: We must also buy some candles for the cake.
items.zh: 我們也必須買一些蛋糕用的蠟燭。

items.en: Visitors must also leave their bags at the entrance.
items.zh: 訪客也必須把包包留在入口。

items.en: I must also thank my parents for their help.
items.zh: 我也必須謝謝我爸媽的幫忙。

items.en: You must also tell the teacher if you're going to be absent.
items.zh: 如果你要缺席，你也必須告訴老師。

examples.heading: ② must + always + 原形動詞：每次都必須

items.en: If you want to lose weight, first you must always watch what you eat.
items.zh: 如果你想減重，首先你每次都必須注意你吃什麼。

items.en: You must always wear a helmet when you ride your bike.
items.zh: 你騎腳踏車的時候一定要戴安全帽。

items.en: You must always say thank you when someone helps you.
items.zh: 有人幫你的時候，你一定要說謝謝。

items.en: We must always lock the back door at night.
items.zh: 晚上我們一定要鎖後門。

items.en: You must always check the oil before a long drive.
items.zh: 長途開車前你一定要檢查機油。

items.en: Children must always hold an adult's hand when crossing the road.
items.zh: 過馬路的時候，孩子一定要牽著大人的手。

examples.heading: ③ must + never + 原形動詞：絕對不可以

items.en: You must never swim alone in the sea.
items.zh: 你絕對不可以一個人在海裡游泳。

items.en: You must never give your password to anyone.
items.zh: 你絕對不可以把密碼給任何人。

items.en: We must never forget the people who helped us.
items.zh: 我們絕對不可以忘記幫助過我們的人。

items.en: You must never leave a candle burning in an empty room.
items.zh: 你絕對不可以讓蠟燭在沒人的房間裡燒著。

items.en: Children must never play near the railway.
items.zh: 孩子絕對不可以在鐵路附近玩。

items.en: You must never touch a wild animal.
items.zh: 你絕對不可以碰野生動物。

examples.heading: ④ must + first + 原形動詞：必須先

items.en: Before you start, you must first read the instructions.
items.zh: 開始之前，你必須先讀說明。

items.en: You must first fill in this form.
items.zh: 你必須先填這張表格。

items.en: We must first find somewhere to stay.
items.zh: 我們必須先找一個地方住。

items.en: You must first ask your parents.
items.zh: 你必須先問你爸媽。

items.en: Before you cook, you must first wash your hands.
items.zh: 煮飯前，你必須先洗手。

items.en: I must first check my diary.
items.zh: 我必須先看一下我的行事曆。

examples.heading: ⑤ must + really / just + 原形動詞

items.en: I must really go now. It's late.
items.zh: 我真的必須走了。很晚了。

items.en: You must really try harder at school.
items.zh: 你在學校真的必須更努力。

items.en: I must just send this email, then I'll help you.
items.zh: 我先寄出這封電子郵件，然後就幫你。

items.en: We must really clean the car this weekend.
items.zh: 這個週末我們真的必須洗車了。

items.en: I must just make a quick phone call.
items.zh: 我得先很快打一通電話。

items.en: You must really see a doctor about that cough.
items.zh: 你那個咳嗽真的必須去看醫生。

items.en: I must just finish this page before dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐前我得先讀完這一頁。

title: We must all act immediately because the future of humanity may be in danger.
translation: 我們所有人都必須馬上行動。
name: must 與副詞的位置（較多種副詞）
sentences: The ice is melting and the seas are rising. We must all act immediately because the future of humanity may be in danger.
Listen, class. You must all hand in your phones before the exam.
There's plastic everywhere on the sand. We must all help to keep the beach clean.
Two hundred people are coming to the conference. They must all wear a name badge.
The river is very low after the dry spring. We must all try to use less water this summer.
You have two hours to look around the town. You must all be back on the bus by four o'clock.
There is one thing we must never forget: we have to be ourselves.
The rescue team hasn't found the climbers yet, but we must never give up hope.
Two of my friends had a car crash last year. You must never drive after drinking.
Someone stole money from the till last night. Staff must never leave the shop without locking it.
A child nearly drowned in the pool today. We must never let this happen again.
The medical students learn this in their first week: doctors must never share their patients' secrets.
Your guidebook is very useful. In addition, I must strongly recommend that you add something about nightlife.
Some parts of this contract aren't clear. I must strongly advise you not to sign it yet.
You're visiting our town in June? I must strongly recommend the fish restaurant by the harbour.
A hospital visit abroad can cost thousands. I must strongly suggest that you take out travel insurance.
There have been some thefts in the hotel. We must strongly advise all guests to lock their rooms.
Your son is clearly very tired. I must strongly recommend a few days of rest.
To get a visa for this country, you must first apply online.
Before we discuss the budget, we must first agree on the plan.
Welcome to the climbing centre. New members must first attend a safety talk.
If you want to rent a flat in London, you must first show proof of income.
Sales of our new phone are low. The company must first find out what customers want.
You want to grow carrots? Before planting, you must first dig the soil.
Customers are leaving because of the long queues. The new manager must certainly deal with this problem.
Our supplier has doubled its prices. We must therefore find a new one.
Many young people get into debt with credit cards. Schools must also teach children about money.
Visitors can never find a space near the market. The town must therefore build a new car park.
The art is amazing in this city. You must certainly visit the museum while you're here.
The new laws affect students the most. The government must also listen to young people.
The theatre lost money again this year. We must therefore raise the price of tickets.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + must all + 原形動詞：每個人都必須

items.en: The ice is melting and the seas are rising. We must all act immediately because the future of humanity may be in danger.
items.zh: 冰在融化，海在上升。我們全都必須馬上行動，因為人類的未來可能有危險。

items.en: Listen, class. You must all hand in your phones before the exam.
items.zh: 同學們聽好。考試前你們每個人都必須交出手機。

items.en: There's plastic everywhere on the sand. We must all help to keep the beach clean.
items.zh: 沙灘上到處都是塑膠。我們全都必須幫忙保持海灘乾淨。

items.en: Two hundred people are coming to the conference. They must all wear a name badge.
items.zh: 會議有兩百人要來。他們全都必須戴名牌。

items.en: The river is very low after the dry spring. We must all try to use less water this summer.
items.zh: 春天很乾，河水很低。這個夏天我們全都必須盡量少用水。

items.en: You have two hours to look around the town. You must all be back on the bus by four o'clock.
items.zh: 你們有兩個小時逛小鎮。你們全都必須在四點前回到巴士上。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + must never + 原形動詞：絕對不可以

items.en: There is one thing we must never forget: we have to be ourselves.
items.zh: 有一件事我們絕對不可以忘記：我們必須做自己。

items.en: The rescue team hasn't found the climbers yet, but we must never give up hope.
items.zh: 救難隊還沒找到登山客，可是我們絕對不可以放棄希望。

items.en: Two of my friends had a car crash last year. You must never drive after drinking.
items.zh: 我有兩個朋友去年出了車禍。你喝酒以後絕對不可以開車。

items.en: Someone stole money from the till last night. Staff must never leave the shop without locking it.
items.zh: 昨晚有人偷了收銀機的錢。員工離開商店時絕對不可以不鎖門。

items.en: A child nearly drowned in the pool today. We must never let this happen again.
items.zh: 今天有個孩子差點在泳池溺水。我們絕對不可以讓這種事再發生。

items.en: The medical students learn this in their first week: doctors must never share their patients' secrets.
items.zh: 醫學生第一週就學到：醫生絕對不可以洩露病人的秘密。

examples.heading: ③ I must strongly + recommend / advise / suggest

items.en: Your guidebook is very useful. In addition, I must strongly recommend that you add something about nightlife.
items.zh: 你的旅遊書很有用。另外，我必須強烈建議你加一些夜生活的介紹。

items.en: Some parts of this contract aren't clear. I must strongly advise you not to sign it yet.
items.zh: 這份合約有些地方不清楚。我必須強烈建議你先不要簽。

items.en: You're visiting our town in June? I must strongly recommend the fish restaurant by the harbour.
items.zh: 你六月要來我們鎮上？我必須強烈推薦港口邊那家海鮮餐廳。

items.en: A hospital visit abroad can cost thousands. I must strongly suggest that you take out travel insurance.
items.zh: 在國外看一次醫院可能要好幾千元。我必須強烈建議你保旅遊險。

items.en: There have been some thefts in the hotel. We must strongly advise all guests to lock their rooms.
items.zh: 飯店裡發生了幾起竊案。我們必須強烈建議所有客人鎖好房門。

items.en: Your son is clearly very tired. I must strongly recommend a few days of rest.
items.zh: 你兒子顯然很累。我必須強烈建議他休息幾天。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + must first + 原形動詞：必須先

items.en: To get a visa for this country, you must first apply online.
items.zh: 要拿到這個國家的簽證，你必須先在網路上申請。

items.en: Before we discuss the budget, we must first agree on the plan.
items.zh: 討論預算之前，我們必須先就計畫達成共識。

items.en: Welcome to the climbing centre. New members must first attend a safety talk.
items.zh: 歡迎來到攀岩中心。新會員必須先參加安全說明會。

items.en: If you want to rent a flat in London, you must first show proof of income.
items.zh: 如果你想在倫敦租公寓，你必須先出示收入證明。

items.en: Sales of our new phone are low. The company must first find out what customers want.
items.zh: 我們新手機的銷量很低。公司必須先了解顧客想要什麼。

items.en: You want to grow carrots? Before planting, you must first dig the soil.
items.zh: 你想種紅蘿蔔？種之前，你必須先翻土。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + must certainly / also / therefore + 原形動詞

items.en: Customers are leaving because of the long queues. The new manager must certainly deal with this problem.
items.zh: 顧客因為排隊太久都走了。新經理一定要處理這個問題。

items.en: Our supplier has doubled its prices. We must therefore find a new one.
items.zh: 我們的供應商把價格提高了一倍。因此我們必須找一家新的。

items.en: Many young people get into debt with credit cards. Schools must also teach children about money.
items.zh: 很多年輕人用信用卡欠了債。學校也必須教孩子關於錢的知識。

items.en: Visitors can never find a space near the market. The town must therefore build a new car park.
items.zh: 遊客在市場附近總是找不到車位。因此這個鎮必須蓋一座新的停車場。

items.en: The art is amazing in this city. You must certainly visit the museum while you're here.
items.zh: 這個城市的藝術很精彩。你在這裡的時候一定要去參觀博物館。

items.en: The new laws affect students the most. The government must also listen to young people.
items.zh: 新法律對學生的影響最大。政府也必須傾聽年輕人的聲音。

items.en: The theatre lost money again this year. We must therefore raise the price of tickets.
items.zh: 劇院今年又虧錢了。因此我們必須提高票價。

title: In my opinion, our town must clearly use this area to create a park and a playground for children.
translation: 這個問題一定還有別的解決辦法。
name: must 後加副詞（較多種）
sentences: Recommendation: in my opinion, our town must clearly use this area to create a park and a playground for children.
Three parents complained about bullying this month. The school must clearly do more to stop it.
The concert is selling fast. We must definitely book the tickets this week.
I waited forty minutes on the phone again. The company must clearly improve its customer service.
You've had that pain for a month now. You must definitely see a doctor about your knee.
Nobody asked us about the new road. The council must clearly listen to local people.
Building on the park is not the answer. There must certainly be other solutions to the problem of space for new houses.
The train to Edinburgh costs two hundred pounds. There must surely be a cheaper way to travel.
Our car has broken down in this small village. There must certainly be someone who can help us.
We only had two coffees, and they charged us thirty pounds. There must surely be a mistake in the bill.
Dan hasn't spoken to us for a week. There must certainly be a reason for his silence.
Everyone has to cross the busy road to get on the bus. There must surely be a better place for the bus stop.
The article says that only doctors and lawyers earn a lot of money. I must completely disagree with this statement.
The letter in today's paper asks for more cycle paths. I must completely agree with the writer.
Tom says that homework is a waste of time. I must partly agree with him, but not completely.
The council wants to close our only library. I must strongly disagree with this decision.
People often say that teenagers don't work hard. I must completely reject the idea that young people are lazy.
I didn't check the plans before the building work started. I must partly accept the blame for what happened.
Our children have left home, and the bills are high. We must seriously consider moving to a smaller house.
Many families can't pay their heating bills this winter. The government must seriously think about the cost of energy.
This is a two-year rental agreement. You must carefully read the contract before you sign it.
Some teenagers spend eight hours a day on their phones. Parents must seriously think about how much time their children spend online.
The bank will read our report on Monday. We must carefully check every figure in it.
Our chess club has only six members left. The club must seriously look for new members.
Ask Mrs Cole about the grammar question. She must surely know the answer. She's a teacher.
Mum and Dad left the party two hours ago. They must certainly be home by now.
You've been at the hospital since six this morning. You must surely be tired.
Everybody laughed at the new design. The manager must certainly feel embarrassed now.
Ben shouted at his best friend in front of everyone. He must surely regret what he said.
Look at all the people in the queue for the new phone. It must certainly be popular.
Its trunk is four metres wide. This must surely be the oldest tree in the park.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + must + clearly / definitely + 原形動詞：意見和建議

items.en: Recommendation: in my opinion, our town must clearly use this area to create a park and a playground for children.
items.zh: 建議：我認為，我們鎮顯然必須用這塊地蓋一座公園和兒童遊樂場。

items.en: Three parents complained about bullying this month. The school must clearly do more to stop it.
items.zh: 這個月有三位家長投訴霸凌。學校顯然必須做更多事來阻止。

items.en: The concert is selling fast. We must definitely book the tickets this week.
items.zh: 音樂會的票賣得很快。我們這個星期一定要訂票。

items.en: I waited forty minutes on the phone again. The company must clearly improve its customer service.
items.zh: 我又在電話上等了四十分鐘。這家公司顯然必須改善客戶服務。

items.en: You've had that pain for a month now. You must definitely see a doctor about your knee.
items.zh: 你膝蓋痛了一個月了。你的膝蓋一定要去看醫生。

items.en: Nobody asked us about the new road. The council must clearly listen to local people.
items.zh: 沒有人問過我們新馬路的事。市議會顯然必須聽聽當地人的意見。

examples.heading: ② There + must + certainly / surely + be + 名詞：推論一定有

items.en: Building on the park is not the answer. There must certainly be other solutions to the problem of space for new houses.
items.zh: 在公園上蓋房子不是答案。新房子用地的問題一定還有其他解決辦法。

items.en: The train to Edinburgh costs two hundred pounds. There must surely be a cheaper way to travel.
items.zh: 去愛丁堡的火車要兩百英鎊。一定有比較便宜的旅行方式。

items.en: Our car has broken down in this small village. There must certainly be someone who can help us.
items.zh: 我們的車在這個小村子裡拋錨了。一定有人能幫我們。

items.en: We only had two coffees, and they charged us thirty pounds. There must surely be a mistake in the bill.
items.zh: 我們只喝了兩杯咖啡，他們卻收我們三十英鎊。帳單一定有錯。

items.en: Dan hasn't spoken to us for a week. There must certainly be a reason for his silence.
items.zh: Dan 一個星期沒跟我們說話了。他不說話一定有原因。

items.en: Everyone has to cross the busy road to get on the bus. There must surely be a better place for the bus stop.
items.zh: 每個人都要穿過車很多的馬路才能搭公車。公車站一定有更好的位置。

examples.heading: ③ I must + completely / strongly / partly + agree / disagree

items.en: The article says that only doctors and lawyers earn a lot of money. I must completely disagree with this statement.
items.zh: 那篇文章說只有醫生和律師才賺得到很多錢。我必須完全反對這個說法。

items.en: The letter in today's paper asks for more cycle paths. I must completely agree with the writer.
items.zh: 今天報紙上的投書要求更多自行車道。我必須完全同意寫信的人。

items.en: Tom says that homework is a waste of time. I must partly agree with him, but not completely.
items.zh: Tom 說回家作業是浪費時間。我必須部分同意他，可是不是完全同意。

items.en: The council wants to close our only library. I must strongly disagree with this decision.
items.zh: 議會想關掉我們唯一的圖書館。我必須強烈反對這個決定。

items.en: People often say that teenagers don't work hard. I must completely reject the idea that young people are lazy.
items.zh: 大家常說青少年不努力。我必須完全否定年輕人很懶的說法。

items.en: I didn't check the plans before the building work started. I must partly accept the blame for what happened.
items.zh: 施工開始前我沒有檢查設計圖。我必須承擔這件事的部分責任。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + must + seriously / carefully + 原形動詞

items.en: Our children have left home, and the bills are high. We must seriously consider moving to a smaller house.
items.zh: 孩子們都離家了，帳單又很高。我們必須認真考慮搬到小一點的房子。

items.en: Many families can't pay their heating bills this winter. The government must seriously think about the cost of energy.
items.zh: 很多家庭這個冬天付不起暖氣費。政府必須認真考慮能源的費用。

items.en: This is a two-year rental agreement. You must carefully read the contract before you sign it.
items.zh: 這是兩年的租約。你簽約前必須仔細讀合約。

items.en: Some teenagers spend eight hours a day on their phones. Parents must seriously think about how much time their children spend online.
items.zh: 有些青少年一天花八個小時用手機。父母必須認真想一想孩子花多少時間上網。

items.en: The bank will read our report on Monday. We must carefully check every figure in it.
items.zh: 銀行星期一會看我們的報告。我們必須仔細檢查報告裡的每一個數字。

items.en: Our chess club has only six members left. The club must seriously look for new members.
items.zh: 我們的西洋棋社只剩六個會員了。社團必須認真找新會員。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + must + surely / certainly + 原形動詞：推論

items.en: Ask Mrs Cole about the grammar question. She must surely know the answer. She's a teacher.
items.zh: 去問 Cole 太太那個文法問題。她一定知道答案。她是老師。

items.en: Mum and Dad left the party two hours ago. They must certainly be home by now.
items.zh: 爸媽兩個小時前就離開派對了。他們現在一定已經到家了。

items.en: You've been at the hospital since six this morning. You must surely be tired.
items.zh: 你從今天早上六點就在醫院了。你一定很累。

items.en: Everybody laughed at the new design. The manager must certainly feel embarrassed now.
items.zh: 大家都在笑新的設計。經理現在一定很尷尬。

items.en: Ben shouted at his best friend in front of everyone. He must surely regret what he said.
items.zh: Ben 在大家面前對他最好的朋友大吼。他一定後悔他說的話。

items.en: Look at all the people in the queue for the new phone. It must certainly be popular.
items.zh: 你看排隊買新手機的人。它一定很受歡迎。

items.en: Its trunk is four metres wide. This must surely be the oldest tree in the park.
items.zh: 它的樹幹有四公尺寬。這一定是公園裡最老的樹。

title: I would definitely choose to live by the seaside!
translation: 我一定會選擇住在海邊！
name: would 的句中副詞（really、probably）
sentences: I love swimming and the sound of the waves. I would definitely choose to live by the seaside!
If I won the lottery, I would definitely buy a house for my parents.
I would certainly help you if I had more time.
My mum would definitely say no to a motorbike.
We would certainly enjoy a week in the mountains.
A dog would definitely make my grandfather happier.
Please come and visit soon. I think you would really enjoy it, because it's very different from your town.
I would really like to see you before you leave.
My little sister would really love a trip to the zoo.
A holiday would really help you relax.
I'd really appreciate a lift to the airport on Sunday morning.
You would really like my cousin. She's very funny.
In my opinion, it would probably be the best idea to choose the biggest school.
It would probably be cheaper to take the train.
It would probably be better to wait until next week.
The film would probably be too scary for the children.
The trip would probably take about three hours.
A bigger flat would probably cost too much.
I'd really love to come to your wedding.
I'd probably stay at home if it rained.
I'd definitely recommend this hotel to my friends.
I'd certainly be happy to lend you my bike.
I'd probably take the bus rather than walk.
I'd really hate to miss the concert.
I probably wouldn't go there again.
She definitely wouldn't like that kind of music.
They certainly wouldn't agree to the new plan.
I really wouldn't want to live in such a big city.
He probably wouldn't notice if you left early.
My dad definitely wouldn't let me stay out so late.
We probably wouldn't have time to see everything.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + would definitely / certainly + 原形動詞：一定會

items.en: I love swimming and the sound of the waves. I would definitely choose to live by the seaside!
items.zh: 我很喜歡游泳和海浪的聲音。我一定會選擇住在海邊！

items.en: If I won the lottery, I would definitely buy a house for my parents.
items.zh: 如果我中了樂透，我一定會買一間房子給我爸媽。

items.en: I would certainly help you if I had more time.
items.zh: 如果我有更多時間，我一定會幫你。

items.en: My mum would definitely say no to a motorbike.
items.zh: 我媽媽一定會拒絕讓我騎摩托車。

items.en: We would certainly enjoy a week in the mountains.
items.zh: 我們一定會喜歡在山上待一個星期。

items.en: A dog would definitely make my grandfather happier.
items.zh: 一隻狗一定會讓我爺爺更快樂。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + would really + 原形動詞：真的會

items.en: Please come and visit soon. I think you would really enjoy it, because it's very different from your town.
items.zh: 請快點來玩。我想你會真的很喜歡，因為這裡跟你的城鎮很不一樣。

items.en: I would really like to see you before you leave.
items.zh: 在你離開之前，我真的很想見你一面。

items.en: My little sister would really love a trip to the zoo.
items.zh: 我妹妹會真的很喜歡去動物園。

items.en: A holiday would really help you relax.
items.zh: 一個假期會真的幫助你放鬆。

items.en: I'd really appreciate a lift to the airport on Sunday morning.
items.zh: 如果你星期天早上能載我去機場，我會真的很感激。

items.en: You would really like my cousin. She's very funny.
items.zh: 你會真的很喜歡我表姊。她很好笑。

examples.heading: ③ It would probably be + 名詞或形容詞：可能會

items.en: In my opinion, it would probably be the best idea to choose the biggest school.
items.zh: 我認為，選最大的那所學校可能會是最好的主意。

items.en: It would probably be cheaper to take the train.
items.zh: 搭火車可能會比較便宜。

items.en: It would probably be better to wait until next week.
items.zh: 等到下星期可能會比較好。

items.en: The film would probably be too scary for the children.
items.zh: 那部電影對孩子們來說可能太可怕了。

items.en: The trip would probably take about three hours.
items.zh: 這趟旅程可能要三個小時左右。

items.en: A bigger flat would probably cost too much.
items.zh: 大一點的公寓可能太貴了。

examples.heading: ④ I'd + 副詞 + 原形動詞：縮寫

items.en: I'd really love to come to your wedding.
items.zh: 我真的很想去參加你的婚禮。

items.en: I'd probably stay at home if it rained.
items.zh: 如果下雨，我可能會待在家。

items.en: I'd definitely recommend this hotel to my friends.
items.zh: 我一定會把這家飯店推薦給我的朋友。

items.en: I'd certainly be happy to lend you my bike.
items.zh: 我一定很樂意借你我的腳踏車。

items.en: I'd probably take the bus rather than walk.
items.zh: 我可能會搭公車，不會走路。

items.en: I'd really hate to miss the concert.
items.zh: 我真的很不想錯過那場演唱會。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + wouldn't + 副詞 + 原形動詞 / would + 副詞 + not

items.en: I probably wouldn't go there again.
items.zh: 我可能不會再去那裡了。

items.en: She definitely wouldn't like that kind of music.
items.zh: 她一定不會喜歡那種音樂。

items.en: They certainly wouldn't agree to the new plan.
items.zh: 他們一定不會同意新的計畫。

items.en: I really wouldn't want to live in such a big city.
items.zh: 我真的不想住在那麼大的城市。

items.en: He probably wouldn't notice if you left early.
items.zh: 如果你提早走，他可能不會注意到。

items.en: My dad definitely wouldn't let me stay out so late.
items.zh: 我爸爸一定不會讓我在外面待那麼晚。

items.en: We probably wouldn't have time to see everything.
items.zh: 我們可能沒有時間看完所有的東西。

title: I would strongly recommend the following changes.
translation: 我相信 Nascha 能輕易融入有小孩的家庭。
name: would 加副詞（較多種）
sentences: After looking at the results of my research, I would strongly recommend the following changes to our timetable.
I would strongly advise all students to get more sleep before exams.
I would strongly recommend this hotel to families with children.
I would strongly suggest that the school offers more sports.
I would strongly advise against driving in this weather.
We would strongly recommend booking at least a month in advance.
Because of her excellent experience with small children, I believe that Nascha would easily fit into a family with young kids.
With his language skills, he would easily find a job abroad.
The new sofa would easily fit in our living room.
A strong student like her would easily pass the exam.
Our car would easily take five people and their bags.
With a little training, he would easily become a good manager.
Children would especially enjoy the boat trip on the lake.
I would especially like to thank my parents for their help.
You would actually save money by buying a better coat.
The new road would actually make the traffic worse.
Older visitors would especially like the gardens.
A walk would actually help you sleep better.
If you need someone to look after your cat, I would gladly do it.
I'd gladly lend you my car for the weekend.
I would absolutely love to come to your wedding.
We'd gladly help with the school fair.
I would absolutely hate to work in such a noisy office.
She'd gladly show you around the city.
Most people would probably agree with this idea.
A bigger budget would greatly improve the library.
This change would seriously affect small shops.
A new park would really help the local children.
The plan would quickly become too expensive.
A short break would certainly do you good.
The new bus service would greatly help elderly people.

examples.heading: ① I would strongly + recommend / advise + …：報告的建議

items.en: After looking at the results of my research, I would strongly recommend the following changes to our timetable.
items.zh: 看了我的研究結果以後，我強烈建議對我們的時間表做以下的改變。

items.en: I would strongly advise all students to get more sleep before exams.
items.zh: 我強烈建議所有學生考試前多睡一點。

items.en: I would strongly recommend this hotel to families with children.
items.zh: 我強烈推薦這家飯店給有小孩的家庭。

items.en: I would strongly suggest that the school offers more sports.
items.zh: 我強烈建議學校提供更多運動項目。

items.en: I would strongly advise against driving in this weather.
items.zh: 我強烈建議不要在這種天氣開車。

items.en: We would strongly recommend booking at least a month in advance.
items.zh: 我們強烈建議至少提前一個月預訂。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + would easily + 原形動詞：推薦信

items.en: Because of her excellent experience with small children, I believe that Nascha would easily fit into a family with young kids.
items.zh: 因為她照顧小孩的經驗很豐富，我相信娜莎很容易就能融入有小孩的家庭。

items.en: With his language skills, he would easily find a job abroad.
items.zh: 以他的語言能力，他很容易就能在國外找到工作。

items.en: The new sofa would easily fit in our living room.
items.zh: 新沙發很容易就能放進我們的客廳。

items.en: A strong student like her would easily pass the exam.
items.zh: 像她這麼優秀的學生，很容易就能通過考試。

items.en: Our car would easily take five people and their bags.
items.zh: 我們的車很容易就能坐五個人和他們的行李。

items.en: With a little training, he would easily become a good manager.
items.zh: 稍微訓練一下，他很容易就能成為一個好經理。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + would especially / actually + 原形動詞

items.en: Children would especially enjoy the boat trip on the lake.
items.zh: 孩子們會特別喜歡在湖上搭船。

items.en: I would especially like to thank my parents for their help.
items.zh: 我特別想謝謝我爸媽的幫忙。

items.en: You would actually save money by buying a better coat.
items.zh: 買一件好一點的外套其實會幫你省錢。

items.en: The new road would actually make the traffic worse.
items.zh: 新的道路其實會讓交通更糟。

items.en: Older visitors would especially like the gardens.
items.zh: 年長的遊客會特別喜歡那些花園。

items.en: A walk would actually help you sleep better.
items.zh: 散步其實會幫你睡得比較好。

examples.heading: ④ I would / I'd + gladly / absolutely + 原形動詞：很樂意、非常

items.en: If you need someone to look after your cat, I would gladly do it.
items.zh: 如果你需要有人照顧你的貓，我很樂意幫忙。

items.en: I'd gladly lend you my car for the weekend.
items.zh: 我很樂意週末借你我的車。

items.en: I would absolutely love to come to your wedding.
items.zh: 我非常想去參加你的婚禮。

items.en: We'd gladly help with the school fair.
items.zh: 我們很樂意幫忙學校園遊會。

items.en: I would absolutely hate to work in such a noisy office.
items.zh: 我非常不想在那麼吵的辦公室工作。

items.en: She'd gladly show you around the city.
items.zh: 她很樂意帶你參觀這個城市。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + would + 副詞 + 原形動詞：其他常用的副詞

items.en: Most people would probably agree with this idea.
items.zh: 大部分的人可能會同意這個想法。

items.en: A bigger budget would greatly improve the library.
items.zh: 多一點預算會大大改善圖書館。

items.en: This change would seriously affect small shops.
items.zh: 這個改變會嚴重影響小商店。

items.en: A new park would really help the local children.
items.zh: 一座新公園會真的幫助當地的孩子。

items.en: The plan would quickly become too expensive.
items.zh: 這個計畫會很快變得太貴。

items.en: A short break would certainly do you good.
items.zh: 休息一下一定會對你有好處。

items.en: The new bus service would greatly help elderly people.
items.zh: 新的公車服務會大大幫助老人。

title: The construction of such a centre would undoubtedly improve our quality of life.
translation: 舉辦以家庭為主的活動會讓會員人數大幅增加。
name: would 後加副詞（較多種）
sentences: I believe that a new leisure centre would undoubtedly improve our quality of life.
A new hospital would undoubtedly save many lives.
Cheaper buses would obviously reduce the number of cars.
More trees would undoubtedly make the streets cooler in summer.
A longer holiday would obviously please the staff.
Better lighting would undoubtedly make the park safer at night.
Organising family activities would significantly increase membership and make the society more popular.
A new railway line would significantly reduce travel times.
Higher taxes would significantly affect poorer families.
Online booking would significantly cut the queues.
A four-day week would significantly improve the health of office workers.
A bigger car park would significantly help the local shops.
Without repairs, the old bridge would eventually fall down.
More cars would inevitably lead to more pollution.
If prices keep rising, people would eventually stop buying.
Cutting the budget would inevitably mean fewer teachers.
With practice, you would eventually speak like a native.
Building on the field would inevitably cause flooding.
I would personally choose the smaller school in the countryside.
I would personally prefer a quiet holiday.
I would personally never buy a car without a test drive.
I would personally like to see more trees in the town centre.
I would personally recommend the train over the bus.
I would personally avoid that area at night.
The new plan would possibly cost less than the old one.
I would normally take the bus, but today I'm walking.
The trip would possibly take two days.
She would normally be at work by now.
A smaller school would possibly suit him better.
We would normally eat dinner at seven.
The changes would possibly take effect next year.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + would undoubtedly / obviously + 原形動詞：很確定的影響

items.en: I believe that a new leisure centre would undoubtedly improve our quality of life.
items.zh: 我相信一座新的休閒中心無疑會改善我們的生活品質。

items.en: A new hospital would undoubtedly save many lives.
items.zh: 一間新醫院無疑會拯救很多生命。

items.en: Cheaper buses would obviously reduce the number of cars.
items.zh: 比較便宜的公車顯然會減少車子的數量。

items.en: More trees would undoubtedly make the streets cooler in summer.
items.zh: 更多的樹無疑會讓夏天的街道涼快一點。

items.en: A longer holiday would obviously please the staff.
items.zh: 更長的假期顯然會讓員工高興。

items.en: Better lighting would undoubtedly make the park safer at night.
items.zh: 更好的照明無疑會讓公園晚上更安全。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + would significantly + 原形動詞：影響很大

items.en: Organising family activities would significantly increase membership and make the society more popular.
items.zh: 辦家庭活動會大大增加會員人數，讓這個協會更受歡迎。

items.en: A new railway line would significantly reduce travel times.
items.zh: 一條新的鐵路線會大大縮短交通時間。

items.en: Higher taxes would significantly affect poorer families.
items.zh: 提高稅會大大影響比較窮的家庭。

items.en: Online booking would significantly cut the queues.
items.zh: 網路訂票會大大減少排隊的人。

items.en: A four-day week would significantly improve the health of office workers.
items.zh: 一星期工作四天會大大改善上班族的健康。

items.en: A bigger car park would significantly help the local shops.
items.zh: 大一點的停車場會大大幫助當地的商店。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + would eventually / inevitably + 原形動詞：最後的結果

items.en: Without repairs, the old bridge would eventually fall down.
items.zh: 不修理的話，那座老橋最後會倒塌。

items.en: More cars would inevitably lead to more pollution.
items.zh: 更多車子必然會導致更多污染。

items.en: If prices keep rising, people would eventually stop buying.
items.zh: 如果價格一直上漲，人們最後會停止購買。

items.en: Cutting the budget would inevitably mean fewer teachers.
items.zh: 刪減預算必然意味著老師會變少。

items.en: With practice, you would eventually speak like a native.
items.zh: 經過練習，你最後會說得像母語人士一樣。

items.en: Building on the field would inevitably cause flooding.
items.zh: 在那塊田上蓋房子必然會造成水災。

examples.heading: ④ I would personally + 原形動詞：說個人的看法

items.en: I would personally choose the smaller school in the countryside.
items.zh: 我個人會選鄉下那所比較小的學校。

items.en: I would personally prefer a quiet holiday.
items.zh: 我個人比較喜歡安靜的假期。

items.en: I would personally never buy a car without a test drive.
items.zh: 我個人絕對不會沒試開就買車。

items.en: I would personally like to see more trees in the town centre.
items.zh: 我個人希望市中心有更多的樹。

items.en: I would personally recommend the train over the bus.
items.zh: 我個人會推薦搭火車，不推薦公車。

items.en: I would personally avoid that area at night.
items.zh: 我個人晚上會避開那一區。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + would possibly / normally + 原形動詞

items.en: The new plan would possibly cost less than the old one.
items.zh: 新計畫可能會比舊的花費少。
