items.en: I would normally take the bus, but today I'm walking.
items.zh: 我通常會搭公車，可是今天我走路。

items.en: The trip would possibly take two days.
items.zh: 這趟旅行可能要兩天。

items.en: She would normally be at work by now.
items.zh: 她現在通常已經在上班了。

items.en: A smaller school would possibly suit him better.
items.zh: 小一點的學校可能比較適合他。

items.en: We would normally eat dinner at seven.
items.zh: 我們通常七點吃晚餐。

items.en: The changes would possibly take effect next year.
items.zh: 這些改變可能明年生效。

title: I can cook.
translation: 我會做菜。
name: can 表示能力
sentences: I can cook, and I can clean too.
I can write English, but my speaking isn't very good.
My dad can make bread.
She can ride a horse.
I can type with ten fingers without looking at the keyboard.
My brother can sing and dance.
We can both ski.
He can count to a hundred in French.
My little sister can read now.
I can play chess.
Our teacher can speak four languages.
Penguins can swim, but they can't fly.
I can speak Italian a little.
She can draw horses and dogs very well for a seven-year-old.
My mum can play the piano quite well.
My cousin can play the violin a little, but only simple songs.
My uncle can repair old radios really well.
They can dance really well.
I can't read very well in English.
My grandma can't use a computer.
I can't ride a bike.
He cannot go up stairs, so he lives on the ground floor.
She can't swim, so she stays near the beach.
I can't whistle, no matter how hard I try.
My brother can't cook at all.
Our new puppy can't climb the stairs yet.
I can't sing.
Can you cook anything without a recipe?
Can your sister speak English?
Can you use this machine?
Can he play tennis?

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + can + 原形動詞：會做的事

items.en: I can cook, and I can clean too.
items.zh: 我會做菜，也會打掃。

items.en: I can write English, but my speaking isn't very good.
items.zh: 我會寫英文，可是口說不太好。

items.en: My dad can make bread.
items.zh: 我爸會做麵包。

items.en: She can ride a horse.
items.zh: 她會騎馬。

items.en: I can type with ten fingers without looking at the keyboard.
items.zh: 我可以十指打字，不用看鍵盤。

items.en: My brother can sing and dance.
items.zh: 我哥會唱歌也會跳舞。

items.en: We can both ski.
items.zh: 我們兩個都會滑雪。

items.en: He can count to a hundred in French.
items.zh: 他會用法文從一數到一百。

items.en: My little sister can read now.
items.zh: 我妹現在會讀書了。

items.en: I can play chess.
items.zh: 我會下西洋棋。

items.en: Our teacher can speak four languages.
items.zh: 我們老師會說四種語言。

items.en: Penguins can swim, but they can't fly.
items.zh: 企鵝會游泳，可是不會飛。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + can + 原形動詞 + well / a little

items.en: I can speak Italian a little.
items.zh: 我會說一點義大利文。

items.en: She can draw horses and dogs very well for a seven-year-old.
items.zh: 以七歲的孩子來說，她馬和狗畫得很好。

items.en: My mum can play the piano quite well.
items.zh: 我媽鋼琴彈得還不錯。

items.en: My cousin can play the violin a little, but only simple songs.
items.zh: 我表妹會拉一點小提琴，不過只會簡單的曲子。

items.en: My uncle can repair old radios really well.
items.zh: 我叔叔很會修舊收音機。

items.en: They can dance really well.
items.zh: 他們舞跳得很好。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + can't / cannot + 原形動詞：不會的事

items.en: I can't read very well in English.
items.zh: 我英文讀得不太好。

items.en: My grandma can't use a computer.
items.zh: 我奶奶不會用電腦。

items.en: I can't ride a bike.
items.zh: 我不會騎腳踏車。

items.en: He cannot go up stairs, so he lives on the ground floor.
items.zh: 他沒辦法爬樓梯，所以他住在一樓。

items.en: She can't swim, so she stays near the beach.
items.zh: 她不會游泳，所以她待在岸邊。

items.en: I can't whistle, no matter how hard I try.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，我都不會吹口哨。

items.en: My brother can't cook at all.
items.zh: 我哥完全不會做菜。

items.en: Our new puppy can't climb the stairs yet.
items.zh: 我們的新小狗還不會爬樓梯。

items.en: I can't sing.
items.zh: 我不會唱歌。

examples.heading: ④ Can + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?：問能力

items.en: Can you cook anything without a recipe?
items.zh: 你可以不看食譜做出什麼菜嗎？

items.en: Can your sister speak English?
items.zh: 你姊會說英文嗎？

items.en: Can you use this machine?
items.zh: 你會用這台機器嗎？

items.en: Can he play tennis?
items.zh: 他會打網球嗎？

title: I couldn't buy the T-shirt because it was too expensive.
translation: 我買不起那件 T 恤，因為它太貴了。
name: couldn't 表示沒有能力
sentences: I couldn't get the lid off the jar.
She couldn't remember where she had parked.
We couldn't see anything in the dark.
He couldn't swim when he was little.
They couldn't hear the teacher at the back of the room.
I couldn't understand the question.
My dad couldn't fix the car.
The baby couldn't stop crying.
I couldn't work without the key to the office.
We couldn't get tickets for the concert.
I couldn't call you because my phone was dead.
She couldn't come to the party because she was sick.
We couldn't finish the game because it got dark.
He couldn't eat the cake because he is allergic to nuts.
I couldn't sleep because the neighbours were too noisy.
They couldn't buy the house because it cost too much.
I couldn't read the sign because it was too far away.
She couldn't answer the phone because she was driving.
We couldn't fly home because of the snow.
I couldn't concentrate because of the noise.
They couldn't play football because of the rain.
She couldn't walk far because of her bad knee.
He couldn't see the stage because of the tall man in front of him.
It was so hot that I couldn't sleep.
The box was too heavy. I couldn't lift it.
I couldn't find a taxi, so I walked home.
The water was too cold. We couldn't stay in for long.
She couldn't decide, so she bought both dresses.
The shop was closed, so I couldn't buy any bread.
The film was so sad that he couldn't stop crying.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + couldn't + 原形動詞

items.en: I couldn't get the lid off the jar.
items.zh: 我轉不開罐子的蓋子。

items.en: She couldn't remember where she had parked.
items.zh: 她想不起來車停在哪裡。

items.en: We couldn't see anything in the dark.
items.zh: 天太黑，我們什麼都看不到。

items.en: He couldn't swim when he was little.
items.zh: 他小時候不會游泳。

items.en: They couldn't hear the teacher at the back of the room.
items.zh: 他們坐在教室後面，聽不到老師說話。

items.en: I couldn't understand the question.
items.zh: 我看不懂那個問題。

items.en: My dad couldn't fix the car.
items.zh: 我爸爸修不好那輛車。

items.en: The baby couldn't stop crying.
items.zh: 寶寶一直哭個不停。

items.en: I couldn't work without the key to the office.
items.zh: 沒有辦公室的鑰匙，我沒辦法工作。

items.en: We couldn't get tickets for the concert.
items.zh: 我們買不到演唱會的票。

examples.heading: ② couldn't + 原形動詞 + because + 原因

items.en: I couldn't call you because my phone was dead.
items.zh: 我沒辦法打給你，因為我的手機沒電了。

items.en: She couldn't come to the party because she was sick.
items.zh: 她沒辦法來派對，因為她生病了。

items.en: We couldn't finish the game because it got dark.
items.zh: 我們沒辦法把比賽打完，因為天黑了。

items.en: He couldn't eat the cake because he is allergic to nuts.
items.zh: 他不能吃那個蛋糕，因為他對堅果過敏。

items.en: I couldn't sleep because the neighbours were too noisy.
items.zh: 我睡不著，因為鄰居太吵了。

items.en: They couldn't buy the house because it cost too much.
items.zh: 他們買不起那間房子，因為太貴了。

items.en: I couldn't read the sign because it was too far away.
items.zh: 我看不清那個標誌，因為太遠了。

items.en: She couldn't answer the phone because she was driving.
items.zh: 她沒辦法接電話，因為她在開車。

examples.heading: ③ couldn't + 原形動詞 + because of + 名詞

items.en: We couldn't fly home because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，我們沒辦法搭飛機回家。

items.en: I couldn't concentrate because of the noise.
items.zh: 因為太吵，我沒辦法專心。

items.en: They couldn't play football because of the rain.
items.zh: 因為下雨，他們沒辦法踢足球。

items.en: She couldn't walk far because of her bad knee.
items.zh: 因為膝蓋不好，她沒辦法走太遠。

items.en: He couldn't see the stage because of the tall man in front of him.
items.zh: 因為前面那個高個子，他看不到舞台。

examples.heading: ④ couldn't + 原形動詞，前後說出結果

items.en: It was so hot that I couldn't sleep.
items.zh: 天氣熱得我睡不著。

items.en: The box was too heavy. I couldn't lift it.
items.zh: 那個箱子太重了。我抬不起來。

items.en: I couldn't find a taxi, so I walked home.
items.zh: 我叫不到計程車，所以走路回家。

items.en: The water was too cold. We couldn't stay in for long.
items.zh: 水太冷了。我們沒辦法在水裡待太久。

items.en: She couldn't decide, so she bought both dresses.
items.zh: 她決定不了，所以兩件洋裝都買了。

items.en: The shop was closed, so I couldn't buy any bread.
items.zh: 店關了，所以我沒買到麵包。

items.en: The film was so sad that he couldn't stop crying.
items.zh: 那部電影太感人了，他哭個不停。

title: She could hear a man talking.
translation: 她聽得到有個男人在說話。
name: could 表示能力
sentences: I could see the sea from my bedroom window.
She could hear the rain on the roof.
We could smell fresh bread from the bakery.
He could feel the sun on his face.
They could see the lights of the city below.
I could hear my neighbours arguing.
The children could see a bird building a nest.
She could smell something burning in the kitchen.
I could feel my heart beating fast.
We could hear music coming from the house next door.
From the top, you could see three countries.
He could taste the salt in the air.
I could understand most of the film without subtitles.
She could remember every word of the song.
He could understand a little Japanese.
My grandfather could remember the day the war ended.
My son could count to a hundred at four.
By the age of ten, he could play the piano well.
My grandmother could sew her own clothes.
When I lived in Spain, I could speak Spanish quite well.
Our dog could open the gate with its nose.
She could run very fast when she was young.
As a child, I could climb any tree in the park.
He could cook only one dish, but he cooked it very well.
The hotel was close, so we could walk everywhere.
In my old job, I could work from home on Fridays.
With the new glasses, she could read the small print.
The library was open late, so students could study there at night.
Back then, you could buy a bus ticket for ten cents.
On a clear day, we could see the island from the beach.

examples.heading: ① could + see / hear / smell / feel

items.en: I could see the sea from my bedroom window.
items.zh: 我從臥室窗戶看得到海。

items.en: She could hear the rain on the roof.
items.zh: 她聽得到雨打在屋頂上的聲音。

items.en: We could smell fresh bread from the bakery.
items.zh: 我們聞得到麵包店飄來的新鮮麵包香。

items.en: He could feel the sun on his face.
items.zh: 他感覺得到臉上的陽光。

items.en: They could see the lights of the city below.
items.zh: 他們看得到下面城市的燈光。

items.en: I could hear my neighbours arguing.
items.zh: 我聽得到鄰居在吵架。

items.en: The children could see a bird building a nest.
items.zh: 孩子們看得到一隻鳥在築巢。

items.en: She could smell something burning in the kitchen.
items.zh: 她聞得到廚房裡有東西燒焦了。

items.en: I could feel my heart beating fast.
items.zh: 我感覺得到自己的心跳得很快。

items.en: We could hear music coming from the house next door.
items.zh: 我們聽得到隔壁房子傳來的音樂。

items.en: From the top, you could see three countries.
items.zh: 從山頂上看得到三個國家。

items.en: He could taste the salt in the air.
items.zh: 他嚐得到空氣中的鹹味。

examples.heading: ② could + understand / remember

items.en: I could understand most of the film without subtitles.
items.zh: 那部電影不看字幕，我大部分也聽得懂。

items.en: She could remember every word of the song.
items.zh: 那首歌的每個字她都記得。

items.en: He could understand a little Japanese.
items.zh: 他聽得懂一點日文。

items.en: My grandfather could remember the day the war ended.
items.zh: 我爺爺記得戰爭結束那天的事。

examples.heading: ③ could + 原形動詞，過去會的技能

items.en: My son could count to a hundred at four.
items.zh: 我兒子四歲就會數到一百了。

items.en: By the age of ten, he could play the piano well.
items.zh: 他十歲的時候，鋼琴就彈得很好了。

items.en: My grandmother could sew her own clothes.
items.zh: 我奶奶會自己縫衣服。

items.en: When I lived in Spain, I could speak Spanish quite well.
items.zh: 我住在西班牙的時候，西班牙文說得還不錯。

items.en: Our dog could open the gate with its nose.
items.zh: 我們家的狗會用鼻子把柵門頂開。

items.en: She could run very fast when she was young.
items.zh: 她年輕的時候跑得很快。

items.en: As a child, I could climb any tree in the park.
items.zh: 我小時候，公園裡的每一棵樹我都爬得上去。

items.en: He could cook only one dish, but he cooked it very well.
items.zh: 他只會做一道菜，可是做得很好。

examples.heading: ④ could + 原形動詞，當時的情況讓人做得到

items.en: The hotel was close, so we could walk everywhere.
items.zh: 飯店很近，所以我們去哪裡都可以走路。

items.en: In my old job, I could work from home on Fridays.
items.zh: 我以前那份工作，星期五可以在家上班。

items.en: With the new glasses, she could read the small print.
items.zh: 戴了新眼鏡，她看得清小字了。

items.en: The library was open late, so students could study there at night.
items.zh: 圖書館開到很晚，所以學生晚上可以在那裡讀書。

items.en: Back then, you could buy a bus ticket for ten cents.
items.zh: 那個時候，十分錢就買得到一張公車票。

items.en: On a clear day, we could see the island from the beach.
items.zh: 天氣晴朗的時候，我們從海灘看得到那座島。

title: If you'd rather go with your friend, you ought to talk to your parents first.
translation: 我覺得你週末應該去打網球或踢足球。
name: you ought to 給勸告
sentences: If you'd rather go with your friend, you ought to talk to your parents first and tell them how you feel.
Before you build the bookcase, you ought to read the instructions first.
If you want Friday off, you ought to ask your boss first.
Those boots are two hundred pounds, so you ought to try them on first.
Before you climb Snowdon on Saturday, you ought to check the forecast first.
If you want to travel round Asia next year, you ought to save some money first.
You sit at your computer all week. I think you ought to play tennis or football at the weekend.
You shouted at your sister this morning. I think you ought to apologise to her.
You look exhausted after the trip. I think you ought to go to bed early tonight.
You've just moved here and you don't know anyone. I think you ought to join a club to meet new people.
The traffic to Manchester is terrible on Fridays. I think you ought to take the train.
That's an expensive camera. I think you ought to keep the receipt.
Headaches can come from not drinking enough. You ought to drink more water.
Your dentist found three holes in your teeth. You ought to stop eating so much sugar.
Your office is only a mile away. You ought to walk to work instead of driving.
The doctor says it's only a sprain. You ought to rest your leg for a few days.
The sun is very strong in Spain in August. You ought to wear sun cream at the beach.
You've been studying until three every night. You ought to get more sleep before exams.
Your grammar is good, but you're shy when you talk. You ought to practise speaking English every day.
The new topic is hard. You ought to ask questions if you don't understand.
The museum needs a guide who speaks three languages. You ought to apply for that job.
You keep forgetting new words. You ought to write them down in a notebook.
Your essay is due on Wednesday. You ought to start it this weekend.
You don't know what to study at university? You ought to talk to a careers adviser.
Want to see the band in May? You ought to book early because the tickets sell out fast.
The desert is hot in the day, but you ought to take a jacket because it gets cold at night.
The train to Edinburgh takes five hours, so you ought to bring something to read.
Your mum phoned me twice today. You ought to call her because she's worried about you.
It was minus five last night. The roads are icy, so you ought to drive slowly.
The new space film is out this week. You ought to see it because you love science fiction.
Welcome to the city centre. You ought to lock your bike because things get stolen here.

examples.heading: ① you ought to + 原形動詞 + first：先做的事

items.en: If you'd rather go with your friend, you ought to talk to your parents first and tell them how you feel.
items.zh: 如果你比較想跟朋友去，你應該先跟你爸媽談一談，告訴他們你的感受。

items.en: Before you build the bookcase, you ought to read the instructions first.
items.zh: 組書櫃之前，你應該先讀說明書。

items.en: If you want Friday off, you ought to ask your boss first.
items.zh: 如果你星期五想請假，你應該先問你的老闆。

items.en: Those boots are two hundred pounds, so you ought to try them on first.
items.zh: 那雙靴子要兩百英鎊，所以你應該先試穿。

items.en: Before you climb Snowdon on Saturday, you ought to check the forecast first.
items.zh: 你星期六爬 Snowdon 山之前，應該先看一下天氣預報。

items.en: If you want to travel round Asia next year, you ought to save some money first.
items.zh: 如果你明年想去亞洲旅行，你應該先存一些錢。

examples.heading: ② I think you ought to + 原形動詞：客氣的建議

items.en: You sit at your computer all week. I think you ought to play tennis or football at the weekend.
items.zh: 你整個星期都坐在電腦前。我想你週末應該去打網球或踢足球。

items.en: You shouted at your sister this morning. I think you ought to apologise to her.
items.zh: 你今天早上對你妹妹大吼。我想你應該跟她道歉。

items.en: You look exhausted after the trip. I think you ought to go to bed early tonight.
items.zh: 旅行回來你看起來好累。我想你今天晚上應該早點睡。

items.en: You've just moved here and you don't know anyone. I think you ought to join a club to meet new people.
items.zh: 你剛搬來這裡，誰都不認識。我想你應該加入一個社團，認識新朋友。

items.en: The traffic to Manchester is terrible on Fridays. I think you ought to take the train.
items.zh: 星期五去曼徹斯特的路很塞。我想你應該搭火車。

items.en: That's an expensive camera. I think you ought to keep the receipt.
items.zh: 那是一台很貴的相機。我想你應該留著收據。

examples.heading: ③ you ought to + 原形動詞：關於健康

items.en: Headaches can come from not drinking enough. You ought to drink more water.
items.zh: 頭痛可能是喝水不夠。你應該多喝水。

items.en: Your dentist found three holes in your teeth. You ought to stop eating so much sugar.
items.zh: 你的牙醫發現你有三顆蛀牙。你應該少吃一點糖。

items.en: Your office is only a mile away. You ought to walk to work instead of driving.
items.zh: 你的辦公室只有一英里遠。你應該走路上班，不要開車。

items.en: The doctor says it's only a sprain. You ought to rest your leg for a few days.
items.zh: 醫生說只是扭傷。你的腳應該休息幾天。

items.en: The sun is very strong in Spain in August. You ought to wear sun cream at the beach.
items.zh: 八月西班牙的太陽很大。你在海灘應該擦防曬乳。

items.en: You've been studying until three every night. You ought to get more sleep before exams.
items.zh: 你每天晚上都讀到三點。考試前你應該多睡一點。

examples.heading: ④ you ought to + 原形動詞：關於學習和工作

items.en: Your grammar is good, but you're shy when you talk. You ought to practise speaking English every day.
items.zh: 你的文法很好，可是你說話很害羞。你應該每天練習說英文。

items.en: The new topic is hard. You ought to ask questions if you don't understand.
items.zh: 新的單元很難。如果你不懂，你應該發問。

items.en: The museum needs a guide who speaks three languages. You ought to apply for that job.
items.zh: 博物館需要會說三種語言的導覽員。你應該去應徵那份工作。

items.en: You keep forgetting new words. You ought to write them down in a notebook.
items.zh: 你一直忘記新單字。你應該把它們寫在筆記本裡。

items.en: Your essay is due on Wednesday. You ought to start it this weekend.
items.zh: 你的作文星期三要交。你這個週末應該開始寫。

items.en: You don't know what to study at university? You ought to talk to a careers adviser.
items.zh: 你不知道大學要念什麼？你應該找職涯顧問談談。

examples.heading: ⑤ you ought to + 原形動詞 + because / so + 子句

items.en: Want to see the band in May? You ought to book early because the tickets sell out fast.
items.zh: 想看五月那個樂團的表演？你應該早點訂，因為票賣得很快。

items.en: The desert is hot in the day, but you ought to take a jacket because it gets cold at night.
items.zh: 沙漠白天很熱，可是你應該帶件外套，因為晚上會變冷。

items.en: The train to Edinburgh takes five hours, so you ought to bring something to read.
items.zh: 去愛丁堡的火車要五個小時，所以你應該帶點東西讀。

items.en: Your mum phoned me twice today. You ought to call her because she's worried about you.
items.zh: 你媽媽今天打給我兩次。你應該打給她，因為她很擔心你。

items.en: It was minus five last night. The roads are icy, so you ought to drive slowly.
items.zh: 昨晚零下五度。路上結冰，所以你應該開慢一點。

items.en: The new space film is out this week. You ought to see it because you love science fiction.
items.zh: 新的太空電影這個星期上映。你應該去看，因為你很喜歡科幻片。

items.en: Welcome to the city centre. You ought to lock your bike because things get stolen here.
items.zh: 歡迎來到市中心。你應該把腳踏車鎖好，因為這裡常有東西被偷。（被動）

title: It was only seventy euros. It looks very nice. My advice: you should buy this.
translation: 你應該帶點吃的，因為你會餓。
name: should 表示勸告
sentences: It was only seventy euros, and the pink looks lovely on you. My advice: you should buy it.
These boots are half price today. You should get them before they sell out.
That jacket is too small. You should try a bigger size.
The market sells fresh fish every morning. You should go early.
The blue shirt suits you better. You should take that one.
You should keep the receipt in case it doesn't fit.
On Monday you will stay in this class for six hours, so you should bring something to eat because you'll be hungry.
You should take some money, because the ticket costs four pounds.
You should wear a hat, because the sun is very strong today.
You should leave now, because the traffic gets bad after five.
You should bring a towel, because the pool doesn't lend them.
You should learn a few words of Greek, because not everyone speaks English there.
You look really tired. I think you should go to bed early tonight.
I think you should tell your teacher that you didn't understand.
I think you should join the drama club. You're very funny.
I think you should call the landlord about the broken window.
I think you should take the job in London.
I think you should say sorry to your brother.
You've had that cough for weeks. You should see a doctor.
You should eat some fruit instead of crisps.
You should walk to school. It's good exercise.
You should drink a glass of water before every meal.
You should turn off your phone an hour before you sleep.
You should stretch before you go running.
Your sister loves animals. She should work at the zoo.
He's always late. He should buy an alarm clock.
They've got four children. They should buy a bigger car.
She sings beautifully. She should enter the competition.
My dad works too hard. He should take a holiday.
The new students look lost. They should ask for a map at reception.
Tom wants to get fit. He should join our football team.

examples.heading: ① You should + buy / get / try：購物的建議

items.en: It was only seventy euros, and the pink looks lovely on you. My advice: you should buy it.
items.zh: 只要七十歐元，而且粉紅色很適合你。我的建議是：你應該買。

items.en: These boots are half price today. You should get them before they sell out.
items.zh: 這雙靴子今天半價。你應該在賣完之前買。

items.en: That jacket is too small. You should try a bigger size.
items.zh: 那件外套太小了。你應該試大一號的。

items.en: The market sells fresh fish every morning. You should go early.
items.zh: 市場每天早上都賣新鮮的魚。你應該早點去。

items.en: The blue shirt suits you better. You should take that one.
items.zh: 藍色那件襯衫比較適合你。你應該買那件。

items.en: You should keep the receipt in case it doesn't fit.
items.zh: 你應該留著收據，萬一不合身。

examples.heading: ② You should + 原形動詞 + because + 子句：說明理由

items.en: On Monday you will stay in this class for six hours, so you should bring something to eat because you'll be hungry.
items.zh: 星期一你要在這個教室待六個小時，所以你應該帶點東西吃，因為你會餓。

items.en: You should take some money, because the ticket costs four pounds.
items.zh: 你應該帶點錢，因為票要四英鎊。

items.en: You should wear a hat, because the sun is very strong today.
items.zh: 你應該戴帽子，因為今天太陽很大。

items.en: You should leave now, because the traffic gets bad after five.
items.zh: 你應該現在走，因為五點以後會塞車。

items.en: You should bring a towel, because the pool doesn't lend them.
items.zh: 你應該帶毛巾，因為游泳池不借毛巾。

items.en: You should learn a few words of Greek, because not everyone speaks English there.
items.zh: 你應該學幾個希臘文的字，因為那裡不是每個人都說英文。

examples.heading: ③ I think you should + 原形動詞：客氣的建議

items.en: You look really tired. I think you should go to bed early tonight.
items.zh: 你看起來很累。我想你今天晚上應該早點睡。

items.en: I think you should tell your teacher that you didn't understand.
items.zh: 我想你應該告訴你的老師你沒聽懂。

items.en: I think you should join the drama club. You're very funny.
items.zh: 我想你應該加入戲劇社。你很好笑。

items.en: I think you should call the landlord about the broken window.
items.zh: 我想你應該打電話給房東說窗戶破了。

items.en: I think you should take the job in London.
items.zh: 我想你應該接受倫敦的那份工作。

items.en: I think you should say sorry to your brother.
items.zh: 我想你應該跟你弟弟說對不起。

examples.heading: ④ You should + 原形動詞：健康的建議

items.en: You've had that cough for weeks. You should see a doctor.
items.zh: 你咳了好幾個星期了。你應該去看醫生。

items.en: You should eat some fruit instead of crisps.
items.zh: 你應該吃點水果，不要吃洋芋片。

items.en: You should walk to school. It's good exercise.
items.zh: 你應該走路上學。那是很好的運動。

items.en: You should drink a glass of water before every meal.
items.zh: 你每餐飯前應該喝一杯水。

items.en: You should turn off your phone an hour before you sleep.
items.zh: 你睡前一個小時應該把手機關掉。

items.en: You should stretch before you go running.
items.zh: 你跑步前應該先伸展。

examples.heading: ⑤ He / She / They + should + 原形動詞：建議別人

items.en: Your sister loves animals. She should work at the zoo.
items.zh: 你妹妹很喜歡動物。她應該去動物園工作。

items.en: He's always late. He should buy an alarm clock.
items.zh: 他總是遲到。他應該買一個鬧鐘。

items.en: They've got four children. They should buy a bigger car.
items.zh: 他們有四個孩子。他們應該買一台大一點的車。

items.en: She sings beautifully. She should enter the competition.
items.zh: 她唱得很好聽。她應該參加比賽。

items.en: My dad works too hard. He should take a holiday.
items.zh: 我爸爸工作太辛苦了。他應該去度假。

items.en: The new students look lost. They should ask for a map at reception.
items.zh: 新生看起來很迷茫。他們應該去櫃台拿一張地圖。

items.en: Tom wants to get fit. He should join our football team.
items.zh: 湯姆想變健康。他應該加入我們的足球隊。

title: If we do not receive a reply this time, we shall take the matter to court.
translation: 如果這次我們還是沒收到回覆，我們將會提告。
name: if 子句後主要子句用 shall
sentences: This is our third letter. If we do not receive a reply this time, we shall take the matter to court.
Dear Mr Kent, you are two months behind with the rent. If it is not paid by Friday, we shall ask you to leave the flat.
A letter to the people in flat six: if the noise continues after midnight, we shall call the police.
Your library books are three months late. If you do not return them, we shall charge you for them.
We ordered the desks in March. If the goods do not arrive by Monday, we shall cancel the order.
The machines have broken down three times this month. If the problem is not fixed, we shall look for another supplier.
People live longer now, which is good, but if things get out of hand, we shall be doomed to live in chaos.
Half the rainforest has already gone. If we keep cutting down the forests, we shall be left with nothing.
Our village is right next to the river. If it floods again, we shall be in serious trouble.
Energy bills doubled last winter. If we don't save energy now, we shall be sorry later.
House prices went up fifteen per cent this year. If they keep rising, we shall be unable to buy a house.
Our village has no bus service. If the trains stop running, we shall be cut off from the city.
My car is at the garage this week. If the weather is good, I shall walk to work tomorrow.
My exams finish in June. If I pass them, I shall go to university in Edinburgh.
I'm working late tonight. If you need anything, I shall be in my office until six.
I had a great interview at the bank. If they offer me the job, I shall accept it immediately.
I want to return these shoes today. If the shop is closed, I shall try again on Monday.
My project is due on Friday. If I have time after that, I shall visit you at the weekend.
We've sent out the invitations for the talk. If enough people come, we shall hire a bigger room.
The forecast says sun on Saturday. If it's right, we shall have the party in the garden.
We've seen the cottage twice and we love it. If the price is reasonable, we shall buy it.
It's been a long week at school. If the children are tired, we shall stay at home on Sunday.
We are testing a new self-service till in one shop. If the plan works, we shall use it in all our shops.
The drive to the coast takes four hours. If we leave at eight, we shall arrive before lunch.
Sales have fallen for six months. Unless we act now, we shall lose the support of our customers.
The new project is huge, but as long as we work together, we shall succeed.
The pitch is under water. Unless the weather improves, we shall cancel the match.
We've just left Leeds. As long as the roads are clear, we shall be there by six.
This is your final notice. Unless you pay the fine, we shall take further action.
There are forty boxes to move. As long as everyone helps, we shall finish the job today.
We lost money every month this year. Unless something changes, we shall have to close the shop.

examples.heading: ① If …, we shall + 原形動詞：正式的警告

items.en: This is our third letter. If we do not receive a reply this time, we shall take the matter to court.
items.zh: 這是我們第三封信。如果這次我們再收不到回覆，我們會把這件事告上法院。

items.en: Dear Mr Kent, you are two months behind with the rent. If it is not paid by Friday, we shall ask you to leave the flat.
items.zh: Kent 先生您好，您的房租已經遲交兩個月了。如果星期五前沒付，我們會請您搬出公寓。

items.en: A letter to the people in flat six: if the noise continues after midnight, we shall call the police.
items.zh: 給六號公寓住戶的信：如果半夜以後噪音還繼續，我們會報警。

items.en: Your library books are three months late. If you do not return them, we shall charge you for them.
items.zh: 您的圖書館書已經逾期三個月了。如果您不還書，我們會向您收書錢。

items.en: We ordered the desks in March. If the goods do not arrive by Monday, we shall cancel the order.
items.zh: 我們三月就訂了書桌。如果貨物星期一前沒到，我們會取消訂單。

items.en: The machines have broken down three times this month. If the problem is not fixed, we shall look for another supplier.
items.zh: 機器這個月壞了三次。如果問題沒有解決，我們會找另一家供應商。

examples.heading: ② If …, we shall + be + 形容詞或過去分詞：預測嚴重的結果

items.en: People live longer now, which is good, but if things get out of hand, we shall be doomed to live in chaos.
items.zh: 現在的人活得比較久，這很好，可是如果事情失控，我們注定會活在一片混亂中。

items.en: Half the rainforest has already gone. If we keep cutting down the forests, we shall be left with nothing.
items.zh: 一半的雨林已經消失了。如果我們一直砍伐森林，我們最後會什麼都沒有。（被動）

items.en: Our village is right next to the river. If it floods again, we shall be in serious trouble.
items.zh: 我們的村子就在河邊。如果河水又氾濫，我們會有大麻煩。

items.en: Energy bills doubled last winter. If we don't save energy now, we shall be sorry later.
items.zh: 去年冬天能源費漲了一倍。如果我們現在不節約能源，以後會後悔。

items.en: House prices went up fifteen per cent this year. If they keep rising, we shall be unable to buy a house.
items.zh: 房價今年漲了百分之十五。如果一直上漲，我們會買不起房子。

items.en: Our village has no bus service. If the trains stop running, we shall be cut off from the city.
items.zh: 我們村子沒有公車。如果火車停駛，我們會跟城市斷絕聯繫。（被動）

examples.heading: ③ If …, I shall + 原形動詞：說自己的決定

items.en: My car is at the garage this week. If the weather is good, I shall walk to work tomorrow.
items.zh: 我的車這個星期在修車廠。如果天氣好，我明天會走路上班。

items.en: My exams finish in June. If I pass them, I shall go to university in Edinburgh.
items.zh: 我的考試六月結束。如果我考過了，我會去愛丁堡念大學。

items.en: I'm working late tonight. If you need anything, I shall be in my office until six.
items.zh: 我今天要加班。如果你需要什麼，我六點前都在辦公室。

items.en: I had a great interview at the bank. If they offer me the job, I shall accept it immediately.
items.zh: 我在銀行的面試很順利。如果他們給我那份工作，我會馬上接受。

items.en: I want to return these shoes today. If the shop is closed, I shall try again on Monday.
items.zh: 我今天想退這雙鞋。如果那家店沒開，我星期一會再去。

items.en: My project is due on Friday. If I have time after that, I shall visit you at the weekend.
items.zh: 我的專題星期五要交。如果之後有時間，我週末會去看你。

examples.heading: ④ If …, we shall + 原形動詞：計畫和安排

items.en: We've sent out the invitations for the talk. If enough people come, we shall hire a bigger room.
items.zh: 我們寄出了演講的邀請函。如果夠多人來，我們會租一間比較大的房間。

items.en: The forecast says sun on Saturday. If it's right, we shall have the party in the garden.
items.zh: 天氣預報說星期六是晴天。如果預報是對的，我們會在花園辦派對。

items.en: We've seen the cottage twice and we love it. If the price is reasonable, we shall buy it.
items.zh: 我們看過那間小屋兩次，很喜歡。如果價格合理，我們會買下來。

items.en: It's been a long week at school. If the children are tired, we shall stay at home on Sunday.
items.zh: 學校這個星期很累。如果孩子們累了，我們星期天會待在家裡。

items.en: We are testing a new self-service till in one shop. If the plan works, we shall use it in all our shops.
items.zh: 我們在一家店測試新的自助收銀機。如果這個計畫成功，我們會在所有的店使用它。

items.en: The drive to the coast takes four hours. If we leave at eight, we shall arrive before lunch.
items.zh: 開車到海邊要四個小時。如果我們八點出發，我們會在午餐前到。

examples.heading: ⑤ Unless / As long as …, we shall + 原形動詞

items.en: Sales have fallen for six months. Unless we act now, we shall lose the support of our customers.
items.zh: 銷量下滑了六個月。除非我們現在行動，否則會失去顧客的支持。

items.en: The new project is huge, but as long as we work together, we shall succeed.
items.zh: 新專案很龐大，可是只要我們合作，我們就會成功。

items.en: The pitch is under water. Unless the weather improves, we shall cancel the match.
items.zh: 球場都淹水了。除非天氣好轉，否則我們會取消比賽。

items.en: We've just left Leeds. As long as the roads are clear, we shall be there by six.
items.zh: 我們剛離開 Leeds。只要路上不塞，我們六點前會到。

items.en: This is your final notice. Unless you pay the fine, we shall take further action.
items.zh: 這是給您的最後通知。除非您繳罰款，否則我們會採取進一步的行動。

items.en: There are forty boxes to move. As long as everyone helps, we shall finish the job today.
items.zh: 有四十個箱子要搬。只要每個人都幫忙，我們今天會完成工作。

items.en: We lost money every month this year. Unless something changes, we shall have to close the shop.
items.zh: 我們今年每個月都虧錢。除非有所改變，否則我們必須關店。

title: She was able to get a good seat.
translation: 她順利拿到了一個好位子。
name: was able to 表示過去做到的事
sentences: She was able to borrow a dress from her cousin.
The bus was late, but I was able to catch the train.
After three hours, the mechanic was able to start the car.
He was able to swim to the shore after the boat sank.
I was able to find a cheap hotel near the beach.
She lost her passport, but she was able to get a new one in a day.
The doctor was able to save the man's life.
I was able to answer every question in the test.
My grandfather was able to fix the old radio.
Sales increased, so we were able to improve the quality of our products.
The firefighters were able to rescue everyone from the building.
We were able to see the whole city from the top of the tower.
They were able to buy their first house last year.
Thanks to the map, we were able to find the waterfall.
The students were able to finish the project before the holidays.
We were able to get tickets for the last show.
The climbers were able to reach the top before the storm.
My parents were able to come to my graduation.
I wasn't able to sleep on the plane.
We weren't able to find a parking space near the stadium.
She wasn't able to come to the party, because she was ill.
The police weren't able to catch the thief.
He wasn't able to open the jar, so he asked me.
They weren't able to save the old tree.
I wasn't able to understand the instructions.
Were you able to get the tickets?
Was he able to talk to the manager?
Were they able to land in the storm?
Was she able to finish the marathon in under four hours?
Were you able to find your keys?
Was the doctor able to see you this morning?

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was able to + 原形動詞：某一次做到

items.en: She was able to borrow a dress from her cousin.
items.zh: 她跟表姊借到了一件洋裝。

items.en: The bus was late, but I was able to catch the train.
items.zh: 公車誤點了，可是我還是趕上了火車。

items.en: After three hours, the mechanic was able to start the car.
items.zh: 三個小時後，技師終於把車發動了。

items.en: He was able to swim to the shore after the boat sank.
items.zh: 船沉了以後，他游到了岸邊。

items.en: I was able to find a cheap hotel near the beach.
items.zh: 我找到了一家海邊附近的便宜飯店。

items.en: She lost her passport, but she was able to get a new one in a day.
items.zh: 她弄丟了護照，可是她一天之內就拿到了新的。

items.en: The doctor was able to save the man's life.
items.zh: 醫生救了那個男人的命。

items.en: I was able to answer every question in the test.
items.zh: 我答出了考試裡的每一題。

items.en: My grandfather was able to fix the old radio.
items.zh: 我爺爺修好了那台舊收音機。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + were able to + 原形動詞：某一次做到

items.en: Sales increased, so we were able to improve the quality of our products.
items.zh: 銷售量增加了，所以我們能改善產品的品質。

items.en: The firefighters were able to rescue everyone from the building.
items.zh: 消防員把大樓裡的每個人都救了出來。

items.en: We were able to see the whole city from the top of the tower.
items.zh: 我們從塔頂看到了整座城市。

items.en: They were able to buy their first house last year.
items.zh: 他們去年買了第一間房子。

items.en: Thanks to the map, we were able to find the waterfall.
items.zh: 多虧有地圖，我們找到了那個瀑布。

items.en: The students were able to finish the project before the holidays.
items.zh: 學生們在放假前完成了專題。

items.en: We were able to get tickets for the last show.
items.zh: 我們買到了最後一場的票。

items.en: The climbers were able to reach the top before the storm.
items.zh: 登山客在暴風雨來之前登上了山頂。

items.en: My parents were able to come to my graduation.
items.zh: 我爸媽來參加了我的畢業典禮。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + wasn't / weren't + able to + 原形動詞：某一次沒做到

items.en: I wasn't able to sleep on the plane.
items.zh: 我在飛機上睡不著。

items.en: We weren't able to find a parking space near the stadium.
items.zh: 我們在體育場附近找不到停車位。

items.en: She wasn't able to come to the party, because she was ill.
items.zh: 她沒辦法來派對，因為她生病了。

items.en: The police weren't able to catch the thief.
items.zh: 警察沒抓到小偷。

items.en: He wasn't able to open the jar, so he asked me.
items.zh: 他打不開那個罐子，所以叫我幫忙。

items.en: They weren't able to save the old tree.
items.zh: 他們沒能救活那棵老樹。

items.en: I wasn't able to understand the instructions.
items.zh: 我看不懂那些說明。

examples.heading: ④ Was / Were + 主詞 + able to + 原形動詞 ...?：問某一次有沒有做到

items.en: Were you able to get the tickets?
items.zh: 你有買到票嗎？

items.en: Was he able to talk to the manager?
items.zh: 他有跟經理談到話嗎？

items.en: Were they able to land in the storm?
items.zh: 他們在暴風雨中有辦法降落嗎？

items.en: Was she able to finish the marathon in under four hours?
items.zh: 她有在四小時內跑完馬拉松嗎？

items.en: Were you able to find your keys?
items.zh: 你有找到你的鑰匙嗎？

items.en: Was the doctor able to see you this morning?
items.zh: 醫生今天早上有幫你看診嗎？

title: My mother went with me on this trip because I wasn't allowed to go by myself.
translation: 這趟旅行我媽媽跟我一起去，因為我不可以自己一個人去。
name: be allowed to 表示許可
sentences: I wasn't allowed to go to the party, so I stayed at home.
When I was young, I wasn't allowed to eat sweets before dinner.
We were allowed to choose our own partners for the project.
The prisoners were allowed to see their families once a month.
My brother was allowed to stay out until midnight on his birthday.
We weren't allowed to talk during the exam.
The journalists weren't allowed to ask any questions.
In my last job, I was allowed to work from home on Fridays.
Children under twelve are not allowed to swim without an adult.
Are we allowed to use calculators in the maths test?
Passengers are allowed to take one bag onto the plane.
I'm not allowed to have friends over on school nights.
Is she allowed to drive her father's car?
Staff are allowed to use the gym for free.
You're not allowed to feed the ducks in this park.
Students are allowed to borrow five books at a time.
If you go with that group, you won't be allowed to do what you want.
Next year we'll be allowed to wear our own clothes at school.
After the operation, you won't be allowed to drive for a month.
Will parents be allowed to watch the final?
From June, visitors will be allowed to climb the tower again.
You won't be allowed to take that much liquid on the plane.
When you're eighteen, you'll be allowed to vote.
Dogs aren't allowed on the beach in summer.
Mobile phones are not allowed in the exam room.
Food and drink are not allowed in the library.
Visitors aren't allowed in the hospital after eight.
Is smoking allowed on the balcony?
Cameras were not allowed in the courtroom.
Bikes are allowed on the train after ten in the morning.
Pets aren't allowed in this block of flats.

examples.heading: ① was / were (not) allowed to：過去的許可

items.en: I wasn't allowed to go to the party, so I stayed at home.
items.zh: 我不可以去那個派對，所以我待在家。

items.en: When I was young, I wasn't allowed to eat sweets before dinner.
items.zh: 我小時候，晚餐前不可以吃糖果。

items.en: We were allowed to choose our own partners for the project.
items.zh: 我們可以自己選專題的組員。

items.en: The prisoners were allowed to see their families once a month.
items.zh: 犯人每個月可以見家人一次。

items.en: My brother was allowed to stay out until midnight on his birthday.
items.zh: 我哥生日那天可以在外面待到半夜。

items.en: We weren't allowed to talk during the exam.
items.zh: 考試時我們不可以講話。

items.en: The journalists weren't allowed to ask any questions.
items.zh: 記者們不可以問任何問題。

items.en: In my last job, I was allowed to work from home on Fridays.
items.zh: 在我上一份工作，星期五可以在家工作。

examples.heading: ② am / is / are (not) allowed to：現在的許可和規定

items.en: Children under twelve are not allowed to swim without an adult.
items.zh: 十二歲以下的小孩沒有大人陪不可以游泳。

items.en: Are we allowed to use calculators in the maths test?
items.zh: 數學考試可以用計算機嗎？

items.en: Passengers are allowed to take one bag onto the plane.
items.zh: 乘客可以帶一個包包上飛機。

items.en: I'm not allowed to have friends over on school nights.
items.zh: 上學日的晚上我不可以請朋友來家裡。

items.en: Is she allowed to drive her father's car?
items.zh: 她可以開她爸爸的車嗎？

items.en: Staff are allowed to use the gym for free.
items.zh: 員工可以免費使用健身房。

items.en: You're not allowed to feed the ducks in this park.
items.zh: 這個公園不可以餵鴨子。

items.en: Students are allowed to borrow five books at a time.
items.zh: 學生一次可以借五本書。

examples.heading: ③ will / won't be allowed to：未來的許可

items.en: If you go with that group, you won't be allowed to do what you want.
items.zh: 如果你跟那個團去，你就不能做你想做的事。

items.en: Next year we'll be allowed to wear our own clothes at school.
items.zh: 明年我們在學校可以穿自己的衣服。

items.en: After the operation, you won't be allowed to drive for a month.
items.zh: 手術後一個月你都不能開車。

items.en: Will parents be allowed to watch the final?
items.zh: 家長可以看決賽嗎？

items.en: From June, visitors will be allowed to climb the tower again.
items.zh: 從六月起，遊客又可以爬塔了。

items.en: You won't be allowed to take that much liquid on the plane.
items.zh: 那麼多液體你不能帶上飛機。

items.en: When you're eighteen, you'll be allowed to vote.
items.zh: 你十八歲的時候就可以投票了。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞主詞 + be (not) allowed + 地點

items.en: Dogs aren't allowed on the beach in summer.
items.zh: 夏天海灘上不准帶狗。

items.en: Mobile phones are not allowed in the exam room.
items.zh: 考場不准帶手機。

items.en: Food and drink are not allowed in the library.
items.zh: 圖書館不准帶食物和飲料。

items.en: Visitors aren't allowed in the hospital after eight.
items.zh: 八點以後醫院不准訪客進入。

items.en: Is smoking allowed on the balcony?
items.zh: 陽台可以抽菸嗎？

items.en: Cameras were not allowed in the courtroom.
items.zh: 法庭裡不准帶相機。

items.en: Bikes are allowed on the train after ten in the morning.
items.zh: 早上十點以後可以帶腳踏車上火車。

items.en: Pets aren't allowed in this block of flats.
items.zh: 這棟公寓不准養寵物。

title: Where many people get together, problems are bound to arise.
translation: 只要很多人聚在一起，就一定會出問題。
name: be bound to 表示必然
sentences: When you move house, a few things are bound to get broken.
If you leave food out in the sun, it's bound to go bad.
You're bound to get lost without a map.
If you don't water the plants, they're bound to die.
With so many cars, the roads are bound to be busy.
If he keeps spending like that, he's bound to run out of money.
If you leave the gate open, the dog is bound to run into the road.
Arguments are bound to happen when people live together.
Driving that fast, he's bound to have an accident one day.
I assure you that our new phone is bound to be popular with young people.
With her talent, she's bound to become a star.
Your grandmother is bound to cry when she sees the photos.
If you practise every day, you're bound to improve.
The restaurant is bound to be a success with food this good.
You're bound to find a job with your experience.
Your parents are bound to be proud of you.
A book by such a famous writer is bound to sell well.
Cycling in the rain, you are almost bound to catch a cold.
The plan is almost bound to fail without more money.
The price is almost bound to go up again.
Someone is almost bound to complain about the noise.
The trains are almost bound to be late in this weather.
The new phone is almost bound to have a few problems at first.
It's bound to snow in the hills by the end of November.
It's bound to be cold in the mountains at night.
It was bound to happen sooner or later.
It's bound to take longer than we think.
It's bound to be crowded at the beach on a hot Sunday.
It is bound to cause problems for small businesses.
It's bound to get easier with practice.
It's bound to be expensive in the city centre.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + bound to + 原形動詞：不好的結果

items.en: When you move house, a few things are bound to get broken.
items.zh: 搬家的時候，一定會有幾樣東西摔壞。

items.en: If you leave food out in the sun, it's bound to go bad.
items.zh: 如果你把食物放在太陽底下，一定會壞掉。

items.en: You're bound to get lost without a map.
items.zh: 沒有地圖你一定會迷路。

items.en: If you don't water the plants, they're bound to die.
items.zh: 如果你不澆水，植物一定會死。

items.en: With so many cars, the roads are bound to be busy.
items.zh: 車這麼多，路上一定很塞。

items.en: If he keeps spending like that, he's bound to run out of money.
items.zh: 如果他一直那樣花錢，錢一定會花光。

items.en: If you leave the gate open, the dog is bound to run into the road.
items.zh: 如果你讓大門開著，狗一定會跑到馬路上。

items.en: Arguments are bound to happen when people live together.
items.zh: 人住在一起，免不了會吵架。

items.en: Driving that fast, he's bound to have an accident one day.
items.zh: 開那麼快，他總有一天一定會出車禍。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + bound to + 原形動詞：好的結果

items.en: I assure you that our new phone is bound to be popular with young people.
items.zh: 我向您保證，我們的新手機一定會受年輕人歡迎。

items.en: With her talent, she's bound to become a star.
items.zh: 以她的天分，她一定會成為明星。

items.en: Your grandmother is bound to cry when she sees the photos.
items.zh: 你奶奶看到照片一定會哭。

items.en: If you practise every day, you're bound to improve.
items.zh: 如果你每天練習，一定會進步。

items.en: The restaurant is bound to be a success with food this good.
items.zh: 菜這麼好吃，這家餐廳一定會成功。

items.en: You're bound to find a job with your experience.
items.zh: 以你的經驗，一定找得到工作。

items.en: Your parents are bound to be proud of you.
items.zh: 你爸媽一定會以你為榮。

items.en: A book by such a famous writer is bound to sell well.
items.zh: 這麼有名的作家寫的書一定會賣得很好。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + almost bound to + 原形動詞

items.en: Cycling in the rain, you are almost bound to catch a cold.
items.zh: 在雨中騎腳踏車，你幾乎一定會感冒。

items.en: The plan is almost bound to fail without more money.
items.zh: 沒有更多經費，這個計畫幾乎一定會失敗。

items.en: The price is almost bound to go up again.
items.zh: 價格幾乎一定會再漲。

items.en: Someone is almost bound to complain about the noise.
items.zh: 幾乎一定會有人抱怨噪音。

items.en: The trains are almost bound to be late in this weather.
items.zh: 這種天氣，火車幾乎一定會誤點。

items.en: The new phone is almost bound to have a few problems at first.
items.zh: 新手機一開始幾乎一定會有一些問題。

examples.heading: ④ It + is / was + bound to + 原形動詞

items.en: It's bound to snow in the hills by the end of November.
items.zh: 到了十一月底，山上一定會下雪。

items.en: It's bound to be cold in the mountains at night.
items.zh: 山上晚上一定很冷。

items.en: It was bound to happen sooner or later.
items.zh: 這件事遲早一定會發生。

items.en: It's bound to take longer than we think.
items.zh: 一定會比我們想的花更多時間。

items.en: It's bound to be crowded at the beach on a hot Sunday.
items.zh: 天氣熱的星期天，海灘一定很擠。

items.en: It is bound to cause problems for small businesses.
items.zh: 這一定會對小公司造成問題。

items.en: It's bound to get easier with practice.
items.zh: 練習之後一定會變得比較簡單。

items.en: It's bound to be expensive in the city centre.
items.zh: 市中心一定很貴。

title: The program was due to start at midday.
translation: 節目原定中午開始。
name: be due to 和 be to 表示預定（含過去式）
sentences: The new directive is due to come into force by 2028.
The next bus is due to arrive in five minutes.
My sister's first baby is due to arrive just after Christmas.
The new stadium is due to open next spring.
The band is due to release a new album in the autumn.
The report is due to come out next Tuesday.
My cousin is due to finish university in July.
The wedding was due to start at two, but the bride was an hour late.
The flight was due to land at six, but it was two hours late.
The parade was due to pass our house at ten, but it took a different route.
The new bridge was due to open last year.
We were due to fly home on Sunday, but the airport closed.
The concert was due to begin at eight, so we arrived at half past seven.
The builders were due to finish the work in March.
I cannot attend the meeting, as I am to go on a business trip to New York then.
The royal couple are to open the new children's hospital in June.
All students are to be in the hall by nine.
The museum is to close for six months for repairs.
The two leaders are to meet in Geneva on Friday.
The company is to open three new stores this year.
You are to report to the manager at ten.
I was to take exams in two weeks, so I had to study hard.
The two teams were to play the final in Madrid.
She was to start her new job the following Monday.
The wedding was to take place in June.
They were to leave for Paris the next morning.
The new hospital was to have three hundred beds.
The money was to pay for a new school roof.
The train isn't due to leave for another hour.
When is the new manager due to arrive?
You are not to touch anything in this room.

examples.heading: ① am / is / are + due to + 原形動詞：未來的安排

items.en: The new directive is due to come into force by 2028.
items.zh: 新的指令預定在 2028 年前生效。

items.en: The next bus is due to arrive in five minutes.
items.zh: 下一班公車預定五分鐘後到。

items.en: My sister's first baby is due to arrive just after Christmas.
items.zh: 我姊的第一個寶寶預產期在聖誕節剛過。

items.en: The new stadium is due to open next spring.
items.zh: 新體育場預定明年春天啟用。

items.en: The band is due to release a new album in the autumn.
items.zh: 樂團預定秋天推出新專輯。

items.en: The report is due to come out next Tuesday.
items.zh: 報告預定下星期二公布。

items.en: My cousin is due to finish university in July.
items.zh: 我表哥預定七月大學畢業。

examples.heading: ② was / were + due to + 原形動詞：原本的安排

items.en: The wedding was due to start at two, but the bride was an hour late.
items.zh: 婚禮原定兩點開始，可是新娘晚了一個小時。

items.en: The flight was due to land at six, but it was two hours late.
items.zh: 班機原定六點降落，可是晚了兩個小時。

items.en: The parade was due to pass our house at ten, but it took a different route.
items.zh: 遊行原定十點經過我們家，可是走了另一條路線。

items.en: The new bridge was due to open last year.
items.zh: 新橋原定去年通車。

items.en: We were due to fly home on Sunday, but the airport closed.
items.zh: 我們原定星期天飛回家，可是機場關閉了。

items.en: The concert was due to begin at eight, so we arrived at half past seven.
items.zh: 演唱會原定八點開始，所以我們七點半就到了。

items.en: The builders were due to finish the work in March.
items.zh: 工人原定三月完工。

examples.heading: ③ am / is / are + to + 原形動詞：正式的安排

items.en: I cannot attend the meeting, as I am to go on a business trip to New York then.
items.zh: 我沒辦法參加會議，因為那時候我要去紐約出差。

items.en: The royal couple are to open the new children's hospital in June.
items.zh: 王室夫婦六月要為新的兒童醫院揭幕。

items.en: All students are to be in the hall by nine.
items.zh: 所有學生九點前要到禮堂。

items.en: The museum is to close for six months for repairs.
items.zh: 博物館要關閉六個月整修。

items.en: The two leaders are to meet in Geneva on Friday.
items.zh: 兩位領袖星期五要在日內瓦會面。

items.en: The company is to open three new stores this year.
items.zh: 那家公司今年要開三家新店。

items.en: You are to report to the manager at ten.
items.zh: 你十點要向經理報到。

examples.heading: ④ was / were + to + 原形動詞：過去的安排

items.en: I was to take exams in two weeks, so I had to study hard.
items.zh: 兩個星期後我就要考試，所以我得用功讀書。

items.en: The two teams were to play the final in Madrid.
items.zh: 兩隊原定在馬德里打決賽。

items.en: She was to start her new job the following Monday.
items.zh: 她下一個星期一就要開始新工作。

items.en: The wedding was to take place in June.
items.zh: 婚禮原定在六月舉行。

items.en: They were to leave for Paris the next morning.
items.zh: 他們隔天早上要出發去巴黎。

items.en: The new hospital was to have three hundred beds.
items.zh: 新醫院原本要設三百張病床。

items.en: The money was to pay for a new school roof.
items.zh: 這筆錢是要用來付學校新屋頂的費用。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定和疑問

items.en: The train isn't due to leave for another hour.
items.zh: 火車還要一個小時才開。

items.en: When is the new manager due to arrive?
items.zh: 新經理預定什麼時候到？

items.en: You are not to touch anything in this room.
items.zh: 這個房間裡的東西你都不可以碰。

title: Due to decreasing sales over the last few months, we are forced to cut the budget.
translation: 由於過去幾個月銷售量持續下滑，我們不得不刪減預算。
name: be forced to 表示不得不
sentences: With fewer customers, the café is forced to open only at weekends.
With prices so high, many families are forced to buy cheaper food.
Because of the roadworks, drivers are forced to take a long way round.
Small shops are forced to close when big supermarkets open nearby.
As the lift is broken, we're forced to use the stairs.
Many young people are forced to live with their parents.
Because of the noise, I'm forced to work with headphones on.
The farmers are forced to sell their animals because of the dry summer.
The plane was forced to land because of the storm.
We were forced to cancel the picnic because of the rain.
Thousands of people were forced to leave their homes after the flood.
The company was forced to sell its offices in London.
I was forced to take a taxi because I missed the last bus.
The players were forced to stop the match because of the snow.
The restaurant was forced to close for a month.
She was forced to give up running after her knee injury.
We were forced to sleep in the car at the airport.
If sales don't improve, we will be forced to close the shop.
If the rent goes up again, they'll be forced to move.
We may be forced to change our plans.
Without more money, the museum will be forced to cut its opening hours.
If the strike continues, the airline may be forced to cancel more flights.
The school will be forced to make bigger classes next year.
I don't like being forced to do something that I don't want to do.
Nobody should be forced to work on Christmas Day.
Children shouldn't be forced to eat food they hate.
He felt he was forced to choose between his job and his family.
I hate being forced to listen to other people's phone calls on the train.
Why should we be forced to pay for their mistakes?
She didn't want to be forced to leave her friends behind.
No one was forced to take part. Everyone volunteered.

examples.heading: ① am / is / are + forced to：現在的情況

items.en: With fewer customers, the café is forced to open only at weekends.
items.zh: 客人變少，那家咖啡店只好只在週末營業。

items.en: With prices so high, many families are forced to buy cheaper food.
items.zh: 物價這麼高，很多家庭不得不買比較便宜的食物。

items.en: Because of the roadworks, drivers are forced to take a long way round.
items.zh: 因為道路施工，駕駛不得不繞遠路。

items.en: Small shops are forced to close when big supermarkets open nearby.
items.zh: 大超市在附近開幕時，小店不得不關門。

items.en: As the lift is broken, we're forced to use the stairs.
items.zh: 因為電梯壞了，我們不得不走樓梯。

items.en: Many young people are forced to live with their parents.
items.zh: 很多年輕人不得不跟父母住。

items.en: Because of the noise, I'm forced to work with headphones on.
items.zh: 因為噪音，我不得不戴著耳機工作。

items.en: The farmers are forced to sell their animals because of the dry summer.
items.zh: 因為夏天太乾，農夫不得不賣掉牲畜。

examples.heading: ② was / were + forced to：過去的情況

items.en: The plane was forced to land because of the storm.
items.zh: 因為暴風雨，飛機被迫降落。

items.en: We were forced to cancel the picnic because of the rain.
items.zh: 因為下雨，我們不得不取消野餐。

items.en: Thousands of people were forced to leave their homes after the flood.
items.zh: 水災後，數千人被迫離開家園。

items.en: The company was forced to sell its offices in London.
items.zh: 那家公司被迫賣掉在倫敦的辦公室。

items.en: I was forced to take a taxi because I missed the last bus.
items.zh: 因為錯過最後一班公車，我不得不搭計程車。

items.en: The players were forced to stop the match because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，球員不得不中斷比賽。

items.en: The restaurant was forced to close for a month.
items.zh: 那家餐廳被迫停業一個月。

items.en: She was forced to give up running after her knee injury.
items.zh: 膝蓋受傷後，她不得不放棄跑步。

items.en: We were forced to sleep in the car at the airport.
items.zh: 我們不得不在機場的車子裡睡覺。

examples.heading: ③ will be / may be + forced to：未來的可能

items.en: If sales don't improve, we will be forced to close the shop.
items.zh: 如果銷售量沒有改善，我們將不得不關店。

items.en: If the rent goes up again, they'll be forced to move.
items.zh: 如果房租再漲，他們將不得不搬家。

items.en: We may be forced to change our plans.
items.zh: 我們也許不得不改變計畫。

items.en: Without more money, the museum will be forced to cut its opening hours.
items.zh: 沒有更多經費，博物館將不得不縮短開放時間。

items.en: If the strike continues, the airline may be forced to cancel more flights.
items.zh: 如果罷工持續，航空公司也許不得不取消更多班機。

items.en: The school will be forced to make bigger classes next year.
items.zh: 學校明年將不得不擴大班級人數。

examples.heading: ④ be forced to 和個人的感受

items.en: I don't like being forced to do something that I don't want to do.
items.zh: 我不喜歡被強迫做我不想做的事。

items.en: Nobody should be forced to work on Christmas Day.
items.zh: 沒有人應該被迫在聖誕節當天工作。

items.en: Children shouldn't be forced to eat food they hate.
items.zh: 不應該強迫孩子吃他們討厭的食物。

items.en: He felt he was forced to choose between his job and his family.
items.zh: 他覺得自己被迫在工作和家庭之間做選擇。

items.en: I hate being forced to listen to other people's phone calls on the train.
items.zh: 我討厭在火車上被迫聽別人講電話。

items.en: Why should we be forced to pay for their mistakes?
items.zh: 為什麼我們要被迫為他們的錯付出代價？

items.en: She didn't want to be forced to leave her friends behind.
items.zh: 她不想被迫離開她的朋友。

items.en: No one was forced to take part. Everyone volunteered.
items.zh: 沒有人被強迫參加，大家都是自願的。

title: Whenever money is involved, some problems are likely to happen.
translation: 只要一牽扯到錢，就很可能會出問題。
name: be likely to 表示可能性
sentences: Mistakes are likely to happen when people work long hours.
It is likely to rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
The tickets are likely to sell out in a few hours.
The new manager is likely to make some changes.
The traffic is likely to be heavy because of the football match.
My sister is likely to be late. She always is.
Strong winds are likely to bring down a few trees in the park.
Prices are likely to fall after the holidays.
I am very likely to make mistakes that I would like to avoid.
The new treatment is highly likely to work.
She's quite likely to change her mind again.
The museum is very likely to be crowded on Sunday.
Our team is quite likely to reach the final this year.
The bridge is highly likely to close for repairs next year.
You're very likely to see dolphins on the boat trip.
The baby is quite likely to wake up if you sing.
The weather is unlikely to improve before Monday.
He's very unlikely to say sorry.
The shop is highly unlikely to give you your money back.
With all this luggage, we're unlikely to get a seat on the bus.
The old printer is unlikely to last another year.
The new rule is very unlikely to change people's habits.
My parents are unlikely to let me go to the festival.
Is the train likely to be late?
Are prices likely to go down soon?
Is it likely to snow at the weekend?
Who is most likely to win the election?
Are the children likely to enjoy this film?
Is the doctor likely to see me today?
Which road is likely to be quieter at rush hour?
How long is the meeting likely to last?

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + likely to + 原形動詞

items.en: Mistakes are likely to happen when people work long hours.
items.zh: 人工作時間太長的時候，很可能會出錯。

items.en: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
items.zh: 今天下午很可能會下雨，所以帶把傘。

items.en: The tickets are likely to sell out in a few hours.
items.zh: 票很可能幾個小時就賣完了。

items.en: The new manager is likely to make some changes.
items.zh: 新經理很可能會做一些改變。

items.en: The traffic is likely to be heavy because of the football match.
items.zh: 因為足球賽，交通很可能會很塞。

items.en: My sister is likely to be late. She always is.
items.zh: 我姊很可能會遲到，她總是這樣。

items.en: Strong winds are likely to bring down a few trees in the park.
items.zh: 強風很可能會吹倒公園裡的幾棵樹。

items.en: Prices are likely to fall after the holidays.
items.zh: 假期過後價格很可能會下跌。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + very / quite / highly + likely to + 原形動詞

items.en: I am very likely to make mistakes that I would like to avoid.
items.zh: 我很可能會犯一些我想避免的錯。

items.en: The new treatment is highly likely to work.
items.zh: 新療法非常有可能有效。

items.en: She's quite likely to change her mind again.
items.zh: 她相當有可能又改變主意。

items.en: The museum is very likely to be crowded on Sunday.
items.zh: 博物館星期天非常可能會很擠。

items.en: Our team is quite likely to reach the final this year.
items.zh: 我們隊今年相當有可能打進決賽。

items.en: The bridge is highly likely to close for repairs next year.
items.zh: 那座橋明年非常可能會封閉整修。

items.en: You're very likely to see dolphins on the boat trip.
items.zh: 搭船出遊非常可能會看到海豚。

items.en: The baby is quite likely to wake up if you sing.
items.zh: 你唱歌的話，寶寶相當有可能會醒來。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + (very / highly) + unlikely to + 原形動詞

items.en: The weather is unlikely to improve before Monday.
items.zh: 星期一前天氣不太可能好轉。

items.en: He's very unlikely to say sorry.
items.zh: 他非常不可能道歉。

items.en: The shop is highly unlikely to give you your money back.
items.zh: 那家店非常不可能退錢給你。

items.en: With all this luggage, we're unlikely to get a seat on the bus.
items.zh: 帶了這麼多行李，我們不太可能在公車上找到位子。

items.en: The old printer is unlikely to last another year.
items.zh: 那台舊印表機不太可能再撐一年。

items.en: The new rule is very unlikely to change people's habits.
items.zh: 新規定非常不可能改變大家的習慣。

items.en: My parents are unlikely to let me go to the festival.
items.zh: 我爸媽不太可能讓我去音樂節。

examples.heading: ④ (wh- 疑問詞) + is / are + 主詞 + likely to + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Is the train likely to be late?
items.zh: 火車很可能會誤點嗎？

items.en: Are prices likely to go down soon?
items.zh: 價格很可能很快就會下跌嗎？

items.en: Is it likely to snow at the weekend?
items.zh: 週末很可能會下雪嗎？

items.en: Who is most likely to win the election?
items.zh: 誰最可能贏得選舉？

items.en: Are the children likely to enjoy this film?
items.zh: 孩子們很可能會喜歡這部電影嗎？

items.en: Is the doctor likely to see me today?
items.zh: 醫生今天很可能會幫我看診嗎？

items.en: Which road is likely to be quieter at rush hour?
items.zh: 尖峰時間哪條路很可能比較不塞？

items.en: How long is the meeting likely to last?
items.zh: 會議很可能會開多久？

title: Animals are meant to be free.
translation: 動物本來就應該是自由的。
name: be meant to 表示理想狀態
sentences: Sundays are meant to be slow and quiet.
A home is meant to be a safe place for children.
Weekends are meant to be for rest and family.
Friends are meant to be there when you need them.
Learning is meant to be fun, not stressful.
Parks are meant to be open to everyone.
A wedding is meant to be the happiest day of your life.
Sport is meant to be about taking part, not just winning.
Children are meant to be curious about the world.
Libraries are meant to be quiet places.
Primary school is meant to give you all the basics of your education.
This room is meant to store old furniture, not to sleep in.
The bonus is meant to reward the staff for their hard work.
Rules are meant to protect people.
This exercise is meant to help you relax your back.
The fence is meant to keep the sheep in the field.
Homework is meant to help students practise what they learn.
The new lights are meant to make the street safer at night.
These boxes aren't meant to carry heavy books.
The test is meant to show what you already know.
Holidays are meant to be relaxing, but ours was very stressful.
The bus lane is meant to make buses faster, but cars use it too.
This jacket is meant to be waterproof, but I still got wet.
Marriage is meant to last forever, but many don't.
The diet is meant to be healthy, but it made me feel tired.
The meeting was meant to be short, but it lasted three hours.
Breakfast is meant to be the most important meal, but I often skip it.
My grandparents always said they were meant to be together.
Some people believe that everyone is meant to do something special.
She felt she was meant to be a doctor.
Perhaps we weren't meant to win this year.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + meant to + be：應有的狀態

items.en: Sundays are meant to be slow and quiet.
items.zh: 星期天本來應該過得悠閒安靜。

items.en: A home is meant to be a safe place for children.
items.zh: 家本來應該是孩子安全的地方。

items.en: Weekends are meant to be for rest and family.
items.zh: 週末本來應該是用來休息和陪家人的。

items.en: Friends are meant to be there when you need them.
items.zh: 朋友本來就應該在你需要的時候出現。

items.en: Learning is meant to be fun, not stressful.
items.zh: 學習本來應該是有趣的，不是讓人有壓力的。

items.en: Parks are meant to be open to everyone.
items.zh: 公園本來應該對所有人開放。

items.en: A wedding is meant to be the happiest day of your life.
items.zh: 婚禮本來應該是你人生中最快樂的一天。

items.en: Sport is meant to be about taking part, not just winning.
items.zh: 運動本來應該重在參與，不只是贏。

items.en: Children are meant to be curious about the world.
items.zh: 孩子本來就應該對世界充滿好奇。

items.en: Libraries are meant to be quiet places.
items.zh: 圖書館本來應該是安靜的地方。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + meant to + 原形動詞：本來的用途

items.en: Primary school is meant to give you all the basics of your education.
items.zh: 小學的用意是讓你打好教育的所有基礎。

items.en: This room is meant to store old furniture, not to sleep in.
items.zh: 這個房間是用來放舊家具的，不是用來睡覺的。

items.en: The bonus is meant to reward the staff for their hard work.
items.zh: 這筆獎金是用來獎勵員工的努力。

items.en: Rules are meant to protect people.
items.zh: 規定的用意是保護人。

items.en: This exercise is meant to help you relax your back.
items.zh: 這個運動的用意是幫你放鬆背部。

items.en: The fence is meant to keep the sheep in the field.
items.zh: 這道圍籬是用來把羊圍在田裡的。

items.en: Homework is meant to help students practise what they learn.
items.zh: 功課的用意是幫學生練習學到的東西。

items.en: The new lights are meant to make the street safer at night.
items.zh: 新路燈的用意是讓街道晚上更安全。

items.en: These boxes aren't meant to carry heavy books.
items.zh: 這些箱子不是用來裝重的書的。

items.en: The test is meant to show what you already know.
items.zh: 這次考試的用意是看你已經知道什麼。

examples.heading: ③ be meant to ..., but ...：理想和現實不一樣

items.en: Holidays are meant to be relaxing, but ours was very stressful.
items.zh: 假期本來應該很放鬆，可是我們的假期壓力很大。

items.en: The bus lane is meant to make buses faster, but cars use it too.
items.zh: 公車專用道本來是要讓公車開快一點，可是汽車也在用。

items.en: This jacket is meant to be waterproof, but I still got wet.
items.zh: 這件外套本來應該是防水的，可是我還是淋濕了。

items.en: Marriage is meant to last forever, but many don't.
items.zh: 婚姻本來應該是一輩子的，可是很多婚姻都沒有。

items.en: The diet is meant to be healthy, but it made me feel tired.
items.zh: 這種飲食法本來應該很健康，可是它讓我覺得很累。

items.en: The meeting was meant to be short, but it lasted three hours.
items.zh: 會議本來應該很短，可是開了三個小時。

items.en: Breakfast is meant to be the most important meal, but I often skip it.
items.zh: 早餐本來應該是最重要的一餐，可是我常常不吃。

examples.heading: ④ be meant to：命中注定

items.en: My grandparents always said they were meant to be together.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶總是說他們是命中注定要在一起的。

items.en: Some people believe that everyone is meant to do something special.
items.zh: 有些人相信每個人都注定要做一件特別的事。

items.en: She felt she was meant to be a doctor.
items.zh: 她覺得自己注定要當醫生。

items.en: Perhaps we weren't meant to win this year.
items.zh: 也許我們今年本來就不該贏。

title: They were obliged to give up their house.
translation: 他們不得不放棄自己的房子。
name: be obliged to 表示外在義務
sentences: All sales representatives are obliged to take part in the conference.
Employers are obliged to provide a safe place to work.
Parents are obliged to send their children to school.
Tenants are obliged to keep the flat clean.
Doctors are obliged to keep patients' information private.
Shops are obliged to give a refund for faulty goods.
Drivers are obliged to carry their licence at all times.
Members are obliged to pay the fee by the end of January.
The family were obliged to borrow money from the bank.
The company was obliged to close two of its factories.
We were obliged to wait three hours at the border.
The pilot was obliged to land at a different airport.
I was obliged to stay late to finish the report.
The school was obliged to cancel the trip because of the strike.
The team were obliged to play without their captain.
She was obliged to sell her car to pay her debts.
From January, everybody will be obliged to have a parking permit for the company car park.
Visitors will be obliged to show identity cards at the entrance.
All new staff will be obliged to complete a safety course.
Restaurants will be obliged to show the calories on their menus.
Students will be obliged to wear uniforms from next year.
Passengers will be obliged to wear seat belts on all buses.
Companies will be obliged to report their profits every quarter.
You are not obliged to answer any of these questions.
Customers are not obliged to buy anything.
You're not obliged to come to the party if you're tired.
We weren't obliged to stay, so we left early.
Students are not obliged to take part in the competition.
You aren't obliged to give a reason for leaving.
Guests are not obliged to leave a tip.
You are under no obligation, and you are not obliged to sign today.

examples.heading: ① am / is / are + obliged to：規定和義務

items.en: All sales representatives are obliged to take part in the conference.
items.zh: 所有業務代表都必須參加研討會。

items.en: Employers are obliged to provide a safe place to work.
items.zh: 雇主有義務提供安全的工作環境。

items.en: Parents are obliged to send their children to school.
items.zh: 父母有義務送孩子上學。

items.en: Tenants are obliged to keep the flat clean.
items.zh: 房客有義務保持公寓清潔。

items.en: Doctors are obliged to keep patients' information private.
items.zh: 醫生有義務為病人的資料保密。

items.en: Shops are obliged to give a refund for faulty goods.
items.zh: 商店有義務為瑕疵商品退款。

items.en: Drivers are obliged to carry their licence at all times.
items.zh: 駕駛必須隨時攜帶駕照。

items.en: Members are obliged to pay the fee by the end of January.
items.zh: 會員必須在一月底前繳費。

examples.heading: ② was / were + obliged to：過去不得不

items.en: The family were obliged to borrow money from the bank.
items.zh: 那家人不得不向銀行借錢。

items.en: The company was obliged to close two of its factories.
items.zh: 那家公司不得不關掉兩間工廠。

items.en: We were obliged to wait three hours at the border.
items.zh: 我們在邊境不得不等了三個小時。

items.en: The pilot was obliged to land at a different airport.
items.zh: 飛行員不得不降落在另一個機場。

items.en: I was obliged to stay late to finish the report.
items.zh: 我不得不留到很晚把報告寫完。

items.en: The school was obliged to cancel the trip because of the strike.
items.zh: 因為罷工，學校不得不取消旅行。

items.en: The team were obliged to play without their captain.
items.zh: 球隊不得不在沒有隊長的情況下比賽。

items.en: She was obliged to sell her car to pay her debts.
items.zh: 她不得不賣車來還債。

examples.heading: ③ will be + obliged to：未來的規定

items.en: From January, everybody will be obliged to have a parking permit for the company car park.
items.zh: 從一月起，大家使用公司停車場都必須有停車證。

items.en: Visitors will be obliged to show identity cards at the entrance.
items.zh: 訪客在入口必須出示身分證。

items.en: All new staff will be obliged to complete a safety course.
items.zh: 所有新員工都必須完成安全課程。

items.en: Restaurants will be obliged to show the calories on their menus.
items.zh: 餐廳必須在菜單上標示熱量。

items.en: Students will be obliged to wear uniforms from next year.
items.zh: 從明年起學生必須穿制服。

items.en: Passengers will be obliged to wear seat belts on all buses.
items.zh: 所有公車上的乘客都必須繫安全帶。

items.en: Companies will be obliged to report their profits every quarter.
items.zh: 公司每一季都必須申報利潤。

examples.heading: ④ not obliged to：不必

items.en: You are not obliged to answer any of these questions.
items.zh: 這些問題你都不必回答。

items.en: Customers are not obliged to buy anything.
items.zh: 顧客不必買任何東西。

items.en: You're not obliged to come to the party if you're tired.
items.zh: 如果你累了，不必來派對。

items.en: We weren't obliged to stay, so we left early.
items.zh: 我們不必留下來，所以我們提早走了。

items.en: Students are not obliged to take part in the competition.
items.zh: 學生不必參加比賽。

items.en: You aren't obliged to give a reason for leaving.
items.zh: 你不必說明離開的理由。

items.en: Guests are not obliged to leave a tip.
items.zh: 客人不必給小費。

items.en: You are under no obligation, and you are not obliged to sign today.
items.zh: 你沒有任何義務，今天不必簽約。

title: The turnover of our company is set to increase dramatically after the establishment of the e-shop.
translation: 網路商店成立後，我們公司的營業額預計會大幅成長。
name: be set to 斷言未來的事
sentences: Our profits are set to increase sharply after the launch of the new app.
Rents in the city centre are set to climb by ten per cent.
The number of tourists is set to grow by twenty per cent.
Online sales are set to double in the next five years.
The cost of energy is set to go up in the winter.
The company's workforce is set to grow to over a thousand.
Demand for electric cars is set to increase dramatically.
The number of children is set to plummet to 11.5% of the population by 2050.
Unemployment is set to fall for the third year running.
Petrol prices are set to drop next month.
The number of working people is set to fall to 46.2% in 2050.
Sales of paper books are set to decline further.
The value of the old currency is set to fall even more.
The city is set to become the country's main technology centre.
The hot weather is set to continue until the weekend.
Interest rates are set to remain low for another year.
Our town is set to become a popular holiday destination.
The dispute is set to continue for months.
English is set to remain the main language of business.
The new president is set to take office in January.
The two companies are set to merge next spring.
The film is set to open in cinemas next week.
The new stadium is set to host the final in June.
The local club is set to sign two new players this summer.
The singer is set to announce a world tour.
Workers at the factory are set to go on strike on Monday.
The government is set to introduce a new tax on sugar.
With little investment, the online shop is set to bring in large profits.
The new product is set to be a big success with young buyers.
These changes are set to save the company millions.
The project is set to finish ahead of schedule.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + set to + increase / rise / grow：上升

items.en: Our profits are set to increase sharply after the launch of the new app.
items.zh: 新的應用程式推出後，我們的利潤預計會大幅增加。

items.en: Rents in the city centre are set to climb by ten per cent.
items.zh: 市中心的房租預計會上漲百分之十。

items.en: The number of tourists is set to grow by twenty per cent.
items.zh: 觀光客的人數預計會成長百分之二十。

items.en: Online sales are set to double in the next five years.
items.zh: 網路銷售額預計在未來五年內加倍。

items.en: The cost of energy is set to go up in the winter.
items.zh: 能源的費用預計冬天會上漲。

items.en: The company's workforce is set to grow to over a thousand.
items.zh: 公司的員工人數預計會成長到超過一千人。

items.en: Demand for electric cars is set to increase dramatically.
items.zh: 電動車的需求預計會大幅增加。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + set to + fall / drop / plummet：下降

items.en: The number of children is set to plummet to 11.5% of the population by 2050.
items.zh: 到了 2050 年，兒童人口預計會暴跌到總人口的 11.5%。

items.en: Unemployment is set to fall for the third year running.
items.zh: 失業率預計會連續第三年下降。

items.en: Petrol prices are set to drop next month.
items.zh: 油價下個月預計會下跌。

items.en: The number of working people is set to fall to 46.2% in 2050.
items.zh: 到了 2050 年，工作人口預計會降到 46.2%。

items.en: Sales of paper books are set to decline further.
items.zh: 紙本書的銷售量預計會進一步下滑。

items.en: The value of the old currency is set to fall even more.
items.zh: 舊貨幣的價值預計會跌得更多。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + set to + become / continue / remain：變化和持續

items.en: The city is set to become the country's main technology centre.
items.zh: 這座城市預計會成為全國主要的科技中心。

items.en: The hot weather is set to continue until the weekend.
items.zh: 炎熱的天氣預計會持續到週末。

items.en: Interest rates are set to remain low for another year.
items.zh: 利率預計會再維持低檔一年。

items.en: Our town is set to become a popular holiday destination.
items.zh: 我們鎮預計會成為熱門的度假地點。

items.en: The dispute is set to continue for months.
items.zh: 這場爭議預計會持續好幾個月。

items.en: English is set to remain the main language of business.
items.zh: 英文預計仍會是商業的主要語言。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + be + set to + 原形動詞：即將發生的事件

items.en: The new president is set to take office in January.
items.zh: 新總統預定一月就職。

items.en: The two companies are set to merge next spring.
items.zh: 這兩家公司預定明年春天合併。

items.en: The film is set to open in cinemas next week.
items.zh: 那部電影預定下星期在電影院上映。

items.en: The new stadium is set to host the final in June.
items.zh: 新體育場預定六月主辦決賽。

items.en: The local club is set to sign two new players this summer.
items.zh: 當地的球隊預定今年夏天簽下兩名新球員。

items.en: The singer is set to announce a world tour.
items.zh: 那位歌手預定宣布世界巡迴演唱會。

items.en: Workers at the factory are set to go on strike on Monday.
items.zh: 工廠的工人預定星期一罷工。

items.en: The government is set to introduce a new tax on sugar.
items.zh: 政府預定推出新的糖稅。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + be + set to + 原形動詞：報告的結論

items.en: With little investment, the online shop is set to bring in large profits.
items.zh: 只需要很少的投資，網路商店預計會帶來大筆利潤。

items.en: The new product is set to be a big success with young buyers.
items.zh: 新產品預計會大受年輕買家歡迎。

items.en: These changes are set to save the company millions.
items.zh: 這些改變預計會為公司省下數百萬。

items.en: The project is set to finish ahead of schedule.
items.zh: 這個專案預計會提前完成。

title: The lake is supposed to be very beautiful.
translation: 聽說那座湖非常漂亮。
name: be supposed to 表示傳聞
sentences: The food at the night market is supposed to be amazing.
The new Italian restaurant is supposed to be excellent.
This film is supposed to be really scary.
The beaches in the south are supposed to be quieter.
Their new album is supposed to be their best yet.
The water there is supposed to be very cold, even in August.
The exam is supposed to be easier this year.
That hotel is supposed to be very expensive.
The museum is supposed to be free on Sundays.
This book is supposed to be a true story.
The old house on the hill is supposed to be haunted.
The castle is supposed to be the oldest in the country.
Their son is supposed to be a brilliant musician.
The market is supposed to be the best place for cheap clothes.
This drink is supposed to be a cure for colds.
Cats are supposed to sleep about sixteen hours a day.
This plant is supposed to bring good luck.
The bakery on the corner is supposed to sell the best croissants in town.
Eating carrots is supposed to help your eyesight.
The new teacher is supposed to give a lot of homework.
The singer is supposed to live in a castle in Scotland.
That old car is supposed to use very little petrol.
That woman is supposed to have killed two husbands for their money.
He is supposed to have won the lottery last year.
The house is supposed to have belonged to a famous writer.
She's supposed to have met the Queen when she was a child.
The bridge is supposed to have taken twenty years to build.
Our neighbour is supposed to have been a famous footballer.
The two brothers are supposed to have stopped speaking years ago.
The painting is supposed to have cost millions.
The village is supposed to have had a castle in the Middle Ages.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + supposed to + be + 形容詞

items.en: The food at the night market is supposed to be amazing.
items.zh: 聽說夜市的東西很好吃。

items.en: The new Italian restaurant is supposed to be excellent.
items.zh: 聽說那家新的義大利餐廳很棒。

items.en: This film is supposed to be really scary.
items.zh: 聽說這部電影很恐怖。

items.en: The beaches in the south are supposed to be quieter.
items.zh: 聽說南部的海灘比較安靜。

items.en: Their new album is supposed to be their best yet.
items.zh: 聽說他們的新專輯是目前最好的一張。

items.en: The water there is supposed to be very cold, even in August.
items.zh: 聽說那裡的水就算八月也很冷。

items.en: The exam is supposed to be easier this year.
items.zh: 聽說今年的考試比較簡單。

items.en: That hotel is supposed to be very expensive.
items.zh: 聽說那家飯店很貴。

items.en: The museum is supposed to be free on Sundays.
items.zh: 聽說那間博物館星期天免費。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + supposed to + be + 名詞

items.en: This book is supposed to be a true story.
items.zh: 聽說這本書是真實故事。

items.en: The old house on the hill is supposed to be haunted.
items.zh: 聽說山丘上那間老房子鬧鬼。

items.en: The castle is supposed to be the oldest in the country.
items.zh: 聽說那座城堡是全國最古老的。

items.en: Their son is supposed to be a brilliant musician.
items.zh: 聽說他們的兒子是很出色的音樂家。

items.en: The market is supposed to be the best place for cheap clothes.
items.zh: 聽說那個市場是買便宜衣服最好的地方。

items.en: This drink is supposed to be a cure for colds.
items.zh: 聽說這種飲料可以治感冒。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + supposed to + 原形動詞

items.en: Cats are supposed to sleep about sixteen hours a day.
items.zh: 聽說貓一天睡大約十六個小時。

items.en: This plant is supposed to bring good luck.
items.zh: 聽說這種植物會帶來好運。

items.en: The bakery on the corner is supposed to sell the best croissants in town.
items.zh: 聽說轉角那家麵包店賣全鎮最好吃的可頌。

items.en: Eating carrots is supposed to help your eyesight.
items.zh: 聽說吃紅蘿蔔對視力有幫助。

items.en: The new teacher is supposed to give a lot of homework.
items.zh: 聽說新老師出很多功課。
