items.en: The singer is supposed to live in a castle in Scotland.
items.zh: 聽說那位歌手住在蘇格蘭的一座城堡裡。

items.en: That old car is supposed to use very little petrol.
items.zh: 聽說那台老車很省油。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + be + supposed to + have + 過去分詞：傳聞中過去的事

items.en: That woman is supposed to have killed two husbands for their money.
items.zh: 聽說那個女人為了錢殺了兩任丈夫。

items.en: He is supposed to have won the lottery last year.
items.zh: 聽說他去年中了樂透。

items.en: The house is supposed to have belonged to a famous writer.
items.zh: 聽說那間房子以前屬於一位有名的作家。

items.en: She's supposed to have met the Queen when she was a child.
items.zh: 聽說她小時候見過女王。

items.en: The bridge is supposed to have taken twenty years to build.
items.zh: 聽說那座橋花了二十年才蓋好。

items.en: Our neighbour is supposed to have been a famous footballer.
items.zh: 聽說我們的鄰居以前是有名的足球員。

items.en: The two brothers are supposed to have stopped speaking years ago.
items.zh: 聽說那對兄弟好幾年前就不說話了。

items.en: The painting is supposed to have cost millions.
items.zh: 聽說那幅畫花了好幾百萬。

items.en: The village is supposed to have had a castle in the Middle Ages.
items.zh: 聽說那個村子在中世紀有一座城堡。

title: I have bought some disks, but I don't know what I am supposed to do with them.
translation: 我買了一些光碟，可是不知道該拿它們怎麼辦。
name: be supposed to 表示義務和預期
sentences: The show is on the 14th of March, the same day we are supposed to go to the Science Museum.
You're supposed to show your ticket at the door.
Students are supposed to wear their uniform on school trips.
We're supposed to be at the airport two hours before the flight.
You're not supposed to park in front of the fire station.
The kids are supposed to be in bed by nine.
I'm supposed to call my mother every Sunday.
Visitors are supposed to sign in at reception.
You're supposed to take off your shoes before you go in.
Our travels are supposed to give us pleasure, knowledge and new experiences.
This cream is supposed to make your skin softer.
The new road is supposed to reduce traffic in the town centre.
Exercise is supposed to help you sleep better.
The course is supposed to prepare you for the exam.
These glasses are supposed to protect your eyes from the sun.
I was supposed to explain to them what they had to do.
We were supposed to finish the project by Friday.
She was supposed to pick up her brother after school.
You were supposed to tell me about the change of plan.
The workers were supposed to wear helmets on the site.
He was supposed to lock the door when he left.
I was supposed to send the invitations last week.
What am I supposed to say to her after all this?
How am I supposed to finish this without any help?
What are we supposed to wear to a garden party?
Where are we supposed to put our bags?
How are you supposed to open this box?
What time are we supposed to arrive?
Who is supposed to clean the kitchen this week?
What is this button supposed to do?
Which form am I supposed to fill in?

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + am / is / are + supposed to + 原形動詞：規定和義務

items.en: The show is on the 14th of March, the same day we are supposed to go to the Science Museum.
items.zh: 那場表演在三月十四日，就是我們應該去科學博物館的那天。

items.en: You're supposed to show your ticket at the door.
items.zh: 你應該在門口出示票。

items.en: Students are supposed to wear their uniform on school trips.
items.zh: 學生參加校外教學應該穿制服。

items.en: We're supposed to be at the airport two hours before the flight.
items.zh: 我們應該在起飛前兩個小時到機場。

items.en: You're not supposed to park in front of the fire station.
items.zh: 你不應該把車停在消防局前面。

items.en: The kids are supposed to be in bed by nine.
items.zh: 孩子們應該九點前上床。

items.en: I'm supposed to call my mother every Sunday.
items.zh: 我應該每個星期天打給我媽。

items.en: Visitors are supposed to sign in at reception.
items.zh: 訪客應該在櫃台登記。

items.en: You're supposed to take off your shoes before you go in.
items.zh: 進去之前你應該脫鞋。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + supposed to + 原形動詞：預期的結果

items.en: Our travels are supposed to give us pleasure, knowledge and new experiences.
items.zh: 旅行應該帶給我們樂趣、知識和新的經驗。

items.en: This cream is supposed to make your skin softer.
items.zh: 這種乳霜應該能讓皮膚變得比較柔軟。

items.en: The new road is supposed to reduce traffic in the town centre.
items.zh: 新路應該能減少市中心的車流量。

items.en: Exercise is supposed to help you sleep better.
items.zh: 運動應該能幫你睡得比較好。

items.en: The course is supposed to prepare you for the exam.
items.zh: 這門課應該能幫你準備考試。

items.en: These glasses are supposed to protect your eyes from the sun.
items.zh: 這副眼鏡應該能保護你的眼睛不受陽光傷害。

examples.heading: ③ was / were + supposed to + 原形動詞：過去的義務

items.en: I was supposed to explain to them what they had to do.
items.zh: 我本來應該向他們說明他們要做什麼。

items.en: We were supposed to finish the project by Friday.
items.zh: 我們本來應該在星期五前完成專案。

items.en: She was supposed to pick up her brother after school.
items.zh: 她本來應該放學後去接她弟弟。

items.en: You were supposed to tell me about the change of plan.
items.zh: 你早該跟我說計畫改了。

items.en: The workers were supposed to wear helmets on the site.
items.zh: 工人在工地本來應該戴安全帽。

items.en: He was supposed to lock the door when he left.
items.zh: 他離開時本來應該鎖門。

items.en: I was supposed to send the invitations last week.
items.zh: 我上個星期本來應該把邀請函寄出去。

examples.heading: ④ wh- 疑問詞 + be + 主詞 + supposed to + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: What am I supposed to say to her after all this?
items.zh: 發生了這些事之後，我該跟她說什麼？

items.en: How am I supposed to finish this without any help?
items.zh: 沒有人幫忙，我要怎麼做完？

items.en: What are we supposed to wear to a garden party?
items.zh: 參加花園派對我們應該穿什麼？

items.en: Where are we supposed to put our bags?
items.zh: 我們的包包應該放哪裡？

items.en: How are you supposed to open this box?
items.zh: 這個盒子要怎麼打開？

items.en: What time are we supposed to arrive?
items.zh: 我們應該幾點到？

items.en: Who is supposed to clean the kitchen this week?
items.zh: 這個星期誰應該打掃廚房？

items.en: What is this button supposed to do?
items.zh: 這個按鈕是做什麼用的？

items.en: Which form am I supposed to fill in?
items.zh: 我應該填哪一張表格？

title: We were supposed to meet some friends at noon, but they called to ask if we could meet at the restaurant.
translation: 我們原本要中午跟幾個朋友碰面，但他們打電話來問能不能改在餐廳見。
name: was supposed to 表示原定的安排
sentences: We were supposed to go to the beach, but it was too windy.
I was supposed to work on Saturday, but my boss gave me the day off.
The parcel was supposed to arrive yesterday, but it's still not here.
She was supposed to fly to Rome, but the airport was closed.
The workers were supposed to finish the roof last week, but it rained every day.
I was supposed to cook dinner, but I fell asleep on the sofa.
We were supposed to have a test today, but the teacher was ill.
The plumber was supposed to come at eight, but he turned up at noon.
The shop was supposed to open at nine, but the door was still locked.
They were supposed to get married in May, but they postponed the wedding.
I was supposed to arrive on 11th June, but I will arrive next month instead.
The new road was supposed to open next year, but it will be later.
We were supposed to move house in March, but now we're moving in May.
The concert was supposed to be next Saturday, but they've changed the date.
I was supposed to start my new job on Monday, but it's now Wednesday.
The guests were supposed to stay for a week, but they're leaving on Friday.
My cousin was supposed to visit us at Easter, but she's coming in the summer.
The meeting? It was supposed to be on Tuesday at one.
It was supposed to be a surprise, but my sister told him.
It was supposed to be a quiet weekend, but ten people came to stay.
The party was supposed to be at Tom's house, not at the pub.
It was supposed to be sunny today, but look at the rain.
The film was supposed to be funny, but nobody laughed.
The trip was supposed to be cheap, but it cost us a fortune.
Weren't you supposed to be at work today?
Wasn't the train supposed to leave at ten?
You weren't supposed to open the present until your birthday!
I wasn't supposed to see the photos, but I found them on the table.
Weren't we supposed to meet at the café?
The kids weren't supposed to eat the cake before the party.
Wasn't your brother supposed to help us move the sofa?

examples.heading: ① was / were supposed to ..., but ...：安排沒有照原樣進行

items.en: We were supposed to go to the beach, but it was too windy.
items.zh: 我們原本要去海邊，可是風太大了。

items.en: I was supposed to work on Saturday, but my boss gave me the day off.
items.zh: 我星期六原本要上班，可是老闆讓我放假。

items.en: The parcel was supposed to arrive yesterday, but it's still not here.
items.zh: 包裹原本應該昨天到，可是到現在還沒來。

items.en: She was supposed to fly to Rome, but the airport was closed.
items.zh: 她原本要飛去羅馬，可是機場關閉了。

items.en: The workers were supposed to finish the roof last week, but it rained every day.
items.zh: 工人原本應該上星期把屋頂做好，可是每天都在下雨。

items.en: I was supposed to cook dinner, but I fell asleep on the sofa.
items.zh: 我原本要煮晚餐，可是我在沙發上睡著了。

items.en: We were supposed to have a test today, but the teacher was ill.
items.zh: 我們今天原本要考試，可是老師生病了。

items.en: The plumber was supposed to come at eight, but he turned up at noon.
items.zh: 水電工原本應該八點來，可是他中午才出現。

items.en: The shop was supposed to open at nine, but the door was still locked.
items.zh: 那家店原本應該九點開門，可是門還鎖著。

items.en: They were supposed to get married in May, but they postponed the wedding.
items.zh: 他們原本要在五月結婚，可是他們把婚禮延後了。

examples.heading: ② was / were supposed to + 原形動詞：未來的安排改變了

items.en: I was supposed to arrive on 11th June, but I will arrive next month instead.
items.zh: 我原本應該六月十一日到，可是我會改成下個月到。

items.en: The new road was supposed to open next year, but it will be later.
items.zh: 新路原本應該明年通車，可是會更晚。

items.en: We were supposed to move house in March, but now we're moving in May.
items.zh: 我們原本要三月搬家，可是現在改成五月。

items.en: The concert was supposed to be next Saturday, but they've changed the date.
items.zh: 演唱會原本應該在下星期六，可是他們改了日期。

items.en: I was supposed to start my new job on Monday, but it's now Wednesday.
items.zh: 我原本應該星期一開始新工作，可是現在改成星期三。

items.en: The guests were supposed to stay for a week, but they're leaving on Friday.
items.zh: 客人原本要待一個星期，可是他們星期五就要走了。

items.en: My cousin was supposed to visit us at Easter, but she's coming in the summer.
items.zh: 我表妹原本要在復活節來看我們，可是她改成夏天來。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + was supposed to be + 時間 / 地點 / 名詞 / 形容詞

items.en: The meeting? It was supposed to be on Tuesday at one.
items.zh: 那個會議？原本應該是星期二一點。

items.en: It was supposed to be a surprise, but my sister told him.
items.zh: 這原本應該是個驚喜，可是我妹告訴他了。

items.en: It was supposed to be a quiet weekend, but ten people came to stay.
items.zh: 這原本應該是個安靜的週末，可是來了十個人住。

items.en: The party was supposed to be at Tom's house, not at the pub.
items.zh: 派對原本應該在 Tom 家，不是在酒吧。

items.en: It was supposed to be sunny today, but look at the rain.
items.zh: 今天原本應該是晴天，可是你看這場雨。

items.en: The film was supposed to be funny, but nobody laughed.
items.zh: 那部電影原本應該很好笑，可是沒有人笑。

items.en: The trip was supposed to be cheap, but it cost us a fortune.
items.zh: 這趟旅行原本應該很便宜，可是花了我們一大筆錢。

examples.heading: ④ Weren't you supposed to ...? / 否定

items.en: Weren't you supposed to be at work today?
items.zh: 你今天不是應該在上班嗎？

items.en: Wasn't the train supposed to leave at ten?
items.zh: 火車不是應該十點開嗎？

items.en: You weren't supposed to open the present until your birthday!
items.zh: 你應該等到生日才能拆禮物的！

items.en: I wasn't supposed to see the photos, but I found them on the table.
items.zh: 我原本不應該看到那些照片，可是我在桌上發現了。

items.en: Weren't we supposed to meet at the café?
items.zh: 我們不是說好在咖啡店見面嗎？

items.en: The kids weren't supposed to eat the cake before the party.
items.zh: 孩子們原本不應該在派對前吃蛋糕。

items.en: Wasn't your brother supposed to help us move the sofa?
items.zh: 你哥不是說好要幫我們搬沙發嗎？

title: A person who acts in that way is sure to be successful.
translation: 用那種方式做事的人一定會成功。
name: be sure to 和 be certain to 表示確定
sentences: A dog like that is sure to need a lot of exercise.
By bicycle, you don't get stuck in traffic, and you're sure to arrive at work on time.
This recipe is sure to impress your guests.
The new swimming pool is sure to attract families.
If you water the seeds every day, they're sure to grow.
A walk in the fresh air is sure to make you feel better.
With such a good cast, the play is sure to do well.
The question is sure to come up in the exam.
A present like that is sure to make her smile.
Your story is sure to make everyone laugh.
The market is still small, but we are certain to attract more and more students.
The new law is certain to cause some problems.
The company is certain to make a profit this year.
The decision is certain to upset the fans.
Prices are certain to rise after the tax change.
The minister is certain to face difficult questions.
Building a second runway is certain to divide the local community.
The festival is certain to bring money into the town.
The new medicine is not certain to work for everyone.
The weather isn't certain to stay fine all weekend.
A higher price isn't certain to mean better quality.
The new manager isn't certain to stay for long.
Hard work isn't certain to bring success, but it helps.
She is almost certain to win the gold medal.
The train is almost sure to be late in this snow.
The shop is fairly certain to close next year.
The tickets are almost certain to sell out on the first day.
Our neighbours are almost sure to complain about the music.
The vote is almost certain to go in our favour.
The bridge is almost sure to need repairs after the storm.
He is almost certain to be chosen for the team.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + be + sure to + 原形動詞

items.en: A dog like that is sure to need a lot of exercise.
items.zh: 那樣的狗一定需要很多運動。

items.en: By bicycle, you don't get stuck in traffic, and you're sure to arrive at work on time.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車不會塞車，你一定能準時上班。

items.en: This recipe is sure to impress your guests.
items.zh: 這道食譜一定會讓你的客人印象深刻。

items.en: The new swimming pool is sure to attract families.
items.zh: 新的游泳池一定會吸引很多家庭。

items.en: If you water the seeds every day, they're sure to grow.
items.zh: 如果你每天幫種子澆水，它們一定會長出來。

items.en: A walk in the fresh air is sure to make you feel better.
items.zh: 在新鮮空氣裡散個步一定會讓你覺得好一點。

items.en: With such a good cast, the play is sure to do well.
items.zh: 有這麼好的演員陣容，這齣戲一定會很成功。

items.en: The question is sure to come up in the exam.
items.zh: 這個問題一定會出現在考試裡。

items.en: A present like that is sure to make her smile.
items.zh: 那樣的禮物一定會讓她笑。

items.en: Your story is sure to make everyone laugh.
items.zh: 你的故事一定會讓大家笑。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + certain to + 原形動詞

items.en: The market is still small, but we are certain to attract more and more students.
items.zh: 市場還很小，可是我們一定會吸引越來越多學生。

items.en: The new law is certain to cause some problems.
items.zh: 新法律一定會造成一些問題。

items.en: The company is certain to make a profit this year.
items.zh: 那家公司今年一定會獲利。

items.en: The decision is certain to upset the fans.
items.zh: 這個決定一定會讓球迷不高興。

items.en: Prices are certain to rise after the tax change.
items.zh: 稅制改變後，物價一定會上漲。

items.en: The minister is certain to face difficult questions.
items.zh: 部長一定會面對很難回答的問題。

items.en: Building a second runway is certain to divide the local community.
items.zh: 蓋第二條跑道一定會讓當地居民意見分歧。

items.en: The festival is certain to bring money into the town.
items.zh: 這個節慶活動一定會為鎮上帶來收入。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + be + not certain + to + 原形動詞

items.en: The new medicine is not certain to work for everyone.
items.zh: 新藥不一定對每個人都有效。

items.en: The weather isn't certain to stay fine all weekend.
items.zh: 天氣不一定整個週末都會很好。

items.en: A higher price isn't certain to mean better quality.
items.zh: 價錢比較高不一定代表品質比較好。

items.en: The new manager isn't certain to stay for long.
items.zh: 新經理不一定會待很久。

items.en: Hard work isn't certain to bring success, but it helps.
items.zh: 努力不一定會帶來成功，可是有幫助。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + be + almost / fairly + sure / certain + to + 原形動詞

items.en: She is almost certain to win the gold medal.
items.zh: 她幾乎一定會拿到金牌。

items.en: The train is almost sure to be late in this snow.
items.zh: 這種雪，火車幾乎一定會誤點。

items.en: The shop is fairly certain to close next year.
items.zh: 那家店明年相當確定會關門。

items.en: The tickets are almost certain to sell out on the first day.
items.zh: 票幾乎一定會在第一天賣完。

items.en: Our neighbours are almost sure to complain about the music.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居幾乎一定會抱怨音樂太吵。

items.en: The vote is almost certain to go in our favour.
items.zh: 投票結果幾乎一定會對我們有利。

items.en: The bridge is almost sure to need repairs after the storm.
items.zh: 暴風雨過後，那座橋幾乎一定需要修理。

items.en: He is almost certain to be chosen for the team.
items.zh: 他幾乎一定會被選進隊伍。（被動）

title: I think they are rather jealous because they daren't give up their cars.
translation: 我覺得他們其實有點嫉妒，因為他們不敢放棄自己的車。
name: 半情態動詞 dare 表示有膽量
sentences: My neighbours daren't leave their windows open at night.
Most of my friends daren't leave their safe jobs.
He daren't jump from the high board.
I daren't try skiing again after last year's accident.
Many workers dare not speak up about the problems in the factory.
She daren't ride a motorbike in the city.
Some parents dare not let their children walk to school alone.
I daren't go on the big rollercoaster.
I didn't dare tell anyone about my plan.
She didn't dare say no to her boss.
We didn't dare to go into the cave.
He didn't dare look his father in the eye.
The boys didn't dare climb over the wall.
I didn't dare to ask the famous writer for a photo.
On her first day, the new student didn't dare answer any questions.
She didn't dare to quit university, although she hated her course.
He was the only one who dared to jump into the river.
She finally dared to tell her parents she wanted to be an actor.
Not many people dare to start their own business.
The young reporter dared to ask the president a difficult question.
My grandmother dared to travel around the world alone at seventy.
Only a few climbers dare to try this mountain in winter.
He dared to sing in front of the whole school.
I've never dared to try the spicy noodles at that restaurant.
Would you dare go skydiving?
Would you dare sleep in a tent in the forest?
Would you dare tell your teacher she's wrong?
Would you dare give up your phone for a month?
Would you dare swim with sharks?
Would you dare move to another country without a job?
Would you dare try the fried insects at the night market?

examples.heading: ① daren't / dare not + 原形動詞：沒有膽量

items.en: My neighbours daren't leave their windows open at night.
items.zh: 我的鄰居晚上不敢開著窗戶。

items.en: Most of my friends daren't leave their safe jobs.
items.zh: 我大部分的朋友都不敢離開穩定的工作。

items.en: He daren't jump from the high board.
items.zh: 他不敢從高跳台跳下去。

items.en: I daren't try skiing again after last year's accident.
items.zh: 發生去年那次意外之後，我不敢再去滑雪了。

items.en: Many workers dare not speak up about the problems in the factory.
items.zh: 很多工人不敢說出工廠裡的問題。

items.en: She daren't ride a motorbike in the city.
items.zh: 她不敢在市區騎機車。

items.en: Some parents dare not let their children walk to school alone.
items.zh: 有些父母不敢讓孩子自己走路上學。

items.en: I daren't go on the big rollercoaster.
items.zh: 我不敢坐那個大雲霄飛車。

examples.heading: ② didn't dare + (to) + 原形動詞：過去沒有膽量

items.en: I didn't dare tell anyone about my plan.
items.zh: 我不敢跟任何人說我的計畫。

items.en: She didn't dare say no to her boss.
items.zh: 她不敢拒絕她的老闆。

items.en: We didn't dare to go into the cave.
items.zh: 我們不敢進那個山洞。

items.en: He didn't dare look his father in the eye.
items.zh: 他不敢直視他爸爸的眼睛。

items.en: The boys didn't dare climb over the wall.
items.zh: 那些男孩不敢爬過那道牆。

items.en: I didn't dare to ask the famous writer for a photo.
items.zh: 我不敢請那位有名的作家跟我合照。

items.en: On her first day, the new student didn't dare answer any questions.
items.zh: 新同學第一天不敢回答任何問題。

items.en: She didn't dare to quit university, although she hated her course.
items.zh: 雖然她很討厭自己的科系，她還是不敢休學。

examples.heading: ③ dare / dared + to + 原形動詞：有膽量

items.en: He was the only one who dared to jump into the river.
items.zh: 他是唯一敢跳進河裡的人。

items.en: She finally dared to tell her parents she wanted to be an actor.
items.zh: 她終於敢告訴爸媽她想當演員。

items.en: Not many people dare to start their own business.
items.zh: 敢自己創業的人不多。

items.en: The young reporter dared to ask the president a difficult question.
items.zh: 那個年輕記者敢問總統一個很難的問題。

items.en: My grandmother dared to travel around the world alone at seventy.
items.zh: 我奶奶七十歲還敢一個人環遊世界。

items.en: Only a few climbers dare to try this mountain in winter.
items.zh: 只有少數登山客敢在冬天挑戰這座山。

items.en: He dared to sing in front of the whole school.
items.zh: 他敢在全校面前唱歌。

items.en: I've never dared to try the spicy noodles at that restaurant.
items.zh: 我從來不敢吃那家餐廳的辣麵。

examples.heading: ④ Would you dare + 原形動詞 ...?：問對方有沒有膽量

items.en: Would you dare go skydiving?
items.zh: 你敢去跳傘嗎？

items.en: Would you dare sleep in a tent in the forest?
items.zh: 你敢在森林裡的帳篷睡覺嗎？

items.en: Would you dare tell your teacher she's wrong?
items.zh: 你敢跟老師說她錯了嗎？

items.en: Would you dare give up your phone for a month?
items.zh: 你敢一個月不用手機嗎？

items.en: Would you dare swim with sharks?
items.zh: 你敢跟鯊魚一起游泳嗎？

items.en: Would you dare move to another country without a job?
items.zh: 你敢沒找到工作就搬去另一個國家嗎？

items.en: Would you dare try the fried insects at the night market?
items.zh: 你敢吃夜市的炸昆蟲嗎？

title: May I have your attention, please?
translation: 可以請大家注意一下嗎？
name: may I 表示正式的請求和指示
sentences: May I have your names, please? I need them for the list.
May I have your boarding passes, please?
May I have a show of hands? Who is coming on the trip?
May I have everyone's reports by Friday?
May I have a quiet moment before we start the exam?
May I have your full address for the delivery?
To save paper, may I ask you to use email or post whenever possible?
Before the film starts, may I ask you to switch off your phones?
May I ask you to keep your seat belts on until the plane stops?
May I ask you to sign the visitors' book at the entrance?
May I ask you all to take your seats? The meeting is about to begin.
May I ask you to fill in the form in black ink?
May I ask you not to take photos inside the church?
About travelling around while we're there, may I suggest using the two bicycles at the house?
May I suggest meeting at the hotel instead of the station?
May I suggest starting the meeting half an hour earlier?
May I suggest booking the restaurant in advance? It gets very busy.
May I suggest taking a short break before we go on?
May I suggest sending the invitations by email?
May I suggest that the committee looks at the budget again in March?
May I suggest that you bring warm clothes? The nights are cold.
May I suggest that we leave the decision until Monday?
May I suggest that you speak to the manager directly?
May I suggest that the children sit at the front?
May I suggest that we share the cost of the taxi?
May I suggest the fish? It's very fresh today.
May I suggest a different date for the party?
May I suggest a small change to the plan?
May I suggest the red wine with your steak?
May I suggest a quieter table by the window?
May I suggest a short walk after dinner?

examples.heading: ① May I have + 名詞：要求注意或資料

items.en: May I have your names, please? I need them for the list.
items.zh: 請給我你們的名字好嗎？我要寫在名單上。

items.en: May I have your boarding passes, please?
items.zh: 請出示您的登機證好嗎？

items.en: May I have a show of hands? Who is coming on the trip?
items.zh: 請大家舉手好嗎？誰會參加這次旅行？

items.en: May I have everyone's reports by Friday?
items.zh: 請大家星期五前交報告好嗎？

items.en: May I have a quiet moment before we start the exam?
items.zh: 考試開始前，請大家安靜一下好嗎？

items.en: May I have your full address for the delivery?
items.zh: 請給我您完整的送貨地址好嗎？

examples.heading: ② May I ask you to + 原形動詞：有禮貌的指示

items.en: To save paper, may I ask you to use email or post whenever possible?
items.zh: 為了節省紙張，可以請您盡量使用電子郵件或郵寄嗎？

items.en: Before the film starts, may I ask you to switch off your phones?
items.zh: 電影開始前，可以請大家把手機關掉嗎？

items.en: May I ask you to keep your seat belts on until the plane stops?
items.zh: 可以請您在飛機停穩前繫好安全帶嗎？

items.en: May I ask you to sign the visitors' book at the entrance?
items.zh: 可以請您在入口的訪客登記簿上簽名嗎？

items.en: May I ask you all to take your seats? The meeting is about to begin.
items.zh: 可以請大家就座嗎？會議快要開始了。

items.en: May I ask you to fill in the form in black ink?
items.zh: 可以請您用黑色墨水填這張表格嗎？

items.en: May I ask you not to take photos inside the church?
items.zh: 可以請您不要在教堂裡拍照嗎？

examples.heading: ③ May I suggest + -ing：有禮貌的建議

items.en: About travelling around while we're there, may I suggest using the two bicycles at the house?
items.zh: 關於我們在那裡怎麼移動，我建議用屋子裡那兩台腳踏車好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest meeting at the hotel instead of the station?
items.zh: 我建議在飯店碰面，不在車站，好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest starting the meeting half an hour earlier?
items.zh: 我建議會議提早半小時開始好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest booking the restaurant in advance? It gets very busy.
items.zh: 我建議先訂餐廳好嗎？那裡很多人。

items.en: May I suggest taking a short break before we go on?
items.zh: 我建議我們先休息一下再繼續好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest sending the invitations by email?
items.zh: 我建議用電子郵件寄邀請函好嗎？

examples.heading: ④ May I suggest + that 子句

items.en: May I suggest that the committee looks at the budget again in March?
items.zh: 我建議委員會三月再檢討一次預算好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest that you bring warm clothes? The nights are cold.
items.zh: 我建議您帶保暖的衣服好嗎？晚上很冷。

items.en: May I suggest that we leave the decision until Monday?
items.zh: 我建議我們星期一再決定好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest that you speak to the manager directly?
items.zh: 我建議您直接跟經理談好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest that the children sit at the front?
items.zh: 我建議讓孩子們坐在前面好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest that we share the cost of the taxi?
items.zh: 我建議我們分攤計程車費好嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ May I suggest + 名詞

items.en: May I suggest the fish? It's very fresh today.
items.zh: 我推薦您吃魚好嗎？今天的魚很新鮮。

items.en: May I suggest a different date for the party?
items.zh: 我建議派對換一個日期好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest a small change to the plan?
items.zh: 我建議計畫做一點小改變好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest the red wine with your steak?
items.zh: 我推薦您的牛排配紅酒好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest a quieter table by the window?
items.zh: 我建議您坐窗邊比較安靜的那桌好嗎？

items.en: May I suggest a short walk after dinner?
items.zh: 我建議晚餐後散個步好嗎？

title: We must insist that the agreement is binding and that the contract shall be fulfilled.
translation: 我們必須堅持這份協議具有約束力，而且合約必須履行。
name: shall 表示命令（極正式）
sentences: The factory delivered only half the machines. We therefore need to insist that the agreement is binding and that the contract shall be fulfilled.
Your company still owes us twelve thousand pounds. We insist that the full amount shall be paid by the end of the month.
Half of the chairs arrived broken. Our client insists that the damaged goods shall be replaced.
The new school must open in September. We must insist that the work shall be completed by June.
Your lease ends next week. The owners insist that the building shall be returned in its original condition.
We never agreed to join your mailing list. We insist that our names shall be removed from it.
Clause two of the lease says: "The tenant shall pay the rent on the first day of each month."
The sales contract is clear: "The seller shall deliver the goods within fourteen days."
My new job contract says: "The employee shall work thirty-seven hours a week."
Under our rental agreement, the landlord shall repair any damage to the roof.
The last line of the agreement reads: "Both parties shall keep the terms of this agreement secret."
The new safety law has a clear rule: the company shall provide all staff with safety training.
Our contract with the Spanish supplier says: "All payments shall be made in euros."
The lawyer added one more line: "Any changes to this contract shall be agreed in writing."
The rules of the parents' association say that the meeting shall be held every three months.
The hotel's guest rules state: "Complaints shall be sent to the manager within seven days."
According to the school rules, the prize shall be given to the student with the highest mark.
The builders received a notice from the council: "All rubbish shall be removed from the site before Friday."
The new constitution says that every citizen shall have the right to vote.
Under the constitution, the president shall serve for four years.
Article five of the society's rules says: "The committee shall meet at least once a month."
The sign on the factory gate reads: "No person shall enter the building without a pass."
The rules of the tennis club say: "Members shall pay their fees by the first of January."
The club's rules are clear on this point: the club shall elect a new chairperson every two years.
In the film, the old wizard stands on the bridge and shouts at the monster: "You shall not pass!"
In the story, the fairy godmother says: "You shall go to the ball, Cinderella."
I'm so sorry about the mistake. You shall have your money back by Friday. I promise.
The king said to the young knight: "You shall stay here until I return."
You have damaged our property and refused to pay. You shall hear from our lawyer.
The old farmer told his sons: "If you work hard, you shall have a reward."
The headmistress in the old novel says to the girl: "You shall not leave this room without permission."

examples.heading: ① insist that + 主詞 + shall be + 過去分詞：律師信

items.en: The factory delivered only half the machines. We therefore need to insist that the agreement is binding and that the contract shall be fulfilled.
items.zh: 工廠只交了一半的機器。因此我們必須堅持，這份協議有約束力，合約必須履行。（被動）

items.en: Your company still owes us twelve thousand pounds. We insist that the full amount shall be paid by the end of the month.
items.zh: 貴公司還欠我們一萬兩千英鎊。我們堅持全額必須在月底前付清。（被動）

items.en: Half of the chairs arrived broken. Our client insists that the damaged goods shall be replaced.
items.zh: 有一半的椅子送到時是壞的。我們的客戶堅持損壞的貨物必須更換。（被動）

items.en: The new school must open in September. We must insist that the work shall be completed by June.
items.zh: 新學校九月一定要開學。我們必須堅持工程要在六月前完成。（被動）

items.en: Your lease ends next week. The owners insist that the building shall be returned in its original condition.
items.zh: 你的租約下星期到期。屋主堅持建築物必須恢復原狀交還。（被動）

items.en: We never agreed to join your mailing list. We insist that our names shall be removed from it.
items.zh: 我們從來沒有同意加入你們的郵寄名單。我們堅持我們的名字必須從名單上移除。（被動）

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + shall + 原形動詞：合約的條款

items.en: Clause two of the lease says: "The tenant shall pay the rent on the first day of each month."
items.zh: 租約第二條寫著：承租人應於每月一日支付租金。

items.en: The sales contract is clear: "The seller shall deliver the goods within fourteen days."
items.zh: 買賣合約寫得很清楚：賣方應於十四天內交貨。

items.en: My new job contract says: "The employee shall work thirty-seven hours a week."
items.zh: 我的新工作合約寫著：員工每週應工作三十七個小時。

items.en: Under our rental agreement, the landlord shall repair any damage to the roof.
items.zh: 根據我們的租賃協議，房東應修理屋頂的任何損壞。

items.en: The last line of the agreement reads: "Both parties shall keep the terms of this agreement secret."
items.zh: 協議的最後一行寫著：雙方應對本協議的條款保密。

items.en: The new safety law has a clear rule: the company shall provide all staff with safety training.
items.zh: 新的安全法規有一條清楚的規定：公司應為所有員工提供安全訓練。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + shall be + 過去分詞：規定事情怎麼處理

items.en: Our contract with the Spanish supplier says: "All payments shall be made in euros."
items.zh: 我們和西班牙供應商的合約寫著：所有款項應以歐元支付。（被動）

items.en: The lawyer added one more line: "Any changes to this contract shall be agreed in writing."
items.zh: 律師又加了一行：本合約的任何變更應以書面同意。（被動）

items.en: The rules of the parents' association say that the meeting shall be held every three months.
items.zh: 家長會的章程規定，會議應每三個月舉行一次。（被動）

items.en: The hotel's guest rules state: "Complaints shall be sent to the manager within seven days."
items.zh: 飯店的住客規定寫著：投訴應於七天內送交經理。（被動）

items.en: According to the school rules, the prize shall be given to the student with the highest mark.
items.zh: 根據校規，獎項應頒給分數最高的學生。（被動）

items.en: The builders received a notice from the council: "All rubbish shall be removed from the site before Friday."
items.zh: 建商收到議會的通知：所有垃圾應於星期五前清出工地。（被動）

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + shall + 原形動詞：法律和章程

items.en: The new constitution says that every citizen shall have the right to vote.
items.zh: 新憲法規定，每個公民都應享有投票權。

items.en: Under the constitution, the president shall serve for four years.
items.zh: 根據憲法，總統任期應為四年。

items.en: Article five of the society's rules says: "The committee shall meet at least once a month."
items.zh: 學會章程第五條寫著：委員會應至少每月開會一次。

items.en: The sign on the factory gate reads: "No person shall enter the building without a pass."
items.zh: 工廠大門的牌子寫著：任何人沒有通行證不得進入大樓。

items.en: The rules of the tennis club say: "Members shall pay their fees by the first of January."
items.zh: 網球俱樂部的章程寫著：會員應於一月一日前繳交會費。

items.en: The club's rules are clear on this point: the club shall elect a new chairperson every two years.
items.zh: 俱樂部的章程對這一點寫得很清楚：俱樂部應每兩年選出新主席。

examples.heading: ⑤ You shall + 原形動詞：很正式或文學的命令

items.en: In the film, the old wizard stands on the bridge and shouts at the monster: "You shall not pass!"
items.zh: 電影裡，老巫師站在橋上對怪物大喊：你不准過去！

items.en: In the story, the fairy godmother says: "You shall go to the ball, Cinderella."
items.zh: 故事裡，仙女教母說：仙杜瑞拉，你一定會去參加舞會。

items.en: I'm so sorry about the mistake. You shall have your money back by Friday. I promise.
items.zh: 這個錯誤我很抱歉。星期五前你一定會拿回你的錢。我保證。

items.en: The king said to the young knight: "You shall stay here until I return."
items.zh: 國王對年輕的騎士說：在我回來之前，你要待在這裡。

items.en: You have damaged our property and refused to pay. You shall hear from our lawyer.
items.zh: 你損壞了我們的財產又拒絕賠償。你會收到我們律師的消息。

items.en: The old farmer told his sons: "If you work hard, you shall have a reward."
items.zh: 老農夫告訴他的兒子們：如果你們努力工作，你們一定會得到獎賞。

items.en: The headmistress in the old novel says to the girl: "You shall not leave this room without permission."
items.zh: 那本老小說裡的女校長對女孩說：沒有允許，你不准離開這個房間。

title: However, I must admit that I completely agree with Chris.
translation: 你得承認，不是所有現成的餐點都很好吃。
name: I must admit 表示讓步
sentences: I wanted to take the mountain road. However, I must admit that I completely agree with Chris. It's too dangerous.
Thanks for bringing me to the party. I didn't want to come, but I must admit I'm enjoying myself.
After my first week at the new school, I must admit that my maths teacher is better than I expected.
The meal tonight was delicious. I must admit I was wrong about this restaurant.
I hated the book at first, but I must admit the ending is brilliant.
We've talked about both trips for an hour. I must admit that your plan is better than mine.
Let's order a pizza tonight. I must admit that I'm not very good at cooking.
Sorry, I only got the report this morning. I must admit I haven't read the whole thing.
Everyone said my talk went well. I must admit that I was a little nervous before it.
My English friends love watching cricket. I must admit I don't understand the rules.
You phoned me on Tuesday, didn't you? I must admit I forgot to call you back.
My wardrobe is full again. I must admit that I spend too much on clothes.
Ready-made meals are quick. On the other hand, you must admit that they are often not as healthy as fresh food.
I know the climb was hard. But you must admit that the view from up here is amazing.
You don't like your cousin very much, but you must admit she plays the piano beautifully.
We got the last two seats on the train. You must admit that it was a good idea to leave early.
This bike is almost new, and I'm only asking fifty pounds. You must admit the price is very fair.
You said Lisbon was too hilly. But you must admit that the city looks lovely at night.
Living in the country is peaceful. However, I must admit that it can be lonely.
Mobile phones are useful, but I must admit they take up too much of our time.
Thanks for asking about the music festival. It was great. However, I must admit the food was expensive.
Online shopping is easy, but I must admit I miss real shops.
Our teacher wants us to join a team. Team sports are fun. However, I must admit I prefer swimming alone.
You asked about the first aid course. It was useful, but I must admit some lessons were boring.
I asked Emma to dance, and I must admit, I was surprised when she said yes.
Thanks for taking me to this little café. I must admit, this is the best coffee I've ever had.
Congratulations on the race! I must admit, I didn't expect you to win.
We just got back from Rome. I must admit, the hotel was much nicer than the photos.
My brother got a new bike for his birthday. I must admit, I was a bit jealous of him.
Thanks for taking the kids to the zoo. I must admit, they behaved very well today.
Your train leaves in five minutes. I must admit, I've never been good at saying goodbye.

examples.heading: ① I must admit (that) + 子句：承認改變了想法

items.en: I wanted to take the mountain road. However, I must admit that I completely agree with Chris. It's too dangerous.
items.zh: 我本來想走山路。不過，我必須承認，我完全同意 Chris。那太危險了。

items.en: Thanks for bringing me to the party. I didn't want to come, but I must admit I'm enjoying myself.
items.zh: 謝謝你帶我來派對。我本來不想來，可是我必須承認，我玩得很開心。

items.en: After my first week at the new school, I must admit that my maths teacher is better than I expected.
items.zh: 在新學校上了一週課以後，我必須承認，數學老師比我想的好。

items.en: The meal tonight was delicious. I must admit I was wrong about this restaurant.
items.zh: 今晚的餐點很好吃。我必須承認，我對這家餐廳的看法錯了。

items.en: I hated the book at first, but I must admit the ending is brilliant.
items.zh: 我一開始很討厭那本書，可是我必須承認，結局很精彩。

items.en: We've talked about both trips for an hour. I must admit that your plan is better than mine.
items.zh: 我們討論這兩個旅行計畫一個小時了。我必須承認，你的計畫比我的好。

examples.heading: ② I must admit (that) + 子句：承認自己的缺點

items.en: Let's order a pizza tonight. I must admit that I'm not very good at cooking.
items.zh: 我們今晚叫披薩吧。我必須承認，我不太會煮飯。

items.en: Sorry, I only got the report this morning. I must admit I haven't read the whole thing.
items.zh: 抱歉，我今天早上才收到報告。我必須承認，我沒讀完整份。

items.en: Everyone said my talk went well. I must admit that I was a little nervous before it.
items.zh: 大家都說我的演講很順利。我必須承認，演講前我有點緊張。

items.en: My English friends love watching cricket. I must admit I don't understand the rules.
items.zh: 我的英國朋友很愛看板球。我必須承認，我不懂它的規則。

items.en: You phoned me on Tuesday, didn't you? I must admit I forgot to call you back.
items.zh: 你星期二打給我，對吧？我必須承認，我忘了回你電話。

items.en: My wardrobe is full again. I must admit that I spend too much on clothes.
items.zh: 我的衣櫃又滿了。我必須承認，我花太多錢買衣服。

examples.heading: ③ You must admit (that) + 子句：請對方接受

items.en: Ready-made meals are quick. On the other hand, you must admit that they are often not as healthy as fresh food.
items.zh: 即食餐點很快。另一方面，你必須承認，它們常常不如新鮮食物健康。

items.en: I know the climb was hard. But you must admit that the view from up here is amazing.
items.zh: 我知道這段路爬得很辛苦。可是你必須承認，從這上面看出去的風景很棒。

items.en: You don't like your cousin very much, but you must admit she plays the piano beautifully.
items.zh: 你不太喜歡你表妹，可是你必須承認，她鋼琴彈得很好。

items.en: We got the last two seats on the train. You must admit that it was a good idea to leave early.
items.zh: 我們搶到火車上最後兩個位子。你必須承認，提早出發是個好主意。

items.en: This bike is almost new, and I'm only asking fifty pounds. You must admit the price is very fair.
items.zh: 這台腳踏車幾乎是新的，我只賣五十英鎊。你必須承認，這個價錢很公道。

items.en: You said Lisbon was too hilly. But you must admit that the city looks lovely at night.
items.zh: 你說里斯本坡太多。可是你必須承認，這個城市晚上看起來很美。

examples.heading: ④ However / But + I must admit + 子句：議論文的讓步

items.en: Living in the country is peaceful. However, I must admit that it can be lonely.
items.zh: 住在鄉下很寧靜。不過，我必須承認，有時候會很寂寞。

items.en: Mobile phones are useful, but I must admit they take up too much of our time.
items.zh: 手機很有用，可是我必須承認，它們佔用了我們太多時間。

items.en: Thanks for asking about the music festival. It was great. However, I must admit the food was expensive.
items.zh: 謝謝你問起音樂節。它很棒。不過，我必須承認，食物很貴。

items.en: Online shopping is easy, but I must admit I miss real shops.
items.zh: 網購很方便，可是我必須承認，我懷念實體商店。

items.en: Our teacher wants us to join a team. Team sports are fun. However, I must admit I prefer swimming alone.
items.zh: 老師要我們參加球隊。團體運動很好玩。不過，我必須承認，我比較喜歡一個人游泳。

items.en: You asked about the first aid course. It was useful, but I must admit some lessons were boring.
items.zh: 你問起急救課程。它很有用，可是我必須承認，有些課很無聊。

examples.heading: ⑤ I must admit, + 句子：放在句首當插入語

items.en: I asked Emma to dance, and I must admit, I was surprised when she said yes.
items.zh: 我邀請 Emma 跳舞。我必須承認，她答應的時候我很驚訝。

items.en: Thanks for taking me to this little café. I must admit, this is the best coffee I've ever had.
items.zh: 謝謝你帶我來這家小咖啡店。我必須承認，這是我喝過最好喝的咖啡。

items.en: Congratulations on the race! I must admit, I didn't expect you to win.
items.zh: 恭喜你贏了比賽！我必須承認，我沒想到你會贏。

items.en: We just got back from Rome. I must admit, the hotel was much nicer than the photos.
items.zh: 我們剛從羅馬回來。我必須承認，那家飯店比照片好多了。

items.en: My brother got a new bike for his birthday. I must admit, I was a bit jealous of him.
items.zh: 我哥哥生日收到一台新腳踏車。我必須承認，我有點嫉妒他。

items.en: Thanks for taking the kids to the zoo. I must admit, they behaved very well today.
items.zh: 謝謝你帶孩子們去動物園。我必須承認，他們今天表現得很好。

items.en: Your train leaves in five minutes. I must admit, I've never been good at saying goodbye.
items.zh: 你的火車五分鐘後就要開了。我必須承認，我一直都不擅長道別。

title: You might not have been able to change the world, but maybe you have made a difference to one or two people.
translation: 總的來說，這次也許不算大成功，但大家都玩得很開心。
name: might 加 but 表示安慰或辯解
sentences: You might not have saved the old cinema, but you made people care about it.
You might not have got the job, but the interview was good practice.
Your team might not have won the cup, but they played brilliantly.
The cake might not have looked perfect, but it tasted wonderful.
You might not have passed this time, but you're much closer.
Your painting might not have won a prize, but everyone stopped to look at it.
All in all, it might not have been a huge success, but people enjoyed themselves.
It might not have been the best holiday, but we laughed a lot.
It might not have been a big crowd, but they were very enthusiastic.
It might not have been an easy year, but we learned a lot.
It might not have been the result we wanted, but we did our best.
It might not have been a five-star hotel, but it was clean and friendly.
The idea that fashion shows people's attitudes might sound superficial, but on closer examination it turns out to be true.
Learning Latin might seem useless, but it helps you understand many English words.
A four-day week might sound strange, but many companies find it works.
My advice might seem hard, but it's for your own good.
Getting up at five might sound crazy, but it gives me time to think.
The rule might seem unfair, but it keeps everyone safe.
Going to the gym to keep fit might be boring sometimes, but most young people enjoy some kind of sport.
The work might be hard, but the pay is good.
The flat might be small, but it's close to everything.
The journey might be long, but the views are amazing.
My grandfather might be slow, but he never forgets anything.
The course might be expensive, but it will help your career.
I might have been late, but I did finish the work.
I might have spent too much, but it was a special day.
I might have said the wrong thing, but I was trying to help.
We might have left early, but we had a long drive home.
I might have made mistakes, but I learned from them.
She might have shouted, but she was very worried about you.
He might have forgotten your birthday, but he's planning a big surprise.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + might not have + 過去分詞, but + 句子：安慰別人

items.en: You might not have saved the old cinema, but you made people care about it.
items.zh: 你可能沒救回那家老電影院，可是你讓大家開始關心它。

items.en: You might not have got the job, but the interview was good practice.
items.zh: 你可能沒拿到那份工作，可是那次面試是很好的練習。

items.en: Your team might not have won the cup, but they played brilliantly.
items.zh: 你們隊可能沒贏得獎盃，可是他們踢得很精彩。

items.en: The cake might not have looked perfect, but it tasted wonderful.
items.zh: 蛋糕可能看起來不完美，可是很好吃。

items.en: You might not have passed this time, but you're much closer.
items.zh: 你這次可能沒考過，可是你已經很接近了。

items.en: Your painting might not have won a prize, but everyone stopped to look at it.
items.zh: 你的畫可能沒得獎，可是每個人都停下來看。

examples.heading: ② It might not have been + 名詞或形容詞, but + 句子：總結活動

items.en: All in all, it might not have been a huge success, but people enjoyed themselves.
items.zh: 總之，這可能不算非常成功，可是大家都玩得很開心。

items.en: It might not have been the best holiday, but we laughed a lot.
items.zh: 那可能不是最好的假期，可是我們笑得很開心。

items.en: It might not have been a big crowd, but they were very enthusiastic.
items.zh: 觀眾可能不多，可是他們非常熱情。

items.en: It might not have been an easy year, but we learned a lot.
items.zh: 這可能不是輕鬆的一年，可是我們學到很多。

items.en: It might not have been the result we wanted, but we did our best.
items.zh: 這可能不是我們想要的結果，可是我們盡力了。

items.en: It might not have been a five-star hotel, but it was clean and friendly.
items.zh: 那可能不是五星級飯店，可是很乾淨，人也很友善。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + might sound / seem + 形容詞, but + 句子：為看法辯護

items.en: The idea that fashion shows people's attitudes might sound superficial, but on closer examination it turns out to be true.
items.zh: 時尚反映人們態度的說法可能聽起來很膚淺，可是仔細看就會發現是真的。

items.en: Learning Latin might seem useless, but it helps you understand many English words.
items.zh: 學拉丁文可能看起來沒用，可是它幫助你了解很多英文字。

items.en: A four-day week might sound strange, but many companies find it works.
items.zh: 一星期工作四天可能聽起來很奇怪，可是很多公司發現它行得通。

items.en: My advice might seem hard, but it's for your own good.
items.zh: 我的建議可能看起來很嚴厲，可是是為了你好。

items.en: Getting up at five might sound crazy, but it gives me time to think.
items.zh: 五點起床可能聽起來很瘋狂，可是這讓我有時間思考。

items.en: The rule might seem unfair, but it keeps everyone safe.
items.zh: 這條規定可能看起來不公平，可是它保護每個人的安全。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + might be + 形容詞, but + 句子：承認缺點

items.en: Going to the gym to keep fit might be boring sometimes, but most young people enjoy some kind of sport.
items.zh: 去健身房保持身材有時候可能很無聊，可是大部分年輕人都喜歡某種運動。

items.en: The work might be hard, but the pay is good.
items.zh: 這份工作可能很辛苦，可是薪水很好。

items.en: The flat might be small, but it's close to everything.
items.zh: 這間公寓可能很小，可是離什麼都很近。

items.en: The journey might be long, but the views are amazing.
items.zh: 這趟路程可能很長，可是風景很美。

items.en: My grandfather might be slow, but he never forgets anything.
items.zh: 我爺爺可能動作很慢，可是他什麼都不會忘。

items.en: The course might be expensive, but it will help your career.
items.zh: 這門課可能很貴，可是它對你的事業有幫助。

examples.heading: ⑤ I might have + 過去分詞, but + 句子：為自己做的事辯護

items.en: I might have been late, but I did finish the work.
items.zh: 我可能遲到了，可是我確實把工作做完了。

items.en: I might have spent too much, but it was a special day.
items.zh: 我可能花太多錢了，可是那天是特別的日子。

items.en: I might have said the wrong thing, but I was trying to help.
items.zh: 我可能說錯話了，可是我是想幫忙。

items.en: We might have left early, but we had a long drive home.
items.zh: 我們可能太早走了，可是我們要開很久的車回家。

items.en: I might have made mistakes, but I learned from them.
items.zh: 我可能犯過錯，可是我從中學到了東西。

items.en: She might have shouted, but she was very worried about you.
items.zh: 她可能大吼了，可是她非常擔心你。

items.en: He might have forgotten your birthday, but he's planning a big surprise.
items.zh: 他可能忘了你的生日，可是他正在計畫一個大驚喜。

title: For the money they had paid, you could have given them a better service.
translation: 他們付了那麼多錢，你們本來可以給他們更好的服務。
name: could have 加過去分詞表示批評
sentences: You could have told me you were going to be late.
He could have asked before borrowing my car.
They could have warned us about the roadworks.
The hotel could have offered us a different room.
You could have cleaned up after yourself.
The council could have repaired the road before winter.
You could have replied to my email.
The airline could have given us a meal voucher.
Our landlord could have fixed the heating months ago.
The organisers could have chosen a bigger venue.
You could have mentioned that the party was formal.
My brother could have helped me move, but he went fishing instead.
The waiter could have brought us some water while we waited.
Somebody could have turned off the lights.
The company could have given its staff more notice.
The manager could have dealt with the complaint himself.
The speaker could have made his talk a little less banal.
You could have been more careful with my camera.
He could have been a little more patient with the kids.
The instructions could have been clearer.
You could have been a bit more polite to her.
You could at least have said thank you.
They could have at least apologised.
He could at least have called to say he wasn't coming.
You could have at least cleared the table.
Couldn't you have waited five more minutes?
Couldn't they have told us sooner?
Couldn't he have picked a quieter restaurant?
The problem could have been avoided with a bit of planning.
The tickets could have been sent earlier.
This could have been handled much better.

examples.heading: ① could have + 過去分詞

items.en: You could have told me you were going to be late.
items.zh: 你本來可以跟我說你會晚到。

items.en: He could have asked before borrowing my car.
items.zh: 他借我的車之前本來可以先問一聲。

items.en: They could have warned us about the roadworks.
items.zh: 他們本來可以先提醒我們有道路施工。

items.en: The hotel could have offered us a different room.
items.zh: 飯店本來可以幫我們換一間房。

items.en: You could have cleaned up after yourself.
items.zh: 你本來可以自己收拾乾淨。

items.en: The council could have repaired the road before winter.
items.zh: 市政府本來可以在冬天之前把路修好。

items.en: You could have replied to my email.
items.zh: 你本來可以回我的電子郵件。

items.en: The airline could have given us a meal voucher.
items.zh: 航空公司本來可以給我們餐券。

items.en: Our landlord could have fixed the heating months ago.
items.zh: 我們房東幾個月前就可以把暖氣修好了。

items.en: The organisers could have chosen a bigger venue.
items.zh: 主辦單位本來可以選一個大一點的場地。

items.en: You could have mentioned that the party was formal.
items.zh: 你本來可以先說派對要穿正式服裝。

items.en: My brother could have helped me move, but he went fishing instead.
items.zh: 我哥本來可以幫我搬家，結果他跑去釣魚。

items.en: The waiter could have brought us some water while we waited.
items.zh: 我們等的時候，服務生本來可以先給我們一點水。

items.en: Somebody could have turned off the lights.
items.zh: 總可以有人把燈關掉吧。

items.en: The company could have given its staff more notice.
items.zh: 公司本來可以早一點通知員工。

items.en: The manager could have dealt with the complaint himself.
items.zh: 經理本來可以自己處理這個客訴。

items.en: The speaker could have made his talk a little less banal.
items.zh: 講者本來可以讓演講別那麼老套。

examples.heading: ② could have been + 形容詞

items.en: You could have been more careful with my camera.
items.zh: 你本來可以對我的相機小心一點。

items.en: He could have been a little more patient with the kids.
items.zh: 他本來可以對孩子們多一點耐心。

items.en: The instructions could have been clearer.
items.zh: 說明本來可以寫得清楚一點。

items.en: You could have been a bit more polite to her.
items.zh: 你本來可以對她客氣一點。

examples.heading: ③ could at least have、could have at least

items.en: You could at least have said thank you.
items.zh: 你至少可以說聲謝謝吧。

items.en: They could have at least apologised.
items.zh: 他們至少可以道個歉吧。

items.en: He could at least have called to say he wasn't coming.
items.zh: 他至少可以打個電話說他不來。

items.en: You could have at least cleared the table.
items.zh: 你至少可以把桌子收一收吧。

examples.heading: ④ Couldn't + 主詞 + have + 過去分詞

items.en: Couldn't you have waited five more minutes?
items.zh: 你就不能多等五分鐘嗎？

items.en: Couldn't they have told us sooner?
items.zh: 他們就不能早點告訴我們嗎？

items.en: Couldn't he have picked a quieter restaurant?
items.zh: 他就不能挑一間安靜一點的餐廳嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ could have been + 過去分詞（被動）

items.en: The problem could have been avoided with a bit of planning.
items.zh: 只要稍微規劃一下，這個問題本來是可以避免的。

items.en: The tickets could have been sent earlier.
items.zh: 票本來可以早點寄出來。

items.en: This could have been handled much better.
items.zh: 這件事本來可以處理得好很多。

title: It's got to be incredible to see a castle rising from the sea.
translation: 一定是 Peter。
name: have (got) to 表示推論
sentences: Look at the queue. That new café has got to be good.
You've got to be joking! You paid two hundred pounds for those shoes?
This has got to be the best pizza in town.
She's got to be over ninety, but she still walks every day.
There's got to be a better way to do this.
That's got to be his brother. They look exactly the same.
The keys aren't in my bag, so they have to be in the car.
There has to be a mistake. I didn't order three pizzas.
He works seven days a week. He has to be exhausted.
With all those lights on, they have to be at home.
This has to be the right street. There's the church on the corner.
The answer has to be in the second chapter.
My mother never visits without phoning first. There had to be something else going on.
The door was open when we got home. Someone had to be inside.
The test was easy for everyone, so the answers had to be on the internet.
He knew all about the party. Somebody had to be telling him our plans.
It was so quiet in the house. The children had to be asleep.
She spoke perfect French, so she had to be from Paris.
I saw a tall man with red hair at the window. Yes, I was sure. It had to have been Peter.
The cake was gone. The dog had to have eaten it.
Her bike wasn't outside, so she had to have left already.
The road was wet. It had to have rained in the night.
Only two people had the key, so one of them had to have opened the safe.
He knew the answer before I told him. He had to have seen the list.
The letter isn't here. It has to have got lost in the post.
She speaks Japanese very well. She has to have lived in Japan.
The window is broken. Someone has to have thrown a stone.
They aren't answering. They have to have gone out.
The milk smells bad. It has to have been in the fridge for weeks.
He looks so happy. He has to have passed his exam.
My phone isn't in my pocket. I have to have left it at the cafe.

examples.heading: ① has / have got to be：現在一定是

items.en: Look at the queue. That new café has got to be good.
items.zh: 你看那個隊伍。那家新咖啡店一定很好。

items.en: You've got to be joking! You paid two hundred pounds for those shoes?
items.zh: 你一定是在開玩笑！你花兩百英鎊買那雙鞋？

items.en: This has got to be the best pizza in town.
items.zh: 這一定是城裡最好吃的披薩。

items.en: She's got to be over ninety, but she still walks every day.
items.zh: 她一定超過九十歲了，可是她還是每天散步。

items.en: There's got to be a better way to do this.
items.zh: 一定有比較好的方法做這件事。

items.en: That's got to be his brother. They look exactly the same.
items.zh: 那一定是他哥哥。他們長得一模一樣。

examples.heading: ② has / have to be：現在一定是

items.en: The keys aren't in my bag, so they have to be in the car.
items.zh: 鑰匙不在我包包裡，所以一定在車上。

items.en: There has to be a mistake. I didn't order three pizzas.
items.zh: 一定弄錯了。我沒有點三個披薩。

items.en: He works seven days a week. He has to be exhausted.
items.zh: 他一星期工作七天。他一定累壞了。

items.en: With all those lights on, they have to be at home.
items.zh: 燈都開著，他們一定在家。

items.en: This has to be the right street. There's the church on the corner.
items.zh: 這一定是對的街。轉角那裡就是教堂。

items.en: The answer has to be in the second chapter.
items.zh: 答案一定在第二章。

examples.heading: ③ had to be：過去一定是

items.en: My mother never visits without phoning first. There had to be something else going on.
items.zh: 我媽媽從來不會沒打電話就來。一定有別的事。

items.en: The door was open when we got home. Someone had to be inside.
items.zh: 我們回家的時候門開著。一定有人在裡面。

items.en: The test was easy for everyone, so the answers had to be on the internet.
items.zh: 那次考試大家都覺得很簡單，所以答案一定在網路上。

items.en: He knew all about the party. Somebody had to be telling him our plans.
items.zh: 他知道派對的一切。一定有人把我們的計畫告訴他。

items.en: It was so quiet in the house. The children had to be asleep.
items.zh: 屋子裡好安靜。孩子們一定睡著了。

items.en: She spoke perfect French, so she had to be from Paris.
items.zh: 她的法文說得很好，所以她一定是巴黎人。

examples.heading: ④ had to have + 過去分詞：一定已經發生了

items.en: I saw a tall man with red hair at the window. Yes, I was sure. It had to have been Peter.
items.zh: 我看到窗邊有一個紅頭髮的高個子。對，我很確定。那一定是彼得。

items.en: The cake was gone. The dog had to have eaten it.
items.zh: 蛋糕不見了。一定是狗吃掉的。

items.en: Her bike wasn't outside, so she had to have left already.
items.zh: 她的腳踏車不在外面，所以她一定已經走了。

items.en: The road was wet. It had to have rained in the night.
items.zh: 路是濕的。夜裡一定下過雨。

items.en: Only two people had the key, so one of them had to have opened the safe.
items.zh: 只有兩個人有鑰匙，所以一定是其中一個人打開了保險箱。

items.en: He knew the answer before I told him. He had to have seen the list.
items.zh: 我還沒告訴他，他就知道答案了。他一定看過那份名單。

examples.heading: ⑤ has to have + 過去分詞：現在推論過去

items.en: The letter isn't here. It has to have got lost in the post.
items.zh: 信不在這裡。一定是郵寄的時候弄丟了。

items.en: She speaks Japanese very well. She has to have lived in Japan.
items.zh: 她的日文說得很好。她一定在日本住過。

items.en: The window is broken. Someone has to have thrown a stone.
items.zh: 窗戶破了。一定有人丟了石頭。

items.en: They aren't answering. They have to have gone out.
items.zh: 他們沒接電話。他們一定出去了。

items.en: The milk smells bad. It has to have been in the fridge for weeks.
items.zh: 牛奶有臭味。它一定在冰箱裡放了好幾個星期。

items.en: He looks so happy. He has to have passed his exam.
items.zh: 他看起來好高興。他一定通過考試了。

items.en: My phone isn't in my pocket. I have to have left it at the cafe.
items.zh: 我的手機不在口袋裡。我一定把它留在咖啡館了。

title: You must be so nervous.
translation: 你一定很緊張吧。
name: must 表示推測
sentences: You're starting a new job tomorrow? You must be excited.
You've been walking all day. You must be tired.
You haven't eaten since breakfast. You must be hungry.
You passed your driving test? You must be so happy!
You must be cold. Come and sit by the fire.
Your exams start tomorrow? You must be worried.
You work in an office. It must be boring for you to sit at a computer all day.
It must be hard for your mum to work at night.
It must be strange for you to live in a big city.
It must be exciting to travel around the world.
It must be difficult for her to speak in front of so many people.
It must be lovely to live by the sea.
Someone is knocking. It must be the pizza.
She speaks perfect English. She must be from London.
That must be your brother. He looks just like you.
This must be the right house. There's a red door.
Look at the crowd outside. It must be a famous singer.
Those must be your keys on the table.
Her car is outside. She must be at home.
He isn't answering. He must be in the shower.
The lights are off. They must be on holiday.
My glasses must be in the car.
Tom must be at football practice. It's Tuesday.
The children must be in the garden. I can hear them.
He goes to the gym every day. He must love sport.
She's got three dogs. She must like animals.
They've got a huge house. They must have a lot of money.
You know everyone here. You must come here often.
He reads all the time. He must know a lot.
Your English is excellent. You must practise a lot.
The shop is always busy. The food must be good.

examples.heading: ① You must be + 形容詞：推論對方的感覺

items.en: You're starting a new job tomorrow? You must be excited.
items.zh: 你明天要開始新工作？你一定很興奮。

items.en: You've been walking all day. You must be tired.
items.zh: 你走了一整天。你一定累了。

items.en: You haven't eaten since breakfast. You must be hungry.
items.zh: 你從早餐到現在都沒吃東西。你一定餓了。

items.en: You passed your driving test? You must be so happy!
items.zh: 你考過駕照了？你一定很高興！

items.en: You must be cold. Come and sit by the fire.
items.zh: 你一定很冷。過來坐在火爐旁邊。

items.en: Your exams start tomorrow? You must be worried.
items.zh: 你的考試明天開始？你一定很擔心。

examples.heading: ② It must be + 形容詞 + for 人 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: You work in an office. It must be boring for you to sit at a computer all day.
items.zh: 你在辦公室工作。整天坐在電腦前對你來說一定很無聊。

items.en: It must be hard for your mum to work at night.
items.zh: 你媽媽晚上工作一定很辛苦。

items.en: It must be strange for you to live in a big city.
items.zh: 住在大城市對你來說一定很奇怪。

items.en: It must be exciting to travel around the world.
items.zh: 環遊世界一定很刺激。

items.en: It must be difficult for her to speak in front of so many people.
items.zh: 在那麼多人面前說話對她來說一定很難。

items.en: It must be lovely to live by the sea.
items.zh: 住在海邊一定很美好。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + must be + 名詞：推論是誰或是什麼

items.en: Someone is knocking. It must be the pizza.
items.zh: 有人在敲門。一定是披薩送來了。

items.en: She speaks perfect English. She must be from London.
items.zh: 她的英文說得很好。她一定是倫敦人。

items.en: That must be your brother. He looks just like you.
items.zh: 那一定是你哥哥。他長得跟你好像。

items.en: This must be the right house. There's a red door.
items.zh: 這一定是對的房子。有一扇紅色的門。

items.en: Look at the crowd outside. It must be a famous singer.
items.zh: 你看外面那些人。一定是有名的歌手來了。

items.en: Those must be your keys on the table.
items.zh: 桌上那些一定是你的鑰匙。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + must be + 地方：推論在哪裡

items.en: Her car is outside. She must be at home.
items.zh: 她的車在外面。她一定在家。

items.en: He isn't answering. He must be in the shower.
items.zh: 他沒接電話。他一定在洗澡。

items.en: The lights are off. They must be on holiday.
items.zh: 燈都關著。他們一定在度假。

items.en: My glasses must be in the car.
items.zh: 我的眼鏡一定在車上。

items.en: Tom must be at football practice. It's Tuesday.
items.zh: 湯姆一定在練足球。今天是星期二。

items.en: The children must be in the garden. I can hear them.
items.zh: 孩子們一定在花園裡。我聽得到他們的聲音。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + must + 原形動詞：推論習慣或情況

items.en: He goes to the gym every day. He must love sport.
items.zh: 他每天都去健身房。他一定很喜歡運動。

items.en: She's got three dogs. She must like animals.
items.zh: 她養了三隻狗。她一定很喜歡動物。

items.en: They've got a huge house. They must have a lot of money.
items.zh: 他們有一間很大的房子。他們一定很有錢。

items.en: You know everyone here. You must come here often.
items.zh: 你認識這裡每一個人。你一定常來這裡。

items.en: He reads all the time. He must know a lot.
items.zh: 他一直在看書。他一定懂很多。

items.en: Your English is excellent. You must practise a lot.
items.zh: 你的英文很好。你一定常常練習。

items.en: The shop is always busy. The food must be good.
items.zh: 那家店總是很多人。東西一定很好吃。

title: I must have looked awful because she asked me whether I was all right.
translation: 我那時看起來一定很糟，因為她問我還好嗎。
name: must have 推斷過去的事
sentences: I hadn't slept all night. I must have looked awful, because my teacher asked me whether I was all right.
I came into the staff room late. Mr Hill must have said something funny, because everyone was laughing.
My first talk in Spanish didn't go well. I must have spoken too fast, because nobody understood me.
I gave my aunt a red scarf at Christmas. She must have liked it, because she wore it every day.
My friends saw the new spy film last night. It must have been boring, because half the audience left early.
Our neighbours came to our party last night. They must have enjoyed it, because they stayed until two.
Of course, India must have changed a lot since Jules Verne wrote his book, but its charm remains.
I haven't been back to Leeds for twenty years. My hometown must have changed a lot since I left.
A coffee here costs five pounds now! The prices must have gone up since we were last here.
Is Max at university now? He must have grown a lot since I last saw him.
My grandparents went to this school in the 1950s. It must have changed since they studied here.
This computer guide is from 1995. Technology must have changed a lot since then.
There were footprints in the snow this morning. Someone must have walked past the house in the night.
When I came downstairs, the kitchen was a mess. The kids must have made breakfast.
The road to the airport was closed, and we saw police cars. There must have been an accident.
We drove past the Smiths' house at eleven. All the lights were off. They must have gone to bed.
When I opened the front door, there was a smell of smoke. Something must have burnt in the oven.
After the night of wind and rain, three windows at the school were broken. The storm must have been very strong.
Grandma was a child in London in 1940. It must have been frightening to live through the war.
Your mother had six children and no help at home. It must have been hard to raise them.
My uncle worked in Canada for ten years. It must have been strange to come home after so long.
You shook hands with the president at your graduation? It must have been exciting to meet him.
My great-grandfather kept the lighthouse on a small island. It must have been lonely to work there.
You moved to a new country at fourteen. It must have been difficult to say goodbye to your friends.
This church is eight hundred years old and covered in stone carvings. The people who built it must have worked for years.
Our guide told us that the village got electricity in 1960. Life must have been very hard before that.
My grandfather's village had no bus. He must have walked miles to school every day.
The road goes straight from the old port to the city. The Romans must have used it to carry goods.
The first sailors crossed the ocean in tiny wooden boats. They must have been very brave.
Only forty families lived in the village a hundred years ago. People there must have known each other well.
This house has twelve bedrooms and a ballroom. It must have belonged to a rich family.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + must have + 過去分詞, because + 子句：根據別人的反應推論

items.en: I hadn't slept all night. I must have looked awful, because my teacher asked me whether I was all right.
items.zh: 我整晚沒睡。我一定看起來很糟，因為老師問我還好嗎。

items.en: I came into the staff room late. Mr Hill must have said something funny, because everyone was laughing.
items.zh: 我晚進教職員辦公室。Hill 老師一定說了什麼好笑的話，因為大家都在笑。

items.en: My first talk in Spanish didn't go well. I must have spoken too fast, because nobody understood me.
items.zh: 我第一次用西班牙文演講不太順利。我一定說得太快了，因為沒有人聽得懂。

items.en: I gave my aunt a red scarf at Christmas. She must have liked it, because she wore it every day.
items.zh: 我聖誕節送阿姨一條紅色圍巾。她一定很喜歡，因為她每天都圍著。

items.en: My friends saw the new spy film last night. It must have been boring, because half the audience left early.
items.zh: 我朋友昨晚去看了那部新的間諜片。那部電影一定很無聊，因為一半的觀眾提早走了。

items.en: Our neighbours came to our party last night. They must have enjoyed it, because they stayed until two.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居昨晚來參加派對。他們一定很喜歡，因為他們待到兩點。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + must have changed + since + 子句

items.en: Of course, India must have changed a lot since Jules Verne wrote his book, but its charm remains.
items.zh: 當然，從凡爾納寫那本書以後，印度一定改變了很多，可是它的魅力還在。

items.en: I haven't been back to Leeds for twenty years. My hometown must have changed a lot since I left.
items.zh: 我二十年沒回 Leeds 了。我離開以後，我的家鄉一定改變了很多。

items.en: A coffee here costs five pounds now! The prices must have gone up since we were last here.
items.zh: 這裡一杯咖啡現在要五英鎊！從我們上次來以後，價錢一定漲了。

items.en: Is Max at university now? He must have grown a lot since I last saw him.
items.zh: Max 現在念大學了？從我上次見到他以後，他一定長高了很多。

items.en: My grandparents went to this school in the 1950s. It must have changed since they studied here.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶在一九五〇年代念這所學校。從他們在這裡念書以後，學校一定改變了。

items.en: This computer guide is from 1995. Technology must have changed a lot since then.
items.zh: 這本電腦指南是一九九五年的。從那時候到現在，科技一定改變了很多。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + must have + 過去分詞：根據看到的東西推論

items.en: There were footprints in the snow this morning. Someone must have walked past the house in the night.
items.zh: 今天早上雪地上有腳印。夜裡一定有人走過這間房子。

items.en: When I came downstairs, the kitchen was a mess. The kids must have made breakfast.
items.zh: 我下樓的時候，廚房一團亂。孩子們一定自己做了早餐。

items.en: The road to the airport was closed, and we saw police cars. There must have been an accident.
items.zh: 往機場的路封了，我們還看到警車。一定發生了意外。

items.en: We drove past the Smiths' house at eleven. All the lights were off. They must have gone to bed.
items.zh: 我們十一點開車經過 Smith 家。所有的燈都關了。他們一定上床睡覺了。

items.en: When I opened the front door, there was a smell of smoke. Something must have burnt in the oven.
items.zh: 我打開前門的時候，聞到煙味。烤箱裡一定有東西燒焦了。

items.en: After the night of wind and rain, three windows at the school were broken. The storm must have been very strong.
items.zh: 經過一夜的風雨，學校有三扇窗戶破了。暴風雨一定很強。

examples.heading: ④ It must have been + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞：推論過去的經驗

items.en: Grandma was a child in London in 1940. It must have been frightening to live through the war.
items.zh: 奶奶一九四〇年在倫敦還是個孩子。經歷那場戰爭一定很可怕。

items.en: Your mother had six children and no help at home. It must have been hard to raise them.
items.zh: 你媽媽生了六個孩子，家裡又沒人幫忙。養大他們一定很辛苦。

items.en: My uncle worked in Canada for ten years. It must have been strange to come home after so long.
items.zh: 我叔叔在加拿大工作了十年。隔了這麼久回到家一定很奇怪。

items.en: You shook hands with the president at your graduation? It must have been exciting to meet him.
items.zh: 你畢業典禮上跟總統握手了？見到他一定很興奮。

items.en: My great-grandfather kept the lighthouse on a small island. It must have been lonely to work there.
items.zh: 我曾祖父在一座小島上看守燈塔。在那裡工作一定很寂寞。

items.en: You moved to a new country at fourteen. It must have been difficult to say goodbye to your friends.
items.zh: 你十四歲搬到新的國家。跟你的朋友道別一定很難。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + must have + 過去分詞：推論過去的人和時代

items.en: This church is eight hundred years old and covered in stone carvings. The people who built it must have worked for years.
items.zh: 這座教堂有八百年歷史，到處都是石雕。蓋這座教堂的人一定工作了很多年。

items.en: Our guide told us that the village got electricity in 1960. Life must have been very hard before that.
items.zh: 導遊告訴我們，這個村子一九六〇年才有電。在那之前的生活一定很辛苦。

items.en: My grandfather's village had no bus. He must have walked miles to school every day.
items.zh: 我爺爺的村子沒有公車。他以前每天一定要走好幾英里去上學。

items.en: The road goes straight from the old port to the city. The Romans must have used it to carry goods.
items.zh: 這條路從舊港口直通城裡。羅馬人一定用它運送貨物。

items.en: The first sailors crossed the ocean in tiny wooden boats. They must have been very brave.
items.zh: 最早的水手坐很小的木船橫渡大洋。他們一定很勇敢。

items.en: Only forty families lived in the village a hundred years ago. People there must have known each other well.
items.zh: 一百年前那個村子只住了四十戶人家。那裡的人一定都很熟。

items.en: This house has twelve bedrooms and a ballroom. It must have belonged to a rich family.
items.zh: 這間房子有十二間臥室和一間舞廳。它以前一定屬於一個有錢人家。

title: There shouldn't be any rubbish dumps; all the rubbish ought to be recycled.
translation: 所有的垃圾都應該回收。
name: ought to 表示期望的狀態
sentences: In my ideal city, there shouldn't be any rubbish dumps. All the rubbish ought to be recycled.
Children learn a lot from growing vegetables. Every school ought to be given a garden.
Our town has lost half its old houses in ten years. Old buildings ought to be protected.
The main square is full of traffic and noise. Cars ought to be banned from the town centre.
My sister works sixty hours a week as a teacher. Teachers ought to be paid more.
We live on an island, but many kids here can't swim. Children ought to be taught how to swim at school.
Not all zoos are as good as they ought to be, but we know much more about animals today.
I was late for work three times this week. The trains are not as reliable as they ought to be.
My dad caught an infection after his operation. Our hospital isn't as clean as it ought to be.
Half the street lights in our area are broken. The streets aren't as safe at night as they ought to be.
Students chat and play music on their phones. The library isn't as quiet as it ought to be.
In many old towns, the water from the tap isn't as fresh as it ought to be.
We ought to take care of our health by going to clean, unpolluted places as often as possible.
Most parents work long hours and children are alone a lot. We ought to spend more time with our families.
My grandparents lived through two wars. We ought to live in a world without war.
Some farms keep animals in tiny cages. We ought to treat animals with respect.
Most of our fruit comes from the other side of the world. We ought to grow more of our own food.
The beaches near us are covered in bottles. We ought to use less plastic.
Hundreds of people sleep on the streets of our city. Everyone ought to have a home.
A salad costs more than a burger here. Healthy food ought to cost less than junk food.
Many bright students can't pay the fees. Every child ought to have the chance to go to university.
Nurses and cleaners finish work at three in the morning. Public transport ought to run all night.
My doctor only had five minutes for me. Doctors ought to have more time for each patient.
Our city is hot and grey in summer. Cities ought to have more trees and parks.
In my essay about family, I wrote that a home ought to be a place where you feel safe.
We spent our whole trip in queues and traffic. Holidays ought to be relaxing, not stressful.
I left my bank job because I was bored. Work ought to be interesting as well as well paid.
My son's football coach shouts at the kids all the time. Sport ought to be fun for children.
My daughter never eats the school pizza. School lunches ought to be healthy and tasty.
Many children in our city have asthma. The air in our cities ought to be clean.
My grandfather can't afford his heart medicine. Good medicine ought to be cheap enough for everyone.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + ought to be + 過去分詞：理想的做法

items.en: In my ideal city, there shouldn't be any rubbish dumps. All the rubbish ought to be recycled.
items.zh: 在我理想的城市裡，不應該有任何垃圾場。所有的垃圾都應該回收。（被動）

items.en: Children learn a lot from growing vegetables. Every school ought to be given a garden.
items.zh: 孩子從種菜裡學到很多。每所學校都應該有一座花園。（被動）

items.en: Our town has lost half its old houses in ten years. Old buildings ought to be protected.
items.zh: 我們鎮上十年內拆掉了一半的老房子。老建築應該受到保護。（被動）

items.en: The main square is full of traffic and noise. Cars ought to be banned from the town centre.
items.zh: 主廣場上都是車子和噪音。市中心應該禁止汽車進入。（被動）

items.en: My sister works sixty hours a week as a teacher. Teachers ought to be paid more.
items.zh: 我姊姊當老師，一個星期工作六十個小時。老師的薪水應該更高。（被動）

items.en: We live on an island, but many kids here can't swim. Children ought to be taught how to swim at school.
items.zh: 我們住在島上，可是這裡很多孩子不會游泳。學校應該教孩子游泳。（被動）

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + be + not as + 形容詞 + as + 主詞 + ought to be

items.en: Not all zoos are as good as they ought to be, but we know much more about animals today.
items.zh: 不是所有的動物園都像它們應該的那麼好，可是我們現在對動物了解多得多。

items.en: I was late for work three times this week. The trains are not as reliable as they ought to be.
items.zh: 我這個星期上班遲到了三次。火車沒有應該的那麼準時可靠。

items.en: My dad caught an infection after his operation. Our hospital isn't as clean as it ought to be.
items.zh: 我爸爸開刀後受到感染。我們的醫院沒有應該的那麼乾淨。

items.en: Half the street lights in our area are broken. The streets aren't as safe at night as they ought to be.
items.zh: 我們這區有一半的路燈壞了。晚上街道沒有應該的那麼安全。

items.en: Students chat and play music on their phones. The library isn't as quiet as it ought to be.
items.zh: 學生在圖書館聊天，還用手機放音樂。圖書館沒有應該的那麼安靜。

items.en: In many old towns, the water from the tap isn't as fresh as it ought to be.
items.zh: 在很多老城鎮，自來水沒有應該的那麼新鮮。

examples.heading: ③ we ought to + 原形動詞：大家應該追求的事

items.en: We ought to take care of our health by going to clean, unpolluted places as often as possible.
items.zh: 我們應該盡量常去乾淨、沒有污染的地方，照顧自己的健康。

items.en: Most parents work long hours and children are alone a lot. We ought to spend more time with our families.
items.zh: 大部分父母工作時間很長，孩子常常一個人。我們應該多花時間陪家人。

items.en: My grandparents lived through two wars. We ought to live in a world without war.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶經歷過兩場戰爭。我們應該活在一個沒有戰爭的世界。

items.en: Some farms keep animals in tiny cages. We ought to treat animals with respect.
items.zh: 有些農場把動物關在很小的籠子裡。我們應該尊重動物。

items.en: Most of our fruit comes from the other side of the world. We ought to grow more of our own food.
items.zh: 我們大部分的水果都來自地球另一邊。我們應該自己種更多食物。

items.en: The beaches near us are covered in bottles. We ought to use less plastic.
items.zh: 我們附近的海灘滿是瓶子。我們應該少用塑膠。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + ought to + 原形動詞：理想的社會

items.en: Hundreds of people sleep on the streets of our city. Everyone ought to have a home.
items.zh: 我們城市有好幾百人睡在街上。每個人都應該有一個家。

items.en: A salad costs more than a burger here. Healthy food ought to cost less than junk food.
items.zh: 這裡一份沙拉比一個漢堡還貴。健康的食物應該比垃圾食物便宜。

items.en: Many bright students can't pay the fees. Every child ought to have the chance to go to university.
items.zh: 很多聰明的學生付不起學費。每個孩子都應該有機會上大學。

items.en: Nurses and cleaners finish work at three in the morning. Public transport ought to run all night.
items.zh: 護理師和清潔工凌晨三點才下班。大眾運輸應該整夜都有。

items.en: My doctor only had five minutes for me. Doctors ought to have more time for each patient.
items.zh: 我的醫生只有五分鐘給我。醫生應該有更多時間看每一個病人。

items.en: Our city is hot and grey in summer. Cities ought to have more trees and parks.
items.zh: 我們的城市夏天又熱又灰暗。城市應該有更多樹和公園。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + ought to be + 形容詞：說理想的樣子

items.en: In my essay about family, I wrote that a home ought to be a place where you feel safe.
items.zh: 我在關於家庭的作文裡寫道，家應該是一個讓你覺得安全的地方。

items.en: We spent our whole trip in queues and traffic. Holidays ought to be relaxing, not stressful.
items.zh: 我們整趟旅行都在排隊和塞車。假期應該是放鬆的，不是有壓力的。

items.en: I left my bank job because I was bored. Work ought to be interesting as well as well paid.
items.zh: 我辭掉銀行的工作，因為很無聊。工作應該有趣，薪水也要好。

items.en: My son's football coach shouts at the kids all the time. Sport ought to be fun for children.
items.zh: 我兒子的足球教練一直對孩子大吼。運動對孩子來說應該是好玩的。

items.en: My daughter never eats the school pizza. School lunches ought to be healthy and tasty.
items.zh: 我女兒從來不吃學校的披薩。學校午餐應該健康又好吃。

items.en: Many children in our city have asthma. The air in our cities ought to be clean.
items.zh: 我們城市很多孩子有氣喘。我們城市的空氣應該是乾淨的。

items.en: My grandfather can't afford his heart medicine. Good medicine ought to be cheap enough for everyone.
items.zh: 我爺爺買不起他的心臟藥。好的藥應該便宜到每個人都買得起。

title: I can't say I was very impressed with the level of the classes.
translation: 我不能說我對課程的程度很滿意。
name: 含 can 的固定說法表示強調
sentences: I can't say I was very impressed with the service at the restaurant.
I can't say I enjoyed the meal. The fish was cold.
I can't say I'm a big fan of modern art.
I can't say the hotel was very clean.
I can't say I agree with everything in the report.
I can't say I'm surprised. He's always late.
I can't say the new manager has made a good start.
About my country, I can tell you that we went through many wars in the last century.
I can tell you that it was the hardest exam I've ever taken.
I can tell you, the view from the top is amazing.
I can say that this year has been a success for the team.
I can tell you that nobody worked harder than her.
I can say with confidence that our product is the best on the market.
I can assure you that this will not happen again.
I can assure you that the room will be ready by three.
I can assure you that your money is safe with us.
I can assure you that we take every complaint seriously.
I can assure you that the problem has been fixed.
I can assure you that the information will remain private.
So, as you can see, there are no serious consequences for us so far.
As you can see from the chart, sales have doubled.
As you can imagine, we were very worried when the plane was late.
As you can see, the kitchen needs a lot of work.
As you can imagine, the children were very excited about the trip.
As you can see in the photo, the house is right next to the sea.
As you can imagine, it was a difficult decision for us.
As you can see, I've changed my hair.
I can't tell you how happy I am to see you again.
I can't imagine life without my dog.
I can't tell you how sorry I am about your loss.
I can't thank you enough for your help.
I can't imagine how hard it must be for you.
We can't thank you enough for everything you've done.

examples.heading: ① I can't say + 子句：委婉地批評

items.en: I can't say I was very impressed with the service at the restaurant.
items.zh: 我不能說我對那家餐廳的服務很滿意。

items.en: I can't say I enjoyed the meal. The fish was cold.
items.zh: 我不能說我喜歡那一餐，魚是冷的。

items.en: I can't say I'm a big fan of modern art.
items.zh: 我不能說我很喜歡現代藝術。

items.en: I can't say the hotel was very clean.
items.zh: 我不能說那家飯店很乾淨。

items.en: I can't say I agree with everything in the report.
items.zh: 我不能說我同意報告裡的每一點。

items.en: I can't say I'm surprised. He's always late.
items.zh: 我不能說我很意外，他總是遲到。

items.en: I can't say the new manager has made a good start.
items.zh: 我不能說新經理有個好的開始。

examples.heading: ② I can tell you / I can say + (that) + 子句：強調

items.en: About my country, I can tell you that we went through many wars in the last century.
items.zh: 關於我的國家，我可以告訴你，我們在上個世紀經歷了很多戰爭。

items.en: I can tell you that it was the hardest exam I've ever taken.
items.zh: 我可以告訴你，那是我考過最難的考試。

items.en: I can tell you, the view from the top is amazing.
items.zh: 我跟你說，從山頂看下去的景色好美。
