items.en: I can say that this year has been a success for the team.
items.zh: 我可以說，今年對這支隊伍來說很成功。

items.en: I can tell you that nobody worked harder than her.
items.zh: 我可以告訴你，沒有人比她更努力。

items.en: I can say with confidence that our product is the best on the market.
items.zh: 我可以很有信心地說，我們的產品是市場上最好的。

examples.heading: ③ I can assure you + that + 子句：正式地強調

items.en: I can assure you that this will not happen again.
items.zh: 我向您保證，這種事不會再發生。

items.en: I can assure you that the room will be ready by three.
items.zh: 我向您保證，房間三點前會準備好。

items.en: I can assure you that your money is safe with us.
items.zh: 我向您保證，您的錢放在我們這裡很安全。

items.en: I can assure you that we take every complaint seriously.
items.zh: 我向您保證，我們認真處理每一件投訴。

items.en: I can assure you that the problem has been fixed.
items.zh: 我向您保證，問題已經修好了。（被動）

items.en: I can assure you that the information will remain private.
items.zh: 我向您保證，這些資料會保密。

examples.heading: ④ As you can see / imagine, + 句子：引出重點

items.en: So, as you can see, there are no serious consequences for us so far.
items.zh: 所以，你可以看到，目前為止對我們沒有嚴重的影響。

items.en: As you can see from the chart, sales have doubled.
items.zh: 你從圖表上可以看到，銷售量增加了一倍。

items.en: As you can imagine, we were very worried when the plane was late.
items.zh: 你可以想像，飛機誤點的時候我們有多擔心。

items.en: As you can see, the kitchen needs a lot of work.
items.zh: 你可以看到，廚房需要大整修。

items.en: As you can imagine, the children were very excited about the trip.
items.zh: 你可以想像，孩子們對這趟旅行有多興奮。

items.en: As you can see in the photo, the house is right next to the sea.
items.zh: 你從照片可以看到，房子就在海邊。

items.en: As you can imagine, it was a difficult decision for us.
items.zh: 你可以想像，這對我們來說是很難的決定。

items.en: As you can see, I've changed my hair.
items.zh: 你看得到吧，我換了髮型。

examples.heading: ⑤ I can't tell you / I can't imagine / I can't thank you enough：加強感受

items.en: I can't tell you how happy I am to see you again.
items.zh: 我說不出我再見到你有多開心。

items.en: I can't imagine life without my dog.
items.zh: 我無法想像沒有我的狗的生活。

items.en: I can't tell you how sorry I am about your loss.
items.zh: 你失去了重要的人，我說不出我有多難過。

items.en: I can't thank you enough for your help.
items.zh: 你的幫忙我怎麼感謝都不夠。

items.en: I can't imagine how hard it must be for you.
items.zh: 我無法想像那對你來說一定有多辛苦。

items.en: We can't thank you enough for everything you've done.
items.zh: 你為我們做的一切，我們怎麼感謝都不夠。

title: Try as I might, I was never able to persuade her to go for a walk.
translation: 我怎麼想都想像不出沒有音樂的世界。
name: try as I might 放在句首加強語氣
sentences: Try as I might, I was never able to grow tomatoes in my garden.
Try as I might, I couldn't get the baby to sleep.
Try as I might, I couldn't find a cheaper flight.
Try as I might, I was never able to beat my brother at chess.
Try as I might, I couldn't stop laughing.
Try as I might, I couldn't open the window. It was stuck.
Music is part of every day for me. Try as I might, I can't imagine a world without it.
Try as I might, I can't see an explanation for what happened.
Try as I might, I can't remember where I parked the car.
Try as I might, I can't understand his handwriting.
Try as I might, I can't get used to the cold here.
Try as I might, I can't make this recipe work.
Try as she might, she couldn't open the jar.
Try as he might, he couldn't hide his disappointment.
Try as she might, she couldn't remember the words of the song.
Try as he might, he can't give up coffee.
Try as she might, she couldn't reach the top shelf.
Try as he might, he never managed to learn to swim.
Try as we might, we couldn't find the hotel in the dark.
Try as they might, they couldn't stop the water coming in.
Try as we might, we can't agree on a name for the dog.
Try as they might, the police couldn't find the missing painting.
Try as we might, we couldn't get tickets for the final.
Try as they might, the doctors couldn't explain her illness.
Try as I might, I find it impossible to like this city.
Try as I might, I see no good reason for the new rule.
Try as I might, I could not make him change his mind.
Try as I might, I have never enjoyed opera.
Try as I might, I find maths very hard.
Try as I might, I can't forget that summer by the sea.
Try as I might, I could never keep my room tidy as a child.

examples.heading: ① Try as I might, + 主詞 + couldn't / was never able to：過去做不到

items.en: Try as I might, I was never able to grow tomatoes in my garden.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，我都沒辦法在花園裡種出番茄。

items.en: Try as I might, I couldn't get the baby to sleep.
items.zh: 不管我怎麼試，都沒辦法讓寶寶睡著。

items.en: Try as I might, I couldn't find a cheaper flight.
items.zh: 不管我怎麼找，都找不到更便宜的機票。

items.en: Try as I might, I was never able to beat my brother at chess.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，下西洋棋都贏不了我哥哥。

items.en: Try as I might, I couldn't stop laughing.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，我就是忍不住一直笑。

items.en: Try as I might, I couldn't open the window. It was stuck.
items.zh: 不管我多用力，都打不開那扇窗。它卡住了。

examples.heading: ② Try as I might, + 主詞 + can't：現在做不到

items.en: Music is part of every day for me. Try as I might, I can't imagine a world without it.
items.zh: 音樂是我每天的一部分。不管我怎麼想，都無法想像沒有音樂的世界。

items.en: Try as I might, I can't see an explanation for what happened.
items.zh: 不管我怎麼想，都找不到這件事的解釋。

items.en: Try as I might, I can't remember where I parked the car.
items.zh: 不管我怎麼想，都記不起來我把車停在哪裡。

items.en: Try as I might, I can't understand his handwriting.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，都看不懂他的字。

items.en: Try as I might, I can't get used to the cold here.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，都沒辦法習慣這裡的冷。

items.en: Try as I might, I can't make this recipe work.
items.zh: 不管我怎麼試，都做不好這道菜。

examples.heading: ③ Try as he / she might, + 句子

items.en: Try as she might, she couldn't open the jar.
items.zh: 不管她多用力，都打不開那個罐子。

items.en: Try as he might, he couldn't hide his disappointment.
items.zh: 不管他多努力，都藏不住他的失望。

items.en: Try as she might, she couldn't remember the words of the song.
items.zh: 不管她怎麼想，都記不起那首歌的歌詞。

items.en: Try as he might, he can't give up coffee.
items.zh: 不管他多努力，都戒不掉咖啡。

items.en: Try as she might, she couldn't reach the top shelf.
items.zh: 不管她怎麼伸手，都搆不到最上層的架子。

items.en: Try as he might, he never managed to learn to swim.
items.zh: 不管他多努力，他都沒學會游泳。

examples.heading: ④ Try as we / they might, + 句子

items.en: Try as we might, we couldn't find the hotel in the dark.
items.zh: 不管我們多努力，天黑了就是找不到飯店。

items.en: Try as they might, they couldn't stop the water coming in.
items.zh: 不管他們多努力，都擋不住水流進來。

items.en: Try as we might, we can't agree on a name for the dog.
items.zh: 不管我們怎麼討論，都沒辦法決定狗的名字。

items.en: Try as they might, the police couldn't find the missing painting.
items.zh: 不管警察多努力，都找不到失蹤的那幅畫。

items.en: Try as we might, we couldn't get tickets for the final.
items.zh: 不管我們多努力，都買不到決賽的票。

items.en: Try as they might, the doctors couldn't explain her illness.
items.zh: 不管醫生多努力，都解釋不了她的病。

examples.heading: ⑤ Try as I might, + 句子：寫作裡的強調

items.en: Try as I might, I find it impossible to like this city.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，我都發現自己沒辦法喜歡這個城市。

items.en: Try as I might, I see no good reason for the new rule.
items.zh: 不管我怎麼想，我都看不出這條新規定有什麼好理由。

items.en: Try as I might, I could not make him change his mind.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，都沒辦法讓他改變主意。

items.en: Try as I might, I have never enjoyed opera.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，我從來沒喜歡過歌劇。

items.en: Try as I might, I find maths very hard.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，我還是覺得數學很難。

items.en: Try as I might, I can't forget that summer by the sea.
items.zh: 不管我多努力，都忘不了海邊的那個夏天。

items.en: Try as I might, I could never keep my room tidy as a child.
items.zh: 小時候不管我多努力，都沒辦法保持房間整齊。

title: I went to as many concerts as possible, and I must say that they were superb.
translation: 我能去的音樂會都盡量去了，不得不說，每一場都非常精彩。
name: I must say 表示強調
sentences: I love music, so I went to as many concerts as possible, and I must say that they were superb.
Thank you for inviting us to your wedding. I must say that the food was delicious.
We haven't spoken for a year. I must say your English has improved a lot.
We had a lovely stay in Rome. I must say that the hotel staff were very helpful.
You've planted so many roses. I must say the garden looks beautiful this year.
Thanks for organising our trip to the lakes. I must say that I enjoyed every minute of it.
I must say that I'm delighted to have you here with us, Mr Saramago. My students will be very happy to hear you.
Thank you all for coming tonight. I must say that it's a great honour to receive this prize.
Dear Mrs Patel, thank you for the books you gave our library. I must say that we are very grateful.
This is my last day before I retire. I must say it's been a pleasure to work with such a good team.
Thank you, Professor Lee. I must say that your talk was very interesting.
Welcome to our prize-giving evening. I must say we're very proud of all our students this year.
Are you going to the interview now? I must say, you look wonderful in that suit.
Thanks for bringing me to your favourite place. I must say, this is the best pizza I've ever eaten.
Your kids said please and thank you all through dinner. I must say, they're very polite.
That was a great evening at the theatre. I must say, I didn't expect the show to be so funny.
We moved to the new building on Monday. I must say, it's much nicer than the old one.
You painted every room yourself? I must say, you've done a great job with the house.
Where did you buy it? It really suits you, I must say.
I kept you waiting for an hour. You've been very patient, I must say.
We won three–two in the last minute. It was a brilliant match, I must say.
I could sit here all afternoon. This is a very comfortable chair, I must say.
I heard you in the choir on Sunday. You sing beautifully, I must say.
That was the best roast chicken I've had in years. Your mum is a great cook, I must say.
I asked Tom why he quit his job. I must say I was surprised by his answer.
The team worked hard all year. However, I must say that I'm a little disappointed with the results.
The first hour was great. But I must say I didn't enjoy the second half of the film.
We waited forty minutes for our main course. I must say the service was very slow.
Your brother didn't say hello to anyone at the party. I must say that I find his behaviour rude.
The repair to my car cost nine hundred pounds. I must say I was shocked by the price.
Dear Sir, our room had no hot water for three days. I must say that I expected more from your hotel.

examples.heading: ① I must say (that) + 子句：強調好的評價

items.en: I love music, so I went to as many concerts as possible, and I must say that they were superb.
items.zh: 我很喜歡音樂，所以盡量多聽音樂會，而且我必須說，它們都太棒了。

items.en: Thank you for inviting us to your wedding. I must say that the food was delicious.
items.zh: 謝謝你邀請我們參加婚禮。我必須說，食物很好吃。

items.en: We haven't spoken for a year. I must say your English has improved a lot.
items.zh: 我們一年沒說話了。我必須說，你的英文進步很多。

items.en: We had a lovely stay in Rome. I must say that the hotel staff were very helpful.
items.zh: 我們在羅馬住得很愉快。我必須說，飯店的員工都很熱心幫忙。

items.en: You've planted so many roses. I must say the garden looks beautiful this year.
items.zh: 你種了好多玫瑰。我必須說，花園今年看起來很漂亮。

items.en: Thanks for organising our trip to the lakes. I must say that I enjoyed every minute of it.
items.zh: 謝謝你安排我們去湖區的旅行。我必須說，每一分鐘我都很享受。

examples.heading: ② I must say (that) + 子句：正式的歡迎和感謝

items.en: I must say that I'm delighted to have you here with us, Mr Saramago. My students will be very happy to hear you.
items.zh: 我必須說，我非常高興您能來這裡，Saramago 先生。我的學生會很高興聽您演講。

items.en: Thank you all for coming tonight. I must say that it's a great honour to receive this prize.
items.zh: 謝謝各位今晚來到這裡。我必須說，得到這個獎是很大的榮幸。

items.en: Dear Mrs Patel, thank you for the books you gave our library. I must say that we are very grateful.
items.zh: 親愛的 Patel 女士，謝謝您捐給我們圖書館的書。我必須說，我們非常感謝。

items.en: This is my last day before I retire. I must say it's been a pleasure to work with such a good team.
items.zh: 這是我退休前的最後一天。我必須說，能跟這麼好的團隊工作很愉快。

items.en: Thank you, Professor Lee. I must say that your talk was very interesting.
items.zh: 謝謝您，Lee 教授。我必須說，您的演講很有趣。

items.en: Welcome to our prize-giving evening. I must say we're very proud of all our students this year.
items.zh: 歡迎來到我們的頒獎晚會。我必須說，我們很以今年所有的學生為榮。

examples.heading: ③ I must say, + 句子：口語的稱讚

items.en: Are you going to the interview now? I must say, you look wonderful in that suit.
items.zh: 你現在要去面試嗎？說真的，你穿那套西裝很好看。

items.en: Thanks for bringing me to your favourite place. I must say, this is the best pizza I've ever eaten.
items.zh: 謝謝你帶我來你最喜歡的店。說真的，這是我吃過最好吃的披薩。

items.en: Your kids said please and thank you all through dinner. I must say, they're very polite.
items.zh: 你的孩子吃晚餐時一直說請和謝謝。說真的，他們很有禮貌。

items.en: That was a great evening at the theatre. I must say, I didn't expect the show to be so funny.
items.zh: 今晚在劇院很愉快。說真的，我沒想到那場表演這麼好笑。

items.en: We moved to the new building on Monday. I must say, it's much nicer than the old one.
items.zh: 我們星期一搬到新大樓。說真的，它比舊的好多了。

items.en: You painted every room yourself? I must say, you've done a great job with the house.
items.zh: 每個房間都是你自己漆的？說真的，你把房子整理得很好。

examples.heading: ④ 句子, I must say.：放在句尾

items.en: Where did you buy it? It really suits you, I must say.
items.zh: 你在哪裡買的？說真的，它很適合你。

items.en: I kept you waiting for an hour. You've been very patient, I must say.
items.zh: 我讓你等了一個小時。說真的，你一直很有耐心。

items.en: We won three–two in the last minute. It was a brilliant match, I must say.
items.zh: 我們在最後一分鐘以三比二贏了。說真的，那是一場精彩的比賽。

items.en: I could sit here all afternoon. This is a very comfortable chair, I must say.
items.zh: 我可以在這裡坐一整個下午。說真的，這張椅子很舒服。

items.en: I heard you in the choir on Sunday. You sing beautifully, I must say.
items.zh: 我星期天聽到你在合唱團唱歌。說真的，你唱得很好聽。

items.en: That was the best roast chicken I've had in years. Your mum is a great cook, I must say.
items.zh: 那是我這幾年吃過最好吃的烤雞。說真的，你媽媽很會煮飯。

examples.heading: ⑤ I must say + 子句：說意外或不滿

items.en: I asked Tom why he quit his job. I must say I was surprised by his answer.
items.zh: 我問 Tom 為什麼辭職。我必須說，他的回答讓我很驚訝。

items.en: The team worked hard all year. However, I must say that I'm a little disappointed with the results.
items.zh: 團隊一整年都很努力。不過，我必須說，我對結果有點失望。

items.en: The first hour was great. But I must say I didn't enjoy the second half of the film.
items.zh: 前一個小時很好看。可是我必須說，我不喜歡電影的後半段。

items.en: We waited forty minutes for our main course. I must say the service was very slow.
items.zh: 我們等主菜等了四十分鐘。我必須說，服務很慢。

items.en: Your brother didn't say hello to anyone at the party. I must say that I find his behaviour rude.
items.zh: 你哥哥在派對上沒跟任何人打招呼。我必須說，我覺得他的行為很沒禮貌。

items.en: The repair to my car cost nine hundred pounds. I must say I was shocked by the price.
items.zh: 我的車修了九百英鎊。我必須說，那個價錢讓我很震驚。

items.en: Dear Sir, our room had no hot water for three days. I must say that I expected more from your hotel.
items.zh: 先生您好，我們的房間三天沒有熱水。我必須說，我對貴飯店的期待比較高。

title: The computer systems should be working again once you restart them.
translation: 你們只要重新啟動電腦系統，它應該就能恢復運作了。
name: should be 加動詞-ing 表示預期
sentences: We've fixed the problem. The computer systems should be working again once you restart them.
The engineer has repaired the lift, so it should be working again by lunchtime.
The trains should be running normally again by Monday.
Your phone should be working again after the update.
The heating should be working again by the time you get home.
The website should be running again in about an hour.
I think the situation should be improving in the next six months, especially in the third quarter.
The weather should be getting better by the weekend.
With the new medicine, she should be feeling better in a few days.
House prices should be rising again next year.
Your English should be improving quickly now that you live in London.
The traffic should be getting lighter after seven.
At a traditional wedding, the groom should be waiting at the front of the church for the bride.
A driver should be waiting for you outside the arrivals hall.
Your teacher should be waiting for you in room twelve.
The guide should be waiting at the hotel entrance at nine.
My parents should be waiting for us at the station.
The doctor should be waiting for your results this afternoon.
Our guests should be arriving at any minute.
The parcel should be arriving between ten and twelve.
The plane should be landing in about twenty minutes.
The last bus should be leaving soon.
The new students should be starting next Monday.
The builders should be finishing the roof this week.
By this time tomorrow, we should be lying on a beach in Spain.
By next year, the new factory should be producing cars.
By five o'clock, the party should be getting started.
By June, the baby should be walking.
By the end of the month, we should be living in our new flat.
By ten, the band should be playing their first song.
By the summer, the new shop should be making a profit.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + should be working + again：預期恢復正常

items.en: We've fixed the problem. The computer systems should be working again once you restart them.
items.zh: 我們修好問題了。你們重新開機以後，電腦系統應該就會恢復正常運作。

items.en: The engineer has repaired the lift, so it should be working again by lunchtime.
items.zh: 工程師修好了電梯，所以午餐前應該就能用了。

items.en: The trains should be running normally again by Monday.
items.zh: 到星期一火車應該就會恢復正常行駛。

items.en: Your phone should be working again after the update.
items.zh: 更新以後你的手機應該就能用了。

items.en: The heating should be working again by the time you get home.
items.zh: 你到家的時候暖氣應該就會恢復了。

items.en: The website should be running again in about an hour.
items.zh: 網站大約一個小時後應該就會恢復運作。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + should be improving：預期情況變好

items.en: I think the situation should be improving in the next six months, especially in the third quarter.
items.zh: 我想未來六個月情況應該會好轉，特別是在第三季。

items.en: The weather should be getting better by the weekend.
items.zh: 到週末天氣應該會變好。

items.en: With the new medicine, she should be feeling better in a few days.
items.zh: 吃了新藥，她幾天後應該就會覺得好一點。

items.en: House prices should be rising again next year.
items.zh: 明年房價應該會再上漲。

items.en: Your English should be improving quickly now that you live in London.
items.zh: 你現在住在倫敦，英文應該會進步得很快。

items.en: The traffic should be getting lighter after seven.
items.zh: 七點以後交通應該會變得順暢一點。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + should be waiting：按照安排在等

items.en: At a traditional wedding, the groom should be waiting at the front of the church for the bride.
items.zh: 在傳統的婚禮上，新郎應該在教堂前面等新娘。

items.en: A driver should be waiting for you outside the arrivals hall.
items.zh: 應該會有一位司機在入境大廳外面等你。

items.en: Your teacher should be waiting for you in room twelve.
items.zh: 你的老師應該在十二號教室等你。

items.en: The guide should be waiting at the hotel entrance at nine.
items.zh: 導遊九點應該會在飯店門口等。

items.en: My parents should be waiting for us at the station.
items.zh: 我爸媽應該在車站等我們。

items.en: The doctor should be waiting for your results this afternoon.
items.zh: 醫生今天下午應該在等你的檢查結果。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + should be arriving / leaving：預期的時間

items.en: Our guests should be arriving at any minute.
items.zh: 我們的客人隨時應該會到。

items.en: The parcel should be arriving between ten and twelve.
items.zh: 包裹應該在十點到十二點之間到。

items.en: The plane should be landing in about twenty minutes.
items.zh: 飛機大約二十分鐘後應該會降落。

items.en: The last bus should be leaving soon.
items.zh: 最後一班公車應該快開了。

items.en: The new students should be starting next Monday.
items.zh: 新生應該下星期一開始上課。

items.en: The builders should be finishing the roof this week.
items.zh: 工人這個星期應該會把屋頂完成。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + should be + -ing + by + 時間：到某個時間預期的狀態

items.en: By this time tomorrow, we should be lying on a beach in Spain.
items.zh: 明天這個時候，我們應該已經躺在西班牙的海灘上了。

items.en: By next year, the new factory should be producing cars.
items.zh: 到明年，新工廠應該已經在生產汽車了。

items.en: By five o'clock, the party should be getting started.
items.zh: 到五點，派對應該已經開始熱鬧起來了。

items.en: By June, the baby should be walking.
items.zh: 到六月，寶寶應該已經會走路了。

items.en: By the end of the month, we should be living in our new flat.
items.zh: 到月底，我們應該已經住在新公寓了。

items.en: By ten, the band should be playing their first song.
items.zh: 到十點，樂團應該已經在唱第一首歌了。

items.en: By the summer, the new shop should be making a profit.
items.zh: 到夏天，新店應該已經在賺錢了。

title: Mr Miller, the Sales Director, will visit us next Thursday.
translation: 業務總監 Miller 先生下週四會來拜訪我們。
name: 情態動詞 will 表示排定的計畫
sentences: Please tidy your desks. Mr Miller, the Sales Director, will visit us next Thursday.
The new manager will start work on the first of March.
The office will close at three on Christmas Eve.
Our team will move to the fourth floor in June.
The training course will take place on the tenth and eleventh of May.
The company will announce the results on Monday morning.
I'm sorry, but I won't be able to attend your class tomorrow. I have a hospital appointment.
I won't be able to come to the meeting on Friday.
I'm afraid I won't be able to finish the report until Monday.
We won't be able to join you for dinner on Saturday.
She won't be able to work next week because of her operation.
I won't be able to answer emails while I'm on holiday.
The train to Edinburgh will leave from platform four at ten past eight.
The tour bus will pick you up from the hotel at nine.
The flight will land in Madrid at half past two.
The museum tour will begin in the main hall at eleven.
The ferry will arrive on the island at noon.
Lunch will be served at one o'clock in the dining room.
The school will hold its sports day on the fifteenth of June.
The exams will start on the second of May.
The new library will open to the public in September.
The book fair will stay open late on the last Thursday of the month.
The concert will take place in the park on Saturday evening.
Term will finish on the twentieth of December.
I will be in Paris from Monday to Wednesday next week.
The doctor will be at the clinic every Tuesday afternoon.
Our sales team will be at the trade fair in Berlin next month.
The head teacher will be away at a conference on Friday.
I will be at my desk until six if you need me.
The band will be in London for two nights only.
My parents will be on holiday in Greece for the first two weeks of July.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will + 原形動詞 + 時間：公司的安排

items.en: Please tidy your desks. Mr Miller, the Sales Director, will visit us next Thursday.
items.zh: 請整理好你們的桌子。業務總監米勒先生下星期四會來拜訪我們。

items.en: The new manager will start work on the first of March.
items.zh: 新經理三月一日開始上班。

items.en: The office will close at three on Christmas Eve.
items.zh: 聖誕夜辦公室三點關門。

items.en: Our team will move to the fourth floor in June.
items.zh: 我們的團隊六月會搬到四樓。

items.en: The training course will take place on the tenth and eleventh of May.
items.zh: 訓練課程會在五月十日和十一日舉行。

items.en: The company will announce the results on Monday morning.
items.zh: 公司星期一早上會公布結果。

examples.heading: ② I won't be able to + 原形動詞 + 時間：說不能出席

items.en: I'm sorry, but I won't be able to attend your class tomorrow. I have a hospital appointment.
items.zh: 很抱歉，我明天沒辦法來上您的課。我有醫院的預約。

items.en: I won't be able to come to the meeting on Friday.
items.zh: 我星期五沒辦法來開會。

items.en: I'm afraid I won't be able to finish the report until Monday.
items.zh: 恐怕我要到星期一才能完成報告。

items.en: We won't be able to join you for dinner on Saturday.
items.zh: 我們星期六沒辦法跟你們一起吃晚餐。

items.en: She won't be able to work next week because of her operation.
items.zh: 她下星期因為手術沒辦法上班。

items.en: I won't be able to answer emails while I'm on holiday.
items.zh: 我度假的時候沒辦法回電子郵件。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + will + 原形動詞 + 時刻：時刻表和行程

items.en: The train to Edinburgh will leave from platform four at ten past eight.
items.zh: 往愛丁堡的火車八點十分從第四月台出發。

items.en: The tour bus will pick you up from the hotel at nine.
items.zh: 遊覽車九點會到飯店接你。

items.en: The flight will land in Madrid at half past two.
items.zh: 班機兩點半會降落在馬德里。

items.en: The museum tour will begin in the main hall at eleven.
items.zh: 博物館導覽十一點在大廳開始。

items.en: The ferry will arrive on the island at noon.
items.zh: 渡輪中午會抵達島上。

items.en: Lunch will be served at one o'clock in the dining room.
items.zh: 午餐一點在餐廳供應。（被動）

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + will + 原形動詞 + 日期：學校和活動的安排

items.en: The school will hold its sports day on the fifteenth of June.
items.zh: 學校會在六月十五日舉行運動會。

items.en: The exams will start on the second of May.
items.zh: 考試五月二日開始。

items.en: The new library will open to the public in September.
items.zh: 新圖書館九月會對大眾開放。

items.en: The book fair will stay open late on the last Thursday of the month.
items.zh: 書展在這個月最後一個星期四會開到很晚。

items.en: The concert will take place in the park on Saturday evening.
items.zh: 音樂會會在星期六傍晚於公園舉行。

items.en: Term will finish on the twentieth of December.
items.zh: 學期在十二月二十日結束。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + will + be + 地方 + 時間：說某人會在哪裡

items.en: I will be in Paris from Monday to Wednesday next week.
items.zh: 我下星期一到星期三會在巴黎。

items.en: The doctor will be at the clinic every Tuesday afternoon.
items.zh: 醫生每個星期二下午會在診所。

items.en: Our sales team will be at the trade fair in Berlin next month.
items.zh: 我們的業務團隊下個月會在柏林的商展。

items.en: The head teacher will be away at a conference on Friday.
items.zh: 校長星期五會去參加研討會，不在學校。

items.en: I will be at my desk until six if you need me.
items.zh: 如果你需要我，我六點前都會在座位上。

items.en: The band will be in London for two nights only.
items.zh: 那個樂團只會在倫敦待兩個晚上。

items.en: My parents will be on holiday in Greece for the first two weeks of July.
items.zh: 我爸媽七月的前兩個星期會在希臘度假。

title: As you might know, I've been very busy recently taking my exams.
translation: 你可能也知道，我最近忙著考試，忙得不得了。
name: as you might know 引出對方已知的事
sentences: As you might know, I've been ill for most of the month.
As you might know, nobody came to fix the heating until Wednesday afternoon.
As you might know, my family moved to a new flat last month.
As you might know, I've started a new job at the hospital.
As you might know, my grandmother has been ill since the spring.
As you might know, our class is putting on a play in June.
As you might have noticed, I broke the beautiful vase that was in the hall.
As you might have noticed, the printer on our floor isn't working.
As you might have noticed, I've lost a bit of weight.
As you might have noticed, the bills went up this month.
As you might have noticed, there's a crack in the bathroom window.
As you might have noticed, the garden needs some work.
As you might have already heard, the canteen is getting a new menu.
As you might have already heard, Sarah and Ben are getting married.
As you might have already heard, the swimming pool will close for repairs.
As you might have already heard, I got the job in Madrid.
As you might have already heard, our football coach is leaving.

items.en: The centre of town can be more dangerous and noisier than the suburbs.
items.zh: 市中心可能比郊區更危險、更吵。

items.en: Small shops can be friendlier than supermarkets.
items.zh: 小店可能比超市親切。

items.en: Second-hand books can be cheaper and just as good.
items.zh: 二手書可能比較便宜，而且一樣好。

items.en: Life in the countryside can be quieter but less exciting.
items.zh: 鄉下的生活可能比較安靜，可是比較沒那麼刺激。

items.en: Online shopping can be easier than going to the shops.
items.zh: 網購可能比去商店方便。

items.en: The second year at university can be harder than the first.
items.zh: 大學第二年可能比第一年難。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + can be + 名詞

items.en: A good friend can be a great help in difficult times.
items.zh: 好朋友在困難的時候可能是很大的幫助。

items.en: Social media can be a waste of time.
items.zh: 社群媒體可能很浪費時間。

items.en: A long walk can be the best way to relax.
items.zh: 走一段長路可能是最好的放鬆方式。

items.en: A small mistake can be a big problem in this job.
items.zh: 在這份工作裡，一個小錯可能會變成大問題。

items.en: Rain can be a real problem for farmers.
items.zh: 雨對農夫來說可能是個真正的麻煩。

title: Too much work can cause stress and heart problems.

Poor food in childhood can lead to health problems later.
Ice on the roads can cause accidents.
Cold weather can damage old pipes.
A good night's sleep can make a big difference.
Regular exercise can help you sleep better.
The sun can damage your skin, even in winter.
Strong coffee can make some people feel nervous.
A kind word can make someone's day.
Too much screen time can hurt children's eyes.
Learning music can help children with maths.
New students can feel shy on their first day.
Older people can feel lonely when their children move away.
Students can get nervous before exams.
Babies can become tired very quickly.
Tourists can get lost in the old part of the city.
Some dogs can become aggressive when they're scared.
Teenagers can feel embarrassed by their parents.
People can get angry very quickly when they're hungry.
In the mountains, the temperature can drop very quickly.
Children can learn a second language very fast.
Prices can change from one week to the next.
A cold can last for two weeks.
Plants can grow without soil if they have water and light.
The journey can take up to six hours in winter.
Friendships can end for very small reasons.

items.en: Heavy rain can cause floods in this part of the country.

items.en: A small argument can lead to a big fight.

items.en: Eating too much salt can cause high blood pressure.

items.en: Poor food in childhood can lead to health problems later.

items.en: Ice on the roads can cause accidents.

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + can + make / damage / help + 受詞

items.en: The sun can damage your skin, even in winter.

examples.heading: ③ 人 + can + feel / get / become + 形容詞

items.en: New students can feel shy on their first day.
items.zh: 新生第一天可能會覺得害羞。

items.en: Older people can feel lonely when their children move away.
items.zh: 孩子搬走以後，老人家可能會覺得寂寞。

items.en: Students can get nervous before exams.
items.zh: 學生考試前可能會很緊張。

items.en: Babies can become tired very quickly.
items.zh: 寶寶可能很快就會累。

items.en: Tourists can get lost in the old part of the city.
items.zh: 觀光客在老城區可能會迷路。

items.en: Some dogs can become aggressive when they're scared.
items.zh: 有些狗害怕的時候可能會變得兇。

items.en: Teenagers can feel embarrassed by their parents.
items.zh: 青少年可能會覺得爸媽讓他們丟臉。

items.en: People can get angry very quickly when they're hungry.
items.zh: 人餓的時候可能很快就會生氣。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + can + 其他動詞：一般的情況

items.en: In the mountains, the temperature can drop very quickly.
items.zh: 山上的氣溫可能會降得很快。

items.en: Children can learn a second language very fast.
items.zh: 小孩學第二種語言可能會很快。

items.en: Prices can change from one week to the next.
items.zh: 價格可能每週都不一樣。

items.en: A cold can last for two weeks.
items.zh: 感冒可能會持續兩個星期。

items.en: Plants can grow without soil if they have water and light.
items.zh: 只要有水和光，植物不用土也能長。

items.en: The journey can take up to six hours in winter.
items.zh: 冬天這段路程可能要花到六個小時。

items.en: Friendships can end for very small reasons.
items.zh: 友誼可能會因為很小的原因結束。

title: You look very pale. You can't be feeling well.
translation: 你臉色很蒼白，一定是身體不舒服。
name: can't 表示推測
sentences: The shop can't be closed. The lights are on.
You can't be hungry. We had lunch an hour ago.
That restaurant can't be expensive. It's always full of students.
Your coffee can't be hot any more. You made it an hour ago.
The answer can't be right. Check your maths again.
The film can't be very good. Nobody is talking about it.
She can't be serious about leaving her job.
The water can't be cold. The sun has been on it all day.
He can't be a criminal. He's too young.
That can't be Anna. She's in Australia this month.
This can't be the right road. We've passed that church twice.
They can't be at home. All the lights are off.
It can't be his car. He sold it last year.
You can't be his sister! You look so different.
That can't be the post office. It closed years ago.
She can't be working today. It's a holiday.
You can't be leaving already! The party has just started.
They can't be telling the truth. Their stories are different.
The baby can't be sleeping with all this noise.
He can't be driving. His car is outside.
You can't be thinking of buying that old house!
It can't be raining again!
That can't be true! I saw him yesterday.
"The bill is two hundred pounds." "That can't be right!"
Ten o'clock already? That can't be right.
"Our teacher is leaving." "It can't be true. She loves this school."
That can't be the end of the story.
That can't be all the money. Where's the rest?
It cannot be good for these animals to live away from their natural home.
It can't be easy to look after five children.
It can't be healthy to eat fast food every day.

examples.heading: ① can't + be + 形容詞

items.en: The shop can't be closed. The lights are on.
items.zh: 那家店不可能關門了，燈還亮著。

items.en: You can't be hungry. We had lunch an hour ago.
items.zh: 你不可能餓，我們一個小時前才吃過午餐。

items.en: That restaurant can't be expensive. It's always full of students.
items.zh: 那家餐廳不可能很貴，裡面總是坐滿學生。

items.en: Your coffee can't be hot any more. You made it an hour ago.
items.zh: 你的咖啡不可能還是熱的，你一個小時前就泡了。

items.en: The answer can't be right. Check your maths again.
items.zh: 這個答案不可能對，再檢查一次你的計算。

items.en: The film can't be very good. Nobody is talking about it.
items.zh: 那部電影不可能很好看，都沒有人在談論。

items.en: She can't be serious about leaving her job.
items.zh: 她不可能是認真要辭職的。

items.en: The water can't be cold. The sun has been on it all day.
items.zh: 水不可能冷，太陽照了一整天。

examples.heading: ② can't + be + 名詞 / 地點

items.en: He can't be a criminal. He's too young.
items.zh: 他不可能是罪犯，他太年輕了。

items.en: That can't be Anna. She's in Australia this month.
items.zh: 那不可能是 Anna，她這個月在澳洲。

items.en: This can't be the right road. We've passed that church twice.
items.zh: 這不可能是對的路，我們經過那間教堂兩次了。

items.en: They can't be at home. All the lights are off.
items.zh: 他們不可能在家，燈全都關著。

items.en: It can't be his car. He sold it last year.
items.zh: 那不可能是他的車，他去年就賣掉了。

items.en: You can't be his sister! You look so different.
items.zh: 你不可能是他姊姊！你們長得一點都不像。

items.en: That can't be the post office. It closed years ago.
items.zh: 那不可能是郵局，它好幾年前就關了。

examples.heading: ③ can't + be + 動詞-ing

items.en: She can't be working today. It's a holiday.
items.zh: 她今天不可能在上班，今天放假。

items.en: You can't be leaving already! The party has just started.
items.zh: 你不可能已經要走了吧！派對才剛開始。

items.en: They can't be telling the truth. Their stories are different.
items.zh: 他們不可能說的是實話，他們的說法不一樣。

items.en: The baby can't be sleeping with all this noise.
items.zh: 這麼吵，寶寶不可能在睡覺。

items.en: He can't be driving. His car is outside.
items.zh: 他不可能在開車，他的車停在外面。

items.en: You can't be thinking of buying that old house!
items.zh: 你不可能在考慮買那間舊房子吧！

items.en: It can't be raining again!
items.zh: 不可能又在下雨吧！

examples.heading: ④ It / That + can't + be + true / right

items.en: That can't be true! I saw him yesterday.
items.zh: 不可能是真的！我昨天還看到他。

items.en: "The bill is two hundred pounds." "That can't be right!"
items.zh: 帳單是兩百英鎊。不可能吧！

items.en: Ten o'clock already? That can't be right.
items.zh: 已經十點了？不可能吧。

items.en: "Our teacher is leaving." "It can't be true. She loves this school."
items.zh: 我們老師要走了。不可能是真的，她很愛這間學校。

items.en: That can't be the end of the story.
items.zh: 故事不可能就這樣結束。

items.en: That can't be all the money. Where's the rest?
items.zh: 不可能只有這些錢，其他的呢？

examples.heading: ⑤ It cannot be + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: It cannot be good for these animals to live away from their natural home.
items.zh: 讓這些動物離開牠們的自然環境，不可能對牠們有好處。

items.en: It can't be easy to look after five children.
items.zh: 照顧五個小孩不可能很輕鬆。

items.en: It can't be healthy to eat fast food every day.
items.zh: 每天吃速食不可能健康。

title: She will often knock on the door to see how you are.
translation: 她常常會來敲門找你。
name: will 表示習慣或典型行為
sentences: Our new neighbour is very kind. She will often knock on the door to see how you are.
My grandfather will often sit in the garden for hours, just watching the birds.
My little brother will often hide under the table when visitors come.
Our teacher will often tell us a joke at the start of the lesson.
The old man next door will often talk to his plants.
My mum will often sing while she's cooking.
A Mexican dish will usually contain a sauce made of hot pepper, tomatoes, garlic and onion.
A good recipe will normally result in a spicy but healthy dish.
A cat will usually sleep for more than twelve hours a day.
A good hotel will usually have someone at the desk all night.
Fresh bread will usually go hard after two days.
A typical English breakfast will include eggs, bacon and beans.
On a bike you can go to beautiful places that you won't usually be able to reach by car, such as riversides.
My dog won't usually eat vegetables, but he loves carrots.
The baby won't usually sleep in the afternoon.
Tourists won't usually find this little beach.
My dad won't usually drink coffee after lunch.
The shop won't usually open before ten.
The dog will always bark when the postman comes.
My sister will cry if she watches a sad film.
Babies will usually stop crying if you sing to them.
Plants will die if you forget to water them.
Children will always ask questions when they're interested.
Milk will go sour if you leave it in the sun.
My brother will play computer games for hours if nobody stops him.
My grandmother will talk about her childhood for hours.
The cat will lie in the sun for hours in the afternoon.
He will read in the library for hours without looking up.
My aunt will chat on the phone for hours with her friends.
The children will play in the sand for hours at the beach.
My uncle will fish by the lake for hours without catching anything.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will often + 原形動詞：人的習慣

items.en: Our new neighbour is very kind. She will often knock on the door to see how you are.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居很好心。她常常會來敲門，看看你好不好。

items.en: My grandfather will often sit in the garden for hours, just watching the birds.
items.zh: 我爺爺常常會在花園裡坐好幾個小時，只是看鳥。

items.en: My little brother will often hide under the table when visitors come.
items.zh: 有客人來的時候，我弟弟常常會躲到桌子底下。

items.en: Our teacher will often tell us a joke at the start of the lesson.
items.zh: 我們老師常常會在上課一開始講一個笑話。

items.en: The old man next door will often talk to his plants.
items.zh: 隔壁的老先生常常會跟他的植物說話。

items.en: My mum will often sing while she's cooking.
items.zh: 我媽媽煮飯的時候常常會唱歌。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + will usually + 原形動詞：東西的典型特徵

items.en: A Mexican dish will usually contain a sauce made of hot pepper, tomatoes, garlic and onion.
items.zh: 墨西哥菜通常會有一種用辣椒、番茄、大蒜和洋蔥做的醬汁。

items.en: A good recipe will normally result in a spicy but healthy dish.
items.zh: 一個好的食譜通常會做出又辣又健康的菜。

items.en: A cat will usually sleep for more than twelve hours a day.
items.zh: 貓通常一天會睡超過十二個小時。

items.en: A good hotel will usually have someone at the desk all night.
items.zh: 好的飯店通常整晚都會有人在櫃台。

items.en: Fresh bread will usually go hard after two days.
items.zh: 新鮮的麵包通常兩天後就會變硬。

items.en: A typical English breakfast will include eggs, bacon and beans.
items.zh: 典型的英式早餐會有蛋、培根和豆子。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + won't usually + 原形動詞：通常不會

items.en: On a bike you can go to beautiful places that you won't usually be able to reach by car, such as riversides.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車可以去很多開車通常到不了的美麗地方，像河邊。

items.en: My dog won't usually eat vegetables, but he loves carrots.
items.zh: 我的狗通常不吃蔬菜，可是他很喜歡紅蘿蔔。

items.en: The baby won't usually sleep in the afternoon.
items.zh: 寶寶下午通常不睡覺。

items.en: Tourists won't usually find this little beach.
items.zh: 觀光客通常找不到這個小海灘。

items.en: My dad won't usually drink coffee after lunch.
items.zh: 我爸爸午餐後通常不喝咖啡。

items.en: The shop won't usually open before ten.
items.zh: 那家店通常十點前不會開。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + will + 原形動詞 + when / if + 子句：典型的反應

items.en: The dog will always bark when the postman comes.
items.zh: 郵差來的時候，狗總是會叫。

items.en: My sister will cry if she watches a sad film.
items.zh: 我妹妹看悲傷的電影會哭。

items.en: Babies will usually stop crying if you sing to them.
items.zh: 如果你唱歌給寶寶聽，他們通常會停止哭泣。

items.en: Plants will die if you forget to water them.
items.zh: 如果你忘了澆水，植物會死。

items.en: Children will always ask questions when they're interested.
items.zh: 孩子們有興趣的時候總是會發問。

items.en: Milk will go sour if you leave it in the sun.
items.zh: 如果你把牛奶放在太陽下，它會變酸。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + will + 原形動詞 + for hours：長時間的習慣

items.en: My brother will play computer games for hours if nobody stops him.
items.zh: 如果沒人阻止，我哥哥會打好幾個小時的電動。

items.en: My grandmother will talk about her childhood for hours.
items.zh: 我奶奶會講她小時候的事講好幾個小時。

items.en: The cat will lie in the sun for hours in the afternoon.
items.zh: 下午貓會在太陽下躺好幾個小時。

items.en: He will read in the library for hours without looking up.
items.zh: 他會在圖書館讀書好幾個小時，頭都不抬。

items.en: My aunt will chat on the phone for hours with her friends.
items.zh: 我阿姨會跟她的朋友講電話講好幾個小時。

items.en: The children will play in the sand for hours at the beach.
items.zh: 孩子們在海灘上會玩沙玩好幾個小時。

items.en: My uncle will fish by the lake for hours without catching anything.
items.zh: 我叔叔會在湖邊釣好幾個小時的魚，什麼都沒釣到。

title: In my opinion I worked very hard. I would spend a lot of hours at work.
translation: 到了晚上，他們常會去岩岸邊生火。
name: would 表示過去的習慣
sentences: Last year I worked in a busy restaurant. In my opinion I worked very hard. I would spend a lot of hours at work.
I would start at six in the morning and finish late at night.
My boss would check every plate before it left the kitchen.
We would have a short break at three o'clock.
I would take the last bus home after work.
On Fridays the restaurant would be full until midnight.
The pirates were clever. At night they would go to the rocky seaside and light a fire to trick the boats.
Every morning the old fisherman would sit by the harbour and mend his nets.
The girl would climb the tree and watch the road for her father.
The king would walk around the city at night in old clothes.
The wolf would come to the village when the snow was deep.
Every evening the children would gather around the fire for a story.
When I was a child, my grandmother would bake bread every Saturday.
When we were young, we would play in the woods until dark.
When I was at school, my mum would walk me to the gate every day.
When my dad was a boy, he would swim in the river every summer.
When we lived in Italy, we would eat outside every evening.
When I was small, my brother would tell me scary stories at night.
My grandfather would often fall asleep in his armchair after lunch.
We would always go to the same beach every summer.
My aunt would often send us parcels from Canada.
Our teacher would always start the lesson with a song.
My friends and I would often meet at the café after school.
The dog would always wait for me at the door.
Every Sunday we would visit my grandparents, and then we would have lunch together.
After school I would do my homework, and then I would go to football practice.
In summer we would get up early, and then we would cycle to the lake.
My mum would cook dinner, and then my dad would wash up.
Every morning she would feed the chickens, and then she would collect the eggs.
At Christmas we would decorate the tree, and then we would sing carols.
On rainy days we would build a tent in the living room, and then we would read inside it.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + would + 原形動詞：過去工作的習慣

items.en: Last year I worked in a busy restaurant. In my opinion I worked very hard. I would spend a lot of hours at work.
items.zh: 去年我在一家很忙的餐廳工作。我認為我工作得很努力。我常常在工作上花很多時間。

items.en: I would start at six in the morning and finish late at night.
items.zh: 我常常早上六點開始，晚上很晚才結束。

items.en: My boss would check every plate before it left the kitchen.
items.zh: 我老闆常常會在每一盤菜離開廚房前檢查。

items.en: We would have a short break at three o'clock.
items.zh: 我們常常在三點的時候休息一下。

items.en: I would take the last bus home after work.
items.zh: 下班後我常常搭最後一班公車回家。

items.en: On Fridays the restaurant would be full until midnight.
items.zh: 星期五餐廳常常客滿到半夜。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + would + 原形動詞：故事裡人物的習慣

items.en: The pirates were clever. At night they would go to the rocky seaside and light a fire to trick the boats.
items.zh: 那些海盜很聰明。晚上他們常常會去岩石海岸生火，欺騙船隻。

items.en: Every morning the old fisherman would sit by the harbour and mend his nets.
items.zh: 每天早上那個老漁夫都會坐在港口邊補他的網。

items.en: The girl would climb the tree and watch the road for her father.
items.zh: 那個女孩常常會爬上樹，看著路等她爸爸回來。

items.en: The king would walk around the city at night in old clothes.
items.zh: 國王常常晚上穿著舊衣服在城裡走來走去。

items.en: The wolf would come to the village when the snow was deep.
items.zh: 雪很深的時候，狼常常會來村子裡。

items.en: Every evening the children would gather around the fire for a story.
items.zh: 每天傍晚孩子們都會圍在火邊聽故事。

examples.heading: ③ When + 主詞 + was …, + 主詞 + would + 原形動詞：童年的回憶

items.en: When I was a child, my grandmother would bake bread every Saturday.
items.zh: 我小時候，我奶奶每個星期六都會烤麵包。

items.en: When we were young, we would play in the woods until dark.
items.zh: 我們小時候，常常在樹林裡玩到天黑。

items.en: When I was at school, my mum would walk me to the gate every day.
items.zh: 我上學的時候，我媽媽每天都會陪我走到校門口。

items.en: When my dad was a boy, he would swim in the river every summer.
items.zh: 我爸爸小時候，每年夏天都會在河裡游泳。

items.en: When we lived in Italy, we would eat outside every evening.
items.zh: 我們住在義大利的時候，每天傍晚都在外面吃飯。

items.en: When I was small, my brother would tell me scary stories at night.
items.zh: 我小時候，我哥哥晚上常常會講恐怖故事給我聽。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + would often / always + 原形動詞：說多常

items.en: My grandfather would often fall asleep in his armchair after lunch.
items.zh: 我爺爺午餐後常常會在扶手椅上睡著。

items.en: We would always go to the same beach every summer.
items.zh: 我們每年夏天總是會去同一個海灘。

items.en: My aunt would often send us parcels from Canada.
items.zh: 我阿姨常常會從加拿大寄包裹給我們。

items.en: Our teacher would always start the lesson with a song.
items.zh: 我們老師總是會用一首歌開始上課。

items.en: My friends and I would often meet at the café after school.
items.zh: 我和朋友常常放學後在咖啡館碰面。

items.en: The dog would always wait for me at the door.
items.zh: 那隻狗總是會在門口等我。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + would + 原形動詞, and then + 主詞 + would + 原形動詞：一連串的習慣

items.en: Every Sunday we would visit my grandparents, and then we would have lunch together.
items.zh: 每個星期天我們都會去看我的祖父母，然後一起吃午餐。

items.en: After school I would do my homework, and then I would go to football practice.
items.zh: 放學後我會先寫功課，然後去練足球。

items.en: In summer we would get up early, and then we would cycle to the lake.
items.zh: 夏天我們會早起，然後騎腳踏車去湖邊。

items.en: My mum would cook dinner, and then my dad would wash up.
items.zh: 我媽媽會煮晚餐，然後我爸爸會洗碗。

items.en: Every morning she would feed the chickens, and then she would collect the eggs.
items.zh: 每天早上她會餵雞，然後撿雞蛋。

items.en: At Christmas we would decorate the tree, and then we would sing carols.
items.zh: 聖誕節我們會裝飾聖誕樹，然後唱聖誕歌。

items.en: On rainy days we would build a tent in the living room, and then we would read inside it.
items.zh: 下雨天我們會在客廳搭帳篷，然後在裡面讀書。

title: It may be argued that a child's academic success is crucial to his or her future.
translation: 也許可以說，孩子在學業上的成就對他的未來非常重要。
name: it may be 加過去分詞 that（委婉）
sentences: It may be argued that children today spend too much time indoors.
Top athletes earn huge salaries. It may be argued that their careers are short, so the money is well deserved.
It may be argued that homework takes away children's free time.
It may be argued that tourism damages small villages.
It may be argued that zoos help to protect rare animals.
It may be argued that public transport should be free.
It may be argued that mobile phones have made people less patient.
On balance, it may be concluded that the main aim of international sport is still to find the fairest winner.
On balance, it may be concluded that the advantages of city life are greater.
On balance, it may be concluded that the new law has helped young workers.
On balance, it may be concluded that online learning works best for adults.
On balance, it may be concluded that both sides have good points.
On balance, it may be concluded that the project was a success.
It may be said that television has changed family life.
It may be said that the internet is the greatest invention of our time.
It may be said that young people today are more open to new ideas.
It may be said that cities never sleep.
It may be said that good teachers change lives.
It may be said that the twentieth century was a century of great change.
It may be suggested that the survey asked too few older people.
It may be claimed that advertising makes people buy things they don't need.
It may be suggested that the results were affected by the weather.
It may be claimed that sport teaches children to work in a team.
It may be suggested that more research is needed.
It may be claimed that working from home saves time and money.
It may be argued that exams are unfair. However, they are the easiest way to compare students.
It may be argued that cars give us freedom, but they also pollute the air.
It may be argued that famous people deserve privacy. However, they often look for attention.
It may be argued that video games are a waste of time, but some of them teach useful skills.
It may be argued that cheap flights are good for travellers. However, they harm the environment.
It may be argued that children should not have phones, but phones help parents keep them safe.

examples.heading: ① It may be argued that + 子句：提出一方的看法

items.en: It may be argued that children today spend too much time indoors.
items.zh: 可以說，現在的孩子待在室內的時間太多了。

items.en: Top athletes earn huge salaries. It may be argued that their careers are short, so the money is well deserved.
items.zh: 頂尖運動員賺很高的薪水。可以說，他們的職業生涯很短，所以這些錢是他們應得的。

items.en: It may be argued that homework takes away children's free time.
items.zh: 可以說，功課佔用了孩子的自由時間。

items.en: It may be argued that tourism damages small villages.
items.zh: 可以說，觀光業傷害了小村莊。

items.en: It may be argued that zoos help to protect rare animals.
items.zh: 可以說，動物園有助於保護稀有動物。

items.en: It may be argued that public transport should be free.
items.zh: 可以說，大眾運輸應該免費。

items.en: It may be argued that mobile phones have made people less patient.
items.zh: 可以說，手機讓人變得比較沒耐心。

examples.heading: ② On balance, it may be concluded that + 子句：論文的結論

items.en: On balance, it may be concluded that the main aim of international sport is still to find the fairest winner.
items.zh: 整體來說，可以得出結論：國際運動比賽的主要目的仍然是公平地找出贏家。

items.en: On balance, it may be concluded that the advantages of city life are greater.
items.zh: 整體來說，可以得出結論：城市生活的好處比較多。

items.en: On balance, it may be concluded that the new law has helped young workers.
items.zh: 整體來說，可以得出結論：新法律幫助了年輕的工作者。

items.en: On balance, it may be concluded that online learning works best for adults.
items.zh: 整體來說，可以得出結論：線上學習對成人最有效。

items.en: On balance, it may be concluded that both sides have good points.
items.zh: 整體來說，可以得出結論：雙方都有道理。

items.en: On balance, it may be concluded that the project was a success.
items.zh: 整體來說，可以得出結論：這個專案是成功的。

examples.heading: ③ It may be said that + 子句：總結一般的看法

items.en: It may be said that television has changed family life.
items.zh: 可以說，電視改變了家庭生活。

items.en: It may be said that the internet is the greatest invention of our time.
items.zh: 可以說，網路是我們這個時代最偉大的發明。

items.en: It may be said that young people today are more open to new ideas.
items.zh: 可以說，現在的年輕人比較能接受新想法。

items.en: It may be said that cities never sleep.
items.zh: 可以說，城市從不休息。

items.en: It may be said that good teachers change lives.
items.zh: 可以說，好老師能改變人的一生。

items.en: It may be said that the twentieth century was a century of great change.
items.zh: 可以說，二十世紀是一個巨變的世紀。

examples.heading: ④ It may be suggested / claimed that + 子句

items.en: It may be suggested that the survey asked too few older people.
items.zh: 可以這麼看：這份調查問到的年長者太少了。

items.en: It may be claimed that advertising makes people buy things they don't need.
items.zh: 有人可能會說，廣告讓人買不需要的東西。

items.en: It may be suggested that the results were affected by the weather.
items.zh: 可以這麼看：結果受到了天氣的影響。

items.en: It may be claimed that sport teaches children to work in a team.
items.zh: 有人可能會說，運動教孩子團隊合作。

items.en: It may be suggested that more research is needed.
items.zh: 可以這麼看：還需要更多的研究。

items.en: It may be claimed that working from home saves time and money.
items.zh: 有人可能會說，在家工作省時又省錢。

examples.heading: ⑤ It may be argued that …, but / however …：先說一方，再反駁

items.en: It may be argued that exams are unfair. However, they are the easiest way to compare students.
items.zh: 可以說，考試不公平。可是考試是比較學生最簡單的方法。

items.en: It may be argued that cars give us freedom, but they also pollute the air.
items.zh: 可以說，汽車給我們自由，可是它們也汙染空氣。

items.en: It may be argued that famous people deserve privacy. However, they often look for attention.
items.zh: 可以說，名人應該有隱私。可是他們常常在尋求關注。

items.en: It may be argued that video games are a waste of time, but some of them teach useful skills.
items.zh: 可以說，電玩浪費時間，可是有些電玩教人有用的技能。

items.en: It may be argued that cheap flights are good for travellers. However, they harm the environment.
items.zh: 可以說，便宜機票對旅客有好處。可是它們傷害環境。

items.en: It may be argued that children should not have phones, but phones help parents keep them safe.
items.zh: 可以說，孩子不應該有手機，可是手機幫助父母保護孩子的安全。

title: How dare you say that this event was a complete failure!
translation: 你竟敢說這次活動徹底失敗！
name: How dare 表示不滿或被冒犯
sentences: How dare you make fun of my accent!
How dare you read my messages without asking!
How dare you speak to your grandmother like that!
How dare you drive my new car to the beach and fill it with sand!
How dare you call me a liar!
How dare you come into my room!
How dare you laugh at my cooking!
How dare you tell my secret to everyone!
How dare you blame me for your mistake!
How dare you park in front of my gate!
How dare people say that we don't do any sport!
How dare they raise the rent again!
How dare they cut down the trees in our park!
How dare people leave rubbish on the beach!
How dare they cancel the concert at the last minute!
How dare they treat their workers like that!
How dare she go through my bag while I was out!
How dare he say I'm lazy!
How dare she use my name without asking!
How dare he arrive two hours late and say nothing!
How dare the manager shout at the new staff!
How dare he eat the last piece of cake!
How dare that newspaper print lies about our school!
"You stole my wallet." "How dare you!"
"Your work is terrible." "How dare you! I worked all night."
How dare you! I've never been so insulted.
"You only care about money." "How dare you!"
How dare you! Get out of my house.
"I think you cheated." "How dare you! I studied for weeks."
How dare you! After everything I've done for you!
"That's not your real hair." "How dare you!"

examples.heading: ① How dare you + 原形動詞!

items.en: How dare you make fun of my accent!
items.zh: 你竟敢取笑我的口音！

items.en: How dare you read my messages without asking!
items.zh: 你竟敢沒問我就看我的訊息！

items.en: How dare you speak to your grandmother like that!
items.zh: 你竟敢那樣跟你奶奶說話！

items.en: How dare you drive my new car to the beach and fill it with sand!
items.zh: 你竟敢把我的新車開去海邊，還弄得滿車都是沙！

items.en: How dare you call me a liar!
items.zh: 你竟敢說我是騙子！

items.en: How dare you come into my room!
items.zh: 你竟敢進我的房間！

items.en: How dare you laugh at my cooking!
items.zh: 你竟敢笑我煮的菜！

items.en: How dare you tell my secret to everyone!
items.zh: 你竟敢把我的祕密告訴大家！

items.en: How dare you blame me for your mistake!
items.zh: 你竟敢把你的錯怪到我身上！

items.en: How dare you park in front of my gate!
items.zh: 你竟敢把車停在我家大門前面！

examples.heading: ② How dare + people / they + 原形動詞!

items.en: How dare people say that we don't do any sport!
items.zh: 人們竟敢說我們都不運動！

items.en: How dare they raise the rent again!
items.zh: 他們竟敢又漲房租！

items.en: How dare they cut down the trees in our park!
items.zh: 他們竟敢砍掉我們公園裡的樹！

items.en: How dare people leave rubbish on the beach!
items.zh: 人們竟敢把垃圾丟在海灘上！

items.en: How dare they cancel the concert at the last minute!
items.zh: 他們竟敢在最後一刻取消演唱會！

items.en: How dare they treat their workers like that!
items.zh: 他們竟敢那樣對待員工！

examples.heading: ③ How dare + 第三人稱單數主詞 + 原形動詞!

items.en: How dare she go through my bag while I was out!
items.zh: 她竟敢趁我出去的時候翻我的包包！

items.en: How dare he say I'm lazy!
items.zh: 他竟敢說我懶！

items.en: How dare she use my name without asking!
items.zh: 她竟敢沒問就用我的名字！

items.en: How dare he arrive two hours late and say nothing!
items.zh: 他竟敢遲到兩個小時還什麼都不說！

items.en: How dare the manager shout at the new staff!
items.zh: 那個經理竟敢對新員工大吼！

items.en: How dare he eat the last piece of cake!
items.zh: 他竟敢吃掉最後一塊蛋糕！

items.en: How dare that newspaper print lies about our school!
items.zh: 那家報紙竟敢刊登關於我們學校的謊言！

examples.heading: ④ How dare you!：單獨使用

items.en: "You stole my wallet." "How dare you!"
items.zh: 你偷了我的錢包。你好大的膽子！

items.en: "Your work is terrible." "How dare you! I worked all night."
items.zh: 你做得很糟。你怎麼敢這樣說！我做了一整晚。

items.en: How dare you! I've never been so insulted.
items.zh: 你好大的膽子！我從來沒被這樣侮辱過。（被動）

items.en: "You only care about money." "How dare you!"
items.zh: 你只在乎錢。你怎麼敢這樣說！

items.en: How dare you! Get out of my house.
items.zh: 你好大的膽子！滾出我家。

items.en: "I think you cheated." "How dare you! I studied for weeks."
items.zh: 我覺得你作弊。你怎麼敢這樣說！我讀了好幾個星期。

items.en: How dare you! After everything I've done for you!
items.zh: 你怎麼敢這樣！我為你做了那麼多！

items.en: "That's not your real hair." "How dare you!"
items.zh: 那不是你真的頭髮。你好大的膽子！

title: I think everyone should learn to cook. You never know when you'll need to.
translation: 我覺得每個人都應該學做菜。
name: should 表示理想的情況
sentences: My brother ate fast food every day at university and got ill. I think everyone should learn to cook.
Everyone should learn to swim when they are young.
Everybody should have a doctor they can see quickly.
Everyone should spend some time living abroad.
Everybody should know how to give first aid.
Everyone should have the chance to go to university.
British people should eat more vegetables and fruit and avoid fast food!
People should walk or cycle more instead of driving everywhere.
People in big cities should get to know their neighbours.
Young people should vote in every election.
Old people should not have to live alone.
Tourists should respect the local customs.
Children should play outside every day, not just sit in front of screens.
Students should learn about money at school.
Every child should learn a musical instrument.
Children should help with the housework at home.
Students should have time to rest between exams.
Teenagers should get at least eight hours' sleep.
The government should make public transport cheaper.
Cities should have more parks and fewer cars.
Every town should have a free library.
Hospitals should never be too far from people's homes.
Shops should use less plastic packaging.
Companies should give their workers more holidays.
People should drink more water, because most of us don't drink enough.
Schools should start later, because teenagers need more sleep.
Everyone should recycle, because the planet is in danger.
Families should eat together, because it's a good time to talk.
People should read more books, because reading improves the mind.
Children should learn a second language, because it opens doors later in life.
Workers should take regular breaks, because tired people make mistakes.

examples.heading: ① everyone / everybody + should + 原形動詞

items.en: My brother ate fast food every day at university and got ill. I think everyone should learn to cook.
items.zh: 我哥哥上大學每天吃速食，結果生病了。我覺得每個人都應該學會煮飯。

items.en: Everyone should learn to swim when they are young.
items.zh: 每個人小時候都應該學游泳。

items.en: Everybody should have a doctor they can see quickly.
items.zh: 每個人都應該有一個能很快看到的醫生。

items.en: Everyone should spend some time living abroad.
items.zh: 每個人都應該在國外住一段時間。

items.en: Everybody should know how to give first aid.
items.zh: 每個人都應該會急救。

items.en: Everyone should have the chance to go to university.
items.zh: 每個人都應該有機會上大學。

examples.heading: ② people + should + 原形動詞：說一國或一群人

items.en: British people should eat more vegetables and fruit and avoid fast food!
items.zh: 英國人應該多吃蔬菜水果，少吃速食！

items.en: People should walk or cycle more instead of driving everywhere.
items.zh: 人們應該多走路或騎腳踏車，不要到哪裡都開車。

items.en: People in big cities should get to know their neighbours.
items.zh: 住在大城市的人應該認識他們的鄰居。

items.en: Young people should vote in every election.
items.zh: 年輕人每次選舉都應該去投票。

items.en: Old people should not have to live alone.
items.zh: 老人不應該得一個人住。

items.en: Tourists should respect the local customs.
items.zh: 觀光客應該尊重當地的習俗。

examples.heading: ③ children / students + should + 原形動詞：教育的理想

items.en: Children should play outside every day, not just sit in front of screens.
items.zh: 孩子應該每天在戶外玩，不要只坐在螢幕前面。

items.en: Students should learn about money at school.
items.zh: 學生應該在學校學習理財。

items.en: Every child should learn a musical instrument.
items.zh: 每個孩子都應該學一種樂器。

items.en: Children should help with the housework at home.
items.zh: 孩子應該在家幫忙做家事。

items.en: Students should have time to rest between exams.
items.zh: 學生在考試之間應該有時間休息。

items.en: Teenagers should get at least eight hours' sleep.
items.zh: 青少年應該睡至少八個小時。

examples.heading: ④ the government / cities + should + 原形動詞：社會的理想

items.en: The government should make public transport cheaper.
items.zh: 政府應該讓大眾運輸便宜一點。

items.en: Cities should have more parks and fewer cars.
items.zh: 城市應該有更多公園，少一點車。

items.en: Every town should have a free library.
items.zh: 每個城鎮都應該有一座免費的圖書館。

items.en: Hospitals should never be too far from people's homes.
items.zh: 醫院不應該離人們的家太遠。

items.en: Shops should use less plastic packaging.
items.zh: 商店應該少用塑膠包裝。

items.en: Companies should give their workers more holidays.
items.zh: 公司應該給員工更多假期。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + should + 原形動詞, because + 子句：理想和理由

items.en: People should drink more water, because most of us don't drink enough.
items.zh: 人們應該多喝水，因為我們大部分的人喝得不夠。

items.en: Schools should start later, because teenagers need more sleep.
items.zh: 學校應該晚一點上課，因為青少年需要更多睡眠。

items.en: Everyone should recycle, because the planet is in danger.
items.zh: 每個人都應該做回收，因為地球有危險。

items.en: Families should eat together, because it's a good time to talk.
items.zh: 家人應該一起吃飯，因為那是聊天的好時間。

items.en: People should read more books, because reading improves the mind.
items.zh: 人們應該多讀書，因為閱讀能讓頭腦更好。

items.en: Children should learn a second language, because it opens doors later in life.
items.zh: 孩子應該學第二種語言，因為以後會有更多機會。

items.en: Workers should take regular breaks, because tired people make mistakes.
items.zh: 工作的人應該定時休息，因為疲倦的人容易犯錯。

title: I was thinking of painting my bedroom blue. It would look awesome.
translation: 我在想要把我的房間漆成藍色。那樣會超好看的。
name: would 表示假想的情況
sentences: My bedroom walls are so boring. I was thinking of painting them blue. It would look awesome.
Let's have the party by the lake. It would be fun there.
Why don't you cut your hair short? It would look great on you.
We could put a big plant in the corner. It would make the room brighter.
Let's take the train along the coast. It would be a lovely trip.
I'd like to grow tomatoes in the garden. They would taste much better.
It would be wonderful to live in a house by the sea.
It would be nice to see all my old school friends again.
It would be easier to take a taxi than the bus.
It would be great to have a swimming pool in our garden.
It would be cheaper to cook at home than eat out.
It would be exciting to sail across the Atlantic in a small boat.
My mum would love this scarf. It's her favourite colour.
Dad would be so angry if he saw this mess.
My grandmother would cry if she heard this song.
The children would enjoy a day at the zoo.
My teacher would be surprised to see me here.
Our dog would go crazy in all this snow.
With a bigger flat, we would have room for guests.
With a car, I would visit my parents more often.
In a quieter town, I would sleep much better.
A dog would be good company for my grandfather.
A new kitchen would make cooking much more fun.
A bike would save me a lot of time.
"Let's have a picnic on Sunday." "That would be lovely."
"I can drive you to the airport." "That would be really helpful."
"Shall we go to the beach?" "That would be perfect."
"We could eat at the Italian place." "That would be nice."
"I'll bring a cake to the party." "That would be great, thanks."
"Let's watch the sunset from the hill." "That would be beautiful."
"My brother can help you move." "That would be wonderful."

examples.heading: ① 想法 + It would + look / be + 形容詞：想像結果

items.en: My bedroom walls are so boring. I was thinking of painting them blue. It would look awesome.
items.zh: 我房間的牆好無聊。我在想要不要把它們漆成藍色。那一定會很好看。

items.en: Let's have the party by the lake. It would be fun there.
items.zh: 我們在湖邊辦派對吧。在那裡會很好玩。

items.en: Why don't you cut your hair short? It would look great on you.
items.zh: 你何不把頭髮剪短？你剪短一定很好看。

items.en: We could put a big plant in the corner. It would make the room brighter.
items.zh: 我們可以在角落放一盆大植物。那會讓房間亮一點。

items.en: Let's take the train along the coast. It would be a lovely trip.
items.zh: 我們搭沿著海岸的火車吧。那會是一趟很棒的旅行。

items.en: I'd like to grow tomatoes in the garden. They would taste much better.
items.zh: 我想在花園裡種番茄。它們會好吃很多。

examples.heading: ② It would be + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞：想像做某件事

items.en: It would be wonderful to live in a house by the sea.
items.zh: 住在海邊的房子會很棒。

items.en: It would be nice to see all my old school friends again.
items.zh: 再見到我所有的老同學會很好。

items.en: It would be easier to take a taxi than the bus.
items.zh: 搭計程車會比搭公車方便。

items.en: It would be great to have a swimming pool in our garden.
items.zh: 我們的花園有一座游泳池會很棒。

items.en: It would be cheaper to cook at home than eat out.
items.zh: 在家煮飯會比外食便宜。

items.en: It would be exciting to sail across the Atlantic in a small boat.
items.zh: 坐小船橫越大西洋會很刺激。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + would + 原形動詞：想像別人的反應

items.en: My mum would love this scarf. It's her favourite colour.
items.zh: 我媽媽會很喜歡這條圍巾。那是她最喜歡的顏色。

items.en: Dad would be so angry if he saw this mess.
items.zh: 如果爸爸看到這一團亂，他會很生氣。

items.en: My grandmother would cry if she heard this song.
items.zh: 如果我奶奶聽到這首歌，她會哭。

items.en: The children would enjoy a day at the zoo.
items.zh: 孩子們會喜歡在動物園玩一天。

items.en: My teacher would be surprised to see me here.
items.zh: 我的老師看到我在這裡會很驚訝。

items.en: Our dog would go crazy in all this snow.
items.zh: 我們的狗在這麼多雪裡會瘋掉。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + would + 原形動詞：想像以後的生活

items.en: With a bigger flat, we would have room for guests.
items.zh: 有大一點的公寓，我們就有地方給客人住。

items.en: With a car, I would visit my parents more often.
items.zh: 有車的話，我會更常去看我爸媽。

items.en: In a quieter town, I would sleep much better.
items.zh: 住在安靜一點的小鎮，我會睡得好很多。

items.en: A dog would be good company for my grandfather.
items.zh: 一隻狗會是我爺爺很好的伴。

items.en: A new kitchen would make cooking much more fun.
items.zh: 新廚房會讓煮飯好玩很多。

items.en: A bike would save me a lot of time.
items.zh: 一台腳踏車會幫我省很多時間。

examples.heading: ⑤ That would be + 形容詞：回應別人的提議

items.en: "Let's have a picnic on Sunday." "That would be lovely."
items.zh: 我們星期天去野餐吧。那會很棒。

items.en: "I can drive you to the airport." "That would be really helpful."
items.zh: 我可以開車載你去機場。那會很有幫助。

items.en: "Shall we go to the beach?" "That would be perfect."
items.zh: 我們去海灘好嗎？那太完美了。

items.en: "We could eat at the Italian place." "That would be nice."
items.zh: 我們可以去那家義大利餐廳吃。那會很不錯。

items.en: "I'll bring a cake to the party." "That would be great, thanks."
items.zh: 我會帶一個蛋糕去派對。那太好了，謝謝。

items.en: "Let's watch the sunset from the hill." "That would be beautiful."
items.zh: 我們從山丘上看夕陽吧。那會很美。

items.en: "My brother can help you move." "That would be wonderful."
items.zh: 我哥哥可以幫你搬家。那太好了。

title: If I had worn uncomfortable shoes, I wouldn't have danced all night.
translation: 要不是你幫我，我根本不知道那份專題作業要怎麼做。
name: would have 表示過去的假想情況
sentences: I chose flat shoes for the wedding. If I had gone in uncomfortable shoes, I wouldn't have danced all night.
If you hadn't helped me, I wouldn't have known how to do that homework project.
If we hadn't taken a taxi, we wouldn't have arrived on time.
If she hadn't called me, I wouldn't have known about the party.
If the guide hadn't come back for us, we wouldn't have found the path in the dark.
If they hadn't booked early, they wouldn't have got a table.
If I were in your shoes, I would have chosen the school in the centre of town.
If I were in your shoes, I would have told her the truth.
If I were in your shoes, I would have asked for a refund.
If I were in your shoes, I would have taken the job in Paris.
If I were in your shoes, I would have called the police.
If I were in your shoes, I would have stayed at home.
In my dream I won a competition. The next week I would have flown to Miami to meet a famous actor.
With the prize money, I would have bought a house by the sea.
In that job, I would have travelled all over Europe.
On the first day of the trip, we would have visited the castle.
As team captain, she would have led the team onto the field.
With a bigger car, we would have taken the whole family.
If I had known you were coming, I would have made a cake.
If we had left earlier, we would have seen the start of the show.
If he had listened to his coach, he would have won the race.
If it had snowed, we would have gone skiing.
If she had studied French, she would have understood the film.
If they had asked, I would have helped them.
I would have called you if I had had your number.
We would have stayed longer if the weather had been better.
She would have come to the party if she had felt better.
They would have bought the house if it had been cheaper.
I would have taken a photo if I had had my camera.
He would have passed the test if he had read the questions carefully.
We would have missed the train if you hadn't woken us up.

examples.heading: ① If + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + wouldn't have + 過去分詞

items.en: I chose flat shoes for the wedding. If I had gone in uncomfortable shoes, I wouldn't have danced all night.
items.zh: 我穿了平底鞋去婚禮。如果我穿了不舒服的鞋子，我就不會整晚都在跳舞了。

items.en: If you hadn't helped me, I wouldn't have known how to do that homework project.
items.zh: 如果你沒幫我，我就不會知道怎麼做那份作業。

items.en: If we hadn't taken a taxi, we wouldn't have arrived on time.
items.zh: 如果我們沒搭計程車，就不會準時到了。

items.en: If she hadn't called me, I wouldn't have known about the party.
items.zh: 如果她沒打給我，我就不會知道派對的事。

items.en: If the guide hadn't come back for us, we wouldn't have found the path in the dark.
items.zh: 如果導遊沒回來找我們，我們在黑暗中就找不到步道了。

items.en: If they hadn't booked early, they wouldn't have got a table.
items.zh: 如果他們沒早點訂位，就不會有位子了。

examples.heading: ② If I were in your shoes, + I would have + 過去分詞

items.en: If I were in your shoes, I would have chosen the school in the centre of town.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會選市中心那所學校。

items.en: If I were in your shoes, I would have told her the truth.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會告訴她真相。

items.en: If I were in your shoes, I would have asked for a refund.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會要求退款。

items.en: If I were in your shoes, I would have taken the job in Paris.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會接受巴黎那份工作。

items.en: If I were in your shoes, I would have called the police.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會報警。

items.en: If I were in your shoes, I would have stayed at home.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會待在家裡。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞：想像中原本的經歷

items.en: In my dream I won a competition. The next week I would have flown to Miami to meet a famous actor.
items.zh: 在我的夢裡我贏了一場比賽。下個星期我本來會飛去邁阿密見一位有名的演員。

items.en: With the prize money, I would have bought a house by the sea.
items.zh: 有了那筆獎金，我本來會在海邊買一間房子。

items.en: In that job, I would have travelled all over Europe.
items.zh: 做那份工作，我本來會到歐洲各地旅行。

items.en: On the first day of the trip, we would have visited the castle.
items.zh: 旅行的第一天，我們本來會去參觀城堡。

items.en: As team captain, she would have led the team onto the field.
items.zh: 身為隊長，她本來會帶領球隊進場。

items.en: With a bigger car, we would have taken the whole family.
items.zh: 有大一點的車，我們本來會帶全家去。

examples.heading: ④ If + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞

items.en: If I had known you were coming, I would have made a cake.
items.zh: 如果我知道你要來，我就會做一個蛋糕。

items.en: If we had left earlier, we would have seen the start of the show.
items.zh: 如果我們早點出發，就會看到表演的開頭了。

items.en: If he had listened to his coach, he would have won the race.
items.zh: 如果他聽了教練的話，他就會贏得比賽了。

items.en: If it had snowed, we would have gone skiing.
items.zh: 如果下雪了，我們就會去滑雪了。

items.en: If she had studied French, she would have understood the film.
items.zh: 如果她學過法文，她就會看懂那部電影了。

items.en: If they had asked, I would have helped them.
items.zh: 如果他們問了，我就會幫他們了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞 + if + 子句：if 子句放在後面

items.en: I would have called you if I had had your number.
items.zh: 如果我有你的電話號碼，我就會打給你了。

items.en: We would have stayed longer if the weather had been better.
items.zh: 如果天氣好一點，我們就會待久一點了。

items.en: She would have come to the party if she had felt better.
items.zh: 如果她覺得好一點，她就會來派對了。

items.en: They would have bought the house if it had been cheaper.
items.zh: 如果那間房子便宜一點，他們就會買了。

items.en: I would have taken a photo if I had had my camera.
items.zh: 如果我帶了相機，我就會拍照了。

items.en: He would have passed the test if he had read the questions carefully.
items.zh: 如果他仔細讀題目，他就會通過考試了。

items.en: We would have missed the train if you hadn't woken us up.
items.zh: 如果你沒叫醒我們，我們就會錯過火車了。

title: Need I go on?
translation: 還需要我提醒你明天就要考試了嗎？
name: need 疑問句當討論中的修辭問句
sentences: The car park would destroy a hundred trees, bring more traffic and make the air dirty. Need I go on?
You ask why I want my money back. The hotel was dirty, noisy and far from the beach. Need I go on?
Why are we leaving this phone company? Prices have doubled and the service is worse. Need I go on?
I don't trust my sister's new boyfriend. He lied about his age, his job and his family. Need I go on?
The board asked why we want a new manager. The project is late, over budget and badly planned. Need I go on?
I'm writing to complain about our street. The roads are full of holes and the street lights don't work. Need I go on?
You stay at the office until midnight every day. Need you work in this way?
Two of the new staff were crying after your meeting. Need you be so hard on them?
We only eat together once a week. Need you check your emails during dinner?
There are sheep and cyclists everywhere here. Need you drive so fast on these narrow roads?
We've had four meetings, and you've said no every time. Need you criticise every idea that we suggest?
Our baby wakes up every time you come home. Need you make so much noise at night?
The designer wants fifty thousand pounds. Need we spend so much money on a new logo?
We already send a weekly report by email. Need we have a meeting every Monday?
There are already three malls within ten miles. Need we build another shopping centre in this town?
The club changed the rules in January. Need we change them again?
Two other companies want to buy our building. Need we accept the first offer?
The library is full every day after school. Need we cut its budget?
You want a bigger office party this year? Need I remind you that we lost money last year?
The manager wants to try the same plan again. Need I point out that it failed twice before?
The committee still hasn't chosen a builder. Need I remind it that the deadline is next week?
The council wants to sell the park. Need I point out how many people use it every day?
A phone has rung twice during this concert. Need I remind everyone that phones must be switched off?
You want Tim to write the next report? Need I mention that his last one had many mistakes?
Many bosses say success means working late. Need young people work such long hours to succeed?
University fees in this country have tripled. Need a good education cost so much?
Our town has good buses and trains. Need every family own two cars?
The new law bans fizzy drinks in schools. Need the government control what we eat?
Our best family holiday was a week of camping. Need a holiday be expensive to be enjoyable?
My son does three hours of homework every night. Need schools give so much?
Our first flat had one room, and we were very happy. Need a house be big to be a home?

examples.heading: ① Need I go on?：論點已經夠清楚

items.en: The car park would destroy a hundred trees, bring more traffic and make the air dirty. Need I go on?
items.zh: 停車場會毀掉一百棵樹，帶來更多車流，讓空氣變髒。我還需要繼續說下去嗎？

items.en: You ask why I want my money back. The hotel was dirty, noisy and far from the beach. Need I go on?
items.zh: 你問我為什麼要退錢。那家飯店很髒、很吵，離海灘又遠。我還需要繼續說嗎？

items.en: Why are we leaving this phone company? Prices have doubled and the service is worse. Need I go on?
items.zh: 我們為什麼要換掉這家電信公司？價格漲了一倍，服務卻變差了。我還需要繼續說嗎？

items.en: I don't trust my sister's new boyfriend. He lied about his age, his job and his family. Need I go on?
items.zh: 我不信任我姊姊的新男友。他在年齡、工作和家庭上都說了謊。我還需要繼續說嗎？

items.en: The board asked why we want a new manager. The project is late, over budget and badly planned. Need I go on?
items.zh: 董事會問我們為什麼要換經理。這個專案延誤、超出預算，計畫也很糟。我還需要繼續說嗎？

items.en: I'm writing to complain about our street. The roads are full of holes and the street lights don't work. Need I go on?
items.zh: 我寫信是要投訴我們這條街。路上都是坑洞，路燈也不亮。我還需要繼續說嗎？

examples.heading: ② Need you + 原形動詞？：表示不贊成對方的做法

items.en: You stay at the office until midnight every day. Need you work in this way?
items.zh: 你每天在辦公室待到半夜。你有必要這樣工作嗎？

items.en: Two of the new staff were crying after your meeting. Need you be so hard on them?
items.zh: 兩個新員工開完你的會都哭了。你有必要對他們這麼嚴格嗎？

items.en: We only eat together once a week. Need you check your emails during dinner?
items.zh: 我們一個星期才一起吃一次飯。你有必要在吃晚餐的時候看電子郵件嗎？

items.en: There are sheep and cyclists everywhere here. Need you drive so fast on these narrow roads?
items.zh: 這裡到處都是羊和騎腳踏車的人。你有必要在這些窄路上開這麼快嗎？

items.en: We've had four meetings, and you've said no every time. Need you criticise every idea that we suggest?
items.zh: 我們開了四次會，你每次都說不行。你有必要批評我們提出的每一個想法嗎？

items.en: Our baby wakes up every time you come home. Need you make so much noise at night?
items.zh: 你每次回家，我們的寶寶都會醒來。你有必要在晚上弄出這麼大的聲音嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Need we + 原形動詞？：在討論裡提出懷疑

items.en: The designer wants fifty thousand pounds. Need we spend so much money on a new logo?
items.zh: 設計師要五萬英鎊。我們有必要花這麼多錢做新的標誌嗎？

items.en: We already send a weekly report by email. Need we have a meeting every Monday?
items.zh: 我們每週都已經用電子郵件寄報告了。我們有必要每個星期一都開會嗎？

items.en: There are already three malls within ten miles. Need we build another shopping centre in this town?
items.zh: 十英里內已經有三座購物中心了。我們有必要在這個鎮上再蓋一座嗎？

items.en: The club changed the rules in January. Need we change them again?
items.zh: 俱樂部一月才改過規定。我們有必要再改一次嗎？

items.en: Two other companies want to buy our building. Need we accept the first offer?
items.zh: 還有兩家公司想買我們的大樓。我們有必要接受第一個報價嗎？

items.en: The library is full every day after school. Need we cut its budget?
items.zh: 圖書館每天放學後都坐滿了人。我們有必要刪減它的預算嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Need I remind / point out + 子句？：提醒對方明顯的事

items.en: You want a bigger office party this year? Need I remind you that we lost money last year?
items.zh: 你今年想辦更大的公司派對？我需要提醒你們我們去年虧錢了嗎？

items.en: The manager wants to try the same plan again. Need I point out that it failed twice before?
items.zh: 經理想再試一次同一個計畫。我需要指出這個計畫之前已經失敗過兩次嗎？

items.en: The committee still hasn't chosen a builder. Need I remind it that the deadline is next week?
items.zh: 委員會還沒選好建商。我需要提醒委員會截止日期是下星期嗎？

items.en: The council wants to sell the park. Need I point out how many people use it every day?
items.zh: 議會想把公園賣掉。我需要指出每天有多少人用這座公園嗎？

items.en: A phone has rung twice during this concert. Need I remind everyone that phones must be switched off?
items.zh: 這場音樂會中手機已經響了兩次。我需要提醒大家手機必須關掉嗎？（被動）

items.en: You want Tim to write the next report? Need I mention that his last one had many mistakes?
items.zh: 你想讓 Tim 寫下一份報告？我需要提到他上一份報告有很多錯嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Need + 主詞 + 原形動詞？：辯論的反問

items.en: Many bosses say success means working late. Need young people work such long hours to succeed?
items.zh: 很多老闆說成功就要加班。年輕人有必要工作那麼久才能成功嗎？

items.en: University fees in this country have tripled. Need a good education cost so much?
items.zh: 這個國家的大學學費漲了三倍。好的教育有必要那麼貴嗎？

items.en: Our town has good buses and trains. Need every family own two cars?
items.zh: 我們鎮上有很好的公車和火車。每個家庭都有必要擁有兩台車嗎？

items.en: The new law bans fizzy drinks in schools. Need the government control what we eat?
items.zh: 新法律禁止學校賣汽水。政府有必要管我們吃什麼嗎？

items.en: Our best family holiday was a week of camping. Need a holiday be expensive to be enjoyable?
items.zh: 我們最棒的家庭假期是露營一個星期。度假有必要很貴才好玩嗎？

items.en: My son does three hours of homework every night. Need schools give so much?
items.zh: 我兒子每天晚上寫三個小時的功課。學校有必要出這麼多功課嗎？

items.en: Our first flat had one room, and we were very happy. Need a house be big to be a home?
