items.zh: 我們的第一間公寓只有一個房間，我們卻很快樂。房子有必要很大才算是家嗎？

title: If you want my opinion, I'd recommend the countryside.
translation: 如果你想聽我的意見，我會推薦鄉下。
name: would 加 say、recommend 表示委婉
sentences: Your friends are going to the beach. I'd advise you to go with them, because I bet you'll have so much fun!
I'd advise you to book the tickets early. They sell out fast.
I'd advise you to talk to your teacher before you decide.
I'd advise you to take a warm coat. It's cold at night.
I'd advise you to save some money before you travel.
I'd advise you not to drive in the snow.
If you want my opinion, I'd recommend the countryside, because the city in my country is very noisy.
I'd recommend the fish soup. It's the best thing on the menu.
I'd recommend taking the train. It's faster than the bus.
I'd recommend this book to anyone who likes history.
I'd recommend visiting the old town in the evening.
I'd recommend the small hotel near the harbour.
Finally, I'd say that you should talk with your parents and your friends to decide.
If you've decided to move, I would say that it's better for you to choose the large school.
I'd say the second film is better than the first.
I'd say we need about twenty chairs for the party.
I'd say the journey takes about two hours.
I'd say she's about thirty years old.
I would imagine the beach is very crowded in August.
I would imagine your parents are very proud of you.
I would imagine the tickets are quite expensive.
I would imagine it's very cold there in winter.
I would imagine the new manager has a lot of work.
I would imagine the children are tired after the long trip.
I wouldn't say the film was bad, but it was too long.
I wouldn't say he's lazy. He's just tired.
I wouldn't say the hotel was cheap, but it was good value.
I wouldn't say I'm an expert, but I know a bit about cars.
I wouldn't say the test was easy, but I think I passed.
I wouldn't say it's the best restaurant in town.
I wouldn't say no to a cup of tea.

examples.heading: ① I'd advise you to + 原形動詞：委婉的建議

items.en: Your friends are going to the beach. I'd advise you to go with them, because I bet you'll have so much fun!
items.zh: 你的朋友要去海邊。我會建議你跟他們去，因為我敢說你會玩得很開心！

items.en: I'd advise you to book the tickets early. They sell out fast.
items.zh: 我會建議你早點訂票。票賣得很快。

items.en: I'd advise you to talk to your teacher before you decide.
items.zh: 我會建議你決定之前先跟你的老師談談。

items.en: I'd advise you to take a warm coat. It's cold at night.
items.zh: 我會建議你帶一件保暖的外套。晚上很冷。

items.en: I'd advise you to save some money before you travel.
items.zh: 我會建議你旅行前先存一些錢。

items.en: I'd advise you not to drive in the snow.
items.zh: 我會建議你不要在雪中開車。

examples.heading: ② I'd recommend + 名詞 / -ing：委婉的推薦

items.en: If you want my opinion, I'd recommend the countryside, because the city in my country is very noisy.
items.zh: 如果你想聽我的意見，我會推薦鄉下，因為我們國家的城市很吵。

items.en: I'd recommend the fish soup. It's the best thing on the menu.
items.zh: 我會推薦魚湯。那是菜單上最好吃的。

items.en: I'd recommend taking the train. It's faster than the bus.
items.zh: 我會推薦搭火車。比公車快。

items.en: I'd recommend this book to anyone who likes history.
items.zh: 我會把這本書推薦給喜歡歷史的人。

items.en: I'd recommend visiting the old town in the evening.
items.zh: 我會推薦晚上去逛舊城區。

items.en: I'd recommend the small hotel near the harbour.
items.zh: 我會推薦港口附近那家小飯店。

examples.heading: ③ I'd say (that) + 子句：說自己的看法

items.en: Finally, I'd say that you should talk with your parents and your friends to decide.
items.zh: 最後，我會說你應該跟你的爸媽和朋友談談再決定。

items.en: If you've decided to move, I would say that it's better for you to choose the large school.
items.zh: 如果你決定搬家，我會說你選那所大學校比較好。

items.en: I'd say the second film is better than the first.
items.zh: 我會說第二集比第一集好看。

items.en: I'd say we need about twenty chairs for the party.
items.zh: 我會說派對大概需要二十張椅子。

items.en: I'd say the journey takes about two hours.
items.zh: 我會說這段路程大概要兩個小時。

items.en: I'd say she's about thirty years old.
items.zh: 我猜她大概三十歲。

examples.heading: ④ I would imagine (that) + 子句：委婉的推測

items.en: I would imagine the beach is very crowded in August.
items.zh: 我想八月的海灘應該很擠。

items.en: I would imagine your parents are very proud of you.
items.zh: 我想你爸媽應該很以你為榮。

items.en: I would imagine the tickets are quite expensive.
items.zh: 我想票應該滿貴的。

items.en: I would imagine it's very cold there in winter.
items.zh: 我想那裡冬天應該很冷。

items.en: I would imagine the new manager has a lot of work.
items.zh: 我想新經理應該有很多工作。

items.en: I would imagine the children are tired after the long trip.
items.zh: 我想孩子們長途旅行後應該很累。

examples.heading: ⑤ I wouldn't say + 子句：委婉地不同意

items.en: I wouldn't say the film was bad, but it was too long.
items.zh: 我不會說那部電影很糟，可是它太長了。

items.en: I wouldn't say he's lazy. He's just tired.
items.zh: 我不會說他很懶。他只是累了。

items.en: I wouldn't say the hotel was cheap, but it was good value.
items.zh: 我不會說那家飯店很便宜，可是很划算。

items.en: I wouldn't say I'm an expert, but I know a bit about cars.
items.zh: 我不會說我是專家，可是我對車子懂一點。

items.en: I wouldn't say the test was easy, but I think I passed.
items.zh: 我不會說考試很簡單，可是我想我考過了。

items.en: I wouldn't say it's the best restaurant in town.
items.zh: 我不會說那是城裡最好的餐廳。

items.en: I wouldn't say no to a cup of tea.
items.zh: 我不會拒絕一杯茶。

title: You must come and stay in our house too.
translation: 你一定要來看看這家餐廳！
name: must 表示邀請
sentences: We loved having you here. You must come and stay at our farm next summer.
You've never seen real snow? You must come and stay with us in the mountains.
When you're in Paris, you must come and stay at my flat.
Two days is far too short. You must come and stay for a whole week next time.
You love fishing, don't you? You must come and stay at our cottage by the lake.
Our new house has four bedrooms. You must all come and stay at Christmas.
We bought the house next to the river. You must come and see it!
We've just got a little brown puppy. You must come and see him.
I planted two hundred tulips last autumn. You must come and see my garden in the spring.
Our new flat is on the tenth floor. You must come and see the view from our balcony.
Lucy is three months old now. You must come and see her before she grows up!
I'm the king in the school play. You must come and see it on Friday.
I'm turning sixteen on Saturday. You must come to my birthday party.
We're driving to the coast next weekend. You must come to the beach with us.
You've helped us so much with the move. You must come to dinner one evening.
We're getting married in June. You must come to our wedding.
You must come to the summer festival. It's the best weekend of the year in our town.
I've practised for months. You must come to my concert. I'm playing the violin.
It's so nice to meet you at last. You must come and have lunch with us one day.
We need a fourth player. You must come and play tennis with us on Sunday.
My parents keep asking about you. You must come and meet my family.
My dad is a chef. You must come and try his cooking.
We've got a huge new TV. You must come and watch the final at our house.
You like dogs, right? You must come and walk them with me in the park.
It was lovely to see you. You must visit us again soon.
The forest is green now. You must come back in the autumn when the leaves change colour.
The streets are full of flowers in May. You must visit our town during the flower festival.
My son really liked your daughter. You must come back and bring her next time.
You must visit us when you're next in Scotland.
You only had one pancake! You must come back for my mum's famous pancakes.
We live on a small island near Athens. You must visit us when the weather is warmer.

examples.heading: ① You must come and stay + 地方：邀請來住

items.en: We loved having you here. You must come and stay at our farm next summer.
items.zh: 很高興你來我們這裡。明年夏天你一定要來我們的農場住。

items.en: You've never seen real snow? You must come and stay with us in the mountains.
items.zh: 你從來沒看過真的雪？你一定要來山上跟我們一起住。

items.en: When you're in Paris, you must come and stay at my flat.
items.zh: 你來巴黎的時候，一定要來我的公寓住。

items.en: Two days is far too short. You must come and stay for a whole week next time.
items.zh: 兩天太短了。下次你一定要來住一整個星期。

items.en: You love fishing, don't you? You must come and stay at our cottage by the lake.
items.zh: 你很喜歡釣魚，對吧？你一定要來我們湖邊的小屋住。

items.en: Our new house has four bedrooms. You must all come and stay at Christmas.
items.zh: 我們的新房子有四個房間。聖誕節你們全家一定要來住。

examples.heading: ② You must come and see + 名詞：邀請來看

items.en: We bought the house next to the river. You must come and see it!
items.zh: 我們買了河邊那棟房子。你一定要來看看！

items.en: We've just got a little brown puppy. You must come and see him.
items.zh: 我們剛養了一隻棕色小狗。你一定要來看看他。

items.en: I planted two hundred tulips last autumn. You must come and see my garden in the spring.
items.zh: 我去年秋天種了兩百株鬱金香。春天的時候你一定要來看看我的花園。

items.en: Our new flat is on the tenth floor. You must come and see the view from our balcony.
items.zh: 我們的新公寓在十樓。你一定要來看看我們陽台的風景。

items.en: Lucy is three months old now. You must come and see her before she grows up!
items.zh: Lucy 現在三個月大了。你一定要在她長大前來看看她！

items.en: I'm the king in the school play. You must come and see it on Friday.
items.zh: 我在學校的話劇裡演國王。星期五你一定要來看。

examples.heading: ③ You must come to + 地方或活動

items.en: I'm turning sixteen on Saturday. You must come to my birthday party.
items.zh: 我星期六滿十六歲。你一定要來我的生日派對。

items.en: We're driving to the coast next weekend. You must come to the beach with us.
items.zh: 我們下個週末要開車去海邊。你一定要跟我們去海灘。

items.en: You've helped us so much with the move. You must come to dinner one evening.
items.zh: 你幫了我們搬家這麼多忙。你哪天晚上一定要來吃晚餐。

items.en: We're getting married in June. You must come to our wedding.
items.zh: 我們六月要結婚了。你一定要來我們的婚禮。

items.en: You must come to the summer festival. It's the best weekend of the year in our town.
items.zh: 你一定要來參加夏日節慶。那是我們鎮上一年中最棒的週末。

items.en: I've practised for months. You must come to my concert. I'm playing the violin.
items.zh: 我練習好幾個月了。你一定要來我的音樂會。我要拉小提琴。

examples.heading: ④ You must come and + 原形動詞：邀請一起做事

items.en: It's so nice to meet you at last. You must come and have lunch with us one day.
items.zh: 終於見到你了，真好。你哪天一定要來跟我們吃午餐。

items.en: We need a fourth player. You must come and play tennis with us on Sunday.
items.zh: 我們缺第四個球員。星期天你一定要來跟我們打網球。

items.en: My parents keep asking about you. You must come and meet my family.
items.zh: 我爸媽一直問起你。你一定要來認識我的家人。

items.en: My dad is a chef. You must come and try his cooking.
items.zh: 我爸爸是廚師。你一定要來嚐嚐他做的菜。

items.en: We've got a huge new TV. You must come and watch the final at our house.
items.zh: 我們買了一台很大的新電視。你一定要來我們家看決賽。

items.en: You like dogs, right? You must come and walk them with me in the park.
items.zh: 你喜歡狗，對吧？你一定要來跟我一起在公園遛狗。

examples.heading: ⑤ You must + visit / come back：邀請再來

items.en: It was lovely to see you. You must visit us again soon.
items.zh: 很高興見到你。你一定要很快再來看我們。

items.en: The forest is green now. You must come back in the autumn when the leaves change colour.
items.zh: 森林現在是綠色的。秋天葉子變色的時候，你一定要再來。

items.en: The streets are full of flowers in May. You must visit our town during the flower festival.
items.zh: 五月的街上都是花。花節的時候你一定要來我們鎮上玩。

items.en: My son really liked your daughter. You must come back and bring her next time.
items.zh: 我兒子很喜歡你女兒。下次你一定要再來，帶她一起來。

items.en: You must visit us when you're next in Scotland.
items.zh: 你下次來蘇格蘭的時候，一定要來看我們。

items.en: You only had one pancake! You must come back for my mum's famous pancakes.
items.zh: 你只吃了一片鬆餅！你一定要再來吃我媽媽有名的鬆餅。

items.en: We live on a small island near Athens. You must visit us when the weather is warmer.
items.zh: 我們住在雅典附近的一個小島上。天氣暖和一點的時候，你一定要來看我們。

title: Dear Neighbours, I would like to invite you to my home for dinner.
translation: 我想邀請你來我家吃晚餐。
name: would like to invite 表示邀請
sentences: Dear Neighbours, I've just moved into flat six. I would like to invite you to my home for dinner on Friday.
I would like to invite you to dinner at my house on Saturday at half past seven.
I would like to invite you to my birthday party next Sunday.
I would like to invite you to our school concert on the twelfth of May.
I would like to invite you to a barbecue in our garden this weekend.
I would like to invite you to the opening of my art exhibition.
We would like to invite you to our wedding on the third of June.
We would like to invite all parents to the school open day.
We would like to invite you to a short meeting on Monday afternoon.
We would like to invite you to visit our new office in London.
We would like to invite you to give a talk at our conference.
We would like to invite you to join our tennis club.
I'd like to invite you to stay with us in Scotland this summer.
I'd like to invite you to my grandparents' farm for the weekend.
I'd like to invite you to our holiday cottage by the lake.
I'd like to invite you to lunch at my favourite restaurant.
I'd like to invite you to come skiing with my family in February.
I'd like to invite you to watch the match at our house.
I would like to invite you to come to the theatre with me.
I would like to invite my classmates to celebrate the end of the exams.
I would like to invite you to have dinner with my parents.
We would like to invite you to spend Christmas with us.
I would like to invite you to try my homemade cake.
We would like to invite you to join us for a walk on Sunday.
I would like to invite you to my party. It starts at eight, and there will be music and dancing.
I would like to invite you to dinner. Please bring your partner too.
I would like to invite you to my graduation. It's at the town hall at two.
We would like to invite you to our new house. We'll send you the address.
I would like to invite you to a picnic. Please bring something to drink.
We would like to invite you to our anniversary dinner. Please reply by Friday.
I would like to invite you to my leaving party. I'll miss you all.

examples.heading: ① I would like to invite you to + 活動 + 時間：邀請參加活動

items.en: Dear Neighbours, I've just moved into flat six. I would like to invite you to my home for dinner on Friday.
items.zh: 親愛的鄰居們，我剛搬進六號公寓。我想邀請你們星期五來我家吃晚餐。

items.en: I would like to invite you to dinner at my house on Saturday at half past seven.
items.zh: 我想邀請你星期六七點半來我家吃晚餐。

items.en: I would like to invite you to my birthday party next Sunday.
items.zh: 我想邀請你參加我下星期天的生日派對。

items.en: I would like to invite you to our school concert on the twelfth of May.
items.zh: 我想邀請你參加我們五月十二日的學校音樂會。

items.en: I would like to invite you to a barbecue in our garden this weekend.
items.zh: 我想邀請你這個週末來我們花園烤肉。

items.en: I would like to invite you to the opening of my art exhibition.
items.zh: 我想邀請你參加我的畫展開幕。

examples.heading: ② We would like to invite you to + 名詞：正式的邀請

items.en: We would like to invite you to our wedding on the third of June.
items.zh: 我們想邀請您參加我們六月三日的婚禮。

items.en: We would like to invite all parents to the school open day.
items.zh: 我們想邀請所有家長參加學校的開放日。

items.en: We would like to invite you to a short meeting on Monday afternoon.
items.zh: 我們想邀請您參加星期一下午的簡短會議。

items.en: We would like to invite you to visit our new office in London.
items.zh: 我們想邀請您參觀我們在倫敦的新辦公室。

items.en: We would like to invite you to give a talk at our conference.
items.zh: 我們想邀請您在我們的研討會上演講。

items.en: We would like to invite you to join our tennis club.
items.zh: 我們想邀請您加入我們的網球俱樂部。

examples.heading: ③ I'd like to invite you to + 地方：邀請來家裡或去旅行

items.en: I'd like to invite you to stay with us in Scotland this summer.
items.zh: 我想邀請你今年夏天來蘇格蘭跟我們住。

items.en: I'd like to invite you to my grandparents' farm for the weekend.
items.zh: 我想邀請你週末去我祖父母的農場。

items.en: I'd like to invite you to our holiday cottage by the lake.
items.zh: 我想邀請你去我們湖邊的度假小屋。

items.en: I'd like to invite you to lunch at my favourite restaurant.
items.zh: 我想邀請你去我最喜歡的餐廳吃午餐。

items.en: I'd like to invite you to come skiing with my family in February.
items.zh: 我想邀請你二月跟我們家去滑雪。

items.en: I'd like to invite you to watch the match at our house.
items.zh: 我想邀請你來我們家看比賽。

examples.heading: ④ I would like to invite + 人 + to + 原形動詞：邀請一起做

items.en: I would like to invite you to come to the theatre with me.
items.zh: 我想邀請你跟我一起去看戲。

items.en: I would like to invite my classmates to celebrate the end of the exams.
items.zh: 我想邀請我的同學一起慶祝考試結束。

items.en: I would like to invite you to have dinner with my parents.
items.zh: 我想邀請你跟我爸媽一起吃晚餐。

items.en: We would like to invite you to spend Christmas with us.
items.zh: 我們想邀請你跟我們一起過聖誕節。

items.en: I would like to invite you to try my homemade cake.
items.zh: 我想邀請你嚐嚐我自己做的蛋糕。

items.en: We would like to invite you to join us for a walk on Sunday.
items.zh: 我們想邀請你星期天跟我們一起去散步。

examples.heading: ⑤ I would like to invite you …, + 細節：邀請卡的內容

items.en: I would like to invite you to my party. It starts at eight, and there will be music and dancing.
items.zh: 我想邀請你參加我的派對。八點開始，會有音樂和跳舞。

items.en: I would like to invite you to dinner. Please bring your partner too.
items.zh: 我想邀請你來吃晚餐。請也帶你的另一半來。

items.en: I would like to invite you to my graduation. It's at the town hall at two.
items.zh: 我想邀請你參加我的畢業典禮。兩點在市政廳。

items.en: We would like to invite you to our new house. We'll send you the address.
items.zh: 我們想邀請你來我們的新家。我們會把地址寄給你。

items.en: I would like to invite you to a picnic. Please bring something to drink.
items.zh: 我想邀請你去野餐。請帶點喝的來。

items.en: We would like to invite you to our anniversary dinner. Please reply by Friday.
items.zh: 我們想邀請您參加我們的週年晚宴。請在星期五前回覆。

items.en: I would like to invite you to my leaving party. I'll miss you all.
items.zh: 我想邀請你們參加我的歡送會。我會想念你們大家。

title: You've just had a big lunch. You ought not to be hungry.
translation: 你應該不會餓才對。
name: ought to 表示很可能
sentences: You had a huge plate of pasta an hour ago. You ought not to be hungry.
The test ought not to be difficult. We've practised a lot.
Let's drive to the coast early. The roads ought not to be busy on a Sunday morning.
It ought not to rain today. The sky is clear.
It's only a small crack in the screen. The repair ought not to cost much.
She had a big feed at ten. The baby ought not to wake up before six.
Accounting software records daily business. Besides, it ought to provide useful information for making decisions.
We've bought a new packing machine for the factory. It ought to make the work much faster.
The manager wants to close two small offices. These changes ought to save the company money.
The buses will now come every eight minutes. The new timetable ought to reduce waiting times.
Take two of these tablets with water. This medicine ought to help with the pain.
New staff will spend a week with an experienced colleague. The training ought to give them more confidence.
He left an hour ago, so he ought to be home by now.
The film starts at eight, so it ought to be finished by ten.
She's trained hard, so the race ought to be easy for her.
The forecast says sunshine all weekend. The weather ought to be good for the picnic.
With all this sun, the tomatoes ought to be ready soon.
It's a new car, so it ought to be reliable.
It's a big hotel, so there ought to be a restaurant.
I ordered twelve pizzas, so there ought to be plenty left over for tomorrow.
Don't worry about missing this one. There ought to be a bus every ten minutes in the city centre.
The concert has only just started. There ought to be some seats left at the back.
You need cash for the taxi? There ought to be a cash machine at the station.
You've sent all the documents, and your passport is new. There ought to be no problem with your visa.
If we leave now, we ought to arrive by lunchtime.
With her experience, she ought to get the job.
I paid for express delivery, so the new printer ought to come before Friday.
Their best player is injured. Our team ought to win easily this time.
If you follow the recipe, the cake ought to taste great.
Bruges is a small city. Two days ought to be enough to see it.
It's filled with goose feathers. This coat ought to keep you warm all winter.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + ought not to + 原形動詞：應該不會

items.en: You had a huge plate of pasta an hour ago. You ought not to be hungry.
items.zh: 你一個小時前吃了一大盤義大利麵。你應該不會餓才對。

items.en: The test ought not to be difficult. We've practised a lot.
items.zh: 考試應該不會很難。我們練習很多次了。

items.en: Let's drive to the coast early. The roads ought not to be busy on a Sunday morning.
items.zh: 我們早點開車去海邊吧。星期天早上路上應該不會很塞。

items.en: It ought not to rain today. The sky is clear.
items.zh: 今天應該不會下雨。天空很晴朗。

items.en: It's only a small crack in the screen. The repair ought not to cost much.
items.zh: 螢幕只有一道小裂痕。修理應該不會花很多錢。

items.en: She had a big feed at ten. The baby ought not to wake up before six.
items.zh: 她十點喝了很多奶。寶寶六點前應該不會醒。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + ought to + 原形動詞：產品和計畫應有的效果

items.en: Accounting software records daily business. Besides, it ought to provide useful information for making decisions.
items.zh: 會計軟體記錄日常的業務。此外，它應該能提供做決定時有用的資訊。

items.en: We've bought a new packing machine for the factory. It ought to make the work much faster.
items.zh: 我們幫工廠買了一台新的包裝機。它應該能讓工作快很多。

items.en: The manager wants to close two small offices. These changes ought to save the company money.
items.zh: 經理想關掉兩間小辦公室。這些改變應該能幫公司省錢。

items.en: The buses will now come every eight minutes. The new timetable ought to reduce waiting times.
items.zh: 公車以後每八分鐘一班。新的時刻表應該能減少等待的時間。

items.en: Take two of these tablets with water. This medicine ought to help with the pain.
items.zh: 這種藥一次吃兩顆，配水吃。它應該能減輕疼痛。

items.en: New staff will spend a week with an experienced colleague. The training ought to give them more confidence.
items.zh: 新員工會跟資深同事一起工作一個星期。這次訓練應該能讓他們更有信心。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + ought to be + 形容詞或地方：根據情況推論

items.en: He left an hour ago, so he ought to be home by now.
items.zh: 他一個小時前走的，所以他現在應該到家了。

items.en: The film starts at eight, so it ought to be finished by ten.
items.zh: 電影八點開始，所以十點前應該演完了。

items.en: She's trained hard, so the race ought to be easy for her.
items.zh: 她訓練得很努力，所以這場比賽對她來說應該很輕鬆。

items.en: The forecast says sunshine all weekend. The weather ought to be good for the picnic.
items.zh: 天氣預報說整個週末都是晴天。野餐那天天氣應該會很好。

items.en: With all this sun, the tomatoes ought to be ready soon.
items.zh: 陽光這麼充足，番茄應該很快就可以採了。

items.en: It's a new car, so it ought to be reliable.
items.zh: 這是一台新車，所以應該很可靠。

examples.heading: ④ There ought to be + 名詞：推論應該有

items.en: It's a big hotel, so there ought to be a restaurant.
items.zh: 那是一家大飯店，所以應該有餐廳。

items.en: I ordered twelve pizzas, so there ought to be plenty left over for tomorrow.
items.zh: 我訂了十二個披薩，所以明天應該還剩很多。

items.en: Don't worry about missing this one. There ought to be a bus every ten minutes in the city centre.
items.zh: 別擔心錯過這班。市中心應該每十分鐘就有一班公車。

items.en: The concert has only just started. There ought to be some seats left at the back.
items.zh: 音樂會才剛開始。後面應該還有一些位子。

items.en: You need cash for the taxi? There ought to be a cash machine at the station.
items.zh: 你需要現金搭計程車？車站應該有提款機。

items.en: You've sent all the documents, and your passport is new. There ought to be no problem with your visa.
items.zh: 你所有的文件都寄了，護照也是新的。你的簽證應該不會有問題。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + ought to + 原形動詞：預測結果

items.en: If we leave now, we ought to arrive by lunchtime.
items.zh: 如果我們現在出發，應該午餐時間前就會到。

items.en: With her experience, she ought to get the job.
items.zh: 以她的經驗，她應該能拿到那份工作。

items.en: I paid for express delivery, so the new printer ought to come before Friday.
items.zh: 我付了快遞費，所以新的印表機星期五前應該會到。

items.en: Their best player is injured. Our team ought to win easily this time.
items.zh: 他們最好的球員受傷了。我們隊這次應該能輕鬆贏。

items.en: If you follow the recipe, the cake ought to taste great.
items.zh: 如果你照著食譜做，蛋糕應該會很好吃。

items.en: Bruges is a small city. Two days ought to be enough to see it.
items.zh: 布魯日是個小城市。兩天應該夠看完。

items.en: It's filled with goose feathers. This coat ought to keep you warm all winter.
items.zh: 它裡面是鵝毛。這件外套應該能讓你整個冬天都很暖和。

title: The weather is still warm, so we should be able to visit the beaches.
translation: 應該會是很棒的一天！
name: should 表示可能發生的事
sentences: Everyone is coming to the school fair, and the forecast is sunny. It should be a good day!
The band is great live. It should be a fun concert.
The teams are very close in the league. It should be an exciting match.
The new restaurant has good reviews. It should be a nice evening.
The road is flat all the way. It should be an easy bike ride.
The guide knows the city very well. It should be an interesting tour.
In September the weather is still warm, so we should be able to visit the beaches and go sightseeing in the evenings.
The train is fast, so we should be able to get there by lunchtime.
With three of us working, we should be able to finish the painting today.
The shop opens at nine, so you should be able to buy it in the morning.
My English is better now, so I should be able to understand the film.
The hotel has a big car park, so we should be able to park easily.
The parcel was sent on Monday, so it should arrive tomorrow.
If we leave now, we should get there before dark.
The medicine should start working in about an hour.
The shop said the repairs should take about a week.
The meeting should finish at around four.
The roads should be quiet on a Sunday morning.
She left an hour ago, so she should be at the station by now.
The cake has been in the oven for forty minutes. It should be ready.
Ask Tom. He should know the answer. He studied history.
The water should be warm enough for swimming now.
The tickets should be in your email. Check your inbox.
The new manager should be here on Monday.
It's a popular route, so there should be plenty of buses.
The museum is big, so there should be a café inside.
We booked early, so there should be good seats left.
There should be enough cake for everyone if we cut small pieces.
It's a big hotel, so there should be a lift.
There should be a cash machine near the market.
After all the rain, there should be lots of mushrooms in the woods.

examples.heading: ① It should be + 形容詞或名詞：推論活動會怎樣

items.en: Everyone is coming to the school fair, and the forecast is sunny. It should be a good day!
items.zh: 大家都會來學校園遊會，天氣預報也是晴天。應該會是很棒的一天！

items.en: The band is great live. It should be a fun concert.
items.zh: 那個樂團現場很棒。應該會是一場好玩的演唱會。

items.en: The teams are very close in the league. It should be an exciting match.
items.zh: 這兩隊在聯賽裡很接近。應該會是一場刺激的比賽。

items.en: The new restaurant has good reviews. It should be a nice evening.
items.zh: 那家新餐廳評價很好。應該會是一個愉快的晚上。

items.en: The road is flat all the way. It should be an easy bike ride.
items.zh: 那條路一路都是平的。騎腳踏車應該很輕鬆。

items.en: The guide knows the city very well. It should be an interesting tour.
items.zh: 導遊對這個城市很熟。應該會是一次有趣的導覽。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + should be able to + 原形動詞：應該能夠

items.en: In September the weather is still warm, so we should be able to visit the beaches and go sightseeing in the evenings.
items.zh: 九月天氣還很暖和，所以我們白天應該可以去海灘，晚上去觀光。

items.en: The train is fast, so we should be able to get there by lunchtime.
items.zh: 火車很快，所以我們應該能在午餐前到。

items.en: With three of us working, we should be able to finish the painting today.
items.zh: 我們三個人一起做，應該今天就能漆完。

items.en: The shop opens at nine, so you should be able to buy it in the morning.
items.zh: 那家店九點開門，所以你早上應該就能買到。

items.en: My English is better now, so I should be able to understand the film.
items.zh: 我的英文現在比較好了，所以我應該看得懂那部電影。

items.en: The hotel has a big car park, so we should be able to park easily.
items.zh: 飯店有很大的停車場，所以我們應該很好停車。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + should + 原形動詞：推論時間和結果

items.en: The parcel was sent on Monday, so it should arrive tomorrow.
items.zh: 包裹星期一寄出，所以應該明天會到。

items.en: If we leave now, we should get there before dark.
items.zh: 如果我們現在出發，應該天黑前會到。

items.en: The medicine should start working in about an hour.
items.zh: 藥大約一個小時後應該會開始有效。

items.en: The shop said the repairs should take about a week.
items.zh: 那家店說修理大概要一個星期。

items.en: The meeting should finish at around four.
items.zh: 會議應該大約四點結束。

items.en: The roads should be quiet on a Sunday morning.
items.zh: 星期天早上路上應該很空。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + should be + 形容詞：推論現在的情況

items.en: She left an hour ago, so she should be at the station by now.
items.zh: 她一個小時前走的，所以現在應該到車站了。

items.en: The cake has been in the oven for forty minutes. It should be ready.
items.zh: 蛋糕在烤箱裡四十分鐘了。應該好了。

items.en: Ask Tom. He should know the answer. He studied history.
items.zh: 問湯姆。他應該知道答案。他念歷史的。

items.en: The water should be warm enough for swimming now.
items.zh: 現在水應該夠暖，可以游泳了。

items.en: The tickets should be in your email. Check your inbox.
items.zh: 票應該在你的電子郵件裡。看一下你的收件匣。

items.en: The new manager should be here on Monday.
items.zh: 新經理星期一應該會到。

examples.heading: ⑤ There should be + 名詞：推論應該有

items.en: It's a popular route, so there should be plenty of buses.
items.zh: 那是熱門路線，所以應該有很多班公車。

items.en: The museum is big, so there should be a café inside.
items.zh: 博物館很大，所以裡面應該有咖啡館。

items.en: We booked early, so there should be good seats left.
items.zh: 我們很早就訂了，所以應該還有好位子。

items.en: There should be enough cake for everyone if we cut small pieces.
items.zh: 如果切小塊一點，蛋糕應該夠每個人吃。

items.en: It's a big hotel, so there should be a lift.
items.zh: 那是一家大飯店，所以應該有電梯。

items.en: There should be a cash machine near the market.
items.zh: 市場附近應該有提款機。

items.en: After all the rain, there should be lots of mushrooms in the woods.
items.zh: 下了那麼多雨，樹林裡應該有很多蘑菇。

title: You should have seen my face. I was so happy.
translation: 你真該聽聽那個聲音。
name: 敘事中的 you should have 加過去分詞
sentences: When I opened the door, everyone shouted "Surprise!" You should have seen my face. I was so happy.
We went to the top of the tower. You should have seen the view!
You should have seen the size of the waves at the beach yesterday.
The kitchen was a disaster after the party. You should have seen the mess.
You should have seen Dad's face when he opened the bill.
You should have seen the crowd at the final. There were thousands of people.
The storm broke a tree in our garden. You should have heard the noise.
You should have heard the crowd when our team scored.
You should have heard my grandmother singing at the wedding.
The baby screamed all night. You should have heard her!
You should have heard the jokes he told at dinner.
You should have heard the band. They were brilliant.
You should have seen how big the fish was. It was nearly a metre long.
You should have seen what the children did to the living room.
You should have seen how fast she ran in the last lap.
You should have seen how much food there was at the party.
You should have seen what he was wearing. A pink suit!
You should have seen how high the dog jumped.
You should have heard what the teacher said when she saw the broken window.
You should have heard how loudly he snored.
You should have heard what my little brother told the doctor.
You should have heard how angry the customer was.
You should have heard what the waiter said about the soup.
You should have heard how well she played the violin.
You should have been there when the bride fell into the pool!
You should have tasted the cake my aunt made. It was delicious.
You should have felt how cold the water was.
You should have smelt the bread in that little bakery.
You should have been on the boat when the dolphins came.
You should have tasted the street food in Bangkok.
You should have been at the airport when my sister came home.

examples.heading: ① You should have seen + 名詞：強調看到的東西

items.en: When I opened the door, everyone shouted "Surprise!" You should have seen my face. I was so happy.
items.zh: 我開門的時候，大家都大喊驚喜！你真該看看我當時的表情。我高興極了。

items.en: We went to the top of the tower. You should have seen the view!
items.zh: 我們上了塔頂。你真該看看那裡的風景！

items.en: You should have seen the size of the waves at the beach yesterday.
items.zh: 你真該看看昨天海灘上的浪有多大。

items.en: The kitchen was a disaster after the party. You should have seen the mess.
items.zh: 派對後廚房一團糟。你真該看看那個亂樣。

items.en: You should have seen Dad's face when he opened the bill.
items.zh: 你真該看看爸爸打開帳單時的表情。

items.en: You should have seen the crowd at the final. There were thousands of people.
items.zh: 你真該看看決賽的人潮。有好幾千人。

examples.heading: ② You should have heard + 名詞：強調聽到的聲音

items.en: The storm broke a tree in our garden. You should have heard the noise.
items.zh: 暴風雨把我們花園的一棵樹吹斷了。你真該聽聽那個聲音。

items.en: You should have heard the crowd when our team scored.
items.zh: 我們隊進球的時候，你真該聽聽觀眾的聲音。

items.en: You should have heard my grandmother singing at the wedding.
items.zh: 你真該聽聽我奶奶在婚禮上唱歌。

items.en: The baby screamed all night. You should have heard her!
items.zh: 寶寶哭了一整晚。你真該聽聽她哭的聲音！

items.en: You should have heard the jokes he told at dinner.
items.zh: 你真該聽聽他吃晚餐時說的笑話。

items.en: You should have heard the band. They were brilliant.
items.zh: 你真該聽聽那個樂團。他們太棒了。

examples.heading: ③ You should have seen + how / what + 子句

items.en: You should have seen how big the fish was. It was nearly a metre long.
items.zh: 你真該看看那條魚有多大。快一公尺長了。

items.en: You should have seen what the children did to the living room.
items.zh: 你真該看看孩子們把客廳弄成什麼樣子。

items.en: You should have seen how fast she ran in the last lap.
items.zh: 你真該看看她最後一圈跑得多快。

items.en: You should have seen how much food there was at the party.
items.zh: 你真該看看派對上有多少食物。

items.en: You should have seen what he was wearing. A pink suit!
items.zh: 你真該看看他穿什麼。一套粉紅色的西裝！

items.en: You should have seen how high the dog jumped.
items.zh: 你真該看看那隻狗跳得多高。

examples.heading: ④ You should have heard + what / how + 子句

items.en: You should have heard what the teacher said when she saw the broken window.
items.zh: 你真該聽聽老師看到破窗戶時說了什麼。

items.en: You should have heard how loudly he snored.
items.zh: 你真該聽聽他打呼有多大聲。

items.en: You should have heard what my little brother told the doctor.
items.zh: 你真該聽聽我弟弟跟醫生說了什麼。

items.en: You should have heard how angry the customer was.
items.zh: 你真該聽聽那個顧客有多生氣。

items.en: You should have heard what the waiter said about the soup.
items.zh: 你真該聽聽服務生怎麼說那道湯。

items.en: You should have heard how well she played the violin.
items.zh: 你真該聽聽她小提琴拉得多好。

examples.heading: ⑤ You should have been there / tasted / felt …：其他強調

items.en: You should have been there when the bride fell into the pool!
items.zh: 新娘掉進游泳池的時候，你真該在場！

items.en: You should have tasted the cake my aunt made. It was delicious.
items.zh: 你真該嚐嚐我阿姨做的蛋糕。太好吃了。

items.en: You should have felt how cold the water was.
items.zh: 你真該感受一下水有多冰。

items.en: You should have smelt the bread in that little bakery.
items.zh: 你真該聞聞那家小麵包店的麵包香。

items.en: You should have been on the boat when the dolphins came.
items.zh: 海豚來的時候，你真該在船上。

items.en: You should have tasted the street food in Bangkok.
items.zh: 你真該嚐嚐曼谷的街頭小吃。

items.en: You should have been at the airport when my sister came home.
items.zh: 我姊姊回家的時候，你真該在機場。

title: When I was a child, I used to go to a small school and I enjoyed it very much.
translation: 我小時候念的是一所規模很小的學校。
name: used to 表示過去的習慣或狀態
sentences: When I was a child, I used to go to a small village school, and I enjoyed it very much.
When I was a child, I used to spend every summer at my grandparents' farm.
When I was a child, I used to climb the big tree in our garden.
When I was a child, I used to believe that the moon followed our car.
When I was a child, I used to hide under the bed during storms.
When I was a child, I used to draw pictures on the walls.
My best friend used to come to my house and play computer games with me every Saturday.
My uncle used to visit us every Christmas with a bag full of presents.
Our neighbour used to bring us fresh eggs from her chickens.
My grandmother used to stay with us for a month every summer.
The postman used to stop and chat with my mother.
My cousins used to come over every Sunday for lunch.
I didn't use to laugh much, but since the day we met, I'm always happy.
I didn't use to sleep well, but since I started yoga, I sleep like a baby.
She didn't use to go out much, but since she got a dog, she walks every day.
We didn't use to eat together, but since Dad changed jobs, we have dinner as a family.
He didn't use to like school, but since he joined the band, he loves it.
I didn't use to cook, but since I moved out, I cook every night.
My mother used to work as a nurse before I was born.
People used to wash their clothes by hand in the river.
My grandfather used to walk five miles to work every day.
Children used to leave school at fourteen.
We used to keep chickens in the back garden.
My parents used to run a small hotel by the sea.
I used to go swimming three times a week.
We used to visit the seaside every August.
She used to phone her mother every evening at seven.
He used to play tennis twice a week with his brother.
They used to have a party every New Year's Eve.
I used to read a book a week when I was at school.
My dad used to take us fishing every Sunday morning.

examples.heading: ① When I was a child, I used to + 原形動詞：童年的回憶

items.en: When I was a child, I used to go to a small village school, and I enjoyed it very much.
items.zh: 我小時候念一所鄉下的小學校，而且我非常喜歡。

items.en: When I was a child, I used to spend every summer at my grandparents' farm.
items.zh: 我小時候每年夏天都在我祖父母的農場過。

items.en: When I was a child, I used to climb the big tree in our garden.
items.zh: 我小時候常常爬我們花園裡那棵大樹。

items.en: When I was a child, I used to believe that the moon followed our car.
items.zh: 我小時候以為月亮會跟著我們的車子走。

items.en: When I was a child, I used to hide under the bed during storms.
items.zh: 我小時候暴風雨的時候都躲在床底下。

items.en: When I was a child, I used to draw pictures on the walls.
items.zh: 我小時候常在牆上畫畫。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + used to + come / visit + …：以前常來往的人

items.en: My best friend used to come to my house and play computer games with me every Saturday.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友以前每個星期六都來我家跟我打電動。

items.en: My uncle used to visit us every Christmas with a bag full of presents.
items.zh: 我叔叔以前每年聖誕節都帶著一袋禮物來看我們。

items.en: Our neighbour used to bring us fresh eggs from her chickens.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居以前會帶她的雞生的新鮮雞蛋給我們。

items.en: My grandmother used to stay with us for a month every summer.
items.zh: 我奶奶以前每年夏天都來我們家住一個月。

items.en: The postman used to stop and chat with my mother.
items.zh: 郵差以前會停下來跟我媽媽聊天。

items.en: My cousins used to come over every Sunday for lunch.
items.zh: 我的表親以前每個星期天都來吃午餐。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + didn't use to + 原形動詞, but since + 子句：自從某時改變了

items.en: I didn't use to laugh much, but since the day we met, I'm always happy.
items.zh: 我以前不太笑，可是自從我們認識那天起，我總是很快樂。

items.en: I didn't use to sleep well, but since I started yoga, I sleep like a baby.
items.zh: 我以前睡不好，可是自從我開始做瑜伽，我睡得像嬰兒一樣。

items.en: She didn't use to go out much, but since she got a dog, she walks every day.
items.zh: 她以前不常出門，可是自從她養了狗，她每天都去散步。

items.en: We didn't use to eat together, but since Dad changed jobs, we have dinner as a family.
items.zh: 我們以前不一起吃飯，可是自從爸爸換了工作，我們全家一起吃晚餐。

items.en: He didn't use to like school, but since he joined the band, he loves it.
items.zh: 他以前不喜歡學校，可是自從他加入樂團，他很喜歡。

items.en: I didn't use to cook, but since I moved out, I cook every night.
items.zh: 我以前不煮飯，可是自從我搬出來住，我每天晚上都煮飯。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + used to + 原形動詞：過去的工作和生活

items.en: My mother used to work as a nurse before I was born.
items.zh: 我媽媽在我出生前是護理師。

items.en: People used to wash their clothes by hand in the river.
items.zh: 人們以前在河裡手洗衣服。

items.en: My grandfather used to walk five miles to work every day.
items.zh: 我爺爺以前每天走五英里去上班。

items.en: Children used to leave school at fourteen.
items.zh: 孩子們以前十四歲就離開學校了。

items.en: We used to keep chickens in the back garden.
items.zh: 我們以前在後院養雞。

items.en: My parents used to run a small hotel by the sea.
items.zh: 我爸媽以前在海邊經營一家小旅館。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + used to + 原形動詞 + 頻率：以前多常做

items.en: I used to go swimming three times a week.
items.zh: 我以前一個星期去游泳三次。

items.en: We used to visit the seaside every August.
items.zh: 我們以前每年八月都去海邊。

items.en: She used to phone her mother every evening at seven.
items.zh: 她以前每天傍晚七點都打電話給她媽媽。

items.en: He used to play tennis twice a week with his brother.
items.zh: 他以前一個星期跟他哥哥打兩次網球。

items.en: They used to have a party every New Year's Eve.
items.zh: 他們以前每年除夕夜都辦派對。

items.en: I used to read a book a week when I was at school.
items.zh: 我上學的時候以前一個星期讀一本書。

items.en: My dad used to take us fishing every Sunday morning.
items.zh: 我爸爸以前每個星期天早上都帶我們去釣魚。

title: You have to bring your swimming costume.
translation: 你一定要帶泳衣。
name: have (got) to 表示義務
sentences: You have to wear a helmet when you ride a motorbike.
In this library you have to leave your bag at the entrance.
Drivers have to stop when the light is red.
All visitors have to sign in at reception.
At my school we have to switch off our phones in class.
You have to be eighteen to vote in this country.
Students have to hand in their essays by Friday.
The concert starts at midnight, but we have to go earlier because we've got to buy our tickets.
I can't come out tonight because I have to study for my exam.
She can't go to the party because she has to babysit her brother.
We have to leave now because the last bus is at eleven.
I have to go home early because my grandparents are visiting.
He has to wear glasses because he can't see the board.
My mum has to start work at seven every morning.
The goalkeeper has to wear a different shirt.
My brother has to do the washing-up every night.
Our teacher has to write a report on every student.
Lucy has to take her medicine three times a day.
Everyone in the team has to train twice a week.
Hurry up! We've got to be at the station in ten minutes.
I've got to return these books to the library today.
You've got to show your ticket at the gate.
She's got to be at the dentist's at three.
We've got to clean the house before our guests arrive.
He's got to give a talk in front of the whole school.
We had to show our passports twice at the airport.
When I was at school, we had to stand up when the teacher came in.
The match was cancelled, so we had to go home.
You'll have to fill in this form first.
From next month, all staff will have to wear a name badge.
If you miss the bus, you'll have to walk.

examples.heading: ① have to：規定要求的事

items.en: You have to wear a helmet when you ride a motorbike.
items.zh: 騎機車必須戴安全帽。

items.en: In this library you have to leave your bag at the entrance.
items.zh: 在這間圖書館，你必須把包包放在入口。

items.en: Drivers have to stop when the light is red.
items.zh: 紅燈時駕駛必須停車。

items.en: All visitors have to sign in at reception.
items.zh: 所有訪客都必須在櫃台登記。

items.en: At my school we have to switch off our phones in class.
items.zh: 在我們學校，上課時必須關手機。

items.en: You have to be eighteen to vote in this country.
items.zh: 在這個國家必須滿十八歲才能投票。

items.en: Students have to hand in their essays by Friday.
items.zh: 學生必須在星期五前交作文。

examples.heading: ② have to + because：說理由

items.en: The concert starts at midnight, but we have to go earlier because we've got to buy our tickets.
items.zh: 音樂會半夜才開始，可是我們必須早點去，因為我們必須買票。

items.en: I can't come out tonight because I have to study for my exam.
items.zh: 我今天晚上不能出去，因為我必須準備考試。

items.en: She can't go to the party because she has to babysit her brother.
items.zh: 她不能去派對，因為她必須照顧她弟弟。

items.en: We have to leave now because the last bus is at eleven.
items.zh: 我們必須現在走，因為最後一班公車是十一點。

items.en: I have to go home early because my grandparents are visiting.
items.zh: 我必須早點回家，因為我的祖父母要來。

items.en: He has to wear glasses because he can't see the board.
items.zh: 他必須戴眼鏡，因為他看不清楚黑板。

examples.heading: ③ has to：別人的義務

items.en: My mum has to start work at seven every morning.
items.zh: 我媽媽每天早上必須七點開始上班。

items.en: The goalkeeper has to wear a different shirt.
items.zh: 守門員必須穿不一樣的球衣。

items.en: My brother has to do the washing-up every night.
items.zh: 我哥哥每天晚上必須洗碗。

items.en: Our teacher has to write a report on every student.
items.zh: 我們老師必須為每個學生寫報告。

items.en: Lucy has to take her medicine three times a day.
items.zh: 露西一天必須吃三次藥。

items.en: Everyone in the team has to train twice a week.
items.zh: 隊上每個人每星期必須訓練兩次。

examples.heading: ④ have got to：口語的義務

items.en: Hurry up! We've got to be at the station in ten minutes.
items.zh: 快一點！我們必須十分鐘內到車站。

items.en: I've got to return these books to the library today.
items.zh: 我今天必須把這些書還給圖書館。

items.en: You've got to show your ticket at the gate.
items.zh: 你必須在門口出示門票。

items.en: She's got to be at the dentist's at three.
items.zh: 她三點必須到牙醫診所。

items.en: We've got to clean the house before our guests arrive.
items.zh: 客人來之前我們必須打掃房子。

items.en: He's got to give a talk in front of the whole school.
items.zh: 他必須在全校面前演講。

examples.heading: ⑤ had to / will have to：過去和未來的義務

items.en: We had to show our passports twice at the airport.
items.zh: 我們在機場必須出示兩次護照。

items.en: When I was at school, we had to stand up when the teacher came in.
items.zh: 我上學的時候，老師進教室我們必須站起來。

items.en: The match was cancelled, so we had to go home.
items.zh: 比賽取消了，所以我們只好回家。

items.en: You'll have to fill in this form first.
items.zh: 你必須先填這張表格。

items.en: From next month, all staff will have to wear a name badge.
items.zh: 從下個月起，所有員工都必須戴名牌。

items.en: If you miss the bus, you'll have to walk.
items.zh: 如果你錯過公車，你必須走路。

title: Nowadays, one has to have finished at least senior high school for any employer to consider hiring you.
translation: 現在，你至少要高中畢業，雇主才會考慮用你。
name: have to 完成式表示過去的義務
sentences: To work at the bank, you have to have finished a business degree.
These days you have to have done an internship to get a good job.
To work as a nurse here, you have to have trained for three years.
Teachers have to have passed a special exam before they can work in state schools.
Pilots have to have flown a thousand hours before they can fly passengers.
Applicants have to have lived in the city for at least a year.
Staff have to have completed the safety training before they use the machines.
To vote in the club elections, members have to have paid their fees.
To become a citizen, you have to have lived in the country for ten years.
Children have to have had all their injections before they start school.
Players have to have rested for two days after a head injury.
Your passport has to have been issued in the last ten years.
To take the course, students have to have studied maths at school.
In my grandfather's time, you had to have served in the army to get a government job.
Before 1990, women had to have married to get a loan from this bank.
To get into the old university, students had to have learned Latin.
Back then, you had to have worked for the company for twenty years to get a pension.
In the past, doctors had to have studied for seven years.
To join the club in those days, you had to have been born in the town.
To get into a state university, you usually had to have been studying in a public school.
To get the grant, you had to have been living in the area for three years.
To join the team, players had to have been training with the club since childhood.
To apply for the job, you had to have been teaching for at least five years.
To get a free ticket, you had to have been waiting in the queue since the morning.
To get a place in the home, you had to have been paying into the fund for years.
From next year, all drivers will have to have taken a first aid course.
New teachers will have to have spent a year in a school before they qualify.
By 2030, builders will have to have put solar panels on every new house.
Students will have to have read the book before the first class.
All workers will have to have learned basic computer skills by the end of the year.
Visitors will have to have booked their tickets online.

examples.heading: ① has / have to have + 過去分詞：現在找工作的條件

items.en: To work at the bank, you have to have finished a business degree.
items.zh: 要在那家銀行工作，你必須念完商學學位。

items.en: These days you have to have done an internship to get a good job.
items.zh: 現在你必須實習過，才找得到好工作。

items.en: To work as a nurse here, you have to have trained for three years.
items.zh: 要在這裡當護理師，你必須受過三年訓練。

items.en: Teachers have to have passed a special exam before they can work in state schools.
items.zh: 老師必須通過一項特別的考試，才能在公立學校工作。

items.en: Pilots have to have flown a thousand hours before they can fly passengers.
items.zh: 飛行員必須飛滿一千個小時，才能載乘客。

items.en: Applicants have to have lived in the city for at least a year.
items.zh: 申請人必須已經在這個城市住滿至少一年。

items.en: Staff have to have completed the safety training before they use the machines.
items.zh: 員工必須完成安全訓練才能使用機器。

examples.heading: ② has / have to have + 過去分詞：現在其他的規定

items.en: To vote in the club elections, members have to have paid their fees.
items.zh: 要在社團選舉投票，會員必須已經繳了會費。

items.en: To become a citizen, you have to have lived in the country for ten years.
items.zh: 要成為公民，你必須已經在這個國家住滿十年。

items.en: Children have to have had all their injections before they start school.
items.zh: 孩子入學前必須打完所有的預防針。

items.en: Players have to have rested for two days after a head injury.
items.zh: 頭部受傷後，球員必須休息兩天。

items.en: Your passport has to have been issued in the last ten years.
items.zh: 你的護照必須是最近十年內核發的。（被動）

items.en: To take the course, students have to have studied maths at school.
items.zh: 要修這門課，學生必須在中學學過數學。

examples.heading: ③ had to have + 過去分詞：過去的規定

items.en: In my grandfather's time, you had to have served in the army to get a government job.
items.zh: 在我爺爺的年代，你必須服過兵役才能找到政府的工作。

items.en: Before 1990, women had to have married to get a loan from this bank.
items.zh: 1990 年以前，女性必須已婚才能向這家銀行貸款。

items.en: To get into the old university, students had to have learned Latin.
items.zh: 要進那所古老的大學，學生必須學過拉丁文。

items.en: Back then, you had to have worked for the company for twenty years to get a pension.
items.zh: 那時候，你必須在公司工作滿二十年才能領退休金。

items.en: In the past, doctors had to have studied for seven years.
items.zh: 以前醫生必須讀七年書。

items.en: To join the club in those days, you had to have been born in the town.
items.zh: 那個年代要加入這個俱樂部，你必須是在這個鎮上出生的。（被動）

examples.heading: ④ had to have been + -ing：過去要求持續的事

items.en: To get into a state university, you usually had to have been studying in a public school.
items.zh: 要進州立大學，你通常必須一直在公立學校就讀。

items.en: To get the grant, you had to have been living in the area for three years.
items.zh: 要拿到補助，你必須已經在這個地區住了三年。

items.en: To join the team, players had to have been training with the club since childhood.
items.zh: 要加入這支球隊，球員必須從小就在俱樂部訓練。

items.en: To apply for the job, you had to have been teaching for at least five years.
items.zh: 要應徵這份工作，你必須已經教了至少五年書。

items.en: To get a free ticket, you had to have been waiting in the queue since the morning.
items.zh: 要拿到免費的票，你必須從早上就在排隊。

items.en: To get a place in the home, you had to have been paying into the fund for years.
items.zh: 要在那家養老院得到床位，你必須已經繳了好幾年的基金。

examples.heading: ⑤ will have to have + 過去分詞：未來的規定

items.en: From next year, all drivers will have to have taken a first aid course.
items.zh: 從明年起，所有駕駛都必須上過急救課程。

items.en: New teachers will have to have spent a year in a school before they qualify.
items.zh: 新老師取得資格之前，必須已經在學校待過一年。

items.en: By 2030, builders will have to have put solar panels on every new house.
items.zh: 到了 2030 年，建商必須已經在每間新房子裝好太陽能板。

items.en: Students will have to have read the book before the first class.
items.zh: 學生必須在第一堂課之前讀完這本書。

items.en: All workers will have to have learned basic computer skills by the end of the year.
items.zh: 所有工人到年底都必須學會基本的電腦技能。

items.en: Visitors will have to have booked their tickets online.
items.zh: 參觀者必須已經在網路上訂好門票。

title: If a driver has drunk too much or is tired, he shouldn't be driving.
translation: 駕駛如果喝了太多酒或很疲倦，就不應該開車。
name: should be 加動詞-ing 表示義務
sentences: If a car driver has drunk too much or is tired, he shouldn't be driving.
If you have a high temperature, you shouldn't be going to work.
If the sea is rough, small boats shouldn't be going out.
If you're taking this medicine, you shouldn't be drinking alcohol.
If the ice is thin, nobody should be skating on the lake.
If a player is injured, he shouldn't be playing in the match.
Wild animals should be running free, but I think zoos today have an important role in keeping them alive.
Children should be playing outside, but many of them stay indoors all day.
Teenagers should be sleeping nine hours a night, but most get only six.
Doctors should be spending more time with patients, but they're too busy.
Old people should be living near their families, but many live alone.
Students should be reading more books, but they spend hours online.
Children under twelve shouldn't be working in factories.
People shouldn't be sleeping on the streets in a rich country.
Families shouldn't be paying so much for basic food.
Nurses shouldn't be working twelve-hour shifts every day.
Factories shouldn't be pouring waste into the river.
Pets shouldn't be living in tiny flats all day.
Every school should be teaching children how to stay safe online.
Parents should be reading to their children every evening.
Companies should be paying their workers a fair wage.
We should all be doing more to protect the environment.
Cities should be planting more trees along their streets.
Governments should be helping people find homes.
You shouldn't be texting while you're crossing the road.
Students shouldn't be eating while the teacher is talking.
Drivers shouldn't be eating while the car is moving.
You shouldn't be watching TV while you're doing your homework.
Workers shouldn't be using their phones while they're operating machines.
You shouldn't be swimming while there's lightning.
People shouldn't be smoking while children are in the car.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + shouldn't be + -ing + if + 子句：某種情況下不應該做

items.en: If a car driver has drunk too much or is tired, he shouldn't be driving.
items.zh: 如果一個駕駛喝太多酒或很累，他就不應該開車。

items.en: If you have a high temperature, you shouldn't be going to work.
items.zh: 如果你發高燒，你就不應該去上班。

items.en: If the sea is rough, small boats shouldn't be going out.
items.zh: 如果海浪很大，小船就不應該出海。

items.en: If you're taking this medicine, you shouldn't be drinking alcohol.
items.zh: 如果你在吃這種藥，你就不應該喝酒。

items.en: If the ice is thin, nobody should be skating on the lake.
items.zh: 如果冰很薄，就不應該有人在湖上溜冰。

items.en: If a player is injured, he shouldn't be playing in the match.
items.zh: 如果一個球員受傷了，他就不應該上場比賽。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + should be + -ing, but + 句子：理想和現實

items.en: Wild animals should be running free, but I think zoos today have an important role in keeping them alive.
items.zh: 野生動物應該自由地奔跑，可是我認為現在的動物園在保護牠們的生命上有重要的角色。

items.en: Children should be playing outside, but many of them stay indoors all day.
items.zh: 孩子們應該在外面玩，可是很多孩子整天待在室內。

items.en: Teenagers should be sleeping nine hours a night, but most get only six.
items.zh: 青少年每晚應該睡九個小時，可是大部分的人只睡六個小時。

items.en: Doctors should be spending more time with patients, but they're too busy.
items.zh: 醫生應該花更多時間陪病人，可是他們太忙了。

items.en: Old people should be living near their families, but many live alone.
items.zh: 老人應該住在家人附近，可是很多人一個人住。

items.en: Students should be reading more books, but they spend hours online.
items.zh: 學生應該多讀書，可是他們花好幾個小時上網。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + shouldn't be + -ing：一般不應該發生的事

items.en: Children under twelve shouldn't be working in factories.
items.zh: 十二歲以下的孩子不應該在工廠工作。

items.en: People shouldn't be sleeping on the streets in a rich country.
items.zh: 在一個富裕的國家，不應該有人睡在街上。

items.en: Families shouldn't be paying so much for basic food.
items.zh: 家庭不應該為基本的食物付那麼多錢。

items.en: Nurses shouldn't be working twelve-hour shifts every day.
items.zh: 護理師不應該每天上十二個小時的班。

items.en: Factories shouldn't be pouring waste into the river.
items.zh: 工廠不應該把廢水倒進河裡。

items.en: Pets shouldn't be living in tiny flats all day.
items.zh: 寵物不應該整天住在很小的公寓裡。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + should be + -ing：一般應該做的事

items.en: Every school should be teaching children how to stay safe online.
items.zh: 每所學校都應該教孩子怎麼安全上網。

items.en: Parents should be reading to their children every evening.
items.zh: 父母應該每天晚上唸書給孩子聽。

items.en: Companies should be paying their workers a fair wage.
items.zh: 公司應該付給員工公平的薪水。

items.en: We should all be doing more to protect the environment.
items.zh: 我們大家都應該為保護環境多做一點。

items.en: Cities should be planting more trees along their streets.
items.zh: 城市應該在街道兩旁種更多樹。

items.en: Governments should be helping people find homes.
items.zh: 政府應該幫助人們找到住處。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + shouldn't be + -ing + while + 子句

items.en: You shouldn't be texting while you're crossing the road.
items.zh: 你過馬路的時候不應該傳訊息。

items.en: Students shouldn't be eating while the teacher is talking.
items.zh: 老師說話的時候，學生不應該吃東西。

items.en: Drivers shouldn't be eating while the car is moving.
items.zh: 車子在開的時候，駕駛不應該吃東西。

items.en: You shouldn't be watching TV while you're doing your homework.
items.zh: 你寫功課的時候不應該看電視。

items.en: Workers shouldn't be using their phones while they're operating machines.
items.zh: 操作機器的時候，工人不應該用手機。

items.en: You shouldn't be swimming while there's lightning.
items.zh: 打雷閃電的時候，你不應該游泳。

items.en: People shouldn't be smoking while children are in the car.
items.zh: 孩子在車裡的時候，大人不應該抽菸。

title: I will be at school, so you must arrive at 3 pm.
translation: 我絕對不能遲到。
name: must 表示義務和必要（I、you）
sentences: The house is hard to find, so you must call me from the bus stop.
You must wait for me at the station entrance.
You must ring the bell twice. It's very quiet.
You must take the number nine bus to my house.
You must bring warm clothes. It's cold at night.
You must text me when you get on the train.
My phone is very important to me because I must call my parents every day.
I must finish this book before I go back to the library.
I must practise the piano every day.
I must write to my grandma. She sent me a lovely letter.
I must get some exercise. I sit at a desk all day.
I must save money for my holiday.
The interview is at nine. I mustn't be late.
I mustn't forget my sister's birthday this year.
I mustn't spend too much money this month.
I mustn't drink coffee after six or I won't sleep.
I mustn't lose my temper with the children.
I mustn't leave my homework until Sunday night.
We're going to the beach. You mustn't forget your swimsuit.
You mustn't show Dad the photos until his birthday party.
You mustn't eat too many sweets before dinner.
You mustn't go into the forest alone.
You mustn't be sad. We'll see each other again soon.
You mustn't worry about the cost. It's my treat.
I must get up at six tomorrow, so I'm going to bed now.
I must catch the early train, so I can't stay for dessert.
You must be at the airport by eight, so leave home at six.
I must study tonight, so I can't come to the cinema.
You must keep the receipt, so put it in your wallet.
I must finish this report today, so please don't call me.
You must rest your leg, so stay on the sofa.

examples.heading: ① You must + 原形動詞：安排和叮嚀

items.en: The house is hard to find, so you must call me from the bus stop.
items.zh: 那間房子很難找，所以你一定要在公車站打電話給我。

items.en: You must wait for me at the station entrance.
items.zh: 你一定要在車站入口等我。

items.en: You must ring the bell twice. It's very quiet.
items.zh: 你一定要按兩次門鈴。它很小聲。

items.en: You must take the number nine bus to my house.
items.zh: 你一定要搭九號公車到我家。

items.en: You must bring warm clothes. It's cold at night.
items.zh: 你一定要帶保暖的衣服。晚上很冷。

items.en: You must text me when you get on the train.
items.zh: 你上火車的時候一定要傳訊息給我。

examples.heading: ② I must + 原形動詞：自己覺得必須做

items.en: My phone is very important to me because I must call my parents every day.
items.zh: 我的手機對我很重要，因為我必須每天打電話給我爸媽。

items.en: I must finish this book before I go back to the library.
items.zh: 我回圖書館之前必須讀完這本書。

items.en: I must practise the piano every day.
items.zh: 我必須每天練鋼琴。

items.en: I must write to my grandma. She sent me a lovely letter.
items.zh: 我必須寫信給我奶奶。她寄給我一封很棒的信。

items.en: I must get some exercise. I sit at a desk all day.
items.zh: 我必須做些運動。我整天都坐在桌前。

items.en: I must save money for my holiday.
items.zh: 我必須為了度假存錢。

examples.heading: ③ I mustn't + 原形動詞：提醒自己不可以

items.en: The interview is at nine. I mustn't be late.
items.zh: 面試在九點。我不可以遲到。

items.en: I mustn't forget my sister's birthday this year.
items.zh: 我今年不可以忘了我妹妹的生日。

items.en: I mustn't spend too much money this month.
items.zh: 這個月我不可以花太多錢。

items.en: I mustn't drink coffee after six or I won't sleep.
items.zh: 六點以後我不可以喝咖啡，不然我會睡不著。

items.en: I mustn't lose my temper with the children.
items.zh: 我不可以對孩子們發脾氣。

items.en: I mustn't leave my homework until Sunday night.
items.zh: 我不可以把功課拖到星期天晚上。

examples.heading: ④ You mustn't + 原形動詞：叮嚀對方不可以

items.en: We're going to the beach. You mustn't forget your swimsuit.
items.zh: 我們要去海灘。你不可以忘了帶泳衣。

items.en: You mustn't show Dad the photos until his birthday party.
items.zh: 爸爸的生日派對之前，你不可以給他看那些照片。

items.en: You mustn't eat too many sweets before dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐前你不可以吃太多糖果。

items.en: You mustn't go into the forest alone.
items.zh: 你不可以一個人進森林。

items.en: You mustn't be sad. We'll see each other again soon.
items.zh: 你不可以難過。我們很快會再見面。

items.en: You mustn't worry about the cost. It's my treat.
items.zh: 你不可以擔心費用。我請客。

examples.heading: ⑤ I must + 原形動詞, so + 句子：說必要的理由

items.en: I must get up at six tomorrow, so I'm going to bed now.
items.zh: 我明天必須六點起床，所以我現在要去睡了。

items.en: I must catch the early train, so I can't stay for dessert.
items.zh: 我必須趕早班火車，所以不能留下來吃甜點。

items.en: You must be at the airport by eight, so leave home at six.
items.zh: 你必須八點前到機場，所以六點出門。

items.en: I must study tonight, so I can't come to the cinema.
items.zh: 我今天晚上必須讀書，所以不能去看電影。

items.en: You must keep the receipt, so put it in your wallet.
items.zh: 你必須留著收據，所以把它放在你的皮夾裡。

items.en: I must finish this report today, so please don't call me.
items.zh: 我今天必須寫完這份報告，所以請不要打給我。

items.en: You must rest your leg, so stay on the sofa.
items.zh: 你的腳必須休息，所以待在沙發上。

title: Your parents must learn to let you live your own life.
translation: 你爸媽得學著讓你過自己的生活。
name: must 表示義務和必要（較多種主詞）
sentences: Mum, his dirty plates are all over the house. Your brother must learn to clean up after himself.
Young people can't afford rent in this city. The government must build more homes for them.
Many teenagers only eat fast food. In my opinion, schools must teach children how to cook.
My bike tyre burst in a hole again. The council must repair the roads in our town.
My sister earns less than the man next to her for the same job. Companies must pay men and women the same.
A child was nearly hit outside our school yesterday. Drivers must slow down there.
She took the wallet and said we must go and find its owner.
The forests are disappearing fast. We must protect them for our children.
The radio says a storm is coming tonight. We must leave before it arrives.
There are bottles and bags under every tree. We must do something about the rubbish in the park.
Our electricity bill was huge last month. We must remember to switch off the lights.
This hotel costs two hundred pounds a night. We must find a cheaper one.
The doctor says my mum is working too hard. She must take more rest if she wants to get better.
My son broke his sister's phone. He must apologise to her.
The bank needs an answer about the loan. They must decide by Friday.
My aunt's back has hurt for three weeks. She must see a doctor about it.
My boss talks all through our meetings. He must learn to listen to other people.
The guests in room twelve are checking out. They must pay the bill before they leave.
Welcome to our office. Everyone must sign in at reception when they arrive.
The bus is about to leave. All passengers must wear a seat belt.
This is the fire safety rule. Everybody must leave the building when the alarm rings.
The college term starts next week. All students must register before the first class.
The tennis club needs money for new nets. Every member must pay the fee by March.
Lunch is ready, children. Everyone must wash their hands before eating.
We lost the last three games. If we want to win, the team must train harder.
The shop on the corner is always empty. If it wants more customers, it must lower its prices.
The head teacher told the parents that students must study every day if they want good grades.
You want to be a doctor? If so, you must study for many years.
The traffic in the centre is terrible. The city must improve its buses if it wants fewer cars.
We spent too much on restaurants this month. If we want to save money, we must stop eating out.
My tomato plants are small and pale. They must get more light if they are going to grow.

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + must + 原形動詞：對別人的要求

items.en: Mum, his dirty plates are all over the house. Your brother must learn to clean up after himself.
items.zh: 媽，他的髒盤子丟得滿屋子都是。你哥哥必須學會自己收拾。

items.en: Young people can't afford rent in this city. The government must build more homes for them.
items.zh: 這個城市的年輕人付不起房租。政府必須為他們蓋更多房子。

items.en: Many teenagers only eat fast food. In my opinion, schools must teach children how to cook.
items.zh: 很多青少年只吃速食。我認為學校必須教孩子怎麼煮飯。

items.en: My bike tyre burst in a hole again. The council must repair the roads in our town.
items.zh: 我的腳踏車輪胎又在坑洞裡爆了。市議會必須修我們鎮上的路。

items.en: My sister earns less than the man next to her for the same job. Companies must pay men and women the same.
items.zh: 我姊姊做一樣的工作，賺得卻比她旁邊的男同事少。公司必須給男女一樣的薪水。

items.en: A child was nearly hit outside our school yesterday. Drivers must slow down there.
items.zh: 昨天我們學校外面有個孩子差點被車撞。駕駛在那裡必須減速。

examples.heading: ② we + must + 原形動詞：大家一起必須做的事

items.en: She took the wallet and said we must go and find its owner.
items.zh: 她拿起錢包，說我們必須去找失主。

items.en: The forests are disappearing fast. We must protect them for our children.
items.zh: 森林消失得很快。我們必須為了下一代保護它們。

items.en: The radio says a storm is coming tonight. We must leave before it arrives.
items.zh: 收音機說今晚有暴風雨。我們必須在它來之前離開。

items.en: There are bottles and bags under every tree. We must do something about the rubbish in the park.
items.zh: 每棵樹下都有瓶子和袋子。我們必須對公園裡的垃圾做點什麼。

items.en: Our electricity bill was huge last month. We must remember to switch off the lights.
items.zh: 我們上個月的電費很高。我們必須記得關燈。

items.en: This hotel costs two hundred pounds a night. We must find a cheaper one.
items.zh: 這家飯店一晚要兩百英鎊。我們必須找一家比較便宜的。

examples.heading: ③ he / she / they + must + 原形動詞

items.en: The doctor says my mum is working too hard. She must take more rest if she wants to get better.
items.zh: 醫生說我媽媽工作太累了。如果她想好起來，她必須多休息。

items.en: My son broke his sister's phone. He must apologise to her.
items.zh: 我兒子弄壞了他妹妹的手機。他必須跟她道歉。

items.en: The bank needs an answer about the loan. They must decide by Friday.
items.zh: 銀行要他們回覆貸款的事。他們必須在星期五前決定。

items.en: My aunt's back has hurt for three weeks. She must see a doctor about it.
items.zh: 我阿姨的背痛了三個星期。她必須去看醫生。

items.en: My boss talks all through our meetings. He must learn to listen to other people.
items.zh: 我老闆開會時從頭講到尾。他必須學會聽別人說話。

items.en: The guests in room twelve are checking out. They must pay the bill before they leave.
items.zh: 十二號房的客人要退房了。他們離開前必須付帳。

examples.heading: ④ everyone / everybody / all + 名詞 + must + 原形動詞：規定

items.en: Welcome to our office. Everyone must sign in at reception when they arrive.
items.zh: 歡迎來到我們公司。每個人到的時候都必須在櫃台登記。

items.en: The bus is about to leave. All passengers must wear a seat belt.
items.zh: 巴士快要開了。所有乘客都必須繫安全帶。

items.en: This is the fire safety rule. Everybody must leave the building when the alarm rings.
items.zh: 這是消防安全規定。警報響的時候，每個人都必須離開大樓。

items.en: The college term starts next week. All students must register before the first class.
items.zh: 學院下星期開學。所有學生都必須在第一堂課前註冊。

items.en: The tennis club needs money for new nets. Every member must pay the fee by March.
items.zh: 網球俱樂部需要錢買新球網。每個會員都必須在三月前繳費。

items.en: Lunch is ready, children. Everyone must wash their hands before eating.
items.zh: 孩子們，午餐好了。每個人吃東西前都必須洗手。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + must + 原形動詞 + if + 子句：達成目標的條件

items.en: We lost the last three games. If we want to win, the team must train harder.
items.zh: 我們輸了前三場比賽。如果我們想贏，球隊必須更努力訓練。

items.en: The shop on the corner is always empty. If it wants more customers, it must lower its prices.
items.zh: 轉角那家店總是沒有客人。如果它想要更多顧客，它必須降價。

items.en: The head teacher told the parents that students must study every day if they want good grades.
items.zh: 校長告訴家長，如果學生想要好成績，他們必須每天讀書。

items.en: You want to be a doctor? If so, you must study for many years.
items.zh: 你想當醫生？那你必須讀很多年書。

items.en: The traffic in the centre is terrible. The city must improve its buses if it wants fewer cars.
items.zh: 市中心的交通很糟。如果這個城市想要車子少一點，它必須改善公車。

items.en: We spent too much on restaurants this month. If we want to save money, we must stop eating out.
items.zh: 我們這個月在餐廳花太多錢了。如果我們想省錢，我們必須停止外食。

items.en: My tomato plants are small and pale. They must get more light if they are going to grow.
items.zh: 我的番茄苗又小又沒有顏色。如果要長大，它們必須曬到更多光。

title: Is it possible to use the prize next year, or must I cancel my trip?
translation: 這個獎品可以留到明年再用嗎？還是我得取消去印度的旅行？
name: must 的疑問句詢問義務和必要
sentences: My sister is getting married that week. Is it possible to use the prize next year, or must I cancel my trip?
I've broken my leg and can't fly to the conference. Can my colleague come instead, or must I go myself?
The blue sofa I ordered from your shop looks grey in my room. Can I change the colour, or must I keep this one?
My meeting in York ends at nine in the evening. Is there a later train, or must I stay the night?
I missed the March exam because I was ill. Can I take it in June, or must I wait until next year?
We're booking a holiday at your hotel. Can the children share our room, or must we book two?
Meals are not included in the price. How much money must I bring for food each day?
I'm applying for a student visa. How many photos must I send with the application?
I'd like to join the school orchestra. How many hours a week must I practise?
I'd like to rent the flat from the first of May. How much must I pay as a deposit?
Our literature course starts in September. How many books must we read before then?
Thank you for explaining the knee operation, doctor. How long must I stay in hospital after it?
Thank you for your letter about the summer course. By what date must I send back the form?
I bought two tickets for the concert online. Where must I go to collect them?
I've just opened an account with your bank. What must I do if I lose my card?
Our flight home is at eight in the evening. When must we leave the room on the last day?
The shoes I bought from your website are too small. Who must I speak to about a refund?
I'm getting my degree next month. What must I wear for the ceremony?
I'm planning a holiday in Vietnam. Must I have a visa to visit your country?
We've booked a cottage for a week in August. Must we bring our own sheets and towels?
I'm staying at the hotel for a week. Must I be a member to use the pool?
The museum costs ten pounds for adults. Must we pay for the children too?
I'm going away on Friday. Must I return the library book in person?
The wedding starts at ten. Must we arrive before nine?
Must I really go to Ben's party tonight? I'm so tired.
Must we really leave now? The film isn't over.
I'm full, Mum. Must I really eat all these vegetables?
Everyone at school wears new jackets. Must I really wear this old one?
We saw Aunt Mary last weekend. Must we really visit her again this weekend?
My friends are waiting for me at the park. Must I really tidy my room today?
The cable car to the top is closed. Must we really walk all the way up the hill?

examples.heading: ① …, or must I + 原形動詞？：問有沒有其他選擇

items.en: My sister is getting married that week. Is it possible to use the prize next year, or must I cancel my trip?
items.zh: 我妹妹那個星期結婚。可以明年再用這個獎嗎，還是我必須取消這趟旅行？

items.en: I've broken my leg and can't fly to the conference. Can my colleague come instead, or must I go myself?
items.zh: 我摔斷了腿，不能飛去開會。可以讓我同事代替我去嗎，還是我必須自己去？

items.en: The blue sofa I ordered from your shop looks grey in my room. Can I change the colour, or must I keep this one?
items.zh: 我在你們店裡訂的藍色沙發放在我房間看起來是灰色的。我可以換顏色嗎，還是我必須留著這張？

items.en: My meeting in York ends at nine in the evening. Is there a later train, or must I stay the night?
items.zh: 我在 York 的會議晚上九點才結束。有晚一點的火車嗎，還是我必須住一晚？

items.en: I missed the March exam because I was ill. Can I take it in June, or must I wait until next year?
items.zh: 我三月生病，錯過了考試。我可以六月考嗎，還是我必須等到明年？

items.en: We're booking a holiday at your hotel. Can the children share our room, or must we book two?
items.zh: 我們要訂你們飯店的假期。孩子們可以跟我們住同一間嗎，還是我們必須訂兩間？

examples.heading: ② how much / how many + must I + 原形動詞？

items.en: Meals are not included in the price. How much money must I bring for food each day?
items.zh: 價格不包含餐費。我每天必須帶多少錢吃飯？

items.en: I'm applying for a student visa. How many photos must I send with the application?
items.zh: 我在申請學生簽證。申請時我必須寄幾張照片？

items.en: I'd like to join the school orchestra. How many hours a week must I practise?
items.zh: 我想加入學校管弦樂團。我一個星期必須練習幾個小時？

items.en: I'd like to rent the flat from the first of May. How much must I pay as a deposit?
items.zh: 我想從五月一日開始租這間公寓。我必須付多少訂金？

items.en: Our literature course starts in September. How many books must we read before then?
items.zh: 我們的文學課九月開始。在那之前我們必須讀幾本書？

items.en: Thank you for explaining the knee operation, doctor. How long must I stay in hospital after it?
items.zh: 醫生，謝謝您說明膝蓋手術的事。手術後我必須住院多久？

examples.heading: ③ when / where / what + must I + 原形動詞？

items.en: Thank you for your letter about the summer course. By what date must I send back the form?
items.zh: 謝謝您寄來暑期課程的信。我必須在哪一天前寄回表格？

items.en: I bought two tickets for the concert online. Where must I go to collect them?
items.zh: 我在網路上買了兩張音樂會的票。我必須去哪裡拿票？

items.en: I've just opened an account with your bank. What must I do if I lose my card?
items.zh: 我剛在你們銀行開了帳戶。如果我的卡掉了，我必須怎麼做？

items.en: Our flight home is at eight in the evening. When must we leave the room on the last day?
items.zh: 我們回程的班機是晚上八點。最後一天我們必須什麼時候退房？

items.en: The shoes I bought from your website are too small. Who must I speak to about a refund?
items.zh: 我在你們網站買的鞋子太小了。退款的事我必須跟誰談？

items.en: I'm getting my degree next month. What must I wear for the ceremony?
items.zh: 我下個月拿學位。參加典禮我必須穿什麼？

examples.heading: ④ Must I / we + 原形動詞？：問是不是必須

items.en: I'm planning a holiday in Vietnam. Must I have a visa to visit your country?
items.zh: 我計畫去越南度假。去你們國家我必須有簽證嗎？

items.en: We've booked a cottage for a week in August. Must we bring our own sheets and towels?
items.zh: 我們訂了八月一週的小屋。我們必須自己帶床單和毛巾嗎？

items.en: I'm staying at the hotel for a week. Must I be a member to use the pool?
items.zh: 我要在飯店住一個星期。我必須是會員才能用游泳池嗎？

items.en: The museum costs ten pounds for adults. Must we pay for the children too?
items.zh: 博物館大人要十英鎊。小孩我們也必須付錢嗎？

items.en: I'm going away on Friday. Must I return the library book in person?
items.zh: 我星期五要出門。我必須親自還圖書館的書嗎？

items.en: The wedding starts at ten. Must we arrive before nine?
items.zh: 婚禮十點開始。我們必須九點前到嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Must I really + 原形動詞？：不想做的時候

items.en: Must I really go to Ben's party tonight? I'm so tired.
items.zh: 我今晚真的一定要去 Ben 的派對嗎？我好累。

items.en: Must we really leave now? The film isn't over.
items.zh: 我們真的一定要現在走嗎？電影還沒演完。

items.en: I'm full, Mum. Must I really eat all these vegetables?
items.zh: 媽，我吃飽了。我真的一定要吃完這些蔬菜嗎？

items.en: Everyone at school wears new jackets. Must I really wear this old one?
items.zh: 學校的每個人都穿新外套。我真的一定要穿這件舊的嗎？

items.en: We saw Aunt Mary last weekend. Must we really visit her again this weekend?
items.zh: 我們上個週末才去看過瑪麗阿姨。這個週末我們真的又要去看她嗎？

items.en: My friends are waiting for me at the park. Must I really tidy my room today?
items.zh: 我朋友在公園等我。我今天真的一定要整理房間嗎？

items.en: The cable car to the top is closed. Must we really walk all the way up the hill?
items.zh: 上山的纜車停駛了。我們真的一定要一路走上山嗎？

title: I like summer so much because the weather is hot and we needn't wear a jacket.
translation: 我喜歡夏天，因為天氣熱，我們不用穿外套。
name: needn't 表示沒有義務
sentences: I like summer so much because the weather is hot and we needn't wear a jacket.
Look, it's twenty degrees outside. You needn't take your scarf today.
It rained all last night, so we needn't water the garden this morning.
The days are long in June, so we needn't hurry home from the beach.
The snow has melted on the mountain road. You needn't put chains on the tyres.
The forecast says sun all day. We needn't take umbrellas to the zoo.
You're organising the party? As for the music, you needn't worry about it. My brother is a DJ.
Thanks for planning the picnic. As for the food, you needn't worry about it. I'll bring some.
The concert is on Saturday. As for the tickets, you needn't worry. I've already bought them.
Your trip to Paris is all arranged. As for the hotel, you needn't worry. It's all booked.
Everything is ready for Grandpa's birthday. As for the cake, you needn't worry. My aunt is making one.
The wedding is in a village far from the station. As for getting there, you needn't worry. I'll pick you up.
This flight only goes to Edinburgh. You needn't show your passport, but you need some photo ID.
Our school has a new rule. Students needn't wear a uniform on Fridays.
The castle costs ten pounds, but you needn't pay to enter the park around it.
The tennis club is quiet before lunch. Members needn't book a court in the mornings.
This is the form for the gym. You needn't fill in the whole thing. Just the first page.
The train company has a family offer. Children under five needn't buy a ticket.
Sit down and rest. You needn't cook tonight. I've made dinner.
You needn't clean the car. Dad did it this morning.
The kitchen tap isn't dripping any more. You needn't call the plumber. I fixed it.
You're going to the shop? You needn't buy any milk. There's some in the fridge.
We needn't book a taxi to the airport. Anna is driving us.
My piano lesson finishes at six. You needn't come and get me. I'll walk home.
The festival has rules for the field. You needn't bring food, but you mustn't bring glass bottles.
The interview is at ten. You needn't be early, but you mustn't be late.
The office party is casual. You needn't dress up, but you mustn't wear jeans.
You're new on the team. You needn't speak in the meeting, but you mustn't use your phone.
Here's my favourite novel. You needn't finish it, but you mustn't lose it.
The plumber says: "You needn't pay now, but you mustn't forget."
It's only a quick visit to Grandma. You needn't stay long, but you mustn't leave without saying goodbye.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + needn't + 原形動詞：天氣和季節

items.en: I like summer so much because the weather is hot and we needn't wear a jacket.
items.zh: 我非常喜歡夏天，因為天氣很熱，我們不必穿外套。

items.en: Look, it's twenty degrees outside. You needn't take your scarf today.
items.zh: 你看，外面二十度。你今天不必帶圍巾。

items.en: It rained all last night, so we needn't water the garden this morning.
items.zh: 昨晚下了一整夜的雨，所以我們今天早上不必幫花園澆水。

items.en: The days are long in June, so we needn't hurry home from the beach.
items.zh: 六月白天很長，所以我們不必急著從海邊趕回家。

items.en: The snow has melted on the mountain road. You needn't put chains on the tyres.
items.zh: 山路上的雪融了。你不必在輪胎上裝雪鏈。

items.en: The forecast says sun all day. We needn't take umbrellas to the zoo.
items.zh: 天氣預報說整天都是晴天。我們去動物園不必帶傘。

examples.heading: ② As for + 名詞, you needn't worry about it：有人處理了

items.en: You're organising the party? As for the music, you needn't worry about it. My brother is a DJ.
items.zh: 你在籌備派對？至於音樂，你不必擔心。我哥哥是 DJ。

items.en: Thanks for planning the picnic. As for the food, you needn't worry about it. I'll bring some.
items.zh: 謝謝你計畫野餐。至於食物，你不必擔心。我會帶一些。

items.en: The concert is on Saturday. As for the tickets, you needn't worry. I've already bought them.
items.zh: 音樂會在星期六。至於票，你不必擔心。我已經買好了。

items.en: Your trip to Paris is all arranged. As for the hotel, you needn't worry. It's all booked.
items.zh: 你去巴黎的行程都安排好了。至於飯店，你不必擔心。都訂好了。

items.en: Everything is ready for Grandpa's birthday. As for the cake, you needn't worry. My aunt is making one.
items.zh: 爺爺的生日都準備好了。至於蛋糕，你不必擔心。我阿姨在做。

items.en: The wedding is in a village far from the station. As for getting there, you needn't worry. I'll pick you up.
items.zh: 婚禮在離車站很遠的村子裡。至於怎麼去，你不必擔心。我會去接你。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + needn't + 原形動詞：規定上沒有義務

items.en: This flight only goes to Edinburgh. You needn't show your passport, but you need some photo ID.
items.zh: 這班飛機只飛到愛丁堡。你不必出示護照，可是需要有照片的證件。

items.en: Our school has a new rule. Students needn't wear a uniform on Fridays.
items.zh: 我們學校有一條新規定。學生星期五不必穿制服。

items.en: The castle costs ten pounds, but you needn't pay to enter the park around it.
