items.zh: 城堡要十英鎊，可是進周圍的公園不必付錢。

items.en: The tennis club is quiet before lunch. Members needn't book a court in the mornings.
items.zh: 網球俱樂部午餐前人很少。會員早上不必預約球場。

items.en: This is the form for the gym. You needn't fill in the whole thing. Just the first page.
items.zh: 這是健身房的表格。你不必填完整張。只要第一頁。

items.en: The train company has a family offer. Children under five needn't buy a ticket.
items.zh: 火車公司有家庭優惠。五歲以下的孩子不必買票。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + needn't + 原形動詞：別人幫你做了

items.en: Sit down and rest. You needn't cook tonight. I've made dinner.
items.zh: 坐下休息吧。你今天晚上不必煮飯。我做好晚餐了。

items.en: You needn't clean the car. Dad did it this morning.
items.zh: 你不必洗車。爸爸今天早上洗過了。

items.en: The kitchen tap isn't dripping any more. You needn't call the plumber. I fixed it.
items.zh: 廚房的水龍頭不滴水了。你不必叫水電工。我修好了。

items.en: You're going to the shop? You needn't buy any milk. There's some in the fridge.
items.zh: 你要去商店？你不必買牛奶。冰箱裡有。

items.en: We needn't book a taxi to the airport. Anna is driving us.
items.zh: 我們不必叫計程車去機場。Anna 會載我們。

items.en: My piano lesson finishes at six. You needn't come and get me. I'll walk home.
items.zh: 我的鋼琴課六點結束。你不必來接我。我走路回家。

examples.heading: ⑤ needn't 和 mustn't：比較不必和不可以

items.en: The festival has rules for the field. You needn't bring food, but you mustn't bring glass bottles.
items.zh: 音樂節的場地有規定。你不必帶食物，可是你不可以帶玻璃瓶。

items.en: The interview is at ten. You needn't be early, but you mustn't be late.
items.zh: 面試在十點。你不必早到，可是你不可以遲到。

items.en: The office party is casual. You needn't dress up, but you mustn't wear jeans.
items.zh: 公司派對很隨性。你不必打扮，可是你不可以穿牛仔褲。

items.en: You're new on the team. You needn't speak in the meeting, but you mustn't use your phone.
items.zh: 你剛加入團隊。你在會議上不必發言，可是你不可以用手機。

items.en: Here's my favourite novel. You needn't finish it, but you mustn't lose it.
items.zh: 這是我最喜歡的小說。你不必讀完，可是你不可以弄丟。

items.en: The plumber says: "You needn't pay now, but you mustn't forget."
items.zh: 水電工說：你現在不必付錢，可是你不可以忘記。

items.en: It's only a quick visit to Grandma. You needn't stay long, but you mustn't leave without saying goodbye.
items.zh: 只是去看奶奶一下。你不必待很久，可是你不可以沒說再見就走。

title: How can I help you?
translation: 有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？
name: can 表示建議
sentences: Can I help you put up the tent?
Can I get you a drink?
Can I carry that box for you?
Can I take your coat?
Can I make you a cup of tea?
Can I give you a lift to the station?
Can I show you how the washing machine works?
Can I help you find a seat?
Can I do the washing-up for you?
Can I lend you some money for the bus?
What can I do for you today?
How can I help you, madam?
What can I get you to eat?
How can I make your stay more comfortable?
What can I do to help you get ready for the wedding?
How else can I help you with the move?
If you want, I can come to your house and help with the housework on Sunday.
I can drive you home after the party.
I can look after your cat while you're away.
I can help you with your maths homework tonight.
Don't worry, I can pick up the kids from school.
I can buy the bread on my way home.
I can lend you my dictionary for the exam.
We can bring some chairs for the barbecue.
I can water your plants while you're on holiday.
If you're tired, I can cook dinner tonight.
I can meet your parents at the airport.
Good morning. Can I help you?
Hello, what can I get you?
Can I wrap it for you? It's a present, isn't it?
How can I help? Are you looking for something special?

examples.heading: ① Can I + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: Can I help you put up the tent?
items.zh: 要我幫你搭帳篷嗎？

items.en: Can I get you a drink?
items.zh: 要我幫你拿杯飲料嗎？

items.en: Can I carry that box for you?
items.zh: 我幫你搬那個箱子好嗎？

items.en: Can I take your coat?
items.zh: 我幫你拿外套好嗎？

items.en: Can I make you a cup of tea?
items.zh: 要我幫你泡杯茶嗎？

items.en: Can I give you a lift to the station?
items.zh: 要我載你去車站嗎？

items.en: Can I show you how the washing machine works?
items.zh: 要我教你怎麼用洗衣機嗎？

items.en: Can I help you find a seat?
items.zh: 要我幫你找位子嗎？

items.en: Can I do the washing-up for you?
items.zh: 要我幫你洗碗嗎？

items.en: Can I lend you some money for the bus?
items.zh: 要我借你一點搭公車的錢嗎？

examples.heading: ② What / How + can I + 原形動詞 ...?

items.en: What can I do for you today?
items.zh: 今天我可以為你做什麼？

items.en: How can I help you, madam?
items.zh: 女士，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

items.en: What can I get you to eat?
items.zh: 要我幫你拿什麼吃的？

items.en: How can I make your stay more comfortable?
items.zh: 我可以怎麼讓你住得更舒服？

items.en: What can I do to help you get ready for the wedding?
items.zh: 婚禮的準備我可以幫什麼忙？

items.en: How else can I help you with the move?
items.zh: 搬家的事我還能怎麼幫你？

examples.heading: ③ I can + 原形動詞

items.en: If you want, I can come to your house and help with the housework on Sunday.
items.zh: 如果你要的話，我星期天可以去你家幫忙做家事。

items.en: I can drive you home after the party.
items.zh: 派對結束後我可以開車送你回家。

items.en: I can look after your cat while you're away.
items.zh: 你不在的時候我可以幫你照顧貓。

items.en: I can help you with your maths homework tonight.
items.zh: 我今晚可以幫你寫數學功課。

items.en: Don't worry, I can pick up the kids from school.
items.zh: 別擔心，我可以去學校接孩子。

items.en: I can buy the bread on my way home.
items.zh: 我回家的路上可以買麵包。

items.en: I can lend you my dictionary for the exam.
items.zh: 考試時我可以借你我的字典。

items.en: We can bring some chairs for the barbecue.
items.zh: 烤肉的時候我們可以帶一些椅子來。

items.en: I can water your plants while you're on holiday.
items.zh: 你去度假的時候我可以幫你澆花。

items.en: If you're tired, I can cook dinner tonight.
items.zh: 如果你累了，我今晚可以煮晚餐。

items.en: I can meet your parents at the airport.
items.zh: 我可以去機場接你爸媽。

examples.heading: ④ 店員和服務人員的提議

items.en: Good morning. Can I help you?
items.zh: 早安，需要幫忙嗎？

items.en: Hello, what can I get you?
items.zh: 您好，請問要點什麼？

items.en: Can I wrap it for you? It's a present, isn't it?
items.zh: 要我幫你包起來嗎？這是禮物，對吧？

items.en: How can I help? Are you looking for something special?
items.zh: 有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？你在找什麼特別的東西嗎？

title: The tickets cost twenty-five euros. Shall I buy you one?
translation: 要我去買點蛋糕和餅乾嗎？
name: shall I 表示主動幫忙（情態動詞）
sentences: I'm going to the ticket office tomorrow. The tickets cost twenty-five euros. Shall I buy you one?
I'm going past the bakery on my way home. Shall I get you a loaf of bread?
The coffee machine is just downstairs. Shall I get you a cappuccino?
They've got the new comic at the newsagent's. Shall I buy you a copy?
You've lost your umbrella? Shall I lend you my spare one?
The shop on the corner sells good flowers. Shall I pick up some for your mum?
Your friends will be here soon. Shall I go and buy some cake and crackers?
The printer is out of paper. Shall I go and find some more in the storeroom?
The dog is barking at the gate. Shall I go and see who's there?
The baby is crying upstairs. Shall I go and check on her?
We've run out of milk. Shall I go and get some from the corner shop?
Your car is blocking the road. Shall I go and move it for you?
That suitcase looks really heavy. Shall I carry it up the stairs for you?
You're busy with the kids. Shall I do the washing-up for you?
Your English letter has a few mistakes. Shall I check it for you before you send it?
The jar won't open? Shall I try it for you?
You don't know the way to the hospital. Shall I draw you a map?
Your hands are full. Shall I hold the door open for you?
You must be thirsty after the long drive. Shall I make some tea?
It's getting dark in here. Shall I put the lamp on?
You're shivering. Shall I fetch you a blanket?
Dinner will be another half hour. Shall I bring you some crisps while you wait?
The guest room is ready. Shall I show you where it is?
Your coat is wet from the rain. Shall I hang it by the fire?
The meeting room is a mess. Shall I tidy it before the clients arrive?
You missed the lesson yesterday. Shall I send you my notes?
The new student looks lost. Shall I show her around the school?
The boss wants the figures by five. Shall I type them up now?
You've got a cold. Shall I take your class this afternoon?
The phone keeps ringing. Shall I answer it for you?
Nobody has watered the office plants. Shall I do it on Friday?

examples.heading: ① Shall I + buy / get + 人 + 名詞？：幫人買東西

items.en: I'm going to the ticket office tomorrow. The tickets cost twenty-five euros. Shall I buy you one?
items.zh: 我明天要去售票處。票是二十五歐元。要我幫你買一張嗎？

items.en: I'm going past the bakery on my way home. Shall I get you a loaf of bread?
items.zh: 我回家的路上會經過麵包店。要我幫你買一條麵包嗎？

items.en: The coffee machine is just downstairs. Shall I get you a cappuccino?
items.zh: 咖啡機就在樓下。要我幫你買一杯卡布奇諾嗎？

items.en: They've got the new comic at the newsagent's. Shall I buy you a copy?
items.zh: 書報攤有新一期的漫畫。要我幫你買一本嗎？

items.en: You've lost your umbrella? Shall I lend you my spare one?
items.zh: 你的傘弄丟了？要我借你我的備用傘嗎？

items.en: The shop on the corner sells good flowers. Shall I pick up some for your mum?
items.zh: 轉角那家店的花很好。要我幫你媽媽買一些嗎？

examples.heading: ② Shall I + go and + 原形動詞？：主動去做

items.en: Your friends will be here soon. Shall I go and buy some cake and crackers?
items.zh: 你的朋友快到了。要我去買一些蛋糕和餅乾嗎？

items.en: The printer is out of paper. Shall I go and find some more in the storeroom?
items.zh: 印表機沒紙了。要我去儲藏室找一些來嗎？

items.en: The dog is barking at the gate. Shall I go and see who's there?
items.zh: 狗對著大門叫。要我去看看是誰嗎？

items.en: The baby is crying upstairs. Shall I go and check on her?
items.zh: 寶寶在樓上哭。要我去看看她嗎？

items.en: We've run out of milk. Shall I go and get some from the corner shop?
items.zh: 我們的牛奶用完了。要我去轉角的店買一些嗎？

items.en: Your car is blocking the road. Shall I go and move it for you?
items.zh: 你的車擋住路了。要我去幫你移車嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Shall I + 原形動詞 + for you？：幫忙做事

items.en: That suitcase looks really heavy. Shall I carry it up the stairs for you?
items.zh: 那個行李箱看起來很重。要我幫你提上樓嗎？

items.en: You're busy with the kids. Shall I do the washing-up for you?
items.zh: 你忙著照顧孩子。要我幫你洗碗嗎？

items.en: Your English letter has a few mistakes. Shall I check it for you before you send it?
items.zh: 你的英文信有幾個錯。你寄出去之前，要我幫你檢查嗎？

items.en: The jar won't open? Shall I try it for you?
items.zh: 罐子打不開？要我幫你試試嗎？

items.en: You don't know the way to the hospital. Shall I draw you a map?
items.zh: 你不知道去醫院的路。要我幫你畫一張地圖嗎？

items.en: Your hands are full. Shall I hold the door open for you?
items.zh: 你兩手都拿滿了。要我幫你把門開著嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Shall I + 原形動詞？：在家裡照顧客人

items.en: You must be thirsty after the long drive. Shall I make some tea?
items.zh: 開了那麼久的車，你一定渴了。要我泡點茶嗎？

items.en: It's getting dark in here. Shall I put the lamp on?
items.zh: 這裡變暗了。要我開檯燈嗎？

items.en: You're shivering. Shall I fetch you a blanket?
items.zh: 你在發抖。要我幫你拿一條毯子嗎？

items.en: Dinner will be another half hour. Shall I bring you some crisps while you wait?
items.zh: 晚餐還要半小時。要我拿點洋芋片給你邊等邊吃嗎？

items.en: The guest room is ready. Shall I show you where it is?
items.zh: 客房準備好了。要我帶你去看在哪裡嗎？

items.en: Your coat is wet from the rain. Shall I hang it by the fire?
items.zh: 你的外套被雨淋濕了。要我把它掛在火爐旁邊嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Shall I + 原形動詞？：在工作和學校

items.en: The meeting room is a mess. Shall I tidy it before the clients arrive?
items.zh: 會議室很亂。要我在客戶來之前整理一下嗎？

items.en: You missed the lesson yesterday. Shall I send you my notes?
items.zh: 你昨天沒上課。要我把我的筆記寄給你嗎？

items.en: The new student looks lost. Shall I show her around the school?
items.zh: 那個新同學看起來很迷茫。要我帶她參觀學校嗎？

items.en: The boss wants the figures by five. Shall I type them up now?
items.zh: 老闆五點前要那些數字。要我現在把它們打出來嗎？

items.en: You've got a cold. Shall I take your class this afternoon?
items.zh: 你感冒了。今天下午要我代你的課嗎？

items.en: The phone keeps ringing. Shall I answer it for you?
items.zh: 電話一直響。要我幫你接嗎？

items.en: Nobody has watered the office plants. Shall I do it on Friday?
items.zh: 沒有人幫辦公室的植物澆水。星期五要我來澆嗎？

title: This may surprise you, but I've managed to lose some weight.
translation: 你可能覺得它很無聊，但其實不會。
name: may … but 表示意外的看法
sentences: This may surprise you, but I've started learning the violin.

This may surprise you, but I actually enjoyed the maths exam.
This may surprise you, but Tom and I are getting married.

It may sound silly, but I'm afraid of small dogs.

It may sound boring, but I really enjoy ironing.
It may sound expensive, but the course is worth every penny.

You may think I'm lazy, but I work twelve hours a day.

The walk may look difficult on the map, but it's quite easy.

examples.heading: ① This may surprise you, but + 句子

items.zh: 這可能會讓你很驚訝，可是我開始學小提琴了。

items.en: This may surprise you, but I've never been on a plane.
items.zh: 這可能會讓你很驚訝，可是我從來沒坐過飛機。

items.zh: 這可能會讓你很驚訝，可是我奶奶會跑馬拉松。

items.en: This may surprise you, but I actually enjoyed the maths exam.
items.zh: 這可能會讓你很驚訝，可是我其實很喜歡那次數學考試。

items.en: This may surprise you, but Tom and I are getting married.
items.zh: 這可能會讓你很驚訝，可是湯姆和我要結婚了。

items.en: This may surprise you, but I've sold my car and bought a bike.
items.zh: 這可能會讓你很驚訝，可是我把車賣了，買了一台腳踏車。

examples.heading: ② It may sound + 形容詞, but + 句子

items.en: It may sound strange, but I love walking in the rain.
items.zh: 這可能聽起來很奇怪，可是我很喜歡在雨中散步。

items.en: It may sound silly, but I'm afraid of small dogs.
items.zh: 這可能聽起來很蠢，可是我怕小狗。

items.en: It may sound easy, but making bread takes a lot of practice.
items.zh: 這可能聽起來很簡單，可是做麵包要練習很多次。

items.en: It may sound boring, but I really enjoy ironing.
items.zh: 這可能聽起來很無聊，可是我真的很喜歡燙衣服。

items.en: It may sound expensive, but the course is worth every penny.
items.zh: 這可能聽起來很貴，可是這門課每一分錢都值得。

items.en: It may sound unkind, but I don't want her at the party.
items.zh: 這可能聽起來很不厚道，可是我不想要她來派對。

examples.heading: ③ You may think (that) + 子句, but + 句子

items.en: You may think that cleaning musical instruments is quite boring, but it is not.
items.zh: 你可能覺得清潔樂器很無聊，可是並不會。

items.en: You may think that living in the country is quiet, but our village is very busy.
items.zh: 你可能覺得住在鄉下很安靜，可是我們村子很熱鬧。

items.en: You may think I'm lazy, but I work twelve hours a day.
items.zh: 你可能覺得我很懶，可是我一天工作十二個小時。

items.en: You may think football is just a game, but for my dad it's everything.
items.zh: 你可能覺得足球只是一場比賽，可是對我爸爸來說它就是一切。

items.en: You may think that old people can't use computers, but my grandpa has his own website.
items.zh: 你可能覺得老人不會用電腦，可是我爺爺有自己的網站。

items.en: You may think this job is easy, but there's a lot to learn.
items.zh: 你可能覺得這份工作很簡單，可是有很多東西要學。

examples.heading: ④ You may believe / feel + 子句, but + 句子

items.en: You may believe that money brings happiness, but many rich people are unhappy.
items.zh: 你可能相信錢能帶來快樂，可是很多有錢人並不快樂。

items.en: You may feel that one vote doesn't matter, but every vote counts.
items.zh: 你可能覺得一票不重要，可是每一票都算數。

items.en: You may believe that cats don't need much care, but they do.
items.zh: 你可能相信貓不需要太多照顧，可是牠們其實需要。

items.en: You may feel that homework is useless, but it helps you remember the lesson.
items.zh: 你可能覺得功課沒有用，可是它幫你記住上課的內容。

items.en: You may believe that the city is dangerous at night, but it's very safe.
items.zh: 你可能相信這個城市晚上很危險，可是其實很安全。

items.en: You may feel that you're too old to learn, but it's never too late.
items.zh: 你可能覺得自己太老學不會，可是永遠不嫌晚。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + may + 原形動詞, but + 句子：先讓步，再說重點

items.en: The hotel may look old from outside, but the rooms are modern.
items.zh: 那家飯店從外面看起來可能很舊，可是房間很新。

items.en: My brother may seem shy, but he's very funny with his friends.
items.zh: 我哥哥看起來可能很害羞，可是他跟朋友在一起很好笑。

items.en: This dish may smell strong, but it tastes wonderful.
items.zh: 這道菜聞起來可能味道很重，可是很好吃。

items.en: Our team may be small, but we work very hard.
items.zh: 我們的團隊可能很小，可是我們非常努力。

items.en: The film may seem long, but you won't notice the time.
items.zh: 那部電影可能看起來很長，可是你不會注意到時間。

items.en: The walk may look difficult on the map, but it's quite easy.
items.zh: 在地圖上那條步道可能看起來很難走，可是其實很輕鬆。

items.en: She may be young, but she's the best player in the club.
items.zh: 她可能很年輕，可是她是俱樂部裡最好的球員。

title: Alice was disappointed that her mother could have phoned her but didn't.
translation: Alice 很失望，她媽媽明明可以打電話給她，卻沒有打。
name: could have 表示過去的可能
sentences: She could have taken a taxi, but she wanted to save money.
He could have told the truth, but he lied.
We could have won the match, but we gave away two goals.
Tom could have gone to Japan last summer, but he stayed home.
My brother could have lent me the money, but he didn't.
They could have waited for us, but they left without us.
The teacher could have given us more time, but she didn't.
Ann could have studied medicine, but she chose music.
The game could have gone either way.
The firefighters said the fire could have spread to the whole street.
The driver could have hit the boy on the bike.
We could have walked home in twenty minutes.
That mistake could have cost him his job.
Ken could have fallen off the ladder.
With a better map, we could have found the hotel easily.
Our holiday in Italy could have been a disaster.
The damage from the flood could have been far more serious.
She could have been a great singer.
Without the storm, the harvest could have been twice as big.
The delay could have been avoided with better planning.
The old bridge could have been repaired years ago.
Many lives could have been saved.
The final could have been played indoors.
The flat was so small that we couldn't have lived there with a baby.
Without your help, I couldn't have finished the project.
We couldn't have arrived any earlier. The roads were closed.
I couldn't have paid for the course on my own.
I couldn't have done it without my parents.
The children couldn't have carried that heavy box.
My grandmother couldn't have walked that far.

examples.heading: ① could have + 過去分詞, but ...

items.en: She could have taken a taxi, but she wanted to save money.
items.zh: 她本來可以搭計程車，可是她想省錢。

items.en: He could have told the truth, but he lied.
items.zh: 他本來可以說實話，可是他說謊了。

items.en: We could have won the match, but we gave away two goals.
items.zh: 我們本來可以贏這場比賽，可是我們讓對手進了兩球。

items.en: Tom could have gone to Japan last summer, but he stayed home.
items.zh: Tom 去年夏天本來可以去日本，可是他待在家。

items.en: My brother could have lent me the money, but he didn't.
items.zh: 我哥本來可以借我錢，可是他沒有。

items.en: They could have waited for us, but they left without us.
items.zh: 他們本來可以等我們，可是他們沒等我們就走了。

items.en: The teacher could have given us more time, but she didn't.
items.zh: 老師本來可以多給我們一點時間，可是她沒有。

items.en: Ann could have studied medicine, but she chose music.
items.zh: Ann 本來可以讀醫，可是她選了音樂。

examples.heading: ② could have + 過去分詞，沒有說出 but

items.en: The game could have gone either way.
items.zh: 這場比賽本來誰贏都有可能。

items.en: The firefighters said the fire could have spread to the whole street.
items.zh: 消防員說，火本來可能燒到整條街。

items.en: The driver could have hit the boy on the bike.
items.zh: 那個司機差點撞到騎腳踏車的男孩。

items.en: We could have walked home in twenty minutes.
items.zh: 我們本來走二十分鐘就能到家。

items.en: That mistake could have cost him his job.
items.zh: 那個錯誤本來可能讓他丟了工作。

items.en: Ken could have fallen off the ladder.
items.zh: Ken 差點從梯子上摔下來。

items.en: With a better map, we could have found the hotel easily.
items.zh: 要是有好一點的地圖，我們本來可以輕鬆找到飯店。

examples.heading: ③ could have been + 形容詞或名詞

items.en: Our holiday in Italy could have been a disaster.
items.zh: 我們在義大利的假期本來可能搞砸。

items.en: The damage from the flood could have been far more serious.
items.zh: 洪水造成的損失本來可能嚴重得多。

items.en: She could have been a great singer.
items.zh: 她本來可以成為很棒的歌手。

items.en: Without the storm, the harvest could have been twice as big.
items.zh: 要不是那場暴風雨，收成本來可以多一倍。

examples.heading: ④ could have been + 過去分詞（被動）

items.en: The delay could have been avoided with better planning.
items.zh: 計畫得好一點，本來可以避免延誤。

items.en: The old bridge could have been repaired years ago.
items.zh: 那座舊橋好幾年前就可以修了。

items.en: Many lives could have been saved.
items.zh: 本來可以救回更多人。

items.en: The final could have been played indoors.
items.zh: 決賽本來可以在室內比。

examples.heading: ⑤ couldn't have + 過去分詞

items.en: The flat was so small that we couldn't have lived there with a baby.
items.zh: 那間公寓太小了，我們不可能帶著寶寶住在那裡。

items.en: Without your help, I couldn't have finished the project.
items.zh: 沒有你的幫忙，我不可能完成這個專案。

items.en: We couldn't have arrived any earlier. The roads were closed.
items.zh: 我們不可能更早到了。路都封了。

items.en: I couldn't have paid for the course on my own.
items.zh: 我一個人不可能付得起這門課的學費。

items.en: I couldn't have done it without my parents.
items.zh: 沒有我爸媽，我做不到。

items.en: The children couldn't have carried that heavy box.
items.zh: 那些孩子不可能搬得動那個重箱子。

items.en: My grandmother couldn't have walked that far.
items.zh: 我奶奶不可能走那麼遠。

title: I thought perhaps a thief could have entered my house.
translation: 我當時想，也許有小偷闖進了我家。
name: could have 表示對過去的推測
sentences: Someone could have taken your bag by mistake.
She could have missed the train.
The letter could have got lost in the post.
He could have left the keys in the car.
They could have gone to the cinema without us.
The cat could have come in through the window.
I could have dropped my wallet on the bus.
Mia could have forgotten about our meeting.
The storm could have damaged the roof.
A fox could have knocked over the bins.
The kids could have eaten the last biscuits.
He could have heard the news from his sister.
The water could have come from the flat upstairs.
I thought perhaps someone could have followed me home.
Your phone could have switched itself off.
It could have been the wind.
The man in the photo could have been her uncle.
She could have been ill that day.
They could have been at the beach when you called.
He could have been joking.
She could have been waiting at the other entrance.
They could have been talking about someone else.
The money could have been stolen while we were out.
The message could have been deleted by accident.
The painting could have been sold years ago.
The match could have been cancelled because of the rain.
Who could have sent me these flowers?
Where could she have put the tickets?
What could have caused the accident?
How could the dog have got out?

examples.heading: ① could have + 過去分詞

items.en: Someone could have taken your bag by mistake.
items.zh: 可能有人不小心拿錯了你的包包。

items.en: She could have missed the train.
items.zh: 她可能沒趕上火車。

items.en: The letter could have got lost in the post.
items.zh: 那封信可能在郵寄途中弄丟了。

items.en: He could have left the keys in the car.
items.zh: 他可能把鑰匙留在車上了。

items.en: They could have gone to the cinema without us.
items.zh: 他們可能沒等我們就去看電影了。

items.en: The cat could have come in through the window.
items.zh: 貓可能是從窗戶進來的。

items.en: I could have dropped my wallet on the bus.
items.zh: 我可能把錢包掉在公車上了。

items.en: Mia could have forgotten about our meeting.
items.zh: Mia 可能忘了我們要開會。

items.en: The storm could have damaged the roof.
items.zh: 暴風雨可能損壞了屋頂。

items.en: A fox could have knocked over the bins.
items.zh: 可能是狐狸把垃圾桶撞倒了。

items.en: The kids could have eaten the last biscuits.
items.zh: 孩子們可能把最後幾塊餅乾吃掉了。

items.en: He could have heard the news from his sister.
items.zh: 他可能是從他姊姊那裡聽到消息的。

items.en: The water could have come from the flat upstairs.
items.zh: 水可能是從樓上那戶流下來的。

items.en: I thought perhaps someone could have followed me home.
items.zh: 我當時想，可能有人跟蹤我回家。

items.en: Your phone could have switched itself off.
items.zh: 你的手機可能自己關機了。

examples.heading: ② could have been + 形容詞、名詞或地點

items.en: It could have been the wind.
items.zh: 那可能是風聲。

items.en: The man in the photo could have been her uncle.
items.zh: 照片裡那個男人可能是她叔叔。

items.en: She could have been ill that day.
items.zh: 她那天可能生病了。

items.en: They could have been at the beach when you called.
items.zh: 你打電話的時候，他們可能在海邊。

examples.heading: ③ could have been + 動詞-ing

items.en: He could have been joking.
items.zh: 他可能是在開玩笑。

items.en: She could have been waiting at the other entrance.
items.zh: 她可能一直在另一個入口等。

items.en: They could have been talking about someone else.
items.zh: 他們可能是在講別人。

examples.heading: ④ could have been + 過去分詞（被動）

items.en: The money could have been stolen while we were out.
items.zh: 錢可能是我們出門時被偷的。

items.en: The message could have been deleted by accident.
items.zh: 訊息可能被不小心刪掉了。

items.en: The painting could have been sold years ago.
items.zh: 那幅畫可能好幾年前就被賣掉了。

items.en: The match could have been cancelled because of the rain.
items.zh: 比賽可能因為下雨取消了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問詞 + could have

items.en: Who could have sent me these flowers?
items.zh: 這些花會是誰送我的呢？

items.en: Where could she have put the tickets?
items.zh: 她會把票放到哪裡去了？

items.en: What could have caused the accident?
items.zh: 這場意外會是什麼造成的？

items.en: How could the dog have got out?
items.zh: 狗是怎麼跑出去的呢？

title: You can wear anything you want.
translation: 你想穿什麼都可以。
name: can 表示許可和禁止
sentences: You can invite a friend if you like.
You've finished your homework, so you can watch TV now.
The teacher said we can use a dictionary in the test.
Guests can use the hotel pool until ten at night.
You can borrow my car this weekend, but please drive carefully.
Children under five can travel on the bus for free.
Mum says I can stay at Lucy's house on Saturday night.
At this museum, you can take photos without flash.
Staff can leave at four on Fridays.
If you finish the report early, you can take the afternoon off.
You can't use a calculator in this test.
Students cannot wear jeans or flip-flops at our school.
Sorry, you can't park here. This space is for doctors.
Visitors cannot feed the animals at the zoo.
You can't swim in the lake. The water is too cold.
My dad says I can't go to the concert alone.
Passengers can't smoke anywhere on the train.
You can't eat in the library, but you can drink water.
Players cannot touch the ball with their hands.
You can't use the lift during a fire.
Can I take one of these leaflets home with me?
It's hot in here. Can I open the window?
Mum, can we have ice cream after dinner?
Can I leave my bike in your garage?
Can we sit anywhere, or do we have numbered seats?
Excuse me, can I try on this jacket?
Can I hand in my essay on Monday instead of Friday?
Can we play football in the garden, Dad?
"Can I borrow your pen?" "Yes, of course you can."
"Can we go out tonight?" "No, you can't. You have school tomorrow."
"Can I sit here?" "Sorry, you can't. It's my friend's seat."

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + can + 原形動詞：允許

items.en: You can invite a friend if you like.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以帶一個朋友來。

items.en: You've finished your homework, so you can watch TV now.
items.zh: 你寫完功課了，現在可以看電視了。

items.en: The teacher said we can use a dictionary in the test.
items.zh: 老師說我們考試可以用字典。

items.en: Guests can use the hotel pool until ten at night.
items.zh: 住客可以使用飯店的游泳池到晚上十點。

items.en: You can borrow my car this weekend, but please drive carefully.
items.zh: 這個週末你可以借我的車，可是請小心開。

items.en: Children under five can travel on the bus for free.
items.zh: 五歲以下的小孩搭公車免費。

items.en: Mum says I can stay at Lucy's house on Saturday night.
items.zh: 媽媽說我星期六晚上可以住 Lucy 家。

items.en: At this museum, you can take photos without flash.
items.zh: 在這間博物館，不開閃光燈就可以拍照。

items.en: Staff can leave at four on Fridays.
items.zh: 員工星期五四點就可以下班。

items.en: If you finish the report early, you can take the afternoon off.
items.zh: 如果你早點做完報告，下午就可以休假。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + can't / cannot + 原形動詞：禁止

items.en: You can't use a calculator in this test.
items.zh: 這次考試不可以用計算機。

items.en: Students cannot wear jeans or flip-flops at our school.
items.zh: 我們學校的學生不可以穿牛仔褲或夾腳拖。

items.en: Sorry, you can't park here. This space is for doctors.
items.zh: 抱歉，你不可以停在這裡，這個位子是給醫生的。

items.en: Visitors cannot feed the animals at the zoo.
items.zh: 動物園的遊客不可以餵動物。

items.en: You can't swim in the lake. The water is too cold.
items.zh: 你不可以在湖裡游泳，水太冷了。

items.en: My dad says I can't go to the concert alone.
items.zh: 我爸說我不可以自己去聽演唱會。

items.en: Passengers can't smoke anywhere on the train.
items.zh: 乘客在火車上任何地方都不可以抽菸。

items.en: You can't eat in the library, but you can drink water.
items.zh: 圖書館裡不可以吃東西，可是可以喝水。

items.en: Players cannot touch the ball with their hands.
items.zh: 球員不可以用手碰球。

items.en: You can't use the lift during a fire.
items.zh: 火災時不可以搭電梯。

examples.heading: ③ Can I / we + 原形動詞 ...?：問許可

items.en: Can I take one of these leaflets home with me?
items.zh: 我可以帶一張這種傳單回家嗎？

items.en: It's hot in here. Can I open the window?
items.zh: 這裡好熱，我可以開窗嗎？

items.en: Mum, can we have ice cream after dinner?
items.zh: 媽，我們晚餐後可以吃冰淇淋嗎？

items.en: Can I leave my bike in your garage?
items.zh: 我可以把腳踏車放在你的車庫嗎？

items.en: Can we sit anywhere, or do we have numbered seats?
items.zh: 我們可以隨便坐，還是有劃位？

items.en: Excuse me, can I try on this jacket?
items.zh: 不好意思，我可以試穿這件外套嗎？

items.en: Can I hand in my essay on Monday instead of Friday?
items.zh: 我可以星期一交作文，不在星期五交嗎？

items.en: Can we play football in the garden, Dad?
items.zh: 爸，我們可以在花園裡踢足球嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 回答許可

items.en: "Can I borrow your pen?" "Yes, of course you can."
items.zh: 我可以借你的筆嗎？當然可以。

items.en: "Can we go out tonight?" "No, you can't. You have school tomorrow."
items.zh: 我們今晚可以出去嗎？不可以，你們明天要上學。

items.en: "Can I sit here?" "Sorry, you can't. It's my friend's seat."
items.zh: 我可以坐這裡嗎？抱歉，不行，這是我朋友的位子。

title: Could I play with it now, please?
translation: 請問我現在可以玩這個嗎？
name: could I 請求許可
sentences: Could I use your phone?
Could I sit next to you?
Could I ask you a question?
Could I take a photo of your garden?
Could I try these shoes on?
Could I bring a friend to the party?
Could I pay by card?
Could I see the menu?
Could I stay at your place this weekend?
Could I speak to the manager?
Could I open my present now, please?
Could I have the bill, please?
Could I have a bit more time, please?
Could I borrow your notes, please?
Could I leave my bag here, please?
Could I change my seat, please?
Could I please go to the toilet?
Could I please watch TV after dinner?
Could I please have my ball back?
Could I please call my mum?
There is an important game tomorrow. Could I take the class that I will miss on Saturday?
I feel a bit cold. Could I close the door?
My phone is dead. Could I charge it here?
I missed the first part. Could I watch it again?
My hands are dirty. Could I wash them first?
Could we sit at the table by the window?
Could we park our car here?
Could we finish the game first?
Could we take a short break?
Could we come back tomorrow?

examples.heading: ① Could I + 原形動詞？

items.en: Could I use your phone?
items.zh: 我可以用一下你的手機嗎？

items.en: Could I sit next to you?
items.zh: 我可以坐你旁邊嗎？

items.en: Could I ask you a question?
items.zh: 我可以問你一個問題嗎？

items.en: Could I take a photo of your garden?
items.zh: 我可以拍一張你花園的照片嗎？

items.en: Could I try these shoes on?
items.zh: 我可以試穿這雙鞋嗎？

items.en: Could I bring a friend to the party?
items.zh: 我可以帶一個朋友去派對嗎？

items.en: Could I pay by card?
items.zh: 我可以刷卡嗎？

items.en: Could I see the menu?
items.zh: 我可以看一下菜單嗎？

items.en: Could I stay at your place this weekend?
items.zh: 這個週末我可以住你家嗎？

items.en: Could I speak to the manager?
items.zh: 我可以跟經理說話嗎？

examples.heading: ② Could I + 原形動詞 + please？

items.en: Could I open my present now, please?
items.zh: 請問我現在可以拆禮物嗎？

items.en: Could I have the bill, please?
items.zh: 麻煩給我帳單好嗎？

items.en: Could I have a bit more time, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以多一點時間嗎？

items.en: Could I borrow your notes, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以借你的筆記嗎？

items.en: Could I leave my bag here, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以把包包放在這裡嗎？

items.en: Could I change my seat, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以換座位嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Could I please + 原形動詞？

items.en: Could I please go to the toilet?
items.zh: 請問我可以去廁所嗎？

items.en: Could I please watch TV after dinner?
items.zh: 請問我吃完晚餐可以看電視嗎？

items.en: Could I please have my ball back?
items.zh: 請問可以把我的球還給我嗎？

items.en: Could I please call my mum?
items.zh: 請問我可以打電話給我媽媽嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Could I + 原形動詞，加上理由

items.en: There is an important game tomorrow. Could I take the class that I will miss on Saturday?
items.zh: 明天有一場重要的比賽。我可以星期六補上我會缺的那堂課嗎？

items.en: I feel a bit cold. Could I close the door?
items.zh: 我覺得有點冷。我可以把門關上嗎？

items.en: My phone is dead. Could I charge it here?
items.zh: 我的手機沒電了。我可以在這裡充電嗎？

items.en: I missed the first part. Could I watch it again?
items.zh: 我錯過了前面那段。我可以再看一次嗎？

items.en: My hands are dirty. Could I wash them first?
items.zh: 我的手很髒。我可以先洗手嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Could we + 原形動詞？

items.en: Could we sit at the table by the window?
items.zh: 我們可以坐靠窗那桌嗎？

items.en: Could we park our car here?
items.zh: 我們可以把車停在這裡嗎？

items.en: Could we finish the game first?
items.zh: 我們可以先把遊戲玩完嗎？

items.en: Could we take a short break?
items.zh: 我們可以休息一下嗎？

items.en: Could we come back tomorrow?
items.zh: 我們可以明天再來嗎？

title: May I borrow your bike?
translation: 我可以借你的腳踏車嗎？
name: may I 請求許可
sentences: May I borrow your umbrella? It's raining hard.
My phone is dead. May I use yours for a minute?
May I borrow your pen? I've left mine at home.
May I use your kitchen to make a cup of tea for my mother?
May I borrow this book until next week?
May I use the computer in the library?
May I sit here? Is this seat free?
The room smells of paint. May I open the window behind your desk?
May I come in and wait for her?
May I hang my wet umbrella by the door?
May I have some more bread, please?
May I close the door? There's a lot of noise outside.
You're new in town. May I be your guide while you're staying here?
Those bags look heavy. May I help you?
May I carry your suitcase to your room?
May I drive you home after the dinner tonight?
May I show you the way to the station?
May I get you something to drink?
May I try on the grey jacket in the window display?
May I sit at the table by the fireplace instead?
May I pay for the flowers by card? I haven't got any cash.
May I taste a little of the cheese before I buy it?
May I look at that watch in the window?
May I change this shirt for a bigger size?
May I leave early today? I have a dentist's appointment.
May I go to the toilet, please?
May I hand in my essay tomorrow?
May I take a photo of the board?
May I bring my little brother to the drama club on Thursday?
May I have a day off next Friday?
May I record the lesson on my phone?

examples.heading: ① May I + borrow / use：借東西

items.en: May I borrow your umbrella? It's raining hard.
items.zh: 我可以借你的傘嗎？雨下得很大。

items.en: My phone is dead. May I use yours for a minute?
items.zh: 我的手機沒電了。我可以借用一下你的嗎？

items.en: May I borrow your pen? I've left mine at home.
items.zh: 我可以借你的筆嗎？我的忘在家裡了。

items.en: May I use your kitchen to make a cup of tea for my mother?
items.zh: 我可以借用你的廚房幫我媽媽泡杯茶嗎？

items.en: May I borrow this book until next week?
items.zh: 我可以借這本書到下星期嗎？

items.en: May I use the computer in the library?
items.zh: 我可以用圖書館的電腦嗎？

examples.heading: ② May I + 動詞：在別人家裡或辦公室

items.en: May I sit here? Is this seat free?
items.zh: 我可以坐這裡嗎？這個位子有人坐嗎？

items.en: The room smells of paint. May I open the window behind your desk?
items.zh: 房間裡有油漆味。我可以打開你桌子後面的窗戶嗎？

items.en: May I come in and wait for her?
items.zh: 我可以進來等她嗎？

items.en: May I hang my wet umbrella by the door?
items.zh: 我可以把濕雨傘掛在門邊嗎？

items.en: May I have some more bread, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以再要一點麵包嗎？

items.en: May I close the door? There's a lot of noise outside.
items.zh: 我可以關門嗎？外面很吵。

examples.heading: ③ May I + 動詞：主動提供幫忙

items.en: You're new in town. May I be your guide while you're staying here?
items.zh: 你剛到這個城市。你在這裡的時候，我可以當你的導遊嗎？

items.en: Those bags look heavy. May I help you?
items.zh: 那些袋子看起來很重。我可以幫你嗎？

items.en: May I carry your suitcase to your room?
items.zh: 我可以幫你把行李箱提到房間嗎？

items.en: May I drive you home after the dinner tonight?
items.zh: 今晚吃完飯後，我可以開車送你回家嗎？

items.en: May I show you the way to the station?
items.zh: 我可以帶你去車站嗎？

items.en: May I get you something to drink?
items.zh: 我可以幫你拿點喝的嗎？

examples.heading: ④ May I + 動詞：在商店和餐廳

items.en: May I try on the grey jacket in the window display?
items.zh: 我可以試穿櫥窗裡那件灰色外套嗎？

items.en: May I sit at the table by the fireplace instead?
items.zh: 我可以改坐壁爐旁邊那桌嗎？

items.en: May I pay for the flowers by card? I haven't got any cash.
items.zh: 我可以刷卡買這些花嗎？我身上沒有現金。

items.en: May I taste a little of the cheese before I buy it?
items.zh: 我買之前可以先嚐一點起司嗎？

items.en: May I look at that watch in the window?
items.zh: 我可以看看櫥窗裡那支手錶嗎？

items.en: May I change this shirt for a bigger size?
items.zh: 我可以把這件襯衫換大一號嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ May I + 動詞：在學校和工作

items.en: May I leave early today? I have a dentist's appointment.
items.zh: 我今天可以提早走嗎？我跟牙醫有約。

items.en: May I go to the toilet, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以去上廁所嗎？

items.en: May I hand in my essay tomorrow?
items.zh: 我可以明天交作文嗎？

items.en: May I take a photo of the board?
items.zh: 我可以拍黑板的照片嗎？

items.en: May I bring my little brother to the drama club on Thursday?
items.zh: 星期四我可以帶我弟弟去戲劇社嗎？

items.en: May I have a day off next Friday?
items.zh: 下星期五我可以請一天假嗎？

items.en: May I record the lesson on my phone?
items.zh: 我可以用手機錄下這堂課嗎？

title: I promise that I shall cover all the work and give it to you tomorrow.
translation: 我後天會去上課。
name: 情態動詞 shall 表示計畫（正式）
sentences: I'm sorry I missed three classes. I promise that I shall cover all the work and give it to you tomorrow.
Thank you for your comments on my draft, Professor Lee. I shall send you the final version by Friday.
I know the deadline is very close. I shall do my best to finish the project on time.
Thank you for your advice. I shall read the chapters you suggested.
Mr Green wasn't happy with the price, I know. I shall call him first thing tomorrow morning.
If there are any problems, I shall let you know immediately.
My cousin's wedding is tomorrow, so I'm sorry I'll miss the English class. I shall be attending class the day after tomorrow.
Please send any questions to my assistant. I shall be travelling to Berlin on business next week.
The office is being painted this week. I shall be working from home on Thursday and Friday.
Thank you for the invitation to speak. I shall be staying at the Grand Hotel during the conference.
Dear Ms Ford, I am writing to tell you that I shall be leaving the company at the end of March.
Thank you for the agenda. I shall be giving a short talk at the start of the meeting.
Remember that we shall start at nine sharp on Monday, not half past.
There's no time today, so we shall look at your proposals on Tuesday.
Thank you for entering the photo competition. We shall announce the winners on Saturday evening.
Thank you for booking with our theatre. We shall send the tickets to you by post.
A message to all staff: we shall close the office early on Christmas Eve.
Thank you for applying to Bridge College. We shall review your application within two weeks.
I've thought about it carefully, and I shall accept the job in Madrid.
I shall never forget the kindness of the people in that village.
When I retire, I shall spend more time in my garden.
I didn't see my grandparents much last year. I shall try to visit them every month this year.
I spent all my money in Greece. After this holiday, I shall start saving for a car.
I've always wanted to be a doctor. I shall study medicine if I get good enough grades.
Our first shop has been a great success. We shall be opening a second one in the city centre next spring.
Dear members, the roof needs work. We shall be closing the pool for repairs during August.
The choir has a busy summer ahead. We shall be visiting three countries on our tour.
Our team has grown to forty people. We shall be moving to a bigger office in the autumn.
Because of the rain, we shall be holding this year's sports day indoors.
The school trip to Paris has been cancelled. We shall be contacting all the parents by email this week.
Welcome to the Lake Hotel. We shall be serving dinner from seven o'clock.

examples.heading: ① I shall + 原形動詞：寫給老師或上司的承諾

items.en: I'm sorry I missed three classes. I promise that I shall cover all the work and give it to you tomorrow.
items.zh: 很抱歉我缺了三堂課。我保證我會把所有的進度補上，明天交給您。

items.en: Thank you for your comments on my draft, Professor Lee. I shall send you the final version by Friday.
items.zh: Lee 教授，謝謝您對我草稿的意見。我星期五前會把定稿寄給您。

items.en: I know the deadline is very close. I shall do my best to finish the project on time.
items.zh: 我知道截止日期很近了。我會盡力準時完成這個專案。

items.en: Thank you for your advice. I shall read the chapters you suggested.
items.zh: 謝謝您的建議。我會讀您建議的那幾章。

items.en: Mr Green wasn't happy with the price, I know. I shall call him first thing tomorrow morning.
items.zh: 我知道 Green 先生對價格不滿意。我明天一早就會打電話給他。

items.en: If there are any problems, I shall let you know immediately.
items.zh: 如果有任何問題，我會馬上通知您。

examples.heading: ② I shall be + -ing：已經安排好的事

items.en: My cousin's wedding is tomorrow, so I'm sorry I'll miss the English class. I shall be attending class the day after tomorrow.
items.zh: 我表姊明天結婚，所以很抱歉我會缺英文課。我後天會來上課。

items.en: Please send any questions to my assistant. I shall be travelling to Berlin on business next week.
items.zh: 有任何問題請寄給我的助理。我下星期會去柏林出差。

items.en: The office is being painted this week. I shall be working from home on Thursday and Friday.
items.zh: 辦公室這個星期在油漆。星期四和星期五我會在家工作。

items.en: Thank you for the invitation to speak. I shall be staying at the Grand Hotel during the conference.
items.zh: 謝謝您邀請我演講。開會期間我會住在 Grand 飯店。

items.en: Dear Ms Ford, I am writing to tell you that I shall be leaving the company at the end of March.
items.zh: Ford 女士您好，我寫信是要告訴您，我三月底會離開公司。

items.en: Thank you for the agenda. I shall be giving a short talk at the start of the meeting.
items.zh: 謝謝您寄來議程。會議一開始我會做一個簡短的報告。

examples.heading: ③ We shall + 原形動詞：提醒大家的安排

items.en: Remember that we shall start at nine sharp on Monday, not half past.
items.zh: 記得我們星期一九點整準時開始，不是九點半。

items.en: There's no time today, so we shall look at your proposals on Tuesday.
items.zh: 今天沒有時間了，所以我們星期二會看你們的提案。

items.en: Thank you for entering the photo competition. We shall announce the winners on Saturday evening.
items.zh: 謝謝您參加攝影比賽。我們星期六晚上會宣布得獎者。

items.en: Thank you for booking with our theatre. We shall send the tickets to you by post.
items.zh: 謝謝您在我們劇院訂票。我們會把票郵寄給您。

items.en: A message to all staff: we shall close the office early on Christmas Eve.
items.zh: 給所有員工的通知：聖誕夜辦公室會提早關門。

items.en: Thank you for applying to Bridge College. We shall review your application within two weeks.
items.zh: 謝謝您申請 Bridge 學院。我們會在兩個星期內審核您的申請。

examples.heading: ④ I shall + 原形動詞：說個人的決定

items.en: I've thought about it carefully, and I shall accept the job in Madrid.
items.zh: 我仔細想過了，我會接受馬德里的那份工作。

items.en: I shall never forget the kindness of the people in that village.
items.zh: 我永遠不會忘記那個村子裡的人的好意。

items.en: When I retire, I shall spend more time in my garden.
items.zh: 我退休以後，會花更多時間在我的花園裡。

items.en: I didn't see my grandparents much last year. I shall try to visit them every month this year.
items.zh: 我去年不常去看爺爺奶奶。今年我會盡量每個月去看他們。

items.en: I spent all my money in Greece. After this holiday, I shall start saving for a car.
items.zh: 我在希臘把錢都花光了。這次假期以後，我會開始存錢買車。

items.en: I've always wanted to be a doctor. I shall study medicine if I get good enough grades.
items.zh: 我一直想當醫生。如果我的成績夠好，我會念醫學。

examples.heading: ⑤ We shall be + -ing：團體和公司的計畫

items.en: Our first shop has been a great success. We shall be opening a second one in the city centre next spring.
items.zh: 我們的第一家店很成功。明年春天我們會在市中心開第二家。

items.en: Dear members, the roof needs work. We shall be closing the pool for repairs during August.
items.zh: 親愛的會員，屋頂需要整修。八月我們會關閉游泳池進行維修。

items.en: The choir has a busy summer ahead. We shall be visiting three countries on our tour.
items.zh: 合唱團今年夏天會很忙。我們的巡迴會去三個國家。

items.en: Our team has grown to forty people. We shall be moving to a bigger office in the autumn.
items.zh: 我們的團隊已經增加到四十人。秋天我們會搬到比較大的辦公室。

items.en: Because of the rain, we shall be holding this year's sports day indoors.
items.zh: 因為下雨，今年的運動會我們會在室內舉行。

items.en: The school trip to Paris has been cancelled. We shall be contacting all the parents by email this week.
items.zh: 去巴黎的校外教學取消了。這個星期我們會用電子郵件聯絡所有的家長。

items.en: Welcome to the Lake Hotel. We shall be serving dinner from seven o'clock.
items.zh: 歡迎來到 Lake 飯店。我們七點開始供應晚餐。

title: I will bring some music to the dinner.
translation: 晚餐的時候我會帶一些音樂過去。
name: 情態動詞 will 表示計畫和意圖
sentences: I will bring some music and some snacks to the dinner.
I will learn ten new words every day this month.
I will clean my room before Mum gets home.
I will email you the details tonight.
I will take the dog for a walk after dinner.
I will join a football club in September.
I will book a table for six people.
I will visit my cousins in Scotland this summer.
The kids look bored. I'll take them to the playground.
The plants look dry. I'll give them some water.
That bag looks heavy. I'll take it for you.
I'm tired. I'll go to bed early tonight.
I don't understand this word. I'll look it up.
It's raining. I'll take an umbrella.
The milk is finished. I'll buy some more.
The printer isn't working. I'll ask Ben to look at it.
You look cold. I'll turn the heating on.
I've got no money. I'll go to the cash machine.
We will plant some trees in the school garden.
We'll paint the fence at the weekend.
We'll go to the beach if it's sunny.
We'll bring the drinks to the barbecue.
We'll leave the car at home and walk to the match.
We will meet again next month to talk about the plan.
We'll cook something special for Dad's birthday.
I'll see you tomorrow at school.
I'll ring you on Sunday to hear about the trip.
I'll see you on Monday morning.
I'll send you a postcard from the mountains.
I'll see you at the bus stop in ten minutes.
I'll write to you from Canada.

examples.heading: ① I will + 原形動詞

items.en: I will bring some music and some snacks to the dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐的時候我會帶一些音樂和零食過去。

items.en: I will learn ten new words every day this month.
items.zh: 這個月我每天都會學十個新單字。

items.en: I will clean my room before Mum gets home.
items.zh: 媽媽回家前我會把房間打掃乾淨。

items.en: I will email you the details tonight.
items.zh: 我今晚會用電子郵件把細節寄給你。

items.en: I will take the dog for a walk after dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐後我會帶狗去散步。

items.en: I will join a football club in September.
items.zh: 我九月會加入一個足球社。

items.en: I will book a table for six people.
items.zh: 我會訂一張六個人的桌子。

items.en: I will visit my cousins in Scotland this summer.
items.zh: 今年夏天我會去蘇格蘭看我表哥他們。

examples.heading: ② I'll + 原形動詞：說話的時候決定

items.en: The kids look bored. I'll take them to the playground.
items.zh: 孩子們看起來很無聊，我帶他們去遊樂場。

items.en: The plants look dry. I'll give them some water.
items.zh: 植物看起來很乾，我來澆點水。

items.en: That bag looks heavy. I'll take it for you.
items.zh: 那個袋子看起來很重，我幫你拿。

items.en: I'm tired. I'll go to bed early tonight.
items.zh: 我累了，今晚我要早點睡。

items.en: I don't understand this word. I'll look it up.
items.zh: 我不懂這個字，我來查一下。

items.en: It's raining. I'll take an umbrella.
items.zh: 在下雨，我帶把傘。

items.en: The milk is finished. I'll buy some more.
items.zh: 牛奶喝完了，我再去買。

items.en: The printer isn't working. I'll ask Ben to look at it.
items.zh: 印表機壞了，我請 Ben 來看看。

items.en: You look cold. I'll turn the heating on.
items.zh: 你看起來很冷，我來開暖氣。

items.en: I've got no money. I'll go to the cash machine.
items.zh: 我沒錢了，我去提款機領錢。

examples.heading: ③ We will / We'll + 原形動詞

items.en: We will plant some trees in the school garden.
items.zh: 我們會在學校的花園種幾棵樹。

items.en: We'll paint the fence at the weekend.
items.zh: 我們週末會油漆圍籬。

items.en: We'll go to the beach if it's sunny.
items.zh: 如果天氣晴朗，我們就去海邊。

items.en: We'll bring the drinks to the barbecue.
items.zh: 烤肉的時候我們會帶飲料。

items.en: We'll leave the car at home and walk to the match.
items.zh: 我們會把車留在家，走路去看比賽。

items.en: We will meet again next month to talk about the plan.
items.zh: 我們下個月會再見面討論這個計畫。

items.en: We'll cook something special for Dad's birthday.
items.zh: 我們會為爸爸的生日煮一頓特別的菜。

examples.heading: ④ I'll see you / I'll call you：道別

items.en: I'll see you tomorrow at school.
items.zh: 明天學校見。

items.en: I'll ring you on Sunday to hear about the trip.
items.zh: 我星期天會打給你，聽你說旅行的事。

items.en: I'll see you on Monday morning.
items.zh: 星期一早上見。

items.en: I'll send you a postcard from the mountains.
items.zh: 我會從山上寄明信片給你。

items.en: I'll see you at the bus stop in ten minutes.
items.zh: 十分鐘後公車站見。

items.en: I'll write to you from Canada.
items.zh: 我會從加拿大寫信給你。

title: Will you come by bus?
translation: 你會跟朋友一起來嗎？
name: will 詢問計畫和意圖（情態動詞）
sentences: My house is quite far from school. Will you come by bus? I can meet you at the stop.
Will you come with any friends, or just your sister?
Will you come by car, or shall I pick you up at the station?
Will you come with your parents to the school concert?
Will you come on your bike? There's a safe place to leave it.
Will you come by plane or by train from Paris?
Will you look for a job after you finish university?
Will you stay in a hotel during your trip to Japan?
Will you visit your grandparents during the summer holidays?
Will you go back to Spain after your course in London?
Will you take any photos at the wedding?
Will you learn to drive when you're seventeen?
Will you phone me when you get to the hotel?
Will you have time to see the castle before you leave?
Will you start your new job next month?
Will you move house before the baby is born?
Will you send the photos to everyone after the trip?
Will you be back in time for dinner?
What will you do after the exams are over?
Where will you live when you go to university?
What will you wear to the party on Saturday?
Where will you go for your honeymoon?
Your exams are over. What subject will you choose for your degree?
Where will you spend Christmas this year?
Will your brother come to the beach with us?
Will your parents stay for the whole weekend?
Will the new teacher start on Monday?
Will your family go abroad this summer?
Will Anna bring her guitar to the campfire?
Will the others meet us at the restaurant?
Will your cousins come over for lunch on Sunday?

examples.heading: ① Will you come + by / with + 名詞？：問怎麼來

items.en: My house is quite far from school. Will you come by bus? I can meet you at the stop.
items.zh: 我家離學校很遠。你會搭公車來嗎？我可以去車站等你。

items.en: Will you come with any friends, or just your sister?
items.zh: 你會帶朋友一起來嗎，還是只有你妹妹？

items.en: Will you come by car, or shall I pick you up at the station?
items.zh: 你會開車來，還是我去車站接你？

items.en: Will you come with your parents to the school concert?
items.zh: 你會跟你爸媽一起來學校的音樂會嗎？

items.en: Will you come on your bike? There's a safe place to leave it.
items.zh: 你會騎腳踏車來嗎？這裡有安全的地方可以停。

items.en: Will you come by plane or by train from Paris?
items.zh: 你從巴黎過來會搭飛機還是火車？

examples.heading: ② Will you + 原形動詞 + after / during + 名詞？：問以後的打算

items.en: Will you look for a job after you finish university?
items.zh: 你大學畢業後會找工作嗎？

items.en: Will you stay in a hotel during your trip to Japan?
items.zh: 你去日本旅行的時候會住飯店嗎？

items.en: Will you visit your grandparents during the summer holidays?
items.zh: 暑假你會去看你的祖父母嗎？

items.en: Will you go back to Spain after your course in London?
items.zh: 你在倫敦上完課以後會回西班牙嗎？

items.en: Will you take any photos at the wedding?
items.zh: 你在婚禮上會拍照嗎？

items.en: Will you learn to drive when you're seventeen?
items.zh: 你十七歲的時候會學開車嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Will you + 原形動詞 + 時間？：問什麼時候做

items.en: Will you phone me when you get to the hotel?
items.zh: 你到飯店的時候會打電話給我嗎？

items.en: Will you have time to see the castle before you leave?
items.zh: 你離開之前有時間去看城堡嗎？

items.en: Will you start your new job next month?
items.zh: 你下個月會開始新工作嗎？

items.en: Will you move house before the baby is born?
items.zh: 寶寶出生之前你們會搬家嗎？

items.en: Will you send the photos to everyone after the trip?
items.zh: 旅行結束後你會把照片寄給大家嗎？

items.en: Will you be back in time for dinner?
items.zh: 你會及時回來吃晚餐嗎？

examples.heading: ④ What / Where + will you + 原形動詞？：問計畫的內容

items.en: What will you do after the exams are over?
items.zh: 考完試你會做什麼？

items.en: Where will you live when you go to university?
items.zh: 你上大學的時候會住在哪裡？

items.en: What will you wear to the party on Saturday?
items.zh: 星期六的派對你會穿什麼？

items.en: Where will you go for your honeymoon?
items.zh: 你們蜜月會去哪裡？

items.en: Your exams are over. What subject will you choose for your degree?
items.zh: 你考完試了。你大學會選什麼科系？

items.en: Where will you spend Christmas this year?
items.zh: 你今年會在哪裡過聖誕節？

examples.heading: ⑤ Will + 主詞 + 原形動詞？：問別人的計畫

items.en: Will your brother come to the beach with us?
items.zh: 你哥哥會跟我們去海灘嗎？

items.en: Will your parents stay for the whole weekend?
items.zh: 你爸媽會待整個週末嗎？

items.en: Will the new teacher start on Monday?
items.zh: 新老師星期一會開始上課嗎？

items.en: Will your family go abroad this summer?
items.zh: 你們家今年夏天會出國嗎？

items.en: Will Anna bring her guitar to the campfire?
items.zh: 安娜會帶她的吉他來營火晚會嗎？

items.en: Will the others meet us at the restaurant?
items.zh: 其他人會在餐廳跟我們碰面嗎？

items.en: Will your cousins come over for lunch on Sunday?
items.zh: 你的表親星期天會來吃午餐嗎？

title: Might I suggest that we have more exciting publicity for the club?
translation: 我可以建議我們俱樂部做些更吸引人的宣傳嗎？
name: might 疑問句表示委婉批評或建議
sentences: Might I suggest that we meet in a bigger room next term?
For the musicals in London, might I suggest that you book seats where people can both see and hear?
Might I suggest that the meetings start a little later?
Might I suggest that you check the facts before you publish them?
Might I suggest that the menu includes some vegetarian dishes?
Might I suggest that staff get more training on the new system?
Last but not least, might it not be wise if you organised more trips?
Might it not be better to answer customers' emails more quickly?
Might it not be fairer to give everyone the same amount of time?
Might it not be wise to test the software before selling it?
Might it not be kinder to tell her the truth?
Might it not be sensible to keep the shop open on Saturdays?
Might I suggest adding a map to the website?
Might I suggest using larger print for the older readers?
Might I suggest putting more bins in the park?
Might I suggest asking the students what they want?
Might I suggest offering a discount to regular customers?
Might I suggest moving the concert to a bigger hall?
Might I suggest a few changes to your report?
Might I suggest a better place for the notice board?
Might I suggest a shorter speech next time?
Might I suggest a different colour for the posters?
Might I suggest a quieter room for the exam?
Might I suggest a clearer title for the article?
Might you not ask the customers before changing the menu?
Might you not give the new staff a little more time?
Might you not explain the rules more clearly next time?
Might you not consider a cheaper venue for the party?
Might you not reply to complaints a little faster?
Might you not invite parents to the next meeting?
Might you not put the timetable on the website?

examples.heading: ① Might I suggest that + 子句？：建議改進

items.en: Might I suggest that we meet in a bigger room next term?
items.zh: 我可以建議我們下學期在大一點的教室聚會嗎？

items.en: For the musicals in London, might I suggest that you book seats where people can both see and hear?
items.zh: 倫敦的音樂劇，我可以建議您訂看得到也聽得到的座位嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest that the meetings start a little later?
items.zh: 我可以建議聚會晚一點開始嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest that you check the facts before you publish them?
items.zh: 我可以建議您發表之前先查證事實嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest that the menu includes some vegetarian dishes?
items.zh: 我可以建議菜單加一些素食料理嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest that staff get more training on the new system?
items.zh: 我可以建議員工多接受一些新系統的訓練嗎？

examples.heading: ② Might it not be + 形容詞 + if / to + …？：委婉的批評

items.en: Last but not least, might it not be wise if you organised more trips?
items.zh: 最後一點，你們多辦一些旅行難道不是比較明智嗎？

items.en: Might it not be better to answer customers' emails more quickly?
items.zh: 更快回覆顧客的電子郵件難道不是比較好嗎？

items.en: Might it not be fairer to give everyone the same amount of time?
items.zh: 給每個人一樣多的時間難道不是比較公平嗎？

items.en: Might it not be wise to test the software before selling it?
items.zh: 軟體賣出之前先測試，難道不是比較明智嗎？

items.en: Might it not be kinder to tell her the truth?
items.zh: 告訴她真相難道不是比較厚道嗎？

items.en: Might it not be sensible to keep the shop open on Saturdays?
items.zh: 星期六讓店開著難道不是比較合理嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Might I suggest + -ing？

items.en: Might I suggest adding a map to the website?
items.zh: 我可以建議在網站上加一張地圖嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest using larger print for the older readers?
items.zh: 我可以建議為年長的讀者用大一點的字嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest putting more bins in the park?
items.zh: 我可以建議在公園多放一些垃圾桶嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest asking the students what they want?
items.zh: 我可以建議問問學生想要什麼嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest offering a discount to regular customers?
items.zh: 我可以建議給常客打個折嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest moving the concert to a bigger hall?
items.zh: 我可以建議把音樂會移到大一點的廳嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Might I suggest + 名詞？

items.en: Might I suggest a few changes to your report?
items.zh: 我可以建議您的報告做幾個修改嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest a better place for the notice board?
items.zh: 我可以建議一個更好的位置放公告欄嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest a shorter speech next time?
items.zh: 我可以建議下次演講短一點嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest a different colour for the posters?
items.zh: 我可以建議海報換一個顏色嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest a quieter room for the exam?
items.zh: 我可以建議考試換一間安靜一點的教室嗎？

items.en: Might I suggest a clearer title for the article?
items.zh: 我可以建議文章換一個清楚一點的標題嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Might you not + 原形動詞？：委婉地說對方可以做得更好

items.en: Might you not ask the customers before changing the menu?
items.zh: 您改菜單之前，難道不能先問問顧客嗎？

items.en: Might you not give the new staff a little more time?
items.zh: 您難道不能多給新員工一點時間嗎？

items.en: Might you not explain the rules more clearly next time?
items.zh: 您下次難道不能把規定解釋得清楚一點嗎？

items.en: Might you not consider a cheaper venue for the party?
items.zh: 您難道不考慮找一個便宜一點的派對場地嗎？

items.en: Might you not reply to complaints a little faster?
items.zh: 您回覆投訴難道不能快一點嗎？

items.en: Might you not invite parents to the next meeting?
items.zh: 您難道不能邀請家長參加下一次會議嗎？

items.en: Might you not put the timetable on the website?
items.zh: 您難道不能把時間表放在網站上嗎？

title: Sir, may I come in?
translation: 請問我可以跟 Wright 小姐談一下嗎？
name: may I 客氣地請求許可
sentences: Excuse me, sir, may I close the window? It's very cold.
Excuse me, Mrs Hall, may I ask a question about the homework?
Madam, may I take a seat while I wait?
Mr Jones, may I leave the meeting a few minutes early?
Professor, may I send you my essay by email?
Doctor, may I see the results of my blood test?
Good afternoon. May I speak to Miss Wright, please?
Hello, may I speak to the person in charge of bookings?
May I speak to someone in the sales department?
Good morning. May I speak to Dr Brown about my appointment?
May I speak to the head teacher, please? It's about my son.
Sorry to call so late. May I speak to your father?
I'm planning to buy the sofa later. May I ask you if your special offer will still be available in September?
May I ask if the room has a view of the sea?
May I ask if you deliver to other countries?
May I ask if there are any jobs available this summer?
May I ask if the price includes a guide?
May I ask you if I can pay in two parts?
May I keep my bags here until this afternoon?
May I check out a little later tomorrow?
May I order a taxi for six o'clock?
May I ask for some extra towels?
May I return these shoes if they don't fit?
May I pay for the room when I arrive?
May I have a copy of the timetable, please?
May I leave the room for a moment, please?
May I borrow the stapler from your desk, please?
May I work from home on Friday, please?
May I take tomorrow afternoon off, please?
May I sit in on your class next week, please?
May I use the meeting room for an hour, please?

examples.heading: ① (稱呼,) + may I + 原形動詞？：對老師和上司

items.en: Excuse me, sir, may I close the window? It's very cold.
items.zh: 不好意思，先生，我可以關窗嗎？好冷。

items.en: Excuse me, Mrs Hall, may I ask a question about the homework?
items.zh: 不好意思，霍爾老師，我可以問一個功課的問題嗎？

items.en: Madam, may I take a seat while I wait?
items.zh: 女士，我等的時候可以坐一下嗎？

items.en: Mr Jones, may I leave the meeting a few minutes early?
items.zh: 瓊斯先生，我可以提早幾分鐘離開會議嗎？

items.en: Professor, may I send you my essay by email?
items.zh: 教授，我可以用電子郵件寄作文給您嗎？

items.en: Doctor, may I see the results of my blood test?
items.zh: 醫生，我可以看我的驗血結果嗎？

examples.heading: ② May I speak to + 人, please？：打電話

items.en: Good afternoon. May I speak to Miss Wright, please?
items.zh: 午安。請問懷特小姐在嗎？

items.en: Hello, may I speak to the person in charge of bookings?
items.zh: 你好，請問負責訂位的人在嗎？

items.en: May I speak to someone in the sales department?
items.zh: 我可以找業務部的人說話嗎？

items.en: Good morning. May I speak to Dr Brown about my appointment?
items.zh: 早安。我可以跟布朗醫生談我的預約嗎？

items.en: May I speak to the head teacher, please? It's about my son.
items.zh: 請問校長在嗎？是關於我兒子的事。

items.en: Sorry to call so late. May I speak to your father?
items.zh: 抱歉這麼晚打來。我可以跟你爸爸說話嗎？

examples.heading: ③ May I ask (you) if + 子句？：寫信問問題

items.en: I'm planning to buy the sofa later. May I ask you if your special offer will still be available in September?
items.zh: 我打算晚一點買沙發。請問你們的特價到九月還有嗎？

items.en: May I ask if the room has a view of the sea?
items.zh: 請問那間房間看得到海嗎？

items.en: May I ask if you deliver to other countries?
items.zh: 請問你們有寄送到其他國家嗎？

items.en: May I ask if there are any jobs available this summer?
items.zh: 請問今年夏天有工作機會嗎？

items.en: May I ask if the price includes a guide?
items.zh: 請問價格有包含導遊嗎？

items.en: May I ask you if I can pay in two parts?
items.zh: 請問我可以分兩次付款嗎？

examples.heading: ④ May I + 原形動詞？：在店裡和旅館

items.en: May I keep my bags here until this afternoon?
items.zh: 我可以把行李寄放在這裡到下午嗎？

items.en: May I check out a little later tomorrow?
items.zh: 我明天可以晚一點退房嗎？

items.en: May I order a taxi for six o'clock?
items.zh: 我可以叫一輛六點的計程車嗎？

items.en: May I ask for some extra towels?
items.zh: 我可以多要幾條毛巾嗎？

items.en: May I return these shoes if they don't fit?
items.zh: 如果這雙鞋不合腳，我可以退貨嗎？

items.en: May I pay for the room when I arrive?
items.zh: 我可以到了再付房錢嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ May I + 原形動詞 + , please？：在學校和辦公室

items.en: May I have a copy of the timetable, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以拿一份課表嗎？

items.en: May I leave the room for a moment, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以離開教室一下嗎？

items.en: May I borrow the stapler from your desk, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以借你桌上的釘書機嗎？

items.en: May I work from home on Friday, please?
items.zh: 請問我星期五可以在家工作嗎？

items.en: May I take tomorrow afternoon off, please?
items.zh: 請問我明天下午可以請假嗎？

items.en: May I sit in on your class next week, please?
items.zh: 請問我下星期可以旁聽您的課嗎？

items.en: May I use the meeting room for an hour, please?
items.zh: 請問我可以用會議室一個小時嗎？

title: We're having a barbecue for lunch. Would you mind bringing a salad?
translation: 我們改約 5 點見面，不約 4 點了，你介意嗎？
name: would 提出客氣的請求（would you mind）
sentences: We're having a barbecue for lunch, and we haven't got any vegetables. Would you mind bringing a salad?
Would you mind closing the window? It's getting cold.
Would you mind waiting here for a few minutes?
Would you mind helping me carry these boxes upstairs?
Would you mind turning off your phone during the film?
Would you mind checking my email before I send it?
I forgot I have a dentist's appointment at four. Would you mind if we met at five instead?
Would you mind if I sat here?
Would you mind if I brought my sister to the party?
The last bus is at ten. Would you mind if we went home before the dessert?
Would you mind if I used your phone for a moment?
Would you mind if I paid you back next week?
I'm busy all afternoon. Would it be possible for you to meet me later that day, around seven?
Would it be possible to change my room to one with a sea view?
Would it be possible for you to send me the information by email?
Would it be possible to pay in two parts?
Would it be possible for you to lend me your notes from yesterday?
Would it be possible to book a table for twelve people?
Would you tell me about your room in your next letter, please?
Would you send me some photos of your town, please?
Would you ask your mum if I can stay for the weekend, please?
Would you write back soon, please?
Would you tell your brother I said hello, please?
Would you send me the recipe for your lemon cake, please?
"Would you mind opening the door for me?" "No, not at all."
"Would you mind if I opened the window?" "Of course not. Go ahead."
"Would you mind lending me your pen?" "No problem. Here you are."
"Would you mind waiting a moment?" "Not at all."
"Would you mind if I smoked?" "Sorry, I'd rather you didn't."
"Would you mind driving tonight?" "Sorry, I'm too tired."
"Would you mind if I left my bag here?" "No, that's fine."

examples.heading: ① Would you mind + -ing？：客氣地請對方做

items.en: We're having a barbecue for lunch, and we haven't got any vegetables. Would you mind bringing a salad?
items.zh: 我們午餐要烤肉，可是我們沒有蔬菜。你介意帶一份沙拉來嗎？

items.en: Would you mind closing the window? It's getting cold.
items.zh: 你介意關一下窗戶嗎？變冷了。

items.en: Would you mind waiting here for a few minutes?
items.zh: 你介意在這裡等幾分鐘嗎？

items.en: Would you mind helping me carry these boxes upstairs?
items.zh: 你介意幫我把這些箱子搬上樓嗎？

items.en: Would you mind turning off your phone during the film?
items.zh: 你介意看電影的時候把手機關掉嗎？

items.en: Would you mind checking my email before I send it?
items.zh: 你介意在我寄出之前檢查一下我的電子郵件嗎？

examples.heading: ② Would you mind if + 主詞 + 過去式？：請求許可或改計畫

items.en: I forgot I have a dentist's appointment at four. Would you mind if we met at five instead?
items.zh: 我忘了我四點跟牙醫有約。你介意我們改成五點見面嗎？

items.en: Would you mind if I sat here?
items.zh: 你介意我坐這裡嗎？

items.en: Would you mind if I brought my sister to the party?
items.zh: 你介意我帶我妹妹去派對嗎？

items.en: The last bus is at ten. Would you mind if we went home before the dessert?
items.zh: 最後一班公車十點開。你介意我們吃甜點前就回家嗎？

items.en: Would you mind if I used your phone for a moment?
items.zh: 你介意我借用一下你的電話嗎？

items.en: Would you mind if I paid you back next week?
items.zh: 你介意我下星期再還你錢嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Would it be possible (for you) to + 原形動詞？：很客氣的請求

items.en: I'm busy all afternoon. Would it be possible for you to meet me later that day, around seven?
items.zh: 我整個下午都很忙。你那天晚一點，大約七點，有可能跟我見面嗎？

items.en: Would it be possible to change my room to one with a sea view?
items.zh: 有可能把我的房間換成看得到海的嗎？

items.en: Would it be possible for you to send me the information by email?
items.zh: 您有可能用電子郵件寄資料給我嗎？

items.en: Would it be possible to pay in two parts?
items.zh: 有可能分兩次付款嗎？

items.en: Would it be possible for you to lend me your notes from yesterday?
items.zh: 你有可能把昨天的筆記借給我嗎？

items.en: Would it be possible to book a table for twelve people?
items.zh: 有可能訂一張十二個人的桌子嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Would you + 原形動詞 + please？：信件裡的請求

items.en: Would you tell me about your room in your next letter, please?
items.zh: 你下一封信可以跟我說說你的房間嗎？

items.en: Would you send me some photos of your town, please?
items.zh: 你可以寄一些你城鎮的照片給我嗎？

items.en: Would you ask your mum if I can stay for the weekend, please?
items.zh: 你可以問你媽媽我能不能來住一個週末嗎？

items.en: Would you write back soon, please?
items.zh: 你可以快點回信嗎？

items.en: Would you tell your brother I said hello, please?
items.zh: 你可以幫我跟你哥哥打聲招呼嗎？

items.en: Would you send me the recipe for your lemon cake, please?
items.zh: 你可以把你的檸檬蛋糕食譜寄給我嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ "Would you mind …？" + 回答

items.en: "Would you mind opening the door for me?" "No, not at all."
items.zh: 你介意幫我開門嗎？不，一點也不介意。

items.en: "Would you mind if I opened the window?" "Of course not. Go ahead."
items.zh: 你介意我開窗嗎？當然不介意。開吧。

items.en: "Would you mind lending me your pen?" "No problem. Here you are."
items.zh: 你介意借我你的筆嗎？沒問題。拿去吧。

items.en: "Would you mind waiting a moment?" "Not at all."
