items.en: Will you please take your rubbish home with you?
items.zh: 可以請各位把垃圾帶回家嗎？

items.en: Will you please show your tickets at the gate?
items.zh: 可以請各位在門口出示門票嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Will you please + not + 原形動詞？：請對方不要做

items.en: Will you please not smoke in the garden? The children are playing there.
items.zh: 可以請你不要在花園抽菸嗎？孩子們在那裡玩。

items.en: Will you please not park in front of my garage?
items.zh: 可以請你不要把車停在我的車庫前面嗎？

items.en: Will you please not talk during the exam?
items.zh: 可以請你們考試的時候不要說話嗎？

items.en: Will you please not leave your shoes in the hall?
items.zh: 可以請你不要把鞋子留在走廊嗎？

items.en: Will you please not call me after ten at night?
items.zh: 可以請你晚上十點以後不要打給我嗎？

items.en: Will you please not touch the paintings?
items.zh: 可以請你不要碰那些畫嗎？

items.en: Will you please not play music so loudly after midnight?
items.zh: 可以請你半夜以後不要把音樂放這麼大聲嗎？

title: In school, you mustn't talk during lessons, and you have to be on time.
translation: 他們不准在牆上寫字。
name: must not 表示禁止
sentences: In our school, you mustn't talk during lessons, and you have to be on time.
Welcome to Hill School. Students mustn't run in the corridors.
Put that away, please. You mustn't use your phone in class.
The head teacher told the new pupils that they must not write on the walls.
Ask the office if you feel ill. You mustn't leave the school without permission.
Our school is a healthy school. Pupils must not bring sweets into the classroom.
The sign by the train door says: "Passengers must not smoke on the train."
The light damages the old paintings. Visitors must not take photos in the gallery.
The notice on the park gate says: "Dogs must not enter the playground."
The water here is only one metre deep. Swimmers must not dive at the shallow end.
The fire engines need to get out fast. Cars must not park outside the fire station.
The sign at the market stall says: "Customers must not touch the fruit."
You must not hit children or punish them without a good reason if you don't want them to become your enemy.
Our dog trainer gave us one main rule. You must not shout at a dog when it's frightened.
My mother always told me this: you must not compare your children with each other.
That's your sister's diary. You must not read other people's letters and diaries.
Don't tell him you'll be at his match. You must not make promises you can't keep.
Leo got the answer wrong, and you all laughed. You must not laugh at people's mistakes.
Our bank has a dress code. Staff mustn't wear jeans in the office.
Take your sandwich to the kitchen. You mustn't eat in the living room. Mum doesn't like it.
My brother is allergic to cats. We mustn't let the cat into the bedrooms.
The new building is going up fast. Workers mustn't enter the site without a hard hat.
Close it behind you. You mustn't leave the garden gate open. The dog will get out.
Rings can carry germs to patients. Nurses mustn't wear them at work.
Here are the rules for the school trip. You mustn't be late, and you have to bring your own lunch.
Our football club has two simple rules. Players mustn't argue with the referee, and they have to shake hands after the game.
Listen, everyone, before we go into the zoo. You mustn't feed the animals, and you have to stay with your group.
Our hostel has a few rules. Guests mustn't smoke in the rooms, and they have to leave by eleven.
Your history essay is due on Friday. You mustn't copy from the internet, and you have to write in your own words.
The tennis club is very busy at weekends. Members mustn't bring guests on Saturdays, and they have to show their card.
You're staying home alone tonight. You mustn't open the door to anyone, and you have to call me if anything goes wrong.

examples.heading: ① mustn't + 原形動詞：學校的規定

items.en: In our school, you mustn't talk during lessons, and you have to be on time.
items.zh: 在我們學校，上課時不可以說話，而且一定要準時。

items.en: Welcome to Hill School. Students mustn't run in the corridors.
items.zh: 歡迎來到 Hill 學校。學生不可以在走廊上跑。

items.en: Put that away, please. You mustn't use your phone in class.
items.zh: 請把它收起來。上課時你不可以用手機。

items.en: The head teacher told the new pupils that they must not write on the walls.
items.zh: 校長告訴新生，他們不可以在牆上寫字。

items.en: Ask the office if you feel ill. You mustn't leave the school without permission.
items.zh: 覺得不舒服就去問辦公室。沒有得到允許，你不可以離開學校。

items.en: Our school is a healthy school. Pupils must not bring sweets into the classroom.
items.zh: 我們學校是健康學校。學生不可以帶糖果進教室。

examples.heading: ② must not + 原形動詞：公共場所的告示

items.en: The sign by the train door says: "Passengers must not smoke on the train."
items.zh: 火車門邊的牌子寫著：乘客在火車上不可以抽菸。

items.en: The light damages the old paintings. Visitors must not take photos in the gallery.
items.zh: 光線會損壞古老的畫作。參觀者在美術館裡不可以拍照。

items.en: The notice on the park gate says: "Dogs must not enter the playground."
items.zh: 公園門口的告示寫著：狗不可以進入遊樂場。

items.en: The water here is only one metre deep. Swimmers must not dive at the shallow end.
items.zh: 這裡的水只有一公尺深。游泳的人不可以在淺水區跳水。

items.en: The fire engines need to get out fast. Cars must not park outside the fire station.
items.zh: 消防車要能很快開出去。車子不可以停在消防局外面。

items.en: The sign at the market stall says: "Customers must not touch the fruit."
items.zh: 市場攤位的牌子寫著：顧客不可以碰水果。

examples.heading: ③ You must not + 原形動詞：教養和相處的原則

items.en: You must not hit children or punish them without a good reason if you don't want them to become your enemy.
items.zh: 如果你不想讓孩子變成你的敵人，你不可以打他們，或沒有好理由就處罰他們。

items.en: Our dog trainer gave us one main rule. You must not shout at a dog when it's frightened.
items.zh: 我們的訓犬師給了一條主要的規則。狗害怕的時候，你不可以對牠大吼。

items.en: My mother always told me this: you must not compare your children with each other.
items.zh: 我媽媽總是跟我說：你不可以拿你的孩子互相比較。

items.en: That's your sister's diary. You must not read other people's letters and diaries.
items.zh: 那是你姊姊的日記。你不可以看別人的信和日記。

items.en: Don't tell him you'll be at his match. You must not make promises you can't keep.
items.zh: 別跟他說你會去看他比賽。你不可以做出你做不到的承諾。

items.en: Leo got the answer wrong, and you all laughed. You must not laugh at people's mistakes.
items.zh: Leo 答錯了，你們全都笑了。你不可以嘲笑別人的錯。

examples.heading: ④ mustn't + 原形動詞：工作和家裡的規定

items.en: Our bank has a dress code. Staff mustn't wear jeans in the office.
items.zh: 我們銀行有服裝規定。員工在辦公室不可以穿牛仔褲。

items.en: Take your sandwich to the kitchen. You mustn't eat in the living room. Mum doesn't like it.
items.zh: 把你的三明治拿到廚房。你不可以在客廳吃東西。媽媽不喜歡。

items.en: My brother is allergic to cats. We mustn't let the cat into the bedrooms.
items.zh: 我弟弟對貓過敏。我們不可以讓貓進臥室。

items.en: The new building is going up fast. Workers mustn't enter the site without a hard hat.
items.zh: 新大樓蓋得很快。沒戴安全帽，工人不可以進入工地。

items.en: Close it behind you. You mustn't leave the garden gate open. The dog will get out.
items.zh: 進出後把門關上。你不可以讓花園的門開著。狗會跑出去。

items.en: Rings can carry germs to patients. Nurses mustn't wear them at work.
items.zh: 戒指會把細菌帶給病人。護理師上班時不可以戴戒指。

examples.heading: ⑤ mustn't 和 have to：比較不可以和必須

items.en: Here are the rules for the school trip. You mustn't be late, and you have to bring your own lunch.
items.zh: 這是校外教學的規定。你不可以遲到，而且一定要自己帶午餐。

items.en: Our football club has two simple rules. Players mustn't argue with the referee, and they have to shake hands after the game.
items.zh: 我們的足球俱樂部有兩條簡單的規定。球員不可以跟裁判爭吵，而且比賽後一定要握手。

items.en: Listen, everyone, before we go into the zoo. You mustn't feed the animals, and you have to stay with your group.
items.zh: 大家聽好，進動物園之前要注意。你們不可以餵動物，而且一定要跟著你們的小組。

items.en: Our hostel has a few rules. Guests mustn't smoke in the rooms, and they have to leave by eleven.
items.zh: 我們的青年旅館有幾條規定。客人不可以在房間抽菸，而且一定要在十一點前退房。

items.en: Your history essay is due on Friday. You mustn't copy from the internet, and you have to write in your own words.
items.zh: 你的歷史報告星期五要交。你不可以從網路上抄，而且一定要用自己的話寫。

items.en: The tennis club is very busy at weekends. Members mustn't bring guests on Saturdays, and they have to show their card.
items.zh: 網球俱樂部週末很忙。會員星期六不可以帶客人，而且一定要出示會員卡。

items.en: You're staying home alone tonight. You mustn't open the door to anyone, and you have to call me if anything goes wrong.
items.zh: 你今晚一個人在家。你不可以幫任何人開門，而且有什麼事一定要打給我。

title: I have to travel to Argentina for health reasons. What shall I do with next week's work?
translation: 她的婚禮我該買什麼送她？
name: shall I 徵求勸告
sentences: I have to go to Argentina for health reasons. What shall I do with next week's work?
I've lost my library card. What shall I do about the books I borrowed?
The client hasn't paid yet. What shall I do about the invoice?
My flight has been cancelled. What shall I do about the hotel booking?
I missed the exam because I was ill. What shall I do now?
The printer has broken again. What shall I do with these documents?
My best friend is getting married in June. What shall I buy for her wedding?
It's my dad's fiftieth birthday. What shall I give him?
My teacher is leaving the school. What shall I get her as a goodbye present?
My neighbour helped me move house. What shall I buy him to say thank you?
My sister has just had a baby. What shall I take when I visit?
I'm invited to dinner at my boss's house. What shall I bring?
Both universities have offered me a place. Which one shall I choose?
I've got two job interviews on the same day. Which shall I go to?
I want to learn a new language. Which shall I start with, French or Spanish?
I'm visiting Japan for a week. Where shall I stay in Tokyo?
I've saved some money. Where shall I put it?
There are three dresses I like. Which shall I wear to the party?
It's a long way to the airport. Shall I take a taxi or go by train?
My old phone still works. Shall I keep it or buy a new one?
He hasn't answered my message. Shall I call him or wait?
I'm not sure about this job offer. Shall I accept it or say no?
The course starts in September. Shall I apply now or next year?
My hair is getting long. Shall I cut it short or let it grow?
She's upset with me. Shall I phone her and say sorry?
My exam results were bad. Shall I tell my parents tonight?
The restaurant overcharged us. Shall I complain to the manager?
I've found a wallet in the street. Shall I take it to the police?
My friend wants to borrow money again. Shall I lend it to her?
My cat hasn't eaten for two days. Shall I take her to the vet?
Nobody has replied to my application. Shall I write to them again?

examples.heading: ① What shall I do + with / about + 名詞？：請老師和上司給建議

items.en: I have to go to Argentina for health reasons. What shall I do with next week's work?
items.zh: 我因為健康的原因必須去阿根廷。下星期的作業我該怎麼辦？

items.en: I've lost my library card. What shall I do about the books I borrowed?
items.zh: 我的借書證掉了。我借的書該怎麼辦？

items.en: The client hasn't paid yet. What shall I do about the invoice?
items.zh: 客戶還沒付錢。這張發票我該怎麼處理？

items.en: My flight has been cancelled. What shall I do about the hotel booking?
items.zh: 我的班機取消了。飯店的預約我該怎麼辦？（被動）

items.en: I missed the exam because I was ill. What shall I do now?
items.zh: 我生病錯過了考試。我現在該怎麼辦？

items.en: The printer has broken again. What shall I do with these documents?
items.zh: 印表機又壞了。這些文件我該怎麼處理？

examples.heading: ② What shall I + buy / give / get + 人？：問送什麼禮物

items.en: My best friend is getting married in June. What shall I buy for her wedding?
items.zh: 我最好的朋友六月要結婚。我該買什麼給她當結婚禮物？

items.en: It's my dad's fiftieth birthday. What shall I give him?
items.zh: 我爸爸五十歲生日。我該送他什麼？

items.en: My teacher is leaving the school. What shall I get her as a goodbye present?
items.zh: 我的老師要離開學校了。我該送她什麼道別禮物？

items.en: My neighbour helped me move house. What shall I buy him to say thank you?
items.zh: 我的鄰居幫我搬家。我該買什麼給他表示感謝？

items.en: My sister has just had a baby. What shall I take when I visit?
items.zh: 我姊姊剛生了寶寶。我去看她的時候該帶什麼？

items.en: I'm invited to dinner at my boss's house. What shall I bring?
items.zh: 我被邀請去老闆家吃晚餐。我該帶什麼？

examples.heading: ③ Which / Where + shall I + 原形動詞？：問哪一個

items.en: Both universities have offered me a place. Which one shall I choose?
items.zh: 兩所大學都錄取我了。我該選哪一所？

items.en: I've got two job interviews on the same day. Which shall I go to?
items.zh: 我同一天有兩個面試。我該去哪一個？

items.en: I want to learn a new language. Which shall I start with, French or Spanish?
items.zh: 我想學一種新語言。我該從哪一個開始，法文還是西班牙文？

items.en: I'm visiting Japan for a week. Where shall I stay in Tokyo?
items.zh: 我要去日本一個星期。我在東京該住哪裡？

items.en: I've saved some money. Where shall I put it?
items.zh: 我存了一些錢。我該把它存在哪裡？

items.en: There are three dresses I like. Which shall I wear to the party?
items.zh: 我喜歡三件洋裝。我該穿哪一件去派對？

examples.heading: ④ Shall I + 原形動詞 + or + 原形動詞？：從兩個選擇中挑

items.en: It's a long way to the airport. Shall I take a taxi or go by train?
items.zh: 去機場很遠。我該搭計程車還是坐火車？

items.en: My old phone still works. Shall I keep it or buy a new one?
items.zh: 我的舊手機還能用。我該留著還是買一支新的？

items.en: He hasn't answered my message. Shall I call him or wait?
items.zh: 他沒回我的訊息。我該打給他還是等？

items.en: I'm not sure about this job offer. Shall I accept it or say no?
items.zh: 我對這個工作機會不太確定。我該接受還是拒絕？

items.en: The course starts in September. Shall I apply now or next year?
items.zh: 課程九月開始。我該現在申請還是明年？

items.en: My hair is getting long. Shall I cut it short or let it grow?
items.zh: 我的頭髮越來越長。我該剪短還是留長？

examples.heading: ⑤ Shall I + 原形動詞？：問對方覺得該不該做

items.en: She's upset with me. Shall I phone her and say sorry?
items.zh: 她在生我的氣。我該打電話給她道歉嗎？

items.en: My exam results were bad. Shall I tell my parents tonight?
items.zh: 我的考試成績很差。我該今天晚上告訴我爸媽嗎？

items.en: The restaurant overcharged us. Shall I complain to the manager?
items.zh: 那家餐廳多收了我們錢。我該向經理投訴嗎？

items.en: I've found a wallet in the street. Shall I take it to the police?
items.zh: 我在路上撿到一個皮夾。我該拿去警察局嗎？

items.en: My friend wants to borrow money again. Shall I lend it to her?
items.zh: 我朋友又想跟我借錢。我該借她嗎？

items.en: My cat hasn't eaten for two days. Shall I take her to the vet?
items.zh: 我的貓兩天沒吃東西了。我該帶她去看獸醫嗎？

items.en: Nobody has replied to my application. Shall I write to them again?
items.zh: 沒有人回覆我的申請。我該再寫信給他們嗎？

title: Surely I couldn't have left it on my seat.
translation: 我總不可能把它忘在座位上了吧。
name: couldn't have 加過去分詞推測過去
sentences: You couldn't have met my brother yesterday because he's in Canada.
She couldn't have heard the news yet.
Tom couldn't have eaten the whole cake by himself.
I couldn't have locked the door, because the key is still on the table.
They couldn't have finished the report so quickly.
The dog couldn't have opened the fridge on its own.
He couldn't have driven home; his car is still in the garage.
Surely the kids couldn't have climbed over that fence.
We couldn't have taken the wrong train, could we?
You couldn't have forgotten her name already!
The thief couldn't have got in through the window, because it was locked.
My grandmother couldn't have written this email.
I couldn't have left my phone at the café; I used it on the bus.
She couldn't have known about the party.
He couldn't have read the whole book in one night.
The package couldn't have arrived so soon.
Jenny couldn't have said that about you.
Anne is so circumspect that she couldn't have made such a careless mistake.
The fire could not have started in the kitchen.
The letter could not have reached them before Friday.
The witness could not have seen the driver's face from that distance.
It couldn't have been Mark; he was with me all evening.
The exam couldn't have been that hard.
She couldn't have been at home, because her lights were off.
You couldn't have been more than six at the time.
He couldn't have been driving; he doesn't have a licence.
They couldn't have been listening, or they would have answered.
She couldn't have been sleeping, because I heard her on the phone.
The window couldn't have been broken from outside.
The money couldn't have been stolen, because the safe was still locked.
This cake couldn't have been made with real butter.
You can't have lost your keys again!
He can't have gone to bed already; it's only eight.

examples.heading: ① couldn't have + 過去分詞

items.en: You couldn't have met my brother yesterday because he's in Canada.
items.zh: 你昨天不可能見到我哥，他人在加拿大。

items.en: She couldn't have heard the news yet.
items.zh: 她不可能已經聽到消息了。

items.en: Tom couldn't have eaten the whole cake by himself.
items.zh: Tom 不可能一個人把整個蛋糕吃完。

items.en: I couldn't have locked the door, because the key is still on the table.
items.zh: 我不可能鎖了門，鑰匙還在桌上。

items.en: They couldn't have finished the report so quickly.
items.zh: 他們不可能這麼快就把報告寫完。

items.en: The dog couldn't have opened the fridge on its own.
items.zh: 狗不可能自己打開冰箱。

items.en: He couldn't have driven home; his car is still in the garage.
items.zh: 他不可能開車回家，他的車還在車庫裡。

items.en: Surely the kids couldn't have climbed over that fence.
items.zh: 那些小孩總不可能爬過那道圍籬吧。

items.en: We couldn't have taken the wrong train, could we?
items.zh: 我們不可能搭錯車了吧？

items.en: You couldn't have forgotten her name already!
items.zh: 你不可能已經忘了她的名字吧！

items.en: The thief couldn't have got in through the window, because it was locked.
items.zh: 小偷不可能從窗戶進來，窗戶是鎖著的。

items.en: My grandmother couldn't have written this email.
items.zh: 這封電子郵件不可能是我奶奶寫的。

items.en: I couldn't have left my phone at the café; I used it on the bus.
items.zh: 我不可能把手機忘在咖啡館，我在公車上還用過。

items.en: She couldn't have known about the party.
items.zh: 她不可能知道派對的事。

items.en: He couldn't have read the whole book in one night.
items.zh: 他不可能一個晚上就把整本書看完。

items.en: The package couldn't have arrived so soon.
items.zh: 包裹不可能這麼快就到。

items.en: Jenny couldn't have said that about you.
items.zh: Jenny 不可能那樣說你。

items.en: Anne is so circumspect that she couldn't have made such a careless mistake.
items.zh: Anne 那麼謹慎，不可能犯這麼粗心的錯。

examples.heading: ② could not have + 過去分詞

items.en: The fire could not have started in the kitchen.
items.zh: 火不可能是從廚房燒起來的。

items.en: The letter could not have reached them before Friday.
items.zh: 這封信不可能在星期五之前寄到他們手上。

items.en: The witness could not have seen the driver's face from that distance.
items.zh: 證人從那麼遠的地方不可能看到司機的臉。

examples.heading: ③ couldn't have been + 形容詞、名詞或地點

items.en: It couldn't have been Mark; he was with me all evening.
items.zh: 那不可能是 Mark，他整晚都跟我在一起。

items.en: The exam couldn't have been that hard.
items.zh: 考試不可能那麼難。

items.en: She couldn't have been at home, because her lights were off.
items.zh: 她不可能在家，她家的燈是關著的。

items.en: You couldn't have been more than six at the time.
items.zh: 你那時候不可能超過六歲。

examples.heading: ④ couldn't have been + 動詞-ing

items.en: He couldn't have been driving; he doesn't have a licence.
items.zh: 他不可能在開車，他沒有駕照。

items.en: They couldn't have been listening, or they would have answered.
items.zh: 他們不可能有在聽，不然早就回答了。

items.en: She couldn't have been sleeping, because I heard her on the phone.
items.zh: 她不可能在睡覺，我聽到她在講電話。

examples.heading: ⑤ couldn't have been + 過去分詞（被動）

items.en: The window couldn't have been broken from outside.
items.zh: 窗戶不可能是從外面被打破的。

items.en: The money couldn't have been stolen, because the safe was still locked.
items.zh: 錢不可能被偷，保險箱還鎖著。

items.en: This cake couldn't have been made with real butter.
items.zh: 這個蛋糕不可能是用真的奶油做的。

examples.heading: ⑥ can't have + 過去分詞

items.en: You can't have lost your keys again!
items.zh: 你不可能又把鑰匙弄丟了吧！

items.en: He can't have gone to bed already; it's only eight.
items.zh: 他不可能已經睡了，才八點而已。

title: If you think you have seen almost everything in this world, you've got to see this museum.
translation: 如果你覺得這世上的東西你幾乎都看過了，那你一定要來看看這間博物館。
name: you've got to 表示強烈建議
sentences: You've got to take the boat trip around the bay.
When you're in Rome, you've got to visit the old market.
You've got to go to the night market. The food is amazing.
You've got to climb the hill behind the hotel. The view is fantastic.
If you like animals, you've got to visit the wildlife park.
You've got to see the old town at night when the lights are on.
You have to see at least one of her films. If you haven't seen them, you haven't lived!
You have to read this book. I couldn't put it down.
You have to try the fish soup in this restaurant.
You have to listen to their new album. It's even better than the first one.
You have to taste my grandmother's apple pie.
You have to watch this series. Everyone at school is talking about it.
You work all the time. You have to relax. You should try to enjoy life.
You have to get more sleep. You look really tired.
You have to stop worrying about what other people think.
You have to take a holiday this year.
You have to eat breakfast before school.
You've got to go out more and meet new people.
There are many chances out there, but you have to look for them.
You have to practise every day if you want to speak English well.
You've got to believe in yourself, or nobody else will.
You have to ask questions in class if you don't understand.
You have to keep trying. Don't give up after one bad interview.
You've got to talk to your teacher about it.
You've got to come to the beach with us on Saturday.
You've got to hear this song. It's so funny.
You've got to meet my cousin. You'll love her.
You've got to try surfing at least once.
You've got to see the photos from the wedding.
You've got to come to the concert. The band is great live.
You've got to try the new pizza place on the corner.

examples.heading: ① You've got to + 原形動詞：推薦地方

items.en: You've got to take the boat trip around the bay.
items.zh: 你一定要搭船遊海灣。

items.en: When you're in Rome, you've got to visit the old market.
items.zh: 你在羅馬的時候，一定要去那個老市場。

items.en: You've got to go to the night market. The food is amazing.
items.zh: 你一定要去夜市。那裡的食物太棒了。

items.en: You've got to climb the hill behind the hotel. The view is fantastic.
items.zh: 你一定要爬飯店後面那座小山。風景好極了。

items.en: If you like animals, you've got to visit the wildlife park.
items.zh: 如果你喜歡動物，你一定要去野生動物園。

items.en: You've got to see the old town at night when the lights are on.
items.zh: 你一定要在晚上燈亮的時候去看舊城區。

examples.heading: ② You have to + 原形動詞：推薦電影、書和食物

items.en: You have to see at least one of her films. If you haven't seen them, you haven't lived!
items.zh: 你一定要至少看一部她的電影。沒看過的話，你等於白活了！

items.en: You have to read this book. I couldn't put it down.
items.zh: 你一定要讀這本書。我一拿起來就放不下。

items.en: You have to try the fish soup in this restaurant.
items.zh: 你一定要試試這家餐廳的魚湯。

items.en: You have to listen to their new album. It's even better than the first one.
items.zh: 你一定要聽他們的新專輯。比第一張還好聽。

items.en: You have to taste my grandmother's apple pie.
items.zh: 你一定要嚐嚐我奶奶做的蘋果派。

items.en: You have to watch this series. Everyone at school is talking about it.
items.zh: 你一定要看這部影集。學校裡每個人都在討論。

examples.heading: ③ You have to + 原形動詞：勸別人改變生活

items.en: You work all the time. You have to relax. You should try to enjoy life.
items.zh: 你一直在工作。你一定要放鬆。你應該試著享受生活。

items.en: You have to get more sleep. You look really tired.
items.zh: 你一定要多睡一點。你看起來真的很累。

items.en: You have to stop worrying about what other people think.
items.zh: 你一定要停止擔心別人怎麼想。

items.en: You have to take a holiday this year.
items.zh: 你今年一定要去度個假。

items.en: You have to eat breakfast before school.
items.zh: 你上學前一定要吃早餐。

items.en: You've got to go out more and meet new people.
items.zh: 你一定要多出去走走，認識新朋友。

examples.heading: ④ You have to + 原形動詞：給求職和學習的建議

items.en: There are many chances out there, but you have to look for them.
items.zh: 機會很多，可是你一定要自己去找。

items.en: You have to practise every day if you want to speak English well.
items.zh: 如果你想把英文說好，你一定要每天練習。

items.en: You've got to believe in yourself, or nobody else will.
items.zh: 你一定要相信自己，不然沒有人會相信你。

items.en: You have to ask questions in class if you don't understand.
items.zh: 如果你不懂，你一定要在課堂上發問。

items.en: You have to keep trying. Don't give up after one bad interview.
items.zh: 你一定要繼續努力。不要因為一次面試不順就放棄。

items.en: You've got to talk to your teacher about it.
items.zh: 你一定要跟你的老師談談這件事。

examples.heading: ⑤ You've got to + 原形動詞：朋友之間的口語推薦

items.en: You've got to come to the beach with us on Saturday.
items.zh: 星期六你一定要跟我們去海灘。

items.en: You've got to hear this song. It's so funny.
items.zh: 你一定要聽這首歌。超好笑的。

items.en: You've got to meet my cousin. You'll love her.
items.zh: 你一定要認識我表姊。你會很喜歡她。

items.en: You've got to try surfing at least once.
items.zh: 你一定要至少試一次衝浪。

items.en: You've got to see the photos from the wedding.
items.zh: 你一定要看看婚禮的照片。

items.en: You've got to come to the concert. The band is great live.
items.zh: 你一定要來聽音樂會。那個樂團現場超棒。

items.en: You've got to try the new pizza place on the corner.
items.zh: 你一定要試試轉角那家新開的披薩店。

title: I really don't know what you should do, but I think that you might talk with your parents.
translation: 我覺得你或許可以跟你爸媽談談。
name: might 提出客氣的建議
sentences: I'm not sure what's best, but you might talk to the school nurse.
If you can't sleep, you might try a warm drink before bed.
You might ask your teacher for extra help.
You might look for a job in a café during the summer.
If you're bored, you might join a sports club.
You might write to the company and complain.
The park has lots of trees and a beautiful view. You might need to bring some food and drink.
You might need to book a table. The restaurant is popular.
You might need to take a jacket. It gets cold at night.
You might need to show your student card.
You might need to leave early to avoid the traffic.
You might need to change trains at the next station.
You might want to check the price before you order.
You might want to bring a book. The journey is long.
You might want to read the contract carefully.
You might want to call before you go.
You might want to wear comfortable shoes for the tour.
You might want to practise your speech in front of a mirror.
You might like to visit the old harbour while you're here.
You might like to try the local cheese.
You might like to join us for dinner on Friday.
If you enjoy history, you might like to see the castle.
You might like to read her first novel.
You might like to take a walk along the river.
It might be a good idea to save some money every month.
It might be a good idea to learn a few words of the language.
It might be a good idea to ask for directions.
It might be a good idea to take a break.
It might be a good idea to tell your boss about the problem.
It might be a good idea to get there before the crowds.
It might be a good idea to keep a copy of your passport.

examples.heading: ① You might + 原形動詞：委婉的建議

items.en: I'm not sure what's best, but you might talk to the school nurse.
items.zh: 我不確定怎麼做最好，可是你或許可以跟學校護理師談談。

items.en: If you can't sleep, you might try a warm drink before bed.
items.zh: 如果你睡不著，你或許可以睡前喝點熱的。

items.en: You might ask your teacher for extra help.
items.zh: 你或許可以請你的老師多幫你一點。

items.en: You might look for a job in a café during the summer.
items.zh: 你暑假或許可以在咖啡館找份工作。

items.en: If you're bored, you might join a sports club.
items.zh: 如果你覺得無聊，你或許可以加入運動社團。

items.en: You might write to the company and complain.
items.zh: 你或許可以寫信給那家公司抱怨。

examples.heading: ② You might need to + 原形動詞：提醒要準備的事

items.en: The park has lots of trees and a beautiful view. You might need to bring some food and drink.
items.zh: 公園裡有很多樹，風景很美。你也許需要帶一些吃的和喝的。

items.en: You might need to book a table. The restaurant is popular.
items.zh: 你也許需要訂位。那家餐廳很熱門。

items.en: You might need to take a jacket. It gets cold at night.
items.zh: 你也許需要帶件外套。晚上會變冷。

items.en: You might need to show your student card.
items.zh: 你也許需要出示學生證。

items.en: You might need to leave early to avoid the traffic.
items.zh: 你也許需要早點出發，避開塞車。

items.en: You might need to change trains at the next station.
items.zh: 你也許需要在下一站換車。

examples.heading: ③ You might want to + 原形動詞：建議對方考慮

items.en: You might want to check the price before you order.
items.zh: 你點之前也許會想先確認價錢。

items.en: You might want to bring a book. The journey is long.
items.zh: 你也許會想帶本書。路程很長。

items.en: You might want to read the contract carefully.
items.zh: 你也許會想仔細讀一下合約。

items.en: You might want to call before you go.
items.zh: 你出發前也許會想先打個電話。

items.en: You might want to wear comfortable shoes for the tour.
items.zh: 參加導覽你也許會想穿舒服的鞋子。

items.en: You might want to practise your speech in front of a mirror.
items.zh: 你也許會想對著鏡子練習你的演講。

examples.heading: ④ You might like to + 原形動詞：推薦

items.en: You might like to visit the old harbour while you're here.
items.zh: 你在這裡的時候，也許會想去看看舊港口。

items.en: You might like to try the local cheese.
items.zh: 你也許會想試試當地的起司。

items.en: You might like to join us for dinner on Friday.
items.zh: 你星期五也許會想跟我們一起吃晚餐。

items.en: If you enjoy history, you might like to see the castle.
items.zh: 如果你喜歡歷史，你也許會想去看看城堡。

items.en: You might like to read her first novel.
items.zh: 你也許會想讀她的第一本小說。

items.en: You might like to take a walk along the river.
items.zh: 你也許會想沿著河邊散個步。

examples.heading: ⑤ It might be a good idea to + 原形動詞

items.en: It might be a good idea to save some money every month.
items.zh: 每個月存一點錢也許是個好主意。

items.en: It might be a good idea to learn a few words of the language.
items.zh: 學幾個當地語言的字也許是個好主意。

items.en: It might be a good idea to ask for directions.
items.zh: 問一下路也許是個好主意。

items.en: It might be a good idea to take a break.
items.zh: 休息一下也許是個好主意。

items.en: It might be a good idea to tell your boss about the problem.
items.zh: 把這個問題告訴你的老闆也許是個好主意。

items.en: It might be a good idea to get there before the crowds.
items.zh: 在人潮出現之前到那裡也許是個好主意。

items.en: It might be a good idea to keep a copy of your passport.
items.zh: 留一份護照影本也許是個好主意。

title: We could take the bus, or we could ask my parents to take us there.
translation: 我們可以搭公車，或是請我爸媽載我們去。
name: could 表示建議
sentences: We could go to the park.
We could have a picnic by the lake.
We could play tennis on Saturday.
We could make pancakes for breakfast.
We could visit Grandma this weekend.
We could buy her a book for her birthday.
We could go swimming after school.
We could listen to some music.
If you want to visit an interesting place near Paris, you could go to Versailles.
You could wear your blue dress.
You could ask your brother for help.
You could take the subway. It's faster.
You could write him a card.
You could buy the tickets online.
You could stay with us next time.
You could visit the old town in the morning.
We could watch a film, or we could play a board game.
We could eat at home, or we could go out.
We could take a taxi, or we could walk to the hotel.
We could leave now, or we could wait for Tom.
We could paint the room blue, or we could leave it white.
We could fly to Rome, or we could take the night train.
You could call her, or you could send her an email.
We could have dinner after that, if you want.
You could borrow my notes, if you want.
We could go shopping tomorrow, if you want.
You could come with us, if you want.
We could meet at my house, if you want.
We could share my umbrella, if you want.
We could start a bit later, if you want.

examples.heading: ① We could + 原形動詞

items.en: We could go to the park.
items.zh: 我們可以去公園。

items.en: We could have a picnic by the lake.
items.zh: 我們可以在湖邊野餐。

items.en: We could play tennis on Saturday.
items.zh: 我們星期六可以打網球。

items.en: We could make pancakes for breakfast.
items.zh: 我們早餐可以做鬆餅。

items.en: We could visit Grandma this weekend.
items.zh: 我們這個週末可以去看奶奶。

items.en: We could buy her a book for her birthday.
items.zh: 我們可以買一本書送她當生日禮物。

items.en: We could go swimming after school.
items.zh: 我們放學後可以去游泳。

items.en: We could listen to some music.
items.zh: 我們可以聽點音樂。

examples.heading: ② You could + 原形動詞

items.en: If you want to visit an interesting place near Paris, you could go to Versailles.
items.zh: 如果你想去巴黎附近有趣的地方，你可以去凡爾賽宮。

items.en: You could wear your blue dress.
items.zh: 你可以穿你那件藍色洋裝。

items.en: You could ask your brother for help.
items.zh: 你可以請你哥哥幫忙。

items.en: You could take the subway. It's faster.
items.zh: 你可以搭地鐵。比較快。

items.en: You could write him a card.
items.zh: 你可以寫張卡片給他。

items.en: You could buy the tickets online.
items.zh: 你可以在網路上買票。

items.en: You could stay with us next time.
items.zh: 下次你可以住我們家。

items.en: You could visit the old town in the morning.
items.zh: 你可以早上去逛舊城區。

examples.heading: ③ We could ..., or we could ...

items.en: We could watch a film, or we could play a board game.
items.zh: 我們可以看電影，或是玩桌遊。

items.en: We could eat at home, or we could go out.
items.zh: 我們可以在家吃，或是出去吃。

items.en: We could take a taxi, or we could walk to the hotel.
items.zh: 我們可以搭計程車，或是走路去飯店。

items.en: We could leave now, or we could wait for Tom.
items.zh: 我們可以現在走，或是等 Tom。

items.en: We could paint the room blue, or we could leave it white.
items.zh: 我們可以把房間漆成藍色，或是維持白色。

items.zh: 我們可以搭飛機去羅馬，或是搭夜車。

items.en: You could call her, or you could send her an email.
items.zh: 你可以打電話給她，或是寄電子郵件給她。

examples.heading: ④ could + 原形動詞, if you want

items.en: We could have dinner after that, if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，我們之後可以去吃晚餐。

items.en: You could borrow my notes, if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以借我的筆記去看。

items.en: We could go shopping tomorrow, if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，我們明天可以去逛街。

items.en: You could come with us, if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，可以跟我們一起來。

items.en: We could meet at my house, if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，我們可以在我家碰面。

items.en: We could share my umbrella, if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，我們可以一起撐我的傘。

items.en: We could start a bit later, if you want.
items.zh: 你想的話，我們可以晚一點開始。

title: We could meet in the nice cafe next to your house and have a coffee.

name: could 表示建議（較多種動詞）
sentences: We could book a table at the new Thai restaurant.
We could share a taxi to the airport.

We could rent bikes and ride along the river.
We could split the bill.
We could practise our presentation together tonight.
We could paint the kitchen yellow.

We could order pizza and stay in tonight.

You could ask your teacher for some extra exercises.
You could borrow my camera for the trip.

I need to change the time of our meeting. Could it be at 5.30 pm?

items.zh: 我們星期天可以請你的表哥表姊來吃午餐。

examples.heading: ② You could + 原形動詞

items.en: You could become a member of a gym.

items.zh: 你可以請老師多給你一些練習題。
