items.en: Maybe we could cook dinner together this weekend.
items.zh: 也許我們這個週末可以一起煮晚餐。

title: Rome is really fantastic and you must go there!
translation: 羅馬真的很棒，你一定要去！
name: must 表示強烈建議
sentences: Venice is beautiful, and you must see it at least once.
You must visit the castle when you're in Edinburgh.
If you go to Japan, you must go in the spring.
You must go up the tower. The view is amazing.
When you're in Lisbon, you must ride the yellow tram up the hill.
You must take a boat trip on the river.
This club opened just two weeks ago. I mean, we must see it.
There's a new Thai restaurant in town. We must try it.
The circus is coming next month. We must get tickets.
We must go camping before the summer ends.
We must visit Grandma at the weekend.
The new exhibition sounds great. We must go together.
What a great day out! We must do that again, don't you think?
That was a lovely meal. We must come here again.
It was so good to see you. We must meet again soon.
We must go to that beach again next summer.
The concert was brilliant. We must see them again.
We must play tennis again next week.
You must read this book. I couldn't stop reading.
You must see the new Spider-Man film. It's brilliant.
You must taste the cheese from this farm.
You must listen to this podcast. It's so funny.
You must try the hot chocolate at that café.
You must watch the sunset from the hill.
You must enter the singing competition. Your voice is beautiful.
You must send your story to a magazine.
You must apply for that job. You'd be perfect.
You must show your paintings to the art teacher.
You must join the choir. They need more singers.
You must start your own cooking blog.
You must take up running again. You loved it.

examples.heading: ① You must + go / visit + 地方：推薦旅遊

items.en: Venice is beautiful, and you must see it at least once.
items.zh: 威尼斯很美，你至少要去看一次。

items.en: You must visit the castle when you're in Edinburgh.
items.zh: 你在愛丁堡的時候一定要去參觀城堡。

items.en: If you go to Japan, you must go in the spring.
items.zh: 如果你去日本，一定要在春天去。

items.en: You must go up the tower. The view is amazing.
items.zh: 你一定要上那座塔。風景好極了。

items.en: When you're in Lisbon, you must ride the yellow tram up the hill.
items.zh: 你在里斯本的時候，一定要搭黃色電車上山。

items.en: You must take a boat trip on the river.
items.zh: 你一定要搭船遊河。

examples.heading: ② We must + 原形動詞：建議大家一起去

items.en: This club opened just two weeks ago. I mean, we must see it.
items.zh: 這家俱樂部兩個星期前才開。我是說，我們一定要去看看。

items.en: There's a new Thai restaurant in town. We must try it.
items.zh: 城裡新開了一家泰國餐廳。我們一定要去吃吃看。

items.en: The circus is coming next month. We must get tickets.
items.zh: 馬戲團下個月要來。我們一定要買票。

items.en: We must go camping before the summer ends.
items.zh: 夏天結束前我們一定要去露營。

items.en: We must visit Grandma at the weekend.
items.zh: 週末我們一定要去看奶奶。

items.en: The new exhibition sounds great. We must go together.
items.zh: 新的展覽聽起來很棒。我們一定要一起去。

examples.heading: ③ We must + 原形動詞 + again：說一定要再來

items.en: What a great day out! We must do that again, don't you think?
items.zh: 今天玩得真開心！我們一定要再來一次，你不覺得嗎？

items.en: That was a lovely meal. We must come here again.
items.zh: 那一餐很棒。我們一定要再來這裡。

items.en: It was so good to see you. We must meet again soon.
items.zh: 見到你真好。我們一定要很快再見面。

items.en: We must go to that beach again next summer.
items.zh: 明年夏天我們一定要再去那個海灘。

items.en: The concert was brilliant. We must see them again.
items.zh: 音樂會太精彩了。我們一定要再去看他們。

items.en: We must play tennis again next week.
items.zh: 下星期我們一定要再打網球。

examples.heading: ④ You must + 原形動詞：推薦電影、書和食物

items.en: You must read this book. I couldn't stop reading.
items.zh: 你一定要讀這本書。我一讀就停不下來。

items.en: You must see the new Spider-Man film. It's brilliant.
items.zh: 你一定要看新的蜘蛛人電影。太精彩了。

items.en: You must taste the cheese from this farm.
items.zh: 你一定要嚐嚐這個農場的起司。

items.en: You must listen to this podcast. It's so funny.
items.zh: 你一定要聽這個 podcast。超好笑的。

items.en: You must try the hot chocolate at that café.
items.zh: 你一定要試試那家咖啡館的熱可可。

items.en: You must watch the sunset from the hill.
items.zh: 你一定要從山丘上看夕陽。

examples.heading: ⑤ You must + 原形動詞：鼓勵對方

items.en: You must enter the singing competition. Your voice is beautiful.
items.zh: 你一定要參加歌唱比賽。你的聲音很好聽。

items.en: You must send your story to a magazine.
items.zh: 你一定要把你的故事投稿到雜誌。

items.en: You must apply for that job. You'd be perfect.
items.zh: 你一定要去應徵那份工作。你很適合。

items.en: You must show your paintings to the art teacher.
items.zh: 你一定要把你的畫給美術老師看。

items.en: You must join the choir. They need more singers.
items.zh: 你一定要加入合唱團。他們需要更多人唱歌。

items.en: You must start your own cooking blog.
items.zh: 你一定要開一個自己的料理部落格。

items.en: You must take up running again. You loved it.
items.zh: 你一定要再開始跑步。你以前很喜歡。

title: Tomorrow evening there is a Laura Pausini concert in Turin. Shall we go?
translation: 看完電影後，我們去韓國餐廳好嗎？
name: shall we 表示建議（情態動詞）
sentences: Tomorrow evening there's a Laura Pausini concert in Turin. Shall we go?
There's a free jazz festival in the park this weekend. Shall we go together?
The circus is in town until Sunday. Shall we take the kids?
The new art gallery opens on Friday night. Shall we go and have a look?
My cousin is playing in a football final on Saturday. Shall we go and cheer for him?
There's a market by the harbour every Sunday. Shall we go after breakfast?
The film finishes at nine, and we won't have eaten. Shall we go to a Korean restaurant after it?
It's so hot today. Shall we get an ice cream after our swimming lesson?
The sunset will be beautiful tonight. Shall we walk home along the beach after dinner?
Dad gave us a new chess set. Shall we play a game after we finish our homework?
The museum closes at four, and the shops are open late. Shall we look round them after the museum?
Grandma sent us both a present. Shall we call her after we open them?
It's such a warm evening. Shall we eat outside in the garden?
It's pouring with rain. Shall we stay in and play cards?
I'm bored of studying. Shall we take a short break?
The snow is perfect for sledging. Shall we go up the hill?
You look tired after work. Shall we just order a takeaway tonight?
The beach is too crowded today. Shall we drive to the next bay?
Your parents' anniversary is next month. Shall we organise a surprise party?
We both want to get fit. Shall we join the gym together?
Summer is coming. Shall we plan a camping trip with the others?
The flat looks so plain. Shall we paint the living room green?
We never see Uncle Tom. Shall we visit him next weekend?
Our Spanish isn't improving. Shall we find a conversation class?
The waiter is busy. Shall we pay at the counter?
These two sofas are both nice. Shall we sit on them before we decide?
The dessert menu looks amazing. Shall we share a chocolate cake?
It's very noisy at this table. Shall we ask to move upstairs?
The queue is very long. Shall we come back later?
There's a sale on winter coats. Shall we have a quick look?
We've got lots of bags. Shall we take a taxi home from the shopping centre?

examples.heading: ① 消息 + Shall we go?：建議去活動

items.en: Tomorrow evening there's a Laura Pausini concert in Turin. Shall we go?
items.zh: 明天晚上在杜林有 Laura Pausini 的演唱會。我們要去嗎？

items.en: There's a free jazz festival in the park this weekend. Shall we go together?
items.zh: 這個週末公園有免費的爵士音樂節。我們一起去好嗎？

items.en: The circus is in town until Sunday. Shall we take the kids?
items.zh: 馬戲團在城裡待到星期天。我們帶孩子們去好嗎？

items.en: The new art gallery opens on Friday night. Shall we go and have a look?
items.zh: 新的美術館星期五晚上開幕。我們去看看好嗎？

items.en: My cousin is playing in a football final on Saturday. Shall we go and cheer for him?
items.zh: 我表哥星期六要踢足球決賽。我們去幫他加油好嗎？

items.en: There's a market by the harbour every Sunday. Shall we go after breakfast?
items.zh: 每個星期天港口邊都有市集。我們吃完早餐去好嗎？

examples.heading: ② Shall we + 原形動詞 + after + 名詞？：建議接下來做的事

items.en: The film finishes at nine, and we won't have eaten. Shall we go to a Korean restaurant after it?
items.zh: 電影九點結束，我們那時還沒吃飯。看完電影我們去吃韓國料理好嗎？

items.en: It's so hot today. Shall we get an ice cream after our swimming lesson?
items.zh: 今天好熱。上完游泳課我們去吃冰淇淋好嗎？

items.en: The sunset will be beautiful tonight. Shall we walk home along the beach after dinner?
items.zh: 今晚的夕陽會很美。吃完晚餐我們沿著海灘走回家好嗎？

items.en: Dad gave us a new chess set. Shall we play a game after we finish our homework?
items.zh: 爸爸送我們一副新的西洋棋。寫完功課我們下一盤棋好嗎？

items.en: The museum closes at four, and the shops are open late. Shall we look round them after the museum?
items.zh: 博物館四點關門，商店開得很晚。參觀完博物館我們去逛逛商店好嗎？

items.en: Grandma sent us both a present. Shall we call her after we open them?
items.zh: 奶奶寄了禮物給我們兩個。拆完禮物我們打電話給她好嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 情況 + Shall we + 原形動詞？：根據天氣和心情

items.en: It's such a warm evening. Shall we eat outside in the garden?
items.zh: 今天傍晚好暖和。我們在花園裡吃飯好嗎？

items.en: It's pouring with rain. Shall we stay in and play cards?
items.zh: 雨下得好大。我們待在家裡玩牌好嗎？

items.en: I'm bored of studying. Shall we take a short break?
items.zh: 我讀書讀膩了。我們休息一下好嗎？

items.en: The snow is perfect for sledging. Shall we go up the hill?
items.zh: 這場雪很適合滑雪橇。我們上山坡去好嗎？

items.en: You look tired after work. Shall we just order a takeaway tonight?
items.zh: 你下班看起來很累。我們今天晚上就叫外賣好嗎？

items.en: The beach is too crowded today. Shall we drive to the next bay?
items.zh: 今天海灘人太多了。我們開車去下一個海灣好嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Shall we + 原形動詞？：建議做計畫

items.en: Your parents' anniversary is next month. Shall we organise a surprise party?
items.zh: 你爸媽的結婚紀念日在下個月。我們辦一個驚喜派對好嗎？

items.en: We both want to get fit. Shall we join the gym together?
items.zh: 我們都想變健康。我們一起加入健身房好嗎？

items.en: Summer is coming. Shall we plan a camping trip with the others?
items.zh: 夏天快到了。我們跟其他人計畫一次露營好嗎？

items.en: The flat looks so plain. Shall we paint the living room green?
items.zh: 公寓看起來好單調。我們把客廳漆成綠色好嗎？

items.en: We never see Uncle Tom. Shall we visit him next weekend?
items.zh: 我們從來沒見到 Tom 叔叔。我們下個週末去看他好嗎？

items.en: Our Spanish isn't improving. Shall we find a conversation class?
items.zh: 我們的西班牙文都沒進步。我們找一個會話課好嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Shall we + 原形動詞？：在店裡和餐廳

items.en: The waiter is busy. Shall we pay at the counter?
items.zh: 服務生很忙。我們去櫃台付錢好嗎？

items.en: These two sofas are both nice. Shall we sit on them before we decide?
items.zh: 這兩張沙發都不錯。我們決定之前先坐坐看好嗎？

items.en: The dessert menu looks amazing. Shall we share a chocolate cake?
items.zh: 甜點菜單看起來好棒。我們分一個巧克力蛋糕好嗎？

items.en: It's very noisy at this table. Shall we ask to move upstairs?
items.zh: 這桌好吵。我們要求換到樓上好嗎？

items.en: The queue is very long. Shall we come back later?
items.zh: 隊伍好長。我們晚點再來好嗎？

items.en: There's a sale on winter coats. Shall we have a quick look?
items.zh: 冬天外套在特價。我們很快看一下好嗎？

items.en: We've got lots of bags. Shall we take a taxi home from the shopping centre?
items.zh: 我們有好多袋子。我們從購物中心搭計程車回家好嗎？

title: I think we should meet at 2 pm, and my mother will take us there, so don't worry.
translation: 你應該把你的吉他帶來。
name: should 表示建議
sentences: The ice rink opens at half past two. I think we should meet at two, and my mother will take us there, so don't worry.
The film starts at seven. I think we should meet in front of the cinema at half past six.
My house is easy to find. I think you should meet me there around four.
The bus station is very busy. I think we should meet by the ticket office.
I think we should meet a bit earlier so we can get good seats.
I think we should meet at the café next to the library.
We're going to sing around the campfire. You should bring your guitar.
The water is cold in the lake. You should bring a wetsuit.
There's nowhere to buy food on the island. You should bring a packed lunch.
We're going to look at birds. You should bring your binoculars.
My parents love meeting my friends. You should bring your sister too.
The path is muddy after the rain. You should bring your wellies.
It's Mum's birthday on Sunday. We should make her a cake.
The weather is perfect. We should have lunch in the park.
We should ask Anna to join us. She doesn't know many people here.
The exam is next week. We should study together after school.
We should take the early train to avoid the crowds.
We should split the bill. The meal was for all of us.
I think you should come to my house first, and then we can walk to the park.
I think you should call the restaurant and book a table.
I think you should choose the music for the party.
I think you should send the invitations this week.
I think you should ask your dad if he can drive us.
I think you should sit at the front so you can see.
It's getting late. Maybe we should go home.
The shop is closed. Maybe we should try the one on the high street.
Maybe we should wait until the rain stops.
Nobody knows the answer. Maybe we should ask the teacher.
Maybe we should take a map. The forest is very big.
Maybe we should invite the neighbours to the barbecue.
This restaurant is too expensive. Maybe we should eat somewhere else.

examples.heading: ① I think we should meet + 時間 / 地點：提議見面

items.en: The ice rink opens at half past two. I think we should meet at two, and my mother will take us there, so don't worry.
items.zh: 溜冰場兩點半開門。我想我們兩點見面，我媽媽會載我們去，所以別擔心。

items.en: The film starts at seven. I think we should meet in front of the cinema at half past six.
items.zh: 電影七點開始。我想我們六點半在電影院前面見面。

items.en: My house is easy to find. I think you should meet me there around four.
items.zh: 我家很好找。我想你大約四點來我家找我。

items.en: The bus station is very busy. I think we should meet by the ticket office.
items.zh: 公車站人很多。我想我們在售票處旁邊見面。

items.en: I think we should meet a bit earlier so we can get good seats.
items.zh: 我想我們早一點見面，這樣才能坐到好位子。

items.en: I think we should meet at the café next to the library.
items.zh: 我想我們在圖書館旁邊的咖啡館見面。

examples.heading: ② You should bring + 名詞：告訴對方帶什麼

items.en: We're going to sing around the campfire. You should bring your guitar.
items.zh: 我們會圍著營火唱歌。你應該帶你的吉他來。

items.en: The water is cold in the lake. You should bring a wetsuit.
items.zh: 湖水很冰。你應該帶潛水衣。

items.en: There's nowhere to buy food on the island. You should bring a packed lunch.
items.zh: 島上沒有地方買吃的。你應該帶午餐。

items.en: We're going to look at birds. You should bring your binoculars.
items.zh: 我們要去賞鳥。你應該帶你的望遠鏡。

items.en: My parents love meeting my friends. You should bring your sister too.
items.zh: 我爸媽很喜歡認識我的朋友。你也應該帶你妹妹來。

items.en: The path is muddy after the rain. You should bring your wellies.
items.zh: 下雨後小路很泥濘。你應該帶雨靴。

examples.heading: ③ We should + 原形動詞：提議一起做

items.en: It's Mum's birthday on Sunday. We should make her a cake.
items.zh: 星期天是媽媽的生日。我們應該幫她做個蛋糕。

items.en: The weather is perfect. We should have lunch in the park.
items.zh: 天氣很好。我們應該在公園吃午餐。

items.en: We should ask Anna to join us. She doesn't know many people here.
items.zh: 我們應該邀安娜一起來。她在這裡不認識很多人。

items.en: The exam is next week. We should study together after school.
items.zh: 考試在下星期。我們應該放學後一起讀書。

items.en: We should take the early train to avoid the crowds.
items.zh: 我們應該搭早班火車避開人潮。

items.en: We should split the bill. The meal was for all of us.
items.zh: 我們應該分攤帳單。這頓飯是大家一起吃的。

examples.heading: ④ I think you should + 原形動詞：請對方做

items.en: I think you should come to my house first, and then we can walk to the park.
items.zh: 我想你應該先來我家，然後我們可以一起走去公園。

items.en: I think you should call the restaurant and book a table.
items.zh: 我想你應該打電話給餐廳訂位。

items.en: I think you should choose the music for the party.
items.zh: 我想派對的音樂應該由你來選。

items.en: I think you should send the invitations this week.
items.zh: 我想你應該這個星期寄出邀請函。

items.en: I think you should ask your dad if he can drive us.
items.zh: 我想你應該問你爸爸可不可以載我們。

items.en: I think you should sit at the front so you can see.
items.zh: 我想你應該坐在前面，這樣才看得到。

examples.heading: ⑤ Maybe we should + 原形動詞：比較不確定的提議

items.en: It's getting late. Maybe we should go home.
items.zh: 很晚了。也許我們應該回家了。

items.en: The shop is closed. Maybe we should try the one on the high street.
items.zh: 那家店關了。也許我們應該去主要街道上那家試試。

items.en: Maybe we should wait until the rain stops.
items.zh: 也許我們應該等雨停。

items.en: Nobody knows the answer. Maybe we should ask the teacher.
items.zh: 沒有人知道答案。也許我們應該問老師。

items.en: Maybe we should take a map. The forest is very big.
items.zh: 也許我們應該帶一張地圖。森林很大。

items.en: Maybe we should invite the neighbours to the barbecue.
items.zh: 也許我們應該邀請鄰居來烤肉。

items.en: This restaurant is too expensive. Maybe we should eat somewhere else.
items.zh: 這家餐廳太貴了。也許我們應該去別的地方吃。

title: It would be perfect if you arrived at 7.20.
translation: 你要是能跟我一起去就太好了。
name: it would be 表示建議
sentences: The film starts at eight, and we can eat first. It would be perfect if you arrived at 7.20.
There's a jazz concert in the park. It would be very good if you came with me.
It would be great if you brought your guitar to the campfire.
It would be helpful if you sent me the address before Friday.
It would be lovely if you wrote a few words in Grandpa's birthday card.
It would be better if we left before the rush hour.
You're coming to stay on Saturday. It would be nice to bring your new computer game and some clothes for two days.
It would be nice to bring some photos from your trip.
It would be nice to have a picnic if the weather is good.
It would be nice to invite your sister too.
It would be nice to meet your parents one day.
It would be nice to have some music at the party.
It would be a good idea to book the tickets early.
It would be a good idea to take a map with you.
It would be a good idea to wear walking boots on the hill.
It would be a good idea to ask the teacher before you start.
It would be a good idea to leave your car at the station.
It would be a good idea to bring an umbrella just in case.
It would be better to take the train. The roads are very busy on Fridays.
It would be best to call before you visit.
It would be better to meet at the café, not the station.
It would be best to go early, before the crowds arrive.
The paint is still wet. It would be better to hang the pictures tomorrow.
It would be best to ask your parents first.
It would be easier for you to come by bus.
It would be good for the children to play outside.
It would be fun for us to go skating together.
It would be useful for you to learn some Spanish before the trip.
It would be nice for Grandma to see the baby.
It would be cheaper for us to share a taxi.
It would be safer for you to stay at our house tonight.

examples.heading: ① It would be + 形容詞 + if + 主詞 + 過去式：客氣的建議

items.en: The film starts at eight, and we can eat first. It would be perfect if you arrived at 7.20.
items.zh: 電影八點開始，我們可以先吃東西。如果你七點二十分到，那就太完美了。

items.en: There's a jazz concert in the park. It would be very good if you came with me.
items.zh: 公園裡有一場爵士音樂會。如果你跟我一起去就太好了。

items.en: It would be great if you brought your guitar to the campfire.
items.zh: 如果你帶你的吉他來營火晚會就太好了。

items.en: It would be helpful if you sent me the address before Friday.
items.zh: 如果你在星期五前把地址寄給我，會很有幫助。

items.en: It would be lovely if you wrote a few words in Grandpa's birthday card.
items.zh: 如果你在爺爺的生日卡上寫幾句話就太好了。

items.en: It would be better if we left before the rush hour.
items.zh: 如果我們在尖峰時段前出發會比較好。

examples.heading: ② It would be nice to + 原形動詞：建議對方帶或做

items.en: You're coming to stay on Saturday. It would be nice to bring your new computer game and some clothes for two days.
items.zh: 你星期六要來住。如果帶你的新電腦遊戲和兩天的衣服就好了。

items.en: It would be nice to bring some photos from your trip.
items.zh: 如果帶一些你旅行的照片來就好了。

items.en: It would be nice to have a picnic if the weather is good.
items.zh: 如果天氣好，去野餐就好了。

items.en: It would be nice to invite your sister too.
items.zh: 如果也邀請你妹妹就好了。

items.en: It would be nice to meet your parents one day.
items.zh: 如果有一天能認識你爸媽就好了。

items.en: It would be nice to have some music at the party.
items.zh: 如果派對上有一些音樂就好了。

examples.heading: ③ It would be a good idea to + 原形動詞

items.en: It would be a good idea to book the tickets early.
items.zh: 早點訂票會是個好主意。

items.en: It would be a good idea to take a map with you.
items.zh: 帶一張地圖會是個好主意。

items.en: It would be a good idea to wear walking boots on the hill.
items.zh: 在山丘上穿健行靴會是個好主意。

items.en: It would be a good idea to ask the teacher before you start.
items.zh: 開始之前問老師會是個好主意。

items.en: It would be a good idea to leave your car at the station.
items.zh: 把車留在車站會是個好主意。

items.en: It would be a good idea to bring an umbrella just in case.
items.zh: 帶把傘以防萬一會是個好主意。

examples.heading: ④ It would be + better / best + to + 原形動詞：比較好的做法

items.en: It would be better to take the train. The roads are very busy on Fridays.
items.zh: 搭火車會比較好。星期五路上很塞。

items.en: It would be best to call before you visit.
items.zh: 你去拜訪之前最好先打電話。

items.en: It would be better to meet at the café, not the station.
items.zh: 在咖啡館碰面會比較好，不要在車站。

items.en: It would be best to go early, before the crowds arrive.
items.zh: 最好早點去，在人潮出現之前。

items.en: The paint is still wet. It would be better to hang the pictures tomorrow.
items.zh: 油漆還沒乾。明天再掛畫會比較好。

items.en: It would be best to ask your parents first.
items.zh: 最好先問你爸媽。

examples.heading: ⑤ It would be + 形容詞 + for + 人 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: It would be easier for you to come by bus.
items.zh: 你搭公車來會比較方便。

items.en: It would be good for the children to play outside.
items.zh: 孩子們在外面玩會很好。

items.en: It would be fun for us to go skating together.
items.zh: 我們一起去溜冰會很好玩。

items.en: It would be useful for you to learn some Spanish before the trip.
items.zh: 旅行前你學一點西班牙文會很有用。

items.en: It would be nice for Grandma to see the baby.
items.zh: 讓奶奶看看寶寶會很好。

items.en: It would be cheaper for us to share a taxi.
items.zh: 我們共乘一輛計程車會比較便宜。

items.en: It would be safer for you to stay at our house tonight.
items.zh: 你今天晚上住我們家會比較安全。

title: Can you believe they invented a robot that plays football?
translation: 你敢相信他們發明了一個會踢足球的機器人嗎？
name: can you believe 表示驚訝
sentences: Can you believe he's only fifteen and already plays for the national team?
Can you believe it's snowing in April?
Can you believe that Tom passed his driving test on the first try?
Can you believe they're getting married after only three months?
Can you believe our teacher gave us no homework this weekend?
Can you believe the shop charged me twice for the same shoes?
Can you believe that my grandma has her own YouTube channel?
Can you believe we've known each other for twenty years?
Can you believe she ran the whole marathon with a broken toe?
Can you believe the train was three hours late?
Can you believe our team actually won the cup?
Can you believe how much they paid for that house?
Can you believe what he said to the teacher?
Can you believe how fast the children are growing?
Can you believe how cold it is today?
Can you believe what happened at the party last night?
Can you believe how many people came to the concert?
The museum let us in for free. Can you believe this?
The repair cost more than the car! Can you believe that!
My brother cleaned the whole house without anyone asking him. Can you believe it?
We waited two hours for a table. Can you believe that?
The cat opened the fridge by itself. Can you believe it?
I found fifty pounds in my old jacket. Can you believe it?
He forgot his own wedding anniversary. Can you believe that?
The flight to Rome was cheaper than the train. Can you believe it?
My little sister read the whole book in one day. Can you believe this?
We've won a holiday in Spain! Can you believe it? I can't believe it!
Can you believe it? The concert is sold out already. I can't believe it!
She said yes! Can you believe it? I still can't believe it.
Can you believe it? Our old teacher remembered my name after ten years.
Can you believe it? The house we wanted is for sale again.

examples.heading: ① Can you believe + (that) + 子句?

items.en: Can you believe he's only fifteen and already plays for the national team?
items.zh: 你敢相信他才十五歲就已經進國家隊了嗎？

items.en: Can you believe it's snowing in April?
items.zh: 你敢相信四月在下雪嗎？

items.en: Can you believe that Tom passed his driving test on the first try?
items.zh: 你敢相信 Tom 第一次就考過駕照嗎？

items.en: Can you believe they're getting married after only three months?
items.zh: 你敢相信他們才交往三個月就要結婚了嗎？

items.en: Can you believe our teacher gave us no homework this weekend?
items.zh: 你敢相信老師這個週末沒出功課嗎？

items.en: Can you believe the shop charged me twice for the same shoes?
items.zh: 你敢相信那家店同一雙鞋跟我收了兩次錢嗎？

items.en: Can you believe that my grandma has her own YouTube channel?
items.zh: 你敢相信我奶奶有自己的 YouTube 頻道嗎？

items.en: Can you believe we've known each other for twenty years?
items.zh: 你敢相信我們認識二十年了嗎？

items.en: Can you believe she ran the whole marathon with a broken toe?
items.zh: 你敢相信她腳趾骨折還跑完整場馬拉松嗎？

items.en: Can you believe the train was three hours late?
items.zh: 你敢相信火車誤點了三個小時嗎？

items.en: Can you believe our team actually won the cup?
items.zh: 你敢相信我們隊真的贏得了獎盃嗎？

examples.heading: ② Can you believe + how / what + 子句?

items.en: Can you believe how much they paid for that house?
items.zh: 你敢相信他們花多少錢買那間房子嗎？

items.en: Can you believe what he said to the teacher?
items.zh: 你敢相信他跟老師說了什麼嗎？

items.en: Can you believe how fast the children are growing?
items.zh: 你敢相信孩子們長得多快嗎？

items.en: Can you believe how cold it is today?
items.zh: 你敢相信今天有多冷嗎？

items.en: Can you believe what happened at the party last night?
items.zh: 你敢相信昨晚派對上發生了什麼事嗎？

items.en: Can you believe how many people came to the concert?
items.zh: 你敢相信有多少人來聽演唱會嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 子句. Can you believe it / this / that?

items.en: The museum let us in for free. Can you believe this?
items.zh: 博物館讓我們免費進去，你相信嗎？

items.en: The repair cost more than the car! Can you believe that!
items.zh: 修理費比車子還貴！你相信嗎！

items.en: My brother cleaned the whole house without anyone asking him. Can you believe it?
items.zh: 我哥沒人叫他就把整間房子打掃乾淨了，你相信嗎？

items.en: We waited two hours for a table. Can you believe that?
items.zh: 我們等了兩個小時才有位子，你相信嗎？

items.en: The cat opened the fridge by itself. Can you believe it?
items.zh: 那隻貓自己開了冰箱，你相信嗎？

items.en: I found fifty pounds in my old jacket. Can you believe it?
items.zh: 我在舊外套裡找到五十英鎊，你相信嗎？

items.en: He forgot his own wedding anniversary. Can you believe that?
items.zh: 他忘了自己的結婚紀念日，你相信嗎？

items.en: The flight to Rome was cheaper than the train. Can you believe it?
items.zh: 飛羅馬的機票比火車票還便宜，你相信嗎？

items.en: My little sister read the whole book in one day. Can you believe this?
items.zh: 我妹一天就讀完了整本書，你相信嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Can you believe it? + I can't believe it!

items.en: We've won a holiday in Spain! Can you believe it? I can't believe it!
items.zh: 我們贏得了西班牙的假期！你相信嗎？我真不敢相信！

items.en: Can you believe it? The concert is sold out already. I can't believe it!
items.zh: 你相信嗎？演唱會的票已經賣完了，我真不敢相信！

items.en: She said yes! Can you believe it? I still can't believe it.
items.zh: 她答應了！你相信嗎？我還是不敢相信。

items.en: Can you believe it? Our old teacher remembered my name after ten years.
items.zh: 你相信嗎？我們以前的老師過了十年還記得我的名字。

items.en: Can you believe it? The house we wanted is for sale again.
items.zh: 你相信嗎？我們想要的那間房子又在賣了。

title: Thank you for the present you sent me. You shouldn't have!
translation: 謝謝你的錢，不過你真的不用寄給我的。
name: you shouldn't have 表示道謝
sentences: Thank you for the lovely scarf you sent me for my birthday. You shouldn't have!
Flowers for me? Oh, thank you, you shouldn't have!
A box of chocolates! Thank you so much, you shouldn't have.
Thank you for the cake. You shouldn't have, but it looks delicious.
Tickets for the concert? Thank you, you really shouldn't have!
Thank you for the book you left on my desk. You shouldn't have!
Thank you for the money, but you shouldn't have sent so much.
You shouldn't have bought me such an expensive present.
You shouldn't have sent flowers all the way from Spain.
You shouldn't have bought tickets for all of us.
You shouldn't have brought wine. We have plenty.
You shouldn't have paid for the meal. It was my turn.
What a wonderful dinner! You shouldn't have gone to all this trouble.
You shouldn't have cleaned the whole house for us.
You shouldn't have driven all this way just to bring me a present.
You shouldn't have made a cake. A card would have been enough.
You shouldn't have waited for me in the rain.
You shouldn't have taken a day off work to help me move.
Oh, you shouldn't have! It's beautiful.
A new watch? You shouldn't have! It's perfect.
Oh, you shouldn't have! It's exactly what I wanted.
You shouldn't have! It's far too generous.
Oh, you shouldn't have! It's my favourite colour.
A handmade card? You shouldn't have! It's lovely.
You shouldn't have, but I'm so glad you did.
You shouldn't have, but thank you. I'll wear it tonight.
You shouldn't have, but the children will love it.
You shouldn't have, but it's very kind of you.
You shouldn't have, but I'll put it on the wall right away.
You shouldn't have, but it will be very useful in my new flat.
You shouldn't have, but I'll think of you every time I use it.

examples.heading: ① Thank you …, you shouldn't have!

items.en: Thank you for the lovely scarf you sent me for my birthday. You shouldn't have!
items.zh: 謝謝你寄給我的那條漂亮圍巾當生日禮物。你太客氣了！

items.en: Flowers for me? Oh, thank you, you shouldn't have!
items.zh: 送我的花？噢，謝謝你，你太客氣了！

items.en: A box of chocolates! Thank you so much, you shouldn't have.
items.zh: 一盒巧克力！非常謝謝你，你太客氣了。

items.en: Thank you for the cake. You shouldn't have, but it looks delicious.
items.zh: 謝謝你的蛋糕。你太客氣了，可是看起來很好吃。

items.en: Tickets for the concert? Thank you, you really shouldn't have!
items.zh: 演唱會的票？謝謝你，你真的太客氣了！

items.en: Thank you for the book you left on my desk. You shouldn't have!
items.zh: 謝謝你放在我桌上的書。你太客氣了！

examples.heading: ② You shouldn't have + sent / bought + 名詞

items.en: Thank you for the money, but you shouldn't have sent so much.
items.zh: 謝謝你給的錢，可是你不必寄那麼多。

items.en: You shouldn't have bought me such an expensive present.
items.zh: 你不必買這麼貴的禮物給我的。

items.en: You shouldn't have sent flowers all the way from Spain.
items.zh: 你不必從西班牙寄花來的。

items.en: You shouldn't have bought tickets for all of us.
items.zh: 你不必幫我們所有人買票的。

items.en: You shouldn't have brought wine. We have plenty.
items.zh: 你不必帶酒來的。我們有很多。

items.en: You shouldn't have paid for the meal. It was my turn.
items.zh: 你不必請這頓飯的。這次輪到我。

examples.heading: ③ You shouldn't have gone to all this trouble：對方花了很多心思

items.en: What a wonderful dinner! You shouldn't have gone to all this trouble.
items.zh: 好棒的晚餐！你不必這麼費心的。

items.en: You shouldn't have cleaned the whole house for us.
items.zh: 你不必為了我們打掃整間房子的。

items.en: You shouldn't have driven all this way just to bring me a present.
items.zh: 你不必只為了送我禮物開這麼遠的車來的。

items.en: You shouldn't have made a cake. A card would have been enough.
items.zh: 你不必做蛋糕的。一張卡片就夠了。

items.en: You shouldn't have waited for me in the rain.
items.zh: 你不必在雨中等我的。

items.en: You shouldn't have taken a day off work to help me move.
items.zh: 你不必為了幫我搬家請一天假的。

examples.heading: ④ Oh, you shouldn't have! It's + 形容詞

items.en: Oh, you shouldn't have! It's beautiful.
items.zh: 噢，你太客氣了！好漂亮。

items.en: A new watch? You shouldn't have! It's perfect.
items.zh: 一支新手錶？你太客氣了！太完美了。

items.en: Oh, you shouldn't have! It's exactly what I wanted.
items.zh: 噢，你太客氣了！這正是我想要的。

items.en: You shouldn't have! It's far too generous.
items.zh: 你太客氣了！這太大方了。

items.en: Oh, you shouldn't have! It's my favourite colour.
items.zh: 噢，你太客氣了！這是我最喜歡的顏色。

items.en: A handmade card? You shouldn't have! It's lovely.
items.zh: 手作卡片？你太客氣了！好可愛。

examples.heading: ⑤ You shouldn't have, but + 句子：收下禮物

items.en: You shouldn't have, but I'm so glad you did.
items.zh: 你太客氣了，可是我很高興你這麼做。

items.en: You shouldn't have, but thank you. I'll wear it tonight.
items.zh: 你太客氣了，可是謝謝你。我今天晚上就會穿。

items.en: You shouldn't have, but the children will love it.
items.zh: 你太客氣了，可是孩子們會很喜歡。

items.en: You shouldn't have, but it's very kind of you.
items.zh: 你太客氣了，可是你真好心。

items.en: You shouldn't have, but I'll put it on the wall right away.
items.zh: 你太客氣了，可是我馬上把它掛到牆上。

items.en: You shouldn't have, but it will be very useful in my new flat.
items.zh: 你太客氣了，可是它在我的新公寓會很有用。

items.en: You shouldn't have, but I'll think of you every time I use it.
items.zh: 你太客氣了，可是我每次用的時候都會想到你。

title: No one can imagine what children will do!
translation: 誰都想不到小孩會做出什麼事來！
name: will 表示習性（多表示不滿）
sentences: I left the kitchen for five minutes and there was flour everywhere. No one can imagine what children will do!
You never know what a cat will do when you open a box.
Nobody knows what teenagers will say next.
You can't guess what my grandfather will do at a party.
Who knows what the weather will do in the mountains?
You can never tell what a puppy will chew next.
My brother will leave his dirty socks on the bathroom floor.
Our neighbour will play loud music late at night.
My flatmate will eat my food without asking.
He will talk on his phone during films.
My dad will fall asleep in front of the TV every evening.
She will borrow my clothes and never give them back.
He broke the window playing football. Well, boys will be boys.
Accidents will happen, so don't be too hard on yourself.
Children will be children. They need to run around.
Mistakes will happen when you're learning something new.
Dogs will be dogs. They love to roll in the mud.
Teenagers will be teenagers. They like to sleep late.
The baby will keep pulling the cat's tail.
My sister will keep asking me the same question.
That car alarm will keep going off in the middle of the night.
The students will keep talking while I'm explaining.
He will keep interrupting me in meetings.
The dog will keep jumping on the sofa.
If you will stay up so late, of course you'll be tired in the morning.
If you will eat so much chocolate, you'll feel sick.
If you will leave your bike outside, someone will take it.
If you will drive so fast, you'll get a fine.
If you will wear those thin shoes in the snow, your feet will get cold.
If you will spend all your money on clothes, you won't have any for the holiday.
If you will forget your homework, the teacher will be angry.

examples.heading: ① what + 主詞 + will do：無法預料的行為

items.en: I left the kitchen for five minutes and there was flour everywhere. No one can imagine what children will do!
items.zh: 我才離開廚房五分鐘，到處都是麵粉。沒有人能想像孩子們會做出什麼事！

items.en: You never know what a cat will do when you open a box.
items.zh: 你打開箱子的時候，永遠不知道貓會做出什麼事。

items.en: Nobody knows what teenagers will say next.
items.zh: 沒有人知道青少年接下來會說什麼。

items.en: You can't guess what my grandfather will do at a party.
items.zh: 你猜不到我爺爺在派對上會做出什麼事。

items.en: Who knows what the weather will do in the mountains?
items.zh: 誰知道山上的天氣會怎樣？

items.en: You can never tell what a puppy will chew next.
items.zh: 你永遠不知道小狗接下來會咬什麼。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + will + 原形動詞：讓人煩的習慣

items.en: My brother will leave his dirty socks on the bathroom floor.
items.zh: 我哥哥就是會把髒襪子丟在浴室地板上。

items.en: Our neighbour will play loud music late at night.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居就是會在半夜放很大聲的音樂。

items.en: My flatmate will eat my food without asking.
items.zh: 我的室友就是會沒問就吃我的食物。

items.en: He will talk on his phone during films.
items.zh: 他就是會在看電影的時候講電話。

items.en: My dad will fall asleep in front of the TV every evening.
items.zh: 我爸爸每天晚上就是會在電視前面睡著。

items.en: She will borrow my clothes and never give them back.
items.zh: 她就是會借我的衣服，然後從來不還。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + will be + 名詞：俗語和一般的說法

items.en: He broke the window playing football. Well, boys will be boys.
items.zh: 他踢足球打破了窗戶。唉，男孩子就是這樣。

items.en: Accidents will happen, so don't be too hard on yourself.
items.zh: 意外總是會發生，所以不要對自己太嚴格。

items.en: Children will be children. They need to run around.
items.zh: 孩子就是孩子。他們需要跑來跑去。

items.en: Mistakes will happen when you're learning something new.
items.zh: 學新東西的時候總是會犯錯。

items.en: Dogs will be dogs. They love to roll in the mud.
items.zh: 狗就是狗。牠們喜歡在泥巴裡打滾。

items.en: Teenagers will be teenagers. They like to sleep late.
items.zh: 青少年就是青少年。他們喜歡睡懶覺。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + will keep + -ing：一直做讓人煩的事

items.en: The baby will keep pulling the cat's tail.
items.zh: 寶寶一直拉貓的尾巴。

items.en: My sister will keep asking me the same question.
items.zh: 我妹妹一直問我同一個問題。

items.en: That car alarm will keep going off in the middle of the night.
items.zh: 那個汽車警報器半夜一直響。

items.en: The students will keep talking while I'm explaining.
items.zh: 我在解釋的時候，學生一直說話。

items.en: He will keep interrupting me in meetings.
items.zh: 開會的時候他一直打斷我。

items.en: The dog will keep jumping on the sofa.
items.zh: 那隻狗一直跳到沙發上。

examples.heading: ⑤ If you will + 原形動詞, + 句子：自己造成的後果

items.en: If you will stay up so late, of course you'll be tired in the morning.
items.zh: 如果你硬要熬夜到那麼晚，早上當然會累。

items.en: If you will eat so much chocolate, you'll feel sick.
items.zh: 如果你硬要吃那麼多巧克力，你會不舒服。

items.en: If you will leave your bike outside, someone will take it.
items.zh: 如果你硬要把腳踏車放在外面，會有人拿走。

items.en: If you will drive so fast, you'll get a fine.
items.zh: 如果你硬要開那麼快，你會被罰錢。

items.en: If you will wear those thin shoes in the snow, your feet will get cold.
items.zh: 如果你硬要在雪地穿那雙薄鞋，你的腳會冷。

items.en: If you will spend all your money on clothes, you won't have any for the holiday.
items.zh: 如果你硬要把錢都花在衣服上，你就沒錢去度假了。

items.en: If you will forget your homework, the teacher will be angry.
items.zh: 如果你硬是忘了帶功課，老師會生氣。

title: We had to leave without you because the bus driver wouldn't wait.
translation: 我們只好不等你先走了，因為巴士司機不肯等。
name: wouldn't 表示過去不願意
sentences: Sorry we left without you this morning. We had to go because the bus driver wouldn't wait.
I asked the shop for a refund, but they wouldn't give me my money back.
My little brother wouldn't eat his dinner last night.
The children wouldn't go to bed until midnight.
She wouldn't tell me why she was upset.
The waiter wouldn't let us sit by the window.
I wanted that guitar more than anything, but my parents would not allow me to buy it.
When I was fourteen, my dad wouldn't let me take the train to London by myself.
The teacher would not allow us to use our phones in class.
My mum wouldn't let me have a dog when I was small.
The guard wouldn't let us into the building without a pass.
The doctor would not allow him to play football for a month.
We were late because the car wouldn't start.
The window wouldn't open, so the room was very hot.
My computer wouldn't turn on this morning.
The key wouldn't turn in the lock.
The printer wouldn't work, so I couldn't print my homework.
It was so cold that the tap in the garden wouldn't turn.
The shop wouldn't take cards, so I had to find a cash machine.
My brother wouldn't share his bike, so I walked to school.
The baby wouldn't stop crying, so we took her for a drive.
The hotel wouldn't give us a bigger room, so we went somewhere else.
The dog wouldn't come inside, so we left the door open.
My friend wouldn't listen to my advice, so she made a big mistake.
He would not change his mind, no matter what we said.
The cat would not come down, no matter how much we called her.
She would not say sorry, no matter how angry her mother was.
The old man would not sell his house, no matter how much money they offered.
My grandfather would not use a mobile phone, no matter how often we asked.
The door would not open, no matter how hard I pushed.
The children would not sleep, no matter what story I read them.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + wouldn't + 原形動詞：別人不肯做

items.en: Sorry we left without you this morning. We had to go because the bus driver wouldn't wait.
items.zh: 抱歉我們今天早上沒等你就走了。我們只好先走，因為巴士司機不肯等。

items.en: I asked the shop for a refund, but they wouldn't give me my money back.
items.zh: 我跟那家店要求退款，可是他們不肯退錢給我。

items.en: My little brother wouldn't eat his dinner last night.
items.zh: 我弟弟昨天晚上不肯吃晚餐。

items.en: The children wouldn't go to bed until midnight.
items.zh: 孩子們一直到半夜都不肯睡覺。

items.en: She wouldn't tell me why she was upset.
items.zh: 她不肯告訴我她為什麼難過。

items.en: The waiter wouldn't let us sit by the window.
items.zh: 服務生不讓我們坐在窗邊。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + would not allow / let + 人 + …：過去不准

items.en: I wanted that guitar more than anything, but my parents would not allow me to buy it.
items.zh: 我想要那把吉他想得要命，可是我爸媽不准我買。

items.en: When I was fourteen, my dad wouldn't let me take the train to London by myself.
items.zh: 我十四歲的時候，我爸爸不讓我一個人搭火車去倫敦。

items.en: The teacher would not allow us to use our phones in class.
items.zh: 老師不准我們上課用手機。

items.en: My mum wouldn't let me have a dog when I was small.
items.zh: 我小時候我媽媽不讓我養狗。

items.en: The guard wouldn't let us into the building without a pass.
items.zh: 沒有通行證，警衛不讓我們進大樓。

items.en: The doctor would not allow him to play football for a month.
items.zh: 醫生一個月內不准他踢足球。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + wouldn't + 原形動詞：東西不能用

items.en: We were late because the car wouldn't start.
items.zh: 我們遲到了，因為車子發不動。

items.en: The window wouldn't open, so the room was very hot.
items.zh: 窗戶打不開，所以房間很熱。

items.en: My computer wouldn't turn on this morning.
items.zh: 我的電腦今天早上開不了機。

items.en: The key wouldn't turn in the lock.
items.zh: 鑰匙在鎖裡轉不動。

items.en: The printer wouldn't work, so I couldn't print my homework.
items.zh: 印表機不能用，所以我沒辦法印功課。

items.en: It was so cold that the tap in the garden wouldn't turn.
items.zh: 天氣太冷了，花園的水龍頭轉不動。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + wouldn't + 原形動詞, so + 句子：結果

items.en: The shop wouldn't take cards, so I had to find a cash machine.
items.zh: 那家店不收卡，所以我只好找提款機。

items.en: My brother wouldn't share his bike, so I walked to school.
items.zh: 我哥哥不肯借我腳踏車，所以我走路上學。

items.en: The baby wouldn't stop crying, so we took her for a drive.
items.zh: 寶寶一直哭個不停，所以我們開車載她出去兜風。

items.en: The hotel wouldn't give us a bigger room, so we went somewhere else.
items.zh: 飯店不肯給我們大一點的房間，所以我們去了別的地方。

items.en: The dog wouldn't come inside, so we left the door open.
items.zh: 狗不肯進來，所以我們讓門開著。

items.en: My friend wouldn't listen to my advice, so she made a big mistake.
items.zh: 我朋友不肯聽我的建議，所以她犯了一個大錯。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + would not + 原形動詞, no matter + 子句：怎樣都不肯

items.en: He would not change his mind, no matter what we said.
items.zh: 不管我們說什麼，他都不肯改變主意。

items.en: The cat would not come down, no matter how much we called her.
items.zh: 不管我們叫了多少次，那隻貓都不肯下來。

items.en: She would not say sorry, no matter how angry her mother was.
items.zh: 不管她媽媽有多生氣，她都不肯道歉。

items.en: The old man would not sell his house, no matter how much money they offered.
items.zh: 不管他們出多少錢，那個老人都不肯賣他的房子。

items.en: My grandfather would not use a mobile phone, no matter how often we asked.
items.zh: 不管我們問了多少次，我爺爺都不肯用手機。

items.en: The door would not open, no matter how hard I pushed.
items.zh: 不管我多用力推，門都打不開。

items.en: The children would not sleep, no matter what story I read them.
items.zh: 不管我唸什麼故事給他們聽，孩子們都不肯睡。

title: My mother will get us there, and she will bring us back to my house after.
translation: 我媽媽會送我們過去，之後她會再載我們回我家。
name: will 表示意願和主動幫忙（情態動詞）
sentences: Don't worry about getting to the pool. My mother will take us there, and she will bring us back to my house afterwards.
My dad will pick us up after the party, so you don't need a taxi.
My grandmother will look after the dog while we're away.
My brother will help you move the furniture on Saturday.
You haven't got a sleeping bag? My aunt will lend you hers.
My parents will pay for your ticket, so don't worry about the money.
The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
You look tired. I'll make dinner tonight.
That box is too heavy for you. I'll carry it upstairs.
You don't have a pen? I'll lend you mine.
The baby's crying. I'll go and see what's wrong.
It's raining hard. I'll drive you to the station.
Don't worry about the party food. We'll bring some sandwiches and a cake.
We'll wash up after dinner. You sit down and relax.
We'll paint your fence on Sunday if you like.
We'll wait for you outside the cinema.
We'll help you look for your keys.
We'll call the doctor for you.
My little brother won't eat his vegetables.
I've tried three times, but the old lawnmower won't start this morning.
My sister has been crying all evening, but she won't say a word about it.
The window won't open. It's stuck.
My dad won't let me go to the concert.
The dog won't come inside. It loves the snow.
My uncle will drive us to the airport if we leave before six.
I'll help you with your homework if you help me with mine.
The neighbours will water our plants if we ask them.
My sister will cut your hair if you buy her a coffee.
Mr Lee will go over the grammar again after class if anyone is still confused.
I'll come with you to the dentist if you're nervous.
The shop will deliver the sofa if you pay a small fee.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + will + 原形動詞：家人願意幫忙

items.en: Don't worry about getting to the pool. My mother will take us there, and she will bring us back to my house afterwards.
items.zh: 別擔心怎麼去游泳池。我媽媽會載我們去，之後也會載我們回我家。

items.en: My dad will pick us up after the party, so you don't need a taxi.
items.zh: 派對結束後我爸爸會來接我們，所以你不需要叫計程車。

items.en: My grandmother will look after the dog while we're away.
items.zh: 我們不在的時候，我奶奶會照顧狗。

items.en: My brother will help you move the furniture on Saturday.
items.zh: 我哥哥星期六會幫你搬家具。

items.en: You haven't got a sleeping bag? My aunt will lend you hers.
items.zh: 你沒有睡袋？我阿姨會借你她的。

items.en: My parents will pay for your ticket, so don't worry about the money.
items.zh: 我爸媽會付你的票錢，所以不用擔心錢的事。

examples.heading: ② I'll + 原形動詞：當下決定主動幫忙

items.en: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
items.zh: 電話在響。我來接。

items.en: You look tired. I'll make dinner tonight.
items.zh: 你看起來很累。今天晚上我來煮晚餐。

items.en: That box is too heavy for you. I'll carry it upstairs.
items.zh: 那個箱子對你來說太重了。我幫你搬上樓。

items.en: You don't have a pen? I'll lend you mine.
items.zh: 你沒有筆？我借你我的。

items.en: The baby's crying. I'll go and see what's wrong.
items.zh: 寶寶在哭。我去看看怎麼了。

items.en: It's raining hard. I'll drive you to the station.
items.zh: 雨下得好大。我開車送你去車站。

examples.heading: ③ We'll + 原形動詞：大家一起幫忙

items.en: Don't worry about the party food. We'll bring some sandwiches and a cake.
items.zh: 別擔心派對的食物。我們會帶一些三明治和一個蛋糕。

items.en: We'll wash up after dinner. You sit down and relax.
items.zh: 晚餐後我們來洗碗。你坐下來休息。

items.en: We'll paint your fence on Sunday if you like.
items.zh: 如果你想要，我們星期天幫你油漆圍籬。

items.en: We'll wait for you outside the cinema.
items.zh: 我們會在電影院外面等你。

items.en: We'll help you look for your keys.
items.zh: 我們幫你找鑰匙。

items.en: We'll call the doctor for you.
items.zh: 我們幫你打電話給醫生。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + won't + 原形動詞：不願意、不肯

items.en: My little brother won't eat his vegetables.
items.zh: 我弟弟不肯吃他的蔬菜。

items.en: I've tried three times, but the old lawnmower won't start this morning.
items.zh: 我試了三次，可是那台舊割草機今天早上就是發不動。

items.en: My sister has been crying all evening, but she won't say a word about it.
items.zh: 我妹妹哭了一整晚，可是她一個字都不肯說。

items.en: The window won't open. It's stuck.
items.zh: 窗戶打不開。卡住了。

items.en: My dad won't let me go to the concert.
items.zh: 我爸爸不讓我去聽演唱會。

items.en: The dog won't come inside. It loves the snow.
items.zh: 狗不肯進來。牠很喜歡雪。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + will + 原形動詞 + if + 子句：願意的條件

items.en: My uncle will drive us to the airport if we leave before six.
items.zh: 如果我們六點前出發，我叔叔會開車載我們去機場。

items.en: I'll help you with your homework if you help me with mine.
items.zh: 如果你幫我寫功課，我就幫你寫你的。

items.en: The neighbours will water our plants if we ask them.
items.zh: 如果我們拜託，鄰居會幫我們澆花。

items.en: My sister will cut your hair if you buy her a coffee.
items.zh: 如果你請我姊姊喝咖啡，她會幫你剪頭髮。

items.en: Mr Lee will go over the grammar again after class if anyone is still confused.
items.zh: 如果還有人不懂，李老師下課後會再講一次文法。

items.en: I'll come with you to the dentist if you're nervous.
items.zh: 如果你很緊張，我會陪你去看牙醫。

items.en: The shop will deliver the sofa if you pay a small fee.
items.zh: 如果你付一點費用，那家店會幫你送沙發。

title: I would prefer to go on Sunday, because on Sunday I have no school.
translation: 我比較想星期天去，因為星期天我不用上學。
name: would 表示願望和偏好
sentences: I would prefer to go to the theme park on Sunday, because on Sunday I have no school.
I would prefer to see the film tomorrow, because I'm very tired tonight.
I would prefer to travel by train, because I can read on the way.
I would prefer to eat at home, because restaurants are so expensive.
I would prefer to meet in the morning, because I work in the afternoon.
I would prefer to study alone, because I can concentrate better.
You've got the band's new CD? Bring it on Saturday! I'd love to hear it!
Your holiday sounds amazing. I'd love to see your photos.
Thanks for the invitation. I'd love to come to your wedding.
I'd love to try your grandmother's famous soup.
Your garden sounds beautiful in spring. I'd love to visit it in April.
I'd love to help you paint your room.
I'd rather walk to school than take the crowded bus.
I'd rather stay at home than go to that boring party.
I'd rather have a small house in the country than a big flat in the city.
I'd rather read a book than watch TV.
I'd rather pay a bit more than wait two weeks.
I'd rather go swimming than play football.
"Coffee or tea?" "I'd prefer tea, please."
I'd prefer the blue jacket. The red one is too bright.
I'd prefer a seat near the front.
I'd prefer a quiet holiday this year.
I'd prefer the chicken to the fish.
I'd prefer a small party with close friends.
I'd rather not talk about my exam results.
I'd rather not go out tonight. It's freezing.
She'd rather not sit at the back.
We'd rather not drive in the snow.
I'd rather not eat too late.
He'd rather not work at the weekend.
The job isn't certain, so I'd rather not mention it to my parents.

examples.heading: ① I would prefer to + 原形動詞 + because + 子句

items.en: I would prefer to go to the theme park on Sunday, because on Sunday I have no school.
items.zh: 我比較想星期天去遊樂園，因為星期天我不用上課。

items.en: I would prefer to see the film tomorrow, because I'm very tired tonight.
items.zh: 我比較想明天去看電影，因為我今天晚上很累。

items.en: I would prefer to travel by train, because I can read on the way.
items.zh: 我比較想搭火車旅行，因為我可以在路上讀書。

items.en: I would prefer to eat at home, because restaurants are so expensive.
items.zh: 我比較想在家吃飯，因為餐廳太貴了。

items.en: I would prefer to meet in the morning, because I work in the afternoon.
items.zh: 我比較想早上見面，因為我下午要工作。

items.en: I would prefer to study alone, because I can concentrate better.
items.zh: 我比較想一個人讀書，因為我比較能專心。

examples.heading: ② I'd love to + 原形動詞：熱情地說想做

items.en: You've got the band's new CD? Bring it on Saturday! I'd love to hear it!
items.zh: 你有那個樂團的新 CD？星期六帶來！我很想聽！

items.en: Your holiday sounds amazing. I'd love to see your photos.
items.zh: 你的假期聽起來好棒。我很想看你的照片。

items.en: Thanks for the invitation. I'd love to come to your wedding.
items.zh: 謝謝你的邀請。我很想去參加你的婚禮。

items.en: I'd love to try your grandmother's famous soup.
items.zh: 我很想嚐嚐你奶奶有名的湯。

items.en: Your garden sounds beautiful in spring. I'd love to visit it in April.
items.zh: 你的花園春天聽起來好美。我很想四月去看看。

items.en: I'd love to help you paint your room.
items.zh: 我很想幫你油漆你的房間。

examples.heading: ③ I'd rather + 原形動詞 + than + 原形動詞：寧願

items.en: I'd rather walk to school than take the crowded bus.
items.zh: 我寧願走路上學，也不要搭很擠的公車。

items.en: I'd rather stay at home than go to that boring party.
items.zh: 我寧願待在家裡，也不要去那個無聊的派對。

items.en: I'd rather have a small house in the country than a big flat in the city.
items.zh: 我寧願在鄉下有一間小房子，也不要在城市有一間大公寓。

items.en: I'd rather read a book than watch TV.
items.zh: 我寧願讀書，也不要看電視。

items.en: I'd rather pay a bit more than wait two weeks.
items.zh: 我寧願多付一點錢，也不要等兩個星期。

items.en: I'd rather go swimming than play football.
items.zh: 我寧願去游泳，也不要踢足球。

examples.heading: ④ I'd prefer + 名詞：選擇東西

items.en: "Coffee or tea?" "I'd prefer tea, please."
items.zh: 咖啡還是茶？我比較想喝茶，謝謝。

items.en: I'd prefer the blue jacket. The red one is too bright.
items.zh: 我比較想要藍色的外套。紅色那件太亮了。

items.en: I'd prefer a seat near the front.
items.zh: 我比較想要靠前面的位子。

items.en: I'd prefer a quiet holiday this year.
items.zh: 我今年比較想要一個安靜的假期。

items.en: I'd prefer the chicken to the fish.
items.zh: 比起魚，我比較想吃雞肉。

items.en: I'd prefer a small party with close friends.
items.zh: 我比較想跟好朋友辦一個小派對。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + would rather + not + 原形動詞：寧願不要

items.en: I'd rather not talk about my exam results.
items.zh: 我寧願不要談我的考試成績。

items.en: I'd rather not go out tonight. It's freezing.
items.zh: 我今天晚上寧願不要出門。好冷。

items.en: She'd rather not sit at the back.
items.zh: 她寧願不要坐在後面。

items.en: We'd rather not drive in the snow.
items.zh: 我們寧願不要在雪中開車。

items.en: I'd rather not eat too late.
items.zh: 我寧願不要太晚吃東西。

items.en: He'd rather not work at the weekend.
items.zh: 他寧願週末不要工作。

items.en: The job isn't certain, so I'd rather not mention it to my parents.
items.zh: 那份工作還不確定，所以我寧願先不跟我爸媽提。

title: If possible, I'd like to come to see you on Tuesday afternoon.
translation: 可以的話，我想星期二下午去看你。
name: would like 表示願望和偏好
sentences: I don't have classes on Tuesday. If possible, I'd like to come to see you on Tuesday afternoon.
If possible, I'd like to change my appointment to Thursday.
If possible, I'd like to sit near the front of the class.
If possible, I'd like to start the new job in September.
If possible, I'd like to pay in two parts.
If possible, I'd like to have a room on the ground floor.
For my main course, I would like the chicken with potatoes and some vegetables.
I would like the tomato soup to start, please.
I'd like a cheese sandwich and a cup of tea.
My son would like the pasta with no sauce.
I'd like a large orange juice, please.
We would like two coffees and a piece of chocolate cake.
I'd like the window seat, if possible.
I'd like a quiet room at the back of the hotel, if possible.
My eyes get tired on screens. I'd like a paper copy of the report, if possible.
I'd like the blue one, if possible. It's my favourite colour.
We'd like a table outside, if possible.
I'd like a single room for three nights, if possible.
I'd like to travel around South America one day.
I'd like to learn to speak Japanese one day.
I'd like to have my own restaurant one day.
I'd like to see the Northern Lights one day.
I'd like to write a book about my grandmother's life one day.
I'd like to run a marathon one day.
My mum would like to retire to a small village by the sea.
My best friend would like to become a vet.
The children would like to spend the afternoon at the park.
My dad would like to go fishing on Sunday morning.
Our teacher would like to take us to the science museum.
My grandparents would like to celebrate their anniversary in Paris.
My sister would like to have a big wedding in the summer.

examples.heading: ① If possible, + I'd like to + 原形動詞：客氣地說希望的安排

items.en: I don't have classes on Tuesday. If possible, I'd like to come to see you on Tuesday afternoon.
items.zh: 我星期二沒有課。如果可以的話，我想星期二下午去找您。

items.en: If possible, I'd like to change my appointment to Thursday.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想把預約改到星期四。

items.en: If possible, I'd like to sit near the front of the class.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想坐在教室前面。

items.en: If possible, I'd like to start the new job in September.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想九月開始新工作。

items.en: If possible, I'd like to pay in two parts.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想分兩次付款。

items.en: If possible, I'd like to have a room on the ground floor.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我想要一樓的房間。

examples.heading: ② I would like + 食物：點餐

items.en: For my main course, I would like the chicken with potatoes and some vegetables.
items.zh: 主菜我要雞肉配馬鈴薯和一些蔬菜。

items.en: I would like the tomato soup to start, please.
items.zh: 前菜我要番茄湯，謝謝。

items.en: I'd like a cheese sandwich and a cup of tea.
items.zh: 我要一個起司三明治和一杯茶。

items.en: My son would like the pasta with no sauce.
items.zh: 我兒子要不加醬的義大利麵。

items.en: I'd like a large orange juice, please.
items.zh: 請給我一大杯柳橙汁。

items.en: We would like two coffees and a piece of chocolate cake.
items.zh: 我們要兩杯咖啡和一塊巧克力蛋糕。

examples.heading: ③ I'd like + 名詞, if possible：說偏好

items.en: I'd like the window seat, if possible.
items.zh: 如果可以，我想要靠窗的位子。

items.en: I'd like a quiet room at the back of the hotel, if possible.
items.zh: 如果可以，我想要飯店後面安靜的房間。

items.en: My eyes get tired on screens. I'd like a paper copy of the report, if possible.
items.zh: 我的眼睛看螢幕會累。如果可以，我想要一份紙本報告。

items.en: I'd like the blue one, if possible. It's my favourite colour.
items.zh: 如果可以，我想要藍色那個。那是我最喜歡的顏色。

items.en: We'd like a table outside, if possible.
items.zh: 如果可以，我們想要外面的桌子。

items.en: I'd like a single room for three nights, if possible.
items.zh: 如果可以，我想要一間單人房住三晚。

examples.heading: ④ I'd like to + 原形動詞 + one day：說願望

items.en: I'd like to travel around South America one day.
items.zh: 我希望有一天能環遊南美洲。

items.en: I'd like to learn to speak Japanese one day.
items.zh: 我希望有一天能學會說日文。

items.en: I'd like to have my own restaurant one day.
items.zh: 我希望有一天能有自己的餐廳。

items.en: I'd like to see the Northern Lights one day.
items.zh: 我希望有一天能看到北極光。

items.en: I'd like to write a book about my grandmother's life one day.
items.zh: 我希望有一天能寫一本關於我奶奶一生的書。

items.en: I'd like to run a marathon one day.
items.zh: 我希望有一天能跑一場馬拉松。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + would like + to + 原形動詞：說別人的願望

items.en: My mum would like to retire to a small village by the sea.
items.zh: 我媽媽想退休後搬到海邊的小村子。

items.en: My best friend would like to become a vet.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友想當獸醫。

items.en: The children would like to spend the afternoon at the park.
items.zh: 孩子們想在公園度過下午。

items.en: My dad would like to go fishing on Sunday morning.
items.zh: 我爸爸星期天早上想去釣魚。

items.en: Our teacher would like to take us to the science museum.
items.zh: 我們老師想帶我們去科學博物館。

items.en: My grandparents would like to celebrate their anniversary in Paris.
items.zh: 我的祖父母想在巴黎慶祝他們的結婚紀念日。

items.en: My sister would like to have a big wedding in the summer.
items.zh: 我姊姊想在夏天辦一個盛大的婚禮。

title: I stayed there for two weeks, and it never rained.
translation: 我在那裡待了兩個星期，一次雨都沒下。
name: 否定句中的 ever、never、yet、still
sentences: We went camping last weekend, and the sun never came out.
My grandfather never drives at night. He can't see well in the dark.
She never forgets a face. She remembers everyone she meets.
We've never been to Australia, but we'd love to go.
Our neighbours never say hello. They're not very friendly.
I never saw him again after we left school.
Tom is never late for work. He always takes the early train.
The shop was never busy on Mondays, so it closed.
The ship sank in deep water. Nobody will ever find it.
Don't ever do that again! You scared me.
Nothing ever happens in this village.
The food made me ill. I won't ever eat at that restaurant again.
No one ever tells me anything in this office.
"Where are you going on holiday?" "I haven't decided yet."
Don't eat the cake. It isn't ready yet.
I've sent the invitations, but nobody has replied yet.
The new library hasn't opened yet. It opens in May.
We can't go in yet. The doors open at seven.
My sister hasn't found a job yet, but she's looking.
She said sorry, but I still don't believe her.
It's ten o'clock, and the plumber still hasn't come.
I've read the instructions three times, and I still don't understand them.
He's twenty-five, and he still can't cook an egg.
We applied in March, and we still haven't heard from the bank about the loan.
My little brother still doesn't like vegetables.
The bus hasn't come yet. Let's wait five more minutes.
The bus still hasn't come. We've been here for an hour!
I haven't finished my essay yet. It's due on Friday.
I still haven't finished my essay, and it's due tomorrow!
Haven't they answered your email yet? It's been three days.
Hasn't the parcel arrived yet? I sent it a week ago.

examples.heading: ① never + 動詞

items.en: We went camping last weekend, and the sun never came out.
items.zh: 我們上週末去露營，太陽一次都沒出來。

items.en: My grandfather never drives at night. He can't see well in the dark.
items.zh: 我爺爺從來不在晚上開車。他在暗處看不清楚。

items.en: She never forgets a face. She remembers everyone she meets.
items.zh: 她見過的臉從來不會忘。每個見過的人她都記得。

items.en: We've never been to Australia, but we'd love to go.
items.zh: 我們從來沒去過澳洲，可是很想去。

items.en: Our neighbours never say hello. They're not very friendly.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居從來不打招呼。他們不太友善。

items.en: I never saw him again after we left school.
items.zh: 畢業以後我就再也沒見過他。

examples.heading: ② be + never

items.en: Tom is never late for work. He always takes the early train.
items.zh: Tom 上班從來不遲到。他都搭早班的火車。

items.en: The shop was never busy on Mondays, so it closed.
items.zh: 那家店星期一從來沒什麼客人，所以後來關了。

examples.heading: ③ ever 在否定的字後面

items.en: The ship sank in deep water. Nobody will ever find it.
items.zh: 那艘船沉在深海裡。永遠不會有人找到它。

items.en: Don't ever do that again! You scared me.
items.zh: 不准再那樣做！你嚇到我了。

items.en: Nothing ever happens in this village.
items.zh: 這個村子從來沒發生過什麼事。

items.en: The food made me ill. I won't ever eat at that restaurant again.
items.zh: 那裡的菜讓我生病了。我再也不會去那家餐廳吃飯了。

items.en: No one ever tells me anything in this office.
items.zh: 在這間辦公室，從來沒有人告訴我任何事。

examples.heading: ④ 否定的動詞 + yet

items.en: "Where are you going on holiday?" "I haven't decided yet."
items.zh: 你要去哪裡度假？我還沒決定。

items.en: Don't eat the cake. It isn't ready yet.
items.zh: 別吃蛋糕。還沒好。

items.en: I've sent the invitations, but nobody has replied yet.
items.zh: 我寄了邀請函，可是還沒有人回覆。

items.en: The new library hasn't opened yet. It opens in May.
items.zh: 新的圖書館還沒開放。五月才開。

items.en: We can't go in yet. The doors open at seven.
items.zh: 我們還不能進去。七點才開門。

items.en: My sister hasn't found a job yet, but she's looking.
items.zh: 我姊姊還沒找到工作，可是她在找。

examples.heading: ⑤ still + 否定的助動詞

items.en: She said sorry, but I still don't believe her.
items.zh: 她說了對不起，可是我還是不相信她。

items.en: It's ten o'clock, and the plumber still hasn't come.
items.zh: 都十點了，水電工還是沒來。

items.en: I've read the instructions three times, and I still don't understand them.
items.zh: 說明我讀了三遍，還是看不懂。

items.en: He's twenty-five, and he still can't cook an egg.
items.zh: 他二十五歲了，還是不會煎蛋。

items.en: We applied in March, and we still haven't heard from the bank about the loan.
items.zh: 我們三月就申請了，到現在還是沒收到銀行貸款的消息。

items.en: My little brother still doesn't like vegetables.
items.zh: 我弟弟到現在還是不喜歡吃青菜。

examples.heading: ⑥ yet 和 still 說同一件事

items.en: The bus hasn't come yet. Let's wait five more minutes.
items.zh: 公車還沒來。我們再等五分鐘吧。

items.en: The bus still hasn't come. We've been here for an hour!
items.zh: 公車到現在都還沒來。我們已經在這裡等了一個小時了！

items.en: I haven't finished my essay yet. It's due on Friday.
items.zh: 我的作文還沒寫完。星期五要交。

items.en: I still haven't finished my essay, and it's due tomorrow!
items.zh: 我的作文到現在還沒寫完，明天就要交了！

examples.heading: ⑦ 否定疑問句 + yet

items.en: Haven't they answered your email yet? It's been three days.
items.zh: 他們還沒回你的信嗎？已經三天了。

items.en: Hasn't the parcel arrived yet? I sent it a week ago.
items.zh: 包裹還沒到嗎？我一個星期前就寄了。

title: I didn't spend a lot of money.
translation: 我沒花很多錢。
name: 過去簡單式 didn't 的否定句
sentences: It was a pity that you didn't come to my birthday party.
I didn't spend a lot of money at the market, only twenty pounds.
Sorry I didn't call you back. My phone was in the car.
We didn't go to the beach because it rained all day.
He didn't eat breakfast, so he was hungry by ten.
I didn't sleep well last night. The neighbours had a party.
The driver didn't see us at the bus stop and drove past.
My parents didn't like the film, but I loved it.
My cousin failed her exam last year. She didn't study at all.
You didn't tell me about the meeting. When was it?
I didn't know the answer, so I asked the teacher.
Our team didn't play well, but we still won.
They didn't have enough money for a taxi, so they walked.
Mark didn't wear a coat and got very cold.
We didn't see any whales on the boat trip.
The shop didn't have my size, so I bought nothing.
I'm sorry about your vase. I didn't see it on the shelf.
Grandma didn't hear the doorbell because the radio was on.
We didn't need the umbrellas in the end. The sun came out.
He didn't understand the joke, so we explained it again.
The hospital did not charge us for the visit.
The plane did not land until midnight because of the fog.
The report did not explain the cause of the fire.
Most of the students did not finish the test in time.
I did not take your bag. Somebody else did.
We didn't have to wait long. The doctor saw us at once.
I didn't have to pay for the ticket. My uncle gave it to me.
"Did you enjoy the concert?" "No, I didn't. The music was too loud."
"Did Sam help you move?" "No, he didn't. He was away."
I didn't buy the jacket, but I bought the boots.
She didn't cook dinner. She ordered pizza.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + didn't + 原形動詞

items.en: It was a pity that you didn't come to my birthday party.
items.zh: 你沒來我的生日派對，好可惜。

items.en: I didn't spend a lot of money at the market, only twenty pounds.
items.zh: 我在市集沒花很多錢，只花了二十英鎊。

items.en: Sorry I didn't call you back. My phone was in the car.
items.zh: 抱歉我沒回你電話。我的手機放在車上。

items.en: We didn't go to the beach because it rained all day.
items.zh: 我們沒去海邊，因為下了一整天的雨。

items.en: He didn't eat breakfast, so he was hungry by ten.
items.zh: 他沒吃早餐，所以十點就餓了。

items.en: I didn't sleep well last night. The neighbours had a party.
items.zh: 我昨晚沒睡好。鄰居在開派對。

items.en: The driver didn't see us at the bus stop and drove past.
items.zh: 司機沒看到我們在公車站，就開過去了。

items.en: My parents didn't like the film, but I loved it.
items.zh: 我爸媽不喜歡那部電影，可是我很喜歡。

items.en: My cousin failed her exam last year. She didn't study at all.
items.zh: 我表妹去年考試沒過。她完全沒念書。

items.en: You didn't tell me about the meeting. When was it?
items.zh: 你沒跟我說會議的事。是什麼時候開的？

items.en: I didn't know the answer, so I asked the teacher.
items.zh: 我不知道答案，所以去問老師。

items.en: Our team didn't play well, but we still won.
items.zh: 我們隊打得不好，可是還是贏了。

items.en: They didn't have enough money for a taxi, so they walked.
items.zh: 他們的錢不夠搭計程車，所以走路回去。

items.en: Mark didn't wear a coat and got very cold.
items.zh: Mark 沒穿外套，凍壞了。

items.en: We didn't see any whales on the boat trip.
items.zh: 我們搭船出海時一隻鯨魚也沒看到。

items.en: The shop didn't have my size, so I bought nothing.
items.zh: 那家店沒有我的尺寸，所以我什麼都沒買。

items.en: I'm sorry about your vase. I didn't see it on the shelf.
items.zh: 你的花瓶真抱歉。我沒看到它在架子上。

items.en: Grandma didn't hear the doorbell because the radio was on.
items.zh: 奶奶沒聽到門鈴，因為收音機開著。

items.en: We didn't need the umbrellas in the end. The sun came out.
items.zh: 結果我們沒用到傘。太陽出來了。

items.en: He didn't understand the joke, so we explained it again.
items.zh: 他聽不懂那個笑話，所以我們又解釋了一次。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + did not + 原形動詞（正式的文章或加強否定）

items.en: The hospital did not charge us for the visit.
items.zh: 醫院沒有向我們收看診的費用。

items.en: The plane did not land until midnight because of the fog.
items.zh: 因為起霧，飛機到半夜才降落。

items.en: The report did not explain the cause of the fire.
items.zh: 報告沒有說明起火的原因。

items.en: Most of the students did not finish the test in time.
items.zh: 大部分學生沒在時間內寫完考卷。

items.en: I did not take your bag. Somebody else did.
items.zh: 我沒有拿你的包包。是別人拿的。

examples.heading: ③ didn't + have to：不需要

items.en: We didn't have to wait long. The doctor saw us at once.
items.zh: 我們沒等很久。醫生馬上就幫我們看了。

items.en: I didn't have to pay for the ticket. My uncle gave it to me.
items.zh: 我不用付票錢。是我叔叔給我的。

examples.heading: ④ 問答裡的簡答

items.en: "Did you enjoy the concert?" "No, I didn't. The music was too loud."
items.zh: 你喜歡那場演唱會嗎？不喜歡。音樂太吵了。

items.en: "Did Sam help you move?" "No, he didn't. He was away."
items.zh: Sam 有幫你搬家嗎？沒有。他不在。

examples.heading: ⑤ didn't 和肯定的過去式對比

items.en: I didn't buy the jacket, but I bought the boots.
items.zh: 我沒買那件外套，可是買了那雙靴子。

items.en: She didn't cook dinner. She ordered pizza.
items.zh: 她沒煮晚餐。她叫了披薩。

title: I don't have a dining room, so we eat in the living room.
translation: 我家沒有飯廳，所以我們在客廳吃飯。
name: don't 加原形動詞的否定
sentences: Our flat is very small. I don't have a dining room, so we eat in the living room.
Can you open the jar for me? I don't know how.
We don't like the French lessons. The teacher talks too fast.
My grandparents don't use the internet, so I write them letters.
You don't need a coat today. It's very warm outside.
No coffee for me, thanks. I don't drink it in the evening.
They don't live in the city. They have a small farm in the hills.
Sorry, I don't understand the question. Can you say it again?
The students don't wear a uniform at my school.
We don't watch much TV at home. We prefer board games.
My brother doesn't eat fish, so Mum cooks chicken for him.
This pen doesn't work. Can I borrow yours?
Lucy doesn't take the bus. She rides her bike to work.
Don't go to the bakery yet. It doesn't open until nine.
Can you turn the radio down? My dad doesn't like loud music in the car.
It doesn't matter. We can try again tomorrow.
I can't use my old headphones. The new phone doesn't have a headphone jack.
Mr Lee is a kind teacher. He doesn't give us homework at the weekend.
My little sister doesn't go to school yet. She's only four.
He doesn't speak English, but his wife does.
The hotel does not accept pets.
Visitors do not need to book in advance.
The ticket does not include lunch.
Our members do not pay for parking.
I don't have any brothers or sisters. I'm an only child.
You don't have to come with me. I can go alone.
Don't call Amy at noon on Monday. She doesn't have time for lunch that day.
Our flat doesn't have a lift, so we carry the shopping up the stairs.
I don't like tea, but I love coffee.
Our cat doesn't like strangers, but she loves my grandmother.
They don't sell bread here, but the shop next door does.

examples.heading: ① I / you / we / they + don't + 原形動詞

items.en: Our flat is very small. I don't have a dining room, so we eat in the living room.
items.zh: 我們的公寓很小。我家沒有飯廳，所以我們在客廳吃飯。

items.en: Can you open the jar for me? I don't know how.
items.zh: 你可以幫我打開這個罐子嗎？我不知道怎麼開。

items.en: We don't like the French lessons. The teacher talks too fast.
items.zh: 我們不喜歡法文課。老師講得太快了。

items.en: My grandparents don't use the internet, so I write them letters.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶不用網路，所以我寫信給他們。

items.en: You don't need a coat today. It's very warm outside.
items.zh: 你今天不用穿外套。外面很暖和。

items.en: No coffee for me, thanks. I don't drink it in the evening.
items.zh: 我不要咖啡，謝謝。我晚上不喝咖啡。

items.en: They don't live in the city. They have a small farm in the hills.
items.zh: 他們不住在城裡。他們在山上有一座小農場。

items.en: Sorry, I don't understand the question. Can you say it again?
items.zh: 不好意思，我不懂這個問題。你可以再說一次嗎？

items.en: The students don't wear a uniform at my school.
items.zh: 我們學校的學生不穿制服。

items.en: We don't watch much TV at home. We prefer board games.
items.zh: 我們在家不太看電視。我們比較喜歡玩桌遊。

examples.heading: ② he / she / it + doesn't + 原形動詞

items.en: My brother doesn't eat fish, so Mum cooks chicken for him.
items.zh: 我哥哥不吃魚，所以媽媽另外煮雞肉給他吃。

items.en: This pen doesn't work. Can I borrow yours?
items.zh: 這支筆寫不出來。我可以借你的嗎？

items.en: Lucy doesn't take the bus. She rides her bike to work.
items.zh: Lucy 不搭公車。她騎腳踏車上班。

items.en: Don't go to the bakery yet. It doesn't open until nine.
items.zh: 先別去麵包店。它九點才開門。

items.en: Can you turn the radio down? My dad doesn't like loud music in the car.
items.zh: 你可以把收音機關小聲一點嗎？我爸不喜歡在車上放很大聲的音樂。

items.en: It doesn't matter. We can try again tomorrow.
items.zh: 沒關係。我們明天可以再試一次。

items.en: I can't use my old headphones. The new phone doesn't have a headphone jack.
items.zh: 我的舊耳機不能用了。新手機沒有耳機孔。

items.en: Mr Lee is a kind teacher. He doesn't give us homework at the weekend.
items.zh: 李老師人很好。他週末不出功課給我們。

items.en: My little sister doesn't go to school yet. She's only four.
items.zh: 我妹妹還沒上學。她才四歲。

items.en: He doesn't speak English, but his wife does.
items.zh: 他不會說英文，可是他太太會。

examples.heading: ③ do not / does not + 原形動詞（正式）

items.en: The hotel does not accept pets.
items.zh: 這家飯店不接受寵物。

items.en: Visitors do not need to book in advance.
items.zh: 訪客不需要事先預約。

items.en: The ticket does not include lunch.
items.zh: 這張票不含午餐。

items.en: Our members do not pay for parking.
items.zh: 我們的會員停車不用付錢。

examples.heading: ④ don't / doesn't + have / have to

items.en: I don't have any brothers or sisters. I'm an only child.
items.zh: 我沒有兄弟姊妹。我是獨生子。

items.en: You don't have to come with me. I can go alone.
items.zh: 你不用陪我去。我可以自己去。

items.en: Don't call Amy at noon on Monday. She doesn't have time for lunch that day.
items.zh: 星期一中午別打給 Amy。她那天連吃午餐的時間都沒有。

items.en: Our flat doesn't have a lift, so we carry the shopping up the stairs.
items.zh: 我們的公寓沒有電梯，所以我們把買的東西搬上樓。

examples.heading: ⑤ don't 和 but 對比兩件事

items.en: I don't like tea, but I love coffee.
items.zh: 我不喜歡茶，可是我很愛咖啡。

items.en: Our cat doesn't like strangers, but she loves my grandmother.
items.zh: 我們家的貓不喜歡陌生人，可是牠很喜歡我奶奶。

items.en: They don't sell bread here, but the shop next door does.
items.zh: 這裡不賣麵包，可是隔壁那家店有賣。

title: I hadn't expected to receive a letter from her.
translation: 我沒想到會收到她的信。
name: 過去進行式和過去完成式的否定句
sentences: I wasn't driving fast when the police stopped me. My rear light was broken.
Sorry, what did you say? I wasn't listening.
When you called, I wasn't sleeping. I was in the shower.
The kids weren't doing their homework when I got home. They were playing games.
He wasn't wearing a coat, so he got very wet.
We weren't expecting visitors, so the house was a mess.
The lift wasn't working, so the delivery man left the parcel downstairs.
I wasn't feeling well at the party, so I left early.
They weren't living in London when they got married. They were still in Leeds.
The driver was not paying attention when the accident happened.
The machines were not running during the strike.
I hadn't expected so many people at the funeral.
When we got to the cinema, the film hadn't started.
She hadn't seen the sea before her trip to Spain.
I was hungry because I hadn't eaten all day.
We hadn't booked a table, so we waited for an hour.
He failed the test because he hadn't studied.
The guests arrived, and I hadn't finished cooking.
They hadn't met before the wedding, but they got on well.
I hadn't heard the news until my sister told me.
The shop had closed, and we hadn't bought any milk.
My parents hadn't been to Japan before last year.
The company had not paid the workers for three months.
By ten o'clock the plane had still not arrived.
The police said the thief had not taken anything.
I wasn't going to tell you, but you'll find out anyway.
We weren't going to buy a car, but the old one broke down.
I wasn't surprised that he left. He hadn't enjoyed the job for months.
The baby wasn't crying, so I knew she hadn't woken up.
When I got to the station, the train wasn't there. It hadn't arrived yet.
She wasn't speaking to me because I hadn't called her on her birthday.

examples.heading: ① wasn't / weren't + 動詞-ing

items.en: I wasn't driving fast when the police stopped me. My rear light was broken.
items.zh: 警察攔下我的時候，我沒開快車。是我的車尾燈壞了。

items.en: Sorry, what did you say? I wasn't listening.
items.zh: 抱歉，你剛剛說什麼？我沒在聽。

items.en: When you called, I wasn't sleeping. I was in the shower.
items.zh: 你打來的時候我沒在睡覺。我在洗澡。

items.en: The kids weren't doing their homework when I got home. They were playing games.
items.zh: 我回家的時候，孩子們沒在寫功課。他們在玩遊戲。

items.en: He wasn't wearing a coat, so he got very wet.
items.zh: 他沒穿外套，所以淋得全身濕透。

items.en: We weren't expecting visitors, so the house was a mess.
items.zh: 我們沒料到會有客人，所以家裡亂七八糟。

items.en: The lift wasn't working, so the delivery man left the parcel downstairs.
items.zh: 電梯壞了，所以送貨員把包裹留在樓下。

items.en: I wasn't feeling well at the party, so I left early.
items.zh: 我在派對上不太舒服，所以提早走了。

items.en: They weren't living in London when they got married. They were still in Leeds.
items.zh: 他們結婚的時候不住在倫敦。他們還住在 Leeds。

examples.heading: ② was not / were not + 動詞-ing（不縮寫）

items.en: The driver was not paying attention when the accident happened.
items.zh: 意外發生的時候，司機沒有專心開車。

items.en: The machines were not running during the strike.
items.zh: 罷工期間，機器都停著。

examples.heading: ③ hadn't + 過去分詞

items.en: I hadn't expected so many people at the funeral.
items.zh: 我沒想到葬禮會來這麼多人。

items.en: When we got to the cinema, the film hadn't started.
items.zh: 我們到電影院的時候，電影還沒開始。

items.en: She hadn't seen the sea before her trip to Spain.
items.zh: 她去西班牙之前沒看過海。

items.en: I was hungry because I hadn't eaten all day.
items.zh: 我很餓，因為我一整天都沒吃東西。

items.en: We hadn't booked a table, so we waited for an hour.
items.zh: 我們沒有訂位，所以等了一個小時。

items.en: He failed the test because he hadn't studied.
items.zh: 他考試沒過，因為他沒念書。

items.en: The guests arrived, and I hadn't finished cooking.
items.zh: 客人到了，我還沒煮完飯。

items.en: They hadn't met before the wedding, but they got on well.
items.zh: 他們在婚禮之前沒見過面，可是相處得很好。

items.en: I hadn't heard the news until my sister told me.
items.zh: 我姊姊跟我說之前，我還沒聽說這個消息。

items.en: The shop had closed, and we hadn't bought any milk.
items.zh: 店已經關了，我們還沒買牛奶。

items.en: My parents hadn't been to Japan before last year.
items.zh: 我爸媽去年之前沒去過日本。

examples.heading: ④ had not + 過去分詞（不縮寫）

items.en: The company had not paid the workers for three months.
items.zh: 那家公司已經三個月沒付薪水給員工了。

items.en: By ten o'clock the plane had still not arrived.
items.zh: 到了十點，飛機還沒到。

items.en: The police said the thief had not taken anything.
items.zh: 警方說小偷什麼都沒拿。

examples.heading: ⑤ wasn't / weren't + going to + 原形動詞

items.en: I wasn't going to tell you, but you'll find out anyway.
items.zh: 我本來不打算跟你說，可是你反正會知道。

items.en: We weren't going to buy a car, but the old one broke down.
items.zh: 我們本來沒打算買車，可是舊車壞了。

examples.heading: ⑥ hadn't 和 wasn't 在同一句

items.en: I wasn't surprised that he left. He hadn't enjoyed the job for months.
items.zh: 他辭職我並不意外。他好幾個月來都不喜歡那份工作。

items.en: The baby wasn't crying, so I knew she hadn't woken up.
items.zh: 寶寶沒在哭，所以我知道她還沒醒。

items.en: When I got to the station, the train wasn't there. It hadn't arrived yet.
items.zh: 我到車站的時候，火車不在那裡。它還沒到。

items.en: She wasn't speaking to me because I hadn't called her on her birthday.
items.zh: 她不跟我說話，因為我在她生日那天沒打電話給她。

title: I haven't tidied my room since I bought this mobile phone.
translation: 自從買了這支手機，我就沒整理過房間了。
name: 現在進行式和現在完成式的否定句

Don't wait for me. I'm not coming to lunch today.

I haven't tidied my room since I bought this mobile phone.
