examples.heading: ① am not / isn't / aren't + 動詞-ing

items.en: Can you call a plumber? The heating isn't working.
items.zh: 你可以叫水電工來嗎？暖氣壞了。

items.en: Don't wait for me. I'm not coming to lunch today.
items.zh: 別等我。我今天不去吃午餐。

items.en: The window is broken and isn't closing properly.
items.zh: 窗戶壞了，關不緊。

items.en: Turn the TV off if you aren't watching it.
items.zh: 你沒在看電視就把它關掉。

items.en: Ben isn't sleeping well these days. He's worried about his exams.
items.zh: Ben 最近睡得不好。他在擔心考試。

items.en: We aren't staying at a hotel this time. We're staying with friends.
items.zh: 我們這次不住飯店。我們住朋友家。

examples.heading: ② 主詞和 be 縮寫 + not + 動詞-ing

items.en: Listen to me! You're not listening.
items.zh: 聽我說！你都沒在聽。

items.en: She's not feeling well, so she's going home early.
items.zh: 她不太舒服，所以要提早回家。

items.en: They're not playing in the park today because of the rain.
items.zh: 今天下雨，他們沒在公園玩。

examples.heading: ③ am not / is not / are not + 動詞-ing（不縮寫）

items.en: I am not asking you to pay for everything. I just want some help.
items.zh: 我不是要你付全部的錢。我只是想要你幫一點忙。

items.en: The company is not looking for new staff at the moment.
items.zh: 公司目前沒有在招人。

items.en: The trains are not running between Leeds and York today.
items.zh: 今天 Leeds 和 York 之間的火車停駛。

examples.heading: ④ haven't / hasn't + 過去分詞

items.en: I haven't tidied my room since I bought this mobile phone.
items.zh: 自從買了這支手機，我就沒整理過房間了。

items.en: Can I have more time? I haven't finished the report.
items.zh: 可以多給我一點時間嗎？我還沒寫完報告。

items.en: My sister hasn't called me this week. I hope she's OK.
items.zh: 我姊姊這個星期都沒打電話給我。希望她沒事。

items.en: We haven't been to Paris, but we'd love to go.
items.zh: 我們沒去過巴黎，可是很想去。

items.en: We've waited twenty minutes, and the bus hasn't come. Let's walk.
items.zh: 我們等了二十分鐘，公車還沒來。我們走路吧。

items.en: They haven't seen each other since they left school.
items.zh: 他們畢業以後就沒見過面了。

items.en: Grandpa hasn't touched his soup. Is he ill?
items.zh: 爺爺一口湯都沒喝。他生病了嗎？

items.en: Stop changing the subject. You haven't told me where you were last night.
items.zh: 別轉移話題。你還沒跟我說你昨晚去哪裡了。

examples.heading: ⑤ have not / has not + 過去分詞（不縮寫）

items.en: The museum has not opened the new rooms yet.
items.zh: 博物館還沒開放新的展廳。

items.en: The prices have not changed since last year.
items.zh: 價格從去年到現在都沒變。

items.en: The council has not repaired the road since the floods.
items.zh: 淹水以後，市政府到現在都還沒修那條路。

examples.heading: ⑥ 主詞和 have 縮寫 + not + 過去分詞

items.en: I'm a bit worried. I've not heard from Jane for weeks.
items.zh: 我有點擔心。我好幾個星期沒有 Jane 的消息了。

items.en: Don't take Tom's plate away. He's not finished his dinner yet.
items.zh: 別把 Tom 的盤子收走。他還沒吃完晚餐。

examples.heading: ⑦ haven't got / hasn't got：沒有

items.en: I need to go shopping. I haven't got any warm clothes for the trip.
items.zh: 我得去買東西。我沒有能帶去旅行的保暖衣服。

items.en: We haven't got hot water, so the shower is very cold.
items.zh: 我們沒有熱水，所以淋浴的水很冷。

items.en: I haven't got any money right now, but I'm really happy.
items.zh: 我現在一毛錢也沒有，可是我很快樂。

items.en: My brother hasn't got a car, so he cycles everywhere.
items.zh: 我哥哥沒有車，所以他去哪裡都騎腳踏車。

items.en: Sorry, I haven't got time to help you today.
items.zh: 抱歉，我今天沒時間幫你。

items.en: The flat hasn't got a garden, but it's near a big park.
items.zh: 那間公寓沒有花園，可是離一座大公園很近。

title: I haven't got many things to do here.
translation: 我在這裡沒有很多事要做。
name: 否定句的 any、much、many 加名詞
sentences: I bought a shirt and a hat because I didn't have any shirts or hats for the trip.
We went on a boat trip, but we didn't see any dolphins.
My little sister doesn't have any brothers to play with.
There aren't any chairs in the meeting room. Can you bring some?
Everyone talks about this writer, but I haven't read any of her books.
There isn't any milk in the fridge, so I drink my coffee black.
Don't put any salt in the soup. Grandpa can't eat it.
We didn't get any information about the new timetable.
I can't buy the ticket. I haven't got any cash on me.
I only spent twenty pounds because I haven't got much money.
Hurry up! We don't have much time before the train leaves.
There isn't much traffic on the roads on Sunday mornings.
My grandmother doesn't eat much meat now.
The guide didn't give us much information about the castle.
We didn't have much snow last winter.
He doesn't drink much water, even in summer.
Our village hasn't got many shops.
There aren't many tourists in the village in winter.
I don't have many friends at my new school yet.
The shop didn't have many sizes, so I didn't buy the jacket.
The concert wasn't very good, and there weren't many people there.
We haven't had many sunny days this month.
My dad doesn't send many emails. He prefers to phone.
We didn't buy any souvenirs, and we didn't take many photos.
There weren't any buses on the holiday, and there weren't many taxis.
Sorry, I haven't got any coins for the parking machine.
We haven't got much bread left. Can you buy some on the way home?
My brother hasn't got many toys, but he loves his old football.
She left the house without any money.
He never gives me any help with the housework.
There was hardly any food left after the party.

examples.heading: ① 否定的動詞 + any + 可數名詞的複數

items.en: I bought a shirt and a hat because I didn't have any shirts or hats for the trip.
items.zh: 我買了一件襯衫和一頂帽子，因為我沒有能帶去旅行的襯衫和帽子。

items.en: We went on a boat trip, but we didn't see any dolphins.
items.zh: 我們搭船出海，可是一隻海豚也沒看到。

items.en: My little sister doesn't have any brothers to play with.
items.zh: 我妹妹沒有哥哥弟弟可以陪她玩。

items.en: There aren't any chairs in the meeting room. Can you bring some?
items.zh: 會議室裡一張椅子也沒有。你可以拿幾張來嗎？

items.en: Everyone talks about this writer, but I haven't read any of her books.
items.zh: 大家都在談這個作家，可是她的書我一本也沒讀過。

examples.heading: ② 否定的動詞 + any + 不可數名詞

items.en: There isn't any milk in the fridge, so I drink my coffee black.
items.zh: 冰箱裡一點牛奶也沒有，所以我喝黑咖啡。

items.en: Don't put any salt in the soup. Grandpa can't eat it.
items.zh: 湯裡別加鹽。爺爺不能吃鹽。

items.en: We didn't get any information about the new timetable.
items.zh: 我們沒拿到任何新時刻表的資料。

items.en: I can't buy the ticket. I haven't got any cash on me.
items.zh: 我沒辦法買票。我身上沒有現金。

examples.heading: ③ 否定的動詞 + much + 不可數名詞

items.en: I only spent twenty pounds because I haven't got much money.
items.zh: 我只花了二十英鎊，因為我的錢不多。

items.en: Hurry up! We don't have much time before the train leaves.
items.zh: 快點！火車開之前我們沒剩多少時間了。

items.en: There isn't much traffic on the roads on Sunday mornings.
items.zh: 星期天早上路上的車不多。

items.en: My grandmother doesn't eat much meat now.
items.zh: 我奶奶現在不太吃肉。

items.en: The guide didn't give us much information about the castle.
items.zh: 導遊沒告訴我們多少城堡的事。

items.en: We didn't have much snow last winter.
items.zh: 去年冬天沒下多少雪。

items.en: He doesn't drink much water, even in summer.
items.zh: 他就算是夏天也不太喝水。

examples.heading: ④ 否定的動詞 + many + 可數名詞的複數

items.en: Our village hasn't got many shops.
items.zh: 我們村子的店不多。

items.en: There aren't many tourists in the village in winter.
items.zh: 冬天村子裡的觀光客不多。

items.en: I don't have many friends at my new school yet.
items.zh: 我在新學校還沒有很多朋友。

items.en: The shop didn't have many sizes, so I didn't buy the jacket.
items.zh: 那家店的尺寸不多，所以我沒買那件外套。

items.en: The concert wasn't very good, and there weren't many people there.
items.zh: 演唱會不太好看，去的人也不多。

items.en: We haven't had many sunny days this month.
items.zh: 這個月晴天不多。

items.en: My dad doesn't send many emails. He prefers to phone.
items.zh: 我爸不太寄電子郵件。他比較喜歡打電話。

examples.heading: ⑤ any 和 many 對比

items.en: We didn't buy any souvenirs, and we didn't take many photos.
items.zh: 我們一個紀念品也沒買，照片也沒拍幾張。

items.en: There weren't any buses on the holiday, and there weren't many taxis.
items.zh: 放假那天一班公車也沒有，計程車也不多。

examples.heading: ⑥ haven't got + any / much / many + 名詞

items.en: Sorry, I haven't got any coins for the parking machine.
items.zh: 抱歉，我沒有硬幣可以投停車繳費機。

items.en: We haven't got much bread left. Can you buy some on the way home?
items.zh: 我們的麵包不多了。你回家的路上可以買一點嗎？

items.en: My brother hasn't got many toys, but he loves his old football.
items.zh: 我弟弟的玩具不多，可是他很愛他那顆舊足球。

examples.heading: ⑦ 有否定意思的 without、never、hardly 後面也用 any

items.en: She left the house without any money.
items.zh: 她身上一毛錢都沒帶就出門了。

items.en: He never gives me any help with the housework.
items.zh: 他從來不幫我做家事。

items.en: There was hardly any food left after the party.
items.zh: 派對結束後幾乎沒剩什麼吃的了。

title: I had no clothes to wear to John's party, so I went shopping yesterday.
translation: 我沒有衣服可以穿去 John 的派對，所以我昨天去逛街了。
name: 限定詞 no 加名詞

There's no bread left, and there isn't any rice.
We had no rain in July, and we didn't have any in August.
She made no mistakes in the test, but I didn't get any right.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + 動詞 + no + 複數名詞

items.en: I had no shoes for the wedding, so I borrowed my sister's.
items.zh: 我沒有鞋子可以穿去婚禮，所以借了我姊姊的。

items.en: The new flat is lovely, but it has no curtains yet.
items.zh: 新公寓很漂亮，可是還沒有窗簾。

items.en: We've got no eggs, so I can't make pancakes.
items.zh: 我們沒有蛋了，所以我沒辦法做鬆餅。

items.en: I have no plans for the weekend. Do you want to do something?
items.zh: 我週末沒有計畫。你想做點什麼嗎？

items.en: My grandfather had no brothers or sisters.
items.zh: 我爺爺沒有兄弟姊妹。

items.en: The teacher gave us no instructions, so we didn't know what to do.
items.zh: 老師沒給我們任何說明，所以我們不知道要做什麼。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 動詞 + no + 不可數名詞

items.en: I bought new shoes, and now I have no money until Friday.
items.zh: 我買了新鞋，現在到星期五之前都沒錢了。

items.en: Sorry, I've got no time to talk today. I'm late for work.
items.zh: 抱歉，我今天沒時間講話。我上班要遲到了。

items.en: Sorry about the cold shower. The hotel has no hot water this morning.
items.zh: 冷水澡真抱歉。飯店今天早上沒有熱水。

items.en: He had no idea where his keys were.
items.zh: 他完全不知道鑰匙在哪裡。

items.en: We had no electricity for two days after the storm.
items.zh: 暴風雨過後，我們有兩天沒電。

items.en: My grandma takes her tea with no sugar.
items.zh: 我奶奶喝茶不加糖。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 動詞 + no + 單數名詞

items.en: My brother has no car, so he takes the bus everywhere.
items.zh: 我哥哥沒有車，所以去哪裡都搭公車。

items.en: This room has no window. It's very dark.
items.zh: 這個房間沒有窗戶。很暗。

items.en: She has no job at the moment, but she's looking.
items.zh: 她目前沒有工作，可是在找。

examples.heading: ④ there is / there are + no + 名詞

items.en: There's no milk in the fridge. Can you buy some?
items.zh: 冰箱裡沒有牛奶了。你可以去買一點嗎？

items.en: There are no buses on Sunday mornings in our village.
items.zh: 我們村子星期天早上沒有公車。

items.en: There was no answer when I called the office.
items.zh: 我打電話到辦公室，沒有人接。

items.en: There were no seats left, so we stood at the back.
items.zh: 沒有位子了，所以我們站在後面。

items.en: There's no room in the car for another bag.
items.zh: 車上沒有空間再放一個袋子了。

items.en: There is no swimming pool in the hotel, but there's a beach nearby.
items.zh: 飯店沒有游泳池，可是附近有海灘。

examples.heading: ⑤ no + 名詞當主詞

items.en: No students came to class on the day of the storm.
items.zh: 暴風雨那天，沒有學生來上課。

items.en: No buses run on Christmas Day, so we'll have to walk.
items.zh: 聖誕節那天沒有公車，所以我們得走路。

items.en: No tickets are left for Saturday's game.
items.zh: 星期六的比賽已經沒有票了。

items.zh: 她考試一個錯都沒有，可是我一題都沒答對。

items.zh: 別大吼。好好跟我說發生了什麼事。

items.zh: 你不用擔心我。我沒有生你的氣。

items.zh: 你可以一個小時後再打來嗎？我現在不在位子上。

items.zh: 我可以自己走去車站。我不是小孩子了。

items.zh: Tom 不在家。他還在公司。

items.en: Your answer is not wrong, but you need to explain it.

items.en: This soup isn't hot enough. Can you warm it up?
items.zh: 這碗湯不夠熱。你可以熱一下嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + is 的縮寫 + not

items.zh: 不用怕那隻狗。牠不危險。

items.zh: 帶把傘吧。天已經不晴了。

items.zh: 這雙鞋不好穿。我想換掉。

items.zh: 我身體不舒服，所以很早就去睡了。

items.zh: 電影不太好看，所以我們沒看完就走了。

items.en: Sorry I missed your call. My phone wasn't in my bag.
items.zh: 抱歉沒接到你的電話。我的手機不在包包裡。

items.en: The test wasn't difficult. Everyone finished early.
items.zh: 考試不難。每個人都提早寫完了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 主詞 + were not / weren't

items.zh: 那間青年旅館的床不乾淨，所以我們睡在睡袋裡。

items.zh: 你昨晚沒來派對。你去哪裡了？

items.zh: 票不貴，所以我們買了四張。

items.zh: 你冷嗎？不冷。我很好。

items.zh: 銀行今天有開嗎？沒有。今天放假。

items.en: "Were they at school yesterday?" "No, they weren't. They were ill."
items.zh: 他們昨天有去學校嗎？沒有。他們生病了。

examples.heading: ① I don't think + 子句

items.zh: 我喜歡這間公寓，可是我不覺得我們會住超過一年。

items.en: Take this map if you want, but I don't think it'll help you.
items.zh: 你想要就拿這張地圖，不過我覺得它幫不了你。

items.en: I don't think we've met. I'm Laura.
items.zh: 我們應該沒見過面。我是 Laura。

items.zh: 我覺得這牛奶不新鮮。聞起來怪怪的。

items.zh: 我覺得你不用穿外套。天氣還滿暖的。

items.zh: 我們星期六去吧。我覺得那家店星期天沒開。

items.en: I don't think it's a good idea to drive in this snow.
items.zh: 我覺得在這種大雪裡開車不是好主意。

items.zh: 我覺得 Ben 今晚不會來。他很忙。

items.en: I don't think I can finish the report by Friday.
items.zh: 我覺得我星期五之前寫不完報告。

examples.heading: ② I don't believe / I don't expect / I don't suppose + 子句

items.zh: 我不相信航空公司會把我的行李箱送回來。

items.en: I don't believe she's telling the truth.
items.zh: 我不相信她說的是實話。

items.en: I don't expect the bus will come on time in this weather.
items.zh: 這種天氣，我想公車不會準時來。

items.en: I don't expect you remember me. We met ten years ago.
items.zh: 我想你應該不記得我了。我們十年前見過面。

items.en: I don't suppose you've seen my glasses?
items.zh: 你應該沒看到我的眼鏡吧？

items.en: I don't imagine the tickets will be cheap.
items.zh: 我想票不會便宜。

items.zh: 我媽覺得我不應該辭職。

items.zh: 別擔心我的咳嗽。醫生覺得不嚴重。

items.zh: 大部分人覺得新的道路不會有幫助。

items.zh: 她不相信自己會贏，可是她贏了。

items.en: I didn't expect the hotel would be so nice.

items.zh: 我的手機沒電了，所以我沒辦法叫計程車。

items.en: I'll call you back later. I can't talk on the train.
items.zh: 我晚點回電給你。我在火車上不方便講話。

items.en: My sister looks tired. She can't sleep because the neighbours are so noisy.
items.zh: 我姊姊看起來很累。鄰居太吵了，她睡不著。

items.en: I can't remember her name. Was it Sarah?
items.zh: 我想不起她的名字。是 Sarah 嗎？

examples.heading: ③ can't：不可以

items.en: You can't park here. It's for buses only.
items.zh: 你不可以在這裡停車。這裡只能停公車。

items.en: Children can't go in the pool without an adult.
items.zh: 小孩沒有大人陪不可以下泳池。

items.en: Phones away, please. You can't use your phone during the exam.
items.zh: 請把手機收起來。考試的時候不可以用手機。

items.en: Put your camera away, please. You can't take pictures of the paintings.
items.zh: 請把相機收起來。這些畫不可以拍照。

items.en: Mum says I can't go out until I finish my homework.
items.zh: 媽媽說我寫完功課才可以出去。

items.en: Dogs can't come into the restaurant, but they can sit outside.
items.zh: 狗不可以進餐廳，可是可以坐在外面。

examples.heading: ④ cannot：正式的文章

items.en: Guests cannot bring food into the rooms.
items.zh: 房客不可以把食物帶進房間。

items.en: The library cannot lend more than five books to one person.
items.zh: 圖書館不能借超過五本書給同一個人。

items.en: Students cannot enter the building after ten at night.
items.zh: 學生晚上十點以後不可以進入大樓。

items.en: We cannot accept payment by cheque.
items.zh: 我們不接受支票付款。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問答裡的簡答

items.en: "Can you play the piano?" "No, I can't. But my sister can."
items.zh: 你會彈鋼琴嗎？不會。可是我妹妹會。

items.en: "Can we stay a bit longer?" "No, we can't. The last bus leaves at eleven."
items.zh: 我們可以再待一下嗎？不行。最後一班公車十一點開。

items.en: "Can Mark come with us?" "No, he can't. He's ill."
items.zh: Mark 可以跟我們一起去嗎？不行。他生病了。

examples.heading: ⑥ can't 和 can 對比

items.en: I can read French, but I can't speak it very well.
items.zh: 我看得懂法文，可是說得不太好。

items.en: You can borrow my bike, but you can't take it to school.
items.zh: 你可以借我的腳踏車，可是不可以騎去學校。

title: You shouldn't wear formal clothes.
translation: 你不應該穿正式的衣服。
name: 情態動詞的否定形式
sentences: I'm sorry, I can't come to your wedding. I'm very ill.
Could you read this label for me? I can't see without my glasses.
You cannot enter the lab without safety glasses.
I couldn't sleep last night because of the storm.
We couldn't find a parking space, so we went home.
The doctor could not see me until Friday.
Sorry, but I won't be in town on Wednesday.
Don't worry. I won't tell anyone your secret.
The car won't start. I think the battery is dead.
The shop will not be open on New Year's Day.
I wouldn't go out in this rain without an umbrella.
He asked her to dance, but she wouldn't.
My parents would not let me go to the concert alone.
It's a beach party, so you shouldn't wear formal clothes.
You shouldn't drink coffee so late. You won't sleep.
The water is deep and fast. Children shouldn't play near the river.
We should not leave the dog alone all day.
You mustn't tell Dad about his birthday present.
We mustn't make any noise. The baby is sleeping.
Drivers must not stop on the bridge.
Take a coat. It may not be warm in the evening.
I may not finish the report today. There's too much work.
Visitors may not take food into the gallery.
Call before you go. The shop might not be open.
Don't wait for me at noon. I might not have time for lunch today.
She might not remember me. We met only once.
"Will you be home for dinner?" "No, I won't. I'm working late."
"Can you swim?" "No, I can't, but I'd like to learn."
"Should I call him?" "No, you shouldn't. Let him call you."
You can borrow my laptop, but you mustn't open my files.
I'd like to help, but I won't have time until next week.

examples.heading: ① can't / cannot

items.en: I'm sorry, I can't come to your wedding. I'm very ill.
items.zh: 很抱歉，我沒辦法去你的婚禮。我病得很重。

items.en: Could you read this label for me? I can't see without my glasses.
items.zh: 你可以幫我看這張標籤嗎？我沒戴眼鏡看不清楚。

items.en: You cannot enter the lab without safety glasses.
items.zh: 不戴護目鏡不可以進實驗室。

examples.heading: ② couldn't / could not

items.en: I couldn't sleep last night because of the storm.
items.zh: 暴風雨讓我昨晚睡不著。

items.en: We couldn't find a parking space, so we went home.
items.zh: 我們找不到停車位，所以就回家了。

items.en: The doctor could not see me until Friday.
items.zh: 醫生要到星期五才能幫我看。

examples.heading: ③ won't / will not

items.en: Sorry, but I won't be in town on Wednesday.
items.zh: 抱歉，我星期三不在城裡。

items.en: Don't worry. I won't tell anyone your secret.
items.zh: 別擔心。我不會把你的秘密告訴任何人。

items.en: The car won't start. I think the battery is dead.
items.zh: 車子發不動。我想是電池沒電了。

items.en: The shop will not be open on New Year's Day.
items.zh: 這家店元旦不營業。

examples.heading: ④ wouldn't / would not

items.en: I wouldn't go out in this rain without an umbrella.
items.zh: 這種雨我不會不帶傘就出門。

items.en: He asked her to dance, but she wouldn't.
items.zh: 他邀她跳舞，可是她不肯。

items.en: My parents would not let me go to the concert alone.
items.zh: 我爸媽不肯讓我自己去聽演唱會。

examples.heading: ⑤ shouldn't / should not

items.en: It's a beach party, so you shouldn't wear formal clothes.
items.zh: 這是海邊的派對，所以你不應該穿正式的衣服。

items.en: You shouldn't drink coffee so late. You won't sleep.
items.zh: 你不應該這麼晚喝咖啡。你會睡不著。

items.en: The water is deep and fast. Children shouldn't play near the river.
items.zh: 河水很深，水流也很急。小孩不應該在河邊玩。

items.en: We should not leave the dog alone all day.
items.zh: 我們不應該讓狗整天獨自在家。

examples.heading: ⑥ mustn't / must not

items.en: You mustn't tell Dad about his birthday present.
items.zh: 你絕對不可以跟爸爸說他的生日禮物是什麼。

items.en: We mustn't make any noise. The baby is sleeping.
items.zh: 我們絕對不可以發出聲音。寶寶在睡覺。

items.en: Drivers must not stop on the bridge.
items.zh: 駕駛人不得在橋上停車。

examples.heading: ⑦ may not

items.en: Take a coat. It may not be warm in the evening.
items.zh: 帶件外套。晚上可能不會暖和。

items.en: I may not finish the report today. There's too much work.
items.zh: 我今天可能寫不完報告。工作太多了。

items.en: Visitors may not take food into the gallery.
items.zh: 參觀者不得攜帶食物進入展覽廳。

examples.heading: ⑧ might not

items.en: Call before you go. The shop might not be open.
items.zh: 去之前先打電話。那家店可能沒開。

items.en: Don't wait for me at noon. I might not have time for lunch today.
items.zh: 中午別等我。我今天可能沒時間吃午餐。

items.en: She might not remember me. We met only once.
items.zh: 她可能不記得我了。我們只見過一次。

examples.heading: ⑨ 問答裡的簡答

items.en: "Will you be home for dinner?" "No, I won't. I'm working late."
items.zh: 你會回家吃晚餐嗎？不會。我要加班。

items.en: "Can you swim?" "No, I can't, but I'd like to learn."
items.zh: 你會游泳嗎？不會，可是我想學。

items.en: "Should I call him?" "No, you shouldn't. Let him call you."
items.zh: 我應該打給他嗎？不應該。讓他打給你。

examples.heading: ⑩ 情態動詞的否定和肯定對比

items.en: You can borrow my laptop, but you mustn't open my files.
items.zh: 你可以借我的筆電，可是絕對不可以打開我的檔案。

items.en: I'd like to help, but I won't have time until next week.
items.zh: 我很想幫忙，可是下星期之前我都沒時間。

title: None of my friends are interested, so there is no one I can talk to.
translation: 我的朋友都沒興趣，所以我找不到人可以聊。
name: neither of 和 none of 加代名詞
sentences: My wife and I are both busy, so neither of us can pick up the children.
I tried on two jackets, but neither of them fitted me.
The twins are eight, and neither of them can ride a bike yet.
We had a small accident, but neither of us is to blame.
I called both hotels, and neither of them had a free room.
Neither of my parents speaks English.
Neither of the two films was very good.
Neither of these roads goes to the beach.
Neither of my grandparents went to university.
We met a group of French students, and none of them spoke English.
I asked all my friends for help, but none of them had time.
I've read three of her books. None of them were very exciting.
None of us knew the way, so we used the map on my phone.
None of you have to stay late tonight. Go home and rest.
I love jazz, but none of my friends enjoy it.
None of the students passed the first test, so the teacher explained it again.
None of the shops in the village sell newspapers any more.
None of these keys open the back door.
The town raised a lot of money, but none of the money went to the school.
None of the food at the party was vegetarian.
I saw two flats yesterday, but I liked neither of them.
She wrote to five companies, but she heard from none of them.
He has two sisters, and he talks to neither of them.
I bought a lot of postcards in Rome, and I sent none of them.
"Which colour do you want, red or blue?" "Neither. I'd like green."
"How many of the questions did you answer?" "None. They were too hard."
"Do you want tea or coffee?" "Neither, thanks. Just water."
Neither of us is liable in this case, so the insurance will pay.
None of the guests stayed after midnight.
None of my friends live near me, so I'm often alone at weekends.
Neither of the shops was open, so we went home without bread.

examples.heading: ① neither of + 代名詞：兩個裡面沒有一個

items.en: My wife and I are both busy, so neither of us can pick up the children.
items.zh: 我太太和我都很忙，所以我們兩個都沒辦法去接孩子。

items.en: I tried on two jackets, but neither of them fitted me.
items.zh: 我試穿了兩件外套，可是兩件都不合身。

items.en: The twins are eight, and neither of them can ride a bike yet.
items.zh: 那對雙胞胎八歲了，兩個都還不會騎腳踏車。

items.en: We had a small accident, but neither of us is to blame.
items.zh: 我們出了一點小車禍，可是我們兩個都沒有錯。

items.en: I called both hotels, and neither of them had a free room.
items.zh: 我打給兩家飯店，兩家都沒有空房。

examples.heading: ② neither of + 名詞片語

items.en: Neither of my parents speaks English.
items.zh: 我爸媽都不會說英文。

items.en: Neither of the two films was very good.
items.zh: 那兩部電影都不太好看。

items.en: Neither of these roads goes to the beach.
items.zh: 這兩條路都不通往海灘。

items.en: Neither of my grandparents went to university.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶都沒上過大學。

examples.heading: ③ none of + 代名詞：三個或更多裡面沒有一個

items.en: We met a group of French students, and none of them spoke English.
items.zh: 我們遇到一群法國學生，他們都不會說英文。

items.en: I asked all my friends for help, but none of them had time.
items.zh: 我找了所有朋友幫忙，可是他們都沒空。

items.en: I've read three of her books. None of them were very exciting.
items.zh: 她的書我讀了三本。沒有一本很精彩。

items.en: None of us knew the way, so we used the map on my phone.
items.zh: 我們都不知道路，所以用我手機上的地圖。

items.en: None of you have to stay late tonight. Go home and rest.
items.zh: 你們今晚都不用留下來加班。回家休息吧。

examples.heading: ④ none of + 名詞片語

items.en: I love jazz, but none of my friends enjoy it.
items.zh: 我很喜歡爵士樂，可是我的朋友都不喜歡。

items.en: None of the students passed the first test, so the teacher explained it again.
items.zh: 學生第一次考試都沒及格，所以老師又講解了一次。

items.en: None of the shops in the village sell newspapers any more.
items.zh: 村子裡的店都不賣報紙了。

items.en: None of these keys open the back door.
items.zh: 這些鑰匙都打不開後門。

items.en: The town raised a lot of money, but none of the money went to the school.
items.zh: 鎮上募了很多錢，可是那筆錢一毛都沒給學校。

items.en: None of the food at the party was vegetarian.
items.zh: 派對上的食物都不是素食。

examples.heading: ⑤ 動詞或介系詞 + neither of / none of

items.en: I saw two flats yesterday, but I liked neither of them.
items.zh: 我昨天看了兩間公寓，可是兩間都不喜歡。

items.en: She wrote to five companies, but she heard from none of them.
items.zh: 她寫信給五家公司，可是一家都沒回音。

items.en: He has two sisters, and he talks to neither of them.
items.zh: 他有兩個姊姊，可是他跟兩個都不說話。

items.en: I bought a lot of postcards in Rome, and I sent none of them.
items.zh: 我在羅馬買了很多明信片，可是一張都沒寄。

examples.heading: ⑥ 簡答：Neither / None

items.en: "Which colour do you want, red or blue?" "Neither. I'd like green."
items.zh: 你要紅色還是藍色？都不要。我想要綠色。

items.en: "How many of the questions did you answer?" "None. They were too hard."
items.zh: 那些題目你答了幾題？一題都沒答。太難了。

items.en: "Do you want tea or coffee?" "Neither, thanks. Just water."
items.zh: 你要茶還是咖啡？都不用，謝謝。給我水就好。

examples.heading: ⑦ neither of / none of 當主詞，後面說結果

items.en: Neither of us is liable in this case, so the insurance will pay.
items.zh: 這件事我們兩個都沒有責任，所以保險會賠。

items.en: None of the guests stayed after midnight.
items.zh: 客人都沒待到半夜以後。

items.en: None of my friends live near me, so I'm often alone at weekends.
items.zh: 我的朋友都沒住在我附近，所以我週末常一個人。

items.en: Neither of the shops was open, so we went home without bread.
items.zh: 兩家店都沒開，所以我們沒買到麵包就回家了。

title: Concerning your question about special requirements, I am glad to tell you that there are none this year.
translation: 關於您問到的特殊需求，很高興告訴您，今年沒有任何特殊需求。
name: none 代替代名詞或名詞片語
sentences: You asked about parking problems. There are none at the new office.
I wanted to buy a hat for the beach, but there were none in my size.
We looked for a hotel in the town centre, but there were none.
People call these hills mountains because there are none in this part of the country.
I needed some cash, but there was none in my wallet.
You wanted some cake? Sorry, there's none left.
I asked for advice from three teachers, but I got none.
He promised to send photos of the trip, but I've received none.
I wanted some milk for my coffee, but we had none.
The tourists hoped to see dolphins, but they saw none.
She has a lot of good ideas, and I have none.
We invited twenty people. None came.
I planted ten seeds, and none grew.
The police asked for witnesses, but none came forward.
Many people applied for the job, but none had the right experience.
"Problems when using English?" "None."
"How many mistakes did you make?" "None. I got everything right."
"How much sugar do you take?" "None, thanks."
"How many brothers do you have?" "None. I'm an only child."
"How much homework did you get today?" "None at all!"
"Did the medicine have any side effects?" "None at all."
"Did you have any trouble finding us?" "None at all. Your directions were perfect."
We expected a lot of complaints, but there were none at all.
The staff suggested several solutions, but the committee accepted none.
The researchers looked for signs of the illness in local children and found none.
The mayor made many promises, but he has kept none.
We asked the company for an explanation and received none.
"Is there any coffee?" "Sorry, there's none left. I'll make some more."
All the tickets for the final have gone. There are none left.
I made forty cookies for the party, and by nine there were none left.
We had plenty of rice last week, but now we've got none left.

examples.heading: ① there is / there are + none

items.en: You asked about parking problems. There are none at the new office.
items.zh: 您問到停車的問題。新辦公室完全沒有這個問題。

items.en: I wanted to buy a hat for the beach, but there were none in my size.
items.zh: 我想買一頂去海邊戴的帽子，可是沒有我的尺寸。

items.en: We looked for a hotel in the town centre, but there were none.
items.zh: 我們在市中心找飯店，可是一家都沒有。

items.en: People call these hills mountains because there are none in this part of the country.
items.zh: 大家把這些小山叫作山，因為國內這一帶根本沒有山。

items.en: I needed some cash, but there was none in my wallet.
items.zh: 我需要一點現金，可是錢包裡一毛也沒有。

items.en: You wanted some cake? Sorry, there's none left.
items.zh: 你想吃蛋糕？抱歉，一塊都不剩了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 動詞 + none

items.en: I asked for advice from three teachers, but I got none.
items.zh: 我向三個老師請教，可是沒有人給我建議。

items.en: He promised to send photos of the trip, but I've received none.
items.zh: 他答應會寄旅行的照片，可是我一張也沒收到。

items.en: I wanted some milk for my coffee, but we had none.
items.zh: 我想在咖啡裡加點牛奶，可是家裡一點也沒有。

items.en: The tourists hoped to see dolphins, but they saw none.
items.zh: 觀光客希望看到海豚，可是一隻都沒看到。

items.en: She has a lot of good ideas, and I have none.
items.zh: 她有很多好點子，我一個也沒有。

examples.heading: ③ None + 動詞

items.en: We invited twenty people. None came.
items.zh: 我們邀了二十個人。一個也沒來。

items.en: I planted ten seeds, and none grew.
items.zh: 我種了十顆種子，一顆也沒長出來。

items.en: The police asked for witnesses, but none came forward.
items.zh: 警方請目擊者出面，可是一個都沒有。

items.en: Many people applied for the job, but none had the right experience.
items.zh: 很多人應徵這份工作，可是沒有一個人有合適的經驗。

examples.heading: ④ 短答：None

items.en: "Problems when using English?" "None."
items.zh: 用英文的時候有遇到問題嗎？沒有。

items.en: "How many mistakes did you make?" "None. I got everything right."
items.zh: 你錯了幾題？一題都沒錯。我全對了。

items.en: "How much sugar do you take?" "None, thanks."
items.zh: 你要加多少糖？不用加，謝謝。

items.en: "How many brothers do you have?" "None. I'm an only child."
items.zh: 你有幾個兄弟？一個也沒有。我是獨生子。

items.en: "How much homework did you get today?" "None at all!"
items.zh: 你今天有多少功課？完全沒有！

examples.heading: ⑤ none at all：加強語氣

items.en: "Did the medicine have any side effects?" "None at all."
items.zh: 這個藥有什麼副作用嗎？完全沒有。

items.en: "Did you have any trouble finding us?" "None at all. Your directions were perfect."
items.zh: 找我們的地方有遇到困難嗎？一點也沒有。你給的路線很清楚。

items.en: We expected a lot of complaints, but there were none at all.
items.zh: 我們以為會收到很多抱怨，結果一個都沒有。

examples.heading: ⑥ 正式的文章裡的 none

items.en: The staff suggested several solutions, but the committee accepted none.
items.zh: 員工提出了幾個解決辦法，可是委員會一個都沒接受。

items.en: The researchers looked for signs of the illness in local children and found none.
items.zh: 研究人員在當地兒童身上尋找這種病的跡象，結果完全沒找到。

items.en: The mayor made many promises, but he has kept none.
items.zh: 市長做了很多承諾，可是一個都沒兌現。

items.en: We asked the company for an explanation and received none.
items.zh: 我們向那家公司要一個解釋，可是沒收到任何回覆。

examples.heading: ⑦ none + left

items.en: "Is there any coffee?" "Sorry, there's none left. I'll make some more."
items.zh: 還有咖啡嗎？抱歉，一點也不剩了。我再煮一些。

items.en: All the tickets for the final have gone. There are none left.
items.zh: 決賽的票都賣完了。一張也不剩。

items.en: I made forty cookies for the party, and by nine there were none left.
items.zh: 我為派對烤了四十片餅乾，到了九點一片也不剩。

items.en: We had plenty of rice last week, but now we've got none left.
items.zh: 上星期我們還有很多米，可是現在一點也不剩了。

title: I would like to apologize for not being able to attend on Friday.
translation: 很抱歉，我星期五沒辦法出席。
name: not 放在非限定子句或省略子句前
sentences: I'm sorry for not answering your call last night.
Sorry for not replying sooner. I was on holiday.
Thank you for not telling Mum about the broken vase.
He was angry with me for not inviting him to the party.
She lost her job for not arriving on time.
I feel bad about not visiting Grandma more often.
Not having a key, we had to wait outside in the rain.
Not having a car makes life in the country difficult.
I hate not knowing what's going on.
Not wanting to wake the baby, she closed the door quietly.
Try not eating sugar for a week. You'll feel better.
We decided not to go camping because of the storm.
The nurse told me not to eat anything before the operation.
Try not to be late tomorrow. The bus leaves at seven.
I promised not to tell anyone about her new job.
He asked me not to park in front of his garage.
We agreed not to spend more than fifty pounds on presents.
My parents warned me not to swim in the river.
We left early in order not to miss the train.
She spoke quietly so as not to wake her parents.
I think you should go to the large school in the centre and not to the small school.
The picnic will be in the park, so it will be quiet and not crowded.
We want a flat with two bedrooms but not on a busy road.
Please send the form by email and not by post.
Please change your diary. The meeting is on Tuesday, not Wednesday.
I need to know by Friday whether you want the room or not.
Ready or not, the guests are arriving.
Every time a small envelope arrived, I ripped it open as fast as I could. Not this time.
"Can I borrow the car tonight?" "Not tonight. I need it."
"Do you want to come to the gym with me?" "Not today. I'm too tired."
"Shall I put the shopping in your car?" "Not in the boot. It's full of tools."

examples.heading: ① 介系詞 + not + 動詞-ing

items.en: I'm sorry for not answering your call last night.
items.zh: 抱歉昨晚沒接你的電話。

items.en: Sorry for not replying sooner. I was on holiday.
items.zh: 抱歉沒早點回覆。我去度假了。

items.en: Thank you for not telling Mum about the broken vase.
items.zh: 謝謝你沒跟媽媽說花瓶破掉的事。

items.en: He was angry with me for not inviting him to the party.
items.zh: 他氣我沒邀請他去派對。

items.en: She lost her job for not arriving on time.
items.zh: 她因為沒準時到被開除了。

items.en: I feel bad about not visiting Grandma more often.
items.zh: 沒有多去看奶奶，我覺得很內疚。

examples.heading: ② not + 動詞-ing 在句首或當受詞

items.en: Not having a key, we had to wait outside in the rain.
items.zh: 我們沒有鑰匙，只好在外面淋雨等。

items.en: Not having a car makes life in the country difficult.
items.zh: 住在鄉下沒有車，生活很不方便。

items.en: I hate not knowing what's going on.
items.zh: 我很討厭不知道發生了什麼事。

items.en: Not wanting to wake the baby, she closed the door quietly.
items.zh: 她不想吵醒寶寶，輕輕地關上門。

items.en: Try not eating sugar for a week. You'll feel better.
items.zh: 試試看一個星期不吃糖。你會覺得好一點。

examples.heading: ③ 動詞 + not + to + 原形動詞

items.en: We decided not to go camping because of the storm.
items.zh: 因為暴風雨，我們決定不去露營了。

items.en: The nurse told me not to eat anything before the operation.
items.zh: 護理師叫我手術前什麼都不要吃。

items.en: Try not to be late tomorrow. The bus leaves at seven.
items.zh: 明天盡量別遲到。公車七點開。

items.en: I promised not to tell anyone about her new job.
items.zh: 我答應過不跟任何人說她換工作的事。

items.en: He asked me not to park in front of his garage.
items.zh: 他請我不要把車停在他的車庫前面。

items.en: We agreed not to spend more than fifty pounds on presents.
items.zh: 我們說好買禮物不超過五十英鎊。

items.en: My parents warned me not to swim in the river.
items.zh: 我爸媽警告我不要在河裡游泳。

examples.heading: ④ in order not to / so as not to + 原形動詞

items.en: We left early in order not to miss the train.
items.zh: 我們提早出發，免得錯過火車。

items.en: She spoke quietly so as not to wake her parents.
items.zh: 她小聲說話，免得吵醒她爸媽。

examples.heading: ⑤ 省略子句：and not / but not / , not

items.en: I think you should go to the large school in the centre and not to the small school.
items.zh: 我覺得你應該去市中心那所大學校，而不是那所小學校。

items.en: The picnic will be in the park, so it will be quiet and not crowded.
items.zh: 野餐會在公園舉行，所以會很安靜，人不會多。

items.en: We want a flat with two bedrooms but not on a busy road.
items.zh: 我們想要一間有兩個房間的公寓，可是不要在大馬路旁邊。

items.en: Please send the form by email and not by post.
items.zh: 請用電子郵件寄表格，不要用郵寄的。

items.en: Please change your diary. The meeting is on Tuesday, not Wednesday.
items.zh: 請改一下你的行事曆。會議是星期二，不是星期三。

examples.heading: ⑥ 省略子句：or not

items.en: I need to know by Friday whether you want the room or not.
items.zh: 我星期五前要知道你到底要不要那個房間。

items.en: Ready or not, the guests are arriving.
items.zh: 不管準備好了沒，客人都到了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 單獨的 Not

items.en: Every time a small envelope arrived, I ripped it open as fast as I could. Not this time.
items.zh: 每次小信封寄來，我都用最快的速度拆開。這一次沒有。

items.en: "Can I borrow the car tonight?" "Not tonight. I need it."
items.zh: 我今晚可以借車嗎？今晚不行。我要用。

items.en: "Do you want to come to the gym with me?" "Not today. I'm too tired."
items.zh: 你要跟我去健身房嗎？今天不要。我太累了。

items.en: "Shall I put the shopping in your car?" "Not in the boot. It's full of tools."
items.zh: 我把買的東西放進你車裡好嗎？別放後車廂。裡面都是工具。

title: I bought a shirt because I haven't got any.
translation: 我買了一件襯衫，因為我一件也沒有。
name: 否定句的限定詞當代名詞
sentences: I need a shirt for the interview, and I haven't got any.
We wanted to buy tickets, but there weren't any left.
Do you have any stamps? I didn't buy any at the post office.
She asked for photos of the wedding, but I didn't take any.
I looked for mistakes in your essay, but I couldn't find any.
I wanted some milk in my tea, but there wasn't any.
Can you lend me some money? I haven't got any.
He offered me some cake, but I didn't want any.
We needed bread for breakfast, but the shop didn't have any.
As for close friends, I don't have many.
I usually read a lot of books, but I haven't read many this year.
There are lots of good restaurants in Rome, but there aren't many in my town.
We expected lots of guests, but not many came.
You can borrow some rice, but I haven't got much.
There's some soup left, but not much.
I ate some of the pasta, but I didn't eat much.
He knows a little about cars, but not much.
It's only a short trip, so don't pack anything heavy.
I went to the market, but I didn't buy anything.
Please speak up. I can't hear anything.
At her first interview, she was so nervous that she couldn't say anything.
Don't touch anything in the lab without asking.
I knocked on the door, but there wasn't anyone at home.
Please don't tell anyone about the surprise party.
I'm new in town, and I don't know anybody here yet.
I worked alone in the office during the holiday. I didn't see anyone all day.
I've looked in every room, and the cat isn't anywhere.
We didn't go anywhere last weekend. We stayed at home.
You can't park anywhere near the stadium on match days.
"How many people came to the meeting?" "Not many. Only six."
"Is there any coffee left?" "Not much. Just half a cup."

examples.heading: ① 否定句 + any，代替可數名詞

items.en: I need a shirt for the interview, and I haven't got any.
items.zh: 我面試需要一件襯衫，可是我一件也沒有。

items.en: We wanted to buy tickets, but there weren't any left.
items.zh: 我們想買票，可是一張也沒剩。

items.en: Do you have any stamps? I didn't buy any at the post office.
items.zh: 你有郵票嗎？我在郵局一張也沒買。

items.en: She asked for photos of the wedding, but I didn't take any.
items.zh: 她跟我要婚禮的照片，可是我一張也沒拍。

items.en: I looked for mistakes in your essay, but I couldn't find any.
items.zh: 我在你的作文裡找錯誤，可是一個也找不到。

examples.heading: ② 否定句 + any，代替不可數名詞

items.en: I wanted some milk in my tea, but there wasn't any.
items.zh: 我想在茶裡加點牛奶，可是一點也沒有。

items.en: Can you lend me some money? I haven't got any.
items.zh: 你可以借我一點錢嗎？我身上一毛錢也沒有。

items.en: He offered me some cake, but I didn't want any.
items.zh: 他請我吃蛋糕，可是我一點也不想吃。

items.en: We needed bread for breakfast, but the shop didn't have any.
items.zh: 我們早餐要吃麵包，可是那家店一點麵包也沒有了。

examples.heading: ③ 否定句 + many

items.en: As for close friends, I don't have many.
items.zh: 說到知心朋友，我沒有幾個。

items.en: I usually read a lot of books, but I haven't read many this year.
items.zh: 我平常讀很多書，可是今年沒讀幾本。

items.en: There are lots of good restaurants in Rome, but there aren't many in my town.
items.zh: 羅馬有很多好餐廳，可是我住的鎮上沒有幾家。

items.en: We expected lots of guests, but not many came.
items.zh: 我們以為會來很多客人，可是沒來幾個。

examples.heading: ④ 否定句 + much

items.en: You can borrow some rice, but I haven't got much.
items.zh: 你可以借一點米，可是我的米不多。

items.en: There's some soup left, but not much.
items.zh: 還剩一點湯，可是不多。

items.en: I ate some of the pasta, but I didn't eat much.
items.zh: 我吃了一點義大利麵，可是沒吃多少。

items.en: He knows a little about cars, but not much.
items.zh: 他對車子懂一點，可是懂得不多。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定句 + anything

items.en: It's only a short trip, so don't pack anything heavy.
items.zh: 只是短途旅行，所以別帶重的東西。

items.en: I went to the market, but I didn't buy anything.
items.zh: 我去了市集，可是什麼都沒買。

items.en: Please speak up. I can't hear anything.
items.zh: 請大聲一點。我什麼都聽不到。

items.en: At her first interview, she was so nervous that she couldn't say anything.
items.zh: 第一次面試的時候，她緊張得一句話都說不出來。

items.en: Don't touch anything in the lab without asking.
items.zh: 沒問過之前，實驗室裡的東西都不要碰。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句 + anyone / anybody

items.en: I knocked on the door, but there wasn't anyone at home.
items.zh: 我敲了門，可是家裡沒有人。

items.en: Please don't tell anyone about the surprise party.
items.zh: 請不要把驚喜派對的事告訴任何人。

items.en: I'm new in town, and I don't know anybody here yet.
items.zh: 我剛搬來這裡，還一個人都不認識。

items.en: I worked alone in the office during the holiday. I didn't see anyone all day.
items.zh: 放假期間我一個人在辦公室上班。我一整天都沒看到任何人。

examples.heading: ⑦ 否定句 + anywhere

items.en: I've looked in every room, and the cat isn't anywhere.
items.zh: 我每個房間都找過了，貓哪裡都不在。

items.en: We didn't go anywhere last weekend. We stayed at home.
items.zh: 我們上個週末哪裡都沒去。我們待在家裡。

items.en: You can't park anywhere near the stadium on match days.
items.zh: 比賽日的時候，體育場附近哪裡都不能停車。

examples.heading: ⑧ 簡答裡的 not many / not much

items.en: "How many people came to the meeting?" "Not many. Only six."
items.zh: 有多少人來開會？沒幾個。只有六個。

items.en: "Is there any coffee left?" "Not much. Just half a cup."
items.zh: 還有咖啡嗎？不多了。只剩半杯。

title: I didn't tell anyone about this story at first.
translation: 一開始我沒跟任何人說這件事。
name: 否定句中的不定代名詞（較多種）
sentences: I broke Mum's vase, and I didn't tell anyone for a week.
It's my first day at this school, so I don't know anybody yet.
We rang the doorbell twice, but there wasn't anyone at home.
Please don't show anybody these photos. They're private.
She was so upset that she didn't want to talk to anyone.
I haven't seen anything of the city yet. I only got here last night.
The thief didn't take anything, but he broke the window.
Don't say anything to Dad about the car. I'll tell him myself.
I can't see anything without my glasses.
We didn't have anything to eat on the long train journey.
I've looked everywhere, but I can't find my passport anywhere.
We didn't go anywhere during the holidays because Mum was ill.
There isn't anywhere to sit in this waiting room.
I told the customs officer I had nothing to declare, but he didn't believe me.
There's nothing in the fridge. Let's order a pizza.
We asked about her new job, but she said nothing about it.
The wedding is on Saturday, and I have nothing to wear.
I knocked and waited, but I saw no one.
My brother is very careful with his new car. He lends it to nobody.
The town was empty. We met nobody on the way.
There's nowhere to park near the hospital.
After the hotel closed, the tourists had nowhere to stay.
Nobody will ever know who that man was.
Nobody called while you were out.
Don't book the boat trip for us. No one in my family can swim.
Nothing happened. It was a quiet day.
Nothing is more important to her than her children.
The teacher asked a very hard question, and no one knew the answer.
"What did you buy at the market?" "Nothing. It was all too expensive."
"Who was at the door?" "Nobody. It was just the wind."
"Where are you going tonight?" "Nowhere. I'm staying in."

examples.heading: ① 否定的動詞 + anyone / anybody

items.en: I broke Mum's vase, and I didn't tell anyone for a week.
items.zh: 我打破了媽媽的花瓶，一個星期都沒跟任何人說。

items.en: It's my first day at this school, so I don't know anybody yet.
items.zh: 今天是我在這所學校的第一天，所以我還一個人都不認識。

items.en: We rang the doorbell twice, but there wasn't anyone at home.
items.zh: 我們按了兩次門鈴，可是家裡沒有人。

items.en: Please don't show anybody these photos. They're private.
items.zh: 請不要把這些照片給任何人看。這是私人的。

items.en: She was so upset that she didn't want to talk to anyone.
items.zh: 她難過到不想跟任何人說話。

examples.heading: ② 否定的動詞 + anything

items.en: I haven't seen anything of the city yet. I only got here last night.
items.zh: 我還沒看到這座城市的任何東西。我昨晚才到。

items.en: The thief didn't take anything, but he broke the window.
items.zh: 小偷什麼都沒拿，可是打破了窗戶。

items.en: Don't say anything to Dad about the car. I'll tell him myself.
items.zh: 車子的事什麼都別跟爸爸說。我自己跟他說。

items.en: I can't see anything without my glasses.
items.zh: 我不戴眼鏡什麼都看不到。

items.en: We didn't have anything to eat on the long train journey.
items.zh: 長途火車上我們什麼吃的都沒有。

examples.heading: ③ 否定的動詞 + anywhere

items.en: I've looked everywhere, but I can't find my passport anywhere.
items.zh: 我每個地方都找了，可是哪裡都找不到我的護照。

items.en: We didn't go anywhere during the holidays because Mum was ill.
items.zh: 放假的時候我們哪裡都沒去，因為媽媽生病了。

items.en: There isn't anywhere to sit in this waiting room.
items.zh: 這間候診室裡沒有地方可以坐。

examples.heading: ④ 肯定的動詞 + nothing

items.en: I told the customs officer I had nothing to declare, but he didn't believe me.
items.zh: 我跟海關說我沒有東西要申報，可是他不相信我。

items.en: There's nothing in the fridge. Let's order a pizza.
items.zh: 冰箱裡什麼都沒有。我們叫披薩吧。

items.en: We asked about her new job, but she said nothing about it.
items.zh: 我們問她新工作的事，可是她一句也沒提。

items.en: The wedding is on Saturday, and I have nothing to wear.
items.zh: 婚禮在星期六，我沒有衣服可以穿。

examples.heading: ⑤ 肯定的動詞 + no one / nobody

items.en: I knocked and waited, but I saw no one.
items.zh: 我敲了門也等了，可是一個人都沒看到。

items.en: My brother is very careful with his new car. He lends it to nobody.
items.zh: 我哥哥對他的新車很小心。他誰都不借。

items.en: The town was empty. We met nobody on the way.
items.zh: 鎮上空蕩蕩的。我們一路上一個人都沒遇到。

examples.heading: ⑥ 肯定的動詞 + nowhere

items.en: There's nowhere to park near the hospital.
items.zh: 醫院附近沒地方停車。

items.en: After the hotel closed, the tourists had nowhere to stay.
items.zh: 飯店關門以後，觀光客沒地方住。

examples.heading: ⑦ no one / nobody / nothing 當主詞

items.en: Nobody will ever know who that man was.
items.zh: 永遠不會有人知道那個男人是誰。

items.en: Nobody called while you were out.
items.zh: 你出去的時候沒有人打電話來。

items.en: Don't book the boat trip for us. No one in my family can swim.
items.zh: 別幫我們訂搭船的行程。我家沒有人會游泳。

items.en: Nothing happened. It was a quiet day.
items.zh: 什麼事都沒發生。那是平靜的一天。

items.en: Nothing is more important to her than her children.
items.zh: 對她來說，沒有什麼比她的孩子更重要。

items.en: The teacher asked a very hard question, and no one knew the answer.
items.zh: 老師問了一個很難的問題，沒有人知道答案。

examples.heading: ⑧ 簡答：Nothing / Nobody / Nowhere

items.en: "What did you buy at the market?" "Nothing. It was all too expensive."
items.zh: 你在市集買了什麼？什麼都沒買。東西都太貴了。

items.en: "Who was at the door?" "Nobody. It was just the wind."
items.zh: 門口是誰？沒有人。只是風。

items.en: "Where are you going tonight?" "Nowhere. I'm staying in."
items.zh: 你今晚要去哪裡？哪裡都不去。我待在家。

title: Aren't you excited about it?
translation: 這件事你不覺得興奮嗎？
name: 否定疑問句和附加問句
sentences: You start your new job tomorrow. Aren't you nervous?
You've been walking all day. Aren't you tired?
Isn't that your sister over there by the door?
Let's go to the zoo instead. Isn't the gallery shut today?
Everybody loves this game. Don't you think it's fun?
Don't you remember me? We were in the same class.
Ask him about the flights. Doesn't your brother work at the airport?
Didn't you get my message? I sent it this morning.
Didn't they tell you about the change of plan?
Your dad really wants you at the concert. Can't you meet your friends another day?
Won't you stay for dinner? There's plenty of food.
Haven't you finished yet? We're going to be late.
Can't you sleep? Do you want some warm milk?
Let's drive to the coast. You're free on Saturday, aren't you?
A picnic by the river would be lovely, wouldn't it?
Close the window, please. It's cold today, isn't it?
Come and say hello. You've met my husband, haven't you?
Can you give Anna a lift? She lives near the station, doesn't she?
We should leave now. The film starts at eight, doesn't it?
Ask the Browns about Rome. They went to Italy last summer, didn't they?
We're going sailing tomorrow. You can swim, can't you?
Don't cook dinner for us. We'll be back by six, won't we?
I signed up last week. I'm on the list, aren't I?
I'm making fish tonight. You don't eat meat, do you?
Let's walk to the restaurant. It isn't far, is it?
Sam promised to ring this morning. He hasn't called yet, has he?
We're nearly at the theatre. You didn't leave the tickets at home, did you?
Speak quietly. The neighbours can't hear us, can they?
Do you not agree with the committee's decision?
Is it not true that the council knew about the problem?
Has the manager not explained the new rules to you?

examples.heading: ① 否定疑問句：Aren't / Isn't + 主詞

items.en: You start your new job tomorrow. Aren't you nervous?
items.zh: 你明天開始新工作。你不緊張嗎？

items.en: You've been walking all day. Aren't you tired?
items.zh: 你走了一整天了。你不累嗎？

items.en: Isn't that your sister over there by the door?
items.zh: 門邊那個人不是你姊姊嗎？

items.en: Let's go to the zoo instead. Isn't the gallery shut today?
items.zh: 我們改去動物園吧。美術館今天不是沒開嗎？

examples.heading: ② 否定疑問句：Don't / Doesn't / Didn't + 主詞

items.en: Everybody loves this game. Don't you think it's fun?
items.zh: 大家都很愛這個遊戲。你不覺得很好玩嗎？

items.en: Don't you remember me? We were in the same class.
items.zh: 你不記得我了嗎？我們以前同班。

items.en: Ask him about the flights. Doesn't your brother work at the airport?
items.zh: 問他航班的事吧。你哥哥不是在機場工作嗎？

items.en: Didn't you get my message? I sent it this morning.
items.zh: 你沒收到我的訊息嗎？我今天早上傳的。

items.en: Didn't they tell you about the change of plan?
items.zh: 他們沒跟你說計畫改了嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 否定疑問句：Can't / Won't / Haven't + 主詞

items.en: Your dad really wants you at the concert. Can't you meet your friends another day?
items.zh: 你爸很希望你去聽音樂會。你不能改天再跟朋友見面嗎？

items.en: Won't you stay for dinner? There's plenty of food.
items.zh: 你不留下來吃晚餐嗎？吃的東西很多。

items.en: Haven't you finished yet? We're going to be late.
items.zh: 你還沒好嗎？我們要遲到了。

items.en: Can't you sleep? Do you want some warm milk?
items.zh: 你睡不著嗎？要不要喝點熱牛奶？

examples.heading: ④ 肯定的直述句 + 否定的附加問句

items.en: Let's drive to the coast. You're free on Saturday, aren't you?
items.zh: 我們開車去海邊吧。你星期六有空，對吧？

items.en: A picnic by the river would be lovely, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 在河邊野餐會很棒，對吧？

items.en: Close the window, please. It's cold today, isn't it?
items.zh: 請把窗戶關上。今天很冷，對吧？

items.en: Come and say hello. You've met my husband, haven't you?
items.zh: 過來打個招呼。你見過我先生，對吧？

items.en: Can you give Anna a lift? She lives near the station, doesn't she?
items.zh: 你可以載 Anna 一程嗎？她住在車站附近，對吧？

items.en: We should leave now. The film starts at eight, doesn't it?
items.zh: 我們該出發了。電影八點開始，對吧？

items.en: Ask the Browns about Rome. They went to Italy last summer, didn't they?
items.zh: 去問 Brown 一家羅馬的事。他們去年夏天去了義大利，對吧？

items.en: We're going sailing tomorrow. You can swim, can't you?
items.zh: 我們明天要去駕帆船。你會游泳，對吧？

items.en: Don't cook dinner for us. We'll be back by six, won't we?
items.zh: 別幫我們煮晚餐。我們六點以前會回來，對吧？

items.en: I signed up last week. I'm on the list, aren't I?
items.zh: 我上星期報名了。名單上有我，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定的直述句 + 肯定的附加問句

items.en: I'm making fish tonight. You don't eat meat, do you?
items.zh: 我今晚要煮魚。你不吃肉，對吧？

items.en: Let's walk to the restaurant. It isn't far, is it?
items.zh: 我們走路去餐廳吧。不遠，對吧？

items.en: Sam promised to ring this morning. He hasn't called yet, has he?
items.zh: Sam 答應今天早上會打來。他還沒打來，對吧？

items.en: We're nearly at the theatre. You didn't leave the tickets at home, did you?
items.zh: 我們快到劇院了。你沒把票留在家裡吧？

items.en: Speak quietly. The neighbours can't hear us, can they?
items.zh: 小聲一點。鄰居聽不到我們說話，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑥ 助動詞 + 主詞 + not：不縮寫的否定疑問句

items.en: Do you not agree with the committee's decision?
items.zh: 你不同意委員會的決定嗎？

items.en: Is it not true that the council knew about the problem?
items.zh: 市議會早就知道這個問題，不是嗎？

items.en: Has the manager not explained the new rules to you?
items.zh: 經理還沒跟你說明新的規定嗎？

title: Don't you ever do that again!
translation: 你再敢這樣做試試看！
name: Don't you 表示警告或斥責
sentences: You went swimming in the river alone? Don't you ever go there again!
Don't you ever lie to me again! I trusted you.
Don't you ever speak to your grandmother like that!
Don't you ever leave the house without telling me!
Don't you ever take my car without asking!
Don't you ever scare me like that again!
Don't you touch my phone! It's private.
I'm your father. Don't you shout at me!
Don't you go near that dog. It bites.
Don't you forget to call me when you get there.
Don't you eat those cakes. They're for the party.
Don't you laugh at me! It isn't funny.
Don't you tell me what to do!
Don't you dare tell anyone about this!
Don't you dare forget me. I want letters from you every week.
Don't you dare open my presents before Christmas!
Don't you dare be late for the wedding.
Don't you dare blame me for this. It was your idea.
Don't you dare quit the team now. The final is next week.
Don't you dare read my diary!
"I'm going to tell Mum." "Don't you dare!"
He picked up the last piece of cake. "Don't you dare!" said his sister.
"I might sell your old guitar." "Don't you dare!"
Tom, don't you ever hit your brother again!
Now, don't you worry about the money. I'll pay.
Don't you cry, sweetheart. Mummy's here.
"Don't you ever come back here!" the old man shouted.
She pointed at him. "Don't you dare walk away from me."
"Don't you touch her," he said quietly.
"Don't you dare say a word," she whispered.
"Don't you ever forget where you come from," my father told me.

examples.heading: ① Don't you ever + 原形動詞

items.en: You went swimming in the river alone? Don't you ever go there again!
items.zh: 你自己去河裡游泳？你以後不准再去那裡！

items.en: Don't you ever lie to me again! I trusted you.
items.zh: 你永遠不准再對我說謊！我那麼信任你。

items.en: Don't you ever speak to your grandmother like that!
items.zh: 你不准再那樣跟奶奶說話！

items.en: Don't you ever leave the house without telling me!
items.zh: 你以後不准沒跟我說就出門！

items.en: Don't you ever take my car without asking!
items.zh: 你以後不准沒問就開走我的車！

items.en: Don't you ever scare me like that again!
items.zh: 你不准再那樣嚇我！

examples.heading: ② Don't you + 原形動詞

items.en: Don't you touch my phone! It's private.
items.zh: 你不准碰我的手機！那是私人的。

items.en: I'm your father. Don't you shout at me!
items.zh: 我是你爸爸。你不准對我大吼！

items.en: Don't you go near that dog. It bites.
items.zh: 你不准靠近那隻狗。牠會咬人。

items.en: Don't you forget to call me when you get there.
items.zh: 你到了一定要打給我，不准忘記。

items.en: Don't you eat those cakes. They're for the party.
items.zh: 你不准吃那些蛋糕。那是派對要用的。

items.en: Don't you laugh at me! It isn't funny.
items.zh: 你不准笑我！一點都不好笑。

items.en: Don't you tell me what to do!
items.zh: 你少管我！

examples.heading: ③ Don't you dare + 原形動詞

items.en: Don't you dare tell anyone about this!
items.zh: 這件事你敢告訴別人試試看！

items.en: Don't you dare forget me. I want letters from you every week.
items.zh: 你敢把我忘了試試看。我每個星期都要收到你的信。

items.en: Don't you dare open my presents before Christmas!
items.zh: 你敢在聖誕節前拆我的禮物試試看！

items.en: Don't you dare be late for the wedding.
items.zh: 你敢在婚禮上遲到試試看。

items.en: Don't you dare blame me for this. It was your idea.
items.zh: 你敢把這件事怪到我頭上試試看。那是你的主意。

items.en: Don't you dare quit the team now. The final is next week.
items.zh: 你現在敢退出球隊試試看。決賽就在下星期。

items.en: Don't you dare read my diary!
items.zh: 你敢看我的日記試試看！

examples.heading: ④ Don't you dare!（單獨用）

items.en: "I'm going to tell Mum." "Don't you dare!"
items.zh: 我要去跟媽媽說。你敢！

items.en: He picked up the last piece of cake. "Don't you dare!" said his sister.
items.zh: 他拿起最後一塊蛋糕。你敢！他妹妹說。

items.en: "I might sell your old guitar." "Don't you dare!"
items.zh: 我可能會把你的舊吉他賣掉。你敢！

examples.heading: ⑤ 加上稱呼，或用來安慰對方

items.en: Tom, don't you ever hit your brother again!
items.zh: Tom，你不准再打你弟弟！

items.en: Now, don't you worry about the money. I'll pay.
items.zh: 好了，錢的事你別擔心。我來付。

items.en: Don't you cry, sweetheart. Mummy's here.
items.zh: 別哭，寶貝。媽媽在這裡。

examples.heading: ⑥ 故事和小說裡的對話

items.en: "Don't you ever come back here!" the old man shouted.
items.zh: 你永遠不准再回來這裡！老人大吼。

items.en: She pointed at him. "Don't you dare walk away from me."
items.zh: 她指著他。你敢給我走開試試看。

items.en: "Don't you touch her," he said quietly.
items.zh: 你不准碰她。他小聲地說。

items.en: "Don't you dare say a word," she whispered.
items.zh: 你敢說一個字試試看。她低聲說。

items.en: "Don't you ever forget where you come from," my father told me.
items.zh: 你永遠不准忘記自己從哪裡來。我爸爸跟我說。

title: What others say doesn't matter in the least.
translation: 別人說什麼一點都不重要。
name: 否定句後加 in the least 加強語氣
sentences: My friends think my haircut is strange, but it doesn't bother me in the least.
She failed her driving test, but that didn't discourage her in the least.
The long wait didn't bother me in the least. I had a good book.
Dad was in a bad mood, but it didn't affect the party in the least.
It rained all afternoon, but that didn't spoil our day in the least.
I don't mind waiting in the least. Take your time.
Many television bosses are not in the least interested in quality. They only care about viewers.
I'm not in the least tired. Let's keep walking.
He wasn't in the least surprised when she said no.
The neighbours' dog is huge, but the children were not in the least afraid of it.
Don't worry about next year. The exam wasn't in the least difficult.
I'm not in the least worried about the interview.
She wasn't worried in the least about the trip.
We asked for directions, but the hotel staff weren't helpful in the least.
I'm not angry in the least. I just want to know what happened.
We paid a lot for it, but the new sofa isn't comfortable in the least.
"Do you mind if I bring my dog?" "Not in the least."
"Were you nervous before the speech?" "Not in the least."
"Am I disturbing you?" "Not in the least. Come in."
"Are you disappointed with the result?" "Not in the least. We did our best."
I live on a busy road, but the noise doesn't disturb me in the least.
She criticised his cooking, but her comments didn't upset him in the least.
The price doesn't interest me in the least. I just want good quality.
It was below zero, but the cold didn't stop the runners in the least.
The new rules do not in the least change the rights of employees.
Sales fell after the price rise. The results were not in the least surprising.
Hundreds of customers wrote in, but the company was not in the least concerned about the complaints.
This does not in the least mean that the project has failed.
The train was an hour late, but my boss didn't care in the least.
I don't care in the least what he thinks.
My grandmother didn't seem in the least tired after the long flight.

examples.heading: ① 否定的動詞 + in the least（句尾）

items.en: My friends think my haircut is strange, but it doesn't bother me in the least.
items.zh: 朋友覺得我的髮型很怪，可是我一點也不在意。

items.en: She failed her driving test, but that didn't discourage her in the least.
items.zh: 她駕照沒考過，可是這一點也沒讓她灰心。

items.en: The long wait didn't bother me in the least. I had a good book.
items.zh: 等了那麼久，我一點也不在意。我有一本好書可以看。

items.en: Dad was in a bad mood, but it didn't affect the party in the least.
items.zh: 爸爸心情不好，可是一點也沒影響派對。

items.en: It rained all afternoon, but that didn't spoil our day in the least.
items.zh: 下了一整個下午的雨，可是一點也沒破壞我們這一天。

items.en: I don't mind waiting in the least. Take your time.
items.zh: 我一點也不介意等。慢慢來。

examples.heading: ② be + not + in the least + 形容詞

items.en: Many television bosses are not in the least interested in quality. They only care about viewers.
items.zh: 很多電視台的主管一點也不在乎品質。他們只在乎收視率。

items.en: I'm not in the least tired. Let's keep walking.
items.zh: 我一點也不累。我們繼續走吧。

items.en: He wasn't in the least surprised when she said no.
items.zh: 她拒絕的時候，他一點也不意外。

items.en: The neighbours' dog is huge, but the children were not in the least afraid of it.
items.zh: 鄰居的狗很大，可是孩子們一點也不怕牠。

items.en: Don't worry about next year. The exam wasn't in the least difficult.
items.zh: 別擔心明年的事。考試一點也不難。

items.en: I'm not in the least worried about the interview.
items.zh: 我一點也不擔心面試。

examples.heading: ③ be + not + 形容詞 + in the least

items.en: She wasn't worried in the least about the trip.
items.zh: 她對這趟旅行一點也不擔心。

items.en: We asked for directions, but the hotel staff weren't helpful in the least.
items.zh: 我們問路，可是飯店的員工一點也不幫忙。

items.en: I'm not angry in the least. I just want to know what happened.
items.zh: 我一點也不生氣。我只是想知道發生了什麼事。

items.en: We paid a lot for it, but the new sofa isn't comfortable in the least.
items.zh: 我們花了很多錢，可是新沙發一點也不舒服。

examples.heading: ④ Not in the least：簡答

items.en: "Do you mind if I bring my dog?" "Not in the least."
items.zh: 你介意我帶狗來嗎？一點也不介意。

items.en: "Were you nervous before the speech?" "Not in the least."
items.zh: 你演講前會緊張嗎？一點也不會。

items.en: "Am I disturbing you?" "Not in the least. Come in."
items.zh: 我打擾到你了嗎？一點也沒有。進來吧。

items.en: "Are you disappointed with the result?" "Not in the least. We did our best."
items.zh: 你對結果失望嗎？一點也不。我們盡力了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定的動詞 + 受詞 + in the least：對人沒有影響

items.en: I live on a busy road, but the noise doesn't disturb me in the least.
items.zh: 我住在大馬路邊，可是噪音一點也不會吵到我。

items.en: She criticised his cooking, but her comments didn't upset him in the least.
items.zh: 她批評他煮的菜，可是她的評論一點也沒讓他難過。

items.en: The price doesn't interest me in the least. I just want good quality.
items.zh: 我一點也不在乎價錢。我只要品質好。

items.en: It was below zero, but the cold didn't stop the runners in the least.
items.zh: 氣溫在零度以下，可是寒冷一點也沒擋住跑者。

examples.heading: ⑥ 正式的寫作

items.en: The new rules do not in the least change the rights of employees.
items.zh: 新規定一點也不會改變員工的權利。

items.en: Sales fell after the price rise. The results were not in the least surprising.
items.zh: 漲價後銷量下降了。這些結果一點也不令人意外。

items.en: Hundreds of customers wrote in, but the company was not in the least concerned about the complaints.
items.zh: 好幾百位顧客寫信來，可是那家公司一點也不在意這些投訴。

items.en: This does not in the least mean that the project has failed.
items.zh: 這一點也不表示這個計畫失敗了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 其他動詞 + in the least

items.en: The train was an hour late, but my boss didn't care in the least.
items.zh: 火車晚了一個小時，可是我老闆一點也不在意。

items.en: I don't care in the least what he thinks.
items.zh: 他怎麼想，我一點也不在乎。

items.en: My grandmother didn't seem in the least tired after the long flight.
items.zh: 長途飛行之後，我奶奶看起來一點也不累。

title: It is not possible to have a conversation on the veranda without shouting. Nor is it possible to watch television in peace.
translation: 在陽台上不用大吼就沒辦法講話，也沒辦法安靜地看電視。
name: neither、nor 加 do 或 be 倒裝追加否定
sentences: The library isn't open on Sundays. Nor is it open in the evenings.
The flat wasn't big. Nor was it close to the station.
The instructions weren't clear. Nor were they in English.
I'm not a morning person. Nor am I very good at waking up early.
I didn't like the food at the hotel. Nor did I like the noisy bar.
The company doesn't pay well. Nor does it offer training.
We didn't see any wildlife. Nor did we see the famous waterfall.
My parents don't own a car. Nor do they want one.
The landlord never fixed the heating. Nor did he answer our emails.
At first, I didn't pay attention to all her magazines. Neither did I object to her buying new clothes every month.
He didn't apologise. Neither did he explain why he was late.
The school doesn't have a gym. Neither does it have a playing field.
I don't enjoy cooking. Neither do I enjoy washing up.
We can't afford a new car. Nor can we afford to fix the old one.
I won't lend him money. Neither will I give him a job.
Children under twelve cannot use the pool alone. Nor can they use the gym.
You shouldn't drive when you're tired. Nor should you drive after drinking.
I haven't finished the report. Nor have I started the presentation.
The council hasn't repaired the road. Neither has it put up any warning signs.
We hadn't booked a hotel. Nor had we checked the weather.
She never wrote to us, and nor did she call.
I don't like big cities, and nor does my wife.
The old bridge isn't safe for lorries, and nor is the road to the farm.
"I don't eat meat." "Neither do I."
"I can't swim." "Nor can my brother."
"I wasn't at the party on Saturday." "Neither was I. I was ill."
"We haven't been to Japan." "Neither have we."
"I didn't understand the question." "Nor did I."
"Tom won't be at the meeting." "Neither will Anna."
The government has not explained the new tax. Nor has it said how the money will be used.
The study did not include older adults. Nor did it look at people with heart disease.

examples.heading: ① Nor + be + 主詞

items.en: The library isn't open on Sundays. Nor is it open in the evenings.
items.zh: 圖書館星期天不開，晚上也不開。

items.en: The flat wasn't big. Nor was it close to the station.
items.zh: 那間公寓不大，離車站也不近。

items.en: The instructions weren't clear. Nor were they in English.
items.zh: 說明不清楚，而且也不是英文的。

items.en: I'm not a morning person. Nor am I very good at waking up early.
items.zh: 我不是早起的人，也不太擅長早起。

examples.heading: ② Nor + do / does / did + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: I didn't like the food at the hotel. Nor did I like the noisy bar.
items.zh: 我不喜歡飯店的菜，也不喜歡吵鬧的酒吧。

items.en: The company doesn't pay well. Nor does it offer training.
items.zh: 那家公司薪水不高，也不提供訓練。

items.en: We didn't see any wildlife. Nor did we see the famous waterfall.
items.zh: 我們沒看到任何野生動物，也沒看到那個有名的瀑布。

items.en: My parents don't own a car. Nor do they want one.
items.zh: 我爸媽沒有車，也不想要車。

items.en: The landlord never fixed the heating. Nor did he answer our emails.
items.zh: 房東從來沒修暖氣，也沒回我們的電子郵件。

examples.heading: ③ Neither + do / does / did + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: At first, I didn't pay attention to all her magazines. Neither did I object to her buying new clothes every month.
items.zh: 一開始我沒注意她訂了那麼多雜誌，也沒反對她每個月買新衣服。

items.en: He didn't apologise. Neither did he explain why he was late.
items.zh: 他沒道歉，也沒解釋為什麼遲到。

items.en: The school doesn't have a gym. Neither does it have a playing field.
items.zh: 那所學校沒有體育館，也沒有運動場。

items.en: I don't enjoy cooking. Neither do I enjoy washing up.
items.zh: 我不喜歡煮飯，也不喜歡洗碗。

examples.heading: ④ Nor / Neither + 情態動詞 + 主詞

items.en: We can't afford a new car. Nor can we afford to fix the old one.
items.zh: 我們買不起新車，也付不起修舊車的錢。

items.en: I won't lend him money. Neither will I give him a job.
items.zh: 我不會借他錢，也不會給他工作。

items.en: Children under twelve cannot use the pool alone. Nor can they use the gym.
items.zh: 十二歲以下的兒童不能單獨使用泳池，也不能使用健身房。

items.en: You shouldn't drive when you're tired. Nor should you drive after drinking.
items.zh: 累的時候不應該開車，喝了酒也不應該開車。

examples.heading: ⑤ Nor / Neither + have / has / had + 主詞

items.en: I haven't finished the report. Nor have I started the presentation.
items.zh: 我還沒寫完報告，簡報也還沒開始做。

items.en: The council hasn't repaired the road. Neither has it put up any warning signs.
items.zh: 市議會沒修那條路，也沒立任何警告標誌。

items.en: We hadn't booked a hotel. Nor had we checked the weather.
items.zh: 我們沒訂飯店，也沒查天氣。

examples.heading: ⑥ and nor / but nor

items.en: She never wrote to us, and nor did she call.
items.zh: 她從來沒寫信給我們，也沒打電話。

items.en: I don't like big cities, and nor does my wife.
items.zh: 我不喜歡大城市，我太太也不喜歡。

items.en: The old bridge isn't safe for lorries, and nor is the road to the farm.
items.zh: 那座舊橋卡車走不安全，通往農場的路也不安全。

examples.heading: ⑦ 簡短的回應：Neither / Nor + 助動詞 + 主詞

items.en: "I don't eat meat." "Neither do I."
items.zh: 我不吃肉。我也不吃。

items.en: "I can't swim." "Nor can my brother."
items.zh: 我不會游泳。我哥哥也不會。

items.en: "I wasn't at the party on Saturday." "Neither was I. I was ill."
items.zh: 我星期六沒去派對。我也沒去。我生病了。

items.en: "We haven't been to Japan." "Neither have we."
items.zh: 我們沒去過日本。我們也沒有。

items.en: "I didn't understand the question." "Nor did I."
items.zh: 我沒聽懂那個問題。我也沒有。

items.en: "Tom won't be at the meeting." "Neither will Anna."
items.zh: Tom 不會來開會。Anna 也不會。

examples.heading: ⑧ 正式的寫作

items.en: The government has not explained the new tax. Nor has it said how the money will be used.
items.zh: 政府沒有說明新的稅，也沒說錢會怎麼用。

items.en: The study did not include older adults. Nor did it look at people with heart disease.
items.zh: 這項研究沒有納入老年人，也沒有研究心臟病患者。

title: Neither you nor I would like that.
translation: 你和我都不會喜歡那樣的。
name: neither … nor 的否定強調
sentences: Neither the hotel nor the airline answered my emails.
Neither my sister nor I can swim very well.
Neither the teacher nor the students knew about the fire drill.
Neither Tom nor Anna came to the meeting, so we stopped early.
Neither the bus nor the train goes to the village on Sundays.
Neither my parents nor my brother has visited my new flat.
The hostel provides neither towels nor soap, so bring your own.
I have neither the time nor the money for a long holiday.
My grandfather drinks neither tea nor coffee. He only drinks water.
I can't check the facts. The report gives neither names nor dates.
We saw neither bears nor wolves on our walk through the forest.
Visitors can neither feed nor touch the animals.
I have neither climbed nor surfed before, so this trip will be very exciting for me.
She neither called nor wrote for six months.
The old man could neither read nor write.
He neither agreed nor disagreed. He just smiled.
The hotel was neither clean nor cheap. We won't go back.
The weather was neither hot nor cold. It was perfect for walking.
The film was neither funny nor scary, so I nearly fell asleep.
My new phone is neither fast nor easy to use.

The answer is neither in the book nor on the website.
Neither my brother nor my parents are coming to the party.
Neither the manager nor the staff were happy with the new hours.
Neither the players nor the coach was ready for the rain.
I enjoy neither cooking nor cleaning, so we often eat out.

Neither shouting nor crying will help. Let's think about what to do.
The new job involves neither travelling nor working at weekends.
