examples.heading: ① 主詞：neither + 名詞或代名詞 + nor + 名詞或代名詞

items.en: Neither the hotel nor the airline answered my emails.
items.zh: 飯店和航空公司都沒回我的電子郵件。

items.en: Neither my sister nor I can swim very well.
items.zh: 我姊姊和我游泳都游得不太好。

items.en: Neither the teacher nor the students knew about the fire drill.
items.zh: 老師和學生都不知道有消防演習。

items.en: Neither Tom nor Anna came to the meeting, so we stopped early.
items.zh: Tom 和 Anna 都沒來開會，所以我們提早結束了。

items.en: Neither the bus nor the train goes to the village on Sundays.
items.zh: 星期天公車和火車都不到那個村子。

items.en: Neither my parents nor my brother has visited my new flat.
items.zh: 我爸媽和我哥哥都還沒來過我的新公寓。

examples.heading: ② 受詞：動詞 + neither + 名詞 + nor + 名詞

items.en: The hostel provides neither towels nor soap, so bring your own.
items.zh: 青年旅館不提供毛巾和肥皂，所以要自己帶。

items.en: I have neither the time nor the money for a long holiday.
items.zh: 我沒有時間也沒有錢去長途度假。

items.en: My grandfather drinks neither tea nor coffee. He only drinks water.
items.zh: 我爺爺茶和咖啡都不喝。他只喝水。

items.en: I can't check the facts. The report gives neither names nor dates.
items.zh: 我沒辦法查證。這份報告沒有寫名字，也沒有寫日期。

items.en: We saw neither bears nor wolves on our walk through the forest.
items.zh: 我們走過森林，熊和狼都沒看到。

examples.heading: ③ 動詞：neither + 動詞 + nor + 動詞

items.en: Visitors can neither feed nor touch the animals.
items.zh: 遊客不能餵動物，也不能摸動物。

items.en: I have neither climbed nor surfed before, so this trip will be very exciting for me.
items.zh: 我以前沒攀岩過，也沒衝浪過，所以這趟旅行對我來說會很刺激。

items.en: She neither called nor wrote for six months.
items.zh: 她六個月沒打電話也沒寫信。

items.en: The old man could neither read nor write.
items.zh: 那個老人不會讀也不會寫。

items.en: He neither agreed nor disagreed. He just smiled.
items.zh: 他既沒同意也沒反對。他只是笑了笑。

examples.heading: ④ 形容詞：be + neither + 形容詞 + nor + 形容詞

items.en: The hotel was neither clean nor cheap. We won't go back.
items.zh: 那家飯店既不乾淨也不便宜。我們不會再去了。

items.en: The weather was neither hot nor cold. It was perfect for walking.
items.zh: 天氣不熱也不冷。很適合散步。

items.en: The film was neither funny nor scary, so I nearly fell asleep.
items.zh: 那部電影既不好笑也不可怕，所以我差點睡著。

items.en: My new phone is neither fast nor easy to use.
items.zh: 我的新手機既不快也不好用。

examples.heading: ⑤ 片語：neither + 介系詞片語 + nor + 介系詞片語

items.en: The keys were neither in my bag nor in my coat.
items.zh: 鑰匙既不在我的包包裡，也不在我的外套裡。

items.en: The cat was neither in the garden nor in the garage. We found it on the roof.
items.zh: 貓不在花園，也不在車庫。我們在屋頂上找到牠。

items.en: The answer is neither in the book nor on the website.
items.zh: 答案不在書裡，也不在網站上。

examples.heading: ⑥ 主詞的單複數跟著 nor 後面的部分

items.en: Neither my brother nor my parents are coming to the party.
items.zh: 我哥哥和我爸媽都不來派對。

items.en: Neither the manager nor the staff were happy with the new hours.
items.zh: 經理和員工都不滿意新的上班時間。

items.en: Neither the players nor the coach was ready for the rain.
items.zh: 球員和教練都沒準備好應付下雨。

examples.heading: ⑦ neither + 動詞-ing + nor + 動詞-ing

items.en: I enjoy neither cooking nor cleaning, so we often eat out.
items.zh: 我既不喜歡煮飯也不喜歡打掃，所以我們常在外面吃。

items.en: My son likes neither swimming nor running, but he loves cycling.
items.zh: 我兒子不喜歡游泳也不喜歡跑步，可是他很愛騎腳踏車。

items.en: Neither shouting nor crying will help. Let's think about what to do.
items.zh: 大吼和哭都沒有用。我們想想該怎麼辦。

items.en: The new job involves neither travelling nor working at weekends.
items.zh: 新工作不用出差，也不用週末上班。

items.en: You need a car out here. Neither walking nor taking the bus is quick.
items.zh: 住在這裡要有車。走路和搭公車都很慢。

title: Never had I thought that my parents would do this to me.
translation: 我做夢也沒想到，我爸媽竟然會這樣對我。
name: never 放在句首的倒裝
sentences: The special effects were amazing. Never have I seen such a realistic film.
Never have I been so happy to see the sea after a long winter.
Never have I met anyone as kind as my grandmother.
Never has the town looked so beautiful as it does this spring.
Never have we had so many visitors at the museum.
Never have I eaten such good pasta, not even in Italy.
Never had I thought that a small dog could eat so much.
Never had she felt so alone as on her first night in the city.
Never had we seen so much snow. The whole village was white.
Never had my brother cooked a meal before he left home.
Never had the team played so badly in front of their own fans.
Thank you for coming to help us after the fire. Never will we forget your kindness.
Never will I fly with that airline again. They lost my bags twice.
Never would I have guessed that he was a famous singer.
Never could she understand why her brother left home.
We're very sorry about the mistake with your order. Never will we let this happen again.
Never did I see him again after that summer.
Never did I imagine that I would become a teacher.
Never did she complain, even when she was very ill.
Never did we expect so many people to come to the concert.
Never did the old man tell anyone where he hid the money.
Never do I feel as relaxed as when I'm in the mountains.
Never does my father leave the house without his hat.
Never before had the school won the national prize.
Never before have so many people used the internet to shop.
Never again will I leave my homework until the last minute.
Never again did they go camping in the rain.
We waited in the rain for an hour. Never was I so glad to see a taxi.
Never were the streets so quiet as on the night of the snowstorm.
My grandparents loved visitors. Never was their house empty at weekends.
Never was a holiday so badly planned. We missed every train.

examples.heading: ① Never + have / has + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: The special effects were amazing. Never have I seen such a realistic film.
items.zh: 特效太厲害了。我從來沒看過這麼逼真的電影。

items.en: Never have I been so happy to see the sea after a long winter.
items.zh: 漫長的冬天過後，我從來沒有這麼高興看到海。

items.en: Never have I met anyone as kind as my grandmother.
items.zh: 我從來沒遇過像我奶奶這麼善良的人。

items.en: Never has the town looked so beautiful as it does this spring.
items.zh: 這個鎮從來沒有像今年春天這麼美。

items.en: Never have we had so many visitors at the museum.
items.zh: 博物館從來沒有過這麼多參觀者。

items.en: Never have I eaten such good pasta, not even in Italy.
items.zh: 我從來沒吃過這麼好吃的義大利麵，在義大利也沒有。

examples.heading: ② Never + had + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: Never had I thought that a small dog could eat so much.
items.zh: 我從來沒想過一隻小狗可以吃這麼多。

items.en: Never had she felt so alone as on her first night in the city.
items.zh: 她從來沒有像到這座城市的第一個晚上那麼孤單。

items.en: Never had we seen so much snow. The whole village was white.
items.zh: 我們從來沒看過這麼多雪。整個村子都白了。

items.en: Never had my brother cooked a meal before he left home.
items.zh: 我哥哥離家之前從來沒煮過一頓飯。

items.en: Never had the team played so badly in front of their own fans.
items.zh: 這支球隊從來沒有在自己的球迷面前打得這麼差。

examples.heading: ③ Never + will / would / can + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Thank you for coming to help us after the fire. Never will we forget your kindness.
items.zh: 謝謝你們在火災後來幫忙。我們永遠不會忘記你們的好意。

items.en: Never will I fly with that airline again. They lost my bags twice.
items.zh: 我再也不會搭那家航空公司的飛機了。他們弄丟我的行李兩次。

items.en: Never would I have guessed that he was a famous singer.
items.zh: 我怎麼也猜不到他是有名的歌手。

items.en: Never could she understand why her brother left home.
items.zh: 她怎麼也想不通她哥哥為什麼離家。

items.en: We're very sorry about the mistake with your order. Never will we let this happen again.
items.zh: 您的訂單出了錯，我們非常抱歉。我們絕對不會再讓這種事發生。

examples.heading: ④ Never + did + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Never did I see him again after that summer.
items.zh: 那個夏天以後，我就再也沒見過他。

items.en: Never did I imagine that I would become a teacher.
items.zh: 我從來沒想過自己會當老師。

items.en: Never did she complain, even when she was very ill.
items.zh: 就算病得很重，她也從來沒抱怨過。

items.en: Never did we expect so many people to come to the concert.
items.zh: 我們從來沒料到會有這麼多人來聽演唱會。

items.en: Never did the old man tell anyone where he hid the money.
items.zh: 那個老人從來沒告訴任何人他把錢藏在哪裡。

examples.heading: ⑤ Never + do / does + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Never do I feel as relaxed as when I'm in the mountains.
items.zh: 我從來沒有像在山上的時候那麼放鬆。

items.en: Never does my father leave the house without his hat.
items.zh: 我爸爸出門從來不會不戴帽子。

examples.heading: ⑥ Never before / Never again + 倒裝

items.en: Never before had the school won the national prize.
items.zh: 這所學校以前從來沒得過全國獎。

items.en: Never before have so many people used the internet to shop.
items.zh: 以前從來沒有這麼多人用網路購物。

items.en: Never again will I leave my homework until the last minute.
items.zh: 我再也不會把功課拖到最後一刻了。

items.en: Never again did they go camping in the rain.
items.zh: 從那以後，他們就再也沒在雨中露營過了。

examples.heading: ⑦ Never + was / were + 主詞

items.en: We waited in the rain for an hour. Never was I so glad to see a taxi.
items.zh: 我們在雨中等了一個小時。我從來沒有這麼高興看到計程車。

items.en: Never were the streets so quiet as on the night of the snowstorm.
items.zh: 街上從來沒有像暴風雪那天晚上那麼安靜。

items.en: My grandparents loved visitors. Never was their house empty at weekends.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶很喜歡有客人來。他們家週末從來沒有空過。

items.en: Never was a holiday so badly planned. We missed every train.
items.zh: 從來沒有一趟旅行計畫得這麼糟。每班火車我們都沒趕上。

title: Not a single noise could be heard from inside any of the rooms.
translation: 每個房間裡都聽不到一點聲音。
name: not a 加名詞加強否定
sentences: The museum was closed. Not a single visitor could be seen.
The couple had argued, and not a single word was exchanged in the car home.
Not a single tree was left standing after the storm.
Not a single ticket was sold for the Monday show.
The teacher checked every page, and not a single error was found.
Not a single light could be seen in the village.
Not a single member of the group expected the coach to break down in the middle of nowhere.
Not a single student passed the final test.
Not a single person came to help us when the car broke down.
Not a single cloud was in the sky, so we went to the beach.
Not a single shop in the village sells fresh bread.
Not a single player on the team scored in the match.
I listened at the door, but not a sound came from the kitchen.
Not a word was said about the money.（被動）
Not a day goes by without my grandmother calling me.
Not a moment passed before the phone rang again.
Not a drop of rain has fallen here since April.
I didn't see a single car on the road all night.
She didn't make a single mistake in the test.
We didn't get a single reply to our advertisement.
He didn't say a single word during dinner.
I haven't had a single day off this month.
The shop was open all day, but it didn't sell a single umbrella.
Not a single one of my friends remembered my birthday.
Not a single one of the windows was open.
Not a single one of us knew the answer.
The streets were empty. Not a single person was out in the snow.
We waited for hours, but not a single bus came.
The exam room was silent. Not a single pen moved.
She read every page of the letter, but not a single line explained why he left.
Not a single star was visible through the thick clouds.

examples.heading: ① Not a single + 名詞 + 被動

items.en: The museum was closed. Not a single visitor could be seen.
items.zh: 博物館關了。一個參觀的人都看不到。

items.en: The couple had argued, and not a single word was exchanged in the car home.
items.zh: 那對夫妻吵架了，回家的車上兩個人一句話都沒說。

items.en: Not a single tree was left standing after the storm.
items.zh: 暴風雨過後，一棵樹都沒有留下來。

items.en: Not a single ticket was sold for the Monday show.
items.zh: 星期一那場表演一張票都沒賣出去。

items.en: The teacher checked every page, and not a single error was found.
items.zh: 老師檢查了每一頁，一個錯誤都沒找到。

items.en: Not a single light could be seen in the village.
items.zh: 村子裡一盞燈都看不到。

examples.heading: ② Not a single + 名詞 + 主動的動詞

items.en: Not a single member of the group expected the coach to break down in the middle of nowhere.
items.zh: 團裡沒有一個人料到遊覽車會在荒郊野外拋錨。

items.en: Not a single student passed the final test.
items.zh: 期末考一個學生都沒及格。

items.en: Not a single person came to help us when the car broke down.
items.zh: 車子拋錨的時候，沒有一個人來幫我們。

items.en: Not a single cloud was in the sky, so we went to the beach.
items.zh: 天上一朵雲都沒有，所以我們去了海邊。

items.en: Not a single shop in the village sells fresh bread.
items.zh: 村子裡沒有一家店賣新鮮麵包。

items.en: Not a single player on the team scored in the match.
items.zh: 隊上沒有一個球員在比賽中得分。

examples.heading: ③ Not a + 名詞（省略 single）

items.en: I listened at the door, but not a sound came from the kitchen.
items.zh: 我在門口聽，可是廚房沒有傳出一點聲音。

items.en: Not a word was said about the money.（被動）
items.zh: 錢的事一句都沒提。

items.en: Not a day goes by without my grandmother calling me.
items.zh: 我奶奶沒有一天不打電話給我。

items.en: Not a moment passed before the phone rang again.
items.zh: 電話才停一下就又響了。

items.en: Not a drop of rain has fallen here since April.
items.zh: 從四月到現在，這裡一滴雨都沒下。

examples.heading: ④ 否定的動詞 + a single + 名詞（受詞）

items.en: I didn't see a single car on the road all night.
items.zh: 整晚路上我連一輛車都沒看到。

items.en: She didn't make a single mistake in the test.
items.zh: 她考試一個錯都沒犯。

items.en: We didn't get a single reply to our advertisement.
items.zh: 我們的廣告連一個回覆都沒收到。

items.en: He didn't say a single word during dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐的時候他一句話都沒說。

items.en: I haven't had a single day off this month.
items.zh: 這個月我一天假都沒放。

items.en: The shop was open all day, but it didn't sell a single umbrella.
items.zh: 那家店開了一整天，可是一把傘都沒賣出去。

examples.heading: ⑤ not a single + 名詞 + of + 名詞片語

items.en: Not a single one of my friends remembered my birthday.
items.zh: 我的朋友沒有一個記得我的生日。

items.en: Not a single one of the windows was open.
items.zh: 窗戶一扇都沒開。

items.en: Not a single one of us knew the answer.
items.zh: 我們沒有一個人知道答案。

examples.heading: ⑥ 故事和寫作

items.en: The streets were empty. Not a single person was out in the snow.
items.zh: 街上空蕩蕩的。雪地裡一個人都沒有。

items.en: We waited for hours, but not a single bus came.
items.zh: 我們等了好幾個小時，可是一班公車都沒來。

items.en: The exam room was silent. Not a single pen moved.
items.zh: 考場一片安靜。沒有一支筆在動。

items.en: She read every page of the letter, but not a single line explained why he left.
items.zh: 她把信讀了每一頁，可是沒有一行說明他為什麼離開。

items.en: Not a single star was visible through the thick clouds.
items.zh: 厚厚的雲層後面一顆星星都看不到。

title: Not only was it in a wonderful location, but it was also very accessible.
translation: 那裡不但地點很棒，交通也很方便。
name: not only 倒裝句（可省略 but）
sentences: Not only was the beach clean, but it was also very quiet.
We didn't rent the flat. Not only was it small, but it was also very dark.
Not only is she a great teacher, but she is also a talented painter.
I won't go to that cinema again. Not only were the drinks overpriced, but the screen was also tiny.
Not only is the museum free, but it also stays open until ten.
Let's drive next time. Not only was the train late, but it was also full.
Not only do they sell the most phones, but they also make the most profit.
Not only does my brother cook, but he also does all the washing.
Not only does the app translate text, but it also reads it aloud.
Not only do bikes save money, but they also keep you fit.
It was a terrible morning. Not only did I oversleep, but I also spilled coffee on my shirt.
My neighbour is very kind. Not only did he fix my fence, but he also painted it.
Not only did the company lose money, but it also lost its best staff.
Not only did she finish the race, but she also beat her own record.
Not only have prices gone up, but salaries have also gone down.
Not only has she written three novels, but she has also directed a film.
Not only had they lost the map, but they had also run out of water.
Not only can she speak five languages, but she can also teach them.
Not only will the new road save time, but it will also reduce traffic in the town.
Not only would a bigger car cost more, but it would also be hard to park.
Not only could he play the guitar, but he could also sing.
Not only did she pass the exam, she also got the highest mark in the class.
Not only do they have the biggest sales, they also increase them every year.
Not only was the room clean; it was also beautifully decorated.
Not only is the food cheap, it's also very good.
Our camping trip was a disaster. Not only did the tent leak, we also forgot the stove.
Not only does tourism bring money to the region, but it also creates jobs.
Not only is public transport cheaper, but it is also better for the environment.
Not only did the survey reach more people, but it also gave clearer results.
Not only has the council cut the budget, but it has also closed two libraries.
Not only do young people read less, but they also write less by hand.

examples.heading: ① Not only + be + 主詞

items.en: Not only was the beach clean, but it was also very quiet.
items.zh: 海灘不但很乾淨，而且很安靜。

items.en: We didn't rent the flat. Not only was it small, but it was also very dark.
items.zh: 我們沒租那間公寓。它不但小，而且很暗。

items.en: Not only is she a great teacher, but she is also a talented painter.
items.zh: 她不但是很棒的老師，也是很有天分的畫家。

items.en: I won't go to that cinema again. Not only were the drinks overpriced, but the screen was also tiny.
items.zh: 我不會再去那家電影院了。飲料不但貴得離譜，螢幕也很小。

items.en: Not only is the museum free, but it also stays open until ten.
items.zh: 那間博物館不但免費，還開到晚上十點。

items.en: Let's drive next time. Not only was the train late, but it was also full.
items.zh: 下次我們開車吧。火車不但誤點，而且還客滿。

examples.heading: ② Not only + do / does + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Not only do they sell the most phones, but they also make the most profit.
items.zh: 他們不但賣出最多手機，獲利也最高。

items.en: Not only does my brother cook, but he also does all the washing.
items.zh: 我哥哥不但煮飯，還包辦所有洗衣服的事。

items.en: Not only does the app translate text, but it also reads it aloud.
items.zh: 這個應用程式不但會翻譯文字，還會唸出來。

items.en: Not only do bikes save money, but they also keep you fit.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車不但省錢，還能保持身體健康。

examples.heading: ③ Not only + did + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: It was a terrible morning. Not only did I oversleep, but I also spilled coffee on my shirt.
items.zh: 那天早上糟透了。我不但睡過頭，還把咖啡灑在襯衫上。

items.en: My neighbour is very kind. Not only did he fix my fence, but he also painted it.
items.zh: 我的鄰居人很好。他不但幫我修好圍籬，還幫我漆好了。

items.en: Not only did the company lose money, but it also lost its best staff.
items.zh: 那家公司不但虧錢，還失去了最好的員工。

items.en: Not only did she finish the race, but she also beat her own record.
items.zh: 她不但跑完了全程，還打破了自己的紀錄。

examples.heading: ④ Not only + have / has / had + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: Not only have prices gone up, but salaries have also gone down.
items.zh: 不但物價上漲，薪水也下降了。

items.en: Not only has she written three novels, but she has also directed a film.
items.zh: 她不但寫了三本小說，還導過一部電影。

items.en: Not only had they lost the map, but they had also run out of water.
items.zh: 他們不但弄丟了地圖，水也喝完了。

examples.heading: ⑤ Not only + can / will / would + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Not only can she speak five languages, but she can also teach them.
items.zh: 她不但會說五種語言，還能教。

items.en: Not only will the new road save time, but it will also reduce traffic in the town.
items.zh: 新的道路不但能節省時間，還能減少鎮上的交通量。

items.en: Not only would a bigger car cost more, but it would also be hard to park.
items.zh: 大一點的車不但比較貴，還很難停。

items.en: Not only could he play the guitar, but he could also sing.
items.zh: 他不但會彈吉他，還會唱歌。

examples.heading: ⑥ 省略 but

items.en: Not only did she pass the exam, she also got the highest mark in the class.
items.zh: 她不但考試及格了，還拿到全班最高分。

items.en: Not only do they have the biggest sales, they also increase them every year.
items.zh: 他們不但銷售量最大，還每年都讓銷售量成長。

items.en: Not only was the room clean; it was also beautifully decorated.
items.zh: 房間不但乾淨，還布置得很漂亮。

items.en: Not only is the food cheap, it's also very good.
items.zh: 那裡的食物不但便宜，還很好吃。

items.en: Our camping trip was a disaster. Not only did the tent leak, we also forgot the stove.
items.zh: 我們的露營旅行一團糟。帳篷不但漏水，我們還忘了帶爐子。

examples.heading: ⑦ 正式的寫作

items.en: Not only does tourism bring money to the region, but it also creates jobs.
items.zh: 觀光業不但為這個地區帶來收入，還創造了就業機會。

items.en: Not only is public transport cheaper, but it is also better for the environment.
items.zh: 大眾運輸不但比較便宜，對環境也比較好。

items.en: Not only did the survey reach more people, but it also gave clearer results.
items.zh: 這份調查不但接觸到更多人，結果也更清楚。

items.en: Not only has the council cut the budget, but it has also closed two libraries.
items.zh: 市議會不但刪減了預算，還關了兩間圖書館。

items.en: Not only do young people read less, but they also write less by hand.
items.zh: 年輕人不但閱讀得比較少，手寫的機會也變少了。

title: Personally, I do not actually think that this relationship will change.
translation: 我個人其實不認為這段關係會改變。
name: not 加態度副詞表示委婉
sentences: Expensive food is not necessarily better than cheap food.
You do not necessarily need a teacher to learn a language well.
This is not necessarily how older people would see it.
A big house doesn't necessarily make a family happy.
The cheapest flight isn't necessarily the best choice.
Good students don't necessarily get the best jobs.
Organising games for the children is fine, but waiting tables is not really my thing.
"Do you like jazz?" "Not really. I prefer rock."
I don't really want to go out tonight. I'm tired.
The film wasn't really funny, but the kids loved it.
She doesn't really know what she wants to study.
We didn't really enjoy the tour. It was too fast.
I don't actually remember locking the door this morning.
I don't actually know him very well. We only met once.
The restaurant isn't actually that far. It's a ten-minute walk.
He didn't actually say no. He just didn't answer.
We don't actually need a new car. The old one works fine.
The hotel wasn't exactly cheap, but the view was worth it.
"Are you angry?" "Not exactly. I'm just a bit disappointed."
That's not exactly what I meant.
He isn't exactly a great cook, but he tries hard.
I don't exactly remember her name. Was it Kate?
I'm not entirely sure what time the meeting starts.
I don't completely agree with you, but I see your point.
The report is not entirely clear about the costs.
The plan doesn't completely solve the parking problem, but it helps.
I don't really like coffee, but I'll have a cup.
Thanks for the invitation, but I don't really feel like dancing tonight.
Thanks for the soup. It's tasty, but it isn't really hot enough.
Your essay is good, but the ending doesn't really answer the question.
The study is small, and the results do not necessarily mean that the treatment works.

examples.heading: ① not necessarily：不一定

items.en: Expensive food is not necessarily better than cheap food.
items.zh: 貴的食物不一定比便宜的好吃。

items.en: You do not necessarily need a teacher to learn a language well.
items.zh: 要學好一種語言，不一定需要老師。

items.en: This is not necessarily how older people would see it.
items.zh: 年紀大的人不一定會這樣看這件事。

items.en: A big house doesn't necessarily make a family happy.
items.zh: 大房子不一定會讓一家人幸福。

items.en: The cheapest flight isn't necessarily the best choice.
items.zh: 最便宜的機票不一定是最好的選擇。

items.en: Good students don't necessarily get the best jobs.
items.zh: 好學生不一定會找到最好的工作。

examples.heading: ② not really：不太

items.en: Organising games for the children is fine, but waiting tables is not really my thing.
items.zh: 幫孩子們安排遊戲還可以，可是當服務生不太適合我。

items.en: "Do you like jazz?" "Not really. I prefer rock."
items.zh: 你喜歡爵士樂嗎？不太喜歡。我比較喜歡搖滾樂。

items.en: I don't really want to go out tonight. I'm tired.
items.zh: 我今晚不太想出門。我好累。

items.en: The film wasn't really funny, but the kids loved it.
items.zh: 那部電影不怎麼好笑，可是孩子們很喜歡。

items.en: She doesn't really know what she wants to study.
items.zh: 她不太確定自己想念什麼。

items.en: We didn't really enjoy the tour. It was too fast.
items.zh: 我們不怎麼喜歡那趟導覽。走得太快了。

examples.heading: ③ not actually：其實不

items.en: I don't actually remember locking the door this morning.
items.zh: 我其實不記得今天早上有沒有鎖門。

items.en: I don't actually know him very well. We only met once.
items.zh: 我其實跟他不太熟。我們只見過一次。

items.en: The restaurant isn't actually that far. It's a ten-minute walk.
items.zh: 那家餐廳其實沒那麼遠。走路十分鐘。

items.en: He didn't actually say no. He just didn't answer.
items.zh: 他其實沒有說不。他只是沒回答。

items.en: We don't actually need a new car. The old one works fine.
items.zh: 我們其實不需要新車。舊的還很好開。

examples.heading: ④ not exactly：不完全是

items.en: The hotel wasn't exactly cheap, but the view was worth it.
items.zh: 那家飯店算不上便宜，可是那個景色很值得。

items.en: "Are you angry?" "Not exactly. I'm just a bit disappointed."
items.zh: 你生氣了嗎？也不算。我只是有點失望。

items.en: That's not exactly what I meant.
items.zh: 那不完全是我的意思。

items.en: He isn't exactly a great cook, but he tries hard.
items.zh: 他算不上是很會煮飯的人，可是他很努力。

items.en: I don't exactly remember her name. Was it Kate?
items.zh: 我不太記得她的名字了。是 Kate 嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ not entirely / not completely：不完全

items.en: I'm not entirely sure what time the meeting starts.
items.zh: 我不完全確定會議幾點開始。

items.en: I don't completely agree with you, but I see your point.
items.zh: 我不完全同意你，可是我懂你的意思。

items.en: The report is not entirely clear about the costs.
items.zh: 報告對費用的說明不是很清楚。

items.en: The plan doesn't completely solve the parking problem, but it helps.
items.zh: 這個計畫沒有完全解決停車問題，可是有幫助。

examples.heading: ⑥ not really：委婉地拒絕或批評

items.en: I don't really like coffee, but I'll have a cup.
items.zh: 我不太喜歡咖啡，可是我會喝一杯。

items.en: Thanks for the invitation, but I don't really feel like dancing tonight.
items.zh: 謝謝你的邀請，可是我今晚不太想跳舞。

items.en: Thanks for the soup. It's tasty, but it isn't really hot enough.
items.zh: 謝謝你的湯。很好喝，可是不太夠熱。

items.en: Your essay is good, but the ending doesn't really answer the question.
items.zh: 你的作文寫得不錯，可是結尾沒有真正回答題目。

examples.heading: ⑦ 正式的寫作

items.en: The study is small, and the results do not necessarily mean that the treatment works.
items.zh: 這項研究的規模很小，結果不一定表示這種療法有效。

title: Waiting tables would be boring, and we have no experience whatsoever.
translation: 當服務生會很無聊，而且我們完全沒有經驗。
name: 否定句後加 whatsoever 加強語氣
sentences: I can't help with the website. I have no computer skills whatsoever.
The new rules will have no effect whatsoever on your pay.
The hotel was so quiet that there was no noise whatsoever at night.
He left the company with no explanation whatsoever.
I had no idea whatsoever that she was moving abroad.
The children showed no interest whatsoever in the museum.
There is no doubt whatsoever that he is the best player on the team.
The storm was strong, but it caused no damage whatsoever to our house.
The police searched the house, but they didn't find any evidence whatsoever.
We didn't have any problems whatsoever with the car.
She didn't give me any help whatsoever with the project.
I don't have any money whatsoever until next Friday.
There wasn't any food whatsoever in the fridge.
I know nothing whatsoever about cars, so I take mine to a mechanic.
We talked for three hours, and the meeting achieved nothing whatsoever.
He said nothing whatsoever about his new job.
There's nothing whatsoever wrong with your phone. Just restart it.
"Did you have any trouble at the border?" "None whatsoever."
I asked for feedback on my essay, but I got none whatsoever.
"Any questions?" "None whatsoever. It was very clear."
It was early in the morning, and there was nobody whatsoever on the beach.
I've told no one whatsoever about our plan.
The employees will notice no change whatsoever in their working conditions.
The council has made no attempt whatsoever to repair the road.
The report contains no information whatsoever about the costs.
There is no evidence whatsoever that the drug is dangerous.
The company accepts no responsibility whatsoever for lost items.
"Do you mind if I open the window?" "No problem whatsoever."
I have no plans whatsoever for the weekend. I'm going to sleep.
Sorry, I have no memory whatsoever of meeting you.
That film made no sense whatsoever. Can you explain the ending?

examples.heading: ① no + 名詞 + whatsoever

items.en: I can't help with the website. I have no computer skills whatsoever.
items.zh: 我沒辦法幫忙做網站。我一點電腦技能也沒有。

items.en: The new rules will have no effect whatsoever on your pay.
items.zh: 新的規定對你的薪水完全沒有影響。

items.en: The hotel was so quiet that there was no noise whatsoever at night.
items.zh: 那家飯店很安靜，晚上一點聲音也沒有。

items.en: He left the company with no explanation whatsoever.
items.zh: 他什麼解釋都沒有就離開了公司。

items.en: I had no idea whatsoever that she was moving abroad.
items.zh: 我完全不知道她要搬到國外。

items.en: The children showed no interest whatsoever in the museum.
items.zh: 孩子們對博物館一點興趣也沒有。

items.en: There is no doubt whatsoever that he is the best player on the team.
items.zh: 毫無疑問，他是隊上最好的球員。

items.en: The storm was strong, but it caused no damage whatsoever to our house.
items.zh: 暴風雨很強，可是我們家完全沒有受損。

examples.heading: ② not + any + 名詞 + whatsoever

items.en: The police searched the house, but they didn't find any evidence whatsoever.
items.zh: 警方搜了那間房子，可是完全沒找到任何證據。

items.en: We didn't have any problems whatsoever with the car.
items.zh: 我們的車一點問題也沒有。

items.en: She didn't give me any help whatsoever with the project.
items.zh: 這個案子她一點忙都沒幫我。

items.en: I don't have any money whatsoever until next Friday.
items.zh: 下星期五以前我身上一毛錢也沒有。

items.en: There wasn't any food whatsoever in the fridge.
items.zh: 冰箱裡一點吃的也沒有。

examples.heading: ③ nothing + whatsoever

items.en: I know nothing whatsoever about cars, so I take mine to a mechanic.
items.zh: 我對車子一竅不通，所以我的車都交給修車師傅。

items.en: We talked for three hours, and the meeting achieved nothing whatsoever.
items.zh: 我們談了三個小時，結果那次會議完全沒有任何成果。

items.en: He said nothing whatsoever about his new job.
items.zh: 他對新工作的事一個字也沒提。

items.en: There's nothing whatsoever wrong with your phone. Just restart it.
items.zh: 你的手機完全沒問題。重新開機就好。

examples.heading: ④ none + whatsoever

items.en: "Did you have any trouble at the border?" "None whatsoever."
items.zh: 你過邊境的時候有遇到麻煩嗎？完全沒有。

items.en: I asked for feedback on my essay, but I got none whatsoever.
items.zh: 我請別人給我作文的意見，可是一個意見都沒收到。

items.en: "Any questions?" "None whatsoever. It was very clear."
items.zh: 有問題嗎？完全沒有。講得很清楚。

examples.heading: ⑤ nobody / no one + whatsoever

items.en: It was early in the morning, and there was nobody whatsoever on the beach.
items.zh: 那時是清晨，海灘上一個人都沒有。

items.en: I've told no one whatsoever about our plan.
items.zh: 我們的計畫我一個人都沒告訴。

examples.heading: ⑥ 正式的文章

items.en: The employees will notice no change whatsoever in their working conditions.
items.zh: 員工的工作條件完全不會有任何改變。

items.en: The council has made no attempt whatsoever to repair the road.
items.zh: 市議會完全沒有試著修那條路。

items.en: The report contains no information whatsoever about the costs.
items.zh: 報告裡完全沒有任何費用的資料。

items.en: There is no evidence whatsoever that the drug is dangerous.
items.zh: 完全沒有證據顯示這種藥很危險。

items.en: The company accepts no responsibility whatsoever for lost items.
items.zh: 本公司對遺失物品不負任何責任。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說話時加強語氣

items.en: "Do you mind if I open the window?" "No problem whatsoever."
items.zh: 你介意我開窗嗎？完全沒問題。

items.en: I have no plans whatsoever for the weekend. I'm going to sleep.
items.zh: 我週末完全沒有計畫。我要睡覺。

items.en: Sorry, I have no memory whatsoever of meeting you.
items.zh: 抱歉，我完全不記得見過你。

items.en: That film made no sense whatsoever. Can you explain the ending?
items.zh: 那部電影完全看不懂。你可以解釋一下結局嗎？

title: They were sent to Britain to improve their English, but few had any real contact with the language.
translation: 他們被送到英國去加強英文，但很少人真的接觸到這個語言。
name: few 表示不多（正式書面語）
sentences: The workers were offered English lessons, but few had any time to go.
Many people apply for the course, but few get a place.
Many people start learning the piano as children, but few continue as adults.
Thousands of people visit the city every year, but few see the old town.
The company offered free training, but few took it.
Many people promise to exercise more, but few do.
Most people can speak a bit of English, but very few speak it well.
The survey went to five hundred homes, and very few replied.
Many teenagers have a bank account, but very few save money regularly.
The village was once busy, but very few live there now.
Few of the people we asked had heard of the new law.
Very few of my classmates read newspapers.
Few of them knew what to do when the fire alarm rang.
Very few of the workers were happy with the new hours.
Few of the visitors stayed longer than one night.
Few people in the town know about the museum.
Very few students chose the evening classes.
Few young people want to work on farms these days.
Very few tourists come here in winter.
Few doctors agree with the new plan.
The report found that few employees took all their holiday.
According to the survey, very few customers read the instructions.
Few of the people in the study exercised more than once a week.
The results show that very few children walk to school now.
Few of those questioned felt safe at night.
The study shows that very few drivers obey the speed limit on this road.
Few of the guests had any idea who the speaker was.
Very few people had any money left at the end of the month.
We interviewed forty nurses for the job. Few had any experience of living abroad.
Few customers used the self-service machines, so the shop removed them.
Few people came to the meeting, so we cancelled it.

examples.heading: ① few + 動詞：指一群人裡沒幾個人

items.en: The workers were offered English lessons, but few had any time to go.
items.zh: 工人可以上英文課，可是很少人有時間去。（被動）

items.en: Many people apply for the course, but few get a place.
items.zh: 很多人申請這門課，可是拿到名額的沒幾個。

items.en: Many people start learning the piano as children, but few continue as adults.
items.zh: 很多人小時候開始學鋼琴，可是長大後還繼續的沒幾個。

items.en: Thousands of people visit the city every year, but few see the old town.
items.zh: 每年有成千上萬的人來這座城市，可是去看舊城區的沒幾個。

items.en: The company offered free training, but few took it.
items.zh: 公司提供免費的訓練，可是參加的人沒幾個。

items.en: Many people promise to exercise more, but few do.
items.zh: 很多人都說要多運動，可是真的做到的沒幾個。

examples.heading: ② very few + 動詞

items.en: Most people can speak a bit of English, but very few speak it well.
items.zh: 大部分人都會說一點英文，可是說得好的很少。

items.en: The survey went to five hundred homes, and very few replied.
items.zh: 調查寄到五百戶人家，回覆的很少。

items.en: Many teenagers have a bank account, but very few save money regularly.
items.zh: 很多青少年有銀行帳戶，可是很少人定期存錢。

items.en: The village was once busy, but very few live there now.
items.zh: 那個村子以前很熱鬧，可是現在住在那裡的人很少。

examples.heading: ③ few / very few + of + 代名詞或名詞片語

items.en: Few of the people we asked had heard of the new law.
items.zh: 我們問的人裡，很少人聽說過新的法律。

items.en: Very few of my classmates read newspapers.
items.zh: 我的同學裡很少人看報紙。

items.en: Few of them knew what to do when the fire alarm rang.
items.zh: 火災警報響的時候，他們裡面很少人知道該怎麼做。

items.en: Very few of the workers were happy with the new hours.
items.zh: 員工裡很少人滿意新的上班時間。

items.en: Few of the visitors stayed longer than one night.
items.zh: 遊客裡很少人待超過一晚。

examples.heading: ④ few + 複數名詞（指人）

items.en: Few people in the town know about the museum.
items.zh: 鎮上很少人知道那間博物館。

items.en: Very few students chose the evening classes.
items.zh: 很少學生選晚上的課。

items.en: Few young people want to work on farms these days.
items.zh: 現在很少年輕人想在農場工作。

items.en: Very few tourists come here in winter.
items.zh: 冬天很少觀光客來這裡。

items.en: Few doctors agree with the new plan.
items.zh: 很少醫生贊成新的計畫。

examples.heading: ⑤ 報告和調查

items.en: The report found that few employees took all their holiday.
items.zh: 報告發現很少員工會把假休完。

items.en: According to the survey, very few customers read the instructions.
items.zh: 根據調查，很少顧客會讀使用說明。

items.en: Few of the people in the study exercised more than once a week.
items.zh: 研究裡很少人一星期運動超過一次。

items.en: The results show that very few children walk to school now.
items.zh: 結果顯示，現在走路上學的孩子很少。

items.en: Few of those questioned felt safe at night.
items.zh: 受訪者裡很少人晚上覺得安全。

items.en: The study shows that very few drivers obey the speed limit on this road.
items.zh: 研究顯示，在這條路上很少駕駛人遵守速限。

examples.heading: ⑥ few + any

items.en: Few of the guests had any idea who the speaker was.
items.zh: 來賓裡很少人知道講者是誰。

items.en: Very few people had any money left at the end of the month.
items.zh: 月底還有錢剩的人很少。

items.en: We interviewed forty nurses for the job. Few had any experience of living abroad.
items.zh: 我們為這份工作面試了四十個護理師。很少人有在國外生活的經驗。

examples.heading: ⑦ few + 動詞，後面說結果

items.en: Few customers used the self-service machines, so the shop removed them.
items.zh: 很少顧客用自助結帳機，所以那家店把機器撤掉了。

items.en: Few people came to the meeting, so we cancelled it.
items.zh: 沒幾個人來開會，所以我們取消了。

title: You love books, don't you?
translation: 你很愛書，對吧？
name: 用否定疑問句和附加問句徵求同意
sentences: Look at those mountains. Isn't it marvellous?
Come and look. Isn't the view from this window beautiful?
Try this cake. Isn't it delicious?
Look at the school play. Aren't the children sweet in their costumes?
Isn't it strange that nobody called back?
Don't you think it's fantastic that Sarah got the job?
Don't you think the music is a bit loud?
Don't you think we should call a doctor? He looks very pale.
Look at me in the mirror. Don't you think this dress is too long for me?
Don't you think it's time to go home? It's nearly midnight.
I loved the last song. Wasn't that a great concert last night?
Didn't we have fun at the beach last summer?
I'm still full. Wasn't the food at the wedding amazing?
You like jazz, don't you? I've got two tickets for Saturday.
It's a lovely day, isn't it? Let's eat outside.
I'm so tired. That was a long meeting, wasn't it?
I had my first class with Ms Lee today. The new teacher is really nice, isn't she?
Taste this. The soup needs more salt, doesn't it?
Look at these photos. We had a great time in Rome, didn't we?
The train leaves at six, doesn't it? I don't want to miss it.
I'm closing the front door now. You've got the keys, haven't you?
I'm setting the table for four. Mark is coming to dinner tonight, isn't he?
The manager hasn't replied yet. You sent him the email, didn't you?
We're flying to Japan tomorrow. We need to bring our passports, don't we?
You don't take sugar, do you? I'll make your tea without it.
I need bread for tomorrow, but the shop isn't open on Sundays, is it?
It's a surprise for Dad. You haven't told anyone about the party, have you?
"Isn't it cold today?" "Yes, it's freezing. I need my gloves."
"Didn't you lock the door?" "No, I forgot. I'll go back."
"Aren't you coming with us?" "Yes, I am. Wait for me."
"Don't you like the film?" "No, not really. It's too slow."

examples.heading: ① Isn't it / Aren't they + 形容詞：請對方同意

items.en: Look at those mountains. Isn't it marvellous?
items.zh: 你看那些山。是不是很棒？

items.en: Come and look. Isn't the view from this window beautiful?
items.zh: 過來看看。從這扇窗戶看出去的風景是不是很美？

items.en: Try this cake. Isn't it delicious?
items.zh: 吃吃看這塊蛋糕。是不是很好吃？

items.en: Look at the school play. Aren't the children sweet in their costumes?
items.zh: 你看學校的話劇。孩子們穿著戲服是不是很可愛？

items.en: Isn't it strange that nobody called back?
items.zh: 沒有人回電，是不是很奇怪？

examples.heading: ② Don't you think + 子句：請對方同意

items.en: Don't you think it's fantastic that Sarah got the job?
items.zh: Sarah 得到那份工作，你不覺得很棒嗎？

items.en: Don't you think the music is a bit loud?
items.zh: 你不覺得音樂有點大聲嗎？

items.en: Don't you think we should call a doctor? He looks very pale.
items.zh: 你不覺得我們應該叫醫生嗎？他臉色很蒼白。

items.en: Look at me in the mirror. Don't you think this dress is too long for me?
items.zh: 你看鏡子裡的我。你不覺得這件洋裝對我來說太長了嗎？

items.en: Don't you think it's time to go home? It's nearly midnight.
items.zh: 你不覺得該回家了嗎？都快半夜了。

examples.heading: ③ Wasn't it / Didn't you + 動詞：一起回想過去的事

items.en: I loved the last song. Wasn't that a great concert last night?
items.zh: 我好愛最後一首歌。昨晚那場演唱會是不是很棒？

items.en: Didn't we have fun at the beach last summer?
items.zh: 我們去年夏天在海邊是不是玩得很開心？

items.en: I'm still full. Wasn't the food at the wedding amazing?
items.zh: 我現在還很飽。婚禮上的菜是不是很棒？

examples.heading: ④ 肯定的直述句 + 否定的附加問句：請對方同意

items.en: You like jazz, don't you? I've got two tickets for Saturday.
items.zh: 你喜歡爵士樂，對吧？我有兩張星期六的票。

items.en: It's a lovely day, isn't it? Let's eat outside.
items.zh: 今天天氣真好，對吧？我們在外面吃吧。

items.en: I'm so tired. That was a long meeting, wasn't it?
items.zh: 我好累。那個會開好久，對吧？

items.en: I had my first class with Ms Lee today. The new teacher is really nice, isn't she?
items.zh: 我今天上了李老師的第一堂課。新來的老師人真好，對吧？

items.en: Taste this. The soup needs more salt, doesn't it?
items.zh: 你嚐嚐看。這湯要再加點鹽，對吧？

items.en: Look at these photos. We had a great time in Rome, didn't we?
items.zh: 你看這些照片。我們在羅馬玩得很開心，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ 肯定的直述句 + 否定的附加問句：確認一件事

items.en: The train leaves at six, doesn't it? I don't want to miss it.
items.zh: 火車是六點開，對吧？我不想錯過。

items.en: I'm closing the front door now. You've got the keys, haven't you?
items.zh: 我要把大門關上了。鑰匙在你那邊，對吧？

items.en: I'm setting the table for four. Mark is coming to dinner tonight, isn't he?
items.zh: 我要擺四個人的餐具。Mark 今晚會來吃晚餐，對吧？

items.en: The manager hasn't replied yet. You sent him the email, didn't you?
items.zh: 經理還沒回覆。你把那封信寄給他了，對吧？

items.en: We're flying to Japan tomorrow. We need to bring our passports, don't we?
items.zh: 我們明天要飛日本。我們要帶護照，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定的直述句 + 肯定的附加問句：確認一件事

items.en: You don't take sugar, do you? I'll make your tea without it.
items.zh: 你不加糖，對吧？我泡茶就不放糖了。

items.en: I need bread for tomorrow, but the shop isn't open on Sundays, is it?
items.zh: 我明天要用麵包，可是那家店星期天沒開，對吧？

items.en: It's a surprise for Dad. You haven't told anyone about the party, have you?
items.zh: 這是要給爸爸的驚喜。你還沒跟任何人說派對的事，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑦ 回答否定疑問句

items.en: "Isn't it cold today?" "Yes, it's freezing. I need my gloves."
items.zh: 今天不是很冷嗎？對啊，冷死了。我要戴手套。

items.en: "Didn't you lock the door?" "No, I forgot. I'll go back."
items.zh: 你沒鎖門嗎？沒有，我忘了。我回去鎖。

items.en: "Aren't you coming with us?" "Yes, I am. Wait for me."
items.zh: 你不跟我們一起去嗎？要啊。等我一下。

items.en: "Don't you like the film?" "No, not really. It's too slow."
items.zh: 你不喜歡這部電影嗎？嗯，不太喜歡。節奏太慢了。

title: Hardly had he reached his front door when he heard the phone ringing.
translation: 他一走到家門口，就聽到電話在響。
name: hardly 放在句首的倒裝（強調）
sentences: Hardly had I closed my eyes when the baby started crying.
Hardly had I paid for the shoes when I saw them cheaper online.
Hardly had I started my new job when the company moved to Leeds.
Hardly had I got into the bath when someone rang the doorbell.
Hardly had I sent the email when I noticed the mistake.
Hardly had she finished her complaint when the manager walked away.
Hardly had he taken his seat when the lights went down.
Hardly had she put the phone down when it rang again.
Hardly had he begun his speech when the microphone stopped working.
Hardly had she arrived in Madrid when she lost her passport.
Hardly had they arrived when they saw a black car leaving the yard.
Hardly had we started the meal when the power went off.
Hardly had we set up the tent when the storm began.
Hardly had they moved into the flat when the neighbours began complaining.
Hardly had we left the harbour when the sea became rough.
Hardly had the film started when the fire alarm went off.
Hardly had the plane taken off when the pilot turned back.
Hardly had the teacher left the room when the students started talking.
Hardly had the match begun when it started to snow.
Hardly had the guests sat down when the waiter dropped a tray.
I had hardly fallen asleep when the alarm went off.
We had hardly left the car park when the tyre went flat.
She had hardly started cooking when her guests arrived.
The shop had hardly opened when the queue reached the corner.
Scarcely had I unpacked my suitcase when my mother called.
Scarcely had the concert begun when the singer lost her voice.
Scarcely had we reached the top when the clouds came down.
No sooner had I hung out the washing than it started to rain.
No sooner had he signed the contract than he regretted it.
No sooner had the bus stopped than everyone rushed for the door.

examples.heading: ① Hardly had I + 過去分詞 + when

items.en: Hardly had I closed my eyes when the baby started crying.
items.zh: 我才剛閉上眼睛，小寶寶就開始哭了。

items.en: Hardly had I paid for the shoes when I saw them cheaper online.
items.zh: 我才剛付完鞋子的錢，就在網路上看到更便宜的價格。

items.en: Hardly had I started my new job when the company moved to Leeds.
items.zh: 我才剛開始新工作，公司就搬到里茲去了。

items.en: Hardly had I got into the bath when someone rang the doorbell.
items.zh: 我才剛進浴缸，就有人按門鈴。

items.en: Hardly had I sent the email when I noticed the mistake.
items.zh: 我才剛把電子郵件寄出去，就發現了錯誤。

examples.heading: ② Hardly had he、she + 過去分詞 + when

items.en: Hardly had she finished her complaint when the manager walked away.
items.zh: 她才剛抱怨完，經理就走開了。

items.en: Hardly had he taken his seat when the lights went down.
items.zh: 他才剛坐好，燈就暗了下來。

items.en: Hardly had she put the phone down when it rang again.
items.zh: 她才剛掛上電話，電話又響了。

items.en: Hardly had he begun his speech when the microphone stopped working.
items.zh: 他才剛開始演講，麥克風就壞了。

items.en: Hardly had she arrived in Madrid when she lost her passport.
items.zh: 她才剛到馬德里就把護照弄丟了。

examples.heading: ③ Hardly had we、they + 過去分詞 + when

items.en: Hardly had they arrived when they saw a black car leaving the yard.
items.zh: 他們才剛到，就看到一輛黑色的車開出院子。

items.en: Hardly had we started the meal when the power went off.
items.zh: 我們才剛開始吃飯就停電了。

items.en: Hardly had we set up the tent when the storm began.
items.zh: 我們才剛搭好帳篷，暴風雨就來了。

items.en: Hardly had they moved into the flat when the neighbours began complaining.
items.zh: 他們才剛搬進那間公寓，鄰居就開始抱怨了。

items.en: Hardly had we left the harbour when the sea became rough.
items.zh: 我們才剛離開港口，海面就變得波濤洶湧。

examples.heading: ④ Hardly had + 名詞主詞 + 過去分詞 + when

items.en: Hardly had the film started when the fire alarm went off.
items.zh: 電影才剛開始，火災警報就響了。

items.en: Hardly had the plane taken off when the pilot turned back.
items.zh: 飛機才剛起飛，機長就折返了。

items.en: Hardly had the teacher left the room when the students started talking.
items.zh: 老師才剛離開教室，學生就開始聊天了。

items.en: Hardly had the match begun when it started to snow.
items.zh: 比賽才剛開始就下起雪來。

items.en: Hardly had the guests sat down when the waiter dropped a tray.
items.zh: 客人才剛坐下，服務生就把托盤摔了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 一般的語序：had hardly + 過去分詞 + when

items.en: I had hardly fallen asleep when the alarm went off.
items.zh: 我才剛睡著，鬧鐘就響了。

items.en: We had hardly left the car park when the tyre went flat.
items.zh: 我們才剛離開停車場，輪胎就沒氣了。

items.en: She had hardly started cooking when her guests arrived.
items.zh: 她才剛開始煮飯，客人就到了。

items.en: The shop had hardly opened when the queue reached the corner.
items.zh: 那家店才剛開門，排隊的人就排到了轉角。

examples.heading: ⑥ Scarcely had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + when

items.en: Scarcely had I unpacked my suitcase when my mother called.
items.zh: 我才剛把行李箱打開整理，我媽就打電話來了。

items.en: Scarcely had the concert begun when the singer lost her voice.
items.zh: 音樂會才剛開始，歌手就失聲了。

items.en: Scarcely had we reached the top when the clouds came down.
items.zh: 我們才剛到山頂，雲就壓了下來。

examples.heading: ⑦ No sooner had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + than

items.en: No sooner had I hung out the washing than it started to rain.
items.zh: 我才剛把衣服晾出去就下雨了。

items.en: No sooner had he signed the contract than he regretted it.
items.zh: 他才剛簽完合約就後悔了。

items.en: No sooner had the bus stopped than everyone rushed for the door.
items.zh: 公車一停，大家就衝向車門。

title: Not only was he helpful, but the students had the opportunity to watch videos and listen to music.
translation: 他不但很熱心幫忙，學生們還有機會看影片、聽音樂。
name: not only 倒裝句接 but (also) 子句
sentences: My trip to work this morning was awful. Not only was the train late, but it was also packed.
We won't rent the flat on King Street. Not only is it small, but it's also very dark.
I wrote a review of the new restaurant. Not only was the food bad, but the service was slow.
Our new neighbours are great. Not only are they friendly, but they're also very helpful.
I loved my French class last year. Not only was the teacher kind, but she also made the lessons fun.
Our new sofa arrived broken. Not only did the shop give us a refund, but it also sent a voucher.
Many fans travelled to the Olympics. Not only did they come for football, but they also watched the smaller events.
I left my bike at Uncle Joe's shop. Not only did he fix it, but he also cleaned it for free.
Our first day in Italy went badly. Not only did we miss the train, but we also lost our bags.
The school trip was a disaster. Not only did the bus break down, but the driver also got lost.
My grandma never buys clothes. Not only does she knit, but she also sews her own dresses.
Let's meet at the bookshop by the station. Not only do they sell books, but they also serve lunch.
I cycle to work every day now. Not only does it save money, but it also gives me time to think.
We bought a new printer for the office. Not only does it print in colour, but it also scans.
I've bought this coffee for years. Not only has the price gone down, but the quality has improved.
Give Lily the main part in the school show. Not only can she sing, but she can also dance.
Switch off the lights when you leave a room. Not only will you save money, but you'll also help the planet.
The builders worked fast this year. Not only have they finished the house, but they've also built a garden.
My cousin came to live with us in 2020. Not only had he lost his job, but he had also lost his flat.
We left at the break. Not only was the concert long, but it was also boring.
The school held a science fair last Friday. Not only did the kids enjoy it, but the parents loved it too.
My teacher gave a talk to new students. Not only is English useful, but it's also fun to learn.
I met my boss's wife at the party. Not only did I forget her name, but I called her by the wrong one.
We won't stay at that hotel again. Not only were the rooms small, but they were also dirty.
I went back to my home town after twenty years. Not only has the town grown, but it has also become cleaner.
The kids had a week off in March. Not only did the storm close the school, but it also damaged the roof.
Welcome to Lake Garda. Not only can you swim here, but you can also go sailing.
We had a great day in Washington. Not only was the museum free, but the guide was excellent.
The teacher wrote about Ken in his report. Not only does he work hard, but he also helps his classmates.
It was a great night for our local club. Not only did the team win, but they scored five goals.

examples.heading: ① Not only + was / is + 主詞

items.en: My trip to work this morning was awful. Not only was the train late, but it was also packed.
items.zh: 我今天早上上班的路程很糟。火車不但誤點，還擠滿了人。

items.en: We won't rent the flat on King Street. Not only is it small, but it's also very dark.
items.zh: 我們不會租國王街那間公寓。它不但小，還很暗。

items.en: I wrote a review of the new restaurant. Not only was the food bad, but the service was slow.
items.zh: 我寫了一篇新餐廳的評論。食物不但難吃，服務還很慢。

items.en: Our new neighbours are great. Not only are they friendly, but they're also very helpful.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居很好。他們不但友善，還很幫忙。

items.en: I loved my French class last year. Not only was the teacher kind, but she also made the lessons fun.
items.zh: 我很喜歡去年的法文課。那位老師不但和善，還把課上得很有趣。

examples.heading: ② Not only + did + 主詞 + 動詞

items.en: Our new sofa arrived broken. Not only did the shop give us a refund, but it also sent a voucher.
items.zh: 我們的新沙發送來的時候是壞的。那家店不但退錢給我們，還寄了一張禮券。

items.en: Many fans travelled to the Olympics. Not only did they come for football, but they also watched the smaller events.
items.zh: 很多球迷去看奧運。他們不但為了足球而來，還看了其他比較小的比賽。

items.en: I left my bike at Uncle Joe's shop. Not only did he fix it, but he also cleaned it for free.
items.zh: 我把腳踏車放在喬叔叔的店裡。他不但修好了它，還免費幫我擦乾淨。

items.en: Our first day in Italy went badly. Not only did we miss the train, but we also lost our bags.
items.zh: 我們在義大利的第一天很不順。我們不但錯過了火車，還弄丟了行李。

items.en: The school trip was a disaster. Not only did the bus break down, but the driver also got lost.
items.zh: 那次校外教學很糟。公車不但拋錨，司機還迷路了。

examples.heading: ③ Not only + does / do + 主詞 + 動詞

items.en: My grandma never buys clothes. Not only does she knit, but she also sews her own dresses.
items.zh: 我奶奶從來不買衣服。她不但會織毛線，還自己縫洋裝。

items.en: Let's meet at the bookshop by the station. Not only do they sell books, but they also serve lunch.
items.zh: 我們在車站旁邊的書店碰面吧。他們不但賣書，還供應午餐。

items.en: I cycle to work every day now. Not only does it save money, but it also gives me time to think.
items.zh: 我現在每天騎腳踏車上班。這不但省錢，還讓我有時間思考。

items.en: We bought a new printer for the office. Not only does it print in colour, but it also scans.
items.zh: 我們買了一台新的辦公室印表機。它不但能彩色列印，還能掃描。

examples.heading: ④ Not only + has / can / will + 主詞

items.en: I've bought this coffee for years. Not only has the price gone down, but the quality has improved.
items.zh: 我買這種咖啡好幾年了。價格不但降了，品質還提升了。

items.en: Give Lily the main part in the school show. Not only can she sing, but she can also dance.
items.zh: 讓莉莉演學校表演的主角。她不但會唱歌，還會跳舞。

items.en: Switch off the lights when you leave a room. Not only will you save money, but you'll also help the planet.
items.zh: 離開房間的時候把燈關掉。你不但能省錢，還能幫助地球。

items.en: The builders worked fast this year. Not only have they finished the house, but they've also built a garden.
items.zh: 工人今年做得很快。他們不但蓋好了房子，還做了一座花園。

items.en: My cousin came to live with us in 2020. Not only had he lost his job, but he had also lost his flat.
items.zh: 我表哥 2020 年來跟我們住。他不但丟了工作，還失去了公寓。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的句型

items.en: We left at the break. Not only was the concert long, but it was also boring.
items.zh: 我們中場休息就走了。演唱會不但很長，還很無聊。

items.en: The school held a science fair last Friday. Not only did the kids enjoy it, but the parents loved it too.
items.zh: 學校上星期五辦了科學展。孩子們不但玩得開心，家長也很喜歡。

items.en: My teacher gave a talk to new students. Not only is English useful, but it's also fun to learn.
items.zh: 我的老師對新生演講。英文不但有用，學起來也很有趣。

items.en: I met my boss's wife at the party. Not only did I forget her name, but I called her by the wrong one.
items.zh: 我在派對上遇到我老闆的太太。我不但忘了她的名字，還叫錯了。

items.en: We won't stay at that hotel again. Not only were the rooms small, but they were also dirty.
items.zh: 我們不會再住那家飯店了。房間不但小，還很髒。

items.en: I went back to my home town after twenty years. Not only has the town grown, but it has also become cleaner.
items.zh: 我隔了二十年回到家鄉。這個鎮不但變大了，還變乾淨了。

items.en: The kids had a week off in March. Not only did the storm close the school, but it also damaged the roof.
items.zh: 孩子們三月放了一個星期的假。暴風雨不但讓學校停課，還損壞了屋頂。

items.en: Welcome to Lake Garda. Not only can you swim here, but you can also go sailing.
items.zh: 歡迎來到加爾達湖。你在這裡不但能游泳，還能去划帆船。

items.en: We had a great day in Washington. Not only was the museum free, but the guide was excellent.
items.zh: 我們在華盛頓度過了很棒的一天。博物館不但免費，導覽員還很棒。

items.en: The teacher wrote about Ken in his report. Not only does he work hard, but he also helps his classmates.
items.zh: 老師在 Ken 的成績單上寫了評語。他不但很用功，還會幫同學。

items.en: It was a great night for our local club. Not only did the team win, but they scored five goals.
items.zh: 那天晚上對我們當地的球隊來說很棒。那支隊伍不但贏了，還進了五球。

title: Not only do I speak fluent English, but I also speak French, Spanish and Portuguese.
translation: 我不只英文說得很流利，還會說法語、西班牙語和葡萄牙語。
name: not only 後接助動詞 do 倒裝
sentences: Not only do I enjoy cooking, but I also love trying new restaurants.
Not only do our students learn the language, but they also live with local families.
Not only do extreme sports provide a feeling of achievement, but they also help you express yourself.
Not only do these plants look nice, but they also clean the air in the room.
Not only do we offer free delivery, but we also accept returns for thirty days.
Not only does the new system save time, but it also reduces mistakes.
Not only does my sister play the violin, but she also writes her own music.
Not only does the city have excellent museums, but it also hosts a famous film festival.
Not only does this jacket keep you warm, but it also folds into a small bag.
Not only does Mark work full-time, but he also studies at night.
Not only did they teach us useful knowledge, but they also organised practical exercises to check our progress.
Not only did the hotel lose our booking, but it also charged us twice.
Not only did we miss the train, but we also left our tickets at home.
Not only did the team win the cup, but they also scored a record number of goals.
Not only did my neighbour fix the fence, but he also painted it for free.
Indeed, not only did the course improve my writing, but it also gave me more confidence.
Furthermore, not only do I speak English at work, but I also use it with my friends online.
Furthermore, not only does the flat have a balcony, but it also comes with a parking space.
Indeed, not only did the volunteers clean the park, but they also collected money for new benches.
For me, not only do long walks help me relax, but they also give me time to think.
In my opinion, not only does social media waste time, but it also affects our sleep.
Not only did I enjoy the conference, but I also met several useful contacts there.
As you know, not only do I have experience in sales, but I also speak three languages.
Not only did your letter arrive on time, but it also answered all my questions.
Not only did the bus arrive late, but it was full when it came.
Not only does she run the business, but she looks after three children.
Not only do they make good coffee, but their cakes are excellent too.
I not only speak Italian, but I also teach it.
Not only do I speak Italian, but I also teach it at a local school.
The festival not only attracted tourists but also helped local shops.
Not only did the festival attract tourists, but it also helped many small local shops.

examples.heading: ① Not only + do + 主詞

items.en: Not only do I enjoy cooking, but I also love trying new restaurants.
items.zh: 我不只喜歡做菜，也很喜歡嘗試新餐廳。

items.en: Not only do our students learn the language, but they also live with local families.
items.zh: 我們的學生不只學語言，還住在當地人家裡。

items.en: Not only do extreme sports provide a feeling of achievement, but they also help you express yourself.
items.zh: 極限運動不只帶來成就感，也幫你表達自己。

items.en: Not only do these plants look nice, but they also clean the air in the room.
items.zh: 這些植物不只好看，還能淨化房間裡的空氣。

items.en: Not only do we offer free delivery, but we also accept returns for thirty days.
items.zh: 我們不只提供免運，還接受三十天內退貨。

examples.heading: ② Not only + does + 主詞

items.en: Not only does the new system save time, but it also reduces mistakes.
items.zh: 新系統不只省時間，也減少錯誤。

items.en: Not only does my sister play the violin, but she also writes her own music.
items.zh: 我姊姊不只會拉小提琴，還自己作曲。

items.en: Not only does the city have excellent museums, but it also hosts a famous film festival.
items.zh: 這座城市不只有很棒的博物館，還舉辦一個有名的電影節。

items.en: Not only does this jacket keep you warm, but it also folds into a small bag.
items.zh: 這件外套不只保暖，還能摺成一個小袋子。

items.en: Not only does Mark work full-time, but he also studies at night.
items.zh: Mark 不只做全職工作，晚上還去上課。

examples.heading: ③ Not only + did + 主詞

items.en: Not only did they teach us useful knowledge, but they also organised practical exercises to check our progress.
items.zh: 他們不只教我們實用的知識，還安排了實作練習來檢查我們的進度。

items.en: Not only did the hotel lose our booking, but it also charged us twice.
items.zh: 飯店不只弄丟了我們的訂房，還收了我們兩次錢。

items.en: Not only did we miss the train, but we also left our tickets at home.
items.zh: 我們不只錯過了火車，還把車票忘在家裡。

items.en: Not only did the team win the cup, but they also scored a record number of goals.
items.zh: 這支球隊不只拿下獎盃，進球數還破了紀錄。

items.en: Not only did my neighbour fix the fence, but he also painted it for free.
items.zh: 我鄰居不只修好了籬笆，還免費幫忙上漆。

examples.heading: ④ 前面有 Indeed、Furthermore

items.en: Indeed, not only did the course improve my writing, but it also gave me more confidence.
items.zh: 確實，這門課不只讓我的寫作進步，也讓我更有自信。

items.en: Furthermore, not only do I speak English at work, but I also use it with my friends online.
items.zh: 此外，我不只在工作上說英文，也在網路上和朋友用英文聊天。

items.en: Furthermore, not only does the flat have a balcony, but it also comes with a parking space.
items.zh: 此外，這間公寓不只有陽台，還附一個停車位。

items.en: Indeed, not only did the volunteers clean the park, but they also collected money for new benches.
items.zh: 確實，志工不只打掃了公園，還募款買新長椅。

examples.heading: ⑤ 書信和作文裡的句子

items.en: For me, not only do long walks help me relax, but they also give me time to think.
items.zh: 對我來說，長距離散步不只讓我放鬆，也給我時間思考。

items.en: In my opinion, not only does social media waste time, but it also affects our sleep.
items.zh: 我認為社群媒體不只浪費時間，也影響我們的睡眠。

items.en: Not only did I enjoy the conference, but I also met several useful contacts there.
items.zh: 我不只很喜歡這場研討會，還在會上認識了好幾個有用的人脈。

items.en: As you know, not only do I have experience in sales, but I also speak three languages.
items.zh: 您也知道，我不只有業務經驗，還會說三種語言。

items.en: Not only did your letter arrive on time, but it also answered all my questions.
items.zh: 您的信不只準時寄到，還回答了我所有的問題。

examples.heading: ⑥ but 後面省略 also

items.en: Not only did the bus arrive late, but it was full when it came.
items.zh: 公車不只晚到，來的時候還客滿。

items.en: Not only does she run the business, but she looks after three children.
items.zh: 她不只經營公司，還照顧三個孩子。

items.en: Not only do they make good coffee, but their cakes are excellent too.
items.zh: 他們不只咖啡煮得好，蛋糕也很棒。

examples.heading: ⑦ 和一般語序比較

items.en: I not only speak Italian, but I also teach it.
items.zh: 我不只會說義大利文，還教義大利文。

items.en: Not only do I speak Italian, but I also teach it at a local school.
items.zh: 我不只會說義大利文，還在當地一所學校教義大利文。

items.en: The festival not only attracted tourists but also helped local shops.
items.zh: 這個節慶不只吸引了觀光客，也幫助了當地的商店。

items.en: Not only did the festival attract tourists, but it also helped many small local shops.
items.zh: 這個節慶不只吸引了觀光客，也幫了很多當地的小店。

title: I have new neighbors.
translation: 我有新鄰居了。
name: 形容詞加複數名詞（不加限定詞）
sentences: I have new neighbors. They moved in last week.
This market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
My son loves fast cars.
We need clean towels in room twelve, please.
My aunt knits warm socks for the whole family every winter.
Do you sell cheap phones here?
I bought new curtains for the living room.
My grandma tells funny stories about her school days.
You should wear comfortable shoes for the walk tomorrow.
They're nice people. You'll like them.
Those are expensive glasses, so be careful.
These are old photos of my parents' wedding.
My brothers are good students, but I'm not.
Penguins are funny animals.
Small dogs are easy to look after in a flat.
Old buildings are everywhere in this part of town.
Hot drinks are free with lunch today.
Young children need a lot of sleep.
Big supermarkets are open late here.
There are tall trees all around our house.
There are free seats at the back of the bus.
This place has nice shops and good cafés.
Our school has great teachers.
I usually read books about famous people.
We had dinner with old friends from university.
My mum makes this soup with fresh tomatoes from the garden.
My cat sleeps on warm blankets in winter.
The hotel has big rooms and clean bathrooms.
In my town there are long beaches and small restaurants.
I like sunny days and quiet evenings.
They sell nice clothes and cheap shoes at that market.

examples.heading: ① 形容詞 + 複數名詞當受詞

items.en: I have new neighbors. They moved in last week.
items.zh: 我有新鄰居了，他們上禮拜搬進來。

items.en: This market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
items.zh: 這個市場每天早上都賣新鮮蔬菜。

items.en: My son loves fast cars.
items.zh: 我兒子很愛跑車。

items.en: We need clean towels in room twelve, please.
items.zh: 麻煩送幾條乾淨的毛巾到十二號房。

items.en: My aunt knits warm socks for the whole family every winter.
items.zh: 我阿姨每年冬天都幫全家織保暖的襪子。

items.en: Do you sell cheap phones here?
items.zh: 你們這裡有賣便宜的手機嗎？

items.en: I bought new curtains for the living room.
items.zh: 我幫客廳買了新窗簾。

items.en: My grandma tells funny stories about her school days.
items.zh: 我奶奶會講她上學時的好笑故事。

items.en: You should wear comfortable shoes for the walk tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天要走路，你應該穿舒服的鞋子。

examples.heading: ② 形容詞 + 複數名詞當補語

items.en: They're nice people. You'll like them.
items.zh: 他們人很好，你會喜歡他們的。

items.en: Those are expensive glasses, so be careful.
items.zh: 那些是很貴的杯子，小心一點。

items.en: These are old photos of my parents' wedding.
items.zh: 這些是我爸媽婚禮的老照片。

items.en: My brothers are good students, but I'm not.
items.zh: 我哥哥們都是好學生，可是我不是。

items.en: Penguins are funny animals.
items.zh: 企鵝是很逗趣的動物。

examples.heading: ③ 形容詞 + 複數名詞當主詞

items.en: Small dogs are easy to look after in a flat.
items.zh: 小型狗在公寓裡很好照顧。

items.en: Old buildings are everywhere in this part of town.
items.zh: 城裡的這一區到處都是老建築。

items.en: Hot drinks are free with lunch today.
items.zh: 今天午餐附的熱飲免費。

items.en: Young children need a lot of sleep.
items.zh: 小孩子需要很多睡眠。

items.en: Big supermarkets are open late here.
items.zh: 這裡的大型超市開到很晚。

examples.heading: ④ 在 there is / there are 和 have 後面

items.en: There are tall trees all around our house.
items.zh: 我們家四周都是高大的樹。

items.en: There are free seats at the back of the bus.
items.zh: 公車後面有空位。

items.en: This place has nice shops and good cafés.
items.zh: 這個地方有不錯的商店和咖啡店。

items.en: Our school has great teachers.
items.zh: 我們學校的老師都很棒。

examples.heading: ⑤ 形容詞 + 複數名詞，在介系詞後面

items.en: I usually read books about famous people.
items.zh: 我常看名人的書。

items.en: We had dinner with old friends from university.
items.zh: 我們跟大學時的老朋友吃了晚餐。

items.en: My mum makes this soup with fresh tomatoes from the garden.
items.zh: 我媽媽用院子裡的新鮮番茄煮這個湯。

items.en: My cat sleeps on warm blankets in winter.
items.zh: 我的貓冬天都睡在暖和的毯子上。

examples.heading: ⑥ 兩組形容詞 + 複數名詞

items.en: The hotel has big rooms and clean bathrooms.
items.zh: 那家飯店房間很大，浴室也很乾淨。

items.en: In my town there are long beaches and small restaurants.
items.zh: 我們鎮上有很長的海灘和小餐廳。

items.en: I like sunny days and quiet evenings.
items.zh: 我喜歡晴朗的白天和安靜的夜晚。

items.en: They sell nice clothes and cheap shoes at that market.
items.zh: 那個市場有賣好看的衣服和便宜的鞋子。

title: I will write to you again next week.
translation: 我下禮拜會再寫信給你。
name: 名詞片語當時間副詞
sentences: Thanks for your letter. I will write to you again next week.
Grandad turns ninety next month, so we're planning a party.
We're moving to a new flat next year.
See you next Tuesday at the gym.
I started my new job last Monday.
We went to Greece last summer.
Our team lost the final last weekend.
She moved to London last year.
I'm very tired this morning.
What are you doing this weekend?
Prices have gone up again this month.
Can we meet this afternoon instead?
My dad walks the dog round the park every evening.
We visit my grandparents every Sunday.
She goes swimming every morning before work.
I change the water in the fish tank every week.
If not, I will see you tomorrow morning.
I can go to see her tomorrow, because I'm going to a job interview today.
I called you yesterday afternoon, but you didn't answer.
The plumber is coming tomorrow evening.
I waited two hours for the doctor.
We stayed three nights in Paris.
He worked twelve hours yesterday.
The film lasted three hours.
Next week, we're going on holiday.
Every morning, I drink a glass of water.
Last night, someone broke into our car.
This year, I want to learn to swim.
The dentist can see you on Thursday at ten.
The dentist is on holiday, so she can see you next Thursday.
We usually go to the beach in the summer, but last summer we stayed at home.

examples.heading: ① next + 時間

items.en: Thanks for your letter. I will write to you again next week.
items.zh: 謝謝你的信，我下禮拜會再寫信給你。

items.en: Grandad turns ninety next month, so we're planning a party.
items.zh: 爺爺下個月滿九十歲，所以我們在籌備派對。

items.en: We're moving to a new flat next year.
items.zh: 我們明年要搬到新公寓。

items.en: See you next Tuesday at the gym.
items.zh: 下星期二健身房見。

examples.heading: ② last + 時間

items.en: I started my new job last Monday.
items.zh: 我上星期一開始新工作。

items.en: We went to Greece last summer.
items.zh: 我們去年夏天去了希臘。

items.en: Our team lost the final last weekend.
items.zh: 我們的球隊上週末在決賽輸了。

items.en: She moved to London last year.
items.zh: 她去年搬到倫敦。

examples.heading: ③ this + 時間

items.en: I'm very tired this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上好累。

items.en: What are you doing this weekend?
items.zh: 你這個週末要做什麼？

items.en: Prices have gone up again this month.
items.zh: 這個月物價又漲了。

items.en: Can we meet this afternoon instead?
items.zh: 我們改成今天下午見面好嗎？

examples.heading: ④ every + 時間

items.en: My dad walks the dog round the park every evening.
items.zh: 我爸爸每天晚上帶狗繞公園散步。

items.en: We visit my grandparents every Sunday.
items.zh: 我們每個星期天去看爺爺奶奶。

items.en: She goes swimming every morning before work.
items.zh: 她每天上班前去游泳。

items.en: I change the water in the fish tank every week.
items.zh: 我每個禮拜換一次魚缸的水。

examples.heading: ⑤ today / tomorrow / yesterday

items.en: If not, I will see you tomorrow morning.
items.zh: 如果不行的話，我明天早上再見你。

items.en: I can go to see her tomorrow, because I'm going to a job interview today.
items.zh: 我明天可以去看她，因為我今天要去工作面試。

items.en: I called you yesterday afternoon, but you didn't answer.
items.zh: 我昨天下午打給你，可是你沒接。

items.en: The plumber is coming tomorrow evening.
items.zh: 水電工明天晚上會來。

examples.heading: ⑥ 時間長度

items.en: I waited two hours for the doctor.
items.zh: 我等醫生等了兩個小時。

items.en: We stayed three nights in Paris.
items.zh: 我們在巴黎住了三晚。

items.en: He worked twelve hours yesterday.
items.zh: 他昨天工作了十二個小時。

items.en: The film lasted three hours.
items.zh: 那部電影長達三小時。

examples.heading: ⑦ 時間名詞片語放在句首

items.en: Next week, we're going on holiday.
items.zh: 下禮拜我們要去度假。

items.en: Every morning, I drink a glass of water.
items.zh: 我每天早上喝一杯水。

items.en: Last night, someone broke into our car.
items.zh: 昨晚有人闖進我們的車。

items.en: This year, I want to learn to swim.
items.zh: 今年我想學游泳。

examples.heading: ⑧ 不加介系詞和加介系詞比較

items.en: The dentist can see you on Thursday at ten.
items.zh: 牙醫星期四十點可以幫你看診。

items.en: The dentist is on holiday, so she can see you next Thursday.
items.zh: 牙醫在休假，所以她下星期四才能幫你看診。

items.en: We usually go to the beach in the summer, but last summer we stayed at home.
items.zh: 我們通常夏天去海邊，不過去年夏天我們待在家。

title: He is a student.
translation: 他是學生。
name: 名詞片語當 be 動詞的補語
sentences: He is a student at B6 College.
My aunt is a vet, so our house is always full of animals.
Her husband is an engineer for a car company.
I want to be a pilot when I grow up.
My uncle was a teacher for forty years.
Our coach is a former Olympic swimmer.
Our village was a quiet place before the new road came.
That was a great party!
This is my new flatmate, and that's her cat.
Hi Rie, it's Mohamad. Are you free tomorrow?
My name is Carlos, and I'm from Mexico.
And the winner of this year's prize is Laura Hughes!
Our new neighbour is Mr Taylor.
My parents are doctors at the same hospital.
We are students from Japan.
Those are my sister's books.
They were good neighbours.
There is a big garden behind the house.
There are two bathrooms upstairs.
There's a supermarket near my flat.
There were a lot of people at the concert.
Excuse me, are you the manager of this shop?
She isn't a doctor. She's a dentist.
Are they your cousins?
Camping in November wasn't the best plan.
Mum, this is Daniel from my football team.
That's my school over there.
It's a present for you.
That's the shop where I bought your present.
A dolphin is a mammal, not a fish.
Paella is a Spanish rice dish.

examples.heading: ① be + a / an + 職業

items.en: He is a student at B6 College.
items.zh: 他是 B6 學院的學生。

items.en: My aunt is a vet, so our house is always full of animals.
items.zh: 我阿姨是獸醫，所以我們家總是有一堆動物。

items.en: Her husband is an engineer for a car company.
items.zh: 她先生是一家汽車公司的工程師。

items.en: I want to be a pilot when I grow up.
items.zh: 我長大想當機師。

items.en: My uncle was a teacher for forty years.
items.zh: 我叔叔當了四十年的老師。

examples.heading: ② be + 限定詞 + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: Our coach is a former Olympic swimmer.
items.zh: 我們的教練以前是奧運游泳選手。

items.en: Our village was a quiet place before the new road came.
items.zh: 新路開通之前，我們村子是個安靜的地方。

items.en: That was a great party!
items.zh: 那個派對好棒！

items.en: This is my new flatmate, and that's her cat.
items.zh: 這是我的新室友，那是她的貓。

examples.heading: ③ be + 人名

items.en: Hi Rie, it's Mohamad. Are you free tomorrow?
items.zh: 嗨 Rie，我是 Mohamad。你明天有空嗎？

items.en: My name is Carlos, and I'm from Mexico.
items.zh: 我的名字是 Carlos，我來自墨西哥。

items.en: And the winner of this year's prize is Laura Hughes!
items.zh: 今年的得獎者是 Laura Hughes！

items.en: Our new neighbour is Mr Taylor.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居是 Taylor 先生。

examples.heading: ④ be + 複數名詞

items.en: My parents are doctors at the same hospital.
items.zh: 我爸媽是同一家醫院的醫生。

items.en: We are students from Japan.
items.zh: 我們是來自日本的學生。

items.en: Those are my sister's books.
items.zh: 那些是我姊姊的書。

items.en: They were good neighbours.
items.zh: 他們以前是好鄰居。

examples.heading: ⑤ there is / there are + 名詞片語

items.en: There is a big garden behind the house.
items.zh: 房子後面有一個大院子。

items.en: There are two bathrooms upstairs.
items.zh: 樓上有兩間浴室。

items.en: There's a supermarket near my flat.
items.zh: 我的公寓附近有一家超市。

items.en: There were a lot of people at the concert.
items.zh: 演唱會有很多人。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Excuse me, are you the manager of this shop?
items.zh: 不好意思，請問您是這家店的經理嗎？

items.en: She isn't a doctor. She's a dentist.
items.zh: 她不是醫生，她是牙醫。

items.en: Are they your cousins?
items.zh: 他們是你的表兄弟姊妹嗎？

items.en: Camping in November wasn't the best plan.
items.zh: 十一月去露營不是最好的計畫。

examples.heading: ⑦ this / that / it + be + 名詞片語

items.en: Mum, this is Daniel from my football team.
items.zh: 媽，這是我足球隊的 Daniel。

items.en: That's my school over there.
items.zh: 那邊那間是我的學校。

items.en: It's a present for you.
items.zh: 這是給你的禮物。

items.en: That's the shop where I bought your present.
items.zh: 那就是我買你禮物的那家店。

examples.heading: ⑧ 名詞片語當補語，說明主詞的種類

items.en: A dolphin is a mammal, not a fish.
items.zh: 海豚是哺乳類，不是魚。

items.en: Paella is a Spanish rice dish.
items.zh: 西班牙海鮮飯是一道西班牙米飯料理。

title: I like everything in my house.
translation: 我喜歡我家裡的每一樣東西。
name: 名詞片語當介系詞受詞
sentences: I like everything in my house, especially the big kitchen.
The keys are on the shelf by the door.
I'll meet you at the bus station at five.
There's a cat under my car again.
We live near the sea.
My sister is getting married in the spring.
Grandma's flight lands on Tuesday morning.
The shop closes at lunchtime on Saturdays.
Let's go for a walk after dinner.
I'm baking a chocolate cake for my mum's birthday.
This present is for my grandmother.
I sent a postcard to my best friend.
Take this form to the office on the second floor.
I went to the cinema with my brother.
She goes to work by bus.
My grandson helps me with my new phone every Sunday.

items.zh: 我五點在公車站跟你碰面。

items.zh: 又有一隻貓在我的車子底下。

items.en: We live near the sea.

examples.heading: ② 時間：in / on / at + 名詞片語

items.zh: 我在烤一個巧克力蛋糕給我媽媽過生日。

items.zh: 這份禮物是要給我奶奶的。

items.zh: 把這張表格拿到二樓的辦公室。

examples.heading: ④ with / by + 名詞片語

items.zh: 我跟我哥哥去看電影。

items.zh: 她搭公車上班。

items.zh: 我跟我爸媽和妹妹住在一起。

items.zh: 我叔叔住在愛丁堡。

examples.heading: ⑥ 介系詞 + 限定詞 + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.zh: 他坐在那張舊沙發上。

items.en: I bought this dress for the summer party.
items.zh: 我買這件洋裝是要穿去夏日派對的。

items.en: Turn left at the next traffic lights.

items.zh: 坐我們旁邊。

items.zh: 我們在海灘上的一家餐廳吃午餐。

examples.heading: ① 限定詞 + 名詞

items.en: My grandfather reads the newspaper with his breakfast every morning.

examples.heading: ② 限定詞 + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.zh: 我阿姨買了一台新車給自己過六十歲生日。

items.en: We watched a funny film on the plane.
items.zh: 我們在飛機上看了一部好笑的電影。

items.en: My son wants a big birthday cake with candles.
items.zh: 我兒子想要一個插著蠟燭的大生日蛋糕。

items.en: She's wearing her red dress tonight.
items.zh: 她今晚要穿她的紅洋裝。

examples.heading: ③ 複數名詞

items.zh: 我哥哥喜歡狗，可是他怕貓。

items.en: I need new shoes for the wedding.
items.zh: 我需要一雙新鞋去參加婚禮。

items.en: We grow tomatoes in the garden.
items.zh: 我們在院子裡種番茄。

items.en: The children made cards for their grandparents.

items.zh: 我每個星期天打掃房間。

items.zh: 我們星期五在那家義大利餐廳訂了一張六人桌。

items.zh: 我吃完午餐會打給牙醫改預約時間。

items.en: My neighbours planted three apple trees last spring.
items.zh: 我鄰居去年春天種了三棵蘋果樹。

items.zh: 你女兒喜歡學校的音樂會嗎？

items.zh: 我們需要一張地圖和一本好的旅遊指南。

Is your sister a student?

examples.heading: ① 限定詞 + 名詞

items.en: My friends are from Poland, Hungary, Libya and Morocco. We met at language school.
items.zh: 我的朋友來自波蘭、匈牙利、利比亞和摩洛哥，我們是在語言學校認識的。

items.en: His name is Stanislav, and he's from Prague.
items.zh: 他的名字是 Stanislav，他來自布拉格。

items.en: Our flat has a small balcony with lots of plants.
items.zh: 我們的公寓有一個種滿植物的小陽台。

items.en: Our English teacher plays the guitar in a band at weekends.
items.zh: 我們的英文老師週末會在樂團彈吉他。

items.en: This road leads to the old castle on the hill.
items.zh: 這條路通往山丘上的老城堡。

examples.heading: ② 人名

items.en: Anna is my best friend.
items.zh: Anna 是我最好的朋友。

items.en: Tom and Lucy live next door.
items.zh: Tom 和 Lucy 住在隔壁。

items.en: Mr Brown teaches us maths.
items.zh: Brown 老師教我們數學。

items.en: Maria has two brothers.
items.zh: Maria 有兩個兄弟。

examples.heading: ③ 限定詞 + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.zh: 新來的櫃台人員會說四種語言。

items.en: My little sister goes to school next year.
items.zh: 我妹妹明年要上學。

items.en: A big dog lives in that house.
items.zh: 那間房子裡住著一隻大狗。

items.en: The old church is very beautiful.
items.zh: 那座老教堂很漂亮。

examples.heading: ④ 複數名詞

items.en: Cats sleep a lot during the day.
items.zh: 貓白天睡很多。

items.zh: 我爸媽住在西班牙。

items.en: The twins next door play the violin every evening.
items.zh: 隔壁的雙胞胎每天晚上都拉小提琴。

items.en: Our neighbours have a swimming pool.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居有一座游泳池。

examples.heading: ⑤ 單數主詞 + 動詞-s

items.en: My brother studies medicine, so he's always busy.
items.zh: 我哥哥讀醫學，所以他總是很忙。

items.en: The bakery on the corner sells the best croissants in town.
items.zh: 轉角那家麵包店賣城裡最好吃的可頌。

items.en: My mum works in a hospital.
items.zh: 我媽媽在醫院工作。

items.en: The last bus to the village leaves at half past eleven.
items.zh: 開往村子的末班車十一點半發車。

examples.heading: ⑥ 名詞片語主詞 + be

items.en: My favourite colour is green.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是綠色。

items.zh: 湖水太冷了，不能游泳。

items.en: My dad's car is red.
items.zh: 我爸爸的車是紅色的。

items.en: Your new glasses are the same colour as mine.
items.zh: 你的新眼鏡跟我的顏色一樣。

examples.heading: ⑦ 名詞片語主詞 + 過去式

items.en: The party was great.
items.zh: 派對很棒。

items.en: My grandparents were farmers.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶以前是農夫。

items.en: The train left at six.
items.zh: 火車六點開走了。

items.en: Her brother came to the wedding.
items.zh: 她哥哥來參加了婚禮。

examples.heading: ⑧ 疑問句裡的主詞

items.en: Is your sister a student?
items.zh: 你姊姊是學生嗎？

items.en: Excuse me, does this train stop at Oxford?
items.zh: 不好意思，這班火車有停牛津嗎？

items.zh: 我的家人全都要來過聖誕節。

items.zh: 球隊的隊員比賽後在換衣服。

items.zh: 班上的同學在做各自的專題。

items.zh: 觀眾在拍手歡呼。

examples.heading: ③ police + 複數動詞

items.zh: 警方在找一個穿黑色大衣的高個子男人。

items.zh: 陪審員還在討論，他們無法達成共識。

items.zh: 樂團今晚要舉行最後一場演出。
