items.zh: 學校在這條路的盡頭。

items.en: Excuse me, is there a bank on this street?
items.zh: 不好意思，這條街上有銀行嗎？

items.en: We play in the park after school.
items.zh: 我們放學後在公園玩。

items.en: London is a big city.
items.zh: 倫敦是一個大城市。

examples.heading: ③ 東西

items.en: Where is my phone? I can't find it.
items.zh: 我的手機呢？我找不到。

items.en: You can borrow this book. I finished it last night.
items.zh: 這本書你可以借去，我昨晚看完了。

items.en: Please leave your umbrella by the door.
items.zh: 請把你的雨傘放在門邊。

items.en: My dad has a red car.
items.zh: 我爸爸有一台紅色的車。

items.en: Mum, there's a spider in the bath!
items.zh: 媽，浴缸裡有一隻蜘蛛！

examples.heading: ④ 時間

items.en: I visit my grandma every week after work.
items.zh: 我每個禮拜下班後去看我奶奶。

items.en: I get up at seven in the morning.
items.zh: 我早上七點起床。

items.en: We have English three times a week.
items.zh: 我們一個禮拜上三次英文課。

items.en: My birthday is next month.
items.zh: 我的生日在下個月。

examples.heading: ⑤ 活動

items.en: In my free time I go shopping, and I like swimming.
items.zh: 我有空的時候會去逛街，而且我喜歡游泳。

items.en: My sister loves dancing.
items.zh: 我妹妹很愛跳舞。

items.en: Football is my favourite sport.
items.zh: 足球是我最喜歡的運動。

items.en: I do my homework after dinner.
items.zh: 我吃完晚餐後寫功課。

examples.heading: ⑥ 句首的普通名詞大寫

items.en: Dogs are my favourite animals.
items.zh: 狗是我最喜歡的動物。

items.en: Breakfast is at eight.
items.zh: 早餐八點開始。

items.en: Teachers work very hard.
items.zh: 老師們工作很辛苦。

items.en: Coffee keeps me awake.
items.zh: 咖啡讓我保持清醒。

examples.heading: ⑦ 普通名詞和人名、地名

items.en: My teacher is called Mr Smith.
items.zh: 我的老師是 Smith 先生。

items.en: This summer I'm visiting my cousin in Paris.
items.zh: 今年夏天我要去巴黎找我表姊。

items.en: My cat is called Tiger.
items.zh: 我的貓叫 Tiger。

items.en: My sister works in a hotel in Rome.
items.zh: 我姊姊在羅馬的一家飯店工作。

title: You just have to send me your design and I'll do the rest.
translation: 你只要把你的設計寄給我，剩下的我來處理。
name: 普通名詞（較多種）
sentences: I love the design of your new kitchen. Who did it?
The storm caused a lot of damage to the roof.
Thanks for your visit. It was lovely to see you.
After ten years in the city, we needed a change.
Can you give me a hand with this box?
I'll pay for the tickets if you pay for the rest.
We ate half the pizza and saved the rest for later.
Two of us went by car, and the rest went by train.
You take the big bags, and I'll carry the rest.
Living in another country is a great experience.
This job is a good opportunity for you.
One advantage of the flat is the big kitchen.
Plastic bags are bad for the environment, so bring your own bag.
They have a very good relationship.
My teacher gave me some good advice about the exam.
She broke my heart, and nobody can repair the damage.
You can find more information on our website.
When you're swimming, you exercise your whole body. It's great for your health.
I've got an interview for a job in a bank.
My boss wants the report by Friday.
Our project is about recycling.
The course starts next month.
Excuse me, we'd like to pay. Could you bring us the bill?
I've got an appointment at the dentist's.
There's a problem with my phone. The screen won't work.
What's the price of this jacket?
The weather was terrible all week.
The result of the match surprised everyone.
My favourite subject at school is history.
The noise from the street keeps me awake.
Their decision was a big mistake.

examples.heading: ① 和動詞同形的名詞

items.en: I love the design of your new kitchen. Who did it?
items.zh: 我好喜歡你新廚房的設計，是誰做的？

items.en: The storm caused a lot of damage to the roof.
items.zh: 暴風雨對屋頂造成很多損害。

items.en: Thanks for your visit. It was lovely to see you.
items.zh: 謝謝你來訪，見到你真開心。

items.en: After ten years in the city, we needed a change.
items.zh: 在城市住了十年後，我們需要改變一下。

items.en: Can you give me a hand with this box?
items.zh: 你可以幫我搬一下這個箱子嗎？

examples.heading: ② the rest

items.en: I'll pay for the tickets if you pay for the rest.
items.zh: 如果你付其他的錢，票錢我來付。

items.en: We ate half the pizza and saved the rest for later.
items.zh: 我們吃了半個披薩，剩下的留著晚點吃。

items.en: Two of us went by car, and the rest went by train.
items.zh: 我們有兩個人開車去，其他人搭火車。

items.en: You take the big bags, and I'll carry the rest.
items.zh: 你拿大袋子，剩下的我來拿。

examples.heading: ③ 抽象名詞

items.en: Living in another country is a great experience.
items.zh: 住在國外是很棒的經驗。

items.en: This job is a good opportunity for you.
items.zh: 這份工作對你來說是個好機會。

items.en: One advantage of the flat is the big kitchen.
items.zh: 這間公寓的一個優點是廚房很大。

items.en: Plastic bags are bad for the environment, so bring your own bag.
items.zh: 塑膠袋對環境不好，所以自己帶袋子。

items.en: They have a very good relationship.
items.zh: 他們的關係很好。

examples.heading: ④ 不可數的抽象名詞

items.en: My teacher gave me some good advice about the exam.
items.zh: 我的老師給了我一些關於考試的好建議。

items.en: She broke my heart, and nobody can repair the damage.
items.zh: 她讓我心碎，沒有人能修補這個傷害。

items.en: You can find more information on our website.
items.zh: 你可以在我們的網站上找到更多資訊。

items.en: When you're swimming, you exercise your whole body. It's great for your health.
items.zh: 游泳的時候全身都在運動，對健康很好。

examples.heading: ⑤ 工作和學校的名詞

items.en: I've got an interview for a job in a bank.
items.zh: 我在一家銀行有一個工作面試。

items.en: My boss wants the report by Friday.
items.zh: 我老闆要我星期五前交報告。

items.en: Our project is about recycling.
items.zh: 我們的專題是關於回收。

items.en: The course starts next month.
items.zh: 課程下個月開始。

examples.heading: ⑥ 日常生活的名詞

items.en: Excuse me, we'd like to pay. Could you bring us the bill?
items.zh: 不好意思，我們要結帳，可以給我們帳單嗎？

items.en: I've got an appointment at the dentist's.
items.zh: 我在牙醫診所有預約。

items.en: There's a problem with my phone. The screen won't work.
items.zh: 我的手機有問題，螢幕不能用。

items.en: What's the price of this jacket?
items.zh: 這件夾克多少錢？

examples.heading: ⑦ 名詞片語當主詞

items.en: The weather was terrible all week.
items.zh: 整個星期天氣都很糟。

items.en: The result of the match surprised everyone.
items.zh: 比賽的結果讓大家都很驚訝。

items.en: My favourite subject at school is history.
items.zh: 我在學校最喜歡的科目是歷史。

items.en: The noise from the street keeps me awake.
items.zh: 街上的噪音讓我睡不著。

items.en: Their decision was a big mistake.
items.zh: 他們的決定是一個很大的錯誤。

title: The subject of my boss's talk will be IT skills.
translation: 我老闆這次演講的主題會是 IT 技能。
name: of 片語含所有格 's 的名詞片語
sentences: The subject of my boss's talk will be IT skills, so please be there.
I ran outside and saw that the window of my neighbour's car was broken.
The name of my brother's school is on his jacket.
The door of my sister's room is always shut.
The end of my friend's story was really funny.
My friend Ronald got the role of James Bond's son in the school play!
Do you know the title of Anna's new book?
The start of Tom's party is at eight.
I love the colour of Sarah's new car.
The price of the hotel's rooms has gone up.
The lights of the teacher's car are still on. Should we tell her?
The walls of the baby's room are pale blue.
The size of the company's new office is amazing.
I found a photo of my grandfather's house in a box.
Mum keeps a picture of my sister's wedding dress on the fridge.
She's a member of her school's football team.
I've got a copy of my mum's favourite recipe.
The colour of my sister's shoes is really bright.
The roof of our neighbour's house blew off in the storm.
The battery of my dad's phone is always dead.
The garden of my aunt's cottage is full of roses.
I can't remember the name of my teacher's dog.
We watched the first episode of my cousin's TV show.
He fixed the lock of his mum's front door.
Have you seen the end of Paul's video?
We sat at the back of my uncle's car.
There's a crack in the screen of my son's tablet.
She's in the middle of her daughter's wedding preparations.
I put the flowers by the door of my grandma's flat.
We talked about the results of my sister's exams.
I left my coat in the hall of my friend's house.

examples.heading: ① the + 名詞 + of + my + 名詞 + 's + 名詞

items.en: The subject of my boss's talk will be IT skills, so please be there.
items.zh: 我老闆這次演講的主題會是 IT 技能，所以請大家到場。

items.en: I ran outside and saw that the window of my neighbour's car was broken.
items.zh: 我跑到外面，看到我鄰居車子的窗戶破了。

items.en: The name of my brother's school is on his jacket.
items.zh: 我弟弟學校的名字印在他的外套上。

items.en: The door of my sister's room is always shut.
items.zh: 我姊姊房間的門總是鎖著。

items.en: The end of my friend's story was really funny.
items.zh: 我朋友那個故事的結局好好笑。

examples.heading: ② the + 名詞 + of + 人名 + 's + 名詞

items.en: My friend Ronald got the role of James Bond's son in the school play!
items.zh: 我朋友 Ronald 在學校話劇裡拿到詹姆士龐德兒子的角色！

items.en: Do you know the title of Anna's new book?
items.zh: 你知道 Anna 新書的書名嗎？

items.en: The start of Tom's party is at eight.
items.zh: Tom 的派對八點開始。

items.en: I love the colour of Sarah's new car.
items.zh: 我很喜歡 Sarah 新車的顏色。

examples.heading: ③ the + 名詞 + of + the + 名詞 + 's + 名詞

items.en: The price of the hotel's rooms has gone up.
items.zh: 那家飯店的房價漲了。

items.en: The lights of the teacher's car are still on. Should we tell her?
items.zh: 老師車子的燈還開著，我們要跟她說嗎？

items.en: The walls of the baby's room are pale blue.
items.zh: 寶寶房間的牆壁是淡藍色的。

items.en: The size of the company's new office is amazing.
items.zh: 公司新辦公室的大小真驚人。

examples.heading: ④ a / one + 名詞 + of + 名詞 + 's + 名詞

items.en: I found a photo of my grandfather's house in a box.
items.zh: 我在一個箱子裡找到一張我爺爺房子的照片。

items.en: Mum keeps a picture of my sister's wedding dress on the fridge.
items.zh: 媽媽把一張我姊姊婚紗的照片貼在冰箱上。

items.en: She's a member of her school's football team.
items.zh: 她是她們學校足球隊的隊員。

items.en: I've got a copy of my mum's favourite recipe.
items.zh: 我有一份我媽媽最喜歡的食譜。

examples.heading: ⑤ 整個名詞片語當主詞

items.en: The colour of my sister's shoes is really bright.
items.zh: 我姊姊鞋子的顏色很鮮豔。

items.en: The roof of our neighbour's house blew off in the storm.
items.zh: 我們鄰居房子的屋頂在暴風雨中被吹走了。

items.en: The battery of my dad's phone is always dead.
items.zh: 我爸手機的電池老是沒電。

items.en: The garden of my aunt's cottage is full of roses.
items.zh: 我阿姨小屋的花園開滿了玫瑰。

examples.heading: ⑥ 整個名詞片語當受詞

items.en: I can't remember the name of my teacher's dog.
items.zh: 我記不得我老師的狗叫什麼名字。

items.en: We watched the first episode of my cousin's TV show.
items.zh: 我們看了我表哥電視節目的第一集。

items.en: He fixed the lock of his mum's front door.
items.zh: 他修好了他媽媽家前門的鎖。

items.en: Have you seen the end of Paul's video?
items.zh: 你看過 Paul 那支影片的結尾嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 整個名詞片語在介系詞後面

items.en: We sat at the back of my uncle's car.
items.zh: 我們坐在我叔叔車子的後座。

items.en: There's a crack in the screen of my son's tablet.
items.zh: 我兒子平板的螢幕有一條裂痕。

items.en: She's in the middle of her daughter's wedding preparations.
items.zh: 她正忙著準備她女兒的婚禮。

items.en: I put the flowers by the door of my grandma's flat.
items.zh: 我把花放在我奶奶公寓的門邊。

items.en: We talked about the results of my sister's exams.
items.zh: 我們聊了我姊姊考試的成績。

items.en: I left my coat in the hall of my friend's house.
items.zh: 我把外套留在我朋友家的玄關。

title: He had beautiful green eyes and short, curly red hair.
translation: 他有一雙漂亮的綠眼睛，還有一頭紅色的短捲髮。
name: 多個形容詞構成的名詞片語（較多種）
sentences: The north-east is famous for its beautiful white beaches.
Inside the box there were three bottles of nasty purple liquid.
She has lovely dark eyes, just like her mother.
I found a gorgeous blue scarf in the sale.
He has short, curly red hair and lots of freckles.
We sat at a big round table in the corner.
The baby has tiny round pink cheeks.
She gave me a little square box with a gold ribbon.
Last weekend I bought a white hooded jacket and black woollen gloves.
My grandad still wears a grey woollen hat every winter.
We need a brown leather sofa for the living room.
The beach is famous for its fine white sand.
They live in a beautiful old Spanish house by the sea.
My uncle collects old Japanese cameras.
We had dinner at a new Thai restaurant in town.
I'd love a modern German car one day.
She wore a long black silk dress to the party.
We stayed in a lovely little old hotel near the castle.
He bought a big new red sports car.
There's a small round wooden table by the window.
My mum gave me an ugly old brown suitcase.
It was a cheap, comfortable hotel.
Our new teacher is a kind, patient woman.
Sorry I fell asleep. It was such a long, slow film.
After the exams, I just want a few calm, lazy days at the beach.
Those tall old trees in the park are over two hundred years old.
A small white cat sleeps on our car every night.
The big new shopping centre opens next Friday.
I'm looking for a dress with long white sleeves.
They walked along the beautiful sandy beach.
She came home with a fat little brown puppy.

examples.heading: ① 評價 + 顏色 + 名詞

items.en: The north-east is famous for its beautiful white beaches.
items.zh: 東北部以美麗的白色沙灘聞名。

items.en: Inside the box there were three bottles of nasty purple liquid.
items.zh: 盒子裡有三瓶噁心的紫色液體。

items.en: She has lovely dark eyes, just like her mother.
items.zh: 她有一雙好看的深色眼睛，跟她媽媽一模一樣。

items.en: I found a gorgeous blue scarf in the sale.
items.zh: 我在特價時找到一條很美的藍色圍巾。

examples.heading: ② 大小 + 形狀 + 顏色 + 名詞

items.en: He has short, curly red hair and lots of freckles.
items.zh: 他有一頭紅色的短捲髮，臉上還有很多雀斑。

items.en: We sat at a big round table in the corner.
items.zh: 我們坐在角落的一張大圓桌旁。

items.en: The baby has tiny round pink cheeks.
items.zh: 寶寶的臉頰小小圓圓、粉粉嫩嫩的。

items.en: She gave me a little square box with a gold ribbon.
items.zh: 她給了我一個綁著金色緞帶的小方盒。

examples.heading: ③ 顏色 + 材料、用途 + 名詞

items.en: Last weekend I bought a white hooded jacket and black woollen gloves.
items.zh: 上週末我買了一件白色連帽外套和一雙黑色毛手套。

items.en: My grandad still wears a grey woollen hat every winter.
items.zh: 我爺爺每年冬天還是戴一頂灰色的毛帽。

items.en: We need a brown leather sofa for the living room.
items.zh: 我們客廳需要一張棕色皮沙發。

items.en: The beach is famous for its fine white sand.
items.zh: 那片海灘以細緻的白沙聞名。

examples.heading: ④ 新舊 + 來源 + 名詞

items.en: They live in a beautiful old Spanish house by the sea.
items.zh: 他們住在海邊一棟漂亮的西班牙老房子裡。

items.en: My uncle collects old Japanese cameras.
items.zh: 我舅舅收集日本的老相機。

items.en: We had dinner at a new Thai restaurant in town.
items.zh: 我們在城裡一家新開的泰國餐廳吃了晚餐。

items.en: I'd love a modern German car one day.
items.zh: 我希望有一天能有一台新款的德國車。

examples.heading: ⑤ 三個以上的形容詞

items.en: She wore a long black silk dress to the party.
items.zh: 她穿了一件黑色的絲質長洋裝去派對。

items.en: We stayed in a lovely little old hotel near the castle.
items.zh: 我們住在城堡附近一家很棒的小小老飯店。

items.en: He bought a big new red sports car.
items.zh: 他買了一台紅色的新款大跑車。

items.en: There's a small round wooden table by the window.
items.zh: 窗邊有一張圓形的小木桌。

items.en: My mum gave me an ugly old brown suitcase.
items.zh: 我媽媽給了我一個醜醜的棕色舊行李箱。

examples.heading: ⑥ 同一類的形容詞，中間加逗號

items.en: It was a cheap, comfortable hotel.
items.zh: 那是一家便宜又舒服的飯店。

items.en: Our new teacher is a kind, patient woman.
items.zh: 我們的新老師是一位親切又有耐心的女士。

items.en: Sorry I fell asleep. It was such a long, slow film.
items.zh: 抱歉我睡著了。那部電影又長又慢。

items.en: After the exams, I just want a few calm, lazy days at the beach.
items.zh: 考完試以後，我只想去海邊過幾天平靜又悠閒的日子。

examples.heading: ⑦ 多個形容詞的名詞片語當主詞

items.en: Those tall old trees in the park are over two hundred years old.
items.zh: 公園裡那些高大的老樹已經有兩百多年了。

items.en: A small white cat sleeps on our car every night.
items.zh: 每天晚上都有一隻小白貓睡在我們的車上。

items.en: The big new shopping centre opens next Friday.
items.zh: 那間新的大型購物中心下星期五開幕。

examples.heading: ⑧ 多個形容詞的名詞片語在介系詞後面

items.en: I'm looking for a dress with long white sleeves.
items.zh: 我在找一件有白色長袖的洋裝。

items.en: They walked along the beautiful sandy beach.
items.zh: 他們沿著那片美麗的沙灘散步。

items.en: She came home with a fat little brown puppy.
items.zh: 她帶了一隻胖胖的棕色小狗回家。

title: I was born in a small but beautiful city.
translation: 我出生在一座不大但很漂亮的城市。
name: 用 but 連接形容詞的名詞片語
sentences: I'm very lucky, because I was born in a small but beautiful city by the river.
We stayed in a cheap but clean hotel near the station.
It's an old but comfortable sofa. I don't want to throw it away.
She gave a short but interesting talk.
It was a long but enjoyable walk.
They have a small but lovely garden.
It's a beautiful but expensive city.
He's a talented but lazy student.
We had a fun but tiring weekend.
It's a delicious but very sweet cake.
She bought a pretty but uncomfortable pair of shoes.
You need to ask yourself a simple but tricky question.
The smoke had a strong but pleasant smell.
It's a quiet but friendly village.
He told a sad but true story.
It was a slow but steady recovery.
It's an old but reliable car.
That was an easy but useful lesson.
She has an unusual but beautiful name.
It's an expensive but excellent restaurant.
They sell cheap but good clothes.
We met some strange but friendly people on the train.
I like short but useful emails.
These are simple but delicious recipes.
A small but brave dog chased the fox away.
A short but heavy shower ruined our picnic.
A quiet but clever girl won the prize.
It's a small and quiet town, so it's good for families.
It's a small but busy town, with lots of shops.
We rented a big and noisy flat above a bar.
Later we found a big but quiet flat near the park.

examples.heading: ① 缺點 + but + 優點

items.en: I'm very lucky, because I was born in a small but beautiful city by the river.
items.zh: 我很幸運，因為我出生在河邊一座不大但很漂亮的城市。

items.en: We stayed in a cheap but clean hotel near the station.
items.zh: 我們住在車站附近一家便宜但乾淨的飯店。

items.en: It's an old but comfortable sofa. I don't want to throw it away.
items.zh: 那是一張舊但很舒服的沙發，我不想丟掉。

items.en: She gave a short but interesting talk.
items.zh: 她做了一場簡短但很有意思的演講。

items.en: It was a long but enjoyable walk.
items.zh: 那是一段很長但很愉快的散步。

items.en: They have a small but lovely garden.
items.zh: 他們有一個不大但很可愛的花園。

examples.heading: ② 優點 + but + 缺點

items.en: It's a beautiful but expensive city.
items.zh: 那是一座很美但物價很高的城市。

items.en: He's a talented but lazy student.
items.zh: 他是一個有天分但很懶的學生。

items.en: We had a fun but tiring weekend.
items.zh: 我們過了一個好玩但很累的週末。

items.en: It's a delicious but very sweet cake.
items.zh: 那是一個好吃但很甜的蛋糕。

items.en: She bought a pretty but uncomfortable pair of shoes.
items.zh: 她買了一雙好看但不舒服的鞋子。

examples.heading: ③ 兩個不同面向的形容詞

items.en: You need to ask yourself a simple but tricky question.
items.zh: 你得問自己一個簡單但很難回答的問題。

items.en: The smoke had a strong but pleasant smell.
items.zh: 那煙的味道很濃但很好聞。

items.en: It's a quiet but friendly village.
items.zh: 那是一個安靜但很友善的村子。

items.en: He told a sad but true story.
items.zh: 他說了一個悲傷但真實的故事。

items.en: It was a slow but steady recovery.
items.zh: 那是一段緩慢但穩定的康復過程。

examples.heading: ④ an + 母音開頭的形容詞 + but

items.en: It's an old but reliable car.
items.zh: 那是一台舊但很可靠的車。

items.en: That was an easy but useful lesson.
items.zh: 那是一堂簡單但很實用的課。

items.en: She has an unusual but beautiful name.
items.zh: 她有一個少見但很好聽的名字。

items.en: It's an expensive but excellent restaurant.
items.zh: 那是一家很貴但很棒的餐廳。

examples.heading: ⑤ 複數名詞前面的 形容詞 + but + 形容詞

items.en: They sell cheap but good clothes.
items.zh: 他們賣便宜但品質不錯的衣服。

items.en: We met some strange but friendly people on the train.
items.zh: 我們在火車上遇到一些奇怪但很友善的人。

items.en: I like short but useful emails.
items.zh: 我喜歡簡短但有用的電子郵件。

items.en: These are simple but delicious recipes.
items.zh: 這些是簡單但很好吃的食譜。

examples.heading: ⑥ 名詞片語當主詞

items.en: A small but brave dog chased the fox away.
items.zh: 一隻小小但很勇敢的狗把狐狸趕走了。

items.en: A short but heavy shower ruined our picnic.
items.zh: 一場短暫但很大的陣雨毀了我們的野餐。

items.en: A quiet but clever girl won the prize.
items.zh: 一個安靜但很聰明的女孩得了獎。

examples.heading: ⑦ and 和 but 比較

items.en: It's a small and quiet town, so it's good for families.
items.zh: 那是一個又小又安靜的鎮，很適合家庭居住。

items.en: It's a small but busy town, with lots of shops.
items.zh: 那是一個不大但很熱鬧的鎮，有很多商店。

items.en: We rented a big and noisy flat above a bar.
items.zh: 我們租了酒吧樓上一間又大又吵的公寓。

items.en: Later we found a big but quiet flat near the park.
items.zh: 後來我們在公園附近找到一間大而安靜的公寓。

title: They made really good friends.
translation: 他們成了非常好的朋友。
name: 副詞加形容詞修飾名詞
sentences: They met at university and made really good friends.
Thanks for a really nice evening. Let's do it again soon.
That was a really difficult exam. I'm not sure I passed.
You've got a really beautiful garden.
It took us a very long time, but it was great fun.
Everyone at the funeral said Grandpa was a very generous neighbour.
Our room had a very small window, so it was always dark.
He gave a very short speech at the wedding.
It was an extremely hot day, so we stayed by the pool.
Have you heard Mia play the piano? She's an incredibly gifted musician.
This is an extremely important meeting. Please don't be late.
We had an incredibly busy weekend.
She's a fairly good cook, but she never bakes.
We found a pretty cheap flight to Lisbon for the long weekend.
Don't worry, kids. It's a fairly easy walk to the top.
He's got a pretty good job at the bank.
It's quite a long way to the station, so let's take a taxi.
That was quite a good film, actually.
She lives in quite a small flat in the city centre.
My son had quite a bad cold last week, but he's better now.
The interviewer asked me a rather personal question about my family.
They live in a rather old building.
He made a rather silly mistake in the final.
There are really nice shops in the old town.
My parents have very different opinions about money.
These are extremely expensive shoes. Be careful with them.
We met some incredibly friendly people on holiday.
A very old man helped me with my bags.
Really good teachers are hard to find.
A pretty serious accident closed the motorway this morning.
Extremely cold weather is coming this weekend.

examples.heading: ① really + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: They met at university and made really good friends.
items.zh: 他們在大學認識，成了非常好的朋友。

items.en: Thanks for a really nice evening. Let's do it again soon.
items.zh: 謝謝你讓我度過一個很愉快的晚上，我們快點再聚。

items.en: That was a really difficult exam. I'm not sure I passed.
items.zh: 那場考試真的很難，我不確定我有沒有及格。

items.en: You've got a really beautiful garden.
items.zh: 你的花園好漂亮。

examples.heading: ② very + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: It took us a very long time, but it was great fun.
items.zh: 我們花了很長的時間，不過很好玩。

items.en: Everyone at the funeral said Grandpa was a very generous neighbour.
items.zh: 葬禮上大家都說爺爺是一位非常慷慨的鄰居。

items.en: Our room had a very small window, so it was always dark.
items.zh: 我們的房間窗戶很小，所以房裡總是很暗。

items.en: He gave a very short speech at the wedding.
items.zh: 他在婚禮上講了很短的致詞。

examples.heading: ③ extremely / incredibly + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: It was an extremely hot day, so we stayed by the pool.
items.zh: 那天非常熱，所以我們一直待在泳池邊。

items.en: Have you heard Mia play the piano? She's an incredibly gifted musician.
items.zh: 你聽過 Mia 彈鋼琴嗎？她是一位天分超高的音樂家。

items.en: This is an extremely important meeting. Please don't be late.
items.zh: 這是非常重要的會議。請不要遲到。

items.en: We had an incredibly busy weekend.
items.zh: 我們這個週末忙翻了。

examples.heading: ④ fairly / pretty + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: She's a fairly good cook, but she never bakes.
items.zh: 她廚藝還不錯，可是她從來不烤東西。

items.en: We found a pretty cheap flight to Lisbon for the long weekend.
items.zh: 我們找到一班飛里斯本、滿便宜的機票，可以去過連假。

items.en: Don't worry, kids. It's a fairly easy walk to the top.
items.zh: 孩子們別擔心，走到山頂的路滿好走的。

items.en: He's got a pretty good job at the bank.
items.zh: 他在銀行有一份還不錯的工作。

examples.heading: ⑤ quite + a + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: It's quite a long way to the station, so let's take a taxi.
items.zh: 到車站還滿遠的，我們搭計程車吧。

items.en: That was quite a good film, actually.
items.zh: 其實那部電影還滿好看的。

items.en: She lives in quite a small flat in the city centre.
items.zh: 她住在市中心一間滿小的公寓。

items.en: My son had quite a bad cold last week, but he's better now.
items.zh: 我兒子上禮拜感冒得滿嚴重的，不過現在好多了。

examples.heading: ⑥ rather + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: The interviewer asked me a rather personal question about my family.
items.zh: 面試官問了我一個有點私人的家庭問題。

items.en: They live in a rather old building.
items.zh: 他們住在一棟有點老舊的大樓裡。

items.en: He made a rather silly mistake in the final.
items.zh: 他在決賽犯了一個有點蠢的錯誤。

examples.heading: ⑦ 副詞 + 形容詞 + 複數名詞

items.en: There are really nice shops in the old town.
items.zh: 舊城區有很不錯的店。

items.en: My parents have very different opinions about money.
items.zh: 我爸媽對錢的看法非常不一樣。

items.en: These are extremely expensive shoes. Be careful with them.
items.zh: 這雙鞋超貴的，小心一點。

items.en: We met some incredibly friendly people on holiday.
items.zh: 我們度假時遇到一些超級友善的人。

examples.heading: ⑧ 名詞片語當主詞

items.en: A very old man helped me with my bags.
items.zh: 有位很老的先生幫我提了包包。

items.en: Really good teachers are hard to find.
items.zh: 真正好的老師很難找。

items.en: A pretty serious accident closed the motorway this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上一場滿嚴重的車禍讓高速公路封閉了。

items.en: Extremely cold weather is coming this weekend.
items.zh: 這個週末會非常冷。

title: They have little or no spare time to relax and recharge their batteries.
translation: 他們幾乎沒有空閒時間可以放鬆、充電。
name: little or no 加名詞
sentences: Many young doctors have little or no spare time to relax and recharge their batteries.
The new staff had little or no training before they started.
Most of the applicants have little or no experience in sales.
The village has little or no public transport.
Small shops have little or no chance against the big supermarkets.
He refused to act in big Hollywood films with little or no artistic value.
You can cook this dish with little or no oil.
The plants grow well with little or no water.
They built the house with little or no help from anyone.
Many people work long hours for little or no reward.
There is little or no chance of rain this weekend.
There was little or no traffic on the roads at that time.
There is little or no evidence that the drug works.
There's little or no difference between the two models.
The government paid little or no attention to the problem.
The rain caused little or no damage to the crops.
The changes will make little or no difference to most families.
The treatment produced little or no improvement.
The museum gets few or no visitors in winter.
There were few or no complaints about the new menu.
Some students ask few or no questions in class.
The island has few or no roads.
Little or no progress was possible without more money.
Families with little or no income need extra support.
Jobs with little or no security are common in this industry.
Children with little or no sleep find it hard to concentrate.
I came to London with little or no English.
She learned to drive with little or no fear.
They arrived with little or no idea of what to expect.
He started the business with little or no money.
Many volunteers have little or no medical knowledge.

examples.heading: ① have + little or no + 名詞

items.en: Many young doctors have little or no spare time to relax and recharge their batteries.
items.zh: 很多年輕醫生幾乎沒有空閒時間可以放鬆、充電。

items.en: The new staff had little or no training before they started.
items.zh: 新進員工開始工作前幾乎沒受過訓練。

items.en: Most of the applicants have little or no experience in sales.
items.zh: 大部分應徵者幾乎沒有業務經驗。

items.en: The village has little or no public transport.
items.zh: 那個村子幾乎沒有大眾運輸。

items.en: Small shops have little or no chance against the big supermarkets.
items.zh: 小商店跟大型超市比幾乎沒有勝算。

examples.heading: ② with + little or no + 名詞

items.en: He refused to act in big Hollywood films with little or no artistic value.
items.zh: 他拒絕演出那些幾乎沒有藝術價值的好萊塢大片。

items.en: You can cook this dish with little or no oil.
items.zh: 這道菜幾乎不用油就能煮。

items.en: The plants grow well with little or no water.
items.zh: 這些植物幾乎不用澆水也長得很好。

items.en: They built the house with little or no help from anyone.
items.zh: 他們幾乎沒靠任何人幫忙就蓋好了房子。

items.en: Many people work long hours for little or no reward.
items.zh: 很多人工作時間很長，卻幾乎沒有回報。

examples.heading: ③ there is + little or no + 名詞

items.en: There is little or no chance of rain this weekend.
items.zh: 這個週末幾乎不可能下雨。

items.en: There was little or no traffic on the roads at that time.
items.zh: 那個時間路上幾乎沒有車。

items.en: There is little or no evidence that the drug works.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有證據顯示這種藥有效。

items.en: There's little or no difference between the two models.
items.zh: 這兩款幾乎沒有差別。

examples.heading: ④ 動詞 + little or no + 名詞

items.en: The government paid little or no attention to the problem.
items.zh: 政府對這個問題幾乎不關心。

items.en: The rain caused little or no damage to the crops.
items.zh: 這場雨對作物幾乎沒有造成損害。

items.en: The changes will make little or no difference to most families.
items.zh: 這些改變對大部分家庭幾乎沒有影響。

items.en: The treatment produced little or no improvement.
items.zh: 這種治療幾乎沒有改善效果。

examples.heading: ⑤ few or no + 複數名詞

items.en: The museum gets few or no visitors in winter.
items.zh: 那間博物館冬天幾乎沒有訪客。

items.en: There were few or no complaints about the new menu.
items.zh: 新菜單幾乎沒有人抱怨。

items.en: Some students ask few or no questions in class.
items.zh: 有些學生上課時幾乎不問問題。

items.en: The island has few or no roads.
items.zh: 那座島上幾乎沒有道路。

examples.heading: ⑥ little or no + 名詞當主詞的一部分

items.en: Little or no progress was possible without more money.
items.zh: 沒有更多經費，幾乎不可能有任何進展。

items.en: Families with little or no income need extra support.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有收入的家庭需要額外的支援。

items.en: Jobs with little or no security are common in this industry.
items.zh: 這一行很常見幾乎沒有保障的工作。

items.en: Children with little or no sleep find it hard to concentrate.
items.zh: 幾乎沒睡覺的孩子很難專心。

examples.heading: ⑦ 描述經驗和能力

items.en: I came to London with little or no English.
items.zh: 我來倫敦的時候幾乎不會說英文。

items.en: She learned to drive with little or no fear.
items.zh: 她學開車的時候幾乎一點都不怕。

items.en: They arrived with little or no idea of what to expect.
items.zh: 他們到的時候幾乎不知道會遇到什麼。

items.en: He started the business with little or no money.
items.zh: 他幾乎沒有本錢就開始創業了。

items.en: Many volunteers have little or no medical knowledge.
items.zh: 很多志工幾乎沒有醫學知識。

title: My house is next to the bus stop.
translation: 我家就在公車站旁邊。
name: 複合名詞
sentences: My house is next to the bus stop, so I can get to work easily.
Our flat has three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
No TV until you finish your homework, OK?
I forgot my toothbrush, so I bought one at the airport.
Can you post this at the post office for me?
My dad watches football on TV every weekend.
She likes to go to the swimming pool and to the gym.
Our washing machine is broken again.
The kids are watching TV in the living room.
The dining room is next to the kitchen.
Don't forget your running shoes.
I buy all my food at the supermarket on the corner.
The teacher wrote the answer on the blackboard.
My sister starts high school in September.
My grandad grows tomatoes in his greenhouse every summer.
I need a new T-shirt for the trip.
My mother-in-law is coming for dinner.
Please go to the check-in desk with your passport.
There are three swimming pools in our town.
We need two bus tickets to the city centre.
All the bedrooms have a sea view.
My daughter keeps all her earrings in a little box.
There are seven rooms: three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and two bathrooms.
Put your schoolbag under your desk.
The classroom is on the first floor.
The children play in the playground at lunchtime.
Is there a car park near the station?
Go straight on and turn left at the second set of traffic lights.
The bus station is in the town centre.
My uncle will pick us up from the railway station at six.
Let's park at the shopping centre and walk to the cinema.

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + 名詞

items.en: My house is next to the bus stop, so I can get to work easily.
items.zh: 我家就在公車站旁邊，所以我上班很方便。

items.en: Our flat has three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
items.zh: 我們的公寓有三間臥室和兩間浴室。

items.en: No TV until you finish your homework, OK?
items.zh: 功課寫完之前不准看電視，知道嗎？

items.en: I forgot my toothbrush, so I bought one at the airport.
items.zh: 我忘了帶牙刷，所以在機場買了一支。

items.en: Can you post this at the post office for me?
items.zh: 你可以幫我到郵局寄這個嗎？

items.en: My dad watches football on TV every weekend.
items.zh: 我爸爸每個週末都看電視上的足球賽。

examples.heading: ② 動詞-ing + 名詞

items.en: She likes to go to the swimming pool and to the gym.
items.zh: 她喜歡去游泳池和健身房。

items.en: Our washing machine is broken again.
items.zh: 我們的洗衣機又壞了。

items.en: The kids are watching TV in the living room.
items.zh: 孩子們在客廳看電視。

items.en: The dining room is next to the kitchen.
items.zh: 餐廳在廚房旁邊。

items.en: Don't forget your running shoes.
items.zh: 別忘了帶你的跑鞋。

examples.heading: ③ 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: I buy all my food at the supermarket on the corner.
items.zh: 我所有的食物都在轉角那家超市買。

items.en: The teacher wrote the answer on the blackboard.
items.zh: 老師把答案寫在黑板上。

items.en: My sister starts high school in September.
items.zh: 我妹妹九月開始上高中。

items.en: My grandad grows tomatoes in his greenhouse every summer.
items.zh: 我爺爺每年夏天都在他的溫室裡種番茄。

examples.heading: ④ 用連字號的複合名詞

items.en: I need a new T-shirt for the trip.
items.zh: 我這趟旅行需要一件新的 T 恤。

items.en: My mother-in-law is coming for dinner.
items.zh: 我岳母要來吃晚餐。

items.en: Please go to the check-in desk with your passport.
items.zh: 請帶著您的護照到報到櫃台。

examples.heading: ⑤ 複合名詞的複數

items.en: There are three swimming pools in our town.
items.zh: 我們鎮上有三座游泳池。

items.en: We need two bus tickets to the city centre.
items.zh: 我們需要兩張到市中心的公車票。

items.en: All the bedrooms have a sea view.
items.zh: 所有的臥室都看得到海。

items.en: My daughter keeps all her earrings in a little box.
items.zh: 我女兒把她所有的耳環都放在一個小盒子裡。

examples.heading: ⑥ 家裡和學校的複合名詞

items.en: There are seven rooms: three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and two bathrooms.
items.zh: 有七個房間：三間臥室、一間客廳、一間廚房和兩間浴室。

items.en: Put your schoolbag under your desk.
items.zh: 把你的書包放在桌子底下。

items.en: The classroom is on the first floor.
items.zh: 教室在二樓。

items.en: The children play in the playground at lunchtime.
items.zh: 孩子們午餐時間在操場玩。

examples.heading: ⑦ 城市裡的複合名詞

items.en: Is there a car park near the station?
items.zh: 車站附近有停車場嗎？

items.en: Go straight on and turn left at the second set of traffic lights.
items.zh: 直走，在第二個紅綠燈左轉。

items.en: The bus station is in the town centre.
items.zh: 公車總站在市中心。

items.en: My uncle will pick us up from the railway station at six.
items.zh: 我叔叔六點會來火車站接我們。

items.en: Let's park at the shopping centre and walk to the cinema.
items.zh: 我們把車停在購物中心，再走去電影院。

title: I have a piece of news.
translation: 我有一個消息。
name: 單位詞表示不可數名詞的數量
sentences: Sit down. I have a piece of news for you.
You must bring two pencils, a rubber and a piece of paper.
Can I give you a piece of advice?
This old chair is my favourite piece of furniture.
Would you like a piece of cake?
We have to bring a bottle of water, trainers and a T-shirt.
I'd love a cup of tea, please.
Drink a glass of milk before bed.
He bought a box of chocolates for his mum.
Can you get me a can of lemonade from the fridge?
I had a slice of toast for breakfast.
The baker gave us a free loaf of bread because it was closing time.
She ate a whole bar of chocolate.
There's a sheet of paper on the printer.
I need a kilo of rice and a litre of milk.
Add two spoons of sugar.
We bought half a kilo of cheese.
We need two bottles of water for the trip.
I drink three cups of coffee a day.
Take some pieces of paper for your notes.
She ate two slices of pizza.
We need four loaves of bread for the party.
Can I have a bowl of soup and a glass of water, please?
Two cups of coffee and a piece of chocolate cake, please.
I'd like a bag of apples and a bunch of bananas.
How much is a bottle of olive oil?
A cup of tea always makes me feel better.
A piece of glass cut my foot on the beach.
Two bottles of milk are enough for the weekend.
A slice of cake costs three pounds.
A tube of toothpaste lasts us about a month.

examples.heading: ① a piece of + 名詞

items.en: Sit down. I have a piece of news for you.
items.zh: 坐下，我有一個消息要告訴你。

items.en: You must bring two pencils, a rubber and a piece of paper.
items.zh: 你得帶兩支鉛筆、一個橡皮擦和一張紙。

items.en: Can I give you a piece of advice?
items.zh: 我可以給你一個建議嗎？

items.en: This old chair is my favourite piece of furniture.
items.zh: 這張舊椅子是我最喜歡的家具。

items.en: Would you like a piece of cake?
items.zh: 你要吃一塊蛋糕嗎？

examples.heading: ② 容器 + of + 名詞

items.en: We have to bring a bottle of water, trainers and a T-shirt.
items.zh: 我們要帶一瓶水、運動鞋和一件 T 恤。

items.en: I'd love a cup of tea, please.
items.zh: 我好想喝杯茶。

items.en: Drink a glass of milk before bed.
items.zh: 睡前喝一杯牛奶。

items.en: He bought a box of chocolates for his mum.
items.zh: 他買了一盒巧克力給他媽媽。

items.en: Can you get me a can of lemonade from the fridge?
items.zh: 你可以從冰箱幫我拿一罐檸檬汽水嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 形狀和大小 + of + 名詞

items.en: I had a slice of toast for breakfast.
items.zh: 我早餐吃了一片吐司。

items.en: The baker gave us a free loaf of bread because it was closing time.
items.zh: 因為快打烊了，麵包師傅送了我們一條麵包。

items.en: She ate a whole bar of chocolate.
items.zh: 她吃了一整條巧克力。

items.en: There's a sheet of paper on the printer.
items.zh: 印表機上有一張紙。

examples.heading: ④ 重量和量 + of + 名詞

items.en: I need a kilo of rice and a litre of milk.
items.zh: 我需要一公斤米和一公升牛奶。

items.en: Add two spoons of sugar.
items.zh: 加兩匙糖。

items.en: We bought half a kilo of cheese.
items.zh: 我們買了半公斤起司。

examples.heading: ⑤ 數字 + 單位詞s + of + 名詞

items.en: We need two bottles of water for the trip.
items.zh: 我們這趟需要兩瓶水。

items.en: I drink three cups of coffee a day.
items.zh: 我一天喝三杯咖啡。

items.en: Take some pieces of paper for your notes.
items.zh: 拿幾張紙寫筆記。

items.en: She ate two slices of pizza.
items.zh: 她吃了兩片披薩。

items.en: We need four loaves of bread for the party.
items.zh: 派對需要四條麵包。

examples.heading: ⑥ 點餐和購物

items.en: Can I have a bowl of soup and a glass of water, please?
items.zh: 請給我一碗湯和一杯水。

items.en: Two cups of coffee and a piece of chocolate cake, please.
items.zh: 請給我兩杯咖啡和一塊巧克力蛋糕。

items.en: I'd like a bag of apples and a bunch of bananas.
items.zh: 我要一袋蘋果和一串香蕉。

items.en: How much is a bottle of olive oil?
items.zh: 一瓶橄欖油多少錢？

examples.heading: ⑦ 單位詞片語當主詞

items.en: A cup of tea always makes me feel better.
items.zh: 一杯茶總是讓我感覺好一點。

items.en: A piece of glass cut my foot on the beach.
items.zh: 海灘上一片玻璃割傷了我的腳。

items.en: Two bottles of milk are enough for the weekend.
items.zh: 兩瓶牛奶夠週末喝了。

items.en: A slice of cake costs three pounds.
items.zh: 一片蛋糕三英鎊。

items.en: A tube of toothpaste lasts us about a month.
items.zh: 一條牙膏我們大概可以用一個月。

title: Her favorite colors are blue and black.
translation: 她最喜歡的顏色是藍色和黑色。
name: 限定詞加形容詞加名詞的名詞片語

My grandad drives an old car, but it never breaks down.
I'd like a hot chocolate, please.
My cousin has a new baby. She's beautiful.
Take an extra jumper. It's cold up the mountain.
It was a long day, so I went to bed early.
Can I try the black jacket in the window?
The new teacher is very nice. She plays games with us.
Let's sit at the big table by the door.
The cheap tickets are all gone, sorry.
Martin is my best friend. We've known each other since we were five.
Have you seen my blue scarf? I can't find it anywhere.
Their new flat is very close to the station.
His little sister is starting school next week.
Our old car broke down on the motorway yesterday.
This red dress is lovely. How much is it?
That tall man over there is my uncle.
These new shoes hurt my feet.
Who are those young people outside the shop?
Her favorite colors are blue and black, so she bought the black bag.
The small rooms are cheaper, but they don't have a bathroom.
My new neighbours invited us for dinner on Saturday.
I gave all my old toys to my little cousins.
Those white flowers smell really nice.
She's an excellent cook. You must try her soup.
We stayed in an expensive hotel near the beach.
Don't worry about tomorrow. It's an easy exam, and you've studied a lot.
He's a friendly dog. Don't worry.
I bought a warm coat for the winter.
Dad, can we get a white kitten from the shelter?
She wants a quiet room at the back of the hotel.

examples.heading: ① a / an + 形容詞 + 單數名詞

items.en: We've got a big garden and a small swimming pool.
items.zh: 我們有一個大院子和一個小游泳池。

items.en: My grandad drives an old car, but it never breaks down.
items.zh: 我爺爺開一台舊車，可是那台車從來沒壞過。

items.en: I'd like a hot chocolate, please.
items.zh: 請給我一杯熱巧克力。

items.en: My cousin has a new baby. She's beautiful.
items.zh: 我表姊生了一個小寶寶，好可愛。

items.en: Take an extra jumper. It's cold up the mountain.
items.zh: 多帶一件毛衣。山上很冷。

items.en: It was a long day, so I went to bed early.
items.zh: 今天好漫長，所以我很早就睡了。

examples.heading: ② the + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: Can I try the black jacket in the window?
items.zh: 我可以試穿櫥窗裡那件黑色夾克嗎？

items.en: The new teacher is very nice. She plays games with us.
items.zh: 新老師人很好，她會跟我們玩遊戲。

items.en: Let's sit at the big table by the door.
items.zh: 我們坐門邊那張大桌子吧。

items.en: The cheap tickets are all gone, sorry.
items.zh: 抱歉，便宜的票都賣完了。

examples.heading: ③ 所有格限定詞 + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: Martin is my best friend. We've known each other since we were five.
items.zh: Martin 是我最好的朋友。我們五歲就認識了。

items.en: Have you seen my blue scarf? I can't find it anywhere.
items.zh: 你有看到我的藍色圍巾嗎？我到處都找不到。

items.en: Their new flat is very close to the station.
items.zh: 他們的新公寓離車站很近。

items.en: His little sister is starting school next week.
items.zh: 他妹妹下禮拜開始上學。

items.en: Our old car broke down on the motorway yesterday.
items.zh: 我們的舊車昨天在高速公路上拋錨了。

examples.heading: ④ this / that / these / those + 形容詞 + 名詞

items.en: This red dress is lovely. How much is it?
items.zh: 這件紅洋裝好漂亮，多少錢？

items.en: That tall man over there is my uncle.
items.zh: 那邊那個高高的男人是我叔叔。

items.en: These new shoes hurt my feet.
items.zh: 這雙新鞋把我的腳磨得好痛。

items.en: Who are those young people outside the shop?
items.zh: 店門外那些年輕人是誰？

examples.heading: ⑤ 形容詞 + 複數名詞，前面有限定詞

items.en: Her favorite colors are blue and black, so she bought the black bag.
items.zh: 她最喜歡的顏色是藍色和黑色，所以她買了那個黑色包包。

items.en: The small rooms are cheaper, but they don't have a bathroom.
items.zh: 小房間比較便宜，不過沒有浴室。

items.en: My new neighbours invited us for dinner on Saturday.
items.zh: 我的新鄰居星期六請我們去吃晚餐。

items.en: I gave all my old toys to my little cousins.
items.zh: 我把舊玩具全部送給我的小表弟妹們了。

items.en: Those white flowers smell really nice.
items.zh: 那些白花好香。

examples.heading: ⑥ a / an 看形容詞的發音

items.en: She's an excellent cook. You must try her soup.
items.zh: 她很會做菜。你一定要嚐嚐她煮的湯。

items.en: We stayed in an expensive hotel near the beach.
items.zh: 我們住在海灘附近一家很貴的飯店。

items.en: Don't worry about tomorrow. It's an easy exam, and you've studied a lot.
items.zh: 別擔心明天。那是很簡單的考試，而且你讀了很多。

items.en: He's a friendly dog. Don't worry.
items.zh: 牠是一隻很友善的狗，別擔心。

examples.heading: ⑦ 名詞片語當受詞

items.en: I bought a warm coat for the winter.
items.zh: 我買了一件過冬的保暖外套。

items.en: Dad, can we get a white kitten from the shelter?
items.zh: 爸，我們可以去收容所領養一隻白色小貓嗎？

items.en: She wants a quiet room at the back of the hotel.
items.zh: 她想要飯店後面一間安靜的房間。

title: My husband is a teacher.
translation: 我先生是老師。
name: 限定詞加名詞的名詞片語
sentences: Look, there's a cat on our car again.
My brother works in a bank in the city centre.
Can I have an orange juice, please?
We need an umbrella today. It's going to rain.
My daughter wants a bike for her birthday.
The bathroom is on the left, next to the kitchen.
Can you close the window? It's cold in here.
The children are in the garden with their dad.
Excuse me, is the post office open on Saturday afternoons?
My mum is a nurse at the hospital.
What's your phone number? I'll call you tonight.
Her parents live in a small village by the sea.
Our teacher gives us homework every day.
The neighbours are on holiday, and their dog is staying with us.
His sister plays the guitar in a band.
This bag is very heavy. Can you help me?
Mum, who's that woman in the blue coat?
I want to buy this book. How much is it?
That restaurant across the road is very good.
These apples are from my grandma's garden.
Are those keys yours? They were on the table.
I love these photos of your trip.
Those boys are in my class.
My husband is a teacher at a primary school.
Our flat is near the station.
Your brother is a really good cook.
That's why I like this place.
The shops close at six on Sundays here.
My friends are coming for dinner tonight.
Please put your bags under the seats.
Their children go to the same school as my son.

examples.heading: ① a / an + 單數名詞

items.en: Look, there's a cat on our car again.
items.zh: 你看，又有一隻貓在我們的車上。

items.en: My brother works in a bank in the city centre.
items.zh: 我哥哥在市中心的一家銀行上班。

items.en: Can I have an orange juice, please?
items.zh: 請給我一杯柳橙汁。

items.en: We need an umbrella today. It's going to rain.
items.zh: 我們今天要帶傘，會下雨。

items.en: My daughter wants a bike for her birthday.
items.zh: 我女兒生日想要一台腳踏車。

examples.heading: ② the + 名詞

items.en: The bathroom is on the left, next to the kitchen.
items.zh: 浴室在左邊，廚房旁邊。

items.en: Can you close the window? It's cold in here.
items.zh: 你可以關一下窗戶嗎？這裡好冷。

items.en: The children are in the garden with their dad.
items.zh: 孩子們跟他們的爸爸在院子裡。

items.en: Excuse me, is the post office open on Saturday afternoons?
items.zh: 不好意思，郵局星期六下午有開嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 所有格限定詞 + 名詞

items.en: My mum is a nurse at the hospital.
items.zh: 我媽媽是那家醫院的護士。

items.en: What's your phone number? I'll call you tonight.
items.zh: 你的電話號碼是多少？我今晚打給你。

items.en: Her parents live in a small village by the sea.
items.zh: 她爸媽住在海邊的一個小村子。

items.en: Our teacher gives us homework every day.
items.zh: 我們老師每天都出功課給我們。

items.en: The neighbours are on holiday, and their dog is staying with us.
items.zh: 鄰居去度假了，他們的狗住在我們家。

items.en: His sister plays the guitar in a band.
items.zh: 他姊姊在一個樂團彈吉他。

examples.heading: ④ this / that + 單數名詞

items.en: This bag is very heavy. Can you help me?
items.zh: 這個袋子好重。你可以幫我一下嗎？

items.en: Mum, who's that woman in the blue coat?
items.zh: 媽，那個穿藍色大衣的女人是誰？

items.en: I want to buy this book. How much is it?
items.zh: 我想買這本書。多少錢？

items.en: That restaurant across the road is very good.
items.zh: 對面那家餐廳很好吃。

examples.heading: ⑤ these / those + 複數名詞

items.en: These apples are from my grandma's garden.
items.zh: 這些蘋果是我奶奶院子裡種的。

items.en: Are those keys yours? They were on the table.
items.zh: 那些鑰匙是你的嗎？剛剛放在桌上。

items.en: I love these photos of your trip.
items.zh: 我很喜歡你旅行的這些照片。

items.en: Those boys are in my class.
items.zh: 那幾個男生跟我同班。

examples.heading: ⑥ 名詞片語當主詞和補語

items.en: My husband is a teacher at a primary school.
items.zh: 我先生是小學老師。

items.en: Our flat is near the station.
items.zh: 我們的公寓在車站附近。

items.en: Your brother is a really good cook.
items.zh: 你哥哥很會做菜。

items.en: That's why I like this place.
items.zh: 所以我才喜歡這個地方。

examples.heading: ⑦ 複數名詞前面的 the 和所有格限定詞

items.en: The shops close at six on Sundays here.
items.zh: 這裡的商店星期天六點就關門了。

items.en: My friends are coming for dinner tonight.
items.zh: 我朋友今晚要來吃晚餐。

items.en: Please put your bags under the seats.
items.zh: 請把你們的包包放在座位下面。

items.en: Their children go to the same school as my son.
items.zh: 他們的孩子跟我兒子上同一所學校。

title: I visited a lot of museums, and I went shopping.
translation: 我參觀了很多博物館，也去逛了街。
name: 限定詞修飾名詞（較多種限定詞）
sentences: In Paris I visited a lot of museums, and I went shopping.
There are lots of good restaurants near the hotel.
My sister drinks a lot of coffee when she has exams.
We had lots of fun at your party. Thanks!
There are so many shops here. Where do you want to start?
I've got too many things in my bag. It won't close.
So many people came to the concert that we couldn't see the stage.
You ate too many sweets. No wonder you feel sick.
I had so much fun at the beach today!
I spent too much money, but I don't mind because the shoes are beautiful.
Don't put so much salt in the soup.
We wasted too much time at the airport.
How many brothers and sisters have you got?
I only know a few people in this town.
We stayed in several hotels during our trip.
Can you wait a few minutes? I'm nearly ready.
Hurry up! We haven't got much time before the film starts.
Just a little milk in my tea, please.
Did you have much rain on holiday?
There's a little bread left. Do you want it?
I go to college every day by bus.
Each room has its own bathroom.
Can I have another piece of cake? It's really good.
The teacher gave each student a book.
Both my grandparents still live in the village where they grew up.
Some people like the city, but other people prefer the countryside.
Sorry, there are no tickets left for tonight.
I've got no money until Friday.
I have a few friends at school, but my brother has lots of friends.
We don't need much bread. We still have a little bread from yesterday.
Every child gets a present, and some children get two.

examples.heading: ① a lot of / lots of + 名詞

items.en: In Paris I visited a lot of museums, and I went shopping.
items.zh: 我在巴黎參觀了很多博物館，也去逛了街。

items.en: There are lots of good restaurants near the hotel.
items.zh: 飯店附近有很多不錯的餐廳。

items.en: My sister drinks a lot of coffee when she has exams.
items.zh: 我姊姊考試的時候會喝很多咖啡。

items.en: We had lots of fun at your party. Thanks!
items.zh: 我們在你的派對上玩得很開心。謝謝！

examples.heading: ② so many / too many + 複數名詞

items.en: There are so many shops here. Where do you want to start?
items.zh: 這裡有好多店。你想從哪裡開始逛？

items.en: I've got too many things in my bag. It won't close.
items.zh: 我包包裡東西太多了，拉不起來。

items.en: So many people came to the concert that we couldn't see the stage.
items.zh: 來聽演唱會的人多到我們看不到舞台。

items.en: You ate too many sweets. No wonder you feel sick.
items.zh: 你吃了太多糖果，難怪你會想吐。

examples.heading: ③ so much / too much + 不可數名詞

items.en: I had so much fun at the beach today!
items.zh: 我今天在海邊玩得好開心！

items.en: I spent too much money, but I don't mind because the shoes are beautiful.
items.zh: 我花了太多錢，可是我不在乎，因為那雙鞋很漂亮。

items.en: Don't put so much salt in the soup.
items.zh: 湯裡別放那麼多鹽。

items.en: We wasted too much time at the airport.
items.zh: 我們在機場浪費了太多時間。

examples.heading: ④ many / a few / several + 複數名詞

items.en: How many brothers and sisters have you got?
items.zh: 你有幾個兄弟姊妹？

items.en: I only know a few people in this town.
items.zh: 我在這個鎮上只認識幾個人。

items.en: We stayed in several hotels during our trip.
items.zh: 我們旅行時住了好幾家飯店。

items.en: Can you wait a few minutes? I'm nearly ready.
items.zh: 你可以等幾分鐘嗎？我快好了。

examples.heading: ⑤ much / a little + 不可數名詞

items.en: Hurry up! We haven't got much time before the film starts.
items.zh: 快點！電影快開始了，我們沒剩多少時間。

items.en: Just a little milk in my tea, please.
items.zh: 我的茶裡加一點點牛奶就好。

items.en: Did you have much rain on holiday?
items.zh: 你們度假的時候常下雨嗎？

items.en: There's a little bread left. Do you want it?
items.zh: 還剩一點麵包，你要吃嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ every / each / another + 單數名詞

items.en: I go to college every day by bus.
items.zh: 我每天搭公車去學院上課。

items.en: Each room has its own bathroom.
items.zh: 每個房間都有自己的浴室。

items.en: Can I have another piece of cake? It's really good.
items.zh: 我可以再吃一塊蛋糕嗎？真的很好吃。

items.en: The teacher gave each student a book.
items.zh: 老師給每個學生一本書。

examples.heading: ⑦ both / other / no + 名詞

items.en: Both my grandparents still live in the village where they grew up.
items.zh: 我的祖父母兩個人都還住在他們長大的那個村子。

items.en: Some people like the city, but other people prefer the countryside.
items.zh: 有些人喜歡城市，可是也有人比較喜歡鄉下。

items.en: Sorry, there are no tickets left for tonight.
items.zh: 抱歉，今晚的票都賣完了。

items.en: I've got no money until Friday.
items.zh: 我到星期五之前都沒錢了。

examples.heading: ⑧ 不同的限定詞，同一個名詞

items.en: I have a few friends at school, but my brother has lots of friends.
items.zh: 我在學校有幾個朋友，可是我弟弟有很多朋友。

items.en: We don't need much bread. We still have a little bread from yesterday.
items.zh: 我們不需要很多麵包，昨天的麵包還剩一點。

items.en: Every child gets a present, and some children get two.
items.zh: 每個小朋友都有一份禮物，有些小朋友還拿到兩份。

title: The food was delicious, and the music was great.
translation: 食物很好吃，音樂也很棒。
name: 限定詞加不可數名詞構成名詞片語

This information is not correct.

examples.heading: ① the + 不可數名詞

items.en: We loved the party. The food was delicious, and the music was great.
items.zh: 我們很喜歡那場派對。食物很好吃，音樂也很棒。

items.en: The weather was so cold that we stayed inside all day.
items.zh: 天氣冷到我們整天都待在室內。

items.en: Mum, the rice is burning! Come quickly!
items.zh: 媽，飯燒焦了！快來！

items.en: The coffee in this café is really strong.
items.zh: 這家咖啡店的咖啡很濃。

items.en: Don't drink the water from that tap.
items.zh: 別喝那個水龍頭的水。

examples.heading: ② 所有格限定詞 + 不可數名詞

items.en: I left my homework on the bus.
items.zh: 我把功課忘在公車上了。

items.en: Is this your money on the floor?
items.zh: 地上這些錢是你的嗎？

items.en: Her hair is much longer now.
items.zh: 她的頭髮現在長多了。

items.en: Our luggage is still at the airport.
items.zh: 我們的行李還在機場。

items.en: Their coffee is the best in town. Let's go there.
items.zh: 他們的咖啡是城裡最好喝的。我們去那裡吧。

examples.heading: ③ this / that + 不可數名詞

items.en: This bread is still warm from the oven.
items.zh: 這個麵包剛出爐，還是溫的。

items.en: Where did you get that furniture? It looks great.
items.zh: 那些家具你在哪裡買的？看起來好棒。

items.en: This milk smells bad. When did you buy it?
items.zh: 這牛奶有怪味。你什麼時候買的？

items.en: I love that music. Who's singing?
items.zh: 我好喜歡那首音樂。是誰在唱？

examples.heading: ④ some + 不可數名詞

items.en: Would you like some tea?
items.zh: 你要不要來點茶？

items.en: I need some help with my bags.
items.zh: 我需要人幫我拿一下包包。

items.en: Let's get some bread on the way home.
items.zh: 回家的路上買點麵包吧。

items.en: She put some sugar in my coffee by mistake.
items.zh: 她不小心在我的咖啡裡加了糖。

examples.heading: ⑤ any + 不可數名詞

items.en: Have you got any money? I left my wallet at home.
items.zh: 你身上有錢嗎？我把錢包忘在家裡了。

items.en: We haven't got any milk. Can you buy some?
items.zh: 我們沒有牛奶了。你可以去買一點嗎？

items.en: Is there any news from your sister?
items.zh: 你姊姊有消息了嗎？

items.en: I don't have any time today. Can we meet tomorrow?
items.zh: 我今天完全沒空。我們明天見好嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ more + 不可數名詞

items.en: I phoned for more information two days ago, but nobody called back.
items.zh: 我兩天前打電話去問更多資訊，可是沒人回電。

items.en: Can I have more rice, please?
items.zh: 可以再給我一點飯嗎？

items.en: You need more sleep. You look tired.
items.zh: 你需要多睡一點。你看起來很累。

items.en: We need more paper for the printer.
items.zh: 印表機需要再加紙。

examples.heading: ⑦ 不可數名詞當主詞，動詞用單數

items.en: The news is on at nine.
items.zh: 新聞九點播。

items.en: Sorry, madam, your luggage is over the weight limit.
items.zh: 女士，不好意思，您的行李超重了。

items.en: Sorry I'm late. The traffic on the bridge was awful.
items.zh: 抱歉我遲到了。橋上塞車塞得很嚴重。

items.en: This information is not correct.
items.zh: 這個資訊不正確。

items.en: Thanks, Grandma. Your advice always helps me.
items.zh: 謝謝奶奶。妳的建議總是幫得上我。

title: He is a friend of my husband.
translation: 他是我先生的朋友。
name: a friend of 加所有格限定詞和名詞
sentences: Don't worry about the man at the door. He's a friend of my husband.
Is she a friend of your sister?
I got the job through a friend of my mum.
A friend of my brother is coming to stay for a week.
A friend of my dad fixed our roof.
She met him at a party. He was a friend of her cousin.
He's staying with a friend of his uncle in Rome.
The boy who called is a friend of their son.
A friend of her grandmother taught her to knit.
I just thought they were friends of my neighbour who were going to visit him.
We had dinner with some friends of my parents.
Are they friends of your daughter?
Two friends of my wife are coming to the wedding.
Some friends of our son came over to play.
She's a friend of my best friend.
He's a friend of my sister's boyfriend.
A friend of my old teacher wrote this book.
I met a friend of your new flatmate yesterday.
This is Laura. She's a friend of my brother.
Everyone, this is Jack, a friend of my husband from work.
Hi, I'm Ben. I'm a friend of your son.
Let me introduce Mr Patel. He's a friend of my father.
A friend of my aunt owns this restaurant.
Friends of my parents gave us this sofa.
A friend of my son broke the window.
A friend of my teacher works at the museum.
I sold my bike to a friend of my brother.
She's going out with a friend of her cousin.
We stayed with friends of my wife in Spain.
Do you know any friends of her husband?
I borrowed the tent from a friend of my dad.

examples.heading: ① a friend of my / your + 名詞

items.en: Don't worry about the man at the door. He's a friend of my husband.
items.zh: 別擔心門口那個男人，他是我先生的朋友。

items.en: Is she a friend of your sister?
items.zh: 她是你姊姊的朋友嗎？

items.en: I got the job through a friend of my mum.
items.zh: 我透過我媽媽的一個朋友得到這份工作。

items.en: A friend of my brother is coming to stay for a week.
items.zh: 我哥哥的一個朋友要來住一個禮拜。

items.en: A friend of my dad fixed our roof.
items.zh: 我爸的一個朋友幫我們修了屋頂。

examples.heading: ② a friend of his / her / their + 名詞

items.en: She met him at a party. He was a friend of her cousin.
items.zh: 她是在一個派對上認識他的，他是她表哥的朋友。

items.en: He's staying with a friend of his uncle in Rome.
items.zh: 他住在羅馬，住在他叔叔的一個朋友家。

items.en: The boy who called is a friend of their son.
items.zh: 打電話來的男孩是他們兒子的朋友。

items.en: A friend of her grandmother taught her to knit.
items.zh: 她奶奶的一個朋友教她織毛線。

examples.heading: ③ friends of + 所有格限定詞 + 名詞

items.en: I just thought they were friends of my neighbour who were going to visit him.
items.zh: 我只以為他們是我鄰居的朋友，要來拜訪他。

items.en: We had dinner with some friends of my parents.
items.zh: 我們跟我爸媽的幾個朋友吃了晚餐。

items.en: Are they friends of your daughter?
items.zh: 他們是你女兒的朋友嗎？

items.en: Two friends of my wife are coming to the wedding.
items.zh: 我太太的兩個朋友要來參加婚禮。

items.en: Some friends of our son came over to play.
items.zh: 我們兒子的幾個朋友來家裡玩。

examples.heading: ④ a friend of + 較長的名詞片語

items.en: She's a friend of my best friend.
items.zh: 她是我最好朋友的朋友。

items.en: He's a friend of my sister's boyfriend.
items.zh: 他是我姊姊男朋友的朋友。

items.en: A friend of my old teacher wrote this book.
items.zh: 我以前老師的一個朋友寫了這本書。

items.en: I met a friend of your new flatmate yesterday.
items.zh: 我昨天遇到你新室友的一個朋友。

examples.heading: ⑤ 介紹別人

items.en: This is Laura. She's a friend of my brother.
items.zh: 這是 Laura，她是我哥哥的朋友。

items.en: Everyone, this is Jack, a friend of my husband from work.
items.zh: 各位，這是 Jack，我先生工作上的朋友。

items.en: Hi, I'm Ben. I'm a friend of your son.
items.zh: 嗨，我是 Ben，我是你兒子的朋友。

items.en: Let me introduce Mr Patel. He's a friend of my father.
items.zh: 讓我介紹 Patel 先生，他是我爸爸的朋友。

examples.heading: ⑥ 名詞片語當主詞

items.en: A friend of my aunt owns this restaurant.
items.zh: 我阿姨的一個朋友是這家餐廳的老闆。

items.en: Friends of my parents gave us this sofa.
items.zh: 我爸媽的朋友送了我們這張沙發。

items.en: A friend of my son broke the window.
items.zh: 我兒子的一個朋友打破了窗戶。

items.en: A friend of my teacher works at the museum.
items.zh: 我老師的一個朋友在博物館工作。

examples.heading: ⑦ 名詞片語當受詞或在介系詞後面

items.en: I sold my bike to a friend of my brother.
items.zh: 我把腳踏車賣給我哥哥的一個朋友了。

items.en: She's going out with a friend of her cousin.
items.zh: 她在跟她表哥的一個朋友交往。

items.en: We stayed with friends of my wife in Spain.
items.zh: 我們在西班牙住在我太太的朋友家。

items.en: Do you know any friends of her husband?
items.zh: 你認識她先生的朋友嗎？

items.en: I borrowed the tent from a friend of my dad.
items.zh: 我跟我爸的一個朋友借了帳篷。

title: There is something important I want to tell you.
translation: 我有件重要的事想跟你說。
name: 不定代名詞加形容詞或子句
sentences: Come here. There is something important I want to tell you.
We see each other every day and always do something different.
You look happy. Did something exciting happen at school?
Let's go somewhere quiet. It's too noisy here.
I met someone famous on the train today!
There's nothing wrong with your phone. It just needs charging.
It's a long drive. Take something to eat in the car.
I need someone to look after my cat next week.
Have you got anything to read on the plane?
Let's take the bus. There's never anywhere to park in the town centre.
I've got nothing to wear to the party!
But then there is nothing special to eat.
I'd like something hot to drink, please.
We're looking for somewhere cheap to stay.
She wants someone new to talk to.
Is there anyone who can help me with these boxes?
Everything I cooked was gone in ten minutes.
I didn't understand anything he said.
Before I start cooking, is there anything your kids don't like?
Someone who works with my dad lives in your street.
I've got something special that I want to show you.
There's nothing new I can tell you.
Is there anything good you want to watch tonight?
She's someone important who works for the government.
Everyone in my class is really friendly.
Nobody was at home when I called.
Everything in this shop is half price today.
Nothing interesting happened at work today.
Do you know anyone good at maths?
These shoes hurt, and I haven't got anything comfortable for the long walk tomorrow.
Did anybody interesting come to the meeting?

examples.heading: ① 不定代名詞 + 形容詞

items.en: Come here. There is something important I want to tell you.
items.zh: 過來一下，我有件重要的事想跟你說。

items.en: We see each other every day and always do something different.
items.zh: 我們每天見面，每次都做不一樣的事。

items.en: You look happy. Did something exciting happen at school?
items.zh: 你看起來好開心，學校發生了什麼好玩的事嗎？

items.en: Let's go somewhere quiet. It's too noisy here.
items.zh: 我們去個安靜的地方吧，這裡太吵了。

items.en: I met someone famous on the train today!
items.zh: 我今天在火車上遇到一個名人！

items.en: There's nothing wrong with your phone. It just needs charging.
items.zh: 你的手機沒壞，只是需要充電。

examples.heading: ② 不定代名詞 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: It's a long drive. Take something to eat in the car.
items.zh: 路程很長，帶點東西在車上吃。

items.en: I need someone to look after my cat next week.
items.zh: 我下禮拜需要有人幫我照顧貓。

items.en: Have you got anything to read on the plane?
items.zh: 你有帶什麼可以在飛機上看的東西嗎？

items.en: Let's take the bus. There's never anywhere to park in the town centre.
items.zh: 我們搭公車吧，市中心永遠找不到地方停車。

items.en: I've got nothing to wear to the party!
items.zh: 我沒有衣服可以穿去派對！

examples.heading: ③ 不定代名詞 + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: But then there is nothing special to eat.
items.zh: 可是那裡也沒什麼特別的東西可以吃。

items.en: I'd like something hot to drink, please.
items.zh: 請給我一杯熱飲。

items.en: We're looking for somewhere cheap to stay.
items.zh: 我們在找便宜的地方住。

items.en: She wants someone new to talk to.
items.zh: 她想找個新朋友聊天。

examples.heading: ④ 不定代名詞 + 關係子句

items.en: Is there anyone who can help me with these boxes?
items.zh: 有沒有人可以幫我搬這些箱子？

items.en: Everything I cooked was gone in ten minutes.
items.zh: 我煮的東西十分鐘就被吃光了。

items.en: I didn't understand anything he said.
items.zh: 他說的我一句都聽不懂。

items.en: Before I start cooking, is there anything your kids don't like?
items.zh: 我開始煮之前想問一下，你的孩子有什麼不喜歡吃的嗎？

items.en: Someone who works with my dad lives in your street.
items.zh: 跟我爸一起工作的一個人住在你們那條街。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不定代名詞 + 形容詞 + 子句

items.en: I've got something special that I want to show you.
items.zh: 我有個特別的東西想給你看。

items.en: There's nothing new I can tell you.
items.zh: 我沒有什麼新消息可以告訴你。

items.en: Is there anything good you want to watch tonight?
items.zh: 你今晚有什麼好看的想看嗎？

items.en: She's someone important who works for the government.
items.zh: 她是在政府工作的重要人物。

examples.heading: ⑥ every- 和 no- 當主詞

items.en: Everyone in my class is really friendly.
items.zh: 我們班上每個人都很友善。

items.en: Nobody was at home when I called.
items.zh: 我打電話的時候家裡沒人。

items.en: Everything in this shop is half price today.
items.zh: 這家店今天全部半價。

items.en: Nothing interesting happened at work today.
items.zh: 今天上班沒發生什麼有趣的事。

examples.heading: ⑦ 疑問句和否定句裡的 any-

items.en: Do you know anyone good at maths?
items.zh: 你認識數學好的人嗎？

items.en: These shoes hurt, and I haven't got anything comfortable for the long walk tomorrow.
items.zh: 這雙鞋好痛，可是我沒有舒服的鞋可以穿去明天的長途健行。

items.en: Did anybody interesting come to the meeting?
items.zh: 會議有什麼有意思的人來嗎？

title: Teaching is terribly challenging and demanding.
translation: 教書非常有挑戰性，也非常吃力。
name: 動詞-ing 當抽象名詞
sentences: I love my students, but teaching is terribly challenging and demanding.
Advertising seems to be very important to promote a new product.
Nursing is a hard job, but it's very rewarding.
He left banking to open a small bakery.
My daughter wants to study engineering at university.
Learning English has its rewards too.
Good training makes new staff more confident.
Parenting is the hardest job in the world.
Online learning became very popular in 2020.
Housing in the city centre is very expensive.
Public spending on schools has gone up this year.
The museum depends on private funding.
Online shopping has changed the way we live.
Effective teaching needs good planning.
Careful listening is an important skill for doctors.
Clear writing makes a report easy to read.
Regular cleaning keeps the machine working well.
The teaching of languages starts at primary school.
The building of the new bridge took three years.
The planning of the event was excellent.
The opening of the new library is next week.
She wants a career in nursing.
He has twenty years of experience in marketing.
I'm interested in a job in publishing.
There's a lot of money in advertising.
Many young people choose teaching because they love children.
The government should improve housing for families.
We need better funding for research.
My parents never understood my love of acting.
The company is cutting spending this year.
She gave up nursing after twenty years.

examples.heading: ① 行業和工作

items.en: I love my students, but teaching is terribly challenging and demanding.
items.zh: 我很愛我的學生，可是教書非常有挑戰性，也非常吃力。

items.en: Advertising seems to be very important to promote a new product.
items.zh: 要推廣新產品，廣告似乎非常重要。

items.en: Nursing is a hard job, but it's very rewarding.
items.zh: 護理是很辛苦的工作，但是很有成就感。

items.en: He left banking to open a small bakery.
items.zh: 他離開銀行業，開了一家小麵包店。

items.en: My daughter wants to study engineering at university.
items.zh: 我女兒想在大學讀工程。

examples.heading: ② 學習和成長

items.en: Learning English has its rewards too.
items.zh: 學英文也有它的收穫。

items.en: Good training makes new staff more confident.
items.zh: 好的訓練讓新員工更有自信。

items.en: Parenting is the hardest job in the world.
items.zh: 當父母是世界上最難的工作。

items.en: Online learning became very popular in 2020.
items.zh: 線上學習在 2020 年變得很普遍。

examples.heading: ③ 生活和社會

items.en: Housing in the city centre is very expensive.
items.zh: 市中心的住房很貴。

items.en: Public spending on schools has gone up this year.
items.zh: 今年公共教育支出增加了。

items.en: The museum depends on private funding.
items.zh: 這座博物館靠私人資助。

items.en: Online shopping has changed the way we live.
items.zh: 網路購物改變了我們的生活方式。

examples.heading: ④ 形容詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: Effective teaching needs good planning.
items.zh: 有效的教學需要好的規劃。

items.en: Careful listening is an important skill for doctors.
items.zh: 仔細聆聽是醫生很重要的技能。

items.en: Clear writing makes a report easy to read.
items.zh: 清楚的寫作讓報告容易閱讀。

items.en: Regular cleaning keeps the machine working well.
items.zh: 定期清潔讓機器運作順暢。

examples.heading: ⑤ the + 動詞-ing + of + 名詞

items.en: The teaching of languages starts at primary school.
items.zh: 語言教學從小學就開始。

items.en: The building of the new bridge took three years.
items.zh: 新橋的建造花了三年。

items.en: The planning of the event was excellent.
items.zh: 這次活動的規劃很出色。

items.en: The opening of the new library is next week.
items.zh: 新圖書館下禮拜開幕。

examples.heading: ⑥ 介系詞 + 動詞-ing 抽象名詞

items.en: She wants a career in nursing.
items.zh: 她想從事護理工作。

items.en: He has twenty years of experience in marketing.
items.zh: 他有二十年的行銷經驗。

items.en: I'm interested in a job in publishing.
items.zh: 我對出版業的工作有興趣。

items.en: There's a lot of money in advertising.
items.zh: 廣告業很賺錢。

examples.heading: ⑦ 動詞-ing 抽象名詞當受詞

items.zh: 很多年輕人選擇教書，因為他們喜歡小孩。

items.en: The government should improve housing for families.
items.zh: 政府應該改善家庭的住房。

items.en: We need better funding for research.
items.zh: 我們需要更多的研究經費。

items.en: My parents never understood my love of acting.
items.zh: 我爸媽從來不懂我為什麼那麼愛演戲。

items.en: The company is cutting spending this year.
items.zh: 公司今年在削減支出。

items.en: She gave up nursing after twenty years.
items.zh: 她做了二十年護理後就不做了。

title: I practiced windsurfing and scuba diving.
translation: 我練習了風帆衝浪和水肺潛水。
name: 動詞-ing 當受詞
sentences: On holiday I practiced windsurfing and scuba diving every day.
My grandad spends hours in the garden because he loves gardening.
Do you enjoy cooking?
My son likes drawing animals.
We really enjoyed sailing around the islands.
I prefer dancing, but on Saturday I'd like to go to a jazz concert.
I'll do the cooking if you do the ironing. I hate ironing!
Do you prefer walking or cycling to work?
My husband hates waiting in queues.
My mum started learning Italian when she retired.
It stopped raining, so we went outside.
Have you finished packing your suitcase?
Our new puppy started barking as soon as we left the house.
We went shopping in town on Saturday.
Let's go swimming after work.
They go skiing in the Alps every winter.
My parents went dancing on their anniversary.
There we did a lot of things, like swimming from the beach and going shopping.
My little brother is brilliant at telling jokes.
I'm interested in learning Spanish.
Thanks for helping me with my bags.
My uncle always takes the train because he's afraid of flying.
My daughter enjoys playing the piano.
I love watching old films on Sunday afternoons.
Tell me when you've finished using the laptop.
He started taking the bus to work.
In my free time I like reading and listening to music.
I practice speaking and writing every day.
The kids love running and jumping in the garden.
My mum enjoys knitting and baking.
We love walking and cycling in the hills.

examples.heading: ① like / love / enjoy + 動詞-ing

items.en: On holiday I practiced windsurfing and scuba diving every day.
items.zh: 我度假的時候每天都練習風帆衝浪和水肺潛水。

items.en: My grandad spends hours in the garden because he loves gardening.
items.zh: 我爺爺常在花園待好幾個小時，因為他很愛園藝。

items.en: Do you enjoy cooking?
items.zh: 你喜歡做菜嗎？

items.en: My son likes drawing animals.
items.zh: 我兒子喜歡畫動物。

items.en: We really enjoyed sailing around the islands.
items.zh: 我們很喜歡在島嶼之間航行。

examples.heading: ② prefer / hate + 動詞-ing

items.en: I prefer dancing, but on Saturday I'd like to go to a jazz concert.
items.zh: 我比較喜歡跳舞，不過星期六我想去聽爵士音樂會。

items.en: I'll do the cooking if you do the ironing. I hate ironing!
items.zh: 你燙衣服的話我就煮飯，我最討厭燙衣服了！

items.en: Do you prefer walking or cycling to work?
items.zh: 你上班比較喜歡走路還是騎腳踏車？

items.en: My husband hates waiting in queues.
items.zh: 我先生討厭排隊。

examples.heading: ③ start / stop / finish + 動詞-ing

items.zh: 我媽媽退休後開始學義大利文。

items.en: It stopped raining, so we went outside.
items.zh: 雨停了，所以我們去外面。

items.en: Have you finished packing your suitcase?
items.zh: 你行李收好了嗎？

items.en: Our new puppy started barking as soon as we left the house.
items.zh: 我們一出門，新養的小狗就開始叫。

examples.heading: ④ go + 動詞-ing

items.en: We went shopping in town on Saturday.
items.zh: 我們星期六去城裡逛街。

items.en: Let's go swimming after work.
items.zh: 下班後我們去游泳吧。

items.en: They go skiing in the Alps every winter.
items.zh: 他們每年冬天都去阿爾卑斯山滑雪。

items.en: My parents went dancing on their anniversary.
items.zh: 我爸媽結婚紀念日那天去跳舞。

examples.heading: ⑤ 介系詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: There we did a lot of things, like swimming from the beach and going shopping.
items.zh: 我們在那裡做了很多事，像是從海灘下水游泳和逛街。

items.en: My little brother is brilliant at telling jokes.
items.zh: 我弟弟超會講笑話。

items.en: I'm interested in learning Spanish.
items.zh: 我對學西班牙文有興趣。

items.en: Thanks for helping me with my bags.
items.zh: 謝謝你幫我提包包。

items.en: My uncle always takes the train because he's afraid of flying.
items.zh: 我舅舅都搭火車，因為他怕搭飛機。

examples.heading: ⑥ 動詞-ing + 受詞

items.en: My daughter enjoys playing the piano.
items.zh: 我女兒喜歡彈鋼琴。

items.en: I love watching old films on Sunday afternoons.
items.zh: 我喜歡在星期天下午看老電影。

items.en: Tell me when you've finished using the laptop.
items.zh: 你用完筆電的時候跟我說一聲。

items.en: He started taking the bus to work.
items.zh: 他開始搭公車上班。

examples.heading: ⑦ 兩個動詞-ing

items.en: In my free time I like reading and listening to music.
items.zh: 我有空的時候喜歡看書和聽音樂。

items.en: I practice speaking and writing every day.
items.zh: 我每天練習口說和寫作。

items.en: The kids love running and jumping in the garden.
items.zh: 孩子們很愛在院子裡跑跑跳跳。

items.en: My mum enjoys knitting and baking.
items.zh: 我媽媽喜歡織毛線和烤東西。

items.en: We love walking and cycling in the hills.
items.zh: 我們很喜歡在山丘上散步和騎腳踏車。

title: Driving in a city is stressful.
translation: 在城市裡開車壓力很大。

examples.heading: ① 動詞-ing + is / are + 形容詞

items.en: Let's take the train. Driving in a city is stressful.
items.zh: 我們搭火車吧，在城市裡開車壓力很大。

items.en: Smoking is bad for your health.
items.zh: 抽菸對健康不好。

items.en: Swimming is good exercise for older people.
items.zh: 游泳對年紀大的人是很好的運動。

items.en: Shopping on Saturdays is a nightmare.
items.zh: 星期六去購物簡直是惡夢。

items.en: Cooking for ten people isn't easy.
items.zh: 幫十個人做飯不容易。

examples.heading: ② 動詞-ing + 受詞 + 動詞

items.en: Learning a language takes a lot of time.
items.zh: 學一種語言要花很多時間。

items.en: Watching films in English helps me a lot.
items.zh: 看英文電影對我很有幫助。

items.zh: 六點以後喝咖啡會讓我整晚睡不著。

items.en: Taking a short walk after lunch helps me stay awake.
items.zh: 午餐後散個步讓我保持清醒。

items.en: Reading a good book always relaxes me.
items.zh: 看一本好書總是讓我放鬆。

examples.heading: ③ 動詞-ing + 介系詞片語 + 動詞

items.en: Working until midnight every evening is not reasonable.
items.zh: 每天晚上工作到半夜是不合理的。

items.en: Living in the countryside is very peaceful.
items.zh: 住在鄉下很寧靜。

items.en: Walking to school helps the kids wake up.
items.zh: 走路上學讓孩子們清醒過來。

items.en: Travelling by train is cheaper than flying.
items.zh: 搭火車旅行比搭飛機便宜。

items.en: Studying at night doesn't work for me.
items.zh: 晚上讀書對我沒用。

examples.heading: ④ 動詞-ing + is + 名詞片語

items.en: Climbing is our favourite hobby.
items.zh: 爬山是我們最喜歡的嗜好。

items.en: Working late is not the solution.
items.zh: 加班不是解決的辦法。

items.en: Saying sorry is the first step.
items.zh: 道歉是第一步。

items.en: Running every morning was my New Year's resolution.
items.zh: 每天早上跑步是我的新年新希望。

examples.heading: ⑤ 兩個動詞-ing + are

items.en: Swimming and cycling are good for your heart.
items.zh: 游泳和騎腳踏車對心臟很好。

items.en: Reading and writing are important skills.
items.zh: 閱讀和寫作是很重要的技能。

items.en: Cooking and cleaning take up most of my weekend.
items.zh: 煮飯和打掃佔掉我週末大部分的時間。

examples.heading: ⑥ 動詞-ing 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: Moving to London was the best decision I ever made.
items.zh: 搬到倫敦是我做過最好的決定。

items.en: Leaving my family was very hard.
items.zh: 離開我的家人很難受。

items.en: Getting the tickets took us two hours.
items.zh: 買到票花了我們兩個小時。

items.en: Losing the final made the team very sad.
items.zh: 決賽輸了讓球隊很難過。

examples.heading: ⑦ 動詞-ing 主詞 + 情態動詞

items.en: Exercising every day can make you feel better.
items.zh: 每天運動可以讓你感覺好一點。

items.en: Speaking in public can be scary.
items.zh: 在公開場合說話可能很嚇人。

items.en: Waiting for news will only make you more nervous.
items.zh: 等消息只會讓你更緊張。

items.en: Sharing a flat could save you a lot of money.
items.zh: 跟人合租公寓可以幫你省很多錢。

items.en: Finishing early might give us time for a coffee.
items.zh: 早點結束的話，我們也許有時間喝杯咖啡。

title: The floor in the kitchen has many holes, and I think there are mice.
translation: 廚房的地板有很多洞，我覺得有老鼠。

examples.heading: ① man / woman / child

items.en: It was a sale, and I bought some clothes for my children.
items.zh: 那時候在特價，我幫我的孩子買了一些衣服。

items.en: Three men came to fix the roof.
items.zh: 三個男人來修屋頂。

items.en: The women in my family are all very tall.
items.zh: 我家的女生都很高。

items.en: My neighbour has four children, and they're all under ten.
items.zh: 我鄰居有四個小孩，全都不到十歲。

examples.heading: ② foot / tooth / mouse / goose

items.en: She has black eyes, a beautiful round face and nice teeth.
items.zh: 她有黑色的眼睛、漂亮的圓臉和好看的牙齒。

items.en: My feet hurt after the long walk.
items.zh: 走了那麼長的路，我的腳好痛。

items.en: I think there are mice in the kitchen.
items.zh: 我覺得廚房裡有老鼠。

items.en: Brush your teeth before bed.
items.zh: 睡前要刷牙。

items.en: There are some geese on the lake.
items.zh: 湖上有幾隻鵝。

examples.heading: ③ person / people

items.en: Twenty people came to my party.
items.zh: 二十個人來參加我的派對。

items.en: Most people in my town work in the factory.
items.zh: 我們鎮上大部分的人都在工廠上班。

items.en: How many people live in your house?
items.zh: 你家住了幾個人？

examples.heading: ④ 單複數同形

items.en: The fishermen caught a lot of fish this morning.
items.zh: 漁夫們今天早上抓到很多魚。

items.en: There are hundreds of sheep on the hills.
items.zh: 山丘上有好幾百隻羊。

items.en: We saw two deer in the forest.
items.zh: 我們在森林裡看到兩隻鹿。

items.en: My son has three fish in a tank.
items.zh: 我兒子在魚缸裡養了三條魚。

items.zh: 你可以把刀叉放到桌上嗎？

items.zh: 秋天葉子會變紅。

items.en: Cut the oranges into halves.
items.zh: 把柳橙切成兩半。

items.en: The farmers and their wives sat at one table.
items.zh: 農夫們和他們的太太坐在同一桌。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不規則複數名詞當主詞

items.zh: 請安靜！孩子們在樓上睡覺。

items.en: People in this village always say hello in the street.
items.zh: 這個村子的人在街上都會打招呼。

items.en: My teeth are very sensitive to cold drinks.
items.zh: 我的牙齒對冷飲很敏感。

items.en: The men in the office all wear ties.
items.zh: 辦公室的男生都打領帶。

examples.heading: ⑦ 不規則複數名詞當受詞

items.en: I need new shoes because my feet have grown.
items.zh: 我需要新鞋，因為我的腳變大了。

items.en: The cat caught two mice last night.
items.zh: 貓昨晚抓到兩隻老鼠。

items.en: At the wedding I didn't know many people, so I danced with my aunt.
items.zh: 婚禮上我認識的人不多，所以我跟我阿姨跳舞。

items.en: My grandmother looks after the children on Fridays.
items.zh: 我奶奶星期五照顧孩子們。

examples.heading: ⑧ 數字 + 不規則複數名詞

items.zh: 烹飪課需要三把鋒利的刀。

items.zh: 兩個女人和三個小孩在公車站等車。

items.en: This table is for six people.
items.zh: 這張桌子是六人座。

examples.heading: ① 藝術和媒體

items.zh: 她每天彈鋼琴。音樂是她的生命，不只是嗜好。

items.zh: 電視比較吸引人，因為它有動態影像。

items.en: Art helps children express their feelings.
items.zh: 藝術幫助孩子表達感受。

items.en: My son finds literature boring, but he loves science.
items.zh: 我兒子覺得文學很無聊，可是他很愛科學。

examples.heading: ② 社會

items.zh: 教育很重要，可以讓你不必像被拴著的狗一樣！

items.zh: 我們這一區今年的犯罪率下降了。

items.zh: 失業對年輕人來說是個大問題。

items.en: Pollution is getting worse in big cities.
items.zh: 大城市的汙染越來越嚴重。

items.en: Doctors say that sleep is as important as food.
items.zh: 醫生說睡眠跟食物一樣重要。

examples.heading: ③ 感覺和價值

items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶說，是愛讓他們在一起六十年。

items.en: Happiness doesn't come from expensive things.
items.zh: 快樂不是來自昂貴的東西。

items.en: Young people want freedom.
items.zh: 年輕人想要自由。

items.en: Success takes hard work and a bit of luck.
items.zh: 成功需要努力和一點運氣。

items.zh: 大家快點，時間就是金錢，客戶在等了。

items.zh: 她在大學讀藝術。

items.zh: 我們需要和平，不要戰爭。

items.en: Children need love and attention.
items.zh: 孩子需要愛和關心。

examples.heading: ⑤ 抽象不可數名詞在介系詞後面

items.zh: 他對政治有興趣。

items.zh: 她寫了一本關於友誼的書。

items.en: They fought for freedom.
items.zh: 他們為自由而戰。

items.zh: 我爸媽教我要懂得尊重。

items.zh: 大城市的生活很刺激。

items.zh: 這家餐廳的食物很棒。

items.zh: 現代藝術很難懂。

items.zh: 古典音樂幫助我讀書。

items.zh: 健康是最好的禮物。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式文章裡的省略

items.zh: 政府的反應比其他國家的慢。

items.zh: 我們分店的銷售數字比倫敦辦公室的高。

items.en: The museum's collection is larger than the gallery's.

examples.heading: ⑥ 日常對話裡的省略

items.zh: 這是誰的外套？是你的還是 Jack 的？

items.zh: 我的手機沒電了，我可以借我哥哥的嗎？

items.zh: 你的字比你爸爸的整齊多了。

items.zh: 媽媽煮的菜比任何一家餐廳的都好吃。

items.en: Their garden looks nicer than the neighbours'.
items.zh: 他們的花園看起來比鄰居的漂亮。
