items.en: Lucy's sister is getting married in Rome next month.
items.zh: Lucy 的姊姊下個月要在羅馬結婚。

examples.heading: ⑥ 名詞 + 's + 名詞當受詞

items.en: I lost my best friend's book. What can I do?
items.zh: 我把我最好朋友的書弄丟了，怎麼辦？

items.en: Did you see the man's face?
items.zh: 你有看到那個男人的臉嗎？

items.en: I'm wearing my mother's ring today.
items.zh: 我今天戴著我媽媽的戒指。

items.en: Can you feed my neighbour's cat while she's away?
items.zh: 她不在的時候，你可以幫我餵我鄰居的貓嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 名詞 + 's + 名詞在介系詞後面

items.en: I can't drive home. The car keys are in my wife's coat pocket.
items.zh: 我沒辦法開車回家，車鑰匙在我太太的外套口袋裡。

items.en: I'm going to the party with my brother's friends.
items.zh: 我要跟我哥哥的朋友一起去派對。

items.en: We met at Paul's birthday party.
items.zh: 我們是在 Paul 的生日派對上認識的。

items.en: There's a hole in my son's shoe.
items.zh: 我兒子的鞋子有一個洞。

title: We could go by boat to a small island full of exotic birds.
translation: 我們可以搭船去一座小島，島上到處都是珍奇的鳥類。
name: 形容詞片語後置修飾名詞
sentences: We could go by boat to a small island full of exotic birds and take photos.
I found a box full of old letters in the attic.
The kids came home with pockets full of sand.
It was a room full of people I didn't know.
She gave me a jar full of homemade jam.
We visited a village famous for its cheese.
Bath is a city known for its Roman baths.
He's a chef famous for his desserts.
They live on an island famous for its beaches.
I'm looking for a phone similar to yours.
We need volunteers good with children.
Students ready for the exam can leave early.
We want a flat close to the kids' school.
Parents worried about the new rules can call the school.
For his birthday, choose a book easy enough for a seven-year-old.
They gave us a map impossible to follow.
After a long search, we chose a sofa small enough to fit in the lift.
He's a man difficult to please.
Emily Brontë wrote a tragic story, beautifully set in the moors.
I bought a bag made in Italy.
We ate a dish called paella.
There's a letter addressed to you on the table.
I need a full bottle of water for the hike.
She carried a bottle full of cold water.
That's a famous restaurant.
That's a restaurant famous for its fish.
Shops full of tourists are no fun at Christmas.
Towns famous for their castles get lots of visitors in summer.
People interested in the course should email me.
A bag full of money sat on the back seat of the bus all day.
Tickets cheaper than ten pounds sell out quickly.

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + full of + 名詞

items.en: We could go by boat to a small island full of exotic birds and take photos.
items.zh: 我們可以搭船去一座到處都是珍奇鳥類的小島，然後拍照。

items.en: I found a box full of old letters in the attic.
items.zh: 我在閣樓找到一個裝滿舊信件的箱子。

items.en: The kids came home with pockets full of sand.
items.zh: 孩子們回家時口袋裡裝滿了沙子。

items.en: It was a room full of people I didn't know.
items.zh: 那個房間裡全是我不認識的人。

items.en: She gave me a jar full of homemade jam.
items.zh: 她給了我一罐滿滿的自製果醬。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + famous for / known for + 名詞

items.en: We visited a village famous for its cheese.
items.zh: 我們去了一個以起司聞名的村子。

items.en: Bath is a city known for its Roman baths.
items.zh: 巴斯是一座以羅馬浴場聞名的城市。

items.en: He's a chef famous for his desserts.
items.zh: 他是一位以甜點出名的主廚。

items.en: They live on an island famous for its beaches.
items.zh: 他們住在一座以海灘聞名的島上。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + 其他形容詞 + 介系詞片語

items.en: I'm looking for a phone similar to yours.
items.zh: 我在找一支跟你的很像的手機。

items.en: We need volunteers good with children.
items.zh: 我們需要會跟小孩相處的志工。

items.en: Students ready for the exam can leave early.
items.zh: 準備好考試的學生可以提早離開。

items.en: We want a flat close to the kids' school.
items.zh: 我們想找一間離孩子學校近的公寓。

items.en: Parents worried about the new rules can call the school.
items.zh: 擔心新規定的家長可以打電話給學校。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞 + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: For his birthday, choose a book easy enough for a seven-year-old.
items.zh: 他生日的時候，挑一本七歲小孩看得懂的書。

items.en: They gave us a map impossible to follow.
items.zh: 他們給我們的地圖根本看不懂。

items.en: After a long search, we chose a sofa small enough to fit in the lift.
items.zh: 找了很久，我們選了一張小到能放進電梯的沙發。

items.en: He's a man difficult to please.
items.zh: 他是一個很難討好的人。

examples.heading: ⑤ 名詞 + 過去分詞片語

items.en: Emily Brontë wrote a tragic story, beautifully set in the moors.
items.zh: 艾蜜莉·勃朗特寫了一個悲傷的故事，背景設在荒原上，寫得很美。

items.en: I bought a bag made in Italy.
items.zh: 我買了一個義大利製的包包。

items.en: We ate a dish called paella.
items.zh: 我們吃了一道叫西班牙海鮮飯的菜。

items.en: There's a letter addressed to you on the table.
items.zh: 桌上有一封寫給你的信。

examples.heading: ⑥ 形容詞單獨在前和形容詞片語在後

items.en: I need a full bottle of water for the hike.
items.zh: 我健行需要一整瓶水。

items.en: She carried a bottle full of cold water.
items.zh: 她帶了一瓶裝滿冰水的瓶子。

items.en: That's a famous restaurant.
items.zh: 那是一家有名的餐廳。

items.en: That's a restaurant famous for its fish.
items.zh: 那是一家以魚料理出名的餐廳。

examples.heading: ⑦ 名詞 + 形容詞片語當主詞

items.en: Shops full of tourists are no fun at Christmas.
items.zh: 聖誕節的時候，擠滿觀光客的商店一點都不好逛。

items.en: Towns famous for their castles get lots of visitors in summer.
items.zh: 以城堡聞名的小鎮夏天有很多遊客。

items.en: People interested in the course should email me.
items.zh: 對這門課有興趣的人請寄電子郵件給我。

items.en: A bag full of money sat on the back seat of the bus all day.
items.zh: 一個裝滿錢的袋子在公車後座放了一整天。

items.en: Tickets cheaper than ten pounds sell out quickly.
items.zh: 十英鎊以下的票很快就賣完了。

title: I want to see you on Saturday and Sunday.
translation: 我想在星期六和星期天見你。
name: 專有名詞（字首大寫）
sentences: I'm busy on Friday, but I want to see you on Saturday and Sunday.
The art classes after school are on Tuesdays.
Sorry, the dentist can't see you until Thursday afternoon.
Don't go to the baker's tomorrow. It never opens on Wednesdays.
I'm having a party on Friday 25 December.
We always go skiing in February.
What are you doing for Christmas this year?
School finishes in July.
In my class there's a girl called Maria.
Mr Brown is our new maths teacher.
Please give this letter to Dr Patel.
Have you met Ahmed? He's from Egypt.
In Leicester I live in an area called Hamilton.
My parents are from Brazil, but I grew up in Canada.
The kids are excited because we're flying to Italy next week.
Is Manchester far from London?
She speaks English, Spanish and a little Japanese.
My husband is Scottish, so we spend New Year in Edinburgh.
I'm learning French at evening classes.
There's a new Chinese restaurant opposite the station.
This place is Gloscat College in Gloucester.
After the interview, my brother got a job at Google.
We visited the British Museum on Sunday.
Meet me outside the Odeon cinema at seven.
My favourite season is summer, but my favourite month is June.
My uncle lives in a small town in Wales.
Our teacher, Mrs Hill, comes from Ireland.
There's a famous river in Paris called the Seine.
My grandparents flew to Portugal for their anniversary.
After university, my sister got a job in Tokyo.
We arrived in Berlin on Thursday.

examples.heading: ① 星期

items.en: I'm busy on Friday, but I want to see you on Saturday and Sunday.
items.zh: 我星期五很忙，可是我想在星期六和星期天見你。

items.en: The art classes after school are on Tuesdays.
items.zh: 放學後的美術課在星期二。

items.en: Sorry, the dentist can't see you until Thursday afternoon.
items.zh: 抱歉，牙醫要到星期四下午才能幫你看診。

items.en: Don't go to the baker's tomorrow. It never opens on Wednesdays.
items.zh: 明天別去麵包店，它星期三都不開。

examples.heading: ② 月份和節日

items.en: I'm having a party on Friday 25 December.
items.zh: 我十二月二十五日星期五要開派對。

items.en: We always go skiing in February.
items.zh: 我們每年二月都去滑雪。

items.en: What are you doing for Christmas this year?
items.zh: 你今年聖誕節要做什麼？

items.en: School finishes in July.
items.zh: 學校七月放假。

examples.heading: ③ 人名

items.en: In my class there's a girl called Maria.
items.zh: 我們班有一個叫 Maria 的女生。

items.en: Mr Brown is our new maths teacher.
items.zh: Brown 先生是我們的新數學老師。

items.en: Please give this letter to Dr Patel.
items.zh: 請把這封信交給 Patel 醫生。

items.en: Have you met Ahmed? He's from Egypt.
items.zh: 你見過 Ahmed 嗎？他是埃及人。

examples.heading: ④ 城市、國家和地區

items.en: In Leicester I live in an area called Hamilton.
items.zh: 我在萊斯特住在一個叫漢彌爾頓的地區。

items.en: My parents are from Brazil, but I grew up in Canada.
items.zh: 我爸媽是巴西人，可是我在加拿大長大。

items.en: The kids are excited because we're flying to Italy next week.
items.zh: 孩子們好興奮，因為我們下禮拜要飛去義大利。

items.en: Is Manchester far from London?
items.zh: 曼徹斯特離倫敦遠嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 語言和國籍

items.en: She speaks English, Spanish and a little Japanese.
items.zh: 她會說英文、西班牙文和一點日文。

items.en: My husband is Scottish, so we spend New Year in Edinburgh.
items.zh: 我先生是蘇格蘭人，所以我們都在愛丁堡過新年。

items.en: I'm learning French at evening classes.
items.zh: 我在上法文夜間課。

items.en: There's a new Chinese restaurant opposite the station.
items.zh: 車站對面新開了一家中國餐廳。

examples.heading: ⑥ 學校、公司和建築

items.en: This place is Gloscat College in Gloucester.
items.zh: 這裡是格洛斯特的 Gloscat 學院。

items.en: After the interview, my brother got a job at Google.
items.zh: 面試完以後，我哥哥拿到了 Google 的工作。

items.en: We visited the British Museum on Sunday.
items.zh: 我們星期天去了大英博物館。

items.en: Meet me outside the Odeon cinema at seven.
items.zh: 七點在 Odeon 電影院外面跟我碰面。

examples.heading: ⑦ 專有名詞和普通名詞

items.en: My favourite season is summer, but my favourite month is June.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的季節是夏天，可是我最喜歡的月份是六月。

items.en: My uncle lives in a small town in Wales.
items.zh: 我舅舅住在威爾斯的一個小鎮。

items.en: Our teacher, Mrs Hill, comes from Ireland.
items.zh: 我們的老師 Hill 女士來自愛爾蘭。

items.en: There's a famous river in Paris called the Seine.
items.zh: 巴黎有一條有名的河叫塞納河。

examples.heading: ⑧ 專有名詞前面不加 the

items.en: My grandparents flew to Portugal for their anniversary.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶飛去葡萄牙慶祝結婚紀念日。

items.en: After university, my sister got a job in Tokyo.
items.zh: 大學畢業後，我姊姊在東京找到工作。

items.en: We arrived in Berlin on Thursday.
items.zh: 我們星期四抵達柏林。

title: Do you have any furniture in this room?
translation: 你這個房間裡有家具嗎？
name: 常用不可數名詞
sentences: Sorry, there's no milk left. Do you want your tea black?
There's some bread in the cupboard if you're hungry.
We had rice and chicken for dinner last night.
It's hot today, so take plenty of water on the walk.
The food at your party was delicious. Who made it?
In my free time I listen to music, watch TV and talk to my friends.
Come to my house at 4.30 pm, so we have time to get ready.
I can't come out tonight. I've got a lot of homework.
The kids had great fun at the fair yesterday.
Can you give me some information about the evening course?
The flat is empty. We have to buy all the furniture ourselves.
I haven't got any money with me. Can you pay?
How much luggage are you taking to Spain?
The weather there was cold and wet all week.
There's a lot of traffic in the city centre today.
I'm making some coffee. Do you want a cup?
Is there any cheese in the fridge for the sandwiches?
We can carry the boxes ourselves. We don't need any help from the neighbours.
Let's buy some fruit for the picnic on Sunday.
How much time do we have before the train leaves?
How much water should a baby drink in hot weather?
How much money did you spend in London?
Turn that down! The music is so loud I can't hear the phone.
The money for the school trip is in the envelope.
The coffee in this café comes from Colombia.
Kids, wash your hands. Dinner is on the table!
My doctor told me to eat less salt and more fruit.
My little girl would eat chocolate for breakfast if I let her.
Money isn't everything, but it helps.
We're out of bread and milk. I'll go to the shop.
We sell fresh fish every morning at the harbour.

examples.heading: ① 食物和飲料

items.en: Sorry, there's no milk left. Do you want your tea black?
items.zh: 抱歉，牛奶沒了。你的茶要不加奶嗎？

items.en: There's some bread in the cupboard if you're hungry.
items.zh: 你餓的話，櫥櫃裡有一些麵包。

items.en: We had rice and chicken for dinner last night.
items.zh: 我們昨天晚餐吃了飯和雞肉。

items.en: It's hot today, so take plenty of water on the walk.
items.zh: 今天很熱，散步的時候多帶點水。

items.en: The food at your party was delicious. Who made it?
items.zh: 你派對上的食物好好吃，是誰做的？

examples.heading: ② 抽象的東西

items.en: In my free time I listen to music, watch TV and talk to my friends.
items.zh: 我有空的時候聽音樂、看電視、跟朋友聊天。

items.en: Come to my house at 4.30 pm, so we have time to get ready.
items.zh: 四點半來我家，這樣我們才有時間準備。

items.en: I can't come out tonight. I've got a lot of homework.
items.zh: 我今晚不能出去，我有很多功課。

items.en: The kids had great fun at the fair yesterday.
items.zh: 孩子們昨天在遊樂會玩得很開心。

items.en: Can you give me some information about the evening course?
items.zh: 你可以給我一些關於夜間課程的資訊嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 總稱

items.en: The flat is empty. We have to buy all the furniture ourselves.
items.zh: 公寓是空的，所有家具都得我們自己買。

items.en: I haven't got any money with me. Can you pay?
items.zh: 我身上沒帶錢，你可以付嗎？

items.en: How much luggage are you taking to Spain?
items.zh: 你要帶多少行李去西班牙？

items.en: The weather there was cold and wet all week.
items.zh: 那裡的天氣整個禮拜都又冷又濕。

items.en: There's a lot of traffic in the city centre today.
items.zh: 今天市中心車很多。

examples.heading: ④ some / any + 不可數名詞

items.en: I'm making some coffee. Do you want a cup?
items.zh: 我在泡咖啡，你要一杯嗎？

items.en: Is there any cheese in the fridge for the sandwiches?
items.zh: 冰箱裡有起司可以做三明治嗎？

items.en: We can carry the boxes ourselves. We don't need any help from the neighbours.
items.zh: 我們可以自己搬箱子，不需要鄰居幫忙。

items.en: Let's buy some fruit for the picnic on Sunday.
items.zh: 我們買點水果，星期天去野餐吧。

examples.heading: ⑤ how much + 不可數名詞

items.en: How much time do we have before the train leaves?
items.zh: 火車開之前我們還有多少時間？

items.en: How much water should a baby drink in hot weather?
items.zh: 天氣熱的時候，寶寶應該喝多少水？

items.en: How much money did you spend in London?
items.zh: 你在倫敦花了多少錢？

examples.heading: ⑥ 不可數名詞 + 單數動詞

items.en: Turn that down! The music is so loud I can't hear the phone.
items.zh: 關小聲一點！音樂大聲到我聽不到電話。

items.en: The money for the school trip is in the envelope.
items.zh: 校外教學的錢在信封裡。

items.en: The coffee in this café comes from Colombia.
items.zh: 這家咖啡店的咖啡來自哥倫比亞。

items.en: Kids, wash your hands. Dinner is on the table!
items.zh: 孩子們，去洗手，晚餐上桌了！

examples.heading: ⑦ 不可數名詞不加限定詞

items.en: My doctor told me to eat less salt and more fruit.
items.zh: 我的醫生叫我少吃鹽、多吃水果。

items.en: My little girl would eat chocolate for breakfast if I let her.
items.zh: 我女兒要是我准，她早餐會吃巧克力。

items.en: Money isn't everything, but it helps.
items.zh: 錢不是一切，不過有錢比較好辦事。

items.en: We're out of bread and milk. I'll go to the shop.
items.zh: 我們的麵包和牛奶都沒了，我去一趟商店。

items.en: We sell fresh fish every morning at the harbour.
items.zh: 我們每天早上在港口賣新鮮的魚。

title: I hope you can help me find new accommodation as soon as possible.
translation: 希望你能幫我盡快找到新的住處。
name: 不可數名詞（較多種）
sentences: My company is moving me to Leeds, so I need new accommodation as soon as possible.
I think the countryside is better than the town centre. People are friendlier.
The scenery in the mountains is amazing.
We spent the weekend walking and enjoying nature.
I love shopping for clothes because I love fashion.
The school bought new sports equipment.
Please don't leave your luggage on the stairs.
She's doing research on climate change.
You've made a lot of progress with your English.
His behaviour in class is getting better.
Education is free in this country.
There's not much entertainment in this small town.
Eating well is good for your health.
She has a lot of knowledge about old cars.
They offer cheap accommodation for students.
The new gym in town has modern equipment and long opening hours.
We had terrible weather all week.
My grandparents love the fresh air in the countryside.
Can you give me some advice about buying a car?
We don't have much luggage, so we can take the bus.
The museum has a lot of information for visitors.
You need a bit of patience with young children.
This is a useful piece of equipment for camping.
My dad gave me a good piece of advice.
That's an interesting piece of research.
The accommodation on our school trip was a bit basic.
The equipment in the lab is very old.
Fashion changes every year.
The countryside around here is beautiful in spring.
Take a day off. Your health matters more than any meeting.
The traffic in the city gets worse every year.

examples.heading: ① 地方和環境

items.en: My company is moving me to Leeds, so I need new accommodation as soon as possible.
items.zh: 公司要把我調去里茲，所以我得盡快找到新住處。

items.en: I think the countryside is better than the town centre. People are friendlier.
items.zh: 我覺得鄉下比市中心好，人比較友善。

items.en: The scenery in the mountains is amazing.
items.zh: 山上的風景美極了。

items.en: We spent the weekend walking and enjoying nature.
items.zh: 我們週末去散步、享受大自然。

examples.heading: ② 生活和工作

items.en: I love shopping for clothes because I love fashion.
items.zh: 我很愛逛街買衣服，因為我愛時尚。

items.en: The school bought new sports equipment.
items.zh: 學校買了新的運動器材。

items.en: Please don't leave your luggage on the stairs.
items.zh: 請不要把行李放在樓梯上。

items.en: She's doing research on climate change.
items.zh: 她在做氣候變遷的研究。

items.en: You've made a lot of progress with your English.
items.zh: 你的英文進步很多。

examples.heading: ③ 抽象的東西

items.en: His behaviour in class is getting better.
items.zh: 他在課堂上的行為越來越好了。

items.en: Education is free in this country.
items.zh: 這個國家的教育是免費的。

items.en: There's not much entertainment in this small town.
items.zh: 這個小鎮沒什麼娛樂。

items.en: Eating well is good for your health.
items.zh: 吃得好對健康有益。

items.en: She has a lot of knowledge about old cars.
items.zh: 她對老車很有研究。

examples.heading: ④ 形容詞 + 不可數名詞

items.en: They offer cheap accommodation for students.
items.zh: 他們提供學生便宜的住處。

items.en: The new gym in town has modern equipment and long opening hours.
items.zh: 鎮上新開的健身房有新式的器材，營業時間也很長。

items.en: We had terrible weather all week.
items.zh: 我們整個禮拜都遇到很糟的天氣。

items.en: My grandparents love the fresh air in the countryside.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶很愛鄉下的新鮮空氣。

examples.heading: ⑤ 數量詞 + 不可數名詞

items.en: Can you give me some advice about buying a car?
items.zh: 你可以給我一些買車的建議嗎？

title: She's the funniest person I've ever known!

It was the biggest fish he had ever caught.

That was the longest walk the children had ever done.
It was the most expensive meal they had ever eaten.
Don't bother with that one. It's the dullest film I've watched this year.
That's the best holiday we've had in years.
It was the hottest day I'd experienced in my life.
This is the busiest week I've had since I started this job.
The best book that I've read is The Da Vinci Code.

examples.heading: ① 現在式 + 最高級名詞 + I've ever + 過去分詞

items.zh: 你一定要認識 Kate。她是我認識的人裡面最好笑的！

items.zh: 謝謝媽，這是我吃過最好吃的蛋糕。

items.en: Look at that water! It's the clearest sea I've ever swum in.
items.zh: 你看那片水！這是我游過最清澈的海。

items.en: That's the strangest question anyone has ever asked me.
items.zh: 那是別人問過我最奇怪的問題。

items.en: He's the most generous man I've ever met.

items.zh: 那是我們班考過最難的考試。

items.en: She has a great deal of experience in teaching.
items.zh: 她有很豐富的教學經驗。

items.en: The storm did a great deal of damage to the town.
items.zh: 暴風雨對小鎮造成很大的損害。

examples.heading: ⑦ 數量詞 + 不可數名詞當主詞

items.en: A bit of exercise every day is good for you.
items.zh: 每天運動一下對你有好處。

items.en: Plenty of fresh air helps you sleep.
items.zh: 多呼吸新鮮空氣能幫你睡得好。

items.en: Enough money came in to fix the roof.
items.zh: 募到的錢夠修屋頂了。

items.en: Not much traffic passes our house at night.
items.zh: 晚上經過我們家的車不多。

examples.heading: ⑧ 數量詞比較

items.en: I've got a bit of money, but not enough money for a holiday.
items.zh: 我有一點錢，可是不夠去度假。

items.en: There's plenty of bread, but not much butter.
items.zh: 麵包很多，可是奶油不多。

items.en: We had loads of fun but not much sleep.
items.zh: 我們玩得超開心，可是沒怎麼睡。

items.en: Can I have a little bit of cream and plenty of chocolate sauce?
items.zh: 可以給我一點點奶油和很多巧克力醬嗎？

items.en: The dress that she wore to the wedding was beautiful.
items.zh: 她穿去婚禮的那件洋裝很漂亮。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + who / that + 子句（人）

items.zh: 送我這支舊手錶的人是我爸爸。

items.zh: 住在隔壁的那個男人是機師。

items.zh: 你認識正在跟 Sam 說話的那個女生嗎？

items.en: The doctor who saw me yesterday was very kind.
items.zh: 昨天幫我看病的那位醫生人很好。

items.en: The students who finish early can go home.

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + when + 子句（時間）

items.zh: 我們能看那部電影的最後一天是星期四。

items.en: I still remember the day when you were born.
items.zh: 我還記得你出生的那一天。

items.en: Summer is the time when we visit our grandparents.
items.zh: 夏天是我們去看爺爺奶奶的時候。

items.en: Do you remember the year when it snowed in April?
items.zh: 你記得四月下雪的那一年嗎？

items.zh: 有沒有店可以買郵票？

items.zh: 我們住的那家飯店有一個很棒的泳池。

items.en: That's the school where my mum teaches.
items.zh: 那是我媽媽教書的學校。

examples.heading: ⑤ 省略當受詞的關係代名詞

items.zh: 我媽媽做的蛋糕很好吃。

items.zh: 我在網路上買的鞋子太小了。

items.en: Is this the book you wanted?
items.zh: 這是你要的那本書嗎？

items.en: The people we met in Spain were very friendly.
items.zh: 我們在西班牙認識的人都很友善。

items.en: I didn't like the food they served at the party.
items.zh: 我不喜歡他們在派對上端出來的食物。

examples.heading: ⑥ 整個名詞片語當受詞

items.en: Have you seen the keys that were on the table?
items.zh: 你有看到原本放在桌上的鑰匙嗎？

items.en: I want to buy the bag which is in the window.
items.zh: 我想買櫥窗裡的那個包包。

items.en: We met the family who bought our old house.
items.zh: 我們見到了買下我們舊房子的那家人。

items.en: Can you call the man who phoned this morning?
items.zh: 你可以回電給今天早上打來的那位先生嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 整個名詞片語在介系詞後面

items.en: I'm looking for the woman who works in this office.
items.zh: 我在找在這間辦公室上班的那位女士。

items.en: We talked about the trip that we're planning for the summer.
items.zh: 我們聊了我們在計畫的暑假旅行。

items.en: She lives in the house which has a red door.
items.zh: 她住在有一扇紅色大門的那間房子。

items.en: I sent a card to the nurse who looked after my dad.
items.zh: 我寄了一張卡片給照顧我爸爸的那位護士。

title: You can always visit our shopping center, which is one of the biggest in Brazil.
translation: 你隨時都可以來逛我們的購物中心，它是巴西最大的購物中心之一。

My sister, who is a nurse, works at night.

Our kitchen, where we eat most meals, is very small.
I'm reading a book by Roald Dahl, who wrote Matilda.

items.zh: 我們在 Luigi's 吃晚餐，那是我最喜歡的餐廳。

items.en: I bought a new laptop, which was very expensive.
items.zh: 我買了一台新筆電，價錢很貴。

items.en: Come and see our new flat, which has a big balcony.
items.zh: 來看看我們的新公寓，它有一個很大的陽台。

items.en: He gave me his old bike, which still works perfectly.
items.zh: 他把他的舊腳踏車給了我，那台車還很好騎。

items.en: We watched the final, which was really exciting.
items.zh: 我們看了決賽，比賽非常精彩。

examples.heading: ② 名詞片語 + , who + 子句（句尾）

items.zh: 這是我哥哥 Tom，他住在里茲。

items.zh: 我打電話給李醫生，他叫我休息幾天。

items.zh: 我們上了 Green 老師的課，她很嚴格。

items.zh: 我見到你表妹 Anna 了，她人很友善。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞片語 + , where + 子句（句尾）

items.en: We stayed in Brighton, where my aunt lives.
items.zh: 我們住在布萊頓，我阿姨住在那裡。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞片語 + , which + 子句 + ,（句中）

examples.heading: ⑤ 名詞片語 + , who + 子句 + ,（句中）

items.zh: 我們老師是加拿大人，她也會說法語。

items.en: My neighbour, who has three dogs, walks them every morning.
items.zh: 我鄰居養了三隻狗，他每天早上都帶牠們去散步。

items.en: The manager, who was very nice, gave us free drinks.
items.zh: 經理人很好，請我們喝免費的飲料。

examples.heading: ⑥ 名詞片語 + , where + 子句 + ,（句中）

items.en: Rome, where my father was born, is a beautiful city.
items.zh: 我爸爸在羅馬出生，那是一座美麗的城市。

items.zh: 我們在布萊頓住了十年，那裡變了很多。

items.en: Our kitchen, where we eat most meals, is very small.
items.zh: 我們大部分的飯都在廚房吃，廚房很小。

examples.heading: ⑦ 補充資料讓句子更清楚

items.zh: 我在看 Roald Dahl 的一本書，他寫了《瑪蒂達》。

items.zh: 我們開車去牛津，牛津離倫敦大約一個小時。

items.zh: 去問 Peter，他對電腦無所不知。

items.zh: 她傳了她寶寶的照片給我，寶寶才出生兩天。

items.en: The second half of the year brought rapid growth in exports.
items.zh: 下半年出口快速成長。

examples.heading: ④ make / take / reach + 名詞

items.en: The board will make a final decision next month.
items.zh: 董事會下個月會做出最後的決定。

items.en: Both sides reached an agreement after long talks.
items.zh: 雙方經過長時間的談判後達成協議。

items.en: The council must take action to reduce traffic.
items.zh: 市議會必須採取行動減少交通量。

items.en: We have made significant progress on the project.
items.zh: 我們在這個專案上有很大的進展。

examples.heading: ⑤ 形容詞變成的名詞

items.en: We cannot overstate the importance of safety in the workplace.
items.zh: 職場安全的重要性再怎麼強調也不為過。

items.en: The availability of cheap flights has changed tourism.
items.zh: 便宜機票的普及改變了觀光業。

items.en: Applicants must show the ability to work in a team.
items.zh: 申請人必須展現團隊合作的能力。

items.en: The popularity of the product grew steadily.
items.zh: 這項產品的受歡迎程度穩定上升。

examples.heading: ⑥ 商業書信裡的名詞化

items.en: With reference to your application, we would like to invite you for an interview.
items.zh: 關於您的申請，我們想邀請您來面試。

items.en: Thank you for your prompt payment of the invoice.
items.zh: 謝謝您及時支付發票款項。

items.en: Please confirm receipt of this letter.
items.zh: 請確認您已收到這封信。

items.en: We would appreciate your cooperation in this matter.
items.zh: 如您能在此事上配合，我們將不勝感激。

examples.heading: ⑦ 報告裡描述圖表的名詞化

items.en: The chart shows fluctuations in industrial output over three years.
items.zh: 圖表顯示三年來工業產量的波動。

items.en: 2002 brought significant growth in output, which reached 19%.
items.zh: 2002 年產量大幅成長，達到 19%。

items.en: The graph shows a gradual fall in unemployment after 2005.
items.zh: 圖表顯示 2005 年以後失業率逐漸下降。

title: Not everyone likes sports or music.
translation: 不是每個人都喜歡運動或音樂。
name: 部分否定 not all、not every
sentences: The school trip is to a football match, but not everyone likes football.
Not everyone can afford a holiday abroad every year.
Not everybody agrees with the new rules about phones in class.
The film was popular, but not everyone enjoyed the ending.
Not everybody wants to live in a big city.
Not everyone in my family eats meat, so we cook two dinners.
Not everything was as good as we expected. The hotel was noisy.
Not everything you read online is true.
Not everything in the shop is expensive. Look at these mugs.
I enjoyed the course, but not everything was easy.
Not everything went to plan, but the wedding was lovely.
Not every cyclist is a danger to the public. Most of them obey the rules.
Not every student can attend the study centre. It closes at five, and some lessons finish at five.
Not every hotel in town has a car park.
Not every day is sunny here, so bring an umbrella.
Not every child enjoys school trips.
Not all parents have time to help with homework, so the school runs a homework club.
Not all the shops in the village are open on Sundays.
Not all dogs like water. Ours hates baths.
Not all teenagers spend their free time online.
Not all the rooms have a sea view, so book early.
Not all of us have the energy to go to the gym regularly.
Not all of them were happy with the result.
Not all of you will need a ticket. Children under five travel free.
The tickets were cheap, but not all of the seats were good.
I like most vegetables, but not all of them.
He goes to the gym often, but not every day.
Not everyone came to the meeting, but most people did.
The snow was heavy, but not every airline cancelled its flights. Ours left on time.
Not all the eggs were broken. We saved six of them.
Not all my friends could come, but the ones who came had a great time.

examples.heading: ① Not everyone / Not everybody + 單數動詞

items.en: The school trip is to a football match, but not everyone likes football.
items.zh: 校外教學是去看足球賽，可是不是每個人都喜歡足球。

items.en: Not everyone can afford a holiday abroad every year.
items.zh: 不是每個人都負擔得起每年出國度假。

items.en: Not everybody agrees with the new rules about phones in class.
items.zh: 不是每個人都同意上課用手機的新規定。

items.en: The film was popular, but not everyone enjoyed the ending.
items.zh: 那部電影很受歡迎，可是不是每個人都喜歡結局。

items.en: Not everybody wants to live in a big city.
items.zh: 不是每個人都想住在大城市。

items.en: Not everyone in my family eats meat, so we cook two dinners.
items.zh: 我家不是每個人都吃肉，所以我們煮兩種晚餐。

examples.heading: ② Not everything + 單數動詞

items.en: Not everything was as good as we expected. The hotel was noisy.
items.zh: 不是每件事都像我們預期的那麼好。飯店很吵。

items.en: Not everything you read online is true.
items.zh: 你在網路上讀到的東西不一定都是真的。

items.en: Not everything in the shop is expensive. Look at these mugs.
items.zh: 這家店不是每樣東西都很貴。你看這些馬克杯。

items.en: I enjoyed the course, but not everything was easy.
items.zh: 我很喜歡這門課，可是不是每樣東西都簡單。

items.en: Not everything went to plan, but the wedding was lovely.
items.zh: 不是每件事都照計畫進行，可是婚禮很美。

examples.heading: ③ Not every + 單數名詞 + 單數動詞

items.en: Not every cyclist is a danger to the public. Most of them obey the rules.
items.zh: 不是每個騎腳踏車的人都會危害大眾。他們大部分都守規矩。

items.en: Not every student can attend the study centre. It closes at five, and some lessons finish at five.
items.zh: 不是每個學生都能去自習中心。它五點就關門，而有些課五點才下課。

items.en: Not every hotel in town has a car park.
items.zh: 城裡不是每家飯店都有停車場。

items.en: Not every day is sunny here, so bring an umbrella.
items.zh: 這裡不是每天都晴天，所以帶把傘。

items.en: Not every child enjoys school trips.
items.zh: 不是每個孩子都喜歡校外教學。

examples.heading: ④ Not all + 名詞 + 複數動詞

items.en: Not all parents have time to help with homework, so the school runs a homework club.
items.zh: 不是所有家長都有時間幫忙看功課，所以學校辦了課後作業班。

items.en: Not all the shops in the village are open on Sundays.
items.zh: 村子裡不是每家店星期天都有開。

items.en: Not all dogs like water. Ours hates baths.
items.zh: 不是所有的狗都喜歡水。我們家的狗討厭洗澡。

items.en: Not all teenagers spend their free time online.
items.zh: 不是所有青少年都把空閒時間花在網路上。

items.en: Not all the rooms have a sea view, so book early.
items.zh: 不是每間房間都看得到海，所以早點訂。

examples.heading: ⑤ Not all of + 代名詞 + 複數動詞

items.en: Not all of us have the energy to go to the gym regularly.
items.zh: 不是我們每個人都有精力定期上健身房。

items.en: Not all of them were happy with the result.
items.zh: 不是他們每個人都滿意這個結果。

items.en: Not all of you will need a ticket. Children under five travel free.
items.zh: 不是你們每個人都需要買票。五歲以下的兒童免費。

examples.heading: ⑥ 句中的 not all / not every

items.en: The tickets were cheap, but not all of the seats were good.
items.zh: 票很便宜，可是不是每個座位都好。

items.en: I like most vegetables, but not all of them.
items.zh: 大部分的蔬菜我都喜歡，可是不是全部。

items.en: He goes to the gym often, but not every day.
items.zh: 他常去健身房，可是不是每天都去。

examples.heading: ⑦ 部分否定，後面說另一部分

items.en: Not everyone came to the meeting, but most people did.
items.zh: 不是每個人都來開會，可是大部分人都來了。

items.en: The snow was heavy, but not every airline cancelled its flights. Ours left on time.
items.zh: 雪下得很大，可是不是每家航空公司都取消了航班。我們那班準時起飛。

items.en: Not all the eggs were broken. We saved six of them.
items.zh: 不是每顆蛋都破了。我們救回了六顆。

items.en: Not all my friends could come, but the ones who came had a great time.
items.zh: 不是我所有的朋友都能來，可是來的人都玩得很開心。

title: It was written by an excellent author, Leo Tolstoy.
translation: 它是一位很優秀的作家 Leo Tolstoy 寫的。
name: 被動語態加 by 補充資訊
sentences: My favourite book is Anna Karenina. It was written by an excellent author, Leo Tolstoy.
I love this bike. It was bought by my uncle for my birthday.
Look at this photo of the beach. It was taken by my sister.
We stayed in an old hotel in Rome. It was built by a rich family in 1890.
Have you seen the painting in our hall? It was painted by my grandmother.
The cake at the party was great. It was made by Tom's mum.
Our school has two new computer rooms. They were paid for by a local company.
The song at the end of the film was beautiful. It was sung by a girl from my town.
I found an old letter in the attic. It was written by my great-grandfather.
We can't open the shop today. The windows at the front were broken by the storm last night.
I've got a new phone. It's made by Sony.
My mum watches a cooking show every Sunday. It's presented by a famous chef.
Our town has a small museum. It's visited by thousands of tourists every summer.
I joined a chess club last month. It's run by two retired teachers.
I bought these bags at the market. They're made by women in a small village in Peru.
Look at the name on our new shirts. Our football team is sponsored by the bakery on the corner.
We always get a discount at the shop downstairs. It's owned by my best friend's parents.
The food in this restaurant is very fresh. Most of the vegetables are grown by local farmers.
We watched Romeo and Juliet at the theatre. The play was written by Shakespeare.
Next to the bridge there's a tall statue. The statue was designed by a student.
My brother gave me a book about space. The book was signed by the writer.
There's a new café on Main Street. The café is run by two sisters from Italy.
We have a small garden behind the house. The garden is looked after by my dad.
There was a big storm last night. The old tree in the park was hit by lightning.
My grandparents couldn't leave their house for days. The village was surrounded by water after the heavy rain.
Most of the buildings here are new. Half the town was destroyed by a fire in 1850.
The road to the beach was blocked by snow, so we went home.
"Who made this lovely dress?" "It was made by my aunt."
"That's a great picture. Who took it?" "It was taken by a friend of mine."
"Do you know who designed this building?" "Yes, it was designed by a Japanese architect."
"Who's going to drive us?" "We're being picked up by Lucy's dad."

examples.heading: ① was / were + 過去分詞 + by：過去的事

items.en: My favourite book is Anna Karenina. It was written by an excellent author, Leo Tolstoy.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的書是《安娜·卡列尼娜》。它是一位很優秀的作家 Leo Tolstoy 寫的。

items.en: I love this bike. It was bought by my uncle for my birthday.
items.zh: 我很愛這台腳踏車。是我叔叔買給我當生日禮物的。

items.en: Look at this photo of the beach. It was taken by my sister.
items.zh: 你看這張海灘的照片。是我姊姊拍的。

items.en: We stayed in an old hotel in Rome. It was built by a rich family in 1890.
items.zh: 我們住在羅馬一間老旅館。那是一個有錢人家在 1890 年蓋的。

items.en: Have you seen the painting in our hall? It was painted by my grandmother.
items.zh: 你看過我們走廊上那幅畫嗎？那是我外婆畫的。

items.en: The cake at the party was great. It was made by Tom's mum.
items.zh: 派對上的蛋糕很好吃。是 Tom 的媽媽做的。

items.en: Our school has two new computer rooms. They were paid for by a local company.
items.zh: 我們學校有兩間新的電腦教室。是本地一家公司出的錢。

items.en: The song at the end of the film was beautiful. It was sung by a girl from my town.
items.zh: 電影最後那首歌很好聽。是我們鎮上一個女生唱的。

items.en: I found an old letter in the attic. It was written by my great-grandfather.
items.zh: 我在閣樓找到一封舊信。是我曾祖父寫的。

items.en: We can't open the shop today. The windows at the front were broken by the storm last night.
items.zh: 我們今天不能開店。前面的窗戶昨晚被暴風雨打破了。

examples.heading: ② is / are + 過去分詞 + by：現在的事

items.en: I've got a new phone. It's made by Sony.
items.zh: 我買了一支新手機。是 Sony 做的。

items.en: My mum watches a cooking show every Sunday. It's presented by a famous chef.
items.zh: 我媽媽每個星期天都看一個烹飪節目。節目是一位有名的廚師主持的。

items.en: Our town has a small museum. It's visited by thousands of tourists every summer.
items.zh: 我們鎮上有一座小博物館。每年夏天有好幾千名遊客來參觀。

items.en: I joined a chess club last month. It's run by two retired teachers.
items.zh: 我上個月參加了一個西洋棋社。社團是兩位退休老師在經營的。

items.en: I bought these bags at the market. They're made by women in a small village in Peru.
items.zh: 我在市集買了這些包包。它們是秘魯一個小村莊裡的婦女做的。

items.en: Look at the name on our new shirts. Our football team is sponsored by the bakery on the corner.
items.zh: 你看我們新球衣上的名字。我們的足球隊是轉角那家麵包店贊助的。

items.en: We always get a discount at the shop downstairs. It's owned by my best friend's parents.
items.zh: 我們在樓下那家店買東西都有折扣。那家店是我最好朋友的爸媽開的。

items.en: The food in this restaurant is very fresh. Most of the vegetables are grown by local farmers.
items.zh: 這家餐廳的食物很新鮮。大部分的蔬菜是本地農夫種的。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞是前面提過的名詞

items.en: We watched Romeo and Juliet at the theatre. The play was written by Shakespeare.
items.zh: 我們在劇院看了《羅密歐與茱麗葉》。這齣戲是莎士比亞寫的。

items.en: Next to the bridge there's a tall statue. The statue was designed by a student.
items.zh: 橋旁邊有一座很高的雕像。這座雕像是一個學生設計的。

items.en: My brother gave me a book about space. The book was signed by the writer.
items.zh: 我哥哥送我一本講太空的書。這本書有作者的簽名。

items.en: There's a new café on Main Street. The café is run by two sisters from Italy.
items.zh: 大街上開了一家新的咖啡店。這家店是兩個從義大利來的姊妹在經營的。

items.en: We have a small garden behind the house. The garden is looked after by my dad.
items.zh: 我們家後面有一個小花園。花園是我爸爸在照顧的。

examples.heading: ④ by 後面接東西

items.en: There was a big storm last night. The old tree in the park was hit by lightning.
items.zh: 昨晚有一場大暴風雨。公園裡那棵老樹被閃電打到了。

items.en: My grandparents couldn't leave their house for days. The village was surrounded by water after the heavy rain.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶好幾天不能出門。大雨過後，村子四周都是水。

items.en: Most of the buildings here are new. Half the town was destroyed by a fire in 1850.
items.zh: 這裡大部分的建築都是新的。這個鎮有一半在 1850 年的一場火災裡燒毀了。

items.en: The road to the beach was blocked by snow, so we went home.
items.zh: 往海灘的路被雪擋住了，所以我們就回家了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問答

items.en: "Who made this lovely dress?" "It was made by my aunt."
items.zh: 這件漂亮的洋裝是誰做的？是我阿姨做的。

items.en: "That's a great picture. Who took it?" "It was taken by a friend of mine."
items.zh: 這張照片拍得真好。誰拍的？我一個朋友拍的。

items.en: "Do you know who designed this building?" "Yes, it was designed by a Japanese architect."
items.zh: 你知道這棟樓是誰設計的嗎？知道，是一位日本建築師設計的。

items.en: "Who's going to drive us?" "We're being picked up by Lucy's dad."
items.zh: 誰要載我們？Lucy 的爸爸會來接我們。

title: It was built in 1880.
translation: 它是 1880 年蓋的。
name: 過去簡單式被動語態的肯定句（單數主詞）
sentences: Our house is very old. It was built in 1880.
I love my watch. It was given to me by my grandad.
The letter came yesterday. It was sent from Canada.
We went to the castle on Sunday. It was built nine hundred years ago.
The film was really good. It was made in Spain.
I bought a cheap old guitar. It was made in the 1970s.
On Saturday morning, I was invited to a sports competition.
I grew up in the mountains, but I was born in a small village near the sea.
I was asked to give a short speech at my sister's wedding.
Sorry I didn't bring a present. I was told about the party at the last minute.
Guess what, Mum! I was chosen for the school football team today.
My brother fell off his bike. He was taken to hospital.
She was offered a job in London, so she moved there.
My uncle was late for dinner. He was stopped by the police for driving too fast.
My mum is fifty this year. She was born in 1975.
Our baby is called Arthur. He was named after his grandfather.
I walked to school today. My bike was stolen last night.
Our guide stopped by the river. The old bridge was opened in 1932.
We had a long holiday in January. The school was closed for a week because of the snow.
We didn't see the band in the end. The concert was cancelled because the singer was ill.
We did a lot of work on the house. The kitchen was painted yellow last summer.
Good news! My phone was found in the back of a taxi.
We were all wet when we got home. The game was played in the rain.
The hotel was lovely. Breakfast was served in the garden every morning.
Do you like this photo of the lake? It was taken by my dad on holiday.
Everyone asks about the picture in our hall. It was painted by my aunt.
The kids were playing in the garden, and the kitchen window was broken by a football.
"When was this church built?" "It was built in 1650."
"Where's your car?" "It was taken to the garage this morning."
"Why was the match stopped?" "A player was hurt."
"Did you get the job?" "Yes! I was offered it yesterday."

examples.heading: ① It was + 過去分詞

items.en: Our house is very old. It was built in 1880.
items.zh: 我們家的房子很老。它是 1880 年蓋的。

items.en: I love my watch. It was given to me by my grandad.
items.zh: 我很愛我的手錶。是我爺爺送我的。

items.en: The letter came yesterday. It was sent from Canada.
items.zh: 信昨天到了。是從加拿大寄來的。

items.en: We went to the castle on Sunday. It was built nine hundred years ago.
items.zh: 我們星期天去了城堡。它是九百年前蓋的。

items.en: The film was really good. It was made in Spain.
items.zh: 那部電影很好看。是在西班牙拍的。

items.en: I bought a cheap old guitar. It was made in the 1970s.
items.zh: 我買了一把便宜的舊吉他。是 1970 年代做的。

examples.heading: ② I was + 過去分詞

items.en: On Saturday morning, I was invited to a sports competition.
items.zh: 星期六早上，我受邀去參加一場運動比賽。

items.en: I grew up in the mountains, but I was born in a small village near the sea.
items.zh: 我在山上長大，可是我出生在海邊的一個小村莊。

items.en: I was asked to give a short speech at my sister's wedding.
items.zh: 我被請去在我姊姊的婚禮上講幾句話。

items.en: Sorry I didn't bring a present. I was told about the party at the last minute.
items.zh: 抱歉我沒帶禮物。派對的事到最後一刻才有人告訴我。

items.en: Guess what, Mum! I was chosen for the school football team today.
items.zh: 媽，你猜怎樣！我今天被選進學校足球隊了。

examples.heading: ③ He / She was + 過去分詞

items.en: My brother fell off his bike. He was taken to hospital.
items.zh: 我弟弟從腳踏車上摔下來。他被送去醫院了。

items.en: She was offered a job in London, so she moved there.
items.zh: 她得到倫敦的一份工作，所以搬去那裡。

items.en: My uncle was late for dinner. He was stopped by the police for driving too fast.
items.zh: 我叔叔晚餐遲到了。他開太快被警察攔下來。

items.en: My mum is fifty this year. She was born in 1975.
items.zh: 我媽媽今年五十歲。她是 1975 年出生的。

items.en: Our baby is called Arthur. He was named after his grandfather.
items.zh: 我們的寶寶叫 Arthur。他是照他爺爺的名字取名的。

examples.heading: ④ 單數名詞 + was + 過去分詞

items.en: I walked to school today. My bike was stolen last night.
items.zh: 我今天走路上學。我的腳踏車昨晚被偷了。

items.en: Our guide stopped by the river. The old bridge was opened in 1932.
items.zh: 導遊在河邊停下來。這座舊橋是 1932 年通車的。

items.en: We had a long holiday in January. The school was closed for a week because of the snow.
items.zh: 我們一月放了很長的假。學校因為下雪停課一個星期。

items.en: We didn't see the band in the end. The concert was cancelled because the singer was ill.
items.zh: 我們最後沒看到那個樂團。因為歌手生病，演唱會取消了。

items.en: We did a lot of work on the house. The kitchen was painted yellow last summer.
items.zh: 我們家整修了很多地方。廚房去年夏天漆成了黃色。

items.en: Good news! My phone was found in the back of a taxi.
items.zh: 好消息！我的手機在一台計程車的後座找到了。

items.en: We were all wet when we got home. The game was played in the rain.
items.zh: 我們回到家全身都濕了。那場比賽是在雨中比的。

items.en: The hotel was lovely. Breakfast was served in the garden every morning.
items.zh: 那間旅館很棒。每天早上早餐都在花園裡供應。

examples.heading: ⑤ was + 過去分詞 + by

items.en: Do you like this photo of the lake? It was taken by my dad on holiday.
items.zh: 你喜歡這張湖的照片嗎？是我爸爸度假時拍的。

items.en: Everyone asks about the picture in our hall. It was painted by my aunt.
items.zh: 每個人都會問我們走廊上那幅畫。那是我阿姨畫的。

items.en: The kids were playing in the garden, and the kitchen window was broken by a football.
items.zh: 孩子們在院子裡玩，廚房的窗戶被一顆足球打破了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問答

items.en: "When was this church built?" "It was built in 1650."
items.zh: 這座教堂是什麼時候蓋的？1650 年蓋的。

items.en: "Where's your car?" "It was taken to the garage this morning."
items.zh: 你的車呢？今天早上送去修車廠了。

items.en: "Why was the match stopped?" "A player was hurt."
items.zh: 比賽為什麼停下來了？有一個球員受傷了。

items.en: "Did you get the job?" "Yes! I was offered it yesterday."
items.zh: 你拿到那份工作了嗎？拿到了！昨天通知我錄取了。

title: The group is called Playmo.
translation: 這個團體叫做 Playmo。
name: 現在簡單式被動語態的肯定句（單數主詞）
sentences: My favourite band has four singers. The group is called Playmo.
I've got a new cat. She's called Lulu.
We stayed in a small town near the coast. It's called Whitby.
There's a great café on our street. It's called The Blue Cup.
My best friend lives next door. He's called Ben.
I'm reading a book about a dog. It's called Lost in the Snow.
I bought a T-shirt for £42 because it is made of cotton.
My grandad gave me this box. It's made of wood.
Try this cheese. It's made from goat's milk.
This bread is really good. It's made from rice flour.
My new bike is light and fast. It's made in Taiwan.
Don't put that cup in the microwave. It's made of metal.
We don't sleep in the small room. It's used as my mum's office.
Our town is near the border. French is spoken in a lot of shops.
You can't buy this tea in the supermarket. It's only sold at the market on Saturday.
This app is great for students. It's used in a lot of schools.
Don't worry about the mess. Our classroom is cleaned every evening after school.
Your letter should arrive soon. The post is delivered at about ten every morning.
Welcome to the summer camp. Lunch is served in the hall at twelve o'clock.
The museum is closed on Mondays, so let's go on Tuesday.
My mum starts work very early. My little sister is taken to school by my dad.
My uncle is a doctor. He's paid very well.
Our village is surrounded by hills, so it's very quiet.
This beach is visited by a lot of tourists in summer.
My brother is good at football. He's known as the fastest player in the team.
The castle is open again. It's looked after by a group of volunteers.
"What's your dog called?" "He's called Max."
"What's this bag made of?" "It's made of leather."
"Where's this coffee from?" "It's grown in Brazil."
"Can I park here?" "No, sorry. This space is kept for the doctor."
"Is breakfast extra?" "No, it's included in the price of the room."

examples.heading: ① is called：說名字

items.en: My favourite band has four singers. The group is called Playmo.
items.zh: 我最喜歡的樂團有四個歌手。這個團體叫做 Playmo。

items.en: I've got a new cat. She's called Lulu.
items.zh: 我養了一隻新的貓。她叫 Lulu。

items.en: We stayed in a small town near the coast. It's called Whitby.
items.zh: 我們住在海邊附近的一個小鎮。那裡叫 Whitby。

items.en: There's a great café on our street. It's called The Blue Cup.
items.zh: 我們這條街有一家很棒的咖啡店。叫 The Blue Cup。

items.en: My best friend lives next door. He's called Ben.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友住在隔壁。他叫 Ben。

items.en: I'm reading a book about a dog. It's called Lost in the Snow.
items.zh: 我在看一本講一隻狗的書。書名叫《雪中迷路》。

examples.heading: ② is made of / from / in

items.en: I bought a T-shirt for £42 because it is made of cotton.
items.zh: 我買了一件 42 英鎊的 T 恤，因為它是棉做的。

items.en: My grandad gave me this box. It's made of wood.
items.zh: 我爺爺給了我這個盒子。它是木頭做的。

items.en: Try this cheese. It's made from goat's milk.
items.zh: 吃吃看這個起司。它是羊奶做的。

items.en: This bread is really good. It's made from rice flour.
items.zh: 這個麵包很好吃。它是用米磨的粉做的。

items.en: My new bike is light and fast. It's made in Taiwan.
items.zh: 我的新腳踏車又輕又快。它是台灣製造的。

items.en: Don't put that cup in the microwave. It's made of metal.
items.zh: 那個杯子不要放進微波爐。它是金屬做的。

examples.heading: ③ is used / spoken / sold

items.en: We don't sleep in the small room. It's used as my mum's office.
items.zh: 我們不睡那個小房間。那裡拿來當我媽媽的辦公室。

items.en: Our town is near the border. French is spoken in a lot of shops.
items.zh: 我們鎮靠近邊界。很多店都說法語。

items.en: You can't buy this tea in the supermarket. It's only sold at the market on Saturday.
items.zh: 你在超市買不到這種茶。它只在星期六的市集賣。

items.en: This app is great for students. It's used in a lot of schools.
items.zh: 這個應用程式很適合學生。很多學校都在用。

examples.heading: ④ is + 過去分詞：常常發生的事

items.en: Don't worry about the mess. Our classroom is cleaned every evening after school.
items.zh: 別擔心這麼亂。我們的教室每天放學後都會打掃。

items.en: Your letter should arrive soon. The post is delivered at about ten every morning.
items.zh: 你的信應該快到了。郵件每天早上大約十點送來。

items.en: Welcome to the summer camp. Lunch is served in the hall at twelve o'clock.
items.zh: 歡迎來到夏令營。午餐十二點在禮堂供應。

items.en: The museum is closed on Mondays, so let's go on Tuesday.
items.zh: 博物館星期一休館，我們星期二去吧。

items.en: My mum starts work very early. My little sister is taken to school by my dad.
items.zh: 我媽媽很早就要上班。我妹妹是我爸爸送去學校的。

examples.heading: ⑤ is + 過去分詞：說人或地方

items.en: My uncle is a doctor. He's paid very well.
items.zh: 我叔叔是醫生。他的薪水很高。

items.en: Our village is surrounded by hills, so it's very quiet.
items.zh: 我們村子四周都是山，所以很安靜。

items.en: This beach is visited by a lot of tourists in summer.
items.zh: 這個海灘夏天有很多遊客來。

items.en: My brother is good at football. He's known as the fastest player in the team.
items.zh: 我哥哥很會踢足球。大家都知道他是隊上跑最快的。

items.en: The castle is open again. It's looked after by a group of volunteers.
items.zh: 城堡又開放了。它是一群志工在照顧的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問答

items.en: "What's your dog called?" "He's called Max."
items.zh: 你的狗叫什麼名字？他叫 Max。

items.en: "What's this bag made of?" "It's made of leather."
items.zh: 這個包包是什麼做的？是皮做的。

items.en: "Where's this coffee from?" "It's grown in Brazil."
items.zh: 這個咖啡是哪裡來的？是巴西種的。

items.en: "Can I park here?" "No, sorry. This space is kept for the doctor."
items.zh: 我可以停這裡嗎？不行，抱歉。這個車位是留給醫生的。

items.en: "Is breakfast extra?" "No, it's included in the price of the room."
items.zh: 早餐要另外付錢嗎？不用，含在房價裡。

title: Last week my husband's car got stolen from our garage.
translation: 上禮拜我先生的車在我們家車庫被偷了。
name: get 被動語態
sentences: I've got bad news. Last week my husband's car got stolen from our garage.
I bought a new mirror because mine got broken when we moved.
We got lost in the forest and walked for hours.
My brother got bitten by a dog on his way to school.
The thief got caught by the police the next day.
Two people got hurt in the accident, but not badly.
I like my weekend job. We get paid well, and the hours are short.
My little brother talks too much in class. He gets told off almost every day.
Our street is narrow, so cars often get damaged.
He's so popular. He gets invited to every party.
In winter, the road gets closed when it snows.
You should be careful while you are crossing, or you will get hurt.
Don't leave your bike there. It'll get stolen.
If you don't hurry, you'll get left behind.
Put your phone away, or it might get broken.
We have new staff, so we want them to get trained properly.
I need to get paid before I can buy the tickets.
She doesn't want to get involved in their argument.
The teachers watch very carefully. It's easy to get caught if you cheat.
This photo is from their wedding. My parents got married in 1995.
I was nearly late for my flight. My bag got searched at the airport.
I got paid on Friday, so let's go out for dinner.
We worked hard and got paid well, so I saved money for my studies.
She got promoted after only a year in the company.
Look out! The paint is getting washed off by the rain.
More and more forests are getting cut down every year.
My phone has got broken again. This is the third time!
Hurry up! The best seats are getting taken.
I didn't get invited to the wedding. I'm a bit upset.
"Did anyone get hurt?" "No, everyone's fine."
"When do you get paid?" "On the last day of the month."

examples.heading: ① got + 過去分詞：意外和壞事

items.en: I've got bad news. Last week my husband's car got stolen from our garage.
items.zh: 我有壞消息。上禮拜我先生的車在我們家車庫被偷了。

items.en: I bought a new mirror because mine got broken when we moved.
items.zh: 我買了一面新鏡子，因為我的在搬家時打破了。

items.en: We got lost in the forest and walked for hours.
items.zh: 我們在森林裡迷路，走了好幾個小時。

items.en: My brother got bitten by a dog on his way to school.
items.zh: 我弟弟上學途中被狗咬了。

items.en: The thief got caught by the police the next day.
items.zh: 小偷隔天被警察抓到了。

items.en: Two people got hurt in the accident, but not badly.
items.zh: 有兩個人在車禍中受傷，可是不嚴重。

examples.heading: ② get / gets + 過去分詞：常常發生的事

items.en: I like my weekend job. We get paid well, and the hours are short.
items.zh: 我喜歡我的週末工作。薪水很好，時數又短。

items.en: My little brother talks too much in class. He gets told off almost every day.
items.zh: 我弟弟上課太愛講話。他幾乎每天都被罵。

items.en: Our street is narrow, so cars often get damaged.
items.zh: 我們這條街很窄，所以車子常被刮到。

items.en: He's so popular. He gets invited to every party.
items.zh: 他很受歡迎。每個派對都邀請他。

items.en: In winter, the road gets closed when it snows.
items.zh: 冬天下雪的時候，這條路會封起來。

examples.heading: ③ will / might get + 過去分詞

items.en: You should be careful while you are crossing, or you will get hurt.
items.zh: 你過馬路要小心，不然會受傷。

items.en: Don't leave your bike there. It'll get stolen.
items.zh: 別把腳踏車停在那裡。會被偷。

items.en: If you don't hurry, you'll get left behind.
items.zh: 你要是不快一點，就會被丟下。

items.en: Put your phone away, or it might get broken.
items.zh: 把手機收起來，不然可能會摔壞。

examples.heading: ④ to get + 過去分詞

items.en: We have new staff, so we want them to get trained properly.
items.zh: 我們有新員工，所以希望他們好好受訓。

items.en: I need to get paid before I can buy the tickets.
items.zh: 我要先領到薪水才能買票。

items.en: She doesn't want to get involved in their argument.
items.zh: 她不想被捲入他們的爭吵。

items.en: The teachers watch very carefully. It's easy to get caught if you cheat.
items.zh: 老師們看得很仔細。作弊很容易被抓到。

examples.heading: ⑤ 生活中的變化

items.en: This photo is from their wedding. My parents got married in 1995.
items.zh: 這張照片是他們婚禮拍的。我爸媽 1995 年結婚。

items.en: I was nearly late for my flight. My bag got searched at the airport.
items.zh: 我差點趕不上飛機。我的包包在機場被搜查了。

items.en: I got paid on Friday, so let's go out for dinner.
items.zh: 我星期五領了薪水，所以我們出去吃晚餐吧。

items.en: We worked hard and got paid well, so I saved money for my studies.
items.zh: 我們很努力工作，薪水也很好，所以我存了錢讀書。

items.en: She got promoted after only a year in the company.
items.zh: 她進公司才一年就升職了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 進行式和完成式

items.en: Look out! The paint is getting washed off by the rain.
items.zh: 小心！油漆被雨沖掉了。

items.en: More and more forests are getting cut down every year.
items.zh: 每年有愈來愈多森林被砍掉。

items.en: My phone has got broken again. This is the third time!
items.zh: 我的手機又壞了。這是第三次了！

items.en: Hurry up! The best seats are getting taken.
items.zh: 快點！好位子都快被坐走了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 否定句和問句

items.en: I didn't get invited to the wedding. I'm a bit upset.
items.zh: 婚禮沒有邀請我。我有點難過。

items.en: "Did anyone get hurt?" "No, everyone's fine."
items.zh: 有人受傷嗎？沒有，大家都沒事。

items.en: "When do you get paid?" "On the last day of the month."
items.zh: 你什麼時候領薪水？每個月最後一天。

title: You could get yourself killed if you don't drive carefully enough.
translation: 你開車要是不夠小心，可能會害死自己。
name: get 加反身代名詞加過去分詞
sentences: Driving is dangerous. You could get yourself killed if you don't drive carefully enough.
Don't climb on the roof. You'll get yourself hurt.
Stop shouting at the police, or you'll get yourself arrested.
Be careful what you say to the boss. You might get yourself sacked.
Don't get yourself involved in their problems. It's not your business.
He has a charming personality, but he uses it to get himself involved in illegal activities.
My cousin got himself arrested at a football match last year.
She got herself invited to the party by saying she knew the band.
He wasn't careful with the knife and got himself cut.
The new boy got himself noticed by the teachers on his first day.
I got myself locked out of the house again. Can I wait at yours?
We got ourselves lost in the old town, so we took a taxi back.
I don't want to get myself involved in office politics.
We got ourselves invited to dinner by asking lots of questions about their garden.
Some fans got themselves thrown out of the stadium for fighting.
The children got themselves covered in mud in the garden.
Every summer, tourists get themselves burnt on the beach.
They got themselves banned from the shop for stealing sweets.
She worked hard and got herself promoted within a year.
He finally got himself elected to the city council.
Get yourself checked by a doctor if the pain doesn't go away.
I need to get myself organised before the exams.
How did you get yourself stuck in the lift?
He's always getting himself told off at school for talking.
She has got herself banned from driving for a year.
If you keep doing that, you're going to get yourself hurt.
They were trying not to get themselves noticed.
"Why is Ben at home?" "He got himself suspended from school for fighting."
"Why are you all wet?" "I went out without an umbrella and got myself caught in the rain."
"Should I tell my boss what I think?" "Not unless you want to get yourself fired!"
"What happened to your arm?" "I tried to pick up the neighbour's cat and got myself scratched."

examples.heading: ① get yourself + 過去分詞：提醒和警告

items.en: Driving is dangerous. You could get yourself killed if you don't drive carefully enough.
items.zh: 開車很危險。你開車要是不夠小心，可能會害死自己。

items.en: Don't climb on the roof. You'll get yourself hurt.
items.zh: 別爬到屋頂上。你會把自己弄傷。

items.en: Stop shouting at the police, or you'll get yourself arrested.
items.zh: 別再對警察大吼了，不然你會被抓。

items.en: Be careful what you say to the boss. You might get yourself sacked.
items.zh: 跟老闆說話小心一點。你可能會被開除。

items.en: Don't get yourself involved in their problems. It's not your business.
items.zh: 別把自己捲進他們的問題。那不關你的事。

examples.heading: ② got himself / herself + 過去分詞

items.en: He has a charming personality, but he uses it to get himself involved in illegal activities.
items.zh: 他的個性很迷人，可是他用這一點讓自己捲入違法的活動。

items.en: My cousin got himself arrested at a football match last year.
items.zh: 我表哥去年在一場足球賽被警察抓了。

items.en: She got herself invited to the party by saying she knew the band.
items.zh: 她說她認識那個樂團，讓自己受邀參加了派對。

items.en: He wasn't careful with the knife and got himself cut.
items.zh: 他用刀不小心，割傷了自己。

items.en: The new boy got himself noticed by the teachers on his first day.
items.zh: 那個新來的男孩第一天就引起了老師的注意。

examples.heading: ③ get myself / ourselves + 過去分詞

items.en: I got myself locked out of the house again. Can I wait at yours?
items.zh: 我又把自己鎖在門外了。我可以在你家等嗎？

items.en: We got ourselves lost in the old town, so we took a taxi back.
items.zh: 我們在舊城區把自己搞丟了，所以搭計程車回去。

items.en: I don't want to get myself involved in office politics.
items.zh: 我不想讓自己捲入辦公室的政治。

items.en: We got ourselves invited to dinner by asking lots of questions about their garden.
items.zh: 我們問了很多他們花園的事，結果被邀請去吃晚餐。

examples.heading: ④ get themselves + 過去分詞

items.en: Some fans got themselves thrown out of the stadium for fighting.
items.zh: 有些球迷因為打架被趕出球場。

items.en: The children got themselves covered in mud in the garden.
items.zh: 孩子們在花園裡弄得全身是泥巴。

items.en: Every summer, tourists get themselves burnt on the beach.
items.zh: 每年夏天都有觀光客在海灘上曬傷。

items.en: They got themselves banned from the shop for stealing sweets.
items.zh: 他們因為偷糖果被禁止進那家店。

examples.heading: ⑤ 好的結果

items.en: She worked hard and got herself promoted within a year.
items.zh: 她很努力，一年內就讓自己升職了。

items.en: He finally got himself elected to the city council.
items.zh: 他終於讓自己當選市議員了。

items.en: Get yourself checked by a doctor if the pain doesn't go away.
items.zh: 如果痛一直不好，去給醫生檢查一下。

items.en: I need to get myself organised before the exams.
items.zh: 考試前我得把自己的事安排好。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的時態

items.en: How did you get yourself stuck in the lift?
items.zh: 你怎麼會被困在電梯裡？

items.en: He's always getting himself told off at school for talking.
items.zh: 他在學校老是因為講話被罵。

items.en: She has got herself banned from driving for a year.
items.zh: 她被吊銷駕照一年。

items.en: If you keep doing that, you're going to get yourself hurt.
items.zh: 你再那樣做下去，會把自己弄傷。

items.en: They were trying not to get themselves noticed.
items.zh: 他們盡量不讓自己被注意到。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Why is Ben at home?" "He got himself suspended from school for fighting."
items.zh: Ben 為什麼在家？他打架被學校停學了。

items.en: "Why are you all wet?" "I went out without an umbrella and got myself caught in the rain."
items.zh: 你怎麼全身濕透？我沒帶傘出門，結果被雨淋了。

items.en: "Should I tell my boss what I think?" "Not unless you want to get yourself fired!"
items.zh: 我應該跟老闆說我的想法嗎？除非你想被炒魷魚！

items.en: "What happened to your arm?" "I tried to pick up the neighbour's cat and got myself scratched."
items.zh: 你的手臂怎麼了？我想抱鄰居的貓，結果被抓傷了。

title: It is going to be shown this Friday.
translation: 它這個星期五會播出。
name: 不定詞的被動語態
sentences: They filmed our school for a TV programme. It is going to be shown this Friday.
Take a photo of it now. Our old school building is going to be knocked down next year.
Don't eat all the cake. It's going to be served at the party tonight.
We finished the exams today. The results are going to be announced on Monday morning.
Grandma's birthday is next week. She's going to be given a surprise party.
The match has been moved. It's going to be played on Sunday instead.
You can come on the trip, but this form has to be signed by your parents.
After that, they printed a form which had to be signed by my parents because I'm under eighteen.
Our teacher was very clear. All essays have to be handed in by Friday.
I work at a hotel on Saturdays. The rooms have to be cleaned before the next guests arrive.
I was busy on the last day of term. The library books had to be returned before the holidays.
Don't leave it on the table. This medicine has to be kept in the fridge.
Look at the grass. It needs to be cut.
My bike is making a strange noise. It needs to be repaired.
We leave for camp on Saturday. These shirts need to be washed before the trip.
Thanks for looking after our flat. The plants need to be watered every two days.
Nobody had lived in the house for years. The windows were so dirty they needed to be cleaned twice.
Welcome to the airport hotel, sir. Your passport needs to be checked at the desk.
Please send me the numbers soon. My manager wants to be informed about sales by the end of November.
I don't want to be disturbed while I'm studying, so I turned my phone off.
Nobody wants to be left out, so we invited the whole class.
My little brother wants to be taken to the zoo for his birthday.
My sister changed her clothes before the party. She didn't want to be seen in her school uniform.
Tom and Anna are getting married. I'd like to be invited to their wedding.
Our kids always ask for a story. They love to be read to at bedtime.
The trials for the school team are tomorrow. I hope to be chosen this year.
"When are the photos going to be printed?" "Tomorrow, I think."
"Does this have to be done today?" "Yes, before five."
"Why are you taking the car to the garage?" "The brakes need to be checked."
"Do you want to be picked up from the station?" "Yes, please. My train gets in at six."
"Is your room going to be painted?" "Yes, my dad is doing it this weekend."

examples.heading: ① going to be + 過去分詞

items.en: They filmed our school for a TV programme. It is going to be shown this Friday.
items.zh: 他們為一個電視節目來我們學校拍片。它這個星期五會播出。

items.en: Take a photo of it now. Our old school building is going to be knocked down next year.
items.zh: 現在拍張照吧。我們學校的舊大樓明年要拆了。

items.en: Don't eat all the cake. It's going to be served at the party tonight.
items.zh: 蛋糕不要吃光。今晚派對要端出來的。

items.en: We finished the exams today. The results are going to be announced on Monday morning.
items.zh: 我們今天考完了。結果星期一早上會公布。

items.en: Grandma's birthday is next week. She's going to be given a surprise party.
items.zh: 奶奶下星期生日。會有人幫她辦一個驚喜派對。

items.en: The match has been moved. It's going to be played on Sunday instead.
items.zh: 比賽改時間了。改到星期天比。

examples.heading: ② have to be + 過去分詞

items.en: You can come on the trip, but this form has to be signed by your parents.
items.zh: 你可以參加旅行，可是這張表格必須讓你爸媽簽名。

items.en: After that, they printed a form which had to be signed by my parents because I'm under eighteen.
items.zh: 接著他們印了一張表格，因為我未滿十八歲，必須讓我爸媽簽名。

items.en: Our teacher was very clear. All essays have to be handed in by Friday.
items.zh: 我們老師說得很清楚。所有的作文都必須在星期五前交。

items.en: I work at a hotel on Saturdays. The rooms have to be cleaned before the next guests arrive.
items.zh: 我星期六在旅館打工。房間必須在下一批客人到之前打掃好。

items.en: I was busy on the last day of term. The library books had to be returned before the holidays.
items.zh: 學期最後一天我很忙。圖書館的書放假前必須還。

items.en: Don't leave it on the table. This medicine has to be kept in the fridge.
items.zh: 別放在桌上。這種藥必須放冰箱。

examples.heading: ③ need to be + 過去分詞

items.en: Look at the grass. It needs to be cut.
items.zh: 你看那片草。該割了。

items.en: My bike is making a strange noise. It needs to be repaired.
items.zh: 我的腳踏車發出奇怪的聲音。需要修了。

items.en: We leave for camp on Saturday. These shirts need to be washed before the trip.
items.zh: 我們星期六要去露營。這些襯衫出發前要洗。

items.en: Thanks for looking after our flat. The plants need to be watered every two days.
items.zh: 謝謝你幫我們顧公寓。這些植物每兩天要澆一次水。

items.en: Nobody had lived in the house for years. The windows were so dirty they needed to be cleaned twice.
items.zh: 那棟房子好幾年沒人住。窗戶髒到要擦兩次。

items.en: Welcome to the airport hotel, sir. Your passport needs to be checked at the desk.
items.zh: 先生，歡迎來到機場旅館。您的護照要在櫃台檢查。

examples.heading: ④ want to be + 過去分詞

items.en: Please send me the numbers soon. My manager wants to be informed about sales by the end of November.
items.zh: 請盡快把數字寄給我。我的主管希望十一月底前有人告訴他銷售的情況。

items.en: I don't want to be disturbed while I'm studying, so I turned my phone off.
items.zh: 我讀書的時候不想被打擾，所以把手機關了。

items.en: Nobody wants to be left out, so we invited the whole class.
items.zh: 沒有人想被排擠，所以我們邀了全班。

items.en: My little brother wants to be taken to the zoo for his birthday.
items.zh: 我弟弟生日想要有人帶他去動物園。

items.en: My sister changed her clothes before the party. She didn't want to be seen in her school uniform.
items.zh: 我姊姊去派對前換了衣服。她不想被人看到她穿學校制服。

examples.heading: ⑤ 其他說法 + to be + 過去分詞

items.en: Tom and Anna are getting married. I'd like to be invited to their wedding.
items.zh: Tom 和 Anna 要結婚了。我希望他們的婚禮有邀請我。

items.en: Our kids always ask for a story. They love to be read to at bedtime.
items.zh: 我們家的孩子都會要聽故事。他們很喜歡睡前有人唸書給他們聽。

items.en: The trials for the school team are tomorrow. I hope to be chosen this year.
items.zh: 校隊明天選拔。我希望今年能被選上。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問答

items.en: "When are the photos going to be printed?" "Tomorrow, I think."
items.zh: 照片什麼時候會印出來？我想明天吧。

items.en: "Does this have to be done today?" "Yes, before five."
items.zh: 這件事一定要今天做完嗎？對，五點前。

items.en: "Why are you taking the car to the garage?" "The brakes need to be checked."
items.zh: 你為什麼要把車開去修車廠？煞車要檢查了。

items.en: "Do you want to be picked up from the station?" "Yes, please. My train gets in at six."
items.zh: 你要不要人去車站接你？好，麻煩了。我的火車六點到。

items.en: "Is your room going to be painted?" "Yes, my dad is doing it this weekend."
items.zh: 你的房間要粉刷嗎？對，我爸爸這個週末要刷。

title: I think it is an experience not to be missed.
translation: 我覺得這是一次不容錯過的體驗。
name: 被動不定詞（較多種動詞和形容詞後）
sentences: I'd like to stay in a tent. I've never done it, and I think it's an experience not to be missed.
You must see the fireworks on New Year's Eve. They're a sight not to be missed.
There's a pile of letters on my desk. They're the letters to be posted today.
Let's make a list of the jobs to be done before the guests arrive.
Have you read the rules? There's a long list of things not to be brought into the exam room.
My composition was ready to be printed, so I looked for some paper.
The cake is still hot. It isn't ready to be cut yet.
Grandpa's watch is very old. He'd be happy to be given a new one for his birthday.
My sister sang at their wedding. She was so proud to be asked.
I was lucky to be chosen for the team. Lots of people tried out.
She worked so hard this year. She deserves to be given a prize.
I'm going to hospital on Monday. I expect to be kept in for two nights.
My little brother hates to be told what to do.
The new manager seems to be liked by everyone in the office.
We hope to be invited to their wedding next summer.
According to your advert, some training is supposed to be given. When does it start?
Don't touch those boxes. They're supposed to be checked by the manager first.
The essays were supposed to be handed in yesterday, but half the class forgot.
This door is supposed to be locked at night. Who left it open?
I took part in your research to help young people not to be addicted to computer games.
Please put a sign on the door. I asked not to be disturbed.
Read the label first. This medicine is not to be taken with alcohol.
She's very shy. She prefers not to be noticed at parties.
The box said "Not to be opened until Christmas", so I put it under the tree.
In the future, homes might not be built of bricks at all.
"Can this dress be washed in the machine?" "No, it should be washed by hand."
The tickets must be paid for before Friday, or you'll lose your seat.
These old photos shouldn't be thrown away. They're our family history.
The work could be finished by tomorrow if we start now.
"Is this soup supposed to be eaten cold?" "Yes, it's a summer soup."
"Do you expect to be paid for the extra work?" "Of course I do!"

examples.heading: ① 名詞加 (not) to be + 過去分詞

items.en: I'd like to stay in a tent. I've never done it, and I think it's an experience not to be missed.
items.zh: 我想住帳篷。我從來沒住過，我覺得這是不容錯過的經驗。

items.en: You must see the fireworks on New Year's Eve. They're a sight not to be missed.
items.zh: 你一定要去看跨年煙火。那是不能錯過的景象。

items.en: There's a pile of letters on my desk. They're the letters to be posted today.
items.zh: 我桌上有一疊信。那些是今天要寄的信。

items.en: Let's make a list of the jobs to be done before the guests arrive.
items.zh: 我們把客人來之前要做的事列出來。

items.en: Have you read the rules? There's a long list of things not to be brought into the exam room.
items.zh: 你看過規定了嗎？有一長串不准帶進考場的東西。

examples.heading: ② 形容詞加 to be + 過去分詞

items.en: My composition was ready to be printed, so I looked for some paper.
items.zh: 我的作文可以印了，所以我去找紙。

items.en: The cake is still hot. It isn't ready to be cut yet.
items.zh: 蛋糕還很燙。還不能切。

items.en: Grandpa's watch is very old. He'd be happy to be given a new one for his birthday.
items.zh: 爺爺的錶很舊了。生日收到一支新的，他會很高興。

items.en: My sister sang at their wedding. She was so proud to be asked.
items.zh: 我姊姊在他們的婚禮上唱歌。被邀請唱歌讓她很驕傲。

items.en: I was lucky to be chosen for the team. Lots of people tried out.
items.zh: 我很幸運被選進隊裡。很多人去試了。

examples.heading: ③ 動詞加 to be + 過去分詞

items.en: She worked so hard this year. She deserves to be given a prize.
items.zh: 她今年很努力。她應該得獎。

items.en: I'm going to hospital on Monday. I expect to be kept in for two nights.
items.zh: 我星期一要去住院。我想會要住兩個晚上。

items.en: My little brother hates to be told what to do.
items.zh: 我弟弟討厭別人叫他做事。

items.en: The new manager seems to be liked by everyone in the office.
items.zh: 辦公室裡的人好像都很喜歡新經理。

items.en: We hope to be invited to their wedding next summer.
items.zh: 我們希望明年夏天能受邀參加他們的婚禮。

examples.heading: ④ be supposed to be + 過去分詞

items.en: According to your advert, some training is supposed to be given. When does it start?
items.zh: 照你們的廣告，應該會有一些訓練。什麼時候開始？

items.en: Don't touch those boxes. They're supposed to be checked by the manager first.
items.zh: 別碰那些箱子。應該要先讓經理檢查。

items.en: The essays were supposed to be handed in yesterday, but half the class forgot.
items.zh: 作文應該昨天交，可是班上一半的人忘了。

items.en: This door is supposed to be locked at night. Who left it open?
items.zh: 這扇門晚上應該要鎖。誰沒關？

examples.heading: ⑤ not to be + 過去分詞

items.en: I took part in your research to help young people not to be addicted to computer games.
items.zh: 我參加你們的研究，是想幫助年輕人不要沉迷電腦遊戲。

items.en: Please put a sign on the door. I asked not to be disturbed.
items.zh: 請在門上掛個牌子。我說過不要打擾我。

items.en: Read the label first. This medicine is not to be taken with alcohol.
items.zh: 先看標籤。這個藥不能跟酒一起吃。

items.en: She's very shy. She prefers not to be noticed at parties.
items.zh: 她很害羞。在派對上她寧願別人不要注意到她。

items.en: The box said "Not to be opened until Christmas", so I put it under the tree.
items.zh: 盒子上寫著聖誕節前不可打開，所以我把它放在樹下。

examples.heading: ⑥ 情態動詞加 (not) be + 過去分詞

items.en: In the future, homes might not be built of bricks at all.
items.zh: 未來的房子可能完全不用磚頭蓋。

items.en: "Can this dress be washed in the machine?" "No, it should be washed by hand."
items.zh: 這件洋裝可以用洗衣機洗嗎？不行，要手洗。

items.en: The tickets must be paid for before Friday, or you'll lose your seat.
items.zh: 票一定要在星期五前付錢，不然你的位子就沒了。

items.en: These old photos shouldn't be thrown away. They're our family history.
items.zh: 這些舊照片不該丟。它們是我們家的歷史。

items.en: The work could be finished by tomorrow if we start now.
items.zh: 我們現在開始的話，明天就可以完成。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Is this soup supposed to be eaten cold?" "Yes, it's a summer soup."
items.zh: 這碗湯是要冷的吃嗎？對，這是夏天的湯。

items.en: "Do you expect to be paid for the extra work?" "Of course I do!"
items.zh: 你期待加班有錢拿嗎？當然！

title: I don't remember how I lost it; it might have been stolen.
translation: 我不記得是怎麼弄丟的，可能是被偷了。
name: 情態動詞完成式的被動語態
sentences: My wallet's gone. I don't remember how I lost it; it might have been stolen.
"Why hasn't the parcel arrived?" "It may have been sent to our old address."
Don't blame Sam for the broken cup. It could have been knocked over by the cat.
Nobody knows who built this wall. It might have been built by the Romans.
I didn't get an answer from the bank. My email may have been deleted by mistake.
The house is freezing. A window must have been left open all night.
Look at the floor! The dog must have been let in with muddy feet.
All the cakes are gone already. They must have been eaten during the break.
He knew all the answers. He must have been told about the test.
The letter can't have been posted. It's still on the kitchen table.
"Was the car stolen?" "It can't have been. I've got the only key."
Those photos couldn't have been taken in Spain. We never went there.
This painting can't have been done by a child. It's far too good.
Some groups were better than others, but they all played well. They should have been given a chance!
The bins are still full. They should have been emptied on Monday.
I'm sorry I missed the meeting. I should have been told about it earlier.
The report should have been finished by now. What's taking so long?
That accident was terrible. The road should have been closed after the snow.
I read the article about our school. That old photo shouldn't have been used in this kind of article.
The children shouldn't have been left alone in the house. They're only six.
Our team lost because of the referee. That goal shouldn't have been allowed.
My shirt is pink now. It shouldn't have been washed with the red towels.
The concert was a disaster. I think all these problems could have been avoided.
Nobody was hurt in the fire, but people could have been killed.
The project was finished in two weeks. It could have been done in one if we'd started earlier.
Thanks for calling the doctor. My dad could have been seriously hurt.
"Could the money have been taken by someone in the office?" "I hope not."
"Should the bill have been paid last week?" "Yes, I forgot. I'll pay it today."
"Where's my blue jacket?" "It might have been given away with the old clothes."
"Was the meeting cancelled?" "It must have been. Nobody's here."
"Do you think the fire was started on purpose?" "It may have been. The police are looking into it."

examples.heading: ① might / may / could have been：不確定

items.en: My wallet's gone. I don't remember how I lost it; it might have been stolen.
items.zh: 我的錢包不見了。我不記得是怎麼弄丟的，可能是被偷了。

items.en: "Why hasn't the parcel arrived?" "It may have been sent to our old address."
items.zh: 包裹怎麼還沒到？可能寄到我們的舊地址了。

items.en: Don't blame Sam for the broken cup. It could have been knocked over by the cat.
items.zh: 別怪 Sam 打破杯子。可能是貓碰倒的。

items.en: Nobody knows who built this wall. It might have been built by the Romans.
items.zh: 沒人知道這道牆是誰蓋的。可能是羅馬人蓋的。

items.en: I didn't get an answer from the bank. My email may have been deleted by mistake.
items.zh: 我沒收到銀行的回覆。我的電子郵件可能被誤刪了。

examples.heading: ② must have been：很確定

items.en: The house is freezing. A window must have been left open all night.
items.zh: 屋子裡好冷。一定有一扇窗戶整晚沒關。

items.en: Look at the floor! The dog must have been let in with muddy feet.
items.zh: 你看地板！一定有人讓狗帶著一腳泥進來了。

items.en: All the cakes are gone already. They must have been eaten during the break.
items.zh: 蛋糕已經全部沒了。一定是休息時間被吃掉了。

items.en: He knew all the answers. He must have been told about the test.
items.zh: 他每一題都會。一定有人跟他講過考試的內容。

examples.heading: ③ can't / couldn't have been：很確定沒有

items.en: The letter can't have been posted. It's still on the kitchen table.
items.zh: 信不可能寄出去了。它還在餐桌上。

items.en: "Was the car stolen?" "It can't have been. I've got the only key."
items.zh: 車被偷了嗎？不可能。唯一的鑰匙在我這裡。

items.en: Those photos couldn't have been taken in Spain. We never went there.
items.zh: 那些照片不可能是在西班牙拍的。我們從來沒去過。

items.en: This painting can't have been done by a child. It's far too good.
items.zh: 這幅畫不可能是小孩畫的。畫得太好了。

examples.heading: ④ should have been：應該做卻沒做

items.en: Some groups were better than others, but they all played well. They should have been given a chance!
items.zh: 有些團體比別人好，可是每一團都表現得不錯。應該給他們一個機會的！

items.en: The bins are still full. They should have been emptied on Monday.
items.zh: 垃圾桶還是滿的。星期一就應該清了。

items.en: I'm sorry I missed the meeting. I should have been told about it earlier.
items.zh: 很抱歉我錯過了會議。應該早點通知我的。

items.en: The report should have been finished by now. What's taking so long?
items.zh: 報告現在應該已經寫完了。怎麼拖這麼久？

items.en: That accident was terrible. The road should have been closed after the snow.
items.zh: 那場車禍很嚴重。下雪之後就該封路了。

examples.heading: ⑤ shouldn't have been：不應該做卻做了

items.en: I read the article about our school. That old photo shouldn't have been used in this kind of article.
items.zh: 我看了那篇講我們學校的文章。那張舊照片不應該用在這種文章裡。

items.en: The children shouldn't have been left alone in the house. They're only six.
items.zh: 那些孩子不該被單獨留在家裡。他們才六歲。

items.en: Our team lost because of the referee. That goal shouldn't have been allowed.
items.zh: 我們隊因為裁判輸了。那一球不該算進。

items.en: My shirt is pink now. It shouldn't have been washed with the red towels.
items.zh: 我的襯衫變粉紅色了。它不該跟紅毛巾一起洗。

examples.heading: ⑥ could have been：本來可能發生，可是沒有發生

items.en: The concert was a disaster. I think all these problems could have been avoided.
items.zh: 那場音樂會糟透了。我覺得這些問題本來都可以避免。

items.en: Nobody was hurt in the fire, but people could have been killed.
items.zh: 火災裡沒有人受傷，可是本來可能會有人喪命。

items.en: The project was finished in two weeks. It could have been done in one if we'd started earlier.
items.zh: 這個計畫兩個星期做完。如果早點開始，一個星期就可以做完。

items.en: Thanks for calling the doctor. My dad could have been seriously hurt.
items.zh: 謝謝你叫了醫生。我爸爸本來可能傷得很重。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句和回答

items.en: "Could the money have been taken by someone in the office?" "I hope not."
items.zh: 錢可能是辦公室裡的人拿走的嗎？希望不是。

items.en: "Should the bill have been paid last week?" "Yes, I forgot. I'll pay it today."
items.zh: 帳單是不是上星期就該付了？對，我忘了。我今天付。

items.en: "Where's my blue jacket?" "It might have been given away with the old clothes."
items.zh: 我的藍外套在哪裡？可能跟舊衣服一起送人了。

items.en: "Was the meeting cancelled?" "It must have been. Nobody's here."
items.zh: 會議取消了嗎？一定是。都沒有人在。

items.en: "Do you think the fire was started on purpose?" "It may have been. The police are looking into it."
items.zh: 你覺得火是有人故意放的嗎？可能是。警察在調查。

title: They are expected to give the couple expensive presents as a reward for having been invited.
translation: 他們受到邀請，照理要送這對夫妻貴重的禮物當作回報。
name: 介系詞後接 having been 加過去分詞
sentences: In some countries, wedding guests are expected to give the couple expensive presents as a reward for having been invited.
The restaurant was very busy. We got free drinks for having been kept waiting so long.
He was sent home for having been rude to a teacher.
I'm very grateful for having been given this chance to study abroad.
The company apologised to customers for having been charged twice.
Miss Kenton knocks on his door and comes in without having been asked to do so.
He left the company without having been paid for his last month.
You can't start the job without having been trained first.
The money was spent without having been approved by the manager.
She signed the contract without having been told about the extra costs.
We caught the bus with the feeling of having been given one of the funniest evenings of our lives.
I can't get rid of the feeling of having been cheated.
She's proud of having been chosen to represent her school.
He has no memory of having been taken to hospital.
After having been delayed for six hours, the plane finally took off.
After having been closed for two years, the museum opened again in May.
After having been rejected twice, his book was finally published.
After having been lost for a week, the dog came home on its own.
The customers complained about having been kept waiting for an hour.
She was upset about having been left out of the team photo.
He was angry at having been treated like a child.
They laughed about having been fooled by such an easy trick.
Despite having been warned many times, he still drove too fast.
As well as having been robbed, we missed our flight home.
Apart from having been bitten by a few insects, we had a great holiday.
He got the job thanks to having been recommended by his old boss.
We would like to apologise to all passengers for having been kept waiting.
"What did he say about the interview?" "He talked about having been asked some very strange questions."
"Why is she angry?" "She's angry about not having been told about the party."
I still remember the shock of having been called into the head teacher's office.
After all these years, he's still bitter about not having been promoted.

examples.heading: ① for having been + 過去分詞

items.en: In some countries, wedding guests are expected to give the couple expensive presents as a reward for having been invited.
items.zh: 在一些國家，婚禮的客人受到邀請，照理要送新人貴重的禮物當作回報。

items.en: The restaurant was very busy. We got free drinks for having been kept waiting so long.
items.zh: 那家餐廳很忙。我們等了那麼久，所以拿到免費的飲料。
