items.en: He was sent home for having been rude to a teacher.
items.zh: 他因為對老師不禮貌被送回家。

items.en: I'm very grateful for having been given this chance to study abroad.
items.zh: 我很感激得到這個出國唸書的機會。

items.en: The company apologised to customers for having been charged twice.
items.zh: 那家公司向被重複收費的客人道歉。

examples.heading: ② without having been + 過去分詞

items.en: Miss Kenton knocks on his door and comes in without having been asked to do so.
items.zh: Kenton 小姐敲了敲他的門，沒等他允許就進來了。

items.en: He left the company without having been paid for his last month.
items.zh: 他離開公司的時候，最後一個月的薪水還沒拿到。

items.en: You can't start the job without having been trained first.
items.zh: 你沒先受過訓練就不能開始做這份工作。

items.en: The money was spent without having been approved by the manager.
items.zh: 這筆錢沒有經過經理同意就花掉了。

items.en: She signed the contract without having been told about the extra costs.
items.zh: 她簽了合約，可是沒人告訴她有額外的費用。

examples.heading: ③ of having been + 過去分詞

items.en: We caught the bus with the feeling of having been given one of the funniest evenings of our lives.
items.zh: 我們搭上公車，覺得自己度過了人生中最好笑的一個晚上。

items.en: I can't get rid of the feeling of having been cheated.
items.zh: 我一直覺得自己被騙了。

items.en: She's proud of having been chosen to represent her school.
items.zh: 她很自豪被選為學校的代表。

items.en: He has no memory of having been taken to hospital.
items.zh: 他不記得自己被送去醫院。

examples.heading: ④ after having been + 過去分詞

items.en: After having been delayed for six hours, the plane finally took off.
items.zh: 延誤了六個小時之後，飛機終於起飛了。

items.en: After having been closed for two years, the museum opened again in May.
items.zh: 博物館關了兩年之後，五月重新開放。

items.en: After having been rejected twice, his book was finally published.
items.zh: 被拒絕兩次之後，他的書終於出版了。

items.en: After having been lost for a week, the dog came home on its own.
items.zh: 狗走失了一個星期之後，自己回家了。

examples.heading: ⑤ about / at having been + 過去分詞

items.en: The customers complained about having been kept waiting for an hour.
items.zh: 客人抱怨被晾在那裡等了一個小時。

items.en: She was upset about having been left out of the team photo.
items.zh: 她很難過團體照裡沒有她。

items.en: He was angry at having been treated like a child.
items.zh: 他很生氣被當成小孩對待。

items.en: They laughed about having been fooled by such an easy trick.
items.zh: 他們笑自己被這麼簡單的把戲騙了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 其他介系詞

items.en: Despite having been warned many times, he still drove too fast.
items.zh: 雖然被警告過很多次，他開車還是太快。

items.en: As well as having been robbed, we missed our flight home.
items.zh: 我們除了被搶，還錯過了回家的班機。

items.en: Apart from having been bitten by a few insects, we had a great holiday.
items.zh: 除了被幾隻蟲咬了之外，我們的假期很棒。

items.en: He got the job thanks to having been recommended by his old boss.
items.zh: 他能得到這份工作，是因為前老闆推薦了他。

examples.heading: ⑦ 不同的語氣

items.en: We would like to apologise to all passengers for having been kept waiting.
items.zh: 我們要向所有久候的乘客致歉。

items.en: "What did he say about the interview?" "He talked about having been asked some very strange questions."
items.zh: 他說面試怎麼樣？他說被問了一些很奇怪的問題。

items.en: "Why is she angry?" "She's angry about not having been told about the party."
items.zh: 她為什麼生氣？她氣沒人跟她說派對的事。

items.en: I still remember the shock of having been called into the head teacher's office.
items.zh: 我還記得被叫進校長室的那種震驚。

items.en: After all these years, he's still bitter about not having been promoted.
items.zh: 這麼多年了，他對沒被升職還是很不甘心。

title: The restaurant was closed because it was being redecorated.
translation: 那家餐廳沒開，因為正在重新裝潢。
name: 過去進行式被動語態的肯定句
sentences: We wanted to have dinner at Mario's, but the restaurant was closed because it was being redecorated.
I couldn't use the computer this morning. It was being repaired.
Sorry I didn't answer. My phone was being charged in the other room.
Our hotel was very noisy because a new pool was being built next to it.
When I got home, dinner was being cooked and the table was already set.
The old man looked behind him. He felt he was being followed.
We had to wait outside because the rooms were being cleaned.
When I visited the farm, the cows were being milked.
The roads were being cleared of snow all night, so we could drive in the morning.
I saw lots of police at the station. Some young men were being questioned.
We didn't sleep much on the ferry. The cars were being loaded all night.
We stayed at your house while our car was being repaired.
While the house was being painted, we lived with my parents.
The children played in the garden while the party food was being prepared.
While the plane was being cleaned, the passengers waited at the gate.
When we arrived at the airport, our bags were being checked.
The fire started when the old factory was being pulled down.
I took a photo of the statue when it was being moved to the new square.
When I opened the door, the new carpet was being put down.
After they explained everything to him, he knew he was being tricked by them.
I couldn't talk to the nurse. I was being examined by the doctor.
Tom wasn't at school yesterday. He was being interviewed for a TV programme.
We felt we were being watched the whole time we were in the shop.
The new students were being shown around the school when the fire alarm went off.
We couldn't get to the beach because the road was being repaired.
The museum was closed on Monday. A new exhibition was being set up.
Sorry you couldn't reach me last night. Our phone line was being fixed.
The match was stopped because a player was being treated on the pitch.
"Why were you so late?" "My train was being checked for a problem with the doors."
"What was happening when you got there?" "The prizes were being given out."
"Was the house being sold when you moved in next door?" "Yes, it was for sale for months."

examples.heading: ① was being + 過去分詞

items.en: We wanted to have dinner at Mario's, but the restaurant was closed because it was being redecorated.
items.zh: 我們想去 Mario's 吃晚餐，可是那家餐廳沒開，因為正在重新裝潢。

items.en: I couldn't use the computer this morning. It was being repaired.
items.zh: 我今天早上不能用電腦。電腦在修。

items.en: Sorry I didn't answer. My phone was being charged in the other room.
items.zh: 抱歉我沒接。我的手機在另一個房間充電。

items.en: Our hotel was very noisy because a new pool was being built next to it.
items.zh: 我們的旅館很吵，因為旁邊在蓋新的游泳池。

items.en: When I got home, dinner was being cooked and the table was already set.
items.zh: 我回到家的時候，晚餐正在煮，桌子已經擺好了。

items.en: The old man looked behind him. He felt he was being followed.
items.zh: 那個老人回頭看。他覺得有人在跟蹤他。

examples.heading: ② were being + 過去分詞

items.en: We had to wait outside because the rooms were being cleaned.
items.zh: 我們只能在外面等，因為房間正在打掃。

items.en: When I visited the farm, the cows were being milked.
items.zh: 我去農場的時候，他們正在擠牛奶。

items.en: The roads were being cleared of snow all night, so we could drive in the morning.
items.zh: 路上的雪整晚都在清，所以我們早上可以開車。

items.en: I saw lots of police at the station. Some young men were being questioned.
items.zh: 我在車站看到很多警察。有幾個年輕人正在接受盤問。

items.en: We didn't sleep much on the ferry. The cars were being loaded all night.
items.zh: 我們在渡輪上沒睡多少。車子整晚都在裝船。

examples.heading: ③ while + was / were being

items.en: We stayed at your house while our car was being repaired.
items.zh: 我們的車在修的時候，我們住在你家。

items.en: While the house was being painted, we lived with my parents.
items.zh: 房子在油漆的時候，我們住在我爸媽家。

items.en: The children played in the garden while the party food was being prepared.
items.zh: 派對的食物在準備的時候，孩子們在花園玩。

items.en: While the plane was being cleaned, the passengers waited at the gate.
items.zh: 飛機在清潔的時候，乘客在登機門等。

examples.heading: ④ when 和過去進行式被動

items.en: When we arrived at the airport, our bags were being checked.
items.zh: 我們到機場的時候，行李正在檢查。

items.en: The fire started when the old factory was being pulled down.
items.zh: 舊工廠在拆的時候起火了。

items.en: I took a photo of the statue when it was being moved to the new square.
items.zh: 雕像搬到新廣場的時候，我拍了一張照片。

items.en: When I opened the door, the new carpet was being put down.
items.zh: 我打開門的時候，新地毯正在鋪。

examples.heading: ⑤ 人當主詞

items.en: After they explained everything to him, he knew he was being tricked by them.
items.zh: 他們把一切解釋給他聽之後，他才知道自己被他們耍了。

items.en: I couldn't talk to the nurse. I was being examined by the doctor.
items.zh: 我沒辦法跟護士說話。醫生正在幫我檢查。

items.en: Tom wasn't at school yesterday. He was being interviewed for a TV programme.
items.zh: Tom 昨天沒來學校。他在接受一個電視節目的訪問。

items.en: We felt we were being watched the whole time we were in the shop.
items.zh: 我們在店裡的時候，一直覺得有人在看我們。

items.en: The new students were being shown around the school when the fire alarm went off.
items.zh: 新生正在參觀學校的時候，火災警報響了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 解釋為什麼不能做

items.en: We couldn't get to the beach because the road was being repaired.
items.zh: 我們沒辦法去海邊，因為路在修。

items.en: The museum was closed on Monday. A new exhibition was being set up.
items.zh: 博物館星期一沒開。他們在布置新的展覽。

items.en: Sorry you couldn't reach me last night. Our phone line was being fixed.
items.zh: 抱歉你昨晚聯絡不到我。我們的電話線在修。

items.en: The match was stopped because a player was being treated on the pitch.
items.zh: 比賽暫停了，因為有一個球員在場上接受治療。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Why were you so late?" "My train was being checked for a problem with the doors."
items.zh: 你怎麼這麼晚？我的火車在檢查車門的問題。

items.en: "What was happening when you got there?" "The prizes were being given out."
items.zh: 你到的時候在做什麼？正在頒獎。

items.en: "Was the house being sold when you moved in next door?" "Yes, it was for sale for months."
items.zh: 你搬到隔壁的時候，那間房子在賣嗎？對，掛了好幾個月。

title: The car had been serviced and everything seemed to be all right.
translation: 車子已經保養過了，一切看起來都沒問題。
name: 過去完成式被動語態的肯定句
sentences: Before the trip, the car had been serviced and everything seemed to be all right.
We got to the station at six, but the train had been cancelled.
When I went back to the café, my bag had been handed in to the manager.
The house looked lovely. It had been painted white and blue.
When we came back from holiday, the window was open and some money had been taken from the drawer.
By the time the firemen arrived, everyone had been moved out of the building.
At that moment, Lime walked in and realised he had been set up.
She looked very happy. She'd just been offered the job.
I didn't know the answer, because I'd been told the wrong page.
When I met Anna at the party, I found out she'd been invited by my brother.
The children were tired because they'd been taken on a long walk.
We were too late. All the tickets had already been sold.
When I got to the office, the decision had already been made.
The paint on the door was still wet. It had just been painted.
"Did you see the old school?" "No, it had already been pulled down."
By the time we got home, the dinner had been eaten by the dogs.
Before the party started, the garden had been decorated with lights.
By the time the police came, the thieves had been caught by two neighbours.
Before I bought my flat, it had been rented to students for years.
After the room had been cleaned, we moved the furniture back.
After the plane had been checked, we were allowed to get on.
I couldn't call you because my phone had been left at work.
The museum was quiet because it had been closed for most of the morning.
In the end, the car wasn't stolen. It had been taken by a man whose wife was about to have a baby.
He told me the bridge had been built by his great-grandfather.
Ben said the report had been sent to the wrong person.
My teacher said our essays had already been marked.
The newspaper said that three new schools had been opened that year.
"Had the room been booked before you called?" "Yes, someone booked it that morning."
"Why were you so angry?" "My bike had been left in the rain all night."
"Had the tickets been paid for when you collected them?" "Yes, my dad paid online."

examples.heading: ① had been + 過去分詞

items.en: Before the trip, the car had been serviced and everything seemed to be all right.
items.zh: 出發之前，車子已經保養過了，一切看起來都沒問題。

items.en: We got to the station at six, but the train had been cancelled.
items.zh: 我們六點到車站，可是火車取消了。

items.en: When I went back to the café, my bag had been handed in to the manager.
items.zh: 我回到咖啡店的時候，我的包包已經有人交給經理了。

items.en: The house looked lovely. It had been painted white and blue.
items.zh: 那間房子看起來很漂亮。它漆成了白色和藍色。

items.en: When we came back from holiday, the window was open and some money had been taken from the drawer.
items.zh: 我們度假回來的時候，窗戶開著，抽屜裡有一些錢被拿走了。

items.en: By the time the firemen arrived, everyone had been moved out of the building.
items.zh: 消防員到的時候，大家都已經被帶出大樓了。

examples.heading: ② 人當主詞

items.en: At that moment, Lime walked in and realised he had been set up.
items.zh: 那時候 Lime 走進來，才發現自己被陷害了。

items.en: She looked very happy. She'd just been offered the job.
items.zh: 她看起來很開心。她剛得到那份工作。

items.en: I didn't know the answer, because I'd been told the wrong page.
items.zh: 我不知道答案，因為有人跟我說錯頁了。

items.en: When I met Anna at the party, I found out she'd been invited by my brother.
items.zh: 我在派對上遇到 Anna，才知道是我哥哥邀請她的。

items.en: The children were tired because they'd been taken on a long walk.
items.zh: 孩子們很累，因為他們被帶去走了很長一段路。

examples.heading: ③ already 和 just

items.en: We were too late. All the tickets had already been sold.
items.zh: 我們太晚了。票已經全部賣完了。

items.en: When I got to the office, the decision had already been made.
items.zh: 我到辦公室的時候，決定已經做好了。

items.en: The paint on the door was still wet. It had just been painted.
items.zh: 門上的油漆還沒乾。剛漆好。

items.en: "Did you see the old school?" "No, it had already been pulled down."
items.zh: 你有看到那間舊學校嗎？沒有，已經拆掉了。

examples.heading: ④ by the time 和 before

items.en: By the time we got home, the dinner had been eaten by the dogs.
items.zh: 我們到家的時候，晚餐已經被狗吃掉了。

items.en: Before the party started, the garden had been decorated with lights.
items.zh: 派對開始之前，花園已經用燈裝飾好了。

items.en: By the time the police came, the thieves had been caught by two neighbours.
items.zh: 警察來的時候，小偷已經被兩個鄰居抓到了。

items.en: Before I bought my flat, it had been rented to students for years.
items.zh: 我買這間公寓之前，它已經租給學生好幾年了。

examples.heading: ⑤ after 和 because

items.en: After the room had been cleaned, we moved the furniture back.
items.zh: 房間打掃好之後，我們把家具搬回去。

items.en: After the plane had been checked, we were allowed to get on.
items.zh: 飛機檢查好之後，我們才可以登機。

items.en: I couldn't call you because my phone had been left at work.
items.zh: 我沒辦法打給你，因為我的手機忘在公司了。

items.en: The museum was quiet because it had been closed for most of the morning.
items.zh: 博物館很安靜，因為早上大部分時間都沒開。

examples.heading: ⑥ 說故事和轉述

items.en: In the end, the car wasn't stolen. It had been taken by a man whose wife was about to have a baby.
items.zh: 最後車子不是被偷的。是一個太太快生產的男人開走的。

items.en: He told me the bridge had been built by his great-grandfather.
items.zh: 他跟我說那座橋是他曾祖父蓋的。

items.en: Ben said the report had been sent to the wrong person.
items.zh: Ben 說報告寄錯人了。

items.en: My teacher said our essays had already been marked.
items.zh: 老師說我們的作文已經改好了。

items.en: The newspaper said that three new schools had been opened that year.
items.zh: 報紙說那一年開了三所新學校。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Had the room been booked before you called?" "Yes, someone booked it that morning."
items.zh: 你打電話之前，那間房間已經有人訂了嗎？對，那天早上有人訂了。

items.en: "Why were you so angry?" "My bike had been left in the rain all night."
items.zh: 你為什麼那麼生氣？我的腳踏車被丟在外面淋了一整晚的雨。

items.en: "Had the tickets been paid for when you collected them?" "Yes, my dad paid online."
items.zh: 你去拿票的時候，票錢已經付了嗎？對，我爸爸在網路上付了。

title: We waited for ages because we had not been informed.
translation: 我們等了好久，因為我們沒有接到通知。
name: 過去完成式被動語態的否定句
sentences: The talk started an hour late. We waited for ages because we had not been informed.
When the police found the car, they saw that it had not been stolen. It had been borrowed by a neighbour.
I was surprised at the meeting because the plan had not been explained to us.
The letter came back to us because it had not been stamped.
The flight was delayed because the plane had not been cleaned.
My grandma was upset at the wedding. She hadn't been asked to give a speech.
The office was very cold. The heating hadn't been turned on.
I went to the party, but I hadn't been invited.
We couldn't start the game because the rules hadn't been agreed.
The milk tasted strange. It hadn't been kept in the fridge.
Sam failed the test. He hadn't been told which chapters to study.
When we got to the hotel, our room hadn't been cleaned yet.
At nine o'clock, the results hadn't been announced yet, so we went to bed.
The new road was still closed. It hadn't been finished yet.
I called the shop on Monday, but my order hadn't been sent yet.
The house was very dirty. It had never been cleaned properly.
She was nervous. She had never been interviewed on TV before.
The box was full of old letters. They had never been opened.
Ben loved the trip. He'd never been taken to the mountains before.
We were the first people to sleep in the room. It had never been used.
I'm writing to complain. We had not been told that the pool was closed.
The meal was cold because it hadn't been heated properly.
The bill was wrong. The discount hadn't been taken off.
Nobody came to the meeting, because the date hadn't been put on the website.
The car broke down on the motorway. It hadn't been checked for months.
The manager said the money hadn't been paid into my account.
She told me the windows hadn't been opened all week.
Tom said he hadn't been given a key.
"Hadn't you been told about the party?" "No, nobody said anything."
"Why was the shop closed?" "The new manager hadn't been found yet."
"Why didn't the plants grow?" "They hadn't been watered for weeks."

examples.heading: ① had not been + 過去分詞

items.en: The talk started an hour late. We waited for ages because we had not been informed.
items.zh: 講座晚了一個小時開始。我們等了好久，因為沒有人通知我們。

items.en: When the police found the car, they saw that it had not been stolen. It had been borrowed by a neighbour.
items.zh: 警察找到車子的時候，發現它不是被偷的。是被一個鄰居借走了。

items.en: I was surprised at the meeting because the plan had not been explained to us.
items.zh: 我在會議上很驚訝，因為沒人跟我們解釋過這個計畫。

items.en: The letter came back to us because it had not been stamped.
items.zh: 那封信被退回來了，因為沒有貼郵票。

items.en: The flight was delayed because the plane had not been cleaned.
items.zh: 班機延誤了，因為飛機還沒清潔。

examples.heading: ② hadn't been + 過去分詞

items.en: My grandma was upset at the wedding. She hadn't been asked to give a speech.
items.zh: 我奶奶在婚禮上不太高興。沒人請她致詞。

items.en: The office was very cold. The heating hadn't been turned on.
items.zh: 辦公室很冷。暖氣還沒開。

items.en: I went to the party, but I hadn't been invited.
items.zh: 我去了派對，可是我沒有被邀請。

items.en: We couldn't start the game because the rules hadn't been agreed.
items.zh: 我們沒辦法開始比賽，因為規則還沒談好。

items.en: The milk tasted strange. It hadn't been kept in the fridge.
items.zh: 牛奶喝起來怪怪的。它沒有放冰箱。

items.en: Sam failed the test. He hadn't been told which chapters to study.
items.zh: Sam 考試沒過。沒人告訴他要讀哪幾章。

examples.heading: ③ hadn't been + 過去分詞 + yet

items.en: When we got to the hotel, our room hadn't been cleaned yet.
items.zh: 我們到旅館的時候，房間還沒打掃。

items.en: At nine o'clock, the results hadn't been announced yet, so we went to bed.
items.zh: 九點的時候結果還沒公布，所以我們就去睡了。

items.en: The new road was still closed. It hadn't been finished yet.
items.zh: 新路還是封著。還沒蓋完。

items.en: I called the shop on Monday, but my order hadn't been sent yet.
items.zh: 我星期一打給那家店，可是我的訂單還沒寄出。

examples.heading: ④ had never been + 過去分詞

items.en: The house was very dirty. It had never been cleaned properly.
items.zh: 那間房子很髒。從來沒有好好打掃過。

items.en: She was nervous. She had never been interviewed on TV before.
items.zh: 她很緊張。她以前從來沒上電視接受訪問。

items.en: The box was full of old letters. They had never been opened.
items.zh: 箱子裡都是舊信。那些信從來沒拆過。

items.en: Ben loved the trip. He'd never been taken to the mountains before.
items.zh: Ben 很喜歡那趟旅行。以前從來沒人帶他去過山上。

items.en: We were the first people to sleep in the room. It had never been used.
items.zh: 我們是第一批睡那個房間的人。它從來沒有用過。

examples.heading: ⑤ 抱怨和解釋

items.en: I'm writing to complain. We had not been told that the pool was closed.
items.zh: 我寫信來抱怨。沒有人告訴我們泳池沒開。

items.en: The meal was cold because it hadn't been heated properly.
items.zh: 那頓飯是冷的，因為沒有熱透。

items.en: The bill was wrong. The discount hadn't been taken off.
items.zh: 帳單算錯了。折扣沒扣掉。

items.en: Nobody came to the meeting, because the date hadn't been put on the website.
items.zh: 沒有人來開會，因為網站上沒放日期。

items.en: The car broke down on the motorway. It hadn't been checked for months.
items.zh: 車子在高速公路上拋錨了。它好幾個月沒檢查了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 轉述

items.en: The manager said the money hadn't been paid into my account.
items.zh: 經理說錢沒有匯進我的帳戶。

items.en: She told me the windows hadn't been opened all week.
items.zh: 她跟我說窗戶整個星期都沒開過。

items.en: Tom said he hadn't been given a key.
items.zh: Tom 說沒人給他鑰匙。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Hadn't you been told about the party?" "No, nobody said anything."
items.zh: 沒人跟你說派對的事嗎？沒有，沒人說。

items.en: "Why was the shop closed?" "The new manager hadn't been found yet."
items.zh: 店怎麼沒開？那時候還沒找到新店長。

items.en: "Why didn't the plants grow?" "They hadn't been watered for weeks."
items.zh: 植物怎麼沒長？好幾個星期沒澆水了。

title: Some pupils were interviewed about their work in the garden.
translation: 有幾個學生接受訪問，談他們在菜園裡做的事。
name: 過去簡單式被動語態的肯定句（各種主詞）
sentences: They filmed the flowers and trees, and some pupils were interviewed about their work in the garden.
There was a storm last night. Two trees in our street were blown down.
The party was a success. All the sandwiches were eaten in ten minutes.
We went back to the hotel early. The beaches were closed because of the wind.
Our team played really well, and three of our players were chosen for the national team.
The town needed more green space. In the end, the old houses were knocked down and a park was built.
There was a lot of noise in the night. Next day, I heard that my neighbour's car was stolen.
I couldn't read the letter. It was written in a strange language.
The museum was very quiet. The main room was closed for repairs.
We were late for the wedding because the road was blocked by a lorry.
My dad was so happy. His lost wallet was found in the park.
I was given a free ticket, so I went to the concert with my cousin.
On our first day, we were shown around the school by an older student.
You were seen at the cinema on Saturday! Who were you with?
The waiting room was full. We were told to wait outside until the doctor was ready.
I was woken up at six by the birds outside my window.
My grandad was a teacher for forty years. He was loved by all his students.
My sister was so excited. She was offered a place at the university.
I sent the photos on Monday, but they were never received.
Our neighbours were very kind. They were invited to the party too.
The new boy was nervous, but he was welcomed by the whole class.
It was a terrible accident. Five people were taken to hospital.
At the end of the show, the children were given a small present.
We moved to a smaller flat, so most of the furniture was sold.
Grandma looked everywhere for her birthday money. The money was found under the sofa a week later.
We booked the trip online. All the information was sent to us by email.
The concert was amazing. The songs were sung in three languages.
"Why are you so late?" "We were stopped by the police for a check."
"Where did you get those apples?" "They were given to us by our neighbour."
"Did you enjoy the trip?" "Yes! We were taken to an island by boat."
"What happened to the old cinema?" "It was turned into a supermarket."

examples.heading: ① 複數名詞 + were + 過去分詞

items.en: They filmed the flowers and trees, and some pupils were interviewed about their work in the garden.
items.zh: 他們拍了花和樹，也有幾個學生接受訪問，談他們在菜園裡做的事。

items.en: There was a storm last night. Two trees in our street were blown down.
items.zh: 昨晚有暴風雨。我們這條街有兩棵樹被吹倒了。

items.en: The party was a success. All the sandwiches were eaten in ten minutes.
items.zh: 派對很成功。三明治十分鐘就被吃光了。

items.en: We went back to the hotel early. The beaches were closed because of the wind.
items.zh: 我們很早就回旅館了。海灘因為風太大關閉了。

items.en: Our team played really well, and three of our players were chosen for the national team.
items.zh: 我們隊打得很好，有三個球員被選進國家隊。

items.en: The town needed more green space. In the end, the old houses were knocked down and a park was built.
items.zh: 這個鎮需要更多綠地。最後舊房子都拆了，蓋了一座公園。

examples.heading: ② 單數名詞 + was + 過去分詞

items.en: There was a lot of noise in the night. Next day, I heard that my neighbour's car was stolen.
items.zh: 半夜很吵。隔天，我聽說我鄰居的車被偷了。

items.en: I couldn't read the letter. It was written in a strange language.
items.zh: 我看不懂那封信。它是用一種奇怪的語言寫的。

items.en: The museum was very quiet. The main room was closed for repairs.
items.zh: 博物館很安靜。主展廳因為整修關閉了。

items.en: We were late for the wedding because the road was blocked by a lorry.
items.zh: 我們婚禮遲到了，因為路被一台卡車擋住了。

items.en: My dad was so happy. His lost wallet was found in the park.
items.zh: 我爸爸好開心。他弄丟的皮夾在公園裡找到了。

examples.heading: ③ I / we / you + was / were + 過去分詞

items.en: I was given a free ticket, so I went to the concert with my cousin.
items.zh: 我拿到一張免費的票，所以跟我表哥去聽了演唱會。

items.en: On our first day, we were shown around the school by an older student.
items.zh: 我們第一天，一個學長帶我們參觀學校。

items.en: You were seen at the cinema on Saturday! Who were you with?
items.zh: 有人星期六在電影院看到你！你跟誰去的？

items.en: The waiting room was full. We were told to wait outside until the doctor was ready.
items.zh: 候診室滿了。我們被叫到外面等，等醫生準備好。

items.en: I was woken up at six by the birds outside my window.
items.zh: 我六點就被窗外的鳥吵醒了。

examples.heading: ④ he / she / they + was / were + 過去分詞

items.en: My grandad was a teacher for forty years. He was loved by all his students.
items.zh: 我爺爺當了四十年老師。他所有的學生都很愛他。

items.en: My sister was so excited. She was offered a place at the university.
items.zh: 我姊姊好興奮。大學錄取她了。

items.en: I sent the photos on Monday, but they were never received.
items.zh: 我星期一寄了照片，可是一直沒有收到。

items.en: Our neighbours were very kind. They were invited to the party too.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居人很好。他們也受邀參加派對了。

items.en: The new boy was nervous, but he was welcomed by the whole class.
items.zh: 新來的男生很緊張，可是全班都歡迎他。

examples.heading: ⑤ people / children / 不可數名詞

items.en: It was a terrible accident. Five people were taken to hospital.
items.zh: 那是一場很嚴重的車禍。有五個人被送去醫院。

items.en: At the end of the show, the children were given a small present.
items.zh: 表演結束時，孩子們每人拿到一份小禮物。

items.en: We moved to a smaller flat, so most of the furniture was sold.
items.zh: 我們搬到比較小的公寓，所以大部分的家具都賣掉了。

items.en: Grandma looked everywhere for her birthday money. The money was found under the sofa a week later.
items.zh: 奶奶到處找她的生日禮金。那筆錢一星期後在沙發底下找到了。

items.en: We booked the trip online. All the information was sent to us by email.
items.zh: 我們在網路上訂了旅行。所有的資料都用電子郵件寄給我們了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的情境

items.en: The concert was amazing. The songs were sung in three languages.
items.zh: 演唱會很精彩。那些歌用三種語言唱。

items.en: "Why are you so late?" "We were stopped by the police for a check."
items.zh: 你們怎麼這麼晚？我們被警察攔下來檢查。

items.en: "Where did you get those apples?" "They were given to us by our neighbour."
items.zh: 你們那些蘋果哪來的？鄰居送我們的。

items.en: "Did you enjoy the trip?" "Yes! We were taken to an island by boat."
items.zh: 旅行好玩嗎？好玩！他們用船載我們去一個島。

items.en: "What happened to the old cinema?" "It was turned into a supermarket."
items.zh: 那家舊電影院怎麼了？改成超市了。

title: The ticket price was not reduced despite the fact that I showed my student ID.
translation: 雖然我出示了學生證，票價還是沒有打折。
name: 過去簡單式被動語態的否定句
sentences: I'm very unhappy with your cinema. The ticket price was not reduced despite the fact that I showed my student ID.
My back hurt so badly that I went to hospital, and I wasn't allowed to work for two weeks.
The window wasn't locked, so the thief just climbed in.
We lost the match, but it wasn't our fault. The goal wasn't given.
My cousin got married last month. I was a bit sad because I wasn't invited.
The cake was a surprise for Mum. She wasn't told about it until the party.
I was really disappointed with the hotel because a lot of things were not done.
Our exam papers weren't marked before the holiday, so we waited two weeks for our results.
Some people say that studying animals would be impossible if they weren't kept in zoos.
We were angry because we weren't given any information about the delay.
The flowers died because they weren't watered while we were away.
Some of the questions weren't answered, so I wrote to the company again.
When I was a child, I wasn't allowed to stay up after nine.
We visited an old church in Rome, but we weren't allowed to take photos inside.
My brother wasn't allowed to drive until he was eighteen.
The students weren't allowed to use their phones during the trip.
I applied for the job, but I wasn't chosen.
Lucy was upset. She wasn't picked for the school play.
The new players weren't paid for the first month.
The car was badly damaged, but luckily we weren't hurt.
I wasn't woken up by the storm. I slept all night.
We had to sit on the floor at the start. The chairs weren't put out in time.
My order arrived late because it wasn't sent until Friday.
The room was dirty. It wasn't cleaned before we arrived.
The concert didn't start on time because the stage wasn't finished.
I'm sorry, but your email wasn't received. Could you send it again?
The house was sold, but the garden wasn't.
The children were given a present, but the adults weren't.
"Weren't you told about the change?" "No, nobody said anything to me."
"Why wasn't the bridge finished on time?" "There wasn't enough money."
"Was the parcel delivered?" "No, it wasn't. Nobody was at home."

examples.heading: ① wasn't / was not + 過去分詞

items.en: I'm very unhappy with your cinema. The ticket price was not reduced despite the fact that I showed my student ID.
items.zh: 我對你們電影院很不滿。雖然我出示了學生證，票價還是沒有打折。

items.en: My back hurt so badly that I went to hospital, and I wasn't allowed to work for two weeks.
items.zh: 我的背痛到去了醫院，兩個星期都不准工作。

items.en: The window wasn't locked, so the thief just climbed in.
items.zh: 窗戶沒鎖，所以小偷直接爬進來。

items.en: We lost the match, but it wasn't our fault. The goal wasn't given.
items.zh: 我們輸了比賽，可是那不是我們的錯。那一球沒算。

items.en: My cousin got married last month. I was a bit sad because I wasn't invited.
items.zh: 我表姊上個月結婚了。我有點難過，因為我沒被邀請。

items.en: The cake was a surprise for Mum. She wasn't told about it until the party.
items.zh: 蛋糕是給媽媽的驚喜。派對開始前沒人告訴她。

examples.heading: ② weren't / were not + 過去分詞

items.en: I was really disappointed with the hotel because a lot of things were not done.
items.zh: 我對那間旅館很失望，因為很多事都沒做。

items.en: Our exam papers weren't marked before the holiday, so we waited two weeks for our results.
items.zh: 考卷假期前沒改，所以我們等了兩個星期才拿到成績。

items.en: Some people say that studying animals would be impossible if they weren't kept in zoos.
items.zh: 有些人說，如果動物沒有養在動物園裡，就沒辦法研究牠們。

items.en: We were angry because we weren't given any information about the delay.
items.zh: 我們很生氣，因為沒人告訴我們任何延誤的消息。

items.en: The flowers died because they weren't watered while we were away.
items.zh: 花死了，因為我們不在的時候沒人澆水。

items.en: Some of the questions weren't answered, so I wrote to the company again.
items.zh: 有些問題沒得到回答，所以我又寫信給那家公司。

examples.heading: ③ wasn't / weren't allowed to

items.en: When I was a child, I wasn't allowed to stay up after nine.
items.zh: 我小時候，九點以後不准熬夜。

items.en: We visited an old church in Rome, but we weren't allowed to take photos inside.
items.zh: 我們去參觀羅馬一間老教堂，可是裡面不准我們拍照。

items.en: My brother wasn't allowed to drive until he was eighteen.
items.zh: 我哥哥十八歲以前不准開車。

items.en: The students weren't allowed to use their phones during the trip.
items.zh: 校外教學時學生不准用手機。

examples.heading: ④ 人當主詞

items.en: I applied for the job, but I wasn't chosen.
items.zh: 我應徵了那份工作，可是沒被選上。

items.en: Lucy was upset. She wasn't picked for the school play.
items.zh: Lucy 很難過。學校話劇沒選她。

items.en: The new players weren't paid for the first month.
items.zh: 新球員第一個月沒拿到薪水。

items.en: The car was badly damaged, but luckily we weren't hurt.
items.zh: 車子撞得很嚴重，可是幸好我們沒受傷。

items.en: I wasn't woken up by the storm. I slept all night.
items.zh: 暴風雨沒把我吵醒。我睡了一整晚。

examples.heading: ⑤ 抱怨和解釋

items.en: We had to sit on the floor at the start. The chairs weren't put out in time.
items.zh: 一開始我們只好坐在地上。椅子沒有及時擺出來。

items.en: My order arrived late because it wasn't sent until Friday.
items.zh: 我的訂單很晚才到，因為星期五才寄出。

items.en: The room was dirty. It wasn't cleaned before we arrived.
items.zh: 房間很髒。我們到之前沒打掃。

items.en: The concert didn't start on time because the stage wasn't finished.
items.zh: 音樂會沒有準時開始，因為舞台還沒搭好。

items.en: I'm sorry, but your email wasn't received. Could you send it again?
items.zh: 抱歉，我們沒收到你的電子郵件。可以再寄一次嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 對比

items.en: The house was sold, but the garden wasn't.
items.zh: 房子賣掉了，可是花園沒有。

items.en: The children were given a present, but the adults weren't.
items.zh: 孩子們有拿到禮物，可是大人沒有。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Weren't you told about the change?" "No, nobody said anything to me."
items.zh: 沒人跟你說改了嗎？沒有，沒人跟我說。

items.en: "Why wasn't the bridge finished on time?" "There wasn't enough money."
items.zh: 橋為什麼沒有準時完工？錢不夠。

items.en: "Was the parcel delivered?" "No, it wasn't. Nobody was at home."
items.zh: 包裹送到了嗎？沒有。家裡沒人。

title: Did you know that the next Harry Potter movie is being filmed in my school?
translation: 你知道下一部《哈利波特》電影正在我們學校拍嗎？
name: 現在進行式被動語態的肯定句（常用動詞）
sentences: Did you know that the next Harry Potter movie is being filmed in my school?
We can't use the gym this week. The floor is being cleaned.
Let's stay at my house and visit Tokyo, where an interesting history exhibition is being held.
Sorry, you can't take the bus today. The bridge is being repaired.
Look at all those cranes. A new hospital is being built next to the station.
My laptop is being fixed, so I'm using my brother's.
Don't sit there! That chair is being painted.
The TV people are at our school today. They're filming a class where new sports clothes are being tested.
The streets near my flat are being dug up for new pipes.
Come and see the baby birds! They're being fed by their mother.
All the old trees in the park are being cut down. It's so sad.
Our exams are being marked this week, so we'll get the results on Monday.
The rooms upstairs are being painted, so we're sleeping in the living room.
I'm being followed by a strange dog! It's been behind me for ten minutes.
My mum is calling, but I can't answer. I'm being interviewed for the school newspaper.
Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm being driven to the station by my dad.
Grandpa had a fall, but he's fine. He's being looked after by the nurses now.
The teachers are busy this morning. The new students are being shown around the school.
My brother loves cooking. He's being trained as a chef in a hotel in Paris.
We got to the stadium early. The players are being given their new shirts.
Prices have gone up a lot this year. As a result, the country's economy is being watched closely by many experts.
Please wait. Your call is being transferred.
The plane has landed, but passengers are being asked to stay in their seats.
There's too much traffic on the old road. A new road is being planned between the two towns.
The forest fire is still burning. It's being fought by over a hundred firefighters.
"Where's your car?" "It's being washed at the garage."
"Why is the road closed?" "A film is being made there."
"Is your kitchen finished?" "No, the new cupboards are being put in this week."
"What's that noise?" "The house next door is being knocked down."
"Is dinner ready?" "Almost. The pasta is being cooked now."
"Can I use the meeting room?" "Not yet. It's being cleaned."

examples.heading: ① is being + 過去分詞

items.en: Did you know that the next Harry Potter movie is being filmed in my school?
items.zh: 你知道下一部《哈利波特》電影正在我們學校拍嗎？

items.en: We can't use the gym this week. The floor is being cleaned.
items.zh: 我們這星期不能用體育館。地板正在清洗。

items.en: Let's stay at my house and visit Tokyo, where an interesting history exhibition is being held.
items.zh: 我們住我家，去東京玩吧，那裡正在辦一個很有意思的歷史展覽。

items.en: Sorry, you can't take the bus today. The bridge is being repaired.
items.zh: 抱歉，你今天不能搭公車。橋正在修。

items.en: Look at all those cranes. A new hospital is being built next to the station.
items.zh: 你看那些起重機。車站旁邊正在蓋一間新醫院。

items.en: My laptop is being fixed, so I'm using my brother's.
items.zh: 我的筆電正在修，所以我在用我哥哥的。

items.en: Don't sit there! That chair is being painted.
items.zh: 不要坐那裡！那張椅子正在上漆。

examples.heading: ② are being + 過去分詞

items.en: The TV people are at our school today. They're filming a class where new sports clothes are being tested.
items.zh: 電視台的人今天在我們學校。他們在拍一個班，那個班正在試穿新的運動服。

items.en: The streets near my flat are being dug up for new pipes.
items.zh: 我家附近的街道正在挖，要換新的水管。

items.en: Come and see the baby birds! They're being fed by their mother.
items.zh: 快來看小鳥！鳥媽媽正在餵牠們。

items.en: All the old trees in the park are being cut down. It's so sad.
items.zh: 公園裡的老樹正在被砍掉。好可惜。

items.en: Our exams are being marked this week, so we'll get the results on Monday.
items.zh: 我們的考卷這星期在改，所以星期一會拿到成績。

items.en: The rooms upstairs are being painted, so we're sleeping in the living room.
items.zh: 樓上的房間正在粉刷，所以我們睡客廳。

examples.heading: ③ am being + 過去分詞

items.en: I'm being followed by a strange dog! It's been behind me for ten minutes.
items.zh: 有一隻奇怪的狗在跟著我！牠已經在我後面十分鐘了。

items.en: My mum is calling, but I can't answer. I'm being interviewed for the school newspaper.
items.zh: 我媽媽打來了，可是我不能接。學校報紙正在訪問我。

items.en: Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm being driven to the station by my dad.
items.zh: 抱歉，我現在不能講。我爸爸正開車載我去車站。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞是人

items.en: Grandpa had a fall, but he's fine. He's being looked after by the nurses now.
items.zh: 爺爺跌倒了，不過他沒事。現在護士正在照顧他。

items.en: The teachers are busy this morning. The new students are being shown around the school.
items.zh: 老師們今天早上很忙。他們正帶新生參觀學校。

items.en: My brother loves cooking. He's being trained as a chef in a hotel in Paris.
items.zh: 我哥哥很愛做菜。他正在巴黎一家飯店受訓當廚師。

items.en: We got to the stadium early. The players are being given their new shirts.
items.zh: 我們很早就到球場。球員們正在領新球衣。

examples.heading: ⑤ 新聞和公告

items.en: Prices have gone up a lot this year. As a result, the country's economy is being watched closely by many experts.
items.zh: 今年物價漲了很多。因此，這個國家的經濟正受到很多專家密切關注。

items.en: Please wait. Your call is being transferred.
items.zh: 請稍候。您的電話正在轉接。

items.en: The plane has landed, but passengers are being asked to stay in their seats.
items.zh: 飛機降落了，可是乘客正被要求留在座位上。

items.en: There's too much traffic on the old road. A new road is being planned between the two towns.
items.zh: 舊的路車太多了。兩個鎮之間正在規劃一條新路。

items.en: The forest fire is still burning. It's being fought by over a hundred firefighters.
items.zh: 森林大火還在燒。一百多名消防員正在救火。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問答

items.en: "Where's your car?" "It's being washed at the garage."
items.zh: 你的車呢？在修車廠洗。

items.en: "Why is the road closed?" "A film is being made there."
items.zh: 那條路為什麼封起來了？那裡在拍電影。

items.en: "Is your kitchen finished?" "No, the new cupboards are being put in this week."
items.zh: 你家廚房弄好了嗎？還沒，新櫃子這星期在裝。

items.en: "What's that noise?" "The house next door is being knocked down."
items.zh: 那是什麼聲音？隔壁的房子在拆。

items.en: "Is dinner ready?" "Almost. The pasta is being cooked now."
items.zh: 晚餐好了嗎？快了。義大利麵正在煮。

items.en: "Can I use the meeting room?" "Not yet. It's being cleaned."
items.zh: 我可以用會議室嗎？還不行。正在打掃。

title: The global temperature is rising, the ice is melting, and miles and miles of coast are being submerged.
translation: 全球氣溫不斷上升，冰正在融化，綿延好幾英里的海岸正被海水淹沒。
name: 現在進行式被動語態的肯定句（較多種動詞）
sentences: Our planet is in danger. The global temperature is rising, the ice is melting, and miles and miles of coast are being submerged.
Every year, huge areas of rainforest are being destroyed to make room for farms.
Our rivers are being polluted by waste from factories.
Look at the trees on the hill. They're being cut down for a new road.
In many countries, old cars are being replaced by electric ones.
This year's topic is the online training for employees, which is being relaunched.
Our computer system is being updated this week, so please save your work.
The company is doing well. New staff are being hired every month.
The new plan is being discussed at the moment. We'll know the result on Friday.
Thank you for your email. Your question is being dealt with by our manager.
First, academic knowledge was linked through computers. Now people are being linked through billions of personal computers.
These days, more and more letters are being replaced by emails.
Small shops in our town are being closed because everyone buys online.
Children are being given phones at a younger and younger age.
A lot of new homes are being built outside the city.
Don't worry about your car. It's being looked at by our best mechanic.
The accident is being investigated by the police.
Please wait here. Your room is being prepared.
My grandmother is in hospital. She's being treated for a bad cough.
"Where's your bike?" "It's being fixed at the shop."
Our school is being extended. There will be a new science building next year.
The exam papers are being marked now, so the results will be out soon.
The children are being taught to swim this term.
A new kind of maths is being tried in some schools.
I can't talk now. I'm being called into a meeting.
I think I'm being followed. There's a man behind me everywhere I go.
Turn on the TV! The players are being interviewed after the match.
You're being asked to help because you know the area well.
"What's happening to the old cinema?" "It's being turned into flats."
"Is anything being done about the noise?" "Yes, the council is looking into it."
"Why is the road closed?" "A new pipe is being put in."

examples.heading: ① 環境和氣候

items.en: Our planet is in danger. The global temperature is rising, the ice is melting, and miles and miles of coast are being submerged.
items.zh: 我們的地球有危險。全球氣溫不斷上升，冰正在融化，綿延好幾英里的海岸正被海水淹沒。

items.en: Every year, huge areas of rainforest are being destroyed to make room for farms.
items.zh: 每年都有大片雨林被毀掉，用來開闢農地。

items.en: Our rivers are being polluted by waste from factories.
items.zh: 我們的河流正被工廠的廢水汙染。

items.en: Look at the trees on the hill. They're being cut down for a new road.
items.zh: 你看山上的樹。它們被砍掉要蓋新路。

items.en: In many countries, old cars are being replaced by electric ones.
items.zh: 在很多國家，舊車正在被電動車取代。

examples.heading: ② 公司和工作

items.en: This year's topic is the online training for employees, which is being relaunched.
items.zh: 今年的主題是員工的線上訓練，這個訓練正在重新推出。

items.en: Our computer system is being updated this week, so please save your work.
items.zh: 我們的電腦系統這個星期在更新，所以請存好你的檔案。

items.en: The company is doing well. New staff are being hired every month.
items.zh: 公司經營得不錯。每個月都在招新員工。

items.en: The new plan is being discussed at the moment. We'll know the result on Friday.
items.zh: 新計畫現在正在討論。我們星期五會知道結果。

items.en: Thank you for your email. Your question is being dealt with by our manager.
items.zh: 謝謝你的來信。你的問題我們經理正在處理。

examples.heading: ③ 科技和社會

items.en: First, academic knowledge was linked through computers. Now people are being linked through billions of personal computers.
items.zh: 一開始是學術知識透過電腦連在一起。現在人們正透過幾十億台個人電腦連在一起。

items.en: These days, more and more letters are being replaced by emails.
items.zh: 現在有愈來愈多信件被電子郵件取代。

items.en: Small shops in our town are being closed because everyone buys online.
items.zh: 我們鎮上的小店一間一間關門，因為大家都在網路上買東西。

items.en: Children are being given phones at a younger and younger age.
items.zh: 孩子拿到手機的年紀愈來愈小。

items.en: A lot of new homes are being built outside the city.
items.zh: 城外正在蓋很多新房子。

examples.heading: ④ 正在處理的事

items.en: Don't worry about your car. It's being looked at by our best mechanic.
items.zh: 別擔心你的車。我們最好的技師正在看。

items.en: The accident is being investigated by the police.
items.zh: 警察正在調查這場車禍。

items.en: Please wait here. Your room is being prepared.
items.zh: 請在這裡等。你的房間正在準備。

items.en: My grandmother is in hospital. She's being treated for a bad cough.
items.zh: 我奶奶在住院。她因為咳得很厲害在接受治療。

items.en: "Where's your bike?" "It's being fixed at the shop."
items.zh: 你的腳踏車呢？在店裡修。

examples.heading: ⑤ 學校

items.en: Our school is being extended. There will be a new science building next year.
items.zh: 我們學校正在擴建。明年會有一棟新的科學大樓。

items.en: The exam papers are being marked now, so the results will be out soon.
items.zh: 考卷現在正在改，所以成績很快就會出來。

items.en: The children are being taught to swim this term.
items.zh: 孩子們這學期在學游泳。

items.en: A new kind of maths is being tried in some schools.
items.zh: 有些學校正在試一種新的數學教法。

examples.heading: ⑥ 人當主詞

items.en: I can't talk now. I'm being called into a meeting.
items.zh: 我現在不能講。有人叫我去開會。

items.en: I think I'm being followed. There's a man behind me everywhere I go.
items.zh: 我覺得有人在跟蹤我。我走到哪裡都有一個男人在我後面。

items.en: Turn on the TV! The players are being interviewed after the match.
items.zh: 快開電視！球員賽後正在接受訪問。

items.en: You're being asked to help because you know the area well.
items.zh: 請你幫忙是因為你很熟這一帶。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "What's happening to the old cinema?" "It's being turned into flats."
items.zh: 那間舊電影院怎麼了？正在改成公寓。

items.en: "Is anything being done about the noise?" "Yes, the council is looking into it."
items.zh: 噪音的事有人在處理嗎？有，市議會在調查。

items.en: "Why is the road closed?" "A new pipe is being put in."
items.zh: 路為什麼封起來？正在埋新的水管。

title: Students are not being educated equally.
translation: 學生並沒有受到平等的教育。
name: 現在進行式被動語態的否定句
sentences: Some schools have everything and some have nothing. Students are not being educated equally.
Some people hate zoos. But having animals in a zoo doesn't mean that they aren't being treated right.
The new rules aren't being followed by most drivers.
I'm worried about the old trees in the park. They aren't being looked after.
Our emails aren't being answered. I think the office is closed.
The cleaners are on strike, so the streets aren't being cleaned this week.
We should keep as many languages alive as possible, so that part of human history is not being lost.
Don't sit there. That chair is broken, and it isn't being used.
The project isn't being managed well. We're already two weeks late.
My brother is upset because he isn't being paid enough at work.
The heating isn't being turned on until next month, so wear a jumper.
Lucy is angry with her friends. She feels she isn't being listened to.
I'm not being paid for this extra work, so I'm going home at five.
Can somebody tell me what's going on? I'm not being told everything, am I?
I don't like this job. I'm not being given anything interesting to do.
I'm not being sent the club's emails any more. Can you check my address?
The old factory isn't being used at the moment. It's empty.
Sorry, that room isn't being cleaned today. The cleaner is ill.
These books aren't being read any more. Let's give them away.
The match isn't being shown on TV this year.
Don't worry. You aren't being blamed for the accident.
The trees in the square aren't being cut down after all. The council changed its mind.
Relax. You aren't being tested on this chapter.
Your car isn't being taken away. You can leave it here until six.
Why aren't these boxes being moved? They've been here all week.
The children aren't being taught enough maths at that school.
I think our money isn't being spent wisely.
Someone should talk to the nurses. The patients on this floor aren't being given enough water.
"Isn't the kitchen being painted this week?" "No, it's next week now."
"Why isn't anything being done about the traffic?" "Nobody wants to pay for it."
"Aren't you being met at the station?" "No, I'm taking a taxi."

examples.heading: ① aren't / are not being + 過去分詞

items.en: Some schools have everything and some have nothing. Students are not being educated equally.
items.zh: 有些學校什麼都有，有些學校什麼都沒有。學生並沒有受到平等的教育。

items.en: Some people hate zoos. But having animals in a zoo doesn't mean that they aren't being treated right.
items.zh: 有些人很討厭動物園。可是動物養在動物園裡，不代表牠們沒有受到好的對待。

items.en: The new rules aren't being followed by most drivers.
items.zh: 大部分的駕駛都沒有遵守新規定。

items.en: I'm worried about the old trees in the park. They aren't being looked after.
items.zh: 我很擔心公園裡的老樹。沒人在照顧它們。

items.en: Our emails aren't being answered. I think the office is closed.
items.zh: 我們的電子郵件都沒人回。我想辦公室沒開。

items.en: The cleaners are on strike, so the streets aren't being cleaned this week.
items.zh: 清潔工在罷工，所以這星期街上沒人打掃。

examples.heading: ② isn't / is not being + 過去分詞

items.en: We should keep as many languages alive as possible, so that part of human history is not being lost.
items.zh: 我們應該讓愈多語言活下來愈好，才不會失去一部分人類的歷史。

items.en: Don't sit there. That chair is broken, and it isn't being used.
items.zh: 別坐那裡。那張椅子壞了，沒人在用。

items.en: The project isn't being managed well. We're already two weeks late.
items.zh: 這個計畫沒有管理好。我們已經晚了兩個星期。

items.en: My brother is upset because he isn't being paid enough at work.
items.zh: 我哥哥很不高興，因為他工作的薪水太少。

items.en: The heating isn't being turned on until next month, so wear a jumper.
items.zh: 暖氣下個月才會開，所以穿件毛衣。

items.en: Lucy is angry with her friends. She feels she isn't being listened to.
items.zh: Lucy 在生朋友的氣。她覺得沒人在聽她說話。

examples.heading: ③ I'm not being + 過去分詞

items.en: I'm not being paid for this extra work, so I'm going home at five.
items.zh: 這些加班我沒拿到錢，所以我五點就回家。

items.en: Can somebody tell me what's going on? I'm not being told everything, am I?
items.zh: 誰可以告訴我發生什麼事？你們沒跟我說全部，對吧？

items.en: I don't like this job. I'm not being given anything interesting to do.
items.zh: 我不喜歡這份工作。我沒有分到任何有趣的事做。

items.en: I'm not being sent the club's emails any more. Can you check my address?
items.zh: 我已經收不到社團的電子郵件了。你可以查一下我的地址嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 現在這段時間

items.en: The old factory isn't being used at the moment. It's empty.
items.zh: 那間舊工廠現在沒在用。裡面是空的。

items.en: Sorry, that room isn't being cleaned today. The cleaner is ill.
items.zh: 抱歉，那個房間今天沒人打掃。清潔工生病了。

items.en: These books aren't being read any more. Let's give them away.
items.zh: 這些書已經沒人在看了。我們送人吧。

items.en: The match isn't being shown on TV this year.
items.zh: 今年那場比賽沒有電視轉播。

examples.heading: ⑤ 安慰和保證

items.en: Don't worry. You aren't being blamed for the accident.
items.zh: 別擔心。沒有人怪你造成這場意外。

items.en: The trees in the square aren't being cut down after all. The council changed its mind.
items.zh: 廣場上的樹最後不會被砍了。市議會改變主意了。

items.en: Relax. You aren't being tested on this chapter.
items.zh: 放輕鬆。這一章不會考。

items.en: Your car isn't being taken away. You can leave it here until six.
items.zh: 你的車不會被拖走。你可以停到六點。

examples.heading: ⑥ 抱怨

items.en: Why aren't these boxes being moved? They've been here all week.
items.zh: 這些箱子怎麼沒人搬？它們在這裡放一整個星期了。

items.en: The children aren't being taught enough maths at that school.
items.zh: 那間學校教孩子的數學不夠。

items.en: I think our money isn't being spent wisely.
items.zh: 我覺得我們的錢沒有花在對的地方。

items.en: Someone should talk to the nurses. The patients on this floor aren't being given enough water.
items.zh: 應該有人去跟護士說。這層樓的病人沒拿到足夠的水。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Isn't the kitchen being painted this week?" "No, it's next week now."
items.zh: 廚房這星期不是要油漆嗎？不是，改成下星期了。

items.en: "Why isn't anything being done about the traffic?" "Nobody wants to pay for it."
items.zh: 交通的問題為什麼沒人處理？沒人想出錢。

items.en: "Aren't you being met at the station?" "No, I'm taking a taxi."
items.zh: 沒有人去車站接你嗎？沒有，我搭計程車。

title: I have been asked to write a report about an accident that happened to me last Saturday.
translation: 我被要求寫一份報告，交代上週六我遇到的意外。
name: 現在完成式被動語態的肯定句
sentences: Dear Sir, I have been asked to write a report about an accident that happened to me last Saturday.
Great news! We've been invited to Sam's wedding in June.
I've been offered a place at the university, so I'm moving in September.
We've just been told that the flight is delayed.
I've been chosen to play in the final. I can't believe it!
Have you heard? The meeting has been moved to Friday.
My bike has been stolen. I left it outside the library.
I walked past the old cinema today. It's been turned into a gym.
My brother's very happy. He's been given a pay rise.
Don't use the lift. It's been switched off for repairs.
Your parcel has been sent. It should arrive on Tuesday.
I am writing to give you more information about the arrangements which have been made for your group of students.
The nurse called this morning. Your test results have been sent to your doctor.
Look at the park! Lots of new trees have been planted.
All the tickets have been sold, I'm afraid.
The school is empty now. The children have all been picked up by their parents.
The floor has just been cleaned, so please take your shoes off.
You don't need to pay. The bill has already been paid.
Our street has recently been made into a one-way street.
Your room has already been prepared. Here's the key.
This house has been owned by my family for over a hundred years.
The road has been closed since Monday because of the flood.
The castle has been visited by millions of people since it opened.
We always buy our bread at that shop. It has been run by the same family for three generations.
We are pleased to tell you that your application has been accepted.
Please note that the library's opening hours have been changed.
Our old manager left in May. A new manager has been appointed and will start next month.
Your order has been received and is being prepared.
"Has the car been fixed yet?" "Yes, you can pick it up tomorrow."
"Have you been told about the new timetable?" "No, what's changed?"
"Why is everyone so excited?" "The school has been chosen for a TV show."

examples.heading: ① I / we have been + 過去分詞

items.en: Dear Sir, I have been asked to write a report about an accident that happened to me last Saturday.
items.zh: 敬啟者：我被要求寫一份報告，交代上週六我遇到的意外。

items.en: Great news! We've been invited to Sam's wedding in June.
items.zh: 好消息！我們收到 Sam 六月婚禮的邀請了。

items.en: I've been offered a place at the university, so I'm moving in September.
items.zh: 大學錄取我了，所以我九月要搬家。

items.en: We've just been told that the flight is delayed.
items.zh: 我們剛接到通知，班機延誤了。

items.en: I've been chosen to play in the final. I can't believe it!
items.zh: 我被選去打決賽了。真不敢相信！

examples.heading: ② it / he / she has been + 過去分詞

items.en: Have you heard? The meeting has been moved to Friday.
items.zh: 你聽說了嗎？會議改到星期五了。

items.en: My bike has been stolen. I left it outside the library.
items.zh: 我的腳踏車被偷了。我把它停在圖書館外面。

items.en: I walked past the old cinema today. It's been turned into a gym.
items.zh: 我今天經過那間舊電影院。它改成健身房了。

items.en: My brother's very happy. He's been given a pay rise.
items.zh: 我哥哥很開心。他加薪了。

items.en: Don't use the lift. It's been switched off for repairs.
items.zh: 別搭電梯。它關掉在修理了。

items.en: Your parcel has been sent. It should arrive on Tuesday.
items.zh: 你的包裹已經寄出了。應該星期二會到。

examples.heading: ③ they / 複數名詞 have been + 過去分詞

items.en: I am writing to give you more information about the arrangements which have been made for your group of students.
items.zh: 我寫信給您，是要提供更多關於您學生團體的安排資訊。

items.en: The nurse called this morning. Your test results have been sent to your doctor.
items.zh: 護士今天早上打電話來。你的檢查結果已經寄給你的醫生了。

items.en: Look at the park! Lots of new trees have been planted.
items.zh: 你看公園！種了好多新的樹。

items.en: All the tickets have been sold, I'm afraid.
items.zh: 恐怕票已經全部賣完了。

items.en: The school is empty now. The children have all been picked up by their parents.
items.zh: 學校現在空了。孩子們都被爸媽接走了。

examples.heading: ④ just / already / recently

items.en: The floor has just been cleaned, so please take your shoes off.
items.zh: 地板剛拖過，所以請脫鞋。

items.en: You don't need to pay. The bill has already been paid.
items.zh: 你不用付錢。帳單已經付了。

items.en: Our street has recently been made into a one-way street.
items.zh: 我們這條街最近改成單行道了。

items.en: Your room has already been prepared. Here's the key.
items.zh: 您的房間已經準備好了。這是鑰匙。

examples.heading: ⑤ since 和 for

items.en: This house has been owned by my family for over a hundred years.
items.zh: 這間房子我們家已經擁有一百多年了。

items.en: The road has been closed since Monday because of the flood.
items.zh: 這條路從星期一就因為淹水封起來了。

items.en: The castle has been visited by millions of people since it opened.
items.zh: 這座城堡開放以來，已經有幾百萬人參觀過。

items.en: We always buy our bread at that shop. It has been run by the same family for three generations.
items.zh: 我們都在那家店買麵包。那家店已經由同一家人經營了三代。

examples.heading: ⑥ 正式通知

items.en: We are pleased to tell you that your application has been accepted.
items.zh: 很高興通知您，您的申請已經通過了。

items.en: Please note that the library's opening hours have been changed.
items.zh: 請注意，圖書館的開放時間已經改了。

items.en: Our old manager left in May. A new manager has been appointed and will start next month.
items.zh: 我們的前任經理五月離職了。新經理已經任命了，下個月開始上班。

items.en: Your order has been received and is being prepared.
items.zh: 您的訂單已經收到，正在準備中。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Has the car been fixed yet?" "Yes, you can pick it up tomorrow."
items.zh: 車子修好了嗎？好了，你明天可以來牽。

items.en: "Have you been told about the new timetable?" "No, what's changed?"
items.zh: 有人跟你說新的課表嗎？沒有，改了什麼？

items.en: "Why is everyone so excited?" "The school has been chosen for a TV show."
items.zh: 大家為什麼那麼興奮？學校被選上要上電視節目。

title: This happened two years ago, and the necklace hasn't been found yet.
translation: 這件事發生在兩年前，那條項鍊到現在還沒找到。
name: 現在完成式被動語態的否定句
sentences: Somebody broke into my grandma's house. This happened two years ago, and the necklace hasn't been found yet.
I'm still waiting for my money. My bill hasn't been paid yet.
Don't eat the cake! It hasn't been cut yet.
Sorry, the report hasn't been finished yet. I'll send it tomorrow.
Lucy's very nervous. She hasn't been told her exam results yet.
We can't go into the new classrooms. The desks haven't been delivered yet.
I can't show you my photos from the trip. They haven't been printed yet.
I'm not sure who's in the team. The names haven't been announced yet.
The guests are here, but the drinks haven't been put out yet!
We haven't been paid yet this month. I hope it's soon.
The old house which has not been used for twenty years is not a nice sight for our town.
The windows haven't been cleaned for months. I can't see outside.
I should take my car to the garage. It hasn't been checked since last summer.
These books haven't been taken out of the library for years.
The garden hasn't been looked after since the old lady moved away.
Come and see it at the museum this week. This painting has never been shown in public before.
I've never been invited to one of their parties.
The case has never been solved. Nobody knows who did it.
The top of that mountain has never been reached in winter.
I'm writing because my order hasn't been delivered. I ordered it three weeks ago.
The heating in our flat hasn't been fixed, and it's really cold.
My emails haven't been answered. Can someone call me, please?
We've been waiting for an hour, and we haven't been given any information.
The rubbish hasn't been collected for two weeks. The street smells awful.
The police say that the thief hasn't been caught.
According to the news, the cause of the fire hasn't been found.
My boss says that the decision hasn't been made.
I heard that the new road hasn't been opened because of the snow.
"Has the room been booked?" "No, it hasn't been booked yet. Shall I do it?"
"Why hasn't the bridge been repaired?" "There's no money."
"Haven't you been sent the new timetable?" "No. Can you forward it to me?"

examples.heading: ① hasn't been + 過去分詞 + yet

items.en: Somebody broke into my grandma's house. This happened two years ago, and the necklace hasn't been found yet.
items.zh: 有人闖進我奶奶家。這件事發生在兩年前，那條項鍊到現在還沒找到。

items.en: I'm still waiting for my money. My bill hasn't been paid yet.
items.zh: 我還在等我的錢。我的帳單還沒付。

items.en: Don't eat the cake! It hasn't been cut yet.
items.zh: 別吃蛋糕！還沒切。

items.en: Sorry, the report hasn't been finished yet. I'll send it tomorrow.
items.zh: 抱歉，報告還沒寫完。我明天寄。

items.en: Lucy's very nervous. She hasn't been told her exam results yet.
items.zh: Lucy 很緊張。她還沒拿到考試成績。

examples.heading: ② haven't been + 過去分詞 + yet

items.en: We can't go into the new classrooms. The desks haven't been delivered yet.
items.zh: 我們還不能進新教室。桌子還沒送來。

items.en: I can't show you my photos from the trip. They haven't been printed yet.
items.zh: 我還不能給你看旅行的照片。還沒洗出來。

items.en: I'm not sure who's in the team. The names haven't been announced yet.
items.zh: 我不確定誰入選了。名單還沒公布。

items.en: The guests are here, but the drinks haven't been put out yet!
items.zh: 客人來了，可是飲料還沒擺出來！

items.en: We haven't been paid yet this month. I hope it's soon.
items.zh: 我們這個月還沒領薪水。希望快一點。

examples.heading: ③ for 和 since

items.en: The old house which has not been used for twenty years is not a nice sight for our town.
items.zh: 那間二十年沒用的老房子，對我們鎮來說不是好看的景象。

items.en: The windows haven't been cleaned for months. I can't see outside.
items.zh: 窗戶好幾個月沒擦了。我都看不到外面。

items.en: I should take my car to the garage. It hasn't been checked since last summer.
items.zh: 我應該把車開去修車廠。它從去年夏天就沒檢查過了。

items.en: These books haven't been taken out of the library for years.
items.zh: 這些書好幾年沒人從圖書館借出去了。

items.en: The garden hasn't been looked after since the old lady moved away.
items.zh: 那位老太太搬走以後，花園就沒人照顧了。

examples.heading: ④ never

items.en: Come and see it at the museum this week. This painting has never been shown in public before.
items.zh: 這星期來博物館看吧。這幅畫以前從來沒有公開展出過。

items.en: I've never been invited to one of their parties.
items.zh: 他們的派對從來沒邀請過我。

items.en: The case has never been solved. Nobody knows who did it.
items.zh: 這個案子一直沒破。沒人知道是誰做的。

items.en: The top of that mountain has never been reached in winter.
items.zh: 那座山的山頂從來沒有人在冬天登上過。

examples.heading: ⑤ 抱怨

items.en: I'm writing because my order hasn't been delivered. I ordered it three weeks ago.
items.zh: 我寫信來是因為我的訂單還沒送到。我三個星期前就訂了。

items.en: The heating in our flat hasn't been fixed, and it's really cold.
items.zh: 我們公寓的暖氣還沒修好，真的很冷。

items.en: My emails haven't been answered. Can someone call me, please?
items.zh: 我的電子郵件都沒人回。可以請人打電話給我嗎？

items.en: We've been waiting for an hour, and we haven't been given any information.
items.zh: 我們已經等了一個小時，還是沒人給我們任何消息。

items.en: The rubbish hasn't been collected for two weeks. The street smells awful.
items.zh: 垃圾已經兩個星期沒收了。整條街很臭。

examples.heading: ⑥ 轉述消息

items.en: The police say that the thief hasn't been caught.
items.zh: 警察說小偷還沒抓到。

items.en: According to the news, the cause of the fire hasn't been found.
items.zh: 根據新聞，起火原因還沒找到。

items.en: My boss says that the decision hasn't been made.
items.zh: 我老闆說還沒做決定。

items.en: I heard that the new road hasn't been opened because of the snow.
items.zh: 我聽說新路因為下雪還沒通車。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Has the room been booked?" "No, it hasn't been booked yet. Shall I do it?"
items.zh: 房間訂了嗎？還沒訂。要我來訂嗎？

items.en: "Why hasn't the bridge been repaired?" "There's no money."
items.zh: 橋為什麼還沒修？沒有錢。

items.en: "Haven't you been sent the new timetable?" "No. Can you forward it to me?"
items.zh: 沒人寄新的課表給你嗎？沒有。你可以轉寄給我嗎？

title: Our office is situated near the airport.
translation: 我們的辦公室在機場附近。
name: 現在簡單式被動語態的肯定句
sentences: Welcome to the team! Our office is situated near the airport, so you can take the train.
You'll love this hotel. It's situated right next to the beach.
Our school is very old. The main building is made of stone.
My sister lives in Montreal. French is spoken there, so she's learning it.
Don't worry about the bill. Breakfast is included in the price.
My dad has a stressful job, but he's paid very well.
My bedroom is my favourite room. The walls are painted dark blue, and the floor is wood.
Don't put the rubbish out tonight. The bins in our street are emptied on Tuesdays.
These cakes are delicious. They're made with fresh fruit from our garden.
You can't miss the shop. The windows are decorated with lights all year.
You don't need to buy a computer. Students at our school are given a laptop in their first year.
Calculators are allowed in the maths exam, so bring yours tomorrow.
I'm a waiter at a café. I'm paid every Friday.
Our grandparents live far away, but we're invited to their house every summer.
I'm not good at sport, so I'm always chosen last for the team.
In this job, you're expected to start at eight.
On the course, you're given lunch and a cup of coffee in the afternoon.
Our cat is very old now. She's fed three times a day.
My uncle is a famous chef. He's known all over the country.
I love these shoes. They're made in Italy.
The library is great. It's used by students from all over the city.
My little brothers are twins. They're often mixed up by their teachers.
We can't go into the zoo yet. The gates are opened at nine.
I like swimming at my gym. The pool is cleaned every night.
There's a sign at the gallery entrance. Visitors are asked to leave their bags at the door.
Welcome to the online course. Your homework is checked by a teacher every week.
"Where's your new flat?" "It's situated above a bakery in the old town."
"Is service included?" "Yes, it's added to the bill."
"What's this soup made with?" "It's made with pumpkin and a little cream."
"How often are the windows cleaned?" "They're cleaned once a month."
"Do you have to pay for the bus?" "No, students are given a free pass."

examples.heading: ① 單數名詞 + is + 過去分詞

items.en: Welcome to the team! Our office is situated near the airport, so you can take the train.
items.zh: 歡迎加入團隊！我們的辦公室在機場附近，你可以搭火車來。

items.en: You'll love this hotel. It's situated right next to the beach.
items.zh: 你會喜歡這間旅館。它就在海灘旁邊。

items.en: Our school is very old. The main building is made of stone.
items.zh: 我們學校很老。主建築是石頭蓋的。

items.en: My sister lives in Montreal. French is spoken there, so she's learning it.
items.zh: 我姊姊住在蒙特婁。那裡說法語，所以她在學。

items.en: Don't worry about the bill. Breakfast is included in the price.
items.zh: 別擔心帳單。早餐含在價錢裡。

items.en: My dad has a stressful job, but he's paid very well.
items.zh: 我爸爸的工作壓力很大，可是薪水很高。

examples.heading: ② 複數名詞 + are + 過去分詞

items.en: My bedroom is my favourite room. The walls are painted dark blue, and the floor is wood.
items.zh: 我的臥室是我最喜歡的房間。牆壁漆成深藍色，地板是木頭的。

items.en: Don't put the rubbish out tonight. The bins in our street are emptied on Tuesdays.
items.zh: 今晚不要把垃圾拿出去。我們這條街的垃圾桶星期二才清。

items.en: These cakes are delicious. They're made with fresh fruit from our garden.
items.zh: 這些蛋糕很好吃。它們是用我們院子裡的新鮮水果做的。

items.en: You can't miss the shop. The windows are decorated with lights all year.
items.zh: 你不會錯過那家店。它的窗戶一年到頭都掛著燈。

items.en: You don't need to buy a computer. Students at our school are given a laptop in their first year.
items.zh: 你不用買電腦。我們學校的學生一年級都會拿到一台筆電。

items.en: Calculators are allowed in the maths exam, so bring yours tomorrow.
items.zh: 數學考試可以帶計算機，明天記得帶你的來。

examples.heading: ③ I / you / we + am / are + 過去分詞

items.en: I'm a waiter at a café. I'm paid every Friday.
items.zh: 我在咖啡店當服務生。我每個星期五領薪水。

items.en: Our grandparents live far away, but we're invited to their house every summer.
items.zh: 我們的爺爺奶奶住得很遠，可是每年夏天都邀我們去他們家。

items.en: I'm not good at sport, so I'm always chosen last for the team.
items.zh: 我運動不好，所以分隊的時候我總是最後一個被選。

items.en: In this job, you're expected to start at eight.
items.zh: 這份工作要八點上班。

items.en: On the course, you're given lunch and a cup of coffee in the afternoon.
items.zh: 上課的時候，中午有午餐，下午有一杯咖啡。

examples.heading: ④ he / she / it / they + is / are + 過去分詞

items.en: Our cat is very old now. She's fed three times a day.
items.zh: 我們的貓現在很老了。她一天吃三餐。

items.en: My uncle is a famous chef. He's known all over the country.
items.zh: 我叔叔是一位有名的廚師。全國的人都知道他。

items.en: I love these shoes. They're made in Italy.
items.zh: 我很喜歡這雙鞋。是義大利做的。

items.en: The library is great. It's used by students from all over the city.
items.zh: 那間圖書館很棒。全市的學生都會去用。

items.en: My little brothers are twins. They're often mixed up by their teachers.
items.zh: 我的弟弟們是雙胞胎。老師常常把他們搞混。

examples.heading: ⑤ 規定和安排

items.en: We can't go into the zoo yet. The gates are opened at nine.
items.zh: 我們還不能進動物園。大門九點才開。

items.en: I like swimming at my gym. The pool is cleaned every night.
items.zh: 我喜歡在我的健身房游泳。游泳池每天晚上都會清洗。

items.en: There's a sign at the gallery entrance. Visitors are asked to leave their bags at the door.
items.zh: 美術館入口有一個告示。訪客要把包包留在門口。

items.en: Welcome to the online course. Your homework is checked by a teacher every week.
items.zh: 歡迎參加線上課程。你的功課每個星期都會有老師檢查。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問答

items.en: "Where's your new flat?" "It's situated above a bakery in the old town."
items.zh: 你的新公寓在哪裡？在老城區一家麵包店樓上。

items.en: "Is service included?" "Yes, it's added to the bill."
items.zh: 有含服務費嗎？有，加在帳單裡了。

items.en: "What's this soup made with?" "It's made with pumpkin and a little cream."
items.zh: 這個湯是用什麼做的？是南瓜加一點鮮奶油做的。

items.en: "How often are the windows cleaned?" "They're cleaned once a month."
items.zh: 窗戶多久擦一次？一個月一次。

items.en: "Do you have to pay for the bus?" "No, students are given a free pass."
items.zh: 你搭公車要付錢嗎？不用，學生有免費的乘車證。

title: The story is about a girl who is not accepted in her class.
translation: 這個故事講的是一個在班上不被接納的女孩。
name: 現在簡單式被動語態的否定句
sentences: I read a book about school life. The story is about a girl who is not accepted in her class.
The room is cheap, but breakfast isn't included.
Please take your dog outside. It isn't allowed in the restaurant.
You can leave your coat on. The heating isn't turned on until November.
My grandma's old piano isn't played any more, so we're giving it away.
Don't worry about the spelling. It isn't marked in this test.
We should replace the printer. It prints very slowly and the sheets aren't printed properly.
Sorry, credit cards aren't accepted here. We only take cash.
Read the sign by the door. Children under twelve aren't allowed in the pool without an adult.
The rooms upstairs aren't used much, so they're always cold.
Our tickets aren't checked on the train, but we always buy them.
Most of these old photos aren't labelled, so we don't know who's in them.
I work late every Friday, but I'm not paid for the extra hours.
My parents are going to a wedding, but we aren't invited.
Put that away, Tom. You aren't allowed to use your phone in class.
I'm not needed at work until ten tomorrow, so I can sleep late.
If you're not chosen this year, you can try again next year.
We watched a sad film last night. It's about a boy who isn't loved by his parents.
Our street is very quiet. We live in a part of the city which isn't visited by many tourists.
We're clearing out the cupboards. Please throw away any clothes that aren't worn any more.
My aunt is a journalist. She writes about people who aren't listened to.
The museum is free, but photos aren't allowed inside.
The school trip is on Saturday. Lunch isn't provided, so please bring your own.
This road isn't used by heavy lorries, so it's quite safe for cycling.
Late essays aren't accepted, so please hand yours in on time.
Your name isn't needed on the form. Just write your student number.
"Is dinner included?" "No, it isn't. Only breakfast is included."
"Can I bring my dog?" "Sorry, dogs aren't allowed in the hotel."
"Why don't you use the front door?" "It isn't opened until nine."
"Is your old bike for sale?" "Yes, it isn't used any more."
"Do you get paid for the training?" "No, we're not paid for that."

examples.heading: ① isn't / is not + 過去分詞

items.en: I read a book about school life. The story is about a girl who is not accepted in her class.
items.zh: 我看了一本講學校生活的書。這個故事講的是一個在班上不被接納的女孩。

items.en: The room is cheap, but breakfast isn't included.
items.zh: 房間很便宜，可是沒有含早餐。

items.en: Please take your dog outside. It isn't allowed in the restaurant.
items.zh: 請把你的狗帶出去。餐廳裡不准帶狗。

items.en: You can leave your coat on. The heating isn't turned on until November.
items.zh: 你可以穿著外套。暖氣要到十一月才會開。

items.en: My grandma's old piano isn't played any more, so we're giving it away.
items.zh: 我奶奶的舊鋼琴已經沒有人彈了，所以我們要送人。

items.en: Don't worry about the spelling. It isn't marked in this test.
items.zh: 別擔心拼字。這次考試不算拼字的分數。

examples.heading: ② aren't / are not + 過去分詞

items.en: We should replace the printer. It prints very slowly and the sheets aren't printed properly.
items.zh: 我們應該換掉印表機。它印得很慢，紙也印得不清楚。

items.en: Sorry, credit cards aren't accepted here. We only take cash.
items.zh: 抱歉，這裡不收信用卡。我們只收現金。

items.en: Read the sign by the door. Children under twelve aren't allowed in the pool without an adult.
items.zh: 看看門邊的告示。十二歲以下的孩子沒有大人陪不能進泳池。

items.en: The rooms upstairs aren't used much, so they're always cold.
items.zh: 樓上的房間很少用，所以一直都很冷。

items.en: Our tickets aren't checked on the train, but we always buy them.
items.zh: 火車上不查票，可是我們都會買票。

items.en: Most of these old photos aren't labelled, so we don't know who's in them.
items.zh: 這些舊照片大部分都沒有標註，所以我們不知道上面是誰。

examples.heading: ③ I'm not / you aren't / we aren't + 過去分詞

items.en: I work late every Friday, but I'm not paid for the extra hours.
items.zh: 我每個星期五都工作到很晚，可是加班的時數我沒有拿到錢。

items.en: My parents are going to a wedding, but we aren't invited.
items.zh: 我爸媽要去參加婚禮，可是我們沒被邀請。

items.en: Put that away, Tom. You aren't allowed to use your phone in class.
items.zh: Tom，把那個收起來。上課不准用手機。

items.en: I'm not needed at work until ten tomorrow, so I can sleep late.
items.zh: 我明天十點才要上班，所以可以睡晚一點。

items.en: If you're not chosen this year, you can try again next year.
items.zh: 你今年要是沒被選上，明年可以再試。

examples.heading: ④ 關係子句裡的否定

items.en: We watched a sad film last night. It's about a boy who isn't loved by his parents.
items.zh: 我們昨晚看了一部很悲傷的電影。內容是一個不被父母愛的男孩。

items.en: Our street is very quiet. We live in a part of the city which isn't visited by many tourists.
items.zh: 我們這條街很安靜。我們住在城裡一個很少遊客去的地方。

items.en: We're clearing out the cupboards. Please throw away any clothes that aren't worn any more.
items.zh: 我們在清櫃子。請把不再穿的衣服丟掉。

items.en: My aunt is a journalist. She writes about people who aren't listened to.
items.zh: 我阿姨是記者。她寫的是那些沒人在聽他們說話的人。

examples.heading: ⑤ 規定和告示

items.en: The museum is free, but photos aren't allowed inside.
items.zh: 博物館不用錢，可是裡面不准拍照。

items.en: The school trip is on Saturday. Lunch isn't provided, so please bring your own.
items.zh: 校外教學在星期六。不提供午餐，請自備。

items.en: This road isn't used by heavy lorries, so it's quite safe for cycling.
items.zh: 這條路沒有大卡車走，所以騎腳踏車很安全。

items.en: Late essays aren't accepted, so please hand yours in on time.
items.zh: 遲交的作文不收，請準時交。

items.en: Your name isn't needed on the form. Just write your student number.
items.zh: 表格上不用寫名字。寫學號就好。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問答

items.en: "Is dinner included?" "No, it isn't. Only breakfast is included."
items.zh: 有含晚餐嗎？沒有。只含早餐。

items.en: "Can I bring my dog?" "Sorry, dogs aren't allowed in the hotel."
items.zh: 我可以帶我的狗嗎？抱歉，旅館不准帶狗。

items.en: "Why don't you use the front door?" "It isn't opened until nine."
items.zh: 你為什麼不走前門？前門九點才開。

items.en: "Is your old bike for sale?" "Yes, it isn't used any more."
items.zh: 你的舊腳踏車要賣嗎？對，已經沒在騎了。

items.en: "Do you get paid for the training?" "No, we're not paid for that."
items.zh: 受訓有錢拿嗎？沒有，那個沒有付錢給我們。

title: Our minibus broke down and it took hours to get it repaired.
translation: 我們的小巴拋錨了，花了好幾個小時才修好。
name: get 加受詞加過去分詞（使某事被做）
sentences: On the way to the coast, our minibus broke down and it took hours to get it repaired.
My phone screen is cracked. I need to get it fixed before the weekend.
We finally got the heating checked after three cold weeks.
Where can I get my watch repaired around here?
I got my bike serviced, so it's running well now.
Caroline and I are good together. I'm a bit lazy, but she's always the one who gets things done.
If you want to get things done, make a list every morning.
Our new manager doesn't talk much, but she gets things done.
I couldn't get anything done today. The phone kept ringing.
We've had complaints from customers about not getting their orders delivered on time.
Can you get these letters posted today? They're important.
I need to get this parcel sent to Spain by Friday.
We got the new furniture delivered on Saturday morning.
I'm getting my hair cut tomorrow. It's far too long.
She got her ears pierced for her sixteenth birthday.
You should get that suit cleaned before the wedding.
He got his photo taken for his new passport.
I need to get this report finished by five.
We got the contract signed just before the deadline.
Let's get the boring jobs done first, and then we can relax.
It took weeks to get my visa approved.
Can you get the room cleaned before the guests arrive?
It's almost impossible to get anything fixed in this building.
We tried for months to get the noise stopped, but nothing changed.
I can't get my money returned. The shop says it's too late.
Getting a new road built in this town takes years.
Get that cut looked at. It might be infected.
Get your homework done before you go out.
You'd better get your passport renewed before the trip.
"Did you get the window fixed?" "Yes, a man came this morning."
"How long did it take to get your car repaired?" "Three days."

examples.heading: ① 修理和服務

items.en: On the way to the coast, our minibus broke down and it took hours to get it repaired.
items.zh: 去海邊的路上，我們的小巴拋錨了，花了好幾個小時才修好。

items.en: My phone screen is cracked. I need to get it fixed before the weekend.
items.zh: 我的手機螢幕裂了。週末前我得拿去修。

items.en: We finally got the heating checked after three cold weeks.
items.zh: 冷了三個星期之後，我們終於找人來檢查暖氣。

items.en: Where can I get my watch repaired around here?
items.zh: 這附近哪裡可以修手錶？

items.en: I got my bike serviced, so it's running well now.
items.zh: 我把腳踏車拿去保養了，所以現在騎起來很順。

examples.heading: ② get things done

items.en: Caroline and I are good together. I'm a bit lazy, but she's always the one who gets things done.
items.zh: 我和 Caroline 很合得來。我有點懶，可是她總是那個把事情做完的人。

items.en: If you want to get things done, make a list every morning.
items.zh: 如果你想把事情做完，每天早上列一張清單。

items.en: Our new manager doesn't talk much, but she gets things done.
items.zh: 我們的新經理話不多，可是她做事很有效率。

items.en: I couldn't get anything done today. The phone kept ringing.
items.zh: 我今天什麼事都做不完。電話一直響。

examples.heading: ③ 訂單和送貨

items.en: We've had complaints from customers about not getting their orders delivered on time.
items.zh: 我們接到客人的抱怨，說訂單沒有準時送到。

items.en: Can you get these letters posted today? They're important.
items.zh: 你今天可以把這些信寄出去嗎？很重要。

items.en: I need to get this parcel sent to Spain by Friday.
items.zh: 我得在星期五前把這個包裹寄到西班牙。

items.en: We got the new furniture delivered on Saturday morning.
items.zh: 我們星期六早上讓人把新家具送來了。

examples.heading: ④ 頭髮和外表

items.en: I'm getting my hair cut tomorrow. It's far too long.
items.zh: 我明天要去剪頭髮。太長了。

items.en: She got her ears pierced for her sixteenth birthday.
items.zh: 她十六歲生日時去穿了耳洞。

items.en: You should get that suit cleaned before the wedding.
items.zh: 婚禮前你應該把那套西裝拿去洗。

items.en: He got his photo taken for his new passport.
items.zh: 他為了辦新護照去拍了照片。

examples.heading: ⑤ 文件和工作

items.en: I need to get this report finished by five.
items.zh: 我得在五點前把這份報告寫完。

items.en: We got the contract signed just before the deadline.
items.zh: 我們在截止日前讓合約簽好了。

items.en: Let's get the boring jobs done first, and then we can relax.
items.zh: 我們先把無聊的工作做完，然後就可以放鬆了。

items.en: It took weeks to get my visa approved.
items.zh: 花了好幾個星期才讓我的簽證核准。

items.en: Can you get the room cleaned before the guests arrive?
items.zh: 客人來之前，你可以讓人把房間打掃好嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 遇到困難

items.en: It's almost impossible to get anything fixed in this building.
items.zh: 在這棟大樓裡，要找人修任何東西都幾乎不可能。

items.en: We tried for months to get the noise stopped, but nothing changed.
items.zh: 我們試了好幾個月想讓噪音停下來，可是什麼都沒改變。

items.en: I can't get my money returned. The shop says it's too late.
items.zh: 我沒辦法讓店家退錢。店家說太晚了。

items.en: Getting a new road built in this town takes years.
items.zh: 在這個鎮上要蓋一條新路，要花好幾年。

examples.heading: ⑦ 命令和建議

items.en: Get that cut looked at. It might be infected.
items.zh: 那個傷口去給人看一下。可能感染了。

items.en: Get your homework done before you go out.
items.zh: 出去之前先把功課做完。

items.en: You'd better get your passport renewed before the trip.
items.zh: 你最好在旅行前去換新護照。

examples.heading: ⑧ 問句

items.en: "Did you get the window fixed?" "Yes, a man came this morning."
items.zh: 你有找人修窗戶嗎？有，今天早上有人來修了。

items.en: "How long did it take to get your car repaired?" "Three days."
items.zh: 你的車修了多久？三天。
