title: I must say that your dilemma got me thinking.
translation: 我得說，你的難題讓我想了很多。
name: get 加受詞加動詞-ing（使某人做某事）
sentences: I was happy to receive your letter, although I must say that your dilemma got me thinking.
The film was simple, but the ending really got us thinking.
Your question got me thinking about my own childhood.
A good teacher gets students thinking for themselves.
Both concerts were great. Elton John and Metallica really know how to get people moving.
The band played an old song, and it got everyone dancing.
The manager couldn't find a way to get the staff moving faster.
Nothing gets me moving in the morning like a strong coffee.
These CDs are so boring. They got me yawning from the very first minute.
Ask him about football. That always gets him talking.
Her funny story got the whole room laughing.
The news got everyone talking at work.
It was so cold that I couldn't get the car going.
Can you help me get this printer working again?
We got the fire going with some old newspapers.
It took an hour to get the old machine running.
Let's get things moving. We've only got an hour.
The coach knows how to get the team working together.
A short game at the start gets the class talking in English.
The new boss got the project going again after months of delay.
That horror film got me checking the locks all night.
The smell from the kitchen got everyone coughing.
His jokes got the children screaming with laughter.
The loud music next door got the dog barking.
This book will get you thinking about the way you live.
I'm trying to get the baby sleeping through the night.
Once you get him laughing, he can't stop.
That walk has got me feeling much better.
"What got you running every morning?" "My doctor told me to get fit."
"How did you get the engine going?" "I just kept trying."
"What got you thinking about moving abroad?" "My sister lives in Canada."

examples.heading: ① get someone thinking

items.en: I was happy to receive your letter, although I must say that your dilemma got me thinking.
items.zh: 我很高興收到你的信，不過我得說，你的難題讓我想了很多。

items.en: The film was simple, but the ending really got us thinking.
items.zh: 那部電影很簡單，可是結局真的讓我們想了很久。

items.en: Your question got me thinking about my own childhood.
items.zh: 你的問題讓我想起了我自己的童年。

items.en: A good teacher gets students thinking for themselves.
items.zh: 好老師會讓學生自己去思考。

examples.heading: ② get people moving / dancing

items.en: Both concerts were great. Elton John and Metallica really know how to get people moving.
items.zh: 兩場演唱會都很棒。Elton John 和 Metallica 真的很懂得怎麼讓人動起來。

items.en: The band played an old song, and it got everyone dancing.
items.zh: 樂團唱了一首老歌，讓大家都跳起舞來。

items.en: The manager couldn't find a way to get the staff moving faster.
items.zh: 經理想不出辦法讓員工動作快一點。

items.en: Nothing gets me moving in the morning like a strong coffee.
items.zh: 早上最能讓我動起來的就是一杯濃咖啡。

examples.heading: ③ get someone talking / laughing / yawning

items.en: These CDs are so boring. They got me yawning from the very first minute.
items.zh: 這些 CD 好無聊。從第一分鐘開始就讓我一直打呵欠。

items.en: Ask him about football. That always gets him talking.
items.zh: 問他足球的事。那一定會讓他講個不停。

items.en: Her funny story got the whole room laughing.
items.zh: 她好笑的故事讓整個房間的人都笑了起來。

items.en: The news got everyone talking at work.
items.zh: 這個消息讓公司裡大家都在談論。

examples.heading: ④ get something going / working

items.en: It was so cold that I couldn't get the car going.
items.zh: 天氣冷到我發動不了車子。

items.en: Can you help me get this printer working again?
items.zh: 你可以幫我讓這台印表機重新運作嗎？

items.en: We got the fire going with some old newspapers.
items.zh: 我們用舊報紙把火生起來了。

items.en: It took an hour to get the old machine running.
items.zh: 花了一個小時才讓那台舊機器運轉起來。

examples.heading: ⑤ 開始一件事

items.en: Let's get things moving. We've only got an hour.
items.zh: 我們開始動起來吧。我們只有一個小時。

items.en: The coach knows how to get the team working together.
items.zh: 教練知道怎麼讓球隊合作。

items.en: A short game at the start gets the class talking in English.
items.zh: 一開始玩個小遊戲，能讓全班開始用英文交談。

items.en: The new boss got the project going again after months of delay.
items.zh: 延誤了好幾個月之後，新老闆讓這個計畫重新開始了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 停不下來的事

items.en: That horror film got me checking the locks all night.
items.zh: 那部恐怖片讓我整晚一直檢查門鎖。

items.en: The smell from the kitchen got everyone coughing.
items.zh: 廚房的味道讓大家咳個不停。

items.en: His jokes got the children screaming with laughter.
items.zh: 他的笑話讓孩子們笑到尖叫。

items.en: The loud music next door got the dog barking.
items.zh: 隔壁的大聲音樂讓狗叫個不停。

examples.heading: ⑦ 不同的時態

items.en: This book will get you thinking about the way you live.
items.zh: 這本書會讓你思考自己的生活方式。

items.en: I'm trying to get the baby sleeping through the night.
items.zh: 我正在試著讓寶寶整晚都睡覺。

items.en: Once you get him laughing, he can't stop.
items.zh: 你一旦讓他笑起來，他就停不下來。

items.en: That walk has got me feeling much better.
items.zh: 散完那趟步，我覺得好多了。

examples.heading: ⑧ 問句

items.en: "What got you running every morning?" "My doctor told me to get fit."
items.zh: 是什麼讓你每天早上跑步？醫生叫我要鍛鍊身體。

items.en: "How did you get the engine going?" "I just kept trying."
items.zh: 你是怎麼發動引擎的？我就一直試。

items.en: "What got you thinking about moving abroad?" "My sister lives in Canada."
items.zh: 是什麼讓你想搬到國外？我姊姊住在加拿大。

title: It is a good way to get them to shop at this particular store.
translation: 這是讓他們專門來這家店購物的好方法。
name: get 加受詞加不定詞
sentences: A loyalty card is a good way to get customers to shop at this particular store.
We need some new ideas to get young people to visit the museum.
Free coffee is a nice way to get people to stay longer in the shop.
The festival is great, but it must be difficult to get people to come in the rain.
We want to explain the town to our friends, to get them to visit us more often.
I finally got my brother to help me move the sofa.
I can't get the baby to sleep. She's been crying for an hour.
My mum got my dad to stop smoking last year.
How did you get the kids to eat their vegetables?
Try to get Sam to come to the party. He never goes out.
I'll get my sister to pick you up from the station.
Can you get someone to fix the printer? It's broken again.
The manager got everyone to work late on Friday.
I'll get my assistant to send you the details.
It took weeks to get the bank to answer my letter.
Our teacher got us to write a story about our holidays.
It's hard to get teenagers to read books these days.
The coach got the players to run ten laps.
She got the whole class to sing a song for the head teacher.
I can't get the car to start. I think the battery is dead.
I finally got the computer to work again.
Can you get this window to open? It's stuck.
I've been trying to get him to call his mother for weeks.
We're going to get the neighbours to turn their music down.
You'll never get her to change her mind.
If you can get them to agree, we can start next week.
We couldn't get anyone to take the old piano.
I didn't get her to sign the form, so we can't send it yet.
"How did you get him to say sorry?" "I just asked him nicely."
"Can you get Lucy to call me back?" "Sure, I'll tell her."
"Did you get the shop to give you your money back?" "Yes, in the end."

examples.heading: ① 生意和行銷

items.en: A loyalty card is a good way to get customers to shop at this particular store.
items.zh: 會員卡是讓客人專門來這家店購物的好方法。

items.en: We need some new ideas to get young people to visit the museum.
items.zh: 我們需要一些新點子，讓年輕人來參觀博物館。

items.en: Free coffee is a nice way to get people to stay longer in the shop.
items.zh: 免費咖啡是讓客人在店裡待久一點的好方法。

items.en: The festival is great, but it must be difficult to get people to come in the rain.
items.zh: 音樂節很棒，可是下雨天要讓人來一定很難。

items.en: We want to explain the town to our friends, to get them to visit us more often.
items.zh: 我們想向朋友介紹我們的小鎮，讓他們更常來看我們。

examples.heading: ② 家人和朋友

items.en: I finally got my brother to help me move the sofa.
items.zh: 我終於說服我哥哥幫我搬沙發。

items.en: I can't get the baby to sleep. She's been crying for an hour.
items.zh: 我沒辦法讓寶寶睡覺。她已經哭了一個小時了。

items.en: My mum got my dad to stop smoking last year.
items.zh: 我媽媽去年讓我爸爸戒菸了。

items.en: How did you get the kids to eat their vegetables?
items.zh: 你是怎麼讓孩子們吃青菜的？

items.en: Try to get Sam to come to the party. He never goes out.
items.zh: 想辦法讓 Sam 來派對。他從來不出門。

items.en: I'll get my sister to pick you up from the station.
items.zh: 我會叫我姊姊去車站接你。

examples.heading: ③ 工作

items.en: Can you get someone to fix the printer? It's broken again.
items.zh: 你可以找人來修印表機嗎？它又壞了。

items.en: The manager got everyone to work late on Friday.
items.zh: 經理讓大家星期五加班。

items.en: I'll get my assistant to send you the details.
items.zh: 我會叫我的助理把細節寄給你。

items.en: It took weeks to get the bank to answer my letter.
items.zh: 花了好幾個星期才讓銀行回覆我的信。

examples.heading: ④ 學校

items.en: Our teacher got us to write a story about our holidays.
items.zh: 老師叫我們寫一篇關於假期的故事。

items.en: It's hard to get teenagers to read books these days.
items.zh: 現在很難讓青少年看書。

items.en: The coach got the players to run ten laps.
items.zh: 教練讓球員跑十圈。

items.en: She got the whole class to sing a song for the head teacher.
items.zh: 她讓全班唱一首歌給校長聽。

examples.heading: ⑤ 東西也可以當受詞

items.en: I can't get the car to start. I think the battery is dead.
items.zh: 我發動不了車子。我想是電池沒電了。

items.en: I finally got the computer to work again.
items.zh: 我終於讓電腦又能用了。

items.en: Can you get this window to open? It's stuck.
items.zh: 你能把這扇窗戶打開嗎？它卡住了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的時態

items.en: I've been trying to get him to call his mother for weeks.
items.zh: 我已經想辦法讓他打電話給他媽媽好幾個星期了。

items.en: We're going to get the neighbours to turn their music down.
items.zh: 我們要讓鄰居把音樂關小聲。

items.en: You'll never get her to change her mind.
items.zh: 你永遠沒辦法讓她改變主意。

items.en: If you can get them to agree, we can start next week.
items.zh: 如果你能讓他們同意，我們下星期就可以開始。

examples.heading: ⑦ 否定句

items.en: We couldn't get anyone to take the old piano.
items.zh: 我們找不到人把舊鋼琴搬走。

items.en: I didn't get her to sign the form, so we can't send it yet.
items.zh: 我沒讓她在表格上簽名，所以我們還不能寄出。

examples.heading: ⑧ 問句

items.en: "How did you get him to say sorry?" "I just asked him nicely."
items.zh: 你是怎麼讓他道歉的？我只是好好地問他。

items.en: "Can you get Lucy to call me back?" "Sure, I'll tell her."
items.zh: 你可以叫 Lucy 回我電話嗎？好，我會跟她說。

items.en: "Did you get the shop to give you your money back?" "Yes, in the end."
items.zh: 你有讓店家退錢給你嗎？有，最後退了。

title: My plans fell through because I had my purse stolen.
translation: 我的計畫泡湯了，因為我的錢包被偷了。
name: have 加受詞加過去分詞
sentences: After I left you on Monday, I had my car serviced and then visited Washington.
It was very hot last month, so she had her hair cut short.
We had the whole house painted before we moved in.
I had my eyes tested last week. I need glasses.
Their old kitchen was falling apart, so they had a new one fitted in the spring.
It's a shame I'm having my room redecorated, but the garden will be perfect for the party.
My hair grows really fast, so I have it cut every six weeks.
We're having a new fence put up next week.
You should have that cough looked at by a doctor.
I'll have the documents sent to your office tomorrow.
My plans fell through because I had my purse stolen and I had no money to continue my journey.
I played for the best team in São Paulo, but I had to stop because I had my leg broken in a car crash.
She had her bag taken while she was asleep on the train.
We had our windows broken by some kids playing football.
He had his flight cancelled and had to stay another night.
My neighbour had his car damaged in the storm.
In a big city, the risk of having your bike stolen is much bigger.
I hate having my photo taken.
She's afraid of having her phone stolen on the bus.
Learn to fix small problems yourself. Having your car repaired can be very expensive.
Where do you have your shirts cleaned?
I'm going to have my teeth checked tomorrow.
We had the piano tuned before the concert.
You can have your shopping delivered to your door.
My mum loves pretty hands. She has her nails done every Saturday.
I didn't have my hair cut. I just washed it!
We haven't had the heating checked this year.
Luckily, we didn't have anything taken during the break-in.
"Your hair looks great! Did you have it coloured?" "Yes, yesterday."
"Have you had your car checked before the long drive?" "Not yet."
"When are you having your kitchen done?" "In March, I hope."

examples.heading: ① 請人做事：過去

items.en: After I left you on Monday, I had my car serviced and then visited Washington.
items.zh: 星期一跟你分開之後，我把車送去保養，然後去參觀華盛頓。

items.en: It was very hot last month, so she had her hair cut short.
items.zh: 上個月很熱，所以她把頭髮剪短了。

items.en: We had the whole house painted before we moved in.
items.zh: 我們搬進去之前，請人把整間房子都油漆了。

items.en: I had my eyes tested last week. I need glasses.
items.zh: 我上星期去檢查眼睛。我需要戴眼鏡。

items.en: Their old kitchen was falling apart, so they had a new one fitted in the spring.
items.zh: 他們的舊廚房快壞了，所以春天請人裝了新的。

examples.heading: ② 請人做事：現在和未來

items.en: It's a shame I'm having my room redecorated, but the garden will be perfect for the party.
items.zh: 很可惜我的房間正在重新裝潢，可是花園拿來開派對很完美。

items.en: My hair grows really fast, so I have it cut every six weeks.
items.zh: 我的頭髮長得很快，所以每六個星期剪一次。

items.en: We're having a new fence put up next week.
items.zh: 我們下星期要請人裝新的圍籬。

items.en: You should have that cough looked at by a doctor.
items.zh: 你應該讓醫生看看你的咳嗽。

items.en: I'll have the documents sent to your office tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天會請人把文件送到你的辦公室。

examples.heading: ③ 遇到不好的事

items.en: My plans fell through because I had my purse stolen and I had no money to continue my journey.
items.zh: 我的計畫泡湯了，因為我的錢包被偷了，我沒錢繼續旅行。

items.en: I played for the best team in São Paulo, but I had to stop because I had my leg broken in a car crash.
items.zh: 我曾經在聖保羅最好的球隊踢球，可是因為在車禍中斷了腿，只好停下來。

items.en: She had her bag taken while she was asleep on the train.
items.zh: 她在火車上睡著的時候，包包被拿走了。

items.en: We had our windows broken by some kids playing football.
items.zh: 我們家的窗戶被一些踢足球的孩子打破了。

items.en: He had his flight cancelled and had to stay another night.
items.zh: 他的班機被取消了，只好再住一晚。

items.en: My neighbour had his car damaged in the storm.
items.zh: 我鄰居的車在暴風雨中受損了。

examples.heading: ④ having + 受詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: In a big city, the risk of having your bike stolen is much bigger.
items.zh: 在大城市，腳踏車被偷的風險大很多。

items.en: I hate having my photo taken.
items.zh: 我討厭被拍照。

items.en: She's afraid of having her phone stolen on the bus.
items.zh: 她怕在公車上手機被偷。

items.en: Learn to fix small problems yourself. Having your car repaired can be very expensive.
items.zh: 小問題要學著自己修。請人修車可能很貴。

examples.heading: ⑤ 生活中常見的服務

items.en: Where do you have your shirts cleaned?
items.zh: 你都去哪裡洗襯衫？

items.en: I'm going to have my teeth checked tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天要去檢查牙齒。

items.en: We had the piano tuned before the concert.
items.zh: 音樂會之前我們請人調了鋼琴。

items.en: You can have your shopping delivered to your door.
items.zh: 你可以讓人把買的東西送到家門口。

items.en: My mum loves pretty hands. She has her nails done every Saturday.
items.zh: 我媽媽很愛漂亮的手。她每個星期六去做指甲。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句

items.en: I didn't have my hair cut. I just washed it!
items.zh: 我沒去剪頭髮。我只是洗了頭！

items.en: We haven't had the heating checked this year.
items.zh: 我們今年還沒請人檢查暖氣。

items.en: Luckily, we didn't have anything taken during the break-in.
items.zh: 幸好小偷闖進來的時候，我們沒有東西被拿走。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Your hair looks great! Did you have it coloured?" "Yes, yesterday."
items.zh: 你的頭髮好好看！你去染了嗎？對，昨天。

items.en: "Have you had your car checked before the long drive?" "Not yet."
items.zh: 長途開車前你有去檢查車子嗎？還沒。

items.en: "When are you having your kitchen done?" "In March, I hope."
items.zh: 你的廚房什麼時候要整修？希望是三月。

title: It is not enough to just have him fill out a multiple-choice form.
translation: 光是叫他填一份選擇題表格是不夠的。
name: have 加受詞加原形不定詞（使役）
sentences: To assess a student's English, it is not enough to just have him fill out a multiple-choice form.
To attract people and have them practise their English, we could explain the benefits of an English degree.
The teacher had us read the poem out loud.
Our school has every student write a short report at the end of the year.
The examiner had me describe a photo for two minutes.
I'll have my secretary send you the contract this afternoon.
The manager had us stay late to finish the stock check.
Please have the guests wait in the lobby until the room is ready.
The company has new staff spend their first week in every department.
Shall I have someone show you to your office?
I had the mechanic check the brakes before the long drive.
We'll have the porter take your bags to your room.
She had the electrician fix all the lights in the house.
The hotel had a taxi meet us at the airport.
The doctor had me take a deep breath.
The nurse had him lie down for ten minutes.
The coach had the players do extra exercises after the injury.
We could have visitors fill in a short survey at the exit.
The organisers should have volunteers help older people find their seats.
It would be useful to have each team present their ideas to the board.
The council plans to have local artists paint the walls of the station.
I'll have Tom call you as soon as he gets back.
The police are having everyone show their ID at the gate.
She's had the children tidy their rooms every Saturday for years.
Before the meeting, the boss had already had us read the report.
The judge had the man leave the courtroom.
The captain had the passengers stay in their seats during the storm.
My mum had me apologise to the neighbours.
"Who should I talk to?" "I'll have our manager come and see you."
"Can you have someone clean the meeting room?" "Of course. Right away."
"Why is the room so quiet?" "The teacher had everyone do a test."

examples.heading: ① 學校和考試

items.en: To assess a student's English, it is not enough to just have him fill out a multiple-choice form.
items.zh: 要評估學生的英文，光是叫他填一份選擇題表格是不夠的。

items.en: To attract people and have them practise their English, we could explain the benefits of an English degree.
items.zh: 為了吸引人並讓他們練習英文，我們可以說明英文學位的好處。

items.en: The teacher had us read the poem out loud.
items.zh: 老師叫我們把那首詩大聲唸出來。

items.en: Our school has every student write a short report at the end of the year.
items.zh: 我們學校讓每個學生在學年結束時寫一份短報告。

items.en: The examiner had me describe a photo for two minutes.
items.zh: 考官叫我描述一張照片兩分鐘。

examples.heading: ② 工作

items.en: I'll have my secretary send you the contract this afternoon.
items.zh: 我會叫我的秘書今天下午把合約寄給你。

items.en: The manager had us stay late to finish the stock check.
items.zh: 經理叫我們留下來把盤點做完。

items.en: Please have the guests wait in the lobby until the room is ready.
items.zh: 房間準備好之前，請讓客人在大廳等。

items.en: The company has new staff spend their first week in every department.
items.zh: 公司讓新員工第一個星期在每個部門都待一下。

items.en: Shall I have someone show you to your office?
items.zh: 要我找人帶您去您的辦公室嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 服務和修理

items.en: I had the mechanic check the brakes before the long drive.
items.zh: 長途開車之前，我叫技師檢查了煞車。

items.en: We'll have the porter take your bags to your room.
items.zh: 我們會讓行李員把您的行李送到房間。

items.en: She had the electrician fix all the lights in the house.
items.zh: 她叫電工把房子裡的燈全修好了。

items.en: The hotel had a taxi meet us at the airport.
items.zh: 旅館安排了一輛計程車在機場接我們。

examples.heading: ④ 醫生和照顧

items.en: The doctor had me take a deep breath.
items.zh: 醫生叫我深呼吸。

items.en: The nurse had him lie down for ten minutes.
items.zh: 護士叫他躺下十分鐘。

items.en: The coach had the players do extra exercises after the injury.
items.zh: 受傷之後，教練讓球員做額外的運動。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式的建議和計畫

items.en: We could have visitors fill in a short survey at the exit.
items.zh: 我們可以讓參觀者在出口填一份簡短的問卷。

items.en: The organisers should have volunteers help older people find their seats.
items.zh: 主辦單位應該讓志工幫老人家找座位。

items.en: It would be useful to have each team present their ideas to the board.
items.zh: 讓每個小組向董事會報告他們的想法會很有用。

items.en: The council plans to have local artists paint the walls of the station.
items.zh: 市議會打算讓本地藝術家畫車站的牆。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的時態

items.en: I'll have Tom call you as soon as he gets back.
items.zh: Tom 一回來我就叫他打給你。

items.en: The police are having everyone show their ID at the gate.
items.zh: 警察正在叫大家在大門口出示身分證。

items.en: She's had the children tidy their rooms every Saturday for years.
items.zh: 她好幾年來都叫孩子們每個星期六整理房間。

items.en: Before the meeting, the boss had already had us read the report.
items.zh: 開會之前，老闆早就叫我們讀過報告了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 有權力或控制

items.en: The judge had the man leave the courtroom.
items.zh: 法官命令那個男人離開法庭。

items.en: The captain had the passengers stay in their seats during the storm.
items.zh: 暴風雨中，機長要乘客留在座位上。

items.en: My mum had me apologise to the neighbours.
items.zh: 我媽媽叫我向鄰居道歉。

examples.heading: ⑧ 問句

items.en: "Who should I talk to?" "I'll have our manager come and see you."
items.zh: 我該找誰談？我會請我們的經理過來見您。

items.en: "Can you have someone clean the meeting room?" "Of course. Right away."
items.zh: 你可以找人打掃會議室嗎？當然，馬上。

items.en: "Why is the room so quiet?" "The teacher had everyone do a test."
items.zh: 教室怎麼這麼安靜？老師叫大家寫考卷。

title: Being invited by your boss to an unexpected lunch makes you feel noticed.
translation: 老闆突然請你吃午餐，會讓你覺得自己被注意到了。
name: being 加過去分詞的被動子句交代背景
sentences: Small things matter at work. Being invited by your boss to an unexpected lunch makes you feel noticed.
Being chosen for the national team was the best moment of my life.
Nobody enjoys being told what to do all the time.
Being stopped by the police can be frightening, even if you've done nothing wrong.
Being left alone in a strange city was a new experience for me.
My little sister hates being laughed at.
I'm tired of being treated like a child.
She left the party early to avoid being asked about her exam results.
He's afraid of being seen without his glasses.
I don't mind being asked for help. Just send me a message.
Being born and raised in Mexico, she is this country's best representative to the world.
Being overworked and badly paid, many nurses are leaving the job.
Being given a second chance, he worked harder than ever.
Being asked to give a speech at short notice, I was very nervous.
Being trained as a nurse, my mum knew exactly what to do after the accident.
Built in 1890, the station is the oldest building in town.
Painted by a local artist, the mural shows the history of our town.
Surrounded by mountains, the village is very quiet in winter.
Shocked by the news, she couldn't say a word.
Being protected by law, these animals cannot be hunted.
Being surrounded by computers all day, young people find it hard to switch off.
Being paid less than men for the same work is still a problem for many women.
Being criticised in public can make people lose confidence.
Being forced to wear a uniform doesn't help students learn.
Being woken up at five every morning by the birds, I soon got used to early starts.
Being praised by her teacher, Lucy felt proud all day.
Being kept waiting for an hour, the customers started to complain.
Being followed by photographers is part of a famous person's life.
"Why did you leave the job?" "Being ignored by my manager every day got too much."
"How did it feel to win?" "Being given the prize in front of my family was amazing."
"Do you like your new school?" "Yes. Being welcomed by everyone made it easy."

examples.heading: ① Being + 過去分詞當主詞

items.en: Small things matter at work. Being invited by your boss to an unexpected lunch makes you feel noticed.
items.zh: 工作上小事很重要。老闆突然請你吃午餐，會讓你覺得自己被注意到了。

items.en: Being chosen for the national team was the best moment of my life.
items.zh: 被選進國家隊是我人生中最棒的時刻。

items.en: Nobody enjoys being told what to do all the time.
items.zh: 沒有人喜歡一直被別人指揮。

items.en: Being stopped by the police can be frightening, even if you've done nothing wrong.
items.zh: 被警察攔下來可能很可怕，就算你什麼也沒做錯。

items.en: Being left alone in a strange city was a new experience for me.
items.zh: 一個人被留在陌生的城市，對我來說是新的經驗。

items.en: My little sister hates being laughed at.
items.zh: 我妹妹很討厭被人取笑。

examples.heading: ② 介系詞後面的 being + 過去分詞

items.en: I'm tired of being treated like a child.
items.zh: 我受夠了被當成小孩。

items.en: She left the party early to avoid being asked about her exam results.
items.zh: 她提早離開派對，以免被問到考試成績。

items.en: He's afraid of being seen without his glasses.
items.zh: 他怕被人看到沒戴眼鏡的樣子。

items.en: I don't mind being asked for help. Just send me a message.
items.zh: 我不介意別人找我幫忙。傳個訊息給我就好。

examples.heading: ③ Being + 過去分詞交代原因

items.en: Being born and raised in Mexico, she is this country's best representative to the world.
items.zh: 她在墨西哥出生長大，是這個國家面向世界最好的代表。

items.en: Being overworked and badly paid, many nurses are leaving the job.
items.zh: 因為工作過量又薪水低，很多護理師正在離職。

items.en: Being given a second chance, he worked harder than ever.
items.zh: 得到第二次機會，他比以前更努力。

items.en: Being asked to give a speech at short notice, I was very nervous.
items.zh: 臨時被要求致詞，我很緊張。

items.en: Being trained as a nurse, my mum knew exactly what to do after the accident.
items.zh: 我媽媽受過護理訓練，所以意外發生後她很清楚該怎麼做。

examples.heading: ④ 省略 being

items.en: Built in 1890, the station is the oldest building in town.
items.zh: 車站建於 1890 年，是鎮上最古老的建築。

items.en: Painted by a local artist, the mural shows the history of our town.
items.zh: 這幅壁畫是當地一位畫家畫的，畫的是我們鎮的歷史。

items.en: Surrounded by mountains, the village is very quiet in winter.
items.zh: 這個村子被群山環繞，冬天很安靜。

items.en: Shocked by the news, she couldn't say a word.
items.zh: 聽到這個消息，她嚇得說不出話來。

examples.heading: ⑤ 在作文裡說明看法

items.en: Being protected by law, these animals cannot be hunted.
items.zh: 這些動物受法律保護，不能獵捕。

items.en: Being surrounded by computers all day, young people find it hard to switch off.
items.zh: 整天被電腦包圍，年輕人很難放鬆下來。

items.en: Being paid less than men for the same work is still a problem for many women.
items.zh: 同樣的工作拿得比男人少，對很多女性來說仍然是個問題。

items.en: Being criticised in public can make people lose confidence.
items.zh: 在大家面前被批評，會讓人失去信心。

items.en: Being forced to wear a uniform doesn't help students learn.
items.zh: 被強迫穿制服並不會幫助學生學習。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的時間

items.en: Being woken up at five every morning by the birds, I soon got used to early starts.
items.zh: 每天早上五點被鳥吵醒，我很快就習慣早起了。

items.en: Being praised by her teacher, Lucy felt proud all day.
items.zh: 被老師稱讚之後，Lucy 整天都很得意。

items.en: Being kept waiting for an hour, the customers started to complain.
items.zh: 被晾在那裡等了一個小時，客人開始抱怨了。

items.en: Being followed by photographers is part of a famous person's life.
items.zh: 被攝影師跟拍是名人生活的一部分。

examples.heading: ⑦ 對話

items.en: "Why did you leave the job?" "Being ignored by my manager every day got too much."
items.zh: 你為什麼辭職？每天被經理忽視，我受不了了。

items.en: "How did it feel to win?" "Being given the prize in front of my family was amazing."
items.zh: 贏的感覺怎樣？在家人面前領獎真的很棒。

items.en: "Do you like your new school?" "Yes. Being welcomed by everyone made it easy."
items.zh: 你喜歡新學校嗎？喜歡。大家都很歡迎我，所以很容易適應。

title: Not having been given precise orders, he decided to work on his own initiative.
translation: 因為沒有收到明確的指示，他決定自己看著辦。
name: having been 加過去分詞的從屬子句
sentences: Not having been given precise orders, he decided to work on his own initiative.
Not having been told about the change, I went to the wrong room.
Not having been invited, she stayed at home that evening.
Not having been trained for the job, he made a lot of mistakes at first.
Not having been warned about the weather, the climbers were caught in the snow.
Having been taught the rights and the wrongs, we had an idea about everything.
Having been chosen as captain, Tom felt he had to work harder.
Having been delayed by the snow, the train arrived two hours late.
Having been brought up by her grandparents, she is very close to them.
Having been stopped by the police twice, I now drive very carefully.
Having been left empty for years, the house needed a lot of repairs.
I myself, having been educated the hard way, would insist on my children getting the best possible education.
The old bridge, having been damaged in the flood, was closed for a year.
My grandfather, having been born in a small village, never liked big cities.
The letter, having been sent to the wrong address, arrived a week late.
Having been given a second chance, she worked harder than anyone else.
Having been treated badly by his last boss, he didn't trust his new manager.
Having been raised on a farm, Ben knew how to look after animals.
Having been trained in Paris, the chef cooks excellent French food.
Having been asked to speak at short notice, I hadn't prepared anything.
Having been accused of cheating, the player left the club.
Having been promised a pay rise, the workers were angry when it didn't come.
Having been rejected by three universities, she decided to take a year off.
Having been locked in the room all night, the prisoner was tired and hungry.
Having been left a fortune by his uncle, he gave up his job.
Having been seen near the house, the man was questioned by the police.
Having been bitten once, the boy was afraid of dogs for years.
Having been cleaned and painted, the room looked like new.
Having been fed, the baby went straight to sleep.
Not having been paid for two months, the staff went on strike.
Having been checked by two teachers, the exam papers were sent back to the students.

examples.heading: ① Not having been + 過去分詞

items.en: Not having been given precise orders, he decided to work on his own initiative.
items.zh: 因為沒有收到明確的指示，他決定自己看著辦。

items.en: Not having been told about the change, I went to the wrong room.
items.zh: 因為沒人告訴我改了，我走錯了教室。

items.en: Not having been invited, she stayed at home that evening.
items.zh: 她沒被邀請，所以那天晚上待在家裡。

items.en: Not having been trained for the job, he made a lot of mistakes at first.
items.zh: 他沒受過這份工作的訓練，所以一開始犯了很多錯。

items.en: Not having been warned about the weather, the climbers were caught in the snow.
items.zh: 登山客沒有收到天氣警告，結果被困在雪裡。

examples.heading: ② Having been + 過去分詞，放在句首

items.en: Having been taught the rights and the wrongs, we had an idea about everything.
items.zh: 我們被教過什麼是對、什麼是錯，所以對每件事都有自己的看法。

items.en: Having been chosen as captain, Tom felt he had to work harder.
items.zh: 被選為隊長之後，Tom 覺得他得更努力。

items.en: Having been delayed by the snow, the train arrived two hours late.
items.zh: 火車因為下雪延誤，晚了兩個小時才到。

items.en: Having been brought up by her grandparents, she is very close to them.
items.zh: 她是爺爺奶奶帶大的，所以跟他們很親。

items.en: Having been stopped by the police twice, I now drive very carefully.
items.zh: 被警察攔下來兩次之後，我現在開車很小心。

items.en: Having been left empty for years, the house needed a lot of repairs.
items.zh: 這間房子空了好幾年，所以需要大量修繕。

examples.heading: ③ having been + 過去分詞，放在主詞後面

items.en: I myself, having been educated the hard way, would insist on my children getting the best possible education.
items.zh: 我自己是吃過苦才受到教育的，所以我會堅持讓孩子得到最好的教育。

items.en: The old bridge, having been damaged in the flood, was closed for a year.
items.zh: 舊橋在水災中受損，封了一年。

items.en: My grandfather, having been born in a small village, never liked big cities.
items.zh: 我爺爺在小村子出生，從來不喜歡大城市。

items.en: The letter, having been sent to the wrong address, arrived a week late.
items.zh: 這封信寄到錯的地址，所以晚了一個星期才到。

examples.heading: ④ 說明經驗和教育

items.en: Having been given a second chance, she worked harder than anyone else.
items.zh: 她得到第二次機會之後，比任何人都努力。

items.en: Having been treated badly by his last boss, he didn't trust his new manager.
items.zh: 他被前任老闆虧待過，所以不信任新經理。

items.en: Having been raised on a farm, Ben knew how to look after animals.
items.zh: Ben 在農場長大，所以知道怎麼照顧動物。

items.en: Having been trained in Paris, the chef cooks excellent French food.
items.zh: 這位主廚在巴黎受訓過，所以做得一手好法國菜。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說明原因

items.en: Having been asked to speak at short notice, I hadn't prepared anything.
items.zh: 我是臨時被叫上台講話的，所以什麼都沒準備。

items.en: Having been accused of cheating, the player left the club.
items.zh: 那個球員被指控作弊，所以離開了球隊。

items.en: Having been promised a pay rise, the workers were angry when it didn't come.
items.zh: 工人們被承諾會加薪，所以加薪沒來時他們很生氣。

items.en: Having been rejected by three universities, she decided to take a year off.
items.zh: 她被三所大學拒絕之後，決定休息一年。

examples.heading: ⑥ 小說和故事

items.en: Having been locked in the room all night, the prisoner was tired and hungry.
items.zh: 犯人被鎖在房間裡一整晚，又累又餓。

items.en: Having been left a fortune by his uncle, he gave up his job.
items.zh: 他叔叔留給他一大筆遺產，所以他辭掉了工作。

items.en: Having been seen near the house, the man was questioned by the police.
items.zh: 那個男人被人看到在房子附近，所以被警察盤問。

items.en: Having been bitten once, the boy was afraid of dogs for years.
items.zh: 那個男孩被咬過一次，好幾年都很怕狗。

examples.heading: ⑦ 不同的主詞

items.en: Having been cleaned and painted, the room looked like new.
items.zh: 房間打掃和油漆過之後，看起來像新的一樣。

items.en: Having been fed, the baby went straight to sleep.
items.zh: 寶寶喝完奶之後，馬上就睡著了。

items.en: Not having been paid for two months, the staff went on strike.
items.zh: 員工兩個月沒拿到薪水，所以罷工了。

items.en: Having been checked by two teachers, the exam papers were sent back to the students.
items.zh: 考卷經過兩位老師檢查之後，發還給學生。

title: In my opinion, the store is not being promoted enough.
translation: 我覺得這家店的宣傳做得不夠。
name: 現在進行式被動語態的否定
sentences: The new store has very few customers. In my opinion, the store is not being promoted enough.
Our local library is closing on Mondays. It isn't being funded enough by the council.
Our team keeps losing because the young players aren't being trained enough.
The museum is empty most days. It isn't being advertised enough.
Science isn't being taught enough in primary schools.
Mobile phones are useful, but as long as they're not being used in a sensible way, they can harm children's health.
The old castle is falling down. It isn't being looked after properly.
I'm worried about the new workers. They aren't being trained properly.
The recycling isn't being sorted properly, so most of it goes to waste.
Customers' complaints aren't being handled properly. Nobody calls them back.
Air pollution in our city is getting worse, but the problem isn't being taken seriously.
I keep telling the doctor about my headaches, but I feel I'm not being taken seriously.
Young people's ideas aren't being taken seriously by the government.
Safety rules on building sites still aren't being taken seriously enough.
Things have changed. Women are not being seen as inferior to men and unable to work outside the home.
These days, cooking isn't being seen as a woman's job any more.
Video games aren't being seen only as a hobby for children now.
Working from home isn't being seen as strange any more.
According to the survey, our website isn't being visited by young customers.
The report shows that the new rules aren't being followed in most offices.
Many talented students are not being given the chance to go to university.
It is clear that the money is not being spent where it is needed most.
In many schools, students' mental health is not being discussed openly.
I'm not being listened to at meetings, so I've stopped giving ideas.
You aren't being paid enough for all the work you do.
The children aren't being given enough time to play outside.
Our neighbourhood isn't being cleaned as often as it should be.
Older people aren't being shown how to use the new machines at the bank.
"Why are sales so low?" "I think the product isn't being marketed to the right people."
"Is the river any cleaner now?" "No, the factories still aren't being checked."
"Is the new speed limit working?" "No. It isn't being enforced by the police at all."

examples.heading: ① not being + 過去分詞 + enough

items.en: The new store has very few customers. In my opinion, the store is not being promoted enough.
items.zh: 新店的客人很少。我覺得這家店的宣傳做得不夠。

items.en: Our local library is closing on Mondays. It isn't being funded enough by the council.
items.zh: 我們的地方圖書館星期一不開了。市議會給的經費不夠。

items.en: Our team keeps losing because the young players aren't being trained enough.
items.zh: 我們隊一直輸，因為年輕球員的訓練不夠。

items.en: The museum is empty most days. It isn't being advertised enough.
items.zh: 博物館大部分時間都沒人。它的廣告做得不夠。

items.en: Science isn't being taught enough in primary schools.
items.zh: 小學的自然課教得不夠。

examples.heading: ② not being + 過去分詞 + properly

items.en: Mobile phones are useful, but as long as they're not being used in a sensible way, they can harm children's health.
items.zh: 手機很有用，可是只要沒被合理地使用，就會傷害孩子的健康。

items.en: The old castle is falling down. It isn't being looked after properly.
items.zh: 那座古堡快倒了。它沒有被好好維護。

items.en: I'm worried about the new workers. They aren't being trained properly.
items.zh: 我很擔心新來的員工。他們沒有受到好好的訓練。

items.en: The recycling isn't being sorted properly, so most of it goes to waste.
items.zh: 回收的東西沒有好好分類，所以大部分都浪費掉了。

items.en: Customers' complaints aren't being handled properly. Nobody calls them back.
items.zh: 客人的抱怨沒有被好好處理。沒有人回電給他們。

examples.heading: ③ not being taken seriously

items.en: Air pollution in our city is getting worse, but the problem isn't being taken seriously.
items.zh: 我們城市的空氣汙染愈來愈嚴重，可是這個問題沒有被認真看待。

items.en: I keep telling the doctor about my headaches, but I feel I'm not being taken seriously.
items.zh: 我一直跟醫生說我頭痛，可是我覺得他沒把我的話當真。

items.en: Young people's ideas aren't being taken seriously by the government.
items.zh: 政府沒有認真看待年輕人的想法。

items.en: Safety rules on building sites still aren't being taken seriously enough.
items.zh: 工地的安全規定還是沒有被足夠重視。

examples.heading: ④ not being seen as

items.en: Things have changed. Women are not being seen as inferior to men and unable to work outside the home.
items.zh: 情況已經變了。女性不再被看成比男性差、不能出外工作的人。

items.en: These days, cooking isn't being seen as a woman's job any more.
items.zh: 現在煮飯已經不再被看成女人的工作了。

items.en: Video games aren't being seen only as a hobby for children now.
items.zh: 電子遊戲現在不再只被看成小孩的嗜好。

items.en: Working from home isn't being seen as strange any more.
items.zh: 在家工作不再被看成奇怪的事了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 報告和正式意見

items.en: According to the survey, our website isn't being visited by young customers.
items.zh: 根據調查，年輕的顧客沒有在逛我們的網站。

items.en: The report shows that the new rules aren't being followed in most offices.
items.zh: 報告顯示，大部分辦公室都沒有遵守新規定。

items.en: Many talented students are not being given the chance to go to university.
items.zh: 很多有才華的學生沒有得到上大學的機會。

items.en: It is clear that the money is not being spent where it is needed most.
items.zh: 很明顯，錢沒有花在最需要的地方。

items.en: In many schools, students' mental health is not being discussed openly.
items.zh: 在很多學校，學生的心理健康沒有被公開討論。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的主詞

items.en: I'm not being listened to at meetings, so I've stopped giving ideas.
items.zh: 開會時沒人聽我說話，所以我不再提意見了。

items.en: You aren't being paid enough for all the work you do.
items.zh: 以你做的工作量來說，你拿的錢不夠。

items.en: The children aren't being given enough time to play outside.
items.zh: 孩子們沒有足夠的時間在外面玩。

items.en: Our neighbourhood isn't being cleaned as often as it should be.
items.zh: 我們社區打掃的次數沒有應有的那麼多。

items.en: Older people aren't being shown how to use the new machines at the bank.
items.zh: 沒有人教老人家怎麼用銀行的新機器。

examples.heading: ⑦ 討論時

items.en: "Why are sales so low?" "I think the product isn't being marketed to the right people."
items.zh: 銷售量怎麼這麼低？我覺得產品沒有賣給對的客群。

items.en: "Is the river any cleaner now?" "No, the factories still aren't being checked."
items.zh: 河現在有比較乾淨嗎？沒有，工廠還是沒人檢查。

items.en: "Is the new speed limit working?" "No. It isn't being enforced by the police at all."
items.zh: 新的速限有用嗎？沒有。警察根本沒在執行。

title: It has been found that some products were difficult to find.
translation: 調查發現，有些產品很難找到。
name: 虛主詞 it 的被動語態（總結、評價）
sentences: We asked 200 customers about our shop. It has been found that some products were difficult to find.
It has been shown that children who read at home do better at school.
In our study, it was found that most people check their phones before breakfast.
It has been shown many times that exercise helps people sleep better.
To sum up, it can be concluded that this report has tried to summarise the main points about the Spanish school system.
From the results, it can be concluded that the new timetable has reduced delays.
It may be concluded that the course was too short for most students.
Our guide told us about the castle on the hill. It is believed that the castle was built in the twelfth century.
Nobody has counted them for years, but it is thought that around five hundred people live on the island.
Nobody swims there at night. It is said that the lake is haunted, but I don't believe it.
It is widely known that sugar is bad for your teeth.
It was once thought that the earth was flat.
Food is already expensive, and it is expected that prices will rise again next year.
It is expected that the new road will be finished by May.
It was expected that more people would come to the opening.
At the meeting, it was decided that the office would close at four on Fridays.
After a long discussion, it was agreed that the trip would go ahead.
It has been decided that all students will wear the new uniform from September.
It was agreed that the money should be spent on new books.
Based on these results, it is recommended that staff take more breaks.
It is suggested that the café should open earlier in the morning.
It is strongly recommended that visitors book their tickets online.
It has been suggested that the park could be used for concerts.
The results look good. However, it should be noted that only fifty people answered the survey.
It must be pointed out that the figures are from last year.
It should be remembered that the town had no hospital before 1990.
The hotel looks cheap online, but it should be noted that the prices do not include tax.
In conclusion, it has been shown that the new system saves both time and money.
Overall, it can be said that the event was well organised.
It is hoped that this report will help the manager make a decision.
Finally, it is generally accepted that the building needs to be repaired.

examples.heading: ① it has been found / shown that

items.en: We asked 200 customers about our shop. It has been found that some products were difficult to find.
items.zh: 我們訪問了兩百位顧客。調查發現，有些產品很難找到。

items.en: It has been shown that children who read at home do better at school.
items.zh: 研究顯示，在家閱讀的孩子在學校表現比較好。

items.en: In our study, it was found that most people check their phones before breakfast.
items.zh: 在我們的研究中發現，大部分人吃早餐前會先看手機。

items.en: It has been shown many times that exercise helps people sleep better.
items.zh: 已經有很多次研究顯示，運動可以幫人睡得更好。

examples.heading: ② it can be concluded that

items.en: To sum up, it can be concluded that this report has tried to summarise the main points about the Spanish school system.
items.zh: 總之，可以得出結論：這份報告試著總結了西班牙教育制度的重點。

items.en: From the results, it can be concluded that the new timetable has reduced delays.
items.zh: 從結果可以得出結論：新的時刻表減少了誤點。

items.en: It may be concluded that the course was too short for most students.
items.zh: 可以得出結論：這門課對大部分學生來說太短了。

examples.heading: ③ it is believed / thought / said that

items.en: Our guide told us about the castle on the hill. It is believed that the castle was built in the twelfth century.
items.zh: 導遊跟我們介紹山上的城堡。一般認為這座城堡建於十二世紀。

items.en: Nobody has counted them for years, but it is thought that around five hundred people live on the island.
items.zh: 好幾年沒人算過了，不過一般認為島上住了大約五百人。

items.en: Nobody swims there at night. It is said that the lake is haunted, but I don't believe it.
items.zh: 晚上沒人去那裡游泳。據說那座湖鬧鬼，可是我不相信。

items.en: It is widely known that sugar is bad for your teeth.
items.zh: 大家都知道糖對牙齒不好。

items.en: It was once thought that the earth was flat.
items.zh: 以前大家認為地球是平的。

examples.heading: ④ it is expected that

items.en: Food is already expensive, and it is expected that prices will rise again next year.
items.zh: 食物已經很貴了，預計明年物價還會再上漲。

items.en: It is expected that the new road will be finished by May.
items.zh: 預計新路五月會完工。

items.en: It was expected that more people would come to the opening.
items.zh: 原本預計會有更多人來參加開幕。

examples.heading: ⑤ it was decided / agreed that

items.en: At the meeting, it was decided that the office would close at four on Fridays.
items.zh: 在會議上決定，辦公室星期五四點下班。

items.en: After a long discussion, it was agreed that the trip would go ahead.
items.zh: 討論了很久之後，大家同意照計畫去旅行。

items.en: It has been decided that all students will wear the new uniform from September.
items.zh: 已經決定九月起所有學生都要穿新制服。

items.en: It was agreed that the money should be spent on new books.
items.zh: 大家同意這筆錢應該用來買新書。

examples.heading: ⑥ it is recommended / suggested that

items.en: Based on these results, it is recommended that staff take more breaks.
items.zh: 根據這些結果，建議員工多休息。

items.en: It is suggested that the café should open earlier in the morning.
items.zh: 建議咖啡店早上早一點開。

items.en: It is strongly recommended that visitors book their tickets online.
items.zh: 強烈建議遊客在網路上訂票。

items.en: It has been suggested that the park could be used for concerts.
items.zh: 有人建議公園可以用來辦音樂會。

examples.heading: ⑦ it should be noted / pointed out that

items.en: The results look good. However, it should be noted that only fifty people answered the survey.
items.zh: 結果看起來不錯。不過，要注意的是，只有五十個人回答了問卷。

items.en: It must be pointed out that the figures are from last year.
items.zh: 必須指出，這些數字是去年的。

items.en: It should be remembered that the town had no hospital before 1990.
items.zh: 要記得，鎮上在 1990 年以前沒有醫院。

items.en: The hotel looks cheap online, but it should be noted that the prices do not include tax.
items.zh: 網路上那間旅館看起來很便宜，可是要注意的是，價格不含稅。

examples.heading: ⑧ 報告的結論

items.en: In conclusion, it has been shown that the new system saves both time and money.
items.zh: 總之，結果顯示新系統既省時又省錢。

items.en: Overall, it can be said that the event was well organised.
items.zh: 整體來說，可以說這次活動辦得很好。

items.en: It is hoped that this report will help the manager make a decision.
items.zh: 希望這份報告能幫經理做決定。

items.en: Finally, it is generally accepted that the building needs to be repaired.
items.zh: 最後，大家普遍認為這棟建築需要修理。

title: I also like wearing clothes which are manufactured by famous brands.
translation: 我也喜歡穿名牌廠商做的衣服。
name: 關係子句裡帶 by 的被動語態
sentences: I like comfortable clothes. I also like wearing clothes which are manufactured by famous brands.
On our school trip, we climbed a hill which is surrounded by small villages.
My dad is careful about what he buys. He only buys coffee which is grown by small farmers.
For my history project, I chose a building which is used by the whole town.
My cousin has an interesting job. She works for a charity which is supported by a lot of famous people.
My sister is getting married in May, so I'm learning a dance which is performed by women at weddings.
The film club meets on Fridays. Last week we watched a film which was directed by a sixteen-year-old girl.
In music class, our teacher played us a song which was written by her brother.
I was cleaning the attic and found some letters which were sent by my grandmother during the war.
Our holiday was lovely. We stayed in a hotel which was designed by a famous architect.
At the open day, they showed us some pictures which were painted by children from the school.
It's the oldest street in the city. The shops are in houses which were built by rich traders in the 1700s.
Is this the cake that was made by your sister? It's delicious.
My friend Sam gave me a watch for my birthday. It's a watch that was owned by his grandfather.
In English class, we read a story that was written by a girl in my class.
My mum always tells me to be careful online. She doesn't trust news that is shared by strangers.
We're all very proud. There's a girl in my class who was chosen by the coach for the national team.
On holiday, I talked to a man who was rescued by a fisherman after his boat sank.
Mrs Lee is the best teacher in the school. The children who are taught by her always do well in exams.
The book fair was great. We met a writer who is loved by teenagers all over the world.
Our family has lived in this village for a long time. The house which was built by my grandfather is still standing.
Go to the bakery on the corner. The bread which is baked by the owner every morning is always fresh.
My uncle loves photography. The photos which were taken by him are on the wall in our living room.
My dad is a football coach. The team which is coached by him won every game this year.
Our class made its own rules this year. The rules which were written by the students are on the classroom door.
Your place on the trip isn't confirmed yet. Please send us the form which was signed by your parents.
I'm reading a book which was recommended by my teacher. It's about a family in Ireland.
"Which bag is yours?" "The one which was given to me by my aunt."
Our printer is very slow. We need a printer which is used by a lot of offices and is easy to repair.
Look, this is the bridge which was damaged by the flood last year. They've just repaired it.
The restaurant has a new chef. Have you tried the soup which is made by him?

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + which + is / are + 過去分詞 + by

items.en: I like comfortable clothes. I also like wearing clothes which are manufactured by famous brands.
items.zh: 我喜歡舒服的衣服。我也喜歡穿名牌廠商做的衣服。

items.en: On our school trip, we climbed a hill which is surrounded by small villages.
items.zh: 校外教學的時候，我們爬了一座四周都是小村莊的山。

items.en: My dad is careful about what he buys. He only buys coffee which is grown by small farmers.
items.zh: 我爸爸買東西很講究。他只買小農種的咖啡。

items.en: For my history project, I chose a building which is used by the whole town.
items.zh: 我的歷史報告選了一棟全鎮的人都在用的建築。

items.en: My cousin has an interesting job. She works for a charity which is supported by a lot of famous people.
items.zh: 我表姊的工作很有意思。她在一個很多名人支持的慈善機構工作。

items.en: My sister is getting married in May, so I'm learning a dance which is performed by women at weddings.
items.zh: 我姊姊五月要結婚，所以我在學一支婚禮上女人跳的舞。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + which + was / were + 過去分詞 + by

items.en: The film club meets on Fridays. Last week we watched a film which was directed by a sixteen-year-old girl.
items.zh: 電影社每個星期五聚會。上星期我們看了一部十六歲女生導的電影。

items.en: In music class, our teacher played us a song which was written by her brother.
items.zh: 音樂課的時候，老師放了一首她哥哥寫的歌給我們聽。

items.en: I was cleaning the attic and found some letters which were sent by my grandmother during the war.
items.zh: 我在打掃閣樓，找到幾封我外婆在戰時寄的信。

items.en: Our holiday was lovely. We stayed in a hotel which was designed by a famous architect.
items.zh: 我們的假期很棒。我們住在一間有名建築師設計的旅館。

items.en: At the open day, they showed us some pictures which were painted by children from the school.
items.zh: 開放日那天，他們給我們看了幾幅那所學校的孩子畫的畫。

items.en: It's the oldest street in the city. The shops are in houses which were built by rich traders in the 1700s.
items.zh: 那是這個城市最古老的街。店都開在十八世紀有錢商人蓋的房子裡。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + that + be + 過去分詞 + by

items.en: Is this the cake that was made by your sister? It's delicious.
items.zh: 這是你姊姊做的那個蛋糕嗎？很好吃。

items.en: My friend Sam gave me a watch for my birthday. It's a watch that was owned by his grandfather.
items.zh: 我朋友 Sam 送我一支手錶當生日禮物。那是他爺爺的手錶。

items.en: In English class, we read a story that was written by a girl in my class.
items.zh: 英文課的時候，我們讀了一篇我們班一個女生寫的故事。

items.en: My mum always tells me to be careful online. She doesn't trust news that is shared by strangers.
items.zh: 我媽媽總是叫我上網要小心。她不相信陌生人分享的新聞。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞是人 + who + be + 過去分詞 + by

items.en: We're all very proud. There's a girl in my class who was chosen by the coach for the national team.
items.zh: 我們都很驕傲。我們班有一個女生被教練選進國家隊。

items.en: On holiday, I talked to a man who was rescued by a fisherman after his boat sank.
items.zh: 度假的時候，我跟一個男人聊過，他的船沉了以後被一個漁夫救起來。

items.en: Mrs Lee is the best teacher in the school. The children who are taught by her always do well in exams.
items.zh: 李老師是學校裡最好的老師。她教的學生考試都考得很好。

items.en: The book fair was great. We met a writer who is loved by teenagers all over the world.
items.zh: 書展很棒。我們見到一位全世界的青少年都很喜歡的作家。

examples.heading: ⑤ 關係子句在句中，說明主詞

items.en: Our family has lived in this village for a long time. The house which was built by my grandfather is still standing.
items.zh: 我們家在這個村子住很久了。我爺爺蓋的那棟房子還在。

items.en: Go to the bakery on the corner. The bread which is baked by the owner every morning is always fresh.
items.zh: 去轉角那家麵包店。老闆每天早上烤的麵包一直都很新鮮。

items.en: My uncle loves photography. The photos which were taken by him are on the wall in our living room.
items.zh: 我叔叔很喜歡攝影。他拍的照片掛在我們家客廳的牆上。

items.en: My dad is a football coach. The team which is coached by him won every game this year.
items.zh: 我爸爸是足球教練。他帶的那支隊伍今年每場都贏。

items.en: Our class made its own rules this year. The rules which were written by the students are on the classroom door.
items.zh: 我們班今年自己訂了規則。學生寫的規則貼在教室門上。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的情境

items.en: Your place on the trip isn't confirmed yet. Please send us the form which was signed by your parents.
items.zh: 你參加旅行的名額還沒確定。請把你爸媽簽過名的表格寄給我們。

items.en: I'm reading a book which was recommended by my teacher. It's about a family in Ireland.
items.zh: 我在看一本老師推薦的書。內容是愛爾蘭的一個家庭。

items.en: "Which bag is yours?" "The one which was given to me by my aunt."
items.zh: 哪一個包包是你的？我阿姨送我的那個。

items.en: Our printer is very slow. We need a printer which is used by a lot of offices and is easy to repair.
items.zh: 我們的印表機很慢。我們需要一台很多辦公室都在用、而且容易修的印表機。

items.en: Look, this is the bridge which was damaged by the flood last year. They've just repaired it.
items.zh: 你看，這就是去年被洪水沖壞的那座橋。他們剛修好。

items.en: The restaurant has a new chef. Have you tried the soup which is made by him?
items.zh: 那家餐廳來了一個新廚師。你喝過他做的湯了嗎？

title: I believe there are a few things that could be improved for next year's festival.
translation: 我認為明年的節慶活動有幾個地方可以改進。
name: 情態動詞的被動語態（多種主詞）
sentences: I had a marvellous time, but I believe there are a few things that could be improved for next year's festival.
The food was good, but it could be served a bit faster.
With more computers, students could be taught in a more interesting way.
Nowadays it could be said that nearly everyone is living in a digital world.
That old building is empty. It could be turned into a youth club.
Our town needs more green space. Architects should be hired to design parks where people can have a picnic.
Students should be given more time to finish the test.
In my opinion, mobile phones should not be used in class.
This letter is important. It should be sent today.
The rubbish on the beach is terrible. Something should be done about it.
Please read the rules. All bags must be checked before you go in.
There's a form for the school trip. It must be signed by a parent.
Animals must not be fed by visitors.
Don't forget, Tom. Your homework must be handed in by Friday.
You don't need to call. The tickets can be bought online.
This sofa can be turned into a bed when we have guests.
Sorry, this coat can't be washed. It has to be dry-cleaned.
From the top of the tower, the whole city can be seen.
Check the weather before you go. The match might be cancelled because of the rain.
Be careful what you write online. It may be read by anyone.
If you're late again, you might be asked to leave the team.
The road may be closed tomorrow, so leave early.
Don't worry about getting to the hotel. You will be met at the airport.
We all entered the photo competition. The winners will be announced on Friday.
Your money won't be returned if you cancel after Monday.
The new bridge will be opened by the mayor next spring.
If we had more money, the library would be opened on Sundays too.
Our town would be improved by a new sports centre.
"Can this be done by tomorrow?" "I'll try my best."
"Should the windows be left open at night?" "No, close them, please."
"When will the results be sent out?" "Next Monday, I think."

examples.heading: ① could be + 過去分詞

items.en: I had a marvellous time, but I believe there are a few things that could be improved for next year's festival.
items.zh: 我玩得很開心，可是我認為明年的節慶活動有幾個地方可以改進。

items.en: The food was good, but it could be served a bit faster.
items.zh: 食物很好吃，可是上菜可以快一點。

items.en: With more computers, students could be taught in a more interesting way.
items.zh: 有更多電腦的話，學生可以用更有趣的方式學習。

items.en: Nowadays it could be said that nearly everyone is living in a digital world.
items.zh: 現在可以說幾乎每個人都活在數位世界裡。

items.en: That old building is empty. It could be turned into a youth club.
items.zh: 那棟舊建築是空的。可以改成青年活動中心。

examples.heading: ② should be + 過去分詞

items.en: Our town needs more green space. Architects should be hired to design parks where people can have a picnic.
items.zh: 我們鎮需要更多綠地。應該請建築師設計公園，讓大家可以去野餐。

items.en: Students should be given more time to finish the test.
items.zh: 應該給學生多一點時間寫完考試。

items.en: In my opinion, mobile phones should not be used in class.
items.zh: 我認為上課時不應該用手機。

items.en: This letter is important. It should be sent today.
items.zh: 這封信很重要。應該今天寄出。

items.en: The rubbish on the beach is terrible. Something should be done about it.
items.zh: 海灘上的垃圾很嚴重。應該想辦法處理。

examples.heading: ③ must be + 過去分詞

items.en: Please read the rules. All bags must be checked before you go in.
items.zh: 請看規定。所有包包進去之前一定要檢查。

items.en: There's a form for the school trip. It must be signed by a parent.
items.zh: 校外教學有一張表格。一定要家長簽名。

items.en: Animals must not be fed by visitors.
items.zh: 遊客不准餵動物。

items.en: Don't forget, Tom. Your homework must be handed in by Friday.
items.zh: Tom，別忘了。你的作業一定要在星期五前交。

examples.heading: ④ can / can't be + 過去分詞

items.en: You don't need to call. The tickets can be bought online.
items.zh: 你不用打電話。票可以在網路上買。

items.en: This sofa can be turned into a bed when we have guests.
items.zh: 有客人來的時候，這張沙發可以變成床。

items.en: Sorry, this coat can't be washed. It has to be dry-cleaned.
items.zh: 抱歉，這件大衣不能水洗。要乾洗。

items.en: From the top of the tower, the whole city can be seen.
items.zh: 從塔頂可以看到整座城市。

examples.heading: ⑤ may / might be + 過去分詞

items.en: Check the weather before you go. The match might be cancelled because of the rain.
items.zh: 出門前看一下天氣。比賽可能會因為下雨取消。

items.en: Be careful what you write online. It may be read by anyone.
items.zh: 在網路上寫東西要小心。任何人都可能看到。

items.en: If you're late again, you might be asked to leave the team.
items.zh: 你要是再遲到，可能會被要求離開球隊。

items.en: The road may be closed tomorrow, so leave early.
items.zh: 那條路明天可能會封，所以早點出門。

examples.heading: ⑥ will / won't be + 過去分詞

items.en: Don't worry about getting to the hotel. You will be met at the airport.
items.zh: 別擔心怎麼去旅館。會有人在機場接你。

items.en: We all entered the photo competition. The winners will be announced on Friday.
items.zh: 我們都參加了攝影比賽。得獎名單星期五公布。

items.en: Your money won't be returned if you cancel after Monday.
items.zh: 你要是星期一之後取消，錢不會退。

items.en: The new bridge will be opened by the mayor next spring.
items.zh: 新橋明年春天由市長主持通車。

examples.heading: ⑦ would be + 過去分詞

items.en: If we had more money, the library would be opened on Sundays too.
items.zh: 如果我們有更多錢，圖書館星期天也會開。

items.en: Our town would be improved by a new sports centre.
items.zh: 有新的運動中心，我們鎮會變得更好。

examples.heading: ⑧ 問句

items.en: "Can this be done by tomorrow?" "I'll try my best."
items.zh: 這個明天前可以做好嗎？我盡量。

items.en: "Should the windows be left open at night?" "No, close them, please."
items.zh: 晚上窗戶要開著嗎？不用，請關起來。

items.en: "When will the results be sent out?" "Next Monday, I think."
items.zh: 結果什麼時候寄出？我想是下星期一。

title: We were lucky because we were given another chance.
translation: 我們很幸運，因為我們又得到了一次機會。
name: 雙受詞動詞的被動語態
sentences: We made a mistake in the first round, but we were lucky because we were given another chance.
I missed my flight, so I was given a ticket for a train from Berlin to Munich.
It was my first day at work. I was given a desk by the window.
The school had a party in July. The children were given a book each at the end of the year.
My grandad was given a gold watch when he left his job.
We waited for two hours, so we were given free drinks.
I couldn't go to the meeting, but I was sent the notes afterwards.
Our teacher is very organised. Everyone in the class was sent an email about the trip.
My cousin had a baby girl. We were sent a photo of her last night.
After the interview, she was sent a letter with the good news.
My sister is moving next month. She was offered a job in a hotel in London.
When we arrived, we were offered tea and cake.
I was offered a place at two universities, and I chose the one near the sea.
Nobody left the team in the summer. The players were offered more money to stay.
On our first day, we were shown the library and the sports hall.
I was shown a photo of the man, but I didn't know him.
The tour was really interesting. We were shown the old kitchen in the castle.
We waited all week to hear about the competition. We were told the results on Friday afternoon.
I was told the way to the station by a kind old lady.
The film has a great ending. The family were told the truth only in the last scene.
My bike was broken, so I was lent one by my neighbour for the weekend.
We worked very hard last month. We were promised a day off after the project.
My aunt sold her first picture at the market. She was paid two hundred pounds for it.
My brother came back from Africa last week. He was asked a lot of questions about his trip.
The competition ended on Sunday. The winners were awarded a cup and a cheque.
My grandmother grew up in Paris. I was taught French by her when I was little.
"Where did you get that bag?" "I was given it for my birthday."
"How did you find out?" "I was sent a message by Anna."
"Why are you so happy?" "I was offered a place on the team!"
"Did they explain the rules?" "Yes, we were told them on the first day."
"How did you find the room?" "We were given a map at the entrance."

examples.heading: ① was / were given

items.en: We made a mistake in the first round, but we were lucky because we were given another chance.
items.zh: 我們第一輪出了錯，可是我們很幸運，因為我們又得到了一次機會。

items.en: I missed my flight, so I was given a ticket for a train from Berlin to Munich.
items.zh: 我錯過了班機，所以拿到一張從柏林到慕尼黑的火車票。

items.en: It was my first day at work. I was given a desk by the window.
items.zh: 那是我上班的第一天。我分到一張靠窗的桌子。

items.en: The school had a party in July. The children were given a book each at the end of the year.
items.zh: 學校七月辦了一個派對。學年結束時，孩子們每人拿到一本書。

items.en: My grandad was given a gold watch when he left his job.
items.zh: 我爺爺退休的時候拿到一支金錶。

items.en: We waited for two hours, so we were given free drinks.
items.zh: 我們等了兩個小時，所以拿到免費的飲料。

examples.heading: ② was / were sent

items.en: I couldn't go to the meeting, but I was sent the notes afterwards.
items.zh: 我沒辦法去開會，可是事後收到了會議紀錄。

items.en: Our teacher is very organised. Everyone in the class was sent an email about the trip.
items.zh: 我們老師很有條理。班上每個人都收到一封關於旅行的電子郵件。

items.en: My cousin had a baby girl. We were sent a photo of her last night.
items.zh: 我表姊生了一個女兒。我們昨晚收到她的照片。

items.en: After the interview, she was sent a letter with the good news.
items.zh: 面試之後，她收到一封有好消息的信。

examples.heading: ③ was / were offered

items.en: My sister is moving next month. She was offered a job in a hotel in London.
items.zh: 我姊姊下個月要搬家。她得到倫敦一家旅館的工作機會。

items.en: When we arrived, we were offered tea and cake.
items.zh: 我們到的時候，有人請我們喝茶吃蛋糕。

items.en: I was offered a place at two universities, and I chose the one near the sea.
items.zh: 兩所大學都錄取我，我選了靠海的那一所。

items.en: Nobody left the team in the summer. The players were offered more money to stay.
items.zh: 夏天沒有人離開球隊。球員們都拿到加薪的條件留下來。

examples.heading: ④ was / were shown

items.en: On our first day, we were shown the library and the sports hall.
items.zh: 我們第一天，有人帶我們看圖書館和體育館。

items.en: I was shown a photo of the man, but I didn't know him.
items.zh: 有人給我看那個男人的照片，可是我不認識他。

items.en: The tour was really interesting. We were shown the old kitchen in the castle.
items.zh: 導覽很有意思。有人帶我們去看城堡裡的舊廚房。

examples.heading: ⑤ was / were told

items.en: We waited all week to hear about the competition. We were told the results on Friday afternoon.
items.zh: 我們等了一整個星期比賽的消息。星期五下午有人告訴我們結果。

items.en: I was told the way to the station by a kind old lady.
items.zh: 一位好心的老太太告訴我去車站的路。

items.en: The film has a great ending. The family were told the truth only in the last scene.
items.zh: 這部電影的結局很棒。家人到最後一幕才被告知真相。

examples.heading: ⑥ 其他雙受詞動詞

items.en: My bike was broken, so I was lent one by my neighbour for the weekend.
items.zh: 我的腳踏車壞了，所以鄰居借我一台過週末。

items.en: We worked very hard last month. We were promised a day off after the project.
items.zh: 我們上個月工作很拚。主管答應我們專案結束後放一天假。

items.en: My aunt sold her first picture at the market. She was paid two hundred pounds for it.
items.zh: 我阿姨在市集賣出她的第一幅畫。她拿到兩百英鎊。

items.en: My brother came back from Africa last week. He was asked a lot of questions about his trip.
items.zh: 我哥哥上星期從非洲回來。大家問了他很多旅行的事。

items.en: The competition ended on Sunday. The winners were awarded a cup and a cheque.
items.zh: 比賽星期天結束。得獎的人拿到一座獎盃和一張支票。

items.en: My grandmother grew up in Paris. I was taught French by her when I was little.
items.zh: 我外婆在巴黎長大。我小時候的法語是她教的。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問答

items.en: "Where did you get that bag?" "I was given it for my birthday."
items.zh: 你那個包包是哪裡來的？是我生日收到的禮物。

items.en: "How did you find out?" "I was sent a message by Anna."
items.zh: 你怎麼知道的？Anna 傳了訊息給我。

items.en: "Why are you so happy?" "I was offered a place on the team!"
items.zh: 你怎麼這麼開心？球隊要我加入！

items.en: "Did they explain the rules?" "Yes, we were told them on the first day."
items.zh: 他們有說明規則嗎？有，第一天就告訴我們了。

items.en: "How did you find the room?" "We were given a map at the entrance."
items.zh: 你們怎麼找到那間教室的？我們在入口拿到一張地圖。

title: She was offered a contract to record a single.
translation: 有人提供她一份合約，請她錄一首單曲。
name: 雙受詞動詞的被動語態（間接受詞當主詞）
sentences: After the TV show, she was offered a contract to record a single.
My grandfather was awarded a medal for saving a child from the river.
At the border, we were refused entry because our visas were wrong.
The workers were promised a pay rise, but it never came.
I was charged twenty pounds for a taxi from the station!
When I arrived at the gate, I was handed a map and a ticket.
I was very happy to hear that you have been offered two jobs, one in a restaurant and one in a museum.
I felt pleased that your firm has been given some extra money to spend on the cinema.
Our school has been awarded a prize for its new garden.
My sister has been granted a visa, so she can work in Canada now.
We've been promised a new teacher next term.
At this hotel, guests are given a free breakfast every morning.
In some countries, students are paid a small amount to study.
Children under five are allowed free entry to the zoo.
New staff are shown the building on their first day.
After you register, you will be sent a password by email.
The best student will be awarded a free trip to Paris.
Don't worry. You won't be charged for the delivery.
Everyone will be given a number at the start of the race.
In my opinion, children should be taught first aid at school.
Visitors can be lent an umbrella if it rains.
The players must be paid their money by the end of the month.
If you ask nicely, you might be given a discount.
I was angry because I wasn't given a choice.
We haven't been told the date of the exam yet.
The people in the old flats weren't offered new homes.
He was denied the chance to speak at the meeting.
"Were you given a receipt?" "Yes, it's in my bag."
"Have you been offered a seat on the committee?" "Not yet."
"How much were you charged for the repair?" "Fifty pounds."
"Will we be given lunch on the trip?" "Yes, but bring some water."

examples.heading: ① 過去簡單式

items.en: After the TV show, she was offered a contract to record a single.
items.zh: 上完那個電視節目之後，有一家公司給她一份合約，請她錄一首單曲。

items.en: My grandfather was awarded a medal for saving a child from the river.
items.zh: 我爺爺因為從河裡救起一個孩子，得到一枚獎章。

items.en: At the border, we were refused entry because our visas were wrong.
items.zh: 在邊境，我們被拒絕入境，因為簽證有問題。

items.en: The workers were promised a pay rise, but it never came.
items.zh: 工人們被承諾會加薪，可是一直沒有加。

items.en: I was charged twenty pounds for a taxi from the station!
items.zh: 我從車站搭計程車被收了二十英鎊！

items.en: When I arrived at the gate, I was handed a map and a ticket.
items.zh: 我到大門的時候，有人遞給我一張地圖和一張票。

examples.heading: ② 現在完成式

items.en: I was very happy to hear that you have been offered two jobs, one in a restaurant and one in a museum.
items.zh: 聽說你得到兩份工作，一份在餐廳，一份在博物館，我很高興。

items.en: I felt pleased that your firm has been given some extra money to spend on the cinema.
items.zh: 我很高興你們公司拿到一筆額外的錢，可以花在電影院上。

items.en: Our school has been awarded a prize for its new garden.
items.zh: 我們學校的新花園得了獎。

items.en: My sister has been granted a visa, so she can work in Canada now.
items.zh: 我妹妹拿到簽證了，所以她現在可以在加拿大工作。

items.en: We've been promised a new teacher next term.
items.zh: 學校答應我們下學期會有新老師。

examples.heading: ③ 現在簡單式

items.en: At this hotel, guests are given a free breakfast every morning.
items.zh: 這間旅館的客人每天早上都有免費早餐。

items.en: In some countries, students are paid a small amount to study.
items.zh: 在一些國家，學生讀書可以拿到一點錢。

items.en: Children under five are allowed free entry to the zoo.
items.zh: 五歲以下的孩子可以免費進動物園。

items.en: New staff are shown the building on their first day.
items.zh: 新員工第一天會有人帶他們看這棟大樓。

examples.heading: ④ will / won't be

items.en: After you register, you will be sent a password by email.
items.zh: 你註冊之後，會用電子郵件收到一組密碼。

items.en: The best student will be awarded a free trip to Paris.
items.zh: 最好的學生會得到一趟免費的巴黎之旅。

items.en: Don't worry. You won't be charged for the delivery.
items.zh: 別擔心。運費不會跟你收。

items.en: Everyone will be given a number at the start of the race.
items.zh: 比賽開始時每個人都會拿到一個號碼。

examples.heading: ⑤ 情態動詞

items.en: In my opinion, children should be taught first aid at school.
items.zh: 我認為學校應該教孩子急救。

items.en: Visitors can be lent an umbrella if it rains.
items.zh: 下雨的話可以借遊客雨傘。

items.en: The players must be paid their money by the end of the month.
items.zh: 球員的錢一定要在月底前付清。

items.en: If you ask nicely, you might be given a discount.
items.zh: 你客氣地問的話，也許會打折。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句

items.en: I was angry because I wasn't given a choice.
items.zh: 我很生氣，因為沒有人給我選擇。

items.en: We haven't been told the date of the exam yet.
items.zh: 還沒人告訴我們考試的日期。

items.en: The people in the old flats weren't offered new homes.
items.zh: 舊公寓的住戶沒有拿到新房子。

items.en: He was denied the chance to speak at the meeting.
items.zh: 他在會議上沒有得到發言的機會。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "Were you given a receipt?" "Yes, it's in my bag."
items.zh: 有給你收據嗎？有，在我包包裡。

items.en: "Have you been offered a seat on the committee?" "Not yet."
items.zh: 委員會有給你一個位子嗎？還沒有。

items.en: "How much were you charged for the repair?" "Fifty pounds."
items.zh: 修理費收了你多少？五十英鎊。

items.en: "Will we be given lunch on the trip?" "Yes, but bring some water."
items.zh: 旅行有供午餐嗎？有，可是要帶水。

title: Your name was given to me by Allan Westwood, whom I met last week.
translation: 我是從 Allan Westwood 那裡得知您的名字的，我上週跟他見過面。
name: 雙受詞動詞的被動語態（直接受詞當主詞）
sentences: Dear Ms Hall, your name was given to me by Allan Westwood, whom I met last week.
Our neighbours moved out in May. Their house was sold to a young couple from London.
The concert made a lot of money. All of it was given to the hospital.
The letters were sent to the wrong address, so we never got them.
My old bike was lent to my cousin for the summer.
The prize was given to the youngest player in the team.
If more training is given to staff, they will be more interested in their work.
In our school, free lunches are given to children from poor families.
English is taught to children from the age of six.
Show your student card at the door. These tickets are sold only to students.
Unfortunately, an interview for a job has been offered to me at the same time as your class.
Your report has been sent to the manager. She'll call you tomorrow.
The flat has been rented to a student, so it isn't free any more.
More help has been promised to the families who lost their homes.
The certificates will be given to all the students at the end of the course.
Your new card will be sent to you by post.
The chef has finished the new menu. It will be shown to the staff on Monday.
Happy birthday! This cake was made for you by Grandma.
A room has been booked for you at the Grand Hotel.
Dinner was cooked for us by the kids last night.
A new playground was built for the children in our street.
These shoes were bought for me by my aunt.
I was given the job, but the car was given to someone else.
We were sent a free book, and a free pen was sent to our teacher.
The children were taught French, and Spanish was taught to the older students.
A copy of the contract has been sent to you by email.
The details of the trip will be given to parents next week.
Your request was passed to our manager, who will reply soon.
"Who was the money given to?" "To the animal hospital."
"Was the letter sent to you or to your mother?" "To me."
"Has the key been given to the new tenant?" "Yes, this morning."

examples.heading: ① was / were + 過去分詞 + to

items.en: Dear Ms Hall, your name was given to me by Allan Westwood, whom I met last week.
items.zh: 親愛的 Hall 女士：我是從 Allan Westwood 那裡得知您的名字的，我上週跟他見過面。

items.en: Our neighbours moved out in May. Their house was sold to a young couple from London.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居五月搬走了。他們的房子賣給一對倫敦來的年輕夫妻。

items.en: The concert made a lot of money. All of it was given to the hospital.
items.zh: 那場音樂會賺了很多錢。全部都捐給了醫院。

items.en: The letters were sent to the wrong address, so we never got them.
items.zh: 那些信寄到錯的地址，所以我們一直沒收到。

items.en: My old bike was lent to my cousin for the summer.
items.zh: 我的舊腳踏車暑假借給我表弟了。

items.en: The prize was given to the youngest player in the team.
items.zh: 獎頒給了隊上年紀最小的球員。

examples.heading: ② is / are + 過去分詞 + to

items.en: If more training is given to staff, they will be more interested in their work.
items.zh: 如果給員工更多訓練，他們會對工作更有興趣。

items.en: In our school, free lunches are given to children from poor families.
items.zh: 在我們學校，窮人家的孩子有免費午餐。

items.en: English is taught to children from the age of six.
items.zh: 孩子六歲開始學英文。

items.en: Show your student card at the door. These tickets are sold only to students.
items.zh: 在門口出示你的學生證。這些票只賣給學生。

examples.heading: ③ has / have been + 過去分詞 + to

items.en: Unfortunately, an interview for a job has been offered to me at the same time as your class.
items.zh: 很不巧，有一份工作的面試時間跟你們的課撞期了。

items.en: Your report has been sent to the manager. She'll call you tomorrow.
items.zh: 你的報告已經寄給經理了。她明天會打給你。

items.en: The flat has been rented to a student, so it isn't free any more.
items.zh: 那間公寓已經租給一個學生了，所以沒空房了。

items.en: More help has been promised to the families who lost their homes.
items.zh: 有人答應要給失去家園的家庭更多幫助。

examples.heading: ④ will be + 過去分詞 + to

items.en: The certificates will be given to all the students at the end of the course.
items.zh: 課程結束時，所有學生都會拿到證書。

items.en: Your new card will be sent to you by post.
items.zh: 你的新卡會用郵寄給你。

items.en: The chef has finished the new menu. It will be shown to the staff on Monday.
items.zh: 主廚把新菜單做好了。星期一會拿給員工看。

examples.heading: ⑤ 用 for 的動詞

items.en: Happy birthday! This cake was made for you by Grandma.
items.zh: 生日快樂！這個蛋糕是奶奶為你做的。

items.en: A room has been booked for you at the Grand Hotel.
items.zh: 已經幫你在 Grand Hotel 訂了一間房間。

items.en: Dinner was cooked for us by the kids last night.
items.zh: 昨晚孩子們煮晚餐給我們吃。

items.en: A new playground was built for the children in our street.
items.zh: 我們這條街幫孩子們蓋了一座新的遊樂場。

items.en: These shoes were bought for me by my aunt.
items.zh: 這雙鞋是我阿姨買給我的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 和收到的人當主詞比較

items.en: I was given the job, but the car was given to someone else.
items.zh: 那份工作給了我，可是車子給了別人。

items.en: We were sent a free book, and a free pen was sent to our teacher.
items.zh: 我們收到一本免費的書，老師收到一支免費的筆。

items.en: The children were taught French, and Spanish was taught to the older students.
items.zh: 孩子們學法文，年紀大一點的學生學西班牙文。

examples.heading: ⑦ 寫信和通知

items.en: A copy of the contract has been sent to you by email.
items.zh: 合約的副本已經用電子郵件寄給您了。

items.en: The details of the trip will be given to parents next week.
items.zh: 校外教學的細節下星期會發給家長。

items.en: Your request was passed to our manager, who will reply soon.
items.zh: 您的要求已經轉給我們的經理，他很快會回覆。

examples.heading: ⑧ 問句

items.en: "Who was the money given to?" "To the animal hospital."
items.zh: 錢給了誰？給動物醫院。

items.en: "Was the letter sent to you or to your mother?" "To me."
items.zh: 信是寄給你還是寄給你媽媽？寄給我。

items.en: "Has the key been given to the new tenant?" "Yes, this morning."
items.zh: 鑰匙交給新房客了嗎？交了，今天早上。

title: The bridge has been being repaired for three months.
translation: 這座橋已經修了三個月了。
name: 現在完成進行式被動語態
sentences: I'm late again. The bridge has been being repaired for three months, so there's always traffic.
Our kitchen has been being redone for weeks. We're eating takeaway every night.
That new hotel has been being built for two years, and it still isn't finished.
The plan has been being discussed for months, but nobody has made a decision.
My car has been being fixed for a week. I'm tired of taking the bus.
The case has been being investigated for over a year.
The old trees along the river have been being cut down for weeks.
The exhibition opens next week. These paintings have been being cleaned for months.
The roads in the city centre have been being dug up all summer.
Their emails have been being read by the company for years.
The museum has been being renovated since last spring.
The road outside our house has been being widened since January.
The new law has been being debated since the election.
The station has been being rebuilt since 2022.
I think I've been being followed all week. I keep seeing the same car.
She's been being treated for back pain since the accident.
The new players have been being trained by the coach since the start of the season.
He's been being bullied at school for months, and nobody noticed.
The lift has been being repaired for ages. When will it work again?
My complaint has been being looked at for six weeks. That's far too long.
The noise is terrible. The building next door has been being knocked down since Monday.
This report has been being written for a month. Can we finish it this week?
The bridge has been being repaired for months. They've been repairing it since June.
The school has been being painted all week, but the classrooms are still not ready.
The house has been being cleaned since nine, and it's nearly done.
The documents have been being checked for days. They're under review.
The missing climbers have been being searched for since Tuesday.
The problem has been being studied by scientists for many years.
Prices have been being pushed up by the cost of energy.
"How long has the road been being repaired?" "Since the spring, I think."
"Has the machine been being used all day?" "Yes, it's very hot now."

examples.heading: ① has been being + 過去分詞 + for

items.en: I'm late again. The bridge has been being repaired for three months, so there's always traffic.
items.zh: 我又遲到了。這座橋已經修了三個月了，所以一直塞車。

items.en: Our kitchen has been being redone for weeks. We're eating takeaway every night.
items.zh: 我們的廚房已經重新裝修好幾個星期了。我們每天晚上都吃外帶。

items.en: That new hotel has been being built for two years, and it still isn't finished.
items.zh: 那間新旅館已經蓋了兩年，還是沒蓋好。

items.en: The plan has been being discussed for months, but nobody has made a decision.
items.zh: 這個計畫已經討論好幾個月了，可是還沒有人做決定。

items.en: My car has been being fixed for a week. I'm tired of taking the bus.
items.zh: 我的車已經修了一個星期。我搭公車搭膩了。

items.en: The case has been being investigated for over a year.
items.zh: 這個案子已經調查了一年多。

examples.heading: ② have been being + 過去分詞

items.en: The old trees along the river have been being cut down for weeks.
items.zh: 河邊的老樹已經砍了好幾個星期了。

items.en: The exhibition opens next week. These paintings have been being cleaned for months.
items.zh: 展覽下星期開幕。這些畫已經清理了好幾個月。

items.en: The roads in the city centre have been being dug up all summer.
items.zh: 市中心的路整個夏天都在挖。

items.en: Their emails have been being read by the company for years.
items.zh: 他們的電子郵件多年來一直被公司偷看。

examples.heading: ③ since + 時間

items.en: The museum has been being renovated since last spring.
items.zh: 博物館從去年春天就開始翻修了。

items.en: The road outside our house has been being widened since January.
items.zh: 我們家外面的路從一月就開始拓寬了。

items.en: The new law has been being debated since the election.
items.zh: 新法律從選舉後就一直在辯論。
