items.en: The station has been being rebuilt since 2022.
items.zh: 車站從 2022 年就開始改建了。

examples.heading: ④ 人當主詞

items.en: I think I've been being followed all week. I keep seeing the same car.
items.zh: 我覺得我整個星期都被跟蹤。我一直看到同一輛車。

items.en: She's been being treated for back pain since the accident.
items.zh: 她從那次意外以後就一直在治療背痛。

items.en: The new players have been being trained by the coach since the start of the season.
items.zh: 新球員從球季開始就一直由教練訓練。

items.en: He's been being bullied at school for months, and nobody noticed.
items.zh: 他在學校被欺負好幾個月了，可是沒人發現。

examples.heading: ⑤ 抱怨

items.en: The lift has been being repaired for ages. When will it work again?
items.zh: 電梯已經修了好久了。什麼時候才會好？

items.en: My complaint has been being looked at for six weeks. That's far too long.
items.zh: 我的投訴已經處理了六個星期。實在太久了。

items.en: The noise is terrible. The building next door has been being knocked down since Monday.
items.zh: 噪音很可怕。隔壁的大樓從星期一就在拆了。

items.en: This report has been being written for a month. Can we finish it this week?
items.zh: 這份報告已經寫了一個月了。我們這星期可以寫完嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 和其他說法比較

items.en: The bridge has been being repaired for months. They've been repairing it since June.
items.zh: 這座橋已經修了好幾個月了。他們從六月就開始修。

items.en: The school has been being painted all week, but the classrooms are still not ready.
items.zh: 學校整個星期都在油漆，可是教室還沒準備好。

items.en: The house has been being cleaned since nine, and it's nearly done.
items.zh: 房子從九點就開始打掃，快打掃完了。

items.en: The documents have been being checked for days. They're under review.
items.zh: 文件已經檢查好幾天了。還在審查中。

examples.heading: ⑦ 新聞和報告

items.en: The missing climbers have been being searched for since Tuesday.
items.zh: 從星期二開始，搜救人員就在找失蹤的登山客。

items.en: The problem has been being studied by scientists for many years.
items.zh: 科學家已經研究這個問題很多年了。

items.en: Prices have been being pushed up by the cost of energy.
items.zh: 物價一直被能源成本推高。

examples.heading: ⑧ 問句

items.en: "How long has the road been being repaired?" "Since the spring, I think."
items.zh: 這條路已經修多久了？我想是從春天開始。

items.en: "Has the machine been being used all day?" "Yes, it's very hot now."
items.zh: 這台機器整天都在用嗎？對，現在很燙。

title: My school was chosen by the TV company because it is one of the newest in town.
translation: 那家電視公司選了我們學校，因為它是鎮上最新的學校之一。
name: 用 by 強調動作者的被動語態
sentences: Guess what! My school was chosen by the TV company because it is one of the newest in town.
Look at this old photo of our street. It was taken by my grandfather in 1965.
"Who broke the window?" "It was broken by the boy next door. He was playing football."
We visited the castle on Saturday. It was built by a rich family in the 15th century.
I love the cake at your party. Was it made by your mum?
My little brother cried all night. He was bitten by a dog in the park.
The winner of the competition was chosen by the students, not the teachers.
We read Romeo and Juliet in class. It was written by Shakespeare over four hundred years ago.
Everyone in the museum stops in front of this painting. It was painted by Van Gogh.
We sing "Yesterday" in our music class. It was written by Paul McCartney.
Our science teacher showed us an old phone. She told us the telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
We're watching a film tonight. It was directed by Steven Spielberg.
Our football club had no money for new kit this year. In the end, the shirts were paid for by the local bank.
There were lots of people in town last week. The new hospital was opened by the mayor.
My cousin is very happy. She was offered a job by a big company in London.
The concert is free. It's paid for by the city council.
Sorry I'm late. My train was delayed by the snow.
We're too busy to do the gardening ourselves. Our garden is looked after by an old man from the village.
My daughter wants to write for this magazine. It's read by millions of teenagers every week.
Don't worry about the dog. He's fed by my sister when I'm away.
You can't borrow books there any more. The old library has been bought by a hotel company.
Have you heard? Our project has been chosen by the judges for the final.
"Did you paint this?" "No, it was painted by my sister. I only did the small one."
The first part of the report was written by Anna, and the second part was written by me.
The tickets weren't bought by Dad. They were bought by Grandma as a birthday present.
The dinner was cooked by the children tonight, so be nice about it!
"This bread is lovely. Who was it made by?" "By the baker on the corner."
"Was the fire started by a cigarette?" "The police think so."
"Who were you taught by at university?" "By Professor Hall. She was great."
"Were these flowers sent by your boyfriend?" "No, by my mum!"
"Who was the email signed by?" "By the head teacher."

examples.heading: ① 過去簡單式加 by

items.en: Guess what! My school was chosen by the TV company because it is one of the newest in town.
items.zh: 你猜怎樣！那家電視公司選了我們學校，因為它是鎮上最新的學校之一。

items.en: Look at this old photo of our street. It was taken by my grandfather in 1965.
items.zh: 你看這張我們這條街的舊照片。是我爺爺 1965 年拍的。

items.en: "Who broke the window?" "It was broken by the boy next door. He was playing football."
items.zh: 誰打破窗戶的？是隔壁的男孩打破的。他在踢足球。

items.en: We visited the castle on Saturday. It was built by a rich family in the 15th century.
items.zh: 我們星期六去參觀那座城堡。它是十五世紀一個有錢人家蓋的。

items.en: I love the cake at your party. Was it made by your mum?
items.zh: 我很喜歡你派對上的蛋糕。是你媽媽做的嗎？

items.en: My little brother cried all night. He was bitten by a dog in the park.
items.zh: 我弟弟哭了一整晚。他在公園被狗咬了。

items.en: The winner of the competition was chosen by the students, not the teachers.
items.zh: 比賽的冠軍是學生選的，不是老師選的。

examples.heading: ② 有名的人和作品

items.en: We read Romeo and Juliet in class. It was written by Shakespeare over four hundred years ago.
items.zh: 我們在課堂上讀《羅密歐與茱麗葉》。這是莎士比亞四百多年前寫的。

items.en: Everyone in the museum stops in front of this painting. It was painted by Van Gogh.
items.zh: 博物館裡每個人都會停在這幅畫前面。這是梵谷畫的。

items.en: We sing "Yesterday" in our music class. It was written by Paul McCartney.
items.zh: 我們音樂課唱〈Yesterday〉。這首歌是保羅麥卡尼寫的。

items.en: Our science teacher showed us an old phone. She told us the telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
items.zh: 自然老師給我們看一支舊電話。她說電話是貝爾發明的。

items.en: We're watching a film tonight. It was directed by Steven Spielberg.
items.zh: 我們今晚要看一部電影。是史蒂芬史匹柏導的。

examples.heading: ③ 機構和公司

items.en: Our football club had no money for new kit this year. In the end, the shirts were paid for by the local bank.
items.zh: 我們足球社今年沒錢買新球衣。最後球衣是當地的銀行出錢買的。

items.en: There were lots of people in town last week. The new hospital was opened by the mayor.
items.zh: 上星期鎮上人很多。新醫院由市長主持開幕。

items.en: My cousin is very happy. She was offered a job by a big company in London.
items.zh: 我表姊很開心。倫敦一家大公司要給她一份工作。

items.en: The concert is free. It's paid for by the city council.
items.zh: 這場音樂會免費。錢是市議會出的。

items.en: Sorry I'm late. My train was delayed by the snow.
items.zh: 抱歉我遲到了。我的火車因為下雪誤點了。

examples.heading: ④ 現在簡單式和現在完成式加 by

items.en: We're too busy to do the gardening ourselves. Our garden is looked after by an old man from the village.
items.zh: 我們太忙，沒空自己整理花園。我們的花園是村子裡一個老先生在照顧。

items.en: My daughter wants to write for this magazine. It's read by millions of teenagers every week.
items.zh: 我女兒想替這本雜誌寫稿。每個星期有幾百萬個青少年看這本雜誌。

items.en: Don't worry about the dog. He's fed by my sister when I'm away.
items.zh: 別擔心狗。我不在的時候我妹妹會餵牠。

items.en: You can't borrow books there any more. The old library has been bought by a hotel company.
items.zh: 那裡已經不能借書了。舊圖書館被一家旅館公司買下來了。

items.en: Have you heard? Our project has been chosen by the judges for the final.
items.zh: 你聽說了嗎？我們的作品被評審選進決賽了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 和別人對比

items.en: "Did you paint this?" "No, it was painted by my sister. I only did the small one."
items.zh: 這是你畫的嗎？不是，是我妹妹畫的。我只畫了小的那張。

items.en: The first part of the report was written by Anna, and the second part was written by me.
items.zh: 報告的第一部分是 Anna 寫的，第二部分是我寫的。

items.en: The tickets weren't bought by Dad. They were bought by Grandma as a birthday present.
items.zh: 票不是爸爸買的。是奶奶買的，當生日禮物。

items.en: The dinner was cooked by the children tonight, so be nice about it!
items.zh: 今晚的晚餐是孩子們煮的，所以說話客氣一點！

examples.heading: ⑥ 問誰做的

items.en: "This bread is lovely. Who was it made by?" "By the baker on the corner."
items.zh: 這麵包很好吃。是誰做的？轉角那家麵包店做的。

items.en: "Was the fire started by a cigarette?" "The police think so."
items.zh: 火是菸蒂引起的嗎？警察是這樣認為。

items.en: "Who were you taught by at university?" "By Professor Hall. She was great."
items.zh: 你大學時是誰教你的？Hall 教授。她教得很好。

items.en: "Were these flowers sent by your boyfriend?" "No, by my mum!"
items.zh: 這些花是你男朋友送的嗎？不是，是我媽媽送的！

items.en: "Who was the email signed by?" "By the head teacher."
items.zh: 這封電子郵件是誰署名的？校長。

title: We are being visited by our sales director on Thursday morning.
translation: 我們的業務總監星期四早上會來拜訪我們。
name: 現在進行式被動語態表示未來
sentences: Please tidy your desks. We are being visited by our sales director on Thursday morning.
Don't go to the main hall tomorrow. The meeting is being held in Room 5.
The school concert is being held in the town hall this year, because our hall is too small.
The seminar is being held in Chennai next week, so I need to book a flight.
I can't come on Saturday. My cousin's wedding is being held in Scotland that weekend.
Can you stay at home on Friday? The new sofa is being delivered between ten and twelve.
Put the bins out tonight. They're being emptied early tomorrow morning.
I ordered your present online. It's being sent next week, so it should arrive before your birthday.
Don't throw that box away. It's being collected by the post office tomorrow.
Can you come in early on Monday? The new books are being delivered at eight.
You don't need a taxi. You're being met at the airport by our driver.
Grandma can't drive any more, so she's being picked up by my dad on Sunday.
I'm a bit nervous. I'm being interviewed for the job tomorrow afternoon.
Remember to pack a lunch for Ben. The children are being taken to the zoo next Friday.
We're going on holiday next week. Our cat is being looked after by the neighbours.
We can't use the kitchen next week. It's being painted.
Take the bus on Monday. The bridge is being repaired, so it'll be closed all day.
Our old windows are being replaced in March. The new ones will keep the house warmer.
Don't park in front of the house tomorrow. The tree is being cut down.
Have you heard? The new shopping centre is being opened by a famous footballer on Saturday.
Don't miss it! Our school play is being shown on local TV next Sunday.
I'm so nervous. The exam results are being sent out on Thursday.
The winners are being announced at the end of the evening, so please stay until then.
You can relax. The test isn't being marked until next week.
The shop isn't being closed after all. They found a new owner.
Don't worry. You aren't being moved to another class next term.
"When is the new fridge being delivered?" "On Wednesday morning, I think."
"Where's the party being held?" "At Lucy's house. Her parents are away."
"Are you being collected after school?" "Yes, my mum's picking me up."
"Is the match being shown on TV tonight?" "No, only on the radio."
"Who is the prize being given to tonight?" "To the girl who wrote the best story."

examples.heading: ① 會議和活動

items.en: Please tidy your desks. We are being visited by our sales director on Thursday morning.
items.zh: 請把桌子整理好。我們的業務總監星期四早上要來。

items.en: Don't go to the main hall tomorrow. The meeting is being held in Room 5.
items.zh: 明天別去大禮堂。會議改在五號教室開。

items.en: The school concert is being held in the town hall this year, because our hall is too small.
items.zh: 今年的學校音樂會在市政廳舉行，因為我們的禮堂太小了。

items.en: The seminar is being held in Chennai next week, so I need to book a flight.
items.zh: 研討會下星期在清奈舉行，所以我得訂機票。

items.en: I can't come on Saturday. My cousin's wedding is being held in Scotland that weekend.
items.zh: 我星期六不能來。那個週末我表哥的婚禮在蘇格蘭舉行。

examples.heading: ② 送貨和收東西

items.en: Can you stay at home on Friday? The new sofa is being delivered between ten and twelve.
items.zh: 你星期五可以待在家嗎？新沙發十點到十二點之間會送來。

items.en: Put the bins out tonight. They're being emptied early tomorrow morning.
items.zh: 今晚把垃圾桶拿出去。明天一大早要清。

items.en: I ordered your present online. It's being sent next week, so it should arrive before your birthday.
items.zh: 我在網路上訂了你的禮物。下星期寄出，應該會在你生日前到。

items.en: Don't throw that box away. It's being collected by the post office tomorrow.
items.zh: 別把那個箱子丟掉。郵局明天要來收。

items.en: Can you come in early on Monday? The new books are being delivered at eight.
items.zh: 你星期一可以早點來嗎？新書八點會送到。

examples.heading: ③ 接人和拜訪

items.en: You don't need a taxi. You're being met at the airport by our driver.
items.zh: 你不用叫計程車。我們的司機會在機場接你。

items.en: Grandma can't drive any more, so she's being picked up by my dad on Sunday.
items.zh: 奶奶已經不能開車了，所以星期天我爸爸會去接她。

items.en: I'm a bit nervous. I'm being interviewed for the job tomorrow afternoon.
items.zh: 我有點緊張。我明天下午要去面試那份工作。

items.en: Remember to pack a lunch for Ben. The children are being taken to the zoo next Friday.
items.zh: 記得幫 Ben 準備午餐。下星期五老師要帶孩子們去動物園。

items.en: We're going on holiday next week. Our cat is being looked after by the neighbours.
items.zh: 我們下星期要去度假。鄰居會幫我們照顧貓。

examples.heading: ④ 修理和工程

items.en: We can't use the kitchen next week. It's being painted.
items.zh: 我們下星期不能用廚房。廚房要油漆。

items.en: Take the bus on Monday. The bridge is being repaired, so it'll be closed all day.
items.zh: 星期一搭公車吧。橋要修，整天都會封起來。

items.en: Our old windows are being replaced in March. The new ones will keep the house warmer.
items.zh: 我們的舊窗戶三月要換。新的會讓房子比較暖。

items.en: Don't park in front of the house tomorrow. The tree is being cut down.
items.zh: 明天別把車停在房子前面。那棵樹要砍掉。

examples.heading: ⑤ 開幕、播出和公布

items.en: Have you heard? The new shopping centre is being opened by a famous footballer on Saturday.
items.zh: 你聽說了嗎？新購物中心星期六由一個有名的足球員主持開幕。

items.en: Don't miss it! Our school play is being shown on local TV next Sunday.
items.zh: 別錯過！我們學校的話劇下星期天會在地方電視台播出。

items.en: I'm so nervous. The exam results are being sent out on Thursday.
items.zh: 我好緊張。考試成績星期四會寄出。

items.en: The winners are being announced at the end of the evening, so please stay until then.
items.zh: 得獎名單在晚會最後公布，所以請待到那時候。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句

items.en: You can relax. The test isn't being marked until next week.
items.zh: 你可以放輕鬆。考卷下星期才會改。

items.en: The shop isn't being closed after all. They found a new owner.
items.zh: 那家店最後不會關了。他們找到新老闆了。

items.en: Don't worry. You aren't being moved to another class next term.
items.zh: 別擔心。下學期不會把你換到別班。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "When is the new fridge being delivered?" "On Wednesday morning, I think."
items.zh: 新冰箱什麼時候送來？我想是星期三早上。

items.en: "Where's the party being held?" "At Lucy's house. Her parents are away."
items.zh: 派對在哪裡辦？在 Lucy 家。她爸媽不在。

items.en: "Are you being collected after school?" "Yes, my mum's picking me up."
items.zh: 放學有人來接你嗎？有，我媽媽會來接我。

items.en: "Is the match being shown on TV tonight?" "No, only on the radio."
items.zh: 今晚的比賽有電視轉播嗎？沒有，只有廣播。

items.en: "Who is the prize being given to tonight?" "To the girl who wrote the best story."
items.zh: 今晚的獎要頒給誰？頒給寫出最好故事的那個女孩。

title: In conclusion, it can be seen that the bicycle is more suitable for those who live in a small town or in the country.
translation: 總之，可以看出腳踏車比較適合住在小鎮或鄉下的人。
name: 情態動詞被動語態用於評估和總結
sentences: In conclusion, it can be seen that the bicycle is more suitable for those who live in a small town or in the country.
Look at the chart. It can be seen that more people are working from home.
From the survey, it can be seen that most students want a longer lunch break.
It can be seen from these figures that sales went down in the winter.
To sum up, it can be concluded that the new timetable works well.
Both cities have good points, but it could be said that Rome is more beautiful.
Hardly anyone goes to the shops on Saturday now. It could be said that the internet has changed the way we shop.
After three years, it can be concluded that the project was a success.
Phones are useful for school work. However, it could be argued that young people spend too much time online.
On the other hand, it could be argued that zoos help to protect animals.
Most teachers give homework every day. But it could be argued that homework is not always useful.
It might be argued that school uniforms are unfair to poor families, but I disagree.
Our streets are not very clean. I think something must be done about it.
There's too much traffic outside the school. Something should be done before there's an accident.
Many old people live alone in our town. More should be done to help them.
The rubbish in the park is a big problem, and it must be dealt with soon.
The festival was good, but the food stalls could be improved.
In my opinion, the opening hours of the library should be changed.
The report is clear, but some parts could be explained in more detail.
The rules are too old. They must be changed to fit the way we live now.
I enjoyed the course. However, more time should be given to speaking practice.
Some parents hate phones. Still, it cannot be denied that smartphones are useful.
People near the airport can't sleep at night. The problem of noise cannot be ignored any longer.
It can't be denied that the city centre is much safer now.
Half of the students said they felt stressed. These results should not be ignored.
I am writing about the bus service. In my view, more buses should be provided in the evening.
The plan is cheap and it will save time. To sum up, it can be recommended to the board.
Overall, the trip can be described as a great success.
Our neighbourhood has a few problems, but they could be solved if everyone worked together.
"So, what do you think?" "Well, it could be said that both plans have problems."
"Is the new park a good idea?" "Yes, but it must be looked after properly."

examples.heading: ① it can be seen that

items.en: In conclusion, it can be seen that the bicycle is more suitable for those who live in a small town or in the country.
items.zh: 總之，可以看出腳踏車比較適合住在小鎮或鄉下的人。

items.en: Look at the chart. It can be seen that more people are working from home.
items.zh: 看這張圖表。可以看出愈來愈多人在家工作。

items.en: From the survey, it can be seen that most students want a longer lunch break.
items.zh: 從問卷可以看出，大部分學生想要更長的午休。

items.en: It can be seen from these figures that sales went down in the winter.
items.zh: 從這些數字可以看出，冬天的銷售量下降了。

examples.heading: ② it can be concluded / it could be said that

items.en: To sum up, it can be concluded that the new timetable works well.
items.zh: 總而言之，可以得出結論：新的課表效果很好。

items.en: Both cities have good points, but it could be said that Rome is more beautiful.
items.zh: 兩座城市都有優點，可是可以說羅馬比較美。

items.en: Hardly anyone goes to the shops on Saturday now. It could be said that the internet has changed the way we shop.
items.zh: 現在星期六幾乎沒人去逛街了。可以說網路改變了我們購物的方式。

items.en: After three years, it can be concluded that the project was a success.
items.zh: 三年之後，可以得出結論：這個計畫很成功。

examples.heading: ③ it could be argued that

items.en: Phones are useful for school work. However, it could be argued that young people spend too much time online.
items.zh: 手機對課業很有用。不過，也有人會說年輕人花太多時間上網。

items.en: On the other hand, it could be argued that zoos help to protect animals.
items.zh: 另一方面，也有人會說動物園有助於保護動物。

items.en: Most teachers give homework every day. But it could be argued that homework is not always useful.
items.zh: 大部分老師每天都出作業。可是也有人會說作業不一定有用。

items.en: It might be argued that school uniforms are unfair to poor families, but I disagree.
items.zh: 也許有人會說學校制服對窮人家不公平，可是我不同意。

examples.heading: ④ something must / should be done

items.en: Our streets are not very clean. I think something must be done about it.
items.zh: 我們的街道不太乾淨。我覺得必須想辦法處理。

items.en: There's too much traffic outside the school. Something should be done before there's an accident.
items.zh: 學校外面車太多了。應該在出事之前想辦法。

items.en: Many old people live alone in our town. More should be done to help them.
items.zh: 我們鎮上很多老人獨居。應該多幫他們一點。

items.en: The rubbish in the park is a big problem, and it must be dealt with soon.
items.zh: 公園的垃圾是個大問題，必須盡快處理。

examples.heading: ⑤ could be improved / should be changed

items.en: The festival was good, but the food stalls could be improved.
items.zh: 音樂節辦得不錯，可是食物攤位可以再改進。

items.en: In my opinion, the opening hours of the library should be changed.
items.zh: 我認為圖書館的開放時間應該改。

items.en: The report is clear, but some parts could be explained in more detail.
items.zh: 報告很清楚，可是有些部分可以解釋得更詳細。

items.en: The rules are too old. They must be changed to fit the way we live now.
items.zh: 這些規定太舊了。必須修改，配合我們現在的生活方式。

items.en: I enjoyed the course. However, more time should be given to speaking practice.
items.zh: 我很喜歡這門課。不過，應該多給一點口說練習的時間。

examples.heading: ⑥ cannot be denied / cannot be ignored

items.en: Some parents hate phones. Still, it cannot be denied that smartphones are useful.
items.zh: 有些家長很討厭手機。不過，不可否認智慧型手機很有用。

items.en: People near the airport can't sleep at night. The problem of noise cannot be ignored any longer.
items.zh: 機場附近的人晚上睡不著。噪音的問題不能再被忽視了。

items.en: It can't be denied that the city centre is much safer now.
items.zh: 不可否認，市中心現在安全多了。

items.en: Half of the students said they felt stressed. These results should not be ignored.
items.zh: 一半的學生說他們覺得壓力很大。這些結果不應該被忽視。

examples.heading: ⑦ 在報告和信裡

items.en: I am writing about the bus service. In my view, more buses should be provided in the evening.
items.zh: 我寫信是關於公車服務。我認為晚上應該多開一些公車。

items.en: The plan is cheap and it will save time. To sum up, it can be recommended to the board.
items.zh: 這個計畫很便宜，也能省時間。總之，可以推薦給董事會。

items.en: Overall, the trip can be described as a great success.
items.zh: 整體來說，這趟旅行可以說非常成功。

items.en: Our neighbourhood has a few problems, but they could be solved if everyone worked together.
items.zh: 我們社區有幾個問題，可是如果大家一起努力，是可以解決的。

examples.heading: ⑧ 討論時

items.en: "So, what do you think?" "Well, it could be said that both plans have problems."
items.zh: 那你覺得呢？嗯，可以說兩個計畫都有問題。

items.en: "Is the new park a good idea?" "Yes, but it must be looked after properly."
items.zh: 新公園是好主意嗎？是，可是一定要好好維護。

title: I am very glad to hear that the cinema will be renovated next year.
translation: 聽到電影院明年要翻修，我很高興。
name: will 的被動語態表示未來
sentences: Just to let you know, you will be booked into the Palace Hotel for three nights.
Welcome to the course. You'll be given a timetable on the first day.
Here's your key, sir. Your bags will be taken to your room by our staff.
Welcome to the conference. Lunch will be served at one o'clock in the main hall.
The keys will be left with the neighbour, so you can get in.
Dear Mr Bixon, I am very glad to hear that the cinema will be renovated next year.
The old bridge is too dangerous. It will be replaced by a new one in the spring.
Our street will be closed on Sunday for the marathon.
The town is growing fast. A new hospital will be built on the edge of town.
The classrooms look old and dirty. They will be painted during the summer holidays.
One day, most cars will be driven by computers.
If we don't do something, these forests will be destroyed.
Don't worry. You'll be chosen for the team. You're the best player.
In the future, more books will be read on screens than on paper.
Congratulations! You'll be contacted by our manager next week.
When you arrive at the station, you'll be met by my brother.
The winners will be invited to a dinner with the mayor.
All new students will be shown around the school by a teacher.
Sorry, your money won't be returned if you cancel now.
Don't worry. The changes won't be made until next year.
The match won't be shown on TV, so let's go to the stadium.
Late homework won't be accepted after Friday.
The pool won't be opened until the water is clean.
Your order will be delivered within five working days.
Your application will be considered by our team, and we'll reply soon.
Please note that the office will be closed on Monday.
We will land in London soon. All passengers will be asked to show their passports.
Full details will be sent to you by email.
"When will the results be announced?" "Next Friday."
"Will I be paid for the extra hours?" "Yes, at the end of the month."
"Will the food be provided, or should we bring our own?" "It'll be provided."

examples.heading: ① 通知安排

items.en: Just to let you know, you will be booked into the Palace Hotel for three nights.
items.zh: 跟您說一聲，我們會幫您訂 Palace Hotel 三個晚上。

items.en: Welcome to the course. You'll be given a timetable on the first day.
items.zh: 歡迎參加這門課。第一天會發課表給你。

items.en: Here's your key, sir. Your bags will be taken to your room by our staff.
items.zh: 先生，這是您的鑰匙。我們的員工會把您的行李送到房間。

items.en: Welcome to the conference. Lunch will be served at one o'clock in the main hall.
items.zh: 歡迎參加研討會。午餐一點在大禮堂供應。

items.en: The keys will be left with the neighbour, so you can get in.
items.zh: 鑰匙會放在鄰居那裡，所以你進得去。

examples.heading: ② 計畫和決定

items.en: Dear Mr Bixon, I am very glad to hear that the cinema will be renovated next year.
items.zh: 親愛的 Bixon 先生：聽到電影院明年要翻修，我很高興。

items.en: The old bridge is too dangerous. It will be replaced by a new one in the spring.
items.zh: 舊橋太危險了。春天會換成一座新的。

items.en: Our street will be closed on Sunday for the marathon.
items.zh: 我們這條街星期天會因為馬拉松封路。

items.en: The town is growing fast. A new hospital will be built on the edge of town.
items.zh: 鎮上人口成長很快。鎮的邊緣要蓋一間新醫院。

items.en: The classrooms look old and dirty. They will be painted during the summer holidays.
items.zh: 教室看起來又舊又髒。暑假會重新油漆。

examples.heading: ③ 預測

items.en: One day, most cars will be driven by computers.
items.zh: 總有一天，大部分的車會由電腦駕駛。

items.en: If we don't do something, these forests will be destroyed.
items.zh: 如果我們不想辦法，這些森林會被毀掉。

items.en: Don't worry. You'll be chosen for the team. You're the best player.
items.zh: 別擔心。你會被選進隊裡。你是最好的球員。

items.en: In the future, more books will be read on screens than on paper.
items.zh: 未來在螢幕上看的書會比紙本多。

examples.heading: ④ 人當主詞

items.en: Congratulations! You'll be contacted by our manager next week.
items.zh: 恭喜！我們經理下星期會跟你聯絡。

items.en: When you arrive at the station, you'll be met by my brother.
items.zh: 你到車站的時候，我哥哥會去接你。

items.en: The winners will be invited to a dinner with the mayor.
items.zh: 得獎的人會受邀跟市長吃晚餐。

items.en: All new students will be shown around the school by a teacher.
items.zh: 所有新生都會由一位老師帶著參觀學校。

examples.heading: ⑤ won't be + 過去分詞

items.en: Sorry, your money won't be returned if you cancel now.
items.zh: 抱歉，你現在取消的話，錢不會退。

items.en: Don't worry. The changes won't be made until next year.
items.zh: 別擔心。要到明年才會改。

items.en: The match won't be shown on TV, so let's go to the stadium.
items.zh: 這場比賽不會在電視上播，所以我們去球場吧。

items.en: Late homework won't be accepted after Friday.
items.zh: 星期五以後遲交的作業不收。

items.en: The pool won't be opened until the water is clean.
items.zh: 水乾淨之前，游泳池不會開放。

examples.heading: ⑥ 在信和通知裡

items.en: Your order will be delivered within five working days.
items.zh: 您的訂單會在五個工作天內送達。

items.en: Your application will be considered by our team, and we'll reply soon.
items.zh: 我們的團隊會考慮您的申請，我們很快會回覆。

items.en: Please note that the office will be closed on Monday.
items.zh: 請注意，辦公室星期一不開。

items.en: We will land in London soon. All passengers will be asked to show their passports.
items.zh: 我們很快就會在倫敦降落。所有乘客都會被要求出示護照。

items.en: Full details will be sent to you by email.
items.zh: 完整的細節會用電子郵件寄給您。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: "When will the results be announced?" "Next Friday."
items.zh: 結果什麼時候公布？下星期五。

items.en: "Will I be paid for the extra hours?" "Yes, at the end of the month."
items.zh: 加班的時數會付錢嗎？會，月底付。

items.en: "Will the food be provided, or should we bring our own?" "It'll be provided."
items.zh: 會提供食物，還是我們要自己帶？會提供。

title: I was waiting for you all Saturday evening.
translation: 我們整個晚上都在跳舞。
name: 過去進行式的肯定句
sentences: Where were you? I was waiting for you at the café all Saturday evening.
I was studying for my exam all weekend.
I was cleaning the house all morning.
I was reading in bed all afternoon because it was raining.
I was working in the garden all day yesterday.
I was sitting in the dentist's waiting room for an hour.
The music was great at the wedding. We were dancing all evening.
We were laughing so much that our faces hurt.
The children were playing in the snow for hours.
They were talking about the match all through lunch.
We were singing songs around the campfire until midnight.
My parents were painting the kitchen when I got home.
The holiday was perfect. I was swimming and sunbathing every day.
We were eating ice cream every afternoon in Italy.
She was walking on the beach every morning.
They were exploring a different village every day.
My brother was surfing every day of the holiday.
We were cycling along the coast every morning.
My dad was cooking dinner when the phone rang.
The baby was sleeping, so we talked quietly.
It was snowing heavily all night.
My sister was practising the piano for two hours.
The dog was barking at the postman.
Our teacher was writing on the board when the bell rang.
At eight o'clock last night, I was having dinner with my family.
At midnight we were still watching the film.
At this time yesterday, I was flying to Madrid.
At noon the workers were having their lunch break.
At six this morning, my mum was already making bread.
At ten o'clock the shops were opening their doors.
At that moment, my phone was ringing in my bag.

examples.heading: ① I was + -ing + all + 時間：整段時間都在做

items.en: Where were you? I was waiting for you at the café all Saturday evening.
items.zh: 你去哪裡了？我整個星期六晚上都在咖啡館等你。

items.en: I was studying for my exam all weekend.
items.zh: 我整個週末都在準備考試。

items.en: I was cleaning the house all morning.
items.zh: 我整個早上都在打掃房子。

items.en: I was reading in bed all afternoon because it was raining.
items.zh: 因為下雨，我整個下午都在床上看書。

items.en: I was working in the garden all day yesterday.
items.zh: 我昨天整天都在花園裡工作。

items.en: I was sitting in the dentist's waiting room for an hour.
items.zh: 我在牙醫的候診室坐了一個小時。

examples.heading: ② We / They were + -ing：大家一起在做

items.en: The music was great at the wedding. We were dancing all evening.
items.zh: 婚禮上的音樂很棒。我們整晚都在跳舞。

items.en: We were laughing so much that our faces hurt.
items.zh: 我們笑得臉都痛了。

items.en: The children were playing in the snow for hours.
items.zh: 孩子們在雪地裡玩了好幾個小時。

items.en: They were talking about the match all through lunch.
items.zh: 他們整個午餐時間都在聊那場比賽。

items.en: We were singing songs around the campfire until midnight.
items.zh: 我們圍著營火唱歌唱到半夜。

items.en: My parents were painting the kitchen when I got home.
items.zh: 我回到家的時候，我爸媽正在油漆廚房。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + was / were + -ing + every day：度假時一直在做

items.en: The holiday was perfect. I was swimming and sunbathing every day.
items.zh: 那次假期很完美。我每天都在游泳和曬太陽。

items.en: We were eating ice cream every afternoon in Italy.
items.zh: 我們在義大利每天下午都在吃冰淇淋。

items.en: She was walking on the beach every morning.
items.zh: 她每天早上都在海灘上散步。

items.en: They were exploring a different village every day.
items.zh: 他們每天都在探索一個不同的村子。

items.en: My brother was surfing every day of the holiday.
items.zh: 我哥哥假期的每一天都在衝浪。

items.en: We were cycling along the coast every morning.
items.zh: 我們每天早上都沿著海岸騎腳踏車。

examples.heading: ④ He / She / It + was + -ing：別人或東西當時在做

items.en: My dad was cooking dinner when the phone rang.
items.zh: 電話響的時候，我爸爸正在煮晚餐。

items.en: The baby was sleeping, so we talked quietly.
items.zh: 寶寶在睡覺，所以我們小聲說話。

items.en: It was snowing heavily all night.
items.zh: 整晚都在下大雪。

items.en: My sister was practising the piano for two hours.
items.zh: 我姊姊練了兩個小時的鋼琴。

items.en: The dog was barking at the postman.
items.zh: 狗正在對郵差叫。

items.en: Our teacher was writing on the board when the bell rang.
items.zh: 鐘響的時候，我們老師正在黑板上寫字。

examples.heading: ⑤ At + 時間, + 主詞 + was / were + -ing：某個時間點正在做

items.en: At eight o'clock last night, I was having dinner with my family.
items.zh: 昨天晚上八點，我正在跟家人吃晚餐。

items.en: At midnight we were still watching the film.
items.zh: 半夜的時候我們還在看電影。

items.en: At this time yesterday, I was flying to Madrid.
items.zh: 昨天這個時候，我正在飛往馬德里。

items.en: At noon the workers were having their lunch break.
items.zh: 中午的時候工人們正在午休。

items.en: At six this morning, my mum was already making bread.
items.zh: 今天早上六點，我媽媽已經在做麵包了。

items.en: At ten o'clock the shops were opening their doors.
items.zh: 十點的時候商店正在開門。

items.en: At that moment, my phone was ringing in my bag.
items.zh: 那個時候，我的手機正在包包裡響。

title: I didn't need much, because I'd been saving money for a few months.
translation: 我們已經等了好幾個小時了。
name: 過去完成進行式的肯定句
sentences: When the project finally ended, I had been working on it for over a year.
When the doctor called our name, we had been waiting for two hours.
By the time the rain stopped, it had been raining for three days.
When I met her, she had been living in Rome for ten years.
When the bus came, we had been standing in the cold for forty minutes.
He had been playing the piano for five years when he gave his first concert.
I didn't need much money on the trip, because I'd been saving for a few months.
She was tired because she'd been working all night.
His clothes were dirty because he'd been playing in the garden.
We were hungry because we'd been walking since breakfast.
The ground was wet because it had been raining.
Her eyes were red because she'd been crying.
By the time we arrived, the guests had been eating since six.
When the teacher came back, the students had been talking since she left.
My grandparents had been living in that house since 1960.
When I called, she had been studying since lunchtime.
The band had been playing since ten when the police arrived.
He had been feeling ill since the weekend.
We had been dancing all night, so we slept until noon.
They had been travelling all day and were very tired.
I had been cleaning all morning, and the house looked great.
She had been shopping all afternoon and had no money left.
We had been swimming all day, so we went to bed early.
He had been driving all night to get home for Christmas.
She had been learning Spanish for a year before she moved to Madrid.
They had been dating for five years before they got married.
I had been feeling nervous for days before the interview.
We had been planning the trip for months before it was cancelled.
He had been working at the bank for twenty years before he retired.
The children had been asking for a dog for ages before we finally got one.
I had been thinking about it for weeks before I decided.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + had been + -ing + for + 時間：持續了多久

items.en: When the project finally ended, I had been working on it for over a year.
items.zh: 那個專案終於結束的時候，我已經做了超過一年。

items.en: When the doctor called our name, we had been waiting for two hours.
items.zh: 醫生叫我們的名字的時候，我們已經等了兩個小時。

items.en: By the time the rain stopped, it had been raining for three days.
items.zh: 雨停的時候，已經下了三天了。

items.en: When I met her, she had been living in Rome for ten years.
items.zh: 我認識她的時候，她已經在羅馬住了十年。

items.en: When the bus came, we had been standing in the cold for forty minutes.
items.zh: 公車來的時候，我們已經在寒風中站了四十分鐘。

items.en: He had been playing the piano for five years when he gave his first concert.
items.zh: 他開第一場音樂會的時候，已經彈了五年鋼琴。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 過去式, because + 主詞 + 'd been + -ing：說原因

items.en: I didn't need much money on the trip, because I'd been saving for a few months.
items.zh: 我旅行時不需要很多錢，因為我已經存了好幾個月。

items.en: She was tired because she'd been working all night.
items.zh: 她很累，因為她工作了一整晚。

items.en: His clothes were dirty because he'd been playing in the garden.
items.zh: 他的衣服很髒，因為他一直在花園裡玩。

items.en: We were hungry because we'd been walking since breakfast.
items.zh: 我們很餓，因為我們從早餐後就一直在走路。

items.en: The ground was wet because it had been raining.
items.zh: 地上是濕的，因為一直在下雨。

items.en: Her eyes were red because she'd been crying.
items.zh: 她的眼睛紅紅的，因為她一直在哭。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + had been + -ing + since + 時間

items.en: By the time we arrived, the guests had been eating since six.
items.zh: 我們到的時候，客人從六點就開始吃了。

items.en: When the teacher came back, the students had been talking since she left.
items.zh: 老師回來的時候，學生從她離開後就一直在說話。

items.en: My grandparents had been living in that house since 1960.
items.zh: 我的祖父母從 1960 年就住在那間房子裡。

items.en: When I called, she had been studying since lunchtime.
items.zh: 我打電話的時候，她從午餐後就一直在讀書。

items.en: The band had been playing since ten when the police arrived.
items.zh: 警察到的時候，樂團從十點就一直在演奏。

items.en: He had been feeling ill since the weekend.
items.zh: 他從週末就一直覺得不舒服。

examples.heading: ④ We had been + -ing + all + 時間

items.en: We had been dancing all night, so we slept until noon.
items.zh: 我們跳了一整晚的舞，所以睡到中午。

items.en: They had been travelling all day and were very tired.
items.zh: 他們旅行了一整天，很累。

items.en: I had been cleaning all morning, and the house looked great.
items.zh: 我打掃了一整個早上，房子看起來很棒。

items.en: She had been shopping all afternoon and had no money left.
items.zh: 她逛了一整個下午，錢都花光了。

items.en: We had been swimming all day, so we went to bed early.
items.zh: 我們游了一整天的泳，所以早早上床了。

items.en: He had been driving all night to get home for Christmas.
items.zh: 為了回家過聖誕節，他開了一整晚的車。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + had been + -ing + before + 子句

items.en: She had been learning Spanish for a year before she moved to Madrid.
items.zh: 她搬到馬德里之前已經學了一年西班牙文。

items.en: They had been dating for five years before they got married.
items.zh: 他們結婚前已經交往了五年。

items.en: I had been feeling nervous for days before the interview.
items.zh: 面試前我已經緊張了好幾天。

items.en: We had been planning the trip for months before it was cancelled.
items.zh: 旅行取消之前，我們已經計畫了好幾個月。（被動）

items.en: He had been working at the bank for twenty years before he retired.
items.zh: 他退休前已經在銀行工作了二十年。

items.en: The children had been asking for a dog for ages before we finally got one.
items.zh: 孩子們吵著要養狗吵了好久，我們才終於養了一隻。

items.en: I had been thinking about it for weeks before I decided.
items.zh: 我決定之前已經想了好幾個星期。

title: I felt really sorry for you after I had read your last letter.
translation: 看了你上一封信以後，我真的很替你難過。
name: 過去完成式的肯定句
sentences: Your dog is still missing? I felt really sorry for you after I had read your last letter.
We went for a walk after we had finished lunch.
She called her mum after she had arrived at the hotel.
I felt much better after I had slept for ten hours.
They went home after they had seen the fireworks.
He started his new job after he had finished university.
When I got to the station, the last train had already left.
When we arrived at the party, most people had already gone home.
When the firefighters came, the neighbours had already put out the fire.
When I opened the fridge, someone had eaten my cake.
When she got home, her husband had cooked dinner.
When the film started, I had already fallen asleep.
I'm sorry I can't come. I'd forgotten that I have a doctor's appointment.
I'd never seen snow before I went to Canada.
She'd left her keys at work, so she couldn't get in.
We'd booked the tickets weeks before.
He'd lost his wallet, so I paid for lunch.
They'd moved house, so my letter didn't reach them.
I couldn't pay because I had left my purse at home.
She was happy because she had passed her driving test.
We were late because we had missed the first bus.
He was tired because he had worked a double shift.
The streets were wet because it had rained in the night.
I didn't watch the film because I had seen it before.
By the time we reached the top, the sun had set.
By the time the doctor arrived, the baby had been born.
By the time I found my phone, the call had stopped.
By the time she was twenty, she had visited thirty countries.
By the time we got to the shop, they had sold all the bread.
By the time the police came, the thieves had run away.
By the time I woke up, my parents had left for work.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + 過去式 + after + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: Your dog is still missing? I felt really sorry for you after I had read your last letter.
items.zh: 你的狗還沒找到？讀完你上一封信以後，我真的很替你難過。

items.en: We went for a walk after we had finished lunch.
items.zh: 我們吃完午餐以後去散步。

items.en: She called her mum after she had arrived at the hotel.
items.zh: 她到了飯店以後打電話給她媽媽。

items.en: I felt much better after I had slept for ten hours.
items.zh: 睡了十個小時以後，我覺得好多了。

items.en: They went home after they had seen the fireworks.
items.zh: 他們看完煙火以後就回家了。

items.en: He started his new job after he had finished university.
items.zh: 他大學畢業以後開始新工作。

examples.heading: ② When + 主詞 + 過去式, + 主詞 + had already + 過去分詞

items.en: When I got to the station, the last train had already left.
items.zh: 我到車站的時候，最後一班火車已經開走了。

items.en: When we arrived at the party, most people had already gone home.
items.zh: 我們到派對的時候，大部分的人已經回家了。

items.en: When the firefighters came, the neighbours had already put out the fire.
items.zh: 消防員來的時候，鄰居已經把火撲滅了。

items.en: When I opened the fridge, someone had eaten my cake.
items.zh: 我打開冰箱的時候，有人已經吃掉我的蛋糕了。

items.en: When she got home, her husband had cooked dinner.
items.zh: 她回到家的時候，她先生已經煮好晚餐了。

items.en: When the film started, I had already fallen asleep.
items.zh: 電影開始的時候，我已經睡著了。

examples.heading: ③ I'd + 過去分詞：口語的縮寫

items.en: I'm sorry I can't come. I'd forgotten that I have a doctor's appointment.
items.zh: 抱歉我不能來。我忘了我跟醫生有約。

items.en: I'd never seen snow before I went to Canada.
items.zh: 我去加拿大之前從來沒看過雪。

items.en: She'd left her keys at work, so she couldn't get in.
items.zh: 她把鑰匙留在公司，所以進不了門。

items.en: We'd booked the tickets weeks before.
items.zh: 我們幾個星期前就訂好票了。

items.en: He'd lost his wallet, so I paid for lunch.
items.zh: 他弄丟了錢包，所以我請他吃午餐。

items.en: They'd moved house, so my letter didn't reach them.
items.zh: 他們搬家了，所以我的信沒寄到他們那裡。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + 過去式 + because + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: I couldn't pay because I had left my purse at home.
items.zh: 我沒辦法付錢，因為我把錢包留在家裡了。

items.en: She was happy because she had passed her driving test.
items.zh: 她很高興，因為她通過了駕照考試。

items.en: We were late because we had missed the first bus.
items.zh: 我們遲到了，因為我們錯過了第一班公車。

items.en: He was tired because he had worked a double shift.
items.zh: 他很累，因為他上了兩班。

items.en: The streets were wet because it had rained in the night.
items.zh: 街道是濕的，因為夜裡下過雨。

items.en: I didn't watch the film because I had seen it before.
items.zh: 我沒看那部電影，因為我以前看過了。

examples.heading: ⑤ By the time + 主詞 + 過去式, + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: By the time we reached the top, the sun had set.
items.zh: 我們到山頂的時候，太陽已經下山了。

items.en: By the time the doctor arrived, the baby had been born.
items.zh: 醫生到的時候，寶寶已經出生了。（被動）

items.en: By the time I found my phone, the call had stopped.
items.zh: 我找到手機的時候，電話已經不響了。

items.en: By the time she was twenty, she had visited thirty countries.
items.zh: 她二十歲的時候，已經去過三十個國家了。

items.en: By the time we got to the shop, they had sold all the bread.
items.zh: 我們到那家店的時候，他們已經把麵包都賣完了。

items.en: By the time the police came, the thieves had run away.
items.zh: 警察來的時候，小偷已經逃跑了。

items.en: By the time I woke up, my parents had left for work.
items.zh: 我醒來的時候，我爸媽已經去上班了。

title: My grandmother lived in a village, and I often went there.
translation: 我是大概十年前認識她的。
name: 過去簡單式的肯定句
sentences: My grandmother lived in a little village in the mountains, and I often went there in the summer.
Our family was very poor then. We lived in a small flat above a shop when I was a baby.
My uncle speaks good French. He lived in Canada for five years.
The teachers all knew me. I went to the same school as my sister.
There's a photo of the Eiffel Tower in our hall. My parents went to Paris for their honeymoon.
It was very hot in 2018. We went to the beach every weekend that summer.
Every day at college I went to class at nine in the morning.
We had a big dog when I was small. Every morning my dad walked him before work.
We had no TV at the farm. Every evening we played cards with our grandparents.
Saturdays were my favourite days. Every Saturday my mum made pancakes for breakfast.
We lived in the city as children. Every summer we visited our cousins by the sea.
I couldn't read when I was four. Every night my brother read a story to me.
Jo and I are very close. I met her about ten years ago.
I know the town quite well now. We moved here five years ago.
My sister is still learning a lot. She started her new job two weeks ago.
We still miss him. My grandfather died three years ago.
The café on the corner is new. They opened it a month ago.
I don't remember the ending. I saw that film a long time ago.
My legs hurt today. I played football with my friends yesterday afternoon.
We cooked a big curry for our neighbours last night.
I'm an aunt now! My sister had a baby last week.
Let's have fish tonight. I ate pizza for lunch yesterday.
My parents love history. They visited the castle last Sunday.
My mum cycles to work now. She bought a new bike last month.
It was a normal Monday. I got up, had a shower and went to school.
We arrived at the hotel, left our bags and went to the beach.
My grandmother put on her glasses and read the card from her grandson.
My son was good last night. He finished his homework and watched TV.
It was a warm evening, so my parents cooked dinner and ate in the garden.
I saw a dog in the street and gave it some water.
The children were bored at home. We walked to the park and played on the swings.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + lived / went + …：說以前的生活

items.en: My grandmother lived in a little village in the mountains, and I often went there in the summer.
items.zh: 我奶奶住在山上的一個小村子裡，我夏天常常去那裡。

items.en: Our family was very poor then. We lived in a small flat above a shop when I was a baby.
items.zh: 那時候我們家很窮。我還是嬰兒的時候，我們住在一家店樓上的小公寓。

items.en: My uncle speaks good French. He lived in Canada for five years.
items.zh: 我叔叔的法文說得很好。他在加拿大住了五年。

items.en: The teachers all knew me. I went to the same school as my sister.
items.zh: 老師們都認識我。我跟我姊姊念同一所學校。

items.en: There's a photo of the Eiffel Tower in our hall. My parents went to Paris for their honeymoon.
items.zh: 我們家走廊有一張艾菲爾鐵塔的照片。我爸媽去巴黎度蜜月。

items.en: It was very hot in 2018. We went to the beach every weekend that summer.
items.zh: 二〇一八年很熱。那年夏天我們每個週末都去海灘。

examples.heading: ② Every day + 主詞 + 過去式：以前每天做的事

items.en: Every day at college I went to class at nine in the morning.
items.zh: 上大學的時候，我每天早上九點去上課。

items.en: We had a big dog when I was small. Every morning my dad walked him before work.
items.zh: 我小時候我們家養了一隻大狗。我爸爸每天早上上班前都去遛牠。

items.en: We had no TV at the farm. Every evening we played cards with our grandparents.
items.zh: 農場上沒有電視。我們每天傍晚都跟祖父母玩牌。

items.en: Saturdays were my favourite days. Every Saturday my mum made pancakes for breakfast.
items.zh: 星期六是我最喜歡的日子。我媽媽每個星期六都做鬆餅當早餐。

items.en: We lived in the city as children. Every summer we visited our cousins by the sea.
items.zh: 我們小時候住在城市。我們每年夏天都去海邊看我們的表親。

items.en: I couldn't read when I was four. Every night my brother read a story to me.
items.zh: 我四歲的時候還不會讀。我哥哥每天晚上都唸一個故事給我聽。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 過去式 + 時間 + ago：多久以前

items.en: Jo and I are very close. I met her about ten years ago.
items.zh: 我和喬很親。我大約十年前認識她。

items.en: I know the town quite well now. We moved here five years ago.
items.zh: 我現在很熟這個鎮了。我們五年前搬到這裡。

items.en: My sister is still learning a lot. She started her new job two weeks ago.
items.zh: 我姊姊還在學很多東西。她兩個星期前開始新工作。

items.en: We still miss him. My grandfather died three years ago.
items.zh: 我們還是很想他。我爺爺三年前過世了。

items.en: The café on the corner is new. They opened it a month ago.
items.zh: 轉角那家咖啡館是新的。他們一個月前開的。

items.en: I don't remember the ending. I saw that film a long time ago.
items.zh: 我不記得結局了。我很久以前看過那部電影。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + 過去式 + yesterday / last + 時間

items.en: My legs hurt today. I played football with my friends yesterday afternoon.
items.zh: 我今天腿好痠。我昨天下午跟朋友踢足球。

items.en: We cooked a big curry for our neighbours last night.
items.zh: 我們昨天晚上為鄰居煮了一大鍋咖哩。

items.en: I'm an aunt now! My sister had a baby last week.
items.zh: 我現在當阿姨了！我姊姊上個星期生了一個寶寶。

items.en: Let's have fish tonight. I ate pizza for lunch yesterday.
items.zh: 我們今晚吃魚吧。我昨天午餐吃披薩。

items.en: My parents love history. They visited the castle last Sunday.
items.zh: 我爸媽很愛歷史。他們上個星期天去參觀了城堡。

items.en: My mum cycles to work now. She bought a new bike last month.
items.zh: 我媽媽現在騎腳踏車上班。她上個月買了一台新的腳踏車。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + 過去式 + and + 過去式：一連串的事

items.en: It was a normal Monday. I got up, had a shower and went to school.
items.zh: 那是一個平常的星期一。我起床，洗了澡，然後去上學。

items.en: We arrived at the hotel, left our bags and went to the beach.
items.zh: 我們到了飯店，放下行李，然後去海灘。

items.en: My grandmother put on her glasses and read the card from her grandson.
items.zh: 我奶奶戴上眼鏡，讀了她孫子寄來的卡片。

items.en: My son was good last night. He finished his homework and watched TV.
items.zh: 我兒子昨晚很乖。他寫完功課，然後看電視。

items.en: It was a warm evening, so my parents cooked dinner and ate in the garden.
items.zh: 那天傍晚很暖和，所以我爸媽煮了晚餐，在花園裡吃。

items.en: I saw a dog in the street and gave it some water.
items.zh: 我在街上看到一隻狗，給了牠一些水。

items.en: The children were bored at home. We walked to the park and played on the swings.
items.zh: 孩子們在家很無聊。我們走到公園，在鞦韆上玩。

title: I spent about £35 on all those clothes.
translation: 我忘了跟你說明天晚上的一些細節。
name: 過去簡單式的肯定句（較多種動詞）
sentences: The second-hand market was so cheap. I spent about £35 on all those clothes.
It rained all day on Sunday. We spent the whole afternoon on a big jigsaw puzzle.
Look at that shiny red car outside. My dad spent a lot of money on it.
My sister got top marks. She spent three hours on her science project.
I love reading. I spent my birthday money on books.
My parents love Italy. They spent all their savings on a trip to Rome.
I'm sorry, I forgot to tell you some details about tomorrow evening.
My sister came home very wet. She forgot her umbrella on the bus.
I forgot to switch off the oven before we went out.
My brother feels terrible. He forgot his mother's birthday.
Someone came into the garden last night. We forgot to lock the back door.
We had a free weekend. The teacher forgot to give us our homework.
I liked the match very much because my favourite team won. It was great.
Look at the cup in the hall. Our school won the football cup last year.
My cousin is a great artist. She won first prize in the painting competition.
It was so close. We lost the final by one point.
My uncle is very lucky. He won a holiday in a radio competition.
Don't call him tonight. My brother lost his phone at the concert.
It's Mother's Day tomorrow. I bought a present for my mum at the market.
The trip was beautiful. We took a lot of photos at the waterfall.
My friend worked until nine. She bought a ticket for the late train.
There was no bridge. They took the boat to the island.
My aunt bought a second-hand piano for her daughter.
My parents were busy on Saturday. I took my little sister to the zoo.
Our holiday in Spain was great. We stayed at a lovely hotel near the beach.
I tried sushi for the first time in Japan.
My grandmother smiled when she saw the old photos.
The taxi driver was very kind. He carried my bags to the car.
Mrs Lee was leaving the school. We planned a surprise party for her.
The children enjoyed the trip to the farm.
I'm so tired this morning. I studied all night for the exam.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + spent + 錢 / 時間 + on + 名詞

items.en: The second-hand market was so cheap. I spent about £35 on all those clothes.
items.zh: 二手市集好便宜。我買那些衣服總共花了大約三十五英鎊。

items.en: It rained all day on Sunday. We spent the whole afternoon on a big jigsaw puzzle.
items.zh: 星期天下了一整天的雨。我們整個下午都在拼一幅大拼圖。

items.en: Look at that shiny red car outside. My dad spent a lot of money on it.
items.zh: 你看外面那台閃亮的紅色車子。我爸爸在它上面花了很多錢。

items.en: My sister got top marks. She spent three hours on her science project.
items.zh: 我妹妹拿了最高分。她花了三個小時做她的自然科作業。

items.en: I love reading. I spent my birthday money on books.
items.zh: 我很愛看書。我把生日禮金花在買書上。

items.en: My parents love Italy. They spent all their savings on a trip to Rome.
items.zh: 我爸媽很愛義大利。他們把所有的積蓄都花在去羅馬的旅行上。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + forgot + to + 原形動詞 / 名詞

items.en: I'm sorry, I forgot to tell you some details about tomorrow evening.
items.zh: 抱歉，我忘了告訴你一些明天晚上的細節。

items.en: My sister came home very wet. She forgot her umbrella on the bus.
items.zh: 我姊姊全身濕透回到家。她把雨傘忘在公車上了。

items.en: I forgot to switch off the oven before we went out.
items.zh: 我們出門前我忘了關烤箱。

items.en: My brother feels terrible. He forgot his mother's birthday.
items.zh: 我哥哥覺得很糟。他忘了他媽媽的生日。

items.en: Someone came into the garden last night. We forgot to lock the back door.
items.zh: 昨晚有人進了花園。我們忘了鎖後門。

items.en: We had a free weekend. The teacher forgot to give us our homework.
items.zh: 我們這個週末很空閒。老師忘了給我們功課。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + won / lost + 名詞：贏得和失去

items.en: I liked the match very much because my favourite team won. It was great.
items.zh: 我很喜歡那場比賽，因為我最喜歡的隊伍贏了。太棒了。

items.en: Look at the cup in the hall. Our school won the football cup last year.
items.zh: 你看大廳裡的獎盃。我們學校去年贏得了足球盃。

items.en: My cousin is a great artist. She won first prize in the painting competition.
items.zh: 我表妹畫畫很厲害。她在繪畫比賽中得了第一名。

items.en: It was so close. We lost the final by one point.
items.zh: 比分好接近。我們以一分之差輸了決賽。

items.en: My uncle is very lucky. He won a holiday in a radio competition.
items.zh: 我叔叔運氣很好。他在一個廣播比賽中贏得了一趟旅行。

items.en: Don't call him tonight. My brother lost his phone at the concert.
items.zh: 今晚別打給他。我哥哥在演唱會上弄丟了手機。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + bought / took + 名詞：購物和旅行

items.en: It's Mother's Day tomorrow. I bought a present for my mum at the market.
items.zh: 明天是母親節。我在市場買了一個禮物給我媽媽。

items.en: The trip was beautiful. We took a lot of photos at the waterfall.
items.zh: 那趟旅行很美。我們在瀑布拍了很多照片。

items.en: My friend worked until nine. She bought a ticket for the late train.
items.zh: 我朋友工作到九點。她買了一張晚班火車的票。

items.en: There was no bridge. They took the boat to the island.
items.zh: 那裡沒有橋。他們搭船去島上。

items.en: My aunt bought a second-hand piano for her daughter.
items.zh: 我阿姨幫她女兒買了一台二手鋼琴。

items.en: My parents were busy on Saturday. I took my little sister to the zoo.
items.zh: 我爸媽星期六很忙。我帶我妹妹去動物園。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + 規則動詞的過去式：更多日常的事

items.en: Our holiday in Spain was great. We stayed at a lovely hotel near the beach.
items.zh: 我們在西班牙的假期很棒。我們住在海灘附近一家很棒的飯店。

items.en: I tried sushi for the first time in Japan.
items.zh: 我在日本第一次吃壽司。

items.en: My grandmother smiled when she saw the old photos.
items.zh: 我奶奶看到那些舊照片時笑了。

items.en: The taxi driver was very kind. He carried my bags to the car.
items.zh: 計程車司機人很好。他幫我把行李提到車上。

items.en: Mrs Lee was leaving the school. We planned a surprise party for her.
items.zh: 李老師要離開學校了。我們為她計畫了一個驚喜派對。

items.en: The children enjoyed the trip to the farm.
items.zh: 孩子們很喜歡去農場的旅行。

items.en: I'm so tired this morning. I studied all night for the exam.
items.zh: 我今天早上好累。我為了考試讀了一整晚的書。

title: Previously I faced many failures, but I never gave up.
translation: 我失敗過很多次，但我從來沒有放棄。
name: 過去簡單式的肯定句（多種動詞）
sentences: My first two cafés closed after a year. Previously I faced many failures, but I never gave up.
My sister moved to a new city alone. She faced a lot of problems in her first year at university.
My uncle used to smoke twenty cigarettes a day. He gave up smoking when his daughter was born.
We stayed too late at the party. We faced a long walk home after the last bus left.
My cousin always wanted to see Asia. He gave up his job to travel around the world.
It was a hard match for our school. The team faced their strongest rivals in the final.
I don't usually go to rap concerts, but I convinced some of my friends to come with me.
I didn't want to sing at first. My sister persuaded me to join the choir.
My brother wanted to start a band. He convinced our parents to buy him a guitar.
The project was very long. We persuaded the teacher to give us more time.
My mum had a new baby. She convinced her boss to let her work from home.
Now we can send photos to each other. I persuaded my grandfather to try a smartphone.
A TV crew came to our school. The cameraman filmed us during a lesson and later in the playground.
We still watch the video. My brother recorded our band's first concert.
My grandmother was in the local paper. A journalist interviewed her about the war.
We didn't have a video camera. We filmed the whole wedding on my phone.
I heard the marathon on the radio. The radio station interviewed the winner of the race.
My aunt loves nature. She recorded the birds singing in her garden.
I've been riding a bike for years. My mum taught me when I was five.
My friend tried on ten coats. She chose the red one in the end.
The singer's plane was late. The concert began an hour late.
We wanted to see the sea last Sunday. We drove all the way to the coast.
My little brother lost our football. He threw the ball over the fence.
I had a lot of news last month. I wrote a long letter to my pen-friend.
I know a lot about fishing. I grew up in a small town by the river.
Our neighbour told us a strange story. We found out the truth a week later.
My cousin's parents worked every day. She looked after her little brother all summer.
We were worried about the storm, but the plane took off on time.
My parents wanted to avoid the traffic. They set off early in the morning.
My neighbour left work at three. He picked up his son from school.
We can't buy sweets there any more. The old shop closed down last year.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + faced / gave up：困難和堅持

items.en: My first two cafés closed after a year. Previously I faced many failures, but I never gave up.
items.zh: 我的前兩家咖啡館開了一年就關了。以前我遇到過很多失敗，可是我從來沒放棄。

items.en: My sister moved to a new city alone. She faced a lot of problems in her first year at university.
items.zh: 我姊姊一個人搬到新的城市。她大學第一年遇到了很多問題。

items.en: My uncle used to smoke twenty cigarettes a day. He gave up smoking when his daughter was born.
items.zh: 我叔叔以前一天抽二十根菸。他在他女兒出生時戒了菸。

items.en: We stayed too late at the party. We faced a long walk home after the last bus left.
items.zh: 我們在派對待太晚了。最後一班公車開走後，我們只好走很長一段路回家。

items.en: My cousin always wanted to see Asia. He gave up his job to travel around the world.
items.zh: 我表哥一直想去亞洲看看。他辭掉工作去環遊世界。

items.en: It was a hard match for our school. The team faced their strongest rivals in the final.
items.zh: 那是我們學校很難打的一場比賽。那支球隊在決賽碰上了他們最強的對手。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + convinced / persuaded + 人 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: I don't usually go to rap concerts, but I convinced some of my friends to come with me.
items.zh: 我通常不去聽饒舌演唱會，可是我說服了我的一些朋友跟我一起去。

items.en: I didn't want to sing at first. My sister persuaded me to join the choir.
items.zh: 我一開始不想唱歌。我姊姊說服我加入合唱團。

items.en: My brother wanted to start a band. He convinced our parents to buy him a guitar.
items.zh: 我弟弟想組樂團。他說服我們爸媽買一把吉他給他。

items.en: The project was very long. We persuaded the teacher to give us more time.
items.zh: 這個作業很長。我們說服老師多給我們一點時間。

items.en: My mum had a new baby. She convinced her boss to let her work from home.
items.zh: 我媽媽剛生了寶寶。她說服她的老闆讓她在家工作。

items.en: Now we can send photos to each other. I persuaded my grandfather to try a smartphone.
items.zh: 現在我們可以互傳照片了。我說服我爺爺試試智慧型手機。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + filmed / recorded / interviewed + 人

items.en: A TV crew came to our school. The cameraman filmed us during a lesson and later in the playground.
items.zh: 一個電視團隊來我們學校。攝影師在上課的時候拍我們，後來又在操場拍。

items.en: We still watch the video. My brother recorded our band's first concert.
items.zh: 我們現在還會看那段影片。我哥哥錄下了我們樂團的第一場演唱會。

items.en: My grandmother was in the local paper. A journalist interviewed her about the war.
items.zh: 我奶奶上了地方報紙。一位記者採訪她關於戰爭的事。

items.en: We didn't have a video camera. We filmed the whole wedding on my phone.
items.zh: 我們沒有攝影機。我們用我的手機拍下了整場婚禮。

items.en: I heard the marathon on the radio. The radio station interviewed the winner of the race.
items.zh: 我在收音機聽馬拉松的轉播。廣播電台採訪了比賽的冠軍。

items.en: My aunt loves nature. She recorded the birds singing in her garden.
items.zh: 我阿姨很愛大自然。她錄下了她花園裡的鳥叫聲。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + 不規則動詞的過去式：更多的不規則動詞

items.en: I've been riding a bike for years. My mum taught me when I was five.
items.zh: 我騎腳踏車騎了好多年了。我五歲的時候，我媽媽教我騎。

items.en: My friend tried on ten coats. She chose the red one in the end.
items.zh: 我朋友試穿了十件外套。她最後選了那件紅色的。

items.en: The singer's plane was late. The concert began an hour late.
items.zh: 歌手的飛機誤點了。音樂會晚了一個小時才開始。

items.en: We wanted to see the sea last Sunday. We drove all the way to the coast.
items.zh: 我們上個星期天想看海。我們一路開車到海邊。

items.en: My little brother lost our football. He threw the ball over the fence.
items.zh: 我弟弟把我們的足球弄丟了。他把球丟過了圍籬。

items.en: I had a lot of news last month. I wrote a long letter to my pen-friend.
items.zh: 我上個月有很多消息。我寫了一封很長的信給我的筆友。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + 片語動詞的過去式

items.en: I know a lot about fishing. I grew up in a small town by the river.
items.zh: 我很懂釣魚。我在河邊的一個小鎮長大。

items.en: Our neighbour told us a strange story. We found out the truth a week later.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居跟我們說了一個奇怪的故事。我們一個星期後才發現了真相。

items.en: My cousin's parents worked every day. She looked after her little brother all summer.
items.zh: 我表妹的爸媽每天都要工作。她整個夏天都在照顧她弟弟。

items.en: We were worried about the storm, but the plane took off on time.
items.zh: 我們很擔心暴風雨，不過飛機準時起飛了。

items.en: My parents wanted to avoid the traffic. They set off early in the morning.
items.zh: 我爸媽想避開塞車。他們一大早就出發了。

items.en: My neighbour left work at three. He picked up his son from school.
items.zh: 我鄰居三點下班。他去學校接他兒子。

items.en: We can't buy sweets there any more. The old shop closed down last year.
items.zh: 我們再也不能去那裡買糖果了。那家老店去年關門了。

title: I have been thinking about your letter.
translation: 我一直在想你信裡說的事。
name: 現在完成進行式的肯定句
sentences: Jenny is my oldest friend. We've been studying together since grade one.
Dear Ann, I've been meaning to write to you for weeks.
Thank you for your email. We have been discussing your proposal with the team.
We leave for Greece tomorrow. I've been looking forward to this trip all year.
Welcome, Mrs Hall. We've been expecting you. Please come in.
My essay is due tomorrow. I've been working on it since lunch.
You've been working so hard. You deserve a holiday.
I can't sleep because of the noise. They have been repairing the road outside my house for a month.
Thank you for all the extra lessons. You've been very patient with me.
My sister and her boyfriend are getting married in May. They've been planning the wedding since last summer.
Come to the school hall in June. The students have been preparing a play for the end of term.
My brother loves big cities. He has been living in New York since he graduated from university.
My new neighbour is a teacher. She has been helping me with my English.
Winter is coming. It has been getting colder every day.
My uncle makes the best pasta. He's been working as a chef for ten years.
We're going to the beach in July. My mother has been learning to swim.
There are new shops and houses everywhere. Our village has been changing since the new road opened.
Sorry about the mess. The kids have been making biscuits.
Mind the kitchen floor. Dad's been mopping it.
My flatmate has been cooking. The whole flat smells of garlic.
Your hands are dirty. You've been fixing your bike again.
My eyes hurt. I've been staring at a screen all day.
Dear Mum, I have been worrying about what you said on the phone.
Dear Ms Lin, I have been reading your blog with great interest.
Dear Mr Brown, we have been receiving complaints about the noise from your flat.
Dear Customer, I have been trying to contact you about your order.
Hi Sam, it's been a month. I've been hoping to hear from you.
Our son was very tired after the trip. He's been sleeping since we got home.
My daughter loves her new camera. She's been taking photos all afternoon.
The schools are closed. It's been snowing since this morning.
My brother never leaves his room now. He's been acting strangely lately.

examples.heading: ① I / We + have been + 動詞-ing

items.en: Jenny is my oldest friend. We've been studying together since grade one.
items.zh: 珍妮是我最老的朋友。我們從一年級就一起念書。

items.en: Dear Ann, I've been meaning to write to you for weeks.
items.zh: 親愛的安，我好幾個禮拜前就想寫信給你了。

items.en: Thank you for your email. We have been discussing your proposal with the team.
items.zh: 謝謝你的電子郵件。我們一直在跟團隊討論你的提案。

items.en: We leave for Greece tomorrow. I've been looking forward to this trip all year.
items.zh: 我們明天出發去希臘。我整年都在期待這趟旅行。

items.en: Welcome, Mrs Hall. We've been expecting you. Please come in.
items.zh: 霍爾女士，歡迎。我們一直在等您，請進。

items.en: My essay is due tomorrow. I've been working on it since lunch.
items.zh: 我的報告明天要交。我從午餐後就一直在寫。

examples.heading: ② You / They + have been + 動詞-ing

items.en: You've been working so hard. You deserve a holiday.
items.zh: 你一直這麼努力工作，應該休個假。

items.en: I can't sleep because of the noise. They have been repairing the road outside my house for a month.
items.zh: 吵得我睡不著。他們在我家外面修路修了一個月了。

items.en: Thank you for all the extra lessons. You've been very patient with me.
items.zh: 謝謝你幫我額外上課。你對我一直很有耐心。

items.en: My sister and her boyfriend are getting married in May. They've been planning the wedding since last summer.
items.zh: 我姊姊和她男朋友五月要結婚。他們從去年夏天就開始籌備婚禮。

items.en: Come to the school hall in June. The students have been preparing a play for the end of term.
items.zh: 六月來學校禮堂吧。學生們一直在準備期末的戲劇表演。

examples.heading: ③ He / She / It + has been + 動詞-ing

items.en: My brother loves big cities. He has been living in New York since he graduated from university.
items.zh: 我哥很愛大城市。他大學畢業以後就一直住在紐約。

items.en: My new neighbour is a teacher. She has been helping me with my English.
items.zh: 我的新鄰居是老師。她一直在幫我學英文。

items.en: Winter is coming. It has been getting colder every day.
items.zh: 冬天快到了。天氣一天比一天冷了。

items.en: My uncle makes the best pasta. He's been working as a chef for ten years.
items.zh: 我叔叔做的義大利麵最好吃。他當廚師當了十年了。

items.en: We're going to the beach in July. My mother has been learning to swim.
items.zh: 我們七月要去海邊。我媽最近在學游泳。

items.en: There are new shops and houses everywhere. Our village has been changing since the new road opened.
items.zh: 到處都是新的店和房子。新的路開通以後，我們村子一直在變。

examples.heading: ④ 剛停下來的活動，看得到結果

items.en: Sorry about the mess. The kids have been making biscuits.
items.zh: 抱歉這裡很亂，孩子們剛剛在做餅乾。

items.en: Mind the kitchen floor. Dad's been mopping it.
items.zh: 小心廚房的地板，爸爸剛剛在拖地。

items.en: My flatmate has been cooking. The whole flat smells of garlic.
items.zh: 我室友剛剛在煮飯，整間公寓都是蒜頭味。

items.en: Your hands are dirty. You've been fixing your bike again.
items.zh: 你的手好髒，你又在修腳踏車了。

items.en: My eyes hurt. I've been staring at a screen all day.
items.zh: 我眼睛好痛，我整天都盯著螢幕。

examples.heading: ⑤ 寫信和電子郵件

items.en: Dear Mum, I have been worrying about what you said on the phone.
items.zh: 親愛的媽媽，我一直很擔心你在電話裡說的話。

items.en: Dear Ms Lin, I have been reading your blog with great interest.
items.zh: 林小姐您好，我一直很有興趣地在看您的部落格。

items.en: Dear Mr Brown, we have been receiving complaints about the noise from your flat.
items.zh: 布朗先生您好，我們一直接到投訴，說您的公寓太吵。

items.en: Dear Customer, I have been trying to contact you about your order.
items.zh: 親愛的顧客，我一直想聯絡您，談您訂購的東西。

items.en: Hi Sam, it's been a month. I've been hoping to hear from you.
items.zh: 嗨，山姆，已經一個月了。我一直在等你的消息。

examples.heading: ⑥ 縮寫 he's / she's / it's been

items.en: Our son was very tired after the trip. He's been sleeping since we got home.
items.zh: 我們兒子旅行完很累。我們到家以後他就一直在睡。

items.en: My daughter loves her new camera. She's been taking photos all afternoon.
items.zh: 我女兒很愛她的新相機。她整個下午都在拍照。

items.en: The schools are closed. It's been snowing since this morning.
items.zh: 學校停課了。從今天早上開始就一直在下雪。

items.en: My brother never leaves his room now. He's been acting strangely lately.
items.zh: 我弟弟現在都不出房間。他最近怪怪的。

title: I have seen the Eiffel Tower and many old buildings.
translation: 我看過艾菲爾鐵塔，也看過很多古老的建築。
name: 現在完成式的肯定句（I 和 we）
sentences: London is great for students. I have visited many museums here.
Summer starts now. I have finished all my exams for this year.
Look in this bag. I have bought a present for my mum.
I need to go back. I have left my coat at the restaurant.
My English class is going well. I have learned a lot of new words.
Don't worry about me at the new school. I have made some new friends here.
You can cook now. I've cleaned the kitchen.
Your parents are coming on Friday. I've booked a table for four.
They were under the sofa. I've found your glasses.
Grandma knitted me a scarf. I've sent a thank-you card to her.
No more cake for me, please. I've eaten too much.
I can drive us to the beach now. I've passed my driving test.
Our London trip is going well. We have seen the Tower of London and Big Ben.
Come and visit us this summer. We have rented a small house by the lake.
The baby can sleep in there now. We've painted the bedroom.
Please write this down. We've changed our phone number.
Thank you for having us. We've had a wonderful time.
Our street party is on Sunday. We've invited all our neighbours.
There'll be more shade next summer. We have planted some trees in the garden.
You should ask me about Kyoto. I've been there more than three times.
Everyone is talking about the new shopping centre. We've been there already.
I can show you the best cafés. I have been to Paris twice.
The weather has been great. We have been to the beach every day this week.
Dear Mum, we have arrived safely in Rome.
Dear Grandpa, I have started my new job at the hospital.
Hi Jo, Scotland is beautiful. We've visited three castles so far.
Hi Dad, I've sent you some photos of the wedding.
Can you get me a plaster? I've cut my finger on a knife.
We'll have to take a taxi. We've missed the last bus.
I know that woman from work, but I have forgotten her name.
Sorry, you'll have to wait for a shower. We've used all the hot water.

examples.heading: ① I have + 過去分詞

items.en: London is great for students. I have visited many museums here.
items.zh: 倫敦很適合學生。我在這裡參觀過很多博物館。

items.en: Summer starts now. I have finished all my exams for this year.
items.zh: 暑假從現在開始。我今年的考試全部考完了。

items.en: Look in this bag. I have bought a present for my mum.
items.zh: 你看這個袋子。我買了一份禮物給我媽媽。

items.en: I need to go back. I have left my coat at the restaurant.
items.zh: 我得回去一趟。我把外套忘在餐廳了。

items.en: My English class is going well. I have learned a lot of new words.
items.zh: 我的英文課上得很順利。我學了很多新單字。

items.en: Don't worry about me at the new school. I have made some new friends here.
items.zh: 別擔心我在新學校的事。我在這裡交了一些新朋友。

examples.heading: ② I've + 過去分詞

items.en: You can cook now. I've cleaned the kitchen.
items.zh: 你現在可以煮飯了。我把廚房打掃好了。

items.en: Your parents are coming on Friday. I've booked a table for four.
items.zh: 你爸媽星期五要來。我訂了四個人的位子。

items.en: They were under the sofa. I've found your glasses.
items.zh: 它們在沙發底下。我找到你的眼鏡了。

items.en: Grandma knitted me a scarf. I've sent a thank-you card to her.
items.zh: 奶奶幫我織了一條圍巾。我寄了一張謝卡給她。

items.en: No more cake for me, please. I've eaten too much.
items.zh: 請不要再給我蛋糕了。我吃太多了。

items.en: I can drive us to the beach now. I've passed my driving test.
items.zh: 我現在可以載我們去海邊了。我考過駕照了。

examples.heading: ③ We have / We've + 過去分詞

items.en: Our London trip is going well. We have seen the Tower of London and Big Ben.
items.zh: 我們的倫敦之旅很順利。我們看過倫敦塔和大笨鐘了。

items.en: Come and visit us this summer. We have rented a small house by the lake.
items.zh: 今年夏天來找我們玩。我們在湖邊租了一間小房子。

items.en: The baby can sleep in there now. We've painted the bedroom.
items.zh: 寶寶現在可以睡那裡了。我們把臥室漆好了。

items.en: Please write this down. We've changed our phone number.
items.zh: 請把這個記下來。我們換了電話號碼。

items.en: Thank you for having us. We've had a wonderful time.
items.zh: 謝謝你招待我們。我們玩得很開心。

items.en: Our street party is on Sunday. We've invited all our neighbours.
items.zh: 我們的街頭派對在星期天。我們邀請了所有的鄰居。

items.en: There'll be more shade next summer. We have planted some trees in the garden.
items.zh: 明年夏天會比較有樹蔭。我們在花園裡種了幾棵樹。

examples.heading: ④ I've been to / We've been to

items.en: You should ask me about Kyoto. I've been there more than three times.
items.zh: 京都的事你應該問我。我去過那裡三次以上。

items.en: Everyone is talking about the new shopping centre. We've been there already.
items.zh: 大家都在聊那家新的購物中心。我們已經去過了。

items.en: I can show you the best cafés. I have been to Paris twice.
items.zh: 我可以帶你去最好的咖啡店。我去過巴黎兩次。

items.en: The weather has been great. We have been to the beach every day this week.
items.zh: 天氣一直很好。這個禮拜我們每天都去海邊。

examples.heading: ⑤ 寫信和明信片

items.en: Dear Mum, we have arrived safely in Rome.
items.zh: 親愛的媽媽，我們平安到羅馬了。

items.en: Dear Grandpa, I have started my new job at the hospital.
items.zh: 親愛的爺爺，我開始在醫院做新工作了。

items.en: Hi Jo, Scotland is beautiful. We've visited three castles so far.
items.zh: 嗨，喬，蘇格蘭好美。到目前為止我們參觀了三座城堡。

items.en: Hi Dad, I've sent you some photos of the wedding.
items.zh: 嗨，爸，我寄了一些婚禮的照片給你。

examples.heading: ⑥ 結果到現在還在

items.en: Can you get me a plaster? I've cut my finger on a knife.
items.zh: 你可以拿一片 OK 繃給我嗎？我被刀子割到手指了。

items.en: We'll have to take a taxi. We've missed the last bus.
items.zh: 我們得搭計程車了。我們錯過末班公車了。

items.en: I know that woman from work, but I have forgotten her name.
items.zh: 我在公司見過那個女人，可是我忘了她的名字。

items.en: Sorry, you'll have to wait for a shower. We've used all the hot water.
items.zh: 抱歉，你得等一下才能洗澡。我們把熱水都用完了。

title: Our company has signed deals with a few German companies.
translation: 我們公司已經跟幾家德國公司簽了合約。
name: 現在完成式的肯定句
sentences: Good news about the move. I've found a cheaper flat.
Come and see the house. We've painted the living room green.
You sent the email to the whole office. You've made a big mistake.
The bakery is doing well. They've opened a new branch in Leeds.
The noise from the building site is terrible. I've written to the manager.
Thank you all for your help. We've raised enough money for a new church roof.
You won't know my brother. He's grown a beard.
Listen to my daughter. She's learned to play the guitar.
I need a new printer. It's stopped working again.
I went to get a drink, and now he's taken my seat.
My aunt is a strong swimmer. She has swum across the lake.
Mum is very proud. My sister has started a new job at a bank.
Driving to work is expensive now. The price of petrol has gone up.
Get your tickets now. Our team has reached the final.
Let's go to the cinema tonight. The new Paddington film has won three awards.
Come and look at the fridge. My daughter has drawn a picture of our cat.
The teacher can mark the work now. The students have handed in their projects.
The dog can't get into our garden now. My neighbours have built a new fence.
Autumn is here. The leaves have turned yellow.
Our shop is doing well online. Our customers have given us good reviews.
Drive carefully on Hill Street. The workers have dug a hole in the road.
Sorry, there's none left for your coffee. I've drunk all the milk.
Please turn off your phone. The concert has begun.
I can't log in to my email. I've forgotten my password.
My friend takes the bus now. She's sold her old bike.
My son and I can't stop sneezing. We've both caught a cold.
The players had a vote this morning. They've chosen a new captain.
You can visit them in the summer. My parents have bought a flat by the sea.
I can't pay with my card. The bank has closed my account.
The jar is empty. The kids have eaten all the biscuits.

examples.heading: ① 代名詞主詞：I / we / you / they + have

items.en: Good news about the move. I've found a cheaper flat.
items.zh: 搬家有好消息。我找到一間比較便宜的公寓了。

items.en: Come and see the house. We've painted the living room green.
items.zh: 來看看房子。我們把客廳漆成綠色了。

items.en: You sent the email to the whole office. You've made a big mistake.
items.zh: 你把那封信寄給了全辦公室。你犯了一個大錯。

items.en: The bakery is doing well. They've opened a new branch in Leeds.
items.zh: 那家麵包店生意很好。他們在里茲開了一家分店。

items.en: The noise from the building site is terrible. I've written to the manager.
items.zh: 工地的噪音很可怕。我寫信給經理了。

items.en: Thank you all for your help. We've raised enough money for a new church roof.
items.zh: 謝謝大家的幫忙。我們募到夠買教堂新屋頂的錢了。

examples.heading: ② 代名詞主詞：he / she / it + has

items.en: You won't know my brother. He's grown a beard.
items.zh: 你會認不出我哥哥。他留了鬍子。

items.en: Listen to my daughter. She's learned to play the guitar.
items.zh: 你聽我女兒彈。她學會彈吉他了。

items.en: I need a new printer. It's stopped working again.
items.zh: 我需要一台新的印表機。這台又不動了。

items.en: I went to get a drink, and now he's taken my seat.
items.zh: 我去拿飲料，結果他坐了我的位子。

items.en: My aunt is a strong swimmer. She has swum across the lake.
items.zh: 我阿姨很會游泳。她游過了那座湖。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞主詞：單數 + has

items.en: Mum is very proud. My sister has started a new job at a bank.
items.zh: 媽媽很驕傲。我姊姊開始在一家銀行做新工作了。

items.en: Driving to work is expensive now. The price of petrol has gone up.
items.zh: 現在開車上班很貴。汽油的價格漲了。

items.en: Get your tickets now. Our team has reached the final.
items.zh: 現在就去買票。我們隊打進決賽了。

items.en: Let's go to the cinema tonight. The new Paddington film has won three awards.
items.zh: 我們今晚去看電影吧。新的柏靈頓熊電影得了三個獎。

items.en: Come and look at the fridge. My daughter has drawn a picture of our cat.
items.zh: 來看看冰箱。我女兒畫了一張我們家貓的畫。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞主詞：複數 + have

items.en: The teacher can mark the work now. The students have handed in their projects.
items.zh: 老師現在可以改作業了。學生們交了他們的作業。

items.en: The dog can't get into our garden now. My neighbours have built a new fence.
items.zh: 狗現在進不了我們的花園了。我的鄰居蓋了一道新的圍籬。

items.en: Autumn is here. The leaves have turned yellow.
items.zh: 秋天到了。葉子都變黃了。

items.en: Our shop is doing well online. Our customers have given us good reviews.
items.zh: 我們的店在網路上做得很好。我們的客戶給了我們很好的評價。

items.en: Drive carefully on Hill Street. The workers have dug a hole in the road.
items.zh: 在山丘街開車要小心。工人在路上挖了一個洞。

examples.heading: ⑤ 更多的不規則動詞

items.en: Sorry, there's none left for your coffee. I've drunk all the milk.
items.zh: 抱歉，沒有牛奶可以加你的咖啡了。我把牛奶都喝光了。

items.en: Please turn off your phone. The concert has begun.
items.zh: 請把手機關機。音樂會開始了。

items.en: I can't log in to my email. I've forgotten my password.
items.zh: 我登不進電子郵件。我忘了密碼。

items.en: My friend takes the bus now. She's sold her old bike.
items.zh: 我朋友現在搭公車。她把舊腳踏車賣掉了。

items.en: My son and I can't stop sneezing. We've both caught a cold.
items.zh: 我和我兒子一直打噴嚏。我們兩個都感冒了。

items.en: The players had a vote this morning. They've chosen a new captain.
items.zh: 球員今天早上投票。他們選出了新隊長。

examples.heading: ⑥ 結果到現在還在

items.en: You can visit them in the summer. My parents have bought a flat by the sea.
items.zh: 你夏天可以去找他們。我爸媽在海邊買了一間公寓。

items.en: I can't pay with my card. The bank has closed my account.
items.zh: 我不能刷卡。銀行把我的帳戶關了。

items.en: The jar is empty. The kids have eaten all the biscuits.
items.zh: 罐子空了。孩子們把餅乾都吃光了。

title: Simon was a very famous writer and had written ten best-sellers.
translation: Simon 是一位非常有名的作家，寫過十本暢銷書。
name: 過去完成式省略主詞
sentences: Simon was a very famous writer and had written ten best-sellers, but he hadn't written a word for years.
My grandfather was a sailor and had travelled all over the world.
The old lady was very kind and had helped many children in the village.
Her brother was a doctor and had worked in Africa for ten years.
The teacher was strict but fair and had taught at the school for thirty years.
The man was very rich and had built three hotels on the island.
After a month at the farm, she felt stronger and had lost her fear of horses.
He looked older and had grown a beard.
They were cold and had gone numb after hours in the snow.
She felt happier and had made lots of new friends.
The boy seemed calmer and had stopped crying.
My aunt looked tired and had lost a lot of weight.
All her friends from Chicago had come to visit her and had brought a huge chocolate cake.
The thieves had broken the window and had taken all the jewellery.
My parents had sold the house and had moved to the coast.
She had finished her degree and had found a job in London.
The storm had knocked down trees and had cut off the power.
He had packed his bags and had said goodbye to everyone.
She had read the letter twice and then threw it in the fire.
We had walked for hours and finally reached the lake.
He had saved enough money and bought a ticket to New York.
They had waited all morning and then left without a word.
I had studied all year and passed every exam.
The children had played all day and fell asleep in the car.
The house was old but had been painted recently.
