He was poor but had always been generous to his friends.
She was only twenty but had already visited forty countries.
The car looked new but had travelled over a hundred thousand miles.
The village was small but had produced three famous painters.
My uncle was quiet but had lived an exciting life.
The shop was tiny but had been open for a hundred years.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was + 名詞 / 形容詞 + and had + 過去分詞：介紹人物

items.en: Simon was a very famous writer and had written ten best-sellers, but he hadn't written a word for years.
items.zh: 西蒙是一個很有名的作家，寫過十本暢銷書，可是他好幾年都寫不出一個字了。

items.en: My grandfather was a sailor and had travelled all over the world.
items.zh: 我爺爺是個水手，到過世界各地。

items.en: The old lady was very kind and had helped many children in the village.
items.zh: 那個老太太很善良，幫助過村子裡很多孩子。

items.en: Her brother was a doctor and had worked in Africa for ten years.
items.zh: 她哥哥是醫生，在非洲工作過十年。

items.en: The teacher was strict but fair and had taught at the school for thirty years.
items.zh: 那位老師很嚴格可是很公平，在那所學校教了三十年書。

items.en: The man was very rich and had built three hotels on the island.
items.zh: 那個男人很有錢，在島上蓋了三家飯店。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + felt / looked + 形容詞 + and had + 過去分詞：人物的變化

items.en: After a month at the farm, she felt stronger and had lost her fear of horses.
items.zh: 在農場待了一個月以後，她覺得比較堅強了，也不再怕馬了。

items.en: He looked older and had grown a beard.
items.zh: 他看起來老了一些，也留了鬍子。

items.en: They were cold and had gone numb after hours in the snow.
items.zh: 他們很冷，在雪地裡待了幾個小時後已經凍僵了。

items.en: She felt happier and had made lots of new friends.
items.zh: 她覺得比較快樂了，也交了很多新朋友。

items.en: The boy seemed calmer and had stopped crying.
items.zh: 那個男孩看起來平靜了一些，也不哭了。

items.en: My aunt looked tired and had lost a lot of weight.
items.zh: 我阿姨看起來很累，也瘦了很多。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + had + 過去分詞 + and had + 過去分詞：兩件更早的事

items.en: All her friends from Chicago had come to visit her and had brought a huge chocolate cake.
items.zh: 她芝加哥的朋友都來看她，還帶了一個巨大的巧克力蛋糕。

items.en: The thieves had broken the window and had taken all the jewellery.
items.zh: 小偷打破了窗戶，拿走了所有的珠寶。

items.en: My parents had sold the house and had moved to the coast.
items.zh: 我爸媽賣掉了房子，搬到了海邊。

items.en: She had finished her degree and had found a job in London.
items.zh: 她念完了學位，在倫敦找到了工作。

items.en: The storm had knocked down trees and had cut off the power.
items.zh: 暴風雨吹倒了樹，也切斷了電力。

items.en: He had packed his bags and had said goodbye to everyone.
items.zh: 他收好了行李，也跟每個人道別了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + had + 過去分詞 + and + 過去式：先後的動作

items.en: She had read the letter twice and then threw it in the fire.
items.zh: 她把那封信讀了兩遍，然後丟進火裡。

items.en: We had walked for hours and finally reached the lake.
items.zh: 我們走了好幾個小時，終於到了湖邊。

items.en: He had saved enough money and bought a ticket to New York.
items.zh: 他存夠了錢，買了一張去紐約的票。

items.en: They had waited all morning and then left without a word.
items.zh: 他們等了一整個早上，然後一句話也沒說就走了。

items.en: I had studied all year and passed every exam.
items.zh: 我讀了一整年的書，每一科都考過了。

items.en: The children had played all day and fell asleep in the car.
items.zh: 孩子們玩了一整天，在車上睡著了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + 過去式 + but had + 過去分詞：轉折

items.en: The house was old but had been painted recently.
items.zh: 那間房子很舊，可是最近才油漆過。（被動）

items.en: He was poor but had always been generous to his friends.
items.zh: 他很窮，可是一直對朋友很大方。

items.en: She was only twenty but had already visited forty countries.
items.zh: 她才二十歲，可是已經去過四十個國家了。

items.en: The car looked new but had travelled over a hundred thousand miles.
items.zh: 那台車看起來很新，可是已經跑了超過十萬英里。

items.en: The village was small but had produced three famous painters.
items.zh: 那個村子很小，可是出了三位有名的畫家。

items.en: My uncle was quiet but had lived an exciting life.
items.zh: 我叔叔很安靜，可是他的一生很精彩。

items.en: The shop was tiny but had been open for a hundred years.
items.zh: 那家店很小，可是已經開了一百年。

title: If it hadn't been for my lack of experience, I wouldn't have been fired.
translation: 要不是 Dan 的個性，他們的友誼本來可以更進一步。
name: had it not been for 與 if it hadn't been for
sentences: If it hadn't been for my lack of knowledge, skills and experience, I wouldn't have been fired.
If it hadn't been for the traffic, we wouldn't have missed the start of the wedding.
If it hadn't been for her broken leg, she wouldn't have left the team.
A car alarm went off in the street. If it hadn't been for the noise, I wouldn't have woken up at three.
If it hadn't been for the strike, the shops wouldn't have run out of milk.
I loved that leather jacket. If it hadn't been for the price, I wouldn't have hesitated to buy it.
If it hadn't been for my older sister, I would have given up my studies.
If it hadn't been for the lifeguard, the boy would have drowned.
If it hadn't been for our coach, we would have lost every game.
If it hadn't been for my neighbour, the house would have burned down.
If it hadn't been for my grandparents, I would never have learned to fish.
If it hadn't been for the kind stranger, we would have spent the night outside.
Had it not been for the fact that I had already read the article, I would have thought that this woman was about thirty.
Had it not been for the fact that the bridge was closed, we would have been home by six.
Had it not been for the fact that she spoke French, she wouldn't have got the job.
Had it not been for the fact that it was a holiday, the shop would have been open.
Had it not been for the fact that he was so tired, he would have come out with us.
Had it not been for the fact that I knew the area, we would have got lost.
Dan was never easy to talk to. Their friendship could have gone further if it hadn't been for his character.
He is a very private person. Had it not been for this, he might have reacted differently.
We might have won the cup if it hadn't been for that injury.
She could have been a famous singer if it hadn't been for her shyness.
The picnic might have been perfect if it hadn't been for the wasps.
They could have bought the house if it hadn't been for the high price.
I would never have met my husband if it hadn't been for that rainy day.
We would never have found the village if it hadn't been for the old map.
He would never have become a chef if it hadn't been for his grandmother.
I would never have learned English if it hadn't been for those films.
She would never have visited Japan if it hadn't been for her pen-friend.
They would never have opened the café if it hadn't been for the old building.
I would never have got the job if it hadn't been for your help.

examples.heading: ① If it hadn't been for + 名詞, + 主詞 + wouldn't have + 過去分詞

items.en: If it hadn't been for my lack of knowledge, skills and experience, I wouldn't have been fired.
items.zh: 要不是因為我缺乏知識、技能和經驗，我就不會被開除。

items.en: If it hadn't been for the traffic, we wouldn't have missed the start of the wedding.
items.zh: 要不是因為塞車，我們就不會錯過婚禮的開頭。

items.en: If it hadn't been for her broken leg, she wouldn't have left the team.
items.zh: 要不是因為她摔斷了腿，她就不會離開球隊。

items.en: A car alarm went off in the street. If it hadn't been for the noise, I wouldn't have woken up at three.
items.zh: 街上有一輛車的警報器響了。要不是因為那個噪音，我就不會在三點醒來。

items.en: If it hadn't been for the strike, the shops wouldn't have run out of milk.
items.zh: 要不是因為罷工，商店就不會缺牛奶。

items.en: I loved that leather jacket. If it hadn't been for the price, I wouldn't have hesitated to buy it.
items.zh: 我很愛那件皮夾克。要不是因為那個價錢，我就不會猶豫要不要買了。

examples.heading: ② If it hadn't been for + 人, + 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞

items.en: If it hadn't been for my older sister, I would have given up my studies.
items.zh: 要不是因為我姊姊，我就會放棄學業了。

items.en: If it hadn't been for the lifeguard, the boy would have drowned.
items.zh: 要不是因為那個救生員，那個男孩就會淹死了。

items.en: If it hadn't been for our coach, we would have lost every game.
items.zh: 要不是因為我們的教練，我們每一場都會輸。

items.en: If it hadn't been for my neighbour, the house would have burned down.
items.zh: 要不是因為我的鄰居，房子就會燒掉了。

items.en: If it hadn't been for my grandparents, I would never have learned to fish.
items.zh: 要不是因為我的祖父母，我永遠不會學會釣魚。

items.en: If it hadn't been for the kind stranger, we would have spent the night outside.
items.zh: 要不是因為那個好心的陌生人，我們就會在外面過夜了。

examples.heading: ③ Had it not been for the fact that + 子句, + 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞

items.en: Had it not been for the fact that I had already read the article, I would have thought that this woman was about thirty.
items.zh: 要不是我已經讀過那篇文章，我會以為這個女人大概三十歲。

items.en: Had it not been for the fact that the bridge was closed, we would have been home by six.
items.zh: 要不是因為那座橋封了，我們六點前就會到家了。

items.en: Had it not been for the fact that she spoke French, she wouldn't have got the job.
items.zh: 要不是因為她會說法文，她就不會得到那份工作。

items.en: Had it not been for the fact that it was a holiday, the shop would have been open.
items.zh: 要不是因為那天是假日，那家店就會開了。

items.en: Had it not been for the fact that he was so tired, he would have come out with us.
items.zh: 要不是因為他那麼累，他就會跟我們出去了。

items.en: Had it not been for the fact that I knew the area, we would have got lost.
items.zh: 要不是因為我熟悉那一帶，我們就會迷路了。

examples.heading: ④ … might / could have + 過去分詞 + if it hadn't been for + 名詞

items.en: Dan was never easy to talk to. Their friendship could have gone further if it hadn't been for his character.
items.zh: 丹一直都不好相處。要不是因為他的個性，他們的友誼也許可以更進一步。

items.en: He is a very private person. Had it not been for this, he might have reacted differently.
items.zh: 他是一個很注重隱私的人。要不是因為這樣，他也許會有不同的反應。

items.en: We might have won the cup if it hadn't been for that injury.
items.zh: 要不是因為那次受傷，我們也許就贏得獎盃了。

items.en: She could have been a famous singer if it hadn't been for her shyness.
items.zh: 要不是因為她很害羞，她本來可以成為一位有名的歌手。

items.en: The picnic might have been perfect if it hadn't been for the wasps.
items.zh: 要不是因為那些黃蜂，那次野餐也許會很完美。

items.en: They could have bought the house if it hadn't been for the high price.
items.zh: 要不是因為價錢太高，他們本來可以買那間房子。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + would never have + 過去分詞 + if it hadn't been for + 名詞

items.en: I would never have met my husband if it hadn't been for that rainy day.
items.zh: 要不是因為那個下雨天，我永遠不會遇到我先生。

items.en: We would never have found the village if it hadn't been for the old map.
items.zh: 要不是因為那張舊地圖，我們永遠不會找到那個村子。

items.en: He would never have become a chef if it hadn't been for his grandmother.
items.zh: 要不是因為他奶奶，他永遠不會成為廚師。

items.en: I would never have learned English if it hadn't been for those films.
items.zh: 要不是因為那些電影，我永遠不會學會英文。

items.en: She would never have visited Japan if it hadn't been for her pen-friend.
items.zh: 要不是因為她的筆友，她永遠不會去日本。

items.en: They would never have opened the café if it hadn't been for the old building.
items.zh: 要不是因為那棟老建築，他們永遠不會開那家咖啡館。

items.en: I would never have got the job if it hadn't been for your help.
items.zh: 要不是因為你的幫忙，我永遠不會得到那份工作。

title: Hardly had he taken them from the counter when the monster vanished again.
translation: 她才剛說完這些話，那位音樂家就明白了，生活不能再這樣下去。
name: hardly … when 倒裝（緊接發生）
sentences: A small monster sat on the counter next to a pair of gold glasses. Hardly had he taken them from the counter when the monster vanished again.
His wife told him that she was leaving. Hardly had she spoken these words when the musician realised that life could not continue like that.
Hardly had the captain left the ship when it began to sink.
Hardly had the princess opened the box when a white bird flew out.
Hardly had the clock struck twelve when the lights went out.
Hardly had the old man closed his eyes when he heard footsteps.
Hardly had I arrived at the beach when it started to pour.
Hardly had I sat down to dinner when the doorbell rang.
Hardly had I got into bed when the baby began to cry.
Hardly had I started my speech when the microphone stopped working.
Hardly had I turned on the computer when the power went off.
Hardly had I stepped off the train when I saw my old teacher.
Hardly had we set off when the car broke down.
Hardly had the game started when it began to snow.
Hardly had they put up the tent when the wind blew it away.
Hardly had she finished painting the wall when the children drew on it.
Hardly had the plane landed when the storm hit the airport.
Hardly had the fishermen pulled in their nets when huge waves began to crash over the boat.
I had hardly opened the door when the dog ran out.
She had hardly finished her coffee when the bus arrived.
We had hardly started eating when the phone rang.
He had hardly left the house when he realised he had forgotten his keys.
My two new neighbours had hardly met when they started to argue about the parking.
The teacher had hardly begun the lesson when the fire alarm went off.
Hardly had she opened the letter when she realised it was not for her.
Hardly had he entered the room when he saw the broken window.
Hardly had I left the shop when I noticed the wrong change.
Hardly had they driven away when they saw smoke behind them.
Hardly had we sat down when we realised we were in the wrong cinema.
Hardly had she put down the phone when she remembered the question she had forgotten to ask.
Hardly had the boy woken up when he smelt the pancakes.

examples.heading: ① Hardly had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + when + 句子：故事的轉折

items.en: A small monster sat on the counter next to a pair of gold glasses. Hardly had he taken them from the counter when the monster vanished again.
items.zh: 一隻小怪物坐在櫃台上，旁邊有一副金色的眼鏡。他才剛從櫃台上拿起眼鏡，那隻怪物就又消失了。

items.en: His wife told him that she was leaving. Hardly had she spoken these words when the musician realised that life could not continue like that.
items.zh: 他的太太說她要離開了。她才剛說出這些話，那位音樂家就明白生活不能再這樣下去了。

items.en: Hardly had the captain left the ship when it began to sink.
items.zh: 船長才剛離開船，船就開始沉了。

items.en: Hardly had the princess opened the box when a white bird flew out.
items.zh: 公主才剛打開盒子，一隻白鳥就飛了出來。

items.en: Hardly had the clock struck twelve when the lights went out.
items.zh: 時鐘才剛敲十二下，燈就熄了。

items.en: Hardly had the old man closed his eyes when he heard footsteps.
items.zh: 那個老人才剛閉上眼睛，就聽到了腳步聲。

examples.heading: ② Hardly had I + 過去分詞 + when + 句子：自己的經歷

items.en: Hardly had I arrived at the beach when it started to pour.
items.zh: 我才剛到海灘，就開始下大雨了。

items.en: Hardly had I sat down to dinner when the doorbell rang.
items.zh: 我才剛坐下來吃晚餐，門鈴就響了。

items.en: Hardly had I got into bed when the baby began to cry.
items.zh: 我才剛上床，寶寶就開始哭了。

items.en: Hardly had I started my speech when the microphone stopped working.
items.zh: 我才剛開始演講，麥克風就壞了。

items.en: Hardly had I turned on the computer when the power went off.
items.zh: 我才剛打開電腦，就停電了。

items.en: Hardly had I stepped off the train when I saw my old teacher.
items.zh: 我才剛下火車，就看到我以前的老師。

examples.heading: ③ Hardly had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + when + 天氣或意外

items.en: Hardly had we set off when the car broke down.
items.zh: 我們才剛出發，車子就拋錨了。

items.en: Hardly had the game started when it began to snow.
items.zh: 比賽才剛開始，就開始下雪了。

items.en: Hardly had they put up the tent when the wind blew it away.
items.zh: 他們才剛搭好帳篷，風就把它吹走了。

items.en: Hardly had she finished painting the wall when the children drew on it.
items.zh: 她才剛油漆完牆壁，孩子們就在上面畫畫。

items.en: Hardly had the plane landed when the storm hit the airport.
items.zh: 飛機才剛降落，暴風雨就襲擊了機場。

items.en: Hardly had the fishermen pulled in their nets when huge waves began to crash over the boat.
items.zh: 漁夫們才剛收網，巨浪就開始打上船。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + had hardly + 過去分詞 + when + 句子：一般的順序

items.en: I had hardly opened the door when the dog ran out.
items.zh: 我才剛打開門，狗就跑出去了。

items.en: She had hardly finished her coffee when the bus arrived.
items.zh: 她才剛喝完咖啡，公車就來了。

items.en: We had hardly started eating when the phone rang.
items.zh: 我們才剛開始吃，電話就響了。

items.en: He had hardly left the house when he realised he had forgotten his keys.
items.zh: 他才剛出門，就發現他忘了帶鑰匙。

items.en: My two new neighbours had hardly met when they started to argue about the parking.
items.zh: 我的兩個新鄰居才剛見面，就開始為了停車的事吵架。

items.en: The teacher had hardly begun the lesson when the fire alarm went off.
items.zh: 老師才剛開始上課，火災警報就響了。

examples.heading: ⑤ Hardly had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + when + 主詞 + realised / saw

items.en: Hardly had she opened the letter when she realised it was not for her.
items.zh: 她才剛打開信，就發現那不是給她的。

items.en: Hardly had he entered the room when he saw the broken window.
items.zh: 他才剛走進房間，就看到了破掉的窗戶。

items.en: Hardly had I left the shop when I noticed the wrong change.
items.zh: 我才剛離開那家店，就注意到找錯錢了。

items.en: Hardly had they driven away when they saw smoke behind them.
items.zh: 他們才剛開車離開，就看到後面冒煙。

items.en: Hardly had we sat down when we realised we were in the wrong cinema.
items.zh: 我們才剛坐下，就發現我們走錯了電影院。

items.en: Hardly had she put down the phone when she remembered the question she had forgotten to ask.
items.zh: 她才剛放下電話，就想起她忘了問的問題。

items.en: Hardly had the boy woken up when he smelt the pancakes.
items.zh: 那個男孩才剛醒來，就聞到了鬆餅的味道。

title: Not only did I find high-technology companies, but I also found shoemakers and plane manufacturers.
translation: 我不但找到了高科技公司，也找到了做鞋子和造飛機的廠商。
name: 過去簡單式 not only 倒裝（did）
sentences: Not only did she win the race, but she also broke the school record.
Not only did they cancel the flight, but they also refused to give us a refund.
Not only did he forget my birthday, but he also forgot our anniversary.
Not only did we enjoy the food, but we also loved the music.
Not only did the storm damage the roof, but it also knocked down two trees.
Not only did I meet the author, but I also got her autograph.
Not only did I find high-technology companies, but also shoemakers and plane manufacturers.
Not only did we visit Rome, but also Florence and Venice.
Not only did she speak to the manager, but also to the owner.
Not only did they bring flowers, but also a cake.
Not only didn't we travel 5,000 miles, as you had advertised, but we also stayed eight days in one place.
Not only didn't I learn any new grammar, but I also couldn't improve my vocabulary.
Not only didn't he apologise, but he also blamed me.
Not only didn't the guide turn up, but nobody told us why.
Not only was the hotel dirty, but it was also noisy.
Not only were the tickets expensive, but the seats were also terrible.
Not only was he late, but he also forgot the documents.
Not only was the course useful, but it was also fun.
Not only did the trip fail to match your description, but it also cost more than we had agreed.
Not only did the delivery arrive late, but several items were also missing.
Not only did the event raise money for the hospital, but it also brought the community together.
Not only did our sales increase, but we also opened two new branches.
Not only did the staff ignore my complaint, but they also lost my booking.
Not only did he pass the exam, but he got the highest mark in the class.
Not only did she cook dinner, but she even washed the dishes.
Not only did they lose the match, but two players were injured as well.
Not only did we miss the train, but we had to wait three hours for the next one.
Not only did he eat all the pizza, but he also drank my juice!
Not only did it rain all week, but the heating also broke down.
Not only did the kids clean their rooms, but they also made us breakfast.
Not only did I get lost, but my phone also ran out of battery.

examples.heading: ① Not only did + 主詞 + 原形動詞, but + 主詞 + also + 過去式

items.en: Not only did she win the race, but she also broke the school record.
items.zh: 她不但贏了比賽，還打破了學校的紀錄。

items.en: Not only did they cancel the flight, but they also refused to give us a refund.
items.zh: 他們不但取消了班機，還拒絕退錢給我們。

items.en: Not only did he forget my birthday, but he also forgot our anniversary.
items.zh: 他不但忘了我的生日，還忘了我們的紀念日。

items.en: Not only did we enjoy the food, but we also loved the music.
items.zh: 我們不但喜歡那裡的菜，也很喜歡那裡的音樂。

items.en: Not only did the storm damage the roof, but it also knocked down two trees.
items.zh: 暴風雨不但吹壞了屋頂，還吹倒了兩棵樹。

items.en: Not only did I meet the author, but I also got her autograph.
items.zh: 我不但見到了作者，還拿到了她的簽名。

examples.heading: ② but also 後面只接名詞

items.en: Not only did I find high-technology companies, but also shoemakers and plane manufacturers.
items.zh: 我不但找到了高科技公司，還找到了做鞋子和造飛機的廠商。

items.en: Not only did we visit Rome, but also Florence and Venice.
items.zh: 我們不但去了羅馬，還去了佛羅倫斯和威尼斯。

items.en: Not only did she speak to the manager, but also to the owner.
items.zh: 她不但跟經理談過，還跟老闆談過。

items.en: Not only did they bring flowers, but also a cake.
items.zh: 他們不但帶了花，還帶了一個蛋糕。

examples.heading: ③ Not only didn't + 主詞

items.en: Not only didn't we travel 5,000 miles, as you had advertised, but we also stayed eight days in one place.
items.zh: 我們不但沒有像你們廣告說的走了五千英里，還在一個地方待了八天。

items.en: Not only didn't I learn any new grammar, but I also couldn't improve my vocabulary.
items.zh: 我不但沒學到新的文法，詞彙也沒有進步。

items.en: Not only didn't he apologise, but he also blamed me.
items.zh: 他不但沒道歉，還怪我。

items.en: Not only didn't the guide turn up, but nobody told us why.
items.zh: 導遊不但沒出現，也沒有人告訴我們原因。

examples.heading: ④ Not only was / were + 主詞

items.en: Not only was the hotel dirty, but it was also noisy.
items.zh: 那家飯店不但髒，還很吵。

items.en: Not only were the tickets expensive, but the seats were also terrible.
items.zh: 票不但很貴，座位還很差。

items.en: Not only was he late, but he also forgot the documents.
items.zh: 他不但遲到，還忘了帶文件。

items.en: Not only was the course useful, but it was also fun.
items.zh: 那門課不但有用，也很有趣。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式的書信和報告

items.en: Not only did the trip fail to match your description, but it also cost more than we had agreed.
items.zh: 這趟旅行不但跟你們的描述不符，費用也比我們說好的還高。

items.en: Not only did the delivery arrive late, but several items were also missing.
items.zh: 貨不但晚到，還少了好幾樣東西。

items.en: Not only did the event raise money for the hospital, but it also brought the community together.
items.zh: 這次活動不但幫醫院募到了錢，也讓社區的人聚在一起。

items.en: Not only did our sales increase, but we also opened two new branches.
items.zh: 我們的業績不但成長了，還開了兩家新分店。

items.en: Not only did the staff ignore my complaint, but they also lost my booking.
items.zh: 員工不但不理我的投訴，還把我的訂位弄丟了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 第二件事不用 also

items.en: Not only did he pass the exam, but he got the highest mark in the class.
items.zh: 他不但考過了，還拿到全班最高分。

items.en: Not only did she cook dinner, but she even washed the dishes.
items.zh: 她不但煮了晚餐，甚至還洗了碗。

items.en: Not only did they lose the match, but two players were injured as well.
items.zh: 他們不但輸了比賽，還有兩個球員受傷。

items.en: Not only did we miss the train, but we had to wait three hours for the next one.
items.zh: 我們不但錯過了火車，還得等三個小時才有下一班。

examples.heading: ⑦ 口語和故事

items.en: Not only did he eat all the pizza, but he also drank my juice!
items.zh: 他不但把披薩吃光，還喝了我的果汁！

items.en: Not only did it rain all week, but the heating also broke down.
items.zh: 不但整個禮拜都在下雨，暖氣還壞了。

items.en: Not only did the kids clean their rooms, but they also made us breakfast.
items.zh: 孩子們不但打掃了房間，還幫我們做了早餐。

items.en: Not only did I get lost, but my phone also ran out of battery.
items.zh: 我不但迷路了，手機還沒電了。

title: I tried to phone her house, but her phone wasn't working.
translation: 我試著打電話到她家，可是她的電話壞了。
name: 過去進行式的否定句
sentences: I called her house five times, but nobody answered. Her phone wasn't working.
The lift wasn't working, so we carried the sofa up the stairs.
The heating wasn't working, so we wore our coats inside.
The traffic lights weren't working, and there was a long queue.
My computer wasn't working, so I wrote the essay by hand.
The cash machines weren't working at the station.
She wasn't feeling very well, so she went home early.
I wasn't feeling hungry, so I skipped dinner.
He wasn't feeling confident before the interview.
My grandmother wasn't feeling strong enough to walk far.
We weren't feeling tired, so we stayed up late.
I wasn't feeling brave enough to jump into the lake.
When he started playing football, he wasn't planning to become a professional player.
We weren't planning to move house until the children finished school.
I wasn't going to tell anyone, but she guessed.
They weren't planning to stay so long.
She wasn't going to come, but her friends persuaded her.
I wasn't planning to buy anything, but the shoes were on sale.
We felt so bad when we heard you weren't working at the school any more.
I was surprised when I heard they weren't living in London any more.
We were sorry to hear that your mother wasn't feeling well.
I was worried when I heard you weren't eating properly.
We were glad to hear the baby wasn't crying so much.
I was disappointed when I heard the band wasn't playing at the festival.
I wasn't paying attention, so I missed my stop.
They weren't listening, so they didn't hear the instructions.
He wasn't wearing gloves, so his fingers went white in the snow.
We weren't looking at the map, so we got lost.
She wasn't watching the road, so she nearly hit a cyclist.
I wasn't expecting a parcel, so I didn't answer the door.
The children weren't sleeping, so I read them another story.

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + wasn't / weren't working：東西壞了

items.en: I called her house five times, but nobody answered. Her phone wasn't working.
items.zh: 我打到她家五次，可是沒人接。她的電話壞了。

items.en: The lift wasn't working, so we carried the sofa up the stairs.
items.zh: 電梯壞了，所以我們把沙發搬上樓。

items.en: The heating wasn't working, so we wore our coats inside.
items.zh: 暖氣壞了，所以我們在室內穿外套。

items.en: The traffic lights weren't working, and there was a long queue.
items.zh: 紅綠燈壞了，排了很長的車。

items.en: My computer wasn't working, so I wrote the essay by hand.
items.zh: 我的電腦壞了，所以我手寫作文。

items.en: The cash machines weren't working at the station.
items.zh: 車站的提款機都壞了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + wasn't + feeling + 形容詞：當時身體不舒服

items.en: She wasn't feeling very well, so she went home early.
items.zh: 她覺得不太舒服，所以提早回家了。

items.en: I wasn't feeling hungry, so I skipped dinner.
items.zh: 我不覺得餓，所以沒吃晚餐。

items.en: He wasn't feeling confident before the interview.
items.zh: 面試前他覺得沒信心。

items.en: My grandmother wasn't feeling strong enough to walk far.
items.zh: 我奶奶覺得體力不夠，走不了很遠。

items.en: We weren't feeling tired, so we stayed up late.
items.zh: 我們不覺得累，所以熬夜到很晚。

items.en: I wasn't feeling brave enough to jump into the lake.
items.zh: 我覺得自己沒有勇氣跳進湖裡。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + wasn't / weren't + planning / going to + 原形動詞

items.en: When he started playing football, he wasn't planning to become a professional player.
items.zh: 他開始踢足球的時候，並沒有打算成為職業球員。

items.en: We weren't planning to move house until the children finished school.
items.zh: 我們本來沒打算在孩子們畢業前搬家。

items.en: I wasn't going to tell anyone, but she guessed.
items.zh: 我本來不打算告訴任何人，可是她猜到了。

items.en: They weren't planning to stay so long.
items.zh: 他們本來沒打算待那麼久。

items.en: She wasn't going to come, but her friends persuaded her.
items.zh: 她本來不打算來，可是她的朋友說服了她。

items.en: I wasn't planning to buy anything, but the shoes were on sale.
items.zh: 我本來沒打算買任何東西，可是那雙鞋在特價。

examples.heading: ④ We were sad / surprised + when + 主詞 + heard + 主詞 + weren't + -ing

items.en: We felt so bad when we heard you weren't working at the school any more.
items.zh: 我們聽說你不在學校工作了，覺得很難過。

items.en: I was surprised when I heard they weren't living in London any more.
items.zh: 我聽說他們不住在倫敦了，很驚訝。

items.en: We were sorry to hear that your mother wasn't feeling well.
items.zh: 聽說你媽媽不太舒服，我們很難過。

items.en: I was worried when I heard you weren't eating properly.
items.zh: 我聽說你沒有好好吃飯，很擔心。

items.en: We were glad to hear the baby wasn't crying so much.
items.zh: 聽說寶寶沒有那麼常哭了，我們很高興。

items.en: I was disappointed when I heard the band wasn't playing at the festival.
items.zh: 我聽說那個樂團不在節慶表演，很失望。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + wasn't / weren't + -ing, so + 句子：沒在做，所以

items.en: I wasn't paying attention, so I missed my stop.
items.zh: 我沒注意，所以錯過了我要下的那一站。

items.en: They weren't listening, so they didn't hear the instructions.
items.zh: 他們沒在聽，所以沒聽到說明。

items.en: He wasn't wearing gloves, so his fingers went white in the snow.
items.zh: 他沒戴手套，所以手指在雪地裡凍白了。

items.en: We weren't looking at the map, so we got lost.
items.zh: 我們沒看地圖，所以迷路了。

items.en: She wasn't watching the road, so she nearly hit a cyclist.
items.zh: 她沒看路，所以差點撞到一個騎腳踏車的人。

items.en: I wasn't expecting a parcel, so I didn't answer the door.
items.zh: 我沒在等包裹，所以沒去開門。

items.en: The children weren't sleeping, so I read them another story.
items.zh: 孩子們沒在睡，所以我又唸了一個故事給他們聽。

title: Laura realised that she had not been studying very hard lately.
translation: Laura 發現自己最近讀書不太認真。
name: 過去完成進行式的否定句
sentences: When Laura saw her exam results, she realised that she had not been studying very hard lately.
I noticed that my grandfather hadn't been eating much.
She realised she hadn't been listening to a word.
We noticed that the dog hadn't been sleeping well.
He realised he hadn't been paying attention to his family.
The teacher noticed that the boy hadn't been doing his homework.
Two of your workers came to fix my central heating, as it had not been working for two days.
The lift hadn't been working for a week, so we used the stairs.
The street lights hadn't been working since the storm.
My phone hadn't been charging properly for days.
The washing machine hadn't been working for a month.
The fridge hadn't been cooling properly, so the milk went bad.
I couldn't tell her about Mark, because she hadn't been doing anything but talking about him for three weeks.
He felt weak, because he hadn't been eating properly.
The plants died, because I hadn't been watering them while I was away.
She was tired, because she hadn't been sleeping well.
They lost the match, because they hadn't been training enough.
I didn't know the news, because I hadn't been reading the papers.
We hadn't been waiting long when the bus arrived.
She hadn't been working there long when she got a promotion.
They hadn't been married long when they moved abroad.
I hadn't been sleeping long when the phone rang.
He hadn't been driving long when he got lost.
We hadn't been walking long when it started to snow.
I hadn't been feeling well, so I stayed at home.
She hadn't been exercising, so she found the race very hard.
We hadn't been saving any money, so we couldn't go on holiday.
He hadn't been practising, so he played badly at the concert.
They hadn't been talking for weeks, so the dinner was very quiet.
I hadn't been checking my emails, so I missed the meeting.
The children hadn't been eating vegetables, so the doctor was worried.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + realised / noticed + 主詞 + hadn't been + -ing

items.en: When Laura saw her exam results, she realised that she had not been studying very hard lately.
items.zh: 蘿拉看到她的考試成績時，發現她最近一直沒有很用功。

items.en: I noticed that my grandfather hadn't been eating much.
items.zh: 我注意到我爺爺一直沒吃什麼東西。

items.en: She realised she hadn't been listening to a word.
items.zh: 她發現她一個字都沒在聽。

items.en: We noticed that the dog hadn't been sleeping well.
items.zh: 我們注意到狗一直睡不好。

items.en: He realised he hadn't been paying attention to his family.
items.zh: 他發現他一直沒有關心他的家人。

items.en: The teacher noticed that the boy hadn't been doing his homework.
items.zh: 老師注意到那個男孩一直沒寫功課。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + hadn't been working + for + 時間：東西壞了一段時間

items.en: Two of your workers came to fix my central heating, as it had not been working for two days.
items.zh: 你們有兩個工人來修我的中央暖氣，因為它已經兩天沒動了。

items.en: The lift hadn't been working for a week, so we used the stairs.
items.zh: 電梯已經一個星期不能用了，所以我們走樓梯。

items.en: The street lights hadn't been working since the storm.
items.zh: 暴風雨之後路燈就一直不亮。

items.en: My phone hadn't been charging properly for days.
items.zh: 我的手機好幾天來一直充不好電。

items.en: The washing machine hadn't been working for a month.
items.zh: 洗衣機已經一個月不能用了。

items.en: The fridge hadn't been cooling properly, so the milk went bad.
items.zh: 冰箱一直不太冷，所以牛奶壞了。

examples.heading: ③ because + 主詞 + hadn't been + -ing：說原因

items.en: I couldn't tell her about Mark, because she hadn't been doing anything but talking about him for three weeks.
items.zh: 我沒辦法跟她說馬克的事，因為她三個星期來什麼都不做，只是一直在談他。

items.en: He felt weak, because he hadn't been eating properly.
items.zh: 他覺得很虛弱，因為他一直沒好好吃飯。

items.en: The plants died, because I hadn't been watering them while I was away.
items.zh: 植物死了，因為我不在的時候一直沒幫它們澆水。

items.en: She was tired, because she hadn't been sleeping well.
items.zh: 她很累，因為她一直睡不好。

items.en: They lost the match, because they hadn't been training enough.
items.zh: 他們輸了比賽，因為他們一直訓練得不夠。

items.en: I didn't know the news, because I hadn't been reading the papers.
items.zh: 我不知道那個消息，因為我一直沒看報紙。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + hadn't been + -ing + long + when + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: We hadn't been waiting long when the bus arrived.
items.zh: 我們沒等多久公車就來了。

items.en: She hadn't been working there long when she got a promotion.
items.zh: 她在那裡工作沒多久就升職了。

items.en: They hadn't been married long when they moved abroad.
items.zh: 他們結婚沒多久就搬到國外了。

items.en: I hadn't been sleeping long when the phone rang.
items.zh: 我才睡沒多久電話就響了。

items.en: He hadn't been driving long when he got lost.
items.zh: 他開車沒多久就迷路了。

items.en: We hadn't been walking long when it started to snow.
items.zh: 我們才走沒多久就開始下雪了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + hadn't been + -ing, so + 句子

items.en: I hadn't been feeling well, so I stayed at home.
items.zh: 我一直覺得不舒服，所以待在家裡。

items.en: She hadn't been exercising, so she found the race very hard.
items.zh: 她一直沒運動，所以覺得那場比賽很辛苦。

items.en: We hadn't been saving any money, so we couldn't go on holiday.
items.zh: 我們一直沒存錢，所以沒辦法去度假。

items.en: He hadn't been practising, so he played badly at the concert.
items.zh: 他一直沒練習，所以在音樂會上彈得很差。

items.en: They hadn't been talking for weeks, so the dinner was very quiet.
items.zh: 他們好幾個星期沒說話了，所以晚餐很安靜。

items.en: I hadn't been checking my emails, so I missed the meeting.
items.zh: 我一直沒看電子郵件，所以錯過了會議。

items.en: The children hadn't been eating vegetables, so the doctor was worried.
items.zh: 孩子們一直沒吃蔬菜，所以醫生很擔心。

title: I hadn't heard from her for two months.
translation: 我已經兩個月沒有她的消息了。
name: 過去完成式的否定句
sentences: My best friend moved to Australia. When her letter finally came, I hadn't heard from her for two months.
I hadn't seen my cousin for ten years, so I didn't recognise him.
We hadn't spoken to each other since the argument.
She hadn't visited her hometown for a long time.
They hadn't had a holiday for three years.
He hadn't played the piano since he was a child.
The ABC Company called this morning to say that we had not delivered the goods on time.
The teacher told me that I had not answered the last question.
The bank said that I had not paid my bill.
My boss said that I had not finished the report correctly.
The hotel told us that they had not received our booking.
She admitted that she had not read the instructions.
When I arrived at the cinema, the film hadn't started yet.
When the guests came, I hadn't finished cooking yet.
When she called, I hadn't woken up yet.
When the exam ended, I hadn't answered half the questions.
When we left, the rain hadn't stopped yet.
When the teacher asked for our homework, I hadn't done it.
The cat was crying at the door because I hadn't fed her that morning.
My sister couldn't sing at the concert because she hadn't learned the words.
We got lost because we hadn't brought a map.
He was nervous because he hadn't flown before.
The tomato plants were dying because I hadn't watered them for weeks.
I couldn't answer because I hadn't heard the question.
I had never eaten sushi before I went to Japan.
She had never seen the sea before that summer.
We had never been to a concert before.
He had never driven on the left before he moved to London.
They had never met each other before the wedding.
I had never felt so cold before.
The children had never ridden a horse before the trip.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + hadn't + heard from / seen + 人 + for + 時間

items.en: My best friend moved to Australia. When her letter finally came, I hadn't heard from her for two months.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友搬去澳洲了。她的信終於來的時候，我已經兩個月沒有她的消息了。

items.en: I hadn't seen my cousin for ten years, so I didn't recognise him.
items.zh: 我已經十年沒見到我表哥了，所以沒認出他。

items.en: We hadn't spoken to each other since the argument.
items.zh: 那次吵架之後我們一直沒跟對方說話。

items.en: She hadn't visited her hometown for a long time.
items.zh: 她很久沒有回她的家鄉了。

items.en: They hadn't had a holiday for three years.
items.zh: 他們已經三年沒度假了。

items.en: He hadn't played the piano since he was a child.
items.zh: 他從小時候就沒再彈過鋼琴。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + said / told + 人 + that + 主詞 + had not + 過去分詞

items.en: The ABC Company called this morning to say that we had not delivered the goods on time.
items.zh: ABC 公司今天早上打電話來，說我們沒有準時交貨。

items.en: The teacher told me that I had not answered the last question.
items.zh: 老師告訴我，我沒有回答最後一題。

items.en: The bank said that I had not paid my bill.
items.zh: 銀行說我沒有付帳單。

items.en: My boss said that I had not finished the report correctly.
items.zh: 我老闆說我的報告沒有正確地完成。

items.en: The hotel told us that they had not received our booking.
items.zh: 飯店告訴我們，他們沒有收到我們的預約。

items.en: She admitted that she had not read the instructions.
items.zh: 她承認她沒有讀說明。

examples.heading: ③ When + 主詞 + 過去式, + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞 + yet

items.en: When I arrived at the cinema, the film hadn't started yet.
items.zh: 我到電影院的時候，電影還沒開始。

items.en: When the guests came, I hadn't finished cooking yet.
items.zh: 客人來的時候，我還沒煮完。

items.en: When she called, I hadn't woken up yet.
items.zh: 她打來的時候，我還沒醒。

items.en: When the exam ended, I hadn't answered half the questions.
items.zh: 考試結束的時候，我有一半的題目還沒答。

items.en: When we left, the rain hadn't stopped yet.
items.zh: 我們離開的時候，雨還沒停。

items.en: When the teacher asked for our homework, I hadn't done it.
items.zh: 老師要我們交功課的時候，我還沒寫。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + 過去式 + because + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞

items.en: The cat was crying at the door because I hadn't fed her that morning.
items.zh: 貓在門口叫，因為那天早上我沒餵她。

items.en: My sister couldn't sing at the concert because she hadn't learned the words.
items.zh: 我妹妹沒辦法在音樂會上唱歌，因為她沒背歌詞。

items.en: We got lost because we hadn't brought a map.
items.zh: 我們迷路了，因為我們沒帶地圖。

items.en: He was nervous because he hadn't flown before.
items.zh: 他很緊張，因為他以前沒坐過飛機。

items.en: The tomato plants were dying because I hadn't watered them for weeks.
items.zh: 番茄苗快死了，因為我好幾個星期沒幫它們澆水。

items.en: I couldn't answer because I hadn't heard the question.
items.zh: 我沒辦法回答，因為我沒聽到問題。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + had never + 過去分詞 + before：以前從來沒有

items.en: I had never eaten sushi before I went to Japan.
items.zh: 我去日本之前從來沒吃過壽司。

items.en: She had never seen the sea before that summer.
items.zh: 那年夏天之前，她從來沒看過海。

items.en: We had never been to a concert before.
items.zh: 我們以前從來沒去過演唱會。

items.en: He had never driven on the left before he moved to London.
items.zh: 他搬到倫敦之前從來沒有靠左開車過。

items.en: They had never met each other before the wedding.
items.zh: 他們在婚禮之前從來沒見過面。

items.en: I had never felt so cold before.
items.zh: 我以前從來沒有這麼冷過。

items.en: The children had never ridden a horse before the trip.
items.zh: 那次旅行之前，孩子們從來沒騎過馬。

title: I was surprised because the heating didn't work.
translation: 你沒有遵守你的承諾。
name: 過去簡單式的否定句（常用動詞）
sentences: The hotel room was lovely, but I was surprised because the heating didn't work.
The lift didn't work, so we walked up five floors.
I couldn't call you last weekend. My phone didn't work in the mountains.
The shower didn't work, so I had a cold bath.
The cash machine didn't work, so I couldn't pay.
We threw it away last year. The old radio didn't work any more.
You promised to call me last night. You did not keep your promise.
Everyone was there except me. You didn't tell me about the party.
I waited for you all evening. You didn't answer my message.
The kitchen is still a mess. You didn't do the washing-up after dinner.
You said you would bring the drinks, but you didn't bring a single bottle.
I need it for my exam. You didn't bring back my book.
I didn't tell you that my house is opposite the new cinema.
Please set another place at the table. I didn't tell you that my sister is coming too.
Sorry, you're an hour early. I didn't tell you that the party starts at seven.
Don't be scared, he's friendly. I didn't tell you that I have a dog.
Let's go somewhere else. I didn't tell you that the restaurant is closed on Mondays.
That's why you couldn't call me. I didn't tell you that I changed my phone number.
The player from China did not look very happy after the match.
The new shoes didn't cost much at the market.
The walk was a bit boring. We didn't see any animals in the forest.
My grandfather didn't enjoy the long flight to Sydney.
Is Lily ill? She didn't come to school yesterday.
My cousins stayed at home. They didn't have enough money for the tickets.
I didn't sleep well, so I was tired all day.
We didn't have a map, so we asked a policeman.
My sister's exam was hard. She didn't know the last answer, so she guessed.
The baby didn't nap after lunch, so she was grumpy all evening.
My parents' room was very noisy. They didn't like the hotel, so they moved to another one.
I didn't hear my alarm, so I missed the bus.
We didn't bring umbrellas, so we got wet.

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + didn't work：東西壞了

items.en: The hotel room was lovely, but I was surprised because the heating didn't work.
items.zh: 旅館的房間很漂亮，可是我很驚訝，因為暖氣壞了。

items.en: The lift didn't work, so we walked up five floors.
items.zh: 電梯壞了，所以我們走了五層樓。

items.en: I couldn't call you last weekend. My phone didn't work in the mountains.
items.zh: 上週末我沒辦法打給你。我的手機在山上收不到訊號。

items.en: The shower didn't work, so I had a cold bath.
items.zh: 蓮蓬頭壞了，所以我洗了一個冷水澡。

items.en: The cash machine didn't work, so I couldn't pay.
items.zh: 提款機壞了，所以我沒辦法付錢。

items.en: We threw it away last year. The old radio didn't work any more.
items.zh: 我們去年把它丟了。那台舊收音機已經不能用了。

examples.heading: ② You didn't + 原形動詞：對方沒做到

items.en: You promised to call me last night. You did not keep your promise.
items.zh: 你答應昨天晚上打給我。你沒有遵守你的承諾。

items.en: Everyone was there except me. You didn't tell me about the party.
items.zh: 大家都去了，只有我沒去。你沒告訴我派對的事。

items.en: I waited for you all evening. You didn't answer my message.
items.zh: 我等了你一整個晚上。你沒回我的訊息。

items.en: The kitchen is still a mess. You didn't do the washing-up after dinner.
items.zh: 廚房還是一團亂。你晚餐後沒洗碗。

items.en: You said you would bring the drinks, but you didn't bring a single bottle.
items.zh: 你說你會帶飲料，可是你一瓶都沒帶。

items.en: I need it for my exam. You didn't bring back my book.
items.zh: 我考試要用。你沒把我的書還來。

examples.heading: ③ I didn't tell you + that + 子句：補充沒說的事

items.en: I didn't tell you that my house is opposite the new cinema.
items.zh: 我沒告訴你我家在新電影院的對面。

items.en: Please set another place at the table. I didn't tell you that my sister is coming too.
items.zh: 請在桌上多擺一副餐具。我沒告訴你我姊姊也會來。

items.en: Sorry, you're an hour early. I didn't tell you that the party starts at seven.
items.zh: 抱歉，你早到了一個小時。我沒告訴你派對七點開始。

items.en: Don't be scared, he's friendly. I didn't tell you that I have a dog.
items.zh: 別怕，牠很友善。我沒告訴你我有一隻狗。

items.en: Let's go somewhere else. I didn't tell you that the restaurant is closed on Mondays.
items.zh: 我們去別的地方吧。我沒告訴你那家餐廳星期一不開。

items.en: That's why you couldn't call me. I didn't tell you that I changed my phone number.
items.zh: 所以你才打不通。我沒告訴你我換了電話號碼。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + didn't + 原形動詞：說事情的經過

items.en: The player from China did not look very happy after the match.
items.zh: 那個中國選手比賽後看起來不太高興。

items.en: The new shoes didn't cost much at the market.
items.zh: 那雙新鞋在市場上不貴。

items.en: The walk was a bit boring. We didn't see any animals in the forest.
items.zh: 那次健行有點無聊。我們在森林裡沒看到任何動物。

items.en: My grandfather didn't enjoy the long flight to Sydney.
items.zh: 我爺爺不喜歡飛去雪梨的那趟長途飛行。

items.en: Is Lily ill? She didn't come to school yesterday.
items.zh: 莉莉生病了嗎？她昨天沒來上學。

items.en: My cousins stayed at home. They didn't have enough money for the tickets.
items.zh: 我的表弟妹待在家裡。他們的錢不夠買票。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + didn't + 原形動詞, so + 句子

items.en: I didn't sleep well, so I was tired all day.
items.zh: 我沒睡好，所以一整天都很累。

items.en: We didn't have a map, so we asked a policeman.
items.zh: 我們沒有地圖，所以問了一個警察。

items.en: My sister's exam was hard. She didn't know the last answer, so she guessed.
items.zh: 我姊姊的考試很難。她不知道最後一題的答案，所以她用猜的。

items.en: The baby didn't nap after lunch, so she was grumpy all evening.
items.zh: 寶寶午餐後沒睡午覺，所以她整個傍晚都很煩躁。

items.en: My parents' room was very noisy. They didn't like the hotel, so they moved to another one.
items.zh: 我爸媽的房間很吵。他們不喜歡那家飯店，所以換到另一家。

items.en: I didn't hear my alarm, so I missed the bus.
items.zh: 我沒聽到鬧鐘，所以錯過了公車。

items.en: We didn't bring umbrellas, so we got wet.
items.zh: 我們沒帶傘，所以淋濕了。

title: I didn't realise I had lost the ring till I was at home.
translation: 我一直到回家才發現戒指掉了。
name: 過去簡單式的否定句（較多種動詞）
sentences: I wore my grandmother's ring at the beach. I didn't realise I had lost it till I was at home.
She didn't realise it was so late until she looked at her phone.
We didn't realise the shop was closed until we got there.
He didn't realise he was on the wrong train until it left the station.
I didn't realise how tired I was until I sat down.
They didn't realise the film was in French until it started.
He said he was a policeman, but he had no card. I didn't trust him.
My grandmother didn't trust banks, so she kept her money at home.
My friends didn't believe his story about the ghost in the attic.
My new neighbour was very loud. I didn't like him at first, but now we're friends.
The children didn't believe that the old man was a famous painter.
She didn't trust the old ladder, so she used a chair.
We needed a second television, and we had one in the garage that we did not use.
My wardrobe was too full. I gave away the clothes that I didn't wear any more.
We had no space in our new flat. We sold the books that we didn't need.
She found an old bike in the shed that her brother didn't ride any more.
My parents cleaned the attic. They threw away the toys that the children didn't play with.
We went camping in Wales. I borrowed a tent that my uncle didn't need that summer.
We only invited ten friends. I didn't expect so many people at the party.
We studied all weekend. We didn't expect the test to be so easy.
My sister was very surprised at work. She didn't expect a present from her boss.
My brother started running in March. He didn't expect to win the race.
My parents only packed summer clothes. They didn't expect such cold weather in May.
I didn't expect to see my old teacher on the plane.
I didn't go to the concert because I had a cold.
She didn't answer the phone because she was in the shower.
We didn't buy the house because it was too far from the city.
He didn't finish his dinner because he wasn't hungry.
They didn't go swimming because the water was too cold.
I got home at midnight. I didn't call you because it was very late.
The plants didn't grow because there wasn't enough sun.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + didn't realise + 子句 + till / until + 子句

items.en: I wore my grandmother's ring at the beach. I didn't realise I had lost it till I was at home.
items.zh: 我在海邊戴著我奶奶的戒指。我一直到回家才發現它掉了。

items.en: She didn't realise it was so late until she looked at her phone.
items.zh: 她一直到看了手機才發現已經那麼晚了。

items.en: We didn't realise the shop was closed until we got there.
items.zh: 我們一直到了那裡才發現那家店關了。

items.en: He didn't realise he was on the wrong train until it left the station.
items.zh: 他一直到火車開出車站才發現他搭錯車了。

items.en: I didn't realise how tired I was until I sat down.
items.zh: 我一直到坐下來才發現我有多累。

items.en: They didn't realise the film was in French until it started.
items.zh: 他們一直到電影開始才發現它是法文的。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + didn't + trust / believe / like + 人

items.en: He said he was a policeman, but he had no card. I didn't trust him.
items.zh: 他說他是警察，可是他沒有證件。我不相信他。

items.en: My grandmother didn't trust banks, so she kept her money at home.
items.zh: 我奶奶不信任銀行，所以把錢放在家裡。

items.en: My friends didn't believe his story about the ghost in the attic.
items.zh: 我的朋友們不相信他那個閣樓鬼故事。

items.en: My new neighbour was very loud. I didn't like him at first, but now we're friends.
items.zh: 我的新鄰居很吵。我一開始不喜歡他，不過現在我們是朋友了。

items.en: The children didn't believe that the old man was a famous painter.
items.zh: 孩子們不相信那個老人是一位有名的畫家。

items.en: She didn't trust the old ladder, so she used a chair.
items.zh: 她不信任那把舊梯子，所以用了一張椅子。

examples.heading: ③ … that we didn't use / need：關係子句裡的否定

items.en: We needed a second television, and we had one in the garage that we did not use.
items.zh: 我們需要第二台電視，剛好車庫裡有一台我們沒在用的。

items.en: My wardrobe was too full. I gave away the clothes that I didn't wear any more.
items.zh: 我的衣櫃太滿了。我把我不再穿的衣服送人了。

items.en: We had no space in our new flat. We sold the books that we didn't need.
items.zh: 我們的新公寓沒有空間。我們把不需要的書賣掉了。

items.en: She found an old bike in the shed that her brother didn't ride any more.
items.zh: 她在棚子裡找到一台她哥哥不再騎的舊腳踏車。

items.en: My parents cleaned the attic. They threw away the toys that the children didn't play with.
items.zh: 我爸媽整理了閣樓。他們把孩子們不玩的玩具丟掉了。

items.en: We went camping in Wales. I borrowed a tent that my uncle didn't need that summer.
items.zh: 我們去威爾斯露營。我借了一頂我叔叔那年夏天不需要的帳篷。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + didn't expect + 名詞 / to + 原形動詞

items.en: We only invited ten friends. I didn't expect so many people at the party.
items.zh: 我們只邀了十個朋友。我沒想到派對上會有這麼多人。

items.en: We studied all weekend. We didn't expect the test to be so easy.
items.zh: 我們整個週末都在念書。我們沒想到考試會這麼簡單。

items.en: My sister was very surprised at work. She didn't expect a present from her boss.
items.zh: 我姊姊在公司很驚訝。她沒想到老闆會送她禮物。

items.en: My brother started running in March. He didn't expect to win the race.
items.zh: 我哥哥三月才開始跑步。他沒想到會贏得比賽。

items.en: My parents only packed summer clothes. They didn't expect such cold weather in May.
items.zh: 我爸媽只帶了夏天的衣服。他們沒想到五月會這麼冷。

items.en: I didn't expect to see my old teacher on the plane.
items.zh: 我沒想到會在飛機上看到我以前的老師。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + didn't + 原形動詞 + because + 子句

items.en: I didn't go to the concert because I had a cold.
items.zh: 我沒去聽演唱會，因為我感冒了。

items.en: She didn't answer the phone because she was in the shower.
items.zh: 她沒接電話，因為她在洗澡。

items.en: We didn't buy the house because it was too far from the city.
items.zh: 我們沒買那間房子，因為它離城市太遠了。

items.en: He didn't finish his dinner because he wasn't hungry.
items.zh: 他沒吃完晚餐，因為他不餓。

items.en: They didn't go swimming because the water was too cold.
items.zh: 他們沒去游泳，因為水太冷了。

items.en: I got home at midnight. I didn't call you because it was very late.
items.zh: 我半夜才到家。我沒打給你，因為已經很晚了。

items.en: The plants didn't grow because there wasn't enough sun.
items.zh: 植物沒長大，因為陽光不夠。

title: I didn't hesitate and went there straight away.
translation: 我毫不猶豫，馬上就去了那裡。
name: 過去簡單式的否定句（多種動詞）
sentences: I didn't realise how late it was.
The plan didn't work, so we tried something else.
She didn't answer my last three messages.
They didn't notice the mistake until the next day.
We didn't expect such a large crowd.
I didn't sleep at all on the plane.
He didn't tell anyone about the accident.
We didn't win a single game last season.
My brother didn't take the job in the end.
You didn't eat much at dinner.
The children didn't understand the joke.
Things didn't turn out the way we planned.
The meeting didn't go on for long.
She didn't give up after the first rejection.
The car didn't slow down at the crossing.
I'm sure it wasn't my fault.
The hotel wasn't as spacious as the photos suggested.
We weren't ready when the taxi arrived.
My parents weren't at home that weekend.
The company did not respond to our complaint.
The witness did not see the driver's face.
I did not receive the refund you promised.
The council did not approve the plans for the new car park.
She didn't wait for an answer and left the room.
We didn't take a taxi and walked home instead.
He didn't argue and signed the contract.
He didn't call or write for months.
I didn't eat or drink anything all day.
They didn't give us any information.
She didn't say anything about the new job.
The doctor didn't find anything wrong with my heart.

examples.heading: ① 規則動詞：didn't + 原形動詞

items.en: I didn't realise how late it was.
items.zh: 我沒發現已經這麼晚了。

items.en: The plan didn't work, so we tried something else.
items.zh: 計畫沒成功，所以我們試了別的方法。

items.en: She didn't answer my last three messages.
items.zh: 她沒回我最後三則訊息。

items.en: They didn't notice the mistake until the next day.
items.zh: 他們直到隔天才發現錯誤。

items.en: We didn't expect such a large crowd.
items.zh: 我們沒想到會有這麼多人。

examples.heading: ② 不規則動詞：didn't + 原形動詞

items.en: I didn't sleep at all on the plane.
items.zh: 我在飛機上完全沒睡。

items.en: He didn't tell anyone about the accident.
items.zh: 他沒跟任何人說那場意外的事。

items.en: We didn't win a single game last season.
items.zh: 我們上一季一場比賽都沒贏。

items.en: My brother didn't take the job in the end.
items.zh: 我哥最後沒接那份工作。

items.en: You didn't eat much at dinner.
items.zh: 你晚餐沒吃什麼。

items.en: The children didn't understand the joke.
items.zh: 孩子們沒聽懂那個笑話。

examples.heading: ③ 片語動詞：didn't + 原形動詞 + 小品詞

items.en: Things didn't turn out the way we planned.
items.zh: 事情的結果跟我們計畫的不一樣。

items.en: The meeting didn't go on for long.
items.zh: 會議沒開很久。

items.en: She didn't give up after the first rejection.
items.zh: 她第一次被拒絕之後沒有放棄。

items.en: The car didn't slow down at the crossing.
items.zh: 那輛車在路口沒有減速。

examples.heading: ④ wasn't / weren't

items.en: I'm sure it wasn't my fault.
items.zh: 我確定那不是我的錯。

items.en: The hotel wasn't as spacious as the photos suggested.
items.zh: 飯店沒有照片看起來那麼寬敞。

items.en: We weren't ready when the taxi arrived.
items.zh: 計程車到的時候我們還沒準備好。

items.en: My parents weren't at home that weekend.
items.zh: 那個週末我爸媽不在家。

examples.heading: ⑤ 完整形式 did not

items.en: The company did not respond to our complaint.
items.zh: 公司沒有回應我們的投訴。

items.en: The witness did not see the driver's face.
items.zh: 證人沒有看到司機的臉。

items.en: I did not receive the refund you promised.
items.zh: 我沒有收到你們答應的退款。

items.en: The council did not approve the plans for the new car park.
items.zh: 市議會沒有核准新停車場的計畫。

examples.heading: ⑥ didn't + 原形動詞 + and + 過去式

items.en: She didn't wait for an answer and left the room.
items.zh: 她沒等回答就離開了房間。

items.en: We didn't take a taxi and walked home instead.
items.zh: 我們沒搭計程車，改走路回家。

items.en: He didn't argue and signed the contract.
items.zh: 他沒有爭辯，就簽了合約。

examples.heading: ⑦ didn't + 原形動詞 + or + 原形動詞

items.en: He didn't call or write for months.
items.zh: 他好幾個月沒打電話，也沒寫信。

items.en: I didn't eat or drink anything all day.
items.zh: 我一整天沒吃也沒喝。

examples.heading: ⑧ didn't + any / anybody / anything

items.en: They didn't give us any information.
items.zh: 他們沒給我們任何資訊。

items.en: She didn't say anything about the new job.
items.zh: 她完全沒提新工作的事。

items.en: The doctor didn't find anything wrong with my heart.
items.zh: 醫生沒發現我的心臟有什麼問題。

title: I hope you haven't been working too hard!
translation: 希望你最近工作沒有太累！
name: 現在完成進行式的否定句
sentences: My neighbours have a new dog. I haven't been sleeping well.
We're saving for a house. We haven't been going out much.
You're looking at your phone again. You haven't been listening to a word I've said.
My two brothers had a fight at Christmas. They haven't been talking to each other since then.
The doctor says I need more vitamins. I haven't been eating enough vegetables.
I'm worried about home. My parents haven't been getting on well recently.
I'll stay at home tonight. I haven't been feeling very well this week.
I'm worried about Grandma. She hasn't been answering her phone.
I'm taking it to the garage. My car hasn't been running well since the winter.
The teacher called Leo's parents. He hasn't been coming to class.
We have to take the stairs. The lift hasn't been working for a week.
The farmers are worried. It hasn't been raining much this summer.
We're taking her to the vet. Our cat hasn't been eating properly.
Dear Sir, I am writing about our new office. The air conditioning has not been working since June.
Thank you for meeting me. I hope that I have not been wasting your time.
The report shows some problems. The company has not been paying its suppliers on time.
Dear Manager, residents have not been receiving their post regularly.
Dear Councillor, there is rubbish everywhere. The council has not been cleaning the streets.
Sorry the train was so late. I hope you haven't been waiting long.
Thanks for babysitting tonight. I hope the kids haven't been giving you any trouble.
I didn't call Mum all week. I hope she hasn't been worrying about me.
You've been very quiet in class. I hope you haven't been feeling ill.
I'm so tired. The baby hasn't been sleeping at night.
I've put on weight because I haven't been going to the gym.
The plants are dying because I haven't been watering them.
He's going to fail the test because he hasn't been studying.
My English is getting worse. I haven't been practising.
Your cough is getting worse. Haven't you been taking your medicine?
The landlord called about your flatmate. Hasn't he been paying the rent?
The teacher sent me a note about the twins. Haven't they been doing their homework?
I've written to you three times. Why haven't you been answering my emails?

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + haven't been + 動詞-ing

items.en: My neighbours have a new dog. I haven't been sleeping well.
items.zh: 我的鄰居養了一隻新的狗。我最近都睡不好。

items.en: We're saving for a house. We haven't been going out much.
items.zh: 我們在存錢買房子。我們最近不太出門。

items.en: You're looking at your phone again. You haven't been listening to a word I've said.
items.zh: 你又在看手機了。我說的話你一個字都沒在聽。

items.en: My two brothers had a fight at Christmas. They haven't been talking to each other since then.
items.zh: 我兩個哥哥聖誕節打了一架。他們從那時候起就一直沒跟對方說話。

items.en: The doctor says I need more vitamins. I haven't been eating enough vegetables.
items.zh: 醫生說我需要更多維他命。我最近青菜吃得不夠。

items.en: I'm worried about home. My parents haven't been getting on well recently.
items.zh: 我很擔心家裡。我爸媽最近處得不太好。

items.en: I'll stay at home tonight. I haven't been feeling very well this week.
items.zh: 我今晚要待在家。我這個禮拜一直不太舒服。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + hasn't been + 動詞-ing

items.en: I'm worried about Grandma. She hasn't been answering her phone.
items.zh: 我很擔心奶奶。她一直沒接電話。

items.en: I'm taking it to the garage. My car hasn't been running well since the winter.
items.zh: 我要把它送去修車廠。我的車從冬天以後就一直跑得不太順。

items.en: The teacher called Leo's parents. He hasn't been coming to class.
items.zh: 老師打電話給李歐的爸媽。他一直沒來上課。

items.en: We have to take the stairs. The lift hasn't been working for a week.
items.zh: 我們得走樓梯。電梯壞了一個禮拜了。

items.en: The farmers are worried. It hasn't been raining much this summer.
items.zh: 農夫們很擔心。今年夏天沒怎麼下雨。

items.en: We're taking her to the vet. Our cat hasn't been eating properly.
items.zh: 我們要帶她去看獸醫。我們家的貓最近都吃得不好。

examples.heading: ③ 正式的完整形式：have not / has not been + 動詞-ing

items.en: Dear Sir, I am writing about our new office. The air conditioning has not been working since June.
items.zh: 敬啟者，我寫信是關於我們的新辦公室。空調從六月起就一直沒有運作。

items.en: Thank you for meeting me. I hope that I have not been wasting your time.
items.zh: 謝謝您跟我見面。希望我沒有浪費您的時間。

items.en: The report shows some problems. The company has not been paying its suppliers on time.
items.zh: 報告顯示了一些問題。這家公司一直沒有準時付款給供應商。

items.en: Dear Manager, residents have not been receiving their post regularly.
items.zh: 經理您好，住戶一直沒有按時收到郵件。

items.en: Dear Councillor, there is rubbish everywhere. The council has not been cleaning the streets.
items.zh: 議員您好，到處都是垃圾。議會一直沒有清掃街道。

examples.heading: ④ hope + 否定句

items.en: Sorry the train was so late. I hope you haven't been waiting long.
items.zh: 抱歉火車誤點那麼久。希望你沒有等很久。

items.en: Thanks for babysitting tonight. I hope the kids haven't been giving you any trouble.
items.zh: 謝謝你今晚幫忙帶小孩。希望孩子們沒給你添麻煩。

items.en: I didn't call Mum all week. I hope she hasn't been worrying about me.
items.zh: 我整個禮拜都沒打給媽媽。希望她沒有一直在擔心我。

items.en: You've been very quiet in class. I hope you haven't been feeling ill.
items.zh: 你上課的時候一直很安靜。希望你沒有不舒服。

examples.heading: ⑤ 解釋原因

items.en: I'm so tired. The baby hasn't been sleeping at night.
items.zh: 我好累，寶寶晚上一直不睡。

items.en: I've put on weight because I haven't been going to the gym.
items.zh: 我變胖了，因為我一直沒去健身房。

items.en: The plants are dying because I haven't been watering them.
items.zh: 植物快死了，因為我一直沒澆水。

items.en: He's going to fail the test because he hasn't been studying.
items.zh: 他考試會不及格，因為他一直沒在念書。

items.en: My English is getting worse. I haven't been practising.
items.zh: 我的英文越來越差了，我一直沒在練習。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問句：Haven't / Hasn't + 主詞 + been + 動詞-ing?

items.en: Your cough is getting worse. Haven't you been taking your medicine?
items.zh: 你咳得越來越嚴重了。你一直沒吃藥嗎？

items.en: The landlord called about your flatmate. Hasn't he been paying the rent?
items.zh: 房東打電話來說你室友的事。他一直沒付房租嗎？

items.en: The teacher sent me a note about the twins. Haven't they been doing their homework?
items.zh: 老師寫了張紙條給我說雙胞胎的事。他們一直沒寫功課嗎？

items.en: I've written to you three times. Why haven't you been answering my emails?
items.zh: 我寫信給你三次了。你為什麼一直沒回我的電子郵件？

title: I haven't seen you for a long time.
translation: 我很久沒見到你了。
name: 現在完成式的否定句（I haven't）
sentences: It has a thousand pieces. I haven't finished the jigsaw puzzle you gave me.

Bring him to lunch on Sunday. I haven't met your new boyfriend.

Sorry I missed the meeting. I haven't been well this week.

examples.heading: ① I haven't + 過去分詞

items.zh: 我哥哥三月搬去澳洲。我沒有聽到他的任何消息。

items.zh: 你看完可以借我嗎？今天的報紙我還沒看。

examples.heading: ② I haven't + 過去分詞 + for + 一段時間

items.en: Let's go there on Friday. I haven't eaten at that Greek restaurant for a long time.
items.zh: 我們星期五去那裡吧。我很久沒去那家希臘餐廳吃飯了。
