items.en: We had a big argument at my birthday party. I haven't spoken to my cousin for months.
items.zh: 我們在我的生日派對上大吵一架。我好幾個月沒跟我表哥講話了。

items.en: I really need a break. I haven't had a holiday for two years.
items.zh: 我真的需要休息。我兩年沒放假了。

items.en: Let's go and see a film tonight. I haven't been to the cinema for ages.
items.zh: 我們今晚去看電影吧。我好久沒去看電影了。

items.en: My new neighbours are very noisy. I haven't slept well for a week.
items.zh: 我的新鄰居很吵。我一個禮拜都沒睡好。

examples.heading: ③ I haven't + 過去分詞 + yet

items.en: Please don't say anything at dinner. I haven't told my parents about the new job yet.
items.zh: 晚餐的時候請什麼都別說。新工作的事我還沒跟爸媽說。

items.en: The heating is still broken. I haven't heard back from the landlord yet.
items.zh: 暖氣還是壞的。我還沒收到房東的回音。

items.en: I'm saving it for my birthday. I haven't opened your present yet.
items.zh: 我要留到生日那天。你送的禮物我還沒拆。

items.en: My boss wrote to me this morning. I haven't answered her email yet.
items.zh: 我老闆今天早上寫信給我。她的電子郵件我還沒回。

items.en: I'm going away next week. I haven't found anyone to look after the cat yet.
items.zh: 我下禮拜要出門。我還沒找到人幫我照顧貓。

examples.heading: ④ I haven't + 過去分詞 + since + 起點

items.en: My uncle lives in Canada now. I haven't seen him since Christmas.
items.zh: 我叔叔現在住在加拿大。我從聖誕節以後就沒見過他。

items.en: I'm a bit nervous about the bike tour. I haven't ridden a bike since I was a child.
items.zh: 我對單車之旅有點緊張。我從小時候以後就沒騎過腳踏車。

items.en: Can we stop for lunch? I haven't eaten anything since breakfast.
items.zh: 我們可以停下來吃午餐嗎？我從早餐以後就沒吃東西了。

items.en: Do you want to borrow my camera? I haven't used it since our trip to Spain.
items.zh: 你要借我的相機嗎？我從我們去西班牙玩以後就沒用過它。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式的完整形式：I have not

items.en: Dear Sir, you sent the papers last month. I have not received the documents.
items.zh: 敬啟者，貴公司上個月寄出文件。我還沒收到這些文件。

items.en: Dear Ms Lee, please send the bill to my home. I have not changed my address.
items.zh: 李女士您好，請把帳單寄到我家。我沒有改地址。

items.en: Dear Mr Jones, I have some questions about the flat. I have not signed the contract yet.
items.zh: 瓊斯先生您好，我對那間公寓有些問題。合約我還沒簽。

items.en: Dear Madam, I wrote to you three weeks ago. I have not had any reply from your office.
items.zh: 敬啟者，我三週前寫信給您。我還沒收到你們辦公室的任何回覆。

examples.heading: ⑥ 道歉和解釋

items.en: Hi Sarah, sorry I haven't been in touch for so long.
items.zh: 嗨，莎拉，抱歉我這麼久沒跟你聯絡。

items.en: I'm sorry, Mum. I haven't done the washing-up.
items.zh: 媽，抱歉，碗我還沒洗。

items.en: Work has been crazy this month. I haven't had time to call you.
items.zh: 這個月工作忙翻了。我一直沒時間打電話給你。

items.en: Sorry I missed the meeting. I haven't been well this week.
items.zh: 抱歉我沒去開會。我這個禮拜身體不太好。

title: We haven't decided where to go yet.
translation: 我們還沒決定要去哪裡。
name: 現在完成式的否定句
sentences: My friend gave me a novel for my birthday. I haven't started the book yet.
Are you feeling ill? You haven't touched your soup.
My aunt's family lives far away. We haven't seen our cousins since Christmas.
My friends had a baby girl last week. They haven't chosen a name for her.
I really need a holiday. I haven't had a day off for weeks.
The prices go up every day. We haven't booked the flights yet.
My daughter feels lonely. She hasn't made many friends at her new school.
Give Grandpa's old jacket away. He hasn't worn it for years.
Look at my phone screen. It hasn't worked properly since you dropped it.
My mum takes the bus to work now. She hasn't driven since her accident.
Dad got up late this morning. He hasn't shaved today.
We miss them a lot. My parents haven't visited us this year.
Business is slow at the moment. The company hasn't hired anyone new.
We took the exam two weeks ago. Our teacher hasn't marked our tests yet.
It's time for bed, but the children haven't brushed their teeth.
I'm waiting for a call about the job. My phone hasn't rung all morning.
We always order the same dishes. The restaurant hasn't changed its menu in years.
This physics book is too hard for me. I haven't understood a word of the first chapter.
Don't look so sad. We haven't forgotten your birthday.
My friend said she would pay me back in May. She hasn't kept her promise.
It's been too dry. My grandparents haven't grown any vegetables this year.
My husband works every weekend. He hasn't spent much time with his family recently.
All your old toys are in the attic. I haven't thrown anything away.
I'm a bit nervous about the trip. I've never ridden a motorbike.
I'm teaching her to send emails. My grandmother has never used a computer.
My husband and I are excited about Japan. We've never travelled abroad together.
Don't play chess with my uncle. He has never lost a game.
My car was stolen last month. The police have not found it.
Visitors must wait until spring. The museum has not opened its new wing.
My dad had his operation this morning. We have not heard anything from the hospital.

examples.heading: ① 主詞是代名詞：I / you / we / they + haven't

items.en: My friend gave me a novel for my birthday. I haven't started the book yet.
items.zh: 朋友送我一本小說當生日禮物。那本書我還沒開始看。

items.en: Are you feeling ill? You haven't touched your soup.
items.zh: 你不舒服嗎？你的湯一口都沒動。

items.en: My aunt's family lives far away. We haven't seen our cousins since Christmas.
items.zh: 我阿姨一家住得很遠。我們從聖誕節以後就沒見過表兄弟姊妹。

items.en: My friends had a baby girl last week. They haven't chosen a name for her.
items.zh: 我朋友上禮拜生了一個女兒。他們還沒幫她取名字。

items.en: I really need a holiday. I haven't had a day off for weeks.
items.zh: 我真的需要放假。我好幾個禮拜沒休假了。

items.en: The prices go up every day. We haven't booked the flights yet.
items.zh: 價格每天都在漲。我們還沒訂機票。

examples.heading: ② 主詞是代名詞：he / she / it + hasn't

items.en: My daughter feels lonely. She hasn't made many friends at her new school.
items.zh: 我女兒覺得很孤單。她在新學校沒交到幾個朋友。

items.en: Give Grandpa's old jacket away. He hasn't worn it for years.
items.zh: 把爺爺那件舊外套送人吧。他好幾年沒穿了。

items.en: Look at my phone screen. It hasn't worked properly since you dropped it.
items.zh: 你看我的手機螢幕。你摔過以後，它就沒正常過。

items.en: My mum takes the bus to work now. She hasn't driven since her accident.
items.zh: 我媽媽現在搭公車上班。她出車禍以後就沒開過車。

items.en: Dad got up late this morning. He hasn't shaved today.
items.zh: 爸爸今天早上起晚了。他今天沒刮鬍子。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞是名詞

items.en: We miss them a lot. My parents haven't visited us this year.
items.zh: 我們很想他們。我爸媽今年還沒來看過我們。

items.en: Business is slow at the moment. The company hasn't hired anyone new.
items.zh: 最近生意很差。公司沒有僱用新人。

items.en: We took the exam two weeks ago. Our teacher hasn't marked our tests yet.
items.zh: 我們兩個禮拜前考試。老師還沒改我們的考卷。

items.en: It's time for bed, but the children haven't brushed their teeth.
items.zh: 該睡覺了，可是孩子們還沒刷牙。

items.en: I'm waiting for a call about the job. My phone hasn't rung all morning.
items.zh: 我在等工作的電話。我的手機一整個早上都沒響。

items.en: We always order the same dishes. The restaurant hasn't changed its menu in years.
items.zh: 我們每次都點一樣的菜。那家餐廳好幾年沒換菜單了。

examples.heading: ④ 更多的動詞

items.en: This physics book is too hard for me. I haven't understood a word of the first chapter.
items.zh: 這本物理書對我來說太難了。第一章我一個字都沒看懂。

items.en: Don't look so sad. We haven't forgotten your birthday.
items.zh: 別那麼難過。我們沒忘記你的生日。

items.en: My friend said she would pay me back in May. She hasn't kept her promise.
items.zh: 我朋友說她五月會還我錢。她沒有遵守承諾。

items.en: It's been too dry. My grandparents haven't grown any vegetables this year.
items.zh: 天氣太乾了。我爺爺奶奶今年沒種菜。

items.en: My husband works every weekend. He hasn't spent much time with his family recently.
items.zh: 我先生每個週末都在工作。他最近沒花多少時間陪家人。

items.en: All your old toys are in the attic. I haven't thrown anything away.
items.zh: 你所有的舊玩具都在閣樓。我什麼都沒丟。

examples.heading: ⑤ never

items.en: I'm a bit nervous about the trip. I've never ridden a motorbike.
items.zh: 這趟旅行我有點緊張。我從來沒騎過機車。

items.en: I'm teaching her to send emails. My grandmother has never used a computer.
items.zh: 我在教她寄電子郵件。我奶奶從來沒用過電腦。

items.en: My husband and I are excited about Japan. We've never travelled abroad together.
items.zh: 我和我先生很期待去日本。我們從來沒一起出國過。

items.en: Don't play chess with my uncle. He has never lost a game.
items.zh: 不要跟我叔叔下西洋棋。他從來沒輸過。

examples.heading: ⑥ 完整形式：have not / has not

items.en: My car was stolen last month. The police have not found it.
items.zh: 我的車上個月被偷了。警察還沒找到。

items.en: Visitors must wait until spring. The museum has not opened its new wing.
items.zh: 參觀的人得等到春天。博物館的新展區還沒開放。

items.en: My dad had his operation this morning. We have not heard anything from the hospital.
items.zh: 我爸爸今天早上動手術。我們還沒收到醫院的任何消息。

title: You have not fulfilled your task with due care.
translation: 你沒有謹慎地完成你的任務。
name: 現在完成式的完整否定形式（正式）
sentences: We have not received your application form.
You have not followed the safety rules.
I have not seen any changes to the contract.
They have not replied to our letter of 4 May.
You have not completed the required training.
We have not been able to contact you by phone.
I have not changed my opinion on this matter.
The company has not paid its workers for two months.
The report has not given any reasons for the delay.
The building has not passed the fire inspection.
The library has not bought any new books since 2019.
The minister has not commented on the news.
The hotel has not refunded my deposit.
My landlord has not repaired the heating.
The council has not yet approved the plan.
We have not yet received your payment.
The judges have not yet announced the winner.
The police have not yet found the driver.
The parcel has not arrived yet.
I have not decided yet.
The new law has not reduced crime.
Sales have not grown as much as we expected.
The trains have not run on time this month.
The two sides have not agreed on a price.
The museum has not allowed photos since the fire.
The bank has not approved your loan.
The bank hasn't approved my loan.
The managers have not explained their decision.
My boss hasn't explained why.
Our records show that you have not attended the last three meetings.

examples.heading: ① 正式信件：主詞 + have not + 過去分詞

items.en: We have not received your application form.
items.zh: 我們沒有收到你的申請表。

items.en: You have not followed the safety rules.
items.zh: 你沒有遵守安全規定。

items.en: I have not seen any changes to the contract.
items.zh: 我沒有看到合約有任何修改。

items.en: They have not replied to our letter of 4 May.
items.zh: 他們沒有回覆我們五月四日的信。

items.en: You have not completed the required training.
items.zh: 你沒有完成規定的訓練。

items.en: We have not been able to contact you by phone.
items.zh: 我們沒辦法用電話聯絡上你。

items.en: I have not changed my opinion on this matter.
items.zh: 我對這件事的看法沒有改變。

examples.heading: ② 第三人稱單數：主詞 + has not + 過去分詞

items.en: The company has not paid its workers for two months.
items.zh: 這家公司兩個月沒有付員工薪水了。

items.en: The report has not given any reasons for the delay.
items.zh: 報告沒有說明延誤的原因。

items.en: The building has not passed the fire inspection.
items.zh: 這棟大樓沒有通過消防檢查。

items.en: The library has not bought any new books since 2019.
items.zh: 圖書館從二〇一九年起就沒有買新書。

items.en: The minister has not commented on the news.
items.zh: 部長沒有對這則新聞發表評論。

items.en: The hotel has not refunded my deposit.
items.zh: 飯店沒有退還我的訂金。

items.en: My landlord has not repaired the heating.
items.zh: 我的房東沒有修暖氣。

examples.heading: ③ not yet：應該做、還沒做的事

items.en: The council has not yet approved the plan.
items.zh: 議會還沒有批准這個計畫。

items.en: We have not yet received your payment.
items.zh: 我們還沒有收到你的付款。

items.en: The judges have not yet announced the winner.
items.zh: 評審還沒有公布得獎者。

items.en: The police have not yet found the driver.
items.zh: 警方還沒有找到那名駕駛。

items.en: The parcel has not arrived yet.
items.zh: 包裹還沒有送到。

items.en: I have not decided yet.
items.zh: 我還沒有決定。

examples.heading: ④ 報告和公告

items.en: The new law has not reduced crime.
items.zh: 新的法律沒有讓犯罪減少。

items.en: Sales have not grown as much as we expected.
items.zh: 銷售量沒有我們預期的那麼多。

items.en: The trains have not run on time this month.
items.zh: 這個月的火車都沒有準時。

items.en: The two sides have not agreed on a price.
items.zh: 雙方還沒有談定價格。

items.en: The museum has not allowed photos since the fire.
items.zh: 博物館從那場火災後就不准拍照。

examples.heading: ⑤ 完整形式和縮寫

items.en: The bank has not approved your loan.
items.zh: 銀行沒有核准你的貸款。

items.en: The bank hasn't approved my loan.
items.zh: 銀行沒核准我的貸款。

items.en: The managers have not explained their decision.
items.zh: 經理們沒有解釋他們的決定。

items.en: My boss hasn't explained why.
items.zh: 我老闆沒解釋為什麼。

items.en: Our records show that you have not attended the last three meetings.
items.zh: 我們的紀錄顯示你沒有出席最近三次會議。

title: Haven't you seen it yet?
translation: 你還沒看過嗎？
name: 現在完成式的否定疑問句
sentences: You're still at your desk at ten o'clock. Haven't you finished your homework?
Everyone is bringing food on Saturday. Haven't they told you about the party?
Wait, this bill is for the hotel. Haven't we paid for this already?
The school is closed tomorrow. Haven't you heard the news?
The film starts in five minutes. Haven't your friends arrived?
Take your shoes off at the door. Haven't I told you a hundred times?
You called Mia this morning. Hasn't she called you back?
You're still coughing a lot. Hasn't the doctor given you any medicine?
I saw a wedding photo on your wall. Hasn't your brother got married?
It's been sunny all week. Hasn't the snow on the roof melted by now?
You ordered the shoes two weeks ago. Hasn't the package arrived?
Your teacher wrote to you on Monday. Haven't you replied to his email yet?
The kitchen is still full of water. Hasn't the plumber come yet?
The shop closes in ten minutes. Haven't the kids decided which ice cream they want yet?
You lent Jack fifty pounds in May. Hasn't he paid you back yet?
Haven't you packed yet? The taxi's here!
I sent you five texts today. Why haven't you answered my messages?
We've waited for half an hour. Why hasn't the bus come?
The meeting started at nine. Why hasn't anyone told me about it?
The office is freezing again. Why haven't they fixed the heating?
Excuse me, you look familiar. Haven't I seen you somewhere before?
My grandma bought bread here when I was little. Hasn't this shop been here for years?
You speak French very well. Haven't you lived in Canada?
I remember that painting on the wall. Haven't we been to this restaurant before?
Everyone at work loves the coffee there. Have you not tried the new café?
The report was due on Friday. Has Emma not finished it?
We wrote to the council a month ago. Have they not received our letter?
This is my friend Sam. Haven't you met him? — No, I haven't.
Lucy's bag isn't here. Hasn't she left? — Yes, she has. She left an hour ago.
I can't find any clean plates. Haven't you done the dishes? — Yes, I have. They're in the cupboard.

examples.heading: ① Haven't + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: You're still at your desk at ten o'clock. Haven't you finished your homework?
items.zh: 都十點了，你還在書桌前。你功課還沒寫完嗎？

items.en: Everyone is bringing food on Saturday. Haven't they told you about the party?
items.zh: 星期六大家都要帶吃的來。他們沒跟你說派對的事嗎？

items.en: Wait, this bill is for the hotel. Haven't we paid for this already?
items.zh: 等一下，這是飯店的帳單。這個我們不是已經付過錢了嗎？

items.en: The school is closed tomorrow. Haven't you heard the news?
items.zh: 學校明天停課。你還沒聽說那個消息嗎？

items.en: The film starts in five minutes. Haven't your friends arrived?
items.zh: 電影再五分鐘就開始了。你朋友還沒到嗎？

items.en: Take your shoes off at the door. Haven't I told you a hundred times?
items.zh: 在門口把鞋子脫掉。我不是跟你說過一百遍了嗎？

examples.heading: ② Hasn't + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: You called Mia this morning. Hasn't she called you back?
items.zh: 你早上打給米亞。她還沒回你電話嗎？

items.en: You're still coughing a lot. Hasn't the doctor given you any medicine?
items.zh: 你還咳得很厲害。醫生沒開藥給你嗎？

items.en: I saw a wedding photo on your wall. Hasn't your brother got married?
items.zh: 我看到你牆上有一張婚紗照。你哥不是已經結婚了嗎？

items.en: It's been sunny all week. Hasn't the snow on the roof melted by now?
items.zh: 這個禮拜都是晴天。屋頂上的雪到現在還沒融化嗎？

items.en: You ordered the shoes two weeks ago. Hasn't the package arrived?
items.zh: 你兩個禮拜前就訂了鞋子。包裹還沒到嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 加 yet：以為早該發生了

items.en: Your teacher wrote to you on Monday. Haven't you replied to his email yet?
items.zh: 你的老師星期一寫信給你。你還沒回他的信嗎？

items.en: The kitchen is still full of water. Hasn't the plumber come yet?
items.zh: 廚房還是滿地的水。水電工還沒來嗎？

items.en: The shop closes in ten minutes. Haven't the kids decided which ice cream they want yet?
items.zh: 店再十分鐘就關了。孩子們還沒決定要哪一種冰淇淋嗎？

items.en: You lent Jack fifty pounds in May. Hasn't he paid you back yet?
items.zh: 你五月借傑克五十英鎊。他還沒還你錢嗎？

items.en: Haven't you packed yet? The taxi's here!
items.zh: 你還沒收好行李嗎？計程車到了！

examples.heading: ④ 疑問詞 + haven't / hasn't

items.en: I sent you five texts today. Why haven't you answered my messages?
items.zh: 我今天傳了五則簡訊給你。你為什麼都不回我訊息？

items.en: We've waited for half an hour. Why hasn't the bus come?
items.zh: 我們等了半小時了。公車為什麼還沒來？

items.en: The meeting started at nine. Why hasn't anyone told me about it?
items.zh: 會議九點就開始了。為什麼都沒有人告訴我？

items.en: The office is freezing again. Why haven't they fixed the heating?
items.zh: 辦公室又冷得要命。他們為什麼還沒修好暖氣？

examples.heading: ⑤ 想確認自己的想法

items.en: Excuse me, you look familiar. Haven't I seen you somewhere before?
items.zh: 不好意思，你看起來很面熟。我是不是在哪裡見過你？

items.en: My grandma bought bread here when I was little. Hasn't this shop been here for years?
items.zh: 我小時候奶奶在這裡買麵包。這家店不是開好幾年了嗎？

items.en: You speak French very well. Haven't you lived in Canada?
items.zh: 你的法文說得很好。你不是在加拿大住過嗎？

items.en: I remember that painting on the wall. Haven't we been to this restaurant before?
items.zh: 我記得牆上那幅畫。我們以前是不是來過這家餐廳？

examples.heading: ⑥ 完整形式：Have / Has + 主詞 + not

items.en: Everyone at work loves the coffee there. Have you not tried the new café?
items.zh: 公司的人都很愛那裡的咖啡。你還沒去過那家新咖啡店嗎？

items.en: The report was due on Friday. Has Emma not finished it?
items.zh: 報告星期五就該交了。艾瑪還沒寫完嗎？

items.en: We wrote to the council a month ago. Have they not received our letter?
items.zh: 我們一個月前寫信給市議會。他們沒收到我們的信嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 回答

items.en: This is my friend Sam. Haven't you met him? — No, I haven't.
items.zh: 這是我朋友山姆。你沒見過他嗎？對，沒見過。

items.en: Lucy's bag isn't here. Hasn't she left? — Yes, she has. She left an hour ago.
items.zh: 露西的包包不在這裡。她不是走了嗎？對，她走了，一個小時前走的。

items.en: I can't find any clean plates. Haven't you done the dishes? — Yes, I have. They're in the cupboard.
items.zh: 我找不到乾淨的盤子。你還沒洗碗嗎？洗了，都在櫥櫃裡。

title: Everything was strange. Why was I following a green fox?
translation: 你那時候在做什麼？
name: 過去進行式的疑問句
sentences: I had a very strange dream last night. Everything was strange. Why was I following a green fox?
Why were you laughing in the library?
Why was the baby crying all night?
Why were they shouting in the street?
Why was your brother sitting outside in the rain?
Why were all those people waiting outside the shop?
The police asked me, "What were you doing at nine o'clock last night?"
The vase was broken when I got home. What were you two doing in the living room?
What were you doing in the kitchen at midnight?
What were you doing when I called you this morning?
What were the children doing while you were cooking?
What was your dad doing in the garden all afternoon?
I couldn't see anybody. Then there he was, my favourite singer, saying a name. But was he calling me?
Your voice sounded strange. Were you lying in bed when I rang?
Was it raining when you left the house?
Were they playing in the garden all day?
Was she wearing a red coat?
Were you listening when the teacher explained it?
My mother was in hospital and I was very scared. Was she going to die?
Were you going to tell me about the party?
Was he going to leave without saying goodbye?
Were your neighbours really going to cut down that old oak tree?
Was it going to rain all weekend?
Were we going to miss the last train?
You were carrying a big suitcase yesterday. Where were you taking it?
You were laughing for ages. Who were you chatting with online?
Where was she living when you met her?
Who was sitting next to you on the plane?
Where were they staying during the festival?
Who was singing so loudly in the shower?
Where were you hiding during the game?

examples.heading: ① Why was / were + 主詞 + -ing？：問原因

items.en: I had a very strange dream last night. Everything was strange. Why was I following a green fox?
items.zh: 我昨晚做了一個很奇怪的夢。一切都很奇怪。我為什麼在跟著一隻綠色的狐狸？

items.en: Why were you laughing in the library?
items.zh: 你為什麼在圖書館裡笑？

items.en: Why was the baby crying all night?
items.zh: 寶寶為什麼哭了一整晚？

items.en: Why were they shouting in the street?
items.zh: 他們為什麼在街上大叫？

items.en: Why was your brother sitting outside in the rain?
items.zh: 你哥哥為什麼坐在外面淋雨？

items.en: Why were all those people waiting outside the shop?
items.zh: 那些人為什麼在店外面等？

examples.heading: ② What were you doing + 時間？：問對方當時在做什麼

items.en: The police asked me, "What were you doing at nine o'clock last night?"
items.zh: 警察問我：你昨天晚上九點在做什麼？

items.en: The vase was broken when I got home. What were you two doing in the living room?
items.zh: 我回家的時候花瓶破了。你們兩個在客廳做什麼？

items.en: What were you doing in the kitchen at midnight?
items.zh: 你半夜在廚房做什麼？

items.en: What were you doing when I called you this morning?
items.zh: 我今天早上打給你的時候你在做什麼？

items.en: What were the children doing while you were cooking?
items.zh: 你在煮飯的時候孩子們在做什麼？

items.en: What was your dad doing in the garden all afternoon?
items.zh: 你爸爸整個下午在花園裡做什麼？

examples.heading: ③ Was / Were + 主詞 + -ing？：問是不是在做

items.en: I couldn't see anybody. Then there he was, my favourite singer, saying a name. But was he calling me?
items.zh: 我什麼人都看不到。然後他出現了，我最喜歡的歌手，喊著一個名字。可是他是在叫我嗎？

items.en: Your voice sounded strange. Were you lying in bed when I rang?
items.zh: 你的聲音聽起來怪怪的。我打電話的時候你躺在床上嗎？

items.en: Was it raining when you left the house?
items.zh: 你出門的時候在下雨嗎？

items.en: Were they playing in the garden all day?
items.zh: 他們整天都在花園裡玩嗎？

items.en: Was she wearing a red coat?
items.zh: 她穿著一件紅色的外套嗎？

items.en: Were you listening when the teacher explained it?
items.zh: 老師解釋的時候你有在聽嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Was / Were + 主詞 + going to + 原形動詞？：問當時的害怕或計畫

items.en: My mother was in hospital and I was very scared. Was she going to die?
items.zh: 我媽媽住院了，我很害怕。她會死嗎？

items.en: Were you going to tell me about the party?
items.zh: 你本來有打算告訴我派對的事嗎？

items.en: Was he going to leave without saying goodbye?
items.zh: 他本來打算不說再見就走嗎？

items.en: Were your neighbours really going to cut down that old oak tree?
items.zh: 你的鄰居真的打算砍掉那棵老橡樹嗎？

items.en: Was it going to rain all weekend?
items.zh: 整個週末都會下雨嗎？

items.en: Were we going to miss the last train?
items.zh: 我們會錯過最後一班火車嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Where / Who + was / were + 主詞 + -ing？

items.en: You were carrying a big suitcase yesterday. Where were you taking it?
items.zh: 你昨天提著一個大行李箱。你要把它帶去哪裡？

items.en: You were laughing for ages. Who were you chatting with online?
items.zh: 你笑了好久。你在網路上跟誰聊天？

items.en: Where was she living when you met her?
items.zh: 你認識她的時候她住在哪裡？

items.en: Who was sitting next to you on the plane?
items.zh: 飛機上誰坐在你旁邊？

items.en: Where were they staying during the festival?
items.zh: 節慶期間他們住在哪裡？

items.en: Who was singing so loudly in the shower?
items.zh: 誰在浴室裡唱歌唱得那麼大聲？

items.en: Where were you hiding during the game?
items.zh: 玩遊戲的時候你躲在哪裡？

title: What had he been doing that morning?
translation: 那天早上他一直在做什麼？
name: 過去完成進行式疑問句
sentences: The old man was found in his study at noon. The detective asked, "What had he been doing that morning?"
What had the children been doing before the fire started?
What had you been doing all day when I called?
What had the driver been doing just before the accident?
What had the students been doing while the teacher was out?
What had she been doing in the garden for so long?
She was still at the station at midnight. So why had she been waiting for such a long time?
The neighbours complained in the morning. Why had our parrot been screaming since dawn?
Why had he been hiding the letters in his desk?
Why had they been arguing before the party?
Why had you been crying when I found you?
Why had the shop been losing money for years?
Your face was blue with cold. How long had you been standing outside the station?
How long had they been living in Spain before they came back?
How long had she been working there when she left?
How long had it been raining when you left the house?
How long had the patient been feeling ill?
How long had the two of them been seeing each other?
Had you been drinking before you drove home?
Had she been sleeping well before the exam?
Had they been living there long?
Had it been snowing all night?
Had he been taking his medicine every day?
Had you been expecting the news?
Where had he been staying before he moved here?
Who had she been talking to on the phone all evening?
Where had the cat been hiding for three days?
Who had they been working for before the company closed?
Where had you been going every Saturday morning?
Who had been sending her flowers every week?
Where had the money been coming from all those years?

examples.heading: ① What had + 主詞 + been doing？：問之前在做什麼

items.en: The old man was found in his study at noon. The detective asked, "What had he been doing that morning?"
items.zh: 那個老人中午在書房被發現。偵探問：那天早上他一直在做什麼？（被動）

items.en: What had the children been doing before the fire started?
items.zh: 火災開始之前，孩子們一直在做什麼？

items.en: What had you been doing all day when I called?
items.zh: 我打給你的時候，你那一整天都在做什麼？

items.en: What had the driver been doing just before the accident?
items.zh: 意外發生前，司機一直在做什麼？

items.en: What had the students been doing while the teacher was out?
items.zh: 老師不在的時候，學生們一直在做什麼？

items.en: What had she been doing in the garden for so long?
items.zh: 她在花園裡待了那麼久，一直在做什麼？

examples.heading: ② Why had + 主詞 + been + -ing？：問原因

items.en: She was still at the station at midnight. So why had she been waiting for such a long time?
items.zh: 她半夜還在車站。那她為什麼等了那麼久？

items.en: The neighbours complained in the morning. Why had our parrot been screaming since dawn?
items.zh: 鄰居早上來抱怨。我們的鸚鵡為什麼從天亮就一直在尖叫？

items.en: Why had he been hiding the letters in his desk?
items.zh: 他為什麼一直把那些信藏在書桌裡？

items.en: Why had they been arguing before the party?
items.zh: 派對前他們為什麼一直在吵架？

items.en: Why had you been crying when I found you?
items.zh: 我找到你的時候，你為什麼一直在哭？

items.en: Why had the shop been losing money for years?
items.zh: 那家店為什麼好幾年來一直在虧錢？

examples.heading: ③ How long had + 主詞 + been + -ing？：問持續多久

items.en: Your face was blue with cold. How long had you been standing outside the station?
items.zh: 你的臉凍得發青。你在車站外面站了多久？

items.en: How long had they been living in Spain before they came back?
items.zh: 他們回來之前在西班牙住了多久？

items.en: How long had she been working there when she left?
items.zh: 她離開的時候，在那裡工作了多久？

items.en: How long had it been raining when you left the house?
items.zh: 你出門的時候，雨已經下了多久？

items.en: How long had the patient been feeling ill?
items.zh: 病人不舒服多久了？

items.en: How long had the two of them been seeing each other?
items.zh: 他們兩個交往了多久？

examples.heading: ④ Had + 主詞 + been + -ing？：問是不是一直在做

items.en: Had you been drinking before you drove home?
items.zh: 你開車回家之前有喝酒嗎？

items.en: Had she been sleeping well before the exam?
items.zh: 考試前她一直睡得好嗎？

items.en: Had they been living there long?
items.zh: 他們在那裡住很久了嗎？

items.en: Had it been snowing all night?
items.zh: 整晚都在下雪嗎？

items.en: Had he been taking his medicine every day?
items.zh: 他有每天吃藥嗎？

items.en: Had you been expecting the news?
items.zh: 你一直在等這個消息嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Where / Who + had + 主詞 + been + -ing？

items.en: Where had he been staying before he moved here?
items.zh: 他搬來這裡之前一直住在哪裡？

items.en: Who had she been talking to on the phone all evening?
items.zh: 她整個傍晚在電話上一直跟誰說話？

items.en: Where had the cat been hiding for three days?
items.zh: 那隻貓這三天一直躲在哪裡？

items.en: Who had they been working for before the company closed?
items.zh: 公司倒閉前他們一直在幫誰工作？

items.en: Where had you been going every Saturday morning?
items.zh: 你每個星期六早上都去哪裡？

items.en: Who had been sending her flowers every week?
items.zh: 是誰每個星期都送花給她？

items.en: Where had the money been coming from all those years?
items.zh: 那些年來錢一直是從哪裡來的？

title: Had I made the same mistake twice?
translation: 我是不是同樣的錯犯了兩次？
name: 過去完成式的疑問句
sentences: My second restaurant was empty after three months. Had I made the same mistake twice?
I looked at the empty platform. Had I missed the last train?
I couldn't find my passport. Had I left it at the hotel?
The door was open. Had I forgotten to lock it?
Nobody laughed at my joke. Had I said something wrong?
She didn't answer. Had I upset her?
My brother had sold his beloved guitar. The question was: why had he done that?
Why had she left the party without saying goodbye?
Why had the letter arrived so late?
Why had the gardener cut down the roses that my mother loved?
Why had the old man moved to such a lonely place?
Why had they closed the road?
Had you ever been to Spain before that holiday?
Had you spoken to your new boss before your first day at work?
Had they visited the museum before?
Had she ever driven on the left before?
Had you tried Thai food before you went to Bangkok?
Had he played in a big match before the final?
What had happened to the money in the box?
Where had she hidden the presents?
How had the dog got out of the garden?
What had the children found in the old wooden box?
Where had they been all night?
How had she learned to speak Russian so well?
Had the film already started when you arrived?
Had they already eaten when you got there?
When you reached the bakery at six, had they already sold all the bread?
When the plumber rang the bell, had your sister already gone to the office?
When your friends called, had you already written your history essay?
When your mum got to the airport, had your flight from Rome already arrived?
Had he already heard the news?

examples.heading: ① Had I + 過去分詞？：問自己

items.en: My second restaurant was empty after three months. Had I made the same mistake twice?
items.zh: 我的第二家餐廳三個月後還是沒客人。我是不是犯了同樣的錯兩次？

items.en: I looked at the empty platform. Had I missed the last train?
items.zh: 我看著空蕩蕩的月台。我錯過最後一班火車了嗎？

items.en: I couldn't find my passport. Had I left it at the hotel?
items.zh: 我找不到我的護照。我把它留在飯店了嗎？

items.en: The door was open. Had I forgotten to lock it?
items.zh: 門開著。我忘了鎖門嗎？

items.en: Nobody laughed at my joke. Had I said something wrong?
items.zh: 沒有人因為我的笑話笑。我說錯什麼了嗎？

items.en: She didn't answer. Had I upset her?
items.zh: 她沒回答。我惹她生氣了嗎？

examples.heading: ② Why had + 主詞 + 過去分詞？：故事裡的疑問

items.en: My brother had sold his beloved guitar. The question was: why had he done that?
items.zh: 我哥哥賣掉了他心愛的吉他。問題是：他為什麼那樣做？

items.en: Why had she left the party without saying goodbye?
items.zh: 她為什麼沒道別就離開派對了？

items.en: Why had the letter arrived so late?
items.zh: 那封信為什麼那麼晚才到？

items.en: Why had the gardener cut down the roses that my mother loved?
items.zh: 園丁為什麼砍掉了我媽媽很喜歡的那些玫瑰？

items.en: Why had the old man moved to such a lonely place?
items.zh: 那個老人為什麼搬到那麼偏僻的地方？

items.en: Why had they closed the road?
items.zh: 他們為什麼封路了？

examples.heading: ③ Had you + 過去分詞 + before？：問以前的經驗

items.en: Had you ever been to Spain before that holiday?
items.zh: 那次假期之前你去過西班牙嗎？

items.en: Had you spoken to your new boss before your first day at work?
items.zh: 上班第一天之前，你跟你的新老闆說過話嗎？

items.en: Had they visited the museum before?
items.zh: 他們以前去過那間博物館嗎？

items.en: Had she ever driven on the left before?
items.zh: 她以前有靠左開過車嗎？

items.en: Had you tried Thai food before you went to Bangkok?
items.zh: 你去曼谷之前吃過泰國菜嗎？

items.en: Had he played in a big match before the final?
items.zh: 決賽之前他打過大比賽嗎？

examples.heading: ④ What / Where / How + had + 主詞 + 過去分詞？

items.en: What had happened to the money in the box?
items.zh: 箱子裡的錢怎麼了？

items.en: Where had she hidden the presents?
items.zh: 她把禮物藏在哪裡了？

items.en: How had the dog got out of the garden?
items.zh: 那隻狗是怎麼跑出花園的？

items.en: What had the children found in the old wooden box?
items.zh: 孩子們在那個舊木箱裡發現了什麼？

items.en: Where had they been all night?
items.zh: 他們整晚去了哪裡？

items.en: How had she learned to speak Russian so well?
items.zh: 她是怎麼把俄文學得這麼好的？

examples.heading: ⑤ Had + 主詞 + already + 過去分詞？：問是不是已經

items.en: Had the film already started when you arrived?
items.zh: 你到的時候電影已經開始了嗎？

items.en: Had they already eaten when you got there?
items.zh: 你到那裡的時候他們已經吃過了嗎？

items.en: When you reached the bakery at six, had they already sold all the bread?
items.zh: 你六點到麵包店的時候，他們已經把麵包都賣完了嗎？

items.en: When the plumber rang the bell, had your sister already gone to the office?
items.zh: 水管工人按門鈴的時候，你姊姊已經去辦公室了嗎？

items.en: When your friends called, had you already written your history essay?
items.zh: 你朋友打來的時候，你已經寫完歷史作文了嗎？

items.en: When your mum got to the airport, had your flight from Rome already arrived?
items.zh: 你媽媽到機場的時候，你從羅馬來的班機已經到了嗎？

items.en: Had he already heard the news?
items.zh: 他那時已經聽到消息了嗎？

title: You lost your phone? Did you find it?
translation: 你昨天有買東西嗎？
name: 過去簡單式以 you 當主詞的疑問句
sentences: You lost your phone at school last week? Did you find it?
Your bag looks full. Did you buy something at the market yesterday?
Thanks for coming to my birthday. Did you enjoy the party on Saturday?
You went out with Ben last night. Did you see the new film at the cinema?
You're playing games now. Did you finish your homework before dinner?
She was wearing a green dress. Did you meet my cousin at the wedding?
You look great in that coat. When did you go shopping last?
I need shoes for the party. Where did you buy those lovely shoes?
Your garden is beautiful. When did you plant all those roses?
You have a great suntan. Where did you go on holiday last summer?
You know all the shops here. When did you move to this town?
That cake is amazing. Where did you find the recipe?
You came home with a big box. What did you buy at the shopping centre?
We looked for you at eleven. Why did you leave the party so early?
Good morning, everyone. What did you do at the weekend?
You live very far away. Why did you choose this school?
I saw you at the concert hall. What did you think of the concert?
I saw a missed call on my phone. Why did you call me at midnight?
You still have a cough. "Did you take your medicine this morning?" "Yes, I did."
We're on the motorway now. "Did you lock the front door?" "No, I didn't. Sorry."
It was Grandma's birthday yesterday. "Did you call her?" "Yes, I did. She's fine."
Good morning! "Did you sleep well?" "No, I didn't. The bed was hard."
The cat is crying in the kitchen. "Did you feed her?" "Yes, I did, twice."
You're smiling. "Did you pass the driving test?" "Yes, I did!"
The traffic was terrible today. How did you get to the airport so quickly?
You ran ten kilometres. How did you feel after the race?
Thank you for the cake! How did you know it was my birthday?
Can I have some more? How did you make this delicious soup?
You two are always together. How did you first become friends at school?
My laptop works again. How did you fix the computer?
You're back from Rome. How did you find the hotel? Was it nice?

examples.heading: ① Did you + 原形動詞 + 名詞？：問對方的事

items.en: You lost your phone at school last week? Did you find it?
items.zh: 你上星期在學校弄丟了手機？你找到了嗎？

items.en: Your bag looks full. Did you buy something at the market yesterday?
items.zh: 你的袋子看起來好滿。你昨天在市場有買東西嗎？

items.en: Thanks for coming to my birthday. Did you enjoy the party on Saturday?
items.zh: 謝謝你來我的生日。你喜歡星期六的派對嗎？

items.en: You went out with Ben last night. Did you see the new film at the cinema?
items.zh: 你昨晚跟班出去。你看了電影院的那部新電影嗎？

items.en: You're playing games now. Did you finish your homework before dinner?
items.zh: 你現在在玩遊戲。你晚餐前寫完功課了嗎？

items.en: She was wearing a green dress. Did you meet my cousin at the wedding?
items.zh: 她穿著一件綠色洋裝。你在婚禮上遇到我表姊了嗎？

examples.heading: ② When / Where + did you + 原形動詞？

items.en: You look great in that coat. When did you go shopping last?
items.zh: 你穿那件外套很好看。你上次去買東西是什麼時候？

items.en: I need shoes for the party. Where did you buy those lovely shoes?
items.zh: 我需要一雙去派對穿的鞋。你在哪裡買那雙漂亮的鞋？

items.en: Your garden is beautiful. When did you plant all those roses?
items.zh: 你的花園好美。你什麼時候種了那些玫瑰？

items.en: You have a great suntan. Where did you go on holiday last summer?
items.zh: 你曬得好漂亮。你去年夏天去哪裡度假？

items.en: You know all the shops here. When did you move to this town?
items.zh: 這裡的店你都知道。你什麼時候搬到這個鎮的？

items.en: That cake is amazing. Where did you find the recipe?
items.zh: 那個蛋糕太棒了。你在哪裡找到食譜的？

examples.heading: ③ What / Why + did you + 原形動詞？

items.en: You came home with a big box. What did you buy at the shopping centre?
items.zh: 你帶著一個大箱子回家。你在購物中心買了什麼？

items.en: We looked for you at eleven. Why did you leave the party so early?
items.zh: 我們十一點的時候找你。你為什麼那麼早離開派對？

items.en: Good morning, everyone. What did you do at the weekend?
items.zh: 大家早。你週末做了什麼？

items.en: You live very far away. Why did you choose this school?
items.zh: 你住得很遠。你為什麼選這所學校？

items.en: I saw you at the concert hall. What did you think of the concert?
items.zh: 我在音樂廳看到你。你覺得那場音樂會怎麼樣？

items.en: I saw a missed call on my phone. Why did you call me at midnight?
items.zh: 我看到手機有一通未接來電。你為什麼半夜打給我？

examples.heading: ④ Did you + 原形動詞？："Yes, I did." / "No, I didn't."

items.en: You still have a cough. "Did you take your medicine this morning?" "Yes, I did."
items.zh: 你還在咳嗽。你今天早上有吃藥嗎？有，我吃了。

items.en: We're on the motorway now. "Did you lock the front door?" "No, I didn't. Sorry."
items.zh: 我們已經上高速公路了。你有鎖前門嗎？沒有。抱歉。

items.en: It was Grandma's birthday yesterday. "Did you call her?" "Yes, I did. She's fine."
items.zh: 昨天是奶奶的生日。你有打給她嗎？有，她很好。

items.en: Good morning! "Did you sleep well?" "No, I didn't. The bed was hard."
items.zh: 早安！你睡得好嗎？不好。床很硬。

items.en: The cat is crying in the kitchen. "Did you feed her?" "Yes, I did, twice."
items.zh: 貓在廚房叫。你有餵她嗎？有，餵了兩次。

items.en: You're smiling. "Did you pass the driving test?" "Yes, I did!"
items.zh: 你在笑。你駕照考過了嗎？過了！

examples.heading: ⑤ How + did you + 原形動詞？：問方法和感覺

items.en: The traffic was terrible today. How did you get to the airport so quickly?
items.zh: 今天交通很糟。你怎麼那麼快就到機場了？

items.en: You ran ten kilometres. How did you feel after the race?
items.zh: 你跑了十公里。跑完比賽你覺得怎麼樣？

items.en: Thank you for the cake! How did you know it was my birthday?
items.zh: 謝謝你的蛋糕！你怎麼知道今天是我生日？

items.en: Can I have some more? How did you make this delicious soup?
items.zh: 我可以再來一點嗎？你怎麼做出這麼好喝的湯？

items.en: You two are always together. How did you first become friends at school?
items.zh: 你們兩個總是在一起。你們在學校是怎麼變成朋友的？

items.en: My laptop works again. How did you fix the computer?
items.zh: 我的筆電又能用了。你是怎麼修好電腦的？

items.en: You're back from Rome. How did you find the hotel? Was it nice?
items.zh: 你從羅馬回來了。你覺得那家飯店怎麼樣？好嗎？

title: Why didn't he call me?
translation: 他為什麼沒打給我？

items.zh: 你有收到我的生日卡嗎？

items.en: Did they win the match?
items.zh: 他們比賽贏了嗎？

items.en: Did you find your keys?
items.zh: 你找到鑰匙了嗎？

examples.heading: ② 疑問詞問句：疑問詞 + did + 主詞

items.zh: 你假期是怎麼過的？

items.zh: 你午餐吃了什麼？

items.en: Who did you see at the party?
items.zh: 你在派對上看到了誰？

items.zh: 你爸媽有因為窗戶的事生氣嗎？

items.zh: 我們約好下禮拜二見面，對吧？

items.zh: 你昨天見過他，對吧？

items.en: She didn't come to class, did she?
items.zh: 她沒來上課吧？

items.en: It was a great day, wasn't it?
items.zh: 那天很棒，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定問句：Didn't / Wasn't + 主詞

items.en: Didn't you spend last summer with them too?
items.zh: 你去年夏天不是也跟他們一起過嗎？

items.en: Didn't you go to Lisbon last year?
items.zh: 你去年不是去了里斯本嗎？

items.en: Didn't she tell you?
items.zh: 她沒跟你說嗎？

items.en: Wasn't he at the meeting?
items.zh: 他沒去開會嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ Why didn't + 主詞

items.zh: 你為什麼沒來派對？

items.zh: 她為什麼沒接電話？

items.en: Why didn't your brother come with you?
items.zh: 你弟弟為什麼沒跟你一起來？

items.en: Why didn't you take a taxi?
items.zh: 你為什麼沒搭計程車？

examples.heading: ⑦ 日常對話

items.en: What time did you get home last night?
items.zh: 你昨天晚上幾點到家？

items.en: Did you remember to buy milk?
items.zh: 你有記得買牛奶嗎？

items.en: Who did you go with?
items.zh: 你跟誰去的？

items.en: What did the teacher say?
items.zh: 老師說了什麼？

title: Didn't you tell me that you had to go to Orleans today?
translation: 你不是跟我說你今天要去奧爾良嗎？
name: 過去簡單式的各種疑問句（較多種動詞）

Did the apology placate the customer?

Did your parents approve of the plan?

How did you persuade him to come?

What caused the delay?
Who recommended this restaurant?
What woke you up so early?
We certainly had a terrific time together, didn't we?
You remembered to feed the cat, didn't you?
She didn't recognise you, did she?
The train arrived on time, didn't it?
They didn't apologise, did they?
Didn't you say you were allergic to cats?
Didn't he work in a bank before?
Didn't we meet at Anna's wedding?

Didn't you enjoy the concert?

"Didn't she call you?" "Yes, she did. She called this morning."

Did you receive the documents I sent last week?

examples.heading: ① 是非問句：Did + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Did the hotel refund your deposit?
items.zh: 飯店有退你訂金嗎？

items.en: Did you recognise anyone at the reunion?
items.zh: 你在同學會上有認出誰嗎？

items.en: Did the apology placate the customer?
items.zh: 道歉有讓那位客人消氣嗎？

items.en: Did the medicine help at all?
items.zh: 藥有一點效果嗎？

items.en: Did your parents approve of the plan?
items.zh: 你爸媽贊成這個計畫嗎？

examples.heading: ② 疑問詞問句：疑問詞 + did + 主詞

items.en: Where did you learn to swim?
items.zh: 你在哪裡學會游泳的？

items.en: How did you persuade him to come?
items.zh: 你是怎麼說服他來的？

items.en: What did the doctor say about your knee?
items.zh: 醫生怎麼說你的膝蓋？

items.en: Why did they decide to extend the deadline?
items.zh: 他們為什麼決定延長期限？

items.en: Which hotel did you choose in the end?
items.zh: 你最後選了哪家飯店？

examples.heading: ③ Who / What 當主詞

items.en: What caused the delay?
items.zh: 延誤是什麼造成的？

items.en: Who recommended this restaurant?
items.zh: 這家餐廳是誰推薦的？

items.en: What woke you up so early?
items.zh: 是什麼把你這麼早吵醒的？

examples.heading: ④ 附加問句

items.en: We certainly had a terrific time together, didn't we?
items.zh: 我們一起玩得超開心的，對吧？

items.en: You remembered to feed the cat, didn't you?
items.zh: 你有記得餵貓吧？

items.en: She didn't recognise you, did she?
items.zh: 她沒認出你吧？

items.en: The train arrived on time, didn't it?
items.zh: 火車準時到了，對吧？

items.en: They didn't apologise, did they?
items.zh: 他們沒道歉吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定問句：Didn't + 主詞

items.en: Didn't you say you were allergic to cats?
items.zh: 你不是說你對貓過敏嗎？

items.en: Didn't he work in a bank before?
items.zh: 他以前不是在銀行上班嗎？

items.en: Didn't we meet at Anna's wedding?
items.zh: 我們不是在 Anna 的婚禮上見過嗎？

items.en: Didn't the shop open at nine?
items.zh: 那家店不是九點開門嗎？

items.en: Didn't you enjoy the concert?
items.zh: 你不喜歡那場音樂會嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ Why didn't + 主詞

items.en: Why didn't you say something earlier?
items.zh: 你為什麼不早點說？

items.en: Why didn't they invite us?
items.zh: 他們為什麼沒邀請我們？

items.en: Why didn't the alarm go off?
items.zh: 鬧鐘為什麼沒響？

examples.heading: ⑦ 回答否定問句

items.en: "Didn't she call you?" "Yes, she did. She called this morning."
items.zh: 她沒打給你嗎？有啊，她今天早上打了。

items.en: "Didn't you post the letter?" "No, I didn't. I forgot."
items.zh: 你沒寄那封信嗎？沒有，我忘了。

examples.heading: ⑧ 用在書信和電子郵件

items.en: Did you receive the documents I sent last week?
items.zh: 我上禮拜寄的文件您收到了嗎？

items.en: When did you first notice the leak?
items.zh: 您是什麼時候第一次發現漏水的？

items.en: Why didn't anyone inform us about the change?
items.zh: 為什麼沒有人通知我們這項變更？

items.en: You didn't receive my previous email, did you?
items.zh: 您沒收到我上一封電子郵件吧？

title: How did it turn out?
translation: 結果怎麼樣？
name: 過去簡單式疑問句（較多種動詞）
sentences: Did you spot the mistake on the poster?
Did they manage to fix the heating?
Did she mention when she'd be back?
Did you get round to calling the bank?
Did the meeting go well?
Did you end up buying the blue sofa?
How did the interview go?
Where did you come across this old map?
Why did they call off the match?
What did you make of the new manager?
When did you find out about the problem?
How long did it take you to recover?
Who told you about the new office?
What happened at the meeting yesterday?
Who came up with this idea?
What made you change your mind?
Who won the election in the end?
I told you about Peter and Mary, didn't I?
You didn't forget my birthday, did you?
She looked really happy at the wedding, didn't she?
They didn't charge you for the drinks, did they?
The film went on far too long, didn't it?
He turned down the job offer, didn't he?
Didn't we all dream of being famous once?
Didn't you get my message?
Didn't she use to live in Bristol?
Didn't they promise to deliver it on Monday?
Why didn't you tell me you were ill?
Did you notice that the camp expects us to help with the entertainment?
How did the other members react to the proposal?
Didn't your advertisement say that breakfast was included?

examples.heading: ① 是非問句：Did + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Did you spot the mistake on the poster?
items.zh: 你有發現海報上的錯誤嗎？

items.en: Did they manage to fix the heating?
items.zh: 他們有修好暖氣嗎？

items.en: Did she mention when she'd be back?
items.zh: 她有說什麼時候回來嗎？

items.en: Did you get round to calling the bank?
items.zh: 你終於有空打電話給銀行了嗎？

items.en: Did the meeting go well?
items.zh: 會開得順利嗎？

items.en: Did you end up buying the blue sofa?
items.zh: 你最後買了那張藍色的沙發嗎？

examples.heading: ② 疑問詞問句：疑問詞 + did + 主詞

items.en: How did the interview go?
items.zh: 面試怎麼樣？

items.en: Where did you come across this old map?
items.zh: 你在哪裡找到這張舊地圖的？

items.en: Why did they call off the match?
items.zh: 他們為什麼取消比賽？

items.en: What did you make of the new manager?
items.zh: 你覺得新經理怎麼樣？

items.en: When did you find out about the problem?
items.zh: 你什麼時候發現這個問題的？

items.en: How long did it take you to recover?
items.zh: 你花了多久才復原？

examples.heading: ③ Who / What 當主詞

items.en: Who told you about the new office?
items.zh: 誰跟你說新辦公室的事？

items.en: What happened at the meeting yesterday?
items.zh: 昨天開會發生了什麼事？

items.en: Who came up with this idea?
items.zh: 這個點子是誰想出來的？

items.en: What made you change your mind?
items.zh: 是什麼讓你改變主意？

items.en: Who won the election in the end?
items.zh: 最後誰贏了選舉？

examples.heading: ④ 附加問句

items.en: I told you about Peter and Mary, didn't I?
items.zh: 我跟你說過 Peter 和 Mary 的事了，對吧？

items.en: You didn't forget my birthday, did you?
items.zh: 你沒有忘記我的生日吧？

items.en: She looked really happy at the wedding, didn't she?
items.zh: 她在婚禮上看起來很開心，對吧？

items.en: They didn't charge you for the drinks, did they?
items.zh: 他們沒有跟你收飲料的錢吧？

items.en: The film went on far too long, didn't it?
items.zh: 那部電影真的太長了，對吧？

items.en: He turned down the job offer, didn't he?
items.zh: 他拒絕了那份工作，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定問句：Didn't + 主詞

items.en: Didn't we all dream of being famous once?
items.zh: 我們不是都曾經夢想過成名嗎？

items.en: Didn't you get my message?
items.zh: 你沒收到我的訊息嗎？

items.en: Didn't she use to live in Bristol?
items.zh: 她以前不是住在布里斯托嗎？

items.zh: 他們不是答應星期一要送來嗎？

items.zh: 你生病了為什麼不跟我說？

examples.heading: ⑥ 用在書信和正式的場合

items.zh: 你有注意到營地希望我們幫忙辦娛樂活動嗎？

items.en: How did the other members react to the proposal?
items.zh: 其他成員對這個提案有什麼反應？

items.en: Didn't your advertisement say that breakfast was included?
items.zh: 你們的廣告不是說有附早餐嗎？

title: What have you been doing?
translation: 你最近都在做什麼？
name: 現在完成進行式的疑問句
sentences: The house is still a mess. What have you been doing all day?
Mum and Dad look upset. What have they been talking about?
What has your sister been eating? She looks really ill.
What have you been doing to your hands? They're covered in paint.
Your brother looks at me strangely now. What has he been telling you about me?
You play the violin beautifully. How long have you been playing in the orchestra?
The car is under a white blanket. How long has it been snowing?
Your face is very pale. How long have you been feeling like this?
Your sister speaks good French now. How long has she been living in Canada?
How long have we been driving? I'm getting hungry.
Where have you been hiding? I haven't seen you for days.
Our son left home in May. Where has he been staying since then?
You were laughing a lot. Who have you been chatting to on the phone?
You never answer my texts. Why have you been avoiding me?
Nobody slept last night. Why has the dog been barking all night?
My screen has someone else's photos on it. Who has been using my computer?
The box is half empty. Who's been eating my biscuits?
You were away for work. Who has been looking after the kids this week?
You seem very quiet since the interview. Have you been thinking about it a lot?
You look so tired. Have you been getting enough sleep?
Have you been crying? Your eyes are red.
The team looks tired. Have they been working on the project all week?
Your cough is better. Have you been taking the tablets the doctor gave you?
Your daughter's test is on Monday. Has she been studying for it?
Has it been raining here? The ground is wet.
You're walking very slowly. Has your back been hurting again?
How is your grandfather? Has he been sleeping better since the operation?
You're out of breath. Have you been running? — Yes, I have.
Is your wife OK? Has she been working late? — No, she hasn't.
Thanks for babysitting. Have the children been behaving? — Yes, they have.
It's very cold in your flat. Has the heating been working properly? — No, it hasn't.

examples.heading: ① What 問句

items.en: The house is still a mess. What have you been doing all day?
items.zh: 家裡還是一團亂。你一整天都在做什麼？

items.en: Mum and Dad look upset. What have they been talking about?
items.zh: 爸媽看起來很不高興。他們剛剛在聊什麼？

items.en: What has your sister been eating? She looks really ill.
items.zh: 你妹妹最近都吃了什麼？她看起來很不舒服。

items.en: What have you been doing to your hands? They're covered in paint.
items.zh: 你的手怎麼了？上面都是油漆。

items.en: Your brother looks at me strangely now. What has he been telling you about me?
items.zh: 你哥哥現在看我的眼神很奇怪。他跟你說了我什麼？

examples.heading: ② How long 問句

items.en: You play the violin beautifully. How long have you been playing in the orchestra?
items.zh: 你小提琴拉得真好。你在管弦樂團演奏多久了？

items.en: The car is under a white blanket. How long has it been snowing?
items.zh: 車子蓋上了一層白雪。雪下多久了？

items.en: Your face is very pale. How long have you been feeling like this?
items.zh: 你的臉色很蒼白。你這樣不舒服多久了？

items.en: Your sister speaks good French now. How long has she been living in Canada?
items.zh: 你姊姊現在法文說得很好。她住在加拿大多久了？

items.en: How long have we been driving? I'm getting hungry.
items.zh: 我們開多久了？我開始餓了。

examples.heading: ③ Where / Who / Why 問句

items.en: Where have you been hiding? I haven't seen you for days.
items.zh: 你躲到哪裡去了？我好幾天沒看到你了。

items.en: Our son left home in May. Where has he been staying since then?
items.zh: 我們兒子五月離開家。他從那時候起都住在哪裡？

items.en: You were laughing a lot. Who have you been chatting to on the phone?
items.zh: 你剛剛笑得好開心。你剛剛在跟誰講電話？

items.en: You never answer my texts. Why have you been avoiding me?
items.zh: 你從來不回我的簡訊。你為什麼一直躲著我？

items.en: Nobody slept last night. Why has the dog been barking all night?
items.zh: 昨晚大家都沒睡。狗為什麼整個晚上都在叫？

examples.heading: ④ Who 當主詞

items.en: My screen has someone else's photos on it. Who has been using my computer?
items.zh: 我的螢幕上有別人的照片。誰一直在用我的電腦？

items.en: The box is half empty. Who's been eating my biscuits?
items.zh: 盒子空了一半。是誰一直在吃我的餅乾？

items.en: You were away for work. Who has been looking after the kids this week?
items.zh: 你出差去了。這個禮拜是誰在照顧小孩？

examples.heading: ⑤ 是非問句：Have + 主詞

items.en: You seem very quiet since the interview. Have you been thinking about it a lot?
items.zh: 面試以後你好像很安靜。你常常在想這件事嗎？

items.en: You look so tired. Have you been getting enough sleep?
items.zh: 你看起來好累。你最近睡得夠嗎？

items.en: Have you been crying? Your eyes are red.
items.zh: 你哭過嗎？你的眼睛紅紅的。

items.en: The team looks tired. Have they been working on the project all week?
items.zh: 團隊看起來很累。他們整個禮拜都在做這個專案嗎？

items.en: Your cough is better. Have you been taking the tablets the doctor gave you?
items.zh: 你的咳嗽好多了。醫生給你的藥你有在吃嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 是非問句：Has + 主詞

items.en: Your daughter's test is on Monday. Has she been studying for it?
items.zh: 你女兒星期一要考試。她有在準備嗎？

items.en: Has it been raining here? The ground is wet.
items.zh: 這裡剛剛有下雨嗎？地上濕濕的。

items.en: You're walking very slowly. Has your back been hurting again?
items.zh: 你走得好慢。你的背又在痛了嗎？

items.en: How is your grandfather? Has he been sleeping better since the operation?
items.zh: 你爺爺還好嗎？他開完刀以後睡得比較好嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 簡答

items.en: You're out of breath. Have you been running? — Yes, I have.
items.zh: 你喘不過氣。你剛剛去跑步了嗎？——對。

items.en: Is your wife OK? Has she been working late? — No, she hasn't.
items.zh: 你太太還好嗎？她最近常加班嗎？——沒有。

items.en: Thanks for babysitting. Have the children been behaving? — Yes, they have.
items.zh: 謝謝你幫忙帶小孩。孩子們有乖嗎？——有。

items.en: It's very cold in your flat. Has the heating been working properly? — No, it hasn't.
items.zh: 你的公寓好冷。暖氣一直都正常嗎？——不正常。

title: Have you bought anything?
translation: 你有買什麼東西嗎？
name: 現在完成式的疑問句（have you）
sentences: It's Grandma's birthday on Friday. Have you bought a card for her?
Everyone is talking about Mr Green. Have you seen the new teacher in Room 4?
You look very pale. Have you eaten anything since this morning?
There's an envelope on the table for you. Have you read the letter from the bank?
You're still holding your face. Have you phoned the dentist about your tooth?
The guests arrive at seven. Have you put the chicken in the oven?
We're leaving for the airport now. Have you turned off the lights upstairs?
I can't see a thing in here. Have you fixed the light in the bathroom?
This is my cousin Lucy. Have you met her before?
You've lived in this town for a month. Have you visited the castle on the hill?
There's some on the kitchen table. Have you tasted the cake I made?
It's time for bed. Have you locked the back door?
The cat is sleeping on the sofa. Have you fed her? — Yes, I have.
Your friends are coming over at five. Have you tidied your bedroom? — No, I haven't.
We need to leave early on Sunday. Have you checked the train times? — Yes, I have.
Dad doesn't know about our plans. Have you sent him a message about dinner? — No, I haven't.
I called you five times. Where have you been all afternoon?
Show me the bags. What have you bought for the party?
It's not in my drawer. What have you done with my blue jumper?
I need the car this morning. Where have you left the keys?
You bought presents for everyone. How much money have you spent on this trip?
Your passport is full of stamps. Which countries have you travelled to?
It's so hot in here. Why have you closed all the windows?
Hi Anna, it's been months. How have you been since the wedding?
You left the bank in the spring. Have you found a new job?
You got the keys last week. Have you moved into your new house?
You bought a guitar for your birthday. Have you started your lessons?
The waiter is coming back. Have you decided what to order?
Excuse me, sir. Have you paid for these shoes?
That one looks a bit small on you. Have you tried this jacket in a bigger size?
It's Friday, and the restaurant gets busy. Have you booked a table for tonight?

examples.heading: ① Have you + 過去分詞

items.en: It's Grandma's birthday on Friday. Have you bought a card for her?
items.zh: 星期五是奶奶的生日。你買好要給她的卡片了嗎？

items.en: Everyone is talking about Mr Green. Have you seen the new teacher in Room 4?
items.zh: 大家都在聊格林老師。你見過四號教室的新老師了嗎？

items.en: You look very pale. Have you eaten anything since this morning?
items.zh: 你臉色很蒼白。你從早上到現在有吃東西嗎？

items.en: There's an envelope on the table for you. Have you read the letter from the bank?
items.zh: 桌上有一封你的信。銀行寄來的那封信你看了嗎？

items.en: You're still holding your face. Have you phoned the dentist about your tooth?
items.zh: 你還捂著臉。你打電話給牙醫說你牙齒的事了嗎？

items.en: The guests arrive at seven. Have you put the chicken in the oven?
items.zh: 客人七點到。你把雞放進烤箱了嗎？

items.en: We're leaving for the airport now. Have you turned off the lights upstairs?
items.zh: 我們現在要去機場了。樓上的燈你關了嗎？

items.en: I can't see a thing in here. Have you fixed the light in the bathroom?
items.zh: 這裡什麼都看不到。浴室的燈你修好了嗎？

items.en: This is my cousin Lucy. Have you met her before?
items.zh: 這是我表妹露西。你以前見過她嗎？

items.en: You've lived in this town for a month. Have you visited the castle on the hill?
items.zh: 你在這個小鎮住了一個月。你去過山上那座城堡嗎？

items.en: There's some on the kitchen table. Have you tasted the cake I made?
items.zh: 廚房桌上還有一些。我做的蛋糕你吃過了嗎？

items.en: It's time for bed. Have you locked the back door?
items.zh: 該睡覺了。後門你鎖了嗎？

examples.heading: ② 簡答：Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

items.en: The cat is sleeping on the sofa. Have you fed her? — Yes, I have.
items.zh: 貓在沙發上睡覺。你餵她了嗎？餵了。

items.en: Your friends are coming over at five. Have you tidied your bedroom? — No, I haven't.
items.zh: 你朋友五點要來。你房間整理了嗎？還沒。

items.en: We need to leave early on Sunday. Have you checked the train times? — Yes, I have.
items.zh: 我們星期天要早點出發。火車時刻你查過了嗎？查過了。

items.en: Dad doesn't know about our plans. Have you sent him a message about dinner? — No, I haven't.
items.zh: 爸爸不知道我們的計畫。你傳訊息跟他說晚餐的事了嗎？還沒。

examples.heading: ③ 疑問詞 + have + you + 過去分詞

items.en: I called you five times. Where have you been all afternoon?
items.zh: 我打了五次電話給你。你整個下午跑去哪裡了？

items.en: Show me the bags. What have you bought for the party?
items.zh: 給我看看袋子。你為了派對買了什麼？

items.en: It's not in my drawer. What have you done with my blue jumper?
items.zh: 它不在我的抽屜裡。你把我的藍色毛衣弄到哪裡去了？

items.en: I need the car this morning. Where have you left the keys?
items.zh: 我今天早上要用車。你把鑰匙放在哪裡了？

items.en: You bought presents for everyone. How much money have you spent on this trip?
items.zh: 你幫每個人都買了禮物。這趟旅行你花了多少錢？

items.en: Your passport is full of stamps. Which countries have you travelled to?
items.zh: 你的護照蓋滿了章。你去過哪些國家旅行？

items.en: It's so hot in here. Why have you closed all the windows?
items.zh: 這裡好熱。你為什麼把窗戶全部關起來？

examples.heading: ④ 問近況

items.en: Hi Anna, it's been months. How have you been since the wedding?
items.zh: 嗨，安娜，好幾個月沒見了。婚禮以後你過得好嗎？

items.en: You left the bank in the spring. Have you found a new job?
items.zh: 你春天離開了銀行。你找到新工作了嗎？

items.en: You got the keys last week. Have you moved into your new house?
items.zh: 你上禮拜拿到鑰匙了。你搬進新家了嗎？

items.en: You bought a guitar for your birthday. Have you started your lessons?
items.zh: 你生日買了一把吉他。你的課開始上了嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 在店裡和餐廳

items.en: The waiter is coming back. Have you decided what to order?
items.zh: 服務生又過來了。你決定要點什麼了嗎？

items.en: Excuse me, sir. Have you paid for these shoes?
items.zh: 先生，不好意思。這雙鞋你付過錢了嗎？

items.en: That one looks a bit small on you. Have you tried this jacket in a bigger size?
items.zh: 那件你穿起來有點小。這件外套你試過大一號的嗎？

items.en: It's Friday, and the restaurant gets busy. Have you booked a table for tonight?
items.zh: 今天是星期五，那家餐廳會很多人。你訂好今晚的位子了嗎？

title: How has your family been?
translation: 你家人最近好嗎？
name: 現在完成式的疑問句（較多種動詞）
sentences: Where have you put my glasses?
Why has the price changed?
How have you been since the operation?
What have they done to the garden?
Where has Emma gone?
How has the new manager settled in?
Why have the shops closed so early today?
What have you told your parents?
How long has your sister been a nurse?
How many countries have you visited?
How much money has she saved?
How long has your grandfather lived in that village?
How many cups of coffee have you had today?
Has your son ever ridden a horse?
Has the doctor called back?
Have they fixed the lift yet?
Has your brother found a job?
Have we met before?
Has anyone seen my phone?
Have you read the instructions?
Has the train left? — Yes, it has.
Have you paid the bill? — No, I haven't.
Has Tom finished the report? — No, he hasn't.
Have the kids eaten? — Yes, they have.
What has happened to your car?
Who has taken my umbrella?
Which team has won the most games?
Who has broken the window?
How has work been this week?
How have your parents been?
How has the weather been in Scotland?

examples.heading: ① 疑問詞 + have / has + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: Where have you put my glasses?
items.zh: 你把我的眼鏡放到哪裡去了？

items.en: Why has the price changed?
items.zh: 價錢為什麼變了？

items.en: How have you been since the operation?
items.zh: 你開刀之後身體還好嗎？

items.en: What have they done to the garden?
items.zh: 他們把花園弄成什麼樣子了？

items.en: Where has Emma gone?
items.zh: Emma 去哪裡了？

items.en: How has the new manager settled in?
items.zh: 新經理適應得怎麼樣？

items.en: Why have the shops closed so early today?
items.zh: 店家今天為什麼這麼早就關門了？

items.en: What have you told your parents?
items.zh: 你跟你爸媽說了什麼？

examples.heading: ② how long / how many / how much

items.en: How long has your sister been a nurse?
items.zh: 你姊姊當護士多久了？

items.en: How many countries have you visited?
items.zh: 你去過幾個國家？

items.en: How much money has she saved?
items.zh: 她存了多少錢？

items.en: How long has your grandfather lived in that village?
items.zh: 你爺爺在那個村子住多久了？

items.en: How many cups of coffee have you had today?
items.zh: 你今天喝了幾杯咖啡？

examples.heading: ③ Have / Has + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: Has your son ever ridden a horse?
items.zh: 你兒子騎過馬嗎？

items.en: Has the doctor called back?
items.zh: 醫生回電了嗎？

items.en: Have they fixed the lift yet?
items.zh: 他們修好電梯了沒？

items.en: Has your brother found a job?
items.zh: 你哥找到工作了嗎？

items.en: Have we met before?
items.zh: 我們以前見過嗎？

items.en: Has anyone seen my phone?
items.zh: 有人看到我的手機嗎？

items.en: Have you read the instructions?
items.zh: 你看過說明了嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 回答：Yes / No + 主詞 + have / has

items.en: Has the train left? — Yes, it has.
items.zh: 火車開走了嗎？開走了。

items.en: Have you paid the bill? — No, I haven't.
items.zh: 你付帳單了嗎？還沒。

items.en: Has Tom finished the report? — No, he hasn't.
items.zh: Tom 報告寫完了嗎？還沒。

items.en: Have the kids eaten? — Yes, they have.
items.zh: 孩子們吃過了嗎？吃過了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問詞當主詞

items.en: What has happened to your car?
items.zh: 你的車怎麼了？

items.en: Who has taken my umbrella?
items.zh: 誰拿走了我的傘？

items.en: Which team has won the most games?
items.zh: 哪一隊贏最多場？

items.en: Who has broken the window?
items.zh: 誰把窗戶打破了？

examples.heading: ⑥ 問候：How has / have ... been

items.en: How has work been this week?
items.zh: 這禮拜工作還好嗎？

items.en: How have your parents been?
items.zh: 你爸媽最近好嗎？

items.en: How has the weather been in Scotland?
items.zh: 蘇格蘭最近天氣怎麼樣？

title: I was driving to my parents' house because I had arranged to have dinner with them.
translation: 我當時正開車去我爸媽家，因為我跟他們約好要一起吃晚餐。
name: because 後面的過去完成式
sentences: On the night of the accident, I was driving to my parents' house because I had arranged to have dinner with them.
She was crying because she had lost her grandmother's ring.
We were celebrating because our team had won the cup.
He was smiling because he had got the job.
They were packing because they had decided to move abroad.
I was running because I had overslept.
The man was asleep, but I realised that this was because he had lost a lot of blood.
I didn't go to the party because I had promised to help my dad.
She couldn't drive because she had broken her arm.
We stayed at home because we had spent all our money.
He knew the way because he had been there before.
The teacher was angry because nobody had done the homework.
The shop was closed. This was because the owner had gone on holiday.
I failed the test. This was because I had studied the wrong chapter.
The roads were empty. This was because everyone had gone to the match.
The milk tasted strange. This was because someone had left it out of the fridge.
The train was late. This was because a tree had fallen on the line.
She was quiet all day. This was because she had heard some bad news.
Because we had booked early, we got the best seats.
Because she had lived in Spain, she spoke Spanish well.
Because he had forgotten his key, he had to wait outside.
Because it had rained all night, the match was cancelled.
Because I had eaten a big lunch, I didn't want dinner.
Because they had saved for years, they could buy a house.
I bought my sister a present because she had passed her exams.
She thanked her neighbour because he had fixed her fence.
They gave him a medal because he had saved a child from the river.
We sent her flowers because she had been in hospital.
The manager called me because I had made a mistake on the order.
I apologised to Tom because I had forgotten his birthday.
The hotel gave us a free dinner because they had lost our booking.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was + -ing + because + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: On the night of the accident, I was driving to my parents' house because I had arranged to have dinner with them.
items.zh: 意外那天晚上，我正開車去我爸媽家，因為我跟他們約好要一起吃晚餐。

items.en: She was crying because she had lost her grandmother's ring.
items.zh: 她在哭，因為她弄丟了她奶奶的戒指。

items.en: We were celebrating because our team had won the cup.
items.zh: 我們在慶祝，因為我們隊贏了獎盃。

items.en: He was smiling because he had got the job.
items.zh: 他在笑，因為他拿到了那份工作。

items.en: They were packing because they had decided to move abroad.
items.zh: 他們在收拾行李，因為他們決定搬到國外。

items.en: I was running because I had overslept.
items.zh: 我在跑，因為我睡過頭了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 過去式 + because + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: The man was asleep, but I realised that this was because he had lost a lot of blood.
items.zh: 那個男人睡著了，可是我發現這是因為他失血很多。

items.en: I didn't go to the party because I had promised to help my dad.
items.zh: 我沒去派對，因為我答應要幫我爸爸。

items.en: She couldn't drive because she had broken her arm.
items.zh: 她不能開車，因為她摔斷了手臂。

items.en: We stayed at home because we had spent all our money.
items.zh: 我們待在家裡，因為我們把錢都花光了。

items.en: He knew the way because he had been there before.
items.zh: 他認得路，因為他以前去過那裡。

items.en: The teacher was angry because nobody had done the homework.
items.zh: 老師很生氣，因為沒有人寫功課。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 過去式. This was because + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: The shop was closed. This was because the owner had gone on holiday.
items.zh: 那家店沒開。這是因為老闆去度假了。

items.en: I failed the test. This was because I had studied the wrong chapter.
items.zh: 我考試沒過。這是因為我讀錯了章節。

items.en: The roads were empty. This was because everyone had gone to the match.
items.zh: 路上沒什麼人。這是因為大家都去看比賽了。

items.en: The milk tasted strange. This was because someone had left it out of the fridge.
items.zh: 牛奶喝起來怪怪的。這是因為有人把它放在冰箱外面。

items.en: The train was late. This was because a tree had fallen on the line.
items.zh: 火車誤點了。這是因為一棵樹倒在鐵軌上。

items.en: She was quiet all day. This was because she had heard some bad news.
items.zh: 她一整天都很安靜。這是因為她聽到了一些壞消息。

examples.heading: ④ Because + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: Because we had booked early, we got the best seats.
items.zh: 因為我們很早就訂了，所以拿到了最好的位子。

items.en: Because she had lived in Spain, she spoke Spanish well.
items.zh: 因為她在西班牙住過，所以她西班牙文說得很好。

items.en: Because he had forgotten his key, he had to wait outside.
items.zh: 因為他忘了帶鑰匙，所以他只好在外面等。

items.en: Because it had rained all night, the match was cancelled.
items.zh: 因為下了一整晚的雨，比賽取消了。（被動）

items.en: Because I had eaten a big lunch, I didn't want dinner.
items.zh: 因為我午餐吃得很多，所以不想吃晚餐。

items.en: Because they had saved for years, they could buy a house.
items.zh: 因為他們存了好幾年的錢，所以買得起房子。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + 過去式 + 名詞 + because + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: I bought my sister a present because she had passed her exams.
items.zh: 我買了一個禮物給我妹妹，因為她通過了考試。

items.en: She thanked her neighbour because he had fixed her fence.
items.zh: 她謝謝她的鄰居，因為他幫她修好了圍籬。

items.en: They gave him a medal because he had saved a child from the river.
items.zh: 他們給了他一枚獎章，因為他從河裡救了一個孩子。

items.en: We sent her flowers because she had been in hospital.
items.zh: 我們送花給她，因為她住院了。

items.en: The manager called me because I had made a mistake on the order.
items.zh: 經理打電話給我，因為我把訂單弄錯了。

items.en: I apologised to Tom because I had forgotten his birthday.
items.zh: 我跟湯姆道歉，因為我忘了他的生日。

items.en: The hotel gave us a free dinner because they had lost our booking.
items.zh: 飯店請我們吃了一頓免費晚餐，因為他們弄丟了我們的預約。

title: If the weather had been better, we would have enjoyed it more.
translation: 要是那時天氣好一點，我們就會玩得更開心。
name: if 子句用過去完成式表示過去的假設
sentences: It rained every day of our holiday. If the weather had been better, we would have enjoyed it more.
If the hotel had been cleaner, we would have stayed longer.
If the tickets had been cheaper, more people would have come.
If the film had been shorter, the children would have enjoyed it.
If the water had been warmer, we would have gone swimming.
If the road had been safer, the accident wouldn't have happened.
The concert was amazing. If you had gone there with me, you would have been so happy.
If you had joined the choir, you would have sung at the cathedral.
If you had studied harder, you would have passed the exam.
If you had left earlier, you wouldn't have missed the train.
If you had told me about the party, I would have come.
If you had worn a coat, you wouldn't have got so cold.
I went back to look for my friends in the park. I would have stayed there all night if it hadn't closed at six!
We would have won if our best player hadn't been injured.
I would have called you if my phone hadn't died.
She would have finished on time if the computer hadn't crashed.
They would have caught the bus if they hadn't stopped for coffee.
I would have slept well if the neighbours hadn't had a party.
If I had known you were ill, I would have brought you some soup.
If I had known the shop was closed, I wouldn't have gone into town.
If we had known about the strike, we would have taken the car.
If she had known the truth, she would have been very angry.
If I had known it was your birthday, I would have bought you a present.
If they had known how cold it was, they would have stayed at home.
If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have met my best friend.
If it hadn't rained, the match wouldn't have been cancelled.
If she hadn't taken the job, she wouldn't have moved to London.
If we hadn't got lost, we wouldn't have found that lovely beach.
If my brother hadn't eaten all the prawns, he wouldn't have spent the night in hospital.
If you hadn't helped me, I wouldn't have finished the project.
If the dog hadn't barked, we wouldn't have woken up.

examples.heading: ① If + 主詞 + had been + 形容詞, + 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞

items.en: It rained every day of our holiday. If the weather had been better, we would have enjoyed it more.
items.zh: 我們度假的每一天都在下雨。如果天氣好一點，我們會玩得更開心。

items.en: If the hotel had been cleaner, we would have stayed longer.
items.zh: 如果飯店乾淨一點，我們就會待久一點。

items.en: If the tickets had been cheaper, more people would have come.
items.zh: 如果票便宜一點，就會有更多人來。

items.en: If the film had been shorter, the children would have enjoyed it.
items.zh: 如果電影短一點，孩子們就會喜歡。

items.en: If the water had been warmer, we would have gone swimming.
items.zh: 如果水暖一點，我們就會去游泳。

items.en: If the road had been safer, the accident wouldn't have happened.
items.zh: 如果那條路安全一點，意外就不會發生。

examples.heading: ② If you had + 過去分詞, + you would have + 過去分詞：可惜對方沒做

items.en: The concert was amazing. If you had gone there with me, you would have been so happy.
items.zh: 演唱會太棒了。如果你跟我一起去，你一定會很開心。

items.en: If you had joined the choir, you would have sung at the cathedral.
items.zh: 如果你加入了合唱團，你就會在大教堂唱歌了。

items.en: If you had studied harder, you would have passed the exam.
items.zh: 如果你更用功，你就會通過考試了。

items.en: If you had left earlier, you wouldn't have missed the train.
items.zh: 如果你早點出發，你就不會錯過火車了。

items.en: If you had told me about the party, I would have come.
items.zh: 如果你告訴我派對的事，我就會來了。

items.en: If you had worn a coat, you wouldn't have got so cold.
items.zh: 如果你穿了外套，你就不會那麼冷了。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞 + if + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞

items.en: I went back to look for my friends in the park. I would have stayed there all night if it hadn't closed at six!
items.zh: 我回公園找我的朋友。如果公園沒有六點關門，我會在那裡待一整晚！

items.en: We would have won if our best player hadn't been injured.
items.zh: 如果我們最好的球員沒有受傷，我們就會贏了。

items.en: I would have called you if my phone hadn't died.
items.zh: 如果我的手機沒有沒電，我就會打給你了。

items.en: She would have finished on time if the computer hadn't crashed.
items.zh: 如果電腦沒有當機，她就會準時完成了。

items.en: They would have caught the bus if they hadn't stopped for coffee.
items.zh: 如果他們沒有停下來喝咖啡，他們就會趕上公車了。

items.en: I would have slept well if the neighbours hadn't had a party.
items.zh: 如果鄰居沒有開派對，我就會睡得很好了。

examples.heading: ④ If I had known + 子句, + I would have + 過去分詞

items.en: If I had known you were ill, I would have brought you some soup.
items.zh: 如果我知道你生病了，我就會帶一些湯給你了。

items.en: If I had known the shop was closed, I wouldn't have gone into town.
items.zh: 如果我知道那家店沒開，我就不會進城了。

items.en: If we had known about the strike, we would have taken the car.
items.zh: 如果我們知道有罷工，我們就會開車了。

items.en: If she had known the truth, she would have been very angry.
items.zh: 如果她知道真相，她會很生氣。

items.en: If I had known it was your birthday, I would have bought you a present.
items.zh: 如果我知道今天是你生日，我就會買禮物給你了。

items.en: If they had known how cold it was, they would have stayed at home.
items.zh: 如果他們知道有多冷，他們就會待在家裡了。

examples.heading: ⑤ If + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + wouldn't have + 過去分詞

items.en: If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have met my best friend.
items.zh: 如果我沒錯過公車，就不會遇到我最好的朋友了。

items.en: If it hadn't rained, the match wouldn't have been cancelled.
items.zh: 如果沒下雨，比賽就不會取消。（被動）

items.en: If she hadn't taken the job, she wouldn't have moved to London.
items.zh: 如果她沒接受那份工作，她就不會搬到倫敦了。

items.en: If we hadn't got lost, we wouldn't have found that lovely beach.
items.zh: 如果我們沒迷路，就不會發現那個美麗的海灘了。

items.en: If my brother hadn't eaten all the prawns, he wouldn't have spent the night in hospital.
items.zh: 如果我哥哥沒把蝦子全吃掉，他就不會在醫院過夜了。

items.en: If you hadn't helped me, I wouldn't have finished the project.
items.zh: 如果你沒幫我，我就不會完成那個專案了。

items.en: If the dog hadn't barked, we wouldn't have woken up.
items.zh: 如果狗沒有叫，我們就不會醒來了。

title: I wish I hadn't told Pat about my plans.
translation: 要是我當初有聽我爸的話就好了！
name: if only 和 wish 後面的過去完成式
sentences: The surprise party is ruined. I wish I hadn't told Pat about my plans.
I wish I hadn't done that, but now I can't change anything.
I wish I hadn't eaten so much cake at the party.
I wish I hadn't sold my old guitar.
I wish I hadn't shouted at my little brother.
I wish I hadn't stayed up so late before the exam.
At the end of the concert, I said to my friend, "I wish they had played a bit more."
I wish I had brought my camera to the beach.
I wish you had told me about the problem earlier.
I wish we had stayed longer in Rome.
I wish I had learned to swim as a child.
She wishes she had visited her grandmother more often.
I bought the car and it broke down the next week. If only I had listened to my father!
She's perfect for me. If only I had met her before.
If only we had left five minutes earlier!
If only I had saved my work before the computer crashed!
If only he had worn a helmet!
If only we had bought the tickets when they were cheap!
If only I hadn't left my bag on the train!
If only it hadn't rained on the wedding day!
If only she hadn't taken that job in London!
If only we hadn't missed the last bus!
If only I hadn't said those terrible things!
If only they hadn't built the motorway so close to our house!
I wish I had gone to university, but I had to work.
We wish we had bought that house, but it was too expensive.
He wishes he had said goodbye, but there was no time.
I wish I had called you, but I lost your number.
She wishes she had kept the letters, but she threw them away.
I wish we had taken more photos, but the battery died.
They wish they had planted more trees, but the garden was too small.

examples.heading: ① I wish I hadn't + 過去分詞：後悔做了

items.en: The surprise party is ruined. I wish I hadn't told Pat about my plans.
items.zh: 驚喜派對泡湯了。真希望我沒有把計畫告訴派特。

items.en: I wish I hadn't done that, but now I can't change anything.
items.zh: 真希望我沒做那件事，可是現在我什麼都改變不了。

items.en: I wish I hadn't eaten so much cake at the party.
items.zh: 真希望我在派對上沒吃那麼多蛋糕。

items.en: I wish I hadn't sold my old guitar.
items.zh: 真希望我沒賣掉我的舊吉他。

items.en: I wish I hadn't shouted at my little brother.
items.zh: 真希望我沒對我弟弟大吼。

items.en: I wish I hadn't stayed up so late before the exam.
items.zh: 真希望我考試前沒熬夜到那麼晚。

examples.heading: ② I wish + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞：希望當時發生了

items.en: At the end of the concert, I said to my friend, "I wish they had played a bit more."
items.zh: 音樂會結束的時候，我跟我朋友說：真希望他們多演奏一點。

items.en: I wish I had brought my camera to the beach.
items.zh: 真希望我當時帶了相機去海灘。

items.en: I wish you had told me about the problem earlier.
items.zh: 真希望你早點告訴我那個問題。

items.en: I wish we had stayed longer in Rome.
items.zh: 真希望我們在羅馬多待一會兒。

items.en: I wish I had learned to swim as a child.
items.zh: 真希望我小時候有學游泳。

items.en: She wishes she had visited her grandmother more often.
items.zh: 她希望當時更常去看她奶奶。

examples.heading: ③ If only + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞!：強烈的後悔

items.en: I bought the car and it broke down the next week. If only I had listened to my father!
items.zh: 我買了那台車，隔週就拋錨了。要是我當時聽我爸爸的話就好了！

items.en: She's perfect for me. If only I had met her before.
items.zh: 她很適合我。要是我早點遇到她就好了。

items.en: If only we had left five minutes earlier!
items.zh: 要是我們早五分鐘出發就好了！

items.en: If only I had saved my work before the computer crashed!
items.zh: 要是我在電腦當機前存了檔就好了！

items.en: If only he had worn a helmet!
items.zh: 要是他當時戴了安全帽就好了！

items.en: If only we had bought the tickets when they were cheap!
items.zh: 要是我們在票便宜的時候買就好了！

examples.heading: ④ If only + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞!

items.en: If only I hadn't left my bag on the train!
items.zh: 要是我沒把包包留在火車上就好了！

items.en: If only it hadn't rained on the wedding day!
items.zh: 要是婚禮那天沒下雨就好了！

items.en: If only she hadn't taken that job in London!
items.zh: 要是她沒接受倫敦那份工作就好了！

items.en: If only we hadn't missed the last bus!
items.zh: 要是我們沒錯過最後一班公車就好了！

items.en: If only I hadn't said those terrible things!
items.zh: 要是我沒說那些難聽的話就好了！

items.en: If only they hadn't built the motorway so close to our house!
items.zh: 要是他們沒把高速公路蓋得離我們家那麼近就好了！

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + wish + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞, but + 句子

items.en: I wish I had gone to university, but I had to work.
items.zh: 真希望我當時有念大學，可是我必須工作。

items.en: We wish we had bought that house, but it was too expensive.
items.zh: 我們希望當時買了那間房子，可是它太貴了。

items.en: He wishes he had said goodbye, but there was no time.
items.zh: 他希望當時有道別，可是沒有時間。

items.en: I wish I had called you, but I lost your number.
items.zh: 真希望我當時有打給你，可是我弄丟了你的號碼。

items.en: She wishes she had kept the letters, but she threw them away.
items.zh: 她希望當時留著那些信，可是她把它們丟了。

items.en: I wish we had taken more photos, but the battery died.
items.zh: 真希望我們當時多拍些照片，可是電池沒電了。

items.en: They wish they had planted more trees, but the garden was too small.
items.zh: 他們希望當時多種一些樹，可是花園太小了。

title: If only I hadn't been that rude!
translation: 要是我當時沒那麼沒禮貌就好了！
name: if only 加過去完成式否定表示遺憾
sentences: My best friend won't talk to me any more. If only I hadn't been that rude to her!
Now I need a degree for this job. If only I hadn't been so lazy at school!
My uncle refused to see a doctor for months. If only he hadn't been so stubborn!
We left the passports at home. If only we hadn't been in such a hurry!
My sister didn't speak to anyone. If only she hadn't been so shy at the party!
He cried all evening. If only I hadn't been so angry with my little brother!
I needed money for the rent. If only I hadn't sold my grandfather's watch!
We're lost in the mountains now. If only we hadn't taken the wrong turning!
My friend can't keep quiet. If only she hadn't told everyone my secret!
My mum was very sad on Sunday. If only I hadn't forgotten her birthday!
The park is so hot in summer now. If only they hadn't cut down the old trees!
My cousin crashed his car last night. If only he hadn't driven so fast in the rain!
If only she had not changed, if only I had helped her, maybe we would still be best friends.
If only I had not left school, I would have a better job now.
If only we had not sold the house, we would still live by the sea.
If only he had not moved abroad, we would see him more often.
If only I had not spent all my money, I could buy that bike now.
If only they had not closed the station, we wouldn't need a car.
I lost my best friend after that argument. If only I had stayed calm, if only I hadn't shouted!
We missed our plane. If only we had left earlier, if only we hadn't stopped for coffee!
My aunt was very ill for weeks. If only she had called a doctor, if only she hadn't waited so long!
My computer crashed, and I lost my essay. If only I had saved my work, if only I hadn't closed the file!
My dad hurt his back moving the sofa. If only he had asked for help, if only he hadn't tried to do it alone!
The climbers got caught in a storm. If only they had checked the weather, if only they hadn't climbed so high!
If only I hadn't eaten so much, I wouldn't feel so ill now.
