If only we hadn't missed the bus, we wouldn't be standing in the rain now.
If only she hadn't broken her leg, she would be skiing with us now.
If only I hadn't stayed up so late, I wouldn't be so tired today.
If only he hadn't lost his job, they wouldn't have to sell the car now.
If only I hadn't lent him my phone, I would be able to call you now.
If only we hadn't argued, we would be on holiday together now.

examples.heading: ① If only + 主詞 + hadn't been + 形容詞!

items.en: My best friend won't talk to me any more. If only I hadn't been that rude to her!
items.zh: 我最好的朋友再也不跟我說話了。要是我當時沒對她那麼沒禮貌就好了！

items.en: Now I need a degree for this job. If only I hadn't been so lazy at school!
items.zh: 我現在這份工作需要學位。要是我上學的時候沒那麼懶就好了！

items.en: My uncle refused to see a doctor for months. If only he hadn't been so stubborn!
items.zh: 我叔叔好幾個月都不肯去看醫生。要是他當時沒那麼固執就好了！

items.en: We left the passports at home. If only we hadn't been in such a hurry!
items.zh: 我們把護照忘在家裡了。要是我們當時沒那麼趕就好了！

items.en: My sister didn't speak to anyone. If only she hadn't been so shy at the party!
items.zh: 我妹妹沒跟任何人說話。要是她在派對上沒那麼害羞就好了！

items.en: He cried all evening. If only I hadn't been so angry with my little brother!
items.zh: 他哭了一整晚。要是我當時沒對我弟弟那麼生氣就好了！

examples.heading: ② If only + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞!

items.en: I needed money for the rent. If only I hadn't sold my grandfather's watch!
items.zh: 我需要錢付房租。要是我沒賣掉我爺爺的手錶就好了！

items.en: We're lost in the mountains now. If only we hadn't taken the wrong turning!
items.zh: 我們現在在山裡迷路了。要是我們沒轉錯彎就好了！

items.en: My friend can't keep quiet. If only she hadn't told everyone my secret!
items.zh: 我朋友藏不住話。要是她沒把我的秘密告訴每個人就好了！

items.en: My mum was very sad on Sunday. If only I hadn't forgotten her birthday!
items.zh: 我媽媽星期天很難過。要是我沒忘記她的生日就好了！

items.en: The park is so hot in summer now. If only they hadn't cut down the old trees!
items.zh: 公園現在夏天好熱。要是他們沒砍掉那些老樹就好了！

items.en: My cousin crashed his car last night. If only he hadn't driven so fast in the rain!
items.zh: 我表哥昨晚撞車了。要是他沒在雨中開那麼快就好了！

examples.heading: ③ If only + 主詞 + had not + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + would + 原形動詞：影響現在

items.en: If only she had not changed, if only I had helped her, maybe we would still be best friends.
items.zh: 要是她沒有變，要是我當時有幫她，也許我們現在還是最好的朋友。

items.en: If only I had not left school, I would have a better job now.
items.zh: 要是我當時沒有退學，我現在就會有比較好的工作。

items.en: If only we had not sold the house, we would still live by the sea.
items.zh: 要是我們當時沒賣掉房子，我們現在還會住在海邊。

items.en: If only he had not moved abroad, we would see him more often.
items.zh: 要是他當時沒搬到國外，我們就會更常見到他。

items.en: If only I had not spent all my money, I could buy that bike now.
items.zh: 要是我當時沒把錢花光，我現在就可以買那台腳踏車了。

items.en: If only they had not closed the station, we wouldn't need a car.
items.zh: 要是他們當時沒關閉車站，我們就不需要車了。

examples.heading: ④ If only + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞, + if only + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞!

items.en: I lost my best friend after that argument. If only I had stayed calm, if only I hadn't shouted!
items.zh: 那次吵架之後我失去了最好的朋友。要是我當時保持冷靜就好了，要是我當時沒有大吼就好了！

items.en: We missed our plane. If only we had left earlier, if only we hadn't stopped for coffee!
items.zh: 我們錯過了飛機。要是我們早點出發就好了，要是我們沒停下來喝咖啡就好了！

items.en: My aunt was very ill for weeks. If only she had called a doctor, if only she hadn't waited so long!
items.zh: 我阿姨病了好幾個禮拜。要是她當時有叫醫生就好了，要是她沒等那麼久就好了！

items.en: My computer crashed, and I lost my essay. If only I had saved my work, if only I hadn't closed the file!
items.zh: 我的電腦當機，報告不見了。要是我有存檔就好了，要是我沒關掉檔案就好了！

items.en: My dad hurt his back moving the sofa. If only he had asked for help, if only he hadn't tried to do it alone!
items.zh: 我爸爸搬沙發的時候傷到背。要是他當時有求助就好了，要是他沒想自己一個人做就好了！

items.en: The climbers got caught in a storm. If only they had checked the weather, if only they hadn't climbed so high!
items.zh: 那些登山客遇到暴風雨。要是他們有看天氣就好了，要是他們沒爬那麼高就好了！

examples.heading: ⑤ If only + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + would / wouldn't + 原形動詞 + now

items.en: If only I hadn't eaten so much, I wouldn't feel so ill now.
items.zh: 要是我沒吃那麼多，我現在就不會這麼不舒服了。

items.en: If only we hadn't missed the bus, we wouldn't be standing in the rain now.
items.zh: 要是我們沒錯過公車，我們現在就不會站在雨中了。

items.en: If only she hadn't broken her leg, she would be skiing with us now.
items.zh: 要是她沒摔斷腿，她現在就會跟我們一起滑雪了。

items.en: If only I hadn't stayed up so late, I wouldn't be so tired today.
items.zh: 要是我沒熬夜那麼晚，我今天就不會這麼累了。

items.en: If only he hadn't lost his job, they wouldn't have to sell the car now.
items.zh: 要是他沒丟掉工作，他們現在就不必賣車了。

items.en: If only I hadn't lent him my phone, I would be able to call you now.
items.zh: 要是我沒把手機借給他，我現在就可以打給你了。

items.en: If only we hadn't argued, we would be on holiday together now.
items.zh: 要是我們沒吵架，我們現在就會一起去度假了。

title: After a few minutes the door opened and the man who had been following me came in.
translation: 過了幾分鐘，門開了，一直跟蹤我的那個男人走了進來。
name: 關係子句中的過去完成進行式
sentences: I hid in a café. After a few minutes the door opened, and the man who had been following me came in.
There were two men who had been chasing the thief through the market.
The girl who had been crying in the corner suddenly smiled.
The boy who had been sitting next to me on the bus got off at the station.
The woman who had been watching us from the window came out.
The children who had been playing in the snow came in for hot chocolate.
The guide told funny stories about an old lord who had been living in the castle in the 18th century.
We met an old fisherman who had been working on the boats for sixty years.
The museum told the story of a family who had been making glass for five generations.
I spoke to a nurse who had been looking after patients there since the war.
We visited a farmer who had been growing grapes on the hill all his life.
The book is about a teacher who had been teaching in the same village for forty years.
The tap that had been dripping all night finally stopped.
The car which had been making a strange noise broke down on the motorway.
The rain that had been falling all day turned to snow.
The dog that had been barking all night was finally quiet.
The machine which had been working perfectly suddenly stopped.
The clock that had been ticking on the wall stopped at midnight.
At the party I met a woman who had been living in Japan for ten years.
The police found the man who had been stealing bikes from the station.
I finally spoke to the neighbour who had been playing the piano every night.
The school thanked the parents who had been helping in the library.
She married the man who had been writing her letters for years.
We thanked the volunteers who had been cleaning the beach all morning.
The book that I had been reading all week was finally finished.
The house that they had been building for years was ready at last.
The job that she had been hoping for went to someone else.
The letter that I had been waiting for arrived on Monday.
The concert that we had been looking forward to was cancelled.
The money that he had been saving went on a new car.
The puppy that the children had been asking for finally arrived.

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + who had been + -ing：故事裡的人物

items.en: I hid in a café. After a few minutes the door opened, and the man who had been following me came in.
items.zh: 我躲進一家咖啡館。幾分鐘後門開了，一直跟著我的那個男人走了進來。

items.en: There were two men who had been chasing the thief through the market.
items.zh: 有兩個男人一直在市場裡追那個小偷。

items.en: The girl who had been crying in the corner suddenly smiled.
items.zh: 一直在角落哭的那個女孩突然笑了。

items.en: The boy who had been sitting next to me on the bus got off at the station.
items.zh: 公車上一直坐在我旁邊的那個男孩在車站下車了。

items.en: The woman who had been watching us from the window came out.
items.zh: 一直在窗邊看著我們的那個女人走了出來。

items.en: The children who had been playing in the snow came in for hot chocolate.
items.zh: 一直在雪地裡玩的孩子們進來喝熱可可。

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + who had been + -ing + 時間：歷史和導覽

items.en: The guide told funny stories about an old lord who had been living in the castle in the 18th century.
items.zh: 導遊講了幾個有趣的故事，關於一個 18 世紀住在城堡裡的老貴族。

items.en: We met an old fisherman who had been working on the boats for sixty years.
items.zh: 我們遇到一個在船上工作了六十年的老漁夫。

items.en: The museum told the story of a family who had been making glass for five generations.
items.zh: 博物館講了一個五代都在做玻璃的家族的故事。

items.en: I spoke to a nurse who had been looking after patients there since the war.
items.zh: 我跟一位護理師談話，她從戰爭時期就一直在那裡照顧病人。

items.en: We visited a farmer who had been growing grapes on the hill all his life.
items.zh: 我們拜訪了一位一輩子都在山坡上種葡萄的農夫。

items.en: The book is about a teacher who had been teaching in the same village for forty years.
items.zh: 這本書講的是一位在同一個村子教了四十年書的老師。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + that / which had been + -ing：說東西

items.en: The tap that had been dripping all night finally stopped.
items.zh: 那個整晚都在滴水的水龍頭終於停了。

items.en: The car which had been making a strange noise broke down on the motorway.
items.zh: 那台一直發出奇怪聲音的車在高速公路上拋錨了。

items.en: The rain that had been falling all day turned to snow.
items.zh: 下了一整天的雨變成了雪。

items.en: The dog that had been barking all night was finally quiet.
items.zh: 那隻整晚都在叫的狗終於安靜了。

items.en: The machine which had been working perfectly suddenly stopped.
items.zh: 那台一直運作得很好的機器突然停了。

items.en: The clock that had been ticking on the wall stopped at midnight.
items.zh: 牆上一直滴答響的時鐘在半夜停了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + 過去式 + 名詞 + who had been + -ing：認識或遇到

items.en: At the party I met a woman who had been living in Japan for ten years.
items.zh: 在派對上我遇到一個在日本住了十年的女人。

items.en: The police found the man who had been stealing bikes from the station.
items.zh: 警察找到了那個一直在車站偷腳踏車的男人。

items.en: I finally spoke to the neighbour who had been playing the piano every night.
items.zh: 我終於跟那個每天晚上都在彈鋼琴的鄰居說話了。

items.en: The school thanked the parents who had been helping in the library.
items.zh: 學校謝謝那些一直在圖書館幫忙的家長。

items.en: She married the man who had been writing her letters for years.
items.zh: 她嫁給了那個寫信給她寫了好幾年的男人。

items.en: We thanked the volunteers who had been cleaning the beach all morning.
items.zh: 我們謝謝那些整個早上都在清理海灘的志工。

examples.heading: ⑤ The + 名詞 + (that) + 主詞 + had been + -ing + 過去式：受詞的關係子句

items.en: The book that I had been reading all week was finally finished.
items.zh: 我讀了一整個星期的那本書終於讀完了。

items.en: The house that they had been building for years was ready at last.
items.zh: 他們蓋了好幾年的房子終於完工了。

items.en: The job that she had been hoping for went to someone else.
items.zh: 她一直希望得到的那份工作給了別人。

items.en: The letter that I had been waiting for arrived on Monday.
items.zh: 我一直在等的那封信星期一到了。

items.en: The concert that we had been looking forward to was cancelled.
items.zh: 我們一直很期待的那場演唱會取消了。（被動）

items.en: The money that he had been saving went on a new car.
items.zh: 他一直在存的錢花在一台新車上了。

items.en: The puppy that the children had been asking for finally arrived.
items.zh: 孩子們一直吵著要的那隻小狗終於來了。

title: After I had been waiting for an hour, I decided to go through the gate on foot.
translation: 我等了一個小時之後，決定走進大門。
name: 時間連接詞後的過去完成進行式
sentences: The shuttle bus never came. After I had been waiting for an hour, I decided to go through the gate on foot.
After we had been sunbathing on the beach all day, we went to a cosy restaurant every evening.
After she had been studying for three hours, she went for a walk.
After they had been driving all night, they stopped at a café.
After he had been working at the bank for ten years, he opened his own business.
After we had been walking for hours, we finally saw the village.
When I had been living in London for a year, I started to feel at home.
When she had been learning the guitar for six months, she played at a party.
When we had been waiting for twenty minutes, the manager came out.
When he had been running for an hour, his knee started to hurt.
When they had been married for fifty years, they had a big party.
When I had been working there for a month, my boss gave me more work.
I fell asleep after I had been reading for an hour.
She felt much better after she had been resting for a few days.
They left the party after they had been dancing for hours.
He got a good job after he had been looking for months.
We finally found the hotel after we had been driving round the town for ages.
The baby fell asleep after she had been crying for an hour.
I had been sleeping well until the neighbours got a dog.
We had been enjoying the picnic until it started to rain.
She had been feeling fine until she ate the fish.
They had been living happily in the village until the factory opened.
He had been doing well at school until he broke his arm.
The car had been running perfectly until last week.
Before she moved to Paris, she had been studying French for three years.
Before he became a chef, he had been working in a bank.
Before we bought the house, we had been renting a small flat.
Before the storm arrived, it had been getting very hot.
Before I met you, I had been feeling very lonely.
Before the new road opened, people had been waiting years for it.
Before the match started, the fans had been singing for an hour.

examples.heading: ① After + 主詞 + had been + -ing, + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: The shuttle bus never came. After I had been waiting for an hour, I decided to go through the gate on foot.
items.zh: 接駁車一直沒來。我等了一個小時以後，決定自己穿過大門走進去。

items.en: After we had been sunbathing on the beach all day, we went to a cosy restaurant every evening.
items.zh: 我們每天在海灘上曬了一整天的太陽以後，晚上就去一家溫馨的餐廳。

items.en: After she had been studying for three hours, she went for a walk.
items.zh: 她讀了三個小時的書以後，去散了一下步。

items.en: After they had been driving all night, they stopped at a café.
items.zh: 他們開了一整晚的車以後，停在一家咖啡館。

items.en: After he had been working at the bank for ten years, he opened his own business.
items.zh: 他在銀行工作了十年以後，開了自己的公司。

items.en: After we had been walking for hours, we finally saw the village.
items.zh: 我們走了好幾個小時以後，終於看到了村子。

examples.heading: ② When + 主詞 + had been + -ing + for + 時間, + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: When I had been living in London for a year, I started to feel at home.
items.zh: 我在倫敦住了一年的時候，開始覺得像家一樣。

items.en: When she had been learning the guitar for six months, she played at a party.
items.zh: 她學了六個月的吉他時，在一個派對上表演。

items.en: When we had been waiting for twenty minutes, the manager came out.
items.zh: 我們等了二十分鐘的時候，經理出來了。

items.en: When he had been running for an hour, his knee started to hurt.
items.zh: 他跑了一個小時的時候，膝蓋開始痛。

items.en: When they had been married for fifty years, they had a big party.
items.zh: 他們結婚五十年的時候，辦了一個大派對。

items.en: When I had been working there for a month, my boss gave me more work.
items.zh: 我在那裡工作了一個月的時候，老闆給了我更多工作。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 過去式 + after + 主詞 + had been + -ing

items.en: I fell asleep after I had been reading for an hour.
items.zh: 我讀了一個小時以後睡著了。

items.en: She felt much better after she had been resting for a few days.
items.zh: 她休息了幾天以後覺得好多了。

items.en: They left the party after they had been dancing for hours.
items.zh: 他們跳了好幾個小時的舞以後離開了派對。

items.en: He got a good job after he had been looking for months.
items.zh: 他找了好幾個月以後找到了一份好工作。

items.en: We finally found the hotel after we had been driving round the town for ages.
items.zh: 我們在城裡繞了好久以後，終於找到了飯店。

items.en: The baby fell asleep after she had been crying for an hour.
items.zh: 寶寶哭了一個小時以後睡著了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + had been + -ing + until + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: I had been sleeping well until the neighbours got a dog.
items.zh: 在鄰居養狗之前，我一直睡得很好。

items.en: We had been enjoying the picnic until it started to rain.
items.zh: 在開始下雨之前，我們一直很享受野餐。

items.en: She had been feeling fine until she ate the fish.
items.zh: 在她吃那條魚之前，她一直覺得很好。

items.en: They had been living happily in the village until the factory opened.
items.zh: 在那間工廠開工之前，他們一直快樂地住在村子裡。

items.en: He had been doing well at school until he broke his arm.
items.zh: 在他摔斷手臂之前，他在學校一直表現得很好。

items.en: The car had been running perfectly until last week.
items.zh: 直到上個星期之前，那台車一直跑得很好。

examples.heading: ⑤ Before + 主詞 + 過去式, + 主詞 + had been + -ing + for + 時間

items.en: Before she moved to Paris, she had been studying French for three years.
items.zh: 她搬到巴黎之前，已經學了三年法文。

items.en: Before he became a chef, he had been working in a bank.
items.zh: 他當廚師之前，一直在銀行工作。

items.en: Before we bought the house, we had been renting a small flat.
items.zh: 我們買房子之前，一直租一間小公寓。

items.en: Before the storm arrived, it had been getting very hot.
items.zh: 暴風雨來之前，天氣一直變得很熱。

items.en: Before I met you, I had been feeling very lonely.
items.zh: 遇到你之前，我一直覺得很寂寞。

items.en: Before the new road opened, people had been waiting years for it.
items.zh: 新路開通之前，人們等了好幾年。

items.en: Before the match started, the fans had been singing for an hour.
items.zh: 比賽開始之前，球迷已經唱了一個小時的歌。

title: Many things have changed since your last visit.
translation: 自從你上次來過以後，很多事情都變了。
name: 現在完成式加 since 表示持續時間
sentences: You don't need a ticket for the museum. It has been free since August.
My aunt speaks good Portuguese. She's lived in Lisbon since 2015.
Where's the doctor? We've waited since nine o'clock.
My son is very hungry. He hasn't eaten since breakfast.
There's a note on the bakery door. The shop has been closed since Monday.
I miss my best friend from camp. I haven't seen her since last summer.
There are new houses everywhere. Our town has grown a lot since the opening of the new factory.
Our weekly shopping costs more now. Prices have risen since the start of the year.
He gets tired very easily now. My dad hasn't been the same since the accident.
Look at this box in the attic. My mother has kept every letter from my dad since her wedding.
Thank you for visiting me. I've felt much better since the operation.
I want to work at the zoo. I've loved animals since I was a child.
Jo and I talk every week. We've been friends since we met at university.
I'm worried about my sister. She hasn't called since she moved to Paris.
The office has a new boss and new desks. Things have changed since you left.
I'm starting flying lessons next month. I've wanted to be a pilot since I saw my first plane.
My cousins need a bigger house. They've had three children since they got married.
I don't know how my old teacher is. It's been two years since I last saw him.
We really need a break. It's been ages since we had a holiday.
They've finally fixed the bridge. It's been a month since the storm.
I hope this soup tastes OK. It's been a while since I last cooked.
It's good to see you again. How have you been since we last spoke?
Tom left early that night. Have you heard from him since the party?
You look great. What have you done since you finished school?
I haven't been back for two years. Has anything changed since my last visit?
I started at the bank in 2020. I've worked there since then.
I know this job well. I've worked here for five years.
My mum loves her old red car. She's had it since she was twenty.
My uncle should buy a new car. He's had his old one for ages.
My brother and my uncle argued at my sister's wedding. They haven't spoken since that day.
My best friend and I fell out. We haven't spoken for months.

examples.heading: ① since + 時間點

items.en: You don't need a ticket for the museum. It has been free since August.
items.zh: 博物館不用買票。它從八月起就免費了。

items.en: My aunt speaks good Portuguese. She's lived in Lisbon since 2015.
items.zh: 我阿姨的葡萄牙文很好。她從二〇一五年起就住在里斯本。

items.en: Where's the doctor? We've waited since nine o'clock.
items.zh: 醫生在哪裡？我們從九點等到現在。

items.en: My son is very hungry. He hasn't eaten since breakfast.
items.zh: 我兒子很餓。他從早餐後就沒吃過東西。

items.en: There's a note on the bakery door. The shop has been closed since Monday.
items.zh: 麵包店的門上貼了一張紙條。這家店從星期一就沒開。

items.en: I miss my best friend from camp. I haven't seen her since last summer.
items.zh: 我很想念夏令營認識的好朋友。我從去年夏天就沒見過她。

examples.heading: ② since + 名詞片語

items.en: There are new houses everywhere. Our town has grown a lot since the opening of the new factory.
items.zh: 到處都是新房子。新工廠開了以後，我們鎮上變大了很多。

items.en: Our weekly shopping costs more now. Prices have risen since the start of the year.
items.zh: 我們每週買菜花的錢變多了。物價從年初就一直漲。

items.en: He gets tired very easily now. My dad hasn't been the same since the accident.
items.zh: 他現在很容易累。我爸從那次意外以後就變了一個人。

items.en: Look at this box in the attic. My mother has kept every letter from my dad since her wedding.
items.zh: 你看閣樓裡這個盒子。我媽媽從結婚以後，我爸寫給她的每一封信都留著。

items.en: Thank you for visiting me. I've felt much better since the operation.
items.zh: 謝謝你來看我。我開刀以後覺得好多了。

examples.heading: ③ since + 過去簡單式的子句

items.en: I want to work at the zoo. I've loved animals since I was a child.
items.zh: 我想在動物園工作。我從小就喜歡動物。

items.en: Jo and I talk every week. We've been friends since we met at university.
items.zh: 我和喬每個禮拜都會聊天。我們從大學認識以後就一直是朋友。

items.en: I'm worried about my sister. She hasn't called since she moved to Paris.
items.zh: 我很擔心我姊姊。她搬去巴黎以後就沒打過電話。

items.en: The office has a new boss and new desks. Things have changed since you left.
items.zh: 辦公室換了新老闆和新桌子。你走了以後，很多事都變了。

items.en: I'm starting flying lessons next month. I've wanted to be a pilot since I saw my first plane.
items.zh: 我下個月開始上飛行課。我從第一次看到飛機就想當飛行員。

items.en: My cousins need a bigger house. They've had three children since they got married.
items.zh: 我表哥表嫂需要大一點的房子。他們結婚以後生了三個孩子。

examples.heading: ④ It's been + 一段時間 + since

items.en: I don't know how my old teacher is. It's been two years since I last saw him.
items.zh: 我不知道我以前的老師過得怎麼樣。我已經兩年沒見到他了。

items.en: We really need a break. It's been ages since we had a holiday.
items.zh: 我們真的需要休息。我們好久沒度假了。

items.en: They've finally fixed the bridge. It's been a month since the storm.
items.zh: 他們終於把橋修好了。暴風雨過後已經一個月了。

items.en: I hope this soup tastes OK. It's been a while since I last cooked.
items.zh: 希望這湯還可以。我好一陣子沒下廚了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問句

items.en: It's good to see you again. How have you been since we last spoke?
items.zh: 很高興又見到你。上次聊過之後，你還好嗎？

items.en: Tom left early that night. Have you heard from him since the party?
items.zh: 湯姆那晚很早就走了。派對之後你有他的消息嗎？

items.en: You look great. What have you done since you finished school?
items.zh: 你看起來很好。你畢業以後都在做什麼？

items.en: I haven't been back for two years. Has anything changed since my last visit?
items.zh: 我兩年沒回來了。我上次來過以後有什麼改變嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ since 和 for

items.en: I started at the bank in 2020. I've worked there since then.
items.zh: 我二〇二〇年進銀行。我從那時候起就在那裡工作。

items.en: I know this job well. I've worked here for five years.
items.zh: 我很熟這份工作。我在這裡工作五年了。

items.en: My mum loves her old red car. She's had it since she was twenty.
items.zh: 我媽媽很愛她那輛舊的紅色車子。她從二十歲就開那輛車。

items.en: My uncle should buy a new car. He's had his old one for ages.
items.zh: 我叔叔應該買新車了。他那輛舊車開好久了。

items.en: My brother and my uncle argued at my sister's wedding. They haven't spoken since that day.
items.zh: 我哥哥和我叔叔在我姊姊的婚禮上吵架。他們從那天之後就沒說過話。

items.en: My best friend and I fell out. We haven't spoken for months.
items.zh: 我和我最好的朋友鬧翻了。我們好幾個月沒說話了。

title: Not only have I been wandering its streets since I was ten, but I have also come to know its history.
translation: 我不但從十歲起就一直在它的街道上閒逛，也慢慢了解了它的歷史。
name: 現在完成進行式 not only 倒裝
sentences: I'd like to be the new shop manager. Not only have I been working here for twelve years, but I have also trained most of the new staff.
I'm a good choice for the Madrid office. Not only have I been studying Spanish for three years, but I have also lived in Madrid.
Ask me anything about the band. Not only have I been playing in it since school, but I also write most of our songs.
Sorry I missed your party. Not only have I been looking after my father, but I have also been running the shop.
I'm ready to leave home. Not only have I been saving for a year, but I have also found a cheaper flat.
Thank you for the job offer. Not only have I been expecting this offer for months, but I am also ready to start next week.
We'd like to speak to the manager. Not only have we been waiting for an hour, but nobody has told us why.
The village is angry with the builders. Not only have they been building flats on the field, but they have also closed the footpath.
Our club had a busy year. Not only have we been raising money for the hospital, but we have also organised visits for the patients.
We've called the council. Not only have our neighbours been playing loud music every night, but they have also blocked our drive.
The new fees have made people angry. Not only have the students been protesting all week, but they have also written to the minister.
Mrs Clark is the best person for the prize. Not only has she been teaching for twenty years, but she has also written three textbooks.
I need to talk to you about Mark. Not only has he been arriving late, but he has also missed two meetings.
My son loves animals. Not only has he been helping at the animal shelter, but he has also adopted a dog from it.
Please send someone to the flat. Not only has the heating been making a strange noise, but it has also stopped working twice.
The workers are worried about their jobs. Not only has the company been losing money, but it has also lost its best managers.
My wife's exam is next week. Not only has she been feeling nervous, but she has also been sleeping badly.
Not only have I been volunteering at the festival for five years, but I have also managed the ticket office.
Not only has Ms Lee been working in our team since 2019, but she has also led two major projects.
Not only have I been coaching children's football, but I have also completed a first aid course.
Not only has he been running the club's website, but he has also organised all our events.
Not only have I been reading your magazine for years, but I have also visited most of the places in it.
Not only have your workers been leaving rubbish in my garden, but they have also damaged my fence.
Not only have I been waiting for my refund for six weeks, but I have also had no reply to my emails.
Not only has the noise been keeping us awake, but it has also upset our baby.
Not only have the trains been running late, but the prices have also gone up.
Not only have we been reducing our energy use, but we have also planted two thousand trees.
Not only has the town been growing fast, but it has also become more expensive.
Not only have scientists been studying this problem for decades, but they have also found some answers.
Not only have prices been rising, but wages have also fallen.
Not only has our team been training harder, but it has also won its last five games.

examples.heading: ① Not only have I been + 動詞-ing

items.en: I'd like to be the new shop manager. Not only have I been working here for twelve years, but I have also trained most of the new staff.
items.zh: 我想當新的店長。我不但在這裡工作了十二年，大部分的新員工也是我訓練的。

items.en: I'm a good choice for the Madrid office. Not only have I been studying Spanish for three years, but I have also lived in Madrid.
items.zh: 我很適合去馬德里的辦公室。我不但學了三年西班牙文，也在馬德里住過。

items.en: Ask me anything about the band. Not only have I been playing in it since school, but I also write most of our songs.
items.zh: 樂團的事儘管問我。我不但從學生時代就一直在裡面演奏，我們大部分的歌也是我寫的。

items.en: Sorry I missed your party. Not only have I been looking after my father, but I have also been running the shop.
items.zh: 抱歉我沒去你的派對。我不但一直在照顧我爸爸，也一直在顧店。

items.en: I'm ready to leave home. Not only have I been saving for a year, but I have also found a cheaper flat.
items.zh: 我準備好搬出去住了。我不但存了一年的錢，也找到一間比較便宜的公寓。

items.en: Thank you for the job offer. Not only have I been expecting this offer for months, but I am also ready to start next week.
items.zh: 謝謝您給我這份工作。我不但等這個工作機會等了好幾個月，下禮拜也可以馬上開始。

examples.heading: ② Not only have we / they been + 動詞-ing

items.en: We'd like to speak to the manager. Not only have we been waiting for an hour, but nobody has told us why.
items.zh: 我們想跟經理談談。我們不但等了一個小時，也沒有人跟我們說原因。

items.en: The village is angry with the builders. Not only have they been building flats on the field, but they have also closed the footpath.
items.zh: 村民很氣那些建商。他們不但一直在那塊空地上蓋公寓，也把步道封起來了。

items.en: Our club had a busy year. Not only have we been raising money for the hospital, but we have also organised visits for the patients.
items.zh: 我們社團今年很忙。我們不但一直在幫醫院募款，也安排了探望病人的活動。

items.en: We've called the council. Not only have our neighbours been playing loud music every night, but they have also blocked our drive.
items.zh: 我們打電話給市政府了。我們的鄰居不但每天晚上大聲放音樂，也擋住了我們的車道。

items.en: The new fees have made people angry. Not only have the students been protesting all week, but they have also written to the minister.
items.zh: 新的學費讓大家很生氣。學生們不但抗議了一整個禮拜，也寫信給部長了。

examples.heading: ③ Not only has he / she / it been + 動詞-ing

items.en: Mrs Clark is the best person for the prize. Not only has she been teaching for twenty years, but she has also written three textbooks.
items.zh: 克拉克老師是最適合得獎的人。她不但教了二十年的書，也寫了三本教科書。

items.en: I need to talk to you about Mark. Not only has he been arriving late, but he has also missed two meetings.
items.zh: 我得跟你談談馬克的事。他不但一直遲到，也錯過了兩次會議。

items.en: My son loves animals. Not only has he been helping at the animal shelter, but he has also adopted a dog from it.
items.zh: 我兒子很愛動物。他不但一直在動物收容所幫忙，也從那裡領養了一隻狗。

items.en: Please send someone to the flat. Not only has the heating been making a strange noise, but it has also stopped working twice.
items.zh: 請派人來公寓一趟。暖氣不但一直發出奇怪的聲音，也壞了兩次。

items.en: The workers are worried about their jobs. Not only has the company been losing money, but it has also lost its best managers.
items.zh: 員工很擔心工作不保。這家公司不但一直在虧錢，也失去了最好的幾位經理。

items.en: My wife's exam is next week. Not only has she been feeling nervous, but she has also been sleeping badly.
items.zh: 我太太下禮拜要考試。她不但一直很緊張，也一直睡不好。

examples.heading: ④ 正式的信：應徵和推薦

items.en: Not only have I been volunteering at the festival for five years, but I have also managed the ticket office.
items.zh: 我不但在這個音樂節當了五年志工，也管理過售票處。

items.en: Not only has Ms Lee been working in our team since 2019, but she has also led two major projects.
items.zh: 李小姐不但從二〇一九年起就在我們的團隊工作，也帶過兩個大型專案。

items.en: Not only have I been coaching children's football, but I have also completed a first aid course.
items.zh: 我不但一直在教小朋友踢足球，也上完了急救課程。

items.en: Not only has he been running the club's website, but he has also organised all our events.
items.zh: 他不但一直在管社團的網站，也籌辦了我們所有的活動。

items.en: Not only have I been reading your magazine for years, but I have also visited most of the places in it.
items.zh: 我不但看你們的雜誌看了好幾年，雜誌裡的地方我也大多去過。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式的信：投訴

items.en: Not only have your workers been leaving rubbish in my garden, but they have also damaged my fence.
items.zh: 你們的工人不但一直把垃圾丟在我的花園，也弄壞了我的圍籬。

items.en: Not only have I been waiting for my refund for six weeks, but I have also had no reply to my emails.
items.zh: 我不但等退款等了六個禮拜，我寄的電子郵件也一直沒有回覆。

items.en: Not only has the noise been keeping us awake, but it has also upset our baby.
items.zh: 那個噪音不但吵得我們睡不著，也把我們的寶寶吵得很不安。

items.en: Not only have the trains been running late, but the prices have also gone up.
items.zh: 火車不但一直誤點，票價也漲了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 演講和報告

items.en: Not only have we been reducing our energy use, but we have also planted two thousand trees.
items.zh: 我們不但一直在減少用電，也種了兩千棵樹。

items.en: Not only has the town been growing fast, but it has also become more expensive.
items.zh: 這個小鎮不但發展得很快，也變得比較貴了。

items.en: Not only have scientists been studying this problem for decades, but they have also found some answers.
items.zh: 科學家不但研究這個問題研究了幾十年，也找到了一些答案。

items.en: Not only have prices been rising, but wages have also fallen.
items.zh: 物價不但一直在漲，薪水也降了。

items.en: Not only has our team been training harder, but it has also won its last five games.
items.zh: 我們隊不但練得比以前更勤，最近五場比賽也都贏了。

title: Had I known the tour would be so bad, I wouldn't have booked it.
translation: 早知道這趟旅行這麼糟，我就不會訂了。
name: had 倒裝表達對過去的假想與遺憾
sentences: The guide was always late and the hotel was dirty. Had I known the tour would be so bad, I wouldn't have booked it.
I fell asleep in the cinema. Had I known the film was so long, I wouldn't have gone.
I got very wet on the way home. Had I known it would rain, I would have brought an umbrella.
I'm so sorry, I only heard today. Had I known your mother was in hospital, I would have sent her some flowers.
Those shoes were half price. Had I known the shop was closing, I would have bought more.
Don't be angry with me after the quiz. Had I known the answer, I would have told you.
Had the customers been travellers from other countries, I could have accepted it, but they were all English!
We had the party in the kitchen. Had the weather been better, we could have eaten outside.
The concert hall was half empty. Had the tickets been cheaper, more people could have come.
We had to walk the last two kilometres. Had the road been wider, the bus could have got through.
My brother loved sport as a boy. Had he been taller, he could have played basketball.
We went to the lake last Sunday. Had the water been warmer, the children could have swum.
Sometimes I think that had I gone to Britain without this experience, my life would have been different.
We lost the final by one goal. I believe that had we worked harder, we would have won.
My aunt didn't know about my exams. She said that had she known, she would have helped.
The bank sent me the wrong bill. They admitted that had they checked, they would have found the mistake.
Don't worry about Mum. I'm sure that had you asked, she would have said yes.
My uncle left medical school after a year. He told me that had he stayed, he would have become a doctor.
We spent the day at the museum. Had it not rained, we would have gone to the beach.
My sister was late for her interview. Had she not missed the train, she would have been on time.
I've lived here for ten years now. Had I not met you, I would never have come to this city.
The locals told us about the floods. Had they not warned us, we would have taken the dangerous road.
My husband acted quickly. Had he not called the doctor, the baby would have been in danger.
The town was full of tourists. Had we not booked early, we wouldn't have got a room.
The forest paths all looked the same. Had it not been for my compass, we would have walked in circles.
Had it not been for my teacher, I would have left school.
Had it not been for the rain, the match would have finished.
Had it not been for your advice, I would have made a big mistake.
Had it not been for the snow, we would have arrived yesterday.
Had it not been for her help, I would never have finished.
Had it not been for the dog, the thieves would have taken everything.

examples.heading: ① Had I known + 子句, + I would (not) have + 過去分詞：投訴和遺憾

items.en: The guide was always late and the hotel was dirty. Had I known the tour would be so bad, I wouldn't have booked it.
items.zh: 導遊總是遲到，飯店很髒。如果我早知道這個旅行團這麼糟，我就不會訂了。

items.en: I fell asleep in the cinema. Had I known the film was so long, I wouldn't have gone.
items.zh: 我在電影院睡著了。如果我早知道那部電影這麼長，我就不會去了。

items.en: I got very wet on the way home. Had I known it would rain, I would have brought an umbrella.
items.zh: 我回家路上淋得好濕。如果我早知道會下雨，我就會帶傘了。

items.en: I'm so sorry, I only heard today. Had I known your mother was in hospital, I would have sent her some flowers.
items.zh: 真抱歉，我今天才聽說。如果我早知道你媽媽住院了，我就會送她一些花。

items.en: Those shoes were half price. Had I known the shop was closing, I would have bought more.
items.zh: 那些鞋子打五折。如果我早知道那家店要關了，我就會多買一點。

items.en: Don't be angry with me after the quiz. Had I known the answer, I would have told you.
items.zh: 小考後別生我的氣。如果我知道答案，我就會告訴你了。

examples.heading: ② Had + 主詞 + been + 名詞或形容詞, + 主詞 + could have + 過去分詞

items.en: Had the customers been travellers from other countries, I could have accepted it, but they were all English!
items.zh: 如果那些客人是從其他國家來的旅客，我還可以接受，可是他們全都是英國人！

items.en: We had the party in the kitchen. Had the weather been better, we could have eaten outside.
items.zh: 我們在廚房開派對。如果天氣好一點，我們就可以在外面吃了。

items.en: The concert hall was half empty. Had the tickets been cheaper, more people could have come.
items.zh: 音樂廳一半是空的。如果票便宜一點，就可以有更多人來。

items.en: We had to walk the last two kilometres. Had the road been wider, the bus could have got through.
items.zh: 我們最後兩公里得用走的。如果路寬一點，公車就可以開過去了。

items.en: My brother loved sport as a boy. Had he been taller, he could have played basketball.
items.zh: 我哥哥小時候很愛運動。如果他高一點，他就可以打籃球了。

items.en: We went to the lake last Sunday. Had the water been warmer, the children could have swum.
items.zh: 我們上個星期天去湖邊。如果水暖一點，孩子們就可以游泳了。

examples.heading: ③ … that had + 主詞 + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞

items.en: Sometimes I think that had I gone to Britain without this experience, my life would have been different.
items.zh: 有時候我想，如果我沒有這段經驗就去英國，我的人生會不一樣。

items.en: We lost the final by one goal. I believe that had we worked harder, we would have won.
items.zh: 我們以一球之差輸了決賽。我相信如果我們更努力，我們就會贏了。

items.en: My aunt didn't know about my exams. She said that had she known, she would have helped.
items.zh: 我阿姨不知道我要考試。她說如果她早知道，她就會幫忙了。

items.en: The bank sent me the wrong bill. They admitted that had they checked, they would have found the mistake.
items.zh: 銀行寄給我錯的帳單。他們承認如果他們有檢查，就會發現那個錯誤。

items.en: Don't worry about Mum. I'm sure that had you asked, she would have said yes.
items.zh: 別擔心媽媽。我確定如果你問了，她就會答應了。

items.en: My uncle left medical school after a year. He told me that had he stayed, he would have become a doctor.
items.zh: 我叔叔念了一年醫學院就離開了。他告訴我如果他留下來，他就會成為醫生了。

examples.heading: ④ Had + 主詞 + not + 過去分詞, + 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞

items.en: We spent the day at the museum. Had it not rained, we would have gone to the beach.
items.zh: 我們在博物館待了一天。如果沒下雨，我們就會去海灘了。

items.en: My sister was late for her interview. Had she not missed the train, she would have been on time.
items.zh: 我姊姊面試遲到了。如果她沒錯過火車，她就會準時了。

items.en: I've lived here for ten years now. Had I not met you, I would never have come to this city.
items.zh: 我在這裡住了十年了。如果我沒遇到你，我永遠不會來這個城市。

items.en: The locals told us about the floods. Had they not warned us, we would have taken the dangerous road.
items.zh: 當地人跟我們說了淹水的事。如果他們沒警告我們，我們就會走那條危險的路了。

items.en: My husband acted quickly. Had he not called the doctor, the baby would have been in danger.
items.zh: 我先生反應很快。如果他沒打給醫生，寶寶就會有危險了。

items.en: The town was full of tourists. Had we not booked early, we wouldn't have got a room.
items.zh: 鎮上都是觀光客。如果我們沒早點訂，就不會有房間了。

examples.heading: ⑤ Had it not been for + 名詞, + 主詞 + would have + 過去分詞

items.en: The forest paths all looked the same. Had it not been for my compass, we would have walked in circles.
items.zh: 森林裡的小路看起來都一樣。要不是有我的指南針，我們就會一直繞圈子了。

items.en: Had it not been for my teacher, I would have left school.
items.zh: 要不是我的老師，我就會退學了。

items.en: Had it not been for the rain, the match would have finished.
items.zh: 要不是下雨，比賽就會打完了。

items.en: Had it not been for your advice, I would have made a big mistake.
items.zh: 要不是你的建議，我就會犯一個大錯了。

items.en: Had it not been for the snow, we would have arrived yesterday.
items.zh: 要不是下雪，我們昨天就會到了。

items.en: Had it not been for her help, I would never have finished.
items.zh: 要不是她的幫忙，我永遠不會完成。

items.en: Had it not been for the dog, the thieves would have taken everything.
items.zh: 要不是那隻狗，小偷就會把東西全偷走了。

title: Never before had we seen such marvellous species of fish.
translation: 我們以前從來沒見過這麼神奇的魚類。
name: never before 後的過去完成式倒裝
sentences: We dived on the reef for the first time. Never before had we seen such marvellous species of fish.
Never before had I seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never before had the village seen so much snow.
Never before had she seen such a huge crowd.
Never before had they seen a city so full of lights.
Never before had the children seen a real whale.
The bus left without us and our bags were on it. Never had I been in such a ridiculous situation!
Never had I been so frightened in my life.
Never had we been so happy as on that holiday.
Never had he been so tired after a match.
Never had she been so proud of her son.
Never had the town been so busy.
Never had I tasted such delicious bread.
Never had we heard such loud thunder.
Never had she felt so alone.
Never had they met such kind people.
Never had I read such a sad story.
Never had he worked so hard for anything.
Never before had I travelled alone.
Never before had the team won a cup.
Never before had my grandmother flown in a plane.
Never before had the school had so many new students.
Never before had we climbed such a high mountain.
Never before had he spoken in front of so many people.
We had never seen such colourful fish before.
I had never felt so nervous before an exam.
She had never eaten such a big breakfast before.
They had never stayed in such a luxurious hotel.
He had never driven such a fast car before.
The children had never played in snow before.
I had never laughed so much in my life.

examples.heading: ① Never before had + 主詞 + seen + such + 名詞：特別的景象

items.en: We dived on the reef for the first time. Never before had we seen such marvellous species of fish.
items.zh: 我們第一次在珊瑚礁潛水。我們以前從來沒看過這麼美妙的魚。

items.en: Never before had I seen such a beautiful sunset.
items.zh: 我以前從來沒看過這麼美的夕陽。

items.en: Never before had the village seen so much snow.
items.zh: 那個村子以前從來沒下過這麼多雪。

items.en: Never before had she seen such a huge crowd.
items.zh: 她以前從來沒看過這麼多人。

items.en: Never before had they seen a city so full of lights.
items.zh: 他們以前從來沒看過燈火這麼多的城市。

items.en: Never before had the children seen a real whale.
items.zh: 孩子們以前從來沒看過真的鯨魚。

examples.heading: ② Never had + 主詞 + been + in such + 名詞!：特別的情況

items.en: The bus left without us and our bags were on it. Never had I been in such a ridiculous situation!
items.zh: 巴士載著我們的行李開走了，把我們丟下。我從來沒遇過這麼荒謬的情況！

items.en: Never had I been so frightened in my life.
items.zh: 我這輩子從來沒這麼害怕過。

items.en: Never had we been so happy as on that holiday.
items.zh: 我們從來沒有像那次假期那麼快樂過。

items.en: Never had he been so tired after a match.
items.zh: 他比賽完從來沒這麼累過。

items.en: Never had she been so proud of her son.
items.zh: 她從來沒有這麼以她兒子為榮過。

items.en: Never had the town been so busy.
items.zh: 這個鎮從來沒有這麼熱鬧過。

examples.heading: ③ Never had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + so + 形容詞 / such + 名詞

items.en: Never had I tasted such delicious bread.
items.zh: 我從來沒吃過這麼好吃的麵包。

items.en: Never had we heard such loud thunder.
items.zh: 我們從來沒聽過這麼大的雷聲。

items.en: Never had she felt so alone.
items.zh: 她從來沒有覺得這麼孤單。

items.en: Never had they met such kind people.
items.zh: 他們從來沒遇過這麼親切的人。

items.en: Never had I read such a sad story.
items.zh: 我從來沒讀過這麼悲傷的故事。

items.en: Never had he worked so hard for anything.
items.zh: 他從來沒有為任何事這麼努力過。

examples.heading: ④ Never before had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + 名詞：第一次的經驗

items.en: Never before had I travelled alone.
items.zh: 我以前從來沒有一個人旅行過。

items.en: Never before had the team won a cup.
items.zh: 那支球隊以前從來沒贏過獎盃。

items.en: Never before had my grandmother flown in a plane.
items.zh: 我奶奶以前從來沒坐過飛機。

items.en: Never before had the school had so many new students.
items.zh: 那所學校以前從來沒有這麼多新生。

items.en: Never before had we climbed such a high mountain.
items.zh: 我們以前從來沒爬過這麼高的山。

items.en: Never before had he spoken in front of so many people.
items.zh: 他以前從來沒有在這麼多人面前說話。

examples.heading: ⑤ 一般順序：主詞 + had never + 過去分詞 + before

items.en: We had never seen such colourful fish before.
items.zh: 我們以前從來沒看過這麼鮮豔的魚。

items.en: I had never felt so nervous before an exam.
items.zh: 我考試前從來沒這麼緊張過。

items.en: She had never eaten such a big breakfast before.
items.zh: 她以前從來沒吃過這麼豐盛的早餐。

items.en: They had never stayed in such a luxurious hotel.
items.zh: 他們從來沒住過這麼豪華的飯店。

items.en: He had never driven such a fast car before.
items.zh: 他以前從來沒開過這麼快的車。

items.en: The children had never played in snow before.
items.zh: 孩子們以前從來沒在雪地裡玩過。

items.en: I had never laughed so much in my life.
items.zh: 我這輩子從來沒笑得這麼多。

title: No sooner had I gone to bed than someone broke the door down.
translation: 我才剛上床睡覺，就有人把門撞破了。
name: no sooner … than 的過去完成式倒裝
sentences: I was exhausted after the long climb. No sooner had I gone to bed than someone broke the door down.
No sooner had I closed my eyes than the baby started to cry.
No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
No sooner had I left the house than it began to pour.
No sooner had I paid for the dress than I saw it cheaper in another shop.
No sooner had I started my new job than the company closed.
I was worried about my exam. But no sooner had I got to school than my classmates told me that I had passed.
No sooner had we got to the beach than the sun disappeared.
No sooner had she got home than her friends arrived.
No sooner had they got to the station than the train left.
No sooner had he got into the car than he realised he had lost his keys.
No sooner had we got off the plane than we felt the heat.
No sooner had we started the picnic than it began to rain.
No sooner had the match begun than the lights went out.
No sooner had the plane taken off than the storm hit.
No sooner had she painted the fence than the dog jumped on it.
No sooner had they built the bridge than the river flooded.
No sooner had the farmer cut the hay than a terrible storm swept across the fields.
No sooner had I said his name than he walked through the door.
No sooner had she promised to be quiet than she started talking again.
No sooner had the teacher explained the rules than someone broke them.
No sooner had he said he wasn't hungry than he ate three sandwiches.
No sooner had we decided to go than the tickets sold out.
No sooner had she told me the secret than she asked me to forget it.
As soon as I went to bed, someone knocked on the door.
As soon as we arrived, the party started.
As soon as she opened the window, the cat jumped out.
As soon as the bell rang, the children ran outside.
As soon as he heard the news, he called his mother.
As soon as I sat down, the waiter brought the menu.
As soon as the sun came out, the beach filled with people.

examples.heading: ① No sooner had I + 過去分詞 + than + 句子：故事的轉折

items.en: I was exhausted after the long climb. No sooner had I gone to bed than someone broke the door down.
items.zh: 爬了很久的山，我累壞了。我才剛上床，就有人把門撞破了。

items.en: No sooner had I closed my eyes than the baby started to cry.
items.zh: 我才剛閉上眼睛，寶寶就開始哭了。

items.en: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
items.zh: 我才剛坐下，電話就響了。

items.en: No sooner had I left the house than it began to pour.
items.zh: 我才剛出門，就開始下大雨了。

items.en: No sooner had I paid for the dress than I saw it cheaper in another shop.
items.zh: 我才剛付完洋裝的錢，就在另一家店看到更便宜的。

items.en: No sooner had I started my new job than the company closed.
items.zh: 我才剛開始新工作，公司就倒了。

examples.heading: ② No sooner had I got + 地方 + than + 句子：一到就發生

items.en: I was worried about my exam. But no sooner had I got to school than my classmates told me that I had passed.
items.zh: 我很擔心我的考試。可是我一到學校，同學們就告訴我我通過了。

items.en: No sooner had we got to the beach than the sun disappeared.
items.zh: 我們一到海灘，太陽就不見了。

items.en: No sooner had she got home than her friends arrived.
items.zh: 她一到家，她的朋友就來了。

items.en: No sooner had they got to the station than the train left.
items.zh: 他們一到車站，火車就開走了。

items.en: No sooner had he got into the car than he realised he had lost his keys.
items.zh: 他一上車，就發現他的鑰匙不見了。

items.en: No sooner had we got off the plane than we felt the heat.
items.zh: 我們一下飛機，就感覺到熱氣。

examples.heading: ③ No sooner had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + than + 天氣或意外

items.en: No sooner had we started the picnic than it began to rain.
items.zh: 我們才剛開始野餐，就開始下雨了。

items.en: No sooner had the match begun than the lights went out.
items.zh: 比賽才剛開始，燈就熄了。

items.en: No sooner had the plane taken off than the storm hit.
items.zh: 飛機才剛起飛，暴風雨就來了。

items.en: No sooner had she painted the fence than the dog jumped on it.
items.zh: 她才剛油漆好圍籬，狗就跳到上面了。

items.en: No sooner had they built the bridge than the river flooded.
items.zh: 他們才剛蓋好橋，河就氾濫了。

items.en: No sooner had the farmer cut the hay than a terrible storm swept across the fields.
items.zh: 農夫才剛割完乾草，一場可怕的暴風雨就橫掃了田野。

examples.heading: ④ No sooner had + 主詞 + said + than + 句子：話剛說完

items.en: No sooner had I said his name than he walked through the door.
items.zh: 我才剛說到他的名字，他就走進門了。

items.en: No sooner had she promised to be quiet than she started talking again.
items.zh: 她才剛答應要安靜，就又開始說話了。

items.en: No sooner had the teacher explained the rules than someone broke them.
items.zh: 老師才剛解釋完規定，就有人違反了。

items.en: No sooner had he said he wasn't hungry than he ate three sandwiches.
items.zh: 他才剛說他不餓，就吃了三個三明治。

items.en: No sooner had we decided to go than the tickets sold out.
items.zh: 我們才剛決定要去，票就賣完了。

items.en: No sooner had she told me the secret than she asked me to forget it.
items.zh: 她才剛把秘密告訴我，就叫我忘掉它。

examples.heading: ⑤ As soon as + 主詞 + 過去式, + 主詞 + 過去式：一般的說法

items.en: As soon as I went to bed, someone knocked on the door.
items.zh: 我一上床，就有人敲門。

items.en: As soon as we arrived, the party started.
items.zh: 我們一到，派對就開始了。

items.en: As soon as she opened the window, the cat jumped out.
items.zh: 她一打開窗戶，貓就跳出去了。

items.en: As soon as the bell rang, the children ran outside.
items.zh: 鐘一響，孩子們就跑到外面。

items.en: As soon as he heard the news, he called his mother.
items.zh: 他一聽到消息，就打電話給他媽媽。

items.en: As soon as I sat down, the waiter brought the menu.
items.zh: 我一坐下，服務生就拿菜單來了。

items.en: As soon as the sun came out, the beach filled with people.
items.zh: 太陽一出來，海灘就擠滿了人。

title: She has already won three gold medals at international tournaments.
translation: 她已經在國際賽事拿過三面金牌了。
name: 現在完成式加 already
sentences: Don't worry about Mum's birthday. I've already planned the party.
You can throw out the old chair. We've already bought a new armchair.
My neighbours got the keys on Friday. They've already moved into their new house.
Not the fishing trip again, Grandpa. You've already told me that story.
Put your coat on. I've already called a taxi.
The wedding is still four months away, and we've already spent half our budget.
Sorry, Dad isn't here. He's already left for work.
My daughter loves the Harry Potter books. She has already read the whole series.
We should go home now. It's already started to get dark.
We don't need to sign him up for lessons. My son has already learned to swim.
He only started in May. The new manager has already changed a lot of things.
It's only March, and we've already used up our holiday days.
She's only twenty, but she has already written two novels.
It's only October, and the shop has already put up its Christmas decorations.
She's only six months old, and our baby has already got four teeth.
I've only been here a week, and I've already made lots of friends.
Put your wallet away. Don't worry, I've already paid.
You don't need to cook. I've already ordered pizza.
We've already seen this film. Let's watch something else.
Stop shouting at Ben. He's already apologized twice.
Check your phone for the party details. I've already sent you the address.
Sit down and relax. I've already cleaned the kitchen and done the shopping.
You've just missed your friend. She has already packed her bags and checked out.
You can stay in bed. We've already fed the dog and taken him for a walk.
I made that cake an hour ago. Have you eaten it all already?
I can hear the car outside. Have the guests arrived already?
Where's Tom? It's only eight. He's gone home already?
I gave it to you yesterday. You've finished the book already?
The flight isn't due until six. Has the plane already landed?
The deadline is next Friday. Has your sister already handed in her essay?

examples.heading: ① I / we / you / they + have already + 過去分詞

items.en: Don't worry about Mum's birthday. I've already planned the party.
items.zh: 媽媽的生日你別擔心。派對我已經計畫好了。

items.en: You can throw out the old chair. We've already bought a new armchair.
items.zh: 你可以把舊椅子丟掉。我們已經買了一張新的扶手椅。

items.en: My neighbours got the keys on Friday. They've already moved into their new house.
items.zh: 我的鄰居星期五拿到鑰匙。他們已經搬進新房子了。

items.en: Not the fishing trip again, Grandpa. You've already told me that story.
items.zh: 爺爺，又是釣魚那次啊。那個故事你已經跟我說過了。

items.en: Put your coat on. I've already called a taxi.
items.zh: 把外套穿上。我已經叫計程車了。

items.en: The wedding is still four months away, and we've already spent half our budget.
items.zh: 婚禮還有四個月，我們已經花掉一半的預算了。

examples.heading: ② he / she / it + has already + 過去分詞

items.en: Sorry, Dad isn't here. He's already left for work.
items.zh: 抱歉，爸爸不在。他已經去上班了。

items.en: My daughter loves the Harry Potter books. She has already read the whole series.
items.zh: 我女兒很愛哈利波特。那整套書她已經看完了。

items.en: We should go home now. It's already started to get dark.
items.zh: 我們該回家了。天已經開始黑了。

items.en: We don't need to sign him up for lessons. My son has already learned to swim.
items.zh: 我們不用幫他報名游泳課。我兒子已經學會游泳了。

items.en: He only started in May. The new manager has already changed a lot of things.
items.zh: 他五月才來。新經理已經改了很多事情。

examples.heading: ③ 比預期早

items.en: It's only March, and we've already used up our holiday days.
items.zh: 現在才三月，我們的假已經休完了。

items.en: She's only twenty, but she has already written two novels.
items.zh: 她才二十歲，就已經寫了兩本小說。

items.en: It's only October, and the shop has already put up its Christmas decorations.
items.zh: 現在才十月，這家店已經掛上聖誕節的裝飾了。

items.en: She's only six months old, and our baby has already got four teeth.
items.zh: 我們的寶寶才六個月大，就已經長了四顆牙。

items.en: I've only been here a week, and I've already made lots of friends.
items.zh: 我才來一個禮拜，就已經交到很多朋友了。

examples.heading: ④ 不用再做了

items.en: Put your wallet away. Don't worry, I've already paid.
items.zh: 把錢包收起來。別擔心，我已經付過了。

items.en: You don't need to cook. I've already ordered pizza.
items.zh: 你不用煮了，我已經叫了披薩。

items.en: We've already seen this film. Let's watch something else.
items.zh: 這部電影我們已經看過了，看別的吧。

items.en: Stop shouting at Ben. He's already apologized twice.
items.zh: 別再對班大吼了。他已經道過兩次歉了。

items.en: Check your phone for the party details. I've already sent you the address.
items.zh: 看一下手機上派對的資料。地址我已經傳給你了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 好幾件做完的事

items.en: Sit down and relax. I've already cleaned the kitchen and done the shopping.
items.zh: 坐下來休息吧。我已經打掃好廚房，也買完東西了。

items.en: You've just missed your friend. She has already packed her bags and checked out.
items.zh: 你剛好錯過你朋友。她已經收好行李，也退房了。

items.en: You can stay in bed. We've already fed the dog and taken him for a walk.
items.zh: 你可以繼續睡。我們已經餵過狗，也帶牠去散步了。

examples.heading: ⑥ already 放在句尾：驚訝

items.en: I made that cake an hour ago. Have you eaten it all already?
items.zh: 那個蛋糕我一個小時前才做好。你已經全部吃完了？

items.en: I can hear the car outside. Have the guests arrived already?
items.zh: 我聽到外面有車子的聲音。客人已經到了？

items.en: Where's Tom? It's only eight. He's gone home already?
items.zh: 湯姆呢？才八點。他已經回家了？

items.en: I gave it to you yesterday. You've finished the book already?
items.zh: 我昨天才給你的。你已經把書看完了？

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句：Have you already ...?

items.en: The flight isn't due until six. Has the plane already landed?
items.zh: 班機要六點才到。飛機已經降落了？

items.en: The deadline is next Friday. Has your sister already handed in her essay?
items.zh: 截止日是下個星期五。你姊姊已經交報告了？

title: I have to tell you that I still haven't decided.
translation: 我得跟你說，我還沒決定。
name: still 加現在完成式的否定句
sentences: I still haven't finished my essay.
We still haven't found a flat.
They still haven't fixed the road outside our house.
You still haven't answered my question.
I still haven't read the book you lent me.
My parents still haven't met my girlfriend.
We still haven't heard from the bank.
My order still hasn't arrived.
He still hasn't paid me back.
The bus still hasn't come.
She still hasn't replied to my message.
The landlord still hasn't fixed the shower.
My brother still hasn't learned to drive.
The plumber still hasn't turned up.
The council still has not repaired the bridge.
We still have not received your reply.
The airline still has not refunded my ticket.
The police still have not found the missing boy.
The school still has not explained the decision.
It's been three weeks and I still haven't got my results.
We ordered an hour ago, and our food still hasn't come.
I sent the form in May, and they still haven't answered.
She moved here two years ago, but she still hasn't made any friends.
He promised to call, but he still hasn't.
Have they still not sent the invoice?
Has he still not called you?
Have the builders still not finished?
Honestly, I still haven't got used to the cold here.
My son still hasn't tidied his room, even after I asked twice.
Sorry, I still haven't had time to look at your photos.
My boss still hasn't signed the contract.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + still + haven't + 過去分詞

items.en: I still haven't finished my essay.
items.zh: 我的報告到現在還沒寫完。

items.en: We still haven't found a flat.
items.zh: 我們到現在還沒找到房子。

items.en: They still haven't fixed the road outside our house.
items.zh: 我們家外面的路他們到現在還沒修好。

items.en: You still haven't answered my question.
items.zh: 你到現在還沒回答我的問題。

items.en: I still haven't read the book you lent me.
items.zh: 你借我的書我到現在還沒看。

items.en: My parents still haven't met my girlfriend.
items.zh: 我爸媽到現在還沒見過我女朋友。

items.en: We still haven't heard from the bank.
items.zh: 銀行到現在還沒有消息。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + still + hasn't + 過去分詞

items.en: My order still hasn't arrived.
items.zh: 我訂的東西到現在還沒到。

items.en: He still hasn't paid me back.
items.zh: 他到現在還沒還我錢。

items.en: The bus still hasn't come.
items.zh: 公車到現在還沒來。

items.en: She still hasn't replied to my message.
items.zh: 她到現在還沒回我訊息。

items.en: The landlord still hasn't fixed the shower.
items.zh: 房東到現在還沒修好淋浴間。

items.en: My brother still hasn't learned to drive.
items.zh: 我哥到現在還不會開車。

items.en: The plumber still hasn't turned up.
items.zh: 水電工到現在還沒出現。

examples.heading: ③ 正式的完整形式：still + have not / has not

items.en: The council still has not repaired the bridge.
items.zh: 議會到現在還沒修好那座橋。

items.en: We still have not received your reply.
items.zh: 我們到現在還沒收到您的回覆。

items.en: The airline still has not refunded my ticket.
items.zh: 航空公司到現在還沒退我的機票錢。

items.en: The police still have not found the missing boy.
items.zh: 警方到現在還沒找到那個失蹤的男孩。

items.en: The school still has not explained the decision.
items.zh: 學校到現在還沒解釋這個決定。

examples.heading: ④ 等了一段時間

items.en: It's been three weeks and I still haven't got my results.
items.zh: 已經三個禮拜了，我到現在還沒拿到成績。

items.en: We ordered an hour ago, and our food still hasn't come.
items.zh: 我們一個小時前就點了，菜到現在還沒來。

items.en: I sent the form in May, and they still haven't answered.
items.zh: 我五月就把表格寄出去了，他們到現在還沒回覆。

items.en: She moved here two years ago, but she still hasn't made any friends.
items.zh: 她兩年前搬來這裡，可是到現在還沒交到朋友。

items.en: He promised to call, but he still hasn't.
items.zh: 他答應要打電話，可是到現在還沒打。

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問句：Have / Has + 主詞 + still not + 過去分詞

items.en: Have they still not sent the invoice?
items.zh: 他們到現在還沒寄發票嗎？

items.en: Has he still not called you?
items.zh: 他到現在還沒打給你嗎？

items.en: Have the builders still not finished?
items.zh: 工人到現在還沒做完嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 說話者覺得太久了

items.en: Honestly, I still haven't got used to the cold here.
items.zh: 說真的，我到現在還不習慣這裡的冷。

items.en: My son still hasn't tidied his room, even after I asked twice.
items.zh: 我叫了兩次，我兒子到現在還沒整理房間。

items.en: Sorry, I still haven't had time to look at your photos.
items.zh: 抱歉，我到現在還沒空看你的照片。

items.en: My boss still hasn't signed the contract.
items.zh: 我老闆到現在還沒簽合約。

title: I was always dreaming about getting a kitten.
translation: 我剛剛在看足球比賽。
name: 過去進行式加句中副詞（常用副詞）
sentences: Sorry I didn't answer. I was just watching a football match and the TV was loud.
I was just leaving the house when it started to rain.
We were just sitting down to dinner when the doorbell rang.
She was just getting into the bath when her phone rang.
I was just thinking about you when your message arrived.
They were just closing the shop when we got there.
I wanted a kitten for years. I was always dreaming about it.
My brother was always playing football in the garden.
She was always reading when she was a child.
My grandfather was always telling us stories about the war.
We were always arguing about who could use the computer.
He was always losing his keys and his phone.
At midnight the neighbours were still playing loud music.
When I got home, my sister was still doing her homework.
The baby was still crying at three in the morning.
It was still raining when we left the cinema.
They were still waiting for the bus an hour later.
I was still feeling sick the next morning.
I was really enjoying the film until the ending.
We were really looking forward to the trip.
She was really trying to be friendly.
The team was really playing well in the first half.
I was really hoping you would come.
They were really working hard before the exams.
I was only joking when I said that.
He was quietly reading when the lights went out.
We were happily eating lunch when the storm began.
She was carefully painting the window when she fell off the ladder.
The children were peacefully sleeping when the alarm went off.
I was slowly walking home when I saw an old friend.
They were nervously waiting outside when the doctor came out.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was / were + just + -ing：剛好正在

items.en: Sorry I didn't answer. I was just watching a football match and the TV was loud.
items.zh: 抱歉我沒接電話。我剛好在看足球比賽，電視很大聲。

items.en: I was just leaving the house when it started to rain.
items.zh: 我剛要出門的時候就開始下雨了。

items.en: We were just sitting down to dinner when the doorbell rang.
items.zh: 我們剛坐下來吃晚餐的時候，門鈴就響了。

items.en: She was just getting into the bath when her phone rang.
items.zh: 她剛要進浴缸的時候，手機就響了。

items.en: I was just thinking about you when your message arrived.
items.zh: 你的訊息來的時候，我剛好在想你。

items.en: They were just closing the shop when we got there.
items.zh: 我們到的時候，他們剛好在關店。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + was / were + always + -ing：過去一直在做

items.en: I wanted a kitten for years. I was always dreaming about it.
items.zh: 我想要一隻小貓想了好幾年。我總是夢想著能養一隻。

items.en: My brother was always playing football in the garden.
items.zh: 我哥哥以前總是在花園裡踢足球。

items.en: She was always reading when she was a child.
items.zh: 她小時候總是在看書。

items.en: My grandfather was always telling us stories about the war.
items.zh: 我爺爺以前總是跟我們講戰爭的故事。

items.en: We were always arguing about who could use the computer.
items.zh: 我們以前總是在吵誰可以用電腦。

items.en: He was always losing his keys and his phone.
items.zh: 他以前總是在弄丟鑰匙和手機。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + was / were + still + -ing：還在

items.en: At midnight the neighbours were still playing loud music.
items.zh: 半夜的時候，鄰居還在放很大聲的音樂。

items.en: When I got home, my sister was still doing her homework.
items.zh: 我回到家的時候，我姊姊還在寫功課。

items.en: The baby was still crying at three in the morning.
items.zh: 凌晨三點寶寶還在哭。

items.en: It was still raining when we left the cinema.
items.zh: 我們離開電影院的時候還在下雨。

items.en: They were still waiting for the bus an hour later.
items.zh: 一個小時以後他們還在等公車。

items.en: I was still feeling sick the next morning.
items.zh: 隔天早上我還是覺得不舒服。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + was / were + really + -ing：真的在

items.en: I was really enjoying the film until the ending.
items.zh: 在結局之前，我真的很喜歡那部電影。

items.en: We were really looking forward to the trip.
items.zh: 我們真的很期待那次旅行。

items.en: She was really trying to be friendly.
items.zh: 她真的很努力想表現得友善。

items.en: The team was really playing well in the first half.
items.zh: 球隊上半場真的踢得很好。

items.en: I was really hoping you would come.
items.zh: 我真的很希望你會來。

items.en: They were really working hard before the exams.
items.zh: 考試前他們真的很用功。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + was / were + 副詞 + -ing + when + 子句

items.en: I was only joking when I said that.
items.zh: 我那樣說的時候只是在開玩笑。

items.en: He was quietly reading when the lights went out.
items.zh: 燈熄的時候，他正在安靜地看書。

items.en: We were happily eating lunch when the storm began.
items.zh: 暴風雨開始的時候，我們正開心地吃著午餐。

items.en: She was carefully painting the window when she fell off the ladder.
items.zh: 她小心地油漆窗戶的時候，從梯子上掉下來了。

items.en: The children were peacefully sleeping when the alarm went off.
items.zh: 警報響的時候，孩子們正在安穩地睡覺。

items.en: I was slowly walking home when I saw an old friend.
items.zh: 我慢慢走回家的時候，看到一個老朋友。

items.en: They were nervously waiting outside when the doctor came out.
items.zh: 醫生出來的時候，他們正在外面緊張地等待。

title: He was actually acting like a ghost.
translation: 他還在紅綠燈那裡等。
name: 過去進行式加句中副詞（較多種副詞）
sentences: The light had turned green, but the old man was still waiting at the crossing.
When I woke up at noon, my brother was still sleeping.
The guests were still arriving when dinner started.
At ten o'clock she was still working on her essay.
The workers were still building the bridge a year later.
The band was still playing when we left the party.
On Halloween my brother hid in the garden under a white sheet. He was actually acting like a ghost.
I thought she was angry, but she was actually laughing.
The dog looked asleep, but it was actually watching us.
We thought they were arguing, but they were actually practising a play.
He looked busy, but he was actually playing games on his computer.
I was actually enjoying the rain until I fell in a puddle.
When we got to the cinema, the film was already starting.
By six o'clock, people were already queuing outside the shop.
When I arrived, my friends were already eating.
By March, the farmers were already planting their crops.
When the head teacher walked into the hall, the choir was already singing.
By lunchtime, the snow was already melting.
I didn't answer because I was probably cycling home.
When you called, they were probably having dinner.
She didn't see you because she was probably reading.
At that time, my dad was probably driving to work.
The children were probably playing in the park.
He was probably sleeping when the storm started.
The baby was finally sleeping after hours of crying.
The sun was slowly going down behind the hills.
We were happily walking along the beach when it started to rain.
He was secretly planning a surprise party for his wife.
The children were quietly drawing at the kitchen table.
She was nervously waiting for her exam results.
They were patiently queuing for the museum to open.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was / were + still + -ing：還在

items.en: The light had turned green, but the old man was still waiting at the crossing.
items.zh: 燈已經變綠了，可是那個老人還在斑馬線前等著。

items.en: When I woke up at noon, my brother was still sleeping.
items.zh: 我中午醒來的時候，我哥哥還在睡覺。

items.en: The guests were still arriving when dinner started.
items.zh: 晚餐開始的時候客人還在陸續到來。

items.en: At ten o'clock she was still working on her essay.
items.zh: 十點的時候她還在寫作文。

items.en: The workers were still building the bridge a year later.
items.zh: 一年以後工人還在蓋那座橋。

items.en: The band was still playing when we left the party.
items.zh: 我們離開派對的時候樂團還在演奏。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + was / were + actually + -ing：其實是

items.en: On Halloween my brother hid in the garden under a white sheet. He was actually acting like a ghost.
items.zh: 萬聖節晚上我哥哥披著白床單躲在花園裡。他其實是在扮鬼。

items.en: I thought she was angry, but she was actually laughing.
items.zh: 我以為她在生氣，可是她其實是在笑。

items.en: The dog looked asleep, but it was actually watching us.
items.zh: 那隻狗看起來在睡覺，可是牠其實在看著我們。

items.en: We thought they were arguing, but they were actually practising a play.
items.zh: 我們以為他們在吵架，可是他們其實是在排練一齣戲。

items.en: He looked busy, but he was actually playing games on his computer.
items.zh: 他看起來很忙，可是他其實在電腦上打電動。

items.en: I was actually enjoying the rain until I fell in a puddle.
items.zh: 我其實很享受那場雨，直到我掉進一個水坑。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + was / were + already + -ing：已經在

items.en: When we got to the cinema, the film was already starting.
items.zh: 我們到電影院的時候，電影已經開始了。

items.en: By six o'clock, people were already queuing outside the shop.
items.zh: 六點的時候，人們已經在店外排隊了。

items.en: When I arrived, my friends were already eating.
items.zh: 我到的時候，我的朋友們已經在吃了。

items.en: By March, the farmers were already planting their crops.
items.zh: 到三月的時候，農夫們已經在種作物了。

items.en: When the head teacher walked into the hall, the choir was already singing.
items.zh: 校長走進禮堂的時候，合唱團已經在唱了。

items.en: By lunchtime, the snow was already melting.
items.zh: 到午餐的時候，雪已經在融化了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + was / were + probably + -ing：大概在

items.en: I didn't answer because I was probably cycling home.
items.zh: 我沒接，因為我大概在騎腳踏車回家。

items.en: When you called, they were probably having dinner.
items.zh: 你打來的時候，他們大概在吃晚餐。

items.en: She didn't see you because she was probably reading.
items.zh: 她沒看到你，因為她大概在看書。

items.en: At that time, my dad was probably driving to work.
items.zh: 那時候，我爸爸大概在開車上班。

items.en: The children were probably playing in the park.
items.zh: 孩子們大概在公園裡玩。

items.en: He was probably sleeping when the storm started.
items.zh: 暴風雨開始的時候他大概在睡覺。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + was / were + 副詞 + -ing：其他常用的副詞

items.en: The baby was finally sleeping after hours of crying.
items.zh: 哭了好幾個小時以後，寶寶終於在睡覺了。

items.en: The sun was slowly going down behind the hills.
items.zh: 太陽正慢慢地落到山丘後面。

items.en: We were happily walking along the beach when it started to rain.
items.zh: 我們正開心地沿著海灘散步，這時開始下雨了。

items.en: He was secretly planning a surprise party for his wife.
items.zh: 他正偷偷地為他太太計畫一個驚喜派對。

items.en: The children were quietly drawing at the kitchen table.
items.zh: 孩子們正安靜地在廚房的桌子上畫畫。

items.en: She was nervously waiting for her exam results.
items.zh: 她正緊張地等著她的考試結果。

items.en: They were patiently queuing for the museum to open.
items.zh: 他們正耐心地排隊等博物館開門。

title: My younger brother was constantly bothering me.
translation: 我弟弟老是在煩我。
name: 過去進行式與副詞的位置
sentences: I was trying to study for my exams, but my younger brother was constantly bothering me.
The phone was constantly ringing in the office.
The children were constantly asking for sweets.
My neighbour's dog was constantly barking at night.
The prices were constantly going up that year.
She was constantly checking her phone during dinner.
After the long winter, the days were gradually getting longer.
The water in the river was gradually rising.
My English was gradually improving.
The village was gradually becoming a busy town.
The pain in my leg was gradually going away.
The crowd was gradually getting bigger.
She was desperately trying to find her lost keys.
The players were desperately trying to score in the last minute.
He was desperately looking for a job.
We were desperately hoping for good news.
The firefighters were desperately fighting the fire.
I was desperately waiting for the bus in the rain.
One evening, as she was wistfully walking in the dusk, she made a decision about her life.
The old man was sadly looking at the photo of his wife.
The children were happily running along the beach.
He was nervously waiting outside the headmaster's office.
She was proudly showing everyone her new baby.
They were anxiously watching the sky for signs of rain.
The machine was continually breaking down.
My parents were continually telling me to study harder.
The rules were continually changing.
He was continually arriving late for meetings.
The team was continually losing its best players.
She was continually moving from one city to another.
The roof was continually leaking in winter.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was / were + constantly + -ing：一直不停

items.en: I was trying to study for my exams, but my younger brother was constantly bothering me.
items.zh: 我在準備考試，可是我弟弟一直在煩我。

items.en: The phone was constantly ringing in the office.
items.zh: 辦公室的電話一直響個不停。

items.en: The children were constantly asking for sweets.
items.zh: 孩子們一直在要糖果。

items.en: My neighbour's dog was constantly barking at night.
items.zh: 我鄰居的狗晚上一直叫個不停。

items.en: The prices were constantly going up that year.
items.zh: 那一年物價一直在上漲。

items.en: She was constantly checking her phone during dinner.
items.zh: 她吃晚餐的時候一直在看手機。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + was / were + gradually + -ing：漸漸改變

items.en: After the long winter, the days were gradually getting longer.
items.zh: 漫長的冬天過後，白天漸漸變長了。

items.en: The water in the river was gradually rising.
items.zh: 河水漸漸在上漲。

items.en: My English was gradually improving.
items.zh: 我的英文漸漸在進步。

items.en: The village was gradually becoming a busy town.
items.zh: 那個村子漸漸變成一個熱鬧的小鎮。

items.en: The pain in my leg was gradually going away.
items.zh: 我腳上的痛漸漸在消退。

items.en: The crowd was gradually getting bigger.
items.zh: 人群漸漸變多了。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + was / were + desperately + -ing：拚命地

items.en: She was desperately trying to find her lost keys.
items.zh: 她拚命地在找她弄丟的鑰匙。

items.en: The players were desperately trying to score in the last minute.
items.zh: 球員們在最後一分鐘拚命地想進球。

items.en: He was desperately looking for a job.
items.zh: 他拚命地在找工作。

items.en: We were desperately hoping for good news.
items.zh: 我們拚命地希望有好消息。

items.en: The firefighters were desperately fighting the fire.
items.zh: 消防員拚命地在滅火。

items.en: I was desperately waiting for the bus in the rain.
items.zh: 我在雨中拚命地等公車。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + was / were + 副詞 + -ing：故事裡的心情

items.en: One evening, as she was wistfully walking in the dusk, she made a decision about her life.
items.zh: 有一天傍晚，她帶著惆悵在黃昏中散步時，她為自己的人生做了一個決定。

items.en: The old man was sadly looking at the photo of his wife.
items.zh: 那個老人悲傷地看著他太太的照片。

items.en: The children were happily running along the beach.
items.zh: 孩子們開心地沿著海灘跑。

items.en: He was nervously waiting outside the headmaster's office.
items.zh: 他緊張地在校長辦公室外面等。

items.en: She was proudly showing everyone her new baby.
items.zh: 她驕傲地讓每個人看她的新寶寶。

items.en: They were anxiously watching the sky for signs of rain.
items.zh: 他們焦急地看著天空，看會不會下雨。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + was / were + continually + -ing：一再發生

items.en: The machine was continually breaking down.
items.zh: 那台機器一再故障。

items.en: My parents were continually telling me to study harder.
items.zh: 我爸媽一再叫我更用功。

items.en: The rules were continually changing.
items.zh: 規定一再改變。

items.en: He was continually arriving late for meetings.
items.zh: 他開會一再遲到。

items.en: The team was continually losing its best players.
items.zh: 那支球隊一再失去它最好的球員。

items.en: She was continually moving from one city to another.
items.zh: 她一再從一個城市搬到另一個城市。

items.en: The roof was continually leaking in winter.
items.zh: 冬天屋頂一再漏水。

title: I had been working hard at my job, and I had really been looking forward to this holiday.
translation: 我一直很努力工作，也真的很期待這次的假期。
name: 過去完成進行式與副詞的位置
sentences: I had been working hard all year, and I had really been looking forward to this holiday.
She had really been enjoying the course until the teacher left.
We had really been hoping for a sunny day.
He had really been trying to stop smoking.
The children had really been looking forward to the zoo trip.
I had really been missing my family.
When he died, he was a rich man, but he had only been living in his new house for ten months.
We had only been driving for ten minutes when the car broke down.
She had only been working there for a week when she got sick.
I had only been sleeping for an hour when the alarm went off.
They had only been dating for a month when they got engaged.
He had only been learning English for a year, but he spoke very well.
She had always been dreaming of living in Paris.
My father had always been working too hard.
They had always been talking about opening a restaurant.
I had always been hoping to meet her one day.
The old man had always been walking his dog in the park at six.
He had always been saving for a trip around the world.
I had just been talking about you when you walked in.
She had just been thinking of calling him when he called her.
We had just been watching the news when the lights went out.
They had just been swimming when the storm started.
He had just been reading about the town when he saw it on TV.
I had just been cleaning the kitchen when the dog came in with muddy feet.
She had been secretly planning a surprise party for weeks.
The water had been slowly rising all night.
He had been quietly saving money for a new guitar.
They had been happily living in the village for years.
The baby had been peacefully sleeping until the doorbell rang.
I had been patiently waiting for my turn for an hour.
She had been carefully writing her diary every night.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + had really been + -ing：真的一直在

items.en: I had been working hard all year, and I had really been looking forward to this holiday.
items.zh: 我一整年都工作得很辛苦，而且我真的一直很期待這個假期。

items.en: She had really been enjoying the course until the teacher left.
items.zh: 在老師離開之前，她真的一直很喜歡那門課。

items.en: We had really been hoping for a sunny day.
items.zh: 我們真的一直希望會是晴天。

items.en: He had really been trying to stop smoking.
items.zh: 他真的一直在努力戒菸。

items.en: The children had really been looking forward to the zoo trip.
items.zh: 孩子們真的一直很期待去動物園。

items.en: I had really been missing my family.
items.zh: 我真的一直很想念我的家人。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + had only been + -ing + for + 時間：才做了多久

items.en: When he died, he was a rich man, but he had only been living in his new house for ten months.
items.zh: 他去世的時候是個有錢人，可是他在他的新房子裡才住了十個月。

items.en: We had only been driving for ten minutes when the car broke down.
items.zh: 我們才開了十分鐘的車，車子就拋錨了。

items.en: She had only been working there for a week when she got sick.
items.zh: 她在那裡才工作了一個星期就生病了。

items.en: I had only been sleeping for an hour when the alarm went off.
items.zh: 我才睡了一個小時，鬧鐘就響了。

items.en: They had only been dating for a month when they got engaged.
items.zh: 他們才交往了一個月就訂婚了。

items.en: He had only been learning English for a year, but he spoke very well.
items.zh: 他才學了一年英文，可是說得很好。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + had always been + -ing：一直在

items.en: She had always been dreaming of living in Paris.
items.zh: 她一直夢想著住在巴黎。

items.en: My father had always been working too hard.
items.zh: 我爸爸一直工作得太辛苦。

items.en: They had always been talking about opening a restaurant.
items.zh: 他們一直在說要開一家餐廳。

items.en: I had always been hoping to meet her one day.
items.zh: 我一直希望有一天能見到她。

items.en: The old man had always been walking his dog in the park at six.
items.zh: 那個老人一直在六點的時候在公園遛狗。

items.en: He had always been saving for a trip around the world.
items.zh: 他一直在為環遊世界的旅行存錢。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + had just been + -ing + when + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: I had just been talking about you when you walked in.
items.zh: 你走進來的時候，我剛剛還在談你。

items.en: She had just been thinking of calling him when he called her.
items.zh: 她剛剛還在想要不要打給他，他就打給她了。

items.en: We had just been watching the news when the lights went out.
items.zh: 燈熄的時候，我們剛剛還在看新聞。

items.en: They had just been swimming when the storm started.
items.zh: 暴風雨開始的時候，他們剛剛還在游泳。

items.en: He had just been reading about the town when he saw it on TV.
items.zh: 他剛剛還在讀關於那個鎮的書，就在電視上看到它了。

items.en: I had just been cleaning the kitchen when the dog came in with muddy feet.
items.zh: 我剛剛才打掃完廚房，狗就帶著滿腳泥巴走進來了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + had been + 副詞 + -ing：其他常用的副詞

items.en: She had been secretly planning a surprise party for weeks.
items.zh: 她好幾個星期以來一直偷偷地在計畫一個驚喜派對。

items.en: The water had been slowly rising all night.
items.zh: 水整晚都在慢慢上漲。

items.en: He had been quietly saving money for a new guitar.
items.zh: 他一直默默地在存錢買一把新吉他。

items.en: They had been happily living in the village for years.
items.zh: 他們好幾年來一直快樂地住在那個村子。

items.en: The baby had been peacefully sleeping until the doorbell rang.
items.zh: 在門鈴響之前，寶寶一直安穩地睡著。

items.en: I had been patiently waiting for my turn for an hour.
items.zh: 我一直耐心地等了一個小時才輪到我。

items.en: She had been carefully writing her diary every night.
items.zh: 她每天晚上都一直很仔細地寫日記。

title: I had always wanted to visit European cities, and Paris was one of the easiest to get to.
translation: 我剛放學回到家，就看到那封信。
name: 過去完成式加句中副詞
sentences: During my year in England, I visited Paris. I had always wanted to visit European cities, and Paris was one of the easiest to get to.
She had always dreamed of living by the sea.
He had always loved music, so he became a teacher.
We had always hoped to visit Japan one day.
My grandfather had always kept a diary.
They had always lived in the same village.
My aunt brought me a dress from Paris. It was the most beautiful one I had ever seen.
It was the best meal we had ever eaten.
That was the funniest film he had ever watched.
It was the hardest exam I had ever taken.
She was the kindest person I had ever met.
It was the coldest winter they had ever known.
She came to America to see a relative she had never met before.
I had never tried Indian food before that evening.
We had never seen such a big crowd before.
He had never been on a plane before the school trip.
