They had never heard that song before.
My dog had never seen snow before that winter.
I had just arrived home from school when I saw the letter on the table.
We had just sat down to dinner when the phone rang.
She had just finished her essay when the computer crashed.
They had just left the house when it started to rain.
He had just fallen asleep when the baby woke up.
I had just washed the car when a bird landed on it.
The film had already started when we found our seats.
She had already eaten when I invited her to lunch.
The shop had already closed by the time we got there.
I had already bought a ticket when I heard about the strike.
They had already sold the house when we called.
He had already left for work when the parcel arrived.
We had already decided to go when the weather changed.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + had always + 過去分詞：一直想要

items.en: During my year in England, I visited Paris. I had always wanted to visit European cities, and Paris was one of the easiest to get to.
items.zh: 我在英國的那一年去了巴黎。我一直很想去歐洲的城市，而巴黎是最容易去的城市之一。

items.en: She had always dreamed of living by the sea.
items.zh: 她一直夢想著住在海邊。

items.en: He had always loved music, so he became a teacher.
items.zh: 他一直很喜歡音樂，所以他當了老師。

items.en: We had always hoped to visit Japan one day.
items.zh: 我們一直希望有一天能去日本。

items.en: My grandfather had always kept a diary.
items.zh: 我爺爺一直有寫日記的習慣。

items.en: They had always lived in the same village.
items.zh: 他們一直住在同一個村子。

examples.heading: ② the + 最高級 + 主詞 + had ever + 過去分詞

items.en: My aunt brought me a dress from Paris. It was the most beautiful one I had ever seen.
items.zh: 我阿姨從巴黎帶了一件洋裝給我。那是我看過最漂亮的一件。

items.en: It was the best meal we had ever eaten.
items.zh: 那是我們吃過最好吃的一餐。

items.en: That was the funniest film he had ever watched.
items.zh: 那是他看過最好笑的電影。

items.en: It was the hardest exam I had ever taken.
items.zh: 那是我考過最難的試。

items.en: She was the kindest person I had ever met.
items.zh: 她是我遇過最善良的人。

items.en: It was the coldest winter they had ever known.
items.zh: 那是他們經歷過最冷的冬天。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + had never + 過去分詞 + before：以前從來沒有

items.en: She came to America to see a relative she had never met before.
items.zh: 她來美國看一個她以前從來沒見過的親戚。

items.en: I had never tried Indian food before that evening.
items.zh: 那天晚上之前，我從來沒吃過印度菜。

items.en: We had never seen such a big crowd before.
items.zh: 我們以前從來沒看過那麼多人。

items.en: He had never been on a plane before the school trip.
items.zh: 那次校外教學之前，他從來沒坐過飛機。

items.en: They had never heard that song before.
items.zh: 他們以前從來沒聽過那首歌。

items.en: My dog had never seen snow before that winter.
items.zh: 那年冬天之前，我的狗從來沒看過雪。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + had just + 過去分詞 + when + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: I had just arrived home from school when I saw the letter on the table.
items.zh: 我剛放學回到家，就看到桌上的那封信。

items.en: We had just sat down to dinner when the phone rang.
items.zh: 我們剛坐下來吃晚餐，電話就響了。

items.en: She had just finished her essay when the computer crashed.
items.zh: 她剛寫完作文，電腦就當機了。

items.en: They had just left the house when it started to rain.
items.zh: 他們剛出門，就開始下雨了。

items.en: He had just fallen asleep when the baby woke up.
items.zh: 他剛睡著，寶寶就醒了。

items.en: I had just washed the car when a bird landed on it.
items.zh: 我剛洗完車，就有一隻鳥停在上面。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + had already + 過去分詞 + when / by the time + 子句

items.en: The film had already started when we found our seats.
items.zh: 我們找到位子的時候，電影已經開始了。

items.en: She had already eaten when I invited her to lunch.
items.zh: 我邀她吃午餐的時候，她已經吃過了。

items.en: The shop had already closed by the time we got there.
items.zh: 我們到的時候，那家店已經關了。

items.en: I had already bought a ticket when I heard about the strike.
items.zh: 我聽說有罷工的時候，已經買了票。

items.en: They had already sold the house when we called.
items.zh: 我們打電話的時候，他們已經把房子賣掉了。

items.en: He had already left for work when the parcel arrived.
items.zh: 包裹到的時候，他已經去上班了。

items.en: We had already decided to go when the weather changed.
items.zh: 天氣變了的時候，我們已經決定要去了。

title: He had finally achieved his goal!
translation: 他終於達成目標了！
name: 過去完成式與副詞的位置（較多種副詞）
sentences: My brother had trained for three years. When he crossed the finish line, he had finally achieved his goal!
After months of searching, she had finally found a flat she liked.
By the end of the year, we had finally saved enough for a car.
The rain had finally stopped when we left the café.
After three attempts, he had finally passed his driving test.
The baby had finally fallen asleep, so we could have dinner.
She had suddenly woken up at that noise, but now she was trying to tell herself it was just a dream.
We were sitting in the dark when the manager came in. The lights had suddenly gone out in the middle of the film.
My brother left the party early. He had suddenly remembered that it was his mother's birthday.
By the time we reached the top, the weather had suddenly changed, and the sky was black.
When we turned round, our dog wasn't there. He had suddenly run off into the woods.
My aunt surprised everyone that year. She had suddenly decided to leave her job and travel.
David's bag was not in his room. Had someone taken his things, or had they simply disappeared?
When she phoned, I realised I had completely forgotten her birthday.
Nobody could help my uncle before the accident. He had simply refused to listen to anyone.
I went back to my home town last year. The old town had completely changed since my childhood.
When I came back, my girlfriend wasn't there. She had simply walked out without a word.
They had completely run out of food by the third day.
When I visited my cousins in May, they had recently moved to a bigger house near the park.
I met Anna at a party last year. She had recently started a new job at the hospital.
We stayed at home that summer. We had recently bought a dog, so we couldn't go away.
When I met Jack, he had recently returned from a year in Australia.
We went to the museum on Saturday. It had recently opened a new wing.
When I left home, my parents had recently retired and loved travelling.
We opened the door. The house had obviously been empty for years.
My sister's birthday trip went perfectly. She had carefully planned every part of it.
My sister didn't know, but her boyfriend had secretly bought her a ring before the trip.
When the teacher turned round, the children had quietly left the room.
We had nearly reached the top when it began to snow.
When I arrived at the party, my friends had already eaten most of the cake.
I had hardly closed my eyes when the alarm went off.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + had finally + 過去分詞：終於

items.en: My brother had trained for three years. When he crossed the finish line, he had finally achieved his goal!
items.zh: 我哥哥練習了三年。他跑過終點線的時候，終於達成了他的目標！

items.en: After months of searching, she had finally found a flat she liked.
items.zh: 找了好幾個月以後，她終於找到一間喜歡的公寓。

items.en: By the end of the year, we had finally saved enough for a car.
items.zh: 到年底的時候，我們終於存夠了買車的錢。

items.en: The rain had finally stopped when we left the café.
items.zh: 我們離開咖啡館的時候，雨終於停了。

items.en: After three attempts, he had finally passed his driving test.
items.zh: 試了三次以後，他終於通過了駕照考試。

items.en: The baby had finally fallen asleep, so we could have dinner.
items.zh: 寶寶終於睡著了，所以我們可以吃晚餐了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + had suddenly + 過去分詞：突然

items.en: She had suddenly woken up at that noise, but now she was trying to tell herself it was just a dream.
items.zh: 她被那個聲音突然吵醒了，可是現在她試著告訴自己那只是一場夢。

items.en: We were sitting in the dark when the manager came in. The lights had suddenly gone out in the middle of the film.
items.zh: 經理進來的時候我們坐在黑暗中。電影演到一半，燈突然熄了。

items.en: My brother left the party early. He had suddenly remembered that it was his mother's birthday.
items.zh: 我哥哥提早離開派對。他突然想起那天是他媽媽的生日。

items.en: By the time we reached the top, the weather had suddenly changed, and the sky was black.
items.zh: 我們到山頂的時候，天氣突然變了，天空一片漆黑。

items.en: When we turned round, our dog wasn't there. He had suddenly run off into the woods.
items.zh: 我們轉過身的時候，我們的狗不見了。牠突然跑進了樹林。

items.en: My aunt surprised everyone that year. She had suddenly decided to leave her job and travel.
items.zh: 我阿姨那年讓大家都很驚訝。她突然決定辭掉工作去旅行。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + had + simply / completely + 過去分詞

items.en: David's bag was not in his room. Had someone taken his things, or had they simply disappeared?
items.zh: 大衛的包包不在他房間裡。是有人拿走了他的東西，還是它們就這樣不見了？

items.en: When she phoned, I realised I had completely forgotten her birthday.
items.zh: 她打電話來的時候，我才發現我完全忘了她的生日。

items.en: Nobody could help my uncle before the accident. He had simply refused to listen to anyone.
items.zh: 在那次意外之前，沒有人幫得了我叔叔。他就是不肯聽任何人的話。

items.en: I went back to my home town last year. The old town had completely changed since my childhood.
items.zh: 我去年回到家鄉。舊城區跟我小時候比完全變了。

items.en: When I came back, my girlfriend wasn't there. She had simply walked out without a word.
items.zh: 我回來的時候，我女朋友不在。她就這樣一句話也沒說就走了。

items.en: They had completely run out of food by the third day.
items.zh: 到第三天，他們的食物已經完全吃光了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + had recently + 過去分詞：最近

items.en: When I visited my cousins in May, they had recently moved to a bigger house near the park.
items.zh: 我五月去看我表親的時候，他們最近搬到公園附近一間比較大的房子。

items.en: I met Anna at a party last year. She had recently started a new job at the hospital.
items.zh: 我去年在一場派對上遇到安娜。她最近在醫院開始了一份新工作。

items.en: We stayed at home that summer. We had recently bought a dog, so we couldn't go away.
items.zh: 那年夏天我們待在家裡。我們最近養了一隻狗，所以不能出遠門。

items.en: When I met Jack, he had recently returned from a year in Australia.
items.zh: 我遇到傑克的時候，他最近剛從澳洲待了一年回來。

items.en: We went to the museum on Saturday. It had recently opened a new wing.
items.zh: 我們星期六去了博物館。它最近開了一個新的展區。

items.en: When I left home, my parents had recently retired and loved travelling.
items.zh: 我離開家的時候，我爸媽最近退休了，很喜歡旅行。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + had + 其他副詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: We opened the door. The house had obviously been empty for years.
items.zh: 我們打開門。那間房子顯然已經空了好幾年。

items.en: My sister's birthday trip went perfectly. She had carefully planned every part of it.
items.zh: 我姊姊的生日旅行很完美。她仔細地計畫了每一個部分。

items.en: My sister didn't know, but her boyfriend had secretly bought her a ring before the trip.
items.zh: 我姊姊不知道，她男朋友旅行前就偷偷幫她買了一枚戒指。

items.en: When the teacher turned round, the children had quietly left the room.
items.zh: 老師轉過身的時候，孩子們已經悄悄地離開了房間。

items.en: We had nearly reached the top when it began to snow.
items.zh: 我們快到山頂的時候開始下雪了。

items.en: When I arrived at the party, my friends had already eaten most of the cake.
items.zh: 我到派對的時候，我朋友們已經吃掉大部分的蛋糕了。

items.en: I had hardly closed my eyes when the alarm went off.
items.zh: 我才剛閉上眼睛，鬧鐘就響了。

title: I've also been singing in a choir for five years.
translation: 我也已經在合唱團唱了五年了。
name: 現在完成進行式加句中副詞
sentences: I'm studying at university, and I've also been working as a waiter at weekends.
Our class sold cakes for charity. We have also been collecting old toys for the children's hospital.
My sister has a busy summer. She's also been taking driving lessons.
My parents are saving money. They've also been planning a trip to Iceland.
He retired last year, but he's still busy. My father has also been helping at the food bank.
Dear Editor, I have just been reading an article in your newspaper about school meals.
Oh, hi, Ben! We've just been talking about you.
My cousin is very excited. She's just been telling me about her new job.
Good news about your holiday. I've just been speaking to the manager.
Come for dinner on Friday. I've recently been learning to cook Thai food.
My son is close to his grandmother. He has recently been spending a lot of time with her.
We only got here ten minutes ago, and you've already been complaining about the food.
Where is the waiter? We've already been waiting for forty minutes.
Water is coming through the ceiling again. My husband has always been saying he'll fix the roof.
There are bottles everywhere outside. The neighbours have probably been having a party.
Your daughter got top marks. She's certainly been working hard this term.
I'm sad that the cooking class ends next week. I've really been enjoying it.
I'm sorry, my phone was broken. You've probably been wondering why I didn't call.
Don't be angry with Tom. He has certainly been trying his best.
We have a big project this month. I've often been staying late at the office.
We need a new one. The printer has constantly been breaking down.
My little brother has constantly been asking for a puppy since his birthday.
I failed the test. I haven't really been paying attention in class.
Don't believe everything Max says. He hasn't always been telling the truth.
I've sent Emma five texts. She probably hasn't been checking her messages.
My son's teacher called me today. He certainly hasn't been doing his homework.
My parents should stop paying for the gym. They haven't really been using it.
Your brother has a cold. Have you also been feeling ill?
Her French is still quite weak. Has she really been living in Paris for ten years?
You're out of breath. Have you just been running?
Your lease ends in June. Have you already been looking for a new flat?

examples.heading: ① also

items.en: I'm studying at university, and I've also been working as a waiter at weekends.
items.zh: 我在念大學，我週末也一直在當服務生。

items.en: Our class sold cakes for charity. We have also been collecting old toys for the children's hospital.
items.zh: 我們班為慈善義賣蛋糕。我們也一直在幫兒童醫院收集舊玩具。

items.en: My sister has a busy summer. She's also been taking driving lessons.
items.zh: 我妹妹這個夏天很忙。她也一直在上駕訓課。

items.en: My parents are saving money. They've also been planning a trip to Iceland.
items.zh: 我爸媽在存錢。他們也一直在計畫去冰島旅行。

items.en: He retired last year, but he's still busy. My father has also been helping at the food bank.
items.zh: 他去年退休了，可是還是很忙。我爸爸也一直在食物銀行幫忙。

examples.heading: ② just

items.en: Dear Editor, I have just been reading an article in your newspaper about school meals.
items.zh: 編輯您好，我剛剛在看你們報紙上一篇關於學校午餐的文章。

items.en: Oh, hi, Ben! We've just been talking about you.
items.zh: 噢，嗨，班！我們剛剛在聊你。

items.en: My cousin is very excited. She's just been telling me about her new job.
items.zh: 我表姊很興奮。她剛剛在跟我講她的新工作。

items.en: Good news about your holiday. I've just been speaking to the manager.
items.zh: 你的假有好消息。我剛剛在跟經理談。

examples.heading: ③ recently / already / always

items.en: Come for dinner on Friday. I've recently been learning to cook Thai food.
items.zh: 星期五來吃晚餐吧。我最近一直在學煮泰國菜。

items.en: My son is close to his grandmother. He has recently been spending a lot of time with her.
items.zh: 我兒子跟他奶奶很親。他最近花很多時間陪她。

items.en: We only got here ten minutes ago, and you've already been complaining about the food.
items.zh: 我們十分鐘前才到，你就已經一直在抱怨食物了。

items.en: Where is the waiter? We've already been waiting for forty minutes.
items.zh: 服務生在哪裡？我們已經等了四十分鐘了。

items.en: Water is coming through the ceiling again. My husband has always been saying he'll fix the roof.
items.zh: 天花板又漏水了。我先生一直都說他會修屋頂。

examples.heading: ④ probably / certainly / really

items.en: There are bottles everywhere outside. The neighbours have probably been having a party.
items.zh: 外面到處都是瓶子。鄰居剛剛大概在開派對。

items.en: Your daughter got top marks. She's certainly been working hard this term.
items.zh: 你女兒拿了最高分。她這學期的確很用功。

items.en: I'm sad that the cooking class ends next week. I've really been enjoying it.
items.zh: 烹飪課下禮拜就結束了，我很難過。這門課我真的上得很開心。

items.en: I'm sorry, my phone was broken. You've probably been wondering why I didn't call.
items.zh: 抱歉，我的手機壞了。你大概一直在想我為什麼沒打電話。

items.en: Don't be angry with Tom. He has certainly been trying his best.
items.zh: 不要生湯姆的氣。他的確一直盡力在做。

examples.heading: ⑤ often / constantly

items.en: We have a big project this month. I've often been staying late at the office.
items.zh: 我們這個月有個大案子。我常常留在辦公室加班。

items.en: We need a new one. The printer has constantly been breaking down.
items.zh: 我們需要一台新的。印表機一直不斷地故障。

items.en: My little brother has constantly been asking for a puppy since his birthday.
items.zh: 我弟弟從生日以後就一直吵著要一隻小狗。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句

items.en: I failed the test. I haven't really been paying attention in class.
items.zh: 我考試不及格。我上課其實都沒在專心。

items.en: Don't believe everything Max says. He hasn't always been telling the truth.
items.zh: 不要相信麥克斯說的每件事。他不是一直都說實話。

items.en: I've sent Emma five texts. She probably hasn't been checking her messages.
items.zh: 我傳了五則簡訊給艾瑪。她大概一直沒看訊息。

items.en: My son's teacher called me today. He certainly hasn't been doing his homework.
items.zh: 我兒子的老師今天打電話給我。他確實一直沒寫功課。

items.en: My parents should stop paying for the gym. They haven't really been using it.
items.zh: 我爸媽不應該再付健身房的錢了。他們其實都沒在用。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: Your brother has a cold. Have you also been feeling ill?
items.zh: 你哥哥感冒了。你也一直覺得不舒服嗎？

items.en: Her French is still quite weak. Has she really been living in Paris for ten years?
items.zh: 她的法文還是很弱。她真的在巴黎住了十年嗎？

items.en: You're out of breath. Have you just been running?
items.zh: 你喘不過氣。你剛剛在跑步嗎？

items.en: Your lease ends in June. Have you already been looking for a new flat?
items.zh: 你的租約六月到期。你已經開始在找新公寓了嗎？

title: I have just seen your notice.
translation: 我剛看到你的公告。
name: 現在完成式加句中副詞（常用副詞）
sentences: Come and have some while it's hot. I've just taken the bread out of the oven.
Hurry up and sit down. The match has just started on TV.
Our daughter wants to learn music. We've just bought a second-hand piano.
Don't wait for Kate. She's just phoned to say she's late.
Get your coat. Your taxi has just arrived.
Thanks for writing. I have just received your email about the meeting.
You can sit down and relax. I've already done the washing-up.
You missed the party. Our guests have already gone home.
My son got his pocket money on Monday. He's already spent all of it.
Let's choose something else. We've already seen this film.
You'll have to send the parcel tomorrow. The post office has already closed for the day.
She's a bit scared of the flight. My grandmother has never been on a plane.
My mum still cooks for him. My brother has never cooked a meal for himself.
We've always lived in flats. We've never had a garden of our own.
I'm taking my girlfriend home this weekend. She's never met my parents.
Look at the white sand. I have never seen such a beautiful beach.
Our team is very strong at home. They've never lost a game here.
Turn up the radio. I've always liked this song.
She knows everyone here. My aunt has always lived in this village.
My family is very close. We've always spent Christmas together.
My brother is learning Japanese. He's always wanted to visit Japan.
Let's come back on a weekday. This café has always been busy on Saturdays.
There's a new restaurant in town. Have you ever tried Korean food?
My sister is going to London next week. Has your sister ever been there?
Your parents are coming for Christmas. Have they already booked their flights home?
The platform is empty. Has the last train to Leeds just left?
You travel a lot for work. Have you ever lost your passport?
Dear Sir, I have just read your advertisement in the newspaper. I would like to apply for the job.
Dear Mr Smith, we have already sent you the money for the hotel room.
Congratulations on the new baby! I've just heard the good news.
Dear Ms Brown, I would like to apply for the job at your school. I have always wanted to work with children.

examples.heading: ① just

items.en: Come and have some while it's hot. I've just taken the bread out of the oven.
items.zh: 趁熱來吃一點。我剛把麵包從烤箱拿出來。

items.en: Hurry up and sit down. The match has just started on TV.
items.zh: 快點坐下。電視上的比賽剛開始。

items.en: Our daughter wants to learn music. We've just bought a second-hand piano.
items.zh: 我們女兒想學音樂。我們剛買了一台二手鋼琴。

items.en: Don't wait for Kate. She's just phoned to say she's late.
items.zh: 不用等凱特。她剛打電話來說她會晚到。

items.en: Get your coat. Your taxi has just arrived.
items.zh: 去拿外套。你叫的計程車剛到。

items.en: Thanks for writing. I have just received your email about the meeting.
items.zh: 謝謝你來信。我剛收到你寄來關於開會的電子郵件。

examples.heading: ② already

items.en: You can sit down and relax. I've already done the washing-up.
items.zh: 你可以坐下來休息。碗我已經洗好了。

items.en: You missed the party. Our guests have already gone home.
items.zh: 你錯過派對了。我們的客人已經回家了。

items.en: My son got his pocket money on Monday. He's already spent all of it.
items.zh: 我兒子星期一拿到零用錢。他已經全部花光了。

items.en: Let's choose something else. We've already seen this film.
items.zh: 我們挑別的吧。這部電影我們已經看過了。

items.en: You'll have to send the parcel tomorrow. The post office has already closed for the day.
items.zh: 你得明天再寄包裹了。郵局今天已經關門了。

examples.heading: ③ never

items.en: She's a bit scared of the flight. My grandmother has never been on a plane.
items.zh: 她有點怕坐飛機。我奶奶從來沒坐過飛機。

items.en: My mum still cooks for him. My brother has never cooked a meal for himself.
items.zh: 我媽媽還在幫他煮飯。我哥從來沒自己煮過一頓飯。

items.en: We've always lived in flats. We've never had a garden of our own.
items.zh: 我們一直都住公寓。我們從來沒有過自己的花園。

items.en: I'm taking my girlfriend home this weekend. She's never met my parents.
items.zh: 我這個週末要帶女朋友回家。她從來沒見過我爸媽。

items.en: Look at the white sand. I have never seen such a beautiful beach.
items.zh: 你看那白沙。我從來沒看過這麼漂亮的海灘。

items.en: Our team is very strong at home. They've never lost a game here.
items.zh: 我們的球隊在主場很強。他們在這裡從來沒輸過。

examples.heading: ④ always

items.en: Turn up the radio. I've always liked this song.
items.zh: 把收音機開大聲一點。我一直都很喜歡這首歌。

items.en: She knows everyone here. My aunt has always lived in this village.
items.zh: 她認識這裡的每個人。我阿姨一直都住在這個村子。

items.en: My family is very close. We've always spent Christmas together.
items.zh: 我們家很親。我們聖誕節一直都一起過。

items.en: My brother is learning Japanese. He's always wanted to visit Japan.
items.zh: 我哥哥在學日文。他一直都想去日本。

items.en: Let's come back on a weekday. This café has always been busy on Saturdays.
items.zh: 我們平日再來吧。這家咖啡店星期六一直都很多人。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句：ever / already / just

items.en: There's a new restaurant in town. Have you ever tried Korean food?
items.zh: 城裡開了一家新餐廳。你吃過韓國菜嗎？

items.en: My sister is going to London next week. Has your sister ever been there?
items.zh: 我姊姊下禮拜要去倫敦。你姊姊去過那裡嗎？

items.en: Your parents are coming for Christmas. Have they already booked their flights home?
items.zh: 你爸媽要來過聖誕節。他們已經訂好回家的機票了嗎？

items.en: The platform is empty. Has the last train to Leeds just left?
items.zh: 月台上沒有人。往里茲的末班火車剛開走嗎？

items.en: You travel a lot for work. Have you ever lost your passport?
items.zh: 你常常出差。你弄丟過護照嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫信和留言的開頭

items.en: Dear Sir, I have just read your advertisement in the newspaper. I would like to apply for the job.
items.zh: 敬啟者，我剛在報紙上看到你們的廣告。我想應徵這份工作。

items.en: Dear Mr Smith, we have already sent you the money for the hotel room.
items.zh: 史密斯先生您好，飯店房間的錢我們已經寄給您了。

items.en: Congratulations on the new baby! I've just heard the good news.
items.zh: 恭喜你們生寶寶了！我剛聽到這個好消息。

items.en: Dear Ms Brown, I would like to apply for the job at your school. I have always wanted to work with children.
items.zh: 布朗女士您好，我想應徵貴校的工作。我一直都想從事跟小孩有關的工作。

title: I've always loved seafood.
translation: 我一直都很愛吃海鮮。
name: 現在完成式加句中副詞（較多種副詞）
sentences: They don't want to move to the city. My grandparents have always lived by the sea.
I'd like to order the salmon roll. I've never tried sushi.
We're tired of the noise in the city. We've often talked about moving to the country.
You asked why the sky is blue. I've sometimes wondered about that too.
Let's get my sister a puppy for her birthday. She's always wanted a dog.
My uncle and aunt are big football fans. They've never missed a match.
You're too late for the party. The guests have already left.
Don't park under the tree. Dad has just washed the car.
I'm trying to get fit. I've recently joined a gym.
We've looked at twenty houses. We've finally found one we like.
You don't need to cook. The kids have already eaten their dinner.
My brother can drive us to the beach now. He has finally passed his driving test.
Give me ten more minutes. I've nearly finished the report.
Can you go to the shop? We've almost run out of rice.
My daughter has a cold. She's hardly eaten anything all day.
Thank you for showing us around Taipei. I've really enjoyed this holiday.
The same shops are still on the main street. The town has hardly changed since I was a child.
Nobody has asked about the old plan. They've probably forgotten about it.
My daughter got top marks in every subject. She has certainly worked hard this year.
Look at the man in the red coat. I've definitely seen him before.
The shop sent the parcel on Monday. It has probably arrived at the office.
There are twelve people coming to dinner now. I've also invited your sister.
The company has shops in London. It has also opened an office in Berlin.
My boss and I work well together, but I haven't always agreed with him.
Our son wants to study abroad. We haven't really talked about it yet.
Kate hasn't replied to my text. She probably hasn't got the message.
Ben left the race halfway. He certainly hasn't done his best.
You've lived in Los Angeles for years. Have you ever met a famous person?
Our trip is next week. Has your mum already booked the hotel?
The house is quiet now. Have the builders finally gone home?
You got full marks again. Have you always been so good at maths?

examples.heading: ① 頻率：always / never / often / sometimes

items.en: They don't want to move to the city. My grandparents have always lived by the sea.
items.zh: 他們不想搬到城市。我爺爺奶奶一直都住在海邊。

items.en: I'd like to order the salmon roll. I've never tried sushi.
items.zh: 我想點鮭魚捲。我從來沒吃過壽司。

items.en: We're tired of the noise in the city. We've often talked about moving to the country.
items.zh: 我們受夠了城市的噪音。我們常常聊到要搬去鄉下。

items.en: You asked why the sky is blue. I've sometimes wondered about that too.
items.zh: 你問天空為什麼是藍的。我有時候也想過這件事。

items.en: Let's get my sister a puppy for her birthday. She's always wanted a dog.
items.zh: 我們送我妹妹一隻小狗當生日禮物吧。她一直都想養狗。

items.en: My uncle and aunt are big football fans. They've never missed a match.
items.zh: 我叔叔和嬸嬸是超級足球迷。他們從來沒錯過一場比賽。

examples.heading: ② 時間：already / just / recently / finally

items.en: You're too late for the party. The guests have already left.
items.zh: 你來參加派對太晚了。客人已經走了。

items.en: Don't park under the tree. Dad has just washed the car.
items.zh: 不要停在樹下。爸爸剛洗好車。

items.en: I'm trying to get fit. I've recently joined a gym.
items.zh: 我正在努力鍛鍊身體。我最近加入了一家健身房。

items.en: We've looked at twenty houses. We've finally found one we like.
items.zh: 我們看了二十間房子。我們終於找到一間喜歡的了。

items.en: You don't need to cook. The kids have already eaten their dinner.
items.zh: 你不用煮了。孩子們已經吃過晚餐了。

items.en: My brother can drive us to the beach now. He has finally passed his driving test.
items.zh: 我哥哥現在可以載我們去海邊了。他終於考過駕照了。

examples.heading: ③ 程度：nearly / almost / hardly / really

items.en: Give me ten more minutes. I've nearly finished the report.
items.zh: 再給我十分鐘。報告我快寫完了。

items.en: Can you go to the shop? We've almost run out of rice.
items.zh: 你可以去店裡一趟嗎？我們的米快吃完了。

items.en: My daughter has a cold. She's hardly eaten anything all day.
items.zh: 我女兒感冒了。她一整天幾乎沒吃東西。

items.en: Thank you for showing us around Taipei. I've really enjoyed this holiday.
items.zh: 謝謝你帶我們逛台北。這次假期我真的玩得很開心。

items.en: The same shops are still on the main street. The town has hardly changed since I was a child.
items.zh: 大街上還是那幾家店。這個小鎮跟我小時候比幾乎沒變。

examples.heading: ④ 確定的程度：probably / certainly / definitely

items.en: Nobody has asked about the old plan. They've probably forgotten about it.
items.zh: 沒有人問起舊的計畫。他們大概已經忘了這件事。

items.en: My daughter got top marks in every subject. She has certainly worked hard this year.
items.zh: 我女兒每一科都拿最高分。她今年的確很努力。

items.en: Look at the man in the red coat. I've definitely seen him before.
items.zh: 你看那個穿紅外套的男人。我確定以前見過他。

items.en: The shop sent the parcel on Monday. It has probably arrived at the office.
items.zh: 店家星期一寄出包裹。包裹大概已經送到辦公室了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 附加：also

items.en: There are twelve people coming to dinner now. I've also invited your sister.
items.zh: 現在有十二個人要來吃晚餐。我也邀了你妹妹。

items.en: The company has shops in London. It has also opened an office in Berlin.
items.zh: 這家公司在倫敦有店。它也在柏林開了辦公室。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定句

items.en: My boss and I work well together, but I haven't always agreed with him.
items.zh: 我跟老闆合作得很好，可是我不是一直都同意他的看法。

items.en: Our son wants to study abroad. We haven't really talked about it yet.
items.zh: 我們兒子想出國念書。我們還沒有真正談過這件事。

items.en: Kate hasn't replied to my text. She probably hasn't got the message.
items.zh: 凱特還沒回我的簡訊。她大概還沒收到訊息。

items.en: Ben left the race halfway. He certainly hasn't done his best.
items.zh: 班比賽跑到一半就退出了。他確實沒有盡全力。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: You've lived in Los Angeles for years. Have you ever met a famous person?
items.zh: 你在洛杉磯住了好幾年。你見過名人嗎？

items.en: Our trip is next week. Has your mum already booked the hotel?
items.zh: 我們的旅行在下禮拜。你媽媽已經訂好飯店了嗎？

items.en: The house is quiet now. Have the builders finally gone home?
items.zh: 屋子現在很安靜。工人終於回家了嗎？

items.en: You got full marks again. Have you always been so good at maths?
items.zh: 你又考了滿分。你數學一直都這麼好嗎？

title: Once he got inside, he started searching for clues.
translation: 他一進去，就開始找線索。
name: 從屬連接詞子句中的過去簡單式
sentences: When I opened the door, the dog ran out into the street.
We were drenched when we finally got home.
My mother cried when she heard the news.
The children were gleeful when they saw the snow.
While I lived in Osaka, I learned to cook.
Someone stole my bike while I was in the library.
While she waited for the bus, she read the whole newspaper.
I checked all the windows before I left the house.
Before we moved here, we lived in a tiny flat above a shop.
She phoned her parents before she got on the plane.
As soon as we went down to fifteen metres, we saw lots of coloured fish.
I called you as soon as I heard.
As soon as the teacher left the room, the students started talking.
Once I found the right key, the door opened easily.
Once the guests left, we cleaned up the kitchen.
Once she made up her mind, nothing could change it.
We waited until the rain stopped.
I didn't know about the party until Tom told me.
He stayed at the office until everyone else went home.
If it rained, we played cards in the kitchen.
If my grandfather didn't like a meal, he never said so.
If you missed the last bus, you had to walk home.
I've lived in this flat since I left university.
She has looked haggard since she started the new job.
Since it was late, we took a taxi home.
Since the hotel was full, we stayed with a friend.
The house was dilapidated, so we decided not to buy it.
I was tired, so I went to bed early.
The shop was closed, so we bought bread at the station.
When we arrived at the hotel, the room wasn't ready, so we went for a walk.
As soon as the rain stopped, we went out and stayed in the park until it got dark.
While we were in Rome, it rained every day, so we spent a lot of time in museums.
Once the baby fell asleep, we watched a film until midnight.

examples.heading: ① when

items.en: When I opened the door, the dog ran out into the street.
items.zh: 我一開門，狗就跑到街上去了。

items.en: We were drenched when we finally got home.
items.zh: 我們終於到家的時候，全身都濕透了。

items.en: My mother cried when she heard the news.
items.zh: 我媽聽到消息的時候哭了。

items.en: The children were gleeful when they saw the snow.
items.zh: 孩子們看到雪的時候開心極了。

examples.heading: ② while

items.en: While I lived in Osaka, I learned to cook.
items.zh: 我住在大阪的時候學會了做菜。

items.en: Someone stole my bike while I was in the library.
items.zh: 我在圖書館的時候，有人偷了我的腳踏車。

items.en: While she waited for the bus, she read the whole newspaper.
items.zh: 她等公車的時候，把整份報紙看完了。

examples.heading: ③ before

items.en: I checked all the windows before I left the house.
items.zh: 我出門前把所有窗戶都檢查了一遍。

items.en: Before we moved here, we lived in a tiny flat above a shop.
items.zh: 搬來這裡以前，我們住在一家店樓上的小公寓。

items.en: She phoned her parents before she got on the plane.
items.zh: 她上飛機前打了電話給爸媽。

examples.heading: ④ as soon as

items.en: As soon as we went down to fifteen metres, we saw lots of coloured fish.
items.zh: 我們一潛到十五公尺深，就看到很多彩色的魚。

items.en: I called you as soon as I heard.
items.zh: 我一聽到消息就打給你了。

items.en: As soon as the teacher left the room, the students started talking.
items.zh: 老師一離開教室，學生就開始講話。

examples.heading: ⑤ once

items.en: Once I found the right key, the door opened easily.
items.zh: 找到對的鑰匙以後，門一下就開了。

items.en: Once the guests left, we cleaned up the kitchen.
items.zh: 客人一走，我們就把廚房收拾乾淨。

items.en: Once she made up her mind, nothing could change it.
items.zh: 她一下了決定，什麼都改變不了。

examples.heading: ⑥ until

items.en: We waited until the rain stopped.
items.zh: 我們等到雨停。

items.en: I didn't know about the party until Tom told me.
items.zh: 直到 Tom 跟我說，我才知道有派對。

items.en: He stayed at the office until everyone else went home.
items.zh: 他在辦公室待到其他人都回家了。

examples.heading: ⑦ if

items.en: If it rained, we played cards in the kitchen.
items.zh: 以前下雨的時候，我們就在廚房玩牌。

items.en: If my grandfather didn't like a meal, he never said so.
items.zh: 我爺爺不喜歡一道菜的話，從來不說出口。

items.en: If you missed the last bus, you had to walk home.
items.zh: 那時候要是錯過末班車，就只能走路回家。

examples.heading: ⑧ since

items.en: I've lived in this flat since I left university.
items.zh: 我大學畢業以後就一直住在這間公寓。

items.en: She has looked haggard since she started the new job.
items.zh: 她開始新工作以後，就一直很憔悴。

items.en: Since it was late, we took a taxi home.
items.zh: 因為很晚了，我們搭計程車回家。

items.en: Since the hotel was full, we stayed with a friend.
items.zh: 因為飯店客滿，我們就住在朋友家。

examples.heading: ⑨ so

items.en: The house was dilapidated, so we decided not to buy it.
items.zh: 那棟房子很破舊，所以我們決定不買。

items.en: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
items.zh: 我累了，所以早早就睡了。

items.en: The shop was closed, so we bought bread at the station.
items.zh: 那家店沒開，所以我們在車站買了麵包。

examples.heading: ⑩ 一句裡用兩個從屬連接詞

items.en: When we arrived at the hotel, the room wasn't ready, so we went for a walk.
items.zh: 我們到飯店的時候房間還沒準備好，所以我們就去散步了。

items.en: As soon as the rain stopped, we went out and stayed in the park until it got dark.
items.zh: 雨一停我們就出門，在公園待到天黑。

items.en: While we were in Rome, it rained every day, so we spent a lot of time in museums.
items.zh: 我們在羅馬的時候天天下雨，所以花了很多時間逛博物館。

items.en: Once the baby fell asleep, we watched a film until midnight.
items.zh: 寶寶一睡著，我們就看電影看到半夜。

title: I worked as a helper at a summer camp in Canada last summer.
translation: 去年夏天，我在加拿大的一個夏令營當幫手。
name: 過去簡單式搭配時間副詞語
sentences: I went to bed very late last night.
We had a vigorous discussion about the budget last week.
Did you see the match last Saturday?
The shop did very well last year.
They painted the kitchen last month.
My sister got married three years ago.
The bus left five minutes ago.
I bought this coat a long time ago.
A few weeks ago, I received a strange letter from an old friend.
My grandfather was born in 1948.
The shop opened on Monday morning.
The train arrived at exactly six o'clock.
In the spring, we planted tomatoes in the garden.
The parcel arrived on the morning of my birthday.
He worked hard for quite a long time to earn the money he needed.
We waited at the airport for four hours.
I lived with my grandparents for a year.
Something funny happened to me last year, during the Christmas holiday.
The baby woke up three times during the night.
Nobody spoke during the meeting.
I saw your brother at the supermarket yesterday.
The other day, a very affable man helped me carry my bags.
I ran into our old teacher the other day.
She called you earlier today.
Earlier today, the manager announced a new holiday policy.
We waited for the bus, but it didn't come. Then we took a taxi.
She read the letter twice and then tore it up.
At that time, I didn't speak any English.
My parents ran a small café at that time.
We argued for hours, but in the end we agreed.
In the end, we decided to stay at home.
Last summer, I worked in a hotel for two months.
We stayed in Kyoto for a week in April.
Two years ago, during the rainy season, the river flooded the whole town.

examples.heading: ① last + 時間

items.en: I went to bed very late last night.
items.zh: 我昨天晚上很晚才睡。

items.en: We had a vigorous discussion about the budget last week.
items.zh: 我們上週針對預算熱烈地討論了一番。

items.en: Did you see the match last Saturday?
items.zh: 你上週六有看那場比賽嗎？

items.en: The shop did very well last year.
items.zh: 那家店去年生意很好。

items.en: They painted the kitchen last month.
items.zh: 他們上個月把廚房漆好了。

examples.heading: ② 一段時間 + ago

items.en: My sister got married three years ago.
items.zh: 我姊姊三年前結婚了。

items.en: The bus left five minutes ago.
items.zh: 公車五分鐘前開走了。

items.en: I bought this coat a long time ago.
items.zh: 這件外套我很久以前就買了。

items.en: A few weeks ago, I received a strange letter from an old friend.
items.zh: 幾週前，我收到一位老朋友寄來的一封奇怪的信。

examples.heading: ③ in / on / at + 時間

items.en: My grandfather was born in 1948.
items.zh: 我爺爺生於 1948 年。

items.en: The shop opened on Monday morning.
items.zh: 那家店星期一早上開張了。

items.en: The train arrived at exactly six o'clock.
items.zh: 火車六點整到站。

items.en: In the spring, we planted tomatoes in the garden.
items.zh: 春天的時候，我們在花園裡種了番茄。

items.en: The parcel arrived on the morning of my birthday.
items.zh: 包裹在我生日那天早上送到了。

examples.heading: ④ for + 一段時間、during + 名詞

items.en: He worked hard for quite a long time to earn the money he needed.
items.zh: 他努力工作了好長一段時間，才賺到需要的錢。

items.en: We waited at the airport for four hours.
items.zh: 我們在機場等了四個小時。

items.en: I lived with my grandparents for a year.
items.zh: 我跟爺爺奶奶住了一年。

items.en: Something funny happened to me last year, during the Christmas holiday.
items.zh: 去年聖誕假期，我遇到了一件好笑的事。

items.en: The baby woke up three times during the night.
items.zh: 寶寶夜裡醒了三次。

items.en: Nobody spoke during the meeting.
items.zh: 開會的時候沒有人說話。

examples.heading: ⑤ yesterday、the other day、earlier today

items.en: I saw your brother at the supermarket yesterday.
items.zh: 我昨天在超市看到你哥哥。

items.en: The other day, a very affable man helped me carry my bags.
items.zh: 前幾天，有一位很親切的先生幫我提袋子。

items.en: I ran into our old teacher the other day.
items.zh: 我前幾天碰到我們以前的老師。

items.en: She called you earlier today.
items.zh: 她今天稍早打過電話給你。

items.en: Earlier today, the manager announced a new holiday policy.
items.zh: 今天稍早，經理宣布了新的休假規定。

examples.heading: ⑥ 故事裡的 then、at that time、in the end

items.en: We waited for the bus, but it didn't come. Then we took a taxi.
items.zh: 我們等公車，可是車一直沒來。後來我們就搭了計程車。

items.en: She read the letter twice and then tore it up.
items.zh: 她把信讀了兩遍，然後就撕掉了。

items.en: At that time, I didn't speak any English.
items.zh: 那時候我一句英文都不會說。

items.en: My parents ran a small café at that time.
items.zh: 我爸媽那時候開了一家小咖啡店。

items.en: We argued for hours, but in the end we agreed.
items.zh: 我們吵了好幾個小時，不過最後還是達成了共識。

items.en: In the end, we decided to stay at home.
items.zh: 最後我們決定待在家裡。

examples.heading: ⑦ 兩個時間副詞語一起用

items.en: Last summer, I worked in a hotel for two months.
items.zh: 去年夏天，我在一家飯店工作了兩個月。

items.en: We stayed in Kyoto for a week in April.
items.zh: 我們四月在京都待了一個禮拜。

items.en: Two years ago, during the rainy season, the river flooded the whole town.
items.zh: 兩年前的雨季，河水淹沒了整個鎮。

title: When I arrived, the weather was horrible.
translation: 我到的時候，天氣糟透了。
name: when 子句用過去簡單式
sentences: I went to a summer camp in Scotland. When I arrived, the weather was horrible.
When we got to the beach, the sun came out.

I came back at two in the morning. When I got home, my parents were very angry.
My parents drove for ten hours. When they reached the hotel, it was already dark.
I waited in the rain for twenty minutes. When the bus arrived, it was full.
I can't find my phone. I think I left it in the kitchen when I fell on the slippery floor.
I couldn't open my front door last night. I lost my keys when I went for a run in the park.
My aunt is very sad today. She dropped her ring when she washed her hands at the restaurant.
I can't read the menu. I broke my glasses when I sat on them.
My son can't play football this week. He hurt his knee when he fell off his bike.

When I was seven, I learned to swim in the sea.
When my mum was young, she lived in Italy.

My dad makes great coffee. When he was a student, he worked in a café.
Now I work as a designer. When I was at school, I loved art.
When my grandfather was a boy, there were no cars in the village.
My parents gave me a puppy for my birthday. When I saw the present, I cried with happiness.
My sister got into medical school. When she heard the news, she called her mother.
I came home after a week away. When the dog saw me, it ran to the door.
We were having a picnic in the garden. When we heard the thunder, we went inside.
My brother wanted the new phone. When he saw the price, he changed his mind.
When I heard the song, I remembered my first holiday abroad.
The university offered me a place. I was very happy when I got the letter.
We hid in the living room for Mum's birthday. She was surprised when she saw all her friends.
We climbed the mountain for six hours. We were tired when we finally reached the top.
My brother is a doctor now. He was nervous when he started his new job.
My parents were proud when I passed my exams.
I was alone in the house during the storm. I was scared when the lights went out.
It was Christmas Eve. The children were excited when it started to snow.

examples.heading: ① When + 主詞 + arrived / got + …, + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: I went to a summer camp in Scotland. When I arrived, the weather was horrible.
items.zh: 我去蘇格蘭參加夏令營。我到的時候，天氣很糟。

items.en: When we got to the beach, the sun came out.
items.zh: 我們到海灘的時候，太陽出來了。

items.en: It was my sister's surprise birthday party. When she arrived, everyone cheered.
items.zh: 那是我姊姊的驚喜生日派對。她到的時候，大家都歡呼起來。

items.en: I came back at two in the morning. When I got home, my parents were very angry.
items.zh: 我凌晨兩點才回來。我回到家的時候，我爸媽很生氣。

items.en: My parents drove for ten hours. When they reached the hotel, it was already dark.
items.zh: 我爸媽開了十個小時的車。他們到飯店的時候，天已經黑了。

items.en: I waited in the rain for twenty minutes. When the bus arrived, it was full.
items.zh: 我在雨中等了二十分鐘。公車來的時候已經客滿了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + 過去式 + when + 主詞 + 過去式：找東西或回想

items.en: I can't find my phone. I think I left it in the kitchen when I fell on the slippery floor.
items.zh: 我找不到我的手機。我想我是在廚房的滑地板上跌倒的時候把它掉在那裡的。

items.en: I couldn't open my front door last night. I lost my keys when I went for a run in the park.
items.zh: 我昨晚打不開家門。我去公園跑步的時候弄丟了鑰匙。

items.en: My aunt is very sad today. She dropped her ring when she washed her hands at the restaurant.
items.zh: 我阿姨今天很難過。她在餐廳洗手的時候把戒指掉了。

items.en: I can't read the menu. I broke my glasses when I sat on them.
items.zh: 我看不清楚菜單。我坐到眼鏡的時候把它壓壞了。

items.en: My son can't play football this week. He hurt his knee when he fell off his bike.
items.zh: 我兒子這個禮拜不能踢足球。他從腳踏車上摔下來的時候傷了膝蓋。

items.en: I got very wet on the way home. I forgot my umbrella when I left the café.
items.zh: 我回家路上淋得好濕。我離開咖啡館的時候忘了帶雨傘。

examples.heading: ③ When + 主詞 + was + 年紀或身分, + 主詞 + 過去式：小時候

items.en: When I was seven, I learned to swim in the sea.
items.zh: 我七歲的時候在海裡學會游泳。

items.en: When my mum was young, she lived in Italy.
items.zh: 我媽媽年輕的時候住在義大利。

items.en: When we were children, we played in the woods every day.
items.zh: 我們小時候每天都在樹林裡玩。

items.en: My dad makes great coffee. When he was a student, he worked in a café.
items.zh: 我爸爸咖啡泡得很好。他當學生的時候在一家咖啡館打工。

items.en: Now I work as a designer. When I was at school, I loved art.
items.zh: 我現在當設計師。我上學的時候很喜歡美術。

items.en: When my grandfather was a boy, there were no cars in the village.
items.zh: 我爺爺小時候，村子裡沒有汽車。

examples.heading: ④ When + 主詞 + saw / heard + …, + 主詞 + 過去式：看到或聽到的反應

items.en: My parents gave me a puppy for my birthday. When I saw the present, I cried with happiness.
items.zh: 我爸媽送我一隻小狗當生日禮物。我看到那個禮物的時候，高興得哭了。

items.en: My sister got into medical school. When she heard the news, she called her mother.
items.zh: 我姊姊考上了醫學院。她聽到那個消息的時候，打電話給她媽媽。

items.en: I came home after a week away. When the dog saw me, it ran to the door.
items.zh: 我出門一個禮拜後回到家。狗看到我的時候，跑到門口。

items.en: We were having a picnic in the garden. When we heard the thunder, we went inside.
items.zh: 我們在花園裡野餐。我們聽到雷聲的時候，就進屋了。

items.en: My brother wanted the new phone. When he saw the price, he changed his mind.
items.zh: 我弟弟想買那支新手機。他看到價錢的時候，改變了主意。

items.en: When I heard the song, I remembered my first holiday abroad.
items.zh: 我聽到那首歌的時候，想起我第一次出國度假。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + was + 形容詞 + when + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: The university offered me a place. I was very happy when I got the letter.
items.zh: 那所大學錄取了我。我收到那封信的時候很高興。

items.en: We hid in the living room for Mum's birthday. She was surprised when she saw all her friends.
items.zh: 我們為了媽媽的生日躲在客廳。她看到她所有朋友的時候很驚訝。

items.en: We climbed the mountain for six hours. We were tired when we finally reached the top.
items.zh: 我們爬了六個小時的山。我們終於到達山頂的時候很累。

items.en: My brother is a doctor now. He was nervous when he started his new job.
items.zh: 我哥哥現在是醫生。他開始新工作的時候很緊張。

items.en: My parents were proud when I passed my exams.
items.zh: 我考試通過的時候，我爸媽很驕傲。

items.en: I was alone in the house during the storm. I was scared when the lights went out.
items.zh: 暴風雨的時候我一個人在家。燈熄的時候我很害怕。

items.en: It was Christmas Eve. The children were excited when it started to snow.
items.zh: 那天是平安夜。開始下雪的時候，孩子們很興奮。

title: It was raining when I arrived.
translation: 我到的時候正在下雨。
name: 過去進行式表示背景事件
sentences: I landed in London in the afternoon. It was raining when I arrived, and I had no umbrella.
It was snowing when we left the house this morning.
It was getting dark when we reached the village.
The sun was shining when we got to the beach.
The wind was blowing hard when the ferry left the harbour.
It was still raining when the match started.
Yesterday we were studying maths in your house, and I left my book on your bed.
I was carrying the plates to the table, and I dropped one.
We were walking in the park, and we saw a famous actor.
She was riding her bike to school, and she fell off.
They were playing football in the street, and they broke a window.
I was cooking dinner, and I cut my finger.
I was having a shower when the doorbell rang.
We were having lunch when the lights went out.
She was reading a book when she heard a strange noise.
He was driving to work when his car broke down.
They were watching TV when the earthquake started.
I was waiting for the bus when I met my old teacher.
The phone rang while I was cleaning the bathroom.
Someone stole my bag while I was looking at the menu.
I fell asleep while I was watching the film.
The baby woke up while we were having dinner.
I found an old photo while I was tidying my room.
He hurt his back while he was moving the sofa.
The sun was shining and the birds were singing. Suddenly, a dog ran into the garden.
Everyone was dancing and laughing when the music stopped.
The children were playing and their parents were chatting when the storm began.
The fire was burning and we were telling stories when we heard a wolf.
It was raining and the streets were empty when I saw the stranger.
My mum was cooking and my dad was reading when I told them the news.
The town was sleeping and the moon was shining when the bells began to ring.

examples.heading: ① It was + -ing + when + 主詞 + 過去式：天氣當背景

items.en: I landed in London in the afternoon. It was raining when I arrived, and I had no umbrella.
items.zh: 我下午降落在倫敦。我到的時候正在下雨，我沒有帶傘。

items.en: It was snowing when we left the house this morning.
items.zh: 我們今天早上出門的時候正在下雪。

items.en: It was getting dark when we reached the village.
items.zh: 我們到村子的時候天快黑了。

items.en: The sun was shining when we got to the beach.
items.zh: 我們到海灘的時候陽光很好。

items.en: The wind was blowing hard when the ferry left the harbour.
items.zh: 渡輪離開港口的時候風很大。

items.en: It was still raining when the match started.
items.zh: 比賽開始的時候還在下雨。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + was / were + -ing + …, and + 主詞 + 過去式：做事的時候發生意外

items.en: Yesterday we were studying maths in your house, and I left my book on your bed.
items.zh: 昨天我們在你家讀數學，我把書留在你的床上了。

items.en: I was carrying the plates to the table, and I dropped one.
items.zh: 我正把盤子端到桌上，然後摔破了一個。

items.en: We were walking in the park, and we saw a famous actor.
items.zh: 我們在公園散步，然後看到了一位有名的演員。

items.en: She was riding her bike to school, and she fell off.
items.zh: 她騎腳踏車上學，然後摔下來了。

items.en: They were playing football in the street, and they broke a window.
items.zh: 他們在街上踢足球，然後打破了一扇窗戶。

items.en: I was cooking dinner, and I cut my finger.
items.zh: 我在煮晚餐，然後割到了手指。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + was / were + -ing + when + 主詞 + 過去式：被打斷

items.en: I was having a shower when the doorbell rang.
items.zh: 我在洗澡的時候，門鈴響了。

items.en: We were having lunch when the lights went out.
items.zh: 我們在吃午餐的時候，燈熄了。

items.en: She was reading a book when she heard a strange noise.
items.zh: 她在看書的時候聽到一個奇怪的聲音。

items.en: He was driving to work when his car broke down.
items.zh: 他開車上班的時候，車子拋錨了。

items.en: They were watching TV when the earthquake started.
items.zh: 他們在看電視的時候，地震開始了。

items.en: I was waiting for the bus when I met my old teacher.
items.zh: 我在等公車的時候遇到了以前的老師。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + 過去式 + while + 主詞 + was / were + -ing

items.en: The phone rang while I was cleaning the bathroom.
items.zh: 我在打掃浴室的時候電話響了。

items.en: Someone stole my bag while I was looking at the menu.
items.zh: 我在看菜單的時候，有人偷了我的包包。

items.en: I fell asleep while I was watching the film.
items.zh: 我看電影的時候睡著了。

items.en: The baby woke up while we were having dinner.
items.zh: 我們在吃晚餐的時候寶寶醒了。

items.en: I found an old photo while I was tidying my room.
items.zh: 我在整理房間的時候找到一張舊照片。

items.en: He hurt his back while he was moving the sofa.
items.zh: 他在搬沙發的時候弄傷了背。

examples.heading: ⑤ 背景 + 背景 + 事件：故事的開頭

items.en: The sun was shining and the birds were singing. Suddenly, a dog ran into the garden.
items.zh: 太陽照著，鳥在唱歌。突然，一隻狗跑進了花園。

items.en: Everyone was dancing and laughing when the music stopped.
items.zh: 大家都在跳舞和笑的時候，音樂停了。

items.en: The children were playing and their parents were chatting when the storm began.
items.zh: 孩子們在玩，他們的父母在聊天，這時暴風雨開始了。

items.en: The fire was burning and we were telling stories when we heard a wolf.
items.zh: 火在燒，我們在說故事，這時我們聽到一隻狼的聲音。

items.en: It was raining and the streets were empty when I saw the stranger.
items.zh: 在下雨，街上空無一人，這時我看到了那個陌生人。

items.en: My mum was cooking and my dad was reading when I told them the news.
items.zh: 我媽媽在煮飯，我爸爸在看書，這時我告訴他們這個消息。

items.en: The town was sleeping and the moon was shining when the bells began to ring.
items.zh: 鎮上的人都在睡覺，月亮照著，這時鐘聲開始響了。

title: I had been waiting for this letter for months, so I opened it immediately.
translation: 這封信我等了好幾個月，所以一收到就馬上拆開了。
name: 過去完成進行式表示主要事件前的持續動作
sentences: I had been waiting for the letter from the university for months, so I opened it immediately.
We had been walking for hours, so we sat down for a rest.
She had been studying all day, so she went to bed early.
He had been saving for years, so he bought a car.
They had been arguing all week, so the house was very quiet.
I had been looking forward to the trip for ages, so I packed a week early.
Once I had been watching TV for six hours when my mum suddenly switched it off.
We had been driving for an hour when the car broke down.
She had been working at the shop for a week when it closed.
I had been sleeping for only an hour when the baby woke up.
They had been playing for twenty minutes when it started to rain.
He had been reading for ages when he realised the time.
He was out of breath because he had been running.
The grass was wet because it had been raining all night.
I was angry because I had been waiting for an hour.
Her hands were dirty because she had been planting flowers.
They were sunburnt because they had been lying on the beach all day.
The kitchen smelt wonderful because Mum had been baking.
By the time the bus arrived, we had been waiting for forty minutes.
By the time I finished, I had been writing for six hours.
By the time the doctor came, he had been feeling ill for days.
By the time we got there, the party had been going for hours.
By the time she retired, she had been teaching for forty years.
By the time the rescue team found them, they had been walking for two days.
It had been snowing all night, and the roads were closed.
We had been talking for hours, and we didn't notice the time.
She had been practising every day, and she finally passed the test.
They had been building the bridge for years, and it finally opened.
I had been feeling lonely, and then I met my best friend.
He had been looking for a job for months, and finally he got one.
The old man had been living alone for years, and nobody visited him.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + had been + -ing + for + 時間, so + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: I had been waiting for the letter from the university for months, so I opened it immediately.
items.zh: 我等那封大學的信等了好幾個月，所以我馬上就打開了。

items.en: We had been walking for hours, so we sat down for a rest.
items.zh: 我們走了好幾個小時，所以坐下來休息。

items.en: She had been studying all day, so she went to bed early.
items.zh: 她讀了一整天的書，所以早早就上床了。

items.en: He had been saving for years, so he bought a car.
items.zh: 他存了好幾年的錢，所以買了一台車。

items.en: They had been arguing all week, so the house was very quiet.
items.zh: 他們吵了一整個星期，所以家裡很安靜。

items.en: I had been looking forward to the trip for ages, so I packed a week early.
items.zh: 我期待那趟旅行很久了，所以提早一個星期就收好行李。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + had been + -ing + when + 主詞 + 過去式：被打斷

items.en: Once I had been watching TV for six hours when my mum suddenly switched it off.
items.zh: 有一次我已經看了六個小時的電視，這時我媽媽突然把它關掉了。

items.en: We had been driving for an hour when the car broke down.
items.zh: 我們開了一個小時的車，這時車子拋錨了。

items.en: She had been working at the shop for a week when it closed.
items.zh: 她在那家店工作了一個星期，這時店就倒了。

items.en: I had been sleeping for only an hour when the baby woke up.
items.zh: 我才睡了一個小時，寶寶就醒了。

items.en: They had been playing for twenty minutes when it started to rain.
items.zh: 他們玩了二十分鐘，這時開始下雨了。

items.en: He had been reading for ages when he realised the time.
items.zh: 他看書看了很久，這時才發現時間。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 過去式 + because + 主詞 + had been + -ing

items.en: He was out of breath because he had been running.
items.zh: 他喘不過氣，因為他一直在跑。

items.en: The grass was wet because it had been raining all night.
items.zh: 草是濕的，因為下了一整晚的雨。

items.en: I was angry because I had been waiting for an hour.
items.zh: 我很生氣，因為我已經等了一個小時。

items.en: Her hands were dirty because she had been planting flowers.
items.zh: 她的手很髒，因為她一直在種花。

items.en: They were sunburnt because they had been lying on the beach all day.
items.zh: 他們曬傷了，因為他們在海灘上躺了一整天。

items.en: The kitchen smelt wonderful because Mum had been baking.
items.zh: 廚房聞起來好香，因為媽媽一直在烤東西。

examples.heading: ④ By the time + 主詞 + 過去式, + 主詞 + had been + -ing

items.en: By the time the bus arrived, we had been waiting for forty minutes.
items.zh: 公車到的時候，我們已經等了四十分鐘。

items.en: By the time I finished, I had been writing for six hours.
items.zh: 我寫完的時候，已經寫了六個小時。

items.en: By the time the doctor came, he had been feeling ill for days.
items.zh: 醫生來的時候，他已經不舒服好幾天了。

items.en: By the time we got there, the party had been going for hours.
items.zh: 我們到的時候，派對已經開了好幾個小時。

items.en: By the time she retired, she had been teaching for forty years.
items.zh: 她退休的時候，已經教了四十年書。

items.en: By the time the rescue team found them, they had been walking for two days.
items.zh: 救援隊找到他們的時候，他們已經走了兩天。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + had been + -ing, and + 主詞 + 過去式：先說持續的背景

items.en: It had been snowing all night, and the roads were closed.
items.zh: 下了一整晚的雪，路都封了。

items.en: We had been talking for hours, and we didn't notice the time.
items.zh: 我們聊了好幾個小時，都沒注意時間。

items.en: She had been practising every day, and she finally passed the test.
items.zh: 她每天都在練習，最後終於通過考試了。

items.en: They had been building the bridge for years, and it finally opened.
items.zh: 他們蓋那座橋蓋了好幾年，最後終於通車了。

items.en: I had been feeling lonely, and then I met my best friend.
items.zh: 我一直覺得很寂寞，後來我遇到了我最好的朋友。

items.en: He had been looking for a job for months, and finally he got one.
items.zh: 他找工作找了好幾個月，最後終於找到了。

items.en: The old man had been living alone for years, and nobody visited him.
items.zh: 那個老人一個人住了好幾年，沒有人去看他。

title: He went to the hotel because he wanted to find out who had sent him a mysterious letter.
translation: 舉辦這場派對的 Landsbury 夫婦請大家保持冷靜。
name: 關係子句中的過去完成式
sentences: The letter only had the name of a hotel on it. He went to the hotel because he wanted to find out who had sent him a mysterious letter.
My sister found roses outside her flat. She wanted to know who had left the flowers on her doorstep.
A ball came through the shop window. The police tried to find out who had broken the window.
The plate was empty in the morning. We never discovered who had eaten the last piece of cake.
There was a funny poem on the classroom wall. The teacher asked who had written it.
It was raining when I left the office. I wondered who had taken my umbrella.
After a while Mr and Mrs Landsbury, the couple who had organised the party, asked everybody to stay calm.
Mrs Green, the woman who had found the lost dog, received a reward.
There was a prize-giving after the race. The boy who had won the race gave a short speech.
I was in hospital for a month. The doctor who had saved my life came to visit me.
The results came out on Friday. The students who had passed the exam celebrated in the park.
We bought an old house in the village. The man who had built the house still lived next door.
Everyone cheered at the airport. It was Annika who had arranged a huge party for her there.
Mum was angry with me, but it was my brother who had broken the vase, not me.
The fire was small, and nobody was hurt. It was the neighbours who had called the fire brigade.
It was our next-door neighbour who had found the lost kitten in the snow.
Someone came into the office at night. It was Tom who had forgotten to lock the door.
Dad blamed the children, but it was the dog that had dug up the flowers.
I was so happy last summer. I found the ring that I had lost on the beach.
My mother cried. She read the letter which her father had written before he died.
Our trip to Paris was great. We stayed in the hotel that my parents had recommended.
My grandfather went to my wedding. He wore the suit that he had bought for his wedding.
My uncles came home from the lake. They ate the fish that they had caught that morning.
My friend loves travel. I showed her the photos that I had taken in Peru.
On the train I met a woman who had lived in India for twenty years.
At the party I saw an old friend who had moved to Canada.
We talked to a farmer who had worked on the land all his life.
My aunt went on a cruise. She met a man who had sailed around the world alone.
I spoke to a nurse who had looked after my grandfather.
My parents went to Nepal. They hired a guide who had climbed the mountain many times.
My grandfather never left his town. He married a girl who had grown up in the same street.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + find out / know / ask + who had + 過去分詞：問是誰做的

items.en: The letter only had the name of a hotel on it. He went to the hotel because he wanted to find out who had sent him a mysterious letter.
items.zh: 那封信上只寫了一家飯店的名字。他去了那家飯店，因為他想知道是誰寄給他那封神秘的信。

items.en: My sister found roses outside her flat. She wanted to know who had left the flowers on her doorstep.
items.zh: 我姊姊在她公寓外面發現玫瑰。她想知道是誰把花放在她家門口。

items.en: A ball came through the shop window. The police tried to find out who had broken the window.
items.zh: 一顆球打穿了商店的櫥窗。警察想查出是誰打破了窗戶。

items.en: The plate was empty in the morning. We never discovered who had eaten the last piece of cake.
items.zh: 早上盤子是空的。我們一直沒發現是誰吃了最後一塊蛋糕。

items.en: There was a funny poem on the classroom wall. The teacher asked who had written it.
items.zh: 教室的牆上有一首好笑的詩。老師問那是誰寫的。

items.en: It was raining when I left the office. I wondered who had taken my umbrella.
items.zh: 我離開辦公室的時候在下雨。我想知道是誰拿走了我的傘。

examples.heading: ② 名詞, + the + 名詞 + who had + 過去分詞, + 過去式

items.en: After a while Mr and Mrs Landsbury, the couple who had organised the party, asked everybody to stay calm.
items.zh: 過了一會兒，辦派對的蘭斯伯里夫婦請大家保持冷靜。

items.en: Mrs Green, the woman who had found the lost dog, received a reward.
items.zh: 找到那隻走失的狗的格林太太得到了一筆獎金。

items.en: There was a prize-giving after the race. The boy who had won the race gave a short speech.
items.zh: 賽跑後有頒獎典禮。贏得比賽的那個男孩做了一個簡短的演講。

items.en: I was in hospital for a month. The doctor who had saved my life came to visit me.
items.zh: 我住院住了一個月。救了我一命的那位醫生來看我。

items.en: The results came out on Friday. The students who had passed the exam celebrated in the park.
items.zh: 成績星期五公布。通過考試的學生們在公園慶祝。

items.en: We bought an old house in the village. The man who had built the house still lived next door.
items.zh: 我們在村子裡買了一間老房子。蓋那間房子的人還住在隔壁。

examples.heading: ③ It was + 人 + who had + 過去分詞：強調是誰

items.en: Everyone cheered at the airport. It was Annika who had arranged a huge party for her there.
items.zh: 大家在機場歡呼。是安妮卡在那裡為她安排了一個盛大的派對。

items.en: Mum was angry with me, but it was my brother who had broken the vase, not me.
items.zh: 媽媽在生我的氣，可是打破花瓶的是我哥哥，不是我。

items.en: The fire was small, and nobody was hurt. It was the neighbours who had called the fire brigade.
items.zh: 那場火很小，沒有人受傷。打電話叫消防隊的是鄰居。

items.en: It was our next-door neighbour who had found the lost kitten in the snow.
items.zh: 在雪地裡找到那隻走失小貓的是我們隔壁的鄰居。

items.en: Someone came into the office at night. It was Tom who had forgotten to lock the door.
items.zh: 晚上有人進了辦公室。忘了鎖門的是湯姆。

items.en: Dad blamed the children, but it was the dog that had dug up the flowers.
items.zh: 爸爸怪孩子們，可是挖掉那些花的是那隻狗。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞 + that / which had + 過去分詞：說東西

items.en: I was so happy last summer. I found the ring that I had lost on the beach.
items.zh: 去年夏天我好開心。我找到了我在海灘上弄丟的那枚戒指。

items.en: My mother cried. She read the letter which her father had written before he died.
items.zh: 我媽媽哭了。她讀了她爸爸去世前寫的那封信。

items.en: Our trip to Paris was great. We stayed in the hotel that my parents had recommended.
items.zh: 我們的巴黎之旅很棒。我們住在我爸媽推薦的那家飯店。

items.en: My grandfather went to my wedding. He wore the suit that he had bought for his wedding.
items.zh: 我爺爺來參加我的婚禮。他穿了他為了自己的婚禮買的那套西裝。

items.en: My uncles came home from the lake. They ate the fish that they had caught that morning.
items.zh: 我的叔叔們從湖邊回到家。他們吃了他們那天早上釣到的魚。

items.en: My friend loves travel. I showed her the photos that I had taken in Peru.
items.zh: 我朋友很愛旅行。我給她看我在秘魯拍的照片。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + met / saw + 人 + who had + 過去分詞：遇到的人

items.en: On the train I met a woman who had lived in India for twenty years.
items.zh: 在火車上我遇到一個在印度住了二十年的女人。

items.en: At the party I saw an old friend who had moved to Canada.
items.zh: 在派對上我看到一個搬去加拿大的老朋友。

items.en: We talked to a farmer who had worked on the land all his life.
items.zh: 我們跟一個一輩子都在種田的農夫聊天。

items.en: My aunt went on a cruise. She met a man who had sailed around the world alone.
items.zh: 我阿姨去坐郵輪。她遇到一個獨自環遊世界航行過的男人。

items.en: I spoke to a nurse who had looked after my grandfather.
items.zh: 我跟一位照顧過我爺爺的護理師說話。

items.en: My parents went to Nepal. They hired a guide who had climbed the mountain many times.
items.zh: 我爸媽去尼泊爾。他們雇了一個爬過那座山很多次的嚮導。

items.en: My grandfather never left his town. He married a girl who had grown up in the same street.
items.zh: 我爺爺從來沒離開過他的小鎮。他娶了一個在同一條街長大的女孩。

title: We had planned to go to Switzerland, but unfortunately our car broke down.
translation: 我們本來打算去瑞士，可惜車子壞了。
name: 過去完成式表示後來改變的情況
sentences: Our holiday in the mountains didn't happen. We had planned to stay in a little hotel, but the hotel closed in June.
After the show we had planned to go to the theatre restaurant, but it was closed.
I had planned to study all weekend, but my cousins came to visit.
They had planned a picnic, but it rained all day.
She had planned to retire at sixty, but she loved her job too much.
We had planned to paint the house in May, but we ran out of money.
My friend liked a boy in her class. At first she had wanted to make the first move, but she wasn't quite sure.
At first I had wanted to study medicine, but I chose art.
My brother and his wife got married last year. At first he had wanted to have a big wedding, but they had a small one.
At first we had wanted to live in the city, but we moved to the country.
Our neighbours have a new pet. At first they had wanted to get a dog, but they got a cat.
At first she had wanted to be a singer, but she became a lawyer.
We had hoped to see the Northern Lights, but the sky was cloudy.
I had hoped to finish the book before the holiday, but I didn't.
She had hoped to get the job, but someone else got it.
They had hoped to arrive by noon, but the traffic was terrible.
My son trained hard for the race. He had hoped to win, but he came second.
We went to the beach in April. We had hoped to sit in the sun, but it snowed.
Happy birthday for yesterday! I had meant to call you, but I forgot.
She had intended to stay for a week, but she left after two days.
We had meant to buy bread, but the shop was shut.
He had intended to fix the roof, but he hurt his back.
Sorry you heard about my new job from Tom. I had meant to tell you the news, but you were busy.
They had intended to sell the car, but nobody wanted it.
I had expected the test to be easy, but it was very hard.
We had thought the hotel was near the beach, but it was miles away.
She had expected a small party, but a hundred people came.
My dad had thought the opera would send him to sleep, but he cried at the end.
They had expected rain, but the sun shone all day.
I had thought she was angry, but she was only tired.
We had expected to wait for hours, but the doctor saw us at once.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + had planned to + 原形動詞, but + 句子

items.en: Our holiday in the mountains didn't happen. We had planned to stay in a little hotel, but the hotel closed in June.
items.zh: 我們去山上的假期沒去成。我們本來計畫住在一家小飯店，可是那家飯店六月就關了。

items.en: After the show we had planned to go to the theatre restaurant, but it was closed.
items.zh: 表演結束後我們本來打算去劇院的餐廳，可是它關了。

items.en: I had planned to study all weekend, but my cousins came to visit.
items.zh: 我本來打算整個週末讀書，可是我的表親來看我。

items.en: They had planned a picnic, but it rained all day.
items.zh: 他們本來計畫去野餐，可是下了一整天的雨。

items.en: She had planned to retire at sixty, but she loved her job too much.
items.zh: 她本來計畫六十歲退休，可是她太喜歡她的工作了。

items.en: We had planned to paint the house in May, but we ran out of money.
items.zh: 我們本來計畫五月油漆房子，可是錢用完了。

examples.heading: ② At first + 主詞 + had wanted to + 原形動詞, but + 句子

items.en: My friend liked a boy in her class. At first she had wanted to make the first move, but she wasn't quite sure.
items.zh: 我朋友喜歡班上的一個男生。她一開始本來想主動，可是她不太確定。

items.en: At first I had wanted to study medicine, but I chose art.
items.zh: 我一開始本來想念醫學，可是我選了藝術。

items.en: My brother and his wife got married last year. At first he had wanted to have a big wedding, but they had a small one.
items.zh: 我哥哥和他太太去年結婚。他一開始本來想辦一個盛大的婚禮，可是他們辦了一個小型的。

items.en: At first we had wanted to live in the city, but we moved to the country.
items.zh: 我們一開始本來想住在城市，可是我們搬到了鄉下。

items.en: Our neighbours have a new pet. At first they had wanted to get a dog, but they got a cat.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居養了新的寵物。他們一開始本來想養狗，可是他們養了一隻貓。

items.en: At first she had wanted to be a singer, but she became a lawyer.
items.zh: 她一開始本來想當歌手，可是她成了律師。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + had hoped to + 原形動詞, but + 句子

items.en: We had hoped to see the Northern Lights, but the sky was cloudy.
items.zh: 我們本來希望看到北極光，可是天空多雲。

items.en: I had hoped to finish the book before the holiday, but I didn't.
items.zh: 我本來希望度假前讀完那本書，可是沒讀完。

items.en: She had hoped to get the job, but someone else got it.
items.zh: 她本來希望得到那份工作，可是別人得到了。

items.en: They had hoped to arrive by noon, but the traffic was terrible.
items.zh: 他們本來希望中午前到，可是交通很糟。

items.en: My son trained hard for the race. He had hoped to win, but he came second.
items.zh: 我兒子為了比賽努力練習。他本來希望贏，可是他得了第二名。

items.en: We went to the beach in April. We had hoped to sit in the sun, but it snowed.
items.zh: 我們四月去海邊。我們本來希望坐在陽光下，可是下雪了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + had intended / meant to + 原形動詞, but + 句子

items.en: Happy birthday for yesterday! I had meant to call you, but I forgot.
items.zh: 昨天生日快樂！我本來要打給你，可是我忘了。

items.en: She had intended to stay for a week, but she left after two days.
items.zh: 她本來打算住一個星期，可是兩天後就走了。

items.en: We had meant to buy bread, but the shop was shut.
items.zh: 我們本來要買麵包，可是那家店關了。

items.en: He had intended to fix the roof, but he hurt his back.
items.zh: 他本來打算修屋頂，可是他弄傷了背。

items.en: Sorry you heard about my new job from Tom. I had meant to tell you the news, but you were busy.
items.zh: 抱歉你是從湯姆那裡聽到我換工作的事。我本來要告訴你那個消息，可是你很忙。

items.en: They had intended to sell the car, but nobody wanted it.
items.zh: 他們本來打算賣車，可是沒有人要。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + had expected / thought + 子句, but + 句子：想的和結果不一樣

items.en: I had expected the test to be easy, but it was very hard.
items.zh: 我本來以為考試會很簡單，可是很難。

items.en: We had thought the hotel was near the beach, but it was miles away.
items.zh: 我們本來以為飯店在海灘附近，可是它離海灘好幾英里。

items.en: She had expected a small party, but a hundred people came.
items.zh: 她本來以為是一個小派對，可是來了一百個人。

items.en: My dad had thought the opera would send him to sleep, but he cried at the end.
items.zh: 我爸爸本來以為那齣歌劇會讓他睡著，可是他在結尾哭了。

items.en: They had expected rain, but the sun shone all day.
items.zh: 他們本來以為會下雨，可是太陽照了一整天。

items.en: I had thought she was angry, but she was only tired.
items.zh: 我本來以為她在生氣，可是她只是累了。

items.en: We had expected to wait for hours, but the doctor saw us at once.
items.zh: 我們本來以為要等好幾個小時，可是醫生馬上就看了我們。

title: I bought your product, only to find out that its quality did not match your advertisement.
translation: 我買了你們的產品，結果發現品質跟廣告說的不一樣。
name: 過去簡單式敘述多個事件的先後
sentences: I ran all the way to the station, only to see my train pull away.
We drove all the way to the beach, only to discover that it was closed.
She ran to the gate, only to be told that boarding had finished.
He finally found the restaurant, only to realise he had left his wallet at home.
I spent hours on the report, only to lose it when my computer crashed.
They queued for two hours, only to hear that the tickets had sold out.
Dear Members, after having discussed the club fees at the meeting, we came up with the following decisions.
After having lived in Spain for five years, she moved back to Taiwan.
After having read your article, I decided to write to you.
After having checked the figures twice, he found the error.
Our friends never came to the café. After having waited for an hour, we went home.
After finishing my degree, I worked abroad for a year.
Before leaving the office, she turned off all the lights.
After visiting the museum, we had lunch by the river.
Before signing the contract, I read it very carefully.
After saying goodbye, he walked slowly to his car.
Following advice from a friend, I bought the English version of your product.
Hearing a noise downstairs, she went to see what it was.
Following the meeting, the manager sent everyone a summary.
Opening the box, I saw that the screen was broken.
Realising he was late, he took a taxi.
The hotel lost our booking, which meant we had to find another room at midnight.
My flight was cancelled, which ruined the first day of my holiday.
She forgot to set the alarm, which made her late for the interview.
The guide spoke only French, which meant nobody in our group understood the tour.
The concert started an hour late, which annoyed a lot of people.
Following the instructions, I installed the software, only to find that it did not work.
After having paid for the course, I received an email saying it was cancelled.
Arriving at the hotel late, we went straight to bed, which was a mistake because we missed dinner.
Having booked the tickets online, we went to the theatre, only to learn that the show had been moved.
After lending him the money, I heard nothing from him for months, which made me very angry.

examples.heading: ① only to + 原形動詞

items.en: I ran all the way to the station, only to see my train pull away.
items.zh: 我一路跑到車站，結果看到我的火車開走了。

items.en: We drove all the way to the beach, only to discover that it was closed.
items.zh: 我們一路開到海邊，結果發現海灘不開放。

items.en: She ran to the gate, only to be told that boarding had finished.
items.zh: 她跑到登機門，結果被告知登機已經結束了。

items.en: He finally found the restaurant, only to realise he had left his wallet at home.
items.zh: 他終於找到餐廳，結果發現錢包忘在家裡。

items.en: I spent hours on the report, only to lose it when my computer crashed.
items.zh: 我花了好幾個小時寫報告，結果電腦當機，報告不見了。

items.en: They queued for two hours, only to hear that the tickets had sold out.
items.zh: 他們排了兩個小時，結果聽說票賣完了。

examples.heading: ② After having + 過去分詞

items.en: Dear Members, after having discussed the club fees at the meeting, we came up with the following decisions.
items.zh: 各位會員好，我們在會議上討論過會費的問題後，做了以下的決定。

items.en: After having lived in Spain for five years, she moved back to Taiwan.
items.zh: 她在西班牙住了五年以後，搬回台灣。

items.en: After having read your article, I decided to write to you.
items.zh: 我讀了你的文章以後，決定寫信給你。

items.en: After having checked the figures twice, he found the error.
items.zh: 他把數字檢查了兩次，才找到那個錯誤。

items.en: Our friends never came to the café. After having waited for an hour, we went home.
items.zh: 我們的朋友一直沒來咖啡店。我們等了一個小時以後就回家了。

examples.heading: ③ After / Before + 動詞-ing

items.en: After finishing my degree, I worked abroad for a year.
items.zh: 我拿到學位以後，在國外工作了一年。

items.en: Before leaving the office, she turned off all the lights.
items.zh: 她離開辦公室前，把燈都關了。

items.en: After visiting the museum, we had lunch by the river.
items.zh: 我們參觀完博物館，在河邊吃午餐。

items.en: Before signing the contract, I read it very carefully.
items.zh: 我簽合約之前仔細讀過了。

items.en: After saying goodbye, he walked slowly to his car.
items.zh: 他道別以後，慢慢走向他的車。

examples.heading: ④ 分詞片語和 Following + 名詞

items.en: Following advice from a friend, I bought the English version of your product.
items.zh: 我聽了朋友的建議，買了你們產品的英文版。

items.en: Hearing a noise downstairs, she went to see what it was.
items.zh: 她聽到樓下有聲音，就下去看看是什麼。

items.en: Following the meeting, the manager sent everyone a summary.
items.zh: 開完會以後，經理寄了一份摘要給大家。

items.en: Opening the box, I saw that the screen was broken.
items.zh: 我打開箱子，看到螢幕破了。

items.en: Realising he was late, he took a taxi.
items.zh: 他發現自己遲到了，就搭計程車。

examples.heading: ⑤ which 接出結果

items.en: The hotel lost our booking, which meant we had to find another room at midnight.
items.zh: 飯店把我們的訂房弄丟了，害我們半夜還得另外找房間。

items.en: My flight was cancelled, which ruined the first day of my holiday.
items.zh: 我的班機取消了，假期的第一天就這樣毀了。

items.en: She forgot to set the alarm, which made her late for the interview.
items.zh: 她忘了設鬧鐘，結果面試遲到了。

items.en: The guide spoke only French, which meant nobody in our group understood the tour.
items.zh: 導遊只說法文，結果我們團裡沒有人聽得懂導覽。

items.en: The concert started an hour late, which annoyed a lot of people.
items.zh: 音樂會晚了一個小時開始，很多人都很不高興。

examples.heading: ⑥ 一句話裡排出三件事

items.en: Following the instructions, I installed the software, only to find that it did not work.
items.zh: 我照著說明安裝了軟體，結果發現不能用。

items.en: After having paid for the course, I received an email saying it was cancelled.
items.zh: 我付了課程的錢以後，收到一封電子郵件說課程取消了。

items.en: Arriving at the hotel late, we went straight to bed, which was a mistake because we missed dinner.
items.zh: 我們很晚才到飯店，就直接去睡了。這是個錯誤，因為我們錯過了晚餐。

items.en: Having booked the tickets online, we went to the theatre, only to learn that the show had been moved.
items.zh: 我們在網路上訂了票去劇院，結果才知道表演改期了。

items.en: After lending him the money, I heard nothing from him for months, which made me very angry.
items.zh: 我借他錢以後，好幾個月都沒有他的消息，讓我很生氣。

title: I know her very well because we had been exchanging letters for a long time.
translation: 她從十歲起就一直去那裡。
name: 過去完成進行式加 for 或 since
sentences: When we finally met, I knew her very well, because we had been exchanging letters for a long time.
They had been living next door to us for twenty years when they moved to Spain.
My grandfather had been working at the factory for forty years when it closed.
We had been travelling around Asia for six months when we ran out of money.
She had been teaching at the school for ten years before she became head.
He had been learning the violin for three years when he joined the orchestra.
She knew everyone at the riding school, because she had been going there since she was ten years old.
The old man had been smoking since he was a child, since he was twelve.
My parents had been running the bakery since 1985.
He had been feeling tired since the beginning of the month.
They had been building the new road since last spring.
I had been waiting for her call since breakfast.
He spoke perfect Italian, because he had been living in Rome since he was a boy.
She was a very good cook, because she had been helping in her mother's restaurant for years.
The dog knew the way home, because it had been walking that path every day for years.
I recognised him at once, because I had been watching his films since I was a teenager.
They were good friends, because they had been playing in the same team since primary school.
She understood the problem, because she had been working in that department for five years.
By 2010, my family had been farming the same land for a hundred years.
By the end of the summer, I had been working at the café for three months.
By midnight, the band had been playing for four hours.
By the time of the wedding, they had been living together for six years.
By March, it had been snowing on and off for weeks.
By his tenth birthday, he had been swimming in competitions for two years.
The old man was sitting by the fire, smoking his pipe. He had been smoking since he was a child. Suddenly, the curtain moved.
The family had been living in the castle for centuries when the war began.
She had been writing in her diary every night for years when she lost it.
The two friends had been meeting at the café every Friday since school when one of them moved away.
The fisherman had been going out to sea every morning for fifty years when he saw the strange light.
The girl had been dreaming of the city since she was small when the letter arrived.
The village had been waiting for rain since spring when the storm finally came.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + had been + -ing + for + 一段時間

items.en: When we finally met, I knew her very well, because we had been exchanging letters for a long time.
items.zh: 我們終於見面的時候，我已經很了解她，因為我們已經通信很久了。

items.en: They had been living next door to us for twenty years when they moved to Spain.
items.zh: 他們搬去西班牙的時候，已經在我們隔壁住了二十年。

items.en: My grandfather had been working at the factory for forty years when it closed.
items.zh: 工廠關門的時候，我爺爺已經在那裡工作了四十年。

items.en: We had been travelling around Asia for six months when we ran out of money.
items.zh: 我們在亞洲旅行了六個月，然後錢就用完了。

items.en: She had been teaching at the school for ten years before she became head.
items.zh: 她當上校長之前，已經在那所學校教了十年書。

items.en: He had been learning the violin for three years when he joined the orchestra.
items.zh: 他加入管弦樂團的時候，已經學了三年小提琴。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + had been + -ing + since + 時間點

items.en: She knew everyone at the riding school, because she had been going there since she was ten years old.
items.zh: 她認識馬術學校的每一個人，因為她從十歲起就一直去那裡。

items.en: The old man had been smoking since he was a child, since he was twelve.
items.zh: 那個老人從小就開始抽菸，從他十二歲開始。

items.en: My parents had been running the bakery since 1985.
items.zh: 我爸媽從 1985 年起就一直經營那家麵包店。

items.en: He had been feeling tired since the beginning of the month.
items.zh: 他從月初就一直覺得很累。

items.en: They had been building the new road since last spring.
items.zh: 他們從去年春天就一直在蓋那條新路。

items.en: I had been waiting for her call since breakfast.
items.zh: 我從早餐後就一直在等她的電話。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 過去式, because + 主詞 + had been + -ing + for / since：說明原因

items.en: He spoke perfect Italian, because he had been living in Rome since he was a boy.
items.zh: 他的義大利文說得很好，因為他從小就住在羅馬。

items.en: She was a very good cook, because she had been helping in her mother's restaurant for years.
items.zh: 她很會煮飯，因為她多年來一直在她媽媽的餐廳幫忙。

items.en: The dog knew the way home, because it had been walking that path every day for years.
items.zh: 那隻狗認得回家的路，因為牠多年來每天都走那條路。
