items.en: I recognised him at once, because I had been watching his films since I was a teenager.
items.zh: 我一眼就認出他了，因為我從十幾歲就一直在看他的電影。

items.en: They were good friends, because they had been playing in the same team since primary school.
items.zh: 他們是好朋友，因為他們從小學就一直在同一支隊伍。

items.en: She understood the problem, because she had been working in that department for five years.
items.zh: 她了解這個問題，因為她已經在那個部門工作了五年。

examples.heading: ④ By + 時間, + 主詞 + had been + -ing + for + 一段時間

items.en: By 2010, my family had been farming the same land for a hundred years.
items.zh: 到 2010 年，我們家已經在同一塊地上耕作了一百年。

items.en: By the end of the summer, I had been working at the café for three months.
items.zh: 到夏天結束的時候，我已經在咖啡館工作了三個月。

items.en: By midnight, the band had been playing for four hours.
items.zh: 到半夜，樂團已經演奏了四個小時。

items.en: By the time of the wedding, they had been living together for six years.
items.zh: 到婚禮的時候，他們已經一起住了六年。

items.en: By March, it had been snowing on and off for weeks.
items.zh: 到三月，雪已經斷斷續續下了好幾個星期。

items.en: By his tenth birthday, he had been swimming in competitions for two years.
items.zh: 到他十歲生日的時候，他已經參加游泳比賽兩年了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 故事的背景：主詞 + had been + -ing + …, when + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: The old man was sitting by the fire, smoking his pipe. He had been smoking since he was a child. Suddenly, the curtain moved.
items.zh: 那個老人坐在火爐旁，抽著煙斗。他從小就開始抽菸。突然，窗簾動了一下。

items.en: The family had been living in the castle for centuries when the war began.
items.zh: 戰爭開始的時候，那一家人已經在城堡裡住了好幾百年。

items.en: She had been writing in her diary every night for years when she lost it.
items.zh: 她多年來每晚都寫日記，然後她把日記弄丟了。

items.en: The two friends had been meeting at the café every Friday since school when one of them moved away.
items.zh: 那兩個朋友從學生時代起每個星期五都在咖啡館見面，後來其中一個搬走了。

items.en: The fisherman had been going out to sea every morning for fifty years when he saw the strange light.
items.zh: 那個漁夫五十年來每天早上都出海，然後他看到了那道奇怪的光。

items.en: The girl had been dreaming of the city since she was small when the letter arrived.
items.zh: 那個女孩從小就夢想著那座城市，這時那封信來了。

items.en: The village had been waiting for rain since spring when the storm finally came.
items.zh: 那個村子從春天就一直在等雨，這時暴風雨終於來了。

title: It was raining, but the concert was so good that I did not mind.
translation: 那時在下雨，不過演唱會很好看，所以我不在意。
name: 過去進行式表示過去某時正在進行的事
sentences: The outdoor concert was on Saturday. It was raining, but the band was so good that I did not mind.
It was snowing, but we went for a walk anyway.
The wind was blowing, but the boat trip was wonderful.
My leg was hurting, but I finished the race.
The baby was crying, but nobody woke up.
It was getting late, but nobody wanted to go home.
I went to a football match. When I arrived, they were playing the last game of the championship.
When we got to the party, everyone was dancing.
When I opened the door, the cat was sleeping on my bed.
When the teacher came in, the students were talking loudly.
When I looked out of the window, it was snowing.
When we reached the top, the sun was setting.
This time last year, I was living in Spain.
In 2010, my parents were running a small hotel.
Last summer I was working in a café by the sea.
During the war, my grandfather was living in the mountains.
At that time, we were saving money for a new house.
Last winter my brother was learning to ski.
I was cooking and my sister was setting the table.
The children were swimming and their parents were reading on the beach.
Dad was washing the car and Mum was cutting the grass.
Some people were singing and others were clapping.
The band was playing and the crowd was jumping up and down.
I was studying and my roommate was listening to music.
The town was very busy. People were shopping and children were playing in the square.
The kitchen was full of smoke. Something was burning in the oven.
The station was crowded. Everyone was waiting for the last train.
The classroom was quiet. All the students were writing their exams.
The garden was beautiful. The roses were blooming and the bees were buzzing.
The restaurant was noisy. A group of friends was celebrating a birthday.
The street was dark. Only one light was shining in a window.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was / were + -ing, but + 句子：當時的情況和感受

items.en: The outdoor concert was on Saturday. It was raining, but the band was so good that I did not mind.
items.zh: 戶外演唱會在星期六。當時在下雨，可是樂團太棒了，所以我不介意。

items.en: It was snowing, but we went for a walk anyway.
items.zh: 當時在下雪，可是我們還是去散步了。

items.en: The wind was blowing, but the boat trip was wonderful.
items.zh: 當時風很大，可是乘船之旅很棒。

items.en: My leg was hurting, but I finished the race.
items.zh: 我的腳在痛，可是我跑完了比賽。

items.en: The baby was crying, but nobody woke up.
items.zh: 寶寶在哭，可是沒有人醒來。

items.en: It was getting late, but nobody wanted to go home.
items.zh: 時間越來越晚了，可是沒有人想回家。

examples.heading: ② When + 主詞 + 過去式, + 主詞 + was / were + -ing：到的時候正在發生

items.en: I went to a football match. When I arrived, they were playing the last game of the championship.
items.zh: 我去看了一場足球賽。我到的時候，他們正在打冠軍賽的最後一場。

items.en: When we got to the party, everyone was dancing.
items.zh: 我們到派對的時候，大家都在跳舞。

items.en: When I opened the door, the cat was sleeping on my bed.
items.zh: 我打開門的時候，貓正在我的床上睡覺。

items.en: When the teacher came in, the students were talking loudly.
items.zh: 老師進來的時候，學生們正在大聲說話。

items.en: When I looked out of the window, it was snowing.
items.zh: 我往窗外看的時候，正在下雪。

items.en: When we reached the top, the sun was setting.
items.zh: 我們到達山頂的時候，太陽正在下山。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + was / were + -ing + 時間：某段時間在做的事

items.en: This time last year, I was living in Spain.
items.zh: 去年這個時候，我住在西班牙。

items.en: In 2010, my parents were running a small hotel.
items.zh: 2010 年的時候，我爸媽在經營一家小旅館。

items.en: Last summer I was working in a café by the sea.
items.zh: 去年夏天我在海邊的一家咖啡館工作。

items.en: During the war, my grandfather was living in the mountains.
items.zh: 戰爭期間，我爺爺住在山裡。

items.en: At that time, we were saving money for a new house.
items.zh: 那時候，我們在存錢買新房子。

items.en: Last winter my brother was learning to ski.
items.zh: 去年冬天我哥哥在學滑雪。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + was / were + -ing + and + 主詞 + was / were + -ing：同時在進行

items.en: I was cooking and my sister was setting the table.
items.zh: 我在煮飯，我妹妹在擺餐具。

items.en: The children were swimming and their parents were reading on the beach.
items.zh: 孩子們在游泳，他們的父母在海灘上看書。

items.en: Dad was washing the car and Mum was cutting the grass.
items.zh: 爸爸在洗車，媽媽在割草。

items.en: Some people were singing and others were clapping.
items.zh: 有些人在唱歌，有些人在拍手。

items.en: The band was playing and the crowd was jumping up and down.
items.zh: 樂團在演奏，觀眾在跳上跳下。

items.en: I was studying and my roommate was listening to music.
items.zh: 我在讀書，我的室友在聽音樂。

examples.heading: ⑤ 地方 + was + 形容詞. + 主詞 + was / were + -ing：描述當時的場景

items.en: The town was very busy. People were shopping and children were playing in the square.
items.zh: 鎮上很熱鬧。人們在購物，孩子們在廣場上玩。

items.en: The kitchen was full of smoke. Something was burning in the oven.
items.zh: 廚房裡都是煙。烤箱裡有東西在燒焦。

items.en: The station was crowded. Everyone was waiting for the last train.
items.zh: 車站很擠。每個人都在等最後一班火車。

items.en: The classroom was quiet. All the students were writing their exams.
items.zh: 教室很安靜。所有的學生都在寫考卷。

items.en: The garden was beautiful. The roses were blooming and the bees were buzzing.
items.zh: 花園很美。玫瑰在開，蜜蜂在嗡嗡叫。

items.en: The restaurant was noisy. A group of friends was celebrating a birthday.
items.zh: 那家餐廳很吵。一群朋友在慶祝生日。

items.en: The street was dark. Only one light was shining in a window.
items.zh: 街上很暗。只有一扇窗戶亮著燈。

title: Every time I went to the park, I saw so many people there.
translation: 那些人非常有禮貌。
name: 過去簡單式表示日常事件和狀態
sentences: There was a big park near my school in London. Every time I went there, I saw so many people.
My aunt loved baking. Every time we visited her, she made a chocolate cake.
I tried to talk to my boss last week. Every time I called him, he was busy.
Our first flat was very old. Every time it rained, the kitchen roof leaked.
We walked to school with Grandpa. Every time we passed the bakery, he bought us a bun.
Our old dog hated visitors. Every time the bell rang, he barked.
I stayed with a family in a small town. The people were very polite and kind.
The guest house by the harbour was small but very comfortable.
We ate at a new restaurant last night. The food was delicious, but the portions were small.
Our holiday in Greece was perfect. The weather was warm and sunny all week.
We couldn't talk in class. The teachers at my old school were very strict.
My grandmother grew up in an old town. The streets were narrow and full of little shops.
I visited the old castle three times. I liked it very much.
We fed the animals every morning. I loved the summer holidays at my grandparents' farm.
Mr Green always made us laugh. We liked our teacher very much.
My mum lived in the north of Sweden. She hated the long winters in that town.
My brother loved football when he was young.
There were many cafés in Paris. I liked the little one on the corner best.
When I lived in Madrid, I walked to work every day.
Our old house had a big garden. We had lunch there every Sunday.
Our house was always quiet at breakfast. My dad read the newspaper every morning.
There weren't many cars in our village then. The children played in the street every evening.
My grandmother was very healthy. She swam in the sea every morning before breakfast.
During my year abroad, I wrote a postcard to my little brother every week.
We didn't need a car. There was a small shop at the end of our street.
They built flats there in 2010. There were lots of trees in the old park.
The whole family cooked together. There was a big kitchen in my grandmother's house.
My school in the mountains was tiny. There were only ten students in my class.
We went ice skating in winter. There was a lake behind the school.
Our town was by the sea. There were always lots of tourists in the summer.
We read a lot of books. There was no television in our house when I was small.

examples.heading: ① Every time + 主詞 + 過去式, + 主詞 + 過去式：以前常發生的事

items.en: There was a big park near my school in London. Every time I went there, I saw so many people.
items.zh: 我在倫敦的學校附近有一座很大的公園。每次我去那裡，都看到很多人。

items.en: My aunt loved baking. Every time we visited her, she made a chocolate cake.
items.zh: 我阿姨很愛烘焙。每次我們去看她，她都做一個巧克力蛋糕。

items.en: I tried to talk to my boss last week. Every time I called him, he was busy.
items.zh: 我上禮拜想找老闆談談。每次我打給他，他都很忙。

items.en: Our first flat was very old. Every time it rained, the kitchen roof leaked.
items.zh: 我們的第一間公寓很舊。每次下雨，廚房的屋頂都會漏水。

items.en: We walked to school with Grandpa. Every time we passed the bakery, he bought us a bun.
items.zh: 我們跟爺爺走路上學。每次我們經過那家麵包店，他都會買一個小麵包給我們。

items.en: Our old dog hated visitors. Every time the bell rang, he barked.
items.zh: 我們家的老狗很討厭客人。每次鈴響，牠都會叫。

examples.heading: ② The + 名詞 + was / were + 形容詞：以前的人和地方

items.en: I stayed with a family in a small town. The people were very polite and kind.
items.zh: 我住在一個小鎮的一戶人家。那裡的人很有禮貌，也很親切。

items.en: The guest house by the harbour was small but very comfortable.
items.zh: 港口邊的那家民宿很小，可是很舒服。

items.en: We ate at a new restaurant last night. The food was delicious, but the portions were small.
items.zh: 我們昨晚去一家新餐廳吃飯。食物很好吃，可是份量很少。

items.en: Our holiday in Greece was perfect. The weather was warm and sunny all week.
items.zh: 我們在希臘的假期很完美。整個星期天氣都很溫暖晴朗。

items.en: We couldn't talk in class. The teachers at my old school were very strict.
items.zh: 我們上課不能講話。我以前學校的老師都很嚴格。

items.en: My grandmother grew up in an old town. The streets were narrow and full of little shops.
items.zh: 我奶奶在一個古老的小鎮長大。街道很窄，到處都是小商店。

examples.heading: ③ I liked / loved + 名詞 + very much：以前的感覺

items.en: I visited the old castle three times. I liked it very much.
items.zh: 我去了那座古堡三次。我很喜歡那裡。

items.en: We fed the animals every morning. I loved the summer holidays at my grandparents' farm.
items.zh: 我們每天早上餵動物。我很喜歡在祖父母農場過的暑假。

items.en: Mr Green always made us laugh. We liked our teacher very much.
items.zh: 格林老師總是逗我們笑。我們很喜歡我們的老師。

items.en: My mum lived in the north of Sweden. She hated the long winters in that town.
items.zh: 我媽媽以前住在瑞典北部。她很討厭那個鎮漫長的冬天。

items.en: My brother loved football when he was young.
items.zh: 我哥哥小時候很喜歡足球。

items.en: There were many cafés in Paris. I liked the little one on the corner best.
items.zh: 巴黎有很多咖啡館。我最喜歡轉角那家小的。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + 過去式 + every + 時間：以前的習慣

items.en: When I lived in Madrid, I walked to work every day.
items.zh: 我住在馬德里的時候，每天走路上班。

items.en: Our old house had a big garden. We had lunch there every Sunday.
items.zh: 我們的老房子有一個大花園。我們每個星期天都在那裡吃午餐。

items.en: Our house was always quiet at breakfast. My dad read the newspaper every morning.
items.zh: 我們家吃早餐的時候總是很安靜。我爸爸每天早上都看報紙。

items.en: There weren't many cars in our village then. The children played in the street every evening.
items.zh: 那時候我們村子裡車子不多。孩子們每天傍晚都在街上玩。

items.en: My grandmother was very healthy. She swam in the sea every morning before breakfast.
items.zh: 我奶奶很健康。她每天早上早餐前都去海裡游泳。

items.en: During my year abroad, I wrote a postcard to my little brother every week.
items.zh: 我在國外的那一年，每個星期都寫一張明信片給我弟弟。

examples.heading: ⑤ There was / were + 名詞：以前那裡有什麼

items.en: We didn't need a car. There was a small shop at the end of our street.
items.zh: 我們不需要車子。我們那條街的盡頭有一家小店。

items.en: They built flats there in 2010. There were lots of trees in the old park.
items.zh: 他們二〇一〇年在那裡蓋了公寓。舊公園裡有很多樹。

items.en: The whole family cooked together. There was a big kitchen in my grandmother's house.
items.zh: 全家人一起煮飯。我奶奶家有一個很大的廚房。

items.en: My school in the mountains was tiny. There were only ten students in my class.
items.zh: 我在山上念的學校很小。我們班只有十個學生。

items.en: We went ice skating in winter. There was a lake behind the school.
items.zh: 我們冬天去溜冰。學校後面有一個湖。

items.en: Our town was by the sea. There were always lots of tourists in the summer.
items.zh: 我們的小鎮在海邊。夏天總是有很多觀光客。

items.en: We read a lot of books. There was no television in our house when I was small.
items.zh: 我們看很多書。我小時候家裡沒有電視。

title: I've seen the British Museum.
translation: 我去看過大英博物館。
name: 現在完成式表示經驗
sentences: Rome is a great city for art. We've visited several museums there.
You can ask me about hiking in Japan. I've climbed Mount Fuji.
My sister knows a lot about first aid. She has worked in a hospital.
My grandparents love Norway. They've seen the Northern Lights.
I'm not scared of heights. I've done a bungee jump.
My uncle was a famous chef. He's met the president.
I'm so excited about tonight. I've never been to a concert.
My grandma is nervous about the trip. She's never flown in a plane.
We're taking them to the beach. My parents have never seen the sea.
We take the bus everywhere. We've never owned a car.
Don't ask my husband to make dinner. He's never cooked a meal in his life.
I'm planning a trip to Delhi. Have you ever been to India?
My sister wants to study in Canada. Has your brother ever lived abroad?
You're a really good singer. Have you ever won a competition?
My parents are thinking about a cruise. Have your parents ever travelled by ship?
We need a fourth player for Saturday. Has your wife ever played golf?
I love the shows on Broadway. I've been to New York twice.
My daughter loves Matilda. She's read that book three times.
My dad was in the army. We've moved house four times.
I don't know your new boyfriend well. I've only met him once.
My brother is very nervous about tomorrow. He's failed his driving test twice.
My aunt can tell you about the pyramids. She has been to Egypt.
My uncle won't be at the party. He has gone to Brazil for work.
Everyone is talking about the new shopping center. Have you been there?
Where's Sam? — He's gone to the gym. He'll be back at six.
I've eaten frogs' legs. I tried them in France.
My sister is careful on her bike. She's broken her arm before. It happened when she was ten.
Let's book the Sea View Hotel. We've stayed there before, and we loved it.
Have you ever ridden a camel? — Yes, I rode one in Morocco.
I've met a famous actor. I met him at the airport last year.

examples.heading: ① 肯定句：做過的事

items.en: Rome is a great city for art. We've visited several museums there.
items.zh: 羅馬是看藝術的好地方。我們參觀過那裡的幾間博物館。

items.en: You can ask me about hiking in Japan. I've climbed Mount Fuji.
items.zh: 日本健行的事你可以問我。我爬過富士山。

items.en: My sister knows a lot about first aid. She has worked in a hospital.
items.zh: 我姊姊很懂急救。她在醫院工作過。

items.en: My grandparents love Norway. They've seen the Northern Lights.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶很愛挪威。他們看過北極光。

items.en: I'm not scared of heights. I've done a bungee jump.
items.zh: 我不怕高。我玩過高空彈跳。

items.en: My uncle was a famous chef. He's met the president.
items.zh: 我叔叔以前是有名的廚師。他見過總統。

examples.heading: ② never：從來沒有

items.en: I'm so excited about tonight. I've never been to a concert.
items.zh: 我好期待今晚。我從來沒去聽過演唱會。

items.en: My grandma is nervous about the trip. She's never flown in a plane.
items.zh: 我奶奶對這趟旅行很緊張。她從來沒坐過飛機。

items.en: We're taking them to the beach. My parents have never seen the sea.
items.zh: 我們要帶他們去海邊。我爸媽從來沒看過海。

items.en: We take the bus everywhere. We've never owned a car.
items.zh: 我們去哪裡都搭公車。我們從來沒有過車。

items.en: Don't ask my husband to make dinner. He's never cooked a meal in his life.
items.zh: 別叫我先生煮晚餐。他這輩子從來沒煮過一頓飯。

examples.heading: ③ 問句：Have you ever ...?

items.en: I'm planning a trip to Delhi. Have you ever been to India?
items.zh: 我在計畫去德里玩。你去過印度嗎？

items.en: My sister wants to study in Canada. Has your brother ever lived abroad?
items.zh: 我姊姊想去加拿大念書。你哥在國外住過嗎？

items.en: You're a really good singer. Have you ever won a competition?
items.zh: 你唱歌真好聽。你在比賽得過獎嗎？

items.en: My parents are thinking about a cruise. Have your parents ever travelled by ship?
items.zh: 我爸媽在考慮坐郵輪。你爸媽搭過船旅行嗎？

items.en: We need a fourth player for Saturday. Has your wife ever played golf?
items.zh: 我們星期六還缺一個人。你太太打過高爾夫球嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 次數：once / twice / three times

items.en: I love the shows on Broadway. I've been to New York twice.
items.zh: 我很愛百老匯的表演。我去過紐約兩次。

items.en: My daughter loves Matilda. She's read that book three times.
items.zh: 我女兒很愛《瑪蒂達》。那本書她看過三次。

items.en: My dad was in the army. We've moved house four times.
items.zh: 我爸爸以前是軍人。我們搬過四次家。

items.en: I don't know your new boyfriend well. I've only met him once.
items.zh: 我跟你的新男朋友不熟。我只見過他一次。

items.en: My brother is very nervous about tomorrow. He's failed his driving test twice.
items.zh: 我哥哥很擔心明天。他考駕照沒過兩次。

examples.heading: ⑤ been to 和 gone to

items.en: My aunt can tell you about the pyramids. She has been to Egypt.
items.zh: 我阿姨可以跟你說金字塔的事。她去過埃及。

items.en: My uncle won't be at the party. He has gone to Brazil for work.
items.zh: 我叔叔不會來派對。他去巴西出差了。

items.en: Everyone is talking about the new shopping center. Have you been there?
items.zh: 大家都在聊那家新的購物中心。你去過了嗎？

items.en: Where's Sam? — He's gone to the gym. He'll be back at six.
items.zh: 山姆呢？他去健身房了。他六點會回來。

examples.heading: ⑥ 先說經驗，再用過去簡單式說細節

items.en: I've eaten frogs' legs. I tried them in France.
items.zh: 我吃過田雞腿，在法國吃的。

items.en: My sister is careful on her bike. She's broken her arm before. It happened when she was ten.
items.zh: 我妹妹騎腳踏車很小心。她以前手臂骨折過，是十歲的時候。

items.en: Let's book the Sea View Hotel. We've stayed there before, and we loved it.
items.zh: 我們訂海景飯店吧。我們住過那裡，很喜歡。

items.en: Have you ever ridden a camel? — Yes, I rode one in Morocco.
items.zh: 你騎過駱駝嗎？騎過，在摩洛哥騎的。

items.en: I've met a famous actor. I met him at the airport last year.
items.zh: 我見過一位有名的演員。我去年在機場遇到他。

title: It is true that it did rain during the day, but it was not a sudden downpour.
translation: 白天確實下過雨，但並不是突然下的大雨。
name: did 加強語氣的過去簡單式
sentences: I did lock the door. I remember turning the key.
Dad, it's Sunday. You did promise to take me to the zoo!
I did send the email. Check your spam folder.
The waiter says we didn't pay. She did pay the bill. I saw her do it.
Your car is in the ditch. I did warn you about the ice on the road.
We did book a table for four. It's under the name Wilson.
The match wasn't cancelled. The wind did blow hard, but the players could still play.
The train did arrive late, but only by five minutes.
Mum, I did eat some of the cake, but I didn't finish it.
The report is too negative. Prices did rise last year, but not as much as people expected.
Don't be too hard on Ben. He did make a few mistakes, but overall it was a good speech.
Dear Editor, we did reach the target figure, and we have sent most of the money to the hospital.
Dear Sir, there were plenty of things to do. We did have a stall with drinks and snacks.
Dear Mrs Hill, our staff did contact you on the day of the delivery.
Dear Mr Ross, we did inform all guests about the change of time.
Dear Sir, the company did offer a full refund, which you refused.
Everyone said the new plan would fail, but it did work in the end.
I didn't think Uncle Joe would come to the party, but he did turn up at the end.
We nearly missed the flight, but we did make it.
My sister was nervous about the exam, but she did pass.
It took ages, but the parcel did arrive eventually.
I did enjoy the party last night. Thank you for inviting me.
Thank you for everything, Sam. We did appreciate your help with the move.
I did like your presentation. It was very clear.
Thank you for coming to the school. The children did love the puppet show.
Welcome home! I did miss you while you were away.
Please don't be angry about my grade. I really did try my best.
My little brother entered the chess contest. He actually did win the competition!
My grandparents had very little money. They really did build the whole house themselves.
I actually did see a fox in the garden this morning.
She really did say that. I was there.

examples.heading: ① 回應懷疑或否認

items.en: I did lock the door. I remember turning the key.
items.zh: 我真的有鎖門，我記得有轉鑰匙。

items.en: Dad, it's Sunday. You did promise to take me to the zoo!
items.zh: 爸，今天是星期天。你明明答應過要帶我去動物園！

items.en: I did send the email. Check your spam folder.
items.zh: 我真的有寄那封電子郵件，你看一下垃圾郵件匣。

items.en: The waiter says we didn't pay. She did pay the bill. I saw her do it.
items.zh: 服務生說我們沒付錢。她真的有付帳，我看到她付了。

items.en: Your car is in the ditch. I did warn you about the ice on the road.
items.zh: 你的車掉進溝裡了。我有提醒過你路上結冰了。

items.en: We did book a table for four. It's under the name Wilson.
items.zh: 我們真的有訂四人桌，用威爾森的名字訂的。

examples.heading: ② 承認一部分事實，再用 but 說出不同的地方

items.en: The match wasn't cancelled. The wind did blow hard, but the players could still play.
items.zh: 比賽沒有取消。風確實吹得很大，不過球員還是可以比賽。

items.en: The train did arrive late, but only by five minutes.
items.zh: 火車確實晚到了，不過只晚了五分鐘。

items.en: Mum, I did eat some of the cake, but I didn't finish it.
items.zh: 媽，那個蛋糕我確實吃了一些，可是我沒有吃完。

items.en: The report is too negative. Prices did rise last year, but not as much as people expected.
items.zh: 這份報告太悲觀了。去年物價確實漲了，但沒有大家預期的那麼多。

items.en: Don't be too hard on Ben. He did make a few mistakes, but overall it was a good speech.
items.zh: 別對班太嚴格。他確實犯了幾個錯，不過整體來說是一場好的演講。

examples.heading: ③ 正式書信：說明事實

items.en: Dear Editor, we did reach the target figure, and we have sent most of the money to the hospital.
items.zh: 編輯您好，我們確實達到了目標金額，大部分的錢已經捐給醫院了。

items.en: Dear Sir, there were plenty of things to do. We did have a stall with drinks and snacks.
items.zh: 敬啟者，活動有很多東西可以玩。我們確實有一個賣飲料點心的攤位。

items.en: Dear Mrs Hill, our staff did contact you on the day of the delivery.
items.zh: 希爾太太您好，我們的員工在送貨當天確實有聯絡您。

items.en: Dear Mr Ross, we did inform all guests about the change of time.
items.zh: 羅斯先生您好，我們確實通知了所有賓客時間改了。

items.en: Dear Sir, the company did offer a full refund, which you refused.
items.zh: 敬啟者，公司確實提出全額退款，是您拒絕的。

examples.heading: ④ 跟預期對比：最後真的發生了

items.en: Everyone said the new plan would fail, but it did work in the end.
items.zh: 大家都說新計畫會失敗，結果最後真的成功了。

items.en: I didn't think Uncle Joe would come to the party, but he did turn up at the end.
items.zh: 我以為喬叔叔不會來派對，結果他最後真的出現了。

items.en: We nearly missed the flight, but we did make it.
items.zh: 我們差點趕不上飛機，不過還是趕上了。

items.en: My sister was nervous about the exam, but she did pass.
items.zh: 我妹妹很擔心那場考試，不過她真的考過了。

items.en: It took ages, but the parcel did arrive eventually.
items.zh: 等了好久，包裹最後還是到了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 加強感謝或感受

items.en: I did enjoy the party last night. Thank you for inviting me.
items.zh: 我昨晚在派對上玩得很開心，謝謝你邀請我。

items.en: Thank you for everything, Sam. We did appreciate your help with the move.
items.zh: 山姆，謝謝你做的一切。你幫我們搬家，我們真的很感激。

items.en: I did like your presentation. It was very clear.
items.zh: 我真的很喜歡你的報告，講得很清楚。

items.en: Thank you for coming to the school. The children did love the puppet show.
items.zh: 謝謝你們來學校。孩子們真的很喜歡那場木偶戲。

items.en: Welcome home! I did miss you while you were away.
items.zh: 歡迎回家！你不在的時候我真的很想你。

examples.heading: ⑥ 加上 really 或 actually

items.en: Please don't be angry about my grade. I really did try my best.
items.zh: 請別因為我的成績生氣。我真的盡力了。

items.en: My little brother entered the chess contest. He actually did win the competition!
items.zh: 我弟弟參加了西洋棋比賽。他真的贏了比賽！

items.en: My grandparents had very little money. They really did build the whole house themselves.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶以前沒什麼錢。那整棟房子真的是他們自己蓋的。

items.en: I actually did see a fox in the garden this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上真的在花園裡看到一隻狐狸。

items.en: She really did say that. I was there.
items.zh: 她真的那樣說了，我當時在場。

title: We always talked during class.
translation: 我們以前上課總是在聊天。
name: 過去簡單式表示過去的習慣或狀態
sentences: My grandfather always seemed so calm.
We usually walked to school together.
She often read in bed until midnight.
My mother always made pancakes on Sundays.
I sometimes helped my uncle in his shop.
My parents never argued in front of us.
We rarely ate out when I was young.
He never did his homework on time.
We spent August at my aunt's farm every year.
I phoned my grandmother every Sunday evening.
The ice-cream van came round every Friday afternoon.
Every morning, she swam in the lake before breakfast.
My grandparents lived in a small village near the coast.
When I was a child, I was very shy.
We had a dog called Rufus.
Everybody knew everybody in our street.
The house was always full of people.
When I was at school, I played football every afternoon.
While we lived in Rome, we ate pizza every Friday.
In those days, people wrote letters instead of emails.
As a student, I worked in a café at weekends.
We didn't have a television until I was ten.
My dad didn't drive, so we went everywhere by bus.
The teachers didn't allow phones in class.
Did you walk to school when you were little?
Where did you usually go on holiday?
What did you do at weekends when you were a student?
Our teacher was very strict, and she rarely smiled.
My best friend lived next door, and we spent every afternoon together.
In winter, it always got dark at four o'clock.

examples.heading: ① always / usually / often / sometimes + 過去簡單式

items.en: My grandfather always seemed so calm.
items.zh: 我爺爺看起來總是很冷靜。

items.en: We usually walked to school together.
items.zh: 我們通常一起走路上學。

items.en: She often read in bed until midnight.
items.zh: 她常常在床上看書看到半夜。

items.en: My mother always made pancakes on Sundays.
items.zh: 我媽每個星期天都會做鬆餅。

items.en: I sometimes helped my uncle in his shop.
items.zh: 我有時候會去叔叔的店裡幫忙。

examples.heading: ② rarely / never + 過去簡單式

items.en: My parents never argued in front of us.
items.zh: 我爸媽從來不在我們面前吵架。

items.en: We rarely ate out when I was young.
items.zh: 我小時候我們很少在外面吃飯。

items.en: He never did his homework on time.
items.zh: 他從來沒有準時寫完功課。

examples.heading: ③ 過去簡單式 + every + 時間

items.en: We spent August at my aunt's farm every year.
items.zh: 我們以前每年八月都在阿姨的農場過。

items.en: I phoned my grandmother every Sunday evening.
items.zh: 我以前每個星期天晚上都打給奶奶。

items.en: The ice-cream van came round every Friday afternoon.
items.zh: 冰淇淋車以前每個星期五下午都會來。

items.en: Every morning, she swam in the lake before breakfast.
items.zh: 她以前每天早上吃早餐前都會去湖裡游泳。

examples.heading: ④ 過去的狀態

items.en: My grandparents lived in a small village near the coast.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶以前住在海邊附近的一個小村子。

items.en: When I was a child, I was very shy.
items.zh: 我小時候很害羞。

items.en: We had a dog called Rufus.
items.zh: 我們以前養過一隻叫 Rufus 的狗。

items.en: Everybody knew everybody in our street.
items.zh: 我們那條街上大家都互相認識。

items.en: The house was always full of people.
items.zh: 那間房子裡總是擠滿了人。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說出那段時期

items.en: When I was at school, I played football every afternoon.
items.zh: 我讀書的時候每天下午都踢足球。

items.en: While we lived in Rome, we ate pizza every Friday.
items.zh: 我們住在羅馬的時候，每個星期五都吃披薩。

items.en: In those days, people wrote letters instead of emails.
items.zh: 那時候，大家寫信，不寫電子郵件。

items.en: As a student, I worked in a café at weekends.
items.zh: 我當學生的時候，週末在咖啡店打工。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定

items.en: We didn't have a television until I was ten.
items.zh: 我十歲以前家裡沒有電視。

items.en: My dad didn't drive, so we went everywhere by bus.
items.zh: 我爸不開車，所以我們去哪裡都搭公車。

items.en: The teachers didn't allow phones in class.
items.zh: 以前老師不准上課用手機。

examples.heading: ⑦ 問句

items.en: Did you walk to school when you were little?
items.zh: 你小時候走路上學嗎？

items.en: Where did you usually go on holiday?
items.zh: 你們以前通常去哪裡度假？

items.en: What did you do at weekends when you were a student?
items.zh: 你當學生的時候週末都做什麼？

examples.heading: ⑧ 回憶以前的生活

items.en: Our teacher was very strict, and she rarely smiled.
items.zh: 我們的老師很嚴格，很少笑。

items.en: My best friend lived next door, and we spent every afternoon together.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友住在隔壁，我們每天下午都在一起。

items.en: In winter, it always got dark at four o'clock.
items.zh: 冬天總是四點天就黑了。

title: It would be better if you spent some time in the fresh air with your friends.
translation: 你要是能花點時間跟朋友到戶外呼吸新鮮空氣，會比較好。
name: if 子句用過去簡單式表示假設
sentences: If I spoke Japanese, I would move to Tokyo.
If we lived in the city, we wouldn't need a car.
If she knew the truth, she would be furious.
If you asked him nicely, he would probably help.
I would buy a bigger flat if I could afford it.
It would be easier if we took the train.
You'd feel much better if you got more sleep.
They'd be happier if they spent less time on their phones.
If the flat were more spacious, we would stay.
If it was warmer, we'd eat outside.
If my brother were taller, he'd play basketball.
If I were you, I'd apologise to her.
I wouldn't sign the contract if I were you.
If I were you, I'd see a doctor about that cough.
If you wanted to, we could go fishing on Sunday.
If we left now, we might catch the earlier train.
If he practised more, he might win next time.
If you lent me your bike, I could get there faster.
What would you do if you won the lottery?
Where would you live if you could choose?
Would you go if they offered you the job?
How would you feel if your best friend lied to you?
It would be better if you went to bed earlier.
It would be cheaper if we booked the tickets online.
It would be quicker if we split the work.
If I didn't have to work tomorrow, I'd come to the party.
If I didn't live so far away, I'd visit you every week.
If she weren't so busy, she'd join the choir.
We wouldn't be late so often if the buses weren't so unreliable.
If people didn't drive so fast, there would be fewer accidents.

examples.heading: ① If + 過去簡單式, 主詞 + would

items.en: If I spoke Japanese, I would move to Tokyo.
items.zh: 如果我會說日文，我就會搬去東京。

items.en: If we lived in the city, we wouldn't need a car.
items.zh: 如果我們住在城裡，就不需要車了。

items.en: If she knew the truth, she would be furious.
items.zh: 她要是知道真相，一定會氣炸。

items.en: If you asked him nicely, he would probably help.
items.zh: 你要是好好拜託他，他大概會幫忙。

examples.heading: ② 主句在前面

items.en: I would buy a bigger flat if I could afford it.
items.zh: 我要是買得起，就會買大一點的公寓。

items.en: It would be easier if we took the train.
items.zh: 我們要是搭火車會比較輕鬆。

items.en: You'd feel much better if you got more sleep.
items.zh: 你要是多睡一點，會覺得好很多。

items.en: They'd be happier if they spent less time on their phones.
items.zh: 他們少花點時間在手機上會比較快樂。

examples.heading: ③ if 子句用 were / was

items.en: If the flat were more spacious, we would stay.
items.zh: 公寓要是寬敞一點，我們就會繼續住。

items.en: If it was warmer, we'd eat outside.
items.zh: 天氣要是暖一點，我們就會在外面吃。

items.en: If my brother were taller, he'd play basketball.
items.zh: 我弟要是高一點，就會去打籃球。

examples.heading: ④ If I were you

items.en: If I were you, I'd apologise to her.
items.zh: 我要是你，就會跟她道歉。

items.en: I wouldn't sign the contract if I were you.
items.zh: 換作是我，我不會簽那份合約。

items.en: If I were you, I'd see a doctor about that cough.
items.zh: 我要是你，就會去看醫生，看看那個咳嗽。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主句用 could / might

items.en: If you wanted to, we could go fishing on Sunday.
items.zh: 你要是想去，我們星期天可以去釣魚。

items.en: If we left now, we might catch the earlier train.
items.zh: 我們要是現在出發，也許趕得上早一班火車。

items.en: If he practised more, he might win next time.
items.zh: 他要是多練習，下次也許會贏。

items.en: If you lent me your bike, I could get there faster.
items.zh: 你要是借我腳踏車，我就可以快一點到。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問句

items.en: What would you do if you won the lottery?
items.zh: 你要是中了樂透，會做什麼？

items.en: Where would you live if you could choose?
items.zh: 如果能選，你會住在哪裡？

items.en: Would you go if they offered you the job?
items.zh: 他們要是給你那份工作，你會去嗎？

items.en: How would you feel if your best friend lied to you?
items.zh: 你最好的朋友要是騙你，你會有什麼感覺？

examples.heading: ⑦ It would be better / cheaper if

items.en: It would be better if you went to bed earlier.
items.zh: 你要是早點睡會比較好。

items.en: It would be cheaper if we booked the tickets online.
items.zh: 我們要是在網路上訂票會比較便宜。

items.en: It would be quicker if we split the work.
items.zh: 我們要是分工會比較快。

examples.heading: ⑧ if 子句用否定

items.en: If I didn't have to work tomorrow, I'd come to the party.
items.zh: 我明天要是不用上班，就會來派對。

items.en: If I didn't live so far away, I'd visit you every week.
items.zh: 我要是沒住那麼遠，就會每個禮拜去看你。

items.en: If she weren't so busy, she'd join the choir.
items.zh: 她要是沒那麼忙，就會參加合唱團。

items.en: We wouldn't be late so often if the buses weren't so unreliable.
items.zh: 公車要是沒那麼不準時，我們就不會這麼常遲到了。

items.en: If people didn't drive so fast, there would be fewer accidents.
items.zh: 大家要是開車不那麼快，車禍就會少一點。

title: A new shopping center has opened in our town.
translation: 我們鎮上新開了一家購物中心。
name: 現在完成式報導新消息
sentences: A new Italian restaurant has opened near the station.
The old cinema on Bridge Street has closed.
They've opened a second swimming pool at the sports center.
Our local post office has shut down.
A bookshop has opened where the bank used to be.
The government has announced a new tax on sugar.
The city council has decided to build a new bus station.
The two countries have agreed to end the war.
The school has changed its uniform.
The airline has cancelled all flights to Paris.
Our national team has won the World Cup.
The president has lost the election.
A local girl has won a prize for her poems.
The company has lost its biggest customer.
Our town has lost its only hospital.
A famous painting has disappeared from the museum.
The first snow has arrived in the mountains.
The coach has left the club after ten years.
Thousands of birds have returned to the lake.
A strange light has appeared in the night sky.
The prime minister has just arrived in London.
We've just heard some great news.
My cousin has just had twins.
The results have just come out.
The storm has just hit the coast.
There has been an accident on the motorway. It happened at six this morning.
Bread prices have gone up again. They rose by ten cents on Monday.
Ben has broken his arm. He fell off his bike on Monday.
The police have caught the thief. They found him at the airport.
Our neighbors have sold their house. They moved to Spain in June.

examples.heading: ① 開幕或關閉

items.en: A new Italian restaurant has opened near the station.
items.zh: 車站附近新開了一家義大利餐廳。

items.en: The old cinema on Bridge Street has closed.
items.zh: 橋街上那家老電影院關門了。

items.en: They've opened a second swimming pool at the sports center.
items.zh: 運動中心開了第二座游泳池。

items.en: Our local post office has shut down.
items.zh: 我們這裡的郵局關掉了。

items.en: A bookshop has opened where the bank used to be.
items.zh: 以前銀行的位置開了一家書店。

examples.heading: ② 宣布或決定

items.en: The government has announced a new tax on sugar.
items.zh: 政府宣布要對糖課新稅。

items.en: The city council has decided to build a new bus station.
items.zh: 市議會決定要蓋一座新的公車總站。

items.en: The two countries have agreed to end the war.
items.zh: 兩國同意結束戰爭。

items.en: The school has changed its uniform.
items.zh: 學校換了制服。

items.en: The airline has cancelled all flights to Paris.
items.zh: 航空公司取消了所有飛往巴黎的班機。

examples.heading: ③ 贏得或失去

items.en: Our national team has won the World Cup.
items.zh: 我們國家隊贏得了世界盃。

items.en: The president has lost the election.
items.zh: 總統輸掉了選舉。

items.en: A local girl has won a prize for her poems.
items.zh: 一個本地的女孩憑她的詩得了獎。

items.en: The company has lost its biggest customer.
items.zh: 這家公司失去了最大的客戶。

items.en: Our town has lost its only hospital.
items.zh: 我們鎮上唯一的醫院沒了。

examples.heading: ④ 出現或消失

items.en: A famous painting has disappeared from the museum.
items.zh: 一幅名畫從博物館裡不見了。

items.en: The first snow has arrived in the mountains.
items.zh: 山上下了第一場雪。

items.en: The coach has left the club after ten years.
items.zh: 教練在待了十年後離開了球隊。

items.en: Thousands of birds have returned to the lake.
items.zh: 上千隻鳥飛回湖邊了。

items.en: A strange light has appeared in the night sky.
items.zh: 夜空中出現了一道奇怪的光。

examples.heading: ⑤ just：剛發生的事

items.en: The prime minister has just arrived in London.
items.zh: 首相剛抵達倫敦。

items.en: We've just heard some great news.
items.zh: 我們剛聽到一個好消息。

items.en: My cousin has just had twins.
items.zh: 我表姊剛生了雙胞胎。

items.en: The results have just come out.
items.zh: 結果剛出來。

items.en: The storm has just hit the coast.
items.zh: 暴風雨剛襲擊海岸。

examples.heading: ⑥ 現在完成式開頭，過去簡單式說細節

items.en: There has been an accident on the motorway. It happened at six this morning.
items.zh: 高速公路上出了車禍。事情發生在今天早上六點。

items.en: Bread prices have gone up again. They rose by ten cents on Monday.
items.zh: 麵包又漲價了。星期一漲了十分錢。

items.en: Ben has broken his arm. He fell off his bike on Monday.
items.zh: Ben 的手臂斷了。他星期一騎腳踏車摔下來。

items.en: The police have caught the thief. They found him at the airport.
items.zh: 警察抓到小偷了。他們在機場找到他。

items.en: Our neighbors have sold their house. They moved to Spain in June.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居把房子賣了。他們六月搬去西班牙了。

title: We waited for the suitcase for two days, and then we bought new clothes.
translation: 我們等行李箱等了兩天，後來就去買了新衣服。
name: 過去簡單式依序敘述事件
sentences: I got up, had a quick shower and caught the bus.
She finished school, moved to London and found a job in a bank.
We met at nine and drove to the lake.
He opened the letter, read it and put it back in the envelope.
They bought an old farmhouse, repaired the roof and moved in that summer.
We waited for an hour, and then we gave up and went home.
I tried calling her, and then I sent her a message.
She paid the bill and then left without a word.
The lights went out. Then we heard a loud bang.
First, we checked into the hotel. After that, we went for a walk along the river.
First we visited the castle, then we had lunch in the old town.
We packed the car. Next, we locked up the house.
Next, she showed us the kitchen.
After that, nobody mentioned the subject again.
Three days later, my test results came back.
A week later, she called to apologise.
We went to a concert and had dinner afterwards.
Afterwards, we walked back to the hotel.
Finally, after three hours, the plane took off.
We finally reached the top just before sunset.
We argued about the name for weeks. In the end, we called the dog Max.
In the end, the company acquiesced and gave us a refund.
When the band came on stage, everyone stood up.
When the rain stopped, we continued our walk.
After we had dinner, we played board games.
After the guide left, we explored the ruins on our own.
I missed the last train, so I walked to my sister's flat and slept on her sofa.
She saw the advert, applied for the job and started the following week.
We got lost, asked a farmer for directions and arrived two hours late.
He fell off his bike, broke his arm and spent a week in hospital.
The next morning, we took a boat to the island.
On the last day, we went shopping and bought presents for everyone.

examples.heading: ① 依序列出過去的事

items.en: I got up, had a quick shower and caught the bus.
items.zh: 我起床，快速沖了澡，然後搭上公車。

items.en: She finished school, moved to London and found a job in a bank.
items.zh: 她畢業後搬到倫敦，在銀行找到了工作。

items.en: We met at nine and drove to the lake.
items.zh: 我們九點碰面，開車去湖邊。

items.en: He opened the letter, read it and put it back in the envelope.
items.zh: 他打開信，讀完後又放回信封。

items.en: They bought an old farmhouse, repaired the roof and moved in that summer.
items.zh: 他們買了一棟老農舍，修好屋頂，那年夏天就搬進去了。

examples.heading: ② and then / then

items.en: We waited for an hour, and then we gave up and went home.
items.zh: 我們等了一個小時，後來就放棄回家了。

items.en: I tried calling her, and then I sent her a message.
items.zh: 我試著打給她，然後傳了訊息給她。

items.en: She paid the bill and then left without a word.
items.zh: 她付了帳，然後一句話也沒說就走了。

items.en: The lights went out. Then we heard a loud bang.
items.zh: 燈熄了。接著我們聽到一聲巨響。

examples.heading: ③ first、next、after that

items.en: First, we checked into the hotel. After that, we went for a walk along the river.
items.zh: 我們先辦了入住，之後沿著河邊散步。

items.en: First we visited the castle, then we had lunch in the old town.
items.zh: 我們先參觀城堡，然後在老城區吃午餐。

items.en: We packed the car. Next, we locked up the house.
items.zh: 我們把東西裝上車，接著把房子鎖好。

items.en: Next, she showed us the kitchen.
items.zh: 接著她帶我們看廚房。

items.en: After that, nobody mentioned the subject again.
items.zh: 那之後就沒有人再提起這件事了。

examples.heading: ④ later、afterwards

items.en: Three days later, my test results came back.
items.zh: 三天後，我的檢查結果出來了。

items.en: A week later, she called to apologise.
items.zh: 一個禮拜後，她打電話來道歉。

items.en: We went to a concert and had dinner afterwards.
items.zh: 我們去聽演唱會，之後吃了晚餐。

items.en: Afterwards, we walked back to the hotel.
items.zh: 之後我們走回飯店。

examples.heading: ⑤ finally、in the end

items.en: Finally, after three hours, the plane took off.
items.zh: 等了三個小時，飛機終於起飛了。

items.en: We finally reached the top just before sunset.
items.zh: 我們終於在日落前登上了山頂。

items.en: We argued about the name for weeks. In the end, we called the dog Max.
items.zh: 我們為了名字吵了好幾個禮拜。最後我們把狗取名叫 Max。

items.en: In the end, the company acquiesced and gave us a refund.
items.zh: 最後公司讓步了，退了錢給我們。

examples.heading: ⑥ when / after 的子句

items.en: When the band came on stage, everyone stood up.
items.zh: 樂團上台的時候，大家都站了起來。

items.en: When the rain stopped, we continued our walk.
items.zh: 雨停了以後，我們繼續散步。

items.en: After we had dinner, we played board games.
items.zh: 吃完晚餐後，我們玩了桌遊。

items.en: After the guide left, we explored the ruins on our own.
items.zh: 導遊走了之後，我們自己去探索遺跡。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說一段經過

items.en: I missed the last train, so I walked to my sister's flat and slept on her sofa.
items.zh: 我錯過了末班車，就走到我姊姊的公寓，睡在她的沙發上。

items.en: She saw the advert, applied for the job and started the following week.
items.zh: 她看到廣告，應徵了那份工作，隔週就開始上班。

items.en: We got lost, asked a farmer for directions and arrived two hours late.
items.zh: 我們迷路了，跟一個農夫問路，結果晚了兩個小時才到。

items.en: He fell off his bike, broke his arm and spent a week in hospital.
items.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來，摔斷了手臂，在醫院住了一個禮拜。

items.en: The next morning, we took a boat to the island.
items.zh: 隔天早上，我們搭船去那座島。

items.en: On the last day, we went shopping and bought presents for everyone.
items.zh: 最後一天，我們去逛街，幫每個人買了禮物。

title: I was wondering if I could stay with you again on my next visit.
translation: 不知道我下次來訪時，能不能再麻煩您一次。
name: 過去進行式表示委婉的請求
sentences: Thank you for having me last month. I was wondering if I could stay with you again on my next visit.
I was wondering if I could use your sewing machine to fix my curtains.
I was wondering if I could leave work an hour early on Friday.
I was wondering if I could ask you a few questions about the job.
I was wondering if I could bring a friend to the party.
I was wondering if I could pay the rest of the money next month.
I was wondering if you could help me with my English homework.
I was wondering if you could give me a lift to the station.
I was wondering if you could send me the photos from the wedding.
I was wondering if you could look after my dog next week.
I was wondering if you could recommend a good dentist.
I was wondering if you could check my CV before I send it.
For the fancy-dress party, I was thinking that you could wear your Marilyn Monroe dress.
I was thinking that you could come to my house and watch the film.
I was thinking you could bring your guitar to the barbecue.
I was thinking that you could ask your teacher for more time.
I was thinking you could stay for dinner if you're free.
I was thinking that you could paint the bedroom green.
I was thinking we could go to the beach on Saturday.
I was thinking that we could have a picnic in the park.
I was thinking we could try that new Thai restaurant.
I was thinking that we could share a taxi to the airport.
I was thinking we could visit Grandma on Sunday.
I was thinking that we could study together for the exam.
I was hoping you could help me move house on Saturday.
I was hoping that you would come to my birthday party.
I was hoping I could talk to you about my grades.
I was hoping you could lend me some money until Friday.
I was hoping we could meet for coffee next week.
I was hoping that you would say yes.
I was hoping you could explain this letter to me.

examples.heading: ① I was wondering if I could + 原形動詞：客氣地請求許可

items.en: Thank you for having me last month. I was wondering if I could stay with you again on my next visit.
items.zh: 謝謝您上個月讓我住。我在想，下次去的時候能不能再打擾您。

items.en: I was wondering if I could use your sewing machine to fix my curtains.
items.zh: 我在想能不能借用你的縫紉機修我的窗簾。

items.en: I was wondering if I could leave work an hour early on Friday.
items.zh: 我在想星期五能不能提早一個小時下班。

items.en: I was wondering if I could ask you a few questions about the job.
items.zh: 我在想能不能問您幾個關於這份工作的問題。

items.en: I was wondering if I could bring a friend to the party.
items.zh: 我在想能不能帶一個朋友去派對。

items.en: I was wondering if I could pay the rest of the money next month.
items.zh: 我在想剩下的錢能不能下個月再付。

examples.heading: ② I was wondering if you could + 原形動詞：客氣地請對方做

items.en: I was wondering if you could help me with my English homework.
items.zh: 不知道你能不能幫我寫英文功課。

items.en: I was wondering if you could give me a lift to the station.
items.zh: 不知道你能不能載我去車站。

items.en: I was wondering if you could send me the photos from the wedding.
items.zh: 不知道你能不能把婚禮的照片寄給我。

items.en: I was wondering if you could look after my dog next week.
items.zh: 不知道你下星期能不能幫我照顧狗。

items.en: I was wondering if you could recommend a good dentist.
items.zh: 不知道您能不能推薦一位好牙醫。

items.en: I was wondering if you could check my CV before I send it.
items.zh: 不知道你能不能在我寄出之前幫我看一下履歷。

examples.heading: ③ I was thinking (that) you could + 原形動詞：客氣的建議

items.en: For the fancy-dress party, I was thinking that you could wear your Marilyn Monroe dress.
items.zh: 化裝舞會的時候，我在想你可以穿你那件瑪麗蓮夢露的洋裝。

items.en: I was thinking that you could come to my house and watch the film.
items.zh: 我在想你可以來我家看電影。

items.en: I was thinking you could bring your guitar to the barbecue.
items.zh: 我在想你可以帶你的吉他來烤肉。

items.en: I was thinking that you could ask your teacher for more time.
items.zh: 我在想你可以請你的老師多給一點時間。

items.en: I was thinking you could stay for dinner if you're free.
items.zh: 我在想如果你有空，可以留下來吃晚餐。

items.en: I was thinking that you could paint the bedroom green.
items.zh: 我在想你可以把臥室漆成綠色。

examples.heading: ④ I was thinking (that) we could + 原形動詞：建議一起做

items.en: I was thinking we could go to the beach on Saturday.
items.zh: 我在想我們星期六可以去海灘。

items.en: I was thinking that we could have a picnic in the park.
items.zh: 我在想我們可以去公園野餐。

items.en: I was thinking we could try that new Thai restaurant.
items.zh: 我在想我們可以去試試那家新的泰國餐廳。

items.en: I was thinking that we could share a taxi to the airport.
items.zh: 我在想我們可以一起搭計程車去機場。

items.en: I was thinking we could visit Grandma on Sunday.
items.zh: 我在想我們星期天可以去看奶奶。

items.en: I was thinking that we could study together for the exam.
items.zh: 我在想我們可以一起準備考試。

examples.heading: ⑤ I was hoping (that) + 主詞 + could / would + 原形動詞

items.en: I was hoping you could help me move house on Saturday.
items.zh: 我希望你星期六能幫我搬家。

items.en: I was hoping that you would come to my birthday party.
items.zh: 我希望你會來我的生日派對。

items.en: I was hoping I could talk to you about my grades.
items.zh: 我希望能跟您談談我的成績。

items.en: I was hoping you could lend me some money until Friday.
items.zh: 我希望你能借我一點錢到星期五。

items.en: I was hoping we could meet for coffee next week.
items.zh: 我希望我們下星期能見面喝杯咖啡。

items.en: I was hoping that you would say yes.
items.zh: 我希望你會答應。

items.en: I was hoping you could explain this letter to me.
items.zh: 我希望你能幫我解釋這封信。

title: It would be great if you sent me a free copy of the next edition.
translation: 如果您能寄一本免費的下一期給我，那就太好了。
name: if 子句用過去簡單式表示客氣
sentences: It would be great if you sent me a few photos from the trip.
It would be nice if you came to the party on Saturday.
It would be great if we met before the meeting to go through the plan.
It would be nice if you called your grandmother more often.
I think it would be very helpful if I told you about my own case.
It would be helpful if you brought your passport on the first day.
It would be helpful if everyone arrived ten minutes early.
It would be really helpful if you explained the rules again.
I would be grateful if you gave me this job.
I would be grateful if you sent me more information about the course.
I would be grateful if you refunded the full price of the ticket.
We would be grateful if you kept this information private.
I'd be very grateful if you didn't mention this to my boss.
I would appreciate it if you replied by Friday.
I'd appreciate it if you turned the music down a bit.
We would appreciate it if you paid the bill within thirty days.
I'd really appreciate it if you were a little more forthright with me.
Would you mind if I opened the window?
Would you mind if I left a bit early today?
Would you mind if we changed the date of the interview?
Would you mind if I asked you a personal question?
It would be wonderful if you were able to join us for dinner.
I would be grateful if you were available for a short call next week.
It would help a lot if the room were ready by nine.
It would be easier for everyone if you were here on time.
It would be very kind of you if you forwarded my letter to the manager.
I would be grateful if you considered my application for the post of assistant.
It would be useful if you included a map with the invitation.
We would be grateful if all members returned the form by the end of the month.
I would appreciate it if you checked my booking and confirmed the dates.
It would be great if you let me know as soon as possible.

examples.heading: ① It would be great / nice if + 過去簡單式

items.en: It would be great if you sent me a few photos from the trip.
items.zh: 你要是能寄幾張旅行的照片給我，那就太好了。

items.en: It would be nice if you came to the party on Saturday.
items.zh: 你星期六要是能來派對就好了。

items.en: It would be great if we met before the meeting to go through the plan.
items.zh: 開會前我們要是能先碰面討論一下計畫，就太好了。

items.en: It would be nice if you called your grandmother more often.
items.zh: 你要是能多打電話給奶奶就好了。

examples.heading: ② It would be helpful if + 過去簡單式

items.en: I think it would be very helpful if I told you about my own case.
items.zh: 我想，要是我跟您說說我自己的情況，應該會很有幫助。

items.en: It would be helpful if you brought your passport on the first day.
items.zh: 第一天如果你能帶護照來，會很有幫助。

items.en: It would be helpful if everyone arrived ten minutes early.
items.zh: 如果大家都能提早十分鐘到，會很有幫助。

items.en: It would be really helpful if you explained the rules again.
items.zh: 你要是能再解釋一次規則，就幫了大忙了。

examples.heading: ③ I would be grateful if + 過去簡單式

items.en: I would be grateful if you gave me this job.
items.zh: 如果您能給我這份工作，我會非常感激。

items.en: I would be grateful if you sent me more information about the course.
items.zh: 如果您能寄更多課程的資料給我，我會很感激。

items.en: I would be grateful if you refunded the full price of the ticket.
items.zh: 如果您能全額退還票價，我會很感激。

items.en: We would be grateful if you kept this information private.
items.zh: 如果您能對這件事保密，我們會很感激。

items.en: I'd be very grateful if you didn't mention this to my boss.
items.zh: 你要是別跟我老闆提這件事，我會很感激。

examples.heading: ④ I would appreciate it if + 過去簡單式

items.en: I would appreciate it if you replied by Friday.
items.zh: 如果您能在星期五前回覆，我會很感謝。

items.en: I'd appreciate it if you turned the music down a bit.
items.zh: 你要是能把音樂關小聲一點，我會很感謝。

items.en: We would appreciate it if you paid the bill within thirty days.
items.zh: 如果您能在三十天內付款，我們會很感謝。

items.en: I'd really appreciate it if you were a little more forthright with me.
items.zh: 你要是能對我再直接一點，我會很感謝。

examples.heading: ⑤ Would you mind if I + 過去簡單式

items.en: Would you mind if I opened the window?
items.zh: 我開個窗戶，你介意嗎？

items.en: Would you mind if I left a bit early today?
items.zh: 我今天早一點走，你介意嗎？

items.en: Would you mind if we changed the date of the interview?
items.zh: 我們改一下面試的日期，您介意嗎？

items.en: Would you mind if I asked you a personal question?
items.zh: 我問你一個私人的問題，你介意嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ if 子句用 were

items.en: It would be wonderful if you were able to join us for dinner.
items.zh: 您要是能跟我們一起吃晚餐，那就太好了。

items.en: I would be grateful if you were available for a short call next week.
items.zh: 如果您下禮拜有空簡短通個電話，我會很感激。

items.en: It would help a lot if the room were ready by nine.
items.zh: 房間要是能在九點前準備好，就幫了大忙了。

items.en: It would be easier for everyone if you were here on time.
items.zh: 你要是準時到，大家都會輕鬆一點。

examples.heading: ⑦ 用在書信和電子郵件

items.en: It would be very kind of you if you forwarded my letter to the manager.
items.zh: 如果您能把我的信轉給經理，那就太感謝了。

items.en: I would be grateful if you considered my application for the post of assistant.
items.zh: 如果您能考慮我應徵助理一職的申請，我會很感激。

items.en: It would be useful if you included a map with the invitation.
items.zh: 如果您能在邀請函裡附上地圖，會很方便。

items.en: We would be grateful if all members returned the form by the end of the month.
items.zh: 如果所有會員能在月底前交回表格，我們會很感激。

items.en: I would appreciate it if you checked my booking and confirmed the dates.
items.zh: 如果您能查一下我的訂位並確認日期，我會很感謝。

items.en: It would be great if you let me know as soon as possible.
items.zh: 您要是能儘快通知我，那就太好了。

title: I thought you might be interested in writing about a special dish from your country.
translation: 我想你可能會有興趣寫一道你們國家的特色菜。
name: I thought 表示委婉
sentences: Here's the book about Spain. I thought you might enjoy it before your trip.
We're going to the beach on Saturday. I thought you might want to come with us.
You've been working all afternoon. I thought you might be hungry, so I made some sandwiches.
You're studying for your driving test. I saw this article and thought you might find it useful.
You're moving house today. I thought you might need some help with the boxes.

Hi, Ben. I thought I'd let you know that the meeting has been moved to Thursday.

examples.heading: ① I thought you might + 原形動詞

items.en: Here's the book about Spain. I thought you might enjoy it before your trip.
items.zh: 這是那本關於西班牙的書。我想你去旅行前可能會喜歡看。

items.en: We're going to the beach on Saturday. I thought you might want to come with us.
items.zh: 我們星期六要去海邊。我想你可能會想跟我們一起去。

items.en: You've been working all afternoon. I thought you might be hungry, so I made some sandwiches.
items.zh: 你整個下午都在工作。我想你可能餓了，所以做了一些三明治。

items.en: You're studying for your driving test. I saw this article and thought you might find it useful.
items.zh: 你在準備駕照考試。我看到這篇文章，想說你可能用得到。

items.en: You're moving house today. I thought you might need some help with the boxes.
items.zh: 你今天搬家。我想你搬那些箱子可能需要幫忙。

examples.heading: ② I thought it would be + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: There are a lot of stories in the office. I thought it would be a good idea to let you know what is really going on.
items.zh: 辦公室裡有很多傳言。我想讓你知道真正的情況會比較好。

items.en: We've only spoken by email. I thought it would be useful to meet before the conference.
items.zh: 我們只用電子郵件聯絡過。我想開會前先見個面會有幫助。

items.en: The family next door moved in last week. I thought it would be nice to invite them for dinner.
items.zh: 隔壁那家人上禮拜搬來。我想請他們來吃晚餐應該不錯。

items.en: This is a difficult problem. I thought it would be better to discuss it in person.
items.zh: 這是個棘手的問題。我想這件事當面談比較好。

items.en: I'm leaving the company in June. I thought it would be fair to tell you before anyone else.
items.zh: 我六月要離開公司。我想先告訴你才公平。

examples.heading: ③ I thought we could + 原形動詞

items.en: It's been ages since we talked. I thought we could have lunch together on Friday.
items.zh: 我們好久沒聊了。我想我們星期五可以一起吃午餐。

items.en: Parking in the city is terrible. I thought we could take the train instead of driving.
items.zh: 城裡很難停車。我想我們可以搭火車，不要開車。

items.en: We have a lot to talk about today. I thought we could start with the budget and then move on to the schedule.
items.zh: 我們今天有很多事要談。我想我們可以先談預算，再談時程。

items.en: We're both going to the airport. I thought we could share the cost of the taxi.
items.zh: 我們兩個都要去機場。我想我們可以一起分攤計程車錢。

items.en: It's a lovely evening. I thought we could go for a walk after dinner.
items.zh: 今天晚上天氣很好。我想我們晚餐後可以去散個步。

examples.heading: ④ I thought I'd + 原形動詞

items.en: Hi, Grandma, it's me. I thought I'd call to see how you are.
items.zh: 嗨，奶奶，是我。我想打個電話看看你好不好。

items.en: Hi, Ben. I thought I'd let you know that the meeting has been moved to Thursday.
items.zh: 嗨，班。我想跟你說一聲，會議改到星期四了。

items.en: I was in the area, so I thought I'd drop in.
items.zh: 我剛好在附近，就想說過來看看。

items.en: I need to go to the shops. I thought I'd ask before I borrow your bike.
items.zh: 我得去商店一趟。我想先問一下再借你的腳踏車。

items.en: Our meeting is on Monday. I thought I'd send you the report early in case you had questions.
items.zh: 我們星期一要開會。我想早點把報告寄給你，萬一你有問題可以先問。

examples.heading: ⑤ 書信和電子郵件

items.en: Dear Tom, the reason I'm writing is that I thought you might be interested in joining our club.
items.zh: 親愛的湯姆，我寫信的原因是，我想你可能會有興趣加入我們的社團。

items.en: Dear Members, we thought you would like to know about the new opening hours.
items.zh: 各位會員好，我們想各位會想知道新的開放時間。

items.en: Dear Students, I thought I should mention that the deadline is next Monday.
items.zh: 各位同學好，我想我應該提一下，截止日是下星期一。

items.en: Dear Mrs Green, as you are new to the area, we thought you might appreciate a map of the town.
items.zh: 格林太太您好，您剛搬來這一帶，我們想您可能會需要一張鎮上的地圖。

items.en: Dear Sir, your office has not answered my calls. I thought it best to write to you directly.
items.zh: 敬啟者，貴辦公室沒有回我的電話。我想直接寫信給您最好。

examples.heading: ⑥ 回應對方，委婉地提出不同的意見

items.en: You want to ask John to the party? I thought perhaps we could ask Mary first.
items.zh: 你想邀約翰來派對？我想我們或許可以先問問瑪莉。

items.en: The red dress is nice. I thought the blue one might look better on you.
items.zh: 紅色洋裝很好看。我想藍色那件你穿起來可能比較好看。

items.en: You said we should leave at five. I thought we might leave a bit earlier to avoid the traffic.
items.zh: 你說我們五點出發。我想我們可以早一點出發，避開塞車。

items.en: You want to buy the tickets at the station? I thought it might be cheaper to book online.
items.zh: 你想在車站買票？我想上網訂可能比較便宜。

items.en: You booked the big meeting room? I thought maybe a smaller room would be enough.
items.zh: 你訂了大會議室？我想也許小一點的房間就夠了。

items.en: You said you had a headache. I thought you'd prefer a quiet table, so I booked one in the corner.
items.zh: 你說你頭痛。我想你會比較喜歡安靜的位子，所以訂了角落那一桌。

title: I wondered if you could introduce me to somebody who knows how to use a camera.
translation: 不知道你能不能幫我介紹一個會用相機的人。
name: I wondered 和 I wanted 表示客氣
sentences: I wondered if you could send me some information about your courses.
I wondered if you could tell me what time the museum opens.
I wondered if you could recommend a good hotel near the station.
I wondered if we could change the date of the meeting.
I wondered if I could borrow your car this weekend.
I wondered if you would like to join us for dinner.
I wondered if you would be interested in giving a talk at our school.
I wondered whether you would mind checking my essay.
I wondered whether it would be possible to pay in two parts.
I was wondering if you could help me move on Saturday.
I was wondering if you had any rooms available for next week.
I was wondering whether you'd thought about my offer.
We were wondering if you could look after our cat while we're away.
I wanted to know if the rooms are single or double.
I also wanted to know if there is a gym in the hotel.
I wanted to ask whether breakfast is included in the price.
I wanted to ask about the job you advertised in the newspaper.
I just wanted to check that you received my application.
First of all, I wanted to thank you for giving me the first prize in your competition.
I wanted to thank you for your help last week.
We wanted to thank everyone who came to the party.
I wanted to thank you for being so patient with me.
I just wanted to say thank you for the lovely flowers.
I wanted to let you know that I'll be late tomorrow.
I wanted to let you know that your parcel has arrived.
I wanted to tell you how much I enjoyed your talk.
We wanted to remind you that the office will be closed on Friday.
I wondered if you might be free for a quick chat.
I wondered if there was any chance of getting a refund.
I wanted to apologise for missing your call yesterday.
I wanted to invite you to our new restaurant's opening night.

examples.heading: ① I wondered if + 主詞 + could

items.en: I wondered if you could send me some information about your courses.
items.zh: 不知道您能不能寄一些課程的資料給我。

items.en: I wondered if you could tell me what time the museum opens.
items.zh: 不知道您能不能告訴我博物館幾點開門。

items.en: I wondered if you could recommend a good hotel near the station.
items.zh: 不知道您能不能推薦車站附近一家好的飯店。

items.en: I wondered if we could change the date of the meeting.
items.zh: 不知道我們能不能改開會的日期。

items.en: I wondered if I could borrow your car this weekend.
items.zh: 不知道這個週末我能不能借你的車。

examples.heading: ② I wondered if + 主詞 + would

items.en: I wondered if you would like to join us for dinner.
items.zh: 不知道你要不要跟我們一起吃晚餐。

items.en: I wondered if you would be interested in giving a talk at our school.
items.zh: 不知道您有沒有興趣來我們學校演講。

items.en: I wondered whether you would mind checking my essay.
items.zh: 不知道你介不介意幫我看一下我的文章。

items.en: I wondered whether it would be possible to pay in two parts.
items.zh: 不知道能不能分兩次付款。

examples.heading: ③ I was wondering if

items.en: I was wondering if you could help me move on Saturday.
items.zh: 不知道你星期六能不能幫我搬家。

items.en: I was wondering if you had any rooms available for next week.
items.zh: 不知道你們下禮拜還有沒有空房。

items.en: I was wondering whether you'd thought about my offer.
items.zh: 不知道你考慮過我的提議了沒有。

items.en: We were wondering if you could look after our cat while we're away.
items.zh: 不知道我們不在的時候你能不能幫忙照顧貓。

examples.heading: ④ I wanted to know / ask

items.en: I wanted to know if the rooms are single or double.
items.zh: 我想請問房間是單人房還是雙人房。

items.en: I also wanted to know if there is a gym in the hotel.
items.zh: 我也想請問飯店有沒有健身房。

items.en: I wanted to ask whether breakfast is included in the price.
items.zh: 我想請問房價有沒有含早餐。

items.en: I wanted to ask about the job you advertised in the newspaper.
items.zh: 我想詢問你們在報紙上刊登的那份工作。

items.en: I just wanted to check that you received my application.
items.zh: 我只是想確認您有收到我的申請。

examples.heading: ⑤ I wanted to thank you

items.en: First of all, I wanted to thank you for giving me the first prize in your competition.
items.zh: 首先，我想謝謝你們在比賽中給我頭獎。

items.en: I wanted to thank you for your help last week.
items.zh: 我想謝謝你上禮拜幫忙。

items.en: We wanted to thank everyone who came to the party.
items.zh: 我們想謝謝每一位來參加派對的人。

items.en: I wanted to thank you for being so patient with me.
items.zh: 我想謝謝你對我這麼有耐心。

items.en: I just wanted to say thank you for the lovely flowers.
items.zh: 我只是想謝謝你送的漂亮花束。

examples.heading: ⑥ I wanted to let you know / tell you

items.en: I wanted to let you know that I'll be late tomorrow.
items.zh: 我想跟你說一聲，我明天會晚到。

items.en: I wanted to let you know that your parcel has arrived.
items.zh: 我想通知您，您的包裹到了。

items.en: I wanted to tell you how much I enjoyed your talk.
items.zh: 我想跟你說我很喜歡你的演講。

items.en: We wanted to remind you that the office will be closed on Friday.
items.zh: 我們想提醒您，辦公室星期五不上班。

examples.heading: ⑦ 跟 I wondered 一起用的其他客氣說法

items.en: I wondered if you might be free for a quick chat.
items.zh: 不知道你有沒有空簡單聊一下。

items.en: I wondered if there was any chance of getting a refund.
items.zh: 不知道有沒有可能退款。

items.en: I wanted to apologise for missing your call yesterday.
items.zh: 昨天沒接到你的電話，我想跟你說聲抱歉。

items.en: I wanted to invite you to our new restaurant's opening night.
items.zh: 我想邀請你來參加我們新餐廳的開幕晚會。

title: Yesterday a TV company came to my school because they were doing a science quiz.
translation: 因為她坐在角落，所以整間咖啡廳她都看得到。
name: 過去進行式表示原因
sentences: Yesterday a TV company came to my school because they were making a science quiz show.
I didn't answer your call because I was driving.
She missed the bus because she was talking to a friend.
We stayed inside because it was raining heavily.
He didn't hear the doorbell because he was having a shower.
I burnt the rice because I was watching TV.
Because she was sitting in the corner, she could see the whole café in front of her.
Because I was walking near the river, I saw the boat race.
Because they were playing so loudly, the neighbours complained.
Because we were standing at the front, we could see the band clearly.
Because the trains were running late, many people missed their flights.
Because it was getting dark, we turned back.
I couldn't sleep because the dog was barking all night.
We couldn't hear the teacher because the workers were drilling outside.
She couldn't concentrate because her brother was playing the drums.
I couldn't take any photos because my brother was using the camera.
They couldn't land because a storm was coming.
He couldn't come to the phone because he was cooking.
I was late for work because the trains were running slowly.
She was tired because she was working night shifts.
He was happy because he was going on holiday the next day.
We were nervous because the plane was shaking a lot.
I was worried because my son was driving in the snow.
They were excited because they were moving to a new house.
I missed the meeting. The reason was that I was waiting for a delivery.
The road was closed. The reason was that they were repairing the bridge.
She left early. The reason was that her son was feeling ill.
The shop was busy. The reason was that it was having a big sale.
I didn't reply. The reason was that I was travelling in the mountains.
The town was full of people. The reason was that a festival was taking place.
He was quiet at dinner. The reason was that he was thinking about his exam.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + 過去式 + because + 主詞 + was / were + -ing

items.en: Yesterday a TV company came to my school because they were making a science quiz show.
items.zh: 昨天一家電視公司來我們學校，因為他們在做一個科學問答節目。

items.en: I didn't answer your call because I was driving.
items.zh: 我沒接你的電話，因為我在開車。

items.en: She missed the bus because she was talking to a friend.
items.zh: 她錯過了公車，因為她在跟朋友說話。

items.en: We stayed inside because it was raining heavily.
items.zh: 我們待在室內，因為雨下得很大。

items.en: He didn't hear the doorbell because he was having a shower.
items.zh: 他沒聽到門鈴，因為他在洗澡。

items.en: I burnt the rice because I was watching TV.
items.zh: 我把飯煮焦了，因為我在看電視。

examples.heading: ② Because + 主詞 + was / were + -ing, + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: Because she was sitting in the corner, she could see the whole café in front of her.
items.zh: 因為她坐在角落，她可以看到前面整個咖啡館。

items.en: Because I was walking near the river, I saw the boat race.
items.zh: 因為我在河邊散步，我看到了划船比賽。

items.en: Because they were playing so loudly, the neighbours complained.
items.zh: 因為他們玩得太大聲，鄰居抱怨了。

items.en: Because we were standing at the front, we could see the band clearly.
items.zh: 因為我們站在前面，我們可以清楚看到樂團。

items.en: Because the trains were running late, many people missed their flights.
items.zh: 因為火車誤點，很多人錯過了班機。

items.en: Because it was getting dark, we turned back.
items.zh: 因為天快黑了，我們就往回走。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + couldn't + 原形動詞 + because + 主詞 + was / were + -ing

items.en: I couldn't sleep because the dog was barking all night.
items.zh: 我睡不著，因為狗叫了一整晚。

items.en: We couldn't hear the teacher because the workers were drilling outside.
items.zh: 我們聽不到老師，因為工人在外面鑽地。

items.en: She couldn't concentrate because her brother was playing the drums.
items.zh: 她沒辦法專心，因為她弟弟在打鼓。

items.en: I couldn't take any photos because my brother was using the camera.
items.zh: 我沒辦法拍照，因為我哥哥在用相機。

items.en: They couldn't land because a storm was coming.
items.zh: 他們沒辦法降落，因為暴風雨要來了。

items.en: He couldn't come to the phone because he was cooking.
items.zh: 他沒辦法來接電話，因為他在煮飯。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + was late / tired + because + 主詞 + was / were + -ing

items.en: I was late for work because the trains were running slowly.
items.zh: 我上班遲到了，因為火車開得很慢。

items.en: She was tired because she was working night shifts.
items.zh: 她很累，因為她在上夜班。

items.en: He was happy because he was going on holiday the next day.
items.zh: 他很高興，因為他隔天要去度假。

items.en: We were nervous because the plane was shaking a lot.
items.zh: 我們很緊張，因為飛機晃得很厲害。

items.en: I was worried because my son was driving in the snow.
items.zh: 我很擔心，因為我兒子在雪中開車。

items.en: They were excited because they were moving to a new house.
items.zh: 他們很興奮，因為他們要搬到新家。

examples.heading: ⑤ The reason was that + 主詞 + was / were + -ing

items.en: I missed the meeting. The reason was that I was waiting for a delivery.
items.zh: 我錯過了會議。原因是我在等一個快遞。

items.en: The road was closed. The reason was that they were repairing the bridge.
items.zh: 那條路封了。原因是他們在修橋。

items.en: She left early. The reason was that her son was feeling ill.
items.zh: 她提早走了。原因是她兒子覺得不舒服。

items.en: The shop was busy. The reason was that it was having a big sale.
items.zh: 那家店很多人。原因是它在辦大特價。

items.en: I didn't reply. The reason was that I was travelling in the mountains.
items.zh: 我沒回覆。原因是我在山裡旅行。

items.en: The town was full of people. The reason was that a festival was taking place.
items.zh: 鎮上都是人。原因是正在舉辦一個節慶。

items.en: He was quiet at dinner. The reason was that he was thinking about his exam.
items.zh: 他吃晚餐的時候很安靜。原因是他在想他的考試。

title: The roads might be slippery when it has been snowing.
translation: 剛下過雪的時候，路面可能會很滑。
name: 現在完成進行式表示剛結束且有影響的動作
sentences: The ground is wet. It's been raining.
Be careful on the steps. It has been snowing.
The garden looks fresh because it's been raining all morning.
There are branches on the road. The wind has been blowing hard.
You look tired. Have you been working late?
Her eyes are red. She's been crying.
My legs hurt. I've been walking all day.
Why are you so sunburnt? Have you been lying on the beach?
I'm out of breath because I've been running.
His hands are covered in paint. He's been painting the fence.
The kitchen smells of onions. Someone has been cooking.
The floor is wet because I've been mopping it.
There's mud everywhere. The dog has been playing in the garden.
The computer is still warm. Somebody has been using it.
The sofa is covered in crumbs. The kids have been eating biscuits.
Sorry I didn't answer. I've been driving.
Sorry about the mess. We've been decorating.
Sit down, Sam. I've been talking to your teacher about your exam.
Sorry I'm late. I've been looking for a parking space.
My voice is a bit hoarse. I've been singing at a wedding.
Have you been swimming? Your hair is wet.
What have you been doing? You're covered in dust.
Have you been gardening? Your boots are muddy.
Have you been drinking? I can smell beer.
My cushion is on the floor. Who has been sitting in my chair?
Don't touch the oven. I've been baking bread.
The roads are icy because it has been freezing all night.
My phone battery is low. I've been watching videos.
The grass is short. Dad has been mowing the lawn.
Ann is very quiet. Has she been arguing with her brother?
The windows are dusty. The builders have been working next door.

examples.heading: ① 天氣

items.en: The ground is wet. It's been raining.
items.zh: 地上是濕的，剛剛下過雨。

items.en: Be careful on the steps. It has been snowing.
items.zh: 走樓梯要小心，剛剛下過雪。

items.en: The garden looks fresh because it's been raining all morning.
items.zh: 花園看起來很清新，因為整個早上都在下雨。

items.en: There are branches on the road. The wind has been blowing hard.
items.zh: 路上有樹枝，剛剛風吹得很大。

examples.heading: ② 身上看得到的結果

items.en: You look tired. Have you been working late?
items.zh: 你看起來很累。你最近都在加班嗎？

items.en: Her eyes are red. She's been crying.
items.zh: 她的眼睛紅紅的，她剛剛哭過。

items.en: My legs hurt. I've been walking all day.
items.zh: 我的腿好痠，我走了一整天。

items.en: Why are you so sunburnt? Have you been lying on the beach?
items.zh: 你怎麼曬得這麼紅？你剛剛在海灘上躺著嗎？

items.en: I'm out of breath because I've been running.
items.zh: 我喘不過氣，因為我剛剛在跑步。

items.en: His hands are covered in paint. He's been painting the fence.
items.zh: 他滿手都是油漆，他剛剛在漆圍籬。

examples.heading: ③ 房間和東西上的痕跡

items.en: The kitchen smells of onions. Someone has been cooking.
items.zh: 廚房有洋蔥的味道，有人剛剛在煮東西。

items.en: The floor is wet because I've been mopping it.
items.zh: 地板是濕的，因為我剛剛在拖地。

items.en: There's mud everywhere. The dog has been playing in the garden.
items.zh: 到處都是泥巴，狗剛剛在花園裡玩。

items.en: The computer is still warm. Somebody has been using it.
items.zh: 電腦還是熱的，有人剛剛在用。

items.en: The sofa is covered in crumbs. The kids have been eating biscuits.
items.zh: 沙發上都是碎屑，孩子們剛剛在吃餅乾。

examples.heading: ④ 解釋和道歉

items.en: Sorry I didn't answer. I've been driving.
items.zh: 抱歉剛剛沒接，我在開車。

items.en: Sorry about the mess. We've been decorating.
items.zh: 抱歉這裡很亂，我們剛剛在裝潢。

items.en: Sit down, Sam. I've been talking to your teacher about your exam.
items.zh: 山姆，坐下。我剛剛跟你的老師談了你考試的事。

items.en: Sorry I'm late. I've been looking for a parking space.
items.zh: 抱歉我遲到了，我剛剛在找停車位。

items.en: My voice is a bit hoarse. I've been singing at a wedding.
items.zh: 我的聲音有點啞，我剛剛在婚禮上唱歌。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句：Have / Has + 主詞 + been + 動詞-ing?

items.en: Have you been swimming? Your hair is wet.
items.zh: 你剛剛去游泳了嗎？你的頭髮是濕的。

items.en: What have you been doing? You're covered in dust.
items.zh: 你剛剛在做什麼？你全身都是灰。

items.en: Have you been gardening? Your boots are muddy.
items.zh: 你剛剛在整理花園嗎？你的靴子都是泥巴。

items.en: Have you been drinking? I can smell beer.
items.zh: 你剛剛喝酒了嗎？我聞到啤酒的味道。

items.en: My cushion is on the floor. Who has been sitting in my chair?
items.zh: 我的坐墊在地上。誰剛剛坐過我的椅子？

examples.heading: ⑥ 結果還有影響

items.en: Don't touch the oven. I've been baking bread.
items.zh: 不要碰烤箱，我剛剛在烤麵包。

items.en: The roads are icy because it has been freezing all night.
items.zh: 路面結冰了，因為整個晚上都在結凍。

items.en: My phone battery is low. I've been watching videos.
items.zh: 我的手機快沒電了，我剛剛在看影片。

items.en: The grass is short. Dad has been mowing the lawn.
items.zh: 草短短的，爸爸剛剛在割草。

items.en: Ann is very quiet. Has she been arguing with her brother?
items.zh: Ann 很安靜。她剛剛跟她哥吵架了嗎？

items.en: The windows are dusty. The builders have been working next door.
items.zh: 窗戶上都是灰，隔壁剛剛有工人在施工。

title: I've just received your email.
translation: 我剛收到你的電子郵件。
name: 現在完成式表示剛發生的事
sentences: Don't touch the walls. I've just finished painting the kitchen.
We're celebrating tonight. We've just signed the contract for our new flat.
Mr Lee left the office two minutes ago. You've just missed him.
Good news for the concert. I've just booked our tickets.
I got a message from my parents. They have just landed in Rome.
I've just made some tea. Would you like some?
Turn on the radio. They've just announced the winners of the singing contest.
Hurry up and sit down. The match has just kicked off.
Sorry, Maria isn't at her desk. She's just gone out for lunch.
Come and see the driveway. My dad has just bought a new car.
We're having a big party on Saturday. My grandmother has just turned ninety.
Please talk quietly. The baby has just fallen asleep.
We can go for a walk now. It's just stopped raining.
Stop worrying about money. I've found a job for you at my uncle's shop.
I'll have to take the bus today. Someone has stolen my bike.
I can't open the front door. Oh no, I've forgotten my keys.
Can you bring a plaster? Tom has cut his finger.
We'll have to buy milk somewhere else. The shop has run out.
Look out of the window. Everything is white. It's snowed!
I can't pay for lunch. I've lost my wallet.
The glass is so clear. Have you just cleaned the windows?
I want to wash the dishes. Has the plumber fixed the sink?
Has Anna just got home? — Yes, she has. She's in her room.
Can we start the dinner? Have the guests arrived? — Yes, they've just come in.
I've just washed the floor, so don't walk on it.
Have you seen Amy today? She's just had her hair cut, and it looks great.
Thanks for the sandwich, but I've just eaten, so I'm not hungry.
Be careful with the front door. Dad has just painted it, and it's still wet.
We've just heard about your new baby, and we're so happy for you.
The kids have just gone to bed, so please be quiet.

examples.heading: ① I / we / you / they + have just + 過去分詞

items.en: Don't touch the walls. I've just finished painting the kitchen.
items.zh: 不要碰牆壁。我剛把廚房漆完。

items.en: We're celebrating tonight. We've just signed the contract for our new flat.
items.zh: 我們今晚要慶祝。我們剛簽了新公寓的租約。

items.en: Mr Lee left the office two minutes ago. You've just missed him.
items.zh: 李先生兩分鐘前離開辦公室了。你剛好跟他錯過了。

items.en: Good news for the concert. I've just booked our tickets.
items.zh: 演唱會有好消息。我剛訂好我們的票。

items.en: I got a message from my parents. They have just landed in Rome.
items.zh: 我收到爸媽的訊息。他們剛在羅馬降落。

items.en: I've just made some tea. Would you like some?
items.zh: 我剛泡了茶，你要喝一點嗎？

items.en: Turn on the radio. They've just announced the winners of the singing contest.
items.zh: 把收音機打開。他們剛宣布歌唱比賽的得獎名單。

examples.heading: ② he / she / it + has just + 過去分詞

items.en: Hurry up and sit down. The match has just kicked off.
items.zh: 快點坐下。比賽剛開打。

items.en: Sorry, Maria isn't at her desk. She's just gone out for lunch.
items.zh: 抱歉，瑪麗亞不在座位上。她剛出去吃午餐。

items.en: Come and see the driveway. My dad has just bought a new car.
items.zh: 來看看車道。我爸剛買了一輛新車。

items.en: We're having a big party on Saturday. My grandmother has just turned ninety.
items.zh: 我們星期六要辦一個大派對。我奶奶剛滿九十歲。

items.en: Please talk quietly. The baby has just fallen asleep.
items.zh: 請小聲說話。寶寶剛睡著。

items.en: We can go for a walk now. It's just stopped raining.
items.zh: 我們現在可以去散步了。雨剛停。

examples.heading: ③ 不加 just：結果還在現在

items.en: Stop worrying about money. I've found a job for you at my uncle's shop.
items.zh: 別再擔心錢了。我幫你在我叔叔的店找到一份工作了。

items.en: I'll have to take the bus today. Someone has stolen my bike.
items.zh: 我今天得搭公車了。有人把我的腳踏車偷走了。

items.en: I can't open the front door. Oh no, I've forgotten my keys.
items.zh: 我打不開前門。糟了，我忘了帶鑰匙。

items.en: Can you bring a plaster? Tom has cut his finger.
items.zh: 你可以拿一片 OK 繃來嗎？湯姆割到手指了。

items.en: We'll have to buy milk somewhere else. The shop has run out.
items.zh: 我們得去別的地方買牛奶了。這家店賣完了。

items.en: Look out of the window. Everything is white. It's snowed!
items.zh: 你看窗外。一片白。下雪了！

items.en: I can't pay for lunch. I've lost my wallet.
items.zh: 我沒辦法付午餐錢。我的錢包不見了。

examples.heading: ④ 問句和回答

items.en: The glass is so clear. Have you just cleaned the windows?
items.zh: 玻璃好乾淨。你剛擦過窗戶嗎？

items.en: I want to wash the dishes. Has the plumber fixed the sink?
items.zh: 我想洗碗。水電工修好水槽了嗎？

items.en: Has Anna just got home? — Yes, she has. She's in her room.
items.zh: 安娜剛到家嗎？對，剛到。她在房間裡。

items.en: Can we start the dinner? Have the guests arrived? — Yes, they've just come in.
items.zh: 我們可以開始晚餐了嗎？客人到了嗎？到了，他們剛進來。

examples.heading: ⑤ 先說剛發生的事，再說現在的情況

items.en: I've just washed the floor, so don't walk on it.
items.zh: 我剛拖完地，不要踩上去。

items.en: Have you seen Amy today? She's just had her hair cut, and it looks great.
items.zh: 你今天看到艾美了嗎？她剛剪了頭髮，看起來很好看。

items.en: Thanks for the sandwich, but I've just eaten, so I'm not hungry.
items.zh: 謝謝你的三明治，不過我剛吃過，所以不餓。

items.en: Be careful with the front door. Dad has just painted it, and it's still wet.
items.zh: 小心前門。爸爸剛漆好，還沒乾。

items.en: We've just heard about your new baby, and we're so happy for you.
items.zh: 我們剛聽到你生寶寶的消息，真替你高興。

items.en: The kids have just gone to bed, so please be quiet.
