items.zh: 孩子們剛去睡，請小聲一點。

title: I wish weekends lasted five days.
translation: 真希望週末有五天。
name: wish 加過去簡單式表示遺憾
sentences: I wish I lived closer to the sea.
I wish I had more time for my hobbies.
I wish I knew the answer.
She wishes she spoke French as well as her sister.
I wish my parents understood me.
I wish you were here to see this.
I wish it were Friday already.
I wish I was a bit taller.
He wishes his job were less arduous.
I wish I didn't have to work this weekend.
I wish you didn't live so far away.
My son wishes he didn't need glasses.
I wish it didn't rain so much here.
I wish I could swim.
I wish we could stay another week.
She wishes she could afford a car.
I wish that I had a brother.
We all wish that the summer lasted longer.
I wish that people were kinder to each other.
If only I had a car!
If only she knew how much I miss her.
If only the trains ran on time.
Do you ever wish you lived in the countryside?
They wish they had a bigger garden.
My grandmother wishes she saw her grandchildren more often.
I wish I knew how to cook. I always eat out.
I wish my boss wasn't so churlish. He never says thank you.
I wish we had a dishwasher. Washing up takes ages.
I wish the hotel was quieter. We can't sleep at night.
I wish I were braver. I never speak up in meetings.

examples.heading: ① I wish + 主詞 + 過去簡單式

items.en: I wish I lived closer to the sea.
items.zh: 真希望我住得離海近一點。

items.en: I wish I had more time for my hobbies.
items.zh: 真希望我有多一點時間做自己的嗜好。

items.en: I wish I knew the answer.
items.zh: 真希望我知道答案。

items.en: She wishes she spoke French as well as her sister.
items.zh: 她希望自己的法文說得跟她姊姊一樣好。

items.en: I wish my parents understood me.
items.zh: 真希望我爸媽能了解我。

examples.heading: ② wish + were / was

items.en: I wish you were here to see this.
items.zh: 真希望你在這裡看看這個。

items.en: I wish it were Friday already.
items.zh: 真希望已經是星期五了。

items.en: I wish I was a bit taller.
items.zh: 真希望我再高一點。

items.en: He wishes his job were less arduous.
items.zh: 他希望工作不要那麼辛苦。

examples.heading: ③ wish + didn't + 原形動詞

items.en: I wish I didn't have to work this weekend.
items.zh: 真希望我這個週末不用上班。

items.en: I wish you didn't live so far away.
items.zh: 真希望你沒住那麼遠。

items.en: My son wishes he didn't need glasses.
items.zh: 我兒子希望自己不用戴眼鏡。

items.en: I wish it didn't rain so much here.
items.zh: 真希望這裡不要這麼常下雨。

examples.heading: ④ wish + could + 原形動詞

items.en: I wish I could swim.
items.zh: 真希望我會游泳。

items.en: I wish we could stay another week.
items.zh: 真希望我們能再待一個禮拜。

items.en: She wishes she could afford a car.
items.zh: 她希望自己買得起車。

examples.heading: ⑤ wish that + 主詞 + 過去簡單式

items.en: I wish that I had a brother.
items.zh: 真希望我有個哥哥。

items.en: We all wish that the summer lasted longer.
items.zh: 我們都希望夏天能長一點。

items.en: I wish that people were kinder to each other.
items.zh: 真希望大家對彼此好一點。

examples.heading: ⑥ If only + 過去簡單式

items.en: If only I had a car!
items.zh: 要是我有車就好了！

items.en: If only she knew how much I miss her.
items.zh: 要是她知道我有多想她就好了。

items.en: If only the trains ran on time.
items.zh: 要是火車都準時就好了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 不同的主詞和問句

items.en: Do you ever wish you lived in the countryside?
items.zh: 你有沒有希望過自己住在鄉下？

items.en: They wish they had a bigger garden.
items.zh: 他們希望有大一點的花園。

items.en: My grandmother wishes she saw her grandchildren more often.
items.zh: 我奶奶希望能多見見孫子。

examples.heading: ⑧ 說完希望，接著說出事實

items.en: I wish I knew how to cook. I always eat out.
items.zh: 真希望我會做菜。我老是在外面吃。

items.en: I wish my boss wasn't so churlish. He never says thank you.
items.zh: 真希望我老闆不要那麼沒禮貌。他從來不說謝謝。

items.en: I wish we had a dishwasher. Washing up takes ages.
items.zh: 真希望我們有洗碗機。洗碗要花好久。

items.en: I wish the hotel was quieter. We can't sleep at night.
items.zh: 真希望飯店安靜一點。我們晚上都睡不著。

items.en: I wish I were braver. I never speak up in meetings.
items.zh: 真希望我勇敢一點。我開會從來不敢發言。

title: I've been watching TV a lot, especially the sports programs.
translation: 我最近很常看電視，尤其是體育節目。
name: 現在完成進行式表示反覆持續的活動
sentences: My commute is an hour long. I've been listening to a lot of podcasts on the way to work.
We've been eating out a lot because the kitchen is being repaired.
My grandmother is lonely. She's been calling me every night.
I can't sleep at night. I've been drinking too much coffee.
We can't sleep on Saturdays. The neighbours have been having parties every weekend.
My boyfriend is in Japan this week. He's been sending me messages all day.
My cousin looks much stronger. He has been lifting weights for a year.
My back feels much better. I've been taking yoga classes for six months.
My cousins look tired. They've been visiting their grandmother in hospital for weeks.
My husband and I love the club. We've been playing tennis on Sundays for years.
My sister is going to see a doctor. She's been having headaches for a month.
I've lost five kilos. I've been walking to school since the bus route changed.
He hardly talks to us now. My son has been playing his new game since Christmas.
My mum has a new hobby. She's been going to dance classes since March.
Nobody says anything on the line. We've been getting strange phone calls since Monday.
My fingers hurt. I've been practising the guitar every day since I bought it.
You look very tired. Have you been sleeping badly lately?
We have a big project at the office. I've been working late a lot recently.
The teacher is worried. Tom's been missing classes lately.
Yes, Jo and I are friends again. We've been seeing a lot of each other recently.
Leave home early. The trains have been running late lately.
I'm going to put my name on it. Someone has been taking my lunch from the office fridge.
The postman is scared of our house. My dog has been barking at him.
I know that journalist's name. I've been reading his articles in the local paper.
I'm angry with my sister. She's been borrowing my car without asking.
The election is next week. The candidates have been knocking on doors to ask for votes.
You look so relaxed. What have you been doing in the evenings?
You look fitter. Have you been running every morning?
Your grandson is so kind. How often has he been visiting you?
You look exhausted. Has the baby been waking up at night?
These tomatoes taste great. Where have you been buying your vegetables?

examples.heading: ① 加次數的說法

items.en: My commute is an hour long. I've been listening to a lot of podcasts on the way to work.
items.zh: 我通勤要一個小時。我最近上班路上常聽 podcast。

items.en: We've been eating out a lot because the kitchen is being repaired.
items.zh: 廚房在整修，所以我們最近常在外面吃。

items.en: My grandmother is lonely. She's been calling me every night.
items.zh: 我奶奶很寂寞。她每天晚上都打電話給我。

items.en: I can't sleep at night. I've been drinking too much coffee.
items.zh: 我晚上睡不著。我最近咖啡喝太多了。

items.en: We can't sleep on Saturdays. The neighbours have been having parties every weekend.
items.zh: 我們星期六都睡不著。鄰居每個週末都在開派對。

items.en: My boyfriend is in Japan this week. He's been sending me messages all day.
items.zh: 我男朋友這個禮拜在日本。他一整天都一直傳訊息給我。

examples.heading: ② 加 for + 一段時間

items.en: My cousin looks much stronger. He has been lifting weights for a year.
items.zh: 我表哥看起來壯多了。他練舉重練了一年了。

items.en: My back feels much better. I've been taking yoga classes for six months.
items.zh: 我的背好多了。我上瑜伽課上了半年了。

items.en: My cousins look tired. They've been visiting their grandmother in hospital for weeks.
items.zh: 我的表弟妹看起來很累。他們去醫院看奶奶看了好幾個禮拜了。

items.en: My husband and I love the club. We've been playing tennis on Sundays for years.
items.zh: 我和我先生很愛那個俱樂部。我們每個星期天打網球，打了好幾年了。

items.en: My sister is going to see a doctor. She's been having headaches for a month.
items.zh: 我姊姊要去看醫生。她頭痛一個月了，常常發作。

examples.heading: ③ 加 since + 起點

items.en: I've lost five kilos. I've been walking to school since the bus route changed.
items.zh: 我瘦了五公斤。從公車路線改了以後，我就一直走路上學。

items.en: He hardly talks to us now. My son has been playing his new game since Christmas.
items.zh: 他現在幾乎不跟我們說話。我兒子從聖誕節以後就一直在玩他的新遊戲。

items.en: My mum has a new hobby. She's been going to dance classes since March.
items.zh: 我媽媽有了新嗜好。她從三月開始上舞蹈課。

items.en: Nobody says anything on the line. We've been getting strange phone calls since Monday.
items.zh: 電話那頭都沒人說話。我們從星期一開始一直接到奇怪的電話。

items.en: My fingers hurt. I've been practising the guitar every day since I bought it.
items.zh: 我的手指好痛。我買了吉他以後每天都在練。

examples.heading: ④ 加 lately / recently

items.en: You look very tired. Have you been sleeping badly lately?
items.zh: 你看起來很累。你最近常睡不好嗎？

items.en: We have a big project at the office. I've been working late a lot recently.
items.zh: 我們公司有個大案子。我最近常常加班。

items.en: The teacher is worried. Tom's been missing classes lately.
items.zh: 老師很擔心。湯姆最近常常翹課。

items.en: Yes, Jo and I are friends again. We've been seeing a lot of each other recently.
items.zh: 對，我和喬又和好了。我們最近常見面。

items.en: Leave home early. The trains have been running late lately.
items.zh: 早點出門。火車最近常常誤點。

examples.heading: ⑤ 從動詞看出活動反覆發生

items.en: I'm going to put my name on it. Someone has been taking my lunch from the office fridge.
items.zh: 我要在上面寫名字。有人一直拿走我放在辦公室冰箱的午餐。

items.en: The postman is scared of our house. My dog has been barking at him.
items.zh: 郵差很怕我們家。我的狗一直對他叫。

items.en: I know that journalist's name. I've been reading his articles in the local paper.
items.zh: 我知道那個記者的名字。我一直有在看他登在地方報紙上的文章。

items.en: I'm angry with my sister. She's been borrowing my car without asking.
items.zh: 我在生我妹妹的氣。她一直沒問我就借走我的車。

items.en: The election is next week. The candidates have been knocking on doors to ask for votes.
items.zh: 選舉在下禮拜。候選人挨家挨戶敲門拉票。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問句

items.en: You look so relaxed. What have you been doing in the evenings?
items.zh: 你看起來好放鬆。你最近晚上都在做什麼？

items.en: You look fitter. Have you been running every morning?
items.zh: 你看起來更健康了。你每天早上都有去跑步嗎？

items.en: Your grandson is so kind. How often has he been visiting you?
items.zh: 你孫子真貼心。他多常來看你？

items.en: You look exhausted. Has the baby been waking up at night?
items.zh: 你看起來累壞了。寶寶晚上常常醒來嗎？

items.en: These tomatoes taste great. Where have you been buying your vegetables?
items.zh: 這些番茄好好吃。你最近都在哪裡買菜？

title: He was always talking about this prize, but I never thought he would win it.
translation: 他老是在講這個獎，可是我從沒想過他真的會得獎。
name: 過去進行式加 always 表示反覆的事
sentences: My brother entered the photo competition every year. He was always talking about this prize, but I never thought he would win it.
My grandmother was always telling us stories about her village.
Our teacher was always saying that reading is important.
My friend was always talking about her trip to Japan.
He was always complaining about his boss.
My dad was always singing old songs in the car.
Our holiday in Scotland was not great. Worst of all, in September it was always raining.
In that town it was always snowing in winter.
When we lived by the sea, it was always blowing hard.
In the mountains it was always getting dark early.
That summer it was always raining at the weekends.
In my childhood it was always snowing at Christmas.
My sister was always borrowing my clothes without asking.
The neighbours were always playing loud music at night.
My little brother was always breaking my toys.
Our old car was always breaking down on the motorway.
He was always forgetting his homework.
The cat was always sleeping on my bed.
My grandfather was always helping people in the village.
Our teacher was always smiling, even on bad days.
My mum was always baking cakes for our birthdays.
Our neighbour was always bringing us vegetables from his garden.
They were always inviting us to their parties.
My best friend was always making me laugh.
He was always promising to visit, but he never came.
She was always saying she would learn to drive, but she never did.
We were always planning a big trip, but we never had the money.
My dad was always saying he would stop smoking, but he didn't.
They were always talking about moving, but they stayed for twenty years.
I was always meaning to write to her, but I forgot.
He was always looking for a better job, but he stayed at the factory.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + was always + talking / saying：一直在說

items.en: My brother entered the photo competition every year. He was always talking about this prize, but I never thought he would win it.
items.zh: 我哥哥每年都參加攝影比賽。他總是在說這個獎，可是我從來沒想過他會贏。

items.en: My grandmother was always telling us stories about her village.
items.zh: 我奶奶總是在跟我們講她村子的故事。

items.en: Our teacher was always saying that reading is important.
items.zh: 我們老師總是在說閱讀很重要。

items.en: My friend was always talking about her trip to Japan.
items.zh: 我朋友總是在說她去日本的旅行。

items.en: He was always complaining about his boss.
items.zh: 他總是在抱怨他的老闆。

items.en: My dad was always singing old songs in the car.
items.zh: 我爸爸總是在車裡唱老歌。

examples.heading: ② It was always + -ing：天氣一直是那樣

items.en: Our holiday in Scotland was not great. Worst of all, in September it was always raining.
items.zh: 我們在蘇格蘭的假期不太好。最糟的是，九月的時候一直在下雨。

items.en: In that town it was always snowing in winter.
items.zh: 那個鎮冬天一直在下雪。

items.en: When we lived by the sea, it was always blowing hard.
items.zh: 我們住在海邊的時候，風一直很大。

items.en: In the mountains it was always getting dark early.
items.zh: 在山上天總是很早就黑了。

items.en: That summer it was always raining at the weekends.
items.zh: 那年夏天每到週末都在下雨。

items.en: In my childhood it was always snowing at Christmas.
items.zh: 我小時候聖誕節總是在下雪。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + was always + -ing：讓人煩的習慣

items.en: My sister was always borrowing my clothes without asking.
items.zh: 我姊姊總是沒問就借我的衣服。

items.en: The neighbours were always playing loud music at night.
items.zh: 鄰居總是在晚上放很大聲的音樂。

items.en: My little brother was always breaking my toys.
items.zh: 我弟弟總是在弄壞我的玩具。

items.en: Our old car was always breaking down on the motorway.
items.zh: 我們的舊車總是在高速公路上拋錨。

items.en: He was always forgetting his homework.
items.zh: 他總是忘了帶功課。

items.en: The cat was always sleeping on my bed.
items.zh: 那隻貓總是睡在我的床上。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + was always + -ing：好的習慣

items.en: My grandfather was always helping people in the village.
items.zh: 我爺爺總是在幫村子裡的人。

items.en: Our teacher was always smiling, even on bad days.
items.zh: 我們老師總是在笑，就算是糟糕的日子也一樣。

items.en: My mum was always baking cakes for our birthdays.
items.zh: 我媽媽總是在我們生日的時候烤蛋糕。

items.en: Our neighbour was always bringing us vegetables from his garden.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居總是帶他花園種的蔬菜給我們。

items.en: They were always inviting us to their parties.
items.zh: 他們總是邀請我們去他們的派對。

items.en: My best friend was always making me laugh.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友總是逗我笑。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + was always + -ing, but + 句子：一直這樣，可是

items.en: He was always promising to visit, but he never came.
items.zh: 他總是說會來看我們，可是他從來沒來。

items.en: She was always saying she would learn to drive, but she never did.
items.zh: 她總是說她會學開車，可是她從來沒學。

items.en: We were always planning a big trip, but we never had the money.
items.zh: 我們總是在計畫一趟大旅行，可是我們從來沒有錢。

items.en: My dad was always saying he would stop smoking, but he didn't.
items.zh: 我爸爸總是說他會戒菸，可是他沒有。

items.en: They were always talking about moving, but they stayed for twenty years.
items.zh: 他們總是在說要搬家，可是他們待了二十年。

items.en: I was always meaning to write to her, but I forgot.
items.zh: 我一直想寫信給她，可是我忘了。

items.en: He was always looking for a better job, but he stayed at the factory.
items.zh: 他一直在找更好的工作，可是他留在那間工廠。

title: I asked her what had happened, and she told me that my grandmother was very ill.
translation: 我問她發生了什麼事，她告訴我，我奶奶病得很重。
name: 過去完成式用於間接引述問句
sentences: My mum was crying in the kitchen. I asked her what had happened, and she told me that my grandmother was very ill.
There was a crash at the corner. The police asked the driver what had happened.
When I saw the broken window, I asked my brother what had happened.
The teacher asked the children what had happened in the playground.
Everyone wanted to know what had happened to the missing money.
I came to work on crutches. My boss asked me what had happened to my leg.
A stranger called me, so I asked him who had given him my phone number.
There were roses on my desk. My colleague asked me who had sent the flowers.
The office was cold in the morning. The manager asked who had left the door open.
The tin was empty. My dad asked who had eaten the last biscuit.
There was a funny picture on the board. The teacher asked who had drawn it.
It was meant to be a secret. I asked my sister who had told her about the party.
He looked for her in every room, so he came to my house to ask me if I had seen her.
I had a bad headache. The doctor asked me if I had taken any medicine.
I wanted to watch TV. My mum asked if I had finished my homework.
We arrived at the hotel at midnight. The receptionist asked if we had booked a room.
The tour guide asked us if we had ever tasted real Greek honey.
A man lost his wallet on the train. The guards asked if anyone had found a black wallet.
I wondered why my neighbour had painted his front door bright pink.
My friend loved my new trainers. He wanted to know where I had bought them.
The gate was still shut. We wondered how the dog had got out.
My aunt didn't see me come in. She wanted to know when I had arrived.
My friend stopped talking to me. I wondered what I had done wrong.
Our neighbours were very curious. They wanted to know how much we had paid for the house.
The meeting was at nine. My boss asked me why I hadn't finished the report.
My sister waited all evening. She asked her boyfriend why he hadn't called her.
Half the class had empty books. The teacher asked us why we hadn't done the homework.
My lunch box was still full. My mum asked why I hadn't eaten my lunch.
The passengers at the stop were angry. They asked why the bus hadn't stopped.
My dad found out about the accident. He asked me why I hadn't told him the truth.
Lucy wasn't at my birthday. I asked her why she hadn't come to the party.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + asked + (人) + what had happened

items.en: My mum was crying in the kitchen. I asked her what had happened, and she told me that my grandmother was very ill.
items.zh: 我媽媽在廚房哭。我問她發生了什麼事，她告訴我奶奶病得很重。

items.en: There was a crash at the corner. The police asked the driver what had happened.
items.zh: 轉角發生了車禍。警察問司機發生了什麼事。

items.en: When I saw the broken window, I asked my brother what had happened.
items.zh: 我看到破掉的窗戶時，問我哥哥發生了什麼事。

items.en: The teacher asked the children what had happened in the playground.
items.zh: 老師問孩子們在操場上發生了什麼事。

items.en: Everyone wanted to know what had happened to the missing money.
items.zh: 每個人都想知道失蹤的錢怎麼了。

items.en: I came to work on crutches. My boss asked me what had happened to my leg.
items.zh: 我拄著拐杖來上班。老闆問我的腳怎麼了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + asked + 人 + who had + 過去分詞

items.en: A stranger called me, so I asked him who had given him my phone number.
items.zh: 一個陌生人打電話給我，所以我問他是誰給他我的電話號碼。

items.en: There were roses on my desk. My colleague asked me who had sent the flowers.
items.zh: 我桌上有玫瑰。我同事問我花是誰送的。

items.en: The office was cold in the morning. The manager asked who had left the door open.
items.zh: 早上辦公室很冷。經理問是誰讓門開著的。

items.en: The tin was empty. My dad asked who had eaten the last biscuit.
items.zh: 罐子空了。我爸爸問是誰吃了最後一塊餅乾。

items.en: There was a funny picture on the board. The teacher asked who had drawn it.
items.zh: 黑板上有一幅好笑的圖。老師問是誰畫的。

items.en: It was meant to be a secret. I asked my sister who had told her about the party.
items.zh: 那本來是個祕密。我問我姊姊是誰告訴她派對的事。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + asked + 人 + if + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: He looked for her in every room, so he came to my house to ask me if I had seen her.
items.zh: 他每個房間都找過了，所以他來我家問我有沒有看到她。

items.en: I had a bad headache. The doctor asked me if I had taken any medicine.
items.zh: 我頭很痛。醫生問我有沒有吃過任何藥。

items.en: I wanted to watch TV. My mum asked if I had finished my homework.
items.zh: 我想看電視。我媽媽問我寫完功課了沒有。

items.en: We arrived at the hotel at midnight. The receptionist asked if we had booked a room.
items.zh: 我們半夜到飯店。櫃台人員問我們有沒有訂房。

items.en: The tour guide asked us if we had ever tasted real Greek honey.
items.zh: 導遊問我們有沒有嚐過真正的希臘蜂蜜。

items.en: A man lost his wallet on the train. The guards asked if anyone had found a black wallet.
items.zh: 一個男人在火車上掉了皮夾。列車員問有沒有人撿到一個黑色的皮夾。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + wanted to know / wondered + 疑問詞 + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: I wondered why my neighbour had painted his front door bright pink.
items.zh: 我想知道我的鄰居為什麼把他的前門漆成亮粉紅色。

items.en: My friend loved my new trainers. He wanted to know where I had bought them.
items.zh: 我朋友很喜歡我的新運動鞋。他想知道我是在哪裡買的。

items.en: The gate was still shut. We wondered how the dog had got out.
items.zh: 大門還是關著的。我們想知道那隻狗是怎麼跑出去的。

items.en: My aunt didn't see me come in. She wanted to know when I had arrived.
items.zh: 我阿姨沒看到我進來。她想知道我什麼時候到的。

items.en: My friend stopped talking to me. I wondered what I had done wrong.
items.zh: 我朋友不跟我說話了。我想知道我做錯了什麼。

items.en: Our neighbours were very curious. They wanted to know how much we had paid for the house.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居很好奇。他們想知道我們買那間房子付了多少錢。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + asked + 人 + why + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞

items.en: The meeting was at nine. My boss asked me why I hadn't finished the report.
items.zh: 會議九點開始。我老闆問我為什麼沒完成報告。

items.en: My sister waited all evening. She asked her boyfriend why he hadn't called her.
items.zh: 我姊姊等了一整個晚上。她問她男朋友為什麼沒打給她。

items.en: Half the class had empty books. The teacher asked us why we hadn't done the homework.
items.zh: 班上一半的人作業本是空的。老師問我們為什麼沒寫功課。

items.en: My lunch box was still full. My mum asked why I hadn't eaten my lunch.
items.zh: 我的便當盒還是滿的。我媽媽問我為什麼沒吃午餐。

items.en: The passengers at the stop were angry. They asked why the bus hadn't stopped.
items.zh: 公車站的乘客很生氣。他們問公車為什麼沒停。

items.en: My dad found out about the accident. He asked me why I hadn't told him the truth.
items.zh: 我爸爸發現了那次意外。他問我為什麼沒告訴他真相。

items.en: Lucy wasn't at my birthday. I asked her why she hadn't come to the party.
items.zh: 露西沒來我的生日。我問她為什麼沒來派對。

title: The announcer said that the police had arrested a man who had stolen five paintings.
translation: 播報員說，警方逮捕了一名男子，他偷了五幅昂貴的畫。
name: 過去完成式用於間接引述陳述句
sentences: One morning I was listening to the radio, when the announcer said that the police had arrested a man who had stolen five paintings.
The newspaper said that a storm had destroyed the old pier.
We landed twenty minutes early. The pilot said that a strong wind had helped us.
The weatherman said that it had been the hottest day of the year.
The report said that prices had gone up by ten per cent.
The head teacher said that our school had won the national prize.
She was so upset that when she tried to explain what had happened, she couldn't.
I looked at the address and I knew what had happened to my sister's postcard.
Nobody could explain what had happened to the missing dog.
He didn't understand what had happened until he read the letter.
The children told their parents what had happened at school.
Finally, the police found out what had happened that night.
My sister told me that she had passed her driving test.
The doctor told us that the operation had gone well.
My new classmate speaks Japanese. He told me that he had lived in Japan as a child.
The waiter told us that they had run out of fish.
My friend told me that she had found a new job.
The teacher told the class that someone had taken her pen.
Tom came to class at ten. He explained that he had missed the bus.
My daughter looked at the floor. She admitted that she had broken the vase.
The manager explained that the delivery had been delayed.
My brother admitted that he had borrowed my bike.
The hotel explained that they had given our room to someone else.
My friend talked about the novel for an hour. Then he admitted that he had never read the book.
My uncle said he hadn't been on a train since he was a boy.
The shop said they hadn't received my order.
My dad looked terrible after the night shift. He said he hadn't slept for two days.
My mum said she hadn't heard from my aunt for weeks.
The students said they hadn't understood the question.
The driver said he hadn't seen the red light.
Our neighbour said she hadn't heard anything in the night.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + said + that + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞：轉述新聞

items.en: One morning I was listening to the radio, when the announcer said that the police had arrested a man who had stolen five paintings.
items.zh: 有一天早上我在聽收音機，播報員說警察逮捕了一個偷了五幅畫的男人。

items.en: The newspaper said that a storm had destroyed the old pier.
items.zh: 報紙說一場暴風雨摧毀了那座老碼頭。

items.en: We landed twenty minutes early. The pilot said that a strong wind had helped us.
items.zh: 我們提早二十分鐘降落。機長說一陣強風幫了我們。

items.en: The weatherman said that it had been the hottest day of the year.
items.zh: 氣象播報員說那是一年中最熱的一天。

items.en: The report said that prices had gone up by ten per cent.
items.zh: 報告說物價上漲了百分之十。

items.en: The head teacher said that our school had won the national prize.
items.zh: 校長說我們學校贏得了全國獎。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + tried to explain / didn't know + what had happened

items.en: She was so upset that when she tried to explain what had happened, she couldn't.
items.zh: 她太難過了，所以她試著解釋發生了什麼事的時候，說不出來。

items.en: I looked at the address and I knew what had happened to my sister's postcard.
items.zh: 我看了地址，就知道我姊姊的明信片怎麼了。

items.en: Nobody could explain what had happened to the missing dog.
items.zh: 沒有人能解釋那隻走失的狗怎麼了。

items.en: He didn't understand what had happened until he read the letter.
items.zh: 他讀了那封信才明白發生了什麼事。

items.en: The children told their parents what had happened at school.
items.zh: 孩子們告訴他們爸媽在學校發生了什麼事。

items.en: Finally, the police found out what had happened that night.
items.zh: 最後，警察查出了那天晚上發生了什麼事。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + told + 人 + that + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: My sister told me that she had passed her driving test.
items.zh: 我姊姊告訴我她通過了駕照考試。

items.en: The doctor told us that the operation had gone well.
items.zh: 醫生告訴我們手術很順利。

items.en: My new classmate speaks Japanese. He told me that he had lived in Japan as a child.
items.zh: 我的新同學會說日文。他告訴我他小時候住過日本。

items.en: The waiter told us that they had run out of fish.
items.zh: 服務生告訴我們魚已經賣完了。

items.en: My friend told me that she had found a new job.
items.zh: 我朋友告訴我她找到了一份新工作。

items.en: The teacher told the class that someone had taken her pen.
items.zh: 老師告訴全班有人拿走了她的筆。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + explained / admitted + that + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: Tom came to class at ten. He explained that he had missed the bus.
items.zh: 湯姆十點才來上課。他解釋說他錯過了公車。

items.en: My daughter looked at the floor. She admitted that she had broken the vase.
items.zh: 我女兒低頭看著地板。她承認是她打破了花瓶。

items.en: The manager explained that the delivery had been delayed.
items.zh: 經理解釋說送貨延誤了。

items.en: My brother admitted that he had borrowed my bike.
items.zh: 我哥哥承認他借了我的腳踏車。

items.en: The hotel explained that they had given our room to someone else.
items.zh: 飯店解釋說他們把我們的房間給了別人。

items.en: My friend talked about the novel for an hour. Then he admitted that he had never read the book.
items.zh: 我朋友聊那本小說聊了一個小時。後來他承認他從來沒讀過那本書。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + said + 主詞 + hadn't + 過去分詞

items.en: My uncle said he hadn't been on a train since he was a boy.
items.zh: 我叔叔說他從小時候就沒坐過火車了。

items.en: The shop said they hadn't received my order.
items.zh: 那家店說他們沒收到我的訂單。

items.en: My dad looked terrible after the night shift. He said he hadn't slept for two days.
items.zh: 我爸爸值完夜班看起來很糟。他說他兩天沒睡了。

items.en: My mum said she hadn't heard from my aunt for weeks.
items.zh: 我媽媽說她好幾個星期沒有我阿姨的消息了。

items.en: The students said they hadn't understood the question.
items.zh: 學生們說他們沒聽懂那個問題。

items.en: The driver said he hadn't seen the red light.
items.zh: 司機說他沒看到紅燈。

items.en: Our neighbour said she hadn't heard anything in the night.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居說她夜裡什麼都沒聽到。

title: It had been snowing for a long time, and so I was unable to go out for a walk.
translation: 雪已經下了很久，所以我沒辦法出去散步。
name: 過去完成進行式表示對過去某時的影響
sentences: When I woke up in the cabin, it had been snowing for a long time, and so I was unable to go out for a walk.
It had been raining all night, so the football pitch was too wet to play on.
The wind had been blowing for days, so the ferry stayed in the harbour.
It had been freezing all week, so the lake was covered in ice.
The sun had been shining all day, so the sand was very hot.
It had been snowing since morning, so the schools closed early.
We had been working very hard all morning, so by lunchtime I was very tired.
She had been dancing all night, so her feet were sore.
They had been walking in the hills all day, so they were hungry.
I had been studying all weekend, so my head was spinning.
He had been gardening all afternoon, so his hands were dirty.
The children had been playing outside all day, so they were covered in mud.
My sister's face was pink and her hair was wet. She had been swimming in the lake.
The kitchen was full of smoke. Someone had been cooking.
My brother's shirt was soaked with sweat. He had been playing tennis in the heat.
There were puddles all over the car park. It had been pouring all morning.
The room smelt of paint. They had been decorating.
Her clothes were covered in flour. She had been baking.
The roads were dangerous because it had been snowing all night.
I failed the test because I hadn't been revising.
He had a sore throat because he had been shouting at the match.
The baby was hungry because she had been sleeping for hours.
My back hurt because I had been carrying heavy boxes.
The car was hot because it had been standing in the sun.
By the evening, we had been travelling for twelve hours, so we went straight to bed.
By the end of the match, the players had been running for ninety minutes, so they were exhausted.
By Friday, I had been working late every night, so I slept all weekend.
By midnight, the guests had been eating and drinking for hours, so the party was very loud.
By the summer, he had been saving for a year, so he could buy the bike.
By ten o'clock, it had been raining for six hours, so the river was very high.
By the time the exam came, she had been practising for months, so she felt calm.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + had been + -ing, so + 主詞 + 過去式：天氣的結果

items.en: When I woke up in the cabin, it had been snowing for a long time, and so I was unable to go out for a walk.
items.zh: 我在小屋醒來的時候，雪已經下了很久，所以我沒辦法出去散步。

items.en: It had been raining all night, so the football pitch was too wet to play on.
items.zh: 下了一整晚的雨，所以足球場太濕了，不能踢球。

items.en: The wind had been blowing for days, so the ferry stayed in the harbour.
items.zh: 風颳了好幾天，所以渡輪一直停在港口。

items.en: It had been freezing all week, so the lake was covered in ice.
items.zh: 冷了一整個星期，所以湖面都結冰了。

items.en: The sun had been shining all day, so the sand was very hot.
items.zh: 太陽照了一整天，所以沙子很燙。

items.en: It had been snowing since morning, so the schools closed early.
items.zh: 從早上就一直下雪，所以學校提早放學了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + had been + -ing + all + 時間, so + 主詞 + was + 形容詞

items.en: We had been working very hard all morning, so by lunchtime I was very tired.
items.zh: 我們一整個早上都工作得很辛苦，所以到午餐時我很累。

items.en: She had been dancing all night, so her feet were sore.
items.zh: 她跳了一整晚的舞，所以她的腳很痛。

items.en: They had been walking in the hills all day, so they were hungry.
items.zh: 他們在山丘上走了一整天，所以很餓。

items.en: I had been studying all weekend, so my head was spinning.
items.zh: 我讀了一整個週末的書，所以頭昏腦脹。

items.en: He had been gardening all afternoon, so his hands were dirty.
items.zh: 他整個下午都在整理花園，所以他的手很髒。

items.en: The children had been playing outside all day, so they were covered in mud.
items.zh: 孩子們在外面玩了一整天，所以全身都是泥巴。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 過去式. + 主詞 + had been + -ing：看到結果，推出原因

items.en: My sister's face was pink and her hair was wet. She had been swimming in the lake.
items.zh: 我妹妹的臉紅紅的，頭髮是濕的。她剛剛一直在湖裡游泳。

items.en: The kitchen was full of smoke. Someone had been cooking.
items.zh: 廚房裡都是煙。剛剛有人在煮東西。

items.en: My brother's shirt was soaked with sweat. He had been playing tennis in the heat.
items.zh: 我哥哥的襯衫被汗濕透了。他剛剛一直在大熱天打網球。

items.en: There were puddles all over the car park. It had been pouring all morning.
items.zh: 停車場到處都是水坑。整個早上一直在下大雨。

items.en: The room smelt of paint. They had been decorating.
items.zh: 房間裡有油漆味。他們剛剛一直在裝修。

items.en: Her clothes were covered in flour. She had been baking.
items.zh: 她的衣服沾滿了麵粉。她剛剛一直在烤東西。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + 過去式 + because + 主詞 + had been + -ing

items.en: The roads were dangerous because it had been snowing all night.
items.zh: 路很危險，因為下了一整晚的雪。

items.en: I failed the test because I hadn't been revising.
items.zh: 我考試沒過，因為我一直沒複習。

items.en: He had a sore throat because he had been shouting at the match.
items.zh: 他喉嚨痛，因為他在比賽時一直在大喊。

items.en: The baby was hungry because she had been sleeping for hours.
items.zh: 寶寶很餓，因為她睡了好幾個小時。

items.en: My back hurt because I had been carrying heavy boxes.
items.zh: 我的背很痛，因為我一直在搬很重的箱子。

items.en: The car was hot because it had been standing in the sun.
items.zh: 車子很熱，因為它一直停在太陽下。

examples.heading: ⑤ By + 時間, + 主詞 + had been + -ing, so + 主詞 + 過去式

items.en: By the evening, we had been travelling for twelve hours, so we went straight to bed.
items.zh: 到了傍晚，我們已經旅行了十二個小時，所以直接上床睡覺了。

items.en: By the end of the match, the players had been running for ninety minutes, so they were exhausted.
items.zh: 到比賽結束的時候，球員們已經跑了九十分鐘，所以累壞了。

items.en: By Friday, I had been working late every night, so I slept all weekend.
items.zh: 到星期五的時候，我每天晚上都加班，所以整個週末都在睡覺。

items.en: By midnight, the guests had been eating and drinking for hours, so the party was very loud.
items.zh: 到半夜的時候，客人們已經吃喝了好幾個小時，所以派對很吵。

items.en: By the summer, he had been saving for a year, so he could buy the bike.
items.zh: 到夏天的時候，他已經存了一年的錢，所以他買得起那台腳踏車。

items.en: By ten o'clock, it had been raining for six hours, so the river was very high.
items.zh: 到十點的時候，已經下了六個小時的雨，所以河水很高。

items.en: By the time the exam came, she had been practising for months, so she felt calm.
items.zh: 到考試的時候，她已經練習了好幾個月，所以她覺得很冷靜。

title: Susan has been working in our company for six years as a sales representative.
translation: Susan 在我們公司當業務代表已經六年了。
name: 現在完成進行式表示單一持續的活動
sentences: I'm in my last year at Leeds University. I've been studying international business there for four years.
Where is it? We've been waiting for the bus for half an hour.
The road is still closed. They've been building that bridge for three years.
Where were you? I've been trying to call you for an hour.
Everyone in town knows them. My parents have been running the shop for over twenty years.
You've been sitting at that computer for hours. Take a break.
Anna knows all the customers. She has been working at the bank for ten years as a cashier.
The river is very high. It's been raining for three days.
My brother is getting worried. He has been looking for a job for months.
I think she's hungry. The baby has been crying for twenty minutes.
Jake knows all the songs. He has been playing in the band for a long time.
Everyone in the village trusts her. Dr Lee has been treating patients at this clinic for fifteen years.
I know this street well. I've been living here since last spring.
Ask Mrs Chen about the school. She has been teaching there since 2018.
Tom and I are very happy. We've been going out together since the summer.
Can you call the repair man? The printer has been making a strange noise since Monday.
I need to lie down. I've been feeling sick since breakfast.
My dad never buys new things. He's been using the same phone since 2015.
My sister loves big cities. She has been living in Tokyo since she finished university.
I want to buy a flat next year. I've been saving money since I started my first job.
The kids are so noisy. They've been arguing since they got in the car.
Look at all these pictures. My grandfather has been painting since he retired.
My brother never calls us. We've been worrying about him since he moved abroad.
Your Japanese is excellent. How long have you been studying it?
Your sister looks very tired. How long has she been working as a nurse?
The waiting room is very full. How long have you been waiting for the doctor?
I've never met the new neighbours. How long have they been living next door?
Sorry I'm late. Have you been waiting long?
I've been reading a great book about the history of tea.
She's been preparing for her exams, so she hasn't had much free time.
Our flat is too small for us. We've been thinking of moving to the countryside.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + have been + 動詞-ing + for ...

items.en: I'm in my last year at Leeds University. I've been studying international business there for four years.
items.zh: 我在里茲大學念最後一年。我在那裡念國際企業念了四年。

items.en: Where is it? We've been waiting for the bus for half an hour.
items.zh: 公車在哪裡？我們等公車等了半個小時。

items.en: The road is still closed. They've been building that bridge for three years.
items.zh: 那條路還是封著。那座橋他們蓋了三年。

items.en: Where were you? I've been trying to call you for an hour.
items.zh: 你去哪裡了？我打電話給你打了一個小時了。

items.en: Everyone in town knows them. My parents have been running the shop for over twenty years.
items.zh: 鎮上每個人都認識他們。我爸媽開這家店開了二十多年。

items.en: You've been sitting at that computer for hours. Take a break.
items.zh: 你在電腦前面坐了好幾個小時了，休息一下吧。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + has been + 動詞-ing + for ...

items.en: Anna knows all the customers. She has been working at the bank for ten years as a cashier.
items.zh: 安娜認識所有的客人。她在那家銀行當出納十年了。

items.en: The river is very high. It's been raining for three days.
items.zh: 河水漲得很高。雨已經下了三天了。

items.en: My brother is getting worried. He has been looking for a job for months.
items.zh: 我哥開始擔心了。他找工作找了好幾個月了。

items.en: I think she's hungry. The baby has been crying for twenty minutes.
items.zh: 我想她餓了。寶寶哭了二十分鐘了。

items.en: Jake knows all the songs. He has been playing in the band for a long time.
items.zh: 傑克每首歌都會。他在那個樂團演奏很久了。

items.en: Everyone in the village trusts her. Dr Lee has been treating patients at this clinic for fifteen years.
items.zh: 村裡每個人都信任她。李醫師在這家診所看診十五年了。

examples.heading: ③ since + 起點

items.en: I know this street well. I've been living here since last spring.
items.zh: 我很熟這條街。我從去年春天開始就住在這裡。

items.en: Ask Mrs Chen about the school. She has been teaching there since 2018.
items.zh: 學校的事去問陳老師。她從 2018 年就在那所學校教書。

items.en: Tom and I are very happy. We've been going out together since the summer.
items.zh: 我和湯姆很幸福。我們從夏天開始交往。

items.en: Can you call the repair man? The printer has been making a strange noise since Monday.
items.zh: 你可以打給修理人員嗎？印表機從星期一開始就一直發出怪聲。

items.en: I need to lie down. I've been feeling sick since breakfast.
items.zh: 我得躺一下。我從吃完早餐就一直覺得不舒服。

items.en: My dad never buys new things. He's been using the same phone since 2015.
items.zh: 我爸從來不買新東西。他從 2015 年就一直用同一支手機。

examples.heading: ④ since + 子句

items.en: My sister loves big cities. She has been living in Tokyo since she finished university.
items.zh: 我姊姊很愛大城市。她大學畢業以後就一直住在東京。

items.en: I want to buy a flat next year. I've been saving money since I started my first job.
items.zh: 我明年想買一間公寓。我從第一份工作開始就一直在存錢。

items.en: The kids are so noisy. They've been arguing since they got in the car.
items.zh: 孩子們好吵。他們從上車就一直在吵架。

items.en: Look at all these pictures. My grandfather has been painting since he retired.
items.zh: 你看這些畫。我爺爺退休以後就一直在畫畫。

items.en: My brother never calls us. We've been worrying about him since he moved abroad.
items.zh: 我哥從不打電話給我們。他搬到國外以後，我們就一直擔心他。

examples.heading: ⑤ How long 問句

items.en: Your Japanese is excellent. How long have you been studying it?
items.zh: 你的日文很好。你學日文多久了？

items.en: Your sister looks very tired. How long has she been working as a nurse?
items.zh: 你姊姊看起來好累。她當護理師多久了？

items.en: The waiting room is very full. How long have you been waiting for the doctor?
items.zh: 候診室好多人。你等醫生等多久了？

items.en: I've never met the new neighbours. How long have they been living next door?
items.zh: 我從來沒見過新鄰居。他們住在隔壁多久了？

examples.heading: ⑥ 沒有 for 或 since，從上下文看出活動還在繼續

items.en: Sorry I'm late. Have you been waiting long?
items.zh: 抱歉我遲到了，你等很久了嗎？

items.en: I've been reading a great book about the history of tea.
items.zh: 我最近在看一本講茶葉歷史的好書。

items.en: She's been preparing for her exams, so she hasn't had much free time.
items.zh: 她在準備考試，所以沒什麼空。

items.en: Our flat is too small for us. We've been thinking of moving to the countryside.
items.zh: 我們的公寓對我們來說太小了。我們一直在考慮搬到鄉下。

title: Actually, I'd arranged an appointment with my doctor before calling you.
translation: 打電話給你之前，我已經跟醫生約好看診時間了。
name: 過去完成式表示更早的過去
sentences: I'm so sorry about Friday. Actually, I'd arranged an appointment with my doctor before calling you.
She'd checked the weather before leaving the house.
We'd packed everything before going to bed.
He'd read the whole book before seeing the film.
I'd saved enough money before booking the flight.
They'd cleaned the house before inviting the guests.
He shouted at his best friend and walked away. He then thought how stupid he had been.
She realised what a mistake she had made.
I remembered how happy we had been in that little flat.
He suddenly understood what his father had meant.
They saw how much the town had changed.
I wondered why she had left so early.
When I got to the airport, I realised that I had left my passport at home.
She found out that her brother had borrowed her car.
We heard that the old cinema had closed.
He noticed that someone had opened his letters.
I discovered that I had paid twice for the same thing.
They learned that the train had been cancelled.
Before I moved to London, I had never lived in a big city.
Before the guests arrived, we had set the table.
Before she became a doctor, she had studied for seven years.
Before the storm came, the farmers had brought in the sheep.
Before he left, he had said goodbye to everyone.
Before the exam started, I had read my notes twice.
I wore the dress my grandmother had made for me.
She showed me the photos she had taken in Italy.
We ate the cake my sister had baked that morning.
He finally found the keys he had lost the week before.
I read the letter my friend had sent from Canada.
They returned the books they had borrowed from the library.
She sold the bike she had bought only a year before.

examples.heading: ① 主詞 + 'd + 過去分詞 + before + -ing

items.en: I'm so sorry about Friday. Actually, I'd arranged an appointment with my doctor before calling you.
items.zh: 星期五的事真的很抱歉。其實我在打電話給你之前，就已經跟醫生約好了。

items.en: She'd checked the weather before leaving the house.
items.zh: 她出門之前已經看過天氣了。

items.en: We'd packed everything before going to bed.
items.zh: 我們睡覺之前已經把東西都收好了。

items.en: He'd read the whole book before seeing the film.
items.zh: 他看電影之前已經讀完整本書了。

items.en: I'd saved enough money before booking the flight.
items.zh: 我訂機票之前已經存夠了錢。

items.en: They'd cleaned the house before inviting the guests.
items.zh: 他們邀請客人之前已經打掃好房子了。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + thought / realised + how / what + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: He shouted at his best friend and walked away. He then thought how stupid he had been.
items.zh: 他對他最好的朋友大吼，然後走開了。他接著想到自己剛才多麼愚蠢。

items.en: She realised what a mistake she had made.
items.zh: 她發現自己犯了多大的錯。

items.en: I remembered how happy we had been in that little flat.
items.zh: 我想起我們在那間小公寓裡曾經多麼快樂。

items.en: He suddenly understood what his father had meant.
items.zh: 他突然明白他爸爸當時的意思。

items.en: They saw how much the town had changed.
items.zh: 他們看到這個鎮改變了多少。

items.en: I wondered why she had left so early.
items.zh: 我想知道她為什麼那麼早走。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + 過去式 + that + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞：發現之前的事

items.en: When I got to the airport, I realised that I had left my passport at home.
items.zh: 我到機場的時候，發現我把護照留在家裡了。

items.en: She found out that her brother had borrowed her car.
items.zh: 她發現她哥哥借走了她的車。

items.en: We heard that the old cinema had closed.
items.zh: 我們聽說那家老電影院關了。

items.en: He noticed that someone had opened his letters.
items.zh: 他注意到有人拆了他的信。

items.en: I discovered that I had paid twice for the same thing.
items.zh: 我發現同一樣東西我付了兩次錢。

items.en: They learned that the train had been cancelled.
items.zh: 他們得知火車取消了。（被動）

examples.heading: ④ Before + 主詞 + 過去式, + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

items.en: Before I moved to London, I had never lived in a big city.
items.zh: 我搬到倫敦之前，從來沒住過大城市。

items.en: Before the guests arrived, we had set the table.
items.zh: 客人到之前，我們已經擺好了餐具。

items.en: Before she became a doctor, she had studied for seven years.
items.zh: 她當醫生之前讀了七年書。

items.en: Before the storm came, the farmers had brought in the sheep.
items.zh: 暴風雨來之前，農夫們已經把羊趕回來了。

items.en: Before he left, he had said goodbye to everyone.
items.zh: 他離開之前已經跟每個人道別了。

items.en: Before the exam started, I had read my notes twice.
items.zh: 考試開始之前，我已經把筆記讀了兩遍。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + 過去式 + 名詞 + 主詞 + had + 過去分詞：說之前的東西

items.en: I wore the dress my grandmother had made for me.
items.zh: 我穿了我奶奶為我做的那件洋裝。

items.en: She showed me the photos she had taken in Italy.
items.zh: 她給我看她在義大利拍的照片。

items.en: We ate the cake my sister had baked that morning.
items.zh: 我們吃了我姊姊那天早上烤的蛋糕。

items.en: He finally found the keys he had lost the week before.
items.zh: 他終於找到了他前一個星期弄丟的鑰匙。

items.en: I read the letter my friend had sent from Canada.
items.zh: 我讀了我朋友從加拿大寄來的信。

items.en: They returned the books they had borrowed from the library.
items.zh: 他們把從圖書館借的書還回去了。

items.en: She sold the bike she had bought only a year before.
items.zh: 她賣掉了她一年前才買的腳踏車。

title: I was constantly trying to balance my school life and was always running out of time.
translation: 他們聽說我老是在惹麻煩。
name: 過去進行式加 always 表示不想要的重複事件
sentences: In my last year at school, I was constantly trying to balance my studies and my job, and I was always running out of time.
I was constantly losing my keys when I lived in that flat.
I was always feeling tired during the winter months.
I was constantly worrying about money when I was a student.
I was always missing the bus in the mornings.
I was constantly forgetting people's names at my new job.
My parents were told that I was always getting into mischief, so they bought me a diary to calm me down.
My little brother was always getting into fights at school.
As a child, I was always getting into trouble with my teachers.
Our dog was always getting into the neighbours' garden.
He was always getting into arguments with his boss.
The kids were always getting into the biscuit tin.
Our old car was constantly breaking down on the way to work.
The computer at the office was constantly crashing.
The roof was constantly leaking when it rained.
The washing machine was always flooding the kitchen.
The heating was constantly switching off in the night.
The trains were always running late that winter.
My roommate was always leaving dirty dishes in the sink.
The man next door was constantly playing the drums.
My sister was always reading my diary.
The students were constantly talking in the back row.
He was always taking my pens without asking.
Our boss was constantly changing his mind.
I was always arriving late, so my teacher moved me to the front.
He was constantly spending money, so he never had any savings.
She was always forgetting her lunch, so her mum brought it to school.
They were constantly arguing, so they decided to live apart.
I was always eating junk food, so I put on weight.
The baby was constantly waking up, so we never slept well.
He was always making excuses, so nobody believed him any more.

examples.heading: ① I was constantly / always + -ing：自己控制不了的事

items.en: In my last year at school, I was constantly trying to balance my studies and my job, and I was always running out of time.
items.zh: 高中最後一年，我一直在努力平衡學業和打工，而且總是時間不夠。

items.en: I was constantly losing my keys when I lived in that flat.
items.zh: 我住在那間公寓的時候，一直在弄丟鑰匙。

items.en: I was always feeling tired during the winter months.
items.zh: 冬天的那幾個月我總是覺得很累。

items.en: I was constantly worrying about money when I was a student.
items.zh: 我當學生的時候一直在擔心錢的事。

items.en: I was always missing the bus in the mornings.
items.zh: 我早上總是錯過公車。

items.en: I was constantly forgetting people's names at my new job.
items.zh: 我在新工作一直忘記別人的名字。

examples.heading: ② 主詞 + was always getting into + 名詞：一再惹麻煩

items.en: My parents were told that I was always getting into mischief, so they bought me a diary to calm me down.
items.zh: 我爸媽聽說我總是在惹麻煩，所以他們買了一本日記給我，讓我冷靜一點。

items.en: My little brother was always getting into fights at school.
items.zh: 我弟弟在學校總是在打架。

items.en: As a child, I was always getting into trouble with my teachers.
items.zh: 我小時候總是惹老師生氣。

items.en: Our dog was always getting into the neighbours' garden.
items.zh: 我們的狗總是跑進鄰居的花園。

items.en: He was always getting into arguments with his boss.
items.zh: 他總是跟他的老闆吵架。

items.en: The kids were always getting into the biscuit tin.
items.zh: 孩子們總是偷吃餅乾罐裡的餅乾。

examples.heading: ③ 名詞 + was constantly + -ing：東西一再出問題

items.en: Our old car was constantly breaking down on the way to work.
items.zh: 我們的舊車在上班的路上一再拋錨。

items.en: The computer at the office was constantly crashing.
items.zh: 辦公室的電腦一再當機。

items.en: The roof was constantly leaking when it rained.
items.zh: 下雨的時候屋頂一再漏水。

items.en: The washing machine was always flooding the kitchen.
items.zh: 洗衣機總是把廚房弄得都是水。

items.en: The heating was constantly switching off in the night.
items.zh: 暖氣半夜一再自己關掉。

items.en: The trains were always running late that winter.
items.zh: 那年冬天火車總是誤點。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞 + was / were + always + -ing：別人讓人煩的習慣

items.en: My roommate was always leaving dirty dishes in the sink.
items.zh: 我的室友總是把髒碗盤留在水槽裡。

items.en: The man next door was constantly playing the drums.
items.zh: 隔壁的男人一直在打鼓。

items.en: My sister was always reading my diary.
items.zh: 我姊姊總是偷看我的日記。

items.en: The students were constantly talking in the back row.
items.zh: 學生們一直在最後一排說話。

items.en: He was always taking my pens without asking.
items.zh: 他總是沒問就拿我的筆。

items.en: Our boss was constantly changing his mind.
items.zh: 我們老闆一直在改變主意。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞 + was always + -ing, so + 句子：結果

items.en: I was always arriving late, so my teacher moved me to the front.
items.zh: 我總是遲到，所以老師把我換到前面。

items.en: He was constantly spending money, so he never had any savings.
items.zh: 他一直在花錢，所以他從來沒有存款。

items.en: She was always forgetting her lunch, so her mum brought it to school.
items.zh: 她總是忘了帶午餐，所以她媽媽把午餐送到學校。

items.en: They were constantly arguing, so they decided to live apart.
items.zh: 他們一直在吵架，所以決定分開住。

items.en: I was always eating junk food, so I put on weight.
items.zh: 我總是吃垃圾食物，所以變胖了。

items.en: The baby was constantly waking up, so we never slept well.
items.zh: 寶寶一直醒來，所以我們從來沒睡好。

items.en: He was always making excuses, so nobody believed him any more.
items.zh: 他總是在找藉口，所以再也沒有人相信他。

title: I've had a really nice week.
translation: 我這個禮拜過得很不錯。
name: 現在完成式表示未結束的時段
sentences: I've worked late every night since Monday. It's been a long week.
Good news from the sales team. We've sold more cars this month than last month.
I joined a book club in January. I've read four books this year.
The manager is angry with Tom. He's been late three times this week.
We're top of the league. The team has played really well this season.
A coffee costs four pounds now. Prices have gone up a lot this year.
I've had a lot of night shifts. I've hardly seen my kids this week.
My watch counts my steps. I've walked ten thousand steps today.
You look pale. Have you eaten anything today?
My mum is worried about the party. She's called me five times today.
I'm going to have a cold shower. It's been really hot today.
I've been in meetings since nine. I haven't checked my email today.
The café was full at lunch. We've had a lot of customers today.
We're halfway through our trip to Spain. The holiday has been wonderful so far.
The school is collecting money for a new library. We've raised two hundred pounds so far.
We're going to visit him on Sunday. My grandfather hasn't been very well recently.
I want to go to the cinema tonight. Have you seen any good films recently?
Our busy season ended in March. Things have been quiet at work recently.
Thank you for the wonderful dinner. This evening has been lovely.
Thanks for answering all my questions about the flat. You've been very helpful.
We're packing up the tent on Sunday afternoon. It's been a sunny, warm weekend.
Welcome home. The children have been so good, and they're asleep now.
It's only eleven o'clock, and I've had three meetings this morning.
It's four in the afternoon now. I missed the bus this morning, so I was late for work.
It's only July, and we've had a lot of rain this summer.
We had to buy new plants in the spring. Our garden flooded twice last winter.
She's at the doctor's again. My sister has been ill a lot this year.
He's healthy now. My uncle was in hospital for a month last year.
We have to start the report again. My boss has changed the plan three times today.
The storms keep cutting the lines. We've had four power cuts this month.
I need to check my work more carefully. I've made the same mistake twice this week.

examples.heading: ① this week / this month / this year

items.en: I've worked late every night since Monday. It's been a long week.
items.zh: 我從星期一起每天晚上都加班。這個禮拜好漫長。

items.en: Good news from the sales team. We've sold more cars this month than last month.
items.zh: 業務部有好消息。我們這個月賣的車比上個月多。

items.en: I joined a book club in January. I've read four books this year.
items.zh: 我一月參加了讀書會。我今年讀了四本書。

items.en: The manager is angry with Tom. He's been late three times this week.
items.zh: 經理在生湯姆的氣。他這個禮拜已經遲到三次了。

items.en: We're top of the league. The team has played really well this season.
items.zh: 我們在聯賽排第一。球隊這一季打得很好。

items.en: A coffee costs four pounds now. Prices have gone up a lot this year.
items.zh: 現在一杯咖啡要四英鎊。今年物價漲了很多。

items.en: I've had a lot of night shifts. I've hardly seen my kids this week.
items.zh: 我上了很多夜班。我這個禮拜幾乎沒見到孩子。

examples.heading: ② today

items.en: My watch counts my steps. I've walked ten thousand steps today.
items.zh: 我的手錶會算步數。我今天走了一萬步。

items.en: You look pale. Have you eaten anything today?
items.zh: 你臉色很蒼白。你今天有吃東西嗎？

items.en: My mum is worried about the party. She's called me five times today.
items.zh: 我媽媽在擔心派對的事。她今天打了五次電話給我。

items.en: I'm going to have a cold shower. It's been really hot today.
items.zh: 我要去沖個冷水澡。今天好熱。

items.en: I've been in meetings since nine. I haven't checked my email today.
items.zh: 我從九點就一直在開會。我今天還沒看電子郵件。

items.en: The café was full at lunch. We've had a lot of customers today.
items.zh: 咖啡店中午客滿。我們今天客人很多。

examples.heading: ③ so far / recently

items.en: We're halfway through our trip to Spain. The holiday has been wonderful so far.
items.zh: 我們的西班牙之旅過了一半。到目前為止，這趟假期很棒。

items.en: The school is collecting money for a new library. We've raised two hundred pounds so far.
items.zh: 學校在為新圖書館募款。到目前為止，我們募到兩百英鎊。

items.en: We're going to visit him on Sunday. My grandfather hasn't been very well recently.
items.zh: 我們星期天要去看他。我爺爺最近身體不太好。

items.en: I want to go to the cinema tonight. Have you seen any good films recently?
items.zh: 我今晚想去看電影。你最近有看什麼好電影嗎？

items.en: Our busy season ended in March. Things have been quiet at work recently.
items.zh: 我們的旺季三月就結束了。最近工作上很清閒。

examples.heading: ④ 不說出時間：從情境知道

items.en: Thank you for the wonderful dinner. This evening has been lovely.
items.zh: 謝謝你這頓很棒的晚餐。今晚很愉快。

items.en: Thanks for answering all my questions about the flat. You've been very helpful.
items.zh: 謝謝你回答我關於公寓的所有問題。你幫了很大的忙。

items.en: We're packing up the tent on Sunday afternoon. It's been a sunny, warm weekend.
items.zh: 我們星期天下午在收帳篷。這個週末又晴朗又溫暖。

items.en: Welcome home. The children have been so good, and they're asleep now.
items.zh: 歡迎回家。孩子們一直都很乖，現在已經睡了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 還沒結束和已經結束

items.en: It's only eleven o'clock, and I've had three meetings this morning.
items.zh: 現在才十一點，我今天早上已經開了三個會。

items.en: It's four in the afternoon now. I missed the bus this morning, so I was late for work.
items.zh: 現在是下午四點。我今天早上沒趕上公車，所以上班遲到了。

items.en: It's only July, and we've had a lot of rain this summer.
items.zh: 現在才七月，今年夏天雨已經下得很多了。

items.en: We had to buy new plants in the spring. Our garden flooded twice last winter.
items.zh: 我們春天得買新的植物。我們的花園去年冬天淹了兩次水。

items.en: She's at the doctor's again. My sister has been ill a lot this year.
items.zh: 她又去看醫生了。我妹妹今年常常生病。

items.en: He's healthy now. My uncle was in hospital for a month last year.
items.zh: 他現在很健康。我叔叔去年住院住了一個月。

examples.heading: ⑥ 這段時間裡發生了很多次

items.en: We have to start the report again. My boss has changed the plan three times today.
items.zh: 我們得重寫報告。我老闆今天把計畫改了三次。

items.en: The storms keep cutting the lines. We've had four power cuts this month.
items.zh: 暴風雨一直弄斷電線。我們這個月停了四次電。

items.en: I need to check my work more carefully. I've made the same mistake twice this week.
items.zh: 我得更仔細檢查我的工作。這個禮拜我同一個錯犯了兩次。

title: That is the best game I've ever played.
translation: 那是我玩過最棒的一場比賽。
name: 現在完成式加最高級形容詞
sentences: Look at the white sand and the clear water. This is the most beautiful beach I've ever seen.
The fish was cold and the rice was hard. That was the worst meal I've ever eaten.
I laughed all the way through it. It's the funniest book I've ever read.
Your new neighbour brought us soup when we were ill. She's the kindest person I've ever met.
I only answered half of the questions. That was the hardest exam I've ever taken.
I slept for ten hours at this hotel. This is the most comfortable bed I've ever slept in.
I dreamed that my cat could drive a bus. That's the strangest dream I've ever had.
Look at the photo from my dad's trip. It's the biggest fish he's ever caught.
My mum walked thirty kilometres for charity. It was the longest walk she has ever done.
My brother paid two thousand pounds for that camera. This is the most expensive thing he's ever bought.
My son hasn't put down the new bike all day. That's the best present he has ever had.
The lake froze for three months. It's the coldest winter my grandmother has ever known.
We're on the eightieth floor now. Is this the tallest building you've ever been in?
We asked the chef for the recipe. That was the most delicious soup we've ever tasted.
The two teams scored six goals each. It's the most exciting match they've ever played.
We're choosing a film for Halloween. What's the scariest film you've ever watched?
We sold three hundred cakes on Saturday. That was the busiest day we've ever had in the shop.
The cheese on this one is amazing. It's the best pizza that I've ever had.
Mr Brown explained the problem five times without getting angry. He's the most patient teacher that we've ever had.
My sister took a photo from the top of the mountain. That's the most amazing view that she's ever seen.
The wind blew the roof off the school. It was the worst storm that our town has ever had.
I'm so excited to see Tokyo. It's the first time I've been to Japan.
Please be kind about the taste. This is the only cake I've ever baked.
We lost our first five games. Today is the first time we've won a game this season.
My aunt plays chess every day. She's the only person who has ever beaten me at chess.
That dog is as big as a horse. I've never seen a bigger dog.
The sun was out every day in Greece. We've never had a better holiday.
The student said a bird ate his homework. The teacher has never heard a worse excuse.
Your father paid for everyone's dinner again. I've never met anyone more generous than him.
My parents had a sea view and free breakfast. They've never stayed in a nicer hotel.

examples.heading: ① the + 最高級 + 名詞 + I've ever + 過去分詞

items.en: Look at the white sand and the clear water. This is the most beautiful beach I've ever seen.
items.zh: 你看這白沙和清澈的海水。這是我看過最美的海灘。

items.en: The fish was cold and the rice was hard. That was the worst meal I've ever eaten.
items.zh: 魚是冷的，飯是硬的。那是我吃過最難吃的一餐。

items.en: I laughed all the way through it. It's the funniest book I've ever read.
items.zh: 我從頭笑到尾。這是我讀過最好笑的書。

items.en: Your new neighbour brought us soup when we were ill. She's the kindest person I've ever met.
items.zh: 你的新鄰居在我們生病時送湯來。她是我遇過最善良的人。

items.en: I only answered half of the questions. That was the hardest exam I've ever taken.
items.zh: 我只答了一半的題目。那是我考過最難的考試。

items.en: I slept for ten hours at this hotel. This is the most comfortable bed I've ever slept in.
items.zh: 我在這間飯店睡了十個小時。這是我睡過最舒服的床。

items.en: I dreamed that my cat could drive a bus. That's the strangest dream I've ever had.
items.zh: 我夢到我的貓會開公車。那是我做過最奇怪的夢。

examples.heading: ② 主詞是 he / she：has ever

items.en: Look at the photo from my dad's trip. It's the biggest fish he's ever caught.
items.zh: 你看我爸爸這次出遊的照片。這是他釣過最大的魚。

items.en: My mum walked thirty kilometres for charity. It was the longest walk she has ever done.
items.zh: 我媽媽為了慈善活動走了三十公里。那是她走過最長的一段路。

items.en: My brother paid two thousand pounds for that camera. This is the most expensive thing he's ever bought.
items.zh: 我哥哥花了兩千英鎊買那台相機。這是他買過最貴的東西。

items.en: My son hasn't put down the new bike all day. That's the best present he has ever had.
items.zh: 我兒子一整天都離不開那台新腳踏車。那是他收過最好的禮物。

items.en: The lake froze for three months. It's the coldest winter my grandmother has ever known.
items.zh: 湖結冰了三個月。這是我奶奶經歷過最冷的冬天。

examples.heading: ③ you / we / they：have ever

items.en: We're on the eightieth floor now. Is this the tallest building you've ever been in?
items.zh: 我們現在在八十樓。這是你進過最高的大樓嗎？

items.en: We asked the chef for the recipe. That was the most delicious soup we've ever tasted.
items.zh: 我們跟主廚要了食譜。那是我們喝過最好喝的湯。

items.en: The two teams scored six goals each. It's the most exciting match they've ever played.
items.zh: 兩隊各進了六球。這是他們踢過最精采的比賽。

items.en: We're choosing a film for Halloween. What's the scariest film you've ever watched?
items.zh: 我們在挑萬聖節要看的電影。你看過最恐怖的電影是哪一部？

items.en: We sold three hundred cakes on Saturday. That was the busiest day we've ever had in the shop.
items.zh: 我們星期六賣了三百個蛋糕。那是我們店裡最忙的一天。

examples.heading: ④ 加 that

items.en: The cheese on this one is amazing. It's the best pizza that I've ever had.
items.zh: 這一片的起司超好吃。這是我吃過最好吃的披薩。

items.en: Mr Brown explained the problem five times without getting angry. He's the most patient teacher that we've ever had.
items.zh: 布朗老師把那道題講了五次，一點都沒生氣。他是我們遇過最有耐心的老師。

items.en: My sister took a photo from the top of the mountain. That's the most amazing view that she's ever seen.
items.zh: 我姊姊在山頂拍了一張照片。那是她看過最壯觀的景色。

items.en: The wind blew the roof off the school. It was the worst storm that our town has ever had.
items.zh: 風把學校的屋頂吹掉了。那是我們鎮上遇過最嚴重的暴風雨。

examples.heading: ⑤ the first / the only + 現在完成式

items.en: I'm so excited to see Tokyo. It's the first time I've been to Japan.
items.zh: 我好期待看到東京。這是我第一次去日本。

items.en: Please be kind about the taste. This is the only cake I've ever baked.
items.zh: 味道請多包涵。這是我唯一烤過的蛋糕。

items.en: We lost our first five games. Today is the first time we've won a game this season.
items.zh: 我們前五場都輸了。今天是我們這一季第一次贏球。

items.en: My aunt plays chess every day. She's the only person who has ever beaten me at chess.
items.zh: 我阿姨每天下西洋棋。她是唯一下西洋棋贏過我的人。

examples.heading: ⑥ never + 比較級

items.en: That dog is as big as a horse. I've never seen a bigger dog.
items.zh: 那隻狗跟馬一樣大。我從來沒看過更大的狗。

items.en: The sun was out every day in Greece. We've never had a better holiday.
items.zh: 我們在希臘每天都是晴天。我們從來沒有過更棒的假期。

items.en: The student said a bird ate his homework. The teacher has never heard a worse excuse.
items.zh: 那個學生說一隻鳥吃了他的作業。老師從來沒聽過更爛的藉口。

items.en: Your father paid for everyone's dinner again. I've never met anyone more generous than him.
items.zh: 你爸爸又請大家吃晚餐了。我從來沒遇過比他更大方的人。

items.en: My parents had a sea view and free breakfast. They've never stayed in a nicer hotel.
items.zh: 我爸媽的房間看得到海，早餐還免費。他們從來沒住過更好的飯店。

title: I'm going to put it right in front of the window so I have enough light.
translation: 我要把它放在窗戶正前方，這樣光線才夠。
name: 程度副詞修飾介系詞片語
sentences: The bus stopped right outside my house.
I'm standing right behind you.
The ball landed right in the middle of the pond.
Put the lamp right next to the bed.
There's a coffee shop right across the street.
The answer was right under my nose.
Call me right after the meeting.
The kids went straight to bed after the trip.
We left right before the storm.
My dad drove straight to the hospital after the call.
The baby fell asleep right in the middle of the film.
The beach is quite near our hotel.
My school is very close to the station.
They live quite far from the city center.
The airport is quite close to the city.
The hospital is very near the motorway.
Our new flat is really near the river.
I love shopping, especially with my sister.
It's cold here, especially in the mornings.
The town is busy, especially at the weekend.
Their farm is really in the middle of nowhere.
The keys were right in my pocket the whole time.
He walked straight into the glass door.
Our seats were right at the front.
The fire started right above the kitchen.
I'll be there straight after school.
The shop is just round the corner, quite close to the bank.
She sat right between her two best friends.
The light switch is right by the door.
The stars look amazing, especially from the top of the mountain.

examples.heading: ① right + 位置

items.en: The bus stopped right outside my house.
items.zh: 公車就停在我家外面。

items.en: I'm standing right behind you.
items.zh: 我就站在你後面。

items.en: The ball landed right in the middle of the pond.
items.zh: 球正好掉在池塘的中間。

items.en: Put the lamp right next to the bed.
items.zh: 把檯燈放在床的正旁邊。

items.en: There's a coffee shop right across the street.
items.zh: 對街就有一家咖啡店。

items.en: The answer was right under my nose.
items.zh: 答案就在我眼前。

examples.heading: ② right / straight + 時間

items.en: Call me right after the meeting.
items.zh: 會議一結束就打給我。

items.en: The kids went straight to bed after the trip.
items.zh: 旅行回來後，孩子們直接去睡了。

items.en: We left right before the storm.
items.zh: 我們就在暴風雨來之前離開了。

items.en: My dad drove straight to the hospital after the call.
items.zh: 我爸爸接到電話後直接開車去醫院。

items.en: The baby fell asleep right in the middle of the film.
items.zh: 寶寶就在電影演到一半時睡著了。

examples.heading: ③ quite / very + 位置

items.en: The beach is quite near our hotel.
items.zh: 海灘離我們的飯店相當近。

items.en: My school is very close to the station.
items.zh: 我的學校離車站很近。

items.en: They live quite far from the city center.
items.zh: 他們住得離市中心相當遠。

items.en: The airport is quite close to the city.
items.zh: 機場離市區相當近。

items.en: The hospital is very near the motorway.
items.zh: 醫院離高速公路很近。

examples.heading: ④ really / especially + 介系詞片語

items.en: Our new flat is really near the river.
items.zh: 我們的新公寓真的離河很近。

items.en: I love shopping, especially with my sister.
items.zh: 我很喜歡逛街，特別是跟我姊姊一起。

items.en: It's cold here, especially in the mornings.
items.zh: 這裡很冷，特別是早上。

items.en: The town is busy, especially at the weekend.
items.zh: 這個小鎮很熱鬧，特別是週末。

items.en: Their farm is really in the middle of nowhere.
items.zh: 他們的農場真的在荒郊野外。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: The keys were right in my pocket the whole time.
items.zh: 鑰匙一直都在我的口袋裡。

items.en: He walked straight into the glass door.
items.zh: 他直接撞上了玻璃門。

items.en: Our seats were right at the front.
items.zh: 我們的座位就在最前面。

items.en: The fire started right above the kitchen.
items.zh: 火是從廚房正上方燒起來的。

items.en: I'll be there straight after school.
items.zh: 我放學後會直接過去。

items.en: The shop is just round the corner, quite close to the bank.
items.zh: 那家店就在轉角，離銀行相當近。

items.en: She sat right between her two best friends.
items.zh: 她坐在她兩個最好的朋友正中間。

items.en: The light switch is right by the door.
items.zh: 電燈開關就在門邊。

items.en: The stars look amazing, especially from the top of the mountain.
items.zh: 星星看起來好美，特別是從山頂看。

title: Due to a dental appointment, I will not be able to participate in the English class tomorrow.
translation: 因為明天要看牙醫，我沒辦法參加英文課。
name: 複合介系詞（較多種）
sentences: The ferry isn't running today due to strong winds.
Due to a staff shortage, the café is closing early today.
Thanks to the new bridge, the journey takes only ten minutes.
We won the game thanks to our goalkeeper.
The road is closed due to an accident.
Thanks to my sister, I found a great flat.
We took the night train instead of flying.
I had soup instead of a sandwich for lunch.
Why don't you call her instead of sending a text?
She stayed home instead of going to the party.
Use oil instead of butter in this recipe.
The battery lasts up to twelve hours.
The bus holds up to sixty people.
A little boy came running out of the classroom.
My parents live just outside of Hsinchu.
Get out of the water, it's getting dark!
According to my map, the museum is on the left.
According to the teacher, the test will be easy.
Apart from Mia, everyone came to the meeting.
I like all vegetables apart from peppers.
According to the news, prices will rise again.
Due to the holiday, the bank will be closed on Monday.
Thanks to the rain, the garden looks beautiful.
I'll take the stairs instead of the lift.
Kids up to the age of six travel free.
Apart from the weather, it was a perfect holiday.
Thanks to the free buses, more people visit the old town.
According to the sign, we can't park here.
She ran out of the room in tears.
Due to a family emergency, I need to leave early today.

examples.heading: ① due to / thanks to

items.en: The ferry isn't running today due to strong winds.
items.zh: 渡輪今天因為強風停駛。

items.en: Due to a staff shortage, the café is closing early today.
items.zh: 因為人手不足，咖啡店今天提早關門。

items.en: Thanks to the new bridge, the journey takes only ten minutes.
items.zh: 多虧了新橋，這段路只要十分鐘。

items.en: We won the game thanks to our goalkeeper.
items.zh: 多虧我們的守門員，我們贏了比賽。

items.en: The road is closed due to an accident.
items.zh: 那條路因為車禍封閉了。

items.en: Thanks to my sister, I found a great flat.
items.zh: 多虧我姊姊，我找到了一間很棒的公寓。

examples.heading: ② instead of

items.en: We took the night train instead of flying.
items.zh: 我們搭了夜車，沒有搭飛機。

items.en: I had soup instead of a sandwich for lunch.
items.zh: 我午餐喝了湯，沒吃三明治。

items.en: Why don't you call her instead of sending a text?
items.zh: 你何不打給她，不要傳簡訊？

items.en: She stayed home instead of going to the party.
items.zh: 她待在家，沒去派對。

items.en: Use oil instead of butter in this recipe.
items.zh: 這個食譜用油，不要用奶油。

examples.heading: ③ up to / out of / outside of

items.en: The battery lasts up to twelve hours.
items.zh: 電池最多可以撐十二個小時。

items.en: The bus holds up to sixty people.
items.zh: 這輛公車最多可以坐六十個人。

items.en: A little boy came running out of the classroom.
items.zh: 一個小男孩從教室裡跑出來。

items.en: My parents live just outside of Hsinchu.
items.zh: 我爸媽住在新竹市區外面一點。

items.en: Get out of the water, it's getting dark!
items.zh: 從水裡出來，天快黑了！

examples.heading: ④ according to / apart from

items.en: According to my map, the museum is on the left.
items.zh: 根據我的地圖，博物館在左邊。

items.en: According to the teacher, the test will be easy.
items.zh: 根據老師的說法，考試會很簡單。

items.en: Apart from Mia, everyone came to the meeting.
items.zh: 除了 Mia，大家都來開會了。

items.en: I like all vegetables apart from peppers.
items.zh: 除了青椒，我所有的蔬菜都喜歡。

items.en: According to the news, prices will rise again.
items.zh: 根據新聞報導，物價還會再漲。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Due to the holiday, the bank will be closed on Monday.
items.zh: 因為放假，銀行星期一不營業。

items.en: Thanks to the rain, the garden looks beautiful.
items.zh: 多虧下了雨，花園看起來很漂亮。

items.en: I'll take the stairs instead of the lift.
items.zh: 我要走樓梯，不搭電梯。

items.en: Kids up to the age of six travel free.
items.zh: 六歲以下的小孩免費搭乘。

items.en: Apart from the weather, it was a perfect holiday.
items.zh: 除了天氣以外，那是一次完美的假期。

items.en: Thanks to the free buses, more people visit the old town.
items.zh: 多虧有免費公車，更多人來逛老城區。

items.en: According to the sign, we can't park here.
items.zh: 根據告示，我們不能在這裡停車。

items.en: She ran out of the room in tears.
items.zh: 她哭著跑出房間。

items.en: Due to a family emergency, I need to leave early today.
items.zh: 因為家裡有急事，我今天得提早走。

title: As for the camping, I admit that I'm not a great fan of it.
translation: 至於露營，我承認我不太喜歡。
name: 複合介系詞（多種）
sentences: The food was great. As for the service, it was a bit slow.
I'm ready to go. As for my sister, she's still getting dressed.
In terms of price, this phone is the best choice.
The town is small in terms of population.
As for the weekend, I haven't made any plans yet.
In spite of the storm, the plane landed safely.
She went to work in spite of her cold.
In spite of being tired, he finished the race.
The old car still runs well in spite of its age.
In spite of the high price, the tickets sold out.
In addition to English, students learn two other languages.
In addition to cooking dinner, he did the washing up.
Apart from the beach, the island has some beautiful forests.
Apart from a sandwich, I haven't eaten anything today.
In addition to the fee, you'll need to pay for the books.
The museum is open every day except for Monday.
I've finished all my homework except for the maths.
Apart from one small mistake, your essay is perfect.
The streets were quiet except for a few taxis.
The room was empty except for an old piano.
On behalf of the whole team, I'd like to thank you.
She accepted the prize on behalf of her father.
As for dessert, I'll just have some fruit.
In terms of size, the new office is perfect.
In spite of his age, my grandfather is very active.
In addition to a salary, the job offers free lunch.
We invited everyone except for the new neighbors.
As for the noise, I'll speak to the neighbors tomorrow.
Apart from being a doctor, she's also a talented painter.
I'm writing on behalf of my company.

examples.heading: ① as for / in terms of

items.en: The food was great. As for the service, it was a bit slow.
items.zh: 食物很好吃。至於服務，有點慢。

items.en: I'm ready to go. As for my sister, she's still getting dressed.
items.zh: 我準備好了。至於我姊姊，她還在換衣服。

items.en: In terms of price, this phone is the best choice.
items.zh: 就價格來說，這支手機是最好的選擇。

items.en: The town is small in terms of population.
items.zh: 就人口來說，這個小鎮很小。

items.en: As for the weekend, I haven't made any plans yet.
items.zh: 至於週末，我還沒有任何計畫。

examples.heading: ② in spite of

items.en: In spite of the storm, the plane landed safely.
items.zh: 儘管有暴風雨，飛機還是安全降落了。

items.en: She went to work in spite of her cold.
items.zh: 儘管感冒了，她還是去上班了。

items.en: In spite of being tired, he finished the race.
items.zh: 儘管很累，他還是跑完了比賽。

items.en: The old car still runs well in spite of its age.
items.zh: 儘管那輛舊車很老了，還是很好開。

items.en: In spite of the high price, the tickets sold out.
items.zh: 儘管票價很高，票還是賣完了。

examples.heading: ③ in addition to / apart from

items.en: In addition to English, students learn two other languages.
items.zh: 除了英文，學生還要學另外兩種語言。

items.en: In addition to cooking dinner, he did the washing up.
items.zh: 除了煮晚餐，他還洗了碗。

items.en: Apart from the beach, the island has some beautiful forests.
items.zh: 除了海灘，那座島還有一些美麗的森林。

items.en: Apart from a sandwich, I haven't eaten anything today.
items.zh: 除了一個三明治，我今天什麼都沒吃。

items.en: In addition to the fee, you'll need to pay for the books.
items.zh: 除了學費，你還要付書錢。

examples.heading: ④ except for / apart from（排除）

items.en: The museum is open every day except for Monday.
items.zh: 博物館除了星期一，每天都開。

items.en: I've finished all my homework except for the maths.
items.zh: 除了數學，我的功課都寫完了。

items.en: Apart from one small mistake, your essay is perfect.
items.zh: 除了一個小錯，你的作文很完美。

items.en: The streets were quiet except for a few taxis.
items.zh: 除了幾輛計程車，街上很安靜。

items.en: The room was empty except for an old piano.
items.zh: 房間裡除了一台舊鋼琴，什麼都沒有。

examples.heading: ⑤ on behalf of 和不同的情境

items.en: On behalf of the whole team, I'd like to thank you.
items.zh: 我代表整個團隊向您致謝。

items.en: She accepted the prize on behalf of her father.
items.zh: 她代表她父親領了獎。

items.en: As for dessert, I'll just have some fruit.
items.zh: 至於甜點，我吃點水果就好。

items.en: In terms of size, the new office is perfect.
items.zh: 就大小來說，新辦公室很完美。

items.en: In spite of his age, my grandfather is very active.
items.zh: 儘管年紀大了，我爺爺還是很活躍。

items.en: In addition to a salary, the job offers free lunch.
items.zh: 除了薪水，這份工作還提供免費午餐。

items.en: We invited everyone except for the new neighbors.
items.zh: 除了新鄰居，我們每個人都邀請了。

items.en: As for the noise, I'll speak to the neighbors tomorrow.
items.zh: 至於噪音，我明天會去跟鄰居談。

items.en: Apart from being a doctor, she's also a talented painter.
items.zh: 除了是醫生，她也是一位很有天分的畫家。

items.en: I'm writing on behalf of my company.
items.zh: 我代表我的公司寫這封信。

title: Thanks for replying.
translation: 謝謝你的回覆。
name: 介系詞後接動詞-ing
sentences: My brother is crazy about playing video games.
My grandmother is brilliant at knitting scarves.
My little brother is afraid of swimming in the sea.
I'm tired of waiting for the bus every morning.
Are you interested in joining our book club?
My dad is very good at fixing things.
I'm thinking about buying a new bike.
We talked about going to the beach this weekend.
She dreams of living in Paris one day.
He apologized for being late.
They succeeded in finishing the project on time.
Thank you for inviting me to your party.
Thanks for feeding my fish while I was away.
Thank you for waiting so patiently, sir.
Thanks for lending me your umbrella.
Thanks for coming all this way.
I learned English by watching cartoons.
You can help by bringing some drinks.
He left without saying goodbye.
Don't cross the road without looking.
She paid for the trip by working at weekends.
How about going for a pizza tonight?
I'm looking forward to seeing you.
Before going to bed, I always read for a while.
What do you think of moving to the countryside?
She's proud of winning the race.
I'm sorry for shouting at you.
We're excited about starting our new jobs.
Instead of driving, why don't we take the train?
He's famous for telling long stories.

examples.heading: ① 形容詞 + 介系詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: My brother is crazy about playing video games.
items.zh: 我哥哥超愛打電動。

items.en: My grandmother is brilliant at knitting scarves.
items.zh: 我奶奶很會織圍巾。

items.en: My little brother is afraid of swimming in the sea.
items.zh: 我弟弟怕在海裡游泳。

items.en: I'm tired of waiting for the bus every morning.
items.zh: 我受夠了每天早上等公車。

items.en: Are you interested in joining our book club?
items.zh: 你有興趣加入我們的讀書會嗎？

items.en: My dad is very good at fixing things.
items.zh: 我爸爸很會修東西。

examples.heading: ② 動詞 + 介系詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: I'm thinking about buying a new bike.
items.zh: 我在考慮買一台新腳踏車。

items.en: We talked about going to the beach this weekend.
items.zh: 我們聊到這個週末去海邊的事。

items.en: She dreams of living in Paris one day.
items.zh: 她夢想有一天能住在巴黎。

items.en: He apologized for being late.
items.zh: 他為遲到道歉。

items.en: They succeeded in finishing the project on time.
items.zh: 他們成功地準時完成了計畫。

examples.heading: ③ thanks for / thank you for

items.en: Thank you for inviting me to your party.
items.zh: 謝謝你邀請我參加你的派對。

items.en: Thanks for feeding my fish while I was away.
items.zh: 謝謝你在我不在的時候幫我餵魚。

items.en: Thank you for waiting so patiently, sir.
items.zh: 先生，謝謝您耐心等候。

items.en: Thanks for lending me your umbrella.
items.zh: 謝謝你借我傘。

items.en: Thanks for coming all this way.
items.zh: 謝謝你大老遠跑來。

examples.heading: ④ by / without + 動詞-ing

items.en: I learned English by watching cartoons.
items.zh: 我是靠看卡通學英文的。

items.en: You can help by bringing some drinks.
items.zh: 你可以帶些飲料來幫忙。

items.en: He left without saying goodbye.
items.zh: 他沒說再見就走了。

items.en: Don't cross the road without looking.
items.zh: 不要沒看就過馬路。

items.en: She paid for the trip by working at weekends.
items.zh: 她靠週末打工付了旅費。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: How about going for a pizza tonight?
items.zh: 今晚去吃披薩怎麼樣？

items.en: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
items.zh: 我很期待見到你。

items.en: Before going to bed, I always read for a while.
items.zh: 睡覺前我都會看一下書。

items.en: What do you think of moving to the countryside?
items.zh: 你覺得搬到鄉下怎麼樣？

items.en: She's proud of winning the race.
items.zh: 她很驕傲贏了比賽。

items.en: I'm sorry for shouting at you.
items.zh: 對不起，我對你大吼了。

items.en: We're excited about starting our new jobs.
items.zh: 我們對開始新工作感到很興奮。

items.en: Instead of driving, why don't we take the train?
items.zh: 我們何不搭火車，不要開車？

items.en: He's famous for telling long stories.
items.zh: 他以講很長的故事出名。

title: My house is just after the library.
translation: 我家就在圖書館過去一點。
name: just 修飾介系詞
sentences: The supermarket is just behind the hospital.
There's a nice beach just south of the town.
My office is just above the coffee shop.
The station is just across the road.
Our hotel was just near the old market.
The lifeguard tower is just in front of the main beach.
