The printer is just next to the photocopier.
Park the car just in front of the gate.
The keys are just on top of the fridge.
There's a playground just opposite our school.
The museum is just outside the city center.
I got home just before midnight.
She called just after you left.
The baby woke up just before dinner.
We met just after the war.
The shops close just after six.
Turn left, and the post office is just after the bridge.
Go straight on, and you'll see the bank just past the traffic lights.
The entrance is just behind the ticket office.
Our house is just around the corner from the school.
The toilets are just down those stairs.
The cat is sleeping just under your chair.
I found my glasses just beside the bed.
My birthday is just before Christmas.
They built a new café just along the river.
The bus stops just outside the library.
The night market is just near the temple.
My grandmother lives just down the street.
There's a parking space just behind that red car.
We finished the project just after lunch.

examples.heading: ① just + 位置

items.en: The supermarket is just behind the hospital.
items.zh: 超市就在醫院後面。

items.en: There's a nice beach just south of the town.
items.zh: 小鎮南邊不遠就有一片很棒的海灘。

items.en: My office is just above the coffee shop.
items.zh: 我的辦公室就在咖啡店樓上。

items.en: The station is just across the road.
items.zh: 車站就在馬路對面。

items.en: Our hotel was just near the old market.
items.zh: 我們的飯店就在舊市場附近。

items.en: The lifeguard tower is just in front of the main beach.
items.zh: 救生員瞭望台就在主海灘前面。

examples.heading: ② just + 複合介系詞

items.en: The printer is just next to the photocopier.
items.zh: 印表機就在影印機旁邊。

items.en: Park the car just in front of the gate.
items.zh: 把車停在大門前面就好。

items.en: The keys are just on top of the fridge.
items.zh: 鑰匙就在冰箱上面。

items.en: There's a playground just opposite our school.
items.zh: 我們學校對面就有一座遊樂場。

items.en: The museum is just outside the city center.
items.zh: 博物館就在市中心外圍。

examples.heading: ③ just + 時間

items.en: I got home just before midnight.
items.zh: 我剛好在半夜之前到家。

items.en: She called just after you left.
items.zh: 你一走她就打來了。

items.en: The baby woke up just before dinner.
items.zh: 寶寶就在晚餐前醒了。

items.en: We met just after the war.
items.zh: 我們是在戰爭剛結束時認識的。

items.en: The shops close just after six.
items.zh: 那些店六點過一點就關門了。

examples.heading: ④ 指路

items.en: Turn left, and the post office is just after the bridge.
items.zh: 左轉，郵局就在過橋之後。

items.en: Go straight on, and you'll see the bank just past the traffic lights.
items.zh: 直走，過了紅綠燈就會看到銀行。

items.en: The entrance is just behind the ticket office.
items.zh: 入口就在售票處後面。

items.en: Our house is just around the corner from the school.
items.zh: 我們家就在學校轉角那邊。

items.en: The toilets are just down those stairs.
items.zh: 廁所就在那些樓梯下去。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: The cat is sleeping just under your chair.
items.zh: 貓就睡在你的椅子底下。

items.en: I found my glasses just beside the bed.
items.zh: 我在床邊就找到了我的眼鏡。

items.en: My birthday is just before Christmas.
items.zh: 我的生日就在聖誕節前。

items.en: They built a new café just along the river.
items.zh: 他們在河邊沿岸就蓋了一家新咖啡店。

items.en: The bus stops just outside the library.
items.zh: 公車就停在圖書館外面。

items.en: The night market is just near the temple.
items.zh: 夜市就在廟附近。

items.en: My grandmother lives just down the street.
items.zh: 我奶奶就住在這條街過去一點。

items.en: There's a parking space just behind that red car.
items.zh: 那輛紅車後面就有一個停車位。

items.en: We finished the project just after lunch.
items.zh: 我們午餐剛過就完成了那個計畫。

title: When I have free time, I go to the park with my dog.
translation: 我有空的時候，會帶我的狗去公園。
name: 介系詞加名詞片語
sentences: You don't have to go far for coffee. There's a nice café on the corner of my street.
Come and look! The ducks are swimming in the pond behind the school.
I got wet on the way to work. I left my umbrella on the train this morning.
It was very hot at the lake, so we sat under a big tree and had a picnic.
Are you looking for your glasses? They're next to the computer.
My aunt and uncle run a noodle shop opposite the temple. Their beef noodles are great.
Come and visit my village. We have lots of fresh fruit in the summer.
Sorry, I'm not free tonight. I go swimming on Tuesday evenings.
We can get fresh bread before work. The bakery opens at seven in the morning.
Our house gets very busy in February. My cousins visit us at Chinese New Year.
We can't travel in early July. The school holidays start in the middle of July.
I'll be late today. I'm going to the dentist with my little brother. He has a toothache.
Don't put milk in his cup. He always drinks tea with lemon.
Her home is never quiet. She lives with her parents and her two brothers.
Do you want rice with your chicken?
I had a lovely afternoon. I went for a walk with my old school friend.
I live close to the school, so I go to school by bike.
She didn't have any cash, so she paid for the tickets with her credit card.
My sister called me last night. We talked on the phone for an hour.
His pen friend lives in Australia, so he wrote the letter in English.
They didn't want to drive, so they travelled around Taiwan by train.
We sometimes meet friends at the sports center on Saturdays. We play basketball together.
My cat doesn't use her basket. She sleeps on my bed every night.
Thanks, they were cheap! I bought these shoes in a shop near the station.
My desk is too small for both of us. Let's do our homework at the kitchen table.
Welcome to my room! There's a photo of my family on the wall.
My dad is never home on Sundays. He goes fishing with his friends at the weekend.
If you need the car, the keys are in the drawer under the TV.
Look at this cover. I'm reading a book about a girl from Mars.
The hotel was by the sea, so we walked along the beach after dinner.

examples.heading: ① 地點

items.en: You don't have to go far for coffee. There's a nice café on the corner of my street.
items.zh: 你不用跑很遠去喝咖啡。我家那條街的轉角有一家很不錯的咖啡店。

items.en: Come and look! The ducks are swimming in the pond behind the school.
items.zh: 快來看！鴨子在學校後面的池塘裡游泳。

items.en: I got wet on the way to work. I left my umbrella on the train this morning.
items.zh: 我上班途中淋濕了。我今天早上把傘忘在火車上了。

items.en: It was very hot at the lake, so we sat under a big tree and had a picnic.
items.zh: 湖邊很熱，所以我們坐在一棵大樹下野餐。

items.en: Are you looking for your glasses? They're next to the computer.
items.zh: 你在找你的眼鏡嗎？在電腦旁邊。

items.en: My aunt and uncle run a noodle shop opposite the temple. Their beef noodles are great.
items.zh: 我阿姨和姨丈在廟的對面開了一家麵店。他們的牛肉麵很好吃。

examples.heading: ② 時間

items.en: Come and visit my village. We have lots of fresh fruit in the summer.
items.zh: 來我住的村子玩吧。我們夏天有很多新鮮水果。

items.en: Sorry, I'm not free tonight. I go swimming on Tuesday evenings.
items.zh: 抱歉，我今晚沒空。我星期二晚上會去游泳。

items.en: We can get fresh bread before work. The bakery opens at seven in the morning.
items.zh: 我們上班前可以去買新鮮的麵包。那家麵包店早上七點開。

items.en: Our house gets very busy in February. My cousins visit us at Chinese New Year.
items.zh: 我們家二月會很熱鬧。我的表兄弟姊妹過年會來我們家。

items.en: We can't travel in early July. The school holidays start in the middle of July.
items.zh: 我們七月初不能去旅行。學校的暑假七月中才開始。

examples.heading: ③ 一起的人和東西

items.en: I'll be late today. I'm going to the dentist with my little brother. He has a toothache.
items.zh: 我今天會晚到。我要陪我弟弟去看牙醫。他牙痛。

items.en: Don't put milk in his cup. He always drinks tea with lemon.
items.zh: 別在他的杯子裡加牛奶。他喝茶都會加檸檬。

items.en: Her home is never quiet. She lives with her parents and her two brothers.
items.zh: 她家從來不安靜。她跟她爸媽和她兩個哥哥一起住。

items.en: Do you want rice with your chicken?
items.zh: 你的雞肉要配飯嗎？

items.en: I had a lovely afternoon. I went for a walk with my old school friend.
items.zh: 我下午過得很愉快。我跟我的老同學去散步。

examples.heading: ④ 方法和交通方式

items.en: I live close to the school, so I go to school by bike.
items.zh: 我住得離學校很近，所以我騎腳踏車上學。

items.en: She didn't have any cash, so she paid for the tickets with her credit card.
items.zh: 她身上沒有現金，所以她用信用卡付了票錢。

items.en: My sister called me last night. We talked on the phone for an hour.
items.zh: 我姊姊昨晚打給我。我們講了一個小時的電話。

items.en: His pen friend lives in Australia, so he wrote the letter in English.
items.zh: 他的筆友住在澳洲，所以他用英文寫了那封信。

items.en: They didn't want to drive, so they travelled around Taiwan by train.
items.zh: 他們不想開車，所以他們搭火車環島。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: We sometimes meet friends at the sports center on Saturdays. We play basketball together.
items.zh: 我們星期六有時候會在運動中心跟朋友碰面。我們一起打籃球。

items.en: My cat doesn't use her basket. She sleeps on my bed every night.
items.zh: 我的貓不睡她的籃子。她每天晚上都睡在我床上。

items.en: Thanks, they were cheap! I bought these shoes in a shop near the station.
items.zh: 謝謝，這雙很便宜！我在車站附近的一家店買的。

items.en: My desk is too small for both of us. Let's do our homework at the kitchen table.
items.zh: 我的書桌太小，坐不下我們兩個。我們在廚房的餐桌寫功課吧。

items.en: Welcome to my room! There's a photo of my family on the wall.
items.zh: 歡迎來我房間！牆上有一張我家人的照片。

items.en: My dad is never home on Sundays. He goes fishing with his friends at the weekend.
items.zh: 我爸星期天都不在家。他週末會跟他朋友去釣魚。

items.en: If you need the car, the keys are in the drawer under the TV.
items.zh: 你如果要用車，鑰匙在電視下面的抽屜裡。

items.en: Look at this cover. I'm reading a book about a girl from Mars.
items.zh: 你看這個封面。我在讀一本講一個火星女孩的書。

items.en: The hotel was by the sea, so we walked along the beach after dinner.
items.zh: 飯店在海邊，所以我們晚餐後沿著海灘散步。

title: I can cook some food for you.
translation: 我可以煮點東西給你吃。
name: 單字介系詞

examples.heading: ① 地點：in / on / at

items.en: Look, there's a frog in the swimming pool!
items.zh: 你看，游泳池裡有一隻青蛙！

items.en: Can you hear that noise? There's a cat on the roof.
items.zh: 你有聽到那個聲音嗎？屋頂上有一隻貓。

items.en: Mum, I'm at the supermarket now. Do we need milk?
items.zh: 媽，我現在在超市。家裡要買牛奶嗎？

items.en: My uncle has a farm in the mountains. We visit him every summer.
items.zh: 我叔叔在山上有一座農場。我們每年夏天都去找他。

items.en: Don't worry, your phone is on the kitchen table.
items.zh: 別擔心，你的手機在廚房的桌上。

items.en: On our last day, we had lunch at a little café by the sea.
items.zh: 最後一天，我們在海邊的一家小咖啡店吃午餐。

examples.heading: ② 時間：in / on / at

items.en: Bring an umbrella if you visit. The rainy season here starts in May.
items.zh: 你要來的話，帶把傘。這裡的雨季五月開始。

items.en: Don't forget to study. We have a spelling test on Wednesday.
items.zh: 別忘了讀書。我們星期三有拼字小考。

items.en: I can't meet before eight. My yoga class finishes at half past seven.
items.zh: 我八點前沒辦法碰面。我的瑜伽課七點半結束。

items.en: My grandmother waters her plants in the evening, when it's cooler.
items.zh: 我奶奶傍晚天氣比較涼的時候幫她的植物澆水。

items.en: I'm busy on Friday. Can you come on Saturday afternoon?
items.zh: 我星期五很忙。你星期六下午可以來嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 方向和來源：to / from

items.en: I don't have a car. I walk to work every day.
items.zh: 我沒有車。我每天走路上班。

items.en: She's at the post office. She's sending a postcard to her friend in Japan.
items.zh: 她在郵局。她要寄一張明信片給她在日本的朋友。

items.en: You look worried. Is this email from your boss?
items.zh: 你看起來很擔心。這封電子郵件是你老闆寄的嗎？

items.en: My teacher is from Canada, so she speaks English and French.
items.zh: 我的老師是加拿大人，所以她會說英文和法文。

items.en: We're flying to Bangkok next week for my cousin's wedding.
items.zh: 我們下禮拜要飛去曼谷參加我表哥的婚禮。

examples.heading: ④ 對象和一起的人：for / with

items.en: It's Mother's Day tomorrow. I made this card for my mom.
items.zh: 明天是母親節。我做了這張卡片要給我媽媽。

items.en: Do you want to go to the night market with us tonight?
items.zh: 你今晚要跟我們一起去夜市嗎？

items.en: Can you carry it? This bag is too heavy for me.
items.zh: 你可以幫我拿嗎？這個包包對我來說太重了。

items.en: I play tennis with my dad on Sundays.
items.zh: 我星期天會跟我爸爸打網球。

items.en: I just got back to the office. Is there a message for me?
items.zh: 我剛回到辦公室。有給我的留言嗎？

items.en: My aunt isn't married. She lives with two cats.
items.zh: 我阿姨沒結婚。她跟兩隻貓一起住。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Please don't wear shoes in the house. Put your shoes in the cupboard by the door.
items.zh: 在家裡請不要穿鞋。把你的鞋子放進門邊的櫃子裡。

items.en: Let's meet at the bus stop outside the library.
items.zh: 我們在圖書館外面的公車站碰面吧。

items.en: You didn't have to buy me lunch. Thank you for the sandwich.
items.zh: 你不用請我吃午餐的。謝謝你的三明治。

items.en: Sorry, I'll miss our class this week. I'm going to the dentist on Thursday.
items.zh: 抱歉，這星期的課我不能去。我星期四要去看牙醫。

items.en: Can you hold my coffee for me while I tie my shoe?
items.zh: 我綁鞋帶的時候，你可以幫我拿一下咖啡嗎？

items.en: He isn't home today. He's shopping with his sister in Taichung.
items.zh: 他今天不在家。他跟他姊姊在台中逛街。

items.en: We don't go out much. We usually stay at home in the evening.
items.zh: 我們不常出門。我們晚上通常待在家。

items.en: I got a letter from the school today. My exam results are good!
items.zh: 我今天收到學校寄來的信。我的考試成績很好！

title: I hate shopping via the internet.
translation: 我很討厭在網路上買東西。
name: 單字介系詞（多種）
sentences: You can send the forms via email.
We drove to Tainan via Taichung.
Sunlight came in through the gap in the curtains.
We walked through the forest to the lake.
I met my husband through a friend from work.
You can pay via the app.
The pizza will arrive within thirty minutes.
Everything you need is within walking distance.
The baby cried throughout the flight.
The museum is popular with tourists throughout the year.
There's a small village just beyond the hill.
Most of the guests left within an hour.
The dog ran towards me.
We had a picnic beside the river.
I found my ring among the leaves.
Don't lean against the door.
My bike is parked beside the vending machine.
The house stands among tall pine trees.
Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
She smiled despite the pain.
Unlike his brother, Tom loves sports.
Despite his age, my grandfather still swims every day.
Unlike most cats, ours loves water.
Turn right towards the harbor at the next corner.
The children hid behind the curtains.
I'll finish the report within the week.
The path goes past the church and over the bridge.
We're against the new parking rules.
She sent the photos via a messaging app.
Despite the price, the concert sold out in an hour.

examples.heading: ① via / through

items.en: You can send the forms via email.
items.zh: 你可以用電子郵件寄表格。

items.en: We drove to Tainan via Taichung.
items.zh: 我們經過台中開車到台南。

items.en: Sunlight came in through the gap in the curtains.
items.zh: 陽光從窗簾的縫隙照進來。

items.en: We walked through the forest to the lake.
items.zh: 我們穿過森林走到湖邊。

items.en: I met my husband through a friend from work.
items.zh: 我是透過一個同事認識我先生的。

items.en: You can pay via the app.
items.zh: 你可以用應用程式付款。

examples.heading: ② within / throughout / beyond

items.en: The pizza will arrive within thirty minutes.
items.zh: 披薩會在三十分鐘內送到。

items.en: Everything you need is within walking distance.
items.zh: 你需要的東西走路都到得了。

items.en: The baby cried throughout the flight.
items.zh: 寶寶整趟飛行都在哭。

items.en: The museum is popular with tourists throughout the year.
items.zh: 那間博物館一年到頭都很受觀光客歡迎。

items.en: There's a small village just beyond the hill.
items.zh: 山丘的另一邊有一個小村子。

items.en: Most of the guests left within an hour.
items.zh: 大部分的客人一個小時內就走了。

examples.heading: ③ towards / beside / among / against

items.en: The dog ran towards me.
items.zh: 那隻狗朝我跑過來。

items.en: We had a picnic beside the river.
items.zh: 我們在河邊野餐。

items.en: I found my ring among the leaves.
items.zh: 我在落葉堆裡找到了我的戒指。

items.en: Don't lean against the door.
items.zh: 別靠著門。

items.en: My bike is parked beside the vending machine.
items.zh: 我的腳踏車停在販賣機旁邊。

items.en: The house stands among tall pine trees.
items.zh: 那棟房子位在高大的松樹之間。

examples.heading: ④ despite / unlike

items.en: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
items.zh: 儘管塞車，我們還是準時到了。

items.en: She smiled despite the pain.
items.zh: 儘管很痛，她還是笑了。

items.en: Unlike his brother, Tom loves sports.
items.zh: 跟他哥哥不一樣，Tom 很愛運動。

items.en: Despite his age, my grandfather still swims every day.
items.zh: 儘管年紀大了，我爺爺還是每天游泳。

items.en: Unlike most cats, ours loves water.
items.zh: 跟大部分的貓不一樣，我們家的貓很愛水。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Turn right towards the harbor at the next corner.
items.zh: 在下一個轉角往港口的方向右轉。

items.en: The children hid behind the curtains.
items.zh: 孩子們躲在窗簾後面。

items.en: I'll finish the report within the week.
items.zh: 我會在這個禮拜內完成報告。

items.en: The path goes past the church and over the bridge.
items.zh: 那條小路經過教堂，再過橋。

items.en: We're against the new parking rules.
items.zh: 我們反對新的停車規定。

items.en: She sent the photos via a messaging app.
items.zh: 她用通訊軟體傳了照片。

items.en: Despite the price, the concert sold out in an hour.
items.zh: 儘管票價很高，演唱會一個小時就賣完了。

title: What are you waiting for?
translation: 你在等什麼？
name: wh- 疑問句的介系詞懸空
sentences: What is this button for?
What did you two argue about?
What are all those people staring at?
What is your new book about?
What did the restaurant charge us extra for?
What is your boss so angry about?
Who are you going on holiday with?
Who did you send the letter to?
Who are these roses on the table from?
Who does this coat belong to?
Who did your daughter sit next to on the school trip?
Who do you usually share a taxi with after work?
Where is your new flatmate from?
Where did you get that hat from?
Where is this train going to?
Where did your parents move to?
Where does this road lead to?
Which room is the meeting in?
Which shelf did you find this old diary on?
Which bus did you come on?
Which subject are you most interested in?
Which drawer did you put the scissors in?
What kind of music do you listen to?
What kind of games is your son into these days?
Who did you get this present from?
What are you looking for? Maybe I can help.
Which team do you play for?
What do you need the money for?
Who is your sister getting married to?
What are your parents arguing about this time?

examples.heading: ① What ... for / about / at

items.en: What is this button for?
items.zh: 這個按鈕是做什麼用的？

items.en: What did you two argue about?
items.zh: 你們兩個在吵什麼？

items.en: What are all those people staring at?
items.zh: 那些人都在盯著什麼看？

items.en: What is your new book about?
items.zh: 你的新書在講什麼？

items.en: What did the restaurant charge us extra for?
items.zh: 餐廳多收了我們什麼錢？

items.en: What is your boss so angry about?
items.zh: 你老闆在氣什麼？

examples.heading: ② Who ... with / to / for

items.en: Who are you going on holiday with?
items.zh: 你要跟誰去度假？

items.en: Who did you send the letter to?
items.zh: 你把信寄給誰了？

items.en: Who are these roses on the table from?
items.zh: 桌上這些玫瑰是誰送的？

items.en: Who does this coat belong to?
items.zh: 這件外套是誰的？

items.en: Who did your daughter sit next to on the school trip?
items.zh: 你女兒校外教學的時候坐在誰旁邊？

items.en: Who do you usually share a taxi with after work?
items.zh: 你下班後通常跟誰共乘計程車？

examples.heading: ③ Where ... from / to

items.en: Where is your new flatmate from?
items.zh: 你的新室友是哪裡人？

items.en: Where did you get that hat from?
items.zh: 你那頂帽子是在哪裡買的？

items.en: Where is this train going to?
items.zh: 這班火車開往哪裡？

items.en: Where did your parents move to?
items.zh: 你爸媽搬到哪裡去了？

items.en: Where does this road lead to?
items.zh: 這條路通往哪裡？

examples.heading: ④ Which ... in / on

items.en: Which room is the meeting in?
items.zh: 會議在哪一間會議室？

items.en: Which shelf did you find this old diary on?
items.zh: 你在哪一層架子上找到這本舊日記的？

items.en: Which bus did you come on?
items.zh: 你搭哪一班公車來的？

items.en: Which subject are you most interested in?
items.zh: 你對哪一科最有興趣？

items.en: Which drawer did you put the scissors in?
items.zh: 你把剪刀放在哪一個抽屜？

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: What kind of music do you listen to?
items.zh: 你聽哪一類的音樂？

items.en: What kind of games is your son into these days?
items.zh: 你兒子最近迷什麼遊戲？

items.en: Who did you get this present from?
items.zh: 這份禮物是誰送你的？

items.en: What are you looking for? Maybe I can help.
items.zh: 你在找什麼？也許我可以幫忙。

items.en: Which team do you play for?
items.zh: 你是哪一隊的球員？

items.en: What do you need the money for?
items.zh: 你要那筆錢做什麼？

items.en: Who is your sister getting married to?
items.zh: 你姊姊要嫁給誰？

items.en: What are your parents arguing about this time?
items.zh: 你爸媽這次在吵什麼？

title: Please give him all the information he asks for.
translation: 他要什麼資料，就全部給他。
name: 關係子句和間接問句的介系詞懸空
sentences: The guesthouse we stayed at served homemade bread.
Is this the book you were telling me about?
The town I grew up in has changed a lot.
That's the song we danced to at our wedding.
The chair you're sitting on is broken.
She's the person I always go to for advice.
The company that I work for has offices in five countries.

Can you tell me who I should speak to?
I don't know what he's so angry about.
Do you remember who you lent my bike to?
She asked me what the money was for.
I wonder who she's writing to.
I forgot which platform my cousin is arriving at.
I can't remember which drawer I put it in.
Do you know where this bus goes to?
He didn't say which team he plays for.
Nobody told us which gate the plane leaves from.
Give the children everything they ask for.
The parcel you've been waiting for arrived this morning.
I finally found the photo I was looking for.
Tell me what you're thinking about.

examples.heading: ① 關係子句：省略 that / which

items.en: The guesthouse we stayed at served homemade bread.
items.zh: 我們住的民宿供應自製麵包。

items.en: Is this the book you were telling me about?
items.zh: 這就是你跟我說的那本書嗎？

items.en: The town I grew up in has changed a lot.
items.zh: 我長大的那個小鎮變了很多。

items.en: That's the song we danced to at our wedding.
items.zh: 那就是我們在婚禮上跳舞的那首歌。

items.en: The chair you're sitting on is broken.
items.zh: 你坐的那張椅子是壞的。

items.en: She's the person I always go to for advice.
items.zh: 她是我需要建議時都會去找的人。

examples.heading: ② 關係子句：that / which / who

items.en: The company that I work for has offices in five countries.
items.zh: 我上班的公司在五個國家都有辦公室。

items.en: The people who we bought the car from were very friendly.
items.zh: 賣車給我們的那家人很友善。

items.en: The course which she signed up for starts in May.
items.zh: 她報名的那門課五月開始。

items.en: Everyone that I spoke to agreed with me.
items.zh: 跟我談過的每個人都同意我的看法。

items.en: The project that we're working on is almost finished.
items.zh: 我們在做的那個計畫快完成了。

examples.heading: ③ 間接問句：who / what

items.en: Can you tell me who I should speak to?
items.zh: 你可以告訴我我該找誰談嗎？

items.en: I don't know what he's so angry about.
items.zh: 我不知道他在氣什麼。

items.en: Do you remember who you lent my bike to?
items.zh: 你記得你把我的腳踏車借給誰了嗎？

items.en: She asked me what the money was for.
items.zh: 她問我那筆錢是做什麼用的。

items.en: I wonder who she's writing to.
items.zh: 我很好奇她在寫信給誰。

examples.heading: ④ 間接問句：which / where

items.en: I forgot which platform my cousin is arriving at.
items.zh: 我忘了我表哥會在哪個月台下車。

items.en: I can't remember which drawer I put it in.
items.zh: 我記不得我把它放在哪個抽屜。

items.en: Do you know where this bus goes to?
items.zh: 你知道這班公車開到哪裡嗎？

items.en: He didn't say which team he plays for.
items.zh: 他沒說他在哪一隊打球。

items.en: Nobody told us which gate the plane leaves from.
items.zh: 沒人告訴我們飛機從哪個登機門出發。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Give the children everything they ask for.
items.zh: 孩子們要什麼都給他們。

items.en: The parcel you've been waiting for arrived this morning.
items.zh: 你一直在等的包裹今天早上到了。

items.en: I finally found the photo I was looking for.
items.zh: 我終於找到我在找的那張照片了。

items.en: Tell me what you're thinking about.
items.zh: 告訴我你在想什麼。

items.en: This is the street my grandparents lived on.
items.zh: 這是我爺爺奶奶以前住的那條街。

items.en: Nobody knows what the meeting is about.
items.zh: 沒人知道這場會議在講什麼。

items.en: The festival we went to last summer was amazing.
items.zh: 我們去年夏天去的那個音樂節很棒。

items.en: I'll show you the room you'll be sleeping in.
items.zh: 我帶你去看你要睡的房間。

items.en: Ask the receptionist which floor the office is on.
items.zh: 問一下櫃台人員辦公室在幾樓。

title: Why don't you act upon my advice?
translation: 你為什麼不照我的建議去做呢？
name: 正式文體中較少用的單字介系詞
sentences: Upon hearing the news, she burst into tears.
Payment is due upon receipt of the invoice.
Once upon a time, there was a poor fisherman.
The decision depends upon the results of the test.
Upon reflection, I think you were right.
The idea is popular amongst young voters.
She felt at home amongst her new colleagues.
Amid all the noise, the baby slept peacefully.
There was a small cottage amongst the trees.
The singer walked onto the stage amid loud applause.
The storm is moving toward the east coast.
The children ran toward the ice cream van.
Unlike its neighbors, the country has no army.
Unlike her sister, Mia hates spicy food.
The boat drifted slowly toward the shore.
I have a question regarding the timetable.
We received several complaints concerning the noise.
Regarding your request, we will reply within a week.
Please read the information concerning safety.
Regarding the party, have you decided on a date?
A strange silence fell upon the room.
Upon entering the building, show your pass to the guard.
The town lies amid green hills.
Unlike most cities, Venice has no cars.
The company has taken a new approach toward training.
I am writing concerning your recent visit to our shop.
There is some disagreement amongst the experts.
Upon request, we can send you a free sample.
The story is based upon real events.
The team worked hard amid difficult conditions.

examples.heading: ① upon

items.en: Upon hearing the news, she burst into tears.
items.zh: 一聽到那個消息，她就哭了出來。

items.en: Payment is due upon receipt of the invoice.
items.zh: 收到發票後就要付款。

items.en: Once upon a time, there was a poor fisherman.
items.zh: 很久很久以前，有一個窮漁夫。

items.en: The decision depends upon the results of the test.
items.zh: 決定要看檢查的結果。

items.en: Upon reflection, I think you were right.
items.zh: 仔細想過之後，我覺得你是對的。

examples.heading: ② amongst / amid

items.en: The idea is popular amongst young voters.
items.zh: 這個想法在年輕選民之間很受歡迎。

items.en: She felt at home amongst her new colleagues.
items.zh: 她跟新同事相處起來很自在。

items.en: Amid all the noise, the baby slept peacefully.
items.zh: 在一片吵雜聲中，寶寶睡得很安穩。

items.en: There was a small cottage amongst the trees.
items.zh: 樹林裡有一間小屋。

items.en: The singer walked onto the stage amid loud applause.
items.zh: 那位歌手在熱烈的掌聲中走上舞台。

examples.heading: ③ toward / unlike

items.en: The storm is moving toward the east coast.
items.zh: 暴風雨正往東海岸移動。

items.en: The children ran toward the ice cream van.
items.zh: 孩子們朝冰淇淋車跑過去。

items.en: Unlike its neighbors, the country has no army.
items.zh: 跟鄰國不一樣，這個國家沒有軍隊。

items.en: Unlike her sister, Mia hates spicy food.
items.zh: 跟她姊姊不一樣，Mia 很討厭吃辣。

items.en: The boat drifted slowly toward the shore.
items.zh: 船慢慢地漂向岸邊。

examples.heading: ④ regarding / concerning

items.en: I have a question regarding the timetable.
items.zh: 我有一個關於時刻表的問題。

items.en: We received several complaints concerning the noise.
items.zh: 我們收到好幾則關於噪音的投訴。

items.en: Regarding your request, we will reply within a week.
items.zh: 關於您的請求，我們會在一週內回覆。

items.en: Please read the information concerning safety.
items.zh: 請閱讀關於安全的資訊。

items.en: Regarding the party, have you decided on a date?
items.zh: 關於派對，你決定日期了嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: A strange silence fell upon the room.
items.zh: 房間裡突然一片奇怪的寂靜。

items.en: Upon entering the building, show your pass to the guard.
items.zh: 進入大樓時，請向警衛出示通行證。

items.en: The town lies amid green hills.
items.zh: 那個小鎮坐落在青山之間。

items.en: Unlike most cities, Venice has no cars.
items.zh: 跟大部分的城市不一樣，威尼斯沒有車。

items.en: The company has taken a new approach toward training.
items.zh: 那家公司對員工訓練採取了新的做法。

items.en: I am writing concerning your recent visit to our shop.
items.zh: 我寫信是關於您最近光臨本店的事。

items.en: There is some disagreement amongst the experts.
items.zh: 專家之間有一些意見分歧。

items.en: Upon request, we can send you a free sample.
items.zh: 如有需要，我們可以寄給您免費的樣品。

items.en: The story is based upon real events.
items.zh: 這個故事是根據真實事件改編的。（is based 是被動）

items.en: The team worked hard amid difficult conditions.
items.zh: 團隊在困難的條件下努力工作。

title: I think the car industry will develop cars that run on solar energy on account of the levels of pollution in big cities.
translation: 我認為，由於大城市的污染程度，汽車業會開發用太陽能跑的車。
name: 較少用的複合介系詞（正式）
sentences: She retired early on account of her health.
The beach is closed on account of the strong currents.
In view of the weather, we've moved the party indoors.
In view of his experience, we offered him the job.
Many people moved away on account of the noise from the airport.
With regard to your question, the answer is on page ten.
I have no comment with regard to the rumours.
The building meets safety standards in accordance with the law.
Please pay the fee in accordance with the contract.
We acted in accordance with your instructions.
You can attach the pages by means of a simple clip.
They crossed the river by means of a rope bridge.
In the event of an emergency, call this number.
In the event of rain, the concert will take place in the hall.
The company communicates with staff by means of a weekly newsletter.
My grandmother's ideas were far ahead of her time.
We finished the project two weeks ahead of schedule.
Please arrive ahead of the other guests.
The team is three points ahead of its rivals.
Ahead of the meeting, please read the attached report.
The museum will close early on account of the public holiday.
In view of recent events, we are reviewing our security.
With regard to payment, we accept all major cards.
Staff must handle all waste in accordance with local rules.
In the event of a delay, passengers will receive a free meal.
Prices have risen sharply on account of the poor harvest.
She got the job ahead of more experienced candidates.
We collected the data by means of an online survey.
I am writing with regard to the invoice you sent last week.
In view of the cost, we have decided not to go ahead.

examples.heading: ① on account of / in view of

items.en: She retired early on account of her health.
items.zh: 她因為健康的關係提早退休了。

items.en: The beach is closed on account of the strong currents.
items.zh: 海灘因為水流很強而關閉。

items.en: In view of the weather, we've moved the party indoors.
items.zh: 考慮到天氣，我們把派對移到室內了。

items.en: In view of his experience, we offered him the job.
items.zh: 考慮到他的經驗，我們給了他這份工作。

items.en: Many people moved away on account of the noise from the airport.
items.zh: 很多人因為機場的噪音搬走了。

examples.heading: ② with regard to / in accordance with

items.en: With regard to your question, the answer is on page ten.
items.zh: 關於您的問題，答案在第十頁。

items.en: I have no comment with regard to the rumours.
items.zh: 關於那些傳言，我不予置評。

items.en: The building meets safety standards in accordance with the law.
items.zh: 這棟建築依照法律符合安全標準。

items.en: Please pay the fee in accordance with the contract.
items.zh: 請依照合約支付費用。

items.en: We acted in accordance with your instructions.
items.zh: 我們依照您的指示行動。

examples.heading: ③ by means of / in the event of

items.en: You can attach the pages by means of a simple clip.
items.zh: 你可以用一個簡單的夾子把這些頁面固定在一起。

items.en: They crossed the river by means of a rope bridge.
items.zh: 他們藉由一座吊橋過了河。

items.en: In the event of an emergency, call this number.
items.zh: 萬一有緊急情況，請打這個號碼。

items.en: In the event of rain, the concert will take place in the hall.
items.zh: 萬一下雨，音樂會將改在禮堂舉行。

items.en: The company communicates with staff by means of a weekly newsletter.
items.zh: 公司藉由每週的電子報跟員工溝通。

examples.heading: ④ ahead of

items.en: My grandmother's ideas were far ahead of her time.
items.zh: 我奶奶的想法遠遠超前了她的時代。

items.en: We finished the project two weeks ahead of schedule.
items.zh: 我們比預定時間提早兩個禮拜完成了計畫。

items.en: Please arrive ahead of the other guests.
items.zh: 請比其他客人早一點到。

items.en: The team is three points ahead of its rivals.
items.zh: 這支隊伍領先對手三分。

items.en: Ahead of the meeting, please read the attached report.
items.zh: 開會之前，請先讀附件的報告。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: The museum will close early on account of the public holiday.
items.zh: 博物館因為國定假日會提早關門。

items.en: In view of recent events, we are reviewing our security.
items.zh: 考慮到最近發生的事，我們正在檢討我們的保全措施。

items.en: With regard to payment, we accept all major cards.
items.zh: 關於付款，我們接受所有主要的信用卡。

items.en: Staff must handle all waste in accordance with local rules.
items.zh: 員工必須依照當地規定處理所有廢棄物。

items.en: In the event of a delay, passengers will receive a free meal.
items.zh: 萬一誤點，乘客可以得到一份免費的餐點。

items.en: Prices have risen sharply on account of the poor harvest.
items.zh: 因為收成不好，價格大幅上漲。

items.en: She got the job ahead of more experienced candidates.
items.zh: 她比更有經驗的應徵者先拿到那份工作。

items.en: We collected the data by means of an online survey.
items.zh: 我們藉由線上問卷收集資料。

items.en: I am writing with regard to the invoice you sent last week.
items.zh: 我寫信是關於您上週寄來的發票。

items.en: In view of the cost, we have decided not to go ahead.
items.zh: 考慮到成本，我們決定不進行了。

title: In my opinion, children need someone to whom they can talk.
translation: 我認為孩子需要一個可以說話的對象。
name: 介系詞放在關係代名詞前面
sentences: The person to whom you should send the form is Ms. Lee.
She's a writer for whom I have great respect.
The colleague with whom I share an office is on holiday.
The people from whom we bought the house have moved abroad.
Every child needs an adult on whom they can rely.
The neighbor to whom we gave our old sofa thanked us with a cake.
The course in which I am most interested starts in September.
The company for which she works is based in Singapore.
The hotel at which we stayed was excellent.
The reasons for which he resigned are still unclear.
The village in which my mother grew up has changed completely.
This is the problem to which I referred in my email.
The charity of which she is the director helps refugees.
The team, of which I was the captain, won the cup.
She has three sisters, all of whom are teachers.
We received fifty applications, most of which were excellent.
I bought ten books, two of which I've already read.
I am writing about the position for which you advertised last week.
Please find attached the report to which I referred.
The department to which you applied will contact you directly.
Please read the terms to which both parties agreed.
The conference at which we first met took place in Kyoto.
Children need friends with whom they can play.
The chair on which she was sitting suddenly broke.
He's the only person in whom I can confide.
The pen with which he signed the contract belonged to his father.
The museum, in which there are over two thousand paintings, opens at ten.
The friend to whom I lent my car has disappeared.
The speed at which technology changes is amazing.
The organization for which my sister volunteers helps homeless people.

examples.heading: ① 介系詞 + whom

items.en: The person to whom you should send the form is Ms. Lee.
items.zh: 你應該把表格寄給李小姐。

items.en: She's a writer for whom I have great respect.
items.zh: 她是一位我很尊敬的作家。

items.en: The colleague with whom I share an office is on holiday.
items.zh: 跟我共用辦公室的同事在休假。

items.en: The people from whom we bought the house have moved abroad.
items.zh: 賣房子給我們的那家人搬到國外去了。

items.en: Every child needs an adult on whom they can rely.
items.zh: 每個孩子都需要一個可以依靠的大人。

items.en: The neighbor to whom we gave our old sofa thanked us with a cake.
items.zh: 我們把舊沙發送給的那位鄰居送了一個蛋糕來謝我們。

examples.heading: ② 介系詞 + which

items.en: The course in which I am most interested starts in September.
items.zh: 我最有興趣的那門課九月開始。

items.en: The company for which she works is based in Singapore.
items.zh: 她工作的公司總部在新加坡。

items.en: The hotel at which we stayed was excellent.
items.zh: 我們住的飯店非常好。

items.en: The reasons for which he resigned are still unclear.
items.zh: 他辭職的原因到現在還不清楚。

items.en: The village in which my mother grew up has changed completely.
items.zh: 我媽媽長大的那個村子已經完全變了。

items.en: This is the problem to which I referred in my email.
items.zh: 這就是我在電子郵件裡提到的問題。

examples.heading: ③ of which / of whom

items.en: The charity of which she is the director helps refugees.
items.zh: 她擔任主任的那個慈善機構幫助難民。

items.en: The team, of which I was the captain, won the cup.
items.zh: 那支隊伍贏得了獎盃，我是隊長。

items.en: She has three sisters, all of whom are teachers.
items.zh: 她有三個姊姊，全都是老師。

items.en: We received fifty applications, most of which were excellent.
items.zh: 我們收到五十份申請，大部分都很優秀。

items.en: I bought ten books, two of which I've already read.
items.zh: 我買了十本書，其中兩本我已經讀過了。

examples.heading: ④ 正式的信件

items.en: I am writing about the position for which you advertised last week.
items.zh: 我寫信是關於貴公司上週刊登的職位。

items.en: Please find attached the report to which I referred.
items.zh: 附件是我提到的報告。

items.en: The department to which you applied will contact you directly.
items.zh: 您申請的部門會直接跟您聯絡。

items.en: Please read the terms to which both parties agreed.
items.zh: 請閱讀雙方同意的條款。

items.en: The conference at which we first met took place in Kyoto.
items.zh: 我們第一次見面的那場研討會在京都舉行。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Children need friends with whom they can play.
items.zh: 孩子需要可以一起玩的朋友。

items.en: The chair on which she was sitting suddenly broke.
items.zh: 她坐的那張椅子突然壞了。

items.en: He's the only person in whom I can confide.
items.zh: 他是我唯一能吐露心事的人。

items.en: The pen with which he signed the contract belonged to his father.
items.zh: 他簽合約用的那支筆是他父親的。

items.en: The museum, in which there are over two thousand paintings, opens at ten.
items.zh: 那間博物館十點開門，裡面有兩千多幅畫。

items.en: The friend to whom I lent my car has disappeared.
items.zh: 我把車借給他的那個朋友不見了。

items.en: The speed at which technology changes is amazing.
items.zh: 科技變化的速度很驚人。

items.en: The organization for which my sister volunteers helps homeless people.
items.zh: 我姊姊擔任志工的那個組織幫助無家可歸的人。

title: I am sending you some flowers because you are not well.
translation: 我要送你一些花，因為你身體不舒服。
name: 現在進行式的肯定句
sentences: Hi Grandma, I am writing to say thank you for the birthday present.
Don't call me now. I am driving to work.
We moved in last week. I'm sending you a photo of our new house.
"Where are you?" "I'm standing outside the cinema."
Sorry, I can't talk. I'm cooking dinner for my parents.
I'm sitting on the train, so the line might go dead.
Can you turn the TV down? The baby is sleeping upstairs.
Mum is making pancakes. Come down for breakfast.
I'll drive you to the station. It's raining quite hard.
My brother can't come to the phone. He's having a shower.
Look at the dog. It's lying in the sun.
Watch out! The clumsy waiter is carrying six plates at once.
Copy these down. Our teacher is writing the answers on the board.
She's working at home today because the office is closed.
We are having a great time here in Rome.
Don't worry about the noise. The children are playing in the garden.
You're doing really well. Keep going.
Dear Ben, we're thinking of you and hoping you feel better soon.
The spare room is full. My grandparents are staying with us this week.
Hurry up. They're waiting for us in the car.
Please wait outside. The students are taking their exam right now.
You're standing on my foot!
I'm making a cake for Sarah's party.
His car is at the garage, so he's riding his bike to school today.
The weather is lovely, so we're having lunch in the park.
Grandma is taking photos of the roses in her garden.

Dad is sitting in the kitchen with a cup of tea.

examples.heading: ① I am + 動詞-ing

items.en: Hi Grandma, I am writing to say thank you for the birthday present.
items.zh: 奶奶好，我寫信是想謝謝您送的生日禮物。

items.en: Don't call me now. I am driving to work.
items.zh: 現在先別打給我。我在開車上班。

items.en: We moved in last week. I'm sending you a photo of our new house.
items.zh: 我們上星期搬進去了。我寄一張我們新家的照片給你。

items.en: "Where are you?" "I'm standing outside the cinema."
items.zh: 你在哪裡？我站在電影院外面。

items.en: Sorry, I can't talk. I'm cooking dinner for my parents.
items.zh: 抱歉，我現在不能講話。我在幫我爸媽煮晚餐。

items.en: I'm sitting on the train, so the line might go dead.
items.zh: 我坐在火車上，所以電話可能會斷。

examples.heading: ② he / she / it + is + 動詞-ing

items.en: Can you turn the TV down? The baby is sleeping upstairs.
items.zh: 電視可以小聲一點嗎？寶寶在樓上睡覺。

items.en: Mum is making pancakes. Come down for breakfast.
items.zh: 媽媽在做鬆餅。下來吃早餐吧。

items.en: I'll drive you to the station. It's raining quite hard.
items.zh: 我開車送你去車站。雨下得滿大的。

items.en: My brother can't come to the phone. He's having a shower.
items.zh: 我哥哥沒辦法接電話。他在洗澡。

items.en: Look at the dog. It's lying in the sun.
items.zh: 你看那隻狗。牠躺在太陽底下。

items.en: Watch out! The clumsy waiter is carrying six plates at once.
items.zh: 小心！那個笨手笨腳的服務生一次端著六個盤子。

items.en: Copy these down. Our teacher is writing the answers on the board.
items.zh: 抄下來。我們老師正在白板上寫答案。

items.en: She's working at home today because the office is closed.
items.zh: 今天辦公室關門，所以她在家工作。

examples.heading: ③ you / we / they + are + 動詞-ing

items.en: We are having a great time here in Rome.
items.zh: 我們在羅馬這裡玩得很開心。

items.en: Don't worry about the noise. The children are playing in the garden.
items.zh: 別在意那些聲音。孩子們在花園裡玩。

items.en: You're doing really well. Keep going.
items.zh: 你做得很好。繼續加油。

items.en: Dear Ben, we're thinking of you and hoping you feel better soon.
items.zh: 親愛的 Ben，我們都很掛念你，希望你早日康復。

items.en: The spare room is full. My grandparents are staying with us this week.
items.zh: 客房住滿了。我爺爺奶奶這個星期住在我們家。

items.en: Hurry up. They're waiting for us in the car.
items.zh: 快點。他們在車上等我們。

items.en: Please wait outside. The students are taking their exam right now.
items.zh: 請在外面等。學生們現在正在考試。

items.en: You're standing on my foot!
items.zh: 你踩到我的腳了！

examples.heading: ④ 去掉字尾的 e 再加 -ing

items.en: I'm making a cake for Sarah's party.
items.zh: 我在幫 Sarah 的派對做蛋糕。

items.en: His car is at the garage, so he's riding his bike to school today.
items.zh: 他的車在修車廠，所以他今天騎腳踏車上學。

items.en: The weather is lovely, so we're having lunch in the park.
items.zh: 天氣很好，所以我們在公園吃午餐。

items.en: Grandma is taking photos of the roses in her garden.
items.zh: 奶奶在拍她花園裡的玫瑰。

examples.heading: ⑤ 重複字尾的子音再加 -ing

items.en: It's so hot today. The kids are swimming in the lake.
items.zh: 今天好熱。孩子們在湖裡游泳。

items.en: Dad is sitting in the kitchen with a cup of tea.
items.zh: 爸爸坐在廚房裡喝茶。

items.en: Look, the bus is stopping. Let's get on.
items.zh: 你看，公車停下來了。我們上車吧。

items.en: The film is beginning. Turn off your phone.
items.zh: 電影開始了。把手機關掉。

items.en: Run! The shop is shutting in five minutes.
items.zh: 快跑！店再五分鐘就要關門了。

title: She plays tennis, and she likes going to the swimming pool.
translation: 她有在打網球，也喜歡去游泳池。
name: 現在簡單式的肯定句（常用動詞）
sentences: Hi, I'm Tom. I live next door, and I am your new neighbour.
Every day at college I learn new words and new things.
We have a big garden, so the kids play outside a lot.
My parents work in the same hospital, so they drive there together.
You speak English very well. Where did you learn it?
They love swimming. They go to the beach every summer.
I like your new haircut. It looks great.
Let me tell you about Amy. She plays tennis, and she likes going to the swimming pool.
Come over on Sunday! My dad cooks dinner on Sundays.
We're too early. The shop opens at nine.
Look at all this hair on my pillow. Our cat sleeps on my bed every night.
Ben loves football. He plays every weekend.
I'm never late. This bus stops right outside my school.
She's only six. My sister watches cartoons every morning before school.
Don't call him late. He goes to bed at ten on school nights.
Grandma does the crossword in the newspaper every day.
We love music class. The teacher finishes every lesson with a song.
My brother studies hard because he wants to be a doctor.
Don't worry about the noise. The baby cries when she's hungry.
I am twelve, and my sister is fifteen.
Welcome to our class. This is your desk.
I like my new school. My friends are very kind to me.
The water is warm. It's perfect for a swim.
You're right. The station is on the left.
My family is big. I have two brothers and one sister.
You can't miss my sister. She has bright red hair.
You can borrow books for free. Our school has a big library.
Can you call after one? We have lunch at twelve thirty.
Buy your bread there. My uncle has a small shop in the town centre.
They can't come out tonight. They have a lot of homework this week.

examples.heading: ① I / you / we / they + 動詞原形

items.en: Hi, I'm Tom. I live next door, and I am your new neighbour.
items.zh: 嗨，我是 Tom。我住隔壁，是你的新鄰居。

items.en: Every day at college I learn new words and new things.
items.zh: 我每天在學校都會學到新的單字和新的東西。

items.en: We have a big garden, so the kids play outside a lot.
items.zh: 我們家有一個大花園，所以孩子們常在外面玩。

items.en: My parents work in the same hospital, so they drive there together.
items.zh: 我爸媽在同一家醫院工作，所以他們一起開車去。

items.en: You speak English very well. Where did you learn it?
items.zh: 你英文說得很好。你在哪裡學的？

items.en: They love swimming. They go to the beach every summer.
items.zh: 他們很愛游泳。他們每年夏天都去海邊。

items.en: I like your new haircut. It looks great.
items.zh: 我喜歡你的新髮型。很好看。

examples.heading: ② he / she / it + 動詞-s

items.en: Let me tell you about Amy. She plays tennis, and she likes going to the swimming pool.
items.zh: 我跟你們介紹一下 Amy。她有在打網球，也喜歡去游泳池。

items.en: Come over on Sunday! My dad cooks dinner on Sundays.
items.zh: 星期天來我家！我爸每個星期天煮晚餐。

items.en: We're too early. The shop opens at nine.
items.zh: 我們太早到了。這家店九點開門。

items.en: Look at all this hair on my pillow. Our cat sleeps on my bed every night.
items.zh: 你看我枕頭上都是毛。我們的貓每天晚上都睡在我床上。

items.en: Ben loves football. He plays every weekend.
items.zh: Ben 很愛足球。他每個週末都踢。

items.en: I'm never late. This bus stops right outside my school.
items.zh: 我從來不遲到。這班公車就停在我學校門口。

examples.heading: ③ he / she / it + 動詞-es

items.en: She's only six. My sister watches cartoons every morning before school.
items.zh: 她才六歲。我妹妹每天早上上學前都看卡通。

items.en: Don't call him late. He goes to bed at ten on school nights.
items.zh: 別太晚打給他。要上學的日子，他十點就睡。

items.en: Grandma does the crossword in the newspaper every day.
items.zh: 奶奶每天都做報紙上的填字遊戲。

items.en: We love music class. The teacher finishes every lesson with a song.
items.zh: 我們很愛上音樂課。老師每堂課都用一首歌結束。

items.en: My brother studies hard because he wants to be a doctor.
items.zh: 我哥哥很用功，因為他想當醫生。

items.en: Don't worry about the noise. The baby cries when she's hungry.
items.zh: 別在意那個聲音。寶寶餓了就會哭。

examples.heading: ④ be：am / is / are

items.en: I am twelve, and my sister is fifteen.
items.zh: 我十二歲，我姊姊十五歲。

items.en: Welcome to our class. This is your desk.
items.zh: 歡迎來我們班。這是你的桌子。

items.en: I like my new school. My friends are very kind to me.
items.zh: 我喜歡我的新學校。我的朋友對我很好。

items.en: The water is warm. It's perfect for a swim.
items.zh: 水很暖。很適合游泳。

items.en: You're right. The station is on the left.
items.zh: 你說得對。車站在左邊。

examples.heading: ⑤ have / has

items.en: My family is big. I have two brothers and one sister.
items.zh: 我家人很多。我有兩個哥哥和一個姊姊。

items.en: You can't miss my sister. She has bright red hair.
items.zh: 你一定認得出我妹妹。她有一頭鮮紅色的頭髮。

items.en: You can borrow books for free. Our school has a big library.
items.zh: 你可以免費借書。我們學校有一間很大的圖書館。

items.en: Can you call after one? We have lunch at twelve thirty.
items.zh: 你可以一點以後再打來嗎？我們十二點半吃午餐。

items.en: Buy your bread there. My uncle has a small shop in the town centre.
items.zh: 去那裡買麵包吧。我舅舅在市中心開了一家小店。

items.en: They can't come out tonight. They have a lot of homework this week.
items.zh: 他們今晚不能出來。他們這個星期有很多功課。

title: The journey takes about half an hour from Paris.
translation: 從巴黎過去大約要半個小時。
name: 現在簡單式的肯定句（較多種動詞）
sentences: You can visit us easily. The journey takes about half an hour from Paris.
Let's walk. It only takes ten minutes.
It takes me an hour to get to work, so I leave at seven.
Start early. Bread takes about four hours to make at home.
The flight to Tokyo takes twelve hours, so bring a book.
You should visit the museum. A ticket costs only five pounds.
Let's take the train. It costs less than the bus.
These shoes cost a lot, but they last for years.
We moved out of town. It costs a lot to live in the city centre.
Bring some coins for the café. A coffee costs three euros here.
My grandma gave me these earrings. They are very important to me, because they bring me good luck.
Don't park there. That yellow line means "no parking".
Is this your umbrella? No, it belongs to my brother.
Thank you so much. Your letter means a lot to me.
The shops are busy now. Every spring brings lots of tourists to our town.
You seem worried. Is everything OK?
Your plan sounds great. Let's do it.
This soup smells wonderful. What's in it?
Your new flat looks really nice in the photos.
Go and say hello to him. The new boy seems very shy.
Thank you for coming. I hope you can come next time too.
Here's your room key. We hope you enjoy your stay with us.
Look at his face. I believe him.
Ask her to sing for you. Grandma remembers every song from her childhood.
"Are you coming to the beach?" "It depends on the weather."
Ask at the front desk. The price depends on the size of the room.
I agree with you. It's a good idea.
My parents agree that I can stay out late on Fridays.
Here's a little present. I wish you a very happy birthday!
My grandma calls before every exam. She wishes me luck every time.

examples.heading: ① take

items.en: You can visit us easily. The journey takes about half an hour from Paris.
items.zh: 你可以很容易來找我們。從巴黎過去大約要半個小時。

items.en: Let's walk. It only takes ten minutes.
items.zh: 我們走路去吧。只要十分鐘。

items.en: It takes me an hour to get to work, so I leave at seven.
items.zh: 我上班要一個小時，所以我七點出門。

items.en: Start early. Bread takes about four hours to make at home.
items.zh: 早點開始。在家做麵包大約要四個小時。

items.en: The flight to Tokyo takes twelve hours, so bring a book.
items.zh: 飛東京要十二個小時，所以帶本書吧。

examples.heading: ② cost

items.en: You should visit the museum. A ticket costs only five pounds.
items.zh: 你應該去那間博物館看看。一張票只要五英鎊。

items.en: Let's take the train. It costs less than the bus.
items.zh: 我們搭火車吧。比公車便宜。

items.en: These shoes cost a lot, but they last for years.
items.zh: 這雙鞋很貴，可是可以穿很多年。

items.en: We moved out of town. It costs a lot to live in the city centre.
items.zh: 我們搬出城了。住在市中心要花很多錢。

items.en: Bring some coins for the café. A coffee costs three euros here.
items.zh: 帶點零錢去咖啡店。這裡一杯咖啡三歐元。

examples.heading: ③ bring / mean / belong

items.en: My grandma gave me these earrings. They are very important to me, because they bring me good luck.
items.zh: 這對耳環是我奶奶送我的。它們對我很重要，因為它們會帶給我好運。

items.en: Don't park there. That yellow line means "no parking".
items.zh: 別停那裡。那條黃線的意思是禁止停車。

items.en: Is this your umbrella? No, it belongs to my brother.
items.zh: 這是你的傘嗎？不是，是我哥哥的。

items.en: Thank you so much. Your letter means a lot to me.
items.zh: 真的很謝謝你。你的信對我來說意義重大。

items.en: The shops are busy now. Every spring brings lots of tourists to our town.
items.zh: 現在店裡都很忙。每年春天都會有很多遊客來我們鎮上。

examples.heading: ④ seem / look / sound / smell

items.en: You seem worried. Is everything OK?
items.zh: 你看起來很擔心。一切都還好嗎？

items.en: Your plan sounds great. Let's do it.
items.zh: 你的計畫聽起來很棒。我們就這麼做吧。

items.en: This soup smells wonderful. What's in it?
items.zh: 這湯好香。裡面放了什麼？

items.en: Your new flat looks really nice in the photos.
items.zh: 你的新公寓在照片裡看起來很漂亮。

items.en: Go and say hello to him. The new boy seems very shy.
items.zh: 去跟他打個招呼。新來的男生好像很害羞。

examples.heading: ⑤ hope / believe / remember

items.en: Thank you for coming. I hope you can come next time too.
items.zh: 謝謝你來。我希望你下次也能來。

items.en: Here's your room key. We hope you enjoy your stay with us.
items.zh: 這是您的房間鑰匙。希望您在我們這裡住得愉快。

items.en: Look at his face. I believe him.
items.zh: 你看他的表情。我相信他。

items.en: Ask her to sing for you. Grandma remembers every song from her childhood.
items.zh: 請她唱歌給你聽。奶奶記得她小時候的每一首歌。

examples.heading: ⑥ depend on / agree / wish

items.en: "Are you coming to the beach?" "It depends on the weather."
items.zh: 你要來海邊嗎？那要看天氣。

items.en: Ask at the front desk. The price depends on the size of the room.
items.zh: 去問櫃檯吧。價格要看房間的大小。

items.en: I agree with you. It's a good idea.
items.zh: 我同意你的看法。這是個好主意。

items.en: My parents agree that I can stay out late on Fridays.
items.zh: 我爸媽同意我星期五可以晚一點回家。

items.en: Here's a little present. I wish you a very happy birthday!
items.zh: 這是一個小禮物。祝你生日快樂！

items.en: My grandma calls before every exam. She wishes me luck every time.
items.zh: 我奶奶每次考試前都會打電話來。她每次都祝我好運。

title: Do you know which present I like best?
translation: 你知道我最喜歡哪一個禮物嗎？
name: Do you know 開頭的間接問句
sentences: Excuse me, do you know where the station is?
I can't find my glasses. Do you know where I put them?
Do you know where Tom lives? I have his birthday card.
We're lost. Do you know where we are on this map?
I need some cash. Do you know where the nearest bank is?
I've got lots of presents this year. Do you know which present I like best?
We need to eat first. Do you know what time the film starts?
Do you know what this word means? I can't find it in my dictionary.
A taxi is too expensive. Do you know which bus goes to the airport?
I have no ideas for a gift. Do you know what Anna wants for her birthday?
There are two keys here. Do you know which one opens the back door?
Do you know how much this jacket costs? There's no price on it.
She looks so young. Do you know how old your grandmother is?
I'm ordering the T-shirts. Do you know how many students are in your class?
My phone is new. Do you know how this camera works?
I want to arrive before lunch. Do you know how long the journey takes?
The shop is closed. Do you know why it's closed today?
We just missed it. Do you know when the next train leaves?
Do you know who that man is? He keeps looking at us.
He slammed the door. Do you know why Mark is so angry?
I need to talk to them. Do you know when your parents get back?
Someone left this on the bus. Do you know whose bag this is?
I'll send you a map. Do you know how to get to my house?
The kids want breakfast. Do you know how to make pancakes?
I've got a free afternoon. Do you know what to do in this town?
I really want to go. Do you know where to buy tickets for the concert?
I left my bag on the train. Do you know who to ask about it?
Excuse me, do you know which platform the next train leaves from?
Sorry to bother you. Do you know where the toilets are?
Hello, do you know what time the museum closes?

examples.heading: ① Do you know where ...

items.en: Excuse me, do you know where the station is?
items.zh: 不好意思，你知道車站在哪裡嗎？

items.en: I can't find my glasses. Do you know where I put them?
items.zh: 我找不到我的眼鏡。你知道我放在哪裡嗎？

items.en: Do you know where Tom lives? I have his birthday card.
items.zh: 你知道 Tom 住在哪裡嗎？我有他的生日卡。

items.en: We're lost. Do you know where we are on this map?
items.zh: 我們迷路了。你知道我們在地圖上的哪裡嗎？

items.en: I need some cash. Do you know where the nearest bank is?
items.zh: 我需要現金。你知道最近的銀行在哪裡嗎？

examples.heading: ② Do you know what / which ...

items.en: I've got lots of presents this year. Do you know which present I like best?
items.zh: 我今年收到很多禮物。你知道我最喜歡哪一個禮物嗎？

items.en: We need to eat first. Do you know what time the film starts?
items.zh: 我們得先吃飯。你知道電影幾點開始嗎？

items.en: Do you know what this word means? I can't find it in my dictionary.
items.zh: 你知道這個字是什麼意思嗎？我在字典裡找不到。

items.en: A taxi is too expensive. Do you know which bus goes to the airport?
items.zh: 計程車太貴了。你知道哪一班公車到機場嗎？

items.en: I have no ideas for a gift. Do you know what Anna wants for her birthday?
items.zh: 我想不到要送什麼。你知道 Anna 生日想要什麼嗎？

items.en: There are two keys here. Do you know which one opens the back door?
items.zh: 這裡有兩把鑰匙。你知道哪一把是開後門的嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Do you know how ...

items.en: Do you know how much this jacket costs? There's no price on it.
items.zh: 你知道這件外套多少錢嗎？上面沒有標價。

items.en: She looks so young. Do you know how old your grandmother is?
items.zh: 她看起來好年輕。你知道你奶奶幾歲嗎？

items.en: I'm ordering the T-shirts. Do you know how many students are in your class?
items.zh: 我在訂 T 恤。你知道你們班有幾個學生嗎？

items.en: My phone is new. Do you know how this camera works?
items.zh: 我的手機是新的。你知道這個相機怎麼用嗎？

items.en: I want to arrive before lunch. Do you know how long the journey takes?
items.zh: 我想在午餐前到。你知道這趟路要多久嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Do you know why / when / who ...

items.en: The shop is closed. Do you know why it's closed today?
items.zh: 店關著。你知道它今天為什麼沒開嗎？

items.en: We just missed it. Do you know when the next train leaves?
items.zh: 我們剛好錯過了。你知道下一班火車什麼時候開嗎？

items.en: Do you know who that man is? He keeps looking at us.
items.zh: 你知道那個男人是誰嗎？他一直看我們。

items.en: He slammed the door. Do you know why Mark is so angry?
items.zh: 他甩門了。你知道 Mark 為什麼那麼生氣嗎？

items.en: I need to talk to them. Do you know when your parents get back?
items.zh: 我得跟他們談談。你知道你爸媽什麼時候回來嗎？

items.en: Someone left this on the bus. Do you know whose bag this is?
items.zh: 有人把這個留在公車上。你知道這是誰的包包嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Do you know + 疑問詞 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: I'll send you a map. Do you know how to get to my house?
items.zh: 我會寄地圖給你。你知道怎麼去我家嗎？

items.en: The kids want breakfast. Do you know how to make pancakes?
items.zh: 孩子們要吃早餐。你會做鬆餅嗎？

items.en: I've got a free afternoon. Do you know what to do in this town?
items.zh: 我下午有空。你知道這個小鎮有什麼好玩的嗎？

items.en: I really want to go. Do you know where to buy tickets for the concert?
items.zh: 我好想去。你知道演唱會的票要去哪裡買嗎？

items.en: I left my bag on the train. Do you know who to ask about it?
items.zh: 我把包包忘在火車上了。你知道要去問誰嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 問陌生人

items.en: Excuse me, do you know which platform the next train leaves from?
items.zh: 不好意思，你知道下一班火車從哪個月台開嗎？

items.en: Sorry to bother you. Do you know where the toilets are?
items.zh: 不好意思打擾了。你知道廁所在哪裡嗎？

items.en: Hello, do you know what time the museum closes?
items.zh: 你好，你知道博物館幾點關門嗎？

title: Not only do they save you filing time, but they also save office space.
translation: 它們不但能幫你省下歸檔的時間，還能節省辦公空間。
name: not only 倒裝句（現在簡單式）
sentences: Let's go digital. Not only do these files save you filing time, but they also save office space.
Sell your car and get a bike. Not only do bikes save money, but they also keep you fit.
They're always tired. Not only do my parents work full-time, but they also look after my grandma.
Not only do trees give us shade, but they also clean the air.
Not only do I enjoy cooking, but I also love washing up.
Not only do the students study hard, but they also help in the community.
Visit our town! Not only does it look nice, but it's also full of places to visit.
Ask Maria for help. Not only does she speak four languages, but she also teaches them.
Not only does this phone take great photos, but it also lasts all day.
Come to his concert. Not only does my brother play the guitar, but he also writes songs.
Not only does the new café serve good coffee, but it also has free Wi-Fi.
Not only does the park have a lake, but it also has a small zoo.
Not only does exercise help your body, but it also improves your mood.
Book this place. Not only is the flat cheap, but it's also close to the station.
You'll love this hotel. Not only are the staff friendly, but they also speak English.
Not only is this book interesting, but it's also easy to read.
Not only is our teacher kind, but she's also very funny.
Forget the final. Not only are the tickets expensive, but they're also hard to get.
I'm tired of my brother. Not only does he never call, but he also forgets my birthday.
I hate the number 12. Not only does the bus come late, but it's also always full.
Not only does the new law protect workers, but it also helps small companies.
Not only do electric cars cut pollution, but they also cost less to run.
Not only does the report show the problem, but it also offers a solution.
Not only do online courses save time, but they also reach more students.
Not only does the museum attract tourists, but it also creates jobs.
Buy the leather ones. These bags not only look good but also last for years.
Watch her in the show. She not only sings but also dances.
The plan is not only cheap but also quick.
My husband is great. He not only cooks but also cleans the kitchen afterwards.
This app is not only free but also very easy to use.

examples.heading: ① Not only do + 複數主詞

items.en: Let's go digital. Not only do these files save you filing time, but they also save office space.
items.zh: 我們改用電子檔吧。這些檔案不但能幫你省下歸檔的時間，還能節省辦公空間。

items.en: Sell your car and get a bike. Not only do bikes save money, but they also keep you fit.
items.zh: 把車賣了，買台腳踏車吧。腳踏車不只省錢，還能讓你保持健康。

items.en: They're always tired. Not only do my parents work full-time, but they also look after my grandma.
items.zh: 他們總是很累。我爸媽不只全職工作，還要照顧我奶奶。

items.en: Not only do trees give us shade, but they also clean the air.
items.zh: 樹不只給我們遮蔭，還能淨化空氣。

items.en: Not only do I enjoy cooking, but I also love washing up.
items.zh: 我不只喜歡煮飯，也很喜歡洗碗。

items.en: Not only do the students study hard, but they also help in the community.
items.zh: 這些學生不只用功讀書，還在社區幫忙。

examples.heading: ② Not only does + 單數主詞

items.en: Visit our town! Not only does it look nice, but it's also full of places to visit.
items.zh: 來我們鎮上玩吧！這裡不只很漂亮，還有很多地方可以參觀。

items.en: Ask Maria for help. Not only does she speak four languages, but she also teaches them.
items.zh: 去找 Maria 幫忙。她不只會說四種語言，還會教。

items.en: Not only does this phone take great photos, but it also lasts all day.
items.zh: 這支手機不只拍照很好看，電池還能撐一整天。

items.en: Come to his concert. Not only does my brother play the guitar, but he also writes songs.
items.zh: 來聽他的演唱會吧。我哥哥不只會彈吉他，還會寫歌。

items.en: Not only does the new café serve good coffee, but it also has free Wi-Fi.
items.zh: 那家新咖啡店不只咖啡好喝，還有免費 Wi-Fi。

items.en: Not only does the park have a lake, but it also has a small zoo.
items.zh: 這座公園不只有湖，還有一座小動物園。

items.en: Not only does exercise help your body, but it also improves your mood.
items.zh: 運動不只對身體好，還能讓心情變好。

examples.heading: ③ Not only is / are + 主詞

items.en: Book this place. Not only is the flat cheap, but it's also close to the station.
items.zh: 訂這間吧。這間公寓不只便宜，還離車站很近。

items.en: You'll love this hotel. Not only are the staff friendly, but they also speak English.
items.zh: 你會喜歡這家飯店的。員工不只很親切，還會說英文。

items.en: Not only is this book interesting, but it's also easy to read.
items.zh: 這本書不只有趣，還很好讀。

items.en: Not only is our teacher kind, but she's also very funny.
items.zh: 我們老師不只人好，還很好笑。

items.en: Forget the final. Not only are the tickets expensive, but they're also hard to get.
items.zh: 決賽就別想了。票不只很貴，還很難買到。

examples.heading: ④ 說兩件不好的事

items.en: I'm tired of my brother. Not only does he never call, but he also forgets my birthday.
items.zh: 我受夠我哥了。他不只從來不打電話，還忘記我的生日。

items.en: I hate the number 12. Not only does the bus come late, but it's also always full.
items.zh: 我討厭十二號公車。它不只晚來，還總是擠滿了人。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式的文字

items.en: Not only does the new law protect workers, but it also helps small companies.
items.zh: 新的法律不只保護勞工，還幫助小公司。

items.en: Not only do electric cars cut pollution, but they also cost less to run.
items.zh: 電動車不只減少污染，用起來也比較省錢。

items.en: Not only does the report show the problem, but it also offers a solution.
items.zh: 這份報告不只指出問題，還提出解決辦法。

items.en: Not only do online courses save time, but they also reach more students.
items.zh: 線上課程不只省時間，還能接觸到更多學生。

items.en: Not only does the museum attract tourists, but it also creates jobs.
items.zh: 博物館不只吸引觀光客，還創造工作機會。

examples.heading: ⑥ 一般語序：not only ... but also

items.en: Buy the leather ones. These bags not only look good but also last for years.
items.zh: 買皮的吧。這些包包不只好看，還能用很多年。

items.en: Watch her in the show. She not only sings but also dances.
items.zh: 去看她的表演。她不只會唱歌，還會跳舞。

items.en: The plan is not only cheap but also quick.
items.zh: 這個計畫不只便宜，還很快。

items.en: My husband is great. He not only cooks but also cleans the kitchen afterwards.
items.zh: 我老公很棒。他不只煮飯，煮完還會清理廚房。

items.en: This app is not only free but also very easy to use.
items.zh: 這個 app 不只免費，還很好用。

title: The fridge isn't working.
translation: 冰箱壞了。
name: 現在進行式的否定句
sentences: You can have my laptop. I'm not using it any more.
I'm not feeling well, so I'm staying home today.
Don't worry, I'm not leaving without you.
Sorry, I'm not listening. Can you say that again?
I'm not wearing a coat because it's so warm today.
I am not asking you to pay. I just need a lift.
I called the landlord this morning. The fridge isn't working.
Leave him alone. He isn't feeling very well.
My phone isn't charging. Can I borrow your cable?
Can you turn the radio off? It isn't helping me concentrate.
It isn't raining any more. Let's go for a walk.
Dad isn't eating breakfast because he's going to work at five.
I need this poster in colour, but the printer isn't printing in colour again.
The kids aren't sleeping. I can hear them talking.
You aren't trying hard enough. Practise a bit more.
We aren't going to the party. We're too tired.
The trains aren't running today because of the snow.
Those plants aren't growing. Maybe they need more sun.
Rents have gone up, so many shops aren't doing well this year.
She's not answering her phone. Is she at work?
We're not staying long. We just came to say hello.
He's not playing in today's match because he hurt his knee.
They're not selling tickets at the door, so book online.
You're not making any sense. Calm down and start again.
It's not working. Try turning it off and on again.
Please note that the museum is not opening on Monday.
We are not accepting any more applications this year.
Don't believe the rumour. The company is not planning to close the shop.
Our team is not giving up. We still have ten minutes.
The guests are not arriving until eight, so we have time to cook.

examples.heading: ① I'm not + 動詞-ing

items.en: You can have my laptop. I'm not using it any more.
items.zh: 你可以拿我的筆電。我不用了。

items.en: I'm not feeling well, so I'm staying home today.
items.zh: 我不太舒服，所以今天待在家。

items.en: Don't worry, I'm not leaving without you.
items.zh: 別擔心，我不會丟下你自己走。

items.en: Sorry, I'm not listening. Can you say that again?
items.zh: 抱歉，我沒在聽。你可以再說一次嗎？

items.en: I'm not wearing a coat because it's so warm today.
items.zh: 今天很暖和，所以我沒穿外套。

items.en: I am not asking you to pay. I just need a lift.
items.zh: 我不是要你付錢。我只是需要搭個便車。

examples.heading: ② isn't + 動詞-ing

items.en: I called the landlord this morning. The fridge isn't working.
items.zh: 我今天早上打給房東了。冰箱壞了。

items.en: Leave him alone. He isn't feeling very well.
items.zh: 讓他靜一靜。他不太舒服。

items.en: My phone isn't charging. Can I borrow your cable?
items.zh: 我的手機充不了電。可以借我你的線嗎？

items.en: Can you turn the radio off? It isn't helping me concentrate.
items.zh: 你可以把收音機關掉嗎？它讓我沒辦法專心。

items.en: It isn't raining any more. Let's go for a walk.
items.zh: 雨停了。我們去散步吧。

items.en: Dad isn't eating breakfast because he's going to work at five.
items.zh: 爸爸五點就要去上班，所以他沒吃早餐。

items.en: I need this poster in colour, but the printer isn't printing in colour again.
items.zh: 我需要這張海報印彩色的，可是印表機又印不出彩色了。

examples.heading: ③ aren't + 動詞-ing

items.en: The kids aren't sleeping. I can hear them talking.
items.zh: 孩子們沒在睡。我聽得到他們在講話。

items.en: You aren't trying hard enough. Practise a bit more.
items.zh: 你不夠努力。再多練習一點。

items.en: We aren't going to the party. We're too tired.
items.zh: 我們不去派對了。我們太累了。

items.en: The trains aren't running today because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，今天火車停駛。

items.en: Those plants aren't growing. Maybe they need more sun.
items.zh: 那些植物都不長。也許它們需要多一點陽光。

items.en: Rents have gone up, so many shops aren't doing well this year.
items.zh: 房租漲了，所以今年很多店生意都不好。

examples.heading: ④ 's not / 're not + 動詞-ing

items.en: She's not answering her phone. Is she at work?
items.zh: 她不接電話。她在上班嗎？

items.en: We're not staying long. We just came to say hello.
items.zh: 我們不會待很久。我們只是來打個招呼。

items.en: He's not playing in today's match because he hurt his knee.
items.zh: 他膝蓋受傷了，所以今天的比賽他不上場。

items.en: They're not selling tickets at the door, so book online.
items.zh: 他們現場不賣票，所以要上網訂。

items.en: You're not making any sense. Calm down and start again.
items.zh: 你講的話我聽不懂。冷靜一下，再從頭講一次。

items.en: It's not working. Try turning it off and on again.
items.zh: 還是不行。試試看關掉再打開。

examples.heading: ⑤ am / is / are not + 動詞-ing（不縮寫）

items.en: Please note that the museum is not opening on Monday.
items.zh: 請注意，博物館星期一不開放。

items.en: We are not accepting any more applications this year.
items.zh: 我們今年不再接受申請。

items.en: Don't believe the rumour. The company is not planning to close the shop.
items.zh: 別相信那個傳言。公司沒有打算關掉這家店。

items.en: Our team is not giving up. We still have ten minutes.
items.zh: 我們隊不會放棄。我們還有十分鐘。

items.en: The guests are not arriving until eight, so we have time to cook.
items.zh: 客人八點才到，所以我們還有時間做飯。

title: You don't know the place.
translation: 你不熟那個地方。
name: 現在簡單式的否定句（常用動詞）
sentences: Let me pick you up. You don't know the place.
No sausages for me, thanks. I don't like meat and fish.
We don't have a car, so we take the bus everywhere.
Sorry, I don't know the answer. Ask the teacher.
They don't live here any more. They moved to Leeds.
You go to the party. I don't want to dance with strangers.
Leave your passport at home. You don't need it for this trip.
Send Grandma a letter. My grandparents don't use the internet.
Cats don't like water, so bathing ours is hard.
My brother doesn't eat breakfast. He's never hungry in the morning.
She doesn't speak French, so I translate for her.
Use the stairs. The lift doesn't work.
Tom doesn't like football, but he loves tennis.
This shop doesn't sell stamps. Try the post office.
My mum doesn't drive, so my dad takes her to work.
Bring sun cream, not an umbrella. It doesn't rain much here in summer.
He always plays alone. He doesn't have any brothers or sisters.
No more cake for me, thanks. I'm not hungry.
Come back tomorrow. The doctor isn't here today.
Can we sit down for a bit? These shoes aren't very comfortable.
Everyone thinks so, but I'm not Scottish. My parents are from Wales.
The museum isn't far. You can walk there.
My parents aren't at home. Can I take a message?
It isn't my bag. Mine is blue.
Keep your money. Children under five do not pay on the bus.
Bring some sandwiches. The ticket does not include lunch.
It's very relaxed here. Students do not wear uniforms at this school.
We can't take the dog. The hotel does not allow pets.
Can you help me, Miss? I do not understand this question at all.
Our flat does not have a garden, but it has a big balcony.

examples.heading: ① I / you / we / they + don't

items.en: Let me pick you up. You don't know the place.
items.zh: 我去接你吧。你不熟那個地方。

items.en: No sausages for me, thanks. I don't like meat and fish.
items.zh: 香腸我不用了，謝謝。我不喜歡肉和魚。

items.en: We don't have a car, so we take the bus everywhere.
items.zh: 我們沒有車，所以去哪都搭公車。

items.en: Sorry, I don't know the answer. Ask the teacher.
items.zh: 抱歉，我不知道答案。問老師吧。

items.en: They don't live here any more. They moved to Leeds.
items.zh: 他們不住這裡了。他們搬去里茲了。

items.en: You go to the party. I don't want to dance with strangers.
items.zh: 你去派對吧。我不想跟陌生人跳舞。

items.en: Leave your passport at home. You don't need it for this trip.
items.zh: 護照放家裡吧。這趟旅行用不到。

items.en: Send Grandma a letter. My grandparents don't use the internet.
items.zh: 寄封信給奶奶吧。我爺爺奶奶不用網路。

items.en: Cats don't like water, so bathing ours is hard.
items.zh: 貓不喜歡水，所以幫我們家的貓洗澡很難。

examples.heading: ② he / she / it + doesn't

items.en: My brother doesn't eat breakfast. He's never hungry in the morning.
items.zh: 我哥哥不吃早餐。他早上從來不餓。

items.en: She doesn't speak French, so I translate for her.
items.zh: 她不會說法文，所以我幫她翻譯。

items.en: Use the stairs. The lift doesn't work.
items.zh: 走樓梯吧。電梯壞了。

items.en: Tom doesn't like football, but he loves tennis.
items.zh: Tom 不喜歡足球，可是他很愛網球。

items.en: This shop doesn't sell stamps. Try the post office.
items.zh: 這家店不賣郵票。去郵局看看。

items.en: My mum doesn't drive, so my dad takes her to work.
items.zh: 我媽不開車，所以我爸載她去上班。

items.en: Bring sun cream, not an umbrella. It doesn't rain much here in summer.
items.zh: 帶防曬乳，不用帶傘。這裡夏天不太下雨。

items.en: He always plays alone. He doesn't have any brothers or sisters.
items.zh: 他總是一個人玩。他沒有兄弟姊妹。

examples.heading: ③ I'm not / isn't / aren't

items.en: No more cake for me, thanks. I'm not hungry.
items.zh: 我不用再吃蛋糕了，謝謝。我不餓。

items.en: Come back tomorrow. The doctor isn't here today.
items.zh: 明天再來吧。醫生今天不在。

items.en: Can we sit down for a bit? These shoes aren't very comfortable.
items.zh: 我們可以坐一下嗎？這雙鞋不太好穿。

items.en: Everyone thinks so, but I'm not Scottish. My parents are from Wales.
items.zh: 大家都這麼以為，可是我不是蘇格蘭人。我爸媽是威爾斯人。

items.en: The museum isn't far. You can walk there.
items.zh: 博物館不遠。你可以走過去。

items.en: My parents aren't at home. Can I take a message?
items.zh: 我爸媽不在家。要我幫你留話嗎？

items.en: It isn't my bag. Mine is blue.
items.zh: 這不是我的包包。我的是藍色的。

examples.heading: ④ do not / does not（不縮寫）

items.en: Keep your money. Children under five do not pay on the bus.
items.zh: 錢收起來吧。五歲以下的小孩搭公車不用付錢。

items.en: Bring some sandwiches. The ticket does not include lunch.
items.zh: 帶點三明治吧。票價不含午餐。

items.en: It's very relaxed here. Students do not wear uniforms at this school.
items.zh: 這裡很自由。這所學校的學生不穿制服。

items.en: We can't take the dog. The hotel does not allow pets.
items.zh: 我們不能帶狗去。這家飯店不准帶寵物。

items.en: Can you help me, Miss? I do not understand this question at all.
items.zh: 老師，你可以幫我嗎？這一題我完全看不懂。

items.en: Our flat does not have a garden, but it has a big balcony.
items.zh: 我們的公寓沒有花園，可是有一個大陽台。

title: It doesn't cost very much.
translation: 那不會很貴。
name: 現在簡單式的否定句（較多種動詞）
sentences: Come and join the class. It doesn't cost very much.
Try the market. Fruit doesn't cost much there.
Leave the car here. It doesn't take long to walk to the beach.
The bus doesn't take you to the door, but it's close.
Let's cook at home. Making soup doesn't take much time.
Thanks, but I don't need the video because I've got the DVD.
Here's the plan for Monday. You don't bring anything because it's the first day.
My grandma is eighty, but she doesn't need glasses for reading.
Water them once a week. The plants don't need much water in winter.
We don't need a car. We live near the station.
"Sorry I'm late." "It doesn't matter. We haven't started yet."
I don't mind the rain. I like walking in it.
My parents don't mind if I stay out until ten.
It doesn't matter what you wear. It's a casual party.
Ask Sam to drive. He doesn't mind long journeys.
This book doesn't belong to me. It's Ben's.
One bad test doesn't mean you're a bad student.
I need new clothes. These jeans don't fit me any more.
Be careful with that word. It doesn't mean the same thing in English.
The red car doesn't belong to us. Ours is the blue one.
Don't try to call me this weekend. My phone doesn't work in the mountains.
I don't understand this letter. Can you help me?
There's no rush. The shop doesn't open until ten on Sundays.
Leave your dog at home. They don't allow dogs in the restaurant.
He was only four then. My brother doesn't remember anything about his first school.
I need a new laptop. This old one doesn't save my files any more.
You'll be tired for a while. Babies don't sleep through the night at first.
She laughs at scary films. My grandma doesn't believe in ghosts.
We love our teacher. She doesn't give homework at weekends.
You go without me. I don't feel like going out tonight.

examples.heading: ① doesn't cost / doesn't take

items.en: Come and join the class. It doesn't cost very much.
items.zh: 來上課吧。不會很貴。

items.en: Try the market. Fruit doesn't cost much there.
items.zh: 去市場看看。那裡的水果不貴。

items.en: Leave the car here. It doesn't take long to walk to the beach.
items.zh: 車停這裡吧。走到海邊不用很久。

items.en: The bus doesn't take you to the door, but it's close.
items.zh: 公車不會載你到門口，可是很近。

items.en: Let's cook at home. Making soup doesn't take much time.
items.zh: 我們在家煮吧。煮湯不用花很多時間。

examples.heading: ② don't / doesn't need

items.en: Thanks, but I don't need the video because I've got the DVD.
items.zh: 謝謝，可是我不需要錄影帶，因為我有 DVD 了。

items.en: Here's the plan for Monday. You don't bring anything because it's the first day.
items.zh: 這是星期一的安排。第一天你不用帶任何東西。

items.en: My grandma is eighty, but she doesn't need glasses for reading.
items.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了，可是她看書不用戴眼鏡。

items.en: Water them once a week. The plants don't need much water in winter.
items.zh: 一個星期澆一次就好。冬天植物不用澆很多水。

items.en: We don't need a car. We live near the station.
items.zh: 我們不需要車。我們住在車站附近。

examples.heading: ③ doesn't matter / don't mind

items.en: "Sorry I'm late." "It doesn't matter. We haven't started yet."
items.zh: 抱歉我遲到了。沒關係。我們還沒開始。

items.en: I don't mind the rain. I like walking in it.
items.zh: 我不在意下雨。我喜歡在雨中散步。

items.en: My parents don't mind if I stay out until ten.
items.zh: 我爸媽不介意我在外面待到十點。

items.en: It doesn't matter what you wear. It's a casual party.
items.zh: 你穿什麼都沒關係。這是個輕鬆的派對。

items.en: Ask Sam to drive. He doesn't mind long journeys.
items.zh: 請 Sam 開車吧。他不介意長途開車。

examples.heading: ④ don't / doesn't mean / belong / fit

items.en: This book doesn't belong to me. It's Ben's.
items.zh: 這本書不是我的。是 Ben 的。

items.en: One bad test doesn't mean you're a bad student.
items.zh: 考壞一次不代表你是壞學生。

items.en: I need new clothes. These jeans don't fit me any more.
items.zh: 我需要買新衣服了。這條牛仔褲我穿不下了。

items.en: Be careful with that word. It doesn't mean the same thing in English.
items.zh: 那個字要小心用。它在英文裡不是同一個意思。

items.en: The red car doesn't belong to us. Ours is the blue one.
items.zh: 那台紅色的車不是我們的。我們的是藍色那台。

examples.heading: ⑤ 其他動詞

items.en: Don't try to call me this weekend. My phone doesn't work in the mountains.
items.zh: 這個週末別打給我。我的手機在山裡沒訊號。

items.en: I don't understand this letter. Can you help me?
items.zh: 我看不懂這封信。你可以幫我嗎？

items.en: There's no rush. The shop doesn't open until ten on Sundays.
items.zh: 不用急。這家店星期天十點才開。

items.en: Leave your dog at home. They don't allow dogs in the restaurant.
items.zh: 把狗留在家吧。這家餐廳不准帶狗。

items.en: He was only four then. My brother doesn't remember anything about his first school.
items.zh: 他那時候才四歲。我哥哥對他的第一所學校一點印象都沒有。

items.en: I need a new laptop. This old one doesn't save my files any more.
items.zh: 我需要一台新筆電。這台舊的已經存不了我的檔案了。

items.en: You'll be tired for a while. Babies don't sleep through the night at first.
items.zh: 你會累一陣子。嬰兒一開始不會整夜睡。

items.en: She laughs at scary films. My grandma doesn't believe in ghosts.
items.zh: 她看恐怖片都在笑。我奶奶不相信有鬼。

items.en: We love our teacher. She doesn't give homework at weekends.
items.zh: 我們很喜歡我們老師。她週末不出功課。

items.en: You go without me. I don't feel like going out tonight.
items.zh: 你們去吧，不用等我。我今晚不想出去。

title: What are you bringing with you?
translation: 你要帶什麼東西來？
name: 現在進行式的 wh- 疑問句
sentences: Hi Jo, I'm packing for the weekend. What are you bringing with you?
You look busy. What are you working on?
I can smell something lovely. What are you cooking?
Dear Grandma, what are you doing for your birthday this year?
What is he saying? I can't hear him.
What are the children watching? It sounds scary.
Where are you staying when you visit London?
Your bag is packed. Where are you going?
I heard he left the bank. Where is your brother working now?
I've lost the message. Where are we meeting the others tonight?
I'm at the station. Where are you waiting?
Dear Mom, how are you doing? I miss you all.
It's been two weeks now. How is your new job going?
You've been in Paris a month. How are you finding the city?
You moved last month. How are the kids getting on at their new school?
I can't drive you tomorrow. How are you getting to the airport?
Thanks for your letter. When are you coming to see us?
Your eyes are red. Why are you crying, sweetheart?
I've bought a little gift. When is your sister having her baby?
The traffic is terrible. Why are they digging up the road again?
It's late. Why are you still working?
I hear they sold the house. When are your parents moving to the new flat?
You've been on the phone for an hour. Who are you talking to?
You've got your best dress on. Who are you meeting tonight?
Who is she waving at? I don't know those people.
Mum is out tonight. Who is cooking dinner?
I'm buying the drinks. Who's coming to your party on Saturday?
What's happening outside? I can hear sirens.
The office is empty. Who is answering the phones this week?
The kitchen smells awful. What's burning?

examples.heading: ① What + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: Hi Jo, I'm packing for the weekend. What are you bringing with you?
items.zh: 嗨 Jo，我在收拾週末的行李。你要帶什麼東西來？

items.en: You look busy. What are you working on?
items.zh: 你看起來很忙。你在忙什麼？

items.en: I can smell something lovely. What are you cooking?
items.zh: 我聞到好香的味道。你在煮什麼？

items.en: Dear Grandma, what are you doing for your birthday this year?
items.zh: 親愛的奶奶，您今年生日要怎麼過？

items.en: What is he saying? I can't hear him.
items.zh: 他在說什麼？我聽不到。

items.en: What are the children watching? It sounds scary.
items.zh: 孩子們在看什麼？聽起來很恐怖。

examples.heading: ② Where + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: Where are you staying when you visit London?
items.zh: 你去倫敦的時候住哪裡？

items.en: Your bag is packed. Where are you going?
items.zh: 你的包包都收好了。你要去哪裡？
