items.en: I heard he left the bank. Where is your brother working now?
items.zh: 我聽說他離開銀行了。你哥哥現在在哪裡工作？

items.en: I've lost the message. Where are we meeting the others tonight?
items.zh: 我把訊息弄丟了。我們今晚在哪裡跟其他人碰面？

items.en: I'm at the station. Where are you waiting?
items.zh: 我在車站了。你在哪裡等？

examples.heading: ③ How + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: Dear Mom, how are you doing? I miss you all.
items.zh: 親愛的媽，您最近好嗎？我好想你們。

items.en: It's been two weeks now. How is your new job going?
items.zh: 已經兩個星期了。你的新工作還順利嗎？

items.en: You've been in Paris a month. How are you finding the city?
items.zh: 你到巴黎一個月了。你覺得這座城市怎麼樣？

items.en: You moved last month. How are the kids getting on at their new school?
items.zh: 你們上個月搬家了。孩子們在新學校適應得怎麼樣？

items.en: I can't drive you tomorrow. How are you getting to the airport?
items.zh: 我明天沒辦法載你。你要怎麼去機場？

examples.heading: ④ When / Why + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: Thanks for your letter. When are you coming to see us?
items.zh: 謝謝你的信。你什麼時候要來看我們？

items.en: Your eyes are red. Why are you crying, sweetheart?
items.zh: 你的眼睛紅紅的。寶貝，你為什麼在哭？

items.en: I've bought a little gift. When is your sister having her baby?
items.zh: 我買了一個小禮物。你姊姊預產期是什麼時候？

items.en: The traffic is terrible. Why are they digging up the road again?
items.zh: 交通好塞。他們為什麼又在挖馬路？

items.en: It's late. Why are you still working?
items.zh: 很晚了。你為什麼還在工作？

items.en: I hear they sold the house. When are your parents moving to the new flat?
items.zh: 我聽說他們把房子賣了。你爸媽什麼時候搬去新公寓？

examples.heading: ⑤ Who + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing（疑問詞當受詞）

items.en: You've been on the phone for an hour. Who are you talking to?
items.zh: 你講電話講了一個小時。你在跟誰講？

items.en: You've got your best dress on. Who are you meeting tonight?
items.zh: 你穿了最好的那件洋裝。你今晚要跟誰見面？

items.en: Who is she waving at? I don't know those people.
items.zh: 她在跟誰揮手？我不認識那些人。

examples.heading: ⑥ Who / What + is + 動詞-ing（疑問詞當主詞）

items.en: Mum is out tonight. Who is cooking dinner?
items.zh: 媽媽今晚不在。誰要煮晚餐？

items.en: I'm buying the drinks. Who's coming to your party on Saturday?
items.zh: 飲料我來買。星期六誰會來你的派對？

items.en: What's happening outside? I can hear sirens.
items.zh: 外面發生什麼事了？我聽到警笛聲。

items.en: The office is empty. Who is answering the phones this week?
items.zh: 辦公室都沒人。這個星期誰在接電話？

items.en: The kitchen smells awful. What's burning?
items.zh: 廚房好臭。什麼東西燒焦了？

title: What do you think about my mobile phone?
translation: 你覺得我的手機怎麼樣？
name: 現在簡單式以 you 當主詞的疑問句
sentences: I'm buying a new one. Do you have a mobile phone?
We're having a concert at school next week. Do you want to come?
Do you like spicy food? This curry is quite hot.
I need a dictionary. Do you have one I can borrow?
Do you play any sports? You look very fit.
Ben says hello to you every morning. Do you know him from football?
Do you walk to school, or does your mum drive you?
I bought a new phone. What do you think about it?
I always stay at home. What do you usually do at the weekend?
You can choose. What do you want for dinner?
Nice to meet you. What do you do? Are you a teacher?
You live so far away. What time do you get up on school days?
Your English is really good. Where do you study?
I can drop you off on my way home. Where do you live now?
Let's have dinner together. When do you finish work today?
Where do you buy your vegetables? They're always so fresh.
I want to visit you. When do you have your piano lessons?
I have four tickets. Who do you want to come to the concert?
I'm painting your room. Which colour do you like best?
Tell me about your new school. Who do you sit next to in class?
There are two cakes. Which one do you want?
You don't have a car. How do you get to work? By train?
They live in the country. How often do you visit your grandparents?
That's a hard language. Why do you want to learn Japanese?
I'm writing your name on the list. How do you spell it?
There are empty seats at the front. Why do you always sit at the back?
"Do you like dogs?" "Yes, I do. I have two."
"Do you need any help?" "No, I don't, thanks."
"Do you live near here?" "Yes, I do. Just round the corner."
"Do you drink coffee?" "No, I don't. Just tea."

examples.heading: ① Do you + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm buying a new one. Do you have a mobile phone?
items.zh: 我要買一支新的。你有手機嗎？

items.en: We're having a concert at school next week. Do you want to come?
items.zh: 我們學校下星期有音樂會。你想來嗎？

items.en: Do you like spicy food? This curry is quite hot.
items.zh: 你喜歡吃辣嗎？這道咖哩滿辣的。

items.en: I need a dictionary. Do you have one I can borrow?
items.zh: 我需要一本字典。你有可以借我的嗎？

items.en: Do you play any sports? You look very fit.
items.zh: 你有在運動嗎？你看起來身材很好。

items.en: Ben says hello to you every morning. Do you know him from football?
items.zh: Ben 每天早上都跟你打招呼。你是踢足球認識他的嗎？

items.en: Do you walk to school, or does your mum drive you?
items.zh: 你走路上學，還是你媽開車送你？

examples.heading: ② What do you ...

items.en: I bought a new phone. What do you think about it?
items.zh: 我買了一支新手機。你覺得怎麼樣？

items.en: I always stay at home. What do you usually do at the weekend?
items.zh: 我都待在家。你週末通常都做什麼？

items.en: You can choose. What do you want for dinner?
items.zh: 你來選。你晚餐想吃什麼？

items.en: Nice to meet you. What do you do? Are you a teacher?
items.zh: 很高興認識你。你是做什麼的？你是老師嗎？

items.en: You live so far away. What time do you get up on school days?
items.zh: 你住得好遠。你上學的日子幾點起床？

examples.heading: ③ Where / When do you ...

items.en: Your English is really good. Where do you study?
items.zh: 你英文很好。你在哪裡學的？

items.en: I can drop you off on my way home. Where do you live now?
items.zh: 我可以回家時順路載你。你現在住在哪裡？

items.en: Let's have dinner together. When do you finish work today?
items.zh: 我們一起吃晚餐吧。你今天什麼時候下班？

items.en: Where do you buy your vegetables? They're always so fresh.
items.zh: 你都在哪裡買菜？你的菜總是好新鮮。

items.en: I want to visit you. When do you have your piano lessons?
items.zh: 我想去找你。你什麼時候上鋼琴課？

examples.heading: ④ Who / Which do you ...

items.en: I have four tickets. Who do you want to come to the concert?
items.zh: 我有四張票。你想找誰來音樂會？

items.en: I'm painting your room. Which colour do you like best?
items.zh: 我要幫你油漆房間。你最喜歡哪個顏色？

items.en: Tell me about your new school. Who do you sit next to in class?
items.zh: 跟我說說你的新學校。你上課坐在誰旁邊？

items.en: There are two cakes. Which one do you want?
items.zh: 有兩個蛋糕。你要哪一個？

examples.heading: ⑤ How / Why do you ...

items.en: You don't have a car. How do you get to work? By train?
items.zh: 你沒有車。你怎麼去上班？搭火車嗎？

items.en: They live in the country. How often do you visit your grandparents?
items.zh: 他們住在鄉下。你多久去看一次你爺爺奶奶？

items.en: That's a hard language. Why do you want to learn Japanese?
items.zh: 那是很難的語言。你為什麼想學日文？

items.en: I'm writing your name on the list. How do you spell it?
items.zh: 我要把你的名字寫在名單上。你的名字怎麼拼？

items.en: There are empty seats at the front. Why do you always sit at the back?
items.zh: 前面有空位。你為什麼總是坐在後面？

examples.heading: ⑥ 回答是非問句

items.en: "Do you like dogs?" "Yes, I do. I have two."
items.zh: 你喜歡狗嗎？喜歡。我養了兩隻。

items.en: "Do you need any help?" "No, I don't, thanks."
items.zh: 你需要幫忙嗎？不用，謝謝。

items.en: "Do you live near here?" "Yes, I do. Just round the corner."
items.zh: 你住這附近嗎？對。就在轉角。

items.en: "Do you drink coffee?" "No, I don't. Just tea."
items.zh: 你喝咖啡嗎？不喝。只喝茶。

title: How does he know my name?
translation: 他怎麼知道我的名字？
name: 現在簡單式的疑問句（多種主詞）
sentences: A man in the hall just said hello to me. How does he know my name?
Your brother is fifteen. Does he go on holiday with your parents?
I saw her in a nurse's uniform. Does your mum work at the hospital?
This machine looks old. Does it still work?
I need some bread tomorrow. Does the bakery open on Sundays?
The time has changed. Does Anna know about the meeting tomorrow?
You visit them every week. Do your parents live near you?
I'm packing a lunch box. Do the children have lunch at school?
I'm going to the shop now. Do we need to bring anything to the party?
Their kids speak English so well. Do they speak it at home?
I'm flying out at six. Do these trains stop at the airport?
Your uncle always wears a suit. What does he do for a living?
I'm new in town. Where does this bus go?
He has so many fishing rods. How often does your dad go fishing?
We need to buy popcorn first. What time does the film start?
We're so tired. Why does the baby cry every night?
I'm looking for a school for my daughter. Which school does your son go to?
Let's plan our TV evening. Which programmes do we all like to watch?
Your cousins are asking about the summer. Where do they want to spend their holidays?
You're always at home. What do your friends usually do at the weekend?
The roads look empty. How do people get to work in your city?
I want to buy a gift tonight. When do the shops close here?
The lights are always on. Who lives in that big house on the corner?
This remote is new to me. What happens if I press this button?
Your English is getting better. Who teaches you this year?
You're smiling a lot. What makes you so happy today?
She moved to London last year. Who does your sister live with there?
You've been dating him for a month. What do your parents think of your new boyfriend?
There are no kids on our street. Who do your children play with after school?
I keep seeing it in this book. What does this word mean?

examples.heading: ① Does + he / she / it

items.en: A man in the hall just said hello to me. How does he know my name?
items.zh: 走廊上有個男人剛剛跟我打招呼。他怎麼知道我的名字？

items.en: Your brother is fifteen. Does he go on holiday with your parents?
items.zh: 你哥哥十五歲了。他還跟你爸媽一起去度假嗎？

items.en: I saw her in a nurse's uniform. Does your mum work at the hospital?
items.zh: 我看到她穿護士服。你媽媽在醫院上班嗎？

items.en: This machine looks old. Does it still work?
items.zh: 這台機器看起來好舊。它還能用嗎？

items.en: I need some bread tomorrow. Does the bakery open on Sundays?
items.zh: 我明天要買麵包。那家麵包店星期天有開嗎？

items.en: The time has changed. Does Anna know about the meeting tomorrow?
items.zh: 時間改了。Anna 知道明天開會的事嗎？

examples.heading: ② Do + we / they / 複數名詞

items.en: You visit them every week. Do your parents live near you?
items.zh: 你每個星期都去看他們。你爸媽住在你附近嗎？

items.en: I'm packing a lunch box. Do the children have lunch at school?
items.zh: 我在準備便當。孩子們在學校吃午餐嗎？

items.en: I'm going to the shop now. Do we need to bring anything to the party?
items.zh: 我現在要去店裡。我們需要帶什麼東西去派對嗎？

items.en: Their kids speak English so well. Do they speak it at home?
items.zh: 他們的孩子英文講得好好。他們在家說英文嗎？

items.en: I'm flying out at six. Do these trains stop at the airport?
items.zh: 我六點的飛機。這些火車有停機場嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 疑問詞 + does + 單數主詞

items.en: Your uncle always wears a suit. What does he do for a living?
items.zh: 你叔叔總是穿西裝。他是做什麼工作的？

items.en: I'm new in town. Where does this bus go?
items.zh: 我剛搬來這裡。這班公車開到哪裡？

items.en: He has so many fishing rods. How often does your dad go fishing?
items.zh: 他有好多釣竿。你爸爸多久去釣一次魚？

items.en: We need to buy popcorn first. What time does the film start?
items.zh: 我們得先買爆米花。電影幾點開始？

items.en: We're so tired. Why does the baby cry every night?
items.zh: 我們好累。寶寶為什麼每天晚上都哭？

items.en: I'm looking for a school for my daughter. Which school does your son go to?
items.zh: 我在幫我女兒找學校。你兒子念哪一所學校？

examples.heading: ④ 疑問詞 + do + 複數主詞

items.en: Let's plan our TV evening. Which programmes do we all like to watch?
items.zh: 我們來安排看電視的晚上吧。我們大家都喜歡看哪些節目？

items.en: Your cousins are asking about the summer. Where do they want to spend their holidays?
items.zh: 你表兄弟姊妹在問暑假的事。他們想去哪裡度假？

items.en: You're always at home. What do your friends usually do at the weekend?
items.zh: 你總是在家。你朋友週末通常都做什麼？

items.en: The roads look empty. How do people get to work in your city?
items.zh: 路上看起來好空。你們城市的人都怎麼去上班？

items.en: I want to buy a gift tonight. When do the shops close here?
items.zh: 我今晚想買個禮物。這裡的店幾點關門？

examples.heading: ⑤ who / what 當主詞

items.en: The lights are always on. Who lives in that big house on the corner?
items.zh: 那裡的燈總是亮著。誰住在轉角那間大房子？

items.en: This remote is new to me. What happens if I press this button?
items.zh: 我沒用過這個遙控器。我按這個按鈕會怎麼樣？

items.en: Your English is getting better. Who teaches you this year?
items.zh: 你的英文越來越好了。今年誰教你？

items.en: You're smiling a lot. What makes you so happy today?
items.zh: 你一直在笑。今天什麼事讓你這麼開心？

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問詞當受詞

items.en: She moved to London last year. Who does your sister live with there?
items.zh: 她去年搬去倫敦了。你姊姊在那裡跟誰住？

items.en: You've been dating him for a month. What do your parents think of your new boyfriend?
items.zh: 你跟他交往一個月了。你爸媽覺得你的新男朋友怎麼樣？

items.en: There are no kids on our street. Who do your children play with after school?
items.zh: 我們這條街沒有小孩。你的孩子放學後跟誰玩？

items.en: I keep seeing it in this book. What does this word mean?
items.zh: 我在這本書裡一直看到它。這個字是什麼意思？

title: Doesn't it sound fascinating?
translation: 聽起來不是很有意思嗎？
name: 否定疑問句用於確認看法
sentences: Look at this new exhibition about ancient Egypt. Doesn't it sound fascinating?
I found a cooking class for Saturdays. Doesn't it sound fun?
I made the chicken soup from Grandma's old recipe. Doesn't it remind you of home?
The hotel has a pool on the roof. Doesn't it look amazing in the photos?
Listen to this song from our last beach trip. Doesn't it make you think of summer?
Look at your sister in her wedding dress. Doesn't she look beautiful?
Our new teacher explains everything so clearly. Doesn't he speak well?
Listen to her at the school concert. Doesn't Anna sing like a professional?
He's only six. Doesn't he read well for his age?
It's your birthday soon. Don't we all like presents?
Look at Dad's photos from the eighties. Don't those clothes look funny now?
Everyone has worked so hard. Don't we all need a holiday after this year?
Look at those puppies. Don't they look sweet?
Let's walk through the garden. Don't the roses smell lovely after the rain?
The leaves are turning red. Don't you love this time of year?
We're on the top floor. Isn't the view beautiful?
We put the ad online a week ago. Isn't it strange that nobody called?
You're walking funny. Aren't these shoes a bit too small for you?
I told you this place was good. Isn't this the best pizza you've ever had?
Isn't the new library wonderful? I go there every day.
Every park in town is full at weekends. Doesn't this show that we need more?
Crime fell by half last year. Don't these results prove that the plan works?
Some villages have no school at all. Doesn't everyone deserve a good education?
Look at the survey. Isn't it true that most people prefer to work from home?
"Doesn't it sound fascinating?" "Yes, it does. Let's go on Sunday."
"Isn't the soup too salty?" "No, it's perfect."
"Doesn't she look tired?" "Yes, she does. She works too much."
"Don't you love this song?" "Not really. It's a bit slow for me."
"The sun is finally out. Isn't it a lovely day?" "Yes, it's beautiful."
"Don't the children look happy?" "Yes, they do. They love the beach."

examples.heading: ① Doesn't it + 動詞

items.en: Look at this new exhibition about ancient Egypt. Doesn't it sound fascinating?
items.zh: 你看這個古埃及的新展覽。聽起來不是很有意思嗎？

items.en: I found a cooking class for Saturdays. Doesn't it sound fun?
items.zh: 我找到一個星期六的烹飪課。聽起來不是很好玩嗎？

items.en: I made the chicken soup from Grandma's old recipe. Doesn't it remind you of home?
items.zh: 我照奶奶的舊食譜煮了雞湯。這不會讓你想起家裡嗎？

items.en: The hotel has a pool on the roof. Doesn't it look amazing in the photos?
items.zh: 這家飯店頂樓有游泳池。照片看起來不是很棒嗎？

items.en: Listen to this song from our last beach trip. Doesn't it make you think of summer?
items.zh: 你聽這首我們上次去海邊時聽的歌。它不會讓你想到夏天嗎？

examples.heading: ② Doesn't he / she + 動詞

items.en: Look at your sister in her wedding dress. Doesn't she look beautiful?
items.zh: 你看你姊姊穿婚紗的樣子。她不是很漂亮嗎？

items.en: Our new teacher explains everything so clearly. Doesn't he speak well?
items.zh: 我們的新老師每件事都解釋得好清楚。他不是很會講嗎？

items.en: Listen to her at the school concert. Doesn't Anna sing like a professional?
items.zh: 你聽她在學校音樂會唱。Anna 唱得不是很像專業歌手嗎？

items.en: He's only six. Doesn't he read well for his age?
items.zh: 他才六歲。以他的年紀，他不是讀得很好嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Don't we / you / they + 動詞

items.en: It's your birthday soon. Don't we all like presents?
items.zh: 你快生日了。我們不是都喜歡收禮物嗎？

items.en: Look at Dad's photos from the eighties. Don't those clothes look funny now?
items.zh: 你看爸爸八〇年代的照片。那些衣服現在看起來不是很好笑嗎？

items.en: Everyone has worked so hard. Don't we all need a holiday after this year?
items.zh: 大家都那麼努力。過了這一年，我們不是都需要放個假嗎？

items.en: Look at those puppies. Don't they look sweet?
items.zh: 你看那些小狗。牠們看起來不是很可愛嗎？

items.en: Let's walk through the garden. Don't the roses smell lovely after the rain?
items.zh: 我們走過花園吧。下過雨以後，玫瑰不是很香嗎？

items.en: The leaves are turning red. Don't you love this time of year?
items.zh: 葉子開始變紅了。你不愛每年的這個時候嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Isn't it / Aren't they + 形容詞

items.en: We're on the top floor. Isn't the view beautiful?
items.zh: 我們在頂樓。景色不是很美嗎？

items.en: We put the ad online a week ago. Isn't it strange that nobody called?
items.zh: 我們一個星期前把廣告放上網。沒有人打來，不是很奇怪嗎？

items.en: You're walking funny. Aren't these shoes a bit too small for you?
items.zh: 你走路怪怪的。這雙鞋對你來說不會有點太小嗎？

items.en: I told you this place was good. Isn't this the best pizza you've ever had?
items.zh: 我就跟你說這家很好吃。這不是你吃過最好吃的披薩嗎？

items.en: Isn't the new library wonderful? I go there every day.
items.zh: 新的圖書館不是很棒嗎？我每天都去。

examples.heading: ⑤ 討論和寫作

items.en: Every park in town is full at weekends. Doesn't this show that we need more?
items.zh: 鎮上每座公園週末都擠滿了人。這不就說明了我們需要更多公園嗎？

items.en: Crime fell by half last year. Don't these results prove that the plan works?
items.zh: 去年犯罪減少了一半。這些結果不就證明了這個計畫有效嗎？

items.en: Some villages have no school at all. Doesn't everyone deserve a good education?
items.zh: 有些村子根本沒有學校。不是每個人都應該受到好的教育嗎？

items.en: Look at the survey. Isn't it true that most people prefer to work from home?
items.zh: 看看這份調查。大部分的人比較喜歡在家工作，不是嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 回答

items.en: "Doesn't it sound fascinating?" "Yes, it does. Let's go on Sunday."
items.zh: 聽起來不是很有意思嗎？對啊。我們星期天去吧。

items.en: "Isn't the soup too salty?" "No, it's perfect."
items.zh: 湯不會太鹹嗎？不會，剛剛好。

items.en: "Doesn't she look tired?" "Yes, she does. She works too much."
items.zh: 她看起來不是很累嗎？對啊。她工作太多了。

items.en: "Don't you love this song?" "Not really. It's a bit slow for me."
items.zh: 你不愛這首歌嗎？還好。對我來說有點慢。

items.en: "The sun is finally out. Isn't it a lovely day?" "Yes, it's beautiful."
items.zh: 太陽終於出來了。今天天氣不是很好嗎？對啊，好漂亮。

items.en: "Don't the children look happy?" "Yes, they do. They love the beach."
items.zh: 孩子們看起來不是很開心嗎？對啊。他們很愛海邊。

title: Don't you just hate taking the bus to school every morning?
translation: 每天早上搭公車上學，你不覺得很討厭嗎？
name: 否定疑問句用於說服
sentences: For sale: a great bike! Don't you just hate taking the bus to school every morning?
Don't you just hate it when your phone dies in the middle of a call? Our battery lasts all week.
Don't you hate cleaning the oven? Let our new spray do the work.
Don't you just hate waiting in long queues? Book online and skip the line.
Don't you hate cold coffee? This cup keeps it hot for six hours.
Don't you find that you sometimes run out of hot water in the shower? Our new heater solves that.
Don't you find that the city is too noisy? Come and live by the lake.
Don't you find that your back hurts after a long day at your desk? Try our new chair.
Don't you find that kids learn faster through games? Our app turns maths into a game.
Don't you love the smell of fresh bread? Visit our bakery today.
Don't you want more time with your family? Work from home with us.
Don't you love waking up to the sound of the sea? Book a room with a view.
Don't you want to feel healthier? Join our gym this month.
Isn't it time for a change? Vote for us on Sunday.
Isn't it nice to come home to a clean house? We clean while you work.
The office is only a mile away. Isn't it better to walk than to sit in traffic?
Isn't it sad that so many people eat alone? Join our community dinner.
Wouldn't you like a bigger kitchen? We can build it in two weeks.
Wouldn't you rather spend your weekend at the beach? Our trains get you there in an hour.
Wouldn't you love to speak a new language by summer? Sign up for our course today.
Wouldn't it be great to never cook again? Our meals arrive at your door every day.
Thank you all for coming tonight. Don't we all want a cleaner town for our children?
The books are forty years old. Don't you think the students deserve a better library?
Please give to our homeless centre. Doesn't everyone need a place to feel safe?
The buses are still late every day. Aren't we tired of the same old excuses?
It's so dark there after six. Don't you agree that the park needs more lights?
Don't you want to come with us? It'll be fun.
Wouldn't you like to try the cake? I made it myself.
Isn't it a perfect day for a picnic? Let's go to the park.
Don't you miss the old days? Let's visit our old school.

examples.heading: ① Don't you just hate ...?

items.en: For sale: a great bike! Don't you just hate taking the bus to school every morning?
items.zh: 腳踏車出售！每天早上搭公車上學，你不覺得很討厭嗎？

items.en: Don't you just hate it when your phone dies in the middle of a call? Our battery lasts all week.
items.zh: 講電話講到一半手機沒電，你不覺得很討厭嗎？我們的電池可以撐一整個星期。

items.en: Don't you hate cleaning the oven? Let our new spray do the work.
items.zh: 清烤箱你不覺得很討厭嗎？讓我們的新清潔劑幫你搞定。

items.en: Don't you just hate waiting in long queues? Book online and skip the line.
items.zh: 排長長的隊，你不覺得很討厭嗎？上網預約就不用排隊。

items.en: Don't you hate cold coffee? This cup keeps it hot for six hours.
items.zh: 你不討厭冷掉的咖啡嗎？這個杯子能保溫六個小時。

examples.heading: ② Don't you find that ...?

items.en: Don't you find that you sometimes run out of hot water in the shower? Our new heater solves that.
items.zh: 你不覺得洗澡的時候有時熱水會用完嗎？我們的新熱水器能解決這個問題。

items.en: Don't you find that the city is too noisy? Come and live by the lake.
items.zh: 你不覺得城市太吵了嗎？來湖邊住吧。

items.en: Don't you find that your back hurts after a long day at your desk? Try our new chair.
items.zh: 坐在桌前一整天之後，你不覺得背很痛嗎？試試我們的新椅子。

items.en: Don't you find that kids learn faster through games? Our app turns maths into a game.
items.zh: 你不覺得孩子透過遊戲學得比較快嗎？我們的 app 把數學變成遊戲。

examples.heading: ③ Don't you love / want ...?

items.en: Don't you love the smell of fresh bread? Visit our bakery today.
items.zh: 你不愛剛出爐麵包的香味嗎？今天就來我們的麵包店吧。

items.en: Don't you want more time with your family? Work from home with us.
items.zh: 你不想多花點時間陪家人嗎？跟我們一起在家工作吧。

items.en: Don't you love waking up to the sound of the sea? Book a room with a view.
items.zh: 早上被海浪聲叫醒，你不覺得很棒嗎？訂一間有海景的房間吧。

items.en: Don't you want to feel healthier? Join our gym this month.
items.zh: 你不想變得更健康嗎？這個月就加入我們的健身房吧。

examples.heading: ④ Isn't it ...?

items.en: Isn't it time for a change? Vote for us on Sunday.
items.zh: 不是該改變一下了嗎？星期天投給我們吧。

items.en: Isn't it nice to come home to a clean house? We clean while you work.
items.zh: 回到一個乾淨的家，不是很棒嗎？你上班的時候我們幫你打掃。

items.en: The office is only a mile away. Isn't it better to walk than to sit in traffic?
items.zh: 辦公室只有一英里遠。走路不是比塞在車陣裡好嗎？

items.en: Isn't it sad that so many people eat alone? Join our community dinner.
items.zh: 這麼多人一個人吃飯，不是很令人難過嗎？來參加我們的社區晚餐吧。

examples.heading: ⑤ Wouldn't you / Wouldn't it ...?

items.en: Wouldn't you like a bigger kitchen? We can build it in two weeks.
items.zh: 你不想要一個大一點的廚房嗎？我們兩個星期就能蓋好。

items.en: Wouldn't you rather spend your weekend at the beach? Our trains get you there in an hour.
items.zh: 你不會比較想在海邊過週末嗎？我們的火車一個小時就能載你到那裡。

items.en: Wouldn't you love to speak a new language by summer? Sign up for our course today.
items.zh: 你不想在夏天前學會一種新語言嗎？今天就報名我們的課程吧。

items.en: Wouldn't it be great to never cook again? Our meals arrive at your door every day.
items.zh: 再也不用煮飯，不是很棒嗎？我們的餐點每天送到你家門口。

examples.heading: ⑥ 演講和討論

items.en: Thank you all for coming tonight. Don't we all want a cleaner town for our children?
items.zh: 謝謝大家今晚來。我們不是都希望給孩子一個更乾淨的城鎮嗎？

items.en: The books are forty years old. Don't you think the students deserve a better library?
items.zh: 這些書都四十年了。你不覺得學生們應該有一座更好的圖書館嗎？

items.en: Please give to our homeless centre. Doesn't everyone need a place to feel safe?
items.zh: 請捐款給我們的遊民中心。不是每個人都需要一個能讓自己安心的地方嗎？

items.en: The buses are still late every day. Aren't we tired of the same old excuses?
items.zh: 公車還是每天誤點。我們不是已經受夠了那些老藉口嗎？

items.en: It's so dark there after six. Don't you agree that the park needs more lights?
items.zh: 六點以後那裡好暗。你不同意公園需要更多路燈嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 朋友之間

items.en: Don't you want to come with us? It'll be fun.
items.zh: 你不想跟我們一起去嗎？會很好玩的。

items.en: Wouldn't you like to try the cake? I made it myself.
items.zh: 你不想吃吃看這個蛋糕嗎？是我自己做的。

items.en: Isn't it a perfect day for a picnic? Let's go to the park.
items.zh: 今天不是很適合野餐嗎？我們去公園吧。

items.en: Don't you miss the old days? Let's visit our old school.
items.zh: 你不懷念以前的日子嗎？我們回去看看我們的母校吧。

title: It's a bit strange, don't you think?
translation: 有點怪，你不覺得嗎？
name: don't you think 徵求同意
sentences: The ending was so sudden. It's a bit strange, don't you think?
Look at the sea. It's beautiful, don't you think?
Let's try another shop. This jacket is too expensive, don't you think?
We should leave now, don't you think? The traffic will be terrible later.
Look at your son next to his father. He's taller than his dad now, don't you think?
That's a lot of money for a sandwich, don't you think?
Listen to the girl on stage. She sings really well, don't you think?
We painted it last week. The room looks bigger with the white walls, don't you think?
Look at the clouds. Don't you think it's too cold to swim today?
She might be busy. Don't you think we should call her first?
Look at Mum's old photos. Don't you think that fashion always looks funny when it's not today's fashion?
We've walked for three hours. Don't you think the kids need a break?
You've been working for hours. Don't you think you should stop?
I want to tell her later. The surprise will be even bigger if I wait. Don't you think so?
This is the best pizza in town. Don't you think so?
She helped me after class. The new teacher is really nice. Don't you think so?
It's much quieter here in the morning. Don't you think so?
We've tried everything else. I think it's the best way, don't you agree?
Students have so little money. Public transport should be free for them, don't you agree?
We don't need two meetings. This plan saves us a lot of time, don't you agree?
They're on screens all day. Children need more time outdoors, don't you agree?
Nobody can focus after two hours. The meeting is too long, don't you agree?
There's nowhere for kids to play. Don't you agree that the city needs more parks?
He said sorry. Don't you agree that everyone deserves a second chance?
Only the girls have to wear skirts. Don't you agree that the rules are unfair?
"It's a bit strange, don't you think?" "Yes, I think so too."
"This film is great, don't you think?" "Not really. It's too long for me."
"We should go by train, don't you agree?" "Yes, I agree."
"Don't you think she looks tired?" "Yes, she does. She's working too hard."
"The food here is amazing, don't you think?" "Absolutely. Let's come back next week."

examples.heading: ① 看法, don't you think?

items.en: The ending was so sudden. It's a bit strange, don't you think?
items.zh: 結局好突然。有點怪，你不覺得嗎？

items.en: Look at the sea. It's beautiful, don't you think?
items.zh: 你看那片海。好美，你不覺得嗎？

items.en: Let's try another shop. This jacket is too expensive, don't you think?
items.zh: 我們去別家店看看吧。這件外套太貴了，你不覺得嗎？

items.en: We should leave now, don't you think? The traffic will be terrible later.
items.zh: 我們應該現在走，你不覺得嗎？晚一點交通會很糟。

items.en: Look at your son next to his father. He's taller than his dad now, don't you think?
items.zh: 你看你兒子站在他爸旁邊。他現在比他爸高了，你不覺得嗎？

items.en: That's a lot of money for a sandwich, don't you think?
items.zh: 一個三明治那麼貴，你不覺得嗎？

items.en: Listen to the girl on stage. She sings really well, don't you think?
items.zh: 你聽臺上那個女生。她唱得真好，你不覺得嗎？

items.en: We painted it last week. The room looks bigger with the white walls, don't you think?
items.zh: 我們上星期油漆了。牆漆成白色以後房間看起來比較大，你不覺得嗎？

examples.heading: ② Don't you think + 看法?

items.en: Look at the clouds. Don't you think it's too cold to swim today?
items.zh: 你看那些雲。你不覺得今天太冷不能游泳嗎？

items.en: She might be busy. Don't you think we should call her first?
items.zh: 她可能在忙。你不覺得我們應該先打給她嗎？

items.en: Look at Mum's old photos. Don't you think that fashion always looks funny when it's not today's fashion?
items.zh: 你看媽媽以前的照片。你不覺得不是現在流行的打扮看起來都很好笑嗎？

items.en: We've walked for three hours. Don't you think the kids need a break?
items.zh: 我們走了三個小時了。你不覺得孩子們需要休息一下嗎？

items.en: You've been working for hours. Don't you think you should stop?
items.zh: 你已經工作好幾個小時了。你不覺得你該停下來了嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Don't you think so?

items.en: I want to tell her later. The surprise will be even bigger if I wait. Don't you think so?
items.zh: 我想晚點再跟她說。我等一下，驚喜會更大。你不覺得嗎？

items.en: This is the best pizza in town. Don't you think so?
items.zh: 這是鎮上最好吃的披薩。你不覺得嗎？

items.en: She helped me after class. The new teacher is really nice. Don't you think so?
items.zh: 她下課後幫了我。新老師人真好。你不覺得嗎？

items.en: It's much quieter here in the morning. Don't you think so?
items.zh: 這裡早上安靜多了。你不覺得嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 看法, don't you agree?

items.en: We've tried everything else. I think it's the best way, don't you agree?
items.zh: 其他方法我們都試過了。我覺得這是最好的方法，你不同意嗎？

items.en: Students have so little money. Public transport should be free for them, don't you agree?
items.zh: 學生的錢很少。他們搭大眾運輸應該免費，你不同意嗎？

items.en: We don't need two meetings. This plan saves us a lot of time, don't you agree?
items.zh: 我們不用開兩次會。這個計畫幫我們省了很多時間，你不同意嗎？

items.en: They're on screens all day. Children need more time outdoors, don't you agree?
items.zh: 他們整天都在看螢幕。孩子需要多一點時間待在戶外，你不同意嗎？

items.en: Nobody can focus after two hours. The meeting is too long, don't you agree?
items.zh: 兩個小時以後大家都無法專心。這個會開太久了，你不同意嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Don't you agree (that) + 看法?

items.en: There's nowhere for kids to play. Don't you agree that the city needs more parks?
items.zh: 孩子沒地方玩。你不同意這個城市需要更多公園嗎？

items.en: He said sorry. Don't you agree that everyone deserves a second chance?
items.zh: 他道歉了。你不同意每個人都值得第二次機會嗎？

items.en: Only the girls have to wear skirts. Don't you agree that the rules are unfair?
items.zh: 只有女生要穿裙子。你不同意這些規定不公平嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 回答

items.en: "It's a bit strange, don't you think?" "Yes, I think so too."
items.zh: 有點怪，你不覺得嗎？對，我也這麼覺得。

items.en: "This film is great, don't you think?" "Not really. It's too long for me."
items.zh: 這部電影很棒，你不覺得嗎？還好。我覺得太長了。

items.en: "We should go by train, don't you agree?" "Yes, I agree."
items.zh: 我們應該搭火車去，你不同意嗎？對，我同意。

items.en: "Don't you think she looks tired?" "Yes, she does. She's working too hard."
items.zh: 你不覺得她看起來很累嗎？對啊。她工作太拚了。

items.en: "The food here is amazing, don't you think?" "Absolutely. Let's come back next week."
items.zh: 這裡的食物超好吃，你不覺得嗎？完全同意。我們下星期再來吧。

title: If you wear white clothes, you will get paint on them.
translation: 如果你穿白色的衣服，衣服會沾到油漆。
name: if 子句用現在簡單式
sentences: Wear your old jeans on Saturday. If you wear white clothes, you'll get paint on them.
Take a jacket. If it gets cold, you'll be glad you have it.
It's four o'clock already. If we leave now, we'll get there before dark.
Think about who to go camping with. If you go with your parents, you'll go walking. If you go with friends, you'll have more fun.
Don't worry. If the train is late, I'll wait for you at the station.
Her results come out next week. If she passes, she'll go to university in London.
Be careful with that glass. If you drop it, it'll break.
Moving house is hard work. If you want some help, I can come next week.
The forecast says sun. If the weather is nice, we can have lunch in the garden.
Here's the deal. If you finish your homework, you can watch TV.
It's a busy restaurant. If we don't book now, we might not get a table.
Ask the teacher. If she has time, she can explain it again.
I can't find Anna anywhere. If you see her, tell her to call me.
You look pale. If you feel sick, go home and rest.
I made a cake this morning. If you're hungry, help yourself.
The streets here are confusing. Call me if you get lost.
I'm going out now. If it rains, bring the washing in, please.
My toothbrush is really important to me. If I don't have it, I can't clean my teeth.
Put the ice cream back in the freezer. If you leave ice in the sun, it melts.
No coffee for me, thanks. If I drink coffee at night, I can't sleep.
Don't be scared. My dog barks if someone knocks on the door.
The baby missed her nap today. If she's tired, she cries a lot.
It's ten past eight. If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
It's been dry for weeks. If it doesn't rain soon, the plants will die.
That dress is very expensive. Don't buy it if you don't love it.
Here's Mr Lee's parcel. If he isn't at home, leave it with his neighbour.
You look exhausted. You'll feel better if you get some sleep.
Pack your swimsuit. We can go to the beach if the weather is good.
Your car is at the garage? I'll lend you my bike if you need it.
I'm in the next room. Tell me if you need anything.

examples.heading: ① If + 現在簡單式, will

items.en: Wear your old jeans on Saturday. If you wear white clothes, you'll get paint on them.
items.zh: 星期六穿你的舊牛仔褲來。如果你穿白色的衣服，衣服會沾到油漆。

items.en: Take a jacket. If it gets cold, you'll be glad you have it.
items.zh: 帶件外套。如果天氣變冷，你會慶幸有帶。

items.en: It's four o'clock already. If we leave now, we'll get there before dark.
items.zh: 已經四點了。如果我們現在出發，天黑前就會到。

items.en: Think about who to go camping with. If you go with your parents, you'll go walking. If you go with friends, you'll have more fun.
items.zh: 想想你要跟誰去露營。如果你跟爸媽去，你們會去健行。如果你跟朋友去，你會玩得比較開心。

items.en: Don't worry. If the train is late, I'll wait for you at the station.
items.zh: 別擔心。如果火車誤點，我會在車站等你。

items.en: Her results come out next week. If she passes, she'll go to university in London.
items.zh: 她的成績下星期出來。如果她考過，她就會去倫敦念大學。

items.en: Be careful with that glass. If you drop it, it'll break.
items.zh: 那個玻璃杯小心一點。你要是掉了，它會破。

examples.heading: ② If + 現在簡單式, can / might

items.en: Moving house is hard work. If you want some help, I can come next week.
items.zh: 搬家很累。如果你需要幫忙，我下星期可以來。

items.en: The forecast says sun. If the weather is nice, we can have lunch in the garden.
items.zh: 氣象預報說會出太陽。如果天氣好，我們可以在花園吃午餐。

items.en: Here's the deal. If you finish your homework, you can watch TV.
items.zh: 我們說好了。你寫完功課，就可以看電視。

items.en: It's a busy restaurant. If we don't book now, we might not get a table.
items.zh: 那家餐廳很熱門。如果我們現在不訂，可能會沒位子。

items.en: Ask the teacher. If she has time, she can explain it again.
items.zh: 去問老師。如果她有空，她可以再解釋一次。

examples.heading: ③ If + 現在簡單式, 祈使句

items.en: I can't find Anna anywhere. If you see her, tell her to call me.
items.zh: 我到處都找不到 Anna。如果你看到她，叫她打給我。

items.en: You look pale. If you feel sick, go home and rest.
items.zh: 你臉色好蒼白。如果你覺得不舒服，就回家休息。

items.en: I made a cake this morning. If you're hungry, help yourself.
items.zh: 我今天早上做了蛋糕。如果你餓了就自己拿。

items.en: The streets here are confusing. Call me if you get lost.
items.zh: 這裡的街道很亂。如果你迷路了就打給我。

items.en: I'm going out now. If it rains, bring the washing in, please.
items.zh: 我現在要出門。如果下雨，請把衣服收進來。

examples.heading: ④ If + 現在簡單式, 現在簡單式

items.en: My toothbrush is really important to me. If I don't have it, I can't clean my teeth.
items.zh: 我的牙刷對我來說很重要。如果沒有它，我就沒辦法刷牙。

items.en: Put the ice cream back in the freezer. If you leave ice in the sun, it melts.
items.zh: 把冰淇淋放回冷凍庫。冰放在太陽底下就會融化。

items.en: No coffee for me, thanks. If I drink coffee at night, I can't sleep.
items.zh: 我不喝咖啡，謝謝。我晚上喝咖啡就會睡不著。

items.en: Don't be scared. My dog barks if someone knocks on the door.
items.zh: 別怕。有人敲門的話，我的狗就會叫。

items.en: The baby missed her nap today. If she's tired, she cries a lot.
items.zh: 寶寶今天沒睡午覺。她累了就會一直哭。

examples.heading: ⑤ if 子句裡的否定

items.en: It's ten past eight. If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
items.zh: 已經八點十分了。如果你不快一點，就會錯過公車。

items.en: It's been dry for weeks. If it doesn't rain soon, the plants will die.
items.zh: 已經好幾個星期沒下雨了。如果再不下雨，植物會死掉。

items.en: That dress is very expensive. Don't buy it if you don't love it.
items.zh: 那件洋裝很貴。如果你沒有很喜歡就別買。

items.en: Here's Mr Lee's parcel. If he isn't at home, leave it with his neighbour.
items.zh: 這是李先生的包裹。如果他不在家，就交給他鄰居。

examples.heading: ⑥ if 子句在後面

items.en: You look exhausted. You'll feel better if you get some sleep.
items.zh: 你看起來累壞了。你睡一下就會好一點。

items.en: Pack your swimsuit. We can go to the beach if the weather is good.
items.zh: 帶上泳衣。如果天氣好，我們可以去海邊。

items.en: Your car is at the garage? I'll lend you my bike if you need it.
items.zh: 你的車在修車廠？如果你需要，我可以把腳踏車借你。

items.en: I'm in the next room. Tell me if you need anything.
items.zh: 我就在隔壁房間。如果你需要什麼就跟我說。

title: You are always losing things.
translation: 你老是弄丟東西。
name: 現在進行式加不定頻率副詞（常用副詞）
sentences: I found your keys under the sofa again. You are always losing things.
Can you knock first? You're always coming into my room without asking.
Where's my charger? My little brother is always taking my things without asking.
I didn't sleep again. Our neighbours are always playing loud music late at night.
He's always checking his phone when I'm talking to him.
Why are you always interrupting me? Let me finish.
That printer is always breaking down when we need it most.
She's always telling me what to do. I'm not a child.
I'll be late for work again. The bus is always running late on Monday mornings.
I'm always forgetting people's names at parties. It's so embarrassing.
You're always saying you'll help, but you never do.
Don't ask him about the film. My dad is always falling asleep in front of the TV.
I can hear them through the wall. They're always arguing about money.
Look at her! She is always smiling, even on a bad day.
The neighbours love her. Grandma is always baking something for them.
Our teacher is always finding new ways to make lessons fun.
Your son is always reading. Does he ever stop?
Mark is always helping people move house. He's so kind.
I'm always dreaming about living by the sea one day.
My sister is forever borrowing my clothes and never giving them back.
He's forever complaining about the weather here.
You're forever leaving the door open. The cat keeps getting out.
We changed the plan again today. My boss is forever changing his mind.
Hide the biscuits. The kids are forever asking for snacks before dinner.
He earns more than I do. Why is he always asking me for money?
Are you always eating? You just had lunch!
Why are the trains always stopping between stations?
Isn't she always talking about her holiday in Greece?
I packed a picnic today. Why is it always raining when I want to go out?
Why am I always cleaning up after everyone?

examples.heading: ① 抱怨：be always + 動詞-ing

items.en: I found your keys under the sofa again. You are always losing things.
items.zh: 我又在沙發底下找到你的鑰匙了。你老是弄丟東西。

items.en: Can you knock first? You're always coming into my room without asking.
items.zh: 你可以先敲門嗎？你老是沒問就進我房間。

items.en: Where's my charger? My little brother is always taking my things without asking.
items.zh: 我的充電器呢？我弟弟老是沒問就拿我的東西。

items.en: I didn't sleep again. Our neighbours are always playing loud music late at night.
items.zh: 我又沒睡好。我們鄰居老是三更半夜放很大聲的音樂。

items.en: He's always checking his phone when I'm talking to him.
items.zh: 我在跟他講話的時候，他老是在看手機。

items.en: Why are you always interrupting me? Let me finish.
items.zh: 你為什麼老是打斷我？讓我說完。

items.en: That printer is always breaking down when we need it most.
items.zh: 那台印表機老是在我們最需要的時候壞掉。

items.en: She's always telling me what to do. I'm not a child.
items.zh: 她老是叫我該做什麼。我又不是小孩子。

items.en: I'll be late for work again. The bus is always running late on Monday mornings.
items.zh: 我上班又要遲到了。星期一早上公車老是誤點。

items.en: I'm always forgetting people's names at parties. It's so embarrassing.
items.zh: 我在派對上老是忘記別人的名字。好尷尬。

items.en: You're always saying you'll help, but you never do.
items.zh: 你老是說你會幫忙，可是你從來沒幫過。

items.en: Don't ask him about the film. My dad is always falling asleep in front of the TV.
items.zh: 別問他那部電影。我爸老是在電視機前面睡著。

items.en: I can hear them through the wall. They're always arguing about money.
items.zh: 我隔著牆都聽得到。他們老是為了錢吵架。

examples.heading: ② 驚訝或欣賞：be always + 動詞-ing

items.en: Look at her! She is always smiling, even on a bad day.
items.zh: 你看她！她總是笑嘻嘻的，連心情不好的日子也一樣。

items.en: The neighbours love her. Grandma is always baking something for them.
items.zh: 鄰居都很喜歡她。奶奶總是在烤東西給他們吃。

items.en: Our teacher is always finding new ways to make lessons fun.
items.zh: 我們老師總是在想新方法讓課變得好玩。

items.en: Your son is always reading. Does he ever stop?
items.zh: 你兒子總是在看書。他都不休息的嗎？

items.en: Mark is always helping people move house. He's so kind.
items.zh: Mark 總是在幫別人搬家。他人真好。

items.en: I'm always dreaming about living by the sea one day.
items.zh: 我總是在夢想有一天能住在海邊。

examples.heading: ③ be forever + 動詞-ing

items.en: My sister is forever borrowing my clothes and never giving them back.
items.zh: 我姊姊老是借我的衣服，而且從來不還。

items.en: He's forever complaining about the weather here.
items.zh: 他老是在抱怨這裡的天氣。

items.en: You're forever leaving the door open. The cat keeps getting out.
items.zh: 你老是不關門。貓一直跑出去。

items.en: We changed the plan again today. My boss is forever changing his mind.
items.zh: 我們今天又改計畫了。我老闆老是改變主意。

items.en: Hide the biscuits. The kids are forever asking for snacks before dinner.
items.zh: 把餅乾藏起來。孩子們老是在晚餐前要零食吃。

examples.heading: ④ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: He earns more than I do. Why is he always asking me for money?
items.zh: 他賺得比我多。他為什麼老是跟我要錢？

items.en: Are you always eating? You just had lunch!
items.zh: 你怎麼一直在吃？你才剛吃過午餐！

items.en: Why are the trains always stopping between stations?
items.zh: 火車為什麼老是在兩站中間停下來？

items.en: Isn't she always talking about her holiday in Greece?
items.zh: 她不是老是在講她去希臘度假的事嗎？

items.en: I packed a picnic today. Why is it always raining when I want to go out?
items.zh: 我今天準備了野餐。為什麼每次我想出門就下雨？

items.en: Why am I always cleaning up after everyone?
items.zh: 為什麼老是我在幫大家收拾？

title: Scientists are constantly studying and reading books.
translation: 科學家總是不停地在做研究、看書。
name: 現在進行式加不定頻率副詞（較多種副詞）
sentences: A top model works on her looks, but scientists are constantly studying and reading books.
I can't get any work done. My phone is constantly ringing.
He's constantly checking his email, even on holiday.
The city is constantly changing. I hardly recognise my old street.
You're constantly telling me to relax, but it isn't that easy.
Our manager is constantly looking for ways to cut costs.
Teenagers are constantly comparing themselves with their friends online.
I'm constantly worrying about my exams these days.
My neighbours are continually complaining about the noise from our garden.
The company is continually changing the rules, and nobody knows what to do.
She's continually interrupting the teacher with silly questions.
We are continually trying new ideas to bring more visitors to the museum.
I'm tired of it. He's continually asking me to lend him money.
I've stopped going there. The prices at this shop are continually going up.
In a lab like this, you're continuously dealing with dangerous chemicals.
We'll get a warning before a flood. The sensors are continuously measuring the water level in the river.
The camera is continuously recording, so don't worry if you miss something.
Our team is continuously improving the app based on your feedback.
The factory is continuously producing parts, day and night.
Where are my glasses? I'm forever losing them.
It's never enough for him. My son is forever asking for a new game.
Please wash up after yourself. You're forever leaving dirty cups in the sink.
I need to buy ink again. Our printer is forever running out.
Don't count on her. She's forever making plans and then cancelling them.
Please move them apart. Those two are always laughing at the back of the class.
Why are you always looking at your phone at dinner?
He's always offering to help, which is really kind.
Why is the system constantly crashing? I've restarted it three times.
Are they continually changing the timetable, or is it just me?
He'll never leave. Isn't he forever saying he's going to quit?
Why are you constantly apologising? You didn't do anything wrong.

examples.heading: ① be constantly + 動詞-ing

items.en: A top model works on her looks, but scientists are constantly studying and reading books.
items.zh: 頂尖模特兒靠外表工作，可是科學家總是不停地在做研究、看書。

items.en: I can't get any work done. My phone is constantly ringing.
items.zh: 我什麼事都做不了。我的手機一直響。

items.en: He's constantly checking his email, even on holiday.
items.zh: 他連度假的時候都一直在看 email。

items.en: The city is constantly changing. I hardly recognise my old street.
items.zh: 這座城市一直在變。我幾乎認不出我以前住的那條街。

items.en: You're constantly telling me to relax, but it isn't that easy.
items.zh: 你一直叫我放輕鬆，可是沒那麼容易。

items.en: Our manager is constantly looking for ways to cut costs.
items.zh: 我們經理一直在想辦法降低成本。

items.en: Teenagers are constantly comparing themselves with their friends online.
items.zh: 青少年一直在網路上拿自己跟朋友比。

items.en: I'm constantly worrying about my exams these days.
items.zh: 我最近一直在擔心考試。

examples.heading: ② be continually + 動詞-ing

items.en: My neighbours are continually complaining about the noise from our garden.
items.zh: 我的鄰居一再抱怨我們花園傳過去的噪音。

items.en: The company is continually changing the rules, and nobody knows what to do.
items.zh: 公司一再改規定，大家都不知道該怎麼辦。

items.en: She's continually interrupting the teacher with silly questions.
items.zh: 她一再用一些無聊的問題打斷老師。

items.en: We are continually trying new ideas to bring more visitors to the museum.
items.zh: 我們一再嘗試新點子，想讓更多人來博物館。

items.en: I'm tired of it. He's continually asking me to lend him money.
items.zh: 我受夠了。他一再要我借錢給他。

items.en: I've stopped going there. The prices at this shop are continually going up.
items.zh: 我不去那裡了。這家店的價格一直在漲。

examples.heading: ③ be continuously + 動詞-ing

items.en: In a lab like this, you're continuously dealing with dangerous chemicals.
items.zh: 在這種實驗室裡，你一直在處理危險的化學物質。

items.en: We'll get a warning before a flood. The sensors are continuously measuring the water level in the river.
items.zh: 淹水前我們會收到警告。感測器不間斷地在測量河的水位。

items.en: The camera is continuously recording, so don't worry if you miss something.
items.zh: 攝影機一直在錄，所以漏看了什麼也不用擔心。

items.en: Our team is continuously improving the app based on your feedback.
items.zh: 我們團隊根據大家的意見不斷改進這個 app。

items.en: The factory is continuously producing parts, day and night.
items.zh: 這家工廠日夜不停地生產零件。

examples.heading: ④ be forever + 動詞-ing

items.en: Where are my glasses? I'm forever losing them.
items.zh: 我的眼鏡在哪？我老是弄丟。

items.en: It's never enough for him. My son is forever asking for a new game.
items.zh: 他永遠不滿足。我兒子老是吵著要新遊戲。

items.en: Please wash up after yourself. You're forever leaving dirty cups in the sink.
items.zh: 請自己洗碗。你老是把髒杯子丟在水槽裡。

items.en: I need to buy ink again. Our printer is forever running out.
items.zh: 我又得買墨水了。我們的印表機老是沒墨水。

items.en: Don't count on her. She's forever making plans and then cancelling them.
items.zh: 別指望她。她老是約好了又取消。

examples.heading: ⑤ be always + 動詞-ing

items.en: Please move them apart. Those two are always laughing at the back of the class.
items.zh: 請把他們分開坐。那兩個人老是在教室後面笑。

items.en: Why are you always looking at your phone at dinner?
items.zh: 你為什麼吃飯的時候老是在看手機？

items.en: He's always offering to help, which is really kind.
items.zh: 他總是主動說要幫忙，真的很好心。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Why is the system constantly crashing? I've restarted it three times.
items.zh: 系統為什麼一直當機？我已經重開三次了。

items.en: Are they continually changing the timetable, or is it just me?
items.zh: 他們是不是一直在改時刻表，還是只有我這麼覺得？

items.en: He'll never leave. Isn't he forever saying he's going to quit?
items.zh: 他不會走的。他不是老是說他要辭職嗎？

items.en: Why are you constantly apologising? You didn't do anything wrong.
items.zh: 你為什麼一直道歉？你又沒做錯事。

title: We are persistently asking ourselves questions about where we are from and why we are here.
translation: 我們不斷地問自己：我們從哪裡來，為什麼會在這裡。
name: 現在進行式加不定頻率副詞（多種副詞）
sentences: It's human nature. We are persistently asking ourselves questions about where we are from and why we are here.
I've written to him three times. He's persistently ignoring my emails.
We've been cold for weeks. The landlord is persistently refusing to fix the heating.
Some students are persistently arriving late, so we're locking the door at nine.
Nothing ever gets decided. The committee is persistently avoiding the real issue.
Don't wait for Tim. He's perpetually running late.
My uncle is perpetually complaining about his salary, but he never looks for another job.
In this job you're perpetually fighting against deadlines.
Politicians are perpetually promising change before an election.
The poor man is perpetually apologising for things that aren't his fault.
Turn the TV off. The kids are endlessly arguing over the remote.
I've stopped watching. The news channels are endlessly repeating the same story.
He's endlessly talking about his trip to Japan. We've heard it all.
Scientists are endlessly searching for a cure for the common cold.
No wonder people are leaving. The company is repeatedly breaking its promises to its staff.
We're repeatedly reminding residents not to park on the grass.
Look at this again. The same mistake is repeatedly appearing in your essays.
We need to fix this fast. Customers are repeatedly reporting problems with the new update.
My son is repeatedly losing his school bag. This is the third one this year.
During life we are permanently learning and increasing our knowledge.
The hospital needs more staff. Doctors in this ward are permanently working under pressure.
Our planet is permanently changing, even if we can't see it.
I can't sleep. The dog next door is barking incessantly.
My phone is buzzing incessantly with messages from the group chat.
The baby has a cold and is crying incessantly.
She's talking incessantly about the wedding. It's all she thinks about.
The park is still full of rubbish. Why is the council repeatedly ignoring our complaints?
Why are you perpetually apologising? It's fine.
We shout at our kids, just like our parents did. Are we endlessly repeating their mistakes?
My boss is getting annoyed. Why is he persistently calling me at work?

examples.heading: ① be persistently + 動詞-ing

items.en: It's human nature. We are persistently asking ourselves questions about where we are from and why we are here.
items.zh: 這是人的天性。我們不斷地問自己，我們從哪裡來，為什麼會在這裡。

items.en: I've written to him three times. He's persistently ignoring my emails.
items.zh: 我寫信給他三次了。他一直不理我的 email。

items.en: We've been cold for weeks. The landlord is persistently refusing to fix the heating.
items.zh: 我們冷了好幾個星期。房東一直拒絕修暖氣。

items.en: Some students are persistently arriving late, so we're locking the door at nine.
items.zh: 有些學生一直遲到，所以我們九點就鎖門。

items.en: Nothing ever gets decided. The committee is persistently avoiding the real issue.
items.zh: 什麼事都決定不了。委員會一直在迴避真正的問題。

examples.heading: ② be perpetually + 動詞-ing

items.en: Don't wait for Tim. He's perpetually running late.
items.zh: 別等 Tim 了。他永遠都在遲到。

items.en: My uncle is perpetually complaining about his salary, but he never looks for another job.
items.zh: 我舅舅永遠在抱怨薪水，可是從來不找別的工作。

items.en: In this job you're perpetually fighting against deadlines.
items.zh: 做這份工作，你永遠都在跟截止日期拚。

items.en: Politicians are perpetually promising change before an election.
items.zh: 政治人物每到選舉前就說要改變，永遠都一樣。

items.en: The poor man is perpetually apologising for things that aren't his fault.
items.zh: 那個可憐的人永遠在為不是他的錯道歉。

examples.heading: ③ be endlessly + 動詞-ing

items.en: Turn the TV off. The kids are endlessly arguing over the remote.
items.zh: 把電視關掉。孩子們為了遙控器吵個沒完。

items.en: I've stopped watching. The news channels are endlessly repeating the same story.
items.zh: 我不看了。新聞台沒完沒了地重播同一則新聞。

items.en: He's endlessly talking about his trip to Japan. We've heard it all.
items.zh: 他沒完沒了地講他去日本的事。我們全都聽過了。

items.en: Scientists are endlessly searching for a cure for the common cold.
items.zh: 科學家一直在尋找治感冒的方法。

examples.heading: ④ be repeatedly + 動詞-ing

items.en: No wonder people are leaving. The company is repeatedly breaking its promises to its staff.
items.zh: 難怪大家都在離職。那家公司一次又一次違背對員工的承諾。

items.en: We're repeatedly reminding residents not to park on the grass.
items.zh: 我們一再提醒住戶不要把車停在草地上。

items.en: Look at this again. The same mistake is repeatedly appearing in your essays.
items.zh: 你再看一次這個。同一個錯誤一再出現在你的作文裡。

items.en: We need to fix this fast. Customers are repeatedly reporting problems with the new update.
items.zh: 我們得趕快修好。客戶一再回報新版更新的問題。

items.en: My son is repeatedly losing his school bag. This is the third one this year.
items.zh: 我兒子一再弄丟書包。這已經是今年第三個了。

examples.heading: ⑤ be permanently + 動詞-ing

items.en: During life we are permanently learning and increasing our knowledge.
items.zh: 人一生都在學習，不斷增加知識。

items.en: The hospital needs more staff. Doctors in this ward are permanently working under pressure.
items.zh: 醫院需要更多人手。這個病房的醫生一直在壓力下工作。

items.en: Our planet is permanently changing, even if we can't see it.
items.zh: 我們的地球一直在變，就算我們看不出來。

examples.heading: ⑥ be + 動詞-ing + incessantly

items.en: I can't sleep. The dog next door is barking incessantly.
items.zh: 我睡不著。隔壁的狗叫個不停。

items.en: My phone is buzzing incessantly with messages from the group chat.
items.zh: 群組的訊息讓我的手機震個不停。

items.en: The baby has a cold and is crying incessantly.
items.zh: 寶寶感冒了，一直哭個不停。

items.en: She's talking incessantly about the wedding. It's all she thinks about.
items.zh: 她不停地講婚禮的事。她滿腦子都是這件事。

examples.heading: ⑦ 疑問句

items.en: The park is still full of rubbish. Why is the council repeatedly ignoring our complaints?
items.zh: 公園還是滿地垃圾。市議會為什麼一再無視我們的投訴？

items.en: Why are you perpetually apologising? It's fine.
items.zh: 你為什麼老是在道歉？沒關係的。

items.en: We shout at our kids, just like our parents did. Are we endlessly repeating their mistakes?
items.zh: 我們跟我們的父母一樣對孩子大吼。我們是不是一直在重複他們犯過的錯？

items.en: My boss is getting annoyed. Why is he persistently calling me at work?
items.zh: 我老闆開始不高興了。他為什麼一直打電話到我公司？

title: They always make special things for their celebrations.
translation: 他們總是會為他們的慶祝活動做一些特別的東西。
name: 現在簡單式加不定頻率副詞
sentences: Every village festival is different. They always make special things for their celebrations.
My grandma always gives me money on my birthday.
Don't worry. The bus is always on time.
I always forget my umbrella when it rains.
We always have pizza on Friday nights. It's a family tradition.
The café opens at seven. People usually eat breakfast between seven and nine.
I usually walk to school, but today I'm taking the bus.
The shop is usually busy on Saturdays. Go early.
She lives abroad now. My sister usually calls me on Sunday evenings.
You're always home after dark. What time do you usually finish work?
We often go to the beach in summer. It's only ten minutes away.
He often works late, so he's tired at weekends.
Bring a jacket. It's often windy here in spring.
You know all the good restaurants. Do you often eat out?
I don't often see my cousins. They live in Canada.
I know the shop well. I sometimes help my dad there.
The park is next to our school. Sometimes we stop there on the way home.
My little brother is sometimes a bit shy with new people.
Leave a bit early. The trains are sometimes late in winter.
She loves books. She sometimes reads in bed until midnight.
My grandad rarely watches TV. He prefers the radio.
It hardly ever snows here, so the kids are excited today.
Don't cook steak for us. We rarely eat meat at home.
His mum is worried. He hardly ever calls his parents.
I never drink coffee after lunch. It keeps me awake.
Don't bother calling her. My cat never comes when I call her.
Mia will get there before us. She's never late for class.
They never go on holiday in August because it's too hot.
Don't go in there. My brother never cleans his room.
Turn the TV off, please. We never watch the news at dinner.

examples.heading: ① always

items.en: Every village festival is different. They always make special things for their celebrations.
items.zh: 村裡每個節慶都不一樣。他們總是會為他們的慶祝活動做一些特別的東西。

items.en: My grandma always gives me money on my birthday.
items.zh: 我奶奶每年生日都會給我錢。

items.en: Don't worry. The bus is always on time.
items.zh: 別擔心。公車都很準時。

items.en: I always forget my umbrella when it rains.
items.zh: 下雨的時候我總是忘記帶傘。

items.en: We always have pizza on Friday nights. It's a family tradition.
items.zh: 我們每個星期五晚上都吃披薩。這是我們家的傳統。

examples.heading: ② usually

items.en: The café opens at seven. People usually eat breakfast between seven and nine.
items.zh: 咖啡店七點開門。人們通常在七點到九點之間吃早餐。

items.en: I usually walk to school, but today I'm taking the bus.
items.zh: 我通常走路上學，可是今天我搭公車。

items.en: The shop is usually busy on Saturdays. Go early.
items.zh: 這家店星期六通常很多人。早點去。

items.en: She lives abroad now. My sister usually calls me on Sunday evenings.
items.zh: 她現在住國外。我姊姊通常星期天晚上打給我。

items.en: You're always home after dark. What time do you usually finish work?
items.zh: 你總是天黑才到家。你通常幾點下班？

examples.heading: ③ often

items.en: We often go to the beach in summer. It's only ten minutes away.
items.zh: 我們夏天常去海邊。只要十分鐘。

items.en: He often works late, so he's tired at weekends.
items.zh: 他常常加班，所以他週末都很累。

items.en: Bring a jacket. It's often windy here in spring.
items.zh: 帶件外套。這裡春天常常颳風。

items.en: You know all the good restaurants. Do you often eat out?
items.zh: 你知道所有好餐廳。你常常在外面吃飯嗎？

items.en: I don't often see my cousins. They live in Canada.
items.zh: 我不常見到我的表兄弟姊妹。他們住在加拿大。

examples.heading: ④ sometimes

items.en: I know the shop well. I sometimes help my dad there.
items.zh: 我對那家店很熟。我有時候會去幫我爸的忙。

items.en: The park is next to our school. Sometimes we stop there on the way home.
items.zh: 公園就在我們學校旁邊。有時候我們回家路上會去那裡逛逛。

items.en: My little brother is sometimes a bit shy with new people.
items.zh: 我弟弟見到不認識的人有時候會有點害羞。

items.en: Leave a bit early. The trains are sometimes late in winter.
items.zh: 早一點出門。冬天火車有時候會誤點。

items.en: She loves books. She sometimes reads in bed until midnight.
items.zh: 她很愛看書。她有時候會在床上看書看到半夜。

examples.heading: ⑤ rarely / hardly ever

items.en: My grandad rarely watches TV. He prefers the radio.
items.zh: 我爺爺很少看電視。他比較喜歡聽收音機。

items.en: It hardly ever snows here, so the kids are excited today.
items.zh: 這裡幾乎不下雪，所以孩子們今天很興奮。

items.en: Don't cook steak for us. We rarely eat meat at home.
items.zh: 別幫我們煮牛排。我們在家很少吃肉。

items.en: His mum is worried. He hardly ever calls his parents.
items.zh: 他媽媽很擔心。他幾乎不打電話給他爸媽。

examples.heading: ⑥ never

items.en: I never drink coffee after lunch. It keeps me awake.
items.zh: 我午餐後從來不喝咖啡。喝了會睡不著。

items.en: Don't bother calling her. My cat never comes when I call her.
items.zh: 別叫了。我叫我的貓，牠從來不過來。

items.en: Mia will get there before us. She's never late for class.
items.zh: Mia 會比我們早到。她上課從來不遲到。

items.en: They never go on holiday in August because it's too hot.
items.zh: 他們從來不在八月去度假，因為太熱了。

items.en: Don't go in there. My brother never cleans his room.
items.zh: 別進去。我弟弟從來不打掃他的房間。

items.en: Turn the TV off, please. We never watch the news at dinner.
items.zh: 請把電視關掉。我們吃晚餐時從來不看新聞。

title: I really want to see you.
translation: 我真的很想見你。
name: really 加強現在簡單式的動詞
sentences: It's been six months. I really want to see you.
I really like my kitchen because it's big and new.
Thanks for the scarf. I really love the colour.
I really need a holiday. I'm so tired.
It's on Saturday at my house. I really hope you can come to my party.
Our teacher is so funny. I really enjoy my English lessons on Fridays.
We really miss you. Please come home soon.
You really need a new phone. That one is so old.
My parents really love this restaurant. They come here every week.
Look at their faces. The children really enjoy the swimming lessons.
We really want a dog, but our flat is too small.
My brother really likes football. He watches every match.
She studies every night. She really wants to be a doctor.
Don't call him before nine. Tom really hates getting up early.
My grandma really enjoys her walk in the park every morning.
This plant really needs some water. Look at the leaves.
Ask Mr Green about the castle. Our teacher really knows a lot about history.
Thanks, but I don't really like coffee. Do you have tea?
He doesn't really enjoy parties. He prefers quiet evenings.
We don't really need a car. The bus is fine.
I don't really know her. We only met once.
She doesn't really want to go, but she has to.
Please don't sing. I really don't like that song.
Stop asking him. He really doesn't want to move to another city.
Let's just get sandwiches. We really don't have time for lunch today.
Try this soup. It's really good.
My new school is really big. I get lost every day.
Thank you, you're really kind.
Start studying now. The test is really hard this year.
I'm really hungry. Let's eat now.

examples.heading: ① I really + 動詞

items.en: It's been six months. I really want to see you.
items.zh: 已經半年了。我真的很想見你。

items.en: I really like my kitchen because it's big and new.
items.zh: 我真的很喜歡我的廚房，因為它又大又新。

items.en: Thanks for the scarf. I really love the colour.
items.zh: 謝謝你的圍巾。我真的很愛這個顏色。

items.en: I really need a holiday. I'm so tired.
items.zh: 我真的需要放個假。我好累。

items.en: It's on Saturday at my house. I really hope you can come to my party.
items.zh: 星期六在我家。我真的很希望你能來我的派對。

items.en: Our teacher is so funny. I really enjoy my English lessons on Fridays.
items.zh: 我們老師好好笑。我真的很喜歡星期五的英文課。

examples.heading: ② we / you / they really + 動詞

items.en: We really miss you. Please come home soon.
items.zh: 我們真的很想你。請早點回家。

items.en: You really need a new phone. That one is so old.
items.zh: 你真的需要一支新手機。那支太舊了。

items.en: My parents really love this restaurant. They come here every week.
items.zh: 我爸媽真的很愛這家餐廳。他們每個星期都來。

items.en: Look at their faces. The children really enjoy the swimming lessons.
items.zh: 你看他們的表情。孩子們真的很喜歡游泳課。

items.en: We really want a dog, but our flat is too small.
items.zh: 我們真的很想養狗，可是我們的公寓太小了。

examples.heading: ③ he / she / it really + 動詞-s

items.en: My brother really likes football. He watches every match.
items.zh: 我哥哥真的很喜歡足球。他每場比賽都看。

items.en: She studies every night. She really wants to be a doctor.
items.zh: 她每天晚上都在讀書。她真的很想當醫生。

items.en: Don't call him before nine. Tom really hates getting up early.
items.zh: 九點前別打給他。Tom 真的很討厭早起。

items.en: My grandma really enjoys her walk in the park every morning.
items.zh: 我奶奶真的很喜歡每天早上去公園散步。

items.en: This plant really needs some water. Look at the leaves.
items.zh: 這盆植物真的需要澆水了。你看那些葉子。

items.en: Ask Mr Green about the castle. Our teacher really knows a lot about history.
items.zh: 去問 Green 老師那座城堡的事。我們老師真的很懂歷史。

examples.heading: ④ don't / doesn't really + 動詞

items.en: Thanks, but I don't really like coffee. Do you have tea?
items.zh: 謝謝，可是我不太喜歡咖啡。你有茶嗎？

items.en: He doesn't really enjoy parties. He prefers quiet evenings.
items.zh: 他不太喜歡派對。他比較喜歡安靜的晚上。

items.en: We don't really need a car. The bus is fine.
items.zh: 我們不太需要車。公車就可以了。

items.en: I don't really know her. We only met once.
items.zh: 我跟她不太熟。我們只見過一次面。

items.en: She doesn't really want to go, but she has to.
items.zh: 她不太想去，可是她非去不可。

examples.heading: ⑤ really don't / doesn't + 動詞

items.en: Please don't sing. I really don't like that song.
items.zh: 拜託別唱了。我真的很不喜歡那首歌。

items.en: Stop asking him. He really doesn't want to move to another city.
items.zh: 別再問他了。他真的很不想搬到別的城市。

items.en: Let's just get sandwiches. We really don't have time for lunch today.
items.zh: 我們買三明治就好。我們今天真的沒時間吃午餐。

examples.heading: ⑥ be + really + 形容詞

items.en: Try this soup. It's really good.
items.zh: 吃吃看這個湯。真的很好喝。

items.en: My new school is really big. I get lost every day.
items.zh: 我的新學校真的很大。我每天都迷路。

items.en: Thank you, you're really kind.
items.zh: 謝謝你，你人真的很好。

items.en: Start studying now. The test is really hard this year.
items.zh: 現在就開始讀書吧。今年的考試真的很難。

items.en: I'm really hungry. Let's eat now.
items.zh: 我真的好餓。我們現在就吃吧。

title: I haven't seen you for ages.
translation: 好久沒看到你了。
name: 現在完成式否定句加 for 表示期間
sentences: Let's go to Mario's tonight. I haven't eaten Italian food for a long time.
We both work too much. We haven't been on holiday for ages.
I'm worried about my sister. She hasn't called me for a while.
My fingers are slow now. I haven't played the piano for years.
Dear Kate, sorry I haven't written for so long.
My cousins live far from their grandparents. They haven't visited them for a long time.
My brother says he's too busy. He hasn't been to the gym for ages.
My dad stopped smoking in May. He hasn't had a cigarette for six months.
The farmers are worried. It hasn't rained for three weeks.
We had a big argument about money. My sister and I haven't spoken for two years.
My brother is very busy in Dubai. He hasn't phoned for a month.
I take the train everywhere. I haven't driven a car for ten years.
The owner is in hospital. The shop hasn't opened for two days.
Is Tom all right? We haven't heard from him for weeks.
I'm going to the school reunion. I haven't talked to my old classmates for years.
I think my friend is angry with me. She hasn't answered my messages for days.
Let's have lunch on Friday. We haven't met up for a long time.
Your old bike is in the garage. You haven't ridden it for months.
We're trying to save money. We haven't eaten out for weeks.
I'm always on my phone now. I haven't read a novel for ages.
Look at all the dirt on the glass. The office cleaners haven't cleaned the windows for a year.
My grandmother loved to dance. She hasn't danced for years.
You didn't know she was in Spain? Haven't you heard from her for a long time?
Mia is looking for a job again. Hasn't she worked for months?
The grass next door is so long. Haven't the neighbours cut it for weeks?
I'm really hungry. I haven't eaten for hours.
The plants look dry because we haven't watered them for a week.
I'm a bit nervous. I haven't sung in public for years.
The car won't start. We haven't used it for months.
I'm so tired. I haven't slept properly for days.

examples.heading: ① for + 不確切的長度

items.en: Let's go to Mario's tonight. I haven't eaten Italian food for a long time.
items.zh: 我們今晚去馬力歐的店吧。我很久沒吃義大利菜了。

items.en: We both work too much. We haven't been on holiday for ages.
items.zh: 我們兩個都工作太多。我們好久沒去度假了。

items.en: I'm worried about my sister. She hasn't called me for a while.
items.zh: 我很擔心我姊姊。她有一陣子沒打給我了。

items.en: My fingers are slow now. I haven't played the piano for years.
items.zh: 我的手指現在很不靈活。我好幾年沒彈鋼琴了。

items.en: Dear Kate, sorry I haven't written for so long.
items.zh: 親愛的凱特，抱歉我這麼久沒寫信給你。

items.en: My cousins live far from their grandparents. They haven't visited them for a long time.
items.zh: 我的表弟妹住得離爺爺奶奶很遠。他們很久沒去看爺爺奶奶了。

items.en: My brother says he's too busy. He hasn't been to the gym for ages.
items.zh: 我哥哥說他太忙了。他好久沒去健身房了。

examples.heading: ② for + 確切的長度

items.en: My dad stopped smoking in May. He hasn't had a cigarette for six months.
items.zh: 我爸爸五月戒菸了。他六個月沒抽菸了。

items.en: The farmers are worried. It hasn't rained for three weeks.
items.zh: 農夫們很擔心。已經三個禮拜沒下雨了。

items.en: We had a big argument about money. My sister and I haven't spoken for two years.
items.zh: 我們為了錢大吵一架。我跟我姊姊兩年沒講話了。

items.en: My brother is very busy in Dubai. He hasn't phoned for a month.
items.zh: 我哥在杜拜很忙。他一個月沒打電話來了。

items.en: I take the train everywhere. I haven't driven a car for ten years.
items.zh: 我去哪裡都搭火車。我十年沒開車了。

items.en: The owner is in hospital. The shop hasn't opened for two days.
items.zh: 老闆住院了。那家店兩天沒開了。

examples.heading: ③ 見面和聯絡

items.en: Is Tom all right? We haven't heard from him for weeks.
items.zh: 湯姆還好嗎？我們好幾個禮拜沒有他的消息了。

items.en: I'm going to the school reunion. I haven't talked to my old classmates for years.
items.zh: 我要去參加同學會。我好幾年沒跟以前的同學聊天了。

items.en: I think my friend is angry with me. She hasn't answered my messages for days.
items.zh: 我覺得我朋友在生我的氣。她好幾天沒回我的訊息了。

items.en: Let's have lunch on Friday. We haven't met up for a long time.
items.zh: 我們星期五一起吃午餐吧。我們很久沒見面了。

examples.heading: ④ 習慣和活動

items.en: Your old bike is in the garage. You haven't ridden it for months.
items.zh: 你的舊腳踏車在車庫裡。你好幾個月沒騎了。

items.en: We're trying to save money. We haven't eaten out for weeks.
items.zh: 我們在努力存錢。我們好幾個禮拜沒在外面吃飯了。

items.en: I'm always on my phone now. I haven't read a novel for ages.
items.zh: 我現在一直在滑手機。我好久沒看小說了。

items.en: Look at all the dirt on the glass. The office cleaners haven't cleaned the windows for a year.
items.zh: 你看玻璃上都是灰塵。辦公室的清潔人員一年沒擦窗戶了。

items.en: My grandmother loved to dance. She hasn't danced for years.
items.zh: 我奶奶以前很愛跳舞。她好幾年沒跳舞了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定問句：Haven't / Hasn't + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + for ...?

items.en: You didn't know she was in Spain? Haven't you heard from her for a long time?
items.zh: 你不知道她在西班牙？你很久沒有她的消息了嗎？

items.en: Mia is looking for a job again. Hasn't she worked for months?
items.zh: 米亞又在找工作了。她好幾個月沒工作了嗎？

items.en: The grass next door is so long. Haven't the neighbours cut it for weeks?
items.zh: 隔壁的草好長。鄰居好幾個禮拜沒割草了嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 說原因

items.en: I'm really hungry. I haven't eaten for hours.
items.zh: 我好餓，我好幾個小時沒吃東西了。

items.en: The plants look dry because we haven't watered them for a week.
items.zh: 植物看起來很乾，因為我們一個禮拜沒澆水了。

items.en: I'm a bit nervous. I haven't sung in public for years.
items.zh: 我有點緊張，我好幾年沒在大家面前唱歌了。

items.en: The car won't start. We haven't used it for months.
items.zh: 車子發不動，我們好幾個月沒開了。

items.en: I'm so tired. I haven't slept properly for days.
items.zh: 我好累，我好幾天沒好好睡覺了。

title: I haven't seen this film yet.
translation: 這部電影我還沒看過。
name: 現在完成式否定句加 yet
sentences: Can I keep it until Friday? I haven't finished the book you lent me yet.
Everyone says it's amazing, but I haven't seen Tom's new phone yet.
The wedding is next month, and I haven't bought a dress yet.
It's already three o'clock. I haven't had anything to eat yet today.
The forms are due in January. I haven't decided which university to apply to yet.
My birthday is in two weeks. I haven't sent out the invitations to the party yet.
Our train gets in late. We haven't found a hotel near the station yet.
Their plane was late. Our friends from Canada haven't arrived yet.
You're leaving school next month. You haven't told me your plans yet.
It's already the middle of December. We haven't put up the Christmas tree yet.
I've been out with Jack for a month. My parents haven't met him yet.
It's ten o'clock, and the children haven't gone to bed yet.
I sent my boss the report this morning. She hasn't replied yet.
The concert is on Saturday. Ben hasn't given me the money for the tickets yet.
Don't worry, the film hasn't started yet. They're still showing adverts.
My sister takes the bus to work. She hasn't passed her driving test yet.
My aunt posted it two weeks ago, but the parcel hasn't come yet.
Take your umbrella. It hasn't stopped raining yet.
You can't play outside now. Have you done your maths homework yet?
Our clothes are piling up. Has anyone come to fix the washing machine yet?
The house next door was sold in May. Have the new neighbours introduced themselves yet?
Tom said he'd call about the party. Has he called you yet?
There's a trip next week. Have you read the email from the school yet?
Grandma is coming for dinner. Have you set the table? — Not yet.
We're leaving at six tomorrow. Have you packed your suitcase? — Not yet.
You had a blood test last week. Has the hospital sent your results? — Not yet.
I can't tell you the ending of the book because I haven't finished it yet.
We can't start the meeting because Sam hasn't arrived yet.
Don't tell me the score. I haven't watched the match yet.
I can't pay you back because I haven't received my wages yet.
Please wait. The manager hasn't signed the form yet.

examples.heading: ① I haven't + 過去分詞 + yet

items.en: Can I keep it until Friday? I haven't finished the book you lent me yet.
items.zh: 我可以留到星期五嗎？你借我的書我還沒看完。

items.en: Everyone says it's amazing, but I haven't seen Tom's new phone yet.
items.zh: 大家都說它很厲害，可是我還沒看過湯姆的新手機。

items.en: The wedding is next month, and I haven't bought a dress yet.
items.zh: 婚禮在下個月，我還沒買洋裝。

items.en: It's already three o'clock. I haven't had anything to eat yet today.
items.zh: 已經三點了。我今天到現在還沒吃東西。

items.en: The forms are due in January. I haven't decided which university to apply to yet.
items.zh: 申請表一月要交。我還沒決定要申請哪一所大學。

items.en: My birthday is in two weeks. I haven't sent out the invitations to the party yet.
items.zh: 我的生日在兩個禮拜後。派對的邀請函我還沒寄出去。

examples.heading: ② we / you / they + haven't + 過去分詞 + yet

items.en: Our train gets in late. We haven't found a hotel near the station yet.
items.zh: 我們的火車很晚才到。我們還沒找到車站附近的飯店。

items.en: Their plane was late. Our friends from Canada haven't arrived yet.
items.zh: 他們的飛機誤點了。我們從加拿大來的朋友還沒到。

items.en: You're leaving school next month. You haven't told me your plans yet.
items.zh: 你下個月就要畢業了。你還沒跟我說你的計畫。

items.en: It's already the middle of December. We haven't put up the Christmas tree yet.
items.zh: 已經十二月中了。我們還沒把聖誕樹擺出來。

items.en: I've been out with Jack for a month. My parents haven't met him yet.
items.zh: 我跟傑克交往一個月了。我爸媽還沒見過他。

items.en: It's ten o'clock, and the children haven't gone to bed yet.
items.zh: 已經十點了，孩子們還沒睡。

examples.heading: ③ he / she / it + hasn't + 過去分詞 + yet

items.en: I sent my boss the report this morning. She hasn't replied yet.
items.zh: 我今天早上把報告寄給老闆。她還沒回覆。

items.en: The concert is on Saturday. Ben hasn't given me the money for the tickets yet.
items.zh: 演唱會在星期六。班還沒給我票錢。

items.en: Don't worry, the film hasn't started yet. They're still showing adverts.
items.zh: 別擔心，電影還沒開始。他們還在播廣告。

items.en: My sister takes the bus to work. She hasn't passed her driving test yet.
items.zh: 我妹妹搭公車上班。她還沒考過駕照。

items.en: My aunt posted it two weeks ago, but the parcel hasn't come yet.
items.zh: 我阿姨兩個禮拜前就寄了，可是包裹還沒到。

items.en: Take your umbrella. It hasn't stopped raining yet.
items.zh: 帶著你的傘。雨還沒停。

examples.heading: ④ 問句：Have / Has + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + yet?

items.en: You can't play outside now. Have you done your maths homework yet?
items.zh: 你現在不能出去玩。你的數學作業寫了沒？

items.en: Our clothes are piling up. Has anyone come to fix the washing machine yet?
items.zh: 我們的衣服越堆越多。有人來修洗衣機了沒？

items.en: The house next door was sold in May. Have the new neighbours introduced themselves yet?
items.zh: 隔壁的房子五月賣掉了。新鄰居來打過招呼了沒？

items.en: Tom said he'd call about the party. Has he called you yet?
items.zh: 湯姆說他會打來說派對的事。他打給你了沒？

items.en: There's a trip next week. Have you read the email from the school yet?
items.zh: 下禮拜有校外教學。學校寄來的電子郵件你看了沒？

examples.heading: ⑤ Not yet.

items.en: Grandma is coming for dinner. Have you set the table? — Not yet.
items.zh: 奶奶要來吃晚餐。你擺好餐具了嗎？還沒。

items.en: We're leaving at six tomorrow. Have you packed your suitcase? — Not yet.
items.zh: 我們明天六點出發。你的行李箱收好了嗎？還沒。

items.en: You had a blood test last week. Has the hospital sent your results? — Not yet.
items.zh: 你上禮拜驗了血。醫院把你的檢查結果寄來了嗎？還沒。

examples.heading: ⑥ 說原因

items.en: I can't tell you the ending of the book because I haven't finished it yet.
items.zh: 我沒辦法跟你說這本書的結局，因為我還沒看完。

items.en: We can't start the meeting because Sam hasn't arrived yet.
items.zh: 我們還不能開會，因為山姆還沒到。

items.en: Don't tell me the score. I haven't watched the match yet.
items.zh: 不要跟我說比數，那場比賽我還沒看。

items.en: I can't pay you back because I haven't received my wages yet.
items.zh: 我還沒辦法還你錢，因為我還沒領到薪水。

items.en: Please wait. The manager hasn't signed the form yet.
items.zh: 請稍等，經理還沒簽那張表格。

title: We are missing you.

name: 現在進行式表示進行中的事（常用動詞）
sentences: "Where's Mum?" "She's having a bath."

Shh, Dad is talking to his boss on the phone.

examples.heading: ① 說話這一刻正在做的動作

items.en: "Where's Mum?" "She's having a bath."
items.zh: 媽媽在哪？她在洗澡。

items.en: I can't come to the phone right now. I'm doing my homework.
items.zh: 我現在不能接電話。我在寫功課。

items.en: "What are you doing?" "I'm waiting for Lisa. She's late again."
items.zh: 你在做什麼？我在等 Lisa。她又遲到了。

items.en: Shh, Dad is talking to his boss on the phone.
items.zh: 噓，爸爸在跟他老闆講電話。

items.en: Come and look! The cat is playing with a bird outside.
items.zh: 快來看！貓在外面跟一隻鳥玩。

items.en: I'm going to the supermarket now. Shall I get some milk for you?
items.zh: 我現在要去超市。要不要幫你買牛奶？

items.en: Hi, it's me. I'm standing at the front door. Can you let me in?
items.zh: 嗨，是我。我站在前門。你可以開門讓我進去嗎？

items.en: Turn the TV off, please. Nobody is watching it.
items.zh: 請把電視關掉。沒有人在看。

items.en: You'll see Ben easily. He's wearing his new football shirt.
items.zh: 你一眼就會看到 Ben。他穿著他的新足球衣。

items.en: "Is it raining?" "Yes, take your umbrella."
items.zh: 在下雨嗎？對，帶傘吧。

items.en: We're having dinner. Can I call you back in half an hour?
items.zh: 我們在吃晚餐。我半小時後再打給你好嗎？

items.en: Quick, get your coat. Our bus is coming round the corner.
items.zh: 快，拿外套。我們的公車從轉角開過來了。

items.en: Look at those boys. What are they doing on the roof?
items.zh: 你看那些男生。他們在屋頂上做什麼？

items.en: Dear Kate, I'm sitting in the garden and reading your letter.
items.zh: 親愛的 Kate，我坐在花園裡讀你的信。

items.en: Can you help me? I'm looking for the train station.
items.zh: 你可以幫我嗎？我在找火車站。

items.en: Our team is winning two to one at half-time.
items.zh: 中場的時候我們隊二比一領先。

items.en: You keep smiling at your phone. Who are you chatting with?
items.zh: 你一直對著手機笑。你在跟誰聊天？

examples.heading: ② 說話前後一段時間都在持續的事

items.en: Dear Amy, we are missing you. Get well soon!
items.zh: 親愛的 Amy，我們好想你。早日康復！

items.en: Grandpa, we're all thinking of you this week.
items.zh: 爺爺，我們這個星期都很掛念您。

items.en: My sister can't drive us yet. She is learning at the moment.
items.zh: 我姊姊還不能載我們。她現在在學。

items.en: I'm reading a really good book about Japan. I'll lend it to you after I finish.
items.zh: 我在看一本講日本的書，很好看。我看完借你。

items.en: Hi from Spain! We're having a great time at the beach.
items.zh: 從西班牙向你問好！我們在海邊玩得很開心。

items.en: Their teacher is pleased. The new students are doing well in their English class.
items.zh: 他們的老師很滿意。新來的學生英文課上得很好。

items.en: My dad is working on a big project, so he comes home late.
items.zh: 我爸在做一個大案子，所以他很晚才回家。

items.en: You started the course last month. Are you enjoying it so far?
items.zh: 你上個月開始上這門課。到目前為止，你喜歡嗎？

items.en: I'm not buying lunch out this month. I'm saving money for a new phone.
items.zh: 我這個月不在外面買午餐。我在存錢買新手機。

items.en: The baby is growing so fast. She's already walking.
items.zh: 寶寶長得好快。她已經會走路了。

items.en: Everyone in the office is talking about the new manager.
items.zh: 辦公室裡大家都在談新來的經理。

examples.heading: ③ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Are you listening to me? I'm asking you a question.
items.zh: 你有在聽我說話嗎？我在問你問題。

items.en: She isn't sleeping. She's just resting her eyes.
items.zh: 她沒在睡。她只是閉目養神。

items.en: The washing machine isn't working. Can you take a look?
items.zh: 洗衣機壞了。你可以看一下嗎？

items.en: "Are the kids watching TV?" "No, they're playing in their room."
items.zh: 孩子們在看電視嗎？沒有，他們在房間裡玩。

title: It's June, and it's getting warmer.
translation: 現在是六月，天氣越來越暖和了。
name: 現在進行式表示進行中的事（較多種動詞）
sentences: I'm at the pool with Dad. I am watching a swimming competition.
I'm selling an English book. It's called "English II". Do you want it?
We're organising a party for Mrs Brown. She's retiring next month.
Can I call you back? I'm cleaning the kitchen.
The library is full. The students are preparing for their final exams this week.
Come and see! My brother is building a treehouse in the garden.
They're painting the school, so we have classes in the hall.
Dear Aunt Mary, I'm writing to tell you about my new school.
Shh, the band is playing our song.
We're decorating the living room. It looks so different now.
I'm writing from London. It's June, and it's getting warmer.
Let's go home. It's getting dark.
My grandad is getting older, so he needs more help at home.
Take your coat. It's getting colder in the evenings.
We need a new train line. The traffic in this city is getting worse every year.
Your cough isn't getting better. You should see a doctor.
Phones are becoming cheaper, so almost every child has one.
We might move out of town. Life in the city is becoming more expensive.
My grandma buys everything on her tablet now. Online shopping is becoming more popular with older people.
We need new school uniforms again. The children are growing taller so fast.
The days are growing shorter now that autumn is here.
Keep practising. Your English is improving.
Our town is changing fast. There are new shops everywhere.
It's a good time to sell. House prices are rising again in this area.
The number of visitors is falling because of the bad weather.
My mum's health is improving slowly after the operation.
