examples.heading: ① 正在進行的動作

items.en: I'm at the pool with Dad. I am watching a swimming competition.
items.zh: 我跟爸爸在游泳池。我在看游泳比賽。

items.en: I'm selling an English book. It's called "English II". Do you want it?
items.zh: 我在賣一本英文書。書名叫《English II》。你要嗎？

items.en: We're organising a party for Mrs Brown. She's retiring next month.
items.zh: 我們在幫 Brown 老師辦派對。她下個月就退休了。

items.en: Can I call you back? I'm cleaning the kitchen.
items.zh: 我可以晚點回你電話嗎？我在打掃廚房。

items.en: The library is full. The students are preparing for their final exams this week.
items.zh: 圖書館坐滿了。學生們這個星期在準備期末考。

items.en: Come and see! My brother is building a treehouse in the garden.
items.zh: 快來看！我哥哥在花園裡蓋樹屋。

items.en: They're painting the school, so we have classes in the hall.
items.zh: 他們在油漆學校，所以我們在禮堂上課。

items.en: Dear Aunt Mary, I'm writing to tell you about my new school.
items.zh: 親愛的 Mary 阿姨，我寫信是想跟您說說我的新學校。

items.en: Shh, the band is playing our song.
items.zh: 噓，樂團在演奏我們的歌。

items.en: We're decorating the living room. It looks so different now.
items.zh: 我們在重新布置客廳。現在看起來很不一樣。

examples.heading: ② get + 比較級

items.en: I'm writing from London. It's June, and it's getting warmer.
items.zh: 我從倫敦寫信給你。現在是六月，天氣越來越暖和了。

items.en: Let's go home. It's getting dark.
items.zh: 我們回家吧。天色暗下來了。

items.en: My grandad is getting older, so he needs more help at home.
items.zh: 我爺爺年紀越來越大，所以在家需要更多幫忙。

items.en: Take your coat. It's getting colder in the evenings.
items.zh: 帶外套。晚上越來越冷了。

items.en: We need a new train line. The traffic in this city is getting worse every year.
items.zh: 我們需要一條新的鐵路。這個城市的交通一年比一年糟。

items.en: Your cough isn't getting better. You should see a doctor.
items.zh: 你的咳嗽一直沒好。你應該去看醫生。

examples.heading: ③ become / grow + 比較級

items.en: Phones are becoming cheaper, so almost every child has one.
items.zh: 手機越來越便宜，所以幾乎每個小孩都有一支。

items.en: We might move out of town. Life in the city is becoming more expensive.
items.zh: 我們可能會搬出城。城市生活越來越貴了。

items.en: My grandma buys everything on her tablet now. Online shopping is becoming more popular with older people.
items.zh: 我奶奶現在什麼都用平板買。網購在老年人之間越來越流行。

items.en: We need new school uniforms again. The children are growing taller so fast.
items.zh: 我們又得買新制服了。孩子們長高得好快。

items.en: The days are growing shorter now that autumn is here.
items.zh: 秋天到了，白天越來越短。

examples.heading: ④ 本身有變化意思的動詞

items.en: Keep practising. Your English is improving.
items.zh: 繼續練習。你的英文越來越好了。

items.en: Our town is changing fast. There are new shops everywhere.
items.zh: 我們鎮變得很快。到處都是新的店。

items.en: It's a good time to sell. House prices are rising again in this area.
items.zh: 現在是賣房子的好時機。這一區的房價又在漲了。

items.en: The number of visitors is falling because of the bad weather.
items.zh: 因為天氣不好，遊客人數在減少。

items.en: My mum's health is improving slowly after the operation.
items.zh: 我媽手術後健康慢慢在好轉。

items.en: Prices are going up every month, so we're buying less.
items.zh: 物價每個月都在漲，所以我們買得比較少。

examples.heading: ⑤ 比較級 and 比較級

items.en: Spring is finally here. The weather is getting warmer and warmer.
items.zh: 春天終於來了。天氣越來越暖和。

items.en: The queue is getting longer and longer. Let's come back later.
items.zh: 排隊的人越來越多。我們晚點再來吧。

items.en: My little sister is becoming more and more confident at school.
items.zh: 我妹妹在學校越來越有自信。

examples.heading: ① 計畫和打算

items.zh: 每家咖啡店都開著電視。大家都在等選舉結果。

examples.heading: ③ 慢慢的變化

items.en: I think I'm falling in love with him. I can't stop thinking about him.
items.zh: 我想我愛上他了。我一直在想他。

items.zh: 她感冒很嚴重，正在康復，所以今天不會來。

items.zh: 我們慢慢在習慣這裡的冷天氣。

items.zh: 醫院傳來好消息。我爺爺手術後恢復得很好。

items.en: Don't worry about your son. The new students are settling in nicely.
items.zh: 別擔心你兒子。新來的學生適應得很好。

items.en: The economy is recovering after a difficult year.
items.zh: 經過困難的一年，經濟在復甦。

examples.heading: ④ 困難和努力

items.en: He's struggling with his maths homework. Can you help him?
items.zh: 他的數學作業寫得很吃力。你可以幫他嗎？

items.en: Many families are struggling to pay their bills this winter.
items.zh: 今年冬天很多家庭都付不出帳單。

items.en: I'm trying to learn Spanish before my trip to Madrid.
items.zh: 去馬德里之前，我在努力學西班牙文。

items.en: We complained last month, and now the council is dealing with the rubbish in the park.
items.zh: 我們上個月投訴過，現在市議會在處理公園的垃圾。

items.en: We're working hard to finish the report by Friday.
items.zh: 我們在努力趕在星期五前完成報告。

items.en: Doctors are fighting to save the boy's life.
items.zh: 醫生們在努力救那個男孩的命。

examples.heading: ⑤ 其他動詞

items.en: Nothing is decided yet. The two companies are negotiating a new deal.
items.zh: 還沒有定案。兩家公司在談一筆新的交易。

items.en: Don't lose hope. Scientists are developing a new vaccine for the virus.
items.zh: 別失去希望。科學家在研發這種病毒的新疫苗。

items.en: I'm so nervous. I'm preparing a speech for my best friend's wedding.
items.zh: 我好緊張。我在準備我最好朋友婚禮上的致詞。

items.en: Buy a cake from us! Our club is raising money for the local hospital.
items.zh: 跟我們買個蛋糕吧！我們社團在為當地的醫院募款。

items.en: I saw you on the housing website. Are you still looking for a flat?
items.zh: 我在租屋網站上看到你。你還在找公寓嗎？

title: She goes to work by bus.
translation: 她搭公車上班。
name: 現在簡單式表示習慣和事實
sentences: My mum works at a bank in town. She goes to work by bus.
I watch TV in the evening, and I read books at night.
Don't call at seven. We have dinner together at that time.
My brother plays computer games after school and does his homework at night.
I'm never thirsty in the morning. I drink a glass of water when I get up.
Dad walks the dog before breakfast, so he's up at six.
She has lovely teeth. She brushes them after every meal.
Come with us! We go swimming on Saturdays.
The house is always busy on Sunday. My grandparents visit us every week.
I can meet you after lunch. The class starts at nine and finishes at twelve.
Don't worry if you miss it. The bus to the airport leaves every twenty minutes.
My room is a mess today. I clean it once a week.
Go before four. The shop closes early on Wednesdays.
I work in a supermarket near my house, so I walk there.
My aunt teaches music at a primary school. The kids love her.
They live in a flat on the tenth floor, so the view is amazing.
I like my place because it's quiet and the people are nice.
My dad drives a taxi, so he works at night.
Turn the heat down. Milk burns easily.
Our bedroom gets the morning light. The sun rises in the east.
Let's drive. It takes 25 minutes by car, but by bus it takes an hour.
Don't worry about your cat. Cats sleep for about fifteen hours a day.
Bring an umbrella if you visit. It rains a lot here in winter.
Let the baby sleep. Babies need a lot of sleep.
You can't get lost. This road goes straight to the station.
Your eyes look tired. What time do you usually get up?
The school is far. Does your sister walk there every day?
I'm always in a hurry. I don't eat breakfast on weekdays.
Call him on Saturday. He doesn't work at weekends.
The traffic is terrible here. How do you get to work?

examples.heading: ① 每天的習慣

items.en: My mum works at a bank in town. She goes to work by bus.
items.zh: 我媽在市區的銀行上班。她搭公車上班。

items.en: I watch TV in the evening, and I read books at night.
items.zh: 我晚上會看電視，睡前會看書。

items.en: Don't call at seven. We have dinner together at that time.
items.zh: 七點別打來。我們那時候都在一起吃晚餐。

items.en: My brother plays computer games after school and does his homework at night.
items.zh: 我弟弟放學後打電動，晚上才寫功課。

items.en: I'm never thirsty in the morning. I drink a glass of water when I get up.
items.zh: 我早上從來不會口渴。我起床就喝一杯水。

items.en: Dad walks the dog before breakfast, so he's up at six.
items.zh: 爸爸吃早餐前會去遛狗，所以他六點就起床。

items.en: She has lovely teeth. She brushes them after every meal.
items.zh: 她的牙齒很漂亮。她每餐飯後都刷牙。

examples.heading: ② 每週或固定的事

items.en: Come with us! We go swimming on Saturdays.
items.zh: 跟我們一起來吧！我們每個星期六去游泳。

items.en: The house is always busy on Sunday. My grandparents visit us every week.
items.zh: 星期天家裡總是很熱鬧。我爺爺奶奶每個星期都來看我們。

items.en: I can meet you after lunch. The class starts at nine and finishes at twelve.
items.zh: 我午餐後可以跟你碰面。課九點開始，十二點結束。

items.en: Don't worry if you miss it. The bus to the airport leaves every twenty minutes.
items.zh: 錯過了也別擔心。往機場的公車每二十分鐘一班。

items.en: My room is a mess today. I clean it once a week.
items.zh: 我的房間今天很亂。我一個星期打掃一次。

items.en: Go before four. The shop closes early on Wednesdays.
items.zh: 四點前去吧。這家店每個星期三提早關門。

examples.heading: ③ 工作和住的地方

items.en: I work in a supermarket near my house, so I walk there.
items.zh: 我在我家附近的超市工作，所以我走路去。

items.en: My aunt teaches music at a primary school. The kids love her.
items.zh: 我阿姨在一所小學教音樂。孩子們都很喜歡她。

items.en: They live in a flat on the tenth floor, so the view is amazing.
items.zh: 他們住在十樓的一間公寓，所以景色很棒。

items.en: I like my place because it's quiet and the people are nice.
items.zh: 我喜歡我住的地方，因為很安靜，人也很好。

items.en: My dad drives a taxi, so he works at night.
items.zh: 我爸開計程車，所以他晚上工作。

examples.heading: ④ 一般的事實

items.en: Turn the heat down. Milk burns easily.
items.zh: 把火關小一點。牛奶很容易燒焦。

items.en: Our bedroom gets the morning light. The sun rises in the east.
items.zh: 我們的臥室早上照得到陽光。太陽從東邊升起。

items.en: Let's drive. It takes 25 minutes by car, but by bus it takes an hour.
items.zh: 我們開車吧。開車要二十五分鐘，可是搭公車要一個小時。

items.en: Don't worry about your cat. Cats sleep for about fifteen hours a day.
items.zh: 別擔心你的貓。貓一天大約睡十五個小時。

items.en: Bring an umbrella if you visit. It rains a lot here in winter.
items.zh: 如果你要來，帶把傘。這裡冬天常下雨。

items.en: Let the baby sleep. Babies need a lot of sleep.
items.zh: 讓寶寶睡吧。嬰兒需要很多睡眠。

items.en: You can't get lost. This road goes straight to the station.
items.zh: 你不會迷路的。這條路直通車站。

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Your eyes look tired. What time do you usually get up?
items.zh: 你的眼睛看起來很累。你通常幾點起床？

items.en: The school is far. Does your sister walk there every day?
items.zh: 學校很遠。你妹妹每天走路去嗎？

items.en: I'm always in a hurry. I don't eat breakfast on weekdays.
items.zh: 我總是很趕。我平日不吃早餐。

items.en: Call him on Saturday. He doesn't work at weekends.
items.zh: 星期六打給他吧。他週末不上班。

items.en: The traffic is terrible here. How do you get to work?
items.zh: 這裡交通好糟。你怎麼去上班？

title: Then you turn right, and my house is on your left.
translation: 然後你右轉，我家就在你的左手邊。
name: 現在簡單式表示指示和指路
sentences: You get off at the post office. Then you turn right, and my house is on your left.
To find my house, you get off the bus at the station. Then you go straight on for about fifty metres.
From my house, you go past the church and cross the bridge.
Keep walking. When you see the supermarket, you turn left.
You walk for a few minutes, and the school is on your right.
You take the second street on the left. Our flat is number 12.
From the station, you take the number 5 bus and get off at the park.
The toilets? You go up the stairs, and they're at the end of the corridor.
You follow this road until you reach the lights. Then you turn right.
You come out of the station and cross the road. The hotel is opposite.
It's easy. First you put the coin in, and then you press the green button.
For pancakes, you mix the flour and the eggs, and then you add the milk.
To join the club, you open the app and type in your name.
First you boil the water. After that, you put the pasta in.
To get a library card, you fill in this form and give it to the woman at the desk.
My mum's way is simple. You wash the rice twice before you cook it.
Can you take our photo? You hold the camera like this and press here.
You wait for the green man, and then you cross.
Watch me. You press this switch, and the fan starts.
You turn left at the end of the road, and the beach is right there.
You go through that door, and the lift is on your right.
This is your room key. You put the card in, and the door opens.
The soup is a bit plain. You add a bit of salt, and it tastes much better.
First you go to the reception. Then you take the lift to the third floor.
After that, you turn right and walk to the end of the street.
Then you knock on the blue door. My aunt lives there.
Growing beans is easy. First you plant the seeds. Then you water them every day.
You don't turn at the first lights. You go on to the second ones.
You don't need a ticket. You just walk in.
Here's the secret to a good cake. You don't open the oven for the first twenty minutes.

examples.heading: ① 指路

items.en: You get off at the post office. Then you turn right, and my house is on your left.
items.zh: 你在郵局下車。然後你右轉，我家就在你的左手邊。

items.en: To find my house, you get off the bus at the station. Then you go straight on for about fifty metres.
items.zh: 要找我家，你在車站下公車。然後你直走大約五十公尺。

items.en: From my house, you go past the church and cross the bridge.
items.zh: 從我家出發，你經過教堂，然後過橋。

items.en: Keep walking. When you see the supermarket, you turn left.
items.zh: 繼續走。你看到超市的時候就左轉。

items.en: You walk for a few minutes, and the school is on your right.
items.zh: 你走幾分鐘，學校就在你的右手邊。

items.en: You take the second street on the left. Our flat is number 12.
items.zh: 你走左邊第二條街。我們的公寓是十二號。

items.en: From the station, you take the number 5 bus and get off at the park.
items.zh: 你從車站搭五號公車，在公園下車。

items.en: The toilets? You go up the stairs, and they're at the end of the corridor.
items.zh: 廁所嗎？你上樓梯，廁所在走廊的盡頭。

items.en: You follow this road until you reach the lights. Then you turn right.
items.zh: 你沿著這條路走到紅綠燈。然後右轉。

items.en: You come out of the station and cross the road. The hotel is opposite.
items.zh: 你出車站後過馬路。飯店就在對面。

examples.heading: ② 說明步驟

items.en: It's easy. First you put the coin in, and then you press the green button.
items.zh: 很簡單。首先你投硬幣，然後按綠色的按鈕。

items.en: For pancakes, you mix the flour and the eggs, and then you add the milk.
items.zh: 做鬆餅的話，你把麵粉和蛋混在一起，然後加牛奶。

items.en: To join the club, you open the app and type in your name.
items.zh: 要加入社團，你打開 app，輸入你的名字。

items.en: First you boil the water. After that, you put the pasta in.
items.zh: 首先你把水煮滾。然後你把麵放進去。

items.en: To get a library card, you fill in this form and give it to the woman at the desk.
items.zh: 要辦借書證，你填好這張表，交給櫃檯的那位女士。

items.en: My mum's way is simple. You wash the rice twice before you cook it.
items.zh: 我媽的做法很簡單。煮飯之前你先把米洗兩次。

items.en: Can you take our photo? You hold the camera like this and press here.
items.zh: 你可以幫我們拍照嗎？你這樣拿相機，然後按這裡。

items.en: You wait for the green man, and then you cross.
items.zh: 你等綠燈的小人亮，然後過馬路。

examples.heading: ③ 說明結果

items.en: Watch me. You press this switch, and the fan starts.
items.zh: 你看我做。你按這個開關，電風扇就會轉。

items.en: You turn left at the end of the road, and the beach is right there.
items.zh: 你在路的盡頭左轉，海灘就在那裡。

items.en: You go through that door, and the lift is on your right.
items.zh: 你穿過那扇門，電梯就在你的右手邊。

items.en: This is your room key. You put the card in, and the door opens.
items.zh: 這是你的房卡。你把卡插進去，門就會開。

items.en: The soup is a bit plain. You add a bit of salt, and it tastes much better.
items.zh: 湯有點淡。你加一點鹽，就好喝多了。

examples.heading: ④ 帶 then 和 after that 的步驟

items.en: First you go to the reception. Then you take the lift to the third floor.
items.zh: 首先你去櫃檯。然後你搭電梯到三樓。

items.en: After that, you turn right and walk to the end of the street.
items.zh: 接著你右轉，走到街的盡頭。

items.en: Then you knock on the blue door. My aunt lives there.
items.zh: 然後你敲藍色那扇門。我阿姨住在那裡。

items.en: Growing beans is easy. First you plant the seeds. Then you water them every day.
items.zh: 種豆子很簡單。首先你把種子種下去。然後你每天澆水。

examples.heading: ⑤ 指示裡的否定

items.en: You don't turn at the first lights. You go on to the second ones.
items.zh: 你在第一個紅綠燈不要轉。你繼續走到第二個。

items.en: You don't need a ticket. You just walk in.
items.zh: 你不用買票。直接走進去就好。

items.en: Here's the secret to a good cake. You don't open the oven for the first twenty minutes.
items.zh: 蛋糕好吃的祕訣是這樣。前二十分鐘你不要打開烤箱。

title: I think my bag is in your kitchen.
translation: 我想我的包包在你家廚房。
name: 現在簡單式加心理動詞（常用動詞）
sentences: I left my bag on a chair before dinner. I think my bag is in your kitchen.
I think it's going to rain. Take an umbrella.
I think you're right. Let's take the train.
This shop is expensive. I think we can find it cheaper online.
He talks about her every day. My brother thinks the new teacher is great.
What do you think of my new haircut?
I don't think he's coming. It's already nine.
We're going the wrong way. I don't think this is the right bus.
Ask Mum first. She doesn't think it's a good idea.
Can you go to the shop? I don't think we have enough milk for breakfast.
Sorry to hear you're ill. I hope that you feel better soon.
It's my birthday next week. I hope all my friends can come.
Thanks for the lovely flowers. We hope they last a long time.
I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow. We're going to the beach.
I study every night. My parents hope I pass my exams.
The film starts at eight. I hope he isn't late again.
I know it's late, but can I call you?
Do you know that we're going to have a concert at school?
I know the answer. It's Paris.
Ask my aunt about it. She knows a lot about old cars.
Can you open the door for me? I don't know where my keys are.
We know you're busy, so we'll be quick.
The sun is out, but it's windy. Do you think it's too cold for a picnic?
It's a surprise. Does your sister know about the party?
My phone is dead. Do you know what time it is?
She smiled at me again today. Do you think she likes me?
"Is the shop open today?" "I think so."
"Will you be at the meeting?" "I hope so."
"Is it going to rain?" "I hope not."
"Is Sam coming tonight?" "I don't think so."

examples.heading: ① I think ...

items.en: I left my bag on a chair before dinner. I think my bag is in your kitchen.
items.zh: 我吃飯前把包包放在椅子上。我想我的包包在你家廚房。

items.en: I think it's going to rain. Take an umbrella.
items.zh: 我覺得會下雨。帶把傘。

items.en: I think you're right. Let's take the train.
items.zh: 我覺得你說得對。我們搭火車吧。

items.en: This shop is expensive. I think we can find it cheaper online.
items.zh: 這家店好貴。我覺得我們在網路上可以買到比較便宜的。

items.en: He talks about her every day. My brother thinks the new teacher is great.
items.zh: 他每天都在講她。我哥哥覺得新老師很棒。

items.en: What do you think of my new haircut?
items.zh: 你覺得我的新髮型怎麼樣？

examples.heading: ② I don't think ...

items.en: I don't think he's coming. It's already nine.
items.zh: 我覺得他不會來了。已經九點了。

items.en: We're going the wrong way. I don't think this is the right bus.
items.zh: 我們方向不對。我覺得這不是對的公車。

items.en: Ask Mum first. She doesn't think it's a good idea.
items.zh: 先問媽媽。她覺得這不是個好主意。

items.en: Can you go to the shop? I don't think we have enough milk for breakfast.
items.zh: 你可以去一趟店裡嗎？我覺得我們的牛奶不夠吃早餐。

examples.heading: ③ I hope ...

items.en: Sorry to hear you're ill. I hope that you feel better soon.
items.zh: 聽說你生病了。我希望你早日康復。

items.en: It's my birthday next week. I hope all my friends can come.
items.zh: 下星期是我生日。我希望我的朋友都能來。

items.en: Thanks for the lovely flowers. We hope they last a long time.
items.zh: 謝謝你送的漂亮花束。我們希望花能開得久一點。

items.en: I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow. We're going to the beach.
items.zh: 我希望明天不要下雨。我們要去海邊。

items.en: I study every night. My parents hope I pass my exams.
items.zh: 我每天晚上都讀書。我爸媽希望我考試及格。

items.en: The film starts at eight. I hope he isn't late again.
items.zh: 電影八點開始。我希望他不要又遲到。

examples.heading: ④ I know ...

items.en: I know it's late, but can I call you?
items.zh: 我知道很晚了，可是我可以打給你嗎？

items.en: Do you know that we're going to have a concert at school?
items.zh: 你知道我們學校要辦音樂會嗎？

items.en: I know the answer. It's Paris.
items.zh: 我知道答案。是巴黎。

items.en: Ask my aunt about it. She knows a lot about old cars.
items.zh: 去問我阿姨。她很懂老爺車。

items.en: Can you open the door for me? I don't know where my keys are.
items.zh: 你可以幫我開門嗎？我不知道我的鑰匙在哪裡。

items.en: We know you're busy, so we'll be quick.
items.zh: 我們知道你很忙，所以我們會很快。

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問句

items.en: The sun is out, but it's windy. Do you think it's too cold for a picnic?
items.zh: 出太陽了，可是有風。你覺得這種天氣野餐會太冷嗎？

items.en: It's a surprise. Does your sister know about the party?
items.zh: 這是個驚喜。你姊姊知道派對的事嗎？

items.en: My phone is dead. Do you know what time it is?
items.zh: 我的手機沒電了。你知道現在幾點嗎？

items.en: She smiled at me again today. Do you think she likes me?
items.zh: 她今天又對我笑了。你覺得她喜歡我嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ I think so / I hope so

items.en: "Is the shop open today?" "I think so."
items.zh: 那家店今天有開嗎？我想有吧。

items.en: "Will you be at the meeting?" "I hope so."
items.zh: 你會來開會嗎？希望可以。

items.en: "Is it going to rain?" "I hope not."
items.zh: 會下雨嗎？希望不會。

items.en: "Is Sam coming tonight?" "I don't think so."
items.zh: Sam 今晚會來嗎？我覺得不會。

title: I totally understand that you want to go somewhere with your friends.
translation: 我完全了解你想跟朋友一起去哪裡走走。
name: 現在簡單式加心理動詞（較多種動詞）
sentences: I totally understand that you want to go somewhere with your friends. But you're only sixteen.
I understand why you're angry. I'm sorry I forgot.
Can you say that again? I don't understand the question.
My grandma understands English, but she doesn't speak it.
We understand that the trains are late. Please wait for more news.
I'm reading an adventure book. I don't remember the title, but it's very boring!
It's ten years today. Do you remember the first time we met?
I remember her face, but I forget her name.
They're on his head again. My dad always forgets where he puts his glasses.
Your face looks familiar. I remember seeing you at Sam's wedding.
She never forgets a birthday. She writes them all in a book.
I believe that he's telling the truth. He has no reason to lie.
You always wear that shirt for matches. Do you believe in luck?
He says the dog ate it. Nobody believes his story about the lost homework.
It's getting late. I doubt she'll come now.
There's so much work left. I doubt that we can finish this by Friday.
I realise this is difficult for you, but we need an answer today.
It's after midnight. Do you realise what time it is?
Mum gets back from Australia tonight. I imagine she's very tired after such a long trip.
I use it for everything. I can't imagine life without my phone.
The roads are terrible at rush hour. I totally agree with you, so let's take the train.
They want me to be a doctor. My parents don't agree with me about my future.
Some schools give no homework at all. Do you agree that homework is important?
No coffee for me, thanks. I prefer tea in the morning.
Sorry, I don't recognise you. Have we met?
What do you mean? I don't follow.
Don't put her in a group. She prefers to work alone.
Two kids and one bathroom? I completely agree. We need a bigger flat.
You've trained so hard. I really believe you can win this race.
I fully understand your worries, but the trip is safe.

examples.heading: ① understand

items.en: I totally understand that you want to go somewhere with your friends. But you're only sixteen.
items.zh: 我完全了解你想跟朋友一起去哪裡走走。可是你才十六歲。

items.en: I understand why you're angry. I'm sorry I forgot.
items.zh: 我了解你為什麼生氣。很抱歉我忘了。

items.en: Can you say that again? I don't understand the question.
items.zh: 你可以再說一次嗎？我聽不懂這個問題。

items.en: My grandma understands English, but she doesn't speak it.
items.zh: 我奶奶聽得懂英文，可是不會說。

items.en: We understand that the trains are late. Please wait for more news.
items.zh: 我們知道火車誤點了。請等候進一步的消息。

examples.heading: ② remember / forget

items.en: I'm reading an adventure book. I don't remember the title, but it's very boring!
items.zh: 我在看一本冒險小說。我不記得書名，可是很無聊！

items.en: It's ten years today. Do you remember the first time we met?
items.zh: 今天滿十年了。你記得我們第一次見面的時候嗎？

items.en: I remember her face, but I forget her name.
items.zh: 我記得她的臉，可是忘了她的名字。

items.en: They're on his head again. My dad always forgets where he puts his glasses.
items.zh: 眼鏡又在他頭上了。我爸總是忘記他把眼鏡放在哪裡。

items.en: Your face looks familiar. I remember seeing you at Sam's wedding.
items.zh: 你看起來很面熟。我記得在 Sam 的婚禮上見過你。

items.en: She never forgets a birthday. She writes them all in a book.
items.zh: 她從來不會忘記別人的生日。她把每個人的生日都寫在本子上。

examples.heading: ③ believe / doubt

items.en: I believe that he's telling the truth. He has no reason to lie.
items.zh: 我相信他說的是實話。他沒有理由說謊。

items.en: You always wear that shirt for matches. Do you believe in luck?
items.zh: 你比賽都穿那件襯衫。你相信運氣嗎？

items.en: He says the dog ate it. Nobody believes his story about the lost homework.
items.zh: 他說狗把功課吃了。沒有人相信他功課不見的說法。

items.en: It's getting late. I doubt she'll come now.
items.zh: 很晚了。我懷疑她現在還會來。

items.en: There's so much work left. I doubt that we can finish this by Friday.
items.zh: 還有好多工作。我懷疑我們能在星期五前做完。

examples.heading: ④ realise / imagine

items.en: I realise this is difficult for you, but we need an answer today.
items.zh: 我知道這對你來說很難，可是我們今天就需要答案。

items.en: It's after midnight. Do you realise what time it is?
items.zh: 已經過半夜了。你知道現在幾點了嗎？

items.en: Mum gets back from Australia tonight. I imagine she's very tired after such a long trip.
items.zh: 媽媽今晚從澳洲回來。我想她旅行那麼久，一定很累。

items.en: I use it for everything. I can't imagine life without my phone.
items.zh: 我什麼都用它。我無法想像沒有手機的生活。

examples.heading: ⑤ agree / disagree

items.en: The roads are terrible at rush hour. I totally agree with you, so let's take the train.
items.zh: 尖峰時間路上很糟。我完全同意你，所以我們搭火車吧。

items.en: They want me to be a doctor. My parents don't agree with me about my future.
items.zh: 他們要我當醫生。我爸媽對我的未來跟我意見不同。

items.en: Some schools give no homework at all. Do you agree that homework is important?
items.zh: 有些學校完全不出功課。你同意功課很重要嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ mean / prefer / recognise

items.en: No coffee for me, thanks. I prefer tea in the morning.
items.zh: 我不用咖啡，謝謝。我早上比較喜歡喝茶。

items.en: Sorry, I don't recognise you. Have we met?
items.zh: 抱歉，我認不出你。我們見過嗎？

items.en: What do you mean? I don't follow.
items.zh: 你是什麼意思？我聽不懂。

items.en: Don't put her in a group. She prefers to work alone.
items.zh: 別把她分到小組裡。她比較喜歡一個人工作。

examples.heading: ⑦ 加強的副詞

items.en: Two kids and one bathroom? I completely agree. We need a bigger flat.
items.zh: 兩個孩子只有一間浴室？我完全同意。我們需要大一點的公寓。

items.en: You've trained so hard. I really believe you can win this race.
items.zh: 你練得那麼辛苦。我真的相信你能贏這場比賽。

items.en: I fully understand your worries, but the trip is safe.
items.zh: 我完全了解你的擔心，可是這趟旅行很安全。

title: I'm asking permission to be excused from work for at least three days.
translation: 我想請求准假，至少請三天。
name: 現在進行式表示委婉的語氣
sentences: My father is in hospital. I'm asking permission to be excused from work for at least three days.
Considering the importance of the project, I am asking for your financial support.
I'm asking you as a friend. Please don't tell anyone.
The school closes early tomorrow. We're asking all parents to collect their children by four.
I know you're busy. I'm only asking for ten minutes of your time.
The data arrived late, so I'm asking for an extra week on the deadline.
These forms are so confusing. I'm hoping you can help me with my visa application.
We're hoping to hear from you by the end of the month.
I'm hoping to leave a bit early today, if that's OK.
We're hoping that you can join us for dinner on Friday.
I was going to call you. I'm hoping we can meet next week.
The school is hoping to raise enough money for a new library.
You're so good at English. I'm wondering if you could check my essay before Monday.
Sorry to bother you. I'm wondering if there's a table for two.
Our train gets in at nine. We're wondering whether the meeting could start a little later.
My car is at the garage. I'm wondering if I could borrow yours this weekend.
If we're wanting to make progress in medicine, we have to be willing to spend money.
I'm wanting to talk to you about my hours. Do you have a minute?
Good evening. We're wanting to book a room for three nights, please.
Are you wanting a drink while you wait?
Here's the form. Is your daughter wanting to join the swimming club?
We're looking for volunteers to help at the school fair.
I'm retiring next year. I'm looking for some advice about my pension.
I'm needing a bit more time to decide, if that's all right.
Our shop is getting busier. We're looking for someone to help on Saturdays.
Are you looking for anything in particular today?
You know this project best. We're inviting you to share your ideas at the next meeting.
Good morning. I'm calling about the flat you advertised.
Congratulations! We're offering you the job, starting on the first of June.
Dear Sir or Madam, I'm writing to ask about the summer course.

examples.heading: ① I'm asking

items.en: My father is in hospital. I'm asking permission to be excused from work for at least three days.
items.zh: 我父親住院了。我想請求准假，至少請三天。

items.en: Considering the importance of the project, I am asking for your financial support.
items.zh: 考慮到這個計畫的重要性，我想請求您在經費上的支持。

items.en: I'm asking you as a friend. Please don't tell anyone.
items.zh: 我是以朋友的身分拜託你。請不要告訴任何人。

items.en: The school closes early tomorrow. We're asking all parents to collect their children by four.
items.zh: 學校明天提早放學。我們想請所有家長在四點前接孩子。

items.en: I know you're busy. I'm only asking for ten minutes of your time.
items.zh: 我知道你很忙。我只想耽誤你十分鐘。

items.en: The data arrived late, so I'm asking for an extra week on the deadline.
items.zh: 資料太晚到了，所以我想請您把截止日延後一個星期。

examples.heading: ② I'm hoping

items.en: These forms are so confusing. I'm hoping you can help me with my visa application.
items.zh: 這些表格好難懂。我希望你能幫我處理簽證申請。

items.en: We're hoping to hear from you by the end of the month.
items.zh: 我們希望能在月底前收到您的回音。

items.en: I'm hoping to leave a bit early today, if that's OK.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我今天想早點走。

items.en: We're hoping that you can join us for dinner on Friday.
items.zh: 我們希望你星期五能來跟我們吃晚餐。

items.en: I was going to call you. I'm hoping we can meet next week.
items.zh: 我正想打給你。我希望我們下星期能見個面。

items.en: The school is hoping to raise enough money for a new library.
items.zh: 學校希望能募到足夠的錢蓋新圖書館。

examples.heading: ③ I'm wondering

items.en: You're so good at English. I'm wondering if you could check my essay before Monday.
items.zh: 你英文好好。不知道你能不能在星期一前幫我看一下作文。

items.en: Sorry to bother you. I'm wondering if there's a table for two.
items.zh: 不好意思打擾了。請問還有兩個人的位子嗎？

items.en: Our train gets in at nine. We're wondering whether the meeting could start a little later.
items.zh: 我們的火車九點才到。我們在想，會議能不能晚一點開始。

items.en: My car is at the garage. I'm wondering if I could borrow yours this weekend.
items.zh: 我的車在修車廠。不知道這個週末能不能跟你借車。

examples.heading: ④ I'm wanting

items.en: If we're wanting to make progress in medicine, we have to be willing to spend money.
items.zh: 如果我們想在醫學上進步，就得願意花錢。

items.en: I'm wanting to talk to you about my hours. Do you have a minute?
items.zh: 我想跟你談談我的工時。你有空嗎？

items.en: Good evening. We're wanting to book a room for three nights, please.
items.zh: 晚安。我們想訂一間房，住三個晚上。

items.en: Are you wanting a drink while you wait?
items.zh: 您在等的時候要喝點什麼嗎？

items.en: Here's the form. Is your daughter wanting to join the swimming club?
items.zh: 這是報名表。您女兒想加入游泳社嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ I'm looking for / I'm needing

items.en: We're looking for volunteers to help at the school fair.
items.zh: 我們在找志工幫忙學校的園遊會。

items.en: I'm retiring next year. I'm looking for some advice about my pension.
items.zh: 我明年要退休了。我想請教一些退休金的問題。

items.en: I'm needing a bit more time to decide, if that's all right.
items.zh: 如果可以的話，我需要多一點時間考慮。

items.en: Our shop is getting busier. We're looking for someone to help on Saturdays.
items.zh: 我們店越來越忙。我們想找人星期六來幫忙。

examples.heading: ⑥ 服務和工作場合

items.en: Are you looking for anything in particular today?
items.zh: 您今天有特別想找什麼嗎？

items.en: You know this project best. We're inviting you to share your ideas at the next meeting.
items.zh: 你最了解這個計畫。我們想邀請你在下次會議分享你的想法。

items.en: Good morning. I'm calling about the flat you advertised.
items.zh: 早安。我打電話來是想問你們廣告上的那間公寓。

items.en: Congratulations! We're offering you the job, starting on the first of June.
items.zh: 恭喜！我們想給你這份工作，六月一號開始。

items.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I'm writing to ask about the summer course.
items.zh: 敬啟者：我寫信來是想詢問暑期課程的事。

title: The movie shows how a woman can make people feel better.
translation: 這部電影講的是一個女人怎麼讓別人心情變好。
name: 現在簡單式加轉述動詞（常用動詞）
sentences: I loved this film. The movie shows how a woman can make people feel better.
Read this article. It says that walking every day is good for your heart.
You'll like this one. The book shows what life was like a hundred years ago.
The sign says "No swimming", so let's stay on the beach.
Take a map at the gate. The map shows where all the toilets are.
Look at this old picture. It shows my grandparents on their wedding day.
Bring the plants inside. The weather report says it will snow tonight.
I know a man who moved here two years ago. He says that it improved his social life.
I'm going to bed early this week. My doctor says I need more sleep.
Come downstairs, everyone. Mum says dinner is ready.
Let's try it this weekend. Everyone says the new café is great.
I practise every day now. My teacher says my English is getting better.
Look how big it is. They say it's the oldest tree in the country.
I'll miss her so much. My sister tells me she's moving to Canada.
I'm worried about him. He always tells his friends that he's fine.
Your letter tells me you're enjoying your new school.
Download this app. It tells you when the bus is coming.
In her email, Kate writes that she misses us all.
Join the tour at two. The guide explains how people built the old castle.
My friend writes that the weather in Spain is lovely.
Don't call a mechanic. This video explains how to change a tyre.
Nobody gets confused. The teacher explains the rules before every game.
Look at the line going up. The chart shows that more people cycle to work now.
Start English early. This study shows that children learn languages quickly.
We tested the river water again. The results show that our town is getting cleaner.
We asked 500 students. The survey shows what they think about school lunches.
You look worried. What does the letter say?
We're a bit lost. Does the map show the way to the beach?
The book doesn't say who the killer is until the last page.
The report came out today. What does it say about the new road?

examples.heading: ① 書、電影、文章 + says / shows

items.en: I loved this film. The movie shows how a woman can make people feel better.
items.zh: 我好愛這部電影。這部電影講的是一個女人怎麼讓別人心情變好。

items.en: Read this article. It says that walking every day is good for your heart.
items.zh: 看看這篇文章。上面說每天走路對心臟好。

items.en: You'll like this one. The book shows what life was like a hundred years ago.
items.zh: 你會喜歡這本的。這本書呈現了一百年前的生活是什麼樣子。

items.en: The sign says "No swimming", so let's stay on the beach.
items.zh: 告示上寫著禁止游泳，所以我們待在沙灘上吧。

items.en: Take a map at the gate. The map shows where all the toilets are.
items.zh: 在門口拿一張地圖。地圖上標出了所有廁所的位置。

items.en: Look at this old picture. It shows my grandparents on their wedding day.
items.zh: 你看這張老照片。這是我爺爺奶奶結婚那天拍的。

items.en: Bring the plants inside. The weather report says it will snow tonight.
items.zh: 把植物搬進來。氣象報告說今晚會下雪。

examples.heading: ② 人 + says

items.en: I know a man who moved here two years ago. He says that it improved his social life.
items.zh: 我認識一個兩年前搬來這裡的人。他說這讓他的社交生活變好了。

items.en: I'm going to bed early this week. My doctor says I need more sleep.
items.zh: 我這個星期要早點睡。我的醫生說我需要多睡一點。

items.en: Come downstairs, everyone. Mum says dinner is ready.
items.zh: 大家下樓吧。媽媽說晚餐好了。

items.en: Let's try it this weekend. Everyone says the new café is great.
items.zh: 我們這個週末去試試吧。大家都說新開的咖啡店很棒。

items.en: I practise every day now. My teacher says my English is getting better.
items.zh: 我現在每天都練習。我老師說我的英文越來越好了。

items.en: Look how big it is. They say it's the oldest tree in the country.
items.zh: 你看它好大。大家都說這是全國最老的樹。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + tells + 聽的人

items.en: I'll miss her so much. My sister tells me she's moving to Canada.
items.zh: 我會好想她。我姊姊跟我說她要搬去加拿大。

items.en: I'm worried about him. He always tells his friends that he's fine.
items.zh: 我很擔心他。他總是跟朋友說他很好。

items.en: Your letter tells me you're enjoying your new school.
items.zh: 從你的信看得出來你很喜歡新學校。

items.en: Download this app. It tells you when the bus is coming.
items.zh: 下載這個 app。它會告訴你公車什麼時候來。

examples.heading: ④ writes / explains

items.en: In her email, Kate writes that she misses us all.
items.zh: Kate 在 email 裡寫說她很想念我們大家。

items.en: Join the tour at two. The guide explains how people built the old castle.
items.zh: 兩點參加導覽。導遊會解釋當時的人怎麼蓋這座古堡。

items.en: My friend writes that the weather in Spain is lovely.
items.zh: 我朋友寫信說西班牙的天氣很好。

items.en: Don't call a mechanic. This video explains how to change a tyre.
items.zh: 不用叫技師。這支影片說明怎麼換輪胎。

items.en: Nobody gets confused. The teacher explains the rules before every game.
items.zh: 沒有人會搞不清楚。每次比賽前老師都會說明規則。

examples.heading: ⑤ 圖表和研究 + shows

items.en: Look at the line going up. The chart shows that more people cycle to work now.
items.zh: 你看那條往上的線。圖表顯示現在有更多人騎腳踏車上班。

items.en: Start English early. This study shows that children learn languages quickly.
items.zh: 早點開始學英文吧。這項研究顯示小孩學語言很快。

items.en: We tested the river water again. The results show that our town is getting cleaner.
items.zh: 我們又檢驗了一次河水。結果顯示我們的鎮越來越乾淨。

items.en: We asked 500 students. The survey shows what they think about school lunches.
items.zh: 我們問了五百個學生。這份調查呈現了他們對學校午餐的看法。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: You look worried. What does the letter say?
items.zh: 你看起來很擔心。信上寫了什麼？

items.en: We're a bit lost. Does the map show the way to the beach?
items.zh: 我們有點迷路了。地圖上有標出去海邊的路嗎？

items.en: The book doesn't say who the killer is until the last page.
items.zh: 這本書到最後一頁才說出兇手是誰。

items.en: The report came out today. What does it say about the new road?
items.zh: 報告今天出來了。裡面對新的道路有什麼說法？

title: The popularity of this TV game in Russia clearly demonstrates the nature of human fears and dreams.
translation: 這個電視遊戲節目在俄羅斯這麼受歡迎，清楚顯示了人類恐懼和夢想的本質。
name: 現在簡單式加轉述動詞（多種動詞）
sentences: In my conclusion, I write that the popularity of this TV game in Russia clearly demonstrates the nature of human fears and dreams.
We tested the drug on two hundred patients. The trial demonstrates that it is safe.
Sales doubled after the advert. This clearly demonstrates the power of television.
Look at the second table. It shows that girls read more than boys.
The history of the city demonstrates how quickly a small port can grow.
Here is my answer to Task 1. The two charts illustrate the number of employees in three factories in 2003.
Describe the figure in your answer. The pie chart illustrates how families spend their money.
Her story illustrates the problems that young farmers face today.
Turn to page 12 of your science book. The diagram illustrates the stages in the life of a frog.
Two teams both thought the room was theirs. This example illustrates why we need clear rules.
Prices went up again in May. The figures indicate that the market is still strong.
Researchers followed five hundred families for a year. The study suggests that children who play outside sleep better.
Early results indicate a fall in crime in the city centre.
Our survey of local shops suggests that most customers prefer to pay by card.
More rivers are polluted than ten years ago. These findings suggest that the problem is getting worse.
We asked a thousand office workers. The survey reveals that many of them feel lonely at work.
The museum has just put her letters online. The letters reveal a different side of the famous writer.
Hospitals are short of staff. The report highlights the need for more nurses.
In the final chapter, the author highlights the role of women in the war.
Twenty cars crashed on the motorway this morning. The accident highlights the dangers of driving in fog.
In her essay on education, the writer argues that schools should start later.
The ice is melting every summer. Some scientists argue that the climate is changing faster than we think.
Don't believe the advert. The company claims that its new phone is the fastest in the world.
Many people claim that money doesn't bring happiness, but the data say otherwise.
In this paper, I argue that social media changes how we make friends.
Earlier studies found the same link. The new study confirms these findings.
Good news for the campers. Tests confirm that the water in the lake is safe to drink.
A tourist took pictures of the robbery. The photos confirm what the witnesses told the police.
The rise in sales is small. The data don't demonstrate that the new design works.
Only ten people took part. The results don't indicate a clear trend.

examples.heading: ① demonstrate / show

items.en: In my conclusion, I write that the popularity of this TV game in Russia clearly demonstrates the nature of human fears and dreams.
items.zh: 我在結論裡寫，這個電視遊戲節目在俄羅斯這麼受歡迎，清楚顯示了人類恐懼和夢想的本質。

items.en: We tested the drug on two hundred patients. The trial demonstrates that it is safe.
items.zh: 我們在兩百位病人身上試了這種藥。試驗證明它是安全的。

items.en: Sales doubled after the advert. This clearly demonstrates the power of television.
items.zh: 廣告播出後銷量增加了一倍。這清楚證明了電視的影響力。

items.en: Look at the second table. It shows that girls read more than boys.
items.zh: 看第二個表格。它顯示女生比男生讀更多書。

items.en: The history of the city demonstrates how quickly a small port can grow.
items.zh: 這座城市的歷史證明一個小港口可以多快發展起來。

examples.heading: ② illustrate

items.en: Here is my answer to Task 1. The two charts illustrate the number of employees in three factories in 2003.
items.zh: 這是我寫作第一題的答案。這兩張圖表呈現二〇〇三年三家工廠的員工人數。

items.en: Describe the figure in your answer. The pie chart illustrates how families spend their money.
items.zh: 在答案裡描述這張圖。這張圓餅圖呈現家庭怎麼花錢。

items.en: Her story illustrates the problems that young farmers face today.
items.zh: 她的故事說明了年輕農夫現在面對的問題。

items.en: Turn to page 12 of your science book. The diagram illustrates the stages in the life of a frog.
items.zh: 翻到自然課本第十二頁。這張圖解呈現青蛙一生的各個階段。

items.en: Two teams both thought the room was theirs. This example illustrates why we need clear rules.
items.zh: 兩組人都以為那間會議室是他們的。這個例子說明了我們為什麼需要清楚的規定。

examples.heading: ③ indicate / suggest

items.en: Prices went up again in May. The figures indicate that the market is still strong.
items.zh: 五月物價又漲了。這些數字顯示市場仍然強勁。

items.en: Researchers followed five hundred families for a year. The study suggests that children who play outside sleep better.
items.zh: 研究人員追蹤了五百個家庭一年。這項研究顯示在戶外玩的孩子睡得比較好。

items.en: Early results indicate a fall in crime in the city centre.
items.zh: 初步結果顯示市中心的犯罪減少了。

items.en: Our survey of local shops suggests that most customers prefer to pay by card.
items.zh: 我們對本地商店的調查顯示大部分顧客比較喜歡刷卡。

items.en: More rivers are polluted than ten years ago. These findings suggest that the problem is getting worse.
items.zh: 受污染的河比十年前更多。這些發現顯示問題越來越嚴重。

examples.heading: ④ reveal / highlight

items.en: We asked a thousand office workers. The survey reveals that many of them feel lonely at work.
items.zh: 我們問了一千位上班族。調查揭露他們很多人上班時覺得孤單。

items.en: The museum has just put her letters online. The letters reveal a different side of the famous writer.
items.zh: 博物館剛把她的信放上網。這些信件揭露了這位名作家的另一面。

items.en: Hospitals are short of staff. The report highlights the need for more nurses.
items.zh: 醫院人手不足。這份報告特別指出需要更多護理師。

items.en: In the final chapter, the author highlights the role of women in the war.
items.zh: 在最後一章，作者特別指出女性在戰爭中扮演的角色。

items.en: Twenty cars crashed on the motorway this morning. The accident highlights the dangers of driving in fog.
items.zh: 今天早上高速公路上有二十輛車相撞。這起事故凸顯了在霧中開車的危險。

examples.heading: ⑤ argue / claim

items.en: In her essay on education, the writer argues that schools should start later.
items.zh: 在她討論教育的文章裡，作者主張學校應該晚一點上課。

items.en: The ice is melting every summer. Some scientists argue that the climate is changing faster than we think.
items.zh: 冰每年夏天都在融化。有些科學家主張氣候變化得比我們想的還快。

items.en: Don't believe the advert. The company claims that its new phone is the fastest in the world.
items.zh: 別相信廣告。這家公司宣稱它的新手機是世界上最快的。

items.en: Many people claim that money doesn't bring happiness, but the data say otherwise.
items.zh: 很多人宣稱錢不能帶來快樂，可是資料顯示的不是這樣。

items.en: In this paper, I argue that social media changes how we make friends.
items.zh: 在這篇論文裡，我主張社群媒體改變了我們交朋友的方式。

examples.heading: ⑥ confirm

items.en: Earlier studies found the same link. The new study confirms these findings.
items.zh: 之前的研究發現了同樣的關聯。新的研究證實了這些發現。

items.en: Good news for the campers. Tests confirm that the water in the lake is safe to drink.
items.zh: 露營的人有好消息了。檢驗證實湖裡的水可以安全飲用。

items.en: A tourist took pictures of the robbery. The photos confirm what the witnesses told the police.
items.zh: 一位觀光客拍下了搶劫的過程。這些照片證實了目擊者告訴警方的話。

examples.heading: ⑦ 否定句

items.en: The rise in sales is small. The data don't demonstrate that the new design works.
items.zh: 銷量只增加了一點點。資料不能證明新設計有效。

items.en: Only ten people took part. The results don't indicate a clear trend.
items.zh: 只有十個人參加。結果並沒有顯示出明確的趨勢。

title: Why is technology taking over our lives?
translation: 為什麼科技要占據我們的生活？
name: 現在進行式的修辭問句
sentences: We check our phones at every meal. Why is technology taking over our lives?
The bins are full of good food. Why are we wasting so much?
Traffic is getting worse. So why are we still building more roads?
Why am I explaining all this? Because I want to show that young people care about sport.
Why are so many young people leaving our town? The answer is simple: there are no jobs.
Why are we still arguing about this? The facts are clear.
Kids spend hours on games. Why are parents letting this happen?
Why is everyone talking about money and nobody talking about happiness?
Fish are dying and beaches are dirty. What is happening to our oceans?
What are we teaching our children when we shout at each other?
What are we doing to the planet? We need to think about it.
What is the government doing about the price of housing? Almost nothing.
Prices go up every year. Where is all this money going?
Families hardly eat together any more. Where are we heading as a society?
How are young people coping with all this pressure? Many of them are not.
How are we helping the environment by buying more and more?
Everyone cares about looks these days. Are we becoming shallow?
Are we losing the art of conversation? I think we are.
Is social media making us lonely? Many studies say yes.
Are we really listening to each other, or just waiting to speak?
Nobody remembers phone numbers now. Is the internet changing the way we think?
Are we spending too much time indoors? Our grandparents played outside all day.
Is fast fashion destroying our planet? Let's look at the facts.
Look at this mess. Aren't we forgetting something important here?
Isn't the world becoming a smaller place, thanks to the internet?
Teachers now deal with every problem at school. Aren't we asking too much of them?
House prices keep rising. Isn't it getting harder for families to buy a home?
Who am I kidding? I'm never going to finish this book.
Who are we fooling? This plan is never going to work.
What am I doing with my life? I need a change.
Why are we even talking about this? Let's get back to work.

examples.heading: ① Why + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing?

items.en: We check our phones at every meal. Why is technology taking over our lives?
items.zh: 我們每一餐都在看手機。為什麼科技要占據我們的生活？

items.en: The bins are full of good food. Why are we wasting so much?
items.zh: 垃圾桶裡都是還能吃的食物。我們為什麼浪費這麼多？

items.en: Traffic is getting worse. So why are we still building more roads?
items.zh: 交通越來越糟。那我們為什麼還在蓋更多的路？

items.en: Why am I explaining all this? Because I want to show that young people care about sport.
items.zh: 我為什麼要解釋這些？因為我想證明年輕人關心運動。

items.en: Why are so many young people leaving our town? The answer is simple: there are no jobs.
items.zh: 為什麼這麼多年輕人離開我們的小鎮？答案很簡單：沒有工作。

items.en: Why are we still arguing about this? The facts are clear.
items.zh: 我們為什麼還在爭論這件事？事實很清楚。

items.en: Kids spend hours on games. Why are parents letting this happen?
items.zh: 孩子們花好幾個小時打電動。為什麼家長要讓這種事發生？

items.en: Why is everyone talking about money and nobody talking about happiness?
items.zh: 為什麼大家都在談錢，卻沒人談快樂？

examples.heading: ② What + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing?

items.en: Fish are dying and beaches are dirty. What is happening to our oceans?
items.zh: 魚在死，海灘很髒。我們的海洋怎麼了？

items.en: What are we teaching our children when we shout at each other?
items.zh: 我們互相大吼的時候，我們在教孩子什麼？

items.en: What are we doing to the planet? We need to think about it.
items.zh: 我們在對地球做什麼？我們得想一想。

items.en: What is the government doing about the price of housing? Almost nothing.
items.zh: 政府對房價做了什麼？幾乎什麼都沒做。

examples.heading: ③ Where / How + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing?

items.en: Prices go up every year. Where is all this money going?
items.zh: 價格每年都在漲。這些錢都跑去哪了？

items.en: Families hardly eat together any more. Where are we heading as a society?
items.zh: 家人幾乎不再一起吃飯了。我們這個社會要走向哪裡？

items.en: How are young people coping with all this pressure? Many of them are not.
items.zh: 年輕人怎麼應付這些壓力？很多人應付不來。

items.en: How are we helping the environment by buying more and more?
items.zh: 我們買得越來越多，這樣怎麼會是在幫環境？

examples.heading: ④ Am / Is / Are + 主詞 + 動詞-ing?

items.en: Everyone cares about looks these days. Are we becoming shallow?
items.zh: 現在大家都在意外表。我們是不是變得很膚淺？

items.en: Are we losing the art of conversation? I think we are.
items.zh: 我們是不是正在失去聊天的能力？我覺得是。

items.en: Is social media making us lonely? Many studies say yes.
items.zh: 社群媒體是不是讓我們更孤單？很多研究說是。

items.en: Are we really listening to each other, or just waiting to speak?
items.zh: 我們真的有在聽彼此說話，還是只是在等著輪到自己講？

items.en: Nobody remembers phone numbers now. Is the internet changing the way we think?
items.zh: 現在沒人記得電話號碼了。網路是不是在改變我們思考的方式？

items.en: Are we spending too much time indoors? Our grandparents played outside all day.
items.zh: 我們是不是待在室內太久了？我們的祖父母小時候整天在外面玩。

items.en: Is fast fashion destroying our planet? Let's look at the facts.
items.zh: 快時尚是不是在破壞我們的地球？我們來看看事實。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定的修辭問句

items.en: Look at this mess. Aren't we forgetting something important here?
items.zh: 看看這一團亂。我們是不是忘了一件很重要的事？

items.en: Isn't the world becoming a smaller place, thanks to the internet?
items.zh: 多虧網路，世界不是變得越來越小了嗎？

items.en: Teachers now deal with every problem at school. Aren't we asking too much of them?
items.zh: 現在學校的每個問題都要老師處理。我們是不是對他們要求太多了？

items.en: House prices keep rising. Isn't it getting harder for families to buy a home?
items.zh: 房價一直漲。家庭要買房子不是越來越難了嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 演講和對話裡的修辭問句

items.en: Who am I kidding? I'm never going to finish this book.
items.zh: 我在騙誰啊？這本書我永遠看不完的。

items.en: Who are we fooling? This plan is never going to work.
items.zh: 我們在騙誰？這個計畫根本不會成功。

items.en: What am I doing with my life? I need a change.
items.zh: 我到底在幹嘛？我需要改變。

items.en: Why are we even talking about this? Let's get back to work.
items.zh: 我們幹嘛還在講這個？回去工作吧。

title: I apologize for missing your class.
translation: 很抱歉我沒去上你的課。
name: 現在簡單式加言語行為動詞（常用動詞）
sentences: I was ill yesterday. I apologize for missing your class.
The train is ten minutes late. We apologise for the delay.
I apologise for the mess. We're painting the kitchen.
I was tired and angry. I apologise for my rude words last night.
The road is closed until Friday. We apologise for any trouble this may cause.
If you travel, I suggest that you pay for your own trip.
The roads are busy. I suggest taking the train.
The concert starts at ten. I suggest we meet at the station at nine.
It's late. I suggest that we finish this tomorrow.
Keep a bottle on your desk. Doctors suggest drinking at least two litres of water a day.
What do you suggest? Should we stay or go?
For these reasons, I definitely recommend staying in a city.
Have you been to Kyoto? I recommend the old temples.
I recommend that you book a table. It gets very busy.
Don't skip the evening. My dentist recommends brushing twice a day.
It's our first time here. Which dish do you recommend?
I promise I'll call you as soon as I land.
Your secret is safe with me. I promise not to tell anyone.
Thank you for shopping with us. We promise to send your order within three days.
Sorry I'm late again. I promise this is the last time.
Welcome to the Sea View. We thank you for choosing our hotel.
Before we eat, I thank everyone who helped with the party.
Dear Mrs Brown, I thank you for your kind letter.
It looks like rain. I suggest you take an umbrella.
Their pizza is the best. I recommend this place to all my friends.
You were right about the road. I admit I was wrong.
You said sorry, and I forgive you. Let's forget about it.
You helped me so much. I insist. Please take the money.
I have some news, everyone. I invite you all to my wedding in June.
Don't jump in yet. I warn you, the water is very cold.

examples.heading: ① apologise

items.en: I was ill yesterday. I apologize for missing your class.
items.zh: 我昨天生病了。很抱歉我沒去上你的課。

items.en: The train is ten minutes late. We apologise for the delay.
items.zh: 火車誤點十分鐘。很抱歉造成延誤。

items.en: I apologise for the mess. We're painting the kitchen.
items.zh: 抱歉家裡很亂。我們在油漆廚房。

items.en: I was tired and angry. I apologise for my rude words last night.
items.zh: 我那時候又累又生氣。我為我昨晚無禮的話道歉。

items.en: The road is closed until Friday. We apologise for any trouble this may cause.
items.zh: 這條路封到星期五。如果造成任何不便，我們深感抱歉。

examples.heading: ② suggest

items.en: If you travel, I suggest that you pay for your own trip.
items.zh: 如果你要旅行，我建議你自己出旅費。

items.en: The roads are busy. I suggest taking the train.
items.zh: 路上車很多。我建議搭火車。

items.en: The concert starts at ten. I suggest we meet at the station at nine.
items.zh: 音樂會十點開始。我建議我們九點在車站碰面。

items.en: It's late. I suggest that we finish this tomorrow.
items.zh: 很晚了。我建議我們明天再做完。

items.en: Keep a bottle on your desk. Doctors suggest drinking at least two litres of water a day.
items.zh: 在桌上放一瓶水。醫生建議每天至少喝兩公升的水。

items.en: What do you suggest? Should we stay or go?
items.zh: 你有什麼建議？我們該留下還是走？

examples.heading: ③ recommend

items.en: For these reasons, I definitely recommend staying in a city.
items.zh: 因為這些原因，我非常推薦住在城市裡。

items.en: Have you been to Kyoto? I recommend the old temples.
items.zh: 你去過京都嗎？我推薦那些古老的寺廟。

items.en: I recommend that you book a table. It gets very busy.
items.zh: 我建議你先訂位。那裡人很多。

items.en: Don't skip the evening. My dentist recommends brushing twice a day.
items.zh: 晚上別偷懶。我的牙醫建議一天刷兩次牙。

items.en: It's our first time here. Which dish do you recommend?
items.zh: 我們第一次來。你推薦哪一道菜？

examples.heading: ④ promise

items.en: I promise I'll call you as soon as I land.
items.zh: 我保證飛機一落地就打給你。

items.en: Your secret is safe with me. I promise not to tell anyone.
items.zh: 你的祕密我會守住。我保證不告訴任何人。

items.en: Thank you for shopping with us. We promise to send your order within three days.
items.zh: 感謝你在本店購物。我們保證三天內寄出你的訂單。

items.en: Sorry I'm late again. I promise this is the last time.
items.zh: 抱歉我又遲到了。我保證這是最後一次。

examples.heading: ⑤ thank

items.en: Welcome to the Sea View. We thank you for choosing our hotel.
items.zh: 歡迎光臨海景飯店。我們感謝您選擇我們的飯店。

items.en: Before we eat, I thank everyone who helped with the party.
items.zh: 吃飯之前，我感謝每一個幫忙辦派對的人。

items.en: Dear Mrs Brown, I thank you for your kind letter.
items.zh: 親愛的 Brown 太太，我感謝您親切的來信。

examples.heading: ⑥ 其他言語行為動詞

items.en: It looks like rain. I suggest you take an umbrella.
items.zh: 看起來要下雨了。我建議你帶把傘。

items.en: Their pizza is the best. I recommend this place to all my friends.
items.zh: 他們的披薩最好吃。我跟所有朋友推薦這家店。

items.en: You were right about the road. I admit I was wrong.
items.zh: 你對那條路的判斷是對的。我承認我錯了。

items.en: You said sorry, and I forgive you. Let's forget about it.
items.zh: 你道歉了，我原諒你。這件事就算了吧。

items.en: You helped me so much. I insist. Please take the money.
items.zh: 你幫了我那麼多。我堅持。請收下這筆錢。

items.en: I have some news, everyone. I invite you all to my wedding in June.
items.zh: 大家，我有個消息。我邀請大家來參加我六月的婚禮。

items.en: Don't jump in yet. I warn you, the water is very cold.
items.zh: 先別跳下去。我先警告你，水很冷。

title: We disagree with the new numbering system as it is too complicated.
translation: 我們不贊成新的編號系統，因為它太複雜了。
name: 現在簡單式加言語行為動詞（多種動詞）
sentences: Dear Head Teacher, we disagree with the new numbering system as it is too complicated.
I agree with you. The film is far too long.
Everyone leaves at five. We agree that the meeting should start earlier.
I'm sorry, but I disagree. I think the old plan is better.
School now starts at seven. Most parents disagree with the new hours.
I'd love to go to the concert with you, so I accept your invitation.
We accept your apology. Let's move on.
I'm afraid we can't accept cards. Cash only, please.
I refuse to work on Sundays. That's my family day.
Take it off the bill, please. I refuse to pay for a meal I didn't eat.
It's winter, you know. I advise you to take a coat.
The roads are dangerous at night. I advise you to leave before dark.
Skip the cake today. Doctors advise people to eat less sugar.
I warn you, the road is very icy tonight.
I warn you not to touch that dog. It bites.
I admit that I made a mistake. I'm sorry.
Don't be angry with the kids. I admit I ate the last biscuit.
I deny taking your money. I was at work all day.
The news is full of it. The company denies that the product is dangerous.
No, please. I insist on paying for dinner.
Thank you for your email. We confirm your booking for two nights.
You drove all this way. I insist that you stay for lunch.
Thank you for the invitation. I confirm that I will attend the meeting.
I promise I'll pay you back next week.
I heard the news this morning. I congratulate you on your new job.
It's been a great year. We congratulate all the students on their excellent results.
I forgive you, but please don't do it again.
The website is working again. We thank you for your patience.
The boss wants an answer today. Do you agree with the new plan?
Half the questions were not in the book. I don't accept that the test was fair.

examples.heading: ① agree / disagree

items.en: Dear Head Teacher, we disagree with the new numbering system as it is too complicated.
items.zh: 校長您好，我們不贊成新的編號系統，因為它太複雜了。

items.en: I agree with you. The film is far too long.
items.zh: 我同意你。這部電影實在太長了。

items.en: Everyone leaves at five. We agree that the meeting should start earlier.
items.zh: 大家五點就走了。我們同意會議應該早點開始。

items.en: I'm sorry, but I disagree. I think the old plan is better.
items.zh: 很抱歉，可是我不同意。我覺得舊的計畫比較好。

items.en: School now starts at seven. Most parents disagree with the new hours.
items.zh: 學校現在七點就上課。大部分的家長不贊成新的上課時間。

examples.heading: ② accept / refuse

items.en: I'd love to go to the concert with you, so I accept your invitation.
items.zh: 我很想跟你去音樂會，所以我接受你的邀請。

items.en: We accept your apology. Let's move on.
items.zh: 我們接受你的道歉。這件事就過去吧。

items.en: I'm afraid we can't accept cards. Cash only, please.
items.zh: 不好意思，我們不收卡。只收現金。

items.en: I refuse to work on Sundays. That's my family day.
items.zh: 我拒絕星期天上班。那天是我陪家人的日子。

items.en: Take it off the bill, please. I refuse to pay for a meal I didn't eat.
items.zh: 請把它從帳單上拿掉。我拒絕付我沒吃的那一餐。

examples.heading: ③ advise / warn

items.en: It's winter, you know. I advise you to take a coat.
items.zh: 現在是冬天，你知道的。我勸你帶件外套。

items.en: The roads are dangerous at night. I advise you to leave before dark.
items.zh: 晚上的路很危險。我勸你天黑前出發。

items.en: Skip the cake today. Doctors advise people to eat less sugar.
items.zh: 今天別吃蛋糕了。醫生勸大家少吃糖。

items.en: I warn you, the road is very icy tonight.
items.zh: 我先警告你，今晚路上很滑。

items.en: I warn you not to touch that dog. It bites.
items.zh: 我警告你不要碰那隻狗。牠會咬人。

examples.heading: ④ admit / deny

items.en: I admit that I made a mistake. I'm sorry.
items.zh: 我承認我犯了錯。對不起。

items.en: Don't be angry with the kids. I admit I ate the last biscuit.
items.zh: 別生孩子們的氣。我承認最後一塊餅乾是我吃的。

items.en: I deny taking your money. I was at work all day.
items.zh: 我否認拿了你的錢。我一整天都在上班。

items.en: The news is full of it. The company denies that the product is dangerous.
items.zh: 新聞都在報這件事。那家公司否認產品有危險。

examples.heading: ⑤ insist / confirm / promise

items.en: No, please. I insist on paying for dinner.
items.zh: 不行，拜託。我堅持要付晚餐的錢。

items.en: Thank you for your email. We confirm your booking for two nights.
items.zh: 感謝您的來信。我們確認您訂了兩晚的房間。

items.en: You drove all this way. I insist that you stay for lunch.
items.zh: 你開了這麼遠的車來。我堅持你留下來吃午餐。

items.en: Thank you for the invitation. I confirm that I will attend the meeting.
items.zh: 謝謝您的邀請。我確認我會參加會議。

items.en: I promise I'll pay you back next week.
items.zh: 我保證下星期還你錢。

examples.heading: ⑥ congratulate / forgive / thank

items.en: I heard the news this morning. I congratulate you on your new job.
items.zh: 我今天早上聽到消息了。恭喜你找到新工作。

items.en: It's been a great year. We congratulate all the students on their excellent results.
items.zh: 今年是很棒的一年。我們恭喜所有學生取得優異的成績。

items.en: I forgive you, but please don't do it again.
items.zh: 我原諒你，可是請別再這樣了。

items.en: The website is working again. We thank you for your patience.
items.zh: 網站已經恢復正常。我們感謝您的耐心。

examples.heading: ⑦ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: The boss wants an answer today. Do you agree with the new plan?
items.zh: 老闆今天要一個答案。你同意新的計畫嗎？

items.en: Half the questions were not in the book. I don't accept that the test was fair.
items.zh: 一半的題目課本裡都沒有。我不認為那次考試是公平的。

title: The story takes place in Vienna after the Second World War.
translation: 這個故事發生在第二次世界大戰後的維也納。
name: 現在簡單式敘述故事情節
sentences: My book report is about a novel. The story takes place in Vienna after the Second World War.
The book begins with a girl who finds a letter in her grandmother's house.
Life on the farm is hard. In the second chapter, the family moves to the city.
Harry meets a strange old man, and his life changes.
At the end, she finds out that her best friend is the thief.
The two boys become friends, but then a war starts.
Here's the plot. The film opens in a fishing village in Sicily.
A young doctor arrives in the village and falls in love with a teacher.
In the next scene, the police find the car in the river.
The scene takes place on a train. On this train, a man is sleeping.
He dreams of a colleague who lost his job last year.
The hero decides to go back home, but his car breaks down.
In 1492, Columbus sails west and reaches the Americas.
In 1969, two men walk on the moon for the first time.
The war ends in 1945, and the city begins to rebuild.
This part of history is sad. The king dies suddenly, and his young son becomes king.
The museum guide says, "Here the soldiers wait for three days."
Silva runs down the left. He passes to Jones, and Jones scores!
It's match point. She serves, and he hits the ball into the net.
What a race! The runner from Kenya takes the lead in the last lap.
Here comes the shot. The goalkeeper jumps, but he can't reach the ball.
Only one minute to go. The home team gets a free kick.
Listen to this. So I walk into the bank, and the man at the desk is my old teacher.
A man goes into a café and asks for a cup of tea.
Then my phone rings, and it's my boss.
So I open the door, and there's a dog in my kitchen!
The play tells the story of two sisters in a small town.
The book ends happily. The family is together again.
The film shows life in Hong Kong in the 1960s.
In this chapter, the writer describes her childhood in the mountains.

examples.heading: ① 小說的情節

items.en: My book report is about a novel. The story takes place in Vienna after the Second World War.
items.zh: 我的讀書報告寫一本小說。這個故事發生在第二次世界大戰後的維也納。

items.en: The book begins with a girl who finds a letter in her grandmother's house.
items.zh: 這本書一開始，一個女孩在她奶奶家發現一封信。

items.en: Life on the farm is hard. In the second chapter, the family moves to the city.
items.zh: 農場的生活很辛苦。第二章裡，這一家人搬到城市。

items.en: Harry meets a strange old man, and his life changes.
items.zh: Harry 遇到一個奇怪的老人，他的人生從此改變。

items.en: At the end, she finds out that her best friend is the thief.
items.zh: 最後她發現她最好的朋友就是小偷。

items.en: The two boys become friends, but then a war starts.
items.zh: 兩個男孩變成朋友，可是後來戰爭爆發了。

examples.heading: ② 電影的劇情

items.en: Here's the plot. The film opens in a fishing village in Sicily.
items.zh: 劇情是這樣的。電影從西西里的一個漁村開始。

items.en: A young doctor arrives in the village and falls in love with a teacher.
items.zh: 一個年輕醫生來到村子，愛上了一位老師。

items.en: In the next scene, the police find the car in the river.
items.zh: 下一幕，警察在河裡找到那輛車。

items.en: The scene takes place on a train. On this train, a man is sleeping.
items.zh: 這一幕發生在火車上。火車上，一個男人在睡覺。

items.en: He dreams of a colleague who lost his job last year.
items.zh: 他夢到一個去年丟了工作的同事。

items.en: The hero decides to go back home, but his car breaks down.
items.zh: 主角決定回家，可是他的車拋錨了。

examples.heading: ③ 歷史事件

items.en: In 1492, Columbus sails west and reaches the Americas.
items.zh: 一四九二年，哥倫布向西航行，抵達美洲。

items.en: In 1969, two men walk on the moon for the first time.
items.zh: 一九六九年，兩個人第一次在月球上漫步。

items.en: The war ends in 1945, and the city begins to rebuild.
items.zh: 戰爭在一九四五年結束，城市開始重建。

items.en: This part of history is sad. The king dies suddenly, and his young son becomes king.
items.zh: 這段歷史很令人難過。國王突然過世，他年幼的兒子成為國王。

items.en: The museum guide says, "Here the soldiers wait for three days."
items.zh: 博物館導覽員說：士兵們在這裡等了三天。

examples.heading: ④ 運動比賽的實況

items.en: Silva runs down the left. He passes to Jones, and Jones scores!
items.zh: Silva 從左路帶球。他傳給 Jones，Jones 射門得分！

items.en: It's match point. She serves, and he hits the ball into the net.
items.zh: 賽末點。她發球，他把球打進網裡。

items.en: What a race! The runner from Kenya takes the lead in the last lap.
items.zh: 好精采的比賽！肯亞的選手在最後一圈領先。

items.en: Here comes the shot. The goalkeeper jumps, but he can't reach the ball.
items.zh: 射門了。守門員跳起來，可是他碰不到球。

items.en: Only one minute to go. The home team gets a free kick.
items.zh: 只剩一分鐘。主隊得到一個自由球。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說笑話和親身經歷

items.en: Listen to this. So I walk into the bank, and the man at the desk is my old teacher.
items.zh: 你聽我說。然後我走進銀行，櫃檯那個人竟然是我以前的老師。

items.en: A man goes into a café and asks for a cup of tea.
items.zh: 有個男人走進一家咖啡店，點了一杯茶。

items.en: Then my phone rings, and it's my boss.
items.zh: 然後我的手機響了，是我老闆打來的。

items.en: So I open the door, and there's a dog in my kitchen!
items.zh: 然後我打開門，我家廚房裡有一隻狗！

examples.heading: ⑥ 介紹作品

items.en: The play tells the story of two sisters in a small town.
items.zh: 這齣戲講的是一個小鎮上兩姊妹的故事。

items.en: The book ends happily. The family is together again.
items.zh: 這本書的結局很圓滿。一家人又團聚了。

items.en: The film shows life in Hong Kong in the 1960s.
items.zh: 這部電影呈現一九六○年代香港的生活。

items.en: In this chapter, the writer describes her childhood in the mountains.
items.zh: 這一章裡，作者描述她在山上的童年。

title: Why don't you wear your black suit?
translation: 你何不穿你那套黑色西裝？
name: why don't you 和 if you like 表示建議
sentences: You look great in it. Why don't you wear your black suit?
You're always tired. Why don't you go to bed earlier?
Why don't you ask your teacher? She can explain it.
If the shoes hurt, why don't you take them back to the shop?
You love animals. Why don't you work at the zoo this summer?
Why don't you call her? She's probably worried about you.
Your room is so dark. Why don't you paint the walls white?
You've worked all day. Why don't you sit down and have a cup of tea?
The film ends at ten. Why don't we go to a disco after that?
It's a lovely day. Why don't we have lunch in the garden?
The bus is very slow. Why don't we take a taxi?
Your office is near the station. Why don't we meet at the café there?
We're all free on Sunday. Why don't we visit Grandma?
They don't know anyone here yet. Why don't we invite the new neighbours for dinner?
I'm bored. Why don't we play a game?
The film finishes at seven. We could have dinner after that, if you want.
You look stuck. I can help you with your homework, if you want.
You can stay with us, if you want. We have a spare room.
The buses are so slow. If you want, I can lend you my bike.
It's going to be sunny. We can go to the beach tomorrow, if you want.
You've never seen the old castle? We can go there, if you like.
Your flight lands at midnight. I can pick you up at the airport, if you like.
Is your battery dead? You can use my phone, if you like.
It's raining too hard to go out. If you like, we can watch a film tonight.
It's your first visit. I can show you around the town, if you like.
"Why don't we go swimming?" "Good idea! Let's go."
"Why don't you try the soup?" "No, thanks. I'm not hungry."
"I can carry that, if you like." "Thanks, that's very kind."
"Why don't we leave early?" "OK, let's go at six."
"We can eat out tonight, if you want." "That sounds great."

examples.heading: ① Why don't you ...?

items.en: You look great in it. Why don't you wear your black suit?
items.zh: 你穿那套很好看。你何不穿你那套黑色西裝？

items.en: You're always tired. Why don't you go to bed earlier?
items.zh: 你總是很累。你何不早點睡？

items.en: Why don't you ask your teacher? She can explain it.
items.zh: 你何不問問你的老師？她可以解釋給你聽。

items.en: If the shoes hurt, why don't you take them back to the shop?
items.zh: 如果鞋子會痛，你何不拿回店裡退？

items.en: You love animals. Why don't you work at the zoo this summer?
items.zh: 你很愛動物。你今年夏天何不去動物園打工？

items.en: Why don't you call her? She's probably worried about you.
items.zh: 你何不打給她？她可能在擔心你。

items.en: Your room is so dark. Why don't you paint the walls white?
items.zh: 你的房間好暗。你何不把牆漆成白色？

items.en: You've worked all day. Why don't you sit down and have a cup of tea?
items.zh: 你工作了一整天。你何不坐下來喝杯茶？

examples.heading: ② Why don't we ...?

items.en: The film ends at ten. Why don't we go to a disco after that?
items.zh: 電影十點結束。之後我們何不去跳舞？

items.en: It's a lovely day. Why don't we have lunch in the garden?
items.zh: 天氣真好。我們何不在花園吃午餐？

items.en: The bus is very slow. Why don't we take a taxi?
items.zh: 公車好慢。我們何不搭計程車？

items.en: Your office is near the station. Why don't we meet at the café there?
items.zh: 你辦公室在車站附近。我們何不在那裡的咖啡店碰面？

items.en: We're all free on Sunday. Why don't we visit Grandma?
items.zh: 我們星期天都有空。我們何不去看奶奶？

items.en: They don't know anyone here yet. Why don't we invite the new neighbours for dinner?
items.zh: 他們在這裡還不認識任何人。我們何不邀請新鄰居來吃晚餐？

items.en: I'm bored. Why don't we play a game?
items.zh: 我好無聊。我們何不來玩個遊戲？

examples.heading: ③ ..., if you want

items.en: The film finishes at seven. We could have dinner after that, if you want.
items.zh: 電影七點結束。你要的話，我們之後可以去吃晚餐。

items.en: You look stuck. I can help you with your homework, if you want.
items.zh: 你看起來卡住了。你要的話，我可以幫你寫功課。

items.en: You can stay with us, if you want. We have a spare room.
items.zh: 你要的話可以住我們家。我們有一間空房。

items.en: The buses are so slow. If you want, I can lend you my bike.
items.zh: 公車好慢。你要的話，我可以把腳踏車借你。

items.en: It's going to be sunny. We can go to the beach tomorrow, if you want.
items.zh: 明天會出太陽。你要的話，我們明天可以去海邊。

examples.heading: ④ ..., if you like

items.en: You've never seen the old castle? We can go there, if you like.
items.zh: 你沒看過那座古堡嗎？你想的話，我們可以去那裡。

items.en: Your flight lands at midnight. I can pick you up at the airport, if you like.
items.zh: 你的班機半夜才到。你想的話，我可以去機場接你。

items.en: Is your battery dead? You can use my phone, if you like.
items.zh: 你的手機沒電了嗎？你想的話，可以用我的手機。

items.en: It's raining too hard to go out. If you like, we can watch a film tonight.
items.zh: 雨太大出不了門。你想的話，我們今晚可以看電影。

items.en: It's your first visit. I can show you around the town, if you like.
items.zh: 這是你第一次來。你想的話，我可以帶你在鎮上逛逛。

examples.heading: ⑤ 回應建議

items.en: "Why don't we go swimming?" "Good idea! Let's go."
items.zh: 我們何不去游泳？好主意！走吧。

items.en: "Why don't you try the soup?" "No, thanks. I'm not hungry."
items.zh: 你何不嚐嚐這個湯？不用了，謝謝。我不餓。

items.en: "I can carry that, if you like." "Thanks, that's very kind."
items.zh: 你想的話我可以幫你拿。謝謝，你人真好。

items.en: "Why don't we leave early?" "OK, let's go at six."
items.zh: 我們何不早點走？好，六點走。

items.en: "We can eat out tonight, if you want." "That sounds great."
items.zh: 你要的話，我們今晚可以去外面吃。聽起來很棒。

title: I'm doing a lot of great leisure activities.
translation: 我最近參加了很多很棒的休閒活動。
name: 現在進行式表示暫時反覆的動作
sentences: Hi Max! Life here is great. I'm doing a lot of great leisure activities.
I'm playing this exciting game called Diner Dash. It's about running a restaurant.
I'm going to yoga twice a week at the moment. I feel so much better.
Builders are redoing our kitchen, so we're eating out a lot these days.
My dad is cycling to work this month to get fit.
I'm a bit worried. The kids are watching too much TV during the holidays.
I'm reading a chapter of my book every night before bed. It helps me sleep.
My sister is practising the piano for three hours a day before her concert.
My car is broken, so I'm taking the train to work these days.
She's working late most evenings because of the big project.
I'm walking the dog for my neighbour while she's in hospital.
Our teacher is giving us a test every Friday this term.
He's driving his daughter to school every day until her ankle heals.
We're meeting every Monday to plan the school fair.
I have to see the doctor because I'm having some problems with my back.
I'm getting a lot of headaches these days. Maybe I need glasses.
My laptop is crashing every time I open a big file.
The baby is waking up three or four times a night at the moment.
I'm so tired. Our neighbours are having a lot of parties this summer.
I'm not sleeping well these days. I keep thinking about work.
I'm trying to drink more water, so I'm carrying a bottle everywhere.
She's cooking at home more often to save money.
Mum is taking dance classes every Thursday. She loves them.
My grandparents live nearby now, so I'm spending more time with them.
He's going to bed earlier because he starts work at six now.
We're speaking only English at dinner to help the kids practise.
I haven't seen you there. Are you still going to the gym every morning?
You look so relaxed. What are you doing in your free time these days?
I saw his boots in the car. Is your son still playing football on Saturdays?
I see your light on at five. Why are you getting up so early these days?

examples.heading: ① 最近常做的活動

items.en: Hi Max! Life here is great. I'm doing a lot of great leisure activities.
items.zh: 嗨 Max！這裡的生活很棒。我最近參加了很多很棒的休閒活動。

items.en: I'm playing this exciting game called Diner Dash. It's about running a restaurant.
items.zh: 我最近在玩一個很刺激的遊戲，叫 Diner Dash。它是在講經營一家餐廳。

items.en: I'm going to yoga twice a week at the moment. I feel so much better.
items.zh: 我最近一個星期去上兩次瑜伽。我覺得舒服多了。

items.en: Builders are redoing our kitchen, so we're eating out a lot these days.
items.zh: 工人在重新裝修我們家廚房，所以我們最近常在外面吃。

items.en: My dad is cycling to work this month to get fit.
items.zh: 我爸這個月騎腳踏車上班，想把身體練好。

items.en: I'm a bit worried. The kids are watching too much TV during the holidays.
items.zh: 我有點擔心。放假的時候孩子們看太多電視了。

items.en: I'm reading a chapter of my book every night before bed. It helps me sleep.
items.zh: 我最近每晚睡前都看一章書。這樣比較好睡。

items.en: My sister is practising the piano for three hours a day before her concert.
items.zh: 我姊姊音樂會前每天練三小時鋼琴。

examples.heading: ② 暫時的通勤和工作安排

items.en: My car is broken, so I'm taking the train to work these days.
items.zh: 我的車壞了，所以我最近搭火車上班。

items.en: She's working late most evenings because of the big project.
items.zh: 因為那個大案子，她最近大部分的晚上都加班。

items.en: I'm walking the dog for my neighbour while she's in hospital.
items.zh: 我鄰居住院的這段時間，我幫她遛狗。

items.en: Our teacher is giving us a test every Friday this term.
items.zh: 我們老師這學期每個星期五都考試。

items.en: He's driving his daughter to school every day until her ankle heals.
items.zh: 他女兒的腳踝好之前，他每天開車送她上學。

items.en: We're meeting every Monday to plan the school fair.
items.zh: 我們每個星期一都開會籌備園遊會。

examples.heading: ③ 最近反覆發生的問題

items.en: I have to see the doctor because I'm having some problems with my back.
items.zh: 我得去看醫生，因為我的背最近有點問題。

items.en: I'm getting a lot of headaches these days. Maybe I need glasses.
items.zh: 我最近常頭痛。我可能需要戴眼鏡了。

items.en: My laptop is crashing every time I open a big file.
items.zh: 我的筆電最近每次打開大檔案就當機。

items.en: The baby is waking up three or four times a night at the moment.
items.zh: 寶寶最近一晚會醒來三四次。

items.en: I'm so tired. Our neighbours are having a lot of parties this summer.
items.zh: 我好累。我們鄰居今年夏天常開派對。

items.en: I'm not sleeping well these days. I keep thinking about work.
items.zh: 我最近睡不好。我一直在想工作的事。

examples.heading: ④ 新的習慣

items.en: I'm trying to drink more water, so I'm carrying a bottle everywhere.
items.zh: 我想多喝水，所以最近走到哪都帶著水壺。

items.en: She's cooking at home more often to save money.
items.zh: 她為了省錢，最近比較常在家煮飯。

items.en: Mum is taking dance classes every Thursday. She loves them.
items.zh: 媽媽最近每個星期四都去上舞蹈課。她很喜歡。

items.en: My grandparents live nearby now, so I'm spending more time with them.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶現在住在附近，所以我最近常花時間陪他們。

items.en: He's going to bed earlier because he starts work at six now.
items.zh: 他現在六點就要上班，所以最近比較早睡。

items.en: We're speaking only English at dinner to help the kids practise.
items.zh: 為了讓孩子練習，我們最近吃晚餐的時候只講英文。

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問句

items.en: I haven't seen you there. Are you still going to the gym every morning?
items.zh: 我都沒在那裡看到你。你最近還是每天早上去健身房嗎？

items.en: You look so relaxed. What are you doing in your free time these days?
items.zh: 你看起來好放鬆。你最近空閒的時候都在做什麼？

items.en: I saw his boots in the car. Is your son still playing football on Saturdays?
items.zh: 我在車上看到他的球鞋。你兒子最近星期六還在踢足球嗎？

items.en: I see your light on at five. Why are you getting up so early these days?
items.zh: 我看到你五點就開燈了。你最近為什麼起那麼早？

title: I'm living with my friend in Wolverhampton.
translation: 我現在跟我朋友一起住在伍爾弗漢普頓。
name: 現在進行式表示暫時的情況（常用動詞）
sentences: Dear Mr Hill, I'm living with my friend in Wolverhampton this year.
The builders are fixing our roof, so we're living with my grandparents for now.
We only see my brother on video calls. He's living in Australia for a year.
We're living in a small flat until our new house is ready.
She's living with her parents while she looks for a job.
I can't meet you this week. My cousins are staying with us.
I hear you're on holiday. Where are you staying in Paris?
Mum's in hospital, so I'm staying at home to look after my little sister.
Greetings from Spain! We're staying at a lovely hotel near the beach.
He's staying in bed today because he has a fever.
My mother is working today, so my older brother can take us to the sports centre.
Dad is working from home this week because the office is closed.
I need money for my trip, so I'm working in a café during the summer holidays.
She's working nights at the moment, so she sleeps in the day.
Tom is working at the front desk until the new receptionist starts.
I'm studying at Wolverhampton College for six months.
My sister can't go out much. She is studying for her driving test this month.
We're studying Shakespeare in English class this term.
He's studying in Japan for a year as an exchange student.
I'm studying hard at the moment because my exams are next week.
I'm using my dad's car this week because mine is at the garage.
We're having lunch in the garden every day while the weather is nice.
The kids are sleeping in the living room while we fix their bedroom.
I'm wearing glasses this week. My eyes are too sore for contact lenses.
My aunt is looking after our dog while we're on holiday.
He's taking the bus to school until his bike is fixed.
I'd love to visit you. Are you still living in that flat near the station?
I'm not working this week. I'm on holiday.
Who's staying in your room while you're away?
She isn't driving at the moment because she broke her arm.

examples.heading: ① be living + 地點

items.en: Dear Mr Hill, I'm living with my friend in Wolverhampton this year.
items.zh: 親愛的 Hill 老師，我今年跟我朋友一起住在伍爾弗漢普頓。

items.en: The builders are fixing our roof, so we're living with my grandparents for now.
items.zh: 工人在修我們家的屋頂，所以我們暫時住在我爺爺奶奶家。

items.en: We only see my brother on video calls. He's living in Australia for a year.
items.zh: 我們只能跟我哥哥視訊。他這一年住在澳洲。

items.en: We're living in a small flat until our new house is ready.
items.zh: 新房子好之前，我們先住在一間小公寓。

items.en: She's living with her parents while she looks for a job.
items.zh: 她在找工作，這段時間先跟爸媽住。

examples.heading: ② be staying + 地點

items.en: I can't meet you this week. My cousins are staying with us.
items.zh: 我這個星期沒辦法跟你見面。我的表兄弟姊妹住在我們家。

items.en: I hear you're on holiday. Where are you staying in Paris?
items.zh: 聽說你在度假。你在巴黎住哪裡？

items.en: Mum's in hospital, so I'm staying at home to look after my little sister.
items.zh: 媽媽住院了，所以我待在家照顧我妹妹。

items.en: Greetings from Spain! We're staying at a lovely hotel near the beach.
items.zh: 從西班牙向你問好！我們住在海邊一家很棒的飯店。

items.en: He's staying in bed today because he has a fever.
items.zh: 他發燒，所以今天躺在床上休息。

examples.heading: ③ be working

items.en: My mother is working today, so my older brother can take us to the sports centre.
items.zh: 我媽今天要上班，所以我哥哥可以帶我們去運動中心。

items.en: Dad is working from home this week because the office is closed.
items.zh: 辦公室關門，所以爸爸這個星期在家上班。

items.en: I need money for my trip, so I'm working in a café during the summer holidays.
items.zh: 我需要旅費，所以暑假在一家咖啡店打工。
