items.en: She's working nights at the moment, so she sleeps in the day.
items.zh: 她現在上夜班，所以白天睡覺。

items.en: Tom is working at the front desk until the new receptionist starts.
items.zh: 新櫃檯人員來之前，Tom 先在櫃檯幫忙。

examples.heading: ④ be studying

items.en: I'm studying at Wolverhampton College for six months.
items.zh: 我在伍爾弗漢普頓學院念六個月。

items.en: My sister can't go out much. She is studying for her driving test this month.
items.zh: 我姊姊沒什麼時間出門。她這個月在準備駕照考試。

items.en: We're studying Shakespeare in English class this term.
items.zh: 我們這學期的英文課在讀莎士比亞。

items.en: He's studying in Japan for a year as an exchange student.
items.zh: 他以交換學生的身分在日本念一年。

items.en: I'm studying hard at the moment because my exams are next week.
items.zh: 我現在很用功，因為下星期就考試了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 其他常用動詞

items.en: I'm using my dad's car this week because mine is at the garage.
items.zh: 我的車在修車廠，所以我這個星期開我爸的車。

items.en: We're having lunch in the garden every day while the weather is nice.
items.zh: 天氣好的這段時間，我們每天在花園吃午餐。

items.en: The kids are sleeping in the living room while we fix their bedroom.
items.zh: 我們在修孩子們的房間，這段時間他們睡客廳。

items.en: I'm wearing glasses this week. My eyes are too sore for contact lenses.
items.zh: 我這個星期戴眼鏡。我的眼睛太痛，戴不了隱形眼鏡。

items.en: My aunt is looking after our dog while we're on holiday.
items.zh: 我們去度假的時候，我阿姨幫我們照顧狗。

items.en: He's taking the bus to school until his bike is fixed.
items.zh: 他的腳踏車修好之前，他搭公車上學。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: I'd love to visit you. Are you still living in that flat near the station?
items.zh: 我很想去看你。你還住在車站附近那間公寓嗎？

items.en: I'm not working this week. I'm on holiday.
items.zh: 我這個星期不用上班。我在休假。

items.en: Who's staying in your room while you're away?
items.zh: 你不在的時候誰住你的房間？

items.en: She isn't driving at the moment because she broke her arm.
items.zh: 她手臂斷了，所以現在不開車。

title: I'm in a hotel in the center of Madrid, and it's raining a little bit.
translation: 我現在在馬德里市中心的一家飯店，外面正下著小雨。
name: 現在進行式表示暫時的情況（多種動詞）
sentences: Hi love, I'm in a hotel in the center of Madrid, and it's raining a little bit.
Bring a warm coat. It's snowing in the mountains.
Let's eat outside. The sun is shining for once.
Hold on to your hat. The wind is blowing really hard.
It's raining again, so the match is off.
Thanks for the card. I'm enjoying the sunshine here. It's much warmer than in England.
I'm loving my new job so far. Everyone is so friendly.
You must be exhausted. How are you feeling after the flight?
She moved north last month, and she's hating the cold weather there.
We're really enjoying our holiday, but I miss my bed.
I miss my mum's cooking. I'm feeling a bit homesick this week.
We're renting a flat until we find a house to buy.
I'm covering for a colleague this week, so I'm doing two jobs.
My grandma is looking after the kids while we're at work.
Two students are sharing this room until the new building opens.
The manager is away, so Mr Lee is running the office for now.
I'm using the spare room as an office while the kids are at university.
The trains are running every hour while they repair the line.
You're looking tired today. Did you sleep badly?
He's wearing a suit today because he has a job interview.
Look at those roses! Your garden is looking lovely this spring.
She's wearing glasses at the moment because her eyes are sore.
My leg is hurting after the long walk.
He's taking medicine for his cough this week.
I'm drinking only tea for a few days because my stomach is upset.
Thanks for asking. My back is getting better slowly.
Hi, it's Mum. Are you enjoying your time in Tokyo?
Your balcony is full of flowers. Who's watering them while you're away?
I'm not feeling very well today. I'm staying at home.
The lift isn't working this week, so we're using the stairs.

examples.heading: ① 暫時的天氣

items.en: Hi love, I'm in a hotel in the center of Madrid, and it's raining a little bit.
items.zh: 親愛的，我現在在馬德里市中心的一家飯店，外面正下著小雨。

items.en: Bring a warm coat. It's snowing in the mountains.
items.zh: 帶件厚外套。山上在下雪。

items.en: Let's eat outside. The sun is shining for once.
items.zh: 我們去外面吃吧。難得出太陽。

items.en: Hold on to your hat. The wind is blowing really hard.
items.zh: 抓好你的帽子。風吹得很大。

items.en: It's raining again, so the match is off.
items.zh: 又在下雨了，所以比賽取消了。

examples.heading: ② 現在的感受

items.en: Thanks for the card. I'm enjoying the sunshine here. It's much warmer than in England.
items.zh: 謝謝你的卡片。我在這裡享受陽光。這裡比英國暖和多了。

items.en: I'm loving my new job so far. Everyone is so friendly.
items.zh: 到目前為止，我很喜歡我的新工作。大家都好親切。

items.en: You must be exhausted. How are you feeling after the flight?
items.zh: 你一定累壞了。坐完飛機你覺得怎麼樣？

items.en: She moved north last month, and she's hating the cold weather there.
items.zh: 她上個月搬到北部，她很討厭那裡的冷天氣。

items.en: We're really enjoying our holiday, but I miss my bed.
items.zh: 我們的假期玩得很開心，可是我想念我的床。

items.en: I miss my mum's cooking. I'm feeling a bit homesick this week.
items.zh: 我好想念我媽煮的菜。我這個星期有點想家。

examples.heading: ③ 暫時的安排

items.en: We're renting a flat until we find a house to buy.
items.zh: 找到要買的房子之前，我們先租公寓。

items.en: I'm covering for a colleague this week, so I'm doing two jobs.
items.zh: 我這個星期在代同事的班，所以一個人做兩份工作。

items.en: My grandma is looking after the kids while we're at work.
items.zh: 我們上班的時候，我奶奶幫忙照顧孩子。

items.en: Two students are sharing this room until the new building opens.
items.zh: 新大樓啟用之前，兩個學生先合住這個房間。

items.en: The manager is away, so Mr Lee is running the office for now.
items.zh: 經理不在，所以李先生暫時負責辦公室。

items.en: I'm using the spare room as an office while the kids are at university.
items.zh: 孩子們去念大學的這段時間，我把客房當成辦公室。

items.en: The trains are running every hour while they repair the line.
items.zh: 修鐵路的這段時間，火車每小時一班。

examples.heading: ④ 暫時的外表和穿著

items.en: You're looking tired today. Did you sleep badly?
items.zh: 你今天看起來很累。你沒睡好嗎？

items.en: He's wearing a suit today because he has a job interview.
items.zh: 他今天要面試，所以穿了西裝。

items.en: Look at those roses! Your garden is looking lovely this spring.
items.zh: 你看那些玫瑰！你的花園今年春天看起來好漂亮。

items.en: She's wearing glasses at the moment because her eyes are sore.
items.zh: 她的眼睛很痛，所以這陣子戴眼鏡。

examples.heading: ⑤ 暫時的身體狀況

items.en: My leg is hurting after the long walk.
items.zh: 走了那麼久，我的腿在痛。

items.en: He's taking medicine for his cough this week.
items.zh: 他這個星期在吃治咳嗽的藥。

items.en: I'm drinking only tea for a few days because my stomach is upset.
items.zh: 我腸胃不舒服，所以這幾天只喝茶。

items.en: Thanks for asking. My back is getting better slowly.
items.zh: 謝謝你的關心。我的背慢慢在好轉。

examples.heading: ⑥ 疑問句和否定句

items.en: Hi, it's Mum. Are you enjoying your time in Tokyo?
items.zh: 嗨，我是媽媽。你在東京玩得開心嗎？

items.en: Your balcony is full of flowers. Who's watering them while you're away?
items.zh: 你的陽台都是花。你不在的時候誰幫你澆水？

items.en: I'm not feeling very well today. I'm staying at home.
items.zh: 我今天不太舒服。我待在家。

items.en: The lift isn't working this week, so we're using the stairs.
items.zh: 電梯這個星期壞了，所以我們走樓梯。

title: A lot depends on your background.
translation: 很多事要看你的背景。
name: a lot 和 much 當主詞代名詞
sentences: A lot has happened since you left.
A lot has changed at the school since my time.
A lot has gone wrong this week.
A lot has been done to make the city safer.
A lot has improved in the hospital.
A lot depends on the price.
A lot can happen in a year.
A lot was said at the meeting, but nothing was decided.
A lot is going on at work right now.
A lot will change when the baby arrives.
Much has changed since the war ended.
Much has been said about the need for cleaner energy.
Much has been written about the causes of the crisis.
Much has been done to protect the forest.
Much has improved in public transport.
Much has been learned from the first experiment.
Much depends on the result of the election.
Much remains to be done.
Much was lost in the fire.
Much was promised, but little was delivered.
Much is expected of the new team.
A lot depends on how hard you work.
Much depends on the teacher.
A lot depends on what the doctor says.
Much depends on the support of the local people.
A lot depends on whether it rains.
Much has been achieved, but there is still work to do.
A lot has been said about young people and social media.
Much can be learned from other countries.
A lot needs to be done before the new law starts.
Much has been made of the new stadium, but few people use it.

examples.heading: ① A lot + 現在完成式

items.en: A lot has happened since you left.
items.zh: 你走了以後發生了很多事。

items.en: A lot has changed at the school since my time.
items.zh: 從我那時候到現在，學校變了很多。

items.en: A lot has gone wrong this week.
items.zh: 這個星期出了很多差錯。

items.en: A lot has been done to make the city safer.
items.zh: 為了讓城市更安全，已經做了很多事。

items.en: A lot has improved in the hospital.
items.zh: 醫院裡很多地方都改善了。

examples.heading: ② A lot + 其他動詞

items.en: A lot depends on the price.
items.zh: 很多事要看價錢。

items.en: A lot can happen in a year.
items.zh: 一年裡可以發生很多事。

items.en: A lot was said at the meeting, but nothing was decided.
items.zh: 會議上說了很多，可是什麼都沒決定。

items.en: A lot is going on at work right now.
items.zh: 公司現在有很多事在忙。

items.en: A lot will change when the baby arrives.
items.zh: 寶寶出生以後，很多事都會改變。

examples.heading: ③ Much + 現在完成式

items.en: Much has changed since the war ended.
items.zh: 戰爭結束以後，改變了很多。

items.en: Much has been said about the need for cleaner energy.
items.zh: 關於需要更乾淨能源的說法很多。

items.en: Much has been written about the causes of the crisis.
items.zh: 討論這場危機成因的文章很多。

items.en: Much has been done to protect the forest.
items.zh: 為了保護森林，已經做了很多事。

items.en: Much has improved in public transport.
items.zh: 大眾運輸改善了很多。

items.en: Much has been learned from the first experiment.
items.zh: 從第一次實驗學到了很多。

examples.heading: ④ Much + 其他動詞

items.en: Much depends on the result of the election.
items.zh: 很多事要看選舉的結果。

items.en: Much remains to be done.
items.zh: 還有很多事要做。

items.en: Much was lost in the fire.
items.zh: 那場火燒掉了很多東西。

items.en: Much was promised, but little was delivered.
items.zh: 承諾了很多，做到的卻很少。

items.en: Much is expected of the new team.
items.zh: 大家對新團隊的期待很高。

examples.heading: ⑤ depend on

items.en: A lot depends on how hard you work.
items.zh: 很多事要看你多努力。

items.en: Much depends on the teacher.
items.zh: 很多事要看老師。

items.en: A lot depends on what the doctor says.
items.zh: 很多事要看醫生怎麼說。

items.en: Much depends on the support of the local people.
items.zh: 很多事要看當地人支不支持。

items.en: A lot depends on whether it rains.
items.zh: 很多事要看會不會下雨。

examples.heading: ⑥ 作文和報告

items.en: Much has been achieved, but there is still work to do.
items.zh: 已經完成了很多，可是還有事要做。

items.en: A lot has been said about young people and social media.
items.zh: 關於年輕人和社群媒體的說法很多。

items.en: Much can be learned from other countries.
items.zh: 從其他國家可以學到很多。

items.en: A lot needs to be done before the new law starts.
items.zh: 新法上路之前，還有很多事要做。

items.en: Much has been made of the new stadium, but few people use it.
items.zh: 新體育館被大肆宣傳，可是很少人去用。

title: Can you bring orange juice, please? I don't have any.
translation: 你可以帶柳橙汁來嗎？我這裡沒有。
name: 代名詞 any 當否定句的受詞
sentences: Can you bring some board games? We don't have any.
Bring some snacks for the trip. I don't have any.
My friends all have cats, but I don't have any.
She asked for a tissue, but I didn't have any.
We need more chairs, but we don't have any.
I love his books, but I don't own any.
He collects stamps, but I don't collect any.
There were lots of apples on the tree, but we didn't pick any.
Everyone took photos at the wedding, but I didn't take any.
I looked for cheap flights, but I couldn't find any.
I'd like some coffee, but there isn't any left.
We need sugar for the cake. We don't have any.
He asked for advice, but I couldn't give him any.
I wanted to buy cheese, but the shop didn't have any.
"Is there any milk?" "No, there isn't any."
There were lots of cakes, but I didn't eat any.
Mum made biscuits, but my brother didn't want any.
I bought some flowers, but she didn't like any.
The teacher gave us homework, but I haven't done any.
We saw lots of fish in the river, but we didn't catch any.
We need eggs. Have you got any?
I forgot to bring presents. Did you bring any?
I'm making soup. Would you like any?
There are biscuits in the tin. Did you have any?
These grapes are sweet. Do you want any?
Please bring some music to the party. I don't have any.
Can you buy some bread on your way home? There isn't any.
I wanted to send you some photos, but I didn't take any.
Don't bring food. We don't need any.
We have lots of plates, so you don't need to bring any.
I asked about tickets, but they didn't have any left.

examples.heading: ① don't have any

items.en: Can you bring some board games? We don't have any.
items.zh: 你可以帶幾個桌遊來嗎？我們家沒有。

items.en: Bring some snacks for the trip. I don't have any.
items.zh: 旅行帶一點零食，我這裡沒有。

items.en: My friends all have cats, but I don't have any.
items.zh: 我的朋友都有養貓，可是我沒有。

items.en: She asked for a tissue, but I didn't have any.
items.zh: 她跟我要面紙，可是我沒有。

items.en: We need more chairs, but we don't have any.
items.zh: 我們需要更多椅子，可是一張也沒有。

examples.heading: ② 複數名詞

items.en: I love his books, but I don't own any.
items.zh: 我很喜歡他的書，可是一本也沒有。

items.en: He collects stamps, but I don't collect any.
items.zh: 他收集郵票，可是我沒有收集。

items.en: There were lots of apples on the tree, but we didn't pick any.
items.zh: 樹上有很多蘋果，可是我們一顆也沒摘。

items.en: Everyone took photos at the wedding, but I didn't take any.
items.zh: 婚禮上大家都在拍照，可是我一張也沒拍。

items.en: I looked for cheap flights, but I couldn't find any.
items.zh: 我找便宜的機票，可是一張也找不到。

examples.heading: ③ 不可數名詞

items.en: I'd like some coffee, but there isn't any left.
items.zh: 我想喝咖啡，可是一點也不剩了。

items.en: We need sugar for the cake. We don't have any.
items.zh: 做蛋糕要用糖，我們家沒有糖。

items.en: He asked for advice, but I couldn't give him any.
items.zh: 他要我給他建議，可是我給不出任何建議。

items.en: I wanted to buy cheese, but the shop didn't have any.
items.zh: 我想買起司，可是店裡沒有。

items.en: "Is there any milk?" "No, there isn't any."
items.zh: 有牛奶嗎？沒有，一點也沒有。

examples.heading: ④ 其他動詞

items.en: There were lots of cakes, but I didn't eat any.
items.zh: 有很多蛋糕，可是我一塊也沒吃。

items.en: Mum made biscuits, but my brother didn't want any.
items.zh: 媽媽做了餅乾，可是我弟弟一塊也不想吃。

items.en: I bought some flowers, but she didn't like any.
items.zh: 我買了一些花，可是她一朵也不喜歡。

items.en: The teacher gave us homework, but I haven't done any.
items.zh: 老師出了作業，可是我一題也還沒寫。

items.en: We saw lots of fish in the river, but we didn't catch any.
items.zh: 我們在河裡看到很多魚，可是一條也沒釣到。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句

items.en: We need eggs. Have you got any?
items.zh: 我們需要蛋，你有嗎？

items.en: I forgot to bring presents. Did you bring any?
items.zh: 我忘了帶禮物，你有帶嗎？

items.en: I'm making soup. Would you like any?
items.zh: 我在煮湯，你要喝一點嗎？

items.en: There are biscuits in the tin. Did you have any?
items.zh: 罐子裡有餅乾，你吃了嗎？

items.en: These grapes are sweet. Do you want any?
items.zh: 這些葡萄很甜，你要吃嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 在信和留言裡

items.en: Please bring some music to the party. I don't have any.
items.zh: 請帶一些音樂來派對，我這裡沒有。

items.en: Can you buy some bread on your way home? There isn't any.
items.zh: 你回家路上可以買麵包嗎？家裡沒有了。

items.en: I wanted to send you some photos, but I didn't take any.
items.zh: 我想寄一些照片給你，可是我一張也沒拍。

items.en: Don't bring food. We don't need any.
items.zh: 不用帶吃的，我們不需要。

items.en: We have lots of plates, so you don't need to bring any.
items.zh: 我們家盤子很多，你不用帶。

items.en: I asked about tickets, but they didn't have any left.
items.zh: 我問了票的事，可是他們一張也不剩了。

title: Suddenly, the window opened by itself and the room filled with cold air.
translation: 突然間，窗戶自己打開了，房間裡灌滿了冷空氣。
name: by itself 表示獨自或自動
sentences: My laptop keeps turning off by itself.
Did the alarm go off by itself, or did someone press it?
The radio started playing by itself in the middle of the night.
The car rolled down the hill by itself because I forgot the handbrake.
The app updates by itself, so you don't need to do anything.
The kettle switches off by itself when the water boils.
A book fell off the shelf by itself. How strange!
The garage door opened by itself while we were on holiday.

items.zh: 那兩姊妹都跟對方很親。

items.en: Each of the neighbours has been a great help to the other.
items.zh: 兩個鄰居都幫了對方很大的忙。

items.en: Each of my grandparents is still kind to the other after fifty years.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶結婚五十年了，到現在還是對彼此很好。

items.en: Each of the boys was jealous of the other.
items.zh: 那兩個男孩都嫉妒對方。

items.en: Each of the two dogs is a danger to the other.
items.zh: 那兩隻狗湊在一起，都會傷到對方。

examples.heading: ③ 動詞 + 介系詞 + the other

items.en: Each of the friends listened carefully to the other.
items.zh: 那兩個朋友都仔細聽對方說話。

items.en: Each of the friends wrote to the other every week.
items.zh: 那兩個朋友每週都寫信給對方。

items.en: Each of the colleagues learned a lot from the other.
items.zh: 那兩個同事都從對方身上學到很多。

items.en: Each of the dancers moved towards the other.
items.zh: 兩個舞者都朝對方移動。

items.en: Each of the two farms depends on the other for water.
items.zh: 那兩座農場都要靠對方供水。

items.en: Each of the kids pointed at the other.
items.zh: 那兩個孩子都指著對方。

examples.heading: ④ 動詞 + 介系詞 + the others

items.en: Each of the students had to talk to the others in English.
items.zh: 每個學生都要用英文跟其他人說話。

items.en: Each team competed with the others for the prize.
items.zh: 每一隊都和其他隊爭奪獎品。

items.en: Each of the climbers was tied to the others with a rope.
items.zh: 每個登山客都用繩子跟其他人綁在一起。

items.en: Each guest brought a small gift for the others.
items.zh: 每個客人都帶了一份小禮物給其他人。

items.en: Each of the children shared their sweets with the others.
items.zh: 每個孩子都把糖果分給其他人。

examples.heading: ⑤ 地點介系詞

items.en: Each of the two towns is across the river from the other.
items.zh: 那兩個鎮隔著河，各在一岸。

items.en: Each of the two shops is right next to the other.
items.zh: 兩家店就在彼此隔壁。

items.en: Each house in the street is very close to the others.
items.zh: 這條街上每棟房子都離其他房子很近。

items.en: Each of the two chairs was placed opposite the other.
items.zh: 兩張椅子面對面擺著。

items.en: Each of the three statues stands far from the others.
items.zh: 那三座雕像，每一座都離其他座很遠。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不同的時態

items.en: Each of the leaders has spoken against the other.
items.zh: 兩位領袖都公開反對過對方。

items.en: Each of the girls will sit beside the other at the wedding.
items.zh: 婚禮上，那兩個女孩會坐在一起。

items.en: Each of the two companies had worked with the other before.
items.zh: 那兩家公司以前都跟對方合作過。

items.en: Each of the soldiers was fighting for the others.
items.zh: 每個士兵都在為其他人而戰。

items.en: Each runner was running against the others.
items.zh: 每個跑者都在跟其他人比賽。

title: Each of them admires the other's intelligence.
translation: 他們兩個都欣賞對方的聰明。
name: each … the other(s) 當受詞
sentences: My parents have been married for forty years, and each of them still loves the other.
Each of us blamed the other for the mistake.
The two shops are next door, and each of them copies the other.
You two worked hard together, so each of you should thank the other.
After the fight, each of them refused to call the other.
In a good marriage, each partner supports the other.
Each twin can always tell what the other is thinking.
The two teams are so strong that each team fears the other.
Each player greeted the other before the final.
Each side accused the other of lying.
Each of the brothers wears the other's clothes.
Each student checked the other's homework.
Each of them knows the other's phone number by heart.
Each of the two writers praised the other's style.
Each of the dogs tried to eat the other's food.
My parents taught us that each of us should help the others.
In this game, each player tries to catch the others.
The four flatmates get on well, and each one respects the others.
On the last lap, each runner watched the others closely.
Each member of the team encourages the others.
At the meeting, each manager blamed the others.
Each of the children wanted the others' sweets.
At the music camp, each singer liked the others' songs.
In our writing class, each of the students read the others' essays.
Each of the cooks tasted the others' dishes.
Each candidate attacked the others' ideas.
Each of the two drivers saw the other too late.
Each of the girls has invited the other to her party.
Each of us will need the others' help.
Each of the boys wanted the other to say sorry first.
Each of the companies had tried to buy the other.

examples.heading: ① each of them / us + the other

items.en: My parents have been married for forty years, and each of them still loves the other.
items.zh: 我爸媽結婚四十年了，兩個人到現在還愛著對方。

items.en: Each of us blamed the other for the mistake.
items.zh: 我們兩個都把錯推到對方身上。

items.en: The two shops are next door, and each of them copies the other.
items.zh: 那兩家店就在隔壁，兩家都在模仿對方。

items.en: You two worked hard together, so each of you should thank the other.
items.zh: 你們兩個一起努力，所以你們都應該謝謝對方。

items.en: After the fight, each of them refused to call the other.
items.zh: 吵架之後，他們兩個都不肯打電話給對方。

examples.heading: ② each + 單數名詞 + the other

items.en: In a good marriage, each partner supports the other.
items.zh: 好的婚姻裡，兩個人都會支持對方。

items.en: Each twin can always tell what the other is thinking.
items.zh: 這對雙胞胎總是知道對方在想什麼。

items.en: The two teams are so strong that each team fears the other.
items.zh: 這兩隊都很強，兩隊都怕對方。

items.en: Each player greeted the other before the final.
items.zh: 決賽前，兩位選手都跟對方打了招呼。

items.en: Each side accused the other of lying.
items.zh: 雙方都指控對方說謊。

examples.heading: ③ the other's + 名詞

items.en: Each of the brothers wears the other's clothes.
items.zh: 那兩兄弟都會穿對方的衣服。

items.en: Each student checked the other's homework.
items.zh: 兩個學生都檢查了對方的作業。

items.en: Each of them knows the other's phone number by heart.
items.zh: 他們兩個都背得出對方的電話號碼。

items.en: Each of the two writers praised the other's style.
items.zh: 那兩位作家都稱讚對方的文筆。

items.en: Each of the dogs tried to eat the other's food.
items.zh: 那兩隻狗都想吃對方的食物。

examples.heading: ④ each + the others

items.en: My parents taught us that each of us should help the others.
items.zh: 我爸媽教我們，每個人都要幫助其他人。

items.en: In this game, each player tries to catch the others.
items.zh: 這個遊戲裡，每個玩家都要去抓其他人。

items.en: The four flatmates get on well, and each one respects the others.
items.zh: 那四個室友處得很好，每個人都尊重其他人。

items.en: On the last lap, each runner watched the others closely.
items.zh: 最後一圈，每個跑者都緊盯著其他人。

items.en: Each member of the team encourages the others.
items.zh: 隊上每個人都會鼓勵其他人。

items.en: At the meeting, each manager blamed the others.
items.zh: 會議上，每個經理都怪其他人。

examples.heading: ⑤ the others' + 名詞

items.en: Each of the children wanted the others' sweets.
items.zh: 每個孩子都想要其他人的糖果。

items.en: At the music camp, each singer liked the others' songs.
items.zh: 在音樂營裡，每個歌手都喜歡其他人的歌。

items.en: In our writing class, each of the students read the others' essays.
items.zh: 在我們的寫作課上，每個學生都讀了其他人的文章。

items.en: Each of the cooks tasted the others' dishes.
items.zh: 每個廚師都嚐了其他人做的菜。

items.en: Each candidate attacked the others' ideas.
items.zh: 每個候選人都攻擊其他人的想法。

examples.heading: ⑥ 過去式和其他時態

items.en: Each of the two drivers saw the other too late.
items.zh: 兩個駕駛都太晚才看到對方。

items.en: Each of the girls has invited the other to her party.
items.zh: 那兩個女孩都邀請了對方來參加自己的派對。

items.en: Each of us will need the others' help.
items.zh: 我們每個人都會需要其他人的幫忙。

items.en: Each of the boys wanted the other to say sorry first.
items.zh: 兩個男孩都要對方先道歉。

items.en: Each of the companies had tried to buy the other.
items.zh: 兩家公司都曾經想收購對方。

title: I hope everything is all right.
translation: 我希望一切都好。
name: everything 當主詞接單數動詞
sentences: Everything is fine, thank you.
Everything is new in our house.
Everything is on the table.
Everything is quiet at night.
Everything is green in spring.
Everything is easy for her.
Everything was great on holiday.
Everything was wet after the rain.
Everything was very good at the restaurant.
Everything was in the wrong place.
Everything was white with snow.
Everything tastes good here.
Everything costs a lot in this city.
Everything happened very fast.
Everything looks different in the dark.
Everything smells of coffee in this café.
Is everything OK at school?
Is everything ready for the party?
Was everything all right with your meal?
Is everything in your bag?
Does everything in this box belong to you?
I hope everything goes well with your new job.
I hope everything is OK with your mum.
I hope everything was nice at the wedding.
I hope everything is fine in your new flat.
I hope everything is better now.
Everything in the fridge is old.
Everything in this shop is very cheap.
Everything on the menu looks good.
Everything in my room is blue.
Everything at the zoo was interesting.

examples.heading: ① everything is

items.en: Everything is fine, thank you.
items.zh: 一切都好，謝謝。

items.en: Everything is new in our house.
items.zh: 我們家裡的東西都是新的。

items.en: Everything is on the table.
items.zh: 東西全都在桌上。

items.en: Everything is quiet at night.
items.zh: 晚上一切都很安靜。

items.en: Everything is green in spring.
items.zh: 春天到處都是綠的。

items.en: Everything is easy for her.
items.zh: 什麼事對她來說都很簡單。

examples.heading: ② everything was

items.en: Everything was great on holiday.
items.zh: 假期一切都很棒。

items.en: Everything was wet after the rain.
items.zh: 下過雨後到處都濕了。

items.en: Everything was very good at the restaurant.
items.zh: 那家餐廳的菜都很好吃。

items.en: Everything was in the wrong place.
items.zh: 所有東西都放錯地方了。

items.en: Everything was white with snow.
items.zh: 到處都被雪蓋得白白的。

examples.heading: ③ everything + 其他動詞

items.en: Everything tastes good here.
items.zh: 這裡的東西都很好吃。

items.en: Everything costs a lot in this city.
items.zh: 這個城市什麼都很貴。

items.en: Everything happened very fast.
items.zh: 一切都發生得很快。

items.en: Everything looks different in the dark.
items.zh: 在黑暗裡什麼東西看起來都不一樣。

items.en: Everything smells of coffee in this café.
items.zh: 這家咖啡店裡到處都是咖啡香。

examples.heading: ④ 問句

items.en: Is everything OK at school?
items.zh: 學校一切都好嗎？

items.en: Is everything ready for the party?
items.zh: 派對都準備好了嗎？

items.en: Was everything all right with your meal?
items.zh: 您的餐點都還滿意嗎？

items.en: Is everything in your bag?
items.zh: 東西都放進你的包包了嗎？

items.en: Does everything in this box belong to you?
items.zh: 這個箱子裡的東西都是你的嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ I hope everything ...

items.en: I hope everything goes well with your new job.
items.zh: 希望你的新工作一切順利。

items.en: I hope everything is OK with your mum.
items.zh: 希望你媽媽一切都好。

items.en: I hope everything was nice at the wedding.
items.zh: 希望婚禮一切都很順利。

items.en: I hope everything is fine in your new flat.
items.zh: 希望你在新公寓一切都好。

items.en: I hope everything is better now.
items.zh: 希望現在一切都好轉了。

examples.heading: ⑥ everything + 地方

items.en: Everything in the fridge is old.
items.zh: 冰箱裡的東西都放很久了。

items.en: Everything in this shop is very cheap.
items.zh: 這家店的東西都很便宜。

items.en: Everything on the menu looks good.
items.zh: 菜單上的東西看起來都很好吃。

items.en: Everything in my room is blue.
items.zh: 我房間裡的東西都是藍色的。

items.en: Everything at the zoo was interesting.
items.zh: 動物園裡的一切都很有趣。

title: When she gave the suitcase a good look, she realized that it wasn't hers.
translation: 她仔細看了看那個行李箱，才發現那不是她的。
name: 所有格代名詞 hers 當受詞或補語
sentences: I lost my map, so my sister gave me hers.
We all showed our tickets, and Lisa showed hers last.
My charger broke, so I borrowed hers.
I finished my drink, and then she finished hers.
The teacher read my essay and then hers.
I've told you my story. Now let her tell you hers.
The coffee with milk is hers.
The car outside isn't hers. It's her brother's.
Is this bag hers or yours?
The cleaner found a ring, but it wasn't hers.
That parking space by the door is hers.
My locker is two doors down from hers.
My bedroom is right above hers.
I put my coat on top of hers.
His opinion is very different from hers.
My score was close to hers.
A: Whose hat is this? B: It's Mia's. I'm sure it's hers.
This can't be hers. She never wears red.
Are you sure this umbrella is hers?
That room was hers when she was a child.
The handwriting on the card is definitely hers.
I brought my lunch, but my sister forgot hers.
I couldn't find my pen, so I used hers.
My birthday is a week after hers.
Don't blame her. The mistake wasn't hers.
He took my advice, but he ignored hers.
Each girl brought a cake, and hers was the biggest.
My flat has one bedroom fewer than hers.
The final decision was hers, not mine.
Grandma lost her reading glasses, so I lent her mine and looked for hers.

examples.heading: ① 動詞後面

items.en: I lost my map, so my sister gave me hers.
items.zh: 我把地圖弄丟了，所以我姊姊把她的給我。

items.en: We all showed our tickets, and Lisa showed hers last.
items.zh: 我們都出示了票，Lisa 最後才出示她的。

items.en: My charger broke, so I borrowed hers.
items.zh: 我的充電器壞了，所以我借了她的。

items.en: I finished my drink, and then she finished hers.
items.zh: 我喝完了我的飲料，接著她也喝完了她的。

items.en: The teacher read my essay and then hers.
items.zh: 老師讀了我的作文，然後讀了她的。

items.en: I've told you my story. Now let her tell you hers.
items.zh: 我已經跟你說了我的故事。現在讓她跟你說她的。

examples.heading: ② be + hers

items.en: The coffee with milk is hers.
items.zh: 加牛奶的那杯咖啡是她的。

items.en: The car outside isn't hers. It's her brother's.
items.zh: 外面那輛車不是她的，是她哥哥的。

items.en: Is this bag hers or yours?
items.zh: 這個包包是她的還是你的？

items.en: The cleaner found a ring, but it wasn't hers.
items.zh: 清潔人員撿到一枚戒指，可是那不是她的。

items.en: That parking space by the door is hers.
items.zh: 門邊那個停車位是她的。

examples.heading: ③ 介系詞 + hers

items.en: My locker is two doors down from hers.
items.zh: 我的置物櫃跟她的隔兩格。

items.en: My bedroom is right above hers.
items.zh: 我的臥室就在她的正上方。

items.en: I put my coat on top of hers.
items.zh: 我把我的外套放在她的上面。

items.en: His opinion is very different from hers.
items.zh: 他的看法跟她的很不一樣。

items.en: My score was close to hers.
items.zh: 我的分數跟她的很接近。

examples.heading: ④ 確認是不是她的

items.en: A: Whose hat is this? B: It's Mia's. I'm sure it's hers.
items.zh: A：這是誰的帽子？B：是 Mia 的。我確定是她的。

items.en: This can't be hers. She never wears red.
items.zh: 這不可能是她的。她從來不穿紅色。

items.en: Are you sure this umbrella is hers?
items.zh: 你確定這把傘是她的嗎？

items.en: That room was hers when she was a child.
items.zh: 她小時候那個房間是她的。

items.en: The handwriting on the card is definitely hers.
items.zh: 卡片上的字跡絕對是她的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: I brought my lunch, but my sister forgot hers.
items.zh: 我帶了午餐，可是我姊姊忘了帶她的。

items.en: I couldn't find my pen, so I used hers.
items.zh: 我找不到我的筆，所以用了她的。

items.en: My birthday is a week after hers.
items.zh: 我的生日在她的一個禮拜之後。

items.en: Don't blame her. The mistake wasn't hers.
items.zh: 別怪她。那不是她的錯。

items.en: He took my advice, but he ignored hers.
items.zh: 他接受了我的建議，卻忽略了她的。

items.en: Each girl brought a cake, and hers was the biggest.
items.zh: 每個女孩都帶了蛋糕，她的最大。

items.en: My flat has one bedroom fewer than hers.
items.zh: 我的公寓比她的少一間臥室。

items.en: The final decision was hers, not mine.
items.zh: 最後的決定是她做的，不是我。

items.en: Grandma lost her reading glasses, so I lent her mine and looked for hers.
items.zh: 奶奶的老花眼鏡不見了，所以我把我的借她，再幫她找她的。

title: I put Sophie's pictures in my bag because hers was already packed.
translation: 我把 Sophie 的照片放進我的包包，因為她的包包已經裝好了。
name: hers 當主詞
sentences: My answer was wrong, but hers was right.
His flight leaves at noon, and hers leaves an hour later.
My phone has no signal, but hers works fine.
His speech was short, but hers lasted forty minutes.
My garden is full of weeds, but hers looks perfect.
Tom's car is fast, and hers is even faster.
I lent Amy my umbrella because hers had a hole in it.
We took my car because hers wouldn't start.
She used my laptop because hers had run out of battery.
Lisa slept in my room because hers was too cold.
I gave her a new pen because hers had stopped working.
Dad said that hers was the best cake at the party.
She realized that hers was the only bike left in the rack.
Everyone agreed that hers was the funniest story.
I heard that hers is the biggest house on the street.
The teacher said that hers was the neatest homework in the class.
Hers was a difficult childhood.
Hers was a long and happy marriage.
Hers is a story that everyone should hear.
Hers was a busy life, with three children and two jobs.
Hers was the first name on the list.
My grandmother's soup is salty, but hers is perfect.
Each child drew a picture, and hers won the prize.
My mother's handwriting is neat, but hers is impossible to read.
Of all the dresses, hers was the most beautiful.
My exam is on Monday, and hers is on Friday.
His joke fell flat, but hers made everyone laugh.
My suitcase is ready, but hers is still empty.
All the plans were good, but hers was the cheapest.
Your idea is interesting, but hers is more practical.

examples.heading: ① but / and + hers

items.en: My answer was wrong, but hers was right.
items.zh: 我的答案錯了，可是她的對了。

items.en: His flight leaves at noon, and hers leaves an hour later.
items.zh: 他的班機中午起飛，她的晚一個小時。

items.en: My phone has no signal, but hers works fine.
items.zh: 我的手機沒訊號，可是她的很正常。

items.en: His speech was short, but hers lasted forty minutes.
items.zh: 他的演講很短，可是她的講了四十分鐘。

items.en: My garden is full of weeds, but hers looks perfect.
items.zh: 我的花園長滿了雜草，可是她的看起來很完美。

items.en: Tom's car is fast, and hers is even faster.
items.zh: Tom 的車很快，她的更快。

examples.heading: ② because + hers

items.en: I lent Amy my umbrella because hers had a hole in it.
items.zh: 我把傘借給 Amy，因為她的破了一個洞。

items.en: We took my car because hers wouldn't start.
items.zh: 我們開我的車，因為她的發不動。

items.en: She used my laptop because hers had run out of battery.
items.zh: 她用了我的筆電，因為她的沒電了。

items.en: Lisa slept in my room because hers was too cold.
items.zh: Lisa 睡在我的房間，因為她的太冷了。

items.en: I gave her a new pen because hers had stopped working.
items.zh: 我給了她一支新筆，因為她的不能寫了。

examples.heading: ③ that 子句 + hers

items.en: Dad said that hers was the best cake at the party.
items.zh: 爸爸說她的蛋糕是派對上最好吃的。

items.en: She realized that hers was the only bike left in the rack.
items.zh: 她發現車架上只剩她的腳踏車。

items.en: Everyone agreed that hers was the funniest story.
items.zh: 大家都同意她的故事最好笑。

items.en: I heard that hers is the biggest house on the street.
items.zh: 我聽說她家是這條街上最大的房子。

items.en: The teacher said that hers was the neatest homework in the class.
items.zh: 老師說她的作業是全班最整齊的。

examples.heading: ④ Hers was a ...（描述人生和處境）

items.en: Hers was a difficult childhood.
items.zh: 她的童年很辛苦。

items.en: Hers was a long and happy marriage.
items.zh: 她的婚姻長久又幸福。

items.en: Hers is a story that everyone should hear.

title: Some of the motorists changed to bicycles or to public transport, but far too few did.
translation: 有些駕駛人改騎腳踏車或搭大眾運輸，但這樣做的人實在太少了。
name: very、too、so 修飾 few 和 many
sentences: Many people start the course, but very few finish it.
We sent out two hundred letters and very few replied.
Lots of students applied, but very few got a place.
He has written many songs, but very few are well known.
I asked everyone in the office, and very few knew the answer.
Not very many came to the meeting last night.
Were there many mistakes? Not very many.
She has friends all over the world, though not very many in her own town.
There used to be lots of bookshops here, but not very many are left.
I've seen some of his films, but not very many.
We need volunteers, but too few have signed up.
The bus company says too few use the night service.
Many young people want to become teachers, but far too few stay in the job.
The town has some cycle lanes, but far too few.
Doctors are working hard, but there are too few to meet the demand.
I bought some apples, but I bought too many.
Tourists are welcome, but far too many arrive in the summer.
We tried to answer all the emails, but there were too many.
Too many have lost their jobs this year.
He took a few photos at first, then far too many.
So few came that we cancelled the concert.
There were birds everywhere. I had never seen so many in one place.
Lots of people move here, but why do so few stay longer than a year?
So many wanted tickets that the website crashed.
There are so many to choose from that I can't decide.
Only the very few who trained every day finished the race.
Private schools were once open to the very few who could pay.
The very few who knew the secret kept it to themselves.
Cars were once a luxury for the very few.
The prize goes to the very few who reach the final round.
Travel abroad used to be possible only for the very few with money.

examples.heading: ① very few

items.en: Many people start the course, but very few finish it.
items.zh: 很多人開始上這門課，可是很少人上完。

items.en: We sent out two hundred letters and very few replied.
items.zh: 我們寄出兩百封信，回信的非常少。

items.en: Lots of students applied, but very few got a place.
items.zh: 很多學生申請，可是錄取的非常少。

items.en: He has written many songs, but very few are well known.
items.zh: 他寫了很多歌，可是有名的非常少。

items.en: I asked everyone in the office, and very few knew the answer.
items.zh: 我問了辦公室裡每個人，知道答案的非常少。

examples.heading: ② very many

items.en: Not very many came to the meeting last night.
items.zh: 昨晚來開會的人不太多。

items.en: Were there many mistakes? Not very many.
items.zh: 錯很多嗎？不太多。

items.en: She has friends all over the world, though not very many in her own town.
items.zh: 她在世界各地都有朋友，可是在自己住的鎮上不多。

items.en: There used to be lots of bookshops here, but not very many are left.
items.zh: 這裡以前有很多書店，可是現在剩下的不多。

items.en: I've seen some of his films, but not very many.
items.zh: 我看過他幾部電影，但看得不多。

examples.heading: ③ too few / far too few

items.en: We need volunteers, but too few have signed up.
items.zh: 我們需要志工，可是報名的人太少了。

items.en: The bus company says too few use the night service.
items.zh: 公車公司說搭夜間班次的人太少。

items.en: Many young people want to become teachers, but far too few stay in the job.
items.zh: 很多年輕人想當老師，可是留下來的人實在太少了。

items.en: The town has some cycle lanes, but far too few.
items.zh: 這個鎮有一些自行車道，可是實在太少了。

items.en: Doctors are working hard, but there are too few to meet the demand.
items.zh: 醫生都很努力，可是人數太少，應付不了需求。

examples.heading: ④ too many / far too many

items.en: I bought some apples, but I bought too many.
items.zh: 我買了一些蘋果，可是買太多了。

items.en: Tourists are welcome, but far too many arrive in the summer.
items.zh: 觀光客很受歡迎，可是夏天來的實在太多了。

items.en: We tried to answer all the emails, but there were too many.
items.zh: 我們想回覆所有的電子郵件，可是太多了。

items.en: Too many have lost their jobs this year.
items.zh: 今年失業的人太多了。

items.en: He took a few photos at first, then far too many.
items.zh: 他一開始只拍幾張照片，後來拍得實在太多了。

examples.heading: ⑤ so few / so many

items.en: So few came that we cancelled the concert.
items.zh: 來的人這麼少，我們就取消了音樂會。

items.en: There were birds everywhere. I had never seen so many in one place.
items.zh: 到處都是鳥，我從來沒在一個地方看過這麼多。

items.en: Lots of people move here, but why do so few stay longer than a year?
items.zh: 很多人搬來這裡，可是為什麼待超過一年的人這麼少？

items.en: So many wanted tickets that the website crashed.
items.zh: 要買票的人這麼多，網站當掉了。

items.en: There are so many to choose from that I can't decide.
items.zh: 可以選的這麼多，我決定不了。

examples.heading: ⑥ the very few

items.en: Only the very few who trained every day finished the race.
items.zh: 只有極少數每天練習的人跑完了比賽。

items.en: Private schools were once open to the very few who could pay.
items.zh: 私立學校以前只開放給極少數付得起學費的人。

items.en: The very few who knew the secret kept it to themselves.
items.zh: 知道秘密的極少數人都守口如瓶。

items.en: Cars were once a luxury for the very few.
items.zh: 汽車以前是極少數人才有的奢侈品。

items.en: The prize goes to the very few who reach the final round.
items.zh: 獎項只頒給打進決賽的極少數人。

items.en: Travel abroad used to be possible only for the very few with money.
items.zh: 以前只有極少數有錢人能出國旅行。

items.zh: 你看起來餓了。要不要吃點冰箱裡的東西？

items.en: Can I offer you something cold?
items.zh: 要不要喝點冰的？

items.en: Do you want something hot?
items.zh: 你要吃點熱的嗎？

items.en: I'm going to the bakery. Do you want something?
items.zh: 我要去麵包店，你要買點什麼嗎？

items.en: Shall I make you something before you go?
items.zh: 你走之前要不要我幫你做點吃的？

title: I bought a new bag, and I love it.
translation: 我買了一個新包包，我好愛它。
name: it 當受詞指前面提過的事物
sentences: I bought a new bag at the weekend, and I love it.
This is my new phone. Do you like it?
I can't find my pen. Have you seen it?
My bike is old, but I still ride it every day.
Grandma gave me this watch. I wear it every day.
We have maths every day. Maths is boring, and I don't like it.
I started tennis last year. I really enjoy it.
English is difficult, but I'm studying it hard.
Swimming is good exercise. I do it twice a week.
This cake is delicious. Try it!
The soup is hot. Don't drink it yet.
I made some pasta. Do you want it?
The party was great. Everyone enjoyed it.
The film is on tonight. Let's watch it together.
It's my sister's birthday next week. Don't forget it.
Take this map with you, and keep it in your bag.
The address is on the card. If you can't find it, call me.
This is your homework. Please do it tonight.
"I've got a new car." "Wow! Can I see it?"
"I love this song." "Do you like it too?"
"Where's my umbrella?" "I put it by the door."

examples.heading: ① 東西

items.en: I bought a new bag at the weekend, and I love it.
items.zh: 我週末買了一個新包包，我好愛它。

items.en: This is my new phone. Do you like it?
items.zh: 這是我的新手機。你喜歡嗎？

items.en: I can't find my pen. Have you seen it?
items.zh: 我找不到我的筆。你有看到嗎？

items.en: My bike is old, but I still ride it every day.
items.zh: 我的腳踏車很舊，可是我還是每天騎。

items.en: Grandma gave me this watch. I wear it every day.
items.zh: 這支手錶是奶奶給我的。我每天都戴。

examples.heading: ② 科目和活動

items.en: We have maths every day. Maths is boring, and I don't like it.
items.zh: 我們每天都有數學課。數學很無聊，我不喜歡。

items.en: I started tennis last year. I really enjoy it.
items.zh: 我去年開始打網球。我真的很喜歡。

items.en: English is difficult, but I'm studying it hard.
items.zh: 英文很難，可是我很用功在學。

items.en: Swimming is good exercise. I do it twice a week.
items.zh: 游泳是很好的運動。我一星期游兩次。

examples.heading: ③ 食物和飲料

items.en: This cake is delicious. Try it!
items.zh: 這個蛋糕很好吃。吃吃看！

items.en: The soup is hot. Don't drink it yet.
items.zh: 湯很燙。先別喝。

items.en: I made some pasta. Do you want it?
items.zh: 我煮了一些義大利麵。你要吃嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 一件事

items.en: The party was great. Everyone enjoyed it.
items.zh: 派對很棒。每個人都玩得很開心。

items.en: The film is on tonight. Let's watch it together.
items.zh: 那部電影今晚播出。我們一起看吧。

items.en: It's my sister's birthday next week. Don't forget it.
items.zh: 下星期是我姊姊的生日。別忘了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 請求和指示

items.en: Take this map with you, and keep it in your bag.
items.zh: 把這張地圖帶著，放在你的包包裡。

items.en: The address is on the card. If you can't find it, call me.
items.zh: 地址在卡片上。如果你找不到，打給我。

items.en: This is your homework. Please do it tonight.
items.zh: 這是你的功課。請今天晚上寫。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "I've got a new car." "Wow! Can I see it?"
items.zh: 我買了一台新車。哇！我可以看看嗎？

items.en: "I love this song." "Do you like it too?"
items.zh: 我好愛這首歌。你也喜歡嗎？

items.en: "Where's my umbrella?" "I put it by the door."
items.zh: 我的傘呢？我放在門邊。

title: I invited everyone in the school, but some people didn't come.
translation: 我邀請了學校裡的每一個人，但是有些人沒來。
name: 不定代名詞當受詞或介系詞受詞
sentences: The teacher thanked everyone for coming.
I know everybody at this party.
She called everyone in her family.
We met everybody at the station.
He helps everyone in the office.
I miss everybody back home.
I saw someone in the garden.
She's waiting for somebody.
We need someone to help us.
I met somebody nice on the plane.
Did you hear somebody at the window?
I made something for you.
She cleaned everything before her parents came.
My brother broke something in the kitchen.
He forgot everything I told him.
We bought something for the baby.
Please give this letter to someone at the desk.
I made a cake for everyone.
She sent a postcard to everybody in the class.
Is this coffee for somebody?
He waved to everyone on the bus.
I heard the news from someone at work.
She went to the cinema with somebody from school.
She worries about everybody in her family.
He got a text from somebody he didn't know.
I want to dance with everyone tonight.
Can you call someone to fix the light?
Did you tell everyone about the party?
Please say thank you to everybody.
Can I bring somebody with me?
Did you buy something for Mum?

examples.heading: ① 動詞 + everyone / everybody

items.en: The teacher thanked everyone for coming.
items.zh: 老師謝謝大家來參加。

items.en: I know everybody at this party.
items.zh: 這個派對上的人我都認識。

items.en: She called everyone in her family.
items.zh: 她打電話給家裡每個人。

items.en: We met everybody at the station.
items.zh: 我們在車站跟大家碰面。

items.en: He helps everyone in the office.
items.zh: 辦公室裡的人他都會幫忙。

items.en: I miss everybody back home.
items.zh: 我想念家鄉的每一個人。

examples.heading: ② 動詞 + someone / somebody

items.en: I saw someone in the garden.
items.zh: 我看到花園裡有人。

items.en: She's waiting for somebody.
items.zh: 她在等人。

items.en: We need someone to help us.
items.zh: 我們需要有人來幫忙。

items.en: I met somebody nice on the plane.
items.zh: 我在飛機上認識了一個很好的人。

items.en: Did you hear somebody at the window?
items.zh: 你有聽到窗邊有人嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 動詞 + something / everything

items.en: I made something for you.
items.zh: 我做了一樣東西給你。

items.en: She cleaned everything before her parents came.
items.zh: 她爸媽來之前她把所有東西都打掃乾淨了。

items.en: My brother broke something in the kitchen.
items.zh: 我弟弟把廚房裡的東西打破了。

items.en: He forgot everything I told him.
items.zh: 我跟他說的事他全忘了。

items.en: We bought something for the baby.
items.zh: 我們買了一樣東西給寶寶。

examples.heading: ④ to / for + 不定代名詞

items.en: Please give this letter to someone at the desk.
items.zh: 請把這封信交給櫃台的人。

items.en: I made a cake for everyone.
items.zh: 我做了一個蛋糕給大家吃。

items.en: She sent a postcard to everybody in the class.
items.zh: 她寄了明信片給班上每個人。

items.en: Is this coffee for somebody?
items.zh: 這杯咖啡是有人要的嗎？

items.en: He waved to everyone on the bus.
items.zh: 他向公車上的每個人揮手。

examples.heading: ⑤ from / with / about + 不定代名詞

items.en: I heard the news from someone at work.
items.zh: 我是從公司的人那裡聽到這個消息的。

items.en: She went to the cinema with somebody from school.
items.zh: 她跟學校的一個人去看電影。

items.en: She worries about everybody in her family.
items.zh: 她擔心家裡的每一個人。

items.en: He got a text from somebody he didn't know.
items.zh: 他收到一封陌生人傳來的簡訊。

items.en: I want to dance with everyone tonight.
items.zh: 今晚我想跟每個人都跳支舞。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問句和請求

items.en: Can you call someone to fix the light?
items.zh: 你可以找人來修燈嗎？

items.en: Did you tell everyone about the party?
items.zh: 派對的事你跟大家說了嗎？

items.en: Please say thank you to everybody.
items.zh: 請跟大家說聲謝謝。

items.en: Can I bring somebody with me?
items.zh: 我可以帶一個人一起來嗎？

items.en: Did you buy something for Mum?
items.zh: 你有買東西給媽媽嗎？

title: When I arrived at his house, there wasn't anyone there.
translation: 我到他家的時候，那裡一個人也沒有。
name: 不定代名詞當受詞或補語
sentences: I need something for my headache.
She invited everyone from work.
We didn't hear anything during the night.
He told nobody about the accident.
Did you bring anything to read on the train?
I want to show you something in the garden.
Don't tell this to anyone.
He's afraid of nothing.
She's kind to everybody.
I got a letter from someone in Canada.
We talked about everything and nothing.
There's someone at the door.
There was nothing in the post today.
Is there anything I can do?
There wasn't anybody in the waiting room.
There's something strange about that man.
My handbag is so full that I can't find anything in it.
Have you met anyone new at school?
It was raining, so we didn't meet anybody on the mountain path.
Do you know anyone who can fix a bike?
The baby won't drink anything today.
We travelled everywhere by train.
Let's go somewhere warm this winter.
We couldn't find a hotel room anywhere in town.
Park anywhere you like in the car park behind the hotel.
There's nowhere to hide in this room.
"Thanks for your help." "It was nothing."
That's everything I know about him.
Before the film, he was nobody.
His new job is something to do with computers.
This isn't anything new.

examples.heading: ① 當動詞的受詞

items.en: I need something for my headache.
items.zh: 我需要吃點治頭痛的藥。

items.en: She invited everyone from work.
items.zh: 她邀請了公司的每個人。

items.en: We didn't hear anything during the night.
items.zh: 我們晚上什麼聲音都沒聽到。

items.en: He told nobody about the accident.
items.zh: 他沒跟任何人說那場意外。

items.en: Did you bring anything to read on the train?
items.zh: 你有帶什麼在火車上看的東西嗎？

items.en: I want to show you something in the garden.
items.zh: 我想給你看花園裡的一樣東西。

examples.heading: ② 當介系詞的受詞

items.en: Don't tell this to anyone.
items.zh: 這件事別跟任何人說。

items.en: He's afraid of nothing.
items.zh: 他什麼都不怕。

items.en: She's kind to everybody.
items.zh: 她對每個人都很好。

items.en: I got a letter from someone in Canada.
items.zh: 我收到一封加拿大的人寄來的信。

items.en: We talked about everything and nothing.
items.zh: 我們天南地北什麼都聊。

examples.heading: ③ there + be + 不定代名詞

items.en: There's someone at the door.
items.zh: 門口有人。

items.en: There was nothing in the post today.
items.zh: 今天沒有收到任何信。

items.en: Is there anything I can do?
items.zh: 有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？

items.en: There wasn't anybody in the waiting room.
items.zh: 候診室裡一個人都沒有。

items.en: There's something strange about that man.
items.zh: 那個男人有點怪怪的。

examples.heading: ④ 否定句和問句

items.en: My handbag is so full that I can't find anything in it.
items.zh: 我的手提包塞得太滿，裡面的東西我什麼都找不到。

items.en: Have you met anyone new at school?
items.zh: 你在學校有認識新朋友嗎？

items.en: It was raining, so we didn't meet anybody on the mountain path.
items.zh: 那時在下雨，所以我們在山路上一個人都沒遇到。

items.en: Do you know anyone who can fix a bike?
items.zh: 你認識會修腳踏車的人嗎？

items.en: The baby won't drink anything today.
items.zh: 寶寶今天什麼都不肯喝。

examples.heading: ⑤ 地方

items.en: We travelled everywhere by train.
items.zh: 我們到哪裡都是搭火車。

items.en: Let's go somewhere warm this winter.
items.zh: 今年冬天我們去個溫暖的地方吧。

items.en: We couldn't find a hotel room anywhere in town.
items.zh: 城裡哪裡都訂不到飯店房間。

items.en: Park anywhere you like in the car park behind the hotel.
items.zh: 飯店後面的停車場，你想停哪裡都可以。

items.en: There's nowhere to hide in this room.
items.zh: 這個房間沒有地方可以躲。

examples.heading: ⑥ 當補語

items.en: "Thanks for your help." "It was nothing."
items.zh: 謝謝你幫忙。小事一樁。

items.en: That's everything I know about him.
items.zh: 我對他的了解就這些。

items.en: Before the film, he was nobody.
items.zh: 演那部電影之前，他只是個無名小卒。

items.en: His new job is something to do with computers.
items.zh: 他的新工作跟電腦有關。

items.en: This isn't anything new.
items.zh: 這沒什麼新鮮的。

title: My shyness makes it hard for me to speak in public.
translation: 害羞的個性讓我很難在眾人面前說話。
name: make 後的形式受詞 it
sentences: I'm very shy. This shyness makes it hard for me to speak in public, or even to go out with my friends as often as I should.
Other companies with cheaper prices and lots of discounts make it impossible for us to do business.
My bad back makes it difficult for me to sit for long.
The new timetable makes it easier for students to get to school on time.
The noise from the street made it hard to sleep.
The snow made it impossible to drive to work.
The heat made it difficult to concentrate in class.
His accent made it hard for me to understand him.
The internet makes it easy to keep in touch with friends abroad.
A good map makes it simple to find your way around the city.
Online banking makes it possible to pay bills at any time.
The new bridge will make it quicker to get to the airport.
Living closer to work would make it easier to see my family.
The rain could make it dangerous to climb the mountain tomorrow.
The loud music in the restaurant made it impossible to have a conversation.
Small text on the website makes it hard for older people to read.
Clear signs would make it easier for tourists to find the museum.
"Why did you leave the party early?" "The smoke made it hard to breathe."
"How's working from home?" "Great. It makes it easy to look after the kids."
"Do you like the new phone?" "Yes, the big screen makes it easier to read."

examples.heading: ① makes it + 形容詞 + for + 人 + to

items.en: I'm very shy. This shyness makes it hard for me to speak in public, or even to go out with my friends as often as I should.
items.zh: 我很害羞。這種個性讓我很難在眾人面前說話，甚至很難像應該的那樣常跟朋友出去。

items.en: Other companies with cheaper prices and lots of discounts make it impossible for us to do business.
items.zh: 其他公司價格更便宜、折扣又多，讓我們根本做不了生意。

items.en: My bad back makes it difficult for me to sit for long.
items.zh: 我的背不好，很難久坐。

items.en: The new timetable makes it easier for students to get to school on time.
items.zh: 新的時刻表讓學生比較容易準時到校。

examples.heading: ② made it + 形容詞 + to

items.en: The noise from the street made it hard to sleep.
items.zh: 街上的噪音讓人很難睡著。

items.en: The snow made it impossible to drive to work.
items.zh: 那場雪讓人根本沒辦法開車上班。

items.en: The heat made it difficult to concentrate in class.
items.zh: 天氣太熱，上課很難專心。

items.en: His accent made it hard for me to understand him.
items.zh: 他的口音讓我很難聽懂他在說什麼。

examples.heading: ③ makes it + easy / possible + to

items.en: The internet makes it easy to keep in touch with friends abroad.
items.zh: 網路讓人很容易跟國外的朋友保持聯絡。

items.en: A good map makes it simple to find your way around the city.
items.zh: 有一張好地圖，在城裡找路就很簡單。

items.en: Online banking makes it possible to pay bills at any time.
items.zh: 網路銀行讓人隨時都能繳帳單。

examples.heading: ④ will make it / could make it

items.en: The new bridge will make it quicker to get to the airport.
items.zh: 新的橋會讓去機場更快。

items.en: Living closer to work would make it easier to see my family.
items.zh: 住得離公司近一點，就比較容易見到家人。

items.en: The rain could make it dangerous to climb the mountain tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天下雨的話，爬山可能會很危險。

examples.heading: ⑤ 抱怨和建議

items.en: The loud music in the restaurant made it impossible to have a conversation.
items.zh: 餐廳的音樂太大聲，根本沒辦法聊天。

items.en: Small text on the website makes it hard for older people to read.
items.zh: 網站上的字太小，老人家很難讀。

items.en: Clear signs would make it easier for tourists to find the museum.
items.zh: 清楚的指標會讓觀光客比較容易找到博物館。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Why did you leave the party early?" "The smoke made it hard to breathe."
items.zh: 你為什麼提早離開派對？煙讓人很難呼吸。

items.en: "How's working from home?" "Great. It makes it easy to look after the kids."
items.zh: 在家工作怎麼樣？很好。照顧小孩變得很容易。

items.en: "Do you like the new phone?" "Yes, the big screen makes it easier to read."
items.zh: 你喜歡那支新手機嗎？喜歡，大螢幕讓閱讀變得比較容易。

title: I spend my free time with them.
translation: 我的空閒時間都跟他們一起過。
name: 受格代名詞當介系詞受詞
sentences: My two best friends live near me. I spend my free time with them.
My sister goes to the gym on Mondays. Sometimes I go with her.
I'm going to the beach. Do you want to come with me?
My dad likes fishing. I sometimes go with him on Sundays.
I really like learning new words. It's very important for me.
I bought a present for her.
Thank you for the card. It was so kind of you to make it for us.
Wait for me! I'm coming.
I've got a new CD. Can you bring your speaker so we can listen to it?
Please write to me soon.
My grandparents are coming. I'm going to show my room to them.
Listen to him. He's right.
Tell me about your new friend. What's she like?
Why are you looking at me?
I got a card from them on my birthday.
We often talk about him.
This cake is from Tom and me.
Come to the cinema with my sister and me.
The teacher was angry with him and me.
"Who are the flowers for?" "They're for you!"
"Do you know Max?" "Yes, I play football with him."
"Where's the dog?" "The kids are playing with it in the garden."

examples.heading: ① with + 受格代名詞

items.en: My two best friends live near me. I spend my free time with them.
items.zh: 我兩個最好的朋友住在我家附近。我的空閒時間都跟他們一起過。

items.en: My sister goes to the gym on Mondays. Sometimes I go with her.
items.zh: 我姊姊星期一去健身房。有時候我跟她一起去。

items.en: I'm going to the beach. Do you want to come with me?
items.zh: 我要去海邊。你要跟我一起去嗎？

items.en: My dad likes fishing. I sometimes go with him on Sundays.
items.zh: 我爸爸喜歡釣魚。我星期天有時候跟他一起去。

examples.heading: ② for + 受格代名詞

items.en: I really like learning new words. It's very important for me.
items.zh: 我真的很喜歡學新單字。這對我很重要。

items.en: I bought a present for her.
items.zh: 我買了一份禮物給她。

items.en: Thank you for the card. It was so kind of you to make it for us.
items.zh: 謝謝你的卡片。你特地為我們做，真貼心。

items.en: Wait for me! I'm coming.
items.zh: 等等我！我來了。

examples.heading: ③ to + 受格代名詞

items.en: I've got a new CD. Can you bring your speaker so we can listen to it?
items.zh: 我買了一張新 CD。你可以帶你的喇叭來，讓我們一起聽嗎？

items.en: Please write to me soon.
items.zh: 請快點寫信給我。

items.en: My grandparents are coming. I'm going to show my room to them.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶要來。我要帶他們看我的房間。

items.en: Listen to him. He's right.
items.zh: 聽他的。他說得對。

examples.heading: ④ about / at / from + 受格代名詞

items.en: Tell me about your new friend. What's she like?
items.zh: 跟我說說你的新朋友。她人怎麼樣？

items.en: Why are you looking at me?
items.zh: 你為什麼一直看我？

items.en: I got a card from them on my birthday.
items.zh: 我生日的時候收到他們寄來的卡片。

items.en: We often talk about him.
items.zh: 我們常常聊到他。

examples.heading: ⑤ 兩個人

items.en: This cake is from Tom and me.
items.zh: 這個蛋糕是 Tom 和我送的。

items.en: Come to the cinema with my sister and me.
items.zh: 跟我妹妹和我一起去看電影吧。

items.en: The teacher was angry with him and me.
items.zh: 老師對他和我很生氣。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Who are the flowers for?" "They're for you!"
items.zh: 這些花是要給誰的？是給你的！

items.en: "Do you know Max?" "Yes, I play football with him."
items.zh: 你認識 Max 嗎？認識，我跟他一起踢足球。

items.en: "Where's the dog?" "The kids are playing with it in the garden."
items.zh: 狗呢？孩子們在花園跟牠玩。

items.zh: 我不喜歡那個蛋糕，我可以拿這個嗎？

items.zh: 可以幫我把金色那個包起來嗎？

items.en: This one's too tight. Is there a looser one?
items.zh: 這件太緊了，有寬鬆一點的嗎？

items.en: I'll take the cheap one.
items.zh: 我要便宜的那個。

items.en: Is the blue one on sale?
items.zh: 藍色的有特價嗎？

items.en: Have you got one in black?
items.zh: 有黑色的嗎？

items.zh: 這顆蘋果很好吃，我可以再吃一顆嗎？

items.zh: 一隻手套在這裡，另一隻在哪裡？

items.zh: 這一課很簡單，下一課會比較難。

items.en: I finished my coffee and ordered another one.
items.zh: 我喝完咖啡，又點了一杯。

items.zh: 他們的花園因為乾旱受損，我們的也是。

items.en: I hope your plan works, as ours did last year.
items.zh: 希望你們的計畫成功，就像我們去年那樣。

examples.heading: ② ours + 倍數比較

items.en: Their flat is small, but ours is three times as big.
items.zh: 他們的公寓很小，可是我們的是三倍大。

items.en: Ours is twice as expensive as the hotel next door.
items.zh: 我們的飯店價格是隔壁那家的兩倍。

items.en: Their pool is big, but ours is almost twice as long.
items.zh: 他們的游泳池很大，可是我們的幾乎是兩倍長。

items.en: Ours is half as big as theirs, but it's much cosier.
items.zh: 我們的只有他們的一半大，可是舒服多了。

items.en: Their bill came to two hundred dollars. Ours was nearly twice as much.
items.zh: 他們的帳單是兩百塊。我們的將近兩倍。

examples.heading: ③ 一段話裡的 Ours

items.en: The school offers several trips each year. Ours was to the mountains.
items.zh: 學校每年都會辦幾次旅遊。我們那一次是去山上。

items.en: Every class performed a play. Ours was the funniest.
items.zh: 每一班都演了一齣戲。我們班的最好笑。

items.en: All the groups gave presentations. Ours went on for an hour.
items.zh: 每一組都做了報告。我們組的講了一個小時。

items.en: The museum runs guided tours. Ours lasted two hours.
items.zh: 博物館有導覽。我們那一場進行了兩個小時。

items.en: Each family brought a dish to the party. Ours disappeared first.
items.zh: 每一家都帶了一道菜來派對。我們家的最先被吃光。

examples.heading: ④ 比較和對照

items.en: Other countries have long summer holidays. Ours are quite short.
items.zh: 其他國家的暑假很長。我們的相當短。

items.en: Many restaurants close on Mondays, but ours stays open all week.
items.zh: 很多餐廳星期一休息，可是我們的整個禮拜都開。

items.en: Most of the houses on this street are modern. Ours dates from 1920.
items.zh: 這條街上大部分的房子都很新。我們家的是一九二〇年的。

items.en: Their wedding lasted a weekend. Ours lasted just one afternoon.
items.zh: 他們的婚禮辦了一整個週末。我們的只辦了一個下午。

items.en: Your children are tall for their age. Ours are quite short.
items.zh: 你們的孩子以這個年紀來說很高。我們的相當矮。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Other airports have added more trains, as ours has.
items.zh: 其他機場增加了更多班火車，我們的機場也是。

items.en: Their neighborhood is noisy at night. Ours is peaceful.
items.zh: 他們那一帶晚上很吵。我們這一帶很安靜。

items.en: There are bigger gardens nearby, but ours gets the most sun.
items.zh: 附近有更大的花園，可是我們的曬到最多太陽。

items.en: Their marriage ended after five years. Ours has lasted thirty.
items.zh: 他們的婚姻五年後就結束了。我們的維持了三十年。

items.en: Most offices in the building are open-plan. Ours still has walls.
items.zh: 這棟大樓大部分的辦公室都是開放式的。我們的還有隔間。

items.en: Many shops lost money last year, but ours made a profit.
items.zh: 很多店去年虧錢，可是我們的有賺。

items.en: Their roof leaks every winter. Ours has never leaked.
items.zh: 他們的屋頂每年冬天都漏水。我們的從來沒漏過。

items.en: Not every team reached the final, but ours did.
items.zh: 不是每一隊都打進決賽，可是我們隊做到了。

items.en: Most dogs hate baths. Ours loves them.
items.zh: 大部分的狗都討厭洗澡。我們家的很愛。

title: The staff didn't have enough time for themselves.
translation: 員工們沒有足夠的時間留給自己。
name: 介系詞後的複數反身代名詞
sentences: Doing sport is a great way to feel good about ourselves.
We kept the news to ourselves until the wedding.
We couldn't help laughing at ourselves when we saw the photos.
After the kids left home, we finally had some time for ourselves.
We need to take better care of ourselves.
We were angry with ourselves for missing the last train.
Let's not talk about ourselves all evening.
We bought the concert tickets for ourselves, not as a gift.
We have to believe in ourselves if we want to win.
After the team lost again, we felt a bit sorry for ourselves.
We were really pleased with ourselves when the cake came out perfectly.
You should all be proud of yourselves.
Tell me a little about yourselves.
Keep some of the cake for yourselves.
Don't be so hard on yourselves. It was your first match.
Did you girls make these costumes for yourselves?
You two only ever think of yourselves.
Be honest with yourselves about how much you can afford.
Write a short paragraph about yourselves for the school website.
Can you two find yourselves in this old class photo?
Save some energy for yourselves. The second half of the hike is steep.
Nurses on night shifts rarely have time for themselves.
The children were very pleased with themselves after the show.
The players were annoyed with themselves for missing so many chances.
They built the cabin for themselves, not to rent out.
Some people only care about themselves.
My grandparents still take care of themselves.
The students talked about themselves in the first lesson.
The new parents had no time to think about themselves.
The kids made a tent for themselves in the living room.
The hikers carried enough water for themselves and the dog.
My neighbors mostly keep to themselves.

examples.heading: ① ourselves

items.en: Doing sport is a great way to feel good about ourselves.
items.zh: 運動是讓我們對自己感覺良好的好方法。

items.en: We kept the news to ourselves until the wedding.
items.zh: 我們把這個消息藏在心裡，直到婚禮才說。

items.en: We couldn't help laughing at ourselves when we saw the photos.
items.zh: 我們看到照片時都忍不住笑自己。

items.en: After the kids left home, we finally had some time for ourselves.
items.zh: 孩子們離家後，我們終於有一些自己的時間。

items.en: We need to take better care of ourselves.
items.zh: 我們得更好好照顧自己。

items.en: We were angry with ourselves for missing the last train.
items.zh: 我們氣自己錯過了末班車。

items.en: Let's not talk about ourselves all evening.
items.zh: 我們別整個晚上都在聊自己的事。

items.en: We bought the concert tickets for ourselves, not as a gift.
items.zh: 演唱會的票是我們買給自己的，不是要送人的。

items.en: We have to believe in ourselves if we want to win.
items.zh: 想贏的話，我們得相信自己。

items.en: After the team lost again, we felt a bit sorry for ourselves.
items.zh: 球隊又輸了之後，我們都覺得自己有點可憐。

items.en: We were really pleased with ourselves when the cake came out perfectly.
items.zh: 蛋糕烤得很完美，我們對自己很滿意。

examples.heading: ② yourselves

items.en: You should all be proud of yourselves.
items.zh: 你們都應該為自己感到驕傲。

items.en: Tell me a little about yourselves.
items.zh: 跟我說說你們自己的事。

items.en: Keep some of the cake for yourselves.
items.zh: 留一些蛋糕給你們自己吃。

items.en: Don't be so hard on yourselves. It was your first match.
items.zh: 別對自己太嚴格，這是你們的第一場比賽。

items.en: Did you girls make these costumes for yourselves?
items.zh: 這些服裝是你們這些女孩幫自己做的嗎？

items.en: You two only ever think of yourselves.
items.zh: 你們兩個永遠只想到自己。

items.en: Be honest with yourselves about how much you can afford.
items.zh: 你們要對自己誠實，想清楚負擔得起多少。

items.en: Write a short paragraph about yourselves for the school website.
items.zh: 為學校網站寫一小段介紹你們自己的文字。

items.en: Can you two find yourselves in this old class photo?
items.zh: 你們兩個在這張舊的班級合照裡找得到自己嗎？

items.en: Save some energy for yourselves. The second half of the hike is steep.
items.zh: 你們留點體力給自己，健行的後半段很陡。

examples.heading: ③ themselves

items.en: Nurses on night shifts rarely have time for themselves.
items.zh: 值夜班的護理師很少有自己的時間。

items.en: The children were very pleased with themselves after the show.
items.zh: 表演結束後，孩子們對自己很滿意。

items.en: The players were annoyed with themselves for missing so many chances.
items.zh: 球員們氣自己錯失了那麼多機會。

items.en: They built the cabin for themselves, not to rent out.
items.zh: 他們蓋這間小屋是要給自己住的，不是要出租。

items.en: Some people only care about themselves.
items.zh: 有些人只在乎自己。

items.en: My grandparents still take care of themselves.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶還是自己照顧自己。

items.en: The students talked about themselves in the first lesson.
items.zh: 第一堂課，學生們談了談自己。

items.en: The new parents had no time to think about themselves.
items.zh: 那對新手爸媽根本沒時間想到自己。

items.en: The kids made a tent for themselves in the living room.
items.zh: 孩子們在客廳幫自己搭了個帳篷。

items.en: The hikers carried enough water for themselves and the dog.
items.zh: 登山客帶了足夠自己和狗喝的水。

items.en: My neighbors mostly keep to themselves.
items.zh: 我的鄰居大多不太跟人往來。

title: I love blue, so I bought the blue one.
translation: 我很愛藍色，所以我買了藍色那一個。
name: 限定詞和形容詞加 one
sentences: My watch stopped working, so I bought a new one.
This chair is too hard. Have you got a softer one?
My laptop is very slow. I need a faster one.
We don't need an expensive camera. A cheap one is fine.
The old fridge was too small, so we got a bigger one.
There are two jackets. I like the red one.
Which cake do you want? The chocolate one?
I prefer the second plan to the first one.
I tried both hats and bought the cheaper one.
The first song was good, but the last one was even better.
We looked at three flats and took the cheapest one.
I lost my old phone, so I'm using my new one.
She sold her small car and bought a bigger one.
Can I borrow your black pen? My blue one has run out.
Our new teacher is nice, but I miss our old one.
He forgot his big umbrella and took his little one.
This key doesn't open the door. Try the other one.
One shoe is under the bed. Where's the other one?
I don't like this restaurant. Let's go to the other one.
This printer is broken, but the other one works.
I've read the first book. Can I borrow the other one?
I've got lots of T-shirts, but this is my favourite one.
Which film did you like? My favourite one was the funny one.
She has three cats, and the grey one is her favourite.
I've been to many beaches, but my favourite one is near my home.
Of all his songs, his first one is still my favourite.
Do you want this round one or that square one?
That wooden one by the door was my grandfather's.
Whose is this purple one with the stars on it?
Can I see that silver one, please?
This little one is perfect for travelling.

examples.heading: ① a / an + 修飾語 + one

items.en: My watch stopped working, so I bought a new one.
items.zh: 我的手錶不走了，所以我買了一支新的。

items.en: This chair is too hard. Have you got a softer one?
items.zh: 這張椅子太硬了，有軟一點的嗎？

items.en: My laptop is very slow. I need a faster one.
items.zh: 我的筆電很慢，我需要快一點的。

items.en: We don't need an expensive camera. A cheap one is fine.
items.zh: 我們不需要很貴的相機，便宜的就可以了。

items.en: The old fridge was too small, so we got a bigger one.
items.zh: 舊冰箱太小了，所以我們換了一台大一點的。

examples.heading: ② the + 修飾語 + one

items.en: There are two jackets. I like the red one.
items.zh: 有兩件外套，我喜歡紅色那件。

items.en: Which cake do you want? The chocolate one?
items.zh: 你要哪一個蛋糕？巧克力那個嗎？

items.en: I prefer the second plan to the first one.
items.zh: 比起第一個方案，我比較喜歡第二個。

items.en: I tried both hats and bought the cheaper one.
items.zh: 兩頂帽子我都試戴了，買了比較便宜的那頂。

items.en: The first song was good, but the last one was even better.
items.zh: 第一首歌不錯，最後一首更好聽。

items.en: We looked at three flats and took the cheapest one.
items.zh: 我們看了三間公寓，租了最便宜的那間。

examples.heading: ③ 所有格 + 修飾語 + one

items.en: I lost my old phone, so I'm using my new one.
items.zh: 我的舊手機弄丟了，所以我在用新的。

items.en: She sold her small car and bought a bigger one.
items.zh: 她把小車賣了，買了一台大一點的。

items.en: Can I borrow your black pen? My blue one has run out.
items.zh: 我可以借你的黑筆嗎？我的藍筆沒水了。

items.en: Our new teacher is nice, but I miss our old one.
items.zh: 我們的新老師人很好，可是我想念以前那位。

items.en: He forgot his big umbrella and took his little one.
items.zh: 他忘了帶大傘，帶了那把小的。

examples.heading: ④ the other one

items.en: This key doesn't open the door. Try the other one.
items.zh: 這把鑰匙開不了門，試試另一把。

items.en: One shoe is under the bed. Where's the other one?
items.zh: 一隻鞋在床底下，另一隻呢？

items.en: I don't like this restaurant. Let's go to the other one.
items.zh: 我不喜歡這家餐廳，我們去另一家吧。

items.en: This printer is broken, but the other one works.
items.zh: 這台印表機壞了，可是另一台可以用。

items.en: I've read the first book. Can I borrow the other one?
items.zh: 第一本我讀完了，可以借我另一本嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ favourite one

items.en: I've got lots of T-shirts, but this is my favourite one.
items.zh: 我有很多 T 恤，這件是我最喜歡的。

items.en: Which film did you like? My favourite one was the funny one.
items.zh: 你喜歡哪一部電影？我最喜歡那部好笑的。

items.en: She has three cats, and the grey one is her favourite.
items.zh: 她有三隻貓，灰色那隻是她最愛的。

items.en: I've been to many beaches, but my favourite one is near my home.
items.zh: 我去過很多海灘，我最喜歡的是家附近那一個。

items.en: Of all his songs, his first one is still my favourite.
items.zh: 他所有的歌裡，我最喜歡的還是第一首。

examples.heading: ⑥ this / that + 修飾語 + one

items.en: Do you want this round one or that square one?
items.zh: 你要這個圓的還是那個方的？

items.en: That wooden one by the door was my grandfather's.
items.zh: 門邊那張木頭的是我爺爺的。

items.en: Whose is this purple one with the stars on it?
items.zh: 這個上面有星星的紫色的是誰的？

items.en: Can I see that silver one, please?
items.zh: 可以給我看看那個銀色的嗎？

items.en: This little one is perfect for travelling.
items.zh: 這個小的很適合旅行帶。

title: I've bought five new T-shirts because I don't like my old ones anymore.

I don't like horror films. I prefer the funny ones.

examples.heading: ① 衣服和東西

items.zh: 我的鞋子快壞了，我要買新的。

items.zh: 我把舊外套送人了，留下保暖的那幾件。

items.zh: 這雙手套太小了，有大一點的嗎？

items.en: She lost her blue earrings, so she's wearing her gold ones today.
items.zh: 她的藍色耳環弄丟了，所以今天戴金色的。

items.zh: 這條褲子還可以，可是我比較喜歡我那條黑的。

examples.heading: ② 吃的東西

items.zh: 這些蘋果很酸，有甜一點的嗎？

items.zh: 我吃了綠葡萄，紅的留給你。

items.zh: 家裡沒蛋了，所以我買了十二顆新鮮的。

items.zh: 我們的番茄很小，可是鄰居家的大番茄比較好吃。

items.en: Those cookies are burnt. Try these soft ones.
items.zh: 那些餅乾烤焦了，吃這些軟的吧。

examples.heading: ③ 在家裡

items.en: Our curtains are too thin. We need some thicker ones.
items.zh: 我們的窗簾太薄了，要換厚一點的。

items.en: The kids broke two glasses, so I put out the plastic ones.
items.zh: 孩子打破了兩個玻璃杯，所以我拿出塑膠杯。

items.en: The old windows let the cold in, so we put in some double-glazed ones.
items.zh: 舊窗戶會透風，所以我們裝了雙層玻璃窗。

items.zh: 籃子裡的毛巾不要用，用架子上那些乾淨的。

examples.heading: ④ 學校和工作

items.en: The new laptops are fast, but the old ones keep crashing.
items.zh: 新的筆電很快，可是舊的一直當機。

items.en: I've read his early books, but not his recent ones.
items.zh: 他早期的書我讀過，最近的還沒讀。

items.zh: 我們先做簡單的題目，難的留到最後。

items.zh: 你有多的筆嗎？我只帶了紅筆。

items.en: We need more workers. Let's hire two experienced ones this month.
items.zh: 我們人手不夠，這個月請兩個有經驗的吧。

examples.heading: ⑤ 電視、電影和音樂

items.en: I love old films, and there are some good ones on TV tonight.
items.zh: 我很愛看老電影，今晚電視上有幾部好看的。

items.en: I don't like horror films. I prefer the funny ones.
items.zh: 我不喜歡恐怖片，我比較喜歡好笑的。

items.en: Have you heard their new songs? I only know their early ones.
items.zh: 你聽過他們的新歌嗎？我只知道他們早期的歌。

items.en: Most cartoons are for kids, but these Japanese ones are for adults too.
items.zh: 大部分的卡通是給小孩看的，可是這些日本卡通大人也能看。

items.en: I downloaded three new podcasts and two old ones.
items.zh: 我下載了三集新的 podcast 和兩集舊的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 比較和選擇

items.en: Do you want the large boxes or the small ones?
items.zh: 你要大箱子還是小的？

items.zh: 我們以前的手機比現在的重。

items.en: Those red roses are lovely, but your white ones are even nicer.
items.zh: 那些紅玫瑰很漂亮，可是你那些白的更好看。

items.zh: 我哥哥的畫很鮮豔，可是我姊姊那些暗色的賣得比較好。

items.en: These rooms are small, but those corner ones have a view of the sea.
items.zh: 這些房間很小，可是轉角那幾間看得到海。

title: How we eat is influenced by several factors, some of which have nothing to do with our nationality.
translation: 我們怎麼吃受到好幾個因素影響，其中有些跟我們的國籍一點關係也沒有。
name: some of、many of 加關係代名詞
sentences: The shop sells old records, some of which are quite rare.
I took lots of photos, some of which I've put online.
The class has thirty students, some of whom are from abroad.
We received many letters, some of which were very kind.
He gave me several pieces of advice, some of which I still follow.
The city has dozens of parks, many of which have lakes.
The festival attracts thousands of visitors, many of whom come every year.
She has written over fifty songs, many of which are about her childhood.

items.en: I have to believe in myself a bit more.
items.zh: 我得更相信自己一點。

items.en: I made a promise to myself to read more this year.
items.zh: 我答應過自己今年要多讀點書。

examples.heading: ② yourself

items.en: Take care of yourself while you're travelling.
items.zh: 旅行的時候要照顧好自己。

items.en: Tell me something about yourself.
items.zh: 跟我說說你自己的事。

items.en: You should feel proud of yourself after all that hard work.
items.zh: 那麼努力之後，你應該為自己感到驕傲。

items.en: Stop being so hard on yourself; everyone makes mistakes.
items.zh: 別再對自己那麼嚴格了，每個人都會犯錯。

items.en: Remember to save some of your salary for yourself, too.
items.zh: 記得也要把一部分薪水留給你自己。

items.en: Be honest with yourself: do you really want this job?
items.zh: 對自己誠實一點：你真的想要這份工作嗎？

items.en: You only ever think about yourself!
items.zh: 你永遠只想到你自己！

items.en: Keep this information to yourself, please.
items.zh: 這個消息請你不要告訴別人。

examples.heading: ③ himself

items.en: He told me about himself and his family over lunch.
items.zh: 吃午餐時，他跟我聊他自己和他家人的事。

items.en: My son is very pleased with himself today.
items.zh: 我兒子今天對自己很滿意。

items.en: He made a cup of tea for himself and sat down.
items.zh: 他幫自己泡了杯茶，然後坐下來。

items.en: Tom felt sorry for himself after the breakup.
items.zh: 分手後，Tom 覺得自己很可憐。

items.en: He never spends money on himself.
items.zh: 他從來不花錢在自己身上。

items.en: My grandfather can still look after himself.
items.zh: 我爺爺還能照顧自己。

items.en: He wrote a note to himself so he wouldn't forget.
items.zh: 他寫了張紙條給自己，免得忘記。

items.en: The new manager talked about himself for the whole meeting.
items.zh: 新經理整場會議都在談他自己。

examples.heading: ④ herself

items.en: She was very proud of herself after the race.
items.zh: 比賽後，她很為自己感到驕傲。

items.en: My sister bought a new laptop for herself.
items.zh: 我姊姊幫自己買了一台新筆電。

items.en: She looked at herself in the mirror and smiled.
items.zh: 她看著鏡子裡的自己笑了。

items.en: Lisa doesn't like talking about herself.
items.zh: Lisa 不喜歡談自己的事。

items.en: My mum never has any time for herself.
items.zh: 我媽從來沒有自己的時間。

items.en: She was annoyed with herself for being late again.
items.zh: 她氣自己又遲到了。

items.en: Anna is learning to stand up for herself at work.
items.zh: Anna 正在學著在職場上為自己發聲。

items.en: Grandma knitted a warm scarf for herself.
items.zh: 奶奶幫自己織了一條溫暖的圍巾。

items.zh: 沒有人記得她的生日。

items.zh: 沒有人知道密碼。

items.zh: 一整天都沒有人打電話來。

items.en: Nobody wants to work on Saturday.
items.zh: 沒有人想星期六上班。

items.en: Nobody has seen her since Monday.
items.zh: 從星期一以後就沒有人看過她。

items.zh: 有人把一個包包忘在火車上。

items.zh: 有人把最後一塊餅乾拿走了。

items.zh: 隔壁房間有人在唱歌。

items.en: Somebody needs to clean the kitchen.
items.zh: 得有人來打掃廚房。

examples.heading: ① everyone / everybody

items.en: Everyone wants a bigger flat these days.
items.zh: 現在每個人都想住大一點的公寓。

items.en: Everybody was asleep when I got home.
items.zh: 我回到家的時候大家都睡了。

items.en: Everyone in the team has a laptop.
items.zh: 隊上每個人都有一台筆電。

items.en: Everybody loves a long weekend.
items.zh: 連假誰都喜歡。

items.en: Everyone at the wedding was dancing.
items.zh: 婚禮上每個人都在跳舞。

examples.heading: ② someone / somebody / anyone / anybody

items.en: Someone wants to speak to the manager.
items.zh: 有人要找經理。

items.en: Somebody has left the lights on.
items.zh: 有人沒關燈。

items.en: Does anyone have a spare pen?
items.zh: 有人有多的筆嗎？

items.zh: 六點以後誰都可以用健身房。

items.en: Someone from the bank called this morning.
items.zh: 今天早上銀行有人打電話來。

examples.heading: ③ no one / nobody

items.en: No one knows where he lives.
items.zh: 沒有人知道他住哪裡。

items.en: Nobody answers the phone at lunchtime.
items.zh: 午餐時間沒有人接電話。

items.en: No one has ever seen him angry.
items.zh: 從來沒有人看過他生氣。

items.en: Nobody likes waiting in the rain.
items.zh: 沒有人喜歡在雨中等。

items.en: No one in my family plays the piano.
items.zh: 我家沒有人會彈鋼琴。

examples.heading: ④ everything / something / anything

items.en: Everything is more expensive than last year.
items.zh: 每樣東西都比去年貴。

items.en: Something is wrong with my phone.
items.zh: 我的手機出了點問題。

items.en: Everything was ready before the guests arrived.
items.zh: 客人到之前一切都準備好了。

items.en: Is anything missing from your bag?
items.zh: 你的包包有少什麼東西嗎？

items.en: Something has to change.
items.zh: 一定得有所改變。

items.en: Anything is better than staying at home all day.
items.zh: 做什麼都比整天待在家好。

examples.heading: ⑤ nothing

items.en: Nothing is open on Christmas Day.
items.zh: 聖誕節當天什麼店都沒開。

items.en: Nothing has changed since I left.
items.zh: 我離開以後什麼都沒變。
