items.zh: 錢的事一句都沒提。（被動）

items.en: Nothing tastes better than fresh bread.
items.zh: 沒有什麼比剛出爐的麵包更好吃。

items.en: Nothing in the fridge looks fresh.
items.zh: 冰箱裡的東西看起來都不新鮮了。

examples.heading: ⑥ everywhere / somewhere / anywhere / nowhere

items.en: Everywhere was quiet after midnight.
items.zh: 過了半夜到處都很安靜。

items.en: Somewhere warm sounds perfect for our holiday.
items.zh: 找個溫暖的地方度假，聽起來很棒。

items.en: Somewhere quiet would be better for the meeting.
items.zh: 開會找個安靜的地方比較好。

items.en: Anywhere is fine for dinner.
items.zh: 晚餐在哪裡吃都可以。

items.en: Nowhere in the town is open after ten.
items.zh: 十點以後鎮上沒有一個地方開著。

title: Both are very good films.
translation: 這兩部電影都很好看。
name: both、a few、another 當代名詞
sentences: I've got two cousins in Spain. Both speak English.
Swimming and cycling are great exercise. Both keep you fit.
We looked at two houses, and both had big gardens.
My parents are retired. Both enjoy gardening.
I tried the two pizzas, and both were delicious.
Tea or coffee? I'll have both, please.
I couldn't choose between the shirts, so I bought both.
She has two dogs and walks both every morning.
The beach or the mountains? I love both.
He invited his two best friends, and I know both.
Many people came to the meeting, but only a few asked questions.
Most of the shops were closed, but a few were still open.
I wrote to several companies, and a few replied.
Lots of students live far away, but a few walk to school.
The apples were mostly bad, but a few were fine.
Would you like some grapes? Just a few, thanks.
I didn't take many photos, just a few.
There are lots of books on the list. I'm happy to select a few.
We need more chairs. Can you bring a few?
I know most of the songs, but I've forgotten a few.
That cake was lovely. Can I have another?
I've lost my umbrella, so I need to buy another.
One student finished early, and then another did.
This pen doesn't work. Have you got another?
Moving from one area to another is not easy.
You asked about the two films. Both are worth seeing.
I've got lots of magazines. Take a few if you like.
The first bus was full, so we waited for another.
There are many TV programmes in my country, but only a few are any good.
I've read two of her books, and I enjoyed both.
One problem was solved, but then another appeared.

examples.heading: ① Both 當主詞

items.en: I've got two cousins in Spain. Both speak English.
items.zh: 我在西班牙有兩個表哥，兩個都會說英文。

items.en: Swimming and cycling are great exercise. Both keep you fit.
items.zh: 游泳和騎腳踏車都是很好的運動，兩個都能讓你保持健康。

items.en: We looked at two houses, and both had big gardens.
items.zh: 我們看了兩間房子，兩間都有大花園。

items.en: My parents are retired. Both enjoy gardening.
items.zh: 我爸媽都退休了，兩個都喜歡園藝。

items.en: I tried the two pizzas, and both were delicious.
items.zh: 我吃了那兩種披薩，兩種都很好吃。

examples.heading: ② Both 當受詞

items.en: Tea or coffee? I'll have both, please.
items.zh: 茶還是咖啡？兩個我都要，謝謝。

items.en: I couldn't choose between the shirts, so I bought both.
items.zh: 我挑不出要哪一件襯衫，所以兩件都買了。

items.en: She has two dogs and walks both every morning.
items.zh: 她養了兩隻狗，每天早上帶兩隻去散步。

items.en: The beach or the mountains? I love both.
items.zh: 海邊還是山上？兩個我都喜歡。

items.en: He invited his two best friends, and I know both.
items.zh: 他邀了兩個最好的朋友，兩個我都認識。

examples.heading: ③ A few 當主詞

items.en: Many people came to the meeting, but only a few asked questions.
items.zh: 很多人來開會，可是只有幾個人提問。

items.en: Most of the shops were closed, but a few were still open.
items.zh: 大部分的店都關了，可是還有幾家開著。

items.en: I wrote to several companies, and a few replied.
items.zh: 我寫信給好幾家公司，有幾家回覆了。

items.en: Lots of students live far away, but a few walk to school.
items.zh: 很多學生住得很遠，可是有幾個走路上學。

items.en: The apples were mostly bad, but a few were fine.
items.zh: 蘋果大部分都壞了，可是有幾顆還好。

examples.heading: ④ A few 當受詞

items.en: Would you like some grapes? Just a few, thanks.
items.zh: 要吃葡萄嗎？只要幾顆就好，謝謝。

items.en: I didn't take many photos, just a few.
items.zh: 我沒拍很多照片，只拍了幾張。

items.en: There are lots of books on the list. I'm happy to select a few.
items.zh: 清單上的書很多，我很樂意挑幾本。

items.en: We need more chairs. Can you bring a few?
items.zh: 我們需要更多椅子，你可以搬幾張過來嗎？

items.en: I know most of the songs, but I've forgotten a few.
items.zh: 大部分的歌我都會，可是有幾首忘了。

examples.heading: ⑤ another

items.en: That cake was lovely. Can I have another?
items.zh: 那塊蛋糕很好吃，可以再來一塊嗎？

items.en: I've lost my umbrella, so I need to buy another.
items.zh: 我的雨傘弄丟了，所以要再買一把。

items.en: One student finished early, and then another did.
items.zh: 一個學生先寫完，接著又一個寫完了。

items.en: This pen doesn't work. Have you got another?
items.zh: 這支筆寫不出來，你還有別支嗎？

items.en: Moving from one area to another is not easy.
items.zh: 從一個地區搬到另一個地區並不容易。

examples.heading: ⑥ 在對話和信裡

items.en: You asked about the two films. Both are worth seeing.
items.zh: 你問到那兩部電影，兩部都值得看。

items.en: I've got lots of magazines. Take a few if you like.
items.zh: 我有很多雜誌，你想要就拿幾本。

items.en: The first bus was full, so we waited for another.
items.zh: 第一班公車客滿了，所以我們等下一班。

items.en: There are many TV programmes in my country, but only a few are any good.
items.zh: 我們國家的電視節目很多，可是好看的沒幾個。

items.en: I've read two of her books, and I enjoyed both.
items.zh: 她的書我讀過兩本，兩本都很喜歡。

items.en: One problem was solved, but then another appeared.
items.zh: 一個問題解決了，接著又出現另一個。

title: Both firms go some way toward fulfilling our needs, but neither covers all of them.
translation: 這兩家公司都能滿足我們部分的需求，但沒有一家能全部滿足。
name: each、several 等數量代名詞當主詞或受詞
sentences: The teacher gave the students a book, and each took it home.
There are four bedrooms, and each has a view of the sea.
My parents both work, and each has a long journey to the office.
I spoke to the players, and each told me the same story.
We tried three cakes, and each was delicious.
There are two roads to the village. You can take either.
I have a red pen and a blue pen. Do you want either?
Monday or Tuesday? Either suits me.
I've seen both films, but I didn't like either.
The two hotels are near the beach, so either would be fine.
I asked two people for directions, but neither knew the way.
We looked at two flats, and neither was suitable.
There were two answers, but neither was correct.
He wrote to two companies, and neither replied.
The two plans have good points, but neither solves the problem.
I've read lots of his novels. Several are really good.
We made some mistakes, and several were serious.
If you need a pen, I have several.
Many people applied, and several got the job.
Will there be one class or several?
Don't buy more milk. We have enough.
I made cupcakes. There are enough for everyone, so take one.
I've had enough, thank you.
We need volunteers, but not enough have come forward.
The pizza looks great. Is there enough for all of us?
We visited both hotels, and each offered a good price.
I compared the two courses, and neither meets our needs.
I read many books on this subject. There are several that I would like to recommend.
The toilets are clean, and there are enough, so you don't have to wait.
Both offers are good, and either would suit the company.
The applicants all have experience, but several lack the right skills.

examples.heading: ① each

items.en: The teacher gave the students a book, and each took it home.
items.zh: 老師發給學生一本書，每個人都帶回家了。

items.en: There are four bedrooms, and each has a view of the sea.
items.zh: 有四間臥室，每一間都看得到海。

items.en: My parents both work, and each has a long journey to the office.
items.zh: 我爸媽都有工作，兩個人上班的路都很遠。

items.en: I spoke to the players, and each told me the same story.
items.zh: 我跟球員談過，每個人跟我說的都一樣。

items.en: We tried three cakes, and each was delicious.
items.zh: 我們吃了三種蛋糕，每一種都很好吃。

examples.heading: ② either

items.en: There are two roads to the village. You can take either.
items.zh: 去村子有兩條路，你走哪一條都可以。

items.en: I have a red pen and a blue pen. Do you want either?
items.zh: 我有一支紅筆和一支藍筆，你要哪一支嗎？

items.en: Monday or Tuesday? Either suits me.
items.zh: 星期一還是星期二？哪一天我都可以。

items.en: I've seen both films, but I didn't like either.
items.zh: 兩部電影我都看過，可是兩部都不喜歡。

items.en: The two hotels are near the beach, so either would be fine.
items.zh: 兩家飯店都在海灘附近，所以哪一家都可以。

examples.heading: ③ neither

items.en: I asked two people for directions, but neither knew the way.
items.zh: 我問了兩個人怎麼走，可是兩個都不知道。

items.en: We looked at two flats, and neither was suitable.
items.zh: 我們看了兩間公寓，兩間都不合適。

items.en: There were two answers, but neither was correct.
items.zh: 有兩個答案，可是兩個都不對。

items.en: He wrote to two companies, and neither replied.
items.zh: 他寫信給兩家公司，兩家都沒回覆。

items.en: The two plans have good points, but neither solves the problem.
items.zh: 兩個方案都有優點，可是兩個都解決不了問題。

examples.heading: ④ several

items.en: I've read lots of his novels. Several are really good.
items.zh: 他的小說我讀了很多，有好幾本非常好看。

items.en: We made some mistakes, and several were serious.
items.zh: 我們犯了一些錯，其中好幾個很嚴重。

items.en: If you need a pen, I have several.
items.zh: 你需要筆的話，我有好幾支。

items.en: Many people applied, and several got the job.
items.zh: 很多人應徵，有好幾個人錄取了。

items.en: Will there be one class or several?
items.zh: 會開一個班還是好幾個班？

examples.heading: ⑤ enough

items.en: Don't buy more milk. We have enough.
items.zh: 不要再買牛奶了，我們有夠多了。

items.en: I made cupcakes. There are enough for everyone, so take one.
items.zh: 我做了杯子蛋糕，每個人都有，拿一個吧。

items.en: I've had enough, thank you.
items.zh: 我吃飽了，謝謝。

items.en: We need volunteers, but not enough have come forward.
items.zh: 我們需要志工，可是報名的人不夠。

items.en: The pizza looks great. Is there enough for all of us?
items.zh: 披薩看起來很好吃，夠我們每個人吃嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 在報告和信裡

items.en: We visited both hotels, and each offered a good price.
items.zh: 我們去了兩家飯店，每一家的價錢都不錯。

items.en: I compared the two courses, and neither meets our needs.
items.zh: 我比較了兩個課程，兩個都不符合我們的需求。

items.en: I read many books on this subject. There are several that I would like to recommend.
items.zh: 這個主題的書我讀了很多，有好幾本我想推薦。

items.en: The toilets are clean, and there are enough, so you don't have to wait.
items.zh: 廁所很乾淨，數量也夠，所以不用排隊。

items.en: Both offers are good, and either would suit the company.
items.zh: 兩個方案都不錯，哪一個都適合公司。

items.en: The applicants all have experience, but several lack the right skills.
items.zh: 應徵的人都有經驗，可是有好幾個人缺少需要的技能。

title: It was my father who took all this away from me.
translation: 把這一切從我身邊奪走的，是我爸爸。
name: it 分裂句強調主詞
sentences: It was my mother who spotted the leak in the roof.
It was Jane who organised the whole event.
It is the manager who makes the final decision.
It was my uncle who taught me how to fish.
It was a young nurse who saved his life that night.
It was the smell of smoke that woke us.
It is the cost of housing that worries young people most.
It was a small mistake that caused the accident.
It's the weather that makes this region so popular with tourists.
It was the final chapter that made me cry.
It wasn't me who told her the secret.
It isn't the money that matters to her.
It wasn't the teachers who complained. It was the parents.
It wasn't the heat that bothered me, but the noise.
It isn't always the strongest team that wins.
Was it you who ate the last biscuit?
Who was it that told you about the party?
Was it the dog that made all this mess?
Is it your sister who works at the hospital?
What was it that changed your mind?
In the end, it was hard work, not luck, that got her the job.
It was his honesty that impressed the interviewers.
It is curiosity that drives most scientists.
It was a single phone call that changed everything.
It's the little things that make a house feel like home.
It was my grandfather who built this house with his own hands.
It was my older sister who looked after me when our parents were at work.
It was the war that forced the family to leave the village.
It was an old teacher of mine who persuaded me to become a writer.
It was my father who sold the farm, and I never forgave him.
It was that summer that taught me what loss really means.

examples.heading: ① 強調是哪個人

items.en: It was my mother who spotted the leak in the roof.
items.zh: 發現屋頂漏水的是我媽媽。

items.en: It was Jane who organised the whole event.
items.zh: 整場活動是珍籌劃的。

items.en: It is the manager who makes the final decision.
items.zh: 做最後決定的是經理。

items.en: It was my uncle who taught me how to fish.
items.zh: 教我釣魚的是我叔叔。

items.en: It was a young nurse who saved his life that night.
items.zh: 那天晚上救了他一命的是一位年輕護士。

examples.heading: ② 強調是哪個東西

items.en: It was the smell of smoke that woke us.
items.zh: 把我們弄醒的是煙味。

items.en: It is the cost of housing that worries young people most.
items.zh: 最讓年輕人擔心的是房價。

items.en: It was a small mistake that caused the accident.
items.zh: 造成這場意外的是一個小錯誤。

items.en: It's the weather that makes this region so popular with tourists.
items.zh: 讓這個地區那麼受遊客歡迎的是天氣。

items.en: It was the final chapter that made me cry.
items.zh: 讓我哭的是最後一章。

examples.heading: ③ 否定句

items.en: It wasn't me who told her the secret.
items.zh: 跟她說那個祕密的不是我。

items.en: It isn't the money that matters to her.
items.zh: 對她來說重要的不是錢。

items.en: It wasn't the teachers who complained. It was the parents.
items.zh: 抱怨的不是老師，是家長。

items.en: It wasn't the heat that bothered me, but the noise.
items.zh: 讓我心煩的不是熱，而是噪音。

items.en: It isn't always the strongest team that wins.
items.zh: 贏的不一定是最強的隊伍。

examples.heading: ④ 問句

items.en: Was it you who ate the last biscuit?
items.zh: 最後一塊餅乾是你吃掉的嗎？

items.en: Who was it that told you about the party?
items.zh: 是誰跟你說派對的事的？

items.en: Was it the dog that made all this mess?
items.zh: 這一團亂是狗弄的嗎？

items.en: Is it your sister who works at the hospital?
items.zh: 在醫院工作的是你姊姊嗎？

items.en: What was it that changed your mind?
items.zh: 是什麼讓你改變主意的？

examples.heading: ⑤ 指出真正的原因

items.en: In the end, it was hard work, not luck, that got her the job.
items.zh: 最後讓她得到工作的是努力，不是運氣。

items.en: It was his honesty that impressed the interviewers.
items.zh: 讓面試官印象深刻的是他的誠實。

items.en: It is curiosity that drives most scientists.
items.zh: 推動大多數科學家的是好奇心。

items.en: It was a single phone call that changed everything.
items.zh: 改變一切的是一通電話。

items.en: It's the little things that make a house feel like home.
items.zh: 讓房子有家的感覺的，是那些小東西。

examples.heading: ⑥ 回憶和故事

items.en: It was my grandfather who built this house with his own hands.
items.zh: 親手蓋了這棟房子的是我爺爺。

items.en: It was my older sister who looked after me when our parents were at work.
items.zh: 爸媽去上班的時候，照顧我的是我姊姊。

items.en: It was the war that forced the family to leave the village.
items.zh: 逼得這一家人離開村子的是戰爭。

items.en: It was an old teacher of mine who persuaded me to become a writer.
items.zh: 說服我當作家的，是我以前的一位老師。

items.en: It was my father who sold the farm, and I never forgave him.
items.zh: 賣掉農場的是我爸爸，我從來沒有原諒他。

items.en: It was that summer that taught me what loss really means.
items.zh: 讓我明白失去真正意思的，是那年夏天。

title: Can't wait to hear about your exam.
translation: 等不及想聽你說考試的事了。
name: 省略主詞代名詞（非正式）
sentences: Good luck on Monday! Can't wait to hear about your exam.
Must rush now because I have to go out with Paul.
Got to go now. Write back soon!
Can't wait to see you next month.
Must stop now. The bus is here.
Don't know what to wear to the party. Any ideas?
Haven't seen you for ages! How are you?
Just got your letter. Thanks so much!
Miss you lots. Come and visit soon.
"I've booked a table at the new Italian place." "Sounds great."
Got your postcard from Spain. Looks like a beautiful place!
Thanks for the photos. Looks like you had a great time.
"He didn't call me back." "Seems strange. He usually does."
Just left the house. See you at six.
Forgot my keys. Can you let me in?
Can't talk now. Call you later.
"Where's Mum?" "Don't know. Maybe in the garden."
"Is the new film any good?" "Don't know. Haven't seen it yet."
"How's the soup?" "Tastes amazing!"

examples.heading: ① 省略 I：信的結尾

items.en: Good luck on Monday! Can't wait to hear about your exam.
items.zh: 星期一加油！等不及想聽你說考試的事了。

items.en: Must rush now because I have to go out with Paul.
items.zh: 我得趕快走了，因為我要跟 Paul 出去。

items.en: Got to go now. Write back soon!
items.zh: 我得走了。快回信！

items.en: Can't wait to see you next month.
items.zh: 等不及下個月見到你了。

items.en: Must stop now. The bus is here.
items.zh: 先寫到這裡。公車來了。

examples.heading: ② 省略 I：說自己的情況

items.en: Don't know what to wear to the party. Any ideas?
items.zh: 不知道派對要穿什麼。有什麼建議嗎？

items.en: Haven't seen you for ages! How are you?
items.zh: 好久沒見到你了！你好嗎？

items.en: Just got your letter. Thanks so much!
items.zh: 剛收到你的信。非常感謝！

items.en: Miss you lots. Come and visit soon.
items.zh: 好想你。快來看我。

examples.heading: ③ 省略 it：評論

items.en: "I've booked a table at the new Italian place." "Sounds great."
items.zh: 我在那家新的義大利餐廳訂了位。聽起來很棒。

items.en: Got your postcard from Spain. Looks like a beautiful place!
items.zh: 收到你從西班牙寄來的明信片了。看起來是個很美的地方！

items.en: Thanks for the photos. Looks like you had a great time.
items.zh: 謝謝你的照片。看起來你玩得很開心。

items.en: "He didn't call me back." "Seems strange. He usually does."
items.zh: 他沒回我電話。好奇怪。他平常都會回。

examples.heading: ④ 簡訊

items.en: Just left the house. See you at six.
items.zh: 剛出門。六點見。

items.en: Forgot my keys. Can you let me in?
items.zh: 忘了帶鑰匙。你可以幫我開門嗎？

items.en: Can't talk now. Call you later.
items.zh: 現在不方便講話。等一下打給你。

examples.heading: ⑤ 對話

items.en: "Where's Mum?" "Don't know. Maybe in the garden."
items.zh: 媽呢？不知道。可能在花園。

items.en: "Is the new film any good?" "Don't know. Haven't seen it yet."
items.zh: 那部新電影好看嗎？不知道。還沒看。

items.en: "How's the soup?" "Tastes amazing!"
items.zh: 湯怎麼樣？好好喝！

title: Hope to see you soon.
translation: 希望很快能見到你。
name: hope 前面省略主詞
sentences: I'd love to visit you in the summer. Hope to see you soon.
Write back when you can. Hope to hear from you soon.
Thanks for a lovely weekend. Hope to come again next year.
Hope to meet your new boyfriend at the party!
Hi! How are you? Hope you are fine.
Dear Gran, hope you're feeling better today.
Hi Tom, hope you had a good holiday.
Hello everyone, hope you're all well.
Good luck with the exam tomorrow. Hope it goes well!
Have a great trip. Hope the weather is good.
Happy birthday! Hope you have a wonderful day.
Get well soon. Hope you're back at school next week.
Running late, sorry! Hope you haven't been waiting long.
Congratulations on the new job! Hope you enjoy it.
Thanks for the present. Hope to thank you in person soon.
"See you on Friday?" "Hope so!"
"Is the shop still open?" "Hope so. Let's go and see."
"Will it rain tomorrow?" "Hope not. We're having a picnic."

examples.heading: ① Hope to + 原形動詞

items.en: I'd love to visit you in the summer. Hope to see you soon.
items.zh: 我暑假很想去看你。希望很快能見到你。

items.en: Write back when you can. Hope to hear from you soon.
items.zh: 有空就回信。希望很快收到你的回信。

items.en: Thanks for a lovely weekend. Hope to come again next year.
items.zh: 謝謝你讓我度過一個很棒的週末。希望明年能再來。

items.en: Hope to meet your new boyfriend at the party!
items.zh: 希望在派對上見到你的新男朋友！

examples.heading: ② Hope + 子句：開頭問候

items.en: Hi! How are you? Hope you are fine.
items.zh: 嗨！你好嗎？希望你一切都好。

items.en: Dear Gran, hope you're feeling better today.
items.zh: 親愛的奶奶，希望您今天好一點了。

items.en: Hi Tom, hope you had a good holiday.
items.zh: 嗨，Tom，希望你假期過得愉快。

items.en: Hello everyone, hope you're all well.
items.zh: 大家好，希望大家都好。

examples.heading: ③ Hope + 子句：結尾祝福

items.en: Good luck with the exam tomorrow. Hope it goes well!
items.zh: 明天考試加油。希望一切順利！

items.en: Have a great trip. Hope the weather is good.
items.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。希望天氣很好。

items.en: Happy birthday! Hope you have a wonderful day.
items.zh: 生日快樂！希望你今天過得很開心。

items.en: Get well soon. Hope you're back at school next week.
items.zh: 早日康復。希望你下星期能回學校。

examples.heading: ④ 簡訊和卡片

items.en: Running late, sorry! Hope you haven't been waiting long.
items.zh: 我會晚到，抱歉！希望你沒等太久。

items.en: Congratulations on the new job! Hope you enjoy it.
items.zh: 恭喜你找到新工作！希望你做得開心。

items.en: Thanks for the present. Hope to thank you in person soon.
items.zh: 謝謝你的禮物。希望很快能當面謝謝你。

examples.heading: ⑤ 口語

items.en: "See you on Friday?" "Hope so!"
items.zh: 星期五見？希望可以！

items.en: "Is the shop still open?" "Hope so. Let's go and see."
items.zh: 那家店還開著嗎？希望還開著。我們去看看。

items.en: "Will it rain tomorrow?" "Hope not. We're having a picnic."
items.zh: 明天會下雨嗎？希望不要。我們要去野餐。

title: It's warm and windy.
translation: 天氣很暖和，風也很大。
name: 虛主詞 it（天氣和時間）
sentences: We're having a great time at the beach. It's warm and windy.
Take your coat. It's very cold outside.
It was sunny all week, so we went swimming every day.
It's snowing! Let's build a snowman.
It will be hot tomorrow, so drink lots of water.
I'm waiting for you at the station. Now it's 3 pm.
It's late. I'm going to bed.
What time is it? Is it six o'clock yet?
The party was great, but it was two in the morning before I got to bed.
It's our wedding anniversary next week. Let's book a table somewhere nice.
It's Friday today. I love Fridays!
It was Christmas, so all the shops were closed.
It's about ten minutes to the station from here.
It's a long way to my grandmother's house.
Is it far to the city centre?
Hi Anna! It's lovely here. It's sunny every day.
It rained a lot last week, but it's dry now.
It's eight o'clock in the evening, and I'm writing this on the balcony.
"What's the weather like?" "It's cloudy, but it isn't cold."
"What day is it today?" "It's Tuesday."
"Is it raining?" "No, it's stopped."

examples.heading: ① 天氣

items.en: We're having a great time at the beach. It's warm and windy.
items.zh: 我們在海邊玩得很開心。天氣很暖和，風也很大。

items.en: Take your coat. It's very cold outside.
items.zh: 帶外套。外面很冷。

items.en: It was sunny all week, so we went swimming every day.
items.zh: 整個星期都是晴天，所以我們每天都去游泳。

items.en: It's snowing! Let's build a snowman.
items.zh: 下雪了！我們來堆雪人吧。

items.en: It will be hot tomorrow, so drink lots of water.
items.zh: 明天會很熱，所以要多喝水。

examples.heading: ② 時間

items.en: I'm waiting for you at the station. Now it's 3 pm.
items.zh: 我在車站等你。現在三點了。

items.en: It's late. I'm going to bed.
items.zh: 很晚了。我要去睡了。

items.en: What time is it? Is it six o'clock yet?
items.zh: 現在幾點？六點了嗎？

items.en: The party was great, but it was two in the morning before I got to bed.
items.zh: 派對很棒，可是我上床的時候已經凌晨兩點了。

examples.heading: ③ 日期和日子

items.en: It's our wedding anniversary next week. Let's book a table somewhere nice.
items.zh: 下星期是我們的結婚紀念日。我們找個好地方訂位吧。

items.en: It's Friday today. I love Fridays!
items.zh: 今天星期五。我好愛星期五！

items.en: It was Christmas, so all the shops were closed.
items.zh: 那天是聖誕節，所以店都關了。

examples.heading: ④ 距離

items.en: It's about ten minutes to the station from here.
items.zh: 從這裡到車站大概十分鐘。

items.en: It's a long way to my grandmother's house.
items.zh: 到我奶奶家要走很遠。

items.en: Is it far to the city centre?
items.zh: 到市中心遠嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 明信片和信

items.en: Hi Anna! It's lovely here. It's sunny every day.
items.zh: 嗨，Anna！這裡好美。每天都是晴天。

items.en: It rained a lot last week, but it's dry now.
items.zh: 上星期下了很多雨，可是現在乾了。

items.en: It's eight o'clock in the evening, and I'm writing this on the balcony.
items.zh: 現在晚上八點，我在陽台寫這封信。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "What's the weather like?" "It's cloudy, but it isn't cold."
items.zh: 天氣怎麼樣？陰天，可是不冷。

items.en: "What day is it today?" "It's Tuesday."
items.zh: 今天星期幾？星期二。

items.en: "Is it raining?" "No, it's stopped."
items.zh: 在下雨嗎？沒有，停了。

title: It appears that there was an error with the older computer system.
translation: 看來舊的電腦系統出過錯。
name: 虛主詞 it 加 appear、seem 等動詞
sentences: We have looked into your complaint, and it appears that there was an error with the older computer system.
Your company has carried out a full investigation, and it appears that the disappearance was not the result of a crime.
It appears that the train was delayed because of the storm.
It appears that some of the students did not receive the email.
When you watch a good film, it seems that you are inside it, and you are one of the characters.
It seems that everyone has heard the news except me.
It seems that the shop has closed down.
It seemed that the whole town had come to watch the parade.
Take an umbrella. It looks as if it's going to rain.
It looks like nobody is at home.
It looked as if the house had been empty for years.
I've only been here a week, but it feels like home already.
It feels as if summer will never come.
It felt like the longest day of my life.
It appears that your payment has not yet been received.
It seems that the problem was caused by a broken pipe.
It appears that the hotel made a mistake with your booking.
"Where's Tom?" "It looks like he's gone home."
"Is the party still on?" "It seems that it is. Nobody has cancelled."
"How's the new job?" "It feels like I've been there for months."

examples.heading: ① It appears that

items.en: We have looked into your complaint, and it appears that there was an error with the older computer system.
items.zh: 我們調查了您的投訴，看來舊的電腦系統出過錯。

items.en: Your company has carried out a full investigation, and it appears that the disappearance was not the result of a crime.
items.zh: 貴公司做了完整的調查，看來東西不見並不是犯罪造成的。

items.en: It appears that the train was delayed because of the storm.
items.zh: 看來火車是因為暴風雨誤點的。

items.en: It appears that some of the students did not receive the email.
items.zh: 看來有些學生沒收到電子郵件。

examples.heading: ② It seems that

items.en: When you watch a good film, it seems that you are inside it, and you are one of the characters.
items.zh: 看一部好電影的時候，好像自己就在裡面，變成其中一個角色。

items.en: It seems that everyone has heard the news except me.
items.zh: 好像除了我以外，每個人都聽說了那個消息。

items.en: It seems that the shop has closed down.
items.zh: 那家店好像倒了。

items.en: It seemed that the whole town had come to watch the parade.
items.zh: 好像全鎮的人都來看遊行了。

examples.heading: ③ It looks as if / like

items.en: Take an umbrella. It looks as if it's going to rain.
items.zh: 帶把傘。看起來快下雨了。

items.en: It looks like nobody is at home.
items.zh: 看起來好像沒人在家。

items.en: It looked as if the house had been empty for years.
items.zh: 那棟房子看起來好像空了好幾年。

examples.heading: ④ It feels as if / like

items.en: I've only been here a week, but it feels like home already.
items.zh: 我才來這裡一個星期，可是已經有家的感覺了。

items.en: It feels as if summer will never come.
items.zh: 感覺夏天好像永遠不會來。

items.en: It felt like the longest day of my life.
items.zh: 那感覺像是我人生中最長的一天。

examples.heading: ⑤ 正式的信和報告

items.en: It appears that your payment has not yet been received.
items.zh: 看來我們還沒收到您的款項。

items.en: It seems that the problem was caused by a broken pipe.
items.zh: 問題似乎是一根破掉的水管造成的。

items.en: It appears that the hotel made a mistake with your booking.
items.zh: 看來旅館把您的訂房弄錯了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Where's Tom?" "It looks like he's gone home."
items.zh: Tom 呢？看起來他好像回家了。

items.en: "Is the party still on?" "It seems that it is. Nobody has cancelled."
items.zh: 派對還照常舉行嗎？好像是。沒人說取消。

items.en: "How's the new job?" "It feels like I've been there for months."
items.zh: 新工作怎麼樣？感覺好像已經在那裡待了好幾個月。

title: Hello, Mrs. Bishop. It's Clarisse.
translation: Bishop 太太您好，我是 Clarisse。
name: it 加 be 動詞指說話者本人
sentences: Hello, Mrs. Bishop. It's Clarisse. Can I ask you about the homework?
Hi, Mum. It's me. I'm at the station.
Hello, it's Sam from the office. Is Mr Jones there?
Hi, Grandma. It's Lucy. Happy birthday!
Hi, it's Ben. Call me back when you get this.
Hello, it's Dr Wilson. I'm calling about your test results.
Hi, Anna. It's me again. Where are you?
Dear Cris, it's me, Paarth. How are you?
Hi Emma, it's Mia. I've got a new phone number.
Hello everyone, it's your teacher. Class starts at ten tomorrow.
"Who's there?" "It's Tom. Can I come in?"
"Hello?" "Hi, it's me. Open the door!"
"Who is it?" "It's the postman. I've got a parcel for you."
"Who ate the last biscuit?" "Sorry, it was me."
"Who called last night?" "It was me. I wanted to say goodnight."
"Who left the door open?" "It was me. I forgot."

examples.heading: ① 打電話

items.en: Hello, Mrs. Bishop. It's Clarisse. Can I ask you about the homework?
items.zh: Bishop 太太您好，我是 Clarisse。我可以問您功課的事嗎？

items.en: Hi, Mum. It's me. I'm at the station.
items.zh: 嗨，媽。是我。我在車站。

items.en: Hello, it's Sam from the office. Is Mr Jones there?
items.zh: 您好，我是公司的 Sam。Jones 先生在嗎？

items.en: Hi, Grandma. It's Lucy. Happy birthday!
items.zh: 嗨，奶奶。我是 Lucy。生日快樂！

examples.heading: ② 留言

items.en: Hi, it's Ben. Call me back when you get this.
items.zh: 嗨，我是 Ben。聽到留言打給我。

items.en: Hello, it's Dr Wilson. I'm calling about your test results.
items.zh: 您好，我是 Wilson 醫師。我打來是要說您的檢查結果。

items.en: Hi, Anna. It's me again. Where are you?
items.zh: 嗨，Anna。又是我。你在哪裡？

examples.heading: ③ 信和簡訊

items.en: Dear Cris, it's me, Paarth. How are you?
items.zh: 親愛的 Cris，是我，Paarth。你好嗎？

items.en: Hi Emma, it's Mia. I've got a new phone number.
items.zh: 嗨，Emma，我是 Mia。我換了新的電話號碼。

items.en: Hello everyone, it's your teacher. Class starts at ten tomorrow.
items.zh: 大家好，我是你們的老師。明天十點上課。

examples.heading: ④ 敲門和對講機

items.en: "Who's there?" "It's Tom. Can I come in?"
items.zh: 誰啊？我是 Tom。我可以進來嗎？

items.en: "Hello?" "Hi, it's me. Open the door!"
items.zh: 喂？嗨，是我。開門！

items.en: "Who is it?" "It's the postman. I've got a parcel for you."
items.zh: 哪位？我是郵差。有你的包裹。

examples.heading: ⑤ It was me

items.en: "Who ate the last biscuit?" "Sorry, it was me."
items.zh: 最後一塊餅乾是誰吃的？抱歉，是我。

items.en: "Who called last night?" "It was me. I wanted to say goodnight."
items.zh: 昨天晚上誰打來？是我。我想跟你說晚安。

items.en: "Who left the door open?" "It was me. I forgot."
items.zh: 誰沒關門？是我。我忘了。

title: If one doesn't live close enough to walk to work, one can choose to get there by bicycle or by car.
translation: 一個人如果住得離公司不夠近，沒辦法走路上班，可以選擇騎腳踏車或開車去。
name: one 當主詞泛指一般人
sentences: One can learn a lot about a country from its food.
In this city, one can find restaurants from all over the world.
One can easily spend a whole day in this museum.
From the tower, one can see three countries on a clear day.
One cannot always get what one wants.
One should never judge people by appearances.
One must show a passport to enter the country.
One should drink plenty of water in hot weather.
One must remember that not everyone has the same opportunities.
One should try to save a little money every month.
If one wants to stay healthy, one needs to exercise regularly.
If one travels by train, one can work during the journey.
If one lives in the countryside, one usually needs a car.
If one is lucky, one may see dolphins from the boat.
If one has a problem, one should talk to someone about it.
One ought to keep one's word.
It is important to look after one's health.
One can't choose one's family.
One's childhood memories often stay for ever.
One needs to plan one's time carefully at university.
One never knows what life will bring.
One would think the trains would be on time by now.
One often forgets how lucky one is.
One rarely sees such beautiful weather in March.
One has to admit that the plan has some good points.
If one works from home, one saves time and money on travel.
One might argue that cars are more convenient than buses.
When one considers the cost of living, one understands why young people leave the city.
One cannot deny that the internet has changed our lives.
If one cycles to work, one gets exercise and helps the environment.
In conclusion, one can see that there are many ways to get to work.

examples.heading: ① one can

items.en: One can learn a lot about a country from its food.
items.zh: 從一個國家的食物可以了解很多關於這個國家的事。

items.en: In this city, one can find restaurants from all over the world.
items.zh: 在這座城市，可以找到來自世界各地的餐廳。

items.en: One can easily spend a whole day in this museum.
items.zh: 在這間博物館很容易就能待上一整天。

items.en: From the tower, one can see three countries on a clear day.
items.zh: 天氣晴朗的時候，從塔上可以看到三個國家。

items.en: One cannot always get what one wants.
items.zh: 人不能總是得到自己想要的。

examples.heading: ② one should / must

items.en: One should never judge people by appearances.
items.zh: 不應該以貌取人。

items.en: One must show a passport to enter the country.
items.zh: 入境這個國家必須出示護照。

items.en: One should drink plenty of water in hot weather.
items.zh: 天氣熱的時候要多喝水。

items.en: One must remember that not everyone has the same opportunities.
items.zh: 要記得不是每個人都有一樣的機會。

items.en: One should try to save a little money every month.
items.zh: 每個月都應該試著存一點錢。

examples.heading: ③ if one …, one …

items.en: If one wants to stay healthy, one needs to exercise regularly.
items.zh: 想保持健康，就要規律運動。

items.en: If one travels by train, one can work during the journey.
items.zh: 搭火車旅行的話，可以在路上工作。

items.en: If one lives in the countryside, one usually needs a car.
items.zh: 住在鄉下的話，通常需要一輛車。

items.en: If one is lucky, one may see dolphins from the boat.
items.zh: 運氣好的話，可以從船上看到海豚。

items.en: If one has a problem, one should talk to someone about it.
items.zh: 有問題的話，應該找人談一談。

examples.heading: ④ one's

items.en: One ought to keep one's word.
items.zh: 人應該說話算話。

items.en: It is important to look after one's health.
items.zh: 照顧自己的健康很重要。

items.en: One can't choose one's family.
items.zh: 人沒辦法選擇自己的家人。

items.en: One's childhood memories often stay for ever.
items.zh: 童年的記憶常常會一輩子留著。

items.en: One needs to plan one's time carefully at university.
items.zh: 上大學要好好規劃自己的時間。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說出一般的看法

items.en: One never knows what life will bring.
items.zh: 誰也不知道人生會發生什麼。

items.en: One would think the trains would be on time by now.
items.zh: 照理說火車到現在應該會準時了。

items.en: One often forgets how lucky one is.
items.zh: 人常常忘了自己有多幸運。

items.en: One rarely sees such beautiful weather in March.
items.zh: 三月很少有這麼好的天氣。

items.en: One has to admit that the plan has some good points.
items.zh: 不得不承認這個計畫有一些優點。

examples.heading: ⑥ 作文和正式的文章

items.en: If one works from home, one saves time and money on travel.
items.zh: 在家工作的話，可以省下通勤的時間和錢。

items.en: One might argue that cars are more convenient than buses.
items.zh: 有人可能會說汽車比公車方便。

items.en: When one considers the cost of living, one understands why young people leave the city.
items.zh: 想想生活費，就能明白為什麼年輕人要離開城市。

items.en: One cannot deny that the internet has changed our lives.
items.zh: 不能否認網路改變了我們的生活。

items.en: If one cycles to work, one gets exercise and helps the environment.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車上班的話，既能運動又能幫助環境。

items.en: In conclusion, one can see that there are many ways to get to work.
items.zh: 總結來說，可以看出上班的方式有很多種。

title: Can we have a chat?
translation: 我們可以聊一下嗎？
name: 疑問句裡助動詞後的主格代名詞
sentences: Have you got a minute after class? Can we have a chat?
You look lost. Can I help you find the station?
I didn't catch your name. Could you spell it for me?
Can they come to the party too?
There's a new Thai place in town. Do you want to try it tonight?
Your cousins are so tall. Do they play basketball?
The kitchen is so clean! Did you do all the washing-up?
Did we get any letters today?
Will you be at home this evening?
I've never been to a job interview. Should I wear a suit?
Will they finish the work on time?
The film starts in ten minutes. Shall we take a taxi?
I've read your plan. What do you think about that?
Your neighbours are always away in August. Where do they go?
The party starts at eight. When should we leave the house?
The trains aren't running today. How can we get to the airport?
Excuse me, can I sit here?
Those boots look really warm. Where did you get them?
Do we need to bring our books tomorrow?
"Can I borrow your pen?" "Sure, here you are."
"Which bus do you take to school?" "The number 12."
"Did they enjoy the film?" "Yes, they loved it."

examples.heading: ① Can / Could + 主格代名詞

items.en: Have you got a minute after class? Can we have a chat?
items.zh: 你下課後有空嗎？我們可以聊一下嗎？

items.en: You look lost. Can I help you find the station?
items.zh: 你好像迷路了。要我幫你找車站嗎？

items.en: I didn't catch your name. Could you spell it for me?
items.zh: 我沒聽清楚你的名字。你可以拼給我聽嗎？

items.en: Can they come to the party too?
items.zh: 他們也可以來參加派對嗎？

examples.heading: ② Do / Does / Did + 主格代名詞

items.en: There's a new Thai place in town. Do you want to try it tonight?
items.zh: 鎮上新開了一家泰國菜。你今晚想去吃吃看嗎？

items.en: Your cousins are so tall. Do they play basketball?
items.zh: 你的表兄弟好高。他們打籃球嗎？

items.en: The kitchen is so clean! Did you do all the washing-up?
items.zh: 廚房好乾淨！碗都是你洗的嗎？

items.en: Did we get any letters today?
items.zh: 我們今天有收到信嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Will / Shall / Should + 主格代名詞

items.en: Will you be at home this evening?
items.zh: 你今天晚上會在家嗎？

items.en: I've never been to a job interview. Should I wear a suit?
items.zh: 我從來沒去過面試。我應該穿西裝嗎？

items.en: Will they finish the work on time?
items.zh: 他們會準時完成工作嗎？

items.en: The film starts in ten minutes. Shall we take a taxi?
items.zh: 電影再十分鐘就開始了。我們搭計程車好嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 疑問詞 + 助動詞 + 主格代名詞

items.en: I've read your plan. What do you think about that?
items.zh: 我讀了你的計畫。你覺得那件事怎麼樣？

items.en: Your neighbours are always away in August. Where do they go?
items.zh: 你的鄰居八月總是不在家。他們都去哪裡？

items.en: The party starts at eight. When should we leave the house?
items.zh: 派對八點開始。我們應該幾點出門？

items.en: The trains aren't running today. How can we get to the airport?
items.zh: 今天火車停駛。我們要怎麼去機場？

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Excuse me, can I sit here?
items.zh: 不好意思，我可以坐這裡嗎？

items.en: Those boots look really warm. Where did you get them?
items.zh: 那雙靴子看起來好保暖。你在哪裡買的？

items.en: Do we need to bring our books tomorrow?
items.zh: 我們明天要帶書嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Can I borrow your pen?" "Sure, here you are."
items.zh: 我可以借你的筆嗎？好啊，給你。

items.en: "Which bus do you take to school?" "The number 12."
items.zh: 你搭哪一路公車上學？12 路。

items.en: "Did they enjoy the film?" "Yes, they loved it."
items.zh: 他們喜歡那部電影嗎？喜歡，他們很愛。

title: Is it OK?
translation: 這樣可以嗎？
name: 疑問句裡 be 動詞後的代名詞
sentences: I made this for you. It's my first time. Is it OK?
Is it cold outside? Should I take a coat?
Is it your birthday today? Happy birthday!
I'm thinking of walking to the station. Is it far?
You fell off your bike! Are you hurt?
You've been on the phone for an hour. Are you still angry with him?
Are you a student here?
Are you ready? The taxi is outside.
Hi, Mrs Bishop. How are you?
The concert has started, and your seat is empty! Where are you?
How old are you now?
Someone left a box at the door. What is it?
I've lost my phone. Where is it?
What time is it? I need to go.
Were you at home last night? I called you.
How was the film? Was it good?
Were you scared on the plane?
"Is it your turn to cook tonight?" "No, it's Dad's."
"Are you hungry?" "Very! Let's eat."
"Is it expensive?" "No, it's only five pounds."

examples.heading: ① Is it + 補語？

items.en: I made this for you. It's my first time. Is it OK?
items.zh: 這是我為你做的。我第一次做。這樣可以嗎？

items.en: Is it cold outside? Should I take a coat?
items.zh: 外面冷嗎？我要帶外套嗎？

items.en: Is it your birthday today? Happy birthday!
items.zh: 今天是你生日嗎？生日快樂！

items.en: I'm thinking of walking to the station. Is it far?
items.zh: 我想走路去車站。很遠嗎？

examples.heading: ② Are you + 補語？

items.en: You fell off your bike! Are you hurt?
items.zh: 你從腳踏車上摔下來了！你有受傷嗎？

items.en: You've been on the phone for an hour. Are you still angry with him?
items.zh: 你已經講了一個小時的電話。你還在生他的氣嗎？

items.en: Are you a student here?
items.zh: 你是這裡的學生嗎？

items.en: Are you ready? The taxi is outside.
items.zh: 你準備好了嗎？計程車在外面了。

examples.heading: ③ How are you? / Where are you?

items.en: Hi, Mrs Bishop. How are you?
items.zh: 嗨，Bishop 太太。您好嗎？

items.en: The concert has started, and your seat is empty! Where are you?
items.zh: 演唱會開始了，你的位子還空著！你在哪裡？

items.en: How old are you now?
items.zh: 你現在幾歲了？

examples.heading: ④ What is it? / Where is it?

items.en: Someone left a box at the door. What is it?
items.zh: 有人在門口放了一個箱子。那是什麼？

items.en: I've lost my phone. Where is it?
items.zh: 我的手機不見了。在哪裡？

items.en: What time is it? I need to go.
items.zh: 現在幾點？我得走了。

examples.heading: ⑤ Was it / Were you？

items.en: Were you at home last night? I called you.
items.zh: 你昨天晚上在家嗎？我有打給你。

items.en: How was the film? Was it good?
items.zh: 電影怎麼樣？好看嗎？

items.en: Were you scared on the plane?
items.zh: 你在飛機上會怕嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Is it your turn to cook tonight?" "No, it's Dad's."
items.zh: 今晚輪到你煮飯嗎？不是，輪到爸爸。

items.en: "Are you hungry?" "Very! Let's eat."
items.zh: 你餓了嗎？好餓！我們吃飯吧。

items.en: "Is it expensive?" "No, it's only five pounds."
items.zh: 很貴嗎？不貴，只要五英鎊。

title: It's boring to be at home when you have a lot of free time.
translation: 空閒時間很多的時候，待在家很無聊。
name: 虛主詞 it
sentences: The summer holiday is too long. It's boring to be at home when you have a lot of free time.
If you visit my country, it is best to spend your time in the countryside.
It's easy to get lost in this city.
It's important to drink water when you exercise.
It was difficult to find a hotel in August.
Don't be angry. It's normal that your parents want you to go with them.
It's obvious that she doesn't want to go to the party.
It's strange that nobody answered the phone.
It's surprising that so many people still use cash.
It's a good idea to book your tickets early.
It was a pleasure to meet you.
It's a shame to waste all this food.
It's better to take the train. The roads are always busy.
It's a good idea to bring a jacket. The evenings can be cold.
It's not safe to swim here. The sea is too rough.
It was great to hear from you after so long.
It's hard to believe that we finished school ten years ago.
It is clear that young people use the internet more than their parents.
"Shall we walk?" "No, it's quicker to take the bus."
"I failed my driving test again." "It's not easy to pass the first time."
"Is it OK to park here?" "Yes, it's free after six."

examples.heading: ① It's + 形容詞 + to + 動詞

items.en: The summer holiday is too long. It's boring to be at home when you have a lot of free time.
items.zh: 暑假太長了。空閒時間很多的時候，待在家很無聊。

items.en: If you visit my country, it is best to spend your time in the countryside.
items.zh: 如果你來我的國家，最好把時間花在鄉下。

items.en: It's easy to get lost in this city.
items.zh: 在這個城市很容易迷路。

items.en: It's important to drink water when you exercise.
items.zh: 運動的時候喝水很重要。

items.en: It was difficult to find a hotel in August.
items.zh: 八月很難找到旅館。

examples.heading: ② It's + 形容詞 + that + 子句

items.en: Don't be angry. It's normal that your parents want you to go with them.
items.zh: 別生氣。你爸媽想要你跟他們一起去，這很正常。

items.en: It's obvious that she doesn't want to go to the party.
items.zh: 很明顯她不想去那個派對。

items.en: It's strange that nobody answered the phone.
items.zh: 沒人接電話，真奇怪。

items.en: It's surprising that so many people still use cash.
items.zh: 這麼多人還在用現金，真令人意外。

examples.heading: ③ It's + 名詞 + to + 動詞

items.en: It's a good idea to book your tickets early.
items.zh: 早點訂票是個好主意。

items.en: It was a pleasure to meet you.
items.zh: 很高興認識你。

items.en: It's a shame to waste all this food.
items.zh: 浪費這些食物真可惜。

examples.heading: ④ 給建議

items.en: It's better to take the train. The roads are always busy.
items.zh: 搭火車比較好。路上總是很塞。

items.en: It's a good idea to bring a jacket. The evenings can be cold.
items.zh: 帶件外套是個好主意。晚上可能會冷。

items.en: It's not safe to swim here. The sea is too rough.
items.zh: 在這裡游泳不安全。海浪太大了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 信和作文

items.en: It was great to hear from you after so long.
items.zh: 隔了這麼久收到你的消息，真好。

items.en: It's hard to believe that we finished school ten years ago.
items.zh: 很難相信我們畢業已經十年了。

items.en: It is clear that young people use the internet more than their parents.
items.zh: 很明顯，年輕人比他們的父母更常上網。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.en: "Shall we walk?" "No, it's quicker to take the bus."
items.zh: 我們走路去好嗎？不要，搭公車比較快。

items.en: "I failed my driving test again." "It's not easy to pass the first time."
items.zh: 我駕照又沒考過。第一次就考過不容易。

items.en: "Is it OK to park here?" "Yes, it's free after six."
items.zh: 這裡可以停車嗎？可以，六點以後免費。

title: That was amazing.
translation: 那真是太棒了。
name: 指示代名詞 that（單數）
sentences: We went to the concert last night. That was fantastic.
I had a ride on a camel. That was scary!
We walked up the mountain. That was hard work.
The film ended at midnight. That was too late for me.
Thanks for dinner. That was delicious.
That's the bus to the airport.
That is the house where I was born.
Look! That's our new teacher.
That's a really good photo of you.
That isn't my coat. Mine is black.
Don't touch that! It's hot.
I'd like that, please. The chocolate one.
Can I borrow that when you've finished?
Could you hold that for a minute while I find my keys?
Did you hear that? I think someone is at the door.
What's that in your hand?
Is that your bike outside?
Who's that over there?
How much is that?
Was that your mum on the phone?
After that, we can go and drink a cup of coffee and eat a piece of cake.
I paid twenty pounds for that.
We had a test on Monday. Before that, I studied all weekend.
The station is near the bank. You can park opposite that.
I've got a meeting at two. Can we talk before that?
Yesterday we visited the castle. That was the best part of the trip.
We stayed in a small hotel by the sea. That was really nice.
In the evening we watched the sunset. That was beautiful.
I lost my sunglasses on the beach. That was a pity.
Tomorrow we're going to Paris. That will be exciting!
The weather has been sunny every day. That's great for swimming.

examples.heading: ① That was + 形容詞

items.en: We went to the concert last night. That was fantastic.
items.zh: 我們昨晚去看了演唱會，真的很精彩。

items.en: I had a ride on a camel. That was scary!
items.zh: 我騎了駱駝，好可怕！

items.en: We walked up the mountain. That was hard work.
items.zh: 我們走路上山，真的很累。

items.en: The film ended at midnight. That was too late for me.
items.zh: 電影半夜才結束，對我來說太晚了。

items.en: Thanks for dinner. That was delicious.
items.zh: 謝謝你的晚餐，真好吃。

examples.heading: ② That is + 名詞

items.en: That's the bus to the airport.
items.zh: 那是開往機場的公車。

items.en: That is the house where I was born.
items.zh: 那是我出生的房子。

items.en: Look! That's our new teacher.
items.zh: 你看！那是我們的新老師。

items.en: That's a really good photo of you.
items.zh: 這張照片把你拍得很好看。

items.en: That isn't my coat. Mine is black.
items.zh: 那不是我的外套，我的是黑色的。

examples.heading: ③ that 當受詞

items.en: Don't touch that! It's hot.
items.zh: 別碰那個！很燙。

items.en: I'd like that, please. The chocolate one.
items.zh: 我要那個，謝謝。巧克力的那個。

items.en: Can I borrow that when you've finished?
items.zh: 你用完以後，那個可以借我嗎？

items.en: Could you hold that for a minute while I find my keys?
items.zh: 我找鑰匙的時候，你可以幫我拿一下那個嗎？

items.en: Did you hear that? I think someone is at the door.
items.zh: 你有聽到嗎？我覺得有人在門口。

examples.heading: ④ 問句

items.en: What's that in your hand?
items.zh: 你手上拿的是什麼？

items.en: Is that your bike outside?
items.zh: 外面那台是你的腳踏車嗎？

items.en: Who's that over there?
items.zh: 那邊那個人是誰？

items.en: How much is that?
items.zh: 那個多少錢？

items.en: Was that your mum on the phone?
items.zh: 剛剛電話裡是你媽媽嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 介系詞後面

items.en: After that, we can go and drink a cup of coffee and eat a piece of cake.
items.zh: 之後我們可以去喝杯咖啡，吃塊蛋糕。

items.en: I paid twenty pounds for that.
items.zh: 那個我花了二十英鎊。

items.en: We had a test on Monday. Before that, I studied all weekend.
items.zh: 我們星期一考試，考試前我整個週末都在讀書。

items.en: The station is near the bank. You can park opposite that.
items.zh: 車站在銀行附近，你可以把車停在銀行對面。

items.en: I've got a meeting at two. Can we talk before that?
items.zh: 我兩點有個會，我們可以在那之前談嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 明信片和信

items.en: Yesterday we visited the castle. That was the best part of the trip.
items.zh: 昨天我們參觀了城堡，那是這趟旅行最棒的部分。

items.en: We stayed in a small hotel by the sea. That was really nice.
items.zh: 我們住在海邊的一家小旅館，很不錯。

items.en: In the evening we watched the sunset. That was beautiful.
items.zh: 晚上我們看了夕陽，很美。

items.en: I lost my sunglasses on the beach. That was a pity.
items.zh: 我的太陽眼鏡在海灘上弄丟了，真可惜。

items.en: Tomorrow we're going to Paris. That will be exciting!
items.zh: 明天我們要去巴黎，一定會很刺激！

items.en: The weather has been sunny every day. That's great for swimming.
items.zh: 天氣每天都很晴朗，很適合游泳。

title: She told him that the baby was theirs.
translation: 她告訴他，那個寶寶是他們的。
name: 所有格代名詞 theirs 當受詞或補語
sentences: Our oven broke, so we used theirs.
We'll teach them our songs, and they'll teach us theirs.
We told them our news, and then they told us theirs.
Our car was in the garage, so we borrowed theirs for the weekend.
My parents painted our fence and then helped the neighbors paint theirs.
We finished our project early and helped the other group finish theirs.
The two bikes chained to the lamp post are theirs.
That big house by the lake is theirs.
The choice isn't ours. It's theirs.
The puppy in the window could be theirs by Friday.
The land has been theirs for three generations.
Our house is right next to theirs.
Our kids play with theirs every weekend.
Our Wi-Fi is much faster than theirs.
My idea is quite similar to theirs.
We parked behind theirs.
I've followed a cousin of theirs online for years.
A friend of theirs is staying with them.
Some old school friends of theirs came to the wedding.
That old car of theirs is always breaking down.
A son of theirs flies helicopters for the coast guard.
A: Whose cat is this? B: It's theirs, from next door.
We had our wedding in May, and they had theirs in June.
Our team lost, and theirs won the cup.
We cooked our national dish, and the exchange students cooked theirs.
We don't need their help. The problem isn't theirs to solve.
We ate our lunch, and they ate theirs in the car.
Our flat faces south, unlike theirs.
We brought our own chairs, but the Lins forgot theirs.
We've paid for our tickets. Have the Wangs paid for theirs?

examples.heading: ① 動詞後面

items.en: Our oven broke, so we used theirs.
items.zh: 我們的烤箱壞了，所以我們用了他們的。

items.en: We'll teach them our songs, and they'll teach us theirs.
items.zh: 我們教他們我們的歌，他們教我們他們的。

items.en: We told them our news, and then they told us theirs.
items.zh: 我們跟他們說了我們的近況，接著他們也說了他們的。

items.en: Our car was in the garage, so we borrowed theirs for the weekend.
items.zh: 我們的車在修車廠，所以週末借了他們的。

items.en: My parents painted our fence and then helped the neighbors paint theirs.
items.zh: 我爸媽漆了我們的圍籬，然後幫鄰居漆他們的。

items.en: We finished our project early and helped the other group finish theirs.
items.zh: 我們提早完成了我們的計畫，還幫另一組完成他們的。

examples.heading: ② be + theirs

items.en: The two bikes chained to the lamp post are theirs.
items.zh: 鎖在路燈柱上的那兩台腳踏車是他們的。

items.en: That big house by the lake is theirs.
items.zh: 湖邊那間大房子是他們的。

items.en: The choice isn't ours. It's theirs.
items.zh: 選擇權不在我們，在他們。

items.en: The puppy in the window could be theirs by Friday.
items.zh: 櫥窗裡那隻小狗星期五以前可能就是他們的了。

items.en: The land has been theirs for three generations.
items.zh: 這塊地在他們家已經三代了。

examples.heading: ③ 介系詞 + theirs

items.en: Our house is right next to theirs.
items.zh: 我們家就在他們家隔壁。

items.en: Our kids play with theirs every weekend.
items.zh: 我們的孩子每個週末都跟他們的孩子一起玩。

items.en: Our Wi-Fi is much faster than theirs.
items.zh: 我們的網路比他們的快多了。

items.en: My idea is quite similar to theirs.
items.zh: 我的點子跟他們的滿像的。

items.en: We parked behind theirs.

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.zh: 我們已經付了我們的票錢。王家付了他們的嗎？

title: Theirs had always been a love-hate relationship.

sentences: Our wedding was small, but theirs had three hundred guests.

items.zh: 這條路封了，我們得走那條。

items.zh: 這兩個披薩看起來一樣，這個是素的嗎？

items.en: That restaurant was too noisy. This one is much better.
items.zh: 那家餐廳太吵了，這家好多了。

items.en: There are two coffees on the table. Is this one yours?
items.zh: 桌上有兩杯咖啡，這杯是你的嗎？

items.en: This pie is good, but that one we had at the market was better.
items.zh: 這個派不錯，可是我們在市集吃的那個比較好吃。

examples.heading: ⑥ 加形容詞

items.en: I don't like this blue one. Do you have a green one?
items.zh: 我不喜歡這個藍色的，有綠色的嗎？

items.en: We don't need a new radio. That old one still works fine.
items.zh: 我們不需要新的收音機，那台舊的還很好用。

items.en: I bought three bags today. This small one is perfect for my keys and phone.
items.zh: 我今天買了三個包包。這個小的拿來放鑰匙和手機剛好。

items.zh: 不好意思，我可以看看櫥窗裡那個銀色的嗎？

items.zh: 我帶了兩件外套。這件厚的是上山穿的。

title: Most of my clothes are lemon, green or orange; those are my favorite colors!
translation: 我的衣服大多是檸檬黃、綠色或橘色，那些是我最喜歡的顏色！
name: those 當代名詞
sentences: Listen to those birds singing outside. Those are blackbirds.
Those are the keys to the garage.
I like jazz and blues. Those are my favorite kinds of music.
Those are not my glasses. Mine are in my bag.
Are those your children over there?
Those were the best days of my life.
My grandparents lived on a farm. Those were happy times.
Those were my old school friends at the door.
Those were my grandmother's earrings.
Those were the rules when I was a child.
Can I try those on, please?
I don't want these apples. I'll take those.
Please put those in the box.
Where did you find those? They're beautiful.
My mum made those for my birthday.
Put the cups next to those on the shelf.
I'm not sure about the red shoes. What about those?
These plants grow faster than those.
We can't play with these balls. Can we play with those?
Don't sit on these chairs. Sit on those.
I love cats and horses. Those are my favorite animals.
I play tennis and basketball. Those are the sports I'm best at.
Maths and science are hard for me. Those are my worst subjects.
My hobbies are reading and cooking. Those take up most of my free time.
I wear jeans and trainers a lot. Those are the most comfortable clothes.
We could eat at home or go out. Those are our choices.

examples.heading: ① those + are

items.en: Listen to those birds singing outside. Those are blackbirds.
items.zh: 你聽外面那些鳥在唱歌，那些是黑鶇。

items.en: Those are the keys to the garage.
items.zh: 那些是車庫的鑰匙。

items.en: I like jazz and blues. Those are my favorite kinds of music.
items.zh: 我喜歡爵士樂和藍調。那些是我最喜歡的音樂類型。

items.en: Those are not my glasses. Mine are in my bag.
items.zh: 那些不是我的眼鏡，我的在包包裡。

items.en: Are those your children over there?
items.zh: 在那邊的那些是你的孩子嗎？

examples.heading: ② those + were

items.en: Those were the best days of my life.
items.zh: 那些是我這輩子最美好的日子。

items.en: My grandparents lived on a farm. Those were happy times.
items.zh: 我的祖父母以前住在農場，那段時光很快樂。

items.en: Those were my old school friends at the door.
items.zh: 在門口的那些人是我以前的同學。

items.en: Those were my grandmother's earrings.
items.zh: 那些是我奶奶的耳環。

items.en: Those were the rules when I was a child.
items.zh: 我小時候的規定就是那些。

examples.heading: ③ those 當受詞

items.en: Can I try those on, please?
items.zh: 那些我可以試穿嗎？

items.en: I don't want these apples. I'll take those.
items.zh: 我不要這些蘋果，我要那些。

items.en: Please put those in the box.
items.zh: 請把那些放進箱子裡。

items.en: Where did you find those? They're beautiful.
items.zh: 那些你在哪裡找到的？好漂亮。

items.en: My mum made those for my birthday.
items.zh: 那些是我媽媽為我生日做的。

examples.heading: ④ 介系詞 + those

items.en: Put the cups next to those on the shelf.
items.zh: 把杯子放在架子上那些旁邊。

items.en: I'm not sure about the red shoes. What about those?
items.zh: 那雙紅鞋我不確定，那雙呢？

items.en: These plants grow faster than those.
items.zh: 這些植物長得比那些快。

items.en: We can't play with these balls. Can we play with those?
items.zh: 我們不能玩這些球，可以玩那些嗎？

items.en: Don't sit on these chairs. Sit on those.
items.zh: 別坐這些椅子，坐那些。

examples.heading: ⑤ 寫信介紹自己

items.en: I love cats and horses. Those are my favorite animals.
items.zh: 我很喜歡貓和馬。那些是我最喜歡的動物。

items.en: I play tennis and basketball. Those are the sports I'm best at.
items.zh: 我打網球和籃球。那些是我最擅長的運動。

items.en: Maths and science are hard for me. Those are my worst subjects.
items.zh: 數學和自然對我來說很難。那些是我最差的科目。

items.en: My hobbies are reading and cooking. Those take up most of my free time.
items.zh: 我的嗜好是閱讀和做菜，我大部分的空閒時間都花在那些上面。

items.en: I wear jeans and trainers a lot. Those are the most comfortable clothes.
items.zh: 我常穿牛仔褲和運動鞋，那些是最舒服的衣服。

examples.heading: ⑥ 提出想法和計畫

items.en: We could eat at home or go out. Those are our choices.
items.zh: 我們可以在家吃或出去吃，就這兩個選擇。

items.en: We could go to the beach or the zoo. Those are my suggestions.
items.zh: 我們可以去海灘或動物園。那些是我的建議。

items.en: Clean the kitchen and walk the dog. Those are your jobs today.
items.zh: 打掃廚房、遛狗。那些是你今天的工作。

items.en: Bring a coat and an umbrella. Those are the most important things.
items.zh: 帶外套和雨傘。那些是最重要的東西。

items.en: A map, some water and good shoes. Those are all you need.
items.zh: 一張地圖、一些水和一雙好鞋。你只需要那些。

items.en: Those are just my thoughts. What do you think?
items.zh: 那些只是我的想法，你覺得呢？

items.zh: 想提出任何事項，請寄給秘書。

items.en: Many are the legends that surround this lake.

items.en: Many are the songs that have been written about love.

examples.heading: ⑥ 作文和演講

items.en: Many are the arguments for and against school uniforms.

items.zh: 我們鎮上過去五十年的變化很多。

items.zh: 這次成功要感謝的人很多。

items.en: Many are the questions that remain unanswered.
items.zh: 到現在還沒有答案的問題很多。

title: Perhaps it will help me understand what my two dogs say to one another.

name: 相互代名詞 one another（正式）

The children in the class are very kind to one another.

The houses in the old town are built very close to one another.
The pupils sat in a circle, facing towards one another.
The two families often stay in one another's homes.
The writers commented on one another's work.
Staff are asked to respect one another's privacy.

The leaders shook one another's hands.
My two cats groom one another every evening.

In the past, the villages used to trade with one another.

items.zh: 這個村子裡的鄰居都互相信任。

items.zh: 學生們坐成一圈，面向彼此。

items.zh: 戰爭期間，那對夫妻每天都寫信給對方。

items.en: The two old friends greeted one another warmly.
items.zh: 兩個老朋友熱情地互相問候。

items.zh: 兩個駕駛都把事故怪到對方身上。

items.zh: 那兩兄弟從葬禮之後就沒跟對方說過話。

items.zh: 各方承諾公平對待彼此。

items.zh: 我們在研討會之前從沒見過面。

items.zh: 他們將在決賽中互相較量。

items.en: In the past, the villages used to trade with one another.
