items.zh: 小型狗通常比大型狗活得久。

items.en: Electric cars are quieter than petrol ones.
items.zh: 電動車比汽油車安靜。

items.en: Short holidays are sometimes more relaxing than long ones.
items.zh: 短假期有時比長假期更放鬆。

items.en: Hard exams are better for learning than easy ones.
items.zh: 難的考試比簡單的考試更能學到東西。

items.en: Wooden toys last longer than plastic ones.
items.zh: 木頭玩具比塑膠玩具耐用。

examples.heading: ② 學校和工作

items.en: Big companies pay more than small ones.
items.zh: 大公司給的薪水比小公司高。

items.en: Young teachers often have more energy than older ones.
items.zh: 年輕老師通常比年長的老師有活力。

items.en: Private universities are more expensive than public ones.
items.zh: 私立大學比公立大學貴。

items.en: Online courses are cheaper than traditional ones.
items.zh: 線上課程比傳統課程便宜。

items.en: Part-time jobs are easier to find than full-time ones.
items.zh: 兼職工作比全職工作好找。

examples.heading: ③ 城市和生活

items.en: Small towns are safer than big ones.
items.zh: 小鎮比大城市安全。

items.en: Modern flats are easier to heat than old ones.
items.zh: 新式公寓比老公寓容易保暖。

items.en: Busy streets are noisier than quiet ones, of course.
items.zh: 熱鬧的街當然比安靜的街吵。

items.en: Local shops are friendlier than big ones.
items.zh: 地方小店比大型商店親切。

items.en: Country roads are more dangerous at night than city ones.
items.zh: 晚上鄉間道路比市區道路危險。

examples.heading: ④ 買東西

items.en: Expensive phones aren't always better than cheap ones.
items.zh: 貴的手機不一定比便宜的好。

items.en: Second-hand books cost much less than new ones.
items.zh: 二手書比新書便宜很多。

items.en: Leather bags last longer than cloth ones.
items.zh: 皮包比布包耐用。

items.en: Big supermarkets usually have lower prices than small ones.
items.zh: 大型超市的價格通常比小超市低。

items.en: Handmade cards mean more than shop-bought ones.
items.zh: 手做卡片比店裡買的更有心意。

examples.heading: ⑤ 人

items.en: Experienced drivers have fewer accidents than new ones.
items.zh: 有經驗的駕駛比新手少出車禍。

items.en: Happy workers do better work than unhappy ones.
items.zh: 快樂的員工比不快樂的員工工作表現好。

items.en: Big families are often noisier than small ones.
items.zh: 大家庭通常比小家庭熱鬧。

items.en: Good students ask more questions than weak ones.
items.zh: 好學生比程度差的學生更常發問。

items.en: Older children can help younger ones with homework.
items.zh: 大一點的孩子可以幫小一點的孩子寫功課。

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫作中的看法

items.en: In my opinion, small classes are better than large ones.
items.zh: 我認為小班比大班好。

items.en: Some people think traditional methods work better than modern ones.
items.zh: 有些人認為傳統方法比現代方法有效。

items.en: Long films can be more boring than short ones.
items.zh: 長片有時比短片無聊。

items.en: Free museums attract more visitors than paid ones.
items.zh: 免費博物館比收費博物館吸引更多遊客。

items.en: I believe public parks are as important as private ones.
items.zh: 我認為公園和私人庭園一樣重要。

title: Nearly everyone I know sits at a computer all day.
translation: 我認識的人幾乎每個都整天坐在電腦前。
name: 不定代名詞前加強調修飾語
sentences: Nearly everyone in the office drinks coffee.
Almost everything in this room belonged to my grandfather.
Nearly everybody on our street has a dog.
Almost everyone on the bus was looking at a phone.
I've read nearly everything she has written.
Almost everybody I asked said no.
You can wear absolutely anything to the party.
Absolutely everyone was at the party.
Absolutely nothing went wrong on the trip.
He knows absolutely everything about football.
Absolutely no one was in the office on Sunday.
Hardly anyone lives in the old town now.
There was hardly anything in the fridge when we got home.
Hardly anybody noticed the mistake.
I know hardly anyone in this city.
Hardly anything in the shop costs less than ten pounds.
You can buy these cards almost everywhere.
We looked nearly everywhere for the keys.
There's almost nowhere to park in the city centre.
I take my camera nearly everywhere.
There was hardly anywhere to sit.
Just about everyone has heard of him.
Practically everything in the house is new.
Virtually nobody uses a fax machine now.
My son will watch just about anything with dinosaurs in it.
Practically everybody in the street came out to watch.
Almost nobody stayed until the end.
There's almost nothing on TV tonight.
Almost no one answered the email.
He ate almost nothing all day.
Almost nothing surprises him anymore.

examples.heading: ① nearly / almost + every-

items.en: Nearly everyone in the office drinks coffee.
items.zh: 辦公室裡幾乎每個人都喝咖啡。

items.en: Almost everything in this room belonged to my grandfather.
items.zh: 這個房間裡的東西幾乎都是我爺爺的。

items.en: Nearly everybody on our street has a dog.
items.zh: 我們這條街上幾乎每戶都養狗。

items.en: Almost everyone on the bus was looking at a phone.
items.zh: 公車上幾乎每個人都在看手機。

items.en: I've read nearly everything she has written.
items.zh: 她寫的東西我幾乎都讀過。

items.en: Almost everybody I asked said no.
items.zh: 我問的人幾乎都說不要。

examples.heading: ② absolutely

items.en: You can wear absolutely anything to the party.
items.zh: 派對穿什麼都可以。

items.en: Absolutely everyone was at the party.
items.zh: 派對上每個人都到了。

items.en: Absolutely nothing went wrong on the trip.
items.zh: 這趟旅行完全沒出任何差錯。

items.en: He knows absolutely everything about football.
items.zh: 足球的事他全都知道。

items.en: Absolutely no one was in the office on Sunday.
items.zh: 星期天辦公室裡一個人都沒有。

examples.heading: ③ hardly + any-

items.en: Hardly anyone lives in the old town now.
items.zh: 現在幾乎沒有人住在舊城區了。

items.en: There was hardly anything in the fridge when we got home.
items.zh: 我們回到家時，冰箱裡幾乎什麼都沒有。

items.en: Hardly anybody noticed the mistake.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有人發現這個錯。

items.en: I know hardly anyone in this city.
items.zh: 這個城市我幾乎誰都不認識。

items.en: Hardly anything in the shop costs less than ten pounds.
items.zh: 店裡幾乎沒有東西低於十英鎊。

examples.heading: ④ 修飾語 + 地方

items.en: You can buy these cards almost everywhere.
items.zh: 這種卡幾乎到處都買得到。

items.en: We looked nearly everywhere for the keys.
items.zh: 我們幾乎每個地方都找過鑰匙了。

items.en: There's almost nowhere to park in the city centre.
items.zh: 市中心幾乎沒有地方可以停車。

items.en: I take my camera nearly everywhere.
items.zh: 我幾乎走到哪裡都帶著相機。

items.en: There was hardly anywhere to sit.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有地方可以坐。

examples.heading: ⑤ just about / practically / virtually

items.en: Just about everyone has heard of him.
items.zh: 差不多每個人都聽過他。

items.en: Practically everything in the house is new.
items.zh: 這間房子的東西差不多都是新的。

items.en: Virtually nobody uses a fax machine now.
items.zh: 現在差不多沒有人用傳真機了。

items.en: My son will watch just about anything with dinosaurs in it.
items.zh: 只要有恐龍，我兒子差不多什麼節目都看。

items.en: Practically everybody in the street came out to watch.
items.zh: 整條街的人差不多都跑出來看了。

examples.heading: ⑥ almost + no-

items.en: Almost nobody stayed until the end.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有人待到最後。

items.en: There's almost nothing on TV tonight.
items.zh: 今晚電視幾乎沒什麼好看的。

items.en: Almost no one answered the email.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有人回那封電子郵件。

items.en: He ate almost nothing all day.
items.zh: 他一整天幾乎什麼都沒吃。

items.en: Almost nothing surprises him anymore.
items.zh: 現在幾乎沒有什麼事能讓他驚訝了。

title: That's a good idea!
translation: 這是個好主意！
name: that's 加形容詞的回應語
sentences: "I've got a new job." "That's fantastic!"
"We're going to have a baby." "That's wonderful news!"
"My sister is coming to visit." "That's nice."
"I got an A in my English exam." "That's brilliant!"
"The rain has stopped." "That's good. Let's go out."
"I lost my wallet on the bus." "Oh, that's terrible!"
"The concert was cancelled." "That's a shame."
"I failed my driving test again." "Oh no, that's too bad."
"My grandmother is in hospital." "I'm sorry. That's awful."
"We missed the train by a minute." "That's so annoying!"
"Why don't we eat outside?" "That's a great idea!"
"Let's ask Mr Brown for help." "Yes, that's a good plan."
"We could go to the beach on Saturday." "That's perfect! I'm free then."
"Maybe we should leave early." "That's true. The roads will be busy."
"Shall I bring some drinks?" "That's very kind of you."
"He's only fourteen and he's at university." "That's amazing!"
"The shop gave me the shoes for free." "Really? That's strange."
"Tickets are two hundred pounds each." "That's crazy!"
"She swam across the lake in winter." "That's incredible."
"I saw a fox in the garden." "That's unusual."
"I've washed the dishes for you." "Oh, that's lovely. Thanks."
"I'll drive you to the airport." "That's really helpful."
"Here's your umbrella. You left it in class." "That's great, thank you!"
"I'm sorry I'm late." "That's OK. We haven't started yet."
"Do you need any more help?" "No, that's fine, thanks."
"I'm going to Italy next month." "That's exciting! Where are you going?"
"I've started doing yoga." "That's interesting. Do you like it?"
"I bought this jacket for ten pounds." "That's cheap!"
"I have to work all weekend." "That's not fair!"
"My brother can speak five languages." "That's cool!"
"Let's meet at the café at six." "OK, that's fine with me."

examples.heading: ① 聽到好消息

items.en: "I've got a new job." "That's fantastic!"
items.zh: 我找到新工作了。太好了！

items.en: "We're going to have a baby." "That's wonderful news!"
items.zh: 我們要有寶寶了。真是好消息！

items.en: "My sister is coming to visit." "That's nice."
items.zh: 我姊姊要來看我。真好。

items.en: "I got an A in my English exam." "That's brilliant!"
items.zh: 我英文考試拿了 A。太厲害了！

items.en: "The rain has stopped." "That's good. Let's go out."
items.zh: 雨停了。很好，我們出去吧。

examples.heading: ② 聽到壞消息

items.en: "I lost my wallet on the bus." "Oh, that's terrible!"
items.zh: 我的錢包在公車上掉了。喔，真糟糕！

items.en: "The concert was cancelled." "That's a shame."
items.zh: 演唱會取消了。真可惜。

items.en: "I failed my driving test again." "Oh no, that's too bad."
items.zh: 我駕照又沒考過。喔不，真遺憾。

items.en: "My grandmother is in hospital." "I'm sorry. That's awful."
items.zh: 我奶奶住院了。我很遺憾，真不好受。

items.en: "We missed the train by a minute." "That's so annoying!"
items.zh: 我們差一分鐘沒趕上火車。真氣人！

examples.heading: ③ 回應提議

items.en: "Why don't we eat outside?" "That's a great idea!"
items.zh: 我們何不在外面吃？好主意！

items.en: "Let's ask Mr Brown for help." "Yes, that's a good plan."
items.zh: 我們去請布朗老師幫忙吧。對，這個計畫不錯。

items.en: "We could go to the beach on Saturday." "That's perfect! I'm free then."
items.zh: 我們星期六可以去海邊。太好了！我那天有空。

items.en: "Maybe we should leave early." "That's true. The roads will be busy."
items.zh: 也許我們應該早點出發。沒錯，路上會很塞。

items.en: "Shall I bring some drinks?" "That's very kind of you."
items.zh: 要我帶點飲料嗎？你真好。

examples.heading: ④ 表示驚訝

items.en: "He's only fourteen and he's at university." "That's amazing!"
items.zh: 他才十四歲就上大學了。太驚人了！

items.en: "The shop gave me the shoes for free." "Really? That's strange."
items.zh: 店家把鞋子免費送我。真的嗎？好奇怪。

items.en: "Tickets are two hundred pounds each." "That's crazy!"
items.zh: 票一張兩百英鎊。太誇張了！

items.en: "She swam across the lake in winter." "That's incredible."
items.zh: 她冬天游過了那座湖。真不可思議。

items.en: "I saw a fox in the garden." "That's unusual."
items.zh: 我在花園裡看到一隻狐狸。這很少見。

examples.heading: ⑤ 回應別人的幫忙

items.en: "I've washed the dishes for you." "Oh, that's lovely. Thanks."
items.zh: 我幫你洗好碗了。喔，你真好，謝謝。

items.en: "I'll drive you to the airport." "That's really helpful."
items.zh: 我開車送你去機場。這真的幫了大忙。

items.en: "Here's your umbrella. You left it in class." "That's great, thank you!"
items.zh: 這是你的傘，你忘在教室了。太好了，謝謝！

items.en: "I'm sorry I'm late." "That's OK. We haven't started yet."
items.zh: 抱歉我遲到了。沒關係，我們還沒開始。

items.en: "Do you need any more help?" "No, that's fine, thanks."
items.zh: 你還需要幫忙嗎？不用了，這樣就好，謝謝。

examples.heading: ⑥ 朋友間的對話

items.en: "I'm going to Italy next month." "That's exciting! Where are you going?"
items.zh: 我下個月要去義大利。真令人興奮！你要去哪裡？

items.en: "I've started doing yoga." "That's interesting. Do you like it?"
items.zh: 我開始做瑜伽了。真有意思，你喜歡嗎？

items.en: "I bought this jacket for ten pounds." "That's cheap!"
items.zh: 這件夾克我十英鎊買的。真便宜！

items.en: "I have to work all weekend." "That's not fair!"
items.zh: 我整個週末都要工作。這不公平！

items.en: "My brother can speak five languages." "That's cool!"
items.zh: 我哥哥會說五種語言。好酷！

items.en: "Let's meet at the café at six." "OK, that's fine with me."
items.zh: 我們六點在咖啡店見。好，我可以。

title: It is hoped that this report will help the club to improve and meet the needs of the whole school.
translation: 希望這份報告能幫助社團改進，並滿足全校的需求。
name: it 加被動語態（主事者不明或不重要）
sentences: It is hoped that the new bridge will reduce traffic in the town centre.
It is hoped that more students will join the drama club next year.
It was hoped that the talks would end the strike.
It is hoped that the money raised will pay for a new playground.
It is hoped that the changes will make the website easier to use.
It is believed that the fire started in the kitchen.
It is thought that around two thousand people attended the concert.
It is widely believed that exercise improves mood.
It was long thought that the illness could not be cured.
It was considered to be the most important thing to supply every computer with Internet and E-mail access.
It was decided that the school trip would be cancelled.
It was agreed that each member would pay ten pounds.
It has been decided that the shop will close on Sundays.
At the end of the meeting, it was agreed to review the budget in May.
It was decided that a new manager should be appointed.
It is said that the house is haunted.
It has been reported that the singer is planning a new tour.
It is often said that travel broadens the mind.
It was announced that the factory would close in March.
It has been suggested that the park should stay open later in summer.
It is recommended that students bring their own laptops.
It is expected that prices will rise again next year.
It is advised that passengers arrive two hours before their flight.
It is required that all staff complete the safety course.
It is estimated that the work will take six months.
Firstly it was highlighted that so many people take advantage of the park, but our survey clearly contradicts this view.
It was found that most students use the library only before exams.
It was noted that the changing rooms were often dirty.
It is suggested that the club buys new balls and nets.
It was felt that the club meetings were too short.
Finally, it is hoped that the school will take these suggestions seriously.

examples.heading: ① It is hoped that

items.en: It is hoped that the new bridge will reduce traffic in the town centre.
items.zh: 希望新的橋能減少市中心的車流。

items.en: It is hoped that more students will join the drama club next year.
items.zh: 希望明年有更多學生參加戲劇社。

items.en: It was hoped that the talks would end the strike.
items.zh: 當時希望這次談判能結束罷工。

items.en: It is hoped that the money raised will pay for a new playground.
items.zh: 希望募到的錢夠蓋一座新的遊樂場。

items.en: It is hoped that the changes will make the website easier to use.
items.zh: 希望這些改變能讓網站更好用。

examples.heading: ② It is believed / thought that

items.en: It is believed that the fire started in the kitchen.
items.zh: 一般認為火是從廚房燒起來的。

items.en: It is thought that around two thousand people attended the concert.
items.zh: 據估計約有兩千人參加了演唱會。

items.en: It is widely believed that exercise improves mood.
items.zh: 一般普遍認為運動能改善心情。

items.en: It was long thought that the illness could not be cured.
items.zh: 長久以來人們都以為這種病治不好。

items.en: It was considered to be the most important thing to supply every computer with Internet and E-mail access.
items.zh: 當時認為最重要的是讓每台電腦都能上網和收發電子郵件。

examples.heading: ③ It was decided / agreed that

items.en: It was decided that the school trip would be cancelled.
items.zh: 學校決定取消校外教學。

items.en: It was agreed that each member would pay ten pounds.
items.zh: 大家同意每位會員付十英鎊。

items.en: It has been decided that the shop will close on Sundays.
items.zh: 已經決定這家店星期天不營業。

items.en: At the end of the meeting, it was agreed to review the budget in May.
items.zh: 會議最後，大家同意五月再檢討預算。

items.en: It was decided that a new manager should be appointed.
items.zh: 會中決定要任命一位新經理。

examples.heading: ④ It is said / reported that

items.en: It is said that the house is haunted.
items.zh: 據說那棟房子鬧鬼。

items.en: It has been reported that the singer is planning a new tour.
items.zh: 據報導那位歌手正在計畫新的巡迴演出。

items.en: It is often said that travel broadens the mind.
items.zh: 常有人說旅行能開闊眼界。

items.en: It was announced that the factory would close in March.
items.zh: 已經宣布工廠三月要關閉。

items.en: It has been suggested that the park should stay open later in summer.
items.zh: 有人建議公園夏天應該開放到更晚。

examples.heading: ⑤ It is recommended / expected that

items.en: It is recommended that students bring their own laptops.
items.zh: 建議學生自備筆電。

items.en: It is expected that prices will rise again next year.
items.zh: 預計明年物價會再上漲。

items.en: It is advised that passengers arrive two hours before their flight.
items.zh: 建議旅客在班機起飛前兩小時抵達。

items.en: It is required that all staff complete the safety course.
items.zh: 規定所有員工都要完成安全課程。

items.en: It is estimated that the work will take six months.
items.zh: 估計這項工程要花六個月。

examples.heading: ⑥ 報告和調查

items.en: Firstly it was highlighted that so many people take advantage of the park, but our survey clearly contradicts this view.
items.zh: 首先，有人強調很多人都會利用這座公園，可是我們的調查清楚地推翻了這個看法。

items.en: It was found that most students use the library only before exams.
items.zh: 調查發現大部分學生只在考試前去圖書館。

items.en: It was noted that the changing rooms were often dirty.
items.zh: 報告指出更衣室常常很髒。

items.en: It is suggested that the club buys new balls and nets.
items.zh: 建議社團購買新的球和球網。

items.en: It was felt that the club meetings were too short.
items.zh: 大家覺得社團聚會的時間太短。

items.en: Finally, it is hoped that the school will take these suggestions seriously.
items.zh: 最後，希望學校能認真看待這些建議。

title: The one that impressed me most was the Chinese New Year Carnival in Hong Kong.
translation: 讓我印象最深的，是香港的農曆新年嘉年華。
name: the one(s) that 子句當主詞（強調）
sentences: The one that broke down was my brother's car.
The one that got away was the biggest fish of the day.
The one that costs the most isn't always the best.
The one that caught my eye was a little blue teapot.
The one that worries me is the last question.
The one that arrived late was the parcel from Japan.
The one I chose in the end was the cheaper flat.
The one we stayed in was a small cottage by the lake.
The one she recommended is closed on Mondays.
The one that I read last summer was much better.
The one you need is on the top shelf.
The ones that grew fastest were the tomatoes by the wall.
The ones that we bought at the airport were twice the price.
The ones that sell best are the small cakes.
The ones I really miss are my old school friends.
The ones that arrived first got the best seats.
The one who called you was my manager.
The ones who suffer most are the children.
The one who taught me to swim was my uncle.
The ones who stayed until the end were rewarded.
The one who usually complains is always the first to leave.
The one that impressed the judges most was the youngest singer.
The one that frightened me most was the ghost train.
The one I enjoyed least was the history museum.
The ones that lasted longest were the cheapest boots.
The one that made me laugh most was the final scene.
The one that has changed most is the price of housing.
The one that will make the biggest difference is better public transport.
The ones that really matter are the long-term effects.
The one that I think will last is the friendship we built.
The ones that he loved most were the stories about the sea.

examples.heading: ① The one that + 動詞

items.en: The one that broke down was my brother's car.
items.zh: 拋錨的是我哥的車。

items.en: The one that got away was the biggest fish of the day.
items.zh: 跑掉的那條是當天最大的魚。

items.en: The one that costs the most isn't always the best.
items.zh: 最貴的不一定最好。

items.en: The one that caught my eye was a little blue teapot.
items.zh: 吸引我目光的是一個藍色小茶壺。

items.en: The one that worries me is the last question.
items.zh: 我擔心的是最後一題。

items.en: The one that arrived late was the parcel from Japan.
items.zh: 晚到的是從日本寄來的包裹。

examples.heading: ② The one (that) + 主詞 + 動詞

items.en: The one I chose in the end was the cheaper flat.
items.zh: 我最後選的是比較便宜的那間公寓。

items.en: The one we stayed in was a small cottage by the lake.
items.zh: 我們住的是湖邊的一間小屋。

items.en: The one she recommended is closed on Mondays.
items.zh: 她推薦的那家星期一沒開。

items.en: The one that I read last summer was much better.
items.zh: 我去年夏天讀的那本好看多了。

items.en: The one you need is on the top shelf.
items.zh: 你要的那個在最上層。

examples.heading: ③ The ones that

items.en: The ones that grew fastest were the tomatoes by the wall.
items.zh: 長得最快的是牆邊的番茄。

items.en: The ones that we bought at the airport were twice the price.
items.zh: 我們在機場買的那些貴了一倍。

items.en: The ones that sell best are the small cakes.
items.zh: 賣得最好的是小蛋糕。

items.en: The ones I really miss are my old school friends.
items.zh: 我真正想念的是我的老同學。

items.en: The ones that arrived first got the best seats.
items.zh: 先到的人拿到了最好的位子。

examples.heading: ④ the one who / the ones who

items.en: The one who called you was my manager.
items.zh: 打給你的是我的主管。

items.en: The ones who suffer most are the children.
items.zh: 受害最深的是孩子。

items.en: The one who taught me to swim was my uncle.
items.zh: 教我游泳的是我叔叔。

items.en: The ones who stayed until the end were rewarded.
items.zh: 待到最後的人都得到了回報。

items.en: The one who usually complains is always the first to leave.
items.zh: 最常抱怨的人總是最先走。

examples.heading: ⑤ 最高級和 most

items.en: The one that impressed the judges most was the youngest singer.
items.zh: 最讓評審印象深刻的是年紀最小的歌手。

items.en: The one that frightened me most was the ghost train.
items.zh: 最讓我害怕的是鬼屋列車。

items.en: The one I enjoyed least was the history museum.
items.zh: 我最不喜歡的是歷史博物館。

items.en: The ones that lasted longest were the cheapest boots.
items.zh: 最耐穿的反而是最便宜的靴子。

items.en: The one that made me laugh most was the final scene.
items.zh: 讓我笑得最厲害的是最後一幕。

examples.heading: ⑥ 談經驗和看法

items.en: The one that has changed most is the price of housing.
items.zh: 改變最大的是房價。

items.en: The one that will make the biggest difference is better public transport.
items.zh: 影響最大的會是更好的大眾運輸。

items.en: The ones that really matter are the long-term effects.
items.zh: 真正重要的是長期的影響。

items.en: The one that I think will last is the friendship we built.
items.zh: 我覺得會長久的，是我們建立起來的友誼。

items.en: The ones that he loved most were the stories about the sea.
items.zh: 他最愛的是關於大海的故事。

title: There are a lot of things that should be done, but let's just start with these ones.
translation: 該做的事情很多，不過我們就先從這些開始吧。
name: these ones、those ones 代替前文的複數名詞
sentences: Those trainers are too expensive. These ones are on sale.
Don't use those towels. These ones are clean.
I've brought some new games. Do you want to try these ones?
Those biscuits are mine. You can have these ones.
My old jeans are torn, so I'm wearing these ones today.
These flowers are nice, but those ones are even prettier.
These seats are taken. Let's sit in those ones by the window.
Which cakes do you want? Those ones at the back look good.
These boxes are empty. Can you check those ones over there?
I need some jars, but I can't reach those ones on the top shelf.
I'd like some apples, please. Can I have those ones?
These earrings are lovely. How much are these ones?
Have you got these sunglasses in black? I only see those ones in brown.
These socks are too thin. Are those ones thicker?
I tried on those boots, but these ones fit me better.
These photos are better than those ones from last year.
Your drawings are more colourful than these ones.
These grapes are sweeter than those ones we bought yesterday.
These rooms are bigger than those ones downstairs.
Those keys don't work. Try these ones instead.
I don't like these red pens. Are those green ones any better?
Our old chairs were broken, so we bought these new ones.
We sell two sizes of cups. These small ones are for children.
We've got lots of bags. Those big ones over there are too heavy to carry.
Both kinds of skirts are nice, but I prefer these short ones to those long ones.
We have many problems, but these ones are the most urgent.
There are several ideas on the list. Let's discuss these ones first.
Some rules are useful, but those ones about uniforms are not.
I've finished the easy tasks. Now I'll start on these ones.
We can't fix every road this year, so let's repair these ones first.
Those plans were too expensive, so the council chose these ones.

examples.heading: ① these ones：近的東西

items.en: Those trainers are too expensive. These ones are on sale.
items.zh: 那雙運動鞋太貴了，這雙在特價。

items.en: Don't use those towels. These ones are clean.
items.zh: 別用那些毛巾，這些是乾淨的。

items.en: I've brought some new games. Do you want to try these ones?
items.zh: 我帶了幾個新遊戲，你要試試這些嗎？

items.en: Those biscuits are mine. You can have these ones.
items.zh: 那些餅乾是我的，你可以吃這些。

items.en: My old jeans are torn, so I'm wearing these ones today.
items.zh: 我的舊牛仔褲破了，所以我今天穿這條。

examples.heading: ② those ones：遠的東西

items.en: These flowers are nice, but those ones are even prettier.
items.zh: 這些花很漂亮，可是那些更漂亮。

items.en: These seats are taken. Let's sit in those ones by the window.
items.zh: 這些位子有人坐了，我們去坐窗邊那些吧。

items.en: Which cakes do you want? Those ones at the back look good.
items.zh: 你要哪些蛋糕？後面那些看起來不錯。

items.en: These boxes are empty. Can you check those ones over there?
items.zh: 這些箱子是空的，你可以看看那邊那些嗎？

items.en: I need some jars, but I can't reach those ones on the top shelf.
items.zh: 我需要幾個罐子，可是最上面那層的我拿不到。

examples.heading: ③ 在商店

items.en: I'd like some apples, please. Can I have those ones?
items.zh: 我想買一些蘋果，可以給我那些嗎？

items.en: These earrings are lovely. How much are these ones?
items.zh: 這些耳環很漂亮，這些多少錢？

items.en: Have you got these sunglasses in black? I only see those ones in brown.
items.zh: 這副太陽眼鏡有黑色的嗎？我只看到那邊咖啡色的。

items.en: These socks are too thin. Are those ones thicker?
items.zh: 這些襪子太薄了，那些有比較厚嗎？

items.en: I tried on those boots, but these ones fit me better.
items.zh: 那雙靴子我試穿過了，可是這雙比較合腳。

examples.heading: ④ 比較兩組東西

items.en: These photos are better than those ones from last year.
items.zh: 這些照片比去年那些好。

items.en: Your drawings are more colourful than these ones.
items.zh: 你的畫比這些畫色彩多。

items.en: These grapes are sweeter than those ones we bought yesterday.
items.zh: 這些葡萄比我們昨天買的那些甜。

items.en: These rooms are bigger than those ones downstairs.
items.zh: 這些房間比樓下那些大。

items.en: Those keys don't work. Try these ones instead.
items.zh: 那些鑰匙打不開，改用這些試試看。

examples.heading: ⑤ 中間加形容詞

items.en: I don't like these red pens. Are those green ones any better?
items.zh: 我不喜歡這些紅筆，那些綠的有比較好嗎？

items.en: Our old chairs were broken, so we bought these new ones.
items.zh: 我們的舊椅子壞了，所以我們買了這些新的。

items.en: We sell two sizes of cups. These small ones are for children.
items.zh: 我們賣兩種大小的杯子，這些小的是給小孩子用的。

items.en: We've got lots of bags. Those big ones over there are too heavy to carry.
items.zh: 我們有很多袋子，那邊那些大的太重了，搬不動。

items.en: Both kinds of skirts are nice, but I prefer these short ones to those long ones.
items.zh: 兩種裙子都很好看，不過比起那些長的，我比較喜歡這些短的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 計畫和建議

items.en: We have many problems, but these ones are the most urgent.
items.zh: 我們有很多問題，不過這幾個最急。

items.en: There are several ideas on the list. Let's discuss these ones first.
items.zh: 清單上有好幾個點子，我們先討論這幾個。

items.en: Some rules are useful, but those ones about uniforms are not.
items.zh: 有些規定很有用，可是那幾條關於制服的就沒用。

items.en: I've finished the easy tasks. Now I'll start on these ones.
items.zh: 簡單的工作我做完了，現在我要開始做這些。

items.en: We can't fix every road this year, so let's repair these ones first.
items.zh: 我們今年沒辦法把每條路都修好，所以先修這幾條。

items.en: Those plans were too expensive, so the council chose these ones.
items.zh: 那些計畫太貴了，所以議會選了這些。

title: I don't usually wear dresses, but I had to buy this one because I am going to be in a singing competition.
translation: 我平常不太穿洋裝，可是我得買這件，因為我要參加一場歌唱比賽。
name: this one、that one 代替前述名詞
sentences: I've tried on lots of jackets, but I like this one best.
My old bike was stolen, so I bought this one.
I've read all his books. This one is the funniest.
There are many cafés here, but this one has the best coffee.
That hotel was noisy, so we moved to this one.
Which house do you live in? That one with the green door.
This table is too small. Let's sit at that one by the window.
I don't want this cake. Can I have that one?
This bus doesn't go to the station. You need to take that one.
Look at all those dogs. That one is really cute.
"Did you like the film last night?" "No, I didn't enjoy that one."
"Have you read the book I gave you?" "Yes, that one was great."
"Do you know the song on the radio?" "Yes, that one is my favourite."
"I'm thinking about the job at the bank." "I think you should take that one."
"Is the blue car yours?" "No, mine is that one behind it."
I like these mugs. How much is this one?
This shirt is too big. Have you got this one in a smaller size?
I'm looking for a watch. Can I see that one, please?
This lamp is too bright. Can I see that one in the corner?
All these cakes look good, but I'll take this one.
I don't want the black hat. I'll take that brown one.
That old laptop is too slow. I'll use this new one.
This big room is for meetings, and that small one is my office.
Which apple do you want, this green one or that red one?
I don't want this plastic chair. I'll sit on that wooden one.
There were two films on TV, and I chose this one because it was short.
Of all the films on the list, I've chosen that one because my father and brother like it too.
There are two English courses. I'm taking this one because it's in the evening.
We looked at three flats and decided on that one near the park.
I usually take the early bus, but today I took this one because I got up late.
I don't usually eat spicy dishes, but I ordered this one because it looked so good.

examples.heading: ① this one：近的東西

items.en: I've tried on lots of jackets, but I like this one best.
items.zh: 我試穿了很多件夾克，可是我最喜歡這件。

items.en: My old bike was stolen, so I bought this one.
items.zh: 我的舊腳踏車被偷了，所以我買了這輛。

items.en: I've read all his books. This one is the funniest.
items.zh: 他的書我都讀過，這本最好笑。

items.en: There are many cafés here, but this one has the best coffee.
items.zh: 這裡有很多咖啡店，可是這家的咖啡最好喝。

items.en: That hotel was noisy, so we moved to this one.
items.zh: 那家旅館很吵，所以我們搬到這家。

examples.heading: ② that one：遠的東西

items.en: Which house do you live in? That one with the green door.
items.zh: 你住哪一棟房子？那棟有綠色大門的。

items.en: This table is too small. Let's sit at that one by the window.
items.zh: 這張桌子太小了，我們去坐窗邊那張吧。

items.en: I don't want this cake. Can I have that one?
items.zh: 我不要這塊蛋糕，我可以吃那塊嗎？

items.en: This bus doesn't go to the station. You need to take that one.
items.zh: 這班公車不到車站，你要搭那班。

items.en: Look at all those dogs. That one is really cute.
items.zh: 你看那些狗，那隻好可愛。

examples.heading: ③ 指對方說過的東西

items.en: "Did you like the film last night?" "No, I didn't enjoy that one."
items.zh: 你喜歡昨晚那部電影嗎？不喜歡，那部我看得不開心。

items.en: "Have you read the book I gave you?" "Yes, that one was great."
items.zh: 你讀了我給你的那本書嗎？讀了，那本很棒。

items.en: "Do you know the song on the radio?" "Yes, that one is my favourite."
items.zh: 你知道廣播在放的那首歌嗎？知道，那首是我最喜歡的。

items.en: "I'm thinking about the job at the bank." "I think you should take that one."
items.zh: 我在考慮銀行那份工作。我覺得你應該接那份。

items.en: "Is the blue car yours?" "No, mine is that one behind it."
items.zh: 那輛藍色的車是你的嗎？不是，我的是後面那輛。

examples.heading: ④ 在商店

items.en: I like these mugs. How much is this one?
items.zh: 我喜歡這些馬克杯，這個多少錢？

items.en: This shirt is too big. Have you got this one in a smaller size?
items.zh: 這件襯衫太大了，這件有小一點的尺寸嗎？

items.en: I'm looking for a watch. Can I see that one, please?
items.zh: 我在找手錶，可以給我看看那支嗎？

items.en: This lamp is too bright. Can I see that one in the corner?
items.zh: 這盞燈太亮了，我可以看看角落那盞嗎？

items.en: All these cakes look good, but I'll take this one.
items.zh: 這些蛋糕看起來都很好吃，不過我要這塊。

examples.heading: ⑤ 中間加形容詞

items.en: I don't want the black hat. I'll take that brown one.
items.zh: 我不要那頂黑帽子，我要那頂咖啡色的。

items.en: That old laptop is too slow. I'll use this new one.
items.zh: 那台舊筆電太慢了，我要用這台新的。

items.en: This big room is for meetings, and that small one is my office.
items.zh: 這間大房間是開會用的，那間小的是我的辦公室。

items.en: Which apple do you want, this green one or that red one?
items.zh: 你要哪一顆蘋果，這顆綠的還是那顆紅的？

items.en: I don't want this plastic chair. I'll sit on that wooden one.
items.zh: 我不要這張塑膠椅，我要坐那張木頭的。

examples.heading: ⑥ 選擇和說明原因

items.en: There were two films on TV, and I chose this one because it was short.
items.zh: 電視上有兩部電影，我選了這部，因為它比較短。

items.en: Of all the films on the list, I've chosen that one because my father and brother like it too.
items.zh: 清單上那麼多電影，我選了那部，因為我爸爸和哥哥也喜歡。

items.en: There are two English courses. I'm taking this one because it's in the evening.
items.zh: 有兩門英文課，我要上這門，因為它在晚上上課。

items.en: We looked at three flats and decided on that one near the park.
items.zh: 我們看了三間公寓，決定租公園附近那間。

items.en: I usually take the early bus, but today I took this one because I got up late.
items.zh: 我平常搭早一點的公車，不過今天睡晚了，所以搭了這班。

items.en: I don't usually eat spicy dishes, but I ordered this one because it looked so good.
items.zh: 我平常不太吃辣的菜，不過我點了這道，因為它看起來很好吃。

title: All those attending are requested to be on time.
translation: 所有與會者請準時出席。
name: 代名詞 those 後接關係子句或分詞
sentences: Those who want to join the club should sign up by Friday.
The museum is free for those who are under eighteen.
Heaven helps those who help themselves.
Those who have finished the test may leave the room.
We offer special prices for those who book early.
Those taking the exam must bring their ID cards.
All those wishing to speak at the meeting should contact the secretary.
Free drinks will be given to those waiting in line.
Those travelling abroad need a valid passport.
There is a car park for those visiting the hospital.
Of those surveyed, 87% said the store was good.
Most of those questioned did not know the answer.
Those injured in the accident were taken to hospital.
The names of those selected will be announced next week.
Among those arrested were two teenagers.
Students should study all the subjects, not only those which are enjoyable.
We looked at the old houses. Those that can be repaired will not be pulled down.
These photos are nicer than those taken last year.
The best seats are those near the stage.
Some of the books are new, but those on the top shelf are very old.
Those not attending the dinner should tell us by Monday.
Passengers are reminded that those without tickets will be fined.
Those parking in the staff area will be asked to move their cars.
All those interested in the trip should come to Room 12 after lunch.
Those who need help with their luggage may ask our staff.
For those who don't like sports, the town should open more shops in the centre.
The new law will help those living on low incomes.
Life is hard for those who have lost their jobs.
Those born after 2000 have grown up with the internet.
The report shows that those working at home are often happier.
We should think about those who cannot afford to pay.

examples.heading: ① those who + 動詞

items.en: Those who want to join the club should sign up by Friday.
items.zh: 想參加社團的人要在星期五以前報名。

items.en: The museum is free for those who are under eighteen.
items.zh: 未滿十八歲的人可以免費參觀博物館。

items.en: Heaven helps those who help themselves.
items.zh: 天助自助者。

items.en: Those who have finished the test may leave the room.
items.zh: 寫完考卷的人可以離開教室。

items.en: We offer special prices for those who book early.
items.zh: 提早訂位的人有特別優惠。

examples.heading: ② those + -ing 分詞

items.en: Those taking the exam must bring their ID cards.
items.zh: 參加考試的人要帶身分證。

items.en: All those wishing to speak at the meeting should contact the secretary.
items.zh: 所有想在會議上發言的人請和秘書聯絡。

items.en: Free drinks will be given to those waiting in line.
items.zh: 排隊的人可以拿到免費飲料。

items.en: Those travelling abroad need a valid passport.
items.zh: 出國的人需要有效的護照。

items.en: There is a car park for those visiting the hospital.
items.zh: 醫院有停車場給來探病的人用。

examples.heading: ③ those + -ed 分詞

items.en: Of those surveyed, 87% said the store was good.
items.zh: 受訪的人有百分之八十七說這家店很好。

items.en: Most of those questioned did not know the answer.
items.zh: 被問到的人大部分都不知道答案。

items.en: Those injured in the accident were taken to hospital.
items.zh: 在意外中受傷的人被送到醫院。

items.en: The names of those selected will be announced next week.
items.zh: 入選的人名下星期公布。

items.en: Among those arrested were two teenagers.
items.zh: 被逮捕的人裡面有兩個青少年。

examples.heading: ④ those 代替前面的複數名詞

items.en: Students should study all the subjects, not only those which are enjoyable.
items.zh: 學生應該讀所有的科目，不是只讀有趣的科目。

items.en: We looked at the old houses. Those that can be repaired will not be pulled down.
items.zh: 我們看了那些舊房子。可以修的不會被拆掉。

items.en: These photos are nicer than those taken last year.
items.zh: 這些照片比去年拍的好看。

items.en: The best seats are those near the stage.
items.zh: 最好的位子是靠近舞台的位子。

items.en: Some of the books are new, but those on the top shelf are very old.
items.zh: 有些書是新的，可是最上面一層的書很舊。

examples.heading: ⑤ 公告和通知

items.en: Those not attending the dinner should tell us by Monday.
items.zh: 不參加晚餐的人請在星期一以前告訴我們。

items.en: Passengers are reminded that those without tickets will be fined.
items.zh: 提醒各位乘客，沒有車票的人會被罰款。

items.en: Those parking in the staff area will be asked to move their cars.
items.zh: 停在員工停車區的人會被要求把車開走。

items.en: All those interested in the trip should come to Room 12 after lunch.
items.zh: 所有對這次旅行有興趣的人請在午餐後到十二號教室。

items.en: Those who need help with their luggage may ask our staff.
items.zh: 需要人幫忙拿行李的人可以找我們的工作人員。

examples.heading: ⑥ 文章和報告

items.en: For those who don't like sports, the town should open more shops in the centre.
items.zh: 對不喜歡運動的人來說，鎮上應該在市中心多開一些商店。

items.en: The new law will help those living on low incomes.
items.zh: 新法律會幫助收入低的人。

items.en: Life is hard for those who have lost their jobs.
items.zh: 對失業的人來說，日子很難過。

items.en: Those born after 2000 have grown up with the internet.
items.zh: 二〇〇〇年以後出生的人是在網路陪伴下長大的。

items.en: The report shows that those working at home are often happier.
items.zh: 報告顯示在家工作的人通常比較快樂。

items.en: We should think about those who cannot afford to pay.
items.zh: 我們應該為付不起錢的人著想。

items.en: I can't remember which one I booked.
items.zh: 我不記得我訂的是哪一間。

items.en: Nobody could tell which one was the original.
items.zh: 沒有人分得出哪一個是原版。

items.en: We found out which one was broken.
items.zh: 我們查出是哪一個壞了。

examples.heading: ③ 決定和選擇

items.en: I can't decide which one to wear tonight.
items.zh: 我決定不了今晚要穿哪一件。

items.en: It's hard to choose which one to read first.
items.zh: 很難決定先看哪一本。

items.en: Let's decide which one we should buy.
items.zh: 我們來決定該買哪一個吧。

items.en: You can choose which one you want.
items.zh: 你可以選你想要的那一個。

items.en: He couldn't decide which one to apply for.
items.zh: 他決定不了要申請哪一個。

examples.heading: ④ 說和指

items.en: Tell me which one you prefer.
items.zh: 告訴我你比較喜歡哪一個。

items.en: Can you show me which one is broken?
items.zh: 你可以指給我看哪一個壞了嗎？

items.en: She told me which one to take.
items.zh: 她告訴我要拿哪一個。

items.en: Point to which one you mean.
items.zh: 指一下你說的是哪一個。

items.en: Please let us know which one suits you.
items.zh: 請告訴我們哪一個適合你。

examples.heading: ⑤ 比較選項

items.en: Look at the two plans and see which one is cheaper.
items.zh: 看看這兩個方案，哪一個比較便宜。

items.en: Try both and see which one you like better.
items.zh: 兩個都試試看，看你比較喜歡哪一個。

items.en: Write down the good and bad points, and you'll see which one is best.
items.zh: 把優點和缺點寫下來，就看得出哪一個最好。

items.en: Compare the two phones and find out which one lasts longer.
items.zh: 比較這兩支手機，看哪一支比較耐用。

items.en: Think about which one will be more useful in the future.
items.zh: 想想看哪一個以後比較有用。

examples.heading: ⑥ 不確定

items.en: I'm not sure which one he meant.
items.zh: 我不確定他指的是哪一個。

items.en: It doesn't matter which one you take.
items.zh: 你拿哪一個都沒關係。

items.en: I have no idea which one is better.
items.zh: 我完全不知道哪一個比較好。

items.en: We weren't sure which one to trust.
items.zh: 我們不確定該相信哪一個。

items.en: It depends on which one is cheaper.
items.zh: 要看哪一個比較便宜。

items.en: Do you care which one I bring?
items.zh: 我帶哪一個你在意嗎？

title: If you need anything else, you'll find it in the classroom.
translation: 如果你還需要什麼別的東西，教室裡都有。
name: 不定代名詞加 else
sentences: This shirt is too small. Have you got something else?
I wanted to tell you something else.
I'm tired of pasta. Can we cook something else tonight?
He was thinking about something else.
Can we talk about something else, please?
Would you like anything else with your coffee?
Is there anything else on the list?
I don't remember anything else about that night.
Did he say anything else?
We don't need anything else for the trip.
Anything else, madam?
This seat is taken. Somebody else is sitting here.
She's going out with someone else now.
Can somebody else help me with this box?
I picked up someone else's keys.
Let someone else drive this time.
Everyone else had already left.
I'll pay for the tickets. You pay for everything else.
Everybody else in my class has a bike.
Apart from the rain, everything else was perfect.
She arrived after everyone else.
There was nothing else in the box.
No one else knows about this.
I want this phone and nothing else.
Nobody else wanted the job.
There's nothing else on TV.
Can we sit somewhere else? It's too sunny here.
You won't find cheaper shoes anywhere else.
I'd like to live somewhere else one day.
Have you looked anywhere else?
My cat won't sleep anywhere else.

examples.heading: ① something else

items.en: This shirt is too small. Have you got something else?
items.zh: 這件襯衫太小了。你們有別的嗎？

items.en: I wanted to tell you something else.
items.zh: 我還有別的事想跟你說。

items.en: I'm tired of pasta. Can we cook something else tonight?
items.zh: 我吃膩義大利麵了。今晚可以煮點別的嗎？

items.en: He was thinking about something else.
items.zh: 他在想別的事。

items.en: Can we talk about something else, please?
items.zh: 我們可以聊點別的嗎？

examples.heading: ② anything else

items.en: Would you like anything else with your coffee?
items.zh: 你的咖啡還要搭點別的嗎？

items.en: Is there anything else on the list?
items.zh: 清單上還有別的嗎？

items.en: I don't remember anything else about that night.
items.zh: 那天晚上的事我別的都不記得了。

items.en: Did he say anything else?
items.zh: 他還有說別的嗎？

items.en: We don't need anything else for the trip.
items.zh: 這趟旅行我們不需要別的東西了。

items.en: Anything else, madam?
items.zh: 女士，還需要別的嗎？

examples.heading: ③ someone else / somebody else

items.en: This seat is taken. Somebody else is sitting here.
items.zh: 這個位子有人了。有別人坐這裡。

items.en: She's going out with someone else now.
items.zh: 她現在跟別人在交往。

items.en: Can somebody else help me with this box?
items.zh: 有沒有其他人可以幫我搬這個箱子？

items.en: I picked up someone else's keys.
items.zh: 我拿錯了別人的鑰匙。

items.en: Let someone else drive this time.
items.zh: 這次讓別人開車吧。

examples.heading: ④ everyone else / everything else

items.en: Everyone else had already left.
items.zh: 其他人都已經走了。

items.en: I'll pay for the tickets. You pay for everything else.
items.zh: 票錢我出，其他的你付。

items.en: Everybody else in my class has a bike.
items.zh: 我們班其他人都有腳踏車。

items.en: Apart from the rain, everything else was perfect.
items.zh: 除了下雨，其他都很完美。

items.en: She arrived after everyone else.
items.zh: 她比其他人都晚到。

examples.heading: ⑤ nothing else / no one else

items.en: There was nothing else in the box.
items.zh: 箱子裡沒有別的東西了。

items.en: No one else knows about this.
items.zh: 這件事沒有其他人知道。

items.en: I want this phone and nothing else.
items.zh: 我只要這支手機，別的都不要。

items.en: Nobody else wanted the job.
items.zh: 沒有其他人想要這份工作。

items.en: There's nothing else on TV.
items.zh: 電視上沒有別的節目了。

examples.heading: ⑥ somewhere else / anywhere else

items.en: Can we sit somewhere else? It's too sunny here.
items.zh: 我們可以坐別的地方嗎？這裡太曬了。

items.en: You won't find cheaper shoes anywhere else.
items.zh: 別的地方買不到更便宜的鞋子了。

items.en: I'd like to live somewhere else one day.
items.zh: 我希望有一天能住到別的地方去。

items.en: Have you looked anywhere else?
items.zh: 你有找過別的地方嗎？

items.en: My cat won't sleep anywhere else.
items.zh: 我的貓不肯睡在別的地方。

title: I've booked two tickets for both of us, so I hope you'll come.
translation: 我已經訂了兩張票，我們兩個一人一張，所以希望你會來。
name: all 和 both 加 of 加受格代名詞
sentences: All of us love going to the beach.
The teacher gave all of us a sticker.
All of us sang Happy Birthday to Grandma.
Dad made pancakes for all of us.
The bus was too small to take all of us.
I want to thank all of you for coming.
I bought some new books, but I haven't read all of them.
My grandparents have five grandchildren, and they love all of them.
All of you need to bring a pen tomorrow.
There are many buttons on the camera, but I don't know how to use all of them.
Both of us like football.
My brother and I were late, so both of us missed the bus.
The room is big enough for both of us.
Both of us want to go to the party.
Mum took a photo of both of us.
I'd like to see both of you this weekend.
I have two cousins, and both of them live in Paris.
The tickets are five pounds, but I can pay for both of them.
Both of you did a great job.
I've got two bikes, but both of them are old.
I saw your old classmates. All of them asked about you.
My two sisters are clever. Both of them are good at maths.
All of us enjoyed the film.
Both of you are welcome to stay for dinner.
Our cats look the same. All of them have green eyes.
We had a great time, and all of us want to go back next year.
I've bought presents for both of you.
Your family were so kind to me. Please say hello to all of them for me.
I hope both of you can come to my birthday party.
My friends from school were there, and all of them sent their love.
Both of us are looking forward to seeing you.

examples.heading: ① all of us

items.en: All of us love going to the beach.
items.zh: 我們全都喜歡去海邊。

items.en: The teacher gave all of us a sticker.
items.zh: 老師給我們每個人一張貼紙。

items.en: All of us sang Happy Birthday to Grandma.
items.zh: 我們大家一起唱生日快樂歌給奶奶聽。

items.en: Dad made pancakes for all of us.
items.zh: 爸爸做了鬆餅給我們大家吃。

items.en: The bus was too small to take all of us.
items.zh: 公車太小，載不下我們全部的人。

examples.heading: ② all of you / all of them

items.en: I want to thank all of you for coming.
items.zh: 我要謝謝你們大家來。

items.en: I bought some new books, but I haven't read all of them.
items.zh: 我買了一些新書，可是還沒全部讀完。

items.en: My grandparents have five grandchildren, and they love all of them.
items.zh: 我的祖父母有五個孫子，他們每個都愛。

items.en: All of you need to bring a pen tomorrow.
items.zh: 你們明天全都要帶一支筆。

items.en: There are many buttons on the camera, but I don't know how to use all of them.
items.zh: 相機上的按鈕很多，可是我不知道全部要怎麼用。

examples.heading: ③ both of us

items.en: Both of us like football.
items.zh: 我們兩個都喜歡足球。

items.en: My brother and I were late, so both of us missed the bus.
items.zh: 我和我哥都遲到了，所以兩個都沒趕上公車。

items.en: The room is big enough for both of us.
items.zh: 這個房間夠我們兩個住。

items.en: Both of us want to go to the party.
items.zh: 我們兩個都想去參加派對。

items.en: Mum took a photo of both of us.
items.zh: 媽媽幫我們兩個拍了一張照片。

examples.heading: ④ both of you / both of them

items.en: I'd like to see both of you this weekend.
items.zh: 這個週末我想見你們兩個。

items.en: I have two cousins, and both of them live in Paris.
items.zh: 我有兩個表姊，兩個都住在巴黎。

items.en: The tickets are five pounds, but I can pay for both of them.
items.zh: 票五英鎊一張，不過兩張我可以付。

items.en: Both of you did a great job.
items.zh: 你們兩個都做得很好。

items.en: I've got two bikes, but both of them are old.
items.zh: 我有兩輛腳踏車，可是兩輛都很舊了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 當主詞

items.en: I saw your old classmates. All of them asked about you.
items.zh: 我遇到你以前的同學，他們全都問起你。

items.en: My two sisters are clever. Both of them are good at maths.
items.zh: 我的兩個姊姊很聰明，兩個數學都很好。

items.en: All of us enjoyed the film.
items.zh: 我們全都很喜歡這部電影。

items.en: Both of you are welcome to stay for dinner.
items.zh: 歡迎你們兩個留下來吃晚飯。

items.en: Our cats look the same. All of them have green eyes.
items.zh: 我們家的貓長得都一樣，全都是綠眼睛。

examples.heading: ⑥ 在信和電子郵件裡

items.en: We had a great time, and all of us want to go back next year.
items.zh: 我們玩得很開心，明年大家都想再去。

items.en: I've bought presents for both of you.
items.zh: 我買了禮物給你們兩個。

items.en: Your family were so kind to me. Please say hello to all of them for me.
items.zh: 你的家人對我很好，請幫我跟他們大家問好。

items.en: I hope both of you can come to my birthday party.
items.zh: 希望你們兩個都能來我的生日派對。

items.en: My friends from school were there, and all of them sent their love.
items.zh: 我的老同學都在，他們全都要我問候你。

items.en: Both of us are looking forward to seeing you.
items.zh: 我們兩個都很期待見到你。

title: Please make sure each of them has a computer.
translation: 請確認他們每個人都有一台電腦。
name: 代名詞加 of 加受格代名詞
sentences: Some of us are going to the cinema tonight.
Some of you have already finished the test.
I baked cookies and gave some of them to my neighbours.
I have five cousins. Some of them are closer to me than others, but I love them all.
I've got lots of old comics. You can have some of them.
A few of us went for a walk after dinner.
I know most of the players, but only a few of them know me.
A few of you will need to come in early tomorrow.
She wrote many poems, and a few of them were published.
We met lots of local people, but only a few of them spoke English well.
Have any of you been to Japan?
There were lots of people at the party, but I didn't recognise any of them.
If any of you have questions, please ask.
Travelling is not a problem for any of us.
Here are the cakes. You can choose any of them.
Each of us brought something to eat.
The twins are friendly, and each of them loves dogs.
Each of you will get a certificate at the end of the course.
I phoned each of them to say thank you.
I asked my three brothers, and each of them has a different opinion.
I bought lots of postcards and sent some of them home.
Our neighbours are nice. We often invite a few of them for dinner.
My cousins were at the party. Did you meet any of them?
The coach spoke to each of us after the game.
I've made some sandwiches. Take a few of them for the journey.
I've taken many photos with my new camera, and I'll email some of them to you.
The students have a test next week. Please ensure each of them can practise for half an hour after class.
A few of us would like to join the evening class.
Please let me know if any of you cannot come.
Some of us think the meeting should start later.
I hope each of you enjoys the trip.

examples.heading: ① some of us / some of you / some of them

items.en: Some of us are going to the cinema tonight.
items.zh: 我們有些人今晚要去看電影。

items.en: Some of you have already finished the test.
items.zh: 你們有些人已經寫完考試了。

items.en: I baked cookies and gave some of them to my neighbours.
items.zh: 我烤了餅乾，分了一些給鄰居。

items.en: I have five cousins. Some of them are closer to me than others, but I love them all.
items.zh: 我有五個表兄弟姊妹，有些跟我比較親，不過我每個都愛。

items.en: I've got lots of old comics. You can have some of them.
items.zh: 我有很多舊漫畫，你可以拿一些去。

examples.heading: ② a few of us / a few of them

items.en: A few of us went for a walk after dinner.
items.zh: 我們有幾個人晚飯後去散步。

items.en: I know most of the players, but only a few of them know me.
items.zh: 我認識大部分的球員，可是認識我的只有幾個。

items.en: A few of you will need to come in early tomorrow.
items.zh: 你們有幾個人明天要早點來。

items.en: She wrote many poems, and a few of them were published.
items.zh: 她寫了很多詩，其中有幾首出版了。

items.en: We met lots of local people, but only a few of them spoke English well.
items.zh: 我們遇到很多當地人，可是只有幾個人英文說得好。

examples.heading: ③ any of us / any of you / any of them

items.en: Have any of you been to Japan?
items.zh: 你們有誰去過日本嗎？

items.en: There were lots of people at the party, but I didn't recognise any of them.
items.zh: 派對上人很多，可是我一個也認不出來。

items.en: If any of you have questions, please ask.
items.zh: 你們誰有問題就請問。

items.en: Travelling is not a problem for any of us.
items.zh: 旅行對我們每個人來說都不是問題。

items.en: Here are the cakes. You can choose any of them.
items.zh: 蛋糕在這裡，你可以選其中任何一個。

examples.heading: ④ each of us / each of you / each of them

items.en: Each of us brought something to eat.
items.zh: 我們每個人都帶了吃的東西。

items.en: The twins are friendly, and each of them loves dogs.
items.zh: 那對雙胞胎很友善，兩個都很愛狗。

items.en: Each of you will get a certificate at the end of the course.
items.zh: 課程結束時，你們每個人都會拿到一張證書。

items.en: I phoned each of them to say thank you.
items.zh: 我打電話給他們每個人道謝。

items.en: I asked my three brothers, and each of them has a different opinion.
items.zh: 我問了我的三個哥哥，他們每個人的意見都不一樣。

examples.heading: ⑤ 當受詞

items.en: I bought lots of postcards and sent some of them home.
items.zh: 我買了很多明信片，寄了一些回家。

items.en: Our neighbours are nice. We often invite a few of them for dinner.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居人很好，我們常請幾個人來吃晚飯。

items.en: My cousins were at the party. Did you meet any of them?
items.zh: 我的表兄弟姊妹也在派對上，你有見到他們之中的誰嗎？

items.en: The coach spoke to each of us after the game.
items.zh: 比賽結束後，教練跟我們每個人都談過。

items.en: I've made some sandwiches. Take a few of them for the journey.
items.zh: 我做了一些三明治，帶幾個路上吃。

examples.heading: ⑥ 在信和電子郵件裡

items.en: I've taken many photos with my new camera, and I'll email some of them to you.
items.zh: 我用新相機拍了很多照片，會用電子郵件寄幾張給你。

items.en: The students have a test next week. Please ensure each of them can practise for half an hour after class.
items.zh: 學生們下星期有考試，請確認他們每個人下課後都能練習半小時。

items.en: A few of us would like to join the evening class.
items.zh: 我們有幾個人想參加晚間課程。

items.en: Please let me know if any of you cannot come.
items.zh: 你們誰不能來，請告訴我。

items.en: Some of us think the meeting should start later.
items.zh: 我們有些人認為會議應該晚一點開始。

items.en: I hope each of you enjoys the trip.
items.zh: 希望你們每個人都玩得愉快。

title: We didn't know what they wanted, and none of us spoke any Italian.
translation: 我們不知道他們想要什麼，而且我們沒有一個人會說義大利語。
name: neither、either、none of 加受格代名詞
sentences: Neither of us had been to Rome before.
I spoke to both doctors, but neither of them could help.
Neither of them wanted to wash the dishes.
We both tried, but neither of us passed the test.
She has two cats, and neither of them likes water.
Have either of you seen my glasses?
I don't think either of them will come.
If either of you needs help, just call me.
Either of them would be a good choice.
I didn't like either of them very much.
None of us expected the test to be so hard.
None of us had a map, so we got lost.
The bus was late, and none of us had any money for a taxi.
None of us knew how to fix the car.
We waited for an hour, but none of us complained.

I tried on lots of shoes, but none of them fitted.
He sent several emails, but none of them got a reply.
The children were tired, and none of them wanted to walk.

When the lights went out, none of us moved.
My grandparents lived in the country, but neither of them ever learned to drive.

examples.heading: ① neither of us / neither of them

items.zh: 他們兩個都不想洗碗。

items.zh: 我們兩個都試了，可是都沒通過考試。

items.zh: 她有兩隻貓，兩隻都不喜歡水。

examples.heading: ② either of us / either of them

items.zh: 你們兩個有誰看到我的眼鏡嗎？

items.zh: 我覺得他們兩個都不會來。

items.zh: 你們兩個誰需要幫忙，就打給我。

items.zh: 他們兩個我都不太喜歡。

examples.heading: ③ none of us

items.en: None of us expected the test to be so hard.
items.zh: 我們沒有一個人料到考試這麼難。

items.en: None of us had a map, so we got lost.
items.zh: 我們沒有一個人帶地圖，所以迷路了。

items.en: The bus was late, and none of us had any money for a taxi.
items.zh: 公車誤點，我們沒有一個人有錢搭計程車。

items.zh: 別忘了帶鑰匙，先這樣。

items.en: I just wanted to check you were OK. That's all.
items.zh: 我只是想確定你沒事，就這樣。

items.en: Meeting moved to 3 p.m. That's all.
items.zh: 會議改到下午三點，就這樣。

examples.heading: ⑥ 筆友的信

items.en: I hope you liked my photos. That's all for this time.
items.zh: 希望你喜歡我的照片，這次就寫到這裡。

items.en: Well, that's all I have to say about my holiday.
items.zh: 嗯，我的假期就說到這裡。

items.en: That's all for now. Say hello to your parents for me.
items.zh: 今天就先寫到這裡，幫我跟你爸媽問好。

items.en: I think that's all. Please write and tell me about your school.
items.zh: 我想就這些了，請寫信告訴我你學校的事。

items.en: That's all for now. I'm going to bed!
items.zh: 今天就先寫到這裡，我要去睡了！

items.en: That's all from Madrid. I'll send you more photos soon.
items.zh: 馬德里的消息就這些，我很快會再寄更多照片給你。

title: As for myself, I like taking responsibility.
translation: 至於我自己，我喜歡承擔責任。
name: as for myself 當言談標記
sentences: Many people are afraid of making decisions at work. As for myself, I like taking responsibility.
Some people think social media is harmful. As for myself, I think it depends on how you use it.
My parents prefer beach holidays. As for myself, I'd rather go hiking in the mountains.
Most of my classmates want to study abroad. As for myself, I'd like to stay near my family.
Many teenagers today have never lived without the internet. As for myself, I grew up during the internet era, so I can still remember life without it.
Some of my friends learned English at school. As for myself, I learned most of it from films.
Everyone in my family can swim. As for myself, I only learned last year.
As you can see from my account of the concert, music still means an awful lot to me, and it probably always will. As for myself, I can't imagine life without it.
The survey shows that most students want longer holidays. As for myself, I would prefer shorter school days.
Many experts believe cities will keep growing. As for myself, I hope more people will move to the countryside.
Many applicants have more experience than me. As for myself, I am a fast learner and I work well in a team.
Some people find working at weekends difficult. As for myself, I am happy to work any day of the week.
Most of the volunteers are students. As for myself, I have just retired, so I have plenty of free time.
My brother loves living in a big city. As for myself, I find it too noisy.
Some people read the news online. As for myself, I still prefer a printed newspaper.
Many of my colleagues drive to work. As for myself, I cycle every day.

examples.heading: ① 說自己的看法

items.en: Many people are afraid of making decisions at work. As for myself, I like taking responsibility.
items.zh: 很多人在工作上怕做決定。至於我自己，我喜歡承擔責任。

items.en: Some people think social media is harmful. As for myself, I think it depends on how you use it.
items.zh: 有些人認為社群媒體有害。至於我自己，我認為要看怎麼用。

items.en: My parents prefer beach holidays. As for myself, I'd rather go hiking in the mountains.
items.zh: 我爸媽比較喜歡去海邊度假。至於我自己，我寧願去山上健行。

items.en: Most of my classmates want to study abroad. As for myself, I'd like to stay near my family.
items.zh: 我大部分的同學想出國讀書。至於我自己，我想留在家人附近。

examples.heading: ② 說自己的經驗

items.en: Many teenagers today have never lived without the internet. As for myself, I grew up during the internet era, so I can still remember life without it.
items.zh: 現在很多青少年從來沒有過沒網路的生活。至於我自己，我是在網路普及的年代長大的，所以還記得沒有網路的日子。

items.en: Some of my friends learned English at school. As for myself, I learned most of it from films.
items.zh: 我有些朋友是在學校學英文的。至於我自己，我大部分是從電影學的。

items.en: Everyone in my family can swim. As for myself, I only learned last year.
items.zh: 我家每個人都會游泳。至於我自己，我去年才學會。

examples.heading: ③ 文章和報告的結尾

items.en: As you can see from my account of the concert, music still means an awful lot to me, and it probably always will. As for myself, I can't imagine life without it.
items.zh: 從我對這場音樂會的描述可以看出，音樂對我還是非常重要，也許永遠都會。至於我自己，我無法想像沒有音樂的生活。

items.en: The survey shows that most students want longer holidays. As for myself, I would prefer shorter school days.
items.zh: 調查顯示大部分學生想要更長的假期。至於我自己，我比較想要每天少上一點課。

items.en: Many experts believe cities will keep growing. As for myself, I hope more people will move to the countryside.
items.zh: 很多專家認為城市會持續擴大。至於我自己，我希望更多人搬到鄉下。

examples.heading: ④ 申請信和自我介紹

items.en: Many applicants have more experience than me. As for myself, I am a fast learner and I work well in a team.
items.zh: 很多應徵者的經驗比我多。至於我自己，我學東西很快，也很擅長團隊合作。

items.en: Some people find working at weekends difficult. As for myself, I am happy to work any day of the week.
items.zh: 有些人覺得週末上班很辛苦。至於我自己，一星期哪一天上班我都可以。

items.en: Most of the volunteers are students. As for myself, I have just retired, so I have plenty of free time.
items.zh: 大部分志工都是學生。至於我自己，我剛退休，所以有很多空閒時間。

examples.heading: ⑤ 比較兩種選擇

items.en: My brother loves living in a big city. As for myself, I find it too noisy.
items.zh: 我哥哥很喜歡住在大城市。至於我自己，我覺得太吵了。

items.en: Some people read the news online. As for myself, I still prefer a printed newspaper.
items.zh: 有些人在網路上看新聞。至於我自己，我還是比較喜歡看紙本報紙。

items.en: Many of my colleagues drive to work. As for myself, I cycle every day.
items.zh: 我很多同事開車上班。至於我自己，我每天騎腳踏車。

title: Many say that extreme sports attract only those who are addicted to adrenaline.
translation: 很多人說，極限運動只吸引那些對腎上腺素上癮的人。
name: few、many、most、others 指人（正式）
sentences: Few would disagree with this idea.
Few expected the team to win the final.
Few remember what life was like before the internet.
Few have read the whole report.
Few could afford a car in those days.
Many believe that the city needs a new hospital.
Many lost their homes in the flood.
Many have asked why the project was stopped.
Many choose to study abroad after school.
Many came to the town looking for work.
We asked the staff about the new hours. Most were happy with them.
Most agreed that the course was too short.
The guests arrived at six, and most stayed until midnight.
Most prefer to shop online these days.
The survey shows that most want more parks in the area.
Some enjoy the cold weather. Others hate it.
Some travelled by train, and others drove.
He always thinks of others before himself.
Some students finished early, while others needed more time.
Try to treat others the way you want to be treated.
Of the people we asked, most said they felt safe at night.
Many reported problems with the new software.
Few said they would recommend the hotel to a friend.
Most were satisfied with the service, but others complained about the price.
Many expressed interest in an evening class.
Many argue that school uniforms are unnecessary.
Few would deny that exercise is good for us.
Some think tourism helps the economy, while others see it as a threat.
Many claim that money cannot buy happiness.
Most would agree that the internet has changed our lives.
Few stop to think about where their food comes from.

examples.heading: ① Few

items.en: Few would disagree with this idea.
items.zh: 很少人會反對這個想法。

items.en: Few expected the team to win the final.
items.zh: 很少人料到這支隊伍會贏得決賽。

items.en: Few remember what life was like before the internet.
items.zh: 很少人記得網路出現以前的生活是什麼樣子。

items.en: Few have read the whole report.
items.zh: 很少人讀完整份報告。

items.en: Few could afford a car in those days.
items.zh: 那個年代很少人買得起車。

examples.heading: ② Many

items.en: Many believe that the city needs a new hospital.
items.zh: 很多人認為這座城市需要一間新醫院。

items.en: Many lost their homes in the flood.
items.zh: 很多人在水災中失去了家。

items.en: Many have asked why the project was stopped.
items.zh: 很多人問過為什麼這個計畫停了。

items.en: Many choose to study abroad after school.
items.zh: 很多人畢業後選擇出國讀書。

items.en: Many came to the town looking for work.
items.zh: 很多人來到這個鎮上找工作。

examples.heading: ③ Most

items.en: We asked the staff about the new hours. Most were happy with them.
items.zh: 我們問員工對新上班時間的看法，大部分的人都很滿意。

items.en: Most agreed that the course was too short.
items.zh: 大部分的人都同意課程太短了。

items.en: The guests arrived at six, and most stayed until midnight.
items.zh: 客人六點到，大部分的人待到半夜。

items.en: Most prefer to shop online these days.
items.zh: 現在大部分的人比較喜歡上網買東西。

items.en: The survey shows that most want more parks in the area.
items.zh: 調查顯示，大部分的人希望這一區有更多公園。

examples.heading: ④ Others

items.en: Some enjoy the cold weather. Others hate it.
items.zh: 有些人喜歡冷天，有些人很討厭。

items.en: Some travelled by train, and others drove.
items.zh: 有些人搭火車，有些人開車。

items.en: He always thinks of others before himself.
items.zh: 他總是先想到別人，再想到自己。

items.en: Some students finished early, while others needed more time.
items.zh: 有些學生很早就寫完，有些需要更多時間。

items.en: Try to treat others the way you want to be treated.
items.zh: 你希望別人怎麼對你，就那樣對待別人。

examples.heading: ⑤ 報告和問卷調查

items.en: Of the people we asked, most said they felt safe at night.
items.zh: 在我們問的人裡，大部分的人說晚上覺得安全。

items.en: Many reported problems with the new software.
items.zh: 很多人反映新軟體有問題。

items.en: Few said they would recommend the hotel to a friend.
items.zh: 很少人說會把這家飯店推薦給朋友。

items.en: Most were satisfied with the service, but others complained about the price.
items.zh: 大部分的人對服務很滿意，不過也有人抱怨價錢。

items.en: Many expressed interest in an evening class.
items.zh: 很多人表示對晚間課程有興趣。

examples.heading: ⑥ 作文

items.en: Many argue that school uniforms are unnecessary.
items.zh: 很多人認為學校制服沒有必要。

items.en: Few would deny that exercise is good for us.
items.zh: 很少人會否認運動對我們有好處。

items.en: Some think tourism helps the economy, while others see it as a threat.
items.zh: 有些人認為觀光業對經濟有幫助，也有人認為觀光業是威脅。

items.en: Many claim that money cannot buy happiness.
items.zh: 很多人說錢買不到快樂。

items.en: Most would agree that the internet has changed our lives.
items.zh: 大部分的人都會同意，網路改變了我們的生活。

items.en: Few stop to think about where their food comes from.
items.zh: 很少人會停下來想一想，自己的食物從哪裡來。

title: In my opinion, a car can't be harmful in itself.
translation: 我認為汽車本身不可能有害。
name: 固定說法 in itself 加強語氣
sentences: Eating chocolate isn't bad in itself, but you shouldn't eat a whole bar every day.
The job was boring in itself, but I liked my colleagues.
A little stress is useful in itself; it helps you focus.
The mistake wasn't serious in itself, but it caused a lot of confusion.
Is technology harmful in itself, or only when people misuse it?
Spending time with your family is important in itself.
Criticism isn't unkind in itself, as long as it's fair.
Waiting for the results was stressful in itself.
The novel is interesting in itself, but the film adds a lot.
Borrowing money isn't wrong in itself. Just make sure you can pay it back.
A quiet evening at home can be relaxing in itself.
Finding a parking space in this city is a challenge in itself.
Getting to the island is an adventure in itself. You need two boats and a bus.
Being invited to an interview is a good sign in itself.
For my grandmother, using a smartphone is a big step in itself.
Learning a new language is a reward in itself.
The walk up to the castle is a workout in itself.
Writing the grant application was a full-time job in itself.
Meeting the president was an honour in itself.
Keeping a garden alive in this heat is an art in itself.
Getting five kids out the door by eight is a small miracle in itself.
Just being nominated for the award was a victory in itself.
The idea in itself isn't bad, but it would cost too much.
A degree in itself won't get you a job; you need experience too.
The law in itself is fair. The problem is how the police enforce it.
This medicine in itself is safe, but don't take it with alcohol.
Exercise in itself won't help you lose weight unless you also eat well.
The house in itself wasn't special, but the view was amazing.
Failure in itself is nothing to be ashamed of.
The app in itself is free; you only pay for the extra features.
A long flight in itself doesn't bother me. It's the jet lag I hate.
Does the treatment in itself carry any risk, doctor?

examples.heading: ① 形容詞 + in itself

items.en: Eating chocolate isn't bad in itself, but you shouldn't eat a whole bar every day.
items.zh: 吃巧克力本身不是壞事，可是你不該每天吃一整條。

items.en: The job was boring in itself, but I liked my colleagues.
items.zh: 那份工作本身很無聊，可是我喜歡我的同事。

items.en: A little stress is useful in itself; it helps you focus.
items.zh: 一點壓力本身是有用的，能幫你專心。

items.en: The mistake wasn't serious in itself, but it caused a lot of confusion.
items.zh: 這個錯誤本身不嚴重，可是造成了很多混亂。

items.en: Is technology harmful in itself, or only when people misuse it?
items.zh: 科技本身有害嗎？還是只有在人們誤用的時候才有害？

items.en: Spending time with your family is important in itself.
items.zh: 和家人相處本身就很重要。

items.en: Criticism isn't unkind in itself, as long as it's fair.
items.zh: 批評本身並不刻薄，只要它是公正的。

items.en: Waiting for the results was stressful in itself.
items.zh: 等結果這件事本身就很有壓力。

items.en: The novel is interesting in itself, but the film adds a lot.
items.zh: 這本小說本身很有趣，可是電影又加了很多東西。

items.en: Borrowing money isn't wrong in itself. Just make sure you can pay it back.
items.zh: 借錢本身沒有錯，只要確定你還得起就好。

items.en: A quiet evening at home can be relaxing in itself.
items.zh: 在家度過一個安靜的晚上本身就很放鬆。

examples.heading: ② a / an + 名詞 + in itself

items.en: Finding a parking space in this city is a challenge in itself.
items.zh: 在這個城市找到停車位本身就是一項挑戰。

items.en: Getting to the island is an adventure in itself. You need two boats and a bus.
items.zh: 去那座島本身就是一趟冒險，你要搭兩班船和一班公車。

items.en: Being invited to an interview is a good sign in itself.
items.zh: 被邀請去面試本身就是個好兆頭。

items.en: For my grandmother, using a smartphone is a big step in itself.
items.zh: 對我奶奶來說，用智慧型手機本身就是一大步。

items.en: Learning a new language is a reward in itself.
items.zh: 學一門新語言本身就是一種收穫。

items.en: The walk up to the castle is a workout in itself.
items.zh: 走上城堡本身就是一種運動。

items.en: Writing the grant application was a full-time job in itself.
items.zh: 寫那份補助申請書本身就像一份全職工作。

items.en: Meeting the president was an honour in itself.
items.zh: 能見到總統本身就是一種榮幸。

items.en: Keeping a garden alive in this heat is an art in itself.
items.zh: 在這麼熱的天氣讓花園保持生機本身就是一門學問。

items.en: Getting five kids out the door by eight is a small miracle in itself.
items.zh: 八點前讓五個孩子都出門本身就是個小奇蹟。

items.en: Just being nominated for the award was a victory in itself.
items.zh: 光是獲得提名本身就是一種勝利。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞 + in itself

items.en: The idea in itself isn't bad, but it would cost too much.
items.zh: 這個想法本身不壞，可是會花太多錢。

items.en: A degree in itself won't get you a job; you need experience too.
items.zh: 學位本身不會讓你找到工作，你還需要經驗。

items.en: The law in itself is fair. The problem is how the police enforce it.
items.zh: 這條法律本身是公平的，問題在於警察怎麼執行。

items.en: This medicine in itself is safe, but don't take it with alcohol.
items.zh: 這種藥本身很安全，可是不要和酒一起吃。

items.en: Exercise in itself won't help you lose weight unless you also eat well.
items.zh: 運動本身不會讓你變瘦，除非你也吃得健康。

items.en: The house in itself wasn't special, but the view was amazing.
items.zh: 房子本身沒什麼特別，可是景色很棒。

items.en: Failure in itself is nothing to be ashamed of.
items.zh: 失敗本身沒什麼好丟臉的。

items.en: The app in itself is free; you only pay for the extra features.
items.zh: 這個應用程式本身是免費的，你只需要付額外功能的錢。

items.en: A long flight in itself doesn't bother me. It's the jet lag I hate.
items.zh: 長途飛行本身不會讓我困擾，我討厭的是時差。

items.en: Does the treatment in itself carry any risk, doctor?
items.zh: 醫生，這個療法本身有任何風險嗎？

title: The building itself looks splendid.
translation: 這棟建築本身看起來很壯觀。
name: 反身代名詞 itself 表示強調
sentences: The film itself is only ninety minutes long, but there are twenty minutes of adverts before it.
The vase itself is translucent, so it glows when the sun hits it.
The form was approved in a week, but the reimbursement itself took three months.
The job itself is fine, but the commute is exhausting.
The idea itself is good. We just need more money to make it work.
The village itself has only one shop, so we drive to town for groceries.
Don't worry. The surgery itself will take about an hour.
The phone itself was cheap, but the case cost almost as much.
Does the course itself cost anything, or do we only pay for the books?
The illness itself is mild; the stigma is what hurts patients most.
The castle itself was closed, so we walked around the gardens.
The testimony itself lasted ten minutes, but the questions went on all afternoon.
The software itself works well; the problem is your old computer.
The beach itself stays quiet, even in August.
The wedding itself was short, but the party lasted until two in the morning.
The card itself was simple, but your message made me cry.
I didn't like our hotel much, but I loved the city itself.
We never actually visited the museum itself; we only saw the gift shop.
Don't blame the app itself. Check your internet connection first.
My daughter cares more about the box than the present itself.
The reviews were terrible, but I enjoyed the book itself.
Nobody complained about the food itself, only about the slow service.
The insurance cost more than the car itself.
I'm not worried about the exam itself, just about the results.
He spent more time on the cover than on the report itself.
The guide talked a lot about the history, but very little about the temple itself.
Let's fix the leak itself instead of mopping the floor every morning.
The protest wasn't about the new tax itself but about the way it was introduced.
Most visitors take photos in the square, and few go inside the cathedral itself.
The flights were expensive, so we spent less on the holiday itself.
The council will repair the road to the castle before it starts on the castle itself.
Don't judge the restaurant by its sign. Try the food itself.

examples.heading: ① 名詞是主詞

items.en: The film itself is only ninety minutes long, but there are twenty minutes of adverts before it.
items.zh: 電影本身只有九十分鐘，可是前面有二十分鐘的廣告。

items.en: The vase itself is translucent, so it glows when the sun hits it.
items.zh: 那個花瓶本身是半透明的，所以陽光照到時會發亮。

items.en: The form was approved in a week, but the reimbursement itself took three months.
items.zh: 表格一週就核准了，可是退款本身花了三個月才入帳。

items.en: The job itself is fine, but the commute is exhausting.
items.zh: 工作本身還好，可是通勤很累人。

items.en: The idea itself is good. We just need more money to make it work.
items.zh: 這個點子本身很好，我們只是需要更多錢來實現它。

items.en: The village itself has only one shop, so we drive to town for groceries.
items.zh: 村子本身只有一家店，所以我們開車去鎮上買菜。

items.en: Don't worry. The surgery itself will take about an hour.
items.zh: 別擔心，手術本身大概只要一個小時。

items.en: The phone itself was cheap, but the case cost almost as much.
items.zh: 手機本身很便宜，可是手機殼幾乎一樣貴。

items.en: Does the course itself cost anything, or do we only pay for the books?
items.zh: 課程本身要收費嗎？還是我們只付書錢？

items.en: The illness itself is mild; the stigma is what hurts patients most.
items.zh: 這種病本身不嚴重，最傷害病人的是汙名。

items.en: The castle itself was closed, so we walked around the gardens.
items.zh: 城堡本身沒開放，所以我們在花園裡逛了逛。

items.en: The testimony itself lasted ten minutes, but the questions went on all afternoon.
items.zh: 證詞本身十分鐘就講完了，可是提問持續了一整個下午。

items.en: The software itself works well; the problem is your old computer.
items.zh: 軟體本身運作得很好，問題出在你那台舊電腦。

items.en: The beach itself stays quiet, even in August.
items.zh: 海灘本身一直很安靜，就算是八月也一樣。

items.en: The wedding itself was short, but the party lasted until two in the morning.
items.zh: 婚禮本身很短，可是派對一直到凌晨兩點才結束。

items.en: The card itself was simple, but your message made me cry.
items.zh: 卡片本身很簡單，可是你寫的話讓我哭了。

examples.heading: ② 名詞是受詞或在介系詞後面

items.en: I didn't like our hotel much, but I loved the city itself.
items.zh: 我不太喜歡我們住的飯店，可是我很愛那座城市本身。

items.en: We never actually visited the museum itself; we only saw the gift shop.
items.zh: 我們其實沒去看博物館本身，只逛了禮品店。

items.en: Don't blame the app itself. Check your internet connection first.
items.zh: 不要怪應用程式本身。先檢查你的網路連線。

items.en: My daughter cares more about the box than the present itself.
items.zh: 比起禮物本身，我女兒更在意盒子。

items.en: The reviews were terrible, but I enjoyed the book itself.
items.zh: 評論很差，可是我很喜歡那本書本身。

items.en: Nobody complained about the food itself, only about the slow service.
items.zh: 沒有人抱怨食物本身，只抱怨上菜太慢。

items.en: The insurance cost more than the car itself.
items.zh: 保險比車子本身還貴。

items.en: I'm not worried about the exam itself, just about the results.
items.zh: 我擔心的不是考試本身，而是成績。

items.en: He spent more time on the cover than on the report itself.
items.zh: 他花在封面上的時間比花在報告本身還多。

items.en: The guide talked a lot about the history, but very little about the temple itself.
items.zh: 導遊講了很多歷史，可是很少講寺廟本身。

items.en: Let's fix the leak itself instead of mopping the floor every morning.
items.zh: 我們來處理漏水本身，不要每天早上都在拖地。

items.en: The protest wasn't about the new tax itself but about the way it was introduced.
items.zh: 這次抗議的重點不是新稅本身，而是它推出的方式。

items.en: Most visitors take photos in the square, and few go inside the cathedral itself.
items.zh: 大部分遊客只在廣場拍照，很少人走進大教堂本身。

items.en: The flights were expensive, so we spent less on the holiday itself.
items.zh: 機票很貴，所以我們在旅遊本身上花得比較少。

items.en: The council will repair the road to the castle before it starts on the castle itself.
items.zh: 市議會會先修通往城堡的路，再開始修城堡本身。

items.en: Don't judge the restaurant by its sign. Try the food itself.
items.zh: 不要用招牌來評斷這家餐廳，嚐嚐食物本身。

title: One more reason I like Singapore is that one sees cats everywhere.
translation: 我喜歡新加坡還有一個原因，就是到處都看得到貓。

title: Cars themselves are never dangerous.
translation: 汽車本身從來都不危險。
name: 複數反身代名詞表示強調
sentences: People blame cars for accidents, but cars themselves are never dangerous. It depends on us.
The rules themselves are simple, but the game is hard to win.
The children themselves chose the name of the school newspaper.
The paintings themselves aren't valuable, but the frames are very old.
The food in the hostel is not very good, but sometimes we can prepare something to eat ourselves.
We didn't hire anyone. We painted the whole flat ourselves.
We're going to organise the party ourselves this year.
Let's not wait for the council. We can clean the beach ourselves.
My new colleagues patiently explained my job to me, even though they were fairly busy themselves.
My grandparents built this house themselves in the 1960s.
The students wrote and performed the play themselves.
Many parents want their children to read, but they never read themselves.
You're both adults now. You can make these decisions yourselves.
Did you make these biscuits yourselves? They're delicious!
Children, please tidy up the classroom yourselves before you go home.
Teachers can help, but students themselves must take responsibility for their learning.
Computers themselves don't make us lazy. It's how we use them.
The players themselves admitted that they played badly.
"Who designed your website?" "We did it ourselves."
"Can you help the kids with their homework?" "No, they should do it themselves."
"Did you two cook all this yourselves?" "Yes, it took all afternoon."

examples.heading: ① 名詞 + themselves

items.en: People blame cars for accidents, but cars themselves are never dangerous. It depends on us.
items.zh: 大家把車禍怪到汽車身上，可是汽車本身從來都不危險。要看我們怎麼開。

items.en: The rules themselves are simple, but the game is hard to win.
items.zh: 規則本身很簡單，可是這個遊戲很難贏。

items.en: The children themselves chose the name of the school newspaper.
items.zh: 校刊的名字是孩子們自己選的。

items.en: The paintings themselves aren't valuable, but the frames are very old.
items.zh: 這些畫本身不值錢，可是畫框很古老。

examples.heading: ② 句尾的 ourselves

items.en: The food in the hostel is not very good, but sometimes we can prepare something to eat ourselves.
items.zh: 青年旅館的食物不太好，可是有時候我們可以自己準備點吃的。

items.en: We didn't hire anyone. We painted the whole flat ourselves.
items.zh: 我們沒請人。整間公寓都是我們自己油漆的。

items.en: We're going to organise the party ourselves this year.
items.zh: 我們今年要自己辦派對。

items.en: Let's not wait for the council. We can clean the beach ourselves.
items.zh: 別等市議會了。我們可以自己清理海灘。

examples.heading: ③ 句尾的 themselves

items.en: My new colleagues patiently explained my job to me, even though they were fairly busy themselves.
items.zh: 我的新同事很有耐心地跟我解釋工作，雖然他們自己也很忙。

items.en: My grandparents built this house themselves in the 1960s.
items.zh: 這棟房子是我爺爺奶奶在六〇年代自己蓋的。

items.en: The students wrote and performed the play themselves.
items.zh: 那齣戲是學生們自己寫、自己演的。

items.en: Many parents want their children to read, but they never read themselves.
items.zh: 很多父母希望孩子讀書，可是他們自己從來不讀。

examples.heading: ④ yourselves

items.en: You're both adults now. You can make these decisions yourselves.
items.zh: 你們兩個都是大人了。這些決定你們可以自己做。

items.en: Did you make these biscuits yourselves? They're delicious!
items.zh: 這些餅乾是你們自己做的嗎？好好吃！

items.en: Children, please tidy up the classroom yourselves before you go home.
items.zh: 孩子們，回家前請自己把教室整理好。

examples.heading: ⑤ 論說文和評論

items.en: Teachers can help, but students themselves must take responsibility for their learning.
items.zh: 老師可以幫忙，可是學生自己必須為學習負責。

items.en: Computers themselves don't make us lazy. It's how we use them.
items.zh: 電腦本身不會讓我們變懶。要看我們怎麼用。

items.en: The players themselves admitted that they played badly.
items.zh: 球員們自己也承認他們打得不好。

examples.heading: ⑥ 對話

items.zh: 你們的網站是誰設計的？我們自己做的。

items.zh: 你可以幫孩子們寫功課嗎？不行，他們應該自己寫。

items.en: "Did you two cook all this yourselves?" "Yes, it took all afternoon."
items.zh: 這些都是你們兩個自己煮的嗎？對，花了一整個下午。

title: The food was delicious, especially the cake, which Sandra had made herself.
