The café has free Wi-Fi, and students love that.
He forgot my birthday. I can't believe that!
I didn't sleep well last night. That's why I'm so tired.
She loves animals. That's why she wants to be a vet.
The tickets were cheap. That's why we went by bus.
My phone was off. That's why I didn't answer.
It was raining. That's why we stayed at home.
Please try to come after 4.30 because I won't be there before that.
We had lunch in the park. After that, we went to the museum.
I'm moving to London in May. Before that, I need to find a flat.
The shop closes at six, so try to get there before that.
I'll be at work until five. After that, I'm free.
"I've passed all my exams." "That was quick!"
We spent the whole day at the beach. That was so much fun.
I left my keys in the car. That was a stupid mistake.
She gave me her old laptop. That was really kind of her.
"The bus leaves at 7.15." "Is that right? I thought it was 7.30."
"The museum is closed on Mondays." "Oh, I didn't know that."
"You should take a coat." "Yes, I'll do that."
"Can we meet at the station?" "Yes, let's do that."
"Tom is leaving the company." "Who told you that?"
"I think Anna is angry with me." "Why do you think that?"
My new flat has a garden, and I really love that.
These boots look really nice on me. That's why I bought them.
Our English teacher is very funny. We all like that about her.
I'm free on Saturday afternoon. Is that OK for you?
My parents are coming at the weekend. I'm really looking forward to that.
You said you wanted to visit Scotland. Let's plan that for next summer!

examples.heading: ① that 當受詞

items.en: My new bike is really light, and I like that.
items.zh: 我的新腳踏車很輕，我很喜歡這一點。

items.en: The teacher always gives us lots of homework. I hate that!
items.zh: 老師總是給我們很多功課，我很討厭這樣！

items.en: You know that blue is my favourite colour, so we are going to use that.
items.zh: 你知道藍色是我最喜歡的顏色，所以我們就用藍色。

items.en: The café has free Wi-Fi, and students love that.
items.zh: 這家咖啡店有免費 Wi-Fi，學生很喜歡這一點。

items.en: He forgot my birthday. I can't believe that!
items.zh: 他忘了我的生日，我真不敢相信！

examples.heading: ② that's why

items.en: I didn't sleep well last night. That's why I'm so tired.
items.zh: 我昨晚沒睡好，所以我才這麼累。

items.en: She loves animals. That's why she wants to be a vet.
items.zh: 她很喜歡動物，所以她想當獸醫。

items.en: The tickets were cheap. That's why we went by bus.
items.zh: 車票很便宜，所以我們才搭巴士去。

items.en: My phone was off. That's why I didn't answer.
items.zh: 我的手機關機了，所以我才沒接。

items.en: It was raining. That's why we stayed at home.
items.zh: 那時在下雨，所以我們才待在家裡。

examples.heading: ③ before that 和 after that

items.en: Please try to come after 4.30 because I won't be there before that.
items.zh: 請盡量四點半以後來，因為在那之前我不在。

items.en: We had lunch in the park. After that, we went to the museum.
items.zh: 我們在公園吃午餐，之後去了博物館。

items.en: I'm moving to London in May. Before that, I need to find a flat.
items.zh: 我五月要搬到倫敦，在那之前我得找到公寓。

items.en: The shop closes at six, so try to get there before that.
items.zh: 那家店六點關門，所以盡量在那之前到。

items.en: I'll be at work until five. After that, I'm free.
items.zh: 我會工作到五點，之後就有空了。

examples.heading: ④ that 當主詞

items.en: "I've passed all my exams." "That was quick!"
items.zh: 我所有考試都過了。這麼快！

items.en: We spent the whole day at the beach. That was so much fun.
items.zh: 我們在海邊玩了一整天，真的很好玩。

items.en: I left my keys in the car. That was a stupid mistake.
items.zh: 我把鑰匙留在車上，真是個愚蠢的錯誤。

items.en: She gave me her old laptop. That was really kind of her.
items.zh: 她把她的舊筆電給了我，她真好。

items.en: "The bus leaves at 7.15." "Is that right? I thought it was 7.30."
items.zh: 公車七點十五分開。是嗎？我以為是七點半。

examples.heading: ⑤ 指別人說的話

items.en: "The museum is closed on Mondays." "Oh, I didn't know that."
items.zh: 博物館星期一休館。喔，我不知道。

items.en: "You should take a coat." "Yes, I'll do that."
items.zh: 你應該帶件外套。好，我會帶。

items.en: "Can we meet at the station?" "Yes, let's do that."
items.zh: 我們可以在車站碰面嗎？好，就這樣吧。

items.en: "Tom is leaving the company." "Who told you that?"
items.zh: 湯姆要離開公司了。誰跟你說的？

items.en: "I think Anna is angry with me." "Why do you think that?"
items.zh: 我覺得安娜在生我的氣。你為什麼這樣想？

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫信給朋友

items.en: My new flat has a garden, and I really love that.
items.zh: 我的新公寓有花園，我真的很喜歡這一點。

items.en: These boots look really nice on me. That's why I bought them.
items.zh: 這雙靴子我穿起來很好看，所以我才買。

items.en: Our English teacher is very funny. We all like that about her.
items.zh: 我們的英文老師很有趣，我們都喜歡她這一點。

items.en: I'm free on Saturday afternoon. Is that OK for you?
items.zh: 我星期六下午有空，你可以嗎？

items.en: My parents are coming at the weekend. I'm really looking forward to that.
items.zh: 我爸媽週末要來，我很期待。

items.en: You said you wanted to visit Scotland. Let's plan that for next summer!
items.zh: 你說你想去蘇格蘭，我們來計畫明年夏天去吧！

title: He is very clever and generous, and these are the things that I like most about him.
translation: 他很聰明又很大方，這些就是我最喜歡他的地方。
name: 代名詞 these 指前面提過的事物
sentences: My mother is patient and kind. These are the qualities I admire in her.
Good food, fresh air and enough sleep. These are the secrets of a long life.
The hotel was cheap and near the beach. These were the main reasons we chose it.
Tea, coffee and cola all contain caffeine. These can keep you awake at night.
Rice, beans and vegetables. These are the main foods in my country.
There are a few funny programmes like The Simpsons. These are the only programmes I like watching.
I've brought some sandwiches. These are for lunch.
I've picked some flowers from the garden. These are for you.
I took some photos of the wedding. These are the best.
Here are some photos of my trip. These were taken in Rome.
I love camping and fishing. Do you enjoy things like these?
My brother collects stamps and old coins. He loves things like these.
Lying and cheating are wrong. I never do things like these.
She worries about exams and money. Problems like these are common for students.
We saw lions and elephants. You don't see animals like these every day.
I've written down some new words. Please learn these for tomorrow.
Here are the tickets. Don't lose these.
Here are some old letters. Read these when you have time.
We found some shells on the beach. Let's take these home.
I've made a list of questions. Can you answer these?
"What are your hobbies?" "Swimming and painting. I do these every weekend."
Read the instructions carefully. These will tell you what to do.
Our teacher gave us three tips. These helped me a lot in the exam.
Wash your hands and wear a mask. These are simple ways to stay healthy.
Check the oil and the tyres. These are the first things to look at.
My best friend is funny and loyal. These are the reasons we get on so well.
The town has a castle, a market and a lake. These make it a great place to visit.
I want to travel, learn Spanish and start a band. These are my goals for next year.
Many people feel lonely or stressed at work. These are serious problems.
He is never late and he always smiles. These are the things I remember about him.
The rooms are small and the walls are thin. These are the only bad points.

examples.heading: ① these 做總結

items.en: My mother is patient and kind. These are the qualities I admire in her.
items.zh: 我媽媽很有耐心又很和善。這些是我欣賞她的特質。

items.en: Good food, fresh air and enough sleep. These are the secrets of a long life.
items.zh: 好的食物、新鮮空氣和充足的睡眠。這些就是長壽的祕訣。

items.en: The hotel was cheap and near the beach. These were the main reasons we chose it.
items.zh: 那家旅館很便宜，又靠近海灘。這些是我們選它的主要原因。

items.en: Tea, coffee and cola all contain caffeine. These can keep you awake at night.
items.zh: 茶、咖啡和可樂都含有咖啡因。這些會讓你晚上睡不著。

items.en: Rice, beans and vegetables. These are the main foods in my country.
items.zh: 米飯、豆子和蔬菜。這些是我們國家的主食。

examples.heading: ② these 指剛說過的複數名詞

items.en: There are a few funny programmes like The Simpsons. These are the only programmes I like watching.
items.zh: 有幾個好笑的節目，像《辛普森家庭》。我只喜歡看這些節目。

items.en: I've brought some sandwiches. These are for lunch.
items.zh: 我帶了一些三明治，這些是午餐要吃的。

items.en: I've picked some flowers from the garden. These are for you.
items.zh: 我從花園摘了一些花，這些是要給你的。

items.en: I took some photos of the wedding. These are the best.
items.zh: 我拍了一些婚禮的照片，這幾張拍得最好。

items.en: Here are some photos of my trip. These were taken in Rome.
items.zh: 這是我旅行的照片，這些是在羅馬拍的。

examples.heading: ③ things like these

items.en: I love camping and fishing. Do you enjoy things like these?
items.zh: 我很喜歡露營和釣魚。你喜歡這類活動嗎？

items.en: My brother collects stamps and old coins. He loves things like these.
items.zh: 我哥哥收集郵票和舊硬幣。他很喜歡這類東西。

items.en: Lying and cheating are wrong. I never do things like these.
items.zh: 說謊和作弊是不對的。我從來不做這類事情。

items.en: She worries about exams and money. Problems like these are common for students.
items.zh: 她擔心考試和錢的事。這類問題在學生之間很常見。

items.en: We saw lions and elephants. You don't see animals like these every day.
items.zh: 我們看到了獅子和大象。這種動物不是每天都看得到。

examples.heading: ④ these 當受詞

items.en: I've written down some new words. Please learn these for tomorrow.
items.zh: 我寫下了幾個新單字，請在明天以前把這些背起來。

items.en: Here are the tickets. Don't lose these.
items.zh: 票在這裡，這些別弄丟了。

items.en: Here are some old letters. Read these when you have time.
items.zh: 這裡有一些舊信，你有空的時候讀讀這些。

items.en: We found some shells on the beach. Let's take these home.
items.zh: 我們在海灘上撿到一些貝殼，把這些帶回家吧。

items.en: I've made a list of questions. Can you answer these?
items.zh: 我列了一些問題，你可以回答這些嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 回答和說明

items.en: "What are your hobbies?" "Swimming and painting. I do these every weekend."
items.zh: 你的嗜好是什麼？游泳和畫畫。我每個週末都做這些。

items.en: Read the instructions carefully. These will tell you what to do.
items.zh: 仔細讀說明，這些會告訴你該怎麼做。

items.en: Our teacher gave us three tips. These helped me a lot in the exam.
items.zh: 老師給了我們三個訣竅，這些在考試時幫了我很多。

items.en: Wash your hands and wear a mask. These are simple ways to stay healthy.
items.zh: 洗手和戴口罩。這些都是保持健康的簡單方法。

items.en: Check the oil and the tyres. These are the first things to look at.
items.zh: 檢查機油和輪胎。這些是最先要看的東西。

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫信和短文

items.en: My best friend is funny and loyal. These are the reasons we get on so well.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友很幽默又很講義氣。這些就是我們處得這麼好的原因。

items.en: The town has a castle, a market and a lake. These make it a great place to visit.
items.zh: 鎮上有城堡、市場和湖。這些讓它成為很適合參觀的地方。

items.en: I want to travel, learn Spanish and start a band. These are my goals for next year.
items.zh: 我想去旅行、學西班牙文、組樂團。這些是我明年的目標。

items.en: Many people feel lonely or stressed at work. These are serious problems.
items.zh: 很多人在工作上覺得孤單或壓力大。這些都是嚴重的問題。

items.en: He is never late and he always smiles. These are the things I remember about him.
items.zh: 他從來不遲到，又總是面帶笑容。這些是我記得他的地方。

items.en: The rooms are small and the walls are thin. These are the only bad points.
items.zh: 房間很小，牆壁很薄。這些是唯一的缺點。

title: Thank you for this.
translation: 謝謝你給我這個。
name: 指示代名詞 this 指前面提過的事物
sentences: Thank you for the lovely book. I can't wait to read this!
Thanks for the flowers. This is so kind of you.
My aunt sent me a cake. I'll share this with my friends.
Thank you for the photo. I'll keep this forever.
Thanks for the birthday card. This made me smile.
I went shopping yesterday. I bought three green T-shirts, a pair of sneakers and some socks. You might ask, why did I buy all this?
Look at all these clothes on the floor! Who's going to tidy all this?
We've got sandwiches, crisps and juice. Can you carry all this?
There are books, papers and cups on my desk. I need to move all this.
Mum made soup, pasta and a salad. We can't eat all this!
I found a pen on the floor. Is this yours?
I bought a new lamp for my room. I really like this.
Here's a map of the town. You'll need this.
My grandfather gave me a watch. I'll never sell this.
I've made you a sandwich. Eat this before you go.
Tents, sleeping bags, food … all this has to go in the car.
Computers, phones, tablets … all this is new technology for my grandparents.
Coffee, tea and cakes. All this is free for visitors.
Hats, scarves, gloves … all this is in the box by the door.
Shoes, bags, jackets … all this was in the sale.
I got a new camera. I took all my holiday photos with this.
The box is very heavy. Can you help me with this?
My phone is broken. How much will it cost to fix this?
She gave me a scarf. I'll think of her every time I look at this.
I've got a new bag for school. My books all fit in this.
Thank you for the CD. I've listened to this three times already!
Thanks for the T-shirt. I'm wearing this right now.
Thank you for the game. My brother already wants to borrow this!
You sent me chocolates, a book and a card. Thank you for all this!
Thank you for the recipe. I'm going to try this at the weekend.
Thanks for the poster. This is going on my bedroom wall!

examples.heading: ① 謝謝送的東西

items.en: Thank you for the lovely book. I can't wait to read this!
items.zh: 謝謝你送的好書，我等不及要讀了！

items.en: Thanks for the flowers. This is so kind of you.
items.zh: 謝謝你的花，你真好。

items.en: My aunt sent me a cake. I'll share this with my friends.
items.zh: 我阿姨寄了一個蛋糕給我，我會跟朋友分享。

items.en: Thank you for the photo. I'll keep this forever.
items.zh: 謝謝你的照片，我會永遠留著。

items.en: Thanks for the birthday card. This made me smile.
items.zh: 謝謝你的生日卡，這張卡讓我笑了。

examples.heading: ② all this 指一組東西

items.en: I went shopping yesterday. I bought three green T-shirts, a pair of sneakers and some socks. You might ask, why did I buy all this?
items.zh: 我昨天去買東西，買了三件綠色 T 恤、一雙運動鞋和一些襪子。你可能會問，我為什麼要買這麼多？

items.en: Look at all these clothes on the floor! Who's going to tidy all this?
items.zh: 地上這麼多衣服！誰要來收拾這些？

items.en: We've got sandwiches, crisps and juice. Can you carry all this?
items.zh: 我們有三明治、洋芋片和果汁，你拿得動這些嗎？

items.en: There are books, papers and cups on my desk. I need to move all this.
items.zh: 我的書桌上有書、紙和杯子，我得把這些都移走。

items.en: Mum made soup, pasta and a salad. We can't eat all this!
items.zh: 媽媽煮了湯、義大利麵和沙拉，我們吃不完這麼多！

examples.heading: ③ this 當受詞

items.en: I found a pen on the floor. Is this yours?
items.zh: 我在地上找到一支筆，這是你的嗎？

items.en: I bought a new lamp for my room. I really like this.
items.zh: 我買了一盞新檯燈放在房間，我真的很喜歡。

items.en: Here's a map of the town. You'll need this.
items.zh: 這是鎮上的地圖，你會用到。

items.en: My grandfather gave me a watch. I'll never sell this.
items.zh: 我爺爺給了我一支手錶，我永遠不會賣掉。

items.en: I've made you a sandwich. Eat this before you go.
items.zh: 我幫你做了三明治，出門前吃掉。

examples.heading: ④ all this 當主詞

items.en: Tents, sleeping bags, food … all this has to go in the car.
items.zh: 帳篷、睡袋、食物……這些全部都要放進車裡。

items.en: Computers, phones, tablets … all this is new technology for my grandparents.
items.zh: 電腦、手機、平板……這些對我祖父母來說都是新科技。

items.en: Coffee, tea and cakes. All this is free for visitors.
items.zh: 咖啡、茶和蛋糕，這些訪客都可以免費享用。

items.en: Hats, scarves, gloves … all this is in the box by the door.
items.zh: 帽子、圍巾、手套……這些都在門邊的箱子裡。

items.en: Shoes, bags, jackets … all this was in the sale.
items.zh: 鞋子、包包、外套……這些都在特價。

examples.heading: ⑤ 介系詞後面

items.en: I got a new camera. I took all my holiday photos with this.
items.zh: 我買了一台新相機，假期的照片都是用它拍的。

items.en: The box is very heavy. Can you help me with this?
items.zh: 這個箱子很重，你可以幫我搬嗎？

items.en: My phone is broken. How much will it cost to fix this?
items.zh: 我的手機壞了，修這個要花多少錢？

items.en: She gave me a scarf. I'll think of her every time I look at this.
items.zh: 她送我一條圍巾，我每次看到它都會想起她。

items.en: I've got a new bag for school. My books all fit in this.
items.zh: 我買了新的上學用包包，我的書全放得進去。

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫給朋友的謝卡

items.en: Thank you for the CD. I've listened to this three times already!
items.zh: 謝謝你送的 CD，我已經聽了三遍了！

items.en: Thanks for the T-shirt. I'm wearing this right now.
items.zh: 謝謝你送的 T 恤，我現在就穿著。

items.en: Thank you for the game. My brother already wants to borrow this!
items.zh: 謝謝你送的遊戲，我弟弟已經想跟我借了！

items.en: You sent me chocolates, a book and a card. Thank you for all this!
items.zh: 你寄給我巧克力、一本書和一張卡片，謝謝你送我這麼多！

items.en: Thank you for the recipe. I'm going to try this at the weekend.
items.zh: 謝謝你給我的食譜，我週末要來試試看。

items.en: Thanks for the poster. This is going on my bedroom wall!
items.zh: 謝謝你送的海報，我要把它貼在臥室牆上！

title: We missed the last bus. Because of this, we had to walk home.
translation: 我們錯過了最後一班公車，所以只好走路回家。
name: this 指前面的子句或句子
sentences: The roads were icy. Because of this, many schools were closed.
He broke his leg. Because of this, he couldn't play in the final.
The tickets were very cheap. Because of this, they sold out in an hour.
She grew up in Spain. Because of this, she speaks Spanish perfectly.
The internet was down. Because of this, I couldn't send the email.
My neighbours play loud music every night. This keeps me awake.
Prices have gone up again. This is bad news for families.
Many young people leave the village. This worries the older people.
He apologised in front of everyone. This surprised me.
Our team won every game this season. This has never happened before.
My room is very cold and unfriendly. I think flowers and pictures will change this.
Some students cheat in exams. I've never understood this.
You can save money by cooking at home. I do this every day.
The bus is always late. I've told the company about this many times.
Our department has many conferences to arrange, and it needs a person to be in charge of this.
Some people never recycle. I think this is terrible.
Children spend hours on their phones. This is not healthy.
The city is planting more trees. This is a great idea.
He said he would help, but he didn't. This was very disappointing.
Most shops close at six. This is too early for people who work.
The hotel was next to a busy road. This meant we couldn't open the windows.
I started running every morning. This has made me feel much better.
They moved to the city last year. This was a big change for the children.
The museum is free on Sundays. This is why it is always crowded then.
Nobody told me about the meeting. This is the second time it has happened.
To stay fit, I'm eating lots of fruit and vegetables. I think you should do this, too.
I've joined a dance class. This was my mum's idea.
My sister is getting married in June. This means I'll be home for the summer.
We didn't have enough money for a hotel. Because of this, we stayed with friends.
I've started learning the guitar. This takes a lot of my free time.
You said you were unhappy at work. Have you told your boss about this?

examples.heading: ① because of this

items.en: The roads were icy. Because of this, many schools were closed.
items.zh: 路面結冰，所以很多學校都停課了。

items.en: He broke his leg. Because of this, he couldn't play in the final.
items.zh: 他摔斷了腿，所以沒辦法參加決賽。

items.en: The tickets were very cheap. Because of this, they sold out in an hour.
items.zh: 票很便宜，所以一個小時就賣完了。

items.en: She grew up in Spain. Because of this, she speaks Spanish perfectly.
items.zh: 她在西班牙長大，所以她的西班牙文說得很好。

items.en: The internet was down. Because of this, I couldn't send the email.
items.zh: 網路斷了，所以我沒辦法寄電子郵件。

examples.heading: ② this 當主詞

items.en: My neighbours play loud music every night. This keeps me awake.
items.zh: 我的鄰居每天晚上都放很大聲的音樂，讓我睡不著。

items.en: Prices have gone up again. This is bad news for families.
items.zh: 物價又漲了，這對家庭來說是壞消息。

items.en: Many young people leave the village. This worries the older people.
items.zh: 很多年輕人離開村子，這讓老人家很擔心。

items.en: He apologised in front of everyone. This surprised me.
items.zh: 他當著大家的面道歉，這讓我很驚訝。

items.en: Our team won every game this season. This has never happened before.
items.zh: 我們的隊這一季每場都贏，這是以前從來沒有過的事。

examples.heading: ③ this 當受詞

items.en: My room is very cold and unfriendly. I think flowers and pictures will change this.
items.zh: 我的房間很冷，感覺很不舒服。我覺得花和畫可以改變這一點。

items.en: Some students cheat in exams. I've never understood this.
items.zh: 有些學生考試作弊，我一直不懂為什麼。

items.en: You can save money by cooking at home. I do this every day.
items.zh: 在家做飯可以省錢，我每天都這樣做。

items.en: The bus is always late. I've told the company about this many times.
items.zh: 公車總是誤點，這件事我已經跟公司反映很多次了。

items.en: Our department has many conferences to arrange, and it needs a person to be in charge of this.
items.zh: 我們部門有很多會議要安排，需要一個人負責這件事。

examples.heading: ④ this 說出看法

items.en: Some people never recycle. I think this is terrible.
items.zh: 有些人從來不做資源回收，我覺得這很糟糕。

items.en: Children spend hours on their phones. This is not healthy.
items.zh: 孩子花好幾個小時在手機上，這樣不健康。

items.en: The city is planting more trees. This is a great idea.
items.zh: 市政府在種更多樹，這是很好的主意。

items.en: He said he would help, but he didn't. This was very disappointing.
items.zh: 他說會幫忙，可是沒有，這讓人很失望。

items.en: Most shops close at six. This is too early for people who work.
items.zh: 大部分的店六點就關門，對上班的人來說太早了。

examples.heading: ⑤ this 接著談下去

items.en: The hotel was next to a busy road. This meant we couldn't open the windows.
items.zh: 旅館就在一條很忙的馬路旁邊，這表示我們不能開窗。

items.en: I started running every morning. This has made me feel much better.
items.zh: 我開始每天早上跑步，這讓我覺得好多了。

items.en: They moved to the city last year. This was a big change for the children.
items.zh: 他們去年搬到城市，這對孩子們來說是很大的改變。

items.en: The museum is free on Sundays. This is why it is always crowded then.
items.zh: 博物館星期天免費，這就是為什麼那天總是人很多。

items.en: Nobody told me about the meeting. This is the second time it has happened.
items.zh: 沒有人告訴我開會的事，這已經是第二次了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫信給朋友

items.en: To stay fit, I'm eating lots of fruit and vegetables. I think you should do this, too.
items.zh: 為了保持健康，我吃很多蔬菜水果。我覺得你也應該這樣做。

items.en: I've joined a dance class. This was my mum's idea.
items.zh: 我參加了一個舞蹈班，這是我媽媽的主意。

items.en: My sister is getting married in June. This means I'll be home for the summer.
items.zh: 我姊姊六月要結婚，這表示我暑假會回家。

items.en: We didn't have enough money for a hotel. Because of this, we stayed with friends.
items.zh: 我們的錢不夠住旅館，所以我們住在朋友家。

items.en: I've started learning the guitar. This takes a lot of my free time.
items.zh: 我開始學吉他，這占了我很多空閒時間。

items.en: You said you were unhappy at work. Have you told your boss about this?
items.zh: 你說你工作得不開心，你跟老闆說過這件事嗎？

title: This is the best holiday I have ever had!
translation: 這是我度過最棒的假期！
name: 指示代名詞 this 指正在發生的事
sentences: We're in Rome! This is amazing.
Sun, sea and good food. This is the life!
The hotel has two pools. This is like a dream!
This is our third day in the mountains, and we love it.
This is my first time abroad. Everything is new.
Come and try the new game. This is so cool!
This is taking too long. Let's ask someone.
We're baking a cake together. This is fun!
This is harder than I thought.
I'm learning to ski. This is really difficult!
This is just a short note to ask you if you want to go with me to the ReggaRton's concert.
Sorry, this is a really long email!
This is to say that the meeting has moved to Friday.
This is my first email in English, so please be kind!
Hi Sam, this is a quick message from the train.
Hi, this is Laura from the dentist's.
Hello, is this the police station?
This is Mark. I'm calling about the flat.
"Who's calling, please?" "This is Mrs Clark."
Hi Dad, this is me. Can you pick me up?
This is the best day of my life!
Oh no, this is terrible. The shop is closed.
This is so boring. When does the film end?
Wow, this is delicious! What's in it?
This is crazy. There are so many people here!
Welcome, everyone. This is a very special evening for our school.
This is your captain speaking. We will land in twenty minutes.
This is the first time we've all been together for years.
Listen, everyone. This is important.
This is the news at six o'clock.
Thank you all for coming. This is a big moment for our family.

examples.heading: ① 度假的時候

items.en: We're in Rome! This is amazing.
items.zh: 我們在羅馬！太棒了。

items.en: Sun, sea and good food. This is the life!
items.zh: 陽光、大海、美食，這才叫生活！

items.en: The hotel has two pools. This is like a dream!
items.zh: 這家旅館有兩個游泳池，簡直像在作夢！

items.en: This is our third day in the mountains, and we love it.
items.zh: 這是我們在山上的第三天，我們很喜歡。

items.en: This is my first time abroad. Everything is new.
items.zh: 這是我第一次出國，一切都很新鮮。

examples.heading: ② 正在做的事

items.en: Come and try the new game. This is so cool!
items.zh: 來試試這個新遊戲，好酷！

items.en: This is taking too long. Let's ask someone.
items.zh: 這花太久時間了，我們找人問問吧。

items.en: We're baking a cake together. This is fun!
items.zh: 我們正在一起做蛋糕，好好玩！

items.en: This is harder than I thought.
items.zh: 這比我想的還難。

items.en: I'm learning to ski. This is really difficult!
items.zh: 我在學滑雪，真的好難！

examples.heading: ③ 寫信和留言

items.en: This is just a short note to ask you if you want to go with me to the ReggaRton's concert.
items.zh: 寫這張短箋是想問你要不要跟我去看 ReggaRton 的演唱會。

items.en: Sorry, this is a really long email!
items.zh: 抱歉，這封電子郵件好長！

items.en: This is to say that the meeting has moved to Friday.
items.zh: 這封信是要通知大家，會議改到星期五。

items.en: This is my first email in English, so please be kind!
items.zh: 這是我第一封英文電子郵件，請多包涵！

items.en: Hi Sam, this is a quick message from the train.
items.zh: 嗨，山姆，我在火車上傳個簡短訊息給你。

examples.heading: ④ 打電話

items.en: Hi, this is Laura from the dentist's.
items.zh: 你好，我是牙醫診所的蘿拉。

items.en: Hello, is this the police station?
items.zh: 喂，請問是警察局嗎？

items.en: This is Mark. I'm calling about the flat.
items.zh: 我是馬克，我打來是想問公寓的事。

items.en: "Who's calling, please?" "This is Mrs Clark."
items.zh: 請問是哪位？我是克拉克太太。

items.en: Hi Dad, this is me. Can you pick me up?
items.zh: 爸，是我。你可以來接我嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 對現在的感受

items.en: This is the best day of my life!
items.zh: 這是我這輩子最棒的一天！

items.en: Oh no, this is terrible. The shop is closed.
items.zh: 喔不，真糟糕。店關門了。

items.en: This is so boring. When does the film end?
items.zh: 好無聊喔，電影什麼時候結束？

items.en: Wow, this is delicious! What's in it?
items.zh: 哇，好好吃！裡面放了什麼？

items.en: This is crazy. There are so many people here!
items.zh: 太誇張了，這裡好多人！

examples.heading: ⑥ 介紹和說明

items.en: Welcome, everyone. This is a very special evening for our school.
items.zh: 歡迎各位，今晚對我們學校來說是很特別的一晚。

items.en: This is your captain speaking. We will land in twenty minutes.
items.zh: 我是機長，我們將在二十分鐘後降落。

items.en: This is the first time we've all been together for years.
items.zh: 這是我們好幾年來第一次全部聚在一起。

items.en: Listen, everyone. This is important.
items.zh: 大家聽好，這件事很重要。

items.en: This is the news at six o'clock.
items.zh: 六點新聞時間到了。

items.en: Thank you all for coming. This is a big moment for our family.
items.zh: 謝謝大家來，這對我們家來說是重要的時刻。

title: This is the information about the new art class: it starts at 4 p.m. and finishes at 6 p.m.
translation: 這是新美術課的資訊：下午 4 點開始，6 點結束。
name: 指示代名詞 this 指接下來的內容
sentences: This is my new address: 14 Green Lane, Oxford.
If you need help, this is the number to call: 0800 123 456.
This is the name of the hotel: the Sea View.
This is the website: www.artclass.com.
This is the code for the door: 4 7 2 9.
This is the plan for Saturday: lunch at one, then the cinema.
This is the timetable: the bus leaves at 8.15 and arrives at 9.
This is what we'll do: you buy the food and I'll cook.
This is the programme for the day: a tour in the morning and free time in the afternoon.
This is the menu for the party: pizza, salad and ice cream.
This is how you make tea: boil the water, then add the tea bag.
This is the way to the station: turn left, then go straight on.
This is what you do: press the green button and wait.
This is the best way to learn words: write them on cards.
This is my advice: get a good night's sleep before the exam.
Listen to this: the school is closed tomorrow!
Look at this: a T-shirt for only two pounds.
Guess what? This is the big news: I'm going to Japan.
Read this: "No swimming after 6 p.m."
This is the funny part: the dog ate his homework!
This is the information about the new art class: the class is on Fridays, and it starts at 4 p.m. and finishes at 6 p.m.
This is an important message for all students: the library will close at 3 p.m. today.
This is the price list: adults £8, children £4.
This is a change to the timetable: there is no class on Monday.
This is the room for the meeting: Room 12, second floor.
This is my email address: anna.lee@mail.com. Write to me soon!
This is the list of things to bring: a towel, a hat and some water.
This is where we're meeting: outside the cinema at seven.
This is my question: can you come to my party on Saturday?
This is the address of the restaurant: 8 King Street.
This is the only thing I need for my birthday: a new bike!

examples.heading: ① 號碼和地址

items.en: This is my new address: 14 Green Lane, Oxford.
items.zh: 這是我的新地址：牛津綠巷 14 號。

items.en: If you need help, this is the number to call: 0800 123 456.
items.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，要打的號碼是這個：0800 123 456。

items.en: This is the name of the hotel: the Sea View.
items.zh: 旅館的名字是這個：海景飯店。

items.en: This is the website: www.artclass.com.
items.zh: 網址是這個：www.artclass.com。

items.en: This is the code for the door: 4 7 2 9.
items.zh: 門的密碼是這個：4 7 2 9。

examples.heading: ② 計畫和時間

items.en: This is the plan for Saturday: lunch at one, then the cinema.
items.zh: 星期六的計畫是這樣：一點吃午餐，然後去看電影。

items.en: This is the timetable: the bus leaves at 8.15 and arrives at 9.
items.zh: 時刻表是這樣：公車八點十五分出發，九點到。

items.en: This is what we'll do: you buy the food and I'll cook.
items.zh: 我們這樣做：你去買菜，我來煮。

items.en: This is the programme for the day: a tour in the morning and free time in the afternoon.
items.zh: 今天的行程是這樣：早上導覽，下午自由活動。

items.en: This is the menu for the party: pizza, salad and ice cream.
items.zh: 派對的菜單是這樣：披薩、沙拉和冰淇淋。

examples.heading: ③ 說明做法

items.en: This is how you make tea: boil the water, then add the tea bag.
items.zh: 泡茶是這樣泡的：先把水煮開，再放茶包。

items.en: This is the way to the station: turn left, then go straight on.
items.zh: 去車站要這樣走：左轉，然後直走。

items.en: This is what you do: press the green button and wait.
items.zh: 你要這樣做：按綠色的按鈕，然後等著。

items.en: This is the best way to learn words: write them on cards.
items.zh: 學單字最好的方法是這個：把單字寫在卡片上。

items.en: This is my advice: get a good night's sleep before the exam.
items.zh: 我的建議是這樣：考試前好好睡一覺。

examples.heading: ④ 要對方注意聽

items.en: Listen to this: the school is closed tomorrow!
items.zh: 你聽我說：學校明天停課！

items.en: Look at this: a T-shirt for only two pounds.
items.zh: 你看這個：一件 T 恤只要兩英鎊。

items.en: Guess what? This is the big news: I'm going to Japan.
items.zh: 你猜怎麼樣？大消息是：我要去日本了。

items.en: Read this: "No swimming after 6 p.m."
items.zh: 你看這個：下午六點後禁止游泳。

items.en: This is the funny part: the dog ate his homework!
items.zh: 好笑的地方是這個：狗吃了他的作業！

examples.heading: ⑤ 通知和公告

items.en: This is the information about the new art class: the class is on Fridays, and it starts at 4 p.m. and finishes at 6 p.m.
items.zh: 這是新美術課的資訊：課在星期五，下午四點開始，六點結束。

items.en: This is an important message for all students: the library will close at 3 p.m. today.
items.zh: 這是給全體學生的重要通知：圖書館今天下午三點關門。

items.en: This is the price list: adults £8, children £4.
items.zh: 價目表是這樣：成人八英鎊，兒童四英鎊。

items.en: This is a change to the timetable: there is no class on Monday.
items.zh: 課表有異動：星期一沒有課。

items.en: This is the room for the meeting: Room 12, second floor.
items.zh: 開會的房間是這間：二樓十二號房。

examples.heading: ⑥ 電子郵件和簡訊

items.en: This is my email address: anna.lee@mail.com. Write to me soon!
items.zh: 這是我的電子郵件地址：anna.lee@mail.com，快寫信給我！

items.en: This is the list of things to bring: a towel, a hat and some water.
items.zh: 要帶的東西是這些：一條毛巾、一頂帽子和一些水。

items.en: This is where we're meeting: outside the cinema at seven.
items.zh: 我們在這裡碰面：七點，電影院外面。

items.en: This is my question: can you come to my party on Saturday?
items.zh: 我的問題是這個：你星期六可以來我的派對嗎？

items.en: This is the address of the restaurant: 8 King Street.
items.zh: 餐廳的地址是這個：國王街 8 號。

items.en: This is the only thing I need for my birthday: a new bike!
items.zh: 我生日只想要這個：一台新腳踏車！

title: Those are the things I like the most about her.
translation: 那些就是我最喜歡她的地方。
name: 代名詞 those 指前面提過的事物
sentences: He never lies and he always helps people. Those are the reasons I trust him.
We need bread, milk and eggs. Those are the only things on the list.
Sun, sea and good food. Those were the best parts of the holiday.
Swimming and cycling are good for you. Those are my favourite sports.
She speaks French and German. Those are useful languages for her job.
These cups are clean, but those are still dirty.
I like these photos, but those are a bit dark.
These shoes are mine. Those are my brother's.
These boxes go in the kitchen, and those go upstairs.
These seats are free, but those are for teachers.
I would love to live in a city like Paris or Rome. I'm very keen on cities like those.
She makes cakes with fruit and cream. I've never had cakes like those.
He tells stories about ghosts. I don't like stories like those.
They sell old toys from the 1960s. You can't find toys like those anymore.
My grandmother grew roses and lilies. I want a garden with flowers like those.
"Did you see the photos from the wedding?" "Yes, those were lovely."
"What about the old chairs?" "Oh, I threw those away."
"I made some biscuits for you." "Thanks, those look delicious."
"Where are my blue socks?" "I put those in the washing machine."
"Have you read the emails from Tom?" "No, I haven't opened those yet."
I don't need these papers, but please keep those.
Put these plates in the cupboard, and wash those later.
I've read these books, but I haven't read those yet.
You can eat these cookies, but don't touch those.
I've washed these shirts. Can you iron those?
My town has a park, a museum and a beach. Those are the places I'd show you.
I miss my friends and my dog. Those are the things I think about every day.
She was kind and patient with everyone. Those are rare qualities today.
The rooms were clean and the staff were helpful. Those were the good points of the hotel.
Music, books and long walks. Those are the things that make me happy.
I made some mistakes last year, but those are in the past now.

examples.heading: ① those 當主詞做總結

items.en: He never lies and he always helps people. Those are the reasons I trust him.
items.zh: 他從不說謊，又總是幫助別人。那些就是我信任他的原因。

items.en: We need bread, milk and eggs. Those are the only things on the list.
items.zh: 我們需要麵包、牛奶和蛋。清單上就只有那些。

items.en: Sun, sea and good food. Those were the best parts of the holiday.
items.zh: 陽光、海和美食。那些是假期裡最棒的部分。

items.en: Swimming and cycling are good for you. Those are my favourite sports.
items.zh: 游泳和騎腳踏車對身體很好。那些是我最喜歡的運動。

items.en: She speaks French and German. Those are useful languages for her job.
items.zh: 她會說法語和德語。那些語言對她的工作很有用。

examples.heading: ② those 和 these 對比

items.en: These cups are clean, but those are still dirty.
items.zh: 這些杯子是乾淨的，可是那些還是髒的。

items.en: I like these photos, but those are a bit dark.
items.zh: 我喜歡這些照片，可是那些有點暗。

items.en: These shoes are mine. Those are my brother's.
items.zh: 這雙鞋是我的，那雙是我哥的。

items.en: These boxes go in the kitchen, and those go upstairs.
items.zh: 這些箱子放廚房，那些放樓上。

items.en: These seats are free, but those are for teachers.
items.zh: 這些位子沒人坐，可是那些是給老師坐的。

examples.heading: ③ like those

items.en: I would love to live in a city like Paris or Rome. I'm very keen on cities like those.
items.zh: 我很想住在巴黎或羅馬那樣的城市。我很喜歡那樣的城市。

items.en: She makes cakes with fruit and cream. I've never had cakes like those.
items.zh: 她做的蛋糕有水果和奶油。我從來沒吃過那樣的蛋糕。

items.en: He tells stories about ghosts. I don't like stories like those.
items.zh: 他會講鬼故事。我不喜歡那樣的故事。

items.en: They sell old toys from the 1960s. You can't find toys like those anymore.
items.zh: 他們賣一九六〇年代的舊玩具。現在已經找不到那樣的玩具了。

items.en: My grandmother grew roses and lilies. I want a garden with flowers like those.
items.zh: 我奶奶種玫瑰和百合。我想要一個有那樣的花的花園。

examples.heading: ④ 回答對方說過的事物

items.en: "Did you see the photos from the wedding?" "Yes, those were lovely."
items.zh: 你看了婚禮的照片嗎？看了，那些照片很漂亮。

items.en: "What about the old chairs?" "Oh, I threw those away."
items.zh: 那些舊椅子呢？喔，我把那些丟掉了。

items.en: "I made some biscuits for you." "Thanks, those look delicious."
items.zh: 我做了一些餅乾給你。謝謝，那些看起來很好吃。

items.en: "Where are my blue socks?" "I put those in the washing machine."
items.zh: 我的藍襪子在哪裡？我把那些丟進洗衣機了。

items.en: "Have you read the emails from Tom?" "No, I haven't opened those yet."
items.zh: 你讀了湯姆寄來的電子郵件嗎？沒有，那些我還沒打開。

examples.heading: ⑤ those 當受詞

items.en: I don't need these papers, but please keep those.
items.zh: 這些文件我不需要，可是那些請留著。

items.en: Put these plates in the cupboard, and wash those later.
items.zh: 這些盤子放進櫃子，那些等一下再洗。

items.en: I've read these books, but I haven't read those yet.
items.zh: 這些書我讀過了，可是那些還沒讀。

items.en: You can eat these cookies, but don't touch those.
items.zh: 這些餅乾你可以吃，可是那些別碰。

items.en: I've washed these shirts. Can you iron those?
items.zh: 這些襯衫我洗好了，你可以燙那些嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫信和短文

items.en: My town has a park, a museum and a beach. Those are the places I'd show you.
items.zh: 我住的鎮上有公園、博物館和海灘。那些是我會帶你去的地方。

items.en: I miss my friends and my dog. Those are the things I think about every day.
items.zh: 我想念我的朋友和我的狗。那些是我每天都會想到的。

items.en: She was kind and patient with everyone. Those are rare qualities today.
items.zh: 她對每個人都很和善、很有耐心。那些特質現在很少見。

items.en: The rooms were clean and the staff were helpful. Those were the good points of the hotel.
items.zh: 房間很乾淨，員工也很幫忙。那些是這家旅館的優點。

items.en: Music, books and long walks. Those are the things that make me happy.
items.zh: 音樂、書和散步。那些就是讓我快樂的事。

items.en: I made some mistakes last year, but those are in the past now.
items.zh: 我去年犯了一些錯，不過那些都過去了。

title: Is it worth having a nervous breakdown or anything like that?
translation: 搞到精神崩潰或那一類的狀況，值得嗎？
name: 不定代名詞用於模糊指稱
sentences: She's a doctor or something like that.
Let's watch a film or something tonight.
I think he's ill or something.
You could take the bus or something to save money.
It's called Mike's Café or something like that.
We need to buy bread or something for breakfast.
I don't drink coffee or anything like that.
Did you hurt yourself or anything?
He didn't call or anything.
I'm not angry or anything. I'm just tired.
Do you need help with your bags or anything?
We didn't have a map or anything, so we got lost.
Let's go to the park or somewhere.
We could hold the meeting in the hall or somewhere else.
I left my keys in the car or somewhere.
She lives in Leeds or somewhere like that.
Is there a bank or anywhere near here?
You should talk to your manager or someone.
Maybe ask a neighbour or somebody to feed the cat.
Did you see a police officer or anyone?
I'll get my brother or someone to help you move.
We need a plumber or someone like that.
They have a pool, a garden and everything.
He knows all the players' names and everything.
The hotel was clean and quiet and everything.
She cooked dinner, washed the dishes and everything.
The room had a TV, a fridge and everything else we needed.
Shall we order some noodles or something?
Is he your cousin or something?
Why don't we have a barbecue or something this weekend?
Was there a problem with the car or anything?

examples.heading: ① or something (like that)

items.en: She's a doctor or something like that.
items.zh: 她是醫生之類的。

items.en: Let's watch a film or something tonight.
items.zh: 今晚我們看個電影什麼的吧。

items.en: I think he's ill or something.
items.zh: 我想他大概是生病了還是怎樣。

items.en: You could take the bus or something to save money.
items.zh: 你可以搭公車之類的來省錢。

items.en: It's called Mike's Café or something like that.
items.zh: 那家店叫 Mike's Café 之類的名字。

items.en: We need to buy bread or something for breakfast.
items.zh: 我們要買麵包之類的當早餐。

examples.heading: ② or anything (like that)

items.en: I don't drink coffee or anything like that.
items.zh: 我不喝咖啡那類的東西。

items.en: Did you hurt yourself or anything?
items.zh: 你有受傷還是怎樣嗎？

items.en: He didn't call or anything.
items.zh: 他沒打電話，什麼都沒有。

items.en: I'm not angry or anything. I'm just tired.
items.zh: 我沒有生氣什麼的，只是累了。

items.en: Do you need help with your bags or anything?
items.zh: 你需要幫忙拿包包還是什麼嗎？

items.en: We didn't have a map or anything, so we got lost.
items.zh: 我們沒有地圖什麼的，所以迷路了。

examples.heading: ③ or somewhere (else)

items.en: Let's go to the park or somewhere.
items.zh: 我們去公園或別的地方吧。

items.en: We could hold the meeting in the hall or somewhere else.
items.zh: 我們可以在禮堂或其他地方開會。

items.en: I left my keys in the car or somewhere.
items.zh: 我把鑰匙忘在車上還是哪裡了。

items.en: She lives in Leeds or somewhere like that.
items.zh: 她住在里茲那一帶。

items.en: Is there a bank or anywhere near here?
items.zh: 這附近有銀行或類似的地方嗎？

examples.heading: ④ or someone / somebody

items.en: You should talk to your manager or someone.
items.zh: 你應該跟你主管或其他人談談。

items.en: Maybe ask a neighbour or somebody to feed the cat.
items.zh: 也許可以請鄰居或別人來餵貓。

items.en: Did you see a police officer or anyone?
items.zh: 你有看到警察或其他人嗎？

items.en: I'll get my brother or someone to help you move.
items.zh: 我會找我哥或其他人來幫你搬家。

items.en: We need a plumber or someone like that.
items.zh: 我們需要找水電工之類的人。

examples.heading: ⑤ and everything

items.en: They have a pool, a garden and everything.
items.zh: 他們家有游泳池、花園，什麼都有。

items.en: He knows all the players' names and everything.
items.zh: 他知道所有球員的名字，什麼都知道。

items.en: The hotel was clean and quiet and everything.
items.zh: 那家飯店乾淨又安靜，什麼都好。

items.en: She cooked dinner, washed the dishes and everything.
items.zh: 她煮了晚餐、洗了碗，什麼都做了。

items.en: The room had a TV, a fridge and everything else we needed.
items.zh: 房間裡有電視、冰箱，還有我們需要的其他所有東西。

examples.heading: ⑥ 用在問句和建議

items.en: Shall we order some noodles or something?
items.zh: 我們要不要叫個麵什麼的？

items.en: Is he your cousin or something?
items.zh: 他是你表哥還是什麼人嗎？

items.en: Why don't we have a barbecue or something this weekend?
items.zh: 這個週末我們何不烤個肉什麼的？

items.en: Was there a problem with the car or anything?
items.zh: 那輛車是出了什麼問題嗎？

title: We all know that being a writer is difficult.
translation: 我們都知道當作家很辛苦。
name: we 和 us 泛指一般人
sentences: These days we can see cars in every corner of the world.
We can't live without the sun.
Through travel, we discover new ways of living.
When we are tired, we make more mistakes.
We learn a lot from our mistakes.
We often forget how lucky we are.
Zoos give us a chance to see animals from other countries.
Books can teach us a lot about the past.
Good food makes us happy.
The internet allows us to talk to people all over the world.
Bad news can make us feel helpless.
We should be careful with our money.
Our health depends on what we eat.
We spend a third of our lives sleeping.
Our parents usually want the best for us.
We often compare our lives with other people's.
We all want to be happy.
We all need a holiday from time to time.
We all have bad days.
We all know that fast food is not good for us.
We all get older, but we don't all get wiser.
Some of us find it hard to get up early.
Most of us have a mobile phone.
Some of us enjoy sport, while others prefer reading.
Few of us read newspapers any more.
Many of us worry too much about what others think.
We must learn to live with less plastic.
We should drink more water every day.
We can't change the past, but we can change the future.
We need to think about the environment when we travel.
We shouldn't believe everything we read online.

examples.heading: ① we 當主詞

items.en: These days we can see cars in every corner of the world.
items.zh: 現在世界每個角落都看得到汽車。

items.en: We can't live without the sun.
items.zh: 我們沒有太陽就活不下去。

items.en: Through travel, we discover new ways of living.
items.zh: 透過旅行，我們會發現不同的生活方式。

items.en: When we are tired, we make more mistakes.
items.zh: 人累的時候，就比較容易出錯。

items.en: We learn a lot from our mistakes.
items.zh: 我們從錯誤中學到很多。

items.en: We often forget how lucky we are.
items.zh: 我們常常忘了自己有多幸運。

examples.heading: ② us 當受詞

items.en: Zoos give us a chance to see animals from other countries.
items.zh: 動物園讓我們有機會看到其他國家的動物。

items.en: Books can teach us a lot about the past.
items.zh: 書能教我們很多關於過去的事。

items.en: Good food makes us happy.
items.zh: 好吃的東西讓人開心。

items.en: The internet allows us to talk to people all over the world.
items.zh: 網路讓我們能和全世界的人聊天。

items.en: Bad news can make us feel helpless.
items.zh: 壞消息會讓人覺得無能為力。

examples.heading: ③ our + 名詞

items.en: We should be careful with our money.
items.zh: 我們應該小心用錢。

items.en: Our health depends on what we eat.
items.zh: 我們的健康取決於我們吃什麼。

items.en: We spend a third of our lives sleeping.
items.zh: 我們一生有三分之一的時間在睡覺。

items.en: Our parents usually want the best for us.
items.zh: 爸媽通常都希望我們過得最好。

items.en: We often compare our lives with other people's.
items.zh: 我們常常拿自己的生活跟別人比。

examples.heading: ④ we all

items.en: We all want to be happy.
items.zh: 每個人都想要快樂。

items.en: We all need a holiday from time to time.
items.zh: 人偶爾都需要放個假。

items.en: We all have bad days.
items.zh: 誰都有不順的日子。

items.en: We all know that fast food is not good for us.
items.zh: 大家都知道速食對身體不好。

items.en: We all get older, but we don't all get wiser.
items.zh: 人都會變老，但不是每個人都會變聰明。

examples.heading: ⑤ 數量詞 + of us

items.en: Some of us find it hard to get up early.
items.zh: 有些人覺得早起很困難。

items.en: Most of us have a mobile phone.
items.zh: 我們大多數人都有手機。

items.en: Some of us enjoy sport, while others prefer reading.
items.zh: 我們有些人喜歡運動，有些人比較喜歡看書。

items.en: Few of us read newspapers any more.
items.zh: 現在我們很少人還在看報紙了。

items.en: Many of us worry too much about what others think.
items.zh: 我們很多人太在意別人的看法。

examples.heading: ⑥ we 和情態動詞

items.en: We must learn to live with less plastic.
items.zh: 我們必須學會少用塑膠。

items.en: We should drink more water every day.
items.zh: 我們每天都應該多喝水。

items.en: We can't change the past, but we can change the future.
items.zh: 我們改變不了過去，但可以改變未來。

items.en: We need to think about the environment when we travel.
items.zh: 我們旅行時要考慮到環境。

items.en: We shouldn't believe everything we read online.
items.zh: 網路上看到的東西，我們不應該全都相信。

title: If you want to travel to China, you need to learn a little Chinese.
translation: 如果你想去中國旅行，就要學一點中文。
name: you 泛指一般人
sentences: With this app, you can order food from your phone.
You press this button to turn on the computer.
On this website, you can buy train tickets.
My new camera is great. You can take photos under water.
You put the coins in here and then choose a drink.
In Paris, you can see the Eiffel Tower from many places.
At the market, you can buy fresh fruit every morning.
From the top of the tower, you can see the mountains.
In our school, you can play basketball after class.
In the summer, you can swim in the lake.
You should always wear a helmet on a bike.
If you feel sick, you should see a doctor.
You shouldn't swim right after a big meal.
You need a warm coat in winter here.
You must be careful when you cross this road.
If you study every day, you will learn fast.
When you are tired, you can't think well.
If you don't sleep enough, you feel bad the next day.
When you travel, you meet lots of people.
If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
You can leave your coat at the door.
You have to bring your own towel to the pool.
In this restaurant, you cook the meat yourself.
You should always lock your bike.
You can help yourself to the cake.
You can't park your car in front of the gate.
You don't need a visa for this country.
You can't buy a good house for that price.
You don't have to pay to visit the park.
You can't learn to swim from a book.
You never know what will happen tomorrow.

examples.heading: ① 說明東西怎麼用

items.en: With this app, you can order food from your phone.
items.zh: 用這個應用程式，可以在手機上點餐。

items.en: You press this button to turn on the computer.
items.zh: 按這個按鈕就能開電腦。

items.en: On this website, you can buy train tickets.
items.zh: 在這個網站上可以買火車票。

items.en: My new camera is great. You can take photos under water.
items.zh: 我的新相機很棒，可以在水裡拍照。

items.en: You put the coins in here and then choose a drink.
items.zh: 把硬幣投進這裡，再選飲料。

examples.heading: ② 說一個地方有什麼

items.en: In Paris, you can see the Eiffel Tower from many places.
items.zh: 在巴黎，從很多地方都看得到艾菲爾鐵塔。

items.en: At the market, you can buy fresh fruit every morning.
items.zh: 每天早上都可以在市場買到新鮮水果。

items.en: From the top of the tower, you can see the mountains.
items.zh: 從塔頂可以看到山。

items.en: In our school, you can play basketball after class.
items.zh: 我們學校下課後可以打籃球。

items.en: In the summer, you can swim in the lake.
items.zh: 夏天可以在湖裡游泳。

examples.heading: ③ 給建議

items.en: You should always wear a helmet on a bike.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車一定要戴安全帽。

items.en: If you feel sick, you should see a doctor.
items.zh: 如果覺得不舒服，就應該去看醫生。

items.en: You shouldn't swim right after a big meal.
items.zh: 吃飽飯後不要馬上游泳。

items.en: You need a warm coat in winter here.
items.zh: 這裡冬天需要穿厚外套。

items.en: You must be careful when you cross this road.
items.zh: 過這條馬路一定要小心。

examples.heading: ④ if you / when you

items.en: If you study every day, you will learn fast.
items.zh: 每天讀書的話，就會學得很快。

items.en: When you are tired, you can't think well.
items.zh: 人累的時候，腦袋就不清楚。

items.en: If you don't sleep enough, you feel bad the next day.
items.zh: 睡不夠的話，隔天就會不舒服。

items.en: When you travel, you meet lots of people.
items.zh: 旅行的時候會認識很多人。

items.en: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
items.zh: 紅色和藍色混在一起就會變成紫色。

examples.heading: ⑤ your 和 yourself

items.en: You can leave your coat at the door.
items.zh: 外套可以放在門口。

items.en: You have to bring your own towel to the pool.
items.zh: 去游泳池要自己帶毛巾。

items.en: In this restaurant, you cook the meat yourself.
items.zh: 在這家餐廳，肉要自己烤。

items.en: You should always lock your bike.
items.zh: 腳踏車一定要上鎖。

items.en: You can help yourself to the cake.
items.zh: 蛋糕可以自己拿。

examples.heading: ⑥ you can't / you don't

items.en: You can't park your car in front of the gate.
items.zh: 大門前面不能停車。

items.en: You don't need a visa for this country.
items.zh: 去這個國家不需要簽證。

items.en: You can't buy a good house for that price.
items.zh: 那個價錢買不到好房子。

items.en: You don't have to pay to visit the park.
items.zh: 參觀這個公園不用錢。

items.en: You can't learn to swim from a book.
items.zh: 看書是學不會游泳的。

items.en: You never know what will happen tomorrow.
items.zh: 誰都不知道明天會發生什麼事。

title: It is a great opportunity to improve my sailing skills, as training will be provided by yourselves.
translation: 這是精進我帆船技術的好機會，因為貴單位會提供訓練。
name: 反身代名詞 yourselves 表示客氣
sentences: I'd like to join the summer course. It is a great opportunity to improve my sailing skills, as training will be provided by yourselves.
Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing in response to the advertisement published by yourselves in The Traveller.
I have received the documents sent by yourselves last week.
The hotel was chosen by yourselves, so I expected it to be of a high standard.
I look forward to hearing from yourselves soon.
I have not yet received a reply from yourselves about my complaint.
We would welcome any suggestions from yourselves.
Your question took me back to my childhood. Like yourselves, I live in a busy town, in a busy street.
Companies like yourselves need staff who can speak several languages.
I believe that people like yourselves can help the local community.
I am sending the completed form to yourselves by post.
I explained the problem to yourselves on the phone last Monday.
I returned the keys to yourselves on the last morning of my stay.
I am very interested in the position advertised by yourselves on your website.
The information given by yourselves was not correct.
I would be grateful if the cost of the repair could be paid by yourselves.
The tour, which was organised by yourselves, did not include the museum visit.

examples.heading: ① by yourselves

items.en: I'd like to join the summer course. It is a great opportunity to improve my sailing skills, as training will be provided by yourselves.
items.zh: 我想參加暑期課程。這是精進我帆船技術的好機會，因為貴單位會提供訓練。

items.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing in response to the advertisement published by yourselves in The Traveller.
items.zh: 敬啟者：我寫信是回應貴公司刊登在《旅行者》雜誌上的廣告。

items.en: I have received the documents sent by yourselves last week.
items.zh: 我已經收到貴公司上星期寄來的文件。

items.en: The hotel was chosen by yourselves, so I expected it to be of a high standard.
items.zh: 那間旅館是貴公司選的，所以我原本期待它的水準很高。

examples.heading: ② from yourselves

items.en: I look forward to hearing from yourselves soon.
items.zh: 期待很快收到貴公司的回覆。

items.en: I have not yet received a reply from yourselves about my complaint.
items.zh: 關於我的投訴，我還沒收到貴公司的回覆。

items.en: We would welcome any suggestions from yourselves.
items.zh: 我們很歡迎貴單位提出任何建議。

examples.heading: ③ like yourselves

items.en: Your question took me back to my childhood. Like yourselves, I live in a busy town, in a busy street.
items.zh: 您的問題讓我想起我的童年。跟各位一樣，我住在一個熱鬧的城鎮，一條熱鬧的街上。

items.en: Companies like yourselves need staff who can speak several languages.
items.zh: 像貴公司這樣的企業需要會說好幾種語言的員工。

items.en: I believe that people like yourselves can help the local community.
items.zh: 我相信像各位這樣的人可以幫助當地社區。

examples.heading: ④ to yourselves

items.en: I am sending the completed form to yourselves by post.
items.zh: 我會把填好的表格郵寄給貴公司。

items.en: I explained the problem to yourselves on the phone last Monday.
items.zh: 我上星期一在電話裡已經向貴公司說明過問題。

items.en: I returned the keys to yourselves on the last morning of my stay.
items.zh: 我在住宿的最後一天早上已經把鑰匙交還給貴單位。

examples.heading: ⑤ 申請信和抱怨信

items.en: I am very interested in the position advertised by yourselves on your website.
items.zh: 我對貴公司在網站上刊登的職缺很有興趣。

items.en: The information given by yourselves was not correct.
items.zh: 貴公司提供的資訊不正確。

items.en: I would be grateful if the cost of the repair could be paid by yourselves.
items.zh: 如果修理費能由貴公司支付，我會很感激。

items.en: The tour, which was organised by yourselves, did not include the museum visit.
items.zh: 貴公司安排的行程並沒有包括參觀博物館。

title: Your boyfriend is also sixteen, is he?
translation: 你男朋友也是十六歲，是嗎？
name: 肯定句加肯定附加問句
sentences: You said he's in your class. Your boyfriend is also sixteen, is he?
So the restaurant is closed on Mondays, is it? I didn't know that.
Oh, you're a teacher, are you? What do you teach?
Your sister is getting married, is she? That's wonderful!
So the film was boring, was it? I'll watch something else.
The children were at the park all day, were they? No wonder they're tired.
You bought new black clothes for the party, did you? Let me see.
So you live near the river, do you? That must be nice.
Your brother plays the drums, does he? No wonder it's so noisy.
You met the Prime Minister, did you? How exciting!
The plate is empty. So the cat ate the fish, did it?
Oh, she speaks four languages, does she? I'm impressed.
You've been to Japan, have you? When did you go?
So you've finished all your homework, have you? Show me.
He's found a new job, has he? Good for him.
Their house is empty now. They've moved to the countryside, have they?
Your mum says you've got a job abroad. So you'll be away all summer, will you?
You can cook Thai food, can you? Teach me!
Oh, he'll help us move, will he? That's kind.
So this is your new flat, is it? It's lovely.
So you're the new manager, are you? Welcome.
So you got the job, did you? Congratulations!
You want to leave university and travel the world. So that's your plan, is it?
Oh, you think you're clever, do you?
So you want to borrow my car again, do you?
You're too busy to help, are you? We'll see about that.
So you forgot my birthday again, did you?
Oh, you know better than the doctor, do you?
You're from Spain, are you? I thought you were Italian.
You're leaving tomorrow, are you? Nobody told me.
You work at the bank, do you? I didn't know that.

examples.heading: ① 肯定的直述句 + is / are / was / were

items.en: You said he's in your class. Your boyfriend is also sixteen, is he?
items.zh: 你說他跟你同班。你男朋友也是十六歲，是嗎？

items.en: So the restaurant is closed on Mondays, is it? I didn't know that.
items.zh: 所以那家餐廳星期一休息，是嗎？我都不知道。

items.en: Oh, you're a teacher, are you? What do you teach?
items.zh: 喔，原來你是老師啊？你教什麼？

items.en: Your sister is getting married, is she? That's wonderful!
items.zh: 你姊姊要結婚了，是嗎？太好了！

items.en: So the film was boring, was it? I'll watch something else.
items.zh: 所以那部電影很無聊，是嗎？我看別的好了。

items.en: The children were at the park all day, were they? No wonder they're tired.
items.zh: 孩子們在公園待了一整天，是嗎？難怪他們很累。

examples.heading: ② 肯定的直述句 + do / does / did

items.en: You bought new black clothes for the party, did you? Let me see.
items.zh: 你為了派對買了新的黑色衣服，是嗎？給我看看。

items.en: So you live near the river, do you? That must be nice.
items.zh: 所以你住在河邊，是嗎？那一定很棒。

items.en: Your brother plays the drums, does he? No wonder it's so noisy.
items.zh: 你哥哥打鼓，是嗎？難怪這麼吵。

items.en: You met the Prime Minister, did you? How exciting!
items.zh: 你見到首相了，是嗎？好令人興奮！

items.en: The plate is empty. So the cat ate the fish, did it?
items.zh: 盤子空了。所以是貓把魚吃掉了，是嗎？

items.en: Oh, she speaks four languages, does she? I'm impressed.
items.zh: 喔，她會說四種語言啊？我好佩服。

examples.heading: ③ 肯定的直述句 + have / has

items.en: You've been to Japan, have you? When did you go?
items.zh: 你去過日本，是嗎？什麼時候去的？

items.en: So you've finished all your homework, have you? Show me.
items.zh: 所以你功課都寫完了，是嗎？拿給我看。

items.en: He's found a new job, has he? Good for him.
items.zh: 他找到新工作了，是嗎？真替他高興。

items.en: Their house is empty now. They've moved to the countryside, have they?
items.zh: 他們家現在空了。他們搬到鄉下了，是嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 肯定的直述句 + will / can

items.en: Your mum says you've got a job abroad. So you'll be away all summer, will you?
items.zh: 你媽說你在國外找到工作了。所以你整個夏天都不在，是嗎？

items.en: You can cook Thai food, can you? Teach me!
items.zh: 你會做泰國菜，是嗎？教我！

items.en: Oh, he'll help us move, will he? That's kind.
items.zh: 喔，他會幫我們搬家，是嗎？他人真好。

examples.heading: ⑤ So + 肯定的直述句 + 肯定的附加問句：剛得知的事

items.en: So this is your new flat, is it? It's lovely.
items.zh: 所以這就是你的新公寓，是嗎？很漂亮。

items.en: So you're the new manager, are you? Welcome.
items.zh: 所以你就是新來的經理，是嗎？歡迎。

items.en: So you got the job, did you? Congratulations!
items.zh: 所以你拿到那份工作了，是嗎？恭喜！

items.en: You want to leave university and travel the world. So that's your plan, is it?
items.zh: 你想休學去環遊世界。所以那就是你的計畫，是嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 帶著懷疑或不滿

items.en: Oh, you think you're clever, do you?
items.zh: 喔，你覺得你很聰明是吧？

items.en: So you want to borrow my car again, do you?
items.zh: 所以你又想借我的車了是吧？

items.en: You're too busy to help, are you? We'll see about that.
items.zh: 你太忙了沒辦法幫忙是吧？我們走著瞧。

items.en: So you forgot my birthday again, did you?
items.zh: 所以你又忘了我的生日是吧？

items.en: Oh, you know better than the doctor, do you?
items.zh: 喔，你比醫生還懂是吧？

examples.heading: ⑦ 剛聽說，表示驚訝

items.en: You're from Spain, are you? I thought you were Italian.
items.zh: 原來你是西班牙人啊？我還以為你是義大利人。

items.en: You're leaving tomorrow, are you? Nobody told me.
items.zh: 你明天就要走了，是嗎？都沒人跟我說。

items.en: You work at the bank, do you? I didn't know that.
items.zh: 原來你在銀行上班啊？我都不知道。

title: It sounds peaceful, doesn't it?
translation: 聽起來很寧靜，不是嗎？
name: 肯定句加否定附加問句
sentences: A little house by the river? It sounds peaceful, doesn't it?
That plan sounds good, doesn't it? Let's try it.
Your new flat looks lovely in the photos, doesn't it?
I need twenty copies. You know how to use this machine, don't you?
This soup tastes a bit strange, doesn't it?
Your parents told me the news. So you're moving to a different area, aren't you?
I'm doing the seating plan. Your brother is coming to the wedding, isn't he?
I'm not cooking, then. We're having pizza tonight, aren't we?
We've arranged to meet at twelve, haven't we? Don't be late.
I'll give you the money later. You've already paid for the tickets, haven't you?
She's lived in Japan for ten years, hasn't she?
It's stopped raining, hasn't it? Let's go out.
There's a shiny car outside the Browns' house. They've bought a new car, haven't they?
When you come back, we should rent some films, shouldn't we?
We should leave soon, shouldn't we? The traffic will be bad.
You should tell your parents, shouldn't you?
We both have time off in July. We could go on holiday together, couldn't we?
You could ask your teacher for help, couldn't you?
The roads will be full of traffic. We could take the train instead, couldn't we?
We both love castles. A week in Scotland would be perfect for us, wouldn't it?
Our class hasn't met for ten years. A reunion would be fun, wouldn't it?
We've got a big garden now. A dog would make the children happy, wouldn't it?
You'll watch the show on the 23rd of August, won't you?
It's a long drive to Scotland. You'll call me when you get there, won't you?
It'll be dark by six, won't it? Take a torch.
It's been years since we visited. They'll remember us, won't they?
I think the bus leaves at eight, doesn't it?
I think she's right, isn't she?
I think we've met before, haven't we?
The view from up here is amazing, isn't it?
Learning a language takes a long time, doesn't it?

examples.heading: ① 肯定的直述句 + doesn't / don't

items.en: A little house by the river? It sounds peaceful, doesn't it?
items.zh: 河邊的小房子？聽起來很寧靜，不是嗎？

items.en: That plan sounds good, doesn't it? Let's try it.
items.zh: 那個計畫聽起來不錯，對吧？我們試試看。

items.en: Your new flat looks lovely in the photos, doesn't it?
items.zh: 你的新公寓在照片上看起來很漂亮，對吧？

items.en: I need twenty copies. You know how to use this machine, don't you?
items.zh: 我需要二十份影本。你知道怎麼用這台機器，對吧？

items.en: This soup tastes a bit strange, doesn't it?
items.zh: 這湯喝起來有點怪，對吧？

examples.heading: ② 肯定的直述句 + aren't / isn't

items.en: Your parents told me the news. So you're moving to a different area, aren't you?
items.zh: 你爸媽跟我說了。所以你要搬到別的地區，對吧？

items.en: I'm doing the seating plan. Your brother is coming to the wedding, isn't he?
items.zh: 我在排座位。你哥哥會來參加婚禮，對吧？

items.en: I'm not cooking, then. We're having pizza tonight, aren't we?
items.zh: 那我就不煮了。我們今晚吃披薩，對吧？

examples.heading: ③ 肯定的直述句 + haven't / hasn't

items.en: We've arranged to meet at twelve, haven't we? Don't be late.
items.zh: 我們約好十二點見面，對吧？別遲到。

items.en: I'll give you the money later. You've already paid for the tickets, haven't you?
items.zh: 我晚點把錢給你。你已經付了票錢，對吧？

items.en: She's lived in Japan for ten years, hasn't she?
items.zh: 她在日本住了十年，對吧？

items.en: It's stopped raining, hasn't it? Let's go out.
items.zh: 雨停了，對吧？我們出去吧。

items.en: There's a shiny car outside the Browns' house. They've bought a new car, haven't they?
items.zh: Brown 家外面停了一輛閃亮的車。他們買了新車，對吧？

examples.heading: ④ 肯定的直述句 + shouldn't

items.en: When you come back, we should rent some films, shouldn't we?
items.zh: 你回來以後，我們應該租幾部電影來看，對吧？

items.en: We should leave soon, shouldn't we? The traffic will be bad.
items.zh: 我們應該快點出發，對吧？車會很多。

items.en: You should tell your parents, shouldn't you?
items.zh: 你應該告訴你爸媽，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ 肯定的直述句 + couldn't

items.en: We both have time off in July. We could go on holiday together, couldn't we?
items.zh: 我們七月都有休假。我們可以一起去度假，對吧？

items.en: You could ask your teacher for help, couldn't you?
items.zh: 你可以請老師幫忙，對吧？

items.en: The roads will be full of traffic. We could take the train instead, couldn't we?
items.zh: 路上會很塞。我們可以改搭火車，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑥ 肯定的直述句 + wouldn't

items.en: We both love castles. A week in Scotland would be perfect for us, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 我們都很愛城堡。在蘇格蘭待一個星期對我們來說再好不過了，對吧？

items.en: Our class hasn't met for ten years. A reunion would be fun, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 我們班十年沒聚了。辦個同學會會很好玩，對吧？

items.en: We've got a big garden now. A dog would make the children happy, wouldn't it?
items.zh: 我們現在有大院子了。養狗會讓孩子們很開心，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑦ 肯定的直述句 + won't

items.en: You'll watch the show on the 23rd of August, won't you?
items.zh: 你會看八月二十三日的節目，對吧？

items.en: It's a long drive to Scotland. You'll call me when you get there, won't you?
items.zh: 開車去蘇格蘭很遠。你到了會打給我，對吧？

items.en: It'll be dark by six, won't it? Take a torch.
items.zh: 六點天就黑了，對吧？帶支手電筒。

items.en: It's been years since we visited. They'll remember us, won't they?
items.zh: 我們好多年沒去拜訪了。他們會記得我們，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑧ I think + 子句 + 附加問句

items.en: I think the bus leaves at eight, doesn't it?
items.zh: 我想公車是八點開，對吧？

items.en: I think she's right, isn't she?
items.zh: 我覺得她是對的，不是嗎？

items.en: I think we've met before, haven't we?
items.zh: 我想我們以前見過，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑨ 請對方同意

items.en: The view from up here is amazing, isn't it?
items.zh: 從這上面看出去的景色很壯觀，對吧？

items.en: Learning a language takes a long time, doesn't it?
items.zh: 學一種語言要花很久的時間，對吧？

title: Are you doing anything on Friday?
translation: 你星期五有要做什麼嗎？
name: 是非疑問句的助動詞 be
sentences: There's a new film at the cinema. Are you doing anything on Friday?
I don't want to go alone. Are you going to the new art class on Tuesday?
I'm making a list for the barbecue. Are your neighbours joining us?
You've bought a new bed for the spare room. Are your cousins staying with you this summer?
I've forgotten the plan for tomorrow. Are we meeting at the café or at the station?
I'm buying tickets for Saturday. Is your son singing in the school show?
You were ill last week. Are you feeling better?
Is it raining? I can hear something on the roof.
Are you watching this programme, or can I change the channel?
Is the baby sleeping? I'll be quiet.
You look a bit lost. Am I talking too fast?
You keep looking at your phone. Are you listening to me?
The party starts at eight. Are you going to come?
They offered you more money. Are you going to take the job?
Your daughter is learning Japanese. Is she going to study abroad next year?
The Browns have a big sign in their garden. Are they going to move?
I need a lift to the airport. Is your husband driving to work today?
It's Christmas Eve. Is the shop closing early today?
Is your phone ringing? I can hear something in your bag.
I haven't seen Tom for years. Is he still living in London?
You didn't answer. Were you sleeping when I called?
Your boots are white. Was it snowing on your way here?
There's mud all over the floor. Were the children playing in the garden?
The police need a description. Was the man carrying a bag?
"Are you joining us for lunch?" "Yes, I am. I'll get my coat."
"Is it still raining?" "No, it isn't. The sun's out."
"Are they staying for dinner?" "Yes, they are."
"Her eyes were red. Was she crying?" "No, she wasn't. She was laughing."
It's been a month since you started. Are you enjoying your new job?
It's your third week at university. Are your classes going well?
You moved last week, didn't you? Are you settling into your new flat?

examples.heading: ① Are you + 動詞-ing：安排好的計畫

items.en: There's a new film at the cinema. Are you doing anything on Friday?
items.zh: 電影院有新片。你星期五有要做什麼嗎？

items.en: I don't want to go alone. Are you going to the new art class on Tuesday?
items.zh: 我不想一個人去。你星期二要去上新的美術課嗎？

items.en: I'm making a list for the barbecue. Are your neighbours joining us?
items.zh: 我在列烤肉的名單。你的鄰居會一起來嗎？

items.en: You've bought a new bed for the spare room. Are your cousins staying with you this summer?
items.zh: 你為客房買了新床。你的表兄弟姊妹今年夏天要住你家嗎？

items.en: I've forgotten the plan for tomorrow. Are we meeting at the café or at the station?
items.zh: 我忘了明天的安排。我們是在咖啡店還是在車站見面？

items.en: I'm buying tickets for Saturday. Is your son singing in the school show?
items.zh: 我要買星期六的票。你兒子會在學校的表演上唱歌嗎？

examples.heading: ② Are you + 動詞-ing：現在正在發生

items.en: You were ill last week. Are you feeling better?
items.zh: 你上星期生病了。你覺得好一點了嗎？

items.en: Is it raining? I can hear something on the roof.
items.zh: 在下雨嗎？我聽到屋頂上有聲音。

items.en: Are you watching this programme, or can I change the channel?
items.zh: 你在看這個節目嗎？還是我可以轉台？

items.en: Is the baby sleeping? I'll be quiet.
items.zh: 寶寶在睡覺嗎？我會小聲一點。

items.en: You look a bit lost. Am I talking too fast?
items.zh: 你看起來有點跟不上。我講得太快了嗎？

items.en: You keep looking at your phone. Are you listening to me?
items.zh: 你一直在看手機。你有在聽我說話嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Are you going to + 原形動詞：問打算

items.en: The party starts at eight. Are you going to come?
items.zh: 派對八點開始。你會來嗎？

items.en: They offered you more money. Are you going to take the job?
items.zh: 他們給你更高的薪水。你會接受那份工作嗎？

items.en: Your daughter is learning Japanese. Is she going to study abroad next year?
items.zh: 你女兒在學日文。她明年要出國念書嗎？

items.en: The Browns have a big sign in their garden. Are they going to move?
items.zh: Brown 家院子裡立了一塊大牌子。他們打算搬家嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Is he / she / it + 動詞-ing

items.en: I need a lift to the airport. Is your husband driving to work today?
items.zh: 我需要人載我去機場。你先生今天開車上班嗎？

items.en: It's Christmas Eve. Is the shop closing early today?
items.zh: 今天是聖誕夜。那家店今天會提早關門嗎？

items.en: Is your phone ringing? I can hear something in your bag.
items.zh: 是你的手機在響嗎？我聽到你包包裡有聲音。

items.en: I haven't seen Tom for years. Is he still living in London?
items.zh: 我好幾年沒見到 Tom 了。他還住在倫敦嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Was / Were + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: You didn't answer. Were you sleeping when I called?
items.zh: 你沒接電話。我打給你的時候你在睡覺嗎？

items.en: Your boots are white. Was it snowing on your way here?
items.zh: 你的靴子都白了。你來的路上在下雪嗎？

items.en: There's mud all over the floor. Were the children playing in the garden?
items.zh: 地上到處都是泥巴。孩子們剛剛在院子裡玩嗎？

items.en: The police need a description. Was the man carrying a bag?
items.zh: 警察需要描述。那個男人當時有拿著包包嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 簡答

items.en: "Are you joining us for lunch?" "Yes, I am. I'll get my coat."
items.zh: 你要跟我們一起吃午餐嗎？要。我去拿外套。

items.en: "Is it still raining?" "No, it isn't. The sun's out."
items.zh: 還在下雨嗎？沒有。太陽出來了。

items.en: "Are they staying for dinner?" "Yes, they are."
items.zh: 他們要留下來吃晚餐嗎？要。

items.en: "Her eyes were red. Was she crying?" "No, she wasn't. She was laughing."
items.zh: 她的眼睛紅紅的。她剛剛在哭嗎？沒有。她在笑。

examples.heading: ⑦ 禮貌地問近況

items.en: It's been a month since you started. Are you enjoying your new job?
items.zh: 你開始上班一個月了。你喜歡你的新工作嗎？

items.en: It's your third week at university. Are your classes going well?
items.zh: 這是你上大學的第三個星期。你的課都還順利嗎？

items.en: You moved last week, didn't you? Are you settling into your new flat?
items.zh: 你上星期搬家了，對吧？你在新公寓住得習慣嗎？

title: I left my mobile phone at your house. Have you seen it?
translation: 我把手機忘在你家了。你有看到嗎？
name: 是非疑問句的助動詞 have
sentences: I left my mobile phone at your house yesterday. Have you seen it?
I've just watched the football final with my family. Have you watched it?
You look different. Have you cut your hair?
Have you heard the news? Sarah is getting married!
It's almost two o'clock. Have you had lunch? I'm going to the café.
The teacher wants the essays today. Have you finished yours?
Have you ever been to Japan? It's beautiful in spring.
This restaurant is new in town. Have you ever eaten Ethiopian food?
You work in a big hotel. Have you ever served anyone famous?
The farm offers rides at the weekend. Have you ever been on a horse?
I'm nervous about flying alone. Have you ever missed a connecting flight?
Your brother finished university in June. Has he started work yet?
Has the post arrived yet? I'm waiting for a letter.
Emma looks so happy these days. Has she told you about her new boyfriend?
Has it stopped raining? I want to go out.
My little boy wants to play with him. Has your dog ever bitten anyone?
Have we met before? Your face looks familiar.
Their plane landed three hours ago. Have they arrived at the hotel yet?
Twelve people are coming tonight. Have we bought enough food?
You moved in a month ago. Have your parents visited your new flat?
The concert sells out fast. Have you booked the tickets yet?
We took the exam six weeks ago. Have the results come out yet?
Has the film started yet? I've just arrived.
The landlord wrote to you on Monday. Have you answered him yet?
"Have you seen my glasses?" "Yes, I have. They're on the table."
"You lent Mark fifty pounds last month. Has he paid you back?" "No, he hasn't."
"Have you ever been to India?" "No, I haven't, but I'd love to go."
"The builders have gone. Have they finished the work?" "Yes, they have."
Have you got a pen? I need to write this down.
Your new friend talks about her family a lot. Has she got any brothers or sisters?
My train doesn't leave until five. Have you got time for a coffee?

examples.heading: ① Have you + 過去分詞：問最近的事

items.en: I left my mobile phone at your house yesterday. Have you seen it?
items.zh: 我昨天把手機忘在你家了。你有看到嗎？

items.en: I've just watched the football final with my family. Have you watched it?
items.zh: 我剛和家人看完足球決賽。你看了嗎？

items.en: You look different. Have you cut your hair?
items.zh: 你看起來不一樣。你剪頭髮了嗎？

items.en: Have you heard the news? Sarah is getting married!
items.zh: 你聽說了嗎？Sarah 要結婚了！

items.en: It's almost two o'clock. Have you had lunch? I'm going to the café.
items.zh: 快兩點了。你吃午餐了嗎？我要去咖啡店。

items.en: The teacher wants the essays today. Have you finished yours?
items.zh: 老師今天要收作文。你寫完了嗎？

examples.heading: ② Have you ever + 過去分詞：問經驗

items.en: Have you ever been to Japan? It's beautiful in spring.
items.zh: 你去過日本嗎？那裡春天很美。

items.en: This restaurant is new in town. Have you ever eaten Ethiopian food?
items.zh: 這家餐廳是鎮上新開的。你吃過衣索比亞菜嗎？

items.en: You work in a big hotel. Have you ever served anyone famous?
items.zh: 你在一家大飯店上班。你招待過名人嗎？

items.en: The farm offers rides at the weekend. Have you ever been on a horse?
items.zh: 那座農場週末有騎馬活動。你騎過馬嗎？

items.en: I'm nervous about flying alone. Have you ever missed a connecting flight?
items.zh: 我很緊張要一個人搭飛機。你錯過轉機航班過嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Has + he / she / it + 過去分詞

items.en: Your brother finished university in June. Has he started work yet?
items.zh: 你哥哥六月大學畢業了。他開始工作了沒？

items.en: Has the post arrived yet? I'm waiting for a letter.
items.zh: 郵件到了沒？我在等一封信。

items.en: Emma looks so happy these days. Has she told you about her new boyfriend?
items.zh: Emma 最近看起來好開心。她跟你說過她新男朋友的事了嗎？

items.en: Has it stopped raining? I want to go out.
items.zh: 雨停了嗎？我想出去。

items.en: My little boy wants to play with him. Has your dog ever bitten anyone?
items.zh: 我兒子想跟牠玩。你的狗咬過人嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Have we / they + 過去分詞

items.en: Have we met before? Your face looks familiar.
items.zh: 我們以前見過嗎？你看起來很面熟。

items.en: Their plane landed three hours ago. Have they arrived at the hotel yet?
items.zh: 他們的飛機三個小時前就降落了。他們到飯店了沒？

items.en: Twelve people are coming tonight. Have we bought enough food?
items.zh: 今晚有十二個人要來。我們買的食物夠嗎？

items.en: You moved in a month ago. Have your parents visited your new flat?
items.zh: 你一個月前搬進去。你爸媽來過你的新公寓了嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Have ... yet?：問已經做了沒

items.en: The concert sells out fast. Have you booked the tickets yet?
items.zh: 那場演唱會很快就賣完。你訂票了沒？

items.en: We took the exam six weeks ago. Have the results come out yet?
items.zh: 我們六個星期前考試。成績公布了沒？

items.en: Has the film started yet? I've just arrived.
items.zh: 電影開始了沒？我剛到。

items.en: The landlord wrote to you on Monday. Have you answered him yet?
items.zh: 房東星期一寫信給你。你回他了沒？

examples.heading: ⑥ 簡答

items.en: "Have you seen my glasses?" "Yes, I have. They're on the table."
items.zh: 你有看到我的眼鏡嗎？有。在桌上。

items.en: "You lent Mark fifty pounds last month. Has he paid you back?" "No, he hasn't."
items.zh: 你上個月借 Mark 五十英鎊。他還你錢了嗎？還沒。

items.en: "Have you ever been to India?" "No, I haven't, but I'd love to go."
items.zh: 你去過印度嗎？沒有，可是我很想去。

items.en: "The builders have gone. Have they finished the work?" "Yes, they have."
items.zh: 工人走了。他們完成工作了嗎？完成了。

examples.heading: ⑦ Have you got：有沒有

items.en: Have you got a pen? I need to write this down.
items.zh: 你有筆嗎？我得把這個記下來。

items.en: Your new friend talks about her family a lot. Has she got any brothers or sisters?
items.zh: 你的新朋友常講她的家人。她有兄弟姊妹嗎？

items.en: My train doesn't leave until five. Have you got time for a coffee?
items.zh: 我的火車五點才開。你有時間喝杯咖啡嗎？

title: Should I go there and talk to her, or should I stay here?
translation: 我應該過去跟她談，還是應該待在這裡？
name: 用 or 連接兩個子句的選擇疑問句

Will you be home for dinner, or will you eat at work?
Does he know about the party, or does he think it's a normal day?
You haven't mentioned Jack lately. Are you still with him, or did you two break up?
Is the shop closed today, or have they moved?
Do you like the new job, or are you still looking for another one?
Are you angry with me, or did something happen at work?
Did you lose your phone, or is the battery dead?
I can't see out of this window. Is it raining, or has it stopped?
Have you read the book, or did you just watch the film?
Will you drive, or should I?
Did you break the window, or did your brother do it?
Are you paying, or is your company paying?
Do you want to tell Mum, or shall I?
Is Sarah coming tonight, or is she still ill?
It's sunny outside. Would you like to go for a walk in the break, or would you rather stay inside?
Do you want to watch the match at home, or would you prefer to go to the pub?
I'm free this afternoon. Shall we have the meeting today, or would tomorrow be better?
"Are you coming, or are you staying?" "I'm staying. I'm too tired."
"Did you walk here, or did someone drive you?" "My dad drove me."
"Is it broken, or is it just switched off?" "It's broken, I'm afraid."
Should I take the job in London, or should I stay in my home town?
Do we book the hotel now, or do we wait for a better price?
Should we tell the teacher, or should we keep quiet?
Are you going to finish your degree, or are you going to start working?
Do I send the email now, or should I wait until Monday?
Shall we paint the room ourselves, or should we pay someone to do it?

examples.heading: ① 疑問句 A + or + 疑問句 B（相同的助動詞）

items.en: She's sitting alone over there. Should I go and talk to her, or should I stay here?
items.zh: 她一個人坐在那邊。我應該過去跟她談，還是應該待在這裡？

items.en: We're leaving for the beach in ten minutes. Are you coming with us, or are you staying at home?
items.zh: 我們十分鐘後要出發去海邊。你要跟我們一起去，還是要待在家裡？

items.en: Do you want me to cook, or do you want to eat out?
items.zh: 你要我煮飯，還是你想去外面吃？

items.en: Can you hear me, or is the line bad again?
items.zh: 你聽得到我嗎？還是訊號又不好了？

items.en: Shall I call a taxi, or shall we walk?
items.zh: 要我叫計程車，還是我們走路？

items.en: Will you be home for dinner, or will you eat at work?
items.zh: 你會回家吃晚餐，還是在公司吃？

items.en: Does he know about the party, or does he think it's a normal day?
items.zh: 他知道派對的事嗎？還是他以為今天是普通的一天？

examples.heading: ② 疑問句 A + or + 疑問句 B（不同的助動詞或時態）

items.en: You haven't mentioned Jack lately. Are you still with him, or did you two break up?
items.zh: 你最近都沒提到 Jack。你還跟他在一起，還是你們分手了？

items.en: Is the shop closed today, or have they moved?
items.zh: 那家店今天沒開，還是搬走了？

items.en: Do you like the new job, or are you still looking for another one?
items.zh: 你喜歡新工作嗎？還是你還在找別的？

items.en: Are you angry with me, or did something happen at work?
items.zh: 你在生我的氣，還是工作上發生了什麼事？

items.en: Did you lose your phone, or is the battery dead?
items.zh: 你的手機弄丟了，還是沒電了？

items.en: I can't see out of this window. Is it raining, or has it stopped?
items.zh: 我從這扇窗看不到外面。還在下雨，還是停了？

items.en: Have you read the book, or did you just watch the film?
items.zh: 你讀過那本書了，還是只看了電影？

examples.heading: ③ 疑問句 B 有不同的主詞

items.en: Will you drive, or should I?
items.zh: 你要開車，還是我來開？

items.en: Did you break the window, or did your brother do it?
items.zh: 窗戶是你打破的，還是你弟弟打破的？

items.en: Are you paying, or is your company paying?
items.zh: 是你付錢，還是你公司付錢？

items.en: Do you want to tell Mum, or shall I?
items.zh: 你要跟媽媽說，還是我來說？

items.en: Is Sarah coming tonight, or is she still ill?
items.zh: Sarah 今晚會來嗎？還是她還在生病？

examples.heading: ④ 疑問句 B 用 would rather / would prefer / would be better

items.en: It's sunny outside. Would you like to go for a walk in the break, or would you rather stay inside?
items.zh: 外面出太陽了。休息時間你想去散步，還是比較想待在室內？

items.en: Do you want to watch the match at home, or would you prefer to go to the pub?
items.zh: 你想在家看比賽，還是比較想去酒吧看？

items.en: I'm free this afternoon. Shall we have the meeting today, or would tomorrow be better?
items.zh: 我今天下午有空。我們今天開會，還是明天比較好？

examples.heading: ⑤ 回答兩個疑問句

items.en: "Are you coming, or are you staying?" "I'm staying. I'm too tired."
items.zh: 你要來，還是要留下來？我留下來。我太累了。

items.en: "Did you walk here, or did someone drive you?" "My dad drove me."
items.zh: 你是走路來的，還是有人載你？我爸載我來的。

items.en: "Is it broken, or is it just switched off?" "It's broken, I'm afraid."
items.zh: 它是壞了，還是只是關機？恐怕是壞了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問對方的決定

items.en: Should I take the job in London, or should I stay in my home town?
items.zh: 我應該接受倫敦的工作，還是應該留在家鄉？

items.en: Do we book the hotel now, or do we wait for a better price?
items.zh: 我們現在訂飯店，還是等更好的價錢？

items.en: Should we tell the teacher, or should we keep quiet?
items.zh: 我們應該跟老師說，還是應該保持沉默？

items.en: Are you going to finish your degree, or are you going to start working?
items.zh: 你要把學位念完，還是要開始工作？

items.en: Do I send the email now, or should I wait until Monday?
items.zh: 我現在寄這封電子郵件，還是應該等到星期一？

items.en: Shall we paint the room ourselves, or should we pay someone to do it?
items.zh: 房間我們自己漆，還是應該花錢請人來漆？

title: Is he going to give it back to me or show it to everybody?
translation: 他是要把它還給我，還是要拿給大家看？
name: 選擇疑問句的省略
sentences: Do you walk to school or take the bus?
