Does your brother live with you or have his own place?
Did you call her or send her a message?
Did the plane land on time or arrive late?
Does the pain stay the same or come and go?
Do they sell tickets online or make you buy them at the door?
Did he say sorry or just walk away?
Does she teach at the school or just help out there?
Are you working tonight or staying home?
Was she crying or laughing?
Is he sleeping or just resting his eyes?
Are they building a new house or fixing the old one?
Was the dog barking at us or chasing a cat?
Have you finished the book or given up on it?
Has the shop closed for good or just moved?
Has the manager quit or gone on holiday?
Will you drive or take the train?
Should we wait for him or start without him?
Could you email the file or bring it on a USB stick?
Would you like to eat out or cook at home?
Should I text you or call you when I get there?
Are you going to fix it yourself or call someone?
Is she going to stay in Tokyo or move back home?
Are we going to walk or get a taxi?
Is it cheaper to fly or take the train?
Is it better to call her now or wait until morning?
Is it easier to rent a car or to take the bus?
Would it be kinder to tell him now or to let him find out for himself?
Do you want to watch a film, play cards or go for a walk?
Did you lose your phone, break it or leave it at home?
Should we paint the room, change the curtains or leave it as it is?
Are you going to study, work or take a year off after high school?

examples.heading: ① Do、Does、Did + 主詞 + 原形 or 原形

items.en: Do you walk to school or take the bus?
items.zh: 你走路上學，還是搭公車？

items.en: Does your brother live with you or have his own place?
items.zh: 你哥哥跟你一起住，還是自己在外面住？

items.en: Did you call her or send her a message?
items.zh: 你是打電話給她，還是傳訊息給她？

items.en: Did the plane land on time or arrive late?
items.zh: 飛機是準時降落，還是誤點了？

items.en: Does the pain stay the same or come and go?
items.zh: 這個痛是一直都一樣，還是一陣一陣的？

items.en: Do they sell tickets online or make you buy them at the door?
items.zh: 他們是在網路上賣票，還是要你到現場買？

items.en: Did he say sorry or just walk away?
items.zh: 他有道歉，還是直接走掉了？

items.en: Does she teach at the school or just help out there?
items.zh: 她是在學校教書，還是只是去幫忙？

examples.heading: ② be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing or 動詞-ing

items.en: Are you working tonight or staying home?
items.zh: 你今晚要上班，還是待在家？

items.en: Was she crying or laughing?
items.zh: 她那時是在哭，還是在笑？

items.en: Is he sleeping or just resting his eyes?
items.zh: 他是睡著了，還是只是閉目養神？

items.en: Are they building a new house or fixing the old one?
items.zh: 他們是在蓋新房子，還是在修舊的？

items.en: Was the dog barking at us or chasing a cat?
items.zh: 那隻狗是在對我們叫，還是在追貓？

examples.heading: ③ have、has + 主詞 + 過去分詞 or 過去分詞

items.en: Have you finished the book or given up on it?
items.zh: 你是看完那本書了，還是放棄了？

items.en: Has the shop closed for good or just moved?
items.zh: 那家店是收掉了，還是只是搬家了？

items.en: Has the manager quit or gone on holiday?
items.zh: 經理是辭職了，還是去度假了？

examples.heading: ④ 情態動詞 + 主詞 + 原形 or 原形

items.en: Will you drive or take the train?
items.zh: 你要開車，還是搭火車？

items.en: Should we wait for him or start without him?
items.zh: 我們該等他，還是先開始？

items.en: Could you email the file or bring it on a USB stick?
items.zh: 你可以把檔案用 email 寄過來，還是用隨身碟帶來？

items.en: Would you like to eat out or cook at home?
items.zh: 你想出去吃，還是在家煮？

items.en: Should I text you or call you when I get there?
items.zh: 我到了以後，要傳訊息給你，還是打給你？

examples.heading: ⑤ be + 主詞 + going to + 原形 or 原形

items.en: Are you going to fix it yourself or call someone?
items.zh: 你要自己修，還是找人來修？

items.en: Is she going to stay in Tokyo or move back home?
items.zh: 她要留在東京，還是搬回老家？

items.en: Are we going to walk or get a taxi?
items.zh: 我們要走路，還是叫計程車？

examples.heading: ⑥ it + be + 形容詞 + to + 原形 or (to) 原形

items.en: Is it cheaper to fly or take the train?
items.zh: 搭飛機比較便宜，還是搭火車？

items.en: Is it better to call her now or wait until morning?
items.zh: 現在打給她比較好，還是等到早上？

items.en: Is it easier to rent a car or to take the bus?
items.zh: 租車比較方便，還是搭公車？

items.en: Would it be kinder to tell him now or to let him find out for himself?
items.zh: 現在就告訴他比較體貼，還是讓他自己發現？

examples.heading: ⑦ 選項不只兩個

items.en: Do you want to watch a film, play cards or go for a walk?
items.zh: 你想看電影、打牌，還是去散步？

items.en: Did you lose your phone, break it or leave it at home?
items.zh: 你的手機是弄丟了、摔壞了，還是忘在家裡？

items.en: Should we paint the room, change the curtains or leave it as it is?
items.zh: 我們該粉刷房間、換窗簾，還是維持原樣？

items.en: Are you going to study, work or take a year off after high school?
items.zh: 高中畢業後，你要念書、工作，還是休息一年？

title: Did you see the football match last night?
translation: 你昨晚有看那場足球比賽嗎？
name: 是非疑問句的助動詞 do
sentences: My favourite song is "Viva la Vida". Do you know it?
My bedroom is going to be blue. I love this colour! Do you like it?
We've got an extra ticket for tonight. Do you want to come to the cinema with us?
I'm meeting your parents on Sunday. Do they understand English?
The school trip is on Thursday. Do we need to bring our own food?
The twins walk home every day. Do they live close to the school?
Our band needs a drummer. Do you know anyone who plays the drums?
Does your brother play tennis? We need a fourth player.
Excuse me, I'm visiting my aunt. Does this bus stop at the hospital?
Does your sister like chocolate? I bought her a box.
The kids want to swim every day. Does the hotel have a pool for children?
The doctor looked at my swollen ankle. "Does it hurt when I touch it here?"
It's meant to be a surprise. Does your mum suspect anything?
That last goal was amazing! Did you see the football match last night?
There's a new shop opposite my house. Did you notice it when you came?
Welcome back from Greece! Did you have a good time?
Lucy had her driving test this morning. Did she pass?
The roads were icy last night. Did your parents get home safely?
The back door is open. Did you lock it when you left?
I ordered a new phone case on Monday. Did the parcel arrive this morning?
"Do you like spicy food?" "Yes, I do. The hotter, the better."
"Does she work at the bank?" "No, she doesn't. She's a teacher."
"Did you finish the book?" "Yes, I did. I loved the ending."
"Do they have children?" "Yes, they do. Two boys."
"Did it rain in Paris?" "No, it didn't. It was sunny every day."
I have to sign this form. Do you have something to write with?
That suitcase looks heavy. Do you want some help with it?
It's dark and cold outside. Do you need me to drive you home?
I've just started learning the guitar. Do you play any music?
Our school has a new library. Does yours have one?
We went to the zoo last week. Did you ever go there when you were little?

examples.heading: ① Do + I / you / we / they + 原形動詞

items.en: My favourite song is "Viva la Vida". Do you know it?
items.zh: 我最喜歡的歌是〈Viva la Vida〉。你知道這首歌嗎？

items.en: My bedroom is going to be blue. I love this colour! Do you like it?
items.zh: 我的房間要漆成藍色。我好喜歡這個顏色！你喜歡嗎？

items.en: We've got an extra ticket for tonight. Do you want to come to the cinema with us?
items.zh: 我們今晚多一張票。你想跟我們一起去看電影嗎？

items.en: I'm meeting your parents on Sunday. Do they understand English?
items.zh: 我星期天要見你爸媽。他們聽得懂英文嗎？

items.en: The school trip is on Thursday. Do we need to bring our own food?
items.zh: 校外教學是星期四。我們需要自己帶吃的嗎？

items.en: The twins walk home every day. Do they live close to the school?
items.zh: 那對雙胞胎每天走路回家。他們家離學校近嗎？

items.en: Our band needs a drummer. Do you know anyone who plays the drums?
items.zh: 我們樂團需要一個鼓手。你認識會打鼓的人嗎？

examples.heading: ② Does + he / she / it + 原形動詞

items.en: Does your brother play tennis? We need a fourth player.
items.zh: 你哥哥打網球嗎？我們還需要第四個人。

items.en: Excuse me, I'm visiting my aunt. Does this bus stop at the hospital?
items.zh: 不好意思，我要去看我阿姨。這班公車會停醫院嗎？

items.en: Does your sister like chocolate? I bought her a box.
items.zh: 你姊姊喜歡巧克力嗎？我買了一盒給她。

items.en: The kids want to swim every day. Does the hotel have a pool for children?
items.zh: 孩子們每天都想游泳。那家飯店有兒童游泳池嗎？

items.en: The doctor looked at my swollen ankle. "Does it hurt when I touch it here?"
items.zh: 醫生看了我腫起來的腳踝。我碰這裡會痛嗎？

items.en: It's meant to be a surprise. Does your mum suspect anything?
items.zh: 這本來是個驚喜。你媽有察覺到什麼嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Did + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: That last goal was amazing! Did you see the football match last night?
items.zh: 最後那一球太精彩了！你昨晚有看那場足球比賽嗎？

items.en: There's a new shop opposite my house. Did you notice it when you came?
items.zh: 我家對面開了一家新店。你來的時候有注意到嗎？

items.en: Welcome back from Greece! Did you have a good time?
items.zh: 歡迎從希臘回來！你玩得開心嗎？

items.en: Lucy had her driving test this morning. Did she pass?
items.zh: Lucy 今天早上考駕照。她考過了嗎？

items.en: The roads were icy last night. Did your parents get home safely?
items.zh: 昨晚路面結冰。你爸媽平安到家了嗎？

items.en: The back door is open. Did you lock it when you left?
items.zh: 後門開著。你出門的時候有鎖門嗎？

items.en: I ordered a new phone case on Monday. Did the parcel arrive this morning?
items.zh: 我星期一訂了新的手機殼。包裹今天早上到了嗎？

examples.heading: ④ 簡答

items.en: "Do you like spicy food?" "Yes, I do. The hotter, the better."
items.zh: 你喜歡吃辣嗎？喜歡。越辣越好。

items.en: "Does she work at the bank?" "No, she doesn't. She's a teacher."
items.zh: 她在銀行上班嗎？不是。她是老師。

items.en: "Did you finish the book?" "Yes, I did. I loved the ending."
items.zh: 你把書讀完了嗎？讀完了。我很喜歡結局。

items.en: "Do they have children?" "Yes, they do. Two boys."
items.zh: 他們有小孩嗎？有。兩個男孩。

items.en: "Did it rain in Paris?" "No, it didn't. It was sunny every day."
items.zh: 巴黎有下雨嗎？沒有。每天都是晴天。

examples.heading: ⑤ Do you + have / want / need

items.en: I have to sign this form. Do you have something to write with?
items.zh: 我得簽這張表格。你有可以寫字的東西嗎？

items.en: That suitcase looks heavy. Do you want some help with it?
items.zh: 那個行李箱看起來很重。你需要幫忙嗎？

items.en: It's dark and cold outside. Do you need me to drive you home?
items.zh: 外面又黑又冷。你需要我開車送你回家嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 用在信和訊息裡

items.en: I've just started learning the guitar. Do you play any music?
items.zh: 我剛開始學吉他。你會玩什麼音樂嗎？

items.en: Our school has a new library. Does yours have one?
items.zh: 我們學校有一間新圖書館。你們學校也有嗎？

items.en: We went to the zoo last week. Did you ever go there when you were little?
items.zh: 我們上星期去了動物園。你小時候有去過那裡嗎？

title: How was your dinner yesterday?
translation: 你昨天的晚餐怎麼樣？
name: wh- 疑問句的主要動詞 be
sentences: You went to the new restaurant last night. How was your dinner?
Hi, Tom! How are you, my friend?
Come and sit down, sweetheart. How was your first day at school?
You've just come back from Spain. How was the weather?
How is your grandmother? Is she better now?
I want to buy him a present. How old is your little brother?
I've looked everywhere. Where are my keys?
Excuse me, I need some cash. Where's the nearest cash machine?
You're late. Where were you?
Where's your dog? Is it OK?
Where were you born?
Nice to meet you. What's your name?
What's the time? I left my watch at home.
You were at the garage all morning. What was the problem with your car?
I want to cook for you on Saturday. What's your favourite dish?
What are those birds on the roof?
Who is that girl next to Anna?
I found an old class photo. Who was the tall boy at the back?
Who's your new teacher? Is she nice?
The doorbell has rung three times. Who are those people at the door?
When is your birthday? I want to send you a card.
When was the last time you saw a doctor?
Excuse me, I've just missed my train. When's the next one to Manchester?
When are the summer holidays this year?
You haven't said a word all morning. Why are you so quiet today?
Why was the shop closed this morning?
Why is the baby crying? Is she hungry?
Mr Lee looked angry this morning. Why were you late for class?
Excuse me, there's no price on it. How much is this coat?
The house is a mess this morning. How many people were at the party?
Which is your bag, the red one or the black one?

examples.heading: ① How + be

items.en: You went to the new restaurant last night. How was your dinner?
items.zh: 你昨晚去了那家新餐廳。晚餐怎麼樣？

items.en: Hi, Tom! How are you, my friend?
items.zh: 嗨，Tom！你好嗎，朋友？

items.en: Come and sit down, sweetheart. How was your first day at school?
items.zh: 過來坐，寶貝。你上學第一天過得怎麼樣？

items.en: You've just come back from Spain. How was the weather?
items.zh: 你剛從西班牙回來。天氣怎麼樣？

items.en: How is your grandmother? Is she better now?
items.zh: 你奶奶還好嗎？她現在好一點了嗎？

items.en: I want to buy him a present. How old is your little brother?
items.zh: 我想買禮物給他。你弟弟幾歲？

examples.heading: ② Where + be

items.en: I've looked everywhere. Where are my keys?
items.zh: 我每個地方都找過了。我的鑰匙在哪裡？

items.en: Excuse me, I need some cash. Where's the nearest cash machine?
items.zh: 不好意思，我需要一點現金。最近的提款機在哪裡？

items.en: You're late. Where were you?
items.zh: 你遲到了。你剛剛在哪裡？

items.en: Where's your dog? Is it OK?
items.zh: 你的狗呢？牠還好嗎？

items.en: Where were you born?
items.zh: 你在哪裡出生的？

examples.heading: ③ What + be

items.en: Nice to meet you. What's your name?
items.zh: 很高興認識你。你叫什麼名字？

items.en: What's the time? I left my watch at home.
items.zh: 現在幾點？我把手錶忘在家裡了。

items.en: You were at the garage all morning. What was the problem with your car?
items.zh: 你一整個早上都在修車廠。你的車出了什麼問題？

items.en: I want to cook for you on Saturday. What's your favourite dish?
items.zh: 我星期六想煮飯給你吃。你最喜歡哪道菜？

items.en: What are those birds on the roof?
items.zh: 屋頂上那些是什麼鳥？

examples.heading: ④ Who + be

items.en: Who is that girl next to Anna?
items.zh: Anna 旁邊那個女孩是誰？

items.en: I found an old class photo. Who was the tall boy at the back?
items.zh: 我找到一張舊的班級照。後面那個高個子男生是誰？

items.en: Who's your new teacher? Is she nice?
items.zh: 你的新老師是誰？她人好嗎？

items.en: The doorbell has rung three times. Who are those people at the door?
items.zh: 門鈴響了三次。門口那些人是誰？

examples.heading: ⑤ When + be

items.en: When is your birthday? I want to send you a card.
items.zh: 你的生日是什麼時候？我想寄卡片給你。

items.en: When was the last time you saw a doctor?
items.zh: 你上次看醫生是什麼時候？

items.en: Excuse me, I've just missed my train. When's the next one to Manchester?
items.zh: 不好意思，我剛錯過火車。下一班去曼徹斯特的是什麼時候？

items.en: When are the summer holidays this year?
items.zh: 今年的暑假是什麼時候？

examples.heading: ⑥ Why + be

items.en: You haven't said a word all morning. Why are you so quiet today?
items.zh: 你一整個早上都沒說話。你今天為什麼這麼安靜？

items.en: Why was the shop closed this morning?
items.zh: 那家店今天早上為什麼沒開？

items.en: Why is the baby crying? Is she hungry?
items.zh: 寶寶為什麼在哭？她餓了嗎？

items.en: Mr Lee looked angry this morning. Why were you late for class?
items.zh: 李老師今天早上看起來很生氣。你上課為什麼遲到？

examples.heading: ⑦ How much / How many / Which + be

items.en: Excuse me, there's no price on it. How much is this coat?
items.zh: 不好意思，上面沒有標價。這件大衣多少錢？

items.en: The house is a mess this morning. How many people were at the party?
items.zh: 今天早上家裡一團亂。派對上有多少人？

items.en: Which is your bag, the red one or the black one?
items.zh: 哪一個是你的包包，紅色的還是黑色的？

title: Are you ready?
translation: 你準備好了嗎？
name: 是非疑問句的主要動詞 be
sentences: Dad's waiting in the car. Are you ready?
You're holding your stomach. Are you in pain?
You've been out all day. Are you thirsty? There's juice in the fridge.
I'd like to say thank you for dinner. Are your parents at home this weekend?
Are these your keys? I found them on the floor.
The car park is almost empty. Are we too early for the show?
I heard your dog was ill. Is it OK now?
Is your sister at home? I need to talk to her.
Excuse me, is this your umbrella? You left it on the bus.
It's a public holiday. Is the museum open today?
We don't have a car this week. Is it far to the beach from here?
Is he your new teacher? He looks very young.
Am I late? I'm sorry, the bus was slow.
Sorry, it's my first day here. Am I in the right room for the English class?
I'm fifty, and I've never played an instrument. Am I too old to learn the piano?
Was the film good? I want to see it.
Were you at home last night? I called you three times, but nobody answered.
Welcome back! You were away for two weeks. Was it cold in Scotland?
Your team lost the final. Were the players very upset?
Your mum and your aunt are both teachers. Was your grandfather a teacher too?
Your holiday photos are lovely. Was the hotel near the sea?
"Are you tired?" "Yes, I am. I didn't sleep well."
"Is it your birthday today?" "No, it isn't. It's tomorrow."
"Were you at the party?" "Yes, I was. It was great."
"Is the shop open?" "No, it's not. It's Sunday."
"The answer is twelve. Am I right?" "Yes, you are."
I need to send this parcel. Is there a post office in this village?
I want to make pancakes. Are there any eggs in the fridge?
You're two hours late. Was there a lot of traffic?
I saw the photos online. Were there many people at the concert?
You're moving to Canada? Is that true?

examples.heading: ① Are + 主詞

items.en: Dad's waiting in the car. Are you ready?
items.zh: 爸爸在車上等了。你準備好了嗎？

items.en: You're holding your stomach. Are you in pain?
items.zh: 你一直按著肚子。你會痛嗎？

items.en: You've been out all day. Are you thirsty? There's juice in the fridge.
items.zh: 你在外面待了一整天。你渴嗎？冰箱裡有果汁。

items.en: I'd like to say thank you for dinner. Are your parents at home this weekend?
items.zh: 我想謝謝他們請我吃晚餐。你爸媽這個週末在家嗎？

items.en: Are these your keys? I found them on the floor.
items.zh: 這些是你的鑰匙嗎？我在地上找到的。

items.en: The car park is almost empty. Are we too early for the show?
items.zh: 停車場幾乎是空的。我們太早來看表演了嗎？

examples.heading: ② Is + 主詞

items.en: I heard your dog was ill. Is it OK now?
items.zh: 我聽說你的狗生病了。牠現在還好嗎？

items.en: Is your sister at home? I need to talk to her.
items.zh: 你姊姊在家嗎？我得跟她說話。

items.en: Excuse me, is this your umbrella? You left it on the bus.
items.zh: 不好意思，這是你的傘嗎？你把它忘在公車上了。

items.en: It's a public holiday. Is the museum open today?
items.zh: 今天是國定假日。博物館今天有開嗎？

items.en: We don't have a car this week. Is it far to the beach from here?
items.zh: 我們這星期沒有車。從這裡到海灘遠嗎？

items.en: Is he your new teacher? He looks very young.
items.zh: 他是你的新老師嗎？他看起來好年輕。

examples.heading: ③ Am I

items.en: Am I late? I'm sorry, the bus was slow.
items.zh: 我遲到了嗎？抱歉，公車很慢。

items.en: Sorry, it's my first day here. Am I in the right room for the English class?
items.zh: 抱歉，我今天第一天來。我是在英文課的教室嗎？

items.en: I'm fifty, and I've never played an instrument. Am I too old to learn the piano?
items.zh: 我五十歲了，從來沒彈過樂器。我學鋼琴會不會太老了？

examples.heading: ④ Was / Were + 主詞

items.en: Was the film good? I want to see it.
items.zh: 那部電影好看嗎？我想去看。

items.en: Were you at home last night? I called you three times, but nobody answered.
items.zh: 你昨晚在家嗎？我打了三次給你，都沒人接。

items.en: Welcome back! You were away for two weeks. Was it cold in Scotland?
items.zh: 歡迎回來！你去了兩個星期。蘇格蘭冷嗎？

items.en: Your team lost the final. Were the players very upset?
items.zh: 你們隊決賽輸了。球員們很難過嗎？

items.en: Your mum and your aunt are both teachers. Was your grandfather a teacher too?
items.zh: 你媽媽和你阿姨都是老師。你爺爺也是老師嗎？

items.en: Your holiday photos are lovely. Was the hotel near the sea?
items.zh: 你的度假照片很漂亮。那家飯店靠近海嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 回答

items.en: "Are you tired?" "Yes, I am. I didn't sleep well."
items.zh: 你累了嗎？累。我沒睡好。

items.en: "Is it your birthday today?" "No, it isn't. It's tomorrow."
items.zh: 今天是你的生日嗎？不是。是明天。

items.en: "Were you at the party?" "Yes, I was. It was great."
items.zh: 你有去派對嗎？有。很好玩。

items.en: "Is the shop open?" "No, it's not. It's Sunday."
items.zh: 店有開嗎？沒有。今天是星期天。

items.en: "The answer is twelve. Am I right?" "Yes, you are."
items.zh: 答案是十二。我說對了嗎？對，你說對了。

examples.heading: ⑥ Is there / Are there

items.en: I need to send this parcel. Is there a post office in this village?
items.zh: 我得寄這個包裹。這個村子有郵局嗎？

items.en: I want to make pancakes. Are there any eggs in the fridge?
items.zh: 我想做鬆餅。冰箱裡有蛋嗎？

items.en: You're two hours late. Was there a lot of traffic?
items.zh: 你晚了兩個小時。路上車多嗎？

items.en: I saw the photos online. Were there many people at the concert?
items.zh: 我在網路上看到照片了。演唱會人多嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 確認聽到的事

items.en: You're moving to Canada? Is that true?
items.zh: 你要搬去加拿大？是真的嗎？

title: How will you get here?
translation: 你要怎麼過來這裡？
name: wh- 疑問句的情態動詞
sentences: There's no bus to my village. How will you get here on Saturday?
We're having a picnic. What will you bring?
You've sent your application. When will they tell you their decision?
You don't know anyone in Glasgow. Where will you sleep?
Who will look after the dog while you're away?
I'm stuck on this question. What can I do?
"Hello, City Bank. How can I help you?" "I've lost my card."
I'd love to see your new baby. When can I visit you?
I'm free most of next week. Which afternoon can you come round?
My phone doesn't work in this country. Where can I get a local SIM?
The new sofa has arrived, and it's heavy. Who can help me move it?
It's my first job interview. What should I wear?
The living room is already full. Where should we put the new bookcase?
I've never made rice before. How long should I cook it?
Who should I talk to about my bill?
When should we leave for the airport?
We've got the whole evening free. What shall we do?
Where shall we meet, at the station or the café?
I'd love to help you paint the kitchen. What time shall I arrive on Sunday?
How shall we pay, cash or card?
Excuse me. Where could I find a taxi?
Welcome! Come in and sit down. What would you like to drink?
Which day would suit you best?
How could I get to the museum from here?
Why would anyone want to live there?
Why can't I go to the party? Everyone else is going.
Why won't the car start? I filled it with petrol yesterday.
My car needs new tyres. How much will that set me back?
We're expecting a big crowd. How many people can the hall hold?
I have a train at four. How long will your talk last?
How far can you swim without stopping?

examples.heading: ① 疑問詞 + will + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: There's no bus to my village. How will you get here on Saturday?
items.zh: 沒有公車到我們村子。你星期六要怎麼過來？

items.en: We're having a picnic. What will you bring?
items.zh: 我們要去野餐。你會帶什麼？

items.en: You've sent your application. When will they tell you their decision?
items.zh: 你已經寄出申請了。他們什麼時候會告訴你結果？

items.en: You don't know anyone in Glasgow. Where will you sleep?
items.zh: 你在格拉斯哥一個人都不認識。你要睡哪裡？

items.en: Who will look after the dog while you're away?
items.zh: 你不在的時候，誰會照顧狗？

examples.heading: ② 疑問詞 + can + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: I'm stuck on this question. What can I do?
items.zh: 我卡在這一題。我可以怎麼辦？

items.en: "Hello, City Bank. How can I help you?" "I've lost my card."
items.zh: 您好，城市銀行。有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？我的卡弄丟了。

items.en: I'd love to see your new baby. When can I visit you?
items.zh: 我很想看看你的新寶寶。我什麼時候可以去看你？

items.en: I'm free most of next week. Which afternoon can you come round?
items.zh: 我下星期大部分時間都有空。你哪天下午可以過來？

items.en: My phone doesn't work in this country. Where can I get a local SIM?
items.zh: 我的手機在這個國家不能用。我可以在哪裡買到當地的 SIM 卡？

items.en: The new sofa has arrived, and it's heavy. Who can help me move it?
items.zh: 新沙發送到了，很重。誰可以幫我搬？

examples.heading: ③ 疑問詞 + should + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: It's my first job interview. What should I wear?
items.zh: 這是我第一次面試。我應該穿什麼？

items.en: The living room is already full. Where should we put the new bookcase?
items.zh: 客廳已經滿了。新書架應該放在哪裡？

items.en: I've never made rice before. How long should I cook it?
items.zh: 我從來沒煮過飯。要煮多久？

items.en: Who should I talk to about my bill?
items.zh: 我的帳單問題應該找誰？

items.en: When should we leave for the airport?
items.zh: 我們應該什麼時候出發去機場？

examples.heading: ④ 疑問詞 + shall + I / we + 原形動詞

items.en: We've got the whole evening free. What shall we do?
items.zh: 我們整個晚上都有空。我們做什麼好？

items.en: Where shall we meet, at the station or the café?
items.zh: 我們在哪裡見面，車站還是咖啡店？

items.en: I'd love to help you paint the kitchen. What time shall I arrive on Sunday?
items.zh: 我很樂意幫你漆廚房。我星期天幾點到好？

items.en: How shall we pay, cash or card?
items.zh: 我們要怎麼付，現金還是刷卡？

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問詞 + could / would + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Excuse me. Where could I find a taxi?
items.zh: 不好意思。我可以在哪裡叫到計程車？

items.en: Welcome! Come in and sit down. What would you like to drink?
items.zh: 歡迎！進來坐。你想喝什麼？

items.en: Which day would suit you best?
items.zh: 哪一天對你最方便？

items.en: How could I get to the museum from here?
items.zh: 我從這裡要怎麼去博物館？

items.en: Why would anyone want to live there?
items.zh: 誰會想住在那裡？

examples.heading: ⑥ Why + can't / won't + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Why can't I go to the party? Everyone else is going.
items.zh: 為什麼我不能去派對？其他人都要去。

items.en: Why won't the car start? I filled it with petrol yesterday.
items.zh: 車子為什麼發不動？我昨天才加滿油。

examples.heading: ⑦ How much / How many / How long + 情態動詞

items.en: My car needs new tyres. How much will that set me back?
items.zh: 我的車要換新輪胎。那要花我多少錢？

items.en: We're expecting a big crowd. How many people can the hall hold?
items.zh: 我們預計會來很多人。這個大廳可以容納多少人？

items.en: I have a train at four. How long will your talk last?
items.zh: 我四點要搭火車。你的演講會講多久？

items.en: How far can you swim without stopping?
items.zh: 你不停下來可以游多遠？

title: Can you come to dinner at my house?
translation: 你可以來我家吃晚餐嗎？
name: 情態動詞開頭的 是非疑問句
sentences: I'm cooking on Saturday. Can you come to dinner at my house?
It's my birthday on Friday. Can you come to my party?
We're going to the beach. Can you come with us?
I need help with my maths project. Can you meet me after school?
I can't find my CD. Can you bring some music, please?
I'm moving the sofa. Can you hold the other end?
Can you open the window, please? It's hot in here.
I don't understand. Can you say that again?
I forgot my calculator. Can I borrow yours for the test?
I can't talk now, I'm on the bus. Can you call me tonight?
We need someone for the band. Can you play the guitar?
Can you swim? The water is deep here.
We're going to Paris next week. Can your brother speak any French at all?
Can she drive? She's only seventeen.
Can you read this? The writing is very small.
The bus is full. Can I put my bag on your seat for a minute?
Can I use your phone? Mine is dead.
Can I go out tonight, Mum?
I've been running. Can I get some water from your kitchen?
These boots look nice. Can I try them in a bigger size?
It's a lovely day, Mum. Can we go to the park after lunch?
I finish work at half past five. Can we meet at six instead of five?
Dad, can we stay up late to watch the match?
"Can you swim?" "Yes, I can. I swim every week."
"Can you come on Sunday?" "No, I can't. I'm visiting my grandma."
"Can I borrow your bike?" "Yes, of course."
"Can he cook?" "No, he can't. He only makes toast."
Excuse me. Can you show me where the shoes are?
Can we see the menu, please? We're ready to order.
I left my wallet at home. Can I pay with my phone here?
Can you wrap it for me? It's a present.

examples.heading: ① Can you + 原形動詞：邀請

items.en: I'm cooking on Saturday. Can you come to dinner at my house?
items.zh: 我星期六要煮飯。你可以來我家吃晚餐嗎？

items.en: It's my birthday on Friday. Can you come to my party?
items.zh: 星期五是我的生日。你可以來我的派對嗎？

items.en: We're going to the beach. Can you come with us?
items.zh: 我們要去海邊。你可以跟我們一起去嗎？

items.en: I need help with my maths project. Can you meet me after school?
items.zh: 我的數學專題需要幫忙。你放學後可以跟我碰面嗎？

examples.heading: ② Can you + 原形動詞：請對方幫忙

items.en: I can't find my CD. Can you bring some music, please?
items.zh: 我找不到我的 CD。你可以帶一些音樂來嗎？

items.en: I'm moving the sofa. Can you hold the other end?
items.zh: 我在搬沙發。你可以抬另一頭嗎？

items.en: Can you open the window, please? It's hot in here.
items.zh: 你可以開窗嗎？這裡好熱。

items.en: I don't understand. Can you say that again?
items.zh: 我聽不懂。你可以再說一次嗎？

items.en: I forgot my calculator. Can I borrow yours for the test?
items.zh: 我忘了帶計算機。考試的時候我可以借你的嗎？

items.en: I can't talk now, I'm on the bus. Can you call me tonight?
items.zh: 我現在不能講話，我在公車上。你今晚可以打給我嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Can you / he / she + 原形動詞：問能力

items.en: We need someone for the band. Can you play the guitar?
items.zh: 我們樂團需要人。你會彈吉他嗎？

items.en: Can you swim? The water is deep here.
items.zh: 你會游泳嗎？這裡的水很深。

items.en: We're going to Paris next week. Can your brother speak any French at all?
items.zh: 我們下星期要去巴黎。你哥哥會說一點法文嗎？

items.en: Can she drive? She's only seventeen.
items.zh: 她會開車嗎？她才十七歲。

items.en: Can you read this? The writing is very small.
items.zh: 你看得清楚這個嗎？字很小。

examples.heading: ④ Can I + 原形動詞：問可不可以

items.en: The bus is full. Can I put my bag on your seat for a minute?
items.zh: 公車客滿了。我可以把包包放在你的位子上一下嗎？

items.en: Can I use your phone? Mine is dead.
items.zh: 我可以用你的手機嗎？我的沒電了。

items.en: Can I go out tonight, Mum?
items.zh: 媽，我今晚可以出去嗎？

items.en: I've been running. Can I get some water from your kitchen?
items.zh: 我剛剛在跑步。我可以去你家廚房拿點水嗎？

items.en: These boots look nice. Can I try them in a bigger size?
items.zh: 這雙靴子看起來不錯。我可以試大一號的嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Can we + 原形動詞

items.en: It's a lovely day, Mum. Can we go to the park after lunch?
items.zh: 媽，今天天氣很好。我們午餐後可以去公園嗎？

items.en: I finish work at half past five. Can we meet at six instead of five?
items.zh: 我五點半才下班。我們可以改成六點見面，不要五點嗎？

items.en: Dad, can we stay up late to watch the match?
items.zh: 爸，我們可以晚點睡看比賽嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ 回答

items.en: "Can you swim?" "Yes, I can. I swim every week."
items.zh: 你會游泳嗎？會。我每個星期都游泳。

items.en: "Can you come on Sunday?" "No, I can't. I'm visiting my grandma."
items.zh: 你星期天可以來嗎？不行。我要去看我奶奶。

items.en: "Can I borrow your bike?" "Yes, of course."
items.zh: 我可以借你的腳踏車嗎？當然可以。

items.en: "Can he cook?" "No, he can't. He only makes toast."
items.zh: 他會煮飯嗎？不會。他只會烤吐司。

examples.heading: ⑦ Can 疑問句：在店裡和餐廳

items.en: Excuse me. Can you show me where the shoes are?
items.zh: 不好意思。你可以告訴我鞋子在哪裡嗎？

items.en: Can we see the menu, please? We're ready to order.
items.zh: 可以給我們看菜單嗎？我們準備好點餐了。

items.en: I left my wallet at home. Can I pay with my phone here?
items.zh: 我把錢包忘在家裡了。我在這裡可以用手機付款嗎？

items.en: Can you wrap it for me? It's a present.
items.zh: 你可以幫我包起來嗎？這是禮物。

title: Could you meet me at my home at 7 p.m.?
translation: 你可以晚上 7 點到我家跟我碰面嗎？
name: 是非疑問句的情態動詞（較多種）
sentences: We need to finish our project. Could you meet me at my home at 7 p.m.?
I've lost my ring somewhere in your house. Could you look for it?
Could you turn the music down a little? I'm trying to study.
I deleted your message by mistake. Could you text me the address again?
My meeting will finish late. Could you collect Emma from her dance class?
My English isn't perfect. Could you read through my cover letter for mistakes?
I've got two tickets. Would you like to go to the U2 concert with me?
We're having a barbecue on Saturday. Would you like to bring your kids along?
You read so many novels. Would you like to join our book club?
There's plenty left. Would you like another slice of pie?
My hands are full. Would you hold the door for me, please?
There's a cold wind coming in. Would you mind closing the window?
Sorry, I missed the last part. Would you explain that again, please?
I don't want to go alone. Will you come with me?
He knelt down and opened a small box. "Will you marry me, Anna?"
I want to bring back your drill. Will you be at home this evening?
I can't do these maths problems alone. Will you sit with me after dinner?
You look cold. Shall I turn the heating up?
The train leaves at quarter past nine. Shall we meet at the station at nine?
Your bags look heavy. Shall I carry one?
It's raining and the last bus has gone. Shall we walk home together?
I'm going to their party. Should I bring anything?
Should we book a table? The restaurant is popular.
Nobody was hurt, but the car is damaged. Should I tell my parents about the accident?
It's a small design company. Should I dress smartly for the interview, or is that too much?
I'm sorry to ask, but could I leave my bike in your garden tonight?
She knocked on the manager's door. "May I come in for a moment?"
Excuse me, my phone is nearly dead. Could I charge it at your desk?
"This box is too heavy for me. Could you help me?" "Yes, of course."
"We're going to the cinema tonight. Would you like to come?" "I'd love to."
"You sound busy. Shall I call you later?" "Yes, please."

examples.heading: ① Could you + 原形動詞：客氣的請求

items.en: We need to finish our project. Could you meet me at my home at 7 p.m.?
items.zh: 我們得完成報告。你可以晚上 7 點到我家跟我碰面嗎？

items.en: I've lost my ring somewhere in your house. Could you look for it?
items.zh: 我把戒指掉在你家某個地方了。你可以找找看嗎？

items.en: Could you turn the music down a little? I'm trying to study.
items.zh: 你可以把音樂關小聲一點嗎？我在念書。

items.en: I deleted your message by mistake. Could you text me the address again?
items.zh: 我不小心刪了你的訊息。你可以再傳一次地址給我嗎？

items.en: My meeting will finish late. Could you collect Emma from her dance class?
items.zh: 我的會議會開到很晚。你可以去舞蹈課接 Emma 嗎？

items.en: My English isn't perfect. Could you read through my cover letter for mistakes?
items.zh: 我的英文不完美。你可以幫我看看求職信有沒有錯嗎？

examples.heading: ② Would you like + to + 原形動詞：邀請

items.en: I've got two tickets. Would you like to go to the U2 concert with me?
items.zh: 我有兩張票。你想跟我去聽 U2 的演唱會嗎？

items.en: We're having a barbecue on Saturday. Would you like to bring your kids along?
items.zh: 我們星期六要烤肉。你想帶孩子一起來嗎？

items.en: You read so many novels. Would you like to join our book club?
items.zh: 你讀那麼多小說。你想加入我們的讀書會嗎？

items.en: There's plenty left. Would you like another slice of pie?
items.zh: 還剩很多。你想再吃一片派嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Would you + 原形動詞：客氣的請求

items.en: My hands are full. Would you hold the door for me, please?
items.zh: 我兩手都拿滿了東西。你可以幫我扶一下門嗎？

items.en: There's a cold wind coming in. Would you mind closing the window?
items.zh: 有冷風吹進來。你介意把窗戶關上嗎？

items.en: Sorry, I missed the last part. Would you explain that again, please?
items.zh: 抱歉，我沒聽到最後那部分。你可以再解釋一次嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Will you + 原形動詞

items.en: I don't want to go alone. Will you come with me?
items.zh: 我不想一個人去。你要跟我一起來嗎？

items.en: He knelt down and opened a small box. "Will you marry me, Anna?"
items.zh: 他單膝跪下，打開一個小盒子。Anna，你願意嫁給我嗎？

items.en: I want to bring back your drill. Will you be at home this evening?
items.zh: 我想把電鑽還你。你今天晚上會在家嗎？

items.en: I can't do these maths problems alone. Will you sit with me after dinner?
items.zh: 這些數學題我自己做不來。晚餐後你會陪我一起做嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Shall I / Shall we + 原形動詞：提議

items.en: You look cold. Shall I turn the heating up?
items.zh: 你看起來很冷。要我把暖氣開大一點嗎？

items.en: The train leaves at quarter past nine. Shall we meet at the station at nine?
items.zh: 火車九點十五分開。我們九點在車站見面好嗎？

items.en: Your bags look heavy. Shall I carry one?
items.zh: 你的袋子看起來很重。要我幫你拿一個嗎？

items.en: It's raining and the last bus has gone. Shall we walk home together?
items.zh: 下雨了，最後一班公車也走了。我們一起走路回家好嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ Should I / Should we + 原形動詞：問建議

items.en: I'm going to their party. Should I bring anything?
items.zh: 我要去他們的派對。我應該帶什麼東西嗎？

items.en: Should we book a table? The restaurant is popular.
items.zh: 我們應該訂位嗎？那家餐廳很熱門。

items.en: Nobody was hurt, but the car is damaged. Should I tell my parents about the accident?
items.zh: 沒有人受傷，可是車子撞壞了。我應該把車禍的事告訴我爸媽嗎？

items.en: It's a small design company. Should I dress smartly for the interview, or is that too much?
items.zh: 那是一家小設計公司。我面試應該穿得正式一點嗎？還是那樣太誇張？

examples.heading: ⑦ Could I / May I + 原形動詞：客氣地問可不可以

items.en: I'm sorry to ask, but could I leave my bike in your garden tonight?
items.zh: 不好意思問一下，我今晚可以把腳踏車放在你家院子嗎？

items.en: She knocked on the manager's door. "May I come in for a moment?"
items.zh: 她敲了經理的門。我可以進來一下嗎？

items.en: Excuse me, my phone is nearly dead. Could I charge it at your desk?
items.zh: 不好意思，我的手機快沒電了。我可以在你桌上充電嗎？

examples.heading: ⑧ 回答

items.en: "This box is too heavy for me. Could you help me?" "Yes, of course."
items.zh: 這個箱子對我來說太重了。你可以幫我嗎？當然可以。

items.en: "We're going to the cinema tonight. Would you like to come?" "I'd love to."
items.zh: 我們今晚要去看電影。你想來嗎？我很樂意。

items.en: "You sound busy. Shall I call you later?" "Yes, please."
items.zh: 你聽起來很忙。要我晚點打給你嗎？好，麻煩你。

title: You haven't been to my house before, have you?
translation: 你以前沒來過我家，對吧？
name: 否定句加肯定附加問句
sentences: Your dog keeps shaking. That isn't normal, is it?
Don't worry about the boss. He isn't really angry, is he?
Let's buy the food today. The shops aren't open on public holidays, are they?
I didn't see you there. You weren't at the meeting yesterday, were you?
I won't stay there again. The hotel wasn't very clean, was it?
I'm sure we'll find a seat. The concert isn't sold out, is it?
Let's not go to the disco. Your parents don't like discos, do they?
You don't need a lift, do you? I'm leaving now.
Your sister doesn't drink coffee, does she? I'll make tea.
Excuse me, I need to get off at Oxford. This train doesn't stop there, does it?
I need to post this card. They don't sell stamps here, do they?
I'm thinking of buying one too. The new phone doesn't cost much, does it?
You didn't tell Mum about the broken glass, did you?
Nobody saw us leave early. The teacher didn't notice, did she?
Wait, we need to go back. We didn't lock the back door, did we?
The tin is empty. You didn't eat all the biscuits, did you?
We left at nine and arrived at half past. It didn't take long to get here, did it?
I'll show you the way. You haven't been to my house before, have you?
We haven't seen each other for about a year, have we?
Don't tell Mia the ending. She hasn't finished the book yet, has she?
I can't open the car. You haven't seen my keys, have you?
I'm waiting for a letter from the bank. The post hasn't come yet, has it?
The sign is still in the garden. They haven't sold the house yet, have they?
Doesn't sound very interesting, does it?
Not very warm in here, is it? Shall I close the window?
Didn't go well, did it? You look upset.
You don't have a phone charger, do you? My battery is nearly dead.
You haven't got a pen, have you? Mine has run out.
You don't know the way to the station, do you?
He isn't important, is he? Why is everyone so nervous?
You aren't leaving already, are you? It's only nine o'clock.

examples.heading: ① 否定的直述句 + is / are / was / were

items.en: Your dog keeps shaking. That isn't normal, is it?
items.zh: 你的狗一直發抖。這不正常，對吧？

items.en: Don't worry about the boss. He isn't really angry, is he?
items.zh: 別擔心老闆。他不是真的生氣，對吧？

items.en: Let's buy the food today. The shops aren't open on public holidays, are they?
items.zh: 我們今天就把吃的買好吧。國定假日商店不開，對吧？

items.en: I didn't see you there. You weren't at the meeting yesterday, were you?
items.zh: 我沒看到你。你昨天沒來開會，對吧？

items.en: I won't stay there again. The hotel wasn't very clean, was it?
items.zh: 我不會再住那裡了。那家飯店不太乾淨，對吧？

items.en: I'm sure we'll find a seat. The concert isn't sold out, is it?
items.zh: 我們一定找得到位子。演唱會沒賣完，對吧？

examples.heading: ② 否定的直述句 + do / does

items.en: Let's not go to the disco. Your parents don't like discos, do they?
items.zh: 我們別去舞廳了。你爸媽不喜歡舞廳，對吧？

items.en: You don't need a lift, do you? I'm leaving now.
items.zh: 你不用人載吧？我現在要走了。

items.en: Your sister doesn't drink coffee, does she? I'll make tea.
items.zh: 你姊姊不喝咖啡，對吧？我來泡茶。

items.en: Excuse me, I need to get off at Oxford. This train doesn't stop there, does it?
items.zh: 不好意思，我要在牛津下車。這班火車不停那裡，對吧？

items.en: I need to post this card. They don't sell stamps here, do they?
items.zh: 我要寄這張卡片。這裡不賣郵票，對吧？

items.en: I'm thinking of buying one too. The new phone doesn't cost much, does it?
items.zh: 我也在考慮買一支。新手機不太貴，對吧？

examples.heading: ③ 否定的直述句 + did

items.en: You didn't tell Mum about the broken glass, did you?
items.zh: 你沒跟媽媽說玻璃杯破了的事，對吧？

items.en: Nobody saw us leave early. The teacher didn't notice, did she?
items.zh: 沒人看到我們提早走。老師沒發現，對吧？

items.en: Wait, we need to go back. We didn't lock the back door, did we?
items.zh: 等一下，我們得回去。我們沒鎖後門，對吧？

items.en: The tin is empty. You didn't eat all the biscuits, did you?
items.zh: 盒子空了。你沒把餅乾全部吃掉吧？

items.en: We left at nine and arrived at half past. It didn't take long to get here, did it?
items.zh: 我們九點出發，九點半就到了。來這裡沒花多久時間，對吧？

examples.heading: ④ 否定的直述句 + have / has

items.en: I'll show you the way. You haven't been to my house before, have you?
items.zh: 我帶你走。你以前沒來過我家，對吧？

items.en: We haven't seen each other for about a year, have we?
items.zh: 我們差不多一年沒見面了，對吧？

items.en: Don't tell Mia the ending. She hasn't finished the book yet, has she?
items.zh: 別跟 Mia 說結局。她還沒讀完那本書，對吧？

items.en: I can't open the car. You haven't seen my keys, have you?
items.zh: 我打不開車門。你沒看到我的鑰匙吧？

items.en: I'm waiting for a letter from the bank. The post hasn't come yet, has it?
items.zh: 我在等銀行的信。郵件還沒來，對吧？

items.en: The sign is still in the garden. They haven't sold the house yet, have they?
items.zh: 牌子還在院子裡。他們還沒把房子賣掉，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ 省略主詞的說法

items.en: Doesn't sound very interesting, does it?
items.zh: 聽起來沒什麼意思，對吧？

items.en: Not very warm in here, is it? Shall I close the window?
items.zh: 這裡不太暖和，對吧？要我把窗戶關上嗎？

items.en: Didn't go well, did it? You look upset.
items.zh: 不太順利，對吧？你看起來很難過。

examples.heading: ⑥ 用來請對方幫忙

items.en: You don't have a phone charger, do you? My battery is nearly dead.
items.zh: 你沒有手機充電器吧？我的手機快沒電了。

items.en: You haven't got a pen, have you? Mine has run out.
items.zh: 你沒有筆，對吧？我的沒水了。

items.en: You don't know the way to the station, do you?
items.zh: 你不知道去車站的路，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑦ 用來表示驚訝或擔心

items.en: He isn't important, is he? Why is everyone so nervous?
items.zh: 他不是什麼重要人物吧？為什麼大家都這麼緊張？

items.en: You aren't leaving already, are you? It's only nine o'clock.
items.zh: 你不會已經要走了吧？才九點而已。

title: Don't you know me?
translation: 你不認得我了嗎？
name: 助動詞 do、have 開頭的否定疑問句
sentences: We were in the same class for six years. Don't you know me?
Don't you like any programmes on TV? You never watch anything.
Don't you remember? We met at Anna's wedding.
Don't you want any dessert? It's chocolate cake.
Don't you have a key? I thought Mum gave you one.
The wind is freezing tonight. Don't you feel cold without a jacket?
Don't you think so? Everyone else agrees.
Let's buy her some flowers. Don't you think she would be happy?
Look at the price. Don't you think this sofa is too expensive?
They might not be at home. Don't you think we should call first?
We're playing a match in Manchester next week. Doesn't your brother live there?
Ask Sara about it. Doesn't she know a lot about plants?
We've just gone past the sign for York. Doesn't this train stop there?
Doesn't it hurt? You've cut your hand.
I waited for you at the gate. Didn't you read my note?
Didn't they tell you? The meeting is cancelled.
Your name sounds familiar. Didn't we meet last year in Paris?
Mia's chair is still empty. Didn't she say she was coming?
Everyone is talking about the film. Haven't you seen it yet?
Haven't you finished your homework? It's nearly bedtime.
It's already eleven. Hasn't the delivery van been yet?
Haven't we been here before? This street looks familiar.
Ben is moving to Glasgow next month. Hasn't he told you about the new job?
They all wear the same clothes. Haven't they got their own style?
It's snowing. Haven't you got a warmer coat?
Hasn't she got a phone? I can't reach her.
"You haven't touched your cup. Don't you like coffee?" "No, I don't. I prefer tea."
"You can't park here. Didn't you see the sign?" "No, I didn't. Sorry."
"Let me introduce you. Haven't you met my sister?" "Yes, I have. At your party."
"Your new neighbour never says a word to us. Doesn't he speak English?" "Yes, he does. Very well."
"It's nine o'clock. Haven't you eaten yet?" "No, I haven't. I'm starving."

examples.heading: ① Don't you + 原形動詞：驚訝

items.en: We were in the same class for six years. Don't you know me?
items.zh: 我們同班了六年。你不認得我了嗎？

items.en: Don't you like any programmes on TV? You never watch anything.
items.zh: 電視上沒有你喜歡的節目嗎？你從來都不看。

items.en: Don't you remember? We met at Anna's wedding.
items.zh: 你不記得了嗎？我們是在 Anna 的婚禮上認識的。

items.en: Don't you want any dessert? It's chocolate cake.
items.zh: 你不想吃點甜點嗎？是巧克力蛋糕耶。

items.en: Don't you have a key? I thought Mum gave you one.
items.zh: 你沒有鑰匙嗎？我以為媽媽給了你一把。

items.en: The wind is freezing tonight. Don't you feel cold without a jacket?
items.zh: 今晚的風好冷。你沒穿外套不冷嗎？

examples.heading: ② Don't you think + 子句：覺得對方應該同意

items.en: Don't you think so? Everyone else agrees.
items.zh: 你不這麼覺得嗎？其他人都同意。

items.en: Let's buy her some flowers. Don't you think she would be happy?
items.zh: 我們買花給她吧。你不覺得她會很開心嗎？

items.en: Look at the price. Don't you think this sofa is too expensive?
items.zh: 你看價錢。你不覺得這張沙發太貴了嗎？

items.en: They might not be at home. Don't you think we should call first?
items.zh: 他們可能不在家。你不覺得我們應該先打電話嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Doesn't + he / she / it + 原形動詞

items.en: We're playing a match in Manchester next week. Doesn't your brother live there?
items.zh: 我們下星期要在曼徹斯特比賽。你哥哥不是住在那裡嗎？

items.en: Ask Sara about it. Doesn't she know a lot about plants?
items.zh: 去問 Sara。她不是對植物很了解嗎？

items.en: We've just gone past the sign for York. Doesn't this train stop there?
items.zh: 我們剛經過約克的站牌。這班火車不是會停那裡嗎？

items.en: Doesn't it hurt? You've cut your hand.
items.zh: 不會痛嗎？你割到手了。

examples.heading: ④ Didn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: I waited for you at the gate. Didn't you read my note?
items.zh: 我在大門口等你。你沒看到我留的紙條嗎？

items.en: Didn't they tell you? The meeting is cancelled.
items.zh: 他們沒跟你說嗎？會議取消了。

items.en: Your name sounds familiar. Didn't we meet last year in Paris?
items.zh: 你的名字聽起來很耳熟。我們去年不是在巴黎見過嗎？

items.en: Mia's chair is still empty. Didn't she say she was coming?
items.zh: Mia 的椅子還是空的。她不是說她會來嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Haven't / Hasn't + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: Everyone is talking about the film. Haven't you seen it yet?
items.zh: 大家都在談那部電影。你還沒看過嗎？

items.en: Haven't you finished your homework? It's nearly bedtime.
items.zh: 你功課還沒寫完嗎？都快睡覺時間了。

items.en: It's already eleven. Hasn't the delivery van been yet?
items.zh: 已經十一點了。送貨車還沒來過嗎？

items.en: Haven't we been here before? This street looks familiar.
items.zh: 我們以前不是來過這裡嗎？這條街看起來很眼熟。

items.en: Ben is moving to Glasgow next month. Hasn't he told you about the new job?
items.zh: Ben 下個月要搬去格拉斯哥。他還沒跟你說新工作的事嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ Haven't ... got：驚訝對方沒有某樣東西

items.en: They all wear the same clothes. Haven't they got their own style?
items.zh: 他們都穿一樣的衣服。他們沒有自己的風格嗎？

items.en: It's snowing. Haven't you got a warmer coat?
items.zh: 在下雪耶。你沒有暖一點的外套嗎？

items.en: Hasn't she got a phone? I can't reach her.
items.zh: 她沒有手機嗎？我聯絡不上她。

examples.heading: ⑦ 回答

items.en: "You haven't touched your cup. Don't you like coffee?" "No, I don't. I prefer tea."
items.zh: 你都沒碰你的杯子。你不喜歡咖啡嗎？不喜歡。我比較喜歡茶。

items.en: "You can't park here. Didn't you see the sign?" "No, I didn't. Sorry."
items.zh: 你不能停在這裡。你沒看到告示嗎？沒有。抱歉。

items.en: "Let me introduce you. Haven't you met my sister?" "Yes, I have. At your party."
items.zh: 我來介紹一下。你沒見過我妹妹嗎？見過。在你的派對上。

items.en: "Your new neighbour never says a word to us. Doesn't he speak English?" "Yes, he does. Very well."
items.zh: 你的新鄰居從來不跟我們說話。他不會說英文嗎？會。說得很好。

items.en: "It's nine o'clock. Haven't you eaten yet?" "No, I haven't. I'm starving."
items.zh: 九點了。你還沒吃嗎？還沒。我快餓死了。

title: Wouldn't you like to come?
translation: 你不想來嗎？
name: 情態動詞開頭的否定疑問句
sentences: We're having a picnic by the lake on Saturday. Wouldn't you like to come?
Wouldn't you like to see the new exhibition? It's free this week.
It's a long drive home. Wouldn't you like a cup of tea before you go?
You love the mountains. Wouldn't you like a cabin there one day?
I'm going to a picnic with my parents. Won't you come with us?
Won't you stay a little longer? The party has just started.
Won't you sit down? You look tired.
She baked it this morning. Won't you try some of my mother's cake?
You want to see both films. Can't you make time for both?
Can't you come a bit earlier? The shop closes at five.
I'm on the phone with a customer. Can't you wait five minutes?
Can't you turn that music down? It's midnight.
Can't we talk about this tomorrow? I'm really tired.
It's raining hard. Couldn't we take a taxi instead?
You can't carry the piano alone. Couldn't you ask your brother to help?
Half of us had to stand. Couldn't they find a bigger room for the meeting?
I'm working all day on Saturday. Couldn't we meet on Sunday instead?
It's a fancy restaurant. Shouldn't we book a table?
It's ten o'clock on a Monday morning. Shouldn't you be at school right now?
It's getting late. Shouldn't we text Dad and say we'll be home soon?
It was due at quarter past. Shouldn't the train be here by now?
Won't your parents be worried if you're late?
You need two hundred pounds by Friday. Can't your sister lend you the money?
You want to go to the lake for your birthday. Won't it be too cold to swim in May?
The living room is a mess. Can't the kids take their toys outside?
"You've got a lovely voice. Wouldn't you like to join the choir?" "Yes, actually. When do you practise?"
"I've made a big pot of soup. Won't you stay for dinner?" "Thanks, but I really must go."
"Can't you come earlier?" "No, sorry. I finish work at six."
"The film starts in twenty minutes. Shouldn't we leave now?" "Yes, you're right. Let's go."
"The bus is late again. Couldn't we walk instead?" "Good idea. It's a lovely day."
"Your flatmates are away all summer. Won't you be lonely on your own?" "No, I'll be fine."

examples.heading: ① Wouldn't you like + 名詞 / to + 原形動詞：熱情地邀請

items.en: We're having a picnic by the lake on Saturday. Wouldn't you like to come?
items.zh: 我們星期六要在湖邊野餐。你不想來嗎？

items.en: Wouldn't you like to see the new exhibition? It's free this week.
items.zh: 你不想去看新的展覽嗎？這星期免費。

items.en: It's a long drive home. Wouldn't you like a cup of tea before you go?
items.zh: 開車回家要很久。你走之前不想喝杯茶嗎？

items.en: You love the mountains. Wouldn't you like a cabin there one day?
items.zh: 你那麼愛山。你不想有一天在那裡有間小木屋嗎？

examples.heading: ② Won't you + 原形動詞：邀請或勸對方

items.en: I'm going to a picnic with my parents. Won't you come with us?
items.zh: 我要跟爸媽去野餐。你不跟我們一起來嗎？

items.en: Won't you stay a little longer? The party has just started.
items.zh: 你不多待一會兒嗎？派對才剛開始。

items.en: Won't you sit down? You look tired.
items.zh: 你不坐一下嗎？你看起來很累。

items.en: She baked it this morning. Won't you try some of my mother's cake?
items.zh: 她今天早上烤的。你不嚐嚐我媽媽做的蛋糕嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Can't you + 原形動詞：建議或不耐煩

items.en: You want to see both films. Can't you make time for both?
items.zh: 你兩部電影都想看。你不能兩部都抽時間去看嗎？

items.en: Can't you come a bit earlier? The shop closes at five.
items.zh: 你不能早一點來嗎？店五點就關門了。

items.en: I'm on the phone with a customer. Can't you wait five minutes?
items.zh: 我在跟客人講電話。你不能等五分鐘嗎？

items.en: Can't you turn that music down? It's midnight.
items.zh: 你不能把音樂關小聲一點嗎？已經半夜了。

items.en: Can't we talk about this tomorrow? I'm really tired.
items.zh: 我們不能明天再談這件事嗎？我真的好累。

examples.heading: ④ Couldn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞：委婉地提出另一個做法

items.en: It's raining hard. Couldn't we take a taxi instead?
items.zh: 雨下得好大。我們不能改搭計程車嗎？

items.en: You can't carry the piano alone. Couldn't you ask your brother to help?
items.zh: 你一個人搬不動鋼琴。你不能請你哥哥幫忙嗎？

items.en: Half of us had to stand. Couldn't they find a bigger room for the meeting?
items.zh: 我們有一半的人得站著。他們不能找一間大一點的會議室嗎？

items.en: I'm working all day on Saturday. Couldn't we meet on Sunday instead?
items.zh: 我星期六要上一整天的班。我們不能改星期天見面嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Shouldn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞：覺得應該做

items.en: It's a fancy restaurant. Shouldn't we book a table?
items.zh: 那是一家高級餐廳。我們不是應該訂位嗎？

items.en: It's ten o'clock on a Monday morning. Shouldn't you be at school right now?
items.zh: 現在是星期一早上十點。你現在不是應該在學校嗎？

items.en: It's getting late. Shouldn't we text Dad and say we'll be home soon?
items.zh: 很晚了。我們不是應該傳訊息跟爸爸說我們快到家了嗎？

items.en: It was due at quarter past. Shouldn't the train be here by now?
items.zh: 火車應該十五分到。現在不是應該到了嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ Won't / Can't + 其他主詞

items.en: Won't your parents be worried if you're late?
items.zh: 你晚回家，你爸媽不會擔心嗎？

items.en: You need two hundred pounds by Friday. Can't your sister lend you the money?
items.zh: 你星期五前需要兩百英鎊。你姊姊不能借你錢嗎？

items.en: You want to go to the lake for your birthday. Won't it be too cold to swim in May?
items.zh: 你生日想去湖邊。五月游泳不會太冷嗎？

items.en: The living room is a mess. Can't the kids take their toys outside?
items.zh: 客廳一團亂。孩子們不能把玩具拿到外面去嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ 回答

items.en: "You've got a lovely voice. Wouldn't you like to join the choir?" "Yes, actually. When do you practise?"
items.zh: 你的聲音很好聽。你不想加入合唱團嗎？其實想。你們什麼時候練習？

items.en: "I've made a big pot of soup. Won't you stay for dinner?" "Thanks, but I really must go."
items.zh: 我煮了一大鍋湯。你不留下來吃晚餐嗎？謝謝，可是我真的得走了。

items.en: "Can't you come earlier?" "No, sorry. I finish work at six."
items.zh: 你不能早一點來嗎？不行，抱歉。我六點才下班。

items.en: "The film starts in twenty minutes. Shouldn't we leave now?" "Yes, you're right. Let's go."
items.zh: 電影二十分鐘後開始。我們不是應該現在出發嗎？對，你說得對。走吧。

items.en: "The bus is late again. Couldn't we walk instead?" "Good idea. It's a lovely day."
items.zh: 公車又誤點了。我們不能改走路嗎？好主意。今天天氣很好。

items.en: "Your flatmates are away all summer. Won't you be lonely on your own?" "No, I'll be fine."
items.zh: 你的室友整個夏天都不在。你一個人不會寂寞嗎？不會，我會沒事的。

title: Isn't he sweet?
translation: 他是不是很貼心？
name: be 動詞開頭的否定疑問句
sentences: Look at the baby smiling at us. Isn't he sweet?
Isn't this view amazing? I could look at it all day.
She's playing with my shoelace. Isn't your new kitten lovely?
Try this. Isn't it the best chocolate you've ever had?
The sun is out after a week of rain. Isn't it lovely?
Your trip to New York is next week. Aren't you excited about it?
You've been walking for hours. Aren't your feet tired?
It's snowing outside. Aren't you cold in that thin jacket?
Aren't you hungry? You didn't eat breakfast.
The boys are only twelve. Aren't they a bit young to travel alone?
You talked about the cottage. Isn't it in the mountains?
Isn't Tom your cousin? You look so alike.
Let's go tomorrow and save some money. Isn't the museum free on Sundays?
Who's looking after your dog? Aren't your parents in Spain this week?
You said someone took your bike. Isn't that your bike outside the shop?
Why are you still here? Isn't the meeting at ten, not eleven?
I still can't stop singing the songs. Wasn't the concert fantastic last night?
Your face looks familiar. Weren't you at the same school as my sister?
Wasn't it your birthday last week? Happy birthday!
It's nearly eight and the guests aren't here. Weren't they supposed to arrive at six?
I know that face. Wasn't he the man from the bank?
I got every answer right. Aren't I clever?
Everyone in the office got a card except me. Aren't I invited to the party too?（被動）
Aren't I next? I've been waiting for an hour.
"That woman just waved at you. Isn't she your teacher?" "Yes, she is. She teaches us maths."
"Aren't you tired?" "No, I'm fine. I slept well."
"I cried at the end. Wasn't the film great?" "Yes, it was brilliant."
"I need to pay in this cheque. Isn't the bank open today?" "No, it's a holiday."
His coat is still on the chair. Isn't it strange that nobody saw him leave?
Sam and Lucy met at our school twenty years ago. Isn't it wonderful that they're getting married?
Our daughter could read at three. Isn't it amazing that she learned so early?

examples.heading: ① Isn't + 主詞：請對方同意

items.en: Look at the baby smiling at us. Isn't he sweet?
items.zh: 你看寶寶對我們笑。他是不是很可愛？

items.en: Isn't this view amazing? I could look at it all day.
items.zh: 這景色是不是很壯觀？我可以看一整天。

items.en: She's playing with my shoelace. Isn't your new kitten lovely?
items.zh: 牠在玩我的鞋帶。你的新小貓是不是很可愛？

items.en: Try this. Isn't it the best chocolate you've ever had?
items.zh: 吃吃看。這是不是你吃過最好吃的巧克力？

items.en: The sun is out after a week of rain. Isn't it lovely?
items.zh: 下了一星期的雨，太陽終於出來了。是不是很棒？

examples.heading: ② Aren't + 主詞：表示驚訝

items.en: Your trip to New York is next week. Aren't you excited about it?
items.zh: 你下星期就要去紐約了。你不覺得興奮嗎？

items.en: You've been walking for hours. Aren't your feet tired?
items.zh: 你走了好幾個小時了。你的腳不累嗎？

items.en: It's snowing outside. Aren't you cold in that thin jacket?
items.zh: 外面在下雪。穿那件薄外套你不冷嗎？

items.en: Aren't you hungry? You didn't eat breakfast.
items.zh: 你不餓嗎？你沒吃早餐。

items.en: The boys are only twelve. Aren't they a bit young to travel alone?
items.zh: 那兩個男孩才十二歲。他們自己旅行不會太小嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Isn't / Aren't + 主詞：確認以為是真的事

items.en: You talked about the cottage. Isn't it in the mountains?
items.zh: 你提過那間小屋。它不是在山上嗎？

items.en: Isn't Tom your cousin? You look so alike.
items.zh: Tom 不是你表哥嗎？你們長得好像。

items.en: Let's go tomorrow and save some money. Isn't the museum free on Sundays?
items.zh: 我們明天去，省點錢。博物館星期天不是免費嗎？

items.en: Who's looking after your dog? Aren't your parents in Spain this week?
items.zh: 誰在照顧你的狗？你爸媽這個星期不是在西班牙嗎？

items.en: You said someone took your bike. Isn't that your bike outside the shop?
items.zh: 你說有人把你的腳踏車騎走了。店外面那台不是你的腳踏車嗎？

items.en: Why are you still here? Isn't the meeting at ten, not eleven?
items.zh: 你怎麼還在這裡？會議不是十點嗎？不是十一點吧？

examples.heading: ④ Wasn't / Weren't + 主詞

items.en: I still can't stop singing the songs. Wasn't the concert fantastic last night?
items.zh: 我到現在還一直在唱那些歌。昨晚的演唱會是不是很棒？

items.en: Your face looks familiar. Weren't you at the same school as my sister?
items.zh: 你看起來很面熟。你不是跟我妹妹同一所學校嗎？

items.en: Wasn't it your birthday last week? Happy birthday!
items.zh: 你的生日不是上星期嗎？生日快樂！

items.en: It's nearly eight and the guests aren't here. Weren't they supposed to arrive at six?
items.zh: 快八點了，客人還沒到。他們不是應該六點到嗎？

items.en: I know that face. Wasn't he the man from the bank?
items.zh: 我認得那張臉。他不是銀行那個人嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ Aren't I

items.en: I got every answer right. Aren't I clever?
items.zh: 我每題都答對了。我是不是很聰明？

items.en: Everyone in the office got a card except me. Aren't I invited to the party too?（被動）
items.zh: 辦公室每個人都收到卡片，只有我沒有。派對沒有邀請我嗎？

items.en: Aren't I next? I've been waiting for an hour.
items.zh: 不是輪到我了嗎？我已經等了一個小時了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 回答否定疑問句

items.en: "That woman just waved at you. Isn't she your teacher?" "Yes, she is. She teaches us maths."
items.zh: 那位女士剛剛向你揮手。她不是你的老師嗎？是啊。她教我們數學。

items.en: "Aren't you tired?" "No, I'm fine. I slept well."
items.zh: 你不累嗎？不累，我很好。我睡得很好。

items.en: "I cried at the end. Wasn't the film great?" "Yes, it was brilliant."
items.zh: 我看到最後哭了。那部電影是不是很棒？對啊，好看極了。

items.en: "I need to pay in this cheque. Isn't the bank open today?" "No, it's a holiday."
items.zh: 我得存這張支票。銀行今天不是有開嗎？沒有，今天放假。

examples.heading: ⑦ Isn't it + 形容詞 + that 子句

items.en: His coat is still on the chair. Isn't it strange that nobody saw him leave?
items.zh: 他的外套還在椅子上。沒有人看到他離開，不是很奇怪嗎？

items.en: Sam and Lucy met at our school twenty years ago. Isn't it wonderful that they're getting married?
items.zh: Sam 和 Lucy 二十年前在我們學校認識。他們要結婚了，是不是很棒？

items.en: Our daughter could read at three. Isn't it amazing that she learned so early?
items.zh: 我們女兒三歲就會讀書了。她這麼早就學會，是不是很驚人？

title: Why didn't you say something about it?
translation: 這件事你為什麼都不說點什麼？
name: wh- 否定疑問句（助動詞 do 加主要動詞）
sentences: Your room has been wet for weeks. Why didn't you say something about it?
You wrote that the concert was cancelled. Why didn't you check with the ticket office first?
I waited for an hour. Why didn't you call me?
Why didn't you come to my party? Everyone asked about you.
You knew the answer. Why didn't you put your hand up?
We were all late for school. Why didn't your clock ring this morning?
We've known them for years. Why didn't they ask us to be at the wedding?
Why didn't she take the job? It paid very well.
You still have this terrible headache. Why don't you go to your doctor?
Grandma always asks about him. Why doesn't your brother ever come to family dinners?
Why don't they fix the road? It's been broken for months.
I've turned it on twice. Why doesn't any water come out of this tap?
Why don't you like Italian food? Everyone likes pizza!
I've texted Mia three times today. Why doesn't she ever reply?
We've been friends for years. Why haven't you told me before?
Why haven't you finished your homework? You've had all weekend.
The kitchen is still flooded. Why hasn't the plumber called back?
I sent it a month ago. Why haven't they replied to my application?
There are dirty plates everywhere. Why hasn't anyone cleaned the kitchen?
What don't you understand? I'll explain it again.
Your test has some empty spaces. Which parts didn't you do?
I only have twenty notebooks here, and there are twenty-five of you. Who didn't bring their homework today?
You gave the film two stars. What didn't you enjoy about it?
Let's cross some places off the list first. Where don't you want to go on holiday?
I found out from your sister. Why didn't you mention you were moving abroad?
Why didn't you listen to me? I told you it was dangerous.
I cooked dinner and I washed the dishes again. Why don't you ever help with the washing-up?
Why haven't you called your grandmother? It's her birthday.
I drove an hour to get here, and the room is empty. Why didn't anyone tell me the meeting was cancelled?
You love animals. Why don't you get a dog?
Why didn't we think of that before? It's so simple!

examples.heading: ① Why didn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞：問過去為什麼沒做

items.en: Your room has been wet for weeks. Why didn't you say something about it?
items.zh: 你的房間濕了好幾個星期。這件事你為什麼都不說點什麼？

items.en: You wrote that the concert was cancelled. Why didn't you check with the ticket office first?
items.zh: 你寫說演唱會取消了。你為什麼沒先問售票處？

items.en: I waited for an hour. Why didn't you call me?
items.zh: 我等了一個小時。你為什麼沒打給我？

items.en: Why didn't you come to my party? Everyone asked about you.
items.zh: 你為什麼沒來我的派對？大家都在問你。

items.en: You knew the answer. Why didn't you put your hand up?
items.zh: 你知道答案。你為什麼沒舉手？

items.en: We were all late for school. Why didn't your clock ring this morning?
items.zh: 我們上學都遲到了。你的鬧鐘今天早上為什麼沒響？

items.en: We've known them for years. Why didn't they ask us to be at the wedding?
items.zh: 我們認識他們好多年了。他們為什麼沒請我們去參加婚禮？

items.en: Why didn't she take the job? It paid very well.
items.zh: 她為什麼沒接那份工作？薪水很高耶。

examples.heading: ② Why don't / doesn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞：問現在的情況

items.en: You still have this terrible headache. Why don't you go to your doctor?
items.zh: 你還在嚴重頭痛。你為什麼不去看醫生？

items.en: Grandma always asks about him. Why doesn't your brother ever come to family dinners?
items.zh: 奶奶每次都問起他。你哥哥為什麼從來都不來家族聚餐？

items.en: Why don't they fix the road? It's been broken for months.
items.zh: 他們為什麼不修那條路？已經壞好幾個月了。

items.en: I've turned it on twice. Why doesn't any water come out of this tap?
items.zh: 我開了兩次。這個水龍頭為什麼都不出水？

items.en: Why don't you like Italian food? Everyone likes pizza!
items.zh: 你為什麼不喜歡義大利菜？每個人都喜歡披薩啊！

items.en: I've texted Mia three times today. Why doesn't she ever reply?
items.zh: 我今天傳了三次訊息給 Mia。她為什麼都不回？

examples.heading: ③ Why haven't / hasn't + 主詞 + 過去分詞：問到現在為什麼還沒做

items.en: We've been friends for years. Why haven't you told me before?
items.zh: 我們做朋友好多年了。你為什麼之前都沒告訴我？

items.en: Why haven't you finished your homework? You've had all weekend.
items.zh: 你為什麼還沒寫完功課？你有一整個週末的時間。

items.en: The kitchen is still flooded. Why hasn't the plumber called back?
items.zh: 廚房還在淹水。水電工為什麼還沒回電？

items.en: I sent it a month ago. Why haven't they replied to my application?
items.zh: 我一個月前就寄出了。他們為什麼還沒回覆我的申請？

items.en: There are dirty plates everywhere. Why hasn't anyone cleaned the kitchen?
items.zh: 到處都是髒盤子。為什麼沒有人打掃廚房？

examples.heading: ④ 其他疑問詞 + don't / didn't

items.en: What don't you understand? I'll explain it again.
items.zh: 你哪裡不懂？我再解釋一次。

items.en: Your test has some empty spaces. Which parts didn't you do?
items.zh: 你的考卷有些空白。你哪些部分沒寫？

items.en: I only have twenty notebooks here, and there are twenty-five of you. Who didn't bring their homework today?
items.zh: 我這裡只有二十本作業簿，你們有二十五個人。今天誰沒帶功課？

items.en: You gave the film two stars. What didn't you enjoy about it?
items.zh: 你給那部電影兩顆星。你不喜歡它哪裡？

items.en: Let's cross some places off the list first. Where don't you want to go on holiday?
items.zh: 我們先從清單上刪掉一些地方。你度假不想去哪裡？

examples.heading: ⑤ 表示責備或失望

items.en: I found out from your sister. Why didn't you mention you were moving abroad?
items.zh: 我是從你姊姊那裡知道的。你為什麼沒提你要搬去國外？

items.en: Why didn't you listen to me? I told you it was dangerous.
items.zh: 你為什麼不聽我的？我跟你說過很危險。

items.en: I cooked dinner and I washed the dishes again. Why don't you ever help with the washing-up?
items.zh: 我煮了晚餐，又洗了碗。你為什麼從來都不幫忙洗碗？

items.en: Why haven't you called your grandmother? It's her birthday.
items.zh: 你為什麼還沒打給奶奶？今天是她生日。

examples.heading: ⑥ 表示驚訝

items.en: I drove an hour to get here, and the room is empty. Why didn't anyone tell me the meeting was cancelled?
items.zh: 我開了一小時的車過來，會議室卻是空的。為什麼都沒有人告訴我會議取消了？

items.en: You love animals. Why don't you get a dog?
items.zh: 你那麼愛動物。你為什麼不養狗？

items.en: Why didn't we think of that before? It's so simple!
items.zh: 我們之前為什麼沒想到？這麼簡單！

title: Why can't you do both things?
translation: 你為什麼不能兩件事都做？
name: 情態動詞的否定 wh- 疑問句
sentences: Your job is in the morning and the club meets in the evening. Why can't you do both things?
Everyone else is going. Why can't I go to the party?
Why can't we take the car? It's raining.
I know you weren't at the library. Why can't you just tell me the truth?
It's sunny today. Why can't the children play in the garden?
The shop is open. Why can't I pay by card?
I shouted at my brother again. Why couldn't I control myself?
We waited for you for half an hour. Why couldn't you come to the meeting yesterday?
They slept in their car last night. Why couldn't they find a hotel in the city?
Anna looks very tired this morning. Why couldn't she sleep last night?
I've called five times. Why won't he answer the phone?
Why won't the door open? Is it locked?
You look exhausted. Why won't you take a break?
Why won't she talk to me? What did I do?
I charged it all night. Why won't my computer turn on?
You have a good job. Why wouldn't the bank give you a loan?
He left the house in a hurry. Why wouldn't he tell us where he was going?
It's a great offer. Why wouldn't you accept it?
She's my best friend. Why shouldn't I tell her?
Why shouldn't we take a holiday? We've worked hard all year.
Some parents want to call their kids during the day. Why shouldn't children use phones at school?
I'm planning the menu for your visit. What foods can't you have?
There are yellow lines everywhere. Where can't we park in this street?
Who can't come on Friday? Put your hand up.
You said the test was hard. Which parts couldn't you finish?
The sign says "No entry". Where can't we go?
This is the third time this week. Why can't you remember your keys?
There are bottles all over the beach again. Why can't people put their rubbish in the bin?
I said the bridge was closed, but they drove that way anyway. Why won't anyone listen to me?
Why couldn't you call me? I was so worried.
First my glasses, now my phone. Why can't I find anything in this house?

examples.heading: ① Why can't + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: Your job is in the morning and the club meets in the evening. Why can't you do both things?
items.zh: 你的工作在早上，社團在晚上。你為什麼不能兩件事都做？

items.en: Everyone else is going. Why can't I go to the party?
items.zh: 其他人都要去。我為什麼不能去派對？

items.en: Why can't we take the car? It's raining.
items.zh: 我們為什麼不能開車？外面在下雨。

items.en: I know you weren't at the library. Why can't you just tell me the truth?
items.zh: 我知道你不在圖書館。你為什麼就是不能跟我說實話？

items.en: It's sunny today. Why can't the children play in the garden?
items.zh: 今天出太陽。孩子們為什麼不能在院子裡玩？

items.en: The shop is open. Why can't I pay by card?
items.zh: 店有開。我為什麼不能刷卡？

examples.heading: ② Why couldn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: I shouted at my brother again. Why couldn't I control myself?
items.zh: 我又對我弟弟大吼了。我當時為什麼控制不了自己？

items.en: We waited for you for half an hour. Why couldn't you come to the meeting yesterday?
items.zh: 我們等了你半小時。你昨天為什麼不能來開會？

items.en: They slept in their car last night. Why couldn't they find a hotel in the city?
items.zh: 他們昨晚睡在車上。他們為什麼在城裡找不到飯店？

items.en: Anna looks very tired this morning. Why couldn't she sleep last night?
items.zh: Anna 今天早上看起來很累。她昨晚為什麼睡不著？

examples.heading: ③ Why won't + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: I've called five times. Why won't he answer the phone?
items.zh: 我打了五次。他為什麼不接電話？

items.en: Why won't the door open? Is it locked?
items.zh: 門為什麼打不開？鎖住了嗎？

items.en: You look exhausted. Why won't you take a break?
items.zh: 你看起來累壞了。你為什麼不肯休息一下？

items.en: Why won't she talk to me? What did I do?
items.zh: 她為什麼不跟我說話？我做了什麼？

items.en: I charged it all night. Why won't my computer turn on?
items.zh: 我充了一整晚的電。我的電腦為什麼開不了機？

examples.heading: ④ Why wouldn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: You have a good job. Why wouldn't the bank give you a loan?
items.zh: 你有份好工作。銀行為什麼不肯貸款給你？

items.en: He left the house in a hurry. Why wouldn't he tell us where he was going?
items.zh: 他匆匆忙忙出門。他為什麼不肯跟我們說他要去哪裡？

items.en: It's a great offer. Why wouldn't you accept it?
items.zh: 這是很好的條件。你為什麼不接受？

examples.heading: ⑤ Why shouldn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞

items.en: She's my best friend. Why shouldn't I tell her?
items.zh: 她是我最好的朋友。我為什麼不應該告訴她？

items.en: Why shouldn't we take a holiday? We've worked hard all year.
items.zh: 我們為什麼不應該去度假？我們辛苦了一整年。

items.en: Some parents want to call their kids during the day. Why shouldn't children use phones at school?
items.zh: 有些家長白天想打電話給孩子。孩子為什麼不應該在學校用手機？

examples.heading: ⑥ 其他疑問詞 + 情態動詞 + n't

items.en: I'm planning the menu for your visit. What foods can't you have?
items.zh: 我在安排你來訪時的菜單。你有哪些食物不能吃？

items.en: There are yellow lines everywhere. Where can't we park in this street?
items.zh: 到處都是黃線。這條街哪裡不能停車？

items.en: Who can't come on Friday? Put your hand up.
items.zh: 星期五誰不能來？請舉手。

items.en: You said the test was hard. Which parts couldn't you finish?
items.zh: 你說考試很難。你有哪些部分寫不完？

items.en: The sign says "No entry". Where can't we go?
items.zh: 告示上寫禁止進入。我們哪裡不能去？

examples.heading: ⑦ 表示不滿或不解

items.en: This is the third time this week. Why can't you remember your keys?
items.zh: 這星期第三次了。你為什麼就是記不住帶鑰匙？

items.en: There are bottles all over the beach again. Why can't people put their rubbish in the bin?
items.zh: 海灘上又到處是瓶子。大家為什麼不能把垃圾丟進垃圾桶？

items.en: I said the bridge was closed, but they drove that way anyway. Why won't anyone listen to me?
items.zh: 我說橋封了，他們還是往那邊開。為什麼沒有人要聽我說？

items.en: Why couldn't you call me? I was so worried.
items.zh: 你為什麼不能打個電話給我？我好擔心。

items.en: First my glasses, now my phone. Why can't I find anything in this house?
items.zh: 先是眼鏡，現在是手機。為什麼我在這個家裡什麼都找不到？

title: Is this area in the city or in the countryside?
translation: 這一區是在市區還是在鄉下？
name: 用 or 連接兩個片語的選擇疑問句
sentences: I saw your flat online. Is this area in the city or in the countryside?
I need to book a dentist appointment. Is the meeting in the morning or in the afternoon?
I can't find my keys. Did you leave them on the table or in the car?
You've booked our holiday. Is the hotel near the beach or in the town centre?
I want to study with you this week. Do you usually study at home or at the library?
Are we meeting at the station or outside the cinema?
You have an interesting accent. Did you grow up in the north or in the south?
Both jackets fit you well. Do you want the red jacket or the blue one?
Do you feel more sympathy for your friends or your parents?
Would you prefer a quiet weekend or a big party for your birthday?
Is your brother the tall man in the hat or the one by the door?
Should we take the early train or the last one?
I'm booking our flights now. Do you want a window seat or an aisle seat?
Is the party for her birthday or her new job?
Do you want to eat out or cook at home tonight?
Shall we take a taxi or walk to the hotel?
Did you lose your phone or leave it at work?
Do you prefer to read the news or watch it on TV?
Would you rather stay in a hotel or rent a flat?
Should I send the letter by post or bring it to your office?
Do you want to play tennis or go for a swim?
You haven't touched your bowl. Is the soup too hot or just right?
You're walking strangely. Are the shoes too big or too small?
Was the exam easier than last year or more difficult?
Is your new boss easy to work with or very strict?
Are you leaving this weekend or next week?
The police want to know when you saw him. Did you see him last night or this morning?
Do you want to meet before lunch or after work?
Which do you like better, the book or the film?
Which bus goes to the airport, the number 5 or the number 12?
Which room is yours, the one upstairs or the one next to the kitchen?

examples.heading: ① 介系詞片語 + or + 介系詞片語

items.en: I saw your flat online. Is this area in the city or in the countryside?
items.zh: 我在網路上看到你的公寓。這一區是在市區還是在鄉下？

items.en: I need to book a dentist appointment. Is the meeting in the morning or in the afternoon?
items.zh: 我得預約看牙醫。會議在早上還是下午？

items.en: I can't find my keys. Did you leave them on the table or in the car?
items.zh: 我找不到鑰匙。你把它們留在桌上還是車上？

items.en: You've booked our holiday. Is the hotel near the beach or in the town centre?
items.zh: 你訂好我們的假期了。飯店在海灘附近還是在市中心？

items.en: I want to study with you this week. Do you usually study at home or at the library?
items.zh: 我這星期想跟你一起念書。你通常在家念書還是在圖書館念書？

items.en: Are we meeting at the station or outside the cinema?
items.zh: 我們是在車站見面還是在電影院外面？

items.en: You have an interesting accent. Did you grow up in the north or in the south?
items.zh: 你的口音很特別。你是在北部還是南部長大的？

examples.heading: ② 名詞片語 + or + 名詞片語

items.en: Both jackets fit you well. Do you want the red jacket or the blue one?
items.zh: 兩件外套你穿都很合身。你要紅色那件還是藍色那件？

items.en: Do you feel more sympathy for your friends or your parents?
items.zh: 你比較同情你的朋友，還是你的父母？

items.en: Would you prefer a quiet weekend or a big party for your birthday?
items.zh: 你生日想要一個安靜的週末，還是一個盛大的派對？

items.en: Is your brother the tall man in the hat or the one by the door?
items.zh: 你哥哥是戴帽子那個高個子，還是門邊那個？

items.en: Should we take the early train or the last one?
items.zh: 我們該搭早班的火車還是最後一班？

items.en: I'm booking our flights now. Do you want a window seat or an aisle seat?
items.zh: 我現在在訂機票。你要靠窗的位子還是靠走道的位子？

items.en: Is the party for her birthday or her new job?
items.zh: 那個派對是為了她的生日，還是她的新工作？

examples.heading: ③ 動詞片語 + or + 動詞片語

items.en: Do you want to eat out or cook at home tonight?
items.zh: 你今晚想去外面吃還是在家煮？

items.en: Shall we take a taxi or walk to the hotel?
items.zh: 我們要搭計程車還是走路去飯店？

items.en: Did you lose your phone or leave it at work?
items.zh: 你的手機是弄丟了還是留在公司了？

items.en: Do you prefer to read the news or watch it on TV?
items.zh: 你比較喜歡讀新聞還是看電視新聞？

items.en: Would you rather stay in a hotel or rent a flat?
items.zh: 你比較想住飯店還是租公寓？

items.en: Should I send the letter by post or bring it to your office?
items.zh: 我該把信寄給你，還是拿去你的辦公室？

items.en: Do you want to play tennis or go for a swim?
items.zh: 你想打網球還是去游泳？

examples.heading: ④ 形容詞片語 + or + 形容詞片語

items.en: You haven't touched your bowl. Is the soup too hot or just right?
items.zh: 你都沒動你那碗。湯太燙還是剛剛好？

items.en: You're walking strangely. Are the shoes too big or too small?
items.zh: 你走路怪怪的。鞋子太大還是太小？

items.en: Was the exam easier than last year or more difficult?
items.zh: 這次考試比去年簡單還是比較難？

items.en: Is your new boss easy to work with or very strict?
items.zh: 你的新老闆好相處還是很嚴格？

examples.heading: ⑤ 時間片語 + or + 時間片語

items.en: Are you leaving this weekend or next week?
items.zh: 你這個週末走還是下星期走？

items.en: The police want to know when you saw him. Did you see him last night or this morning?
items.zh: 警察想知道你什麼時候看到他。你是昨晚還是今天早上看到他的？

items.en: Do you want to meet before lunch or after work?
items.zh: 你想在午餐前見面還是下班後？

examples.heading: ⑥ 用 Which 開頭的選擇疑問句

items.en: Which do you like better, the book or the film?
items.zh: 你比較喜歡哪一個，書還是電影？

items.en: Which bus goes to the airport, the number 5 or the number 12?
items.zh: 哪一班公車到機場，五號還是十二號？

items.en: Which room is yours, the one upstairs or the one next to the kitchen?
items.zh: 哪一間是你的房間，樓上那間還是廚房旁邊那間？

title: It's fantastic, isn't it?
translation: 這很棒，對吧？
name: 附加問句（常用）
sentences: We should come here again. The ice cream is fantastic, isn't it?
The sea is so blue today, isn't it? Let's go swimming.
I think I know your face. You're in my maths class, aren't you?
I saw two people waving at you. Your parents were at the school play, weren't they?
It isn't far to the station, is it? We can walk.
The tickets weren't very expensive, were they?
The shoes cost £30. That wasn't too expensive, was it?
You don't know where I live, do you? I'll send you the address.
You like spicy food, don't you? This curry is very hot.
We need a guitarist for the concert. Your brother plays the guitar, doesn't he?
Excuse me. This bus goes to the airport, doesn't it?
She doesn't eat meat, does she? I'll make some pasta.
That's not what you said yesterday. You told me a different story, didn't you?
You saw the film last week, didn't you? Was it good?
We met at Anna's party, didn't we?
The kitchen smells of smoke. You didn't burn the toast, did you?
Grandma called from the station. Her train got in early, didn't it?
I've invited the whole class. You can come to my party on Saturday, can't you?
We'll be back before dark, won't we?
You can't drive, can you? I'll pick you up.
It won't rain tomorrow, will it? We're having a picnic.
Can you show us around? You've been to London before, haven't you?
The guests are late. They haven't called, have they?
Lucy is watching TV. She's finished her homework, hasn't she?
What a beautiful day! It's lovely and warm, isn't it?
I laughed all the way through. The film was so funny, wasn't it?
This cake is delicious, isn't it? Did you make it?
The new teacher is really funny, isn't he?
I'll get there early to set up. The meeting starts at ten, doesn't it?
I'm buying food for the weekend. You're coming to dinner on Friday, aren't you?
We're at the theatre now. You've got the tickets, haven't you?

examples.heading: ① be 的附加問句

items.en: We should come here again. The ice cream is fantastic, isn't it?
items.zh: 我們應該再來。這裡的冰淇淋很棒，對吧？

items.en: The sea is so blue today, isn't it? Let's go swimming.
items.zh: 今天的海好藍，對吧？我們去游泳吧。

items.en: I think I know your face. You're in my maths class, aren't you?
items.zh: 我好像認得你的臉。你跟我上同一堂數學課，對吧？

items.en: I saw two people waving at you. Your parents were at the school play, weren't they?
items.zh: 我看到兩個人在跟你揮手。你爸媽有去看學校的話劇，對吧？

items.en: It isn't far to the station, is it? We can walk.
items.zh: 到車站不遠，對吧？我們可以走路。

items.en: The tickets weren't very expensive, were they?
items.zh: 票不太貴，對吧？

items.en: The shoes cost £30. That wasn't too expensive, was it?
items.zh: 那雙鞋三十英鎊。不算太貴，對吧？

examples.heading: ② do / does 的附加問句

items.en: You don't know where I live, do you? I'll send you the address.
items.zh: 你不知道我住哪裡，對吧？我把地址傳給你。

items.en: You like spicy food, don't you? This curry is very hot.
items.zh: 你喜歡吃辣，對吧？這道咖哩很辣。

items.en: We need a guitarist for the concert. Your brother plays the guitar, doesn't he?
items.zh: 我們的音樂會需要一個吉他手。你哥哥會彈吉他，對吧？

items.en: Excuse me. This bus goes to the airport, doesn't it?
items.zh: 不好意思。這班公車會到機場，對吧？

items.en: She doesn't eat meat, does she? I'll make some pasta.
items.zh: 她不吃肉，對吧？我來煮義大利麵。

examples.heading: ③ did 的附加問句

items.en: That's not what you said yesterday. You told me a different story, didn't you?
items.zh: 你昨天不是這樣說的。你跟我說的是另一個版本，對吧？

items.en: You saw the film last week, didn't you? Was it good?
items.zh: 你上星期看了那部電影，對吧？好看嗎？

items.en: We met at Anna's party, didn't we?
items.zh: 我們是在 Anna 的派對上認識的，對吧？

items.en: The kitchen smells of smoke. You didn't burn the toast, did you?
items.zh: 廚房有煙味。你沒把吐司烤焦吧？

items.en: Grandma called from the station. Her train got in early, didn't it?
items.zh: 奶奶從車站打電話來。她的火車提早到了，對吧？

examples.heading: ④ can / will 的附加問句

items.en: I've invited the whole class. You can come to my party on Saturday, can't you?
items.zh: 我邀了全班。你星期六可以來我的派對，對吧？

items.en: We'll be back before dark, won't we?
items.zh: 我們天黑前會回來，對吧？

items.en: You can't drive, can you? I'll pick you up.
items.zh: 你不會開車，對吧？我去接你。

items.en: It won't rain tomorrow, will it? We're having a picnic.
items.zh: 明天不會下雨，對吧？我們要去野餐。

examples.heading: ⑤ have 的附加問句

items.en: Can you show us around? You've been to London before, haven't you?
items.zh: 你可以帶我們逛逛嗎？你以前去過倫敦，對吧？

items.en: The guests are late. They haven't called, have they?
items.zh: 客人遲到了。他們沒打電話來，對吧？

items.en: Lucy is watching TV. She's finished her homework, hasn't she?
items.zh: Lucy 在看電視。她寫完功課了，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑥ 請對方同意

items.en: What a beautiful day! It's lovely and warm, isn't it?
items.zh: 天氣真好！又暖和又舒服，對吧？

items.en: I laughed all the way through. The film was so funny, wasn't it?
items.zh: 我從頭笑到尾。那部電影超好笑，對吧？

items.en: This cake is delicious, isn't it? Did you make it?
items.zh: 這蛋糕很好吃，對吧？是你做的嗎？

items.en: The new teacher is really funny, isn't he?
items.zh: 新來的老師真的很好笑，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑦ 確認一件事

items.en: I'll get there early to set up. The meeting starts at ten, doesn't it?
items.zh: 我會早點到去準備。會議十點開始，對吧？

items.en: I'm buying food for the weekend. You're coming to dinner on Friday, aren't you?
