items.zh: 我在買週末的食物。你星期五會來吃晚餐，對吧？

items.en: We're at the theatre now. You've got the tickets, haven't you?
items.zh: 我們到劇院了。票在你那邊，對吧？

title: There is always something you can improve, isn't there?
translation: 總是有可以改進的地方，不是嗎？
name: there be 的附加問句
sentences: Don't give up after one bad game. There is always something you can improve, isn't there?
I need some cash. There's a bank near here, isn't there?
Let's eat out tonight. There are lots of good restaurants in this street, aren't there?
There's a train at six, isn't there? We can still catch it.
I can't go to the gym at three. There's a meeting this afternoon, isn't there?
My brother could stay with us. There are two bedrooms in the flat, aren't there?
Our time zones are close. There isn't much of a difference, is there?
The sign says the show is sold out. There aren't any tickets left, are there?
We'll need to bring food. There isn't a supermarket in the village, is there?
There isn't time for coffee, is there? The film starts at seven.
We can sit anywhere. There aren't many people here tonight, are there?
The reports didn't come out. There was a problem with the printer, wasn't there?
We couldn't see the stage at all. There were a lot of people at the concert, weren't there?
You came back with the parcel. There wasn't anyone at home, was there?
You walked home last night. There weren't any buses after midnight, were there?
There was a fire in the old school last year, wasn't there?
There'll be time for lunch before the meeting, won't there?
I won't eat before I go. There'll be food at the party, won't there?
It's six in the morning. There won't be any traffic at this time, will there?
I've sent all the forms. There won't be a problem with the visa, will there?
There's been an accident on the motorway, hasn't there? The traffic isn't moving.
There have been a lot of changes at work, haven't there?
The garden looks so dry. There hasn't been any rain for weeks, has there?
The last train has gone. There's nothing we can do now, is there?
There's no milk left, is there? I'll go and buy some.
There's no need to hurry, is there? We've got plenty of time.
There's little chance of rain today, is there?
Nobody answered when you rang. There was nobody in the office, was there?
There's nothing better than a hot bath after a long day, is there?
Look at the house on the corner. There's something odd about it, isn't there?
There are worse places to live, aren't there?

examples.heading: ① There is / There are + 否定的附加問句

items.en: Don't give up after one bad game. There is always something you can improve, isn't there?
items.zh: 別因為一場比賽打不好就放棄。總是有可以改進的地方，不是嗎？

items.en: I need some cash. There's a bank near here, isn't there?
items.zh: 我需要一點現金。這附近有銀行，對吧？

items.en: Let's eat out tonight. There are lots of good restaurants in this street, aren't there?
items.zh: 我們今晚去外面吃吧。這條街上有很多好餐廳，對吧？

items.en: There's a train at six, isn't there? We can still catch it.
items.zh: 六點有一班火車，對吧？我們還趕得上。

items.en: I can't go to the gym at three. There's a meeting this afternoon, isn't there?
items.zh: 我三點不能去健身房。今天下午要開會，對吧？

items.en: My brother could stay with us. There are two bedrooms in the flat, aren't there?
items.zh: 我哥哥可以跟我們住。那間公寓有兩個房間，對吧？

examples.heading: ② There isn't / There aren't + 肯定的附加問句

items.en: Our time zones are close. There isn't much of a difference, is there?
items.zh: 我們的時區很接近。沒有什麼差別，對吧？

items.en: The sign says the show is sold out. There aren't any tickets left, are there?
items.zh: 告示上寫表演賣完了。票一張都不剩了，對吧？

items.en: We'll need to bring food. There isn't a supermarket in the village, is there?
items.zh: 我們得自己帶吃的。村子裡沒有超市，對吧？

items.en: There isn't time for coffee, is there? The film starts at seven.
items.zh: 沒時間喝咖啡了，對吧？電影七點開始。

items.en: We can sit anywhere. There aren't many people here tonight, are there?
items.zh: 我們坐哪裡都行。今晚這裡人不多，對吧？

examples.heading: ③ There was / There were

items.en: The reports didn't come out. There was a problem with the printer, wasn't there?
items.zh: 報告沒印出來。印表機有點問題，對吧？

items.en: We couldn't see the stage at all. There were a lot of people at the concert, weren't there?
items.zh: 我們完全看不到舞台。演唱會有很多人，對吧？

items.en: You came back with the parcel. There wasn't anyone at home, was there?
items.zh: 你把包裹帶回來了。家裡沒有人，對吧？

items.en: You walked home last night. There weren't any buses after midnight, were there?
items.zh: 你昨晚走路回家。半夜以後沒有公車，對吧？

items.en: There was a fire in the old school last year, wasn't there?
items.zh: 去年那所舊學校發生過火災，對吧？

examples.heading: ④ There will be / There won't be

items.en: There'll be time for lunch before the meeting, won't there?
items.zh: 開會前會有時間吃午餐，對吧？

items.en: I won't eat before I go. There'll be food at the party, won't there?
items.zh: 我出門前不吃了。派對上會有吃的，對吧？

items.en: It's six in the morning. There won't be any traffic at this time, will there?
items.zh: 現在是早上六點。這個時間不會塞車，對吧？

items.en: I've sent all the forms. There won't be a problem with the visa, will there?
items.zh: 表格我都寄了。簽證不會有問題，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ There has been / There have been

items.en: There's been an accident on the motorway, hasn't there? The traffic isn't moving.
items.zh: 高速公路上發生了車禍，對吧？車都動不了。

items.en: There have been a lot of changes at work, haven't there?
items.zh: 公司最近有很多改變，對吧？

items.en: The garden looks so dry. There hasn't been any rain for weeks, has there?
items.zh: 院子看起來好乾。好幾個星期沒下雨了，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑥ no / nothing / little + 肯定的附加問句

items.en: The last train has gone. There's nothing we can do now, is there?
items.zh: 最後一班火車已經開走了。我們現在什麼也做不了，對吧？

items.en: There's no milk left, is there? I'll go and buy some.
items.zh: 牛奶沒了，對吧？我去買一點。

items.en: There's no need to hurry, is there? We've got plenty of time.
items.zh: 不用急，對吧？我們時間還很多。

items.en: There's little chance of rain today, is there?
items.zh: 今天不太可能下雨，對吧？

items.en: Nobody answered when you rang. There was nobody in the office, was there?
items.zh: 你打去的時候沒人接。辦公室裡沒有人，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑦ 請對方同意

items.en: There's nothing better than a hot bath after a long day, is there?
items.zh: 忙了一整天之後，沒有什麼比泡熱水澡更好的了，對吧？

items.en: Look at the house on the corner. There's something odd about it, isn't there?
items.zh: 你看轉角那間房子。它有點怪怪的，對吧？

items.en: There are worse places to live, aren't there?
items.zh: 比這裡更糟的地方多得是，對吧？

title: Maybe you could hand out toys or show a movie?
translation: 也許你可以發玩具，或是放一部電影？
name: 第二子句省略情態動詞的選擇疑問句（委婉）
sentences: For the Christmas party, maybe you could hand out toys or show a movie?
The kids are bored. Maybe we could play a game or read them a story?
If you're free on Sunday, maybe we could go to the beach or visit your parents?
The kitchen is a mess. Maybe you could wash the dishes or clean the floor?
He hasn't answered my messages. Maybe you could call him tonight or send him an email?
If the room is too small, maybe we could move the table or take out a chair?
The buses are always full. Maybe the company could add more buses or make the tickets cheaper?
Maybe you will be able to arrange another trip this year or give us more time there?
Maybe the school will be able to buy new computers or repair the old ones?
Maybe you'll be able to find a cheaper hotel or stay with friends?
Perhaps the club could open on Sundays or stay open later on weekdays?
Perhaps you could send the report by Friday or give us a short summary?
Perhaps the council could plant more trees or build a small park?
Perhaps we could share a taxi or take the late bus together?
If the printer is broken, maybe we can use the one upstairs or print it at home?
I can't find your house. Maybe you can text me the address or send me a map?
Maybe you could check the figures again or ask the finance team?
Maybe the hotel could offer a free breakfast or give guests a discount?
Maybe the students could present their work in groups or make a short video?
Half the team is ill this week. Maybe we could postpone the meeting or hold it online?
Maybe the museum could stay open late on Fridays or offer cheaper tickets for students?
You look tired. Maybe you could take a day off or go to bed earlier?
If you don't like the job, maybe you could talk to your boss or look for something new?
Maybe you could ask your sister for help or hire a babysitter?
You love music so much. Maybe you could learn the guitar or join a band?
Maybe we could cook together tonight or try that new restaurant?
Your car is at the garage all week. Maybe you could walk, cycle or take the bus?
Maybe we could paint the walls, buy new curtains or move the sofa?
Maybe they could sell cakes, wash cars or organise a concert to raise money?
Maybe you could read more, watch films in English or find a language partner?
Maybe the town could build a cinema, open a sports centre or improve the library?

examples.heading: ① Maybe + 主詞 + could + 動詞片語 A + or + 動詞片語 B?

items.en: For the Christmas party, maybe you could hand out toys or show a movie?
items.zh: 聖誕派對的時候，也許你可以發玩具，或是放一部電影？

items.en: The kids are bored. Maybe we could play a game or read them a story?
items.zh: 孩子們很無聊。也許我們可以玩個遊戲，或是讀故事給他們聽？

items.en: If you're free on Sunday, maybe we could go to the beach or visit your parents?
items.zh: 如果你星期天有空，也許我們可以去海邊，或是去看你爸媽？

items.en: The kitchen is a mess. Maybe you could wash the dishes or clean the floor?
items.zh: 廚房好亂。也許你可以洗碗，或是擦地板？

items.en: He hasn't answered my messages. Maybe you could call him tonight or send him an email?
items.zh: 他都沒回我的訊息。也許你今晚可以打給他，或是寄電子郵件給他？

items.en: If the room is too small, maybe we could move the table or take out a chair?
items.zh: 如果房間太小，也許我們可以把桌子移開，或是搬出一張椅子？

items.en: The buses are always full. Maybe the company could add more buses or make the tickets cheaper?
items.zh: 公車總是客滿。也許公司可以增加公車班次，或是讓票便宜一點？

examples.heading: ② Maybe + 主詞 + will be able to + 動詞片語 A + or + 動詞片語 B?

items.en: Maybe you will be able to arrange another trip this year or give us more time there?
items.zh: 也許你們今年可以再安排一次旅行，或是讓我們在那裡多待一點時間？

items.en: Maybe the school will be able to buy new computers or repair the old ones?
items.zh: 也許學校能買新電腦，或是修好舊的？

items.en: Maybe you'll be able to find a cheaper hotel or stay with friends?
items.zh: 也許你可以找到便宜一點的飯店，或是住朋友家？

examples.heading: ③ Perhaps + 主詞 + could + 動詞片語 A + or + 動詞片語 B?

items.en: Perhaps the club could open on Sundays or stay open later on weekdays?
items.zh: 也許俱樂部可以星期天開放，或是平日開晚一點？

items.en: Perhaps you could send the report by Friday or give us a short summary?
items.zh: 也許您可以在星期五前寄報告，或是給我們一份簡短的摘要？

items.en: Perhaps the council could plant more trees or build a small park?
items.zh: 也許市議會可以多種一些樹，或是蓋一座小公園？

items.en: Perhaps we could share a taxi or take the late bus together?
items.zh: 也許我們可以一起搭計程車，或是一起搭晚班公車？

examples.heading: ④ Maybe + 主詞 + can + 動詞片語 A + or + 動詞片語 B?

items.en: If the printer is broken, maybe we can use the one upstairs or print it at home?
items.zh: 如果印表機壞了，也許我們可以用樓上那台，或是在家印？

items.en: I can't find your house. Maybe you can text me the address or send me a map?
items.zh: 我找不到你家。也許你可以把地址傳給我，或是傳地圖給我？

examples.heading: ⑤ 給上司或客人的委婉建議

items.en: Maybe you could check the figures again or ask the finance team?
items.zh: 也許您可以再核對一次數字，或是問問財務部？

items.en: Maybe the hotel could offer a free breakfast or give guests a discount?
items.zh: 也許飯店可以提供免費早餐，或是給客人折扣？

items.en: Maybe the students could present their work in groups or make a short video?
items.zh: 也許學生可以分組發表作品，或是拍一支短片？

items.en: Half the team is ill this week. Maybe we could postpone the meeting or hold it online?
items.zh: 這星期團隊有一半的人生病了。也許我們可以把會議延期，或是改在線上開？

items.en: Maybe the museum could stay open late on Fridays or offer cheaper tickets for students?
items.zh: 也許博物館可以星期五開晚一點，或是給學生便宜一點的票？

examples.heading: ⑥ 給朋友的委婉建議

items.en: You look tired. Maybe you could take a day off or go to bed earlier?
items.zh: 你看起來很累。也許你可以請一天假，或是早點睡？

items.en: If you don't like the job, maybe you could talk to your boss or look for something new?
items.zh: 如果你不喜歡那份工作，也許你可以跟老闆談談，或是找新的工作？

items.en: Maybe you could ask your sister for help or hire a babysitter?
items.zh: 也許你可以請你姊姊幫忙，或是請一個保母？

items.en: You love music so much. Maybe you could learn the guitar or join a band?
items.zh: 你那麼愛音樂。也許你可以學吉他，或是加入一個樂團？

items.en: Maybe we could cook together tonight or try that new restaurant?
items.zh: 也許我們今晚可以一起煮飯，或是去試試那家新餐廳？

examples.heading: ⑦ 有三個建議

items.en: Your car is at the garage all week. Maybe you could walk, cycle or take the bus?
items.zh: 你的車整個星期都在修車廠。也許你可以走路、騎腳踏車，或是搭公車？

items.en: Maybe we could paint the walls, buy new curtains or move the sofa?
items.zh: 也許我們可以漆牆、買新窗簾，或是移動沙發？

items.en: Maybe they could sell cakes, wash cars or organise a concert to raise money?
items.zh: 也許他們可以賣蛋糕、洗車，或是辦一場音樂會來募款？

items.en: Maybe you could read more, watch films in English or find a language partner?
items.zh: 也許你可以多讀一點、看英文電影，或是找一個語言交換的夥伴？

items.en: Maybe the town could build a cinema, open a sports centre or improve the library?
items.zh: 也許鎮上可以蓋一間電影院、開一間運動中心，或是改善圖書館？

title: Do we not want our children to be as happy as possible?
translation: 難道我們不希望孩子盡可能過得快樂嗎？
name: 不縮寫 not 的否定疑問句
sentences: Do we not owe the volunteers our thanks?
Does the report not prove our point?
Did the council not promise us a new library?
Do you not think the price is too high?
Did you not say the same thing last year?
Does every child not deserve a safe school?
Do they not see the danger?
Does the law not apply to everyone?
Are we not entitled to know where our money went?
Is it not obvious?
Is this not the best plan we have?
Are you not worried about the cost?
Was that not the whole point of the meeting?
Is the government not responsible for the roads?
Are we not all on the same side here?
Is the park not a better place for the market?
Is it not fair to ask who paid for the study?
Is it not too early to close the case?
Is it not cheaper to repair the old bus than to buy a new one?
Is it not better to wait one more week?
Have we not heard this excuse before?
Has the minister not changed his mind twice already?
Have the tenants not waited long enough?
Can we not ask the tenants first?
Should the board not have seen this coming?
Would it not be simpler to ask her directly?
Could we not take her silence as a yes?
Will the delay not upset the parents?
Should we not give them a second chance?
Can they not settle it between themselves?
Would they not be happier in a bigger flat?

examples.heading: ① Do、Does、Did + 主詞 + not + 原形

items.en: Do we not owe the volunteers our thanks?
items.zh: 我們難道不該感謝這些志工嗎？

items.en: Does the report not prove our point?
items.zh: 這份報告難道沒有證明我們的看法嗎？

items.en: Did the council not promise us a new library?
items.zh: 市議會難道沒有答應給我們一座新圖書館嗎？

items.en: Do you not think the price is too high?
items.zh: 你難道不覺得價錢太高了嗎？

items.en: Did you not say the same thing last year?
items.zh: 你去年難道沒有說過同樣的話嗎？

items.en: Does every child not deserve a safe school?
items.zh: 每個孩子難道不該有一間安全的學校嗎？

items.en: Do they not see the danger?
items.zh: 他們難道看不出危險嗎？

items.en: Does the law not apply to everyone?
items.zh: 法律難道不是對每個人都適用嗎？

examples.heading: ② be + 主詞 + not + 補語

items.en: Are we not entitled to know where our money went?
items.zh: 我們難道沒有權利知道錢花到哪裡去了嗎？

items.en: Is it not obvious?
items.zh: 這難道還不明顯嗎？

items.en: Is this not the best plan we have?
items.zh: 這難道不是我們最好的計畫嗎？

items.en: Are you not worried about the cost?
items.zh: 你難道不擔心費用嗎？

items.en: Was that not the whole point of the meeting?
items.zh: 那難道不就是這場會的重點嗎？

items.en: Is the government not responsible for the roads?
items.zh: 政府難道不該為道路負責嗎？

items.en: Are we not all on the same side here?
items.zh: 我們難道不是站在同一邊的嗎？

items.en: Is the park not a better place for the market?
items.zh: 公園難道不是更適合辦市集的地方嗎？

examples.heading: ③ Is it not + 形容詞 + to + 原形

items.en: Is it not fair to ask who paid for the study?
items.zh: 問是誰出錢做這份研究，難道不合理嗎？

items.en: Is it not too early to close the case?
items.zh: 現在結案難道不會太早嗎？

items.en: Is it not cheaper to repair the old bus than to buy a new one?
items.zh: 修舊公車難道不比買新的便宜嗎？

items.en: Is it not better to wait one more week?
items.zh: 再等一個禮拜難道不是比較好嗎？

examples.heading: ④ Have、Has + 主詞 + not + 過去分詞

items.en: Have we not heard this excuse before?
items.zh: 這個藉口我們難道沒聽過嗎？

items.en: Has the minister not changed his mind twice already?
items.zh: 部長難道不是已經改變主意兩次了嗎？

items.en: Have the tenants not waited long enough?
items.zh: 房客難道等得還不夠久嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 情態動詞 + 主詞 + not + 原形

items.en: Can we not ask the tenants first?
items.zh: 我們難道不能先問問房客嗎？

items.en: Should the board not have seen this coming?
items.zh: 董事會難道不該早就料到嗎？

items.en: Would it not be simpler to ask her directly?
items.zh: 直接問她難道不是比較簡單嗎？

items.en: Could we not take her silence as a yes?
items.zh: 我們難道不能把她的沉默當成同意嗎？

items.en: Will the delay not upset the parents?
items.zh: 這次延誤難道不會讓家長不高興嗎？

items.en: Should we not give them a second chance?
items.zh: 我們難道不該再給他們一次機會嗎？

items.en: Can they not settle it between themselves?
items.zh: 他們難道不能私下解決嗎？

items.en: Would they not be happier in a bigger flat?
items.zh: 他們住大一點的公寓難道不會比較開心嗎？

title: Why don't we watch a film?
translation: 我們何不看部電影？
name: why don't 否定疑問句表示建議
sentences: It's raining too hard to play outside. Why don't we watch a film?
We're both hungry. Why don't we stop for lunch?
The weather is perfect. Why don't we have a picnic in the park?
Why don't we share a taxi? We're going the same way.
The library is closed on Monday. Why don't we study at my place?
We've got a long weekend. Why don't we visit your parents?
Why don't we ask Sam? He knows a lot about cars.
I'm tired of pizza. Why don't we cook something different tonight?
This plan isn't working. Why don't we start again from the beginning?
You look tired. Why don't you go to bed early tonight?
Your headache hasn't gone. Why don't you see a doctor?
Why don't you ask your teacher? She'll know the answer.
That dress looks great on you. Why don't you buy it?
That's a long phone number. Why don't you write it down so you don't forget?
If you're bored, why don't you learn a new language?
Why don't you take the train? It's faster than driving.
I'm going to the market. Why don't you come with me?
We're having a barbecue on Sunday. Why don't you join us?
Why don't you stay for dinner? I've made plenty.
Why don't you come and visit us in the summer?
There's plenty of space in the car. Why don't you bring your cousin along?
You're busy. Why don't I make the dinner tonight?
Your bags look heavy. Why don't I carry one of them?
It's Mum's birthday on Friday. Why don't I call the restaurant and book a table?
Why not take a day off? You deserve it.
Why not ask for help? Everyone needs it sometimes.
"Why don't we go for a swim?" "Good idea! I'll get my towel."
"Why don't you join us for coffee?" "I'd love to, thanks."
"Why don't we go out tonight?" "Sorry, I'm too tired."
"Why don't you try the chocolate cake?" "OK, I will."
"Why don't we paint the kitchen yellow?" "Hmm, maybe. Let's look at some colours first."

examples.heading: ① Why don't we + 原形動詞：提議一起做

items.en: It's raining too hard to play outside. Why don't we watch a film?
items.zh: 雨太大了，不能在外面玩。我們何不看部電影？

items.en: We're both hungry. Why don't we stop for lunch?
items.zh: 我們都餓了。我們何不停下來吃午餐？

items.en: The weather is perfect. Why don't we have a picnic in the park?
items.zh: 天氣好極了。我們何不在公園野餐？

items.en: Why don't we share a taxi? We're going the same way.
items.zh: 我們何不一起搭計程車？我們順路。

items.en: The library is closed on Monday. Why don't we study at my place?
items.zh: 圖書館星期一休館。我們何不在我家念書？

items.en: We've got a long weekend. Why don't we visit your parents?
items.zh: 我們有連假。我們何不去看你爸媽？

items.en: Why don't we ask Sam? He knows a lot about cars.
items.zh: 我們何不問 Sam？他對車子很懂。

items.en: I'm tired of pizza. Why don't we cook something different tonight?
items.zh: 我吃膩披薩了。我們今晚何不煮點不一樣的？

items.en: This plan isn't working. Why don't we start again from the beginning?
items.zh: 這個計畫行不通。我們何不從頭再來一次？

examples.heading: ② Why don't you + 原形動詞：建議對方

items.en: You look tired. Why don't you go to bed early tonight?
items.zh: 你看起來很累。你今晚何不早點睡？

items.en: Your headache hasn't gone. Why don't you see a doctor?
items.zh: 你的頭痛還沒好。你何不去看醫生？

items.en: Why don't you ask your teacher? She'll know the answer.
items.zh: 你何不問你的老師？她會知道答案。

items.en: That dress looks great on you. Why don't you buy it?
items.zh: 那件洋裝你穿起來很好看。你何不買下來？

items.en: That's a long phone number. Why don't you write it down so you don't forget?
items.zh: 那個電話號碼很長。你何不把它寫下來，免得忘記？

items.en: If you're bored, why don't you learn a new language?
items.zh: 如果你很無聊，何不學一種新的語言？

items.en: Why don't you take the train? It's faster than driving.
items.zh: 你何不搭火車？比開車快。

examples.heading: ③ Why don't you + 原形動詞：邀請對方

items.en: I'm going to the market. Why don't you come with me?
items.zh: 我要去市集。你何不跟我一起去？

items.en: We're having a barbecue on Sunday. Why don't you join us?
items.zh: 我們星期天要烤肉。你何不一起來？

items.en: Why don't you stay for dinner? I've made plenty.
items.zh: 你何不留下來吃晚餐？我煮了很多。

items.en: Why don't you come and visit us in the summer?
items.zh: 你夏天何不來看我們？

items.en: There's plenty of space in the car. Why don't you bring your cousin along?
items.zh: 車上空間很多。你何不帶你表妹一起來？

examples.heading: ④ Why don't I + 原形動詞：主動幫忙

items.en: You're busy. Why don't I make the dinner tonight?
items.zh: 你很忙。今晚何不讓我來煮晚餐？

items.en: Your bags look heavy. Why don't I carry one of them?
items.zh: 你的袋子看起來好重。何不讓我幫你拿一個？

items.en: It's Mum's birthday on Friday. Why don't I call the restaurant and book a table?
items.zh: 星期五是媽媽的生日。何不讓我打電話給餐廳訂位？

examples.heading: ⑤ Why not + 原形動詞：更簡短的說法

items.en: Why not take a day off? You deserve it.
items.zh: 何不請一天假？你應該休息一下。

items.en: Why not ask for help? Everyone needs it sometimes.
items.zh: 何不請人幫忙？每個人有時候都需要。

examples.heading: ⑥ 回答建議

items.en: "Why don't we go for a swim?" "Good idea! I'll get my towel."
items.zh: 我們何不去游泳？好主意！我去拿毛巾。

items.en: "Why don't you join us for coffee?" "I'd love to, thanks."
items.zh: 你何不跟我們一起喝咖啡？我很樂意，謝謝。

items.en: "Why don't we go out tonight?" "Sorry, I'm too tired."
items.zh: 我們今晚何不出去？抱歉，我太累了。

items.en: "Why don't you try the chocolate cake?" "OK, I will."
items.zh: 你何不試試巧克力蛋糕？好，我試試。

items.en: "Why don't we paint the kitchen yellow?" "Hmm, maybe. Let's look at some colours first."
items.zh: 我們何不把廚房漆成黃色？嗯，也許吧。我們先看看顏色。

title: Do you want to do that or not?
translation: 你到底要不要做那件事？
name: 以 or not 結尾的選擇疑問句
sentences: The sign-up closes today. Do you want to do the volunteer work or not?
We've been talking about this for an hour. Do you agree with me or not?
The taxi is waiting. Are you coming or not?
I need to book the table. Will you be there at eight or not?
Just tell me. Do you like the dress or not?
Is the shop open or not? There's nobody inside.
Dinner is ready. Have you done your maths homework or not?
Did you lock the front door or not? I can't remember.
He was quiet for a few seconds. I couldn't wait any longer. "Did you pass or not?"
The doctor looked at the X-ray. "Is it broken or not?" I asked.
Did they give you the job or not? Tell me!
Please check the website again. Did the plane land safely or not?
I've asked you three times. Are you paying attention or not?
Are you going to help me or not? I can't carry this alone.
Do you want this last piece of cake or not? I'll eat it.
Can you fix the computer or not? I need it for work.
Is he coming to the meeting or not? We can't wait all day.
Did you read my email or not? You haven't answered.
Is breakfast included in the price or not?（被動）
Do we need to bring our passports or not?
Is it going to rain tomorrow or not? I want to plan the picnic.
Are pets allowed in the flat or not?（被動）
Should I bring a present or not? I don't know them very well.
Tom, are you coming or not? We're leaving.
Kids, are you getting up or not? It's half past seven.
I don't know whether or not he passed the exam.
Tell me if you're coming or not by Friday.
I'm not sure whether or not the museum is open on Mondays.
Let me know if you want a ticket or not.
I can't tell whether the milk is fresh or not. Can you smell it?
Can you check if the train is on time or not?

examples.heading: ① 一般疑問句 + or not：要對方給明確的答案

items.en: The sign-up closes today. Do you want to do the volunteer work or not?
items.zh: 報名今天截止。你到底要不要去當志工？

items.en: We've been talking about this for an hour. Do you agree with me or not?
items.zh: 這件事我們已經談了一個小時了。你到底同不同意我？

items.en: The taxi is waiting. Are you coming or not?
items.zh: 計程車在等了。你到底要不要來？

items.en: I need to book the table. Will you be there at eight or not?
items.zh: 我得訂位。你八點到底會不會到？

items.en: Just tell me. Do you like the dress or not?
items.zh: 你直接告訴我。你到底喜不喜歡這件洋裝？

items.en: Is the shop open or not? There's nobody inside.
items.zh: 那家店到底有沒有開？裡面都沒人。

items.en: Dinner is ready. Have you done your maths homework or not?
items.zh: 晚餐好了。你的數學功課到底寫完了沒？

items.en: Did you lock the front door or not? I can't remember.
items.zh: 你到底有沒有鎖前門？我記不得了。

examples.heading: ② or not：焦急地等答案

items.en: He was quiet for a few seconds. I couldn't wait any longer. "Did you pass or not?"
items.zh: 他有幾秒鐘都沒說話。我等不下去了。你到底有沒有及格？

items.en: The doctor looked at the X-ray. "Is it broken or not?" I asked.
items.zh: 醫生看著 X 光片。到底有沒有斷？我問。

items.en: Did they give you the job or not? Tell me!
items.zh: 他們到底有沒有錄取你？快告訴我！

items.en: Please check the website again. Did the plane land safely or not?
items.zh: 請再查一次網站。飛機到底有沒有平安降落？

examples.heading: ③ or not：生氣或不耐煩

items.en: I've asked you three times. Are you paying attention or not?
items.zh: 我已經問你三次了。你到底有沒有在專心聽？

items.en: Are you going to help me or not? I can't carry this alone.
items.zh: 你到底要不要幫我？我一個人搬不動。

items.en: Do you want this last piece of cake or not? I'll eat it.
items.zh: 這最後一塊蛋糕你到底要不要？不要我就吃了。

items.en: Can you fix the computer or not? I need it for work.
items.zh: 你到底能不能修好電腦？我工作要用。

items.en: Is he coming to the meeting or not? We can't wait all day.
items.zh: 他到底要不要來開會？我們不能等一整天。

items.en: Did you read my email or not? You haven't answered.
items.zh: 你到底有沒有看我的信？你都沒回。

examples.heading: ④ or not：問清楚一件事

items.en: Is breakfast included in the price or not?（被動）
items.zh: 早餐到底有沒有包含在價錢裡？

items.en: Do we need to bring our passports or not?
items.zh: 我們到底需不需要帶護照？

items.en: Is it going to rain tomorrow or not? I want to plan the picnic.
items.zh: 明天到底會不會下雨？我想安排野餐。

items.en: Are pets allowed in the flat or not?（被動）
items.zh: 那間公寓到底可不可以養寵物？

items.en: Should I bring a present or not? I don't know them very well.
items.zh: 我到底該不該帶禮物？我跟他們不太熟。

examples.heading: ⑤ 加上稱呼

items.en: Tom, are you coming or not? We're leaving.
items.zh: Tom，你到底要不要來？我們要走了。

items.en: Kids, are you getting up or not? It's half past seven.
items.zh: 孩子們，你們到底要不要起床？已經七點半了。

examples.heading: ⑥ whether or not 和 if ... or not

items.en: I don't know whether or not he passed the exam.
items.zh: 我不知道他考試有沒有及格。

items.en: Tell me if you're coming or not by Friday.
items.zh: 星期五之前告訴我你到底要不要來。

items.en: I'm not sure whether or not the museum is open on Mondays.
items.zh: 我不確定博物館星期一有沒有開。

items.en: Let me know if you want a ticket or not.
items.zh: 告訴我你到底要不要票。

items.en: I can't tell whether the milk is fresh or not. Can you smell it?
items.zh: 我分不出這牛奶到底新不新鮮。你可以聞聞看嗎？

items.en: Can you check if the train is on time or not?
items.zh: 你可以查一下火車到底有沒有準時嗎？

title: Shall we buy him a book, a CD or something else?
translation: 我們要買書、CD，還是別的東西給他？
name: or something else 選擇疑問句
sentences: It's Ben's birthday next week. Shall we buy him a book, a CD or something else?
I'm going to the café. Do you want a coffee, a tea or something else?
What's wrong with your car? Is it the battery or something else?
You look upset. Are you tired, or is it something else?
For dessert, would you like ice cream or something else?
You said you're at university now. Are you studying law, medicine or something else?
Is that noise the washing machine or something else?
Shall I make pasta for dinner, or would you like something else?
Do you need paper, pens or something else for the meeting?
You didn't buy the flat. Was the problem the price or something else?
Poetry, history or something else? What kind of books do you like?
Red wine, white wine or something else?
Chicken, fish or something else? I'm ordering for everyone.
Football or something else? Which sport do you play?
Shall we watch a film tonight or do something else?
Do you want to go swimming or do something else this afternoon?
Should I wait for the bus or try something else?
Should we ask Tom or someone else to help with the move?
Is your mum picking you up, or someone else?
Did you write this yourself, or did someone else help you?
Do you want to sit with me or someone else on the bus?
Do you want to eat here or somewhere else?
Are you going to Spain again this summer, or somewhere else?
Shall we meet at the station or somewhere else?
Is the party at your house or somewhere else?
After school, do you want to go to university, find a job or do something else?
Are you going to take the train, drive or do something else?
For the class party, should we cook, order food or do something else?
"Is it for a present, or something else?" "It's a present for my sister."
"Are you here for the job interview, or something else?" "The interview, yes."
"Would you like the soup, the salad or something else to start?" "The soup, please."

examples.heading: ① 名詞片語 + or something else

items.en: It's Ben's birthday next week. Shall we buy him a book, a CD or something else?
items.zh: 下星期是 Ben 的生日。我們要買書、CD，還是別的東西給他？

items.en: I'm going to the café. Do you want a coffee, a tea or something else?
items.zh: 我要去咖啡店。你要咖啡、茶，還是別的？

items.en: What's wrong with your car? Is it the battery or something else?
items.zh: 你的車怎麼了？是電池的問題還是別的？

items.en: You look upset. Are you tired, or is it something else?
items.zh: 你看起來不太開心。你是累了，還是有別的事？

items.en: For dessert, would you like ice cream or something else?
items.zh: 甜點你要冰淇淋還是別的？

items.en: You said you're at university now. Are you studying law, medicine or something else?
items.zh: 你說你現在在念大學。你念的是法律、醫學，還是別的？

items.en: Is that noise the washing machine or something else?
items.zh: 那個聲音是洗衣機，還是別的東西？

items.en: Shall I make pasta for dinner, or would you like something else?
items.zh: 晚餐我煮義大利麵好嗎？還是你想吃別的？

items.en: Do you need paper, pens or something else for the meeting?
items.zh: 開會你需要紙、筆，還是別的東西？

items.en: You didn't buy the flat. Was the problem the price or something else?
items.zh: 你沒買那間公寓。問題是價錢，還是別的？

examples.heading: ② 簡短的問句

items.en: Poetry, history or something else? What kind of books do you like?
items.zh: 詩、歷史，還是別的？你喜歡哪一種書？

items.en: Red wine, white wine or something else?
items.zh: 紅酒、白酒，還是別的？

items.en: Chicken, fish or something else? I'm ordering for everyone.
items.zh: 雞肉、魚，還是別的？我幫大家點。

items.en: Football or something else? Which sport do you play?
items.zh: 足球還是別的？你玩哪一種運動？

examples.heading: ③ 動詞片語 + or something else

items.en: Shall we watch a film tonight or do something else?
items.zh: 我們今晚要看電影，還是做點別的？

items.en: Do you want to go swimming or do something else this afternoon?
items.zh: 你今天下午想去游泳，還是做點別的？

items.en: Should I wait for the bus or try something else?
items.zh: 我該等公車，還是想別的辦法？

examples.heading: ④ or someone else

items.en: Should we ask Tom or someone else to help with the move?
items.zh: 我們搬家要找 Tom 幫忙，還是找別人？

items.en: Is your mum picking you up, or someone else?
items.zh: 是你媽媽來接你，還是別人？

items.en: Did you write this yourself, or did someone else help you?
items.zh: 這是你自己寫的，還是有別人幫你？

items.en: Do you want to sit with me or someone else on the bus?
items.zh: 在公車上你要跟我坐，還是跟別人坐？

examples.heading: ⑤ or somewhere else

items.en: Do you want to eat here or somewhere else?
items.zh: 你要在這裡吃還是去別的地方？

items.en: Are you going to Spain again this summer, or somewhere else?
items.zh: 你今年夏天又要去西班牙，還是去別的地方？

items.en: Shall we meet at the station or somewhere else?
items.zh: 我們要在車站見面，還是在別的地方？

items.en: Is the party at your house or somewhere else?
items.zh: 派對在你家，還是在別的地方？

examples.heading: ⑥ 問對方的計畫

items.en: After school, do you want to go to university, find a job or do something else?
items.zh: 畢業以後，你想上大學、找工作，還是做別的？

items.en: Are you going to take the train, drive or do something else?
items.zh: 你要搭火車、開車，還是用別的方式？

items.en: For the class party, should we cook, order food or do something else?
items.zh: 班級派對我們要自己煮、叫外送，還是做別的安排？

examples.heading: ⑦ 店員和服務生的問句

items.en: "Is it for a present, or something else?" "It's a present for my sister."
items.zh: 這是要送人的，還是有別的用途？是要送給我妹妹的禮物。

items.en: "Are you here for the job interview, or something else?" "The interview, yes."
items.zh: 你是來面試的，還是有別的事？對，是來面試的。

items.en: "Would you like the soup, the salad or something else to start?" "The soup, please."
items.zh: 前菜您要湯、沙拉，還是別的？湯，謝謝。

title: You asked me for some help, right?
translation: 你有請我幫忙，對吧？
name: right 當非正式附加問句
sentences: You're moving this weekend. You asked me for some help, right?
You're fourteen years old, right? Then you can join the junior team.
I'm getting ready now. The barbecue starts at eight, right?
You said you liked shopping for clothes, right? Let's go to the market.
They're black, right? I want to buy the same ones.
I'm outside your building. Your flat is on the third floor, right?
I'm leaving the house now. We're meeting at the station, right?
You've got my number, right? Call me if you get lost.
Excuse me, I'm new here. This is the bus to the city centre, right?
You studied in London, right? What was it like?
Let's go on Sunday. The museum is free on Sundays, right?
You can swim, right? The water is quite deep here.
Have a good time at the party. You'll be home by ten, right?
You don't eat meat, right? I'll order a vegetable pizza.
Don't tell me the ending! You haven't seen this film yet, right?
Let's walk to the beach. It isn't far from here, right?
Dad looks very calm. You didn't tell him about the party, right?
We don't need tickets for the concert, right? It's free.
She can't come tomorrow, right? She's working.
I think you asked if I liked shopping for clothes, right?
I think the shop closes at six, right?
I think we turn left here, right?
So I add the eggs after the flour, right?
So you want me to send it today, right?
Let me check. You need two tickets for Friday, right?
So the answer is twelve, right?
Hi Sam! You're still coming on Saturday, right?
You got my email, right? Let me know what you think.
We said seven o'clock, right? See you then!
You remember Lucy, right? She's coming to stay with us.
That was a great weekend, right? Let's do it again soon.

examples.heading: ① 肯定的直述句 + right

items.en: You're moving this weekend. You asked me for some help, right?
items.zh: 你這個週末要搬家。你有請我幫忙，對吧？

items.en: You're fourteen years old, right? Then you can join the junior team.
items.zh: 你十四歲，對吧？那你可以參加少年隊。

items.en: I'm getting ready now. The barbecue starts at eight, right?
items.zh: 我現在在準備。烤肉八點開始，對吧？

items.en: You said you liked shopping for clothes, right? Let's go to the market.
items.zh: 你說過你喜歡買衣服，對吧？我們去市集吧。

items.en: They're black, right? I want to buy the same ones.
items.zh: 那雙是黑色的，對吧？我想買一樣的。

items.en: I'm outside your building. Your flat is on the third floor, right?
items.zh: 我在你家大樓外面。你的公寓在三樓，對吧？

items.en: I'm leaving the house now. We're meeting at the station, right?
items.zh: 我現在要出門了。我們在車站見面，對吧？

items.en: You've got my number, right? Call me if you get lost.
items.zh: 你有我的號碼，對吧？迷路的話打給我。

items.en: Excuse me, I'm new here. This is the bus to the city centre, right?
items.zh: 不好意思，我第一次來。這是去市中心的公車，對吧？

items.en: You studied in London, right? What was it like?
items.zh: 你在倫敦念過書，對吧？那裡怎麼樣？

items.en: Let's go on Sunday. The museum is free on Sundays, right?
items.zh: 我們星期天去吧。博物館星期天免費，對吧？

items.en: You can swim, right? The water is quite deep here.
items.zh: 你會游泳，對吧？這裡的水滿深的。

items.en: Have a good time at the party. You'll be home by ten, right?
items.zh: 派對玩得開心點。你十點以前會到家，對吧？

examples.heading: ② 否定的直述句 + right

items.en: You don't eat meat, right? I'll order a vegetable pizza.
items.zh: 你不吃肉，對吧？我點蔬菜披薩。

items.en: Don't tell me the ending! You haven't seen this film yet, right?
items.zh: 別告訴我結局！你還沒看過這部電影，對吧？

items.en: Let's walk to the beach. It isn't far from here, right?
items.zh: 我們走路去海灘吧。從這裡過去不遠，對吧？

items.en: Dad looks very calm. You didn't tell him about the party, right?
items.zh: 爸爸看起來很平靜。你沒跟他說派對的事，對吧？

items.en: We don't need tickets for the concert, right? It's free.
items.zh: 那場音樂會不用票，對吧？是免費的。

items.en: She can't come tomorrow, right? She's working.
items.zh: 她明天不能來，對吧？她要上班。

examples.heading: ③ I think + 子句 + right

items.en: I think you asked if I liked shopping for clothes, right?
items.zh: 我想你是問我喜不喜歡買衣服，對吧？

items.en: I think the shop closes at six, right?
items.zh: 我想那家店六點關門，對吧？

items.en: I think we turn left here, right?
items.zh: 我想我們在這裡左轉，對吧？

examples.heading: ④ 確認聽懂了

items.en: So I add the eggs after the flour, right?
items.zh: 所以我是在麵粉之後加蛋，對吧？

items.en: So you want me to send it today, right?
items.zh: 所以你要我今天寄出去，對吧？

items.en: Let me check. You need two tickets for Friday, right?
items.zh: 我確認一下。你要兩張星期五的票，對吧？

items.en: So the answer is twelve, right?
items.zh: 所以答案是十二，對吧？

examples.heading: ⑤ 訊息和非正式的信

items.en: Hi Sam! You're still coming on Saturday, right?
items.zh: 嗨 Sam！你星期六還是會來，對吧？

items.en: You got my email, right? Let me know what you think.
items.zh: 你收到我的電子郵件了，對吧？告訴我你的想法。

items.en: We said seven o'clock, right? See you then!
items.zh: 我們說好七點，對吧？到時候見！

items.en: You remember Lucy, right? She's coming to stay with us.
items.zh: 你記得 Lucy，對吧？她要來我們家住。

items.en: That was a great weekend, right? Let's do it again soon.
items.zh: 那個週末超好玩的，對吧？我們很快再來一次吧。

title: Is this new industry a blessing for the region or the exact opposite?
translation: 這個新產業對這個地區是福氣，還是正好相反？
name: 用極端選項的選擇疑問句
sentences: The new factory brings jobs but also pollution. Is this new industry a blessing for the region or the exact opposite?
Everyone is talking about the new shopping centre. Will it help small shops or do the exact opposite?
Are mobile phones bringing families closer or doing the complete opposite?
The council says the new road will reduce traffic. Will it, or will it do the exact opposite?
Is homework helping children learn, or is it doing the exact opposite?
Is the internet a useful tool for students or a waste of time?
Is this new law a step forward or a disaster for workers?
Was the trip a holiday or a punishment? It rained every day.
Is tourism good news for the island or the beginning of the end?
Is this diet healthy or simply dangerous?
Are video games a harmless hobby or a serious problem?
Is the new stadium a gift to the city or a huge mistake?
Is working from home freeing us or trapping us?
Is fast fashion making life easier or harder for young people?
Are the new rules fair or completely unfair?
Is the city becoming safer or more dangerous at night?
Is the plan brilliant or crazy? I honestly can't tell.
Do you call this a meal or a snack? I'm still hungry.
Is this a hotel room or a cupboard? There's no space at all.
My brother keeps moving the boxes around. Is he helping us or making things worse?
Is this a car or a piece of junk? It breaks down every week.
You laughed at my new haircut. Was that a joke or an insult?
Is a university degree still a good investment or a waste of money?
Has the internet made us better informed or more confused?
Is nuclear power the answer to climate change or a new danger?
Are school uniforms useful or a waste of money for parents?
Do exams show what students know, or do they show nothing at all?
Is the new airport a blessing or a curse? In my opinion, it is both.
Is social media connecting people or isolating them? I believe it does both.
Are zoos protecting animals or doing the exact opposite? I think good zoos protect them.
Is the four-day week a dream or a disaster for small companies? Let us look at the facts.

examples.heading: ① 選項 A + or the exact opposite / the complete opposite

items.en: The new factory brings jobs but also pollution. Is this new industry a blessing for the region or the exact opposite?
items.zh: 新工廠帶來工作，也帶來污染。這個新產業對這個地區是福氣，還是正好相反？

items.en: Everyone is talking about the new shopping centre. Will it help small shops or do the exact opposite?
items.zh: 大家都在談新的購物中心。它會幫助小商店，還是正好相反？

items.en: Are mobile phones bringing families closer or doing the complete opposite?
items.zh: 手機讓家人更親近，還是正好相反？

items.en: The council says the new road will reduce traffic. Will it, or will it do the exact opposite?
items.zh: 市議會說新的道路會減少車流。真的會嗎？還是會正好相反？

items.en: Is homework helping children learn, or is it doing the exact opposite?
items.zh: 功課是在幫孩子學習，還是正好相反？

examples.heading: ② 選項 A + or + 很糟的選項

items.en: Is the internet a useful tool for students or a waste of time?
items.zh: 網路對學生來說是有用的工具，還是浪費時間？

items.en: Is this new law a step forward or a disaster for workers?
items.zh: 這條新法律對勞工來說是進步，還是一場災難？

items.en: Was the trip a holiday or a punishment? It rained every day.
items.zh: 這趟旅行是度假還是處罰？每天都在下雨。

items.en: Is tourism good news for the island or the beginning of the end?
items.zh: 觀光業對這座島來說是好消息，還是末日的開始？

items.en: Is this diet healthy or simply dangerous?
items.zh: 這種飲食法健康，還是根本很危險？

items.en: Are video games a harmless hobby or a serious problem?
items.zh: 電子遊戲是無害的嗜好，還是嚴重的問題？

items.en: Is the new stadium a gift to the city or a huge mistake?
items.zh: 新的體育場是給這座城市的禮物，還是一個大錯誤？

examples.heading: ③ 選項 A + or + 完全相反的形容詞或動詞

items.en: Is working from home freeing us or trapping us?
items.zh: 在家工作是讓我們更自由，還是把我們困住？

items.en: Is fast fashion making life easier or harder for young people?
items.zh: 快時尚讓年輕人的生活更輕鬆，還是更辛苦？

items.en: Are the new rules fair or completely unfair?
items.zh: 新的規定公平，還是完全不公平？

items.en: Is the city becoming safer or more dangerous at night?
items.zh: 這座城市晚上變得更安全，還是更危險？

items.en: Is the plan brilliant or crazy? I honestly can't tell.
items.zh: 這個計畫是很聰明，還是很瘋狂？我真的看不出來。

examples.heading: ④ 說話時表示懷疑

items.en: Do you call this a meal or a snack? I'm still hungry.
items.zh: 你說這是一頓飯還是點心？我還很餓。

items.en: Is this a hotel room or a cupboard? There's no space at all.
items.zh: 這是飯店房間還是櫃子？一點空間都沒有。

items.en: My brother keeps moving the boxes around. Is he helping us or making things worse?
items.zh: 我弟弟一直把箱子搬來搬去。他是在幫我們，還是讓事情更糟？

items.en: Is this a car or a piece of junk? It breaks down every week.
items.zh: 這是車還是廢鐵？每個星期都會拋錨。

items.en: You laughed at my new haircut. Was that a joke or an insult?
items.zh: 你笑我的新髮型。那是開玩笑還是侮辱？

examples.heading: ⑤ 報告和文章的開頭

items.en: Is a university degree still a good investment or a waste of money?
items.zh: 大學學位仍然是好的投資，還是浪費錢？

items.en: Has the internet made us better informed or more confused?
items.zh: 網路讓我們知道得更多，還是更困惑？

items.en: Is nuclear power the answer to climate change or a new danger?
items.zh: 核能是氣候變遷的解答，還是新的危險？

items.en: Are school uniforms useful or a waste of money for parents?
items.zh: 學校制服有用，還是讓家長浪費錢？

items.en: Do exams show what students know, or do they show nothing at all?
items.zh: 考試能顯示學生懂多少，還是完全顯示不出什麼？

examples.heading: ⑥ 問完以後說出自己的看法

items.en: Is the new airport a blessing or a curse? In my opinion, it is both.
items.zh: 新機場是福氣還是禍害？我覺得兩者都是。

items.en: Is social media connecting people or isolating them? I believe it does both.
items.zh: 社群媒體是在連結人，還是在孤立人？我相信兩者都有。

items.en: Are zoos protecting animals or doing the exact opposite? I think good zoos protect them.
items.zh: 動物園是在保護動物，還是正好相反？我認為好的動物園是在保護牠們。

items.en: Is the four-day week a dream or a disaster for small companies? Let us look at the facts.
items.zh: 一週工作四天對小公司來說是美夢，還是災難？我們來看看事實。

title: Think about it, will you?
translation: 你考慮一下，好嗎？
name: 祈使句後加附加問句表示委婉
sentences: You don't have to decide now. Think about it, will you?
It's cold in here. Close the window, will you?
Take the route by Lake Frene, will you? It's much quicker.
This soup needs something. Pass me the salt, will you?
Keep an eye on my bag, will you? I'll be back in a minute.
Turn the music down, will you? The baby is asleep.
It's late and the roads are icy. Call me when you get home, will you?
I need to find my keys. Hold this for a moment, would you?
I didn't take any pictures. Send me the photos from the trip, would you?
Wait here for a minute, could you? I need to buy a ticket.
Help me with these boxes, could you? They're very heavy.
Give this letter to your mother, would you?
We've run out of milk. Get some on the way home, can you?
Feed the cat while I'm away, can you?
Check your email tonight, can you? I've sent you the plan.
Come in and sit down, won't you?
Have another piece of cake, won't you?
Stay for dinner, won't you? There's plenty of food.
Come and visit us in the summer, won't you?
I'm not sure the numbers are right. Let's check together, shall we?
Let's go for a walk after lunch, shall we?
We've been working for three hours. Let's take a short break, shall we?
We both want the best for the kids. Let's not shout at each other, shall we?
Let's start with the easy questions, shall we?
Let's meet at the café, shall we? It's closer for you.
Don't be late, will you? The train leaves at six.
You're the last one to leave. Don't forget to lock the door, will you?
I haven't told my parents yet. Don't tell anyone about this, will you?
Don't touch the paint, will you? It's still wet.
Be quiet, will you? I'm trying to work.
Hurry up, will you? We're going to miss the bus.

examples.heading: ① 祈使句 + will you?

items.en: You don't have to decide now. Think about it, will you?
items.zh: 你不用現在決定。你考慮一下，好嗎？

items.en: It's cold in here. Close the window, will you?
items.zh: 這裡好冷。把窗戶關上，好嗎？

items.en: Take the route by Lake Frene, will you? It's much quicker.
items.zh: 走 Frene 湖那條路，好嗎？快多了。

items.en: This soup needs something. Pass me the salt, will you?
items.zh: 這湯好像少了點什麼。把鹽遞給我，好嗎？

items.en: Keep an eye on my bag, will you? I'll be back in a minute.
items.zh: 幫我看一下包包，好嗎？我馬上回來。

items.en: Turn the music down, will you? The baby is asleep.
items.zh: 把音樂關小聲，好嗎？寶寶在睡覺。

items.en: It's late and the roads are icy. Call me when you get home, will you?
items.zh: 很晚了，路上又結冰。你到家打給我，好嗎？

examples.heading: ② 祈使句 + would you? / could you?

items.en: I need to find my keys. Hold this for a moment, would you?
items.zh: 我得找一下鑰匙。幫我拿一下這個，好嗎？

items.en: I didn't take any pictures. Send me the photos from the trip, would you?
items.zh: 我一張照片都沒拍。把旅行的照片寄給我，好嗎？

items.en: Wait here for a minute, could you? I need to buy a ticket.
items.zh: 在這裡等我一下，好嗎？我得去買票。

items.en: Help me with these boxes, could you? They're very heavy.
items.zh: 幫我搬這些箱子，好嗎？很重。

items.en: Give this letter to your mother, would you?
items.zh: 把這封信交給你媽媽，好嗎？

examples.heading: ③ 祈使句 + can you?

items.en: We've run out of milk. Get some on the way home, can you?
items.zh: 牛奶喝完了。回家路上買一點，好嗎？

items.en: Feed the cat while I'm away, can you?
items.zh: 我不在的時候幫我餵貓，好嗎？

items.en: Check your email tonight, can you? I've sent you the plan.
items.zh: 今晚看一下你的電子郵件，好嗎？我把計畫寄給你了。

examples.heading: ④ 祈使句 + won't you?：邀請

items.en: Come in and sit down, won't you?
items.zh: 請進來坐吧。

items.en: Have another piece of cake, won't you?
items.zh: 再吃一塊蛋糕吧。

items.en: Stay for dinner, won't you? There's plenty of food.
items.zh: 留下來吃晚餐吧？吃的東西很多。

items.en: Come and visit us in the summer, won't you?
items.zh: 夏天來看我們吧。

examples.heading: ⑤ Let's + 原形動詞, shall we?

items.en: I'm not sure the numbers are right. Let's check together, shall we?
items.zh: 我不確定數字對不對。我們一起檢查，好嗎？

items.en: Let's go for a walk after lunch, shall we?
items.zh: 午餐後我們去散步，好嗎？

items.en: We've been working for three hours. Let's take a short break, shall we?
items.zh: 我們已經工作三個小時了。我們休息一下，好嗎？

items.en: We both want the best for the kids. Let's not shout at each other, shall we?
items.zh: 我們都想給孩子最好的。我們別再對彼此大吼了，好嗎？

items.en: Let's start with the easy questions, shall we?
items.zh: 我們先做簡單的題目，好嗎？

items.en: Let's meet at the café, shall we? It's closer for you.
items.zh: 我們在咖啡店見面，好嗎？離你比較近。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定的祈使句 + will you?

items.en: Don't be late, will you? The train leaves at six.
items.zh: 別遲到，好嗎？火車六點開。

items.en: You're the last one to leave. Don't forget to lock the door, will you?
items.zh: 你是最後一個走的。別忘了鎖門，好嗎？

items.en: I haven't told my parents yet. Don't tell anyone about this, will you?
items.zh: 我還沒跟我爸媽說。這件事別告訴任何人，好嗎？

items.en: Don't touch the paint, will you? It's still wet.
items.zh: 別碰油漆，好嗎？還沒乾。

examples.heading: ⑦ 說話者不耐煩時

items.en: Be quiet, will you? I'm trying to work.
items.zh: 安靜一點好嗎？我在工作。

items.en: Hurry up, will you? We're going to miss the bus.
items.zh: 快一點好嗎？我們要錯過公車了。

title: Who are you going with?
translation: 你要跟誰一起去？
name: wh- 疑問句的助動詞 be
sentences: I heard you have tickets for the concert. Who are you going with?
You've been texting all evening. Who are you sending messages to?
Your sister has been at the window for an hour. Who is she waiting for?
Who were you dancing with at the party?
You've got your coat on. Where are you going?
I'd love to visit you in Rome. Where are you living now?
Where is your brother working now?
Where were you hiding? We looked everywhere.
We miss you. When are you coming here?
I need to book time off work. When is your sister getting married?
When are they moving to the new house?
What are you reading? Is it good?
What are you cooking? It smells wonderful.
What is he looking for under the table?
The police want to know. What were you doing when you heard the crash?
You've got paint on your hands. What are you making in the garage?
Why are you laughing? Is there something on my face?
I've just fed her. Why is the baby crying again?
Why were you standing outside in the rain?
Why are they building a wall there?
How are you feeling today? Better?
How is your new course going?
There's a train strike tomorrow. How are you getting to work?
Your suitcase is huge. How long are you going away for?
What are you looking at? There's nothing there.
Tom has been at his desk all evening with a pen. Who is he writing to?
What are you worrying about?
You're covered in mud. Where are you coming from?
You were carrying a big box on the bus. Where were you taking it?
What was she saying when I came in?
Why was he running so fast?

examples.heading: ① Who + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: I heard you have tickets for the concert. Who are you going with?
items.zh: 我聽說你有演唱會的票。你要跟誰一起去？

items.en: You've been texting all evening. Who are you sending messages to?
items.zh: 你整晚都在傳訊息。你在傳給誰？

items.en: Your sister has been at the window for an hour. Who is she waiting for?
items.zh: 你姊姊在窗邊站了一個小時。她在等誰？

items.en: Who were you dancing with at the party?
items.zh: 你在派對上跟誰跳舞？

examples.heading: ② Where + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: You've got your coat on. Where are you going?
items.zh: 你穿上外套了。你要去哪裡？

items.en: I'd love to visit you in Rome. Where are you living now?
items.zh: 我很想去羅馬看你。你現在住在哪裡？

items.en: Where is your brother working now?
items.zh: 你哥哥現在在哪裡工作？

items.en: Where were you hiding? We looked everywhere.
items.zh: 你剛剛躲在哪裡？我們到處找。

examples.heading: ③ When + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: We miss you. When are you coming here?
items.zh: 我們很想你。你什麼時候要來這裡？

items.en: I need to book time off work. When is your sister getting married?
items.zh: 我得跟公司請假。你姊姊什麼時候結婚？

items.en: When are they moving to the new house?
items.zh: 他們什麼時候搬去新房子？

examples.heading: ④ What + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: What are you reading? Is it good?
items.zh: 你在讀什麼？好看嗎？

items.en: What are you cooking? It smells wonderful.
items.zh: 你在煮什麼？聞起來好香。

items.en: What is he looking for under the table?
items.zh: 他在桌子底下找什麼？

items.en: The police want to know. What were you doing when you heard the crash?
items.zh: 警察想知道。你聽到撞擊聲的時候在做什麼？

items.en: You've got paint on your hands. What are you making in the garage?
items.zh: 你手上有油漆。你在車庫裡做什麼東西？

examples.heading: ⑤ Why + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: Why are you laughing? Is there something on my face?
items.zh: 你為什麼在笑？我臉上有東西嗎？

items.en: I've just fed her. Why is the baby crying again?
items.zh: 我剛餵過她。寶寶為什麼又在哭？

items.en: Why were you standing outside in the rain?
items.zh: 你剛剛為什麼站在外面淋雨？

items.en: Why are they building a wall there?
items.zh: 他們為什麼在那裡蓋一道牆？

examples.heading: ⑥ How + be + 主詞 + 動詞-ing

items.en: How are you feeling today? Better?
items.zh: 你今天覺得怎麼樣？好一點了嗎？

items.en: How is your new course going?
items.zh: 你的新課程進行得怎麼樣？

items.en: There's a train strike tomorrow. How are you getting to work?
items.zh: 明天火車罷工。你要怎麼去上班？

items.en: Your suitcase is huge. How long are you going away for?
items.zh: 你的行李箱好大。你要出門多久？

examples.heading: ⑦ 介系詞放在句尾

items.en: What are you looking at? There's nothing there.
items.zh: 你在看什麼？那裡什麼都沒有。

items.en: Tom has been at his desk all evening with a pen. Who is he writing to?
items.zh: Tom 拿著筆在書桌前坐了一整晚。他在寫信給誰？

items.en: What are you worrying about?
items.zh: 你在擔心什麼？

items.en: You're covered in mud. Where are you coming from?
items.zh: 你全身都是泥巴。你從哪裡回來的？

examples.heading: ⑧ 過去進行式：was / were

items.en: You were carrying a big box on the bus. Where were you taking it?
items.zh: 你在公車上抱著一個大箱子。你要把它拿去哪裡？

items.en: What was she saying when I came in?
items.zh: 我進來的時候她在說什麼？

items.en: Why was he running so fast?
items.zh: 他剛剛為什麼跑那麼快？

title: What did you do yesterday?
translation: 你昨天做了什麼？
name: wh- 疑問句的助動詞 do
sentences: You didn't answer my messages all weekend. What did you do yesterday?
I want to paint my room blue. What do you think?
What does your sister do? Is she a nurse?
You were at the dentist for two hours. What did she do to your tooth?
What do you usually have for breakfast?
We need to leave soon. What time does the match kick off?
You look very brown. Where did you go on holiday?
Where do you live? Is it near the school?
Where does this bus go?
I love your scarf. Where did you get it?
There's no space outside the office. Where do your colleagues leave their cars?
Welcome to England! When did you arrive in London?
I need to buy a present tomorrow. When does the bookshop close on Saturdays?
You play the violin so well. When did you first pick it up?
I can pick you up later. When do you finish work today?
You never told me about him. How do you know?
The roads are full of snow. How did you drive here in this weather?
I've never used a coffee machine like this. How does it work?
How do you say "thank you" in Japanese?
You two look so happy. How did you and your wife first meet?
You were gone by nine. Why did you leave the party so early?
Why does the baby cry every night?
Why do you want to study medicine?
We're in the middle of nowhere. Why did the train stop?
You love that jacket. Why don't you buy it?
Why don't you ask your teacher for help?
Everyone is bored. Why don't we play a board game?
You were at the school reunion last night. Who did you chat with?
Who do you want to invite to your birthday?
I saw you outside the cinema. Who did you go with?
Who does your little brother look like, your mum or your dad?

examples.heading: ① What + do / does / did

items.en: You didn't answer my messages all weekend. What did you do yesterday?
items.zh: 你整個週末都沒回我訊息。你昨天做了什麼？

items.en: I want to paint my room blue. What do you think?
items.zh: 我想把房間漆成藍色。你覺得呢？

items.en: What does your sister do? Is she a nurse?
items.zh: 你姊姊是做什麼的？她是護理師嗎？

items.en: You were at the dentist for two hours. What did she do to your tooth?
items.zh: 你在牙醫那裡待了兩個小時。她對你的牙齒做了什麼？

items.en: What do you usually have for breakfast?
items.zh: 你早餐通常吃什麼？

items.en: We need to leave soon. What time does the match kick off?
items.zh: 我們得快點出發了。比賽幾點開打？

examples.heading: ② Where + do / does / did

items.en: You look very brown. Where did you go on holiday?
items.zh: 你曬得好黑。你去哪裡度假？

items.en: Where do you live? Is it near the school?
items.zh: 你住哪裡？離學校近嗎？

items.en: Where does this bus go?
items.zh: 這班公車開到哪裡？

items.en: I love your scarf. Where did you get it?
items.zh: 我好喜歡你的圍巾。你在哪裡買的？

items.en: There's no space outside the office. Where do your colleagues leave their cars?
items.zh: 辦公室外面沒有空位。你的同事都把車停在哪裡？

examples.heading: ③ When + do / does / did

items.en: Welcome to England! When did you arrive in London?
items.zh: 歡迎來英國！你什麼時候到倫敦的？

items.en: I need to buy a present tomorrow. When does the bookshop close on Saturdays?
items.zh: 我明天得買禮物。那家書店星期六幾點關門？

items.en: You play the violin so well. When did you first pick it up?
items.zh: 你小提琴拉得真好。你什麼時候開始拉的？

items.en: I can pick you up later. When do you finish work today?
items.zh: 我晚點可以去接你。你今天幾點下班？

examples.heading: ④ How + do / does / did

items.en: You never told me about him. How do you know?
items.zh: 你從來沒跟我說過他的事。你怎麼知道的？

items.en: The roads are full of snow. How did you drive here in this weather?
items.zh: 路上都是雪。這種天氣你是怎麼開車過來的？

items.en: I've never used a coffee machine like this. How does it work?
items.zh: 我從來沒用過這種咖啡機。它怎麼用？

items.en: How do you say "thank you" in Japanese?
items.zh: 謝謝的日文怎麼說？

items.en: You two look so happy. How did you and your wife first meet?
items.zh: 你們兩個看起來好幸福。你跟你太太是怎麼認識的？

examples.heading: ⑤ Why + do / does / did

items.en: You were gone by nine. Why did you leave the party so early?
items.zh: 你九點就不見了。你為什麼那麼早離開派對？

items.en: Why does the baby cry every night?
items.zh: 寶寶為什麼每天晚上都哭？

items.en: Why do you want to study medicine?
items.zh: 你為什麼想念醫學？

items.en: We're in the middle of nowhere. Why did the train stop?
items.zh: 我們在荒郊野外。火車為什麼停了？

examples.heading: ⑥ Why don't you / Why don't we：建議

items.en: You love that jacket. Why don't you buy it?
items.zh: 你很愛那件外套。你何不買下來？

items.en: Why don't you ask your teacher for help?
items.zh: 你何不請老師幫忙？

items.en: Everyone is bored. Why don't we play a board game?
items.zh: 大家都很無聊。我們何不玩個桌遊？

examples.heading: ⑦ Who + do / did（受詞）

items.en: You were at the school reunion last night. Who did you chat with?
items.zh: 你昨晚去了同學會。你跟誰聊了天？

items.en: Who do you want to invite to your birthday?
items.zh: 你生日想邀請誰？

items.en: I saw you outside the cinema. Who did you go with?
items.zh: 我在電影院外面看到你。你跟誰去的？

items.en: Who does your little brother look like, your mum or your dad?
items.zh: 你弟弟長得像誰，你媽媽還是你爸爸？

title: What have you brought for me?
translation: 你帶了什麼東西給我？
name: wh- 疑問句的助動詞 have
sentences: Uncle Mark, you're back! What have you brought for me?
The kitchen is a mess. What have you done?
What has happened to your arm? Did you fall?
They want an answer by Friday. What have you decided about the job in Paris?
What has she said to make you so angry?
You're three hours late. Where have you been?
Where have I put my glasses? I had them a minute ago.
Where has Dad gone? His car isn't here.
Where have you travelled in Europe?
I haven't seen you for ages. How have you been?
How has your new job been so far?
You know every street here. How long have you lived in this town?
Your passport is full of stamps. How many countries have you been to?
How much have you spent on the wedding?
Who has eaten my sandwich? It was on the table.
I need to know how much food to buy. Who have you invited to the party?
Which books have you read this year?
Why have you turned off the heating? It's freezing.
It's nearly midnight. Why haven't the children gone to bed?
You speak French so well. Where had you lived before you came to London?
What had he done to make her so upset?
How long had you waited when the bus finally came?
Why had nobody told her about the meeting?
Which countries had you visited before that trip?
Where's he gone? He was here a minute ago.
What's she done to her hair? It looks great.
My charger isn't on my desk. Who's borrowed it?
How have things changed since you moved to the city?
What have you learned from this experience?
How much has the town changed since you were a child?
What have you enjoyed most about the course?

examples.heading: ① What + have / has + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: Uncle Mark, you're back! What have you brought for me?
items.zh: Mark 叔叔，你回來了！你帶了什麼東西給我？

items.en: The kitchen is a mess. What have you done?
items.zh: 廚房一團亂。你做了什麼？

items.en: What has happened to your arm? Did you fall?
items.zh: 你的手臂怎麼了？你跌倒了嗎？

items.en: They want an answer by Friday. What have you decided about the job in Paris?
items.zh: 他們星期五前要答覆。巴黎那份工作你決定得怎麼樣了？

items.en: What has she said to make you so angry?
items.zh: 她說了什麼讓你這麼生氣？

examples.heading: ② Where + have / has + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: You're three hours late. Where have you been?
items.zh: 你遲到了三個小時。你去哪裡了？

items.en: Where have I put my glasses? I had them a minute ago.
items.zh: 我把眼鏡放到哪裡去了？我剛剛還戴著。

items.en: Where has Dad gone? His car isn't here.
items.zh: 爸爸去哪裡了？他的車不在這裡。

items.en: Where have you travelled in Europe?
items.zh: 你在歐洲去過哪些地方？

examples.heading: ③ How + have / has + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: I haven't seen you for ages. How have you been?
items.zh: 好久不見。你最近好嗎？

items.en: How has your new job been so far?
items.zh: 你的新工作到目前為止怎麼樣？

items.en: You know every street here. How long have you lived in this town?
items.zh: 你對這裡每條街都很熟。你在這個鎮住多久了？

items.en: Your passport is full of stamps. How many countries have you been to?
items.zh: 你的護照蓋滿了章。你去過幾個國家？

items.en: How much have you spent on the wedding?
items.zh: 你在婚禮上花了多少錢？

examples.heading: ④ Who / Which / Why + have / has

items.en: Who has eaten my sandwich? It was on the table.
items.zh: 誰吃了我的三明治？它本來在桌上。

items.en: I need to know how much food to buy. Who have you invited to the party?
items.zh: 我得知道要買多少食物。你邀請了誰來派對？

items.en: Which books have you read this year?
items.zh: 你今年讀了哪些書？

items.en: Why have you turned off the heating? It's freezing.
items.zh: 你為什麼把暖氣關了？冷死了。

items.en: It's nearly midnight. Why haven't the children gone to bed?
items.zh: 都快半夜了。孩子們為什麼還沒去睡覺？

examples.heading: ⑤ 疑問詞 + had + 主詞 + 過去分詞

items.en: You speak French so well. Where had you lived before you came to London?
items.zh: 你法文說得真好。你來倫敦之前住過哪裡？

items.en: What had he done to make her so upset?
items.zh: 他之前做了什麼讓她那麼難過？

items.en: How long had you waited when the bus finally came?
items.zh: 公車終於來的時候，你已經等了多久？

items.en: Why had nobody told her about the meeting?
items.zh: 為什麼之前都沒有人告訴她開會的事？

items.en: Which countries had you visited before that trip?
items.zh: 那趟旅行之前，你去過哪些國家？

examples.heading: ⑥ 縮寫的 has

items.en: Where's he gone? He was here a minute ago.
items.zh: 他去哪裡了？他剛剛還在這裡。

items.en: What's she done to her hair? It looks great.
items.zh: 她的頭髮做了什麼？看起來好漂亮。

items.en: My charger isn't on my desk. Who's borrowed it?
items.zh: 我的充電器不在桌上。誰借走了？

examples.heading: ⑦ 問經驗和改變

items.en: How have things changed since you moved to the city?
items.zh: 你搬到城市以後，生活有什麼改變？

items.en: What have you learned from this experience?
items.zh: 你從這次經驗學到了什麼？

items.en: How much has the town changed since you were a child?
items.zh: 跟你小時候比，這個鎮變了多少？

items.en: What have you enjoyed most about the course?
items.zh: 這門課你最喜歡哪個部分？

title: Is it cheap or expensive for you?
translation: 這對你來說算便宜還是貴？
name: 用 or 連接兩個字的選擇疑問句
sentences: You said the language course was £800. Is it cheap or expensive for you?
I'm making tea. Do you like it strong or weak?
You started at the new school today. Is your teacher strict or friendly?
I can't see the sky from here. Is it sunny or cloudy?
Was the film good or bad? I'm thinking of seeing it.
Is the water hot or cold? I want to have a shower.
I want to study at the café. Is it quiet or busy at lunchtime?
Can you bring some food or drinks for the dinner?
I'm putting the kettle on. Do you want tea or coffee after dinner?
Is the meeting on Monday or Tuesday? I've forgotten.
Would you like rice or chips with your fish?
Congratulations! Is your sister's baby a boy or a girl?
I'm going to the market. Do you want apples or oranges?
You live quite far away. Do you go to work by bus or train?
A phone is ringing on the table. Is that your phone or mine?
We're free tonight. Shall we chat or watch a film?
Shall we walk or drive to the restaurant?
The party is nearly over. Do you want to stay or leave?
You look great. Did you buy the dress or borrow it?
Are you going to cook or order a pizza tonight?
Do you want to swim or sunbathe this afternoon?
The rain has stopped. Do you want to leave now or later?
Should I call you today or tomorrow?
Is the party this Saturday or next Saturday?
You look tired. Did you get up early or late this morning?
Who's driving tonight, you or me?
There are two names on the card. Is this present for him or her?
Which do you want, this or that?
"Tea or coffee?" "Coffee, please. Black."
"Cash or card?" "Card, please."
"Window or aisle?" "Window, please. I like to look out."

examples.heading: ① 形容詞 + or + 形容詞

items.en: You said the language course was £800. Is it cheap or expensive for you?
items.zh: 你說語言課程要八百英鎊。這對你來說算便宜還是貴？

items.en: I'm making tea. Do you like it strong or weak?
items.zh: 我在泡茶。你喜歡濃的還是淡的？

items.en: You started at the new school today. Is your teacher strict or friendly?
items.zh: 你今天開始在新學校上課。你的老師是嚴格還是和善？

items.en: I can't see the sky from here. Is it sunny or cloudy?
items.zh: 我從這裡看不到天空。現在是晴天還是陰天？

items.en: Was the film good or bad? I'm thinking of seeing it.
items.zh: 那部電影好看還是不好看？我在考慮要不要去看。

items.en: Is the water hot or cold? I want to have a shower.
items.zh: 水是熱的還是冷的？我想洗澡。

items.en: I want to study at the café. Is it quiet or busy at lunchtime?
items.zh: 我想去那家咖啡店念書。那裡中午安靜還是很多人？

examples.heading: ② 名詞 + or + 名詞

items.en: Can you bring some food or drinks for the dinner?
items.zh: 晚餐你可以帶一些吃的或喝的來嗎？

items.en: I'm putting the kettle on. Do you want tea or coffee after dinner?
items.zh: 我在燒水。晚餐後你要茶還是咖啡？

items.en: Is the meeting on Monday or Tuesday? I've forgotten.
items.zh: 會議是星期一還是星期二？我忘了。

items.en: Would you like rice or chips with your fish?
items.zh: 你的魚要配飯還是薯條？

items.en: Congratulations! Is your sister's baby a boy or a girl?
items.zh: 恭喜！你姊姊的寶寶是男生還是女生？

items.en: I'm going to the market. Do you want apples or oranges?
items.zh: 我要去市場。你要蘋果還是柳橙？

items.en: You live quite far away. Do you go to work by bus or train?
items.zh: 你住得滿遠的。你搭公車還是火車上班？

items.en: A phone is ringing on the table. Is that your phone or mine?
items.zh: 桌上有支手機在響。那是你的手機還是我的？

examples.heading: ③ 動詞 + or + 動詞

items.en: We're free tonight. Shall we chat or watch a film?
items.zh: 我們今晚有空。我們要聊天還是看電影？

items.en: Shall we walk or drive to the restaurant?
items.zh: 我們要走路還是開車去餐廳？

items.en: The party is nearly over. Do you want to stay or leave?
items.zh: 派對快結束了。你要留下來還是離開？

items.en: You look great. Did you buy the dress or borrow it?
items.zh: 你好好看。那件洋裝是你買的還是借的？

items.en: Are you going to cook or order a pizza tonight?
items.zh: 你今晚要煮飯還是叫披薩？

items.en: Do you want to swim or sunbathe this afternoon?
items.zh: 你今天下午要游泳還是曬太陽？

examples.heading: ④ 副詞或時間 + or + 副詞或時間

items.en: The rain has stopped. Do you want to leave now or later?
items.zh: 雨停了。你要現在走還是晚一點？

items.en: Should I call you today or tomorrow?
items.zh: 我該今天打給你還是明天？

items.en: Is the party this Saturday or next Saturday?
items.zh: 派對是這個星期六還是下個星期六？

items.en: You look tired. Did you get up early or late this morning?
items.zh: 你看起來很累。你今天早上很早起還是很晚起？

examples.heading: ⑤ 代名詞 + or + 代名詞

items.en: Who's driving tonight, you or me?
items.zh: 今晚誰開車，你還是我？

items.en: There are two names on the card. Is this present for him or her?
items.zh: 卡片上有兩個名字。這個禮物是給他的還是給她的？

items.en: Which do you want, this or that?
items.zh: 你要哪一個，這個還是那個？

examples.heading: ⑥ 省略的選擇疑問句

items.en: "Tea or coffee?" "Coffee, please. Black."
items.zh: 茶還是咖啡？咖啡，謝謝。黑咖啡。

items.en: "Cash or card?" "Card, please."
items.zh: 現金還是刷卡？刷卡，謝謝。

items.en: "Window or aisle?" "Window, please. I like to look out."
items.zh: 靠窗還是靠走道？靠窗，謝謝。我喜歡看外面。

title: So what makes a good present? From my point of view, the best presents are personal.
translation: 那什麼樣的禮物才是好禮物呢？依我看，最好的禮物是有個人心意的禮物。
name: wh- 疑問句引出要強調的內容
sentences: Many people give presents out of habit. So what makes a good present? From my point of view, the best presents are personal.
Every student wants good marks. So what makes a good teacher? I think it's someone who listens.
Some people use apps, and others take classes. So what is the best way to learn a language? In my opinion, it's to live in the country.
So why do so many young people move to the city? The answer is simple: jobs.
Many families never talk at meals. So what can parents do? First, they can turn off the TV at dinner.
Electricity bills are going up. So how can we save energy at home? There are three easy steps.
Cars cause a lot of pollution. But what are the alternatives? Berlin, for example, has an excellent underground.
Everyone agrees that we need more parks. But where will the money come from? The council must raise taxes.
Exams are stressful. But how else can teachers check what students know? I believe projects are a good answer.
Tourism brings money. But who really gets the money? Usually it's the big hotels, not local people.
Use the coin phones, because the others need a card. What else can I tell you? There are cafés at the airport if you're hungry.
The hotel is near the beach. What else should you know? Breakfast is from seven to ten.
Bring warm clothes. What else? Oh yes, don't forget your passport.
Most teenagers sleep less than seven hours. Why is this important? Sleep affects how well we learn.
The river is getting dirtier every year. Why does this matter? Thousands of people drink its water.
Fewer children walk to school now. Why should we worry? Walking keeps them healthy.
Traffic in the city centre is terrible. How can we solve this problem? We could make public transport free.
Some classes have forty students. How can schools help students who are struggling? One answer is smaller classes.
Every year, more old houses in our town disappear. How do we protect old buildings? The first step is to list them.
Then the lights went out. What happened next? Nobody knows, because no one saw anything.
He never came back to the village. What was the reason? Some people say he was afraid.
She opened the box. And what did she find inside? A letter from her grandmother.
We waited for hours. And who arrived in the end? The same bus driver as before.
What do young people really want from a job? Our survey gives a clear answer: freedom.
So what did we learn from this project? Above all, we learned to work as a team.
Why did the company fail? I see two main reasons.
What is the biggest danger for our planet? Many scientists say it is climate change.
So who should pay for the new hospital? I believe the government should.
The bike costs a thousand pounds. Why is it worth the money? Because it will last for twenty years.
The old plan failed, and the money is almost gone. So where do we go from here? We need a new plan.
Solar panels can power a whole house. And what about the cost? It is lower than most people think.

examples.heading: ① So + wh- 疑問句 + 回答：提出自己的看法

items.en: Many people give presents out of habit. So what makes a good present? From my point of view, the best presents are personal.
items.zh: 很多人送禮物只是出於習慣。那什麼樣的禮物才是好禮物呢？依我看，最好的禮物是有個人心意的禮物。

items.en: Every student wants good marks. So what makes a good teacher? I think it's someone who listens.
items.zh: 每個學生都想拿好成績。那怎樣才算是好老師？我認為是願意聽學生說話的人。

items.en: Some people use apps, and others take classes. So what is the best way to learn a language? In my opinion, it's to live in the country.
items.zh: 有些人用應用程式，有些人去上課。那學一種語言最好的方法是什麼？我認為是住在那個國家。

items.en: So why do so many young people move to the city? The answer is simple: jobs.
items.zh: 那為什麼有那麼多年輕人搬到城市？答案很簡單：工作。

items.en: Many families never talk at meals. So what can parents do? First, they can turn off the TV at dinner.
items.zh: 很多家庭吃飯時從來不聊天。那父母可以做什麼？首先，他們可以在晚餐時關掉電視。

items.en: Electricity bills are going up. So how can we save energy at home? There are three easy steps.
items.zh: 電費一直漲。那我們在家可以怎麼省電？有三個簡單的步驟。

examples.heading: ② But + wh- 疑問句 + 回答：轉到另一個方向

items.en: Cars cause a lot of pollution. But what are the alternatives? Berlin, for example, has an excellent underground.
items.zh: 汽車造成很多污染。可是有什麼其他的選擇？舉例來說，柏林有很好的地鐵。

items.en: Everyone agrees that we need more parks. But where will the money come from? The council must raise taxes.
items.zh: 大家都同意我們需要更多公園。可是錢從哪裡來？市議會必須加稅。

items.en: Exams are stressful. But how else can teachers check what students know? I believe projects are a good answer.
items.zh: 考試讓人壓力很大。可是老師還能用什麼方法知道學生懂多少？我相信做專題是個好方法。

items.en: Tourism brings money. But who really gets the money? Usually it's the big hotels, not local people.
items.zh: 觀光業帶來收入。可是誰真的拿到這些錢？通常是大飯店，不是當地人。

examples.heading: ③ What else ... ?：在信裡轉到下一個話題

items.en: Use the coin phones, because the others need a card. What else can I tell you? There are cafés at the airport if you're hungry.
items.zh: 用投幣式的電話，因為其他的要用卡。我還能告訴你什麼呢？如果你餓了，機場有咖啡店。

items.en: The hotel is near the beach. What else should you know? Breakfast is from seven to ten.
items.zh: 飯店在海灘附近。你還應該知道什麼呢？早餐是七點到十點。

items.en: Bring warm clothes. What else? Oh yes, don't forget your passport.
items.zh: 帶保暖的衣服。還有什麼？對了，別忘了帶護照。

examples.heading: ④ Why is this important? / Why does this matter?

items.en: Most teenagers sleep less than seven hours. Why is this important? Sleep affects how well we learn.
items.zh: 大部分的青少年睡不到七個小時。這為什麼重要？睡眠會影響我們的學習。

items.en: The river is getting dirtier every year. Why does this matter? Thousands of people drink its water.
items.zh: 這條河一年比一年髒。這為什麼重要？有成千上萬的人喝這條河的水。

items.en: Fewer children walk to school now. Why should we worry? Walking keeps them healthy.
items.zh: 現在走路上學的孩子變少了。我們為什麼要擔心？走路讓他們保持健康。

examples.heading: ⑤ How can we ... ?：引出解決的方法

items.en: Traffic in the city centre is terrible. How can we solve this problem? We could make public transport free.
items.zh: 市中心的交通很糟。我們要怎麼解決這個問題？我們可以讓大眾運輸免費。

items.en: Some classes have forty students. How can schools help students who are struggling? One answer is smaller classes.
items.zh: 有些班級有四十個學生。學校要怎麼幫助跟不上的學生？其中一個答案是小班制。

items.en: Every year, more old houses in our town disappear. How do we protect old buildings? The first step is to list them.
items.zh: 我們鎮上每年都有更多老房子消失。我們要怎麼保護老建築？第一步是把它們列冊。

examples.heading: ⑥ What is the reason? / What happened next?：說故事

items.en: Then the lights went out. What happened next? Nobody knows, because no one saw anything.
items.zh: 接著燈熄了。接下來發生了什麼事？沒有人知道，因為沒有人看到任何東西。

items.en: He never came back to the village. What was the reason? Some people say he was afraid.
items.zh: 他再也沒回到那個村子。原因是什麼？有些人說他是害怕。

items.en: She opened the box. And what did she find inside? A letter from her grandmother.
items.zh: 她打開了盒子。她在裡面找到什麼？一封她奶奶寫的信。

items.en: We waited for hours. And who arrived in the end? The same bus driver as before.
items.zh: 我們等了好幾個小時。最後到的是誰？還是之前那個公車司機。

examples.heading: ⑦ 演講和報告

items.en: What do young people really want from a job? Our survey gives a clear answer: freedom.
items.zh: 年輕人真正想從工作中得到什麼？我們的調查給了明確的答案：自由。

items.en: So what did we learn from this project? Above all, we learned to work as a team.
items.zh: 那我們從這個專案學到了什麼？最重要的是，我們學會了團隊合作。

items.en: Why did the company fail? I see two main reasons.
items.zh: 這家公司為什麼會失敗？我認為有兩個主要原因。

items.en: What is the biggest danger for our planet? Many scientists say it is climate change.
items.zh: 我們的星球最大的危險是什麼？很多科學家說是氣候變遷。

items.en: So who should pay for the new hospital? I believe the government should.
items.zh: 那新醫院應該由誰出錢？我認為應該由政府出。

examples.heading: ⑧ 回答前面的疑問

items.en: The bike costs a thousand pounds. Why is it worth the money? Because it will last for twenty years.
items.zh: 這台腳踏車要一千英鎊。為什麼值得花這筆錢？因為它可以騎二十年。

items.en: The old plan failed, and the money is almost gone. So where do we go from here? We need a new plan.
items.zh: 舊計畫失敗了，錢也快用完了。那我們接下來該怎麼走？我們需要一個新的計畫。

items.en: Solar panels can power a whole house. And what about the cost? It is lower than most people think.
items.zh: 太陽能板可以供應整間房子的電。那費用呢？比大部分人想的還低。

title: They're filming part of Harry Potter at our school. Isn't that great?
translation: 他們正在我們學校拍《哈利波特》的部分場景。是不是很棒？
name: 否定疑問句徵求同意
sentences: They're filming part of Harry Potter at our school. Isn't that great?
My sister is having twins! Isn't that amazing?
Our team won the cup for the first time in fifty years. Isn't that fantastic?
I got the job at the zoo. Isn't that exciting?
My grandad is learning to use a smartphone at eighty-five. Isn't that wonderful?
Finally, two days later, I found the key in my pocket! It's funny, isn't it?
We both have the same birthday. Isn't that strange?
The cat sleeps in the dog's bed every night. Isn't that funny?
He lived next door for ten years, and we never met. Isn't that odd?
There was a concert, and I got to see Rihanna! Wasn't that awesome?
We swam with dolphins on the last day. Wasn't that lucky?
The whole class passed the exam. Wasn't that brilliant?
The bus came just as we reached the stop. Wasn't that perfect timing?
You can relax and sunbathe while you drink a cold lemonade. Wouldn't that be amazing?
We could all go camping together this summer. Wouldn't that be fun?
Imagine having a pool in the garden. Wouldn't that be lovely?
You could visit us at Christmas. Wouldn't that be nice?
We could open our own café one day. Wouldn't that be a dream?
Cooking with friends is more fun than eating out. Don't you think?
This town is more beautiful in winter. Don't you think?
Her new song is even better than the last one, don't you think?
It's a bit expensive for a sandwich, don't you think?
Our teacher looks happier this term. Don't you think?
The walls are grey and the paint is coming off. Don't you think it's time we painted the kitchen?
Look at this photo of Sam and his dad. Don't you think he looks just like his father?
We're having a barbecue on Sunday. Don't you think we should invite the new neighbours?
Smell the bread. Doesn't it smell wonderful?
Listen to the rain on the roof. Isn't it relaxing?
Look at the stars tonight. Aren't they beautiful?
Taste this soup. Doesn't it taste like Grandma's?
Feel this blanket. Isn't it soft?

examples.heading: ① 說一件事 + Isn't that great / amazing?

items.en: They're filming part of Harry Potter at our school. Isn't that great?
items.zh: 他們正在我們學校拍《哈利波特》的部分場景。是不是很棒？

items.en: My sister is having twins! Isn't that amazing?
items.zh: 我姊姊要生雙胞胎了！是不是很驚人？

items.en: Our team won the cup for the first time in fifty years. Isn't that fantastic?
items.zh: 我們隊五十年來第一次贏得冠軍。是不是很棒？

items.en: I got the job at the zoo. Isn't that exciting?
items.zh: 我拿到動物園的工作了。是不是很令人興奮？

items.en: My grandad is learning to use a smartphone at eighty-five. Isn't that wonderful?
items.zh: 我爺爺八十五歲在學用智慧型手機。是不是很棒？

examples.heading: ② 說一件事 + Isn't it / Isn't that funny / strange?

items.en: Finally, two days later, I found the key in my pocket! It's funny, isn't it?
items.zh: 兩天後，我終於在口袋裡找到鑰匙！很好笑，對吧？

items.en: We both have the same birthday. Isn't that strange?
items.zh: 我們兩個同一天生日。是不是很奇怪？

items.en: The cat sleeps in the dog's bed every night. Isn't that funny?
items.zh: 那隻貓每天晚上都睡在狗的床上。是不是很好笑？

items.en: He lived next door for ten years, and we never met. Isn't that odd?
items.zh: 他住在我隔壁十年了，我們從來沒見過面。是不是很怪？

examples.heading: ③ 說過去的事 + Wasn't that ...?

items.en: There was a concert, and I got to see Rihanna! Wasn't that awesome?
items.zh: 那裡有一場演唱會，我看到 Rihanna 了！是不是超棒？

items.en: We swam with dolphins on the last day. Wasn't that lucky?
items.zh: 我們最後一天和海豚一起游泳。是不是很幸運？

items.en: The whole class passed the exam. Wasn't that brilliant?
items.zh: 全班都考過了。是不是很厲害？

items.en: The bus came just as we reached the stop. Wasn't that perfect timing?
items.zh: 我們一到站公車就來了。是不是時間剛剛好？

examples.heading: ④ 想像的事 + Wouldn't that be ...?

items.en: You can relax and sunbathe while you drink a cold lemonade. Wouldn't that be amazing?
items.zh: 你可以一邊喝冰檸檬汁一邊放鬆曬太陽。那不是很棒嗎？

items.en: We could all go camping together this summer. Wouldn't that be fun?
items.zh: 我們今年夏天可以一起去露營。那不是很好玩嗎？

items.en: Imagine having a pool in the garden. Wouldn't that be lovely?
items.zh: 想像一下院子裡有個游泳池。那不是很好嗎？

items.en: You could visit us at Christmas. Wouldn't that be nice?
items.zh: 你可以聖誕節來看我們。那不是很好嗎？

items.en: We could open our own café one day. Wouldn't that be a dream?
items.zh: 我們有一天可以開自己的咖啡店。那不是夢想成真嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ 看法 + Don't you think?

items.en: Cooking with friends is more fun than eating out. Don't you think?
items.zh: 跟朋友一起煮飯比去外面吃好玩。你不覺得嗎？

items.en: This town is more beautiful in winter. Don't you think?
items.zh: 這個鎮冬天更美。你不覺得嗎？

items.en: Her new song is even better than the last one, don't you think?
items.zh: 她的新歌比上一首還好聽，你不覺得嗎？
