items.en: It's a bit expensive for a sandwich, don't you think?
items.zh: 一個三明治這樣有點貴，你不覺得嗎？

items.en: Our teacher looks happier this term. Don't you think?
items.zh: 我們老師這學期看起來比較開心。你不覺得嗎？

examples.heading: ⑥ Don't you think + 子句?

items.en: The walls are grey and the paint is coming off. Don't you think it's time we painted the kitchen?
items.zh: 牆都灰了，漆也在剝落。你不覺得我們該漆廚房了嗎？

items.en: Look at this photo of Sam and his dad. Don't you think he looks just like his father?
items.zh: 你看這張 Sam 和他爸爸的照片。你不覺得他長得跟他爸爸一模一樣嗎？

items.en: We're having a barbecue on Sunday. Don't you think we should invite the new neighbours?
items.zh: 我們星期天要烤肉。你不覺得我們應該邀請新鄰居嗎？

examples.heading: ⑦ Isn't it / Doesn't it + 動詞：請對方同意

items.en: Smell the bread. Doesn't it smell wonderful?
items.zh: 聞聞看麵包。是不是很香？

items.en: Listen to the rain on the roof. Isn't it relaxing?
items.zh: 聽屋頂上的雨聲。是不是很放鬆？

items.en: Look at the stars tonight. Aren't they beautiful?
items.zh: 你看今晚的星星。是不是很美？

items.en: Taste this soup. Doesn't it taste like Grandma's?
items.zh: 喝喝看這湯。是不是很像奶奶煮的味道？

items.en: Feel this blanket. Isn't it soft?
items.zh: 摸摸看這條毯子。是不是很軟？

title: "What's your name?" he asked.
translation: 「你叫什麼名字？」他問。
name: 直接引述（引述子句在後）
sentences: "I'll be back in an hour," she said.
"This soup is delicious," my dad said.
"I've never seen snow before," Maria said.
"We missed the last train," they said.
"Excuse me, you forgot your umbrella," the waitress said.
"It's my turn to pay," I said.
"Where do you live?" she asked.
"Can I borrow your pen?" the boy asked.
"Why is everyone so quiet?" Dad asked.
"Have you finished your homework?" my mother asked.
"Where has everybody gone?" I asked.
"Would you like to come to my party?" "Yes, I'd love to," she answered.
"How long will it take to the airport?" "About twenty minutes," the driver replied.
"I'm not sure yet which university I'll choose," he answered.
"When do you work at the café?" "Only on weekends," Sara replied.
"No, thanks, I'm full," I replied.
"Run! The dog is coming!" he shouted.
"Get off my bike!" the girl shouted.
"Don't make a sound," she whispered.
"I want my mummy!" the child cried.
"Happy birthday!" everyone shouted.
"Have I made a mistake?" I thought.
"He looks familiar," she thought.
"This is going to be a long day," I thought.
"Did I lock the door?" he asked himself.
"Why did I say that?" she asked herself.
"Is anybody home?" I asked. "In the kitchen!" my mum answered.
"Can you help me?" the old man asked. "Of course," I said.
"Where are my keys?" she asked. "On the table," he replied.
"Is this seat free?" he asked. "Sorry, it's taken," she said.
"Let's take a break," the coach said. "Great idea!" we shouted.

examples.heading: ① said

items.en: "I'll be back in an hour," she said.
items.zh: 我一個小時後回來。她說。

items.en: "This soup is delicious," my dad said.
items.zh: 這湯真好喝。我爸說。

items.en: "I've never seen snow before," Maria said.
items.zh: 我以前從沒看過雪。Maria 說。

items.en: "We missed the last train," they said.
items.zh: 我們錯過最後一班火車了。他們說。

items.en: "Excuse me, you forgot your umbrella," the waitress said.
items.zh: 不好意思，您忘了帶傘。女服務生說。

items.en: "It's my turn to pay," I said.
items.zh: 這次換我付。我說。

examples.heading: ② asked

items.en: "Where do you live?" she asked.
items.zh: 你住在哪裡？她問。

items.en: "Can I borrow your pen?" the boy asked.
items.zh: 我可以借你的筆嗎？男孩問。

items.en: "Why is everyone so quiet?" Dad asked.
items.zh: 大家怎麼都這麼安靜？爸爸問。

items.en: "Have you finished your homework?" my mother asked.
items.zh: 你功課寫完了嗎？我媽問。

items.en: "Where has everybody gone?" I asked.
items.zh: 大家都跑去哪了？我問。

examples.heading: ③ answered / replied

items.en: "Would you like to come to my party?" "Yes, I'd love to," she answered.
items.zh: 你要來我的派對嗎？好，我很樂意。她回答。

items.en: "How long will it take to the airport?" "About twenty minutes," the driver replied.
items.zh: 到機場要多久？大概二十分鐘。司機回答。

items.en: "I'm not sure yet which university I'll choose," he answered.
items.zh: 我還不確定要選哪一所大學。他回答。

items.en: "When do you work at the café?" "Only on weekends," Sara replied.
items.zh: 你什麼時候在咖啡廳上班？只有週末。Sara 回答。

items.en: "No, thanks, I'm full," I replied.
items.zh: 不用了，謝謝，我吃飽了。我回答。

examples.heading: ④ shouted / whispered / cried

items.en: "Run! The dog is coming!" he shouted.
items.zh: 快跑！那隻狗過來了！他大喊。

items.en: "Get off my bike!" the girl shouted.
items.zh: 從我的腳踏車上下來！女孩大喊。

items.en: "Don't make a sound," she whispered.
items.zh: 別出聲。她小聲說。

items.en: "I want my mummy!" the child cried.
items.zh: 我要媽媽！那個孩子哭著說。

items.en: "Happy birthday!" everyone shouted.
items.zh: 生日快樂！大家一起喊。

examples.heading: ⑤ thought / asked myself

items.en: "Have I made a mistake?" I thought.
items.zh: 我是不是做錯了？我心想。

items.en: "He looks familiar," she thought.
items.zh: 他看起來好眼熟。她心想。

items.en: "This is going to be a long day," I thought.
items.zh: 今天會很漫長。我心想。

items.en: "Did I lock the door?" he asked himself.
items.zh: 我有鎖門嗎？他問自己。

items.en: "Why did I say that?" she asked herself.
items.zh: 我為什麼要說那種話？她問自己。

examples.heading: ⑥ 故事裡的對話

items.en: "Is anybody home?" I asked. "In the kitchen!" my mum answered.
items.zh: 有人在家嗎？我問。在廚房！我媽回答。

items.en: "Can you help me?" the old man asked. "Of course," I said.
items.zh: 你可以幫我嗎？老先生問。當然。我說。

items.en: "Where are my keys?" she asked. "On the table," he replied.
items.zh: 我的鑰匙在哪裡？她問。在桌上。他回答。

items.en: "Is this seat free?" he asked. "Sorry, it's taken," she said.
items.zh: 這個位子有人坐嗎？他問。抱歉，有人了。她說。

items.en: "Let's take a break," the coach said. "Great idea!" we shouted.
items.zh: 我們休息一下吧。教練說。好主意！我們大喊。

title: He asked, "Are you Clarice?" and I answered yes.
translation: 他問：「你是 Clarice 嗎？」我回答是。
name: 直接引述（引述子句在前）
sentences: My grandmother said, "Eat your vegetables first."
The pilot said, "We will land in ten minutes."
Then she said, "I think we're lost."
Mr Hill said, "Put your phones away, please."
Everybody said, "Congratulations!"
The woman at the desk asked, "Do you have a reservation?"
My little brother asked, "Why is the sky blue?"
She asked, "Who left the door open?"
The customer asked, "Do you take credit cards?"
At the garage, I asked, "How long will it take?"
When I asked if he had visited Japan, he answered, "No, I've never been there."
The doctor replied, "It's nothing serious."
When the teacher asked why she was late, Lily answered, "Because I missed the bus."
When I suggested pizza, my friend replied, "Sounds good to me."
The shop assistant answered, "It's on the second floor."
The sign said: "No parking."
Her text said: "Running late, sorry!"
The teacher asked: "Who knows the answer?"
The note on the fridge said: "Back at six."
She said to her son, "Hold my hand."
The coach said to us, "You played really well."
I said to the driver, "Stop here, please."
He asked me, "Do you want some tea?"
The officer asked us, "Where are you going?"
I thought, "I've seen this man before."
She thought, "Should I call him or not?"
After a bad day at work, he thought, "Maybe tomorrow will be better."
When I saw the price, I thought, "That's far too expensive."
She asked, "Are you hungry?" and I said no.
He said, "See you tomorrow," and walked out.
Mum asked, "Who broke the vase?" and nobody answered.

examples.heading: ① said, "…"

items.en: My grandmother said, "Eat your vegetables first."
items.zh: 我奶奶說：先把青菜吃掉。

items.en: The pilot said, "We will land in ten minutes."
items.zh: 機長說：我們十分鐘後降落。

items.en: Then she said, "I think we're lost."
items.zh: 接著她說：我覺得我們迷路了。

items.en: Mr Hill said, "Put your phones away, please."
items.zh: Hill 老師說：請把手機收起來。

items.en: Everybody said, "Congratulations!"
items.zh: 大家都說：恭喜！

examples.heading: ② asked, "…?"

items.en: The woman at the desk asked, "Do you have a reservation?"
items.zh: 櫃台的女士問：您有訂位嗎？

items.en: My little brother asked, "Why is the sky blue?"
items.zh: 我弟弟問：天空為什麼是藍色的？

items.en: She asked, "Who left the door open?"
items.zh: 她問：誰沒關門？

items.en: The customer asked, "Do you take credit cards?"
items.zh: 那位客人問：你們收信用卡嗎？

items.en: At the garage, I asked, "How long will it take?"
items.zh: 在修車廠，我問：要多久？

examples.heading: ③ answered / replied

items.en: When I asked if he had visited Japan, he answered, "No, I've never been there."
items.zh: 我問他有沒有去過日本，他回答：沒有，我從沒去過那裡。

items.en: The doctor replied, "It's nothing serious."
items.zh: 醫生回答：沒什麼大礙。

items.en: When the teacher asked why she was late, Lily answered, "Because I missed the bus."
items.zh: 老師問她為什麼遲到，Lily 回答：因為我沒趕上公車。

items.en: When I suggested pizza, my friend replied, "Sounds good to me."
items.zh: 我提議吃披薩，我朋友回答：好啊。

items.en: The shop assistant answered, "It's on the second floor."
items.zh: 店員回答：在二樓。

examples.heading: ④ 冒號

items.en: The sign said: "No parking."
items.zh: 告示上寫著：禁止停車。

items.en: Her text said: "Running late, sorry!"
items.zh: 她的簡訊寫著：我會晚到，抱歉！

items.en: The teacher asked: "Who knows the answer?"
items.zh: 老師問：誰知道答案？

items.en: The note on the fridge said: "Back at six."
items.zh: 冰箱上的紙條寫著：六點回來。

examples.heading: ⑤ said to + 聽的人 / asked + 聽的人

items.en: She said to her son, "Hold my hand."
items.zh: 她對兒子說：牽著我的手。

items.en: The coach said to us, "You played really well."
items.zh: 教練對我們說：你們打得很好。

items.en: I said to the driver, "Stop here, please."
items.zh: 我對司機說：請在這裡停。

items.en: He asked me, "Do you want some tea?"
items.zh: 他問我：你要喝點茶嗎？

items.en: The officer asked us, "Where are you going?"
items.zh: 警察問我們：你們要去哪裡？

examples.heading: ⑥ thought

items.en: I thought, "I've seen this man before."
items.zh: 我心想：我見過這個人。

items.en: She thought, "Should I call him or not?"
items.zh: 她心想：我該不該打給他？

items.en: After a bad day at work, he thought, "Maybe tomorrow will be better."
items.zh: 上班上得很不順，他心想：也許明天會好一點。

items.en: When I saw the price, I thought, "That's far too expensive."
items.zh: 看到價錢的時候，我心想：這也太貴了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 引號後面接另一個子句

items.en: She asked, "Are you hungry?" and I said no.
items.zh: 她問：你餓了嗎？我說不餓。

items.en: He said, "See you tomorrow," and walked out.
items.zh: 他說：明天見。然後走了出去。

items.en: Mum asked, "Who broke the vase?" and nobody answered.
items.zh: 媽媽問：誰打破了花瓶？沒有人回答。

title: "Who are you?" asked Peter.
translation: 「你是誰？」Peter 問。
name: 直接引述後的引述子句主詞倒裝
sentences: "I was really surprised to see them there," said John.
"Let's go home," said Emma.
"That's the best pizza I've ever had," said Leo.
"I'll call you later," said Mrs Brown.
"It's not my fault. The window was already broken," said Daniel.
"Is anyone sitting here?" asked Sophie.
"Why are you crying?" asked Grandpa.
"Can I sit next to you?" asked Ali.
"What time does the film start?" asked Kate.
"Have you seen my phone?" asked Mum.
"Where are the scissors?" "In the top drawer," replied Sarah.
"Stop!" shouted the police officer.
"Help me!" cried the little boy.
"Can we sit by the window?" "Of course," answered the waiter.
"Be careful, the floor is wet," whispered my sister.
"Tickets, please," said the man at the gate.
"Excuse me, is this yours?" asked a voice behind me.
"We're closing in five minutes," said one of the staff.
"That's my seat," said the woman in the red coat.
"Where's the station?" asked a tourist with a big map.
"Room 12 is ready," said the woman at reception.
"Sit down," said the doctor to his patient.
"Well done, you played really well today," said the coach to the team.
"Have a good trip," said the officer to the passenger.
"Thank you for coming," said the bride to her guests.
"Don't be late," said Mr Jones to the class.
"Who's there?" asked Anna. "It's only me," replied her brother.
"Are we nearly there?" asked the children. "Almost," said Dad.

examples.heading: ① said + 名字

items.en: "I was really surprised to see them there," said John.
items.zh: 在那裡看到他們，我真的很驚訝。John 說。

items.en: "Let's go home," said Emma.
items.zh: 我們回家吧。Emma 說。

items.en: "That's the best pizza I've ever had," said Leo.
items.zh: 這是我吃過最好吃的披薩。Leo 說。

items.en: "I'll call you later," said Mrs Brown.
items.zh: 我晚點打給你。Brown 太太說。

items.en: "It's not my fault. The window was already broken," said Daniel.
items.zh: 不是我的錯。窗戶本來就破了。Daniel 說。

examples.heading: ② asked + 名字

items.en: "Is anyone sitting here?" asked Sophie.
items.zh: 這裡有人坐嗎？Sophie 問。

items.en: "Why are you crying?" asked Grandpa.
items.zh: 你為什麼在哭？爺爺問。

items.en: "Can I sit next to you?" asked Ali.
items.zh: 我可以坐你旁邊嗎？Ali 問。

items.en: "What time does the film start?" asked Kate.
items.zh: 電影幾點開始？Kate 問。

items.en: "Have you seen my phone?" asked Mum.
items.zh: 你有看到我的手機嗎？媽媽問。

examples.heading: ③ 其他引述動詞

items.en: "Where are the scissors?" "In the top drawer," replied Sarah.
items.zh: 剪刀在哪裡？在最上面的抽屜。Sarah 回答。

items.en: "Stop!" shouted the police officer.
items.zh: 站住！警察大喊。

items.en: "Help me!" cried the little boy.
items.zh: 救我！小男孩哭喊。

items.en: "Can we sit by the window?" "Of course," answered the waiter.
items.zh: 我們可以坐窗邊嗎？當然。服務生回答。

items.en: "Be careful, the floor is wet," whispered my sister.
items.zh: 小心點，地板是濕的。我妹小聲說。

examples.heading: ④ 名詞片語當主詞

items.en: "Tickets, please," said the man at the gate.
items.zh: 請出示車票。門口的男人說。

items.en: "Excuse me, is this yours?" asked a voice behind me.
items.zh: 不好意思，這是你的嗎？我後面有個聲音問。

items.en: "We're closing in five minutes," said one of the staff.
items.zh: 我們五分鐘後關門。其中一位員工說。

items.en: "That's my seat," said the woman in the red coat.
items.zh: 那是我的位子。穿紅外套的女人說。

items.en: "Where's the station?" asked a tourist with a big map.
items.zh: 車站在哪裡？一個拿著大地圖的觀光客問。

items.en: "Room 12 is ready," said the woman at reception.
items.zh: 12 號房準備好了。櫃台的女士說。

examples.heading: ⑤ 引述動詞 + 名詞 + to + 人

items.en: "Sit down," said the doctor to his patient.
items.zh: 請坐。醫生對病人說。

items.en: "Well done, you played really well today," said the coach to the team.
items.zh: 做得好，你們今天打得很好。教練對球隊說。

items.en: "Have a good trip," said the officer to the passenger.
items.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。警員對那名乘客說。

items.en: "Thank you for coming," said the bride to her guests.
items.zh: 謝謝大家來。新娘對賓客說。

items.en: "Don't be late," said Mr Jones to the class.
items.zh: 別遲到。Jones 老師對全班說。

examples.heading: ⑥ 故事裡的對話

items.en: "Who's there?" asked Anna. "It's only me," replied her brother.
items.zh: 誰在那裡？Anna 問。是我啦。她哥哥回答。

items.en: "Are we nearly there?" asked the children. "Almost," said Dad.
items.zh: 快到了嗎？孩子們問。快了。爸爸說。

items.en: "I'm hungry," said Ben. "Me too," said Lucy.
items.zh: 我餓了。Ben 說。我也是。Lucy 說。

items.en: "What happened?" asked the teacher. "He fell," said one of the boys.
items.zh: 發生什麼事了？老師問。他跌倒了。其中一個男孩說。

items.en: "Can you help me?" asked the old woman. "Of course," said the bus driver.
items.zh: 你可以幫我嗎？老太太問。當然。公車司機說。

title: "We have come together," the man said, "to celebrate our annual meeting."
translation: 「我們齊聚一堂，」那個男人說，「是為了慶祝我們的年會。」
name: 直接引述中間插入引述子句
sentences: "If you're free tomorrow," Mia said, "we could go shopping."
"The best thing about this job," he said, "is the people."
"When I was your age," my grandfather said, "I walked to school every day."
"Before you go," the teacher said, "please hand in your homework."
"Actually," she said, "I've never been to Spain."
"The problem with this phone," Dad said, "is the battery."
"Thank you," she said. "That's very kind of you."
"I'm sorry," he said. "I didn't mean to hurt you."
"Come in," the doctor said. "Take a seat."
"It's late," Mum said. "You should go to bed."
"Don't worry," my friend said. "Everything will be fine."
"This can't be right," I thought. "I must have made a mistake."
"If I hurry," she thought, "I can still catch the train."
"Maybe," he thought, "she didn't get my message."
"What a lovely day," I thought. "I'll go to the beach."
"Either I talk to her now," I thought, "or I'll never get the chance."
"In my opinion," said the manager, "we need more staff."
"Ladies and gentlemen," said the pilot, "we are about to land."
"The thing is," said Jack, "I don't have any money."
"Please," said the little girl, "can I keep the puppy?"
"Of course," said Mrs Lee, "you can stay with us."
"Excuse me," she asked, "is this seat taken?"
"If it rains," he asked, "what shall we do?"
"Well," she replied, "I'm not really sure where the station is."
"Hurry up," he shouted, "or we'll miss the bus!"
"Can I use your laptop?" "Yes," I replied, "but only for a few minutes."
"We have to leave," the guide said, "before it gets dark."
"I found this wallet," the boy said, "on the floor of the bus."
"This house," the old man said, "has been in my family for a hundred years."
"When the bell rings," the teacher said, "put your pens down."
"My sister," Ana said, "is the one in the blue dress."

examples.heading: ① 後半句接同一句

items.en: "If you're free tomorrow," Mia said, "we could go shopping."
items.zh: 如果你明天有空，Mia 說，我們可以去逛街。

items.en: "The best thing about this job," he said, "is the people."
items.zh: 這份工作最好的地方，他說，是這裡的人。

items.en: "When I was your age," my grandfather said, "I walked to school every day."
items.zh: 我在你這個年紀的時候，我爺爺說，每天都走路上學。

items.en: "Before you go," the teacher said, "please hand in your homework."
items.zh: 走之前，老師說，請把作業交出來。

items.en: "Actually," she said, "I've never been to Spain."
items.zh: 其實，她說，我從來沒去過西班牙。

items.en: "The problem with this phone," Dad said, "is the battery."
items.zh: 這支手機的問題，爸爸說，是電池。

examples.heading: ② 後半句是新的一句

items.en: "Thank you," she said. "That's very kind of you."
items.zh: 謝謝，她說。你真好。

items.en: "I'm sorry," he said. "I didn't mean to hurt you."
items.zh: 對不起，他說。我不是故意要傷害你的。

items.en: "Come in," the doctor said. "Take a seat."
items.zh: 請進，醫生說。請坐。

items.en: "It's late," Mum said. "You should go to bed."
items.zh: 很晚了，媽媽說。你該去睡了。

items.en: "Don't worry," my friend said. "Everything will be fine."
items.zh: 別擔心，我朋友說。一切都會沒事的。

examples.heading: ③ 轉述想法

items.en: "This can't be right," I thought. "I must have made a mistake."
items.zh: 這不可能是對的，我心想。我一定是哪裡算錯了。

items.en: "If I hurry," she thought, "I can still catch the train."
items.zh: 如果我快一點，她心想，還趕得上火車。

items.en: "Maybe," he thought, "she didn't get my message."
items.zh: 也許，他心想，她沒收到我的訊息。

items.en: "What a lovely day," I thought. "I'll go to the beach."
items.zh: 天氣真好，我心想。我要去海邊。

items.en: "Either I talk to her now," I thought, "or I'll never get the chance."
items.zh: 我要不是現在跟她說，我心想，就再也沒機會了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞是名詞時倒裝

items.en: "In my opinion," said the manager, "we need more staff."
items.zh: 我認為，經理說，我們需要更多人手。

items.en: "Ladies and gentlemen," said the pilot, "we are about to land."
items.zh: 各位先生女士，機長說，我們即將降落。

items.en: "The thing is," said Jack, "I don't have any money."
items.zh: 問題是，Jack 說，我沒錢。

items.en: "Please," said the little girl, "can I keep the puppy?"
items.zh: 拜託，小女孩說，我可以養這隻小狗嗎？

items.en: "Of course," said Mrs Lee, "you can stay with us."
items.zh: 當然，Lee 太太說，你可以跟我們住。

examples.heading: ⑤ asked / replied / shouted

items.en: "Excuse me," she asked, "is this seat taken?"
items.zh: 不好意思，她問，這個位子有人坐嗎？

items.en: "If it rains," he asked, "what shall we do?"
items.zh: 如果下雨，他問，我們要怎麼辦？

items.en: "Well," she replied, "I'm not really sure where the station is."
items.zh: 嗯，她回答，我不太確定車站在哪裡。

items.en: "Hurry up," he shouted, "or we'll miss the bus!"
items.zh: 快點，他大喊，不然我們會錯過公車！

items.en: "Can I use your laptop?" "Yes," I replied, "but only for a few minutes."
items.zh: 我可以用你的筆電嗎？好，我回答，但只能用幾分鐘。

examples.heading: ⑥ 故事裡的長句

items.en: "We have to leave," the guide said, "before it gets dark."
items.zh: 我們得離開，導遊說，在天黑之前。

items.en: "I found this wallet," the boy said, "on the floor of the bus."
items.zh: 我撿到這個錢包，男孩說，在公車的地板上。

items.en: "This house," the old man said, "has been in my family for a hundred years."
items.zh: 這棟房子，老先生說，已經在我們家傳了一百年。

items.en: "When the bell rings," the teacher said, "put your pens down."
items.zh: 鈴聲一響，老師說，就把筆放下。

items.en: "My sister," Ana said, "is the one in the blue dress."
items.zh: 我姊姊，Ana 說，是穿藍色洋裝的那個。

title: "Come on, what's wrong?" Bella asked curiously.
translation: 「好啦，到底怎麼了？」Bella 好奇地問。
name: 副詞修飾引述動詞
sentences: "I'm sorry," he said quietly.
"That's not fair!" the boy said angrily.
"We're going to have a baby," she said happily.
"Don't cry. It's only a game," Dad said calmly.
"I'll be there at eight," Lisa said firmly.
"Are you all right?" she asked gently.
"Where have you been?" his mother asked angrily.
"Can I have one?" the little girl asked politely.
"Is this really yours?" Tom asked doubtfully.
"What did he say?" I asked nervously.
"Get out of the water!" the lifeguard shouted urgently.
"Look behind you," she whispered nervously.
"Have you finished your homework?" "Not yet," he replied quickly.
"Who broke the vase?" "I don't know," Sam replied honestly.
"Put that light out!" the guard shouted firmly.
She said softly, "Good night, sweetheart."
He asked politely, "Could you close the window?"
My boss said firmly, "This has to be finished today."
The child asked shyly, "Can I play too?"
Anna replied coldly, "I have nothing to say to you."
"Quiet, please," said the librarian firmly.
"Welcome home," said Grandma warmly.
"Who's there?" asked the old man nervously.
"We'll find her," said the police officer calmly.
"Is it broken?" asked Jack anxiously.
"Our old dog died last night," she said sadly.
"I passed my driving test!" Ben said proudly.
"The bus is late again," my sister said impatiently.
"Do I have to clean my room now?" he asked unhappily.
"Thank you so much," the old lady said gratefully.
"It wasn't me who ate the cake," Max said nervously.

examples.heading: ① said + 副詞

items.en: "I'm sorry," he said quietly.
items.zh: 對不起。他小聲地說。

items.en: "That's not fair!" the boy said angrily.
items.zh: 這不公平！那個男孩生氣地說。

items.en: "We're going to have a baby," she said happily.
items.zh: 我們要有寶寶了。她開心地說。

items.en: "Don't cry. It's only a game," Dad said calmly.
items.zh: 別哭。這只是遊戲而已。爸爸平靜地說。

items.en: "I'll be there at eight," Lisa said firmly.
items.zh: 我八點會到。Lisa 堅定地說。

examples.heading: ② asked + 副詞

items.en: "Are you all right?" she asked gently.
items.zh: 你還好嗎？她溫柔地問。

items.en: "Where have you been?" his mother asked angrily.
items.zh: 你跑去哪裡了？他媽媽生氣地問。

items.en: "Can I have one?" the little girl asked politely.
items.zh: 我可以拿一個嗎？小女孩有禮貌地問。

items.en: "Is this really yours?" Tom asked doubtfully.
items.zh: 這真的是你的嗎？Tom 半信半疑地問。

items.en: "What did he say?" I asked nervously.
items.zh: 他說了什麼？我緊張地問。

examples.heading: ③ shouted / whispered / replied + 副詞

items.en: "Get out of the water!" the lifeguard shouted urgently.
items.zh: 快離開水裡！救生員急忙大喊。

items.en: "Look behind you," she whispered nervously.
items.zh: 看你後面。她緊張地小聲說。

items.en: "Have you finished your homework?" "Not yet," he replied quickly.
items.zh: 你功課寫完了嗎？還沒。他很快地回答。

items.en: "Who broke the vase?" "I don't know," Sam replied honestly.
items.zh: 花瓶是誰打破的？我不知道。Sam 老實地回答。

items.en: "Put that light out!" the guard shouted firmly.
items.zh: 把那盞燈關掉！警衛厲聲喊道。

examples.heading: ④ 引述子句放在前面

items.en: She said softly, "Good night, sweetheart."
items.zh: 她輕聲地說：晚安，寶貝。

items.en: He asked politely, "Could you close the window?"
items.zh: 他有禮貌地問：可以請你關窗嗎？

items.en: My boss said firmly, "This has to be finished today."
items.zh: 我老闆堅定地說：這個今天一定要做完。

items.en: The child asked shyly, "Can I play too?"
items.zh: 那個孩子害羞地問：我也可以玩嗎？

items.en: Anna replied coldly, "I have nothing to say to you."
items.zh: Anna 冷冷地回答：我跟你沒什麼好說的。

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞是名詞時倒裝

items.en: "Quiet, please," said the librarian firmly.
items.zh: 請安靜。圖書館員堅定地說。

items.en: "Welcome home," said Grandma warmly.
items.zh: 歡迎回家。奶奶熱情地說。

items.en: "Who's there?" asked the old man nervously.
items.zh: 誰在那裡？老先生緊張地問。

items.en: "We'll find her," said the police officer calmly.
items.zh: 我們會找到她的。警察冷靜地說。

items.en: "Is it broken?" asked Jack anxiously.
items.zh: 壞掉了嗎？Jack 焦急地問。

examples.heading: ⑥ 說出情緒的副詞

items.en: "Our old dog died last night," she said sadly.
items.zh: 我們家的老狗昨晚死了。她難過地說。

items.en: "I passed my driving test!" Ben said proudly.
items.zh: 我駕照考過了！Ben 驕傲地說。

items.en: "The bus is late again," my sister said impatiently.
items.zh: 公車又遲到了。我妹不耐煩地說。

items.en: "Do I have to clean my room now?" he asked unhappily.
items.zh: 我一定要現在整理房間嗎？他不太高興地問。

items.en: "Thank you so much," the old lady said gratefully.
items.zh: 真的很謝謝你。那位老太太感激地說。

items.en: "It wasn't me who ate the cake," Max said nervously.
items.zh: 蛋糕不是我吃的。Max 緊張地說。

title: Dad asked me to help him at work.
translation: 爸爸要我在工作上幫他。
name: 用 ask、tell 轉述請求和命令
sentences: My neighbour asked me to water her plants.
I asked the waiter to bring us some more bread.
She asked her brother to pick her up from the station.
The hotel asked guests to check out by eleven.
We asked our teacher to explain the question again.
He asked me to keep an eye on his bag.
The officer told the driver to get out of the car.
My mum told me to take the rubbish out after dinner.
The doctor told her to drink more water.
Our manager told us to finish the report by Friday.
The teacher told the class to open their books.
He told his dog to sit.
She told me to call her when I got home.
He asked us to wait for him outside.
My sister asked me to lend her my jacket.
The kids asked their dad to read them a story.
Tom told me to meet him at the café.
She told me to take off my shoes and leave them by the door.
They asked us to fill in the form and send it back.
The coach told us to warm up and then run three laps.
Dad told me to turn off the TV and go to bed.
The guide asked everyone to stay together and follow her.
The police asked witnesses to come forward.
My boss asked me to stay late tonight.
The pilot told the passengers to fasten their seatbelts.
I told my son to put his coat on.
Passengers are asked to show their tickets.
She was told to come back the following week.
The students were asked to bring a pencil.
The workers were told to leave the building at once.
I've been asked to give a short speech at the wedding.

examples.heading: ① asked + 人 + to

items.en: My neighbour asked me to water her plants.
items.zh: 我鄰居請我幫她澆花。

items.en: I asked the waiter to bring us some more bread.
items.zh: 我請服務生再拿一些麵包來。

items.en: She asked her brother to pick her up from the station.
items.zh: 她請她哥哥去車站接她。

items.en: The hotel asked guests to check out by eleven.
items.zh: 飯店請房客十一點前退房。

items.en: We asked our teacher to explain the question again.
items.zh: 我們請老師再解釋一次那個題目。

items.en: He asked me to keep an eye on his bag.
items.zh: 他請我幫他顧一下包包。

examples.heading: ② told + 人 + to

items.en: The officer told the driver to get out of the car.
items.zh: 警察叫駕駛下車。

items.en: My mum told me to take the rubbish out after dinner.
items.zh: 我媽叫我晚餐後把垃圾拿出去倒。

items.en: The doctor told her to drink more water.
items.zh: 醫生叫她多喝水。

items.en: Our manager told us to finish the report by Friday.
items.zh: 我們經理叫我們星期五前把報告寫完。

items.en: The teacher told the class to open their books.
items.zh: 老師叫全班打開課本。

items.en: He told his dog to sit.
items.zh: 他叫他的狗坐下。

examples.heading: ③ 代名詞跟著換

items.en: She told me to call her when I got home.
items.zh: 她叫我到家時打給她。

items.en: He asked us to wait for him outside.
items.zh: 他請我們在外面等他。

items.en: My sister asked me to lend her my jacket.
items.zh: 我妹妹請我把外套借她。

items.en: The kids asked their dad to read them a story.
items.zh: 孩子們請爸爸念故事給他們聽。

items.en: Tom told me to meet him at the café.
items.zh: Tom 叫我去咖啡廳跟他碰面。

examples.heading: ④ 一句轉述好幾件事

items.en: She told me to take off my shoes and leave them by the door.
items.zh: 她叫我把鞋子脫掉，放在門邊。

items.en: They asked us to fill in the form and send it back.
items.zh: 他們請我們填好表格寄回去。

items.en: The coach told us to warm up and then run three laps.
items.zh: 教練叫我們先熱身，再跑三圈。

items.en: Dad told me to turn off the TV and go to bed.
items.zh: 爸爸叫我關電視去睡覺。

items.en: The guide asked everyone to stay together and follow her.
items.zh: 導遊請大家走在一起，跟著她走。

examples.heading: ⑤ 各種場合的請求和命令

items.en: The police asked witnesses to come forward.
items.zh: 警方請目擊者出面。

items.en: My boss asked me to stay late tonight.
items.zh: 我老闆請我今晚留下來加班。

items.en: The pilot told the passengers to fasten their seatbelts.
items.zh: 機長叫乘客繫好安全帶。

items.en: I told my son to put his coat on.
items.zh: 我叫我兒子把外套穿上。

examples.heading: ⑥ 被動：be asked / be told + to

items.en: Passengers are asked to show their tickets.
items.zh: 乘客請出示車票。

items.en: She was told to come back the following week.
items.zh: 她被告知隔週再來。

items.en: The students were asked to bring a pencil.
items.zh: 學生被要求帶鉛筆。

items.en: The workers were told to leave the building at once.
items.zh: 工人們被要求馬上離開大樓。

items.en: I've been asked to give a short speech at the wedding.
items.zh: 我被邀請在婚禮上簡短致詞。

title: I asked Pat not to tell anyone, and she promised me she wouldn't.
translation: 我請 Pat 別跟任何人說，她答應我她不會說。
name: 間接引述的否定請求和命令（not to）
sentences: She asked me not to tell her parents.
We asked the neighbours not to park in front of our gate.
The teacher asked the students not to use their phones in class.
I asked him not to be late again.
They asked us not to take photos during the show.
He asked me not to mention it to anyone at work.
She told me not to be scared.
I told him not to climb the wall, but he didn't listen.
The police told everyone not to go near the building.
My boss told me not to worry about the mistake.
Mum told us not to make a mess in the kitchen.
The coach told the players not to give up.
The guide told us not to touch anything and to stay on the path.
She asked me not to shout and to speak slowly.
The nurse told him not to get up and to call if he needed anything.
They told us not to panic and to leave the building quietly.
He asked me not to wait for him and to start without him.
The doctor warned me not to lift anything heavy.
My friend warned me not to eat the fish there.
Dad reminded us not to leave the lights on.
The email reminded customers not to reply to this address.
She begged him not to sell the house.
I asked her not to say anything, and she kept her promise.
He told me not to touch the dog, but I did anyway.
We asked them not to make so much noise, and they apologized.
She told the kids not to run, but they didn't hear her.
I asked my brother not to borrow my car, and he agreed.
We were told not to open the door to strangers.
I was asked not to discuss the case with the press.
Visitors are asked not to feed the animals.
The students were told not to bring bags into the exam room.

examples.heading: ① asked + 人 + not to

items.en: She asked me not to tell her parents.
items.zh: 她請我別跟她爸媽說。

items.en: We asked the neighbours not to park in front of our gate.
items.zh: 我們請鄰居別把車停在我們家門口。

items.en: The teacher asked the students not to use their phones in class.
items.zh: 老師請學生上課時別用手機。

items.en: I asked him not to be late again.
items.zh: 我請他別再遲到了。

items.en: They asked us not to take photos during the show.
items.zh: 他們請我們表演期間別拍照。

items.en: He asked me not to mention it to anyone at work.
items.zh: 他請我別跟公司的任何人提這件事。

examples.heading: ② told + 人 + not to

items.en: She told me not to be scared.
items.zh: 她叫我別害怕。

items.en: I told him not to climb the wall, but he didn't listen.
items.zh: 我叫他別爬那面牆，但他不聽。

items.en: The police told everyone not to go near the building.
items.zh: 警察叫大家別靠近那棟大樓。

items.en: My boss told me not to worry about the mistake.
items.zh: 我老闆叫我別擔心那個錯誤。

items.en: Mum told us not to make a mess in the kitchen.
items.zh: 媽媽叫我們別把廚房弄亂。

items.en: The coach told the players not to give up.
items.zh: 教練叫球員別放棄。

examples.heading: ③ not to 和 to 一起用

items.en: The guide told us not to touch anything and to stay on the path.
items.zh: 導遊叫我們什麼都別碰，走在步道上。

items.en: She asked me not to shout and to speak slowly.
items.zh: 她請我別大吼，說慢一點。

items.en: The nurse told him not to get up and to call if he needed anything.
items.zh: 護士叫他別起來，需要什麼就叫人。

items.en: They told us not to panic and to leave the building quietly.
items.zh: 他們叫我們別慌張，安靜地離開大樓。

items.en: He asked me not to wait for him and to start without him.
items.zh: 他請我別等他，先開始。

examples.heading: ④ warned / reminded / begged + 人 + not to

items.en: The doctor warned me not to lift anything heavy.
items.zh: 醫生警告我別提重物。

items.en: My friend warned me not to eat the fish there.
items.zh: 我朋友警告我別吃那裡的魚。

items.en: Dad reminded us not to leave the lights on.
items.zh: 爸爸提醒我們別讓燈開著。

items.en: The email reminded customers not to reply to this address.
items.zh: 那封信提醒客戶別回覆這個信箱。

items.en: She begged him not to sell the house.
items.zh: 她求他別把房子賣掉。

examples.heading: ⑤ 後面說出對方的回應

items.en: I asked her not to say anything, and she kept her promise.
items.zh: 我請她什麼都別說，她也守住了承諾。

items.en: He told me not to touch the dog, but I did anyway.
items.zh: 他叫我別碰那隻狗，但我還是碰了。

items.en: We asked them not to make so much noise, and they apologized.
items.zh: 我們請他們別那麼吵，他們道了歉。

items.en: She told the kids not to run, but they didn't hear her.
items.zh: 她叫孩子們別跑，但他們沒聽到。

items.en: I asked my brother not to borrow my car, and he agreed.
items.zh: 我請我弟別借我的車，他答應了。

examples.heading: ⑥ 被動：be told / be asked + not to

items.en: We were told not to open the door to strangers.
items.zh: 我們被告知不要給陌生人開門。

items.en: I was asked not to discuss the case with the press.
items.zh: 我被要求不要跟媒體談這個案子。

items.en: Visitors are asked not to feed the animals.
items.zh: 請遊客不要餵動物。

items.en: The students were told not to bring bags into the exam room.
items.zh: 學生被告知不能帶包包進考場。

title: My mother said that she can take us there.
translation: 我媽媽說她可以帶我們去那裡。
name: say 的間接引述句和代名詞轉換
sentences: My brother said that he can't find his keys.
The new girl said she comes from Brazil.
Mr Green said that he's going to retire next year.
My friend said she's too tired to go out.
The driver said he knows a faster way.
Mum said that she's proud of us.
The waiter said he'll bring us some water.
My grandma said that she misses me.
Our neighbour said he can give us a lift.
The teacher said that we can use a dictionary.
The students said that they want a longer lunch break.
My parents said they're going on holiday in May.
The players said their coach is the best.
Our neighbours said that they're selling their house.
The twins said they don't like the same food.
Emma said that her phone is broken.
The doctor said my results are fine.
My uncle said his dog is ten years old.
The guide said our bus is waiting outside.
Leo said that his sister is a pilot.
She said she likes my new haircut.
He said he'll be home by six.
The kids said they're hungry.
My boss said I can take a day off next week.
Tina said she doesn't drink coffee.
He said to me that he's sorry.
The nurse said to us that the doctor is busy.
My dad said to my mum that he loves her.
When I saw him, Tom said that he was on his way to work.
Last night Rosa said she felt sick.
At the party, Ali said he didn't know anyone there.

examples.heading: ① I → he / she

items.en: My brother said that he can't find his keys.
items.zh: 我哥哥說他找不到他的鑰匙。

items.en: The new girl said she comes from Brazil.
items.zh: 那個新來的女生說她是巴西人。

items.en: Mr Green said that he's going to retire next year.
items.zh: Green 先生說他明年要退休。

items.en: My friend said she's too tired to go out.
items.zh: 我朋友說她太累了，不想出門。

items.en: The driver said he knows a faster way.
items.zh: 司機說他知道一條比較快的路。

examples.heading: ② you → me / us

items.en: Mum said that she's proud of us.
items.zh: 媽媽說她以我們為榮。

items.en: The waiter said he'll bring us some water.
items.zh: 服務生說他會拿水給我們。

items.en: My grandma said that she misses me.
items.zh: 我奶奶說她很想我。

items.en: Our neighbour said he can give us a lift.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居說他可以載我們一程。

items.en: The teacher said that we can use a dictionary.
items.zh: 老師說我們可以用字典。

examples.heading: ③ we / our → they / their

items.en: The students said that they want a longer lunch break.
items.zh: 學生們說他們想要更長的午休時間。

items.en: My parents said they're going on holiday in May.
items.zh: 我爸媽說他們五月要去度假。

items.en: The players said their coach is the best.
items.zh: 球員們說他們的教練是最好的。

items.en: Our neighbours said that they're selling their house.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居說他們要賣房子。

items.en: The twins said they don't like the same food.
items.zh: 那對雙胞胎說他們喜歡的食物不一樣。

examples.heading: ④ my / your → his / her / my / our

items.en: Emma said that her phone is broken.
items.zh: Emma 說她的手機壞了。

items.en: The doctor said my results are fine.
items.zh: 醫生說我的檢查結果沒問題。

items.en: My uncle said his dog is ten years old.
items.zh: 我叔叔說他的狗十歲了。

items.en: The guide said our bus is waiting outside.
items.zh: 導遊說我們的巴士在外面等。

items.en: Leo said that his sister is a pilot.
items.zh: Leo 說他姊姊是機師。

examples.heading: ⑤ 省略 that

items.en: She said she likes my new haircut.
items.zh: 她說她喜歡我的新髮型。

items.en: He said he'll be home by six.
items.zh: 他說他六點前會到家。

items.en: The kids said they're hungry.
items.zh: 孩子們說他們餓了。

items.en: My boss said I can take a day off next week.
items.zh: 我老闆說我下週可以休一天假。

items.en: Tina said she doesn't drink coffee.
items.zh: Tina 說她不喝咖啡。

examples.heading: ⑥ said to + 聽的人

items.en: He said to me that he's sorry.
items.zh: 他跟我說他很抱歉。

items.en: The nurse said to us that the doctor is busy.
items.zh: 護士跟我們說醫生在忙。

items.en: My dad said to my mum that he loves her.
items.zh: 我爸跟我媽說他愛她。

examples.heading: ⑦ 已經過去的事，時態後移

items.en: When I saw him, Tom said that he was on his way to work.
items.zh: 我看到他的時候，Tom 說他正要去上班。

items.en: Last night Rosa said she felt sick.
items.zh: Rosa 昨晚說她覺得不舒服。

items.en: At the party, Ali said he didn't know anyone there.
items.zh: 在派對上，Ali 說他在那裡誰都不認識。

title: My sister told me that this film is very good.
translation: 我姊姊跟我說這部電影很好看。
name: tell 的間接引述句和代名詞轉換
sentences: My best friend told me that she has a new boyfriend.
The doctor told me that my leg isn't broken.
Dad told me that dinner is ready.
My classmate told me that the library closes early today.
Grandpa told me that he loves my cooking.
The waiter told us that the kitchen is closed.
I told him that I don't eat meat.
She told them that the party is on Saturday.
We told her that we miss her.
The coach told us that we can win this game.
I told my mum that I'm going to be late.
Sam told his boss that he needs a day off.
The pilot told the passengers that the weather is good.
She told the police that someone took her bike.
My brother told everyone that he passed his driving test.
Ella told me she wants to be a nurse.
He told me his phone is broken.
My neighbour told me the water is off this morning.
They told us the bus is always late.
The teacher told me my English is getting better.
Jake told me that he'll pick me up at eight.
Lucy told me that her brother knows my brother.
The man told me that my car is blocking his gate.
My parents told me that they're proud of me.
Our host told us that we can use her kitchen.
You told me that your sister lives in Canada.
My father told me that he would call after work.
Ken told me that you had broken your arm skiing.
The receptionist told us the room wasn't ready yet.
She told me she was too tired to go out.
He told his teacher that he had forgotten his homework.

examples.heading: ① told me

items.en: My best friend told me that she has a new boyfriend.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友跟我說她有新男友了。

items.en: The doctor told me that my leg isn't broken.
items.zh: 醫生跟我說我的腿沒斷。

items.en: Dad told me that dinner is ready.
items.zh: 爸爸跟我說晚餐好了。

items.en: My classmate told me that the library closes early today.
items.zh: 我同學跟我說圖書館今天提早關門。

items.en: Grandpa told me that he loves my cooking.
items.zh: 爺爺跟我說他很喜歡我做的菜。

examples.heading: ② told us / him / her / them

items.en: The waiter told us that the kitchen is closed.
items.zh: 服務生跟我們說廚房已經關了。

items.en: I told him that I don't eat meat.
items.zh: 我跟他說我不吃肉。

items.en: She told them that the party is on Saturday.
items.zh: 她跟他們說派對在星期六。

items.en: We told her that we miss her.
items.zh: 我們跟她說我們很想她。

items.en: The coach told us that we can win this game.
items.zh: 教練跟我們說我們可以贏這場比賽。

examples.heading: ③ told + 名字或名詞

items.en: I told my mum that I'm going to be late.
items.zh: 我跟我媽說我會晚到。

items.en: Sam told his boss that he needs a day off.
items.zh: Sam 跟老闆說他需要請一天假。

items.en: The pilot told the passengers that the weather is good.
items.zh: 機長跟乘客說天氣很好。

items.en: She told the police that someone took her bike.
items.zh: 她跟警察說有人把她的腳踏車騎走了。

items.en: My brother told everyone that he passed his driving test.
items.zh: 我哥跟大家說他駕照考過了。

examples.heading: ④ 省略 that

items.en: Ella told me she wants to be a nurse.
items.zh: Ella 跟我說她想當護士。

items.en: He told me his phone is broken.
items.zh: 他跟我說他的手機壞了。

items.en: My neighbour told me the water is off this morning.
items.zh: 我鄰居跟我說今天早上停水。

items.en: They told us the bus is always late.
items.zh: 他們跟我們說公車老是誤點。

items.en: The teacher told me my English is getting better.
items.zh: 老師跟我說我的英文越來越好了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 代名詞換掉

items.en: Jake told me that he'll pick me up at eight.
items.zh: Jake 跟我說他八點會來接我。

items.en: Lucy told me that her brother knows my brother.
items.zh: Lucy 跟我說她哥哥認識我哥哥。

items.en: The man told me that my car is blocking his gate.
items.zh: 那個男人跟我說我的車擋到他家大門了。

items.en: My parents told me that they're proud of me.
items.zh: 我爸媽跟我說他們以我為榮。

items.en: Our host told us that we can use her kitchen.
items.zh: 我們的房東跟我們說我們可以用她的廚房。

items.en: You told me that your sister lives in Canada.
items.zh: 你跟我說過你姊姊住在加拿大。

examples.heading: ⑥ 已經過去的事，時態後移

items.en: My father told me that he would call after work.
items.zh: 我爸跟我說他下班後會打給我。

items.en: Ken told me that you had broken your arm skiing.
items.zh: Ken 跟我說你滑雪摔斷了手臂。

items.en: The receptionist told us the room wasn't ready yet.
items.zh: 櫃台人員跟我們說房間還沒準備好。

items.en: She told me she was too tired to go out.
items.zh: 她跟我說她太累了，不想出門。

items.en: He told his teacher that he had forgotten his homework.
items.zh: 他跟老師說他忘了帶作業。

title: I asked when it would be on TV.
translation: 我問它什麼時候會在電視上播。
name: 轉述 wh- 問句
sentences: She asked me what I did for a living.
I called the gym and asked what classes they offered.
The doctor asked what I had eaten that morning.
My friend asked what I was going to wear to the party.
A tourist asked us where the nearest cash machine was.
He asked a man where the changing rooms were.
The police asked where we had been that night.
My grandmother asked where I had bought my shoes.
I asked the receptionist what time breakfast was served.
They asked when the next bus would come.
She asked me when I had started learning the guitar.
Our neighbour asked when we were moving out.
We asked the film crew why they were filming our school.
The teacher asked why I hadn't done my homework.
He asked me why I looked so worried.
Mum asked why the kitchen was such a mess.
I asked the shop assistant how much the jacket was.
She asked how long the journey would take.
My cousin asked how I had found the flat.
The interviewer asked how many languages I spoke.
Dad asked who had left the gate open.
I asked her who she was waiting for.
The waiter asked which wine we would like.
She asked which bus went to the airport.
My boss asked who would be in charge while she was away.
The police officer wanted to know where I was going.
My parents wanted to know who I had been talking to.
The customer wanted to know why the price had gone up.
The kids keep asking when we're going to arrive.
My boss asked me yesterday what my plans are for the summer.
I've just asked how long the delay will be.

examples.heading: ① what

items.en: She asked me what I did for a living.
items.zh: 她問我是做什麼工作的。

items.en: I called the gym and asked what classes they offered.
items.zh: 我打電話到健身房，問他們有哪些課。

items.en: The doctor asked what I had eaten that morning.
items.zh: 醫生問我那天早上吃了什麼。

items.en: My friend asked what I was going to wear to the party.
items.zh: 我朋友問我要穿什麼去派對。

examples.heading: ② where

items.en: A tourist asked us where the nearest cash machine was.
items.zh: 一個觀光客問我們最近的提款機在哪裡。

items.en: He asked a man where the changing rooms were.
items.zh: 他問一個男人更衣室在哪裡。

items.en: The police asked where we had been that night.
items.zh: 警察問我們那天晚上去了哪裡。

items.en: My grandmother asked where I had bought my shoes.
items.zh: 我奶奶問我鞋子在哪裡買的。

examples.heading: ③ when / what time

items.en: I asked the receptionist what time breakfast was served.
items.zh: 我問櫃台人員早餐幾點供應。

items.en: They asked when the next bus would come.
items.zh: 他們問下一班公車什麼時候來。

items.en: She asked me when I had started learning the guitar.
items.zh: 她問我什麼時候開始學吉他的。

items.en: Our neighbour asked when we were moving out.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居問我們什麼時候搬走。

examples.heading: ④ why

items.en: We asked the film crew why they were filming our school.
items.zh: 我們問攝影團隊為什麼在拍我們學校。

items.en: The teacher asked why I hadn't done my homework.
items.zh: 老師問我為什麼沒寫作業。

items.en: He asked me why I looked so worried.
items.zh: 他問我為什麼看起來那麼擔心。

items.en: Mum asked why the kitchen was such a mess.
items.zh: 媽媽問廚房為什麼那麼亂。

examples.heading: ⑤ how / how much / how long

items.en: I asked the shop assistant how much the jacket was.
items.zh: 我問店員那件外套多少錢。

items.en: She asked how long the journey would take.
items.zh: 她問路程要多久。

items.en: My cousin asked how I had found the flat.
items.zh: 我表哥問我是怎麼找到那間公寓的。

items.en: The interviewer asked how many languages I spoke.
items.zh: 面試官問我會說幾種語言。

examples.heading: ⑥ who / which

items.en: Dad asked who had left the gate open.
items.zh: 爸爸問是誰沒關大門。

items.en: I asked her who she was waiting for.
items.zh: 我問她在等誰。

items.en: The waiter asked which wine we would like.
items.zh: 服務生問我們想要哪一種酒。

items.en: She asked which bus went to the airport.
items.zh: 她問哪一班公車到機場。

items.en: My boss asked who would be in charge while she was away.
items.zh: 我老闆問她不在的時候誰負責。

examples.heading: ⑦ wanted to know

items.en: The police officer wanted to know where I was going.
items.zh: 警察想知道我要去哪裡。

items.en: My parents wanted to know who I had been talking to.
items.zh: 我爸媽想知道我在跟誰講話。

items.en: The customer wanted to know why the price had gone up.
items.zh: 那位客人想知道價錢為什麼漲了。

examples.heading: ⑧ 時態不後移

items.en: The kids keep asking when we're going to arrive.
items.zh: 孩子們一直問我們什麼時候會到。

items.en: My boss asked me yesterday what my plans are for the summer.
items.zh: 我老闆昨天問我今年夏天有什麼計畫。

items.en: I've just asked how long the delay will be.
items.zh: 我剛剛問了會延誤多久。

title: I asked her if she wanted to go and have dinner together.
translation: 我問她要不要一起去吃晚餐。
name: 轉述 是非問句
sentences: The waiter asked us if we were ready to order.
My friend asked me if I wanted to join her book club.
The coach asked me if I wanted to be on the team.
I asked my teacher if I could leave early.
She asked me if I had ever been to Italy.
Someone at the door asked if Mr Wong was home.
The driver asked if everyone had a seat.
Jack asked if the meeting had been cancelled.
My little sister asked if dogs could see colours.
The nurse asked whether I was allergic to anything.
They asked me whether I could start on Monday.
The manager asked whether we had any questions.
He asked his wife whether she had locked the car.
Mum asked if I had brushed my teeth or not.
The officer asked whether or not we had anything to declare.
She asked if the price included breakfast or not.
They asked us whether or not we wanted a receipt.
He asked me if I was OK after the fall.
She asked if the train would be late.
My uncle asked if I was still living in London.
The interviewer asked if I had any experience with children.
We asked if we could bring our dog.
I'm calling to ask if you have any rooms available.
Lisa asked me last week if I still play tennis.
Can you ask the waiter whether they take cards?
Everyone keeps asking me if I'm OK.
My boss wanted to know if the report was finished.
The kids wanted to know whether they could stay up late.
Her parents wanted to know if she had passed the exam.
The hotel wanted to know whether we needed a taxi.
I wanted to know if anyone had found my wallet.

examples.heading: ① asked + 人 + if

items.en: The waiter asked us if we were ready to order.
items.zh: 服務生問我們準備好點餐了沒。

items.en: My friend asked me if I wanted to join her book club.
items.zh: 我朋友問我要不要加入她的讀書會。

items.en: The coach asked me if I wanted to be on the team.
items.zh: 教練問我想不想加入球隊。

items.en: I asked my teacher if I could leave early.
items.zh: 我問老師我可不可以早點走。

items.en: She asked me if I had ever been to Italy.
items.zh: 她問我有沒有去過義大利。

examples.heading: ② asked if（沒有被問的人）

items.en: Someone at the door asked if Mr Wong was home.
items.zh: 門口有人問黃先生在不在家。

items.en: The driver asked if everyone had a seat.
items.zh: 司機問大家是不是都有位子。

items.en: Jack asked if the meeting had been cancelled.
items.zh: Jack 問會議是不是取消了。

items.en: My little sister asked if dogs could see colours.
items.zh: 我妹妹問狗看不看得到顏色。

examples.heading: ③ whether

items.en: The nurse asked whether I was allergic to anything.
items.zh: 護士問我有沒有對什麼東西過敏。

items.en: They asked me whether I could start on Monday.
items.zh: 他們問我星期一能不能開始上班。

items.en: The manager asked whether we had any questions.
items.zh: 經理問我們有沒有問題。

items.en: He asked his wife whether she had locked the car.
items.zh: 他問太太有沒有鎖車。

examples.heading: ④ or not

items.en: Mum asked if I had brushed my teeth or not.
items.zh: 媽媽問我刷牙了沒。

items.en: The officer asked whether or not we had anything to declare.
items.zh: 海關人員問我們有沒有東西要申報。

items.en: She asked if the price included breakfast or not.
items.zh: 她問價錢有沒有含早餐。

items.en: They asked us whether or not we wanted a receipt.
items.zh: 他們問我們要不要收據。

examples.heading: ⑤ 時態後移

items.en: He asked me if I was OK after the fall.
items.zh: 他在我跌倒後問我還好嗎。

items.en: She asked if the train would be late.
items.zh: 她問火車會不會誤點。

items.en: My uncle asked if I was still living in London.
items.zh: 我叔叔問我是不是還住在倫敦。

items.en: The interviewer asked if I had any experience with children.
items.zh: 面試官問我有沒有帶小孩的經驗。

items.en: We asked if we could bring our dog.
items.zh: 我們問可不可以帶狗去。

examples.heading: ⑥ 時態不後移

items.en: I'm calling to ask if you have any rooms available.
items.zh: 我打電話來問你們還有沒有空房。

items.en: Lisa asked me last week if I still play tennis.
items.zh: Lisa 上週問我現在還打不打網球。

items.en: Can you ask the waiter whether they take cards?
items.zh: 你可以問一下服務生他們收不收卡嗎？

items.en: Everyone keeps asking me if I'm OK.
items.zh: 每個人一直問我還好嗎。

examples.heading: ⑦ wanted to know if / whether

items.en: My boss wanted to know if the report was finished.
items.zh: 我老闆想知道報告寫完了沒。

items.en: The kids wanted to know whether they could stay up late.
items.zh: 孩子們想知道他們可不可以晚點睡。

items.en: Her parents wanted to know if she had passed the exam.
items.zh: 她爸媽想知道她考試有沒有過。

items.en: The hotel wanted to know whether we needed a taxi.
items.zh: 飯店想知道我們需不需要叫計程車。

items.en: I wanted to know if anyone had found my wallet.
items.zh: 我想知道有沒有人撿到我的錢包。

title: The guidebook says that we can get there by train from London.
translation: 旅遊指南上說，我們可以從倫敦搭火車到那裡。
name: 現在簡單式引述書面資料
sentences: The menu says that all the meat is local.
The email says the train leaves at ten past nine.
The forecast says it's going to snow tonight.
My ticket says I'm in seat 14B.
The report says that most students walk to school.
It says here that breakfast is included.
It says on the box that it's suitable for children over three.
I read the article, and it says the factory is closing.
It says on the website that the pool is open until nine.
Look at the sign. It says you can't take photos inside.
Your advertisement tells us that the trip includes two nights in a hotel.
The map tells you that the toilets are next to the café.
This leaflet tells you that the museum is free for students.
The note on the door tells visitors that the office is upstairs.
The letter tells me that my passport is ready.
The rules say that you can't bring food into the library.
The instructions say you should wait ten minutes.
The signs say the beach is closed for cleaning.
The reviews say the hotel is clean but noisy.
Her notes say that the meeting starts at two.
The guide explains how to get to the castle on foot.
The article explains why prices are going up.
The sign warns that the water is deep.
The label warns that the medicine may make you sleepy.
The company claims that its phones last for ten years.
The advert claims you can learn French in a month.
The timetable says the last bus is at midnight.
Your letter says you want to change your booking.
The app says we're five minutes away.
The recipe says you need three eggs.
This book says the castle was built in 1200.

examples.heading: ① 書面資料 + says (that)

items.en: The menu says that all the meat is local.
items.zh: 菜單上說所有的肉都是本地的。

items.en: The email says the train leaves at ten past nine.
items.zh: 信上說火車九點十分開。

items.en: The forecast says it's going to snow tonight.
items.zh: 天氣預報說今晚會下雪。

items.en: My ticket says I'm in seat 14B.
items.zh: 我的票上寫說我是 14B 的座位。

items.en: The report says that most students walk to school.
items.zh: 報告上說大部分學生走路上學。

examples.heading: ② It says

items.en: It says here that breakfast is included.
items.zh: 這裡寫說含早餐。

items.en: It says on the box that it's suitable for children over three.
items.zh: 盒子上寫說適合三歲以上的孩子。

items.en: I read the article, and it says the factory is closing.
items.zh: 我看了那篇報導，上面說那家工廠要關了。

items.en: It says on the website that the pool is open until nine.
items.zh: 網站上寫說游泳池開到九點。

items.en: Look at the sign. It says you can't take photos inside.
items.zh: 你看那個牌子，上面寫著裡面不能拍照。

examples.heading: ③ 書面資料 + tells + 人

items.en: Your advertisement tells us that the trip includes two nights in a hotel.
items.zh: 你們的廣告上寫說，這趟旅行包含兩晚的飯店住宿。

items.en: The map tells you that the toilets are next to the café.
items.zh: 地圖上標說廁所在咖啡館旁邊。

items.en: This leaflet tells you that the museum is free for students.
items.zh: 這份傳單上寫說博物館對學生免費。

items.en: The note on the door tells visitors that the office is upstairs.
items.zh: 門上的紙條告訴訪客辦公室在樓上。

items.en: The letter tells me that my passport is ready.
items.zh: 信上通知我護照辦好了。

examples.heading: ④ 複數的書面資料 + say

items.en: The rules say that you can't bring food into the library.
items.zh: 規定上說不能帶食物進圖書館。

items.en: The instructions say you should wait ten minutes.
items.zh: 說明書上說要等十分鐘。

items.en: The signs say the beach is closed for cleaning.
items.zh: 告示上說海灘因為清潔暫時關閉。

items.en: The reviews say the hotel is clean but noisy.
items.zh: 評論上說那家飯店很乾淨，但是很吵。

items.en: Her notes say that the meeting starts at two.
items.zh: 她的筆記上寫說會議兩點開始。

examples.heading: ⑤ explains / warns / claims

items.en: The guide explains how to get to the castle on foot.
items.zh: 導覽手冊上說明怎麼走路去城堡。

items.en: The article explains why prices are going up.
items.zh: 那篇文章解釋了物價為什麼一直漲。

items.en: The sign warns that the water is deep.
items.zh: 告示上警告說水很深。

items.en: The label warns that the medicine may make you sleepy.
items.zh: 標籤上警告說這個藥可能會讓人想睡。

items.en: The company claims that its phones last for ten years.
items.zh: 那家公司宣稱他們的手機可以用十年。

items.en: The advert claims you can learn French in a month.
items.zh: 那則廣告宣稱一個月就能學會法文。

examples.heading: ⑥ 省略 that

items.en: The timetable says the last bus is at midnight.
items.zh: 時刻表上說末班公車是午夜。

items.en: Your letter says you want to change your booking.
items.zh: 你的信上說你想更改訂位。

items.en: The app says we're five minutes away.
items.zh: App 上說我們還有五分鐘就到了。

items.en: The recipe says you need three eggs.
items.zh: 食譜上說需要三顆蛋。

items.en: This book says the castle was built in 1200.
items.zh: 這本書上說那座城堡是在 1200 年蓋的。

title: We were wondering what had happened, but then we realized that there had been a power cut.
translation: 我們本來在想到底發生了什麼事，後來才發現是停電了。
name: 過去進行式的引述動詞加 wh- 子句
sentences: I was wondering why he hadn't replied to my message.
She was wondering where she had left her glasses.
We were wondering who had sent the flowers.
He was wondering what his boss would say.
They were wondering how the dog had got out of the garden.
I was thinking which of the two courses would be more useful.
She was thinking how lucky she was to have such good friends.
We were thinking what we could buy for Mum's birthday.
He was thinking how much he missed his family.
I was thinking where we could go for the weekend.
I was wondering what to wear to the interview.
She was wondering how to tell her parents.
We were thinking where to stay in Lisbon.
He was wondering who to invite to the party.
They were thinking which train to take.
I was wondering when to start packing.
I was wondering if I had locked the front door.
She was wondering whether to accept the job.
We were wondering if the restaurant would still be open.
He was wondering whether he should call her back.
They were wondering if the rain would ever stop.
I was wondering where everyone was when the lights came on.
She was thinking what to cook when the phone rang.
We were wondering why the bus was late, but then we saw the accident.
While I was wondering how to fix it, my brother just switched it off and on again.
He was thinking what to say when she walked into the room.
My teacher told me she was wondering why I looked so tired.
Dad said he was wondering when we'd be home.
The neighbours were wondering who had moved into the house.
My friends were wondering how I had found out.
She said she was wondering what all the noise was about.

examples.heading: ① was / were wondering + wh 詞 + 子句

items.en: I was wondering why he hadn't replied to my message.
items.zh: 我那時在想他為什麼沒回我訊息。

items.en: She was wondering where she had left her glasses.
items.zh: 她在想她把眼鏡放到哪裡去了。

items.en: We were wondering who had sent the flowers.
items.zh: 我們在想花是誰送的。

items.en: He was wondering what his boss would say.
items.zh: 他在想老闆會怎麼說。

items.en: They were wondering how the dog had got out of the garden.
items.zh: 他們在想狗是怎麼跑出院子的。

examples.heading: ② was / were thinking + wh 詞 + 子句

items.en: I was thinking which of the two courses would be more useful.
items.zh: 我在想這兩門課哪一門比較有用。

items.en: She was thinking how lucky she was to have such good friends.
items.zh: 她在想自己有這麼好的朋友，真是幸運。

items.en: We were thinking what we could buy for Mum's birthday.
items.zh: 我們在想媽媽生日要買什麼給她。

items.en: He was thinking how much he missed his family.
items.zh: 他在想他有多想念家人。

items.en: I was thinking where we could go for the weekend.
items.zh: 我在想我們週末可以去哪裡。

examples.heading: ③ wh 詞 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: I was wondering what to wear to the interview.
items.zh: 我在想面試要穿什麼。

items.en: She was wondering how to tell her parents.
items.zh: 她在想要怎麼跟爸媽說。

items.en: We were thinking where to stay in Lisbon.
items.zh: 我們在想在里斯本要住哪裡。

items.en: He was wondering who to invite to the party.
items.zh: 他在想要邀誰來參加派對。

items.en: They were thinking which train to take.
items.zh: 他們在想要搭哪一班火車。

items.en: I was wondering when to start packing.
items.zh: 我在想什麼時候開始打包。

examples.heading: ④ if / whether

items.en: I was wondering if I had locked the front door.
items.zh: 我在想我到底有沒有鎖大門。

items.en: She was wondering whether to accept the job.
items.zh: 她在想要不要接受那份工作。

items.en: We were wondering if the restaurant would still be open.
items.zh: 我們在想那家餐廳是不是還開著。

items.en: He was wondering whether he should call her back.
items.zh: 他在想要不要回她電話。

items.en: They were wondering if the rain would ever stop.
items.zh: 他們在想這場雨到底會不會停。

examples.heading: ⑤ 想到一半被打斷

items.en: I was wondering where everyone was when the lights came on.
items.zh: 我正在想大家都去哪了，燈就亮了。

items.en: She was thinking what to cook when the phone rang.
items.zh: 她正在想要煮什麼，電話就響了。

items.en: We were wondering why the bus was late, but then we saw the accident.
items.zh: 我們本來在想公車為什麼遲到，後來才看到那場車禍。

items.en: While I was wondering how to fix it, my brother just switched it off and on again.
items.zh: 我還在想要怎麼修，我弟就直接把它關掉再打開。

items.en: He was thinking what to say when she walked into the room.
items.zh: 他正在想要說什麼，她就走進了房間。

examples.heading: ⑥ 轉述別人心裡想的問題

items.en: My teacher told me she was wondering why I looked so tired.
items.zh: 老師跟我說，她在想我為什麼看起來那麼累。

items.en: Dad said he was wondering when we'd be home.
items.zh: 爸爸說他在想我們什麼時候會到家。

items.en: The neighbours were wondering who had moved into the house.
items.zh: 鄰居們在想是誰搬進了那棟房子。

items.en: My friends were wondering how I had found out.
items.zh: 我朋友在想我是怎麼知道的。

items.en: She said she was wondering what all the noise was about.
items.zh: 她說她那時在想那些吵鬧聲是怎麼回事。

title: She had told me the previous day that she had something important to tell me.
translation: 她前一天就跟我說過，她有重要的事要告訴我。
name: 間接引述的時態和時間詞後移（過去事件）
sentences: She told me she had finished the book the day before.
He said he had sent the email the previous day.
They told us they had arrived the day before.
My boss said she had spoken to the client the previous day.
Anna said she had been ill the day before.
He said he would pay me back the next day.
She told us the shop would open the following day.
The teacher said we were going to have a test the next day.
My friend told me he was flying to Rome the following day.
They said the results would come out the next day.
She said she was too busy to see me that day.
He told me he was working late that night.
The nurse said the doctor wasn't coming in that day.
My sister said she would cook dinner that night.
They told me the bridge was closed that day.
He said he had moved house the week before.
She told me she had started the course two months before.
The manager said they had fixed the machine the previous week.
My uncle said he had sold his car a year earlier.
They told us the hotel had opened three weeks before.
She said she was going on holiday the following week.
He told me the new rules would start the following week.
The school said the exams would be the following week.
My landlord said he was going to paint the flat the following week.
He said he was too tired to talk then.
She told me she was living in a small flat at that time.
The waiter told us the fish there was very fresh.
She said she would finish the report that week.
I had told my parents the week before that I wanted to study abroad.
He had promised me the day before that he would help.
We had warned them the previous day that the road was dangerous.

examples.heading: ① yesterday → the day before / the previous day

items.en: She told me she had finished the book the day before.
items.zh: 她跟我說，她前一天把那本書看完了。

items.en: He said he had sent the email the previous day.
items.zh: 他說他前一天就寄了那封信。

items.en: They told us they had arrived the day before.
items.zh: 他們跟我們說，他們前一天就到了。

items.en: My boss said she had spoken to the client the previous day.
items.zh: 我老闆說她前一天跟客戶談過了。

items.en: Anna said she had been ill the day before.
items.zh: Anna 說她前一天生病了。

examples.heading: ② tomorrow → the next day / the following day

items.en: He said he would pay me back the next day.
items.zh: 他說他隔天會把錢還我。

items.en: She told us the shop would open the following day.
items.zh: 她跟我們說，那家店隔天會開。

items.en: The teacher said we were going to have a test the next day.
items.zh: 老師說我們隔天要考試。

items.en: My friend told me he was flying to Rome the following day.
items.zh: 我朋友跟我說他隔天要飛去羅馬。

items.en: They said the results would come out the next day.
items.zh: 他們說結果隔天會出來。

examples.heading: ③ today / tonight → that day / that night

items.en: She said she was too busy to see me that day.
items.zh: 她說她那天太忙，沒空見我。

items.en: He told me he was working late that night.
items.zh: 他跟我說他那天晚上要加班。

items.en: The nurse said the doctor wasn't coming in that day.
items.zh: 護士說醫生那天不會來。

items.en: My sister said she would cook dinner that night.
items.zh: 我妹妹說那天晚上她會煮晚餐。

items.en: They told me the bridge was closed that day.
items.zh: 他們跟我說那座橋那天封閉。

examples.heading: ④ last week / ago → the week before / before

items.en: He said he had moved house the week before.
items.zh: 他說他前一週剛搬家。

items.en: She told me she had started the course two months before.
items.zh: 她跟我說，她兩個月前就開始上那門課了。

items.en: The manager said they had fixed the machine the previous week.
items.zh: 經理說他們前一週修好了那台機器。

items.en: My uncle said he had sold his car a year earlier.
items.zh: 我叔叔說他一年前就把車賣了。

items.en: They told us the hotel had opened three weeks before.
items.zh: 他們跟我們說，那家飯店三週前才開幕。

examples.heading: ⑤ next week → the following week

items.en: She said she was going on holiday the following week.
items.zh: 她說她下一週要去度假。

items.en: He told me the new rules would start the following week.
items.zh: 他跟我說新規定下一週開始實施。

items.en: The school said the exams would be the following week.
items.zh: 學校說考試在下一週。

items.en: My landlord said he was going to paint the flat the following week.
items.zh: 我房東說他下一週要粉刷公寓。

examples.heading: ⑥ now / here / this → then / there / that

items.en: He said he was too tired to talk then.
items.zh: 他說他當時太累了，不想講話。

items.en: She told me she was living in a small flat at that time.
items.zh: 她跟我說她那時住在一間小公寓。

items.en: The waiter told us the fish there was very fresh.
items.zh: 服務生跟我們說那裡的魚很新鮮。

items.en: She said she would finish the report that week.
items.zh: 她說她那週會把報告寫完。

examples.heading: ⑦ 引述動詞用過去完成式

items.en: I had told my parents the week before that I wanted to study abroad.
items.zh: 我在前一週就跟爸媽說過我想出國念書。

items.en: He had promised me the day before that he would help.
items.zh: 他前一天就答應過我會幫忙。

items.en: We had warned them the previous day that the road was dangerous.

examples.heading: ① 現在簡單式 → 過去簡單式

items.en: I wondered who the man in the photo was.

items.en: She wondered what her new teacher's name was.
items.zh: 她很好奇新老師叫什麼名字。

items.en: We wondered how much the tickets cost.
items.zh: 我們很好奇票要多少錢。

items.en: He wondered why everyone was looking at him.

items.en: I wondered where the nearest bus stop was.
items.zh: 我在想最近的公車站在哪裡。

examples.heading: ② 現在完成式 / 過去簡單式 → 過去完成式

items.zh: 我很好奇是誰吃了最後一塊蛋糕。

items.en: She wondered how long he had lived in the city.
items.zh: 她很好奇他在這個城市住了多久。

items.en: We wondered why the plane had landed so early.

items.en: They wondered what had happened to their old friend.
items.zh: 他們很好奇他們的老朋友後來怎麼了。

items.en: I wondered when she had learned to speak Japanese.
items.zh: 我很好奇她是什麼時候學會說日語的。

items.en: He wondered where he had seen her before.
items.zh: 他在想他以前在哪裡見過她。

examples.heading: ③ will → would / can → could

items.en: I wondered what my parents would say.
items.zh: 我在想我爸媽會說什麼。

items.en: She wondered when the rain would stop.
items.zh: 她在想雨什麼時候會停。

items.en: We wondered how we could get home without a car.
items.zh: 我們在想沒有車要怎麼回家。

items.en: He wondered who would win the match.
items.zh: 他很好奇誰會贏那場比賽。

items.en: I wondered where I could buy a cheap phone.
items.zh: 我在想去哪裡可以買到便宜的手機。

examples.heading: ④ if / whether

items.en: I wondered if I had made the right choice.
items.zh: 我在想自己是不是做了對的選擇。

items.en: She wondered whether her friends would remember her birthday.
items.zh: 她在想朋友們會不會記得她的生日。

items.en: We wondered if the museum was open on Sundays.
items.zh: 我們在想博物館星期天有沒有開。

items.en: He wondered whether he should apologize.
items.zh: 他在想自己該不該道歉。

items.en: They wondered if the hotel had a pool.
items.zh: 他們在想飯店有沒有游泳池。

examples.heading: ⑤ wh 詞 + to + 原形動詞

items.en: I wondered what to buy for my sister.
items.zh: 我在想要買什麼給我妹妹。

items.en: She wondered which dress to wear.
items.zh: 她在想要穿哪一件洋裝。

items.en: He wondered how to start the letter.
items.zh: 他在想信要怎麼開頭。

items.en: We wondered where to park the car.
items.zh: 我們在想車要停在哪裡。

examples.heading: ⑥ 故事裡的想法

items.en: When I opened the box, I wondered who had sent it.
items.zh: 打開盒子的時候，我很好奇是誰寄來的。

items.en: I wondered who he was, but I didn't want to stare.
items.zh: 我很好奇他是誰，可是我不想一直盯著他看。

items.en: As we waited, we wondered what the doctor would tell us.
items.zh: 我們等的時候，一直在想醫生會跟我們說什麼。

items.en: She looked at the letter and wondered why he hadn't signed it.
items.zh: 她看著那封信，納悶他為什麼沒簽名。

items.en: The house was dark, and I wondered where everyone had gone.
items.zh: 屋子裡一片漆黑，我在想大家都去哪了。

items.en: He wondered how his life would be different in ten years.
items.zh: 他在想十年後他的生活會有什麼不一樣。

title: He said that it was his phone and he had left it in a cafe.
translation: 他說那是他的手機，他把它忘在一家咖啡廳了。
