examples.heading: ① 現在簡單式 → 過去簡單式

items.en: She said that she had a meeting at three.
items.zh: 她說她三點要開會。

items.en: My brother said he didn't like the film.
items.zh: 我哥哥說他不喜歡那部電影。

items.en: They said that our school was the best place for the film.
items.zh: 他們說我們學校是拍那部電影最好的地方。

items.en: The doctor said I needed more rest.
items.zh: 醫生說我需要多休息。

examples.heading: ② 現在進行式 → 過去進行式

items.en: He said that he was looking for a new job.
items.zh: 他說他在找新工作。

items.en: My neighbour told me they were building a garage.
items.zh: 我鄰居跟我說他們在蓋車庫。

items.en: She said she was feeling much better.
items.zh: 她說她覺得好多了。

items.en: Tom said his parents were staying with him that week.
items.zh: Tom 說他爸媽那個星期住在他那裡。

examples.heading: ③ 現在完成式 / 過去簡單式 → 過去完成式

items.en: She said she had won the lottery.
items.zh: 她說她中了樂透。

items.en: He told me he had never been on a plane.
items.zh: 他跟我說他從沒坐過飛機。

items.en: My friend said she had seen my sister at the station.
items.zh: 我朋友說她在車站看到我妹妹。

items.en: The boy said he had broken the window by accident.
items.zh: 男孩說他不小心打破了窗戶。

items.en: They said they had already eaten.
items.zh: 他們說他們已經吃過了。

examples.heading: ④ will → would / can → could

items.en: My aunt said she would send me a postcard.
items.zh: 我阿姨說她會寄明信片給我。

items.en: He told us he couldn't come to the wedding.
items.zh: 他跟我們說他不能來參加婚禮。

items.en: The mechanic said the car would be ready at five.
items.zh: 技師說車子五點會好。

items.en: She said she could speak three languages.
items.zh: 她說她會說三種語言。

examples.heading: ⑤ must / have to → had to

items.en: He said he had to work on Saturday.
items.zh: 他說他星期六得上班。

items.en: My mum said we had to be home by ten.
items.zh: 我媽說我們得在十點前回家。

items.en: The teacher said that everyone had to wear a helmet.
items.zh: 老師說每個人都得戴安全帽。

examples.heading: ⑥ told + 人 + that

items.en: Mary told me that she was getting married.
items.zh: Mary 跟我說她要結婚了。

items.en: He told his boss he was sick.
items.zh: 他跟老闆說他生病了。

items.en: The guide told us the museum was closed.
items.zh: 導遊跟我們說博物館沒開。

items.en: I told her that I had lost her book.
items.zh: 我跟她說我把她的書弄丟了。

items.en: Our teacher told us she was leaving the school.
items.zh: 我們老師跟我們說她要離開學校了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 用 and 連起來的子句

items.en: She said that she had won some money and she wanted to share it with me.
items.zh: 她說她贏了一些錢，想分一些給我。

items.en: He told me he was coming to Madrid and he would call me.
items.zh: 他跟我說他要來馬德里，還會打給我。

items.en: They said their car had broken down and they were waiting for help.
items.zh: 他們說他們的車拋錨了，正在等人來幫忙。

items.en: My dad said he was tired and he was going to bed.
items.zh: 我爸說他累了，要去睡了。

items.en: The woman said she had lost her dog and she was looking everywhere for it.
items.zh: 那個女人說她的狗走丟了，她到處在找。

items.en: Ben told us he had failed the test and he had to take it again.
items.zh: Ben 跟我們說他考試沒過，得重考。

title: At the airport they told him to come the next morning.
translation: 在機場，他們叫他隔天早上再來。
name: 轉述未來的事時的時間詞轉換
sentences: The mechanic said my car would be ready the next day.
My mum told me she would bake a cake the following day.
The airline said our bags would arrive the next day.
Leo promised he would return the book the following day.
The hotel told us the pool would be closed the next day.
The doctor said the operation would be the next morning.
They told us the ferry would leave early the next morning.
My dad said he would drive me to the station the following morning.
Sam said the band was playing in town the following night.
The guide said the sky would be clear the next night.
The company said I would get my reimbursement the following month.
She told me she was starting a new job the following week.
His lawyer said he would receive his inheritance the following year.
The landlord told us the rent would go up the following month.
They said the new bridge would be finished the following year.
My teacher said we would start a new book the following week.
The teacher told us to bring our swimsuits the next day.
The bank told me to call back the following morning.
My boss told me to take the next day off.
The doctor told him not to go to work the following week.
They told the students to meet at the gate the next morning.
My sister said she's flying to Tokyo next week.
The weather forecast said it will snow tomorrow.
Ben told me he'll be at the party tonight.
The school said the new term starts next Monday.
Grandma said she's going to visit us next month.
Mark said he would send me the photos tomorrow.
Anna told me she would finish the report next week.
The coach said I would be in the team next season.
The coach said that if I train hard, I'll play in the next match.
My mum said that if it's sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.

examples.heading: ① tomorrow → the next day / the following day

items.en: The mechanic said my car would be ready the next day.
items.zh: 技師說我的車隔天就會修好。

items.en: My mum told me she would bake a cake the following day.
items.zh: 我媽跟我說她隔天要烤蛋糕。

items.en: The airline said our bags would arrive the next day.
items.zh: 航空公司說我們的行李隔天會到。

items.en: Leo promised he would return the book the following day.
items.zh: Leo 答應隔天會把書還來。

items.en: The hotel told us the pool would be closed the next day.
items.zh: 飯店跟我們說泳池隔天不開放。

examples.heading: ② tomorrow morning / tomorrow night → the next morning / the following night

items.en: The doctor said the operation would be the next morning.
items.zh: 醫生說手術在隔天早上。

items.en: They told us the ferry would leave early the next morning.
items.zh: 他們跟我們說渡輪隔天一早就開。

items.en: My dad said he would drive me to the station the following morning.
items.zh: 我爸說他隔天早上會開車送我去車站。

items.en: Sam said the band was playing in town the following night.
items.zh: Sam 說那個樂團隔天晚上在城裡表演。

items.en: The guide said the sky would be clear the next night.
items.zh: 導遊說隔天晚上會是晴天。

examples.heading: ③ next week / month / year → the following week / month / year

items.en: The company said I would get my reimbursement the following month.
items.zh: 公司說我墊的錢隔月會退給我。

items.en: She told me she was starting a new job the following week.
items.zh: 她跟我說她隔週要開始新工作。

items.en: His lawyer said he would receive his inheritance the following year.
items.zh: 他的律師說他隔年會拿到遺產。

items.en: The landlord told us the rent would go up the following month.
items.zh: 房東跟我們說房租隔月要漲。

items.en: They said the new bridge would be finished the following year.
items.zh: 他們說新橋隔年會完工。

items.en: My teacher said we would start a new book the following week.
items.zh: 老師說我們隔週要換新課本。

examples.heading: ④ told + 聽的人 + to + 動詞 + 時間詞

items.en: The teacher told us to bring our swimsuits the next day.
items.zh: 老師叫我們隔天帶泳衣來。

items.en: The bank told me to call back the following morning.
items.zh: 銀行叫我隔天早上再打來。

items.en: My boss told me to take the next day off.
items.zh: 我老闆叫我隔天休假。

items.en: The doctor told him not to go to work the following week.
items.zh: 醫生叫他隔週別去上班。

items.en: They told the students to meet at the gate the next morning.
items.zh: 他們叫學生隔天早上在校門口集合。

examples.heading: ⑤ 時間還沒到，時間詞和時態照原話

items.en: My sister said she's flying to Tokyo next week.
items.zh: 我姊姊說她下週要飛東京。

items.en: The weather forecast said it will snow tomorrow.
items.zh: 氣象預報說明天會下雪。

items.en: Ben told me he'll be at the party tonight.
items.zh: Ben 跟我說他今晚會來派對。

items.en: The school said the new term starts next Monday.
items.zh: 學校說新學期下週一開始。

items.en: Grandma said she's going to visit us next month.
items.zh: 奶奶說她下個月要來看我們。

examples.heading: ⑥ 時間還沒到，will 換成 would

items.en: Mark said he would send me the photos tomorrow.
items.zh: Mark 說他明天會把照片傳給我。

items.en: Anna told me she would finish the report next week.
items.zh: Anna 跟我說她下週會把報告寫完。

items.en: The coach said I would be in the team next season.
items.zh: 教練說我下一季會進球隊。

examples.heading: ⑦ 時間還沒到，if 子句照原話

items.en: The coach said that if I train hard, I'll play in the next match.
items.zh: 教練說如果我努力練習，下一場比賽就能上場。

items.en: My mum said that if it's sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.
items.zh: 我媽說如果明天天氣好，我們就去海邊。

title: The Russian educational system differs dramatically from that of European, Asian or American countries.
translation: 俄羅斯的教育制度跟歐洲、亞洲或美洲國家的教育制度差別很大。
name: that of、those of 代替前面的名詞
sentences: The economy of China is now larger than that of Japan.
The price of a train ticket is higher than that of a bus ticket.
Her salary is almost double that of her husband.
The size of the new stadium is twice that of the old one.
The population of this city is smaller than that of the capital.
The quality of the food was much better than that of the service.
The climate of the north is colder than that of the south.
The speed of light is much greater than that of sound.
The taste of fresh bread is different from that of frozen bread.
The cost of housing is rising faster than that of food.
The results of this year are better than those of last year.
Our products meet the needs of young families, especially those of working parents.
The views of the students are different from those of the teachers.
His paintings are often compared with those of Monet.
The houses of the old town are smaller than those of the new suburbs.
The skills needed today differ from those of fifty years ago.
His experience is similar to that of many other immigrants.
This year's profit is double that of last year.
The rights of women should be equal to those of men.
The cost of living here is lower than that of most European cities.
The survey shows that the opinions of older people differ from those of the young.
The growth rate of the company is higher than that of the industry as a whole.
The effect of the new drug was compared with that of a placebo.
The teaching methods of our school are similar to those of Finnish schools.
The income of rural families is lower than that of urban families.
Your views clearly do not reflect those of the general public.
The service at your hotel did not match that of other hotels in the area.
I believe the interests of local people are more important than those of tourists.
The needs of patients must come before those of the hospital.
The design of your website is much clearer than that of your competitors.
The opinions in the article are not those of most readers.

examples.heading: ① that of + 單數名詞

items.en: The economy of China is now larger than that of Japan.
items.zh: 中國的經濟規模現在比日本大。

items.en: The price of a train ticket is higher than that of a bus ticket.
items.zh: 火車票的價錢比公車票高。

items.en: Her salary is almost double that of her husband.
items.zh: 她的薪水幾乎是她先生的兩倍。

items.en: The size of the new stadium is twice that of the old one.
items.zh: 新體育館的大小是舊的兩倍。

items.en: The population of this city is smaller than that of the capital.
items.zh: 這座城市的人口比首都少。

examples.heading: ② that of + 不可數名詞

items.en: The quality of the food was much better than that of the service.
items.zh: 食物的品質比服務好很多。

items.en: The climate of the north is colder than that of the south.
items.zh: 北部的氣候比南部冷。

items.en: The speed of light is much greater than that of sound.
items.zh: 光速比音速快很多。

items.en: The taste of fresh bread is different from that of frozen bread.
items.zh: 新鮮麵包的味道和冷凍麵包不一樣。

items.en: The cost of housing is rising faster than that of food.
items.zh: 房價上漲的速度比食物快。

examples.heading: ③ those of + 複數名詞

items.en: The results of this year are better than those of last year.
items.zh: 今年的成績比去年好。

items.en: Our products meet the needs of young families, especially those of working parents.
items.zh: 我們的產品符合年輕家庭的需要，特別是雙薪父母的需要。

items.en: The views of the students are different from those of the teachers.
items.zh: 學生的看法和老師的看法不一樣。

items.en: His paintings are often compared with those of Monet.
items.zh: 他的畫常被拿來和莫內的畫比較。

items.en: The houses of the old town are smaller than those of the new suburbs.
items.zh: 老城區的房子比新郊區的房子小。

examples.heading: ④ 在比較句裡

items.en: The skills needed today differ from those of fifty years ago.
items.zh: 今天需要的技能和五十年前的不一樣。

items.en: His experience is similar to that of many other immigrants.
items.zh: 他的經歷和其他很多移民的經歷很像。

items.en: This year's profit is double that of last year.
items.zh: 今年的利潤是去年的兩倍。

items.en: The rights of women should be equal to those of men.
items.zh: 女性的權利應該和男性的權利平等。

items.en: The cost of living here is lower than that of most European cities.
items.zh: 這裡的生活費比大部分歐洲城市低。

examples.heading: ⑤ 報告和論文

items.en: The survey shows that the opinions of older people differ from those of the young.
items.zh: 調查顯示，老年人的意見和年輕人的意見不一樣。

items.en: The growth rate of the company is higher than that of the industry as a whole.
items.zh: 這家公司的成長率比整個產業高。

items.en: The effect of the new drug was compared with that of a placebo.
items.zh: 新藥的效果被拿來和安慰劑的效果比較。

items.en: The teaching methods of our school are similar to those of Finnish schools.
items.zh: 我們學校的教學方法和芬蘭學校的教學方法很像。

items.en: The income of rural families is lower than that of urban families.
items.zh: 鄉村家庭的收入比都市家庭低。

examples.heading: ⑥ 寫給報社和公司的信

items.en: Your views clearly do not reflect those of the general public.
items.zh: 你們的看法顯然不能代表一般民眾的看法。

items.en: The service at your hotel did not match that of other hotels in the area.
items.zh: 你們飯店的服務比不上這一區其他飯店的服務。

items.en: I believe the interests of local people are more important than those of tourists.
items.zh: 我認為當地人的利益比觀光客的利益重要。

items.en: The needs of patients must come before those of the hospital.
items.zh: 病人的需要必須放在醫院的需要前面。

items.en: The design of your website is much clearer than that of your competitors.
items.zh: 你們網站的設計比競爭對手的清楚很多。

items.en: The opinions in the article are not those of most readers.
items.zh: 文章裡的意見並不是大部分讀者的意見。

title: I cannot agree with you, Mr. Brown.
translation: Brown 先生，我無法同意您的看法。
name: 不縮寫的 not
sentences: I cannot agree with the council's plan to close the library.
I am writing because the heating in my flat does not work.
Unfortunately, I will not be able to attend the meeting on 3 May.
We do not have any rooms available on those dates.
I have not received the package that I ordered on 10 June.
The company did not answer my first letter, so I am writing again.
Keeping animals in zoos will not help them survive in the wild.
Many young people do not read newspapers any more.
The government should not close the small village schools.
A high salary does not always make people happy.
Without public transport, many old people would not be able to go shopping.
The study did not find any link between coffee and heart disease.
Do not lean out of the window while the train is moving.
Do not open the door while the machine is running.
We cannot exchange or refund tickets.
Do not leave children alone in the car.
Do not drive for six hours after you take this medicine.
"You ate my sandwich." "I did not eat your sandwich! It was the dog."
I am not going to say sorry. I did nothing wrong.
"Are you tired?" "I am not tired. I just don't want to go."
No, you cannot have ice cream before dinner.
I do not want to hear another word about it.
I will not lend him money again. He never pays it back.
The car will not start, and I've tried everything.
I would not eat anything from that kitchen. It's very dirty.
Our dog has been missing for three days, but we will not stop looking.
You will not speak to your sister like that!
Do not touch the oven, Lily. It's hot.
You are not leaving this house until your room is tidy.
You will not go out in this storm. It's too dangerous.
We do not hit people in this family, Sam.

examples.heading: ① 正式的信：cannot / do not / will not

items.en: I cannot agree with the council's plan to close the library.
items.zh: 我無法同意市議會關閉圖書館的計畫。

items.en: I am writing because the heating in my flat does not work.
items.zh: 我寫這封信是因為我公寓的暖氣壞了。

items.en: Unfortunately, I will not be able to attend the meeting on 3 May.
items.zh: 很遺憾，我無法出席五月三日的會議。

items.en: We do not have any rooms available on those dates.
items.zh: 那幾天我們沒有空房。

items.en: I have not received the package that I ordered on 10 June.
items.zh: 我六月十日訂的包裹還沒收到。

items.en: The company did not answer my first letter, so I am writing again.
items.zh: 貴公司沒有回覆我的第一封信，所以我再寫一次。

examples.heading: ② 正式的文章：報告和評論

items.en: Keeping animals in zoos will not help them survive in the wild.
items.zh: 把動物關在動物園，對牠們在野外生存沒有幫助。

items.en: Many young people do not read newspapers any more.
items.zh: 很多年輕人已經不看報紙了。

items.en: The government should not close the small village schools.
items.zh: 政府不應該關閉鄉下的小學校。

items.en: A high salary does not always make people happy.
items.zh: 高薪不一定會讓人快樂。

items.en: Without public transport, many old people would not be able to go shopping.
items.zh: 沒有大眾運輸，很多老人就沒辦法去買東西。

items.en: The study did not find any link between coffee and heart disease.
items.zh: 這項研究沒有發現咖啡和心臟病之間有任何關聯。

examples.heading: ③ 告示和說明書：Do not / cannot

items.en: Do not lean out of the window while the train is moving.
items.zh: 火車行駛時請勿將身體探出窗外。

items.en: Do not open the door while the machine is running.
items.zh: 機器運轉時請勿開門。

items.en: We cannot exchange or refund tickets.
items.zh: 本公司票券恕不退換。

items.en: Do not leave children alone in the car.
items.zh: 請勿將兒童單獨留在車內。

items.en: Do not drive for six hours after you take this medicine.
items.zh: 服用本藥後六小時內請勿開車。

examples.heading: ④ 說話時加強語氣：反駁和拒絕

items.en: "You ate my sandwich." "I did not eat your sandwich! It was the dog."
items.zh: 你吃了我的三明治。我真的沒吃你的三明治！是狗吃的。

items.en: I am not going to say sorry. I did nothing wrong.
items.zh: 我才不要道歉。我又沒做錯事。

items.en: "Are you tired?" "I am not tired. I just don't want to go."
items.zh: 你累了嗎？我才不累。我只是不想去。

items.en: No, you cannot have ice cream before dinner.
items.zh: 不行，晚餐前不可以吃冰淇淋。

items.en: I do not want to hear another word about it.
items.zh: 這件事我一個字都不想再聽了。

examples.heading: ⑤ 說話時加強語氣：will not / would not

items.en: I will not lend him money again. He never pays it back.
items.zh: 我絕對不會再借他錢了。他從來不還。

items.en: The car will not start, and I've tried everything.
items.zh: 車子就是發不動，我什麼方法都試過了。

items.en: I would not eat anything from that kitchen. It's very dirty.
items.zh: 那間廚房做的東西我絕對不吃。那裡很髒。

items.en: Our dog has been missing for three days, but we will not stop looking.
items.zh: 我們的狗已經走失三天了，可是我們絕不停止找牠。

examples.heading: ⑥ 父母和老師的命令

items.en: You will not speak to your sister like that!
items.zh: 你不准那樣跟你妹妹說話！

items.en: Do not touch the oven, Lily. It's hot.
items.zh: Lily，不准碰烤箱。很燙。

items.en: You are not leaving this house until your room is tidy.
items.zh: 房間沒整理好，你不准出門。

items.en: You will not go out in this storm. It's too dangerous.
items.zh: 這種暴風雨你不准出門。太危險了。

items.en: We do not hit people in this family, Sam.
items.zh: Sam，我們家不可以打人。

title: I'm going to get up early on Saturday.
translation: 我星期六要早起。
name: 不及物片語動詞
sentences: "Why are you so tired?" "I got up at five to catch the train."
My little brother wakes up at six every morning, even on Sundays.
On holiday we don't get up until ten.
I woke up in the night because of the storm.
Every day I can see the sea when I wake up.
"Shall we go out tonight?" "Good idea. There's a new film on."
My parents go out for dinner every Friday.
"When is Dad coming back?" "He'll be back at six."
She went to Spain last year, and she wants to go back.
"Hello? Can I come in?" "Yes, come in! The door's open."
If you have time, you can come over and I'll introduce you to my friends.
"Whose bag is this?" "Anna's. She came over for lunch."
It's raining. Come in and have a cup of tea.
"Please sit down," said the doctor.
The students stood up when the teacher came in.
There were no chairs, so we sat down on the floor.
Stand up, please. We're going to sing the song.
"Are you free on Saturday?" "Yes. Let's meet up at the café at two."
My old classmates meet up once a year.
We met up after work and went to the cinema.
"Hurry up! The bus is coming!"
My sister was in the bathroom for an hour, so I told her to hurry up.
"Go away! I'm busy," my brother shouted.
We're going away for the weekend.
I'm going to get up early tomorrow and go running.
"Can you come over on Sunday?" "Sure, I'll come over after lunch."
We're going out for pizza tonight. Do you want to come?
"What time did you wake up this morning?" "Around nine. I was so tired."
"Did you go out last night?" "No, I stayed at home."
The baby didn't wake up all night.
Don't stand up in the boat!

examples.heading: ① get up / wake up

items.en: "Why are you so tired?" "I got up at five to catch the train."
items.zh: 你怎麼這麼累？我五點就起床趕火車。

items.en: My little brother wakes up at six every morning, even on Sundays.
items.zh: 我弟弟每天早上六點就醒了，連星期天也一樣。

items.en: On holiday we don't get up until ten.
items.zh: 放假的時候，我們十點才起床。

items.en: I woke up in the night because of the storm.
items.zh: 暴風雨讓我半夜醒了過來。

items.en: Every day I can see the sea when I wake up.
items.zh: 每天我醒來都能看到海。

examples.heading: ② go out / come back

items.en: "Shall we go out tonight?" "Good idea. There's a new film on."
items.zh: 我們今晚要不要出去？好主意。有部新電影上映了。

items.en: My parents go out for dinner every Friday.
items.zh: 我爸媽每個星期五都出去吃晚餐。

items.en: "When is Dad coming back?" "He'll be back at six."
items.zh: 爸爸什麼時候回來？他六點會回來。

items.en: She went to Spain last year, and she wants to go back.
items.zh: 她去年去了西班牙，還想再回去。

examples.heading: ③ come in / come over

items.en: "Hello? Can I come in?" "Yes, come in! The door's open."
items.zh: 哈囉？我可以進來嗎？可以，進來！門沒鎖。

items.en: If you have time, you can come over and I'll introduce you to my friends.
items.zh: 你有時間的話可以過來，我介紹我的朋友給你認識。

items.en: "Whose bag is this?" "Anna's. She came over for lunch."
items.zh: 這是誰的包包？Anna 的。她過來吃午餐。

items.en: It's raining. Come in and have a cup of tea.
items.zh: 下雨了。進來喝杯茶吧。

examples.heading: ④ sit down / stand up

items.en: "Please sit down," said the doctor.
items.zh: 請坐，醫生說。

items.en: The students stood up when the teacher came in.
items.zh: 老師進來的時候，學生們站了起來。

items.en: There were no chairs, so we sat down on the floor.
items.zh: 沒有椅子，所以我們坐在地上。

items.en: Stand up, please. We're going to sing the song.
items.zh: 請站起來。我們要唱這首歌了。

examples.heading: ⑤ meet up

items.en: "Are you free on Saturday?" "Yes. Let's meet up at the café at two."
items.zh: 你星期六有空嗎？有。我們兩點在咖啡店碰面吧。

items.en: My old classmates meet up once a year.
items.zh: 我的老同學一年聚一次。

items.en: We met up after work and went to the cinema.
items.zh: 我們下班後碰面，去看了電影。

examples.heading: ⑥ hurry up / go away

items.en: "Hurry up! The bus is coming!"
items.zh: 快一點！公車來了！

items.en: My sister was in the bathroom for an hour, so I told her to hurry up.
items.zh: 我姊姊在浴室待了一個小時，所以我叫她快一點。

items.en: "Go away! I'm busy," my brother shouted.
items.zh: 走開！我在忙，我弟弟大叫。

items.en: We're going away for the weekend.
items.zh: 我們這個週末要出去玩。

examples.heading: ⑦ 未來的計畫

items.en: I'm going to get up early tomorrow and go running.
items.zh: 我明天要早起去跑步。

items.en: "Can you come over on Sunday?" "Sure, I'll come over after lunch."
items.zh: 你星期天可以過來嗎？好啊，我吃完午餐就過去。

items.en: We're going out for pizza tonight. Do you want to come?
items.zh: 我們今晚要出去吃披薩。你要來嗎？

examples.heading: ⑧ 問句和否定

items.en: "What time did you wake up this morning?" "Around nine. I was so tired."
items.zh: 你今天早上幾點醒來的？九點左右。我好累。

items.en: "Did you go out last night?" "No, I stayed at home."
items.zh: 你昨晚有出去嗎？沒有，我待在家。

items.en: The baby didn't wake up all night.
items.zh: 寶寶整晚都沒醒。

items.en: Don't stand up in the boat!
items.zh: 在船上不要站起來！

title: After having breakfast, I started doing my homework.
translation: 吃完早餐後，我開始寫功課。
name: before、after 加動詞-ing 表示時間
sentences: Before going to the interview, she practiced her answers.
Before buying a new phone, read some reviews.
Before starting the test, write your name at the top.
Before moving to Taipei, I lived in a small village.
Before cooking the rice, wash it two or three times.
Before leaving the office, he always tidies his desk.
After finishing school, my brother joined the army.
After watching the news, I felt a bit worried.
After talking to her teacher, she felt much better.
After checking into the hotel, we went straight to the night market.
After spending a year in London, he came back with a British accent.
After having a shower, I felt wide awake.
Always warm up before running.
She checked the price twice before paying.
We had a coffee before catching the train.
Think carefully before saying yes.
I usually read the news before getting up.
You can watch TV after finishing your homework.
I always feel sleepy after eating rice.
He went straight to bed after getting home.
She started a business after leaving university.
My legs hurt after climbing the mountain.
Before signing anything, ask a lawyer.
After losing his job, he decided to retrain as a nurse.
Turn off the oven after taking the cake out.
After saying goodbye, she got into the taxi.
Before going abroad, check that your passport is valid.
They reconciled after not speaking for a year.
After reading the instructions, I still didn't understand.
Please knock before entering.

examples.heading: ① Before + 動詞-ing 放在前面

items.en: Before going to the interview, she practiced her answers.
items.zh: 去面試之前，她先練習了她的回答。

items.en: Before buying a new phone, read some reviews.
items.zh: 買新手機之前，先看看評價。

items.en: Before starting the test, write your name at the top.
items.zh: 開始考試前，先在最上面寫上你的名字。

items.en: Before moving to Taipei, I lived in a small village.
items.zh: 搬到台北之前，我住在一個小村子。

items.en: Before cooking the rice, wash it two or three times.
items.zh: 煮飯之前，先把米洗兩三次。

items.en: Before leaving the office, he always tidies his desk.
items.zh: 離開辦公室前，他都會整理桌子。

examples.heading: ② After + 動詞-ing 放在前面

items.en: After finishing school, my brother joined the army.
items.zh: 我哥哥畢業後去當兵了。

items.en: After watching the news, I felt a bit worried.
items.zh: 看完新聞後，我覺得有點擔心。

items.en: After talking to her teacher, she felt much better.
items.zh: 跟老師談過之後，她覺得好多了。

items.en: After checking into the hotel, we went straight to the night market.
items.zh: 辦好飯店入住後，我們直接去了夜市。

items.en: After spending a year in London, he came back with a British accent.
items.zh: 在倫敦待了一年之後，他帶著英國口音回來了。

items.en: After having a shower, I felt wide awake.
items.zh: 洗完澡後，我整個人都清醒了。

examples.heading: ③ before + 動詞-ing 放在後面

items.en: Always warm up before running.
items.zh: 跑步前一定要暖身。

items.en: She checked the price twice before paying.
items.zh: 她付錢前確認了兩次價錢。

items.en: We had a coffee before catching the train.
items.zh: 我們搭火車前先喝了一杯咖啡。

items.en: Think carefully before saying yes.
items.zh: 答應之前要仔細想想。

items.en: I usually read the news before getting up.
items.zh: 我通常起床前會看新聞。

examples.heading: ④ after + 動詞-ing 放在後面

items.en: You can watch TV after finishing your homework.
items.zh: 你寫完功課以後就可以看電視。

items.en: I always feel sleepy after eating rice.
items.zh: 我吃完飯以後都會想睡覺。

items.en: He went straight to bed after getting home.
items.zh: 他回到家後就直接上床睡覺了。

items.en: She started a business after leaving university.
items.zh: 她大學畢業後開始創業。

items.en: My legs hurt after climbing the mountain.
items.zh: 爬完山以後我的腿好痠。

examples.heading: ⑤ 不同的情境

items.en: Before signing anything, ask a lawyer.
items.zh: 簽任何東西之前，先問律師。

items.en: After losing his job, he decided to retrain as a nurse.
items.zh: 丟了工作之後，他決定重新受訓當護理師。

items.en: Turn off the oven after taking the cake out.
items.zh: 把蛋糕拿出來以後，把烤箱關掉。

items.en: After saying goodbye, she got into the taxi.
items.zh: 道別之後，她坐上了計程車。

items.en: Before going abroad, check that your passport is valid.
items.zh: 出國之前，確認你的護照還有效。

items.en: They reconciled after not speaking for a year.
items.zh: 他們一年沒說話以後和好了。

items.en: After reading the instructions, I still didn't understand.
items.zh: 讀完說明以後，我還是不懂。

items.en: Please knock before entering.
items.zh: 進來之前請先敲門。

title: I'm working today.
translation: 我今天要上班。
name: be 動詞當助動詞（現在進行式）
sentences: "Can I call you back? I'm driving."
"Where's Mum?" "She's sleeping. She had a long day."
"Let's walk to the shop." "Wait, it's raining. Let's take the car."
"What are the kids doing?" "They're playing in the garden."
Shh! The baby is sleeping in the next room.
I can't talk now. We're having dinner.
My brother is studying medicine in Taichung.
"How's your English?" "Better. I'm taking classes on Tuesday evenings."
Dear Ben, I am writing to tell you about my first week at college.
We're living with my parents until our new flat is ready.
She's learning to swim this summer.
"Do you want to have lunch?" "Sorry, I'm working today."
We are going to the park on Sunday. Do you want to come?
My parents are flying to Japan tomorrow morning.
"What are you doing this weekend?" "I'm visiting my grandma."
Tom is having a party on Saturday, and he's inviting everyone in our class.
"Are you coming with us?" "No, I'm not coming. I've got a cold."
"Can you print this for me?" "Sorry, the printer in our office isn't working."
Turn off the TV. You aren't watching it.
My sister isn't living at home this year. She's in London.
"Are you working today?" "No, it's my day off."
"Is the bus coming?" "Yes, I can see it at the corner."
"Why are you laughing?" "Look at the dog. He's wearing your hat!"
"Who is your sister talking to?" "That's her new boss."
Please be quiet. I'm writing an important email.
"Where's Ann?" "She's sitting by the window."
My dad is running in the city marathon on Sunday.
We're making a cake for Grandpa's birthday.
"Mum, the dog is swimming in the lake!" "Oh no, get him out!"
"Are you leaving already?" "Yes, my bus comes in five minutes."

examples.heading: ① 說話的時候正在做的事

items.en: "Can I call you back? I'm driving."
items.zh: 我晚點再打給你好嗎？我在開車。

items.en: "Where's Mum?" "She's sleeping. She had a long day."
items.zh: 媽媽在哪裡？她在睡覺。她今天很累。

items.en: "Let's walk to the shop." "Wait, it's raining. Let's take the car."
items.zh: 我們走路去商店吧。等一下，在下雨。我們開車去吧。

items.en: "What are the kids doing?" "They're playing in the garden."
items.zh: 孩子們在做什麼？他們在院子裡玩。

items.en: Shh! The baby is sleeping in the next room.
items.zh: 噓！寶寶在隔壁房間睡覺。

items.en: I can't talk now. We're having dinner.
items.zh: 我現在不能講電話。我們在吃晚餐。

examples.heading: ② 這段時間在做的事

items.en: My brother is studying medicine in Taichung.
items.zh: 我哥哥在台中讀醫學系。

items.en: "How's your English?" "Better. I'm taking classes on Tuesday evenings."
items.zh: 你的英文怎麼樣？進步了。我現在每週二晚上都去上課。

items.en: Dear Ben, I am writing to tell you about my first week at college.
items.zh: 親愛的 Ben，我寫信來跟你說我在大學第一週的事。

items.en: We're living with my parents until our new flat is ready.
items.zh: 在我們的新公寓弄好之前，我們都跟我爸媽住。

items.en: She's learning to swim this summer.
items.zh: 她這個夏天在學游泳。

examples.heading: ③ 已經安排好的計畫

items.en: "Do you want to have lunch?" "Sorry, I'm working today."
items.zh: 要一起吃午餐嗎？抱歉，我今天要上班。

items.en: We are going to the park on Sunday. Do you want to come?
items.zh: 我們星期天要去公園。你要一起來嗎？

items.en: My parents are flying to Japan tomorrow morning.
items.zh: 我爸媽明天早上要飛日本。

items.en: "What are you doing this weekend?" "I'm visiting my grandma."
items.zh: 你這個週末要做什麼？我要去看我奶奶。

items.en: Tom is having a party on Saturday, and he's inviting everyone in our class.
items.zh: Tom 星期六要辦派對，他要邀請我們班上的每個人。

examples.heading: ④ 否定

items.en: "Are you coming with us?" "No, I'm not coming. I've got a cold."
items.zh: 你要跟我們一起去嗎？不，我不去。我感冒了。

items.en: "Can you print this for me?" "Sorry, the printer in our office isn't working."
items.zh: 你可以幫我印這個嗎？抱歉，我們辦公室的印表機壞了。

items.en: Turn off the TV. You aren't watching it.
items.zh: 把電視關掉。你又沒在看。

items.en: My sister isn't living at home this year. She's in London.
items.zh: 我妹妹今年沒住在家裡。她在倫敦。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句

items.en: "Are you working today?" "No, it's my day off."
items.zh: 你今天要上班嗎？不用，今天我休假。

items.en: "Is the bus coming?" "Yes, I can see it at the corner."
items.zh: 公車來了嗎？來了，我看到它在轉角。

items.en: "Why are you laughing?" "Look at the dog. He's wearing your hat!"
items.zh: 你在笑什麼？你看那隻狗。牠戴著你的帽子！

items.en: "Who is your sister talking to?" "That's her new boss."
items.zh: 你姊姊在跟誰講話？那是她的新老闆。

examples.heading: ⑥ 動詞-ing 的拼法

items.zh: 請安靜一點。我在寫一封很重要的電子郵件。

items.zh: Ann 在哪裡？她坐在窗邊。

items.zh: 我爸星期天要跑城市馬拉松。

items.zh: 我們在為爺爺的生日做蛋糕。

items.zh: 媽，狗在湖裡游泳！糟了，快把牠弄上來！

items.en: "Are you leaving already?" "Yes, my bus comes in five minutes."
items.zh: 你已經要走了嗎？對，我的公車五分鐘後就來了。

title: Why didn't you come to my birthday party?

We don't have class on Wednesday afternoons.

"Do you like shopping?" "Not really. I prefer buying things online."
"Does your sister work here?" "Yes, she works in the shop downstairs."
"What time do you usually get up?" "At half past six."
Why didn't you come to my birthday party? We missed you.

The children didn't want to leave the zoo.
"Do you want to come with us?" "Yes, I do. I'm really excited about the trip."
"Does your flat have a balcony?" "No, it doesn't."
"Did you lock the door?" "Yes, I did. Don't worry."
"Have you met my brother?" "No, I haven't."
"Has your son started school?" "Yes, he has. He loves it."
I thought I wouldn't find nice clothes in that shop, but surprisingly, I did.
My sister likes horror films, but I don't.
"I need a coffee before the meeting." "So do I. Let's go to the café."
Everyone said he would fail the test, but he didn't.
"Who broke the window?" "Tom did."

examples.heading: ① 助動詞 have：肯定

items.en: Sorry, I think I have left my suitcase at your house.
items.zh: 抱歉，我好像把行李箱留在你家了。

items.en: Dear Maria, it has been a long time since I last saw you.
items.zh: 親愛的 Maria，好久沒見到你了。

items.en: "Is Tom still at work?" "No, he's gone home."
items.zh: Tom 還在上班嗎？沒有，他回家了。

items.en: We've booked a table for eight o'clock.
items.zh: 我們訂了八點的位子。

examples.heading: ② 助動詞 have：否定

items.en: I'm sorry I haven't emailed you in a long time.
items.zh: 抱歉我很久沒寫電子郵件給你了。

items.en: "Can we eat?" "Not yet. Dad hasn't come home."
items.zh: 可以吃了嗎？還不行。爸爸還沒回家。

items.en: I haven't read the book, so don't tell me the ending.
items.zh: 我還沒看那本書，所以別告訴我結局。

examples.heading: ③ 助動詞 have：問句

items.en: "Have you got a mobile phone?" "Yes, but it's very old."
items.zh: 你有手機嗎？有，可是很舊了。

items.en: "Have you ever been to Japan?" "Yes, twice."
items.zh: 你去過日本嗎？去過，兩次。

items.en: "Has the bus left?" "Yes, you just missed it."
items.zh: 公車走了嗎？走了，你剛好錯過。

examples.heading: ④ 助動詞 do：現在簡單式的否定

items.en: My daughter doesn't eat vegetables, so I hide them in her soup.
items.zh: 我女兒不吃蔬菜，所以我把蔬菜藏在她的湯裡。

items.en: We don't have class on Wednesday afternoons.
items.zh: 我們星期三下午沒課。

items.en: "Why are you walking?" "My car doesn't start in cold weather."
items.zh: 你怎麼用走的？我的車天冷就發不動。

examples.heading: ⑤ 助動詞 do：現在簡單式的問句

items.en: "Do you like shopping?" "Not really. I prefer buying things online."
items.zh: 你喜歡逛街嗎？不太喜歡。我比較喜歡在網路上買東西。

items.en: "Does your sister work here?" "Yes, she works in the shop downstairs."
items.zh: 你姊姊在這裡上班嗎？對，她在樓下的店上班。

items.en: "What time do you usually get up?" "At half past six."
items.zh: 你平常幾點起床？六點半。

examples.heading: ⑥ 助動詞 do：過去簡單式的否定和問句

items.en: Why didn't you come to my birthday party? We missed you.
items.zh: 你為什麼沒來我的生日派對？我們都很想你。

items.en: "Did you buy a new mobile phone?" "Yes, my old one broke."
items.zh: 你買了新手機嗎？對，我的舊手機壞了。

items.en: I didn't sleep well last night because of the noise next door.
items.zh: 隔壁太吵，我昨晚沒睡好。

items.en: "Where did you go on holiday?" "We went to the beach in Kenting."
items.zh: 你去哪裡度假？我們去了墾丁的海邊。

items.en: The children didn't want to leave the zoo.
items.zh: 孩子們不想離開動物園。

examples.heading: ⑦ 簡答

items.en: "Do you want to come with us?" "Yes, I do. I'm really excited about the trip."
items.zh: 你想跟我們一起去嗎？想。我很期待這趟旅行。

items.en: "Does your flat have a balcony?" "No, it doesn't."
items.zh: 你的公寓有陽台嗎？沒有。

items.en: "Did you lock the door?" "Yes, I did. Don't worry."
items.zh: 你鎖門了嗎？鎖了。別擔心。

items.en: "Have you met my brother?" "No, I haven't."
items.zh: 你見過我哥哥嗎？沒見過。

items.en: "Has your son started school?" "Yes, he has. He loves it."
items.zh: 你兒子開始上學了嗎？開始了。他很喜歡。

examples.heading: ⑧ 代替前面的動詞

items.en: I thought I wouldn't find nice clothes in that shop, but surprisingly, I did.
items.zh: 我以為在那家店找不到好看的衣服，沒想到找到了。

items.en: My sister likes horror films, but I don't.
items.zh: 我姊姊喜歡恐怖片，可是我不喜歡。

items.en: "I need a coffee before the meeting." "So do I. Let's go to the café."
items.zh: 開會前我需要來杯咖啡。我也是。我們去咖啡廳吧。

items.en: Everyone said he would fail the test, but he didn't.
items.zh: 大家都說他考試會不及格，結果他沒有。

items.en: "Who broke the window?" "Tom did."
items.zh: 誰打破窗戶的？Tom。

examples.heading: ① be + 形容詞

items.zh: 進來吧！廚房很亂，因為我們在油漆。

items.zh: 你的新鞋好好看。

examples.heading: ③ be + from + 地方

items.zh: Martin 是波蘭人，不過他現在住在倫敦。

items.zh: 你的英文很好，你是加拿大人嗎？

items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶來自威爾斯的一個小村子。

items.zh: 昨晚的音樂會好聽嗎？我沒辦法去。

items.zh: 跟你妹妹在一起的那個女生是誰？

items.en: What's the name of that new café near the station?
items.zh: 車站附近那家新咖啡店叫什麼名字？

examples.heading: ① enjoy + 動詞-ing

items.zh: 我姊姊和我很愛音樂。我們喜歡一起彈鋼琴、唱歌。

items.en: You know I really enjoy listening to music, so the concert tickets are a perfect present.
items.zh: 你知道我真的很喜歡聽音樂，所以演唱會的票是最棒的禮物。

items.en: My grandmother enjoys working in her garden every morning.
items.zh: 我奶奶喜歡每天早上在她的花園裡做事。

items.en: "Why do you walk to work?" "I enjoy walking. It helps me think."
items.zh: 你為什麼走路上班？我喜歡走路。走路能幫我想事情。

items.en: Our son enjoys building things with his toy bricks.
items.zh: 我們兒子喜歡用積木蓋東西。

items.en: I enjoy cooking for my friends at the weekend.
items.zh: 我週末喜歡煮飯給朋友吃。

items.en: Most children enjoy being outside.
items.zh: 大部分的小孩都喜歡待在戶外。

examples.heading: ② enjoy + 兩個動詞-ing

items.zh: 度假的時候，我們喜歡早上游泳、下午看書。

items.zh: 我叔叔喜歡在湖邊釣魚和露營。

items.zh: 她喜歡素描和畫畫，所以她想念藝術。

items.en: Now that they've retired, my parents enjoy travelling and trying new food.
items.zh: 我爸媽退休以後，喜歡到處旅行、嚐嚐新的食物。

examples.heading: ③ enjoyed：過去

items.en: We really enjoyed staying at your house. Thank you!
items.zh: 我們很喜歡住在你家。謝謝你！

items.en: The kids enjoyed feeding the ducks at the park.
items.zh: 孩子們在公園餵鴨子餵得很開心。

items.en: I enjoyed working with you on this project.
items.zh: 我很高興能和你一起做這個計畫。

items.en: When I was young, I enjoyed climbing trees with my brother.
items.zh: 我小時候喜歡跟我哥一起爬樹。

examples.heading: ④ 否定

items.zh: 她不喜歡住在大城市，所以搬回家了。

items.zh: 你的狗喜歡游泳嗎？牠超愛的！

examples.heading: ⑥ enjoy + 名詞

items.zh: 你喜歡那部電影嗎？喜歡，真的很好笑。

items.zh: 謝謝您的光臨。希望您住得愉快。

items.zh: 大家都很喜歡婚禮上的食物。

items.zh: 你在演唱會上玩得開心嗎？開心，那個樂團太棒了。

items.zh: 志工幫難民找到住處和工作。

items.en: Good sleep helps children to concentrate at school.
items.zh: 睡得好能幫孩子在學校專心。

examples.heading: ④ 請求：Can / Could you help me ...?

items.en: "Could you help me find the station?" "Sure. It's just round the corner."
items.zh: 你可以告訴我車站怎麼走嗎？好啊。就在轉角。

items.en: This house is terrible. Can you help me find something better?
items.zh: 這間房子很糟。你可以幫我找一間好一點的嗎？

items.en: Can you help me to write an email in English?
items.zh: 你可以幫我用英文寫一封電子郵件嗎？

items.en: "Could you help me choose a present for my mum?" "Of course. What does she like?"
items.zh: 你可以幫我挑一份送我媽的禮物嗎？當然好。她喜歡什麼？

examples.heading: ⑤ 主詞是東西或做法

items.en: A cup of coffee helps me wake up in the morning.
items.zh: 早上喝一杯咖啡能讓我清醒。

items.en: The photos helped the police catch the thief.
items.zh: 那些照片幫警察抓到了小偷。

items.en: Learning a few words in Spanish helped us make friends in Madrid.
items.zh: 學幾個西班牙文的字，幫我們在馬德里交到了朋友。

items.en: "Why do you read every night?" "It helps me to relax after work."
items.zh: 你為什麼每天晚上看書？看書能幫我在下班後放鬆。

examples.heading: ⑥ help + 原形動詞（沒有受詞）

items.en: Turning off the lights helps save energy.
items.zh: 關燈有助於節省能源。

items.en: Everyone in the village helped to build the new school.
items.zh: 村裡每個人都幫忙蓋了新學校。

items.en: "How can I help?" "You can help clean up after the party."
items.zh: 我能幫什麼忙？你可以在派對後幫忙打掃。

items.en: The money will help pay for the new library.
items.zh: 這筆錢會幫忙支付新圖書館的費用。

examples.heading: ⑦ 否定和問句

items.en: The medicine didn't help me sleep at all.
items.zh: 那個藥一點都沒幫我睡著。

items.en: "Did the map help you find the hotel?" "Not really. We got lost twice."
items.zh: 那張地圖有幫你們找到飯店嗎？沒有。我們迷路了兩次。

items.en: Shouting won't help the children to calm down.
items.zh: 大吼大叫不會讓孩子們冷靜下來。

items.en: Who helped you plan this party? It's amazing!
items.zh: 是誰幫你籌劃這個派對的？太棒了！

title: I like learning grammar.
translation: 我喜歡學文法。
name: like 加不定詞或動詞-ing
sentences: "What do you like about your new job?" "I like meeting new people."
My mum likes reading lots of magazines on the train.
We like travelling by car because we can stop anywhere.
"What's your sister's hobby?" "She likes taking photos of birds."
"Do you like living in the city?" "Yes, there's always something to do."
My grandfather likes walking his dog in the park every morning.
I like listening to music when I cook.
I like to work with my teacher after class.
My brother likes to get up early and go running.
"Where do you like to sit?" "Near the window, if possible."
On holiday we like to try the local food.
She likes to be on time, so she always leaves early.
My dad likes to read the newspaper with his coffee.
I don't like doing homework at college. It's too noisy.
My son doesn't like going to the dentist.
We don't like waiting in long lines.
"Do you want to go shopping?" "No, I don't like shopping at the weekend."
I don't like to eat at the college café. The food is cold.
My cat doesn't like to be alone.
She doesn't like to talk about her job.
I don't like to drive at night because I can't see well.
"Do you like cooking?" "Yes, I make dinner every night."
"Does your daughter like to swim?" "She loves it. She's in the school team."
"What do you like doing on Sundays?" "I like sleeping late!"
"Did you like living in Tokyo?" "Yes, but it was very expensive."
When I was a child, I liked climbing trees.
My grandmother liked to sing while she cooked.
We liked staying at that hotel because the staff were so kind.
I like swimming in the sea in summer.
My kids like running around in the garden after dinner.
Our neighbour likes making cakes for everyone on the street.

examples.heading: ① like + 動詞-ing

items.en: "What do you like about your new job?" "I like meeting new people."
items.zh: 你喜歡新工作的什麼？我喜歡認識新的人。

items.en: My mum likes reading lots of magazines on the train.
items.zh: 我媽喜歡在火車上看很多雜誌。

items.en: We like travelling by car because we can stop anywhere.
items.zh: 我們喜歡開車旅行，因為想停哪裡就停哪裡。

items.en: "What's your sister's hobby?" "She likes taking photos of birds."
items.zh: 你妹妹的嗜好是什麼？她喜歡拍鳥的照片。

items.en: "Do you like living in the city?" "Yes, there's always something to do."
items.zh: 你喜歡住在城市嗎？喜歡，總是有事可以做。

items.en: My grandfather likes walking his dog in the park every morning.
items.zh: 我爺爺喜歡每天早上去公園遛狗。

items.en: I like listening to music when I cook.
items.zh: 我喜歡邊煮飯邊聽音樂。

examples.heading: ② like + to + 原形動詞

items.en: I like to work with my teacher after class.
items.zh: 我喜歡下課後跟老師一起做功課。

items.en: My brother likes to get up early and go running.
items.zh: 我哥喜歡早起去跑步。

items.en: "Where do you like to sit?" "Near the window, if possible."
items.zh: 你喜歡坐哪裡？可以的話靠窗。

items.en: On holiday we like to try the local food.
items.zh: 度假的時候，我們喜歡吃當地的食物。

items.en: She likes to be on time, so she always leaves early.
items.zh: 她喜歡準時，所以總是很早出門。

items.en: My dad likes to read the newspaper with his coffee.
items.zh: 我爸喜歡邊喝咖啡邊看報紙。

examples.heading: ③ don't like + 動詞-ing

items.en: I don't like doing homework at college. It's too noisy.
items.zh: 我不喜歡在學校寫功課。太吵了。

items.en: My son doesn't like going to the dentist.
items.zh: 我兒子不喜歡去看牙醫。

items.en: We don't like waiting in long lines.
items.zh: 我們不喜歡排很長的隊。

items.en: "Do you want to go shopping?" "No, I don't like shopping at the weekend."
items.zh: 你想去逛街嗎？不要，我不喜歡週末逛街。

examples.heading: ④ don't like + to + 原形動詞

items.en: I don't like to eat at the college café. The food is cold.
items.zh: 我不喜歡在學校的咖啡廳吃飯。東西都冷冷的。

items.en: My cat doesn't like to be alone.
items.zh: 我的貓不喜歡單獨待著。

items.en: She doesn't like to talk about her job.
items.zh: 她不喜歡談她的工作。

items.en: I don't like to drive at night because I can't see well.
items.zh: 我不喜歡晚上開車，因為我看不太清楚。

examples.heading: ⑤ 問句

items.en: "Do you like cooking?" "Yes, I make dinner every night."
items.zh: 你喜歡煮飯嗎？喜歡，我每天晚上都煮晚餐。

items.en: "Does your daughter like to swim?" "She loves it. She's in the school team."
items.zh: 你女兒喜歡游泳嗎？她超愛的。她是學校游泳隊的。

items.en: "What do you like doing on Sundays?" "I like sleeping late!"
items.zh: 你星期天喜歡做什麼？我喜歡睡晚一點！

items.en: "Did you like living in Tokyo?" "Yes, but it was very expensive."
items.zh: 你喜歡住在東京嗎？喜歡，可是很貴。

examples.heading: ⑥ 過去：liked

items.en: When I was a child, I liked climbing trees.
items.zh: 我小時候喜歡爬樹。

items.en: My grandmother liked to sing while she cooked.
items.zh: 我奶奶以前喜歡邊煮飯邊唱歌。

items.en: We liked staying at that hotel because the staff were so kind.
items.zh: 我們喜歡住那家飯店，因為員工都很親切。

examples.heading: ⑦ 動詞-ing 的拼法

items.en: I like swimming in the sea in summer.
items.zh: 我喜歡夏天在海裡游泳。

items.en: My kids like running around in the garden after dinner.
items.zh: 我的孩子喜歡晚餐後在院子裡跑來跑去。

items.en: Our neighbour likes making cakes for everyone on the street.
items.zh: 我們的鄰居喜歡做蛋糕給整條街的人。

title: It looks good on you.
translation: 這個你穿起來很好看。
name: 連綴動詞加補語（較多種）
sentences: Try this hat. It looks great with your coat.
You look pale this morning. Are you feeling OK?
The cake looks delicious. Can I have some?
Your garden looks lovely in spring.
I'd like to join the art class because it sounds interesting.
A picnic on Sunday? That sounds great.
You sound worried. What's wrong?
His plan sounds a bit dangerous to me.
I feel sorry for you. I hope you get better soon.
Can we stop the car? I feel dizzy on these mountain roads.
The new carpet feels soft under my feet.
We felt very happy after the match.
Wear something over your clothes, so they won't get dirty.
It gets dark early in winter.
Hurry up! Your dinner is getting cold.
My grandmother gets tired quickly these days.
After the trip, the two boys became close friends.
She became a doctor after ten years of study.
The weather became very hot in July.
The town became famous after the film.
Something smells good. Are you cooking?
This milk tastes strange. Is it old?
The fresh sheets smell lovely after a day in the sun.
Grandma's apple pie always tastes amazing.
The film looked boring, so we didn't go.
Her voice sounded strange on the phone.
My son felt proud when he scored his first goal.
It got very cold in the night.
Do I look OK in this dress?
How does my hair look? I cut it myself.
Does your ankle still feel sore after the run?

examples.heading: ① look + 形容詞

items.en: Try this hat. It looks great with your coat.
items.zh: 戴戴看這頂帽子。它跟你的外套很搭。

items.en: You look pale this morning. Are you feeling OK?
items.zh: 你今天早上臉色好蒼白，你還好嗎？

items.en: The cake looks delicious. Can I have some?
items.zh: 那個蛋糕看起來好好吃，我可以吃一點嗎？

items.en: Your garden looks lovely in spring.
items.zh: 你的花園春天看起來好漂亮。

examples.heading: ② sound + 形容詞

items.en: I'd like to join the art class because it sounds interesting.
items.zh: 我想參加美術課，因為聽起來很有意思。

items.en: A picnic on Sunday? That sounds great.
items.zh: 星期天去野餐？聽起來很棒。

items.en: You sound worried. What's wrong?
items.zh: 你聽起來很擔心，怎麼了？

items.en: His plan sounds a bit dangerous to me.
items.zh: 他的計畫我聽起來有點危險。

examples.heading: ③ feel + 形容詞

items.en: I feel sorry for you. I hope you get better soon.
items.zh: 我替你難過，希望你快點好起來。

items.en: Can we stop the car? I feel dizzy on these mountain roads.
items.zh: 可以停車嗎？在這些山路上我覺得頭好暈。

items.en: The new carpet feels soft under my feet.
items.zh: 新地毯踩起來好軟。

items.en: We felt very happy after the match.
items.zh: 比賽後我們覺得很開心。

examples.heading: ④ get + 形容詞

items.en: Wear something over your clothes, so they won't get dirty.
items.zh: 在衣服外面套件東西，這樣衣服才不會弄髒。

items.en: It gets dark early in winter.
items.zh: 冬天天黑得很早。

items.en: Hurry up! Your dinner is getting cold.
items.zh: 快點！你的晚餐要涼了。

items.en: My grandmother gets tired quickly these days.
items.zh: 我奶奶最近很容易累。

examples.heading: ⑤ become + 形容詞 / 名詞片語

items.en: After the trip, the two boys became close friends.
items.zh: 那趟旅行之後，兩個男孩成了好朋友。

items.en: She became a doctor after ten years of study.
items.zh: 她讀了十年書後成了醫生。

items.en: The weather became very hot in July.
items.zh: 七月天氣變得很熱。

items.en: The town became famous after the film.
items.zh: 那部電影之後，這個小鎮出名了。

examples.heading: ⑥ smell / taste + 形容詞

items.en: Something smells good. Are you cooking?
items.zh: 有東西好香，你在煮飯嗎？

items.en: This milk tastes strange. Is it old?
items.zh: 這牛奶喝起來怪怪的，是不是放太久了？

items.en: The fresh sheets smell lovely after a day in the sun.
items.zh: 新床單曬了一天太陽，聞起來好香。

items.en: Grandma's apple pie always tastes amazing.
items.zh: 奶奶做的蘋果派總是好吃得不得了。

examples.heading: ⑦ 過去式

items.en: The film looked boring, so we didn't go.
items.zh: 那部電影看起來很無聊，所以我們沒去。

items.en: Her voice sounded strange on the phone.
items.zh: 她在電話裡的聲音聽起來怪怪的。

items.en: My son felt proud when he scored his first goal.
items.zh: 我兒子進了他的第一球時覺得很驕傲。

items.en: It got very cold in the night.
items.zh: 夜裡變得很冷。

examples.heading: ⑧ 疑問句

items.en: Do I look OK in this dress?
items.zh: 我穿這件洋裝好看嗎？

items.en: How does my hair look? I cut it myself.
items.zh: 我的頭髮看起來怎麼樣？我自己剪的。

items.en: Does your ankle still feel sore after the run?
items.zh: 跑完步後你的腳踝還會痠痛嗎？

title: Alice was so unhappy that she remained silent for a long time.
translation: Alice 難過到好長一段時間都不說話。
name: 連綴動詞加補語（較多種連綴動詞）
sentences: The children remained quiet during the whole film.
The shop will remain closed until Monday.
Try to stay calm and call for help.
The weather stayed dry for the whole holiday.
Please remain seated until the plane stops.
Keep quiet! The baby's asleep.
Wear a hat to keep warm.
My grandmother keeps busy with her garden.
There are many ways of doing this, and it all seems very confusing.
After ten years away, the whole house appeared very unfamiliar to me.
Our new neighbours seem quiet, but we haven't met them yet.
The problem appears simple, but it isn't.
He seems to be very busy this week.
She appears to be the only person who knows the answer.
The shop seems to be closed today.
My face turned bright red when everyone started singing to me.
My father's hair has gone grey.
It was growing dark when we got home.
The milk has turned sour.
Korean food was new to me. It looked strange but tasted good.
Your idea sounds reasonable to me.
The kitchen smells wonderful. What are you cooking?
The exam proved more difficult than we expected.
The new system proved a great success.
His advice proved very useful.
They remained good friends after the divorce.
She remains the best player in the team.
The heating remained a problem all winter.
The children grew bored after an hour.
Everything stayed the same in the village.
The streets have become very crowded since the new shopping centre opened.

examples.heading: ① remain / stay + 形容詞

items.en: The children remained quiet during the whole film.
items.zh: 整部電影播放時孩子們都很安靜。

items.en: The shop will remain closed until Monday.
items.zh: 這家店會休息到星期一。

items.en: Try to stay calm and call for help.
items.zh: 試著保持冷靜，然後打電話求救。

items.en: The weather stayed dry for the whole holiday.
items.zh: 整個假期天氣都很乾爽。

items.en: Please remain seated until the plane stops.
items.zh: 飛機停下來之前請保持坐著。

examples.heading: ② keep + 形容詞

items.en: Keep quiet! The baby's asleep.
items.zh: 安靜！寶寶在睡覺。

items.en: Wear a hat to keep warm.
items.zh: 戴頂帽子保暖。

items.en: My grandmother keeps busy with her garden.
items.zh: 我奶奶忙著照顧她的花園。

examples.heading: ③ seem / appear + 形容詞

items.en: There are many ways of doing this, and it all seems very confusing.
items.zh: 做這件事的方法有很多，一切看起來都很混亂。

items.en: After ten years away, the whole house appeared very unfamiliar to me.
items.zh: 離開十年後，整間房子在我看來都很陌生。

items.en: Our new neighbours seem quiet, but we haven't met them yet.
items.zh: 我們的新鄰居好像很安靜，不過我們還沒見過他們。

items.en: The problem appears simple, but it isn't.
items.zh: 這個問題看起來簡單，其實不然。

examples.heading: ④ seem / appear + to be + 補語

items.en: He seems to be very busy this week.
items.zh: 他這個禮拜好像很忙。

items.en: She appears to be the only person who knows the answer.
items.zh: 她好像是唯一知道答案的人。

items.en: The shop seems to be closed today.
items.zh: 那家店今天好像沒開。

examples.heading: ⑤ turn / grow / go + 形容詞

items.en: My face turned bright red when everyone started singing to me.
items.zh: 大家開始對我唱歌的時候，我的臉變得通紅。

items.en: My father's hair has gone grey.
items.zh: 我爸爸的頭髮變白了。

items.en: It was growing dark when we got home.
items.zh: 我們到家的時候天快黑了。

items.en: The milk has turned sour.
items.zh: 牛奶已經變酸了。

examples.heading: ⑥ taste / smell / sound + 形容詞

items.en: Korean food was new to me. It looked strange but tasted good.
items.zh: 韓國菜對我來說很新奇。看起來很怪，可是很好吃。

items.en: Your idea sounds reasonable to me.
items.zh: 你的想法聽起來很合理。

items.en: The kitchen smells wonderful. What are you cooking?
items.zh: 廚房好香，你在煮什麼？

examples.heading: ⑦ prove + 形容詞 / 名詞片語

items.en: The exam proved more difficult than we expected.
items.zh: 那次考試結果比我們預期的還難。

items.en: The new system proved a great success.
items.zh: 新系統結果非常成功。

items.en: His advice proved very useful.
items.zh: 他的建議後來證明很有用。

examples.heading: ⑧ remain / appear + 名詞片語

items.en: They remained good friends after the divorce.
items.zh: 他們離婚後還是好朋友。

items.en: She remains the best player in the team.
items.zh: 她仍然是隊上最好的球員。

items.en: The heating remained a problem all winter.
items.zh: 暖氣整個冬天都是個問題。

examples.heading: ⑨ 過去式和完成式

items.en: The children grew bored after an hour.
items.zh: 一個小時後孩子們就覺得無聊了。

items.en: Everything stayed the same in the village.
items.zh: 村子裡的一切都沒變。

items.en: The streets have become very crowded since the new shopping centre opened.
items.zh: 自從新購物中心開幕後，街上變得很擁擠。

title: It was very nice.
translation: 那真的很不錯。
name: be 動詞當連綴動詞
sentences: "How was the restaurant?" "It was very nice. You should try it."
I like my home because it's not too big and it's very quiet.
"Are you OK?" "I'm fine, thanks. I'm just tired."
The shoes were cheap, but they're really comfortable.
My teacher is very kind, and her lessons are never boring.
We were so hungry after the long walk.
"What does your mother do?" "She's a doctor at the city hospital."
Tom and I are good friends. We were classmates at school.
This is my brother, and that's his wife.
It's a very nice flat with a big kitchen.
"Who was your favourite teacher?" "Mr Lin. He was my maths teacher."
Hi, my name is Anna and I'm 22 years old.
"How old is your daughter?" "She's six."
My grandfather was 90 when he learned to use a smartphone.
Our cat is almost fifteen years old.
"Where are my keys?" "They're on the kitchen table."
Sorry I can't come. I'm at the dentist's.
We were in Paris last week for my sister's wedding.
"Is Mum here?" "No, she's in the garden."
The film wasn't very good, so we left early.
"Do you want some cake?" "No, thanks. I'm not hungry right now."
You can borrow my bike. The seat isn't very high.
I knocked on the door, but my neighbours weren't in.
"Is it far from here?" "No, it's only five minutes on foot."
"Were you busy yesterday?" "Yes, I was at work until ten."
"Are your parents from Tainan?" "My dad is, but my mum isn't."
"Was the hotel clean?" "Yes, and the staff were very friendly."
Dear Sam, thank you for the birthday card. It was a lovely surprise.
My village is small, but the people are very friendly.
The weather was terrible last weekend, so we stayed at home.
My new job is hard, but my boss is patient.

examples.heading: ① 主詞補語是形容詞

items.en: "How was the restaurant?" "It was very nice. You should try it."
items.zh: 那家餐廳怎麼樣？很不錯。你應該去吃吃看。

items.en: I like my home because it's not too big and it's very quiet.
items.zh: 我喜歡我家，因為它不會太大，而且很安靜。

items.en: "Are you OK?" "I'm fine, thanks. I'm just tired."
items.zh: 你還好嗎？我很好，謝謝。我只是累了。

items.en: The shoes were cheap, but they're really comfortable.
items.zh: 這雙鞋很便宜，可是穿起來真的很舒服。

items.en: My teacher is very kind, and her lessons are never boring.
items.zh: 我的老師人很好，她的課從來不無聊。

items.en: We were so hungry after the long walk.
items.zh: 走了那麼久，我們好餓。

examples.heading: ② 主詞補語是名詞

items.en: "What does your mother do?" "She's a doctor at the city hospital."
items.zh: 你媽媽做什麼工作？她是市立醫院的醫生。

items.en: Tom and I are good friends. We were classmates at school.
items.zh: Tom 和我是好朋友。我們以前是同學。

items.en: This is my brother, and that's his wife.
items.zh: 這是我哥哥，那是他太太。

items.en: It's a very nice flat with a big kitchen.
items.zh: 那是一間很不錯的公寓，有一個大廚房。

items.en: "Who was your favourite teacher?" "Mr Lin. He was my maths teacher."
items.zh: 你最喜歡哪個老師？林老師。他是我的數學老師。

examples.heading: ③ 主詞補語是年齡

items.en: Hi, my name is Anna and I'm 22 years old.
items.zh: 嗨，我叫 Anna，今年二十二歲。

items.en: "How old is your daughter?" "She's six."
items.zh: 你女兒幾歲？她六歲。

items.en: My grandfather was 90 when he learned to use a smartphone.
items.zh: 我爺爺九十歲才學會用智慧型手機。

items.en: Our cat is almost fifteen years old.
items.zh: 我們的貓快十五歲了。

examples.heading: ④ 主詞補語是地點

items.en: "Where are my keys?" "They're on the kitchen table."
items.zh: 我的鑰匙在哪裡？在廚房的桌子上。

items.en: Sorry I can't come. I'm at the dentist's.
items.zh: 抱歉我沒辦法去。我在牙醫診所。

items.en: We were in Paris last week for my sister's wedding.
items.zh: 我們上星期在巴黎參加我姊姊的婚禮。

items.en: "Is Mum here?" "No, she's in the garden."
items.zh: 媽媽在這裡嗎？不在，她在花園裡。

examples.heading: ⑤ 否定

items.en: The film wasn't very good, so we left early.
items.zh: 那部電影不太好看，所以我們提早走了。

items.en: "Do you want some cake?" "No, thanks. I'm not hungry right now."
items.zh: 你要吃點蛋糕嗎？不用了，謝謝。我現在不餓。

items.en: You can borrow my bike. The seat isn't very high.
items.zh: 你可以借我的腳踏車。座墊不會很高。

items.en: I knocked on the door, but my neighbours weren't in.
items.zh: 我敲了門，可是我的鄰居不在家。

examples.heading: ⑥ 問句

items.en: "Is it far from here?" "No, it's only five minutes on foot."
items.zh: 離這裡遠嗎？不遠，走路只要五分鐘。

items.en: "Were you busy yesterday?" "Yes, I was at work until ten."
items.zh: 你昨天很忙嗎？對，我工作到十點。

items.en: "Are your parents from Tainan?" "My dad is, but my mum isn't."
items.zh: 你爸媽是台南人嗎？我爸是，我媽不是。

items.en: "Was the hotel clean?" "Yes, and the staff were very friendly."
items.zh: 那家飯店乾淨嗎？乾淨，而且員工都很友善。

examples.heading: ⑦ 寫信和作文

items.en: Dear Sam, thank you for the birthday card. It was a lovely surprise.
items.zh: 親愛的 Sam，謝謝你的生日卡。真是個驚喜。

items.en: My village is small, but the people are very friendly.
items.zh: 我的村子很小，可是那裡的人都很友善。

items.en: The weather was terrible last weekend, so we stayed at home.
items.zh: 上週末天氣很糟，所以我們待在家裡。

items.en: My new job is hard, but my boss is patient.
items.zh: 我的新工作很難，可是我的老闆很有耐心。

title: The color blue always looks fresh.
translation: 藍色看起來總是很清新。
name: 連綴動詞加形容詞
sentences: My bedroom will be blue because blue always looks fresh.
"You look tired. Are you OK?" "I didn't sleep well last night."
I painted the walls white, and now the room looks much bigger.
That jacket looks great on you. You should buy it.
"Let's have a picnic on Saturday." "That sounds lovely!"
"Are you all right? You sound worried." "My son isn't home yet."
The new singer sounds a bit nervous tonight.
"Mm, something smells good!" "I'm baking bread."
Don't drink that milk. It smells strange.
"How's the soup?" "It tastes a bit salty."
These strawberries taste really sweet.
I feel much better today, thanks. I'll come to work tomorrow.
"How do you feel?" "I feel a bit sick. I think it was the fish."
"Is the water warm?" "No, it feels very cold!"
My new shoes feel comfortable, so I wear them every day.
"Should we keep walking?" "No, it's getting dark. Let's go back to the car."
"Can you turn on the heater?" "Sure. It's getting cold in here."
In autumn the leaves in our street turn yellow.
My grandfather's hair went white when he was forty.
The city became very busy after the new station opened.
When the teacher called my name, my face went red.
Your new boss seems very friendly.
"Is Anna angry with me?" "She seems a bit upset."
"Can I talk during the film?" "No, you have to keep quiet in the cinema."
Drink lots of water to stay healthy in summer.
"Is the library open tonight?" "Yes, it stays open late during exams."
I like the light green walls in my room. They make me feel calm.
Thank you for your kind letter. It made me feel much better.
"Do you like my new glasses?" "Yes, they make you look younger."
A big mirror on that wall will make the room look wider.
Add some lemon. It makes the fish taste fresher.

examples.heading: ① look + 形容詞

items.en: My bedroom will be blue because blue always looks fresh.
items.zh: 我的臥室要漆成藍色，因為藍色看起來總是很清新。

items.en: "You look tired. Are you OK?" "I didn't sleep well last night."
items.zh: 你看起來很累。你還好嗎？我昨晚沒睡好。

items.en: I painted the walls white, and now the room looks much bigger.
items.zh: 我把牆漆成白色，現在房間看起來大多了。

items.en: That jacket looks great on you. You should buy it.
items.zh: 那件外套你穿起來很好看。你應該買。

examples.heading: ② sound + 形容詞

items.en: "Let's have a picnic on Saturday." "That sounds lovely!"
items.zh: 我們星期六去野餐吧。聽起來好棒！

items.en: "Are you all right? You sound worried." "My son isn't home yet."
items.zh: 你還好嗎？你聽起來很擔心。我兒子還沒回家。

items.en: The new singer sounds a bit nervous tonight.
items.zh: 那個新歌手今晚聽起來有點緊張。

examples.heading: ③ smell / taste + 形容詞

items.en: "Mm, something smells good!" "I'm baking bread."
items.zh: 嗯，好香！我在烤麵包。

items.en: Don't drink that milk. It smells strange.
items.zh: 別喝那瓶牛奶。它聞起來怪怪的。

items.en: "How's the soup?" "It tastes a bit salty."
items.zh: 湯怎麼樣？嚐起來有點鹹。

items.en: These strawberries taste really sweet.
items.zh: 這些草莓吃起來好甜。

examples.heading: ④ feel + 形容詞

items.en: I feel much better today, thanks. I'll come to work tomorrow.
items.zh: 我今天覺得好多了，謝謝。我明天會去上班。

items.en: "How do you feel?" "I feel a bit sick. I think it was the fish."
items.zh: 你覺得怎麼樣？我覺得有點想吐。應該是那條魚的關係。

items.en: "Is the water warm?" "No, it feels very cold!"
items.zh: 水是溫的嗎？不是，摸起來好冰！

items.en: My new shoes feel comfortable, so I wear them every day.
items.zh: 我的新鞋穿起來很舒服，所以我每天都穿。

examples.heading: ⑤ get / become / go / turn + 形容詞

items.en: "Should we keep walking?" "No, it's getting dark. Let's go back to the car."
items.zh: 我們要繼續走嗎？不要，天快黑了。我們回車上吧。

items.en: "Can you turn on the heater?" "Sure. It's getting cold in here."
items.zh: 你可以開暖氣嗎？好啊。這裡越來越冷了。

items.en: In autumn the leaves in our street turn yellow.
items.zh: 秋天的時候，我們這條街上的葉子會變黃。

items.en: My grandfather's hair went white when he was forty.
items.zh: 我爺爺四十歲的時候頭髮就白了。

items.en: The city became very busy after the new station opened.
items.zh: 新車站開了以後，這座城市變得很熱鬧。

items.en: When the teacher called my name, my face went red.
items.zh: 老師叫到我名字的時候，我的臉都紅了。

examples.heading: ⑥ seem / stay / keep + 形容詞

items.en: Your new boss seems very friendly.
items.zh: 你的新老闆好像很友善。

items.en: "Is Anna angry with me?" "She seems a bit upset."
items.zh: Anna 在生我的氣嗎？她好像有點不高興。

items.en: "Can I talk during the film?" "No, you have to keep quiet in the cinema."
items.zh: 看電影的時候我可以講話嗎？不行，在電影院裡要保持安靜。

items.en: Drink lots of water to stay healthy in summer.
items.zh: 夏天要多喝水來保持健康。

items.en: "Is the library open tonight?" "Yes, it stays open late during exams."
items.zh: 圖書館今晚有開嗎？有，考試期間會開到很晚。

examples.heading: ⑦ make + 受詞 + 連綴動詞 + 形容詞

items.en: I like the light green walls in my room. They make me feel calm.
items.zh: 我喜歡我房間的淡綠色牆壁。它們讓我覺得很平靜。

items.en: Thank you for your kind letter. It made me feel much better.
items.zh: 謝謝你的貼心來信。它讓我覺得好多了。

items.en: "Do you like my new glasses?" "Yes, they make you look younger."
items.zh: 你喜歡我的新眼鏡嗎？喜歡，它讓你看起來更年輕。

items.en: A big mirror on that wall will make the room look wider.
items.zh: 在那面牆上掛一面大鏡子，會讓房間看起來比較寬。

items.en: Add some lemon. It makes the fish taste fresher.
items.zh: 加點檸檬。它會讓魚吃起來比較清爽。

title: He gets up at six o'clock and goes to work.
translation: 他六點起床，然後去上班。
name: 規則和不規則的一般動詞
sentences: "Where do you live?" "I live near the station."
You know, I love your cooking!
We have English lessons on Mondays and Thursdays.
My grandparents grow vegetables in their garden.
"What do your kids do after school?" "They play football in the park."
My brother works at a hotel, so he gets home very late.
"Is your new teacher nice?" "Yes, she speaks very slowly and smiles a lot."
Our dog sleeps on the sofa every afternoon.
The shop opens at nine and closes at six.
My best friend lives in Kaohsiung, and she visits me every summer.
My dad watches the news every night after dinner.
Every morning my mum goes for a walk before breakfast.
My sister studies at a university in Tainan.
My new friend has long, dark hair and brown eyes.
"Does the hotel have a pool?" "Yes, it has a big one on the roof."
My grandmother lived in a small village by the sea.
We played cards all evening because it rained.
"Did you have a good weekend?" "Yes, I cleaned the flat and watched a film."
She studied hard and passed all her exams.
I called you three times yesterday, but you didn't answer.
When I was a child, I often went to my grandmother's house.
I heard from our neighbours about your new job. Congratulations!
"How was Japan?" "Wonderful. We saw Mount Fuji from the train."
He got up late this morning and missed the bus.
"Where did you buy that jacket?" "I bought it in Tokyo last year."
My parents came to Taiwan in 1990.
Every day she gets up at seven and makes coffee.
My uncle sells old books and repairs clocks.
Last night we cooked dinner and ate it on the balcony.
After the meeting, he went back to his desk and wrote the report.
On Saturdays my son wakes up early and plays video games.

examples.heading: ① 現在簡單式：主詞是 I、you、we、they

items.en: "Where do you live?" "I live near the station."
items.zh: 你住在哪裡？我住在車站附近。

items.en: You know, I love your cooking!
items.zh: 你知道嗎，我好愛你做的菜！

items.en: We have English lessons on Mondays and Thursdays.
items.zh: 我們星期一和星期四有英文課。

items.en: My grandparents grow vegetables in their garden.
items.zh: 我爺爺奶奶在他們的院子裡種菜。

items.en: "What do your kids do after school?" "They play football in the park."
items.zh: 你的孩子放學後做什麼？他們在公園踢足球。

examples.heading: ② 現在簡單式：主詞是 he、she、it 或單數名詞，加 -s

items.en: My brother works at a hotel, so he gets home very late.
items.zh: 我哥在飯店上班，所以他很晚才到家。

items.en: "Is your new teacher nice?" "Yes, she speaks very slowly and smiles a lot."
items.zh: 你的新老師人好嗎？好，她講話很慢，而且常常笑。

items.en: Our dog sleeps on the sofa every afternoon.
items.zh: 我們的狗每天下午都睡在沙發上。

items.en: The shop opens at nine and closes at six.
items.zh: 這家店九點開門，六點關門。

items.en: My best friend lives in Kaohsiung, and she visits me every summer.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友住在高雄，她每年夏天都來看我。

examples.heading: ③ 現在簡單式：加 -es、y 改成 i、has

items.en: My dad watches the news every night after dinner.
items.zh: 我爸每天晚上吃完晚餐都看新聞。

items.en: Every morning my mum goes for a walk before breakfast.
items.zh: 我媽每天早上吃早餐前都去散步。

items.en: My sister studies at a university in Tainan.
items.zh: 我妹妹在台南念大學。

items.en: My new friend has long, dark hair and brown eyes.
items.zh: 我的新朋友有一頭深色長髮和一雙棕色的眼睛。

items.en: "Does the hotel have a pool?" "Yes, it has a big one on the roof."
items.zh: 那家飯店有游泳池嗎？有，屋頂上有一個很大的。

examples.heading: ④ 過去簡單式：規則動詞

items.en: My grandmother lived in a small village by the sea.
items.zh: 我奶奶以前住在海邊的一個小村子裡。

items.en: We played cards all evening because it rained.
items.zh: 因為下雨，我們整個晚上都在玩牌。

items.en: "Did you have a good weekend?" "Yes, I cleaned the flat and watched a film."
items.zh: 你週末過得好嗎？好啊，我打掃了公寓，還看了一部電影。

items.en: She studied hard and passed all her exams.
items.zh: 她很用功，所有考試都過了。

items.en: I called you three times yesterday, but you didn't answer.
items.zh: 我昨天打給你三次，可是你都沒接。

examples.heading: ⑤ 過去簡單式：不規則動詞

items.en: When I was a child, I often went to my grandmother's house.
items.zh: 我小時候常常去我奶奶家。

items.en: I heard from our neighbours about your new job. Congratulations!
items.zh: 我從鄰居那裡聽說你找到新工作了。恭喜！

items.en: "How was Japan?" "Wonderful. We saw Mount Fuji from the train."
items.zh: 日本好玩嗎？很棒。我們在火車上看到了富士山。

items.en: He got up late this morning and missed the bus.
items.zh: 他今天早上起晚了，沒趕上公車。

items.en: "Where did you buy that jacket?" "I bought it in Tokyo last year."
items.zh: 你那件外套在哪裡買的？我去年在東京買的。

items.en: My parents came to Taiwan in 1990.
items.zh: 我爸媽在一九九〇年來到台灣。

examples.heading: ⑥ and 連接兩個一般動詞

items.en: Every day she gets up at seven and makes coffee.
items.zh: 她每天七點起床，然後泡咖啡。

items.en: My uncle sells old books and repairs clocks.
items.zh: 我叔叔賣舊書，也修時鐘。

items.en: Last night we cooked dinner and ate it on the balcony.
items.zh: 昨天晚上我們煮了晚餐，在陽台上吃。

items.en: After the meeting, he went back to his desk and wrote the report.
items.zh: 開完會以後，他回到座位上寫報告。

items.en: On Saturdays my son wakes up early and plays video games.
items.zh: 每個星期六我兒子都很早起床，然後打電動。

title: She makes me smile when I'm sad.
translation: 我難過的時候，她總能讓我笑出來。
name: make、let 加原形不定詞
sentences: My best friend is so funny. She always makes me laugh.
"Why are you crying?" "This song always makes me cry."
The smell of the bakery made us feel hungry.
Don't make me laugh. I'm trying to be serious.
The long journey made the children feel tired and bored.
My mum made me tidy my room before I went out.
"Why are you so tired?" "My boss made me work until ten."
The teacher made the whole class stay after school.
You can't make him eat vegetables if he doesn't want to.
Try to make your parents understand how you feel.
You're eighteen now. Your parents should let you decide.
"Can I go to the party?" "OK, I'll let you go, but be home by midnight."
My landlord doesn't let us keep pets.
The guard let us take photos inside the museum.
My sister never lets me borrow her clothes.
Please read the plan and let me know if it is suitable for you.
"This box is heavy." "Let me help you."
Let me think about it and I'll call you tomorrow.
"Who's at the door?" "Let me see. It's the postman."
"I'm bored." "Let's go to the cinema."
It's late. Let's finish the rest tomorrow.
We've walked all morning. Let's stop and have lunch here.
My dad didn't let me drive his new car.
"Did the teacher make you rewrite the essay?" "Yes, all of it."
Will your parents let you go away by yourself?
"Can I stay up to watch the match?" "Ask your mum. She won't let you stay up after ten."
The cold weather made my hands hurt.
The new bridge lets people cross the river in five minutes.
The bad news made everyone go quiet.
"Can you read the board now?" "Yes, my new glasses let me see everything clearly."
Her kind words made me feel much better.

examples.heading: ① make + 受詞 + 原形動詞（讓人有反應）

items.en: My best friend is so funny. She always makes me laugh.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友好好笑。她總是能讓我笑。

items.en: "Why are you crying?" "This song always makes me cry."
items.zh: 你為什麼在哭？這首歌每次都讓我哭。

items.en: The smell of the bakery made us feel hungry.
items.zh: 麵包店的香味讓我們覺得餓了。

items.en: Don't make me laugh. I'm trying to be serious.
items.zh: 別逗我笑。我想正經一點。

items.en: The long journey made the children feel tired and bored.
items.zh: 長途旅行讓孩子們覺得又累又無聊。

examples.heading: ② make + 受詞 + 原形動詞（叫人做不想做的事）

items.en: My mum made me tidy my room before I went out.
items.zh: 我媽要我把房間整理好才能出門。

items.en: "Why are you so tired?" "My boss made me work until ten."
items.zh: 你怎麼這麼累？我老闆叫我工作到十點。

items.en: The teacher made the whole class stay after school.
items.zh: 老師叫全班放學後留下來。

items.en: You can't make him eat vegetables if he doesn't want to.
items.zh: 他不想吃的話，你沒辦法逼他吃蔬菜。

items.en: Try to make your parents understand how you feel.
items.zh: 試著讓你爸媽了解你的感受。

examples.heading: ③ let + 受詞 + 原形動詞（允許）

items.en: You're eighteen now. Your parents should let you decide.
items.zh: 你已經十八歲了。你爸媽應該讓你自己決定。

items.en: "Can I go to the party?" "OK, I'll let you go, but be home by midnight."
items.zh: 我可以去派對嗎？好，我讓你去，可是要在午夜前回家。

items.en: My landlord doesn't let us keep pets.
items.zh: 我的房東不讓我們養寵物。

items.en: The guard let us take photos inside the museum.
items.zh: 警衛讓我們在博物館裡面拍照。

items.en: My sister never lets me borrow her clothes.
items.zh: 我姊姊從來不讓我借她的衣服。

examples.heading: ④ Let me + 原形動詞（說要幫忙或請對方告訴自己）

items.en: Please read the plan and let me know if it is suitable for you.
items.zh: 請看一下這個計畫，跟我說它適不適合你。

items.en: "This box is heavy." "Let me help you."
items.zh: 這個箱子好重。我來幫你。

items.en: Let me think about it and I'll call you tomorrow.
items.zh: 讓我想一想，我明天打電話給你。

items.en: "Who's at the door?" "Let me see. It's the postman."
items.zh: 誰在門口？我看看。是郵差。

examples.heading: ⑤ Let's + 原形動詞（提議）

items.en: "I'm bored." "Let's go to the cinema."
items.zh: 我好無聊。我們去看電影吧。

items.en: It's late. Let's finish the rest tomorrow.
items.zh: 很晚了。剩下的我們明天再做吧。

items.en: We've walked all morning. Let's stop and have lunch here.
items.zh: 我們走了一整個早上了。我們在這裡停下來吃午餐吧。

examples.heading: ⑥ 否定和問句

items.en: My dad didn't let me drive his new car.
items.zh: 我爸不讓我開他的新車。

items.en: "Did the teacher make you rewrite the essay?" "Yes, all of it."
items.zh: 老師要你重寫作文嗎？對，整篇。

items.en: Will your parents let you go away by yourself?
items.zh: 你爸媽會讓你自己一個人出遠門嗎？

items.en: "Can I stay up to watch the match?" "Ask your mum. She won't let you stay up after ten."
items.zh: 我可以晚點睡看比賽嗎？問你媽。她不會讓你十點以後還不睡的。

examples.heading: ⑦ 主詞是東西或事情

items.en: The cold weather made my hands hurt.
items.zh: 冷天讓我的手很痛。

items.en: The new bridge lets people cross the river in five minutes.
items.zh: 新的橋讓大家五分鐘就能過河。

items.en: The bad news made everyone go quiet.
items.zh: 那個壞消息讓大家都安靜了下來。

items.en: "Can you read the board now?" "Yes, my new glasses let me see everything clearly."
items.zh: 你現在看得到黑板嗎？看得到，我的新眼鏡讓我什麼都看得很清楚。

items.en: Her kind words made me feel much better.
items.zh: 她親切的話讓我覺得好多了。

title: I'll be very happy to help you.
translation: 我很樂意幫你。
name: 情態動詞 can、will、would
sentences: "Can you swim?" "Yes, but not very well."
My grandmother is 80, but she can still walk up the mountain.
I can't hear you. The music is too loud.
"Can your son ride a bike?" "Yes, he learned last summer."
Can you bring some music with you to the dinner?
"Can I borrow your pen for a minute?" "Sure, here you are."
"Can I pay by card?" "Sorry, we only take cash."
You can stay at our house when you come to Taipei.
Students can't use their phones during the test.
Thank you for your invitation. I'll be very happy to come.
"Is it far?" "No, it will only take ten minutes."
My parents will be at home all day on Sunday.
Don't worry about the exam. You'll be fine.
Take a coat. It will be cold on the mountain.
"Someone's at the door." "Stay there. I'll go."
"We don't have any milk." "I'll get some on my way home."
"This bag is very heavy." "Don't worry, I'll carry it for you."
It's late. I'll call you tomorrow, OK?
"Will you be at the meeting tomorrow?" "Yes, I'll be there at nine."
"Will you feed the cat while I'm away?" "Of course."
"Will Anna come to the party?" "I don't know. I'll ask her."
"What would you like to drink?" "I'd like an orange juice, please."
I would like to eat some Spanish food tonight.
"Would you like to come to my birthday party?" "Yes, I'd love to!"
We'd like to thank everyone for coming to our wedding.
Dear Sir, I would like to book a room for two nights.
"Would you open the door for me, please?" "Of course."
I'd be very happy to show you around the city.
"Would you pass me the salt, please?" "Here you are."
Thanks for a lovely weekend. It would be great to see you again in the summer.
"Would Saturday be OK for you?" "Yes, Saturday is perfect."

examples.heading: ① can：能力

items.en: "Can you swim?" "Yes, but not very well."
items.zh: 你會游泳嗎？會，可是游得不太好。

items.en: My grandmother is 80, but she can still walk up the mountain.
items.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了，可是她還是能走上山。

items.en: I can't hear you. The music is too loud.
items.zh: 我聽不到你說話。音樂太大聲了。

items.en: "Can your son ride a bike?" "Yes, he learned last summer."
items.zh: 你兒子會騎腳踏車嗎？會，他去年夏天學會的。

examples.heading: ② can：請求和許可

items.en: Can you bring some music with you to the dinner?
items.zh: 你可以帶些音樂來晚餐嗎？

items.en: "Can I borrow your pen for a minute?" "Sure, here you are."
items.zh: 我可以借一下你的筆嗎？好啊，給你。

items.en: "Can I pay by card?" "Sorry, we only take cash."
items.zh: 我可以刷卡嗎？抱歉，我們只收現金。

items.en: You can stay at our house when you come to Taipei.
items.zh: 你來台北的時候可以住我們家。

items.en: Students can't use their phones during the test.
items.zh: 學生考試的時候不能用手機。

examples.heading: ③ will：未來的事

items.en: Thank you for your invitation. I'll be very happy to come.
items.zh: 謝謝你的邀請。我很樂意參加。

items.en: "Is it far?" "No, it will only take ten minutes."
items.zh: 遠嗎？不遠，只要十分鐘。

items.en: My parents will be at home all day on Sunday.
items.zh: 我爸媽星期天會整天在家。

items.en: Don't worry about the exam. You'll be fine.
items.zh: 別擔心考試。你會沒事的。

items.en: Take a coat. It will be cold on the mountain.
items.zh: 帶件外套。山上會很冷。

examples.heading: ④ will：說話時決定要做的事

items.en: "Someone's at the door." "Stay there. I'll go."
items.zh: 有人在門口。你待著。我去開。

items.en: "We don't have any milk." "I'll get some on my way home."
items.zh: 我們沒有牛奶了。我回家路上買一些。

items.en: "This bag is very heavy." "Don't worry, I'll carry it for you."
items.zh: 這個包包好重。別擔心，我幫你拿。

items.en: It's late. I'll call you tomorrow, OK?
items.zh: 很晚了。我明天打給你，好嗎？

examples.heading: ⑤ will：問句和請求

items.en: "Will you be at the meeting tomorrow?" "Yes, I'll be there at nine."
items.zh: 你明天會去開會嗎？會，我九點會到。

items.en: "Will you feed the cat while I'm away?" "Of course."
items.zh: 我不在的時候，你可以餵貓嗎？當然。

items.en: "Will Anna come to the party?" "I don't know. I'll ask her."
items.zh: Anna 會來派對嗎？我不知道。我去問她。

examples.heading: ⑥ would：would like

items.en: "What would you like to drink?" "I'd like an orange juice, please."
items.zh: 您想喝什麼？麻煩給我一杯柳橙汁。

items.en: I would like to eat some Spanish food tonight.
items.zh: 我今晚想吃點西班牙菜。

items.en: "Would you like to come to my birthday party?" "Yes, I'd love to!"
items.zh: 你想來我的生日派對嗎？好啊，我很想去！

items.en: We'd like to thank everyone for coming to our wedding.
items.zh: 我們想謝謝大家來參加我們的婚禮。

items.en: Dear Sir, I would like to book a room for two nights.
items.zh: 先生您好，我想訂一間房間住兩晚。

examples.heading: ⑦ would：Would you ...? 和 would be

items.en: "Would you open the door for me, please?" "Of course."
items.zh: 可以麻煩你幫我開門嗎？當然。

items.en: I'd be very happy to show you around the city.
items.zh: 我很樂意帶你參觀這座城市。

items.en: "Would you pass me the salt, please?" "Here you are."
items.zh: 可以麻煩你把鹽遞給我嗎？給你。

items.en: Thanks for a lovely weekend. It would be great to see you again in the summer.
items.zh: 謝謝你讓我度過一個很棒的週末。要是夏天能再見到你就太好了。

items.en: "Would Saturday be OK for you?" "Yes, Saturday is perfect."
items.zh: 星期六你可以嗎？可以，星期六剛好。

title: Please wear some of your old clothes because they might get dirty.
translation: 請穿一些你的舊衣服，因為衣服可能會弄髒。
name: 情態動詞（較多種）
sentences: We're painting the kitchen on Saturday. Please wear old clothes because they might get dirty.
"Is Tom coming tonight?" "He might come later. He's still at work."
Take a jacket. It may be cold by the lake in the evening.
Don't wait for me. I might not finish until seven.
The train may be late because of the snow.
"Where's my phone?" "It could be in your car."
Don't leave your bike there. Someone could take it.
"Who's that man with Anna?" "He could be her brother. They have the same eyes."
"The cinema bar is too noisy." "I agree. I think we should go somewhere else to have a drink after the film."
"I've had a headache for three days." "You should see a doctor."
"I failed the test again." "You shouldn't give up. Let's study together."
"What should I wear to the interview?" "A dark suit is best."
Your English is really good. You should apply for that job.
Visitors must sign in at the front desk.
I must remember to buy a card for Mum's birthday.
"This is a secret. You mustn't tell anyone." "I promise."
"Can I use my phone in the exam?" "No, you mustn't."
My passport is old. I must renew it before our trip.
When I was a child, I could climb any tree in the park.
I had a bad cold last week, so I couldn't go to work.
"Did you see the fireworks?" "Yes, we could see them from our window."
The music was so loud that we couldn't talk.
"Could you lend me ten dollars until Friday?" "Sure, no problem."
Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the museum?
"May I come in?" "Yes, please sit down."
Guests may use the pool from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.
"It's really hot in here." "Shall I turn on the fan?"
"Our guests arrive at six." "Shall I set the table now?"
"I'm bored." "Shall we go for a walk by the river?"
"These bags are so heavy." "Shall I carry one for you?"
"Mum is coming for lunch on Sunday." "OK. What shall we cook for her?"

examples.heading: ① might / may：可能

items.en: We're painting the kitchen on Saturday. Please wear old clothes because they might get dirty.
items.zh: 我們星期六要漆廚房。請穿舊衣服來，因為衣服可能會弄髒。

items.en: "Is Tom coming tonight?" "He might come later. He's still at work."
items.zh: Tom 今晚會來嗎？他晚點可能會來。他還在上班。

items.en: Take a jacket. It may be cold by the lake in the evening.
items.zh: 帶件外套。傍晚湖邊可能會冷。
