items.en: "What would you like to eat?" "Something light, please."
items.zh: 你想吃什麼？清淡一點的。

examples.heading: ⑦ 回答邀請

items.en: "Would you like to join our team?" "I'd like to, but I don't have time."
items.zh: 你想加入我們的隊嗎？我很想，可是我沒時間。

items.en: "Do you want to come to the cinema?" "Yes, I'd like to."
items.zh: 你想去看電影嗎？好啊，我想去。

items.en: "Would you like to stay for dinner?" "I'd like to, but my mum is waiting for me."
items.zh: 你要留下來吃晚餐嗎？我很想，可是我媽在等我。

examples.heading: ⑧ 否定：wouldn't like to

items.en: I wouldn't like to live in a big city. It's too noisy.
items.zh: 我不會想住在大城市。太吵了。

items.en: My sister goes to bed at nine, so she wouldn't like to work at night.
items.zh: 我姊姊九點就睡了，所以她不會想上夜班。

items.en: It's a very cold country. I wouldn't like to go there in winter.
items.zh: 那是個很冷的國家。我不會想冬天去那裡。

items.en: "Would you like to be famous?" "No, I wouldn't like to."
items.zh: 你想出名嗎？不，我不想。

title: What we need is a strong publicity campaign directed at young people.
translation: 我們需要的是一個針對年輕人的強力宣傳活動。
name: what 準分裂句
sentences: What I need right now is a cup of coffee.
What companies care about is profit.
What this town lacks is a decent cinema.
What she really wanted was a bit of respect.
What I like most about my job is the people.
What the team needs is a good coach.
What worries the parents is the traffic outside the school.
What tourists want is to see the real city.
What I'd love is to spend a year in Spain.
What we'd like is to finish the project by spring.
What he wanted was to be left alone.
What you should do is talk to your teacher.
What I did was call the bank straight away.
What we'll do is meet at the station at six.
What she does is check every report twice.
What they did was paint the whole house in a weekend.
What I found fascinating was that the story still feels fresh.
What surprised everyone was that he said yes.
What I didn't know was that the shop had closed.
What matters is that nobody was hurt.
What the guests liked best were the desserts.
What I miss most are my friends from school.
What I remember are the long summer evenings.
What the kids enjoyed most were the animals.
What upset her was the way he spoke to the waiter.
What made the trip special was the food.
What annoyed him was the noise from upstairs.
What we didn't expect was such a warm welcome.
A good night's sleep is what you need.
Honesty is what I value most in a friend.
That's exactly what I was going to say.

examples.heading: ① 焦點是名詞片語

items.en: What I need right now is a cup of coffee.
items.zh: 我現在需要的是一杯咖啡。

items.en: What companies care about is profit.
items.zh: 公司在乎的是利潤。

items.en: What this town lacks is a decent cinema.
items.zh: 這個小鎮缺的是一家像樣的電影院。

items.en: What she really wanted was a bit of respect.
items.zh: 她真正想要的是一點尊重。

items.en: What I like most about my job is the people.
items.zh: 我最喜歡我工作的一點是那裡的人。

items.en: What the team needs is a good coach.
items.zh: 這支球隊需要的是一個好教練。

items.en: What worries the parents is the traffic outside the school.
items.zh: 讓家長擔心的是學校外面的車流。

examples.heading: ② 焦點是 to + 原形動詞

items.en: What tourists want is to see the real city.
items.zh: 觀光客想要的是看到真實的城市。

items.en: What I'd love is to spend a year in Spain.
items.zh: 我很想做的是在西班牙待一年。

items.en: What we'd like is to finish the project by spring.
items.zh: 我們想要的是在春天前完成這個計畫。

items.en: What he wanted was to be left alone.
items.zh: 他想要的是別人不要管他。

examples.heading: ③ 焦點是原形動詞（What 子句用 do）

items.en: What you should do is talk to your teacher.
items.zh: 你該做的是去找你的老師談談。

items.en: What I did was call the bank straight away.
items.zh: 我做的就是馬上打電話給銀行。

items.en: What we'll do is meet at the station at six.
items.zh: 我們就這樣：六點在車站碰面。

items.en: What she does is check every report twice.
items.zh: 她的做法是每份報告都檢查兩遍。

items.en: What they did was paint the whole house in a weekend.
items.zh: 他們做的就是在一個週末內把整間房子漆完。

examples.heading: ④ 焦點是 that 子句

items.en: What I found fascinating was that the story still feels fresh.
items.zh: 我覺得很迷人的是，這個故事到現在還是很新鮮。

items.en: What surprised everyone was that he said yes.
items.zh: 讓大家意外的是他答應了。

items.en: What I didn't know was that the shop had closed.
items.zh: 我不知道的是那家店已經關了。

items.en: What matters is that nobody was hurt.
items.zh: 重要的是沒有人受傷。

examples.heading: ⑤ be 用複數

items.en: What the guests liked best were the desserts.
items.zh: 客人最喜歡的是甜點。

items.en: What I miss most are my friends from school.
items.zh: 我最想念的是學校的朋友。

items.en: What I remember are the long summer evenings.
items.zh: 我記得的是那些漫長的夏日傍晚。

items.en: What the kids enjoyed most were the animals.
items.zh: 孩子們最喜歡的是那些動物。

examples.heading: ⑥ be 用過去式

items.en: What upset her was the way he spoke to the waiter.
items.zh: 讓她不高興的是他跟服務生說話的態度。

items.en: What made the trip special was the food.
items.zh: 讓這趟旅行特別的是食物。

items.en: What annoyed him was the noise from upstairs.
items.zh: 讓他心煩的是樓上傳來的噪音。

items.en: What we didn't expect was such a warm welcome.
items.zh: 我們沒想到的是會受到這麼熱情的歡迎。

examples.heading: ⑦ 焦點放在句首

items.en: A good night's sleep is what you need.
items.zh: 你需要的就是好好睡一覺。

items.en: Honesty is what I value most in a friend.
items.zh: 誠實是我最看重朋友的一點。

items.en: That's exactly what I was going to say.
items.zh: 那正是我要說的。
